title_en: Visual self-organization-based method for constructing temporary communication network of unmanned aerial vehicle group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a temporary communication network of an unmanned aerial vehicle group based on visual self-organization. The method comprises the steps of establishing an unmanned aerial vehicle node system and a security audit management system to realize flight control and message encryption exchange, realizing airborne perception through a visual candidate site identification system, carrying out multi-mode data fusion and site scoring, realizing field autonomy and weighted election through a distributed voting and election system, determining a relay node, completing multi-hop path scheduling, monitoring and self-adaptive reconstruction based on a multi-hop relay and route maintenance system, and executing target detection, positioning and emergency reporting through a search and rescue positioning and situation returning system. The method can quickly recover the voice and data links when the ground communication facilities are damaged or unavailable, and enables the unmanned aerial vehicle group to autonomously and distributively identify the safe position and negotiate to establish a reliable multi-hop communication network under the condition of limited communication and energy, thereby supporting emergency rescue and positioning service.
assignees: RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ZHEJIANG UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY TAIZHOU

title_en: A kind of memory method for path navigation based on individual soldier's Intelligent visible glasses
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of memory method for path navigation based on individual soldier's Intelligent visible glasses, include the following steps：One, the building interior planogram data of command centre's transmission is received, the key element in data is extracted, is plotted on Intelligent visible glasses with block diagram form；Two, the location information of real-time reception inertial navigation set transmission, and the data received are saved in local data base；Three, according to inertial navigation location information, Intelligent visible spectacle plane schematic diagram is simultaneously switched to the layer by floor where judging individual soldier, matches coordinate relationship, map location point and progress path where drawing individual soldier；Four, judge whether be currently the state of withdrawing.The present invention is using Intelligent visible glasses as platform, comprehensive utilization inertial navigation technology, network transmission technology, can provide evacuation route for fire-fighting individual soldier in the case where dense smoke visibility is low and navigate, its is assisted safety quick to withdraw the scene of a fire.
assignees: 28TH RES INST CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORP

title_en: Building interior fire emergency navigation positioning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire emergency navigation positioning system and method in a building, wherein the system comprises handheld positioning devices, a fire emergency lamp, a first UWB transceiver and an intelligent sensor, wherein each handheld positioning device is provided with a UWB positioning tag and a second UWB transceiver; each fire-fighting emergency lamp is provided with a power supply, a display screen and a processor, a first UWB transceiver and an intelligent sensor are installed in each fire-fighting emergency lamp and are connected with the processor and the power supply, and the first UWB transceiver is used for sending corresponding signals and self positioning data to the processor when receiving UWB signals of a UWB positioning tag; the processor is used for calculating and sending positioning data and environmental data of the handheld positioning device, judging the unblocked condition of the channel and controlling the display screen to indicate an escape route according to the judgment result and the environmental data. The invention can provide the smooth condition of the internal passage of the building and the distribution condition of the trapped personnel for the fire fighters, and improve the disaster relief efficiency.

title_en: Fire scene escape-rescue combined system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire scene escape-rescue combined system based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises an escape suit arranged near a fire hydrant box of a fire safety key unit and a fire control room arranged on a fire rescue vehicle, wherein the escape suit is arranged in the fire control safety key unit; the escape suit is provided with a low-power-consumption wireless signal transmission module which is communicated with the outside in a severe environment and is implanted into a building escape route map, an indoor positioning system and an enhanced learning escape route planning algorithm based on Q-learning; the fire control room is provided with an information receiving module and an escape route guidance algorithm based on real-time fire and LSTM; in case of a fire, when the field personnel take the escape suit to move quickly, the line signal transmission module of the escape suit automatically starts to guide personnel to evacuate, and the line signal transmission module is communicated with the fire control room and the fire rescue vehicle in real time, so that the combination of fire scene self rescue and fire rescue personnel search and rescue is realized, the survival rate is effectively improved, and the damage degree of the fire scene personnel is reduced to the maximum extent.
assignees: SUZHOU INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY JIANGSU UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Robot-based indoor trapped person search and rescue guiding evacuation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot-based indoor trapped person search and rescue guide evacuation system and method, and belongs to the technical field of virtual simulation. The invention senses the environment by setting the number and the initial position of the robots, intelligently searches and rescues the indoor trapped people in disaster situations, collects the real-time three-dimensional image data of the scene, makes decision analysis and transmits the surrounding environment information to the scene rescue personnel in time. The evacuation method provided by the invention adopts the robot to perform simulation training, relies on a virtual reality technology, optimizes the evacuation path through an improved path planning algorithm, creates a more realistic evacuation environment and character reconstruction model, improves the evacuation efficiency, and can better simulate the real evacuation process, thereby providing references for effectively reducing casualties in personnel evacuation and establishing an optimal rescue scheme, having certain practical guiding significance, and being worth popularizing and using.

title_en: Coaxial double-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coaxial double-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. The vertical cylindrical fuselage is adopted, the coaxial double propellers provide power, and the control of the aircraft is realized by changing the direction of the pulling force and the rotating speed difference of the double rotors. The invention can also adopt GNSS positioning equipment and vision positioning equipment to respectively combine with IMU to form an inertial satellite integrated navigation and vision-inertial navigation synchronous positioning and map building VI-SLAM navigation positioning system, and can realize autonomous flight in both open environment covered by GNSS and closed and GNSS-rejected environment. The aircraft has the attributes of universalization, informatization, autonomy, intellectualization and the like, has a simple structure, low cost, high efficiency ratio, firmness and durability and convenient carrying, can provide global situation information of 'no-go, no-touch and no-see' parts of streets, indoors, jungles and the like, and completes the tasks of detection or search and rescue of closed and sheltered spaces of cities, jungles, indoors and the like.
assignees: SHENYANG AIRCRAFT DESIGN INSTITUTE YANGZHOU COLLABORATIVE INNOVATION RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Fire evacuation path planning method and system based on road seeker and A-algorithm
abstract_en: The application relates to a fire evacuation path planning method and a system based on a road finder and an A-algorithm, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining that a fire disaster occurs in a target area according to information acquired in real time on a perception site; acquiring the position information of trapped personnel in a target area; when the position elevation of the trapped person is higher than or equal to the position coordinates of the fire point, path planning is carried out according to a path finder mechanism based on a heuristic function under a fire scene until the position coordinates of all the trapped person are lower than the position coordinates of the fire point; when the position coordinates of the trapped person are lower than the position coordinates of the fire points, path planning is carried out according to a path planning mechanism based on heuristic function MOA under the fire scene. The application adopts a segmentation algorithm to plan. According to the position relation, two different path planning algorithms are adopted, the uncertainty of environmental change under a fire scene is fully considered, and the respective emphasis points under the two conditions are considered, so that the aim of combining safety and speed is fulfilled.

title_en: Route planning method for collaborative search and rescue of trucks and unmanned aerial vehicles in mountain area environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a path planning method for collaborative search and rescue of trucks and unmanned aerial vehicles in mountain environments, and belongs to the field of path planning. Establishing a refuge site selection model according to the data parameters by acquiring population and refuge data of a disaster-stricken area and terrain and road network data of the area; and acquiring evacuation results of population points by using the site selection model, determining rescue priority by using an analytic hierarchy process, establishing a path planning model for collaborative search and rescue of the unmanned aerial vehicle of the truck, and acquiring a search and rescue scheme corresponding to the site selection result. According to the method, a proper refuge site selection model can be established under a mountain area environment to optimize site selection results, and meanwhile, the search and rescue mode under the cooperation of the carrier truck and the unmanned aerial vehicle is optimized, so that the search and rescue efficiency is improved, and the method is suitable for collaborative search and rescue of the unmanned aerial vehicle of the truck in the mountain area environment.

title_en: Intelligent escape evacuation indication system of hydropower station and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of escape evacuation, in particular to an intelligent escape evacuation indicating system of a hydropower station and a control method thereof, comprising the steps of collecting three-dimensional space data and real-time operation parameters of the hydropower station, and establishing a digital twin model of the hydropower station environment; the method comprises the steps of carrying out risk assessment on a digital twin model to obtain a risk assessment matrix, optimizing an evacuation strategy of an action set according to a Q-learning algorithm to obtain an evacuation path planning table, embedding emergency constraint conditions into the evacuation path planning table, verifying path feasibility according to a Monte Carlo tree search algorithm, carrying out path reconstruction on a region with equipment blockage or structural damage, calculating the shortest safety distance of an alternative path according to the Dijkstra algorithm to obtain an optimized evacuation scheme, and carrying out noise suppression on a prediction result to obtain an evacuation instruction set. According to the invention, the Monte Carlo tree search and Dijkstra algorithm are used for rescheduling the alternative path, so that personnel can find the safest evacuation route, and the strain capacity of the system under complex and sudden conditions is improved.

title_en: Apparatus for determining the emergency situation of the old and the infirm
title_ko: 노약자의 응급 상황을 판별하는 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for determining an emergency situation of the elderly and infirm which senses a bio-signal of the elderly and infirm and whether the elderly and infirm enters a specific space through a contactless method by being arranged in a living space of the elderly and infirm, determines whether an emergency situation of the elderly and infirm occurs by sensing the bio-signal of the elderly and infirm, determines whether the emergency situation of the elderly and infirm occurs as the elderly and infirm pushes a button, and determines whether the emergency situation of the elderly and infirm occurs through a movement of a body of the apparatus. To this end, the apparatus comprises: a bio-radar; a warning sound occurring button; a gyro sensor; and a control unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 노약자의 응급 상황을 판별하는 장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 노약자의 주거 공간 내에 배치되어 노약자의 특정 공간 진입 여부와 노약자의 생체신호를 비접촉 방식으로 감지하고, 노약자의 생체신호 감지를 통해 노약자의 응급 상황 발생 여부를 판단하고, 노약자의 버튼 누름을 통해서도 노약자의 응급 상황 발생 여부를 판단하며, 장치 몸체의 움직임을 통해서도 노약자의 응급 상황 발생 여부를 판단하는 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Wireless intelligent ward nursing system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wireless intelligent ward nursing system, the system includes: hospital server, ward computer, medical staff mobile terminal, patient terminal, control signal transmitter, wireless sensing signal collector, threshold value alarm, remove the bar code scanner, hospital server and ward computer, medical staff mobile terminal, patient terminal interconnect, the ward computer is connected with control signal transmitter, wireless sensing signal collector, threshold value alarm, remove the bar code scanner, a plurality of wireless devices are connected to the control signal transmitter output, the wireless transmitter of a plurality of integrated sensors is connected to wireless sensing signal collector input. The utility model discloses accessible medical staff mobile terminal or patient terminal are long-range to look over the patient vital sign parameter condition through the sensor monitoring, but also the work of remote control wireless device, and the doctor's advice is perhaps looked over in the adjustment, and convenient operation can satisfy the treatment and the nursing needs under the emergency situation.

title_en: Method and system for identifying and filtering suspicious monitoring data
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for identifying and filtering suspicious monitoring data, which are applied to a software system in a central application server of a disaster prevention system, change the uncertainty of monitoring foreign matters through a sensor in the traditional mode, and find a hyperplane for dividing the boundary between a credible data space and a suspicious data space by carrying out meteorological data related statistical analysis on the weather and snow historical data of the disaster prevention system. Then comparing the newly received on-site real-time monitoring data, and if the newly received on-site real-time monitoring data falls into a suspicious data space, defining the newly received on-site real-time monitoring data as singular points, thereby realizing the identification and filtration of suspicious wind, rain and snow monitoring data; meanwhile, the invention can also effectively identify suspicious error data which does not exceed the measuring range, does not generate messy codes or negative values and meets the resolution condition, greatly reduces the false alarm and the missing report of the system, and timely reminds the maintenance department of the on-line maintenance, thereby ensuring the stability and the reliability of the system.
assignees: BEIJING NAT RAILWAY RES & DESIGN INST SIGNAL & COMMUNICATION LTD

title_en: Hydrogeology monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of hydrologic monitoring, in particular to a hydrologic geological monitoring method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of defining a hydrologic geological monitoring area, acquiring an early warning task, transmitting the early warning task to an unmanned aerial vehicle, acquiring video data of the monitoring area by utilizing video monitoring equipment which is pre-integrated in the unmanned aerial vehicle, judging whether trapped personnel exist in the monitoring area, if so, recording the real-time position of the trapped personnel, establishing a shouting tracking mechanism, starting a pre-integrated shouting device in the unmanned aerial vehicle, and playing evacuation voice; and activating the shouting tracking mechanism, selecting a safety area from the monitoring area, and generating emergency guiding information. According to the invention, by determining feedback information, rescue activities can be coordinated, blind search and rescue are avoided, distribution of trapped personnel is accurately mastered, a rescue scheme is optimized, invalid search can be reduced, a rescue path is optimized by generating rescue guidance, and early warning efficiency of hydrogeology monitoring is greatly improved.

title_en: Life detection alarm device in automobile
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a life detection alarm device in an automobile, which comprises a lock control module, a temperature detector, a time delay module, a life body detection sensor, a reminding module, a sound warning module and a control interface module, wherein the temperature detector receives command signals of the lock control module to open/close an automobile door and an automobile window and sends a temperature value and a delay time command; the life body detection sensor sends a life body information detection instruction after receiving the temperature value and the delay time instruction, the reminding module receives the life body information detection instruction to carry out acousto-optic reminding, the sound warning module receives the acousto-optic reminding to carry out reminding alarm or cancel operation outside the vehicle, and the control interface module receives the acousto-optic reminding to turn off the alarm device. When an accident life body appears in the automobile, the automobile gives an alarm, calls a telephone, sends a short message and the like to send a distress to a preset number, and a person receiving the distress carries out remote control operation on the automobile through the short message or the telephone to help the trapped person to escape, can talk with the inside of the automobile and monitor sound, images and the like.

title_en: A Fire Evacuees' Context- Information Providing Method and A System therefor
title_ko: 화재 대피자 상황정보 제공 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention comprises a CCTV; a flame/smoke sensor; a server which includes a person detection module, a context information module, a fire dynamics simulator (FDS), and a building exodus, receives images from the CCTV, and transmits the context information on evacuees in a building to an emergency operation center; a person characteristic information database which has person detection information, such as person patterns; a building information database which has information on the building, such as the drawing of the building; a detection information database which stores the person detection information by areas in the building; and an emergency operation center which receives the context information from the server in a fire and sends a rescue team to the building.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재 대피자의 상황정보를 종합방재 센터의 구조대에게 제공하는 시스템에 있어서, CCTV, 화염/연기 감지 센서,  상기 CCTV의 영상에서 사람을 검출하고 대피자의 수와 위치를 확인하는 사람 검출 모듈, 상기 사람 검출 정보와 상기 센서의 정보를 기반으로 대피자의 상황정보를 생성하는 상황 정보 모듈, 화재의 현상을 가상 모델링하는 시뮬레이션하는 FDS(Fire Dynamics Simulator), 건물 상주 인원들의 대피경로를 계산하는 Building Exodus를 포함하며, 상기 CCTV로부터 영상을 수신 받고 화재시 상기 건축물의 대피자에 대한 상황정보를 종합방재 센터로 전송하는 Server, 상기 사람 패턴과 같은 사람 검출 정보를 가지고 있는 사람 특징 정보 데이터베이스, 상기 건축물의 도면과 같은 건축물의 정보를 가지고 있는 건물 정보 데이터베이스, 상기 사람 검출 모듈에서 검출된 사람 검출 정보를 건축물 내부의 지역별로 저장하는 검출 정보 데이터베이스, 화재시 상기 Server로부터 상황정보를 수신 받고 구조대를 상기 건축물로 보내는 종합방재 센터로 이루어진 화재 대피자 상황정보 제공 시스템과,  
상기 CCTV으로부터 영상을 입력받는 영상 입력 단계, 상기 CCTV의 동작여부를 확인하는 CCTV 작동 여부 확인 단계, 상기 CCTV가 동작하지 않을 경우 경보를 제공하는 사람 검출 오류 경보 단계, 사람을 검출하는 사람 검출 단계, 화재가 발생하였는지 확인하는 화재 발생 확인 단계, 평시에 종합 방재 센터로 정보를 전송한 전송 주기를 확인하는 전송 주기 확인 단계, 사람 검출 정보를 상기 검출 정보 데이터베이스에 저장하는 사람 검출 정보 갱신 단계, 화재가 발생한 지역을 확인하고 FDS를 통해 화재 현상, 화재 위험 지역 및 인명 사상 지역 정보를 계산하여 화재 상황 정보를 계산하는 화재 상황 정보 확인 단계, Building Exodus를 통해 인명 가상 대피 정보와 잔류 인원에 대한 정보를 계산하는 화재 인명 정보 확인 단계, 사람 검출 정보와 화재 상황 정보, 화재 인명 정보들을 종합방재 센터로 전송하는 인명 상황 정보 전송 단계로 이루어진 화재 대피자 상황정보 제공 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 의한 화재 대피자 상황정보 제공 시스템 및 방법으로, 기존 건축물의 CCTV를 통해 화재시 대피인원 및 잔류 인원에 대한 상황정보를 획득하기 때문에 종래의 시스템들이 시스템 구축을 위해 생체 신호를 수집하는 센서, 위치 정보를 제공하는 센서, 상기 센서들로부터 정보를 수신 받는 PDA와 같은 장치들로 인해 시스템 구축이 어렵고 시스템 사용이 복잡한 종래의 문제점들을 해결할 수 있으며, 실시간으로 상기 건축물의 대피인원 및 잔류인원들에 대한 가상의 대피 정보를 정확하게 시뮬레이션하고 화재 현상 모델링을 기반으로 화재 상황을 정확하게 시뮬레이션하기 때문에 보다 정확한 인명 구조를 위한 정보의 수집이 가능하며, 상기 시뮬레이션정보, 사람 검출 정보를 실시간으로 종합방재 센터로 전송하여 구조대가 인명을 구조하기 위한 구조 시간의 단축과 정확한 구조를 하는데 효과적이다. 
또한, 평시에도 사람 검출정보를 전송하기 때문에 화재시 본 발명에 의한 시스템이 문제가 발생하게 될 경우 평시에 전송되어진 최근 정보를 기반으로 보다 신속하게 상기 건축물의 구조를 수행할 수 있다는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Managing evacuation of a building in real time
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an evacuation management system, EMS, (40, 52, 60, 100, 200) operative to provide real-time evacuation information for evacuation of a building triggered (S202) by an alarm notification, based on determining (S214) the precise real-time location of a personal ultra-wideband UWB device, as determined by a UWB real-time location system, RT L S, a controller determines (S210) a real-time evacuation plan specific to the personal UWB device, based on the individual evacuation plan and input from the building facility, defines (S208) and sends to each personal UWB device real-time guidance information providing to the person carrying the personal UWB device which direction to move to reach a guided safe area (S212). then, based on the location signal, UWB RT L SA calculates the updated location of the personal device and sends it to the evacuation management system.

title_en: A system based on ai and crowd dynamics invented to improve safety and efficiency while traveling in groups or clusters during crowded events like hajj and umrah
abstract_en: A wearable electronic travel aid device is disclosed for monitoring and guiding pedestrians in crowds, including those with visual impairments. The device uses positioning sensors and Al to generate accurate location estimations within a twenty-cubic-centimetre frame. It also includes a guidance communication system, audio signals, 3D Haptic communication, and a human-machine interface. The system uses RSSI and CSI techniques to characterise human presence and activities, and uses Wi-Fi fingerprinting for active localization. It is designed for crowd dynamics management, particularly for crowded Islamic rituals like Hajj. The system is based on active particle dynamics principles. The system uses particle dynamics to model crowds with discrete sets of pseudo-particles, allowing for realistic dynamic behaviour and event change detection. It also includes pedestrian dynamics, integrating groups of different sizes for crowded situations like Al Kaaba, Masjid al- Haram, and the Holy City of Makkah during Hajj or Umrah pilgrimages. The system uses clustering algorithms and supports vector machines to process pedestrians and optimize their paths. It also includes a dashboard for managing simultaneous requests and positioning data, ensuring safety for individual travellers or pilgrims. The dashboard uses big-data analysis to detect and predict crowd congestion in real-time, enabling timely interventions in emergencies or potential security threats. This crowd motion summarization approach can benefit industries such as public safety, event management, and urban planning by accurately estimating crowd density, predicting precise crowd motions, and forecasting trajectories. The system is designed to guide individuals to services such as restrooms, food, and medical care stations. It uses real-time crowd data analysis to estimate occupancy levels and propose alternatives. The system also functions as an intelligent traveling guide and companion, with a multitude of chatbots providing services like accommodation reservations, purchase requests, and site seeing. The bots use crowd dynamics to provide comprehensive guidance, hints, and alerts. They can assist with Islamic rituals, travel, tourism, and evacuation. The Evacuation Bot uses crowd dynamics and real-time data to manage evacuation procedures and ensure safety during emergencies. The Near Services Bot assists in finding nearby amenities and provides real-time updates on wait times. The system uses deep neural networks to suggest shortest paths and cost functions to ensure efficient and cost-effective travel.

title_en: Landslide safety monitoring system and early warning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide safety monitoring system and an early warning method thereof, and relates to the technical field of safety monitoring. The method comprises the steps of connecting a control end of a cloud server and landslide sensors buried in a soil slope to be monitored, wherein the landslide sensors are uniformly distributed on the soil slope to be monitored, soil layer tightness data and soil layer deviation data of different depths of installation points of the landslide sensors are obtained, the control end obtains the soil layer tightness data and the soil layer deviation data sent by the landslide sensors and combines a three-dimensional image of a region of the soil slope to be monitored, which is obtained in advance, to construct a three-dimensional soil layer monitoring model of the soil slope to be monitored, the control end obtains the data sent by the landslide sensors in real time and updates the three-dimensional soil layer monitoring model, if the three-dimensional soil layer monitoring model change exceeds a preset threshold value, the control end sends out landslide warning alarms, and the three-dimensional soil layer monitoring model change is a comparison value of the three-dimensional real-time soil layer monitoring model and an initial three-dimensional soil layer monitoring model, and the three-dimensional soil layer deviation is obtained.

title_en: Urban power grid fault early warning method and system based on expected fault set
abstract_en: The application provides an urban power grid fault early warning method and system based on an expected fault set, wherein the method comprises the steps of combining meteorological data with real-time monitoring data and operation data of a power grid to judge the type of disaster where the power grid is currently located; the method comprises the steps of receiving a target prediction model corresponding to a current disaster type, calling the target prediction model corresponding to the current disaster type to predict whether the power grid can fail, predicting the failure type after judging that the power grid can fail, optimizing super parameters of the target prediction model through a parameter adjusting tool, carrying out global risk assessment and disaster early warning on the power grid through an expected failure set, dynamically updating the model through an online learning algorithm and a model parameter self-adaptive adjustment algorithm based on real-time data flow, and carrying out failure prediction and risk assessment again based on the dynamically updated model. According to the method, prediction uncertainty is reduced through staged model prediction, and accurate fault prediction can be realized under various disaster scenes by combining dynamic updating of a prediction model and an expected fault set.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD WUXI POWER SUPPLY CO;UNIV CHINA AGRICULTURAL

title_en: Steam room and sauna emergency monitoring system and apparatus
abstract_en: A system for monitoring and responding to medical emergencies in high-humidity environments includes a processor, a memory storing computer-executable instructions, and a sensor array comprising motion detection, fall detection, and vital signs monitoring. The sensor array includes a steam-adaptive calibration configured to adjust detection thresholds based on vapor density and humidity levels. A privacy-preserving architecture processes non-identifiable inputs such as motion signatures, radar signals, or acoustic triggers without storing visual or audio recordings. When inactivity, collapse, or absence of respiration is detected for a predefined threshold period, the privacy-preserving architecture initiates a first notification to staff interface and response tools. If the first notification is not acknowledged within a predetermined escalation period, a secondary notification is transmitted. The system operates in real time to provide emergency alerts while preserving occupant privacy.

title_en: Fire fighter fire extinguishing protective clothing identification method and system based on AI artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of protective clothing identification, in particular to a fire-fighting protective clothing identification method and system based on AI artificial intelligence firefighters. The method comprises the steps of S1, collecting body type data of a firefighter and protective clothing data of fire extinguishment equipment of the firefighter, S2, accessing a video monitoring module of a rescue place, then establishing a three-dimensional space model of the rescue place by combining the video monitoring module, collecting video recording data of the firefighter at the rescue place, and sending the video recording data to the three-dimensional space model for supplementing, accurately obtaining key vital sign data such as temperature, humidity and heart rate of the firefighter in the protective clothing through a built-in sensor by monitoring the performance parameters of the protective clothing in real time, and immediately giving an early warning once the data exceeds a safety threshold value, so that the firefighter can know own situation danger in the first time, withdraw replacement equipment in time or take corresponding protective measures, and life safety of the firefighter in fire extinguishment rescue actions is practically ensured.
assignees: U PROTEC SHENZHEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent judging method for stability of highway slope rock mass
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent judging method for stability of a highway slope rock mass, which comprises the steps of obtaining rock mass displacement and moisture content of the highway slope rock mass, obtaining a rock mass internal mechanical property distribution diagram through finite element simulation, comparing the rock mass internal mechanical property distribution diagram with historical geological data, dividing the rock mass into a high uncertainty area and a low uncertainty area, extracting a deformation monitoring sequence from the high uncertainty area, classifying to obtain a deformation trend classification result, fusing the deformation trend classification result with the mechanical property of the low uncertainty area to generate a slope stability index map, updating rock mass fracture density and permeability, combining the updated fracture density, permeability and deformation trend, obtaining a instability probability distribution curve through probability simulation, generating an early warning signal according to whether a curve peak probability point is located in a safety interval, and outputting a slope stability judging report. The method improves accuracy and instantaneity of slope stability evaluation and obviously reduces geological disaster risks.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY NO 10 ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Firefighter location tracking system and method using Bluetooth-based indoor positioning and altitude sensor
title_ko: 블루투스 기반 실내 측위 및 고도 센서를 이용한 소방 대원 위치 추적 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 블루투스 기반 실내 측위 및 고도 센서를 이용한 소방 대원 위치 추적 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 시스템은 소방 대원이 휴대하는 스마트폰, 웨어러블 기기, 그리고 관제 서버로 구성된다. 스마트폰은 블루투스 모듈과 고도 센서를 이용하여 위치 정보를 측정하고, 웨어러블 기기는 스마트폰과 블루투스 통신을 통해 위치 정보를 수신하여 디스플레이에 표시한다. 관제 서버는 스마트폰과 웨어러블 기기에서 수신된 정보를 기반으로 소방 대원의 위치를 3차원 좌표로 계산하고, 이를 지도 상에 시각적으로 표시하여 소방 현장 지휘 및 효율적인 구조 활동을 지원한다. 
 
본 발명에 따르면, 블루투스 및 고도 센서를 이용하여 실내 환경에서 소방 대원의 위치를 정확하게 파악할 수 있으며, 저비용, 저전력으로 구현 가능하며, 유지보수가 용이한 위치 추적 시스템을 제공한다. 또한, 화재, 재난 등의 상황에서도 안정적으로 작동하는 강건한 위치 추적 시스템을 제공하며, 소방 대원의 위치 정보, 이동 경로, 층 정보, 상대적 위치 등 다양한 정보를 실시간으로 제공하여 소방 현장 지휘 및 효율적인 구조 활동을 지원할 수 있다.

title_en: Rescue worker Indoor Location Tracking System
title_ko: 구조대원 실내 위치 추적 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 구조대원 실내 위치 추적 시스템은, 복수의 실시간 위치추적용 무선태그의 무선신호를 수신하는 적어도 하나 이상의 앵커노드와, 구조대원의 몸에 부착되며 소정의 주기마다 실시간 위치추적용 무선태그를 자동투하시키는 태그 투하장치와, 상기 앵커노드로부터 수신된 상기 복수의 실시간 위치추적용 무선태그의 무선신호를 바탕으로 미리 설정된 위치측위방식을 이용하여 실시간 위치추적용 무선태그의 위치를 파악하는 위치 파악부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KUMOH NATIONAL INST OF TECHNOLOGY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Method and System for Determining the Delay of Digital Signals
abstract_en: A method of and system for determining the time required for a digital bit or bit stream to traverse a round-trip path from a source transceiver to at least one destination transceiver and back is disclosed. The relative timing of the transmitted bit or bit stream is compared to the return bit or bit stream using a high speed comparison configuration so as to provide in substantially real-time various measurements related to or derived from the time required to traverse the round trip path, including distance measurement in indoor positioning, real-time locating, adaptive cruise control, intelligent transportation systems, robotics, collision avoidance, personnel accountability, emergency location, search and rescue, loss and theft prevention, logistics, marine safety, network analysis, communication channel characterization, and other high-speed measurement tasks. In addition, a method of and system for determining the distance between a source transceiver and a destination transceiver, and a method of and system for determining the angular position of a transceiver with respect to at least two other transceivers, are disclosed.

title_en: Method and system for locating and monitoring first responders
abstract_en: The present invention is directed to methods and systems for locating and monitoring the status of people and moveable assets, such as first responders, including firefighters and other public service personnel, and their equipment both indoors and out. The invention can provide for locating and monitoring the status of people and assets in environments where GPS systems do not operate, or where operation is impaired or otherwise limited. The system and method uses inertial navigation to determine the location, motion and orientation of the personnel or assets and communicates with an external monitoring station to receive requests for location, motion orientation and status information and to transmit the location, motion orientation and status information to the monitoring station.

title_en: System and method for non-invasive instantaneous and continuous measurement of cardiac chamber volume.
abstract_en: A system and method for non-invasive and continuous measurement of cardiac chamber volume and derivative parameters including stroke volume, cardiac output and ejection fraction comprising an ultrawideband radar system having a trans-mitting and receiving antenna for applying ultrawideband radio signals to a target area of a subject's anatomy wherein the receiving antenna collects and transmits signal returns from the target area which are then delivered to a data processing unit, such as an integrated processor or PDA, having software and hardware used to process the signal returns to produce a value for cardiac stroke volume and changes in cardiac stroke volume supporting multiple diagnostic requirements for emergency response and medical personnel whether located in the battlefield, at a disaster site or at a hospital or other treatment facility.

title_en: System for communicating location of survivors in mine emergencies
abstract_en: The disclosed system uses seismic signaling to locate survivors in a mine collapse. A separate transmitter with a specific pre-selected frequency or frequencies is placed in pre-positioned safety zones of a mine. The system generates frequency-locked, unmodulated seismic energy, which allows rescuers to identify the safety zone where a transmitter is activated. The transmitter comprises an oscillator that generates the signal. The oscillator drives the transducer. The transducer causes the inertial mass to move. The movement of the inertial mass generates the seismic waves, which are conducted through the pressure plate to the earth. The seismic signal is detected then amplified, filtered, converted and then processed. The use of a continuous signal enables the processing unit to identify the frequency of the signal with a very low error rate, using frequency content identification. The disclosure also describes a method for transmitting seismic waves through the earth using the above described system.
assignees: SQUIRE JAMES C;SULLIVAN GERALD A;FLATHERS III GEORGE W

title_en: Vertical take-off and landing multimodal, multienvironment, gyropendular craft with compensatory propulsion and fluidic gradient collimation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vertical take-off and landing gyropendular craft or drone device (FIG. 18) able to move around in the following different physical environments: in the air, on land, at sea, underwater or in space, comprising upper and lower propulsion units, equipped with an annular fairing accommodating a certain number of electronically slaved wing or gas-powered drive or propulsion units situated in the continuation of the axis of this device, mounted on 3-D swivels at the ends of a certain number of telescopic rods, for example set at 120° apart at the periphery of the platform and orientable about the three axes according to the plane of flight of the multimodal multi-environment craft, a vertebral structure by way of a 3-D articulated central body of solid or hollow cylindrical shape for forming a stabilized function of stabilizing, maintaining the position and heading, and of an inertial rotary disc platform equipped underneath with a cabin of hemispherical shape extending from the vertebral structure, accommodating a payload or a useful application, designed for various fields of application e.g. the sector of defence or civil security, so as to perform functions of search and rescue, exploration, navigation, transport, surveillance and telecommunications infrastructure deployment in free space.

title_en: Ultra-wide bandwidth radar type non-contact life parameter real-time monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wide bandwidth radar type non-contact life parameter real-time monitoring system which comprises a UWB (Ultra-Wide Bandwidth) radar front end and a signal processing display unit. The system can realize real-time and non-contact monitoring on physiological parameters of a human body, such as respiration, body movement signals, respiratory rate, and the like under the condition of penetrating through a thicker nonmetal obstacle. The ultra-wide bandwidth radar type non-contact life parameter real-time monitoring system is mainly used for the physiological parameter monitoring of patients which are not suitable for being connected with electrodes and a sensor in a ward, such as large-area burn patients, and the like, can be also used for carrying out non-contact real-time monitoring on buried wounded people (who can not be rescued in short time) in the disasters, such as earthquake, and the like and provides necessary reference for search and rescue staffs applying medical rescue to learn the vital sign condition of a rescued object at any time.

title_en: A location tracking system for a building indoor
title_ko: 구조물 실내 위치 추적시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A location tracking system for an inside of a building is provided to easily identify a rescuer from a command center by monitoring a location of the rescuer located in a building in real time. CONSTITUTION: A relay(102) is installed in an external fixed position of a building(101) for performing rescue. A terminal is worn by a rescuer entering the inside of the building. A command center(110) is installed outside the building. The command center receives final location information from the terminal. The command center manages the rescuer by displaying the location of the rescuer on a monitor. The relay includes a GPS(Global Positioning System) reception module, a reception data process module, and a wireless communication module.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 구조물의 내부에 진입하는 구조자의 위치를 실시간으로 지휘센터 또는 관제센터에서 확인 가능하여 용이하게 할 수 있고, 구조자가 위험상황에 처하였을 때에도 정확한 위치파악으로 신속하게 대처할 수 있도록 한 구조물 실내 위치 추적시스템에 관한 것으로서, 
구조작업을 수행하고자 하는 구조물의 외부 소정의 위치에 구비하는 중계기와, 구조물 내부로 진입하는 구조자가 휴대 또는 착용하는 단말기와, 상기 구조물의 외부에 설치되어 단말기로부터 최종위치정보를 제공받아 모니터에 구조자의 위치를 실시간으로 표시하여 추적 관리하는 지휘센터로 구성하는 것이 특징이다.

title_en: Target positioning method and device for airborne equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a target positioning method and a target positioning device for airborne equipment. The device comprises a signal processing unit, a laser distance measuring instrument, a thermal infrared imager, a visible light camera, a combined inertial navigation module and an angle meter, wherein output signals of the laser distance measuring instrument, the thermal infrared imager, the visible light camera, the combined inertial navigation module and the angle meter are all connected to the signal processing unit, and the signal processing unit is used for solving positional information of a target according to uploaded signals. Aerial carrier global positioning system (GPS) information, aerial carrier gesture information, angular deviation of observation equipment relative to an aerial carrier and distance measuring information of the target by the observation equipment are integrated to realize accurate positioning of longitude and latitude height of the target. The advantage of a multi-sensor is combined, a multi-dimensional spatial alternation principle is utilized so as to rapidly and effectively realize accurate target positioning in a non-contact and high-adaptability way, and the target positioning method can be applied to fields such as forest fire prevention, personnel rapid search and rescue and the like, and has wide technological and market prospects.
assignees: CAMA LUOYANG MEASUREMENT AND CONTROL CO LTD

title_en: Victim rescue support system and information processing method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a victim rescue support system which can be utilized without a limit of area or place, and also rapidly and efficiently locate victims' positions.SOLUTION: A plurality of portable base stations are installed at a disaster stricken area. Each of the portable base station generates position parameter information composed of a tag ID and a parameter for position estimation by communicating with an RFID tag carried by a victim via UWB-IR, and transmits the position parameter information to a positioning server. The positioning server estimates and stores a position of each RFID tag 100 on the basis of the position parameter information transmitted from the portable base station.

title_en: Target positioning device used for airborne equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates a target positioning device used for airborne equipment. The target positioning device includes a signal processing unit, a laser range finder of which output signals are connected into the signal processing unit, an infrared thermal imager, a visible-light camera, a combination inertial navigation module and a goniometer, wherein the signal processing unit is used for calculating position information of a target according to uploaded various signals. According to the target positioning device used for the airborne equipment of the utility model, aerial carrier GPS information, aerial carrier attitude information, angle deviation of observation equipment relative to a carrier aircraft, and ranging information of the observation equipment for the target are integrated so as to realize accurate positioning of the longitude, latitude and height of the target; the advantages of multiple sensors are combined, and a multidimensional space transformation principle is utilized, such that rapid, effective, non-contact, high-adaptability and accurate positioning of the target can be realized; and the target positioning device can be used in fields such as forest fire prevention, and rapid search and rescue, and has broad technical and market prospect.
assignees: CAMA LUOYANG MEASUREMENTS & CONTROLS CO LTD

title_en: System and method for performing indoor and outdoor 3D (Three-Dimensional) seamless positioning and gesture measuring on fire man
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for performing indoor and outdoor 3D (Three-Dimensional) seamless positioning and gesture measuring on a fire man. The system comprises a main control circuit board based on an STM32 (Scanning Tunneling Microscope 32) singlechip, a GPRS (General Packet Radio Service) data transmission module based on Sim-900, a GPS (Global Positioning System) module, a remote monitoring client side, an inertial navigation module I and an inertial navigation module II, wherein the main control circuit board is respectively connected with the GPRS data transmission module, the GPS module, the inertial navigation module I and the inertial navigation module II by virtue of serial ports; and the GPRS data transmission module communicates with the bound remote monitoring client side by utilizing a GPRS network. The system and the method can be used for realizing the indoor and outdoor 3D (Three-Dimensional) seamless positioning and gesture measuring for the fire man, accurately recognizing and judging the motion state of the fire man and meanwhile realizing the indoor and outdoor 3D seamless positioning for the fire man; aiming at the application occasion of the fire man, the system can be expanded to be provided with a poisonous gas sensor, a smoke sensor, a temperature sensor and the like, and has great significance in guaranteeing the life safety of the fire man working under a complex fire scene environment.

title_en: Firefighter indoor/outdoor 3D seamless positioning and attitude detection system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a firefighter indoor/outdoor 3D seamless positioning and attitude detection system. The system includes a main control circuit board based on an STM32 single chip microcomputer, a GPRS data transmission module based on Sim-900, a GPS positioning module, a remote monitoring client and an inertial navigation module I and an inertial navigation module II; the main control circuit board is respectively connected with the GPRS data transmission module, the GPS positioning module and the inertial navigation module I and the inertial navigation module II through serial ports; and the GPRS data transmission module is connected and communicates with the bound remote monitoring client through adopting a GPRS network. The firefighter indoor/outdoor 3D seamless positioning and attitude detection system of the utility model can realize firefighter indoor/outdoor 3D seamless positioning and attitude detection, can accurately identify and judge movement states of firefighters, and at the same time, can realize firefighter indoor/outdoor 3D seamless positioning; according to application occasions of the firefighters, the system can extend sensors such as a toxic gas sensor, a smoke sensor and a temperature sensor; and the system is of great significance in the protection of life safety of the firefighters who work in complex fire environments.

title_en: Method for performing two-dimensional wireless positioning on stationary node based on single mobile node
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for performing two-dimensional wireless positioning on a stationary node based on a single mobile node and relates to a wireless positioning method. The method comprises the steps of measuring information of acceleration, angular speed and the like through an inertial sensor to calculate the relative position of the mobile node; determining several point coordinates to serve as virtual positioning index points; and using measured distances between the stationary node and the index points during determination and a locating algorithm to calculate relative coordinates of the stationary node to the mobile node, and displaying the relative coordinates on a handheld device. According to the method for performing two-dimensional wireless positioning on the stationary node based on the single mobile node, search and rescue personnel can find persons in distress rapidly and accurately.

title_en: Human body target and surrounding structure compatibility detecting method based on UWB (Ultra Wideband) bio-radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human body target and surrounding structure compatibility detecting method based on a UWB (Ultra Wideband) bio-radar, comprising the following steps: a preprocessing step A, a human body target detecting step B and a structure detecting step C. Since most of survivors pressed and buried in ruins after an earthquake and other disasters are buried in holes formed under the ruins is considered, a certain space is formed between the survivors and the ruins, and the medium in the space is air. The detection and identification are realized on the upper and lower interfaces of the holes according to the limited conditions and the human body target position information, so that more accurate and more comprehensive ruins structure information can be obtained in the follow-up study, and new thinking can be provided for the application and development of a UWB search and rescue bio-radar technology.

title_en: A socket connector of incandescent lamp, a fire detector and escape-guide lamp having beacon module for detecting indoor location and system for detecting indoor location using the same
title_ko: 실내 측위용 비콘 모듈을 구비한 화재 감지기 및 피난 유도등과 이를 이용한 실내 측위 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fire detector including a beacon module for indoor positioning, an evacuation guidance lamp, and an indoor positioning system using the same are provided to facilitate accurate indoor positioning by mounting the beacon module for indoor positioning, thereby being manufactured at low costs. CONSTITUTION: A fire detector (700) is composed of a base, a cover (700b), and a support (700c). The base is combined with the cover and simultaneously forms a smoke sensing room and a dark room inside. A power supply unit receives power from the outside and provides the power. An AC/DC converter converts the received power and supplies driving power. A beacon module for indoor positioning wirelessly transmits a beacon signal to the outside through an embedded antenna using wireless communication. The beacon module for indoor positioning is installed on a predetermined position of the base or on a circuit board between the support and the base. [Reference numerals] (AA) Beacon signal (including a beacon ID); (BB) Position of a user; (CC) Position estimation message
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 실내 측위용 비콘 모듈을 구비한 백열등 소켓 커넥터, 화재 감지기 및 피난 유도등과 이를 이용한 실내 측위 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 의하면 백열등 소켓 커넥터, 화재 감지기 및 피난 유도등에 실내 측위용 비콘 모듈을 장착하여 정확한 실내 측위가 가능하도록 함으로써, 실내 측위 시스템을 저렴한 비용으로 간단하게 구축할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 또한, 본 발명에 의하면 백열등 소켓 커넥터, 화재 감지기 및 피난 유도등으로부터 전송되는 비콘 신호의 세기를 기초로 사용자의 현재 위치를 정확하게 파악할 수 있으므로, 이에 따라 건물 내부에 화재나 위급상황이 발생하였을 때 실내에 사람이 있는지를 일일이 확인하러 다니지 않고도 사용자의 현재 위치를 신속하게 파악하여 대피하도록 할 수 있어 신속한 인명구조 및 초기대응이 가능하게 되는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Method for realizing indoor positioning by utilizing fire-fighting evacuation strobe light and smoke detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing indoor positioning by utilizing a fire-fighting evacuation strobe light and a smoke detector. The method comprises the steps of obtaining positioning identification information by taking the fire-fighting evacuation strobe light or the smoke detector as a positioning base point through intelligent positioning equipment communicating with the positioning base point, and locally processing the positioning information or sending the positioning information through a network to conduct remote processing. According to the method, a great amount of fire-fighting evacuation strobe lights and smoke detectors installed or necessarily installed are used, a communication module (such as a zigbee module) with a GUID (Globally Unique Identifier) positioning function is additionally arranged in the equipment, thus not only being used for the communication control of the fire-fighting evacuation strobe lights and the smoke detectors, but also realizing the low-cost distribution of the indoor positioning base points. The method is of a positioning method which is low in cost, wide in coverage and capable of fast distributing the positioning base points.
assignees: XINJIANG ENOWIT INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Novel hand-held indoor positioner, positioning system thereof, and positioning method of positioning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel hand-held indoor positioner, a positioning system thereof, and a positioning method of the positioning system. The positioner comprises a system operation control module, and a sensor group module, a two-dimensional code scanning module, a display module and a data storage module which are connected with the system operation control module; the positioning system comprises the hand-held indoor positioner and two-dimensional codes pasted at the entrance of a room and key points; and the positioning method allows current position information to be obtained by calculating according to sensor data sent from sensor groups, data room two-dimensional code data sent from the two-dimensional code scanning module and room landform data in the data storage module and to be displayed through the display module. The positioner, the positioning system and the positioning method have a reasonable design, realizes the indoor positioning function through the sensor data and the two-dimensional code information by effectively combining a plurality of sensor groups, the two-dimensional code scanning module and the two-dimensional codes in the room, has the characteristics of high positioning precision, high anti-interference capability, use convenience, low cost and the like, and can be widely used in the exhibition field, the firefighting field and the like.
assignees: TIANJIN GUOXIN HAOTIAN 3D SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Multi-axis scout robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multi-axis scout robot which comprises a machine body and a flight control panel. Four rotor wing pieces are installed at the positions of four corners of the machine body respectively, every rotor wing piece is connected with a motor, the flight control panel is installed at the central position of the machine body, a global positioning system (GPS) sensor is installed at one end of the flight control panel, the other end of the control panel opposite to the end is provided with a high-definition camera, a three-axis gyroscope is installed at the central position of the flight control panel, a magnetometer and a three-axis acceleration sensor are arranged on two sides of the three-axis gyroscope respectively, and a barometer is installed between the three-axis gyroscope and the GPS sensor. The multi-axis scout robot has the advantages that the three-axis gyroscope and the three-axis acceleration sensor are installed on the multi-axis scout robot to form an inertial navigation module, and the multi-axis scout robot can rapidly fly through an electronic regulator; functions of speed setting, height setting, heading locking and automatic return flight and the like can be achieved, and scout and search and rescue tasks can be finished excellently under the matching of the camera.

title_en: Portable intelligent fire-fighting rescue terminal
abstract_en: A portable intelligent fire-fighting rescue terminal comprises a data acquisition device and an intelligent device based on an Android system. The data acquisition device comprises a microcontroller, a smog / toxic gas sensor, a temperature sensor, a heart rate sensor, an accelerometer, a ZigBee wireless transmission module, a bluetooth module, a sound and light alarm module, a one-key calling module and a power supply circuit. The microcontroller is directly connected to the smog / toxic gas sensor, the temperature sensor, the heart rate sensor, the accelerometer, the ZigBee wireless transmission module, the bluetooth module, the sound and light alarm module and the one-key calling module separately. The intelligent device is connected to the data acquisition device via the bluetooth module to set up communication. The terminal allows visiting an upper level server and visiting external networks via Internet. The terminal accurately achieves indoor positioning of firefighters, allows automatic networking and information exchange, and transmits field conditions of a fire, heart rates and motion status of firefighters and emergency alarm information to a monitoring center and commanding people to satisfy the needs of field rescue.

title_en: Method and apparatus to allow a psap to derive useful information from accelerometer data transmitted by a caller's device
abstract_en: A Public Safety Answering Point (PSAP) is configured to receive a description of detected movement associated with one or more inertial sensors of a communication device. The description of the detected movement may then be analyzed to determine a likelihood of injury associated with the movement, whether or not the user associated with the communication device is experiencing abnormal neuromuscular activity, and/or whether the user is outside a range of the communication device such that the user is unlikely to hear audio information originating from the communication device. The PSAP may additionally or alternatively utilize the description of the movement information to assist and/or provide an advisory recommendation in the decision of which, if any first responder resources should be dispatched; the recommendation may include which resources and at what priority the resources should be dispatched.

title_en: Rescuer indoor cooperated positioning device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a rescuer indoor cooperated positioning device and a method. A system comprises at least three inertial navigation positioning devices, a plurality of single chip microcomputers, a plurality of ZigBee wireless sensor network nodes, a plurality of GPRS modules, and a remote server. The inertial navigation positioning devices are separately disposed on at least three rescuers. All the rescuers are provided with one of the single chip microcomputers, one of the ZigBee wireless sensor network nodes and one of the GPRS modules. The inertial navigation positioning devices are carried by some of the rescuers, thus achieving indoor positioning. A real-time positioning network is formed through a ZigBee wireless sensor network, and position data is provided for other rescuers not carrying the inertial navigation positioning devices in a rescuing site. When a rescuer can verify the position of himself or herself, the position information can be corrected and the precision of a dynamic positioning network can be corrected. A headquarter can know the positions and distribution of the rescuers on the site in real time, and the rescuers can known the position information of themselves and their teammates, thus increasing the disaster rescuing efficiency so as to guarantee human safety.

title_en: Inertial measurement unit for fire fighting scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to an inertial measurement unit for a fire fighting scene. The inertial measurement unit comprises an inertia information sensing assembly, a magnetic field intensity sensing assembly, a temperature sensing assembly, an environment sensing assembly, a man-machine interaction assembly, an alarming assembly, a data processing assembly, a data transmission assembly and a battery; the inertial measurement unit is mainly applied to occasions that indoor environments such as fire rescue scenes and disaster search and rescue scenes are severely damaged, is installed on a fireman body, can overcome the defects that a traditional saving alarm cannot locate in real time and causes false alarm, and also can overcome the defects that a traditional inertial measurement unit cannot perform environment sensing and sound-light alarming; the inertial measurement unit has the advantages of simple structure, high starting speed, low false alarm rate, strong stability, high locating precision and prognosis of dangerous cases, is particularly suitable for beig used in the fire rescue scenes for locating a firemen in real time, sensing the scene environment and effectively guaranteeing the safety.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING INF SCI & TECH;BEIJING DEWEICHUANGYING TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: The comprehensive search and rescue system of community policing personnel and localization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of comprehensive search and rescue system of community policing personnel and localization method, belong to emergency relief and position field of locating technology.The search and rescue system includes：Locator, cell on wheels, hand-held set and Surveillance center.The locator is carried by going on patrol personnel, and locator has explicit alarm and implicit alarm dual-alarm function, and explicit alarm is manual alarm, when patrol personnel can not realize manual alarm, can be alarmed by the implicit warning function of locator from trend Surveillance center；It is used for when the cell on wheels is searched and rescued to patrol personnel's indoor positioning；The hand-held set is carried when being searched and rescued by rescue worker.The invention also provides a kind of indoor positioning algorithms, Stepping positioning algorithm；Seamless positioning to patrol personnel community indoor and outdoor can quickly be realized by the search and rescue device of Stepping positioning algorithm and the present invention；The present invention in community's indoor and outdoor without arranging radio sensing network in advance, and using single architecture, equipment is simple, and cost is relatively low, is easy to implement, and is particularly suitable for use in emergency searching and rescuing.

title_en: Indoor positioning and condition monitoring system for fire-fighting and rescue personnel
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an indoor positioning and condition monitoring system for fire-fighting and rescue personnel, and belongs to the technical field of dead zone positioning. The system consists of an indoor positioning module, a condition monitoring module, an emergent rescue device, and a remote monitoring module, wherein the indoor positioning module, the condition monitoring module and the emergent rescue device are fixed in a terminal which is worn on a rear waist of an operator, so as to achieve the positioning and condition monitoring of the operator. Moreover, the position and condition of the operator are displayed through an upper computer. The surroundings of the operator are simulated by the upper computer, and a route is also drawn. The system provided by the utility model is high in positioning precision, is high in safety, is good in instantaneity, and greatly helps the indoor firefighting and rescue.

title_en: Battle tracking system and method aiming at firefighters at fire scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a battle tracking system and method aiming at firefighters at a fire scene. The system comprises shoe bodies, position labels and a fire fighting commanding system, wherein each shoe body is provided with a micro control unit, a GPS module, an inertial navigation system module, a label identifying module, an environment induction sensing module, an alarming module, a communication module and a power supply in the position of the heel of a sole; the label identifying modules are used for identifying the position labels in a building through scanning and obtaining the three-dimensional absolute coordinate values of the positions where the labels are placed; the shoe bodies are communicated with the fire fighting commanding system for data transfer through the communication modules. The battle tracking system has the benefits as follows: the positioning system is combined with the special shoes of firefighters, so that the real-time position tracking of battle firefighters at the fire scene and the real-time detection monitoring on the fire scene disaster situation can be implemented, and the real-time positions of firefighters and the fire scene disaster situation can be fed back to commanders through the communication modules in time, therefore, the commanders can control the overall situation conveniently, the safety of people's lives and properties can be guaranteed furthest, and the fire damage is reduced.

title_en: Position mining device and mining system
abstract_en: The invention discloses the mining device of one kind positioning and mining system, positioning mining device includes a body, and the body sets location and installation chamber, and the location and installation chamber sets locating module mounting seat, an indoor positioning module is fixedly installed thereon.The location and installation chamber also sets up a battery, and it connects described locating module mounting seat, for for the indoor positioning module for power supply.The mining device of positioning described above can realize precise positioning; trapped personnel can be searched and rescued in time when occurring accident of mine disaster, get the rescue time of preciousness, simultaneously; the track protection to miner operation can be also realized for mining site manager in daily miner operation, unnecessary security incident is to avoid.

title_en: Real-time, two dimensional (2-D) tracking of first responders with identification inside premises
abstract_en: A combination of active reader tags and ultra wideband (UWB) radar systems provide real-time monitoring of first responders, with identification of each team member using active tags, and detection of victims or other subjects using motion or breathing detection, in a field of operations such as a building affected by fire or hazardous material or search and rescue mission area. Initially, a cluster of miniaturized radars (sensors) act in a static mode of operation, gathering static radar information used to depict a constructed layout of the premises. The cluster of radars then operate in a dynamic mode that detects motion or breathing of multiple subjects inside the field of operations. With dual mode operation the system can read the active tags identification, and by triangulation, display the position of each first responder with its identification and positions of subjects on a composite image of the constructed layout.

title_en: Locate mining device and mining system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses the mining device in a kind of location and mining system, locate mining device and comprise a body, described body arranges location and installation chamber, and described location and installation chamber arranges locating module mount pad, it is fixedly installed an indoor positioning module.Described location and installation chamber also arranges a battery, and it connects described locating module mount pad, for being described indoor positioning module for power supply.The above locates mining device can realize precise positioning; trapped personnel can be searched and rescued in time when there is accident of mine disaster, getting valuable rescue time, simultaneously; also can be the track protection of mining site manager realization to miner operation in daily miner operation, to avoid unnecessary security incident.

title_en: Method and system for quickly setting up map to assist indoor positioning under emergency rescue scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for quickly setting up a map to assist indoor positioning under an emergency rescue scene. The method comprises the following steps: setting up a three-dimensional map of a target building; obtaining initial position coordinate information of a rescuer entering the target building; reading sensing data and processing the sensing data; deducing the walking position coordinate information of the rescuer at the current moment through a pre-stored calculation algorithm; with one of double feet of the rescuer as a reference foot, judging whether the reference foot is in a static state at the current moment, if so, correcting a calculation error and an accumulative position calculation error, and outputting corrected walking position coordinate information of the rescuer at the current moment, otherwise, outputting deduced walking position coordinate information of the rescuer at the current moment; marking the walking position coordinate information of the rescuer at the current moment in the three-dimensional map of the target building. The method provided by the invention is used for dynamically tracking the rescuer in real time and providing assistance for integral command and dispatch of emergency rescue and the life guarantee of the rescuer.

title_en: A kind of ultra-wideband microwave chaos life detection radar device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of life detection radar device, especially a kind of ultra-wideband microwave chaos life detection radar device having both detection human life characteristic information and range information, can be used for disaster assistance.A kind of ultra-wideband microwave chaos life detection radar device includes the first signal generator, the first power splitter, frequency mixer, power amplifier, ultra broadband transmitting antenna, ultra-wideband receiver antenna, low noise amplifier, i/q demodulator, secondary signal generator, the second power splitter, voltage-controlled phase shifter, adjustable attenuator, solid state microwave sensor, the 3rd signal generator, lock-in amplifier, signal acquisition process module, can quickly and accurately detect vital signss information and the positional information of trapped personnel.

title_en: A firefighting time check system and flashlight
title_ko: 소방시간 체크시스템 및 상기 체크시스템에서 사용되는 무선통신용 인식칩을 장착한 손전등
abstract_en: A firefighting time check system according to the present invention can use a communication method such as an ultra-wideband (UWB) method or radio-frequency identification (RFID) scanner method by installing a wireless communication recognition chip such as an RFID, an UWB chip to an absolutely portable flashlight when a fireman goes into fires or various disaster sites. It can easily check the access and the position of the fireman who goes to the fire or various disaster sites. The access time of the fire site of firemen can be accurately managed by an access control scanner which can check access through the recognition chip of the flashlight. The proper compensation and placement for the firemen can carried out by managing a fire fighting time at the firefighting site of the firemen.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 소방시간 체크시스템은 소방관등이 화재 또는 각종 재난현장에 출동 시 반드시 휴대하는 손전등에 RFID, UWB칩 등의 무선통신용 인식칩을 장착하여 UWB 방식 또는 RFID 스캐너방식 등과 같은 통신방식을 이용할 수 있어 화재 또는 각종 재난현장에 출동하는 소방관등의 입출입 및 위치를 손쉽게 파악할 수 있으며, 상기 손전등의 인식칩을 통해 입출입을 체크할 수 있는 출입통제 스캐너에 의하여 소방관들의 화재현장의 입출입시간이 정확하게 관리될 수가 있게 되어 소방관들의 소방현장에서 소방작업시간이 철저하게 관리되어 소방인력의 적절한 보상과 인력배치가 가능하게 된다.

title_en: Firefighter safety positioning system based on UWB and positioning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to technical field of fire-fighting safety and UWB wireless sensor networks, and discloses a firefighter safety positioning system based on UWB. The firefighter safety positioning system based on the UWB comprises multiple child anchor nodes and one main anchor node which are arranged in each room of a building, a positioning wristband, a router and a command center. The invention also discloses a positioning method applying the positioning system. The fire-fighting command center is enabled to understand real-time position information of firefighters in the building on fire, and whether danger occurs on the firefighters is judged according to the real-time position information. Meanwhile, the real-time fire situation of the building on fire is mastered in real time so that occurrence of danger due to the fact that the firefighters enter areas with higher risk of danger can be prevented.
assignees: HUNAN PUAN CONSTRUCTION ENGINEERING CO LTD;UNIV EAST CHINA SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Disaster control system
title_ko: 실내위치제공장치를 통한 재난방지 시스템
abstract_en: A beacon is installed on a train or a public stage and is managed to execute an operation or report the location. A security guard in the corresponding location is connected through the corresponding beacon. The beacon can always connect the responsible agent and the security guard in a short range in order to check a device when an accident occurs, transmit a warning or a message, and enable the security guard to execute a needed operation as a first responder. The present invention can also group the security guard and a special public officer in a short range and transmit a responding manual to the corresponding agent to enable the security guard to execute the needed operation as the first responder. The present invention can group the agents on the same floor or train or in adjacent locations to enable more organized response.
abstract_ko:
비컨은 열차, 공공장소 등에 설치되어 있으며 위치및 작동이 관리되고 있으며 해당 비컨을 통하여 해당 위치의 안전요원등이 연결되어 있는 상태로 되어 있거나 근거리에 있는 책임요원이나 안전요원을 언제나 연결할 수 있도록 하여 사고가 발새아였을대 장치를 확인하여 경고및 메세지를 전달하도록 하고 안전요원을 통하여는 필요한 초동조치를 할 수 있도록 한다.  
또한, 근거리에 있는 안전요원, 특수공무원등을 그룹핑 할 수 있으며 필요한 경우 대응메뉴얼을 해당 요원에게 전송하여 안전요원등이 당황하지 않고 초동조치를 행할 수 이쏟록 한다.  
특히 같은 층, 근처의 위치와 장소, 같은 열차 등에 있는 요원들이 그룹핑될 수 있어 보다 조직적인 대응이 가능하도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Instant location and map building survey search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of instant location and survey search and rescue robot with map building, to be applied to after calamity the fields such as tube map establishment, landform exploration, comprise obstacle detouring chassis, vehicle body platform, 3-D scanning module, main control unit, body shell and driver module form.Obstacle detouring chassis adopts the bionics suspension frame structure of six wheel drive, makes car body have passive adaptivity to different terrain.3-D scanning module includes 3-D scanning mechanism, scanning laser radar, infrared temperature sensor, inertial laser sensor and fixed support composition.This robot can in traveling process autonomous exploration surrounding environment, and create three-dimensional land map in real time, detect whether likely life entity simultaneously and exist; Real-time three-dimensional map, possibility life entity can be searched and rescued position feedback to operating personal; Operating personal is helped to understand field condition quickly and accurately, to launch salvage work as early as possible, the personal casualty that minimizing is surveyed and rescue worker is unnecessary simultaneously and labor loss.

title_en: Internet of things sign-in card and fire fighting propaganda loading method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an internet of things sign-in card and a fire fighting propaganda loading method. The characteristic lies in that the sign-in card adopts a passive two-dimensional code, NFC (near field communication) and UHF (ultra high frequency) based RFID (radio frequency identification) as internet of things sign-in carriers. The characteristic also lies in that an application method of the sign-in card comprises the step of setting an intelligent mobile phone, an App (application program), a corresponding network, a server and an intelligent device used for reading a fire fighting propaganda RFID carrier. The advantage of loading the RFID sign-in carrier of the sign-in card is that fire fighting guidance is realized through indoor positioning in special fire scenes of power failure, network disconnection, indoor and outdoor communication shielding, smoke billowing and complete dark. The advantage of loading the two-dimensional code and the NFC sign-in carrier of the sign-in card is that fire fighting propaganda is implied to commercial sign-in through sign-in services of the sign-in card at ordinary times. Therefore, purposes of the invention are achieved efficiently with a low cost.

title_en: Wafer scale. ultra-wide band (uwb) radiometer with sensor probe for disaster victim rescue
abstract_en: A multi-sensor system is disclosed for detecting victims that may be trapped or buried (for example, earthquake survivors in collapsed buildings) and for accurately and safely locating such victims for safe and efficient rescue. An ultra wide band (UWB) radiometer sensor can detect and precisely calculate the position of the victim relative to a known position of a sensor probe or a monitoring unit of a sensor system. A sensing probe may be guided toward a victim and provide a combination of sensors and transducers (e.g., radiometer, optical and infrared camera, acoustic or sound transducers such as microphone and speaker) that may allow a probe operator remote from the subject (e.g., victim) to also determine the condition and status of the victim and communicate with the victim. With unique coding of the UWB signals, multiple units can be used together to triangulate a more exact position of each victim.

title_en: Ultra wideband radar multipoint distributed target positioning method based on life detection aircraft
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra wideband radar multipoint distributed target positioning method based on a life detection aircraft, which relates to the technical field of life detection aircrafts and radars. Based on powerful maneuvering performance of a search and rescue aircraft, an ultra wideband life detection radar is arranged on the aircraft, and by using the multipoint distributed target positioning method, quick and accurate living thing positioning can be realized.
