In an experiment, the radar is placed on an aircraft pan-tilt, the aircraft is used for controlling the radar to move at a high altitude, and according to a multipoint distributed target judgment criterion, a three-sphere method is applied to solving target position information. The original distance detection result in a pitch-catch mode is used for solving a ternary quadratic inhomogeneous equation set, the optimal solution is selected according to results of the equation set, and thus the position information of the living thing in three-dimensional space can be obtained. Through applying an adjacent discrimination method to searching a detection point, the radar is closest to the target position and surrounds the target, and effectiveness and reliability of living thing target positioning are enhanced.

title_en: Novel large -scale naval vessels under -deck personnel positioning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel large -scale naval vessels under -deck personnel positioning system, sign, refer to label, ultra wide band location receiver, ultra wide band location processing ware and surveillance center's server including ultra wide band (UWB) personel locator beacon. Provide another kind of novel large -scale naval vessels under -deck personnel positioning system simultaneously, signed the mounting groove, referred to label mounting groove, ultra wide band location receiver mounting groove, ultra wide band location processing ware mounting groove and surveillance center's server mounting groove including integrated ultra wide band personel locator beacon. The utility model discloses based on the ultra wide band location finding technique, solved the problem of the inside personnel location in large -scale naval vessels cabin, for large -scale naval vessel is taking place under the condition such as accident, under -deck personnel's location, search and rescue, medical science rescue etc. Provide technical foundation and support.

title_en: Heading Orientation Estimation Method Using Pedestrian Characteristics in Indoor Environment
title_ko: 보행특성을 이용한 실내에서의 보행자 이동방향 추정 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for estimating a moving direction of a pedestrian in an indoor environment using a walking property. The method for estimating a moving direction of a pedestrian in an indoor environment using a walking property comprises: a waling data obtaining step (S100) obtaining walking data from a signal transmitted in accordance with a walking motion of a pedestrian from an inertial measurement unit (IMU) mounted on shoes of the pedestrian; a pedestrian position estimating step (S200) of estimating the position of the pedestrian using the obtained walking data; and a moving direction correcting step (S300) of correcting a moving direction of the pedestrian to reduce an estimation error of the pedestrian position estimated by the pedestrian position estimating step (S200). The moving direction correcting step (S300) comprises: a pedestrian exercise type determining step (S310) of determining an exercise type of the pedestrian; and a measurement value renewing step (S320) of renewing a measurement value in accordance with the determined exercise type. According to the composition of the present invention, the method for estimating a moving direction of a pedestrian in an indoor environment using a walking property enables a user to accurately grasp the position of a rescuer or a person who needs to be rescued, in an indoor environment in which it is difficult to receive a navigation signal.

title_en: Positioning, vital sign monitoring and rescue method in the cabin of crewman sea
abstract_en: One kind is based on positioning in the cabin of crewman sea, it is positioned in the crewman sea cabin of vital sign monitoring and search and rescue system, vital sign monitors and rescue method, the system comprises command centre's servers, fence transmitter, crewman's vital sign real-time monitor, crewman's Real Time Localizer, carrier-borne personnel positioning processor and persons falling in water locator, this method is by being based on AIS, UWB, the modern information technologies such as big-dipper satellite positioning, develop single crewman's vital sign real-time monitor, carrier-borne and persons falling in water Real Time Localizer and wounded's vital sign are transmitted with location data, realize marine wounded's vital sign monitoring automation, information storage electronization, information transmission network and the wounded give first aid to visualization.

title_en: Positioning, vital sign monitoring and search and rescue system in the cabin of crewman sea
abstract_en: Positioning, vital sign monitoring and search and rescue system in a kind of cabin of crewman sea, including：Command centre's server, fence transmitter, crewman's vital sign real-time monitor, crewman's Real Time Localizer, carrier-borne personnel positioning processor and persons falling in water locator, it is by being based on the modern information technologies such as AIS, UWB, big-dipper satellite positioning, single crewman's vital sign real-time monitor, carrier-borne and persons falling in water Real Time Localizer and wounded's vital sign and location data Transmission system are developed, realizes that marine wounded's vital sign monitoring automation, information storage electronization, information transmission network and the wounded give first aid to visualization.

title_en: Inertial navigation indoor positioning system and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inertial navigation indoor positioning system and a use method thereof. The system comprises a positioning module and a receiving module, the positioning module mainly comprises a calculating and processing module, an emission module and a gyroscope, one side of the calculating and processing module in the positioning module is provided with an error calibration module, the gyroscope is communicated with the calculating and processing module and the error calibration module, the calculating and processing module is communicated with the emission module, and the emission module is wirelessly communicated with the receiving module. The system can realizes accurate positioning in firefighting or rescue and relief work places without arranging basic points in advance. Human body pace data is acquired by the gyroscope, is calculated and analyzed by the calculating and processing module, is received by the receiving module, and is introduced to a computer, the position information of personnel is monitored in real time, and the pace data undergoes error detection and error correction through the error calibration module to make position information transmitted to command personnel be accurate.

title_en: Fire rescue system
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire rescue system comprising a command platform and a positioning caller worn on a firefighter. The positioning caller comprises an inertial positioning module, an active positioning module and a first sending module; the inertial positioning module is used for acquiring current first position information by adopting an inertial positioning mode; the active positioning module is used for acquiring current second position information by adopting an active positioning mode; the first sending module is used for sending the first position information and the second position information to the command platform; and the command platform is used for calculating the actual position of the positioning caller according to the first position information and the second position information. By adopting the fire rescue system, accurate position data is obtained by synthesizing the positioning results of the inertial positioning module and the active positioning module and after constraint and correction of an algorithm, so that the positioning precision of indoor positioning under complex environments is improved.

title_en: Multifunctional life detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multifunctional life detection instrument. The multifunctional life detection instrument comprises a control terminal, a life detection device carrying out data exchange with the control terminal, and a charging and discharging cell and a power source circuit which provide power for the control terminal and the life detection device, wherein the life detection device comprises a main control module carrying out data exchange with the control terminal, and a UWB electromagnetic detector, a micro vibration detector and an audio video detector which are respectively connected with the main control module to realize data interaction, and the control terminal controls switching among the three modes of the UWB electromagnetic detector, the micro vibration detector and the audio video detector. The multifunctional life detection instrument is advantaged in that high precision is realized, life rescue under various conditions can be adapted, powerful guarantee is provided for disaster rescuers, and the technological level and the equipment level in aspects of earthquake relief work and life saving of the country are effectively improved.

title_en: Firefighter indoor positioning device and firefighter indoor positioning method based on compound positioning system
abstract_en: A firefighter indoor positioning device and a firefighter indoor positioning method based on a compound positioning system are disclosed. The method comprises the following steps: getting outdoor satellite positioning information; getting outdoor base station positioning information; getting indoor WIFI positioning information; correcting and optimizing the sea level standard atmospheric pressure and temperature values of the current area of the positioning system to get corresponding altitude information; and analytically processing, storing and recording the satellite positioning information, the base station positioning information, the WIFI positioning information and the altitude information, and providing real-time indoor positioning information and trajectory tracking information for a data service center. According to the invention, the positioning information of the modules in the positioning system is acquired and synthetically analyzed, and the locations of firefighters can be precisely positioned in real time when the firefighters get into a room and put out a fire to save life and property; and meanwhile, data of each dimension of the satellite positioning information is effectively stored in milliseconds, so the external data service center can monitor the trajectory of indoor rescue work of firefighters in real time.

title_en: Search and Rescue UAV System and Method
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) having at least one sensor for detecting the presence of a survivor in a search and rescue area. The at least one sensor is preferably an ultra-wide band (UWB) transceiver sensor. The UAV includes a UAV data link transceiver for wirelessly communicating information concerning the survivor to a command center.

title_en: Method for emergency call using wearable device in both in-building and outdoor environment
title_ko: 웨어러블 디바이스를 활용한 실내외 응급호출 구현 방안
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a communication terminal device which transmits location information measured by an optimum positioning method to a rescuer, respectively, in case a victim is located indoors and outdoors, in an emergency call by using a wearable device, and a recording medium storing a program to perform the method. Unlike the prior art in which errors may be generated according to the position of the victim by performing only the indoor positioning or outdoor positioning, optimum position information is automatically selected according to the position of the victim to transmit accurate position information of the victim, thereby increasing the likelihood of success of rescue.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 웨어러블 디바이스를 활용하여 응급호출시 피구호자의 위치가  실내일 경우와 실외일 경우, 각각 최적의 측위방법으로 측위된 위치정보를 구호자에게 전송하는 통신단말장치와 이러한 방법을 수행할 수 있는 프로그램이 저장된 기록매체에 관한 것이다. 실내측위 혹은 실외측위만 수행하여 피구호차의 위치에 따라서 오차가 많이 발생할 수 있는 종래의 기술과 달리 피구호자의 위치에 따라  자동으로 최적의 위치정보를  선택하여 피구호자의 정확한 위치정보를 전송함으로써 구호의 성공 가능성을 높였다.

title_en: Through-the-wall magnetoquasistatic positioning
abstract_en: Magnetoquasistatic through-the-wall non-line-of-sight coupling between a mobile transmitting device located within a building, or indoor, and a fixed receiving device located outside the building, outdoor, enables positioning of the transmitting device through the wall of the building and in non-line-of-sight environments. Systems based on magnetoquasistatic coupling can separately sense the distance and orientation of the transmitting device accurately even in heavy non-line-sight environments such as steel-reinforced buildings. The approach permits sensing and determination of location and attitude of mobile devices in buildings and can be used to locate rescue workers, first responders, or law enforcement officers inside a building.

title_en: Indoor positioning and tracing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses track system, the method and apparatus of at least one of object, vehicle and personnel at the scene by determining the distance between first node and remote node.In some embodiments, it provides a kind of for by the distance between node for being located in emergency responder and allowing to draw the relative position of the emergency responder method to track the emergency responder at emergency scene.

title_en: LTE and PDR-based fire-fighting indoor positioning and track navigating method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an LTE and PDR-based fire-fighting indoor positioning and track navigating method and system. The system comprises an intelligent terminal, an LTE small base station and a positioning server, wherein the intelligent terminal is terminal equipment supporting LTE, a camera, a nine-axis sensor and an air-pressure sensor; fire-fighting positioning service APP is installed on the intelligent terminal equipment, is an operator of a positioning algorithm, and is used for collecting information of the LTE RSS, camera, nine-axis sensor and air-pressure sensor, calculating the position of a firefighter according to the information, and returning the positioning result to the server; the LTE small base station is a small cell of a mobile communication system for covering indoor signals, and is used for providing data service link and assistant positioning to a smart mobile phone in the positioning system. The method and system have the beneficial effects that a communication and positioning environment can be quickly constructed by utilizing the LTE small base station and the intelligent terminal, the field arrangement system is convenient, and the implementation of the system can be greatly increased.

title_en: Personnel and asset searching system and method for tourist attraction and goods yard
abstract_en: The invention integrates the GPS module and an ultra-long distance intelligent electronic tag which works in a low duty ratio working mode into a low-power consumption intelligent GPS tag by utilizing ultra-low power consumption and ultra-long distance sleep awakening technology with a distance of more than 1500 meters. The GPS tag not only has all functions of intelligent electronic tags including indoor positioning and multi-channel cooperative work, but also has the function of outdoor accurate positioning which is unique to the GPS. The GPS label does not depend on networks such as a mobile public network or WiFi and the like to transmit the GPS position information acquired by the GPS label, and the service life of a battery of the GPS label can reach 3-5 years. It is not only low in cost, but also simple and convenient to use. The device can be widely used for searching and positioning personnel in various tourist attractions, amusement places and cities; personnel management of the travel team. The remote area has no personnel search and rescue covered by network, and can be widely used for asset search and positioning of containers and the like in large ports and cargo yards.

title_en: Indoor positioning smoke sensor emitting smoke through Bluetooth
abstract_en: The invention belongs to an indoor positioning smoke sensor emitting smoke by Bluetooth, which is characterized in that a geographic information superimposer and a Bluetooth emitter are additionally arranged on the existing smoke sensor. The device automatically overlaps two-dimensional and three-dimensional geographic position information (room number, building position, road section name and region name) of a smoke sensor, when an alarm condition occurs, a mobile phone owner in the site touches a mobile phone emergency rescue button, the mobile phone receives the geographic position information of the owner sent by a Bluetooth transmitter embedded in the device in real time and uploads the specific geographic information to a duty police mobile terminal, a district dispatching place and a superior command center in real time, and a duty department can reach a first site for issuing a case in real time according to the uploaded alarm condition position and a doorplate number after receiving the alarm, so that the purpose of integrating the alarm condition command and alarm handling action is achieved; the invention can also upload the alarm condition and the video monitored by the embedded camera of the device to the district dispatching place and the superior command center in real time through the operation of the on-site mobile phone according to the requirement.

title_en: A kind of amphibious unmanned boat of Quick rescue
abstract_en: It the utility model is related to unmanned boat technical field, and in particular to a kind of amphibious unmanned boat of Quick rescue.Wherein, including：Hull, cabin, mast, master controller, power plant module, communication module, power module and monitoring modular, cabin is installed at the top of hull stage casing, mast is installed on the afterbody of hull, and the top of mast is provided with headlamp, communication antenna and camera by rotating ring；Power plant module includes Cross-country wheel, engine, propeller and autopilot；Communication module includes image radio station, location communication device and inertial navigation equipment；Power module includes storage battery, charger and generator；Monitoring modular includes minisize gyroscopes and depth of water inductor；Master controller is commander's maincenter.The amphibious unmanned boat can timely respond to waterlogging rescue demand, and route is not known in cell of passing through；Using all transitable feature in its land and water, to carrying out organized conveying by rescuer；It is oriented to without manpower, meets the demand of the Quick rescue under waterlogging environment.
assignees: QINGDAO ZHONGBANG DEFENSE INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus for transmitting image of scene of fire, and hand-held thermal imager for firefighting
abstract_en: Provided are a method and apparatus for transmitting an image of the scene of a fire, and a hand-held thermal imager for firefighting. The method comprises: acquiring position information about a fire-fighter by means of an inertial navigation system, and generating a visible spectrum image and a thermal imaging far-infrared spectrum image of the scene of a fire; according to the thermal imaging far-infrared spectrum image and the visible spectrum image, performing superposition to generate a scene image of the scene of the fire corresponding to the position information; and transmitting the position information and the scene image to a background command centre by means of a mobile network. By implementing the embodiments of the present application, position information about a fire-fighter and a scene image corresponding to the position information can be transmitted to a background command centre in a timely manner, so that the background command centre develops a reasonable rescue plan for the situation at the scene of a fire.

title_en: Indoor localization system in disaster relief and localization method thereof
title_ko: 재난 구조시의 실내 위치 표시 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to aindoor localization system and method during disaster relief, which can carry out exact localization by recognizing an indoor position if existing communication facilities are interrupted, and an indoor environment is changed (damaged) in a disaster situation. The indoor localization system comprises: a disaster victim terminal as a fixed node; a plurality of rescuer terminals as a plurality of mobile nodes, which can communicate with the disaster victim terminal; a localization server which divides a lower region with respect to the indoor environment, determines a position of the disaster victim terminal with the highest accuracy among positions reported from all the rescuer terminals as the final position of the disaster victim terminal; a database which divides the inside of a building into a latticed target region by the localization server, divides the target region into a lower region in accordance with the number and type of walls between the region and each latticed point, and stores information with respect to the indoor environment realized by separately forming the gathering of reference points (RP) with respect to each latticed point. According to the present invention, therefore, costs of an off-line step may be reduced in comparison to a conventional fingerprint-based method.
abstract_ko: 재난 상황에서 기존의 통신 시설이 중단되고 실내 환경이 변경(손상)되는 경우 실내 위치를 파악하여 정확한 위치 표시(localization)를 실행할 수 있는 재난 구조시의 실내 위치 표시 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 고정 노드로서 재난피해자 단말기, 다수의 이동 노드로서 상기 재난피해자 단말기와 통신 가능한 다수의 구조자 단말기, 상기 실내 환경에 대한 하부 영역을 분할하고, 상기 재난피해자 단말기의 최종 위치로서 모든 구조자 단말기들로부터 보고된 위치들 중에서 가장 높은 정확도를 갖는 재난피해자 단말기의 위치를 재난피해자 단말기의 최종 위치로 결정하는 위치 표시 서버, 상기 위치 표시 서버에 의해 건물 내를 격자로 표적 영역으로 분할하고, 영역과 각 격자점 사이의 벽의 개수와 종류에 따라 표적 영역을 하부 영역으로 분할하고, 각 격자점에 대해 별도로 참조 점(RP : Reference Points) 집합을 형성하여 이루어진 상기 실내 환경에 대한 정보를 저장하는 데이터베이스를 포함하는 구성을 마련하여, 종래의 지문 기반 방법에 비해 오프라인 단계의 비용을 줄일 수 있다.

title_en: Method for realizing intelligent fire-fighting helmet for sensing explosion accident and predicting risk
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for realizing an intelligent fire-fighting helmet for sensing explosion accidents and predicting risks, which comprises a fire-fighting helmet, a remote combustible gas detector, a thermal imaging camera module, a head-mounted near-to-eye display module, a positioning instrument, a data communication transmission module, an embedded core board, an earphone, a base station and a fire-fighting command center. According to the invention, a firefighter positioning technology is combined with a building information model and live-action thermal image information, and information projection and display are carried out through the head-mounted near-to-eye display module, so that the real-time position of the firefighter in a building can be displayed for the firefighter, and the environment explosion risk and the risk thereof can be predicted in real time. When a firefighter enters an unknown environment place, the potential fire explosion accident risk can be rapidly and effectively predicted, and the rapid perception and information communication of the firefighter on the fire accident scene can be realized through an advanced video and thermal imaging technology and an indoor positioning and communication transmission technology, so that the fire fighting rescue science level and capability of the firefighter are improved.

title_en: Intelligent gas leakage alarm system and method thereof
title_ko: 지능형 가스 누출 경보 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Provided is an intelligent gas leakage alarm system for providing an optimal evacuation path and a method thereof. The system comprises: a worker mobile device estimating worker location information based on a radio signal for indoor positioning received from a plurality of gas leakage detecting devices fixedly installed in a building; and a control center collecting measurement data measuring concentration of a harmful gas, the temperature/humidity, flow of air, and smoke from the gas leak detecting devices, generating harmful information indicating a gas leakage position, a gas distribution map according to the gas leakage position, and a gas diffusion state according to time based on the measurement data, estimating evacuation path information optimized for each worker in the building based on the harmful information and the worker position information received from the worker mobile device, and transmitting the estimated evacuation path information and the harmful information to the worker mobile device.
abstract_ko: 지능형 가스 누출 경보 시스템이 제공된다. 이 시스템은, 건물 내에 고정 설치된 다수의 가스 누출 감지 장치로부터 수신된 실내측위용 무선신호를 기반으로 작업자 위치 정보를 추정하는 작업자 휴대기기; 및 상기 다수의 가수 누출 감지 장치로부터 유해 가스의 농도, 온/습도, 공기의 흐름, 연기를 측정한 측정 데이터를 수집하고, 상기 측정 데이터를 기반으로 가스 누출 위치, 상기 가스 누출 위치에 따른 가스 분포도 및 시간에 따른 가스 확산 양상을 나타내는 유해 정보를 생성하고, 상기 유해 정보와 상기 작업자 휴대기기로부터 수신된 작업자 위치 정보를 기반으로 상기 건물 내에서 작업자 별로 최적화된 대피 경로 정보를 추정하고, 추정된 상기 대피 경로 정보와 상기 유해 정보를 상기 작업자 휴대기기로 전송하는 관제 센터;를 포함한다.

title_en: A kind of building based on BIM and UWB faces side hole safety management system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of buildings based on BIM and UWB to face side hole safety management system and method, and management system includes UWB personnel positioning modules, and central server visualizes display module, and safe early warning module and intelligence search and rescue module；UWB personnel positionings module realizes personnel's three-dimensional localization by UWB no-load communication techniques；Personnel positioning information is carried out data with BIM models and coupled by central server, and analyzes whether personnel are in danger zone；Visualize accurate location of the display module real-time display personnel in BIM models；Safe early warning module carries out danger warning prompt to personnel；Intelligence searches and rescues module and determines most short rescue route for unexpected personnel occur, and is shown on BIM models.The present invention can be accurately positioned personnel's three-dimensional position in real time, and be compared and analyzed with preset danger zone, and phonic warning is carried out to construction personnel, to effectively take precautions against dangerous generation, help to reduce casualties, realize building site intelligent safety management.

title_en: One kind is shed with water proof type infrared light smoke detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses one kind to shed with water proof type infrared light smoke detector, including smoke detector ontology, the smoke detector ontology is internally provided with air flue, the on both sides of the middle of the air flue is symmetrically arranged with infraluminescence pipe and infrared photodiode, one end end both sides of the air flue are symmetrically arranged with electrode contacts A and electrode contacts B, the other end end both sides of the air flue are symmetrically arranged with electrode contacts C and electrode contacts D, the electrode contacts A, electrode contacts B, electrode contacts C, electrode contacts D, infraluminescence pipe and infrared photodiode are connect by conducting wire with control circuit board box, the control circuit board box is fixed at the inside center of smoke detector ontology.The utility model solves the problems, such as that traditional smoke sensor device is difficult to quick, accurate measurements region smog near the ground in the adverse circumstances such as emergency management and rescue by the way that infraluminescence pipe, infrared photodiode and acceleration inertial sensor is arranged.
assignees: COMPREHEND SUZHOU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device for position tracking and monitoring of endangered rescue personnel in indoor diseaster environment using wireless communication and method thereof
title_ko: 무선통신을 이용한 실내 재난환경에서의 위험에 처한 구조대원의 위치파악 및 모니터링 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a device for acquiring and monitoring a position of a rescue worker in danger in an indoor disaster environment using wireless communication comprises: a monitoring terminal including a bioactivity monitoring sensor unit to collect bioactivities via Bluetooth low energy (BLE) communication between a temperature sensor and a heart rate sensor, an indoor environment position tracking unit to use an acceleration sensor to track a position in an indoor environment, and a remote server communication unit to perform communication with a remote server via wireless communication to be carried on the body of a rescue worker; a server including a bioactivity monitoring unit to collect, store, and monitor the bioactivities and recognize a dangerous state, and an indoor position tracking unit to store position tracking data; and a search terminal including a sensing unit to determine whether the rescue worker is present or absent, a position tracking unit to track a position of a rescue worker and track a direction of a rescue worker in danger, and a direction display lamp to notify a direction to find a rescue worker in danger.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무선통신을 이용한 실내 재난환경에서의 위험에 처한 구조대원의 위치파악 및 모니터링 장치에 관한 것으로, 온도센서와 심박센서간 BLE(Bluetooth Low Energy)통신을 통해 생체활동을 수집하는 생체활동 모니터링 센서부, 가속도 센서를 이용하여 실내 환경에서의 위치추적을 담당하는 실내환경 위치추적부, 및 무선통신을 통해 원격 서버와 통신을 수행하는 원격 서버통신부로 구성되어 구조대원 몸에 휴대하는 모니터링 단말; 상기 생체활동을 수집 및 저장, 모니터링, 위험상태 인지를 담당하는 생체활동 모니터링부, 및 위치추적 데이터를 저장하는 실내 위치 추적부로 구성된 서버; 및 상기 구조대원이 있는지 없는지를 판별하는 감지부, 구조대원의 위치를 추적하고 위험에 처한 구조대원의 방향을 추적해 내는 위치 추적부, 및 위험에 처한 구조대원을 찾기 위한 방향을 알리는 방향 표시등으로 구성된 탐색 단말;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Indoor positioning and path planning method under fire-fighting rescue condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indoor positioning and path planning method under the condition of fire fighting and rescue, which comprises a server platform of an emergency on-site command center, a GPS positioning module, an inertial navigation module, an air respirator with augmented reality glasses and information processing and transmitting terminal equipment, wherein the GPS positioning module and the inertial navigation module are arranged on the firemen, and the specific position of the firemen in a building is obtained by obtaining the conversion relation from an inertial navigation coordinate system to a world coordinate system through the GPS positioning and the inertial navigation positioning. And planning an indoor optimal path from the firefighter to the target position according to the target position appointed by the command center. By the method, the fire-fighting rescue action speed of the firemen can be effectively improved, and the action safety of the firemen is guaranteed.

title_en: A kind of UWB positioning systems for robot
abstract_en: A kind of UWB positioning systems for robot,Belong to indoor autonomous navigation technology field,Including locating module,Reconnoitre module,Data processing module,Control module,GPS technology and UWB technology are combined by locating module,GPS technology is for positioning robot chamber external position,UWB technology is for the positioning to indoor location,It reconnoitres module and is equipped with a variety of detection units,For detecting varying environment data,After data being exchanged with the pattern drawing unit in control module,It can be used for search-and-rescue work,Control model is divided into Active Control Mode and passive control model,The formulation of route can to data analysis and be independently carried out by system CPU data analysis unit,It also can be by the way that mobile route be sent instructions or fixed in a manner of program under artificial remote control,The present invention solves the problems, such as the unstable of indoor transmissions signal by UWB technology,UWB technology transmission rate is high,Spatial content is big,It is at low cost,It is low in energy consumption.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle group searching and rescuing method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue method and a system for unmanned aerial vehicle groups, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a plurality of search unmanned aerial vehicles form an unmanned aerial vehicle group, and a detection source is carried to scan a region to be searched to determine a suspected region, wherein the detection source comprises a radio spectrum detection source, and/or a SAR imaging detection source, and/or an optical imaging detection source; determining a target area from the suspected area through data fusion; and scanning the target area by searching an ultra-wideband life detection radar carried by the unmanned aerial vehicle, and acquiring and returning vital sign state information in the target area. The method has the advantages of accurate search and rescue positioning, high precision, good flexibility, good stability, capability of greatly improving the search and rescue efficiency and the like.

title_en: Life entity double station cooperative detection method based on single channel ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of life entity double station cooperative detection method based on single channel ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR, pass through echo-signal in the radar receiving area of two different locations, form two two-dimentional echo-signal matrixes, motion filtering is carried out respectively to two matrixes, two matrixes are subjected to cross-correlation calculation along slow time dimension after the operation such as low-pass filtering, cross correlation matrix number is formed, calculates specific location and the imaging of target at a distance from two radars using target in cross-correlation matrix.This method can either realize effective detection to multiple and different strong and weak life entity targets, the range information relative to two radars of each life entity target can be disposably extracted again, the location information of life entity target can be resolved without pairing processing, it can be effectively reduced false-alarm and false dismissal probability under multi-target condition, the accuracy and robustness for improving human body target detection can satisfy the needs of the plural faint vital signs detection of name trapped person under the occasions such as disaster assistance.

title_en: It is a kind of can long-range monitoring human vital sign unmanned plane device
abstract_en: The present invention relates to it is a kind of can long-range monitoring human vital sign unmanned plane device, including unmanned plane detection device and ground intelligent terminal；By ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR device carry below unmanned plane, be equipped with transmitting antenna and receiving antenna, the direction of the transmitting antenna and receiving antenna vertically downward, towards ruins direction；The unmanned plane is equipped with airborne computer, can determine whether human life according to radar antenna signal；The judging result of airborne computer is sent to ground intelligent terminal by the unmanned plane detection device；The ground intelligent terminal has terminal interface, shows the position where unmanned plane on terminal interface on map, and the regional scope that unmanned plane detection device is searched and rescued may be selected, and control unmanned plane detection device is back and forth flown in selected region.Personnel search and rescue after the present invention can be widely applied to calamity, can use the high maneuverability of unmanned plane, the human life signal under a wide range of quick detection ruins.

title_en: WIFI indoor positioning data acquisition equipment and system
abstract_en: The utility model embodiment discloses a kind of WIFI indoor positioning data acquisition equipment, including AP device.AP device includes signal receiving module, memory module, smoke detection module, sound and light alarm module, processor, shell and pedestal.Signal receiving module is used for return pulse signal；Smoke detection module transmits signal to processor for smokescope in detecting chamber.Sound and light alarm module is used to make a sound the warning signal with light beam.Signal receiving module, memory module, smoke detection module, sound and light alarm module and processor are all provided with inside the shell；Cover top portion is equipped with multiple sense cigarette holes；Pedestal passes through multiple set screw connected with outer casing.And then it realizes accurate positioning and meets the needs of user is to functional diversities.Meanwhile WIFI indoor positioning data collection system is equipped with mobile tag, server, keeps orientation management convenient and easy to use.
assignees: SHENZHEN YUANSHU LIHE TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of indoor positioning and search and rescue system based on unmanned plane
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of indoor positioning and search and rescue system based on unmanned plane, including earth station and unmanned plane two parts, the earth station includes control computer, model generates interface, control interface, the base station UWBLOC and data transmission module, the unmanned plane includes drone body, flight control system, signal transmission device, indoor positioning module, data processing module, gas detection module, camera, fire behavior acquisition module and life detection module, fire behavior size and spatial distribution and variation tendency are judged by setting fire behavior acquisition module, life detection module is set simultaneously and detects the life entity to live, gas-detecting device is set again to judge the concentration of pernicious gas, and these detection results are generated interface display in model to come out for fireman's reference, the present invention can carry out scene of fire effectively and comprehensive Information is collected, and is referred to for fireman, is helped fireman to formulate rescue strategies, is reduced the difficulty and risk of rescue.
assignees: GUANGDONG RONGQE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting drill bracelet based on UWB
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of fire-fighting drill bracelet based on UWB, including shell, is connected to first watchband and the second watchband at shell both ends, set on the face-piece of housing upper surface, display screen, battery and the machine core panel being set in the housing, set on the bottom case of housing lower surface；Machine core panel includes: master controller, UWB locating module, communication module, attitude transducer, heart rate sensor, smoke detector, and main controller controls；Master controller receives the position data determined by UWB locating module, the attitude data obtained by attitude transducer, the heart rate data obtained by heart rate sensor, the smoke data obtained by smoke detector, control display is on a display screen, and above-mentioned data are transmitted to by server by communication module, server is electrically connected monitoring client, is monitored in real time by monitoring client.The present invention can monitor the case where bracelet wearer in real time, and convenient processing in time is abnormal, ensure its safety, and accurate positioning, data transmission are fast.

title_en: Indoor positioning system for fire alarm system
abstract_en: A building management system tracks occupants of a building in which the building management system is installed and presents information about the occupants, including location information, to first responders during emergency and/or training events. Distributed devices of the building management system receive identification information broadcast by user devices of the occupants and sends the identification information to a control panel of the building management system. Location information for the occupants is generated based on the identification information received from the user devices and stored along with time and date information. This location information is then retrieved and presented to first responders, for example, by displaying a map of the building with icons representing the distributed devices and occupants, based on the location information.

title_en: Terricole track monitor terminal and working method based on NB-IOT
abstract_en: The invention discloses terricole track monitor terminals and working method based on NB-IOT, belong to the motion profile locating and tracking technical field of the terricole based on Internet of Things.Monitor terminal includes control processing module, GPS/ Beidou module, INS inertial navigation module, barometric leveling module, smoke sensor device, Temperature Humidity Sensor, NB-IOT communication module and antenna and backstage host computer, GPS/ Beidou module, INS inertial navigation module, barometric leveling module, smoke sensor device module, temperature humidity sensor module, NB-IOT communication module and antenna are connect with control processing module, and are monitored by monitor terminal to animal.The present invention is communicated using NB-IOT wireless technology, realize the transmission of low-power consumption, the location information of long range and environmental information, the technical advantage for thering are other locating and tracking technologies to hardly match, it is micro- to realize that intelligentized wild animal tracer technique has extremely profound significance.

title_en: TOA co-positioning method for vehicle-mounted fire-fighting rotor unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a TOA co-location method of a vehicle-mounted fire-fighting rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps: UWB module installation and deployment: three motor fire-fighting vehicles on the ground are adopted as positioning platforms, and four UWB modules are deployed and installed on the roof of each vehicle; each motor fire truck roof platform is provided with a fire-fighting rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, and each rotor unmanned aerial vehicle is provided with a UWB module; the UWB module coordinates of the fire rotor unmanned aerial vehicle are calculated; the method comprises the steps of collecting TOA sensor data of a UWB module of the fire-fighting rotor unmanned aerial vehicle; and (5) solving the spatial position of the fire-fighting rotor unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the invention, under the conditions of unreliable GPS signals, weak signals or refusal among urban buildings, the accurate and reliable calculation of the spatial position of the fire-fighting rotor unmanned aerial vehicle is realized by the TOA co-location mode of a plurality of small-sized motor fire-fighting vehicles, thereby providing preconditions for autonomous or semi-autonomous flight of the fire-fighting rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and improving the safety of firefighters during operation.

title_en: Indoor positioning system for firemen
abstract_en: A firefighter indoor positioning system, having: a wireless tag reader for a firefighter to wear or carry; the wireless tags are arranged at a plurality of positioning points in an indoor space and are respectively provided with a memory for storing position information, and the position information corresponds to one positioning point; in operation, the wireless tag reading device is wirelessly coupled with at least one wireless tag in a sensing range to obtain the position information corresponding to at least one positioning point of the indoor space.

title_en: Positioning system and method for emergency networking in disaster area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a positioning system and a method for emergency networking in a disaster area, belonging to the technical field of communication positioning. The system comprises a GNSS data module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the GNSS data module is used for acquiring coordinate data of a peripheral reference point of a disaster area and providing reference coordinate data for UWB emergency networking in the disaster area; the UWB emergency networking module is used for establishing UWB emergency networking in a disaster area according to the reference coordinate data; the UWB mobile tag positioning module is used for acquiring positioning data of UWB emergency networking in a disaster area; the data calculation module is used for calculating the position information of the rescuers according to the positioning data of the UWB emergency networking and the reference coordinate data; and the monitoring end display module is used for receiving the position information of the rescue workers and displaying the positions of the rescue workers in real time. The invention solves the problem that rescue workers cannot be accurately positioned due to the fact that the quality of communication signals cannot be guaranteed in a disaster site of building collapse in the prior art.

title_en: Alarm and indication system for starting process of multi-turboprop engine of amphibious aircraft
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alarm and indication system for the starting process of a multi-turboprop engine of an amphibious aircraft, which is characterized in that: the lifting wheel-mounted annunciator (115) acquires parameters such as engine ignition control, fuel oil, lubricating oil, torque, engine speed, exhaust temperature and the like and wheel-mounted signals; the collector (102) collects the sensor signals, the inertial navigation system (103) collects ground speed signals, and the radio altimeter (104) collects airplane altitude signals; the system processor (101) receives signals of the collector (102), the inertial navigation system (103) and the radio altimeter (104), and identifies the engine starting alarm state after comprehensive processing. The method can solve the problem of engine starting process alarm when the amphibious aircraft executes a water surface task, reduce the interference of unnecessary engine starting alarm to the unit when the amphibious aircraft executes the water surface task, reduce the operation load of the unit, further more rapidly execute a water surface search and rescue task, and meet the requirements of civil airworthiness standard in China.

title_en: A kind of emergency light and indoor positioning navigation system with positioning function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to emergency light technical fields, specifically disclose a kind of emergency light with positioning function, wherein, lamp includes: lighting circuit, Bluetooth base. station, power module, microcontroller, speech control module and lamp cap control module, speech control module and lighting circuit are connect with power module, Bluetooth base. station is connect with power module and microcontroller respectively, power module with external power supply power supply for connecting, speech control module is connect with lamp cap control module, speech control module is also connect with microcontroller, lighting circuit is connect with lamp cap control module, Bluetooth base. station with communication of mobile terminal for connecting, microcontroller is used to control the work of Bluetooth base. station.The invention also discloses a kind of indoor positioning navigation system.The helpful trapped person's positioning of emergence lighting lamp with positioning function provided by the utility model, to improve the escape efficiency of trapped person.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHONGKE ZHIRUI INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of emergency light and indoor positioning navigation system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to indoor navigation technical fields, specifically disclose a kind of emergency light, wherein, emergency light includes: emergency light lamps and lanterns, power module, battery, Wi-Fi module, speech control module, lamp cap control module and buzzer, speech control module, Wi-Fi module and battery are connect with power module, emergency light lamps and lanterns are connect with battery and power module respectively, buzzer is connected with battery, speech control module is connect with lamp cap control module, and emergency light lamps and lanterns are connect with lamp cap control module；Speech control module can control the rotation of lamp cap control module, and power module can to charge the battery, and battery can provide power supply supply when power module powers off for buzzer and emergency light lamps and lanterns, and Wi-Fi module with mobile terminal for connecting.The invention also discloses a kind of indoor positioning navigation system.The function of the helpful trapped person's indoor positioning of emergency luminaire provided by the utility model, to solve the escape efficiency of trapped person.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHONGKE ZHIRUI INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign detection method and system based on ultra-wideband radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign detection method and a vital sign detection system based on an ultra-wideband radar, which relate to the technical field of vital sign detection and are used for acquiring an echo signal of the ultra-wideband radar; filtering processing operations such as linear migration removal, time domain sliding average difference filtering, fast Fourier transform, frequency domain sliding average difference filtering, overall frequency domain sliding average filtering and the like are carried out on the ultra-wideband radar echo signals; carrying out harmonic multiple cycle detection on the filtered frequency domain signal to obtain a vital sign signal, wherein the vital sign signal comprises information such as position information, respiratory rate and heart rate of a person to be detected; the invention improves the judgment standard of respiration and heartbeat frequency, can accurately detect the position of a vital body from a radar and the respiration and heartbeat rate, can detect and display the vital sign information in real time, and has wide application prospect in the aspects of medical care, disaster search and rescue and the vital sign detection of special people.

title_en: Automatic determination of defibrillation pad location on patient's chest
abstract_en: A medical device uses UWB units to infer a position of an adjunct positioned in proximity to an exterior portion of a patient's body. The position information can be used to provide CPR feedback to a rescuer. In other applications, the position information can be used to provide prompts to a user to change the position of the adjunct.

title_en: Waterproof infrared light smoke detector for throwing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waterproof infrared light smoke detector for throwing, which comprises a smoke detector body, wherein an air passage is arranged in the smoke detector body, an infrared luminous tube and an infrared photosensitive tube are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the middle of the air passage, an electrode contact A and an electrode contact B are symmetrically arranged on two sides of one end part of the air passage, an electrode contact C and an electrode contact D are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the other end part of the air passage, the electrode contact A, the electrode contact B, the electrode contact C, the electrode contact D, the infrared luminous tube and the infrared photosensitive tube are all connected with a control circuit board box through wires, and the control circuit board box is fixedly arranged at the right center of the inside of the smoke detector body. The invention solves the problem that the traditional smoke sensor is difficult to rapidly and accurately monitor smoke in the area near the ground in severe environments such as emergency rescue and the like by arranging the infrared luminous tube, the infrared photosensitive tube and the acceleration inertial sensor.

title_en: A kind of Internet of Things intelligent fire self-rescue apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Internet of Things intelligent fire self-rescue apparatus, including Protective clothes combined with cap and mask (1), self-help apparatus (2) and intelligent positioner (3), it is characterized in that the filter device (2) is arranged in parallel using multiple filtration film, equipped with two filter layers and activated carbon adsorption device, form closed filter, filter and Protective clothes combined with cap and mask are all made of new material, it is lightweight and convenient, meet Human Engineering Principle, survivor is set to avoid wearing discomfort because of respirator during escape, the problem of Smoke Filter is delayed escape time not in time, the intelligent positioner uses NFC indoor positioning technologies, it is automatically positioned indicator of trapped personnel position, and it be furnished with light source emitter and loudspeaking alarm, allow fire fighter more rapidly and accurately find indicator of trapped personnel specific location.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting drill bracelet based on UWB
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire-fighting drill bracelet based on UWB, including shell, it is connected to first watchband and the second watchband at shell both ends, set on the face-piece of housing upper surface, display screen, battery and the machine core panel being set in the housing, set on the bottom case of housing lower surface；Machine core panel includes: master controller, UWB locating module, communication module, attitude transducer, heart rate sensor, smoke detector, and main controller controls；Master controller receives the position data determined by UWB locating module, the attitude data obtained by attitude transducer, the heart rate data obtained by heart rate sensor, the smoke data obtained by smoke detector, control display is on a display screen, and above-mentioned data are transmitted to by server by communication module, server is electrically connected monitoring client, is monitored in real time by monitoring client.The utility model can monitor the case where bracelet wearer in real time, and convenient processing in time is abnormal, ensure its safety, and accurate positioning, data transmission are fast.

title_en: A kind of autonomous heuristic approach in interior based on caterpillar robot
abstract_en: The autonomous heuristic approach in interior that the invention discloses a kind of based on caterpillar robot, includes the following steps: step 1, using caterpillar robot as mobile robot platform, is expanded；Step 2 optimizes laser beam dot matrix with the map obtained, estimates laser point in the expression of map and the probability of occupancy grid；Scan matching is solved the problems, such as with Gaussian-Newton method, obtains the rigid body translation (x, y, theta) that laser point set is mapped to existing map；Step 3 is built Tu Bao and is combined using hector_navigation navigation packet and hector_slam, to realize the indoor specific frame independently explored；Inertial measurement system IMU is added in state estimation in navigation, and is filtered using EKF；The present invention can be easier, be more convenient that control robot is gone to carry out indoor autonomous exploration, the grating map of indoor environment be obtained, to more effectively rescue personnel be helped to search and rescue the wounded.

title_en: System and method for tracking location of rescue worker in disaster building
title_ko: 재난건물 내에서 구조대원의 위치추적 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, provided is a system for tracking a position of a rescue member in a disaster building, which comprises: a position detector outputting blinking light having a light blinking frequency which is distinguishable toward at least one light transmitting window present in the disaster building, and detecting a light arrival point position corresponding to an arrival point in the disaster building of the blinking light; a member terminal carried by a rescue member and photographing a ray image formed at the position of the ray arrival point in the disaster building by the blinking ray, and transmitting the photographed ray image; and a position tracking server using the arrival point position of the ray for the blinking ray received from the position detector and a light blinking frequency calculated from the received ray image, and determining an indoor position of the rescue member carrying the member terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 재난건물 내에서 구조대원의 위치추적시스템은 재난 건물에 존재하는 적어도 하나 이상의 광선 투과 윈도우를 향해 구분 가능한 광 점멸 주파수를 갖는 점멸 광선을 출력하고, 상기 점멸 광선의 상기 재난 건물 내의 도달 지점에 대응하는 광선 도달점 위치를 검출하는 위치 검출기; 구조대원에 의해 휴대되며, 상기 점멸 광선에 의해 상기 재난 건물 내의 상기 광선 도달점 위치에 형성된 광선 이미지를 촬영하고, 촬영된 광선 이미지를 전송하는 대원 단말기; 및 상기 위치 검출기로부터 수신된 상기 점멸 광선에 대한 상기 광선 도달점 위치 및 상기 대원 단말기로부터 수신된 상기 광선 이미지로부터 산출된 광 점멸 주파수를 이용하여, 상기 대원 단말기를 휴대하는 상기 구조대원의 실내 위치를 결정하는 위치 추적 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Indoor dynamic security evacuation system based on Internet of things and BIM
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indoor dynamic security evacuation system based on the Internet of things and BIM, which comprises: the system comprises an indoor personnel positioning system, an indoor environment monitoring system, a building structure monitoring system, a set of dynamic evacuation path optimization algorithm and a three-dimensional dynamic visual system, wherein the indoor environment monitoring system is installed in a room of a building; the building structure monitoring system is arranged in a beam, a column, a floor slab and a wall body of a building; the dynamic evacuation path optimization algorithm can divide an indoor layout into a dangerous area and a safe area according to indoor environment information acquired by the indoor environment system and structural stress information acquired by the building structure monitoring system, and an evacuation path optimization scheme for trapped people is obtained by combining personnel position information acquired by the indoor positioning system and the indoor layout after dividing the areas; when disasters such as earthquake, fire and the like occur, trapped people can be helped to find the optimal evacuation path, the evacuation efficiency is improved, and casualties are reduced.

title_en: Method for uwb transaction and electronic device therefor
title_ko: Uwb 트랜잭션을 위한 방법 및 전자 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for an ultrawide band (UWB) transaction, which is capable of providing a security-guaranteed transaction using a UWB transaction, and an electronic device thereof. According to various embodiments of the present invention, the electronic device comprises: a communication circuit performing short-range wireless communications; a UWB communication circuit performing UWB communications; a security element providing an execution environment isolated from an operating system (OS) of the electronic device; and a processor. The UWB communication circuit performs ranging with an external electronic device, receives a first UWB signal including a media access control (MAC) header and a MAC payload from the external electronic device, and determines whether to transfer information included in a MAC payload information element to the security element based on at least the MAC payload information element included in the MAC payload. In addition, various embodiments are possible.
abstract_ko: 다양한 실시예에 따르면, 근거리 무선 통신을 수행하도록 설정된 통신 회로, UWB(ultra-wideband) 통신을 수행하도록 설정된 UWB 통신 회로, 상기 전자 장치의 OS(operating system)로부터 고립된(isolated) 실행 환경을 제공하도록 설정된 보안 요소, 및 프로세서를 포함하는 전자 장치가 개시된다. 상기 UWB 통신 회로는, 외부 전자 장치와의 레인징(ranging)을 수행하고, 상기 외부 전자 장치로부터 MAC 헤더 및 MAC 페이로드를 포함하는 제1 UWB 신호를 수신하고, 상기 MAC 페이로드에 포함된 MAC(medium access control) 페이로드 정보 요소에 적어도 기반하여 상기 MAC 페이로드 정보 요소에 포함된 정보의 상기 보안 요소로의 전달 여부를 결정하도록 설정될 수 있다. 이외에도 다양한 실시예들이 가능하다.

title_en: Fire Command System utilizing Real-Time status and Indoor Position Tracking Information
title_ko: 소방대원의 실시간 상태 확인 및 실내 위치 트래킹 정보를 활용한 소방 지휘 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting command system utilizing a real-time status and indoor position tracking information of a firefighter. More specifically, disclosed is a firefighting command system which sets a location coordinate using a beacon to obtain the indoor location information of a firefighter using an acceleration, geomagnetic field, and barometric pressure sensors and obtains a more accurate location using a pedestrian dead reckoning (PDR) method. In addition, the firefighting command system displays the location information on the screen of a mobile terminal to identify a movement path through a tracking system and measure, in real time, the status of the firefighter and information on the field by attaching a shock detection sensor and a temperature and humidity sensor to a firefighting suit and attaching a heart rate sensor attached to a fire fighting glove, thereby transmitting the status and information to the mobile terminal by using a long range (LoRa) communication module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방대원의 실시간 상태 확인 및 실내 위치 트래킹 정보를 활용한 소방 지휘 시스템에 관한 것으로서 더욱 상세하게는 비콘을 활용하여 위치 좌표를 설정한 뒤 가속도, 지자계, 기압 센서를 이용하여 소방대원의 실내 위치 정보를 확보하고 PDR(Pedestrian Dead Reckoning) 방식을 이용하여 보다 정확한 위치를 파악 할 수 있으며, 이러한 위치 정보를 모바일 단말기의 화면에 출력하여 트래킹 시스템을 도입해 이동 경로 파악과 충격 감지 센서, 온습도 센서를 화재 진압복에 부착하고 심박 센서를 소방 장갑에 부착하여 현장 정보와 소방대원의 상태를 실시간으로 측정해 LoRa(Long Range) 통신 모듈을 활용하여 모바일 단말기로 전송하는 소방 지휘 시스템이 개시된다.

title_en: Rescue equipment for dog
abstract_en: The invention relates to rescue equipment for dogs, which comprises a police dog cap, wherein the police dog cap is connected to rescue personnel handheld equipment through wireless transmission; the police dog cap comprises a control module, a camera, a sound pickup, a loudspeaker, a chargeable and dischargeable battery, a GPS positioning tag and a UWB positioning tag; the handheld device comprises a sound pickup, a loudspeaker, a chargeable and dischargeable battery, two UWB positioning base stations, a remote controller and a display module; the control module, UWB location label and GPS location are connected with control module, and the camera is connected with control module, and the adapter is connected with the controller, and the speaker is connected with the controller, can charge and discharge the battery and be connected with control module. The invention can realize the autonomous positioning requirements of the police dog and the rescued person with real-time high precision, the real-time transmission of the site environment, the voice conversation between the rescuers and the rescued person and the voice instruction of the police dog.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system, include: the system comprises an upper computer, an unmanned aerial vehicle and a portable device which are in wireless connection communication with the upper computer, and an OpenMV machine vision module; the portable device is positioned on the person to be rescued; the portable device is attached with a GPS module to preliminarily position the rescue workers, and meanwhile, the unmanned aerial vehicle and the portable device are respectively provided with a UWB positioning module to perform positioning again. The utility model discloses at first treat the rescue personnel through the GPS module and carry out preliminary location, the host computer obtains preliminary positioning information, go out to move unmanned aerial vehicle and go to preliminary positioning position according to planning the route, the further accurate positioning of UWB positioning module is recycled, positioning accuracy reaches centimetre level, can realize accurate input, when unable realization real-time location and the pursuit through the UWB module, unmanned aerial vehicle can rely on OpenMV machine vision module to realize real-time location and pursuit, thereby the adaptability and the interference killing feature of system have been strengthened.

title_en: Multifunctional fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire fighting equipment, and discloses a multifunctional fire fighting robot, which mainly comprises four parts, namely a self-walking chassis 1, an upper loader 2, an autonomous control system 3 and a data acquisition and transmission system 4; the robot is provided with various sensors such as a laser radar, a tracking camera and various toxic gas detectors, can be remotely controlled in a non-line-of-sight manner, has the functions of autonomous path planning driving, tracking driving and the like, and is a third-generation intelligent fire-extinguishing rescue robot in the true sense. The robot can replace fire rescue personnel to enter dangerous disaster accident sites such as inflammable, explosive, toxic, anoxic or dense smoke and the like for detection, fire extinguishing and rescue, and the problem of personal safety threat of the fire fighters in the sites is solved; meanwhile, the robot has extremely strong off-road surface driving capacity, can overcome surface obstacles such as curbs, abrupt slopes, trenches and the like through various field road surfaces such as grasslands, sand lands, shoals, broken stones and the like, and is used for detection, fire extinguishment and rescue under field conditions.
assignees: MINGGUANG HAOMIAO SECURITY AND PROTECTION SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for simultaneously positioning and mapping autonomous mobile platform in rescue scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simultaneously positioning and mapping an autonomous mobile platform in a rescue scene, which is applied to the search and rescue autonomous mobile platform and can be used for positioning and mapping in extreme environments such as a fire rescue scene, a complex dangerous accident scene and the like. The method mainly comprises three parts of sensor information processing, pose estimation and pose correction. Firstly, performing operations such as deblurring, feature extraction and the like on the omnibearing image information acquired by the four-eye camera module. Then, fusing the position and the measurement information of the inertial navigation sensor, estimating the pose, and finally, carrying out global pose optimization correction. The method designs a full-automatic end-to-end defogging method based on the convolutional neural network, does not need post-processing steps, has wide application range, and can be simultaneously applied to defogging of indoor and natural scenes. Meanwhile, a relatively stable binocular vision SLAM method based on a feature point method is adopted to fuse IMU sensor data to locate and build a map of the autonomous mobile platform.

title_en: Emergency positioning searching device, method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency positioning searching device, a method and a system, wherein the emergency positioning searching device comprises: the ultra-wideband PDOA module is used for precise distance measurement and azimuth angle measurement; the MPU module is used for configuring the working mode of each module, managing communication and reading and writing operation and processing of data information; the wireless data transmission module is used for data interaction between the emergency positioning search and rescue device and the background server; the power supply module is used for supplying power to each module; the emergency fixed search device also comprises a display module for displaying the working state of the emergency fixed search device and the distance and direction information of a person seeking help or an object to be searched relative to the emergency fixed search device; the emergency positioning search and rescue searching device further comprises a key module used for manually sending a distress signal and switching the working modes of the emergency positioning search and rescue searching device. The system can realize interactive positioning between firefighters on site, know accurate position information of the person seeking help in real time, reduce rescue difficulty and improve rescue efficiency.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU LOCARIS ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Maritime life saving system with a geofence and artificial intelligence function
title_ko: 지오펜스와 인공 지능을 활용한 해상 인명 구조 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a marine lifesaving system using a geofence and artificial intelligence (AI). The marine lifesaving system of the present invention includes a transmitting device provided in a life jacket, and a receiving device and a rescue processing device provided in a ship. The transmitting device has an inertial sensor and a salinity sensor. The receiving device transmits a radio signal transmitted from the transmitting device to the rescue processing device. The rescue processing device generates voice information in accordance with various scenarios in response to various distress accidents, and forms an AI voice signal optimized for a situation of a distress accident as a database. The rescue processing device sets a positional relationship between the transmitting device and the receiving device as a geofence area. When the transmitting device deviates from a set geofence area or is detected equal to or less than a reference altitude from the inertial sensor and a certain value of salinity concentration is detected at the same time, it is determined that a distress accident or a fall accident occurs to induce sailing of a ship to a location of a survivor or to provide an operator of the ship with AI voice information guiding to rescue a falling person. According to the present invention, when a distress accident occurs, the AI voice information can be output to promptly and accurately rescue a survivor or a falling person.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지오펜스와 인공 지능을 활용한 해상 인명 구조 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 해상 인명 구조 시스템은 구명 조끼에 구비되는 발신 장치와, 선박에 구비된 수신 장치 및 구조 처리 장치를 포함한다. 발신 장치는 관성 센서와 염분 센서를 구비한다. 수신 장치는 발신 장치로부터 전송되는 무선 신호를 구조 처리 장치로 전달한다. 구조 처리 장치는 다양한 조난 사고에 대응하여 여러가지 시니리오에 따른 음성 정보를 생성하고, 조난 사고의 상황에 최적화된 인공 지능 음성 신호를 데이터베이스화한다. 구조 처리 장치는 발신 장치와 수신 장치들 간의 위치 관계를 지오펜스 영역으로 설정한다. 발신 장치가 설정된 지오펜스 영역으로부터 이탈되거나, 관성 센서로부터 기준 고도 이하로 감지되고 동시에 일정 크기의 염분 농도가 감지되면, 조난 사고 또는 낙선 사고가 발생된 것으로 판별하여 조난자의 위치로 선박의 항해를 유도하거나 또는 낙선자를 구조하도록 안내하는 인공 지능 음성 정보를 선박의 운항자에게 제공한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 조난 사고 발생 시, 인공 지능 음성 정보를 출력하여 조난자 및 낙선자를 신속하고 정확하게 구조하도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Multi-terminal collaborative forest crown lower landform mapping system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for establishing a map of a landform under a multi-terminal cooperative forest tree crown. The method comprises initializing correction time; the method comprises the following steps that a three-dimensional laser radar obtains three-dimensional point cloud data of a space environment around an unmanned vehicle, an inertial navigation system obtains inertial navigation positioning data of the unmanned vehicle, and a satellite navigation module obtains satellite navigation positioning data of the unmanned vehicle; fusing inertial navigation positioning data and satellite navigation positioning data of the unmanned vehicle to obtain real-time positioning information of the unmanned vehicle; and orderly accumulating according to the three-dimensional point cloud data and the real-time positioning information to generate a three-dimensional landform map. The unmanned vehicle inertial navigation positioning data and the satellite navigation positioning data are fused, the positioning precision of the unmanned vehicle is improved, the precision of the three-dimensional landform map is improved, and direct basis and guarantee are provided for the optimal fire extinguishing search and rescue path and scheme when a fire disaster occurs.
assignees: ZHEJIANG XIBEIHU SPECIAL VEHICLE CO LTD

title_en: UWB antenna, UWB positioning tag and indoor positioning system
abstract_en: The application provides a UWB antenna, UWB location label and indoor positioning system relates to UWB location field. This application is through printing radiating element paster and feed paster on the first plane of medium base plate, and make the radiating element paster connect the feed paster gradually, in order to guarantee radiating element paster and feed paster impedance match, then through printing the ground plane paster on the second plane relative with the first plane of medium base plate, and make the ground plane paster be connected with the feed paster, in order to realize the feed ground function of feed paster, thereby guarantee that the UWB antenna that obtains belongs to small and low cost's printing plate antenna. In addition, this application is through having seted up a fluting structure in ground plane paster's position department that corresponds with the radiating element paster, makes ground plane paster realize its ground function simultaneously, also can carry out the frequency trapped wave to the radiating element paster to ensure that the UWB antenna that obtains has higher radiation efficiency.

title_en: Indoor positioning method and positioning device based on WIFI and laser radar and robot
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to an indoor positioning method, a positioning device, an unmanned robot, a server, terminal equipment and a computer readable storage medium based on WIFI and laser radar, wherein the indoor positioning method based on the WIFI and the laser radar comprises the following steps: constructing a WIFI fingerprint database; constructing a laser 2D map; simultaneously performing indoor WIFI positioning and laser AMCL positioning; and selecting a WIFI positioning result to replace the AMCL for repositioning according to the effectiveness of the AMCL positioning result until the positioning result is output. According to the embodiment of the invention, by adding the WIFI indoor positioning method, when the robot runs in an indoor environment, the result of the WIFI positioning is adopted to replace the result of the laser positioning trapped in the local optimum, so that the result of the laser positioning is changed, the repositioning is completed on the basis, the accurate position of the laser positioning is found, the robot is helped to find the position of the robot under the mismatch condition, and the application requirement of an actual scene is better met.
assignees: GUANGZHOU ELITE AUTOPILOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rapid help seeking method based on indoor positioning advertisement screen
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quick help seeking method based on an indoor positioning advertisement screen. When the person needs to seek help, the person looks for a nearby advertisement screen; judging whether the help seeker can use code scanning software or not; seeking help by scanning the two-dimensional code on the advertisement screen; seeking help through a help seeking button of the advertisement screen; initiating a help call; the machine linkage is used for displaying the requirements and the position of equipment closest to the help seeker; the rescuer selects whether to provide help; scanning the two-dimensional code on the watched advertisement screen, and displaying navigation of equipment nearest to the help seeker, snapshot of a nearby environment or contact information of the help seeker; the rescuer arrives at the position of the help seeker and judges whether the help can be given or not; displaying a feedback two-dimensional code on an advertisement screen after releasing the release of the related emergency message; and (3) the rescuers and passers-by scan and evaluate the two-dimensional codes in the step (10), if the two-dimensional codes are true to call for help, the two-dimensional codes are ended, and if the two-dimensional codes are false to call for help, the two-dimensional codes are added into a blacklist.
assignees: FUZHOU DONGFANG WISDOM NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Indoor positioning method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to an indoor positioning method and system, wherein the indoor positioning method comprises the following steps: constructing a three-dimensional coordinate map according to the installation positions of a plurality of detection devices in a building; controlling each detection device to detect the trapped person and acquiring detection data; and determining the position of the trapped person according to the detection data and the position coordinates of each detection device in the three-dimensional coordinate map. Through the application, the problem that the position of the trapped person cannot be quickly positioned in the related technology is solved.

title_en: Indoor positioning search and rescue system and method based on microwave technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indoor positioning search and rescue system and method based on microwave technology, and the indoor positioning search and rescue system comprises a microwave antenna module (1), a circulator (2), a radio frequency transceiver module (3), a signal processor (4), an infrared temperature measurement module (5) and a positioning module (6), wherein the microwave antenna module (1) is connected with the circulator (2), the circulator (2) is connected with the radio frequency transceiver module (3), the radio frequency transceiver module (3) is connected with the signal processor (4), and the signal processor (4) is connected with the infrared temperature measurement module (5) and the positioning module (6). Has the advantages that: the radio frequency technology has low cost and wide radiation area distance. The search can be performed without lighting. The search precision is high, and the method is suitable for search and rescue work of different targets.
assignees: WANCHUANG HUIKE CHONGQING INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fine positioning system applying UWB technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a fine positioning system applying UWB technology, which comprises a server, a positioning module arranged on a positioning device and a search and rescue module; the positioning module is provided with a UWB tag which communicates with the server through UWB; the positioning module is connected with the search and rescue module through Bluetooth; the search and rescue module and the positioning module are respectively provided with a Bluetooth sending module and a Bluetooth receiving module which are matched; and a sending indicator lamp and a receiving indicator lamp for displaying the strength of the Bluetooth connecting signal are respectively arranged on the search and rescue module and the positioning module.
