By adopting the technical scheme, when the rescue is carried out under the mine, the rescue personnel can know the distance from the rescuee in real time, the rescue time is saved, and meanwhile, as the positioning device is also provided with the indicating lamp, the rescuee can know the signal that the rescuer comes to rescue the rescuee by receiving the indicating lamp, so that the rescuee is informed, and the rescuers can further take the measures of calling for help and the like to directly find the rescuee.

title_en: Handheld instrument suitable for accurate positioning of coal mine personnel and positioning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a handheld instrument suitable for accurately positioning coal mine personnel, which comprises a shell, a power supply, a voltage conversion circuit, a UWB radio frequency chip, a power amplifier, a UWB signal receiving and transmitting antenna, a microcontroller, a Bluetooth communication module, a Bluetooth signal receiving and transmitting antenna and a touch display screen. The invention provides three working modes to meet the search and rescue requirements under different situations, and the accurate positioning of the tag/base station is realized by effectively combining the three working modes, thereby being beneficial to search and rescue personnel under a mine; meanwhile, parameter configuration, operation management and firmware updating are carried out on the tags/base stations by combining the Bluetooth communication module, so that the positioning accuracy of other tags can be improved and the tag power consumption can be reduced by reasonably setting the working mode of each tag in the search and rescue process besides the convenience of daily management.

title_en: Independently distributed search and rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device is searched for andd rescue to autonomic distributing type, the crawler-type chassis is installed to the bottom of automobile body, there is six degrees of freedom robotic arm at the upper end middle part on crawler-type chassis through bolted connection, there is UWB wireless range finding orientation module upper end of six degrees of freedom robotic arm through bolted connection, there is intelligent camera module at the front end middle part on crawler-type chassis through bolted connection, AMG8833 thermal imaging module is installed to the lower extreme of intelligent camera module, STM32 single chip microcomputer system's rear end is connected with communication system. Adopt the hot imaging module of AMG, the stranded personnel of discernment that can be accurate can send the coordinate and the picture condition of stranded personnel to the rescue personnel the very first time, can the search and rescue of zero clearance high strength, the work efficiency of effectual improvement rescue, scalability is high, can increase and decrease the quantity of robot wantonly, and does not influence the operating condition of robot, and the use scene is nimble.
assignees: GUOKE ZHEJIANG MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Indoor positioning device based on wireless WIFI inertial positioning
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of wireless positioning, in particular to an indoor positioning device based on wireless WIFI inertial positioning, which comprises a mounting seat, a control box and a processor, wherein both sides of the mounting seat are provided with fixing binding bands, the top of the mounting seat is provided with the control box, the left side of the top of the control box is provided with a smoke sensor, the middle of the top of the control box is provided with a display screen, the right side of the top of the control box is provided with a buzzer, the inner cavity of the control box is provided with a processor, a storage battery, an inertial sensor and a communication module, the processor is electrically connected with the storage battery, the smoke sensor and the inertial sensor in an input mode, the structure is reasonable, the indoor positioning is realized through the cooperation of the inertial sensor, the processor, the communication module and a monitoring terminal, the smoke sensor, the display screen and the buzzer are arranged on the, the fire disaster monitoring and early warning is realized, and the remote warning is realized through the cooperation of the communication module and the monitoring terminal.

title_en: Building interior fire emergency navigation and positioning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building interior fire emergency navigation positioning system, which comprises a handheld positioning device, a fire emergency lamp, a first UWB transceiver and an intelligent sensor, wherein each handheld positioning device is provided with a UWB positioning tag and a second UWB transceiver; each fire-fighting emergency lamp is provided with a power supply, a display screen and a processor, a first UWB transceiver and an intelligent sensor are installed in each fire-fighting emergency lamp and connected with the processor and the power supply, and the first UWB transceiver sends corresponding signals and positioning data of the first UWB transceiver to the processor when receiving UWB signals of a UWB positioning tag; the processor sends the positioning data and the environmental data of the trapped person to the trapped person and the rescue personnel handheld positioning device through the first UWB transceiver, and the processor is connected with and controls the display screen. The utility model discloses can provide the unblocked condition and the stranded personnel distribution condition of building inner channel for the fire fighter, improve the efficiency of rescuing.

title_en: Ultra-wideband MIMO radar vital sign detection positioning method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ultra wide band radar signal processing, and discloses an ultra wide band MIMO radar vital sign detection positioning method. The invention mainly comprises the following steps: (1) rearranging the echo data of a plurality of channels of the MIMO radar; (2) performing sequential inertial coherent imaging and compensation on the target area; (3) band-pass filtering along a time dimension; (4) calculating the position of the surface of the thorax of the living body; (5) removing clutter and direct current bias; (6) taking phases to obtain vital sign signals; (7) the respiratory and heartbeat signals are separated. (8) Detecting the peak values of the respiration and heartbeat signals, and calculating the instantaneous respiration rate and the heart rate; (9) sliding time window dynamic measurements. The invention can be used for carrying out three-dimensional positioning and vital sign measurement on trapped people in ruins and buildings, has high signal processing gain, high positioning precision and good real-time performance, and can realize instantaneous respiration rate and heart rate measurement.

title_en: Dual-source IR-UWB radar for searching and rescuing non-natural human body target after disaster
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of post-disaster search and rescue, and particularly relates to a dual-source IR-UWB radar for searching and rescuing a human body target in an unnatural state after a disaster, which comprises a radar host, an antenna array and an upper computer; the radar host comprises a stepping control module, a sequential logic control module, a data acquisition module, a DSP data processing module, a power supply module, an indicator light and an operation button; the antenna array comprises a Tx1 antenna, a Tx2 antenna, an Rx1 antenna and an Rx2 antenna; the upper computer is a notebook computer and a tablet personal computer, the structure is reasonable, the defect that a single-source IR-UWB radar cannot have a lower central frequency and a larger bandwidth at the same time is overcome, the target is detected by using two antennas with low central frequencies of 270MHz and 400MHz, the equivalent bandwidth of the radar is expanded, and the system has good ruins penetration capacity and strong weak signal detection capacity.

title_en: Management system based on UWB mine staff
abstract_en: The invention discloses a management system based on UWB mine workers, comprising: a base station system; the tag system is used for receiving and transmitting data with the base station system and is arranged on a safety helmet of a worker; the upper computer transmits and receives data to and from the base station system; and the background monitoring alarm system is used for receiving the data signal sent by the upper computer. The system can know the specific position of each worker in real time through the upper computer of the system, and whether the worker enters a dangerous area, and timely remind workers entering an illegal area; the life safety of the worker can be better guaranteed, and if the worker encounters an emergency or danger, the worker can ask for help through a help calling button on the label system to be rescued in time; when an accident occurs in the mine, the trapped personnel can be accurately positioned, and accurate and effective rescue is implemented.

title_en: AI based dangerous situation detection system for mobile crane and work of ground work place yard using analyzing accident cause big data of mobile crane and work of ground work place yard
title_ko: 이동식 크레인 지상 작업장 및 작업자 사고원인 분석 빅데이터를 이용한 ai기반 이동식 크레인 지상 작업장 및 작업자 위험 탐지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an artificial intelligence (AI)-based dangerous situation detection system for a working ground and worker below a mobile crane using accident cause analysis big data of a working ground and worker below a mobile crane and, more specifically, to a system for detecting the risk of a working ground and worker below a mobile crane, which is operated by an AI system and an ultrawide band (UWB) VT sensor and PT sensor system to prevent accidents. According to the present invention, the system comprises: an AI system analyzing mobile crane types and features, mobile crane working environments, disaster cases by the type of disaster including fall, drop, overturning, straying, collapse, electric shock, and collision related to mobile crane works, causes of accidents including defects in lifting objects, booms, car bodies, boarding equipment, and hooks, classification of victims including crane operators, nearby workers, and managers, and causes of accidents including non-compliance with safety rules, defective line hanging works, defective crane equipment, overturning of cranes, defective boarding facilities, defective buckets, and inexperienced work to build big data for each mobile crane type/feature, each mobile crane working environment, each disaster case by disaster type, each accident cause, each victim classification, and each accident cause, and generating and mapping accident response scenarios corresponding to the big data for each classification; and a UWB VT sensor and PT sensor system attached to the mobile crane and a worker or an object.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 이동식 크레인 지상 작업장 및 작업자 사고원인 분석 빅데이터를 이용한 AI기반 이동식 크레인 지상 작업장 및 작업자 위험 탐지 시스템에 관한 것으로, 이동식 크레인 종류 및 특징과, 이동식 크레인 작업환경과, 이동식 크레인 작업과 관련한 추락, 낙하, 전도, 협착, 도괴·붕괴, 감전 및 충돌을 포함하는 재해형태별 재해사례와, 인양물, 붐대, 차체, 탑승설비 및 후크 결함을 포함하는 사고유발원인과, 크레인 운전자, 인근 작업자, 관리자를 포함하는 피해자분류와, 안전수칙 미준수, 줄걸이 작업불량, 크레인 장비불량, 크레인 전도, 탑승설비 불량, 버켓불량 및 작업미숙을 포함하는 사고원인을 분석하여 상기 이동식 크레인 종류 및 특징, 이동식 크레인 작업환경, 재해형태별 재해사례, 사고유발원인, 피해자분류, 사고원인별로 분류별 빅데이터화하고, 상기 분류별 빅데이터에 상응하는 안전사고 대응시나리오를 작성 맵핑하여 구축한 인공지능시스템과; 이동식 크레인 및 작업자 또는 사물에 부착된 UWB VT 및 PT센서시스템;을 포함하여 구성되어 상기 인공지능시스템 및 UWB VT센서 및 PT센서 시스템에 의하여 작동되는 이동식 크레인 지상 작업장 및 작업자의 위험을 탐지하기 위한 시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: IL SEUNG DONG ENG & CON CO LTD

title_en: Self-networking positioning system based on UWB
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ad hoc network positioning system based on UWB, which comprises a long-distance Bluetooth gateway or a UWB base station, 1 or a plurality of fixed-point tags, 1 or a plurality of nearby tags and a server. The invention adopts a mechanism combining UWB and Bluetooth, and coordinates the master-slave relation M and the fixed point relation A of the label while reducing the power consumption, and confirms the self-positioning condition F; meanwhile, the ranging result is uploaded through Bluetooth, so that the ranging result can be conveniently received by a Bluetooth gateway or other intelligent equipment such as a tablet, a mobile phone and the like with Bluetooth, and the position information is further analyzed and displayed on a map; and self positioning and navigation can be realized. The firefighter carrying the tag can acquire the position information of the member carrying the tag at any time through the industrial tablet, and can support teammates through navigation or arrange personnel nearby for support. Because the data is directly transmitted from the tag to the tablet personal computer or the smart phone, the data does not need to be forwarded through a cloud platform or a server and the like, and the time delay of the position data is reduced to the minimum.

title_en: Fireman indoor positioning method based on WiFi fingerprint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a WiFi fingerprint-based firefighter indoor positioning method, which comprises the following steps: when a fire disaster suddenly occurs, receiving signal intensity information transmitted by the wireless access node by a fireman rushing into the fire scene, and determining the serial number of a cluster to which the fireman belongs; according to the wireless access node reliability function, calculating and screening the reliability of each wireless access node, and filtering out wireless access nodes damaged by fire; calculating the distance proportion of all reference points in the same cluster by using a dynamic online matching algorithm in the cluster to which the firefighter belongs and combining the signal strength values received by the reference points, and selecting the reference points with the distance proportion larger than a distance proportion threshold value to carry out position estimation; and calculating the position coordinates of the firefighter according to the selected reference point. The invention provides an AP trust function to screen the AP aiming at the possible AP damage condition in the fire scene; and a dynamic online matching algorithm is applied, so that the positioning precision of the algorithm is improved.

title_en: Aerial search positioning processor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication equipment, and particularly discloses an aerial search positioning processor which comprises a case, and a power module, a CPU module, an I/O module and a motherboard which are arranged in the case, wherein the power module, the CPU module and the I/O module are electrically connected with the motherboard. According to the invention, by utilizing related information provided by devices such as a communication radio station, a lifesaving radio station, a GNSS/BD Beidou transceiver, an inertial navigation system and the like, the current position of a carrier, the position of a search target, a search track, a straight flight path and other comprehensive search and rescue conditions are displayed on a display controller, so that the air search and rescue efficiency is improved, search and rescue, positioning and instant state confirmation of people and articles falling into water are completed, and the identification of the rescued target on an electronic digital map is completed.
assignees: XIAN LONGZI ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire scene firefighter cooperative relay positioning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire scene firefighter cooperative relay positioning method and a system. According to the number of UWB base stations which can be communicated by the tag to be positioned, the UWB base stations are divided into multiple priorities, and then targeted positioning is carried out. Aiming at the first priority label, UWB and INS are combined, NLOS error in UWB ranging value is weakened under the condition that UWB base station is sufficient but is mostly in NLOS environment, and positioning accuracy of the first priority label is improved. And then combining the positioned labels with the corresponding UWB base stations as a reference node, aiming at other priority labels, adopting a UWB-based cooperative positioning algorithm according to the conditions of the UWB base stations distributed around the labels and the mobile anchor points, and carrying out relay positioning on the labels to be positioned in a grouping positioning mode, thereby improving the positioning rate of the other priority labels. The invention can reduce the requirement of positioning on high distribution density or long communication radius of UWB base stations, and maximally uses the whole co-positioning network resource, thereby acquiring more positioning reference information.

title_en: Autonomous navigation unmanned aerial vehicle integrating visual inertial navigation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an autonomous navigation unmanned aerial vehicle integrating visual inertial navigation, wherein a frame is of a three-layer structure, and the bottom of the bottom layer of the frame is provided with a supporting part and a camera assembly; a plurality of wings are arranged outwards at the edges between the middle layer and the bottom layer of the rack, and a flight assembly and a function expansion assembly are arranged in cooperation with the wings; a control panel is arranged on the upper part of the bottom layer of the machine frame among the plurality of wings in a matching way; a power supply is arranged on the middle layer of the frame in a matching way; the top layer of the rack is provided with an upper computer in a matching way; the upper computer and the control panel are connected with a power supply, and the upper computer is matched with the control panel; the camera shooting assembly, the flying assembly and the function expansion assembly are arranged in a matched mode with the control panel. The utility model can independently position and navigate in complex unknown environment which can not be reached easily, provide reasonable and stable map building of surrounding environment, automatically patrol in high-difficulty search and rescue tasks of different occasions, carry out map reconnaissance and construction in unknown geographical areas, and realize autonomous navigation logistics transportation; overall structure is stable, and work efficiency is high, and operating condition is stable, the maintenance of being convenient for.

title_en: Doorplate with umb and Beidou positioning functions
abstract_en: The invention discloses a doorplate utilizing umb and Beidou positioning functions, which comprises a mounting plate, a doorplate main body, a fixing plate, a fixing component, a doorplate mark, a buzzer, a solar panel, a power supply module, a Beidou positioning module, a umb module, a UWB module, a control module, a two-dimensional code generation module, a switching module and a wireless transmission module, wherein the doorplate main body is fixed on one side of the mounting plate, the fixing plate is mounted on the other side of the mounting plate through the fixing component, and the doorplate mark is mounted on one side of the doorplate main body; the doorplate provided by the invention avoids the singleness of the traditional doorplate, is convenient for a user to use, the Beidou positioning module and the umb module are more accurately positioned, and are matched with the buzzer, so that the alarming positioning and disaster rescue are facilitated, the doorplate position is conveniently and accurately found, the search and rescue time is reduced, and the fixed assembly is arranged, so that the doorplate main body can be conveniently fixedly installed, detached and maintained, and time and labor are saved.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting protective clothing
abstract_en: The utility model provides an intelligent fire-fighting protective clothing, comprising: the fire-fighting backpack is internally provided with a wireless radio frequency identification system, an electronic instrument, a battery, a circuit board and an oxygen cylinder, the upper part of the protective suit is provided with a protective mask and a head-mounted display, and the circuit board is connected with the electronic instrument of the fire-fighting backpack, the battery, the protective mask and the head-mounted display; the top of the protective mask is provided with a camera, and a thermal inductance image is displayed in a thermal inductance image head-mounted display; the intelligent watch also comprises an RFID reader and an intelligent watch, and is used for detecting the blood pressure, the heart rate and the oxygen value of a wearer; the microphone is used for realizing a remote video intercom function; the help caller sends out warning information to team members through a sound or visual warning device when the wearer is static or trapped; the communication system and the inertial navigation module are used for positioning personnel in real time; the fire-fighting backpack is externally provided with a temperature sensor for detecting the ambient temperature, and the temperature sensor can automatically alarm through a prompting lamp, a sound alarm and a vibrator when the ambient temperature exceeds a set value.
assignees: RUENTEX RESCUE EQUIPMENT TECH HEBEI CO LTD

title_en: Emergency rescue comprehensive command device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an emergency rescue comprehensive command device, which belongs to the technical field of emergency rescue, and comprises a closed space, double emergency rescue comprehensive command equipment with double UWB (ultra wide band) tag modules and a UWB base station system; the emergency rescue comprehensive command equipment comprises a motor, a wireless module, an obstacle avoidance device, an encoder, a double UWB (ultra Wide band) tag module, an IMU (inertial measurement Unit) inertial measurement unit, a temperature detection module, a gas concentration detection module and a smoke concentration detection module, wherein the motor, the wireless module, the obstacle avoidance device, the encoder, the double UWB tag module, the IMU inertial measurement unit, the temperature detection module, the gas concentration detection module and the smoke concentration detection module are respectively connected with a PID (proportion integration differentiation) controller; the method has the advantages that the UWB positioning is adopted to automatically set the path tour according to the user; when meeting an obstacle during driving, the vehicle can automatically stop; through the configuration of cell-phone APP: a. the movement speed and the movement track of the emergency rescue comprehensive command equipment can be configured through the APP; b. the driving, stopping and remote control of the emergency rescue comprehensive command equipment can be controlled through the APP; c. the running state of the emergency rescue comprehensive command equipment can be monitored.
assignees: HUNAN VOCATIONAL INSTITUTE OF SAFETY TECH CHANGSHA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Accurate positioning method and system for firefighter in full-task scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for accurately positioning firefighters in a full-task scene, which comprises the following steps: intelligent fire hydrant system module: referencing a positioning beacon, monitoring the health state, detecting the fire and predicting the situation, and guiding the alarm and the task; the movable intelligent reference positioning system module comprises: the method comprises the steps of referencing a positioning beacon, autonomously positioning to acquire information through an IMU (inertial measurement unit), and resolving reference positioning; wearable individual positioning system: the positioning tag is referenced, the accurate position is calculated by receiving signals, information is obtained by self-positioning, task guidance is carried out, and physiological information is monitored; fire control task control commander terminal system module: positioning monitoring personnel, monitoring and predicting fire situation, optimizing and commanding tasks, monitoring equipment state, displaying and controlling; a central processing server module: monitoring information, optimizing tasks and guidance, resolving and positioning, and managing a database. The invention provides a method for accurately positioning fire fighters and guiding tasks in a full task stage.
assignees: JIANGSU DEYANJIA SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Firefighter gait and posture detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting gait and posture of a firefighter, which comprises the following steps: each time the firefighter takes a step, the corresponding basic state parameters are obtained through measurement of the sensors; deriving the basic state parameters to obtain extended state parameters; judging the movement gait or gesture of the firefighter according to the basic state parameters and the expansion state parameters of the firefighter and the state judgment criteria; and transmitting the determined movement gait or gesture data of the firefighter back to the command end. The invention embeds an inertia processing layer, and judges the action state of personnel by analyzing the inertia data (speed, position and attitude angle) independently, analyzes the actions of fire fighters and classifies the actions as follows: normal walking, running, resting, creeping forward, free falling, going upstairs, downstairs and the like; the method monitors the actions and the gesture and posture properties of the firefighter in real time only through the inertial sensors arranged on the feet, and performs flexible early warning under the condition that the firefighter is unconscious and cannot communicate.

title_en: Precision aerial firefighting and deluge system for helicopters and unmanned aerial systems
abstract_en: The precision aerial firefighting and deluge system for helicopters and unmanned aerial systems is a device to attack fires inaccessible to firefighters due to altitude or other obstructions by streaming water or other fire retardant into or onto a specific location on the ground, on the water, or at altitude. The system employs a medium or heavy lift helicopter or unmanned aerial systems one or more tanks or bladders for water and/or fire retardant chemicals, a compressed air foam system, a pump, rigid plumbing lines for outflow of water/fire retardant; a rigid, telescopic boom that extends beyond rotor tip path plane, flexible lines/hoses inside boom; a crew switched electronic boom controller, a boom management system, a flange adapter, an electric, variable direction, crew-controlled fire monitor, a drop-hose, and a dart with inertial feathers.

title_en: Disaster prevention support system and program
abstract_en: To provide a disaster prevention support system and a program that allow for determining the attributes of occupants when displaying the number of the occupants in each area of a building.SOLUTION: A disaster prevention support system 1 includes an automatic fire alarm system 2, an indoor positioning system 3, an on-site activity support system 4, and a private firefighting support system 5. The disaster prevention support system 1 acquires location and attribute information of occupants. At the time of a fire, detector alarm information is sent from a support server 7 to portable terminals 8 carried by private firefighters, and a map image showing numbers of occupants in each area of a building, which are aggregated in units of the attribute based on the acquired location and attribute information, is displayed on a display device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Underwater acoustic signal detection method based on Redberg atomic radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater acoustic signal detection method based on a Redberg atomic radar, which utilizes a multi-frequency band microwave source to emit microwave signals to a water surface, each frequency band microwave signal senses fluctuation of the water surface and generates a reflection echo, utilizes a Redberg atomic antenna array to receive the reflection echo of each frequency band microwave signal once, inverts the water surface fluctuation signal according to a micro Doppler effect and fits an acoustic component through high-pass filtering. According to the invention, the performance of the traditional radar is upgraded by the capability advantage of the Redburg atoms in the aspects of high-sensitivity electromagnetic signal sensing, ultra-wideband multi-band parallel signal detection and the like, so that the traditional radar meets the micro-Doppler water surface fluctuation measurement requirement; meanwhile, in view of the fact that the working frequency of the underwater acoustic signal is larger than the fluctuation frequency of the water surface waves, high-frequency effective information can be extracted from low-frequency strong background noise by using a high-pass filter, and a brand-new and feasible underwater acoustic signal detection means with upgraded performance is provided for underwater exploration, hydrologic measurement, diving search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Disaster site self-adaptive emergency investigation device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a disaster site self-adaptive emergency investigation device which comprises an antenna assembly, a main control board, a battery, an egg-shaped shell and a camera arranged on the shell, wherein the main control board is connected with the antenna assembly; the bottom of the shell is provided with a counterweight part for centering, so that the shell forms a tumbler structure; the antenna assembly, the main control board and the battery are respectively arranged in the shell; the main control board is provided with a UWB positioning module, and the battery, the antenna assembly and the camera are respectively electrically connected with the main control board. The disaster site self-adaptive emergency investigation device has a simple and novel structure; the shell is arranged into a tumbler structure, so that the shell can be kept upright after being thrown into a disaster site, and the camera has a good shooting visual angle; the antenna assembly can transmit pictures shot by the camera to a command center outside a disaster site, and help rescue workers to remotely survey the site condition; the UWB positioning module can help determine the position of a UWB positioning card on the rescue personnel, and the rescue personnel are prevented from getting lost.
assignees: SHENZHEN TIANYOU SATELLITE APPLICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster monitoring system of steep slope land by using DRON and operating method thereof
title_ko: 드론을 이용한 경사지 재난 감시 시스템 및 그 운용방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a slope disaster monitoring system using a drone and an operating method thereof. The slope disaster monitoring system comprises: a ground pile unit; a central control center server; a manager control terminal; and a disaster monitoring drone. According to the present invention, it is possible to accurately predict the possibility of a landslide or collapse of a slope.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 산사태 등이 발생할 수 있는 급격한 경사지에 위치정보를 확인할 수 있는 소자를 다수 살포하고 가시광선과 열화상이 포함된 현장의 3차원 위치데이터와 이미지를 촬영하여 데이터베이스로 기록 관리하고 주기적으로 해당 현장을 감시하므로 경사지에서 발생할 수 있는 재난을 사전에 예방하거나 피해 규모를 예상하고 확인하는 드론을 이용한 경사지 재난 감시 시스템 및 그 운용방법에 관한 것으로 지상의 경사지에 해당하는 특정 지역에 고정 설치되며 해당 위치 설명 정보를 입력받아 기록 저장하고 지피에스 좌표정보와 엘비에스 좌표정보를 각각 수신하여 갱신 기록 저장하며 해당 제어신호 수신에 의하여 기록 저장된 정보를 지반데이터 패킷 프레임으로 변환하여 와이파이 통신방식과 블루투스 통신방식과 CDMA 이동통신 방식으로 각각 송신하고 하나 이상 다수로 이루어지는 지상말뚝부; 지상말뚝부와 스마트통신망을 경유하여 와이파이 통신방식과 블루투스 통신방식과 CDMA 이동통신 방식과 유선랜 통신방식 중 선택된 어느 하나 또는 선택된 어느 하나 이상으로 접속하고 지반데이터 패킷 프레임으로 변환된 정보를 수신하여 할당된 영역에 저장 관리하며 분석 처리된 상황정보를 출력하는 중앙관제센터서버; 중앙관제센터서버에 접속하여 상기 상황정보를 수신하고 해당 비행조정제어신호를 출력하는 관리자조정단말; 관리자조정단말의 해당 비행조정제어신호에 의하여 비행하고 지피에스 좌표정보와 엘비에스 좌표정보와 관성항법 좌표정보를 각각 검출하며 선택적 산술평균연산된 좌표정보를 이용하여 비행자세를 제어하고 지정된 위치의 상공에서 지정된 지상을 자외선과 적외선과 가시광선으로 각각 스테레오 촬영하고 촬영시의 해당 자세 정보에 연계시켜 할당된 영역에 기록 저장하며 지반데이터 패킷 프레임으로 변환하여 자체 구비된 다수 통신수단 중 2 가지 이상의 통신수단으로 상기 관리자조정단말과 중앙관제센터서버에 송신하는 재난감시드론을 포함하는 특징에 의하여 수풀이 울창한 산간지역의 지반의 상태를 신속하고 정밀하게 측정 관찰하여 산사태 또는 경사지의 붕괴 가능성을 정확하게 예측하고, 발생된 재난 현장을 정확하게 분석하여 필요한 후속조치가 신속하게 진행되도록 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for position estimation of first responders
title_ko: 긴급 구조원의 위치 결정 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for measuring an indoor location of an emergency responder in an emergency communication system which can be rapidly deployed during disaster recovery. According to one embodiment, a method for determining a location of an emergency responder includes the steps of: estimating a distance between an anchor node and an emergency responder based on signals received from a plurality of anchor nodes; based on the distance, determining an optimal set of anchor nodes from the plurality of anchor nodes; and determining the location of the emergency responder based on the optimal set of anchor nodes. The anchor node includes at least one of still-alive access points (SAPs) and helper access points (HAPs).
abstract_ko: 재난 복구 시 신속 배치 가능한 응급 통신 시스템에서 긴급 구조원의 실내 위치 측정 방법이 개시된다.  일 실시예에 따른 긴급 구조원의 위치 결정 방법은 복수의 앵커 노드에서 수신되는 신호에 기초하여, 앵커 노드와 긴급 구조원 사이의 거리를 추정하는 단계, 거리에 기초하여, 복수의 앵커 노드 중에서 최적의 앵커 노드 집합을 결정하는 단계, 최적의 앵커 노드 집합에 기초하여, 긴급 구조원의 위치를 결정하는 단계를 포함하고, 앵커 노드는 스틸 얼라이브 액세스 포인트(still-alive access points ; SAPs) 및 헬퍼 액세스 포인트(helper access points ; HAPs) 중 적어도 하나를 포함한다.

title_en: Amphibious exoskeleton robot system for underwater rescue
abstract_en: The invention provides an amphibious exoskeleton robot system for underwater rescue in the technical field of flood disaster relief auxiliary robots, which comprises a sensing module, a base module and a rigid lower limb exoskeleton, wherein the sensing module comprises a myoelectric sensor and an inertial sensor, the base module comprises a processing module and a driving module, the rigid lower limb exoskeleton module comprises a waterproof backpack, the inertial sensor is arranged on the surface of the skin of a joint, the myoelectric sensor is arranged at the position of a shank and a thigh, the driving module and the processing module are arranged in the waterproof backpack, the driving module is connected with the processing module, the inertial sensor and the myoelectric sensor receive signals, the signals are fed back to the processing module and the driving module, and the driving module indicates the rigid lower limb exoskeleton to make corresponding actions to provide assistance. The invention is provided with the inertial sensor to realize the distinguishing of the motion states, obtains the bioelectricity signal of the rescuers by the myoelectric sensor to predict the next action, and controls the rigid lower limb exoskeleton to make the corresponding action to complete the optimal boosting work.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY OF CHINA

title_en: Method and system for locating entry point of firefighter building
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for locating entry points of firefighters in buildings, comprising the following steps: step S1: respectively solving position data by a micro inertial navigation system and a satellite navigation system; step S2: fusing the position data to obtain fused position data; step S3: collecting 3D data of surrounding environment, matching and resolving the data with the 3D graphic database of the building, and correcting the position information of the micro inertial navigation system by using the position information of the database after the entry point of the building is successfully paired; step S4: the micro inertial navigation system calculates accurate position data by integration starting from this point based on the corrected position information. The invention provides a fusion positioning method based on a miniature 3D laser radar, which is used for determining the accurate position of a building entry point of a fireman and fusion positioning calculation of an individual positioning system, so that the problem that the prior art cannot provide an effective and accurate fusion positioning method is solved.

title_en: Fire scene smoke scene positioning and mapping method and device based on millimeter wave radar inertia combination
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire scene smoke scene positioning and mapping method and device based on millimeter wave radar inertia combination, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring inertial data and point cloud data; obtaining posture information of the human body based on the inertial data, estimating the step length of the human body based on the constraint of human kinematics and the inertial data, and determining the position information of the human body; lifting the sparse high-noise millimeter wave radar point cloud data to obtain dense point cloud data; and mapping the dense point cloud data to a global coordinate system through the posture information and the position information of the human body to construct a map. The invention is applied to the field of navigation positioning, aims at the characteristic that the movement of emergency rescue personnel is complex and changeable, and realizes navigation positioning by detecting gait and calculating position and posture through an inertial device based on the constraint of human kinematics; and mapping the point cloud data to a global coordinate system through the position and posture information to construct a map, so as to realize real-time positioning and map construction positioning of personnel in a smoke environment.
assignees: PEOPLE'S LIBERATION ARMY NATIONAL UNIVERSITY OF DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Rat search and rescue robot based on multi-mode fusion positioning and search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rat search and rescue robot based on multi-mode fusion positioning and a search and rescue method, and the robot comprises a rat biological body, an electronic backpack module and a system platform, wherein the electronic backpack module comprises a microprocessor, a pulse generator, a channel selector, a wireless communication signal receiving module, a UWB human body presence sensor, a positioning module and a power supply circuit, the system platform comprises an upper computer and a wireless communication signal transmitting module, and wireless communication connection is established in a wireless communication mode so as to establish an information interaction channel between a computer system and a biological brain central nervous system among the rat biological body, the electronic backpack module and the system platform. The rat robot realized by the brain-computer interface technology directly takes the body of a rat as a body, reserves the good function of the animal through natural evolution, does not need to use a special control algorithm to detect and judge the environment in a complex environment, and can autonomously realize the motion control and obstacle avoidance functions by utilizing the existing capacity of the rat.

title_en: Radar sensor-based bio-inspired autonomous mobile robot using ble location tracking for disaster rescue
abstract_en: An autonomous bio-inspired mobile robotic device (100) capable of detecting, tracking and communicating location of survivors trapped under earthquake/building collapse debris. The small-size, lightweight, ruggedized autonomous legged mobile robot incorporates high-frequency millimeter-wave radar sensor and Ultra Wideband (IR-UWB) radar sensor for detecting presence and perform ranging of trapped survivors. The autonomous mobile robot also comprises GNSS and BLE connectivity for location tracking of trapped survivors in conjunction with a Wi-Fi enabled visual sensing solution and a flashlight to aid during rescue operation. The battery-powered autonomous bio-inspired mobile robot (100) also comprises an MCU, actuators, motor control circuitry and IMU to control robot locomotion and perform sensor data fusion. BLE connectivity solution of the present invention communicates the location of detected trapped survivors to a plurality of rescue devices which use BLE Angle-of-Arrival method for successful survivor location resolution.

title_en: Novel Slam indoor positioning navigation method based on monocular camera
abstract_en: A novel Slam indoor positioning navigation method based on a monocular camera relates to the technical field of navigation positioning, wherein a video stream transmitted by an unmanned aerial vehicle is analyzed through a system platform AI system, a background contour is identified and separated from an image, posterior estimation comparison is carried out based on HF-Net, and accurate position data are finally obtained; the unmanned aerial vehicle data transmission system is high in practicability and very convenient to use, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be quickly subjected to data transmission and positioning by means of a 4G network, the use cost is saved, the damage of the unmanned aerial vehicle during operation in a high-temperature high-smoke environment can be reduced, and the service life of the unmanned aerial vehicle is prolonged.
assignees: ZHENJIANG RUNTU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distributed intelligent reconnaissance and striking integrated system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed intelligent reconnaissance and striking integrated system and method, which relate to the field of intelligent weapon control and comprise the following steps: the upper end of the ship body is provided with a ship cabin; the photoelectric tracking reconnaissance device comprises a photoelectric detection head and a photoelectric control cabinet, wherein the photoelectric detection head is fixedly arranged at the top of the ship cabin, and the photoelectric control cabinet is arranged in the ship cabin; the inertial navigation device is arranged below the photoelectric detection head; the remote control weapon station comprises a weapon platform and a wall hanging box, wherein the weapon platform is fixedly arranged on the front side of the upper end of the warship body, and the wall hanging box is arranged in the warship cabin. The invention has the advantages that: the photoelectric, navigation and remote control weapon equipment on the unmanned ship are optimally integrated to form a distributed intelligent reconnaissance and striking integrated system, so that the warning patrol, intelligence reconnaissance, offshore accurate striking, search and rescue and other tasks of a designated area, as well as the mine exploration/mine discharge, anti-frog personnel and other special combat tasks can be effectively completed.

title_en: Self-configurable firefighter location and environment detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-configurable firefighter positioning and environment detecting method and system, which comprises the following steps: step 1, the equipment is in a sleep mode; step 2, the equipment is switched into a working state from a sleep mode; step 3, respectively calculating position data by the micro inertial navigation system and the satellite navigation system; step 4, the central processing unit acquires environmental data by using the sensing detection module; step 5, acquiring equipment information and firefighter identity identification information; step 6, the positioning equipment and the identity identification information of the firemen, the fusion positioning position data and the fire fighting site environment detection data are broadcasted and sent out through the wireless communication module; and 7, continuously and intelligently detecting and configuring the peripheral sensing detection module/equipment by the equipment in the working mode. The invention can realize non-inductive use, and firemen do not need to manually operate each device on a task site, thereby reducing the workload, and also do not need to carry out additional training on the firemen, thereby reducing the use cost and difficulty.
assignees: JIANGSU DEYIJIA SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue ware based on ultra wide band suitable for environment in pit
abstract_en: Disclosed is an ultra-wideband based search and rescue apparatus suitable for use in a downhole environment, comprising: a data processing unit; an ultra-wideband radio frequency unit communicably connected to the data processing unit; and a power supply unit for the data processing unit and the ultra-wideband radio frequency unit; the ultra-wideband radio frequency unit is configured to communicate with a positioning identifier carried by a person to be searched and rescued based on an ultra-wideband communication technology to obtain communication data, and the data processing unit is configured to process the communication data to obtain positioning data of the person to be searched and rescued, wherein the positioning data comprises distance information between the person to be searched and rescued and the search and rescue device and direction information of the person to be searched and rescued relative to the search and rescue device. Therefore, the search and rescue device can realize the positioning of the personnel to be searched and rescued based on the ultra-wideband communication technology, and can obtain the distance information and the direction information of the personnel to be searched and rescued at the same time.
assignees: BEIJING YONGAN XINTONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency positioning method based on mobile anchor point
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for conveniently and quickly positioning trapped people by UWB mobile anchor point dynamic networking. Namely, each search and rescue worker carries a UWB mobile anchor point pull-net type detection signal sent by a UWB label worn by the trapped person; after the signal is found, arranging at least three UWB mobile anchor points near a found point, and taking one of the UWB mobile anchor points as a main anchor point; UWB positioning resolving initial conditions, namely coordinate values of each mobile anchor point can be set visually, and measuring tools or instruments are not needed for surveying the coordinates of the mobile anchor points; the main anchor point calculates UWB label positioning signals detected by the main anchor point and other anchor points in real time in an edge calculation mode, so that the position of the label is determined; and then, a search and rescue person carrying a UWB tag integrated with a portable display terminal gradually approaches the position of the tag of the trapped person according to the position icons of the tag and the tag of the trapped person on the display terminal, and finally finds the accurate position of the trapped person.

title_en: Direction and distance measuring method based on inertial navigation and pseudo-range
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of search and rescue positioning, in particular to a direction and distance measuring method based on inertial navigation and pseudo range. The invention can realize the positioning of the target to be rescued by using the search and rescue equipment with single antenna, reduce the cost of the search and rescue equipment, and solve the problems of the installation of the traditional double-antenna array search and rescue equipment on a small airplane and the interference of the installation environment of double antennas on the reflection of wireless signals; the positioning accuracy can be improved along with the increase of the interrogation times, and the defects that each interrogation response of the double-antenna array is independently solved, and the positioning accuracy cannot be improved due to multiple interrogation responses are overcome; and the phase characteristics of the channel and the antenna are not required, which is different from the condition that the phase balance of the channel and the antenna is high in the dual-antenna array.

title_en: Fire fighting fire scene internal attack positioning method based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire fighting fire scene internal attack positioning method based on a digital twin technology, which comprises the following steps: step one, acquiring sensor information from a data acquisition device; step two, importing a scene three-dimensional model; acquiring real-time data of an attack position in a fire scene; step four, carrying out real-time synchronous twinning in the fire scene attack process of the firemen; fifthly, carrying out online interaction by firemen; the fourth step specifically comprises the following steps; s1, establishing and researching a twin model; s2, indoor positioning research based on a PDR algorithm; s3, designing a digital twin physical layer; s4, visual monitoring research based on MQTT; the invention can solve the problem that the firefighter gets lost in the process of attack.

title_en: Digital fire-fighting individual communication system and data perception acquisition communication method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital fire-fighting individual communication system and a data perception acquisition communication method, which comprise a core communication terminal and a plurality of networking nodes, wherein the core communication terminal is assembled on a scene fire-fighting individual, and has a plurality of network communication modes, is carried by the fire-fighting individual, can be in wireless interconnection and intercommunication with one or a plurality of networking nodes nearby, and can carry out audio and video communication with scene actual combat command platform commander of other scene fire-fighting individual or scene command parts. According to the invention, the information acquisition and communication equipment are highly integrated, so that the effective fusion of the individual fire fighting system equipment is realized, the individual combat load is reduced, and the individual flexible combat advantage is better exerted; the UWB-Tag is applied to realize the position location of the UWB base station, a method for information communication exchange between two networks is established, the difficulty of position acquisition of individual firefighters in indoor and outdoor spaces, particularly in the internal combat process of complex buildings, is solved, and the individual safety protection capability of the individual firefighters in the emergency rescue process can be effectively improved.
assignees: SHENYANG FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: High-rise building fire rescue information system based on bluetooth indoor positioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-rise building fire rescue information system based on Bluetooth indoor positioning, which comprises: the Bluetooth beacon is used for sending Bluetooth signals to the intelligent terminals in the communication range in the building; the intelligent terminal is used for collecting real-time position information of rescue workers, receiving Bluetooth signals sent by the Bluetooth beacons and sending the received Bluetooth signals to the background server; the background server is used for analyzing the Bluetooth signal through a signal attenuation model to obtain a signal intensity indication value of the intelligent terminal, analyzing the signal intensity indication value through a filtering algorithm to obtain a stable signal intensity indication value, calculating to obtain the distance between the Bluetooth beacon and the intelligent terminal, further calculating to obtain the position of the intelligent terminal, and transmitting the obtained position information to the command terminal; and the command terminal is used for receiving the position information of the intelligent terminal sent by the background server. The invention can accurately acquire the position of the firefighter, improve rescue efficiency and reduce the probability of casualties.
assignees: NANJING LES INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multiple access techniques in ultra-wideband (uwb) positioning
abstract_en: Disclosed are techniques for wireless communication. In an aspect, an initiator anchor node transmits, to a first responder anchor node, first configuration information for a first ranging session between the initiator anchor node and the first responder anchor node, wherein the first configuration information indicates a first initiation time for the first ranging session, and transmits, to a second responder anchor node, second configuration information for a second ranging session between the initiator anchor node and the second responder anchor node, wherein the second configuration information indicates a second initiation time for the second ranging session, wherein the first and second ranging sessions are configured to enable a mobile device to obtain a first time-difference of arrival (TDOA) measurement and a second TDOA measurement for the first responder anchor node and the second responder anchor node, respectively, and wherein the second initiation time is offset from the first initiation time.

title_en: Terminal for alerting based on position for fire fighting
title_ko: 소방용 위치 기반 경보 단말
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a location-based alarm terminal for firefighting, comprises an NFC module, a wireless LAN, an RFID tag, a Bluetooth module, an ultra-wideband (UWB) module, an output module, and a control circuit electrically connected to the NFC module, the wireless LAN, the RFID tag, the Bluetooth module, the UWB module, and the output module. The control circuit can initiate a communication with one or more adjacent external terminals using the NFC module, form a Wi-Fi mesh with the external terminals using the wireless LAN, calculate a first distance between a location-based alarm terminal for firefighting and each of the external terminals using the Bluetooth module, calculate a second distance between the location-based alarm terminal for firefighting and each of the external terminals using the UWB module, and output an alarm using the output module when the first distance calculated by using the Bluetooth module and the second distance calculated by using the UWB module satisfy a specified condition. Therefore, a firefighter can be prevented from falling behind or being isolated.
abstract_ko: 본 문서에 개시되는 일 실시예에 따른 소방용 위치 기반 경보 단말은 NFC 모듈, 무선 LAN, RFID 태그, 블루투스 모듈, UWB(ultra wideband) 모듈, 출력 모듈, 및 NFC 모듈, 무선 LAN, RFID 태그, 블루투스 모듈, UWB 모듈 및 출력 모듈과 전기적으로 연결된 제어 회로를 포함하고, 제어 회로는 NFC 모듈을 이용하여 인접한 하나 이상의 외부 단말과 통신을 개시하고, 무선 LAN을 이용하여 하나 이상의 외부 단말과 Wi-Fi 메쉬를 형성하고, 블루투스 모듈을 이용하여 소방용 위치 기반 경보 단말과 하나 이상의 외부 단말 각각 사이의 제1 거리를 산출하고, UWB 모듈을 이용하여 소방용 위치 기반 경보 단말과 하나 이상의 외부 단말 각각 사이의 제2 거리를 산출하고, 블루투스 모듈을 이용하여 산출한 제1 거리 및 UWB 모듈을 이용하여 산출한 제2 거리가 지정된 조건을 만족하는 경우, 출력 모듈을 이용하여 경보를 출력할 수 있다.

title_en: Augmented reality search and rescue glasses suitable for complicated environmental conditions
abstract_en: The invention discloses augmented reality search and rescue glasses suitable for complex environmental conditions, which comprise UWB ultra-wideband radar, RGB cameras, infrared cameras, IMU, eyeball trackers, calculation modules, display modules and the like. Wherein: UWB ultra-wideband radar, RGB camera, infrared camera adopt different technical means to detect the life in the environment respectively, realize shielding, life detection under multiple complex environment such as low illumination. The eye tracker is used for monitoring eye movements of the wearer, and the IMU is used for monitoring head movements of the wearer. The calculation module fuses the real-time life detection result, the eyeball movement of the wearer and the head movement data, and then presents the life detection result on the display module, thereby providing guidance for the search and rescue work of the rescue workers. Under complex environmental conditions, the invention has higher life detection capability, can greatly reduce the workload of rescue workers, and is very beneficial to life detection under complex environmental conditions.

title_en: Emergency management fire-fighting and disaster-relief search and rescue radar based on MIMO frequency modulation continuous wave
abstract_en: The utility model designs an MIMO frequency modulation continuous wave-based emergency management fire-fighting and disaster-relief search and rescue radar which comprises a product shell, a linear power supply module, an integrated transceiver module, a power amplifier module, a signal processing board, a display control unit, a calibration unit, a VGA unit, a rectifying circuit, a low-noise amplification unit and an FPGA interface module, wherein the linear power supply module is arranged in the product shell; the environment-friendly energy-saving wall body penetrating power, power area, external interference and other factors are taken into consideration, the MIMO array antenna with multiple inputs and multiple outputs is adopted, the requirements of ultra-wideband, impedance matching, light weight and low profile are met, receiving and transmitting leakage is controlled, and the dynamic range of a receiving channel is ensured; the array topological structure is optimized, and grating lobes on angles are avoided as much as possible while the requirement of detecting high resolution is met; the multi-airspace degree of freedom is adopted to ensure the fuzzy calculation of the target, reduce the change of propagation speed and direction deviation and inhibit a plurality of false targets caused by multipath effect.

title_en: Life detection positioning method and system for mine drilling rescue
abstract_en: The application provides a life detection and positioning method and system for mine drilling rescue, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting an area to be detected by using back-to-back ultra-wideband radars placed in a borehole, obtaining radar echo matrixes in each preset direction of the area to be detected, and preprocessing each radar echo matrix; determining each initial direction in which the trapped person is located and the radar echo matrix preprocessed in each initial direction according to the preprocessed radar echo matrix in each preset direction; determining the distance between trapped personnel corresponding to each initial direction and the back-to-back ultra-wideband radar according to the radar echo matrix preprocessed in each initial direction; and determining the position of the trapped person based on the distance between the trapped person corresponding to each initial direction and the back-to-back ultra-wideband radar. According to the technical scheme, the back-to-back ultra-wideband radar is used for detecting the positions of trapped people, so that the calculated amount is small, and the three-dimensional positions of the trapped people can be rapidly and accurately determined.
assignees: CHINA COAL RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;BEIJING TECH RESEARCH BRANCH OF TIANDI SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: ROS-based modular unmanned ship/unmanned vehicle system with intelligent auxiliary counterweight
abstract_en: The modular unmanned ship/unmanned vehicle system based on intelligent auxiliary counterweight of ROS comprises a ship body/vehicle body, wherein a foundation module and an expansion module are installed in the ship body/vehicle body, the foundation module and the expansion module both comprise universal modules, each universal module comprises an embedded ROS system, a battery, a wireless electric energy conversion circuit and a wireless charging coil interface, the foundation module is provided with a plurality of wireless charging coil interfaces, the wireless charging coil interface of the expansion module is in butt joint with the wireless charging coil interface on the foundation module to realize charging and communication with the foundation module, the expansion module is one or a plurality of combinations of camera modules, 4G network modules, radar modules, inertial modules, vertical propulsion modules, horizontal propulsion modules, docking modules, water quality detection modules, water surface garbage cleaning modules, sonar imaging modules, search and rescue modules, magnetic sensor modules, high-speed calculation modules, interference modules and Mecanum wheel modules, and the ship body is provided with an intelligent counterweight module for counterweight or weight reduction and balance.

title_en: Mining UWB wireless positioning base station and positioning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mining UWB wireless positioning base station and a positioning system. Mining UWB wireless positioning basic station has circuit board (6), its characterized in that: be provided with control chip (4), first UWB radio frequency chip (3) and POE interface (5) on circuit board (6), first UWB radio frequency chip (3) have two at least, and antenna (2) that correspond are all connected to each first UWB radio frequency chip (3), can be used to the power supply of data transmission and circuit board (6) after POE interface (5) wiring. The utility model has simple structure and reasonable design, can realize the real-time positioning of underground workers, and is convenient for monitoring management and quick search and rescue in positioning.
assignees: WENZHOU YANCHUANG INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Track tracking and positioning filtering system and fusion navigation method of rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: A track tracking positioning filtering system and a fusion navigation method of a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle belong to the field of navigation of rescue unmanned aerial vehicles. The track tracking module and the automatic tracking return module of the track tracking positioning filtering system are fixedly arranged on the navigation platform of the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, the track tracking module is in signal connection with the automatic return module, and the automatic return module is in signal connection with the navigation platform of the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle. The method comprises the following steps: calculating the rotation angle of the gyroscope; calculating the rotation angle of the navigation platform; speed and position descriptions; defining a state vector of an inertial navigation system and a Beidou combined system; constructing a fusion measurement position vector by using the measurement of the Beidou receiver; a filtering method based on unscented Kalman filtering uses unscented transformation techniques to approximate the probability distribution of nonlinear system states. The invention can track and record the path of the unmanned aerial vehicle in search and rescue, provide simple dangerous environment and condition positioning for staff, and provide expected preparation for further search and rescue work.

title_en: Three-dimensional visual indoor positioning system for fire rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional visual indoor positioning system for fire rescue, which relates to the technical field of positioning and comprises a positioning label, a positioning module and a positioning module, wherein the positioning label is used for sending communication information to the outside, and the communication information comprises sending time; the positioning module comprises at least three positioning units, and the positioning units are used for receiving the communication information sent by the positioning tag and sending the receiving time and the sending time to the server; and the server is used for receiving the receiving time and the sending time sent by the positioning unit and determining the position information of the positioning label on the three-dimensional model according to the receiving time, the sending time, the communication speed, the positioning unit position and the preset three-dimensional model. The invention solves the problem of low positioning accuracy of the existing indoor positioning system and realizes the accurate positioning of firefighters indoors.
assignees: HANGZHOU JIUBANG FIRE SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster search and rescue detection system and method based on radio tomography
abstract_en: The application discloses a post-disaster search and rescue detection system and method based on radio tomography, comprising the following steps: ultra-wideband wireless sensor network, robot cluster and cluster control and tomography system. The ultra-wideband wireless sensor network is divided into a stationary ultra-wideband node and a mobile ultra-wideband node, wherein the stationary node is used for assisting in positioning of the mobile node, and all the nodes are used for radio tomography; the robot clusters are used for bearing the mobile ultra-wideband nodes, each robot is provided with two nodes, and is provided with an independent power supply, a two-dimensional laser radar and a communication module, so that the robot can walk under complex road conditions, and the application range is wide; the cluster control and tomography system is in wireless interconnection with the robot clusters and is used for controlling the moving track of the robot, performing tomography on the environment according to the direct path signal receiving intensity signals acquired in the ultra-wideband wireless sensor network, and realizing victim detection in invisible areas (dense smoke, collapse environments and the like).

title_en: Intelligent fire rescue boot and positioning method thereof
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent firefighting rescue boot and a positioning method thereof, wherein walking speed values, direction data and gesture data of a plurality of preset time points are transmitted by a miniature Inertial Navigation System (INS) deployed in the firefighting boot; performing time sequence association analysis on the walking speed values, the direction data and the gesture data of the plurality of preset time points to obtain positioning parameter association characteristics; and determining positioning data based on the positioning parameter association features. Therefore, the high-precision positioning of the firefighter can be realized under the condition that no external reference signal exists, so that the firefighter is suitable for complex and changeable fire scene environments, and the rescue efficiency and safety are improved.
assignees: DONGPENG SHOES IND CO LTD;Pingxiang Fire Rescue Detachment

title_en: Method and apparatus for cluster configuration and round assignment for uwb communication
title_ko: Uwb 통신을 위한 클러스터 구성 및 라운드 할당 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: According to various embodiments of the present invention, provided is an operating method of an electronic device which includes the following steps of: identifying two-way ranging (TWR) values for a plurality of anchors; configuring a first cluster including a first initiator anchor and first responder anchors on the basis of the TWR values; configuring a second cluster including a second initiator anchor and second responder anchors on the basis of the TWR values; and allocating a ranging round to each of the first cluster and the second cluster. Therefore, during UWB communication, an optimal anchor role can be assigned and an optimal cluster can be configured.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 다양한 실시예에 따른 전자 장치의 동작 방법은, 복수의 앵커들에 대한 TWR (two-way ranging) 값들을 확인하는 단계와, 상기 TWR 값들에 기반하여, 제1 initiator 앵커와 제1 responder 앵커들을 포함하는 제1 클러스터를 구성하는 단계와, 상기 TWR 값들에 기반하여, 제2 initiator 앵커와 제2 responder 앵커들을 포함하는 제2 클러스터를 구성하는 단계와, 상기 제1 클러스터 및 상기 제2 클러스터 각각에 레인징 라운드를 할당하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Method for Tracking Emergency Caller for Securing Emergency Rescue Golden Time in City Area
title_ko: 도심 지역에서 긴급 구조 골든타임 확보를 위한 요구조자 탐색 방법
abstract_en: A method for locating a first responder to ensure emergency rescue golden time in an urban area is disclosed. The method includes the following steps: measuring a signal strength from a rescuer terminal; estimating a GPS position error distribution of the rescuer; determining whether a path between the rescuer and the rescuer is LOS or NLOS and estimating a location and uncertainty of the rescuer after obtaining channel parameters according to each of the above; and minimizing a navigation path of the rescuer in a direction that minimizes a cramer-rao lower bound (CRLB), which is an inverse matrix of the FIM.
abstract_ko: 도심 지역에서 긴급 구조 골든타임 확보를 위한 요구조자 탐색 방법이 개시된다. 개시된 방법은 요구조자 단말기로부터의 신호 세기를 측정하는 단계; 구조대의 GPS 위치 오차 분포를 추정하는 단계; 구조대와 요구조자 사이의 경로가 LOS 인지 또는 NLOS인지 여부를 판단하고 각 상항에 따른 채널 파라미터를 획득한 후 요구조자의 위치 및 불확실성을 추정하는 단계; 및 FIM의 역행렬인 CRLB(Cramer-Rao Lower Bound)를 최소화하는 방향으로 구조대의 탐색 경로를 최소화하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: UIF UNIV INDUSTRY FOUNDATION YONSEI UNIV

title_en: Risk analysis early warning device, early warning method, safety risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses risk analysis early warning equipment, an early warning method, a safety risk assessment method and a system, wherein the risk analysis early warning equipment comprises a clothing body, a positioning component, a monitoring component, an alarm component, an analysis prediction component and a communication component, the positioning component comprises a main positioning module and a standby positioning module, the main positioning module comprises a UWB main positioning module and an RTK positioning module, and the standby positioning module comprises a UWB standby positioning module; the monitoring component comprises a physiological condition monitoring module and an environmental condition monitoring module; the analysis and prediction component comprises a main control module and a standby control module which are provided with risk analysis and prediction units for constructing a CNN-LSTM model; the communication assembly comprises a main communication module and a standby communication module; and meanwhile, when accidents such as roof collapse and the like occur, the position information, the physiological condition information and the internal environment information of the mining area of the operating personnel can be provided for the outside, so that the search and rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Ultra wideband ai-enhanced imu tracking system for first responder use with smart glasses
abstract_en: A tracking system that works through walls, below grade, and at long range is provided, which may be utilized as a first responder tracking system. The system combines UWB (Ultrawideband) with AI-enhanced IMU motion tracking with use on, e.g., android-based smart glasses, phones and tablets. The UWB tracking provides a stable reference point in GPS denied environments, offering 3D tracking under the most challenging conditions. When walls or distance make UWB untenable, disclosed tags stream back IMU data processed by machine learning algorithms which remove, e.g., the effect of drift, noise, and error common to motion-based tracking. The system may process the UWB and IMU input data and produce a platform and language agnostic serialized message stream with position data. This published stream allows any visualization platform to subscribe and consume 3D position data, be it a local graph for engineering debug, cloud-based first responder software, or a third-party solution.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle capable of automatically switching navigation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle capable of automatically switching a navigation system, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a laser SLAM system for realizing navigation of the unmanned aerial vehicle, a visual SLAM system for assisting navigation of the unmanned aerial vehicle and a controller, wherein when the controller detects that the error between the pose obtained by a laser inertial odometer in the laser SLAM system and a reference true value is greater than a switching setting threshold value, the laser SLAM system is switched to the visual SLAM system for navigation of the unmanned aerial vehicle. The unmanned aerial vehicle provided by the invention can still make a movement decision in a complex environment when encountering severe weather such as heavy rain, dense smoke or dense fog, and the like, so that the accuracy and stability of the unmanned aerial vehicle are improved, the unmanned aerial vehicle is convenient to use, and the safety is improved.

title_en: Fire control is with multi-functional location rescue communication system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fire control communication, in particular to a multifunctional positioning rescue communication system for fire control, which comprises a communication device, a communication base station, a first mobile communication end and a second mobile communication end, wherein the communication device and the second mobile communication end are respectively in communication connection with the communication base station, and the first mobile communication end is in communication connection with the communication device; escape system software is arranged in the first mobile communication end and can be carried by trapped people; rescue system software is arranged in the second mobile communication terminal and can be carried by firefighters; the communication device comprises a shell, a controller, a first radio frequency module, a 4G signal antenna, a second radio frequency module, a UWB ranging and positioning antenna and a UWB communication antenna, wherein the controller is arranged on the shell; the first radio frequency module and the second radio frequency module are respectively connected with the controller in a communication way, the 4G signal antenna is connected to the first radio frequency module, the UWB ranging and positioning antenna and the UWB communication antenna are respectively connected to the second radio frequency module, and the survival probability of trapped personnel can be improved.

title_en: Infant dectection system in vehicle based on ultra-wideband impluse-radio
title_ko: Uwb 기반 비접촉식 임펄스 레이더 방식의 차량 유아 재실 감지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a UWB-based non-contact impulse radar-based vehicle infant occupancy detection system and, more specifically, to a UWB-based non-contact impulse radar-based vehicle infant occupancy detection system, in which a UWB sensor unit is installed on an upper end of a rear seat of a vehicle to measure a bio-signal of a passenger who is a monitoring target for monitoring an infant occupancy state of the vehicle in a non-contact manner, and an estimated distance between a guardian or a driver and the vehicle is measured through Bluetooth signal strength (RSSI) to monitor the occupancy state in a smartphone application through Bluetooth communication based on the measured bio-signal data and the measured estimated distance data between the guardian or the driver and the vehicle, and at the same time, a warning command signal is transmitted to a guardian terminal even if the guardian or the passenger (driver) deviates from the vehicle in the infant occupancy state to notify the guardian terminal audiovisually and immediately, thereby preventing an infant from being trapped in the vehicle.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 UWB 기반 비접촉식 임펄스 레이더 방식의 차량 유아 재실 감지 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 차량의 뒷 좌석 상단에 UWB 센서부가 설치되어, 비접촉식으로 차량의 유아 재실 상태를 모니터링하기 위한 모니터링 대상자인 탑승자의 생체 신호를 측정하고, 보호자 또는 운전자와 차량 사이의 추정 거리를 블루투스 신호 세기(RSSI)를 통해 측정하여 상기 측정된 생체 신호 데이터와 보호자 또는 운전자와 차량 사이의 측정된 추정 거리 데이터를 기초로 하여 블루투스 연통을 통해 스마트폰 앱에서 재실 상태를 모니터링함과 동시에, 유아 재실 상태에서 보호자 또는 탑승자(운전자)가 차량으로부터 이탈하더라도 보호자 단말로 경고 명령 신호를 전송하여 시청각적으로 즉각 통지할 수 있도록 하여 차량내 유아 갇힘 사고를 예방할 수 있는 UWB 기반 비접촉식 임펄스 레이더 방식의 차량 유아 재실 감지 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle field search and rescue method and device based on UWB
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication positioning, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle field search and rescue method and device based on UWB. The method comprises the following steps: step 100, receiving a distress signal sent by a UWB transmitter carried by a distress person by using a UWB receiver carried by an unmanned aerial vehicle; 102, controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly for three times from an initial position according to a preset flight rule; 104, collecting position coordinates of the current position of the unmanned aerial vehicle after each flight is finished; step 106, determining the position coordinates of the distress call and the distance from the initial position to the distress call based on the initial position of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the position coordinates of the current position after each flight is finished; step 108, circularly executing the steps 102-106 until the distance from the initial position to the SOS person is smaller than the preset distance; and taking the position coordinate of the current position of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the first flight in each round of circulation process as the position coordinate of the initial position. The technical scheme of the invention can improve the field search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Emergency wireless communication scheduling system for indoor positioning of firefighters
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency wireless communication scheduling system for indoor positioning of firefighters, which particularly relates to the technical field of wireless communication scheduling in firefighters, and comprises a communication scheduling module, a signal receiving module and terminal equipment, wherein the communication scheduling module is connected with the signal receiving module, and the signal receiving module is connected with the terminal equipment; the communication scheduling module is carried on the fire fighter body, and the terminal equipment is arranged on the ground. The communication scheduling module comprises a sensor and a radio indicator transmitting part which are arranged on the body of the firefighter, a wireless communication assembly connected with the radio indicator transmitting part and a power supply module. The wireless communication assembly is connected with the photo transmission module; the photo transmission module comprises a camera shooting assembly and a cooling and mist reducing assembly which are arranged on the body of the firefighter. The emergency wireless communication scheduling system for indoor positioning of firefighters provided by the invention realizes the aim of indoor positioning of firefighters in a wireless communication scheduling transmission mode.

title_en: Emergency callingElevator emergency call system equipped with the function of utilizing passengers' personal information
title_ko: 비상통화호출승객 신상정보 활용기능을 구비한 엘리베이터 비상통화 시스템
