abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an elevator emergency call system having a function for utilizing personal information of passengers who have made an emergency call, which enables a manager to know personal information of passengers who have made an emergency call, thereby efficiently rescuing the passengers in need of rescue. The present invention comprises: a main unit installed in a machine room of an elevator; a sub-unit installed inside a car of the elevator and connected to the main unit, the sub-unit having a microphone, a speaker, a camera, a monitor, a Bluetooth, and a UWB transceiver built in, and having an emergency call button connected; a management office unit installed in a management office, connected to the main unit, and connected to the microphone, the speaker, the camera and the monitor; a control server installed in the management office and displaying a personal information screen comprising the name, age, type of disability, phone number and address of a person requiring rescue on the monitor of the management office unit and the monitor of an operation PC; and an operation PC installed in the management office and connected to the control server. The present invention has the effect of allowing the manager to easily obtain information about the elevator that was in the emergency call when the emergency call connection is disconnected and then physically/electrically restored during the emergency call, thereby allowing the manager to call the passengers again with a simple click call.
abstract_ko: 이 발명은 비상통화호출승객 신상정보 활용기능을 구비한 엘리베이터 비상통화 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 이 발명의 구성은, 엘리베이터의 기계실에 설치되는 주장치와, 엘리베이터의 카내부에 설치되며, 상기 주장치와 연결되며, 마이크로폰, 카메라, 모니터, 블루투스 및 UWB 송수신기가 내장되어 있으며 비상호출버튼이 연결되어 있는 자기와, 관리실에 설치되며, 상기 주장치와 연결되며, 마이크로폰과 스피커와 카메라와 모니터가 연결되어 있는 관리실기와, 관리실에 설치되며, 주장치와 관리실기와 연결되어 엘리베이터 번호 및 모기 위치를 포함한 비상통화와 관련된 데이터를 관리하고 저장함과 동시에 요구조자의 성명, 나이, 장애종류, 전화번호, 주소로 이루어지는 신상정보 화면을 관리실기의 모니터와 운영 PC의 모니터에 표시하는 관제서버와, 관리실에 설치되며, 관리실에 설치되어 있으며 상기 관제서버와 연결되는 운영 PC를 포함하며, 상기 관제서버에는 정부 또는 지방자치단체에 등록되어 있는 지체장애자, 치매환자에 대한 신상정보(성명, 나이, 장애종류, 전화번호, 주소)가 미리 저장되며, 정부 또는 지방자치단체에 등록되어 있는 지체장애자, 치매환자의 스마트폰에는 엘리베이터 비상상황과 관련된 스마트폰앱이 설치된다.

title_en: UWB network-based remote fire-fighting IoT system design
abstract_en: The design name is a remote fire-fighting IOT system design based on a UWB network, is an internet of things system with main functions of positioning, monitoring, fire-fighting and local navigation based on UWB communication technology, and is used for combining communication, positioning, network organization, data processing, computer visualization and the like, and aims to better solve the problem of difficult implementation of fire-fighting rescue in remote areas and higher floors of cities, monitor environments, remote operation objects and reduce casualties through the internet of things. Meanwhile, in a 3D modeling scene, positioning and navigation are performed by combining data, so that firefighters can conveniently perform fixed-point search and rescue navigation, and convenient intelligent service is provided for common users of other non-firefighting staff in commercial buildings.

title_en: Fire emergency device based on UWB positioning
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire emergency devices and discloses a fire emergency device based on UWB positioning, which comprises a wear plate positioning device and positioning auxiliary devices, wherein the wear plate positioning device and the positioning auxiliary devices are internally provided with the UWB positioning device, the wear plate positioning device and a signal center wirelessly transmit signals, the wear plate positioning device is worn on a rescuer, the number of the positioning auxiliary devices is multiple, and the multiple positioning auxiliary devices are arranged in the building in a pre-distributed manner. This fire control emergency device based on UWB location is through seting up at the back of removing positioning device and wearing the slot, can effectually fix the position such as waistband, the safety rope at personnel with removing positioning device through wearing the slot, when carrying out the scene of a fire rescue, can avoid the high strength motion and lead to the problem that equipment drops, and use battery locking piece to fix spacing to the lithium cell, make the lithium cell make things convenient for the dismouting to change and the installation is firm, reached the effect that equipment convenient to carry is difficult for droing.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZHENENG TAIZHOU NO 2 POWER GENERATION CO LTD;HANGZHOU PUFENG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wireless remote control life detector for rescue searching
abstract_en: A life detector for wireless remote control rescue search belongs to the technical field of detection equipment and aims to solve the problems that the imaging effect of a radar detector and the detection precision of trapped people are affected due to the fact that the number of antennas causes high grating/side lobe levels when the existing radar life detector transmits ultra-wideband signals; according to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle main body is provided with the radio-frequency radar and the far-infrared camera for aerial detection, the unmanned aerial vehicle main body receives instructions from an operator under the action of the remote control antenna, so that control of a flight track and operation of radar detection equipment are realized, the radio-frequency radar emits ultra-wideband signals, electromagnetic wave irradiation detection is performed by using the spiral antenna array, meanwhile, the far-infrared camera captures thermal imaging data of a target point, the data are processed and analyzed by each functional module in the intelligent control computer, and the image optimization module optimizes images by adopting a weighted coherence factor processing method, so that grating/sidelobe levels are effectively inhibited, and resolution and detection accuracy of the images are improved.
assignees: BEIJING TOPSKY INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Indoor positioning system and method based on multi-source information fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-source information fusion, and discloses an indoor positioning system and method based on multi-source information fusion, wherein the indoor positioning system comprises the following steps: the system comprises a data acquisition module, an image enhancement module, a multi-source data fusion and pose resolving module. The data acquisition module acquires external raw data by using different sensors. And the image enhancement module improves the quality of the obtained image data. And the multisource data fusion and pose resolving module fuses the acquired multisource data to obtain fusion data, and the pose information of the system is obtained by resolving the fusion data. The data from the visible light camera, the thermal imaging camera and the inertial measurement unit (I MU) are directly integrated through a tight coupling method, so that the problem of positioning failure when GPS signals are abnormal can be solved, meanwhile, the problem of positioning failure caused by the fact that a large amount of available information is lost in an acquired image when substances such as smoke, dust or water vapor exist in dark environment and air can be solved, and accurate positioning of equipment in various indoor environments is realized.

title_en: Measuring Method of Searcher's Indoor Position
title_ko: 탐색자의 실내 위치 측위 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system (indoor positioning system) and a method for accurately identifying the position of a searcher inside a building at low cost. Provided is an indoor positioning method of a searcher, which comprises: a step in which at least three portable UWB anchors (1, 2, 3) are installed outside a building where GPS signals are receivable; a step in which GPS location information (p1, p2, p3) of each UWB anchor is transmitted to an external remote server via a mobile communication module (7); a step in which UWB communication is performed and signal arrival information, calculated by an operating module (6), is transmitted to the external server via the mobile communication module (7); and a step in which the external server calculates the exact position of a signal receiver to determine the accurate indoor position of the searcher.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 탐색자의 실내 위치 측위 방법에 관한 것이다. 

본 발명은, 탐색자의 위치 측위 방법에 있어서, 
재난 현장에 출동한 탐색자들에 의해 건물 내부에 진입하기 전에 적어도 3개의 휴대용 UWB 앵커들(1, 2, 3)이 GPS신호 수신이 가능한 건물 외부 장소에 설치되는 단계;. 각 휴대용 UWB 앵커들(1, 2, 3)이 내부의 GPS모듈(5)을 통해 파악한 각 휴대용 UWB 앵커들(1, 2, 3)들의 GPS 위치 정보들(p1, P2, p3)이 이동통신 모듈(7)을 통해 외부 원격 서버로 전송되는 단계; 탐색자들이 소지하는 각 신호수집기와 휴대용 UWB 앵커들(1, 2, 3) 사이에 UWB통신모듈(4)을 통한 UWB통신이 수행되어 연산모듈(6)에서 계산된 신호수집기 신호 도달 관련 정보들이 이동통신 모듈(7)을 통해 외부 서버로 전송되는 단계; 수신된 상기 GPS위치 정보(p1, P2, p3)와 신호수집기 신호 도달 관련 정보들을 이용하여, 외부 서버가 신호수집기의 정확한 위치를 계산하여 탐색자의 정확한 위치를 파악하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 

이상과 같은 본 발명을 이용하면, 작은 비용으로 건물 내부의 탐색자의 위치를 정확히 파악하는 것이 가능해 진다.

title_en: Fire scene vision construction system and working method
abstract_en: A fire scene vision construction system and a working method belong to the technical field of fire robots. The system comprises an environment-aware robot and a matched AR fire-fighting helmet, wherein the robot comprises a crawler device, a chassis cabin and a main cabin; the chassis cabin is fixedly provided with a protective shell, an electric motor, a power supply and a motion control board, and the main cabin is provided with the protective shell, a 4D millimeter wave radar sensor, a UWB sensor and a miniature main board. The AR fire helmet comprises a power supply, a UWB sensor, a miniature main board and an AR display. According to the invention, a cross-mode millimeter wave radar signal semantic segmentation algorithm, a high-precision rapid graph building and man-machine cooperative motion control algorithm of UWB are operated on a miniature main board in a main body cabin, and segmentation results are processed by the miniature main board in the helmet and then displayed by an AR display. The system can effectively avoid the short plates of the camera and the laser radar which fail in the dense smoke environment; the calculation power consumption of point cloud calculation is avoided, the drawing precision is improved, and the problem of motion control of the robot is solved.

title_en: Down-the-hole hammer drill bit for life rescue sensing and positioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a down-the-hole hammer drill bit for life rescue sensing and positioning, which comprises the following components: the device comprises a drill bit body, a UWB base station, a nine-axis attitude sensor, a protective shell and a mounting bracket; the UWB base station and the nine-axis attitude sensor are circumferentially arranged and fixed inside the mounting bracket, the mounting bracket is fixed on the outer surface of the drill bit body, the protective housing is located outside the mounting bracket, the top end of the drill bit body is provided with a thread groove, the middle end of the drill bit body is provided with a thread groove and the inside of the protective housing is provided with a central spray pipe, and the central spray pipe and the middle of the drill bit body are provided with an air inlet duct. The problem that the existing down-the-hole hammer drill bit cannot locate and autonomously track trapped personnel in real time in the actual use process, rescue workers cannot clear and know the positions of the trapped personnel, so that rescue work difficulty is increased, and the trapped personnel cannot be timely rescued is solved.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 16TH BUREAU GROUP CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY 16 BUREAU GROUP BEIJING METRO ENG CONSTR CO LTD;UNIV SHIJIAZHUANG TIEDAO

title_en: System for spatial visualizing of disaster site and method thereof
title_ko: 재난현장 공간 시각화 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for visualizing a space at a disaster site and a method thereof and, more specifically, to a system for visualizing a space at a disaster site and a method thereof, which visualize and provide spatial information of various disaster sites by using location information of rescue workers confirmed through pedestrian dead reckoning (pdr) and data measured through fmcw lidar, thereby accurately grasping a spatial structure of a site where a disaster occurs and smoothly performing lifesaving work.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난현장 공간 시각화 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 보행자 추측 항법(PDR)을 통해 확인한 구조대원의 위치 정보와 FMCW 라이다를 통해 측정한 데이터를 이용하여 각종 재난현장의 공간 정보를 시각화하여 제공함으로써, 재난이 발생한 현장의 공간 구조를 정확하게 파악할 수 있으며, 이를 통해서 인명 구조 작업을 원활하게 수행할 수 있도록 하는 재난현장 공간 시각화 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Fire detection system for predicting fire situation and checking occupancy through supervised learning
title_ko: 지도학습을 통한 화재 상황 예측 및 재실 여부를 확인할 수 있는 화재감지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a fire detection system capable of predicting fire situations and confirming occupancy status through supervised learning. The fire detection method according to an embodiment comprises the steps of: obtaining data for fire detection by the fire detection system; applying the obtained data to a recurrent neural network (RNN) model; determining the occurrence of a fire based on the RNN model; and determining occupancy detection based on an ultra-wideband (UWB) sensor. By utilizing machine learning with data from various sensors such as temperature, humidity, and smoke detectors, the system can assess and predict fire risk in advance and improve accuracy through re-learning of the prediction model. Additionally, the UWB radar sensor enables detection of human presence and location at the fire site, thereby minimizing human casualties during fire incidents.
abstract_ko: 지도학습을 통한 화재 상황 예측 및 재실 여부를 확인할 수 있는 화재감지 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 화재감지 방법은, 화재감지 시스템이, 화재 감지를 위한 데이터를 획득하는 단계; 화재감지 시스템이, 획득된 데이터를 RNN(Recurrent Neural Network) 모델에 적용하는 단계; 화재감지 시스템이, RNN 모델을 기반으로 화재 발생 여부를 판단하는 단계; 및 화재감지 시스템이, UWB(Ultra-WideBand; 초광대역) 센서를 기반으로 재실감지 여부를 판단하는 단계;를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 각 센서(온/습도, 연기감지)로부터 데이터를 이용한 기계학습을 통해 화재감지의 위험도를 사전에 판단하고 예측할 수 있으며, 예측 모델의 재학습을 통해 정확도를 개선할 수 있다. 또한, UWB(Ultra-WideBand; 초광대역) 레이더 센서를 통하여 화재 발생 장소에 인체가 존재하는지를 판단하고, 위치를 확인할 수 있어, 화재 발생 시 인명 피해를 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: Integrated control system for emergency disaster response and method for providing service thereof
title_ko: 긴급 재난 대응을 위한 통합 관제 시스템 및 그의 서비스 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated control system for emergency disaster response and a service method thereof. The integrated control system of the present invention provides real-time information on the movement status of dispatched vehicles to a caller from the time of the emergency disaster report, thereby providing a reassuring service to the caller, analyzes multiple composite signals of the caller and firefighters to measure and identify their indoor locations at the disaster scene, secures the floor-by-floor layout of the building at the scene to accurately determine the locations of the caller and the dispatched firefighters, and provides a response service that responds to emergency disasters by sharing real-time information on hospital beds and situational information according to the transport situation among the fire situation room, police station, emergency medical institution, public health center, and disaster medical support team in relation to the transport of emergency patients, thereby securing an appropriate time for transport and controlling, monitoring, and supporting all information from dispatch to conclusion in the comprehensive situation room with the dispatched firefighters. The present invention enables rapid response and rescue from relevant agencies within the full council, thereby securing the golden time for emergency disaster incidents.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 긴급 재난 대응을 위한 통합 관제 시스템 및 그의 서비스 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 통합 관제 시스템은 긴급 재난 발생에 따른 신고 시점에서부터 신고자에게 출동 차량의 이동 상황을 실시간 전달하여 신고자에게 안심 서비스를 제공하고, 신고자와 소방대원의 다중 복합 신호를 분석하여 재난 현장에서의 실내 위치를 측정 및 파악하고, 현장의 건물에 대한 층별 평면 위치를 확보하여 신고자와 출동 소방대원의 정확한 위치를 파악하며, 응급 환자 이송에 따른 소방 상황실, 경찰서, 응급의료 기관, 보건소 및 재난 의료 지원팀들 간에 병상 정보와 이송 상황에 따른 상황 정보를 실시간 공유하여 이송 적정 시간을 확보하여 출동 소방대원들과 종합 상황실에서 출동에서 종결까지 모든 정보를 관제, 모니터링 및 지원하여 긴급 재난 대응에 대처하는 대응 서비스를 제공한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 전원 협의체의 관련 기관들로부터 신속한 대응 및 구조가 가능하도록 하여 긴급 재난 사고에 대한 골든타임을 확보할 수 있다.

title_en: Method for positioning and monitoring in limited space based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention provides a limited space positioning monitoring method based on the Internet of things, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of acquiring first position information of personnel in a limited space in real time through a UWB limited space positioning technology, acquiring point cloud data in the limited space in real time through a laser radar positioning device, constructing an indoor map in the limited space through the point cloud data, supplying power to a system through a solar cell panel and a storage battery, acquiring environment information data in the limited space in real time through a singlechip module, a smoke sensing acquisition circuit module, a temperature sensing acquisition circuit module and a gas sensing acquisition circuit module, uploading real-time information of each sensing acquisition module circuit to a PC, a mobile phone and a cloud, and transmitting the data information to the mobile phone in real time through a short message module. The invention can monitor the environmental information data and the personnel position in the limited space on the premise of saving energy, thereby improving the disaster rescue efficiency.

title_en: Man-machine cooperation method and system for emergency rescue service
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of search and rescue, in particular to a man-machine cooperation method and a man-machine cooperation system for emergency rescue service, which comprise the following steps: s1, a robot end collects data through UWB, an odometer, a laser radar and a camera, and an operator end collects data through UWB and an IMU; s2, estimating an operator motion trail based on the IMU, estimating a robot motion trail based on the wheel type odometer, constructing a constraint function by using UWB distance measurement values, and realizing pose optimization and man-machine cooperation positioning by fusing mileage information and UWB measurement data through a graph optimization algorithm; and S3, an operator utilizes the pointing device and the touch screen to realize man-machine information interaction through a wireless network, and based on the optimized man-machine cooperation positioning result, the robot fixed-point exploration and formation following are completed by combining laser radar data. The invention can perform man-machine cooperation better.

title_en: Handheld stand-alone search and rescue method and system based on inertial navigation and UWB
abstract_en: The application discloses a handheld single machine search and rescue method and system based on inertial navigation and UWB. The method comprises the following steps: determining initial gesture information of the handheld stand-alone device, wherein the gesture comprises initial position information and initial speed information; calculating initial distance information between the handheld single machine equipment and the personnel to be searched and rescued; the handheld single machine equipment is moved for multiple times, and updated posture information of the handheld single machine equipment and updated distance information between the handheld single machine equipment and the personnel to be searched and rescuing after each movement are calculated; and determining the position information of the personnel to be searched and rescuing according to the initial posture information, the initial distance information, the updated posture information and the updated distance information. According to the application, the inertial navigation system is introduced, so that the more accurate positioning of the personnel to be searched and rescued can be finished only through the single-machine search and rescue equipment, the active participation of the personnel to be searched and rescued is not needed, and the pressure and misjudgment of the personnel to be searched and rescued are reduced. In an environment where more complex ranging is continuously abnormal and jumping, the interference of the abnormal ranging on a positioning result can be eliminated based on the historical ranging by using a factor graph algorithm. Better positioning effect can be obtained in complex environment.

title_en: Multi-information fusion and heat source assisted medical search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle positioning method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle positioning, and particularly relates to a medical search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle positioning method based on multi-information fusion and heat source assistance. According to the method, a GPS, an inertial measurement unit, an optical flow sensor, an ultrasonic sensor, an infrared thermal imaging camera and other sensors are integrated, an extended Kalman filtering algorithm and an active disturbance rejection control algorithm are utilized to achieve accurate positioning of a target heat source and accurate landing of an unmanned aerial vehicle, and a real-time monitoring unit in a real-time monitoring and decision support system receives data returned by the unmanned aerial vehicle and transmits analysis results to a real-time decision unit. The positioning method provided by the invention enables the unmanned aerial vehicle to effectively execute medical search and rescue tasks in a wide search area under complex terrain and changeable weather conditions, and provides immediate medical assistance for trapped persons, thereby playing a vital role in the field of emergency medical rescue.
assignees: JIANGXI CHANGHE PHARMACEUTICAL SUPPLY CHAIN MAN CO LTD

title_en: Target detection method and device based on inertial measurement unit and ultra-wideband radar coupling
abstract_en: The invention provides a target detection method and device based on inertial measurement unit and ultra-wideband radar coupling, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a reference speed calculated by an inertial measurement unit; receiving a radar echo signal returned by an indoor environment; based on the reference speed, carrying out weak target enhancement processing on the radar echo signal by adopting a preset adaptive algorithm to obtain a target radar echo signal; and detecting the target in the indoor environment according to the target radar echo signal to obtain a target detection result. According to the method, the reference speed calculated by the inertial measurement unit is utilized to assist in carrying out weak target enhancement processing on the radar echo signal, so that the performance of detecting the weak target under the influence of multipath interference and clutter of the radar in a mobile measurement mode can be effectively improved, high-precision target detection is realized, and firefighters and other rescue workers are assisted to rapidly and accurately detect trapped people under emergency conditions such as fire.

title_en: Emergency positioning method and device based on vehicle, vehicle and equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an emergency positioning method and device based on a vehicle, the vehicle and equipment, and the method and the device can be used in the technical field of vehicle positioning. The method comprises the following steps: if the vehicle is monitored to be in an emergency state, a first UWB signal is sent to UWB search and rescue equipment through a UWB functional module; receiving a second UWB signal sent by UWB search and rescue equipment through a UWB functional module; analyzing the received second UWB signal to obtain the positioning information of the vehicle; transmitting a third UWB signal to UWB search and rescue equipment through the UWB functional module; wherein the third UWB signal includes positioning information of the vehicle; the UWB search and rescue equipment is used for processing the positioning information and generating and displaying the relative position information of the vehicle. The method can quickly and accurately position the trapped vehicle, reduce the positioning time and the excavation workload, and is more beneficial to search and rescue operation.

title_en: Method and system for predicting survival space aperture of pressed human body
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of prediction of living space of a buried human body, and discloses a method and a system for predicting aperture of living space of the buried human body based on ultra-wideband biological radar, according to prior information that medium in a living space hole is mostly air, and the propagation speed of electromagnetic waves is close to the propagation speed of the electromagnetic waves in vacuum, after a human body target is judged to exist and positioned, taking the human body target positioning position as the circle center, taking the distance from the sparse pulse sequence obtained by sparse pulse deconvolution to the circle center as the radius, making a series of concentric circles, if the concentric circles are overlapped to a certain extent, judging the position of the pulse sequence as the upper edge position of the human body living space hole, and estimating the aperture size. The method can effectively estimate the aperture size of the living space of the human body target under ruins, and the information is favorable for judging the surrounding condition of survivors.
assignees: GENERAL HOSPITAL OF NORTHERN THEATER COMMAND OF PLA

title_en: Indoor buried-type of ultra-wideband anchor device with downlight function
title_ko: 다운라이트 조명 기능이 구비되는 실내 매립형 uwb 앵커 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed is an indoor embedded ultra-wideband (UWB) anchor device having a downlight lighting function. The present invention comprises: a downlight lighting module installed on a ceiling of a certain space in a building and having an LED radiating downlight lighting light; a UWB anchor module attached to the downlight lighting module and performing UWB communication with a UWB tag; an emergency power supply module for supplying commercial power and emergency power to the downlight lighting module and the UWB anchor module; a fixing plate for fixing and coupling the downlight lighting module and the UWB anchor module in close contact with each other; and a microphone for collecting surrounding voice and sound in real time. According to the indoor embedded UWB anchor device having a downlight lighting function, a ceiling-embedded downlight lighting, and a UWB anchor are attached and installed indoors, and the UWB anchor is configured to perform UWB communication with a UWB tag of a firefighter or a demander, thereby measuring and recognizing a precise position of the firefighter or the demander at a fire scene from the outside.
abstract_ko: 다운라이트 조명 기능이 구비되는 실내 매립형 UWB 앵커 장치가 개시된다. 건물 내 소정 공간의 천정에 설치되며, 다운라이트 조명광을 방사하는 LED를 구비하는 다운라이트 조명 모듈; 상기 다운라이트 조명 모듈에 부착되어 설치되며, UWB 태그와 UWB 통신을 수행하는 UWB 앵커 모듈; 상기 다운라이트 조명 모듈 및 상기 UWB 앵커 모듈로 상용 전원 및 비상 전원을 공급하는 비상 전원 공급 모듈; 상기 다운라이트 조명 모듈 및 상기 UWB 앵커 모듈을 서로 밀착하여 고정 결합하는 고정용 플레이트; 주변의 음성 및 소리를 실시간 집음하는 마이크로폰을 구성한다.  상술한 다운라이트 조명 기능이 구비되는 실내 매립형 UWB 앵커 장치에 의하면, 실내에 천장 매립형의 다운라이트 조명과 이에 UWB 앵커를 부착하여 설치하고, UWB앵커가 소방관이나 요구조자의 UWB 태그와 UWB 통신을 수행하도록 구성됨으로써, 외부에서도 화재 현장의 소방관이나 요구조자의 정밀한 위치를 측정하여 인지할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Human body target positioning method based on tensor decomposition singular spectrum analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human body target positioning method based on a singular spectrum analysis method of tensor decomposition, which relates to the technical field of emergency search and rescue human body positioning and comprises the following steps of S1, ultra Wideband (UWB) biological radar echo signal acquisition and preprocessing, S2, embedding a preprocessed one-dimensional time sequence into tensor, S3, tensor decomposition, S4, grouping reconstruction, S5 and Hankel matrixing. The method is more suitable for processing non-stationary signals, and in subspace selection and reconstruction, the tensor decomposition process is supervised by using an Ensemble Empirical Mode (EEMD), and the tensor decomposition replaces the Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) process in the traditional Singular Spectrum Analysis (SSA), so that the signals can be well processed, in addition, the EEMD plays a role in supervising the reconstruction process in the tensor decomposition, and the SNCR reduction caused by error estimation of respiratory signal frequency is avoided.
assignees: GENERAL HOSPITAL OF NORTHERN THEATER COMMAND OF PLA

title_en: Inertial navigation assisted radio direction correction method in complex environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a radio direction-finding correction method assisted by inertial navigation in a complex environment, which can be used for the inertial navigation assisted radio direction-finding correction of a long-distance complex aviation search and rescue application scene, under the condition that a direction-finding device of a carrier receives interference such as shielding, the information of the position and the heading of the carrier output by inertial navigation is combined with the direction-finding information measured by a directional device, and the single plane flying Duan Duo point measurement information is utilized to carry out cross positioning, single positioning precision is improved through clustering, and then the multi-plane flying section measurement information is utilized to gradually improve global target positioning precision, so that the direction-finding result is corrected, and the orientation precision and reliability of the aviation search and rescue orientation equipment are greatly improved.
assignees: UNIV NORTHWESTERN POLYTECHNICAL;SHAANXI FENGHUO ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Under-forest personnel positioning equipment based on inertial navigation, UWB, GNSS and LORA
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an inertial navigation, UWB, GNSS and LORA based understory personnel positioning apparatus, method, electronic device and storage medium. The personnel positioning equipment comprises a main control module, a sensor module and an antenna module, wherein the main control module is used for receiving UWB information, GPS information, beidou information and LORA information based on the antenna module, receiving the sensor information based on the sensor module and processing the UWB information, the GPS information, the Beidou information, the LORA information and the sensor information to generate positioning information, the sensor module is used for generating the sensor information based on each sensor, and the antenna module is used for collecting the UWB information, the GPS information, the Beidou information and the LORA information based on each antenna. The system and the method adopt three modes for combined positioning, more accurately position personnel and more quickly rescue facilities, can send information under the condition of no public network, are convenient for detecting firefighter conditions in real time, detect harmful gases and send alarm signals.

title_en: Method and device for evaluating object damage degree of disaster site by utilizing skeletonizing technology
abstract_en: A method for evaluating the damage degree of an object in a disaster site by using a skeletonizing technique includes moving the position of a survey robot for analyzing information in a disaster site space to a first position by using at least one sensor module including a laser radar sensor, an inertial measurement unit sensor, and one or more visual sensors, acquiring sensing information corresponding to the first position by locating a map on the fly, identifying a facility segment in the first space by using the sensing information, acquiring visual crack identification information analyzed from visual image information of the sensing information and unit crack information corresponding to the visual crack identification information by using the facility segment, determining the crack expansion risk corresponding to the unit crack information, and constructing disaster site evaluation information in the first space by using the crack expansion risk and outputting the information to one or more devices.
assignees: NAT INSTITUTE OF PHYSICAL AND SAFETY

title_en: Communication method and related equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a communication method and related equipment. The method includes a first responder receiving a first frame from an initiator for initiating a ranging procedure, the first responder generating a first private address based on the first frame and information related to an identity of the first responder, the first responder transmitting a second frame carrying the first private address to the initiator. The method can be applied to an ultra wideband multi-millisecond ranging system. In accordance with the present application, the initiator may verify whether the frame is indeed from an authorized responder in an ultra wideband multi-millisecond ranging session.

title_en: Method and system for constructing and optimizing environment map based on ultra wideband UWB
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for constructing and optimizing an environment map based on ultra wideband UWB, which are applicable to extreme environments. First, the system initializes a two-dimensional grid map and collects signal data through the UWB device. When determining the LOS path, the corresponding mesh is defined as "free" state, otherwise marked as "occupied". For NLOS features, the obstacle positions are mapped onto a map. And then, refining the map through an average filter, a morphological filter and a region growing algorithm, and improving the accuracy of obstacle representation. Finally, the optimized map information is utilized, and the weight of a positioning algorithm is adjusted through a Weighted Least Squares (WLS) method, so that the positioning accuracy is improved. The invention has the advantages that the invention can effectively construct the environment obstacle information, is suitable for navigation after refinement treatment, and can normally construct the map in dark light and smoke environment. The system relies solely on UWB sensors to achieve accurate positioning in obstructed environments.

title_en: Terminal positioning method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a terminal positioning method, a terminal positioning device, terminal positioning equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining base station data of an unmanned aerial vehicle base station and coordinate data of a terminal in an unmanned aerial vehicle flight area, identifying a signal transmission environment between the terminal and the unmanned aerial vehicle base station to obtain an identification result, correcting the base station data under the condition that the identification result represents that the signal transmission environment is a non-line-of-sight signal environment, determining positioning information of the terminal based on the corrected base station data and the coordinate data, solving the problem that search and rescue positioning accuracy is low under the condition that the search and rescue signal transmission environment is the non-line-of-sight signal transmission environment, realizing automatic correction of the coordinate data of the terminal, and improving the accuracy of the positioning information of the terminal.
assignees: CHINA MOBILE CHENGDU INFORMATION COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD;CHINA MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Uwb communication-based fire control system using indoor embedded lighting
title_ko: 실내 매립형 조명을 이용한 uwb 통신 기반 소방 관제 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a UWB communication-based fire monitoring system using indoor embedded lighting, comprising: a firefighter UWB tag that is attached to a firefighter and performs UWB communication; a rescue requester UWB tag that is attached to a rescue requester and performs UWB communication; a fire status notification UWB tag that is attached to a designated area of a fire site and performs UWB communication; an indoor embedded UWB anchor that is embedded in an indoor space, emits light, and performs UWB communication with the firefighter UWB tag, the rescue requester UWB tag, and the fire status notification UWB tag; and a UWB integrated monitoring server that measures the UWB tag communication time of the indoor embedded UWB anchor with the rescue requester UWB tag, the firefighter UWB tag, and the fire status notification UWB tag in real-time and measures and monitors the respective positions of the firefighter UWB tag, the rescue requester UWB tag, and the fire status notification UWB tag in real-time based on the real-time measured UWB tag communication time.
abstract_ko: 실내 매립형 조명을 이용한 UWB 통신 기반 소방 관제 시스템이 개시된다.  소방관에 부착되어 UWB 통신을 수행하는 소방관 UWB 태그; 요구조자에 부착되어 UWB 통신을 수행하는 요구조자 UWB 태그; 화재 현장의 소정 공간에 부착되어 UWB 통신을 수행하는 화재 상태 알림 UWB 태그; 실내 공간에 매립되어 조명을 방사하며, 상기 소방관 UWB 태그, 상기 요구조자 UWB 태그 및 상기 화재 상태 알림 UWB 태그와 UWB 통신을 수행하는 실내 매립형 UWB 앵커; 상기 실내 매립형 UWB 앵커의 상기 요구조자 UWB 태그, 상기 소방관 UWB 태그 및 상기 화재 상태 알림 UWB 태그와의 UWB 태그 통신 시간을 실시간 측정하고, 실시간 측정된 UWB 태그 통신 시간에 의해 상기 소방관 UWB 태그, 상기 요구조자 UWB 태그 및 상기 화재 상태 알림 UWB 태그의 각각의 위치를 실시간 측정하고 모니터링하는 UWB 통합 관제 서버를 구성한다.

title_en: Mine rescue search system and mine rescue search method
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine rescue search system and method, which belong to the field of mine safety technology and emergency rescue communication, and comprise a plurality of search instruments and a plurality of beacons, wherein the search instruments are positioned under a mine and are in communication connection through an ultra wideband UWB module, each search instrument is in communication connection with the plurality of beacons and is used for receiving signals of the plurality of beacons and transmitting the received beacon signals to other search instruments, and the plurality of search instruments position the beacons according to the received signals of the same beacon. The invention adopts the TNP protocol to calculate and compensate the propagation delay of the aerial signal, distributes the time interval for communicating with the same beacon for the searcher and at least two searchers nearest to the searcher, can lead the beacon signal of trapped personnel to be shared to the searchers, realizes data sharing, and can form rescue team under the mine to rescue, thereby avoiding the problem that rescue cannot be carried out when mine disaster occurs.

title_en: Enhancement of the 3d indoor positioning by augmenting a multitude of 3d imaging, lidar distance corrections, imu sensors and 3-d ultrasound
abstract_en: The invention focuses on enhancing indoor positioning and navigation through advanced synchronous fusion methodologies that integrate various technologies, including Inertial Navigation Systems (INS), Inertial Measurement Units (IMU), LiDAR, stereo vision, and Sonar. This comprehensive system aims to achieve high-precision data collection with centimeter-level accuracy, crucial for creating detailed three-dimensional indoor maps. A significant aspect of this innovation is its ability to address privacy concerns by incorporating measures that abstract sensitive segments of the environment when necessary, ensuring personal privacy is maintained during data collection. Additionally, the system tackles challenges such as voids in stereo imaging and temperature variations in ultrasound and LiDAR measurements through sophisticated algorithms and corrections, including back propagation techniques that utilize stereo depth data. By employing particle swarm optimization and Neuro-Fuzzy algorithms, the framework enhances the accuracy and reliability of navigation in complex environments, making it particularly beneficial for emergency responders and personal navigation in unfamiliar settings.

title_en: Heading angle-assisted Kalman information direction finding correction method
abstract_en: The invention provides a heading angle-assisted Kalman information direction finding correction method, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining a heading angle of a search and rescue aircraft through an airborne inertial unit of the search and rescue aircraft, measuring a gangway angle of a search and rescue target relative to the search and rescue aircraft through an airborne search and rescue radio station, combining the heading angle information of the search and rescue aircraft with a radio direction finding, calculating an azimuth angle of the search and rescue target, taking the azimuth angle of the search and rescue target as a state value, establishing a Kalman filtering recursive formula, constructing Kalman information, carrying out first correction on a direction finding result, and carrying out second correction on the heading angle, so that the radio direction finding wild value is effectively corrected, and the accuracy and reliability of aviation search and rescue radio direction finding are greatly improved.

title_en: Outdoor search and rescue method and device based on ultra-wideband correction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computers, in particular to a field search and rescue method and device based on ultra-wideband correction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an initial data set of a person to be rescued, determining position coordinates of the person to be rescued based on the data set of the person to be rescued, determining estimated coordinates of an IMU at a fourth moment based on the data set of the person to be rescued and a preset step length, updating the initial data set of the person to be rescued according to the estimated coordinates of the IMU at the fourth moment and the distance from the position of the person to be rescued to obtain an updated data set of the person to be rescued, and circularly executing the steps of 102-106 until the estimated coordinates of the IMU and the distance from the position of the person to be rescued are smaller than the preset distance. Through the configuration mode, the position of the personnel to be searched and rescuing can be accurately positioned on the premise of a large-scale UWB positioning system without a plurality of base stations and tags.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle peak cruising path planning method, storage medium and device based on goblet sea squirt swarm algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle mountain peak cruising path planning method based on a goblet sea squirt swarm algorithm, which solves the defects of low search precision, slow convergence speed, easy local optimization, poor optimizing stability and the like of the goblet sea squirt swarm algorithm, and provides a goblet sea squirt swarm algorithm (CWSSA) based on chaotic mapping and self-adaptive inertial weight. In order to enable the population to be uniformly distributed in a search space, enhance the diversity of the population, initialize the population by adopting a Tent chaotic map, select a logic chaotic map to update the position of a leader, avoid the leader from being trapped in local optimum and leading to insufficient global search, update the position of a follower by a self-adaptive weight strategy, improve the global search and local development capacity of an algorithm, introduce Gauss variation at a food source position, enable the algorithm to quickly jump out of the local optimum and improve the global search precision.
assignees: CSSC CHONGQING HYDRAULIC MECH ELECTRONICAL CO LTD

title_en: Portable flashlight with indoor positioning terminal and fire-fighting helmet assembly
abstract_en: The utility model provides a portable flashlight with an indoor positioning terminal and a fire-fighting helmet assembly, relates to the technical field of fire fighting, and solves the technical problem that the flashlight which is frequently worn by firefighters has a single function and cannot realize indoor positioning of firefighters; the flashlight comprises a buckle, an indoor positioning device and a flashlight body with an illumination part, wherein the buckle is fixed on the flashlight body and used for fixing the flashlight body and other equipment in a clamping manner, one end, deviating from the illumination part, of the flashlight body is provided with an accommodating end, an accommodating cavity is formed in the accommodating end, the indoor positioning device is fixed in the accommodating cavity and communicated with an indoor UWB base station in real time and used for identifying the position of the flashlight body, the flashlight can be used as indoor illumination when a fire-fighting and rescue person is positioned, emergency rescue is facilitated, and the fire-fighting helmet assembly can be used for conveniently illuminating and indoor positioning.
assignees: HANGZHOU JIUBANG FIRE SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: UWB technology-based factory personnel positioning system
abstract_en: The factory personnel positioning system based on the UWB technology comprises a server, a UWB base station, a UWB tag, an alarm unit and a positioning calibration unit, wherein the server comprises a factory map drawing module, a signal receiving module, an instruction sending module and a processing module, the UWB base station is arranged in a factory and can communicate with the UWB tag and position the UWB tag, and meanwhile the UWB base station can transmit signals with the server signal receiving module through the signal sending module. According to the invention, the UWB base station is arranged on the factory, meanwhile, the factory personnel carry the UWB tag, and the UWB base station can communicate with the server, so that the position of the factory personnel can be monitored in real time, the factory personnel can be warned to avoid entering the dangerous area through the warning unit when the factory personnel is about to enter the dangerous area, meanwhile, the specific position of the factory personnel can be rapidly known when an accident occurs on the factory, and therefore, the personnel trapped on the factory can be rescued, the probability of occurrence of the safety accident in the factory personnel is reduced, and the safety of the factory personnel is ensured.
assignees: HANDAN HONGLIAN ZHIYU TECH CO LTD

title_en: CPR assist device
title_ko: 심폐소생술 보조장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) assistance device. The device may comprise: a plurality of antennas for receiving signals, which are transmitted from an IR-UWB radar and changed according to chest compression of an object; a control unit for determining a chest compression depth, a number of chest compressions per minute, and a degree of chest relaxation of a CPR operation performed by a rescuer through analysis of the signals received from the plurality of antennas; and an output unit for outputting the chest compression depth, the number of chest compressions per minute, and the degree of chest relaxation of the CPR operation of the rescuer determined by the control unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 심폐소생술 보조장치에 관한 것이다. 본 장치는 IR-UWB 레이더로부터 송신된 신호가 객체의 흉부 압박에 따라 변화되는 신호를 수신하는 복수개의 안테나, 복수개의 안테나로부터 수신된 신호를 분석을 통해 구조자가 시행하는 심폐소생술 동작의 흉부 압박 깊이, 분당 흉부 압박 횟수, 흉부 이완의 정도를 판단하는 제어부 및 제어부로부터 판단된 구조자의 심폐소생술 동작의 흉부 압박 깊이, 분당 흉부 압박 횟수, 흉부 이완의 정도를 출력하는 출력부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Fire rescue field positioning system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire rescue field positioning system and method based on the Internet of things, and relates to the technical field of positioning; the method comprises the steps of enabling a person to be positioned to wear equipment integrated with an ultrahigh frequency RFID card reader and an inertial navigation sensor, entering the area to be positioned, enabling the ultrahigh frequency RFID card reader to automatically scan surrounding passive RFID cards and read ID information to obtain RFID positioning information, enabling the inertial navigation sensor to calculate the motion track and direction of the person to be positioned to obtain the positioning information of the inertial navigation sensor, and commanding a dispatching background to determine the real-time position of the person to be positioned through a data analysis algorithm. According to the invention, the RFID positioning and the inertial navigation sensor are combined, the passive RFID card is used for providing a fixed position reference, the inertial navigation sensor compensates the positioning blind area, the personnel positioning is completed in a seamless connection way, and the firefighting rescue area is covered.
assignees: SUZHOU QIANYE IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine equipment control system and control method based on gesture analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gesture analysis-based coal mine equipment control system and a gesture analysis-based coal mine equipment control method, which are characterized in that an RGB camera and a thermal infrared instrument are spliced left and right to form a camera device, a camera device is installed on a fully mechanized working face every 6 hydraulic supports, a camera device is installed on an equipment train every 10 meters, a camera device is installed at a position where fully mechanized equipment is arranged in a mine roadway, a GPU (graphic processing unit) power calculating server and a control server are deployed in a control center, UWB positioning labels are attached to each self-rescuer equipment, wireless buttons of a signal sending module are fixed for each UWB positioning label, a UWB positioning base station is arranged in the mine every 200 meters, the UWB positioning base station is communicated with the UWB positioning labels in a communication range of the UWB positioning base station, and the UWB positioning base station and the camera device are connected with the GPU power calculating server and the control server through a switch. The invention can reduce the manpower and labor of operators, ensure the safety of the operators and realize intelligent control.
assignees: SICHUAN AEROSPACE ELECTRO & HYDRAULIC CONTROL CO LTD

title_en: Hearing protection with directional audio
abstract_en: Hearing protection (102) including passive noise cancellation or reduction material can include ultrawideband radios (110). The hearing protection may include a microphone (112a, 112b) for capturing the audio (106) when the user (104) is speaking. An ultrawideband radio (110) can be used to transmit the audio (106) to other users (104) with similar hearing protection (102). The ultrawideband radio (110) can also be used to determine a relative location of other users (104) and 3D spatial audio encoding can be applied to the associated audio signals in order to make it appear that the audio signals are coming from the relative location of the other respective users (104). The hearing protection (102) may be used in a wide range of environments, including for example for first responders. In such cases, the hearing protection (102) may include active noise cancelling functionality for reducing a loudness of siren noises.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue positioning method with low power consumption and two-way beacon cooperation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue positioning, and particularly discloses a unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue positioning method with low power consumption and two-way beacon cooperation, which is characterized in that an activation signal is forwarded through unmanned aerial vehicle group cooperation relay, a coverage radius range is improved by combining a spread spectrum technology, a terrain shielding blind area is eliminated, a joint positioning algorithm of azimuth angles and change rates thereof is provided, satellite signals are not required to be relied on, meter-level positioning is realized in a non-line-of-sight environment, the beacon device adopts an intermittent wake-up mechanism, the standby current is reduced to below 10 mu A, the endurance time is prolonged to 30 days, the long-period search and rescue requirement is met, and the problems of the traditional search and rescue system in terms of coverage area, safety, precision and cost are systematically solved.

title_en: Underground personnel positioning and tracking method based on laser ranging
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of underground coal mine positioning, and discloses an underground personnel positioning and tracking method based on laser ranging, which comprises the steps of calculating the distance between nodes through ranging signals between UWB mobile nodes, and establishing a relative positioning model of the UWB mobile nodes by combining preset fixed base station coordinates; registering and aligning a first local octree map of a collapse area with a relative positioning model, fusing heterogeneous data of a laser radar and a UWB sensor in time and space dimensions to form an initial positioning result of trapped personnel, acquiring real-time data of a second local octree map and the relative positioning model of the UWB under the extreme condition of communication blockage or signal interruption, predicting the position of the trapped personnel, updating the position coordinates of a mobile node of a rescue personnel in real time according to a path planning result after local obstacle avoidance adjustment, and correcting the positioning data of the trapped personnel through a graph optimization algorithm. The invention solves the positioning problem under the complex environment of the mine collapse disaster site.

title_en: Fire control positioning system based on INS, 5G and unmanned aerial vehicle combination
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting positioning system based on combination of an INS, a 5G and an unmanned aerial vehicle, which belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting positioning and comprises a rotary wing unmanned aerial vehicle and a positioning terminal, wherein the rotary wing unmanned aerial vehicle is provided with a 5G base station and a first camera module, the first camera module is arranged on a cradle head of the rotary wing unmanned aerial vehicle, data acquired by the first camera module are wirelessly transmitted through the 5G base station, the positioning terminal comprises a microprocessor module arranged in a shell, a display screen, a first Bluetooth module and a 5G communication module, the display screen, the first Bluetooth module and the 5G communication module are electrically connected with the microprocessor module, an inertial navigation system module, a second camera and the second Bluetooth module are arranged on a fire-fighting helmet, the inertial navigation system module, the second camera module and the second Bluetooth module are electrically connected, and the first Bluetooth module and the second Bluetooth module are in communication connection. The utility model can assist firefighters in sensing the scene situation and the position, and improve the positioning accuracy and reliability in the fire environment.

title_en: Mining disaster rescue robot based on multi-mode sensing and intelligent recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine disaster rescue robot and a mine disaster monitoring method based on multi-mode sensing and intelligent recognition, which relate to the technical field of mine disaster rescue robots, the mining disaster rescue robot based on multi-mode sensing and intelligent recognition mainly comprises an image processing and edge calculating unit, a UWB positioning module, an inertia measuring unit, a laser radar, a binocular depth camera, a thermal imager, a sound sensor, a gas sensor, an RGB camera, a motion control unit and a power supply system. By implementing the mining disaster rescue robot and the mining disaster monitoring method based on multi-mode sensing and intelligent recognition, the positioning precision and autonomous navigation capability of the rescue robot in a complex mine environment can be improved, and the accuracy and the instantaneity of judging the states of trapped workers are improved.

title_en: Fire-fighting indoor rescue positioning method and system based on national secret trusted communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting indoor rescue positioning method, a fire-fighting indoor rescue positioning system and a fire-fighting indoor rescue positioning system based on national secret trusted communication, which relate to the technical field of indoor rescue personnel positioning and comprise the following steps that step 100, a hybrid positioning network is formed through a UWB positioning base station, a UWB positioning card and a visual positioning node; step 200, acquiring initial positions and motion tracks of trapped personnel, encrypting by adopting a national encryption algorithm, uploading to a command center digital twin platform, step 300, acquiring multi-source sensor data by a rescue personnel terminal, receiving UWB base station signals, generating real-time position information of the rescue personnel and sign information of the rescue personnel by combining a pre-stored indoor micro map, step 400, encrypting the real-time position information of the rescue personnel and the sign information of the rescue personnel by adopting the national encryption algorithm, selecting a communication frequency band by adopting a dynamic frequency spectrum allocation mechanism, transmitting to the command center digital twin platform, and step 500, fusing the real-time position of the rescue personnel and the information of the trapped personnel by the command center digital twin platform, generating a rescue obstacle avoidance path and transmitting to the rescue personnel terminal.
assignees: YUXI E GOVERNMENT INTRANET INFORMATION TECH CENTER

title_en: Cooperative positioning and track planning method based on air-ground robot system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a co-positioning and track planning method based on an air-ground robot system, which comprises the following steps: the unmanned aerial vehicle utilizes the laser radar to construct a global environment map and position the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the unmanned aerial vehicle combines the IMU and the UWB ranging chip to obtain the distance between the unmanned aerial vehicle and each unmanned aerial vehicle, so as to estimate the pose in real time. Based on the fused pose and global map information, a method of combining mixed A search with nonlinear track optimization is adopted, a collaborative track planning problem is converted into a multi-constraint optimization model, the problems of view distance quality, unmanned vehicle formation geometry and unmanned vehicle rapid navigation among space robots are comprehensively considered, and a collision-free optimization collaborative track meeting the kinematic constraint of the multi-robots is generated in real time. The method remarkably improves the positioning precision and the cooperation degree of the air-ground cooperation system in a complex dynamic environment, and provides a safe, efficient and real-time heterogeneous multi-robot track planning method for various application scenes such as inspection, search and rescue, environmental monitoring and the like.

title_en: IMU auxiliary depth SLAM method and system integrating language-vision multi-mode perception
abstract_en: The invention provides an IMU auxiliary depth SLAM method and system integrating language-visual multi-mode perception, which comprises the functional modules of initial calibration and semantic map initialization, pre-integral prediction and key frame judgment, dense point cloud reconstruction and relative pose estimation, semantic embedding extraction, semantic guidance loop detection, semantic three-dimensional map incremental update and the like, wherein IMU motion priori, depth geometric constraint and language model semantic factors are jointly modeled through a graph optimization framework, and high-precision positioning and labeled map construction under a complex dynamic environment are realized. Compared with the prior art which only depends on geometric or inertial information, the invention reduces the loop error matching rate, improves the closed loop convergence efficiency and long-time repositioning robustness, and provides semantic interfaces for upper-layer tasks such as natural language navigation, target retrieval and the like. The invention can be widely applied to the fields of service robots, security inspection, intelligent driving, post-disaster search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Dual-communication intelligent fire-fighting equipment with high-precision indoor positioning function
abstract_en: The invention discloses double-communication intelligent fire-fighting equipment with a high-precision indoor positioning function, which belongs to the field of intelligent distress systems. The system has the functions of accurate positioning and high-efficiency communication, combines ATGM H positioning modules and UWB positioning technologies, provides accurate indoor and outdoor positioning capability, and ensures that firefighters can be positioned in real time and accurately no matter in indoor, underground or outdoor environments. In particular to indoor positioning, primary position calculation is realized through PDOA and DS-TWR algorithms, and then a self-adaptive Kalman filtering algorithm with memory attenuation is adopted as a post-processing link to realize indoor centimeter-level high-precision positioning.

title_en: Robot capable of automatically searching personnel underground coal mine and rescue method
abstract_en: The application relates to a robot capable of automatically searching personnel in a coal mine and a rescue method thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps that the robot collects environment information of an underground accident site, and the environment information comprises high-frequency IMU data, laser radar point clouds and camera images; and determining the current position of the robot according to the high-frequency IMU data, the laser radar point cloud, the motor encoder pulse data and the camera image. The application realizes high-precision positioning by utilizing the laser radar, the inertial measurement unit and the camera, performs detection such as personnel search and gas analysis on unknown areas, can assist trapped personnel to quickly evacuate through the personnel carrying cabin after the trapped personnel are searched, and can send the position of the trapped personnel to off-site searching and rescuing personnel in a state that the trapped personnel are disabled to assist the rescuing personnel to enter an accident site for rescuing wounded personnel. The application not only can greatly improve the safety and efficiency of rescue, but also can provide powerful technical support for emergency disposal of coal mine safety accidents, and becomes an important tool for guaranteeing the life safety of miners.
assignees: XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Individual soldier field searching equipment based on IMU guides
abstract_en: The invention discloses individual field searching equipment based on IMU (inertial measurement unit) guidance in the technical field of communication equipment, which comprises a microcontroller, a positioning function module, a communication function module, a power supply system, an interaction function module, a searching function module and a distress function module. The invention is provided with a GPS and Beidou BDS dual positioning mode, carries 4G, LORA and Beidou short message multi-communication modes, uses an MPU9250 nine-axis sensor and uses an algorithm such as Kalman filtering to calibrate gesture and geomagnetic errors for an IMU to be matched with an LCD to serve as an electronic compass to execute search and rescue guidance, uses low-power hardware, designs various working modes in terms of equipment software and algorithm to realize dynamic power consumption management, and tests that the duration is not less than 24 hours under the condition of full task output and not less than 48 hours under the normal condition.

title_en: Intelligent reflecting surface-assisted ultra-wideband indoor positioning method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent reflection surface-assisted ultra-wideband indoor positioning method, which relates to the technical field of communication facilities, wherein an intelligent reflection surface receives ultra-wideband pulse signals, selects different beam forming schemes, dynamically generates and applies optimal phase configuration parameters to reflection units, user equipment receives ultra-wideband signals from a direct path and a path reflected by the intelligent reflection surface, calculates distance information, performs comprehensive position calculation by combining an arrival time difference or an arrival angle algorithm, estimates three-dimensional coordinates of the user equipment, updates the phase configuration parameters, constructs a closed-loop feedback optimization loop, and iteratively executes until final three-dimensional position coordinates of the user equipment are calculated. The invention also provides an ultra-wideband indoor positioning device, which comprises an ultra-wideband base station, user equipment and an intelligent reflecting surface, wherein the intelligent reflecting surface is provided with a passive reflecting unit for independently regulating and controlling the phase. The invention is suitable for complex indoor and outdoor environments and meets the high-precision positioning requirements of urban traffic, personnel guidance, disaster sites, logistics and the like.

title_en: Forest team firefighter positioning system, method, equipment and medium based on wearable equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a forest team firefighter positioning system, a method, equipment and a medium based on wearable equipment, and relates to the technical field of forest accurate positioning, wherein the system comprises: the wearable device worn on the body of the firefighter comprises a head positioning module, a lower limb positioning module and a waist positioning module, wherein the head positioning module is used for positioning the firefighter based on satellite positioning to obtain first position information, meanwhile, positioning the firefighter based on UWB positioning to obtain second position information, the lower limb positioning module is used for positioning thighs, calves and feet of the firefighter based on inertial positioning to obtain third position information, fourth position information and fifth position information, and the head positioning module is used for obtaining the position information of the firefighter based on five position information. The application can combine three positioning modes of satellite positioning, UWB positioning and inertial positioning to position forest firefighters, and can accurately position forest firefighters.

title_en: Wall penetrating radar system for life detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar system for life detection, which belongs to the technical field of radar detection, and comprises an antenna module, a P440 ultra-wideband transceiver module, a signal processing module, a communication module and a control terminal, wherein an antenna array formed by sail-shaped antenna units is constructed, and the P440 ultra-wideband transceiver module is combined to realize accurate detection of a human body target after a dry brick wall with the thickness of more than or equal to 22cm, and the system is modularized integrated under the condition of ensuring the detection distance and the angle range, so that portability is ensured, and the system stability is ensured through a power module and a temperature sensing supplementing unit, so that the system can be widely applied to the scenes of anti-terrorism detection, post-disaster search and rescue and the like. The invention solves the problem of insufficient reliability of life detection of the radar in a complex wall environment.

title_en: Disaster warning video color ring sending method and device based on near field communication equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a disaster warning video color ring sending method and device based on short-range communication equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining networking information of a search and rescue network sent by a target user terminal, wherein the search and rescue network is a group constructed by the target user terminal based on ultra wideband UWB technology, screening optimal terminals from surrounding short-distance assisted search and rescue terminals, the networking information comprises disaster type information and position information reported by the target user terminal, corresponding disaster warning video color ring is generated according to the disaster type information in the networking information, and the disaster warning video color ring and the position information of the target user terminal are directionally pushed to the assisted search and rescue terminals in the search and rescue network based on terminal identification of the networking information, wherein the disaster warning video color ring is used for assisting the assisted search and rescue terminals to rescue. The method and the device can reduce the resource loss of the search and rescue target in the search and rescue process, can also improve the accuracy of search and rescue information transmission, and realize the accurate triggering of the search and rescue information.
assignees: MIGU MUSIC CO LTD;MIGU CULTURE TECH CO LTD;CHINA MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Indoor personnel positioning method and system based on multi-mode sensing
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of indoor positioning, in particular to an indoor personnel positioning method and system based on multi-mode sensing, the ultra-wideband channel impulse response, millimeter wave radar data and thermal imaging data of each layer are acquired, double-base geometric mapping is carried out by combining building information, an indoor ray path is reconstructed, and an occupied grid diagram is generated. Further collecting the water mist distribution intensity generated by the spraying equipment, carrying out phase correction and beam domain purification on millimeter wave data, and carrying out flow direction filtering and flicker suppression on thermal imaging data to obtain preprocessing data. On the basis, motion prior information and boundary constraint information are extracted, fusion is realized in the occupied grid diagram through mass conservation updating and normalization synthesis, and finally the position information and the motion orientation of the object to be positioned are output. The application can maintain the positioning stability and accuracy under the interference of fire smoke, water mist and multipath effect, and is suitable for high-risk scenes such as fire rescue and the like.
assignees: SHANDONG TAIGUANG ELECTRONIC GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Mining post-disaster multifunctional emergency rescue detection system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of rescue detection systems, and particularly relates to a mining post-disaster multifunctional emergency rescue detection system which comprises a personnel positioning identification card and a rescue end, wherein the personnel positioning identification card is carried by underground personnel in daily life, the personnel positioning identification card comprises a UWB communication module and is used for carrying out real-time positioning based on the cooperation of a preset communication channel CH2 and a UWB base station network, the rescue end is integrated with an environment detection module, a positioning search module, a laser ranging module and a communication module, the environment detection module is used for acquiring environment information, the laser ranging module is used for carrying out laser ranging, the positioning search module is provided with four independent and equidistant interfaces, the interface 1 and the interface 2 have a receiving and transmitting function, and the interface 3 and the interface 4 only have a receiving function. The invention can conveniently implement emergency rescue detection and support rapid, accurate and independent positioning search of trapped personnel in a communication interruption environment after disaster.
assignees: CHONGQING MAS SCI & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Microwave tracking system based on Beidou positioning and signal searching automatic rotation adjustment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of maritime communication and target tracking, and discloses a maritime search and rescue multi-target collaborative tracking method and a maritime search and rescue multi-target collaborative tracking system based on sea condition self-adaption, wherein the maritime search and rescue multi-target collaborative tracking method comprises the steps of obtaining sea condition forecast data, ship gyroscope data and target initial position data to generate a comprehensive data set, and (3) establishing a motion-drift coupling prediction model, calculating a time-varying difficulty matrix, executing a sea condition self-adaptive load balancing algorithm to generate a collaborative tracking instruction set, updating prediction parameters in real time through a ship motion-target track coupling prediction network, and carrying out multipath signal transmission processing based on a non-line-of-sight microwave communication technology. The method solves the technical problems of low multi-target collaborative tracking precision and unreasonable resource allocation under extreme sea conditions.
assignees: JIANGSU RUICHI BOTONG COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD;YANGJIANG BRANCH OF CHINA UNITED NETWORK COMMUNICATIONS LTD

title_en: Safety monitoring system suitable for firefighter training
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety monitoring system suitable for firefighter training, relates to the technical field of firefighting training safety, and aims to solve the problems of difficult personnel positioning, communication distortion delay, low efficiency of video monitoring and untimely safety intervention in the existing firefighting training. The system comprises a personnel positioning subsystem based on UWB, a real-time communication subsystem based on WebRTC and a training guide management subsystem, wherein the UWB personnel positioning subsystem realizes accurate positioning and track tracking of different training spaces, the WebRTC real-time communication subsystem realizes multi-mode real-time voice interaction and voice-text conversion, and the training guide management subsystem realizes positioning display, communication scheduling, video linkage and alarm control through front and rear end cooperation. The system can improve the safety monitoring precision and the scheduling efficiency in the training of firefighters, simultaneously supports the backtracking and the rewinding of the training process, and provides technical support for the safety guarantee and the efficiency improvement of the firefighting training.

title_en: Dynamic path planning and intelligent navigation return method and system for firefighter safety
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic path planning and intelligent navigation return method and system for firefighter safety, which relate to the field of path planning and comprise the steps of acquiring data of fire scene air pressure, distance, gesture and the like through various sensors such as an air pressure sensor, UWB, an electronic compass and the like, acquiring three-dimensional positioning coordinates of firefighters through a fusion algorithm, recording tracks and marking characteristic points to construct a path database, dynamically planning an optimal path through an improved A-algorithm after evaluating dangerous grades by combining environment parameters, judging lost road through positioning continuity and the like, triggering return, tracing back to generate a reference path through a reverse track and correcting, sending search and rescue requests when UWB signals are lower than a threshold value, optimizing the position and guiding directions through triangular positioning, constructing a manual and automatic multi-scene alarm mechanism, and synchronously transmitting alarm related data through multiple channels. The intelligent fire scene matching system has the advantages that the fire scene complex environment is adapted by combining accurate three-dimensional positioning with dynamic path planning, intelligent return and collaborative search and rescue, and the operation safety and emergency treatment efficiency of firefighters are ensured.
assignees: BEIJING ORIENTAL DRAGON FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster site three-dimensional mapping system based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster site mapping, and discloses a disaster site three-dimensional mapping system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle. The system comprises a control unmanned aerial vehicle carrying a multispectral sensor for carrying out omnibearing scanning on a disaster site, collecting earth surface deformation data and multiband reflectivity data, carrying out time sequence alignment and noise filtering on the collected data, constructing an initial three-dimensional point cloud through dynamic voxelization processing, merging inertial measurement unit data to correct space positions, identifying earth surface fracture zone edge and elevation mutation characteristics from the point cloud, dividing geological stability subareas by combining the reflectivity data, carrying out multilevel detail division on the stability subareas by adopting a self-adaptive octree segmentation algorithm, automatically adjusting grid resolution according to fracture zone density to generate a three-dimensional topological structure of the disaster site, calculating earth surface displacement vectors and sedimentation gradients through comparing historic and current three-dimensional data, marking potential secondary disaster risk areas, and realizing accurate evaluation and risk early warning of the disaster site.
