title_en: Breathing detection apparatus and method
abstract_en: A device is disclosed for remote monitoring of breathing movements of a patient, comprising a sender transmitting a microwave signal toward the patient, a receiver arranged to receive a signal reflected by the patient, and a processor. The processor mixes the received signal with the transmitted signal and with a signal in quadrature with the transmitted signal to determine a breathing frequency of the patient. In some embodiments, two signals at different frequencies are emitted toward the patient and processed in order to compensate for breathing patterns that are not uniquely resolvable at a single frequency.

title_en: Detection, location, and characterization of buried explosive devices and weapons caches
abstract_en: Embodiments of this invention utilize Fraunhofer diffraction to detect, locate, and characterize buried objects, and, in particular, weapons caches and/or potentially dangerous explosive devices, are to be detected and characterized according to rough size, shape, and reflectivity with respect to the probe energy (ultrasound, microwave, milliwave, etc.). Size is obtained by measuring the spatial pattern and/or width of the Fraunhofer diffraction wave. Reflectivity is obtained by normalizing the reflected energy with respect to the energy reaching the target object and the size of the reflective area of the target object.

title_en: Vital Sign Sensing Device
abstract_en: Vital sign sensing device includes a housing adapted to support a hand of a user and sensors adapted to detect vital signs of the user. The sensor device includes an arithmetic processor adapted to receive the electrical signal, manipulate the signal, and generate an electrical signal representative of the vital signs. The vital sign sensing device can be incorporated into various structures and equipment, such as, an armrest or seating device, a stretcher, or a kiosk.

title_ko: 유량제어가 가능한 하천 배수 댐 구조물
abstract_en: A river dam structure for flow control is provided to secure the enough time for evacuation and to inform the lower reaches of a river of flood occurrence if the river rises rapidly by a localized torrential downpour. The river dam structure for flow control comprises a reservoir panel(10) composed of a support frame and a support case and installed to make the base hinged on the bottom of the river to be close by the lower reaches of an underwater barrier(2) and the front end placed closely to the bottom(1) of a river toward the upper reaches of a river to block up a waterway of a river, a support(20) installed to the lower reaches of the reservoir panel and supporting the rear of the reservoir panel when the reservoir panel ascends to keep the reservoir panel vertically, a fixture(30) composed of a bracket(32), a fixing hook(34), a spring(36) and a wire(38) and installed on the bottom of the river to fix the reservoir panel adhered closely to the bottom of the river not to be ascent, a pressure detector(40) composed of a housing(42) provided with an opening(41) and buried under the underwater barrier to make the opening face the upper reaches of the river, a piston(43) fixed to the housing, a spring(44) placed on the rear of the piston to pressurize the piston toward the upper reaches of the river, a push rod(45) extended to the rear of the piston and a movable arm(46) hinged on the rear of the housing and connected with the push rod and the wire and installed on the upper reaches of the underwater barrier to be operated by the pressure of water flowing along the river to release the fixture, and an alarm composed of a sensor switch(62) placed on the rear of the housing of the pressure detector and switched on when the movable arm moves, a controller connected to the sensor switch, a voice alarm connected to the controller to generate alarm sounds according to the signals of the controller and a signal flare projector connected to the sensor switch to project signal flares and to let people know the flooded location.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 유량제어가 가능한 하천 배수 댐 구조물은 하천의 물이 불어나면 저수패널(10)이 자동으로 입설되어 하천의 물을 가둠과 동시에, 경보를 출력하도록 구성되어, 집중호우에 의해 하천의 수량이 급격하게 증가되면 대피시간을 벌 뿐 아니라, 하류쪽에 홍수발생 사실을 알릴 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Ultra wideband monitoring systems and antennas
title_ko: 초광대역 모니터링 시스템 및 안테나
abstract_en: Apparatus for monitoring vital signs of one or more living subjects comprises a monitoring station and at least one sensor in communication with the monitoring station. The sensor comprises an antenna system, an ultra wideband radar system coupled to the antenna system, a signal processor and a communication system. The signal processor is connected to receive a signal from the ultra wideband radar system and configured to extract from the signal information about one or more vital signs of a person or animal in a sensing volume corresponding to the antenna system. The communication system is configured to transmit the information to the monitoring station.
abstract_ko: 하나 이상의 살아있는 대상의 활력 징후를 모니터링하는 장치는 모니터링 스테이션 및 상기 모니터링 스테이션과 통신하는 적어도 하나의 센서를 포함한다. 상기 센서는 안테나 시스템, 상기 안테나 시스템에 커플된 초광대역 레이더 시스템, 신호 프로세서 및 통신 시스템을 포함한다. 상기 신호 프로세서는 상기 초광대역 레이더 시스템으로부터 신호를 수신하도록 연결되고 상기 안테나 시스템에 대응하는 감지 공간 내에서 사람 또는 동물의 하나 이상의 활력 징후에 대해 상기 신호 정보로부터 추출되도록 구성된다. 상기 통신 시스템은 상기 모니터링 스테이션으로 상기 정보를 전송하도록 구성된다.

title_en: Radar for through wall detection
abstract_en: Radar apparatus for detecting an object in through wall and related applications, the radar apparatus comprising a transmitter for transmitting radar signals, and a receiver for receiving reflected portions of said transmitted signals from said object. The radar apparatus is configured for operation in any of at least a first and a second selectable mode. The transmitter is configured for transmitting radar signals in accordance with a selected one of the modes of operation, and said receiver is configured for receiving said reflected portions of said signals transmitted in accordance with said selected mode of operation. The radar apparatus is configured for transmission of signals, through an obstacle, to said object when operating in at least one of said modes.
assignees: CAMBRIDGE CONSULTANTS;BURCHETT MICHAEL HUGH;UTSI PER ARNE VINCENT;OSWALD GORON KENNETH ANDREW;CARTER EDWIN CHRISTOPHER;EDGCOMBE JONATHAN PETER;KEMP GARY;CARTER ROBERT JOHN

title_en: Sewage pipe flushing system
title_ko: 하수도용 관거 세척장치
abstract_en: A washer of a sewerage conduit is provided to prevent the inundation of the downstream and improve sewage purification capacity by controlling and discharging excessively introduced sewage. A washer of a sewerage conduit includes a manhole type buried portion, sensors(31,33,35), and a vacuum device(40). The manhole type buried portion includes a first water tub and a second water tub. The first water tub stores sewage. The second water tub communicates with the first water tube through a lower communication hole. The sensors are installed at the first water tub and the second water tub, and sense a water level. The vacuum device is installed at an upper portion of the second water tub, and is electrically connected to the sensors. The vacuum device opens air in the second water tub according to signals of the sensors.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 하수관거에 침전된 침전물의 처리를 쉽게 함으로서 하수시설의 유지 관리를 편리하고 안전하게 하기 위한 하수도용 관거 세척장치에 관한 것이다. 이러한 본 발명은 하수관거의 중간에 설치되어 하수관거를 따라 흐르는 하수(우수)를 진공으로 빨아 들여 저장하였다가 방류함으로서 하수관거의 바닥에 침전되는 침전물을 말끔하게 세척하도록 한 것이다. 그 세척 과정은 자동으로 이루어지기 때문에 운전이 편리하고, 세척기계장치가 하수와 접액되는 기계부품이 없으므로 유지관리비용이 절감되고, 사이펀 유로를 통하여 세척수가 파도처럼 밀려나와 쇄도하는 모습으로 침전물을 세척함으로서 침전물의 처리를 효과적으로 한 것이다. 
       
     맨홀, 하수관거, 침전물, 수세

title_en: Pipe diameter estimation method in underground survey radar
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To precisely find an aperture of a buried pipe based on a reception signal level, using an underground survey radar.  <P>SOLUTION: This pipe diameter estimation method stores a correspondence table of a pipe diameter in a reference depth to the reception signal level (S1), conducts usual survey (S2), and finds a buried depth and a dielectric constant of a soil, based on different propagation times from two lines of reception systems (S3). A reception signal is inverse-TC-processed (S4) to find the reception signal level for estimation. The correspondence table in a reference signal is corrected based on the depth and the dielectric constant (S5), and the corrected table is compared with the reception signal level to estimate the pipe diameter (S6).  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT
assignees: JAPAN RADIO CO LTD;TOKYO GAS CO LTD;OSAKA GAS CO LTD;TOHO GAS KK;SEIBU GAS CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake-proof insulated energy-saving house for countryside
abstract_en: A rural shock-proof thermal-insulation energy-saving house relates to movable rural shock-proof energy-saving house. The utility model solves failures for current houses such as poor function for land source and disaster-proof, bad thermal insulation, wasting resource and high cost. A thread post of the utility model is arranged on a reinforced concrete base (1) whose four corners are provided with movable hole (9); bottom of a metal frame (2) and a pre-buried thread (6) on the reinforced concrete base (1) are fixed joint through nut; a decoration plate (4) for outer and inner wall is fixed on the metal frame (2); the outer and inner wall decoration plate (4) is provided with thermal insulation material layer (3); a solar heating device (5) is arranged at inclined face for A-shape beam for house top and is provided with anti-rain layer (7). Compared to current houses, the utility model has saved percent 40 to percent 50 in energy and saved percent 10 to percent 20 in cost, and also has the advantages of saving large quantity of land source; good shock-proof function; good thermal insulation.

title_en: Health monitoring appliance
abstract_en: A heart monitoring system for a person includes one or more wireless nodes forming a wireless network; a wearable sensor having a wireless transceiver adapted to communicate with the one or more wireless nodes; and a software module receiving data from the wireless nodes to detect changes in patient vital signs.

title_en: Fitness monitoring
abstract_en: A mobile system for a user includes a telephone having one or more sensors to capture fitness data or vital sign data, the telephone having a wireless transceiver coupled to the processor to communicate fitness or vital sign data over a personal area network; and a processor coupled to the personal area network to process the fitness or vital sign data.

title_en: Ground penetrating radar system and image signal processing method
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a ground penetrating radar system, and an image signal process method capable of simplifying operation formula for specifying a body though the detection precision of the body buried under the ground is improved to show a high reliability.  <P>SOLUTION: The 3D-data acquisition step of obtaining each element of the 3D-matrix data composed of the ground surface as a reference of horizontal surface direction and depth direction from the ground surface to the underground direction; the moving average calculation step of obtaining the moving average in the ground surface as reference of the horizontal surface; the imaging step of making 3D-images from the 3D-data acquisition step and the moving average calculation step; the peak sharpness calculation step of calculating by the correlation between adjacent images;the mine image specification step of specifying the mine image from the condition of peak sharpness is at maximum; and the mine coordinate specification step of specifying the mine coordinate from the point of mine image maximum value.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Outlet box
title_ko: 공동주택의 실내벽면에 매설되는 전기콘센트박스
abstract_en: An outlet box buried in an inner wall surface of an apartment is provided to employ a housing, an outlet, an opening part, a pinion gear, the first motor, a screw axis, the second motor, a switch, the first load sensor, the second load sensor, and a controller, thereby preventing a conductor or impurities from being inserted into the outlet or piled into the outlet. A housing has an opening part at a front surface and an internal space. An outlet is mounted in the housing movably forward and backward. The outlet includes a body provided with a protrusion protruding forward through the opening part of the housing, in which the protrusion includes a plug connection recess having a leg insertion hole in the lower portion of the body. The outlet includes an electrode installed in the body, is connected to an external power source, and is stuck to a leg inserted into the leg insertion hole(21a2) to apply power to the leg. An opening panel has an embossed part having a rack shape, and is vertically slid inside the housing to open the opening part. A pinion gear vertically moves the opening panel in the engagement with the embossed part of the opening panel. A guide guides the left and right movement of the opening panel. The first motor rotates the pinion gear. A screw axis passes through the outlet. The second motor is coupled to the screw axis. A switch is installed at the front side of the housing. The first load sensor detects the load of the first motor. The second load sensor detects the load of the second motor. A controller controls the operation of the first and second motors according to signals of the first and second load sensors and the switch.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공동주택의 실내벽면에 매설되는 전기콘센트박스에 관한 것으로, 레그가 구비된 플러그를 꽂아 전원을 공급할 수 있도록 된 벽체매설형 전기배전단자함에 있어서, 전면일측에 개구부(11)가 구비되고, 내부에 공간이 형성된 하우징(10) ; 하우징의 내부에 전후진가능하게 장착되고 전면에는 전진시 상기 개구부를 통해 전방으로 돌출되는 돌부(P)가 구비되며 돌부(P)에는 내부 저면에 레그삽입홀(21a2)을 갖는 플러그연결홈(21a)이 형성된 본체(21)와, 본체(21)에 내설되어 외부전원에 연결되며 레그삽입홀(21a2)에 삽입된 레그와 밀착되어 전원을 인가하는 전극을 포함하는 콘센트(20) ; 상부에 랙 형상의 요철부(31)가 형성되며, 하우징(10)의 내부에 측방향으로 슬라이드되어 개구부(11)를 개폐하도록 장착된 개폐부재(30) ; 개폐부재(30)의 요철부(31)와 연동하여 개폐부재(30)를 측방향으로 이동시키는 피니언기어(40) ; 피니언기어(40)를 회전시키는 제1모터(50) ; 콘센트(20)를 전후방으로 관통하도록 나사결합된 나사축(60) ; 나사축(70)에 연결된 제2모터(70) ; 하우징(10)의 전면에 설치되는 스위치(80) ; 제1모터(50)의 부하를 감지하는 제1부하감지센서(90) ; 제2모터(70)의 부하를 감지하는 제2부하감지센서(100) ; 스위치(80)와 제1 및 제2부하감지센서(90,100)의 신호에 따라 제1모터(50)와 제2모터(70)를 작동제어하는 제어부(110)를 갖추고서 벽체에 매설되어, 콘센트(20)의 플러그연결홈(21a)로의 전도체 삽입으로 인한 감전사고 및, 이물질이 플러그연결홈(21a)에 쌓여 발생할 수 있는 화재사고를 방지할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Underground wire connect pipe laid underground
title_ko: 지하에 매설되는 지중배전선 연결관
abstract_en: An underground wire connection pipe is provided to accelerate an underground wire repairing process by instantly monitoring a damage state of the underground wire. A support unit(100) is buried under an underground pipe. An external case(200) is buried on a ground to be located over the underground pipe. A first measuring unit(300) and a second measuring unit are symmetrically embedded in the external case. First ends of a first wire(400) and a second wire are connected to the support unit, while second ends thereof are connected to the first and second measuring units. First and second support wires are connected to the measuring units. First and second winders wind the support wires. A control unit is connected to the measuring units. A light emitting unit(800) is connected to the control unit. A pipe is connected to an exterior of the underground pipe. Liquid is filled inside the pipe. A fire detector detects a fire inside the underground pipe.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하에 매설되는 지중배전선 연결관에 관한 것으로, 지면(1)에 매설되는 지중배관(2)과, 지중배관(2)의 내부에 배치되는 케이블(C)로 이루어진 지하에 매설되는 지중배전선 연결관에 있어서, 상기 지중배관(2)이 내관(2a)과, 내관(2a)의 외부에 끼워지며 내관(2a)의 외주면과의 사이에 수용부(2c)를 형성하는 외관(2b)으로 이루어지고 ; 상하단이 개방된 실린더(110)와, 하단이 실린더(110)의 상측에 승강가능하게 삽입되고 상단이 지중배관(2)을 지지하는 상부지지대(120)와, 상단이 실린더(110)의 하측에 승강가능하게 삽입되고 하단이 지중 토사에 의해 지지되는 하부지지대(130)와, 압축된 상태로 상부지지대(120)와 하부지지대(130) 사이에 배치되는 스프링(140)을 갖춘 지지기구(100)와 ; 상판(220)이 투광성 재질로 구성되고, 내부에 수용부(210)가 형성되며, 상판(220)이 지면(1)의 상측으로 노출되도록 지면(1)에  매설되는 외부케이스(200)와 ; 외부케이스(200) 내부 양측에 각각 구비되는 제1·2보호케이스(310,310')와, 제1·2보호케이스(310,310') 내부에 상하방향으로 각각 설치되는 제1·2가이드바(320,320')와, 제1·2가이드바(320,320')에 승강가능하게 각각 결합 된 제1·2이동판(340,340')과, 제1·2이동판(340,340')을 각각 상향가압하는 제1·2스프링(330,330')과, 제1·2이동판(340,340')에 각각 설치되어 제1·2이동판(340,340')과 같이 승강하는 제1·2영구자석(350,350')과, 제1·2보호케이스(310,310')의 내벽에 수직방향을 따라 각각 이격 설치되어 제1·2영구자석(350,350')의 자력과 작용하는 다수의 제1·2마그네틱근접스위치(360,360')를 갖추고서 외부케이스(200)에  내설되는 제1·2측정기구(300,300')와 ; 일단이 하부지지대(130)에 연결되고, 타단이 이동판(340,340')에 고정되는 제1·2와이어(400,400')와 ; 제1·2이동판(340,340')에 연결되는 제1·2지지와이어(500,500')와 ; 제1·2지지와이어(500,500')와 연결되어 제1·2지지와이어(500,500')를 감아서,  제1·2이동판(340,340')을 상승시키는 제1·2권취기(600,600')와 ; 제1·2마그네틱근접스위치(360,360')로부터 제1·2이동판(340,340')의 위치신호를 받아 중앙통제실의 수신기(H)로 데이터를 전송하고, 제1·2권취기(600,600')를 동작제어하는  제어유닛(700)과 ; 외부케이스(200)에 내설되며, 제어유닛(700)에 연결되어 제어유닛(700)에 의해 ON·OFF 제어되는 발광유닛(800)과 ; 내부공간(910)이 지중배관(2)의 수용부(2c)와 연통되도록 지중배관(2)에 연결되고, 투광성 재질의 상단은 외부케이스(200)의 수용부(210)로 노출되는 파이프(900)와 ; 지중배관(2)의 수용부(2c) 및 파이프(900)에 충진되는 확인액체(L)와 ; 하단이 열에 약한 재질의 폐쇄막(1011)에 의해 폐쇄되어 지중배관(2)의 내관(2a) 안으로 돌출되고 상단이 개구되어 외부케이스(200)로 노출되는 연기통로관(1010)과, 외부케이스(200) 내부에 설치되는 연기감지센서(1020)를 갖춘 화재감지기구(1000) 더 구비되어, 지중배관(2)보다 아래에 위치한 지반이 지하수등에 의해 세굴되었을 시, 그 상황을 중앙통제실에 즉각 알리며, 복구반이 도착할 때까지 지중배관(2)이 계속적으로 지지되는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Method for checking underground-buried pipeline
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To make a check as far as a deeper position than in the past when checking the position of a buried pipe by using a ground penetrating radar.  <P>SOLUTION: A bore hole 14 is formed along a pipe 11 buried in the ground. An electromagnetic wave 16 is transmitted/received between the bore hole 14 and a ground surface 2, thereby detecting a position where the pipe 11 is buried.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Smart watch
abstract_en: Systems and methods include a cellular, WiFi, and Bluetooth transceiver coupled to a processor; an accelerometer or a motion sensor coupled to the processor; and a sensor coupled to the processor to sense mood or body vital sign; and a wearable device operating wirelessly with the processor, wherein the wearable device includes at least one sensor coupled to a back of the wearable device and wherein the wearable device recognizes and executes a speech command.

title_en: Sensor for detecting the passing of a pulse wave from a subject´s arterial system
abstract_en: In order to provide an easy-to-use technique for measuring blood pressure and/or other vital signs of a subject, a sensor for detecting the passing of a pulse wave from a subject's arterial system is suggested, the sensor being adapted to be located at a sensing position on the exterior of the subject's body, characterized in that the sensor comprises a number of electrical coils for generating an inductive coupling to the subject's body in a way that the properties of said inductive coupling change if a pulse wave passes a screened volume underneath the sensing position, and a circuit connected to the number of electrical coils, said circuit being adapted to detect said property changes of the inductive coupling.
assignees: PHILIPS INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY;KONINKL PHILIPS ELECTRONICS NV

title_en: Buried object detection sensor
abstract_en: A combined type buried object detection sensor is provided, in which a MD and a GPR are integrated to improve a detectivity. A buried object detection sensor  10  has a constitution in which plural antenna elements composing a GPR  14  are disposed on a circumference, an inner coil  16  of a MD  12  is arranged at a center portion of the GPR  14  and an outer coil  18  of the MD  12  is arranged at a periphery of the GPR  14 , the GPR  14  has slits  20  separating the respective antenna elements, and the slits  20  between adjacent antenna elements are connected by a metal leaf  36.

title_en: Transmitting and receiving equipment of bio signal using zigbee
title_ko: 지그비를 이용한 생체신호 송수신장치
abstract_en: A device for transceiving a bio signal using ZigBee is provided to enable a user to receive emergency treatment quickly by transmitting an emergency signal to an external medical institution or an emergency rescue center through ZigBee when the bio signal exceeds a dangerous value while recognizing the bio signal of the user. A bio signal receiver(21) receives a bio signal value measured through a bio sensor(10). A signal amplifier(22) amplifies the received bio signal to a level for an ADC(Analog/Digital Converter)(23). The ADC converts an analog bio signal value into a digital bio signal value. A controller(24) determines whether the bio signal value exceeds a dangerous value, and generates a control signal for issuing an emergency call through various communication paths through the ZigBee. A memory(25) stores application software and the dangerous value. A ZigBee communicator(26) communicates with a bio signal receiving device(30) through the ZigBee. The bio signal receiving device includes a ZigBee receiver(31), a communication path selector(32), and a communication unit(33) comprising various communication paths connecting to the medical institution or the emergency rescue center.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지그비 통신이 가능한 단말기를 휴대하면서 생체측정기를 통해 측정된 생체신호를 인식하고, 지그비 통신을 통해 외부의 의료기관 또는 응급 구조기관과 연결된 단말기에 사용자의 위험 생체수치 정보를 전송할 수 있도록 하여 신속하게 응급조치를 받을 수 있도록 한 것이다. 
     본 발명은 생체측정기를 통해 측정된 생체신호값을 수신하는 생체신호 수신부와 생체신호 수신부를 통해 수신된 생체신호값을 A/D컨버터부에서 인식 가능한 레벨로 신호를 증폭하는 신호증폭부와 신호증폭부를 통해 증폭된 아날로그 생체신호값을 디지털 생체신호값으로 변환하는 A/D컨버터부와 생체신호값이 위험수치를 경과하는 지를 판단한 후, 생체신호 수신장치와 지그비통신을 하여 다양한 통신경로를 통해 응급 호출을 하도록 해당 구성장치에 제어신호를 인가하여 제어하는 제어부와 제어부를 운용하는 응용 소프트웨어 및 생체신호 위험수치 정보를 저장하는 메모리부와 생체신호 수신장치와 지그비 통신을 하는 지그비 송신부로 이루어지는 셍체신호 송신장치; 상기 생체신호 송신장치의 지그비 송신부와 지그비 통신을 하여 생체신호 정보를 수신하는 지그비 수신부와 통신부와 연결된 다양한 통신경로 중 가장 빠르게 연결되는 통신경로를 측정한 후, 이에 따른 통신경로를 지정하는 통신경로 선택부와 외부의 의료기관 또는 응급 구조기관과 연결되게 다양한 통신경로로 이루어지는 통신부로 이루어지는 생체신호 수신장치;로 구성되는 지그비를 이용한 생체신호 송수신장치에 관한 것이다. 
       
     지그비, 생체신호, 응급 호출, 위험수치, 의료기관

title_en: Nondestructive survey instrument, method therefor, and program
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a nondestructive survey instrument capable of detecting a position and a shape of a buried object buried in a shallow position, precisely compared with a conventional example, and capable of estimating a material of the buried object impossible to be estimated in the prior art.  <P>SOLUTION: This nondestructive survey instrument of the present invention has a microwave radar part for transmitting a transmission wave to receive a reflected wave thereof, a difference calculation part for subtracting a transmission waveform from a reflection waveform to find a differential waveform, a mutual correlation Hilbert transform part for Hilbert-transforming a crosscorrelation between the differential waveform and the transmission waveform to obtain a model fitness function of an absolute value of a complex reflection coefficient, a boundary model fitness computing part for holding the maximum value of a time difference of the model fitness function and a time difference of the maximum value, for conducting conversion into a prescribed time difference width of boundary model fitness function, a reverse projection image generating part for generating a reverse projection image by a histogram of the boundary model fitness function of a reflected wave, using the boundary model fitness function of the reflected wave in every measured point as a degree of reliability of a consideration point, and a phase detecting part for finding a phase of the transmission wave bringing the maximum value of the histogram in the reverse projection image.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Underground radar
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an underground radar having a wide survey range in a direction orthogonal to a radar movement direction, capable of acquiring easily the shape of a buried object and a burying position with excellent resolution in the radar movement direction.  <P>SOLUTION: This radar has a constitution equipped with an electromagnetic wave transmission part 20 capable of scanning in the radar width direction with an electromagnetic wave transmitted toward the underground from a transmission array antenna 24, an electromagnetic wave transmission direction control part 30 for controlling variably the electromagnetic wave transmission direction of the electromagnetic wave transmission part 20, an electromagnetic wave reception part 40 for receiving a reflected wave from the underground by a reception array antenna 41, a reflected wave incoming angle estimation part 50 for estimating the reflected wave incoming direction from a received signal by the electromagnetic wave reception part 40, a synthetic aperture processing part 60 for performing synthetic aperture processing from the received signal by the electromagnetic wave reception part 40, a transmission/reception time operation part 70 for operating a time from electromagnetic wave transmission until reflected wave reception, an image processing part 80 for calculating display data, and an image display part 90 for displaying the display data.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT
assignees: NIPPON SIGNAL CO LTD;NAT UNIV YOKOHAMA

title_en: Prefabricated yellow soil wall-board as a building material
title_ko: 건축 구조물의 조립형 황토벽판
abstract_en: A prefabricated loess wall panel of a building structure is provided to assemble and install as a portion of a building structure of a multistoried building structure such as an apartment house by coupling a loess wall filled with loess materials to a space of a wall panel frame, to increase structural strength by forming a wall panel frame with steel beams, and to control humidity and to be beneficial to the human body sanitarily by forming a wall with loess materials. A prefabricated loess wall panel of a building structure is formed by coupling a wall panel frame(F), which comprises a top horizontal beam(1) made of an H-steel beam, vertical beams(2) made of H-steel beams arranged on two ends and the middle of the top horizontal beam at regular intervals, horizontal reinforcements(3) composed of plural square bars arranged on the vertical beams at regular intervals and diagonal reinforcements(4) arranged to cross the frame diagonally, with a loess wall(Y), which comprises a wire sieve(5) attached to front and rear sides of the wall plate frame and loess materials(y) filled in a space of the wall plate frame to make the wire sieve buried, wherein many holes(1h) are formed on a retreated part(1a) of the top horizontal beam to penetrate and support a reinforcing bar of a slab to install a slab and a loess wall(P) integrally, and veneer(6) is attached to the outside of the horizontal reinforcement to improve on appearance of a wall or to use effectively for driving a nail.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건축 구조물의 조립형 황토벽판에 관한 것으로 H형 강철빔으로 된 상단 가로빔, 상기 상단 가로빔의 양단부와 중간부에 일정한 간격의 세로로 배치된 세로빔, 상기 세로빔의 전후 양측에서 세로빔에 걸쳐 상하 일정한 간격으로 배치된 복수개의 가로 보강대, 및 대각선으로 교차된 대각선 보강대로 형성된 벽판 프레임과, 상기 벽판 프레임의 양측면에 장착된 금속망체, 금속망체가 매입되게 벽판 프레임의 내부공간에 황토소재가 충전된 황토벽체가 결합되어 황토벽체로 구성되어 있다.  설정된 벽의 높이와 폭으로 된 상기 황토벽판을 건축물이 정위치에 수직으로 고정시키고 상단 프레임의 구멍을 이용하여 철근 슬라브를 황토벽판과 일체로 축조하여 건축물 구조체의 일부가 되게 한다. 황토 벽판의 조립시공이 간편하고 강도와 내구성이 매우 높으며, 실내의 습기조절기능이 있고 화재의 우려가 없으며 화재시 유해가스가 방출이 없고 황토에서 방출되는 원적외선과 음이온에 의해 위생에 유익하여 각종 건축 구조물의 벽판으로 유효하게 사용할 수 있게 제공한다.       
       
     상단 가로빔, 세로빔, 가로 보강대, 대각선 보강대, 망판, 황토소재.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted ultra-wideband radar systems and methods
abstract_en: Vehicle-mounted UWB systems and/or methods for detecting mines and other explosive devices are provided. In certain exemplary embodiments, a system for detecting non-buried mines and/or improvised explosive devices is provided. Distance measuring equipment may be configured to track movement of the system. Substantially forward-looking bistatic antenna transceivers may be capable of collecting range-magnitude radar data over two channels. A first transceiver may capture radar data for a first area, and a second transceiver may capture radar data for a second area. A processor may be configured to: derive range resolution data and cross-range resolution data from the range-magnitude radar data; focus the range resolution data and the cross-range resolution data, based at least on the distance data and an antenna beamwidth pattern associated with the antenna transceivers; and, “and” data for portions of the first area and the second area that overlap.

title_en: Bio-signal measurement system unified toilet stool
title_ko: 원격 건강관리를 위한 변좌 일체형 생체신호 획득 장치
abstract_en: A toilet stool unified type bio-signal measurement system is provided to measure and manage an individual bio-signal by using a personal identification card for identifying a user. A toilet stool unified type bio-signal measurement system includes a foothold(100), a toilet stool unit(200), and a brachium support unit(300). The foothold detects a weight by mounting at least four weight measuring sensors on a bottom surface. The toilet stool unit detects a weight by mounting at least four weight measuring sensors on a bottom surface and mounts thigh electrocardiogram electrodes(220) and thigh bio-electrical impedance measuring electrodes(260) on a top surface where both thighs are in contact with each other. The brachium support unit mounts a finger insertion type measuring device(305) on an upper end and wrist electrocardiogram electrodes(370) and wrist bio-electrical impedance measuring electrodes(380) on a top portion in contact with a wrist.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 원격 건강관리를 위한 변좌 일체형 생체신호 획득 장치에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세히는 변기와 발판에 장착되어 체중, 혈압, 심전도, 체임피던스, 혈중산소포화도를 측정하며 이 측정된 데이터들을 사용자별로 관리가능하며 원격전송할 수 있는 생체신호획득 장치에 관한 것이다.  
     본 발명의 변좌 일체형 생체신호 획득 장치는 그 밑면에 4개이상의 체중 측정 센서가 장착되어 발판측정 체중을 검출하는 발판부(100); 그 아랫면에 4개 이상의 체중측정센서가 장착되어 변좌측정 체중을 검출하며, 그 윗면에 양쪽 허벅지 닿는 부분에 허벅지 심전도 전극들 및 허벅지 체임피던스 측정전극들이 장착되어 있는 변좌부; 그 상면 일단부에 손가락 삽입형측정기(305)가 장착되어 있으며. 그 상면의 팔목이 닿는 부분에 팔목 심전도 전극 및 팔목 체임피던스 측정전극이 장착되어 있는 상완거치부;를 구비한다. 
     또한 본 발명은 개인 식별자카드를 읽어들여 인식하는 카드 인식부(390)를 더 구비하며, 상기 허벅지 심전도 전극들과 상기 팔목 심전도 전극을 이용하여 심전도를 측정하며, 상기 허벅지 체임피던스 측정전극들과 상기 팔목 체임피던스 측정전극를 이용하여 체임피던스(체지방)을 측정한다. 
       
      심전도, 체임피던스, 체지방, 혈압, 산소포화도, 개인 식별자카드, 무선전송

title_en: Spherical surface contact type rotation slip support and underground buried pile method in support body pile head
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a pile head base-isolated structure capable of supporting a big building weight without being influenced by a periodic characteristic of earthquake wave.  <P>SOLUTION: A supporting part is a spherical structure similar to a bearing support and a slip support equivalent to a ball bearing which Coulomb friction coefficient is η=0.01-0.001 by a combination of a sphere 7 and a spherical surface saucer, and the supporting part bears a bit axial force. In order to reduce a frictional force, a coating rim in which a zinc galvanized steel plate or a stainless steel plate or the like are thermally pressed with an electroresistive welding and a hot metal on the surface of both end rotate and slip support of a column 8 is provided, and a polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFT) which is a tribology technology to support the axial force and to reduce a stress concentration and a creaking sound on a slideway between the sphere and a casing.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Remote fire extinguisher
abstract_en: Disclosed is a long-distance fire extinguisher, pertaining to the technical field of fire-extinguishing device. The utility model is designed for the fire extinguisher deeply entering the fire center by long-distance. The utility model comprises a shell, a closed sending ring, a tail wing and a gas generator. The back part of the shell 1 is cylindrical and the front part of the shell 1 is cone-shaped to reduce the flying resistance; the closed sending ring 2 are arranged at the back of the cone-shaped part of the shell 1 in the way of surrounding the shell 1 to be favorable for the good sealing of the sending device; the tail wing 3 is arranged at the back part of the shell 1 to control the flying direction; the fire-extinguishing agent 5 is filled inside the shell 1; the gas generator 4 is arranged at the axis part; a gas generating agent 7 is wrapped by a shell 6 into cylinder shape; one end of a fuse 8 is buried inside the gas generating agent 7; the other end of the fuse 8 is connected with a thermal-sensitive head 9 with fuse powder arranged at the top of the cone-shaped part. When in fire extinguishing, the fire extinguisher enters the fire scene, the thermal-sensitive head 9 is ignited to ignite the fuse 8 to heat the gas generating agent 7 and then the gas generating agent 7 is gasified and expanded to expand the fire extinguisher to put out the fire. The utility model is applicable for the being used in the fire scene where the fire fighters can not get close to.

title_en: Direction-sensitive radiation detector and radiation detection method
abstract_en: A radiation detection system and method suitable for use by a first responder to detect a radiological source. The system includes a container that encloses a chamber containing a pressurized inert gas. Incident gamma rays pass through walls of the container to interact with inert gas atoms within the chamber. Wavelength-shifting fiber elements are disposed within scintillator bars oriented parallel to and radially spaced from the chamber axis. At least one sensor is interconnected with the fiber elements to receive first signals therefrom in response to the scattered gamma rays. An electrically-charged wire is disposed within the container along the axis thereof. The wire is adapted to attract electrons released from atoms of the inert gas that are ionized from being impacted by an incident gamma ray, and then produce second signals in response to the released electrons. Electronic circuitry collects the first and second signals, and a processor acquires and analyzes the first and second signals to produce an output based thereon.

title_en: Rfid based proximity sensor and alert system for fugitives, sex offenders, missing soldiers and the like
abstract_en: A robust, wireless sensor system providing a low cost method of tracking people such as sex offenders, child molesters, etc., after their release from prison or other confinement, which protects society from such individuals and lessens their ability to repeat such offenses. The system and method of the invention can also be used to locate kidnapped persons, people buried in snow avalanches, missing or dead soldiers, etc. The system utilizes RFID tags placed on people or in specified locations and RFID transmitters that can resonate with the tagged people or objects. Such a trigger recognition arrangement combined with communication of information from the triggering can be used to obtain a signal alerting the transmitter carrier that the tagged object or person is nearby. The triggering action can also initiate a sequence of information transfers in which the transmitter broadcasts to a central command that a particular transmitter is or was in proximity to a specific object or person, and allows the command center to order the dispatch of authorized personnel, such as policemen, military personnel, emergency rescue workers, etc. to the triggering location.

title_en: Movement detector for detecting the movement of a breathing activity
abstract_en: To enhance a movement detector for detecting the movement of a body breathing or heartbeat activity comprising a Doppler sensor (11) with a microwave oscillator (2) and at least one mixer (14) in such a manner, that the detector is on the one hand efficient and save with respect to a baby breathing or heartbeat detection and on the other hand a low cost solution, the sensor (11) is performed as sensor unit (13) with a volume less than 100 cm3 and a sending energy lower than 10 mW.

title_en: Radar sensor for remote vital signal detection using two frequency
title_ko: 두 개의 주파수를 사용하는 원격 생체 신호 측정 레이더센서
abstract_en: A remote bio-signal measuring radar sensor using two frequencies is provided to facilitate heart beat measurement, remote voice acquisition, and survivor checking by sensing motions of internal organs in a remote place. A transmitting stage inputs a signal with a frequency f1 and a signal with a frequency f2 into a body(125) at the same time, wherein f2 is greater than f1. A receiving stage receives the reflected radio waves, which are inputted into the body in the transmitting stage, and divides the received radio waves into the signals with the frequencies f1 and f2 to amplify the divided signals. A primary frequency mixer(416) multiplies the signals with the frequencies f1 and f2. A band pass filter(417) passes only a signal with a frequency f2-f1 among the signals multiplied by the primary frequency mixer. A second frequency mixer(419) multiplies the signal passing through the band pass filter by a sine wave with the frequency f2-f1. A low band pass filter(420) filters the signal passing through the secondary frequency mixer. A digital signal processing unit(421) digitally processes the signal filtered through the low band pass filter.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 몸에 대한 투과도가 다른 서로 다른 두 개의 주파수를 사용하여 체내의 생체 정보를 얻는 원격 생체 신호 측정 레이더 센서에 관한 것으로서, 주파수 f1을 가지는 신호와 주파수 f2(f2>f1)을 가지는 신호를 생체에 동시에 입사시키는 송신단과, 상기 송신단에서 생체에 입사된 전파가 반사되어 오는 것을 입력받아 f1과 f2 주파수로 분리 후 증폭하는 수신단과, 상기 수신단에서 분리되어 출력되는 f1과 f2의 주파수를 가지는 두 신호를 서로 곱하는 1차 주파수 혼합기와, 상기 1차 주파수 혼합기를 통해 서로 곱해진 신호 중 f2-f1 주파수를 가지는 신호만을 골라서 통과시키는 대역통과필터와, 상기 대역통과필터를 통과한 신호에 f2-f1의 주파수를 가지는 정현파를 곱하는 2차 주파수 혼합기와, 상기 2차 주파수 혼합기를 통과한 신호를 필터링하는 저대역통과필터와, 상기 저대역통과필터를 거쳐서 필터링된 신호를 디지털 처리하는 디지털 신호처리부를 구비하는 것을 특징으로 한다.  
       
     레이더 센서, 도플러, 주파수 혼합기, 대역통과필터, 생체신호

title_en: Portable urodynamics monitoring system using mobile device
title_ko: 모바일 장치를 이용한 휴대용 방광기능 검사 방법
abstract_en: A portable bladder monitoring method using a mobile device is provided to monitor a patient's bladder function in a remote place by using the mobile device such as a PDA(Personal Digital Assistant) or a mobile phone. A portable bladder monitoring method using a mobile device includes the steps of: collecting bio-signals generated during urine collection and urination of a bladder by a sensor unit; measuring data required for a bladder function test from the collected bio-signals by a signal pre-processing unit(20); allowing a user to monitor the measured data through the mobile device by a control unit(40) remotely; and storing and managing the measured data by a server unit(50). The bio-signals are a bladder pressure signal, an abdominal electromyogram signal, and an impedance signal inside the urethral canal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 휴대용 방광기능 검사 방법에 관한 것으로서, 자세하게는 모바일 장치와 중앙서버를 이용하여 방광기능을 검사하기 위한 휴대용 방광기능 검사 방법에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명은 방광의 축뇨와 배뇨 중 발생하는 생체 신호를 수집하는 단계; 상기 수집된 생체신호로부터 방광기능 검사에 필요한 데이터를 측정하는 단계; 상기 측정된 데이터를 모바일 장치를 이용하여 사용자가 원격 모니터링하는 단계; 상기 측정된 데이터를 수집하여 저장 및 관리하는 단계; 를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 휴대용 방광기능 검사 방법을 제공한다. 
     본 발명에 따르면, 휴대용 하드웨어를 제공하여 가정이나 병상에서 간단하게 방광기능 검사를 수행할 수 있으며, 자동으로 배뇨 시점을 정확하게 판정할 수 있고, 복압 측정을 위해 사용되는 항문 카테터를 사용할 필요가 없으며, 모바일 장치를 이용하여 방광기능 검사 과정에 대한 원격 관리할 수 있다는 장점이 있다. 
       
     방광기능 검사, 모바일 장치, 서버유닛, 복압, 휴대용
assignees: KIM KEO SIK;AN YANG SOO;SONG CHUL GUY

title_en: Buried object detector
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a buried object detector capable of reducing a burden of a worker carrying the detector.  <P>SOLUTION: This buried object detector 10 is attached with a sensor part 30 for detecting an underground buried object, in one end of a rod 20, and a signal processor 40 for inputting a detection value of the sensor part 30, in the other end of the rod 20. The buried object detector 10 is constituted to make a gravity center of the sensor part 30 and the signal processor 40 on the rod serve as a suspension support point. The suspension support point is coupled to a waist belt of a searching person via a joint part 60, so as to be supported in a waist of the searching person and to serve as the scanning center of the sensor part 30 for circular arc shaped scan.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Waistband with health management function
title_ko: 건강관리 기능을 가진 혁대
abstract_en: A belt having the health care function is provided to make the efficient management of the extracted health information possible. A belt having health care function comprises: a health information derivation module drawing the health related information from all kinds of the bio-signals; a buckle(13) performing the housing function of the derivation module; and a band(10) connected to one end of the buckle. The health information derivation module(14) comprises: a sensor module which senses all kinds of the bio-signals; and a processing extracting unit extracting the health related information from the digital signal which is obtained by the digital processing of the sensed bio-signal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지능형 혁대에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 건강관리 기능을 구비한 혁대에 관한 것이다. 
     본 명세서에서 개시하는 건강관리 기능을 구비한 지능형 혁대는 각종 생체신호로부터 건강 관련 정보를 도출하는 건강정보 도출 모듈; 상기 도출 모듈의 하우징 기능을 수행하는 버클; 및 상기 버클의 일단에 연결되는 띠를 포함하여 본 발명의 목적 및 기술적 과제를 달성하며, 상기 건강정보 도출 모듈은 상기 각종 생체신호를 감지하는 센서 모듈; 및 상기 감지된 생체신호를 디지털 처리하여 처리된 디지털 신호로부터 상기 건강 관련 정보를 추출하는 처리/추출부를 포함하는 것이 본 발명의 목적 및 기술적 과제를 달성함에 바람직하다. 
       
     건강관리 혁대(waistband for health management), 다이어트(diet), 생체신호(physiological signal), 넘어짐 감지(fall detection), 호흡(respiration), 심전도(electrocardiography), 체지방(body fat), 혈압(blood pressure), 체온(body temperature)
assignees: KOREA ELECTRONICS TELECOMM;CATHOLIC UNIV IND ACAD COOP

title_en: Power cable connector
title_ko: 지중배전선의 단자연결 커넥터
abstract_en: A terminal connector for an underground power distribution wire is provided to repair the underground power distribution wire through a through hole by moving an upper base to one side and exposing the through hole of a lower base, and deal with a fire in the pipe line by transmitting a warning signal through a wireless transmitter. An underground power distribution wire(2) passes through a base(10) vertically and buried in a pipe line. A terminal connector(4) is connected with a power distribution unit(3a) of a power distributor(3). The base includes a lower base(11) which is formed with a through hole(11a) and with a rail(11b), and an upper base(12) in which a roller is placed at a lower side. The power distribution unit and a case(3b) are installed at an upper side. The terminal connector includes a bracket(40), a connector body(50), a connecting terminal(60), a solenoid device(70), an upper base transfer device, a controller, a fire sensor(100), a wireless transmitter, and an input device. The connector body is downward pressed by a spring(51). The connecting terminal has a connecting socket(61) which is detached from the power distribution unit. The upper base transfer device has a screw shaft, a driving motor, and a transfer block. The fire sensor is connected with the controller.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지중에 매설된 배전선을 지속적으로 관리, 보수하여 합선이 발생되는 것을 방지할 수 있도록 된 지중배전선의 단자연결 커넥터에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명에 따른 지중배전선의 단자연결 커넥터는 관리자가 입력장치(120)를 이용하여 비밀번호 및 제어명령을 입력하면, 상기 솔레노이드장치(70)와 상부기대 이송장치(80)가 작동되어, 상기 접속단자(60)와 커넥터(50)의 연결을 해제함과 동시에 상부기대(12)를 일측으로 이동시켜 하부기대(11)의 관통공(11a)을 노출시키므로써, 관통공(11a)을 통해 관로(1) 내부의 배전선을 유지 보수할 수 있으며, 관로(1) 내부에 화제가 발생될 경우, 이를 감지하여 무선송신기(110)를 통해 경보신호를 무선송신하므로써, 관리자가 이를 수신하여 화재에 신속하게 대처할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Equipment for protection transmission tower
title_ko: 송전탑 보호 시설물
abstract_en: Equipment for protecting a transmission tower is provided to prevent the approach of a fire in advance by storing rainwater and to spray water in all directions when sensing a fire. Equipment for protecting a transmission tower includes a water storing tower(110), a water collecting tool(120), a pump, a discharge pipe(140), a valve controller(150), a water spray nozzle(170), a fire sensing sensor(180), a large amount water spray nozzle(190) and a wind direction switch. The water storing tanks are buried in the ground around a transmission tower(10). The large amount water spray nozzles are installed in four directions around the transmission tower, and are opened and closed by the control of the valve controller. The wind direction switch sends instructions to open and close the large amount water spray nozzle in a direction of wind coming in.
abstract_ko: 빗물을 받아 저장해 놓고, 송전탑의 주변에서 산불을 감지하면 저장된 물을 사방으로 뿌려주도록 하여 산불의 접근을 미리 막을 수 있으며, 바람이 불어오는 방향으로 대량살수를 하도록 하여 산불을 진압할 수 있는 송전탑 보호 시설물이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 송전탑 보호 시설물은 송전탑주변 지중에 매립되는 저수조와, 저수조로 빗물을 받아 유입시키는 집수구와, 저수조의 물을 지면위로 퍼올리는 펌프 및 배출관과, 배출관이 연결되는 밸브제어기와, 송전탑주변에 다량으로 골고루 설치되면서 밸브제어기의 제어에 의해 개폐되는 살수노즐과, 송전탑의 주변에 설치되어 산불을 감지하여 밸브제어기를 작동시키는 화재감지센서를 포함한다. 그리고 송전탑주변 네방향에 설치되면서 밸브제어기의 제어에 의해 어느 하나가 개폐되는 대량살수노즐과, 풍향을 계산하여 바람이 불어오는 방향의 대량살수노즐을 개폐시키도록 지시하는 풍향스위치가 더 포함될 수 있다.

title_en: Antenna for underground search radar
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To rapidly and accurately detect a three dimensional position of an underground buried object.  <P>SOLUTION: Three sets of pairs of transmitting-receiving antenna elements 1a, 1b; 1c1, 1c2; 1d1, 1d2 are arranged in a plurality of partial storage spaces formed in a conductive antenna housing 2. In the antenna elements, pairs of conductors 5a, 5b, 5cl, 5c2, 5d1, 5d2, 6a, 6b, 6c1, 6c2, 6d1, 6d2 are arranged in a straight line, and a dipole antenna is formed. The conductor has a length of λ/2 when a wavelength is λ, and the pair of the antenna elements 1a and 1b is arranged to be shifted by λ/2 in a longitudinal direction of the conductors from the sets of the antenna elements 1cl, 1c2; 1d1, 1d2. A distance of the underground buried object, that is, the position thereof can be detected based on the time difference between a pulse-like transmitting signal applied to the sets of the transmitting antenna elements 1a, 1c1, 1d1 and a receiving signal obtained from the sets of the receiving antenna elements 1b, 1c2, 1d2.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Garment for measuring physiological signals and method of fabricating the same
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정용 의복 및 그 제조 방법
abstract_en: A garment for measuring physiological signals and a method for manufacturing the same are provided to reduce distortion and noise of the measured physiological signals due to wrinkle and stretch thereof even in wearer's intensive exercise. A garment(10) for measuring physiological signals includes an electrode sensor, a signal connection line(300), a snap structure, and a measuring device. The electrode sensor is coupled with an inner surface of the garment as one body to contact the skin and senses the physiological signals. The signal connection line is connected to the electrode sensor. The snap structure is electrically connected to the snap structure. The measuring device is mounted on the snap structure to measure the physiological signals. The signal connection line has elasticity.
abstract_ko:
생체 신호 측정용 의복을 제공한다. 이 의복은 피부 표면과 접촉되도록 의복의 내부면에 일체로 결합되어 생체 신호를 감지하는 적어도 하나의 전극 센서, 전극 센서로부터 감지된 생체 신호를 전송하되 의복의 내부면에 마감 처리된 신호 연결선, 신호 연결선과 전기적으로 연결되되 전극 센서와 중첩되지 않는 의복의 부위에 일체로 결합되는 스냅 구조물 및 스냅 구조물에 장착되어 생체 신호를 측정하는 측정기를 포함한다. 신호 연결선은 신축성을 갖는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
       
     의복, 생체 신호, 전극 센서, 전도성 실, 연결 스냅

title_en: Method for detecting concealed target life trace and concealed target detection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the radar technology, in particular to the hidden target detection and recognition technology. The invention discloses a method for detecting a hidden living target by utilizing the radar technology and a detection device. The hidden target detection device of the invention is composed of a microwave radar, and is characterized in that the microwave radar has two different modes: a moving target detection mode and a life sign detection mode. The method and the detection device have the advantages that the detection and the positioning of the hidden target are carried out by utilizing the penetrability of the microwave. The accurate detection of the motion state of the hidden target can be carried out, the detection and the recognition of the life signs of a static target can also be carried out, thereby being able to be widely applied in fight against terrorism, disaster relief and other fields.

title_en: Wavelength division sensing method and apparatus for doppler radar vital sign monitoring and mechanical vibration monitoring
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention provide a method and a radar system incorporating multiple carrier wavelengths. A multi-carrier radar method and system according to the present invention can be used to realize sensing of complex pattern vibrations using a wavelength division sensing technique.

title_en: Connecting structure between sheath tube for communication cable and side wall of handhole
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a connecting structure between a sheath tube and a side wall of a handhole that prevents a sheath tube from protruding into a handhole together with a fixing plate or prevents a sheath tube from being detached from a sleeve while allowing axial thermal-expansion/contraction of a sheath tube and allowing movement of a sheath tube when an earthquake occurs, and a joint used for the connection.  <P>SOLUTION: The connecting structure is a connecting structure between a sheath tube 2 inserted with a communication cable and a side wall 4a of a handhole 4 buried in the ground. A sleeve 13 is fixed onto the side wall 4a of the handhole 4 while the end of the sheath tube 2 is connected to the sleeve 13 via a joint 1. The joint 1 has a first tube 11 and a second tube 12 axially movably fitted to the first tube 11. A coil spring 10 is externally fitted to the first tube 11 and the second tube 12. One end of the coil spring 10 is fixed to the first tube 11 while the other end of the coil spring 10 is fixed to the second tube 12.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Connection structure of the electric cable
title_ko: 지중배전용 전선보호관 이음구조
abstract_en: A connection structure of a wire protection tube for an underground distribution line is provided to prevent the fire from spreading along an underground pipe by cutting off electrical connection of a switchboard when the firs occurs in the switchboard or a switchboard case due to an electric leakage or arson. A switchboard case(10) is installed on the ground. A switchboard(20) is installed in the switchboard case. An underground pipe(30) made of an insulation material is buried under the ground and is connected to the bottom of the switchboard. A switchboard power supply line(40) is composed of an active wire and a neutral wire and is arranged inside the underground pipe. An external power supply line(50) is composed of the active wire and the neutral wire and is installed in the underground pipe. A connection unit(60) electrically interconnects the active wires of the switchboard power supply line and the external power supply line or the neutral wires of the switchboard power supply line and the external power supply line. A disconnection unit(70) includes a striking part of the fire retarding material which seals the underground pipe and is installed in a piston. A fire sensor(80) is installed at the switchboard case and senses the fire of the switchboard. A control unit(90) receives the fire signal from the fire sensor and controls the drive motor of the disconnection unit. An alarm unit(100) is controlled by the control unit and outputs the fire state to the outside.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지중배전용 전선보호관 이음구조에 관한 것으로, 지면에 설치되는 배전반케이스(10)와; 배전반케이스(10)에 내설되는 배전반(20)과; 지중에 매설되어, 배전반케이스(10)의 저면에 연통되는 절연재질의 지중배관(30)과; 활선(41)과 중성선(42)으로 구성되어, 지중배관(30) 내부에 배치되는 배전반전력공급선(40)과; 활선(51)과 중성선(52)으로 구성되어, 지중배관(30)에 내설되는 외부전력공급선(50)과; 중심부에 절개홈(61)을 갖추고서, 배전반전력공급선(40)을 구성하는 활선(41)과 외부전력공급선을 구성하는 활선(51)을 전기적으로 상호연결하거나, 배전반전력공급선(40)을 구성하는 중성선(42)과 외부전력공급선을 구성하는 중성선(42)을 전기적으로 상호연결하는 "一" 자 형태의 연결대(60)와; 지중배관(30)의 외면에 설치되어, 지중에 매설되는 케이스(71)와, 지중배관(30)의 축 방향과 90도로 교차하는 방향으로 직선왕복이동가능하게 내설되는 피스톤(72)과, 피스톤(72)에 설치되어 연결대(60)를 절단하면서 지중배관(30)을 밀폐하는 난연재의 타격부(73)와, 케이스(71)에 내설되어 피스톤(72)을 일방향으로 탄발지지하는 스프링(74)과, 와이어(W)를 매개로 피스톤(72)에 연결되는 권취드럼(75a)과 권취드럼(75a)을 구동하는 구동모터(75b)를 갖추고서 케이스(71)에 설치되어 피스톤(72)의 동작을 제어하는 권취기구(75)를 포함하는 차단기구(70)와; 배전반케이스(10)에 설치되어, 배전반(20)의 화재를 감지하는 화재감지센서(80)와; 화재감지센서(80)로부터의 화재신호를 입력받아 차단기구(70)의 구동모터(75b)를 작동제어하는 제어유닛(90)과; 제어유닛(90)에 의해 작동제어되어 화재상태를 외부로 출력하는 경보장치(100)로 이루어져, 지중배관을 따라 불길이 번져가지 않으며, 화재의 발생을 관리자가 즉각 알 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Sensor for detecting buried object
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a sensor for detecting a buried object of complex-type enhancing detection sensitivity of a magnetic sensor.  <P>SOLUTION: The sensor 10 includes a magnetic sensor 12 and a radio-frequency sensor 14, consisting of a receiving section 16 and a transmitting section 18, preparing a plurality of antenna elements constituting the radio frequency sensor 14 on the periphery of the receiving section 16 and moreover, preparing the transmitting section 18 on a periphery of the radio-frequency sensor 14 centered on the receiving section 16. The receiving section 16 is made into a circular form by combining a pair of semicircular coils 20 symmetrically and forms the directions of coil pattern of the coil 20 which is to be mutually reversed.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Device to cut the underground line for the distributing board
title_ko: 특고압 전용 지상배전반 접속용 지중배전선 차단장치
abstract_en: An underground line interruption device for connecting a distribution board for a high voltage is provided to prevent the fire from being spread to the distribution board. A distribution board case(10) is installed on the ground. A distribution board(20) is embed in the distribution board case. An underground tube(30) made of an insulation material is buried under the ground and is connected to the bottom of the distribution board case. A distribution board power supply line(40) is composed of an active line and a neutral line and is arranged inside the underground tube. An external power supply line(50) is composed of the active line and the neutral line and is embedded in the underground tube. A conductive connection bar(60) is embedded in the underground tube through a support stand and connects the active line of the distribution board power supply line and the active line of the external power supply line mutually or connects the neutral line of the distribution board power supply line and the neutral line of the external power supply line mutually. An interruption device is installed in an outer portion of the underground tube and includes a case, a piston reciprocating linearly at right angles to the axial direction of the underground tube, a hitting part with a fire-retardant sealing the underground tube, a spring elastically supporting the piston, and a solenoid controlling the operation of the piston. A fire sensor(80) is installed in the distribution board case, and senses the fire of the distribution board. A control unit(90) receives a fire signal from the fire sensor is and control the operation of the solenoid. An alarm device(100) is controlled by the control unit and outputs the firing state to the outside.

title_en: Ubiquitous network system enabling life-saving and emergency reporting services based on lighting supervisory system
title_ko: 도시조명 관리시스템을 기반으로 인명구조 및 구급 신고가 가능한 유비쿼터스 방식의 네트워크 시스템
abstract_en: The invention is a network system for emergency reporting services that enables remote checking of ON/OFF states in lighting installations, comprising: a terminal with a communication module for transmitting radio frequency signals; a lighting supervisory terminal including a light emitting device; a module for controlling the light emitting device; a module for transmission/receipt of control signals; and a control/supervision server including a transmission/receiving module for receiving lighting information data and signal strength data; a location tracking module for tracking location of the portable terminal by using the lighting information data and the received signal strength data, a lighting supervisory module for controlling/supervising the lighting supervisory terminal, and a lighting location information DB for storing data about lighting locations. In one embodiment, the portable terminal comprises a detecting sensor for measuring and detecting a vital sign of a target person and a control module that combines data about the transmitted vital signal from the detecting sensor with an input ID to the portable terminal, thereby generating result data and sending the result data to the communication module to be sent; and the control and supervisory server further includes a user information DB.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 중앙 관제시스템을 통해 도시조명 시설물의 ON/OFF 및 고장 여부에 대한 확인을 원격에서 제어 관리하는 한편, 구급 및 응급이 요청되는 주민에 대한 신속한 구조와 응급활동을 수행할 수 있도록 효율적인 신고 환경을 구축하는 도시조명 관리시스템을 기반으로 인명구조 및 구급 신고가 가능한 유비쿼터스 방식의 네트워크 시스템에 관한 것으로, 조명등 관리단말기와 통신하는 휴대단말기의 발신 ID를 확인하여 사용자정보DB에서 대상자의 정보를 검색한 후 유관기관의 통신망에 접속 통신하면서 대상자의 추적된 위치와 정보를 전송하도록 된 것이다
assignees: JE CHEON CITY;ROADBANK CO LTD;JANG YONG HAK;AN YOUNG SOOK

title_en: Intelligent earthquake information detector
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent earthquake information detector which is composed of a seeker 1, earthquake sensors 2, universal connectors 3, connection cables 4 and an earthquake information processor 5; wherein, the numbers of the earthquake sensors 2, the universal couplings 3 and the connection cables 4 are determined according to a plurality of units as required to meet the requirements of detection depth and distance. The seeker 1 is made of hard materials to facilitate the detector to be put into a proper place in a drill hole or a crack under the coordination of the universal connectors. The connection cables are used for transmitting the earthquake information collected by all the earthquake sensors to the earthquake information processor 5 which sends out earthquake forecast after carrying out the analysis and judgment or sends the earthquake information to other devices through a network interface. In earthquake-prone areas, the intelligent earthquake information detector can be buried into foundation together with ground piles to detect and forecast the occurrence of earthquake at any moment, and thereby further reducing the loss of people lives and properties.

title_en: Integration energy-conserving system for solar construction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a solar building integrated energy-saving system, comprising a solar photovoltaic generation and energy storage system, an intelligent power control system, energy-saving lighting and various electrical devices, a solar photo-thermal water heating system, a geothermal heat exchange system, a heat pump unit, a fresh air conditioning system, a fire-fighting and industrial and domestic water storage system, a hot water tank, various water-consuming devices, a floor radiation heating system, a membrane separation water treatment and reuse system, a rainwater and waste water collection system and a sewage flushing and discharging system. The solar photovoltaic generation and energy storage system supplies all the power needed by the building; the solar photo-thermal water heating system is arranged on the top layer of the building or on the solar-oriented wall surface; the geothermal heat exchange system is buried underground; a rainwater and waste water collection tank is arranged on the ground or in the subterranean layer of the building to collect rain water and waste water; and the collected water is treated through the membrane separation water treatment and reuse system and supplied for the building to use. The remaining systems and various water-consuming or electrical devices as well as the electric cables are arranged inside the building and integrated with the building.

title_en: Earthquake-proof, traffic safety full automatic alarm schoolbag, knapsack
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an earthquake resistant schoolbag and a dorsal sac which can automatically give an alarm about traffic safety and are used as earthquake resistance and assistance equipment and traffic safety protection equipment, and discloses an earthquake resistance and head protecting rubber plate device fixed on the schoolbag. The device can prevent injuries to students in traffic accidents, and help prevent the heads of the students from being injured or alleviate the injuries in an earthquake, and after the earthquake, the device can help rescuers rescue and the students buried in ruins perform self rescue or passively cry for help by sending a distress signal through the reflection of light and acoustic control, thus reducing the death toll.

title_en: Method and system for monitoring vital body signs of a seated person
title_ko: 사람의 생체 사인들을 모니터링하기 위한 디바이스
abstract_en: A method comprising the step of using a plurality of doppler radars disposed on the seat belt or integrated into the seat belt for monitoring vital body signs of a person seated in a seat of a motor vehicle is disclosed. The disclosed method unobtrusively monitors vital body signs like heart rate and respiration of the person seated in the motor vehicle. A number of safety applications as well as wellness applications can be enabled. Examples are detection of momentary sleep of the driver, vital sign monitoring in case of an accident as well as relaxation exercise using biofeedback to reduce stress for drivers.
abstract_ko: 좌석 벨트 상에 배치되거나 좌석 벨트 내에 통합된 복수의 도플러 레이더들을 사용하여 자동차의 좌석에 착석한 사람의 생체 사인들을 모니터링하기 위한 단계를 포함하는 방법이 개시되어 있다. 개시된 방법은 자동차에 착석한 사람의 심박수 및 호흡과 같은 생체 사인들을 거슬리지 않게 모니터링한다. 다수의 안전 애플리케이션들 뿐만 아니라, 건강관리 애플리케이션(wellness application)들이 가능해질 수 있다. 예들은 운전자의 순간적인 졸음의 검출, 사고의 경우에 생체 사인 모니터링 뿐만 아니라, 운전자들에 대한 스트레스를 감소시키기 위한 바이오피드백을 사용하는 이완 운동이다.
assignees: KONINKL PHILIPS ELECTRONICS NV;PHILIPS INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

title_en: Reconfigurable portable locator employing multiple sensor array having flexible nested orthogonal antennas
abstract_en: A portable locator for detecting a buried object characterized by an electromagnetic (EM) field emission employing three-dimensional (3D) sensor arrays each having three substantially-identical EM field sensors disposed on a flexible annular wall having a radial centroid defining a sensing axis. The flexible annular sensors are retained in substantial concentricity with the corresponding sensing axes disposed in substantial mutual orthogonality. A pair of 3D sensor arrays disposed on a first axis substantially orthogonal to a second axis defined by another pair of EM field sensors each having a sensing axis disposed along the second axis. The locator introduces a user-reconfigurable user interface (UI) employing a “sticky” ratcheting audio UI and a hollow hinge assembly for redisposing the sensor assembly from an operating to a storage disposition.

title_en: Wireless remote life monitoring paging instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless remote life monitoring paging instrument, comprising a life information processing part, a control part, a communication part and a display part for sound, pictures and texts. A digital body temperature sensor 101, a pulse detection amplifying circuit 102 and a storage 103 are respectively connected with an input/output port of a microprocessor 120; a red rescue key 123, an orange rescue key 124, a yellow rescue key 125, a green safe key 126 and a start key 127 are respectively connected with the input port of the microprocessor 120; a wireless communication module 121 and a USB interface 122 are respectively connected with the input/output port of the microprocessor 120; and a loudspeaker and a driving circuit 110 thereof, a liquid crystal display 111 and a calendar clock chip 112 are respectively connected with the input/output port of the microprocessor 120. The wireless remote life monitoring paging instrument of the invention is mainly used for carrying out emergency rescue on victims who suffer natural disasters such as earthquake and the like, and emergent accidents of mine disasters, traffic accidents and the like, can receive 'finding' signals and can automatically send 'distress call' messages of vital signs and the like.

title_en: Imaging system using infrared light
abstract_en: An imaging system is disclosed for imaging buried structure, typically vasculature, below the surface of an object which can be skin, fat deposits, or other material and for projecting an image of the buried structure onto the surface of the object. Scanning lasers are used both to illuminate the object and to project an image onto it. One or more photodiodes measure the intensity of scattered and reflected light to create an image in conjunction with one or more of the scanning lasers.
assignees: LUMINETX CORP;ZEMAN HERBERT D;LOVHOIDEN GUNNAR;BERRYHILL JEFF D

title_en: Detection device for vital signs
abstract_en: The invention relates to a detection device (1) for vital signs, comprising a sensor (2) and an energy supply module (3), wherein the sensor (2) has at least one detection means (5, 6, 7, 8), which is designed to detect a vital sign from the group consisting of the oxygen content of the blood, body temperature, skin moisture, conductivity of the skin, and pulse, and furthermore comprises a first (10) communication module, wherein the energy supply module (3) has a second communication module (20) and an energy source (21), and wherein a wireless communication connection (4) exists between the first (10) and second communication module (20), wherein the sensor (2) is configured as an elastically restorably deformable thin-film sensor, and the communication connection (4) is configured for transmitting energy and measured values, or measurement data.

title_en: Method for melting snow and ice based on carbon fiber-glass fiber composite braiding net
abstract_en: The invention discloses a snow-ice melting method based on carbon-glass fiber composite woven nets, which belongs to the field of transportation and disaster prevention. The method is characterized in that a thermal insulating layer, a heat conducting layer, a carbon-glass fiber composite woven net subjected to electric insulation and sand sticking treatment, and another heat conducting layer are laid in turn on a base layer of a to-be-heated body; a temperature measurement element is buried in a surface layer of the to-be-heated body; a carbon fiber bundle heating element is connected to a controllable power source with protection function in a series parallel connection mode by use of electric conducting silver colloid and a conductor; and according to surface layer temperature of the to-be-heated body, surface wind speed, the thickness of snow cover and ice, air temperature and the expected time for melting snow and ice, a digital PID temperature control system optimizes and adjusts the control parameters of the system and regulates heating power. The method has the advantages of high construction speed, uniform fast heating, stable performance, long life span, low cost and the like, plays a role in preventing cracking and reinforcing, and is an ideal snow-ice melting method for pavement, bridges and other facilities.

title_en: System and methods for vital sign estimation from passive thermal video
abstract_en: A system for measuring a pulse and respiratory rate from passive thermal video includes contour segmentation and tracking, clustering of informative pixels of interests, and robust dominant frequency component estimation. Contour segmentation is used to locate a blood vessel region to measure, after which all pixels in the nearby region are aligned across frames based on the segmentation's position, and scale in each frame. Spatial filtering is then performed to remove noise not related to heart beat and then non-linear filtering is performed on the temporal signal corresponding to each aligned pixel. The signal spectrum of each pixel is then feed to a clustering algorithm for outlier removal. Pixels in the largest cluster are then used to vote for the dominant frequency, and the median of the dominant frequency is output as the pulse rate.

title_en: A portable medical eqiupment for measuring physiological signal
title_ko: 휴대가 가능한 생체신호측정용 탈부착식 의료장비
abstract_en: A portable medical device for measuring a physiological signal is provided to perform medial treatment by measuring the physiological signal quickly in an emergency situation. A portable medical device(100) includes a measuring device(20), a display device(40), and a mounting device(60). The measuring device includes a measuring module(22) and a communication module(24). The measuring module is composed of a sensor for measuring the physiological signal. The communication module transmits the physiological signal measured in the measuring module. The display device includes the communication module and a monitor. The communication module transmits and receives the physiological signal information and medical information from and to the communication module and a medical center in a remote place. The monitor displays the physiological signal information and the medical information. The measuring device and the display device are detachably mounted in the mounting device.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 응급처치를 요하는 환자의 현재 신체상태를 측정하기 위한 휴대가 가능한 생체신호측정용 탈부착식 의료장비를 제공한다. 이와 같은 휴대가 가능한 생체신호측정용 탈부착식 의료장비는 신체의 각종 생체신호를 측정하는 측정기구와, 이를 모니터링하는 디스플레이기구들이 휴대용으로 이루어져 구급차량이나 휴대용 가방 등에 간편하게 탈부착될 수 있도록 함으로써 긴급한 상황이나 일반적인 의료장비의 설치 및 사용이 어려운 장소에서도 신속하게 생체신호를 측정하여 효과적인 의료 조치를 행할 수 있게 된다. 본 발명에 따른 휴대가 가능한 생체신호측정용 탈부착식 의료장비는 신체의 생체신호가 측정되는 센서로 이루어진 측정모듈과, 상기 측정모듈로부터 생체신호를 전달받아 이를 송신하는 통신모듈이 케이싱에 설치되어 이루어지는 측정기구와; 측정기구의 통신모듈 및 원격지의 의료기관과 유무선으로 연결되어 생체신호 정보 및 의료정보를 송수신하는 통신모듈과, 통신모듈과 연결되어 생체신호 정보 및 의료정보를 표시하게 되는 모니터가 케이싱에 설치되어 이루어지는 디스플레이기구 및; 일측이 개방된 공간부가 측정기구의 케이싱과 디스플레이기구의 케이싱에 대응되게 각각 형성되어  측정기구 및 상기 디스플레이기구가 각각 탈부착이 가능하게 장착되는 장착기구를; 포함하여 이루어진다. 이와 같은 휴대가 가능한 생체신호측정용 탈부착식 의료장비에서 장착기구의 공간부 측면을 이루는 고정면과, 장착기구의 고정면에 대응되는 측정기구의 케이싱 외측면 및 디스플레이기구의 케이싱 외측면에는 서로 요철관계를 이루며 착탈되는 고정구가 각 각 설치되어 고정구에 의해 측정기구와 디스플레이기구가 장착기구에 고정되게 된다.

title_en: Living body information executive system that ubiquitous sensor network
title_ko: 무선센서네트워크를 이용한 생체정보 관리시스템
abstract_en: A living body information management system by using wireless sensor network is provided to grasp a location of a target person in an occurrence of an emergency situation to take an immediate action to the emergency situation. A portable living body information terminal(101) is adhered to a body of a person, measures bio-information in a constant time interval, and transmits the bio-information with identification code through a wireless sensor network(102). A router(103) wirelessly receives the bio-information obtained in the portable living body information terminal. A web server(104) manages the router location information, and manages the bio-information transmitted from the router. An information server(105) stores the router location information and bio-information. A client transmits a data to a monitoring system which displays a collected bio-information and location information. An information transmitting server(108) converts the set up designated time interval bio- information into the HL7 standard among the bio-information stored in the information server. The converted information is transmitted to an external system(109).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 무선센서네트워크를 이용한 생체정보 관리시스템에 관한 것으로, 대상자의 몸에 부착하여 생체정보를 일정 시간 간격으로 계측하고, 상기 생체정보를 대상자별 식별코드와 연계하여 무선센서네트워크 통신을 이용하여 전송하는 휴대형 무선센서네트워크 생체정보 단말기; 소정 공간별 설치되고, 상기휴대형 무선센서네트워크 생체정보 단말기에서 취득된 생체정보를 무선 수신하는 라우터; 상기 식별코드별 대상자 정보 및 상기 라우터별 위치정보가 저장되고, 상기 라우터에서 전송된 생체정보를 수집 및 저장하는 정보서버; 상기 정보서버에 수집된 생체정보 및 상기 대상자별 위치정보를 표시하는 모니터링 시스템부; 상기 정보서버에 저장된 생체정보 중 설정된 소정 시간 간격별 생체정보를 HL7 표준으로 변환하여 외부 시스템(전자의무기록 시스템 또는 처방전달시스템 등)으로 전송하는 정보 전송 서버로 구성된 무선센서네트워크를 이용한 생체정보 관리시스템에 관한 것이다.
