title_en: Combined infrared displacement sensor network node for monitoring mountain massif coast
abstract_en: The invention discloses a joined infrared displacement sensor network node for monitoring landslide, and relates to a slope displacement sensor for monitoring landslide in real time. The structure of the joined infrared displacement sensor network node combined according to a triangle comprises the following: the joined infrared displacement sensor network node consists of a primary node (10), a first secondary node (20) and a second secondary node (30) which are arranged on vertexes of the locked monitoring triangle respectively. The structure of the joined infrared displacement sensor network node combined according to a quadrangle comprises the following: the joined infrared displacement sensor network node consists of a primary node (10), a first secondary node (20), a second secondary node (30) and a third secondary node (40) which are arranged on vertexes of the locked monitoring quadrangle respectively. The joined infrared displacement sensor network node can reliably monitor lateral displacement, longitudinal displacement, altitude difference three-dimensional displacement and collapse information of a slope. When the sensing nodes are buried by gliding mass, loss information of the buried sensing nodes can also be accurately calculated, so that the aim of objectively identifying and evaluating position, state and level of landslide and collapse is achieved. The joined infrared displacement sensor network node has the advantages of low price, high sensitivity, flexible radio-frequency control and small power consumption, and meets the characteristic requirements of the sensing nodes.

title_en: Life detecting device based on pseudocode phase-modulated continuous wave system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection device based on pseudocode phase modulation continuous wave system. The devices comprises the following steps: performing phase modulation on intermediate frequency signal by applying fake random encoded signal, then changing wave to microwave and amplify the microwave by power, radiated by transmitting antenna. Encoded signal entering into receiving antenna is amplified by low noise, two mixing and wave filtering and switched into stimulation baseband signal, translated into digital signal by high speed sampling, the digital signal is performed clutter cancellation, distance gate correlation, digital filtering by applying large-scale FPGA device, performs FFT switch in high speed DSP processor and adjudged, the result of judgment will be sent to terminal to display. The detection device can be used for discovering people located in the wall body or other barrier, and can measure the distance between people and detection device, provides convenience for search, rescue, thus the device has stronger anti-clutter and anti-background interference capability.

title_en: Method for extracting images of vascular structure and blood flow from image sequences
abstract_en: Periodic biological functions and their related anatomy that cannot be seen in image sequences using typical means, can nonetheless be made visible by demodulating the image sequence according to the timing of that biological function using the described method. In particular, vascular structure and the function of that structure becomes observable when demodulated according to the patient's heart beat. This method suppresses the effects of thermal variations across the anatomy, and of severe scattering loss from buried tissues, that limit current thermographic (heat imaging) methods. It also measures localized changes in the wave front amplitude, shape, and phase, which are expected to prove useful for disease diagnosis and biometry.

title_en: Body composition, circulation, and vital signs monitor and method
abstract_en: The invented non-invasive vital signs monitor is in a flexible, nominally flat planar form having integral gel electrodes, a sticky-back rear surface, an internal flex circuit capable of sensing, recording and playing out several minutes of the most recently acquired ECG waveform data and a front surface that includes an outplay port. The invented non-invasive body composition ‘risk’ monitor includes a measurement device for monitoring one or more variables including body fluid mass, dehydration, respiratory rate, blood pressure, bio-impedance, cardiography such as cardiac output, and body conformation parameters. The risk monitor may be provided in a lightweight carrying case into which the vital signs monitor plugs. Finally, a lightweight portable probe or transducer containing a transmissive or reflective electro-optical emitter and receptor in the infrared spectrum is fitted on a subject's finger or toe. Associated electronics energize and monitor the probe, detect cardio-rhythmic fluctuations therefrom, and process digital data over a prescribed window to produce a non-invasive, qualitative or quantitative measure of the subject's circulation. In accordance with one embodiment of the invention, a simple tri-color LED array is used to indicate the subject's circulation as being normal, reduced, or borderline. Thus the vital signs, bio-impedance, and circulation monitors may be independent or they may be integrated into one portable, non-invasive device that can concurrently monitor and locally display or remotely convey important patient data including circulation data to a local subject or physician or to/from a remote patient medical data center via wireless telemetry for oversight, treatment and possible intervention by a remote physician.
assignees: SEMLER HERBERT J;BENZ PHILIP;MILLS GARY;MCNAMES JAMES

title_en: Wireless remote life monitoring paging instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wireless remote life monitoring pager which comprises a life information processing part, a control part, a communication part and a sound and image display part. A digital body temperature sensor 101, a pulse detection amplifying module 102 and a memory 103 are respectively connected with an input interface and an output interface of a microprocessor 120; a red SOS key 123, an orange SOS key 124, a yellow SOS key 125, a green safe key 126 and a starting key 127 are respectively connected with an input port of the microprocessor 120; a wireless communication module 121 and a USB interface 122 are respectively connected with the input interface and the output interface of the microprocessor 120; and a loudspeaker, a driving circuit 110, a liquid crystal display 111 and a calendar clock chip 112 are respectively connected with the input interface and the output interface of the microprocessor 120. The utility model is mainly used for the emergency relief of survivors in natural disasters such as earthquake and the like and emergency accidents such as mine disasters, traffic accidents and the like. The wireless remote life monitoring pager can receive ''finding'' signals, and can automatically send ''SOS'' information of physical life sign and the like.

title_en: Combined type buried object surveying apparatus
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a compact and convenient surveying apparatus by reducing mutual effect between both sensors without increasing the distance between a coil sensor and an antenna sensor.  <P>SOLUTION: This combined type buried object surveying apparatus 6 has both the coil sensors 141 through 147 by an electromagnetic induction method and antenna sensors 441 and 442 by an electromagnetic wave method. The operating frequency band of the coil sensors is separated from the operating frequency band of the antenna sensors, and the coil sensors are covered with electric wave absorber effectively acting in the operating frequency band of the antenna sensors.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Emergency SOS device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency SOS device. Infrared lights (6) are arranged on a shell (1) in various directions, and a chargeable battery (2) and a radio (9) are arranged inside the shell (1), and infrared lights (6) are arranged at one end of the shell (1), and a whistle is arranged at the other end thereof; the chargeable battery (2), the radio (9), a switch (7), infrared lights (6) and an external charging port (8) are connected with a control device (3). The utility model provides a small device for overcoming the deficiency that buried people cannot communicate with the outside; after being buried, since the emergency SOS device can illuminate, people can ask for help by blowing the whistle and acquire information from the outside through the radio, thus increasing the probability of being detected by an external life detecting instrument through infrared information and the opportunity to be saved; and the emergency SOS device can be used in the earthquake-prone area.

title_en: Mobile device for physiological sensing
title_ko: 생체 신호 계측용 휴대용 장치
abstract_en: A mobile device for measuring a bio-signal is provided to improve convenience of bio-signal measurement by measuring a bio-signal of one hand or both hands according to necessary. A mobile device for measuring a bio-signal includes a sensing part(20), a power supply part(60), an operation display lamp(70), and a wireless communication part. The sensing part has a grip groove for gripping a thumb. The sensing part measures a bio-signal. The sensing part includes a first sensor(30), a second sensor(40), and a third sensor(50). The first sensor is contacted with an end part of a thumb in order to measure a heart rate. The second sensor is contacted with a palm in order to measure a skin conductance. The third sensor measures a body temperature. The power supply part is formed with a button type. The operation display lamp displays an operation state of the sensing part. The wireless communication part transmits a measured result of the bio-signal to outside.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 생체 신호 계측용 휴대용 장치에 관한 것이다. 보다 상세하게는 착용하지 않고 필요시에 취부 하여 생체 신호를 계측하는 것이 가능한 생체 신호 계측용 휴대용 장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Method and device for monitoring and dynamically positioning vital signs in real time
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for monitoring and dynamically positioning vital signs in real time. The device comprises a part for detecting, processing and sending vital sign information of a monitored person and a part for positioning the vital sign information; the vital signs of a person are detected and acquired by a pulse sensor, a temperature sensor and a body movement sensor, is processed by an A/D conversion module, and then is sent out by a wireless sending module; and the part for positioning the vital sign information is provided with a wireless receiving module for receiving the vital sign information, a remote data communication module, a GPS global positioning information receiving module, a mobile communication GSM/3G module and a wireless local area network (WLAN) module to form a comprehensively-positioning system, and a control unit controls a positioning calculation unit to calculate the positioning. The method and the device have the following steps: (1) the position and the vital sign information of the monitored person can be acquired at the same time for the benefit of nursing, monitoring, searching and rescuing special crowds; and (2) the device has modularized design for the convenience of carrying.

title_en: A detection method of sleepiness
title_ko: 졸음 감지방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A detection method of sleepiness is provided to compensate noises signal due to an action of a body by using a Doppler radar mode and an optical system mode of using the light source / optical detector, so extracting a heartbeat and a respiratory signal accurately. CONSTITUTION: In a detection method of sleepiness, in a Doppler radar and the optical system mode of using the light source / optical detector, each detection signal is applied to a amplifier(2000). Noises are removed from the detection signal and the detection signal is amplified. The output signal is applied to a central processing unit(3000) to perform signal processing of the output signal and mix processed signal. If a value of subtraction of a counted valued before two minutes and a counted valued before one minute is between 2~10 pr -2 ~-10 and this value is detected twice or ten times, an alarm and vibration is outputted through a output unit(4000).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 졸음 감지방법에 관한 것으로, 특히 신체의 움직임 하에서도 심장박동 검출이 가능하도록 도플러 레이더의 원리를 이용한 방식과 광원/광검출기를 이용한 광학계 방식을 혼용하여 사용함으로써 대상 신체에 접촉함이 없이 심장박동 및 호흡의 신호를 검출하는 제1 단계와; 상기 도플러 레이더의 원리를 이용한 방식과 광원/광검출기를 이용한 광학계 방식에서의 각 상기 검출 신호를 각각의 증폭부에 인가하여 신호 잡음을 제거하고 증폭하는 제2 단계와; 상기 제2 단계의 출력 신호를 각각 중앙처리부에 인가하여 신호처리 및 상기 신호처리된 각 신호를 합성하는 제3 단계; 및 상기 제3 단계에서 출력된 출력 값을 카운트하고, 상기 출력 값을 모니터링한 과거 2분전의 상기 카운트 값에 과거 1분전의 상기 카운트 값을 차감한 값이 2 내지 10 범위 또는 -2 내지 -10 범위에 있고, 상기 2 내지 10 범위 또는 -2 내지 -10 범위의 값이 시간이 흐름에 따라 동일 상기 범위 권내를 연속적으로 2번 내지 10번 검출되면, 출력부를 통해 경보음이나 멘트 또는 진동을 출력하는 제4 단계;로 이루어진 것을 특징으로 하는 졸음 감지방법에 관한 것이다. 
      따라서, 본 발명은 사용자가 졸림 현상이 올 때 심박수가 느려지고 호흡수가 느려지는 현상을 상기 심박센서로 감지하고 졸음이 올 때 경보 또는 진동을 발생하여 자각증상을 회복시켜 졸음 운전에 대한 사고 예방하는 이점이 있다.  
       
     	심박, 생체신호, 도플러, 광학계

title_en: Underground line stopper
title_ko: 지중매설형 배전 전선 스토퍼
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An underground installation power distribution electrical wire stopper is provided, which enables to stably prepare the earthquake by achieving supporting force and buffer force. CONSTITUTION: An underground installation power distribution electrical wire stopper includes an underground piping of the square pipe shape, a connector(100), and a supporting apparatus(200). The underground piping is formed as follows. The support stand receiving part is formed upward and downward along the inner surface. The penetration part connected to the support stand receiving part is opened to the lateral part. A support stand catching part is formed to face the support stand receiving part and buried under the ground. The upper part is connected to power-supplies installed on the ground. The connector is arranged on the top of the support stand receiving part of the underground piping. The supporting apparatus includes a case, a support stand, a spring, a solenoid, a detection sensor, and a control unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지중매설형 배전 전선 스토퍼에 관한 것으로, 지지대수용부(P1)가 내면을 따라 상하방으로 형성되고, 지지대수용부(P1)와 연통된 관통부(P2)가 측방으로 개구되며, 지지대걸림부(P3)가 지지대수용부(P1)와 대향되게 형성되어 지면에 매설되되, 상부가 지상에 설치된 배전함(C)과 연통되는 사각관 형상의 지중배관(P)과; 전력공급원으로부터 인입되는 인입전선(L)과 배전반(B)으로부터 인출되는 인출전선(L') 사이에 배치되도록 지중배관(P) 내부에 배치되는 절연재질인 패널(110)과, 패널(110)에 삽입되는 십자형상의 삽입부(121)와, 삽입부(121)로부터 하방으로 연장되며 패널(110)을 관통하여 인입전선(L)과 연결되는 제1연결부(122)와, 삽입부(121)로부터 상방으로 연장되며 패널(110)을 관통하여 인출전선(L')과 연결되는 제2연결부(123)로 구성된 도전재질인 연결대(120)와, 패널(110)의 측면에 고정되는 패널고정부(131)와, 지중배관(P) 내벽에 고정되는 지중배관고정부(132)로 구성되어, 패널(110)을 상방으로 탄발하는 적어도 두개 이상의 스프링(130)을 갖추고서, 지중배관(P)의 지지대수용부(P1)의 상부에 배치되는 커넥터(100)와; 측면에 지중배관(P)의 관통부(P2)와 연통되는 개구부(211)가 형성되어, 지중배관(P)과 이웃되게 배치되는 케이스(210)와, 지중배관(P)의 지지대수용부(P1)에 회전가능하게 설치되는 지지부(221)와, 관통홀(h)이 형성되며 지지부(221)로부터 연장되어 케이스(210) 내부로 인입되는 걸림부(222)와, 지지부(221)와 걸림부(222)에 형성되며 인입전선(L)이 통과하는 가이드부(223)를 갖춘 지지대(220)와, 지지대(220)가 지중배관(P)를 폐쇄하도록 탄발지지하는 스프링(230)과, 지지대(220)의 관통홀(h)에 삽탈가능하게 삽입되는 플런저(241)를 갖추고서, 케이스(210)에 내설되는 솔레노이드(240)와, 케이스(210) 보다 상부에 배치되도록 지중배관(P) 내면에 설치되어, 커넥터(100)의 낙하를 감지하는 감지센서(250)와, 케이스(210)에 내설되어, 감지센서(250)로부터 커넥터 낙하신호를 수신하면 솔레노이드(240)를 동작시키는 제어유닛(260)을 갖춘 지지장치(200)를 포함하여, 지진에 안정적으로 대처할 수 있으며, 커넥터로 흐르는 전기가 누전되지 않는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A kind of radar life-detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of radar life-detection instrument, it comprises wireless detector and PDA (1), wireless detector comprises receiving unit and radiating portion, receiving unit comprises the receiving antenna (2) of several, receiving antenna (2) passes through filtering circuit successively, the low noise amplifying circuit is connected with the signal input part of baseband signal processor (4) with down conversion module (3) back, baseband signal processor (4) output terminal I is connected with the system master part, baseband module scrambler input end in the signal input part of baseband signal processor (4) and the baseband signal processor (4) is connected, baseband module scrambler output terminal is connected with filtering circuit in turn, modulation module, up-conversion module (5), power amplifier is connected with emitting antenna (6), and emitting antenna (6) is wireless connections with PDA (1).The present invention not only can detect trapped personnel quickly and easily, and the accuracy height of surveying.

title_en: Apparatus for notifying emergency situation based on physiological signal and Watch using by the same
title_ko: 생체 신호에 기반한 사용자 응급 상황 알림 장치 및 그 시계
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An apparatus for notifying an emergency situation based on a bio signal and a watch are provided to transmit position information of a user and peripheral situation in a specific situation using the bio signal of the user. CONSTITUTION: A bio sensor(110) senses a bio signal of a user. A microphone(130) receives a surrounding voice signal. An antenna(140) transmits a wireless signal to an access point. A microcontroller(120) receives the bio signal from the bio sensor. The microcontroller transmits the position signal and peripheral voice signal by wireless by operating the microphone and the antenna if the measurement value of the received bio signal exceeds the specific threshold value. A power supply unit is electrically connected to the microcontroller and supplies the power.
abstract_ko: 생체 신호에 기반한 사용자 응급 상황 알림 장치 및 그 시계가 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 생체 신호에 기반한 사용자 응급 상황 알림 장치는, 사용자의 생체 신호를 감지하는 바이오 센서; 주위 음성 신호를 수신하는 마이크; 상기 사용자의 위치 신호 및 상기 마이크의 음성 신호를 전송하는 안테나부; 상기 바이오 센서로부터 생체 신호를 수신하고, 상기 수신된 생체 신호의 측정값이 미리 설정된 특정의 임계값을 초과하는 경우 상기 마이크 및 상기 안테나부를 동작시키는 마이크로 컨트롤러; 및 상기 마이크로 컨트롤러와 전기적으로 연결된 전원공급부를 포함한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 생체 신호에 기반한 사용자 응급 알림 장치를 구비함으로써 특정 응급 상황이 발생시에 사용자의 신체에서 반응하는 생체 신호에 따라 응급 신호를 전송할 수 있어서 응급 상황 발생에 대한 신뢰도가 향상되고, 이와 동시에 응급 상황이 발생한 위치를 정확하게 파악할 수 있으며, 사고 발생시 이에 대한 추적이 용이하며, 다양한 센싱 기술들과 결합하여 유비쿼터스 서비스의 신경망적 역할을 수행할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: location recognition system used RFID for block transportation in shipyard
title_ko: Ｒｆｉｄ를 이용한 블록 위치 인식 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A location recognition system using an RFID for block transportation in a shipyard is provided to sense a shape and position of a target block by obtaining a coordinate through recognition of an RFID tag. CONSTITUTION: In a location recognition system using an RFID for block transportation in a shipyard, an RFID tag(10) is buried under the ground by a certain interval. An ID and latitude and longitude are stored in the RFID tag, and the RFID reader recognizes a coordinate of the RFID tag. A laser rangefinder and a direction angle sensor are built in a location and geometry-measuring apparatus(200). A location and geometry-measuring apparatus measure the distance from the coordinate of the RFID tag to the target block. A reception server(300) receive location and shape data of the target block from a location and geometry-measuring apparatus.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 지면에 소정 간격으로 삽입되어 있으며, 고유 식별번호와 위도 및 경도 좌표가 저장되는 RFID 태그; RFID 리더기가 내장되어 바닥에 소정 간격으로 삽입되어 있는 상기 RFID 태그의 좌표를 인식하고, 레이져 거리 측정기 및 방향각 센서가 내장되어 상기 RFID 태그의 좌표로부터 블록 부재까지의 거리 및 방향각을 측정하는 위치 및 형상 측정장치; 상기 위치 및 형상 측정장치로부터 블록 부재의 위치 및 형상 정보를 수신받는 위치 및 형상 수신서버; 및 상기 위치 및 형상 수신서버로부터 블록 부재의 위치 및 형상 정보를 수신받아 상기 위치 및 형상 측정장치로 블록 부재의 이동을 요청하는 운반관리 시스템을 포함하는 RFID를 이용한 블록 위치 인식 시스템을 제공한다. 
       
     선박, GPS, 블록 부재, 배치, RFID

title_en: Land mine locating device and land mine locating system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a land mine locating system for quickly locating a land mine while preventing erroneous detection and oversight.  <P>SOLUTION: The land mine locating system 1 includes a land mine locating device 10 for performing location by scanning a land mine locating area 30 with land mines likely to be buried therein in an A direction and in a B direction, and a personal computer PC 20 for receiving, analyzing, and displaying information transmitted from the locating device 10. A land mine locating part 100 of the locating device 10 includes a metal locator, an underground radar, a smell sensor, an infrared camera, a communication part connected to an antenna to radio-communicate with the PC 20, a control part for controlling operation of respective parts, a wheel drive part driving wheels 110 while being driven by the control part, and a guide drive part for driving the locating part 100 so as to move it on a guide 120 while being controlled by the control part.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Bio complicated sensor
title_ko: 생체복합센서
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A bio complex sensor is provided to comfortably receive various bio signals by performing an integrated shape. CONSTITUTION: A bio complex sensor includes a glove, a pressure sensor, a temperature sensor, a conductive fiber part(170), and an optical sensor part(180). The glove has a unit for sensing bio information of user, and comprises body part(110), a finger part(150a~150e), and a kerf part(120). The pressure sensor and the temperature sensor are included in the kerf part, and measure blood pressure and body temperature of user. The conductive fiber part measures electrocardiogram and fat of the user. The optical sensor part measures oxygen saturation of the user.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 생체복합센서에 관한 것으로, 사용자의 생체정보를 측정하는 장치에 있어서, 상기 사용자의 생체정보를 감지하는 수단을 내장한 장갑, 상기 장갑은 몸통부, 손가락부, 커프부로 구성되고, 상기 사용자의 혈압을 측정을 위해 가압 및 감압을 하는 커프부, 상기 커프부에 구비되어 사용자의 혈압 및 체온을 측정하는 압력센서 및 온도센서, 상기 사용자의 심전도 및 체지방을 측정하는 도전성 섬유부, 상기 사용자의 산소 포화도를 측정하는 광센서부로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     상기와 같은 생체복합센서를 이용하는 것에 의해, 기존의 팔뚝형 혈압계, 심전계, 산소 포화도 측정기와 체지방 측정기를 비롯해 생체신호 측정시 번거롭게 센서를 장착하거나 외부로 배선을 연결할 필요없는 일체형 형태를 가짐으로 보다 편하게 다양한 생체신호를 받을 수 있다. 
       
     장갑, 산소 포화도, 심전도, 혈압, 체온

title_en: Slope measuring apparatus and system using for the same
title_ko: 사면계측장치 및 이를 포함하는 사면계측시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A slope measuring apparatus and a system with the same are provided to prevent physical damage by falling rocks and a slope collapse. CONSTITUTION: A slope measuring apparatus comprises a main body, a displacement measuring sensor and a sinkage meter(50). The main body is equipped in a pile among several piles buried under the slop. The displacement measuring sensor is built in the main body and measures the displacement of the slop. The sinkage meter is installed in the main body and measures the sinkage of the slop.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 사면의 거동을 계측하여 사면 붕괴로 인한 재해를 예방하기 위한 사면계측장치 및 이를 포함하는 사면계측시스템에 관한 것이다. 특히 본 발명은 사면에 매설되는 복수의 파일 중 어느 하나와 결합되는 본체; 상기 사면의 변위를 계측하도록 상기 본체에 설치되는 변위계측센서; 상기 복수의 파일 간 상대변위에 의해 상기 사면의 침하량을 계측하도록 상기 본체에 설치된 침하량 계측계;를 포함하는 사면계측장치 및 이를 포함하는 사면계측시스템에 관한 것으로서, 사면의 이상징후 발생시 즉각적으로 대처할 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
       
     사면붕괴, 낙석, 사면계측, 변위, 침하

title_en: Ground subsidence measuring apparatus and system using for the same
title_ko: 침하량 계측장치 및 이를 포함하는 침하량 계측시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A ground subsidence measuring apparatus and a system with the same are provided to reduce a responding time to the abnormal occurrence. CONSTITUTION: A ground subsidence measuring apparatus comprises a main body(60), a hinge binding site(70), a connecting member(72) and a tilt sensor. The main body is equipped in a pile among several piles buried under the ground. The hinge binding site is hinge-coupled in the main body and is circulated around the main body. The connecting member connects the hinge binding site to the piles. The tilt sensor measures the slope variation of the hinge binding site using the swinging of the hinge binding site around the pile.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지중의 침하량을 계측하여 지중의 침하로 인한 재해를 예방하기 위한 침하량 계측장치 및 이를 포함하는 침하량 계측시스템에 관한 것이다. 특히 본 발명은 지중에 매설된 복수의 파일 중 어느 하나의 파일에 장착되는 본체; 상기 본체에 대하여 회동될 수 있도록 상기 본체에 힌지 결합되는 힌지결합부; 상기 힌지결합부를 상기 복수의 파일 중 또 다른 파일에 연결하는 연결부재; 상기 파일에 대한 상기 힌지결합부의 회동에 의한 상기 힌지결합부의 기울기 변화를 계측하는 기울기 센서;를 포함하는 침하량 계측장치 및 이를 포함하는 침하량 계측시스템에 관한 것으로서, 지중의 침하 이상징후 발생시 즉각적으로 대처할 수 있도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Emergency assistance support vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency assistance support vehicle, which comprises an automotive chassis and a working device mounted on the automotive chassis, wherein the working device comprisesa crane, a hydraulic lifting platform, a communication device and a shelter; the crane is mounted at the front part of the automotive chassis; the hydraulic lifting platform is mounted at the middle part of the automotive chassis; the shelter is mounted at the back part of the automotive chassis; the communication device comprises a satellite antenna and a short wave antenna for communication in motion; a base is mounted at the upper end of the shelter; the satellite antenna is mounted on the base and can rotate; and the short wave antenna for communication in motion is mounted at the back part of the shelter. Since the utility model is provided with emergency equipment with the functions of hoisting, aerial work, communication and earthquake relief work; and earthquake relief work emergency equipment like life detection instruments, infrared scanners, generators, construction tools, cookers, tents and the like of the earthquake relief work device can be loaded in the shelter, so thatthe utility model has the characteristics that the device is complete, fast, flexible and engine-driven, and provides an all-around assistance support for earthquake relief work.

title_en: Radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a radar life detection instrument, which comprises a wireless detector and PDA (1); the wireless detector comprises a receiving part and a transmitting part; the receivingpart comprises a plurality of receiving antennae (2); the receiving antennae (2) respectively passes through a filtering circuit, a low-noise amplifying circuit and a down-conversion module (3) and then is connected with a signal input end of a baseband signal processor (4), an output end I of the baseband signal processor (4) is connected with a system main control part, the signal input end of the baseband signal processor (4) is connected with the input end of a baseband module coder in the baseband signal processor (4); and the output end of the baseband module coder is respectively connected with the filtering circuit, a modulation module, an up-conversion module (5), a power amplifier and a transmitting antenna (6), the transmitting antenna (6) is wirelessly connected with the PDA (1). The radar life detection instrument not only conveniently and quickly detects the trapped person, but also has high accuracy of detecting.

title_en: A interpolation method for vital signs using doppler radar sensing
title_ko: 도플러 레이더를 이용한 심박데이터에 대한 ｈｒｖ 보간법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An HRV interpolation method about heart rate data is provided to receive a heart rate signal of a human without the contact with the human. CONSTITUTION: An interval between the maximum and the minimum of a level of an respiratory signal is divided into a plurality of parts(21-1,21-2,21-3,21-4) in a dividing step. In a setting step, a time of a respiratory signal is set up. In a measuring step, the period of a Doppler heart rate signal is measured in the set time. An average period of the Doppler hear rate signal is measured in the respiratory time. The corresponding value is calculated from the value obtained in the dividing step at each period of the Doppler heart rate signal. The average is calculated by summing the Doppler heart rate signal periods(25-1 to 25-8) by searching for the same value for the period of the Doppler heart rate signal. An error value is obtained using the average and the difference value between the Doppler average periods. The interpolation is performed by adding or subtracting the error value to or from the Doppler heart rate signal period.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 마이크로파를 인체를 통해서 송수신하여 인체의 호흡, 심박신호를 도플러 효과를 이용하여 얻어진 심박신호에서 호흡의 영향을 제거하고 신체의 건강상태, 스트레스 지수 등의 인체의 순환계상태를 분석하는 도플러 레이더를 이용한 심박데이터에 대한 HRV(에이치알브이) 보간방법에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명은 마이크로파의 도플러 신호를 이용하여 비 접촉으로 인체의 심박신호와 호흡신호를 측정하되, 심장박동의 도플러 심박신호가 호흡신호에 의하여 변화하는 것을 보간하기 위한 것으로,  ECG를 이용한 표준 심박신호의 최대점에 대하여 도플러 심박신호가 호흡신호에 의하여 빠르거나 늦어지는 것을 보간하기 위하여 호흡신호 주기에 대해 일정구간을 설정하고, 호흡신호의 레벨을 다수개로 구분하며, 설정된 호흡주기 동안에 발생하는 도플러 심박신호사이의 주기를 각각 측정하고, 설정된 호흡주기 동안 호흡 신호의 레벨에 상관없이 전체의 주기를 합하여  도플러 평균 주기를  측정하고, 설정된 호흡주기 동안에 도플러 심박신호의 주기를 상기 다수개로 구분한 호흡신호의 레벨이 동일한 값을 가진 심박신호로 각각 구성하여 측정한 호흡 크기 구간별 심박주기와  상기의 도플러 평균 주기와 발생한 오차를 보간하도록 구성되어 있다. 
     본 발명은 마이크로파 도플러 심박신호와 ECG 표준 심박신호 주기를 대비하되, 다수개로 구분한 호흡신호의 레벨이 동일한 값을 갖는 심박신호를 사용하여 호흡신호에 의하여 발생한 오차를 보간 하므로 정확하고 신뢰성이 높은 HRV분석 결과 를 제공하는 작용효과가 있다.

title_en: Popular earthquake alarm for civil use
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a popular earthquake alarm for civil use, which comprises a life detection device in wireless connection with a wireless receiving unit. The wireless receiving unit and anearthquake wave detection unit are embedded into a microprocessor; and the microprocessor is respectively connected with an alarming unit, a wireless SOS (Save Our Souls) unit, an emergency indicatorlamp control unit, a voice prompt unit, a voice SOS unit and a main/stand-by power supply. A three-way vibration acceleration sensor is used for detecting P waves (longitudinal waves) and S waves (transversal waves) of the earthquake waves. Emergency lighting is automatically switched on upon detecting an earthquake; and the infrared life detection device provides the life information at the periphery before and after the earthquake, which helps to judge whether people are trapped under collapsed buildings, and then sends out wireless distress calls and voice distress calls, thereby providinghelp for rescue personnel to rapidly position and salvage the trapped people. Moreover, as the main/stand-by power supply is provided, the alarm works as usual even under the circumstance of current failure.

title_en: Apparatus for feedback according to emotional state
title_ko: 감정 상태에 따른 피드백 장치
abstract_ko:
감정 상태에 따른 피드백 장치가 개시된다. 
     본 고안은 사용자가 소정의 스포츠 경기를 진행하여 점수를 획득할 때마다 상기 사용자에 부착된 복수의 센서로부터 생체 신호를 측정하는 신호 측정부, 상기 측정된 생체 신호를 사용자별로 분류하여 저장하는 제1 데이터 베이스부, 소정의 평균 생체 신호 및 상기 평균 생체 신호에 대응하는 감정 정보를 저장하는 제2 데이터 베이스부, 상기 평균 생체 신호를 참조하여 상기 제1 데이터 베이스부에 저장된 생체 신호에 대응하는 감정 정보를 제2 데이터 베이스부에서 검색하는 감정 검색부, 상기 감정 검색부에 의해 검색된 감정 정보를 이용하여 상기 사용자의 감정 상태 정보를 생성하는 신호 처리부; 및 상기 사용자에게 상기 감정 상태 정보에 대응하는 피드백을 수행하는 감정 피드백부를 포함하는 감정 상태에 따른 피드백 장치를 제공한다. 
     본 고안에 의하면, 스포츠 경기 중 생체 신호를 측정하여 실시간으로 감정 상태를 분류하고, 기 저장된 데이터 베이스(DB) 정보를 이용하여 선수의 감정 상태에 따른 피드백을 제공함으로써, 인간의 감정 상태를 세부적으로 분류할 수 있고, 감정 상태 판단의 정확성을 향상시키고, 특정 선수에게 존재하는 심리적인 문제점을 용이하게 개선하게 할 수 있고, 스포츠 선수에게 자기조절을 통한 피드백 학습을 제공하여 집중력과 내적으로 초점적 주의 상태와 관련된 생체패턴에 도달시킬 수 있으며, 양궁이나 골프 퍼팅과 같은 집중력과 주의를 요하는 스포츠 분야의 훈 련과정을 촉진시키고 수행 능력을 증진시킬 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: An old or feeble person care system
title_ko: 노약자 구호 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A care system for the old and the infirm is provided to rapidly save the old and the infirm of an emergency condition by monitoring a health condition of the old and the infirm without leak of personal information of the old and the infirm on a real time. CONSTITUTION: A care system for the old and the infirm includes a detecting device(100), an alarm device(200), and a phone(300). The detecting device is attached to a body of the old and the infirm, detects bio signals like pulse or body temperature, and transmits an emergency signal which indicates an abnormal state of the bio signals to the alarm device. The alarm device is adjacently installed to the phone, and sends an emergency message transmission command to the phone. The phone includes an auto-message transmission function or an auto-dialing function.
abstract_ko:
노약자 구호 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명은 노약자의 생체신호를 감지하여 생체신호의 이상에 따라 응급신호를 발생시키는 감지장치, 및 감지장치로부터 응급신호를 수신하며, 자동 메시지 전송 기능 및 자동 다이얼링 기능 중 적어도 하나를 구비하는 전화기에 설치되어 전화기가 미리 정해진 전화번호로 응급 메시지를 전송하도록 하는 알림장치를 구비한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 노약자의 개인 정보 유출의 문제점 없이 노약자의 건강상태를 실시간으로 감시하여 노약자의 응급상태의 경우에 신속한 구조가 가능하게 된다.

title_en: Multifunctional telemetry alert safety system (MTASS)
abstract_en: A personnel accountability and situational awareness monitoring communications system for emergency personnel that comprises wireless network-adaptable monitoring devices, peripherals and base station console software for telemetry monitoring of real-time information at a plurality of personnel accountability and situational awareness parameters of critical data about the safety, health and whereabouts of first responders deployed in typically hazardous environments. Exterior incident command, including fire, rescue, safety and other emergency agencies achieve real-time command view and control over a variety of personnel accountability and safety parameters during emergency response activities of personnel wearing the system of the present invention portable device while operating within the wireless network of an emergency incident scene. Configured to be carried by emergency services personnel while deployed on scene, the portable device is a multi-functional sensing and communicating integration of accountability and situational awareness technologies consolidated into one portable, telemetry device. The portable device's multifunctional integrated technology includes the monitoring, telemetry and alert notification of accountability identification, location, assignment notification, vital signs, ambient vicinity temperature, SCBA status, combustible gas sensing, video streaming, “evacuation” recall signaling, signal tracking and multi-alarm signaling if the wearer has either low remaining air pressure/time, impending thermal breakthrough, low battery power, exceeds the safety threshold for safe heart rate or external body temperature readings, or becomes motionless for a predetermined time period.

title_en: Lateral wave radar system for forward detection
abstract_en: A forward-looking radar system adapted to detect and identify buried or near surface objects from a moving ground vehicle has been developed. The system incorporates a radar detection system and in one embodiment is mounted on a ground vehicle. The system is adapted to differentiate common roadway clutter from objects of interest.

title_en: Apparatus and method of integratedly processing a plurality of bio signals
title_ko: 통합적인 생체신호 처리장치 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A bio signal processing unit and a method thereof are provided to obtain a desired bio signal by processing the bio signal of specific sensor according to a predetermined processing requirement. CONSTITUTION: A sensing module(110) includes a plurality of sensor groups. A plurality of sensor groups measures a bio signal according to a predetermined control signal. A first signal processing module(130) generates a signal for driving the sensing module. A first signal processing module processes the bio-signal provided from a plurality of sensor groups. A second signal processing module(150) processes the bio-signal provided from the first signal processing module according to a predetermined processing requirement. The predetermined processing requirement comprises at least one among a filtering frequency band, an amplifying gain, and a computing algorithm.
abstract_ko: 통합적인 생체신호 처리장치 및 방법을 개시한다.   제1 신호처리모듈은  제어신호에 대응하여 각 센서를 구동하기 위한 신호를 생성하고, 각 센서로부터 제공되는 생체신호를 처리한다.  제2 신호처리모듈은 처리하고자 하는 생체신호에 대응하여 제어신호를 생성하는 한편 처리조건을 자동으로 설정하고, 제1 신호처리모듈로부터 제공되는 생체신호를 설정된 처리조건에 따라서 처리하고, 처리결과를 출력한다.

title_en: Bio-signal measurement device of mouse type
title_ko: 마우스형 다중 생체신호 측정장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A mouse type multiple bio-signal measuring apparatus is provided to measure a multiple bio-signal at the same time by using a ring-shaped measuring part, an electrocardiogram electrode, and an impedance electrode. CONSTITUTION: A palm holding part(100) has a cupola-shape. A ring-shaped measuring part(200) is arranged in one side of the palm holding part. The ring-shaped measuring part measures the blood pressure from an inserted finger. The ring-shaped measuring part comprises a cuff pressure measurement part and an oxygen saturation measurement sensor part. The cuff surrounds the inserted finger. The oxygen saturation measurement sensor part has a lighting-emitting part and a light receiving unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 보다 정확한 심전도, 혈압을 측정하며, 사용하기 간편한 마우스형 생체신호 측정장치에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세히는 상기 마우스형 생체신호 측정장치 상의 일측에 장착된 링형 측정부에서 커프압 및 산소포화도에 의해 정확한 혈압을 측정하며, 마우스형 생체신호 측정장치 상의 손바닥 접촉부에 위치된 심전도 전극 및 마우스형 생체신호 측정장치 밑면에 위치된 가슴 심전도 전극을 통해 정확한 심전도를 측정하며, 마우스형 생체신호 측정장치 상의 손바닥 접촉부에 위치된 체임피던스 전극을 통해 체임피던스를 측정하는 마우스형 다중 생체신호 측정장치에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명은, 반구(半球)형으로 이루어지며 손바닥을 거치(据置)하도록 이루어진 손바닥 거치부를 구비한 마우스형 생체신호 측정장치에 있어서, 상기 손바닥 거치부(100) 상의 일측에 위치되며, 손가락이 삽입되도록 이루어지고, 삽입된 손가락에서 혈압 및 산소포화도를 측정하는 링형 측정부; 를 적어도 구비하며, 상기 링형 측정부는, 내측에 삽입된 손가락을 감싸도록 이루어진 커프를 구비하며, 상기 커프에 공기를 가압한 후, 커프에서의 압력 변화로 부터 혈압신호를 검출하도록 이루어진 커프압력 측정부; 내측에 발광부와 수광부를 구비하여, 산소포화도를 검출하도록 이루어진 산소포화도 측정센서부;를 구비하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     또한, 본 발명은, 손바닥 거치부 상에 위치되되, 손바닥이 닿는 부분에 장착되어지는 심전도 전극을 구비하는 손바닥 심전도 전극부; 상기 마우스형 생체신호  측정장치의 밑면의 일측에 심전도 전극이 구비되며, 상기 마우스형 생체신호 측정장치의 밑면을 가슴부위에 위치(부착)시킴에 의해 가슴 심전도를 측정하도록 이루어진 가슴 심전도 전극부; 손바닥 거치부(100) 상에 위치되되, 손바닥이 닿는 부분에 체임피던스 전극이 장착되는 손바닥 체임피던스 전극부;를 더 구비하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
       
     생체신호, 마우스, 심전도, 혈압, 체임피던스, 혈압, 산소포화도, 전극

title_en: Real time psychophysiology-health monitering system using eyeglass
title_ko: 안경을 이용한 실시간 건강 및 감성 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A real-time health and sensibility monitoring system is provided to measure blood oxygen concentration, skin conductance, and respiration by installing a sensor or a microphone to a nose pad member of glasses or a goggle. CONSTITUTION: A first bio-signal measurement part(110) is arranged in a nose pad member of glasses or goggle. The first bio-signal measurement part comprises a SpO2 electrode, a skin resistance electrode, and a microphone electrode. The SpO2 electrode measures the blood oxygen saturation value. The skin resistance electrode measures the skin conductance. The microphone electrode measures respiration. A wireless transceiver(130) wirelessly transmits a first bio-signal detected by the first body signal measurement part to an external device.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 안경을 이용한 생체신호 무선 측정장치 및 그것을 이용한 건강 및 감성 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 안경이나 고글의 코 받침부재에 SpO 2     센서, GSR센서, 마이크로폰, EMG, EEG 등을 부착하여 혈중 산소농도, 피부전도도, 호흡, 뇌파, 근전도 등을 무선 측정하고 건강 및 감성상태를 모니터링하기 위한 것이다. 
     이를 위하여 본 발명은 안경이나 고글의 코 받침부재에 설치되어 안경이나 고글 착용자의 혈중 산소농도, 피부 전도도, 호흡, 뇌파, 근전도에 관련된 하나 이상의 전기신호를 검출하는 생체신호 측정부; 생체신호 측정부로부터 검출된 생체신호를 수신하여 무선 신호로 변환한 후 외부 기기로 전송하는 무선 송수신부;를 포함하는 안경을 이용한 생체신호 무선 측정장치 및 그것을 이용한 건강 및 감성 모니터링 시스템을 제공하여, 시간과 장소에 구애받지 않고 간편하게 생체신호를 측정하고, 사용자의 건강 및 감성 상태를 지속적으로 실시간 모니터링할 수 있게 한다. 
       
     생체, 측정, 안경, 감성 및 건강상태, 모니터링 시스템, 무선전송

title_en: Realtime monitoring system for guard based on bio signal and etc
title_ko: 생체 신호 등을 기반으로 한 경계 근무 실시간 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: In one barrier service real time monitoring system is the remote the organism state of the guard including bio-signal etc, it on a real time basis monitors. The information about the organism state of the guard is grasped rapidly. CONSTITUTION: A sensor module(20) comprises the electrocardiogram sensor unit(21) and 3 shaft acceleration sensor part(22) in which the electrocardiogram of the guard is measured and which is created the electrocardiogram signal. It measures the movement of the guard and 3 shaft acceleration sensor part is created 3 shaft acceleration signal. The portable terminal apparatus(100) transmits the electrocardiogram signal received a message from the sensor module and the guard status signal including 3 shaft acceleration signal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 경계 근무 상황실에서 원격으로 경계 근무자를 모니터링하는 것에 관한 것이며, 특히 경계 근무자의 생존 여부, 생체 상태, 근무 태도 및 이동 경로 등을 모니터링하는 시스템에 관한 것이다.  
     본 발명의 경계 근무 실시간 모니터링 시스템은, 경계 근무자의 심전도를 측정하여 심전도 신호를 생성하는 심전도 센서부(21)와, 상기 경계 근무자의 움직임을 측정하여 3축 가속도 신호를 생성하는 3축 가속도 센서부(22)를 포함하는 센서 모듈(20); 상기 센서 모듈(20)로부터 수신한 상기 심전도 신호 및 3축 가속도 신호를 포함하는 경계 근무자 상태 신호를 전송하는 휴대 단말 장치(100); 상기 휴대 단말 장치(100)로부터 상기 경계 근무자 상태 신호를 수신하여 분석하는 경계 근무 모니터링 서버(200)를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.  
     
     경계근무, 보초, 심전도, 가속도, 알람, 근태, 안전, 실시간 모니터링
assignees: V I SOFT CO LTD;ICU RES & IND COOP GROUP

title_en: Superconducting coil apparatus
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a superconducting coil apparatus which has improved stability and insulation by reducing an influence of deterioration and strain stress in an edgewise direction which are caused by thermal distortion at the time of connection.  <P>SOLUTION: A first superconducting coil apparatus 10A includes a core 15 formed of an insulator, an electrode 13 buried into the core and fixed to the core 15 with a screw 16, and two superconducting tape wires 14a and 14b electrically connected to the electrode 13, and is constituted by disposing two superconducting coils 11a and 11b wherein two superconducting tape wires 14a and 14b are wound in opposite directions, coaxially adjacently to each other.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: System and method for detection of buried objects
abstract_en: A system for detecting buried objects or threats is described. Radiation is detected from a target area by at least two wavelength radiation band sensors. The radiation emitted by the target area is detected by suitable detectors and processed using suitable signal processing means together with statistical data processing methods such that an image of the target area is produced capable of showing buried objects in the target area.

title_en: Portable touchless vital sign acquisition device
abstract_en: Disclosed herein is a non-contact MCG is anticipated as one embodiment. Additionally, a non-contact stethoscope, thermal sensor, or MCG could be utilized singly or in combination with each other, or included singly or together in other medical devices such as a fluoroscope, For example, a handheld, portable instrument comprising a non- contact stethoscope without a magnetometer or thermal sensor can provide a measure of acoustic signals without contacting a subject, while a non-contact thermal sensor as a single device can provide a rapid contactless temperature of a subject
assignees: UNIV FLORIDA;SKIDMORE FRANK M;DAVIDSON MARK;DONDA RUSSELL S

title_en: Lifting or supporting machine for earthquake rescue
abstract_en: The invention provides a lifting or supporting machine for earthquake rescue and relates to the field of rescue, engineering application and the like, in particular to a special lifting or supporting machine needed in natural disasters such as earthquakes and the like. The lifting or supporting machine consists of a spherical body and four telescopic type hydraulic cylinders, wherein the telescopic type hydraulic cylinders are mutually connected in the spherical body by pipe joints, and four points where the four telescopic type hydraulic cylinders are contacted with the surface of the spherical body form four apex points of a regular hexahedron inscribed to the spherical body; the supporting palms on the top parts of the telescopic type hydraulic cylinders are connected with the telescopic type hydraulic cylinders by sphere pairs; and the top part of each telescopic type hydraulic cylinder is provided with a supporting palm provided with a force sensor. Under a condition of lower load, the lifting or supporting machine is used as a lifting machine to rescue people buried beneath collapsed buildings, and under a condition of bigger load, the lifting or supporting machine is used as a supporting machine to protect trapped persons from the secondary extrusion when the large-scale machinery is used for moving buried objects; and the lifting or supporting machine also has the advantages of simple structure, convenient operation, easy maintenance, big lifting or supporting force and strong environmental adaptability.

title_en: Infrared laser alarm device of hoisting machinery
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an infrared laser alarm device of hoisting machinery, which comprises an area scanning module, a far infrared life detection sensing module, a micro control processing module (CPU), a reminding module and a control circuit connected with hoisting equipment, wherein the area scanning module is connected with a plurality of infrared photoelectric transmitting tubes, and the far infrared life detection sensing module is connected with a high-precision sign detector; the reminding module is respectively connected with the voice warning module, the image warning module and the vital sign display module. The device comprises a loudspeaker connected with a voice warning module, a dangerous area light beam illuminating lamp connected with an image warning module, and a vital sign temperature display instrument connected with a vital sign display module, wherein the vital sign temperature display instrument clearly displays a dangerous area of a lifted cargo, detects the position and distance of a human vital sign existing underground, and timely sends out a safety alarm signal, thereby effectively preventing accidental personal injury on construction or search and rescue sites.

title_en: Method for monitoring stability and predicting destabilization of side slope based on change of state of strain of soil-rock mass
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring the stability and predicting the destabilization of a side slope based on the change of the state of strain of soil-rock mass, which is used for monitoring strain sensitivity and strain acceleration condition along a sensor distribution direction in the side slope to fulfill the aims of pre-warning and prediction under the condition that buried monitoring sensors do not change the stable state of the side slope by arranging a plurality of parallel or slightly inclined multi-point strain gauges or distributed strain gauges in a slope body of the side slope, judging the plastic zone and potential destabilization range of the side slope according to the strain sensitivity change of the multi-point strain gauges or the distributed strain gauges and evaluating the stability of the side slope. Specifically for the slope bodies which are not obviously deformed before the side slopes are destabilized, a conventional displacement monitoring method cannot monitor and pre-warn the destabilization. Compared with the conventional method, the method has inimitable advantages, and compared with the conventional method for monitoring the stability of the side slope and a landslide disaster, is more direct and more rational monitoring means.

title_en: Video life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a video life detection instrument, which acquires image and voice information of a trapped person under the ruins by a high definition video and a high sensitivity audio signal. The video life detection instrument has convenient use and small visual appearance, is firm and light, and is very suitable for the search and rescue operation of fallen buildings or narrow space. The front end of the video life detection instrument is provided with a micro motor which can control a micro camera at the front end of the video life detection instrument to rotate 360 degrees. And an infrared LED lamp is used to illuminate so as to see the image clearly in the dark place.
assignees: BEIJING TOPSKY CENTURY AUTOMATIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Radar life-detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar life-detection instrument, which comprises a main body of the instrument and a bluetooth device (1), wherein the main body comprises a transmitting antenna (2), a receiving antenna (3), a low noise amplifier (4), a power amplifier (5), a modem (6) and a signal processor (7); the transmitting antenna (2) is arranged on the power amplifier (5), and the receiving antenna (3) is arranged on the low noise amplifier (4); and the low noise amplifier (4) and the power amplifier (5) are respectively connected with the signal processor (7) through the modem (6). The radar life-detection instrument can conveniently and quickly detect the trapped person, and has the advantages of high detection accuracy and simple structure.

title_en: Underground radar
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an underground radar not only detecting the position of a buried object but also discriminating whether the underground buried object is a metal object or a nonmetal object, when examining a buried state prior to an underground drilling work.  <P>SOLUTION: This underground radar 1 includes an electromagnetic wave transmission part 4 for transmitting an electromagnetic wave toward the underground, and an electromagnetic wave reception part 5 for receiving a reflected electromagnetic wave based on the transmitted electromagnetic wave, and detects a buried object 9 buried underground based on an electromagnetic wave received by the electromagnetic wave reception part 5. The radar 1 has a constitution including a correlation processing part 22 for performing mutual correlation processing between a reception waveform 19 of the electromagnetic wave received by the electromagnetic wave reception part 5 and a transmission waveform 12 of the electromagnetic wave transmitted from the electromagnetic wave transmission part 4, and autocorrelation processing of the reception waveform 19; and a discrimination part 7 for calculating the ratio between a mutual correlation value and an autocorrelation value acquired by the correlation processing part 22, and discriminating whether the underground buried object 9 buried underground is a metal object or a nonmetal object based on the calculated ratio.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT
assignees: NIPPON SIGNAL CO LTD;NAT UNIV YOKOHAMA

title_en: Intrusion detection device
abstract_en: The invention provides an intrusion detection device and belongs to the technical field of public safety. The intrusion detection device comprises a passive infrared detection unit, a camera, a video image analyzer and an alarm unit, wherein the passive infrared detection unit is used for acquiring the human or animal alarm signals with vital signs; the camera is used for acquiring a video image; the video image analyzer is used for analyzing the video image acquired by the camera and extracting the alarm signals with human signs; and the alarm unit is used for analyzing the alarm signals with the human signs recognized by the video image analyzer in combination with the human or animal alarm signals with the vital signs detected by the passive infrared detection unit, and rejecting the alarm signals with the human sign outline but without the vital signs or the alarm signals with the vital signs but without the human sign outline so as to ensure that the recognition alarm only aims at the intruding human bodies, thereby realizing the functions of advanced alarming and accurate alarming.
assignees: KARASSN SECURITY PROT ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Buried object surveying apparatus, target point surveying method, and v-shaped target
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a buried object surveying apparatus that is compatible with a comparatively thick wall and is easily handleable, and surveys the position of a target point provided on the back side being a back plane of a wall or floor, from its near-side surface by using a radar wave.  <P>SOLUTION: The buried object surveying apparatus 1 includes a display 2, an operation switch 3, a handle 4 for holding the buried-object surveying apparatus 1, and wheels 5 having a built-in encoder for detecting the position of movement. Moreover, the buried-object surveying apparatus 1 is operated on the near side of the wall, and a V-shaped target 10 is arranged on the back side of the wall. The V-shaped target 10 is a tapelike metal plate which reflects radar waves, and is stuck to the wall so as to stretch right and left at an angle of θ/2 with respect to a perpendicular axis (direction of gravity) passing a target point (point C).  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Method for human only activity detection based on radar signals
abstract_en: A method of detecting human presence includes using a radar sensor to monitor a space, and receiving an output signal from the radar sensor. A Fourier transform is performed on the output signal to produce a signal spectrum. It is decided whether the output signal is indicative of human activity dependent upon at least one acoustic feature of the signal spectrum and at least one spectral feature of the signal spectrum.

title_en: Buried object detector
abstract_en: A sensor device designed to detect buried objects by measuring the anisotropy of the electromagnetic properties of ground. This anisotropy is distinguished from the main reflection by modulating the signal using either a mechanically rotated antenna or an electronically switched antenna array after the in-phase and quadrature components are isolated from the main reflection using an electronic filter.

title_en: Buried object locating device with a plurality of spherical sensor balls that include a plurality of orthogonal antennae
abstract_en: A buried object locator which may include at least one antenna array including three mutually orthogonal antennas each sharing a common center point senses electromagnetic signals emitted by two or more buried objects such as utility lines, pipes or sondes. A circuit at least partially mounted in a housing of the locator may be connected to the array and used to determine location information of the buried objects by measuring signal strength and field angles in three dimensions.

title_en: Contactless sensor circuit
title_ko: 비접촉식 센서 회로
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A contactless sensor circuit is provided to be applicable for a bio and electric signal measurement process by measuring voltage signals from voltage signal source without electrical and physical contact. CONSTITUTION: A measuring electrode is capacitively coupled with a target(102). A coupling electric-condenser(112) is in serial connection with the measuring electrode. A first amplifier(106) includes a first negative inputting terminal(106b) and a first positive inputting terminal(106a). The first positive inputting terminal is in connection with the coupling electric-condenser. The first amplifier includes self inputted resistance(Ri) and self electrostatic capacitance. A bias circuit part secures the stable operation of the first amplifier.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비접촉식 센서 회로를 제공한다. 이 센서 회로는 측정 대상과 전기적, 물리적으로 비접촉하여 측정 대상의 전위를 측정할 수 있다. 이 센서 회로는  측정 대상과 축전 결합하는 측정 전극, 측정 전극과 직렬 연결되는 결합 축전기, 제1 음의 입력단 및 결합 축전기에 연결된 제1 양의 입력단을 포함하고 측정 신호를 제1 양의 입력단으로 입력받아 측정 신호를 증폭하여 제1 출력단으로 출력하는 제1 증폭기, 및 제1 증폭기의 제1 양의 입력단과 결합 축전기 사이에 위치한 제1 노드와 제1 증폭기의 상기 제1 출력단 사이에 연결되어 제1 증폭기의 안정적 동작을 제공하는 바이어스 회로부를 포함할 수 있다. 제1 증폭기는 자체 입력 저항(Ri) 및 자체 정전용량(Ci)를 포함하고, 결합 축전기의 결합 정전용량은 측정 대상과  측정 전극에 의하여 형성된 등가 정전 용량보다 작을 수 있다. 
       
     비접촉 센서, 전위 센서, 생체 신호 증폭기, 고입력 임피던스, 저입력 커패시턴스

title_en: Contactless sensor circuit
title_ko: 비접촉식 센서 회로
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A contactless sensor circuit is provided to activate bioelectric signal measurement field by performing a contactless measuring operation for signals without an electrolyte electrode. CONSTITUTION: A measuring electrode is capacitevly coupled with a measuring target(102). A coupling electric-condenser(112) is in serial connection with the measuring electrode. A first amplifier(106) includes a first negative inputting terminal(106b) and a first positive inputting terminal(106a). The first positive inputting terminal is in connection with the capacitive electric condenser. The first amplifier includes self-inputted resistance and self-electrostatic capacitance(Ci).

title_en: The device which sends the living body signal between living bodies
title_ko: 생체간 생체신호 전달 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A device is provided to transfer the bio-signal of an organism to a different organism through an electrode. CONSTITUTION: An organism signal transfer device comprises a first electrode, a second electrode, an amplifier, and a wire. The first electrode is attached onto the skin of a first organism. A second electrode is attached onto the skin of a second organism. The second electrode is connected to the end of the wire. The amplifier is connected to the first electrode and the wire. The amplifier amplifies a bio-signal which is measured from the first electrode. The amplifier transfers the amplified bio-signal to the second electrode through the wire.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 한 생체의 생체신호를 다른 생체에 전달할 수 있는 장치로서 생체신호가 전극을 통하여 전자기유도 현상에 의하여 전선을 따라 이동하거나 마이크로파에 담긴 생체신호가 수신 안테나를 통하여 증폭부에서 증폭된 후 전선을 통하여 다른 생체에 부착되는 전극이나 송신 안테나를 통하여 다른 생체의 신경에 전달되어 다른 생체의 생각이나 의지등을 알 수 있게 되는 생체신호 전달 장치이다. 
       
     생체신호,증폭부

title_en: Probe radar antenna
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enhance a resolution of a probe image in probing a relatively shallow region.  <P>SOLUTION: A probe radar antenna 10 provided for a buried object detector 1 has: circular antennas comprising two each of circular element conductors arranged on a substrate 17; and a circular antenna being a reception antenna B arranged in parallel with a transmission antenna A. A pulser 23 generates a pulsed radar wave, and the pulsed radar wave is sent to the two circular element conductors (11, 12) forming the transmission antenna A and radiated to a floor or a wall surface. The reflected wave from the wall or the floor is received by the circular element conductors (13, 14), and the buried object detector 1 discriminates a state of a buried object, based on a time between radiation of the radar wave and reception of the reflected wave, and a phase of a reception signal.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Device, system and method for measuring vital signs
abstract_en: In order to provide means for measuring vital signs such as heart rate, breathing rate, pulse forms, that allow accurate and unobtrusive signal acquisition and that are automatically adjusted to varying positions of an area of interest within a predetermined area, a device, a system and a method for measuring vital signs are provided, wherein electromagnetic signals such as microwave or radar are emitted and reflected electromagnetic signals are sensed with directional sensitivity by a transceiving unit and wherein a direction of interest is determined based on the sensed reflected signals and a primary direction of sensitivity (300) of the transceiving unit is adjusted to the direction of interest by a control unit. Thus, vital signs can be monitored in an unobtrusive and simple way.
assignees: PHILIPS INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY;KONINKL PHILIPS ELECTRONICS NV

title_en: Sensor system for explosive detection and removal
abstract_en: A sensor system for detecting one of Improvised Explosive Devices (IEDs), landmines or other buried explosives, the sensor system is mounted in place of a standard backhoe digging bucket of a backhoe vehicle. The sensor system includes a mounting portion having arc swing points for hanging the sensor system on a backhoe arm, and a holding pin opening for receiving a holding pin when positioned in a mounting position on the backhoe arm; and an electronic sensor wand arm assembly mounted to the mounting portion.

title_en: Multifunctional life rescuing system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional life rescuing system which is characterized in that: a life rescuing card (A) is communicated with a life signal receiving instrument (B) by wireless signals, the life rescuing card (A) is provided with a human body thermal infrared sensor module (A2), a heart detection sensor module (A3), a first low power-consumption singlechip module (A4) and a first wireless modulation-demodulation module (A5); the life signal receiving instrument (B) is provided with a second wireless modulation-demodulation module (B5), a second low power-consumption singlechip module (B4), a LCD driver module (B2), a LCD display module (B3), a D/A conversion module (B8), an audio filtering/amplification module (B9) and a loudspeaker (B10). The multifunction life rescuing system can overcome the environmental impact, has convenient operation and efficiently finishes the searching and rescuing of trapped persons.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;CHONGQING SHARING CULTURE DIFFUSION CO LTD

title_en: Mask for clean room
title_ko: 청정실용 무진 마스크
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A mask for clean room is provided, which prevents foreign material like saliva from being exhausted to the outside and minimizes generation of dust in the cut out part of the mask. CONSTITUTION: A mask for clean room comprises: a mask body(11) which is formed so that the length become narrow towards both side ends; a cover(14) which is thermally fused in the top end portion of the mask body and in which both side ends are thermally fused in both side ends of the mask body by ultrasonic wave and a metal or plastic wire is buried in the bottom; and a hanging band(12) in which both ends are fused with both side ends of the mask body by ultrasonic wave. The mask body, band, cover and a wrinkle part(13) are integrated by ultrasonic wave welding.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 무진 마스크에서 미세 먼지가 발생하는 것을 억제하고 작업자 즉, 작업자의 안면으로부터 이물질이 떨어지지 않도록 하기 위해, 상기 마스크 본체와 상기 걸이 밴드, 상기 덮개 그리고 주름부가 초음파 실링에 의해 컷팅 및 마무리되는 한편 초음파 용착에 의해 일체화된 것으로서, 마스크 본체의 하단부에 필터지가 연장되고, 이 필터지가 접혀져 외주름 또는 맞주름을 가지는 주름부가 형성되며, 이 주름부가 상기 마스크 본체 이면에 닿도록 접혀진 상태에서 초음파에 의해 마스크 본체의 양측 단부에 주름부의 양측 단부가 용착되어, 사용시 주름부의 외주름 또는 맞주름들이 펴지면서 마스크 본체의 후방에 작업자의 턱을 수용할 수 있는 포켓이 형성되도록 한 청정실용 무진 마스크에 관한 것이다. 
     
     청정실, 무진 마스크, 미세 먼지, 외주름, 맞주름, 포켓, 초음파.

title_en: Fire hydrant freeze-proofing method and device by geothermal energy
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire hydrant freeze-proofing method and a device by geothermal energy. According to the method, constant temperature heat from a stratum below the meters of ground surface is adopted and is transferred upwards through a low temperature heat pipe of a fire hydrant geothermal energy device buried underground to heat the fire hydrant, so that the temperature of the fire hydrant body above the ground surface is constantly higher than freezing temperature and the purpose of preventing the fire hydrant from being frozen is achieved. The freeze-proofing device is composed of a heat adsorption fin, a heat release fin, a water supply stand pipe, a low temperature heat pipe, the fire hydrant, a water supply pipe, a stand pipe thermal insulating layer, a hot top and a rapid dismounting clip. The freeze-proofing method of the invention is easy to implement, the freeze-proofing device is easy to be produced and installed, dose not consume energy and is safe, reliable, convenient and effective; and in addition, with the device, the hidden dangers can be eliminated and good guarantee can be provided for fire fighting in the winter.

title_en: Portable infrared pyroelectric life detection instrument for earthquakes
abstract_en: A portable infrared pyroelectric life detection instrument for earthquakes adopts the structure that an infrared sensor is connected with an infrared signal acquisition circuit, the infrared signal acquisition circuit is connected with a signal amplification circuit, the signal amplification circuit is connected with a time control circuit, and the time control circuit is connected with an executive circuit. The utility model has the technical effects that the instrument is simple in structure and small in volume, and can be popularized due to low cost; and as trapped victims can be found to the maximum extent, more rescue time can be gained.

title_en: Method and apparatus for evaluation of a subject's emotional, physiological and/or physical state with the subject's physiological and/or acoustic data
abstract_en: Embodiments of the subject invention relate to a method and apparatus for remote evaluation of a subject's emotive and/or physiological state. Embodiments can utilize a device that can be used to determine the emotional and/or physiological state of a subject through the measurement and analysis of vital signs and/or speech. A specific embodiment relates to a device capable of remotely acquiring a subject's physiological and/or acoustic data, and then correlating and analyzing the data to provide an assessment of a subject's emotional and/or physiological state. In a further specific embodiment, the device can acquire such data, correlate and analyze the data, and provide the assessment of the subject's emotional state and/or physiological in real time.

title_en: Apparatus for measuring the physiological signal, method for providing emergency rescue service and system for emergency rescue using the same
title_ko: 생체신호 측정단말기, 이를 이용한 응급구호 서비스 제공방법 및 응급구호 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A biometric signal measurement terminal, an emergency service supplying method using the same and an emergency system for determining a cautious step and an emergency step are provided to supply an efficient emergency service by determining an emergency situation of the user. CONSTITUTION: A biometric signal measurement sensor(130) measures the biometric signal of a user. A controller(110) controls the measurement signal value is transmitted to a mobile communication terminal(200). A database(150) sets up the cautious step and the emergency step corresponding to a health standard value of the user. If the measurement signal value is less than the lowest limit, an emergency reader determines the cautious step and the emergency step.

title_en: Tube for distribution position adjustment
title_ko: 배선위치 조정용 전선관
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A conduit for the control of a wire position is provided to enable people to rapidly extinguish fires by arranging a fire sensor and a fire hydrant in a wire installation stand and a distribution panel. CONSTITUTION: A one end of a main body member(10) is buried to the underground. The other end of the main body member is communicated with the support plate of a distribution panel. A wire installation stand(20) is arranged in the other end of the main body by passing through the support plate of the distribution panel. A buffer spring is arranged between the support plate of the panel and the wire installation stand in order to elastically support the wire installation stand. A fire sensor(60) is arranged in the bottom surface of the wire installation stand. A controller(70) outputs an opening and closing signal to a fire hydrant according to the fire monitoring signal of the fire sensor. The fire hydrant sprays a fire extinguishing material onto the wire protection member according to the opening and closing signal of the controller.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 일단부가 지중에 매립되고, 타단부가 배전반(1)의 지지플레이트(1-1)와 상호 연통되며, 양단에는 플랜지(11a)가 형성된 원통형상의 전선보호부재(11)와; 전선보호부재(11)의 둘레면에 설치되며, 내주면과 전선보호부재(11)의 외주면 사이에 공기층이 마련되는 럭비공형상의 탄성재질을 갖는 보호튜브(12)와; 플랜지(11a)를 감싸 고정 및 연결하는 탄성재질의 연결고무링(13)과; 반원형을 이루고, 외면에는 다수개의 볼트가 형성되며, 연결고무링(13)의 외면을 감싸 고정하는 한 쌍의 체결링(14)과; 체결링(14)의 볼트에 결합되어 너트를 매개로 고정되는 고정판(15)으로 구성된 본체부(10)와: 일측으로 개구되되, 개구된 내측에는 공간부(21a)가 형성되고, 상면에는 등 간격을 이루며 공간부(21a)와 연통되는 적어도 3개 이상의 장착공(21b)이 구비되며, 지지플레이트(1-1)를 관통하여 본체부(10)의 타단부에 삽탑가능하게 설치되는 도넛형상의 장착대바디(21)와; 공간부(21a)에 형성되되, 장착공(21b)을 기준으로 상호 대향되게 배치되어 한 쌍을 이루는 탄성재질의 가압링억류부재(22)와; 가압링억류부재(22)에 의해 고정되는 탄성재질의 가압링(23)과; 장착대바디(21)의 개구부를 밀폐하고, 전체적으로 원형관 형상을 이루는 가요성 및 탄성 재질의 팽창부재(24)와; 일측이 장착공(21b)에 설치되고, 타측이 컴프레셔(80)에 설치되는 연결부재(25)로 구성된 전선장착대(20)와: 지지플레이트(1-1)와 전선장착대(20) 사이에 설치되어 전선장착대(20)를 탄발지지하는 완충부재(30)와: 상부와 하부에는 돌부(41a)가 형성되며, 지중전선(L)의 둘레면에 고정되는 제1전선고정부(41)와, 외면에는 환형홈(42a)이 형성되고, 내면에는 돌부(41a)에 대응되는 삽입홈(42b)이 마련되어, 제1전선고정부(41)의 둘레면에 상하이동가능하게 설치되는 제2전선고정부(42)를 갖추고서, 전선장착대(20)의 가압링(23) 및 팽창부재(24)에 의해 위치가 고정되는 전선연결부(40)와: 전선장착대(20)의 상면에 설치되며 지중전선(L)에 의해 동작되어 제어부(70)로 감지신호를 출력하는 스위치부(50)와: 전선장착대(20)의 저면에 설치되어 화재시 발생되는 열을 감지하여 제어부(70)로 화재감지신호를 출력하는 화재감지센서(60)와: 스위치부(50)에 인접하게 배치되어 스위치부(50)로부터 감지신호를 입력받아 컴프레셔(80)에 동작신호를 출력하고, 화재감지센서(60)로부터 화재감지신호를 입력받아 소화전(90)의 개폐밸브(93)에 개폐신호를 출력하는 제어부(70)와: 제어부(70)로부터 동작신호를 입력받아 전선장착대(20)의 연결부재(25)에 에어를 공급하는 컴프레셔(80)와: 소화액이 저장되는 저장통(91)과; 장착대바디(21)의 공간부(21a)를 수직관통하는 다수개의 노즐(92a)과, 저장통(91)과 연결되는 연결호스(92b)를 갖추고서, 장착대바디(21)의 상면에 설치되어 저장통(91)으로부터 유입된 소화액을 전선보호부재(11)의 내부로 분사하는 분사관(92)과; 연결호스(92b)에 설치되며 제어부(70)의 개폐신호에 의해 작동제어되는 개폐밸브(93)를 갖춘 소화전(90)을 포함하여 된 것으로서, 전선장착대의 저면에 화재감지센서를 설치하고, 배전반의 내부에 소화전을 마련하여 줌으로서, 지중전선의 손상으로 인한 전기화재시 이를 신속하게 진압할 수 있어 지중전선을 타고 불길이 번지는 것을 방지 및 최소화할 수 있으며, 전선보호부재에 보호튜브를 설치하여 줌으로서, 전선보호부재에 외부요인 작용시 이를 보호튜브 및 보호튜브의 내부에 마련되는 공기층(미도시)이 충격을 흡수하여 전선보호부재가 파손되는 것을 최소화시켜줄 수 있다.

title_en: Sensor for acquiring physiological signals
title_ko: 생체신호를 획득하기 위한 센서
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 특히 센서(1)가 의복(7)에 포함되고 이러한 의복(7)을 착용한 사람이 고 레벨 활동을 하는 경우에, 개선된 실리콘 고무를 가지는, 생체신호를 획득하기 위한 센서(1)에 관한 것이고, 본 발명은 또한 이러한 센서를 포함하는 장치 및 이러한 장치를 포함하는 의복(7)에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Artificial object detection system, method of detecting artificial object used therein, and artificial object detection control program
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an artificial object detection system, capable of efficiently and simultaneously detecting artificial objects existing at the bottom of the sea or water in a wide area, even when an artificial object is buried therein.  <P>SOLUTION: An artificial earthquake generating means (e.g., an artificial earthquake source 11) arranged at a bottom B of the sea or water generates an artificial earthquake. A vibration wave detection means (e.g., a vibration sensor 12) arranged in the sea or water detects the sound waves generated by the artificial earthquake and a vibration wave radiated in the sea or water from the bottom B of the sea or water, with the bottom B propagating an earthquake wave qw being faster than the sound waves. An artificial object presence determination means (e.g., a data processing device 13) detects the arrival orientation of the vibration waves when the level of the vibration waves detected by the vibration sensor 12 is relatively higher and determines that an artificial object HW exists at the bottom B of the sea or water in the arrival orientation.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Fire-prevention and invasion-prevention synchronous early warning system and signal processing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-prevention and invasion-prevention synchronous early warning system based on an FBG (fiber bragg grating) sensing network, comprising such three modules as a sensing optical cable, an optical signal demodulating device and a central processing unit, wherein the sensing optical cable is hung on a perimeter fence or buried underground. By using the characteristics that an FBG sensor is sensitive to both the stress and the temperature and the stress and the temperature result in different wavelength change rules, namely, the FBG reflection wavelength fluctuates rapidly near the static value thereof due to the invasion and the reflection wavelength drifts slowly towards a certain direction due to temperature change, the different characteristics of the temperature and the stress are extracted by using a signal processing method, thus the invasion and the fire disaster are intelligently distinguished, and the corresponding prompting warning is given.

title_en: High-risk place safety guarantee system of digital wireless sensor network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-risk safety guaranteeing system of a digital wireless sensor network, and the high-risk place safety guarantee system is used for guaranteeing safety of firefighters, relief workers and the like in the high-risk places such as fire scenes and mine accident sites. The system comprises a wristwatch module, a helmet module, an air breathing module, a control centre module and a handheld PDA (personal digital assistant) module. According to the invention, the vital signs of people in the high-risk place and the field environment are monitored in real time with the IOT (Internet of things) technology, the real-time tracking and positioning of people in the high-risk place are realized, the field command and scheduling in the high-risk place are accomplished, and the life safety of the people is guaranteed.
assignees: JIANGSU RIFETUNE SOFTWARE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Destructive earthquake automatic voice countdown alarm system and mounting method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alarm system which can automatically send a voice prompt and voice countdown before ground destructive power of an earthquake occurs. In the system, a pressure sensor is buried in a stratum to transmit data to a management computer; related calculation programs and voice prompt contents exist in the management computer; and the management computer is connected with an alarm speaker. A female voice prompt of an earthquake escape method and a countdown background male voice prompt of destructive power occurrence are automatically sent according to a calculation result of pressure change data transmitted by the pressure sensor arranged on an upper stratum on the back airspace side of a free earthquake center block when the free earthquake center block is determined to be unbalanced and starts to move.

title_en: Insert door
title_ko: 접이식 도어
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A folding door is provided to improve safety, prevent noise by the removal of a floor threshold, and make better use of a space. CONSTITUTION: A folding door comprises a door frame(1), a door housing(3), a seating projection, a detection sensor, an upper rail, a lower rail, and an incombustible soundproof material. The door frame is buried under a concrete wall. The door housing accepts a multi-stage door in a folder manner. The seating projection and the detection sensor are mounted in the seating groove. The upper rail and the lower rail guide the horizontal and linear reciprocating motion. The incombustible soundproof material is formed on both sides of the door.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건물의 벽체에 매립시켜 수동 및 자동으로 열고 닫을 수 있는 다단의 접이식 도어에 관한 것이다. 
     사무실이나 주택의 현관. 방. 화장실. 등의 문 에는 일반적으로 사용되는 도어의 종류로는 금속류의 여닫이문을 사용하며 목재용 여닫이나 미닫이문 그리고 유리의 회전 및 여닫이 또는 미닫이의 수동 및 자동문이 등이 사용되고 있다. 
     그러나 현재 도어 사용의 여닫이문은 높이와 넓이의 원둘레 공간을 사용이 제한되고 또한 실내에서 화재발생시 뜨거운 공기의 팽창으로 인한 여닫이문을 개방하기 어려움으로 안전사고에 취약하며 화장실의 목재용 문틀 또는 문은 쉽게 썩어버려 고정 나사못이 이탈되고 변형되어 교체하는 시공비용이 발생하고 세면기 또는 양변기 사용 시에 사용자가 여닫이의 문에 걸려 문 주위를 벗어나야 열고 닫을 수 있는 불편함과 소음에 많이 노출되어 있으며 미닫이문 또한 문의 넓이가 벽체에 매립 또는 벽체에 겹치게 들어감으로 문 주위의 공간사용이 제한되며 레일에서 이탈되면 보수비용이 발생하고 하부 문틀이 없는 것은 흔들림으로 인한 소음이 발생하며 벽체는 기둥의 역할로서 협소한 공간에서는 시공 또한 불가하여 사용함에 불편함이 많고 자동문 역시 정기적으로 벨트 및 기타부품을 교체함으로 자재비 및 인건비가 발생하는 여러 가지의 문제점이 발생하고 있다.   
     따라서 여러 가지의 문제점을 효과적으로 해결하기 위하여 접이식 도어는 전동식과 수동식으로 구분하며 이에 도어의 전체 넓이에다 다단의 도어 중 어느 하나의 폭만 큼을 더한 도어 프레임을 설치함으로 협소한 벽체의 공간에 시공함에 용이하고 도어 수납부에 다단의 도어는 도어의 사이로 들어가 벽체에 매립됨으로 공간사용이 용이하며 화재발생시 압력에도 상. 하부의 레일을 구비하여 원활한 미닫이의 개폐가 용이하며 다단의 도어는 불연 방음재가 구비되며 바닥 문턱을 삭제함으로 상. 하부레일은 수평 및 직선왕복 운동을 유도한다. 
     전동용 접이식 도어는 제어부와 감속하는 구동모터는 클러치기어 그리고 구동 스크루에 볼 롤러를 구비하여 동력전달 부에 연결되며 안전한 개폐를 위하여 안착돌기와 감지센서가 구비되어 개폐스위치를 터치하면 접이식 도어는 자동개폐가 이루어지며 수동은 상기의 전동장치를 제외함으로 제작원가를 절감하고 손잡이를 이용하여 개폐하는 접이식 도어 이다.

title_en: Individual a lie detector
title_ko: 휴대용 거짓말 탐지기
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A portable lie detector is provided to remove a sense of incongruity while miniaturizing by measuring a bio-signal through a small PPG sensor. CONSTITUTION: A portable lie detector includes a sensor unit(110), a signal processing unit(120), and a lie signal generator(130). The sensor unit comprises a skin reflection sensor(111) and a PPG sensor(112). The signal processing unit comprises a signal processing circuit(140), a calculation module(150), a storage(160), and a determination unit(170). Pulse, respiration, electricity reflection from the skin, and a blood pressure signal are measured through a bio-signal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 피험자가 평온한 상태에서 피험자의 맥박 ,혈압, 피부전기반사, 호흡 등 일정시간 동안 생체신호를 PPG 센서, 피부전기반사로 측정한 뒤에 이 측정치를 기준으로 삼고 이후에 측정된 생체신호와 비교하여 기존의 측정 기준 범위를 벗어났을때 거짓말이라고 탐지할 수 있는 장치에 관한 것이다. 
     기존의 거짓말 탐지기의 생체신호 측정 기계가 대형이었으며 장비 이동의 대한 제 약이 있었다. 본 발명은 생체신호를 소형 PPG 센서를 이용해 측정하고 기록장치인 폴리그래프를 사용하지 않고 기록용지를 사람이 확인하는 대신에 생체신호를 디지털 신호로 변환하여 저장하여 측정된 생체신호 값이 기준 범위를 벗어나면 외부신호를 통해 거짓말임을 알 수 있게 거짓말탐지기의 휴대성을 극대화하였다. 
       
     거짓말 탐지기, 피부 전기반사, 맥박, 호흡, 혈류량, PPG센서, 혈압

title_en: Novel method for monitoring strain on earth crust shallow layer
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel method for monitoring strain on an earth crust shallow layer. Practice proves that the strain on the earth crust shallow layer is related to an earthquake precursor, so that the method is a novel method for monitoring the earthquake precursor. By the method provided by the invention, the characteristics of particle media are used, a stress sensor is not arranged in a drill hole of a bed rock on an earth crust deep layer but is embedded in sand of the earth crust shallow layer, and water around the stress sensor is displaced into clean water for washing sand in spite of an earth surface soil stratum or an earth surface bed stratum. The stress sensor is buried below a frozen soil layer and above an underground water level.
assignees: BEIJING PREC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;XIAOMING SUN

title_en: UVB based multi-channel radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a UVB based multi-channel radar life detection instrument for multi-target detection, which comprises a front end of a UWB biologic radar and a computing unit. The front end of the UWB biologic radar comprises a transmitting antenna, three receiving antennas, an impulse oscillator, an electromagnetic pulse generator and a sampling integrator. The transmitting antenna and each receiving antenna form a channel and therefore three channels are formed. The computing unit analyses and processes the collected three radar echo signals and finally extracts life information of multiple human body targets and the two dimensional position information of each target.

title_en: Multichannel multi-human body target two-dimensional positioning method based on UWB (Ultra Wide Band) radar type life detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multichannel multi-human body target two-dimensional positioning method based on a UWB (Ultra Wide Band) radar type life detector. The life detector comprises a transmitting antenna and three receiving antennas which respectively form three radar echo signal channels. The two-dimensional positioning method comprises the following steps of: A1. enhancing a weak life signal of a static human body by all channels and integrating a radar echo signal in distance by all the channels through adopting a method for integrating eight points at an interval of four points; scattering the integrated signal for decomposing, reconstructing and synthesizing a target echo signal and a distance signal; carrying out digital filtration and digital differentiation on the target echo signal and realizing the enhancement of the weak available signal; A2. distinguishing one-dimensional distance, carrying out space frequency analysis according to the target echo signal obtained afterdigital filtration and digital differentiation and the distance signal by all the channels and respectively obtaining three projecting signals of a target in the three channels; and A3. confirming the two-dimensional position information of the target according to the three projecting signals and forming a display image.

title_en: Building earthquake forecasting device based on wireless sensor network
