abstract_en: The utility model relates to a building earthquake forecasting device based on a wireless sensor network, which comprises a data storage server, a plurality of wireless sensor network nodes, a single chip microcomputer and an audible alarm, wherein the single chip microcomputer is in communication with the wireless sensor network nodes. The building earthquake forecasting device is characterized in that parts of the wireless sensor network nodes are connected with a temperature sensor and a shock sensor and buried under a building foundation, the other parts of the wireless sensor network nodes are connected with the shock sensor and arranged among floors, and the single chip microcomputer is connected with the data storage server and the audible alarm. The building earthquake forecasting device is capable of realizing forecasting of an earthquake for people living on low floors, gaining time for residents to escape from a building, and also assisting relevant departments in monitoring earthquakes.

title_en: Mobile phone positioning type life detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mobile phone positioning type life detection device which comprises a fire rescue module (1), an earthquake rescue module (2), a field rescue module (3), a single chip microcomputer processing module (4), a terminal console (5) and a mobile phone signal transmitting and receiving device (6), wherein the fire rescue module (1), the earthquake rescue module (2) and the field rescue module (3) are independent mutually and commonly apply the mobile phone signal transmitting and receiving device (6) for performing life detection and positioning. The mobile phone positioning type life detection device is applicable to life detection and rescue under specific disasters, such as the mobile phone detection technology with low cost adopted in fire rescue, earthquake rescue and field rescue, and a plurality of sensors are used for coordination work, thereby making up for deficiency in precision and being applicable to being put into actual production.

title_en: Multifunctional telemetry alert safety system (MTASS)
abstract_en: A Continuation-in-Part (CIP) of application Ser. No. 12/286,210 for the system of the present invention “Multifunctional Telemetry Alert Safety System” or “MTASS”, which comprises a personnel accountability and situational awareness monitoring communications system for hazardous work personnel that comprises wireless network-adaptable sensoring-monitoring devices, peripherals and base station dashboard software for telemetry monitoring of real-time information at a plurality of personnel accountability and situational awareness parameters of critical data about the safety, health and whereabouts of hazardous workers deployed in typically dangerous environments. Exterior worker management for urban/wildland firefighting, paramedics, search & rescue, hazmat, coal mines, oil platforms, law enforcement, and other hazardous work, achieve real-time command view and control over a variety, of personnel accountability and safety parameters during work activities of personnel wearing the system of the present invention portable device while operating within the mobile ad hoc wireless network. The portable device is a multi-functional sensing and communicating integration of technologies consolidated into one portable, telemetry device. The portable device's multifunctional integrated technology includes the monitoring, telemetry and alert notification of accountability identification, location, assignment notification, vital signs, ambient vicinity temperature, breathing apparatus status, combustible gas sensing, video streaming, “evacuation” recall signaling, signal tracking and multi-alarm signaling if the wearer has either low remaining air pressure/time, impending thermal breakthrough, low battery power, exceed the safety threshold for safe heart rate or external body temperature readings, or becomes motionless for a predetermined time period, or manually signals for help.

title_en: Apparatus and method of wearable detection for underground objects
title_ko: 지하 매설물 착용형 탐지 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A wearing type underground objects detecting apparatus and a method for the same are provided to prevent the occurrence of accidents in an operational field and improve operational efficiency by detecting the buried positions of underground objects in real time. CONSTITUTION: A wireless transmitting unit(111) transmits a transmission detecting sensor(112) by generating a signal for detecting underground objects. A reception detecting sensor(124) receives reflected wave corresponding to the signal from the transmission detecting sensor and transmits the reflected wave to a wireless reception unit(123). The wireless receiving unit transmits the reflected wave from the reception detecting sensor to a recognition signal processing unit(121). The recognition signal processing unit generates detecting information related to underground objects and transmits the detecting information to an indicating and displaying unit(130).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지하 매설물 탐지 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로 특히 착용이 가능한 지하 매설물 탐지 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명에서는 휴대성이 용이하고, 실시간으로 정보를 수신할 수 있으며, 구현이 용이한 지하 매설물 착용형 탐지 장치 및 방법을 제공한다. 
     본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따른 탐지 장치는, 착용형 지하 매설물 탐지 장치에 있어서, 미리 결정된 신호를 미리 결정된 방향으로 송신하는 신호 송신 장치와, 상기 송신된 신호에 대응하는 반사파를 수신하는 수신 탐지 센서와, 상기 수신된 반사파를 수신 신호로 복원하는 무선 수신 장치와, 상기 복원된 수신 신호를 기준으로 상기 매설물의 유/무를 분석하여 상기 매설물의 유/무에 따라 제1인지 신호 및 제2인지 신호를 발생하는 인지 신호 처리 장치를 포함한다. 
       
     착용형, 매설물 탐지, 지하 매설물

title_en: Comprehensive life monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a comprehensive life monitoring system, which comprises a sensor module, a microprocessor module, a power supply module, a wireless communication module and a comprehensive terminal monitoring module, wherein the comprehensive terminal monitoring module is located at an external platform; the sensor module comprises a passive type pyroelectric infrared probe and a gas sensor which are respectively connected with an input port of the microprocessor module; an output port of the microprocessor module is connected with the input port of the wireless communication module; the wireless communication module and the comprehensive terminal monitoring module are in wireless transmission; the wireless communication module adopts a Zigbee module with a wireless positioning function; and the Zigbee module comprises two Zigbee nodes, wherein one of the Zigbee nodes is an FFD (full function device) node, and is fixed in a mine, and the other one of the Zigbee nodes is a RFD (reduced function device) node, and is located on the body of a monitored person. The comprehensive life monitoring system can be used for detecting vital signs of a miner in real time in case of a mine disaster and accurately positioning the miner for effective and timely rescue.

title_en: Apparatus for monitoring physiology-health using mouse pad and method thereof
title_ko: 마우스 패드를 이용한 무자각 건강 모니터링 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A health monitoring apparatus and method thereof which uses a mouse pad are provided to prevent accident through alarm and to continuously monitor a health condition by monitoring a bio-signal through a mouse pad. CONSTITUTION: A health monitoring apparatus(100) includes a mouse pad unit and a health condition processing unit(200). The mouse pad unit includes a human body sensing unit(10) and a bio-signal processing unit. The body sensing unit is installed in the fixed region of a wrist supporting unit of the mouse pad. The body sensing unit includes a PPG sensor, a pressure sensor, a GSP sensor, and temperature sensor.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 마우스 패드를 이용한 건강 모니터링 장치는, 마우스의 안착면을 갖는 판의 형상이며, 일측에는 사용자의 손목을 지지하는 손목 지지부가 마련된 마우스 패드와, 손목 지지부의 소정 영역에 내장되고, 사용자의 손목부분의 광혈류, 피부저항 및 온도를 포함하는 생체신호를 감지하는 인체 감지부와, 인체 감지부로부터 감지된 사용자의 생체신호들을 증폭 및 필터링한 후 상기 생체신호를 분석 및 가공하여 무선신호로 송출하는 생체신호 처리부를 포함하는 마우스 패드 장치; 및 마우스 패드 장치로부터 무선신호를 수신하여 모니터링 프로그램에 따라 사용자의 건강상태를 판정하는 건강상태 처리장치를 구비한다. 
       
     마우스 패드, 생체신호, 분석, 경고, 모니터링, 건강

title_en: Remote emergency monitoring system
title_ko: 원격 응급상황 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A remote monitoring system for emergency situation is provided to shorten time required for a rescuing process by obtaining the disease history, the address, and the emergency contact number of a target according to the emergency signal of the target. CONSTITUTION: A monitoring server(10) analyzes bio signal data and verifies an emergency situation using a calculator. An user terminal(20) includes a vital sensor and a zigbee module. The vital sensor is worn in the wrist of a user. The bio signal data including the pulse of a user is measured. The zigbee module transfers and receives data through a zigbee communication. A plurality of gateways(30) includes an AP zigbee module, an AP communicator, and an AP controller. The AP zigbee module receives data from the zigbee module. The AP communicator transfers and receives data with the monitoring server. The AP controller transfers an intrinsic terminal ID, the bio signal data, and an intrinsic gateway ID to the monitoring server.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 원격 응급상황 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 사용자의 팔목에 착용되어 생체신호정보를 측정할 수 있는 바이탈센서가 구비된 사용자단말기와, 상기 사용자단말기와 지그비 무선 통신을 이용하여 상기 바이탈센서에서 측정된 생체신호정보를 수신받고 수신받은 생체신호정보를 통신망을 이용하여 원격지에 위치된 모니터링 서버에 송신할 수 있는 게이트웨이와, 수신받은 사용자의 생체신호정보를 분석하여 응급상황을 판단할 수 있는 모니터링 서버가 상호 유기적으로 결합된 모니터링 시스템을 구축함으로써 사용자 특히, 독거노인이나 장애인과 같이 거동이 불편한 사람에게 유용하게 활용할 수 있고, 사회구조 서비스로 활용할 수 있으며, 갑작스런 심장마비나 의식불명 등 응급상황 발생시에 신체의 맥박 등 신체신호정보와 IT 기술의 접목으로 응급상황을 모니터링할 수 있도록 한 원격 응급상황 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 원격 응급상황 모니터링 시스템은, 원격지에 위치되고 사용자의 생체신호정보를 분석하여 응급상황을 판단할 수 있는 연산부가 구비된 모니터링 서버와; 사용자의 팔목에 착용되어 사용자의 맥박을 포함한 생체신호정보를 측정할 수 있는 바이탈센서와, 지그비 무선 통신을 이용하여 정보의 송수신이 가능한 사용자지그비모듈과, 사용자의 식별을 위한 고유 단말기ID가 저장되고 고유 단말기ID 및 상기 바이탈센서로부터 측정된 생체신호정보를 외부로 송신하도록 상기 사용자지그비모듈을 제어하는 단말기제어부가 구비된 사용자단말기와; 상기 사용자지그비모듈로부터 송신된 정보를 수신받을 수 있는 AP지그비모듈과, 통신망을 통해 상기 모니터링 서버와 정보의 송수신이 가능한 AP통신부와, 상기 AP지그비모듈을 통해 수신된 고유 단말기ID 및 생체신호정보를 상기 모니터링 서버로 송신하도록 상기 AP통신부를 제어하는 AP제어부가 구비된 게이트웨이를; 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Remote diagnosis system for faults of freight train on road
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of train transportations and provides a remote diagnosis system for faults of a freight train on road. The system mainly comprises a portable detector connected by network, a special railway management system and a fault diagnosis module; the portable detector comprises an intelligent processing unit, an infrared temperature detecting unit, an image shooting unit, an audio recording unit, a network transmission unit, a locating unit, an interface and a power supply unit; and the special railway management system comprises a data server, a management platform and an emergency commanding repeating terminal. Pictures and data of the faults are collected by the portable detector and are transmitted to a remote database for experts to diagnose, then the diagnosis result is transmitted back to the portable detector; and the field train operation personnel can timely repair the faults according to the diagnosis result; in this way, the hidden safety troubles buried by the field operating personnel due to error operations caused by limited professional knowledge can be shot; meanwhile, the lines are guaranteed to be opened timely, and the transmission efficiency is improved.

title_en: Earthquake alarm method and device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of earthquake disaster reduction, and relates to a new detection method for updating an earthquake detection concept, which comprises the following steps: the earthquake omnibearing signal is detected by the linkage mechanism and the magnetic sensor, and the earthquake alarm method solves the problems of signal loss and error and prevents the missed alarm. And a plurality of detection modes can be singly selected or selected to form a plurality of measuring and reporting devices with function difference, so that manufacturers can select or regulate and control measuring and reporting modes according to different regional requirements, and the like, thereby breaking the old mode that longitudinal waves and transverse waves of the traditional alarm are respectively singly measured and reported. The earthquake-proof lifesaving box is integrated with functions of recording messages, sending distress signals and the like, wherein a solid conduction sound sensor is designed for blocking sound conduction, all sound and information can be recorded or stored in a storage device at any time in advance, earthquake process data can be recorded, infrared ray sending and infrared life detection instruments are adopted to correspond, and the earthquake-proof lifesaving box is a quakeproof lifesaving project invention with the theme of improving lifesaving effect and is called as an earthquake lifesaving black box for short.

title_en: Method and apparatus for measuring body impedance based on baseband signal detection
abstract_en: Certain aspects of the present disclosure relate to techniques for measuring body impedance based on baseband signal detection in analog domain. Proposed methods and apparatus are able to measure an impedance of human body based on sub-Nyquist sampling of signals. The proposed techniques can be particularly beneficial for reducing overall sensor power when an actuation signal generates electrical signals corresponding to vital signs in humans.
assignees: GARUDADRI HARINATH;BAHETI PAWAN K;MAJUMDAR SOMDEB;QUALCOMM INC

title_en: A radar apparatus for detecting multiple life-signs of a subject, a method and a computer program product
abstract_en: The invention relates to a radar apparatus for detecting a life-sign of a subject, comprising a transmitter system for emitting a transmission electromagnetic beam to the chest and/or the abdomen of a subject, a receiving system for receiving first reflected electromagnetic beam data from the chest and/or the abdomen, and a processor unit for processing the first received beam data retrieving breath activity information. The transmitter system, the receiving system and the processor are further arranged for performing a radar measurement of a superficial artery structure, such as a wrist artery, an ankle artery, a carotid artery and/or the fontanel artery for retrieving heart activity information.

title_en: Systems and methods for non-contact multiparameter vital signs monitoring, apnea therapy, sway cancellation, patient identification, and subject monitoring sensors
abstract_en: Aspects of the of the disclosure relate to a non-contact physiological motion sensor and a monitor device that can incorporate use of the Doppler effect. A continuous wave of electromagnetic radiation can be transmitted toward one or more subjects and the Doppler- shifted received signals can be digitized and/or processed subsequently to extract information related to the cardiopulmonary motion in the one or more subjects. The extracted information can be used, for example, to determine apneic events and/or to provide apnea therapy to subjects when used in conjunction with an apnea therapy device. In addition, methods of use are disclosed for sway cancellation, realization of cessation of breath, integration with multi-parameter patient monitoring systems, providing positive providing patient identification, or any combination thereof.
assignees: KAI MEDICAL INC;DROITCOUR AMY;VERGARA ALEXANDER;SHING TOMMY;EL HOURANI CHARLES;NAKATA ROBERT;MOSTAFANEZHAD ISAR;MIYASATO SCOTT

title_en: Physiological signal analysis system, and method using the same
title_ko: 생체신호 분석 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A bio-signal analysis system and method are provided to measure a bio-signal of examinee more accurately by providing the bio-signal analysis system that consists of a bio-signal sensor and a terminal expressed the bio-signal measured at from the bio-signal sensor. CONSTITUTION: A bio-signal sensor(100) senses and transmits the bio-signal of examinee. The bio-signal sensor comprises a power supply unit(110) supplying the power, an A/D converter(130) and a sensor unit(120) sensing the bio-signal of examinee. The A/D converter changes an analog bio-signal sensed in the sensor unit to a digital bio-signal. The terminal(200) receives the bio-signal sensed from the bio-signal sensor and stores, analyzes and indicates it.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 생체신호분석시스템 및 이를 이용한 거짓말 탐지방법에 관한 것으로, 구체적으로 피검자의 신체에 부착되어 피검자의 생체신호를 감지 및 전송하는 생체신호감지기 및 상기 생체신호감지기로부터 측정된 생체신호를 수신, 저장 및 분석하여 표시하는 단말기로 이루어진 생체신호분석시스템, 및 이를 이용한 거짓말 탐지방법을 제공한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 피검자의 신체에 부착되어 피검자의 생체신호를 감지 및 전송하는 생체신호감지기, 및 상기 생체신호감지기로부터 측정된 생체신호를 수신, 저장 및 분석하여 표시하는 단말기로 이루어진 생체신호분석시스템을 제공함으로써 피검자의 생체신호를 더욱 정확하게 측정할 수 있고, 피검자 이외의 다수의 제3자가 피검자의 생체신호에 접근하는 것이 가능하며, 나아가 피검자의 생체신호를 사용자의 니즈에 부합하도록 다양하게 활용할 수 있다.

title_en: Rescue system for a collapse
title_ko: 붕괴에 따른 조난 구조 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a rescue system for a collapse, in which a body detection unit is installed in order to detect the presence of people inside a building, and a tilt sensor and an acceleration sensor are installed in order to set changed tilt data and acceleration data as an event trigger signal, when an earthquake or external shock occurs. Moreover, by analyzing a signal measured in the body detection unit at a predetermined time before the event trigger signal occurs, if someone was in the building before a collapse accident, the place where people are buried is announced through a voice or Morse code via an alarm unit in order to perform a rescue operation quickly. As a result, accident mortality from a collapse may be drastically reduced.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인체 감지부를 설치하여 건축물 내부 사람의 유무를 감지하고 경사 센서와 가속도 센서를 설치하여 지진 또는 외부의 충격이 발생할 경우 변화되는 경사 데이터와 가속도 데이터를 이벤트 트리거 신호로 설정하여 이벤트 트리거 신호가 발생한 시점의 일정시간 전 인체 감지부에서 계측한 신호를 분석하여 건축물의 붕괴사고 발생 전 사람이 있을 경우 경보 알람부를 통해 사람이 매몰된 장소의 위치를 음성 또는 모스부호를 통해 경보하여 신속하게 구조 작업을 진행할 수 있도록 함으로써 붕괴에 의한 사고 사망률을 현저히 저감할 수 있는 붕괴에 따른 조난 구조 시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: KOREA MAINTENANCE CO LTD;CHOI JUN SEONG;SONG JEA HWAN;KANG SUNG MIN

title_en: Patient monitoring and surveillance system, methods, and devices
abstract_en: Provided herein are methods, devices and systems for the remote monitoring and/or surveillance of a patient's location, position, movement, vital signs, biopotentials, or a combination thereof using transmission of stepped-frequency radar signals, detecting reflections of the transmitted signals and processing the frequency and phase shifts.
assignees: LIFEFLOW TECHNOLOGIES INC;BROWN DAVID;NORDIN DAVID;TERAN MANUEL

title_en: Wearable monitoring apparatus
title_ko: 착용형 모니터링 장치
abstract_ko:
실시예는 착용형 모니터링 장치에 관한 것이다. 
실시예에 따른 착용형 모니터링 장치는, 피부에 부착 가능하게 형성되고, 복수 개로 배열된 전극을 이용하여 인체로부터 신호 대 잡음비를 측정하고, 측정된 신호 대 잡음비에 기초하여 복수 개의 전극 중 생체신호를 측정하기 위한 전극들을 선택하고, 선택된 전극들을 이용하여 하나 이상의 생체신호를 검출하는 센서부, 및 피부에 부착 가능하게 형성되고, 센서부를 통해 검출된 생체신호를 수집하는 단말부를 포함하고, 센서부 및 단말부는, 인체 통신을 이용하여 데이터를 송수신하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Emergency rescue assisting devices and the method
title_ko: 응급구호 보조장치와 이를 이용한 응급구호방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An auxiliary device for emergency relief and an emergency relief method using the same are provided to safely and accurately implement emergency relief by properly assists the relief operation of an operator. CONSTITUTION: A first bio-signal sensor part senses the bio-signal of the state of the respiratory organ of a patient. A second bio-signal sensor part senses the bio-signal of the state of the circulatory system of the patient. A chest pressure tuning sensor part comprises a dynamometer sensor sensing the intensity of chest pressure and a nine shaft displacement sensor sensing the accuracy of pressure. A wireless data transceiver wirelessly transmits data to an external personal computer or a server. A memory storage part stores chest pressure data.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 응급구호 보조장치와 이를 이용한 방법에 관한 것이다. 
급성 심정지 환자와 같은 응급 구호상황이 발생했을 때, 본 발명에 의하면 먼저 환자의 생체 호흡기 신호를 감지하는 제 1 생체신호 센서부; 환자의 순환기 생체 상태를 감지하는 제 2 생체신호 센서부; 환자의 흉골을 압박하여 흉부 압박의 힘의 강도를 감지하는 검력계 센서와 흉부압박의 정확성을 감지하는 9축 변위센서를 사용하는 흉부압박 조율 센서부; 와 상기 센서부로 부터 신호 값을 유선전송 받거나 혹은 무선 전송받는 무선데이터 송수신부;와 모니터링하여 이를 표시하는 표시부;와 압박 속도 및 안내콘텐츠를 버저와 스피커로 재생해주는 음량발생부;와 9축 변위 센서의 기준값을 저장하고 흉부압박 전과정의 데이터를 저장하는 메모리 저장부;와 데이터 필요시 또는 실시간으로 데이터를 출력해주는 프린터부;를 포함하며,필요한 전원을 공급해주는 전원부;를 포함하고, 전체 를 제어 통제하는 중앙연산 장치부를 포함 구성하는 응급구호 보조장치와 이를 이용한 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Emergency rescue system in the ship using biological signal
title_ko: 생체신호를 이용한 선박 내 응급구조구난 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 생체신호를 이용한 선박 내 응급구조구난 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면, 해상 및 선박 내에서 승객에게서 발생할 수 있는 응급상황을 실시간으로 판단하고, 신속한 대처를 할 수 있어 귀중한 인명의 피해를 줄일 수 있게 된다. 또한, 재난상황이 발생한 경우, 위치기반 센서(140)에 의해 환자의 정확한 위치를 알아낼 수 있어, 바다에 빠져 조난을 당하거나, 다수의 층과 객실로 이루어지거나 위락 시설이 설치되어 있는 복잡한 구조를 갖는 대형 여객선과 같은 곳에서 즉각적인 응급 구조 조치를 할 수 있게 된다.
assignees: MOKPO NAT UNIV IND ACAD COOP

title_en: Memory-based, real time feedback system using the processing of several pieces of bio-information into unified communication frames
title_ko: 메모리 기반 다중 생체정보의 통신 프레임 단일화 처리를 통한 실시간 피드백시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a memory-based, real time feedback system using the processing of several pieces of bio-information into unified communication frames, wherein the system is installed in a home or public facility, for detecting bio-signals emitted by a user, analyzing the bio-signals and providing various information to enable the user to autonomously manage the user's health, checking the condition of the user's body in real time so as to determine whether an emergency situation arises and allow a course of action to be taken that is required for said emergency situation. The real time feedback system comprises a bio-signal measuring terminal and a health management apparatus. The bio-signal measuring terminal comprises: a plurality of bio-signal detection sensors for detecting bio-signals of a user; and frame generating means for consolidating information on the bio-signals into one data frame, generating body information data from the data frame, and transmitting the body information data. The health management apparatus comprises: a receiving unit for receiving body information data from the bio-signal measuring terminal; data categorizing means for categorizing body information from the body information data received by the receiving unit; storage means for storing the body information; data analysis means for analyzing the body information stored in the storage means, when input or set analysis conditions for a user analysis request signal are satisfied; and a control unit including control means for receiving an input signal from an input unit and controlling the operation of the data analysis means, and for receiving the analysis results of the data analysis means and transmitting the analysis results via an output unit to an output terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 일반 가정 또는 공공장소 등에 설치되어 사용자가 발산하는 생체신호를 감지하고 이를 분석해서 상기 사용자가 자발적으로 건강관리를 하기 위한 다양한 정보를 제공하고, 사용자의 몸 상태를 실시간으로 확인해서 응급상황 여부까지 판단해 처리할 수 있도록 한 메모리 기반 다중 생체정보의 통신 프레임 단일화 처리를 통한 실시간 피드백시스템에 관한 것으로, 사용자의 생체신호를 감지하는 다수의 셍체신호 감지센서와; 상기 생체신호에 대한 정보를 하나의 데이터 프레임으로 통합해 신체정보데이터로 생성해서 발신하는 프레임생성수단;이 구비된 생체신호 측정단말기, 생체신호 측정단말기로부터 신체정보데이터를 수신하는 수신부와; 수신부의 신체정보데이터로부터 신체정보를 분류하는 데이터분류수단과, 상기 신체정보를 저장하는 저장수단과, 사용자분석요청신호의 입력 또는 설정된 분석조건이 만족되면 저장수단에 저장된 신체정보를 분석하는 데이터분석수단과, 입력부의 입력신호를 수신해서 데이터분석수단의 동작을 제어하고 데이터분석수단의 분석결과를 받아 출력부를 통해 출력단말기로 전송하는 제어수단이 구비된 제어부;가 구비된 건강관리장치를 포함하는 것이다.
assignees: KOREA ELECTRONICS TECHNOLOGY;SON JAE GI;PARK CHANG WON;CHUNG HA JOONG;JEON KI MAN;KIM YOUNG HWAN;KIM HYUN WOO

title_en: Fire fighting protective clothing embedded with vital sign detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to fire fighting protective clothing embedded with a vital sign detection device, which comprises a fire fighting protective clothing body and is characterized in that the vital sign detection device is embedded in the fire fighting protective clothing body; the vital sign detection device comprises a data acquisition module, a wireless sensor network communication module and a power supply module; the data acquisition module is connected with the wireless sensor network communication module; the wireless sensor network communication module is connected with an antenna; and the power supply module is respectively connected with the data acquisition module and the wireless sensor network communication module. After the fire fighting protective clothing is adopted, vital signs of a fire fighter, which comprises pulse and breath, can be detected in real time, wherein the two parameters can represent the health condition and the physical consumption of the fire fighter; and data is transmitted to a control system of a fire engine through a wireless sensor network, so that a fire commander can make a correct decision according to the special body condition of the fire fighter on site, which is very beneficial to the life safety of the fire fighter.

title_en: Safety helmet with lifesaving function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a safety helmet with a lifesaving function, which consists of a safety helmet, a life signal amplifier and a wireless signal sound receiving device, wherein the life signal amplifier consists of a sensor, a lead and a life signal amplifier body, is capable of collecting life signals of human bodies and processing and outputting the life signals, can be used for searching, rescuing and positioning trapped persons in disaster incidents and can be used for monitoring physiological states of people in daily work and life; and the wireless signal sound receiving device can be used for receiving wireless voice signals with a specific frequency, can be used for guiding escape for the people during emergency evacuation and can be used for scheduling and managing the people in daily production and management.

title_en: Buried object survey device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To easily remove striped noise components included in a received signal of an underground radar device to improve visibility of an image.SOLUTION: For pieces of one-dimensional image data f(t) in all reflection time axis directions in two-dimensional image data, the pieces of data are transformed into time-frequency areas by one-dimensional wavelet analysis, time-frequency data is calculated, and frequency components of vertical striped noise are calculated, after that, first filtering processing for extracting the noise components is executed, and second filtering processing for removing vertical striped noise components extracted from the original two-dimensional image data is executed to remove the vertical striped noise, and similar noise removal processing is further executed for the pieces of one-dimensional image data f(t) in all moving distance axis directions in the two-dimensional image data to remove the horizontal striped noise.
assignees: NIPPON SIGNAL CO LTD:THE;UNIV OF ELECTRO-COMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Garment able to measure physical signal and the system using that
title_ko: 생체신호 수집이 가능한 의류 및 이를 이용한 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A garment able to measure physical signal and a system using the same are provided to help a user to manage an emergency situation by collecting a bio-signal and transmitting it to a management system in wireless. CONSTITUTION: In a garment able to measure physical signal and a system using the same, a fiber type sensor senses a bio-signal. The bio-signal transmission line transmits a detected bio-signal. A signal transmission unit(100) transmits the detected bio-signal to outside in wireless. The signal transmission unit transmits data in one of Zigbee communication and Bluetooth communication. The garment is comprised of a conductive fiber and a fiber sensor. A bio-information management server deciphers the bio-signal received from the garment.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 의복 착용자의 착용감과 편리성을 최대화하면서도 생체신호를 정확하게 측정할 수 있도록 하는 생체신호 수집이 가능한 의류 및 이를 이용한 시스템에 관한 것으로, 생체신호를 감지하는 섬유형 센서, 전기 전도성을 가진 직물로 구현되며, 상기 섬유형 센서와 연결되어 감지된 상기 생체신호를 전송하는 생체신호 전송 선로 및 상기 생체신호 전송 선로와 연결되어 상기 감지된 생체신호를 수신하여 외부로 무선 송신하는 신호 송신부를 포함하며, 이에 따라 비침습, 무구속적으로 생체신호를 측정함에 따라 인체의 다양한 활동시에도 쾌적한 착의성을 도모할 수 있으며, 섬유형 센서 및 전도성 섬유를 이용하여 신호의 측정 및 전달이 이루어지도록 함으로써 인체의 다양한 동작에도 안정적인 생체정보 획득과 안정적인 생체정보 전달을 가능하게 할 수 있다.

title_en: Eemergency shelter apparatus a hatch type
title_ko: 해치형 비상 피난장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A hatch type emergency sheltering device is provided to enable residents, the old, and children to rapidly escape in an emergency. CONSTITUTION: A hatch type emergency sheltering device comprises: a frame(10) which is buried in a square form in the veranda floor of an apartment house and is vertically penetrated in a size that a user can come in and out; a hatch cover(20) which is hinge-coupled with the top of the frame and is installed to be able to be opened and closed; a hatch cover opening and closing part(60) which opens and close the hatch cover; a supporting plate elevating unit which is installed in the lower part of the frame; a load sensor installed in one side of the frame; a heat/smoke sensor which senses indoor heat or smoke; and a controller(90) which elevates the supporting plate.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재와 같이 비상시에 화재가 발생한 아래층으로 노약자, 어린이들이 안전하고 빠르게 대피할 수 있도록 함과 동시에 홈오토메이션과 연동하여 외부와 커뮤니케이션을 통해 타인에게 피해를 최소한으로 줄이고, 또한 피난장치에 의해 층간 소음이 전달되는 것을 방지할 수 있도록 한 해치형 비상 피난장치에 관한 것으로, 다수의 가구가 공동으로 거주하는 공동주택의 베란다 바닥에 사각형의 형태로 매립 설치되어 사람이 출입할 수 있는 크기의 상하로 관통된 프레임; 프레임의 상부에 힌지 결합되어 개폐 가능하게 설치되는 해치덮개; 해치덮개를 개폐시키는 해치덮개 해치덮개 개폐부; 프레임의 하부에 승강 가능하게 설치되어지되 그 상부로 인원의 탑승이 이루어지는 받침판; 받침판을 지지하여 전원의 인가에 의해 승강시키는 받침판 승강수단; 프레임의 일측에 설치되어지되 받침판의 하중을 감지하여 설정된 하중을 기준으로 이상의 하중일 경우에는 받침판 승강수단을 통해 하강시키는 한편 이하의 하중일 경우에는 받침판 승강수단을 통해 상승시키는 하중감지센서; 공동주택의 내부에 설치되어 화재로 인한 열 또는 연기의 발생시 실내 내부의 열 또는 연기를 감지하는 열/연기 감지기; 및 열/연기 감지기로부터 감지된 신호에 따라 해치덮개 개폐부를 제어하여 해치덮개를 개폐시키는 한편 하중감지센서에 의한 하중 감지를 통해 받침판 승강수단을 제어하여 받침판을 승강시키는 컨트롤러를 포함한 구성으로 이루어진다.
assignees: DAEMYUNG MACHINE IND CO LTD;SEOHAN F & AMP C CO LTD

title_en: Matrix-type three-dimensional-layered landslide monitoring and early-warning system
abstract_en: A matrix-type three-dimensional-layered landslide monitoring and early-warning system characterized in that: the system consists of stand-alone positioning sensors (1), and a relay station (2) and a monitoring center (3) in proximity to the stand-alone positioning sensors. The stand-alone positioning sensors are buried vertically in positions in a mountain requiring monitoring. The stand-alone positioning sensors are each provided with a radio module, a battery (1-7), and a positioning response device. A wireless signal transmitted by the stand-alone positioning sensors (1) is received and retransmitted by the relay station to the monitoring center (3) reception system. The advantages of the early-warning system are: the early-warning system has a long life, allows for automatic remote monitoring, has a simple structure, has accurate early-warning capabilities, and does not consume energy during periods of inactivity. The stand-alone positioning sensors remain hidden from sight and are not easily damaged. The early-warning system minimizes losses caused by natural disasters such as landslides, mudslides, and sand dune movements.

title_en: System for automatically classifying sleep stages on the basis of biosignals
title_ko: 생체신호 기반 자동 수면단계 분류시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for automatically classifying sleep stages on the basis of biosignals for predicting sleep stages using mutually different biosignals. For this purpose, the present invention relates to a system for automatically classifying sleep stages on the basis of biosignals, comprising: a biosignal detection unit using EEG, EOG, EMG, PPG, SKT, and GSR sensors to acquire various biosignals through mutually different channels; a signal-processing and characteristic extraction unit using a method suitable for extracting the characteristics of each biosignal to process the various biosignals acquired through each channel by the biosignal detection unit, and extract a certain characteristic from each of the biosignals; a subset-generating unit for generating biosignal groups based on the certain characteristics of each biosignal extracted by the signal-processing and characteristic extraction unit; and a performance evaluation unit for classifying the biosignals into sleep stage categories (i.e. REM, LS, and DS) using the biosignal groups formed by the subset-generating unit, and analyzing a performance evaluation of the groups for each stage, wherein for the analysis of sleep stages using mutually different biosignals, sleep stages can be accurately and conveniently predicted through the combination of biosignals in order to enable accurate measurement and convenience.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 생체신호 기반 자동 수면단계 분류시스템에 관한 것으로, 서로 다른 조건의 생체신호를 이용하여 수면 단계를 예측하기 위한 것이다. 이를 위하여 본 발명은 EEG, EOG, EMG, PPG, SKT, GSR 센서를 이용하여 서로 다른 채널을 통해 다양한 생체 신호를 획득하는 생체신호 검출부, 생체신호 검출부에서 각 채널을 통해 획득된 다양한 생체신호를 각 생체신호의 특징 추출에 적합한 방법으로 신호 처리를 실시하여 각각의 생체신호로부터 각 생체신호의 특징을 나타내는 특징점을 추출하는 신호 처리 및 특징 추출부, 신호 처리 및 특징 추출부의 각 생체신호에 대한 특징점을 기준으로 생체신호 조합을 생성하는 서브셋 발생부, 및 서브셋 발생부에서 조합된 생체신호 조합을 통하여 수면단계(REM,LS,DS)를 분류하고, 각 단계에 따른 조합의 성능 평가를 분석하는 성능 평가부를 포함하는 생체신호 기반 자동 수면단계 분류시스템을 제공하여, 서로 다른 조건의 생체신호를 이용한 수면 단계 분석시 측정의 정확도와 편리성을 고려한 최적의 생체신호 조합으로 수면 단계를 정확하고 편리하게 예측할 수 있게 한다.
assignees: UNIV YONSEI IACF;YOO SEON KOOK;LEE CHUNG KI

title_en: Full fabric skin sensing autonomous flexible deformation search and rescue robot and operating method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a full fabric skin sensing autonomous flexible deformation search and rescue robot and an operating method thereof. The search and rescue robot consists of three parts, namely a head part, a body part and a tail part, wherein the three parts are connected together through a connecting mechanism; the head part is provided with a life detection device, a driving device, a control device, a power device, a communication device, a camera and an infrared device; the body part and the tail part are provided with a driving device, a control device and a power device; each part consists of a plurality of joints; a deformation mechanism is a structure which is used for supporting in the joints; the joints are connected together through the driving device; and the outer surface of the entire robot is covered by a flexible fabric skin layer. The robot is suitable for executing detection tasks of living bodies under ruin environments of earthquake, coal mine disasters and the like; the robot can also enter a narrow space in ruins through deformation of the robot to detect life information; and thus, the search and rescue range of the robot is expanded, the rescue efficiency is increased, and valuable time is brought for rescuing more lives.

title_en: Respirator with end-of-service-life detection
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to methods and apparatus for detecting when respiratory cartridges of a respirator have reached their end-of-service-life. In some instances, two or more respiratory cartridges are removably connectable to a respirator housing, where each of the two or more respiratory cartridges receives ambient air and deliver cleaned air to the respirator housing. One of the respiratory cartridges may be configured to have a lower adsorption capacity than the remaining respirator cartridges. A gas sensor may be situated downstream of the reduced capacity respirator cartridge, and may detect an increased concentration of the targeted gas in the cleaned air delivered by the reduced capacity respiratory cartridge. When detected, an end-of-service-life indication may be provided to the user.

title_en: Piezoelectric film sensor and wireless respiration detection circuit's MCP packaging form
abstract_en: The invention discloses an MCP packaging form of a piezoelectric film sensor and a wireless respiration detection circuit. The MCP packaging structure is as follows: the wireless respiration detection circuit chip is fixed on the piezoelectric film sensor through a fixing adhesive layer, a conductive pin of the chip is connected to the antenna and the piezoelectric film sensor, and the chip and the connection part of the conductive pin, the antenna and the piezoelectric film sensor are wrapped by a packaging filling body. The system has small size, low cost, simple manufacture and easy use by adopting the MCP packaging form.

title_en: Terminal for carrying out far-distance monitoring on life information of wounded persons in disaster environment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a terminal for carrying out far-distance monitoring on the life information of wounded persons in a disaster environment. The terminal comprises a man-machine interface module, a communication module, a CPU (central processing unit) control module, a positioning module, a vital sign detection sensor and a power supply module, wherein the communication module is respectively connected with a rescue command center module and the CPU control module, the man-machine interface module is connected with the CPU control module, the positioning module is connected with the CPU control module, the vital sign detection sensor is connected with the CPU control module, and the power supply module is connected with all the modules above so as to supply power for the modules. The terminal disclosed by the utility model comprehensively integrate the functions of satellite positioning, vital sign monitoring and information transmission, thereby achieving an integration effect; the location positioning of an individual soldier is performed by using a Beidou-2 satellite navigation system and GPS (global positioning system) compatible chips; the short message transmission is performed by using a BD1 (Beidou-1) satellite navigation system, thereby ensuring the demands of communication in the disaster environment; a plurality of vital sign monitoring modules are integrated, and an effect of expert diagnosis can be achieved; and a low-power-consumption and lightweight miniaturization design is adopted.
assignees: BEIJING AEROSPACE SCIENCE & INDUSTRY CENTURY SATELLITE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Multichannel ultra wide band based (uwb-based) radar life detector and positioning method thereof
abstract_en: A multichannel ultra wide band based (UWB-based) radar type life detector and a two-dimensional positioning method thereof are provided. The life detector comprises a transmitting antenna and three receiving antennas, which respectively form three radar echo signal channels. The two-dimensional positioning method comprises the following steps: A1, enhancing a weak vital sign signal of a static human body in each channels and integrating a radar echo signal in distance in each channels through adopting a method of integrating eight points at an interval of four points; scattering the integrated signal for decomposing, reconstructing and synthesizing a target echo signal and a distance signal; carrying out digital filtration and digital differentiation on the target echo signal and realizing the enhancement of the weak usable signal; A2, distinguishing one-dimensional distance, carrying out space frequency analysis in each channels according to the target echo signal obtained after digital filtration and digital differentiation and the distance signal, and respectively obtaining three projecting signals of the target in three channels; and A3, confirming the two-dimensional position information of the target according to the three projecting signals and displaying an image.
assignees: FOURTH MILITARY MEDICAL UNIV;WANG JIANQI;JING XIJING;ZHANG YANG;LU HAO;LI YANFENG;LI ZHAO;JIAO TENG;YU XIAO

title_en: Control system of wireless sensing mine rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a control system of a wireless sensing mine rescue robot, relates to a control system of a robot and solves the problems that the existing rescue robot sensor has a single type and a small number and underground cables are possibly damaged in accidents to cause system breakdown. A first input/output end of a main controller is connected with an input/output end of a wireless communication system based on the zigbee technology; a second input/output end of the main controller is connected with an input/output end of an ultrasonic obstacle avoiding system; a third input/output end of the main controller is connected with an input/output end of a life detection system; an output end of a positioning system is connected with a fourth input end of the main controller; an output end of a vision system is connected with a fifth input end of the main controller; an output end of an underground environment detection system is connected with a sixth input end of the main controller; and an output end of a power module is connected with a seventh input end of the main controller. The control system disclosed by the utility model is mainly used for collecting the complicated environment information underground in the case of mine disasters, and realizes real-time, accurate and comprehensive information collection.

title_en: Radar type life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a radar formula life detection instrument, including the computational element: calculating the standard deviation of the radar echo signals; a judging unit: judging that radar echoes are interfered by RFI based on the standard deviation; a processing unit: and carrying out frequency domain amplitude limiting on the echo containing the RFI interference, and not processing the echo containing no RFI interference. Adopt the technical scheme of the utility model, can be when effectively restraining RFI better the integrality that has kept target information, have that the algorithm is simple, calculate high efficiency, effectual characteristics.
assignees: WUXI JUNSHUAI ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus adjustable level of the manhole cover assembly and construction method of the same
title_ko: 높이조절용 맨홀뚜껑 조립체 및 그의 시공방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A height-adjustable manhole cover assembly and a construction method thereof are provided to prevent differential settlement and secure superior evenness of a road. CONSTITUTION: A height-adjustable manhole cover assembly comprises a primary manhole cover support(2) and a secondary manhole cover support(4). The primary manhole cover support is buried in a sub base material of aggregate in order to prevent obstacles to compaction work. The primary manhole cover support has a height for leveling a manhole cover(1) to the sub base material. The secondary manhole cover support is coupled to the primary manhole cover support. The secondary manhole cover support has a height for leveling the manhole cover to the surface layer.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 높이가 다른 1차 및 2차 맨홀뚜껑 받침대를 이용하여, 맨홀설치후 자갈의 보조기층재와 아스콘의 표층 포설시공시 1차 및 2차 맨홀뚜껑 받침대와 맨홀뚜껑이 보조기층 및 표층과 레벨을 같게 함으로써 맨홀뚜껑에 의한 지장물 발생을 제거하여 그레이더 및 다짐장비에 의한 1차 및 2차 포설 및 다짐을 견고하게 할 수 있어 부등침하를 방지하고 우수한 노면의 평탄성을 구현할 수 있으며, 다짐작업의 효율성을 향상시킬 수 있는 높이조절용 맨홀뚜껑 조립체 및 그의 시공방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 맨홀뚜껑을 수용하기 위한 제1 수용부와 상기 제1 수용부의 하단에 내측으로 연장되어 맨홀뚜껑을 지지하기 위한 받침연장판과 맨홀슬라브에 안착되기 위한 외부 플랜지를 구비하며, 원형단면의 회주철로 이루어져 다짐작업에 따른 지장물이 발생되지 않도록 자갈의 보조기층재에 매립되는 1차 맨홀뚜껑 받침수단; 및 상기 1차 맨홀뚜껑 받침수단의 제1 수용부에 끼워져 지지되는 원형의 직립면과, 상기 직립면의 상단에 맨홀뚜껑을 수용하기 위한 제2 수용부및 맨홀뚜껑을 받쳐 지지하기 위한 단턱을 구비하며, 원형단면의 회주철로 이루어져 표층재에 맨홀뚜껑의 레벨을 맞추기 위한 2차 맨홀뚜껑 받침수단을 포함하는 높이조절용 맨홀뚜껑 조립체 및 그의 시공방법을 제공한다.

title_en: A method of health functional dried fruit using jujube
title_ko: 건강 기능성 대추 건과 제조방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A producing method of health functional dried jujube is provided to offer the crunchy texture and the excellent nutrition of the jujube to eaters. CONSTITUTION: A producing method of health functional dried jujube comprises the following steps: dipping dried jujube in a medical herb extract for 1-1.5 minutes; separating the jujube from the extract, and coating the jujube with medical herb powder; and drying the coated jujube with low temperature air at 45-50 deg C using a microwave drier. A medical herb for the medical extract is selected from red ginseng, schisandra chinensis, schisandra chinensis, chaenomeles sinensis, and ginger.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 (a) 건대추를 한약재 추출물에 침수하여 한약재 추출물을 대추에 침투시키는 단계; (b) 한약재 추출물이 침투된 건대추를 수득하는 단계; (c) 상기 수득된 한약재 추출물이 침투된 건대추에 한약재 분말을 도포하여 코팅하는 단계; 및 (d) 상기 한약재 분말로 코팅된 건대추를 저온풍 건조하는 단계를 포함하는 건강 기능성 대추 건과(乾果) 제조방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 제조방법은 (c)의 건대추를 마이크로웨이브를 이용하여 저온풍 건조함으로써 동결건조 방식보다 건조시간이 단축될 뿐만 아니라, 대추의 천연 감미와 약리성을 그대로 유지하면서 씹는 질감을 살릴 수 있어 바삭바삭하면서 영양이 풍부한 대추 건과 제조를 가능하게 한다. 또한 본 발명의 제조방법에 따라 제조된 대추 건과는 원재료가 대추 및 한약재 성분으로 이루어져 영양이 풍부하며 안전한 건강 기능성 건과이며, 대추를 주재료로 하되 대추에 첨가되는(추출물과 분말) 재료에 따라 그 맛이 달라지며, 또한 씹는 질감이 바삭바삭(스넥처럼)하기 때문에 남녀노소, 특히 대추 및 한약재를 일반적으로 섭취하는데 거부감을 보이는 어린아이들에게도 손쉽게 다가갈 수 있는 이상적인 천연 기호식품이다.

title_en: System and control method for feedback of user emotion by robot
title_ko: 사용자의 생체정보 분석을 통한 감정상태 분석장치 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A feeling state analysis apparatus and method through bio-information analysis of a user are provided to analyze and determine a feeling state of the user by using a bio-signal including pulse waves, electric skin resistance, skin temperature, and external temperature etc. CONSTITUTION: A feeling analysis apparatus determines a feeling state of a user. A feeling reactor executes a fixed operation according to feeling condition information. A biosensor part measures each bio-information(S101). An analog to digital converter changes the bio-information into a digital signal. A main processor determines the feeling state of the user. The main processor transmits the feeling condition information to the feeling reactor. A feeling reaction control part drives feeling reactions. A music player reproduces and outputs sound data through a speaker.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 로봇을 통한 인간의 감정반응 시스템 및 그 제어방법은 사용자로부터 수집한 맥파(PPG), 피부전기전도도(GSR), 피부온도(SKT)등 생체신호를 이용하여 사용자의 감정상태를 인식 및 판단하고, 이를 로봇으로 전송하여 로봇이 사용자의 감정상태에 따라 설정된 반응을 하도록 로봇을 제어하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
본 발명의 목적은 다수의 바이오센서를 이용하여 추출된 사용자의 생체정보를 연산하여 사용자의 감정을 인식하는 감정분석장치와, 감정분석장치로부터 전송된 감정상태정보에 따라 로봇이 설정된 동작을 수행하도록 하는 로봇을 통한 사용자의 감정반응 시스템에 있어서, 감정분석장치는 맥파센서, 피부온도센서 및 피부전기저항센서로부터 각 생체정보를 측정하는 바이오센서부; 바이오센서부로부터 검지된 아날로그 생체정보를 디지털신호로 변환하는 아날로그/디지털변환부; 및 아날로그/디지털변환부를 통해 입력된 생체정보를 연산하여 사용자의 감정상태를 판단하고, 감정반응장치로 전송하는 메인프로세서;를 포함하여 구성되고, 감정반응장치는 감정분석장치로부터 전송된 사용자의 감정상태에 따라 설정된 감정반응을 구동하는 감정반응제어부; 로봇의 동작을 제어하는 로봇구동부; 설정된 음악을 재생하는 음악재생부;를 포함하여 구성된 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method of requesting rescue of emergent patient and portable terminal program for implementing the same
title_ko: 응급 환자 구조요청 방법 및 이를 구현하기 위한 휴대형 단말기용 프로그램
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An emergency patient rescue request method and program of a portable terminal are provided to rapidly rescue emergency patents by rapidly transmitting emergency state information to a protector or an emergency rescue organization. CONSTITUTION: An abnormal state determination unit initializes a measurement time(200). In case the movement of a user is not detected, the abnormal state determination unit determines the range of electrocardiogram values and patterns based on measurement data stored in a data storage uni and a current electrocardiogram received from a sensor module(204). When the electrocardiogram data is not normality, an error determination unit determines the standard time of an error state(206). When a main control unit receives an emergency state determination signal is received, the main control unit transmits an emergency text message from the text message transmission unit to a protector terminal. The main control unit transmits a rescue request message from the rescue request unit to an emergency organization server(210). All rescue request activities are stopped when a user pushes the cancellation button of a terminal(212).
abstract_ko:
예컨대 심장병과 같은 질환을 가진 환자가 응급 상황에 처했을 때 환자의 생체 신호와 상기 환자의 움직임을 통해 응급상황임을 감지하고, 네트웍을 통해 구조 요청을 함과 아울러 주변에 있는 사람에게 구조 요청을 하여 신속히 구조될 수 있도록 해주기 위한 응급 환자 구조요청 방법. 
본 발명의 응급 환자 구조요청 방법은 적어도 하나의 센서 모듈과 인터페이스될 수 있고 가속도 센서를 구비하는 휴대형 단말기에서 구현된다.  단말기는 이를 휴대한 사용자의 신체상태를 감지하여 축적하고, 가속도 센서로부터의 가속도 데이터를 축적한다.  그리고, 단말기는 축적된 감지 데이터들과 가속도 데이터들을 토대로 사용자가 응급상황에 처했는지를 판단한다.  사용자가 응급상황에 처한 경우, 단말기는 네트웍을 통해 외부 장치에 구조요청을 함과 아울러, 음향으로 주변인에게 구조요청을 하고, 주변인이 단말기에 소정의 입력을 인가하는 경우 메모리에 저장된 구조방법 영상을 재생하게 된다. 
환자가 극단적인 상황에 처하지 않고 신속하게 구조될 수 있도록 해주는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Hand-held landmine detector with image display
title_ko: 영상 전시 핸드 헬드 지뢰 탐지 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A hand-held mine detection device having an image displaying function is provided to provide a user with the image information of the ground in real time. CONSTITUTION: A hand-held mine detection device having an image displaying function comprises a detector(100), a controller(400), a detected signal transmitter-receiver(300), and a detection grip body. The detector senses materials buried in the ground and generates detected signals. The controller comprises a wired and wireless communication unit, a signal processing unit, a detection position/motion sensing unit, a detected image synchronizing unit, and a display unit. The detected signal transmitter-receiver transmits the detected signals from the detector to the controller. The detector and the controller are attached on the detection grip body.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 영상 전시 핸드 헬드(Hend-held)형 지뢰 탐지 장치에 관한 것으로서, 지중에 매설된 지뢰를 탐지(detection)하여 인지(recognition)할 수 있는 영상 전시 핸드 헬드 지뢰 탐지 장치이다. 본 발명의 실시 형태는 지중에 매설된 매설물을 감지하여 탐지 신호를 발생하는 탐지체;와,  상기 탐지 신호 송수신기로부터의 탐지 신호를 수신하는 통제기 유무선 통신부와, 탐지 방향에서의 탐지가 완료되면 탐지 시작점에서부터 탐지 완료점까지의 탐지 신호를 필터링하여 탐지 영상으로 생성하는 신호 처리부와, 탐지가 이루어지는 탐지체의 위치정보 및 움직임정보를 감지하는 탐지위치 및 움직임 센싱부와, 상기 탐지 영상에 탐지체의 위치정보 및 움직임정보를 동기화하는 탐지 영상 동기화부와, 상기 탐지 영상, 탐지체의 위치정보 및 움직임정보를 함께 하나의 화면에 디스플레이하는 표시부를 포함하는 통제기;와, 상기 탐지체에 탐지 구동 신호를 인가하여 상기 탐지체로부터 탐지 신호를 상기 통제기로 중계하는 탐지 신호 송수신기;와, 상기 탐지체 및 통제기가 부착된 탐지 파지체;를 포함하며, 상기 신호 처리부는, 탐지 영상 생성 조건에 충족할 경우에만 탐지 방향에서의 탐지가 완료되었다고 판단하여 탐지 영상을 생성하며, 이때, 상기 탐지 영상 생성 조건은, 탐지 방향에서의 작업 방위각, 작업 시간, 지표 투과 레이더의 측정값 및 금속 탐지기의 측정값 갯수인 처리정보갯수를 포함한다.

title_en: Earthquake underground fluid inspection well and system and method used earthquake underground fluid inspection well to detect seismic precursor abnormal information
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake underground fluid inspection well and a system and a method used the earthquake underground fluid inspection well to detect seismic precursor abnormal information of gap pressure diffusion coefficients, which relate to earth physics and quakeproof disaster reduction technology. The earthquake underground fluid inspection well is arranged vertical to the direction of strata, a corrosion resisting seal stainless steel sleeve is installed in the center of the inspection well in the middle, cement is used at the bottom and the top of the inspection well for fixing a sleeve, a stainless steel clamp is adopted to fix the sleeve at the position of the axial center of the stainless steel sleeve additionally, multimode fibers are buried in a gap between the sleeve and the well wall, ore particles are filled in the gap between the sleeve and the well wall, so that an even gap medium layer is formed. A special high-resolution-ratio fiber sensor collects gas pressure dynamic response signals stimulated by earthquake cutting waves, a data analyzing system is integrated through a maximum likelihood deconvolution space-time conservation method and a weight integral method chips, characteristic scale of the dynamic gap pressure diffusion coefficients related to the cutting waves is obtained through calculation, an earthquake source generated the earthquake cutting waves is  carried out high-precision earthquake location, scientific decision-making data with earthquake source physical significances are provided to seismic prediction. The obtaining method of the characteristic scale of the dynamic gap pressure diffusion coefficients can be used for well wall fracture monitor of oil exploitation wells and carbon dioxide geology seal injection wells.
assignees: INST OF CRUSTAL DYNAMICS CHINA SEISMOLOGICAL BUREAU

title_en: Ultra wide band radar life detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra wide band radar life detection system and an ultra wide band radar life detection method. The ultra wide band radar life detection system comprises a radar host and a control terminal. The radar host comprises a transmitting antenna, a receiving antenna, a transmitter, a receiver, a main control unit and a communication unit. The control terminal transmits a detection command; the detection command enters the main control system through the communication unit; the main control system triggers the transmitter to generate an ultra wide band narrow pulse; then the ultra wide band narrow pulse is radiated to an observation region by the transmitting antenna; the receiving antenna receives a pulse echo; the pulse echo is transmitted into the receiver to be sampled; data obtained after sampling is transmitted into the main control system to be subjected to clutter rejection, detection and judgment; and the communication unit transmits a processing result of the main control system into the control terminal to display the processing result. Compared with a conventional life detector, the ultra wide band radar life detection system has the advantages that the control terminal can remotely control the radar host to work according to the required mode; and the ultra wide band radar life detection system not only has strong penetrating power, but also has high reliability and high detection accuracy.
assignees: WUXI JUNSHUAI ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Carrying type small radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of life detectors, and provides a carrying type small radar life detection instrument. A vital sign signal in a ruin gap is detected by a radar detection system; a respiration signal, a heartbeat signal and a monitoring signal are extracted from the vital sign signal, and are transmitted to a detection and analysis control system through a wireless transmission mode; a detection result is obtained by analyzing and judging the respiration signal, the heartbeat signal and the monitoring signal; therefore, the shortcomings of the conventional radar life detection instrument are made up; the carrying type small radar life detection instrument is carried on a carrier and put into the ruin gap for life detection; furthermore, the wireless control mode is adopted, so that a rescuer for detection can perform the detection operation in a safety zone; detection data and a detection result are wirelessly transmitted to the rescuer for detection; the safety of the rescuer for detection is guaranteed; and the injury to the rescuer approaching the ruin is avoided.

title_en: Oxyhemoglobin saturation monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention overcomes serious environment condition limit in rescue processes of firefighters and defects in physiology monitoring technology of the firefighters and provides an oxyhemoglobin saturation monitoring system capable of monitoring vital signs of oxyhemoglobin saturation and the like of firefighters. The oxyhemoglobin saturation monitoring system is characterized by comprising an oxyhemoglobin saturation monitoring terminal arranged on a user and an intelligent cell phone which is arranged at the position of a monitor and provided with a Bluetooth wireless data communication module or a Zigbee wireless data communication module. An oxyhemoglobin sensor is arranged on the oxyhemoglobin saturation monitoring terminal. The oxyhemoglobin sensor can detect oxyhemoglobin saturation of the user in real time mode and feeds results back to the oxyhemoglobin saturation monitoring terminal to judge whether the oxyhemoglobin saturation is out of limit and then weather alarm can be given out by an acousto-optic alarm circuit. The oxyhemoglobin saturation monitoring system can accurately detect oxyhemoglobin saturation information of the firefighters in real time mode and feed information back to the intelligent cell phone of a firefighter command monitoring end. The monitoring terminal has the advantages of being small in volume and convenient to wear.

title_en: Underground radar
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To easily display a burial position of a buried object on a road surface or the like in an underground radar for detecting the underground buried object.SOLUTION: An underground radar 1 includes a radar body 2 having an electromagnetic transmission section 5 for transmitting an electromagnetic wave, and an electromagnetic receiving section 6 for receiving a reflection wave of the electromagnetic wave; and detects a buried object by receiving wave data A from the electromagnetic wave receiving section 5. The underground radar 1 further includes: a position measuring section 3 for measuring a moving position of the radar body 2; a storage section 8 for storing burial position data C of the buried object determined based on the receiving wave data A when moving the radar body 2 and detecting the buried object, and position data B of the radar body 2 acquired by the position measuring section 3 when acquiring the receiving wave data A; and a display section 4 displaying the burial position of the buried object 11 based on the position data B of the radar body 2, when radar body 2 is moved again, acquired by the position measuring section 3 by the moving, and the burial position data C already stored in the storage section 8.

title_en: Unpiloted scout car
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unpiloted scout car comprising a driver camera video antenna, a driver head sensing camera, an environmental voice sensor, a life detection instrument, an environmental smoke concentration sensor, an environmental temperature sensor, a viewer camera video antenna, a viewer remote control holder camera, a car control sensor receiving antenna, a headlamp, a caterpillar band and a car body, wherein the caterpillar band is arranged under a car body; the environmental voice sensor, the life detection instrument, the environmental smoke concentration sensor, the environmental temperature sensor and the headlamp are arranged on the front side of the car body; and the driver head sensing camera, the driver camera video antenna, the viewer camera video antenna, the viewer remote control holder camera and the car control sensor receiving antenna are arranged on the top of the car body. The unpiloted scout car is suitable for earthquakes, fire and military, and capable of scouting situations in a spot in stead of people in accidents and events and then transmitting information to a central headquarter, thus conveniently determining a specific solution so as to reduce casualties.

title_en: Sailing control method of mine-sweeper using radar image tracking
title_ko: 레이더 영상 추적 기법을 활용한 소해함 운항 제어방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A sailing control method of mine-sweeper using radar image tracking is provided to effectively eliminate mines buried in the swept area by controlling the operation of mine-sweepers by correcting a moving route and speed of mine-sweepers. CONSTITUTION: A swept area is set(S10). A route for a mine-sweeper is determined(S20). A mine-sweeper operates(S30). A towing type mine eliminating device is towed(S40). A radar image tracking starts(S100). A result of a radar image tracking is displayed on the electronic navigation chart(S150). It is determined if mine-sweepers are maintained in a designed swept area(S200).
abstract_ko: 레이더 영상 추적 기법을 활용한 소해함 운항 제어방법이 개시된다. 보다 상세하게는 본 발명은, (a) 미리 설정된 소해 구역에서 소해함을 이용하여 소해구를 예인하는 단계와, (b) 소해구의 실시간 위치에 대한 레이더 영상 추적을 시행하여 레이더 영상 추적에 의한 결과를 전자 해도에 전시하는 단계와, (c) 전자 해도를 판독하여 상기 소해구가 미리 설정된 소해 구역에 유지되고 있는지 판정하는 단계와, (d) (c)단계의 판정결과 소해구가 미리 설정된 소해 구역에서 벗어난 경우, 소해구가 상기 미리 설정된 소해구로 복귀되기 위한 소해함의 이동 속도 및 이동 경로를 산출하는 단계 및 (e) 산출된 소해함의 이동 속도 및 이동 경로에 따라 소해함을 운용하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Thermochromic pigment-based fiber-optic respiration sensor for respiratory monitoring during clinical procedures using mri system or radiation devices
title_ko: 자기공명영상장치 또는 방사선 장치를 이용한 시술 시 호흡 모니터링을 위한  시온안료 기반의 광섬유 호흡센서와 광섬유 호흡센서 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A fiber-optic respiration sensor of the thermochromic microcapsule pigment base and a fiber-optic respiration sensor system are provided to enhance the quality of a radiological image by controlling fine movement due to a respiratory motion of a patient. CONSTITUTION: A respiration sensing film(1) is attached to a plastic pipe(2). The plastic pipe is combined with one end of optical fiber(3). The respiration sensing film mixes thionic pigment powder and transparent optics epoxy. The respiration sensing film compresses and dries a mixture. The respiration sensing film is formed into a thin film type. The respiration sensing film is composed of a light source(4), a Y- coupler(5), a light detector(6), and a display device.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 자기공명영상(magnetic resonance imaging, MRI) 촬영 또는 방사선 장치(radiation device)를 이용한 진단 및 치료 시 호흡 모니터링을 위해 시온안료(thermochromic microcapsule pigment) 기반의 광섬유 호흡센서와 광섬유 호흡센서 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 호흡 감지부, 광섬유(optical fiber), 광원(light source) 및 광 계측장비(light measuring device)로 구성된 온라인 광섬유 호흡센서(fiber-optic respiration sensor)에 관한 것이다. 
 발명은 광섬유 호흡센서에 있어서 호흡 감지 필름을 플라스틱 관에 부착하고, 상기 플라스틱 관을 광섬유의 끝단에 결합하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Steering wheel cover of insensible detection type
title_ko: 무자극 신호검출 타입의 스티어링 휠 커버
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An unstimulating signal detection type steering wheel cover is provided to measure bio signal of a driver accurately by detecting the error range of meridian points in hands. CONSTITUTION: An unstimulating signal detection type steering wheel cover comprises a primary piezoelectric sensor portion and a secondary piezoelectric sensor portion. The primary piezoelectric sensor portion measures heart rate, skin conduction, and pulsation and is widely distributed in a steering wheel cover gripped by the hands of a driver. A plurality of piezoelectric sensors is installed in the primary piezoelectric sensor portion. The secondary piezoelectric sensor portion measures heart rate, skin conduction, and pulsation and outputs warning message at the determined set value at the same time. The secondary piezoelectric sensor portion is installed in the center portion of the primary piezoelectric sensor portion. The secondary piezoelectric sensor portion is projected from a steering wheel to a driver.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 차량의 스티어링 휠에 결합되는 무자극 신호검출 타입의 스티어링 휠 커버에 있어서, 운전 시, 운전자의 양 손이 상기 스티어링 휠을 파지하는 부분에 복수개의 패턴으로 형성되어 심박수, 피부전도도 및 맥동을 측정하는 제1피에조센서부 및 상기 제1피에조센서부의 중앙에 배치되고, 운전자의 양 손바닥에 형성된 경혈부위에 위치하도록 형성되며, 심박수, 피부전도도 및 맥동을 측정함과 동시에 설정된 수치에서 경고진동을 발생시키는 한 쌍의 제2피에조센서부를 포함하며, 상기 제1피에조센서부는 상기 제2피에조센서부를 중심으로 하여 상기 무자극 신호검출 타입의 스티어링 휠 커버의 원주방향으로 감싸도록 형성될 수 있다. 
본 발명에 의한 무자극 신호검출 타입의 스티어링 휠 커버는 첫째, 피에조센서를 사용하여 심박수, 피부전도도 및 맥동을 측정할 수 있고, 둘째, 측정된 전기적 신호에 의해 운전자의 경혈을 자극하여 전기자극 치료 또는 경고 메세지를 전달할 수 있으며, 셋째, 운전자의 지속적인 생체신호 모니터링이 가능하고, 넷째, 저렴한 가격으로 설치 및 보급이 용이한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Stress and burn-out analysis and diagnostic device
abstract_en: The invention relates to an analysis and diagnostic device (1) for detecting stress and/or burn-out syndrome in a test person. According to the invention, the device comprises at least one sensor (2) detecting vital signs of the test person and transferring said vital signs to a memory unit, a voltage supply, and an evaluating unit connected to a memory unit. By means of the evaluating unit a time-resolved course of the vital signs detected by the at least one sensor (2) can be evaluated, and a comparator diagnosing stress and/or burn-out syndrome by means of a comparison of the time-resolved course of the detected vital signs with time-resolved stress and burn-out vital patterns stored in a data base is provided in the evaluating unit.

title_en: Method and device for searching through collapsed ground
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device and a method for determining whether a living person has been buried in collapsed ground. The device consists of a rod provided with a receiver unit and a signal processing unit. The receiver unit is intended to receive reflected radar signals transmitted form a radar transmitting antenna and transfer these signals to the signal processing unit. The signal processing unit which is provided with specific detection units determines whether the received signal have been Doppler shifted. By determining this the device can decide whether the Doppler shift depends on the moving chest of a breathing person buried alive.

title_en: Underground radar apparatus
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an underground radar apparatus capable of surely surveying a buried object on a shallow layer by suppressing linking of direct waves.SOLUTION: A receiving signal obtained by receiving a reflected wave of an electromagnetic wave sent from a transmission antenna 12 to underground by a receiving antenna 21 is decomposed into a plurality of frequency component signals by a wavelet transformer 5. An STC processing part 6 performs STC processing by individually setting sensitivity adjustment quantity so that in a direct wave receiving period of an electromagnetic wave directly received from the transmission antenna 12 and a reflected wave from a ground surface, signal levels of respective frequency signal components generated by decomposition are equalized, and in the following receiving period, performs STC processing for emphasizing a signal component having strong reflected signal intensity from the buried object by setting the sensitivity adjustment quantity so that the sensitivity adjustment quantity of a low frequency signal component is increased with the lapse of time. Respective frequency signal component after the STC processing are combined by a reverse wavelet transformer 7 to generate a combined receiving signal, and the buried object is surveyed based on the combined receiving signal.

title_en: Apparatus for measure of bio signal and method for analysis of rehabilitation training by suit type bio sensors
title_ko: 피복타입 무구속 생체신호 측정 및 이를 이용한 재활훈련 정도 판단방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An apparatus for measuring coated type nonintrusive bio signals and a method for analyzing rehabilitation training using the same are provided to obtain various bio-information at a time by only wearing a bio signal measuring suit. CONSTITUTION: A bio signal measuring suit(101) includes a plurality of sensors(112,113,114) for measuring bio signals. The bio signal measuring suit is formed into large, middle, and small sizes for wearing convenience. Left and right electromyography sensors(111) measure electromyographic signals of the left and right shoulders and chest of a person to be tested. A control board(200) calculates all kinds of parameters for determining the health condition of the person and processing the signals. The control board comprises an analog to digital converter, an interface transformation unit, and a microcontroller.
abstract_ko:
따라서, 본 발명은 피복타입 무구속 생체신호 측정장치 및 이를 이용한 재활훈련정도 분석방법에 관한 것으로서, 의류와 같이 피검자가 착용한 조끼타입의 생체신호측정슈트(suit)의 어깨 및 가슴 부위에 근전도(EMG), 심전도(ECG), 맥박, 호흡수 또는 피부온도 등을 획득하기 위한 다양한 생체센서를 장착하여 무구속, 무자각 상태에서 피검자의 생체신호를 획득하므로 피검자의 건강상태를 분석 및 관리하기 위한 기초 데이터를 제공하도록 하며, 측정된 근전도를 포함한 생체신호를 이용하여 재활훈련의 정도를 분석 및 판단하도록 하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
본 발명의 목적은 근전도센서, 심전도센서, 피부저항센서 및 피부온도센서로부터 획득된 피검자의 각 생체신호를 채널별로 각각 입력받아 디지털신호로 변환 및 래치하는 AD변환기; AD변환기를 통해 입력된 각 채널별 생체데이터를 수집하고, 어떤 채널의 데이터인지 판단하고, 외부 인터페이스 매칭을 위해 변환 및 출력하는 인터페이스변환부; 및 인터페이스변환부로부터 입력된 생체데이터의 노이즈를 제거하고, 각 생체신호를 분석하여 피검자의 동작 및 건강상태와 감성인식 판단을 위한 파라미터를 산출하는 마이크로콘트롤러;를 포함하여 구성하되, 상기 생체센서부는 피검자가 착용 가능한 생체신호측정슈트의 내측에 부착된 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Physiological signal measuring equipment using socks
title_ko: 양말을 활용한 생체정보 측정 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A bio-information measuring system utilizing socks is provided to simultaneously measure various bio-signals through a patch composed of biometric sensors. CONSTITUTION: A bio-information measuring system utilizing socks comprises a bio-sensor module(110) and a control unit. The bio-sensor module contacts wearer's foot, particularly the instep(20a), the sole(20b), or the heel(20c). The bio-sensor module is composed of an electrocardiogram sensor, a skin conductivity sensor, or a body temperature sensor. The control unit converts bio-information data into the digital bio-signal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 양말 내에서 하나 또는 복수개가 부착되며, 상기 양말을 착용하는 착용자의 생체정보를 감지하는 생체센서모듈 및 상기 생체정보의 데이터를 무선으로 전달받는 제어부를 포함하는 양말을 활용한 생체정보 측정 장치가 제공된다.  
따라서 양말의 발등 부분과 발바닥 장심 부분에 생체신호 측정 장치를 부착하여 오차 및 노이즈가 감소되어 정확한 데이터를 측정할 수 있다. 또한 기존의 장갑이나 의류가 아닌, 일반적으로 착용하는 양말에 부착하므로, 주의력 분산이 감소되어 사용자는 장시간 편안하게 착용이 가능한 효과를 가진다.

title_en: Wireless sensor network-based maritime search and rescue system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a wireless sensor network-based maritime search and rescue system which comprises a wireless sensor network, a wireless communication sink node, a communication base station and a search and rescue network center, wherein the wireless sensor network transmits data to the wireless communication sink node, the wireless communication sink node transmits the data to the communication base station, and the communication base station transmits the data to the search and rescue network center; the system applies wireless sensor network technology into maritime search and rescue, changes conventional search and rescue method for searching only by search and rescue party, and realizes positioning on a falling target and real-time monitoring; and the data transmittedto the network by the wireless sensor network can help search and rescue people to fast position the target, and at the same time vital sign information of the target can be detected, so that the search and rescue efficiency can be greatly improved.

title_en: Time-share rotary scanning detection method for radar vital sign detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for time-share rotary scanning detection method for a radar vital sign detector. The method comprises the following steps of: erecting a radar in the middle of a wall according to a position to be detected and a range to be detected; determining a detection region of the radar according to a wave velocity width phi degree of the radar and a range of the detection region; and after all the regions in the detection range are detected, generating a vital sign distribution planar graph of the whole region on a computer. According to the method, the radar vital sign detector is deflected at a fixed angle by adopting a gradual deflection scanning detection mode, so that the detection direction of the detector can be changed, and vital sign distribution in the whole region or a room can be gradually finished without moving the radar detector. Each deflection angle of the radar is equal to the wave velocity width of the radar, so that problems of region leakage, repeated detection, leakage detection and the like can be solved. The method is simple, reliable and favorable for detection; the result is accurate and reliable; the method is convenient; and furthermore, the vital sign distribution planar graph can be generated.

title_en: Nuclear power plant, safety system with fuse element and gravity elevator
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a nuclear power plant and safety system with fuse element and gravity elevator, the buildings of the power plant subjected to contamination being buried below sea level and under borated water basins, and having a safety system free of electrical and electronic components to act in the event of possible accidents comprising, among others, means for flooding the buildings of the power plant with thermal fuses and gravity elevators for operator evacuation in the event of an emergency.
assignees: SERBEX TECNOLOGÍA Y VALORES S L

title_en: Side slope geologic hazard pre-warning method and device based on wireless sensor network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a side slope geologic hazard pre-warning method and device based on a wireless sensor network. The wireless sensor network is buried inside a side slope body; a wireless sensor network cluster head is used for acquiring a sound transmission signal at the initial catastrophe stage of a side slope, and transmitting the signal to a data transmitter arranged at a safety position in a wireless way through a multi-hop path; the data transmitter is used for transmitting assembled information to an indoor receiving and analyzing system in a customized data format through a backbone network, and transmitting a received signal to a computer of the receiving and analyzing system; the computer is used for analyzing and processing the received signal, and taking a pre-warning measure of a corresponding level according to a processing result; and the pre-warning information is transmitted to a pre-warning display screen at a section where a disaster occurs through a communication cable to prompt passing vehicles, pedestrians or residential areas and the like of taking corresponding disaster reduction and prevention measures.

title_en: Device for predicting earthquakes and volcanic eruptions, and for locating epicentres and magnitudes by measuring the radon in the soil
abstract_en: The invention relates to a device for predicting earthquakes and volcanic eruptions, and for locating epicentres and magnitudes using an array (200) of device for detecting and analyzing radon anomalies in the soil (100). The device for detecting and analyzing radon anomalies in the soil (100) consists of two modules: a buried module (110), itself consisting of a radon sensor (111) and of a housing (112) and a surface module (120), itself consisting of a wireless communication system (121), of environmental sensors, of an electronic card, of a foot (125) and of a power supply (124). The multitude of device for detecting and analyzing radon anomalies in the soil (100) forms a measurement array (200) which dispatches the data to a server (210) which are processed by an earthquake prediction algorithm (220). The device according to the invention is particularly intended for monitoring radon anomaly in the soil for predicting earthquakes and volcanic eruptions, and locating epicentres and magnitudes.

title_en: A sensor and a method of sensing thereof
title_ko: 센서 및 센싱방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A sensor and a sensing method are provided to accurately measure a biological signal by detecting the size variation of the biological signal using the deviation degree of an oscillation frequency of an oscillator. CONSTITUTION: An oscillator(100) generates oscillation frequency deviation corresponded to a biological signal. A signal detector(200) detects the size variation of the biological signal using the deviation degree of an oscillation frequency. The signal detector includes a filter(210) and a power detector(220). The power detector is connected to the filter. The filter detects the size deviation of the biological signal using an SAW filter. [Reference numerals] (100) Oscillator; (110) Plate resonator; (200) Signal detector; (210) Filter; (220) Power detector; (300) Signal processor; (320) Filter; (400) Display unit
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 생체신호 측정센서 및 측정방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일실시예에 따른 생체신호 측정센서는 발진기, 신호검출부 및 신호처리부를 포함하며, 발진기의 발진주파수 편이량을 생체신호의 크기변화로 검출하고 검출된 생체신호로부터 맥박신호 및 호흡신호를 각각 검출한다.  
본 발명의 일실시예에 따른 생체신호 측정센서 및 측정방법은 생체신호 검출대상과 비접촉하여 이루어지며, 근거리에서 정확한 생체신호 검출이 가능하다.

title_en: Portable mri apparatus
title_ko: 포터블 ｍｒｉ 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A portable MRI apparatus is provided to supply a spatial selection saturation without influencing an integral value of a gradient magnetic field in 1TR(repetition time). CONSTITUTION: A main magnetic field coil unit(102) forms a magnetic field in an inner space of a magnet system(100). A gradient coil unit(106) generates three gradient magnetic fields. A signal obtaining device obtains a magnetic resonance signal by supplying a gradient magnetic pulse and an RF pulse to an object. An image reconstructing device(170) reconstructs an image based on the obtained magnetic resonance signal. A controller device(160) controls the signal obtaining device and the image reconstructing device. [Reference numerals] (1) Object; (100) Magnet system; (102) Parking lot coil unit; (106) Gradient coil unit; (108) RF coil unit; (110) Heartbeat detector unit; (112) Heartbeat sensor; (130) Gradient driver unit; (140) RF driver unit; (150) Data collector unit; (160) Sequence controller unit; (170) Data processing unit; (180) Display unit; (190) Operation console unit; (500) Cradle
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 1TR내의 구배 자장의 적분값에 영향을 미치지 않고서 선택 포화를 행하는 포토블 MRI 장치를 제공한다. 포터블 MRI 장치는 정자장, 구배 자장 펄스 및 RF 펄스를 대상에 인가하여 자기 공명 신호를 획득하는 신호 획득 장치와, 획득된 자기 공명 신호에 근거하여 화상을 재구성하는 화상 재구성 장치(170)와, 그러한 두 개의 장치를 제어하는 제어기 장치(160)를 포함한다. 제어기 장치(160)는 신호 획득 장치에게, 선택 포화를 위한 구배 자장 펄스 및 RF 펄스를 복수회 인가한 후, 신호 획득을 위한 구배 자장 펄스 및 RF 펄스를 인가하도록 지시한다.

title_en: Power saving type bio-signal monitering system
title_ko: 절전형 생체신호 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A power saving type bio-signal monitoring system is provided to transmit bio-signal data and simultaneously measure a bio-signal of a user, thereby stably detecting the bio-signal of the user of a bio-signal measuring terminal. CONSTITUTION: A plurality of measurer sensors(110) are worn on a wrist of a measured person to measure a bio-signal. A display unit(120) displays bio-signal measuring values which are measured by measurers. A control unit(130) controls the measurer sensors to measure the bio-signal. The control unit converts the measuring values into bio-signal data. A local area network module(140) performs local area communication with a wireless mobile terminal. [Reference numerals] (10) Biometric signal measuring unit; (110) Measuring unit sensor; (120) Display unit; (130) Control unit; (140) LAN module; (150) Battery; (151) Power monitoring unit; (160) Selection button unit; (30) Biometric signal DB server
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 절전형 생체신호 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 맥박, 심전도, 혈압, 혈당, 호흡신호와 같은 생체신호를 측정하기 위한 생체신호 측정기를 무선이동통신과 연계하여 위험상황의 발생시 동거인은 물론, 원거리에 있는 친족과 가장 근접한 응급구조대 및 응급실 등에 경보를 전달하고 그 생체신호 데이터를 별도의 서버에 저장할 수 있도록 구성하여 상기 생체신호 측정기의 배터리 소모를 최소화할 수 있도록 사용자의 선택에 따라 절전 기능이 작동되도록 하고, 상기 생체신호 측정기의 배터리를 충전함과 동시에 생체신호 데이터를 전송할 수 있으며, 배터리의 충전을 위해 생체신호 측정기가 이동통신단말기에 유선으로 연결된 경우 피측정자의 생체신호를 측정하는 것을 유지함과 동시에 블루투스 등 무선통신수단의 전원을 자동으로 차단시켜 절전할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라, 다양한 생체신호 중 사용자에 최적화된 생체신호만을 추출하도록 생체신호 측정을 선택적으로 제어할 수 있는 절전형 생체신호 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 절전형 생체신호 모니터링 시스템은, 피측정자의 생체신호를 측정하기 위한 생체신호 측정기와, 상기 측정기 센서에서 측정된 생체신호 데이터를 전송받아 저장하고 송출시키기 위한 무선이동단말기와, 상기 무선이동단말기에 수신 및 저장된 생체신호 데이터를 이동통신망을 통해 전송받아 저장하기 위한 생체신호DB서버를 포함하되, 상기 생체신호 측정기는 피측정자의 손목에 착용하여 생체신호를 측정하는 복수개의 측정기 센서와, 상기 복수개의 측정기 센서 각각에서 측정된 생체신호 측정값을 표시하기 위한 디스플레이부와, 상기 측정기 센서가 생체신호를 측정하도록 제어하고, 그 측정값을 생체신호 데이터로 변환하여 상기 디스플레이부에 표시하도록 제어하며 상기 생체신호 측정기가 이동통신과 통신하도록 제어하는 제어부와, 상기 제어부를 통해 변환된 상기 생체신호 데이터를 상기 무선이동단말기에 전송하도록 상기 무선이동단말기와 근거리 통신하기 위한 근거리통신모듈과, 상기 복수개의 측정기 센서, 디스플레이부, 제어부 및 상기 근거리통신모듈에 전원을 공급하기 위한 배터리부가 구비된 생체신호 모니터링 시스템에 있어서, 상기 생체신호 측정기는 측정 가능한 생체신호 중 피측정자가 원하는 생체신호만을 선택하여 측정하도록 상기 복수개의 측정기 센서 전체 또는 각각을 제어하기 위한 센서선택부가 더 구비된 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: System and method for ground penetrating radar communication using antenna crosstalk
abstract_en: An object detection system (24) is disclosed having a transducer (40, 40') for detecting buried objects (26). The transducer is encapsulated within a robust, electromagnetically transparent construction (42).
assignees: DEERE & CO;LOUISIANA TECH UNIVERSITY RES FOUNDATION

title_en: Underground radar
