abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To improve efficiency in survey operation by an operator of an underground radar and quality of survey data in an underground radar system which detects an object buried under the ground.SOLUTION: An underground radar 1 has a radar body 2 equipped with an electromagnetic wave transmission part 5 for transmitting an electromagnetic wave towards the underground and an electromagnetic wave reception part 6 for receiving a reflection wave of the transmitted electromagnetic wave, and surveys a buried object 11 which is buried under the ground from reception wave data based on the electromagnetic wave received by the electromagnetic wave reception part 6. The underground radar 1 includes a location measurement part 3 for measuring a two-dimensional location of the radar body 2 at a survey area, a direction measurement part 4 for acquiring information on movement direction of the radar body 2 and a storage part 8 for unifying the reception wave data based on the electromagnetic wave received by the electromagnetic wave reception part 6 in surveying at the survey area, the two-dimensional location data acquired by the location measurement part 3 and the movement direction information acquired by the direction measurement part 4 as survey data of one unit and storing the survey data for each survey location.

title_en: Sensor installation method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To bury a sensor in the seafloor with high positional accuracy in a manner that ensures measurement accuracy.SOLUTION: A sensor installation method: moves an excavation steel pipe 200, for installing an earthquake measurement device therein, to a predetermined position on the seafloor to bury the earthquake measurement device by using an unmanned submersible capable of moving on the seafloor; excavates the seafloor below the excavation steel pile 200 while pressing the same onto the seafloor and removes excavated surplus soil outside the excavated steel pile 200 through an upper face thereof in a manner that an internal space of the excavation steel pile 200 extends downward in an almost vertical direction using an excavation control function as well as a surplus soil removal function mounted on the unmanned submersible; inserts the earthquake measurement device in the internal space of the excavation steel pile 200 buried in the seafloor using the unmanned submersible; and fills soil in a space between an inner surface of the excavation steel pile 200 and a surface of the earthquake measurement device as well as a space between a bottom surface of a burial hole and the earthquake measurement device using a soil spreading function mounted on the unmanned submersible.

title_en: Closed Compact Panel with Voltage Detector
title_ko: 전압 감지 기능을 갖춘 격벽 격실 축소형 고?저압 폐쇄배전반
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A compact type enclosed switchgear with a voltage detector is provided to prevent the generation of visual corona and partial discharging in the state of use by choosing a high voltage through wall busing and a low voltage through wall busing on the switchgear. CONSTITUTION: High voltage switchgear(110) includes a high voltage through wall busing(111). The high voltage through wall busing includes a voltage detecting sensor. A voltage indicator displays the voltage of electricity flowing through a high voltage supply cable. A voltage display controller(113) controls the voltage. A transformer for instrument supplies a primary high voltage and low voltage to a multifunctional digital protective relay(118). A vacuum interrupter is a main circuit breaker for switching a high voltage power circuit. A surge absorber removes surge due to the switching of the vacuum interrupter.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전압 감지 기능을 갖춘 격벽 격실 축소형 고?저압 폐쇄배전반에 관한 것으로서, 고압 벽관통 부싱, 고압 공급 케이블을 통해 유입된 전기의 전압을 표시하는 전압표시기, 전압을 감지제어하는 전압표시제어기, 계기용 변압기, 진공차단기, 계기용 변류기, 다기능 디지털 보호계전기, 서어지 흡수기, 제어 스위치를 포함하는 고압 배전반 및 저압 벽관통 부싱, 기중 차단기, 배선용 차단기, 계기용 변압기, 계기용 변류기, 영상 변류기, 다기능 디지털 시계, 누전 화재 경보기, 제어 스위치를 포함하는 저압 배전반으로 이루어지고, 상기 저압 배전반과 고압 배전반은 금속판에 의해 구획된 다수 개의 격벽으로 격실을 갖춘 격벽 격실 축소형 고?저압 폐쇄배전반에 있어서, 상기 고압 벽관통 부싱은 24kV 특고압에 적용되도록 내부에 도체가 삽입 배치되고, 상기 도체의 주변에 절연체로 이루어진 절연애관이 배치되며, 상기 절연애관의 중앙에 패널 걸림부가 설치되고, 상기 패널 걸림부의 내부에 상기 도체와 평행 방향으로 전압감지 기능 센서가 내장되는 동시에 외주면에 상기 전압감지 기능 센서와의 접속 단자를 형성하며, 상기 패널 걸림부를 중심으로 하여 양쪽 가장자리를 따라 점진적으로 적어지면서 상기 절연애관의 표면에 반경방향으로 돌출된 다수개의 방열절연돌기가 일정한 간격을 두고 방사상으로 형성되고, 상기 절연애관의 양쪽 끝단에 상기 다수 개의 방열절연돌기보다 더 큰 직경을 갖는 돌출턱이 형성되고, 상기 돌출턱의 가장자리 선단면에 상기 도체와 연결된 접속판이 설치되고, 상기 저압 벽관통 부싱은 7.2kV 이하 고압 및 저압에 적용되도록 내부에 도체가 삽입 배치되고, 중앙에 패널 걸림부가 설치되며, 상기 패널 걸림부의 내부에 상기 도체와 평행 방향으로 전압감지 기능 센서가 내장되는 동시에 외주면에 상기 전압감지 기능 센서와의 접속 단자를 형성하고, 상기 패널 걸림부의 양쪽 끝단에 상기 도체와 연결된 접속판이 설치되는 것을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.  
따라서 본 발명은 전압감지 기능 센서가 내장된 고압 벽관통 부싱 및 저압 벽관통 부싱을 배전반에 채택하여 전기적 및 기계적 성능과 내구성이 우수할 뿐만 아니라 구조적으로 안전성이 향상될 뿐만 아니라 설치가 간편하고 원재료비가 절감될 수 있고, 금속 격벽으로 격실을 갖춘 폐쇄형 구조로 인해 독립된 모선실, 차단기실, 저압실 등 격실을 구획하여 불의의 사고시 주변 기기로의 사고 파급을 최대한 억제하여 구조적으로 전력계통의 안정된 시스템을 구축할 수 있다.

title_en: Defibrillator for Ubiquitous healthcare
title_ko: 유비쿼터스 헬스케어용 환자 모니터링 기능을 갖는 심장제세동기
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A heart defibrillator is provided to consecutively monitor biological signal data and to deliver a message in an emergency situation. CONSTITUTION: A heart defibrillator comprises a bio-signal sensor module(100), a defibrillator main body(200), a control unit(300), and a relay server(400). The bio-signal sensor module measures the electrocardiogram and blood oxygen saturation value of a user and transmits the measured information wirelessly. The defibrillator main body determines the amount of electric shock and applies electric shock through an electrode pad. The control unit stores and analyzes biological signal data and displays a message in an emergency situation. The relay server transmits user position information and biological signal data to administrator and medical team by wire. [Reference numerals] (100) Bio-signal sensor module; (200) Defibrillator main body; (300) Control unit; (400) Relay server; (AA) Manager; (BB) Medical staff
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 사용자 신체에 부착하여 심전도, 혈중산소포화도 측정하는 생체신호센서모듈과 제세동기를 무선으로 연결하여 생체신호데이터를 분석 및 저장한 다음 긴급상황발생시에는 제세동기 본체를 동작하여 전기충격에 의한 응급처치를 할 수 있도록 함과 아울러 중계서버를 통해 관리자 및 의료진에게 생체신호데이터를 전송하여 환자관리를 할 수 있도록 한 유비쿼터스 헬스케어용 환자 모니터링 기능을 갖는 심장제세동기에 관한 것이다 
즉, 본 발명은 사용자 신체에 부착되어 사용자의 심전도 및 혈중산소포화도를 측정하고 측정된 정보를 무선으로 송출하는 생체신호센서모듈과; 사용자의 생체신호데이터 신호에 의해 전기충격여부 및 전기충격량을 판정하고 전극패드를 통하여 전기충격이 이루어지는 제세동기 본체와; 상기 생체신호센서모듈로부터 송신되는 측정정보를 수신하여 생체신호데이터를 분석 및 저장한 다음 긴급상황발생시 메시지를 표시하여 경보하는 수단으로 전기충격에 의한 응급처치를 할 수 있도록 하고. 통신망을 통해 생체신호데이터를 송신하는 제어장치부와; 상기 제어장치부와 상호 무선연결되어 사용자 위치정보 및 생체신호데이터를 관리자 및 의료진에게 유무선으로 전송하는 중계서버;를 포함하는 유비쿼터스 헬스케어용 환자 모니터링 기능을 갖는 심장제세동기를 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Search system and method for searching for a buried person
abstract_en: The system (10) has a radio device (R) comprising a receiving device with a receiving antenna (12) for receiving field of a transmitter antenna. The radio device determines direction of a field vector of the transmitter antenna relative to the receiving antenna. A user interface device (UI) interfaces with the radio device and has an output device (16) for outputting search information. The radio and interface devices are formed as separate units and accommodated by respective housings. Position sensors (18a, 18b) determine relative orientation of the interface device to the radio device. An independent claim is also included for a method for searching buried persons.

title_en: Automatic alarm system for vehicle casualties and traffic accidents
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic alarm system for vehicle casualties and traffic accidents. The automatic alarm system is characterized in that an infrared life detection instrument is installed on a vehicle and respectively acquires the life information below a vehicle chassis and the life information within a vehicle peripheral setting range; the life information below the vehicle chassis is obtained through covering an area right below the vehicle chassis via the infrared light which is sent out by the infrared life detection instrument, and the life information within the setting range is collected in real time, so that life images are generated and are transmitted to an alarm information control center via a public wireless communication network through utilizing global system for mobile communication (GSM); and the life information within the vehicle peripheral setting range is obtained in the way that for a traveling vehicle, when the infrared life detection instrument detects the vehicle body peripheral life information, and the vehicle is judge to hit pedestrians during brake acceleration, as a result, the image information is instantly sent to the alarm information control center. The automatic alarm system can be used for effectively solving the problems of runaway drivers or delayed and inaccurate alarming and difficult control when traffic accidents are happened, so that patients can be rescued in time.

title_en: Fixed-point whole-plane full-automatic deflection scanning detection device for radar life-detection instruments
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fixed-point whole-plane full-automatic deflection scanning detection device for radar life-detection instruments. A constant-angle horizontal-deflection bearing platform is fixed at the top of a camera tripod; a detection radar is fixed on the constant-angle horizontal-deflection bearing platform; and a computer is connected with the constant-angle horizontal-deflection bearing platform through a data transmission line or in a wireless transmission mode. According to the detection device provided by the invention, through adopting a horizontal time-sharing deflection scanning detection mode and an automatic constant-angle deflection radar life-detection instrument, the detection direction of the detection instrument is changed so as to successively complete the detection on the distribution of life entities in a whole area or a room without moving the radar detection instrument. Because each deflection angle of a radar is equal to the beam width of the radar, no detection-leakage area is produced, and a repeated detection problem is also not produced. The detection device disclosed by the invention has the advantages of high degree of automation, rapid detection speed, accurate time-sharing detection area, no produced detection-leakage leakage and repeated detection, and capability of producing planar graphs of life entity distribution, and the like.

title_en: Water shelter apparatus of underpass
title_ko: 지하도 출입구의 물막이 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A water barrier device for the entrance of an underpass is provided to position a water barrier cover in a vertical direction using a cylinder actuating device or magnetic actuating device installed inside a case. CONSTITUTION: A water barrier device for the entrance of an underpass is buried in the bottom surface of the entrance of an underpass and comprises a case unit and an air inflating and discharging unit. The case unit is composed of a case(10), a hinge(12), and a cover(11). The case is buried in a groove formed on the bottom surface of the entrance. The hinge is coupled to the case. The cover is connected to the hinge and covers the case. The air inflating and discharging unit is composed of an air compressor, an air injecting fan, an airbag(20), and an air outlet. The air compressor powers the air injecting fan. The air injecting fan supplies air into the airbag. The airbag is inflated by the supplied air. The air outlet discharges the air to the outside. [Reference numerals] (AA) Inside; (BB) Outside
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하도 출입구의 물막이 장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 지하도로 내려가는 출입구 바닥에 형성된 홈에 케이스를 설치하여 평상시에는 사람들이 밟고 지나도록 해주고, 집중호우로 침수가 우려될 경우에는 케이스 내부에 장착되어 있는 에어 컴프레셔에 의해 공기주입 팬을 구동시켜 에어백이 수직으로 부풀어 오르거나, 케이스 내부에 장착되어 있는 실린더 작동장치 또는 마그네틱 작동장치에 의해 물막이 커버를 수직으로 직립되게 하며, 매립된 힌지에 의해 결합된 케이스용 커버가 자동으로 에어백의 외측부분에 수직으로 세워짐으로써, 도로에 넘쳐나는 빗물이 지하도로 흘러내리는 것을 완전히 차단되도록 하여 지하 시설물을 보호할 수 있고, 집중호우로 인하여 침수가 우려되는 비가 그쳐 평상시로 되는 경우에는 에어백의 상부 일측에 형성되어 있는 공기 배출구에 의해 공기가 모두 빠져나간 다음 케이스용 커버가 닫쳐지게 함으로써, 사람들이 밟고 지나도록 할 수 있으며, 물막이장치의 후면 일측에 공기압력 조절센서가 설치됨으로써, 에어백의 공기압력을 주변 상황에 맞게 조절을 할 수 있고, 물막이장치의 후면 일측에 유입수 배출구를 형성하여 줌으로써, 물막이 장치 내에 남아있는 유입수를 자연적으로 배출시킬 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: HAN A TECH CO LTD;JANG SEONG JUN

title_en: Waveform-audio-fused ultra-wideband radar life detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel waveform parameter-audio-fused ultra-wideband radar life detector. A radar echo is divided into two paths: one path is processed and extracted into a respiratory signal, and then whether the respiratory signal is a life parameter of a human being is intelligently identified; and the other path is processed into an audio signal through amplitude modulation or frequency modulation, and through multi-channel and noise masking characteristics of a human ear, information carried by the radar echo is monitored in real time in a listening way to obtain information which is difficultly expressed by waveform of an ultra-wideband biological radar echo so as to identify whether a biological radar echo signal carries life information artificially. Through the two processing and identifying ways, the life detection accuracy is greatly improved; and the novel waveform parameter-audio-fused ultra-wideband radar life detector breaks through a limitation that the conventional radar life detector relies on a single waveform parameter for identification, improves the practicality of the radar life detector and has a good application prospect.

title_en: Systems and methods for non-contact multiparameter vital signs monitoring, apnea therapy, apnea diagnosis, and snore therapy
abstract_en: Aspects of the of the disclosure relate to a non-contact physiological motion sensor and a monitor device that can incorporate use of the Doppler effect. A continuous wave of electromagnetic radiation can be transmitted toward one or more subjects and the Doppler-shifted received signals can be digitized and/or processed subsequently to extract information related to the cardiopulmonary motion in the one or more subjects. The extracted information can be used, for example, to determine apneic events and/or snoring events and/or to provide apnea or snoring therapy to subjects when used in conjunction with an apnea or snoring therapy device. In addition, methods of use are disclosed for sway cancellation, realization of cessation of breath, integration with multi-parameter patient monitoring systems, providing positive providing patient identification, or any combination thereof.
assignees: KAI MEDICAL INC;NAKATA ROBERT;MOSTAFANEZHAD ISAR;MIYASATO SCOTT

title_en: Complex tunnel-type agricultural facility and storeroom
title_ko: 복합 터널형 농업시설 및 저장고
abstract_en: To form a complex tunnel-type agricultural facility and storeroom, a foundation is formed on a base selected as a location for the installation of an arched roof structure formed of a foamed polystyrene panel with a thickness of 0.175 M (175 mm) and a width of 2 M, a concrete base, of an L shape and in which a rebar having a diameter of 10 mm is buried in an inner central portion thereof, is formed on an outer side of the foundation, and a panel base part, having a bottom formed of foamed polystyrene above the concrete base and an L and panel-shaped base part, is buried in the concrete base part to reinforce the installed strength of the arched roof structure through the deposition of concrete, and thereby minimize damage generated by typhoons or other natural disasters. Also, in the concrete base part of the bottom surface of the agricultural facility, heating pipes having carbon nanotubes built therein that emit heat derived from electric power are buried at certain intervals so as to be connected to a power source, the growing temperature for crops in the agricultural facility formed in the arched roof structure is controlled by a controller controlled by a temperature sensor installed indoors, a condensing unit formed of carbonate for condensing sunlight is formed on a top surface of the agricultural facility, sunlight is supplied to shaded portions by using a reflector mounted on the panel forming an arched roof to be angle-adjustable, sunlight can be directly received through windows on side surfaces of the structure to allow the agricultural products to grow and photosynthesize, a product loading unit and unloading unit are installed between the agricultural facility and the storeroom to reduce transferring distance in order to avoid having to transport agricultural products produced in the agricultural facility out from the arched roof structure, to thereby effectively minimize a moving line for workers, and the storeroom is maintained at a temperature of 4℃ by using a well-known and common type of refrigerating air-conditioner, so as to maintain the freshness of stored agricultural products and enable appropriate shipping dates of agricultural products to be adjusted.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 의한 복합 터널형 농업시설 및 저장고를 형성하기 위하여, 패널소재의 두께가 0.175M(175㎜)이고, 폭은 2M인 발포 폴리스틸렌에 의한 패널로 이루어지는 원형지붕 구조물의 설치위치가 선정된 바닥기초에 토대를 형성하고, 상기 토대위의 외측부에는 ┗자 형태로 콘크리트 기초를 형성하되, 내부중심부에는 직경10㎜의 철근이 매설되는 콘크리트기초, 상기 콘크리트기초 위에 하부에는 발포 폴리스틸렌으로 형성되며, 패널형태의 기초부가 L자 형태의 패널 기초부를 콘크리트 기초부에 매설하여 원형지붕 구조물의 설치강도를 콘크리트타설로 보강하므로 태풍 및 기타 자연재해로 발생되는 피해를 최소화할 수 있다. 또한, 농업 시설부의 바닥면의 콘크리트 기초부에는 전력에 의거 발열되는 탄소 나노 튜뷰가 내부에 구비된 히팅 파이프를 일정간격으로 매설하여 전원에 연결하고, 실내에 설치된 온도센서에 의거 제어되는 콘트롤러에 의거 원형지붕 구조물의 내부에 형성된 농업시설부의 농산물의 성장온도를 제어하며, 또한, 농업시설부의 상부면에서 햇빛을 집광하기 위하여 카보네이트로 이루어지는 집광부를 형성하고, 원형지붕을 형성하는 패널에는 각도 조절이 가능하게 장착된 반사경에 의거 그늘진 부분에 햇빛을 공급하고, 측면의 창문에서는 태양광을 직접 받아들이에 농산물의 성장의 광합성을 도우며, 물품 상, 하차부는 농업 시설부와 저장고의 사이에 설치하여, 농업 시설부에서 생산된 농산물 등을 원형지붕 구조물의 밖으로 출하할 때보다 그 이송거리를 단축하여 작업자의 동선을 효율적으로 최소화시키고, 저장고에는 공지공용의 냉동 공조시설에 의거 4℃를 유지하여 생산된 보관중인 농작물의 신선도를 유지하고, 농작물의 적정한 출하시기를 조절가능하게 할 수 있다.

title_en: Non-contact type audio frequency life detection instrument based on ultra-wideband biological radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact type audio frequency life detection instrument based on an ultra-wideband biological radar. The non-contact type audio frequency life detection instrument comprises the ultra-wideband biological radar for detecting a measured object, and an echo signal preprocessor connected with the output end of the ultra-wideband biological radar, wherein the output end of the echo signal preprocessor is connected with the input end of a signal modulator, and the output end of the signal modulator is connected with an audio frequency player. The non-contact type audio frequency life detection instrument adopts a listening mode to monitor the audio frequency information carried by radar echo by utilizing the characteristics of multiple channels and noise masking of the ears of people, so that the information which can not be expressed easily by the biological radar echo form or image display can be obtained, further whether the echo signals of the biological radar carry life information or not can be judged by people, and the life detection capability of the life detection instrument in a complex environment can be improved. The non-contact type audio frequency life detection instrument based on the ultra-wideband biological radar breaks through the dependence of the conventional radar type life detection instrument on wave forms and life parameters, and has a broad application prospect and a market promotion value.

title_en: For the equipment, system and method for detection and the processing of heartbeat signal
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the detection for heartbeat signal and the equipment, system and method for processing.A kind of heartbeat detection apparatus, including at least one optical reflection sensor (10 or 10a and 10b) that will be positioned on the skin of people.The sensor unit is provided with optical transmitting set (11) and the corresponding optical receiver (12) that electric signal is converted by the light of skin reflex, and including the electrically tuneable optical filter (16,17) for being connected to transmitter, receiver or both of which, to select desired optical wavelength in operation, and the processing of signal that so obtains is performed to enhance heartbeat signal.Also illustrate system and detection method with the equipment.

title_en: Buried object detection in gpr images
abstract_en: A method and system for detecting the presence of subsurface objects within a medium is provided. In some embodiments, the imaging and detection system operates in a multistatic mode to collect radar return signals generated by an array of transceiver antenna pairs that is positioned across the surface and that travels down the surface. The imaging and detection system pre-processes the return signal to suppress certain undesirable effects. The imaging and detection system then generates synthetic aperture radar images from real aperture radar images generated from the pre-processed return signal. The imaging and detection system then post-processes the synthetic aperture radar images to improve detection of subsurface objects. The imaging and detection system identifies peaks in the energy levels of the post-processed image frame, which indicates the presence of a subsurface object.
assignees: PAGLIERONI DAVID W;CHAMBERS DAVID H;BOND STEVEN W;BEER N REGINALD

title_en: Sensor fusion framework using multiple sensors to assess buried structures
abstract_en: A method of surveying the condition of an underground conduit by positioning a propelled carriage assembly within the underground conduit. The carriage assembly includes (i) at least one transmitter/receiver unit capable of transmitting a pulsed signal toward at least a portion of an inner wall of the conduit, and (ii) a secondary sensor positioned on the carriage assembly. The data derived from the pulsed signal at a given lateral location within an underground conduit is read as is a secondary sensor condition derived from secondary sensor data taken at the given lateral location. Then it is determined whether the secondary sensor condition indicates a basis for a false void detection by the data derived from the pulsed signal and if the basis for false void detection exists, providing an indication of such basis.
assignees: LOUISIANA TECH UNIVERSITY RES FOUNDATION A DIVISION OF LOUISIANA TECH UNIVERSITY FOUNDATION INC;JAGANATHAN ARUN PRAKASH;ALLOUCHE EREZ N

title_en: Disaster escape capsule
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a disaster escape capsule which comprises a capsule body and a capsule door. An oxygen supply device and a storage bin are arranged in the capsule body. The disaster escape capsule is characterized in that the capsule wall of the capsule body is formed by a heat insulation anti-explosion coating, a compression resistant layer, a bulletproof anti-explosion layer and a buffer layer in sequence. The heat insulation anti-explosion coating is made of aluminum silicate heat-protection thermal-insulation plates. The outer layer of the compression resistant layer is a stainless steel outer shell. The inner layer of the compression resistant layer is made of alloy tile-type materials. The bulletproof anti-explosion layer is made of bulletproof polyester fabrics. The buffer layer is formed by a plurality of springs which are arranged on the layer surface in a regular mode. Sponge and rubber are filled in gaps between the springs. Through arrangement of the compression resistant layer, the disaster escape capsule can not structurally deform and break even if the disaster escape capsule drops down from a high altitude or is collided, pressed and buried by heavy objects. Through arrangement of the bulletproof anti-explosion layer, the disaster escape capsule can be effectively prevented from being damaged by bullets, shrapnels and explosion splashes. The buffer layer ensures that people in the disaster escape capsule can feel soft and buffering force is formed.

title_en: Disaster site information intelligent collecting device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a disaster site information intelligent collecting device which comprises a communication module, a temperature pressure sensor, a tender moving sensor, a radio frequency identification device (RFID) reading instrument, a gyroscope, a vital sign detector and the like and is enabled to have innovation functions including individual positioning inside a building, wireless telecommunication, movement state detection, air breathing apparatus pressure monitoring, external environment (temperature, pressure) detection, vital sign monitoring and the like. All the detection parameters can be transmitted to a site command rescue platform in real time. The disaster site information intelligent collecting device is reasonable in design, and capable of improving efficiency of fire fighting and rescue, lowering loss of lives and fortune to the lowest point and improving life safety guarantee level.
assignees: XINJIANG ZHONGJU ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent slope geological disaster monitoring and pre-warning device based on wireless sensor networks
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent slope geological disaster monitoring and pre-warning device based on wireless sensor networks. The device comprises wireless sensor networks, the wireless sensor networks are connected with a data transmitter, the data transmitter is connected with a backbone network, the backbone network is connected with a receiving and analyzing system, and a pre-warning display screen is connected to the receiving and analyzing system. According to the utility model, the wireless sensor networks are buried inside a slope body; a wireless sensor network cluster head is used to acquire sound transmission signals at the initial catastrophe stage of a slope and the signals are transmitted to the data transmitter arranged at a safe position in a wireless way through a multi-hop path; the data transmitter transmits gathered information to the indoor receiving and analyzing system in a customized data format through the backbone network and transmits received signals to a computer of the receiving and analyzing system; the computer analyzes and processes the received signals and takes a pre-warning measure of a corresponding level according to a processing result; and the pre-warning information is transmitted to the pre-warning display screen at a section where a disaster occurs through a communication cable to remind passing vehicles, pedestrians or residential areas and the like to take corresponding disaster reduction and prevention measures.

title_en: Sensor attachable bio signal transmitter
title_ko: 센서의 탈부착이 가능한 생체신호 발신기
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A bio-signal transmitter having a detachable sensor is provided to improve accuracy of bio-signal measurement and to replace a detachable sensor unit. CONSTITUTION: A bio-signal transmitter(100) includes a main body(110), a strap(120) and a detachable sensor unit(130). The main body wirelessly transmits a signal. The strap is connected with both sides of the main body and is supported by a user's wrist. The detachable sensor unit measures a user bio-signal, transmits to the main body and is detachably connected with the main body from the inner side of the strap. The main body judges an emergency state through a measured user bio-signal in the detachable sensor unit and transmits a wireless signal notifying an emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 센서의 탈부착이 가능한 생체신호 발신기에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 생체신호 발신기는 무선으로 신호를 송출하는 본체; 상기 본체의 양측에 결합되며 상기 본체를 사용자의 손목에 지지시켜주는 착용줄; 및 상기 사용자의 생체신호를 측정하여 상기 본체로 전달하며 상기 착용줄 내측에서 상기 본체에 착탈 가능하게 결합되는 착탈식 센서부;를 포함하며, 상기 본체는 상기 착탈식 센서부에서 측정된 상기 사용자의 생체신호를 통해 위급상황을 판단하고 위급상황을 알리는 무선 신호를 송출할 수 있다. 이에 따라 생체신호 발신기를 손목에 착용하면 착용줄 내측에 위치한 착탈식 센서부의 센서가 착용줄의 조임에 의해 손목에 완전하게 밀착될 수 있으며, 따라서 더욱 정확하게 생체신호를 측정할 수가 있다. 더불어 착탈식 센서부의 교체가 가능하여 다른 종류의 센서를 적용시킬 수가 있다.
assignees: OHSUNG E R S TECH CO LTD

title_en: Sensor head
abstract_en: Detection systems for scanning regions are disclosed. The detection systems may be used to detect various objects that are, for example, buried in the ground or obscured by being hidden on the body of a person. The detection systems include a sensor head having a continuous wave metal detector (CWMD) coil, radar antennas, and a transceiver electrically connected to a radar. The radar includes a transmit antenna configured to transmit electromagnetic radiation, and a receive antenna configured to sense electromagnetic radiation.
assignees: DUVOISIN III HERBERT;CARLSON DOUGLAS O;HOLMAN GLEN A;JOHNSON KEVIN L;SCOTT WAYMOND;SENTELLE CHRISTOPHER GARY;SOLOMON GEOFFREY;TABONY JOSHUA L;TORRES-ROSARIO JUAN ANTONIO;TRISHAUN MARQUETTE;L3 COMMUNICATIONS CYTERRA CORP

title_en: Radar detection of buried objects
abstract_en: An apparatus for detecting objects includes a transceiver configured to generate a radar signal, a transmit antenna coupled to the transceiver and configured to emit the radar signal, the radar signal comprising a first circular polarization, and a receive antenna coupled to the transceiver and configured to receive a return signal, the return signal comprising the first circular polarization.

title_en: Cognitive workload estimation system using driving performance and physiological data
title_ko: 운전수행도와 생체신호를 이용한 운전 중 인지부하 평가장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A cognitive load estimation system using driving performance and a physiological data and a method thereof are provided to allow a driver to safely and conveniently drive by operating a safe driving support system or by appropriately warning according to a cognitive load state of the driver. CONSTITUTION: A cognitive load estimation system(100) using driving performance and a physiological data comprises a lane detecting unit(140), an SDLP calculation unit(110), an SCL calculation unit(120), and a cognitive load determining unit(130). The lane detecting unit calculates a lane position by inputting an image of vehicle surroundings. The SDLP calculation unit calculates a standard deviation value of the lane position which is accumulated for predetermined time about a lane position data transmitted from the lane detecting unit. The SCL calculation unit calculates an average value of skin conductivity of the driver for the predetermined time from a skin conductance sensor mounted on a handle of a vehicle. The cognitive load determining unit estimates a cognitive load state of a driver through the SDLP value and the average value of the skin conductivity. [Reference numerals] (110) SDLP calculation unit; (120) SCL calculation unit; (130) Cognitive load determining unit; (140) Lane detecting unit; (151) HMI module; (152) Display unit; (153) Audio unit; (AA) Bio signal sensor data; (BB) In the absence of an ADAS; (CC) Image; (DD) Lane position data from an ADAS; (EE) Estimated severity of cognitive loads
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 운전수행도와 생체신호를 이용하여 운전자의 운전중 인지부하를 평가하고, 그 평가에 따른 안전 및 예방 조치를 행하는 지능형 자동차 시스템에 과한 것이다. 이를 위해, 본 발명은, 상기 차량의 이미지를 입력받아 차선의 위치를 계산하는 차선 검출부와, 상기 차선 검출부로부터 수신된 상기 차선의 위치 데이터에 대해 일정 시간 동안 누적된 SDLP 값을 구하는 SDLP 연산부와, 상기 차량의 스킨 컨덕턴스 센서로부터 일정시간 동안 입력된 상기 차량의 운전자에 대한 피부전도도의 평균값을 구하는 SCL 연산부와, 상기 SDLP값과 피부전도도 평균값을 통해 상기 운전자의 인지부하 상태를 추정하는 인지부하 판단부를 포함하는 인지부하 평가장치 및 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Emergency communication system based on intelligent terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency communication system based on an intelligent terminal. The emergency communication system based on the intelligent terminal comprises the intelligent terminal which supports wireless transmission technology such as Bluetooth, wireless fidelity (WIFI), Zigbee or amateur radio, and software which runs on the terminals and supports an offline end-to-end communication mode, so that certain communication capacity can be kept under the condition that cellular mobile communication network infrastructure is seriously damaged, and rescue and relief work is convenient. By the adoption of the scheme, when traditional communication network does not work due to various natural disasters such as an earthquake, an end-to-end communication direct connection mode can be adopted, and a certain distance communication can be conducted when the network infrastructure is removed, so that a trapped person who is buried under ruins knows a position and a state by making a call and rescue and relief work is quite beneficial. Therefore, the emergency communication system based on the intelligent terminal has high economic value and social benefits.

title_en: Device and method for detecting position and orientation of underground elongated bodies
abstract_en: A method for defining a lay direction δ of at least one elongated buried object (50), by means of GPR technique (Ground Penetrating Radar), comprises the steps of moving a first GPR sensor (110) along a first trajectory s consisting of a plurality of points P, and moving a second GPR sensor (110'), integral to the first GPR sensor (110), along a second trajectory s' consisting of a plurality of points P' and parallel to the first trajectory s. The method also comprises the steps of detecting a first and a second plurality of presence signals concerning possible buried objects by the first GPR sensor (110) and the second GPR sensor (120), acquisition of a first and a second set of spatial coordinates for each point P and P' at which a presence signal is detected, and receiving by a control unit (150) the presence signals and the set of spatial coordinates. The method provides then a step of computing the data concerning the presence of possible buried elongated objects (50) and the set of spatial coordinates, in order to determine, among all points P and P' at which a presence signal has been detected, points P 1  and P 1 ' at which the probability of presence of an elongated buried object (50) is higher. Then, a step of determining, at the end of said computing step, the lay direction δ of at least one elongated buried object (50) is carried out responsive to the set of spatial coordinates corresponding to points P 1  and P 1 '.
assignees: I D S INGEGNERIA DEI SISTEMI S P A

title_en: Human life detection mechanism applicable to S-shaped robot
abstract_en: A human life detection mechanism applicable to an S-shaped robot comprises pyroelectric infrared sensors. A power apparatus is fixed in the S-shaped robot body, a main bevel gear is mounted on an output shaft of the power apparatus, and rotary shafts are mounted on a casing of the S-shaped robot through bearings. Auxiliary bevel gears are mounted at one ends of the rotary shafts, and the other ends stretch out of the S-shaped robot. A plurality of the rotary shafts are distributed evenly on a longitudinal section of the S-shaped robot to form a group of the rotary shafts which are meshed with the main bevel gear through the auxiliary bevel gears. At least one group of the rotary shafts is arranged on the S-shaped robot, and the pyroelectric infrared sensors are installed at the ends of the rotary shafts stretching out of the S-shaped robot and connected with a receiving processing apparatus in the S-shaped robot through wires in the rotary shafts. According to the human life detection mechanism, the structure is simple and stable, the size is small, and the sensitivity is high; universal sensing apparatuses and processing circuits on the market can be used, so that a good practicality is provided; and trapped persons with vital signs can be detected in a rescue and disaster relief process, particularly in ruins.

title_en: Robot for life-saving
title_ko: 인명 구조 로봇
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A lifesaving robot is provided to freely move debris of a collapsed building in a random direction and to detect a person who is buried in the debris of the collapsed building. CONSTITUTION: A lifesaving robot comprises a movement unit(100), a sensing sensor unit(200), a human sensing signal generator(300), and a transmitting and receiving unit(400). The movement unit comprises a mobile unit(110) and a movement control unit(120). The mobile unit moves the lifesaving robot inside a collapsed building. The movement control unit controls the mobile unit. The sensing sensor unit senses a person who is positioned in a movement route of the lifesaving robot. The human sensing signal generator generates a human sensing signal including a count identifier when receiving the human sensing signal. The transmitting and receiving unit transmits the human sensing signal to a surrounding lifesaving robot through a local area wireless network. [Reference numerals] (110) Moving unit; (120) Movement control unit; (200) Sensor unit; (300) Human sensing signal generator; (400) Transmitting and receiving unit; (500) Display unit; (600) Distance control signal generator
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인명 구조 로봇에 관한 것으로, 보다 구체적으로 소형으로 제작되어 자연 피해나 인공 피해로 인해 붕괴된 건축물 잔해를 자유롭게 이동하여 붕괴된 건축물 잔해에 매몰되어 있는 사람을 감지하며, 사람을 감지하는 순간 이동을 멈추고 사람 감지 신호를 생성하여 주변 인명 구조 로봇으로 송신하며 사람 감지 신호를 수신하는 인명 구조 로봇은 사람 감지 신호의 카운트 식별자를 증가시켜 카운트 식별자가 감소하는 방향에 위치하는 인명 구조 로봇을 따라가며 붕괴된 건축물에서 매몰된 사람을 용이하게 구조할 수 있는 인명 구조 로봇에 관한 것이다.
assignees: UNIV KYUNG HEE UNIV IND COOP GROUP

title_en: Ultra wide band radar life detection device used for positioning
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ultra wide band radar life detection device used for positioning comprising a satellite differential positioning base station unit, a detection control and display system, and more than three ultra wide band radar life detection units. The satellite differential positioning base station unit can be cooperated with the ultra wide band radar life detection units to complete the self-positioning. Each of the ultra wide band radar life detection units comprises a WiFi data transceiving module, a satellite positioning module, an ultra wide band radar life detection transceiving and processing module. The ultra wide band radar life detection transceiving and processing module can use the radar to detect life signals, and the satellite positioning module can be cooperated with the satellite differential positioning base station unit. The WiFi data transceiving module can be connected with the detection control and display system, and can be used to transmit the detected data signals. The detection control and display system can be used to complete a WiFi networking and transceiving work, a target positioning resolving work, and a detection result display work. The ultra wide band radar life detection device has advantages of convenient operation, superior performance, high positioning accuracy, and ability of improving efficiency of searching and rescuing affected people.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: End of service life indicator for organic vapor respirator cartridges
abstract_en: Embodiments are generally directed to detection of end of service life of a respirator cartridge for one or more organic vapors. In general, end-of-life detection may use a competitive UV light absorption-fluorescence method. Thus, a sensor that emits light when UV is applied may be placed within the cartridge with the UV lamp and photodetector directed at the sensor. In some embodiments, multiple corresponding sensors and UV lamps and light detectors may be used. Generally, the light level emitted by one or more sensors can be used to estimate the effective end of life.

title_en: Carbon dioxide detector used for ruins life detection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a carbon dioxide detection device used for ruins life detection. A sampling rod sleeve is of a hollow structure, a conical head is fixed at the front end of an internal support to form a sampling inner core, and the rear end of a conical sleeve is connected with the front end of the sampling rod sleeve in a sealing manner to form a hollow sampling rod; the sampling inner core is inserted into the sampling rod, the sampling inner core and the sampling rod are arranged in a sliding manner, and a locking device is arranged between the sampling inner core and the sampling rod; a gas sampling pump, a carbon dioxide sensor and a separating plate are respectively fixed on the internal support; the separating plate separates the gas sampling pump from the carbon dioxide sensor, the separating plate and the inner wall of the sampling rod are in sliding hermetic seal, and an output air pipe of the gas sampling pump penetrates through the separating plate to be communicated with the carbon dioxide sensor; and the carbon dioxide sensor is electrically connected with a display control alarm device. The carbon dioxide detection device used for ruins life detection solves the problem that the existing carbon dioxide life detection device is not applicable to detection in debris ruins environment, and the device and the method provided by the utility model are convenient for searching trapped persons in debris ruins in a rescue scene.
assignees: INST OF CRUSTAL DYNAMICS CHINA SEISMOLOGICAL BUREAU

title_en: Breath measurement system based on x-band doppler radar
title_ko: 엑스밴드 도플러 레이더를 이용한 호흡 측정시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A respiration measurement system capable of using an X-band Doppler radar is provided to use a DFD(Dual Frequency Differential) method, thereby facilitating the measurement. CONSTITUTION: A transceiver process unit(120) obtains a bio-signal from a patient. An antenna unit propagates a frequency to the patient. An amplifier(130) amplifies the size of the bio-signal. A TCP IP transmission unit(140) transmits bio-signal to a respiration analysis equipment. A noise elimination filter unit removes the noise of the bio-signal. [Reference numerals] (110) X-Band antenna unit; (120) Transceiver process unit; (130) Amplifier; (140) TCP/IP transmission unit
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 엑스밴드 도플러 레이더를 이용한 호흡 측정시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 사람의 심장부에 RF 신호를 방사하여 생체 신호를 검출하여 원격으로 호흡을 측정하는 바이오 레이더 시스템으로 신체에 부착하지 않은 상태에서 호흡을 측정하며, 측정된 호흡 정보를 관제모니터링수단에서 실시간으로 저장하고 관리하여 미리 설정된 경고/위험수준에 도달하면 알람을 발생시키고, 해당 호흡값 정보를 환자이력관리부에 저장 관리하는 엑스밴드 도플러 레이더를 이용한 호흡 측정시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명을 통해 사람의 심장부에 RF 신호를 방사하여 생체 신호를 검출하여 원격으로 호흡을 측정하는 바이오 레이더 시스템으로 신체에 부착하지 않은 상태에서 호흡을 측정할 수 있게 되어 중환자 혹은 상시 호흡 측정이나 모니터링이 필요한 환자를 대상으로 실시간 호흡수 측정이 가능한 효과를 제공하게 된다.

title_en: Monitoring system and method for concreteballast
title_ko: 광섬유 브릴루앙 산란 센서를 이용한 철도 콘크리트 도상 변형 감시 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system and a method using an optical fiber brillouin scattering sensor for monitoring the deformation of railway concrete roadbed are provided to sense a position and the size of the deformation generated in an arbitrary position on the railway concrete roadbed of a monitoring target section, thereby measuring the deformation of a track caused by a roadbed loss and subsidence might be generated natural disasters. CONSTITUTION: A system using an optical fiber brillouin scattering sensor for monitoring the deformation of railway concrete roadbed comprises a roadbed monitoring member and an information analyzing member. The roadbed monitoring member acquires brillouin scattering lights according to the length of an optical fiber buried in the concrete roadbed, thereby calculating a brillouin frequency, which is a frequency of the brillouin scattering lights. The information analyzing member converts the brillouin frequency acquired by the roadbed monitoring member, thereby extracting the temperature of the roadbed and deformation data thereof.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 광섬유 브릴루앙 산란 센서를 이용한 철도 콘크리트 도상 변형 감시 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로; 콘크리트 도상에 매립된 광섬유의 길이에 따른 브릴루앙 산란광을 취득하여 이의 중심 주파수인 브릴루앙 주파수를 산출하는 도상감시수단과, 상기 도상감지수단에서 취득한 브릴루앙 주파수를 환산하여 도상의 온도 및 변형 데이터를 추출하는 정보분석수단으로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 광섬유 브릴루앙 산란 센서를 이용한 철도 콘크리트 도상 변형 감시 시스템과, 그 감시 방법을 제공한다.  
본 발명에 따르면, 감시 대상 구간에 위치한 콘크리트 도상의 임의의 위치에서 발생한 변형의 위치와 크기를 감지할 수 있게 하므로, 지진 및 폭우 등 자연재해로 인해 발생할 수 있는 노반 유실 및 침하에 의한 궤도 변형을 측정하는데 사용되어 즉각적인 선로 유지보수에 사용될 수 있다.

title_en: Combined low and high frequency band multiple ground-penetrating radar system, and control method thereof
title_ko: 저주파/고주파 복합형 지하 탐사 레이더 시스템 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A low and high frequency combined underground exploration radar system and a control method of the same are provided to use both a low frequency radar system and a high frequency radar system, thereby detecting all targets buried in a shallow or deep depth using a single system. CONSTITUTION: A low frequency radar module generates and transmits a low frequency band pulse signal and obtains a reflected signal of a generated low frequency band pulse signal from an underground buried target. A high frequency radar module generates and transmits a high frequency band pulse signal. The high frequency radar module obtains a reflected signal of a generated high frequency band pulse signal from the underground buried target. An image processing device displays signals obtained in the low frequency radar module and the high frequency radar module. [Reference numerals] (AA) Bent trace; (BB) Drainpipe
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 저주파/고주파 복합형 지하 탐사 레이더 시스템 및 그 제어 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 시스템은 저주파 대역 펄스 신호를 생성하여 방사하고, 상기 생성된 저주파 대역 펄스 신호가 지하 매설 표적으로부터 반사되는 신호를 획득하는 저주파 레이더 모듈, 고주파 대역 펄스 신호를 생성하여 방사하고, 상기 생성된 고주파 대역 펄스 신호가 지하 매설 표적으로부터 반사되는 신호를 획득하는 고주파 레이더 모듈, 그리고 상기 저주파 레이더 모듈에서 획득된 신호와 상기 고주파 레이더 모듈에서 획득된 신호를 합성하여 표시하는 영상 처리 장치를 포함한다.  본 발명에 의하면 지하의 얕은 곳에 매설되어 있는 작은 표적과 깊은 곳에 매설되어 있는 큰 표적을 하나의 시스템으로 하나의 화면 상에서 동시에 인식할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Heartbeat signal processor and heartbeat signal processing method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable acquisition of proper heartbeat detection characteristics by removing a noise from a heartbeat signal.SOLUTION: A heartbeat signal processor includes: a means for acquiring a heartbeat signal associated with a subject's heartbeat from a heartbeat sensor; a low-pass filter for allowing the passage of the signal with a first predetermined frequency or lower, among the heartbeat signals; a harmonic noise acquiring means for acquiring a harmonic signal with a low-frequency noise by applying high-pass complementation to the signal output from the low-pass filter means; a high-pass filter for allowing the passage of the signal with a second predetermined frequency or higher, among the heartbeat signals; and a harmonic noise removing means for removing the harmonic signal with the low-frequency noise from the signal output from the high-pass filter.
assignees: TOYOTA INFOTECH CT CO LTD;TOYOTA MOTOR CORP

title_en: Laying method of long distance coal conveying pipeline at debris flow gully section
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pipeline laying method and particularly relates to a laying method of a long distance coal conveying pipeline at a debris flow gully section. The laying method includes the following steps: 1) a pipe ditch on a coal paste laying line is dug to the bed rock, and width of the pipe ditch is two times of that of a designed pipe ditch; 2) a pipe ditch is dug on the bed rock, and depth and width of the pipe ditch meet requirements of pipeline laying; and 3) when the pipeline is laid well, prevention measures of flood drainage and flow guidance are performed on the section so as to reduce damage of debris flow on the coal conveying pipeline. Due to the fact that the pipeline is buried deeply, the pipeline is arranged in the bed rock with underlaying stability, the risk that the pipeline is damaged by the debris flow in a debris flow season is reduced, the top of the pipeline is buried under the frost line, and thermal insulation performance of the pipeline is improved.
assignees: WUHAN DESIGN & RES INST CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP

title_en: After-calamity search-and-rescue cluster locating method based on assist of air pressure and height measurement
abstract_en: The invention disclose an after-calamity search-and-rescue cluster locating method based on assist of air pressure and height measurement, and relates to the technology of locating. According to the method, a mobile phone and a plurality of life detection instruments are included. The mobile phone and the life detection instruments are respectively provided a temperature and air pressure sensor, and the position of each life detection instrument is accurately measured firstly. Under the after-calamity condition, a trapped person decodes and modulates information such as the air pressure, temperature and life and then sends a distress signal through the mobile phone, and the life detection instruments receive the distress signal at the same time and process the distress signal to obtain measurement information such as the distance from the mobile phone to the life detection instruments. Information of distance measurement and the height of the mobile phone of each subsidiary life detect instrument is transmitted to a main life detection instrument through a communication link. Measurement data of the main life detection instrument and the subsidiary life detection instruments are combined with measurement data of the air pressure and the height of the mobile phone, weighting processing is carried out on the measurement data, absolute elevation of a user is obtained, the absolute elevation of the user serves as an auxiliary equation, the auxiliary equation is processed by the main life detection instrument and then the three-dimension position of the mobile phone is obtained. The method is simple and easy to implement, the obtained three-dimension position of the trapped person is accurate, and the search-and-rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Life-saving robot prepared for avalanches and snow storms
title_ko: 눈사태와 폭설에 대비한 재난 방제 및 인명 구조 로봇
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A disaster control and life-saving robot used in snow slide and heavy snow is provided to identify the location of people with a distance measuring sensor, a sound detecting sensor and a camera, to send a signal to rescue workers, and then to rescue people buried in snow. CONSTITUTION: A disaster control and life-saving robot used in snow slide and heavy snow inhales snow through a snow sucking unit (10) and converts snow into water by a heating plate (20). The disaster control and life-saving robot used in snow slide and heavy snow converts the water into vapor by an ultrasonic generator (50) for removing snow. The disaster control and life-saving robot used in snow slide and heavy snow identifies the location of people with a distance measuring sensor, a sound detecting sensor and a camera, sends a signal to rescue workers and then rescues people buried in snow.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 눈사태와 폭설 시 재난 방제 및 인명을 구조하는 로봇에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 눈을 수증기로 바꿈으로써 눈을 제거하고, 눈에 갇힌 사람의 위치를 파악함과 더불어, 구조 신호를 보내 구조대원들이 조난자를 구조할 수 있도록 메커니즘을 제공할 수 있는 눈 제거 및 인명 구조에 관한 로봇이다.

title_en: Life-saving robot prepared for avalanches and snow storms
title_ko: 눈사태와 폭설에 대비한 재난 방제 및 인명 구조 로봇

title_en: Determining penetrability of a barrier
abstract_en: A through-wall radar system includes a transceiver configured to receive and transmit multiple radar signals, each radar signal associated with a frequency that nominally passes through a barrier. The system includes a processor coupled to an electronic storage, the processor configured to sense a portion of a signal transmitted by the transceiver and analyze the sensed portion of the signal to determine a penetrability of a barrier. The system also includes an output configured to present a perceivable indicator related to the determined penetrability of the barrier.
assignees: CYTERRA CORP L 3 COMM;L3 COMMUNICATIONS CYTERRA CORP

title_en: Inductive biosignal detection sensor based on conductive textile
title_ko: 전도성 직물기반 유도용량성 생체신호 측정 센서
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A conductive fabric based inductively capacitive biological signal measurement sensor is provided to detect volume change of a biological tissue by preparing a contact prevention unit consisting of an insulator. CONSTITUTION: An inductively capacitive biological signal measurement sensor receives a vibration signal from an oscillation unit, forms an inductor and outputs a vibration signal having a biological signal. A spiral coil confines a magnetic flux in a central part and has a whirlwind form. The spiral coil is formed to be an embroidery using silver thread or conductive thread. A contact prevention unit between coil wire of the spiral coil and coil wire is prepared. The contact prevention unit is prepared by stitching with a thread.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 발진부로부터 진동신호를 수신하면 시변함수의 인덕터가 형성되어, 생체신호가 포함된 진동신호를 출력하는 유도용량성 생체신호 측정 센서에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은, 발진부로부터 진동신호를 수신하면, 시변함수의 인덕터가 형성되어, 생체신호가 포함된 진동신호를 출력하는 유도용량성 생체신호 측정 센서에 있어서, 중앙부위에 자속을 집속시킬 수 있도록, 직물지 위에 회오리 형태를 가지는 나선형 코일을, 은사 또는 전도사(conductive yarn)를 이용하여 자수(embroidery)로 형성하며, 상기 나선형 코일에서 코일선과 코일선 사이에는 절연체로 이루어진 접촉방지부를 구비하되, 상기 접촉방지부는 실로 스티치를 행하여 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: UNIV KONKUK IND COOP CORP;UNIV YONSEI IACF

title_en: Biometric system using both hands for evaluation of blood vessel and cardio pulmonary function
title_ko: 양손을 이용한 혈관 및 심폐기능 평가를 위한 생체 계측 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a biometric system using both hands for the evaluation of blood vessel and cardio pulmonary function, the system being capable of measuring an electrocardiogram, oxygen saturation, blood pressure, body impedance and performing tests on body fat percentage, non-invasive blood pressure (NIBP), vascular compliance, cardiac output and pulmonary function, in order to perform multi-dimensional analysis on the bio parameters rather than using a single parameter, and using just two hands, thus reducing cost and time restrictions and allowing continuous monitoring of blood vessel and cardio pulmonary function. A biometric system of the present invention is configured in that a blood pressure measuring cuff is placed around the wrist of a user, and a left end and a right end of the system can be held by the hand of the user, respectively, the left right ends having respective hand contact portions in which the respective bio signal detection electrodes are embedded, the system comprising: an electrocardiogram and body impedance measurement module serving as a means for measuring an electrocardiogram, body impedance, cardiac output and impedance pulmonary function and having an electrocardiogram sensor unit and a body impedance sensor unit for detecting an electrocardiogram signal and a body impedance signal in order to thus measure an electrocardiogram parameter including RR interval, FEV1/FVC ratio, cardiac output, body fat and vascular compliance; an oxygen saturation detection module having an oxygen saturation sensor unit for detecting oxygen saturation; a blood pressure measurement module having an NIBP sensor unit and a pressure sensor unit for detecting a blood pressure signal from the NIBP sensor unit and a Korotkoff sound signal from the pressure sensor unit in order to detect blood pressure from the blood pressure signal by means of an oscillometric method and detect blood pressure based on the Korotkoff sound from the Korotkoff sound signal; and a main module for controlling operations of the electrocardiogram and body impedance measurement module, the oxygen saturation detection module and the blood pressure measurement module, collecting statistics on the bio measurement signals of a user and outputting the result on a display unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 양손만을 이용하여, 단일 파라미터가 아닌, 심전도, 산소포화도, 혈압, 체임피던스를 측정하고, 체지방율, 비관혈식 혈압(NIBP), 혈관탄성도, 심박출량, 폐기능 검사의 다차원의 생체 파라미터의 분석을 행하여, 비용과 시간의 제약이 적게 들며, 지속적인 혈관 및 심폐기능 모니터링이 가능한, 양손을 이용한 혈관 및 심폐기능 평가를 위한 생체 계측 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은, 손목에 혈압측정용 커프를 장착하고, 좌측단과 우측단을 손으로 잡도록 이루어지되, 좌측단과 우측단의 손접촉부에는 생체신호 검출전극이 장착되어 있는 생체 계측 시스템에 있어서, 심전도, 체임피던스, 심박출량, 임피던스 폐기능검사를 측정하는 수단으로, 심전도 센서부과 체임피던스 센서부을 구비하여, 심전도신호와 체임피던스 신호를 검출하여, RR간격을 포함하는 심전도 파라미터, FEV1/FVC 비율, 심박출량, 체지방량, 혈관탄성도을 측정하는 심전도 및 체임피던스 측정모듈; 산소포화도 센서부를 구비하여 산소포화도를 검출하는 산소포화도 검출모듈; NIBP 센서부 및 압력센서부를 구비하여, NIBP센서부로부터의 혈압신호 및 압력센서부로부터의 코르트코프음신호를 검출하여, 혈압 신호로부터 오실로메트릭법에 따른 혈압을 검출하고, 코르트코프음신호로부터 코로토코프음에 따른 혈압을 검출하는 혈압측정모듈; 심전도 및 체임피던스 측정모듈, 산소포화도 검출모듈, 혈압측정모듈의 구동을 제어하고, 사용자의 생체측정신호를 통계처리하여 결과를 디스플레이부로 출력하는 메인 모듈를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: UNIV YONSEI WONJU INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION;NUGA MEDICAL CO LTD;CHO SYUNG HYUN;LEE JONG SOO;YI KYE HYOUNG;JUNG WOON MO;JUNG SANG O;YOON HYUNG RO;SIM MYEONG HEON;KIM MIN YONG;YOON CHAN SOL

title_ko: 다기능 연기투시 랜턴
abstract_ko: 본 고안은 다기능 연기투시 랜턴에 관한 것으로서, 헤드부와, 본체부와, 바닥부를 가지며, 상기 본체부는 내측에 배터리를 수용하는 배터리부와, 상기 반사판측으로 삽입되는 LED램프와, 상기 배터리부의 배터리에 접속되는 마이콤과, 상기 마이콤에 전기적으로 접속되는 스위치부와, 상기 마이콤에 전기적으로 접속되는 위치센서와, 상기 마이콤으로부터 인가된 전압신호에 따라 배터리의 잔량을 표시하는 배터리잔량표시부와, 상기 마이콤에 연결되는 레이저포인터를 구비하며, 상기 바닥부는 상기 마이콤에 전기적으로 접속되는 경고음 발생부과 상기 바닥부의 저면을 관통하여 형성된 복수의 관통홀을 구비하며, 상기 랜턴은 충전용 거치대를 더욱 구비하여, 랜턴 사용자가 안전사고를 당하여 일정시간 움직임이 없을 경우 비상 경고음을 발생시켜 다른 소방대원으로부터 구조를 받을 수 있는 비상경고음 발생기능을 구비함과 동시에, 짙은 연무가 발생한 경우에도 사물의 식별이 용이하고, 배터리 잔량을 인식할 수 있도록 하여 예상치 못한 배터리의 방전으로 인한 위험을 배제할 수 있고, 랜턴을 올려놓는 것만으로도 충전이 가능한 충전용 거치대를 구비하여 비상시에 신속하고 용이하게 파지할 수 있으며, 랜턴의 밝기를 여러 단계로 조절함과 동시에 밝기의 조절이 간편하게 할 수 있으며, 하나의 랜턴에 상술한 여러 가지 기능을 구비하여 보다 편리하고 유용하게 사용할 수 있다.

title_en: User interfaces for utility locators
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to utility locator and user interfaces for use with such locators. Such utility locators may include multiple antennas and sensors for determining and displaying information associated with a buried or otherwise inaccessible utility.

title_en: An intrinsically safe wireless data acquiring apparatus
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intrinsically safe wireless data acquiring apparatus. The intrinsically safe wireless data acquiring apparatus comprises a housing. A display screen is disposed on the front surface of the housing. An antenna is disposed on the top of the housing. A circuit supporting board is disposed in the housing and is equipped with a video server, a wireless communication card, a Bluetooth communication device, a RS485 communication device, and a power supply device. The power supply device provides electricity for various devices and elements. The Bluetooth communication device is wirelessly connected with a human vital sign sensor of a peripheral data device. The RS485 communication device is wirelessly connected with an environmental parameter sensor of the peripheral data device. The video server is connected with a camera device and a headset of the peripheral data device. The video server, the Bluetooth communication device, and the RS485 communication device transmit acquired signals to a repeater of the peripheral data device via the wireless communication card. The repeater transmits the acquired signals in a communication manner to a rear-end server in an external data management center to be processed. The intrinsically safe wireless data acquiring apparatus can be widely used in daily and emergency rescue in underground coal mines.
assignees: BEIJING CHINA COAL MINE ENG CO

title_en: Water amount detection device, vital sign detection device, and environment control system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To detect a water amount derived from a living body in a non-contact state.SOLUTION: A living body water amount detection unit 1 includes: a light source 11 that irradiates electromagnetic wave to a fabric part 231 as a detection target; at least one sensor 141 that detects a return amount of the electromagnetic wave reflected by the fabric part 231; and a calculation part 15 that calculates the return amount detected by the sensor 141 and converts it into the water amount.

title_en: Wireless life search and rescue instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wireless life search and rescue instrument which comprises a life detection sensing module and a wireless receiving module. The life detection sensing module includes a microcontroller and a vibration sensor and a human body infrared sensor which are connected with the microcontroller, wherein the microcontroller contains an ARM-core-based STM32 single-chip microcomputer; an output end of the microcontroller is connected with a wireless transmitting antenna. The wireless receiving module includes a wireless receiving antenna and a signal processor, wherein the wireless receiving antenna is connected with an input end of the signal processor. According to the wireless life search and rescue instrument, the vibration sensor has high sensitivity and high reliability; the human body infrared sensor is utilized to sense a survivor and the survivor information can be readily and rapidly transmitted wirelessly to the wireless receiving module, and the wireless receiving module gives audio alarms and searches and locates the survivor, and thus the search and rescue efficiency is improved, and the death rates in earthquakes or other disasters are substantially reduced.
assignees: ANHUI POPULAR SCIENCE PRODUCT ENG RES CT CO LTD

title_en: Garment for measuring vital signals
title_ko: 생체신호측정용 의복
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A garment for biological signal measurement is provided to accurately measure a biological signal by increasing the adhesion between a biological signal measurement unit and the body of a patient and to take prompt emergency measures by informing an emergency situation to the outside when the emergency situation occurs. CONSTITUTION: A garment(10) for biological signal measurement comprises a main body(100), a biological signal measurement unit, and a biological signal measurement sensor(300). The biological signal measurement unit is detachable from the main body. The biological signal measurement unit is in contact with the body of a patient to measure a biological signal of the patient. The biological signal measurement sensor is connected to the biological signal measurement unit to send the biological signal transmitted from the biological signal measurement unit to a terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 생체신호측정용 의복은 의복 본체와 분리 가능하게 결합되는 생체신호측정 유닛을 구비하여, 의복 본체의 관리 편의성을 향상시킬 뿐만 아니라 생체신호측정 유닛과 신체와의 밀착력을 증대시켜 정확한 생체신호 측정을 가능하게 한다.

title_en: System for rescuing distress of human life by collapse and fire
title_ko: 붕괴 및 화재에 따른 인명 조난 구조 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system for rescuing people when a collapse or fire occurs is provided to minimize the number of victims by determining whether a person exists inside a building in which the collapse or fire occurs. CONSTITUTION: An acceleration sensor (110) measures vibrations affected to a building when an earthquake occurs or an external impact is applied. An inclination sensor (120) measures a change in an inclination angle of the building. An analog-to-digital (A/D) converting unit (140) converts analog data filtered in a band-pass filter into digital data. A human body sensing unit (300) detects an infrared ray generated from a human body and senses existence of a person inside the building. A data analyzing unit (400) determines whether a person exists inside the building. [Reference numerals] (100) Collapse detection unit; (110) Acceleration sensor; (120) Inclination sensor; (130) Band pass filter; (140) A/D converting unit; (200) Smoke detection unit; (300) Human body sensing unit; (400) Data analyzing unit; (500) Warning alarm unit; (600) Power supply unit
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사람들이 내부에서 업무 또는 휴식을 취하는 건축물에 지진, 외부 충격, 화재가 발생할 경우 건축물 내부에 미처 대피하지 못한 사람의 유무를 감지하고 붕괴로 인한 매몰자 및 화재로 인한 질식자를 감지하여 구조대원에게 구조요청을 할 수 있도록 경보 및 구조요청 신호를 전달하는 것으로 상기 건축물에 발생하는 붕괴와 화재를 붕괴 감지부와 화재 감지부를 통해 감지하고, 상기 건축물의 내부에 사람이 존재할 경우 인체 감지부를 통해 사람의 유무를 감지하여 건축물의 붕괴 또는 화재 발생 시 구조대원들이 휴대하고 있는 구조 요청 단말기에 붕괴 또는 화재 발생 신호를 전송하고 인체 감지부를 통해 사람의 유무 감지 시 사람이 있다고 판단할 경우 붕괴로 인해 발생한 매몰자 또는 화재에 따른 연기 질식자가 있음을 구조 요청 단말기에 전송하여 상기 건축물의 붕괴 및 화재 발생 시 구조대원들이 매몰자 또는 질식자를 신속하게 구조할 수 있는 붕괴 및 화재에 따른 인명 조난 구조 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: A radar life detection instrument comprises a detection machine main body and a Bluetooth device, wherein the Bluetooth device 1 comprises a Bluetooth module and a display module. The detection machine main body comprises transmitting/receiving antennas (2 and 3), a low noise amplifier 4, a power amplifier 5, a modulator-demodulator 6 and a signal processing device 7, wherein the transmitting antenna 2 is arranged on the power amplifier 5, the receiving antenna 3 is arranged on the low noise amplifier 4, and the low noise amplifier 4 and the power amplifier 5 are connected with the signal processing device 7 through the modulator-demodulator 6.
assignees: BEIJING TOPSKY AUTOMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Implementation method towards the wireless sensor network emergency communication system of earthquake disaster
abstract_en: A kind of implementation method based on the wireless sensor network emergency communication system towards earthquake disaster, this system is by multifunctional sensing node, wireless sensor network gateway, systems soft ware and terminal software four part are constituted, multifunctional sensing node passes through blood oxygen probe, pulse is popped one's head in, the multiple probe such as probe for detecting temperature gathers the blood oxygen of human body, pulse, the specifying informations such as body temperature and relative geographical location information, then wireless sense network gateway device is transferred data to by wireless sensing module, gateway device is by realizing wireless sense network and Ethernet, the seamless switching of WLAN, concrete data are passed on terminal unit by infrastructure network, Surveillance center can use associated mobile device easily, such as PDA, the vital sign of smart mobile phone monitoring trapped personnel and geographical location information.This system can be applied practically under earthquake disaster environment, the life of people, the loss of property brought due to earthquake disaster can be reduced in each side such as manpower, financial resources, material resources, for the process towards earthquake disaster, the monitoring of outburst surroundings provides a real-time monitoring platform.

title_en: Wireless sensor network system for rescue field
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wireless sensor network system for rescue field. The wireless sensor network system comprises information gatherers, a communicator and a wireless monitoring host, wherein the information gatherers are installed in various field rescue equipment, the communicator is carried by a rescue worker, the information gatherers are connected to the communicator by wireless network, and the communicator is interconnected with the wireless monitoring host by the wireless network; and each information gatherer comprises an environment condition acquisition module, a personnel positioning module, a vital signs information acquisition module and an equipment condition acquisition module. The wireless sensor network system is adapted to a complex rescue environment, acquired field environment information, equipment condition information, rescue worker positional information and vital signs information are transmitted to the wireless monitoring host by the information gatherers through the communicator, more field information is supplied for scientific decision and command of emergency field managers, and therefore rescue efficiency is improved, life and property losses are minimized, and safety guarantee level for field emergency rescue workers is raised.

title_en: Life surviving device
abstract_en: The invention provides a life surviving device which belongs to rescuing equipment for assisting life detection and indicating the position of a trapped person. The life-surviving device comprises a pot body and air inflation bags arranged on the two sides of the pot body, wherein the pot body is provided with a valve which is used for blocking inflation openings of the air inflation bags; the valve is provided with a pulse sensor and a wireless transmitter; the pulse sensor is connected with a data input end of a first processor; the wireless transmitter is connected with a data output end of the first processor; each air inflation bag is provided with a wireless receiver and an LED (Light Emitting Diode) indication lamp; each wireless receiver is connected with a data input end of a second processor; each LED indication lamp is connected to a data output end of the second processor. According to the life surviving device, the positions of the trapped people can be indicated and vital signs of the trapped people can be monitored so that rescuing personnel not only can find the trapped people rapidly, but also can judge rescuing priorities according to the vital signs of the trapped people.
assignees: WUXI XRES PRODUCT DES & RES CO

title_en: Apparatus for detect to vital signal from chair
title_ko: 의자를 이용한 생체정보 획득장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for acquiring bio information by using a chair. The purpose of the present invention is to acquire continuously the bio information by installing bio signal sensor at an armrest, a back and a seat of the chair mainly used in daily life or an office for acquiring the bio information and making compensations possible in spite of an error such as a contact degradation at a place, to calculate parameters for determining a health state, a stress state or an emotion state of a user, and to analyze a sitting posture state by distributing a plurality of pressure sensors to the back and the seat of the chair and acquiring data measured via each of the pressure sensors. The present invention comprises: an armrest bio signal measurement part for measuring the electrocardiogram (ECG), the GSR and the PPG from the arm or the palm of the user in contact with the armrest; a back ECG sensor installed on the back of the chair for measuring the ECG signal from the back of the user in contact with the back of the chair; a seat ECG sensor installed on the seat of the chair for measuring the ECG signal from the hips of the user in contact with the seat of the chair; and a bio information processor for receiving the bio signal measured from the armrest bio signal measurement part, the back ECG sensor and the seat ECG sensor and transmitting processed bio information or raw bio signal data to a personal computer or a smartphone. [Reference numerals] (110) Armrest bio signal measurement part;(111) Left and right ECG sensors;(112) GSR sensor;(113) PPG sensor;(114) Left and right CDS sensors;(121) Back ECG sensor;(122) Back pressure sensor;(131) Seat ECG sensor;(132) Sear pressure sensor;(210) Posture data calculator;(220) Micro controller
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 목적은 의자를 이용한 생체정보 획득장치에 관한 것으로, 사용자가 일상생활 또는 업무 중 주로 사용하는 의자에서 생체정보획득을 위해 팔걸이, 등판, 좌판에 생체신호센서를 설치하고, 어느 한 곳에서도 접촉불량 등의 오류가 발생할 지라도 보상이 가능하여 지속적인 생체정보 획득하고, 사용자의 건강상태, 스트레스상태 또는 감정상태를 판단할 수 있는 파라미터를 산출하고, 의자의 등판, 좌판에 다수의 압력센서를 분포시켜, 각 압력센서를 통해 측정된 데이터획득하므로, 사용자의 앉아있는 자세상태를 분석하도록 하는데 있다. 
본 발명의 목적은 의자의 팔걸이에 접촉된 사용자의 팔 또는 손바닥으로부터 ECG, GSR, PPG를 측정하는 팔걸이 생체신호측정부; 의자의 등판에 설치되어 접촉된 사용자의 등부위로부터 심전도신호를 측정하는 등판 심전도센서부; 의자의 좌판에 설치되어 접촉된 사용자의 엉덩이부위로부터 심전도신호를 측정하는 좌판 심전도센서부; 팔걸이 생체신호측정부 및 등판,좌판 심전도센서부로부터 측정된 생체신호를 입력받아 산출한 생체정보 또는 생체신호 원(raw)데이터를 개인용컴퓨터 또는 스마트폰으로 전송하는 생체정보처리부;를 포함하여 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Connecting structure of smart garment for measuring biological signal
title_ko: 생체신호 측정용 스마트 의복의 접속구조
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a connecting structure of a smart garment for measuring biosignals and, more specifically, to a connecting structure of a smart garment for measuring biosignals, the connecting structure comprising: at least one connecting unit which a sensor for sensing biosignals is detachably mounted to; an output unit which outputs, to a biosignal processor, biosignals detected by the sensor attached to the connecting unit; and electrically conductive nanofibers which have one end and the other end connected to the connecting unit and the output unit, respectively and send, to the output unit, the biosignals detected by the sensor, wherein the connecting unit and output unit of the smart garment for measuring biosignals have first magnetic bodies, respectively, of which the surface is coated with a conductive layer, both ends of the nanofibers are connected to the first magnetic bodies, the sensor and the biosignal processor have a polarity opposite to that of the first magnetic bodies respectively provided on the connecting unit and the output unit and have second magnetic bodies, respectively, of which the surface is coated with a conductive layer, and the biosignals are sent by contact between the first and second magnetic bodies. According to the present invention, the sensor for sensing biosignals and the biosignal processor for processing the biosignals are easily attached to or detached from a flexible garment, having magnetism-based electrical conductivity and comprising nanofibers, with less power by using magnetic forces, thereby preventing loss of signal due to the short circuit of the nanofibers provided on the garment.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 생체신호 측정용 스마트 의복의 접속구조에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 생체신호를 감지하는 센서가 탈부착 되는 적어도 하나 이상의 접속부와, 접속부에 부착된 센서에 의해 감지되는 생체신호가 생체신호처리장치로 출력되는 것을 가능하게 하는 출력부 및 접속부와 출력부에 일단과 타단이 각각 연결되며, 센서에 의해 감지되는 생체신호를 출력부로 전달하는 전기 전도성 나노섬유를 구비하는 생체신호 측정용 스마트 의복의 접속부와 출력부는 표면에 전도층이 코팅된 제1 자성체를 각각 구비하며, 제1 자성체에 나노섬유의 양단이 연결되고, 센서와 생체신호처리장치는 접속부와 출력부에 각각 구비된 제1 자성체에 반대되는 극성이며 표면에 전도층이 코팅된 제2 자성체를 각각 구비하며, 제1 자성체와 제2 자성체 간의 접촉을 통해 생체신호가 전달되는 것을 특징으로 하는 생체신호 측정용 스마트 의복의 접속구조에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 자성 기반의 전기 전도성을 지닌 나노섬유를 구비한 신축성 있는 의복에 생체신호를 감지하는 센서와 이를 처리하는 생체신호처리장치를 자력을 이용해 적은 힘으로 용이하게 탈부착할 수 있어 의복에 구비된 나노섬유의 단락으로 인한 신호손실을 방지하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Flight life detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a flight life detector. The flight life detector comprises a quadcopter, a core circuit board and a sensor device. The core circuit board is arranged on the lower side of the quadcopter. The sensor device is arranged on the lower side of the core circuit board. The sensor device is a human body infrared thermal sensor. The sensor device can also be an optical life detector or an acoustic wave life detector. The quadcopter is controlled through a control handheld terminal. The control handheld terminal comprises a flight control handle and a color screen. According to the utility model, by installing the sensor device and the core circuit board on the lower side of the quadcopter, signs of life are detected through the flight of the quadcopter in the air, so the disaster relief work is more safe, convenient and fast, and the purpose of long-distance life detection can be realized.

title_en: Ultra-wide band through-wall radar hidden moving object detecting and imaging method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wide band through-wall radar hidden moving object detecting and imaging method. The ultra-wide band through-wall radar hidden moving object detecting and imaging can be achieved through an oval envelope line moving object boundary imaging algorithm, and an oval envelope line cluster tangent with the target boundary is constructed through the oval envelope line moving object boundary imaging algorithm according to the geometrical relationships between one transmitting antenna and multiple receiving antennas and a target at each moment. An actual equivalent circle of the target boundary at the moment is constructed by selecting three points of the oval envelope line cluster, and actual equivalent circles at adjacent moments are averaged to obtain an average equivalent circle. The same processing is carried out at all moment, the track of the centers of the obtained average equivalent circles can be regarded as the moving track of the target boundary, the imaging point numbers at all moments are integrated and unified through the locus function, the information of the shape of the target boundary can be obtained, and the imaging process can be finished. The ultra-wide band through-wall radar hidden moving object detecting and imaging method has the advantages of being high in imaging precision and noise immunity and low in complexity.

title_en: After-calamity detecting rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an after-calamity detecting rescue robot, which is formed by a robot body, a remote control terminal and a signal transmission module, wherein the robot body comprises more than two reflection photoelectric switches, a temperature sensor, a life signal detector, a humidity sensor and a front-positioned CCD (charge-coupled device) camera, a wireless module and a voice module, which are connected with a control circuit and are respectively fixed on a vehicle body; the robot body also comprises wheels driven by a driving circuit and speed reducing motors; the reflection photoelectric switches, the temperature sensor, the life signal detector and the humidity sensor are mounted at the front end of the robot body; the front-positioned CCD camera is mounted above the front end of the robot. The after-calamity detecting rescue robot overcomes the after-calamity severe rescue environment and avoids the potential dangers of a dangerous area to the rescue staff, so the rescue and survival probability of trapped people in the disaster area is improved, functions such as finding and detecting lives, position determining and performing multiple rescue are achieved, the stability is good, the operation is simple and the after-calamity detecting rescue robot has a well application prospect.

title_en: Method for user interface of based on vital signal
title_ko: 의자에서 획득한 생체정보를 기반으로 한 사용자 인터페이스방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for user interface based on biometric information obtained through a chair. The purpose of the present invention is to output a music or voice as a response, set according to a user's health condition, stress level or emotional state, or to output audio guidance, to lead the user to exercise or breathe, through a personal computer or a smartphone which receives biometric information from bio-signals acquired by bio-signal sensors installed in the armrests, the backrest, and the seat of a chair. The method of the present invention comprises the steps of: determining the health condition, stress level, and emotional state of a user, based on bio-signals acquired by bio-signal sensors installed in a chair; determining the sitting posture of the user based on pressure signals acquired by each pressure sensor; displaying the health condition, stress level, emotional state, and the sitting posture of the user in the screen of a user terminal; displaying changes in the health condition, stress level, emotional state, and the sitting posture, classified according to time, date, week, or month; providing videos or voices as feedback information classified according to the stress level and emotional state; and providing image and voice information to enable the user to correct his/her sitting posture. [Reference numerals] (AA) User information; (BB) Name, age, gender, height, weight, etc.; (CC) Musical breathing; (DD) Meditation; (EE) Exercise (Eyes, Color, Chair movement); (FF) mm/dd/yyyy, hh: Run musical breathing (Automatic); (GG) mm/dd/yyyy, hh: Run meditation (Manual)
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 의자에서 획득한 생체정보를 기반으로 한 사용자 인터페이스방법에 관한 것으로, 의자에서 생체정보획득을 위해 팔걸이, 등판, 좌판에 생체신호센서를 통해 획득된 생체정보를 수신한 개인용컴퓨터 또는 스마트폰 등의 사용자 단말기를 통해 사용자의 건강상태, 스트레스 또는 감정상태에 따라 설정된 반응으로 음악 또는 음성을 출력하거나, 안내음성을 출력하여 운동 또는 호흡을 유도하도록 하는 을 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
본 발명의 목적은 사용자단말기에 의해 의자에 구비된 생체신호 획득센서로부터 획득된 생체신호에서 사용자의 건강상태, 스트레스상태 및 감정상태를 판단하는 과정; 압력센서로부터 획득된 각 센서의 압력신호로부터 사용자의 자세상태를 판단하는 과정; 제1, 제2과정으로부터 획득된 사용자의 건강상태, 스트레스상태 및 감정상태와 사용자의 앉은 자세상태를 상기 사용자단말기의 화면에 표시하는 과정; 사용자의 건강상태, 스트레스상태, 감정상태 및 앉은 자세상태를 시간별, 날짜별, 주간별 또는 월간별로 변화상태를 표시하는 과정; 스트레스상태 및 감정상태에 따라 영상 또는 음성으로 분류된 피드백 정보를 제공하는 과정; 사용자의 자세상태를 바로 잡을 수 있도록 화면 및 음성 정보를 제공하는 과정;을 포함하여 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다.
