title_en: UWB bio-radar-based multiple-human body object estimation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a UWB bio-radar-based multiple-human body object estimation method and a UWB Bio-radar-based multiple-human body object estimation system, and belongs to the technical field of bio-radar biological life detection. According to the UWB bio-radar-based multiple-human body object estimation method of the invention, echo data obtained through collection are processed through the following manners that: a breath detection algorithm, an adaptive cancellation method and a target recognition algorithm are adopted to process the echo data in each channel; correlation processing is performed among each channel according to processing results; and finally, threshold values are set such that clutter left in the channels after processing can be removed, and at the same time, target classification and number estimation are realized. With the UWB bio-radar-based multiple-human body object estimation of the invention adopted, a technological base can be provided for further implementation of bio-radar detection and positioning of multiple human body objects, and the improvement of the level and ability of bio-radar technique to obtain information of human bodies can be facilitated.

title_en: Multi-stage detection of buried IEDs
abstract_en: A surveillance system includes a multi-propeller aircraft having a main propeller and a plurality of wing unit propellers; a housing that houses the main propeller and the wing unit propellers; an optical video camera; an ultra-wideband (UWB) radar imaging system; a control system for controlling flight of the multi-propeller aircraft from a remote location; and a telemetry system for providing information from the optical camera and the ultra-wideband (UWB) radar imaging system to a remote location.

title_en: The collection of disaster field information intelligent is equipped
abstract_en: The invention discloses disaster field information intelligent collection equipment, communication module, temperature and pressure transmitter, jogging sensor, RFID reading apparatus, gyroscope, vital signs detecting device etc. are installed additional by design, it is made also to have individual soldier location, radio communication, motion state detection, air respiratorresuscitator pressure monitoring in building, several large innovative functions such as external environment (temperature, pressure) detection, vital sign monitoring, every detected parameters energy real-time Transmission is to floor manager Succor plain stage.The present invention is rational in infrastructure, improves fire-fighting, rescue efficiency, drops to minimum, sublimation of life security assurance level by life, property loss.

title_en: Fireman vital sign monitoring and coordinated rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fireman vital sign monitoring and coordinated rescue system, and belongs to the field of fireman individual equipment. The fireman vital sign monitoring and coordinated rescue system comprises vital sign information collection terminals and a monitoring command center, wherein each vital sign information collection terminal comprises a vital sign sensor, an information collection and transmission device and a helmet display device, data transmission is carried out between each information collection and transmission device and the corresponding vital sign sensor and between each information collection and transmission device and the monitoring command center in a wireless communication mode, an Android operating system is installed in each information collection and transmission device, a graphic display data interface is formed in each information collection and transmission device, and each helmet display device comprises a helmet, a rotatable connecting part, a metal hose and a small-sized display screen. The fireman vital sign monitoring and coordinated rescue system has the advantages that each integrated vital sign sensor is comfortable in wear and convenient to wear, and the normal rescue combat cannot be influenced; firemen can check information more conveniently and more rapidly through the helmet display devices; the monitoring command center can monitor the state of a plurality of firemen at the same time and learn about the vital sign state of the firemen and information of harmful gas in a fire scene in real time.
assignees: SHENYANG FIRE RES INST OF MINISTRY PUBLIC SECURITY

title_en: Low-cost electromagnetic wave life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a low-cost electromagnetic wave life detection instrument which comprises a front-end radar system part and a back-end signal processor part. The front end radar system part is a small-sized handheld radar device. A transceiver module is arranged in the radar device and is provided with an emission antenna and two receiving antennas. The back-end signal processor part comprises a single chip microcomputer, a power circuit, a clock circuit, a reset circuit, a keyboard circuit and a display circuit. According to a signal processor of the electromagnetic wave life detection instrument, the single chip microcomputer is adopted to replace a DSP and an FPGA chip and is used as a main processing module, so that the production cost of the electromagnetic wave life detection instrument is greatly reduced. The signal processor of the electromagnetic wave life detection instrument is simple, feasible, low in cost, easy to popularize, capable of meeting common life rescue requirements. The electromagnetic wave life detection instrument can be popularized and utilized in the whole society through reduction of the production cost, so that Chinese disaster relief capacity can be improved.

title_en: Method and device for determining a kind of land mind based on various characteristics
title_ko: 다특성 기반의 지뢰 분류 결정 방법 및 이를 적용한 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mine classification apparatus capable of accurately classifying mines regardless of mine type and condition of soil in which mines are buried. Provided is a mine classification method based on multi-characteristic including: a buried mine recognition step (S21) for receiving a mine refection signal from at least one buried mine buried under the ground through ground penetrating radar; a buried mine analysis step (S22) for analyzing the mine reflection signal by a main component analysis method and discrete frequency conversion and obtaining eigenvalue for each buried mine and mine characteristic data with frequency coefficient; and a buried mine detection step (S23) for presenting the eigenvalue and the frequency coefficient on a graph with respect to each X-axis and Y-axis on a basis of the mine characteristic data and obtaining mine classification data recognizing the buried mine by applying a likelihood ratio test method. [Reference numerals] (AA) Start; (BB) End; (S31) Input data detected by a ground penetrating radar; (S32) Equalization for removing effect of ground; (S33) Extracting feature through a main component analysis method; (S34) Extracting feature through a discrete frequency transformation method; (S35) Recognization and classification through likelihood ratio testing method; (S36) Determining type of inputted mine
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지뢰의 종류와, 지뢰가 매설된 토양의 상태에 관계없이 정확하게 지뢰의 분류를 결정해 낼 수 있도록 하는 지뢰의 분류 결정 장치가 구현되고, 
이를 위해 본 발명은 지표 투과 레이더를 통해 지표면 아래에 매설된 적어도 1개 이상의 매몰지뢰로부터 지뢰 반사신호가 수집되는 매몰지뢰인식단계(S21)와, 상기 지뢰 반사신호가 주성분 분석법과, 이산 주파수 변환을 통해 분석되고, 상기 매몰지뢰 별로 각각 고유치와, 주파수 계수를 갖는 지뢰특성데이터가 획득되는 매몰지뢰분석단계(S22) 및 상기 지뢰특성데이터로부터 상기 고유치 및 상기 주파수 계수를 각각 X축과 Y축에 대한 그래프로 표현하고, 우도 비율 검정법이 적용되어 상기 매몰지뢰가 인식될 수 있는 지뢰분류데이터가 획득되는 매몰지뢰검출단계(S23)를 포함하는 다특성 기반의 지뢰 분류 결정 방법이 제공된다.

title_en: The method of through-wall radar imaging
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of method of through-wall radar imaging.The method is in Radar Imaging Processing process, be multiplied by body of wall compensating factor to frequency spectrum data, compensating factor employs accurate physical model, considers the interaction between electromagnetic wave and body of wall, thus eliminate the impact of body of wall on image space, ensure that imaging accuracy.In addition, because the elimination of wall influence is carried out at frequency domain, only relate to multiplying, and compensating factor calculates without the need to solving nonlinear equation, therefore calculated amount is less.

title_en: Based on the expansion moving-target through-wall imaging method of array radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of expansion moving-target through-wall imaging method based on array radar.Technical scheme comprises the steps: the first step: adopt change detecting method to differ from process to eliminate clutter impact to adjacent two frames of echo data; Second step: successively imaging is carried out to each frame echo data; 3rd step: adopt the CFAR detecting device of Gaussian distribution to complete the detection of target; 4th step: the locus coordinate extracting target in image; 5th step: false target judge with eliminate, obtain each frame echo data eliminate false target after expansion pre-filter method result.The present invention can solve the suppression problem of false target in extension movement target imaging, and the present invention is simultaneously easy to realize, and can be used for actual engineering design and signal transacting.

title_en: System and method for sensing high-resolution distance, and application thereof
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To conduct a non-contact and non-invasive type sending of a vital sign or other health signal using radar or other high-resolution distance sensing.SOLUTION: A sensing system 11 includes a first radar sensing assembly and an analysis system 18. The first radar sensing assembly uses a radar to measure a plurality of distances to a first target position 16 at different times. The analysis system 18 receives the plurality of distances from the first radar sensing assembly and calculates a difference of the plurality of distances measured by the first radar sensing assembly, thereby quantifying a movement of a target 14 at the first target position 16 at different times. The sensing system 11 uses the calculated difference of the plurality of distances to generate one or more first quantitative action level value that represents the movement of the target 14 at the first target position 16.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Survival device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a survival device, and belongs to auxiliary life detection and trapped person position indication equipment. The survival device comprises a tank and inflatable bags arranged on the two sides of the tank, wherein a valve is arranged on the tank, and is used for blocking inflation inlets of the inflatable bags; a pulse sensor and a wireless transmitter are arranged on the valve; the pulse sensor is connected to the data input end of a first processor; the wireless transmitter is connected to the data output end of the first processor; wireless receivers and LED (light-emitting diode) indicator lamps are arranged on the inflatable bags; the wireless receivers are connected to the data input end of a second processor; the LED indicator lamps are connected to the data output end of the second processor. According to the survival device, not only can be the position of a trapped person indicated, but also vital signs of the trapped person can be monitored, so that a rescuer can rapidly find the trapped person, and can also determine rescue priority according to the vital signs of the trapped person.
assignees: WUXI XRES PRODUCT DES & RES CO

title_en: An earthquake rescue positioning watch
abstract_en: Provided is an earthquake rescue positioning watch which comprises a watchband, a watchcase, and a watch surface which are connected successively. A time display and a liquid crystal screen are disposed on the watch surface. A cell and an integrated circuit board are installed inside the watch surface. A GPS positioner is installed on the top of the watchcase. A loudspeaker and a switch are installed on the bottom of the watchcase. A remote control receiving switch and a time adjusting button are installed on the right side of the watchcase. A microphone is installed on the upper right side of the watchcase. An LED calling glittering lamp is installed on the upper left side of the watchcase. An infrared probe is installed on the left side of the watchcase. A microwave emitter is installed on the lower left side of the watchcase. An LED floodlight and a light switch are installed on the lower right side of the watchcase. Usually, the earthquake rescue positioning watch is worn on a hand and does not leave a body. After an earthquake, if a user is  buried or forgets to turn on the switch while being sacred, a rescuer may use a unified specially-produced remote controller to remotely switch on the remote control receiving switch of the earthquake rescue positioning watch. At this time, the GPS positioner, the microwave emitter, the LED calling glittering lamp, and the loudspeaker give a distress signal such that the rescuer is easy to find out the user needing for help in order to perform rescue in time.
assignees: KUNSHAN YUSHAN TOWN SHILONG DESIGN WORK STUDIO

title_en: Infrared life detection robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a robot which detects life based on infrared temperature induction. The robot is capable of performing infrared life detection in a severe environment and alarming through radio waves. At the same time, the robot has a motion function of robots and is capable of carrying out search and rescue work for wounded people efficiently under a condition that personnel use is reduced and reducing personnel casualty in a highly risky environment at the same time.

title_en: Low power device for monitoring a vital sign
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for monitoring a vital sign of a subject (14) when attached to the subject's body. The device (12, 12', 12", 12" ') comprises an optical sensor arrangement (18) including a light source (20) for emitting light into tissue of the subject, a light sensor (22) for receiving at least part of the emitted light after an interaction of the emitted light with the tissue and an evaluation unit (24) for deriving an optical monitoring signal from the received light being indicative of the vital sign of the subject (14). The device (12, 12', 12", 12' ") further comprises an auxiliary sensor arrangement (26) different from the optical sensor arrangement (18) for obtaining an auxiliary monitoring signal being indicative of the vital sign of the subject (14). Still further, the device (12, 12', 12", 12" ') comprises a fusion unit (28) for determining an output signal based on the optical monitoring signal and the auxiliary monitoring signal, said output signal being representative of the vital sign of the subject (14); and a control unit (30) for controlling the optical sensor arrangement (18), the auxiliary sensor arrangement (26) and the fusion unit (28). The optical monitoring signal and the auxiliary monitoring signal are indicative of the same vital sign of the subject. The present invention further relates to a corresponding method as well as to a monitoring apparatus (10) including a device as described above.

title_en: Microseismic-monitoring-sensor arrangement method for stratified excavation of deeply-buried hard-rock tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microseismic-monitoring-sensor arrangement method for stratified excavation of a deeply-buried hard-rock tunnel. When a second layer to the last layer of the tunnel are excavated, a first group/second group of microseismic sensors are installed in rock mass of a tunnel inner wall at the front/back of a tunnel face; a line obtained through downward movement of a center line of a currently-excavated-layer bottom plate for 1 meter is used as a rotating center line and the first group of microseismics sensors and the second group of microseismic sensors are distributed in the rock mass of the tunnel inner wall, the rotating center line being a central axis; and with the advancement of the tunnel face, the first group of microseismic sensors and the second groups of microseismic sensors are redistributed until tunnel excavation is completed. In the method, through use of space supplied by excavated layers of a tunnel, microseismic sensors are arranged at the front and back of excavated tunnel faces and a tunnel face of higher risks and adjacent areas of the tunnel face are included in the two groups of microseismic sensor arrayed at the front and back of the tunnel face all the time so that acquisition of micro-fracture signals is facilitated, microseism positioning precision is ensured and a basis is laid for accurate prediction and forecast of a disaster.
assignees: INST OF ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS

title_en: System and device based on dynamic gradient clustering and inter-cluster frequency division routing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of sensors, and relates to a sensor network system of a motion node based on dynamic gradient clustering and inter-cluster frequency division routing. The system comprises a convergence node (1) and a sensor node (2). A device comprises a sensor node hardware based on a radio frequency baseband, a PA, an LNA, a radio frequency switch and a matching circuit of the aforementioned elements. A method comprises a motion node self-networking method based on the dynamic gradient clustering and inter-cluster frequency division. The system can be applied to a dynamic sensor network with nodes are moving, a sensor network with the nodes are static and occasions of vital signal detection of firefighters in a scene of fire.
assignees: BEIJING YILIN ZHIXIN TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting emergency system capable of life detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting emergency system capable of life detection. The system comprises a main controller. The main controller is connected with at least one sub-controller in communication. The sub-controller is electrically connected with a fire-fighting emergency lamp; and the fire-fighting emergency lamp is internally provided with a life detection sensor. The invention provides the fire-fighting emergency system capable of the life detection. The fire-fighting emergency system can perform concentration management, reduces maintenance difficulty, can be normally used in case of an emergency, can carry out life sign detection, facilitates the operation of rescue work, shortens life rescuing time, increases life rescuing probability, enhances disaster rescue efficiency, and besides, can also effectively reduce loss and casualties.

title_en: Fire site handling support system and fire site handling support method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a fire site handling support system and a fire site handling support method capable of effective supporting fire fighting, prevention of fire spread, and evacuation guidance of survivors.SOLUTION: A fire site handling support system comprises: a fire situation determination device which detects whether a fire has occurred from sensing information of fire detection sensors; a fire prevention zone creation state determination device which determines an opened/closed state of fire doors from sensing information of the fire door sensors located near the fire doors; a remaining survivor state detection device which determines whether there is any remaining survivor from sensing information of remaining survivor detection sensors; a determination processing device which generates disaster activity information on which disaster prevention staff acts from a combination of the fire situation determined by the fire situation determination device, the opened/closed state of the fire doors determined by the fire prevention zone creation state determination device, the remaining survivor information determined by the remaining survivor state detection device and each installation location of the fire detection sensors, the fire door sensors, the remaining survivor detection sensors; an information transmission device which transmits the disaster activity information from the determination processing device.

title_en: Biosignal interface device and method of operation of biosignal interface device
title_ko: 생체신호 인터페이스 장치 및 생체신호 인터페이스 장치의 동작 방법
abstract_en: Provided are a bio-signal interface device and a method for operating the bio-signal interface device. The bio-signal interface device according to an embodiment is provided to generally use the thickness of a forearm and an elbow and approximately predict the position of a sensor unit, thereby changing a mode such as the number of recognized gestures or the like. The bio-signal interface device comprises a sensor unit which is touched to a measured object and senses the measured object; a position identifying unit which identifies the position of the sensor unit in the measured object; and an adjusting unit which adjusts the mode of the sensor unit according to the identified position.
abstract_ko: 생체신호 인터페이스 장치 및 생체신호 인터페이스 장치의 동작 방법을 제공한다.  일실시예에 따른 생체신호 인터페이스 장치는, 일반적으로 손목보다 팔뚝/팔꿈치쪽으로, 아래팔의 두께가 두꺼워지는 것을 이용하여, 센서부가 아래팔의 어떤 부위에 위치해 있는지 대략적으로 예측 함으로써, 인식할 수 있는 제스처의 개수 등의 모드를 변환하고 있다.

title_en: Landslide deep position displacement monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide deep position displacement monitoring system which comprises a pull wire, a displacement measurement device arranged on the ground and a measurement pipe arranged underground. One end of the pull wire is connected with the displacement measurement device, the other end of the pull wire is fixedly arranged in the measurement pipe, the measurement pipe is arranged to be inclined to a horizontal plane and penetrates through a sliding face of a landslide to enable the bottom of the measurement pipe to be fixed to a sliding bed, and the measurement pipe is a flexible pipe capable of being deformed along with the sliding of a sliding body. The measurement pipe is the flexible pipe inclined to the horizontal plane, the bottom of the measurement pipe stretches into the sliding bed, the pull wire in the measurement pipe can respond to displacement changes under the condition of small sliding displacement, displacement enough for detection is generated, and displacement monitoring accuracy is guaranteed. The landslide deep position displacement monitoring system is simple in structure and convenient to use, a drilling dip angle sensor and other micro-displacement measurement devices do not need to be buried, the micro displacement of the landslide can be monitored by only mounting the displacement measurement device on the ground surface, the instrument environment is good, damage is not prone to happening, maintenance is facilitated, operation cost is greatly lowered, and high popularization and application value is achieved.
assignees: CHONGQING GAOXIN ENGINEERING SURVEY AND DESIGN INST CO LTD;WANG SEN

title_en: Telemetry apparatus, system, and method for animal experiment
title_ko: 실험용 동물의 생체 신호 획득 장치, 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: In the present invention, wireless power is delivered using an electromagnetic field to operate a sensor mounted on a laboratory animal, and a signal detected by the sensor is delivered to a data analysis system through electromagnetic field communication. According to the present invention, an apparatus to obtain biosignals from a laboratory animal comprises: a transceiving antenna; a power control unit to convert power delivered from an external wireless power transmission device through the transceiving antenna; a sensor operated using power supplied from the power control unit to detect biosignals of the laboratory animal; a signal processing unit connected to the sensor to process the biosignals detected by the sensor; and a wireless communication unit to communicate with an external device using the transceiving antenna.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에서는 자기장을 이용하여 무선 전력을 전달하여 실험용 동물에 장착된 센서를 동작시키고, 센서에 의해 검출된 신호를 자기장 통신을 통해 데이터 분석 시스템으로 전달한다. 본 발명에 따른 실험용 동물로부터 생체 신호를 획득하는 장치는, 송수신 안테나; 외부의 무선 전력전송 장치로부터 상기 송수신 안테나를 통해 전달되는 전력을 변환하는 전력 제어부; 상기 전력 제어부로부터 공급되는 전력을 이용하여 동작하며 실험용 동물의 생체 신호를 감지하는 센서; 상기 센서와 연결되어 있으며, 상기 센서에 의해 감지된 상기 생체 신호를 처리하는 신호 처리부; 및 상기 송수신 안테나를 이용하여 외부 장치와 통신을 수행하는 무선 통신부를 포함한다.

title_en: Near field subwavelength focusing synthetic aperture radar with chemical detection mode
abstract_en: Detection of objects such as a buried explosive device while operating from a moving platform using a radio frequency emission system having two modes. An electromagnetic wave emission and detection system operates in a first mode to locate objects of interest and in a second mode to determine if an object contains explosive materials. In the first mode, the emission and detection system preferably operates as a subwavelength focusing, wideband, superlens using a near field super gain synthetic aperture continuous wave (CW) swept radar. In the second mode the system preferably enabled after detection of an object in the first mode, uses chemical detection methods such as Nuclear Quadrupole Resonance (NQR).

title_en: Plant frost-proof system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a plant frost-proof system, and belongs to the field of agro-meteorological disaster regulation and control. According to an existing frost-proof technique, a lot of resources are consumed, and environment is severely polluted in certain frost-proof methods. Heat in soil is absorbed through a parallel-connection soil heat exchanger with vertical buried pipes, arrives at a heat pump unit through a circulating medium and then is transmitted to a ground heat exchanger on the ground; eventually, heat transferring is carried out between the ground heat exchanger and air, heat is transmitted to the air, and accordingly the temperature of small climate of a plant growth area is increased, and the frost-proof effect is achieved during last frost of the early spring. Meanwhile, the frost-proof effect of a soil source geo-thermal heat pump system is further improved through solar heating.

title_en: Service robot with visual system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a service robot with a visual system. The service robot comprises a robot vehicle body and a mechanical hand mounted above the robot vehicle body, wherein the robot vehicle body is internally provided with a control system for controlling the robot control vehicle body to move and controlling the mechanical hand to move; the robot control vehicle body is internally provided with an embedded type visual tracking system and a WIFI (Wireless Fidelity) communication module; a camera of the visual tracking system is mounted on the mechanical hand by a cloud deck; the WIFI communication module realizes wireless transmission of data and instructions of the control system, the visual tracking system and an upper computer. According to the service robot with the visual system, the service robot adopts the embedded type visual tracking system; the camera is used for carrying out visual tracking and the WIFI communication module and the upper computer are used for realizing visual transmission; a WIFI wireless network is used as a data transmission carrier to realize an intelligent system with the functions of real-time control, audio/video transmission, image acquisition and the like. The service robot disclosed by the invention can be used for civil and military fields including anti-terrorist investigation, battlefield C4ISR systems, fire protection and disaster relief, life detection and the like.

title_en: Antenna system for ultra-wideband radar applications
abstract_en: Antenna systems suitable for ultra-wideband radar applications, e.g. ground penetrating radar, through-wall radar systems, are disclosed in which backward electromagnetic radiation leakage, which is detrimental to antenna performance, is eliminated, and thereby enhancing the forward radiation performance of the antenna system. This necessarily results in insignificant electromagnetic interference to proximate antenna systems. Accordingly, an antenna array may be provided in which multiple antenna systems may be juxtaposed to one another even without a gap between adjacent antenna systems.

title_en: Strain resistor based bridge type debris flow pore water pressure sensor and early warning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a strain resistor based bridge type debris flow pore water pressure sensor and an early warning system. The strain resistor based bridge type debris flow pore water pressure sensor is characterized by comprising a soil pore water pressure sensor full-bridge circuit and an amplifying circuit. According to the utility model, a method of monitoring the pore water pressure through the sensor adopting bridge type resistance principles is adopted, thereby enabling the size of the sensor to be small, being high in interference resisting capacity and suitable for being buried under a starting condition that the debris flow is monitored. The strain resistor based bridge type debris flow pore water pressure sensor can realize early warning for a debris flow disaster through monitoring variations in water content in shallow soil layer and predicates and gives out early warning on occurrence of the debris flow disaster through analyzing water content data when rains.
assignees: INST MOUNTAIN HAZARDS & ENVIRONMENT IMHE CAS CHENGDU

title_en: Fire emergency system capable of achieving life detection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire emergency system capable of achieving life detection. The fire emergency system comprises a master controller, the master controller is in communication connection with at least one sub-controller, the sub-controllers are electrically connected with a fire emergency lamp, and the fire emergency lamp is provided with a life detection sensor. The fire emergency system capable of achieving life detection can be managed in a centralized manner, the maintenance difficulty is small, the fire emergency system can be used normally in case of emergency, and can carry out life sign detection, the fire emergency system is beneficial to rescue operation, lives can be rescued quickly, the life saving probability can be increased, and the disaster relief efficiency can be improved, in addition, loss, injuries and deaths can be effectively reduced.

title_en: Systems and methods for non-contact multiparameter vital signs monitoring, apnea therapy, apnea diagnosis, and snore therapy
abstract_en: Aspects of the of the disclosure relate to a non-contact physiological motion sensor and a monitor device that can incorporate use of the Doppler effect. A continuous wave of electromagnetic radiation can be transmitted toward one or more subjects and the Doppler-shifted received signals can be digitized and/or processed subsequently to extract information related to the cardiopulmonary motion in the one or more subjects. The extracted information can be used, for example, to determine apneic events and/or snoring events and/or to provide apnea or snoring therapy to subjects when used in conjunction with an apnea or snoring therapy device. In addition, methods of use are disclosed for sway cancellation, realization of cessation of breath, integration with multi-parameter patient monitoring systems, providing positive providing patient identification, or any combination thereof.

title_en: Remote infrared positioning instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a remote infrared positioning instrument comprising a pyroelectric infrared sensor mounted on a leg part of a monitored person, a control circuit device, a GPS system carried around by the monitored person and a control center, wherein the control circuit device is linked to the pyroelectric infrared sensor, radio signals are emitted by the control circuit device for one time when detection is performed by the pyroelectric infrared sensor for one time, the GPS system receives the radio signals emitted by the control circuit device, and bidirectional signal transmission is carried out by the control center and the GPS system. The remote infrared positioning instrument is characterized in that human body signals can be detected through use of infrared rays emitted from a human body, the human body signals can be converted into the radio signals which are then sent to the GPS system through use of a wireless emitting device, bidirectional signal transmission is carried out by the GPS system and the control center, the position and life signs of the monitored person can be tracked and positioned in a real-time manner, and therefore an aim that search and rescue work can be carried out timely when an accident occurs can be attained.

title_en: One is applicable to through-wall radar multiaspect body of wall aligning formation method
abstract_en: The invention provides one and be applicable to through-wall radar multiaspect body of wall aligning formation method, utilize the existing conversion of the Radon for detection of straight line in image to carry out body of wall position probing, penetrate compensation of delay and imaging by each face wall rear region is carried out respectively to body of wall, realized the focal imaging of each imaging region and each face wall body. Further, before splicing subimage, first subimage is carried out the contrast of body of wall and background in the linear change process enhancer of gray scale image. The present invention has corrected body of wall position effectively, has improved image quality.

title_en: Pre-buried building fire-fighting information collecting device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pre-buried building fire-fighting information collecting device which comprises a solar power supply buried in a building body and used for supplying power, fire-fighting data sensors for collecting data, a data black box for storing the data, and a photoelectric electrode plate disposed outside the building body. The photoelectric electrode plate is electrically connected with the solar power supply and charges the solar power supply. The solar power supply supplies power to the fire-fighting data sensors and the data black box. The fire-fighting sensors are connected with the data black box and store fire-fighting data in the data black box. The beneficial effects are that because the pre-buried building fire-fighting information collecting device is buried in a core position of the building when the building is being constructed, in the case of a fire disaster, performance changes of construction material during the period of the fire disaster can be completely preserved, and the collected data is valid and reliable.
assignees: SUZHOU SIDI INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Radar sensing for vehicle occupancy
abstract_en: A method for sensing occupancy states within a motor vehicle using a radar sensor system, the radar sensor system comprising: an antenna system, at least one sensor (10), and processing circuitry (18). The method comprises the following steps: at least one occupiable location within the vehicle is illuminated with a continuous wave (CW signal) using an antenna system, the CW signal being frequency modulated in time. Receiving at least one sensor signal (a) reflected as a result of the CW signal using at least one sensor (10), the at least one sensor (10) defining a plurality of reception channels (1 … i), each channel having a different frequency (f) 1 …f i ). The processing circuitry (18) is operable to: for each receive channel (1 … i), applying DC offset removal to the respective sensor signal (a) to generate a modified signal (b); and generating one or more multiplication status signals (34, 38) based on the modified signal (b), the multiplication status signals indicating an attribute related to the at least one multiplicable position. A system for implementing the method is also disclosed. These technologies provide in-vehicle occupant detection and classification (airbag suppression), occupant presence detection and occupant vital sign monitoring, and seat belt reminder functionality (SBR). The radar system may include one or two (or four) outputs (I/Q) per channel. Can be used forThe received signal is mixed down into baseband using a single channel demodulator or I/Q demodulator. Advanced signal processing including auto-calibration routines and clutter removal may be used to detect occupants and their vital signs (breathing and heartbeat) and determine their distance from the radar system.

title_en: Multi-wall-body quick compensation method suitable for through-wall radar imaging
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-wall-body quick compensation method suitable for through-wall radar imaging. Based on known or estimated wall body parameters, hidden target imaging in an antenna attaching wall and multi-parallel-wall-body building structure is considered, let us suppose that multiple wall bodies have the same relative dielectric constant and different widths, first, according to the refraction law, the multiple wall bodies are moved to the edge of a first wall body in parallel, the multiple wall bodies are combined to form an equivalent single wall body, and meanwhile the fact that imaging focusing delay is not changed is guaranteed. By the equivalent processing, the multi-refraction problem related to multi-wall-body electromagnetic propagation is converted to a traditional single wall body single-refraction problem equivalently, and problem difficulty is simplified. Then, based on a minimum-duration method, refraction point position searching on the equivalent wall body is carried out, and propagation path delay is computed. Finally, a back-projection imaging algorithm is used for obtaining a target focusing image after multi-wall-body compensating, the advantage of target position error accurate compensation is achieved, and high practicability is achieved.

title_en: Life detection apparatus based on infrared and sound wave cooperation
abstract_en: A life detection apparatus based on infrared and sound wave cooperation is disclosed and is characterized by comprising an infrared image acquisition apparatus, a sound wave signal acquisition apparatus and a signal fusion apparatus, wherein the infrared image acquisition apparatus is connected with the signal fusion apparatus, and the sound wave signal acquisition apparatus is connected with the signal fusion apparatus. According to the life detection apparatus based on infrared and sound wave cooperation, infrared image and sound wave information synchronous acquisition and processing are adopted, infrared and sound wave sensors can work in adverse environment conditions such as dark light environment, greasy dirt environment and the like; the life detection apparatus based on infrared and sound wave cooperation is advantaged by simple structure, low cost, strong adaptability, not-easy-to-damage and the like. According to the life detection apparatus based on infrared and sound wave cooperation, images of environment where living entities are positioned can be obtained through the infrared sensor, active and passive type sound wave sensors can be used for detecting weak distress signals emitted by living entities and can be used for accurately positioning the living entities, an accurate decision basis for making a rescue solution can be provided through cooperation of the two kinds of sensors, rescue time can be reduced, and calamity loss can be reduced.

title_en: Method for distinguishing position of rockburst risk on deep buried tunnel section
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for distinguishing the position of a rockburst risk on a deep buried tunnel section. The method comprises the following steps: A, performing numerical simulation analysis according to the shape of a section, engineering geology, conditions of initial ground stress and an excavation method before tunnel excavation, to be specific, a, performing indoor rock mechanics experiments and parametric inversion; b, confirming a three-dimensional initial ground stress field; c, constructing a geometrical model for three-dimensional numerical calculation according to stratigraphic distribution, geologic construction and the size of the tunnel section; d, implementing numerical calculation and analysis of a tunnel excavation process for the geometrical model; e, analyzing the distributed situation of the local energy release rate on the tunnel section; B, monitoring slight shock in a real-time mode in the tunnel excavation process, to be specific, 1, mounting a sensor at the rear part of a tunnel face; 2, collecting slight shock signals in the process of the micro fracture of rock mass to invert the occurrence position of the micro fracture of surrounding rocks; 3, analyzing the projection distribution of micro fracture events on the tunnel section; C, performing comprehensive evaluation on the distinguished occurrence positions of the rockburst risk. Through the adoption of the method, the occurrence of rockburst disasters is reduced or avoided, and the construction safety and the construction progress are ensured.
assignees: INST OF ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS

title_en: Wireless passive rfid stress sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wireless passive RFID stress sensor. On the premise of not damaging the mechanics structure of a wire rope or a steel bar, stress data inside material are obtained through force direction changing measuring. Through an RFID wireless technology, the data are transmitted out in real time, an additional power source does not need to be provided by the adoption of a passive technology, the problem that the power supply of traditional equipment is difficult is solved, and efficient deployment can be convenient to perform. The wireless passive RFID is mainly used for a railway, a highway, a bridge, a viaduct and others. The stress sensor is buried into a large concrete beam body, the load capacity of the beam body can be measured in real time, multiple strut beam bodies can form the internet of things, and the dangerous beam bodies can be predicated. When stress data of the strut beam bodies fluctuate up and down abnormally in one region, it shows that the risk of earthquake occurring possibly exists in the region. Bridge type clamps (1), the wire rope (2), a boss (3), a steel body (4), a stress piece (5), bridge type clamp screws (6), a plastic support (7), a PCB (8) and a plastic cover (9) are arranged as the drawing.

title_en: Apparatus and Method for Emotion Interaction based on Bio-Signal
title_ko: 생체 신호 기반의 감성 인터랙션 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emotion signal sensing device which includes a sensor unit which senses an environment signal and a bio-signal by the emotion change of a user, a signal processing unit which converts the sensed bio-signal and environment signal into digital signals and outputs the digital signals, and a control unit which generates emotion information by using the digital signals outputted from the signal processing unit and transmits the generated emotion information to an emotion service providing apparatus or an emotion signal sensing device of another user.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 감성 신호 감지 장치로, 사용자의 감성 변화에 의한 생체 신호와 환경 신호를 감지하는 센서부와, 상기 감지한 생체 신호와 환경 신호를 디지털 신호로 변환하여 출력하는 신호 처리부와, 상기 신호 처리부로부터 출력되는 디지털 신호를 이용하여 감성 정보를 생성하고, 생성된 감성 정보를 다른 사용자의 감성 신호 감지 장치 또는 감성 서비스 제공 장치에 전달하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Firefighter vital sign monitoring device based on Bluetooth technology
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a firefighter vital sign monitoring device based on the Bluetooth technology. The firefighter vital sign monitoring device based on the Bluetooth technology is composed of an acquisition module, a processing module, a Bluetooth forwarding module and a monitoring end. The acquisition module is connected with the processing module. The Bluetooth forwarding module comprises a Bluetooth transceiver chip and a wireless module, and the wireless module is a WIFI module and/or a mobile communication module. The monitoring end is a device supporting Bluetooth and WIFI. Firefighter vital sign data are acquired and transmitted to the processing module by the acquisition module, the data are packaged and then transmitted to the Bluetooth forwarding module through Bluetooth signals by the processing module, and the firefighter vital sign data are transmitted to the monitoring end by the Bluetooth forwarding module through the WIFI or a communication network. The firefighter vital sign monitoring device based on the Bluetooth technology can be separated from a PC, is high in portability and can expand the range of motion of a monitored firefighter. Through the firefighter vital sign monitoring device based on the Bluetooth technology, the vital sign conditions of firefighters in firefighting rescue and service training can be monitored in real time, and vital sign abnormality warning signs can be given out in time.

title_en: Underground radar system achieving three-dimensional display
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an underground radar system capable of accurately detecting a position and a direction of an underground radar apparatus and capable of acquiring accurate investigation data corresponding to the position of the underground radar apparatus.SOLUTION: An underground radar system includes: an underground radar apparatus 1 allowed to be moved along a ground surface to investigate an underground buried object; a marker member 13 including at least three light-emitting elements 14 attached to the underground radar apparatus 1; a camera 17 for photographing an investigation area of the underground radar apparatus 1; a position measuring apparatus 2 for detecting a position of the underground radar apparatus 1 on the basis of an image of the marker member 13 photographed by the camera 17; a database 24 for storing position information of the underground radar apparatus 1 detected by the position measuring apparatus 2 and investigation data acquired by the underground radar apparatus in association with each other; and an image display part 21 for displaying an investigation image on the basis of the investigation data and the position information stored in the database 24.
assignees: TOHOKU ELECTRIC POWER CO;DITECT KK;NIPPON SIGNAL CO LTD

title_en: A life detection instrument based on an ultra wide band pulse radar
abstract_en: The utility model provides a life detection instrument based on an ultra wide band pulse radar. According to the life detection instrument, a down converter does not need to be employed, and baseband signals are directly generated from carrier wave signals through equivalent sampling, so that restrictions of A/D data processing rates of existing life detection instruments are overcome; and equivalent sampling is carried out on radar echo pulse signals so as to broaden nanosecond or picosecond pulse signals along a time axis into millisecond-order or microsecond-order base-band pulse signals.

title_en: Through Wall Sensing System Using WiFi/Cellular Radar
abstract_en: A handheld through-wall sensing system comprising a transmitter/receiving operating at wireless data or cellular transmission frequencies. The system is operated in a monostatic radar mode with transmission occurring on frequency f o  and reception on a predetermined bandwidth centered on f o . The system may be operated on a pulsed or pseudo “half duplex” mode and have a transmit/receive pattern that is a function of the desired minimum stand-off distance.

title_en: Multi-target detecting method used for through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-path illusion suppression method suitable for enclosed space multi-target detection on the basis of the principle that the multi-path echo distance corresponding to one target is certainly larger than the echo distance of the target itself. According to the method, binaryzation is conducted on an original image through threshold detection, the binaryzation image is marked on the basis of a 4-connected method to obtain a group of connected domains, and all the connected domains are sorted in an ascending mode from small to large according to the distances between the mean values of the coordinates of the connected domains to the central point a radar to form a connected domain sequence; then whether each connected domain is a target or a multi-path illusion region is analyzed and judged according to the ascending order of the distances between the mean values of the coordinates of the connected domains to the central point the radar from small to large, the connected domains which are judged to be the targets are remained, zero setting is conducted on the connected domains which are judged to be the multi-path illusion regions, and therefore it is guaranteed that target images in the multi-path illusion regions cannot be lost while suppression of multi-path illusion is achieved.

title_en: Array type electrode based on magnetic-induced method to detecting biosignal
title_ko: 어레이형 유도용량성 생체신호 전극 및 이를 구비한 생체신호 검출키트
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an array type inductance biosignal fabric electrode and a biosignal detection kit having the same. The inductance biosignal fabric electrode is formed by positioning a conductive thread or a conductive fabric-based coil type magnetic sensor for detecting a change in the volume of a biological tissue by using a change in inductance, on a fabric in a planar or three-dimensional structure. Buffer members are positioned between the inductance biosignal fabric electrode and the skin while being separated from each other to have a predetermined space to reduce motion. The inductance biosignal fabric electrode is configured as a single electrode or an array type electrode, and a fabric-based connector unit is provided to connect the inductance biosignal fabric electrode to power. The biosignal detection kit of the present invention comprises: an array electrode unit formed by stacking two or more electrode units including a fabric electrode which has a spiral coil, receives an oscillating signal from an oscillating circuit, and outputs the oscillating signal including a biosignal; buffer members positioned under the array electrode unit; and a bottom fabric positioned on the bottom of the buffer members, wherein the buffer members are installed to be spaced apart from each other and have a space therebetween.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 유도용량(Inductance)변화를 이용한 생체조직의 체적변화를 검출하는 전도성 실 또는 전도성 직물 기반 코일 형 자계 센서를 직물 위에 평면 혹은 입체 구조로 위치시켜 유도용량성 생체신호 직물전극을 형성하며, 유도용량성 생체신호 직물전극과 피부의 사이에, 완충부재들이 위치되되, 완충부재들이 소정의 공간을 구비하도록 이격되어 위치함에 의해 동잡음이 저감되도록 이루어지며, 유도용량성 생체신호 직물전극이 단일 전극으로 구성되거나 어레이형 전극으로 구성되며, 유도용량성 생체신호 직물전극에 전원을 연결하기 위한 직물기반 코넥터부를 포함하는, 유도용량성 생체신호 직물전극 및 이를 구비한 생체신호 검출키트에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 생체신호 검출키트는, 나선형 코일을 구비하며 발진회로로부터 발진신호를 수신하고 생체신호를 포함한 발진신호를 출력하는 직물전극을 포함하는 전극부를 2개 이상 적층하여 이루어진, 어레이 전극부; 상기 어레이 전극부의 아래에 위치되는, 완충부재; 상기 완충부재 밑에 위치되는, 밑면 직물지;를 포함하여 이루어지며, 상기 완충부재는, 다수개의 완충부재가 서로 이격되어 설치되되, 완충부재들 사이에는 공간이 구비되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Textile electrode kit, and the motion artifact-minimizing clothing installed with the kit
title_ko: 직물전극 키트 및 이를 장착한 동잡음 최소화 의복
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a textile electrode kit and clothing for minimizing motion artifacts having the same includes; the textile electrode kit composed of a conductive textile based biological signal measurement sensor; and a clothing structure for indiscernibly and unconstrainedly minimizing the motion artifacts in your daily life and stably detecting a biological signal such as an electrocardiogram of a patient or the like. The present invention, which is the clothing to have an electrode detecting the biological signal, includes; an elastic member under an armpit positioned under a left side armpit and a right side armpit independently; a front center band positioned on a front plate of the clothing; an upper front center dart which is a dart perpendicularly extended from the center of an upper end of the front center band to the center of a neck circumference line of the front plate; a rear center band positioned on a rear plate of the clothing; and a lower rear center dart which is a dart perpendicularly extended from the center of a lower end of the rear center band to a waist portion.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전도성 직물기반 생체신호 측정 센서 등으로 이루어진 직물전극 키트와, 상기 직물전극 키트가 의류에 장착되어, 무구속적 및 무자각적으로, 피검자의 심전도 등 생체신호를 일상 동작 중에도 동잡음이 최소화하고 안정적으로 검출하도록 하는 의복 구조를 구비한, 직물전극 키트 및 이를 장착한 의복에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에서, 생체신호를 검출하는 전극을 장착하기 위한 의복은, 좌우측 겨드랑이 밑에 각각 위치되며, 탄성재질로 이루어진, 겨드랑이 밑 탄성부재; 비신축성 소재를 포함하여 이루어지며, 띠형태를 이루며, 의복 앞판에 위치되되, 일단이 좌측의 겨드랑이 밑 탄성부재의 일단에 장착되고, 다른 일단이 우측의 겨드랑이 밑 탄성부재의 일단에 장착되는, 앞판중앙 띠;  앞판중앙 띠의 상단의 중앙에서 앞판의 목둘레선의 중앙까지 수직으로 이루어진 다트(dart)인, 앞판상부 중앙다트; 비신축성 소재로 이루어지며, 띠형태를 이루며, 의복 뒷판에 위치되되, 일단이 좌측의 겨드랑이 밑 탄성부재의 다른 일단에 장착되고, 다른 일단이 우측의 겨드랑이 밑 탄성부재의 다른 일단에 장착되는, 뒷판중앙 띠; 뒷판중앙 띠의 하단의 중앙에서 허리부까지 수직으로 이루어진 다트(dart)인, 뒷판하부 중앙다트;를 포함하여 이루어진다. 
앞판중앙 띠는, 중앙에 위치되며 탄성재질로 이루어진, 가슴중앙 탄성부재; 비신축성 소재로 이루어지며, 일단이 좌측의 겨드랑이 밑 탄성부재의 일단에 장착되고, 다른 일단이 가슴중앙 탄성부재의 일단에 장착된, 좌측 앞판중앙 띠; 비신축성 소재로 이루어지며, 일단이 우측의 겨드랑이 밑 탄성부재의 일단에 장착되고, 다른 일단이 가슴중앙 탄성부재의 다른 일단에 장착된, 우측 앞판중앙 띠;를 포함하여 이루어진다.
assignees: UNIV YONSEI IACF;UNIV KONKUK IND COOP CORP

title_en: Beidou system-based transmission line geological disaster monitoring system
abstract_en: Provided in the utility model is a Beidou system-based transmission line geological disaster monitoring system comprising a sensor, a collection box, a camera, and an elevated tower. To be specific, the sensor buried under the ground monitors data of geological changes in real time; the collector box installed at the elevated tower receives the data collected by the sensor; and the camera arranged at the elevated tower can rotate automatically in a 360-degree range and is provided with a video sensor. According to the technical scheme, all-weather, full-automatic, high-precision, real-time monitoring of geological disasters like a regional transmission line corridor debris flow source and surface displacement and the like as well as secure and reliable collection and transmission of monitoring data can be realized; and a fault spot can be determined based on the analysis on the collected data.
assignees: XI AN TONGKAI ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: System for the detection and classification of buried unexploded ordnance
abstract_en: A sensor system for detecting buried metal objects such as unexploded ordnance and the collection of data for the classification of the detected objects based on parameters extracted from the collected data includes a wheeled cart, positioned on which is an array of transmitter coils for transmitting a series of excitation signals onto the area of interest and a sensor array of receiver coils and preamplifiers for receiving back the resultant eddy current decays emitted by the buried objects, a computer, and data acquisition electronics for acquiring and storing the received decays as decay data within the computer. The incoming EMI data are digitized and a data fitting process is performed to extract fit location and shape parameters. These data can be transferred to other data analysis systems for comparison to previously recorded signatures to determine whether the received decay data from the area of interest is attributable to buried metal objects or conversely to an object constituting an anomaly.

title_en: Miner basic vital sign wireless monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of wireless monitoring, and particularly relates to a miner basic vital sign wireless monitoring system under a mine. A piezoelectric film sensor is adopted to convert pulses to electric signals, a digital temperature sensor is adopted to directly convert the temperature at the wrist of a miner to digital values, a single chip microcomputer is used for processing the pulse signals to obtain pulse wave information, a value of the temperature sensor is read, the pulse wave information and the temperature value are transmitted to a ground monitoring room through an underground wireless transmission network, and miner basic vital signs can be wirelessly monitored in real time. The miner basic vital sign wireless monitoring system can play an important role in the rescue work of mine disaster accidents, and also can monitor pulses and body temperature of the miner in real time in down-hole operation at ordinate times, and the health conditions of the miner can be conveniently mastered.

title_en: Necklace-shaped physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor (referred to herein as the ‘necklace’) that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the necklace can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Method for Service of Driver Identfy and Bio Signal Information of Driver
title_ko: 생체정보를 통한 운전자 개인인식 및 운전상태 변화정보 제공방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for recognizing a driver, using biometric information, and for providing changes in driving conditions. The present invention is disclosed to recognize a driver by producing characteristics from biometric information on a driver through a biometric information sensor installed in the steering wheel of a vehicle; to produce a physical condition of the driver from the biometric information equipped in the steering wheel during driving; to provide information on changes in biological signals in real time during driving to provide information on changes in biological signals according to drowsiness of a driver, a driving habit, and a driving situation; and to detect a steering angle of the steering wheel by a gyro sensor installed in the steering wheel, thereby analyzing driving habits of the driver and helping the driver to safely drive. The method of the present invention comprises the following steps of: recognizing a driver by comparing characteristics of the stored biological signals with biological signals obtained by biometric information sensors including an ECG sensor, a skin electric resistance sensor, a skin temperature sensor, a body fat sensor, and an arterial elasticity sensor; producing basic health information from the biological signals obtained by each sensor and providing the information to the driver; producing information on changes in the biological signals obtained by each sensor according to the mileage and the travel time of the vehicle and providing the information to the driver; and generating a guide to improve the physical condition of the driver and a guide on driving habits by obtaining and analyzing the changes in the biological signals for a predetermined time period.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 생체정보를 통한 운전자 개인인식 및 운전상태 변화정보 제공방법에 관한 것으로, 차량의 핸들에 장착된 생체정보센서를 통해 운전자의 생체정보로부터 특징을 산출하여 운전자를 인식하며, 운전 중 핸들에 장착된 생체정보로부터 운전자의 건강상태를 산출하고, 운전 중 실시간으로 생체신호 변화정보를 제공하여 운전자의 졸음, 운전습관 및 운전상황에 따른 생체신호변화 정보를 제공하고, 핸들에 장착된 자이로센서를 통해 핸들의 조향각도를 감지하여 운전자의 운전습관 등을 분석 및 안전운전을 가이드 하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
본 발명의 목적은 차량의 핸들에 장착된 심전도센서, 피부전기저항센서, 피부온도센서, 체지방센서, 동맥탄성도센서를 포함한 생체정보센서를 통해 획득된 생체신호의 특징과 기 저장된 생체신호 특징과의 비교를 통해 운전자를 식별하는 과정; 각 센서를 통해 획득된 생체신호에서 기초 건강정보를 산출하여 운전자에게 제공하는 과정; 차량의 주행거리 및 시간에 따라 상기 각 센서를 통해 획득된 생체신호의 변화상태정보를 산출하여 운전자에게 제공하는 과정; 및 생체신호의 변화상태정보를 일정 기간획득 및 분석하여 운전자의 개인건강 향상 및 운전습관에 대한 가이드를 생성하는 과정;을 포함하여 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: UWB-based contactless biometric signals Tester
title_ko: Uwb 기반 비접촉식 생체신호진단기
abstract_en: Disclosed are a system and a method for remote health care using UWB radar. According to the present invention, a training set is configured by grouping values, which can be analyzed from a first UWB radar Doppler signal, by class using a pattern recognition method. A central center diagnoses a health state by analyzing a second UWB radar Doppler signal measured by a mobile terminal based on the training set and transmits class information to the mobile terminal as diagnostic results. As the result of the diagnosis, when the class information is classified as dangerous and an emergency has occurred, the central center requests emergency rescue based on a position signal transmitted from the mobile terminal.
abstract_ko: UWB 레이더를 이용한 원격 건강관리 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따르면, 제1 UWB 레이더 도플러 신호에서 분석할 수 있는 값들을 패턴인식 기법을 이용해 클래스별로 그룹화하여 트레이닝 셋을 구성한다. 중앙 센터는 트레이닝 셋을 바탕으로 휴대 단말기에서 측정된 제2 UWB 레이더UWB 레이더 신호를 분석하여 건강상태를 진단하고, 진단결과로서 클래스 정보를 휴대 단말기로 전송한다. 진단 결과, 클래스 정보가 위험으로 분류되어 응급 상황이 발생한 경우에, 중앙 센터는 휴대 단말기로부터 전송된 위치 신호에 기반하여 응급 구조를 요청한다.

title_en: Insulation type distributing box layed underground
title_ko: 지중 매설용 절연형 배전반
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an insulative distributing board to be buried underground. According to the present invention, a ceramic heater capable of dissipating heat is included in a closure part, which constitutes the distributing board. At the same time, a temperature sensor and a humidity sensor are installed in parallel in the closure part. An interspace between both sides of a door part is sealed by a sealing cover; a structure of a distributing hole is improved to arrange a ventilation hole. Therefore, water is prevented from permeating into the distributing board; electric leakage and short-circuit are prevented. According to the present invention, the inside of the insulative distributing board is maintained to be at a constant temperature and the humidity. Therefore, electric leakage or short-circuit caused by humidity and moisture, which permeates into the distributing board when it rains, are prevented in advance; accidents are prevented; and an electric shock accident is prevented when the short-circuit occurs.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지중 매설용 절연형 배전반에 관한 것으로, 배전반을 구성하는 함체부 내부에 발열기능을 하는 세라믹히터를 내장함과 동시에 온도센서 및 습도센서를 병행설치하고, 도어부의 양측 도어 경계면을 밀폐커버로 밀봉하며, 배전공 구조를 개선하여 통풍구를 마련함에 의해 침수를 막고, 누전이나 단락을 예방할 수 있게 된다. 
이와 같은 본 발명은 내부를 항상 일정한 온도와 습도를 유지하도록 건조시키기 때문에 수분이나 습기, 우천시 스며든 물기에 의한 누전이나 합선을 미연에 방지할 수 있게 되어 안전사고를 예방하고, 단락시에도 감전사고를 예방한다.

title_en: Microwave stethoscope for measuring cardio-pulmonary vital signs and lung water content
abstract_en: A microwave stethoscope measurement method and sensor design employ a microwave transmission sensor and a microwave reception sensor placed on a patient's chest in spaced-apart side-by-side configuration for monitoring patient vital signs, lung water content and other critical measurements. The side-by-side sensors are spaced apart a separation distance of about 1-3 cm in lateral chest orientation. The sensors may be formed with a textile fabric for wearer comfort and to improve contact with the patient's skin. The microwave sensor measurements are digitally processed using a modified short time Fourier Transform (STFT) spectrum windowed-averaged algorithm. Output data extracted from the microwave sensor measurements may be transmitted wirelessly to a mobile device such as a smartphone for remote monitoring of the patient's medical condition.
assignees: ISKANDER MAGDY F;CELIK NURI;GAGARIN RUTHSENNE;HUANG GUI CHAO;BIBB DARCY ALAN;UNIV HAWAII

title_en: Weak-breathing-signal enhancement method used for life detection radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a breathing signal enhancement method used for a life detection radar. In the breathing signal enhancement method, an echo signal matrix of an ultra-wide-band life detection radar is modeled into a zero mean stationary random process, and through a background removal method and a linear jitter removal method, a signal matrix which includes weak breathing signals is obtained preliminarily. Different degrees of enhancement processing, fast time FIR band-pass filter and a slow time moving average filter enable the weak breathing signals to be enhanced and more obvious in an output signal matrix so that guarantee is provided to follow-up detection of weak human body characteristics.

title_en: User interfaces for utility locators
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to user interfaces for enhanced utility locators. Such enhanced utility locators may include a myriad of sensors and other such technologies for determining information regarding the buried or otherwise inaccessible utility line. Such information may be displayed in a myriad of ways to convey relative characteristics among multiple utilities, or to convey relative characteristics of one or more utilities with respect to a locator.

title_en: Earthquake wave underground construction space observation system and method based on random arrangement
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake wave underground construction space observation system and method based on random arrangement, and belongs to a geological survey method of underground construction. The system comprises an earthquake wave trigger and an earthquake wave receiver, the earthquake wave trigger and the earthquake wave receiver are both connected into a data acquisition instrument, and the data acquisition instrument is further connected into a computer. The earthquake wave trigger comprises a plurality of kinds of earthquake wave excitation devices, and respective starting switches are arranged on the earthquake wave excitation devices. The earthquake wave receiver comprises detector strings which are used for being buried underground and on the ground to detect different earthquake waves. Each earthquake wave sensor in the earthquake wave receivers is used as a basic unit, position description and direction description are carried out, ray tracing and homing imaging are carried out on received transmission waves and reflection waves through position offset and angle offset, and earthquake data correction, processing and standard wave spectrum display are achieved.

title_en: Monitoring and early warning system for landslide disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to a monitoring and early warning system for a landslide disaster. The system comprises piezoelectric cables, a front-end signal processor, a system host, a field alarm device, a wireless transmission device, and a monitoring center and the like. A plurality of piezoelectric cables are buried inside a side slope soil body and are used as sensors to carry out processing and analyzing on obtained signals; the field alarm device emits early warning prompting information in real time at field; the wireless transmission device sends the information to a monitoring center in real time by a GSM wireless network and processing, analyzing and displaying are carried out. According to the invention, the invention is mainly applied to monitoring of landslide stability; and functions of field real-time early warning, remote wireless disaster information transmission, and remote data displaying and the like can be realized. Moreover, the system having the characteristics of simple arrangement, low cost, and high practicability and the like can be effectively applied to large-area slide slope deformation monitoring and disaster forecasting.
assignees: TIANJIN SATCOM IOT APPLIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST CO LTD;BEIJING SATCOM ITS TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus for image processing in ground penetratiang radar
title_ko: 지표면 투과영상 시스템 및 그 이미지 처리 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a ground penetrating radar system (GPR) and a method of processing an image therefrom, more particularly, to a ground penetrating radar system and a method of processing an image therefrom for improving a performance of detecting a nearby object by compensating for a strength of a reflected signal according to an angle of the reflected signal when image-processing the signal reflected from an object near a surface. The ground penetrating radar system of the present invention includes a controller to generate a pulse; a transmitting antenna to receive and transmit the pulse generated from the controller; a receiving antenna to receive the signal reflected from a buried object after the transmitted pulse passes through a medium; an image signal processing unit to compensate for a strength of the reflected signal according to an incident angle of the reflected signal of the receiving antenna and generating a 2-dimensional image or a 3-dimensional image when image-processing the reflected signal received from the receiving antenna; and a display unit to display the generated 2-dimensional image or the 3-dimensional image on a display screen.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지표면 투과영상 시스템(GPR) 및 그 이미지 처리 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 표면에 근접한 물체에서 반사된 신호를 이미지 처리함에 있어서 각도에 따라 반사 신호의 강도를 보정함으로써 근접 물체의 감지 능력을 향상시키는 지표면 투과영상 시스템 및 그 이미지 처리 방법에 관한 것이다. 
  본 발명의 지표면 투과영상 시스템은 펄스를 발생시키는 제어장치; 제어장치에서 발생한 펄스를 수신하여 방사시키는 송신안테나; 방사된 펄스가 매질을 통과한 후 매설 물체에서 반사되어 들어오는 신호를 받아들이는 수신안테나; 수신 안테나로부터 수신된 반사 신호를 이미지 처리함에 있어서 수신 안테나의 반사 신호 수신 각도에 따라 반사 신호의 강도를 보정하여 2영상 또는 3차원 영상을 생성하는 이미지 신호 처리부; 및 생성된 2영상 또는 3차원 영상을 디스플레이 화면에 표시하는 표시부를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Cable digital display synchronous fixed point path instrument and fixed point method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cable digital display synchronous fixed point path instrument and a fixed point method thereof, relates to the field of cable detection, and provides a detecting instrument for insulating fault points of a buried power cable. The detecting instrument comprises an electromagnetic wave sensor, a sound wave vibrating sensor, a data processor, a range display and an audio frequency amplifier, wherein the electromagnetic wave sensor and the sound wave vibrating sensor are connected with the data processor respectively; the electromagnetic wave sensor is used for sending the received electromagnetic waves transmitted from cable radiation to the data processor for processing; the sound wave vibrating sensor is used for sending the received fault point earthquake waves transmitted from the underground to the data processor for processing; the data processor is connected with the range display for information exchange; the electromagnetic wave sensor and a sound sensor are adopted to send received electromagnetic wave signals and earthquake waves to the data processor for processing; processed data information is displayed by the range display.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO;JIANGSU SUQIAN POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: A kind of service robot with vision system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of service robot with vision system, comprise robot car body and side's manipulator mounted thereto, described robot car body is built with the control system of robot controlling body movement and manipulator behavior, embedded vision tracking system and WIFI communication module are also housed in described robot car body, the camera of Visual Tracking System is installed on a robotic arm by The Cloud Terrace, and WIFI communication module realizes the wireless transmission of the data and instruction of control system, Visual Tracking System and host computer.The utility model adopts embedded vision tracking system on service robot, camera is utilized to carry out vision tracking, and utilize WIFI communication module and host computer to realize visual transmission, with WIFI wireless network for data transport vehicle, realize the intelligence system of the functions such as real-time control, audio video transmission and IMAQ, service robot described in the utility model is used in the civilian and military fields such as anti-terrorism investigation, battlefield C4ISR system, fire control and disaster rescue, life detection.

title_en: For the faint breath signal detection method of life detection radar
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of faint breath signal detection method for life detection radar. This faint breath signal detection method comprises: by radar echo signal, set up M �� N dimension distance slow time signal matrix S (m, n); For each range unit, when S (m, n) slow, direction carries out auto-correlation processing, obtain signal matrix R x (m, ��); Respectively to R x Each row vector of (m, ��) carries out FFT, obtains frequency of distance matrix   Range direction on carry out weighted accumulation, obtain breath signal frequency spectrum And traversal Each position, find energy than the position being greater than pre-determined threshold, if when the number of this position is greater than 0, judge that underground exists life entity. Present invention achieves the enhancing of faint breath signal, detection and extract, the needs of the faint vital signs detection of the personnel that bury under meeting the occasions such as disaster rescue.

title_en: Moving body location and error correction method for through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a moving body location and error correction method for through-wall radar. Target distance sums under two receiving channels are used for obtaining the virtual position of a target through direct oval cross location, the virtual distance sums of a virtual target are obtained on the basis of known wall parameters, distance sum correction quantities are obtained by subtracting the target distance sums from the virtual distance sums, finally, the correction quantities are subtracted from the distance sums of the real target, oval cross location is conducted, and target location and error correction are finished. The position deviation caused by wall electromagnetism penetration to target location is corrected, the moving target location accuracy of the through-wall radar is improved, and the robustness of follow-up tracking processing is guaranteed. Compared with existing method, the moving body location and error correction method for the through-wall radar has the advantages that computation is simple and convenient, and the real-time performance and practicability are high.

title_en: Meteorological monitoring system and monitoring system for early warning of rock slope landslide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a meteorological monitoring system and a meteorological monitoring system for the early warning of rock slope landslide, and belongs to the field of an environment monitoring technology. The meteorological monitoring system comprises a water pressure gage buried on a sliding surface, and a water level indicator arranged at the top of a trailing edge pulling crack; the meteorological monitoring system further comprises a wireless remote system which is connected with the water pressure gauge and the water level indicator through data wires, and an operating system which receives the water pressure monitoring data and water level monitoring data of the wireless remote system. Field monitoring data is transmitted to the operating system through wireless signal transmission, and an early warning value and a field valve can be given simultaneously by a monitoring software in the operating system, therefore the subjectivity of the a man-made set prewarning value can be prevented, and the automatic remote monitoring and landslide forecasting and early warning can be realized. The monitoring system provided by the invention does not need to install a drilling clinometers and a stress sensor based on water level monitoring, therefore the construction difficulty and monitoring cost can be reduced.
assignees: HONG DA GUO YUAN WUHU RESOURCES AND ENVIRONMENT MAN CO LTD

title_en: System for sensing collapse of the slope
title_ko: 비탈면 붕괴 사전 감지시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for detecting collapse of slope in advance, more particularly, to a system for detecting collapse of slope in advance to prevent disaster due to the collapse of slope by detecting the collapse of natural slope. For the purpose, the present invention includes: inclination sensors which are installed in a plurality of piles buried in a slope to detect the inclination of the slope; infrared sensors which are installed in at least one of the piles to detect the displacement of the slope by receiving infrared light after irradiating the infrared light to an adjacent pile; a control unit which is installed in one side of the slope to receive and store detected information from the inclination sensors and infrared sensors, and to deliver the detected information to an administrator server; and the administrator server for storing the detected information received from each control unit installed in slopes of many locations, determining whether the stored detected information is out of the preset reference value, and notifying the result to an administrator if the detected information is out of the reference range.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비탈면 붕괴 사전 감지시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 자연사면의 붕괴를 감지하여 사면붕괴로 인한 재해를 예방하도록 한 비탈면 붕괴 사전 감지시스템에 관한 것이다. 이를 위해, 본 발명은 사면에 매설되는 복수 개의 파일에 각각 설치되어 사면의 기울기를 감지하는 기울기센서; 상기 복수 개의 파일 중 어느 하나 이상에 설치되어 인접된 파일에 적외선 조사 후 수광여부로 사면의 변위를 감지하는 적외선센서; 사면의 일측에 설치되어 상기 기울기센서와 적외선센서로부터 감지정보를 전달받아 저장하고, 관리자서버에 그 감지정보를 전달하는 제어부; 여러 장소의 사면에 설치되는 각각의 제어부로부터 전달받은 감지정보를 저장하고, 그 저장된 감지정보가 설정된 기준값을 초과하는지를 판별한 후 기준값을 초과하는 경우 해당 사면의 관리자에게 이를 알려주는 관리자서버;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Water-level monitoring system and method for early warning of landslide of rock slopes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-level monitoring system and method for early warning of landslide of rock slopes and belongs to the technical field of environment monitoring. The water-level monitoring system comprises a water pressure meter buried at a sliding surface and a water level meter arranged at the top part of a pull-apart crack of the rear edge. The water-level monitoring system also comprises a wireless remote system and an operation system, wherein the wireless remote system is connected with the water pressure meter and the water level meter by a data line; the operation system is used for receiving water-pressure monitoring data and water-level monitoring data of the wireless remote system. Site monitoring data is transmitted to the operation system by wireless signals, and an early-warning value and a site value can be given out simultaneously by monitoring software in the operation system, so that the subjectivity of the early-warning value artificially set is avoided and remote automatic monitoring and predicted early warning of landslide can be realized. The water-level monitoring system is mainly used for monitoring the water level and does not need to install a borehole clinometer and a stress sensor, so that the construction difficulty and the monitoring cost are reduced.
assignees: HONG DA GUO YUAN WUHU RESOURCES AND ENVIRONMENTAL MAN CO LTD

title_en: Ground Penetrating Radar with Variable Dwell Time
abstract_en: An object detection system may be capable of sensing a buried object and providing an estimate of the object's depth.
