The object detection system may comprise a signal generator transmitting one or more signals. At least one of the signals may be directed toward the buried object and reflected off of the object back to the system. At least one of the signals may be transmitted along a variable length path. A correlator may then receive the signals and determine an offset between their arrival times at the correlator. The variable length path may then be adjusted over a range which includes a minimum offset indicating a distance to the object.
assignees: HALL DAVID R;WAHLQUIST DAVID C;LEFEVRE DON

title_en: Robotic sense-through-wall sensor with simplified control interface
abstract_en: A system includes a self-propelled robotic vehicle carrying an UWB sensor. The UWB sensor responds to binary transitions of a mode control signal to select for its modes of operation.

title_en: High-resolution through-wall imaging system and method based on random antenna array and microwave relevance imaging principle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of high-resolution through-wall imaging system and method based on random antenna array and microwave relevance imaging principle.Use using the equal aerial array of equidistantly arrangement and ranks number as emitting portion, the opening and closing random by each array-element antenna carries out stochastical sampling to single signal source, project and be imaged region, formed to have and be similar to counterfeit thermal light source space-time stochastic volatility and the microwave field of statistical independence, by once detecting acquisition high-resolution imaging result, simplify design and the manufacture difficulty of microwave relevance imaging system, reduce cost, the stability of raising system and interference free performance, the large-scale application for microwave relevance imaging creates condition with universal.Formation method can obtain the high-definition picture of indoor objects and the room area blocked by body of wall, and the signal attenuation effect that brings body of wall is insensitive, there is strong noise robustness, improve disguise and the battlefield survivability of operating personnel of detection device, there is huge using value.

title_en: Portable through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses portable through-wall radar which comprises a radar shell. The portable through-wall radar further comprises a power supply module, a display control module, a digital module, a transceiving module and an antenna array, wherein the power supply module, the display control module, the digital module, the transceiving module and the antenna array are arranged in the radar shell; the output end of the power supply module is connected with the display control module, the digital module and the transceiving module; the display control module is connected with the digital module, the transceiving module and the antenna array in sequence. Various aspect factors such as penetrating power, areas and external disturbance are considered during optimized frequency band selection; light and ultra-broadband antennae are adopted; the requirements for broadband, impedance matching, lightweight and low profiles are met at the same time, transceiving leakage is controlled, and the dynamic range of a reception channel is guaranteed; the array topological structure is optimized, the requirement for high angular resolution is met, and angular grating lobes are avoided as much as possible; multi-airspace freedom degree is adopted to guarantee target fuzzy calculating; propagation speed changes and direction deviations are reduced; multiple false targets caused by the multipath effect are suppressed.

title_en: Exit flee t0 leading light
title_ko: 피난구 유도등
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency exit sign which makes it possible to secure a clear view from dust and smoke in case of a fire, and changes the angle of the sign to another safe exit, not a guide indication direction in case there is a fire in the guide indication direction indicated by the emergency exit sign, in order for persons to be always guided to a safe exit without a fire. The emergency exit including a body (10), a fixing plate (20), a light penetration part (30), a direction guide display part (31), a power source part (40), and an LED and LED driving part (50), additionally comprises: a control part (60), a first and a second heat sensor (70, 71), a laser generator (80), a laser ray passage hole (85), an angle change part (90) and a subsidiary accommodation part (100). Thus, the emergency exit sign has the distinguished effect of being able to guide persons to take refuge safely and more accurately under darkness where it is difficult to secure a clear view because of smoke. In ordinary times, the laser ray is irradiated to an original exit sign or another exit sign installed adjacently thereto and at the same time, the laser ray irradiated from the adjacent emergency exit sign is irradiated to other exit direction refractively, not to the ordinary exit sign. Thus, the emergency exit sign can be used in case of a bidirectional exit. The laser generator can be installed in the left, right side or the front of the body, and thus, the emergency exit sign can be installed regardless of an evacuation passage structure.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재시 먼지, 연기 등으로부터 시야 확보를 가능하게 하고, 피난구 유도등이 지시하는 안내표시 방향에서 화재가 발생된 경우에도 안내표시 방향이 아닌 다른 안전한 출구측 방향으로 변각하여 항상 화재가 없는 안전한 출구로만 안내되도록 표시하는 피난구 유도등에 관한 것으로, 이는 몸체(10), 고정판(20), 광투시부(30), 방향안내표시부(31), 전원부(40), LED 및 LED구동부(50)를 구비한 피난구 유도등에 제어부(60)와, 제1 및 제2 열감지기(70)(71)와, 레이저발생기(80)와, 레이저 광선 통로구(85)와, 변각부(90) 및 보조수납부(100)를 구비하여서, 연기로 인한 시야확보가 어려운 상황속에서도 보다 정확하게 안전 대피하도록 유도할 수 있는 현저한 효과가 잇고, 또한 평상시에 본래의 피난구 또는 인접설치된 다른 피난구유도등으로 레이저 광선을 조사하는 동시에 인접 설치된 피난구 유도등에서 조사되는 레이저 광선을 평상시의 피난구측이 아닌 다른 피난구측 방향으로도 굴절 조사되도록 피난구가 양방향인 곳에서도 유용하게 사용할 수 있는 장점과, 레이저 발생기를 몸체의 좌, 우측면 또는 전방에 설치가 가능하여 피난통로구조에 관계없이 모두 설치 적용이 가능한 효과가 있다.

title_en: System for measuring living body signal
title_ko: 생체신호 측정 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a bio-signal measurement system. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the bio-signal measurement system checks the location of a measurement subject; decides the coordinates of a location where the measurement subject has stopped; makes a sensor unit move to the coordinates; enables the sensor unit to detect a displacement corresponding to a bio-signal from the stopped measurement subject; and determines whether an emergency situation has occurred to the measurement subject based on a variation of the displacement.
abstract_ko: 생체신호 측정 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일실시예의 시스템은, 측정대상자의 위치를 확인하고, 측정대상자가 정지한 위치의 좌표를 결정하여, 상기 좌표로 센서부를 이동하게 하고, 센서부가 정지한 측정대상자로부터 생체신호에 해당하는 변위를 수신하여, 변위의 변화량에 의해 측정대상자의 응급상황을 판단할 수 있다.

title_en: Method, apparatus and terminal for life detection processing
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a life detection processing method, device and terminal. The method includes that: a WiFi electromagnetic wave is emitted; coherent waves of a reflected wave of the WiFi electromagnetic wave and the WiFi electromagnetic wave are received; and life information is determined according to the received coherent waves. The method solves the problems about the life detection in related art that it is not convenient for users to operate, the penetration is low and the general feature is poor, while offering portability, usability and timeliness of use.

title_en: Contents valuation system and contents valuating method using the system
title_ko: 콘텐츠 평가 시스템 및 이를 이용한 콘텐츠 평가 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a content evaluation system capable of evaluating content more objectively and reliably and a content evaluation method using the same. The content evaluation system includes: a brainwave measurement unit, a biometric signal measurement unit, a sensor control unit, and a main control unit. The brainwave measurement unit measures brainwaves from a subject who receives content and outputs the measured brainwaves. The biometric signal measurement unit measures a biometric signal from the subject and outputs the measured biometric signal. The sensor control unit controls the brainwave measurement unit and the biometric signal measurement unit, and receives and transmits the brainwaves and the biometric signal. The main control unit senses changes in the brainwaves and the biometric signal, which occur before the content is provided and while the content is provided by analyzing the brainwaves and the biometric signal transmitted from the sensor control unit. The main control unit also draws at least one of the immersion of the subject in the content and a direction of the emotion of the subject using the changes in the brainwaves and the biometric signal, and evaluates the content using the drawn at least one. Thus, the content may be evaluated more reliably.
abstract_ko: 보다 객관적이고 신뢰도가 높게 콘텐츠를 평가할 수 있는 콘텐츠 평가 시스템 및 이를 이용한 콘텐츠 평가 방법이 개시된다.  이러한 콘텐츠 평가 시스템은 뇌파 측정부, 생체신호 측정부, 센서 제어부 및 메인 제어부를 포함한다.  상기 뇌파 측정부는 콘텐츠를 제공받는 피험자로부터 뇌파를 측정하여 출력하고, 상기 생체신호 측정부는 상기 피험자로부터 생체 신호를 측정하여 출력한다.  상기 센서 제어부는 상기 뇌파 측정부 및 상기 생체신호 측정부를 제어하고, 상기 뇌파 및 상기 생체 신호를 제공받아 전달한다.  상기 메인 제어부는 상기 센서 제어부로부터 전달된 상기 뇌파 및 상기 생체 신호를 분석하여 상기 콘텐츠를 제공하기 전과 제공하는 동안 발생되는 상기 뇌파 및 상기 생체 신호의 변화를 감지하고, 상기 뇌파 및 상기 생체 신호의 변화에 이용하여 상기 피험자의 상기 콘텐츠에 대한 몰입도 및 정서의 방향 중 적어도 하나를 도출하며, 상기 도출된 적어도 하나의 결과를 이용하여 상기 콘텐츠를 평가한다.  이로써, 상기 콘텐츠를 신뢰도 높게 평가할 수 있다.

title_en: Electrostatic field sensor and security system in interior and exterior spaces
abstract_en: The invention relates to an electrostatic field sensor and a security system in interior spaces, which can measure electrostatic fields and the variations thereof along a metal conductor that acts as a detection probe or antenna (1). Said probe is connected to an electronic circuit (2, 3, 4, 31, 32) which is able to decode said changes in the electrostatic field around the conductor, and to detect minuscule variations in the electrostatic field, by means of a processor (7), enabling the clear detection of a human presence in an area surrounding said antenna (1) and the ability to differentiate between a human presence and any other type of animal or object.

title_en: Mobile terminal and method for processing the car accident usgin mobile terminal
title_ko: 이동 단말기 및 이를 이용한 차량의 사고 발생 처리 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a mobile terminal and a method for processing an accident of a vehicle by using the same. According to the present invention, a main body, formed to be worn on a certain portion of a body of a user, is connected to an e-call system of the vehicle and receives information related to a state of the vehicle; if a state that the main body is worn is sensed, a biosignal of the user, a wearer, is detected by using at least one sensor arranged on the main body. Afterwards, state information of the wearer is sequentially obtained by analyzing the detected biosignal to correspond to a state that an accident occurrence event of the vehicle is sensed based on the received information; and then, if a predetermined condition is satisfied, state information of the wearer and information, related to a state of the vehicle, are transmitted to a predetermined call center in cooperation with the e-call system.
abstract_ko: 이동 단말기 및 이를 이용한 차량의 사고 발생 처리 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명은, 신체의 특정부위에 착용가능하도록 이루어진 본체가 차량의 이콜(e-Call) 시스템과 연결되어, 차량의 상태와 관련된 정보를 수신한다. 그리고, 본체의 착용이 감지되면, 본체에 구비된 적어도 하나의 센서를 이용하여 착용자의 생체신호를 검출한다. 그리고, 수신된 정보에 기초하여 차량의 사고 발생 이벤트가 감지된 것에 응답하여, 상기 검출된 생체신호를 분석하여 착용자의 상태 정보를 단계적으로 획득한다. 그런 다음, 기설정된 조건을 만족하면, 이콜(e-Call) 시스템과 연동하여, 착용자의 상태 정보와 차량의 상태와 관련된 정보를 기설정된 콜센터로 전송한다.

title_en: Vital signal measuring apparatus and method for estimating contact condition
abstract_en: A vital signal measuring apparatus is attached to a living body to measure a vital signal of the living body, which includes an amplifier, an A/D converter, a processing unit, an n-th-order differential signal output unit, and an output unit. The amplifier and the A/D converter constitute a vital signal measuring unit for measuring a vital signal from a vital signal sensor and outputting a first signal corresponding to the vital signal. A time differentiation signal output unit includes the n-th-order differential signal output unit for receiving the first signal and outputting an n-th-order time differentiation signal (where n is an integer of 1 or more) of the first signal. The processing unit functions as a contact condition determination unit for determining contact condition between the vital signal measuring apparatus and the living body based on the n-th-order time differentiation signal.

title_en: Two-dimensional physical simulation test system and method for water inrush disaster of deep-buried tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-dimensional physical simulation test system for water inrush disasters of a deeply buried tunnel, which comprises a rigid test box, a water pressure servo control system, a vertical loading system, a pressure sensor and a permeation pressure sensor, wherein the rigid test box is of a cubic structure with an opening at the upper part, a high-strength glass plate is arranged on the front side surface of the rigid test box, a reserved tunnel portal is arranged on the high-strength glass plate, rock similar materials are paved inside the rigid test box, a karst cave cavity is buried at a preset position, the pressure stress sensor and the permeation pressure sensor are arranged on the periphery of the karst cave cavity and the tunnel, the karst cave cavity is communicated with the water pressure servo control system through a high-pressure water pipe, and the opening at the upper part of the rigid test box is loaded to a set load value through the. The two-dimensional model test system and the test method thereof have the advantages of simple structure, high strength, high rigidity and good water sealing performance, and can be used for more visually observing the surrounding rock fracture evolution characteristics in the water inrush process of the tunnel.

title_en: Fire-fighting search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses fire-fighting search and rescue robot, it comprises base, hose reel, controller and search and rescue main body, is provided with road wheel at base bottom, is provided with controller, rotates the search and rescue main body of hose reel and the split setting arranged in base top; Temperature sensor and life-detection instrument is provided with in search and rescue body front end; Search and rescue main body wall is provided with water cannon; Searching and rescuing, body top is provided with The Cloud Terrace, the electric-controlled mechanical arm of lower the temperature shower nozzle and rotation setting.Advantage: structure is simple, and cost is low; Search and rescue body volume is little, and action is convenient; Fire-fighting robot obtains water source by fire hose and carries out high-pressure extinction to different burning things which may cause a fire disaster from the scene of a fire, and fire-fighting efficiency is high; Controller is connected with search and rescue main body by flexible cable, and stable signal transmission, can manipulate search and rescue main body accurately; Robot body carries apparatus of oxygen supply, provides oxygen can to dyspneic trapped personnel; In addition, robot also carries extinguishing device, contributes to trapped personnel and carries out saving oneself or waiting for rescue.

title_en: Based on the search and rescue robot system of multi-agent theory
abstract_en: The utility model discloses the search and rescue robot system based on multi-agent theory.Apply to search and rescue technology that is extensive, high-level efficiency multiple robots not comprehensive, particularly the group behavior of search and rescue robot group controls deficienter.Arduino Uno R3 single-chip microcomputer, expansion board, circuit for controlling motor, positioning system, Zigbee module, infrared life detection module, the first direct supply and the second direct supply is provided with in car body of the present utility model; Circuit for controlling motor by the second DC power supply, and controls the running of four wheels by four reducing motors; Radio Network System Zigbee module builds autonomous network, and remote control equipment and multiple agent multiple robots are all by Zigbee module access of radio network system.The utility model substantially increases the automatism of search and rescue robot, concertedness and controllability, decreases the search and rescue time, meets extensive requirement of searching and rescuing.

title_en: Method for detecting vital signs in non-contact mode by terahertz waves
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting vital signs in a non-contact mode by terahertz waves. The method comprises the steps that a system for detecting the vital signs in the non-contact mode by the terahertz waves is arranged, a transmitting antenna and a receiving antenna of the system are arranged at the equidistant positions of a detected life body, and the detection signals of the detected life body are sampled; after time-frequency transformation is conducted on the sampled detection signals twice, the movement frequency signals, the respiration signals and the heartbeat signals of the detected life body are extracted after time weighting is conducted. According to the method for detecting the vital signs in the non-contact mode by the terahertz waves, the detection sensitivity is higher than that of microwave detection in the prior art, and meanwhile the vital sign data obtained by detection through the method are more precise and accurate. The method can be widely applied to the fields of medicine, rescuing, security and the like, for example, non-contact heartbeat monitoring, automatic personal health detection, chronic health condition diagnosis and even personnel searching in earthquakes or snow crashes can be achieved.

title_en: Earthquake help calling positioning watch
abstract_en: Provided is an earthquake help calling positioning watch which comprises a watchband, a watchcase and a watch surface which are connected in turn. The watch surface is provided with a time displayer and a liquid crystal screen. The internal part of the watch surface is provided with a battery and an integrated circuit board. The top part of the watchcase is provided with a GPS position indicator. The bottom part of the watchcase is provided with a loudspeaker and a switch. The right part of the watchcase is provided with a remote control receiving switch and a time adjusting button. The upper right part of the watchcase is provided with a microphone. The upper left part of the watchcase is provided with an LED help calling flashing lamp. The left part of the watchcase is provided with an infrared ray probe. The lower left part of the watchcase is provided with a microwave emitter. The lower right part of the watchcase is provided with an LED lighting lamp and a lighting button. The earthquake help calling positioning watch is worn on the hand at ordinary times without leaving the body. If the body is buried after earthquake or the switch is forgotten to start in panic, search and rescue personnel use a unified special remote controller to start the remote control receiving switch of the earthquake help calling positioning watch in a remote control way, and then the GPS position indicator, the microwave emitter, the LED help calling flashing lamp and the loudspeaker generate help calling signals so that the search and rescue personnel can easily find help calling people and perform lifesaving timely.

title_en: Wall parameter estimation method of through-wall imaging radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wall parameter estimation method of a through-wall imaging radar. The wall parameter estimation method includes steps of (1) estimating the variation range of the relative dielectric constant and the thickness of the wall, and selecting the minimum value as initial parameter value; (2) calculating the distance between the radar and the wall, and setting an imaging area behind the wall; (3) compensating the effect of the wall in imaging by parameters obtained in the step (1) to obtain aperture range data; (4) calculating GCF value of each imaging point along the aperture range data; (5) searching the maximum value of the GCF values of all imaging points as a target GCF value; (6) sequentially increasing the relative dielectric constant and the thickness of the wall sequentially and repeating the above steps to obtain a target GCF value for each pair of wall parameters; (7) searching the maximum value in all the target GCF values and using the corresponding wall parameters as estimation results. The wall parameter estimation method has the advantages that wall parameters are accurately estimated, the effects of the wall in the through-wall imaging can be effectively compensated, and focusing effect of target imaging is improved.

title_en: Method and Apparatus for Body State Recognition using the Impedance Charateristic Enhanced Electorde
title_ko: 임피던스가 향상된 전극을 이용한 생체 상황 인지 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Provided are a method and an apparatus to recognize biological conditions using an electrode having improved impedance. The biological condition recognizing apparatus according to an embodiment of the present invention includes an EEG sensor, an ECG sensor, an EEG signal processing unit, an ECG signal processing unit, and a processor which determines biological conditions based on EEG and ECG, wherein the electrode of the EEG sensor and the electrode of the ECG sensor are textile electrodes using conductive thread. Thereby an accurate biological signal can be sensed by overcoming high skin impedance using an electrode having improved impedance.
abstract_ko: 임피던스가 향상된 전극을 이용한 생체 상황 인지 방법 및 장치가 제공된다.  본 발명의 실시예에 따른 생체 상황 인지장치는, EEG 센서, ECG 센서, EEG 신호처리부, ECG 신호처리부 및 신호처리된 EEG와 ECG를 기반으로 생체 상황을 판단하는 프로세서를 포함하고, EEG 센서의 전극과 ECG 센서의 전극은 전도사를 이용한 직물 전극이다.  이에 의해, 임피던스가 향상된 전극을 이용하여 높은 피부 임피던스를 극복하여 정확한 생체 신호 센싱이 가능해진다.

title_en: Method and Apparatus for Body State Recognition using Various Bio-Signal Parameter
title_ko: 다양한 생체 신호의 파라미터를 이용한 생체 상황 인지 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Provided are a method and an apparatus to recognize biological conditions using parameters of various biological signals. The biological condition recognizing apparatus according to an embodiment of the present invention includes an ECG sensor, an ECG signal processing unit, and a processor which determines biological conditions by referring to the number of peaks of a signal-processed ECG and the maximum peak. Thereby the present invention is able to increase accuracy by determining biological conditions by considering both the peak number of an ECG and the maximum peak.
abstract_ko: 다양한 생체 신호의 파라미터를 이용한 생체 상황 인지 방법 및 장치가 제공된다.  본 발명의 실시예에 따른 생체 상황 인지장치는, ECG 센서, ECG 신호처리부 및 신호처리된 ECG의 피크 개수와 최대 피크를 참조하여 생체 상황을 판단하는 프로세서를 포함한다.  이에 의해, ECG의 피크 개수와 최대 피크를 모두 고려하여 생체 상황을 판단하므로, 그 정확도를 높일 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Moving target two-dimensional detecting and tracking method for ultra-wideband through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a moving target two-dimensional detecting and tracking method for ultra-wideband through-wall radar. According to the method, through echo data of a linear array sensor, an area to be measured is subjected to two-dimensional imaging by beam-forming, and the position of a target in an imaging result is extracted in the coordinate point form according to the concept of relative gray; a point trajectory output by an image detector is matched and correlated with an existing track; the existing track is managed and operated by track initiation, track maintaining, track deletion and the like; the existing stable track is subjected to KF (Kalman filtering) on the basis of IMM (interacting multiple model); optimal estimated values of two-dimensional parameters of all targets in the area to be measured are acquired; the moving targets behind an obstacle are subjected to two-dimensional detecting and tracking through the data of the linear array sensor of the ultra-wideband through-wall radar.

title_en: Apparatus and Method for measuring physiological signal
title_ko: 생체 신호를 측정하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: An apparatus for measuring a physiological signal includes a battery cover which covers a region to and from which a battery of a terminal device is attached and detached, a sensor unit which senses the physiological signal included in the battery cover, and a control unit which controls the sensor unit to sense the physiological signal. The apparatus for measuring the physiological signal is attached to and detached from the terminal device by attaching and detaching the battery cover to and from the terminal device.
abstract_ko: 생체 신호를 측정하기 위한 생체 신호 측정 장치에 있어서, 단말 장치의 배터리를 탈부착할 수 있는 영역을 커버하기 위한 배터리 커버; 배터리 커버에 포함된 생체 신호를 감지하는 센서부; 센서부가 생체 신호를 감지하도록 제어하는 제어부를 포함하고, 생체 신호 측정 장치는, 배터리 커버가 단말 장치와 탈부착됨으로써 단말 장치와 탈부착될 수 있는 것을 특징으로 하는 생체 신호 측정 장치가 개시된다.

title_en: Digital device and method for controlling the same
title_ko: 웨어러블 디바이스 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_en: A wearable device includes a bio signal sensor unit which senses a bio signal; a storage unit which stores data; and a processor which controls the bio signal sensor unit and the storage unit. The processor unit generates first reference data which includes the weight of the first reference object and the first bio signal in case of directing a first bio signal generated when a first reference object is held, generates measurement data which includes a second bio signal in case of directing the second bio signal generated when the measurement object is held, compares the measurement data with the first reference data, and obtains the weight of the measurement object.
abstract_ko: 웨어러블 디바이스에 있어서, 생체 신호를 센싱하는 생체 신호 센서 유닛; 데이터를 저장하는 스토리지 유닛; 및 상기 생체 신호 센서 유닛 및 상기 스토리지 유닛을 제어하는 프로세서; 를 포함하고, 상기 프로세서는, 제 1 레퍼런스 오브젝트가 홀딩됨에 따라 발생된 제 1 생체 신호를 디텍트한 경우, 상기 제 1 생체 신호 및 상기 제 1 레퍼런스 오브젝트의 무게를 포함하는 제 1 레퍼런스 데이터를 생성하고, 측정 오브젝트가 홀딩됨에 따라 발생된 제 2 생체 신호를 디텍트한 경우, 상기 제 2 생체 신호를 포함하는 측정 데이터를 생성하고, 상기 측정 데이터를 상기 제 1 레퍼런스 데이터와 비교하여, 상기 측정 오브젝트의 무게를 획득하는, 웨어러블 디바이스를 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Device and method for monitoring compressions at a cardiac massage
abstract_en:
The invention relates to a device for and method of monitoring compressions in a cardiac massage on a person in a medical emergency situation. The device is equipped with a flow tube ( 2, 202 ), which exhibits a continuous flow channel for air, with at least one flow sensor ( 10 ) for determining mass or volumetric flow arranged in the flow channel of the flow tube ( 2, 202 ), and/or with a vital signs sensor arranged on the flow tube, by means of which a proportion of oxygen and carbon dioxide can be determined, with a processor that produces a characteristic output signal for penetration depth from the mass or volumetric flow determined and/or from the proportion of oxygen or carbon dioxide detected, and 
     with an output device ( 124, 224 ) that issues the output signal.

title_en: Radar life detection system and method
abstract_en: A radar life detection system is composed of a radar acquisition and control processing module, a radar antenna unit module, and a radar power supply unit module. The radar acquisition and control processing module consists of a preprocessor and a signal processor, and processes received life signals. The radar life detection system is a system which is applied to coal mines or other dangerous places to sample and detect gases.

title_en: Mental load evaluation device and program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a device capable of estimating a mental load attributed to an operation of on-vehicle information equipment.SOLUTION: A respiration rate is derived based on respiratory data acquired from a respiration detection sensor (S330), and an SCL (skin conductance level) is derived based on skin conductance data acquired from a skin conductance detection sensor (S340). All respiration rates and SCLs associated with the corresponding time are acquired in an operation period (S370), and a representative value of the respiration rates in the period and a representative value of the SCLs in the period are calculated (S380). The sum of the representative value of the respiration rates in the period and the representative value of the SCLs in the period is calculated as an evaluation index (S390), and if the difference between the evaluation index and an evaluation criterion is equal to or greater than a specified value, a mental load attributed to an operation of on-vehicle information equipment is evaluated as being felt by a driver while an automobile is driven (S400).

title_en: Function Operating Method based on Biological Signals and Electronic Device supporting the same
title_ko: 생체 신호 기반 기능 운용 방법 및 이를 지원하는 전자 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a bio-signal-based function. The present invention may provide: a method for operating a bio-signal-based function; and configuration of an electronic device supporting the same. The method includes: a step of a first electronic device arranged on a wrist for collecting bio-signals according to a condition of bio-tissue by using an electromyogram sensor and a subsidiary sensor; and a step of outputting information, related to the collected bio-signals, on a first display module of the first electronic device. The present invention is not limited to the configuration described above but should be understood with various embodiments described in the detained description.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 생체 신호 기반 기능에 관한 것으로, 손목에 배치된 제1 전자 장치가 생체 조직의 상태에 따른 생체 신호를 근전도 센서 및 보조 센서를 이용하여 수집하는 과정, 수집된 생체 신호와 관련된 정보를 상기 제1 전자 장치의 제1 표시 모듈에 출력하는 과정을 포함하는 생체 신호 기반 전자 장치의 기능 운용 방법과 이를 지원하는 전자 장치의 구성을 개시할 수 있다. 여기서 본 발명이 상술한 구성에 한정되는 것은 아니며, 발명의 상세한 설명에 기재된 다양한 실시 예들로서 이해되어야 할 것이다.

title_en: Method for avoiding an accident or for mitigating the consequences of an accident
abstract_en: A method for avoiding accidents a biometric sensor system is used to ascertain vital signs of a vehicle occupant, and in the event that the vital signs lie outside a normal range, preparatory emergency measures are carried out in a safety system in the vehicle.

title_en: Device for measuring the infrared output of the Abreu brain thermal tunnel
abstract_en: A medical device for the measurement of brain temperature data through the Abreu brain thermal tunnel (ABTT) is described. Brain temperature measurement is the key and universal indicator of both disease and health equally, and is the only vital sign that cannot be artificially changed by emotional states. Currently, brain temperature is difficult to measure. However, the present disclosure describes a device that readily locates the Abreu brain thermal tunnel, and is configured to provide a non-contact temperature reading of the brain. Embodiments of the disclosed device enable an individual to measure their own temperature and enable medical professionals to measure the temperature of others.

title_en: Mm-wave radar vital signs detection apparatus and method of operation
abstract_en: The present invention discloses mm-wave radar sensor to be applied for detection of the vital signs of humans, particularly babies, as well as animals, in clinical and daily life environments. The key system relevant elements are the utilization of mm-wave integrated radar system, with specific planar high-gain antenna radiation pattern, with separate receive and transmit antennas, and detection of the following biomarkers: heartbeat and respiratory dynamics. The method of operation calculates the probability of a number of possible events. In case that probability is above a predefined threshold, the interaction with end user or end system is initiated, typically by using arbitrary wireless communication. Corresponding event related predefined actions are performed in that case. Preferably, the system is using 60 GHz integrated radar front end working in Doppler operation mode, with 4 x 4 TX and RX planar radiation elements, with physical size typically in the range 4 x 2 x 1 cm, or smaller.

title_en: Interface between vital-signs sensors and patient monitor
abstract_en: An apparatus includes at least one sensor, a connector and a conversion unit. The sensor is coupled to a patient body so as to measure a physiological parameter of the body. The connector coupled to a patient monitor, which measures a value of the physiological parameter by applying a test signal via the connector and measuring a response signal on the connector in response to the test signal. The conversion unit is coupled between the at least one sensor and the connector, and is configured to determine a corrected value of the physiological parameter, to calculate an auxiliary signal that, in combination with the test signal produced by the patient monitor, causes the response signal on the connector to represent the corrected value of the physiological parameter, and to generate and output the auxiliary signal to the connector so as to cause the patient monitor to measure the corrected value.

title_en: Hybrid fmcw-intererometry radar for positioning and monitoring and methods of using same
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system and method for a hybrid radar system that integrates frequency-modulated continuous wave (FMCW) mode and interferometry mode. The radar works as a time division system that continuously switches between the FMCW mode and interferometry mode. The FMCW mode is responsible for absolute range detection and the interferometry mode takes cares of the weak physiological movement monitoring. The respective accuracies in range detection and displacement measurement complements the advantages of the two radar modes, providing versatile performance. By steering the antenna beam, the proposed radar system becomes an ideal solution for indoor health care, human localization, and human-computer interaction. Objects or human targets with or without stationary clutters can be precisely located. At the same time, the targets' vital signs and gestures can be monitored.

title_en: Gravity elevator
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a gravity elevator that can be used in a nuclear power plant with safety system with fuse element , the buildings of the power plant subjected to contamination being buried below sea level and under borated water basins, and having a safety system free of electrical and electronic components to act in the event of possible accidents comprising, among others, means for flooding the buildings of the power plant with thermal fuses and gravity elevators for operator evacuation in the event of an emergency.
assignees: SERBEX TECNOLOGÍA Y VALORES S L

title_en: Wireless sensing network system and method for searching and rescuing trapped persons
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a wireless sensing network system and a method for searching and rescuing the trapped persons. The wireless sensing network system is composed of a physical sign data acquisition sensor node, a wireless positioning device based on an RSSI value, a Sink node and a terminal display device. The physical sign data acquisition sensor node processes the acquired physical sign data and then transmits the data to the Sink node by a multi-hop routing, the Sink node then sends the data to a system terminal via other basic supporting networks, at the same time, a wireless positioning system calculates the relative position of a to-be-positioned node according to the position of a reference positioning node of the wireless positioning system and transmits the coordinate information of the relative position to the Sink node via a wireless coordinator, and the Sink node calculates the absolute position of a mobile node by combining the relative coordinate with the absolute position of the reference positioning node, and transmits the absolute position of the mobile node to the mobile terminals of the rescue personnel, so that the rescue personnel can determine the concrete position of the buried life accurately and rapidly.

title_en: Wearable device having an attachable and detachable sensor for detecting a biological signal and method of controlling wearable device
title_ko: 생체 신호를 검출하는 센서를 착탈할 수 있는 웨어러블 디바이스 및 웨어러블 디바이스를 제어하는 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wearable device capable of easily attaching/detaching a sensor for detecting a biological signal, and a method for controlling the wearable device. The wearable device comprises: a wearing part configured to assist a user in wearing the wearable device on a body part of the user; a first interface part configured to receive a biological signal from a sensor installed in the wearable device; a control unit configured to generate biological information based on the received biological signal; and an output unit configured to output the generated biological information.

title_en: Intelligent robot for fire-extinguishing
title_ko: 소화용 지능형 로봇
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an intelligent robot for fire-extinguishing purposes to wirelessly inform a user or a fire station of a fire and to travel to a relevant indoor position on its own to promptly extinguish a fire in the initial stages. To achieve this, the intelligent robot for fire-extinguishing purposes includes: a body part (10) wherein a main wheel (11) is mounted on both sides and an auxiliary wheel (12) is mounted at the center on the front and rear sides; an insertion space part (16) arranged above the body part (10); a fire hydrant (40) inserted into the insertion space part (16) of the body part (10); a proximity sensor bar (20) joined to the front side of the body part (10) to avoid obstacles; an infrared sensor bar (30) joined to the front side of the body part (10) to sense a fire; and a control part (50) buried in the body part (10).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소화용 지능형 로봇에 관한 것으로, 특히 화재시 소방소 또는 사용자에게 무선으로 화재 사실을 알리고, 실내에서 자체적으로 해당 위치까지 자율 주행하여 화재를 신속하게 초기 진압할 수 있도록 한 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Remote controller for measuring bio-signal

abstract_en: A remote controller recognizes a user by using a user recognizing module on the remote controller. Disclosed is a method. According to whether a user is a member or not, a bio signal sensor on the remote controller measures the bio signal of the user. The data of the measured bio signal is transmitted to a display device.
abstract_ko: 원격 제어 장치(remote controller)가, 원격 제어 장치 상의 사용자 인식 모듈을 이용하여 사용자를 인식하고, 사용자가 등록된 사용자인지 여부에 대한 판단에 따라, 사용자의 생체 신호를 원격 제어 장치 상의 생체 신호 센서를 이용하여 측정하고, 측정된 생체 신호의 데이터를 표시 장치에게 전송하는, 방법이 개시된다.

title_en: Railway slope landslide information collection and early warning systems based on distributed fiber sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses railway slope landslide information collection and early warning systems based on distributed fiber sensing. The collection system comprises a linear continuous monitoring sequence and a control cabinet; the linear continuous monitoring sequence is composed of fiber sensor buried in the slope structure at one side of a railway in an M shape, and the slope condition can be comprehensively and effectively monitored without omission; and the control cabinet comprises an optical path module which can generate pumping laser pulses, a circuit module which controls the optical path, and a communication module which transmits data to a monitoring room. The system monitors deformation of the railway slope via the fiber sensors which are buried in the distributed manner, and transmits collected information to the control cabinet in real time via the wireless communication module; the system can effectively forecast slope landslide, and predict possible slope landslide according to trends of data; and the systems are characterized by high stability, high anti-interference capability and long signal transmission distance.
