title_en: Electronic apparatus and method for monitoring sleep
title_ko: 전자 장치 및 전자 장치에서 수면 모니터링 방법
abstract_en: According to various embodiments of the present invention, an electronic device includes: a motion sensor sensing the movement of the electronic device; a bio sensor sensing bio signals; and a processor calculating an intensity of the movement of the electronic device, determining whether a user wears the electronic device or not by activating the bio sensor if a change in the intensity of the movement during at least two sections corresponds to a preset pattern, and controlling to the electronic device to monitor a sleep when it is determined that the user wears the electronic device. Above and beyond these, various other embodiments are possible.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 다양한 실시 예들에 따르면 전자 장치에 있어서, 상기 전자 장치의 움직임을 감지하는 움직임 센서; 생체 신호를 감지하는 생체 센서; 및 미리 설정된 구간 별로 상기 움직임 센서 출력값과 미리 설정된 값을 비교하여 상기 전자 장치의 움직임 강도를 계산하고, 적어도 두 개 이상의 구간들 간의 움직임 강도의 변화가 미리 설정된 패턴에 대응되는 경우, 상기 생체 센서를 활성화시켜 상기 전자 장치의 착용 여부를 판단하여, 착용 상태이면 수면 모니터링을 수행하도록 제어하는 프로세서를 포함할 수 있으며, 이외에도 다양한 다른 실시 예들이 가능하다.

title_en: Multi-target tracking method after through-wall radar imaging
abstract_en: The present invention provides a multi-target tracking method after through-wall radar imaging, the rapid imaging can be achieved in a certain error, and a high quality imaging result can be obtained. According to the target targeting algorithm based on two-dimensional low-pass filtering and image etching, measurement position information and amplitude information can be effectively extracted, and finally a nearest area data association algorithm is used to carry out target tracking. At the same time, according to an interacting multiple model tracking algorithm, the high mobility of the target is fully considered, and the target tracking accuracy is high.

title_en: A wearable sensing device and a method of monitoring biological signal data/alerting emergencies by using thereof
title_ko: 웨어러블 센싱 디바이스 및 이를 이용한 생체 신호 데이터 모니터링/응급 상황 감지 방법
abstract_en: A wearable sensing device may comprise: a bio sensor sheet covering a part of a front chest and back chest around an axillar (armpit) as the center; and a biosensor control unit connected to the biosensor sheet and located at the bottom of the back chest. The bio sensor sheet is configured to measure one or more bio-signals among the electrocardiogram, the heart rate, the body temperature, the pulse, the electromyogram, the blood pressure, and the respiration volume. A wearable sensing device, and a bio-data management and emergency situation detection method using the same, according to the present invention, enable a small number of staffs to rapidly determine whether there is any problem in the health of invalids who are being cared for in a nursing/protective facility and whether an emergency situation occurs.
abstract_ko: 웨어러블 센싱 디바이스는 액와(겨드랑이)를 중심으로 흉부 정면의 일부와 흉부 배면의 일부를 덮는 바이오센서 시트, 및 바이오센서 시트에 접속되고 상기 흉부 배면의 하단에 위치한 바이오센서 제어부를 포함하고, 상기 바이오센서 시트는 심전도, 심박율, 체온, 맥박, 근전도, 혈압, 근전도, 및 호흡량 중 적어도 하나 이상의 생체 신호를 측정하도록 구성될 수 있다.  본 발명에 따른 웨어러블 센싱 디바이스 및 이를 이용한 생체 데이터 관리 및 응급 상황 감지 방법은 요양/보호 시설에 있는 보호대상약자들의 건강 이상 유무 및 응급 상황 발생 여부를 적은 인원으로 빠르게 판단할 수 있다.

title_en: Focusing delay calculation method for known multilayer non-uniform walls
abstract_en: The invented discloses a focusing delay calculation method for known multilayer non-uniform walls, belongs to the technical field of through-wall radar target imaging, and specially relates to through-wall radar multilayer non-uniform wall compensation. Firstly, a range profile, namely, echo information of a target, is acquired; secondly, a wall is subdivided into enough small layers, each small layer is uniform, and a propagation delay expression of electromagnetic waves from a transmitting antenna to a receiving antenna is written according to the law of refraction; thirdly, the angle of incidence is calculated according to the geometric relationship, and thus, the focusing delay is obtained; and finally, BP imaging is carried out. To sum up, by adopting the method, a wall of which the dielectric constant changes in the thickness direction of the wall can be compensated precisely, and the delay of electromagnetic waves in penetrating the wall can be calculated accurately.

title_en: A kind of Wearable air filtering purifier
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Wearable air filtering purifier, comprise main frame, USB discharge port, USB charge port, power supply and speed-regulating switch, power supply indicator, sensor signal interface, composite guide tracheae, respiration transducer and single-pass mouth mask; Described composite guide tracheae one end is inserted in main frame air outlet, and another end is connected with respiration transducer, and side, main frame bottom is provided with some air inlets; Described USB discharge port, USB charge port, power supply and speed-regulating switch, power supply indicator and sensor signal interface are successively set on main frame one side from the bottom to top, and are connected with the control circuit wire be arranged in main frame; It is in conjunction with breathing detection technology, air filtration technology and power management techniques, Miniaturization Design clarifier main frame and stealth composite guide tracheae and mouth mask or facial gas operated device, efficiently solve battery long continuation of the journey working time and air purifier at the volley or have the technical barrier used in wind environment.

title_en: Phase-locked tracking loop-based through-wall detection wall body suppression method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a phase-locked tracking loop-based through-wall detection wall body suppression method. The method includes the following steps that: 1) original echo signals received by a receiving antenna are multiplied by the sine and cosine of local carriers respectively which are generated by a PLL (phase locked loop) module, after the carriers are removed, the signals are divided into two paths of signals; 2) the two paths of signals are transmitted to a first DLL module together, and after the delay phase tau of an M sequence is calculated, the M sequence is outputted, and is multiplied by the cosine of the carriers outputted by the PLL module, so that direct wave signals can be obtained; 3) subtraction is performed on the received original signals and the direct wave signals, so that direct wave-free signals can be obtained; 4) processing modes from the step 1) and the step 3) are repeated through a plurality of DLL modules sequentially, and target echo information can be obtained finally, and the method terminates. The method of the invention has the advantages of proper signal to noise ratio and accurate target detection when being applied to through-the-wall radars.

title_en: Method for controlling an wearable device and the wearable device thereof
title_ko: 웨어러블 디바이스를 제어하는 방법 및 그 웨어러블 디바이스
abstract_en: Provided is a method for controlling a wearable device and a wearable device thereof. The method for controlling the wearable device includes the following steps: determining whether a sensor installed in the wearable device is activated or not; controlling an adherency control unit which enables to control the adherency between the sensor and a human body of a wearer based on an activation states of the sensor; and sensing a biological signal through the sensor.
abstract_ko: 웨어러블 디바이스(wearable device)를 제어하는 방법 및 그 웨어러블 디바이스가 제공된다. 웨어러블 디바이스를 제어하는 방법은, 웨어러블 디바이스에 구비된 센서의 활성화 여부를 판단하는 단계와, 센서의 활성화 여부에 기초하여 센서와 착용자의 신체 간의 밀착도를 조절할 수 있는 밀착도 조절부를 제어하는 단계 및 센서를 통해 생체 신호를 감지하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Noise filtering out method based on kurtosis coefficient
abstract_en: The invention relates to microwave imaging and ultra-wide-band wireless detection, in particular to a noise filtering out method based on a kurtosis coefficient. By the noise filtering out method based on the kurtosis coefficient, a buried object can be detected effectively, an objective response signal can be directly extracted from a signal containing objective information, and the shortcoming that an object cannot be detected due to over large noises in the objective signal is overcome. According to the noise filtering out method based on the kurtosis coefficient in the technical scheme, a transmitting antenna and a receiving antenna are arranged on the periphery of an organization to be measured, the transmitting antenna transmits signals, and the receiving antenna receives the signals. The noise filtering out method based on the kurtosis coefficient comprises the following steps of (1) performing ensemble empirical mode decomposition (EEMD) on signals obtained by the receiving antenna; (2) guiding in a coefficient of association; (3) finding out a plurality of maximum intrinsic mode functions of the coefficient of association; (4) calculating a kurtosis coefficient of the maximum intrinsic mode functions of the coefficient of association by using the kurtosis coefficient; and (5) obtaining an objective information image. The noise filtering out method is mainly used for microwave imaging.

title_en: Computerized method and system for global health, personal safety and emergency response
abstract_en: A computerized system and method for intuitively detecting a user's need for emergency help, preventive care and medical interventions and also for coordinating care for user's loved ones and pets when user experiences an emergency or has passed away. Detection is done via labs and life signs equipment and sensors, self-initiated request for monitoring or the system's periodically polling user through an alert, a telephone call, a notification, a text message or other appropriate means to find out if they are in danger. Polling and automated monitoring may also be triggered by real-time medical data electronically or wirelessly transmitted to the system. If user fails to respond, the system automatedly calls either user's contacts (by listed priority) to notify them of a potential emergency, or emergency responders directly depending on severity of the emergency and communicates to them critical information as well as a code to access user's medical record(s).

title_en: Mine emergency rescue command information generation and transmission system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine emergency rescue command information generation and transmission system and a method, wherein the mine emergency rescue command information generation and transmission system comprises a rescue scene subsystem, an underground command base subsystem, a ground command center, a remote command center subsystem and a mobile command center subsystem, and is characterized in that: in the rescue scene subsystem, a first wireless camera, a first wireless mobile phone, a first wireless environmental parameter sensor and a first wireless vital sign detector are in wireless communication with a wireless/wired converter through a first wireless base station, a second wireless base station, … or an nth wireless base station respectively; in the underground command base subsystem, a second wireless camera, a second wireless mobile phone, a second wireless environment parameter sensor and a second wireless vital sign detector are in wireless communication with the mining intrinsic safety computer respectively; the third wireless camera and the third wireless mobile phone are in wireless communication with the ground base station respectively; can be widely applied to the fields of coal mines, non-coal mines and the like.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Personal air breathing device with safety alarm function and worker management system
title_ko: 안전 경보 기능이 구비된 개인용 공기호흡기 및 이를 이용한 대원관리시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a personal air respirator having a safe alarming function, which is mounted on an air respirator to enable a user to easily confirm survival, disorder, and position of fire fighters during fire fighting (life saving), and to a worker management system using the same. The worker management system comprises: an air respirator including a respiration sensor for sensing respiration of a user, an air residual amount sensing unit for measuring the air amount stored in a high pressure container, a control unit for determining a state of a user according to a respiration sensed signal sensed through the respiration sensor, controlling display of the air residual amount according to the air residual amount sensed through the air residual amount sensing unit, and controlling a user state signal to be transmitted, and a wireless transmitter for transmitting the user state signal as a wireless signal according to control of the control unit; and a worker management device which receives and stores the user state signal transmitted from the wireless transmitter of the air respirator and displays the state of the user on a screen according to a request of an administrator.
abstract_ko: 공기호흡기에 장착되어 화재진압(인명구조)시 소방대원들의 생존 여부, 이상 여부 및 위치를 용이하게 확인할 수 있도록 한 안전 경보 기능이 구비된 개인용 공기호흡기 및 이를 이용한 대원관리시스템에 관한 것으로서, 사용자의 호흡을 감지하는 호흡 감지 센서, 고압용기에 저장된 공기량을 측정하는 공기 잔량 감지부, 상기 호흡 감지 센서에서 감지한 호흡 감지 신호에 따라 사용자의 상태를 판별하고, 상기 공기 잔량 감지부에서 감지한 공기 잔량에 따라 공기 잔량 표시를 제어하며, 사용자의 상태 신호를 전송토록 제어하는 제어부, 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 사용자의 상태 신호를 무선신호로 전송하는 무선 송신기를 포함하는 공기호흡기; 상기 공기호흡기의 무선 송신기에서 송출된 사용자의 상태신호를 수신하여 저장하고, 관리자의 요청에 따라 사용자의 상태를 화면에 표시해주는 대원관리장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Radar for detecting object under the ground and method for detecting the same
title_ko: 매설물 탐지 레이더 및 탐지 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a radar unit for detecting an object under the ground and a method for detecting the same, which minimizes the error rate in detecting an object buried under the ground. The radar unit of the embodiment of the present invention comprises: a transmission antenna for transmitting a detection signal to the ground surface; a plurality of receiving antennas for receiving reflected signals from an object buried under the ground by a detection signal; an environment analyzing unit for using the characteristics of each reflected signal received from the receiving antennas to identify the environmental characteristics where the detection of the object buried under the ground is conducted; and a signal processing control unit for processing the first reflected signal and second reflected signal according to the environmental characteristics to create a detection image.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 매설물 탐지 레이더 및 탐지 방법으로서, 지중에 매설된 매설물을 탐지하는데 있어서 오탐율을 최소화하는 매설물 탐지 레이더 및 탐지 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 실시 형태는 지표면에 탐지 신호를 송신하는 송신 안테나; 상기 탐지 신호에 의해 지중에 매설된 물체로부터 반사되는 반사 신호를 각각 수신하는 복수의 수신 안테나; 상기 복수의 수신 안테나로부터 수신하는 각각의 반사 신호의 특성을 이용하여, 매설물 탐지가 이루어지는 탐지 환경 특성을 파악하는 환경 분석부; 상기 탐지 환경 특성에 따라서 상기 제1반사 신호 및 제2반사 신호를 처리하여 탐지 영상을 생성하는 신호처리 제어부;를 포함한다.

title_en: Wireless underground miner positioning and construction area environment safety intelligent monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless underground miner positioning and construction area environment safety intelligent monitoring system. The system comprises a comprehensive processing server, a communication base station, an intelligent watch node, a positioning and monitoring node, a wind speed sensor node and a pressure sensor node. The comprehensive processing server can be in communication with the communication base station through connection of a cable. The communication base station is wirelessly connected with the intelligent watch node, the positioning and monitoring node, the wind speed sensor node and the pressure sensor node, and wireless mesh network communication is formed. According to the wireless underground miner positioning and construction area environment safety intelligent monitoring system, the positions of an underground miner can be positioned accurately, the vital signs of the miner and the safety information of the construction area environment of the miner can also be monitored, monitoring information can be transmitted to a ground monitoring center and the intelligent watch node on the hand of the underground miner in real time, operation and use are convenient, when the monitoring parameter exceeds the safety threshold value, the system can send out alarming information in time automatically, the positions of survived people can be determined after a mine disaster happens, the rescue efficiency can be improved, and the casualty loss can be reduced.

title_en: Case having individual a lie detector
title_ko: 거짓말 탐지기를 갖는 케이스
abstract_ko: 본 고안은 측정된 인간의 생체신호의 전류 변화량을 기반으로 거짓말 여부를 판별하는 거짓말 탐지기를 갖는 케이스에를 제공하기 위한 것으로서, 휴대폰이 장착되어 외부 충격으로부터 휴대폰을 보호하는 몸체부와, 센서부에 사용자의 손가락이 접촉되면, 생체신호를 감지하고 기존 생체신호와 비교하여 거짓말 여부를 판단하여 표시부에 거짓여부를 표시하는 거짓말 탐지부를 포함하여 구성되는데 있다.

title_en: Implantable cardioverter defibrillator designed for use in a magnetic resonance imaging environment
abstract_en: An implantable cardioverter defibrillator (ICD) includes a communication interface operable to receive a communication signal from an external programmer. With the ICD not being in the presence of an MRI field generated by an MRI scanner, a communication signal is sent precharging a high energy storage capacitor before the patient undergoes the MRI scan. The signal also switches the ICD into an MRI mode which turns off the ICD's sensing functions detecting a dangerous ventricular arrhythmia. An operator monitors the patient's vital signs with sensors connected to the patient. If the patient does require the defibrillation shock, the operator sends a second communication signal delivering the defibrillation shock from the precharged high energy storage capacitor of the ICD. The patient can then be removed from the MRI scanner and the RF and gradient fields of the MRI scanner turned off.

title_en: Multifunctional search and rescue detecting head used for disaster ruin crack search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention provides a multifunctional search and rescue detecting head used for disaster ruin crack search and rescue. The multifunctional search and rescue detecting head used for disaster ruin crack search and rescue comprises a detecting head housing, a search and rescue part mounting frame, an obstacle sensor, an attitude sensor, a human body infrared inductor, a video collector, a voice conversation device, life maintenance object conveying pipeline, a signal transmission cable and a switching port. The video collector comprises an image sensor, an LED light source, and a shooting control and image processing module. The voice conversation device comprises a miniature loudspeaker and a microphone. The miniature multifunctional detecting head with a plurality of built-in sensors can be used for the internal detection and the search and rescue work of ruin cracks, and especially, the detecting head is also provided with life detection, voice conversation and relief goods conveying functions when used for rescue.

title_en: measurement module for bio signal and healthcare underwear for bio signal monitoring
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정 모듈 및 생체 신호 모니터링을 위한 기능성 속옷
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a functional underwear and, more particularly, to the functional underwear which is configured to include an electrocardiogram sensor, a temperature sensor and a blood flow sensor and which includes a biosignal measuring module attached to an underwear to measure a biosignal of a wearer in real time. According to the biosignal measuring module and the functional underwear for monitoring a biosignal presented in the present invention, the functional underwear is configured to include an electrocardiogram sensor, a temperature sensor and a blood flow sensor and is provided with the biosignal measuring module which is attached to a specific region of an underwear and which is capable of measuring a biosignal of a functional underwear wearer in real time and thereby, it is easy to maintain the biosignal measuring module consistently by being secured to a human body and several types of measuring sensors are provided together therein and therefore, it is possible to obtain a variety of biosignals. In addition, according to the present invention, a removable storage module or a communications module is further added and thus, measurement information can be transferred to an external terminal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 기능성 속옷에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 심전도 센서, 온도 센서 및 혈류 센서를 포함하여 구성되고, 속옷에 부착되어 실시간으로 착용자의 생체 신호를 측정하는 생체 신호 측정 모듈을 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 생체 신호 측정 모듈 및 생체 신호 모니터링을 위한 기능성 속옷에 따르면, 심전도 센서, 온도 센서 및 혈류 센서를 포함하여 구성되어, 기능성 속옷 착용자의 생체 신호를 실시간으로 측정하는 생체 신호 측정 모듈을 속옷의 특정 부위에 구비시킴으로써, 신체에 지속적으로 고정 유지되는 것이 용이하고, 복수 종류의 측정 센서를 함께 구비하여 다양한 생체 신호 획득이 가능하다. 
또한, 본 발명에 따르면, 분리형 저장 모듈 또는 통신 모듈을 더 포함함으로써, 외부 단말기에 측정 정보를 전송할 수 있다.

title_en: System for monitoring living body signal
title_ko: 생체신호 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: A system for monitoring a biometric signal is disclosed. The system for monitoring a biometric signal according to the present invention is provided on a movable device in an indoor space, and comprises: a radar unit which uses an impulse radar to track a location of a monitoring target to determine a coordinate of the monitoring target, and gives directivity to the impulse radar according to the coordinate of the corresponding monitoring target to receive a biometric signal of the monitoring target; and a first control unit which refers to the coordinate of the monitoring target to move the movable device to a location for acquiring the biometric signal of the monitoring target, and determines the breathing rate and the heart rate from the biometric signal received by the radar unit to determine an emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 생체신호 모니터링 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 시스템은, 실내에서 이동가능한 장치에 제공되며, 임펄스 레이더를 이용하여 모니터링 대상의 위치를 추적하여, 모니터링 대상의 좌표를 결정하고, 해당 모니터링 대상의 좌표에 따라 임펄스 레이더에 지향성을 부여하여, 모니터링 대상의 생체신호를 수신하는 레이더부와, 모니터링 대상의 좌표를 참조로, 모니터링 대상의 생체신호를 획득하기 위한 위치로 상기 이동가능한 장치가 이동하도록 구동하고, 상기 레이더부가 수신한 생체신호로부터 호흡수 및 심박수를 결정하여, 응급상황을 판단하는 제1제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: The apparatus of human body antenna in mine detection
title_ko: 지뢰탐지용 휴먼바디 안테나장치
abstract_en: The present invention provides a human body antenna device (1) to detect a mine using an ultrahigh frequency RF beam by being installed in a human body to be detached, to solve a problem wherein many human resources and much time are wasted as an existing mine detecting device cannot distinguish a spot where mine detection was performed or a spot where the mine detection is not performed; to solve a problem in which a mine is not accurately detected when a user quickly moves a sensor head unit or moves the sensor head unit in an irregular speed; and to solve a problem of a mine detection error solved using a one-way ultrasonic waves sensing signal. The human body antenna device can be worn on a human body as a detachable type while the human wears a combat uniform such that the human body antenna device has excellent compatibility with an existing combat uniform. The human body antenna device distinguishes an ignition of the mine which is not a metal and a base metal of the mine and detects the mine. Also, the human antenna device detects the mine buried underground and on the ground in all directions (360°). The human body antenna device transmits ignition detection data to a combat command server in a remote place to share the data, and radiates a plurality of ultrahigh frequency RF beams to a front ground and a side ground in an antenna structure. The human body antenna device also performs pretreatment by an ignition pretreatment unit and detects a signal of a mine to which it is of high possibility, and an explosive based on the strength of a response signal of the ultrahigh frequency RF beam in accordance with a delay time by applying a property in which the strength of the signal received to the ultrahigh frequency RF beam through a nonlinear regressive model algorithm engine unit nonlinearly damps in accordance with the delay time. As such, the human body antenna device improves a mine detection accuracy by 90% or more than an existing invention.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에서는 종래의 지뢰탐지 장치가 지뢰탐지를 실시한 곳과 탐지를 실시하지 않은 지역을 구분할 수 없으므로, 많은 인력 및 시간이 낭비되는 문제점과, 사용자가 센서 헤드부를 일정한 속도로 움직이지 않거나 너무 빨리 움직이는 경우, 지뢰를 정확히 탐지하지 못하는 문제점, 단방향 초음파 센싱신호를 통한 지뢰탐지오류 문제점을 개선하고자, 신체에 탈부착식으로 설치되어 초고주파 RF빔을 통해 지뢰를 탐지하는 휴먼바디안테나장치(1)가 구성됨으로서, 전투복을 입은 상태에서 신체에 탈부착식으로 장착할 수 있어, 기존의 전투복과 호환성이 우수하고, 지뢰의 금속과 비금속이 아닌 지뢰의 기폭제를 식별하면서 지뢰를 탐지할 수 있으며, 지상 및 지하에 매설된 지뢰를 전방위(360°)로 탐지할 수 있고, 기폭제탐지데이터를 원격지 전투지휘서버로 전송시켜 데이터를 공유할 수 있으며, 플렉시블 루프방사형 안테나구조로 초고주파 RF 방사빔을 전방지면, 측방지면으로 복수개로 방사시키고, 기폭제전처리부를 통해 전처리시키며, 비선형 회귀모델알고리즘엔진부를 통해 초고주파 RF 방사빔에 수신되는 신호의 세기가 지연 시간에 따라 비선형적으로 감쇄하는 특성을 반영하여, 지연 시간에 따른 초고주파 RF 방사빔 응답신호의 세기를 기반으로 지뢰 및 폭약일 가능성이 높은 신호를 검출할 수 있어, 기존보다 지뢰탐지 정확률을 90% 향상시킬 수 있는 지뢰탐지용 휴먼바디안테나장치을 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다.

title_en: Firefighter vital sign monitoring and information synergy oriented portable device
abstract_en: The invention provides a firefighter vital sign monitoring and information synergy oriented portable device which comprises portable terminals, visual terminals and a server. Heart rate, respiration rate, temperature, gesture and acceleration sensors and Bluetooth modules are integrated with the portable terminals, and important physiological data of firefighters can be monitored by the sign sensors in real time. The visual terminals are provided with portable display screens of Android systems and can be in data connection with the portable terminals, information of signs, positions and the like can be displayed in real time, and position and state information of the firefighters and teammates can be queried in real time. The server is provided with interface programs and B/S (browser/server) architecture browser programs. Data transmitted by the visual terminals can be parsed by the interface programs and can be stored in local databases according to fixed formats. Interactive interfaces which can be updated in real time can be remotely provided by the B/S architecture browser programs for command staffs, and the sign and position information of the firefighters can be queried in real time. The firefighter vital sign monitoring and information synergy oriented portable device has the advantages that the multiple firefighters in fire scenes can be monitored in real time, and accordingly the safety can be effectively guaranteed.

title_en: A kind of imaging preprocess method of the through-wall radar extracted based on target trajectory
abstract_en: A kind of imaging preprocess method of the through-wall radar extracted based on target trajectory, belongs to through-wall radar technical field.The present invention determines wall position on the basis of front distance picture in offseting for target echo first, utilizes wall position to divide detection zone；Secondly, the Range Profile in continuous two cycles is offseted into processing, target information is highlighted；Then, in the detection zone of division of Range Profile after offseting, Cycle by Cycle carries out adaptive thresholding, distinguishes target and background and then finds target position and limit target trajectory width；Finally, the data of target trajectory institute overlay area are imaged, so that institute is into only containing target information in radar image.The present invention is configured based on MIMO and the echo data of through-wall radar is pre-processed, wall position is determined, detection zone is divided, and then extract target trajectory, imaging effect is significantly increased, suppresses the target extension caused by closing scene and multi-path jamming in radar image.

title_en: Continuous wave radar through-wall detection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a continuous wave radar through-wall detection system comprising a radar head device and a plurality of display devices. The system is characterized in that a millimeter-wave transceiver module, a transmitting antenna and a receiving antenna are arranged on the radar head device. The millimeter-wave transceiver module includes a transmitting part and a receiving part; the transmitting part contains a sweeping frequency source, a coupler, and a power amplifier, wherein the sweeping frequency source, the coupler, and the power amplifier are successively connected; and the receiving part includes a low-noise amplifier, an image rejection mixer, a band rejection filter, an intermediate-frequency matching filter and a hand-operated gain control circuit. And the display devices receive images and data from the radar head device by a wireless transmission module. According to the invention, because of multiple display devices, a target can be detected by the user at different positions. The detection radar with the millimeter-wave frequency-modulation continuous wave system can meet requirements of high-resolution imaging and target identification of through-wall detection; and a saturated phenomenon during short-distance target detection by the radar can be avoided.
assignees: WUHU HANGFEI SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Landslide pre-warning system used for detection of micro-vibration of mountain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide pre-warning system used for detection of micro-vibration of a mountain and belongs to the technical field of geological hazard prevention and control. The landslide pre-warning system comprises a metal tube buried in the mountain, wherein a plurality of vibration probes are mounted in the metal tube in the longitudinal direction at an interval of 0.5-1m; a vibrating sensor is placed on the surface of the mountain and electrically connected with the plurality of vibration probes. Prediction errors can be reduced, the pre-warning accuracy is improved, possible geological disaster can be predicted in advance, and sufficient time is provided for crowd evacuation and disaster elimination.
assignees: HONGDA GUOYUAN WUHU RESOURCES AND ENVIRONMENT MAN CO LTD

title_en: Efflux fan anti -drop early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an efflux fan anti -drop early warning device, including typhoon machine, the fan is fixed on the tunnel roof through a plurality of lifting ropes, it leads the chain still to be equipped with a safety between fan and the tunnel roof, lead safely that the chain is parallelly connected to have a force sensor, force sensor and control center signal connection. The upper end of leading safely the chain is connected with pre -buried iron or the anchor assembly on the tunnel roof, the lower extreme of leading safely the chain is connected with the rings at fan top, lead the focus of the extension line of chain through the fan safely. Adopted the utility model discloses an efflux fan anti -drop early warning device, through leading chain and force sensor with establishing a safety, when arbitrary lifting rope fracture, it can play the supplementary function to lead the chain safely, and the pulling force inductor is sent alarm signal by the pull back(PB) and gives control center simultaneously, and the messenger maintenance personal can judge rapidly that which typhoon machine has had the trouble to the on -call maintenance, the emergence of to prevent accidental accident.

title_en: A kind of method of through-wall radar to multiple mobile object real-time detection, separation
abstract_en: A kind of through-wall radar rejects complicated background signal to the method for multiple mobile object real-time detection, separation by a kind of Clutter suppression algorithm based on exponential smoothing filter, and the information of movement human target is retained more rapidly, exactly；By a kind of envelope detected algorithm based on Hilbert transform, so as to realize the crest that each moving target is placed in different envelopes；By a kind of based on the algorithm for being combined fixed threshold and adaptive threshold, so as to realize the separation of each moving target more quickly in different regions；The inventive method is simple, execution efficiency is high, it is adaptable to detection of the portable through-wall radar partition wall to human body target of doing more physical exercises, and is that through-wall radar is accurately positioned there is provided sound assurance to each moving target, can effectively improve the operating efficiency of through-wall radar.

title_en: Wearable sensor to monitor bio signal and method to monitor bio signal using wearable device
title_ko: 생체 신호를 모니터링하는 웨어러블 센서 및 웨어러블 장치를 이용하여 생체 신호를 모니터링하는 방법
abstract_en: Provided is a wearable device for monitoring a biometric signal of a user. According to an embodiment, the wearable device is formed of a wearable sensor and an interaction unit which are attached/detached to/from each other. When the wearable sensor is connected to the interaction unit each other, the wearable sensor can use resources of the interaction unit while receiving power from the interaction unit.
abstract_ko: 사용자의 생체 신호를 모니터링하는 웨어러블 장치가 제공된다.  일 실시예에 따르면, 웨어러블 장치는 서로 착탈 가능한 웨어러블 센서 및 인터랙션부로 구성되고, 웨어러블 센서 및 인터랙션부가 서로 연결되어 있는 경우 웨어러블 센서는 인터랙션부로부터 전력을 공급 받으면서 인터랙션부의 자원을 이용할 수 있다.

title_en: Processing system for online health care and medical service and method thereof
title_ko: 온라인을 통한 개인 건강관리와 의료서비스 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a personal health care and medical service system through online capable of efficiently caring health of a patient and a method thereof. The personal health care and medical service system through online comprises: a health sensor device (10) which stores and transmits measured patient data through a near field communication device; a telehealth hub (20) which transmits the patient data through wired and wireless communication network; and a central server (30) which finds condition and location information of the patient and transmits the information to each service through wired and wireless communication network; and a service server (40) which performs treatment according to the patient data.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 개인 의료센서장치(health sensor device)를 이용하여 온라인 상에서 환자에게 효율적인 건강관리와 의료서비스를 받을 수 있게 하고, 환자에게 위급상황이 발생되었을 때 소방관서 및 응급구조센터 등에 구조요청을 하며, 환자의 건강관리 상태에 따라 헬스케어, 요양시설 등과 연계하여 환자의 건강관리를 효율적으로 관리하도록 한 온라인을 통한 개인 건강관리와 의료서비스 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 
전술한, 본 발명의 특징은, 각 환자의 생체신호(심전계, 체온, 혈압, 혈당, 체중 등)를 측정하고, 측정한 환자데이터를 저장하고 이를 근거리 통신장치(블루투스, 와이파이, 지그비 등)를 통하여 전송하는 의료센서장치(health sensor device)(10)와, 근거리 통신장치를 통하여 각 의료센서장치(10)의 각 환자데이터를 전송 받아 저장하고, 각 환자데이터를 인터넷 등 유/무선통신을 통하여 전송하는 원격의료 허브(telehealth hub)(20)와, 인터넷 등 유/무선통신을 통하여 원격의료 허브(20)의 각 환자데이터를 전송 받아 저장하고, 각 환자데이터를 분석하고 판별하는 자체 진단 프로그램을 통하여 환자의 이상상태 및 위치정보를 파악하여 인터넷 등 유/무선통신을 통하여 각 서비스로 전송하는 중앙서버(30)와, 중앙서버(30)와 제휴를 관계를 맺고, 서로 인터넷 등 유/무선통신을 통하여 각 데이터를 전송하며 중앙서버(30)로부터 전송 받은 각 환자데이터의 상태에 따라 처치하는 서비스서버(40)로 구성됨을 특징으로 하는 온라인을 통한 개인 건강관리와 의료서비스 시스템에 의하여 달성될 수 있는 것이다.

title_en: Using environmental friendly materials so thick, Thermal and noncombustible fire door
title_ko: 친환경소재 이용한 방음, 단열, 불연성 방화문
abstract_en: The present invention provides a noncombustible fireproof door manufactured only using environmentally friendly materials such as earth, straw, sawdust, charcoal and corn to prevent the shortcoming and weakness of a traditional fireproof door, as described above. The present invention can reduce casualties and property damages in the case of a fire as the present invention is never burned by any strong fire. The present invention can be separated and recycled when discarded and the waste is separated without being incinerated or buried so that metallic materials can be returned to a steel mill and environmentally friendly materials can be returned to nature. Therefore, environmental problems together with global warming can be solved simultaneously. Also, once the noncombustible fireproof door is installed, soundproofing and insulation can also be provided in addition to fireproofing. Moreover, the present invention gives a large profit to industries and societies and will be greatly influential in preventing global warming and conserving nature as the present invention can give social and economic benefits to consumers owing to long life and environmental friendliness.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 위에서 서술한바와 같이 종래의 방화문의 단점과 취약점을 방지하고자 그야말로 친환경소재인 흙과 짚, 톱밥과 숯,옥수수를 100% 이용하여 불연성방화문을 만들어 졌기때문에 그 어떤 강력한 화재에도 전혀 불에 타지 않아 화재시 인명피해와 재산피해를 크게 줄일수 있으며 , 
폐기처리시 분리하여 다시 재활용할수도 있고, 폐기물이 소각되거나 매립되는 일이 없이 분리되어 금속자재는 제강소로 , 친환경소재들은 자연으로 다시 돌아갈수 있어 지구온난화와 함께 환경문제도 동시에 해결해줄수 있는 그야말로 일석오조의 금상첨화를 얻을수 있다. 
또한 방화뿐만 아니라 이 불연성방화문이 설치시공완료되면 방음과 단열 도 동시에 해결할수 있고 긴수명과 환경친화성을 띠어 소비자들에게 사회적, 경제적이익을 줄수있기때문에 나아가서는 산업과 사회에 막대한 이익을 가져오며 , 
지구온난화를 방지하고 환경을 보전하는데 크나큰 영향력을 발휘할것이다.

title_en: Measuring apparatus for velocity of rainfall and measuring method using the same
title_ko: 우수 침투속도 측정장치 및 이를 이용한 우수 침투속도 측정방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus (100) for measuring the infiltration velocity of rainwater comprising: a main body (110); a supporting part (120) extended toward the lower side of the main body (110) to be buried under the ground in order to fix the main body (110) to the predetermined position of the ground; a measuring part (130) mounted on the deep part of the main body (110); a first electric wire (11) and a second electric wire (21) whose one end is connected with the measuring part (130), and the other side is extended toward the lower side from the position at a distance toward a lateral side from the measuring part (130); and a first moisture sensor (10) connected with the first electric wire (11), and buried under the ground; and a second moisture sensor (20) connected with the second electric wire (21), and buried under the ground. The length of the first electric wire (11) and the second electric wire (21) is formed to be different from each other. Therefore, the buried depth of the first moisture sensor (10) and the second moisture sensor (20) is formed to be different from each other. The measuring part (130) is capable of measuring the rainwater filtration velocity by the time difference of a measured value of the first moisture sensor (10) and the second moisture sensor (20). Therefore, a landslide is efficiently predicted and prepared.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 본체(110); 상기 본체(110)를 지면의 일정 위치에 고정하기 위하여 지중에 매설되도록, 상기 본체(110)의 하측으로 연장형성된 지지부(120); 상기 본체(110)의 심부에 장착된 측정부(130); 일단이 상기 측정부(130)에 연결되고, 타단이 상기 측정부(130)로부터 측방으로 이격한 위치에서 하측으로 연장설치된 제1 전선(11) 및 제2 전선(21); 상기 제1 전선(11)에 연결됨과 아울러, 지중에 매설된 제1 수분센서(10); 상기 제2 전선(21)에 연결됨과 아울러, 지중에 매설된 제2 수분센서(20);를 포함하고, 상기 제1 전선(11)과 제2 전선(21)의 길이가 상호 다르게 형성되고, 이에 따라 상기 제1 수분센서(10)와 제2 수분센서(20)의 매설깊이가 상호 다르게 형성되며, 상기 측정부(130)는 상기 제1 수분센서(10)와 제2 수분센서(20)의 측정값의 시간차에 의해 우수 침투속도를 측정하는 것을 특징으로 하는 우수 침투속도 측정장치(100)를 제시함으로써, 산사태를 효율적으로 예측하고 대비할 수 있도록 한다.

title_en: Floating Dam and Controlling Method of Water Level using such Floating Dam
title_ko: 수위계측 센서에 의한 보 직하수위 측정을 이용한 부력식 가동보 구조물 및 이를 이용한 하천 저류수위조절 방법
abstract_en: Provided are a buoyancy-type movable weir structure and a method for controlling a water level of reserved river water using the same. The buoyancy-type movable weir structure blocks the flow of water and stores a considerable quantity of the water flowing down from the upper reaches of a river, as a main body of a weir rises by buoyancy and a weir part is exposed above the water in the case of an ordinary water level, In the case of a flood water level, the buoyancy-type movable weir structure introduces the water into the main body and causes the main body of the weir to sink and the weir part not to be exposed above the water, thereby allowing the flow of water to smoothly flow downstream. The present invention includes a buried container (20) and a movable weir (10) moving up and down by buoyancy, wherein the movable weir (10) includes a vertical body (16) and a lower body (17), and has an internal space (14). The buried container (20) includes a water level sensor (202) for measuring a water level of water directly under a weir, and a passage control valve (201). If a measured water level directly down the weir is less than a lower bound value, the passage control valve (201) is closed to elevate the movable weir (10) with the buoyancy of the water stored in the buried container (20) so that the vertical body (16) blocks the flow of water. If the measured water level directly down the weir is greater than an upper bound value, the internal space (14) of the movable weir (10) is filled with the water and the movable weir (10) descends. If the measured water level directly down the weir is less than the upper bound value, the movable weir (10) is elevated again.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 평수위의 경우에는, 보의 본체가 부력에 의해 상승하여 보 부분이 하상으로부터 돌출됨으로써 수류의 흐름을 막아 상류로부터 흘러오는 물의 상당량을 저류하게 되지만, 홍수위의 경우에는 보의 본체 내부로 물을 유입시켜 본체가 가라앉도록 하여 하상으로부터 보 부분이 하상으로부터 돌출되지 않도록 함으로써, 수류가 하류로 원활하게 흘러갈 수 있도록 하는 부력식 가동보 구조물에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에서는 매립함(20)과, 부력에 의해 승하강하는 가동보(10)를 포함하며; 가동보(10)는 연직체(16)와 하부체(17)로 이루어져 있으며; 가동보(10)에는 내부공간(14)이 존재하며; 매립함(20)에는 보 직하수위를 측정하는 수위계측 센서(202)와 통로제어밸브(201)가 구비되어 있고; 측정된 보 직하수위가 하한 값 미만이면 통로제어밸브(201)를 폐쇄하여 매립함(20)에 채워진 물의 부력으로 인하여 가동보(10)가 상승하여 연직체(16)가 물의 흐름을 막아 가두게 되고; 측정된 보 직하수위가 상한 값 이상이면 가동보(10)의 내부공간(14)에 물이 채워지면서 가동보(10)가 하강하고, 측정된 보 직하수위가 상한 값 미만이 되면 내부공간(14)의 물을 배수하여 가동보(10)가 다시 상승하는 구성을 구성을 가지는 것을 특징으로 하는 부력식 가동보 구조물과, 이를 이용하여 하천의 저류수위를 조절하는 방법이 제공된다.

title_en: Flight type radar life detector
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the electron equipment technical field, and discloses a flight type radar life detector comprising a control box, an operation page, a display, aircraft direction control handles, a human life information screen, an equipment cabin, an antenna, a rotor, a motor and an undercarriage; a flight type radar life detector control system comprises an LED light source, a power supply portion, a camera, a radar detection wave, a microphone, a noise reduction unit, a loudspeaker, a signal amplifier1, a signal acquisition portion, a filter signal sensor, a signal amplifier 2, a video reception end, a voice reception end and life characteristic information; the top of the control box is provided with the human life information screen; two sides of the control box are respectively provided with the aircraft direction control handle; one end of the control box is provided with the operation page and the display arranged on the top of the operation page; the bottom of the equipment cabin is provided with the undercarriage; the flight type radar life detector is strong in function, wide in life detection scope, thus greatly improving rescue strength.

title_en: Smart life radar detection method matching heartbeat features
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smart life radar detection method matching heartbeat features. The method comprises the following steps of sending an emission instruction, and emitting electromagnetic waves; receiving echo signals reflected from a life body; processing the echo signals to obtain detection signals; preprocessing the detection signals to obtain life signals including heartbeat signals; calculating position data and distance data of the life body according to the life signals; smartly analyzing and recognizing the heartbeat signals to obtain feature data of the life body; sending the position data and distance data of the life body and the feature data to a client terminal, and displaying the data to a user by the client terminal. The method can automatically analyze feature information of a detected life body, effectively sort life bodies, and more visually display features and states of life bodies behind a barrier block, so as to quickly sort rescue targets to provide reference to rescuers so the rescuers can firstly rescue targets in danger or special targets, valuable time can be saved for rescue.

title_en: Ground Penetrating Radar with Multiple Correlators
abstract_en: A subsurface detection system may be capable of sensing a buried feature and providing an estimate of the feature's depth. Such a subsurface detection system may comprise a signal generator transmitting at least one signal toward a buried feature and at least one signal along a plurality of various length paths. Each of a plurality of correlators may be associated with one of the various length paths and receive both a signal reflected by the feature and a signal transmitted along one of the various length paths. Each of the correlators may correspond to a distance to the buried feature. As the reflected signal reaches each correlator it may identify a time offset between the arrival of the reflected signal and the signal transmitted along one of the various length paths. By so doing, a distance to the buried feature may be estimated by detecting the correlator with the shortest time offset.

title_en: Animal Caloric Output Tracking Methods
abstract_en: A system and method for monitoring the health of an animal using multiple sensors is described. The wearable device may include one or more sensors whose resultant signal levels may be analyzed in the wearable device or uploaded to a data management server for additional analysis. One or more embodiments include variations of the sensor system to accommodate differences in animals, including tracking vital signs over a period of time and comparing recorded values with an individual or species-based trendline. A deviation from the trendline may be signaled by alerting a user associated with the device about the deviation.

title_en: Safety helmet
title_ko: 안전 헬멧
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety helmet, wherein the safety helmet, which is worn on a user in an industrial site or a disaster site, senses a working environment of the user and displays the environment to the user in real time, and when a danger is sensed, the safety helmet apprises the danger of an external administrator through intercommunication, thereby transmitting, to an external administrator, the location, environment, and health state of the user. In the present invention, provide is a safety helmet, which is worn to protect the head of a user in an industrial site or a disaster site, and comprises an air suction port formed in one surface of the front side and a transmissive goggle part at the front side facing both eyes of the user, wherein a first sensor module is installed inside the suction port of the safety helmet and senses the temperature, brightness, humidity, gas, and shock around the user to generate a sensing signal; a signal processing module and a control module are installed inside the rear side of the helmet, wherein the signal processing module receives a measurement signal sensed by the first sensor module, amplifies and filters the measurement signal, and then converts the measurement signal into digital data, and the control module receives the measurement data through the signal processing module, displays the measurement data based on previously stored data display algorithm and analysis algorithm, and controls alarm and display through comparative analysis; a display part is provided on the goggle part, wherein the display part displays the measurement data and analysis data of the surrounding environment, which are analyzed by the control module such that the user can see the measurement data and the analysis data; an alarm part (6) is installed outside of the helmet, wherein the alarm part receives signals from a controller (3) to apprise the signals of the user through voice; and a power unit, for supplying necessary power to the first sensor module, the control module, the display part, and the alarm part, is installed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 안전 헬멧으로서 산업현장이나 재해현장에서 작업자가 착용하는 안전 헬멧이 사용자가 작업하는 환경을 감지하면서 작업자에게 실시간으로 표시하며, 위험이 감지되었을 때 외부의 관리자에게 상호 통신하여 위험성을 전달하여 사용자의 위치, 환경, 건강상태 등을 실시간으로 전달하는 것으로, 산업현장이나 재해현장에서 작업자의 머리를 보호하도록 착용하면서 전측 일면에 공기 흡입구가 형성되며, 작업자의 양 눈에 대면하는 전측에 투시형 고글부가 구비되는 안전 헬멧에 있어서, 상기 안전 헬멧의 흡입구 내측에 구비되어 작업자의 주변의 온도, 조도, 습도, 가스(gas), 충격을 감지하여 센싱신호를 생성시키는 제1센서모듈이 설치되고, 상기 제1센서모듈에서 감지한 측정신호를 받아 증폭하고 필터링한 후 디지털 데이터로 변환하는 신호처리모듈과 상기 신호처리모듈을 통해 측정데이터를 입력받고, 측정된 데이터에 대해 미리 저장되어있는 데이터 표시 알고리즘과 분석 알고리즘에 의해 측정 데이터를 표시함과 아울러 비교분석에 의해 알람 및 표시를 제어하는 제어모듈이 상기 헬멧의 후측 내부에 설치되고, 상기 제어모듈에 분석된 주변 환경의 측정 데이터와 분석 데이터를 작업자가 볼 수 있도록 고글부에 마련된 표시부에 표시하고, 상기 제어부(3)로부터 신호를 수신하여 음성으로 알리는 알림부(6)가 헬멧 외측에 마련되고, 상기 제1센서모듈, 제어모듈, 표시부 및 알림부에 필요한 전원을 공급하는 전원부가 포함되는 안전 헬멧을 제공한다.

title_en: Patient head-mountable device having a vital sign camera for use in a medical scanning modality
abstract_en: A patient head-mountable device for use in a medical scanning modality, comprising a frame member adapted to the shape of a patient's head, at least one optical sensor that is temporarily fixedly attachable to the frame member; wherein the optical sensor is a vital sign camera configured for providing an output signal that is indicative of at least a first type of physiological parameter of the patient and serves as a basis for determining the at least first type of physiological parameter of the patient; wherein the patient head-mountable device includes a data acquisition and analysis unit that is configured to acquire output signals of the optical sensors temporarily fixedly attachable to the frame member and to analyze the acquired output signals by applying pre-determined criteria related to the output signals, and to provide a trigger output signal if one of the pre-determined criteria is fulfilled.

title_en: System of smart safeguard helmet for fireman and device thereof
title_ko: 소방관용 스마트 보호 헬멧 시스템 및 장치
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a smart protective helmet for firefighters includes: a display unit which scans an area around the helmet and outputs a signal applied from the outside as an image; an infrared ray sensing thermal image camera which reads infrared emitting values from every object around the helmet in order to reset an image of the front side of the helmet; and a radar scanning unit which scans the front area as moving in a predetermined space where the helmet is located based on a radar sensor in order to sense objects and generate a signal regarding the sensed objects; and a control unit which reads the infrared emitting values from the objects around the helmet by driving the infrared ray sensing thermal image camera when the front scan rate of the display unit is equal to or less than a first scan rate and drives the radar scanning unit to transmit the signal regarding the sensed objects to the display unit in order to provide the image around the helmet when the front scan rate of the display unit is less than or equal to a first emitting value. According to the present invention, location and moving situation of firefighters are provided to a fire station and other firefighters, and thus help firefighting and lifesaving.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시 예에 따른 소방관용 스마트 헬멧은 헬멧의 주변을 투시하고, 외부로부터 인가된 신호를 영상으로 출력하는 디스플레이부와, 상기 헬멧 주변의 모든 물체의 적외선 발산값을 읽어 상기 헬멧 전면의 영상을 재설정하는 적외선 센싱용 열상 카메라부와, 레이더 센서를 통하여 상기 헬멧이 위치하는 일정 공간에서 이동하면서 전방을 스캐닝하여 물체를 감지하고, 감지된 물체에 관한 신호를 발생하는 레이더 스캐닝부 및 상기 디스플레이부를 통한 전방의 투시율이 제1 투시율 이하일 경우, 상기 적외선 센싱용 열상 카메라부를 구동시켜 상기 헬멧 주변 물체의 적외선 발산값을 읽고, 제1 발산값 이하일 경우, 상기 레이더 스캐닝부를 구동시켜 이를 통해 감지된 물체에 관한 신호를 상기 디스플레이부로 전송하여 주변 영상을 제공하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Healthcare system of vehicle and method thereof
title_ko: 차량용 헬스케어 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a healthcare device for a vehicle, through which a driver can frequently check a health condition of the driver through self-diagnosis, and to a method thereof. The healthcare device comprises: a biosignal sensing unit sensing a biosignal of a driver by using multiple bio-information sensors installed in a driver seat of a vehicle and a device operated by the driver; and an audio/video device analyzing the biosignal of the driver, obtained from the biosignal sensing unit, with a pre-installed diagnosis application to diagnose a health condition of the driver, and audiovisually expressing a diagnosis result so that the driver recognizes the result. Therefore, the driver is able to conveniently confirm the health condition of the driver in real time.
abstract_ko: 차량에 설치된 헬스케어 장비를 통해서 운전자가 수시로 자가 진단을 통해 본인의 건강 상태를 확인할 수 있도록 한 차량용 헬스케어 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로서, 차량의 운전석 및 운전자가 운전 시 조작하는 장비에 장착된 복수의 생체정보센서를 이용하여 운전자의 생체신호를 감지하는 생체신호 감지수단; 및 상기 생체신호 감지수단에서 획득한 운전자의 생체신호를 미리 내장된 진단 애플리케이션으로 분석하여 운전자의 건강 상태를 진단하고, 그 진단 결과를 운전자가 인지할 수 있도록 시청각으로 표출해주는 오디오/비디오 장치로 차량용 헬스케어 장치를 구현함으로써, 운전자가 편리하게 실시간으로 자신의 건강 상태를 확인할 수 있게 된다.

The utility model discloses build control core to supporting environment detection sensor system and vital sign detection system have reduced the search and rescue time, have improved search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Moving multi-polarization multi-transmitter/receiver ground penetrating radar system and signal processing for buried target detection
abstract_en: A moving ground penetrating radar is comprised of multiple transmitters and receivers with multiple, e.g., Horizontal and Vertical, polarizations to detect buried targets with standoff capability. Novel signal and imaging techniques are used to form high quality radar imagery with low artifacts that are due to various sources of self-induced resonances, e.g., transmitter-receiver coupling, calibration errors, and motion errors in the multi transmitter/receiver channels of the radar system. The irradiated target area image is formed via exploiting both the spatial diversity of the physical multi-transmitter and multi-receiver array and synthetic aperture/array that is generated by the motion of the platform that carries the radar system. The images that are formed from the multiple polarizations are combined to remove surface targets/clutter and, thus, enhance signatures of buried targets.

title_en: Conflagration rescue intelligent robot

title_en: Post-disaster life tracking unmanned aerial vehicle system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster life tracking unmanned aerial vehicle system. The post-disaster life tracking unmanned aerial vehicle system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle system body, a control station system and a communication link system. The unmanned aerial vehicle system body comprises at least one unmanned aerial vehicle which obtains the position of the unmanned aerial vehicle in real time through a navigational satellite and flies in the sky above a post-disaster search-rescue region to collect an image, the spectrum and infrared rays of the ground in real time. In addition, the position, the image, the spectrum and the infrared rays are sent to a control station after being integrated, classified and analyzed. The control station system comprises at least one control station which is used for recognizing a vital sign signal according to the image, the spectrum and the infrared rays collected through the unmanned aerial vehicle and drawing a map presenting a life position in combination with the position. The communication link system is used for providing communication links between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the navigational satellite, between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the control station, and between the control station and a disaster relief command center. The post-disaster life tracking unmanned aerial vehicle system can overcome the influence of severe environment and collect data continuously, and has the advantages of being high in search-rescue efficiency and accurate in life locating.

title_en: Buried heat storage can
abstract_en: The present invention relates to heat energy technology apparatus field, more particularly to a kind of buried heat storage can, including top ends of cans (1), tank skin (2) and tank bottom (3), it is characterized in that, the top ends of cans (1) is provided with fused salt pumping hole (4), fused salt entrance (5), fused salt agitator mouth (6), electric heater mouth (7), liquid level gauge (8), thermometer (9), inspection manhole (10), heat-insulation layer A (11)；The inner side of the tank skin (2) sets electric heating layer (12) and temperature sensor (13), the outside of the tank skin (2) to be provided with heat-insulation layer B (14).The present invention is buried heat storage can, avoids heat-storing device from being placed in heat-energy losses excessive in atmospheric environment；Tank body can be made to be corroded from natural calamities such as dusts storm, extend the service life of heat storage can, reduce the cost and expense of replacing.

title_en: Method for measuring bio-signal and wearable electronic device
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정을 위한 방법 및 이를 위한 착용형 전자 장치
abstract_en: According to a variety of embodiments of the present invention, a wearable electronic device comprises: a first sensor configured to sense movement of the electronic device; a second sensor configured to sense a biological signal for a user wearing the electronic device; and a processor configured to compute a movement value of the electronic device by using the first sensor, configured to detect a resting state when the movement value lasts within a predetermined first threshold range during a first time period, and configured to form biological information of the user based on a biological signal measured after detection of the resting state. Other various embodiments are possible.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 다양한 실시예들에 따른 착용형 전자 장치에 있어서, 상기 전자 장치의 움직임을 감지하기 위한 제1 센서와, 상기 전자 장치의 착용자에 대한 생체 신호를 감지하기 위한 제2 센서와, 상기 제1 센서를 이용하여 상기 전자 장치의 움직임값을 산출하고, 상기 움직임값이 미리 정해진 제1임계 범위 이내로 제1 시간 구간 유지되는 안정화 시점을 결정하여, 상기 안정화 시점 이후에 측정되는 생체 신호에 근거하여 상기 착용자의 생체 정보를 구성하도록 제어하는 프로세서를 포함할 수 있으며, 이외에도 다양한 다른 실시예들이 가능하다.

title_en: Integrated terahertz sensor
title_ko: 통합 테라헤르츠 센서
abstract_ko: 시스템 및 방법은 전자기 스펙트럼의 테라헤르츠 영역에서 동작하는 통합 소형 센서를 제공할 수 있다.  통합 소형 센서는 원격 표적을 검출하고, 비접촉, 비외과적 방식으로 동작할 수 있다.  통합 소형 센서가 생체 신호의 장기간 기록이 필요한 생명 의학, 생리학 및 기타 환경에서 사용될 때, 도플러 레이더 기술, 흡수 분광학 등과 같은 다양한 신호 분석 기술이 사용될 수 있다.

title_en: Method of electronically mapping underground utility infrastructures from the surface
abstract_en: A non-invasive method of buried-utility-mapping includes using a long wavelength gradiometric ground penetrating radar to “see” patches of conductive material below ground and buried pipes and electrical conductors that are all constantly radio-illuminated by local AM radio broadcasts. The underground infrastructure of entire cities can be surveyed this way, point-by-point over time. A short wavelength part of the gradiometric ground penetrating radar operates shoulder-to-shoulder with the magnetic part and is able to improve shallow object resolution, map moisture build-ups under roads, and spot contaminated soils. Two gradiometric ground penetrating radar technologies, cameras, and navigation receivers can be mounted on city vehicles and a daily collection of their data batch transformed by digital processing algorithms into detailed and automatically updating false-color maps of the underground utilities of the whole city and other buried infrastructures.

title_en: Method and apparatus for non-contact fast vital sign acquisition based on radar signal
abstract_en: Various examples are provided for non-contact vital sign acquisition. Information can be provided regarding vibrations of a target using a radar signal such as, e.g., non-contact vital sign measurement. Examples include estimation of heart rate, change in heart rate, respiration rate, and/or change in respiration rate, for a human or other animal. Implementations can produce one or both rates of vibration and/or change in one or both rates of vibration for a target other than an animal or human experiencing two vibrations at the same time, such as a motor, a vehicle incorporating a motor, or another physical object. Some implementations can estimate the respiration movement in the radar baseband output signal. The estimated respiration signal can then be subtracted from radar signals in the time domain and, optionally, can be further enhanced using digital signal processing techniques, to produce an estimate of the heartbeat pulses.

title_en: Through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a through-wall radar. The through-wall radar is characterized by comprising a housing, one surface of the housing is an operation surface, and the operation surface is provided with a display screen and holding portions disposed at the two sides of the display screen; and the other surface of the housing is an attachment surface attached to a wall surface, a cross-shaped groove is formed in the attachment surface, and a radar emission surface is formed at the central portion of the cross-shaped groove. The through-wall radar provided by the invention is a high-tech reconnaissance device applying an ultra-wideband radar technology, can perform accurate detection and display on position information and a movement locus of personnel existing in a certain scope in front of the radar, and is applied to the military, anti-terrorism, rescue and special forces as a special tactical tool.

title_en: Post-earthquake life sign detection search-and-rescue method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a post-earthquake life sign detection search-and-rescue system. The post-earthquake life sign detection search-and-rescue system includes ZigBee node detection devices, ZigBee routers, a ZigBee coordinator, a server and mobile terminals; the ZigBee nodes build a network; the ZigBee nodes are provided with the node detection devices; the node detection devices transmit acquired data to the local server; the local server marks the geographical locations of the ZigBee node detection devices on a map; the mobile terminals visit the server; and the mobile terminals obtain the geographical locations of ZigBee node detection devices which display life signs. According to the post-earthquake life sign detection search-and-rescue system, the ZigBee ad-hoc network is adopted as a core; the ZigBee nodes are scattered in the air; life signs are detected through infrared thermal release human body detection sensors and audio signal detection sensors on the nodes. The post-earthquake life sign detection search-and-rescue system has the advantages of low cost and high detection efficiency, and can assist in saving precious rescue time.

title_en: Life detection radar-based multiple-detection point target searching and locating method
abstract_en: The invention provides a life detection radar-based multiple-detection point target searching and locating method. According to the life detection radar-based multiple-detection point target searching and locating method, a life detection radar is adopted to perform detection on a plurality of detection points; the position of a live body is solved based on multiple-detection point criterions; the position of the live body is determined repeatedly through adopting the K-nearest neighbor principle; and therefore, the locating accuracy and detection probability of the spatial position of the live body can be improved. The life detection radar-based multiple-detection point target searching and locating method has the advantages of large detection area, low hardware cost and easiness in implementation in practical application.

title_en: Detachable living body signal complex sensor and method for detecting information of the living body using the same
title_ko: 착탈 가능한 생체 신호 복합 센서 및 이를 이용한 생체 정보 검출 방법
abstract_en: A detachable biometric signal complex sensor has a circuit module for biometric signal sensing and signal processing with regard to a subject embedded therein. The detachable biometric signal complex sensor comprises: a clip type structure including a first plate and a second plate having one side thereof connected to the first plate to form a pair of claws; and a blood pressure sensor and a plurality of electrodes arranged on an external surface of the clip type structure.
abstract_ko: 착탈식 생체 신호 복합 센서는 피검체에 대한 생체 신호 센싱 및 신호 처리를 위한 회로 모듈이 내장된 것으로, 제 1 평판과, 상기 제 1 평판과 일측이 연결되어 한 쌍의 집게발 형태를 형성하는 제 2 평판을 포함하는 클립형 구조물; 상기 클립형 구조물의 외측면에 배치된 혈압 센서 및 복수의 전극;을 포함한다.

title_en: Neck-worn physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the sensor can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: A kind of life detection robotic equipment based on multi-sensor information
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of life detection robotic equipment based on multi-sensor information, the both sides of casing are symmetrically installed with walking mechanism unit, head unit is arranged on casing, with the rotary joint arm for realizing rotary freedom and on rotary joint arm, realize the pitching joint arm of pitch freedom, video load cell is arranged on pitching joint arm, rotated with pitching joint arm pitching and with rotary joint arm, and sound load cell, radar life detection load cell are separately mounted on rotary joint arm, rotated with rotary joint arm；Head unit, video load cell, sound load cell, radar life detection load cell are connected with the control unit in casing respectively, and control unit is connected by the wireless telecommunications on casing with fast leaflet member and rear console.The present invention can replace rescue personnel to enter ruins scene and perform search and rescue task, reduce rescue personnel's injures and deaths, significant to provide survivor's search efficiency.

title_en: MIMO through-wall radar based single-side double-point squint imaging method of building
abstract_en: The invention discloses an MIMO through-wall radar based single-side double-point squint imaging method of a building. An MIMO through-wall radar carries out real-aperture squint detection at two detection points selected in the single side of the building, and collected real aperture echoes of the two points from two squint images which include part corners of the building and static objects in the building via a backward projection imaging algorithm. Overlapped fusion and 2D constant false alarm detection are carried out on the two squint images, the integrity of all corner images of the building is ensured, the layout of all walls can be determined, corner image sidelobe and multipath phantom interference are inhibited, distribution of static objects therein can be determined, and a panorama image of the building including clear corner images and static object images is obtained finally. The corner image and the static object image can be used to determine the wall layer out and the static object distribution respectively, and imaging detection for the wall layout and the internal static objects of the building is realized.

title_en: MILITARY IoT WATCH AND PLATFORM CORRESPONDING TO THE SITUATION USING THE SAME AND METHOD THEREOF
title_ko: 군용 IoT 워치와 이를 이용한 상황 대응 플랫폼 및 그 방법
abstract_en: A military IoT watch, a platform which copes with a situation by using the same, and a method thereof are disclosed. The military IoT watch comprises: a main body configured to display a view and transmit a signal by wireless communication; a band unit coupled to the main body and worn on a wrist of a user; and a sensor unit configured to measure a biometric signal of the user and transmit a measurement result to the main body. When the measurement result exceeds a preset limit point, the main body reports the situation to a situation room.
abstract_ko: 군용 IoT 워치와 이를 이용한 상황 대응 플랫폼 및 그 방법이 개시된다. 군용 IoT 워치에 있어서, 시각을 디스플레이 하고, 무선통신으로 신호를 송출하는 본체; 상기 본체와 결합하여 사용자의 손목에 착용되는 밴드부; 및 상기 사용자의 생체 신호를 측정하여 상기 본체로 측정결과를 전송하는 센서부를 포함하고, 상기 본체는 상기 측정결과가 미리 정해진 한계점을 넘어서는 경우, 상황실에 보고할 수 있다.

title_en: Transmit-receive integrated ultra wide band flight radar timing sampling detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmit-receive integrated ultra wide band flight radar timing sampling detection method, and relates to the technical field of an aircraft and a life detection radar. A flight radar refers to an integral mechanical structure formed by carrying an ultra wide band life detection radar on a rotorcraft. The integrated ultra wide band radar is carried by the rotorcraft so as to perform low and medium-altitude flight and carries out life detection continuously on buried life in a flying process. In a detection process, a GPS positioning apparatus is used for positioning a three-dimensional coordinate position of the aircraft. Distance information between the three-dimensional coordinate position and a life object is continuously transmitted by the flight radar in the flying process, the data is stored in a database, and finally, according to the acquired life distance information and the three-dimensional coordinate position of the aircraft, after data processing is performed through three-sphere method, a real position of buried object life is obtained finally. The method provided by the invention can greatly reduce the workload of rescue personnel, shortens rescue time and improves the life rescue efficiency.

title_en: Air supply amount detecting device for air supplied respirator
title_ko: 송기 마스크용 공기 공급량 감지장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air supply amount sensor for an air supplied respirator, and more specifically, to an air supply amount sensor for an air supplied respirator, which is displayed to a sight glass of a respirator due to a change in air pressure when the amount of air supplied into the respirator is smaller than a predetermined standard amount. Accordingly, a worker is allowed to quickly recognize the shortage of air supply amount so great and small safety accidents caused by the shortage of air supply amount can be effectively prevented. According to the present invention, the air supply respirator consists of the respirator with the sight glass and a muffler which is mounted on the upper side of the respirator and has multiple air supply holes, and allows air received from the outside to be supplied into the respirator through the air supply holes. The air supply amount sensor for the air supplied respirator comprises: an air inflow pipe connected to one air supply hole among the multiple air supply holes and receiving air; and a movable member which is mounted on the inner side of the respirator to be connected to the air inflow pipe, senses the amount of air supplied through the air inflow pipe, and is displayed to the sight glass while moving due to a change in air pressure when the amount of supplied air is smaller than a predetermined supply amount, thereby visually notifying abnormal air supply.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 송기 마스크용 공기 공급량 감지장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 마스크의 내부로 공급되는 공기의 공급량이 기설정된 기준량보다 적을 때 공기의 압력변화에 의해 마스크의 투시창으로 표출됨에 따라 공기의 공급량이 부족한 상황을 작업자가 신속하게 인지하도록 함으로써 공기의 공급량 부족으로 인한 크고 작은 안전사고를 효과적으로 예방할 수 있는 송기 마스크용 공기 공급량 감지장치에 관한 것이다.  
이러한 본 발명은 투시창이 구비된 마스크와, 상기 마스크의 상측에 장착되고 복수 개의 송기공이 천공된 소음기로 구성되어 외부에서 제공되는 공기가 상기 송기공을 통해 상기 마스크의 내부로 공급되는 송기 마스크에 있어서, 상기 복수 개의 송기공 중 하나의 송기공에 연결되어 상기 공기가 유입되는 공기유입관; 및 상기 마스크의 내측에 설치되고 상기 공기유입관과 연결되어 상기 공기유입관을 통해 유입되는 공기의 공급량을 감지하여 기설정 공급량보다 적을 때 공기의 압력변화에 의해 유동하면서 상기 투시창으로 표출되어 공기의 공급이 원활하지 않은 상황을 시각적으로 알리는 유동부재;를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 송기 마스크용 공기 공급량 감지장치를 기술적 요지로 한다.

title_en: Onshore electromagnetic reservoir monitoring
abstract_en: Onshore electromagnetic (EM) reservoir monitoring systems and methods, including a system with a light source producing a light beam and an EM sensor array positioned above ground or buried underground over one or more regions of interest within a subterranean formation, the array coupled to the light source with an optical fiber. An EM sensor modulates the interrogation light beam in response to an EM signal induced into the subterranean formation by an EM source. The system further includes a processor controlling the light source, processing modulated light received from the array, and collecting data with the array to produce EM surveys, each EM survey based on data sets collected at different times. The EM sensor is physically isolated from a surrounding environment. The surveys are combined to produce a time lapse earth model of the regions of interest.

title_en: Devices and methods for noninvasive physiological analysis
title_ko: 비 침습 생체 신호 분석 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a physiological signal analysis device and method to detect physiological information of a subject. The physiological signal analysis device includes: a memory device configured to store a wrinkle pattern at a measurement position of the subject as a reference position; a measurement position sensor configured to periodically sense the reference position; and a physiological signal sensor configured to sense a physiological signal at the reference position if the stored reference position enters a range of the measurement position sensor; a signal processor configured to process signals of the measurement position sensor and the physiological signal sensor; and a display configured to display the physiological signal measured by the physiological signal sensor. The physiological signal analysis device of the present invention includes the measurement position sensor capable of sensing a measurement position to measure a physiological signal corresponding to a consistent measurement position, thereby performing a consistent and accurate analysis of health information.

title_en: Cardiopulmonary resuscitation guidance method, computer program product and system
abstract_en: A hands-free cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) guidance method (40) for a system including a head-mountable computing device (100) comprising a processor (110) and at least one display module (106, 106') arranged to be viewed by the wearer (20) of the head-mountable computing device when wearing the device is disclosed that allows a rescuer to receive CPR guidance without losing sight of the victim. The method comprises receiving (420), on said processor, a first signal conveying vital signs information from at least one sensor (200, 210) for monitoring vital signs of a patient (10), wherein a sensor (210) of the at least one sensor is integrated in the head-mountable computing device (100); processing said first signal on said processor to obtain the vital signs information; and displaying (422) CPR guidance on said at least one display module in response to the processed vital signs information. A computer program product and a CPR guidance system are also disclosed. The system may be created in situ using ubiquitous devices, e.g. smart devices including usable sensors, thus facilitating rapid response to an SCA event, which improves the chances of survival of a SCA victim.

title_en: Front and sides simultaneous monitoring type underground radar device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To perform realtime detection of an obstacle buried in the ground or an obstacle visually concealed by vegetation, debris, and the like in front and side directions of a moving body such as a vehicle.SOLUTION: A microwave underground radar loaded on a vehicle that travels on a ground surface is provided with: a radar part 1 that can simultaneously perform monitoring and detection of presence/absence of an obstacle such as a land mine buried under a ground surface and in the ground of a road in a front direction and in shoulder side directions through an image by irradiating the ground surface with a microwave via an array antenna while being loaded on the vehicle and travelling; and a radar calibration part 2 that enables an operator to design a nonplanar array antenna that can easily detect an object when desired front and side direction detection regions are designated, and to stop the vehicle in order to configure the designed array antenna, and calibrate each element antenna so as to have a correct position and a correct orientation direction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Thermal Storage Pipe Filled with Paraffin Phase Change Materials and Temperature Management Method Thereby
title_ko: 파라핀계 상변화 물질로 충진된 축열재 파이프 및 이를 이용한 온도유지 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method of preventing a road from being frozen. According to the present invention, a pore of one or more porous particles selected from the group consisting of zeolite, perlite, or graphite is filled with a paraffin-based phase change material (PCM), and a heat storage material pipe filled with a heat resistant heat storage material, in which an outer surface of a porous particle filled with the phase change material is coated with one or more coating agents selected from the group consisting of a silica solidifier, cement, silica, a plaster, or loess, is buried below a sidewalk, a parking lot, or a mountain trail consisting of asphalt, cement, or loess. The present invention relates to a method for insulating a greenhouse by installing a heat storage material pipe filled with a heat resistant heat storage material below the greenhouse. In addition, the present invention relates to a cooling and heating system using a heat storage material, comprising: a heat circulation pipe for transferring heat from the heat storage material pipe; and a heat pump which is a heat exchanger connected to the heat circulation pipe.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 파라핀계 상변화물질(PCM)이 제올라이트(Zeolite), 퍼라이트(Perlite) 또는 흑연(graphite)로 구성되는 군에서 선택되는 하나 이상의 다공성 입자의 세공경(pore)에 충진되고, 상기 상변화물질이 충진된 다공성 입자의 외부 표면이 실리카 고화재, 시멘트, 규사, 석고 또는 황토로 구성되는 군에서 선택되는 하나 이상의 코팅재로 코팅된 내열성 축열재가 충진된 축열재 파이프를 아스팔트, 시멘트 또는 황토로 이루어진 인도, 주차장 또는 등산로의 하부에 매설하는 도로의 결빙 방지 방법, 내열성 축열재가 충진된 축열재 파이프를 비닐하우스의 하부에 설치하여 비닐하우스를 보온하는 방법 및 상기 축열재 파이프로 부터 열을 전달할 수 있는 열순환 파이프; 및 상기 열순환 파이프와 연결되는 열교환기인 히트펌프;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 축열재를 이용한 냉난방 시스템에 관한 것이다.
