title_en: Sensor module for biological signal detection using conductive wire
title_ko: 전도성 실을 이용한 생체신호 감지용 센서모듈
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a method capable of reducing a manufacturing processes and of improving productivity by utilizing an electrode as an electrode of a bio-signal sensing device and by simplifying a construction of the electrode and an electrical connection structure. The present invention discloses the sensor module to detect a bio-signal by using a conductive-wire as an electrode. The sensor module to detect the bio-signal according to the present invention comprises: an array electrode including a plurality of electrode patterns formed on both surfaces of a nonconductive basic material by using the conductive wire; a substrate including a plurality of connecting terminals corresponding to the plurality of electrode patterns and a plurality of wire patterns individually connected to the plurality of connecting terminals; and a fixing means to fixate the substrate on the array electrode to always connect the plurality of electrode patterns to the plurality of connecting terminals. According to the present invention, the sensor module may give smooth and comfortable wearing sensation to a user by utilizing the conductive wire as the electrode to detect the bio-signal and more accurately detect a bio-signal by obtaining an enough connecting surface when the flection is existed on a skin contact surface. In addition, the method may simply form an array electrode by using the conductive wire in the non-conductive base material and may remarkably improve the productivity of the array electrode with a simple electric connecting configuration. In addition, the electrode pattern formed by the conductive wire provides a flexible skin contact surface, minimizes the electrode pattern, and compactly forms the sensor module.
abstract_ko:

본 발명에 따르면 전도성 실을 생체신호 감지용 전극으로 활용하므로 사용자에게 부드럽고 편안한 착용감을 줄 수 있고 피부접촉면에 굴곡이 있는 경우에도 충분한 접촉면을 확보함으로써 보다 정확한 생체신호를 검출할 수 있다. 또한 비전도성 모재에 전도성 실을 이용하여 간편하게 어레이 전극을 구성할 수 있고, 전기적 연결 구성이 매우 간단하므로 어레이 전극의 생산성을 크게 향상시킬 수 있다. 또한 전도성 실로 이루어진 전극패턴은 유연한 피부접촉면을 제공하고 전극패턴의 소형화가 가능하므로 센서모듈을 컴팩트하게 제조하는 것이 가능해진다.

title_en: Airborne systems and detection methods localisation and production of images of buried objects and characterisation of the composition of the subsurface
abstract_en:
Airborne systems and methods for the detection, location and obtaining of images of buried objects and for the characterization of the composition of the subsoil. The systems comprise at least one aerial module (1) with a radar unit (11) that emits and / or captures radar signals and a positioning and guidance system (13) with an accuracy equal to or less than 3 cm, and a ground station (2) with a flight control system (21) and a radar signal processing unit (23) where radar signal processing algorithms (25) are applied. The invention also comprises a method for the detection, localization and obtaining of images of buried objects and a method for the characterization of the composition of the subsoil. 
     Applicable in sectors where it is necessary to perform the detection of buried objects, as for example in civil applications (detection of antipersonnel mines), pipeline inspection or in archaeology.

title_en: Behind-wall human body target self-adaptive indication method of through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a behind-wall human body target self-adaptive indication method of a through-wall radar. According to the invention, for the background of each data point of echo signals, the historical pulse data of the optical length is selected for estimation, and the SCR of each data point after clutter inhibition reach the maximum, so that the problem of a routine behind-wall human body target indication method fails to be adapted to targets different in moving types is successfully solved, and the adaptation of the through-wall radar to the human body target different in moving types is improved; in addition, the method is low in calculation amount, high in execution efficiency, suitable for the detection of the human body target different in moving types by the through-wall radar, and capable of effectively improving the working efficiency of the through-wall radar.

title_en: Radar type remote vital sign monitoring system based on self-rotating microwave detector
abstract_en: The invention relates to vital sign monitoring systems in the fields of medical diagnosis and health supervision, in particular to a radar type remote vital sign monitoring system based on a self-rotating microwave detector. The radar type remote vital sign monitoring system solves the problems that an existing vital sign monitoring system is restricted in application range, can not achieve remote monitoring and is low in monitoring sensitivity. The radar type remote vital sign monitoring system based on the self-rotating microwave detector comprises a life detection instrument, a network communicating device and a monitoring device. The life detection instrument comprises a first signal generator, a power divider, a transmitting antenna, the self-rotating microwave detector, a voltage control phase shifter, a second signal generator, a bias device, a lock phase amplifier and a data acquisition card. The monitoring device comprises a single-chip microcomputer, an audible and visual alarm and an LED display screen. The system is applicable to the fields of medical diagnosis and health supervision.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for measuring a pulse wave, skin resistance, and respiration. The device comprises: a grip-skin current measurement piece (80) configured to measure skin resistance of a person to be measured; a probe-skin current measurement piece (90) having a rod shape; a wrist pulse wave detecting sensor (100) having a clip shape; an index finger pulse wave detecting sensor (110) including a light emitting element and a light receiving element; a respiration detecting pad (120) including an air pressure pad; a main body (1) including a control unit (130), a capacitance touch input unit (30), a display unit (20), and a USB interface (140); and a personal computer (150) including an integrated control unit (160). Therefore, the device enables a user to simply obtain basic medical information.

title_en: Removable underground exploration radar device using the properties of the mediators
title_ko: 매개물질의 물성을 이용한 착탈식 지하 레이다 탐사장치
abstract_en: The removable radar underground exploration device comprises: a detector which detects an underground cavity or an underground buried object by transmitting and receiving signals to and from an earth surface while mitigating a property difference at the earth surface by using a mediator; and a transfer unit which provides a driving force and moves the detector along the earth surface, wherein the detector is mounted at a lower portion of the transfer unit; and a coupling member which couples the detector with the transfer unit such that they can be separated from each other. Since the detector can be removably mounted on a vehicle or a cart by way of the coupling member, it is easy to carry and transfer the detector. Also, since the detector is manufactured in a caterpillar type and a detecting sensor is installed inside a caterpillar, it is possible to bring the detecting sensor to be close to an uneven earth surface, which results in a stable exploration. Furthermore, it is possible to protect the detecting sensor and prevent transmission and reception signals from being scattered by mitigating a property difference at the earth surface by forming the caterpillar of a matching member such as rubber, etc., which increases an exploration depth.

title_en: Patient-worn sensor assembly
abstract_en: A patient-worn sensor assembly for detecting, recording and communicating patient vital signs includes several structural features that can provide improved signal quality, reduced signal noise, improved patient comfort, improved reliability, and improved adhesion to the patient's skin. The patient-worn sensor is capable of tracking vital sign information such as blood pressure, body temperature, respiratory rate, blood oxygen saturation, heart rate (via ECG), heart rate, blood glucose level, and hydration (bio-impedance) level. The sensors are also capable of tracking and recording other information about the patient, including patient motion, activity, and sleep patterns.

title_en: Device for Sensing Crack of Concrete Structure

abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus to sense a crack of a concrete structure which uses a same cement as the concrete structure as a basic material; and is able to monitor a position and a depth of a generated crack by burying a burial type sensor having an electroconductive network in the reinforced concrete structure. According to the present invention, the apparatus to sense the crack of the concrete structure comprises: a crack sensing sensor which has electroconductivity by being made by mixing a carbon type filling material and a super flowing material into a cement basic material, and is buried in the concrete structure; an electrode installed in both ends of the crack sensing sensor; and a monitoring part which senses the crack by measuring a resistance by applying electricity through an electric wire connected to the electrode.

title_en: Apparatus and method for decision of psychological state using bio signals

abstract_en: An apparatus for determining a psychological state according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a bio-signal acquisition unit for acquiring a first bio-signal and a second bio-signal of a user generated by a first stimulus; and a psychological state determination unit for extracting a first feature and a second feature by analyzing the first bio-signal and the second bio-signal and determining the psychological state of the user based on the first feature and the second feature. The first bio-signal and the second bio-signal are bio-signals indicating changes in autonomic nerves measured by different bio-sensors. For example, the first bio-signal is a PPG signal measured by a pulse wave sensor, and the second bio-signal is a GSR signal measured by a skin conductivity sensor. The apparatus of the present invention can accurately determine the psychological state of the user by using the bio-signals.

title_en: Device for carrying out early warning on geological disasters by applying sensors and wireless network
abstract_en: The invention provides a device for carrying out early warning on geological disasters by applying sensors and a wireless network, and belongs to the fields of sensors, electronics and wireless communication. The device comprises sensor modules, a wireless transmitting module, a wireless receiving module, a signal processing module and an information publishing module, wherein the sensor modules are arranged in places such as a detected mountain, a steep slope and a dam where the disasters occur easily, and the wireless receiving module is installed at an information center. Natural disasters such as heavy rain, flood and small variations in geological structure cause mountain slope or landslide, and thus severe threats are imposed on the public property and the life and property of people. The device provided by the invention aims to prevent the disasters timely. A stress sensor is buried in the detected mountain or the steep slope, once the stress change exceeds a certain limit, a network alarm can inform a command monitoring center through a 3G wireless network, and passing vehicles, pedestrians, and surrounding residents and organizations can be informed to take preventive measures quickly.

title_en: Automatic portable clinometer
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic portable clinometer. The automatic portable clinometer is characterized by comprising a sensor probe, a cable, a positioning hole cover, a wire spool and an equipment terminal, wherein the sensor probe is connected with one end of the cable and the other end of the cable is connected with the wire spool; the positioning hole cover is arranged at the upper end part of the clinometer and is used for positioning the cable; the clinometer adopts a brand-new data acquisition manner and measurement software so that the function is more intelligent and complete, and automatic measurement of inclined deformation of a pre-buried clinometer pipe is realized; and meanwhile, the novel cable and the positioning hole cover are introduced so that the labor intensity of workers is alleviated, the measurement precision is improved and the automatic portable clinometer can be widely applied to monitoring of deformation of a slippage surface in a soil body of landslides, embanks, water dams and deep pits and at the periphery of a tunnel.
assignees: NANJING NARI GROUP CORP;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Method of suppressing timing jitter in ultra-wideband through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method of suppressing timing jitter in an ultra-wideband through-wall radar, comprising the following steps: collecting multiple groups of echo receiving signals, performing Fourier transform in range dimension on the signals to get corresponding frequency domain data; calculating the modulus value of the frequency domain data, performing Fourier transform in speed dimension on the calculated modulus value, and solving the modulus value of the transformed frequency domain data again; coherently integrating the solved modulus value according to the range dimension; carrying out adaptive threshold processing and target feature extraction based on distance unit on the coherently-integrated data; and positioning the coordinate of a target location using an elliptical positioning method, and displaying the target location. Through the method, dynamic clutter caused by timing jitter can be suppressed effectively, the signal-to-noise ratio of signals can be improved, the complexity of target detection can be reduced, and the probability of false alarm can be reduced.
assignees: SHANDONG ACAD OF SCIENCES INST OF AUTOMATION

title_en: The one-dimensional radar that system is monitored based on non-contact vital sign is structured the formation optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of one-dimensional radars monitoring system based on non-contact vital sign to structure the formation optimization method, and steps are as follows：Under conditions of considering cardiac dimensions, according to radar system carrier frequency, the aperture of array and the number of array element are determined, sliding-model control is carried out to radar one-dimensional array aperture and discrete aperture topology is indicated using the binary vector of Problem with Some Constrained Conditions；MIMO radar directional diagram formula is substituted into obtained binary vector to establish the one-to-one relationship with directional diagram, its corresponding peak sidelobe PSL can be solved by directional diagram, to which PSL to be expressed as to the function of topological structure binary vector, corresponding binary system optimization problem is established；Array topology after optimization is determined using intelligent optimization algorithm, obtains corresponding optimal PSL directional diagrams.The present invention can effectively reduce the PSL that non-contact vital sign monitors radar by intelligent optimization algorithm, structure the formation optimization design to realize that non-contact vital sign monitors the one-dimensional radar of system.

title_en: Method and device for detecting buried metal using synchronous detection method
abstract_en: To provide a method and device for detecting buried metal, whereby it is possible to radio (wirelessly) transmit a synchronizing signal, and, when the frequency band of the transmission signal is restricted, to problem synchronous detection using a reference signal having a frequency equal to or greater than the frequency band. A method for detecting buried metal using synchronous detection method having a transmitting side device that transmits a transmitting signal (alternating current) to a buried metal for detection and transmits a synchronizing signal for synchronous detection, and a receiving side device for measuring the position and burial depth of the buried metal by detecting a magnetic field generated by the transmitting signal flowing in the buried metal with a magnetic sensor and processing amplitude and phase of the magnetic field, the method including: generating a standard signal of frequency f in the transmitting side device, and n dividing this standard signal to convert it to a transmitting signal of frequency f/n, transmitting this transmitting signal to the buried metal, m dividing the standard signal to convert it to a synchronizing signal of frequency f/m, transmitting this synchronizing signal from the transmitting side device by radio. Receiving the synchronizing signal by the receiving side device, m multiplying this received synchronizing signal to convert it to the standard signal. N dividing this converted standard signal to convert it to a reference signal of frequency f/n. Detecting a magnetic field generated by the transmitting signal flowing in the buried metal and synchronously detecting with the reference signal.

title_en: Receive low -to -medium altitude ultra wide band flight radar for one
abstract_en: Receive low -to -medium altitude ultra wide band flight radar for one relates to life detection radar and rotor craft technical field. Overall structure divide into two parts, and the first portion is for carrying on one aircraft of receiving integral type ultra wide band radar, and another part is for cooperating of aircraft lift -launch to receive integral type ultra wide band radar, the aircraft is four and revolves wing structure, aircraft fixed connection's bilayer structure, and the center of aircraft is the spider, is equipped with four wings on the spider, the lower floor surface of spider is for being equipped with the support, and one receipts integral type ultra wide band radar passes through the support and fixes the lower surface in spider lower floor, and the last fixed surface on the upper strata of spider has GPS positioner, and the higher authority on the upper strata of spider still is equipped with a cover layer, covers GPS positioner, the propeller is installed respectively to the tip upper surface of four wings. Use the utility model discloses a receive low -to -medium altitude ultra wide band flight radar for one can strengthen big quickening disaster relief speed, reduces the rescue degree of difficulty and danger simultaneously.

title_en: Device and method for bio-signal measurement
title_ko: 생체신호 측정장치 및 이를 이용한 생체신호 측정방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a bio-signal measuring device using glasses. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the bio-signal measuring device comprises: at least one mounting unit which can be mounted in glasses; a sensor unit including a bio-signal sensor unit which measures a bio-signal of a user wearing the glasses; a signal processing unit configured to convert at least the bio-signal to output the bio-information; and a communication unit configured to transmit the bio-information to the outside. Therefore, the bio-signal measuring device is conveniently mounted in various types of glasses to be universally used.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 안경을 이용한 생체신호 측정장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 실시예에 의한 생체신호 측정장치는 안경에 장착될 수 있는 하나 이상의 장착부를 포함하며, 상기 안경을 착용한 사용자의 생체신호를 측정하는 생체신호 센서부를 포함한 센서부와, 적어도 상기 생체신호를 변환하여 생체정보를 출력하는 신호 처리부와, 상기 생체정보를 외부로 전송하는 통신부를 포함한다.

title_en: A kind of more people based on variation mode decomposition time-varying breath signal detection method through walls
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of more people time-varying breath signal detection methods through walls for being based on variation mode decomposition (VMD), steps are as follows: ultra wide band transmitting antenna emits the vibration that burst pulse passes through torso model micro-doppler, echo is received by receiving antenna, and ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR echo samples to obtain human body echo-signal matrix through walls when passing through slow；The variance of each range gate is calculated by range gate selection algorithm, and finds out range gate existing for the maximum i.e. more people's targets of variance and High-frequency Interference and extra frequency components are eliminated using low-pass filter；Mode decomposition is carried out using VMD algorithm to filtered signal, iteration subsignal obtains the effective respiration information for meeting breathing number and frequency range；It carries out Hilbert transform and carries out time frequency processing, obtain the dynamic prompting message comprising smooth respiratory characteristic.The present invention can effectively eliminate the interference harmonic wave of different respiratory components, and removal metope interference enhances feeble respiration signal, have common-path interference, and accurate time-varying tracks characteristic.

title_en: Omnidirectional biological radar-based two-dimensional CA-CFAR (cell average-constant false-alarm rate) human body random motion detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an omnidirectional biological radar-based two-dimensional CA-CFAR (cell average-constant false-alarm rate) human body random motion detection method. According to the method, a biological radar is utilized to detect human body random motion in a strong moving target interference environment, so that the detection and recognition of surviving targets can be realized, so that a new idea can be provided for radar detection for surviving targets; and with an intra-channel reference background and an environment reference background adopted as the two-dimensional threshold value of the two-dimensional CA-CFAR technique, comprehensive analysis and judgment are carried out on the signals of the four-channel biological radar, so that accurate detection and recognition of human body random motion under outdoor moving target interference such as the blowing of wind and the movement of grasses can be realized, and the requirements of the life detection radar for search and rescue environments can be effectively reduced, and search and rescue efficiency can be improved.

title_en: A low power biological signal measuring instrument and a amplification rate control method of measured signal
title_ko: 저전력 생체신호 측정기 및 측정 신호 증폭율 제어 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a low power biological measuring device and a method of controlling a measuring signal amplification factor. The low power biological measuring device comprises: a sensor unit detecting a biological signal; a filter unit receiving the detected biological signal and filtering the biological signal; an amplification factor control unit outputting an amplification factor control signal by comparing DC baselines of the detected biological signal; an amplification unit receiving the filtered biological signal and amplifying the biological signal to correspond to the amplification factor control signal; a signal processing unit receiving the amplified biological signal and processing the biological signal using a diagnosis algorithm; and a power unit supplying power or blocking power in accordance with whether a pair of first and second contact terminals in the sensor unit are in contact with each other or submerged in the water. According to the present invention, the low power biological measuring device and the method of controlling a measuring signal amplification factor can remarkably increase the use time of a biological signal measuring device by remarkably reducing a duty cycle in a measured biological signal waveform and remarkably reducing the whole power to be consumed when the biological signal is measured, also can prevent power from being continuously consumed when the biological signal is not measured, and prevent a malfunction when the biological signal measuring device is submerged in the water.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 저전력 생체신호 측정기 및 측정 신호 증폭율 제어 방법을 공개한다. 이 장치는 생체신호를 감지하는 센서부; 상기 감지된 생체신호를 인가받아 필터링하는 필터부; 상기 감지된 생체신호의 직류 기저선(DC baseline)을 비교하여 증폭율 제어 신호를 출력하는 증폭율 제어부; 상기 필터링된 생체신호를 인가받아 상기 증폭율 제어 신호에 응답하여 증폭하는 증폭부; 상기 증폭된 생체신호를 인가받아 진단 알고리즘을 이용하여 생체신호를 처리하는 신호 처리부; 및 상기 센서부 내 제1 및 제2 접촉단자 쌍의 접촉여부 또는 침수 여부에 따라 측정기에 전원을 공급 또는 차단하는 전원부;를 구비하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에 의할 경우, 측정되는 생체신호 파형의 듀티 싸이클을 현격하게 감소시키고, 생체신호 측정시 전체의 소모되는 전력을 현저하게 절감시킴으로써, 생체신호 측정기의 사용 시간을 획기적으로 증가시킬 수 있게 된다. 또한, 생체신호 비측정시에도 지속되는 전력소모를 방지하고, 생체신호 측정기 침수시 고장을 미연에 예방할 수 있다.
assignees: FOUNDATION RES & BUSINESS SEOUL NAT UNIV SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Smart terminal system for highland tourist rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smart terminal system for highland tourist rescue, and relates to the technical field of smart rescue. The system comprises a smart rescue box and a smart terminal based on a mobile platform. The smart rescue box comprises a sign sensor, a master control module, a Bluetooth module, a wifi module, a Beidou location communication module and a power supply module. The sign sensor transmits detected signals to the master control module through the Bluetooth module. The master control module transmits location information and sign information of a person in distress to a rear end server through a Beidou short message communication module. According to the system, the life sign information is obtained through the front end sign sensor; stable and reliable short message communication is established by use of a Beidou navigation communication module; the transmission problem of search and rescue signals in an area without coverage of a public network is solved; finally connection is carried out with the rear end server; and the smart terminal system for highland tourist rescue based on the mobile platform is established.

title_en: Method for determining a relative dielectric constant and detection method for ground embedded objects
title_ko: 상대 유전 상수를 결정하기 위한 방법 및 지면 매립 물체를 검출하기 위한 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method to determine a relative dielectric constant, and a method to detect an object buried in the ground. According to the present invention, the method to determine a relative dielectric constant is to determine εR, a relative dielectric constant of the ground surface to be searched for a landmine by using a detector, which comprises a ground surface penetrating radar comprising: one or more detection coils; one or more transmitter antennas; and one or more receiver antennas. The method to detect an object buried in the ground is to detect a metallic or a nonmetallic object from the ground by using a landmine detector which comprises a metal detector and a ground penetrating radar. The metal detector comprises one or more detection coils having a coil plane to move in parallel to the ground surface during a detection process. The ground penetrating radar comprises an antenna arrangement which comprises: one or more transmitter antennas; and one or more receiver antennas. According to the present invention, the method to determine εR, which is a relative dielectric constant, is able to calibrate a detector by a fast and known method for properties of the ground surface to be searched. According to the present invention, the method to detect an object buried in the ground based on the determined relative dielectric constant is able to provide essential, necessary data for search and detection to a user. Accordingly, the present invention is able to make it easier for the user to handle the detector.
abstract_ko:
상대 유전 상수를 결정하기 위한 방법 및 지면 매립 물체를 검출하는 방법 
적어도 하나의 검출 코일 및 적어도 하나의 송신기 안테나 및 적어도 하나의 수신기 안테나를 포함하는 지면 투과 레이더를 포함하는 검출기를 이용해 지뢰가 탐색될 지면의 상대 유전 상수 ε R 를 결정하기 위한 방법 및 금속 검출기 및 지면 투과 레이더를 포함하는 지뢰 검출기를 이용해 지면에서 금속 및 비-금속 물체를 검출하기 위한 검출 방법으로서, 금속 검출기는 검출 동안 지면에 평행하게 이동하는 코일 평면을 갖는 적어도 하나의 검출 코일을 포함하고, 지면 투과 레이더는 적어도 하나의 송신기 안테나 및 적어도 하나의 수신기 안테나를 포함하는 안테나 배열을 포함한다. 상대 유전 상수 ε R 를 결정하기 위한 본 발명에 따르는 방법에 의해, 사용자는 탐색될 지면의 지면 속성에 대해 빠르고 알려진 방식으로 검출기를 교정할 수 있다. 결정된 상대 유전 상수를 기초로 하는 본 발명에 따르는 검출 방법은 사용자에게 탐색 및 검출을 위해 필수적이고 필요한 데이터를 제공한다. 다라서 검출기의 핸들링이 사용자에게 훨씬 더 쉬워진다.

title_en: Gripping detecting device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To accurately detect whether or not a hand of a driver contacts steering wheel.SOLUTION: A gripping detecting device 10 comprises: a first electrode (L)13L and a second electrode (R)13R provided for a steering wheel of a vehicle; a heartbeat detection part 14 which detects heartbeats of a driver contacting the first electrode (L)13L and the second electrode (R)13R based on voltage patterns obtained from the first electrode (L)13L and the second electrode (R)13R; a first sensor (L)11L and a second sensor (R)11R which detect electrostatic capacitance on the steering wheel; and a gripping state determination part 15 which determines a gripping state of the driver to the steering wheel based on electrostatic capacitance detected by an electrostatic capacitance detection part 12 and voltage patterns of the first electrode (L)13L and the second electrode (R)13R detected by the heartbeat detection part 14.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Smart home systems that apply to indoor and outdoor environment changes
title_ko: 실,내외 환경 변화에 따른 스마트홈 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart home system, which comprises: an outdoor environment detection unit for generally detecting an outdoor environment condition; an indoor environment detection unit for generally detecting an indoor environment condition; a database in which a preset S/W algorithm is stored while collecting and storing the detected environment conditions by the outdoor environment detection unit and the indoor environment detection unit; and a control unit for setting an optimal indoor environment condition.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트홈 시스템에 관한 것으로, 온도감지센서, 습도감지센서, 조도감지센서, 연기감지센서 등의 각종 센서 및 RFID(radio frequency identification), 직비(ZigBee), 와이파이(Wi-Fi), 블루투스(Bluetooth) 등의 무선 센서 네트워크(WSN; Wireless Sensor Network)를 포함하여 실외 환경 조건을 총괄적으로 감지하는 외부환경감지부와; 상기 외부환경감지부와 동일하게 이루어져 실내 환경 조건을 총괄적으로 감지하는 내부환경감지부와; 상기 외부환경감지부와 내부환경감지부에 의해 감지된 환경조건을 취합하여 저장함과 아울러, 미리 설정된 S/W 알고리즘이 저장된 데이타베이스와; 상기 외부환경감지부와 내부환경감지부에 의해 감지된 환경조건과 데이타베이스에 저장된 S/W 알고리즘을 종합적으로 비교, 분석하여 내부 환경조건의 설정 기준치를 가변 시키고, 가변 된 설정 기준치를 통해 난방설비, 냉방설비, 공조설비, 조명설비, 방범설비, 통신설비, 가전제품 등의 부대시설을 자동적으로 제어하여 최적의 내부 환경조건을 설정하는 제어부를 포함하여 구성되며, 상기 내부환경감지부에는 비접촉으로 실내 거주자의 건강, 부상, 실신 등의 위급상항이나 실내 화재, 침입, 도난 등의 비상상황을 감지하여 상기 제어부에 전달하는 적외선감지센서, 심박감지센서, 음향감지센서 등의 비상감지부가 더 구비되고, 상기 제어부에는 상기 비상감지부의 신호에 따라 데이타베이스에 미리 저장된 비상연락처로 연락하여 비상 상황을 알리는 비상통신부를 더 포함하고, 태양전지, 풍력발전기 등의 발전전원으로 상시 또는 비상시 상기 부대시설에 전원을 공급하는 전력공급부를 더 포함하며, 제어부에는 상기 내부환경감지부에 의해 감지된 전기, 도시가스, 수도 등의 에너지 사용량을 사용자의 스마트폰으로 전송하는 데이타전송부를 더 포함하는 실,내외 환경 변화에 따른 스마트홈 시스템을 제공함으로써, 실외환경과 실내환경의 변화에 따라 사용자의 조작 없이 부대시설을 자동적으로 제어하여 실내환경을 쾌적하게 조성할 수 있으며, 실내 위급 또는 비상 상황에 신속하게 대처할 수 있고, 실내 에너지 사용량을 한눈에 알아보는 것은 물론, 상용전원의 사용량을 최소화 할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Based on multiple target location estimation method after the through-wall radar imaging for improving Dynamic Programming
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of based on multiple target location estimation method after the through-wall radar imaging for improving Dynamic Programming；It includes target area imaging, target image optimization, Dynamic Programming and the estimation of sliding window smooth position.The present invention has fully taken into account autgmentability of the target in imaging results, the target caused by scattering coefficient difference, target echo attenuation, target occlusion etc. between target is improved well loses problem, improve target detection probability, with the advantage that target detection probability is high, position estimation accuracy is higher, can be applied directly in through-wall radar equipment.

title_en: A kind of strong reflection clutter removing method based on double source IR UWB bioradar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of strong reflection clutter removing method based on double source IR UWB bioradar, the antenna utilizing two kinds of different center frequency detects simultaneously, first pretreatment in the radar echo signal to two kinds of different frequencies carries out passage respectively, it is included in the accumulation of spatial domain enterprising row distance, be normalized in time domain, linear trend eliminates and low-pass filtering, realizes the enhancing of the faint life signal of human body；The most pretreated two kinds of different frequency radar echo signals are carried out interchannel process, uses the strong reflection noise jamming in self-adapting clutter technology for eliminating suppression radar return, thus improve the accuracy rate of radar detection.

title_en: Vital signs detecting module for safeguard station
abstract_en: The present invention is a kind of vital signs detecting module for safeguard station, including the Ith road signal conditioning circuit (1), IIth road signal conditioning circuit (2), IIIth road signal conditioning circuit (3), IVth road signal conditioning circuit (4), vital sign parameter signals radiating circuit (5), totally 5 parts combine and constitute an one integral piece.For omnidirectional detection human body vital sign, safeguard station uses 4 road radar modules, radar module output signal amplitude compared with little and interference signal many, 3 grades of filter amplification circuit are devised for this, the signal of amplifying circuit output enters wireless transmitter module ADC, after software algorithm processes, it is transformed into breathing/beats, by safeguard station, vital sign information is launched with 121.5MHz/243MHz frequency range.Radar module is applied on safeguard station by the present invention first, can send the vital sign of distress personnel to search and rescue center, greatly improve efficiency and the specific aim of search-and-rescue work.
assignees: WUHAN ZHONGYUAN MOBILCOM ENG CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign measurement system and vital sign measurement method thereof
abstract_en: A vital sign measurement system includes an excitation signal source, a vital sign sensor, an environmental sensor, an analog front-end sensor electrically connected with the vital sign sensor, and a processor module electrically connected with the excitation signal source, the environmental sensor and the analog front-end sensor. The excitation signal source generates excitation signals. The excitation signals are transmitted to a human body, and then the excitation signals are reflected to generate sensing signals. The vital sign sensor receives the sensing signals, and the sensing signals are converted into a plurality of analog synthetic signals. The environmental sensor receives environmental light. The analog front-end sensor receives and amplifies the analog synthetic signals. The processor module calculates an intensity of the environmental light. And the processor module sends an adjustment instruction to the analog front-end sensor to adjust a sampling frequency of the analog front-end sensor.

title_en: The remote supervision system of mankind's activity

title_en: Appratus for Biological Signals Measurement of Textile base
title_ko: 텍스타일 기반의 생체신호 측정장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for measuring biological signals based on textile. By attaching a sensor formed with textile to gloves and the like worn by an inspection target, the apparatus for measuring biological signals based on textile is to measure biological signals in which the inspection target is unaware that the sensor is attached thereonto, when the inspection target wears the gloves and the like. Also, by providing with a GSR measuring sensor in a textile form to gloves worn by winter sports athletes, the apparatus for measuring biological signals based on textile is to analyze GSR signals measured in a state that the inspection target is unrestricted and unconscious, thereby monitoring a psychological state. To this end, the apparatus for measuring biological signals based on textile comprises: a textile electrode for measuring electrical signals by coming into contact with skin of an inspection target; a signal processing unit for extracting properties of corresponding biological signals by receiving input of electrical signals measured by the textile electrode and for processing signals; and a wireless transmission unit for storing or wirelessly transmitting the extracted and signal-processed biological signals from the signal processing unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 본 발명은 텍스타일 기반의 생체신호 측정장치에 관한 것으로, 센서를 텍스타일로 구성하여 피검자의 장갑 등에 부착하고, 피검자가 착용시 이를 자각하지 못하는 상태에서 생체신호를 측정할 수 있도록 하며, 동계스포츠 운동선수의 장갑에 텍스타일 형태의 GSR측정센서를 구비하여, 피검자가 무구속 무자각 상태에서 측정된 GSR신호를 분석하여 피검자의 심리상태를 모니터링 하도록 하는데 그 목적이 있다.  
상기 목적은 피검자의 피부에 접촉하여 전기신호를 측정하는 직물전극; 상기 직물전극으로부터 측정된 전기신호를 입력받아 해당 생체신호의 특징을 추출 및 신호처리하는 신호처리부; 및 상기 신호처리부로부터 추출 및 신호처리된 생체신호를 저장 또는 무선으로 전송하는 무선송신부;를 포함하여 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method of manufacturing loess wood
title_ko: 황토목재 제조방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a manufacturing method of loess wood, which can be used in an economic manner, by delaying the corrosion phenomena of the wood with antimicrobial activities of the loess. The manufacturing method of loess wood comprises: a first process for manufacturing a loess raw material; a second process for manufacturing a loess crude liquid; a third process for inserting the wood in an impregnation furnace; a fourth process for removing the moisture and impurities inside the wood; a fifth process for supplying the loess crude liquid to a storage tank of the impregnation furnace; a sixth process for permeating the loess crude liquid into the inside of the wood tissue; a seventh process for collecting the excessively absorbed loess crude liquid and the residues on the surface of the wood; an eighth process for drying the loess crude liquid-collected wood; and a ninth process for sanding and treating the surface of the dried wood.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 황토목재 제조방법에 관한 것으로 더욱 상세하게는, 황토목재 제조방법은 황토를 소금과 혼합한 혼합물을 0.1 ~ 5㎚ 크기의 입자로 제조하는 제 1 공정, 상기 제조한 황토 원료, 규소 또는 알루미늄으로 이루어지는 염알루미늄 계열의 무기질 경화제 및 물을 혼합하여 황토원액을 제조하는 제 2 공정, 목재를 함침로에 투입하는 제 3 공정, 상기 함침로에 진공을 가하여 목재 내부의 수분 및 불순물을 제거하는 제 4 공정, 상기 함침로의 저장탱크에 황토원액을 공급하는 제 5 공정, 상기 함침로의 압력을 가하여 상기 황토원액을 목재 조직 내부로 침투시키는 제 6 공정, 상기 가압을 해제하고 진공을 가하여 목재 표면의 잔재물 및 과잉흡수된 황토원액을 회수하는 제 7 공정, 상기 황토원액을 회수한 목재를 8시간 ~ 7일 동안 60 ~ 120℃의 온도에서 건조하는 제 8 공정 및 상기 건조한 목재의 표면을 샌딩처리하는 제 9 공정으로 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 하는 황토목재 제조방법에 관한 것이다. 
또한 본 발명에 따라 제조된 황토목재는 산업적인 측면에서 황토의 원가가 저렴하여 원재료인 황토의 구입이 용이하며 취급시 안전하다는 장점이 있으며, 황토의 점성적 성질로 목재 내부의 융착이 용이하다는 장점이 있다. 
또한 환경적인 측면에서 황토를 사용함으로써 친환경적이며 습도조절능력이 뛰어나다는 효과가 있으며,목재와 함께 사용함으로써 통기성 및 축열성이 높으며 원적외선 방사로 인체 건강에 유익하며, 강력한 항균력으로 곰팡이 서식을 억제할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
또한 목재와 황토무기질 세라믹의 혼합으로 착화온도가 높아 화재 발생을 지연 또는 억제시키는 역할을 하며, 연소시 불꽃이 형성되지 않아 유독가스의 발생을 억제시키는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A kind of multipath mitigation algorithms based on node degree
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multipath mitigation algorithms based on node degree, be applied in through-wall radar data processing module.When target location changes, the echo-signal time delay of each propagation path and phase place respective change, thus affect the position of multipath ghost, i.e. target is interrelated with multipath ghost.Therefore the flight path that Target Tracking System produces can describe by a complex network model being made up of node and directed edge, and every flight path is seen as node, and limit is regarded in the association between flight path as.Go out in-degree by calculate each discrete instants flight path, update average out-degree peace all in-degrees of whole flight path node, finally judge whether every flight path constitutes discrete nodes or whether be multipath.Repetition above step, until having processed all track data, completes the multipaths restraint to whole scene.The present invention realizes multipaths restraint based on node degree, it is possible to the real-time of boosting algorithm while improving Studies of Radar Detection performance.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitoring signal processing system
abstract_en: The invention provides a signal processing system for non-contact vital sign monitoring, which comprises: the I/Q channel signal processing module: for combining the I/Q channel signals I (t) and Q (t) into a complex signal s (t); a respiratory frequency estimation module: defining frequency rotation operator according to the characteristics of the baseband signal mathematical model A reaction of S (t) with After multiplication, Fourier transform is carried out, the parameter P is optimized and estimated through frequency spectrum concentration indexes, and the respiratory frequency f is firstly estimated r (ii) a A modulation component removing module for operating S (t) and the frequency rotation operator estimated in step 2 Multiplying, removing the modulation component caused by respiration in S (t); a heartbeat frequency estimation module: for estimating the frequency f of the heartbeat h . The method is based on a radar baseband signal model, constructs a matched frequency rotation operator to carry out parametric optimization estimation, and can obtain high-precision f by using shorter sampling length data r And f h And the value is estimated, the test sensitivity is high, and the noise resistance is strong.

title_en: Marine vital signs detecting module based on Bluetooth technology
abstract_en: The present invention is a kind of marine vital signs detecting module based on Bluetooth technology, includes water-proof sensor (1), low frequency filtering and amplifying circuit (2), Bluetooth transmission circuit (3), and totally 3 parts combine and constitute an one integral piece.The analogue signal that water-proof sensor is exported, after 2 grades are amplified filtering, the gain that can make 1Hz low frequency respiratory frequency signal reaches 10dB, the signal of amplifying circuit output enters bluetooth module ADC, after bluetooth module kernel algorithm processes, it is converted into frequency of respiration, gives closely lifesaving appliance by Bluetooth transmission.In a word, water-proof sensor and bluetooth module are combined by the present invention, can be emitted by bluetooth wireless mode by the vital sign of maritime peril personnel, greatly improve efficiency and the specific aim of maritime search and rescue work.

title_en: A alarm for saving a life
title_ko: 개인인명구조용 경보기
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a personal life saving alarm comprises: a case main body, and a main board. And a beacon, which is a wireless communication module, is installed in the personal life saving alarm to enable the personal life saving alarm to track a position of a firefighter, thereby easily recognizing a firefighter buried in a fire scene, and to verify personal information of firefighters entering the fire scene and a maximum entry maintaining time from a firefighting command center away from the fire scene, thereby considering safety of the entering firefighters.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 개인인명구조용 경보기는, 배면에 버클이 부착되고 전면에 이머전시 키와 상기 이머전시 키를 둘러싸는 LED 링이 배치된 케이스본체와, 상기 케이스본체의 측면에 인출작동이 가능하게 작동 키가 설치되고, 해제버튼이 설치되고, 상부측면에 LED 표시창이 설치되고 타측면에 모드키 및 접속부가 설치되고 내부에 움직임 감지 센서와 RTD센서가 설치되고, 비콘이 설치되고, 상기 비콘과 접속되며 경보음을 발생하는 부저와 배터리와 연결되며 상기 LED 링과 LCD 표시창과 연결된 메인보드를 포함하여, 화재 또는 각종 재난현장에 출동하는 소방관등의 안전과 출동현장의 현황을 파악하여 현장을 효율적으로 지휘하기 위하여 소방관등이 화재 또는 각종 재난현장에 출동 시에 소방관들이 착용한 소방복상에 걸어서 착용할 수가 있으며 착용이 용이하고, 화재현장에 진입한 소방관의 움직임이 없으면 경보음을 출력하고 LED가 점멸작동되고 화재현장에 설정된 온도이상의 고온의 온도가 감지되게 되면 경보음을 출력하고 LED가 점멸작동되어 위험한 현장을 식별하여 붕괴사고가 발생될 위험한 현장을 알려주며 화재현장의 진입시간과 현재시간이 표시되어 용이하게 착용한 소방관이 진입시간과 현재시간을 파악할 수가 있으며 무선통신모듈인 비콘이 설치되어 소방관의 위치의 추적이 가능하게 되어 화재현장에서 매몰된 소방관을 용이하게 인지하며 화재현장에서 떨어진 소방지휘소에서 화재현장에 진입한 소방관들의 인적사항과 진입시간의 파악이 가능하게 되어 최대진입유지시간의 파악으로 인하여 진입 소방관들의 안전을 고려하는 것이 가능한 우수한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Forward direction mixing match tracing method and system towards multipolarization through-wall radar imaging
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of forward direction mixing match tracing method and system towards multipolarization through-wall radar imaging, the method includes: obtain the radar return under multiple POLARIZATION CHANNEL；Multiple radar returns are carried out vectorization process, calculates base signal matrix according to multiple radar returns of vectorization, and degree of rarefication K is set；Utilizing orthogonal matching pursuit method to solve the local solution of multiple POLARIZATION CHANNEL, merge all local solutions, find out the position corresponding to K maximum in fusion results, initialize Ji Xinhaoji, the signal calculating multiple POLARIZATION CHANNEL is remaining；It is iterated calculating to the local solution of multiple POLARIZATION CHANNEL, whether stops iteration according to default iteration stopping conditional judgment；Calculate according to the iteration result meeting iteration stopping condition and merge and obtain being ultimately imaged result.Present invention have the advantage that in forward direction mixing matching pursuit algorithm, selected base signal is evaluated and selects the base signal of optimum, image quality is better than other greedy algorithms.

title_en: A kind of amphibious ship shape searching machine people
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of amphibious ship shape searching machine people, detect liquid level information by level sensor and be sent to controller, then judging amphibious ship shape searching machine people's local environment by controller；If residing environment is land, then wheel work, propeller II does not works and passes through in expansion link II indentation hollow out nacelle, and amphibious ship shape searching machine people utilizes life-detection instrument and photographic head to start to search for trapped personnel；If residing environment is the water surface, then wheel quits work, and propeller I and propeller II all works.Propeller I rotates in atmosphere, filling channel and aerator is utilized to be full of air cushion by air, amphibious ship shape searching machine people is provided the buoyancy in water, propeller II stretches out hollow out nacelle through expansion link II and rotates in water simultaneously, the propulsive force that amphibious ship shape searching machine people travels at the water surface is provided, searches for trapped personnel also with life-detection instrument and photographic head.

title_en: Wearable Authentication Device Using Biological Signal
title_ko: 생체 신호를 이용한 착용형 인증 장치
abstract_en: Provided is a wearable authentication device using a bio-signal. The wearable authentication device includes: a proximity sensor which distinguishes whether to be worn, and generates a signal for authentication when wearing and a signal for de- authentication when not wearing; a measurement signal which touches on a skin of a user so as to measure the bio-signal from the user; and a control unit which analyzes the bio-signal measured by the measurement unit and performs an authentication process to compare with the previously registered bio-signal so as to determine whether to use.
abstract_ko: 착용형 인증 장치가 제공된다. 이 착용형 인증 장치는 착용 여부를 구별하여, 착용시에는 인증 실시용 신호를, 그리고 미착용시에는 인증 해제용 신호를 생성하는 근접 센서, 사용자의 피부에 접촉하여 사용자로부터 생체 신호를 측정하는 측정부 및 측정부에 의해 측정된 생체 신호를 분석하여 미리 등록된 생체 신호와 비교하는 인증 절차를 수행하여 사용 여부를 결정하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: User authentication method and system via the skin impedence recognition in the bio-electrical signal measurement environment using wearable sensors
title_ko: 웨어러블 센서를 이용한 생체 신호 측정 환경에서의 피부 임피던스 인식을 통한 사용자 인증 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and system for authenticating a user via recognition of skin impedance in a bio-electrical signal measurement environment by using wearable sensors. The method for authenticating a user via recognition of skin impedance in a bio-electrical signal measurement environment by using wearable sensors comprises the steps of: (1) measuring, by a skin impedance measurement unit, skin impedance of a user; (2) transmitting, by a communication unit, the skin impedance, measured at step (1), to an authentication unit; and (3) authenticating, by the authentication unit, the user by comparing the skin impedance transmitted at step (2) with previously stored user data. According to the method and system for authenticating a user via recognition of skin impedance in a bio-electrical signal measurement environment by using wearable sensors, which are proposed by the present invention, skin impedance unique to an individual person is measured by using the electrode sensors, and the measured skin impedance is used as a user authentication tool, thereby simply and conveniently authenticating a user, i.e., a bio-electrical signal measurement target, in an environment in which bio-electrical signals are measured by using the wearable sensors.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 웨어러블 센서를 이용한 생체 신호 측정 환경에서의 피부 임피던스 인식을 통한 사용자 인증 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 (1) 피부 임피던스 측정부가 사용자의 피부 임피던스를 측정하는 단계; (2) 통신부가 상기 단계 (1)에서 측정된 피부 임피던스를 인증부로 전송하는 단계; 및 (3) 인증부가 상기 단계 (2)에서 전송된 피부 임피던스를 미리 저장된 사용자 데이터와 비교하여 사용자를 인증하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 웨어러블 센서를 이용한 생체 신호 측정 환경에서의 피부 임피던스 인식을 통한 사용자 인증 방법 및 시스템에 따르면, 개인별로 차이가 나는 피부 임피던스를 전극 센서를 이용하여 측정하고, 이를 사용자 인증 도구로 사용함으로써, 웨어러블 센서로 생체 신호를 측정하는 환경에서 생체 신호 측정 대상이 되는 사용자를 간편하고 편리하며 정확하게 인증할 수 있다.

title_en: Microwave stethoscope for measuring cardio-pulmonary vital signs and lung water content
abstract_en: A microwave stethoscope measurement method and sensor design employ a microwave transmission sensor and a microwave reception sensor placed on a patient's chest in spaced-apart side-by-side configuration for monitoring patient vital signs, lung water content and other critical measurements. The side-by- side sensors are spaced apart a separation distance of about 1-3 cm in lateral chest orientation. The sensors may be formed with a textile fabric for wearer comfort and to improve contact with the patient's skin. The microwave sensor measurements are digitally processed using a modified short time Fourier Transform (STFT) spectrum windowed-averaged algorithm. Output data extracted from the microwave sensor measurements may be transmitted wirelessly to a mobile device such as a smartphone for remote monitoring of the patient's medical condition.

title_en: Nursing respiration detection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a detection device, in particular to a nursing respiration detection device. The nursing respiration detection device comprises fixing belts and an elastic belt, wherein the fixing belts are arranged at both ends of the elastic belt and are fixedly connected with the elastic belt through fixing blocks; a slip buckle and an electrode plate are arranged on each fixing belt; the elastic strip is provided with annular grains; a casing is arranged on the fixing blocks; a motor is fixedly arranged on the casing and is connected with a rotary shaft; a bearing is arranged on the rotary shaft and is fixedly connected with a turntable; photoelectric sensors are arranged on the turntable, and are distributed in a cross way; a storage device is arranged on the side wall of the casing. By adopting the technical scheme, the nursing respiration detection device has the advantage that defect of lower detection accuracy in the prior art can be effectively overcome.

title_en: Testing device for simulating seepage failure of dam with upper part defects and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a testing device for simulating a seepage failure of a dam with upper part defects and a construction method thereof. The testing device comprises a model tank and a dam model arranged in the model tank. An arch simulative ant channel is formed in the upper part of the dam model. A spherical area is arranged near the position, close to the downstream dam slope, of the simulative ant channel of the dam model, and an artificial sprinkler is arranged above the model tank. A plurality of sets of monitoring sensors are buried near the simulative ant channel in the dam model. The construction method of the testing device comprises the steps that firstly, clay is made into a soil sample, an arch thin pipe is buried on the upper part of the dam model, and tamping is conducted after the soil sample is made higher than the thin pipe through filling; and secondly, the portion, on the periphery of the thin pipe, of the soil sample is excavated to be spherical, the excavated portion of the soil sample is backfilled again to make a clay layer in the spherical area become looser towards the thin pipe, the simulative ant channel is generated by pulling out the pre-buried thin pipe after filling is completed, and the multiple sets of monitoring sensors are arranged along the simulative ant channel. The testing device can be used for studying preferential flow effects of the upper part defects of the homogeneous dam and the disaster-causing mechanism inducing the seepage failure of the homogeneous dam.

title_en: Multifunctional life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multifunctional life detection instrument, including control terminal to and with control terminal data interchange's life detection device, but and for control terminal, life detection device carry out the charge -discharge pond and the power supply circuit that supply power, the life detection device includes the host system who carries out data interchange with control terminal to and being connected the electric magnetic detection ware of the UWB who forms the data interaction, shake detector and audio frequency and video detector a little with host system respectively, control terminal controls UWB electricity magnetic detection ware, shake switching between three kinds of detection modes of detector and audio frequency and video detector a little. The utility model discloses realize the high accuracy, can adapt to the life rescue under the various condition, for first -aid staff after the calamity provides the powerful guarantee, technical merit and the equipment level of effectual promotion china at earthquake relief, in the aspect of salvaging life.

title_en: Buried depth detecting device and method of communication pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to a buried depth detecting device and method of a communication pipeline. The detecting device comprises a control unit, and ground penetrating radar system GPR, a GPS device, a display unit and a storage battery connected with the control unit; the storage battery supplies power to the whole device; the control unit sets parameters including time, the buried soil type of a detecting pipeline and the arched shape of the detecting pipeline, and displays detection data via the display unit; the control unit is also connected with a resource management server to upload the detection data; the ground penetrating radar system GPR emits high-frequency electromagnetic waves in 3D conical distribution to the underground via a radar technology, and a radar reception antenna of the ground penetrating radar system GPR can receive electromagnetic waves reflected from the channel pipeline, so that the buried depth of the underground communication pipeline is detected and transmitted to the control unit to generate a visual image; and the GPS device can position the latitude and longitude of the present position of the detecting pipeline, and back feeds the latitude and longitude to the control unit. Thus, the buried depth of the underground communication pipeline can be identified.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting footwear carrying out vital signs detecting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of fire-fighting footwear carrying out vital signs detecting, including sole, vital signs detecting device, illuminating lamp and shoulder guard, on described sole, deck is installed, on described deck, roller is installed, described sole is internally provided with described shoulder guard, described sole is provided above with fire-proof and thermal-insulation vamp, it is provided with described shoulder guard inside the toe-cap of described fire-proof and thermal-insulation vamp, described fire-proof and thermal-insulation vamp is provided above with face, described face is provided above described illuminating lamp, described illuminating lamp is provided above belt, described belt is provided below buzzer, described buzzer is provided below function key, described function key is provided below alarm lamp, described alarm lamp side is provided with described vital signs detecting device.Having the beneficial effects that: fireman can be helped to carry out personnel's search and rescue, described illuminating lamp facilitates rescue work at night to carry out, and has fire-proof and thermal-insulation function simultaneously, can prevent scene of fire flame burn consumption person foot.

title_en: A kind of multipaths restraint method of multiple target side wall after through-wall radar imaging
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of multipaths restraint method of multiple target side wall suitable for through-wall radar imaging, and all connected domains are extracted from the original radar image of binary first with 4 connection area detecting methods；Then connected domain vector is obtained to all connection Field Numbers and according to Euclidean distance ascending sort of their average coordinates from radar array center；Then connected domain vector element is reassembled into two subvectors, the two subvectors is extended according to the multi-path transmission paths to radar and direct echo transmission path respectively；Then the similarity matrix of two subvectors is calculated using similarity function；Finally judge all elements of similarity matrix using the method for similarity thresholding and decision rule, obtain the connected domain where real goal and curb multipath decoy.The present invention can be detected hidden multiple target after wall, can effectively be rejected multipath while target is retained.

title_en: Method for obtaining bio signal and electronic device implementing the same
title_ko: 생체 신호 취득 방법 및 이를 지원하는 전자 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for obtaining a bio signal and an electronic device supporting the same. A wearable electronic device according to any one among various embodiments of the present invention includes a housing, a battery mounted inside the housing, a coupling member configured to detachably couple the electronic device to a portion of a body of a user, a conductive member which is electrically connected to the battery and is exposed to the outside, at least one sensor electrically connected to the conductive member, and a circuit which is electrically connected to the battery, the conductive member, and the at least one sensor. The method for obtaining a bio signal of the electronic device according to the present invention includes the operations of: applying a current transmitted from an external material to a switch; electrically connecting at least one or more terminals to the battery; and charging the battery with the current transmitted from the external material. Therefore, the present invention can accurately measure a skin temperature through an external device connection unit.

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of plateau visitor and succour intelligent terminal system, relate to intelligence rescue technique field, including wisdom rescue box and intelligent terminal based on mobile platform, wisdom rescue box comprises condition sensor, main control module, bluetooth module, wifi module, Big Dipper positioning and communicating module and power module；Condition sensor passes to main control module by bluetooth module the signal detected, location information and the sign information of distress personnel are passed to back-end server by Big Dipper short message communication module by main control module again.This utility model obtains vital sign information by front end condition sensor, Beidou navigation communication module is utilized to set up reliable and stable short message communication, solve the transmission problem without public network area of coverage search and rescue signal, it is eventually connected to back-end server end, establishes a kind of plateau visitor based on mobile platform and succour intelligent terminal system.

title_en: Ingestible devices and methods for physiological status monitoring
abstract_en: Reliable, real-time heart and respiratory rates are key vital signs used in evaluating the physiological status in many clinical and non-clinical settings. Measuring these vital signs generally requires superficial attachment of physically or logistically obtrusive sensors to subjects that may result in skin irritation or adversely influence subject performance. Given the broad acceptance of ingestible electronics, the approach disclosed here enables vital sign monitoring internally from the gastrointestinal tract. The large animal (porcine) experiments and a robust processing disclosed herein demonstrate the feasibility of this approach. Implementing vital sign monitoring as a stand-alone technology or in conjunction with other ingestible devices has the capacity to significantly aid telemedicine, optimize performance monitoring of athletes, military service members, and first-responders, as well as provide a facile method for rapid clinical evaluation and triage.

title_en: Space-ground-air integrated coordinated search and rescue system suitable for complex mountain scenic areas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-ground-air integrated coordinated search and rescue system suitable for complex mountain scenic areas, and relates to the technical field of tourism safety. The three-dimensional rescue mode of multiple dimensions is erected, and a rescue auxiliary information system acts as a decision command hub so that integration and coordination of a search and rescue technology platform are facilitated, and a tourism safety guarantee technology integrated framework for the complex mountain scenic areas can be formed. Vital sign information is acquired through a front-end sign sensor, and a stable and reliable communication link is established by using the "space-air-ground" coordinated search and rescue communication system so that the problem of transmission of the search and rescue signals of the complex mountain scenic areas can be solved, finally the system is connected to a background server side to process and analyze emergency rescue decision information and thus the "space-air-ground" (integrated) coordinated search and rescue command mode for the complex mountain scenic areas is established.

title_en: Buried object prospecting method and buried object prospecting apparatus
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a buried object prospecting method capable of prospecting a buried part with higher accuracy.SOLUTION: A buried object prospecting method according to an embodiment, comprises a first setting step, a first analysis step, a first display step, a second setting step, a second scanning step, a second analysis step, and a second display step. In the first setting step, a first scanning range of a high frequency electromagnetic radar prospecting machine is set. In the first analysis step, first position information on a first buried object at a first to-be-prospected depth is obtained on the basis of an analysis of result data obtained in the first scanning step. In the first display step, a position of the first buried object is displayed. In the second setting step, a second scanning position of a low frequency electromagnetic radar prospecting machine is set. In the second analysis step, second position information on a second buried object at a second to-be-prospected depth is obtained on the basis of an analysis of result data obtained in the second scanning step. In the second display step, a position of the second buried object is displayed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 13

title_en: A kind of ultra-wide spectrum radar type human body respiration enhancing detection method based on multi-antenna data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of ultra-wide spectrum radar type human body respirations based on multi-antenna data fusion to enhance detection method, belongs to bioradar or radar type human life detection field.Technical solution are as follows: firstly, providing the multi-channel information breathed about human body target by multiple antennas ultra-wide spectrum radar system；Secondly, by the original radar return data in each channel by pre-processing and carrying out adaptable Kalman filter fusion after target association；Finally, the human body respiration waveform that output detects.Innovation of the invention is to propose a kind of ultra-wide spectrum radar type human body respiration enhancing detection method, data fusion is carried out by receiving the multi-channel information provided to multiple antennas, it solves feeble respiration caused by human body target orientation and postural change and detects problem, to enhance human body respiration detectivity of the ultra-wide spectrum radar in the application such as detecting through walls, earthquake rescue.

title_en: Rader module for detecting and measuring vital sign
title_ko: 생체신호 탐지 및 측정용 레이더 모듈
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a radar module for detection and measurement of biological signals, and more specifically, to a radar module for detection and measurement of biological signals, where an electronic component mount area and an antenna area are arranged on a single printed circuit board and the interference of a side robe on the antenna area is reduced. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the radar module includes a board including a mount area for mounting electronic components on the front surface and first and second antenna areas arranged on the left and right sides of the mount area. The board includes through-holes penetrating in a vertical direction between the mount area and the first antenna area and between the mount area and the second antenna area. The through-holes contact an antenna pattern crossing the mount area in a horizontal direction. A radio frequency (RF) bushing connector is inserted into the through-holes.
abstract_ko:

title_en: Registered multi-layer underground and surface images in land surveys
abstract_en: A method of land surveying that electronically registers together multi-layer underground and surface images of a surface volume with buried utilities and other infrastructures. Such method further comprises assembling and presenting the combination to a device in the field that visually guides crews in their safe digging of the ground nearby. The orienting, scaling, and registering of a first image layer is to a standardized orientation and scaling on a map of a photograph of a land surface from a zenith point in space above. Then the orienting, scaling, and registering of a second image layer is made to the standardized orientation and scaling on the map. This layer is a result of a ground penetrating radar investigation of buried objects point-by-point in an immediate search area of a corresponding ground surface. Underground buried objects and utilities are thereby located to make safe digging nearby.

title_en: Method and apparatus for monitoring bionic signal based wireless network
title_ko: 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and apparatus for monitoring a bionic signal based on a wireless network. The method for monitoring a bionic signal based on a wireless network includes the steps of: enabling a bionic sensor to sense the bionic signal generated by a sensing object; enabling a bionic signal monitoring device to monitor the bionic signal; enabling the bionic signal monitoring device to determine whether the bionic signal is in a normal range or an abnormal range based on a preset value; enabling the bionic signal monitoring device to transmit state information of the sensing object to an emergency situation management device if the bionic signal is not in the abnormal range; and enabling the emergency situation management device to transmit the state information to a user device of a protector of the sensing object. Accordingly, the present invention can continuously manage the state of the sensing object by analyzing the bionic signal.
abstract_ko: 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 장치가 개시된다. 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법은 생체 센서가 센싱 대상에 의해 발생되는 생체 신호를 센싱하는 단계, 생체 신호 모니터링 장치가 생체 신호를 모니터링하는 단계, 생체 신호 모니터링 장치가 설정된 값을 기반으로 생체 신호가 정상 범위인지 비정상 범위인지 여부를 판단하는 단계, 생체 신호 모니터링 장치가 생체 신호가 상기 비정상 범위인 경우, 응급 상황 관리 장치로 센싱 대상의 상태 정보를 전송하는 단계와 응급 상황 관리 장치가 센싱 대상의 보호자의 사용자 장치로 상태 정보를 전달하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: System for be used for interior vital signs of probe vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a system for be used for interior vital signs of probe vehicle, including radar formula life detector, gas composition sensor, temperature sensor, controller and alarm device, wherein, the radar formula life detector set up in engine compartment for vital signs in the response car, gas composition sensor settings is in the up end of car operation panel for gaseous information in the measuring car, temperature sensor sets up in the top in carriage for response in -car temperature, the controller sets up in the inside of car operation panel, is connected with radar formula life detector, gas composition sensor and temperature sensor electricity for receive and the process information, alarm device sets up in vehicle chassis for send alarm information. title_en: Electric signal system and method for converting respiration
title_ko: 호흡을 이용한 신호 처리 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for processing a signal by using respiration, which include: a respiration sensor for sensing respiration and converting the respiration into a respiration electrical signal; a respiration processing processor for processing the respiration electrical signal to generate digital data; and an output device for outputting the digital data. According to the present invention, the communication with a disabled person is possible, such that needs of the disabled person can be treated quickly in an emergency situation. In addition, it can be used for military purposes because it can be applied to cryptographic techniques such as Morse code, and it can be used as an input scheme for substituting a touch when using a smart phone or the like because the signal can be processed without using a hand.

title_en: an assembly system for fire-insulation materials
title_ko: 내화 충전재 결합구조
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a structure for installation of fireproof filling materials, which are buried in a penetrating-hole formed in an inter-floor slab or a wall between adjacent rooms in a building to prevent flames and smoke from quickly spreading to the next floor or room in case of fire. Especially, pipes installed in a high-rise building in Korea are connected through penetrating-holes of each floor. However, it is practically impossible to place a pipe in the dead center of a penetrating-hole such that the pipe is placed eccentrically with respect to the penetrating-hole and a space formed by the pipe and the penetrating-hole has an indeterminate shape. A fireproof filling material installed to fill the indeterminate space has a sponge function to be easily applicable to the indeterminate space and has characteristics to suppress the heat of flames and the passage of smoke in case of fire. An existing fireproof foam pad (11), having the characteristics and usage as a fireproof filling material (1), is used since it is a conventional concept of a prior art product. The products high density and specific gravity, and lack of elasticity make product prone to breakage when applied to the penetrating-hole, a distinctive feature of a Korean building. When reducing the density and specific gravity to resolve the issue, the product shows structural weakness in sealing and thermal conduction performance. To solve these issues, the present invention provides a high-performance fireproof filling material having a composite structure in which a thermally expanding curtain with good thermal expansion is added to a fireproof foam pad, which can be conveniently applied to distinctive Korean buildings and remarkably improve the performance of the existing product.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건축물에 있어 층간 슬래브층 혹은 인접실 간의 벽체에 형성하는 관통구에 매설되어 화재 발생시 화염과 연기가 층간 또는 인접실로 급속히 퍼지는 것을 방지하기 위해 설치하는 내화충전재 설치구조에 관한 것이다. 
특히 국내 고층 건물에 설치하는 배관은 각층별 관통구를 통하여 연결되는데 이때 파이프가 관통구의 정중앙에 위치하는 것이 현실적으로 불가하여 관통구에 배관의 위치는 편심을 이루고 이로 인하여 이들이 이루는 공간은 부정형이므로 이를 메우도록 설치하는 내화 충전재는 부정형의 공간에 적응이 용이하도록 스펀지 기능을 가지도록 하고 화재 발생시 화염의 높은 열과 연기가 통과하는 것을 억제 지연하도록 하는 성질을 가지고 있다. 
이와 같은 성질을 가지고 내화 충진재(1)로 사용되는 방화 폼 패드(11)가 종래의 것이 외국의 선행 제품의 개념을 차용한 제품을 사용하다 보니 밀도와 비중이 높고 보다 경질의 특성으로 인하여 국내의 건축 특성인 관통구에 적용하기에는 탄력성이 부족하고 쪼개지는 현상이 많으며 이를 극복하고자 밀도와 비중이 낮으면 결국 밀폐성과 열전도성에 구조적인 문제를 보이는 점이 있어 이를 개선하고자 방화 폼 패드에 열팽창성이 우수한 열팽창 커튼을 첨부하는 복합 구조를 이루어 성능이 상승한 내화 충진재로 국내 건축 특성에 편리하게 적용하고 동시에 기존의 제품의 성능을 획기적으로 개선할 수 있도록 하려는 것이다.

title_en: Proactive and preventive health care system using remote monitoring and notifications
abstract_en: A health status monitoring and reporting system comprising a user-wearable armband and a gateway device is disclosed. title_en: Method and apparatus for monitoring bionic signal based wireless network
title_ko: 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and an apparatus for monitoring a biosignal based on a wireless network. A method for preventing solitary death based on an embedded biosignal collector installed in a lamp in a room comprises: a step of collecting a biosignal based on an embedded biosignal collector in a room lamp; a step of performing digital signal processing (DSP) to suppress a clutter signal in the biosignal and extract only a biosignal of a solitary death prevention subject; a step of performing signal processing to extract only an important signal from the biosignal on which DSP is performed; a step of extracting a feature parameter from the biosignal on which signal processing is performed; and a step of transmitting the biosignal and the feature parameter to a biosignal processing collection server. The biosignal includes a heart beat signal, a motion signal, and a respiration signal. The embedded biosignal collector is a super-sensitivity microwave sensor. The biosignal processing collection server collects the feature parameter and the biosignal of the solitary death prevention subject to extract biosignal property information. The biosignal collection server extracts a signal of the solitary death prevention subject in a plurality of biosignals generated by a plurality of solitary death prevention subjects in an identical place based on the biosignal property information.
abstract_ko: 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 장치가 개시된다. 방 내부의 등에 설치된 내장형 생체 신호 수집기 기반 고독사 방지 방법에 있어서, 방등 내장형 생체 신호 수집기를 기반으로 생체 신호를 수집하는 단계; 상기 생체 신호에서 클러터(Clutter) 신호를 억제하고 고독사 방지 대상자의 생체 신호만을 추출하는 DSP(digital signal processing) 처리를 수행하는 단계; 상기 DSP 처리된 상기 생체 신호에서 중요 신호만 추출하는 신호 처리를 수행하는 단계; 상기 신호 처리된 상기 생체 신호에서 특징 파라미터를 추출하는 단계; 상기 생체 신호 및 상기 특징 파라미터를 생체 신호 처리 수집 서버로 전송하는 단계를 포함하고, 상기 생체 신호는 심장 박동 신호, 움직임 신호, 호흡 신호를 포함하고, 상기 내장형 생체 신호 수집기는 초고감도 마이크로파 센서이며, 상기 생체 신호 처리 수집 서버는 상기 고독사 방지 대상자의 상기 생체 신호 및 특징 파라미터를 수집하여 생체 신호 특성 정보를 추출하고,  상기 생체 신호 수집 서버는 상기 생체 신호 특성 정보를 기반으로 동일한 장소 내에 있는 복수의 고독사 방지 대상자에 의해 발생되는 복수의 생체 신호 중 상기 고독사 방지 대상자의 신호를 추출한다.
