title_en: Method and apparatus for monitoring bionic signal based wireless network
title_ko: 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and a device for monitoring a bio-signal on the basis of a wireless network. A system for monitoring a bio-signal on the basis of a wireless network comprise: a bio-sensor for sensing a bio-signal generated by a sensing object; a bio-signal monitoring device for monitoring the bio-signal, determining whether the bio-signal is in a normal range or in an abnormal range on the basis of a set value, and transmitting state information of the sensing object to an emergency situation management device when the bio-signal is in the abnormal range; and the emergency situation management device for transferring the state information to a user terminal of a guardian of the sensing object. The sensing signal includes a cardiac impulse signal, a movement signal, and a respiration signal. The bio-sensor is an ultrahigh sensitive microwave sensor, and the bio-signal monitoring device extracts bio-signal feature information by collecting the bio-signal of the sensing object. The bio-signal monitoring device extracts a signal of the sensing object from a plurality of bio-signals generated by a plurality of sensing objects in the same place on the basis of the bio-signal feature information.
abstract_ko: 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 방법 및 장치가 개시된다. 무선 네트워크 기반의 생체 신호 모니터링 시스템은, 센싱 대상에 의해 발생되는 생체 신호를 센싱하도록 구현되는 생체 센서; 상기 생체 신호를 모니터링하고, 설정된 값을 기반으로 상기 생체 신호가 정상 범위인지 비정상 범위인지 여부를 판단하고, 상기 생체 신호가 상기 비정상 범위인 경우, 응급 상황 관리 장치로 상기 센싱 대상의 상태 정보를 전송하도록 구현되는 생체 신호 모니터링 장치; 및 상기 센싱 대상의 보호자의 사용자 장치로 상기 상태 정보를 전달하도록 구현되는 응급 상황 관리 장치를 포함하고, 상기 생체 신호는 심장 박동 신호, 움직임 신호, 호흡 신호를 포함하고, 상기 생체 센서는 초고감도 마이크로파 센서이며, 상기 생체 신호 모니터링 장치는 상기 센싱 대상의 상기 생체 신호를 수집하여 생체 신호 특성 정보를 추출하도록 구현되고, 상기 생체 신호 모니터링 장치는 상기 생체 신호 특성 정보를 기반으로 동일한 장소 내에 있는 복수의 센싱 대상에 의해 발생되는 복수의 생체 신호 중 상기 센싱 대상의 신호를 추출하도록 구현된다.

title_en: Intelligent control method for mine rescue detection robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent control method for a mine rescue detection robot, and the method comprises the steps: employing a gas concentration sensor, a carbon monoxide sensor and a temperature sensor to detect the environment parameters of a roadway; enabling the mine rescue detection robot to carry out the obstacle avoiding according to the information of a visual sensor, a supersonic sensor and an infrared sensor; carrying out the positioning and life detection of underground trapped persons through a GPS positioning module and a life detector; outputting decision making control information through an intelligent control algorithm and a central controller, carrying out the real-time monitoring of an underground environment, and carrying out the control of the mine rescue detection robot. According to the technical effect, the method carries out the coupling of an Elman neural network through employing a fruit fly optimization method, carries out the modeling of a mine rescue detection robot detection control system, carries out the information fusion of a plurality of sensors, and achieves the intelligent control of the sensors. The method is high in convergence speed, is high in precision, is better in stability and reliability, ad provides a new idea for the mine safety research.

title_en: Two-dimensional through-wall object detection radar system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-dimensional through-wall object detection radar system, and relates to an impulse pulse radar detection field. The two-dimensional through-wall detection object radar system adopts impulse pulses in a range from 0 to 6GHZ, and a single emission antenna is used to emit impulse pulse signals, which can penetrate walls, ruins, and other obstacles, and then are bounced back after being collided with a life entity, and then are reflected back to double time-sharing sharing receiving antennas. Doppler effect of a received impulse pulse sequence can be caused by the moving of the chest wall of the detected life entity, which is used as the basis of the detection of the life entity. The signals acquired by the two receiving antennas are transmitted to an FPGA signal control processing unit, and the two-dimensional plane position of the detected life entity is calculated after being processed and calculated by adopting an algorithm, and then is displayed by a display unit.

title_en: Three-dimensional through-wall target imaging radar system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional through-wall target imaging radar system. The system is a target radar imaging system, a wave source frequency is 4GHz, and transmitting power is 2W. An antenna is arranged on a moving platform, and the moving platform is driven by rotation of a rotating plate to reciprocate in uniform motion so as to scan a tested organism in a reciprocated manner to obtain echo signals. The acquired signals are subjected to amplifying, filtering and down conversion and then subjected to imaging algorithm processing by an FPGA (field programmable gate array) pulse signals to obtain image data, and the image data are finally displayed through a display.

title_en: Self-focusing compressed sensing imaging method of through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-focusing compressed sensing imaging method of a through-wall radar. The method has the advantages that wall parameter estimation and behind-wall scene imaging are unified into the same processing frame, wall parameter estimation is achieved while a high-resolution target image is obtained, frequency band resources occupied by a system transmission end and the sampling number of a receiving end are reduced, operation complexity is lowered, and detecting efficiency is increased.

title_en: The six-freedom motion track data processing method of drop test pre-buried sensor
abstract_en: The six-freedom motion track data processing method of drop test pre-buried sensor, comprises the following steps：The relative referential of object of which movement is set up based on ground, the relative coordinate system of object of which movement is set up based on drop test pre-buried sensor, when collecting object of which movement, monitoring point voltage data in a coordinate system on object；Step voltage data is converted into Mechanical Data, monitoring point on object is respectively converted into linear acceleration component of the monitoring point in each axle of referential on object in the linear acceleration of each axle of coordinate system, and the linear acceleration component to monitoring point on object in each axle of referential is sued for peace respectively, obtain linear acceleration of the monitoring point in each axle of referential on object, and it is converted into linear acceleration of the object mass center in each axle of referential, time is integrated, obtain barycenter linear velocity and displacement component of the object mass center in each axle of referential, draw out the time-histories function and displacement function of object of which movement.The present invention has scientific generality, can be widely used in falling rocks Disaster Study.

title_en: Searching machine people based on various biosensors and 3D cameras

title_en: A kind of multipath based on Bayes's compressed sensing utilizes through-wall radar imaging method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multipaths based on Bayes's compressed sensing to utilize through-wall radar imaging method.The present invention is being parallel to the multiple position transmitting trains of pulse of metope and is being obtained echo-signal using Dan Zhandan dual-mode antenna Millimeter Wave Stepped-Frequency High Resolution Radar system, the measuring signal that compression sampling obtains relatively small amount is carried out to echo-signal by random measurement matrix, then joint constructs compressed sensing model according to the designed dictionary of wall multipath reflection characteristic, scene information after wall is reconstructed to come from measuring signal using Bayes's compression sensing method, finally completes through-wall radar imaging using the information reconstructed.Present invention reduces cost, reduce the record time, at the same Bayes's compressed sensing technology use so that calculating speed faster, required observation data volume it is less, the precision of images obtained using method in conjunction with multipath is higher and restrained effectively the appearance of diplopia.

title_en: A kind of implementation method of the ultra-broadband wall-through radar imagery algorithm based on FPGA

title_en: A kind of underground criminal case material evidence detection system and method based on geological radar

title_en: Driver Vital Detecting System using Impulse UWB RADAR
title_ko: 임펄스 초광대역 레이더를 이용한 차량 운전자 생체 신호 측정 경보 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an alarm system (100) for measuring a bio-signal of a vehicle driver using an impulse ultra wide band (UWB) radar, which comprises: an impulse UWB radar module (110) for receiving a wireless signal reflected by emitting a UWB impulse signal toward a heart (H) and a lung (L) of a driver; a conversion module (120) for converting the received wireless signal for the driver into heartbeat and respiration signals; a bio-abnormality analysis module (130) for comparing the converted heartbeat and respiration signals with the range of predetermined normal heartbeat and respiration values to determine a bio-abnormality; and an alarm module (160) for generating an alarm by receiving information on the bio-abnormality through a communications module (150) when the bio-abnormality analysis module (130) determines the bio-signal as the bio-abnormality that the heartbeat or respiration signals are out of the range of the predetermined normal heartbeat and respiration values.

title_en: Neck-worn physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the sensor can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: A kind of life detection radar breathing of FMCW broadbands and heartbeat signal extraction algorithm
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of breathing of FMCW broadbands life detection radar and heartbeat signal extraction algorithm, and compared with prior art, the present invention has following beneficial effect：Breathing and the heartbeat signal of many people can simultaneously be obtained,By using Coiflets small echos,Compared to traditional frequency domain filtering,The small echo can well keep reconstructing border and the energy of breath signal,Treatment especially to short time signal is particularly evident,Using the higher hamonic wave for filtering based on double coefficient LMS adaptive filter algorithms breath signal,And the adaptive filter algorithm does not need extra reference signal,Due to employing the step-size in search factor successively decreased in algorithm,Heartbeat signal can preferably be retained while breath signal harmonic wave is filtered,By selecting the suitable initial step length factor,Heartbeat signal can be rapidly converged to based on double coefficient LMS adaptive filter methods,And less steady output rate is kept in longer time,So that be finally recovered heartbeat signal frequency content is more accurate in a long time.

title_en: Method of manufacturing loess wood
title_ko: 황토목재 제조방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 황토목재 제조방법에 관한 것으로 더욱 상세하게는, 황토목재 제조방법은 황토를 소금과 혼합한 혼합물을 0.1 ~ 5㎚ 크기의 입자로 제조하는 제 1 공정, 상기 제조한 황토 원료, 규소 또는 알루미늄으로 이루어지는 염알루미늄 계열의 무기질 경화제 및 물을 혼합하여 황토원액을 제조하는 제 2 공정, 목재를 함침로에 투입하는 제 3 공정, 상기 함침로에 진공을 가하여 목재 내부의 수분 및 불순물을 제거하는 제 4 공정, 상기 함침로의 저장탱크에 황토원액을 공급하는 제 5 공정, 상기 함침로의 압력을 가하여 상기 황토원액을 목재 조직 내부로 침투시키는 제 6 공정, 상기 가압을 해제하고 진공을 가하여 목재 표면의 잔재물 및 과잉흡수된 황토원액을 회수하는 제 7 공정, 상기 황토원액을 회수한 목재를 8시간 ~ 7일 동안 60 ~ 120℃의 온도에서 건조하는 제 8 공정 및 상기 건조한 목재의 표면을 샌딩처리하는 제 9 공정으로 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 하는 황토목재 제조방법에 관한 것이다. 
또한 본 발명에 따라 제조된 황토목재는 산업적인 측면에서 황토의 원가가 저렴하여 원재료인 황토의 구입이 용이하며 취급시 안전하다는 장점이 있으며, 황토의 점성적 성질로 목재 내부의 융착이 용이하다는 장점이 있다. 
또한 환경적인 측면에서 황토를 사용함으로써 친환경적이며 습도조절능력이 뛰어나다는 효과가 있으며,목재와 함께 사용함으로써 통기성 및 축열성이 높으며 원적외선 방사로 인체 건강에 유익하며, 강력한 항균력으로 곰팡이 서식을 억제할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
또한 목재와 황토무기질 세라믹의 혼합으로 착화온도가 높아 화재 발생을 지연 또는 억제시키는 역할을 하며, 연소시 불꽃이 형성되지 않아 유독가스의 발생을 억제시키는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Handheld physiological sensor
abstract_en: A handheld device measures all vital signs and some hemodynamic parameters from the human body and transmits measured information wirelessly to a web-based system, where the information can be analyzed by a clinician to help diagnose a patient. The system utilizes our discovery that bio-impedance signals used to determine vital signs and hemodynamic parameters can be measured over a conduction pathway extending from the patient's wrist to a location on their thoracic cavity, e.g. their chest or navel. The device's form factor can include re-usable electrode materials to reduce costs. Measurements made by the handheld device, which use the belly button as a ‘fiducial’ marker, facilitate consistent, daily measurements, thereby reducing positioning errors that reduce accuracy of standard impedance measurements. In this and other ways, the handheld device provides an effective tool for characterizing patients with chronic diseases, such as heart failure, renal disease, and hypertension.

title_en: Physiological monitoring system featuring floormat and wired handheld sensor
abstract_en: A physiological monitoring system features a Floormat and Handheld Sensor connected by a cable. A user stands on the Floormat and grips the Handheld Sensor. These components measure time-dependent physiological waveforms from a user over a conduction pathway extending from the user's hand or wrist to their feet. The Handheld Sensor and Floormat use a combination of electrodes that inject current into the user's body and collect bioelectric signals that, with processing, yield ECG, impedance, and bioreactance waveforms. Simultaneously, the Handheld Sensor measures photoplethysmogram waveforms with red and infrared radiation and pressure waveforms from the user's fingers and wrist, while the Floormat measures signals from load cells to determine ‘force’ waveforms to determine the user's weight, and ballistocardiogram waveforms to determine parameters related to cardiac contractility. Processing these waveforms with algorithms running on a microprocessor yield the vital sign, hemodynamic, and biometric parameters.

title_en: Floormat physiological sensor
abstract_en: A stand-on physiological sensor (e.g. floormat) measures vital signs and various hemodynamic parameters, including blood pressure and ECG waveforms. The sensor is similar in configuration to a common bathroom scale and includes electrodes that take electrical measurements from a patient's feet to generate bioimpedance waveforms, which are analyzed digitally to extract various other parameters, as well as a cuff-type blood pressure system that takes physical blood pressure measurements at one of the patient's feet. Blood pressure can also be calculated/derived from the bioimpedance waveforms. Measured parameters are transmitted wirelessly to facilitate remote monitoring of the patient for heart failure, chronic heart failure, end-stage renal disease, cardiac arrhythmias, and other degenerative diseases.

abstract_en: A handheld device measures all vital signs and some hemodynamic parameters from the human body and transmits measured information wirelessly to a web-based system, where the information can be analyzed by a clinician to help diagnose a patient. The system utilizes our discovery that bio-impedance signals used to determine vital signs and hemodynamic parameters can be measured over a conduction pathway extending from the patient's wrist to a location on their thoracic cavity, e.g. their chest or navel. The device's form factor can include re-usable electrode materials to reduce costs. Measurements made by the handheld device, which use the belly button as a ‘fiducial’ marker, facilitate consistent, daily measurements, thereby reducing positioning errors that reduce accuracy of standard impedance measurements. In this and other ways, the handheld device provides an effective tool for characterizing patients with chronic diseases, such as heart failure, renal disease, and hypertension.

title_en: Floormat physiological sensor
abstract_en: A stand-on physiological sensor (e.g. floormat) measures vital signs and various hemodynamic parameters, including blood pressure and ECG waveforms. The sensor is similar in configuration to a common bathroom scale and includes electrodes that take electrical measurements from a patient's feet to generate bioimpedance waveforms, which are analyzed digitally to extract various other parameters, as well as a cuff-type blood pressure system that takes physical blood pressure measurements at one of the patient's feet. Blood pressure can also be calculated/derived from the bioimpedance waveforms. Measured parameters are transmitted wirelessly to facilitate remote monitoring of the patient for heart failure, chronic heart failure, end-stage renal disease, cardiac arrhythmias, and other degenerative diseases.

title_en: Physiological monitoring system featuring floormat and wired handheld sensor
abstract_en: A physiological monitoring system features a Floormat and Handheld Sensor connected by a cable. A user stands on the Floormat and grips the Handheld Sensor. These components measure time-dependent physiological waveforms from a user over a conduction pathway extending from the user's hand or wrist to their feet. The Handheld Sensor and Floormat use a combination of electrodes that inject current into the user's body and collect bioelectric signals that, with processing, yield ECG, impedance, and bioreactance waveforms. Simultaneously, the Handheld Sensor measures photoplethysmogram waveforms with red and infrared radiation and pressure waveforms from the user's fingers and wrist, while the Floormat measures signals from load cells to determine ‘force’ waveforms to determine the user's weight, and ballistocardiogram waveforms to determine parameters related to cardiac contractility. Processing these waveforms with algorithms running on a microprocessor yield the vital sign, hemodynamic, and biometric parameters.

abstract_en: The invention belongs to Radar Signal Processing Technology and life medical science/tele-medicine field, it is related to a kind of human life signal high precision measuring method based on Terahertz radar, step is：(S1) radar system emission measurement signal；(S2) radar echo signal is obtained, range Imaging is carried out according to echo-signal, and select the coverage unit related to human body target；(S3) phase ranging processing is carried out, the phase changing capacity of human body target is obtained, by phase unwrapping and the displacement variable of human body target is converted to；(S4) displacement variable of human body target is decomposed using empirical mode decomposition method, filters out the displacement component related with heartbeat to human body respiration, additive combination obtains displacement signal；(S5) displacement signal is carried out being fourier transformed into frequency domain, selects the parameter of the peak value in frequency domain, as human body respiration and heartbeat signal.The present invention is applicable special human body and environment, with higher Doppler sensitivity and measurement capability.

According to the present invention, by doing an MRI according to a synchronizing signal, an ultrasound image and an MRI can be provided in real time. In addition, it is possible to precisely track a position of an interested area and measure the temperature of the interested area so stable ultrasound treatment is possible.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예는, 대상체의 일 호흡주기를 감지하여 호흡감지신호를 생성하는 호흡센서부; 상기 호흡감지신호를 이용하여 상기 일 호흡주기 중 어느 하나의 시구간에 대응되는 동기화 신호를 추출하는 정보처리부; 자기공명영상 촬영을 위한 자기장이 인가되는 중공을 포함하고, 상기 동기화 신호에 따라 상기 대상체의 관심영역의 자기공명영상을 생성하는 자기공명영상 생성부; 상기 대상체의 관심영역에 촬상용 초음파를 조사시키는 초음파 프로브(probe)를 포함하며, 상기 자기공명영상 생성부의 일 측에 배치되어 상기 관심영역의 초음파 영상을 생성하는 초음파영상 생성부; 및 상기 자기공명영상 생성부의 일 측에 배치되며, 상기 초음파영상 및 상기 자기공명영상을 이용하여 상기 관심영역에 집속(focused) 초음파를 조사하는 초음파 치료부;를 포함하는, 초음파 치료 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Detection apparatus of vital parameters on steering wheel
title_ko: 스티어링 휠에 장착된 생체 파라미터 검출장치
abstract_en: A detection apparatus of vital parameters on a steering wheel is provided. The apparatus includes a horn switch, remote control switches configured to operate devices within a vehicle and a vital signal detector configured to detect a vital signal of an operator. The vital signal detector includes a detection sensor that is configured to detect the vital signal of the operator and a photo sensor that is mounted on the remote control switch. Accordingly, the separate space for the assembling portion of the vital signal detector is not required and the volume of the apparatus and the number of components are reduced. The mountability and the aesthetics are improved.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 혼스위치와, 차량의 기기를 작동시키는 리모컨 스위치와, 탑승자의 생체 신호를 검출하는 생체신호 감지부가 장착된 스티어링 휠에 장착된 생체 파라미터 검출장치에 있어서, 상기 생체신호 감지부는, 탑승자의 생체 신호를 검출하는 감지센서와, 광센서를 포함하여, 상기 리모컨 스위치에 장착되어, 스티어링 휠을 파지한 상태에서 생체신호 감지부의 파지가 용이하고, 스티어링 휠의 리모컨 스위치에 생체신호 감지부를 일체로 장착함으로써 별도의 조립부가 필요하지 않게 되어 편의성의 향상되고, 생체신호 감지부를 리모콘 스위치에 내장하여 견고한 조립구성을 이루며, 감지센서를 인쇄회로기판에 전기적으로 연결시 볼팅 및 솔더로 인하여 강건하게 고정되는 스티어링 휠에 장착된 생체 파라미터 검출장치에 관한 것이다.
assignees: HYUNDAI MOTOR CO LTD;DAESUNG ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: A kind of united through-wall radar object localization method of ellipse-hyperbolic
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of target location algorithm suitable for through-wall radar imaging, and first, target area after wall is detected using linear array antenna arrays more than two passages；Then offseted using adjacent periods pulse and extract activity concealed target and utilization Step Frequency radar feature acquisition target and transmitting-receiving array element spacing after wall；Then target location is determined by conventional elliptical Cross Location Method, recycles hyperbola Cross Location Method to determine coordinates of targets；The position of target is determined finally by the low coordinate of error-sensitivity in two methods of selection respectively.The present invention can be accurately positioned to concealed target after wall, and compare conventional mapping methods with higher positioning precision.

title_en: Multi-target back wall one-time multipath suppression method after three-dimensional imaging of through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target rear wall one-time multipath inhibition method after through-wall radar three-dimensional imaging, which comprises the steps of firstly extracting objects in all images from an original radar three-dimensional image after binarization; then extracting barycentric coordinates of all objects, and sequencing the objects in an ascending order according to Euclidean distances from the barycentric coordinates to the center of the radar array; secondly, calculating the direct path propagation distance and the multipath path propagation distance from all objects to each antenna array element; then defining correlation matching coefficients, and calculating correlation matching coefficients of direct path propagation distance and multipath path propagation distance of the object two by two; and finally, defining a decision threshold and a rule, judging whether the two objects have a target-multipath relation according to the correlation matching coefficients of the two objects, and removing all multipaths in the image after finding out the multipaths. The method can effectively remove the back wall multipath in the through-wall radar three-dimensional image once.

title_en: Electronic device for measuring biometric data and device for charging the electronic device
title_ko: 생체 정보를 측정하는 전자 장치 및 그를 충전하는 장치
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 다양한 실시예는 생체 정보를 측정할 수 있는 전자 장치 및 그를 충전하는 장치에 관한 것이다. 상기 전자 장치는 하우징; 상기 하우징의 일면에 위치하며, 도전성 재질의 장식물을 이용하여 형성되는 제1전극; 상기 하우징의 타면에 위치하며, 상기 전자 장치의 착용 시 사용자의 신체에 접촉되는 제2전극; 상기 제1전극 및 상기 제2전극과 전기적으로 커플되는 센서 모듈; 상기 센서 모듈과 전기적으로 커플되는 프로세서; 상기 프로세서와 전기적으로 커플되는 디스플레이 모듈; 및 상기 프로세서와 전기적으로 커플되는 메모리를 포함하되, 상기 메모리는 상기 센서 모듈이 상기 제1전극 및 상기 제2전극을 통해 사용자의 생체 신호를 측정하고, 상기 프로세서가 상기 측정된 생체 신호를 분석하여 사용자의 건강 상태에 대한 정보를 상기 디스플레이 모듈을 통해 사용자에게 제공하도록 하는 명령을 저장할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 기술적 사상에 바탕을 둔 다양한 실시예가 가능하다.

title_en: Apparatus and method of trouble shooting for big-signal sensor in vehcile
title_ko: 차량용 생체신호 센서 고장 진단 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: A method for diagnosing trouble of a bio-signal sensor in a vehicle comprises the following steps of: measuring a first bio-signal through a bio-signal sensor in correspondence with a signal inputted from a seating sensor; measuring a second bio-signal through the bio-signal sensor in correspondence with the input through interface in a vehicle; and determining whether the bio-signal sensor is out of order in accordance with existence of a signal left from a critical range which is set as the second bio-signal corresponds to the first bio-signal.
abstract_ko: 차량용 생체 신호 센서의 고장 진단 방법은 착석 센서로부터 입력되는 신호에 대응하여 생체 신호 센서를 통해 제1 생체 신호를 측정하는 단계, 차량 내 인터페이스를 통한 입력에 대응하여 생체 신호 센서를 통해 제2 생체 신호를 측정하는 단계, 및 제2 생체 신호가 제1 생체 신호에 대응하여 설정된 임계 범위를 벗어나는 신호를 포함하는 지에 따라 생체 신호 센서의 고장 여부를 판단하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: HYUNDAI MOTOR CO LTD;OMRON AUTOMOTIVE ELECTRONICS;OMRON AUTOMOTIVE ELECTRONIC KOREA CO LTD

title_en: Ground Penetrating Radar buried target localization method and system based on box spline wavelets frame
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of Ground Penetrating Radar buried target localization method and system based on box spline wavelets frame.The present invention obtains the echo image data of Ground Penetrating Radar first, and removes the direct wave image in the image, obtains pretreated Gpr Signal；Then pretreated Gpr Signal is decomposed using box spline wavelets, and carries out edge positioning to decomposition result；It is fitted the boundary curve of image, chooses vertex of the point that curve derivative is zero as radar image；Buried target curvilinear equation is finally established, two points in the Liang Ge branch on the radar image vertex on asymmetric selection edge are fitted buried target curve using 3 fitting process, to realize the positioning of buried target.Localization method of the invention improves the precision of target positioning, for metal pipe line and nonmetal pipe line shallow-layer detection all that may be present, is not likely to produce false-alarm；And algorithm is simple, runing time is short, improves the efficiency of target positioning.

title_en: A kind of indoor fire-fighting UAS
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of indoor fire-fighting UAS, including for obtaining the position data of indoor objects for interior structure mapping laser radar module used, the camera module for obtaining indoor picture and auxiliary positioning, the loudspeaker module for sending sound searching or guide indicator of trapped personnel, the sound detection module for detecting voice, and for detecting the life detection module of sign of life；The laser radar module, camera module, loudspeaker module, sound detection module and life detection module are all connected to the winged control plate of unmanned plane, the control command sent by flying control plate is received, and the data collected are sent to the integrated data processing platform outside scene of fire by the wireless transport module for flying by being connected to control plate.The utility model is easy to rescue personnel more quickly and accurately to understand scene of fire interior structure and trapped personnel situation, and the information of directiveness can be provided for rapid development rescue method, is advantageous to improve rescue efficiency.

title_en: A kind of underground mine disaster sign of life detection and alignment system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of detection of underground mine disaster sign of life and alignment system, including Transmission Fibers, positioned at generating laser L face to face, optical splitter P, circulator C, phase detectors D, data collecting card Q, signal transacting main frame N, and the optical fiber acoustic detection probe A positioned at mine passage, when mine disaster occurs, by the sign of life for calling for help voice signal acquisition trapped personnel caused by the activity such as sound and walking for gathering and monitoring the personnel for being confined in underground.Meanwhile optical fiber sound wave sensing probe A equidistantly distributes according to certain, it can realize and the position for being stranded personnel in the pit is positioned by information such as the different optical fiber sound wave sensing probe A intensities of sound collected.The positional information of trapped personnel is provided for rescue personnel.The present invention use transmission line of the optical fiber as signal, due to light weight, it is corrosion-resistant the advantages that, be hardly damaged when mine disaster occurs, it is ensured that the validity in signals transmission.

title_en: A kind of life detection car, wearable device and virtual reality detection system
abstract_en: A kind of life detection car, wearable device and virtual reality detection system, life detection car includes vehicle main body, life-detection instrument, sensor assembly, at least four cameras and processor, vehicle main body is provided with the running assembly of driving life detection car traveling, and processor is connected with running assembly, life-detection instrument, sensor assembly and all cameras.The surrounding environment image that sign of life, the life detection car of sensor assembly detection and the range information and camera of surrounding objects that can be detected due to the application by life-detection instrument are shot, under the control of a processor, so that direction automatic running of the life detection car towards sign of life, search person in distress and its accurate location, rescue personnel is allowed in the place away from hazardous environment, the information that life detection car is passed back can be received by wearable device, understand site environment as on the spot in person, the decision of next step action is precisely made, unnecessary casualties is reduced.

title_en: System and method for estimating vital signs
abstract_en: A system for estimating breathing frequency and heartbeat frequency of a subject, comprises at least one ultra-wideband (UWB) transceiver, connected to at least one hardware processor, configured to: receive a plurality of readings from the UWB transceiver, each of the readings having a time and comprising a plurality of intensity values at the time, each of the intensity values having a corresponding distance value representing a distance between the UWB transceiver and the subject; determine a Range-Doppler map from the plurality of readings; analyze the Range-Doppler map to determine a breathing frequency value of the subject; perform null steering of a plurality of Doppler-map frequencies in the Range-Doppler map to nullify the breathing frequency value and integer multiples of the breathing frequency value to obtain a plurality of combined frequencies; and determine a heartbeat frequency value for which a plurality of computed frequencies corresponds with the plurality of combined frequencies.

title_en: Fire fighter's alignment system based on Internet of Things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of fire fighter's alignment system based on Internet of Things, including：Information terminal, it includes image collection assembly, voice talk module, intelligence sensor；For gathering information；Information receives and Transmission system, for sending and receiving information by communication；And floor manager terminal, for receiving, transmitting and display data.The present invention provides a kind of fire fighter's alignment system based on Internet of Things, the Real-time Feedback of the information such as accident site environment, personnel positions and vital sign is realized, the safety of science decision commander and live emergency management and rescue personnel for accident floor manager provide technological means.
assignees: SUZHOU TEAMAY NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Heartbeat detection radar system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of heartbeat detection radar system, radar system includes：Radar transmitter, for launching the signal of predetermined waveform；The transmitting antenna being connected with radar transmitter, the signal for radar transmitter to be launched are radiated to default security region；Reception antenna, the echo-signal of human heartbeat's signal is included for receiving；The signal to noise ratio regulation circuit being connected with reception antenna, for improving the signal to noise ratio of low frequency signal in echo-signal；The frequency mixer being connected with signal to noise ratio regulation circuit, for the echo-signal of signal to noise ratio regulation circuit input to be carried out into Frequency mixing processing with default input signal；The A/D converter being connected with frequency mixer, the mixed frequency signal for frequency mixer to be inputted are converted to data signal；The terminal processor being connected with A/D converter, for detecting the heartbeat signal included in data signal.The present invention determines whether invader by detecting the heartbeat signal of human body, can strengthen security safety.

title_en: Waistband monitoring analysis for a user
abstract_en: Methods, apparatuses, and computer readable mediums for waistband monitoring analysis for a user are provided. In a particular embodiment, a waistband monitoring device is configured to generate a motion pattern based on motion data from a motion sensor coupled to the waistband monitoring device; receive physiological data generated by a physiological sensor coupled to the waistband monitoring device, wherein the physiological data indicates at least one vital sign of the user; identify an activity of the user that corresponds to the motion data and the physiological data; and generate an analysis of the user's performance of the identified activity based on the motion data and the physiological data.

title_en: Apparatus and method for measuring bio-signal by using impulse radar signal
title_ko: 임펄스 레이더 신호를 이용하여 생체 신호를 측정하기 위한 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 임펄스 레이더 신호를 이용하여 생체 신호를 측정하기 위한 장치 및 방법을 개시한다. 본 발명의 일실시 예에 따른 임펄스(impulse) 레이더(radar) 신호를 이용하여 생체 신호를 측정하기 위한 전자 장치는 상기 생체 신호와 관련된 적어도 하나 이상의 임펄스 레이더 신호를 송수신하는 레이더부; 및 상기 적어도 하나 이상의 임펄스 레이더 신호 중 일부 신호들에서 기준 신호와 상기 기준 신호를 제외한 나머지 신호들을 결정하고, 상기 기준 신호와 상기 나머지 신호들에 대하여 상호 상관(cross correlation) 연산을 수행하고, 상기 상호 상관 연산에 따른 최대값을 획득하고, 상기 최대값을 주파수 성분의 스펙트럼으로 변환하고, 상기 주파수 성분을 분석함으로써 상기 생체 신호를 측정하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Method and Apparatus for Matching Vital sign Information to a Concurrently Recorded Data Set
abstract_en: An approach is provided for matching vital sign information to a concurrently recorded data set according to a time domain. The approach involves determining sensor information collected from one or more sensors configured to monitor one or more vital signs of one or more objects within a monitored area. The approach also involves processing and/or facilitating a processing of the sensor information to detect the one or more objects and to track the one or more vital signs of the one or more objects over a time domain. The approach further involves matching the one or more vital signs of the one or more objects to a concurrently recorded data set based on the time domain. The approach further involves storing at least one record of the one or more vital signs matched to the concurrently recorded data set.

title_en: A kind of intelligent search and rescue system based on wireless networking and location technology
abstract_en: The utility model is related to a kind of intelligent search and rescue system based on wireless networking and location technology, wherein system includes search and rescue robot, and the search and rescue robot includes the first car body, the first Power Component, first microprocessor, locating module, life detection module, the first power module and the first wireless communication module；Communication robot；Host computer, the host computer is communicated with first wireless communication module and/or second wireless communication module.Using this kind of system, arm processor is combined with ZigBee wireless sensor network technologies, utilize the intelligent search and rescue robot control core of ARM platform buildings, and aligned environment detection sensor system and vital signs detecting system, robot system is more effectively applied to search and rescue field, greatly improve the automaticity, concertedness and controllability of search and rescue robot, increase search efficiency, the search and rescue time is reduced, the requirement searched and rescued on a large scale is met.

title_en: Alarm devices of biological signals detection for fireman
title_ko: 소방관용 생체신호감지 경보장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for alarming biological signal detection for a fireman. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the device for alarming the biological signal detection for the fireman comprises: a lower body (100) which is attached to a shirt or underwear; and an upper body (200) which is combined with the lower body (100) to be detached. The device for alarming the biological signal detection for the fireman easily detects biological signals.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방복의 일측에 부착함으로써 설정 값 이상의 생체신호가 감지되면 경보신호를 발생할 수 있도록 무선신호를 송출하는 경보장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 소방관의 호흡수 및 심박수를 동시에 감지할 수 있으며 휴대가 더욱 용이한 소방관용 생체신호감지 경보장치에 관한 것으로, 소방관의 진압복 내측에 착용하는 셔츠 또는 속옷에 부착되는 하측몸체와, 상기 하측몸체에 착탈할 수 있도록 결합되는 상측몸체로 구성되고, 상기 상측몸체의 내측에 설치된 피씨비에는 호흡수 및 심박수를 감지하여 수치가 설정범위를 벗어나면 소정의 전기적 신호를 발생하는 호흡감지센서 및 심박감지센서와, 상기 호흡감지센서 및 심박감지센서에서 발생된 전기적 신호를 제어하는 엠씨유와, 상기 엠씨유의 제어신호에 따라 엘이디 점등, 부저경보음 발생, 진동발생을 위해 무선신호를 송수신하는 블루투스모듈이 설치되되, 상기 하측몸체는 셔츠 또는 속옷에 부착되는 하측커버와, 상기 하측커버의 내측에 결합되며 복수의 접속단자가 형성된 단자고정부재와, 상기 단자고정부재의 외측에 결합되는 패킹링을 포함하여 구성되며, 상기 상측몸체는 전원버튼 및 표시부가 구비된 상측커버와, 상기 상측커버의 하측에 결합되는 설치부재와, 상기 설치부재의 상측에 결합되는 피씨비를 포함하여 구성된 것을 특징으로 한다. 따라서 본 발명은 호흡감지센서 및 심박감지센서가 소방관의 호흡수 및 심박수를 감지하고, 설정범위를 벗어나면 엘이디 점등과 진동 및 경보음을 발생할 수 있는 무선신호를 송출함으로써 사용자가 신속히 대피할 수 있도록 하여 긴박한 상황에서 더욱 안전하게 대처할 수 있는 장점이 있다. 또한, 소방관의 진압복 내측에 착용하는 셔츠 또는 속옷에 부착할 수 있도록 구성됨으로써 생체신호의 감지가 더욱 용이하고, 휴대 및 사용이 더욱 편리한 효과가 있다.

title_en: System for monitoring survival in danger zone
title_ko: 위험공간에서의 생존 감지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a survival detecting system in a dangerous space. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the survival detecting system in a dangerous space comprises: a radar unit; a terminal unit; and a lamp unit. The survival detecting system in the dangerous space effectively detects survival and a position of a monitored person.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 위험공간에서의 생존 감지 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 피감지자가 위치하는 공간인 위험공간에 배치되며, 초광대역(UWB : Ultra Wide Band) 주파수를 사용하는 레이더로 마련되어 상기 피감지자의 생체신호를 감지하는 레이더부; 상기 위험공간 외부에 배치되며, 상기 레이더부로부터 전달되는 상기 생체신호를 화면에 표시하며, 상기 생체신호를 기초로 상기 피감지자의 상태가 위험하다고 판단되는 경우 비상신호를 생성하는 단말부; 및 상기 위험공간에 배치되며, 상기 비상신호를 전달받는 경우 점등하는 램프부를 포함하되, 상기 위험공간은, 터널 내부 또는 가스탱크 내부 또는 지하실 내부 또는 하수구 내부 또는 엘리베이터 내부 또는 비상계단을 형성하는 공간 또는 복도를 형성하는 공간 중 어느 하나로 마련되며, 상기 램프부는, 복수개로 마련되며, 소정의 간격으로 이격되어 상기 위험공간을 형성하는 구조물의 천정에 각각 설치되며, 상기 레이더부는, 복수개로 마련되어 복수개의 상기 램프부 사이에 각각 설치되며, 상기 레이더부는, 제1전파를 상기 피감지자로 송신하는 송신부와, 상기 제1전파가 상기 피감지자에 송신된 이후 반사되는 제2전파를 수신하는 수신부와, 상기 제1전파와 상기 제2전파를 기초로 상기 피감지자의 생체신호를 생성하는 연산부와, 상기 생체신호를 상기 단말부로 전달하는 통신부와, 상기 송신부와 수신부와 연산부와 통신부에 전원을 공급하는 배터리부를 포함하며, 상기 배터리부는, 화재가 발생하는 경우, 화염에 의한 열에너지 및 빛에너지를 흡수하여 전원을 충전하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 외부에서 위험공간에 위치하는 피감지자의 생존 및 위치가 효과적으로 감지될 수 있다.

title_en: Emergency Notification System

The emergency notification system comprises a biometric sensor unit (200), a target person terminal unit (300), a management server unit (400), and the designated output unit (500).

title_en: A kind of estimation method of underground metalliferous round tube radius and buried depth based on BP neural network
abstract_en: The estimation method of the invention discloses a kind of underground metalliferous round tube radius and buried depth based on BP neural network buries radar return data in different media using the metal circular tube that Ground Penetrating Radar forward simulation obtains different radii and buried depth；The backward energy value in A-Scan echo-peak, peak value arrival time and the preset time period right above metal circular tube is extracted, with this 3 parameter construction feature vectors, composition characteristic vector matrix, the data set as training sample importation.The data set of training sample output par, c is made of the relative dielectric constant of the radius of known metal round tube, buried depth and underground medium.The structure for designing BP neural network, is trained BP neural network with training sample data, and the characteristic parameter of Ground Penetrating Radar echo data to be measured is input to the BP neural network after training, is estimated the radius and buried depth of underground metal circular tube.The present invention can fast, accurately estimate the radius and buried depth of underground metalliferous round tube.

title_en: Vital sign detection system with random body movement cancellation
abstract_en: A vital sign detection system includes a radar device, a nonreciprocal network, a first antenna and a second antenna. An output signal from the radar device is delivered to the first antenna via the nonreciprocal network and then transmitted to a first side of a biological subject via the first antenna. A first reflection signal from the first side of the biological subject is received by the first antenna and then delivered to the second antenna via the nonreciprocal network and then transmitted to a second side of the biological subject via the second antenna. A second reflection signal from the second side of the biological subject is received by the second antenna and then delivered to the radar device via the nonreciprocal network for vital sign detection with random body movement cancellation.

title_en: A kind of robot for the detection of colliery tunnel safety
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of robot for the detection of colliery tunnel safety, safety detection device and safety device for life-saving including crawler type walking mechanism and for colliery tunnel, be provided with the crawler type walking mechanism for install safety detection device and safety device for life-saving from steady head；The safety detection device includes the sensor cluster for being sealingly disposed in rear in crawler type walking mechanism, and the sensor cluster includes infrared thermography and gas detector；The safety device for life-saving includes the life-detection instrument of sealed set and is operated in the wireless tranceiver communication system of ultrashort wave frequency band.The operating efficiency that the robot detected provided by the present invention for colliery tunnel safety improves gas in the tunnel of colliery, the potential safety hazard of electric wiring is investigated, when solving colliery tunnel generation cave-in accident, it is excessive because searching and rescuing scope to being buried survivor's search-and-rescue work, search and rescue team member and search and rescue that direction is indefinite to cause to search and rescue the problem of being wasted time.

title_en: Life detection intelligent carriage
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of life detection intelligent carriage.Life detection intelligent carriage of the present utility model includes：One-chip computer module, motor drive module, independent current source module, infrared obstacle avoidance module, human body induction module, GPS module and gsm module.The utility model has the advantages that the intelligent carriage with life detection function, it is contemplated that the complexity of application environment, configure various types of sensors and communication module etc. and be used to monitor car body local environment in real time, obtain effective information, it is very big to lift rescue efficiency；Dolly, which can enter in narrow and small complex environment, searches for survivor, unnecessary injury caused by avoiding the non-intellectual of environment possible to rescuer；Vehicle body is light simultaneously, small volume, and motion is flexible, and power consumption is low, can be used for a long time in complex environment, solves the problems, such as that mankind's activity is limited.

title_en: A kind of directing self-extinguishing module
abstract_en: It the utility model is related to a kind of directing self-extinguishing module, including vision sensor, foamite container, extinguishing chemical jet module, head, extinguishing chemical flexible pipe and processor, vision sensor is integrated in same head with extinguishing chemical jet module, vision sensor includes visible image capturing module and infrared thermal imaging module, it is seen that the light photographing module and camera lens of infrared thermal imaging module is identical with the nozzle direction of extinguishing chemical jet module and centerline parallel.Fire suppression module of the present utility model has the characteristics that operating efficiency is high, fire extinguishing accuracy rate is high, and fire suppression module of the present utility model is equipped in mobile robot or other platforms, it is possible to increase the fire disaster emergency processing rapidity and accuracy in buried cable tunnel.

title_en: Physiological signal sensor
abstract_en: A physiological signal sensor to measure life signs includes at least one first and one second Doppler detectors, at least one first amplification filter, at least one second amplification filter, a processor, and a transceiver. Data from the physiological signal sensor is sent to the first and second Doppler detectors to detect first and second physiological signals from different locations on a living body. The two physiological signals are sent to the first and second amplification filters and amplified and filtered, and converted to obtain a first and second digital sensed signal. Digital signal processing is carried out on the digital sensed signals to obtain first and second physiological information which are outputted via the transceiver.

title_en: Physiological monitoring system featuring floormat and wired handheld sensor
abstract_en: A physiological monitoring system features a Floormat and Handheld Sensor connected by a cable. A user stands on the Floormat and grips the Handheld Sensor. These components measure time-dependent physiological waveforms from a user over a conduction pathway extending from the user's hand or wrist to their feet. The Handheld Sensor and Floormat use a combination of electrodes that inject current into the user's body and collect bioelectric signals that, with processing, yield ECG, impedance, and bioreactance waveforms. Simultaneously, the Handheld Sensor measures photoplethysmogram waveforms with red and infrared radiation and pressure waveforms from the user's fingers and wrist, while the Floormat measures signals from load cells to determine ‘force’ waveforms to determine the user's weight, and ballistocardiogram waveforms to determine parameters related to cardiac contractility. Processing these waveforms with algorithms running on a microprocessor yield the vital sign, hemodynamic, and biometric parameters.

title_en: Handheld physiological sensor
abstract_en: A handheld device measures all vital signs and some hemodynamic parameters from the human body and transmits measured information wirelessly to a web-based system, where the information can be analyzed by a clinician to help diagnose a patient. The system utilizes our discovery that bio-impedance signals used to determine vital signs and hemodynamic parameters can be measured over a conduction pathway extending from the patient's wrist to a location on their thoracic cavity, e.g. their chest or navel. The device's form factor can include re-usable electrode materials to reduce costs. Measurements made by the handheld device, which use the belly button as a ‘fiducial’ marker, facilitate consistent, daily measurements, thereby reducing positioning errors that reduce accuracy of standard impedance measurements. In this and other ways, the handheld device provides an effective tool for characterizing patients with chronic diseases, such as heart failure, renal disease, and hypertension.

title_en: Synthetic aperture through-wall radar multipath decoy elimination method based on more imaging dictionaries
abstract_en: The present invention discloses the synthetic aperture through-wall radar multipath decoy elimination method based on more imaging dictionaries, applied to multipaths restraint technical field of synthetic aperture through-wall radar, first, according to fabric structure feature, through-wall radar from preceding wall displacement and each reflection path echo, the direct echo dictionary of target and multipath decoy dictionary are established；Secondly, to echo data, rear orientation projection's imaging is carried out using the direct echo dictionary of target and multipath decoy dictionary respectively, obtains target aerial image and multipath decoy spatial image；Finally, target aerial image and multipath decoy spatial image are subjected to incoherent fusion, realize the suppression of a multipath decoy in building；Complexity is lower compared with prior art, and multipaths restraint effect is preferable.

title_en: Plurisensorial system adapted for the prevention of professional diseases in the working environment, and method for the use of the system
abstract_en: A multi-sense system adapted for prevention of occupational diseases in a working environment is described, which comprises: - a protective facial mask, adapted for application in the front zone of a person's face, comprising nose and mouth areas, and comprising: - a temperature and humidity sensor (5, 6) adapted to be activated when the mask is worn, and adapted to provide time-related data concerning said activation as well as temperature and humidity values; - removable air filter elements (3, 4) applied to the front side parts of the mask; - inhalation (8) and exhalation (7) valves applied to the front zone of the mask, in front of the mouth, when the mask is worn; - elements for securing the mask to the face (2, 9, 10, 11, 12); - an electronic nose device (3) adapted to provide, when worn by the person, time-related data about the quality of the air in said working environment; - a breathing detection device, adapted to provide, when worn by the person, time-related data about the respiratory rate; - a data processing and displaying device, adapted to receive and store the data outputted by said protective facial mask, electronic nose device and breathing detection device, also adapted to process and display said data in order to determine a condition wherein said rotective facial mask needs to be worn.

title_en: Methods, apparatuses, and systems for radio-frequency imaging sensors for advanced fingterprint biometrics and medical imaging
abstract_en: Methods, apparatuses, systems, and implementations of an ultra-compact RF (30 GHz-10 THz) imaging sensor topology that provides a new insight into the human skin are disclosed. The skin tissue is the largest organ in the body—both in weight and surface area—and stores valuable information that can revolutionize security biometrics and mobile health monitoring. The proposed compact sensor enables, for the first time, portable and wearable devices to perform superior biometric authentication compared to current fingerprint methods. Additionally, these devices could probe into the skin to monitor vital signs in real-time and enable mobile health monitoring.

title_en: Video search and rescue robot based on ZigBee wireless positioning and search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention provides a video search and rescue robot based on ZigBee wireless positioning, which comprises a ZigBee coordinator, zigBee blind nodes and more than three ZigBee auxiliary positioning mechanisms, wherein the ZigBee blind nodes are arranged on the search and rescue robot, a controller, a communication module, an infrared monitoring module and a video monitoring module are further arranged on the search and rescue robot, and the ZigBee auxiliary positioning mechanisms are arranged at the vertex positions of the smallest regular polygon surrounding a search and rescue area. According to the invention, the search and rescue robot searches for life signals by utilizing the pyroelectric infrared sensor, the cradle head camera is utilized to capture surrounding environment images and videos, the environment images and videos are transmitted to the intelligent terminal by utilizing a Wi-Fi network built by the search and rescue robot or outside, the ZigBee blind node module is arranged on the search and rescue robot, the ZigBee auxiliary positioning mechanism and the ZigBee coordinator module which are arranged on the periphery of a disaster scene are matched to calculate the real-time position coordinates of the search and rescue robot, and the real-time position coordinates are displayed on an electronic map of the search and rescue intelligent terminal, so that the search and rescue work of wounded persons in disaster ruins is realized.

title_en: Connection structure of underground distribution line

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a connection structure for lead-in and lead-out lines of a buried underground line. More particularly, the present invention relates to a connection structure of lead-in and lead-out lines of a buried underground line which can quickly seal an underground pipe by smoothly spraying extinguishing powder from a case by sensing a fire by a fire sensor so as to smoothly extract a hitting unit from the case as well as extinguishing the fire while simultaneously notify a manager immediately and preventing the fire from spreading when the fire occurs in a distribution board.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지중매설형 지중전선의 인입출선 연결구조에 관한 것으로써, 더욱 상세하게는 배전반에 화재가 발생할 시 관리자에게 즉각적으로 알 수 있도록 하는 동시에 지중배관으로 불길이 번지지 않도록 하는 한편, 화재감지센서의 화재감지에 따라 케이스로부터 소화분말의 분사가 원활하게 이루어질 수 있도록 하여 화재진압과 함께 케이스로부터 타격부의 인출이 원활하게 이루어질 수 있도록 하여 지중배관의 밀폐가 신속히 이루어질 수 있도록 하기 위한 지중매설형 지중전선의 인입출선 연결구조에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Method and system of attachment and detection of attachment of a wearable sensor to clothing material
abstract_en: A method and system of universal, secure attachment with attachment detection mechanism, of a wearable sensor-unit to any article of clothing worn around the body in order to measure vital signals of a person, such as motion, movements and activity levels. The method and system permits: reliable attachment to any article of clothing; an attachment in any position to clothing or fabric worn by a person; and detection for the wearable sensor attachment to an article of clothing to minimize false alarms.

title_en: Sound object detection method and system based on multi-functional ultra-broadband wall-through radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses the sound object detection method based on multi-functional ultra-broadband wall-through radar and system.This method includes the pattern for determining through-wall radar detection target；The signal of receiver is gathered, gathers M*N groups altogether；M is effective impulse length, represents distance to data；N is pulse group number, and representation speed is to data；When the pattern of through-wall radar detection target is moving-target detection pattern, M>N；When the pattern of through-wall radar detection target is quiet target detection mode, M=N；Seeking the distance of M*N group data, the points of Fourier transformation are 2k times, obtain 2k*N frequency domain data to Fourier transformation；Wherein 2k>M；Speed is asked for Fourier transformation to Fourier transformation result to the distance of M*N group data again, the points of Fourier transformation are n times, obtain 2k*N frequency domain data；The data of coverage in 2k*N frequency domain data are intercepted, are added up according to Doppler to the data of interception；Object detection process is carried out to the result after cumulative, calculates target location coordinate.

title_en: Geogrid with Having a Function of Ground Sink Detection and Falling Accident Prevention
title_ko: 땅 꺼짐 탐지 및 추락 사고 방지 기능을 갖는 지오그리드
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a geogrid with a ground sink detecting function and a falling accident preventing function, which is able to detect sinking of the ground in accordance with changes in the terrain below a road, prevent a falling accident by notifying authorities of the position with a risk of sinking of the ground and prevent a vehicle and a person from falling into a space formed due to the ground sinking. When sinking of the ground (17) where a net mat (100) is buried proceeds, the current situation occurs directly before the sinking of the ground, or when sinking of the ground has occurred, a coordinate is formed on a power cable (150) of the net mat (100) to check the corresponding position by an arranged sensor (200). Thus, there is an effect to prevent an accident caused by the ground sinking.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로 하부에서 지형의 변화에 따른 땅 꺼짐을 탐지하고, 땅 꺼짐 위험 위치를 통보해주어 추락 사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있으며, 땅 꺼짐이 발생하더라도 이로 인해 생긴 공간으로 차량 및 인명이 추락하는 것을 방지할 수 있는 땅 꺼짐 탐지 및 추락 사고 방지 기능을 갖는 지오그리드에 관한 것으로, 그물 매트(100)가 매설된 지반(17)의 땅 꺼짐이 진행되고 있거나, 또는 땅 꺼짐이 발생하기 직전 상태에 있거나, 또는 땅 꺼짐이 발생했을 경우, 그물 매트(100)의 전원 케이블(150) 상에 좌표를 형성하여 배치된 탐지 센서(200)로 해당 위치를 확인할 수 있고, 땅 꺼짐으로 발생할 수 있는 사고를 예방할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Multi-sending and multi-receiving through-wall thunder imaging back-front-back wall oscillation once multi-path restraining method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-sending and multi-receiving through-wall mine imaging back-front-back-wall oscillation one-time multi-path restraining method. After obtaining an original radar image, binarizing the original radar image, extracting central values of all targets in the original image, calculating direct propagation distance and multipath propagation distance of target electromagnetic waves, calculating a normalized multipath error coefficient and an error threshold value, thereby judging the target of the original image, finally rejecting the multipath false target, realizing multipath inhibition, effectively identifying the real target in the radar image and the two front and back wall oscillation one-time multipath false targets, the loss of a real target can not be caused while the multipath false target is inhibited, two different multipath forms in one-way multipath can be perfectly considered, the method has the advantages of comprehensively and completely inhibiting the multipath, avoiding omission, ensuring the practical effect of the through-wall radar in the detection environment of the closed building and providing powerful guarantee for operators to make correct decisions.

title_en: Through-wall radar remote assisting system and method based on WiFi secure communications
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of through-wall radar remote assisting system and method based on WiFi secure communications, including：At least one through-wall radar device, the transmitting antenna of through-wall radar device can launch ultra wide band electrically magnetic wave, penetrate in the personnel targets after wall is mapped to wall, receive the ultra wide band electrically magnetic wave reflected by reception antenna, extract personnel targets information；At least one wireless network module, the wireless network module are attached with through-wall radar device, and by wireless network module, the personnel targets information of detection is uploaded to remote assisting system center by through-wall radar device；Beneficial effect of the present invention：Remote assisting system is solved under complicated operational environment, through-wall radar device needs long-range the problem of carrying out assisting to judge, due to being the wireless communication based on WPA between remote assisting system and through-wall radar device, so safe, transmission range is grown, and versatility is high.

title_en: Method and apparatus for real-time non-invasive optical monitoring of decompression sickness state
abstract_en: Described herein is a device and system and method for the detection of naturally occurring gas bubbles in the bloodstream; in one embodiment, a wireless optical device may be placed on various parts of the body including a finger or earlobe or is coupled with the SCUBA mouthpiece and detects certain vital signs such as heart rate, blood oxygen saturation (SpO2) and respiration rate by analyzing the photoplethysmogram (PPG) from a miniature sensor. There is also a method and apparatus for real-time non-invasive optical monitoring of actual state of decompression sickness are presented. The method is based on simultaneous measurements of PPG signals in different locations of human body and analysis of such a factor as phase shifts between various locations, change the shape of PPG signal between different locations, existence and modification of slow trends and low frequency modulations and angular distributions of the out-coming light.

title_en: Methods circuits assemblies devices systems facets and associated machine executable code for detecting vital signs
abstract_en: Disclosed are a composite bio-parameter sensor assembly and a wearable device including same, for detecting vital signs of a subject person. The sensor assembly includes one or more sensors, mounted on an outer contact surface of the assembly, having a sensing surface to optically detect one or more parameters of a pulse of the subject. The sensor assembly further includes an additional sensor, facing an inner cavity of the assembly, for optically detecting displacement of the one or more outer sensors. The one or more sensors and the additional sensor are positioned on the opposite sides of a printed circuit board (PCB).

title_en: Apparatus For Disaster Relief
title_ko: 재난 구조 장치
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an apparatus for disaster relief comprises: a driving unit which provides a driving force to move to a disaster scene in which a disastrous event happens in the case of the disastrous event; a sensor unit which detects victims belonging to the disaster scene and senses biological signals of the detected victims during the movement; a control unit which includes a victim status determination unit determining the present status of the victims based on the sensed biological signals, and a behavior determination unit differently determining a relief measure to be performed with respect to the victims in accordance with the perceived present status of the victims; and a screen unit marking a map showing the victims the way to evacuate.
abstract_ko: 상기 과제를 해결하기 위한 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 재난 구조 장치는 재난 이벤트가 발생한 경우 상기 재난 이벤트가 발생한 재난 현장으로 이동하기 위한 동력을 제공하는 구동부; 상기 이동 과정 중에 상기 재난 현장에 속하는 재난자를 탐색하고, 상기 탐색된 재난자의 생체 신호를 감지하는 센서부; 상기 감지된 생체 신호를 기초로 상기 탐색된 재난자의 현재 상태를 판단하는 재난자 상태 판단부 및 상기 판단된 현재 상태에 따라 상기 재난자에 대하여 수행할 구호조치를 상이하게 판단하는 동작 판단부를 포함하는 제어부; 및 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 상기 재난자에게 대피 방법을 안내하는 지도를 표시하는 화면부를 포함한다.

title_en: The measurement apparatus and measuring method of a kind of contactless buried pipe track forces cun
abstract_en: The measurement apparatus and measuring method of a kind of disclosure of the invention contactless buried pipe track forces cun, including electromagnetic wave saturating ground equipment, signal preprocessing device is connected with electromagnetic wave saturating ground equipment, buried depth locator is connected with signal preprocessing device, line size measuring appliance is connected with buried depth locator, imaging processor is connected with signal preprocessing device, buried depth locator and line size measuring appliance respectively, and aobvious control instrument is connected with imaging processor；The present invention solves the position that current ground penetrating radar detection technology can only position underground piping, the problem of being unable to accurate measurement underground piping size, the present invention can realize lossless non-contact measurement, to underground surrounding medium and underground piping without destruction, also the dimension information of different depth underground piping can under the antenna of different frequency, be detected.

title_en: A kind of electromagnetic wave three-dimensional reverse-time migration imaging method under higher-Order Time-Domain algorithm
abstract_en: A kind of electromagnetic wave three-dimensional reverse-time migration imaging method under higher-Order Time-Domain algorithm, it is related to Computational electromagnetics and wideband radar detection.It is applicable not only to the buried target of ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR and hidden media area is reconnoitred and data acquisition imaging, is further widely applied to the particular problems such as geological prospecting, road prospecting and through-wall imaging.The experimental signal detected using three-dimensional high-order time-domain finite difference and ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR, obtains the positive field distribution for the time domain excitation signal that ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR receives and the reverse field distribution of time domain observation signal that ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR receives.In the case where meeting the requirement of reverse-time migration image-forming condition, overcome inclination angle to limit in theory, and accurately image can be realized.The numerical simulation of reverse-time migration Imaging Simulation is carried out to target area using radar signal, the dynamic information of target to be measured can effectively be obtained, there is higher imaging resolution advantage compared to traditional magnetography algorithm, taken a firm foundation to obtain the identification of target to be measured and parametric inversion.

title_en: System with vital sign data sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system having an analysis unit 1 and sensors 2, 3, wherein the sensors 2, 3 are capable of measuring vital sign parameters of a living being 4 and the analysis unit 1 is capable of performing an analysis based on the measured vital sign parameters. The analysis unit 1 is provided such that the analysis unit 1 can send a command signal 8 to the external arrangement 5, 6, 7 depending on the result of the analysis, so that the external arrangement 5, 6, 7 performs an action in accordance with the command signal 8. The invention also relates to an application, a method and a computer program product. The user can thereby save time and achieve a particularly high level of operating comfort.

title_en: A kind of real-time mobile disaster emergency system model in before institute and scene
abstract_en: A kind of real-time mobile disaster emergency system model in before institute and scene, with electronics first aid glasses end, expert's remote assistance end, it is characterized in that at electronics first aid glasses end, expert's remote assistance is provided with application software in end, electronics first aid glasses end rescuer wears when suing and labouring, electronics first aid glasses end includes the physical aspect mirror body similar with common spectacles, electronic equipment is provided with mirror body, electronic equipment includes environment camera, full shot, microphone, light sensor, infrared positioning lamp, earphone, environment camera has more sets, electronics first aid glasses end also has medical treatment collection accessory kit and signal transmission component, medical treatment collection accessory kit can gather the physiological parameter data of reflection vital sign patient, signal transmission component can realize information exchange with expert's remote assistance end.The present invention realizes real-time communication between long-range first visual angle of various salvation scene experts and field first aid personnel, and being admitted to hospital for patient, offer is basic to be prepared, the application prospect having had.

title_en: A kind of six crawler belt autonomous formula coalmine rescue devices
abstract_en: The invention belongs to colliery emergency rescue technology field, be related to a kind of six crawler belt autonomous formula coalmine rescue devices, its small volume, be easy to carry, simple operation, manufacturing cost it is low.Include the car body of square；360 degree of rotary units, walking unit and scalable mechanical arm unit are provided with the car body；Controller, walking unit, hoofing part unit, GPS positioning unit, infrared ray vital signs detector, night vision cam, voice transfer unit, scalable mechanical arm unit, mechanical arm driver element, sensor integration unit, power module, data storage element, wireless communication unit, Digiplex and emergency light are additionally provided with the car body；The controller receives the control signal that the Digiplex sends by wireless communication unit；The hoofing part unit is connected with walking unit, and the mechanical arm driver element is connected with scalable mechanical arm unit.

title_en: System and method for customized addiction therapy based on bio signal
title_ko: 생체신호 기반의 환자 맞춤형 중독치료 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a patient-customized disintoxication system based on a biosignal, and a method therefor. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the patient-customized disintoxication system comprises: a sensor measuring the biosignal from a user; a condition determination part determining condition of the user based on the measured biosignal; a cognitive behavior treatment image determination part determining images of cognitive behavior treatment based on the determined condition of the user; and an image providing part providing the user with the determined images of cognitive behavior treatment.
abstract_ko: 실시예들은 사용자로부터 생체신호를 측정하는 센서, 측정된 생체신호를 기초로 사용자 상태를 결정하는 상태 결정부, 결정된 사용자 상태를 기초로 인지행동치료 영상을 결정하는 인지행동치료 영상 결정부, 및 결정된 인지행동치료 영상을 사용자에게 제공하는 영상 제공부를 포함하는 생체신호 기반의 환자 맞춤형 중독치료 시스템 및 그 방법에 관련된다.

title_en: A kind of life detecting device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of life detecting device, is related to human life detection field.The present invention includes main body, is provided with infrared thermography and radar life-detection instrument in main body, the Athey wheel mechanism that bottom part body is provided with chassis and is connected with chassis, and Liang Ge troubleshootings mechanism is provided with chassis.Troubleshooting mechanism can remove roadblock, and carry the metal object opened and influence radar life-detection instrument investigative range, improve the detection accuracy of radar life-detection instrument；Athey wheel mechanism can be searched and rescued with the function of realization device autonomous, ensured the personal safety of rescue worker in adverse circumstances instead of rescue worker.There is the present invention man-made environment to disturb less, result is stable accurately, search and rescue the characteristics of scope is big.
