title_en: Method for real-time tracking of multiple moving targets by through-wall radar in complex environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for tracking multiple moving targets in real time by a through-wall radar in a complex environment. Firstly, predicting the positions and the energies of all tracks at the current moment by using a Kalman filter, respectively constructing two neighborhoods with the positions and the energy predicted values as centers, and associating all targets in the two neighborhoods with the corresponding tracks; then, an improved nearest neighbor method based on position and energy information and a bipartite graph maximum weight matching algorithm are utilized to find out targets which are respectively matched with each motion track to realize the best matching from the related targets; then, judging the current states of the tracks according to the track quality based on the log-likelihood ratio so as to decide track maintenance, new track generation or track deletion; and finally, smoothing the existing track by using a Kalman filter. The method is simple, high in execution efficiency and suitable for the portable through-wall radar partition wall to track the multiple moving human body targets, and the working efficiency of the through-wall radar can be effectively improved.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting sensorcraft
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire-fighting sensorcraft, including body, it is characterised in that：Body is surrounded by wing, wing end is provided with infrared ray proximity switch, registering weather vane is provided with the top of body, inside is provided with battery, the front side wall and rear wall of body are provided with storage box one, the inner top of storage box one is provided with motor, the output axis connection transmission device of motor, transmission device connects push rod, push rod connection expansion link, expansion link is flexibly connected infrared hemisphere camera, organism bottom center is provided with storage box two, the bottom of storage box two is provided with four pieces of baffle plates, baffle plate side is provided with fire monitor, the inner top of storage box two is provided with lowering or hoisting gear, lowering or hoisting gear lower end connects thermal infrared life-detection instrument by connection component, the bottom of storage box two is biparting two-way vertical hinged door.The utility model advantage：It can predict that the intensity of a fire is moved towards, and the personnel in the condition of a disaster can be detected so that fire-fighting center quickly and accurately carries out fire control and personnel sue and labour.

title_en: A kind of Zai Hou detection and rescues robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Zai Hou detection and rescues robot, including micromachine, wheel stand, wheel and axletree, the main shaft of the micromachine is connected by shaft coupling with the axletree, the axletree is connected with the wheel, the both ends of the axletree are connected by bearing with the wheel stand, the wheel stand is arranged on secondary stent, the secondary stent is connected with one-level support, the upper end of the one-level support is connected with frame, illuminating lamp is provided with the frame, the illuminating lamp is arranged on lighting lamp bracket, temperature sensor is installed in the frame of the side of the illuminating lamp.Detection and rescue robot architecture is simple after the calamity, it is readily transported, suitable for scene after the complicated calamity of various environment, life-detection instrument and security protection camera are provided with device, can in time find and feedback signal, detecting location are accurate, ensure the accuracy of search and rescue position, meanwhile illuminating lamp is provided with device, it is easy to night to be searched and rescued.

title_en: A kind of life detection and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of life detection and rescue robot, including pedestal, electric machine stand and storing bin, the impact faces end set has the electric machine stand, servomotor is provided with the electric machine stand, the servomotor end set has rotating shaft, the roller end is provided with transmission belt wheel set, and the transmission belt wheel set end set has drive shaft.Beneficial effect is：The present apparatus carries out infrared imaging to rescue environment by infrared induction camera and infrared imaging device and finds captive to detect life, and captive is moved to carry out trajectory calculation rear drive equipment to image-forming information by cascade algorithm processor, and the accurate location information of captive is received by gps signal receivers and sent by wireless signal to external device to be rescued, the relief supplies that captive can be taken off in storage bin are simply saved oneself, it instead of traditional artificial search and rescue mode, search efficiency is improved, has ensured the promptness of rescue.

title_en: A kind of unmanned plane device that can launch fire service inventory to captive in building fire
abstract_en: A kind of unmanned plane device that can launch fire service inventory to captive in building fire, including unmanned plane and connected ground control centre, wherein, unmanned plane includes a cabin, rotor is connected with cabin gusset, and an airborne laser radar and fire alarm bell are provided with cabin, and the fire service inventory delivery device is drum, inside there is the chamber of multiple storage fire service inventories, the fire service inventory bottom plate of each chamber is inclined-plane；The fire service inventory delivery device side is opening surface, and each chamber has a side door, and side door controls folding by rotary electric switch；The detection device is installed at the center of fire service inventory delivery device lower surface, has spinfunction, can scan the environment of large area around the unmanned plane.In rescue operations, unmanned plane is using camera and airborne laser radar record site environment and obstacle information and sends picture to ground control centre, is searched and rescued by radar life-detection instrument, fire service inventory is dispensed into trapped personnel hand in time.

title_en: A kind of rescue UAS for fire of high-rise building
abstract_en: A kind of rescue UAS for fire of high-rise building；Vital signs is detected using radar life-detection instrument, it is automatic to launch escape wet towel, simple relief goods, extend rescue time；Take pictures by GPS positioning system and circular flight and obtain trapped personnel ambient condition information, these data are sent back into ground base station using Wireless data transmission equipment；While ground base station carries out data analysis and sends rescue personnel to stand by, unmanned plane continues to investigate, surrounding environmental gases are detected using smog Long Range Detecting and Ranging, above led the way by unmanned plane in evacuation process, once detect in the range of certain distance have endanger gas if send alarm signal.Rescue UAS described in the utility model for fire of high-rise building, substantially increases search rate and rescue is efficient.

title_en: Heartbeat detection radar system
abstract_en: A kind of heartbeat detection radar system is the utility model is related to, radar system includes：Radar transmitter, for launching the signal of predetermined waveform；The transmitting antenna being connected with radar transmitter, the signal for radar transmitter to be launched are radiated to default security region；Reception antenna, the echo-signal of human heartbeat's signal is included for receiving；The signal to noise ratio regulation circuit being connected with reception antenna, for improving the signal to noise ratio of low frequency signal in echo-signal；The frequency mixer being connected with signal to noise ratio regulation circuit, for the echo-signal of signal to noise ratio regulation circuit input to be carried out into Frequency mixing processing with default input signal；The A/D converter being connected with frequency mixer, the mixed frequency signal for frequency mixer to be inputted are converted to data signal；The terminal processor being connected with A/D converter, for detecting the heartbeat signal included in data signal.The utility model determines whether invader by detecting the heartbeat signal of human body, can strengthen security safety.

title_en: A kind of haze mouth mask
abstract_en: The invention belongs to student with protective articles technical field, discloses a kind of haze mouth mask, including：Mouth mask body, it is sleeved at human body mouth and nose；Breather valve, it is inlaid in mouth mask body, realizes the exchange of mouth mask inside and outside air；Filter, breather valve are connected, and inside is provided with disinfection filtering bag, realize absorption, sterilization, filtering to impurity in extraneous air；Breathing detection sensor, it is inlaid in mouth mask body on wall, combines updating formula for the pressure and temperature in acquisition port cover body, and using air pressure, temperature to obtain the air pressure change in mouth mask body, by the air pressure in mouth mask body and the change of temperature, to perceive the breathing situation of wearer；Controller, electrically connected with breathing detection sensor, the electric signal of reception is analyzed and handled.The haze mouth mask can effectively carry out absorption by filter and disinfection filtering bag to the haze in air and pernicious gas composition and close filtering, and pass through the breathing situation inside breathing detection sensor detection mouth cover body.

title_en: Control system based on quadrotor auxiliary search and rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of control system based on quadrotor auxiliary search and rescue device, including flight module and search and rescue module, the flight module include master control set, communication unit, remote control signal receiver, remote control；The search and rescue module includes MCU, infrared life-detection instrument, earth station, GPS.The master control set is arranged on inside quadrotor, master control set and MCU wireless connections；Remote control signal receiver communicates connection with master control set；The remote control and remote control signal receiver wireless connection；The infrared life-detection instrument and GPS communicate connection with MCU；The utility model is by the way that auxiliary search and rescue device is be combined with each other with aircraft so that control search can be realized by aircraft in the place that some are with a varied topography or are searched and rescued by the bad realization in ground so as to reach the purpose of auxiliary rescue.Pass through the setting of infrared life-detection instrument so that rescue worker easier can have found to treat the position of rescue worker.
assignees: ANHUI LANGBA SMART TECH CO LTD

title_en: Through-wall radar diffraction tomography method based on compressed sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of through-wall radar Diffraction tomography method based on compressed sensing, carried imaging method uses compression sampling to the frequency domain scattering field data of concealed target after wall in frequency domain, then field data is all scattered in frequency band using openness resume work using sparse algorithm for reconstructing of reception signal in each observation position, imaging reconstruction is finally carried out to concealed target after wall using conventional diffractive chromatography imaging method.The present invention can still ensure the quality of target imaging reconstructed results, substantially increase systematic survey speed in the case where system frequency domain data collection capacity substantially reduces.

title_en: Mobile sensor platform
title_ko: 모바일 센서 플랫폼
abstract_en: Disclosed is a mobile sensor platform including a variety of hardware and software to perform sensing operations of various passengers in a mobile sensor platform. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a method includes: a step of using one or more sensors in a vehicle to continuously monitor a biosignal of a passenger in the vehicle; a step of generating data results from data fusing of different sensor signals received from at least one among one or more first electronic devices in the vehicle and one or more second electronic devices outside the vehicle and the biosignal; a step of using the data results to determine one or more operations to be performed on behalf of the passenger independently of the passenger; and a step where the vehicle performs the one or more operations independently of the passenger.
abstract_ko:
모바일 센서 플랫폼 내의 다양한 탑승자들의 센싱 동작을 수행하기 위한 다양한 하드웨어 및 소프트웨어를 포함하는 모바일 센서 플랫폼이 개시된다. 개시된 일 실시 예에 따른 방법은 차량 내의 하나 이상의 센서를 사용하여 차량 내의 탑승자의 생체 신호를 지속적으로 모니터링하는 단계, 차량 내의 하나 이상의 제1전자 장치, 및 차량 외부의 하나 이상의 제2전자 장치 중 하나 이상으로부터 수신된 다른 센서 신호들과 생체 신호의 데이터 융합으로부터 데이터 결과를 생성하는 단계, 데이터 결과를 사용하여, 탑승자와 독립적으로 탑승자를 대신하여 수행할 하나 이상의 동작을 결정하는 단계, 및
차량이 탑승자와 독립적으로 하나 이상의 동작을 수행하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for detecting abnormal respiration
title_ko: 이상호흡 감지 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is an apparatus for sensing abnormal breathing comprising: a sensor for sensing photoplethysmogram from optical signals received by being reflected from a user body; a bandpass filter for extracting signals of a necessary band from the photoplethysmogram received from the sensor; an analog-digital converter for performing a digital conversion for the filtered signal; and an abnormal breathing recognition unit which extracts a respiratory rate signal from the digital-converted photoplethysmogram signal, derives a plurality of respiratory rate feature values for the extracted respiratory rate signal through a time axis analysis, and senses abnormal breathing by using the derived plurality of respiratory rate feature values. The abnormal breathing sensing apparatus according to the present invention can be used in a survival monitoring for seniors living alone, soldiers separated during operations, and survivors isolated in a disaster/accident, and in a sleep quality diagnosis and monitoring thereof.
abstract_ko: 사용자 신체로부터 반사되어 수신되는 광신호로부터 광용적맥파를 센싱하는 센서, 상기 센서로부터 수신된 광용적맥파로부터 필요 대역의 신호를 추출하는 대역통과 필터, 상기 필터링된 신호에 대해 디지털 변환을 수행하는 아날로그-디지털 변환기, 및 디지털 변환된 광용적맥파 신호로부터 호흡률 신호를 추출하고, 추출된 호흡률 신호에 대해 시간 축 분석을 통해 복수의 호흡률 특징 값을 도출하고, 도출된 복수의 호흡률 특징 값을 이용해 이상 호흡을 감지하는 이상호흡 인지부를 포함하는 이상호흡 감지 장치가 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 이상호흡 감지 장치는 독거노인 및 군사 작전시 고립된 병사들, 재난/사고 현장에 고립된 사람들의 생존 여부 모니터링, 수면 질 진단 및 모니터링 등에 활용될 수 있다.

title_en: System for drawing digital map
title_ko: 영상정보와 수치데이터를 이용한 공간영상 도화 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fixed and spatial image drawing system using image information and numerical data, in which a plurality of GPS notification devices installed for each region where aerial imaging is performed, to be operated are maintained with the state of being buried in the ground during a normal time, and are exposed to the ground only when in use, emergency situations such as damage due to external impacts or a theft risk can be monitored in real time when in use on the ground, and a corresponding GPS notification device has a function of crime prevention through environmental design (CPTED) concept to improve cost effectiveness in accordance with the manufacturing, installation, and operation thereof. The fixed and spatial image drawing system using image information and numerical data comprises: a plurality of GPS notification devices; a GPS storage module; a lidar device; an elevation model storage module; a digital photographing module; an image storage module; a drawing module; and a numerical information synthesis module. Each of the GPS notification devices includes a housing, a solenoid actuator, a lift plate, a GPS receiver, a wireless transmitter, a forward and reverse rotation motor, a protection cover, a wireless communications module, an impact sensor, a tilt sensor, an infrared thermal image camera, a control unit, a storage unit, and a display unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 항공촬영이 진행되는 지역 단위로 복수 개 설치되어 운용되는 GPS 알림장치가 평상 시에는 지중에 매입된 상태를 유지하고 사용 시에만 지상으로 노출되고 지상에서의 사용 중에는 외부의 충격에 의한 파손 내지 도난 위험 등의 비상 상황이 실시간 감시될 수 있도록 하며, 해당 GPS 알림장치가 셉테드 개념의   기능을 가져 그 제작, 설치 및 운용에 따른 비용 대비 효율성을 높일 수 있도록 하는 영상정보와 수치데이터를 이용한 고정과 공간영상 도화 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 영상정보와 수치데이터를 이용한 고정과 공간영상 도화 시스템은 다수개의 GPS 알림장치, GPS 저장모듈, 라이다장치, 표고모델 저장모듈, 디지털 촬영모듈, 이미지 저장모듈, 도화모듈 및 수치정보 합성모듈을 포함하여 구성되고, GPS 알림장치 각각은 하우징, 솔레노이드 액츄에이터, 승하강 플레이트, GPS 수신기, 무선송신기, 정역회전모터, 보호커버, 무선통신모듈, 충격감지센서, 기울기 감지센서, 적외선 열화상 카메라, 제어부, 저장부 및 디스플레이부를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Method and appratus for measuring biometric data using radar
title_ko: 레이더를 이용하여 생체 신호를 측정하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Provided are a method and a device to measure a biometric signal by using radar. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the biometric signal measuring device includes: a first signal obtaining part obtaining a first signal, measuring a first biometric signal of a subject, from first radar; a second signal obtaining part obtaining a second signal, measuring both the first and second biometric signals of the subject, from second radar; a signal synchronizing part synchronizing the first and second signals; and a biometric signal detecting part removing the first biometric signal from the second signal and detecting the second biometric signal by calculating a difference between the first and second signals synchronized. The first radar is placed at a set distance to measure the first biometric signal from the subject, and the second radar is placed at a set distance to measure both the first and second biometric signals from the subject.
abstract_ko: 레이더를 이용하여 생체 신호를 측정하는 방법 및 장치가 제공된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 레이더를 이용하여 생체 신호를 측정하는 장치는 제1 레이더로부터 측정 대상자의 제1 생체 신호가 측정된 제1 신호를 획득하는 제1 신호 획득부, 제2 레이더로부터 상기 측정 대상자의 제2 생체 신호와 상기 제1 생체 신호가 모두 측정된 제2 신호를 획득하는 제2 신호 획득부, 상기 제1 신호와 제2 신호를 동기화하는 신호 동기화부 및 상기 동기화된 제1 신호와 제2 신호의 차이를 계산하여 상기 제2 신호에서 상기 제1 생체 신호를 제거하고 상기 제2 생체 신호를 검출하는 생체 신호 검출부를 포함하되, 상기 제1 레이더는 상기 측정 대상자로부터 상기 제1 생체 신호가 측정되도록 설정된 거리에 배치되고, 상기 제2 레이더는 상기 측정 대상자로부터 상기 제1 생체 신호 및 제2 생체 신호가 모두 측정되도록 설정된 거리에 배치되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Doppler's through-wall radar localization method based on LASSO feature extractions
abstract_en: The invention belongs to target following technical field, discloses a kind of Doppler's through-wall radar localization method based on LASSO feature extractions.Wherein, LASSO frequency estimation algorithms separate the component for demodulating back echo signal and estimate the frequecy characteristic of interesting target component；According to target instantaneous frequency, real-time estimation target position information, synthesizes target trajectory, realizes the tracking to target locating and tracking algorithm.The present invention can not only be on the basis of Doppler's Through-Wall Radar System terseness (only needing a transmitter and two receivers) and detection real-time (arithmetic speed is fast) be ensured, effectively improve the positioning accuracy to target, it can also solve the problems, such as " frequency ambiguity ", be realized at the same time for the track and localization of multiple target at the same time.In addition, the present invention, without lengthy and tedious calculating process such as multi-channel data fusions, arithmetic speed is fast, is with a wide range of applications in the target tracking domain of Doppler's through-wall radar.

title_en: A kind of Precise Position System for having the function of to monitor vital signs
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of Precise Position System for having the function of to monitor vital signs,Silicone band both sides position distribution for being fixed on user's wrist location has velcro,Two side positions of one side end face of silicone band are equipped with air bag,Position between described two air bags is equipped with flexible PCB,Heart rate sensor for monitor heart rate is installed on the rearward position of air bag,Body temperature transducer for monitoring user's body temperature is distributed in the forward position of air bag,Vital signs is monitored by adding heart rate sensor realization,The design greatly facilitates conceptual design and the deployment of emergency management and rescue,And body temperature transducer then realizes the real-time monitoring to user's body temperature,Wireless communication module is coordinated to transfer data in the receiving device in the external world,And identification card uses the design of low-power consumption,And then improve its cruising time,And card reader one,The work of card reader two and identification card influences from working environment,And then greatly improve registration,It is simple and reliable for structure.

title_en: A kind of vital sign remote monitoring device based on Kalman filtering and target following
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of vital sign remote monitoring devices based on Kalman filtering and target following, the vital sign observation circuit uses contactless radar detection circuit, its governor circuit has been also connected with human body tracking circuit, so that monitoring objective is still fallen in the coverage of radar detection antenna main lobe direction.Device can independent suspension in indoor open position, also can be arranged at as component in the household electrical appliances such as home computer or television set, set-top box, telephone set, home-services robot, in scope separated by a distance, the vital sign parameters such as contactless automatic tracking, monitoring solitary indoor old age, the heart rate of weakling, breathing, and pass through communication network, internet to remote monitoring equipment, transtelephonic real-time parameter and alarm signal, realize care facilities and relatives to old, weakling long distance monitoring.People under the guardianship can be freely movable indoors, has broken away from traditional monitor device and the action such as the sensor wearing of people under the guardianship and cable winds are limited.

title_en: Prevention System for Safety Accident of Driver Using Analysis of Individual Sleeping Pattern and Bio Rhythm and Method of Operating the Same
title_ko: 개인별 수면 패턴 및 생체 리듬 분석을 이용하는 운전자 안전 사고 예방 시스템 및 그 작동 방법
abstract_en: Provided is a system for preventing a driver from being injured. The system comprises: a first radio frequency mode radar for detecting a biological signal of a driver in a sleeping area of the driver; a second radio frequency mode radar for detecting a biological signal of the driver in a driving area of the driver; and a network storage apparatus wirelessly linked with the first and second radio frequency mode radars and analyzing the biological signal of the driver detected by the first and second radio frequency mode radars to periodically calculate biological rhythm of the driver.
abstract_ko: 운전자 안전 사고 예방 시스템이 제공된다. 운전자 안전 사고 예방 시스템은 대상자의 수면 공간에서 대상자의 생체 신호를 감지하기 위한 제 1 무선 주파수 방식 레이더, 대상자의 운전 공간에서 대상자의 생체 신호를 감지하기 위한 제 2 무선 주파수 방식 레이더, 및 제 1 및 제 2 무선 주파수 방식 레이더들과 무선으로 연동하되, 제 1 및 제 2 무선 주파수 방식 레이더들에 의해 감지된 대상자의 생체 신호를 분석하여 대상자의 생체 리듬을 주기적으로 계산하는 네트워크 저장 장치를 포함한다.

title_en: One kind is used for fire control security protection mask
abstract_en: The utility model discloses one kind to be used for fire control security protection mask, including main body and filter core, the upper end of the main body is equipped with thermal infrared life-detection instrument, and the inner surface of main body is equipped with wireless intercom, the top of the filter core is equipped with isolation type air respiratorresuscitator, and the lower end of filter core is installed with sealing reinforcer, the lower end of the sealing reinforcer is equipped with smoke filter, and the sealing reinforcer is fixedly connected with main body.It is described in the utility model a kind of for fire control security protection mask, equipped with smoke filter, wireless intercom and thermal-infrared sensing instrument, the pernicious gas generated after object burning can be filtered out so as to ensure safety of the fireman in fire fighting, and fireman can be facilitated to receive the instruction that higher level sends out in fire fighting, prevent fireman from can not find to be trapped in the people in shelter in fire fighting so as to cannot timely sue and labour, different operating situation is applicable in, brings better prospect of the application.
assignees: XINCHANG COUNTY WAIPOKENG ORGANIC TEA PROFESSIONAL COOP

title_en: The device of soil shear strength in situ measurement is used under a kind of piezoelectric effect
abstract_en: The utility model discloses the devices that soil shear strength in situ measurement is used under a kind of piezoelectric effect.Piezoelectric ceramic piece, soil moisture content sensor, shearing wave vibration source including mainly receiving shearing wave signal by two panels, soil moisture content sensor vertical are inserted into the soil body, and shearing wave vibration source and the two panels piezoelectric ceramic piece level of arranging in a line are buried in the earth；It is connected and installed by piezoelectric patches fixation kit between the shearing wave vibration source and two panels piezoelectric ceramic piece, piezoelectric patches fixation kit includes grip block and fixed link, one end of fixed link is installed with shearing wave vibration source, and two panels piezoelectric ceramic piece is fixed on the other end and the middle part of fixed link through grip block respectively.The utility model can be used in measuring soil shear strength using soil body shear wave velocity combination soil moisture content, the long-term in-situ monitoring soil shear strength variation of field condition is carried out, soil body stability calculates analysis and landslide in working for civil engineering construction, the law study of mud-stone flow disaster and forecast provides theoretical foundation.

title_en: Elevator wireless intercommunication warning device
abstract_en: The utility model is related to elevator safety technical fields, disclose elevator wireless intercommunication warning device, including the wireless talkback alarm terminal being arranged in elevator and the emergency rescue device being located at below wireless talkback alarm terminal；Wireless talkback alarm terminal includes central controller, the wireless telecommunications intercommunication module being connected with central controller, the data acquisition module being connected with central controller, the automatic alarm module being connected with central controller；Data acquisition module includes elevator data acquisition module and video acquisition module and the infrared vital sign inductor being integrated on wireless talkback alarm terminal；Compared with prior art, the elevator wireless intercommunication warning device of the utility model passes through design data acquisition module, wireless telecommunications intercommunication module, automatic alarm module, emergency rescue device extends rescue time in all its bearings when being elevator faults, reduce the mortality caused by accident, while improve the work efficiency of rescuer.

title_en: A kind of life-detection system based on unmanned plane
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to unmanned plane applied technical field; specifically provide a kind of life-detection system based on unmanned plane; life-information after calamity is detected by radar life-detection instrument of the carry on unmanned plane, is made of six rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicles, GPS module, protective cradle, radar life-detection instrument, antenna, unmanned controller, posture display, Minitype hand-held computer controller.Solve the problems, such as in rescue and relief work that artificial detection efficient is low, danger zone rescue personnel is unable to reach, it is convenient, efficient, accurate to have the advantages that.
assignees: MENGCHENG COUNTY YONGTENG MICRO PAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital signs detecting module for safeguard station
abstract_en: The utility model is a kind of vital signs detecting module for safeguard station, including the Ith road signal conditioning circuit (1), IIth road signal conditioning circuit (2), IIIth road signal conditioning circuit (3), IVth road signal conditioning circuit (4), vital sign parameter signals radiating circuit (5), totally 5 parts, which are combined, forms an one integral piece.For omnidirectional detection human body vital sign, safeguard station uses 4 road radar modules, radar module output signal amplitude is more compared with small and interference signal, 3 grades of filter amplification circuits are devised for this, the signal of amplifying circuit output enters wireless transmitter module ADC, after software algorithm is handled, breathing/beats are transformed into, are launched vital sign information with 121.5MHz/243MHz frequency ranges by safeguard station.The utility model first applies radar module on safeguard station, can send the vital sign of distress personnel to search and rescue center, greatly improve the efficiency and specific aim of search-and-rescue work.
assignees: WUHAN ZHONGYUAN MOBILCOM ENG CO LTD

title_en: Across the hole radar detection device of diaphram wall internal flaw and method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to underground engineering detection fields, disclose across the hole radar detection device and method of a kind of diaphram wall internal flaw.The invention vertically pre-buried test tube in diaphram wall, across hole radar method is used during detection, transmitting antenna and reception antenna are respectively placed in adjacent test tube, different location transmitting and reception frequency electromagnetic waves in test tube, since the dielectric constant and conductivity of rejected region are apparently higher than complete concrete structure, when electromagnetic wave is by the defects of diaphram wall region, its velocity of wave, amplitude and waveform can all change, therefore can be judged in diaphram wall with the presence or absence of the position of defect and defect by analyzing the form of electromagnetic wave, the information such as size and shape.
assignees: UNIV TONGJI;SHANGHAI ROAD AND BRIDGE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Through-wall radar remote assisting system based on WiFi secure communications
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of through-wall radar remote assisting system based on WiFi secure communications, including：Through-wall radar device, wireless network module and remote assisting system center；Through-wall radar device includes transmitting antenna and reception antenna；Transmitting antenna can emit ultra wide band electrically magnetic wave, penetrate in the personnel targets after wall is mapped to wall, while the ultra wide band electrically magnetic wave that reception antenna reception reflects；Wireless network module is attached with through-wall radar device, wireless network module and remote assisting system center to center communications；By wireless network module, the personnel targets information of detection is uploaded to remote assisting system center by through-wall radar device.The utility model advantageous effect：It solves under complicated operational environment, through-wall radar device needs remotely to carry out the problem of assistance judges, due to being the wireless communication based on WPA between remote assisting system and through-wall radar device, so safe, transmission range is long, and versatility is high.
assignees: SHANDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES INST AUTOMATION

title_en: A kind of life detection car, wearable device and virtual reality detection system
abstract_en: A kind of life detection car, wearable device and virtual reality detection system, life detection car includes vehicle main body, life-detection instrument, sensor assembly, at least four cameras and processor, vehicle main body is provided with the running assembly of driving life detection car traveling, and processor is connected with running assembly, life-detection instrument, sensor assembly and all cameras.The surrounding environment image that can be shot due to the application by the range information and camera for sign of life, the life detection car that sensor assembly detects and the surrounding objects that life-detection instrument detects, under the control of a processor, so that direction automatic running of the life detection car towards sign of life, search person in distress and its accurate location, rescue personnel is allowed in the place away from hazardous environment, the information that life detection car is passed back can be received by wearable device, understand site environment as on the spot in person, the decision of next step action is precisely made, reduces unnecessary casualties.

title_en: Individual safety system using wearable wireless device
title_ko: 웨어러블 무선 장치를 이용한 개인 안전 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a user safety ensuring system using a wireless wearable device. The user safety ensuring system includes the wireless wearable device and a user terminal. The wireless wearable device includes: a sensing unit which is attached to a specific body part of a user and includes at least two of the pressure sensors, voice sensors, motion sensors, image sensors, and bio-signal sensors; and a wearable control unit which recognizes the presence of a dangerous situation when sensing two or more abnormal signals in the detected signals from a location information receiver, a communication unit, pressure sensors, voice sensors, motion sensors, image sensors, and bio-signal sensors, generates rescue request signals including the location information of the location information receiver as short-range communication signals or wireless signals, and outputs the rescue request signals including the location information of the user to the communication unit. The user terminal receives the rescue request signals transmitted by the wireless wearable device and transmits the rescue request signals including the location information of the user to a rescue request system designated in advance.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 웨어러블 무선 장치를 이용한 사용자 안전 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 사용자의 특정 부위에 부착되며, 압력센서, 음성센서, 움직임센서, 영상센서 및 생체 신호 센서 중 적어도 둘 이상을 포함하는 감지부, 위치정보 수신기, 통신부, 상기 압력 센서, 음성 센서, 움직임 센서, 생체 신호 센서 및 영상센서로부터 검출된 신호들 중 적어도 둘 이상의 이상 신호가 감지되면 위험상황으로 인식하고, 상기 위치정보 수신기의 위치 정보를 포함하는 구조요청신호를 근거리 통신 신호 또는 무전 신호로 형성하고, 상기 사용자의 위치 정보가 포함된 구조 요청 신호를 상기 통신부로 출력하는 웨어러블 제어부를 포함하는 웨어러블 무선 장치와, 상기 웨어러블 무선 장치가 전송하는 구조 요청 신호를 수신하여, 미리 지정된 구조 요청 시스템으로 상기 사용자의 위치 정보가 포함된 구조 요청 신호를 전송하는 사용자 단말기를 포함한다.

title_en: glasses with measuring module and its emergency situation determination method
title_ko: 측정모듈이 구비된 안경을 이용한 위급상황판단 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency situation determining method using glasses having a measurement module. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the emergency situation determining method using glasses having a measurement module comprises a signal transmission step, a bio-signal determination step, an emergency situation determination step, and an emergency situation notification step. According to the present invention, the emergency situation determining method using glasses having a measurement module can rapidly perform follow-up action of a wearer.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 측정모듈이 구비된 안경은 안경 몸체(110)와; 뇌전도를 측정하기 위한 스트레스 지수 측정모듈(120)과; 심전도를 측정하기 위한 맥박 측정모듈(130)과; 운동량을 측정하기 위한 자이로 센서(140)와; 상기 스트레스 지수 측정모듈(120), 맥박 측정모듈(130), 자이로 센서(140)에서 신호를 수신받은 후, 뇌전도, 심전도, 운동량을 파악하고, 상기 뇌전도, 심전도, 운동량을 통해 사용자의 생체신호를 파악한 후, 생체신호에 따라 보청 장치(170) 또는 골전도 보청 장치(160)를 통해 착용자에게 알려주거나, 무선통신부(180)를 통해 외부로 전송하도록 제어하는 제어부(150)와; 상기 제어부(150)의 결과에 따라 소리를 출력하여 착용자에게 들리도록 하는 보청 장치(170)와; 상기 제어부(150)의 결과에 따라 골전도를 통해 착용자의 내이에 소리를 전달하는 골전도 보청 장치(160)와; 상기 제어부(150)의 결과에 따라 별도로 구비된 외부의 서버(200)로 신호를 전송하는 무선통신부(180)와; 배터리(190); 로 이루어지는 것이며,  
본 발명 측정모듈이 구비된 안경을 이용한 위급상황판단 방법은 측정모듈이 구비된 안경(100)의 안경 몸체(110)에 구비된 스트레스 지수 측정모듈(120), 맥박 측정모듈(130), 자이로 센서(140)에서의 신호가 제어부(150)로 전달되는 신호 전달단계; 상기 제어부(150)가 신호를 통해 착용자의 생체신호를 파악하는 생체신호 판단단계; 상기 제어부(150)가 생체신호를 통해 착용자의 위급상황을 판단하는 위급상황 판단단계; 상기 제어부(150)가 생체신호를 파악한 착용자의 위급상황이면 보청 장치(170) 또는 골전도 보청 장치(160)를 통해 착용자에게 위급상황임을 알려주거나, 또는 무선통신부(180)를 통해 별도로 구비된 외부의 서버(200)로 신호를 전송하여 서버(200)에서 위급상황을 확인이 필요한 보호자에게 위급상황임을 알려주는 위급상황 알림단계; 로 이루어지는 것으로, 
따라서 본 발명 측정모듈이 구비된 안경 및 이를 이용한 위급상황판단 방법은 안경에 스트레스 지수 측정모듈, 맥박 측정 모듈, 자이로 센서 등의 센서들을 구비하여 검사기를 일일이 붙이지 않아 일상생활에 지장이 없으며, 내장된 센서들의 무게도 사람이 느끼지 못할 정도로 가볍기에 사용에 불편하지 않고, 안경에 구비된 스트레스 지수 측정모듈, 맥박 측정 모듈, 자이로 센서를 통해 측정된 데이터를 통해 뇌전도, 심전도, 운동량을 파악하여 심신이 약한 노인 등의 착용자의 상태를 파악하고, 상기 착용자의 상태가 좋지 않다고 판단되면 보청 장치 또는 골전도 보청 장치를 통해 사용자에 알려주어 휴식 등으로 대처할 수 있도록 하며, 착용자의 상태가 위급하다고 판단되면 무선통신부를 통해 가족, 119안전신고센터, 사회복지기관, 기타보호자 등에 신호를 전송하여 알려줌으로써 가족, 119안전신고센터, 사회복지기관, 기타보호자 등에서 착용자의 후속조치가 빠르게 될 수 있도록 하는 현저한 효과가 있다.
assignees: PARK CHANG HOON;PARK SEONG BAE;KIM YOUN HO

title_en: A kind of robot for the detection of coal mine tunnel safety
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of robots for the detection of coal mine tunnel safety, safety detection device and safety device for life-saving including crawler type walking mechanism and for coal mine tunnel, be provided on the crawler type walking mechanism for install safety detection device and safety device for life-saving from steady holder；The safety detection device includes the sensor module for being sealingly disposed in rear in crawler type walking mechanism, and the sensor module includes infrared thermography and gas detector；The safety device for life-saving includes the life-detection instrument of sealed set and is operated in the wireless tranceiver communication system of ultrashort wave frequency band.The working efficiency that robot provided by the utility model for the detection of coal mine tunnel safety improves gas in coal mine tunnel, the security risk of electric wiring is investigated, when solving coal mine tunnel generation cave-in accident, it is excessive because searching and rescuing range to being buried survivor's search-and-rescue work, it searches and rescues team member and searches and rescues that direction is indefinite to cause to search and rescue the problem of being wasted time.

title_en: Underground utility location and damage prevention
abstract_en: A method of underground utility location and damage prevention that electronically registers together multi-layer underground and surface images of a surface volume with buried utilities and other infrastructures. Such method further comprises assembling and presenting the combination to a device in the field that visually guides crews in their safe digging of the ground nearby. The orienting, scaling, and registering of a first image layer is to a standardized orientation and scaling on a map of a photograph of a land surface from a zenith point in space above. Then the orienting, scaling, and registering of a second image layer is made to the standardized orientation and scaling on the map. This layer is a result of an ground penetrating radar investigation of buried objects point-by-point in an immediate search area of a corresponding ground surface. Underground buried objects and utilities are thereby located to make safe digging nearby.

title_en: Micropile and micropile molding method for earthquake-proof and strengthening ground
title_ko: 내진 및 지반강화용 마이크로파일 성형방법 및 상기 방법에 의하여 시공된 내진 및 지반강화용 마이크로파일
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a forming method of a micropile for earthquake resistance and ground reinforcement and a micropile for earthquake resistance and ground reinforcement constructed by the same and, more specifically, to a forming method of a micropile for earthquake resistance and ground reinforcement and a micropile for earthquake resistance and ground reinforcement constructed by the same which allow ground reinforcing work regardless of all ground regardless of strength and weakness of bearing power of the ground, facilitate forming work of a micropile for ground reinforcement to increase a work progress speed to shorten a construction period, and easily insert a steel bar vertically to a center of a bottom surface of a bore to fix the steel bar to guarantee design strength to property provide strength and easily absorb an S wave of an earthquake by the vertically buried steel bar even when being shaken by the S wave of the earthquake to minimize destruction of the micropile to be used as an earthquake resistant structure. The forming method of a micropile for earthquake resistance and ground reinforcement comprises: a step of drilling the ground by a bit; a step of embedding a steel bar on a center of a bore through a center hole in the bit in the drilled ground; and a step of lifting the bit while spraying air supplied from an air supply pipe installed on the bit through an air spray hole and spraying mortar supplied through a mortar supply pipe installed on the bit through a mortar spray nozzle in a state where the steel bar is embedded on the center of the bore to form a grout bulb.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 내진 및 지반강화용 마이크로파일 성형방법 및 상기 방법에 의하여 시공된 내진 및 지반강화용 마이크로파일에 관한 것으로, 지반의 지지력의 강약을 불문하고 모든 지반에 관계없이 지반의 보강작업이 가능하게 되며 지반을 보강하기 위한 마이크로파일의 성형작업이 용이하게 되어 작업의 진척속도가 빨라 시공기간이 단축되며 천공의 저면의 중앙에 수직으로 강봉을 용이하게 삽입시켜 고정시킬 수가 있게 되므로 설계강도까지 보장되어 강도가 제대로 발현되고 지진의 횡파로 인한 요동시에도 이러한 지진의 횡파를 용이하게 수직으로 매립된 강봉에서 흡수하게 되어 마이크로파일의 파괴를 최소한으로 하는 것이 가능하게 되어 내진용 구조로도 사용이 가능한 내진 및 지반강화용 마이크로파일 성형방법 및 상기 방법에 의하여 시공된 내진 및 지반강화용 마이크로파일을 포함하고, 
지반을 비트로 천공하는 단계와, 천공된 지반에 비트내의 중앙공을 통하여 강봉을 천공의 중앙에 근입시키는 단계와, 천공의 중앙에 강봉이 근입된 상태에서 비트에 설치된 에어공급관에서 공급된 에어를 에어분사공을 통하여 분사함과 동시에 비트에 설치된 몰탈공급관을 통하여 공급된 몰탈을 몰탈분사노즐을 통하여 분사하면서 비트를 상승시켜서 그라우트구근을 형성시키는 단계를 포함하는 본 발명에 따른 내진 및 지반강화용 마이크로파일 성형방법에 의하여 그 목적이 달성된다.

title_en: A kind of small sensible weight wide range tipping bucket rain gauge
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of small sensible weight wide range tipping bucket rain gauges, let slip a remark including water outlet, there are the bypass channel of water outlet and a pair of of tipping bucket component in both ends；Bypass channel is located on the center line for being discharged bottom of leting slip a remark, and the center line that tipping bucket component is let slip a remark according to water outlet is symmetrically arranged on bypass channel bottom.The 0.1mm sensibility reciprocal rain sensors of the utility model respectively form branch component with accurate counterweight by two pairs of single tipping buckets, are pivotally supported with tipping bucket, back-to-back in rack-mount jewel bearing branch, can delicately rotated.Its is simple in structure, small, is joined together with rain containing bin component, is supported and installed with only bar, designs firm base, buried underground.Surrounding is tensed with steel wire rope, can be worked normally under 8 grades of typhoons, and use, is repaired conveniently at dimensional expansion, and dripping, calibrating is simple and convenient, precision is high；It can not only be used for the hydrology, meteorological department's routine rainfall basic document, it can also be used to 0.2,0.5mm and telemetering, real-time alert flood situation, wide application.
assignees: JIANGSU NANSHUI WATER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electronic acupuncture needle having heart rate sensor
title_ko: 심박센서가 구비된 전자침
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electronic acupuncture needle apparatus which adjusts electrical stimulation provided by an electronic acupuncture needle by using bio-signal information, and a method of controlling the electronic acupuncture needle apparatus. An objective of an embodiment of the present invention is to provide the electronic acupuncture needle apparatus which simultaneously stimulates a plurality of acupuncture points depending on the health state of a user by using the bio-signal information. The electronic acupuncture needle apparatus of the present invention comprises: an electronic acupuncture needle unit which applies electrical stimulation to the user; a sensor unit which senses the bio-signal information of the user; and a control unit which controls the sensor unit to sense a bio-signal at preset intervals and controls the electronic acupuncture needle unit so that an electrical stimulation amount is adjusted according to the bio-signal sensed by the sensor unit. The control unit controls the electrical stimulation amount after estimating if the user is in an emergency situation depending on whether a signal variation amount from a bio-signal sensed at the first set time to a bio-signal sensed at the second set time during a time change from a first set time to a second set time belongs to a predetermined range or not.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 생체신호 정보를 이용하여 전자침이 제공하는 전기자극을 조절하는 전자침 장치 및 그 제어방법에 관한 것으로서, 사용자에게 전기자극을 가하는 전자침부, 사용자의 생체신호를 감지하는 센서부 및 미리 설정한 시간 간격으로 생체신호를 감지하도록 센서부를 제어하고, 센서부가 감지한 생체신호에 따라 전기자극량이 조절되도록 전자침부를 제어하는 제어부를 포함하며, 제어부는 제1설정시간으로부터 제2설정시간까지의 시간변화 동안 제1설정시간에 감지된 생체신호로부터 제2설정시간에 감지된 생체신호까지의 신호변화량이 소정의 범위에 속하는지 여부에 따라 사용자가 응급상황에 있는지 여부를 추정한 후 전기자극량을 제어하는 것을 특징으로 하는 전자침 장치 및 그 제어방법을 제공한다.

title_en: A kind of robot guided for life detection after earthquake and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of robots guided for life detection after earthquake and rescue, including robot body, the bottom of the robot body is movably installed with traveling wheel, sliding slot is offered at the top of robot body, motion bar is slidably fitted in sliding slot, and the top of motion bar is extended to outside sliding slot, the side of motion bar is welded with rack, the side of sliding slot is installed with the first servo motor, first gear is welded on the output shaft of first servo motor, first gear is engaged with rack, the top of the motion bar is welded with the second servo motor, second gear is welded on the output shaft of second servo motor, the side of second servo motor is equipped with the groove for being opened in motion bar top.The utility model is easy to operate, easy to use, and very easily the height of infrared detector and detection angles can be adjusted, area of detection is considerably increased, substantially eliminate check frequency.

title_en: Life saving instrument and saving method based on mobile phone
abstract_en: The application relates to a life saving instrument and a saving method based on a mobile phone. The application is based on a smart phone, the smart phone is used as a carrier, the triaxial acceleration sensor is used for acquiring triaxial acceleration of a human body at any moment to judge whether the human body is in a buried state due to earthquake, if the human body is judged to be in the buried state, the smart phone enters a power saving mode, and a power supply of the smart phone is closed except for an electromagnetic wave transmitting module, an audio analyzing module and a high-frequency sound wave module. According to the application, no extra complex equipment is needed, the mobile phone with very high correlation with human space is used as a help signal transmitting device, and the accurate and rapid positioning of combining the help signal transmission and self-help rescue is realized by combining the help mode and the audio mode of transmitting electromagnetic wave signals, so that the success rate of rescue is greatly improved; the application overcomes the defects of long time consumption, low efficiency, complex operation and the like of the traditional search and rescue method, has popularization value and significance of important people, and saves more innocent lives.

title_en: An earthquake detection and user status check system using the smart devices
title_ko: 스마트기기를 이용한 지진감지 및 사용자 상태 확인시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart device-based earthquake detection and user status confirmation system. With the present invention, earthquake alarm-based evacuation can be carried out during an earthquake and the status of family members can be confirmed. The present invention uses a household earthquake detector provided with an earthquake detection sensor; a wearable device Bluetooth-connected to the earthquake detector, transmitting earthquake occurrence information from the earthquake detection sensor to a wearer by means of a vibration signal, and provided with a temperature sensor, a motion sensor, a heart rate sensor, and a GPS to detect wearer information; and smart devices respectively connected to the wearable devices via an application and receiving information on the wearers wearing the wearable devices. As a result, during an earthquake, the wearer in each room can evacuate the room by detecting the earthquake via the vibration signal from the wearable device and the safety status of each wearer can be mutually confirmed by the smart devices receiving the wearers′ biosignals and positions via the temperature sensor, the motion sensor, the heart rate sensor, and the GPS.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지진발생시 지진 알람을 통해 대피를 이룰 수 있음과 더불어, 가족 구성원간의 상태를 확인할 수 있도록 하는 스마트기기를 이용한 지진감지 및 사용자 상태 확인시스템에 관한 것으로, 지진감지센서가 구비되어 세대에 배치되는 지진감지기; 상기 지진감지기와 블루투스로 연결되어 지진감지센서로부터 전달받은 지진발생 정보를 진동신호를 통해 착용자에게 전달하며, 온도센서와 동작센서와 심박센서 및 GPS가 구비되어 착용자의 정보를 감지하는 웨어러블기기; 어플을 통해 각각의 웨어러블기기에 연결되어 상기 웨이러블기기를 착용하고 있는 착용자들의 정보를 수신하는 각각의 스마트기기;를 이용함으로써, 지진발생시, 각 방에 위치한 착용자들이 웨어러블기기에서 발생하는 진동신호를 통해 지진을 감지하여 대피할 수 있음과 더불어, 온도센서와 동작센서와 심박센서와 GPS를 통해 착용자들의 생체신호 및 위치를 스마트기기로 수신함으로써 각각의 착용자들의 안전 상태를 서로 확인할 수 있는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: through-wall radar
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of through-wall radar, through-wall radar includes shell, display, transmitter, receiver, alarm and controller, the side of shell is arcwall face, shell is equipped with boss, and boss is set to the outside wall surface of shell, and boss has a flat surface, flat surface is the surface far from shell in boss, a mounting hole is arranged in boss, and mounting hole extends to the internal face of shell from flat surface, and earphone socket is inserted in mounting hole and is fixedly arranged on boss.The through-wall radar of the utility model is by being arranged earphone socket, alarm signal is sent to earphone socket by controller, operating personnel are connect with earphone socket using audible device and draw alarm signal, even if under complicated environmental condition, operating personnel can directly receive the sound of audible device, and the sound of alarm will not be masked even if noisy environment.And the setting of the flat surface of shell convex platform, it can make earphone socket is stronger to be connected to shell, improve the performance of through-wall radar.
assignees: SHANGHAI TIANXUN ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: A kind of Ground Penetrating Radar buried target localization method based on frequency spectrum remnants conspicuousness detection methods
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of Ground Penetrating Radar buried target localization methods based on frequency spectrum remnants conspicuousness detection methods, including（1）, Ground Penetrating Radar B Scan echo datas are filtered；（2）, using frequency spectrum remnants conspicuousnesses detection method find out target region of interest from filtered B Scan images；（3）, to extract target region of interest image carry out edge extracting；（4）, utilize Hough transformation position target hyperbola；（5）, according to target hyperbola realize buried target positioning.This method can efficiently differentiate clutter and target echo, promote the effect of clutter recognition；Target region of interest can be accurately extracted, and more completely remains target information, improves the precision of target positioning；And the algorithm used is succinct, and algorithm operation time is shorter, can quickly complete the positioning of Ground Penetrating Radar buried target.

title_en: A kind of buried pipeline detection device and method based on sound wave reflection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of buried pipeline detection devices based on sound wave reflection, it include: surface-based signal generator, power amplifier, vibration excitor, rake shake table, several three axis geophones, and the signal processor being mounted on host computer；Wherein, several three axis geophones constitute detector array, and the vibration excitor and detector array line constitute line direction；The signal generator is used to generate two kinds of modulated signals using waveform modulated；The modulated signal that the power amplifier is used to generate signal generator carries out power amplification；The signal that the vibration excitor is used to receive the power amplifier generates seismic wave；The rake shake table is used for the earthquake wave coupling that generates vibration excitor into soil；The three axis geophone is used to receive the reflected sonic signals in three directions；The signal processor obtains the position of buried pipeline by image for handling the received acoustic signals of three axis geophones and being imaged.

title_en: Method and Device for Measuring Biometric Data using Radar
title_ko: 레이더를 이용한 생체 신호 측정 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and an apparatus for measuring biometric signals using radar. The method for measuring biometric signals using the radar comprises: a step (a) of receiving multiple biometric signals from the radar; a step (b) of calculating distance information of the received multiple biometric signals and calculating the multiple biometric signals according to each distance; a step (c) of selecting a signal with the largest distribution in accordance with time among the multiple biometric signals for each distance classified in the step (b); a step (d) of further selecting a plurality of signals among signals of which distance to the signals selected in the step (c) among the multiple biometric signals for each distance classified in the step (b) is less than an arbitrary distance; a step (e) of converting all the signals selected in the step (c) and the step (d) from time domain to frequency domain; a step (f) of calculating reliability for each biometric signal from the signals for each distance converted in the step (e); and a step (g) of selecting the signals for each distance with the highest reliability calculated in the step (f) for each biometric signal to detect corresponding biometric signals. The disclosed method can accurately detect each biometric signal from the multiple biometric signals.
abstract_ko: 레이더를 이용한 생체 신호 측정 방법 및 장치가 개시된다. 개시된 방법은 레이더를 이용하여 다중 생체 신호를 측정하는 방법에 있어서, (a) 상기 레이더로부터 상기 다중 생체 신호를 입력받는 단계; (b) 상기 입력받은 다중 생체 신호의 거리 정보를 계산하고 거리별로 분류하는 단계; (c) 상기 (b)단계에서 분류된 각 거리별 다중 생체 신호 중 시간에 따른 분산이 가장 큰 신호를 선택하는 단계; (d) 상기 (b)단계에서 분류된 각 거리별 다중 생체 신호 중 상기 (c)단계에서 선택된 신호와의 거리가 임의의 거리보다 작은 신호들 중에서 다수의 신호들을 더 선택하는 단계; (e) 상기 (c)단계 및 (d)단계에서 선택된 모든 신호들을 시간 도메인에서 주파수 도메인으로 변환하는 단계; (f) 상기 (e)단계에서 변환된 거리별 신호들에서 각 생체 신호별로 신뢰도를 산출하는 단계; 및 (g) 각 생체 신호 별로 상기 (f)단계에서 산출된 신뢰도가 가장 높은 거리별 신호를 선택하여 해당 생체 신호를 검출하는 단계를 포함한다. 개시된 방법에 따르면, 다중 생체 신호에서 각 생체 신호를 정확하게 검출해 낼 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Indicator light equipement for a fire shelter
title_ko: 화재대피를 위한 소방피난유도기구
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire evacuation guide device for evacuation from fire, the fire evacuation guide device comprising: a case (10) buried to be exposed on a wall body; a guide plate (20) installed to be foldable on the case(10); an LED electronic display (30) which is installed on the guide plate (20) and visually displays characters or a design; a linear actuator (40) which folds the guide plate (20); a fire sensor (50) which senses an emergency situation and outputs the same; a control unit (60) which receives transmission of a signal from the fire sensor (50) and controls operation of the LED electronic display (30) and the linear actuator (40); and a battery (70) which supplies power to the LED electronic display (30), the linear actuator (40), the fire sensor (50), and the control unit (60). According to an embodiment of the present invention, the fire evacuation guide device displays a location of an emergency exit while not interrupting pedestrian′s passage since the guide plate is inserted in a wall body in a common situation. When a fire occurs, the guide plate and the LED electronic display are folded and protrude from the wall body. Consequently, visibility of displaying a location of the emergency exit is significantly increased, and the fire evacuation device can guide people to escape in a rapid manner.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재대피를 위한 소방피난유도기구에 관한 것으로서, 벽체 노출되게 매설되는 케이스(10); 케이스(10)에 접철가능하게 설치되는 안내판(20); 안내판(20)에 설치되어 문자나 도안을 시각적으로 표시하는 LED전광판(30); 안내판(20)을 절첩하는 리니어액추에이터(40); 비상상황을 감지해 출력하는 화재감지센서(50); 화재감지센서(50)로부터 신호를 전달받아 LED전광판(30) 및 리니어액추에이터(40)를 동작제어하는 제어부(60); LED전광판(30), 리니어액추에이터(40), 화재감지센서(50), 제어부(60)로 전원을 공급하는 축전지(70)를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
본 실시 예에 의하면, 평상시에는 안내판이 벽체에 인입되어 있기 때문에 보행자의 통행을 방해하지 않으면서 비상구의 위치를 표시하고, 화재발생시에는 안내판과 LED전광판이 접히면서 벽체로부터 돌출됨에 따라 비상구의 위치 표시에 대한 시인성을 획기적으로 높여주어 화재의 위험으로부터 신속한 대피를 유도할 수 있다.

title_en: Indicator light equipement for guideing the escape in the event of fire
title_ko: 안전한 대피를 위한 소방표시기구
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire display device for safe evacuation, the fire display device comprising: a case (10) buried to be exposed on a wall body; a guide plate (20) installed to be foldable on the case (10); an LED electronic display (30) which is installed on the guide plate (20) and visually displays characters or a design; a linear actuator (40) which folds the guide plate (20); a fire sensor (50) which senses an emergency situation and outputs the same; a control unit (60) which receives transmission of a signal from the fire sensor (50) and controls operation of the LED electronic display (30) and the linear actuator (40); a speaker (70) which is operated and controlled by the control unit (60) and outputs sounds for evacuation to the outside; and a battery (80) which supplies power to the LED electronic display (30), the linear actuator (40), the fire sensor (50), the control unit (60), and the speaker (70). According to an embodiment of the present invention, the fire display device for safe evacuation can guide people to escape from risk of fire in a rapid manner by significantly increasing visibility of displaying the location of an emergency exit as the guide plate and the LED electronic display are folded and protrude from the wall body when a fire occurs. The fire display device for safe evacuation stores evacuation articles (a flashlight, a mask, and so on) easy to be lost (misplaced) therein and enables the evacuation articles to be naturally exposed only in an emergency situation. Accordingly, the fire display device for safe evacuation can reduce the number of lost (misplaced) evacuation articles and can significantly help evacuation activities.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 안전한 대피를 위한 소방표시기구에 관한 것으로서, 벽체 노출되게 매설되는 케이스(10); 케이스(10)에 접철가능하게 설치되는 안내판(20); 안내판(20)에 설치되어 문자나 도안을 시각적으로 표시하는 LED전광판(30); 안내판(20)을 절첩하는 리니어액추에이터(40); 비상상황을 감지해 출력하는 화재감지센서(50); 화재감지센서(50)로부터 신호를 전달받아 LED전광판(30) 및 리니어액추에이터(40)를 동작제어하는 제어부(60); 제어부(60)에 의해 동작제어되어 외부로 대피음향을 방출하는 스피커(70); LED전광판(30), 리니어액추에이터(40), 화재감지센서(50), 제어부(60), 스피커(70)로 전원을 공급하는 축전지(80)를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
본 실시 예에 의하면, 화재발생시 안내판과 LED전광판이 접히면서 벽체로부터 돌출됨에 따라 비상구의 위치 표시에 대한 시인성을 획기적으로 높여주어 화재의 위험으로부터 신속한 대피를 유도할 수 있고, 분실(망실)되기 쉬운 피난물품(손전등, 마스크 등)을 내부에 수납하여 비상상황 시에만 자연스럽게 노출되도록 함으로서 피난물품의 분실(망실)을 줄일 수 있으면서 대피활동에 큰 도움을 줄 수 있다.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting respirator glasses with multi-information fusion display function
abstract_en: The invention discloses intelligent fire-fighting respiratory mask glasses with multi-information fusion display, which are characterized in that: the breathing mask comprises a spectacle frame, an imaging module and a battery module, wherein the spectacle frame is arranged on a breathing mask, the imaging module is arranged on one side, close to eyes, of the top of the spectacle frame, and the battery module is integrated on one side of the tail end of the spectacle frame; the spectacle frame and the spectacle frame are integrated with a circuit board processor and a control module. The invention is installed in the fire-fighting breathing mask, can be connected with the pressure value of an oxygen cylinder of an air respirator, the gas concentration of a gas detector, the sign parameters of a vital sign bracelet and the imaging picture of a thermal imager, has compact structure, light weight and convenient use and interaction, does not influence the normal sight, really liberates the hands of a fireman, and improves the rescue and self-protection capability of the fireman.

title_en: The processing method of through-wall radar echo data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of processing methods of through-wall radar echo data, including obtain radar return signal sequence；It carries out difference by column and obtains difference sequence；Calculating energy, which is tieed up, in direction obtains energy sequence；Difference sequence after being normalized line by line to difference sequence；Accumulation summation, which is tieed up, in direction obtains sequence；The point more than differential threshold is obtained, determines target interval, guard interval and reference interval；Whether judgement target interval there is target and determines the initial position of target；Sequence is filtered to obtain pretreated data；Target location and display target track are obtained, the processing of through-wall radar echo data is completed.The present invention is not necessarily to additional hsrdware requirements, and applicability is high, and calculating speed is fast, and clutter recognition effect is good, can be applied to the real-time positioning of through-wall radar moving target, in the data prediction of the moving-targets acquisition radar system such as unmanned plane.

title_en: Minimize the life-detection instrument of visible light and the fusion of LONG WAVE INFRARED two-waveband video
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the life-detection instruments of a kind of miniaturization visible light and the fusion of LONG WAVE INFRARED two-waveband video, belong to life detection and rescue field.In the radiation of visible light to environment to be measured that the lighting source of the present invention is sent out, spectroscope is reflected by the object in environment；The infra-red radiation that object is sent out in environment simultaneously is irradiated at spectroscope；Visible light and infra-red radiation are split mirror reflection or transmission respectively, are then received respectively by miniature visual light imaging component and small-sized LONG WAVE INFRARED image-forming assembly；Miniature visual light imaging component and small-sized LONG WAVE INFRARED image-forming assembly give the Image Real-time Transmission of each self-forming to image co-registration component, are merged by image co-registration component, and the video of infrared and visible light fusion is formed.The present invention can generate the infrared colour merged with visible light or black and white video information in real time, can detect trapped person's vital sign and its local environment situation, have the mechanical-optical setup thus small volume of light path altogether.

title_en: Portable audio and video life detection instrument based on wireless transmission
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable audio and video life detector based on wireless transmission, which belongs to the technical field of security rescue and comprises a life detector main body, a signal acquisition and output module, a signal processing and control module, a wireless equipment sending module, a wireless equipment receiving module and a remote control driving module; utilize infrared camera and digital adapter to carry out image and audio acquisition respectively, again respectively through video signal processing circuit and audio signal processing circuit after handling, audio and video transmission to handheld terminal after will handling by transmitting antenna, if confirm that there is the trapped person, then accessible remote control drive module opens quantum wave transceiver, utilizes to transmit quantum wave and receives the quantum wave signal that returns to it carries out processing analysis, judges the health condition of trapped person. In a word, the invention has the advantages of high transmission efficiency, convenient operation and flexible realization.

title_en: workers healthcare method using smartphone application
title_ko: 스마트폰 어플리케이션을 통한 근로자 건강관리 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a method of managing the health of employees by using a smartphone application comprises: a screen output step in which an application is executed in a smartphone to output a main screen on a display under the control of a control part; a converting step in which the control part of the smartphone makes a request to a web service (210) of a server (200) through network communication and then receives and converts a biometric signal stored in a Hadoop distributed file system (HDFS)(230) of the server (200) into data able to be outputted on the display; and a data output step in which the control part matches the converted biometric signal data with each position of the main screen outputted on the display. As such, the employee health management method is capable of preventing accidents in industrial sites by identifying health condition based on a biometric signal of an employee in a safety management suit measuring the biometric signal; preventing accidents by analyzing the health state of an employee including stress level, exercise strength, movement, and behavior patterns through a bigdata-based server using a biometric signal such as electrocardiogram, accelerometer, or temperature sensed through a biometric signal sensor of the safety management suit; and preventing an industrial accident, improving productivity, and enhancing health by providing a continuous personalized health management service through a smartphone application.
abstract_ko:
본 발명 스마트폰 어플리케이션을 통한 근로자 건강관리 방법은 스마트폰에 어플리케이션이 실행되어 제어부의 제어하에 메인화면을 디스플레이에 출력하는 화면출력단계; 상기 스마트폰의 제어부가 네트워크통신을 통해 서버(200)의 웹 서비스(210)에 요청을 한 후, 서버(200)의 하둡 분산 파일 시스템(230)(HDFS, Hadoop Distributed File System)에 저장된 생체신호 데이터를 수신하여 디스플레이에 출력할 수 있도록 변환하는 변환단계; 상기 제어부는 변환된 생체신호 데이터를 디스플레이에 출력되는 메인화면의 각 위치에 매칭하여 표시하는 데이터출력단계; 로 이루어지는 것으로, 
본 발명 스마트폰 어플리케이션을 통한 근로자 건강관리 방법은 생체신호를 측정하는 안전관리작업복을 착용한 근로자의 생체신호 기반의 건강 상태를 파악하여 산업현장에서의 업무상사고를 예방하되, 상기 안전관리작업복의 생체신호용 센서를 통해 감지한 심전도, 가속도, 체온 등의 생체신호를 활용하여 빅데이터 기반의 서버에서 스트레스 상태, 운동 강도, 움직임 및 행동 패턴 등의 근로자의 상태를 분석하여 안전사고를 예방하며, 스마트폰 어플리케이션을 통해 근로자를 대상으로 지속적인 개인 맞춤형 건강관리 서비스를 제공함으로써 재해 예방, 생산성 향상, 건강증진을 도모하는 현저한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Worker health management system and monitoring method using biosignal-based safety management workwear
title_ko: 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 이용한 근로자 건강관리 시스템 및 모니터링 방법
abstract_en: A worker health management system and monitoring method using biosignal-based safety management workwear, according to the present invention, comprises the steps in which: a signal detected by a biosignal sensor (130) provided to biosignal-based safety management workwear (100) is transmitted to a web service (210) of a server (200); the web service (210) sends an algorithm insertion or deletion request to a database (220) of the server (200), or an algorithm storage request to a Hadoop distributed file system (HDFS) (230) of the server (200); the HDFS (230) stores the algorithm when the algorithm storage request is received; the HDFS (230) transmits the algorithm to the web service (210) in order for the execution of the stored algorithm; the web service (210) that received the algorithm retrieves and applies the algorithm, and then retrieves data having the algorithm applied thereto and sends a simple object access protocol (SOAP) message to an output device; and a screen is outputted via the output device. The worker health management system and monitoring method using biosignal-based safety management workwear, according to the present invention, enables the prevention of work accidents on an industrial site by enabling the identification of the biosignal-based health status of a worker wearing safety management workwear for measuring a biosignal, and enables the prevention of safety-related accidents by having a big data-based server analyze the state of a worker, such as the state of stress, movement intensity, motion and behavior patterns, etc., by using a biosignal, such as an electrocardiogram record, acceleration, body temperature, etc., detected by the biosignal sensor provided to the safety management workwear, and a notable effect of promoting accident prevention, production increase and health improvement is achieved by providing a continuous personalized health management service to workers.

title_en: workers healthcare system using biological signals based safety menagement woking clothes
title_ko: 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 이용한 근로자 건강관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a worker healthcare system using safety management work clothes based on a biological signal. According to the present invention, the worker healthcare system using the safety management work clothes based on the biological signal comprises: safety management work clothes (100) based on a biological signal including a sensor for a biological signal and a module; a server (200) receiving and analyzing the biological signal of a user from the safety management work clothes (100) based on the biological signal, wherein the server (200) changes the biological signal to data capable of determining a user′s pattern; and an output device outputting the user′s health state on a screen to enable the user to monitor the health state using the data provided by the server (200). According to the present invention, the worker healthcare system using the safety management work clothes based on the biological signal can prevent an accident in an industrial field by obtaining the health state based on the biological signal of the worker wearing the safety management work clothes measuring the biological signal. Also, the worker healthcare system using the safety management work clothes based on the biological signal can prevent an accident by analyzing the state of the worker such as the level of stress, exercise strength, a motion, an action pattern and the like in the server based on big data by using the biological signal such as electrocardiogram, acceleration, and body temperature, which are sensed by the sensor for a biological signal of the safety management work clothes. The worker healthcare system using the safety management work clothes based on the biological signal can provide a continuous personalized healthcare service to the worker. Therefore, the worker healthcare system using the safety management work clothes based on the biological signal can remarkably increase productivity, promote health, and prevent a disaster.

title_en: Safety management work clothes based on biological signals
title_ko: 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복
abstract_en: The present invention relates to safety management work clothes based on a biological signal. According to the present invention, the safety management work clothes based on the biological signal comprises: work clothes (110); a band (120) attached to the inner side of the work clothes and manufactured of a synthetic elastic resin fabric to minimize bending the human body by a sensor for a biological signal and a module; the sensor (130) for a biological signal, attached to the band; the module (140) processing the signal by receiving the signal from the sensor for a biological signal; a battery (150); and a digital chamber (160) capable of transmitting the signal between the sensor for a biological signal and the module or between the module and the battery. According to the present invention, the safety management work clothes based on the biological signal prevents an accident in an industrial field by detecting a health state based on the biological signal of a worker wearing safety management work clothes based on the biological signal. The safety management work clothes based on the biological signal also prevent accidents due to carelessness by analyzing the state of the worker, such as level of stress, exercise strength, and motion and action pattern, in a server based on big data by using the biological signal such as electrocardiogram, acceleration, and body temperature, which are sensed by the sensor for a biological signal of the safety management work clothes. The safety management work clothes based on the biological signal provide a continuous personalized healthcare service for the worker, and therefore, can prevent disease, improve productivity and promote health.
