title_en: Detection city landslide causes fuel gas conduit to bury the packaged type device for squeezing off leakage
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of detection city landslide and fuel gas conduit is caused to bury the packaged type device for squeezing off leakage, belongs to Urban Disaster Prevention and Mitigation and hazards control field.The device collects the infrasound signal at the gas pipeline fracture leakage of burial by infrasound sensor measuring system to detect the degree of injury of gas pipeline.The leakage degree of injury for the city gas pipeline buried by burst landslide can be precisely detected using the present apparatus; buried pipes combustible gas leakage information can be detected with real-time early warning; mobile system is welded on the bottom end of full guard support cover by the present apparatus simultaneously; pass through several rotating pulleys and annular scraper set up; it can guarantee that the packaged type in the planarization and arbitrary region of present apparatus detecting location flexibly detects; several probe energy close contact Rock And Soils for ensuring to set up guarantee the accuracy of detection.

title_en: Home occupant detection and monitoring system
abstract_en: A home occupant detection and monitoring system has a sensor unit having a radio wave transmitter, a radio wave receiver, and a wireless transmitter configured to detect and receive vital signs of an occupant; a user interface having a microcontroller, a wireless receiver configured to receive the wireless signals transmitted from the sensor unit, a means for user input, and a network card; and a means for alerting occupants and third-parties to a triggering event; wherein the microcontroller, based upon logic, activates the alerting means at the triggering event.

title_en: Practical landslide early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a practical landslide early warning system. Comprises a main control unit and a plurality of landslide sensors. The main control unit is composed of a wireless receiving module, a microprocessor, a short message module, a storage module, an audible and visual alarm, a state indicating module and a receiving antenna. The landslide sensor is composed of a mechanical double-shaft inclination angle detection module, a wireless transmitting module, an antenna and a battery. The landslide sensors are buried in different positions of a scene where landslide is likely to occur perpendicularly to the horizontal plane, and each landslide sensor can be set with different inclination angle thresholds and is in a power-off state at ordinary times. The main control unit is arranged in the home of personnel near the landslide point or in enterprises and public institutions or other places where uninterrupted power supply is possible. The invention has the advantages that the difficult problem of power supply of the landslide sensor is solved; the landslide sensor has the advantages of simple internal structure, power supply by a dry battery, small volume, low cost and capability of being used in a large amount; landslide sensors can be embedded in a plurality of positions at the same place, so that the landslide monitoring range is enlarged, and the practicability is high.

title_en: Utilization system for traffic infrastructure investigation data
abstract_en: In order to effectively utilize investigation data about the deterioration in or damage to traffic infrastructure and prevent accidents in advance, the present invention is provided with: an electromagnetic wave radar (12) mounted on a vehicle (13); a GNSS device (14) mounted on the vehicle (13); and a server (30) which is connected to the electromagnetic wave radar (12) and the GNSS device (14) through a communication line and which receives reflective wave data and current position data. The server (30) has: an analysis program (P1) which analyzes the reflective wave data to detect the deterioration and damage that has occurred on a target surface and under the target surface or detect the presence of a buried object; map data (D1); and a map data synchronization program (P2) which, on the basis of position data, specifies on the map data (D1), the place where the deterioration, damage, or buried object has been detected by the analysis program (P1). The server (30) discloses the map data (D1), on which the place is specified where the deterioration, damage, or buried object has been detected, only to specific access members on the Internet.
assignees: C E MAN INTEGRATED LABORATORY CO LTD

title_en: Structure sparse imaging method and device of MIMO through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of through-wall radar imaging, and provides a structure sparse imaging method and device of an MIMO through-wall radar. The method comprises the following steps: sparse transformation is carried out on echo signals of an extended target collected by the MIMO through-wall radar array, a pseudo-random measurement matrix based on a pseudo-random m sequence is constructed for compression sampling, and a perception matrix is further constructed; obtaining an initial value of a scattering coefficient of an extended target according to a back projection imaging algorithm, and estimating an index set for an orthogonal matching pursuit compressed sensing algorithm; fully considering the structure sparse prior information among pixels according to the one-by-one transfer process of the first-order neighborhood of the Markov random field to obtain a new index set; and then recalculating the scattering coefficient of the extended target until a convergence condition is met, and using the scattering coefficient of the extended target at the moment for two-dimensional imaging. The invention does not need to manually set the partitioning parameters, has small required storage space, reduces the computation amount and the system complexity and is easy to realize hardware.

title_en: Human Body Change Measurement System And Method In Accordance With Stimulus Presentation To Classify The Sex Offense
title_ko: 성범죄 분류를 위한 자극 제시에 따른 신체 변화 측정 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a system and a method for measuring a body change according to presentation of stimulation for classification of sex crimes. According to the present invention, sensors of an apparatus for measuring a body change for classification of sexual crimes are attached to the body of a subject. A penis diameter change measuring unit, an electrocardiogram measuring unit, and various sensors (for example, skin conductivity detecting unit, skin conduction and visual deviation detecting unit, safety measuring circuit) for measuring psycho physiological reactions are attached, wherein the penis diameter change measuring unit uses a strain gauge which measures a change amount in the diameter of a penis of a subject according to auditory stimulation and visual stimulation of presenting pictures of children or adults by imitating a virtual sexual situation. Measured biosignals are transmitted to a computer, and the type and stimulation source database of sex offenders are constructed. In integrated operation and analysis software of a computer, which is a system for measuring a body change, combined with an autonomous nervous system analysis, patient information and a stimulation source category of a sex offender are inputted. It is possible to measure the autonomic nervous system reaction and physiological change of the sex offender according to auditory stimulation and visual stimulation of presenting pictures of children or adults by imitating a virtual sexual situation with respect to stimulation sources corresponding to the characteristics of the sex offender, and to determine whether the sex offender has child molestering paraphilias. Classification and treating effects are provided according to risk factors of the sex offender, and a sex offender treatment program is improved to guide the sex offender in the right direction. Thus, it is possible to reduce the recidivism rate of the sex offender.
abstract_ko:
성범죄 분류를 위한 자극제시에 따른 신체 변화 측정 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 신체 변화 측정 시스템은 대상자의 신체에 성범죄 분류를 위한 신체 변화 측정 장치의 센서들을 부착하고, 가상의 성적인 상황을 묘사하여 아동이나 성인 사진이 제시되는 시각 자극과 청각 자극에 따라 대상자의 성기에 음경의 직경의 변화량을 측정하는 스트레인 게이지를 사용한 음경 직경 변화 측정부와 심전도 측정부, 및 심리생리반응을 측정하는 여러 센서(ex. 피부전도도 검출부-피부전도반응, 시선이탈 감지부-안전도 계측 회로)들을 부착하여 측정된 생체 신호들을 컴퓨터로 전송하며,  
성범죄자의 유형과 자극원 데이터베이스를 구축하고, 자율신경계 분석이 결합된 신체 변화 측정 시스템인 컴퓨터의 통합 운영 및 분석 소프트웨어에서 성범죄자의 환자 정보와 자극원 카테고리를 입력하고, 성범죄자 특성에 맞게 자극원을 가상의 성적인 상황을 묘사하여 아동이나 성인 사진이 제시되는 시각 자극과 청각 자극에 따른 성범죄자의 자율신경계의 반응과 생리적인 변화를 측정하여 성범죄자의 아동 성애적 성도착증 여부를 판단하며, 성폭력 범죄자의 위험 요인에 따른 분류와 치료효과를 제공하여 올바른 방향으로 인도하도록 성범죄자 치료 프로그램을 개선하여 성범죄자의 재범률을 줄이는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Assembly for the generation of a two or three-dimensional map of obstacles in a surrounding area through walls, system comprising it and associated method and use
abstract_en:
The present invention is in the area of the identification of obstacles - particularly objects or living beings - through walls, based on electromagnetic signals, such as radiofrequency or microwave signals. 
     The invention refers to a method for the generation of a two- or three-dimensional map of obstacles in a surrounding area through walls characterised in that it comprises the following steps: 
- emission of a first electromagnetic signal from a first position and an at least one subsequent electromagnetic signal emitted from at least one subsequent position, 
- reception of the first electromagnetic signal and of each subsequent electromagnetic signal in a plurality of antennas (2), 
- detection of the power level of the received signal in each of the antennas (2), and 
- generate a map of obstacles in a surrounding area of the receiving device, based on: 
i) said pluralities of power level values corresponding to each emitted electromagnetic signal, and 
ii) the positions corresponding to the emitted electromagnetic signals.

title_en: The method positioned simultaneously for life detection radar array multiple target
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of methods positioned simultaneously for life detection radar array multiple target, including：At least four is arranged into a face battle array for the radar detection unit of life detection, determines its position coordinates；Obtain the signal of each radar detection unit；Therefrom extract the life entity number detected and corresponding range information；Random combine mathematically is carried out to all radar detection units, and combinations of pairs is carried out to the range information in each radar complex and calculates a possible target location, and a reliability index is distributed to each position, determines whether it retains；And the position of reservation is clustered, one probability of pro rate of all possible position points is accounted for according to element number in each class, the highest m class of probability is chosen as the class where objective body actual position, it is weighted averagely, while obtaining the specific location of more life entities.The above method has effectively removed wrong solution and false solution, realizes multiple target while positioning.

title_en: A kind of three-dimensional radar life detection positioning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of three-dimensional radar life detection positioning devices, main includes transmitting subsystem, receiving subsystem, multichannel data acquisition system, main control unit, wireless line traffic control terminal, power module, by by marx pulse-generating circuits, three avalanche transistors, the high amplitude pulses of the nanosecond of Resonant Mode Trigger Circuits composition emit subsystem, reception echo is carried out by receiving subsystem, by noise reduction unit, filter unit, the processing of information amplifying unit, incoming multi-channel data collection unit carries out sampling processing, the result of sampling processing comes in and goes out by DSP data processing units and WiFi communication module and the main control unit for running linux system, bidirectional data communication is carried out to wireless line traffic control terminal by 2.4GWiFi.In short, the utility model can realize three-dimensional localization life detection, the distortion of impulse wave is prevented, improve the clear of the image of three-dimensional simulation and receives the intensity of weak signal.

title_en: A kind of fire helmet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire helmets, including helmet shell, helmet inner casing and wind shield, wind shield is connect by buckle structure with helmet shell, helmet shell is equipped with thermal insulation layer, noise control layer, anticollision layer and buffer layer successively from outside to inside, helmet inner casing is equipped with mounting box, and controller, positioning device, wireless communication module, power module, heartbeat detection device and apparatus for testing body temperature are equipped in mounting box.The utility model is provided simultaneously with heat-insulated, noise control, anticollision and the function of damping, feature-rich various, and thermal insulation layer is set to the outermost layer of helmet shell, and the helmet integrally will not easily be deformed because of high temperature, and service life is long；In addition, the utility model can monitor the physiology sign of fire fighter in real time and be accurately positioned, to make quick response to emergency episode, practicability is high, can be widely applied to fire-fighting equipment technical field.

title_en: First responder dispatch system and methods of operation thereof
abstract_en: A first responder dispatch system is disclosed comprising a sensing wearable configured to be worn by a first responder. The sensing wearable can comprise a wrist-worn electronic device, a power-generating garment, or a combination thereof. The sensing wearable can comprise a plurality of biometric sensors configured to measure a plurality of vital signs of the first responder. The system can comprise a server programmed to receive biometric data concerning a plurality of vital signs of the first responder measured by the sensing wearable. The server can also transmit alerts to a plurality of dispatch client devices over a plurality of secured real-time bidirectional connections concerning a status of the first responder. At least one dispatch client device can transmit a response to the server and the server can, in turn, transmit additional biometric data concerning the first responder to the dispatch client device.

title_en: System for monitoring biometric data
title_ko: 생체신호 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for monitoring a bio-signal which monitors user data in real time. The system comprises: a pair of glasses composed of a glasses frame and glasses lenses, and having an identification means assigned thereto; and a server connected to the pair of glasses through a network, and storing and managing data received from the pair of glasses. The pair of glasses includes: a bio-sensor for generating a bio-signal of a user; a communication unit for transmitting the bio-signal to the server; an operation sensor for sensing an operation that the user stretches the glasses frame; a bio-sensor for sensing whether the user wears the pair of glasses; and a control unit for analyzing the bio-signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 생체신호 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 안경테와 안경알로 구성되며, 식별수단이 부여되는 안경; 상기 안경과 네트워크를 통해 연결되어, 상기 안경으로부터 수신하는 데이터를 저장 및 관리하는 서버를 포함하고, 상기 안경은, 사용자의 생체신호를 생성하는 바이오센서; 상기 생체신호를 상기 서버로 송신하는 통신부; 사용자가 상기 안경테를 펼치는 동작을 감지하는 동작감지센서; 사용자의 안경착용을 감지하는 생체감지센서; 및 상기 생체신호를 분석하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Based on multinuclear digital signal processor through-wall radar motion target tracking imaging method
abstract_en: One kind being based on multinuclear digital signal processor through-wall radar motion target tracking imaging method, is related to digital signal processing technique field, solves the problems, such as it is to meet ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR imaging requirement of real-time, is as follows：（1）Information data acquisition is carried out to mobile target and inputs the ends PC；（2）It carries out data encapsulation by information data and reaches multinuclear digital signal processor to handle；（3）8 parts are splitted data into, common storage area is stored in；（4）Using Core0 as main core, the initialization of control system notifies other to execute respective task from core；（5）Using Core1-7 as from core, the data of common storage area are accessed；（6）Each core reads information data and carries out time-delay calculation, and result is sent to original memory block；（7）The superposition that main core Core0 carries out last algorithm arranges, and former road returns to the ends PC.Operation efficiency of the present invention is high, meets the requirement of real-time of motion target tracking imaging.

title_en: Quick wall compensation method suitable for MIMO through-wall radar imagings
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of quick wall compensation methodes suitable for MIMO through-wall radar imagings, include the following steps：Setting radar establishes coordinate system, specified pixel point；MIMO through-wall radars carry out multiple-input multiple-output reality aperture and face detection, obtain echo-signal；The corresponding upper end of first pixel, lower end calculating abscissa are found, the propagation delay value that first pixel corresponds to all transceiver channels is calculated, finally obtains the propagation delay value that all pixels point corresponds to all transceiver channels；It is imaged to form final image according to rear orientation projection in conjunction with echo-signal and propagation delay value.The present invention is avoiding traditional wall compensation method due to iteration and is traversing the excessive problem of the operand brought simultaneously, it is good with correction target image position offset effect, the big superperformance in focal imaging region, finally obtained output image can be used for positioning, identify and extract target, have a good application prospect in the MIMO through-wall radar imagings application for needing to handle in real time.

title_en: CNN-Based Remote Locating and Tracking of Individuals Through Walls
abstract_en: A system and method is provided to quantize a plurality of search bins within a structure with a label corresponding to whether an UWB radar sensor has detected an individual within the search bin to produce a labeled image of plurality of search bins. A convolutional neural network classifies the labeled image regarding how many individuals are shown in the labeled image.

title_en: A kind of life detection radar of three-dimensional localization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of life detection radar of three-dimensional localization, including radio-frequency receiving-transmitting subelement, the electromagnetic signal for modulating generation low-frequency ultra-wideband, and receive and demodulate target echo signal；MIMO imaging antenna array elements include the transmitting antenna array being made of multiple transmission antenna units, are used for outside electromagnetic radiation signal；And the receiving antenna array being made of multiple reception antenna units, it is used for receives echo-signal；Radio-frequency receiving-transmitting switch matrix unit, between radio-frequency receiving-transmitting subelement and MIMO imaging antenna array elements, for realizing the switching for the unlike signal interchannel that transmitting signal and echo-signal are constituted in different antennae unit；Data acquire and signal processing unit, generate transmitting signal for controlling radio-frequency receiving-transmitting subelement, and for receiving target echo signal, carry out analysis imaging and target detection identification.The life detection radar of the three-dimensional localization of the present invention has many advantages, such as that positioning accuracy is high, penetration capacity is strong and high sensitivity.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of object localization method for building penetrating life-detection radar
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of object localization methods for building penetrating life-detection radar, include the following steps：Step A：Original signal is inputted, and original signal is arranged in B-SCAN figures by road number；Step B：For per the static clutter of the removal of original signal all the way and linear trend item；Step C：By doing energy accumulation to life micro-tremor signal in time domain, the peak value in energy spectrum is detected, to determine the distance between target and two reception antennas estimated value；Step D：According to the range estimation that step C is provided, to this apart from upper all slow times to data be FFT, obtain the echo frequency information at the distance, determine the distance between target and reception antenna；Step E：Distance of the target that step D is provided away from two reception antennas is obtained by the revised time lag curve of wall time delay；Step F：The intersection point for seeking time lag curve, the location estimation as target.

title_en: A kind of adaptive through-wall radar static human body object localization method based on EMD
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of adaptive through-wall radar static human body object localization method based on EMD is related to through-wall radar technology, more particularly to the static target detection of through-wall radar and location technology.The present invention provides the static target location algorithm suitable for MIMO through-wall radars.Fast time dimension Fourier transformation is carried out to the multicycle data of reception and obtains multicycle Range Profile；Multicycle Range Profile is resolved into multiple column vectors by range cell again, with each column vector data of EMD algorithm process；By slow time dimension Fourier transformation, by treated, each Range Profile is transformed into frequency domain, the adaptively selected Range Profile for including target information.Noise and clutter are further suppressed finally by BP imaging algorithm fast imagings, and in conjunction with PCF algorithms.The present invention has positioning accuracy high, can self-adaptive processing data ability, can be applied directly in through-wall radar equipment.

title_en: Lodging vehicle smog fire protection alarm device
abstract_en: The utility model provides lodging vehicle smog fire protection alarm device, including lodging vehicle, feature further include：Signal processor（MCU）Temperature detection scan device I, II, III, infrared temperature detects the condition pickoffs I, II of scanning strip human life detection non-process, phonetic alarm, it is connect by conducting wire with signal processor, audio alert is carried out when being connected to the audio alert signal of signal processor, when nobody is engaged in cooking activity and deck occupant smokes, the two sector scanning signal operation principles are identical with electrical heating region and front and back bed sensor scanning work principle, signal processor alarm（At displays temperature exception electric appliance）And signal audio alert is sent, vehicle occupant handles it to abnormal immediately, can avoid fire in time to lodging vehicle burning things which may cause a fire disaster automatic early-warning on fire, ensure passenger life and property safety.

title_en: A kind of low complex degree entropy extension through-wall radar imaging method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of through-wall radar imaging methods, belong to through-wall radar imaging algorithm field, this method first carries out dimension-reduction treatment to the received echo-signal matrix of bay institute, obtain the submatrix of low dimensional, then according to discrete memoryless source entropy principle, submatrix is extended respectively, utilizes the entropy thresholding different to each arranged in matrix, the influence of wall clutter is eliminated, realizes target imaging.Computation complexity can be greatly reduced in this method, reduce the memory that data occupy in algorithm.

title_en: Method for recovering buried history of stratum near normal fault
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for recovering a buried history of a stratum near a normal fault, which comprises the following steps: s1, carrying out regional stratum division by combining well and earthquake; s2, selecting a virtual well position of the target area and calculating the degradation amount of the virtual well position; s3, calculating the fault activity rate; and S4, recovering the burying history. The method adopts well-seismic combination to divide regional strata, selects a virtual well position in a zone where a fault does not pass near a target well position, calculates the stratum erosion amount by using a trend analysis method, calculates the fault activity rate according to the thickness characteristics of the two strata of a fault rising disc and a fault falling disc, and determines the fault activity period; and recovering the buried history of the research area by integrating the formation degradation data, the lithology data, the ground temperature data and the geological analysis data. The method can accurately recover the burying history and the thermal evolution history of the stratum near the fracture zone, thereby laying a foundation for reservoir evolution and high-quality reservoir diagenesis research; and further, the high-quality reservoir distribution is determined, the drilling efficiency in the exploration and development process is improved, and the production cost is saved.

title_en: Through-wall imaging method based on WiFi signal
abstract_en: The through-wall imaging method based on WiFi signal that the invention discloses a kind of.Through-wall imaging method hardware device cost proposed by the invention is extremely low, WiFi signal caused by wireless universal router can be used as the transmitting signal of imaging system, and wireless router has been distributed widely in family, bank, market, office building and hotels and other places at present, substantial amounts provide signal source abundant for through-wall imaging system；The WiFi signal that the wireless router utilized generates has wider bandwidth, theoretically ensure that the high-resolution of imaging；The WiFi signal frequency range that the wireless router utilized generates meets ieee standard, and the whole world is general, and the frequency range is free frequency range, without paying frequency range usage charges；The hardware device small volume needed, compares traditional through-wall radar, it is only necessary to which configuration is with reference to receiving antenna and detection receiving antenna；Suitable for any through-wall radar imaging method；Through-wall imaging method based on WiFi signal proposed by the invention can realize through-wall imaging to low-cost high-efficiency, lay a good foundation effectively quickly to solve indoor emergency event.

title_en: A kind of multi-functional air respirator

title_en: Algorithmic Approach for Estimation of Respiration and Heart Rates
abstract_en: One or more aspects of the disclosure relate to monitoring a resting subject's respiration and heart rate through an impulse radio ultra-wideband (IR-UWB) radar in a noninvasive fashion, in order to infer the corresponding health status including heart rate and respiration rate. Any other reflectance technology may be used. These two cardiopulmonary vital signs are derived based on the processing of recorded waveforms that are collected by the IR-UWB radar or any other reflectance technology system, after getting reflected-off the resting subject's body or relevant body part. A novel algorithm that processes the recorded waveforms is proposed to extract these vitals' signals and, accordingly, estimate their rates. This algorithm includes at least three major stages: i) noise reduction, ii) respiration rate estimation, and iii) heart rate estimation. Furthermore, the algorithm addresses the effects of harmonics and intermodulation between the breathing and heartbeat signals without requiring the implementation of filters.

title_en: Electronic device and method for determining information associated with sleep
title_ko: 수면과 관련된 정보를 결정하기 위한 전자 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: An electronic device according to various embodiments of the present invention includes a biometric signal detection sensor set to acquire first biometric information and second biometric information for an object outside the electronic device and a processor. The processor is set to acquire the first biometric information and the second biometric information using the biometric signal detection sensor, to conform a first change amount in which the first biometric information is changed and a second change amount in which the second biometric information is changed, to determine the state of the object associated with sleep based on at least a part of the first change amount and the second change amount, and to estimate sleep latency associated with the object based on at least a part of the state. Accordingly, the present invention can determine the sleep latency without the engagement or intervention of a user.
abstract_ko: 다양한 실시 예들에 따른 전자 장치(electronic device)는, 상기 전자 장치 외부의 오브젝트에 대한 제1 생체 정보 및 제2 생체 정보를 획득하도록 설정된 생체 신호 감지 센서와, 프로세서를 포함하고, 상기 프로세서는, 상기 제1 생체 정보 및 상기 제2 생체 정보를 상기 생체 신호 감지 센서를 이용하여 획득하고, 상기 제1 생체 정보가 변화된 제1 변화량 및 상기 제2 생체 정보가 변화된 제2 변화량을 확인하고, 상기 제1 변화량 및 상기 제2 변화량에 적어도 일부 기반하여, 수면과 관련된 상기 오브젝트의 상태를 결정하고, 상기 상태에 적어도 일부 기반하여, 상기 오브젝트와 관련된 수면 잠복기를 추정하도록 설정될 수 있다.

title_en: The vital sign monitoring of mine servant a kind of and positioning search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of monitoring of the vital sign of mine servant and positioning search and rescue systems, and the system comprises wireless sensings to position network, external alert device, server end；The wireless sensing positions network, including：User terminal, coordinator and multiple beaconing nodes, user terminal are wearable devices, and beaconing nodes are sensor node known to different location but position of the regular arrangement under mine；The valid data of each node feeding back of the user terminal received are transferred to server end and handled by the coordinator；The external alert device, for receiving the warning message issued by the processor module；The server end carries out processing storage to data information, and show in the form of picture and text when needed for receiving the data information that coordinator transmits；The vital sign real-time monitoring to mine servant can be achieved in the present invention, and carries out timely positioning to the miner that emergency situations occur and search and rescue.

title_en: A kind of multiple target physical examination survey and localization method based on constant false alarm rate detection
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of multiple target physical examination survey for life detection radar based on constant false alarm rate detection and localization methods, include the following steps：Step A：Original signal is inputted, and original signal is arranged in B-SCAN figure by road number, wherein the fast time, to comprising range information, the slow time is to including frequency information；Step B：Remove the static clutter and linear trend item in initial data；Step C：Fourier transformation is carried out to all road information that the same sampling instant obtains, obtains distance-Doppler hum pattern；Step D：The algorithm of target detection based on CFAR is used in distance-Doppler domain, objective body is marked on distance-Doppler domain；Step E：Judge that whether there is or not non-zero points in the image of CFAR output, the result of output is then carried out target identification by non-zero points if it exists, exports the location information and respiratory rate size of target.The present invention reduces because of the false target that the interference of local very noisy occurs.

title_en: A kind of through-wall radar construction wall location acquiring method utilized based on multipath
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of through-wall radar construction wall location acquiring method utilized based on multipath, is averaged CFAR detection method to original radar image progress binaryzation first with two-dimensional cell；Secondly, by clustering method multiple cluster regions will be divided into the image-region of high pixel density in binaryzation radar image, by point cluster region zero setting that pixel is less in cluster process；Again, coordinate value of the geometric center of each image-region after taking clustering processing as each cluster region；Then, by the change in location feature of each cluster areas in analysis multiframe radar image, successively each cluster areas attribute in each frame image is determined；Finally, the ordinate on surface within the walls after being obtained using the geometrical relationship between real goal and the secondary multipath decoy of rear wall, the ordinate of front wall inner surface is acquired according to the geometrical relationship that real goal and front-back wall vibrate a multipath.

title_en: A kind of high altitude regions rescue system based on Intelligent bracelet
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of high altitude regions rescue system based on Intelligent bracelet, comprising: Intelligent bracelet, user mobile phone, Lora communication terminal, monitoring center and search and rescue service station；Intelligent bracelet detects human heart rate, blood pressure, ECG, body temperature, human body posture.There is public network regional, the sign information of field personnel is transmitted to user mobile phone, information is transmitted to by 4G public network by monitoring center；In no public network area, information is transmitted to by Lora technology and searches and rescues service station, 4G public network is recycled to be transmitted to monitoring center.The present invention has the advantages that vital sign information can be obtained by front end condition sensor, there is public network area and the transmission of information can be carried out without public network area, solve the transmission problem of field search and rescue signal, it is not limited by weather, landform and distance, the multidimensional information for the personnel that rescued, the especially warning information of high altitude regions environment lower body status tracking are provided to the search and rescue of complicated highlands.

title_en: A kind of automation deviational survey warning device and foundation pit tilt monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of automation deviational survey warning devices, by in the pre-buried inclinometer pipe of pit foundation side wall to be measured, inclination sensor is set in inclinometer pipe, it is connect using detection module with inclination sensor, pass through inclination sensor and the deformation situation of inclinometer pipe synchro measure pit foundation to be measured in the construction process, the change shape in pit foundation work progress is obtained using detection module, and the data and preset threshold obtained by detection module by inclination sensor compare, so as to quickly see if fall out slant range, early warning can be carried out in time, the present apparatus can carry out real-time monitoring to the case where foundation pit side-wall horizontal displacement, it is again easy to use, save manpower, the problem of overcoming cumbersome traditional measurement method and serious lag, accurate data can be provided for guiding construction, early warning can be carried out to foundation pit disaster, to improve Foundation Pit Construction Mechanization, the level of IT application.

title_en: Early warning and help seeking system based on external sensor and used for emergency condition of autonomous vehicle passenger
abstract_en: The invention relates to an external sensor-based early warning and help seeking system for an emergency situation of an autonomous vehicle passenger, which is characterized by comprising a vehicle door opening and closing recording module, an in-vehicle people number detection module, a background database module, a vital sign data acquisition module, a data processing module, an early warning module, a voice vibration reminding module, an emergency rescue module and a self-contained power supply module. title_en: A kind of millimeter wave life detection bird-repeller system and bird repellent method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of millimeter wave life detection bird-repeller system and bird repellent methods, wherein bird-repeller system includes including vital signs detecting device, scarer, detection device controller, go up and down steering mechanism and power supply, the detection device controller is connect with the electric control part of lifting steering mechanism, the vital signs detecting device is mounted on the movable erecting bed of the lifting steering mechanism, the vital signs detecting device includes antenna assembly, millimetre-wave radar device, millimeter wave radiometer and signal processing module, the millimetre-wave radar device and the millimeter wave radiometer are connected respectively to the signal processing module, the signal processing module is for acquiring, it extracts to compare again after vital sign parameter signals and calculate comprising birds quantity, the bird repellent signal of position and distance, the scarer is electrically connected with the signal processing module.The present invention solves bird repellent unicity, and effect on driving birds is undesirable, and birds lead to the problem of adaptability for a long time.

title_en: A kind of sealing detector of highly sensitive high anti-interference pipe and cable detector

title_en: System and method for customized addiction therapy based on bio signal

To this end, the biosignal-based patient-oriented addiction treatment system comprises: a sensor for measuring a biosignal from a user; a state determination unit for determining user state based on the measured biosignal; a cognitive behavior treatment image determination unit for determining a cognitive behavior treatment image based on the determined user state; and an image providing unit for providing the user with the determined cognitive behavior treatment image.
abstract_ko: 실시예들은 사용자로부터 생체신호를 측정하는 센서, 측정된 생체신호를 기초로 사용자 상태를 결정하는 상태 결정부, 결정된 사용자 상태를 기초로 인지행동치료 영상을 결정하는 인지행동치료 영상 결정부, 및 결정된 인지행동치료 영상을 사용자에게 제공하는 영상 제공부를 포함하는 생체신호 기반의 환자 맞춤형 중독치료 시스템 및 그 방법에 관련된다.

title_en: Device for providing emotional feedback service

abstract_en: According to the present invention, an emotion feedback service providing device can accurately diagnose a current emotion state of a user. The emotion feedback service providing device comprises: a DB unit for storing emotion determining reference information related to multiple types of state information representing an emotion state and multiple types of reference feature information generated by using a bio-signal for each emotion state; a receiving unit for receiving a bio-signal of a user from a sensor module which has a sensor sensing the bio-signal attached thereto and is worn by the user; an extracting unit for extracting feature information from the bio-signal of the user; and an information generating unit for generating current state information of the user by matching the extracted feature information and the emotion determining reference information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 의한 감성 피드백 서비스 제공 장치는 감정 상태별 생체신호를 이용하여 생성된 복수 개 기준특징정보와 해당 감정 상태를 표상하는 복수 개의 상태정보가 연계된 감성판단 기준정보가 저장된 DB부; 생체신호를 감지하는 센서가 부착되며 사용자가 착용하는 센서모듈로부터 상기 사용자의 생체신호를 전송받는 수신부; 상기 사용자의 생체신호로부터 특징정보를 추출하는 추출부; 및 상기 추출된 특징정보와 상기 감성판단 기준정보의 매칭을 통하여 상기 사용자의 현재 상태정보를 생성하는 정보생성부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: A kind of through-wall radar multi-Target Image domain robust tracking method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of through-wall radar multi-Target Image domain robust tracking methods, are related to through-wall radar technology, in particular to the multi-target detection tracking technique of through-wall radar.The present invention provides the image area track algorithm of the multiple target after being suitable for through-wall radar imaging.The fast imaging in certain allowable error obtains better quality imaging results；Algorithm for image enhancement based on PCF weighting processing can effectively inhibit the influence of graing lobe, enhance target；Target template creation algorithm based on twin shaft projection can efficiently extract clarification of objective information, prepare for tracking；Image area track algorithm based on average drifting and Kalman filtering can effectively cope with the problem of target image extension and deformation, also can easily cope with target occlusion problem, and tracking accuracy is high.Therefore, the present invention has real-time good, the high advantage of tracking accuracy, can be applied directly in through-wall radar equipment.

title_en: ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR human body respiration signal detecting method through walls based on Faster-RCNN network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR human body respiration signal detecting method through walls based on Faster-RCNN network, first to it is original slow when the m- two-dimentional ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR echo-signal of distance do denoising and weak signal enhancement pre-processes；Then using Advance Normalisation method, for treated, echo continues signal enhancing and denoising；Echo-signal in preprocessing process is imaged as by gray level image using MATLAB, scheme the wide corresponding echo slow time to, scheme high corresponding echo distance to；Finally obtained gray level image is screened, labeled data collection, training Faster-RCNN network model carries out the identification of human body respiration small-signal.Recognition accuracy of the invention is high, and detection speed is fast, provides superior technique for practical techniques such as radar return target detection, life detections in practical application and supports.

title_en: A kind of sound insulation shock isolation system of the floor slab pipeline through walls for building construction
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to sound insulation shock isolation system technical field, the sound insulation shock isolation system of specially a kind of floor slab pipeline through walls for building construction, including sound insulation earthquake isolating equipment entirety and acoustic vibration damper plate, the upper end of the sound insulation earthquake isolating equipment entirety is fixedly installed with fixed block, and glass sound insulation lid is installed below fixed block, position of the inner surface of the fixed block among glass sound insulation lid is movably installed with tube seat, one end of the sound insulation earthquake isolating equipment entirety is fixedly installed with card and block, the side of the card and block is fixedly installed with adjusting soundproof plate, the upper end of the acoustic vibration damper plate is fixedly installed with noise reduction shock insulation plate close to the position of glass sound insulation lid lower end, a kind of sound insulation shock isolation system of floor slab pipeline through walls for building construction described in the utility model, equipped with adjusting soundproof plate, acoustic vibration damper plate and noise reduction shock insulation plate, it can mention The flexibility that height uses, and the better sound insulation shock insulation of energy, bring better prospect of the application.
assignees: FOSHAN NANHAI JINYUAN BUILDING MAT CO LTD

title_en: Polarized through-wall radar compressed sensing imaging method
abstract_en: The invention provides a polarized through-wall radar compressed sensing imaging method, and relates to the technical field. The method converts the polarized through-the-wall radar imaging problem into a sparse group basis tracking denoising problem by utilizing the joint sparsity of scene reflectivity vectors corresponding to all polarized channels, solves the sparse group basis tracking denoising problem by adopting a spectral projection gradient L1 norm minimization algorithm to realize imaging reconstruction, realizes the calculation of forward functions and adjoint function operators by adopting a non-uniform fast Fourier transform technology in the imaging process, and avoids the calculation and storage of each element of a dictionary matrix. The polarized through-wall radar compressed sensing imaging method provided by the invention obviously reduces the requirement on the memory of a computer in the imaging process, can ensure the quality of imaging reconstruction, and is suitable for large-scale high-resolution polarized through-wall radar imaging occasions.

title_en: Arrangement for monitoring vitality data of a vehicle driver
abstract_en: The invention relates to an arrangement in a vehicle for monitoring vitality data of a vehicle driver (10). The arrangement has a sensor unit (01) which comprises a sensor, with a transmission unit (Tx) which generates a transmission signal and emits it in the direction of the vehicle driver (10) via an antenna (03), and with a receiving unit (Rx) which receives components of the transmission signal reflected by the vehicle driver (10) as reception signal via an antenna (04). A control unit controls the transmission and receiving units and extracts a vital signal, which corresponds to an organ movement representing the vitality of the vehicle driver (10). The control unit sends the vital signal to a vehicle control unit if the sensor unit (01) detects a change to the vitality data of the vehicle driver (10) beyond a predetermined limit value.

title_en: Apparatus for detecting missing person in disaster scene using a drone and method by using the same
title_ko: 무인기를 이용한 재난현장에서의 실종자 탐지 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for detecting a missing person in a disaster site by using a drone and a method thereof which rapidly detect a missing person buried in a building or under the ground or escaping to an evacuation space by using a radar sensor mounted in a drone in a disaster site where earthquake, landslide, shipwreck and the like occur wherein detection equipment or a rescue team has difficulty to access the disaster site, which photograph an image of a corresponding region and check location information if a missing person is detected, and which provide the image data and the location information to the rescue team through a disaster control server of a remote place to rapidly rescue the person.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 탐지 장비나 구조대의 접근이 어려운 지진, 산사태, 조난사고 등이 발생한 재난현장에서 무인기(drone)에 탑재된 레이더 센서를 사용하여 건물이나 지하에 매몰되거나 대피공간으로 피신한 실종자를 신속하게 탐지하고, 실종자가 탐지되면 해당 지역의 영상 촬영 및 위치정보 확인을 수행하고, 영상 데이터 및 위치정보를 원격지의 재난관제서버를 통해 구조대에 제공하여 신속한 인명구조를 수행할 수 있도록 하는 무인기를 이용한 재난현장에서의 실종자 탐지 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다.
assignees: NAT UNIV CHONBUK IND COOP FOUND

title_en: Emotion sensor system
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a mm-wave radar sensor to be deployed as emotion sensor, being inherently small size, and being able to be produced in low cost manner. The key system relevant components are utilization of mm-wave integrated radar, specific planar high-gain antenna radiation patterns, and analyzing the vital signs of objects by the same apparatus. The objects are human beings with vital signs vibrations, and animals with vital sign vibrations, where the system calculates and detects the frequency of vital sign rates: heartbeats and respiration frequencies. The values of vital signs rates as well as the changes of vital sign rates are used together with objects vital signs profile to calculate the emotion value. Emotion value may be additionally enhanced by specific movement pattern events added additionally in the emotion status evaluation. Emotion value can be information about object mood or simple alert of the excitements or calmness, as well as information of the increased or decreased excitement. Preferably, the proposed apparatus is using 60 GHz ISM Band integrated radar front, working in Doppler mode. Physical size of proposed apparatus in range: 4×2×1 cm or smaller.

title_en: A kind of estimating two-dimensional direction-of-arrival method applied to S-band through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of estimating two-dimensional direction-of-arrival methods applied to S-band through-wall radar, specifically includes the following steps: first, the rectangular array layout being made of asymmetrically distributed five bay is set, first antenna array element is placed in coordinate origin, other four bays are centered on first antenna array element, four quadrants are respectively placed in, and each bay and first antenna array element spacing are unequal；Then, using the incoherent signal Subspace algorithm of processing broadband signal, radar emission/received broadband signal is divided into multiple sub-bands on frequency domain, arrival direction estimation is done by the method for narrow band signal to the signal of each sub-band, then the DOA estimated result of each sub-band is done into weighting processing, obtains estimated result to the end；Estimating two-dimensional direction-of-arrival method applied to S-band through-wall radar of the invention eliminates the influence of false peak spectrum, and be applicable in narrowband and broadband signal while improving angular resolution.

title_en: Systems and methods for detecting buried objects
abstract_en: In one embodiment, a method for detecting buried objects includes receiving ground penetrating radar (GPR) signals captured at discrete locations along a surface of a medium in which an object may be buried, computing parameters based on the received GPR signals that are indicative of the proximity of a buried object, plotting the computed parameters as a function of location, determining an apex of a hyperbola that results from the plotting of the computed parameters, and designating a location at which the apex occurs as an estimated location of the buried object.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH FLORIDA;UNIV OF THE SCIENCES IN PHILADELPHIA

title_en: Double-frequency-band vital sign detection radar system based on superheterodyne and low-intermediate frequency structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-frequency-band vital sign detection radar system based on superheterodyne and a low-intermediate frequency structure, which comprises a receiving antenna and a transmitting antenna, wherein the receiving antenna is connected with a low-noise amplifier, a first frequency mixer and a band-pass filter in series; the transmitting antenna is connected with a power amplifier, the power amplifier is connected with a power synthesis structure, one path of the input end of the power synthesis structure is connected with a second phase-locked loop chip connected with the input end of the second mixer, and the other path of the input end of the power synthesis structure is connected with a power divider; the input end of the power divider is connected with a phase-locked loop chip, one path of the output end of the power divider is connected to the input end of the power synthesis structure, and the other path of the output end of the power divider is connected to the input end of the first frequency mixer. The invention can simultaneously solve the problems of direct current bias and image suppression and realize the detection effect of the vital sign signals with higher precision.

title_en: Intelligent imaging formula vital signs detecting instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of intelligent imaging formula vital signs detecting instrument, main control end, the scalable feeler lever containing signal transmssion line, the camera probe that feeler lever front end is arranged in, front end light source and front end signal processing unit including having main power source and display；Camera probe uses the double mode camera with infrared camera and colour imagery shot, the reflected light signal of body surface is received by the ccd image sensor inside camera probe, and reflected light signal is converted into picture signal, and signal processing is carried out by front end signal processing unit, obtain trapped person's vital sign parameter such as heart rate and respiratory rate；Picture signal also returns main control end by cable transmission in feeler lever；Front end light source is used to provide illumination for colour imagery shot.The present invention can effectively improve the reliability and accuracy for traditional optical formula vital signs detecting.

title_en: Appratus for controlling integrated supervisory of pilots status and method for guiding task performance ability of pilots using the same
title_ko: 조종사 상태의 통합 감시 제어 장치 및 이를 이용한 조종사의 임무 수행 능력 유도 방법
abstract_en: According to one aspect of the present invention, a method of deriving a pilot′s mission performance capability performed by an integrated supervisory and control apparatus of a pilot state for evaluating a mission performance capability necessary for piloting a piloted object based on state information of the pilot comprises: a signal measuring step of measuring surrounding environment information in conjunction with a control apparatus of the piloted object and measuring at least one biological signals including an electroencephalography signal, an eye movement signal, a skin electrical activity signal, and a respiration measurement signal through a sensor device mounted on the pilot; an information calculating step of reflecting the pilot′s environment information in real time into an arousal state evaluation model for evaluation of the pilot′s state, analyzing the at least one biological signals to extract individual feature information, inputting the extracted individual feature information into the arousal state evaluation model and calculating convergence feature information through a correlation analysis with the pilot′s arousal state; and an arousal state evaluation and feedback providing step of evaluating the pilot′s real-time arousal state level using the convergence feature information, and providing an arousal deriving feedback signal in accordance with the evaluated arousal state level.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 측면에 따른 조종사 상태의 통합 감시 제어 장치 및 이를 이용한 조종사의 임무 수행 능력 유도 방법은 조종사의 상태 정보에 기반하여 조종 대상체의 조정에 필요한 임무 수행 능력을 평가하는 조종사 상태의 통합 감시 제어 장치에 의해 수행되는 조종사의 임무 수행 능력 유도 방법에 있어서, 상기 조종 대상체의 제어 장치와 연계하여 주변 환경 정보를 측정하고, 조종사에 장착되는 센서 장치를 통해 뇌파 신호, 안구 움직임 신호, 피부 전기활동 신호, 호흡 측정 신호를 포함한 적어도 하나 이상의 생체신호를 측정하는 신호 측정 단계; 상기 조종 환경 정보를 조종사의 상태 평가를 위한 각성 상태 평가 모델에 실시간 반영하고, 상기 적어도 하나 이상의 생체 신호를 분석하여 개별 특징 정보를 추출한 후 상기 추출된 개별 특징 정보를 상기 각성 상태 평가 모델에 입력하여 조종사의 각성 상태와의 상관 관계 분석을 통해 융합 특징 정보를 산출하는 정보 산출 단계; 및 상기 융합 특징 정보를 이용하여 실시간 조종사의 각성 상태 수준을 평가하고, 상기 평가된 각성 상태 수준에 따라 각성 유도 피드백 신호를 제공하는 각성 상태 평가 및 피드백 제공 단계를 포함하는 것이다.

title_en: Electric concent box for laying wall of buinding
title_ko: 개선된 기능을 갖는 벽면 매설용 건축 전기 콘센트박스
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wall-buried building electrical outlet box having an improved function. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the building electrical outlet box for wall-embedded use having an improved function includes a short-range communication unit (300), a display part (500), a fire occurrence sensing unit (600), and a micom control part (400). The risk of electric shock due to the curiosity of an infant can be fundamentally prevented.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 콘센트박스에 있어서, 상기 콘센트박스 내부 및 외부에는 상기 콘센트박스의 현재 상태 정보를 사용자에게 송신하고, 송신된 상태 정보에 따른 사용자의 지령을 수신하여 상기 콘센트박스가 제어되도록 양방향 통신이 가능한 와이 파이, 지그비, NFC 내지 비콘을 포함하는 근거리 통신수단(300)이 하나 이상 마련되고, 상기 콘센트박스 외부에는 사용자에게 상기 콘센트박스의 상태 정보 메시지를 전달하는 LED 내지 OLED로 마련된 디스플레이부(500)가 마련되고, 상기 콘센트박스 내부 및 외부에는 온도센서(610) 및 연기센서(630)를 포함하는 화재 발생 감지수단(600)을 마련하여 상기 디스플레이부(500) 및 근거리 통신수단(300)을 통해 화재 발생 정보를 사용자에게 송신하고, 하나 이상의 알람 수단(700)을 상기 콘센트박스에 마련함으로써 화재 시 건물 내 또는 상기 콘센트박스 인근 지역에 화재에 관한 알람 기능을 수행하며, 상기 콘센트박스 내부에는 상기 근거리 통신수단(300), 디스플레이부(500), 화재 발생 감지수단(600), 알람수단(700) 및 콘센트박스를 제어하는 마이콤 제어부(400)가 마련되고, 외부의 우수나 해충의 침입으로 인해 발생하는 누수, 누전, 손상 방지를 위한 밀폐부재를 포함하는 케이싱이 마련되고, 상기 케이싱은 내화성, 내열성 및 내부식성을 확보하도록 아노다이징 표면처리 된 알루미늄과 스칸듐의 합금으로 형성되며, 상기 콘센트박스의 구성 중 적어도 하나 이상은 밀폐성능, 절연성, 내열성 및 내화학성을 확보하고 사용자의 그립감을 개선시키도록 실리콘 고무, 도자, ABS 및 PLA 중 어느 하나 이상을 사용하되, 정교한 형태를 확보하기 위해 3D 프린팅 가공을 통해 성형하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: System and method for vital signal sensing using a millimeter-wave radar sensor
abstract_en: A method of measuring vital signals using a millimeter-wave radar sensor system includes performing a first set of radar measurements using a millimeter-wave radar sensor to produce a first set of radar data; determining a first set of range gate measurements from the first set of radar data; determining high response range gates from the first set of range gate measurements; and extracting vital signal information from the high response range gates.

title_en: System and method for vital signal sensing using a millimeter-wave radar sensor
abstract_en: A system includes a millimeter-wave radar sensor disposed on a circuit board, a plurality of antennas coupled to the millimeter-wave radar sensor and disposed on the circuit board, and a processing circuit coupled to the millimeter-wave radar sensor and disposed on the circuit board. The processing circuit is configured to determine vital signal information based on output from the millimeter-wave radar sensor.

title_en: A kind of disaster relief unmanned plane
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of disaster relief unmanned planes, comprising: disc shaped shell, machine top rotor, side Zhou Xuanyi, diving cabin, shutter, goods and materials frame, infrared detection system and solar panel；Machine top rotor is mounted on disc shaped shell upper surface center；Side Zhou Xuanyi is uniformly arranged on disc shaped shell edge by connecting rod；Diving cabin is arranged in disc shaped shell bottom concave side；Shutter and solar panel include multiple, and are arranged at disc shaped shell surface；Shutter is disposed adjacent with solar panel；Goods and materials frame is detachably connected with disc shaped shell；Infrared detection system is arranged at disc shaped shell bottom concave side edge.The present invention both can be used for air transport disaster relief supplies, and accurately detect human life sign, and can snorkeling in water.
assignees: FOSHAN SHENFENG AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of double frequency circuit structure for realizing vital signs detecting and short distance positioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of double frequency circuit structures for realizing vital signs detecting and short distance positioning, receiving antenna connects No. four power splitters, No. four power splitter output ends are connected No. three bandpass filters, No.1 low-noise amplifier and No.1 orthogonal mixer all the way, and another way is connected No. four bandpass filters, No. two low-noise amplifiers and No. two orthogonal mixers；Transmitting antenna Series power amplifier, No. three power splitters, No. three power splitter connection No.1 power splitters and No. two power splitters；No.1 power splitter output end connects No. three power splitters all the way, and another way connects No.1 orthogonal mixer through No.1 bandpass filter；No. two power splitter output ends connect No. three power splitters all the way, and another way connects No. two orthogonal mixers through No. two bandpass filters.This invention simplifies the Doppler radar circuit structure for realizing vital signs detecting and short distance positioning, the Doppler radar circuit cost for realizing this two functions is reduced.

title_en: A kind of automatic detection and rescue robot of deep-well
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of automatic detection and rescue robots of deep-well, including No.1 body, No. two bodies, No.1 wheel, No. two wheels, crawler belt, No.1 operating room, No. two operating rooms, battery, control device, the positive and negative motor of No.1, laser radar, radar life-detection instrument, rotary shaft, No.1 gear, No. two gears, locating piece, compressed spring, winder, No.1 cylinder, No. two cylinders, No. two positive and negative motors, hemisphere wheel, servo motor and camera, by the way that winder is arranged in No. two operating rooms, and several locating pieces and compressed spring are set in the side of winder, locating piece is fixed in box body by compressed spring, and the line of winder is made to pass through all locating pieces, when radar life detector test is to life, locating piece is set to be depressed into ground downwards by No.1 cylinder, and then secure the wire in locating piece On ground, to facilitate rescue personnel's tripping in deep-well and be rescued along the direction finding wounded of line.

title_en: A kind of radar life-detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of radar life-detection instruments, are related to radar detector technical field.The utility model includes survey meter ontology, and one opposite flank of survey meter ontology is respectively and fixedly provided with both heights and adjusts component；Both heights, which adjust component and are rotatably assorted, limit assembly；Height adjustment assembly includes rectangle connection guide post；Rectangle connection one end face of guide post is provided with the first guiding circular hole；First guiding one inner wall of circular hole is hinged with electric telescopic rod by the first free bearing；The electric telescopic rod other end is hinged with end cap by the second free bearing；End cap one end week side is threaded with levelling column guide cylinder；Levelling column guide cylinder week side is provided with the first notch.The height adjustment assembly that the utility model passes through design, it is primary to place the first levelling and progress detection angle adjustment for being able to carry out radar life-detection instrument on ruins, supplement detection is carried out to horizontality detection blind area, solving existing radar life-detection instrument does not have the problem of detection angle regulating device, the time is searched and rescued in waste.
assignees: ANXIN KEGONG BEIJING TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus for measuring biological signal and operating method thereof
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정 장치 및 그의 동작 방법
abstract_en: According to one embodiment, a biological signal measuring apparatus can include: an optical sensor which includes a photo detector and a light source array disposed to surround the photo detector; a first electrode which is disposed between the photo detector and the light source array; a second electrode which is disposed at an outer side of the light source array; an impedance measuring unit which measures impedance of a subject through the first electrode and the second electrode; and a processing unit which determines contact state of the subject and the optical sensor based on the impedance of the subject. According to the present invention, it is possible to improve accuracy of measuring a biological signal.
abstract_ko: 일 실시예에 따른 생체 신호 측정 장치는, 광 검출기 및 상기 광 검출기 주위를 둘러싸도록 배치된 광원 어레이를 포함하는 광학 센서와, 상기 광 검출기와 상기 광원 어레이 사이에 배치된 제1 전극와, 상기 광원 어레이의 외곽에 배치된 제2 전극와, 상기 제1 전극 및 상기 제2 전극을 통해 피검체의 임피던스를 측정하는 임피던스 측정부와, 상기 피검체의 임피던스를 기반으로 상기 피검체와 상기 광학 센서의 접촉 상태를 판단하는 처리부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Smart device-based radar system detecting human vital signs using a compact circularly-polarized antenna
abstract_en: Techniques and apparatuses are described that implement a smart device-based radar system capable of detecting human vital signs using a compact circularly-polarized antenna. A radar system includes at least one compact circularly-polarized antenna with a patch antenna and a quadrature hybrid coupler. The quadrature hybrid coupler is on a separate plane that is above or below the patch antenna. By vertically stacking the patch antenna with the quadrature hybrid coupler, lateral dimensions of the radar system can be reduced relative to other antenna configurations or designs. The quadrature hybrid coupler can also have a ring-shape design to improve isolation and polarization purity of the compact circularly-polarized antenna relative to a rectangular design. The compact circularly-polarized antenna enables a radar system operating at frequencies between approximately 1 gigahertz (GHz) and 24 GHz to be implemented within a variety of small smart devices.

title_en: A kind of synthetic aperture imaging optimized treatment method, device for through-wall radar
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of synthetic aperture imaging optimized treatment method, device for through-wall radar, and this method step includes: that S1. detects destination region using through-wall radar, acquires multi-channel back wave signal；S2. channel echo domain each in multi-channel back wave signal signal is imaged respectively and is carried out coherent superposition, obtain image domain data；S3. the image domain data output for processing being focused the energy of mesh target area is carried out primary energy focusing, after obtaining optimization processing to image domain data；The device includes that echo-signal obtains module, multichannel coherent imaging module and image area focus optimization module.The present invention has many advantages, such as that implementation method is simple, can inhibit clutter in through-wall radar synthetic aperture image in real time, reduces false alarm rate and does not lose target energy.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Detections of radar false alarm rejection method and device based on constructure inner structure feature
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of detections of radar false alarm rejection method based on constructure inner structure feature, step includes: that S1. detects interior of building region by through-wall radar detection system, obtains the first detectable signal containing constructure inner structure characteristic information and the second detectable signal containing target signature information respectively；S2. feature extraction is carried out to the first detectable signal respectively, obtains the structure feature signal of interior of building, and feature extraction is carried out to the second detectable signal, obtains target signature signal；S3. obtained target signature signal is matched with structure feature signal, the echo signal after obtaining characteristic matching is exported as final detectable signal to filter out false-alarm；The device includes radar detected module, characteristic extracting module and characteristic matching module.The present invention has many advantages, such as simple implementation method, required at low cost, real-time and realizes that effect is good and high-efficient.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic monitoring system for sectional overhead line type slope earth surface deformation
abstract_en: The invention provides a segmented overhead line type slope earth surface deformation automatic monitoring system, a plurality of overhead line piles are sequentially arranged, a head end overhead line pile is defined as a control pile, and the control pile is positioned at a relatively stable position on the periphery of a slope earth surface potential landslide body; the lower end of the wire-lifting pile is buried in the ground surface of the side slope, the wire-lifting pile is rotationally connected with a rotating body, the upper end of the rotating body is provided with a fixed pulley support, the fixed pulley support is rotationally connected with a fixed pulley, a rotary displacement sensor is arranged on the rotating body and below the fixed pulley, the fixed pulley is movably connected with a steel wire rope, one end of the steel wire rope is connected with a steel wire rope tensioning device, a part between one end of the steel wire rope and the fixed pulley passes through the rotary displacement sensor, and the other end of the steel wire rope is fixedly connected with the adjacent wire-lifting pile; the power supply device is electrically connected with the data communication device, and the rotary displacement sensor is connected with the data processing device through the data communication device signal. The invention has the beneficial effects that: realize the long-term automatic monitoring of the slope surface deformation in a large scale, and the cost is low, the operation is convenient, simple and effective.

title_en: Rock-soil seepage real-time measuring instrument system based on heat conduction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rock-soil seepage real-time measuring instrument system based on heat conduction. The system is buried underground, each seepage measurement sensor is connected with a seepage information collection transmitter through a seepage measurement processing terminal, and the seepage information collection transmitter is connected with a transmitting end antenna; in the seepage flow measuring sensor, a thin tube funnel structure is a middle thin tube and two funnels connected to two ends of the thin tube, the small end of the funnels is fixed to the end part of the thin tube and is communicated with the thin tube, a porous ceramic plate is arranged on the end face of the large end of the funnels, a controllable heating rod is arranged in the center of the inside of the thin tube, a temperature sensor is arranged at two end parts of the inside of the thin tube, and a water detection needle is inserted in the middle of the inside of the thin tube. The invention accurately measures the direction and the seepage flow of the rock and soil caused by various reasons in the rock and soil, is a novel instrument for observing the seepage flow in the rock and soil in real time, and provides precursor information for the occurrence of disasters such as landslide, debris flow and the like.

title_en: Through-wall radar imaging method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses the through-wall radar imaging methods based on deep learning, first acquisition artificial echo data；BP imaging is carried out to echo data, input picture when as neural metwork training；Then simulation training generates reference picture, reference picture when as neural metwork training；Neural network is built using tensorflow tool to be trained training data, neural network is trained with input picture and reference picture, and generate network model；Trained network model is finally applied to measured data.Method provided by the invention improves the resolution ratio of through-wall radar imaging；Reduce the secondary lobe in through-wall radar image.

title_en: A kind of manned unmanned plane of composite material
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of manned unmanned planes of composite material, comprising: with respectively by unmanned planes more than three axis of corresponding motor driving, the execution module, the controlling terminal by wirelessly controlling unmanned plane and execution module respectively and for providing the battery of electric energy to execution module that are arranged on unmanned plane；Execution module includes: lighting system, radar life-detection instrument, GPS positioning system and/or high-definition camera；Further include: the fire extinguishing ball unmanned plane of ten or more the broken unmanned planes of detection, ten or more water spray unmanned planes and ten or more.Illumination rescue investigation composite material unmanned aerial vehicle group disclosed by the invention, six rotors can provide the angle for looking down the world for people, the image in disaster area can be transmitted in real time and be come out, rescue personnel is set to have the understanding of an entirety to disaster-stricken situation, radar life-detection instrument can detect the life entity in disaster area simultaneously, can rescue life entity.
assignees: FOSHAN SHENFENG AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Contactless detection and monitoring system of vital signs of vehicle occupants
title_ko: 차량 탑승자의 생체 신호의 무접촉 검출 및 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are methods and systems for detecting vital signs of occupants in vehicles, for example, the vehicle cabin. A signal unit transmits a radar signal to the occupant and receiving the radar signal reflected from the occupant. The reflected radar signal is analyzed with respect to vibration data of the vehicle, to produce a modified signal. The modified signal is analyzed to determine the vital signs of the occupant.
abstract_ko: 차량, 예를 들어, 차량 객실압의 탑승자의 생체 신호를 감지하기 위한 방법 및 시스템이 개시된다. 신호 유닛은 레이더 신호를 탑승자에게 전송하고, 탑승자로부터 반사된 레이더 신호를 수신한다. 반사된 레이더 신호는 차량의 진동 데이터에 관해 분석되어, 수정된 신호를 생성한다. 수정된 신호는 탑승자의 생체 신호를 결정하기 위해 분석된다.

title_en: A readout circuit for multi-sensing
title_ko: 멀티 센싱 리드아웃 회로
abstract_en: According to the present invention, in a multi sensor system, a readout circuit capable of creating a variety of signals inputted from TSP based on a touch or various environmental sensor signals inputted from an environment sensor as sensing information corresponding to the signals, and bio signals and environmental sensor signals may be sensed by including a touch signal without separate additional devices using one TSP so that corresponding signals are processed through a readout circuit corresponding to characteristics of signals when various signals are inputted.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따르면, 멀티 센서 시스템에 있어서, TSP로부터 터치를 기반으로 입력되는 다양한 신호 또는 환경 센서로부터 입력되는 다양한 환경 센서 신호를 해당 신호에 대응되는 센싱 정보로 생성할 수 있는 리드아웃 회로를 통합하여 구현하고, 다양한 신호가 입력되는 경우 신호의 특성에 대응되는 리드아웃 회로를 통해 해당 신호가 처리되도록 하여 하나의 TSP를 이용하여 별도의 추가적인 장치 없이 터치 신호를 포함하여 생체 신호 및 환경센서 신호도 센싱할 수 있도록 한다.
assignees: ULSAN NAT INST SCIENCE & TECH UNIST

title_en: Long-distance tunnel rock burst microseismic monitoring method for TBM (tunnel boring machine) under soft-hard interbed geological condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a long-distance TBM tunnel rock burst microseismic monitoring method under soft-hard interbed geological conditions, which is characterized in that a hard rock area and a soft rock area in a tunnel are distinguished through geological exploration, hard rock drill holes in the hard rock area are subjected to drill hole shooting, and a microseismic sensor is arranged in the hard rock drill holes of a complete hard rock section in the hard rock area; and installing the micro-seismic monitoring system on the TBM, and communicating the wireless network bridge group with the rock burst micro-seismic monitoring center outside the tunnel. The method better solves the problems of installation and recovery of the microseismic sensor under the soft-hard interbed geological condition, avoids the influence of a soft rock area on receiving the microseismic monitoring signal, overcomes the difficulty that a transmission line of a long-distance tunnel signal is easy to damage, ensures the quality and continuity of microseismic monitoring of the rock burst, and lays a foundation for accurate early warning of the rock burst disaster. The method can be used for the safe excavation of the deep-buried long-distance TBM tunnel engineering under the complex geological condition.

title_en: Portable software robot for life detection for earthquake relief
abstract_en: The invention relates to a portable soft robot for life detection for earthquake relief, which comprises a central loading body and a central resetting through groove, wherein the upper end of a central loading body is provided with a robot main transmission mechanism, the lower end of the central loading body is provided with a robot auxiliary transmission mechanism, the middle part of the central loading body is provided with a detection chamber, the front end of the detection chamber is provided with a sealing top cover, the periphery of the sealing top cover is provided with fixing screws, and the inside of the sealing top cover is provided with a cable through hole, the invention has the beneficial effects that: this portable software robot is used in life detection for earthquake relief is provided with center dress carrier, robot main drive mechanism, the vice drive mechanism of robot and detection room, through the center and the detection room that are located the device body center, can let the device body can keep better equilibrium through the center with behind the detection room linking installation circuit and the detection sensor, make things convenient for the device body to carry out better function.

title_en: Bio-processor, bio-signal detecting system, and method for operating the same
title_ko: 바이오 프로세서, 생체 신호 감지 시스템, 및 바이오 프로세서의 동작 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a bio-processor, a bio-signal detecting system, and a method of operating the same. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the bio-processor includes a bioelectrical impedance sensor and a digital signal processor. The bioelectrical impedance sensor measures the bioelectrical resistance for a period of time including a portion of a settling time. The digital signal processor estimates a stabilized bioelectrical resistance value based on a change in the measured bioelectrical resistance. The digital signal processor generates biometric data based on the stabilized bioelectrical resistance value. According to the embodiment of the present invention, it is possible to reduce the measurement time of a bio-signal, but to ensure the accuracy of the stabilized bioelectric resistance value.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 바이오 프로세서, 생체 신호 감지 시스템, 및 바이오 프로세서의 동작 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 바이오 프로세서는 생체 전기 저항 센서 및 디지털 신호 프로세서를 포함한다. 생체 전기 저항 센서는 정착 시간의 일부를 포함하는 시간 동안 생체 전기 저항을 측정한다. 디지털 신호 프로세서는 측정된 생체 전기 저항의 변화 추이에 기초하여 안정화된 생체 전기 저항 값을 추정한다. 디지털 신호 프로세서는 안정화된 생체 전기 저항 값에 기초하여 생체 데이터를 생성한다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따르면, 생체 신호의 측정 시간을 감소시키되, 안정화된 생체 전기 저항 값의 정확성을 확보할 수 있다.

title_en: Air-coupled type ground penetrating radar antenna
title_ko: 지면 이격형 지표투과레이다 안테나
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a ground-spaced type bistatic ground penetrating radar (GPR) antenna and, more specifically, to a ground-spaced type GPR antenna which reduces a direct wave that is a factor limiting imaging performance of a system when receiving in a receiving party of the GPR antenna by placing a loop antenna to be vertical to an antenna plane at a receiver point and allowing a feeding direction to be orthogonal to a feeding direction of a transmitter and the ground.
