The ground-spaced type GPR antenna spaced apart from the ground comprises: a transmitting antenna directed to the ground and penetrating a radio wave into the ground; and a receiving antenna receiving a radio wave which is radiated from the transmitting antenna and reflected from the ground, and fed to be perpendicular to the ground surface and the feeding direction of the transmitting antenna. The transmitting antenna uses a horn antenna having directivity and the receiving antenna uses a loop antenna in which a physical plane of the antenna is positioned to be perpendicular to the ground surface, thereby improving radar detection performance of the ground-spaced type GPR system.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지면 이격형 바이스태틱 지표투과레이다 안테나에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 수신기 지점에 루프 안테나를 안테나 평면에 수직이 되게 놓고 급전방향을 송신기의 급전방향 및 지표면과 직교가 되게 구성하여 지표투과레이다 안테나(Ground Penetrating Radar, 이하 GPR이라 칭함)의 수신측에서 수신하는 경우 시스템의 영상화 성능을 제한하는 요소인 직접파를 감소시킨 지면 이격형 지표투과레이다 안테나에 관한 것으로서, 지면에서 이격하여 구성된 지면 이격형 GPR 안테나에 있어서, 지면으로 지향시키고 내부로 전파를 침투시키도록 구성되는 송신안테나; 상기 송신안테나로부터 방사되어 상기 지중으로부터 반사되어 돌아오는 전파를 수신하고 상기 송신안테나의 급전 방향 및 지표면과 직각을 이루도록 급전받는 수신안테나;를 포함하고, 상기 송신안테나는 지향성을 갖는 혼 안테나를, 상기 수신안테나는 안테나의 물리적 평면이 지표면에 대해 수직을 이루도록 위치시킨 루프 안테나를 사용하도록 구성되어 지면 이격형 지표투과레이다 시스템의 레이다 탐지 성능을 향상시키는 효과가 있다.
assignees: KOREA INST GEOSCIENCE & MINERAL RESOURCES KIGAM

title_en: Search and rescue device and method integrating vibration and radar detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue device and a method for fusion of vibration and radar detection, wherein the device comprises a host module, a vibration detection module and a radar detection module, wherein the vibration detection module and the radar detection module are respectively connected with the host module, the vibration detection module detects vibration signals in a target area and sends vibration detection results to the host module, and the radar detection module detects vital sign signals of targets to be rescued in the area and sends radar detection results to the host module; the method obtains the final detection result of the target to be saved by fusing the vibration detection result and the radar detection result. The invention has the advantages of simple realization, high search efficiency and precision, strong anti-interference performance and the like.

title_en: Non-contact self-injection locking sensor
abstract_en: A non-contact self-injection locking sensor transmits a signal to a living body by a self-injection locking integrated oscillation antenna, and the signal reflected by the living body is injection-locked, and the signal is modulated by the phase of the vital sign of the living body, so that the physiological sign signal of the living body can be obtained by demodulating the injection locking signal of the self-injection locking integrated oscillation antenna by a demodulator.

title_en: Apparatus and method for determining defects in dielectric materials and detecting subsurface objects
abstract_en: An apparatus travels within a 3-dimensional space collecting data that may be used to expose defects in structures and objects beneath the ground surface. In a preferred embodiment, the apparatus includes an unmanned aerial vehicle controlled by a user. The apparatus carries LIDAR and ground penetrating radar and correlates data received from both to facilitate displaying a map with data superimposed on it representing locations of defects in structures and buried objects.

title_en: One kind is for vital signs detection device after calamity
abstract_en: The utility model discloses one kind for vital signs detection device after calamity, including equipment box, side inside equipment box is fixedly installed air pump, air pump is connected by one end of tracheae and connecting tube, the two sides on connecting tube top are symmetrically arranged with into object mouth and object out hole, the other end of connecting tube is fixedly connected with one end of infrared heat survey meter, and the other end of infrared heat survey meter is fixedly installed the second video intercom.The utility model passes through air pump, tracheae and the connecting tube being equipped with, convenient for the life such as food or water requirement is put into from connecting tube, air pump is recycled to inflate tracheae, slide to food near trapped person from connecting tube, to provide food and water etc. for trapped person, and infrared heat survey meter and the second video intercom can be fixed in connecting tube, pass through the first video intercom and the second video intercom being equipped with, convenient for carrying out video communication using the first video intercom and the second video intercom after finding trapped person.
assignees: SHENZHEN INVESTIGATION & RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Biont information is extracted to alarm switch control device and method using bioradar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to extract and utilize technical field to Biont information is contactless, disclose it is a kind of extract Biont information to alarm switch control device and method using bioradar, detected respectively by organism breathing that bioradar is extracted and restored simultaneously, heartbeat waveform；According to testing result, it provides a variety of logical combination level to export as alarm level, user selects the driving alarm switch movement of respective logic level as needed.The present invention is not required to object to be monitored in such a way that the vital sign for detecting organism carries out switch control by bioradar and issues the sound and move, it is not influenced by use environment temperature and thermal objects, and since bioradar wave energy effectively penetrates a variety of media (a variety of non-metal articles such as rain, mist, clothing, paper, plastics), so the problem that detection switch fails caused by stopping because of each type objects and rate of false alarm is high is also minimized.

title_en: Tunnel engineering safety construction excavation method
abstract_en: A tunnel engineering safe construction excavation method is characterized in that the excavation process of two opposite tunneling working faces of a deep-buried tunnel is continuously monitored through a micro-seismic sensor, the condition of a fault in front of the working face is detected in real time, and the working face of the tunnel excavated and penetrated through the fault is determined according to the distribution condition of the fault in front of the working face, so that the rockburst disaster caused when the working face of the tunnel penetrates through the fault can be effectively reduced, the construction safety of the tunnel is ensured, and the engineering construction progress is accelerated.

title_en: It is positioned in a kind of ship personnel cabin based on UWB and health management system arranged
abstract_en: The invention belongs to UWB technology fields, and in particular to position in a kind of ship personnel cabin based on UWB and health management system arranged.The system includes positioning label, locating base station, isochronous controller and the location-server with vital sign sensors；Wherein, positioning label issues pulse data packet repeatedly；Locating base station receives the pulse data packet that positioning label is sent out, and measures the precise time that each pulse data packet reaches locating base station antenna；Isochronous controller is used to complete the coordinated control of network, guarantees the positioning timing of each locating base station, and the pulse data packet for collecting each locating base station is sent to location-server；Location-server reaches time difference and the multi-path algorithm of each locating base station according to pulse data packet, determines the position of positioning label and the health status of personnel.The present invention can effectively solve the problem that due to cabin inner shield and the problem of position inaccurate.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign detection system and method
abstract_en: A non-contact vital sign detection system and method, the non-contact vital sign detection system has radar that locates near person under test, the non-contact vital sign detection system includes the data buffer, store a plurality of output signals of radar sampled sequentially in the predetermined period; the state classifier determines the state of the person to be tested according to the output signal; and the vital sign detector is used for obtaining the vital signs of the person to be detected according to the output signal when the person to be detected is in a static state.

title_en: A kind of earthquake rescue robot being convenient for carrying goods and materials
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of earthquake rescue robots for being convenient for carrying goods and materials, including car body, the car body both ends are respectively mounted searchlight, the searchlight side is installed by colored video camera, goods and materials storeroom is arranged in the vehicle body, cover board is set at the top of the goods and materials storeroom, the first in command is set at the top of the cover board, pedestal is arranged in the car body top, shield is arranged in the base top, the shield side wall installs two thermal imaging systems and two life-detection instruments, the first protecting tube is arranged in the shield side, hydraulic stem is installed at the top of first protecting tube, one end of described hydraulic stem installs the first link block.The beneficial effects obtained by the present invention are as follows being: structure of the invention is compact, it is easy to use, by extending hydraulic stem, and then hydraulic stem is made to drive the first link block mobile, and then make connecting rod that the second protecting tube be driven to rotate down, and then the length of earthquake rescue robot is shortened, and then earthquake rescue robot is facilitated to move in narrow rescue channel.
assignees: GUANGDONG HAIXUEYUN EDUCATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Through-wall radar signal optimization processing method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar signal optimization processing method and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, performing target detection on a region to be detected by using a through-wall radar, and receiving multi-channel echo signals corresponding to a plurality of apertures; s2, respectively acquiring aperture domain data of different apertures from multi-channel echo signals to form a plurality of sub-aperture data groups, respectively performing weighted imaging on full aperture data corresponding to the multi-channel echo signals and each sub-aperture data group, then comparing weighted imaging results, and obtaining optimized imaging data signals from similar parts in each weighted imaging result; the device comprises a radar detection module and a signal optimization processing module; the invention has the advantages of simple implementation method, low cost, good optimization performance, high efficiency and the like, and can realize real-time signal processing and simultaneously inhibit clutter.

title_en: Safe and reliable Quick rescue device and rescue mode after a kind of tunnel cave
abstract_en: The present invention relates to Quick rescue devices and rescue mode safe and reliable after a kind of tunnel cave.Quick rescue device includes the push-bench of built-in belt conveyor, radar life-detection instrument, the steel push pipe and jack of internal illumination device, after tunnel cave, Rapid Excavation active well, the push-bench and radar life-detection instrument of built-in belt conveyor are installed in active well, the steel push pipe of internal illumination device, jack, then the push-bench of built-in belt conveyor rescued by excavating, radar life-detection instrument detects the sign of life in collapsing ruins, make fast and accurately to reach rescue position, then trapped person is transported by belt conveyor from the rescue channel that the push-bench of built-in belt conveyor and the steel push pipe of internal illumination device are formed.It, securely and reliably and being capable of Quick rescue after the present invention can collapse in constructing tunnel.

title_en: One kind being suitable for tunnel-liner automatic checkout system and method
abstract_en: Present disclose provides one kind to be suitable for tunnel-liner automatic checkout system and method, automatic sweep apparatus is coupled including the pre-buried rail unit of segmented and radar antenna, the pre-buried rail unit of segmented includes multiple segmented guide rails and embedded bracket, each embedded bracket lifts a segmented guide rail, inside the pre-buried position to be measured in one end of embedded bracket, the pre-buried guide rail linear of segmented is arranged as coupling the mobile track of automatic sweep apparatus for radar antenna；It includes geological radar, elastic component and walking mechanism that radar antenna, which couples automatic sweep apparatus, the walking mechanism is parallel to the traffic direction of radar antenna, elastic component is laid between walking mechanism and radar antenna, and radar antenna progress lining quality detection on the track of the pre-buried rail unit composition of the segmented is lifted by walking mechanism.

title_en: Precise infrastructure mapping using full-waveform inversion of ground penetrating radar signals
abstract_en: A new method for FWI of common-offset GPR data, particularly targeting the dimensions and infilling material of buried pipes. The method is useful in situation where clear isolated diffraction hyperbolas indicate the presence of a pipe, but pipe dimensions and filling may be unknown. The invention is a method of taking GPR data and applying advanced numerical methods to get the depth and size of an underground pipe in a very accurate manner. An embodiment of the method consists of five main steps: GPR data processing, ray-based analysis to set a good initial model, 3D to 2D transformation of data, effective SW estimation, and FWI.

title_en: It is a kind of that the fire-fighting automatic spraying device of exterior walls of buildings protrusion structurally is set
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of, the fire-fighting automatic spraying device of exterior walls of buildings protrusion structurally is set, including the extinguishing pipe being connected in fire-fighting automatic spraying device ontology, the extinguishing pipe is respectively positioned on the lower section of external wall projective structure, and extinguishing pipe is supported by the multiple pre-buried bracing members being arranged below, the pre-buried bracing members are L shape, one end of pre-buried bracing members is embedded in external wall, and the other end of pre-buried bracing members is vertically upward；The side of the extinguishing pipe downward opens up multiple threaded holes, and the connection of threaded hole internal screw thread adjusts one end of pipeline, adjusts the other end connection applicator of pipeline；Originally practical to play the role of controlling external wall fire under the premise of having substantially no effect on facade effect, the flame retardant treatment of thermal insulation material, ornament materials, component by External Wall etc., when fire occurs, sprawling of the intensity of a fire by exterior wall can effectively be slowed down, gained time for fire-fighting and rescue.

title_en: Life signal synchronous measurement system and measurement method for biological radar detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life signal synchronous measurement system and a measurement method for biological radar detection, and belongs to the technical field of biological radar and life signal measurement. The touch sensor group control system comprises a plurality of touch sensor groups and a control display end; each contact sensor group comprises a piezoelectric respiration sensor and a photosensitive pulse sensor; the control display end comprises a computer and a Bluetooth router, and the contact sensor group is communicated with the computer through the Bluetooth router; the computer is in communication with the biological radar system and is used for monitoring the working state of the biological radar system. A third-party software monitor is established by using a Hook technology in a Windows message mechanism, namely, a Hook is used for capturing event messages of starting/stopping measurement of the software of the biological radar system, and when the events of starting/stopping data storage of the biological radar are monitored, a synchronous measurement system is immediately triggered to start/stop data storage, so that the time synchronization of the data collected by the biological radar system and the data collected by the biological radar system is realized.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting vital sign headgear system based on ad hoc network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of fire-fighting vital sign headgear system based on ad hoc network, it includes vital sign module (1), gyro module (2), microprocessor module (6) and ad hoc network transmission module (7), vital sign module (1) is located at the inside of the helmet, vital sign module (1) includes photoelectric sensor (4) and temperature sensor (5), the photoelectric sensor (4) is through epidermis for detecting heart rate, and temperature sensor (5) is for measuring head skin temperature；Gyro module (2) is used to detect movement, the attitude data information of people；Vital sign module (1), the information conveyance of gyro module (2) detection are given microprocessor module (6), and microprocessor module (6) sends the data received by ad hoc network transmission module (7)；The invention enables the states that Fire Command Center more accurately understands fire fighter, and can make the decision to rescue and relief work faster.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHONGLI ELECTRONICS INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;JIANGSU ZHONGLI GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Fire escape room fire door
title_ko: 화재 대피실용 방화문
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire door for a fire escape room, which is for temporarily evacuating when a fire occurs in a high-rise building such as an apartment, a building, etc. The fire door prevents high temperature heat and toxic gas from fire, and is prevented from thermal deformation, so that it is possible to not only protect people from suffocation, burns, etc. but also improve the fire resistance of the fire door. According to the present invention, a fire door installed at the entrance of a fire escape room includes: a heat insulating material installed inside the fire door; a heat insulating space disposed inside the fire door and disposed on the front surface of the heat insulating material; an external panel surrounding the outside of the heat insulating material and the heat insulating space; and a sight window installed through the heat insulating material, the heat insulating part and the external panel to inspect the inside of the fire escape room.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 아파트나 빌딩 등의 고층 건물에서 화재 발생시 일시적으로 대피하는 화재 대피실용 방화문에 관한 기술로서, 화재로 인한 고온의 열과 유독가스를 차단하고, 방화문의 열변형을 방지하므로, 대피자들의 질식사고와 화상 등의 인명피해를 방지할 뿐만 아니라 방화문의 내화성을 높이는 화재 대피실용 방화문에 관한 기술이다. 
이러한 본 발명의 주요 구성은, 화재 대피실의 입구에 설치되는 방화문에 있어서, 상기 방화문에 내장 설치되는 차열단열재; 상기 방화문의 내부에 설치되고, 차열단열재의 전면에 배치되는 차열공간부; 상기 차열단열재와 차열공간부의 외부로 감싸는 외장패널; 상기 차열단열재와 차열공간부 및 외장패널을 관통하여 설치되고, 대피실의 내부를 확인하기 위한 투시창;을 포함하여 구현된다.

title_en: Multi-target life detection method based on radar signals and detection radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar signal-based multi-target life detection method and a detection radar, wherein time accumulation in a slow time direction is carried out on a preprocessed echo signal to obtain a first echo signal; carrying out inflection point envelope extraction on the first echo signal to obtain a second echo signal; calculating the average value of all amplitude signals except the M mark amplitude signals in the second echo signal; if the ratio of the marking amplitude signal to the average value is larger than a threshold value, a life target is arranged at the radar detection distance corresponding to the marking amplitude signal; the life detection method provided by the invention normalizes the amplitude of the radar signal on the dimension of fast time (distance) by adopting a normalization method, solves the problem of energy attenuation generated along with the increase of the distance in the transmission process of the radar signal, and effectively reduces the rate of missing judgment of a far-end target; and the method of twice inflection point envelope extraction is adopted, so that the multi-target axial identification accuracy is improved.

title_en: A kind of through-wall detection radar installations and Through-Wall Radar System
abstract_en: Through-wall detection radar installations provided by the utility model, including range finder module, wireless network module, signal emission module, signal receiving module, time synchronization module and signal processing module, it can be while guaranteeing portable, largely improve the azimuth resolution of the Through-Wall Radar System, the utility model also provides Through-Wall Radar System, higher azimuth resolution may be implemented using more portable through-wall detection radar installations, improving Effect on Detecting.

title_en: A kind of human body detection imaging method through walls based on kurtosis assessment
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of human body detection imaging methods through walls based on kurtosis assessment, in this method, establish the constraint relationship between wall parameter；To three-dimensional data matrix Focusedimage is obtained using the self-focusing imaging algorithm based on kurtosis assessed value；During step 5 obtains focal imaging, human body target has been detected whether using the maximum value of kurtosis value sequence.Method of the invention uses the self-focusing imaging algorithm based on kurtosis assessed value, traditional MIMO radar BP imaging model is modified in conjunction with wall parameter, then enhancing amendment has been carried out to Human Physiology micro-tremor signal in self-focusing imaging process, revised algorithm can obtain the higher-quality self-focusing image of Human Physiology micro-tremor signal.

title_en: A kind of multi-functional full landform fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to fire-fighting robot technical fields, it is a kind of multi-functional full landform fire-fighting robot, including main body, crawler type walking mechanism, connection shaft, crawler type climbing mechanism, central processing unit, rotating device, first support bar, camera, 4G transmit network interface card, loudspeaker, second support bar, life-detection instrument, transmission module, extinguishing device, temperature sensor；The utility model rotates turntable by rotating electric machine and carries out patrol monitoring, the temperature change of temperature sensor real-time monitoring surrounding enviroment, camera records the information detected in real time, the information that 4G transmission network interface card will test in real time is transferred to fire-fighting control platform, without considering the place of monitoring and the complexity of scene of fire rescue environment in use process, it saves in time to fire source, it is existing high to landform environmental requirement to efficiently solve existing fire-fighting robot, it encounters rough terrain use and is restricted the problem of cannot rescuing fire in time, fire excessive loss is avoided to increase.
assignees: URUMQI ZHIYUAN YITONG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of life-detection system based on multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, method
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of life-detection system based on multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, method, the system includes multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and the life detection radar device being mounted in multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, it further include the motion compensation unit being connect with life detection radar device, multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle is in region to be measured when flight, life entity target acquisition is carried out by life detection radar device, in life detection radar device detection process, motion compensation is carried out to radar detection signal according to the real-time position information of multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle by motion compensation unit, to compensate the offset deviation that multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle shake generates.The present invention have many advantages, such as structure it is simple, it is at low cost, can be realized dynamic life detection, and detection efficient and precision is high, detection mode is flexible.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of false alarm rejection method, apparatus for through-wall radar detection
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of false alarm rejection method, apparatus for through-wall radar detection, this method step includes: that S1. detects purpose interior of building region using through-wall radar detection system, acquires the first echo signal comprising interior of building strong reflection spot characteristic information respectively and comprising the second echo signal of target signature information；S2. first echo signal is detected, obtains interior of building strong reflection spot characteristic signal, and detect to second echo signal, obtain interior of building target signature signal；S3. interior of building strong reflection spot characteristic signal, interior of building target signature signal are subjected to characteristic matching, the echo signal after being matched is exported as final target detection signal to filter out false-alarm.The present invention is able to suppress the false-alarm generated by structure feature in building, and has many advantages, such as simple implementation method, at low cost, strong real-time, inhibition precision and high-efficient.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Home occupant detection and monitoring system
abstract_en: A occupant detection and monitoring system has a sensor unit having a radio wave transmitter, a radio wave receiver, and a wireless transmitter configured to detect and receive vital signs of an occupant; a user interface having a microcontroller, a wireless receiver configured to receive the wireless signals transmitted from the sensor unit, a means for user input, and a network card; and a means for alerting occupants and third-parties to a triggering event; wherein the microcontroller, based upon logic, activates the alerting means at the triggering event. The sensor unit may be a camera that detects the presence of an individual and register their unique heart rhythm for identification purposes. This camera can be installed at the entry points of a home, behind the counter of a business near a cash register or at a bank or any other place that desires to use surveillance as a form of security. The sensor unit may be a light bulb that comprises the components of the sensor unit. The sensor unit may be a contactless vital sign monitor capable of remotely monitoring one or more vital signs.

title_en: Soil body flowing model test system for large-scale vibration table experiment platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to a soil mass flow model test system for a large-scale vibration table test platform, which comprises: and (4) modeling a box: the device is used for simulating the motion conditions of soil bodies under the action of earthquake loads on mountain surfaces with different slopes and under different friction strengths; a data acquisition device: the device comprises a computer, a high-speed camera arranged on the front surface of a model box and connected with the computer, a three-dimensional laser scanner arranged on one side of the model box, a sensor which is connected with a data acquisition device of the existing large-scale vibrating table through a data line and is buried in the soil body of the model box, and monitoring cameras arranged on the side surface and the bottom of the model box. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of convenience and automation, convenient and adjustable door opening, avoidance of impact and swing, accurate data capture and the like.

title_en: A kind of life signal Enhancement Method based on segmentation classification enhancing processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of life signal Enhancement Methods based on segmentation classification enhancing processing, remove ULTRA-WIDEBAND RADAR echo-signal background clutter, echo signal registration block is selected using simulated scenario emulation data, judge whether survey window matches with registration block using sliding window, classification segmentation denoising, enhancing are carried out to radar signal matrix, multiframe weighting processing is being carried out to treated result, finally enhance distant signal with local normalization method, the signal matrix finally enhanced is used for coordinate detection life entity.The present invention realizes the enhancing to life signal, by doing different processing to different types of signal matrix block, effectively is denoised, enhanced for the type of signal, it is modified using consecutive frame, and the amplitude of distant signal is enhanced, become apparent the position of echo signal all accurately, to provide guarantee for subsequent detection in time domain and frequency domain.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;SUZHOU TIANBIYOU TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of life detection radar of three-dimensional localization
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of life detection radar of three-dimensional localization, including radio-frequency receiving-transmitting subelement, for modulating the electromagnetic signal for generating low-frequency ultra-wideband, and receives and demodulate target echo signal；MIMO imaging antenna array element, including be made of multiple transmission antenna units transmitting antenna array, for outside electromagnetic radiation signal；And the receiving antenna array being made of multiple receiving antenna units, it is used for receives echo-signal；Radio-frequency receiving-transmitting switch matrix unit, between radio-frequency receiving-transmitting subelement and MIMO imaging antenna array element, for realizing the switching for the unlike signal interchannel that transmitting signal and echo-signal are constituted in different antennae unit；Data acquisition and signal processing unit generate transmitting signal for controlling radio-frequency receiving-transmitting subelement, and for receiving target echo signal, carry out analysis imaging and target detection identification.The life detection radar of the three-dimensional localization of the utility model has many advantages, such as that positioning accuracy is high, penetration capacity is strong and high sensitivity.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of human life feature detection device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of human life feature detection device, and the device includes: doppler sensor, is used for human-body emitting microwave signal, and receive the feedback signal of human body；Filter amplifier module, including multi-stage filter circuit, input terminal are connect with doppler sensor, are obtained feedback signal and are filtered and amplify；Control module is connect with the output end of filter amplifier module.The design utilizes the microwave signal of doppler sensor, and the vital sign signals frequency of human body is acquired in the case where not contacting human body.

title_en: Insulation Wall-pannel structure for improving hardness and cohesion
title_ko: 내진 성능을 갖춘 열교 차단형 단열 벽 패널 구조체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a thermal bridge prevention type insulation wall panel structure having earthquake-resistance performance, capable of having an earthquake-resistance performance by enabling a wall panel to offset vibrations and movements caused by an external shock. According to an advisable embodiment of the present invention, the present invention comprises: a wall panel comprising an outer finishing material and an insulator integrated directly with the rear side of the outer finishing material; fixtures buried in the upper and lower parts of the wall panel respectively; a connection plate located and fixed between wall panels stacked vertically; an L-shaped fixing bracket having a side bolted with the connection plate and having the other side fixed to a wall or support structure of a building through anchor bolts; and a fixing joint comprising a horizontal insertion part inserted into a separation part of the connection plate and vertical insertion parts inserted into insertion holes of fixtures in the upper and lower parts and fixed.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 벽 패널 설치시 벽 패널의 상부와 하부에 각각 고정구를 매입시키고 고정구에 구조용 브래킷으로 상하 벽 패널 고정시에 "ㅏ" 형상의 연결 고정용 이음부재를 추가로 설치하여 좌/우측으로 이동 설치가 가능하여 수평방향의 오차의 수렴이 용이하면서도 벽면에 설치된 벽패널이 외부 충격에 의한 움직임과 진동을 상쇄할 수 있어 내진 성능을 갖추도록 하는 내진 성능을 갖춘 열교 차단형 단열 벽 패널 구조체에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 바람직한 일 실시예는 외부 마감재와, 외부 마감재의 배면에 직접적으로 일체화 된 단열재로 형성되는 벽 패널과; 상부가 개구되어 삽입구가 형성되는 U형 단면으로 이루어져 삽입구가 노출되도록 벽 패널의 상단부와 하단부에 각각 매입되는 고정구와; 일정 길이의 수평 판형상의 조정판과, 조정판의 일측 단부에서 일정 거리 이격되어 이격부가 형성되도록 각각 수평방향으로 연장되는 연장부와, 한 쌍의 연장부의 외측단부에서 상하부로 엇갈려 형성되도록 수직 상방 및 하방으로 연장되는 걸림턱으로 이루어져, 벽 패널의 상하부 적층시 상하부 적층된 벽 패널의 사이에 위치하여 걸림턱이 고정구의 삽입구에 삽입되어 고정되는 연결플레이트와; 일측은 연결플레이트에 볼트 결합되고, 타측은 앵커 볼트를 통해 건축물의 벽체 또는 지지용 구조물에 고정되는 "L" 자 형상의 고정 브라켓과; 일정길이의 수직끼움부와 수직끼움부의 중앙부에서 수평방향으로 일체로 형성되는 수평끼움부로 이루어져, 수평끼움부가 연결플레이트의 이격부에 삽입되며 수직끼움부가 각각 상부와 하부의 고정구의 삽입구에 삽입되어 고정되는 고정용 이음부재;를 포함하여 이루어진다.

title_en: A kind of object detection method suitable for through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of object detection methods suitable for through-wall radar to obtain raw radar data by radar to objective emission signal wave, and pre-processes to raw radar data；Pulse compression is carried out by matched filter, static target is inhibited by mti filter, obtains moving target indication data；By Doppler filter group, Doppler frequency-distance-angle dimension data of moving target is obtained；Three-dimensional CFAR detection is first carried out to Doppler frequency-distance-angle dimension data of moving target, then testing result is clustered, identifies quantity and the position of aobvious moving-target；Doppler frequency-distance-angle dimension data of moving target is condensed, determines quantity and the position of target, three-dimensional CFAR detection then is carried out to the quantity that cohesion comes out, identifies fine motion target.The present invention separates aobvious moving-target and the testing process of fine motion target, provides different detection methods to improve the detection probability of target.

title_en: High-resolution through-wall radar imaging method based on group structure and correlation study
abstract_en: High-resolution through-wall radar imaging method based on group structure and correlation study, is related to the technical field of radar imagery.The present invention includes the following steps: the homogenous linear array for assuming N array element, emulates the through echo-signal of n-th of array element；M frequency point echo-signal of vectorization N number of array element simultaneously；Emulate N number of array element multipath echo signal；Obtain compressed observation data；It constructs a layering Bayes and generates model；Variable γ, x are optimized with c；Initialize γ, x and c；Calculate the upper bound that a nonzero element of γ is become to objective function reduction after neutral element Calculate the upper bound that a neutral element of γ is become to objective function reduction after nonzero element γ is converged into optimal value；Parameter c is learnt group interior element correlation.The present invention take full advantage of in signal group sparsity structure and organize correlation between interior element, the sparse reconstruct mean square error of signal can be effectively improved, observation number needed for reducing reconstruct original signal, and there is stronger noise resisting ability.
assignees: NANJING HUIJUN SEMICONDUCTOR TECH CO LTD

title_en: High-resolution through-wall radar imaging method based on spatial structure correlation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-resolution wall-penetrating radar imaging method based on spatial structure relevance, which comprises the following steps of: acquiring an echo signal of an nth array element receiving observation scene in the N-dimensional uniform linear array; receiving echo signals of N array elements and M frequency points in a vectorization mode; electromagnetic wave multipath propagation is caused by reflection of an inner wall, and echo signals received by the N-dimensional array under the multipath propagation are obtained; performing down-sampling on the measurement signal to obtain an observation vector of sparse reconstruction; adding group sparse prior distribution to direct wave and K-1 multipath reflection coefficient vectors to simulate a group sparse structure of the vectors; and (4) iteratively solving each parameter by using a parameter estimation formula to obtain a high-resolution through-wall radar imaging result. The method fully utilizes a group sparse structure of multipath propagation and a spatial distribution structure of target continuity in the through-wall radar imaging process, and obtains a high-resolution radar image.

title_en: A kind of disaster relief system, method and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of disaster relief system, method and storage mediums, including radar detector, image capture device, monitoring server and maneuvering platform；Radar detector acquires the vital sign information and location information of life entity, and is sent to image capture device；Image and the vital sign information received are sent to monitoring server by image capture device；The image received and vital sign information are sent to maneuvering platform by monitoring server, so that salvor formulates rescue plan according to the vital sign information in maneuvering platform and the environmental information in image and notifies that the disaster relief is live.Due in embodiments of the present invention, salvor can formulate rescue plan according to the vital sign information in maneuvering platform and the environmental information in image and be notified at the first time to scene, therefore life entity after can not only being shaken with quick lock in, the help and guidance that disaster relief expert can also be got in first time after shake greatly improve disaster relief efficiency after shake.

title_en: System and Method for Monitoring Life Signs of a Person
abstract_en: A system and method for monitoring a person within a defined area by detecting breathing, or the lack thereof. Breathing is detected using radar signals, camera signals and/or microphone signals. The radar signals, camera signals and/or microphone signals are analyzed to determine if the subject person is moving, and if not moving if the person is breathing or not-breathing. An alarm is generated should the reflected radar signals, the camera signals and the microphone signals all simultaneously indicate no movement and no movement of the subject person in the defined area for a selected period of time.

title_en: A kind of life detection radar system and method based on random code modulated sinusoid signal
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of life detection radar system and methods based on random code modulated sinusoid signal, including radar host computer and handheld terminal, the radar host computer includes power module, central processing unit, transmitting unit, receiving unit, transmitting antenna, receiving antenna and communication unit, life detection order is sent from the handheld terminal to radar host computer, system generates random code modulated sinusoid signal after receiving order, emitted after power amplifier amplifies by transmitting antenna, life detection is carried out to target area, the echo-signal that receiving antenna receives is demodulated after low noise amplifier amplifies by quadrature demodulator, data acquisition module is acquired the signal after demodulation, then it exports to central processing unit and carries out the extraction of life-information and location information, and it will analyze and determine that result is transmitted to handheld terminal and shows.Random code signal is introduced into traditional Doppler's life detection radar by this system, is quick on the draw, high resolution, strong antijamming capability.

title_en: Tunnel engineering safety construction excavation method
abstract_en: A tunnel engineering safe construction excavation method is characterized in that the excavation process of two opposite tunneling working faces of a deep-buried tunnel is continuously monitored through a micro-seismic sensor, the fault condition in front of the working faces is detected in real time, and when a plurality of faults exist in front of the working faces at two sides, the excavation sequence of the working faces at two sides of the tunnel is determined according to the rock mass property between each fault and the working face, so that the rockburst disasters caused when the working faces of the tunnel pass through the faults can be effectively reduced, and the tunnel construction safety is ensured.

title_en: Build long-distance intelligent life detection fire extinguishing system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses building long-distance intelligent life detection fire extinguishing systems, wireless smoke sensor device, radio temperature sensor, wireless heart rate detection sensor, radar detection sensor, full-view camera, several first spray heads, the second spray head and pressure dry powder extinguisher and central signal including being mounted on architecture indoor receive control machine；The central signal receives control machine and is configured as receiving the signal that wireless smoke sensor device, radio temperature sensor, radar detection sensor, full-view camera and wireless heart rate detection sensor issue, the triggering of the start and stop of full-view camera and the trigger mechanism of pressure dry powder extinguisher is controlled, and carries out both-way communication and connect to be controlled by it with fire-fighting central platform.The utility model carries out fire behavior control in first time, while informing fighting condition of afflicted personnel information and trapped person's situation, reduces rescue difficulty and fighting personnel probability in danger, while increasing the chance for survival of trapped person.
assignees: SICHUAN JIANAN CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Wall parameter estimation method of through-wall radar
abstract_en: A wall parameter estimation method of a through-wall radar mainly solves the problem that the deviation of wall parameter estimation results is large due to the fact that the accuracy of time delay estimation results is poor in the conventional method. The method comprises the steps of estimating the time delay difference of the reflected waves of the front surface and the rear surface of the wall body through a seven-step orthogonal matching pursuit sparse reconstruction algorithm, constructing the time delay difference estimated values and the time delay difference theoretical values of M observation positions into an objective function, accurately estimating the thickness and the relative dielectric constant of the wall body through minimizing the objective function, and accurately estimating the conductivity of the wall body by combining the amplitude ratio of the reflected waves of the rear surface and the front surface of the wall body under the condition of single-base transceiving. In the wall parameter estimation process, an orthogonal matching pursuit sparse reconstruction algorithm is adopted to estimate the double-pass transmission delay difference of the front surface and the rear surface of the wall, so that the resolution and the accuracy of the delay difference estimation result under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio are improved, and the accuracy of wall parameter estimation is ensured. The method is particularly suitable for parameter estimation of the thin-layer wall body under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio.

title_en: Maritime disaster prevention system
title_ko: 해상 조난사고 예방 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for preventing maritime distress, and more specifically, to a system for preventing maritime distress, which automatically stops the screw of a ship in emergency and at the same time, sends an emergency rescue request signal through an inter-ship communication network and a control center communication network when a marine accident (death due to loss of footing) occurs, thereby maximizing the probability of survival of crew on board during navigation. To achieve the purpose, the present invention provides the system for preventing maritime distress comprising: a biometric sensor device mounted on essential equipment of the crew and including a biometric signal measuring unit measuring biometric signals of the crew and a first transmitting unit transmitting, to a remote control server unit, a biometric signal measured by the biometric signal measuring unit through wireless communications; and the remote control server unit provided in the ship and including a biometric signal receiving unit receiving a signal transmitted from the biometric sensor device, a screw control unit emergently stopping the screw being driven, and a second transmitting unit transmitting an urgent rescue request signal to a neighboring ship and a control center through wireless communications. When the biometric sensor device and the remote control server unit are out of a predetermined section, a contact signal is lost, and the communication is terminated for a predetermined period of time, the system considers the termination as an accident due to loss of footing such that the screw control unit automatically and emergently stops the screw being driven, and simultaneously, the second transmitting unit transmits the urgent rescue request signal through the inter-ship communication network and the control center communication network.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 해상 조난사고 예방 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 해상에서 사고발생(실족사)시 자동으로 선박의 스크류를 비상정지시킴과 동시에 긴급구조요청 신호를 선박 간 통신망 및 관제센터 통신망으로 송신하므로 선박에 승선한 선원들이 항해 중 생존확률을 극대화할 수 있는 해상 조난사고 예방 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
이러한 목적 달성을 위한 본 발명은 선원의 필수장비에 장착되며, 상기 선원의 생체신호를 측정하는 생체신호 측정부와, 상기 생체신호 측정부에서 측정된 생체신호를 무선통신을 통해 원격 관제 서버부로 송신하는 제1 송신부를 포함하는 생체인식센서장치; 및 선박에 구비되며, 상기 생체인식센서장치로부터 송신되는 신호를 수신하는 생체신호 수신부와, 구동 중인 스크류를 비상정지시키는 스크류 제어부와, 인근 선박 및 관제센터에 무선통신을 통해 긴급구조요청 신호를 송신하는 제2 송신부를 포함하는 원격 관제 서버부;를 포함하되, 상기 생체인식센서장치와 원격 관제 서버부가 일정구간을 벗어나 접점신호가 상실되어 기설정된 일정기간 동안 통신이 두절되면 실족사고로 간주하여 자동으로 스크류 제어부가 구동되고 있는 스크류를 비상정지시킴과 동시에 제2 송신부가 긴급구조요청 신호를 선박 간 통신망 및 관제센터 통신망으로 송신하는 해상 조난사고 예방시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Connector suppling of electric power
title_ko: 지중배전라인 분기가 가능한 안전성 향상 연결 커넥터
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a connector with improved safety, capable of branching an underground distribution line, which comprises: a case (10) for forming an appearance; a clamp (20) buried in the case (10); a connection pipe (30) pressed and fixed by the clamp (20), and electrically connecting and fixing an underground distribution line (L) inserted into the case (10); a filling material (40) injected into the case (10) to be integrally formed with the case (10), the clamp (20), the connection pipe (30), and the underground distribution line (L); a fixed plate (50) fixed to the bottom; a lifting stand (60) movably installed on an upper surface of the fixed plate (50), and having the case (10) buried to be vertically moved; a sensor (70) for sensing the underground distribution line (L) fixed to the case (10) to output a sensing signal; a control unit (80) for receiving the sensing signal from the sensor (70), and outputting a submersion warning signal; and a transmitting device (90) for receiving a the submersion warning signal from the control unit (80), and transmitting the same to the outside. According to the present embodiment, the underground distribution line can be easily branched, and the impact applied to a connection part of the underground distribution line can be minimized to prevent damage thereby, by offsetting the force while the lifting stand moves along the upper surface of the fixed plate in a direction that external force is applied when the external force is applied to the underground distribution line.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지중배전라인 분기가 가능한 안전성 향상 연결 커넥터에 관한 것으로서, 외관을 이루는 케이스(10)와; 케이스(10)에 내설되는 클램프(20)와; 클램프(20)에 의해 가압고정되며 케이스(10)의 내측으로 인입된 지중배전선(L)을 전기적으로 상호 연결 및 고정시키는 연결관(30)과; 케이스(10)에 주입되어 케이스(10)와 클램프(20), 연결관(30) 및 지중배전선(L)과 일체형을 이루는 충진재(40)와; 바닥에 고정되는 고정판(50)과; 고정판(50)의 상면에 이동가능하게 설치되며 케이스(10)가 상하이동가능하게 내설되는 승강대(60)와; 케이스(10)에 고정된 지중배전선(L)을 감지하여 감지신호를 출력하는 감지센서(70)와; 감지센서(70)로부터 감지신호를 전달받아 침수경고신호를 출력하는 제어부(80)와; 제어부(80)로부터 침수경고신호를 전달받아 외부로 송신하는 송신기(90);를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
본 실시 예에 의하면, 지중배전선을 손쉽게 분기할 수 있고, 특히 지중배전선에 외력이 작용하게 될 경우 외력이 작용하는 방향으로 고정판의 상면을 따라 승강대가 이동하면서 힘을 상쇄시켜 줌으로 지중배전선의 연결부위에 가해지는 충격을 최소화할 수 있어 이에 따른 손상을 방지할 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Electronic apparatus and labeling method thereof
title_ko: 전자 장치 및 그의 레이블링 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is an electronic apparatus. According to the present invention, the electronic apparatus comprises: a user input unit including a button; a sensor measuring a brain signal and a vital sign of a user; an audio output unit outputting audio to provide audiogenic stimulation to the user; and a processor outputting the audio through the audio output unit while measuring the brains signal and the vital sign of the user through the sensor, determining a conscious state of the user based on user reaction to the audio inputted/outputted through the button, and classifying the measured brain signal and the measured vital sign for each determined conscious state to label the classified brain signal and the classified vital sign.
abstract_ko: 전자 장치가 개시된다. 본 전자 장치는 버튼을 포함하는 사용자 입력부, 사용자의 뇌신호 및 생체 신호를 측정하는 센서, 사용자에게 청각 자극을 제공하기 위한 오디오를 출력하는 오디오 출력부 및 센서를 통해 상기 사용자의 뇌신호 및 생체 신호를 측정하는 동안 오디오 출력부를 통해 오디오를 출력하고, 버튼을 통해 입력된 출력된 오디오에 대한 사용자의 반응에 기초하여 사용자의 의식 상태를 판단하고, 측정된 뇌신호 및 생체 신호를 판단된 의식 상태별로 구분하여 레이블링하는 프로세서를 포함한다.

title_en: Remote life micro-tremor signal detection method based on Terahertz Doppler radar
abstract_en: The remote life micro-tremor signal detection method based on Terahertz Doppler radar that the invention discloses a kind of, and in particular to life micro-tremor signal detection technique field.This method is digitized by four road life entity reflection echo signal of Terahertz Doppler radar real-time reception by tetra- road life entity reflection echo signal of multichannel digital Yi Dui；Inhibit the static clutter in four road life entity reflection echo signals；Linear trend item in the four road life entity reflection echo signals for filtering out static clutter is inhibited；Respectively to filtering out static clutter and tetra- road signal of linear trend Hou being inhibited to carry out the processing such as complex signal demodulation, the vital sign parameter signals after being reconstructed are handled result using set empirical mode decomposition；Fourier transformation is carried out to the vital sign parameter signals after reconstruct, obtains signal spectrum；Harmonic component is inhibited, the peak value in frequency spectrum after in-band harmonic is inhibited is as the estimated value of respiratory rate and heart rate.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRONIC TECH INSTRUMENTS CO LTD

title_en: Sleep tracking and vital sign monitoring using low power radio waves
abstract_en: Various arrangements for performing radar-based measurement of vital signs. Waveform data may be received then filtered of data indicative of static objects to obtain motion-indicative waveform data. The motion-indicative waveform data may be analyzed to determine one or more frequencies of movement present within the motion-indicative waveform data. A spectral analysis may be performed on the motion-indicative waveform data to determine a spectral-analysis state of a monitored region. The spectral-analysis state of the monitored region may be determined to match a predefined spectral-analysis state during which vital sign monitoring is permitted. One or more vital signs of a monitored user present within the monitored region may be determined and output based on analyzing the motion-indicative waveform data.

title_en: Signal processing method and apparatus for ultra wide band ground penetrating radar based land mine detection
title_ko: 초광대역 지면 투과 레이더 기반 지뢰 탐지를 위한 신호 처리 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Provided in the present invention is a signal processing method for detecting landmines based on an ultra-wide band ground surface penetration radar, comprising: a training process of generating a background signal model by collecting data of an area in which landmines are not buried and of an area in which landmines are buried in a state in which burial of landmines is recognized; and a probing step of probing landmines by using the background signal model acquired through the training process in a state in which burial of landmines is not recognized.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지뢰 매설을 인지한 상태에서 지뢰가 매설되지 않은 영역과 지뢰가 매설된 영역의 데이터를 수집하여 배경 신호 모델을 생성하는 훈련 과정과, 지뢰 매설을 인지하지 못한 상태에서 훈련 과정을 통해 획득한 배경 신호 모델을 이용하여 지뢰를 탐지하는 탐지 과정을 포함하는 초광대역 지면 투과 레이더 기반 지뢰 탐지를 위한 신호 처리 방법을 제시한다.

title_en: System for Sensing Landsilde
title_ko: 산사태 감지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a landslide detection system, wherein a plurality of foundation supports buried and installed in a mountainous terrain are connected by a sensing wire, a possibility of an occurrence of landslide can be determined in a simple manner without applying various sensors by measuring a change in a tensile force of the sensing wire to determine the possibility of an occurrence of landslide, in addition to a sensor for measuring the tensile force of the sensing wire, a separate sound detection sensor is mounted to detect a sound generated at the time of surface displacement, accordingly, the possibility of an occurrence of landslide can be determined more accurately, the sensing wire can be restored to its initial state through a tensile force holding means by providing the tensile force holding means capable of restoring the tensile force of the sensing wire to an initial set value state when the change in the tensile force of the sensing wire occurs due to an external factor, and accordingly, a stable and precise sensing state can be always maintained.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 산사태 감지 시스템에 관한 것으로, 산악 지형에 매립 설치된 다수개의 기초 지지대를 감지 와이어로 연결하고, 감지 와이어의 인장력 변화를 측정하여 산사태 발생 가능성을 판단함으로써, 다양한 센서들을 적용하지 않고 단순한 방식으로 산사태 발생 가능성을 판단할 수 있고, 감지 와이어의 인장력을 측정하는 센서 이외에 별도의 소리 감지 센서를 장착하여 지표 변위 이동시 발생하는 소리를 감지함으로써, 산사태 발생 가능성을 더욱 정확하게 판단할 수 있으며, 감지 와이어의 인장력을 최초 설정값 상태로 복원시킬 수 있는 인장력 유지 수단을 구비함으로써, 외부 요인에 의해 감지 와이어의 인장력 변화가 발생한 경우에는 인장력 유지 수단을 통해 감지 와이어를 최초 상태로 복원시켜 항상 안정적이고 정확한 감지 상태를 유지할 수 있는 산사태 감지 시스템을 제공한다.
assignees: UNIV INDUSTRY COOPERATION GROUP KYUNG HEE UNIV

title_en: Helmet
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of helmet, and the helmet includes laser radar module and thermal imaging module；Radar information where the laser radar module is used to detect the user for dressing the helmet in fire field environment；Heating power distributed intelligence where the thermal imaging module is used to detect the user for dressing the helmet in fire field environment.The helmet further includes vital signs detection module, for the vital signs in fire field environment where detecting the user for dressing the helmet.The helmet further includes permeability display unit, for showing the information of user.It can reduce casualties rate, and reduce material damage.
assignees: SHANGHAI HANLI ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of intelligent fire scene auxiliary whippet tank
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of intelligent fire scenes to assist whippet tank, characterized by further comprising 51 single-chip computer control systems, ultrasonic sensor, flame sensor, gray-scale sensor, Raman spectrum analysis instrument, ultra-wide spectrum radar life-detection instrument, left motor drive module, right motor drive modules, the beneficial effects of the utility model are: be programmed using c language, 51 single-chip microcontrollers, it is fairly simple；Flame sensor module seeks fire distance far, strong antijamming capability；Using the direction of MPU6050 gyroscope control turning, direction controlling precision is high, without motion dead angle, and rotation is flexible；Strong using ultrasonic sensor obstacle avoidance ability, anti-interference ability is good；Raman spectrum analysis technology has been used, can analyze the corresponding chemical substance of fire source, has been had great significance to correct fire fighting；Ultra-wide spectrum radar life-detection instrument has been used, the presence of people's life entity can be detected；It is mounted with hawkeye camera, the firsthand information at scene can be obtained, the function of thering are data to transmit.

title_en: Home occupant detection and monitoring system
abstract_en: A occupant detection and monitoring system has a sensor unit having a radio wave transmitter, a radio wave receiver, and a wireless transmitter configured to detect and receive vital signs of an occupant; a user interface having a microcontroller, a wireless receiver configured to receive the wireless signals transmitted from the sensor unit, a means for user input, and a network card; and a means for alerting occupants and third-parties to a triggering event; wherein the microcontroller, based upon logic, activates the alerting means at the triggering event. The sensor unit may be a camera that detects the presence of an individual and register their unique heart rhythm for identification purposes. This camera can be installed at the entry points of a home, behind the counter of a business near a cash register or at a bank or any other place that desires to use surveillance as a form of security. The sensor unit may be a light bulb that comprises the components of the sensor unit. The sensor unit may be a contactless vital sign monitor capable of remotely monitoring one or more vital signs.

title_en: Vital-sign detecting system and method
abstract_en: A vital-sign detecting system includes radio-frequency (RF) tags disposed on detected subjects respectively, the RF tags respectively generating incident RF signals with different predetermined frequencies, and the incident RF signal projecting on a corresponding detected subject to generate a corresponding reflected RF signal; and at least one RF radar that demodulates the reflected RF signal to obtain vital sign of the corresponding detected subject, and identifies the detected subject according to associated frequency of the reflected RF signal.

title_en: Method for robust vehicle occupancy detection through vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: A radar sensor system (10) and a method of operating a radar sensor system (10) for detecting occupancy of an interior (34) of a vehicle (32) and with vital signs monitoring are provided. The radar sensor system (10) comprises a radar transmitting unit (12), a radar receiving unit (18) and a signal processing and control unit (26). The method at least comprises the following steps: transmitting (60) radar waves to a scene within a vehicle interior (34), receiving (62) at least one radar wave generated by reflection of the transmitted radar waves (16), decomposing (64) the received at least one radar wave (22) into range, doppler and angle information, quantifying and tracking (68) movement in each region of interest (38, 40, 42) by angle gating and range gating, detecting (78) and monitoring vital signs of an occupant (28, 30) in each region of interest (38, 40, 42), and determining (84) whether the quantified and tracked movement in the scene relates to the occupant (28, 30) or to external or internal disturbances based on satisfaction of at least one predefined condition relating to the quantified and tracked movement and/or the detected and monitored vital signs.

title_en: A kind of automation deviational survey warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of automation deviational survey warning devices, by in the pre-buried inclinometer pipe of pit foundation side wall to be measured, inclination sensor is set in inclinometer pipe, it is connect using detection module with inclination sensor, pass through inclination sensor and the deformation situation of inclinometer pipe synchro measure pit foundation to be measured in the construction process, the change shape in pit foundation work progress is obtained using detection module, and the data and preset threshold obtained by detection module by inclination sensor compare, so as to quickly see if fall out slant range, early warning can be carried out in time, the present apparatus can carry out real-time monitoring to the case where foundation pit side-wall horizontal displacement, it is again easy to use, save manpower, the problem of overcoming cumbersome traditional measurement method and serious lag, accurate data can be provided for guiding construction, early warning can be carried out to foundation pit disaster, to improve base pit engineering The mechanization of construction, the level of IT application.

title_en: A kind of forest fire protection monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of forest fire protection monitoring devices, including inner cavity, the outside of the inner cavity has shell, the bottom of inner cavity is fixedly installed with pre-buried pedestal, the inner bottom of inner cavity is equipped with battery group, the inside of battery group is equipped with reserve battery, the outer middle side part of shell is equipped with monitoring camera, the outside of monitoring camera is equipped with computer camera protective cover, the lower part left end of inner cavity has temperature sensor, the top of temperature sensor has control device, the lower part right end of inner cavity has smoke sensor device, the top of smoke sensor device has Beidou module, the top of inner cavity is equipped with two pieces of solar panels.The forest fire protection monitoring device, reasonable in design, monitoring effect is stablized, and is hardly damaged, can satisfy people to the requirement of forest fire protection monitoring device.

title_en: Apparatus for handling emergency situation based on internet of things smartware
title_ko: IoT 스마트웨어 기반의 긴급 상황 대응 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency situation countermeasure apparatus based on IoT smartware, comprising: the smartware including (1) a situation detection sensor sensing at least one among position data, shock data and biometric signal data to generate situation information, (2) an air bag control unit (ACU) controlling expansion of an air bag if an accident occurrence is detected, and (3) a communication unit transmitting the situation information as emergency situation information if the expansion of the air bag is determined; and an emergency situation monitoring server analyzing the emergency situation information received from the smartware to calculate an accident occurrence possibility, and, if the calculated accident occurrence possibility is a reference value or more, transmitting the emergency situation information and the accident occurrence possibility to a control server to request an emergency rescue. The present invention prevents indiscreet emergency rescue requests due to device malfunctions or minor injuries to reduce social costs.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 IoT 스마트웨어 기반의 긴급 상황 대응 장치에 관한 것으로, (1) 위치데이터, 충격데이터 및 생체신호데이터 중 적어도 하나를 센싱하여 상황정보를 생성하는 상황감지센서, (2) 사고발생이 감지되면 에어백의 팽창을 제어하는 ACU(AirBag Control Unit) 및 (3) 상기 에어백의 팽창이 결정되면 상기 상황정보를 긴급 상황정보로서 송신하는 통신부를 포함하는 스마트웨어; 및 
상기 스마트웨어로부터 수신된 긴급 상황정보를 분석하여 사고발생 가능성을 산출하고, 상기 산출된 사고발생 가능성이 기준 값 이상이면 관제 서버에 상기 긴급 상황정보 및 사고발생 가능성을 전송하고 긴급 구난의 진행을 요청하는 긴급 상황 모니터링 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: In-home wireless broadcasting terminal with body activity and fire detection, living body signal reception function and the control method thereof
title_ko: 동체활동 및 화재감지, 생체신호수신 기능이 구비된 댁내 무선방송단말기 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a home wireless broadcasting terminal having body activity, fire detection, and biometric signal receiving functions and a control method therefor. The purpose of the present invention is to provide a home wireless broadcasting terminal having body activity, fire detection, and biometric signal receiving functions, which adds body activity, fire detection, and biometric signal receiving functions to a wireless broadcasting receiver installed in each family home within a predetermined area to receive and output predetermined announcements transmitted from a main broadcasting device installed in a specific place, and then transmits corresponding information to the main broadcasting device, thereby quickly responding to the occurrence of an emergency situation, and a control method therefor. To this end, the home wireless broadcasting terminal comprises: a wireless communication module; a digital clock unit; a button unit; an I/O control unit; a voice control unit; and a control unit (CPU). The wireless broadcasting receiver further includes an infrared array sensor for detecting body activities and sensing fires in a corresponding family home and a communication module for receiving a biometric signal. The wireless communication module is composed of a bidirectional data communication module and is configured to transmit a measured value from the infrared array sensor and a received measured value of a biometric signal measuring device to the main broadcasting device under the control of the control unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 동체활동 및 화재감지, 생체신호수신 기능이 구비된 댁내 무선방송단말기 및 그 제어방법에 관한 것으로, 특정 장소에 설치된 메인방송장치로부터 송출되는 소정 안내방송을 전달받아 출력시키도록 일정 지역 내의 각 가정집에 설치되는 무선방송수신기에 동체활동 및 화재감지, 생체신호수신 기능을 추가로 구성한 후 해당 정보를 메인방송장치 측으로 전송하도록 하여 긴급상황 발생에 신속하게 대처할 수 있도록 한 동체활동 및 화재감지, 생체신호수신 기능이 구비된 댁내 무선방송단말기 및 그 제어방법을 제공함에 그 목적이 있다. 
이를 위해, 본 발명에 따른 동체활동 및 화재감지, 생체신호수신 기능이 구비된 댁내 무선방송단말기는, 무선통신모듈과, 디지털시계부와, 버튼부와, I/O 제어부와, 음성 제어부 및, 제어부(CPU)를 포함하여 구성되되, 상기 무선방송수신기에는 해당 가정집의 동체활동 및 화재감지를 위한 적외선 배열센서, 생체신호수신용 통신모듈이 더 구비되며, 상기 무선통신모듈은 양방향 데이터 통신모듈로 이루어져 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 상기 적외선 배열센서로부터의 측정값 및 수신된 생체신호측정기의 측정값을 상기 메인방송장치 측으로 전송하도록 구성된다.

title_en: A kind of device and method of active In vivo detection
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of device and methods of active In vivo detection, it emits by radio-frequency module and receives radar radiofrequency signal, and radar rf echo signal is handled by signal processing control module to obtain the maximum peak amplitude of echo-signal, the maximum peak amplitude is compared with the threshold value set according to vital sign, and then judge whether address has living object, when there is living object, is notified and alarmed by communication module and alarm module.In vivo detection of the invention is not affected by temperature, and has stronger adaptive capacity to environment, to have better detection effect.

title_en: A method of it is rescued for snowfield
abstract_en: A kind of method for snowfield rescue disclosed by the invention, use a kind of unmanned plane snowfield rescue system, including unmanned machine detecting device and rescue center, unmanned machine detecting device and rescue center's wireless communication connect, unmanned machine detecting device includes fuselage, rotor is provided on fuselage, fuselage surface center is installed by MCU Main Processing Unit, MCU Main Processing Unit is separately connected radar life detector, sound acquisition module, delivery device, holder, signal transmitting and receiving module and GPS positioning module, delivery device is mounted on the bottom surface of fuselage, camera is installed on holder, MCU Main Processing Unit is also connected with the output end of electric power detection module, the input terminal of electric power detection module connects power module, power module is used to power to the unmanned machine detecting device.Rescue mode disclosed by the invention, so that being found as early as possible by the trapped person to snow is buried, and heat generating device provides thermal energy, the extending life time provides a possibility that bigger successfully to rescue.

title_en: A kind of intelligent safety and defence system and its control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of intelligent safety and defence systems, including the master control panel for laying and withdrawing a garrison for security system, access control module, fire alarm module, burglar alarm module, natural gas alarm module and server terminal, the master control panel, access control module, fire alarm module, burglar alarm module, natural gas alarm module is communicated to connect with server terminal, it is characterized by also including intelligent fire fighting modules, escape truck module and natural gas leaking processing module, radar life-detection instrument is additionally provided in the burglar alarm module, the intelligent fire fighting module, escape truck module and natural gas leaking processing module are communicated to connect with server terminal.Beneficial effects of the present invention: the ability of intelligent safety and defence system emergency processing is imparted, mitigation processing can be carried out to scene first before human intervention, security performance is effectively promoted, while the phenomenon that burglar alarm is reported by mistake is greatly reduced, and intelligence degree is high.
assignees: NINGBO JIAKAI ZERO POINT ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Physical test device and test method for simulating sandy soil debris flow
abstract_en: The invention discloses a physical test device and a physical test method for simulating sandy soil debris flow, which relate to the technical field of geological experiments and have the technical scheme that: the rainfall simulation device comprises a transparent model box, a rainfall simulation device and a data acquisition system; a sand model is paved in the transparent model box; a sensor device is buried in the sand model; the rainfall simulation device comprises a water inlet tank, a water guide pipe and a nozzle; the data acquisition system consists of a high-definition camera, stereo microscope equipment, a dynamic strain data acquisition system connected with the sensor device and computer equipment; the high-definition camera, the stereo microscope device and the dynamic strain data acquisition system are connected with the computer device. The method has the advantages that the development process of the debris flow can be finely and visually obtained, the debris flow starting characteristics, the displacement field evolution process and the destruction form are obtained through analysis, the deep exploration of the complex induction mechanism of the debris flow is facilitated, and technical support and theoretical basis are provided for effective prevention and treatment engineering measures.

title_en: Seismic isolation rubber pad for micro-pile and construction method of micro-pile using the same
title_ko: 마이크로파일 면진 고무패드 및 이를 이용한 내진과 면진 기능을 갖는 마이크로파일의 시공방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a seismic isolation rubber pad, coupled to a head of a micro-pile (a pile with a small diameter) buried in a concrete layer to absorb and attenuate a shock, and a method for constructing a micro-pile with a function of earthquake proofing and seismic isolation using the same, and, more specifically, to a seismic isolation rubber pad and a method for constructing a micro-pile with a function of earthquake proofing and seismic isolation using the same, wherein the rubber pad includes: a first seismic isolation pad coupled to encompass a side surface and an upper part of a plate based on the plate (a ground pressing plate) coupled to the head of the micro-pile, an upper fixation unit of the plate and the micro-pile exposed to a set length at an upper part of the plate; a second seismic isolation pad coupled to encompass a lower surface of the plate and a lower fixation unit of the plate; and a third seismic isolation pad which is coupled to a lower part of the second seismic isolation pad while encompassing an exposed part of the micro-pile installed at an upper part of a weak layer.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 콘크리트층에 매설되는 마이크로파일(소구경말뚝)의 두부(Head)에 결합되어 충격을 흡수 및 감쇄시키는 마이크로파일 면진 고무패드 및 이를 이용한 내진과 면진 기능을 갖는 마이크로파일의 시공방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는, 마이크로파일의 두부에 결합되는 플레이트(지압판)를 기준으로 플레이트의 측면과 상부, 플레이트의 상부 고정부 및 플레이트의 상부에 소정 길이 노출된 마이크로파일을 감싸면서 결합되는 제1면진패드; 플레이트의 하부면과 플레이트의 하부 고정부를 감싸면서 결합되는 제2면진패드; 및 제2면진패드의 하부로 연약층 상부에 설치된 마이크로파일의 노출부를 감싸면서 결합되는 제3면진패드;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 마이크로파일 면진 고무패드 및 이를 이용한 내진과 면진 기능을 갖는 마이크로파일의 시공방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Using wifi-signal based, device-free human presence detection technology to identify humans consuming media content
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method includes detecting a presence of a subject in a vicinity of radio transceivers based on radio signal strength variations received at an input of the radio transceivers as a radio signature, so as to recognize the presence of the subject in an indoor environment by analyzing and quantifying irregularities in the radio signature, wherein the detecting the presence does not incorporate sensors for subject detection, and only performs the detecting based on radio irregularity phenomenon, without modifying the indoor environment; and mixing the detected presence of the subject with viewership datasets derived from an audience measurement source, to generate rich result datasets that provide insights on media exposure at a personal and household level, and to assign personal viewership insights to the household audience observation, without sacrificing personal privacy of the subject, and without requiring additional hardware or detection signals.

title_en: System and method for monitoring vital signs of a person
abstract_en: A system (10) and method for monitoring a person (14) within a defined area by detecting breathing or lack of breathing. Respiration is detected using the radar signal (24), the camera signal (22), and/or the microphone signal (26). The radar signal (24), the camera signal (22) and/or the microphone signal (26) are analyzed to determine whether the subject person (14) is active and, if not, whether the person is breathing or not breathing. An alert is generated if the reflected radar signal (24), the camera signal (22) and the microphone signal (26) all simultaneously indicate that the subject person (14) has not moved and is not active for a selected period of time.

title_en: Life searching method and system based on multi-sensor fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life searching method and a life searching system based on multi-sensor fusion, wherein the method comprises the following steps: arranging a plurality of sensor modules to acquire a sensor data sequence group acquired by each sensor module at a set frequency; preprocessing the sensor data sequence group based on a neural network to form life detection preliminary probability output corresponding to the sensor module; and taking each preliminary probability output as one path of input of a deep neural network, splicing and fusing a plurality of preliminary probability outputs of the sensor modules through the deep neural network, and outputting a final probability value of life existence. The life searching method and the life searching system collect various environmental information based on the plurality of sensor modules, and fuse and splice life detection data under different environmental information by using the deep neural network, so that the robustness and the accuracy of life detection are improved in a stage manner.

title_en: A kind of intelligent wearable device and help-asking system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a kind of intelligent wearable device and help-asking systems, and wherein intelligent wearable device includes: processor, acceleration transducer, bio-electrical impedance sensor, electrodermal reaction sensor, temperature sensor, baroceptor, Bluetooth antenna, flash memory；Acceleration transducer, for obtaining the step counting information of user；Bio-electrical impedance sensor, for obtaining heart rate, the respiratory rate of user；Electrodermal reaction sensor, for detecting the rate of perspiration of user；Temperature sensor, for detecting the skin temperature of user；Baroceptor is used for, and is detected the air pressure size of user position, is obtained height above sea level locating for user；Processor, for receiving each vital sign information；Each vital sign information stored in flash memory is sent to the application software of mobile terminal, so that application software issues warning information and distress signals when vital sign information meets preset condition.The present invention is realized sends distress signals in the case where user's body situation exception automatically.

title_en: Leakage detection apparatus for underground hot water pipe
title_ko: 지중 온수 배관 누수감지장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an underground hot water pipe leakage detection device, which comprises: a case provided on an upper side of a hot water pipe embedded in the ground and having an inner accommodating portion with an opened upper portion; an opening/closing cover disposed on an upper side of the accommodation portion of the case; a sensing unit comprising a temperature sensor disposed adjacent to the hot water pipe and a test coupon disposed adjacent to the hot water pipe and buried, and detecting the leakage of the hot water pipe according to the temperature change by the temperature sensor and the potential change of the test coupon; a processing unit for converting an analog signal input from the sensing unit into a digital signal to check an error, and performing conversion into a predetermined data transmission format; a communication unit for transmitting data of the processing unit through wireless communication; a storage unit for storing the data of the processing unit; a situation room server for monitoring the state of the hot water pipe through the data wirelessly transmitted by the communication unit, and notifying those outside of the danger; and a cylindrical enclosure having the sensing unit, the processing unit, the communication unit, and the storage unit embedded therein, and disposed in the accommodation portion of the case.
