The underground hot water pipe leakage detection device can measure the degree of leakage or corrosion of underground facilities, determine the time of replacement and repair of the underground facilities, and establish a situation room server based on the Internet of Things (IoT) combined with wireless communication to perform monitoring for 24 hours in real time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지중에 매설된 온수 배관의 상부 측에 설치되고 상방 개구(開口)형 내부 수용부를 갖는 케이스;  상기 케이스의 수용부 상부 측에 배치되는 개폐커버;  상기 온수 배관에 인접하게 배치되어 매설되는 온도센서와, 상기 온수 배관에 인접하게 배치되어 매설되는 테스트쿠폰(test coupon)으로 이루어져, 상기 온도센서에 의한 온도 변화와 상기 테스트쿠폰의 전위 변화에 따라 온수 배관의 누수를 감지하기 위한 감지부;  상기 감지부에서 입력되는 아날로그 신호를 디지털 신호로 전환하여 오류를 검사하고 기설정된 데이터 전송 형식으로 변환하는 처리부;  상기 처리부의 데이터를 무선 통신으로 전송하기 위한 통신부;  상기 처리부의 데이터를 보관하기 위한 저장부;  상기 통신부에 의해 무선 전송된 데이터를 통해 상기 온수 배관의 상태를 모니터링하고, 사전 위험 정보를 외부로 알리기 위한 상황실 서버; 및  상기 감지부, 처리부, 통신부 및 저장부가 내장되고 상기 케이스의 수용부에 배치되는 원통형의 외함체;로 이루어지도록 구현함으로써, 지중시설물의 누수나 부식 정도를 측정할 수 있고, 또 이를 통해 지중시설물에 대한 교체 및 보수시기를 판단할 수 있으며, 무선통신을 결합한 사물인터넷(IoT) 기반으로 상황실 서버를 구축하여 실시간으로 24시간 모니터링 할 수 있는 지중 온수 배관 누수감지장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Through-wall radar wall parameter estimation method without reference to transmitted waveform
abstract_en: A through-wall radar wall parameter estimation method without reference to transmitted waveforms includes obtaining reflection coefficient sequences and transmitted signals from wall echo time domain sampling data by a sparse blind deconvolution method at the same time, accurately estimating time delay differences of reflected waves on the front surface and the rear surface of a wall, constructing a target function based on time delay difference estimated values and time delay difference theoretical values of multiple observation positions, accurately estimating thickness and relative dielectric constant of the wall by minimizing the target function, and accurately estimating conductivity of the wall by comparing amplitude of the reflected waves on the rear surface and the front surface of the wall with amplitude of the reflected waves on the lower wall in a mode of single-base receiving and transmitting. The estimation method is particularly suitable for estimating the wall parameters under the condition of unknown reference emission waveforms, can avoid the problem that the prior information of the reference emission waveforms is needed in the wall parameter estimation process, and not only improves the efficiency of wall parameter estimation, but also improves the accuracy of wall parameter estimation.

title_en: A kind of inspection device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of inspection device, including engineering truck, array Ground Penetrating Radar and trailer pole, and engineering truck is connected with array Ground Penetrating Radar by trailer pole；It will test equipment to be placed on engineering truck；The array Ground Penetrating Radar includes main structure group, steering structure group, driven structure group；Main structure group main function realizes support, connection, fixed effect；Steering structure group and driven structure group realize complete machine steering, lifting and vibration-damping function.The present invention can low cruise, collect the position RTK record, coal gas detection, visit the multifunctional alls such as ground, it realizes the detection of road foundation disaster, road quality examination, Urban Buried Pipeline Network detection, the functions such as underground utilities periphery Defect inspection, achievees the purpose that efficient, continuous probe, easy to use.
assignees: BEIJING HUAHANG RADIO MEASUREMENT RES INST

title_en: Portable penetrating radar
abstract_en: Method and apparatus is a handheld ground penetrating radar which transmits radar pulses and acquires and processes received data for presentation on a display allowing a user to identify buried targets. Novel low cost approach to portable high-resolution light weight penetrating imaging. Method and apparatus for a portable penetrating radar incorporating a display depicting permittivity variation versus distance and time as the medium is scanned.

title_en: Fire detection rescue mode and system based on millimetre-wave radar technology
abstract_en: The present invention relates to fire rescue fields, disclose a kind of method and system based on the fire detection of millimeter microwave Radar Technology and emergency management and rescue, this method provides a kind of based on millimetre-wave radar personnel statistical method, human body target vital signs detection method, millimetre-wave radar Detection Techniques, computer storage medium, smoke alarm and its fire rescue system, end control centre, which is waken up, by smog warning system sends warning information to background data center, or timing wake-up terminal control center, signal emission module by controlling millimeter microwave emits millimeter microwave signal, then obtain reflection echo signal, millimeter microwave area of coverage human body target quantity and track are determined according to echo information, the corresponding data of each human body target is transmitted to background data center, to fire occur when can be accurately positioned out rescue target position and its Vital signs provides fast and accurately rescue scenario for rescue, reduces human loss, reduce the danger coefficient of rescue.

title_en: Human presence detector and human presence detection method
abstract_en: A human body detector comprising a microwave generator (10), a microwave receiver (20), a mixer detector (30) and a signal processor (40), wherein the microwave generator (10) is arranged to emit probe microwaves for propagation in a probe space, wherein the microwave receiver (20) is arranged to receive respective echoes of the probe microwaves, wherein the mixer detector (30) is connected to the microwave generator (10) and the microwave receiver (20) and arranged to perform mixer detection of the probe microwaves and the respective echoes to output respective primary detection wave signals, wherein the signal processor (40) is connected to the mixer detector (30) and arranged to select and amplify the primary detection wave signals output by the mixer detector (30) to output secondary detection wave signals of a specific fluctuation frequency range, the response signal of the human body detector to the motion of which the motion frequency is in the specific frequency range is amplified, so that the presence of the human body can be judged in response to the motion of the specific frequency range.

title_en: Apparatus and method for measuring bio signal
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a device and a method for measuring bio signals. The device for measuring bio signals according to one embodiment comprises: an optical sensor for irradiating light to a subject and receiving a light signal returned from the subject; and a bio impedance sensor for measuring a bio impedance by depth with respect to the same area as the measurement area of the optical sensor. According to the present invention, precise signals can be obtained.
abstract_ko: 생체 신호 측정 장치 및 방법이 개시된다. 일 실시예에 따른 생체 신호 측정 장치는, 피검체에 광을 조사하고 상기 피검체로부터 되돌아오는 광 신호를 수신하는 광 센서와, 상기 광 센서의 측정 영역과 동일한 영역에 대한 깊이별 생체 임피던스를 측정하는 생체 임피던스 센서를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Systems for maintaining, managing and exploring pipe networks
title_ko: 관망의 유지관리탐사 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a system for maintaining and exploring pipe networks, comprising: a ground penetrating radar (GPR) applying electromagnetic waves to roads to check whether to install pipe networks buried in the ground and the location thereof; a sound wave detecting device receiving sound waves generated from the pipe networks to check whether water has leaked from the pipe networks; and a control device checking whether to install the pipe networks and the location thereof by using information received from the GPR and checking whether water has leaked from the checked pipe networks and the location of the water leakage by using information received from the sound wave detecting device. Therefore, whether to install the pipe networks and the location thereof and whether water has leaked from the checked pipe networks and the location of the water leakage can be identified together.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하에 매설되어 있는 관망의 설치 여부 및 위치를 확인하기 위하여, 도로에 전자기파를 가진하는 지표투과레이더(GPR, Ground Penetrating Radar), 상기 관망의 누수 여부를 확인하기 위하여, 상기 관망에서 발생하는 음파를 수신하는 음파 탐지 장치, 상기 지표투과레이더로부터 수신된 정보를 이용하여 상기 관망의 설치 여부 및 위치를 확인하고, 상기 음파 탐지장치로부터 수신된 정보를 이용하여 상기 확인된 관망에서 유출 여부, 누수 여부 및 누수 위치를 판단하는 제어장치를 포함하는 관망의 유지관리탐사 시스템을 제공한다. 따라서 관망의 설치 여부 및 위치를 확인하고, 확인된 관망에서 유출 및 누수가 있는지와 유출 및 누수가 있다면 위치가 어디인지도 함께 파악이 가능한 장점이 있다.

title_en: Fire escape room fire door
title_ko: 화재 대피실용 방화문
abstract_en: The present invention relates to technology for a fire door for a fire shelter, which enables evacuees to temporarily escape from a fire which occurs in a high-rise structure such as an apartment or a building, and more particularly, to technology for a fire door for a fire shelter, which prevents personal injuries such as suffocation and burns caused by a toxic gas inside a fire shelter by blocking heat and the toxic gas transferred to the inside of the fire shelter and preventing thermal deformation of the fire door. The fire door installed at the entrance of a fire shelter in an apartment or a building comprises: a heat shielding interior material embedded in the fire door; heat shielding boards attached to the front and rear of the heat shielding interior material; and see-through holes installed to check the interior of the fire shelter, in which an exterior panel surrounds the outsides of the heat shielding interior material and the heat shielding boards.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 아파트 또는 빌딩 등의 고층 건물에서 화재가 발생할 경우 일시적으로 대피하는 화재 대피실용 방화문에 관한 기술로서, 대피실의 내부로 전달되는 고온의 열과 유독가스를 차단하고, 방화문의 열변형을 방지하므로, 대피실의 내부에서 유독가스로 인한 질식사고와 화상 등의 인명피해를 방지하는 화재 대피실용 방화문에 관한 기술이다. 
이러한 본 발명의 주요 구성은, 아파트 또는 빌딩 등의 공동 주택에서 화재 대피실의 입구에 설치되는 방화문에 있어서, 상기 방화문의 내부에 내장되는 차열내장재; 상기 차열내장재의 전면부와 후면부에 부착되는 차열보드; 및 상기 차열내장재와 차열보드의 외부를 외장패널이 감싸 구성되고, 대피실의 내부를 확인하기 위하여 설치된 투시홀;을 포함하여 구현된다.

title_en: System and Method for Contactless Sensing on a Treadmill
abstract_en: A treadmill includes a belt, a display, a first sensor having first transmission circuitry for transmitting a first radar beam over the belt and first reception circuitry for detecting a first reflected signal that is a reflection of the first radar beam from a user on the belt, a processor connected to the first sensor, the belt and the display, and a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium storing a program to be executed by the processor. The program includes instructions for determining, according to the first reflected signal, first data associated with a vital sign of the user and displaying, according to the first data, the vital sign on the display.

title_en: Electronic device generating health information based on a plurality of biometric signal and method of operating the same
title_ko: 복수의 생체 신호에 기반하여 건강 정보를 생성하는 전자 장치 및 이의 동작 방법
abstract_en: According to various embodiments of the present invention, an electronic device comprises: a battery; a display; at least one sensor; an interface; at least one memory; and at least one processor electrically connected to the display, the at least one sensor, the interface, and the at least one memory. The at least one processor uses the at least one sensor to determine whether a user wears the electronic device, uses the at least one sensor to measure a first biosignal of the user while the user wears the electronic device, drives an RF sensor included in a charging device to measure a second biosignal of the user generated by an RF signal oscillated from the RF sensor while the electronic device is connected to the charging device via the interface, receives at least one among power for charging the battery and the second biosignal from the charging device via the interface, generates health information of the user based at least on the first and the second biosignal, and displays the generated health information on the display. Other embodiments of the present invention are possible.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 다양한 실시예에 따른 전자 장치는, 배터리, 디스플레이, 적어도 하나의 센서, 인터페이스, 적어도 하나의 메모리, 및 상기 디스플레이, 상기 적어도 하나의 센서, 상기 인터페이스, 및 상기 적어도 하나의 메모리와 전기적으로 연결되는 적어도 하나의 프로세서를 포함하고, 상기 적어도 하나의 프로세서가, 상기 적어도 하나의 센서를 이용하여 사용자가 상기 전자 장치를 착용하였는지 여부를 판단하고, 상기 사용자가 전자 장치를 착용한 동안에, 상기 적어도 하나의 센서를 이용하여 상기 사용자의 제1 생체 신호를 측정하고, 상기 전자 장치가 상기 인터페이스를 통해 RF 센서를 포함하는 충전 장치와 연결된 동안에, 상기 충전 장치에 포함된 상기 RF 센서를 구동시켜 상기 RF 센서로부터 발진되는 RF 신호에 의하여 발생되는 상기 사용자의 제2 생체 신호를 측정하고, 상기 인터페이스를 통해 상기 충전 장치로부터 상기 배터리를 충전하기 위한 전력 및 상기 제2 생체 신호 중 적어도 하나를 수신하고, 상기 제1 생체 신호 및 상기 제2 생체 신호에 적어도 기반하여 상기 사용자의 건강 정보를 생성하고, 생성된 상기 건강 정보를 상기 디스플레이에 표시할 수 있다. 그 밖의 다양한 실시예가 가능하다.

title_en: Radar-camera fusion disaster tracking system and method for scanning invisible space
title_ko: 비가시공간 투시 레이더-카메라 융합형 재난 추적 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an invisible space perspective radar-camera fused type disaster tracking system, which comprises: a radar sensor configured to set a plurality of regions of interest having a center angle of 180 degrees to transmit a signal in all directions, and to detect an object to be tracked within the regions of interest based on the signal to set an event zone; a camera unit configured to receive an event zone set by the radar sensor and to track a movement of the object to be tracked located in the event zone based on the event zone; an information processing unit configured to coordinate the detected position of the object to be tracked and to calculate tracking information combining coordinate information of the coordinated object to be tracked and movement information of the object to be tracked collected through the camera unit; and a communication unit configured to share the tracking information calculated by the information processing unit by relaying wired/wireless communication with an external device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 비가시공간 투시 레이더-카메라 융합형 재난 추적 시스템은 중심각이 180도로 형성된 복수의 관심영역을 설정하여 전방위에 신호를 송출하고, 신호를 기초로 관심영역 내부의 추적대상을 감지하여 이벤트 존을 설정하는 레이더 센서; 레이더 센서에서 설정된 이벤트 존을 수신하고, 이를 기초로 이벤트 존에 위치한 추적대상의 움직임을 추적하는 카메라부; 감지된 추적대상의 위치를 좌표화 하여, 좌표화된 추적대상의 좌표 정보와 카메라부를 통해 수집된 추적대상의 움직임 정보를 종합한 트래킹 정보를 산출하는 정보 처리부; 및 외부 장치와 유무선 통신을 중계하여 정보 처리부에서 산출된 트래킹 정보를 공유하는 통신부;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Electronic device for obtaining biometric signal and method of operating the same
title_ko: 생체 신호를 획득하는 전자 장치와 이의 동작 방법
abstract_en: According to various embodiments of the present invention, an electronic device comprises: a sensor module; a first electrode unit connected to a first channel of the sensor module; a second electrode unit connected to a second channel of the sensor module; and a processor. The processor measures first impedance between the first electrode unit and a first part of a body of a user in contact with the first electrode unit and second impedance between the second electrode unit and a second part of the body of the user in contact with the second electrode unit through the sensor module, adjusts the impedance corresponding to each of the first channel and the second channel to satisfy a range in which a difference between the first impedance and the second impedance is predetermined based on the first impedance and the second impedance through the sensor module, and is set to obtain a biometric signal of the user in a state in which the impedance of the first channel and the second channel is adjusted through the sensor module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 다양한 실시 예에 따른 전자 장치는, 센서 모듈, 상기 센서 모듈의 제1채널과 연결된 제1전극부, 상기 센서 모듈의 제2채널과 연결된 제2전극부, 및 상기 센서 모듈을 통해, 상기 제1전극부와 상기 제1전극부와 접촉된 사용자의 신체의 제1부분 사이의 제1임피던스와, 상기 제2전극부와 상기 제2전극부와 접촉된 사용자의 신체의 제2부분 사이의 제2임피던스를 측정하고, 상기 센서 모듈을 통해, 상기 제1임피던스와 상기 제2임피던스에 기초하여 상기 제1임피던스 및 상기 제2임피던스의 차이가 지정된 범위를 만족하도록 상기 제1채널과 상기 제2채널 각각에 대응하는 임피던스를 조절하고, 상기 센서 모듈을 통해, 상기 제1채널 및 상기 제2채널의 임피던스가 조절된 상태에서, 상기 사용자의 생체 신호를 획득하도록 설정될 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of through-wall imaging radar target tracking method of dimension self-adaption
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of through-wall imaging radar target tracking methods of dimension self-adaption, are related to through-wall radar technology, in particular to the target following technology of through-wall radar.This method uses time domain back projection imaging method, quickly obtains the radar image of better quality；Algorithm for image enhancement based on CF weighting processing can inhibit secondary lobe and noise, improve signal noise ratio (snr) of image；After obtaining target area using twin shaft projection algorithm, the track algorithm based on average drifting can effectively cope with the stronger human body target tracking of randomness；Target scale and angle estimating method based on image moment can accurately calculate target image scale and angle, and tracking accuracy and robustness can be improved.The present invention has real-time good, adaptable, the high advantage of tracking robustness.

title_en: A kind of multidimensional fire-fighting data fusion analysis method neural network based
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multidimensional fire-fighting data fusion analysis methods neural network based, include the following steps: step 1, establish with the state parameter of live cigarette sense, the temperature parameter at scene, the temperature warning threshold parameter at scene and the vital signs parameter at scene as input, it take occurrence index as the neural network model of output, and the neural network model of foundation is trained, according to the implicit layer number of training result and the error transfer factor neural network model of actual alarm result, until accuracy rate is not less than desired value；Step 2, with trained neural network model, the condition of a disaster analysis is carried out to the state parameter of the live cigarette sense obtained in real time, the temperature parameter at scene, the temperature warning threshold parameter at scene and the vital signs parameter at scene.Compared with prior art, the present invention obtains the operating condition of field device in time, carries out data analysis convenient for platform.Field condition is judged in time by the video information that infrared photography provides, and can be remotely operated fire extinguisher and be put out a fire.
assignees: NANJING KEGU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: The method for carrying out human body target positioning based on comentropy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of methods for carrying out human body target positioning based on comentropy, firstly, radar sends electromagnetic wave signal, and receive the echo-signal reflected through human body；Then, Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) is done by the time signal to different distance point respectively, obtains the frequency spectrum of time signal in each range points；Comentropy mass spectrum database method is used again, is sought logarithm the bottom of by of e, is calculated the information entropy of different distance point signal spectrum signal；Finally, target exact position is positioned by choosing the smallest distance unit of information entropy, the echo-signal of distance unit where obtaining vital sign target.Compared with prior art, stronger to noise filtering ability, and constituents extraction precision is higher, have convenient for operation, the advantages of stability is good and high reliablity.
assignees: HUNAN SHUNHONG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;CHANGSHA JUNMIN ADVANCED TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Drowsy-driving prevention method and drowsy-driving prevention system
title_ko: 운전자 졸음 방지 방법 및 운전자 졸음 방지 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a drowsy-driving prevention method and a drowsy-driving prevention system to control a stimulation unit and a measurement unit by performing an artificial intelligence (AI) algorithm and/or a machine learning algorithm in a 5G environment connected for Internet of things. According to the present invention, the drowsy-driving prevention method comprises a stimulating step, a measuring step and a determining step. The stimulation unit outputs stimulation to stimulate sensory organs of a driver, and then, the measurement unit measures a biosignal of the driver from the time to output the stimulation. When the biosignal of the driver is determined not to be a response to the stimulation, the stimulation unit can output stimulation again.
abstract_ko: 사물 인터넷을 위해 연결된 5G 환경에서 인공지능(artificial intelligence, AI) 알고리즘 및/또는 기계학습(machine learning) 알고리즘을 실행하여 자극부와 측정부를 제어하는 운전자 졸음 방지 방법 및 운전자 졸음 방지 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 운전자 졸음 방지 방법은, 자극하는 단계, 측정하는 단계 및 판단하는 단계를 포함하여 구성될 수 있다. 자극부가 자극을 출력하여 운전자의 감각기관을 자극하고 나서, 측정부가 자극의 출력시점부터 운전자의 생체신호를 측정한다. 운전자의 생체신호가 자극에 대한 반응이 아니라고 판단되면, 자극부가 자극을 재출력할 수 있다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for detecting status of vehicle occupant
title_ko: 차량 탑승자 상태 감지방법 및 차량 탑승자 상태 감지장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and an apparatus for detecting a state of a vehicle occupant, which can control operation of a vehicle internal device or vehicle driving to respond to a change in a body of an occupant estimated in communication with the vehicle internal device in a 5G communication environment after executing an on-board artificial intelligence (AI) algorithm and/or a machine learning algorithm to acquire a biosignal of the occupant getting in the vehicle, and measuring a change in a body of the occupant through a movement signal, a breathing signal, and a heart rate signal in the acquired biosignal of the occupant. According to the present invention, after extracting movement, breathing, and heart rate signals of the occupant getting in the vehicle through an RF sensor mounted in the vehicle, based on the extracted biosignal of the occupant, a state of an occupant body is estimated to inform the occupant that the state of the body is estimated to be a biosignal deviant from a normal state.
abstract_ko: 탑재된 인공지능(artificial intelligence, AI) 알고리즘 및/또는 기계학습(machine learning) 알고리즘을 실행하여 차량에 탑승한 탑승자의 생체신호를 취득하고, 취득한 탑승자 생체신호에서 움직임 신호, 호흡 신호 및 심박수 신호를 통해 탑승자의 신체 변화를 측정한 뒤, 5G 통신 환경에서 차량 내부 기기와 통신하여 추정된 탑승자의 신체 변화에 대응할 수 있도록 차량 내부 기기의 구동을 제어하거나 차량 운행을 제어할 수 있는 차량 탑승자 상태 감지방법 및 차량 탑승자 상태 감지장치가 개시된다. 본 발명에 의하여 차량 내 탑재된 RF 센서를 통해 차량에 탑승한 탑승자의 움직임, 호흡, 심박수 신호를 추출한 뒤, 추출된 탑승자의 생체신호를 기초로 탑승자의 신체 상태를 추정하여 신체 상태가 정상상태를 벗어난 생체신호로 추정되면, 이를 탑승자에 알릴 수 있다.

title_en: System searching based on drone for rescuing mountaineers
title_ko: 산악 조난자 구조를 위한 무인항공용 드론을 이용한 수색 시스템
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a search system using an UAV to rescue sufferers at a mountain comprises: an UAV equipped with a life detection ICT integrated module based on a wireless sensor in the scene of a disaster and scanning Wi-Fi signals from mobile phones of sufferers in the air; a ground control device controlling the UAV to fly to a desired place; and a sufferer rescue integrated server collecting position information, signal strength, time, and atmospheric pressure data of mobile phone of each sufferer through LTE network in real time based on the signals scanned by the UAV.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 산악 조난자 구조를 위한 무인항공용 드론을 이용한 수색 시스템은 조난 현장에 무선센서 기반 인명탐지 ICT통합 모듈을 탑재하고, 상공에서 조난자들의 휴대폰 Wi-Fi 신호를 스캔하는 무인항공용 드론; 상기 무인항공용 드론을 원하는 위치로 비행시킬 수 있도록 제어하는 지상통제장치; 및 상기 무인항공용 드론에서 스캔된 신호를 기초로 하여, 실시간으로 LTE 통신망을 통해 조난자의 각 휴대폰의 위치정보와 신호강도, 시간, 기압 데이터를 수집하는 조난자 구조 통합서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method and system for determining thickness of effective soil layer of soil
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for determining the thickness of an effective soil layer of soil, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a ground penetrating radar image of a target place; determining the calibration depth of a calibration object buried in soil; determining the depth of a calibration object in the ground penetrating radar image and the time of transmission of electromagnetic waves to the calibration object based on the ground penetrating radar image of the target place; determining the propagation speed of the electromagnetic wave in the soil based on the calibration depth and the time for transmitting the electromagnetic wave to the calibration object; determining a dielectric constant based on the propagation velocity; determining a soil moisture content based on the dielectric constant; and determining the thickness of a soil layer according to the depth of the calibration object in the ground penetrating radar image, the propagation speed, the dielectric constant and the soil moisture content. The method can improve the measurement precision of the soil layer thickness.

title_en: A kind of breathing mask of the traceable sign of life based on baroceptor
abstract_en: The breathing mask for the traceable sign of life based on baroceptor that the utility model discloses a kind of, including mask bodies and main control module, the front end installation settings of mask bodies has filter poison cover, the two sides of mask bodies front end, which are respectively mounted, is provided with oral area respirator, the rear end of mask bodies is provided with the headband for wearing, oxygen concentration sensor and alarm indicator are installed, the inside of mask bodies is also equipped with main control module, baroceptor, blood oxygen transducer, power supply and wireless transport module at the top of mask bodies.Baroceptor and blood oxygen transducer are provided in the utility model, the vital sign of detectable mask wearer, and it prompts to withdraw before user's asphyxia or anoxic, or pass through wireless transport module automatic alarm when asphyxia or anoxic are alarmed, and it is positioned by GPS, to implement treatment and transfer in time, convenient for the progress of security protection work.

title_en: Systems and methods for subject monitoring
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides systems and methods for collecting and analyzing vital sign information to predict a likelihood of a subject having a disease or disorder. In an aspect, a system for monitoring a subject may comprise: sensors comprising an electrocardiogram (ECG) sensor, which sensors are configured to acquire health data comprising vital sign measurements of the subject over a period of time; and a mobile electronic device, comprising: an electronic display; a wireless transceiver; and one or more computer processors configured to (i) receive the health data from the sensors through the wireless transceiver, (ii) process the health data using a trained algorithm to generate an output indicative of a progression or regression of a health condition of the subject over the period of time at a sensitivity of at least about 80%, and (iii) provide the output for display to the subject on the electronic display.

title_en: Handheld through-wall radar device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hand-held through-the-wall radar device, which belongs to the field of radars and comprises a radar host, a charger and a charging cable; the radar host comprises an antenna module, a radio frequency module, a signal processing and display control module, a charge-discharge module and a shell; after the radar host is powered on, the charging module provides required voltage for the radio frequency module and the signal processing and display control module through voltage conversion, when the signal processing and display control module receives the detection key information, the radio frequency module is controlled to generate radar signals, the radar signals are emitted through an antenna, the antenna module receives echo signals and sends the echo signals to the signal processing and display control module after being processed by the radio frequency module, and target information is displayed again after being processed by an algorithm; the handheld through-wall radar has the advantages of small volume, light weight, large effective detection range, high sensitivity and high precision, and meanwhile, the handheld through-wall radar has the advantages of multi-target detection and tracking and high anti-interference capability.

title_en: A kind of earthquake search and rescue device based on unmanned plane
abstract_en: The invention belongs to air vehicle technique fields, especially a kind of earthquake search and rescue device based on unmanned plane, including six rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicles, the top of six rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicles is equipped with GPS instrument, six rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicles are fixedly connected with GPS instrument, the lower end of six rotor wing unmanned aerial vehicles is fixedly connected with fixed disk, sliding slot is offered in fixed disk, sliding block is equipped in sliding slot, sliding slot and sliding block are slidably connected, the inner wall of sliding slot and the outer surface of sliding block match, the lower end of sliding block is equipped with holder, sliding block is fixedly connected with holder, the lower end of holder offers cavity, positioning device is equipped in cavity, positioning device includes shockproof box, extension spring, placement plate, GPS module and combined aural and visual alarm, placement plate is located in shockproof box, sponge is fixedly connected on the inner roof wall of shockproof box, life is detected by radar life-detection instrument, repositioning is thrown Locator facilitates and searches and rescues team member's accurate positionin to the position of trapped person, and the time is searched and rescued in shortening, and convenient, efficient, accurate.

title_en: Breathing detection system after calamity based on intelligent terminal
abstract_en: The invention belongs to sensor network, mobile computing and voice processing technology field, a kind of specifically breathing detection system after calamity based on intelligent terminal.System of the invention includes trigger module and detection module；The trigger module is used for the automatic triggering system after calamity and starts to work, and the detection module is used to detect the breath state of the trapped person of terminal surrounding.The present invention provides trapped person's breathing detections after calamity, according to current technology, corresponding signal transmission or detection means can be set according to the type of terminal device, to provide a kind of possible search and rescue reference direction to rescue worker, rather than the search of blindness, the probability that trapped person is rescued can be improved under specific circumstances.

title_en: A kind of wearable flexible biological monitoring sensor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to biological intelligence sensing technologies, and in particular to a kind of wearable flexible biological monitoring sensor.Its core group becomes using macromolecular elastomer as matrix, mixes the high flexibility composite membrane of micro nano structure conducting particles.The characteristic film substantially with piezoresistive effect of the film.In actual test, which carrys out the vital signs such as the accurate organism heartbeat of reflection in real time, pulse with the fluctuation of resistance, to realize effectively monitoring.

title_en: Physiological signal measurement apparatus
title_ko: 생체신호측정기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a physiological signal measurement apparatus, comprising: two pairs of electrodes to measure a physiological signal of at least a portion of a body of a user; a measurement unit to measure at least one among the impedance, the electrocardiogram, and the pulse transit time (PTT) of a human body from the two pairs of electrodes; a triaxial acceleration sensor to triaxially sense a sensing value related to a change in the measured posture of the user; and a control unit to determine the measured posture of the physiological signal by using the sensing value detected by the triaxial acceleration sensor, to determine at least one among the impedance, electrocardiogram, and PTT of the human body through the measurement unit by using a first condition when the measured posture is in a first mode, and to determine at least one among the impedance, electrocardiogram, and PTT by using a second condition which is different from the first condition when the measured posture is in a second mode. Therefore, according to the present invention, when a physiological signal cannot be precisely measured in a state in which a band type physiological signal measurement apparatus is worn, a physiological signal measurement mode is changed from a wearing mode to a non-wearing mode to measure the physiological signal in a condition corresponding to the non-wearing mode. Resultantly, the physiological signal can be precisely measured even at low temperatures and in environments with low humidity.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 생체신호측정기에 관한 것으로, 사용자의 신체의 적어도 일부분의 생체 신호를 측정하기 위한 두 쌍의 전극, 상기 두 쌍의 전극으로부터 인체의 임피던스, 심전도, PTT(Pulse Transmit Time) 중 적어도 하나를 측정하는 측정부, 상기 사용자의 측정 자세 변화와 관련된 센싱값을 3축으로 감지하는 3축 가속도센서, 및 상기 3축 가속도센서에서 감지된 센싱값을 이용하여 상기 생체 신호의 측정 자세를 판단하고, 상기 측정 자세가 제1 모드인 경우, 상기 측정부를 통해 인체의 임피던스, 심전도, PTT 중 적어도 하나를 제1 조건을 이용하여 결정하고, 상기 측정 자세가 제2 모드인 경우, 상기 임피던스, 상기 심전도, 상기 PTT 중 적어도 하나를 상기 제1 조건과 상이한 제2 조건을 이용하여 결정하는 제어부를 포함한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 밴드형 생체신호측정기를 착용한 상태로 정확한 생체신호 측정이 어려운 경우, 생체신호 측정 모드를 착용 모드에서 비착용 모드로 측정모드로 변환하여 비착용 모드에 대응하는 조건으로 생체 신호를 측정함으로써, 낮은 온도와 낮은 습도 환경에서도 정확한 생체 신호를 측정할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of through-wall radar fine motion object detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of through-wall radar fine motion object detection methods, belong to detections of radar field, through-wall radar detection field, and method and step of the invention is as follows: the echo signal of intermediate frequency of acquisition is carried out process of pulse-compression；A narrow band filter is designed according to the Doppler shift characteristics of fine motion target to inhibit to outer clutter；Coherent accumulation is carried out to clutter recognition treated signal；Treated signal is subjected to CFAR detection；Wherein pulse compression improves signal-to-noise ratio and range accuracy；The strong clutter at barrier rear can be effectively suppressed in clutter recognition；This method targetedly the processing such as is filtered, amplifies, extracts to the faint echo of fine motion target after wall on the basis of the analysis of the micro-doppler characteristic to fine motion target, finally realizes effective detection of fine motion target.
assignees: CHANGZHOU THE FOURTH RADIO FACTORY CO LTD

title_en: Methods, computer programs, radar systems, antenna systems and flying platforms for detecting a horizontally buried linear object
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a method for detecting a horizontally buried linear object, the horizontally buried linear object having a longitudinal extension. The method comprises moving(S10), with a flying platform comprising a radar for synthetic aperture radar, SAR, vertical imaging, along a trajectory corresponding to a synthetic aperture. The method further comprises transmitting (S20) and receiving radar signals while moving along the trajectory corresponding to the synthetic aperture. The method also comprises forming (S30) a SAR image based on collected data representing radar signal reflections received from the ground. The method additionally comprises detecting (S40) one or more features in the formed SAR image relating to the horizontally buried linear object. Said trajectory is oriented in a direction substantially perpendicular to an expected orientation of the longitudinal extension of the horizontally buried object and traversing the horizontally buried object. The present disclosure further relates to corresponding computer programs, radar systems, flying platforms and antenna systems.

title_en: A kind of protected working Integration Equipment for fireman
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of protected working Integration Equipments for fireman, it is equipped including protective helmet and ectoskeleton, ectoskeleton equipment includes the close-fitting protective garment with biosensor, upper body protective gear, lower part of the body protective gear and Protective Boots are worn from top to bottom on the surface of close-fitting protective garment, the gas cylinder mounting box for grafting respirator is being also set up on human body back, Yu Suoshu upper body protective gear, and the open and close type storage box for placing axe, safety rope is being also set up at thigh two sides, on Yu Suoshu lower part of the body protective gear.The utility model can provide extra power by each force aid system, ensure that the harmony between human action and machinery.It acquires fireman chest heartbeat data in time by biosensor, monitors the vital sign of fireman, the arrangement of infrared ray life detectors can judge different targets by temperature difference, detect victim's body heat.

title_en: A kind of unmanned aerial vehicle group searching rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of unmanned aerial vehicle group searching rescue systems, including form unmanned aerial vehicle group by multi rack search unmanned plane, and described search unmanned plane carries detection source, is scanned for treating region of search, determines suspicious region；Described search unmanned plane also carries ultra-wide life detection radar, for being scanned to target area, obtaining and returning the vital sign status information in the target area；The detection source includes radio-frequency spectrum detection source and/or SAR imaging detection source and/or optical imagery detection source；The target area is to be determined and carrying out data fusion to the suspicious region.The advantages that with searching rescue accurate positioning, precision is high, and flexibility is good, and stability is good, can greatly improve the efficiency of searching rescue.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Necklace-shaped physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor (referred to herein as the ‘necklace’) that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the necklace can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: It is a kind of for monitor hydrodynamic force type landslide device and its application method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of for monitoring the device on hydrodynamic force type landslide, including several end to end monitoring pipes, measuring staff is provided in monitoring pipe, strain inductor is provided on measuring staff, the two sides of strain inductor are connected with one end of foil gauge respectively, the other end of foil gauge is connected with one end of compressed spring, compressed spring is vertical with measuring staff, the other end of compressed spring is fixedly connected with the rotation axis of pulley, the sliding slot for pulley rolling is offered in monitoring pipe, the upper end of measuring staff is provided with data line, the lower end of measuring staff is provided with water level sensor, one end of data line is connect with strain inductor and water level sensor, monitoring pipe positioned at the top is provided with hole in outer wall, pore pressure gauge is buried in hole.The invention also discloses the application methods of the device.A kind of device and its working method, structure for monitoring the landslide of the hydrodynamic force type due to caused by rainfall or Reservoir Water Level provided by the invention is simple and convenient to operate and integrates earth horizontal displacement, level of ground water and pore water pressure.

title_en: Consider the Ground Penetrating Radar diffraction stack imaging method and system of antenna radiation pattern
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Ground Penetrating Radar diffraction stack imaging method and system for considering antenna radiation pattern, this method includes the following steps: that dual-mode antenna and corresponding survey line are arranged on component to be measured, and dual-mode antenna carries out common offset B-Scan sampling along survey line；Extract received every one of echo-signal；Calculate the emitted antenna transmitting of electromagnetic wave, point scatter scattering and the received stroke of receiving antenna；When extracting the travelling of each imaging point electromagnetic wave of imaging space；The value range of imaging region and the sampling interval of pixel are set, is established when according to travelling and receives signal index；The electric field value of each imaging space point scattering is extracted according to index when travelling；Obtain the directional diagram of antenna in radar system；Diffraction stack migration is corrected, by the imaging space point scattering electric field value superposition calculated per reception data together as the imaging results after offset.The present invention introduces radiation pattern in offset imaging method, improves imaging precision and imaging effect to buried target.

title_en: Landslide model test device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a landslide model test device which comprises a landslide model box, wherein a model slope body and a freezing and thawing unit are arranged in the landslide model box; the model slope body is piled on the bottom plate of the landslide model box, one side face of the model slope body is used for slope setting and is a free slope face, and the other side faces of the model slope body are limited by the side plates of the landslide model box so that the section of the model slope body vertical to the slope face is in a right trapezoid shape; the freeze-thaw simulation unit comprises a condensation pipe network which corresponds to the slope surface and is buried under the slope surface, and the condensation pipe network is connected with the heat exchange equipment main body outside the landslide model box; a plurality of temperature sensors are also embedded under the slope surface. According to the invention, through the freeze-thaw simulation unit, a test for simulating and researching the influence of seasonal freeze-thaw on landslide geological disasters can be effectively developed, and a test for simulating and researching the influence of freeze-thaw skid promotion on landslide geological disasters under the action of water can be effectively developed by combining the existing rainfall system and the like.

title_en: Portable software robot for life detection for earthquake relief
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a life detection is with portable software robot for earthquake relief, load the body and the center through groove that resets including the center, settle the upper end of center dress carrier has robot main drive mechanism, and the lower extreme of center dress carrier installs the vice drive mechanism of robot, the middle part of center dress carrier is provided with the detection room, and the front end of detecting the room settles and have sealed top cap, all install the set screw all around of sealed top cap, and the inside of sealed top cap is provided with the cable through hole, the beneficial effects of the utility model are that: this portable software robot is used in life detection for earthquake relief is provided with center dress carrier, robot main drive mechanism, the vice drive mechanism of robot and detection room, through the center and the detection room that are located the device body center, can let the device body can keep better equilibrium through the center with behind the detection room linking installation circuit and the detection sensor, make things convenient for the device body to carry out better function.

title_en: Whole fabric radiating far-infrared ray and manufacturing process thereof
title_ko: 원적외선을 방사하는 섬유원단과 그의 제조방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a fiber fabric, from which far infrared rays are emitted, is manufactured by a method which comprises: a first process in which an appropriate amount of acid is added to an alkaline germanium solution of pH 9-10, prepared by dissolving germanium dioxide powder in an alkaline solution, to convert the germanium solution into a slightly acid germanium solution of pH 5-7, wherein undissolved solids are filtered out with a filter so as to prepare a pure slightly acid mixed solution; a second process in which 30-50% of the slightly acid mixed solution is mixed with 50-70% of an aqueous binder solution so as to prepare an undiluted adhesive germanium solution; a third step in which 3-10% of the undiluted germanium solution is diluted in clean water at a temperature of 40-50°C and added with 3-5% of an antistatic agent so as to prepare a germanium mixed diluted solution; and a fourth step in which a fiber fabric having the diluted solution infiltrated thereinto by immersion and coating processes is dried while being transferred through an electric heater thermal kiln set at a temperature of 80-130°C. The fiber fabric manufactured by the present invention is configured to maintain softness like an original fiber fabric. Unlike a conventional fiber fabric using powder type germanium, the fiber fabric of the present invention is not stiff caused by protruding concave-convex parts or coated films but soft, and is configured to emit far infrared rays having an emissivity of 0.9 or more.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따른 원적외선이 방출되는 섬유원단은 
이산화 게르마늄 분말을 알칼리 액으로 용해하여 만들어진 ph 9~10의 알카리성 게르마늄 용액이 ph 5~7 정도의 약산성으로 전환되도록 산을 적정량 혼합하고, 용해되지 아니한 고형물을 필터로 여과하여 순수한 약산성 혼합용액을 만드는 제 1공정, 
상기 약산성 혼합용액 30~50%에 수용성 바인더액 50~70%의 비율로 혼합한 후 접착성 게르마늄 원액을 완성하는 제2공정, 
상기 게르마늄 원액을 3~10%로 하여 40~50℃ 정도의 깨끗한 물에 희석하고, 정전기방지제 3~5%를 혼합하여 게르마늄 혼합 희석액을 완성하는 제3공정, 
희석액을 침수, 도포작업으로 내부로 침투시킨 섬유원단을 80~130℃로 설정된 전기히터 열가마를 경유하면서 건조되는 제4공정을 통하여 제조된다. 
본 발명으로 제조되는 섬유원단은 원래의 섬유원단과 같은 부드럼움을 유지한다. 기존의 분말형 게르마늄을 사용한 섬유원단과는 달리 요철 돌출이나 코팅피막으로 인한 뻣뻣함이 없이 부드러우며, 0.9이상의 원적외선을 방출한다.

title_en: A kind of maintenance component with thermal-insulating waterproof function
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to building maintenance applied technical field, specifically discloses a kind of maintenance component with thermal-insulating waterproof function, including exterior wall production board, interior wall production board, insulating layer, snap-gauge, connection card slot, hole for injecting glue and waterproof gasket cement.A kind of beneficial effect of maintenance component with thermal-insulating waterproof function of the utility model is: 1, having good waterproof performance, common building Pack the outer wall, it is not arranged to stay between steel tie, wall column by regulation and sets straight stubble, simultaneously in building wall construction, scaffold eye clogs the positions ash plug imprecisions such as pipeline not firm, through walls, penetrating passage is all easily left, which has substantially prevented inducement caused by leaking；2, since wall is on-site assembly, the construction time is greatly saved；3, anti-seismic performance improves, simultaneously because exterior wall is light material, the secondary injury for the generation that can collapse to avoid wall in earthquake.
assignees: JIANGSU PROVINCIAL BUILDING MATERIALS RES & DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting vital sign headgear system based on ad hoc network
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire-fighting vital sign headgear system based on ad hoc network, it includes vital sign module (1), gyro module (2), microprocessor module (6) and ad hoc network transmission module (7), vital sign module (1) is located at the inside of the helmet, vital sign module (1) includes photoelectric sensor (4) and temperature sensor (5), the photoelectric sensor (4) is through epidermis for detecting heart rate, and temperature sensor (5) is for measuring head skin temperature；Gyro module (2) is used to detect movement, the attitude data information of people；Vital sign module (1), the information conveyance of gyro module (2) detection are given microprocessor module (6), and microprocessor module (6) sends the data received by ad hoc network transmission module (7)；The utility model makes Fire Command Center more accurately understand the state of fire fighter, and can make the decision to rescue and relief work faster.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHONGLI ELECTRONICS INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;JIANGSU ZHONGLI GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitoring method, device and system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact vital sign monitoring method, a non-contact vital sign monitoring device and a non-contact vital sign monitoring system based on a millimeter wave radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: extracting echo signals reflected after the emission signals meet the target to be detected; mixing the transmitting signal and the echo signal to generate a mixing signal; performing AD sampling on the mixing signal to generate a time domain sampling signal; carrying out distance transformation on the time domain sampling signal to obtain a one-dimensional range profile of the radar; acquiring a maximum peak value in the one-dimensional range profile to obtain a target range unit, and calculating a phase on the target range unit; repeating the distance conversion and phase calculation steps according to the radar frame refreshing frequency to obtain a phase set which is respectively calculated on the same distance unit every time, and performing phase difference processing to obtain a phase difference set; and filtering the phase difference set to obtain a vital sign signal of the target to be detected, and converting to obtain the vital sign. The invention solves the problems of inconvenience and infection caused by contact detection in the prior art, realizes non-contact measurement, has high practicability and convenience and avoids contact infection.

title_en: Rock soil seepage real-time measuring instrument device based on heat conduction
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ground seepage flow real-time measuring instrument device based on heat-conduction. The device is buried underground, each seepage measurement sensor is connected with a seepage information collection transmitter through a respective seepage measurement processing terminal, and the seepage information collection transmitter is connected with a transmitting end antenna; among the seepage flow measurement sensor, tubule and two funnels of connection at the tubule both ends in the middle of the tubule funnel structure, the tip of tubule and communicate with each other with the tubule are connected to the tip of funnel admittedly, and the main aspects terminal surface of funnel is equipped with porous potsherd, and the inside central authorities of tubule have arranged controllable heating rod, and a temperature sensor has been put to the inside both ends equipartition of tubule, and the inside middle part cartridge of tubule has the water probe. The utility model discloses carry out its direction of accurate measurement and seepage flow volume size to the ground seepage flow that causes by various reasons in the ground, for the new instrument of seepage flow volume in the real-time observation ground, provide the precursor information for the emergence of calamity such as landslide, mud-rock flow.

title_en: Apparatus for mapping buried object and ground cavity through electromagneticwave analysis
title_ko: 전자기파 분석을 통한 지하구조물과 공동형상 맵핑장치 및 그 맵핑방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is an apparatus for mapping a buried object and a ground cavity through electromagnetic wave analysis, comprising: a moving unit configured to move in a first direction in a specific exploration section on the ground surface; a ground penetrating radar configured to transmit a directional electromagnetic wave to the ground of the exploration section and receive a reflected wave reflected from a buried object; and a controller configured to extract a first reflected wave reflected through a shortest path from a specific reflection point of the buried object at a first point of the ground penetrating radar in the specific exploration section and a second reflected wave reflected from the same specific reflection point at a second point, calculate coordinates by calculating the length and depth of the specific reflection point, analyze distributed coordinates of the specific reflection point while continuously changing the first and second points of the ground penetrating radar according to the movement of the moving unit at a specific exploration interval, to map and evaluate the length, depth, and shape of the buried object. As described above, the apparatus of the present invention evaluates the specific shape and size of the buried object.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 지표상의 특정 탐사구간에서 제1방향으로 이동하는 이동부; 상기 탐사구간의 지반으로 지향성 전자기파를 송신하고, 지하구조물로부터 반사되는 반사파를 수신하는 지표투과레이더; 및 상기 특정 탐사구간에서의 상기 지표투과레이더의 제1지점에서 상기 지하구조물의 특정 반사점으로부터 최단경로로 반사되는 제1반사파와, 제2지점에서 상기 동일 특정 반사점으로부터 반사되는 제2반사파를 추출하여, 상기 특정 반사점의 길이와 심도를 연산하여 좌표를 산출하고, 상기 이동부의 이동에 따른 상기 지표투과레이더의 제1 및 제2지점을 특정 탐사진행간격만큼 연속적으로 변경하여 상기 특정 반사점의 분포좌표를 분석하여서, 상기 지하구조물의 길이와 심도와 형상을 맵핑하여 평가하는 제어부;를 포함하여, 상기 지하구조물의 구체적인 형상 및 크기를 평가하는, 전자기파 분석을 통한 지하구조물과 공동형상 맵핑장치를 개시한다.

title_en: A kind of object detection apparatus suitable for through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to object detection apparatus fields, especially a kind of object detection apparatus suitable for through-wall radar, for the problem that existing object detection apparatus volume is big, portability is poor, now propose following scheme comprising the first mounting shell, the second mounting shell, the first rotating turret, the second rotating turret, erecting bed, through-wall radar and control ECU；Through-wall radar, control ECU and display screen are arranged on the second mounting shell；Second rotating turret is arranged on the second mounting shell, and is rotatablely connected with the first rotating turret；First rotating turret is rotatably arranged on the first mounting shell；Erecting bed be arranged on the first mounting shell, and along the vertical direction be arranged side by side there are two；Thread gluing subband and thread gluing master tape are respectively arranged on two erecting beds；The accommodating groove that can store the second mounting shell is provided on first mounting shell；Accommodating groove and thread gluing subband and thread gluing master tape are located at the first mounting shell longitudinal direction two sides.The present invention is small in size, can be worn on user's arm, use good portability.
assignees: JIANGSU WEIHANG JINGYI TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of explorer vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of explorer vehicles for search and rescue, including flying control module and to the power module of each module for power supply, fly control module respectively with GPS positioning module, drive the motor drive module of propeller and raspberry pie module for sending aircraft motion command and data processing to be connected, raspberry pie module is connected with life detection module, environment detection module, communication module and SD card；Life detection module includes camera and sound acquisition module, and environment detection module includes Temperature and Humidity module, detection of air quality module and dust detection module, and communication module includes WIFI module and LORA module.After aircraft provided by the utility model flies to devastated, it acquires the environmental information of devastated and indicator of trapped personnel is unfolded to search operation, the location information of trapped person is locked by GPS positioning module, collected information back is converged to ground data and is stood, the rapid deployment of rescue work can be accelerated.
assignees: ZHEJIANG SHUREN COLLEGE ZHEJIANG SHUREN UNIV

title_en: Augmented reality system for electromagnetic buried asset location
abstract_en: A system for calculating and visualizing a position of buried assets during a buried asset locate procedure in a target area includes an electromagnetic locate device (ELD) including electromagnetic antennas configured for sensing an electromagnetic (EM) field emanating from a buried asset at a target area, and an augmented reality system comprising a camera, a display, inertial sensors for measuring motion and distance moved, and processors configured for reading camera data and sensor data, calculating motion and distance moved, generating a 3D model representing the target area, generating a 3D vector field representing the EM field emanating from the buried asset, calculating a position of the buried asset based on the 3D vector field and the 3D model, creating an object in the 3D model that represents the buried asset, and rendering video of the target area including a graphic representation of the position of the buried asset.

title_en: A radar based ranging system for positioning and vital sign detection
abstract_en: A radar interferometry based phase detection for ranging of a target object is provided. The method of ranging or positioning is based on a phase of a carrier frequency and a plurality of phases of beats among all frequencies. After ranging, positioning may be determined by multi-station trilateration or mono-station cooperating with direction of arrival detection. The method may be also suitable for vital sign detection because of its high sensitivity to distance changes, and in one example, detect the respiration rate of a moving object.

title_en: Cavity identification system and cavity identification method
abstract_en: To suppress false detection of a cavity occurring in the vicinity of a stratum and buried structure to improve the reliability of the underground cavity identification process.SOLUTION: The cavity identification system is for detecting an underground cavity, includes a calculating device for performing a predetermined process and a computer having a storage device connected to the computing device, and equipped with an identification device that detects a cavity from an inputted ground radar reflection image; a primary determination unit for determining the candidate cavity which may be present in the underground radar reflected image using the detection result by the identification device; and a false detection verification unit for determining whether a cavity exists in the region or not using the image of the area of the cavity candidate determined, and the false detection verification unit has a shape verification unit for inspecting the relative positional relationship between a tip portion and, a left slope portion, and a right slope portion of the cavity for the image of the region of the determined candidate cavity, and a tip verification unit for inspecting the shape of the tip.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: A kind of Non-contact pediatric measurement method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Non-contact pediatric measurement methods, the present invention carries out non-contact detection using vital sign parameter signals of the vital sign detections of radar instrument to tested children, it can also promote the shared exchange of the medical informations such as diagnosis correlation data, improve medical service level and working efficiency, malpractice is reduced, has the advantages that process easy to operate, easy-to-search, safe and efficient.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN WEST CHINA 2ND UNIV HOSPITAL

title_en: A kind of Combined through-wall radar
abstract_en: The utility model relates to Radar Technology fields, more particularly to apply the Combined through-wall radar in individual soldier's partition wall detection radar field.The Combined through-wall radar includes one-dimensional through-wall radar, and the one-dimensional through-wall radar includes: transmitter, receiver, wideband signal source, signal-processing board and display screen；The transmitter, receiver, display screen and wideband signal source are all connected with signal-processing board, and the transmitter connects transmitting antenna, and receiver connects receiving antenna, and the output end of the wideband signal source connects receiver；The transmitter will emit the emitted antenna of signal and launch, and the echo-signal of the transmitting signal is received by the receiving antenna of the one-dimensional through-wall radar and is transferred to its receiver；The wideband signal source generates reference signal, and by the reference signal transmission to receiver；Reference signal is mixed and is amplified with echo-signal received in receiver, and signal-processing board is then forwarded to, and display screen shows the result of the signal-processing board processing.
assignees: North general electronics group co ltd

title_en: Multi-mode composite type life-detection system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of multi-mode composite type life-detection system, including mobile terminal and detecting terminal, and mobile terminal is wirelessly connected detecting terminal；Mobile terminal includes touch screen, signal analyzer and the first wireless telecom equipment；Detecting terminal includes shell, main control unit, radar detecting equipment, micro- vibration probe, audio-video probe, the second wireless telecom equipment, radar antenna and main battery.The multi-mode composite type life-detection system of the utility model, by the way that radar detection, micro- vibration detection and audio-video detection are combined, can more efficiently, accurately carry out life detection, simultaneously by the introducing of improvement and wireless communication technique to system structure, so that the operation of life detection is more simple and convenient.
assignees: BEIJING LSJ TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Signal processing method and apparatus for ultra wide band ground penetrating radar based land mine detection
title_ko: 초광대역 지면 투과 레이더 기반 지뢰 탐지를 위한 신호 처리 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for detecting a landmine based on ultra-wideband ground penetrating radar, which comprises: a training process for generating a background signal model by collecting data in an area where landmines are not buried and in an area where landmines are buried while recognizing the landmines; and a detecting process that detects the landmines by using the background signal model acquired through the training process without recognizing the landmines.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지뢰 매설을 인지한 상태에서 지뢰가 매설되지 않은 영역과 지뢰가 매설된 영역의 데이터를 수집하여 배경 신호 모델을 생성하는 훈련 과정과, 지뢰 매설을 인지하지 못한 상태에서 훈련 과정을 통해 획득한 배경 신호 모델을 이용하여 지뢰를 탐지하는 탐지 과정을 포함하는 초광대역 지면 투과 레이더 기반 지뢰 탐지를 위한 신호 처리 방법을 제시한다.
