title_en: Emergency determination device
title_ko: 위급 상황 판단 장치
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided is an emergency situation determining apparatus. The emergency situation determining apparatus comprises: a sensor detecting a bio-signal of a person and a motion of a hand of the person within a predetermined range; and a determination unit analyzing the bio-signal recognized by the sensor and additionally analyzing the motion of the hand in accordance with a result of analyzing the bio-signal to determine whether an emergency situation has occurred.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 위급 상황 판단 장치를 제공한다. 위급 상황 판단 장치는 일정 범위 내에서 사람의 생체 신호 및 사람의 손의 동작을 감지하는 센서 및 상기 센서가 인식한 상기 생체신호를 분석하고, 상기 생체신호를 분석한 결과에 따라 추가적으로 손의 동작을 분석하여 위급 상황이 발생하였는지 여부를 판단하는 판단부를 포함한다.

title_en: Ultra-wideband through-wall radar human respiration and heartbeat detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting respiration and heartbeat of an ultra-wideband through-wall radar life body, belonging to the technical field of radar detection and comprising the following steps: s1: receiving a through-wall echo signal; s2: partitioning the echo signals; s3: accumulating the correlation pulses; s4: suppressing wall echo; s5: denoising the wavelet; s6: decomposing the signal; s7: performing Fourier transform; s8: screening a frequency domain mode; s9: detecting a constant false alarm; s10: and identifying a plurality of life body targets. Wall clutter is removed through singular value decomposition, weak breathing heartbeat signals are enhanced, high-frequency noise is removed through wavelet transformation, breathing and heartbeat signals are separated through intrinsic mode decomposition, and breathing and heartbeat signals of a living body can be extracted at the same time; finally, identifying a plurality of life body targets according to the difference of breathing and heartbeat frequencies and position information of different life bodies; the signal-to-noise ratio is effectively improved in a certain mode, and the calculation efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: A kind of multichannel error self-correcting method for impulse formula through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multichannel error self-correcting methods for impulse formula through-wall radar, the steps include: step S1: detecting straight coupling wave position in each channel；Step S2: reference instant in reference channel and reference channel is determined；Step S3: each channel time delay error is calculated；Step S4: adaptive compensation is made to the error obtained in step S3 by the method for zero padding or truncation；Step S5: conformance error compensation is done in all channels, compensates straight coupling wave propagated error.The present invention has many advantages, such as to can be improved debugging efficiency, applied widely.

title_en: Non-contact pulse transit time measurement system and non-contact vital sign sensing device thereof
abstract_en: In non-contact pulse transit time measurement system of the present invention, two continuous-wave radars are provided to detect movements at two positions on a subject for use in measuring pulse transit time. The measurement of the pulse transit time can be continuous and last for a long time because there is no contact to skin necessary.

title_en: Underground radar apparatus and method therefor
abstract_en: To provide an underground radar apparatus and a method therefor capable of searching a buried object by one scan without having to replace a transmitting/receiving antenna in accordance with a width of a road.SOLUTION: In an underground radar apparatus 100 having a transmitting array antenna 30 and a receiving array antenna 40, a position variable mechanism 20 in which each interval of either antenna elements of the transmitting array antenna 30 and the receiving array antenna 40 is variable while keeping all intervals equal is provided. The position variable mechanism 20 includes: a driving unit; multiple crossbars that constitute bellows; and a plurality of connection units connecting each crossbar so that inclination angles of ridges and valleys of the bellows can be varied.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Emergency determination device
title_ko: 위급 상황 판단 장치
abstract_en: Provided is an emergency situation determination apparatus. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the emergency situation determination apparatus comprises: a sensor detecting the biosignal of a person and the motion of the hands of the person within a certain range; and a determination part analyzing the biosignal recognized by the sensor and determining whether an emergency situation occurs by additionally analyzing the motion of the hands according to the result of analyzing the biosignal, wherein the determination part determines whether the biosignal is analyzed and the emergency situation occurs after a wake-up behavior is detected by the sensor.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 위급 상황 판단 장치를 제공한다. 위급 상황 판단 장치는 일정 범위 내에서 사람의 생체 신호 및 사람의 손의 동작을 감지하는 센서 및 상기 센서가 인식한 상기 생체신호를 분석하고, 상기 생체신호를 분석한 결과에 따라 추가적으로 손의 동작을 분석하여 위급 상황이 발생하였는지 여부를 판단하는 판단부를 포함하고, 상기 판단부는 상기 센서에 의해 웨이크-업(wake-up) 행위가 감지된 이후에 상기 생체 신호의 분석 및 위급 상황이 발생하였는지 여부를 판단한다.

title_en: Human body static target acceleration detection method for impulse type through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human body static target acceleration detection method for impulse type through-wall radar, which comprises the following steps: step S1: eliminating background clutter, namely eliminating the background clutter generated by a completely static target in an echo; step S2: adaptive compensation, namely compensating the influence generated by medium mutation in the electromagnetic wave propagation path; step S3: compensating the energy attenuation of the electromagnetic wave along with the change of the propagation distance so as to meet the requirement of constant false alarm during target detection; step S4: selecting a proper window in the fast and slow time directions, and performing sliding window point taking operation along the fast time direction; step S5: and (6) performing Fourier transform on the data obtained by the sliding window in the step (S4), detecting a respiratory thoracic cavity movement frequency signal of the human body in a frequency domain, judging whether a human body target exists in a detection area and accurately positioning. The invention has the advantages of simple principle, easy realization, wide application range and the like.

title_en: Vital sign sensor capable of resisting clutter
abstract_en: In a vital sign sensor of the present invention, an antenna assembly radiates an oscillation signal generated by a SIL oscillator to an object in a form of a wireless signal and receives a reflected signal from the object, and the reflected signal can have the SIL oscillator injection-locked. The wireless signal radiated from the antenna assembly is transmitted to a demodulator for demodulation such that the vital signs of the object can be obtained. Additionally, an isolator of the antenna assembly is provided to prevent the SIL oscillator from receiving a clutter reflected from the demodulator and an environment where the demodulator is placed. As a result, the clutter can't influence the vital sign detection of the object.

title_en: earth sound sensing probe and earthquake detection system
abstract_en: the invention discloses a ground sound sensing probe and a seismic detection system, wherein the ground sound sensing probe comprises: a test sensor assembly for measuring vibration data; an external processing device, the external processing device comprising: the main control board is electrically connected with the test sensing assembly; the power supply assembly comprises a photoelectric conversion component, a power supply manager and an energy storage component, wherein the photoelectric conversion component and the energy storage component are both electrically connected with the power supply manager, and the power supply manager is electrically connected with the main control board; and the transmission cable is used for electrically connecting the test sensor assembly which is arranged in a split manner with a main control board of the external processing device. The invention aims to ensure that the function of continuous use can be ensured even if the earth sound sensing probe is deeply buried underground and the installation environment is complex, and the stability of the earth sound sensing probe is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN VALLEY VENTURES TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Deconvolution-based impulse type through-wall radar antenna ringing suppression method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deconvolution-based impulse type through-wall radar antenna ringing suppression method, which comprises the following steps: step S1: obtaining an antenna impulse response function, converting the antenna impulse response function into a frequency domain form, and pre-storing the frequency domain form into a radar processor; step S2: if the radar is a multi-channel radar, carrying out channel correction on each channel error in the echo; if the radar is a single-channel radar, the step is omitted; step S3: FFT transforming the channel corrected echo to the frequency domain; step S4: the echo signal in the frequency domain is multiplied by the inverse function of the antenna impulse response function to realize deconvolution ringing suppression; step S5: the signal is converted into the time domain, where ringing effects in the signal have been removed. The invention has the advantages of wide application range, realization of suppression of signal ringing at the antenna end, improvement of radar range resolution, and the like.

title_en: Detection method for deeply-buried high-pressure gas pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting a deeply buried high-pressure gas pipeline, which comprises the following steps: according to the result of the earlier stage on-site gas pipeline investigation, two vertical shafts are firstly constructed right above the pipeline in the approximate direction, the vertical shafts are constructed by adopting an inverted well wall method, and the excavation depth is 13.2 m. After the vertical shaft is seen from the bottom, the position of the pipeline is detected by a radar, and then the specific trend and the elevation of the pipeline are detected in a penetration mode. The method solves the problems that the traditional pipeline detection method has large detection error on the deeply buried metal pipeline and cannot position the non-metal pipeline, has the characteristics of high precision, easy operation, quick response and the like, has strong practical value in the accurate detection of the deeply buried pipeline, has wide application prospect, and is worthy of reference and popularization.
assignees: SUBWAY ENG CO LTD OF CHINA RAILWAY 16TH BUREAU GROUP CO LTD;CHINA RAILWAY 16TH BUREAU GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Physical test device for simulating sandy soil debris flow
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a physical test device for simulating sandy soil mud-rock flow relates to geological experiment technical field, and its technical scheme main points are: the rainfall simulation system comprises a transparent model box, a rainfall simulation device and a data acquisition system; a sandy soil model is laid in the transparent model box; a plurality of sensor devices are buried in the sandy soil model; the rainfall simulation device comprises a water inlet tank, a water guide pipe and a nozzle; the data acquisition system consists of a high-definition camera, a three-dimensional microscopic device, a dynamic strain acquisition system connected with the sensor device and a computer device; the high-definition camera, the stereo microscope and the dynamic strain acquisition system are connected with the computer equipment. The test device can be used for finely and visually acquiring the occurrence and development processes of the sand-soil debris flow, and obtaining the debris flow starting characteristics, the displacement field evolution process and the damage form through analysis, so that the complicated inducing mechanism of the debris flow can be conveniently and deeply explored, and technical support and theoretical basis can be provided for effective prevention and treatment engineering measures.

title_en: Providing image units for vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: According to an example aspect of the present invention, there is provided image units for vital sign monitoring by a multichannel radar scanning a field-of-view and a microwave imaging radiometer sounding the field-of- view. Presence of moving targets within the field-of- view of the radar is determined on the basis of phase and/or amplitude changes of the image units between scans. Thermal information or information determined based on the thermal information obtained by the sounding is combined with the image units of the moving targets. In this way vital signs may be monitored based on movement and thermal information of the image units.

title_en: False alarm eliminating method for handheld through-wall radar
abstract_en: A false alarm eliminating method for a handheld through-wall radar comprises the following steps: step S1: acquiring strong reflection point distance information; detecting the internal area of the building through a handheld one-dimensional through-wall radar detection system, acquiring a strong reflection point signal in the building, and solving the distance information of the strong reflection point; step S2: acquiring target point distance information; simultaneously acquiring target signals of an internal area of a building through a through-wall radar, and solving target point distance information; step S3: matching the characteristics; matching the obtained distance information of the target point signal of the internal area of the building with the obtained distance information of the strong reflection point of the internal area of the building to obtain a target signal with matched characteristics, filtering false alarms and counting; step S4: matching results; and matching the real-time target detection result with the false alarm statistical result to further eliminate the false alarm. The method has the advantages of simple implementation method, good real-time performance and high efficiency, and can effectively inhibit false alarms caused by the distribution of the internal structure of the building.

title_en: Rear interference suppression method for handheld through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for suppressing rear interference of a handheld through-wall radar, which comprises the following steps: step S1: obtaining the distance of a human body target behind the through-wall radar and the echo intensity; step S2: obtaining the distance of a human body target in front of the through-wall radar and the echo intensity; step S3: comparing the echo intensities corresponding to the human body target obtained in the steps S1 and S2, forming a preset threshold value by the difference between the two echo intensities, and using the threshold value as a basis for eliminating the rear interference. Step S4: when a target is detected within a certain distance, the echo intensity corresponding to the target is feature-matched with the threshold T obtained in step S3. And if the echo intensity corresponding to the target is greater than the threshold value T, judging as the target, otherwise, judging as a false alarm and filtering. The method has the advantages of simple principle, easy realization, effective suppression of rear interference, guarantee of the optimal detection performance of the radar and the like.

title_en: Rf coil with integrated vital signs detector
abstract_en: It is an object of the invention to provide a radio frequency (RF) transmit-receive coil (1) for a magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system with an integrated vital signs detector (3) for the detection of vital signs of a patient within the magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system, whereby contact sensors directly attached to the body of the patient, are replaced by a contactless system for monitoring vital signs, which makes it much easier to measure vital signs of the patient. The object is achieved by a RF transmit-receive coil (1) comprising a vital signs detector (3) wherein the vital signs detector (3) is integrated in the RF transmit-receive coil (1), wherein a pair of electrically conducting coil elements (4) of the RF transmit-receive coil (1) forms the vital signs detector (3), wherein the vital signs detector (3) is a capacitive vital signs detector (3), the capacitive vital signs detector (3) being adapted for receiving capacitive vital signs signals. The present invention also concerns a system for the detection of vital signs of a patient within a magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system, a method for operating the system for the detection of vital signs of a patient within a magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system, a software package for a magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system and a software package for upgrading a magnetic resonance (MR) imaging system.

title_en: Automobile safety system
abstract_en: The invention provides an automobile safety system, which comprises a power supply, a control circuit and a power supply, wherein the power supply is used for supplying power to the whole safety system, and the power supply is triggered to start to supply power when a door is closed and locked by a key; the trigger module is used for controlling the on and off of the power supply; the life sensor is used for sensing life signs in the vehicle; the sound detector is used for detecting sound signals in the vehicle; the temperature sensor is used for sensing the temperature in the vehicle when the life signs in the vehicle are detected; the air conditioner controller is used for actively starting the vehicle-mounted air conditioner when the temperature sensor senses that the temperature in the vehicle exceeds a threshold range; the communication module is used for sending out help seeking information and making a help seeking call when the life signs in the vehicle are sensed. Whether life signs exist in the vehicle is sensed by the life sensor, if the life signs exist, emergency rescue information is sent to an emergency contact person or a rescue center, the temperature sensor and the air conditioner controller are matched to sense the temperature in the vehicle, the situation that accidents are caused by too high or too low temperature in the vehicle when rescue is not timely is avoided, and therefore the accident rate is reduced.

title_en: Method for realizing intelligent safety protection wearable equipment for firefighter emergency rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for realizing intelligent safety protection wearing equipment for firefighter emergency rescue, which comprises a fire fighting AR intelligent helmet and a multifunctional firefighter tactical vest; the implementation method is that the gas concentration detector, the thermal imaging module, the Beidou positioning module, the AR display module, the wireless networking module, the multi-information real-time communication transmission module, the brain wave information monitoring module and the vital sign monitoring module are integrated in the fire-fighting AR intelligent helmet and the multifunctional tactical vest, so that support is provided for the command center to judge the on-site rescue condition and develop scientific command decision. The intelligent sensing and judging system can intelligently sense and judge the environmental temperature, environmental position information, site suffocation, explosion, poisoning accident risk, personnel search and rescue and other information of a disaster accident site before a fireman enters an unknown disaster accident site, can also monitor the psychological, physiological and other vital sign information of the fireman at the same time, and provides site real-time information and rescue command decision basis for rescue command of the accident site.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM;HANGZHOU DINGJIE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Telescopic forest fire prevention warning device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fireproof warning devices, and discloses a telescopic forest fireproof warning device which comprises a rack, a telescopic device and a hydraulic system, wherein the telescopic device is fixedly connected to the center of the top of the rack, the hydraulic system is fixedly connected to two sides of the bottom of the rack, the rack is made of stainless steel, all frames are welded and connected, and the rack is integrally buried in soil. When the pedestrian passes through, the sensor receives pulse signal, make hydraulic system and telescoping device work, the warning sign rises and exceeds ground, the pedestrian just can see forest fire prevention warning sign, and disappear as pulse signal, under the effect of gravity, the warning sign can slowly descend back to the original position, can avoid the bad weather of strong wind and rainy, reduce the personal safety accident that probably takes place, the overall process does not need artifical the participation, can make the reaction fast when someone gets into the forest zone time, thereby time saving and labor saving, safe and reliable's effect has been reached.

title_en: Ground penetrating radar simulation test device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ground penetrating radar analogue test device, the device sets up in the cross section is for falling trapezoidal ground recess, and the characteristic target is buried the both sides of ground recess, the device includes: the cross section of the vehicle body is in an inverted trapezoid shape, first mounting positions are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the vehicle body and used for mounting a ground penetrating radar, second mounting positions are arranged on the left side and the right side of the vehicle body and used for mounting the ground penetrating radar, and the ground penetrating radars on the first mounting positions and the second mounting positions face the left side and the right side of the vehicle body; side wheels arranged on the left side and the right side of the vehicle body; a drive device; a controller electrically connected to the drive device; and a computer. The utility model has the advantages that the device has a plurality of ground penetrating radar mounting positions on the head part, the tail part and two sides; and a lateral detection simulation mode is adopted, so that a feasible way is provided for realizing convenient replacement of the tested buried target and simulation test of the large-depth target.
assignees: SHANGHAI YUNYI ELECTROMAGNETIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Reducing motion-related artifacts in optical measurements for vital signs monitoring
abstract_en: Vital sign monitors are plagued by noisy photoplethysmography (PPG) data, making it difficult for the monitors to output consistently accurate readings. Noise in PPG signals is often caused by motion. The present disclosure provides improved techniques for reducing motion-related artifacts in optical/PPG measurements for vital signs monitoring. In general, techniques described herein are based on using measurements of reference sensors that include sensors other than optical sensors used for the optical measurements, e.g., biopotential sensors, bioimpedance sensors, and/or capacitive sensors. In particular, techniques described herein aim to filter PPG signals using substantially only the noise components of signals generated by reference sensors, by attenuating or altogether eliminating components of the signals generated by reference sensors which are indicative of the parameter the reference sensors are designed to measure. Implementing the techniques described herein may lead to more accurate vital sign evaluation using optical/PPG measurements.

title_en: The device which sends the living body signal between living bodies
title_ko: 생체간 생체신호 전달 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device capable of transmitting a bio-signal of one living body to another living body. The device may know thought or will of another living body when a bio-signal is transmitted to nerves of another living body through an electrode or transmission antenna attached to another living body through a wire after the bio-signal moves along the wire by an electromagnetic phenomenon through the electrode or the bio-signal in microwave is amplified in an amplification unit through a reception antenna.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 한 생체의 생체신호를 다른 생체에 전달할 수 있는 장치로서 생체신호가 전극을 통하여 전자기유도 현상에 의하여 전선을 따라 이동하거나 마이크로파에 담긴 생체신호가 수신 안테나를 통하여 증폭부에서 증폭된 후 전선을 통하여 다른 생체에 부착되는 전극이나 송신 안테나를 통하여 다른 생체의 신경에 전달되어 다른 생체의 생각이나 의지등을 알 수 있게 되는 생체신호 전달 장치이다.

title_en: Physiological sensor resembling a neck-worn collar
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor for simultaneously measuring a blood pressure (BP), pulse oximetry (SpO2), and other vital signs and hemodynamic parameters from a patient. The neck-worn sensor features a sensing portion having a flexible housing that is worn entirely on the patient's chest and encloses a battery, wireless transmitter, and all the sensor's sensing and electronic components. It measures electrocardiogram (ECG), impedance plethysmogram (IPG), photoplethysmogram (PPG), and phonocardiogram (PCG) waveforms, and collectively processes these to determine the vital signs and hemodynamic parameters. The sensor that measures PPG waveforms also includes a heating element to increase perfusion of tissue on the chest.

title_en: Patch-based physiological sensor
abstract_en: The invention provides a body-worn patch sensor for simultaneously measuring a blood pressure (BP), pulse oximetry (SpO2), and other vital signs and hemodynamic parameters from a patient. The patch sensor features a sensing portion having a flexible housing that is worn entirely on the patient's chest and encloses a battery, wireless transmitter, and all the sensor's sensing and electronic components. It measures electrocardiogram (ECG), impedance plethysmogram (IPG), photoplethysmogram (PPG), and phonocardiogram (PCG) waveforms, and collectively processes these to determine the vital signs and hemodynamic parameters. The sensor that measures PPG waveforms also includes a heating element to increase perfusion of tissue on the chest.

title_en: Patch-based physiological sensor
abstract_en: The present invention provides a body-worn patch sensor for simultaneously measuring Blood Pressure (BP), pulse oximetry (SpO2), and other vital sign and hemodynamic parameters from a patient. The patch sensor features a sensing portion having a flexible housing that is worn entirely on the patient's chest and encloses a battery, a wireless transmitter, and all of the sensing and electronic components of the sensor. The patch sensor measures and centrally processes Electrocardiogram (ECG), Impedance Plethysmogram (IPG), vascular plethysmogram (PPG), and Phonocardiogram (PCG) waveforms to determine the vital signs and hemodynamic parameters. The sensor measuring PPG waveforms also includes a heating element for increasing perfusion of tissue on the breast.

title_en: Method of attaching sensor, which detects carbon dioxide, to drone, finding point where concentration of carbon dioxide is high, and transmitting information to portable terminal such as smartphone
abstract_en: To provide a method that imposes limited restrictions on use, and makes it possible to readily grasp position information on a human being who is buried alive because of a disaster, and efficiently perform a rescue operation.SOLUTION: A method for finding a location of a human being who is buried alive because of a landslide or collapse of a building includes a process for using a system 1 to secure a carbon dioxide sensor 13, which detects and measures carbon dioxide, to a drone 10, a process for flying the drone, a process for detecting a concentration of carbon dioxide of a level, at which a human being can breathe, using the carbon dioxide sensor, a process for identifying position information on the detected place, and a process for transmitting information to a portable terminal 70.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method and radar of life detection
abstract_en: In a life detection method of the present invention, a signal transceiver is configured to transmit a transmission signal to an area and receive a reflected signal from the area as a detection signal, a demodulator coupled to the signal transceiver is configured to receive and demodulate the detection signal to output a demodulated signal, a compute element coupled to the demodulator is configured to receive the demodulated signal and compute a RMS value of the demodulated signal, and a determination element coupled to the compute element is configured to receive the RMS value of the demodulated signal and determine whether having a living body within the area according to the RMS value and a RMS threshold value.

title_en: Transmit-receive antenna and hand-held type through-wall radar system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a transceiving antenna and a handheld through-wall radar system, wherein the transceiving antenna comprises a dielectric substrate, at least two antenna structures, a plurality of branches and a plurality of first gaps, wherein the antenna structures are arranged on the first side surface of the dielectric substrate in parallel; the plurality of first gaps are distributed on two sides of the antenna structure, and the first gaps are vertical to the radiation direction of the antenna structure; the branches are distributed on the surfaces of the two sides of the dielectric substrate in a one-to-one correspondence mode, and the branches are located in the radiation direction of the antenna structure. This receiving and dispatching antenna is through the first gap that distributes in antenna structure's both sides, realizes the miniaturization of antenna, distributes at antenna structure's radiation direction simultaneously and sets up the minor matters, improves the radiation gain of whole antenna to make the antenna can carry out the system integration with radio frequency circuit board and reduce the holistic size of through-wall radar system, improve the angle resolution ratio of the range separation of penetrating through-wall radar system and system, and then obtain the miniaturized through-wall radar system of high performance.

title_en: Patch-type biosensor device for measuring multiple bio signals
title_ko: 다중생체신호 측정용 패치형 바이오센서 디바이스
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a patch-type biosensor device for measuring multiple biosignals which operates wirelessly to provide a remote health care service. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the patch-type biosensor device for measuring multiple biosignals comprises: an electrode patch module having electrodes arranged on a first surface to collect multiple biosignals and connectors arranged on both ends of a second surface facing the first surface, wherein a middle portion connecting both ends of the second surface has a shape becoming narrower as a symmetric arch shape; a circuit unit main body which is detachable and attachable to a first area of the patch module, is electrically connected to a connector arranged on the first area, and includes one or more circuit parts for processing, storage, and short-range wireless communication for the collected multiple biosignals; and a power supply unit main body which is detachable and attachable to a second area of the patch module and is electrically connected to a connector arranged on the second area to supply power to the circuit parts.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무선으로 동작하는 다중생체신호 측정용 패치형 바이오센서 디바이스에 관한 것으로서, 일실시예에 따른 다중생체신호 측정용 패치형 바이오센서 디바이스는 제1 면에 다중생체신호 수집을 위한 전극들이 배치되고, 상기 제1 면에 대향하는 제2 면의 양끝 단에 커넥터가 배치되며, 상기 양끝 단을 잇는 가운데 부분이 서로 대칭되는 아치형태로써 좁아지는 형태를 갖는 전극패치 모듈, 상기 패치 모듈의 제1 영역에 탈부착이 가능하되, 상기 제1 영역에 배치된 커넥터와 전기적으로 연결되고, 상기 수집된 다중생체신호에 대한 처리, 저장, 및 근거리 무선통신을 위한 적어도 하나 이상의 회로부품들을 포함하는 회로부 본체, 및 상기 패치 모듈의 제2 영역에 탈부착이 가능하되, 상기 제2 영역에 배치된 커넥터와 전기적으로 연결되어 상기 회로부품들에 전원을 공급하기 위한 전원부 본체를 포함한다.

title_en: face mask
title_ko: 페이스 마스크
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a face mask, which displays various information collected through a sensor on a lens part penetrating the front to display the same to a wearer in a face mask used in various water leisure or disaster environments and provides a warning. According to the present invention, the face mask includes: a frame sealing a face surface; a lens part arranged in front of the frame to penetrate the front; a sensor part collecting body information and outside information; an outputting part outputting the information collected by the sensor part to the lens part; and a control part receiving the body information and the outside information collected from the sensor part to control the outputting part to output the same and controlling the outputting part to output the processed information obtained through the body information and the outside information.

title_en: Method of operating a radar sensor system for vital sign detection with elimination of signals excited by interfering movements
abstract_en: A method of operating a radar sensor system that is configured to determine range and velocity information from radar waves reflected by a scene in an interior of a vehicle for vital sign detection. The method includes steps to decompose reflected and received signals into range and velocity information, to measure the movement over time in specified range gates and to evaluate the similarities between them. Based on the characteristics of similar behaving range bins, it can be decided whether any detected movement is related to an internal or external disturbance or by vital signs.

title_en: Convenient-to-use life detection device for searching earthquake disaster victims
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a convenient life detection device for searching earthquake disaster victims, which comprises a main body, a controller and a display screen, the main body is cuboid, the controller is arranged on the main body, the display screen is arranged on the controller, the main body is internally provided with a radar search and rescue system, the main body is provided with four auxiliary mechanisms which are respectively arranged at four corners of the bottom of the main body, the auxiliary mechanism comprises a connecting block, a connecting pipe, a supporting rod, a screw rod, a buckle and a buffer component, the connecting block is connected with the main body through the buffer component, the buckle is fixed on the main body, the connecting pipe is parallel to the plane of the bottom of the main body, this a convenient to use's life detection equipment for searching earthquake disaster person who suffers from a difficult need not the user through complementary unit and seeks the suitable work area of this equipment, has improved the convenience of use.

title_en: Underground radar device and construction machine
abstract_en: To ensure that the performance of detecting a buried object hardly decreases for even irregular ground surfaces such as uneven grounds.SOLUTION: An underground radar device 400 comprises a drum-shaped casing 410, a drum shaft 420 capable of rotating relatively to the casing 410, and a radar 430 suspended from the drum shaft 420 inside the casing 410. The radar 430 is disposed by being spaced apart from the inner surface of the casing 410 by a prescribed interval so that it can be displaced relatively to the inner surface of the casing 410. This ensures that the interval between the radar 430 and a ground surface is maintained almost constant as the casing 410 proceeds on an irregular ground surface while rolling thereupon, and it is possible to suppress a decrease in the performance of detecting a buried object.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Printing solvent storage room
abstract_en: The invention discloses a printing solvent storage room which is divided into a storage area and a filling area by a fire-fighting roller shutter door, wherein a solvent taking platform of the filling area is provided with an electromagnetic explosion-proof valve, and a solvent storage tank of the storage area supplies solvent to the electromagnetic explosion-proof valve through a buried conduit and a solvent pump; a lifting fire-fighting hood is arranged above the solvent taking platform, sealing grooves which are correspondingly nested with hood openings at the bottom of the fire-fighting hood are arranged around the solvent taking platform, a hood body of the fire-fighting hood is of a hollow interlayer structure, and a dry powder automatic fire extinguisher and a temperature sensor are hung at the top of an inner cavity of the fire-fighting hood; the filling area is provided with a combustible gas concentration detection alarm device and a fire automatic alarm system, and a fire alarm controller is in communication connection with a lifting mechanism of the fire control cover; the explosion-proof ventilation mechanism is in communication connection with the combustible gas concentration detection alarm device. Effectively improves the safety of the storage and the matching of the printing solvent, thoroughly avoids the occurrence of casualty accidents, and effectively reduces the accident loss.
