title_en: Data transmission method and buried object detection device
abstract_en: To provide a data transmission method that has certainty in data transmission even for UDP that has no acknowledgment function and high real-time properties.SOLUTION: A buried object detection device includes a search device body that radiates a medium with radar waves and searches for a buried object in the medium, and a display device that receives data from the search device body and displays a search result, and when the latest data is transmitted from the search device body to the display device by using UDP having no acknowledgment function and having high real-time properties, retransmission data which is predetermined data transmitted in the past is simultaneously transmitted.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Human life detection device in car
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a human life detection device in car, which comprises a roof, the roof lower surface passes through installation screw fixed connection's device shell, the movable hole has been seted up to the left surface of device shell, the multi-angle turn trough has been seted up to the inner wall in movable hole, the ball ejector pin has been cup jointed to the inner wall in multi-angle turn trough, the inside of device shell is equipped with information processing apparatus and fine-tuning respectively, the side of device shell is equipped with signal acquisition device. The human body life detection device in the automobile has the advantages that the detection head, the information processing box and the ultra-wide spectrum radar type life detection instrument connected with the information processing box are arranged inside the automobile body, so that the detection of the life characteristics of a driver is realized, and the human body life detection device in the automobile has the effects of detecting the life characteristics of the driver and automatically alarming when a traffic accident is sent by controlling the main board and the infinite signal transmitter connected with the front surface of the main board.

title_en: Control device for air conditioner, air conditioner including control device, control method for air conditioner and program
abstract_en: To provide a control device for an air conditioner that detects occurrence of a fire disaster early.SOLUTION: A control device 2 for an air conditioner (indoor unit 3 for air conditioning) includes: an acquisition unit for acquiring an output signal from a human presence sensor 4 that detects presence/absence of a person (user 101) in a predetermined range 41 and also detects temperature of each of the division ranges 42 obtained by dividing the range 41 into multiple pieces; and a determination unit for determining whether an abnormal heating source 201 occurs in a space 8 in which an air conditioner is installed on the basis of the temperature detected by the human presence sensor 4.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: MITSUBISHI HEAVY IND THERMAL SYSTEMS LTD

title_en: A method of localizing objects, explosive mines and unexploded ordnance on or in the ground
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for detecting explosive mines, unexploded ordnance (UXO) or other targeted objects on or buried underground using a combination of metal detectors (2,4) and Ground Penetration Radar (1) with multiple receivers and transmitters and a GPS device.

title_en: Vehicle occupant detection
abstract_en: A vehicle occupant detection system and method for using the same.The vehicle occupant detection system includes: a controller; a plurality of life detection sensors, wherein the plurality of life detection sensors are installed within an interior cabin of a mass-transit vehicle and are each associated with a life detection zone; a local warning system having at least one human-machine interface (HMI) output device; and a vehicle interface that communicatively couples the controller to a vehicle electrical system of the mass-transit vehicle.The vehicle occupant detection system is configured to: (i) acquire sensor data by scanning the life detection zone using the plurality of life detection sensors; (ii) determine whether an occupant is present based on the sensor data; and (iii) provide an indication to a user that an occupant is present using the HMI output device when it is determined that an occupant is present.

title_en: Apparatus and method for acquiring bio-signal, and apparatus for estimating bio-information
title_ko: 생체신호 획득 장치 및 방법과, 생체정보 추정 장치
abstract_en: A biosignal acquisition apparatus is disclosed. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a biosignal acquisition apparatus may comprise: a sensor unit including a biosignal sensor which measures a biosignal according to the contact of an object, a load sensor which detects a contact load of the object, and an ultrasonic sensor array which detects a contact load distribution of the object; and a signal processing unit which acquires an actual contact load of a region of interest based on the contact load and the contact load distribution and outputs the actual contact load and biosignal of the region of interest.
abstract_ko: 생체신호 획득 장치가 개시된다. 일 실시예에 따르면 생체신호 획득 장치는 대상체의 접촉에 따라 생체신호를 측정하는 생체신호 센서, 대상체의 접촉 하중을 검출하는 하중 센서 및 대상체의 접촉 하중 분포를 검출하는 초음파 센서 어레이를 포함하는 센서부와, 접촉 하중 및 접촉 하중 분포를 기초로 관심영역의 실제 접촉 하중을 획득하고, 관심영역의 실제 접촉 하중 및 생체신호를 출력하는 신호 처리부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Method, system, and computer program product for automatic multi object localization and/or vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: A method for automatic multi-object localization and/or vital sign monitoring is provided. The method comprises the steps of receiving a radar signal in order to form a corresponding observation matrix, reducing noise by applying singular value decomposition to the observation matrix, processing the result of the singular value decomposition by an independent component analysis in order to estimate the corresponding sources, and estimating propagation channels of the estimated sources by minimizing the corresponding residual error based on the observation matrix and the estimated sources.

title_en: Seat occupation, vital signs and safety belt lock sensor system for rear vehicle seats without power supply
abstract_en: The present invention discloses seat occupation, vital signs and safety belt lock sensor for rear seats, which do not have power supply. The proposed system contains mm-wave radar sensor to be used for rear seat detection of seat occupancy and for vital sign detection, being placed on the vehicle ceiling or being integrated in the front seats, having radiation in the direction of the rear seat and detection if the human being is on the rear seat. The proposed system further contains hardware functionality being integrated in the safety belt environment. This functionality is communicating status if the safety belt is locked or not, in the case when the remote mm-wave sensor detected the human being on the rear seat, using arbitrary wireless communication means, and embedded arbitrary means for conserving energy, like battery. The proposed system is additionally detecting vital signs of the person using rear seats.

title_en: Sudden stop of respiration detection alarm system
abstract_en: The invention provides a respiratory sudden stop detection alarm system, which comprises a processor and at least one radar sensor which is arranged in a monitoring area and is in communication connection with the processor, wherein the radar sensor is used for transmitting electromagnetic waves and receiving echo signals, the processor is used for carrying out respiratory sudden stop detection according to the acquired transmitted electromagnetic waves and echo information, the respiratory sudden stop pre-alarm condition is determined by utilizing the minimum value of the echo amplitude under the condition of no person lying in bed, the echo interference level under the condition of no person lying in bed and the minimum value of the sum of power spectral densities calculated under four lying postures, and the respiratory sudden stop pre-alarm is carried out when the real-time received echo signals meet the pre-alarm condition; the method is suitable for a non-contact non-visual detection mode, does not need to be worn, does not influence normal activities, does not infringe personal privacy, greatly improves the detection practicability, and has high popularization value.
assignees: INST OF AUTOMATION SHANDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Radar detection system and method for detecting permanence of slow targets
abstract_en: A method and a system for radar detection system include, after cyclically generating a detection profile representing signal intensity as a function of position, cyclically analyzing the detection profile by alternating two modes of analysis. The first mode is suitable to detect a target entering the field of view, but may have poor sensitivity to targets that move at a low speed for a long time, such as a person entering a hazardous area and stopping. When this mode detects a target, a second mode is entered, which is more sensitive and suitable to detect the permanence of the target in the field of view, and in particular small movements connected to the vital signs of the target. The second mode may be based, for example, on complex signal deviations for each position with respect to a long-term complex mean value for that position. Only if the second mode does not detect any target for a certain restart time, the field of view is deemed to be clear and the first mode is used again.

title_en: Protective clothing based on flexible sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses protective clothing based on a flexible sensor, which comprises a coat for protecting the upper body, trousers for protecting legs and a head cover for protecting the head and the neck, wherein the coat, the trousers and the head cover are integrally formed; still include the data acquisition subassembly, the data acquisition subassembly is including the flexible gas sensor that is used for gaseous composition to gather, the flexible humidity transducer that is used for air humidity to gather, the flexible temperature sensor that is used for the collection of regional interior temperature and the flexible inductance formula sensor that is used for vital sign to gather. The invention can realize data acquisition of the surrounding environment in a wearing mode, and can detect the vital signs of the firefighter, thereby facilitating the command center to know the conditions in the area where the firefighter is located and the command center to formulate a rescue scheme.

title_en: Direct RF signal processing for heart-rate monitoring using UWB impulse radar
abstract_en: Methods, systems, and devices for direct radio frequency (RF) signal processing for heart rate (HR) monitoring using ultra-wide band (UWB) impulse radar are presented. A radar sensor is able to directly sample a received signal at RF which satisfies the Nyquist sampling rate, preserving a subject's vital sign information in the received signal. The vital sign information can be extracted directly from a raw RF signal and thus down conversion to a complex baseband is not required. The HR monitoring performance from the proposed direct RF signal processing technique provides an improvement in continuous HR monitoring as compared against existing methods using a complex baseband signal and/or other measurement techniques.

title_en: Elliptical cross target positioning method for one-transmitting and double-receiving through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elliptical cross positioning method suitable for a transmitting-receiving platform through-wall radar. The method can effectively eliminate the false points which may occur in the multi-target detection of the one-and-two-receiving platform through-wall radar, and improve the positioning accuracy of the radar system. Compared with the traditional double-ellipse cross positioning algorithm, the method can effectively prevent the problem of false point interference which is easy to occur in the positioning of the first-sending and second-receiving platform through-wall radar, avoids the limitation that more than 3 receivers are needed in the past, saves the actual research and development cost, improves the service performance of the first-sending and second-receiving platform through-wall radar in the actual environment, and is beneficial to the actual application of the through-wall radar.

title_en: Through-wall perspective method based on neural network associated radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall perspective method based on a neural network associated radar, which comprises the following steps of: the partition wall collects radar detection information of a sample space, converts the radar detection information into a two-dimensional array, and stores the two-dimensional array as sample data; collecting image information of a sample space, converting the image information into binary picture data, and storing the binary picture data as label data; bringing the sample data and the label data into a convolutional neural network to obtain a trained data model; and detecting the space to be detected by using the radar partition wall, obtaining real-time radar detection data of the space to be detected, bringing the real-time radar detection data into a data model, and obtaining an indoor binary image through the data model. And (3) recognizing weak differences among received signals by utilizing the self-learning training capability of the convolutional neural network. So as to distinguish the action postures of the human body after the wall are standing, walking and lying; the placement position of large furniture such as sofas, beds and the like.
assignees: CHENGDU WEIZHI COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ultra-long tunnel sewage disposing and separation drainage structure suitable for cold regions
abstract_en: An ultra-long tunnel sewage disposing and separation drainage structure suitable for cold regions, comprising a portal segment drainage structure and a trunk segment drainage structure, as well as an outside clean water trench (14), an outside deeply buried water trench (15), an outside sewage trench (16) and a water purification tank (17); the portal segment drainage structure comprises a central water trench (6) and side-type sewage trenches A(7), the central water trench is deeply buried in a main tunnel portal segment (4) at a position lower than a freezing depth, the side-type sewage trenches A are provided on both sides of the main tunnel portal segment, the trunk segment drainage structure comprises side-type clean water trenches (8) and side-type sewage trenches B, and the side-type clean water trenches and the side-type sewage trenches B are provided on both sides of a main tunnel trunk segment (5). The drainage structure achieves the separation drainage disposal of clean water and sewage during tunnel construction and operation, and satisfies high environmental requirements; drainage structures are separately arranged on the portal segment and the trunk segment, meeting the thermal insulation requirements of drainage in cold regions, and being capable of effectively preventing the occurrence of cold disaster caused by the infiltration of underground water into tunnels; and a service tunnel is used to assist in enhancing the drainage capability of the main tunnel, thereby realizing the drainage of a huge amount of water for an ultra-long tunnel.
assignees: CCCC SECOND HIGHWAY CONSULTANTS CO LTD

title_en: Direct-buried laying steam pipeline structure and construction method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a direct-buried laying steam pipeline structure, which relates to the technical field of thermal pipelines and comprises a core pipe, wherein the core pipe comprises a left pipe section and a right pipe section, a disposable compensator is connected between the left pipe section and the right pipe section, sleeves are sleeved on the left pipe section and the right pipe section, and heat-insulating layers are filled between the sleeves and the left pipe section and between the sleeves and the right pipe section. Aiming at the problem that the corrugated pipe is frequently stretched and easily damaged in the prior art, the invention lays the steam pipe network in a non-compensation laying mode, simplifies the installation project of the heat supply network, reduces the manufacturing cost and eliminates the risk of disasters caused by damage of the compensator.
assignees: SHANGHAI KEHUA THERMAL PIPE SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Systems and methods for using radio frequency signals and sensors to monitor environments
abstract_en: Systems and methods for using radio frequency signals and sensors to monitor environments (e.g., indoor building, industrial environments) are disclosed herein. In one embodiment, a system for providing a wireless asymmetric network comprises a hub having one or more processing units and at least one antenna for transmitting and receiving radio frequency (RF) communications in the wireless asymmetric network and a plurality of sensor nodes each having a wireless device with a transmitter and a receiver to enable bi-directional RF communications with the hub in the wireless asymmetric network. The one or more processing units of the hub are configured to determine localization of the plurality of sensor nodes within the wireless asymmetric network, to monitor regions within an environment for human presence and location of at least one robot, to determine human presence information to indicate whether a human is present within the monitored regions, and to determine a location for the human based on the human presence information when a human is present within the monitored regions.

title_en: Container house
abstract_en: The application relates to a container room is applied to container technical field, include: this container body, wind and rain inductor, ground anchor device, air cushion device, controller. When the wind speed monitored by the wind and rain sensor exceeds a preset wind speed threshold value, the wind and rain sensor can trigger the connected controller to send a first control signal to the ground anchor device, and the ground anchor device can be buried into a placing surface for a preset depth, so that the container body can be more firmly fixed on the placing surface to prevent the container body from being blown down by typhoon; the container body is provided with groove structure in order to hold the air cushion device, and when the rainfall that sets up the monitoring of the rain sensor at container body top exceeded predetermined rainfall threshold value, the rain sensor can trigger the controller of connecting and send second control signal for the air cushion device, and the air cushion device is aerifyd to support container body rebound, break away from ponding.

title_en: Apparatus and method for calibrating bio-information estimation model and, apparatus for estimating bio-information
title_ko: 생체정보 추정 모델의 캘리브레이션 장치 및 방법과, 생체정보 추정 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed is a calibration device of a biometric information estimation model. According to one embodiment, the calibration device comprises: a sensor unit measuring a bio-signal from a subject; and a processor extracting a first characteristic and a second characteristic from each of a plurality of points of the bio-signal, and determining a calibration point of the biometric information estimation model from the plurality of points based on a degree of change of the first characteristic of each point compared to the first characteristic of the reference point and a degree of change of the second characteristic of each point compared to the second characteristic of the reference point.
abstract_ko: 생체정보 추정 모델의 캘리브레이션 장치가 개시된다. 일 실시예에 따르면, 캘리브레이션 장치는 피검체로부터 생체신호를 측정하는 센서부와, 생체신호의 복수 지점 각각에서 제1 특징 및 제2 특징을 추출하고, 기준 지점의 제1 특징 대비 각 지점의 제1 특징의 변화 정도 및 상기 기준 지점의 제2 특징 대비 각 지점의 제2 특징의 변화 정도를 기초로 복수 지점 중에서 생체정보 추정 모델의 캘리브레이션 지점을 결정하는 프로세서를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Non-contact self-injection-locked vital sign sensor
abstract_en: A non-contact self-injection-locked vital sign sensor is disclosed, which includes transmitting antenna, receiving antenna, self-injection-locked integrated circuit and demodulator. The self-injection-locked integrated circuit includes voltage-controlled oscillator, mixer, two amplifiers and harmonic-frequency power combiner. A frequency-multiplied signal is produced by amplifiers and harmonic-frequency power combiner then transmitted to a living body by transmitting antenna. A frequency-divided signal is produced by voltage-controlled oscillator and mixer then transmitted to voltage-controlled oscillator, then a frequency- and amplitude-modulated signal is produced by the voltage-controlled oscillator then transmitted to demodulator to produce a vital sign. So as to detect vital sign with a higher frequency to increase measurement sensitivity by using a low-cost integrated circuit process. A centrifugal compressor includes a volute base block, a volute cover plate, an impeller, a diffuser-adjusting assembly, a radial constraint assembly, an axial constraint assembly and a driving assembly.

title_en: Wearable device and sensor device
title_ko: 웨어러블 디바이스 및 센서 디바이스
abstract_en: According to one aspect of the present invention, a wearable device capable of stably measuring a biosignal may comprise: a wearable device body; a sensor unit measuring a biosignal by contacting the skin of a user wearing the wearable device; and a buffer unit formed between the wearable device body and the sensor unit to mechanically connect the wearable device body and the sensor unit, and blocking transfer of movement between the wearable device body and the sensor unit so that the wearable device body and the sensor unit may independently move.
abstract_ko: 일 양상에 따른 웨어러블 디바이스는, 웨어러블 디바이스 본체와, 웨어러블 디바이스를 착용한 사용자의 피부에 접촉하여 생체 신호를 측정하는 센서부와, 상기 웨어러블 디바이스 본체와 상기 센서부 사이에 형성되어 상기 웨어러블 디바이스 본체와 상기 센서부를 기구적으로 연결하며, 상기 웨어러블 디바이스 본체와 상기 센서부가 독립적으로 움직일 수 있도록 상기 웨어러블 디바이스 본체와 상기 센서부 사이의 움직임 전달을 차단하는 완충부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Multi-mode composite detection system for sensing environment behind non-visual obstacle
abstract_en: A multimode composite detection system for non-visual obstacle rear environment perception, comprising: the sensor array comprises a through-wall radar sensor array and a partition listening sensor array, wherein the through-wall radar sensor array is used for generating and radiating electromagnetic wave signals and receiving, reducing frequency and filtering echo signals, and the partition listening sensor array is used for receiving sound signals in a detection area, filtering and amplifying; the sensor control and data acquisition and preprocessing platform is used for carrying out detection control on the front-end sensor array, acquiring and digitizing received data and carrying out filtering and matrix transformation on the digitized data; and the signal processing and fusion decision platform is used for processing the signals received by the sensor array, inputting the processing result of the sensor array into the fusion decision module for fusion decision, and giving out the final detection result of the system. The invention has the advantages of improving the detection probability and precision, improving the detection efficiency, improving the environment adaptability and the like.
assignees: ANTI-TERRORIST AND SWAT CORPS OF BEIJING MUNICIPAL PUBLIC SECURITY BUREAU;HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for acquiring water level information of aquifer by using ground penetrating radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water level detection devices, in particular to a method for acquiring water level information of an aquifer by using a ground penetrating radar, which comprises the following steps: firstly, carrying out topographic measurement on a section selected in a working area to obtain topographic data of the section; detecting the aquifer of the section to obtain a time section of the ground penetrating radar; and processing the time profile of the ground penetrating radar by combining the topographic data of the section, and obtaining water level buried depth data after time-depth conversion. The invention can realize that the underground water level is not exposed in areas with few wells or no wells by digging, the water level information of the underground aquifer can be rapidly and accurately measured by utilizing the ground penetrating radar, and meanwhile, the detection error can be reduced by combining with the terrain data.
assignees: XI'AN CENTER OF GEOLOGICAL SURVEY CGS

title_en: Mobile device based on through-wall radar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mobile device based on a through-wall radar, which comprises a radar host and a control terminal, wherein the control terminal is a mobile terminal, and the control terminal and the radar host are mutually connected through a spring slot; carry out the plug between control terminal and the radar host computer and be connected the back and lock through the draw-in groove through the magnetic stripe absorption, be provided with compression spring between draw-in groove and the control terminal lower extreme, adsorb the back through the magnetic stripe between control terminal and the radar host computer thereby carry out the draw-in groove of downstream card income radar host computer under compression spring's the effect. The utility model has the advantages of simple structure, good portability, easy operation, wide application range and the like.

title_en: Vital sign signal enhancement method and equipment, and extraction method and equipment based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and equipment for enhancing vital sign signals based on a millimeter wave radar, and a method and equipment for extracting the vital sign signals, wherein the enhancing method comprises the following steps: the multi-antenna radar continuously receives N echo signals, wherein the echo signals are echoes of a target to radar transmission signals; carrying out null filtering on the echo signal to remove zero-frequency components; establishing a multi-channel Kalman smoothing model by taking the signals which are received at the same time and subjected to null filtering as observed quantities to obtain enhanced vital sign signals; the extraction method further comprises the steps of: and performing Fourier transformation on the enhanced vital sign signals to a frequency domain, determining the range of the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency according to the comparison of the amplitude and the frequency spectrum data of a preset threshold value in a preset frequency range, and further determining the characteristic value of the life. The method and the equipment can improve the signal-to-noise ratio of the radar receiving echo when the life signal is too weak or the interference of the environmental noise is too large.
assignees: NANJING HUIJUN SEMICONDUCTOR TECH CO LTD

title_en: Doppler through-wall radar positioning method based on extended Bessel model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Doppler through-the-wall radar positioning method based on Hough transform of an extended Bezier model, which belongs to the technical field of target tracking, and is characterized in that a Hough transform frequency estimation algorithm based on the extended Bezier model is used for extracting an interested target component in a received echo and estimating an instantaneous frequency characteristic value of the target component, an extended Bezier curve is constructed by introducing parameters, and further, the parameters are dynamically adjusted, and a value is determined when signal energy can be concentrated to the maximum extent, at the moment, when a fitting result is most approximate to a target instantaneous frequency curve, the estimation of target instantaneous frequency is completed, the precision is improved when compared with the parameters, and the method has innovativeness; and the positioning and tracking algorithm is used for estimating position information of the target in real time according to the instantaneous frequency, synthesizing a target motion track and realizing the tracking of the target.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for emergency rescue and disaster relief
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for emergency rescue and disaster relief, including guard box, horizontal pole, first-aid kit, storing chamber, chamber door, first support column, sole, radar life detection instrument, push pedal, support, searchlight, camera, first fixed block, baffle, round bar, second fixed block, solar cell panel, second support column, spring, warning light and screw. The radar life detection instrument can analyze and judge whether life bodies exist in ruins and obtain specific position information of the life bodies based on the time domain Doppler effect generated by human body telecontrol on radar echoes, is more accurate than a common thermal infrared detection instrument, and can transmit information through the outside of a warning lamp box when detecting life, so that the rescue efficiency is improved; the utility model discloses install the first-aid kit in the bottom of protective case, the inside of first-aid kit is equipped with the storing chamber, can carry some emergent medicines, has increased the stability of transporting, and the mode through the air transportation send first-aid products to the disaster area inside, has better emergent effect.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a monitoring and early warning device of geological disasters belongs to geological disasters technical field, including pre-buried section of thick bamboo, dwang, bearing, protection casing, motor cover, servo motor, a protection section of thick bamboo, returning face plate, cage, main control board, battery, pressure sensor, rubber ring and monitoring facilities, the front and the back of pre-buried section of thick bamboo all imbed the welding and have the bearing, the centre of bearing runs through the welding and has the dwang, the front seamless welding of pre-buried section of thick bamboo is provided with the protection casing, and the dwang is located the protection casing. The utility model provides a pressure sensor can experience when the impact of earth, gives the control circuit on the main control board with data feedback, and control circuit control servo motor begins to operate, and servo motor drives a protection section of thick bamboo, returning face plate and cage rotation one hundred eighty degrees, makes monitoring facilities rotate the bottom of returning face plate, and a protection section of thick bamboo bears the impact of earth, avoids monitoring facilities to be destroyed by the washing, has and is difficult to damage, advantages such as long service life.

title_en: Fire control photoelectric smoke detector with life detection function
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire-fighting equipment technical field specifically is a fire control photoelectric smoke detector with life detects function, including installation box, photoelectric smoke detector, infrared ray image probe and protection device, installation box lower surface is equipped with photoelectric smoke detector and infrared ray image probe, and infrared ray image probe's lower extreme is equipped with protection device, and protection device includes protection base, glass cover and scrapes the hawk, and beneficial effect is: servo motor drives the axostylus axostyle that is equipped with driving pulley through the belt to control the scraping board and come the flyback in the below of glass cover and move, the medial surface that the scraping board is close to the glass cover bonds and has the brush, and the outer wall of glass cover is hugged closely to the brush, and when the scraping board comes the flyback and moves, the brush cleans the smog that the glass cover outer wall is infected with, prevents to be infected with and causes the influence at the surperficial smog of glass cover to the detection of glass cover.
assignees: HEBEI SHANGBO MINING ENG CO LTD

title_en: Building layout reconstruction optimization method based on through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building layout reconstruction optimization method based on a through-wall radar, which is applied to the technical field of through-wall radar imaging and aims to solve the problem of low operation efficiency caused by large calculated amount of the existing reconstruction algorithm; then extracting building layout and internal object edge information according to the gray gradient change of the preliminarily imaged image, and performing region segmentation on the preliminarily imaged image to obtain a plurality of sub-regions; secondly, respectively carrying out self-adaptive iteration threshold value binarization operation on the original images of different sub-regions; finally, fusing results after binarization of different sub-regions to obtain an unknown scene building layout and an internal object imaging result; the scheme of the invention can quickly and efficiently realize the reconstruction of the building layout of the unknown scene, and obviously improve the artifact problem of the initial reconstruction result.

title_en: Pipeline carrier radar damage detection process
abstract_en: A radar damage detection process for a pipeline carrier relates to the technical field of damage detection of buried pipelines. The method comprises the following steps: s1, sending radar wave signals to the metal pipeline through the radar station; s2, receiving radar wave signals on the metal pipeline through a plurality of radar receivers arranged along the metal pipeline and sending the received signals to a processor; s3, analyzing and processing the received information through the processor to find out the damage position of the outer anticorrosive layer of the metal pipeline; and S4, detecting and scanning the metal pipeline at the damaged position of the anticorrosive layer through the pipeline damage detector, and confirming the damaged position and type of the metal layer, the damaged degree and the damage detection range. According to the invention, the damage position of the anticorrosive coating outside the pipeline is found through the matching of the radar station and the distributed radar receiver, and then the pipeline at the damage position of the anticorrosive coating of the pipeline damage detector is used for detecting and scanning, so that the damage type, the damage position and the damage degree of the metal pipeline are confirmed, and the purpose of preventing the metal pipeline from being damaged in the bud is achieved.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGDUN XUNDA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vibrating table test system for tunnel-landslide system and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vibrating table test system for a tunnel-landslide system and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein the test system comprises a visual model box with an open top surface, which is made of a U-shaped steel plate, an organic glass plate and a steel plate, wherein a polystyrene foam plate is arranged on the right side wall in the box, surrounding rock materials are filled in the box and a slope body is built, the sliding belt is arranged under the slope body, two stereo-crossed tunnel models are buried horizontally in the surrounding rock material, a plurality of acceleration sensors and dynamic strain gauges are arranged around the tunnel models, and a plurality of acceleration sensors and dynamic soil pressure gauges are arranged on the slope surface of the slope body, on the upper side and the lower side of the sliding belt and in the surrounding rock material. The vibration table test system provided by the invention can comprehensively and dynamically monitor the dynamic response conditions and strain response changes of tunnel lining, tunnel integrity and surrounding rocks in a tunnel-landslide system, grasp the dynamic response conditions of the tunnel lining and the surrounding rocks under different working conditions, save cost, and monitor and analyze the dynamic response conditions of the tunnel and the side slope in the same stage.

title_en: Underground radar survey device
abstract_en: To provide an underground radar survey device capable of surely and easily teaching an operator of an excavator, an underground buried object in an object region.SOLUTION: There is provided an underground radar survey device which is provided on an excavator 1 comprising: an operation device 2 operated by an operator; an excavator body 3 which can travel in response to an operation of the operation device 2; and a bucket 4 which is provided on the excavator body 3 and is movable in response to an operation of the operation device 2. The underground radar survey device comprises: an antenna 6 which is provided on the bucket 4, radiates an electromagnetic wave for survey to a direction separated from the bucket 4, and receives a reflection wave of the electromagnetic wave for survey by the object buried in the underground; a signal processing part 7 which is mounted on the excavator body 3 and generates a three-dimensional image signal on the basis of a reception signal of the reflection wave received by the antenna 4; and an image display part 8 which is provided on the excavator body 3 and displays the three-dimensional image signal generated by the signal processing part 7.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Exercise management system based on wearable device
title_ko: 웨어러블 디바이스 기반의 운동 관리 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a wearable device-based exercise management system. According to the present invention, when an exercise device performs short-range communications with smart glasses worn by a user and exercise-related sensor information measured by the exercise device and user′s exercise video photographed by the exercise device are transmitted to the smart glasses, the smart glasses or an exercise management server uses the sensor information to diagnose a current exercise state of the user, correctness of an exercise posture, and the like and display a diagnosis result on the user′s smart glasses as video, thereby enabling the user to effectively perform exercise. Moreover, a body state of the user is diagnosed by using a biological signal measured by a smart band worn by the user to be displayed through the user′s smart glasses and proper measures are taken in an emergency situation, thereby protecting the user from risk caused by excessive exercise. Moreover, when the exercise devices are photographed through a camera of the smart glasses, the smart glasses sequentially designs the exercise devices to be used in accordance with a preset exercise program and displays unknown usage of the exercise devices through the smart glasses in video, thereby enabling the user to effectively perform exercise. According to the present invention, the system comprises the exercise device, the smart band, and the smart glasses.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 웨어러블 디바이스 기반의 운동 관리 시스템을 공개한다. 본 발명은 운동 기구와 사용자가 착용한 스마트 글래스가 상호 근거리 통신을 수행하고, 운동 기구에서 측정한 운동 관련 센서 정보 및 운동 기구에서 촬영한 사용자의 운동 영상을 스마트 글래스로 전송하면, 스마트 글래스 또는 운동 관리 서버가 센서 정보를 이용하여 현재 사용자의 운동 상태 및 운동 자세의 정확성 등을 진단하고, 진단 결과를 사용자의 스마트 글래스에 영상으로 표시함으로써 보다 효과적인 운동을 가능하게 한다. 또한, 본 발명은 사용자가 착용한 스마트 밴드에서 측정한 생체 신호를 이용하여 사용자의 몸 상태를 진단하여 사용자의 스마트 글래스를 통해서 표시하고, 위급 상황에서 적절한 조치를 취하도록 함으로써, 과도한 운동으로 인한 사용자의 위험을 방지할 수 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 스마트 글래스의 카메라를 통해서 운동 기구들을 촬영하면, 스마트 글래스가 사전에 설정된 운동 프로그램에 따라서 운동을 수행할 운동 기구를 순차적으로 표시하여 줄 뿐만 아니라, 사용자가 숙지하지 못한 운동 기구 사용법을 스마트 글래스를 통해서 영상으로 표시하여 줌으로써, 보다 효과적인 운동을 가능하게 한다.

title_en: Life-saving sensor for using of reconnaissance robot and operating method thereof
title_ko: 정찰용로봇 활용을 위한 인명탐지 센서 및 그 운용방법
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a life detection sensor for utilizing a reconnaissance robot and an operating method thereof. An object of the present invention is to provide the life detection sensor capable of searching for human life on behalf of a firefighter in a space and an environment which are difficult to access. The life detection sensor for utilizing the reconnaissance robot according to one embodiment of the present invention includes: a sensor unit mounted inside or outside the reconnaissance robot and detecting human life from a detection area; a plurality of antenna units mounted on front, rear, left, and right perpendicular surfaces of the reconnaissance robot and transmitting and receiving signals of the sensor unit; a signal processing unit which is mounted inside the reconnaissance robot, derives presence or absence and detection result of human life from the signal of the sensor unit received through the antenna units, and transmits the same to a server; and a control unit mounted inside the reconnaissance robot, and controlling the sensor unit, the antenna units, and the signal processing unit according to performance of the reconnaissance robot.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 정찰용로봇 활용을 위한 인명탐지 센서 및 그 운용방법을 개시한다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 정찰용로봇 활용을 위한 인명탐지 센서는. 정찰용로봇의 내부 또는 외부에 장착되며, 검출지역으로부터 인명을 탐지하는 센서부; 정찰용로봇의 전, 후, 좌, 우 수직면에 복수로 장착되며, 센서부의 신호를 송수신하는 안테나부; 정찰용로봇의 내부에 장착되며, 안테나부를 통해 수신한 센서부의 신호로부터 인명유무 및 탐지결과를 도출하여 서버로 송신하는 신호처리부; 및 정찰용로봇의 내부에 장착되며, 정찰용로봇의 임무 수행에 따라 센서부, 안테나부 및 신호처리부를 제어하는 제어부;를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: Patch-based physiological sensor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a body-worn patch sensor for simultaneously measuring Blood Pressure (BP), pulse oximetry (SpO2) and other vital signs and hemodynamic parameters of a patient, characterized by a sensing portion having a flexible housing that can be worn entirely on the patient's chest and encloses a battery, a wireless transmitter, and the sensing and electronics components of all sensors. The patch sensor measures Electrocardiogram (ECG), Impedance Plethysmogram (IPG), photoplethysmogram (PPG), and Phonocardiogram (PCG) waveforms, and collectively processes these waveforms to determine vital signs and hemodynamic parameters. The sensor that measures the PPG waveform also includes a heating element to increase perfusion of the breast tissue.

title_en: Earthquake early warning and protection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake disaster early warning and protection system which comprises a set of distributed earth-crust vibration monitoring sensor subsystem, a set of distributed data link radio station transmission subsystem, a set of family early warning terminal subsystem and a set of safety protection subsystem. The system utilizes the characteristics of low transmission speed and high transmission speed of electromagnetic waves of earthquake waves to early warn earthquake information for people additionally provided with the system, and provides a reliable earthquake disaster avoiding space for the people additionally provided with the system, the space can not only protect personnel in the house from being injured when the house collapses, but also provide necessary living conditions for the people, so that the people deeply buried underground can safely survive for 1 month, and sufficient rescue time is provided for rescue personnel. The system is suitable for residents nearby earthquake zones, is particularly suitable for large cities with high population density and people living in high buildings, can effectively protect the coming time of high-grade earthquakes, and ensures that people additionally provided with the system are not threatened by life safety.

title_en: Security surveillance microwave sensor having reduced false report rate by means of biological signal detection
title_ko: 생체신호 감지에 따른 오보율을 개선한 보안 감시용 마이크로웨이브 센서
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a security surveillance microwave sensor having a reduced false report rate by means of biological signal detection, the security surveillance microwave sensor monitoring and determining a malfunction state or false alarm due to environmental factors by detecting humans, animals or objects approaching within a predetermined distance by means of a microwave signal. The present invention: has a first doppler radar and a second doppler radar, each of which detect humans and process security signals, provided in a pair so as to further extend the monitoring distance and perform security surveillance; can specifically set an IF frequency band which can be disturbed by humans; can simply amplify the IF frequency or use a change in the voltage level (peak to peak) by converting and outputting same into a displacement of a DC voltage in order to extend the monitoring distance (d); can precisely manage a monitoring state by double-checking such that the pair of sensors can transmit and receive security signals to and from each other by means of the extended monitoring distance; and has a reduced false report rate compared to an existing microwave sensor by distinguishing false alarms or a malfunction state of the sensors.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 마이크로웨이브(Microwave) 신호를 이용하여 일정 거리 이내에서 접근하는 인체나 동물 또는 사물을 감지하여 환경적 요인에 의한 오경보나 고장상태를 감시하고 판단하는 생체신호 감지에 따른 오보율을 개선한 보안 감시용 마이크로웨이브 센서에 관한 것으로, 인체감지 및 보안신호를 각각 처리하는 제1도플러레이더와 제2도플러레이더를 한 쌍으로 설치하여 감시거리를 더욱 확장하여 보안감시를 할 수 있도록 하고, 인체에 의해 교란되는 IF 주파수대역을 특정하여 설정할 수 있고, 감시거리(d)를 확장하기 위하여 단순히 IF 주파수를 증폭하거나 전압레벨(peak to peak)의 변화를 DC 전압의 변위로 변경 출력하여 사용할 수 있도록 하며, 감시거리의 확장으로 한 쌍의 센서에서 상호 보안신호를 송출하고 수신할 수 있도록 이중 체크함으로써 감시상태를 세밀하게 관리할 수 있고, 센서의 오경보나 고장상태를 더욱 구분할 수 있어 기존의 마이크로웨이브 센서에 비하여 더욱 향상된 오보율의 개선할 수 있도록 한 것이다.

title_en: Human rescue control system using radar human body detection sensor installed in a building
title_ko: 건물내 설치되는 레이더 인체감지센서를 이용한 인명구출 제어시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a life rescue control system using a radar human body detecting sensor installed in a building. According to the present invention, the life rescue control system comprises: a radar human body detecting sensor installed on one side of each room inside a building; a server for receiving scene data; an emergency rescue center; and a scene command center for providing command for life rescue. According to the present invention, efficient life rescue can be implemented in case of fire.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 인명구출 제어시스템에 관한 것으로서, 특히 건물의 각 방에 설치되는 레이더 인체감지센서를 이용하여, 화재발생시 각 방에 사람이 있는 지를 검출하여 응급구조센터로 발송하고, 응급구조센터에서 현장의 소방관에게 정보를 송출하여 효과적인 인물구출이 가능하도록 구현된 건물내 설치되는 레이더 인체감지 센서를 이용한 인명구출 제어시스템에 관한 것이다.   
종래에는 다급한 화재현장에서 어디에 구조할 인명이 있는 지 확인할 수 있는 방법이 없었는데, 본 발명은 건물 내부 각 룸(room)의 일측에 설치되는 레이더 인체감지센서와; 상기 레이더 인체감지센서에서 전달된 생체신호에 따라 룸 넘버와 인명의 존재여부를 포함하는 현장데이터를 전달받는 서버와; 상기 서버의 통신모듈을 통해 현장데이터를 수신하는 응급구조센터와; 상기 응급구조센터에서 송신된 현장데이터를 통해 화재현장에 실제 존재하고 있는 인명에 대한 정보를 파악하여 인명구조를 지휘하는 현장지휘센터를 포함하여 구성된 것을 특징으로 하는 건물내 설치되는 레이더 인체감지센서를 이용한 인명구출 제어시스템을 제안한다. 
따라서 본 발명은 호흡감지센서 및 심박감지센서가 소방관의 호흡수 및 심박수를 감지하고, 설정범위를 벗어나면 엘이디 점등과 진동 및 경보음을 발생할 수 있는 무선신호를 송출함으로써 사용자가 신속히 대피할 수 있도록 하여 긴박한 상황에서 더욱 안전하게 대처할 수 있는 장점이 있다. 또한, 소방관의 진압복 내측에 착용하는 셔츠 또는 속옷에 부착할 수 있도록 구성됨으로써 생체신호의 감지가 더욱 용이하고, 휴대 및 사용이 더욱 편리한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Method for Reduction Random Noise of Radar Gathering Signals in Radar for Measurement of Bio-Signals and Apparatus thereof
title_ko: 생체신호 측정용 레이더에서 레이더 수집신호의 랜덤노이즈 제거방법 및 그 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for reducing random noise from radar-gathering signals in a biometric measurement radar to increase biometric sensing correctness in a noncontact method and a device thereof. According to the present invention, the method comprises the following steps of: (a) receiving a signal reflected from a dynamic target and various kinds of n signals generated from the circumference of the dynamic target through n reception antennas; (b) generating Doppler intermediate frequency (IF) signals from the received n signals, respectively; (c) converting a plurality of doppler IF signals into digital data, respectively; (d) forming a digital signal into a data set having symbols at sampling time intervals and converting the data set into a frequency component symbol set of a plurality of indexes; (e) summing the index symbols converted into the frequency component symbol set by each index set to calculate a value divided by the number of n reception antennas; and (f) filtering only a periodical signal generated in common with respect to a value calculated in a calculation unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 본 발명은 마이크로웨이브 도플러레이더를 이용하여 인체의 생체신호를 획득하는 동안 외부에서 유입되는 각종의 진동노이즈를 효과적으로 감쇄시키고 제거하기 위한 방법과 그 장치에 관한 것으로, (a) IF 신호생성기의 전압제어발진부(VCO)에서 외부에서 인가된 전압(V(t))으로 일정 주기의 발진 주파수를 생성하여 단일의 송신안테나를 통해 동적 타깃의 주요 부위로 송출하고, 상기 동적 타깃에서 반사된 신호와 동적 타깃 주변에서 발생된 각종 신호를 n개의 수신안테나에서 수신하는 단계; (b) 상기 IF 신호생성기는 수신된 n개의 신호에서 각각 도플러 IF 신호를 생성하는 단계; (c) 아날로그/디지털변환기는 상기 IF 신호생성기에서 입력된 복수의 도플러 IF 신호를 각각의 디지털데이터로 변환하는 단계; (d) 상기 아날로그/디지털변환기(20)에서 단위 시간동안 수집된 디지털신호를 고속푸리에변환기에서 샘플링 시간 간격으로 심벌을 갖는 데이터 열로 구성하고, 이 데이터 열을 복수의 인덱스(Index)의 주파수 성분 심벌 열(symbol set)로 전환하는 단계; (e) 상기 신호연산기의 연산부에서 주파수 성분 심벌 열로 전환된 인덱스 심벌들을 각 인덱스 열로 합하여 n개의 수신안테나 수로 나눈 값으로 연산하는 단계; (f) 상기 연산부에서 연산된 값에 대하여 공통적으로 발생하는 주기적인 신호와 공통적이지 않은 비주기적인 신호의 스펙트럼 성분의 편차를 일정 기준의 문턱(Threshold) 값으로 분류하여 주기적인 신호만 필터링하는 단계를 포함하여 이루어진 것이다. 본 발명은 단일의 송신부와 복수의 수신부로 이루어진 생체신호 측정용 도플러레이더를 이용하여 생체신호 영역에 포함되어 있는 랜덤노이즈를 효과적으로 제거함으로써 비접촉식 방식에서 생체신호를 센싱하는 정확도를 개선한 것이다.

title_en: Driving Prediction and Safety Driving System Based on Judgment of Driver Emergency Situation of Autonomous Driving Vehicle
title_ko: 자율주행차량의 운전자 응급상황발생판단에 기반한 주행예측 및 안전주행시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a driving prediction system of an autonomous vehicle. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the driving prediction system of an autonomous vehicle comprises: an acceleration control module to sense a vehicle adjacent to a driving vehicle, and adjust a speed and a speed change rate in accordance with a distance from adjacent vehicles; a safe driving module to generate accident risk information and collision prediction information in accordance with location information and a road situation of a region where the driving vehicle is located; a route generation module to generate a driving route based on traffic information for each region and input information of a destination and a current location of the driving vehicle; and a driving prediction module to recognize a front vehicle, a rear vehicle, and a surrounding object driving on an adjacent lane, receive a driving signal and driving route information transmitted from the surrounding object and sense the speed of the surrounding object to predict driving of surrounding objects, and adjust autonomous driving of the vehicle in accordance with predicted driving information. The driving prediction module identifies a driver biosignal including a breathing cycle of a driver from a biosignal sensor installed in the vehicle to determine an occurrence of an emergency situation, and automatically switches to a safe driving mode if the emergency situation is determined to have occurred.
abstract_ko: 자율주행차량의 주행예측시스템을 개시한다. 실시예에 따른 주행예측시스템은 자율주행차량의 주행예측시스템에 있어서, 주행하는 차량에 인접한 차량을 감지하고, 인접 차량들과의 거리에 따라 속도 및 속도 변화량을 조정하는 가속제어모듈; 주행중인 차량이 위치한 지역의 도로상황과 위치 정보에 따라 충돌 예측정보 및 사고위험정보를 생성하는 안전주행모듈; 주행차량의 현재 위치와 목적지 입력정보, 지역별 교통 정보를 기반으로 주행경로를 생성하는 경로생성모듈; 및 전방차량, 후방차량 및 인접한 차선을 주행하는 주변객체를 인식하고, 주변객체에서 전송하는 운전신호와 주행경로정보를 수신하고 주변객체의 속도를 감지하여 주변객체들의 주행을 예측하고, 예측된 주행정보에 따라 차량의 자율주행을 조정하는 주행예측모듈; 을 포함하고, 주행예측모듈은 차량 내부에 설치된 생체신호 감지 센서로부터 운전자의 호흡주기를 포함하는 운전자생체 신호를 파악하여 응급상황 발생여부를 판단하고, 응급상황이 발생된 것으로 파악한 경우, 안전주행모드로 자동전환 한다.

title_en: High-precision radar sign detector
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-precision radar sign detector. The system comprises a physical sign detector and an information processing terminal; the physical sign detector comprises a radar baseband processing module, at least one set of radar transmitting link and at least two sets of radar receiving links, wherein a plurality of sets of receiving and transmitting links are synchronous and are connected in a rigid body, the radar baseband processing module pretreats echo signals received by the radar receiving links, transmits the echo signals to the information processing terminal for further processing, and outputs heartbeat breathing signals. The invention is provided with a plurality of sets of radar receiving and transmitting systems, and eliminates the micro-motion interference of the trunk of the human body by specially processing complex signals uploaded by the plurality of sets of systems, thereby obtaining more accurate vital signs.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitoring method for bedridden patient
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact vital sign monitoring method for a bedridden patient, and aims to solve the problem that the bedridden patient needs to monitor vital signs but is inconvenient to wear contact equipment. The invention utilizes the advantage that the millimeter wave radar does not need to be in direct contact with the measured object, utilizes the Popler effect, obtains the vibration information of the chest surface of the patient through a series of processing on the received millimeter wave radar, and further calculates the heart rate and the respiratory rate. The accuracy of the calculation result is improved by the cooperation of a plurality of spectrum estimation methods and the design of a respiratory harmonic filter. Therefore, the method for monitoring the vital signs of the bedridden patient is convenient to use, high in measurement precision and non-contact.

title_en: Ground earthquake microgravity combined measurement system and data acquisition and processing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground earthquake microgravity combined measurement system and a data acquisition processing method, comprising earthquake sources uniformly or non-uniformly distributed on the ground, an earthquake source excitation signal detection instrument and a ground gravity measurement instrument; the seismic source excitation signal detection instrument is a wired detector and a wired seismic data recording instrument which are arranged on the ground, or a wireless node seismic instrument which is arranged on the ground, or a buried armored optical cable which is wound in a continuous spiral shape and a distributed optical fiber acoustic wave sensing modulation-demodulation system. Microgravity data are acquired point by point in high density along the ground detector line and the ground source line. The buried depth and the velocity distribution of the whole measuring work area from the earth surface to the bedrock surface are obtained through the joint inversion of the direct wave, the reflected wave, the refraction wave first arrival time data and the ground microgravity data of the ground seismic data, and the method is used for accurately and reliably carrying out static correction processing on the ground seismic data and providing high-quality data after static correction processing for the subsequent further processing of the ground seismic data.

title_en: Handheld through-wall radar device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a handheld through-wall radar device, belonging to the radar field, comprising a radar host, a charger and a charging cable; the radar host comprises an antenna module, a radio frequency module, a signal processing and display control module, a charging and discharging module and a shell; after the radar host is powered on to work, the charging module provides required voltage for the radio frequency module and the signal processing and display control module through voltage conversion, when the signal processing and display control module receives detection key information, the radio frequency module is controlled to generate radar signals and emit the radar signals through an antenna, the antenna module receives echo signals, the echo signals are processed by the radio frequency module and then are sent to the signal processing and display control module, and target information is displayed after algorithm processing; the utility model discloses hand-held type through-wall radar is small, light in weight, effective detection range is big, sensitivity is high, the precision is high, has the advantage that multi-target detection and tracking, interference killing feature are strong simultaneously.
assignees: CHANGZHOU THE FOURTH RADIO FACTORY CO LTD

title_en: Forest fire prevention monitoring system utilizing solar energy
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of solar energy application, in particular to a forest fire prevention monitoring system using solar energy, which comprises a base, a pillar, an equipment cabin, a platform, a solar power generation panel, a telescopic rod, a storage battery, a controller, a signal transmitter, a storage battery and a smoke sensor; the base is buried, a pillar is arranged at the upper part of the base, an equipment cabin is arranged on the pillar, a platform is arranged on the equipment cabin, and a solar power generation panel is arranged on the platform; the storage battery and the signal transmitter are arranged in the equipment cabin, the storage battery is connected with the solar power generation panel, the signal transmitter is connected with the smoke sensor, and the smoke sensor is arranged at the bottom of the equipment cabin, so that the problem that the forest fire prevention modern sensor is difficult to use is solved.
assignees: YUNNAN YAOCHUANG ENERGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle and control method for the same
title_ko: 차량 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: Provided are a vehicle and a control method thereof, wherein the vehicle determines a positive level of a user in the vehicle and accumulates a positive index of the user when the determined positive level is greater than or equal to a predetermined value. The vehicle according to an exemplary embodiment includes: a bio-signal sensor for measuring the user′s bio-signal; a display for displaying an image; and a control unit that determines at least one of a positive level and a change amount of the positive level of the user based on the measured bio-signal, accumulates the user′s positive index if at least one of the determined positive level and the change amount of the positive level is greater than or equal to a predetermined value, and transmits a control signal so that the display can display the accumulated positive index.
abstract_ko:
차량 내 사용자의 긍정도를 결정하고, 결정된 긍정도가 미리 정해진 값 이상이면 사용자의 긍정 지수를 누적시키는 차량 및 그 제어방법을 제공한다. 
일 실시예에 따른 차량은, 사용자의 생체신호를 측정하는 생체신호 센서, 영상을 표시하는 디스플레이, 및 상기 측정된 생체신호에 기초하여 상기 사용자의 긍정도 및 긍정도의 변화량 중 적어도 하나를 결정하고, 상기 결정된 긍정도 및 긍정도의 변화량 중 적어도 하나가 미리 정해진 값 이상이면 상기 사용자의 긍정 지수를 누적 시키고, 상기 디스플레이가 상기 누적된 긍정 지수를 표시하도록 제어 신호를 송출하는 제어부를 포함한다.
assignees: HYUNDAI MOTOR CO LTD;KIA MOTORS CORP

title_en: Wearable signal generating apparaus and an underwater missing person search system including the same
title_ko: 착용형 신호 발생 장치 및 이를 포함하는 수중 실종자 탐색 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a wearable signal generating apparatus worn on the wrist or ankle of a user, which includes a cylindrical body, a signal control module disposed on one side of the inner peripheral surface of the body, and an expansion unit disposed on the other side opposite to one of the inner circumferential surfaces of the body. The signal generating module includes a flooding sensor determining the flooding and generating flooding information, a biometric signal detection sensor detecting a biometric signal of a user and generating biometric signal information, a power supply unit supplying power, a sound wave generation unit generating and transmitting a sound wave signal, and a control unit controlling the flooding sensor, the biometric signal detection sensor, the power supply unit, and the sound wave generation unit. Disclosed are the wearable signal generating apparatus in which the volume expands when moisture is absorbed, and an underwater missing person search system including the same.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사용자의 손목 또는 발목에 착용되는 착용형 신호 발생 장치에 있어서, 원통형의 몸체; 상기 몸체의 내주면 중 일측에 배치된 신호 제어 모듈; 및 상기 몸체의 내주면 중 일측에 대향하는 타측에 배치된 팽창부; 를 포함하고, 상기 신호 제어 모듈은 침수를 판단하고, 침수 정보를 생성하는 침수 센서, 사용자의 생체 신호를 감지하고, 생체 신호 정보를 생성하는 생체 신호 감지 센서, 전원을 공급하는 전원 공급부, 음파 신호를 생성하여 송출하는 음파 발생부 및 상기 침수 센서, 생체 신호 감지 센서, 전원 공급부 및 음파 발생부를 제어하는 제어부를 포함하고, 상기 팽창부는 흡습(吸濕) 시 부피가 팽창하는 착용형 신호 발생 장치 및 이를 포함하는 수중 실종자 탐색 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Rotatable distributed radar life detection positioning equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses rotatable distributed radar life detection positioning equipment which comprises more than two independent radar units, wherein each radar unit is provided with a rotating mechanism, and the independent radar units rotate around a fixed shaft through the rotating mechanisms so as to adjust the polarization direction of an antenna. The invention has the advantages of simple structure, simple and convenient operation, wide application range, capability of realizing large-range rapid search and full-polarization target detection and the like.

title_en: Telescopic distributed radar life detection positioning equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses telescopic distributed radar life detection positioning equipment which comprises more than two radar units, wherein two adjacent radar units are connected through a telescopic mechanism, and the telescopic mechanism is used for enlarging or reducing the distance between the two adjacent radar units. The invention has the advantages of simple structure, simple and convenient operation, wide application range, capability of realizing multi-mode detection and the like.

title_en: Distributed radar life detection positioning equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed radar life detection positioning device, which comprises: the life detection module comprises more than two radar units to form a network, and each radar unit comprises a transmitting unit and a receiving unit and can work independently; and the GPS positioning time service module is used for receiving GPS communication, positioning the position of each radar unit in real time, and using the GPS signal as a time sequence trigger signal of each radar unit to realize time sequence synchronization of each radar unit. And the WIFI signal transmission module is used for performing wireless transmission of radar detection data and issuing a control instruction. The invention has the advantages of simple structure, convenient operation, larger coverage, wider detection range and the like.

title_en: Driver Personalized Negative Emotion Discrimination System using Radar
title_ko: 레이더를 이용한 운전자 개인 맞춤형 부정적 감정 판별 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a driver personalized negative emotion discrimination system using radar. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a driver emotion discrimination system comprises: radar installed in a driver seat and obtaining a biological signal in a non-contact method; and a terminal determining a negative emotion of a driver by analyzing the biological signal obtained from the radar. Accordingly, a service which reduces probabilities of violent driving, legal violations and the like having a high correlation when the emotion of the driver is discriminated as the negative emotion is provided, thereby increasing user satisfaction.
abstract_ko: 레이더를 이용한 운전자 개인 맞춤형 부정적 감정 판별 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 운전자 감정 판별 시스템은, 운전석에 설치되어 생체신호를 비접촉식으로 획득하는 레이더 및 레이더에서 획득된 생체신호를 분석하여, 운전자의 부정적 감정을 판별하는 단말을 포함한다. 이에 의해, 부정적 감정으로 판별시 높은 상관관계를 갖는 난폭운전과 법규위반 등의 확률을 줄이는 서비스를 제공함으로써 사용자의 만족도를 향상시킬 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating forest-healing program
title_ko: 산림 치유 프로그램 평가 방법 및 산림 치유 프로그램 평가 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a forest healing program evaluation method and a forest healing program evaluation system capable of maximizing a forest healing effect. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the forest healing program evaluation method comprises the steps of: measuring multiple biological signals by a sensor attached to a patient in accordance with a forest healing program; analyzing measured values of the multiple biological signals to calculate a score for each function for each function related to a health state of the patient; comparing the score for each function with a prior score for each function in accordance with the multiple biological signals measured before execution of the forest healing program to select a first function with improved health state; and using the selected first function to provide an evaluation result for the forest healing program.
abstract_ko: 산림 치유 프로그램 평가 방법 및 산림 치유 프로그램 평가 시스템이 개시된다.  본 발명의 일실시예에 따른 산림 치유 프로그램 평가 방법은, 산림 치유 프로그램의 실시에 따라, 환자에 부착된 센서에 의해 다중 생체신호를 측정하는 단계와, 상기 다중 생체신호의 측정값을 분석하여, 상기 환자의 건강상태와 관련한 기능 별로 기능 별 점수를 산출하는 단계와, 상기 기능 별 점수를, 상기 산림 치유 프로그램의 실시 전에 측정된 다중 생체신호에 따른 기능 별 사전 점수와 비교하여, 건강상태가 호전된 제1 기능을 선별하는 단계, 및 상기 선별한 제1 기능을 이용하여, 상기 산림 치유 프로그램에 대한 평가 결과를 제공하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Automatic Emergency Report Bracelet
title_ko: 자동위급신고팔찌
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic emergency reporting bracelet. According to the present invention, the automatic emergency reporting bracelet is attached with an LED display lamp connected with a light-sensitive photodiode in pair to flicker an LED light hundreds per second so as to calculate a heart rate through measurement of the number of times of heartbeat per minute, that is, photoplethysmography. In addition, a blood pressure changed in real time is measured by attaching a flexible sensor capable of measuring a pressure of a large blood vessel below several centimeters through the skin, the muscle, and panniculus adiposus by a non-invasive method with an ultrasound. Also, a bracelet wall equipped with a digital temperature measuring function can measure a body temperature change of a user. Furthermore, data measured in the automatic emergency reporting bracelet is connected to a device through Bluetooth communication, and the device can be connected to an emergency management center in real time through an emergency management center application to construct a communication network with a medical institution or emergency center through the device. Therefore, a report is automatically accepted to the emergency management center from the device when the user pre-determines values of a bio-signal (heart rate, blood pressure, and body temperature) to compare the same with a predetermined value, and the difference between a predetermined normal value and a current value occurs by exceeding a predetermined time.
abstract_ko:
자동위급신고팔찌에서 빛에 민감한 광다이오드와 쌍으로 연결된 LED 표시등을 부착하여 초당 수백 번 LED 라이트를 깜박여서 분당 심장이 뛴 횟수, 즉 광혈류 측정을 통해 심박수를계산한다, 또한 초음파를 이용해 비침습적 방법을 통해 피부와 근육, 지방층을 뚫고 수cm 아래 있는 큰 혈관의 압력을 측정할 수 있는 
플렉서블 센서을 부착하여 실시간 변하는 혈압을 측정하고, 
 또한 디지털온도측정 기능이 탑재된 팔찌벽면은 사용자의 체온변화를 측정할 수 있다. 자동위급신고팔찌에서 측정된 데이터들은 디바이스와 블루투스 통신을 통해 연결되며 디바이스에서 응급상황관리센터 어플리케이션을 통해 응급상황관리센터와 실시간 접속가능하게 하여 디바이스를 통해 의료기관이나 응급센터와의 통신망을 구축할 수 있도록한다. 사용자가 생체 신호의 수치(심박수,혈압,체온)를 
미리 정하여 일정 수치에 비교하였을때 미리정한 정상 수치와 현재 수치의 격차가 일정시간을 초과하여 발생할 경우 디바이스에서 자동으로 응급상황관리센터로 신고가 접수된다.

title_en: Through-wall radar system based on mobile terminal
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wear wall radar system based on mobile terminal, including radar host computer and control terminal, control terminal is mobile terminal, control terminal with radar host computer passes through magnetism adsorption formula interconnect. The utility model has the advantages of simple structure, good portability, easy operation, wide application range and the like.

title_en: Bio signal measurement apparatus and method
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: According to one aspect of the present invention, a biosignal measurement device may comprise: a tissue fluid extraction part for extracting a tissue fluid from the skin of a user; a sensor part for measuring at least one of impedance and optical characteristics of the extracted tissue fluid; and a processor for estimating the concentration of an analyte based on at least one of the impedance and the optical characteristics. Therefore, the accuracy of estimating the concentration of the analyte can be improved.
abstract_ko: 일 양상에 따른 생체 신호 측정 장치는 사용자의 피부로부터 조직액을 추출하는 조직액 추출부와, 상기 추출된 조직액의 임피던스 및 광 특성 중 적어도 하나를 측정하는 센서부와, 상기 임피던스 및 광 특성 중 적어도 하나를 기반으로 분석 물질의 농도를 추정하는 프로세서를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Through-wall detection radar device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a through-wall detection radar device, which comprises a frame, the through-wall radar host computer is installed to the upper end of frame, and the lower extreme is connected with the link, be provided with the round pin axle on the link, epaxial clipboard A and the clipboard B that is connected with the cross setting of round pin, the other end is provided with the through-hole, it has the bolt to embolia in the through-hole, the nut is installed to the bolt, through-wall radar host computer includes receiver, transmitter and battery, the receiver is connected with the schottky diode, the schottky diode is connected with the base of triode, the collecting electrode and the projecting pole of triode are connected with the positive pole and the negative pole of power respectively, the projecting pole of triode is connected with signal processor, signal processor is connected with the. The through-wall radar host can be fixed on the wall, so that the image is clearer, the strength of weak signals can be increased, and the power of target signals is improved.

title_en: Through-wall detection radar for enhancing signal
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a through-wall detection radar of reinforcing signal, including through-wall radar host computer, through-wall radar host computer includes receiver, transmitter and battery, the receiver is connected with the schottky diode, the schottky diode is connected with the base of triode, the collecting electrode and the projecting pole of triode are connected with the positive pole and the negative pole of power respectively, the projecting pole of triode is connected with signal processor, signal processor is connected with the controller, the controller is connected with the display, the battery passes through the wire and connects receiver, transmitter, signal processor, controller and display respectively. title_en: Through-wall radar equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a through-wall radar device, which comprises a through-wall radar host, wherein two sides of the through-wall radar host are provided with hand handles, the rear side surface of the through-wall radar host is provided with an adsorption mechanism, the adsorption mechanism comprises an installation block and an adsorption unit, the installation block is fixedly arranged on the rear side surface of the through-wall radar host, the installation block is connected with the adsorption unit, the adsorption unit comprises a cylindrical tube, a lifting rod, a rubber plug and a sucker, the upper end of the cylindrical tube is fixedly arranged on the installation block, a cavity is arranged in the installation block, a sliding plate is arranged in the cavity, the upper end of the sliding plate is connected with a driving piece of the sliding plate, the other end of the driving piece of the sliding plate is connected with the upper end of the inner wall of the installation block, the lower end of the sliding plate is fixedly connected with the lifting rod, the lifting, the support is connected with the rough surface adhesive plate. The utility model has the advantages of place light, adsorption effect is good, improve imaging quality.

title_en: Multi-target respiration heart rate monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a millimeter wave radar-based multi-target respiration heart rate monitoring method and system, wherein a millimeter wave radar module is used for detecting a heart rate and a respiration rate in a non-contact manner, so that a complicated contact-type monitoring program is avoided, and the privacy of a detected person cannot be violated. Compared with the non-contact detection technology in the prior art, the invention improves the detection precision and greatly enhances the reliability of measurement. According to the invention, the respiration heart rate data of the monitored object is monitored and analyzed in real time through the vital sign monitoring platform, so that sudden unexpected diseases of the monitored object can be prevented, or timely alarm can be realized when sudden situations occur; medical care personnel can timely master the physical sign data of the monitored object through the vital sign monitoring platform, timely evaluate the physical condition of the monitored object and give professional opinions and suggestions; the family members of the monitoring object can acquire the health report form of the monitoring object through the vital sign monitoring platform and nurse the monitoring object according to the professional guidance suggestions.

title_en: apparatus for ultra-precision high-resolution bio-signal measuring and method using it
title_ko: 초정밀 고분해능 생체신호 측정장치 및 측정방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an ultra-precise, high-resolution bio-signal measurement device having improved energy efficiency while having high measurement precision, and a measurement method thereof. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the ultra-precise, high-resolution bio-signal measurement device comprises: a sensor part measuring a bio-signal by measuring a plurality of electrodes through which electricity is conducted and a change in capacitance between the plurality of electrodes; and a driving control part that supplies a variable current to the sensor part, compares output voltage output by the supplied variable current and reference voltage, and when the output voltage is greater than or equal to the reference voltage, fixes the variable current and resupplies the same to the sensor part.
