title_en: Coal mine underground disaster avoiding and self-rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a colliery is calamity self-rescue device in pit of mine safety technical field, including refuge system and system of saving oneself, refuge system includes main storehouse and the supply storehouse that has the air purification system device, the supply storehouse is located the inner chamber lower part of main storehouse, the four corners fixedly connected with telescopic bracket of main storehouse, supply storehouse and main storehouse through among the system of saving refuge provide survival material and refuge place respectively, the small-size storehouse that can be in broken calamity scene through the motor-driven removal of water route amphibious running gear of recycling system of saving oneself shifts, and can search for and rescue the buried area through the ware of removing obstacles, the sensor group explores the place ahead of on-the-spot calamity, the device is not limited to the function of avoiding calamity, can also observe and transmit peripheral environment information; the small separation bin body is arranged, and the air purification burden is small when the air is switched on and off; the device has a plurality of independent bins, increases the survival probability, can search surrounding personnel and has rescue ability.

title_en: Detection ball for reconnaissance of life signs after earthquake disaster
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a post-earthquake life sign reconnaissance detection ball, which comprises a circular ball shell, wherein a group of miniature cameras and a group of pyroelectric sensors are symmetrically arranged in the shell, and the heads of the miniature cameras and the pyroelectric sensors are embedded on the surface of the shell and are in the same plane with the shell and are integrated into a whole; a main control chip and a power supply are also arranged in the shell, a wireless transceiver and a positioner are arranged on the main control chip, a rotating shaft and a fixing device are arranged right below the main control chip, and the bottoms of the rotating shaft and the fixing device are connected with a single pendulum instrument; the micro camera, the pyroelectric sensor, the wireless transceiver, the positioner, the rotating shaft and the fixing device are all electrically connected with the main control chip; the detection ball is remotely controlled by a remote controller, and the main control chip is used for controlling the rotating shaft and the fixing device, so that the simple pendulum instrument swings left and right to control the forward and backward of the detection ball; and the information is transmitted to a remote place through the wireless transceiver after the micro camera and the pyroelectric sensor detect the vital signs.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster early warning device which comprises a vertical rod, wherein the top of the vertical rod is fixedly connected with a mounting ball body, a plurality of sensors are assembled on the mounting ball body, the bottom of the vertical rod is fixedly connected with a buried mounting piece, the buried mounting piece comprises a mounting annular plate fixedly connected to the bottom of the vertical rod, a mounting hole is formed in the mounting annular plate, the inner side wall of the mounting hole is fixedly connected to the outer side wall of the vertical rod through a plurality of connecting columns, the buried mounting piece further comprises a plurality of buried annular plates which are distributed at intervals up and down, through holes are formed in the buried annular plates, a plurality of buried pieces are fixedly connected to the buried annular plates, each buried piece comprises a buried mounting column penetrating through the buried annular plate, two ends of each buried mounting column are respectively connected with an outer buried ball body and an inner buried ball body, and the mounting annular plates are fixedly connected through a plurality of annular arrays. The invention has the advantages of improving the embedding stability and the early warning reliability.

title_en: Water conservancy flood prevention monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention provides a water conservancy flood prevention monitoring and early warning system, which is characterized in that a water condition monitoring device, a soil monitoring device and an early warning notification terminal are arranged to notify flood condition information of villagers in real time, and if flood disasters are predicted to occur, the villagers can be notified to evacuate at the first time, so that the problem of low efficiency caused by the combination of the existing broadcast and artificial notification is solved, and the notification timeliness of villages influenced by flood periods is improved. Simultaneously through be provided with the monitoring subassembly on the soil monitoring devices and bore the integrated structure of native subassembly and flexible subassembly for at the in-process of installation or maintenance, drive the mode that bores native subassembly and monitoring subassembly and remove through its flexible subassembly of electric control, with the sensor is buried underground or pulled out to the quick realization, thereby installation or the maintenance progress of monitoring devices are in order to ensure during the quickening flood season the monitoring of water conservancy flood prevention monitoring and early warning system is ageing.
assignees: GEOVIS SHENZHEN DIGITAL TECH INDUSTRIAL RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Life detection and positioning method for full-polarization radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection and positioning method of a full-polarization radar, which comprises the steps of emitting electromagnetic waves to detect a detected area in a full-polarization antenna mode, and then receiving a scattering waveform of a target in the full-polarization antenna mode; and then, preprocessing the received signal, solving a polarization scattering matrix, inverting and estimating time delay, and finally obtaining target information. The invention has the advantages of simple operation, wide application range, adoption of various antenna polarization modes, enhancement of the echo intensity of a detection target, improvement of the detection probability of the life detection radar and the like.

title_en: A system and method for through-wall imaging
abstract_en: An antenna array (100) for through wall imaging includes a plurality of antennas (102) configured to transmit and receive a plurality of signals to and from, respectively, a plurality of targets (90) across an obstruction (95); and a plurality of interference restricting elements (104) interposed between the plurality of antennas (102), wherein the plurality of interference restricting elements (104) are configured to reduce interference of the plurality of signals among the plurality of antennas (102) based upon microwave absorption. An imaging device (106) for through wall imaging includes the antenna array (100); a transceiver unit (108) communicably coupled to the antenna array (100); and a control unit (110) communicably coupled to the antenna array (100) and the transceiver unit (108). The imaging device (106) is communicably coupled to a through wall imaging system (112) configured for reconstructing a scene based upon identification of the targets (90) behind the obstruction (95).

title_en: Through-wall radar imaging method based on convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar imaging method based on a convolutional neural network, which comprises the steps of generating training data, wherein the training data comprises two parts of input echo data and output reference data; the convolutional neural network is a multilayer network and comprises two activation functions, namely a convolutional layer activation function is designed on a convolutional layer, and an output layer activation function is designed on an output layer; constructing a loss function according to the output reference data and the activation function; constructing a convolutional neural network structure for through-wall imaging by training data, an activation function and a loss function and combining a convolutional neural network technology; and inputting training data into the convolutional neural network structure, training the convolutional neural network structure, and then inputting echo data to be imaged to perform imaging test. The invention introduces the deep learning network into the imaging process instead of image post-processing, improves the imaging quality and inhibits grating lobes.

title_en: Through-wall radar imaging method based on wall low-rank sparse constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar imaging method based on wall low-rank sparse constraint, which utilizes two important characteristics of signals in through-wall radar imaging: the invention converts the problems of wall clutter suppression and target reconstruction into a regularized least square optimization problem, wherein the target function comprises a data fidelity (least square) term, a nuclear norm regularization term and a sum of l 1 Norm punishment item, realizes the integrated processing of wall clutter suppression and target imaging, separates out wall clutter in iterative cycle, and simultaneously carries out the pairThe target signal is subjected to reconstruction imaging, and the imaging quality is improved.

title_en: Intelligent alarm method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent alarm method and an intelligent alarm device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining target vital sign data of a target object, determining a body state of the target object based on the target vital sign data, determining alarm parameters based on the body state of the target object, determining the position of the target object through the UWB module when the body state of the target object is in an abnormal state, sending alarm information to target equipment when the duration of the abnormal state of the body state of the target object is longer than or equal to a preset duration, and controlling an alarm module to alarm based on the alarm parameters, wherein the alarm information carries the target vital sign data and the position. The method can realize the positioning and alarming of the target object when the body state of the target object is abnormal, thereby reducing the loss and casualties caused by accidents.

title_en: Security protection fire-fighting equipment based on thing networking
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a security protection fire-fighting equipment based on thing networking, including pre-buried box and fishplate bar, pre-buried box bottom surface fixedly connected with fishplate bar, and the fishplate bar underrun articulates the post and rotate and be connected with the rotation piece to rotate the piece surface and seted up tooth, the inside fixedly connected with servo motor of pre-buried box, and the servo motor output passes through universal coupling and is connected with the dwang, and dwang bottom surface fixedly connected with driving gear, driving gear and tooth meshing, rotate the vertical fixedly connected with connecting rod of rotation bottom surface central point position, and the connecting rod underrun first articulated shaft rotates and is connected with the connecting rod. Has the advantages that: the utility model discloses a first infrared induction camera, second infrared induction camera, servo motor and telescopic link make the shower nozzle can aim at the burning things which may cause a fire disaster department and put out a fire, improve fire control fire extinguishing efficiency, relative and traditional fire gun, simple structure, the low price is fit for the large tracts of land installation.

title_en: Method and device for nondestructive survey at recessed corner of concrete structure using electromagnetic wave radar
abstract_en: To provide a method and device for nondestructive survey at a recessed corner of a concrete structure using an electromagnetic wave radar, with which it is possible to nondestructively survey a buried object or a space arranged at a recessed corner of the concrete structure that has hitherto been a blind spot.SOLUTION: At a recessed corner 2 of a concrete structure 1 is arranged a wedge-shaped electromagnetic wave propagating substance 20 having a dielectric constant of 6-9, having a slope 21 ascending toward the recessed corner 2 and having no reflecting element inside, and an electromagnetic wave radar device 10 is run along the slope 21 of the wedge-shaped electromagnetic wave propagating substance 20, whereby a buried object 4 or a vacant space 3 located at the recessed corner 2 of the concrete structure 1 is surveyed by radiating an electromagnetic wave to the concrete structure 1 in such a way that an electromagnetic wave propagating axis 14 is diagonal to a surface 6 of the concrete structure 1.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Radar-based respiration and heartbeat signal detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting respiration and heartbeat signals based on a radar. The method comprises the following steps: a, judging whether a target exists or not based on a transmitting signal and a receiving signal; b, processing the mixed vital sign signal of the target as follows: b1, carrying out high-pass filtering and FFT (fast Fourier transform) on the mixed vital sign signal to obtain first spectrum data; b2, if the frequency corresponding to the maximum amplitude value point is in the respiratory frequency range and an amplitude maximum value point exists at the Q frequency multiplication position and/or near the Q frequency multiplication position of the frequency, taking the frequency as a respiratory main frequency; b3, decomposing the mixed vital sign signals of the target based on empirical wavelet transform; and B4, if the maximum frequency of the third component or the fourth component is within a preset heartbeat frequency range, taking the maximum frequency as the heartbeat main frequency. Based on empirical wavelet transform, breath and heartbeat signals are separated in a self-adaptive mode, the frequency of the breath and heartbeat signals is extracted accurately, and the breath and heartbeat frequencies of a plurality of people can be extracted and separated simultaneously for a broadband/ultra-wideband radar.

title_en: Ground buried pipe backfilling and compactness detection processing method for rock-soil thermal response testing hole
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for backfilling a buried pipe of a rock-soil thermal response test hole and detecting and processing compactness, and belongs to the field of new energy. The method comprises the following steps: after a plurality of test holes are finished, the buried pipe is put into the bottom of the hole, and the grouting pipe which has the slightly thicker pipe diameter and the same length as the buried pipe is also put into the hole together with the buried pipe; the prepared backfill slurry is injected into the bottom of the hole through the grouting pipe and returns to the ground through the annular space between the grouting pipe and the hole wall; jacking the backfill slurry in the grouting pipe into the annulus by using clear water to finish primary backfill; a radar is inserted into the hole from the lower part of the grouting pipe, a radar detection section of the test hole is generated in the process from bottom to top, and the depth of the cavity or the honeycomb section and the direction in the test hole are determined; perforating at a preset depth and a preset direction by putting a perforating gun under the grouting pipe, wherein the perforating gun emitting hole faces to the cavity or the honeycomb section; and finally, injecting the backfill slurry into the grouting pipe again, wherein the backfill slurry enters the cavity or the honeycomb section through the perforation channel.
assignees: SHANDONG FANGNENG NEW KINETIC ENERGY SCIENCE INST CO LTD

title_en: Wall clutter suppression method of through-wall imaging radar based on joint entropy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall imaging radar wall clutter suppression method based on a joint entropy value, which belongs to the field of through-wall radar imaging. Due to the change of each scanning position of the antenna, the change intensity of a target echo signal is large, the change intensity of a wall clutter is small, so that the information entropy value of the target echo is smaller than that of the wall clutter, and a joint entropy value method is provided according to the fact that the joint entropy value of two groups of echo data is larger than that of any one group. The method can enlarge the adjustable range of the threshold, thereby improving the difference between the input signal-to-clutter ratio and the output signal-to-clutter ratio of the target, eliminating the influence of wall clutter by adaptively selecting the optimal threshold adjusting factor, and obtaining the target image with higher quality by a back projection algorithm.

title_en: Pet monitoring
abstract_en: A system to monitor a pet includes a wearable device with: sensor(s) to monitor vital sign; a wireless transceiver to determine a geolocation of the pet; a processor coupled to the sensor and the wireless transceiver, the processor capturing pet parameters for the pet's caregiver or owner.

title_en: Through-wall radar target near-wall maneuvering tracking method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of through-wall radars, in particular to a through-wall radar target near-wall maneuvering tracking method, and provides a new motion inertia model, namely a covariance prediction formula which is not only related to historical information, but also related to steering degree, namely: the smaller the steering angle is, the closer the prediction mode is to the linear Kalman filtering mode; the larger the steering angle is, the smaller the influence of the history information is; by adopting the prediction strategy, the probability of tracking failure during rapid steering is effectively reduced.
assignees: CHANGZHOU THE FOURTH RADIO FACTORY CO LTD

title_en: Sleep apnea monitoring system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sleep apnea monitoring system based on a millimeter wave radar, which comprises a millimeter wave radar module, a signal processing module, an MCU (microprogrammed control Unit) processor, a deep learning identification system and a rear-end display system, wherein the millimeter wave radar module is connected with the signal processing module; the method is characterized in that: the millimeter wave radar module is connected with the MUC processor, transmits a linear frequency modulation continuous wave signal in the working process according to the detection principle of the Doppler radar, receives a reflected echo signal and transmits the signal to the signal processing module; the signal processing module is connected with the MCU, obtains vital sign monitoring data of a user in the sleeping process by performing signal processing such as demodulation, amplification and the like on the echo signal, and transmits the signal to the deep learning identification system; the deep learning identification system filters a received signal, and filters noise and interference through a band-pass filter with a passband response of 2-50 Hz, which is generated by cascading a low-pass digital filter and a high-pass digital filter, according to the frequency of the signal.

title_en: Air breathing pressure and vital sign online monitoring and early warning system for firefighters
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pressure and vital sign on-line monitoring early warning system are exhaled to fireman sky, include: the air-breathing pressure on-line monitoring and early-warning system for the firefighters comprises a PT500-500 gas pressure sensor, a peripheral circuit, a single-chip microcomputer processing and low-power-consumption Bluetooth wireless transceiver, a data relay forwarding platform, a team data server and a mobile command platform. Both systems comprise: the remote monitoring system comprises a remote transmitting and receiving display device, a host transmitting and receiving system and a voice communication device, wherein the remote transmitting and receiving display device is connected with the host transmitting and receiving system through a data line; the individual soldier system in the forecourt includes a plurality of fire scene terminal parts, and it passes through WIFI, 3G or relay transmission part intercommunication with host computer receiving and dispatching system. The vital sign on-line monitoring and early warning system comprises a vital body information acquisition terminal and a monitoring command center.

title_en: Vibration table test system for tunnel-landslide system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a shaking table test system for tunnel-landslide system, make the open visual model case of top surface including U shaped steel board, organic glass board and steel sheet, the incasement right side wall sets up the polystyrene foam board, and the incasement is filled and is built the country rock material and build the slope body, sets up the tourniquet under the slope body, and two intercrossed tunnel models are buried underground to the inside level of country rock material, lay a plurality of acceleration sensor and dynamic strain gauge around the tunnel model, and the slope body is domatic, on both sides about the tourniquet and arrange if dry acceleration sensor and dynamic soil pressure gauge in the country rock material. The utility model provides a shaking table test system tunnel lining, the whole dynamic response condition and the response change of meeting an emergency of tunnel lining, the whole peripheral country rock of tunnel in can all-round dynamic monitoring tunnel-landslide system, master the dynamic response condition of tunnel lining and peripheral country rock under the different operating mode, not only practice thrift the cost, can carry out with stage monitoring and analysis to the dynamic response condition of tunnel and side slope moreover.
assignees: NORTHWEST RES INST CO LTD CREC

title_en: System for detecting a person's course of motion and/or vital sign parameters
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for detecting a person's course of motion. The method comprises detecting a plurality of images of a person during movement by a non-contact sensor, wherein the plurality of images depict movement of a body element of the person, creating at least one skeletal model with limb positions for at least some of the plurality of images, and calculating a movement process from movement of the body element of the person by comparing changes in limb positions in the at least one created skeletal model. At the same time vital sign parameters and/or signal processing parameters about the person may be detected and analyzed.

title_en: Wireless communication with enhanced maximum permissible exposure (MPE) compliance based on vital signs detection
abstract_en: Aspects of the disclosure relate to radar-based signaling for detecting, measuring, and/or characterizing a target object. An electronic device may transmit a plurality of detection signals and receive a plurality of reflection signals reflected from the target object. The electronic device then processes the plurality of reflection signals to extract one or more parameters of the target object. Based on the reflection signals, the device can measure and/or characterize the target object, e.g., to obtain a heart rate and/or breathing rate. In other examples, the device may determine whether the reflection signals indicate human vital signs, such as a heart rate or breathing. The electronic device may then adjust at least one transmission parameter based on whether human vital signs are detected at the target object, and transmit the adjusted signal using the transmission parameter. Other aspects, embodiments, and features are also claimed and described.

title_en: Flood early warning grade division and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood early warning grade division and early warning method, which comprises the following steps: step 1, dividing flood forecast grades into four grades of extra large, medium and small according to a recurrence period; step 2, corresponding early warning is divided into four levels of extreme danger, high danger, danger and low danger for early warning; the method solves the technical problems that in the prior art, sensors are buried in a water system drainage basin, a remote sensing station is built to collect rainfall and hydrological data, the data are transmitted back to a central station through a communication system to be analyzed and processed, and flood forecasting is carried out according to an analysis result, such as large investment, difficult maintenance, incomplete data, short forecasting period and the like, and timeliness, stability and accuracy of the rainfall forecasting, the flood forecasting and mountain flood disaster forecasting are seriously affected.

title_en: Wearable vital signs monitor with selective signal acquisition
abstract_en: In one example, a wearable vital sign monitor (WVSM) system comprises a support structure configured to be worn by a patient, a plurality of patient physiological sensors configured to be coupled to the patient when the patient is wearing the support structure, each patient physiological sensor configured to output a respective patient physiological signal, a memory, and, a processor communicatively coupled to the plurality of patient physiological sensors and configured to store in the memory measurements of patient physiological signals taken at selected times based on a categorization of the patient physiological signal.

title_en: Vehicle mounted metal and mine detector
abstract_en: The invention is related to a vehicle mounted metal and mine detector, which is used in the operations with military or humanitarian purposes regarding the clearance or removal of landmines for detecting mines with high metal content and plastic mines with a minimum content of metal that are near the ground surface or buried underground, as well as any improvised explosive devices, ammunitions and explosives; in the archaeological researches for determining the location of the buried archaeological remains without damaging them; in the geophysical studies for the exploration of mineral deposits, industrial minerals and rock formations; and in the detection of infrastructure elements such as underground pipelines and cables. The system is comprised of a manned or unmanned ground vehicle ( 8 ), a lower arm ( 2 ) and an upper arm ( 3 ) that are connected to the lower shell ( 7 ) of the vehicle by means of rotating links, a search head ( 1 ) in which electromagnetic interference (EMI) sensor coils and ground penetrating radar (GPR) antennas are arranged to be nested inside one another, fore arms ( 9 ) that are fastened directly on the search head ( 1 ) or into the ribs ( 13 ) placed on the search head and that enable the search head ( 1 ) to be connected to the lower arm ( 2 ) and to the upper arm ( 3 ) by means of the quick-connect rotating connection components, a linear actuator ( 5 ) and a lever arm ( 4 ) that are connected to either one of the lower arm ( 2 ) and the upper arm ( 3 ) with rotating links for adjusting the height of the search head ( 1 ) from the ground, and an upper shell ( 6 ) covering the last-mentioned mechanisms for protecting them against external factors. While adjusting the height of the search head ( 1 ) from the ground, at the same time, it is kept parallel to the ground, and these two functions are carried out by using only one linear actuator ( 3 ). Through the arrangement of the sensors in the search head such that the sensors are arrayed in pairs nested one another, the dimensions of the search head are kept as small as possible, providing the ease of use in narrow areas where the detection operation is carried out. When the search head is damaged, the connection components are broken off by themselves and the search head is broken off from the vehicle due to the connection of the search head ( 1 ) to the lower arm ( 2 ) and the upper arm ( 3 ) by means of the quick-connect connection components, which prevents the rest of the vehicle from being damaged by protecting it against the damaging effects. Furthermore, the damaged search head can be replaced easily and quickly with a new one on site without the need for any special equipment, therefore the vehicle has the ability to operate for a long time.

title_en: Printing solvent storage room
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a printing solvent storage room, which is divided into a storage area and a filling area by a fire-fighting roller shutter door, wherein a solvent taking platform of the filling area is provided with an electromagnetic explosion-proof valve, and a solvent storage tank of the storage area supplies solvent to the electromagnetic explosion-proof valve through a buried conduit and a solvent pump; a lifting fire-fighting hood is arranged above the solvent taking platform, sealing grooves which are correspondingly nested with hood openings at the bottom of the fire-fighting hood are arranged around the solvent taking platform, a hood body of the fire-fighting hood is of a hollow interlayer structure, and a dry powder automatic fire extinguisher and a temperature sensor are hung at the top of an inner cavity of the fire-fighting hood; the filling area is provided with a combustible gas concentration detection alarm device and a fire automatic alarm system, and a fire alarm controller is in communication connection with a lifting mechanism of the fire control cover; the explosion-proof ventilation mechanism is in communication connection with the combustible gas concentration detection alarm device. Effectively improves the safety of the storage and the matching of the printing solvent, thoroughly avoids the occurrence of casualty accidents, and effectively reduces the accident loss.
assignees: LIUYANG YUANYOU PRINTING PACKING CO LTD

title_en: Water valve control system
title_ko: 제수밸브 제어시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a water valve control system that can accurately grasp the open/close state of a manual type or automatic type water valve by installing a sensor module on an instruction plate that displays the rotation amount of the water valve buried in a manhole, and collecting the rotation amount of the instruction plate in a collection device outside the manhole and notifying the rotation amount of the instruction plate to a remote location. In addition, the water valve control system that can ascertain the buried state of the water valve from the remote location as the sensor module is completely waterproof so that no malfunction occurs, and the sensor module detects an earthquake or shock. To this end, the water valve control system is provided with the instruction plate indicating the rotation amount of the valve in a scale on a gearbox of a valve body built in the manhole, and mounts the sensor module on the instruction plate so that the rotation amount of the instruction plate can be checked by the collection device on the ground, wherein the sensor module is composed of a 3-axis acceleration sensor, a 3-axis gyro sensor, and a geomagnetic sensor, when the instruction plate is installed vertically, the sensor module is fixed to the instruction plate so that a Y axis of the 3-axis acceleration sensor is parallel to the instruction plate, and the rotation amount of the instruction plate is detected according to the gravity vector of the Y axis, when the instruction plate is installed horizontally, the sensor module is fixed to the instruction plate so that the Y axis of the 3-axis gyro sensor faces south, and the rotation amount of the instruction plate is detected according to the quaternion value output from the 3-axis acceleration sensor, 3-axis gyro sensor, and geomagnetic sensor.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 맨홀에 묻힌 제수밸브의 회전량을 표시하는 지침판에 센서모듈을 장착하여 상기 지침판의 회전량을 맨홀 외부의 수집장비에서 집계한 뒤 원격지에 통보 함으로써, 수동식 또는 자동식 제수밸브의 개폐상태를 정확하게 파악할 수 있으며, 또한 센서모듈이 완전방수되어 오작동이 발생되지 않고, 상기 센서모듈이 지진이나 충격을 감지하므로 상기 제수밸브의 매립상태를 원격지에서 파악할 수 있는 제수밸브 제어시스템에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위하여 본 발명은 맨홀에 내장된 밸브몸체의 기어박스에 밸브의 회전량을 눈금으로 표시하는 지침판이 구비되고, 상기 지침판에 센서모듈을 장착하여 지상의 수집장비에서 상기 지침판의 회전량을 확인할 수 있도록 한 제수밸브 제어시스템에 있어서, 상기 센서모듈은 3축가속도센서, 3축자이로센서 및 지자기센서로 구성되고; 상기 지침판이 수직으로 설치될 경우 상기 3축가속도센서의 Y축이 상기 지침판의 지침과 나란하도록 상기 센서모듈을 지침판에 고정하고, Y축의 중력 벡터에 따라 상기 지침판의 회전량이 감지되도록 하며; 상기 지침판이 수평으로 설치될 경우 상기 3축자이로센서의 Y축이 남쪽을 향하도록 상기 센서모듈을 지침판에 고정하고, 상기 3축가속도센서, 3축자이로센서 및 지자기센서에서 출력되는 쿼터니언값에 따라 상기 지침판의 회전량이 감지되도록 한 특징이 있다.

title_en: System for determining a dangerous situation and managing the safety of the user
title_ko: 위험 상황을 판단하고, 사용자의 안전을 관리하는 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system for determining a dangerous situation and managing the safety of a user. The system for determining a dangerous situation and managing the safety of a user comprises: a wearable device to sense a biosignal of a user in every predetermined period by using at least one sensor, and transmit sensed information to a server; and the server to monitor the state of the user based on sensor information received from the wearable device, match the surrounding environment of the user to one state group among a plurality of state groups classified in accordance with activity attributes of the user if the change of the biosignal of the user exceeds a threshold, determine a danger level for the surrounding environment based on setting information of the matched state group and the biosignal of the user, and transmit a notification message to a terminal of a protector in accordance with the determined danger level.
abstract_ko: 기 정해진 주기마다 적어도 하나의 센서를 이용하여 사용자의 생체 신호를 센싱하고, 센싱된 정보를 서버로 전송하는 웨어러블 디바이스 및 상기 웨어러블 디바이스로부터 수신된 센서 정보에 기초하여 상기 사용자의 상태를 모니터링하되, 상기 사용자의 생체 신호의 변화가 임계값을 벗어나는 경우, 상기 사용자의 주변 환경을 상기 사용자의 활동 속성에 따라 분류된 복수개의 상태 그룹 중 어느 하나의 상태 그룹에 매칭하고, 상기 매칭된 상태 그룹의 세팅 정보 및 사용자의 생체 신호에 기초하여, 상기 주변 환경에 대한 위험 레벨을 결정하고, 상기 결정된 위험 레벨에 따라 보호자의 단말로 알림 메시지를 전송하는 서버를 포함하는, 위험 상황을 판단하고 사용자의 안전을 관리하는 시스템이 개시된다.

title_en: Hollow snake robot for topographical detection of a urial and collapse and control method thereof
title_ko: 붕괴지형 매몰자 탐지를 위한 뱀 로봇 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a hollow snake robot for detecting a buried person in a flat and narrow space, and a control method thereof. According to an aspect of the present invention, the hollow snake robot comprises: a hollow body unit constructed by connecting a plurality of modules having drive shafts perpendicular to each other in a universal joint scheme; a supply unit connected to one end of the body unit; and a robot hand which is connected to at least a portion of the supply unit, and performs a task by gripping or liberating an object. The supply unit includes: a tube inserted into the hollow space of the other end of the body unit to move a first material associated with survival of a rescue request person to the outside through the one end; a camera to photograph an area around the hollow snake robot; a temperature sensor to measure the temperature of the area around the hollow snake robot; a gas sensor to measure a gas amount and the present of gas in the area around the hollow snake robot; a microphone to receive a voice of the rescue request person and a sound in the area around the hollow snake robot; a speaker to output information inputted from the outside; and a projector to use light to output an image to the area around the hollow snake robot. The hollow snake robot may further comprise a communication unit to transfer information acquired through at least one among the camera, the temperature sensor, the gas sensor, and the microphone to the outside via wired communication or wireless communication.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 양상인 중공형 뱀 로봇은, 유니버설 조인트(universal joint) 방식의 서로 직교하는 구동축을 가진 복수의 모듈을 연결하여 구성된 중공형의 몸통부; 상기 몸통부의 일단에 연결되는 공급부; 및 상기 공급부의 적어도 일부에 연결되고, 객체를 파지 또는 해방하여 태스크(task)를 수행하는 로봇 핸드; 를 포함하고, 상기 공급부는, 상기 몸통부의 타단의 중공으로 삽입되고, 상기 일단을 통해 외부로 구조요청자의 생존과 관련된 제 1 물질을 이동시키기 위한 튜브; 상기 중공형 뱀 로봇의 주변 영역을 촬영하는 카메라; 상기 중공형 뱀 로봇의 주변 영역의 온도를 측정하는 온도 센서; 상기 중공형 뱀 로봇의 주변 영역의 가스 유무 및 가스량을 측정하는 가스 센서; 상기 구조요청자의 음성 및 상기 중공형 뱀 로봇의 주변 영역의 소리를 입력 받는 마이크로폰; 상기 외부로부터 입력된 정보를 출력하기 위한 스피커; 및 빛을 이용하여 영상을 상기 중공형 뱀 로봇의 주변 영역으로 출력하는 프로젝터;를 더 포함하며, 상기 카메라, 온도 센서, 가스 센서 및 마이크로폰 중 적어도 하나를 통해 획득한 정보를, 유선 통신 또는 무선 통신을 통해 외부로 전달하기 위한 통신부;를 더 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for determining a dangerous situation and managing the safety of the user
title_ko: 위험 상황을 판단하고, 사용자의 안전을 관리하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: According to one disclosure, provided is a method for determining a dangerous situation of a user through first danger determination which has analyzed a bio-signal of a user and second danger determination which has analyzed surrounding environment information, and managing the safety. The method comprises the steps of: sensing a bio-signal of a user by using at least one sensor every predetermined period; matching a surrounding environment of the user with any one of a plurality of state groups classified in accordance with the activity attribute of the user, when the change in the bio-signal of the user exceeds a threshold value; determining a danger level for the surrounding environment based on setting information of the matched state group and the bio-signal of the user; and transmitting a notification message to a terminal of a guardian in accordance with the determined danger level.
abstract_ko: 일 개시에 의하여, 사용자의 생체 신호를 분석한 1차 위험 판단, 주변 환경 정보를 분석한 2차 위험 판단을 통해 사용자의 위험 상황을 판단하고 안전을 관리하는 방법을 제공하며, 본 방법은 기 정해진 주기마다 적어도 하나의 센서를 이용하여 사용자의 생체 신호를 센싱하는 단계, 사용자의 생체 신호의 변화가 임계값을 벗어나는 경우, 사용자의 주변 환경을 사용자의 활동 속성에 따라 분류된 복수개의 상태 그룹 중 어느 하나의 상태 그룹에 매칭하는 단계, 매칭된 상태 그룹의 세팅 정보 및 사용자의 생체 신호에 기초하여, 주변 환경에 대한 위험 레벨을 정하는 단계 및 결정된 위험 레벨에 따라 보호자의 단말로 알림 메시지를 전송하는 단계를 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention provides a radar life detection instrument, and relates to the technical field of radar detection. This radar life detection instrument, including the guard box, the top of guard box is rotated and is connected with sealed lid, the equal fixedly connected with metal safe edge of each edge of guard box and sealed lid, the top of guard box is provided with the waterproofing mechanism corresponding with sealed lid, one side at guard box center is provided with radar life detection device body, one side of radar life detection device body is provided with handheld terminal fixed establishment, week side of radar life detection device body outer wall all is provided with avris protection mechanism, the bottom of radar life detection device body is provided with bottom damper. Through design waterproof sealing mechanism, terminal protection mechanism, detection device avris protection mechanism and bottom damper, can play fine guard action to radar life detection device, effectually prevented to lead to the damage of detection instrument because of bumping under adverse circumstances.

title_en: Ground earthquake microgravity combined measurement system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a ground earthquake microgravity combined measurement system, which comprises seismic sources, seismic source excitation signal detection instruments and ground gravity measurement instruments, wherein the seismic sources are uniformly or non-uniformly distributed on the ground; the seismic source excitation signal detecting instrument is a wired wave detector and a wired seismic data recording instrument which are arranged on the ground, or a wireless node seismic instrument which is arranged on the ground, or an embedded continuous spirally wound armored optical cable and a distributed optical fiber acoustic wave sensing modulation and demodulation system. And (4) acquiring microgravity data point by point along the ground detector line and the ground seismic source line in a high density manner. The buried depth and the velocity distribution of the whole measuring work area from the earth surface to the bedrock surface are obtained through the joint inversion of the first arrival travel time data, the reflected wave and the refracted wave of the ground seismic data and the ground microgravity data, the buried depth and the velocity distribution are used for carrying out accurate and reliable static correction processing on the ground seismic data, and the data after high-quality static correction processing are provided for the subsequent further processing of the ground seismic data.
assignees: CNPC AOBO CHENGDU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact phase-locked and self-injection-locked vital sign sensor
abstract_en: A non-contact phase-locked and self-injection-locked vital sign sensor includes a self-oscillating voltage-controlled frequency-adjustable radiating element and a phase-locked loop. The self-oscillating voltage-controlled frequency-adjustable radiating element is used for transmitting an oscillation signal to an organism and for receiving a corresponding reflected signal from the organism to be posed at a self-injection-locked state, the oscillation signal being tuned by a vital sign of the organism to form a frequency-tuned signal. The phase-locked loop is used for demodulating the frequency-tuned signal to obtain a corresponding vital signal of the organism. By comparing the oscillation signal frequency-eliminated and outputted from the self-oscillating voltage-controlled frequency-adjustable radiating element with a reference signal, a corresponding comparison result is used to vary a phase of the frequency-divided oscillation signal for maintaining the same phase of the reference signal. Thereupon, the oscillation frequency can be stabilized, and the measurement sensitivity can be enhanced.

title_en: Near-field coherent sensing methods and systems
abstract_en: Near-field coherent sensing (NCS) methods and systems are described herein. The techniques may be used to monitor vital signs is introduced herein. Multiple-input, multiple output near-field techniques may be used to characterize motion. In some embodiments, the methods and systems are used to measure cardiac motion. In some embodiments, the disclosed system is integrated into a seat, such as, for example, a car seat. The system be configured to monitor the vital signs of a seat occupant with multiple sensing points. The sensor can be integrated into the cushion and hence “invisible” to the user.

title_en: Method and apparatus for detecting emergency with wearable devices
title_ko: 웨어러블 기기를 이용한 응급 상황 감지 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method for detecting an emergency situation using a wearable device, and a device therefor. The method for detecting an emergency situation comprises the steps of: allowing a wearable device to collect a user′s biometric signal through a sensor; determining whether the user′s biometric signal satisfies a predetermined normal criterion; transmitting, when the user′s biometric does not satisfy the predetermined criterion, a first notification signal to inform the user terminal of an emergency situation; outputting, when the user terminal receives the first notification signal, a screen for requesting a user confirmation input for an emergency situation in response to the first notification signal; allowing the user terminal to transmit a second notification signal for informing the emergency situation to a predetermined target when it is determined that the emergency situation has occurred based on the request result. According to the present invention, it is possible to monitor and determine an emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 웨어러블 기기를 이용한 응급 상황 감지 방법 및 장치가 개시된다.  응급 상황 감지 방법은 웨어러블 기기가 센서를 통해 사용자의 생체 신호를 수집하는 단계, 사용자의 생체 신호가 미리 정해진 정상 기준을 만족시키는지 여부를 판단하는 단계, 사용자의 생체 신호가 미리 정해진 기준을 만족시키지 않는 경우, 사용자 단말에 응급 상황을 알리기 위한 제1 알림 신호를 전송하는 단계, 사용자 단말이  제1 알림 신호를 수신하는 경우, 제1 알림 신호에 응답하여 응급 상황에 대한 사용자 확인 입력을 요청하는 화면을 출력하는 단계 및 요청 결과에 기초하여 응급 상황이 발생한 것으로 결정된 경우, 사용자 단말이 응급 상황을 알리기 위한 제2 알림 신호를 미리 설정된 대상에게 전송하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA POLYTECHNIC UNIV INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Context-Awareness System Using Dynamic Object Detection based on Breathing Signal
title_ko: 호흡 신호 기반 동적 객체 탐지를 이용한 상황 인지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a bio signal sensing sensor installed in a vehicle to use breathing signal-based dynamic object detection. An antenna for an impulse radio ultra-wide band (IR-UWB), which is a chip type surface mount device (SMD), includes: a bio signal sensing sensor providing a sensing result by receiving a radio signal reflected from a random object in a detection area; a context determination part determining a context in the detection area in accordance with whether there is a dynamic object in the detection area based on the sensing result, a classification of the dynamic object, and the situation in the detection area based on the classification of the dynamic object, and providing the determination result as a context determination result; and an alarm part actuating a warning device or providing an alarm to a registered personal communication device based on the context determination result. The present invention can prevent an accident in which an infant is left alone in a vehicle.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자동차 내부에 설치되어 호흡 신호 기반 동적 객체 탐지를 이용한 생체 신호 감지 센서로 IR-UWB(Impulse Radio Ultra-Wide Band) 레이더용 안테나는 칩형 SMD(Surface Mount Device) 형태로, 탐지 영역 내에 임의의 객체에서 반사된 전파 신호를 수신하여 센싱 결과를 제공하는 생체 신호 감지 센서, 상기 센싱 결과를 기초로 하여 상기 탐지 영역 내에 동적 객체의 존재 유무, 동적 객체의 구분 및 동적 객체 구분에 따라 탐지 영역 내에 상황을 판단하고, 판단 결과를 상황 판단 결과로서 제공하는 상황 판단부, 및 상기 상황 판단 결과에 기초하여 경보 장치를 작동시키거나 등록된 개인용 통신기기에 알람을 제공하는 알람부를 포함한다.

title_en: Multi-mode composite life detection system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multimode composite life detection system, which comprises a mobile terminal and a detection terminal, wherein the mobile terminal is in wireless connection with the detection terminal; the mobile terminal comprises a touch screen, a signal analyzer and first wireless communication equipment; the detection terminal comprises a shell, a main control unit, radar detection equipment, a micro-vibration probe, an audio and video probe, second wireless communication equipment, a radar antenna and a main battery. According to the multimode composite life detection system, the radar detection, the micro-vibration detection and the audio-video detection are combined, so that the life detection can be carried out more efficiently and accurately, and meanwhile, the life detection operation is simpler and more convenient through the improvement of the system structure and the introduction of a wireless communication technology.
assignees: BEIJING LSJ TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Colliery is many information sensing devices of environment in pit based on thing networking
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a colliery is environmental multi-information perception device in pit based on thing networking belongs to communication and environmental monitoring field. The device uses an FPGA as a main control chip and transmits real-time voice video and environmental parameter information under a coal mine to a ground control center through connection with a camera, a microphone, a temperature and humidity sensor, a gas concentration sensor and a dust concentration sensor; the optical fiber transmission is realized by connecting the photoelectric conversion module, and meanwhile, the transmission efficiency is improved by compressing the image acquired by the camera; the detection of the life body can be carried out by connecting with the life detection radar; by connecting to NB-loT, emergency communication may be available. The device greatly improves the underground coal mine environment detection elements, the communication quality and the efficiency through a multi-sensor fusion technology and an optical fiber communication technology, timely discovers and pre-warns the monitored environment information and the position with problems, and ensures the safety production of a coal mine.

title_en: Self-focusing sparse imaging method of through-wall radar and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of through-wall radar imaging, and provides a through-wall radar self-focusing sparse imaging method and computer equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring echo signals of an expansion target, and constructing a parameterized dictionary signal model taking wall thickness and relative dielectric constant as parameters; taking the sparse characteristic of the expansion target as priori information, and constructing an objective function containing a parameterized dictionary based on maximum posterior probability estimation of total variation constraint and a parameterized dictionary signal model; alternately iterating and updating sparse reflection coefficients and wall parameters according to an objective function, wherein a hash table and linear convolution are used for replacing related operations of dictionary matrixes contained in an updating formula; when the iteration termination condition is reached, outputting the wall thickness and the relative dielectric constant corresponding to the termination of the outer loop as wall parameter estimation values, and using the corresponding sparse reflection coefficient for imaging. The invention effectively reserves the edge characteristic of the expansion target, eliminates the target position deviation caused by unknown wall parameters, simultaneously ensures that the imaging result is clearer, effectively reduces the operation time and improves the space complexity.

title_en: GNSS and gyroscope fused high-precision geological disaster monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-precision geological disaster monitoring system with a GNSS and a gyroscope integrated, which comprises a plurality of monitoring stations arranged at monitoring points, wherein each monitoring station comprises a positioning monitoring pile and a plurality of sensors buried under the ground, each positioning monitoring pile comprises a positioning assembly, a pile body and a control assembly, each positioning assembly comprises a gyroscope, a GNSS antenna and a circuit board, each circuit board comprises an OEM board and an MEMS accelerometer, each GNSS antenna is connected with the OEM board to receive positioning information of a satellite navigation system, each control assembly comprises a storage battery, a data acquisition front end, a data conversion circuit, an MCU data processing circuit and a communication module, the data acquisition front end acquires the positioning information of the sensors buried under the ground, the gyroscopes, the MEMS accelerometers and the satellite navigation system, data is transmitted to an operation center through the communication module, the operation center calculates monitoring results, and the monitoring large screen displays field monitoring results, and sending the early warning alarm information and the early warning place geographic coordinate information to terminal equipment of related management personnel.

title_en: Pipeline carrier radar damage detection system
abstract_en: Pipeline carrier radar damage detection system relates to buried pipeline damage detection technical field. The pipeline damage detector comprises a radar station used for sending radar wave signals to a metal pipeline, a distributed radar receiver used for receiving the radar wave signals on the metal pipeline, a processor used for receiving data sent by the radar receiver and analyzing and finding out the damage position of an outer anticorrosive coating of the pipeline, and a pipeline damage detector used for detecting and scanning the metal pipeline at the damage position of the anticorrosive coating and determining the damage position, type and degree of the metal layer of the metal pipeline. The utility model discloses a radar station and distributed radar receiver cooperation find the damage position of outer anticorrosive coating of metal pipeline, and the scanning is surveyed to the metal pipeline that rethread pipeline damage detector anticorrosive coating damaged the position, confirms the type of the damage of metal level and the position of damage and the degree of damage, reaches and prevents suffering from in unprecedented purpose.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGDUN XUNDA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Real-time gesture recognition method and computer equipment for through-wall radar human body image sequence
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of through-wall radars, and provides a real-time gesture recognition method and computer equipment for a through-wall radar human body image sequence. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a human body image sequence when a hidden human body target moves through a human body image generation algorithm according to the radar echo signal of the target; dividing a human body image sequence when a hidden human body target moves into a training set sample and a test set sample according to a preset proportion, and labeling corresponding action labels at corresponding moments; constructing a human body posture real-time recognition network by combining a 3D convolution layer and a 3D convolution gate control circulation unit, and training the human body posture real-time recognition network through a training set sample; and inputting the test set sample into the trained human body posture real-time recognition network to obtain the posture category of each moment. The invention has the capability of short-time judgment of human behavior types, and effectively solves the problems that the actions are incomplete within fixed time or are difficult to distinguish when two actions exist, and the like.

title_en: Through-wall radar rapid imaging method based on unmanned aerial vehicle platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar rapid imaging method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle platform. The invention adopts a receiving and transmitting separately-arranged mode, and the coordinates of the transmitter and the receiver are different, so that the signal models are different, and the green function of the layered medium from the transmitting antenna to the target and the green function of the layered medium from the target to the receiving antenna are different; and the unmanned aerial vehicle platform is adopted for data acquisition, and the azimuth sampling position is not straight and uniform, so that the imaging result is obtained by utilizing the conjugate linear process that the imaging result is equivalent to the echo generation process.

title_en: Outdoor infrared ray makes a video recording and surveys multi-legged running gear
abstract_en: The invention relates to outdoor detection equipment, in particular to an outdoor infrared ray camera shooting, detecting and observing multi-foot walking device. Comprises a rolling multi-foot walking device, a flat ground walking device, a camera, an infrared sensor and a controller; the rolling multi-foot walking device comprises a rolling motor, a hemispherical shell and a plurality of telescopic stabbing feet, wherein the plurality of telescopic stabbing feet are fixedly connected to the outer part of the hemispherical shell, and the rolling motor is connected with the hemispherical shell; the flat ground walking device comprises an annular shell, supporting legs, walking wheels and a walking motor, wherein the supporting legs are fixedly connected outside the annular shell, the walking wheels are arranged on the supporting legs, and the walking motor is connected with the walking wheels; the two hemispherical shells are arranged on two sides of the annular shell through bearings, the camera, the infrared sensor, the walking motor and the rolling motor are electrically connected with a controller, and the controller is powered by a battery. The camera helps people to take a picture or view in an outdoor complex environment; after disasters such as earthquakes occur, life signs are searched for through infrared detection in a complex and severe environment.

title_en: Through-wall imaging method for inhibiting clutter interference of wall body
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall imaging method for inhibiting wall clutter interference, which comprises echo modeling, antenna coupling interference inhibition, echo discretization, echo calculation, iterative clutter inhibition processing and a smoothed data entropy value, wherein the echo discretization comprises that a through-wall radar uses a multi-receiving multi-transmitting antenna, an equivalent antenna array element can be formed after the transmitting antenna and the receiving antenna are combined, and each antenna array element is subjected to discretization sampling in a time domain to form a sampling point. The detection of slow moving targets is influenced, and the problem that weak targets cannot be extracted correctly exists.
assignees: CHANGZHOU THE FOURTH RADIO FACTORY CO LTD

title_en: Building site uses multi-functional life detection instrument after earthquake
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building site uses multi-functional life detection instrument after earthquake, its structure includes that radar surveys dish, lithium cell group, detection instrument body, horizontal pole, gripping handle, infrared inductor, solar energy electroplax and display screen, the bottom of radar survey dish is equipped with infrared inductor, the top of radar survey dish is equipped with the solar energy electroplax, the right part welding of radar survey dish has the detection instrument body, the top front side of detection instrument body is equipped with lithium cell group, the rear portion of lithium cell group is equipped with the display screen, the bottom front side of detection instrument body is equipped with controlling means, controlling means's process connecting rod is connected with detection monitoring device, detection monitoring device's top left side is equipped with gas sensor, detection monitoring device's top right side is equipped with temperature monitor and humidity monitor. This multi-functional life detection instrument is used in building site after earthquake, the life sign after the high efficiency detected the earthquake, and detection efficiency is high, and the precision is high.
assignees: SHANNENG ENG SURVEY AND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus for guiding exit in fire
title_ko: 화재상황에서도 식별이 용이한 피난구 유도 장치
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention provides an evacuation exit guiding device, which comprises: a detection sensor which is installed at a position of a certain height of an inner wall of a building and detects smoke caused by a fire; and an evacuation exit guiding projection unit which is buried and installed on the floor of the building, and controls a direction irradiating an evacuation exit guidance image recognizable with naked eyes by an evacuee toward the evacuation exit door in a different direction than usual without the fire.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시 형태는 건물 내벽의 일정 높이의 위치에 설치되며 화재로 인한 연기를 감지하는 감지센서; 및 건물 바닥에 매립되어 설치되되, 감지센서를 통해 연기 감지될 경우 대피자가 육안으로 인식가능한 피난구 유도 이미지를 피난구 대피문을 향해 조사하는 방향을 화재 발생되지 않은 평상시와 다르게 하여 제어하는 피난구 유도 영사부;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: pre-acknowledge mask system of synapse
title_ko: 천식발작 조기감지 마스크 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an asthma attack early detection mask system. According to the present invention, a bio-signal detection sensor is mounted on a mask to detect symptoms before asthma coughing by a sensor and transmit the same to a control unit installed on the mask, and the control unit generates an alarm by an alarm means to allow a mask wearer to detect asthma attack in advance so that the mask wearer can be prepared quickly. The present invention has a remarkable effect of relieving pain by asthma and relieving asthma attack by detecting symptoms before asthma attack by the sensor in advance and allowing a mask wearer to quickly take action by taking medicine beforehand or the like.
abstract_ko:
본발명은 천식발작 조기감지 마스크 시스템에 관한 것으로, 생체신호감지센서가 마스크에 장착되어 천식 기침전 증후를 미리 센서로 감지하여 이를 마스크에 설치된 제어부에 전송하고 제어부에서는 경보수단에 의해 경보를 발생하여 마스크 착용자가 천식발작을 미리 감지하게 하여 신속히 대비토록 하는 것으로, 
본발명은 천식발작 증후를 센서에 의해 미리 감지하여 약을 미연에 복용하는 등 조치를 신속히 취함으로써 천식에 의한 고통을 덜고 천식발작을 진정시키는 현저한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Foldable fire self-rescue cabin
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a conflagration life saving equipment technical field specifically discloses folding conflagration cabin of saving oneself, including pre-buried frame, the folding cabin of fire prevention and decoration fixed plate, be equipped with the holding tank that is used for accomodating the folding cabin of fire prevention on the pre-buried frame, the opening of holding tank is forward, decorate the opening part that fixed plate detachably lid closed at the holding tank, make the folding cabin of fire prevention accomodate to the holding tank in, the folding cabin of fire prevention can expand forward and fold backward, the folding cabin of fire prevention after the expansion is formed and is used for holding personnel's of fleing the thermal-insulated inner chamber of fire prevention, and leave the thermal-insulated inner chamber of fire prevention and switch on in the side in the folding cabin of fire prevention, and be used for the fire prevention hatch. The utility model discloses simple structure, convenient to use, space occupancy is little, can enter and dodge when the conflagration breaing out, waits for the rescue, guarantees life safety.

title_en: Dynamic and static human body target self-adaptive detection method and system based on through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for self-adaptive detection of moving and static human body targets based on a through-wall radar, and relates to the technical field of radar detection. The invention comprises the following steps: SS01 obtains baseband signals after frequency mixing and amplification of the through-wall radar and the radio frequency module; SS02 collects 32 groups of data, and after distance Fourier transform and Doppler Fourier transform, accumulation of Doppler direction on corresponding distance units is carried out after modulus taking; SS03 judgment of moving human body; SS04 conversion of stationary human body distance units; SS05 judgment of static human body; SS06 location determination. According to the invention, the moving human body target and the static human body target can be respectively detected through the moving target detection algorithm and the static target detection algorithm, so that on one hand, the detection accuracy is improved, on the other hand, the interference of the moving target on the detection of the static human body target is effectively inhibited, and the problem that the moving target and the static target cannot be simultaneously detected by the conventional detection method is solved by utilizing the characteristic that the breathing heartbeat frequency of the static human body target is low.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological disaster early warning device, which comprises a vertical post rod; the top of the upright post rod is fixedly connected with a mounting sphere, and a plurality of sensors are assembled on the mounting sphere; the bottom of the upright post rod is fixedly connected with an embedded mounting part; the embedded mounting part comprises a mounting ring plate fixedly connected to the bottom of the upright post rod, a mounting hole is formed in the mounting ring plate, and the inner side wall of the mounting hole is fixedly connected to the outer side wall of the upright post rod through a plurality of connecting posts; the embedded installation part also comprises a plurality of embedded ring plates which are distributed at intervals from top to bottom, through holes are formed in the embedded ring plates, a plurality of embedded parts are fixedly connected to the embedded ring plates, each embedded part comprises an embedded installation column penetrating through the embedded ring plates, and two ends of each embedded installation column are respectively connected with an outer embedded ball body and an inner embedded ball body; the installation ring plates are fixedly connected with the embedded ring plates through a plurality of installation pieces distributed in an annular array mode. The utility model has the advantages of improved buried stability, improved the reliability of early warning.

title_en: Target detection method for ground-penetrating radar and associated radar
abstract_en: A method for detecting at least one target buried in an area of the ground, using a ground-penetrating radar, the method includes the steps of: acquiring a measurement of a signal transmitted by each transmitting antenna and reflected in the area of the ground, converting an estimate, into the frequency domain, of the propagation channel for each pair consisting of a transmitting antenna and of a receiving antenna, defining a first hypothesis H0 corresponding to an absence of target in the area of the ground, defining a second hypothesis H1 corresponding to the presence of at least one target in the area of the ground, performing a test of the likelihood ratio between the likelihood of the channel matrix under the second hypothesis H1 and the likelihood of the channel matrix under the first hypothesis H0, in order to conclude whether a target is present at a given position in the area of the ground.
assignees: COMMISSARIAT A L’ENERGIE ATOMIQUE ET AUX ENERGIES ALTERNATIVES

title_en: Building repair method
title_ko: 신속하고 스마트한 구조물 인상 공법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a rapid and smart method of lifting a structure, which uses an apparatus for correcting cracks and abnormal displacement of the structure generated by aging of the structure or constant natural disasters so as to remove the ground around the structure with the abnormal displacement, select a position by considering the leaning direction of the structure and the position of cracks, and bury a lathe connection pipe and a plurality of connection pipes by a hydraulic pressure through a rotary cylinder at the selected position of the structure. When the front end connection pipe is buried down to a firm ground layer, the structure is supported by a beam, and a hydraulic apparatus is installed on an upper surface of the connection pipe engaged with a connection pipe mounting plate to be operated so as to lift the structure by raising the beam along a bracket formed on one side of the beam. At the same time, the cracks of the structure are matched. In addition, the present invention is able to frequently check the displacement of a building through a vibration detection sensor and at the same time, automatically block electricity in the structure when a natural disaster occurs, thereby preventing accidents.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 구조물의 노후화 또는 잇따른 자연재해로인해 발생하는 구조물의 균열과 이상변위를 바로잡는 장치로써, 상기 이상변위가 생긴 구조물 주위에 지반을 걷어낸 후 상기 구조물의 기울어진 방향과 균열의 위치를 고려하여 위치선정을 하고, 상기 선정된 구조물 위치에 회전식실린더를 통해 선반연결관과 다수의 연결관을 유압으로 매설한다.  상기 선단연결관이 단단한 지반층까지 매설되면 대들보를 통해 구조물을 받치도록 하고 연결관탑재판에 결합된 연결관 상면에 유압장치를 설치하여 가동하므로 대들보 일측에 형성된 브라켓을 따라 대들보가 상승하도록 하여 구조물을 들어올리고 그 동시에 구조물의 균열을 맞출 수 있도록 한다.    또한, 진동감지센서를 통해 건물의 변위를 수시로 체크하는 동시에 자연재해가 발생할 시 구조물 내의 전력을 자동차단하여 안전사고를 예방을 할 수 있는 것을 특징으로 하는 신속하고 스마트한 구조물 인상 공법 장치에 관한것이다.

title_en: Smart home device using a single radar transmission mode for activity recognition of active users and vital sign monitoring of inactive users
abstract_en: Various arrangements for monitoring for contactless human interactions and health using a single radar transmission modulation mode are provided. Radar chirps may be output by a radar sensor operating in a burst mode. The burst mode radar data stream may be monitored for a contactless human interaction performed by an active user. The burst mode radar data stream may be converted to a virtual continuous mode radar data stream. Health monitoring of an inactive user may be performed using the virtual continuous mode radar data stream.

title_en: Through-wall radar imaging correction method based on refracted wave static correction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a through-wall radar imaging correction method based on refracted wave static correction, which comprises the steps of firstly reading echo data of each receiving antenna to determine refracted echo time of electromagnetic waves, and obtaining propagation delay of the electromagnetic waves in an outer wall body through a basic refraction equation; then estimating the propagation delay of the electromagnetic wave in the inner wall by using the delay time difference between the adjacent transmitting antenna and the adjacent receiving antenna; and finally, sequentially adding the propagation time delays in the channels, then imaging by using a back projection algorithm, correcting the electromagnetic wave propagation abnormity generated due to the existence of the wall body, and correcting the imaged target position to a correct position.

title_en: Identification device and method for detecting buried pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recognition device and a recognition method for detecting a buried pipeline. When the ground penetrating radar protection box is transported or not used, the protection plate is pulled to be in contact with the protection box through the electric telescopic rod, so that the ground penetrating radar enters the protection box, the protection box and the protection plate can be used for protecting the ground penetrating radar, the damage caused by collision of the ground penetrating radar in the transportation process is reduced, the limiting rod is pulled upwards to drive the arc-shaped clamping block to be separated from the gear, the supporting plate is pulled to adjust the angle between the supporting plate and the battery box, and therefore a user can adjust the supporting plate and the connecting rod according to self habits.
assignees: TIANJIN SCIENCE AND TECH ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent vital sign monitoring and controlling system and method based on microwave radar
abstract_en: A vital sign intelligent monitoring control system and method based on microwave radar is characterized in that: the system comprises a Doppler human body life detection radar front end, an intelligent control end, a local control end and a remote end; the local control end comprises a controller and local hardware equipment, and the local hardware equipment comprises an intelligent home and a medical emergency system; and the intelligent control end identifies the original data acquired by the front end of the Doppler human body life detection radar and then generates human body life characteristic parameters and gesture commands. The invention carries out gesture command and human body respiration and heart rate detection based on the continuous wave radar, the front end of the Doppler radar has simple structure, the all-weather monitoring of the physiological state of the target human body is realized under the condition of no contact, and the radar electromagnetic wave technology is not influenced by the environment; the intelligent household appliance can realize the control switch and emergency help seeking of the intelligent household appliance, and can carry out voice or manual remote control.

title_en: Crab apartment device with monitoring function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a crab apartment device with monitor function, includes crab apartment, automatic monitoring device, track, support, power cord, coaster device, backup pad, controller, first servo motor, has first belt pulley device, first assembly pulley, second belt assembly pulley, second servo motor, shell, automatic telescoping device, third servo motor, screw rod, nut, telescopic link, camera device, radar life detection appearance, alarm and infrared induction remote controller. The invention has the advantages that the occupied space is small, and the occupied area of every hundred swimming crabs is less than 1 square meter on average, thereby saving resources; the camera captures the picture of each swimming crab in the crab apartment, so that the workload of managers is reduced, the working efficiency is improved, and the labor is saved; the life state of the portunids is detected in real time through a radar life detector, so that the death of the portunids is avoided, and the accurate positioning treatment is realized; the operation of the monitoring device can be controlled by the infrared of the remote controller, and the operation is simple and convenient.

title_en: Blood Pressure Meter And Method For Measuring Blood Pressure Using The Same
title_ko: 혈압 측정 시스템 및 이를 이용한 혈압 측정 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a blood pressure measurement system which calculates a blood pressure value by using biological signals measured at two different parts, and a blood pressure measurement method using the same. According to the present invention, the blood pressure measurement system comprises: a first sensor unit detecting a blood flow parameter in one part of a body; a second sensor unit detecting a blood flow parameter and arterial pressure in the other part of the body; and a control unit having a blood pressure calculation unit for calculating a blood pressure value of a part in which a first blood flow parameter is detected from the first blood flow parameter detected by the first sensor unit, a second blood flow parameter detected by the second sensor unit, and the arterial pressure. The blood pressure measurement system measures blood pressure using changes in vascular resistivity and blood pressure parameters. More specifically, the blood pressure measurement system is a sphygmomanometer which calculates the blood pressure by using the blood flow parameter detected in one part of the body, the arterial pressure detected in other part of the body, and the vascular resistivity by the blood flow parameter, thereby more accurately measuring the blood pressure of a part desired to obtain the blood pressure based on an amount of changes in the blood flow parameter and the vascular resistivity, and greatly improving reliability of the sphygmomanometer.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 서로 다른 2 부위에서 측정되는 생체 신호를 이용해서 혈압값을 산출하는 혈압 측정 시스템 및 이를 이용한 혈압 측정 방법을 개시한다. 본 발명에 따른 혈압 측정 시스템은: 신체의 일 부위에서 혈류 파라미터의 검출을 위한 제1센서부; 신체의 다른 일 부위에서 혈류 파라미터와 동맥압 측정의 검출을 위한 제2센서부; 그리고 상기 제1센서부에 의해 검출되는 제1 혈류 파라미터와 상기 제2센서부에 의해 검출되는 제2 혈류 파라미터 및 동맥압으로부터, 상기 제1 혈류 파라미터가 검출되는 부위의 혈압값을 산출하는 혈압 산출부를 갖는 제어유닛을 포함한다. 
본 발명은 혈관 저항률과 혈압 파라미터의 변화를 이용해서 혈압을 측정하는 혈압 측정 시스템, 보다 구체적으로 신체의 일 부위에서 검출되는 혈류 파라미터와 신체의 다른 일 부위에서 검출되는 동맥압과 혈류 파라미터에 의한 혈관 저항률을 이용해서 혈압을 계산하는 혈압계이므로, 혈류 파라미터 변화량과 혈관 저항률을 기반으로 혈압 획득을 원하는 부위의 혈압을 보다 정확하게 측정할 수 있고, 혈압계의 신뢰도가 크게 향상될 수 있다.

title_en: Multi-human body vital sign ultra-wideband radar monitor based on eye-shaped differential antenna
abstract_en: The invention discloses an eye-shaped differential antenna-based multi-human body vital sign ultra-wideband radar monitor, which comprises an XETHRU X4 ultra-wideband radar chip, an ultra-wideband differential transmitting antenna, an ultra-wideband differential receiving antenna and a microprocessor with a QSPI interface, wherein the XETHRU X4 ultra-wideband radar chip is positioned on the front surface of a multilayer PCB, and the ultra-wideband differential transmitting antenna and the ultra-wideband differential receiving antenna are printed on the plane of the same multilayer PCB and are respectively positioned on the left side and the right side of the XETHRU X4 ultra-wideband radar chip. The invention has the advantages of high detection sensitivity, strong anti-interference performance and capability of distinguishing multi-target human body vital signs.
assignees: SHANDONG PUTAI INFORMATION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Fire scene high-precision infrared camera
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire scene high accuracy infrared camera, which comprises a mounting seat, a cover body, a camera, an alarm, a storage battery, a mainboard, a fire prevention detection device and a main controller, wherein the camera is fixed on the upper part of the mounting seat, the cover body is arranged on the outer side of the camera and the mounting seat, a temperature sensor and a lighting lamp are arranged in the cover body, the temperature sensor is arranged for sensing the state of the environment in the range and controlling the switch of the camera, the effect of saving energy is achieved, a life detection module is arranged in the camera and comprises an infrared sensor, the infrared sensor and the temperature sensor are connected with the main controller, the camera is provided with an independent power switch, the main controller is connected with the storage battery, the main controller is connected with a wireless transmission module, and the life signs can be distinguished by infrared sensing under the environment with larger smoke after the fire occurs by the arrangement of the infrared sensor, thereby facilitating rescue and making the device more practical.
assignees: HUIFENG TIANJIN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: System for detecting underground facilities by performing hybrid multi-exploration
title_ko: 하이브리드 멀티 탐사를 실시하여 탐사율을 향상시킬 수 있는 지하시설물 탐사시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an underground facility exploring system, which comprises: an underground facility probe for exploring the depth and position of a buried underground facility using a magnetic field; a high-power probe for exploring the depth and position of the buried underground facility using a magnetic field relatively higher than that of the underground facility probe; and a ground penetrating radar (GPR) device for exploring the depth and position of the underground facility by receiving a signal reflected from the underground facility after radiating a pulse. According to the present invention, hybrid multi-exploration capable of accurate exploration through fusion of different devices, such as an underground facility probe and a GPR device is performed, thereby improving an exploration rate.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하시설물 탐사시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 자기장을 이용하여 매설된 지하시설물의 심도와 위치를 탐사하는 지하시설물탐사기, 지하시설물탐사기보다 상대적으로 높은 자기장을 이용하여 매설된 지하시설물의 심도와 위치를 탐사하는 고출력탐사기 및 펄스를 방사한 후 지하시설물에 반사된 신호를 수신하여 지하시설물의 심도와 위치를 탐사하는 지피알장비를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하여, 지하시설물탐사기와 지피알장비 등 이기종 장비의 융합을 통하여 정확한 탐사가 가능한 하이브리드 멀티 탐사를 실시하여 탐사율을 향상시킬 수 있는 지하시설물 탐사시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Signal monitoring method, device, storage medium and system
