abstract_en: The invention discloses a signal monitoring method, a device, a computer readable storage medium and a system, firstly, collecting vital sign signals of a monitored object in a non-contact mode through a millimeter wave radar chip; performing microwave signal processing on the acquired vital sign signals to obtain a monitoring result comprising vital sign frequencies; and sending the monitoring result to a cloud platform so that the cloud platform manages the monitoring result.

title_en: Intelligent search and rescue system for fire fighting
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent search and rescue system for fire fighting, which comprises intelligent fire fighting search and rescue equipment and a transmission communication system connected with the intelligent fire fighting search and rescue equipment; the intelligent fire fighting search and rescue equipment can collect and process the detected data and transmit the data to the command center in real time through the transmission communication system. The intelligent search and rescue system for fire fighting can assist the firemen to quickly finish rescue work on the premise of ensuring the self safety of the firemen in a disaster emergency rescue site; the equipment information of the individual soldier is transmitted to the vehicle-mounted control terminal in real time through the network, analysis and decision are carried out, and the analysis decision result is pushed to the individual soldier equipment so as to achieve accurate and rapid rescue and realize linkage of the individual soldier and a command center; the intelligent detection system achieves the purposes of accurate positioning of individual soldier personnel in fire rescue on site, infrared video return, intelligent identification of personnel to be rescued, voice talkback, vital signs and integrated detection of ventilator air pressure.
assignees: CHINA NAT AERO TECH HUADONG OPTOELECTRONIC CO LTD

title_en: Performance detection system and method of UWB radar life detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a performance detection system and a method of a UWB radar life detection device, wherein the detection system consists of a field simulation device, a position moving device, a vital sign simulation device and a movable interference device; placing equipment to be tested on one side of the post-disaster field simulation device, wherein one side is a life signal detection area; the position moving device is arranged in a life signal detection area of the post-disaster field simulation device; the vital sign simulation device is arranged on the position moving device; the movable interference devices are arranged in the buried vital signal detection area according to actual random. When the UWB radar life detection device is detected, the life sign simulation device moves in a life signal detection area, and detection of detection distance, field angle, angle and distance information resolution, multi-target anti-interference capability and dynamic target detection capability is completed. The invention can simulate the actual conditions of different burying depths, burying materials, a plurality of living bodies and micro-moving living bodies, thereby carrying out target two-dimensional detection on the device, having high detection precision and good applicability.

title_en: Sign contactless intelligent monitoring system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar-based physical sign contactless intelligent monitoring system, wherein a millimeter wave radar front-end module transmits and receives millimeter wave radar signals and is connected with a signal processing module; the signal processing module is connected with the communication interface module, analyzes the sampled and quantized echo signals to obtain vital sign data of a tested person, including frequency parameters of respiration and heartbeat, and transmits the processed information result to the upper computer through the communication interface module; and the upper computer compares the received vital sign data with preset data, uploads the data and comparison results to the background server, and gives an alarm to the mobile terminal if the comparison results are abnormal, and automatically gives an alarm when the comparison results exceed a preset maximum value. The intelligent monitoring system and the intelligent monitoring method realize real-time intelligent monitoring of vital signs of the old in the room, including monitoring of breathing and heartbeat parameters, and realize real-time alarm when abnormality occurs so as to prevent accidents.

title_en: Ground penetrating radar device and measurement method
abstract_en: This ground penetrating radar device 1 is moved by human power and has three wheels 11A-11 respectively having axles that are at 120 degree angles from each other and that each have an encoder 12A-12C attached thereto. A control unit 14 calculates a movement direction, movement distance, movement speed vector, and turning vector for the ground penetrating radar device 1 from the rotation amounts measured by the encoders 12A-12C. A measurement unit 15 uses radio waves to locate an object buried underground. A storage unit 17 stores a two-dimensional measurement data set associating the position information and movement direction for the ground penetrating radar device 1 calculated by the control unit 14 with measurement data from the radar measurement unit, and a display unit 18 displays, in a superimposed manner, the measurement data and an installation map that is stored in a database 16 and shows the buried position of the underground structure.

title_en: Individual soldier emergency rescue equipment with vital sign monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses individual soldier emergency rescue equipment with a vital sign monitoring system, which comprises an equipment main body, wherein a reinforcing ring is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the equipment main body, a fixing strip is arranged on one side of the equipment main body, a display screen and a buzzer are arranged on the front side of the fixing strip, a water storage tank is embedded in the bottom of the equipment main body, the water storage tank consists of a water diversion mechanism, a water absorption layer and a pull buckle, the water absorption layer is inserted into the bottom of the water storage tank, the water diversion mechanism is arranged on the upper part of the water absorption layer, the pull buckle is fixedly connected to one side of the water absorption layer, an inner cavity is arranged on the inner side of the equipment main body, a sweat detection sensor and a liquid collection rod are arranged on the side surface of the inner cavity, a monitoring system is arranged in the equipment main body, and the individual soldier emergency rescue equipment with the vital sign monitoring system is characterized, Blood pressure detection module and heart rate detection module carry out comprehensive control to temperature, blood pressure and heart rate.
assignees: THE FIRST MEDICAL CENTER CHINESE PEOPLES LIBERATION ARMY GENERAL HOSPITAL

title_en: Monitoring alarm equipment for detecting geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning equipment, in particular to a monitoring and alarming device for detecting geological disasters; including detecting box, support rack, protection box with a net, collection subassembly, solar cell panel, battery and pre-buried stake, be equipped with in the protection box with a net and detect the box and support the rack, protection box with a net bottom rigid coupling has if intervene the pile of burying, the support rack is put on the shelf and is equipped with the detection box, it is equipped with controller, alarm and battery to detect box inside, the collection subassembly includes air velocity transducer, wind direction sensor, earthquake wave sensor and soil salinity sensor, the equal rigid coupling of lateral wall all around of detection box has solar cell panel. The utility model discloses stable in structure can monitor multiple data, and powerful can in time discover geological disasters, and then early warning geological disasters.
assignees: XINJIANG VOCATIONAL & TECHNICAL COLLEGE OF COMMUNICAITONS

title_en: Life detection instrument on water
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water life detecting instrument, which belongs to the technical field of water search and rescue, and particularly relates to a water life detecting instrument, which comprises a base, a four-chamber body shield is arranged above the outer side of a tripod head, an infrared thermal imager is arranged in a chamber body above the left side of the four-chamber body shield, a low-light-level camera is arranged in a chamber body below the left side of the four-chamber body shield, a high-definition automatic focusing camera is arranged in a chamber body above the right side of the four-chamber body shield, and the infrared thermal imager, the low-light-level camera, the high-definition automatic focusing camera and a laser module are arranged in the four-chamber body shield, thereby avoiding the influence of the humid environment on the service life of the infrared thermal imager, the low-light-level camera, the high-definition automatic focusing camera and the laser module, and the infrared thermal, thereby meeting the use requirements of different scenes.
assignees: GUANGZHOU HENGWEI ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: System and method of monitoring elderly people living alone using lighting device based on IoT
title_ko: 사물인터넷 기반의 조명장치를 이용한 독거노인 모니터링 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for monitoring a senior citizen who lives along using an IoT lighting device. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the system comprises: an IoT lighting device including a lighting lamp, a motion detecting unit, a CO2 sensor, and a biosignal detecting unit; and a monitoring device including a health condition analysis unit for analyzing a health condition of a user using operation data, CO2 concentration data, and biosignal data acquired by the IoT lighting device, an alarm generating unit for generating an alarm command when the health condition analysis unit determines a situation as emergency, and a feedback providing unit for generating a feedback command corresponding to the health condition determined by the health condition analysis unit to transmit the same to the IoT lighting device. According to the present invention, a health condition can be checked in real-time using a biosignal and CO2 concentration of a senior citizen, such that rapid respond can be performed when an emergency situation occurs. In addition, real-time check and rapid response can be performed even when an emergency situation occurs during sleeping of the senior citizen.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 IoT조명장치를 이용한 독거노인 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 모니터링 시스템은, 조명등과, 동작검출부와, CO2센서와, 생체신호검출부를 구비하는 IoT조명장치; 상기 IoT조명장치에서 획득한 동작데이터, CO2농도데이터 및 생체신호데이터를 이용하여 사용자의 건강상태를 분석하는 건강상태분석부와, 상기 건강상태분석부에서 응급상황으로 판단하면 경보지령을 생성하는 경보발생부와, 상기 건강상태분석부에서 판단한 건강상태에 대응하는 피드백 지령을 생성하여 상기 IoT조명장치로 전송하는 피드백제공부를 구비하는 모니터링장치를 포함한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 독거노인의 생체신호와 CO2농도를 이용하여 건강상태를 실시간으로 확인할 수 있으므로 긴급상황이 발생하였을 때 신속하게 대처하는 것이 가능하게 된다. 또한 독거노인이 취침 중에 긴급상황이 발생하더라도 실시간으로 확인하여 신속하게 대처할 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Apparatus for detecting wake-up
title_ko: 웨이크-업 감지 장치
abstract_en: Provided is a wake-up detection device. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the wake-up detection device comprises: a sensor that detects movements and biosignals of a person; and a control part that analyzes the movements and biosignals recognized by the sensor, and determines whether the person wakes up based on a result of analyzing the movements and biosignals, wherein the control part determines a change in the heart rate of the person when transitioning from a sleeping state to a non-sleeping state, and outputs a first alarm when it is determined that the change in the heart rate and the movement of the person are increased.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 웨이크-업 감지 장치를 제공한다. 웨이크-업 감지 장치는 사람의 움직임 및 사람의 생체 신호를 감지하는 센서 및 상기 센서가 인식한 상기 움직임 및 상기 생체 신호를 분석하고, 상기 움직임 및 상기 생체 신호를 분석한 결과에 기초하여 사람이 잠에서 깨는지 여부를 판단하는 제어부를 포함하고, 상기 제어부는 수면 상태에서 비수면 상태로 전환될 때의 사람의 심박수의 변화를 판단하고, 상기 제어부는 상기 심박수의 변화 및 사람의 움직임이 증가된 것으로 판단하는 경우 제1 알람을 출력한다.

title_en: Anti-interference vital sign information extraction and separation method based on millimeter wave biological radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-interference method for extracting and separating vital sign information based on a millimeter wave biological radar; the method comprises the following steps: s1: performing time domain interference detection on the signals, and traversing and detecting whether all frequency modulation signals are interfered; s2: carrying out interference position detection on the interfered signals; s3: interference suppression and signal restoration, wherein an interference section in the interfered frequency modulation signal is suppressed and the section of signal is reconstructed; s4: detecting target vital sign information, namely detecting the position of a target and the vital sign information of the target; s5: and (4) extracting and separating vital sign information, and extracting and separating heartbeat and respiratory signals of the target. The invention can accurately find the interference position and accurately repair the interfered signal, reduces the phase noise caused by the interference, ensures that a radar system can be used in the environment with multiple interferences, improves the signal-to-noise ratio of the life signal and more accurately separates the respiration heartbeat signal.

title_en: Management system for elderly people living alone based on ultra-wideband impluse-radio
title_ko: Uwb 기반 비접촉식 임펄스 레이더 방식의 독거노인 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a UWB-based contactless impulse radar-type system for managing living-alone senior citizens. According to the present invention, the UWB-based contactless impulse radar-type system for managing living-alone senior citizens comprises: a bio-signal detection unit for detecting a reflection signal; a bio-signal calculation unit; a bio-signal comparison unit; an emergency power supply unit for supplying emergency power to a bio-signal recognition terminal; and a control unit. According to the present invention, the reliability of measurement of bio-signals can be increased.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 UWB 기반 비접촉식 임펄스 레이더 방식의 독거노인 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 건물 실내의 벽면에 생체신호 인식 단말이 설치되어, 비접촉식으로 실내에 거주하는 모니터링 대상자의 생체신호를 측정하여, 측정된 생체신호 데이터를 인터넷망을 통해 관리서버로 전송하고, 상기 관리서버에서는 상기 생체신호 데이터를 기초로 하여 관리 단말로 제어신호를 전송하도록 하는 UWB 기반 비접촉식 임펄스 레이더 방식의 독거노인 관리 시스템에 있어서, 실내 특정장소에 누워있는 모니터링 대상자의 가슴 방향으로 무선 주파수(radio frequency) 전파를 송신하고, 상기 대상자의 가슴으로부터 운전자의 심장 및 폐의 운동 변위에 따른 반사 신호를 검출하기 위한 생체신호검출부, 상기 생체신호검출부로부터 검출된 모니터링 대상자의 심장 및 폐의 운동 변위에 따른 반사 신호를 토대로 실시간으로 모니터링 대상자의 심박수 및 호흡수를 계산하는 생체신호계산부, 상기 생체신호계산부으로 계산된 실시간으로 모니터링 대상자의 심박수 및 호흡수와 기 저장된 기준 심박수 및 호흡수를 비교하는 생체신호비교부, 상기 생체신호 인식 단말로 건물내의 전원공급이 중단될 경우, 비상용 충전 배터리를 통해 상기 생체신호 인식 단말로 비상전원이 공급되도록 하는 비상전원공급부 및 상기 생체신호비교부로부터 실시간으로 운전자의 심박수 및 호흡수가 기준 심박수 및 호흡수로부터 벗어나 신체 이상 상태인 것으로 판단되는 경우, 상기 관리자 단말 또는 상기 생체 신호 인식 단말로 운전자에게 경고명령 신호를 전송하도록 제어하는 제어부를 포함하여 제공된다. 
상기와 같은 본 발명에 따르면, 신체의 생체신호를 측정하기 위한 센싱수단을 신체에 부착하거나 파지하는 등의 번거로움을 덜고, UWB를 기반으로 한 비접촉식 임펄스 레이더 방식을 이용하여 독거노인의 생체정보를 외부로 전송 및 경고할 수 있도록 하여, 모니터링 대상자의 불편함없이 관리가 이루어 질 수 있도록 하는 효과가 있다. 
또한, 지진 등의 자연재해나 화재 또는 건물내 정전으로 생체신호 인식 단말로 전원이 공급되지 않을 경우, 비상용 배터리를 통해 모니터링 대상자의 생체신호 측정이 연속적으로 이루어지도록 하여, 위급상황에서 안정적으로 관리가 이루어질 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
또한, 건물내 천정에 설치되는 생체신호 인식 단말이 탄성줄에 의해 천정에 매달리는 형태로 설치되도록 하여, 지진이나 건물 주변 열차 통행에 의해 건물의 천정으로 전달되는 진동이 생체신호 인식 단말로 전달되지 않아 위급상황에서도 생체신호 측정의 오류없이 신뢰도가 높은 관리가 이루어질 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Underground facilities detection system using gpr
title_ko: 지피알 시스템을 이용한 지하시설물 탐지시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an underground facility detection system, and more specifically, to an underground facility detection system using a ground penetrating radar (GPR) system, which is characterized by comprising: a control device generating a transceiving pulse and storing a received signal; a transmitting antenna radiating the pulse generated in the control device; a receiving antenna receiving the signal which is returned after the radiated pulse is reflected by a buried object after passing through a medium; a display unit embodying the signal acquired from the control device as an image; and a cart on which the control device, the transmitting antenna, the receiving antenna and the display unit are mounted. Therefore, an underground facility detection method is established to improve performance. Furthermore, the present invention is miniaturized and integrated to improve work efficiency and reduce fabrication costs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하시설물 탐지시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 송수신 펄스를 발생시키고 수신된 신호를 저장하는 제어장치, 상기 제어장치에서 발생한 펄스를 방사시키는 송신 안테나, 방사된 펄스가 매질을 통과한 후 매설물체에서 반사되어 돌아오는 신호를 수신하는 수신 안테나, 상기 제어장치에서 획득한 신호를 영상으로 구현하는 디스플레이부 및 상기 제어장치, 송신 안테나, 수신 안테나 및 디스플레이부가 탑재되는 카트를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하여, 지하시설물 탐측기법을 확립하여 성능을 향상시키고, 소형 일체화를 통해 작업 효율을 향상시킴과 동시에 원가를 절감할 수 있는 지피알 시스템을 이용한 지하시설물 탐지시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Respiration detector for fire control
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a respiratory detector is used in fire control. The utility model discloses in: the upper end surface and the lower end surface of the detector body are respectively provided with a lower buckle and an upper buckle; the respiratory sensor detects respiratory signals of a fireman and transmits the respiratory signals to the pre-amplification circuit, and the pre-amplification circuit amplifies the signals transmitted by the respiratory sensor and transmits the amplified signals to the signal conditioning circuit; the signal conditioning circuit processes the signal and transmits the processed signal to the main controller through the A/D conversion circuit; the main controller processes the received signal and controls the state indicator lamp; the main controller transmits the signal data to the law enforcement recorder. The utility model discloses an install respiratory sensor in the fire control full face guard and carry out real-time detection to the respiratory state of fire fighter, the signal that respiratory sensor gathered is transmitted to main control unit after preamplification circuit, signal conditioning circuit are handled, main control unit passes through communication module and law enforcement record appearance and monitoring center are connected; thereby ensuring the monitoring and protection of firemen in the fire-fighting and disaster-relief site.
assignees: HEFEI HUAKE ELECTRONIC TECHNICAL RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Rapid Gaussian gridding non-uniform FFT through-wall imaging radar BP method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid Gaussian gridding non-uniform FFT through-wall imaging radar BP method, which comprises the following steps: establishing a through-wall radar detection scene model, arranging antenna array elements parallel to a wall body, transmitting electromagnetic waves, and uniformly sampling an obtained target echo signal to obtain echo signal data e; gridding pixel points in the imaging area of the through-wall radar, projecting echo signal data onto each pixel point grid in the imaging area to obtain an amplitude value I (x) of a BP imaging pixel point of the through-wall radar p ,y p ) (ii) a Constructing an expression of the non-uniform FFT, and pre-calculating and storing each coefficient in the expression of the non-uniform FFT; transforming uniformly sampled data to non-uniformly sampled data, pair I (x) p ,y p ) And (4) performing fast Gaussian gridding non-uniform FFT calculation and accumulating to obtain a radar imaging graph. The invention can effectively reduce the calculation complexity while ensuring the imaging quality, and solves the problem that the calculation amount of the BP method is along with the working frequencyThe number of points, antennas and pixel points are increased.

title_en: Mine geological environment monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mine geological environment monitoring devices. In the monitoring device, a soil pressure monitoring device, a vibration sensor and a camera are all positioned on the same monitoring section in a monitoring area; the soil pressure monitoring device is buried below the ground surface to a set depth, the vibration sensor is fixed at the ground surface, the lower end of the fixing device is buried below the ground surface, the upper end of the fixing device is located above the ground surface, and the camera is fixed at the top end of the fixing device; the data output end of the soil pressure monitoring device, the data output end of the vibration sensor and the data output end of the camera are connected to the lower computer; the lower computer transmits data to the upper computer of the monitoring center through the data transceiver; and the upper computer of the monitoring center is used for determining geological environment data of a monitoring area according to the monitoring data of the soil pressure monitoring device, the monitoring data of the vibration sensor and the monitoring data of the camera. The utility model discloses can the geological environment in real-time supervision mine, avoid causing personnel's damage because the geological disasters in mine.

title_en: Sensing Catheter
abstract_en: To provide a vascular access device, and associated system and method.SOLUTION: A catheter system can include a catheter including a catheter lumen having a proximal end, a distal end, a luminal surface, and an outer luminal surface. The catheter can also include first and second electrodes. A blood sensor can communicate with the first and second electrodes. The distal end of the catheter lumen can be inserted into a blood vessel of a patient in the following manner: (1) At least part of the first and second electrodes is buried in the blood vessel of the patient. (2) The first and second electrodes communicate with each other through the blood present in the blood vessel of the patient. (3) The blood sensor detects insertion of the distal end of the catheter lumen into the blood vessel of the patient by sensing at least one characteristic associated with the blood present in the blood vessel of the patient.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1A

title_en: Underground pipeline buried depth estimation method based on ground penetrating radar and three-dimensional velocity spectrum
abstract_en: The invention provides an underground pipeline buried depth estimation method based on a ground penetrating radar and a three-dimensional velocity spectrum. The invention solves the problem that the traditional special pipeline exploring instrument can only detect metal pipelines when detecting the urban underground pipelines.

title_en: Magnetic resonance imaging system
abstract_en: The present application relates to a magnetic resonance imaging system. The magnetic resonance imaging system comprises: the system comprises a scanning bed, a magnetic resonance scanner, a non-contact motion monitoring unit and computer equipment; a magnetic resonance scanner is formed with a scan bore having a scan field of view; the scanning bed is used for carrying a subject and moving the subject into a scanning visual field; the magnetic resonance scanner and the scanning bed are respectively connected with the computer equipment; the computer equipment is used for controlling the movement of the scanning bed, controlling the magnetic resonance scanner to acquire the magnetic resonance data of the examinee and reconstructing a magnetic resonance image according to the magnetic resonance data; the non-contact motion monitoring unit comprises a frequency modulation continuous wave sensor, and the frequency modulation continuous wave sensor is connected with computer equipment. Through the method and the device, the problem that a motion monitoring system in the related technology cannot monitor the posture change information of the examinee and the physiological motion generated due to the vital signs at the same time is solved, and the posture change information of the examinee and the physiological motion generated due to the vital signs can be monitored at the same time.
assignees: SHANGHAI UNITED IMAGING MEDICAL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Heart beat respiration detection method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heartbeat respiration detection method and device and a processor. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: sending a detection signal to a detection object through a packaged antenna, and receiving a feedback signal returned by the detection object through a radar of the packaged antenna; and determining the heartbeat signal and the respiration signal of the detection object through an analysis algorithm according to the feedback signal. The invention solves the technical problems of lower efficiency, inconvenient use and complex operation of the related technology in the modes of respectively adopting the breathing machine and the electrocardiogram equipment to collect breath and heartbeat.

title_en: Method, device and system for learning and imaging ultra-wideband through-wall radar and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to a method, a device and a system for learning and imaging of an ultra-wideband through-wall radar and a readable storage medium, wherein the method is used for acquiring echo scattering data of a hidden target; removing wall echoes and noise of the echo scattering data; constructing a fast operator of Fourier transform according to a diffraction tomography algorithm; constructing a compressed sensing sparse reconstruction model based on the echo scattering data and the fast Fourier transform operator; and a sparse reconstruction iterative algorithm is expanded into a multilayer neural network structure, and the hyper-parameters in the network model are trained through a training data set. According to the invention, by randomly down-sampling the echo data, the frequency domain data acquisition amount of the system is greatly reduced, and the data acquisition time of the system is reduced; reducing the memory required by the operation of the algorithm by constructing a fast operator of Fourier transform; by driving the hyper-parameters of the intelligent learning network model through data, the calculation complexity is reduced, the limitation of iteration time consumption of a sparse reconstruction method is avoided, and the imaging quality is improved.

title_en: Rotatable distributed radar life detection positioning equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotatable distributed radar life detection location is equipped, including solitary radar unit more than two, every be provided with a rotary mechanism on the radar unit, let solitary radar unit rotate with the direction of adjustment antenna polarization round the fixed axle through rotary mechanism. The utility model has the advantages of simple structure, easy and simple to handle, application scope are wide, can realize searching for fast on a large scale and full polarization target detection etc.

title_en: Distributed radar life detection positioning equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a distributing type radar life detection location is equipped, it includes: the life detection module comprises more than two radar units to form a network, and each radar unit comprises a transmitting unit and a receiving unit and can work independently; and the GPS positioning time service module is used for receiving GPS communication, positioning the position of each radar unit in real time, and using the GPS signal as a time sequence trigger signal of each radar unit to realize time sequence synchronization of each radar unit. And the WIFI signal transmission module is used for performing wireless transmission of radar detection data and issuing a control instruction. The utility model has the advantages of simple structure, convenient operation, wider coverage, wider detection range and the like.

title_en: Telescopic distributed radar life detection positioning equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a telescopic distributing type radar life detection location is equipped, including the radar unit more than two, adjacent two link to each other through a telescopic machanism between the radar unit, telescopic machanism is used for drawing big or reducing adjacent two distance between the radar unit. The utility model has the advantages of simple structure, easy and simple to handle, application scope are wide, can realize multi-mode detection etc.

title_en: All-Direction High-Resolution Subsurface Imaging Using Distributed Moving Transceivers
abstract_en: A subsurface imaging technique using distributed sensors is introduced. Instead of monostatic transceivers employed in conventional ground penetrating radars, the proposed technique utilizes bi-static transceivers to sample the reflected signals from the ground at different positions and create a large two-dimensional aperture for high resolution subsurface imaging. The coherent processing of the samples in the proposed imaging method eliminates the need for large antenna arrays for obtaining high lateral resolution images. In addition, it eliminates the need for sampling on a grid which is a time-consuming task in imaging using ground penetration radar. Imaging results show that the method can provide high-resolution images of the buried targets using only samples of the reflected signals on a circle with the center at the transmitter location.

title_en: Out-of-plane stiffness variable metal damper with earthquake monitoring function
abstract_en: The invention relates to an out-of-plane stiffness variable metal damper with an earthquake monitoring function. The invention comprises an energy consumption metal plate, a friction plate, a first box type long support, a second box type long support, a box type short support, a sensor, a high-strength bolt, a nut, a gasket, a pre-buried connecting steel plate, a connecting bending-resistant steel plate, a threaded bolt hole, an anchoring piece, a shearing-resistant bolt, a bending-resistant bolt and pre-buried I-shaped steel. The damper is arranged in a structural member, does not bear the initial gravity load of the structure, can provide out-of-plane rigidity for the energy-consuming metal plate, detects the damage condition of the damper by using a sensor when the damper is subjected to vibration load, is convenient to replace by adopting full-bolt connection, and improves the overall performance of the damper by adopting bending-shearing separation control of a damper support and an embedded member.

title_en: Apparatus for measuring vital signs
abstract_en: Disclosed is an apparatus for battery-free measuring vital signs of a user from a single position near the user influenced by an alternating electric field provided by an electronic device. The apparatus includes a first electronic circuitry, a second electronic circuitry stacked to the first electronic circuitry, an instrumentation amplifier for amplifying the signals, an analog/digital converting logic circuit for generating digitized information, and a communication unit for communicating the digitized information. The first electronic circuitry includes a first electrode for receiving vital signals (acoustic, mechanical, electrical signals) from the user's body, a first shield unit for shielding the first electrode from electrical influences and influenced by the alternating electric field provided by the electronic device, a first rectifier for harvesting and rectifying the received alternating electric field from the first shield unit, further the first rectifier provides DC energy, a first buffer stores the DC energy and provides differential voltages, a first programmable operational amplifier amplifies the amplitude of the received vital signs powered by the received differential voltage from the first buffer.

title_en: High safe type radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of radar detection instruments, in particular to a high-safety radar life detection instrument, which comprises a base and a detection instrument body, wherein the top of the base is fixedly connected with the bottom of the detection instrument body through a plurality of first telescopic rods, a plurality of first telescopic rods are all sleeved with damping springs, the two ends of each damping spring are respectively fixedly connected with the detection instrument body and the base, a plurality of cavities are arranged in the base, a screw rod is rotatably connected in each cavity, a first gear is fixedly sleeved on the screw rod, a second gear meshed with the first gear is arranged in each cavity, the second gear is rotatably connected to a transmission rod, one end of the transmission rod penetrates through the inner wall of each cavity and is fixedly connected with a knob, and the radar life detection instrument can be freely adjusted according to the use requirement through the arrangement of a plurality of adjusting mechanisms, therefore, the placing efficiency and the detection accuracy of the radar life detection instrument are improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU YIJIE SHANLIAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact vital sign detection device
abstract_en: A non-contact vital sign detection device comprises an antenna module, a radar module, a control module, a display module and a power supply module; the radar module is connected with the antenna module and the control module, the display module is connected with the control module, and the power supply module is connected with the radar module, the control module and the display module. This novel life detection to stranded personnel in the calamity accident has accuracy, reliability scheduling problem, provides a novel non-contact vital sign detection device, and the device is through acquireing the radar data who carries stranded personnel heartbeat, breathing and micro-motion signal, can be accurate, effectual discernment stranded personnel vital sign condition to reach the purpose that stranded personnel vital sign detected accuracy and reliability in improving the calamity accident.
assignees: SHENYANG FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Mask apparatus and controlling method thereof
title_ko: 마스크 장치 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mask apparatus and a control method therefor. The present invention relates to a mask apparatus and a control method for controlling the same, wherein the mask apparatus comprises: a mask body which is in close contact with the face of a user, and has an inner surface covering the nose and mouth of the user and an outer surface exposed to an external space; an air cleaner which is connected to the mask body and is formed with an inlet port for introducing external air and an air flow hole for allowing the air introduced through the inlet port to flow into the inner surface of the mask body; and a respiration sensor which is arranged on a flow path between the inner surface and the outer surface of the mask body and senses the amount of respiration that flows through the air cleaner. According to the present invention, a flow of air can be adjusted to be suitable for the user′s respiration condition through the respiration sensor arranged in the flow path between the inner surface and the outer surface of the mask body, and an automatic respiration sensing-based fan operation allows the user′s respiration to be more comfortable compared to a static pressure-type operation.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 마스크 장치 및 그 제어 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 사용자의 얼굴에 밀착되고, 사용자의 코와 입을 커버하는 내면과 외부 공간으로 노출되는 외면을 가지는 마스크 몸체; 마스크 몸체에 연결되고, 외부 공기가 유입되는 흡입구와 흡입구로 유입된 공기를 마스크 몸체의 내면으로 유동되도록 하는 공기 유동홀이 형성되는 에어클리너; 및 마스크 몸체의 내면과 외면 사이의 유로에 배치되고, 에어클리너를 통과하여 유동하는 호흡량을 감지하는 호흡 센서를 포함하는 마스크 장치와 이를 제어하는 제어 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 마스크 몸체의 내면과 외면 사이의 유로에 배치된 호흡 센서를 통해 사용자의 호흡 상태에 맞게 공기의 유동을 조절할 수 있으며,자동식 호흡 감지 기반 FAN 동작으로써 정압식 방식에 비해 고객의 호흡을 편안하게 해줄 수 있다.

title_en: Method, system and electronic equipment for removing static background and trend items of life detection radar echo signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and electronic equipment for removing static background and trend items of a life detection radar echo signal, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring life detection radar echo data and acquiring an original echo matrix; taking the maximum value position of each column in the obtained original echo matrix as a segmentation marking point; segmenting each row of the original echo matrix; then, fitting by using a polynomial to obtain static background and trend item estimation; and subtracting the static background and the trend item estimation by using the original echo matrix to obtain an enhanced signal matrix. The method can accurately estimate the signal trend term introduced by the instability of radar hardware, and can effectively reduce the influence of non-stationary interference on the target signal.

title_en: Complex procedure apparatus using galvanic and plasma
title_ko: 갈바닉 및 플라즈마를 이용한 복합 시술 장치
abstract_en: A complex procedure apparatus is disclosed. According to one aspect of the present invention, provided is a complex procedure apparatus, comprising: a main body where a grip portion, capable of being gripped by a user, is formed; a plasma generating portion installed on one side of the main body to generate plasma; a galvanic current generating portion installed on one side of the main body to generate a galvanic current; a biosignal measuring sensor installed on the other side of the main body to measure a user′s biosignal by the user′s grip; and a control portion for controlling the operation of the plasma generating portion and the galvanic current generating portion.
abstract_ko: 복합 시술 장치가 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 측면에 따르면, 사용자가 파지 가능한 파지부가 형성되는 본체,본체의 일측에 설치되어 플라즈마를 발생시키는 플라즈마 발생부, 본체의 일측에 설치되어 갈바닉 전류를 발생시키는 갈바닉 발생부, 본체의 타측에 설치되어 사용자의 파지에 의해 사용자의 생체신호를 측정하는 생체신호 측정 센서, 및 플라즈마 발생부 및 갈바닉 발생부의 작동을 제어하는 제어부를 포함하는 복합 시술 장치가 제공된다.

title_en: Biological signal measurement apparatus and system
title_ko: 생체신호 측정 장치 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a biological signal measurement device and a system thereof. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the biosignal measurement device includes: at least one EEG sensor for measuring an EEG signal of a user in contact with a user′s head; and a Bluetooth module for receiving the EEG signal measured by the EEG sensor, transmitting the EEG signal to a preset terminal, and receiving a sound source transmitted from the terminal. The Bluetooth module consists of a first means for processing the measured EEG signal and providing the measured EEG signal to the Bluetooth module, a second means for processing the received sound source, and a one-chip, wherein the Bluetooth module may receive the EEG signal through a receiving terminal connected to a microphone and transmit the EEG signal to the terminal. According to the present invention, it is possible to provide a user′s electroencephalogram signal (EEG signal) measured using the single Bluetooth module, and to provide a customized sound source according to a measurement result, as well as interpretation information on the measurement result to the user.
abstract_ko: 생체신호 측정 장치 및 그 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 생체신호 측정 장치는 사용자의 두상에 접촉하여 상기 사용자의 뇌파 신호를 측정하기 위한 적어도 하나의 뇌파 측정 센서; 및 상기 뇌파 측정 센서에서 측정한 뇌파 신호를 수신하여 미리 설정된 단말기로 전송하고, 상기 단말기로부터 전송된 음원을 수신하는 블루투스 모듈을 포함하고, 상기 블루투스 모듈은 상기 측정된 뇌파 신호를 처리하여 상기 블루투스 모듈로 제공하기 위한 제1 수단 및 상기 수신된 음원을 처리하기 위한 제2 수단과 원칩으로 구성되며, 상기 블루투스 모듈은 마이크와 연결되는 수신 단자를 통해 상기 뇌파 신호를 수신하여 상기 단말기로 전송할 수 있다.

title_en: Mask apparatus and controlling method thereof
title_ko: 마스크 장치 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mask device and a method for controlling the same. According to the present invention, the mask device includes: a mask body coming into close contact with a user′s face and having an inner surface covering the user′s nose and mouth and an outer surface exposed to an outer space; an air cleaner connected to the mask body, and having a suction port for the outside air to flow in and an air flow hole allowing the air flown in through the suction port to flow to the inner surface of the mask body; and a respiration sensor disposed on a flow path between the inner surface and the outer surface of the mask body and detecting the amount of respiration flowing through the air cleaner. According to the present invention, the air flow can be adjusted in accordance with the state of respiration of the user using the respiration sensor disposed on the flow path between the inner surface and the outer surface of the mask body. In addition, a customer′s respiration can become comfortable, as compared with a static pressure method, by the fan operation based on automatic respiration detection.

본 발명에 따르면, 사용자의 얼굴에 밀착되고, 사용자의 코와 입을 커버하는 내면과 외부 공간으로 노출되는 외면을 가지는 마스크 몸체; 마스크 몸체에 연결되고, 외부 공기가 유입되는 흡입구와 흡입구로 유입된 공기를 마스크 몸체의 내면으로 유동되도록 하는 공기 유동홀이 형성되는 에어클리너; 및 마스크 몸체의 내면과 외면 사이의 유로에 배치되고, 에어클리너를 통과하여 유동하는 호흡량을 감지하는 호흡 센서를 포함하는 마스크 장치와 이를 제어하는 제어 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Systems and methods for mapping manmade objects buried in subterranean surfaces using an unmanned aerial vehicle integrated with radar sensor equipment
abstract_en: A method for mapping an object buried in a subterranean surface includes receiving a first input data set. The first input data set is based on a GNSS signal, a SAR signal, and a GPR signal. The method further includes generating a raw image based on the first input data set, comparing the raw image to a calibration data set, identifying an object based on the raw image compared to the calibration data set, transmitting object data to a ground-based post-processing unit, and displaying the object data to a graphic user interface. The calibration data set may be based on material calibration data. The object data may be based on the object identified.

title_en: Device and method for assessing, predicting and operating user's health in real time
abstract_en: Exemplary embodiments of the present disclosure are directed towards a medical device for assessing, and predicting and operating the user's health by capturing the user's vital signs in real time. The medical device comprises a plurality of electrodes and a plurality of sensors positioned on various finger sheaths, wrist portions, and hand portions. The various finger sheaths, the wrist portions, and the hand portions are configured to allow the plurality of electrodes to detect a plurality of electrical potentials on different surfaces of a user's body parts and the plurality of sensors to collect vital signs on different surfaces of a user's body parts, at least one processing device configured to contact with the plurality of electrodes and the plurality of sensors, the plurality of electrodes and the plurality of sensors configured to transmit the detected plurality of electrical potentials and the plurality of vital signs from the different surfaces of the user's body parts to the processing device. The processing device configured to store the plurality of electrical potentials and the plurality of vital signs and process the detected plurality of electrical potentials and the plurality of vital signs to assess a user's health and an end user device configured to receive the plurality of processed electrical potentials and the plurality of vital signs form the processing device through a network.

title_en: A method and system for monitoring vital signs of an infant
abstract_en: An infant monitoring system combines an infant soother having a sensor for detecting the location or sucking motion of the soother and a vital signs sensor for providing a vital signs sensor output. The vital signs sensor output is interpreted taking account of the sensing of the soother. In this way, it can be prevented that a soother sucking motion is incorrectly interpreted as a different vital signs measurement (such as heart rate or respiration rate) or otherwise corrupts the vital signs measurement.

title_en: Life body feature detection and identification method for rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a life body characteristic detection and identification method for a rescue robot, which is used for solving the technical problem that rescue fails due to complex environment of the existing rescue robot. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing an O-shaped detection area by taking the position of a rescue robot as a starting point, and starting an obstacle avoidance system of the rescue robot; secondly, performing rescue scanning on the O-shaped detection area by using a carbon dioxide detector to obtain a target point set; then, performing target detection on the target point set by using an infrared detector, and determining a target point to be rescued; and finally, identifying a target point to be rescued by using the radar life detector in a third stage, determining the specific position of the rescuers, sending a distress signal by using a controller of the rescue robot, and timely informing rescue workers of rescuing. According to the invention, multiple detectors are combined, so that the identification precision is improved, the rescue time is shortened, and the rescue robot has the capability of efficiently and accurately detecting the vital signs of a human body.

title_en: Vital sign detection method and device based on periodic characteristics and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a vital sign detection method, a device and a storage medium based on periodic characteristics, and the vital sign detection method based on the periodic characteristics comprises the following steps: sending radar signals to a region to be detected, and receiving radar echo signals returned by the region to be detected; performing signal preprocessing on the radar echo signal, and determining the state of a human body target in the region to be detected; if a human body target exists in the area to be detected, extracting vital sign data with periodic characteristics from radar echo signals of the area to be detected based on the periodic characteristics of the vital sign data; and carrying out data processing on the vital sign data with the periodic characteristics to obtain a vital sign detection result with the periodic characteristics. The vital sign detection method, the device and the storage medium based on the periodic characteristics, disclosed by the embodiment of the application, improve the detection precision of vital sign data.

title_en: Fire engine operation place of ascending a height
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire fighting truck ascending operation site, which comprises a turf, planting soil, grass planting grids, a plain soil layer, a gravel cushion layer and a base layer which are arranged from top to bottom in sequence; planting soil is paved in the grass planting grids, the thickness of the planting soil is higher than that of the grass planting grids, an anti-seepage film is paved on the base layer, the gravel cushion layer is positioned on the anti-seepage film, a drainage blind pipe is buried at the bottom end of the gravel cushion layer, and the drainage blind pipe is communicated with a water tank positioned in the gravel cushion layer; the inside soil moisture sensor that is equipped with of planting soil, be equipped with in the water tank and pierce through the turf, planting soil, plant the grass check, plain soil layer, be equipped with the water pump on the spray pipe and the spray pipe of rubble bed course, the outside cover of water pump has the protective housing, through being equipped with drainage blind pipe and water tank, be equipped with the prevention of seepage membrane in the basic unit, can retrieve the water of rubble bed course, when needs irrigate the turf, utilize the water pump to draw water from the water tank, irrigate the turf, realize the reuse to water, save the water resource.

title_en: Respiration detection and mode classification method based on FMCW radar
abstract_en: A breathing detection and mode classification method based on FMCW radar relates to the technical field of vital sign detection. The invention aims to solve the problem that the results cannot be classified by measuring vital signs in the existing radar mode. The method comprises the steps of firstly, acquiring data through an FMCW radar system, and separating and extracting respiration and heartbeat signals through data calculation to realize non-contact measurement of vital signs; secondly, calculating an energy spectrum and a threshold value of respiration at each time interval by using a rectangular window, and comparing the two values to realize accurate judgment of apnea; finally, extracting a peak value, a valley value and a difference value of the peak value and the valley value by respectively using a VPD peak searching algorithm; calculating the average value and standard deviation of the normalized short-time energy; and extracting the average value, the standard deviation and the minimum value of the instantaneous frequency by using HHT, and finally classifying the extracted characteristic values by using an SVM (support vector machine) and a K-proximity algorithm, thereby realizing the effective identification of various respiratory modes.

title_en: Highway soft soil foundation prefabricated friction type pile and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a friction type pile and a method for prefabricating a soft soil foundation on a highway, which comprises the following steps: the pile body, dynamometer and spacing pipe connected with the pile body; the limiting pipe is internally used for placing a limiting sheet, the dynamometer passes through the limiting pipe to enable a force measuring point to be in a region to be measured, and the dynamometer is limited or opened by adjusting the position of the limiting sheet; piles need to be buried in an danger zone, but whether the piles provide required stress cannot be determined, the precast piles can be monitored and repaired in time, and the safety factor of a foundation pit is greatly improved; compared with the traditional method for measuring the pile body stress, the method has the advantages that the measuring depth can be greatly deepened by arranging the sensor inside, and the installation is convenient without the guidance of technicians on workers; whether the pile body is broken or not can be analyzed in advance through data so as to prevent engineering disasters.

title_en: Life detection system and search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle based on life detection function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection system and a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle based on a life detection function, wherein the life detection system comprises a radar imaging module, a thermal imaging module, a video recording module, a feedback module, a control module, a power supply module and a throwing component for throwing a positioning instrument; the radar imaging module, the thermal imaging module and the video recording module are all electrically connected with the feedback module; the feedback module, the releasing assembly and the power supply module are all electrically connected with the control module. The control module is used for controlling the power supply module to supply power to the radar imaging module, the thermal imaging module, the video recording module and the putting component, and simultaneously controlling the feedback module to receive information fed back by the radar imaging module, the thermal imaging module and the video recording module, analyze the received information and transmit the information back to the control center; by the scheme of the invention, the life of the flight area can be effectively detected and recorded in real time.

title_en: Individual soldier emergency rescue equipment with vital sign monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses individual soldier emergency rescue equipment with a vital sign monitoring system, which comprises an equipment main body, wherein a reinforcing ring is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the equipment main body, a fixing strip is arranged on one side of the equipment main body, a display screen and a buzzer are arranged on the front side of the fixing strip, a water storage tank is embedded in the bottom of the equipment main body, the water storage tank consists of a water diversion mechanism, a water absorption layer and a pull buckle, the water absorption layer is inserted into the bottom of the water storage tank, the water diversion mechanism is arranged on the upper part of the water absorption layer, the pull buckle is fixedly connected to one side of the water absorption layer, an inner cavity is arranged on the inner side of the equipment main body, a sweat detection sensor and a liquid collection rod are arranged on the side surface of the inner cavity, a monitoring system is arranged in the equipment main body, and the individual soldier emergency rescue equipment with the vital sign monitoring system is characterized, Blood pressure detection module and heart rate detection module carry out comprehensive control to temperature, blood pressure and heart rate.
assignees: THE FIRST MEDICAL CENTER CHINESE PEOPLES LIBERATION ARMY GENERAL HOSPITAL

title_en: Protective clothing based on flexible sensor
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a protective clothing based on flexible sensor, which comprises a coat for upper body protection, trousers for leg protection and a head cover for head and neck protection, wherein the coat, the trousers and the head cover are arranged in an integrated manner, the coat comprises two groups of sleeves for arm protection and a coat main body for chest and back protection, and the two groups of sleeves are integrally connected with the coat main body; still include the data acquisition subassembly, the data acquisition subassembly is including the flexible gas sensor that is used for gaseous composition to gather, the flexible humidity transducer that is used for air humidity to gather, the flexible temperature sensor that is used for the collection of regional interior temperature and the flexible inductance formula sensor that is used for vital sign to gather. The utility model discloses can realize carrying out data acquisition with the form of wearing to the condition of surrounding environment to can detect fire fighter's vital sign, with the condition in the fire fighter place region is known to the command center of being convenient for, the command center of being convenient for formulates the rescue scheme.

title_en: Small micro-motion object detector, method and biological radar sensor for hiding in cabin
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of aviation safety detection, and discloses a small micro-motion object detector, a method and a biological radar sensor for cabin hiding, wherein the small micro-motion object detector for cabin hiding is used for collecting vital sign information of small micro-animals, and the number of JC122 biological radar sensors for cabin hiding small micro-motion object detection is 10; the small micro-motion object detector comprises: JC122 biological radar sensor, signal preprocessing and multipath information synthesis module, signal equalization processing module, little micro-motion object vital sign information extraction module, information enhancement module, wireless data transmission module, PDA software intelligent discrimination equipment, adopt the lithium ion battery to supply power. The invention synchronously detects a plurality of pieces at one time, thereby improving the working efficiency; meanwhile, the method can indicate the region of the small micro-animals in the cabin, realize the horizontal omnibearing detection of the 2X 10 meter long-distance vital sign information, and meet the detection and use requirements of various airplanes.

title_en: GNSS and gyroscope fused high-precision geological disaster monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a high-precision geological disaster monitoring system with GNSS and gyroscope integrated, which comprises a plurality of monitoring stations arranged at monitoring points, wherein each monitoring station comprises a positioning monitoring pile and a plurality of sensors buried underground, the positioning monitoring pile comprises a positioning component, a pile body and a control component, the positioning component comprises a gyroscope, a GNSS antenna and a circuit board, the circuit board comprises an OEM board and an MEMS accelerometer, the GNSS antenna is connected with the OEM board to receive positioning information of a satellite navigation system, the control component comprises a storage battery, a data acquisition front end, a data conversion circuit, an MCU data processing circuit and a communication module, the data acquisition front end acquires the positioning information of the sensors buried underground, the gyroscope, the MEMS accelerometer and the satellite navigation system, data is transmitted to an operation center through the communication module, the operation center calculates monitoring results, and the monitoring large screen displays field monitoring results, and sending the early warning alarm information and the early warning place geographic coordinate information to terminal equipment of related management personnel.

title_en: Health monitoring system and method for gymnasium bracelet
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of monitoring and control, and discloses a health monitoring system and a method for a gymnasium bracelet, the system comprises a control center and a bracelet information acquisition end which are in signal connection with each other through a communication module, the bracelet information acquisition end consists of a sensor and a processor, the sensor is connected with the processor, the sensor detects vital sign information of a sporter during sports, the processor receives the vital sign information of the sporter during sports detected by the sensor, compares, analyzes and processes the sports vital sign data of the sporter stored in the control center, judges whether the sporter exceeds a sports vital sign data safety threshold value, judges whether the sporter continues to move and gives an alarm, the alarm information is output by the processor, and the control center receives the alarm information sent by the processor, the invention comprehensively monitors the vital sign information of the sporter during sports in the gymnasium, and the monitoring center can be informed to process abnormal conditions in time when abnormal conditions occur in the vital sign information of the sporter, so that accidents are prevented.
assignees: SICHUAN HUAYOU ENTERPRISE MAN SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Through-wall detection radar with autonomous movement capability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall detection radar with automatic movement energy, which comprises a guide post, a motor and a clamping plate, wherein a chute is formed in one side of the guide post, a linkage block is movably connected in the chute, a connecting rod is fixedly connected to one side of the linkage block, and one side of the connecting rod is connected with an organism; the machine body is connected with a butt joint column on one side far away from the connecting rod, a first sliding block is connected on one side far away from the machine body, a sliding bead is connected on one side of the first sliding block, and a bidirectional screw rod is movably connected on one side of the sliding bead. This wear wall detection radar with independently remove ability, organism one side is connected with two-way lead screw through butt joint post, first slider and sliding bead, drives two-way lead screw and rotates when the motor rotates, and the sliding bead can remove along the orbit of the notch of two-way lead screw when two-way lead screw rotates to make the sliding bead drive the organism through first slider and butt joint post and remove, just so the organism just can realize automatic movement's function when using.

title_en: Earthquake trapped personnel search unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an unmanned air vehicle technique field provides an earthquake stranded personnel search unmanned aerial vehicle, include the main part and locate first wing in the main part, be equipped with first radar life detection instrument in the main part, there is the cabin in the main part, be equipped with mini unmanned aerial vehicle in the cabin, be equipped with second radar life detection instrument on the mini unmanned aerial vehicle. The utility model discloses an earthquake trapped personnel search unmanned aerial vehicle, through adopting unmanned aerial vehicle to cooperate with radar life detection instrument to search for and rescue work, more flexible and convenient than depending on manpower or searching for and rescuing dogs; the mini unmanned aerial vehicle is arranged in the cabin of the main body, so that the mini unmanned aerial vehicle can enter a narrow space to perform search and rescue work, and more places can be searched and rescued conveniently; the switching of four wings and six wings is realized through the bracket group; the main body can not contact the ground when the unmanned aerial vehicle lands on the ground by adopting the support frame; the main body is provided with the heat dissipation holes, so that heat dissipation of electronic components in the main body can be facilitated; the current environment condition can be transmitted in real time by arranging the infrared camera.

title_en: Module for measuring bio information
title_ko: 생체정보 측정모듈
abstract_en: Disclosed is a bio information measuring module. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the bio information measuring module may include a finger contact interface, a bio sensor, a force sensor, and a support. The finger contact interface is operated by contact force applied by coming in contact with a finger of a user. The bio sensor measures a bio signal in a state where the finger comes in contact with the finger contact interface. The force sensor measures the contact force of the finger applied to the finger contact interface. The support guides an operation of the finger contact interface for the force sensor to support the finger contact interface.
abstract_ko: 생체정보 측정모듈이 개시된다. 일 실시예에 따른 생체정보 측정모듈은 핑거 접촉 인터페이스와, 생체센서와, 힘 센서, 및 서포트를 포함할 수 있다. 핑거 접촉 인터페이스는 사용자의 손가락이 접촉되어 가해지는 접촉력에 의해 동작한다. 생체센서는 핑거 접촉 인터페이스에 손가락이 접촉된 상태에서 사용자의 생체신호를 측정한다. 힘 센서는 핑거 접촉 인터페이스에 가해지는 손가락의 접촉력을 측정한다. 서포트는 힘 센서를 핑거 접촉 인터페이스에 대해 지지한 상태로 핑거 접촉 인터페이스의 동작을 가이드한다.

title_en: Image biological physiological signal pairing method and physiological signal pairing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a physiological signal matching method of an image organism, which can correctly match a plurality of vital signs contained in a physiological signal measured by a radar to each organism in an image by matching the image auxiliary physiological signal captured by an image capturing device, thereby continuously tracking the vital signs of the plurality of organisms.

title_en: Respiration detection using radar
abstract_en: One or more radar sensors can be used to monitor patients in a variety of different environments and embodiments. In one embodiment, radar sensors can be used to monitor a patient's breathing, including monitoring of tidal volume, chest expansion distance, breathing rate, etc. In another embodiment, a patient position can be monitored in a patient bed, which can be used as feedback for control of bladders of a patient bed. Additional embodiments are described herein.

title_en: Speech-based fire fighting channel monitoring device for property management
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire control passageway monitoring device for property management based on pronunciation relates to fire-fighting equipment technical field. The utility model discloses a pre-buried pole, high definition camera, photovoltaic power generation subassembly, control controller and speaker, pre-buried pole bury underground in one side of outdoor fire control passageway, and cantilever bar is installed to upper portion one side of pre-buried pole, and the one end that pre-buried pole was kept away from to the pole of encorbelmenting installs the high definition camera. The utility model discloses a set up speaker and infrared inductor, the speaker passes through the signal receiving and dispatching antenna and is connected with remote control's monitor, can realize long-range propaganda directed to communicate, avoids the fire control through occupied, and infrared inductor can carry out the auto-induction to vehicle in through the fire control passageway, stops when reaching 2 minutes in the fire control passageway when the vehicle, will trigger alarm program and report to the police to the monitor, has solved current technical function singleness, and the monitoring efficiency is low, the big problem of personnel working strength.

title_en: Radar vital signal tracking using a Kalman filter
abstract_en: In an embodiment, a method includes: receiving reflected radar signals with a millimeter-wave radar; generating a displacement signal indicative of a displacement of a target based on the reflected radar signals; filtering the displacement signal using a bandpass filter to generate a filtered displacement signal; determining a first rate indicative of a heartbeat rate of the target based on the filtered displacement signal; tracking a second rate indicative of the heartbeat rate of the target with a track using a Kalman filter; updating the track based on the first rate; and updating a setting of the bandpass filter based on the updated track.

title_en: Detection device, method and system for vital signs
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a device, a method and a system for detecting vital signs, wherein the device comprises: the first calculation unit is used for calculating the phase distribution of the distance FFT signal of the position of the living body along with the change of time according to the reflected signal of the microwave radar in a first preset time range; an unwrapping unit for phase unwrapping the phase distribution; a first determining unit configured to determine all local extreme points of the phase distribution subjected to the phase unwrapping according to a preset time window, the time window being determined according to a cycle range of respiration or heartbeat of a living body; the uniformization unit is used for performing amplitude uniformization processing on the phase distribution between each pair of adjacent local extreme points; and a second calculation unit for calculating the frequency of breathing or heartbeat of the living body based on the phase distribution subjected to the uniformization processing of the amplitude.

title_en: Human condition detecting device
abstract_en: A human condition detection device comprises a depth image-taking module for taking a depth image of a target area. A millimeter-wave radar module detects breaths or heartbeats in the target area to provide a signal. A thermal image-taking module takes a thermal image of the target area. A processor module determines whether a person is in the target area based on the depth image. The processor module determines whether there is any breath or heartbeat based on the signal if a person is in the target area. The processor module determines whether there is any abnormal vital sign of the person in the target area based on the signal and the thermal image if there is a breath or heartbeat in the target area. The processor module actuates the warning module to provide a warning if there is an abnormal vital sign of the person in the target area.

title_en: Monitoring Vital Sign of Occupant in a Vehicle Seat
abstract_en: A method for measuring vital signs of an occupant in a vehicle seat is provided. In an embodiment, a sensor includes a transmission circuitry, a reception circuitry, and a controller. The transmission circuitry is configured to transmit a radar beam to an occupant in a vehicle seat. The reception circuitry is configured to receive a reflected signal. The reflected signal being a reflection of the radar beam from the occupant. The controller is configured to determine data associated with a vital sign of the occupant based on the reflected signal.

title_en: recessed solar LED road marker
title_ko: 매립형 태양광 엘이디 도로표지병
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a road-buried road stud, and more specifically, to a buried solar LED road stud, which can send emergency situation information and location information by means of a wireless communication, and can make an accident circumstance to be clearly recognized, thereby preventing an accident. To this end, the present invention comprises: a main body housing to be buried in the road; a main body inserted and installed in the main body housing; and a main body housing cover fixated to the main body housing by means of a cover fixating pin to prevent the dislocation of the main body at the upper portion of the main body housing. The main body comprises: a solar panel converting sunlight introduced into the upper portion of the main body into electricity; a battery storing electricity converted in the solar panel; an LED outputting light by using the electricity stored in the battery; a beacon receiving an emergency situation signal from a smartphone, and linked with the smartphone to transmit a message notifying location information and an emergency circumstance; an illuminance sensor detecting illuminance; and a control board connected to the beacon and the illuminance sensor to control the operation of the LED. A lens is provided to be convex at the upper portion of the main body.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로 매립형 도로표지병에 있어서, 특히 무선통신을 통해 긴급 상황정보와 위치정보를 보낼 수 있고 또한 사고 상황에 대한 명확한 인지가 가능하게 하여 사고를 예방할 수 있도록 한 매립형 태양광 엘이디 도로표지병에 관한 것으로, 도로 매립을 위한 본체하우징; 상기 본체하우징의 내부에 삽입 설치되는 본체; 및 상기 본체하우징의 상부에서 상기 본체의 이탈을 방지하기 위하여 커버고정핀에 의해 상기 본체하우징에 고정되는 본체하우징커버로 구성되며, 상기 본체는 상기 본체의 상부로 유입되는 태양광을 전기로 변환하는 태양광 판넬과, 상기 태양광 판넬에서 변환된 전기를 저장하는 배터리와, 상기 배터리에 저장된 전기를 사용하여 빛을 출력하는 엘이디와, 스마트폰으로부터 위급 상황 신호를 수신하고 상기 스마트폰과 연동하여 위치정보와 위급 상황을 알리는 메시지를 전송하는 비콘과, 조도를 감지하는 조도센서와, 상기 비콘과 상기 조도센서와 연결되어 상기 엘이디의 동작을 제어하는 컨트롤보드를 구비하며, 상기 본체의 상부는 렌즈를 볼록하게 구비하는 것이 특징인 발명이다.

title_en: Outdoor infrared ray makes a video recording and surveys multi-legged running gear
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an outdoor detection equipment especially relates to an outdoor infrared ray makes a video recording and surveys multi-legged running gear of observation. Comprises a rolling multi-foot walking device, a flat ground walking device, a camera, an infrared sensor and a controller; the rolling multi-foot walking device comprises a rolling motor, a hemispherical shell and a plurality of telescopic stabbing feet, wherein the plurality of telescopic stabbing feet are fixedly connected to the outer part of the hemispherical shell, and the rolling motor is connected with the hemispherical shell; the flat ground walking device comprises an annular shell, supporting legs, walking wheels and a walking motor, wherein the supporting legs are fixedly connected outside the annular shell, the walking wheels are arranged on the supporting legs, and the walking motor is connected with the walking wheels; the two hemispherical shells are arranged on two sides of the annular shell through bearings, the camera, the infrared sensor, the walking motor and the rolling motor are electrically connected with a controller, and the controller is powered by a battery. The camera helps people to take a picture or view in an outdoor complex environment; after disasters such as earthquakes occur, life signs are searched for through infrared detection in a complex and severe environment.

title_en: Non-contact real-time vital sign monitoring system and method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact real-time vital sign monitoring system and a non-contact real-time vital sign monitoring method based on a millimeter wave radar; the monitoring system includes: the system comprises a millimeter wave transceiver module, a real-time signal acquisition module, a real-time signal processing module and a visualization module; the real-time signal processing module is used for extracting a respiratory signal and a heart rate signal through clutter suppression; the visualization module is used for carrying out waveform fitting on the respiration signal and the heart rate signal and displaying the position, the respiration and the heart rate of the testee in real time through a visualization interface. The invention effectively overcomes the influence of environmental noise through clutter suppression, and improves the precision of a monitoring system; in addition, fitting is carried out on the respiration signal and the heart rate signal through an iterative algorithm, and related waveforms and monitoring results are visually displayed.

title_en: Through-wall radar signal processing and imaging display system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a through-wall radar signal processing and imaging display system, which comprises a radio frequency module, an STM data acquisition and imaging processing module and a liquid crystal imaging module which are connected in sequence, and also comprises a power supply module for supplying power to the radio frequency module, the STM data acquisition and imaging processing module and the liquid crystal imaging module; the radio frequency module is used for transmitting and receiving signals; the STM data acquisition and imaging processing module is used for acquiring a data stream signal from the radio frequency module and processing the acquired data stream signal to obtain point target data which can be displayed on a liquid crystal display; and the liquid crystal imaging module is used for carrying out imaging display operation on the point target data obtained by the STM data acquisition and imaging processing module. The utility model discloses a many hardware module framework realize signal processing system's design, can realize finally having the imaging system of the expanded communication interface of standard, high-speed data processing function, data transmission and memory function.

title_en: Life detection rescue equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses life detection rescue equipment, which comprises a machine body and a nutrient solution cavity arranged in the machine body, wherein nutrient solution is stored in the nutrient solution cavity, the right end of the machine body is fixedly connected with a gear box, a transmission cavity is arranged in the gear box, a disinfectant cavity is arranged below the nutrient solution cavity and is arranged in the machine body, medical disinfectant is stored in the disinfectant cavity, two pairs of travelling shaft seats are fixedly connected at the bottom end of the machine body in a bilateral symmetry manner, a slide block valve is arranged at the left end of the machine body at the left side of the nutrient solution cavity in a vertically sliding manner, a magnet is fixedly connected at the bottom end of the slide block valve and is elastically connected at the top end of an electromagnet through a magnet spring, the life detection rescue equipment provided by the invention has the advantages of simple structure and convenient operation, the life detection through infrared thermal induction is realized when a disaster, when the life is detected, the life can be supplied through the obstacle ruins, so that the safety of the life can be ensured to the maximum extent.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU MIAOXIAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_ko: 생체 신호들의 판독에 기초한 전자기 치료 프로토콜을 생성하기 위한 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 프로토콜 생성 및 치료 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 프로토콜 생성 및 치료 시스템은: 메인 데이터베이스; 머신 러닝 소프트웨어, 전자기장들을 생성하도록 구성되는 전자기장 발생기를 포함하는 휴대용 장치(100); 생물리학적 신호들을 측정하도록 구성되는 일련의 센서들(500) 및 전자기장들을 전달하도록 구성되는 일련의 이미터들(400); 전자기장 발생기를 제어하도록, 일련의 센서들(500) 각각으로부터 실시간으로 측정되는 생물리학적 신호들을 기록하기 위하여, 측정된 생물리학적 신호들을 기준 전자기장 또는 신호 범위와 비교하기 위하여, 일련의 이미터들(400)을 통해 복수의 상이한 전자기장들을 전달하도록 구성되는 컴퓨팅 장치(104); 그리고 휴대용 장치(100)의 구성요소들을 위한 전원 공급장치; 그리고 휴대용 장치(100)를 보정하도록, 일련의 센서들(500) 및 이미터들(400)의 정확성을 테스트하도록, 환자가 사용하기 전에 기본 치료 프로토콜과 기준 센서들(500) 및 이미터들(400) 포지셔닝 맵을 메인 데이터베이스와 휴대용 장치(100)의 저장 공간에 저장하도록 구성되는 고정 장치(200);를 포함한다. 컴퓨팅 유닛(104)이 일련의 센서들(500) 각각으로부터의 생물리학적 신호의 측정과 동시에 일련의 이미터들(400) 각각을 통해 전달되는 전자기장을 보정하도록 더 구성되고, 서로 근접하게 위치되는 각 특정 이미터(400) 및 각 특정 센서(500)는 쌍으로 작동한다. 각 이미터(400)를 통해 전달되는 전자기장은 측정된 생물리학적 신호가 기준 전자기장 또는 신호 범위 내에 있다는 것이 달성될 때까지 계속해서 보정된다. 컴퓨팅 유닛(104)은, 신호가 기준 전자기장 범위 내에 있을 때 복수의 센서들(500)로부터의 하나 이상의 센서(500)에 의해 측정되는 생물리학적 신호에 기초하여, 전자기장 전달을 제외하기 위해 복수의 이미터들(400)로부터 하나 이상의 이미터(400)를 선택하도록 추가로 구성된다.

title_en: Through-wall radar sensors networked together to create 2d and 3d combined views of an area
abstract_en: Systems and methods for networking together through-wall radar sensors to generate a combined image based on signal data from the networked through-wall radar sensors. The system includes a first through-wall radar sensor and a second through-wall radar sensor. The second through-wall radar sensor is networked with the first through-wall radar sensor. The system includes a display of an area, wherein the display of the area is based on data from the first through-wall radar sensor combined with data from the second through-wall radar sensor. The system may include a first communication device connected to the first through-wall radar sensor and a second communication device connected to the second through-wall radar sensor. A controller is networked with the first through-wall radar sensor and the second through-wall radar sensor. The system may include a plurality of through-wall radar sensors networked together to provide a two-dimensional or a three-dimensional image of an area.

title_en: Electronic device for estimating physiological signal and method thereof
title_ko: 생체 신호를 추정하는 전자 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electronic device for estimating a biometric signal to increase accuracy and reliability of biometric information acquired by using a wearable device and to a method thereof. According to various embodiments of the present invention, the electronic device comprises: a first sensor measuring a biometric parameter of a user; a second sensor measuring characteristic of the user′s movement; at least one processor operatively connected to the first sensor or the second sensor; and a memory operatively connected to the at least one processor.
