The method stores instructions allowing the at least one processor, during execution, to monitor the user′s biometric signals based on the bio-parameters measured by the first sensor; check a first signal indicating a bioactivity trend on the basis of the user′s movement characteristics acquired from the second sensor when the user′s movement is detected by using at least one of the first sensor and the second sensor during monitoring; and correct the user′s biometric signals recorded during a first time period, in which the user′s movement is maintained, on the basis of the first signal. Various other embodiments are possible.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 다양한 실시예에 따른, 전자 장치는, 사용자에 대한 생체 파라미터를 측정하는 제1 센서, 상기 사용자의 움직임 특성을 측정하는 제2 센서, 상기 제1 센서 또는 상기 제2 센서와 작동적으로 연결된 적어도 하나의 프로세서, 및 상기 적어도 하나의 프로세서와 작동적으로 연결된 메모리를 포함하고, 상기 메모리는, 실행 시에, 상기 적어도 하나의 프로세서가, 상기 제1 센서에 의해 측정된 생체 파라미터를 기반으로 상기 사용자의 생체신호를 모니터링 하고, 상기 모니터링 중 상기 제1 센서 또는 상기 제2 센서 중 적어도 하나를 이용하여 상기 사용자의 움직임을 감지하면, 상기 제2 센서로부터 획득한 상기 사용자의 움직임 특성을 기반으로 생체 활동 추세를 나타내는 제1 신호를 확인하고, 상기 제1 신호를 기반으로 상기 사용자의 움직임이 유지되는 제1 시간 구간 동안 기록된 상기 사용자의 생체 신호를 보정하도록 하는 인스트럭션들을 저장할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 다양한 실시예에 따라 다른 실시예들이 가능할 수 있다.

title_en: Through-wall imaging radar double-fundamental-frequency three-channel time base control circuit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a through-wall imaging radar double-fundamental-frequency three-channel time base control circuit, which comprises an FPGA (field programmable gate array) time sequence control circuit, a programmable time sequence control circuit, a system clock circuit, a reference clock circuit and three paths of delay pulse output circuits which are arranged in parallel; the FPGA time sequence control circuit is electrically connected with the system clock circuit and is used for outputting initial pulses, delay data, fine tuning data and channel gating signals; the programmable time sequence control circuit comprises an ECL conditioning circuit, a programmable delay chip and a fine tuning DAC chip. The invention realizes high-precision and large-range time delay control of three channels through the time sequence control circuit; the synchronous design of the two base frequency clocks reduces time jitter errors and improves the stability of the pulse signal generation module; the method can set 16-bit delay configuration control words, is flexible in parameter adjustment, can realize ultrahigh delay precision of 2ps, can realize continuous scanning of a maximum 2000ns time window, can simultaneously send three paths of delay pulses or send the delay pulses in a time-sharing manner, and has controllable time interval of time-sharing sending.
assignees: QINGDAO ZHONGDIAN ZHONGYI INTELLIGENT TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake early warning alarm for converter station and monitoring method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an alarm for earthquake early warning of a converter station and a monitoring method thereof, belonging to the technical field of earthquake early warning. The earthquake early warning alarm for the converter station comprises a box body, a moving mechanism, a driving mechanism and an earthquake warning mechanism. The moving mechanism comprises a first hollow pipe and a second hollow pipe, the first hollow pipe penetrates through the box body in a sliding mode, a conical head is installed at the bottom end of the first hollow pipe, and a through hole is formed in the surface of the first hollow pipe. The first hollow pipe, the second hollow pipe, the micro motor, the screw rod, the clamping plate and the elastic piece are matched, so that the seismic sensor can be buried in the soil, a pit does not need to be dug on the surface of the soil, the seismic sensor can be buried, the burying of the seismic sensor is facilitated, in addition, the conical head is additionally arranged at the bottom end of the first hollow pipe, the first hollow pipe is favorably driven into the soil, and the subsequent burying of the seismic sensor is facilitated.

title_en: Fire safety monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire-fighting equipment technical field, when taking place to the conflagration, smog is to the great literary composition problem of personnel's injury, aims at providing a conflagration safety monitoring system, including installing at indoor smog induction circuit, install the raceway on the indoor ceiling, the intercommunication has a plurality of spray pipes that extend towards the ground direction on the raceway, and pre-buried in the indoor wall has the water tank, has placed the working shaft in the water tank, and the intercommunication has the flow pipe between working shaft and the raceway, and smog induction circuit includes: the device comprises a smoke sensor, a smoke concentration comparison unit and a verification control unit. The water in the water tank is sprayed out from the water spraying pipe through the water conveying pipe under the action of the water supply pump, and the water spraying pipe is arranged around the circumference of the water conveying pipe, so that water sprayed out from the water spraying pipe forms a water curtain indoors, people stand in the water curtain, and smoke is partially contained in the water, so that the people standing in the water curtain are not easy to absorb too much smoke in a short time, and more rescue time is strived for fire fighters.
assignees: GUANGZHOU NEW GOOD CASTLE FIRE ENGINEERING ENTPR CO LTD

title_en: Beidou positioning system-based monitoring system and monitoring method for deep foundation pit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring system and a monitoring method for a deep foundation pit based on a Beidou positioning system, wherein the monitoring system comprises displacement sensors, a Beidou navigation positioning base station, a monitoring controller, terminal data processing equipment, data storage equipment and Internet of things transmission equipment, the displacement sensors are pre-buried in monitoring positions of the foundation pit through grid layout, and are interconnected and intercommunicated, crossed and fused, so that the distance change among the displacement sensors is measured in real time; the detection distance change is transmitted to a monitoring controller in real time through a base station, and the deformation condition of the deep foundation pit is judged after the detection distance change is analyzed by the monitoring controller; the data terminal processing equipment can correct errors of the monitored data through a differential technology, real-time monitoring of the deep foundation pit is achieved, the phenomenon of deformation of the deep foundation pit can be truly reflected through data processing and error correction, monitoring precision is improved, whether the displacement deformation of the deep foundation pit is within a safety range or not is judged, accidents can be effectively prevented through advanced early warning, and casualties, equipment damage and influences on safety of surrounding buildings due to sudden collapse and instability of the foundation pit are avoided.

title_en: Narrow-beam microstrip Doppler radar organism motion detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a narrow-beam micro-strip Doppler radar organism motion detector, which comprises a metal lining plate, a micro-strip Doppler radar module and a wave-absorbing plate, wherein the micro-strip Doppler radar module is fixed in the middle of the metal lining plate, and the wave-absorbing plate is arranged around the micro-strip Doppler radar module; the microstrip Doppler radar module comprises a circuit board and a bottom cavity, a microstrip antenna is arranged on the front side of the circuit board, a high-frequency circuit is arranged on the back side of the circuit board, the bottom cavity surrounds the high-frequency circuit and is fixed on the back side of the circuit board, and the bottom of the bottom cavity is fixed in the middle of the metal lining plate. The utility model discloses a set up the wave absorption plate on current microstrip Doppler radar module, narrow the microwave detection wave beam, can promote the directive property of microwave in the detection process, avoid interfering mutually between the detector of neighbouring setting, can be applicable to the application scene that many beds surveyed respectively, avoid the adjacent bed to interfere; meanwhile, the narrow beam reduces background noise, can distinguish slight body movement, and lays a foundation for vital sign detection.

title_en: Ultra-wideband through-wall radar detection system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ultra wide band through-wall radar detection system belongs to radar detection technical field for solve present radar detection result and show technical problem such as disguised inadequately, this detection system specifically includes the ultra wide band through-wall radar, still include with the glasses terminal that the ultra wide band through-wall radar communication links to each other, be used for right the detection result of ultra wide band through-wall radar shows. The utility model discloses an ultra wide band through-wall radar detection system has advantages such as simple structure, flexibility height, disguise are strong.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-target vital sign radar detection system based on coding and phased array antenna
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target vital sign radar detection system based on coding and a phased array antenna, which is characterized by comprising a transmitter and a receiver; the invention applies the coding technology and the phased array antenna technology to a vital sign detection system, and because the detection signal in each direction is modulated by the coded baseband signal, the direction and distance information of each echo signal can be determined by the correlation characteristic analysis of the random code in a receiver module, and then the vital sign information of each target can be distinguished.

title_en: Method, system and storage medium for monitoring vital movement and physical sign
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a storage medium for monitoring vital movements and physical signs, and belongs to the technical field of millimeter wave radars. The method comprises the following steps: compounding the continuous sine millimeter waves and the linear frequency modulation millimeter waves to obtain composite waveform millimeter waves; indoor vital movement and sign information detection is carried out by a millimeter wave radar by utilizing composite waveform millimeter waves; and extracting the indoor vital movement and sign information by using the echo baseband signal comprising the vital movement and sign information. The invention can optimize the application scene of the millimeter wave radar, can monitor the indoor vital movement information and the indoor vital sign information, realizes that one radar can carry out various monitoring functions of indoor vital movement, vital signs and the like, and reduces the cost.
assignees: BEIJING MUNIU NAVIGATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-channel integrated non-contact vital sign monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-channel integrated non-contact vital sign monitoring system which comprises a vision part, an ultra-wideband radar part and an infrared temperature measurement part. The invention displays the vital sign information of each target in real time by wireless monitoring of multiple target vital signs (including heart rate, respiration and body temperature), realizes the real-time monitoring function of the target, and timely gives a warning when the target vital signs are abnormal.

title_en: Double-triaxial electromagnetic detection and route positioning method for submarine cable
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-triaxial electromagnetic detection and submarine cable routing positioning algorithm for a submarine electrified cable, wherein the submarine cable routing relative positioning algorithm comprises a magnetic deviation positioning algorithm, a transverse deviation positioning algorithm and a vertical deviation positioning algorithm, six real-time electromagnetic signals and sensor attitude angle signals provided for two orthogonal triaxial electromagnetic detection sensors are input into the algorithm, and the algorithm outputs submarine cable routing angle, submarine cable routing point transverse deviation, submarine cable routing point vertical deviation and submarine cable routing point burial depth. The submarine cable route absolute positioning algorithm comprises a submarine cable buried depth positioning algorithm, a submarine cable route angle positioning algorithm and a submarine cable route point absolute positioning algorithm, wherein the algorithm inputs are output of the submarine cable route relative positioning algorithm, a real-time ground altitude signal fed back by an altimeter, and a course angle and an absolute position (namely a longitude/latitude signal of a detection platform body) of a detection sensor under a geodetic coordinate system; the algorithm output is the absolute position of the submarine cable routing point (i.e., the longitude/latitude of the submarine cable routing point).

title_en: Swarm type ad hoc network slope inclination state monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a swarm type ad hoc network slope inclination state monitoring device; the method comprises the following steps: the shell is an engineering plastic cube; the inclination angle sensor chip is arranged in the shell and used for monitoring the inclination change of the side slope to obtain side slope inclination data; the wireless communication module is arranged in the shell, is connected with the tilt angle sensor chip and is used for forming a swarm type network by the ad hoc network; the slope inclination data is transmitted to the remote terminal; and the battery is arranged in the shell and is respectively connected with the tilt angle sensor chip and the wireless communication module. The utility model discloses the adoption that can solve the existence is monitored the side slope tilt state with pre-buried inclinometer, needs to spend longer engineering time, can not satisfy the technical problem of the anti-disaster requirement of speedily carrying out rescue work under the emergency.
assignees: CHINA MERCHANTS CHONGQING COMMUNICATIONS TECH RESEARCH & DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitoring device and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact vital sign monitoring device, which comprises: a radar transmission system; the first input end of the radar receiving system is connected with the output end of the radar transmitting system; the input end of the digital signal processing system is connected with the output end of the radar receiving system, the first output end of the digital signal processing system is connected with the input end of the radar transmitting system, the second output end of the digital signal processing system is connected with the second input end of the radar receiving system, and the digital signal processing system is used for digitally processing and regulating and controlling the radar transmitting system and the radar receiving system in real time; and the input end of the upper computer is connected with the third output end of the digital signal processing system, algorithm processing is carried out, vital sign information is extracted, and vital sign monitoring is completed. The invention solves the problem that the speed measurement and distance measurement resolution ratio of the traditional CW radar and UWB radar is limited, adopts the FMCW radar with the distance measurement and speed measurement capability, has the bandwidth of 4GHz, greatly improves the accuracy of physical sign monitoring, and realizes the high integration of hardware and the miniaturization of equipment through the antenna-radio frequency-digital mixed pressure integration.

title_en: Remote battlefield wounded person identification method and device based on vital signs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote battlefield wounded person identification method and device based on vital signs, and belongs to the technical field of personnel search and rescue and identification. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a basic vital sign data set of the individual soldiers in a preset time sequence before the current moment, and judging the physiological state of the individual soldiers at the current moment and the reliability of the physiological state of the individual soldiers at the current moment according to the data set; and (4) integrating the current individual physiological state and the current individual physiological state reliability, and determining and marking the current individual state. The invention solves the problems of accuracy and reliability in the existing remote identification technology of the individual wounded person, improves the remote identification accuracy and reliability of the individual wounded person by utilizing a multi-sensor fusion technology and a time sequence analysis technology according to the real-time vital sign information of the individual wounded person, and provides information support for the effective treatment of the wounded person.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF SYSTEM ENGINEERING ACADEMY OF MILITARY SCIENCES INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SUPPORT TECH

title_en: Dynamic and static human body target self-adaptive detection method and system based on through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a medium, equipment and a system for adaptively detecting moving and static human body targets based on a through-wall radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring first echo data information and second echo data information, and generating a first baseband signal corresponding to the first echo data information and a second baseband signal corresponding to the second echo data information; performing distance-to-Fourier transform and Doppler-to-Fourier transform on each set of first baseband data and each set of second baseband data to generate first frequency domain data and second frequency domain data; judging whether a moving human body target exists according to a first preset self-adaptive threshold value, and calculating the first target distance delay; judging whether a static human body target exists according to a second preset self-adaptive threshold value, and calculating a second target distance delay; calculating the position information of a moving human body target and the position information of a static human body target; the interference of the moving target to the detection of the static target in the detection process can be effectively inhibited, and the accuracy of the detection of the moving and static human targets is improved.
assignees: INST OF AUTOMATION SHANDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Vital sensor
abstract_en: To provide a vital sensor suitable for, especially, a use in an MRI examination.SOLUTION: A cable 4 allows a probe which can be mounted on a body of a subject and outputs a signal corresponding to a vital sign of the subject to be connected to a signal processing section for processing the signal. The cable 4 includes a conductor wire 40, a first heat insulation layer 41, and a second heat insulation layer 42. The conductor wire 40 transmits a signal output from the probe to the signal processing section. The first heat insulation layer 41 covers the conductor wire 40 from a radially outer side of the cable 4. The second heat insulation layer 42 is formed between the conductor wire 40 and the first heat insulation layer 41.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Sensor, system and method for detecting radar biosignal
title_ko: 생체신호 검출을 위한 low-IF 레이더 센서, 시스템 및 이를 이용한 생체 신호 검출 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sensor and system for radar bio-signal detection and a bio-signal detection method using the same. More specifically, the sensor has a simple radar structure without a null detection point while canceling the noise effect caused by a signal source. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the sensor for radar bio-signal detection according to one embodiment of the present invention may comprise: a transmission unit transmitting a signal to a living organism; a reception unit receiving a signal reflected from the living organism; and a switching signal application unit directly connected to the reception unit to apply a switching signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 레이더 생체신호 검출을 위한 센서, 시스템 및 이를 이용한 생체 신호 검출 방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 신호원에 의한 잡음 영향을 상세하면서도 널 감지 지점(Null detection point)이 없는 간단한 구조의 레이더 구조를 갖는 것으로, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 레이더 생체신호 검출 센서는 생명체를 향해 신호를 송신하는 송신부; 상기 생명체로부터 반사되는 신호를 수신하는 수신부; 및 상기 수신부에 직접 연결되어 스위칭 신호를 인가하는 스위칭 신호 인가부;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Anti-deformation prefabricated direct-buried engineering pipeline
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a prefabricated direct-burried engineering pipeline of preapring for an unfavorable turn of events shape, including the inner tube, the heat preservation has been cup jointed to the inner tube outer wall, the heat preservation outer wall has cup jointed the sleeve pipe, the sleeve pipe outer wall is equipped with the rubber tube, be equipped with a plurality of spring preforming between rubber tube and the sleeve pipe, spring preforming one side and sleeve pipe fixed connection, the first spring of fixedly connected with between spring preforming and the sleeve pipe. The utility model discloses a connecting pipe passes through the screw nail with the installed part and is connected with first screw hole, screw and second screw hole threaded connection, internal thread and external screw thread threaded connection combination use, wherein the spring preforming and the first spring combination of sheathed tube outer wall, the inner tube is made by stainless steel material, strengthen the firm and the corrosion resistance of pipeline, the heat preservation is made by polyurethane foam, the resistance to compression takes precautions against earthquakes, heat-resisting heat preservation, the cellucotton is made by inorganic fiber cotton, thermal insulation performance is good, stability is stronger, the resistance to compression of combatting earthquake prevents that liquid punching press from leading to the pipeline to break or the pipeline.
assignees: LIAONING HUAYANG PIPELINE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for processing sign data based on frequency modulation continuous wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of signal processing, in particular to a sign data processing method and a system based on a frequency modulation continuous wave radar, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly adopting the frequency modulation continuous wave radar to transmit electromagnetic wave signals to a human body to be detected so as to detect the mechanical motion signals of the chest wall of the human body to be detected and receive returned echo signals; then sampling the echo signals, processing the sampled echo signals by using a multiple signal classification algorithm to obtain a high-resolution range profile, and extracting respiratory signals and heartbeat signals according to the high-resolution range profile; finally, physical sign data of the human body to be detected are determined according to the respiration signals and the heartbeat signals, wherein the physical sign data comprise respiration rate, real-time respiration rate variability, heart rate and real-time heart rate variability; the invention can detect the vital signs of the human body to be detected more conveniently and more efficiently, realizes the high-precision real-time extraction of the respiration rate, the heart rate, the variability of the respiration rate and the variability of the heart rate, and provides accurate and clear sign data.

title_en: Crab apartment device with monitoring function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a crab apartment device with monitor function, includes crab apartment, automatic monitoring device, track, support, power cord, coaster device, backup pad, controller, first servo motor, has first belt pulley device, first assembly pulley, second belt assembly pulley, second servo motor, shell, automatic telescoping device, third servo motor, screw rod, nut, telescopic link, camera device, radar life detection appearance, alarm and infrared induction remote controller. The utility model has the advantages that the occupied space is small, and the occupied area of every hundred swimming crabs is less than 1 square meter on average, thereby saving resources; the camera captures the picture of each swimming crab in the crab apartment, so that the workload of managers is reduced, the working efficiency is improved, and the labor is saved; the life state of the portunids is detected in real time through a radar life detector, so that the death of the portunids is avoided, and the accurate positioning treatment is realized; the operation of the monitoring device can be controlled by the infrared of the remote controller, and the operation is simple and convenient.

title_en: Through-wall radar detection system and detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar detection system and a detection method, wherein the detection system comprises a visual detection unit and an ultra-wideband radar, the visual detection unit is used for acquiring target information of a visual area, and the target information comprises wall information; the ultra-wideband radar is connected with the visual detection unit and used for filtering target information in front of the wall according to the wall information and detecting a target in a rear area of the wall to obtain a detection result. The invention has the advantages of long-distance omnibearing detection, high detection speed, high detection precision, flexibility and the like.

title_en: Patient vital sign change trend detection method and system based on microwave radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for detecting the change trend of vital signs of a patient based on a microwave radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring vital sign data of a patient based on a microwave radar; performing trend analysis based on the patient vital sign data, the trend analysis including a lifting trend analysis and a variability trend analysis; and judging whether the result of the trend analysis meets a first preset condition, and if so, sending out an alarm. The invention allows medical staff to pay attention to the change trend of vital signs of patients in time, evaluates the conditions of the patients, gives corresponding intervention measures as early as possible, and avoids serious bad results caused by delayed discovery of the changes of the conditions.

title_en: Portable multifunctional rescue instrument for firefighters
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rescue instruments, in particular to a portable multifunctional rescue instrument for firemen, which comprises a shell, wherein an infrared life detection instrument is arranged inside the shell, a gas detection instrument is arranged on the right side of the shell, a handle is arranged below the shell, and an outer sleeve is arranged outside the handle; the portable multifunctional rescue instrument for the firefighter is provided with the infrared life detection instrument, the gas detection instrument, the outer sleeve and the like, namely, the rescue instrument is fixed on an arm through the outer sleeve during fire rescue, when the life characteristics are detected, the infrared life detection instrument vibrates and sends out a prompt sound, and when harmful gas is detected, the gas detection instrument vibrates and sends out the prompt sound; the design changes the condition that the traditional infrared life detection instrument and the gas detection instrument occupy more space to affect rescue, the rescue is conveniently fixed on the arm according to actual conditions, and the fire fighter can conveniently carry out rescue work.

title_en: Oil pipe protection device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of oil exploitation equipment, and discloses an oil pipe protection device which comprises an oil pipeline, wherein a protective outer pipe sleeve is sleeved outside the oil pipeline, a puncture-resistant layer is embedded and installed on one side inside the protective outer pipe sleeve, a heat-insulating layer is embedded and installed on one side outside the puncture-resistant layer, a flame-retardant rubber ring is embedded and installed on one side outside the heat-insulating layer, a pressure sensor is uniformly clamped and installed at the edge position of the outer wall of the flame-retardant rubber ring, and a fixed inner side ring is fixedly installed on one side outside the flame-retardant rubber ring. According to the invention, through the electronic conducting wire and the puncture-resistant layer inside the protective outer sleeve, the functions of plant puncture prevention, heat preservation and water prevention can be provided when an oil pipeline is pre-buried, meanwhile, when a fire disaster occurs inside the oil pipeline, the flame-retardant rubber ring can be contracted towards the fixed inner side ring side under the action of high temperature, the fire source is closed to block air, the fire source is extinguished, and the function of flame-retardant protection of the oil pipeline is realized.

title_en: Intelligent window-breaking escape protection device for automobile
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent automobile window breaking and escaping protection device, which belongs to the technical field of emergency escaping equipment and comprises a control processing module, an emergency alarm module, a fire alarm module, a vital sign alarm module, a button module, a communication module, a voice synthesis module, a window breaking device and a GPS module. The intelligent window breaking device has the advantages that automatic window breaking is achieved through the cooperation of the sensors of the alarm modules and the control processing module, manual window breaking is achieved through the button module, remote window breaking is achieved through the communication between the communication module and the rear-end equipment, and the window breaking device is driven to act in three intelligent window breaking modes, so that the personal safety of people in the vehicle is effectively guaranteed.

title_en: Fire-fighting robot with life detection function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting robot with life detection function, which comprises a movable base, wherein a driving box is fixedly arranged on the surface of the top end of the movable base, bearings are fixedly arranged in the middle parts of the upper end and the lower end of the driving box in a penetrating manner, two bearing inner hole walls are fixedly arranged in a penetrating manner and are provided with rotating rods, a follower gear is embedded and arranged on the surface of the middle end of each rotating rod, a rotating motor is fixedly arranged on the surface of the bottom end of the right side in the driving box, and a rotating plate is fixedly arranged on the surface of the; the utility model discloses owing to remove the base top and install the drive box to install the dwang through the bearing in drive box inside, can rotate along with the rotor plate at its top of rotation drive of bearing through the dwang, be convenient for adjust the position of the detection box of rotor plate top, and then change the detection position of vital sign sensor, guarantee to carry out quick detection to the different positions in conflagration scene, improve the efficiency of rescue.
assignees: HAINAN HUI PENG FIRE TECH SERVICES CO LTD

title_en: Method for detecting object through wall by radar, radar detection equipment and electronic device
abstract_en: The application relates to a method for detecting an object through a wall by a radar, a radar detection device, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein a stationary object on one side of the wall is detected on the other side of the wall by using radar detectors at different positions on the other side of the wall, and a detection result corresponding to each position is obtained; establishing a first relationship at each position for representing the length of the different propagation paths, the propagation time of the electromagnetic wave and the propagation speed of the electromagnetic wave, and establishing a second relationship for representing the received electromagnetic wave strength, the propagation time and the propagation speed obtained on the different propagation paths; according to the first relation and the second relation, the position of the static object is determined, the problem of low accuracy when the radar is adopted to detect the target object blocked by the wall body in the fire scene is solved, and the accuracy of radar detection is improved.

title_en: Millimeter wave-based device and method for positioning personnel and detecting vital signs in fire scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave-based device and a millimeter wave-based method for locating personnel and detecting vital signs in a fire scene, wherein the device comprises a central control and processing module, and a DAC (digital-to-analog converter), an ADC (analog-to-digital converter), an optional data storage module, a millimeter wave radar module, a camera module, a WIFI module and an intermediate frequency signal processing module which are connected with the central control and processing module; according to the method, the DAC, the ADC and the central processing and controller module are used for processing and identifying the positions of personnel in the fire and vital sign key data, FMCW millimeter wave data collection is achieved, the MCU processes and analyzes the data, the SD card caches the data, the positions and vital sign states of the personnel in the fire are given, the SCCB communication protocol is used for controlling the camera to give specific position information, and the data are transmitted to the local terminal device in cooperation with the WIFI module based on the SPI.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitoring under slow random motion based on biological radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of vital sign detection, and provides a non-contact vital sign monitoring method based on a biological radar under slow random motion. Firstly, synchronously acquiring frequency modulation continuous wave radar and pulse ultra-wideband radar data; and then, based on the echo signals of the frequency modulation continuous wave radar, the target detection, the motion mode pre-classification and the body orientation classification are realized by utilizing machine learning. On the basis, the estimation of the position of the chest echo is realized based on the body orientation, the vital sign signals obtained by the detection of the pulse ultra-wideband radar are corrected in an auxiliary mode, and the vital sign extraction is further realized by adopting a heartbeat estimation and recovery algorithm. The detection method provided by the invention can accurately detect the target vital signs under the slow random motion, and provides possibility for further realizing long-term, robust and comprehensive vital sign monitoring under the motion state and exploring the influence of motion on the physiological health of a human body.

title_en: Indoor and outdoor multi-person vital sign monitoring system based on multi-radar fusion internet of things
abstract_en: The scheme requires that the indoor and outdoor multi-target vital signs can be monitored based on the multi-radar fusion network. Under the environment that many people appear intensively indoor and outdoor, the problem of sheltering from and the aliasing of signal appears easily, thereby cause target vital sign monitoring inaccurate, undulant great scheduling problem, solitary ultra wide band radar network lacks the unable body state of discernment target of multidimension information and then influences vital sign monitoring, thereby solitary frequency modulation continuous wave radar can't realize accurate target location and lead to subsequent vital sign monitoring inaccurate, network deployment and the information fusion at different dimensions through ultra wide band radar and frequency modulation continuous wave radar, can reduce the influence of multi-target mutual interference effectively, simultaneously can also monitor the body state of multi-target, increase vital sign monitoring's accuracy and robustness.

title_en: Loess landslide formation mechanism physical model test device under environment of undermining
abstract_en: A physical model test device of a loess landslide forming mechanism in a subsurface erosion environment comprises a water supply system, a test system, a collection system and a high-definition real-time camera system; the water supply system comprises a water supply barrel and a flowmeter, and the water supply barrel and the flowmeter are connected by a water supply pipe; the testing system comprises a model box, a slope model is buried in the model box, a porous latex tube communicated with a water supply barrel is buried in the slope model, a sensor is buried in the slope model according to conditions, and the change of a stress field and a seepage field in the slope body in the testing process is monitored through the sensor; the collection system collects accumulated water of the experiment system, the high-definition real-time camera system comprises a top camera, a left camera, a right camera and a front camera, and the change condition of the slope model in the experiment process can be recorded in real time; the utility model discloses considered the undermining to the influence of soil slope stability, especially be applicable to under the undermining environment loess landslide and form mechanism experimental study, easy operation, durable reliable, economic environmental protection, circulated repetitious usage.

title_en: Radar-based vital sign estimation
abstract_en: In an embodiment, a method includes: receiving radar signals with a millimeter-wave radar; generating range data based on the received radar signals; detecting a target based on the range data; performing ellipse fitting on in-phase (I) and quadrature (Q) signals associated with the detected target to generate compensated I and Q signals associated with the detected target; classifying the compensated I and Q signals; when the classification of the compensated I and Q signals correspond to a first class, determining a displacement signal based on the compensated I and Q signals, and determining a vital sign based on the displacement signal; and when the classification of the compensated I and Q signals correspond to a second class, discarding the compensated I and Q signals.

title_en: Rear seat entertainment system, rear seat entertainment remote controlling apparatus and method thereof
title_ko: 후석 엔터테인먼트 시스템, 후석 엔터테인먼트 원격 제어 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a rear seat entertainment controlling apparatus, and a method thereof. The rear seat entertainment remote controlling apparatus may include a sensing module that is provided with a sensing surface including a biometric sensor and senses a biometric signal and a finger gesture of a user, a main controller that supplies AC current to the sensing module, and a short-range wireless communication module that transmits one of the sensed biometric signal or the sensed finger gesture to a rear seat monitor through short-range wireless communication depending on an operation mode. Accordingly, the present invention can provide a rear seat entertainment remote controlling appparatus capable of remote control of a rear seat monitor as well as health care information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 후석 엔터테인먼트 원격 제어 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 실시 예에 따른 후석 엔터테인먼트 원격 제어 장치는 생체 센서를 포함한 센싱면이 형성되어 사용자의 생체 신호 및 손가락 제스처(Gesture)를 감지하는 센싱 모듈과 상기 센싱 모듈로 교류 전류를 제공하는 주제어기와 동작 모드에 따라 상기 감지된 생체 신호 및 손가락 제스처 중 어느 하나를 근거리 무선 통신을 통해 후석 모니터로 전송하는 근거리 무선통신 모듈을 포함할 수 있다. 따라서, 본 발명은 헬스 케어 정보뿐만 아니라 후석 모니터의 원격 제어가 가능한 후석 엔터테인먼트 원격 제어 장치를 제공하는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Fire-fighting helmet with life detection thermal imager
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a take life to survey helmet for fire control of thermal imaging system, including helmet shell body, face guard and life detection thermal imaging system, the outside of helmet shell body is provided with the reflector panel, and the lower extreme of helmet shell body is connected with and separates the shelves cloth, separate the outside of shelves cloth and install the elastic cord, the protecting crust is installed to the outside front end of helmet shell body, and the inboard of protecting crust installs life detection thermal imaging system, the front side of helmet shell body is provided with the face guard, and the inboard of face guard is connected with the display, the second installation piece is installed to the right side lower extreme of helmet shell body, and the outside fixedly connected with connection pad of second installation piece. This take helmet for fire control of life detection thermal imager improves the helmet functional problem, installs life detection thermal imager, is convenient for implement rescue work fast, improves rescue and fire extinguishing efficiency greatly, can avoid danger simultaneously, reduces the injures and deaths, has improved the head safeguard measure to the fire fighter simultaneously.
assignees: HUNAN HANGHUA INNOVATION SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle environment detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle environment detection system and a method, wherein a life information detection module of the system detects whether life information exists in a vehicle through millimeter radar signals, a life information confirmation module confirms a detection result according to current image information, an information acquisition module acquires environment information in the vehicle when the life information exists, an environment information judgment module judges whether the environment information in the vehicle meets preset environment conditions, and an alarm module generates alarm information when the environment information in the vehicle does not meet the preset environment conditions. The invention determines whether to give an alarm or not by detecting the life information in the vehicle, confirming the detection result and judging the environmental information, thereby more accurately realizing the alarm of the life detection.

title_en: Millimeter wave perception-based multi-human vital sign synchronous monitoring system and method
abstract_en: A multi-human vital sign synchronous monitoring system and method based on millimeter wave perception comprises a millimeter wave radar front-end module, a microcontroller, a processor and a display and recording module, wherein the millimeter wave radar front-end module is used for transmitting linear frequency modulation continuous wave microwaves or millimeter wave signals and receiving reflected echo signals to generate multichannel intermediate frequency baseband signals, the microcontroller is used for setting and controlling waveform parameters, transmitting power, signal gain parameters and monitoring processes, setting and controlling acquisition parameters of a signal acquisition module of the processor, the processor extracts vital sign parameter information of a human body from the multichannel intermediate frequency baseband signals, and the display and recording module is used for displaying and storing information including the multi-human body position information, chest wall micro-motion displacement information and vital sign parameters obtained by the processor. The invention provides a non-contact vital sign monitoring system and a non-contact vital sign monitoring method which are high in measurement precision, strong in anti-interference capability, reliable and stable for synchronous monitoring of multiple human vital signs.

title_en: Intelligent vital sign monitoring and controlling system based on microwave radar
abstract_en: The utility model provides a vital sign intelligent monitoring control system based on microwave radar which characterized in that: the system comprises a Doppler human body life detection radar front end, an intelligent control end, a local control end and a remote end; the local control end comprises a controller and local hardware equipment, and the local hardware equipment comprises an intelligent home and a medical emergency system; and the intelligent control end identifies the original data acquired by the front end of the Doppler human body life detection radar and then generates human body life characteristic parameters and gesture commands. The utility model is based on the detection of gesture command, human respiration and heart rate by the continuous wave radar, the front end of the Doppler radar has simple structure, realizes the all-weather monitoring of the physiological state of the target human body under the condition of no contact, and the radar electromagnetic wave technology is not influenced by the environment; the intelligent household appliance can realize the control switch and emergency help seeking of the intelligent household appliance, and can carry out voice or manual remote control.

title_en: Health management
abstract_en: A method includes capturing continuously vital signs and motion data from one or more sensors adapted to be coupled to a user; capturing food consumption of the user; predicting a predetermined health condition of the user based on the vital signs; generating a plan for the predetermined health condition; and prompting the user to execute the plan with a closed-loop feedback based on sensor data.

title_en: Respiration and heartbeat monitoring system based on millimeter wave radar and lightweight neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a respiratory heartbeat monitoring system based on a millimeter wave radar and a lightweight neural network. The radar vital signal extraction module is used for preprocessing the radar echo original signal, filtering clutter interference and accurately extracting a radar vital signal containing the vital sign of the detected human body; the vital sign separation module is used for realizing the quick and effective separation of the vital sign respiratory signal and the heartbeat signal by adopting an LMS self-adaptive algorithm; the breath heartbeat classification module is used for training a lightweight neural network MobileNetV2 network and respectively extracting and classifying the characteristics of the normal/abnormal breath signals and the normal/abnormal heartbeat signals; and the breath heartbeat monitoring module is used for monitoring whether the breath heartbeat of the detected human body is abnormal or not in real time.

title_en: Shield segment utilizing air-entrapping bag for intelligent vibration isolation and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shield segment utilizing intelligent vibration isolation of an air-entrapping bag and a use method thereof, wherein the outer side wall of the segment is provided with a plurality of air cushions; the outer side wall of the duct piece is provided with an air cushion embedded groove corresponding to each air cushion; the bottom of each air cushion pre-buried groove is provided with an air charging and discharging reserved hole communicated with the inner side of the duct piece; one surface of each air cushion, which is close to the corresponding air cushion embedded groove, is provided with a pressure sensor, and the other surface of each air cushion, which faces the outer side of the air cushion embedded groove, is provided with a rubber limit strip, and is fixed in the corresponding air cushion embedded groove through the corresponding rubber limit strip; each air cushion is connected with an air charging and discharging device; each pressure sensor is connected with the control center; the control center controls the inflation and deflation device to inflate or deflate the corresponding air cushion according to the pressure acquired by each pressure sensor. The application of the invention ensures that the shield segment can sense the deformation of the joint of the segment caused by the earthquake and immediately make air leakage reaction, thereby effectively consuming the energy generated by the earthquake and avoiding the damage of the shield tunnel.
assignees: SHANGHAI URBAN CONSTR DESIGN RES INST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Wearable device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a wearable device, and this wearable device is the loop configuration, is provided with on it: the system comprises at least two sensors, a signal processing unit and a signal processing unit, wherein the sensors are used for acquiring sign signals of a target user; the preprocessing module is used for obtaining at least two sign parameters with specified dimensionality according to the target user sign signal; the processing module is used for respectively matching at least two sign parameters with a preset threshold value on the designated dimension to obtain a characteristic value of the designated dimension; the processing module is further configured to perform operation based on at least two of the characterization values to obtain a sign state evaluation value of the target user; the display module is used for displaying the vital sign interface; and the vital sign interface displays the evaluation value of the state of the vital sign. The problem that the user cannot visually know the physical sign state of the user due to the fact that the user basic data are simply fed back by the current wearable intelligent device is solved.

title_en: An earthquake-resistant manhole srtucture
title_ko: 내진 성능을 구비한 단지내 배수로 구조를 갖는 맨홀 구조물
abstract_en: The present invention provides a manhole structure with an in-site drain structure having seismic performance which prevents damage to a manhole body. The manhole structure with an in-site drain structure having seismic performance comprises: a base unit which is installed in the ground, is made of concrete, and has a reinforcing member of a grid shape buried therein; a manhole body arranged on the base unit to be moved; a roller unit which is installed on a corner portion of the lower end of the manhole body, and rolls along a curved surface formed on a corner of a seating groove formed on the upper end of the base unit to move the manhole body; an impact sensor which is installed on the manhole body, and senses an external impact force; a level sensor installed on the manhole body to sense whether manhole body is level; and a control unit which controls driving of the roller unit to allow the manhole body to become level by driving the roller unit if the sensed impact force is higher than or equal to a preset impact force.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지중에 설치되며, 콘크리트로 형성되며, 내부에 격자 형상의 보강 부재가 매설되는 베이스 부; 상기 베이스 부 상에 유동 가능하게 배치되는 맨홀 본체; 상기 맨홀 본체의 하단 모서리부에 설치되며, 상기 베이스 부의 상단에 형성되는 안착홈의 모서리에 형성되는 곡면을 따라 굴러 상기 맨홀 본체를 유동 시키는 롤러부; 상기 맨홀 본체에 설치되며, 외부 충격력을 감지하는 충격 센서; 상기 맨홀 본체에 설치되어 수평 여부를 감지하는 수평 센서; 및, 감지되는 상기 충격력이 기설정된 이상 충격력 이상을 이루는 경우, 상기 롤러부를 구동시켜 상기 맨홀 본체가 상기 수평을 이루도록 상기 롤러부의 구동을 제어하는 제어부를 포함하는 내진 성능을 구비한 단지내 배수로 구조를 갖는 맨홀 구조물을 제공한다.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring children target
abstract_en: The invention provides a target object for monitoring vital signs of children, which comprises: the children model comprises a children model body, a children model skin and a motion mechanism, wherein the children model skin is attached to the children model body and is formed by multiple layers of cloth and used for generating the same millimeter wave radar RCS radar scattering sectional area, the same micro Doppler effect and the same laser radar attribute as those of real children; motion is located the abdominal cavity of children's model body, includes: the device comprises a moving motor, an eccentric wheel, a jacking sliding plate and a fixed shell, wherein vertical slideways are arranged on two walls of the inner side of the fixed shell, the jacking sliding plate is erected on the vertical slideways, an output shaft of the motor is connected with a central shaft of the eccentric wheel, an eccentric shaft of the eccentric wheel is rotatably connected with a driving end of the jacking sliding plate so as to drive the eccentric wheel to rotate by the moving motor, and therefore the eccentric wheel drags the jacking sliding plate to reciprocate up and down to simulate the fluctuation of the thoracic cavity during respiration.

title_en: In-vehicle life detection method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of intelligent automobiles, and provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for detecting life in an automobile, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an x-th radar frame signal acquired by a preset millimeter wave radar in the vehicle; demodulating and sampling and time-frequency conversion are carried out on the xth radar frame signal to obtain a first distance dimension signal array; filtering the first distance dimension signal array to obtain a second distance dimension signal array; extracting the phase and confidence of a preset detection point in the second distance dimensional signal array; performing iterative filtering on the phase and the confidence coefficient of the preset detection point of the xth radar frame signal according to the phase and the confidence coefficient of the preset detection point of the pre-extracted xth-1 radar frame signal to obtain a filtering result of the preset detection point of the xth radar frame signal; and determining that the preset detection point has life under the condition that the filtering result is greater than a preset threshold value. The invention can be suitable for life detection in vehicles in various scenes and has better detection effect.

title_en: Electronic device including biometric sensor and electrode for acquiring biometric signal
title_ko: 생체 신호 획득을 위한 생체 센서 및 전극을 포함하는 전자 장치
abstract_en: An electronic device is disclosed. According to an embodiment disclosed in the present document, the electronic device comprises: a housing forming a plurality of through-holes formed on its surface; a wheel member rotatably coupled to the surface of the housing, wherein the wheel member comprises a conductive portion; a printed circuit board disposed inside the housing; and a first bearing structure, at least a portion of which is disposed inside the through-holes, to support rotation of the wheel member, wherein the first bearing structure electrically connects the printed circuit board and the conductive portion. In addition to this, various embodiments identified through the specification are possible.
abstract_ko: 전자 장치가 개시된다. 본 문서에 개시되는 일 실시 예에 따른 전자 장치는, 표면에 복수의 관통 홀이 형성되는 하우징; 상기 하우징의 상기 표면에 회전 가능하도록 결합되는 휠 부재, 상기 휠 부재는 도전성 부분을 포함함; 상기 하우징 내부에 배치되는 인쇄 회로 기판; 및 상기 휠 부재의 회전을 지지하기 위해, 적어도 일부가 상기 관통 홀의 내부에 배치되는 제1 베어링 구조, 상기 제1 베어링 구조는 상기 인쇄 회로 기판과 상기 도전성 부분을 전기적으로 연결함; 을 포함할 수 있다. 이 외에도 명세서를 통해 파악되는 다양한 실시 예가 가능하다.

title_en: Life detection radar system based on multi-domain multi-feature and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection radar system based on multi-domain multi-feature and deep learning, wherein the signal output end of a receiving and transmitting channel is respectively connected with the signal input end of a pulse pressure pre-life body recognition module and the signal input end of a pulse pressure preprocessing module, the signal output end of the pulse pressure preprocessing module is respectively connected with the signal input end of a pulse pressure post-life body recognition module and the signal input end of an imaging-based life body detection position recognition module, and the pulse pressure pre-life body recognition module, the pulse pressure post-life body recognition module and the imaging-based life body detection position recognition module are all connected with a sparse self-coding network and a logistic regression classifier. The method is used for radar life detection, solves the outstanding problems of low recognition efficiency and low accuracy caused by adopting a manually designed feature extraction method and only using a time-frequency combined domain as a feature extraction domain in the existing life detection radar target recognition technology, and meets the practical requirement of quick search and rescue of trapped personnel in disaster ruins such as earthquakes, landslides and the like.

title_en: Vital sign sensing method and system using a communication device
abstract_en: Vital sign sensing method and system using a communication device are disclosed in the present invention. An EVM algorithm is performed on a demodulated in-phase signal and a demodulated quadrature-phase signal output from an IQ demodulator for extracting a vital-sign signal of a subject. Any communication device can still preserve communication function while being used as a vital sign sensor, no other hardware architecture is required. The vital sign sensing method and system can overcome the shortcoming of signal interference between the conventional active sensing system and the communication device and also can reduce the construction costs of noncontact vital sign sensing system significantly.

title_en: Multi-person vital sign detection method based on improved robust adaptive beam forming
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-person vital sign detection method based on improved robust self-adaptive beam forming, which comprises the following steps: acquiring radar receiving signals, and estimating the angles of the human bodies and the angle intervals occupied by the human bodies by adopting a direction-of-arrival estimation algorithm; one human body echo is made to be a desired signal, the other human bodies are made to be interference signals, and an improved epsilon constraint value-based method is adopted to reconstruct a covariance matrix; reconstructing a steering vector of the expected signal direction by adopting an improved method based on a zeta constraint value; obtaining a weight value by utilizing an adaptive beam forming algorithm; the method of the maximum signal-to-noise ratio search is adopted to obtain ideal weight and respiratory signals; repeating the steps to obtain all human respiratory signals. The method improves the robust beam forming algorithm from the scene of vital sign detection, and the improved robust self-adaptive beam forming method is effective and feasible, has reliable performance and can accurately extract vital sign signals of each human body.

title_en: Wifi-based human body detection method, and smart device
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a Wi-Fi based human body detection method, which includes selecting a sub-carrier data source device by a smart device, acquiring sub-carrier channel frequency responses, checking and filtering out invalid sub-carrier channel frequency responses, obtaining sub-carrier amplitudes, and grouping to obtain a plurality of datasets. Each data set is divided into multiple sub-datasets according to different parts of the sub-carrier channel frequency responses, and then for each sub-dataset, a correlation coefficient between the sub-carrier amplitudes is calculated, to obtain a human body presence detection value; a Mahalanobis distance or a Euclidean distance between the sub-carrier amplitudes is calculated to obtain a human activity detection value; in conjunction of a human activity threshold and a human presence threshold, a state of a human body sign is determined and reported to a cloud server. The present disclosure also includes a smart device for implementing the above method.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitoring radar equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a non-contact vital sign guards radar equipment includes radar radio frequency equipment, connector, ARM treater and signal transmission equipment, radar radio frequency equipment passes through the connector with the ARM treater is connected, signal transmission equipment with the ARM treater is connected, radar radio frequency equipment includes radar crystal oscillator, receiving antenna, transmitting antenna and radar chip, receiving antenna reaches transmitting antenna all with the radar chip is connected, the signal that radar crystal oscillator produced makes the inside broadband microwave signal that produces of radar chip, and pass through the transmitting antenna transmission, receiving antenna receives the return signal. The utility model discloses can realize human vital sign monitoring function, monitor human from multiple human signs such as the distance of equipment, respiratory rate, rhythm of the heart, equipment return signal intensity size contactlessly.
assignees: SENSEWORLD TECH CO LIMITED DONGSHENG NANXIANG

title_en: Apparatus for monitoring position of underground power distribution line
title_ko: 특고압 지중 배전선로의 위치 감시 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a position monitoring apparatus for an extra-high voltage underground distribution line. A light receiving part of a flooding monitoring sensor is stored and installed in a waterproof floodlighting casing buried in the floor of an underground power tunnel to promptly start monitoring on flooding when flooding actually starts to occur in the underground power tunnel, thereby enabling real time flooding monitoring, and certainly preventing damage caused by flooding. Also, the quantity of polarized light received by a light receiving part through first and second linear polarization discs is controlled in accordance with characteristics of a light emitting part and the light receiving part, thereby effectively inspecting a flooding monitoring sensor. Also, a motor constituting a flooding monitoring sensor inspection part is installed on an installation position of the flooding monitoring sensor spaced upward apart from the floor of the underground power tunnel to prevent the malfunction of the motor caused by flooding. Also, since a low-priced general motor can be used without the use of a high-priced waterproof motor, costs for installation can be reduced.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 특고압 지중 배전선로의 위치 감시 장치에 관한 것으로, 침수감시센서의 수광부는 전력구 바닥에 매설된 방수투광케이싱 내에 수납 설치하여 실제 전력구에 침수가 시작되면 곧바로 침수에 대한 감시가 이루어지게 하여 침수감시가 실시간으로 이루어지며, 침수로 인한 피해를 확실하게 방지할 수 있고, 발광부와 수광부의 특성에 따라 제1 선편광원판과 제2 선편광원판을 통과하여 수광부에 수광되는 편광 빛의 광량을 조절함으로써 침수감시센서를 효과적으로 점검할 수 있으며, 침수감시센서 점검부를 구성하는 모터를 전력구 바닥에서 상부로 이격된 침수감시센서의 설치 위치에 설치하여 침수로 인한 모터의 고장을 방지할 수 있게 되며, 고가의 방수모터를 사용하지 않고 저렴한 일반모터를 사용할 수 있으므로 설치비용이 절감될 수 있도록 한 것이다.

title_en: Gesture-based disaster response device and method
title_ko: 제스처 기반의 재난대응 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a gesture-based disaster response device and a method. The device includes: a situation information collection unit for receiving an operation signal and a biosignal for disaster response from a wearable terminal including a plurality of sensors which are attached to a user's body and are operated; a gesture recognition unit for recognizing a user's gesture according to a change pattern of the operation signal based on a location characteristic according to a location of a user; a disaster occurrence detector configured to monitor the presence or absence of abnormalities in the biosignal according to the gesture to detect the occurrence of a disaster related to the user; and a disaster response processing unit which propagates disaster information including the user's location and requests a control server to proceed with emergency rescue, in case the occurrence of the disaster is detected.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 제스처 기반의 재난대응 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 상기 장치는 사용자의 신체에 부착되어 동작하는 복수의 센서들을 포함하는 웨어러블 단말로부터 재난 대응을 위한 동작 신호 및 생체 신호를 수신하는 상황 정보 수집부, 상기 사용자의 위치에 따른 장소 특성을 기초로 상기 동작 신호의 변화 패턴에 따라 상기 사용자의 제스처를 인식하는 제스처 인식부, 상기 제스처에 따른 생체 신호의 이상 유무를 모니터링하여 상기 사용자에 관한 재난 발생을 검출하는 재난 발생 검출부 및 상기 재난 발생이 검출된 경우 상기 사용자의 위치를 포함하는 재난 정보를 전파하고 관제 서버에 긴급 구조의 진행을 요청하는 재난 대응 처리부를 포함한다.

title_en: Non-contact intestinal disease diagnostic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact intestinal disease diagnosis device, comprising: the data acquisition module is used for acquiring radar echo signals by using a non-contact vital sign monitoring radar; the preprocessing module is used for processing the radar echo signal by adopting a band-pass filter; the signal separation module is used for processing the preprocessed signals by adopting a signal separation algorithm to separate intestinal motility signals; the characteristic extraction module is used for extracting the characteristics of the separated intestinal motility signals to obtain characteristic parameters which are beneficial to judging different intestinal conditions, and the machine learning module is used for determining a mapping model between the intestinal conditions and the characteristic parameters by utilizing a machine learning algorithm; and the intestinal disease judgment module judges the intestinal diseases according to the mapping model. The method is effective and feasible, has reliable performance, and can accurately judge the intestinal diseases.

title_en: Non-contact intestinal motility signal feature extraction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact intestinal motility signal feature extraction method and a non-contact intestinal motility signal feature extraction system, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the data acquisition module is used for acquiring radar echo signals by using a non-contact vital sign monitoring radar; the preprocessing module is used for processing the radar echo signal by adopting a band-pass filter; the signal separation module is used for processing the preprocessed signals by adopting a signal separation algorithm to separate gastric motility signals, intestinal motility signals, respiration signals and heartbeat signals; and the characteristic extraction module is used for extracting the characteristics of the separated intestinal motility signals to obtain characteristic parameters which are beneficial to judging different intestinal conditions.

title_en: Vital sign extraction method based on dual-source IR-UWB biological radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign extraction method based on a dual-source IR-UWB biological radar, which is used for separating broadband signals and narrowband signals in radar echoes by combining a self-adaptive spectral line enhancement algorithm through a dual-channel cross-correlation signal enhancement technology of the dual-source UWB biological radar so as to realize the extraction of human respiratory signals in an unnatural state. The invention establishes a model for simulating an unnatural human body by tying a pneumatic tourniquet belt on the human body, and the model can quantitatively control and simulate human body targets with different pressed parts.

title_en: Point type temperature-sensing fire detector convenient to install
abstract_en: The utility model provides a point type temperature sensing fire detector convenient to installation belongs to fire-fighting equipment technical field, and this point type temperature sensing fire detector convenient to installation includes the protective housing, the lower fixed surface of protective housing is connected with the shell, the gas pocket is seted up to the upper surface of shell, it has the heat conduction post to peg graft in the center of shell upper surface, the one end fixedly connected with thermal-arrest piece of heat conduction post, the other end fixedly connected with hot detector of heat conduction post, the last fixed surface of hot detector is connected with the fixed plate, carry out fixed connection between the both ends of fixed plate and the inner wall of shell. Through the heat collecting sheet, the heat conduction post and the thermal detector that set up, absorb the heat through the heat collection sheet and pass through the heat conduction post heat conduction to the heat sensing detector when the conflagration breaing out to can report to the police the conflagration, through buckle and the draw-in groove that sets up, can be convenient install the pre-buried box to the shell on, thereby solved and installed inconvenient problem among the prior art.
assignees: HUBEI DONGJIU FIRE FIGHTING SYSTEM ENG CO LTD

title_en: Radio frequency life detection radar system
abstract_en: Trapped or confined individuals may be located and rescued by detecting their vital signs (e.g., chest movement or heart beat) using reflected, radio frequency signals over a range of multiple antenna polarities.
assignees: GHAFFARI NIK HOSSEIN;FRASER DESMOND A;PEIXOTO NATHALIA

title_en: Underground cable position determining and imaging method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining and imaging the position of an underground cable, which comprises a ground penetrating radar and a position determining system, wherein the position determining system comprises a data processing module, an electromagnetic signal analysis module, a signal receiving module and display equipment, the ground penetrating radar is electrically connected with the signal receiving module through a wire, the signal receiving module is electrically connected with the data processing module through the electromagnetic signal analysis module, and the data processing module is electrically connected with the display equipment; the invention utilizes the penetrating electromagnetic wave to detect the buried cable, realizes the reconstruction and imaging of the shape and the space position of the direct current cable by collecting and analyzing the reflected echo signal of the electromagnetic wave and combining the three-dimensional imaging technology, simplifies the direct current cable into line current, can obtain the space coordinate and the shape of the direct current cable, and can visually display through the reconstructed image.
assignees: JINAN POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;SHANDONG ANLAN POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic fire extinguishing system for parking lot
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic fire extinguishing system for a parking lot, which comprises a lifting module, a fireproof and waterproof soft fence, a water spraying system, a drainage system, a control system and a temperature sensor, wherein the fireproof and waterproof soft fence is pre-buried in a parking area, the fireproof and waterproof soft fence is positioned around the parking area and extends towards the upper part of the parking area to form a cuboid fence type structure, positioning mounting points are arranged at four corners of the parking area along the upper edge after the fence type structure is erected, the lifting module is also arranged at the four corners of the parking area, the positioning mounting points are connected with the lifting module, storage grooves are formed in the periphery of the parking area, and the lifting module can drive the fireproof and waterproof soft fence to be lifted to form the cuboid fence type structure or be folded and stored in the storage grooves. The intelligent car fire-fighting water-saving system can automatically control the temperature to sense whether the car is on fire or not, isolate the car from the outside through the fireproof and waterproof soft fence, and can automatically spray water to extinguish fire and drain water, so that the intelligent degree is higher, and the safety is stronger.
assignees: SHENZHEN QIANHAI XIANGBOBO INTELLIGENT DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Clutter suppression method for holographic penetration imaging radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a clutter suppression method for a holographic penetration imaging radar. The technical scheme is as follows: firstly, carrying out singular value decomposition on received holographic penetration imaging radar echo data; then, solving a reconstruction coefficient matrix by taking the maximum Target Clutter Ratio (TCR) as a criterion; and finally, calculating echo data after clutter suppression by using the solved reconstruction coefficient matrix. The method can effectively inhibit clutter components in the echo data of the holographic penetration imaging radar, simultaneously reserve target information, and realize the enhanced imaging of the buried weak target in the medium.

title_en: Fire control extinguishing device based on thing networking
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of Internet of things fire fighting, and discloses a fire fighting device based on the Internet of things, which comprises a pre-buried base, wherein the top of the pre-buried base is connected with a box cover through a bolt, a connecting pipe is fixedly connected inside the box cover, an automatic fire fighting mechanism is arranged inside the pre-buried base, the surface of a connecting arm is fixedly connected with an alarm through a bolt, the bottom of the connecting arm is fixedly connected with a small infrared induction camera through a bolt, and the bottom end of the automatic fire fighting mechanism is provided with a protection mechanism. This fire control extinguishing device based on thing networking utilizes automatic fire extinguishing mechanism and protection machanism, reaches the effect that the shower nozzle was automatic to be looked for the ignition and carries out the pertinence to put out a fire, sprays the different thing of putting out a fire to different sources of a fire simultaneously and reaches the effect of putting out a fire, improves the efficiency of putting out a fire, has ensured the security when putting out a fire simultaneously, further reaches avoiding the inside effect of mosquito dust entering shower nozzle.
assignees: GUANGZHOU BINGWU NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Buried ground disaster monitoring device capable of guaranteeing timely response
abstract_en: The invention discloses a buried type ground disaster monitoring device capable of guaranteeing timely reaction, which comprises a mounting plate, a storage battery body, a data receiving and sending device, a central processing unit and a double-shaft driving device, wherein a buried pipe is welded on the lower side of an opening in the middle of the mounting plate, a supporting pipe is mounted on the upper side of the opening in the middle of the mounting plate through a bolt, a photovoltaic plate body is mounted on the inner side of the mounting frame, the storage battery body is arranged on the inner side wall of the lower end of the supporting pipe, a microseismic sensor is arranged below the central processing unit, the double-shaft driving device is mounted inside the upper end of the mounting frame through a bolt, and a movable frame is connected to the outer side of the upper end of the mounting frame in a clamping manner. This can guarantee to react bury formula ground disaster monitoring device in time has solved the photovoltaic board clearance problem, guarantees the cleanliness factor of photovoltaic board, makes the photovoltaic board be in good operating condition, guarantees battery power storage, ensures that equipment is in charged state all the time, can real-time supervision.

title_en: Emergency window breaking device for automobile safety protection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an urgent broken window device of car safety protection belongs to emergent escape apparatus technical field, an urgent broken window device of car safety protection include control processing module, alarm module, fire alarm module, vital sign alarm module, button module, communication module, speech synthesis module, broken window device in danger. The automatic window breaking is realized through the matching of the sensors of the alarm modules and the control processing module, the manual window breaking is realized through the button module, and the window breaking device is driven to act by the communication module and the rear-end equipment through three means of realizing remote window breaking, so that the personal safety of personnel in the vehicle is effectively guaranteed.

title_en: Test device for performance evaluation under action of dislocation load of buried pressurizing pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test device for performance evaluation under the action of a dislocation load of a buried pressurizing pipeline, which comprises a bracket, a separable box body, a pipeline, a loading assembly, an angle adjusting assembly, a pressurizing assembly and a data acquisition assembly, wherein the detachable box body is provided with a loading hole; the separable box body comprises a fixed end box body and a sliding end box body, the lower part of the bracket is fixed on the rigid floor, and the upper part of the bracket is fixedly connected with the fixed end box body of the separable box body; two ends of the pipeline are respectively and fixedly connected with two ends of the separable box body; the end part of the pipeline is connected with a pressurizing assembly, and the loading assembly is connected with a sliding end box body of the separable box body and is used for realizing axial and oblique dislocation loading of the box body; the data acquisition assembly comprises a pressure sensor, a DIC, an electromagnetic flowmeter, a dynamic acquisition instrument, a computer terminal and the like. The invention can realize accurate and convenient measurement of the three-dimensional space behavior of the pipeline under the action of the earthquake.

title_en: System of alarm and leakage detecting for underground hot water pipe
title_ko: 지하 열배관 누수감지 및 경보 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for detecting leakage of an underground heat pipe and issuing an alarm thereof. According to the present invention, the system comprises: a bimetal sensor installed at a junction or a connection part of a heat pipe buried underground and operated when the temperature of the junction exceeds a predetermined critical temperature to control switching; a temperature sensor operated only in a dangerous situation by the operation of the bimetal sensor to detect the temperature of the junction or connection part of the heat pipe; an Arduino unit; and a system server.
abstract_ko:
[기술분야/해결과제]   
본 발명은 지하 열배관 누수감지 및 경보 시스템에 관한 것으로, 지하에 매설된 열배관의 점검인원이 턱없이 부족하여 제대로 점검이 이루어지지 않고 있으며, 사람의 육안으로 점검이 이루어지다보니 오류가 많고 정확한 점검이 어려우며, 점검 및 유지관리에 비용이 많이 소요되는 문제점을 해결하기 위한 것이다. 
 [해결수단]
