본 발명에 의한 지하 열배관 누수감지 및 경보 시스템은, 지중에 매설된 열배관의 접합부분 또는 접속부분에 설치되며, 상기 접합부의 온도가 소정의 임계 온도를 초과했을 때 작동하여 스위칭을 제어하는 바이메탈 센서; 상기 열배관의 접합부분 또는 접속부분에 배관 둘레를 따라 병렬로 복수로 설치되며, 상기 바이메탈 센서의 작동에 의해 위험 상황에서만 동작하여 상기 열배관의 접합부분 또는 접속부분의 온도를 감지하는 온도 센서; 상기 온도 센서가 설치된 부근의 열배관에 설치되며, 상기 온도 센서의 감지 데이터와 상기 열배관의 위치정보와 일련번호를 묶은 데이터 리스트를 로라(LoRa) 통신을 통해 전송하는 아두이노; 및 상기 아두이노로부터 로라(LoRa) 통신을 통해 상기 데이터 리스트를 수신받고, 상기 데이터 리스트에 포함된 상기 열배관의 감지 데이터를 분석하여 열배관의 파열 조짐을 미리 예측하고, 상기 열배관의 파열로 판단되면 사고내용과 사고위치가 포함된 긴급 재난 문자를 발송하는 시스템 서버;를 포함한다. 
 [기대효과]   
본 발명에 따르면, 열배관 파열에 따른 누수를 실시간으로 감지할 수 있고 감시 인력과 시스템의 운영 비용을 크게 감소시킬 수 있다. 또한, 열배관의 감지 데이터 분석에 의해 파열 조짐을 미리 예측할 수 있고, 파열이 발생한 열배관의 위치정보를 제공함에 따라 위험상황에 대한 정확한 지령을 전달할 수 있다.

title_en: Graphene-based life detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a graphene-based life detector which comprises an infrared sensor, a telescopic mechanical arm, a signal processing unit and an alarm, wherein the infrared sensor is fixed at the front end of the telescopic mechanical arm, and the infrared sensor and the alarm are respectively connected with the signal processing unit. The infrared sensor is a regular icosahedron structure consisting of triangles, the surface of the regular icosahedron structure is a photoelectric device consisting of a semiconductor, a plurality of graphene films and an infrared filter layer, the semiconductor is used as a substrate, the graphene films are laid on the semiconductor, and finally the infrared filter layer is plated. By the regular icosahedron substrate structure, life signs in the ruins after a natural disaster are searched for with as large a specific surface area as possible exposed to the environment. The response distance of the life detector is greatly improved, and meanwhile, the sensitivity and the use convenience of infrared response are also improved.

title_en: System and method for sensing with millimeter waves for sleep position detection, vital signs monitoring and/or driver detection
abstract_en: A sensor and method for sleep position detection including: a transmitter configured to transmit electromagnetic waves between 30 GHz and 300 GHz; a receiver configured to receive the electromagnetic waves from the transmitter, wherein the transmitter and receiver are positioned in relation to person sleeping such that the receiver receives reflected electromagnetic waves; and a control station configured to analyze the transmitted and received electromagnetic waves to determine a position of the person sleeping. In some cases, the method may include: forming a radar cube of results; performing a fast fourier transform (FFT) on the radar cube; applying a constant false alarm rate (CFAR) processor to the FFT data; determining a capon gradient; forming a 5-dimensional feature space based on the capon gradient; and conducting an optimization of SVM.

title_en: Object recognition method, object recognition device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an object identification method, an object identification device, a computer device and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an image to be recognized comprising the buried object to be recognized, inputting the image to be recognized into a target recognition model comprising a feature extraction submodel and an object recognition submodel, recognizing the buried object to be recognized in the image to be recognized through the feature extraction submodel and the object recognition submodel comprising a plurality of convolution layers, outputting a recognition result, and determining the type of the buried object to be recognized in the image to be recognized according to the recognition result output by the target recognition model. Compared with the traditional method for detecting the buried object in the ground penetrating radar image through Hough transform and the like, the method has the advantages that the buried object type in the image to be recognized is recognized by the aid of the characteristic extraction submodels and the object recognition submodels comprising the plurality of convolution layers, and accordingly the recognition accuracy of the buried object is improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU BUREAU EXTRA HIGH VOLTAGE TRANSMISSION CO CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle carried life detection equipment and detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses unmanned aerial vehicle carried life detection equipment and a detection method, wherein the detection equipment comprises sky end detection radar equipment and ground end display control equipment, and the sky end detection radar equipment comprises an antenna, a radio frequency module and a baseband processing module; the radio frequency module comprises a digital frequency synthesizer or a phase-locked loop, a power amplifier, a circulator, a low-noise amplifier, a combiner, a mixer, a band-pass filter, a gain-controllable amplifier, an amplitude limiter, an analog-digital converter and an antenna, wherein the digital frequency synthesizer or the phase-locked loop, the power amplifier, the circulator and the antenna form a transmitting channel; the antenna, the circulator, the low noise amplifier, the combiner, the mixer, the band-pass filter, the gain controllable amplifier, the amplitude limiter and the analog-digital converter form a receiving channel. The detection device is small in size and light in weight, is carried on the unmanned aerial vehicle to realize large-area rapid detection of trapped people, and has stronger environmental adaptability and applicability.

title_en: Vital-sign radar sensor using a wireless frequency-locked loop
abstract_en: A vital-sign radar sensor using wireless frequency-locked loop includes a voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO), an antenna component, a mixer, a loop filter and a frequency demodulation component. The VCO outputs an oscillation signal to the antenna component via a output port, the antenna component transmits the oscillation signal to a subject as a transmitted signal and receives a reflected signal from the subject as a received signal, the mixer receives and mix the oscillation signal and the received signal into a mixed signal, the loop filter receives and filter the mixed signal to output a filtered signal, the filtered signal is delivered to the VCO via a tuning port, the frequency demodulation component receives and demodulates the oscillation signal to output a vital-sign signal.

title_en: Real-time monitoring and care system
title_ko: 실시간 모니터링 및 돌봄 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a real-time monitoring and care system. The real-time monitoring and care system includes: a sensor part generating sensing information by sensing the sleep condition and movement of a care target person (an infant, a child, an elderly person, an inpatient or a handicapped person) and whether a door is open; a gateway transmitting the sensing information to a manager terminal connected through an information communication network; and the manager terminal monitoring the sensing information by classifying the same by care target person, while generating relief activity request information when the sensing information is out of a preset reference value. In accordance with the present invention, the system senses one biometric signal among the heart rate, breathing rate, tossing-and-turning, and apnea of the care target person through a sleep tracking pad in real time based on Internet of things (IoT), and senses one motion signal among whether the care target person presses an emergency bell or whether a door is open, while checking an emergency situation, in which the care target person presses the emergency bell, in real time even remotely, and enabling prompt action by situation in an untact manner.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 실시간 모니터링 및 돌봄 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 관리대상자(영유아, 어린이, 노약자, 입원환자 또는 장애인)의 수면상태, 움직임 및 도어 개폐 여부를 감지하여 감지정보를 생성하는 센서부; 감지정보들을 정보통신망을 통해 접속된 관리자 단말기로 전송하는 게이트웨이; 및 감지정보를 관리대상자별로 분류하여 모니터링하되, 감지정보가 기 설정된 기준값을 벗어나는 경우 구호활동 요청정보를 생성하는 관리자 단말기를 포함하되, 센서부는 관리대상자의 심박수, 무호흡 여부 및 뒤척임 정도를 계측하여 수치화한 감지정보를 생성하는 수면 추적 패드; 관리대상자의 댁내에 기 설정된 범위마다 설치되어 관리대상자의 움직임을 인식하여 감지정보를 생성하는 모션센서; 및 관리대상자 댁내 문의 손잡이 또는 경첩에 설치되어 도어 개폐 여부에 따른 감지정보를 생성하는 도어센서를 포함한다. 
상기와 같은 본 발명에 따르면, 사물인터넷(IoT)를 기반으로 실시간으로 수면 추적 패드를 통해 관리대상자의 심박수, 호흡수, 뒤척임 또는 무호흡 중에 어느 하나의 생체신호를 감지하고, 관리대상자의 응급벨 호출 여부 또는 문열림 감지 중에 어느 하나의 모션신호를 감지하되, 감지된 측정 데이터가 비정상이거나, 관리대상자가 응급벨을 호출하는 경우 등 관리대상자의 위급상황을 원격지에서도 실시간 확인이 가능하고, 비대면으로 상황별로 즉각적인 대처가 가능한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Search and rescue robot for coal mine
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of search and rescue instruments, in particular to a search and rescue robot for coal mines, which comprises a device main body, a mobile device and a search and rescue device, wherein the mobile device comprises a driving wheel, a driven wheel, a supporting wheel, a crawler belt, a supporting column, a left driving motor and a right driving motor, the search and rescue device comprises a lighting lamp, a thermal imaging camera, a sound wave life detection instrument, a communication module, a signal receiver and a traction ring, the climbing capability of the device is stronger and the device is adaptive to various terrains by additionally arranging the supporting wheel obliquely above the driving wheel, trapped persons can see the light to find the search and rescue device by installing the lighting lamp at the forefront, the trapped persons can also find the trapped persons in the unclear environment by installing the thermal imaging camera on a rotatable telescopic rod, the trapped persons can hear search and rescue voice and can communicate with the search and rescue persons to relieve tension to a certain degree by installing the communication module, the device can be remotely controlled by installing the controller and the signal receiver.
assignees: ANHUI DERUI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for calculating positions of trapped persons based on CFD (computational fluid dynamics) adjoint probability method
abstract_en: A trapped person position calculation method based on a CFD (computational fluid dynamics) adjoint probability method comprises the steps of 1, constructing a loose porous medium type ruin simplified physical model; step 2, obtaining a steady-state flow field through CFD forward simulation; step 3, collecting monitoring information of monitoring points of the sensor; step 4, solving an adjoint equation based on CFD for each monitoring alarm position to obtain a standard reverse position probability; step 5, solving a joint position probability equation to obtain a joint reverse position probability; step 6, solving a conditional reverse position probability equation and a multiple conditional reverse position probability equation to obtain a conditional reverse position probability; step 7 identifies the source location from the reverse location probability distribution. According to the method, the vital sign representative gas collected along the path of the monitoring point of the sensor by the instantaneous time sequence is combined, the collected data is analyzed by the cascaded large-scale monitoring point of the sensor, and the search and rescue workers track and trace the source by the gas inversion theory to judge the condition and the approximate position of the trapped personnel.

title_en: Fire rescue method, device and system based on radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire rescue method based on a radar, which is applied to a fire rescue system, wherein the fire rescue system comprises the radar and a prompting device, the prompting device is used for outputting or forming a corresponding path, and the fire rescue method comprises the following steps: detecting the detection range by using a radar and acquiring an echo signal; extracting vital sign information and a motion trail of a detection target from the echo signal; acquiring the number of detection targets according to the vital sign information of the detection targets; acquiring position information of a radar; planning a first rescue path according to the motion track and the number of the detection targets and the position information of the radar; and controlling the prompting device to prompt the first rescue path. In addition, the invention also provides a fire rescue device and a fire rescue system. According to the technical scheme, fire rescue can be assisted when a fire disaster occurs.

title_en: Method for detecting life information through non-contact wall
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for detecting life information by non-contact wall penetration, which comprises the following steps: denoising a target signal to be detected; processing the signal in the fast time dimension direction of the denoised target signal to be detected by adopting the EEMD to obtain a first IMFs set; locating characteristic time exponential sampling points in a first set of IMFs; processing the signal in the slow time dimension direction of the denoised target signal by adopting the EEMD to obtain a second IMFs set of characteristic time index sampling points in the slow time dimension direction, and constructing a second IMFs set matrix; and acquiring signals which meet the respiration rate characteristic and the heart rate characteristic in the second IMFs set matrix, and finding out corresponding respiration signals and heart rate signals. The method and the device can remove the fixed background noise in the radar receiving echo signal, can utilize the through-wall detection function of the radar receiving echo signal, and adopt non-contact detection to realize detection of the life information.

title_en: Life detection method based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention provides a life detection method based on a neural network, which comprises the following steps: at a certain distance from the earth's surface, the airborne life detection radar transmits detection signals and receives echoes, such as echoes of subsurface life signals, the earth's surface and other interference signals; preprocessing an echo signal received by an airborne radar; carrying out Fourier transform on the preprocessed signals and constructing a neural network data set; preprocessing the constructed neural network data set; and (3) building a neural network and training a test neural network model, and effectively distinguishing life signals, strong earth surface echoes and other interference signals so as to detect whether life signs exist under the earth surface. The method provided by the invention can be used for detecting the vital signals more effectively and has stronger environmental adaptability.

title_en: Life detection radar weak target detection method based on state prediction accumulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection radar weak target detection method based on state prediction accumulation, which comprises the following steps: discretizing the received multi-frame echo signals; detecting each frame of discrete echo signals according to a first detection threshold; constructing a target motion model and a target measurement model; constructing a target accumulation function according to the target motion model and the target measurement model; updating the state transition set of each frame of echo detection signal according to the speed constraint threshold and the prediction constraint threshold; calculating a target accumulation function value for each frame of echo detection signals according to the updated state transition set and the target accumulation function; judging a target according to a second detection threshold and a target accumulation function value; and backtracking the target estimation track according to the target accumulation function value. The invention sets the first detection threshold to filter noise interference, and sets the speed constraint threshold and the forecast constraint threshold to filter state information with high conformity with the target state, thereby reducing the arithmetic operation amount and improving the target detection performance.

title_en: Life signal monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life signal monitoring method based on a millimeter wave radar, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the data acquisition module comprises the millimeter wave radar, the millimeter wave radar transmits a frequency modulation signal, a human chest cavity reflects an echo signal, and data are finally transmitted to the data processing module through a mixer and a sampler which are integrated by the millimeter wave radar; the data processing module processes the intermediate frequency signals in the data sent by the data acquisition module through background noise filtering, phase extraction, respiration and heartbeat separation, respiration and heartbeat reconstruction, distance and frequency separation and calculation reduction methods to obtain the heart rate, the respiration and the displacement distance of the human thorax; the follow-up application module acquires data and processes the data in real time through multiple processes, uploads the data to the cloud server, and utilizes the GUI to visualize the heart rate, the respiration and the displacement distance of the human chest, so that a guardian can conveniently check the data at any time.

title_en: Method for detecting underground cavity around non-metal pipeline by using in-hole radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for detecting underground cavities around a non-metal pipeline by using an in-hole radar, which is characterized in that the underground cavities around the non-metal pipeline are detected by using ground penetrating radar equipment with an in-hole radar antenna, the in-hole radar antenna enters the non-metal pipeline and moves forwards along the non-metal pipeline through the dragging of a rope from downstream, and transmits and receives electromagnetic wave signals, the in-hole radar antenna is connected with a ground radar receiver through a relay cable, the received radar signals are transmitted to the radar receiver and stored, and the underground cavities around the non-metal pipeline are judged according to radar reflected wave signals and the characteristics of a same phase axis. The invention effectively solves the problems that the pipeline cannot be effectively detected on the ground and personnel cannot detect the pipeline (the pipe diameter is small, the siltation is serious and the like) when the pipeline is deeply buried (the buried depth is more than 5m), has high detection efficiency and good detection effect (equivalent to short-distance detection), and avoids the safety problem caused by the personnel entering the underground pipeline.

title_en: Smart traffic signal lamp
title_ko: 스마트 교통신호봉
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart traffic signal rod. The smart traffic signal rod according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: an LED unit in which an LED light bulb is formed on the top of the smart traffic signal rod; a handle provided at the lower end of the LED unit; a self-generation battery unit provided inside the LED unit to convert kinetic energy to generate power; and a biosignal detection sensor provided on the outside of the handle to sense the biosignal of an operator.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트 교통신호봉에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 실시 예에 따른 스마트 교통신호봉은, 스마트 교통신호봉의 상단에 LED전구가 형성되는 LED부; 상기 LED부의 하단으로 마련되는 손잡이부; 상기 LED부의 내측에 마련되어 　 운동에너지를 변환하여 전력을 생산하도록 구비되는 자가발전 배터리부; 및 상기 손잡이부의 외측에 마련되어 작업자의 생체신호를 감지하도록　구비되는 생체신호 감지센서를 포함하여 구성될 수 있다.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle with laser radar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a take laser radar's unmanned aerial vehicle, the reciprocating impact tunnel drilling machine comprises a machine body, the bottom fixed connection of fuselage is at the top middle part of goods and materials box, the front end upper portion both sides of goods and materials box all are connected with the upside of apron through the hinge, be provided with first aid medical kit, food, tinfoil blanket, satellite phone and drinking water in the goods and materials box, the lower extreme middle part fixedly connected with camera of goods and materials box, lower extreme middle part one side fixedly connected with laser radar of goods and materials box, the lower extreme middle part opposite side fixedly connected with life detection instrument of goods and materials box. The utility model discloses in, unmanned aerial vehicle searches after the personnel of being in distress, descends by stranded personnel, and stranded personnel can open the goods and materials box and take goods and materials this moment, can postpone the danger of stranded personnel and meet the situation, and help rescue team strives for the valuable rescue time, through laser radar, life detection instrument cooperation camera, can search the position of fixing a position stranded personnel fast, improves search and rescue efficiency, is worth wideling popularize.
assignees: JIANGXI INST OF SOIL AND WATER CONSERVATION

title_en: Fire rescue helmet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting rescue helmet, which comprises a helmet body, a control mechanism, a battery, a lighting lamp, a camera, a hot boot, an infrared night vision device, a micro projector, a protective mask, a microphone and an earphone, wherein the control mechanism comprises a PCB (printed circuit board), a central processing unit, a vital sign monitoring device, a GPS (global positioning system) positioning chip, a temperature sensor, a humidity sensor, an infrared gas sensor and a 5G chip, and the fire-fighting rescue helmet can determine the position and the vital sign condition of trapped personnel, discover toxic and harmful gas in a disaster site in time and provide fire-fighting rescue information for individual fire-fighting rescue personnel through communication with a fire-fighting rescue command center, thereby avoiding individual rescue of each fire-fighting rescue personnel, better protecting the safety of the personnel, improving the fire-fighting and rescue efficiency, and projecting the received rescue auxiliary information onto the protective mask, the surrounding environment can be fully known, the rescue success rate is improved, and meanwhile the safety of rescuers can be better guaranteed.

title_en: Deep buried pipe detection device based on ultra wide band radar technology
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a deep hidden pipe detection device based on ultra wide band radar technique, include the frame and fix the detection instrument body on the frame, the one end of frame is equipped with two bracing pieces, the both ends of two bracing pieces fixedly connected with handle and connecting axle respectively. The utility model discloses in, detecting device is provided with the frame, be provided with detection instrument body and bracing piece on the frame, be provided with handle and connecting axle on the bracing piece, be provided with the casing on the connecting axle, the inside of casing is provided with the ratchet, pawl and elastic component, the pawl bottom is provided with the footboard, the ratchet blocks through the pawl during use, make the bracing piece fix on different positions, make things convenient for the height of different users regulation handle, simultaneously through pressing down the footboard, drive the pawl and break away from the ratchet, the contrarotation bracing piece makes its top that is located the detection instrument body again, thereby save device's space, convenient transportation.
assignees: TR GEOPHYSICS TECH WUHAN CO LTD

title_en: MIMO through-wall radar imaging method based on two-dimensional minimum phase coherence factor
abstract_en: The invention provides a MIMO through-wall radar imaging method based on a two-dimensional minimum phase coherence factor, which comprises the steps of recording echo signals of K frequency points corresponding to an m-th transmitting array element and an n-th receiving array element through an MIMO antenna array element parallel to a wall body, removing background clutter signals in the echo signals by adopting a background cancellation method, calculating a phase coherence factor PCF and a range phase coherence factor RPCF according to phase diversity at a pixel point, calculating a two-dimensional minimum phase coherence factor according to the phase coherence factor and the range phase coherence factor, and weighting an FDBP imaging result to obtain a final imaging result; the MIMO through-the-wall radar imaging method provided by the invention can better integrate the advantages of PCF and RPCF, not only can effectively inhibit clutter interference, but also can further improve the resolution of an imaging reconstruction result, and is more beneficial to the detection and imaging of a hidden target behind a wall.

title_en: Noncontact vital sign detection apparatus of two adjacent targets using signal decomposition and method thereof
title_ko: 신호 분리를 이용한 근접한 두 표적의 비접촉식 생체 신호 탐지 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a noncontact vital sign detection apparatus for two adjacent targets using signal decomposition and a method thereof. According to the present invention, a vital sign detection method using a vital sign detection apparatus comprises the following steps: transmitting a radar transmission signal toward first and second targets close to each other and obtaining a radar reception signal in which signals reflected from each target are mixed; extracting an I-channel component and a Q-channel component from the radar reception signal; inputting the I-channel component and the Q-channel component to a preset signal separation function model to separate and extract a first phase component by the first target and a second phase component by the second target, which are mixed in the radar reception signal; and individually detecting a vital sign of the first target and a vital sign of the second target from results of processing the first phase component and the second phase component by fast Fourier transform (FFT), respectively. Accordingly, a mixed radar reception signal due to two targets disposed close to each other on the same distance is separated, thereby efficiently detecting a vital sign of each target.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 신호 분리를 이용한 근접한 두 표적의 비접촉식 생체 신호 탐지 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면, 생체 신호 탐지 장치를 이용한 생체 신호 탐지 방법에 있어서, 서로 근접한 제1 및 제2 표적을 향하여 송출 후 각 표적에서 반사되어 혼합 수신되는 레이다 수신 신호를 획득하는 단계와, 상기 레이다 수신 신호에서 I 채널 성분과 Q 채널 성분을 추출하는 단계와, 상기 I 채널 성분과 Q 채널 성분을 기 설정된 신호분리 함수 모델에 입력하여, 상기 레이다 수신 신호에 혼재된 제1 표적에 의한 제1 위상 성분과 제2 표적에 의한 제2 위상 성분을 분리 도출하는 단계, 및 상기 제1 위상 성분과 상기 제2 위상 성분을 각각 FFT(Fast Fourier Transform) 처리한 결과로부터 상기 제1 표적의 생체 신호와 제2 표적의 생체 신호를 개별 탐지하는 단계를 포함하는 생체 신호 탐지 방법을 제공한다. 
본 발명에 의하면, 동일 거리 상에 서로 근접하게 위치한 두 표적들로 인하여 혼합된 레이다 수신 신호를 분리하여 각 표적의 생체 신호를 보다 효율적으로 탐지할 수 있다.

title_en: Home occupant detection and monitoring system
abstract_en: A occupant detection and monitoring system has a sensor unit having a radio wave transmitter, a radio wave receiver, and a wireless transmitter configured to detect and receive vital signs of an occupant; a user interface having a microcontroller, a wireless receiver configured to receive the wireless signals transmitted from the sensor unit, a means for user input, and a network card; and a means for alerting occupants and third-parties to a triggering event; wherein the microcontroller, based upon logic, activates the alerting means at the triggering event. The sensor unit may be a camera that detects the presence of an individual and register their unique heart rhythm for identification purposes. This camera can be installed at the entry points of a home, behind the counter of a business near a cash register or at a bank or any other place that desires to use surveillance as a form of security. The sensor unit may be a light bulb that comprises the components of the sensor unit. The sensor unit may be a contactless vital sign monitor capable of remotely monitoring one or more vital signs.

title_en: Three-dimensional through-wall radar system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional through-wall radar system, which comprises a frequency source, a transmitter, a transmitting antenna, a receiving antenna, a receiver, a signal processing board and a power supply, wherein the frequency source, the transmitter and the receiver are integrated on the same PCB to form a radio frequency integrated board; the signal processing board is connected with the radio frequency integrated board through an inter-board connector; the power supply is fixed on the radio frequency integrated board and is directly connected with the signal processing board through a power supply interface; the transmitting antenna and the receiving antenna are both positioned on the periphery of the radio frequency integrated board. The invention has the advantages of simple and compact structure, light weight, simple, quick and reliable connection and the like.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Buried object identification device, buried object identification method, and exploration device
abstract_en: This buried object identification unit (3) comprises: a synthetic aperture processing unit (13) that when electromagnetic waves are emitted from a plurality of points toward a dielectric material (5) and then electromagnetic waves scattered by the dielectric material (5) or electromagnetic waves scattered by a buried object (6) existing in the dielectric material (5) are received , generates synthetic aperture radar images from wave data representing the respective electromagnetic waves that have been received; a position detection unit (14) that detects a position, at which the buried object (6) exists, on the basis of the intensity of a plurality of pixels constituting the synthetic aperture radar images generated by the synthetic aperture processing unit (13); and a buried object identification unit (15) that extracts a feature amount of a synthetic aperture radar image at the position detected by the position detection unit (14), among the synthetic aperture radar images generated by the synthetic aperture processing unit (13), and identifies, on the basis of the feature amount, whether or not the buried object (6) is a pipeline.

title_en: Ultra-wideband Doppler radar life detection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wideband Doppler radar life detection system, and belongs to the technical field of radars. The device comprises a transmitting module, a receiving module and a data processing module; the transmitting module and the receiving module keep signal synchronization; the transmitting module is used for transmitting electromagnetic radio frequency signals, the electromagnetic radio frequency signals are modulated by the tested life electromagnetic information to form echo signals, the receiving module is used for completing pretreatment of the received signals, the data processing module is used for carrying out data analysis on the pretreated received signals, and a weak signal detection mode based on stochastic resonance is adopted for realizing spectrum analysis and extraction of the signals, so that detection and capture of the weak life electromagnetic information are realized. And a bistable stochastic resonance detection mode of subsampling and parameter compensation is adopted for the received weak physiological characteristic signals, and frequency spectrum migration and enhancement processing of signals to be detected are realized by utilizing the difference of gain characteristics of bistable stochastic resonance on different frequency components.

title_en: Method And Apparatus for Vital Signal by Using Radar
title_ko: 레이더를 이용하여 바이탈 신호를 감지하는 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and a device for detecting a vital signal using a radar. An embodiment of the present invention provides a method and a device for detecting a vital signal using a radar, which use a continuous wave (CW) type radar signal to perform band-pass filtering from a received signal to a heartbeat frequency band, a respiration frequency band, and a heart movement frequency band, respectively, thereby accurately measuring a respiration rate, heart rate, and heart movement of a human body from the received signal.
abstract_ko:
레이더를 이용하여 바이탈 신호를 감지하는 방법 및 장치를 개시한다. 
본 실시예는 CW(Continuous Wave) 형태의 레이더 신호를 이용하여 수신된 수신 신호로부터 심박 주파수 대역 및 호흡 주파수 대역, 심장의 움직임 주파수 대역으로 각각 대역 통과 필터링하여 수신 신호로부터 인체의 호흡 수, 심박 수, 심장 움직임을 정확하게 측정할 수 있도록 하는 레이더를 이용하여 바이탈 신호를 감지하는 방법 및 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Reservoir landslide array type underwater deformation monitoring device and monitoring method
abstract_en: The application provides a reservoir landslide array type underwater deformation monitoring device and a monitoring method, wherein an anchorage is buried at an underwater monitoring point of a sliding body, and a floating shell is used for floating on the water surface; the GPS sensor is used for receiving and transmitting GPS signals to obtain the real-time position of the floating shell, the water temperature sensor is used for obtaining a water temperature time sequence, and the gravity wave meter is used for obtaining a water surface wave height time sequence; the upper end of the pull rope is fixedly connected with the floating shell through a displacement compensation mechanism, the lower end of the pull rope is fixedly connected with the anchorage, the displacement compensation mechanism is used for carrying out displacement compensation after the floating shell floats along with the wave, and the coding type displacement meter is used for measuring the real-time distance between the displacement meter and the anchorage. The technical scheme provided by the application has the beneficial effects that: the real-time three-dimensional coordinates of the underwater monitoring points are monitored by the buoy type monitor, so that the change of the underwater three-dimensional space coordinates of the landslide body can be accurately positioned. And recording related environmental factors in real time, and integrating functions of real-time information acquisition, storage, processing analysis, transmission and the like.

title_en: Miniature non-contact radar system for human body monitoring
abstract_en: A miniaturized non-contact radar system for human body monitoring, comprising: the invention adopts a radio frequency-baseband fusion cancellation full duplex radio frequency system architecture to construct a stray signal cancellation network for a received signal at a radio frequency end and a baseband end respectively, interference is reduced in two steps, thus the signal-to-noise ratio of the received signal is greatly improved, and non-contact accurate real-time perception of human vital signs and body subtle actions is realized.

title_en: Nuclear magnetic imaging detection equipment and method based on increased biological radar detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nuclear magnetic resonance, and discloses a nuclear magnetic imaging detection device based on increased biological radar detection. This nuclear magnetic imaging check out test set and method based on increase biological radar detects, can acquire the patient through biological radar and be carrying out the detailed respiratory wave and the pulse shock wave information of nuclear magnetic resonance inspection in-process, and can remove along with patient's removal, avoid appearing data loss or data detection deviation, be favorable to the vital sign change of real time monitoring person being examined, grasp the real-time vital sign change of patient when carrying out nuclear magnetic resonance, the doctor can further formulate the scheme according to patient's health, provide sufficient treatment judgement basis.

title_en: Multifunctional life detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multifunctional life detection instrument which comprises a control terminal, wherein the control terminal is electrically connected with a detection handle through a connecting wire, the detection handle is fixedly connected with a detector through a flexible wire, the detector comprises a detection shell, a bioelectricity sensor is fixedly arranged on the surface of the detection shell, a vibration sensor is fixedly arranged in the detection shell and positioned on the right side of the bioelectricity sensor, a lateral optical camera is fixedly arranged in the detection shell and positioned on the right side of the vibration sensor, a video processor is fixedly arranged on the inner side of the lateral optical camera, and a vertical optical camera extending to the right side of the detection shell is fixedly arranged on the right side of the video processor. According to the multifunctional life detector, the bioelectricity sensor senses an electric field generated by ultralow frequency electric waves emitted by a human body, the vibration sensor identifies sound emitted by trapped persons, the optical camera shoots scenes in the ruins, and the trapped persons in the ruins can be detected to the greatest extent by three detection modes.
assignees: SHENZHEN DINGGUANHENGTONG ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Systems and methods for remotely tracking life signs with a millimeter-wave radar
abstract_en: Systems and methods for monitoring life signs in a subject. A radar unit comprising generates raw data and a processor unit receives raw data and identifies oscillating signals in a series of arrays of complex values representing radiation reflected from each voxel of a target region during a given time segment. A phase vaue is determined for each voxel in each frame and a waveform representing phase changes over time for each voxel is generated. Voxels indicating an oscillating signal are selected and life sign parameters are extracted.

title_en: Detection robot based on machine vision
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a detection robot based on machine vision, including round platform shape main part, the both ends of a certain diameter of lower surface of main part are provided with first drive wheel and second drive wheel, the lower surface edge of main part still is provided with 4 universal wheels, central angle between two adjacent wheels in first drive wheel, second drive wheel and the universal wheel is 60 degrees, every the wheel top all is provided with camera module, camera module distributes in the side of main part. The utility model discloses can be through many cameras in the machine vision application of space modeling in coordination with two mesh stereovision, let survey rescue robot system performance function bigger, and can carry on multiple sensor and detection instrument to carry out vital sign through host computer remote control system and survey, provide useful on-the-spot information for disaster accident scene rescue.

title_en: Information transfer control method and equipment
title_ko: 정보 표시 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Provided are an information display method and a device. According to the present invention, the information display method includes the steps of: measuring a current bio-signal using a sensor; determining stress signal information based on a comparison result of the current bio-signal measured by the sensor and a reference bio-signal used for detecting a stress signal; determining an information display setting according to the stress signal information; and outputting visual information and/or auditory information according to the information display setting. Accordingly, it is possible to determine tendency of a user's health state and a risk of the health state early by converting the bio-signals into a database.
abstract_ko: 정보 표시 방법 및 장치가 제공된다. 본 개시에 따른 정보 표시 방법은, 센서를 이용하여 현재 생체 신호를 측정하는 단계, 상기 센서에 의하여 측정된 상기 현재 생체 신호와 스트레스 신호 감지에 사용되는 참조 생체 신호의 비교 결과에 기초하여, 스트레스 신호 정보를 결정하는 단계, 상기 스트레스 신호 정보에 따라 정보 표시 설정을 결정하는 단계, 및 상기 정보 표시 설정에 따라 시각 정보 및/또는 청각 정보를 출력하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Imaging method and system based on through-wall radar clutter suppression
abstract_en: The invention relates to an imaging method and system based on through-the-wall radar clutter suppression, comprising the following steps: acquiring an original echo signal received by a through-wall radar; imaging the original echo signal to determine an original image; determining discrete coefficients of pixel vectors of the original image according to the original image; sorting the pixel vectors of the original image according to the discrete coefficients to obtain the sorted pixel vectors; determining a stepping length according to the original image; determining a pixel elimination proportion according to the stepping length; determining a first elimination ratio by using the sorted pixel vectors and the pixel elimination ratio; determining a second elimination proportion according to the first elimination proportion and the pixel elimination proportion; and reproducing according to the pixel value corresponding to the second elimination proportion to obtain an imaging result. The method and the system provided by the invention improve the imaging quality by improving the inhibition effect of clutter and background pixel vectors.

title_en: Gateway-based situation monitoring system
abstract_en: To provide a gateway-based situation monitoring system capable of effectively observing an emergency situation that occurs in a house using non-contact, non-aware, and non-constrained IoT sensors.SOLUTION: A gateway-based situation monitoring system includes: a plurality of edge sensor terminals each installed in a specific space, connected by at least one wireless communication scheme, and collecting life signals generated in the specific space as monitoring information; a gateway terminal selectively connected to the plurality of edge sensor terminals by the at least one wireless communication scheme, receiving the life signal, and transmitting the signal to a cloud server; and a cloud server detecting the occurrence of an abnormal situation while monitoring the specific space by analyzing the life signal received from the gateway terminal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Robot for detecting and positioning fire scene and life
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire scene and life detection positioning robot, which comprises a base, wherein a cooling system is arranged in the base, a detection device is arranged on the base, and a moving device is arranged at the bottom of the base; the detection device comprises a shell arranged on the base, a fireproof infrared camera arranged on the shell, a temperature detector arranged on the shell, a wireless data transmitter arranged in the shell and a microcontroller arranged in the base and connected with the wireless data transmitter; the cooling system comprises a cavity arranged in the base, a group of through holes arranged at the top of the base, a cooling pipe arranged on the inner side surfaces of the cavity and the shell, and a micro circulating pump arranged in the cavity, wherein the through holes are connected with the cavity and positioned at the bottom of the shell, and two ends of the micro circulating pump are respectively connected with two ends of the cooling pipe.

title_en: Bistatic MIMO radar life detection method based on propagation operator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bistatic MIMO radar life detection method based on a propagation operator, which comprises the following steps: matching filtering is carried out on echo signals of the radar, an output signal matrix of a virtual array is constructed, a propagation operator is constructed after finite primary row-column transformation is carried out on the matrix, a minimum cost function of the propagation operator is solved, the solution of the propagation operator is obtained, eigenvalue decomposition is carried out on the matrix to obtain a diagonal matrix to realize parameter matching, and the estimation of an azimuth angle is calculated through the diagonal matrix to obtain the life position. The invention has high distance and angle positioning accuracy, can enhance the positioning, tracking and detecting capabilities of the target, has strong anti-interference capability, has fine speed resolution potential and strong detecting capability in a disaster environment.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;NANJING MINZHIDA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device for measuring or stimulating vital signs of a user
abstract_en: Disclosed is a novel hybrid of a device combined with independent integrated multi sensing automats that measures up to 64 different vital signs simultaneously and battery free(!). This device includes a glue-free suction patch, easy to attach to a patient's neck, wrists, temples (or selected body parts, if required). A base station contains electronic parts that provide a weak alternating electric field (AeF), which propagates over the patient's skin with no harm, to power and communicate with the suction patch. The electric field is bi-directionally data-modulated (proprietary phase-duplex) while remotely powering the chip at the same time. The suction patch gets a sequence from the base station to create desired vital signs sensors temporarily on-the-fly and sends the digitized sensing values radiation-free(!) continuously to the base station, which wirelessly connects to networks, computers, SmartDevices and applications.

title_en: Multi-feature fusion fatigue monitoring and identifying method for pole climbing operation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fatigue monitoring and identifying method for multi-feature fusion of pole climbing operation, which is characterized in that a hardware facility is arranged in a power dispatching center, a human body infrared video is collected, human body infrared video data are sent to a background server in real time, the human body infrared video data are analyzed and divided into single-frame pictures, the single-frame pictures are input into a trained deep learning model, an action prediction result is output, a respiration index and a heart rate index are detected by a vital sign monitoring module based on a UWB radar to obtain the respiration index and heart rate index results, a LVQ-BP artificial neural network is adopted for feature index fusion to form a comprehensive fatigue index, whether a human body is in a fatigue state or not is judged according to the comprehensive fatigue index, the method can monitor the body state of a worker in the power dispatching center in real time, has high accuracy, and guarantees the safety of power operation and the life safety of the worker, thereby reducing the incidence of accidents.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG PROVINCE FENGHUA DISTR POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Node thermal disaster monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a node thermal disaster monitoring device, which relates to the technical field of underground pipeline monitoring, and comprises an underground pipeline, a sensing optical fiber, an electronic marker, a detecting instrument, a temperature measuring host and a display device, wherein the sensing optical fiber is buried underground and fixed on the outer wall of the underground pipeline, the electronic marker is fixed at the right upper end of the underground pipeline, and the detecting instrument is used for detecting the position of the electronic marker on the ground; the sensing optical fiber is connected to the temperature measurement host through the optical cable, and the temperature measurement host is used for demodulating and early warning the temperature signal transmitted by the sensing optical fiber. The utility model discloses a temperature measurement host computer converts the temperature signal of sensing optical fiber into data signal and shows at display device, and the staff utilizes the detection instrument to detect out the concrete position data after the temperature measurement host computer conversion according to data again, then implements the maintenance, in time repairs little leak source, and big incident takes place in effective prevention.
assignees: SHANDONG LAIOU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Sewage pipe positioning device based on buoy signal enhancement and dynamic detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sewage pipe positioning device based on buoy signal enhancement and dynamic detection. Comprises a measuring rod (3), a buoy roll (12) for placing a buoy (5), and a geological radar (6) placed on the ground (7). This device can fix a position the outer sewage pipe of well room, surveys reinforcing sewage pipe signal through metal buoy and developments, improves the detection ability of geological radar to the target body, improves the detection degree of depth, can realize the accurate positioning to ageing sewage pipe and big buried depth sewage pipe, fills the blank field of an underground pipeline detection trade, surveys the technical regulation "CJJ 61" for city underground pipeline and becomes more meticulous underground pipeline and surveys or complicated underground pipeline and provide the trade standard.
assignees: XUZHOU SURVEY AND MAPPING RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Systems and methods for non-invasive virus symptom detection
abstract_en: Systems for symptom detection include a sensor configured to sense a signal indicative of at least one vital sign of a user, a display, a processor, and a memory. The memory has stored thereon instructions which, when executed by the processor, cause the system to determine at least one vital sign of the user based on the sensed signal, determine a wellness and/or health condition of the user based on the at least one vital sign, and display on the display at least one of information or indicia indicative of the determined wellness or health condition.

title_en: Information detection method and device for indoor object, storage medium and processor
abstract_en: The application discloses an indoor object information detection method and device, a storage medium and a processor. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring target data information of an indoor target object through target detection equipment, wherein the target data information at least comprises vital sign information and behavior information of the target object, and the target detection equipment comprises radar monitoring equipment which is not required to be worn by the target object and vital sign monitoring equipment worn on the target object; analyzing the behavior state information of the target object based on the target data information; and displaying the behavior state information of the target object on a display interface. Through this application, solved among the correlation technique to the not good problem of indoor personnel's information detection effect.

title_en: Thermal imaging intelligent interconnected fire-fighting helmet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a thermal imaging intelligent interconnected fire-fighting helmet, which comprises a helmet and an inductive interconnection component; the top of the helmet is provided with a heat dissipation ridge, and the surface of the heat dissipation ridge is provided with heat dissipation holes; the sensing interconnection assembly comprises a visible light camera, a thermal imaging camera, a display screen, a carbon monoxide sensor, a heart rate sensor, a temperature sensor, a pressure sensor, a data processing module and a data sending module. The utility model discloses the radiating effect is good, and is comfortable and easy to wear, can also real-time supervision fire fighter vital sign and the scene of a fire condition simultaneously to the outward appearance personnel carry out unified command dispatch according to the scene of a fire condition. The utility model discloses can effectively improve scene of a fire commander efficiency, protection fire fighter's life safety.

title_en: Non-contact fatigue detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-contact fatigue detection method and a non-contact fatigue detection system, which comprise the following steps: sending a millimeter wave radar signal to a person to be detected, and receiving an echo signal reflected from the person to be detected; to determine time-frequency domain characteristics, nonlinear characteristics and timing characteristics of the vital sign signals; acquiring a face video image of a person to be detected, and performing face detection and alignment based on the face video image to extract time domain characteristics and space domain characteristics of the face of the person to be detected; fusing the time-frequency domain characteristics, the nonlinear characteristics and the time sequence characteristics of the vital sign signals with the time domain characteristics and the space domain characteristics of the face of the person to be detected to obtain fused characteristics; and inputting the fused features into a classifier, identifying the fatigue state of the person to be detected, and judging whether the person to be detected is in the fatigue state. The invention combines the two technologies, thereby effectively inhibiting the interference of subjective and objective factors and improving the precision of fatigue detection.

title_en: Monitoring system using hospital room patient's bio information and environment information
title_ko: 병실 환자 생체 정보 및 환경정보를 이용한 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a monitoring system using bio information and environment information of a patient in a hospital room, which comprises: an antenna unit installed in a hospital room, using a time difference between an impulse signal and a reflected signal from a patient to measure the patient's presence and a distance from the patient to measure the patient's heart rate and respiration status, which are vital signs, and, at the same time, receiving the patient's moving status; a sensor unit installed on the lower part of a bed to continuously measure the patient's moving status and presence; a gateway unit transmitting the patient's bio-signals and status information measured by the antenna unit and the sensor unit; and a control unit modulating an impulse signal value received from the antenna unit into a digital signal, separating a noise signal and a target signal of the patient from the acquired signal, extracting the bio-signals through the patient's motion to monitor the patient's bio-signals and status information, and notifying the outside in case of emergency. According to the present invention, the patient's bio-signals are measured in a non-contact manner, the patient's movement and position are continuously measured through a pressure difference applied to the bed, the patient's condition is analyzed by receiving the measured values, an analyzed result is monitored, and an emergency is notified to the outside so, on the basis of collected data, falls, bedsores, contamination of a hospital room, and the like can be prevented and the emergency can be immediately managed, thereby providing an effect of effectively managing the patient.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 병실 환자 생체 정보 및 환경정보를 이용한 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 병실에 설치되어 발생하는 임펄스 신호가 환자로부터 반사되어 되돌아오는 신호의 시간차를 이용하여 환자 유무와 환자의 탐지 및 거리를 측정하여 환자의 생체신호인 심박과 호흡 상태를 측정하는 동시에 환자의 모션 상태를 수신하는 안테나부와, 상기 침대의 하부에 설치되어 환자의 모션 상태 및 유무를 지속적으로 측정하는 센서부와, 상기 안테나부와 센서부에서 측정된 환자의 생체신호 및 상태 정보를 송신하는 게이트웨이부와, 상기 안테나부로부터 수신된 임펄스 신호값을 디지털 신호로 변조하고 취득한 신호에서 잡음신호와 환자의 대상 신호를 구분한 다음 환자의 모션을 통한 생체신호를 추출하여 환자의 생체신호 및 상태 정보를 모니터링 및 위급상황시 외부로 알려주도록 하는 제어부를 포함한다. 
이를 통해, 환자의 생체신호를 비접촉으로 측정하며 침대에 가해지는 압력차를 통해 환자의 움직임과 위치를 지속적으로 측정하고, 측정된 값을 수신받아 환자의 상태를 분석하며, 분석된 결과를 모니터링 및 위급상황시 외부로 알려주어, 수집된 데이터를 기반으로 낙상, 욕창, 병실 오염 등을 사전에 예방하고 응급상황 발생시 즉각적인 대처가 가능하여 환자를 효과적으로 관리할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Piping structure for firefighting water
title_ko: 건축물의 소방 배관 설치 구조물
abstract_en: In accordance with the present invention, provided is a firefighting piping installation structure for a building. The firefighting piping installation structure for a building includes: a ceiling formed in the interior of a building; a firefighting water pipe buried in the ceiling, and receiving firefighting water from a first firefighting water supply part placed in the building; a sprinklers connected with the firefighting water pipe, and sprinkling the firefighting water to the interior; a connection pipe connected with the firefighting water pipe, and penetrating a wall forming the interior; a valve provided on the connection pipe; a first position sensor installed in an end part of the connection pipe, and transmitting a position of the end part of the connection pipe to a controller; a second firefighting water supply part placed in the rooftop of the building; a moving part connected with the second firefighting water supply part through a tube having a predetermined length, and moved laterally in the rooftop of the building; a winder provided in the moving part, and winding or unwinding a fire-retardant rope; a pipe connection part installed at an end part of the rope, and connected with an end part of the tube; and a second position sensor installed in the pipe connection part, and transmitting the position of a connector formed in the pipe connection part to the controller. Therefore, the present invention is capable of efficiently suppressing a fire by promptly supplying firefighting water.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건축물의 소방 배관 설치 구조물을 제공한다. 상기 건축물의 소방 배관 설치 구조물은 건물의 실내에 형성되는 천정; 상기 천정에 매입되며, 건물에 배치된 제 1소방수 공급부로부터 소방수를 공급 받는 소방수 배관; 상기 소방수 배관과 연결되며, 상기 실내에 소방수를 분사하는 스프링 클러들; 상기 소방수 배관과 연결되며, 상기 실내를 이루는 벽체를 관통하는 연결 배관; 상기 연결 배관에 구비되는 밸브; 상기 연결 배관의 단부에 설치되며, 상기 연결 배관 단부의 위치를 제어기로 전송하는 제 1위치 센서; 상기 건물의 옥상에 배치되는 제 2소방수 공급부; 상기 제 2소방수 공급부와 일정 길이를 갖는 튜브를 통해 연결되며, 상기 건물의 옥상에서 좌우를 따라 이동되는 이동부; 상기 이동부에 구비되며, 난연성의 로프를 권취 또는 권출하는 와인더; 상기 로프의 단부에 설치되며, 상기 튜브의 단부와 연결되는 배관 연결부; 상기 배관 연결부에 설치되며, 상기 배관 연결부에 형성되는 커넥터의 위치를 상기 제어기로 전송하는 제 2위치 센서;를 포함한다.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring via remote sensing on stationary exercise equipment
abstract_en: Vital sign monitoring via remote sensing on stationary exercise equipment is provided. A new non-contact approach described herein uses radio frequency (RF) radar (e.g., ultra-wide band (UWB) radar) to remotely monitor vital sign information (such as heartbeat and breathing) and human activity information of subjects using stationary exercise equipment. In some embodiments, a radar sensor captures micro-scale chest motions (corresponding to the vital sign information) as well as macro-scale body motions (corresponding to movements from exercise). A signal processor receives radar signals from the radar sensor and processes the radar signals to reconstruct vital sign information from the micro-scale chest motions and/or human activity information from the macro-scale body motions using a joint vital sign-motion model, which can be trained using machine learning and other approaches.

title_en: Rescue and disaster relief method based on unmanned aerial vehicle system and unmanned aerial vehicle system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency rescue and disaster relief method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle system and the unmanned aerial vehicle system thereof, comprising the following steps; the method comprises the following steps that firstly, corresponding unmanned aerial vehicles are dispatched according to the serious situation of the disaster; secondly, distributing unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue ranges through an unmanned aerial vehicle formation host according to disaster types, terrains and damage conditions; a third step of detecting the life signs by a thermal imaging camera and throwing a marker at the corresponding position; and fourthly, the search and rescue personnel perform search and rescue activities within the range of the marked positions. The invention can deal with post-disaster rescue activities of debris flow, flood, earthquake and other natural disasters, detect life signs from the air through the unmanned aerial vehicle, and enable search and rescue pairs to find search and rescue targets more easily through throwing the marker, thereby greatly improving the search and rescue efficiency.
assignees: CCCC REMOTE SENSING LOAD JIANGSU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Contactless sensor-driven device, system, and method enabling ambient health monitoring and predictive assessment
abstract_en: An ambient monitoring device includes a housing, contactless sensors coupled to the housing, and a processing device disposed in the housing. The processing device is coupled to the contactless sensors. The processing device is to receive, from one or more contactless sensors of the plurality of contactless sensors, historical sensor data. The processing device is further to determine baseline vital signs based on the historical sensor data. The processing device is further to receive, from the one or more contactless sensors, current sensor data associated with a user that is within a threshold distance of the ambient monitoring device without contacting the ambient monitoring device. The processing device is further to determine, based on the current sensor data, current vital signs of the user. Responsive to determining the current vital signs do not meet the baseline vital signs, the processing device is to provide an alert.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitor

title_en: Biological information acquisition device and biological information acquisition method
abstract_en: A biological information acquisition device (5) comprises a detected value acquisition unit (11) for acquiring a value detected by a noncontact biological sensor (3), a vital sign measurement unit (12) for measuring a vital sign of a subject (TP) by using the detected value, an image data acquisition unit (13) for acquiring image data on images captured by a camera (4), an image processing unit (14) for performing image processing on captured images including the subject (TP) to perform at least one of state estimation for estimating the state of the subject (TP), attribute estimation for estimating the attribute of the subject (TP), and personal identification for identifying the subject (TP), and a parameter setting unit (15) for setting a parameter in the measurement of the vital sign according to the result of the image processing.

title_en: Three-dimensional detection and positioning method for dental implant
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional detection and positioning method of a dental implant, which is used for detecting the implant in a gingival. The tooth implant detection device comprises a detection sensor, a software and hardware control device and the like, wherein the detection sensor consists of a spiral coil at the front end and an electrode at the tail end, and when the detection sensor senses a metal implant buried in gum, the inductance of the coil is changed, and the frequency of an oscillation circuit is changed along with the change of the inductance, so that the detection and positioning effects are achieved. Can bury three dimensions such as the outside of gum, the inboard of gum through top, the planting body to wearing the planting body and survey to can fix a position the inside accurate position whether have planting body and planting body of gum fast, not only can make things convenient for the planting body in accurate location patient oral cavity of doctor, also can reduce patient's economic burden and reduce the injury to the human body.

title_en: Antidetonation steel mesh thermal insulation wall body convenient to fitment is reformed transform

title_en: Remote vital sign detection method and device based on phased array radar technology
abstract_en: The method and the device for detecting the remote vital signs based on the phased array radar technology acquire the position information of a target human body under a preset coordinate system of a space to be detected to form a position coordinate data set of the target human body; configuring a millimeter wave radar transmitter, and respectively performing radar beam forming on a transmitting radio frequency channel and a receiving radio frequency channel according to the position direction of a target human body in a space to be detected; receiving an echo signal reflected by a target human body through a radar receiver, performing one-dimensional Fourier transform on distance dimensional information of the echo signal, then performing maximum value search, extracting data near the maximum value and forming a new echo sequence for performing two-dimensional Fourier transform; and (3) obtaining a respiration characteristic signal and a heart rate characteristic signal from the echo sequence through a digital filter, and carrying out noise reduction and fast Fourier transform to restore the respiration and heartbeat motion waveforms of the target human body. The invention has the advantages of long testing distance, high precision, no loss of the testing target and capability of testing multiple targets.

title_en: Communication optical cable line damage emergency alarm induction device

title_en: Multi-living-body intelligent detection device and method based on CPPWM radar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the disaster detection field and discloses a multi-life intelligent detection device and method based on CPPWM-MIMO radar, wherein the device comprises a CPPWM signal generator, a plurality of power amplifiers, an array antenna, a plurality of low-noise amplifiers, a multichannel high-speed mixed sampler and a data processing system; the array antenna comprises a plurality of transmitting antennas and a plurality of receiving antennas, and the CPPWM signal generator simultaneously generates orthogonal multipath CPPWM detection signals and multipath CPPWM reference signals corresponding to the orthogonal multipath CPPWM detection signals; each CPPWM detection signal is connected with a transmitting antenna through a power amplifier, and the output end of each receiving antenna is connected with a multichannel high-speed mixed sampler through a low-noise amplifier; each CPPWM reference signal is respectively connected with the multi-channel high-speed mixed sampler; the multichannel high-speed mixed sampler is connected with the data processing module, and the data processing system is used for calculating and analyzing to obtain a life detection result. The invention has the advantages of being not influenced by environmental temperature, noise, site visibility, external electromagnetic interference and the like.

title_en: Portable automatic ventilating assistant device

In detail, the present invention relates to a portable automatic artificial respiration assistant device which automatically pumps an air bag which supplies air or gas required for respiration to patients to enable artificial respiration adjustment, and comprises a sensor part, an auxiliary battery, and others to measure conditions of the patients, that are vital signs, in real time so that an optimal amount of respiration can be provided according to the conditions of the patients and a structure thereof is simple to be simply portable, thereby being used in emergency situation outdoors.

title_en: Foundation structure of fume pipe with buried structure
title_ko: 내진성을 가지는 지중 흄관 기초구조물
abstract_en: Provided by the present invention is an underground hume pipe foundation structure with earthquake resistance. The underground hume pipe foundation structure with earthquake resistance comprises: a concrete support part positioned underground; hume pipes positioned on an upper portion of the concrete support part, disposed adjacently to drain sewage, and forming a hollow; a connection part which connects the hume pipes; an impact sensor installed on each of the hume pipes and configured to measure the impact force applied to the hume pipes; a support part installed on the concrete support part and configured to support lower end portions of the hume pipes; and a posture control part provided on the support part, and configured to guide the rotation and distortion of each of the hume pipes when the impact force exceeds a predetermined abnormal impact force and correct the forcible rotation and distortion of each of the hume pipes when the impact force is less than the predetermined abnormal impact force such that the hume pipes are arranged in the original positions.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 내진성을 가지는 지중 흄관 기초구조물을 제공한다. 상기 내진성을 가지는 지중 흄관 기초구조물은 지중에 위치되는 콘크리트 지지부; 상기 콘크리트 지지부의 상부에 위치되며, 오수를 배수시키도록 서로 이웃하여 배치되고, 중공을 이루는 흄관들; 상기 흄관들의 사이를 연결하는 연결부; 상기 흄관들 각각에 설치되며, 상기 흄관들로 가해지는 충격력을 측정하는 충격 센서; 상기 콘크리트 지지부 상에 설치되고, 상기 흄관들의 하단부를 지지하는 지지부; 및, 상기 지지부에 구비되어, 상기 충격력이 기설정되는 이상충격력 이상을 이루면 상기 흄관들 각각이 회전 및 틀어짐을 안내하고, 상기 충격력이 기설정되는 이상충격력 미만을 이루면 상기 흄관들 각각을 강제 회전 및 강제 틀어짐을 교정하여 원위치로 배치시키는 자세 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Smoke alarm device and method capable of sensing vital signs
abstract_en: A can perceive the smog alarm device and method of the vital sign, when the smog sensory module detects that there is smog in the environment, the smog sensory module sends the alarm signal to the microcontroller; the radar sensing module is used for judging whether personnel exist in the environment with smoke by using the human body micro-motion signal; the networking module is used for transmitting the processing information of the controller to a cloud or a control center; when smoke exists in the environment, the sound-light alarm prompting module carries out sound-light alarm prompting; when smoke exists in the environment and people exist in the environment, smoke alarm is carried out in a first acousto-optic prompt mode; when the fact that only smoke exists in the environment and no people exist is detected, smoke alarm is carried out in a second acousto-optic prompting mode. The invention can enable the rescue workers to know whether the trapped people exist in the fire search and rescue field at the first time, avoid missing the gold rescue time of the trapped people, more accurately find the search and rescue targets during search and rescue, and is beneficial to ensuring the life safety of the trapped people.
assignees: SHENZHEN JINGHUA PHASE CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Railway bridge dynamic deflection wireless detection system device based on microwave radar technology
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a railway bridge dynamic deflection wireless detection system device based on microwave radar technology, which comprises a deflection measuring radar; the bottom of the deflection measuring radar is fixedly connected with a plurality of supporting legs; the bottom of the supporting leg is provided with a reinforcing embedded part; the reinforcing embedded part comprises a top seat plate assembled on the supporting legs, and the bottom of the top seat plate is fixedly connected with an I-shaped plate; the I-shaped plate comprises vertical steel plate parts which are arranged at intervals in the front and back, and horizontal steel plate parts are fixedly connected between the vertical steel plate parts; a plurality of pairs of embedded rod bodies which are arranged at intervals up and down are fixedly connected between the vertical steel plate parts; each pair of the buried rod bodies comprises two symmetrically arranged U-shaped buried rods, and a plurality of wrapping columns are fixedly connected to the U-shaped buried rods; the gripping column penetrates through the U-shaped embedded rod, and the device further comprises an assembling portion fixedly connected to the bottom of the vertical steel plate portion. Adopt the design of above-mentioned device part can realize firm will detect the deflection measurement thunder of railway bridge and erect.
assignees: BEIJING PUBLIC WORKS SECTION CHINA RAILWAY BEIJING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Geological landslide monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a geological landslide monitoring device, belonging to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, which comprises a monitoring pile buried in the middle and lower part of a mountain slope; the mountain body sensing assembly is provided with a pressure sensor, a vibration sensor and a crack monitoring sensor; the pressure sensor is arranged on the upper slope surface at the lower part of the monitoring pile; the vibration sensor is arranged inside the monitoring pile; the crack monitoring sensor is arranged on the mountain slope; the control box is arranged at the upper part of the monitoring pile and is electrically connected with the pressure sensor, the vibration sensor and the crack monitoring sensor; the signal emitter is arranged at the top of the monitoring pile and is electrically connected with the control box; the signal transmitter is used for transmitting the monitoring signal to the remote control center. The geological landslide monitoring device can be used for carrying out 24-hour all-weather monitoring and early warning on the geological landslide, and the intelligent degree and the use safety of the geological landslide monitoring and early warning are improved.
assignees: SICHUAN SHUDU GEOLOGICAL ENG SURVEY CO LTD

title_en: Disaster area personnel rescue method and system based on tilt rotor aircraft
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of airplane general technology, in particular to a disaster area personnel rescue method and a disaster area personnel rescue system based on a tilt rotor aircraft, wherein the system comprises the tilt rotor aircraft, an airborne communication base station, a aerial survey CCD camera, a synthetic aperture radar, a photoelectric ball head and a plurality of quad-rotor unmanned aerial vehicles are loaded on the tilt rotor aircraft, and cameras, life detection instruments, voice communication recognition devices and portable material bags are all assembled on the quad-rotor unmanned aerial vehicles; the method combines the identification of suspect areas, identification of key search and rescue areas, and targeted rescue of quad-rotor drones. By the aid of the rescue method and the rescue system, the problems of untimely rescue and low efficiency can be effectively solved.
assignees: CHENGDU AIRCRAFT IND GROUP CO LTD

title_en: System and method for monitoring a vehicle cabin
abstract_en: Vehicle cabin monitoring uses a radar unit positioned in the center of the cabin to acquire image data of the vehicle cabin and uses a processor to generate detection of occupancy of a seat within the vehicle cabin, classification of an occupant, detection of a gesture, determination of a seat belt state, and monitoring of vital signs of the occupant. The output unit may perform a response adapted to the state of an occupant of the vehicle cabin.

title_en: Permanent scattering point device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a permanent scattering point device, which is characterized in that: comprises a main body part, a movable part and a corner reflector part; the corner reflector part is fixed at the upper end of the main body part; the movable part is positioned at the lower end of the main body part; the main body part comprises a hollow tube and a sensor module; the sliding part comprises a sliding rod and a fin assembly, and the fin assembly is arranged at the lower end of the sliding rod; the slide rod is slidably inserted into a hollow tube of the main body portion, and the sensor module is disposed in the hollow tube to detect a vertical movement of the slide rod within the hollow tube. The device for settling permanent scattering points is inserted into the ground of a place to be detected and buried. When landslide occurs, the sensor module can send detected signals to an external communication device, so that the measurement precision of the ground-based synthetic aperture radar system is improved as auxiliary data, and false alarm is reduced.
assignees: SICHUAN DIGITAL TRANSP TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;HAWKEYE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a radar life detection instrument, including the detection instrument body, the bottom of detection instrument body is equipped with the box, be equipped with the guide post group on the detection instrument body, the guide post group includes two interval arrangement's first guide post and second guide post, the box is worn out along upper and lower direction to the assembly that slides in the guide post direction on the detection instrument body, be equipped with the lead screw in the box, the one end of lead screw rotates the assembly with the inner wall of box, the box is worn out to the other end of lead screw, the screw thread assembly has the nut on the lead screw, it is equipped with first rotation stopping piece and second rotation stopping piece to rotate on the inner wall of box, the relative both sides of nut articulate has first connecting rod and second connecting rod, first connecting rod links to each other with first rotation stopping piece, the second connecting rod links to each other with the second rotation stopping piece, still include the bracing piece, the middle part in the outer bottom surface of box is just established to the orientation about the bracing piece extends. The utility model discloses a radar life detection instrument has made things convenient for the level of radar life detection instrument to adapt, has improved and has placed efficiency.
assignees: HENAN XITUO FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Human body activity state detection method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to the technical field of human body detection of electromagnetic waves, and provides a human body activity state detection method, a human body activity state detection device, human body activity state detection equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring echo signals generated in continuous frames, analyzing to obtain voltage values of the echo signals, and determining a state decision weight corresponding to a signal wave of each frame according to the voltage values of the echo signals and the voltage value of the spatial noise; calculating a state value corresponding to each frame according to the state decision weight and the voltage value of the echo signal, comparing the state value corresponding to each frame with a standard value of a preset human body state, and determining the human body state corresponding to each frame according to a comparison result; and detecting the activity state of the human body according to the human body state corresponding to the continuous frames in the preset time and a preset decision rule. The method and the device can realize the recognition of the human body state based on the microwave signal, thereby accurately judging the activity state of the human body and improving the application range of detecting the vital signs of the human body by utilizing the microwave.

title_en: Near-to-eye display life detection device
