abstract_en: The utility model discloses a nearly eye shows life detection device, include: the glasses part comprises an optical waveguide lens, a control module and a first wireless network module, wherein the control module and the first wireless network module are installed on the legs of the glasses; the probe part comprises an infrared focal plane detector, a microprocessor controller and a second wireless network module, wherein the infrared focal plane detector and the second wireless network module are both connected with the microprocessor controller, and the second wireless network module is connected with the first wireless network module of the glasses part. Through the optical waveguide lens with traditional thermal imaging life detection device's thermal imaging image display on the glasses part with probe part wireless connection for thermal imaging detection device is lighter-weighted more, and single can accomplish the life and survey, has improved search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Providing energy-efficient features using human presence detection
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for the detection of human presence in an energy efficient manner using a plurality of sensors such as those of a battery-powered device such as a television remote, and a device with a processor, such as a television. Data gathered from an initial television WiFi radio scan, or an initial low-powered detection scan from the television remote, may be analyzed by the processor to determine a potential presence of one or more humans are present proximate to the device. If there is such a potential presence, the device remote can enter a full-powered detection mode to accurately determine the presence or absence of one or more humans, and take further actions.

title_en: Providing customized entertainment experience using human presence detection
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for the detection of human presence in front of a plurality of sensors such as those of speakers and a device with a processor, such as a television. Data gathered from the plurality of sensors may be analyzed by the processor to determine if one or more humans are present proximate to the device. Based on the determined presence or absence of one or more humans, further actions including, inter alia, customizing a home theatre experience for the one or more humans, making content recommendations, or activating parental controls can be taken by the device.

title_en: Handheld live pig vital sign detection equipment based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a hand-held type live pig vital sign check out test set based on millimeter wave radar, include: the detector is a main body structure of the device, anti-slip layers for increasing friction force are arranged on the side faces of the detector at equal intervals, and an operation switch is arranged below the right end of the detector and is L-shaped; the base is arranged at the lower end of the detector, and the base is embedded in the limiting frame. This hand-held type live pig vital sign check out test set based on millimeter wave radar stretches into the inside of mount with the hand, tightening band can contract this moment, thereby fix user's hand and device, the user can drive the gasbag with the grip of hand and contract this moment, thereby make the gaseous outflow in the gasbag, will drive turbine blade this moment and rotate, thereby start operating switch, because this moment the device removes along with the arm, and then make user's wrist rest.
assignees: QINGDAO BUCHOUWANG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Underground hidden defect simulation detection system and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground hidden defect simulation detection system and a detection method thereof, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the sector ring tunnel comprises two shield tunnel segments; the ground penetrating radar assembly comprises a radar slide rail and a ground penetrating radar, the radar slide rail is arranged on the inner side of the sector ring tunnel, and the ground penetrating radar is arranged on the radar slide rail; the defect simulation assembly is positioned at the outer side of the fan-shaped annular tunnel and comprises a first side wall, a second side wall and a bottom surface, a cavity is formed among the first side wall, the second side wall, the bottom surface and the fan-shaped annular tunnel, quartz sand is filled in the cavity, a plurality of pipelines are buried in the quartz sand, mortar is laid on one side, far away from the cavity, of the first side wall, and a plurality of drilling holes are formed in the second side wall; and the signal processing component is used for processing radar echo signals received by the ground penetrating radar and determining radar signal characteristics. The method can accurately analyze the hidden defect type after shield tunnel segment through defect simulation and radar echo signal processing, and can be widely applied to the technical field of radar detection.

title_en: Precise electromagnetic calibration method for ultra-deep underground pipeline azimuth
abstract_en: An accurate electromagnetic calibration method for the azimuth of an ultra-deep underground pipeline. The invention uses a measuring sensor formed by three-component orthogonal coil groups, a built-in circuit board and a plane electron Luo Panan to be arranged in a non-metallic probe, thereby realizing electromagnetic calibration of the orientation of the ultra-deep underground pipeline relative to the probe. The probe for electromagnetic calibration method measurement is connected by a cable, is lowered into a well drilled in advance, is connected with a detection host on the ground through serial communication, and is used for completing measurement parameter setting, process control and measurement result display. In the detection process, the probe descends by self gravity, when approaching to a pipeline, a plurality of groups of data are collected, and the data of the probe azimuth measured by the electronic compass are collected and uploaded to the detection host, and the detection host calculates and displays the position of the target pipeline relative to the exploratory well. The method is matched with the ultra-deep pipeline buried depth measuring device, and can be widely applied to high-precision measuring occasions of ultra-deep underground pipelines and cable positions.

title_en: Portable through-wall radar
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a radar detection technical field, more specifically relates to a portable through-wall radar, including the casing, be used for signalling and can for casing pivoted detection module, be used for signal reception's signal module, be used for presenting the detection result and locate the outside display module of casing, be used for giving detection module signal module display module provides the electric energy respectively and rather than the power module of electricity connection, detection module with display module locates respectively the casing is outside, just detection module with the casing rotates to be connected, display module with the connection can be dismantled to the casing, signal module respectively with detection module display module electricity is connected, power module locates in the casing and with the connection can be dismantled to the casing. The utility model provides a realize enlarging the portable through-wall radar of detection scope through the rotation of detecting the module under the unchangeable condition in radar position.

title_en: Earthquake-resistant support for building
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an earthquake-resistant support for building, which comprises a base, the skeleton is installed through four connecting pieces in the bottom of base, the inside of skeleton is inlayed and is equipped with a plurality of sound cottons of inhaling, the bottom fixedly connected with acoustic celotex board of skeleton, a plurality of gypsum boards of bottom fixedly connected with of acoustic celotex board, the connecting piece includes pre-buried seat and bumper shock absorber, the bumper shock absorber joint is in the bottom of pre-buried seat, pre-buried seat includes the mount, the draw-in groove has been seted up to the bottom of mount, the bumper shock absorber includes the support, the top of support is provided with the cardboard, the bottom of cardboard is provided with the clamp plate, there are rubber pad and lower rubber pad at the top of support inside wall and bottom difference fixed mounting, the utility model relates to a construction technical field. This antidetonation support for building through being provided with the connecting piece, utilizes the mode of pre-buried seat and bumper shock absorber joint to replace traditional self-tapping screw, greatly reduced operating personnel's intensity of labour.
assignees: CHINA CONSTR 7TH ENG DIVISION CORP LTD

title_en: Non-contact type monitoring device for monitoring infectious patient and non-contact type monitoring system using the same
title_ko: 감염병 환자 격리 감시를 위한 비접촉 방식 모니터링 장치 및 이를 이용한 비접촉 방식 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: A non-contact monitoring device for quarantine monitoring of an infectious patient according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a radar sensor which measures a biosignal of a patient accommodated in an isolation facility in a non-contact manner; a data learning unit which learns a biosignal normal range of the patient through biosignal data measured by the radar sensor; and an abnormal state detection unit which detects the biosignal to be in an abnormal state when the biosignal measured by the radar sensor is out of the biosignal normal range learned by the data learning unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 감염병 환자 격리 감시를 위한 비접촉 방식 모니터링 장치는, 격리 시설에 수용된 환자의 생체 신호를 비접촉 방식으로 측정하는 레이다 센서; 상기 레이다 센서에 의해 측정된 생체 신호 데이터를 통해 환자의 생체 신호 정상 범위를 학습하는 데이터 학습부; 및 상기 레이다 센서에 의해 측정된 생체 신호가 상기 데이터 학습부에 의해 학습된 생체 신호 정상 범위를 벗어나는 경우, 생체 신호 비정상 상태임을 감지하는 비정상 상태 감지부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Method and device for monitoring vital sign information, storage medium and processor
abstract_en: The application discloses a vital sign information monitoring method and device, a storage medium and a processor. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting echo signals of a target object in a sleep state through target monitoring equipment, wherein the target monitoring equipment is radar monitoring equipment which is not required to be worn by the target object; extracting a micro-motion signal from each distance unit in the echo signal; performing spectrum analysis on the micro-motion signal to obtain a chromatographic spectrum of the micro-motion signal; and monitoring vital sign information of the target object by utilizing a chromatographic spectrum of the micro-motion signal, wherein the vital sign information at least comprises the respiration rate, the respiration form and the restless leg phenomenon of the target object. The application solves the problem of poor monitoring effect on vital sign information in the related technology.

title_en: Life detection method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a life detection method and a device thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting by adopting an ultra-wideband radar to obtain a radar echo; receiving pulses for radar in a radar echo along a slow time direction, and determining a permutation entropy PE value; determining the position of the human body object according to the PE value; vital sign signals are extracted from the radar echoes according to the position of the human subject. Therefore, the position of the human body object can be determined according to the PE value of the radar receiving pulse in the radar echo along the slow time direction, and the vital sign signal can be effectively extracted from the radar echo according to the position of the human body object.
assignees: CHINA COAL RES INST;UNIV LIAONING TECHNICAL

title_en: Living body detection method, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a life body detection method, a terminal and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method is applied to millimeter wave radar and comprises the following steps: acquiring distance dimension data of a millimeter wave radar; intercepting through preset effective distance range distance dimension data to obtain a target index corresponding to a maximum peak value in intercepted data; according to the target index, N adjacent distance detection units taking a distance detection unit corresponding to the target index as a center are obtained, and amplitude difference data of distance dimension data of the distance detection unit at the kth moment and the kth-1 moment in continuous N moments are sequentially obtained; windowing and fast Fourier transformation are carried out on amplitude difference data corresponding to any distance detection unit, so as to obtain a frequency spectrum corresponding to the distance detection unit; and judging whether a target exists at the nth moment according to the frequency spectrums corresponding to the N distance detection units. The application can improve the life detection precision.

title_en: Drunk driving detection method based on MQ3 sensor and UWB laser radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drunk driving detection system and method based on an MQ3 sensor and a UWB laser radar, and the drunk driving detection system comprises an alcohol detection module (100), a respiration detection module (200), a signal matching module (300) and a drunk driving alarm module (400), wherein all the modules cooperatively operate to complete detection; wherein the alcohol detection module (100) based on MQ3 sensor is used for alcohol signal capture, alcohol sequence processing and drunk driving threshold detection; the UWB lidar-based respiration detection module (200) is used for respiration signal acquisition, respiration signal processing, and passenger separation and localization; the signal matching module (300) is used for periodic signal alignment, sequence feature matching and drinker identity confirmation; the drunk driving alarm module (400) is used for system alarm prompt, data observable interface and drunk driving information uploading. Compared with the prior art, the method can provide efficient and accurate drunk driving detection for a motor vehicle driving scene, and detect the alcohol concentration in the vehicle and the breathing signals of all passengers in real time.

title_en: Radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a radar life detection instrument relates to the field of radar detection instrument, including the detection instrument body, detection instrument body below is provided with the base, the base is provided with the bracing piece, fixed surface is connected with the fixed plate under the detection instrument body, the fixed plate lower surface rotates to be connected in the upper end of the support bar, one side that the base is located the bracing piece is provided with the regulation pole, it is provided with the angle adjustment mechanism who is used for adjusting detection instrument body detection angle to adjust the pole, angle adjustment mechanism connects in the fixed plate. The application has the effect of shortening the rescue time.
assignees: SHENZHEN DASANTI SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Search device and search method
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a search device and a search method which can detect a buried object related to a social infrastructure facility in a space-saving manner and without interrupting work.　According to the search device and the search method, a transceiver for transmitting and receiving electromagnetic waves is mounted on a rotational shaft of a drilling device, the transceiver is rotated with the rotation axis, the electromagnetic waves are transmitted while drilling, reflected waves from a buried object are received, and the buried object is sensed on the basis of the principle of an underground radar. Thus, the search device and the search method do not require a work space such as required by a cart-type electromagnetic radar system, and can determine, from the state of the reflected waves, whether the buried object is a social infrastructure facility or just a stone without interrupting the drilling work.

title_en: Intelligent vital sign monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent non-visual non-contact vital sign monitoring device, which comprises a front-end device, wherein the front-end device comprises: a radar sensor, the radar sensor comprising: a radar signal receiving and transmitting processing unit and a signal output unit; the radar signal transceiving processing unit includes: radar chip, receiving and transmitting antenna, program memory and clock crystal oscillator; the radar chip is used for collecting signals at the front end, the program memory is used for storing application program codes, and the clock crystal oscillator is used for providing clock signals; the radar signal receiving and transmitting processing unit is used for generating, amplifying, transmitting, receiving, mixing and collecting and processing radar signals, and real-time accurate measurement of vibration characteristics and displacement of equipment is realized through analyzing frequency, phase and amplitude characteristics of intermediate frequency signals. The invention adopts non-contact vital sign monitoring, which is helpful to reduce virus transmission caused by contact points and contacters to the maximum extent and better ensure the contact safety of personnel.
assignees: JIUZHOU YUNHE SHANDONG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent vital sign monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent real-time monitoring, and provides an intelligent vital sign monitoring method, which comprises the following steps: modeling human body vital signs; the monitoring radar transmits a transmitting signal of linear frequency modulation continuous waves to a monitoring area, and simultaneously captures echo signals reflected by a human body uninterruptedly; analyzing a transmitting signal, an echo signal and a beat signal of the radar, and extracting human body vital sign data; checking vital sign information in real time; and separating the heartbeat signal and the respiration signal, and respectively carrying out frequency calculation on the heartbeat signal and the respiration signal. The invention measures the human body vital sign signal by measuring the relative frequency relation between the received signal and the transmitted signal, thereby improving the real-time performance and the accuracy of the human body vital sign signal detection; the data of the heartbeat signal and the respiratory signal are extracted through the confidence parameters of spectral estimation based on FFT, autocorrelation and peak value interval, and the calculation accuracy of separating the heartbeat signal and the respiratory signal is greatly improved.
assignees: JIUZHOU YUNHE SHANDONG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Use method of induction device for monitoring landslide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a use method of an induction device for monitoring landslide, which comprises the following steps: the signal inductor is connected to the current release device in a linear arrangement mode through a plurality of flexible wires with different lengths, and the using method comprises the following steps: s1, embedding: embedding the signal sensor into a mountain, and placing the current release device into the mountain; s2, monitoring: before landslide occurs on the mountain, relative displacement occurs on rock masses around the landslide, the shearing force along with the vertical displacement causes the flexible lead to extend, the resistance of the flexible lead is increased, and the current value measured by an ammeter is decreased; s3, data reception: the signal receiver receives data of an ammeter in the signal sensor, the signal sensor is buried in a mountain body when the signal receiver is used, whether the mountain body has landslide or not and the landslide strength are judged according to the current, the monitoring process cannot be influenced by weather and external environment, the monitoring is not assisted by external conditions, and therefore the signal receiver is not limited by geographical environment and is wide in application range.
assignees: SUZHOU ZHIDAFEI TESTING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Monitoring method and device capable of preventing asphyxia
abstract_en: A monitoring method and device capable of preventing suffocation, carry on IQ quadrature mixing to the transmitting wave and echo of the millimeter wave radar, output the target distance, speed, direction and phase information; performing correlation analysis through the modulus of the corresponding frequency point and amplitude transformation caused by respiratory vibration, and selecting the optimal vital sign point of the monitored object; selecting the frequency of the maximum module value as the frequency of the current breath and the heartbeat respectively; comprehensively judging the respiration and heartbeat, analyzing whether the frequency of the current respiration and heartbeat is in a preset normal range, and if not, analyzing the duration and the trend quantity of increasing or decreasing; and according to the data of comprehensive judgment, if the duration of the breath which is not in the normal range exceeds a preset time value and the heartbeat exceeds the normal range, judging that the asphyxia occurs, and reporting the judgment result to perform local and remote alarm. The baby asphyxia detection device can actively find baby asphyxia in time and reduce baby risk; the application range is wide, and the life safety of the monitored object is effectively guaranteed.
assignees: SHENZHEN JINGHUA XIANGKONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Respiration detection method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a respiration detection method and device, relates to the technical field of radar detection, and is used for improving the accuracy of respiration detection. The method comprises the following steps: transmitting electromagnetic waves to a target space, and acquiring echo signals of M channels; processing echo signals of the M channels to obtain respiration characteristic signals of a target human body of the M channels; processing the respiration characteristic signals of the target human bodies of the M channels to obtain cross-correlation entropy corresponding to the target human bodies; performing Fourier transform on the cross-correlation entropy to obtain a cross-power spectrum; and determining the respiratory frequency of the target human body according to the cross power spectrum.

title_en: Method for separating UWB radar sensor receiving signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for separating a UWB radar sensor receiving signal, namely a method for carrying out signal decomposition on the UWB radar sensor receiving signal based on a zero-space tracking extraction single-component signal algorithm and confidence coefficient of a recursive integral operator, and extracting respiratory signals and heartbeat signal frequencies of a human body, which can be applied to monitoring vital signs such as heart rate of infectious patients and can also be used for detecting the human body signs in earthquake. The method has short operation time, can accurately extract the breathing signal and the heartbeat signal frequency in the UWB ground penetrating radar signal, and provides an important basis for non-contact human body feature extraction.

title_en: Flight type radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The application relates to a flight type radar life detection instrument, including the detection instrument body, be provided with the aircraft on the detection instrument body, be provided with connecting device between aircraft and the detection instrument body, connecting device is including connecting the platform and connecting the inserted block, it has two and all sets up at aircraft towards detection instrument body one side to connect the platform, connect the inserted block and insert and establish between two connection platforms, connect the inserted block and set up in detection instrument body towards aircraft one side. This application has and drives the detection instrument body through the aircraft and surveys in the space to avoid the road and the house of collapse, reduce the effect of the road of collapse and the performance of house restriction radar life detection instrument.
assignees: SHENZHEN DASANTI SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for fire fighting and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle for fire fighting and a system thereof, comprising: the unmanned aerial vehicle body, be equipped with battery, radar life detection instrument, GPS positioner, extinguishing device, temperature-sensing ware, wireless transceiver and controller etc. on the unmanned aerial vehicle body. The unmanned aerial vehicle for fire fighting and the system thereof provided by the invention can monitor the occurrence of forest fire in time, and can carry out emergency fire fighting at the first time and transmit the fire situation to the terminal, thereby reminding people to pay attention to and reducing the loss caused by forest fire.
assignees: JIANGSU JINGTONGJIE SAFETY PREVENTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: System and method for mitigating random body movement and interference effects in radar-based vital sign monitoring systems in medical applications
abstract_en: A radar system (10) for vital sign monitoring such as at least heart rate or respiration and a method for mitigating random body movement and external disturbance effects in vital sign monitoring such as at least heart rate or respiration by employing a radar system (10) configured for providing in-phase and quadrature signals from reflected radar waves and received radar waves are provided. The problem of random body movement effects and external disturbances affecting vital sign monitoring is alleviated at least by decomposing and filtering the reconstructed displacement signal x (t) using time and frequency analysis techniques such as Short Time Fourier Transform (STFT), followed by a non-Negative Matrix Factorization (NMF) operation. The decomposition allows the identification of time and frequency base components that contain random body movement disturbances. Thus, the filtered signal may be reconstructed after removal of the random body movement component, thereby enabling a reliable and robust vital sign parameter estimation.

title_en: Millimeter wave vital sign monitoring radar, monitoring method and emotion judging method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a millimeter wave vital sign monitoring radar, a monitoring method and an emotion judging method, which belong to the technical field of health monitoring, and particularly comprise an MCU module, a loudspeaker module, a millimeter wave radar antenna board, a power supply module and a display screen, wherein the MCU module, the loudspeaker module, the millimeter wave radar antenna board and the power supply module are arranged in a shell, and the display screen is arranged on the shell; the invention adopts non-contact monitoring, has wide application range and simple and quick monitoring.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar-based HRV signal extraction method and equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a millimeter wave radar-based HRV signal extraction method and equipment, which are used for solving the technical problem that the conventional HRV signal extraction method cannot carry out non-contact long-term monitoring on a user. The method comprises the following steps: collecting radar echo data of a human body in a sleep state, and processing the radar echo data to obtain vital sign signals of the human body; the radar echo data are obtained by acting a millimeter wave radar on the human body; filtering the vital sign signal based on a first preset filter to obtain a first filtered signal, and filtering the vital sign signal based on a second preset filter to obtain a second filtered signal; carrying out heartbeat cycle division on the first filtering signal through a first preset algorithm to obtain a heartbeat cycle signal; and screening the heartbeat periodic signal by using the second filtering signal through a second preset algorithm to obtain an HRV signal.

title_en: Excavation assistance system for work machine and excavation assistance method for work machine
abstract_en: To enhance the accuracy and efficiency of excavation by a work machine.SOLUTION: An excavation assistance system for a work machine includes: a work machine having: an underground search device with a radar capable of searching for a buried object; a machine body; and a work device provided on the machine body and performing an excavation work; a first display device that displays information; a first acquisition unit that acquires an allowable depth, which is a depth enabling the radar to perform a search from a ground surface with predetermined accuracy; and a second acquisition unit that acquires a search position at which a radar has performed a search. The first display device has a first display unit that, based on the allowable depth acquired by the first acquisition unit and the search position acquired by the second acquisition unit, displays on a map the allowable depth and an excavation position where the work device is allowed to perform an excavation work.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1A

title_en: Information Complex Alert
title_ko: 사물인터넷을 기반으로 한 환경, 응급상황, 정보복합알리미
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an Internet-of-Things (IoT)-based user management system that enables a user to check a variety of information and measure and transmit bio-signals to monitor and manage the environmental status of the user with a complex information notifier. An IoT-based user management complex service of the present invention comprises: a device that can be installed in a living space such as a living room, a room, a kitchen, etc., and includes an activity detection sensor capable of detecting the amount of activity; an information notification window that enables a user to check various information such as time, fine dust, and temperature; and a disaster broadcast speaker that can receive various disaster broadcasts, wherein the device is capable of transmitting designated content to a predetermined location by using an SOS button, an activity signal sent from the device is periodically received and stored, and a manager server is configured to receive information about the activity signal stored in a designated terminal.
abstract_ko:
-본 발명은 정보복합 알리미 장비를 이용해 사용자가 각종정보를 확인할 수 있고 생체신호를 측정 및 전송함으로써 사용자의 환경상태를 모니터링 관리할 수 있는 사물인터넷 기반 사용자 관리 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명 은 사물인터넷 기반 사용자 관리 복합서비스는 거주 공간 거실, 방, 부엌 등에 설치할 수 있으며, 활동량을 감지 할 수 있는 활동 감지 센서가 포함하는 기기와, 시간, 미세먼지, 온존수치 등 각종정보를 확인할 수 있는 정보알림창과, 각종 재난 방송을 수신할 수 있는 재난방송 스피커를 포함하며, SOS 버튼을 활용하여 미리 지정한 위치에 지정된 내용을 전송할 수 있는 기기이며, 상기 기기에서 송출된 활동신호를 주기적으로 수신하여 저장하며, 상기 관리자 서버는 지정한 단말기로 저장된 활동신호를 정보를 수신하도록 형성된다.

title_en: Through-wall radar detection system and detection method based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar detection system and a detection method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the system comprises the unmanned aerial vehicle, an environment sensing unit, a through-wall radar, a holder and a control unit; the unmanned aerial vehicle, the environment sensing unit, the through-wall radar and the holder are all connected with the control unit; the through-wall radar is positioned on the unmanned aerial vehicle and used for detecting the external structure, the internal structure and the internal personnel of the building to be detected; the environment sensing unit is positioned on the unmanned aerial vehicle and used for sensing the flight environment information of the unmanned aerial vehicle and sending the flight environment information to the control unit; the control unit controls the flight of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the flight environment information so as to keep the distance between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the outer wall body within a certain range; the cloud platform is located unmanned aerial vehicle, and the receiving and dispatching antenna of through-wall radar is located the cloud platform, and the control unit is according to flight environment information control cloud platform's action so that the array face of receiving and dispatching antenna keeps parallel with outer wall body. The invention has the advantages of simple structure, good detection performance and the like.

title_en: TRM-based through-wall radar detector
abstract_en: The invention discloses a TRM-based through-wall radar detector, and relates to the technical field of radar detection devices. The detector comprises a control module, wherein a control signal output end of the control module is connected with a control signal input end of a radar signal source and is used for outputting radar pulse signals under the control of the control module, a signal output end of the radar signal source is connected with a signal input end of a transmitter module, a signal output end of the transmitter module is connected with a signal input end of a transceiver module, a signal output end of the transceiver module is connected with a signal input end of a receiver module, and the transceiver module is used for transmitting detection signals to a wall and receiving reflected detection signals; the signal output end of the receiver module is connected with the signal input end of the control module. The detector has the advantages of simple structure, low cost, high resolution, good imaging effect and the like.

title_en: Optical waveguide display assembly for breathing mask
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for a respirator technical field provides a light guide display module for respirator, include: a support, its fixed mounting is on respirator's medial surface, just a standing groove has on the terminal surface of support, a connecting plate, connecting plate detachable fixed mounting in the standing groove, a casing, its joint is fixed in on a tip of support, just all be provided with a recess on the relative both ends face that sets up of casing, two lenses, every the equal holding of lens is fixed in and corresponds in the recess, and every the lens is made by transparent material, through this device of fixed mounting on respirator's medial surface, can be convenient for the staff when using, through the timely feedback signal to the staff of optical waveguide display screen, for example, ambient gas monitoring result, environment humiture, operation environment infrared image, oxygen cylinder pressure value, user vital sign monitoring result etc..
assignees: NANJING HANHAI XINGHE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Pipeline stress monitoring system and monitoring test method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a pipeline stress monitoring system and a monitoring test method thereof, wherein the pipeline stress monitoring system comprises a bottom plate, a fixed support, a stress loading device and a resistance strain type sensor, wherein the bottom plate is placed on the ground and is constructed with a first area for arranging the fixed support and a second area for arranging the stress loading device; the fixed support is arranged in the first area and can fix two ends of the pipeline so as to simulate the fully-constrained state of the buried pipeline at the soil inlet and outlet points of the landslide section; the stress loading device is arranged in the second area and can apply a vertical downward acting force to a section of pipeline so as to simulate the uniform load action of objects around the pipeline on the pipe body; the resistance strain type sensor is arranged on a stress monitoring point of the pipeline and can monitor and output the stress generation process of the pipeline. The pipeline stress monitoring system can monitor the stress-strain state of the pipeline, can find pipeline damage in time and realize real-time monitoring and scientific early warning of the suspended state of the pipeline.
assignees: NAT OIL & GAS PIPE NETWORK GROUP CO LTD;STATE PIPE NETWORK GROUP SOUTHWEST PIPELINE CO LTD

title_en: Systems and methods for living thing presence detection using a radar system
abstract_en: Embodiments of the disclosure include a Radar system for detecting presence of a living thing. The radar system includes a transmitter/receiver module configured to emit radio signals to an environment surrounding the Radar system and to detect returned radio signals from the environment, and a large-movement detection sub-module configured to determine a large movement of the living thing based on the returned radio signals. The radar system also includes a micro-movement detection sub-module configured to determine a micro movement of the living thing based on the returned radio signals, and a breath and heartbeat detection sub-module configured to determine a breath or heartbeat of the living thing based on the returned radio signals. The radar system further includes a presence detection sub-module configured to determine the presence of the living thing based on determinations received from the corresponding detection sub-modules.
assignees: AIRTOUCH SHANGHAI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Millimeter wave radar-based sports multi-person vital sign monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar-based method for monitoring vital signs of multiple persons moving, which comprises the steps of emitting linear frequency modulation continuous waves through a millimeter wave radar, detecting the multiple persons moving, receiving echoes through a receiving antenna, obtaining intermediate frequency signals after frequency mixing, storing the radar signals into a fast time-slow time format, and carrying out FFT (fast Fourier transform) processing in the fast time direction to carry out ranging so as to obtain echo data in a distance-slow time form. According to the invention, the influence of human body translation on the phase is removed in a time-frequency domain through wavelet transformation, the phase sequence of each target echo is respectively extracted, phase unwrapping is carried out, heartbeat signals and respiratory signals with different frequency bands are separated through an intermediate frequency filter, the heartbeat frequency and the respiratory frequency are respectively calculated through FFT (fast Fourier transform), the phenomenon that the motion of a human body can generate extra phase change on radar echoes is prevented, and the millimeter wave radar can accurately detect the heartbeat and the respiration of the human body is caused.
assignees: NANJING LIUJI OPTOELECTRONIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;JIANGSU YUNHEFENG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Heartbeat detection method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a heartbeat detection method and a heartbeat detection device, relates to the technical field of radar detection, and is used for improving the accuracy of heartbeat detection. The method comprises the following steps: transmitting electromagnetic waves to a target space and acquiring echo signals; processing the echo signal to obtain a heartbeat time domain signal of the target human body; determining the number of effective peak-valley pairs in the heartbeat time domain signal according to the heartbeat time domain signal, and determining a frequency selection range according to the number of the effective peak-valley pairs; carrying out fast Fourier transformation on the heartbeat time domain signal to obtain a heartbeat frequency domain signal; finding a target spectrum peak of the heartbeat frequency domain signal in the frequency selection range; and determining the heartbeat frequency of the target human body according to the frequency corresponding to the peak value of the target spectrum peak.
assignees: QINGDAO HISENSE HITACHI AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact type accurate heart rate detection method based on 77GHz millimeter radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-contact type accurate heartbeat detection method based on a 77GHz millimeter wave radar. Firstly, the frequency shift caused by weak chest displacement caused by the beating of the heart of a human body is captured by adopting the principle of continuous wave Doppler radar sign detection, namely, the radar transmits T (t) to a subject through a transmitting terminal. Then the phase of the signal T (t) is modulated by the chest wall movement x (t) of the subject, and the reflected signal is captured by a radar receiving end; secondly, after the reflected signal passes through a low noise amplifier at the front end, a baseband signal is obtained, a quadrature mixer is adopted to demodulate the baseband signal, and after the baseband signal passes through a gain amplifier, a chest wall signal can be obtained through arc tangent demodulation and joint winding calculation; and finally, obtaining a digital signal x (t) by the chest wall analog signal through an analog-to-digital converter, and obtaining a heartbeat frequency spectrum result after the digital signal is processed and is subjected to a heartbeat signal extraction algorithm VMD and a heartbeat frequency spectrum estimation algorithm CZT at the PC end.

title_en: Battlefield search and rescue method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a battlefield search and rescue method. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, receiving signals from a vital sign signal sensor arranged on a warrior; step 2, generating the vital sign signal of the warrior according to the signal acquired by the vital sign signal of the warrior; step 3, judging whether the warrior is in an injured state or not according to the vital sign signal of the warrior; and 4, positioning the position of the warrior when the warrior is in an injured state.
assignees: THE 305 HOSPITAL OF PEOPLES LIBERATION ARMY

title_en: Heartbeat detection method and system based on millimeter wave signals
abstract_en: According to the heartbeat detection method and system based on the millimeter wave signals, the millimeter wave sensor is used for transmitting continuous frequency modulation wave signals to a target user and receiving echo signals to obtain intermediate frequency signals, phase signals are extracted from the intermediate frequency signals, and the phase signals are used for capturing chest cavity micro-vibration of the target user caused by heartbeat movement. The method and the system can perform modal decomposition on the phase signal at least once based on the hierarchical variation modal decomposition model so as to remove the influence of the interference signal on the heartbeat signal, thereby obtaining fine-grained heartbeat information. The input signal of each variational modal decomposition is the output signal of the last variational modal decomposition. In each variational modal decomposition process, the method and the system calculate corresponding initial parameters based on input signals of the current variational modal decomposition, so that the optimization result is more accurate, the convergence rate is higher, the precision of the variational modal decomposition is improved, and the precision of heart rate detection is further improved.

title_en: Multi-radar association control method and control device in health monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-radar association control method and a multi-radar association control device in a health monitoring system. The health monitoring system comprises a first fall monitoring radar and a first human presence monitoring radar which monitor a first area, and a first vital sign monitoring radar which monitors respiration and heartbeat of a sub-area in the first area. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring personnel presence information monitored by a first human presence monitoring radar; and controlling the working modes of the first vital sign monitoring radar and the first fall monitoring radar according to the existence information of the personnel in the first area and whether the personnel are in the sub-area. The invention can reduce the false alarm rate of the monitoring radar of the health monitoring system, improve the reliability of the monitoring result and reduce the average power consumption of the health monitoring system.

title_en: Collapsible loess area road intelligent monitoring early warning system that sinks
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent monitoring early warning system that collapsible loess area road sinks belongs to collapsible loess area road monitoring early warning technical field, has solved that current detection technique is difficult to comprehensively, directly perceivedly to the road in time monitoring and the problem of early warning of sinking. The utility model discloses an information acquisition device, official working management facility and communication facility, communication facility includes 3S integrated system, commercial satellite and ground radar system, official working management facility includes the internet, computer and display device, the computer links to each other with display device, 3S integrated system and ground radar system link to each other with the computer through the internet respectively, commercial satellite links to each other with 3S integrated system, ground radar system and internet respectively, information acquisition device is pre-buried underground at the road, information acquisition device links to each other with 3S integrated system. The utility model discloses a two accuses of 3S integrated system and ground radar detecting system, it is more accurate, directly perceived to the prejudgement of collapsing.

title_en: Multifunctional solar heat collection and dissipation system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-functional solar energy collection cooling system. The system mainly comprises a non-pressure-bearing solar heat-collecting and heat-dissipating water bag, a heat-insulating and heat-storing water tank buried under a north wall, a submersible pump for circulation, a high-pressure submersible pump for fire fighting, an automatic temperature difference controller, a temperature and time controller and the like, wherein the solar heat-collecting and heat-dissipating water bag is fixedly suspended on the north wall in the sunlight greenhouse, and the heat-insulating and heat-storing water tank made of composite rubber and plastic is buried in an underground foundation groove of a truss of the north wall of the greenhouse. The utility model has the advantages of low in construction cost, mend warm effectual, the operation is stable with low costs, does not occupy the cultivation soil in the canopy, has solved china's northern regional assembled sunlight greenhouse because there is not thermal-arrest temperature compensation measure, only is applicable to and plants low temperature crops such as leafy vegetables, strawberry, can't plant the problem of solanberry class thermophilic nature crop through winter, has eliminated the fire control hidden danger that greenhouse material is flammable simultaneously.
assignees: BEIJING HUAMEI WOLONG AGRICULTURE TECH CO LTD;HUAMEI ENERGY SAVING TECH GROUP CO LTD;BEIJING WOLONG AGRICULTURE & FORESTRY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact biosignal analysis system for body condition determination
title_ko: 인체상태 판단을 위한 비접촉식 생체신호 분석 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a non-contact biometric signal analysis system for determining body conditions to prevent accidents caused by drowsy driving. According to the present invention, the non-contact biometric signal analysis system comprises: a signal generation unit transmitting a ultrawide band (UWB) impulse radar signal in a space in which a person to be determined exists and receiving a reflected signal; a signal processing unit filtering the signals received after being transmitted from the signal generation unit to extract a respiration signal and a heart rate signal as biometric signals to be determined; and a signal analysis unit performing time domain analysis and frequency domain analysis on the basis of the respiration signal and heart rate signal extracted through the signal processing unit to measure and generate a plurality of parameter information related to heart rate variability (HRV) and generating state analysis information for determining a current body condition of the person to be determined on the basis of the generated plurality of parameter information and preset and stored human condition determination reference information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 인체상태 판단을 위한 비접촉식 생체신호 분석 시스템은, UWB(Ultra wideband) 임펄스(Impulse) 레이더 신호를 판단대상이 존재하는 공간 내에 송신 후 반사되어 오는 신호를 수신하는 신호발생유닛; 상기 신호발생유닛으로부터 송신 후 반사되어 수신되는 신호들을 필터링 처리하여 판단대상의 생체 신호로서 호흡 신호 및 심박 신호를 추출하는 신호처리유닛; 및 상기 신호처리유닛을 통해 추출된 호흡 신호 및 심박 신호를 기반으로 시간 영역(Time Domain) 분석 및 주파수 영역(Frequency Domain) 분석을 수행하여 심박변이도(HRV, Heart Rate Variability) 관련 다수의 파라미터 정보를 측정 생성하고, 생성된 다수의 파라미터 정보 및 기 설정 저장된 인체상태 판단기준 정보를 기반으로 판단대상의 현재 인체상태를 판단한 상태분석정보를 생성하는 신호분석유닛;을 포함한다.
assignees: UNIV NAT HANBAT IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Vital sign information extraction method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a vital sign information extraction method, a vital sign information extraction device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting by adopting an ultra-wideband radar to obtain a radar echo signal; determining signal energy corresponding to each slice signal in the slow time direction in the radar echo signal; extracting human body sign signals from the radar echo signals based on an energy window with a preset width and signal energy corresponding to each slice signal; and carrying out coherent accumulation processing on the human body sign signals, and extracting respiratory signals and heartbeat signals from the processed human body sign signals. Therefore, the respiratory signal and the heartbeat signal can be accurately extracted from the radar echo signal according to the signal energy corresponding to each slice signal in the slow time direction in the radar echo signal and the energy window with the preset width.
assignees: CHINA COAL RES INST;UNIV LIAONING TECHNICAL

title_en: Protection device and method for X80 buried pipeline to penetrate through earthquake fracture zone
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of petrochemical industry and natural gas, and particularly relates to a protection device and a protection method for an X80 buried pipeline to pass through an earthquake fracture zone; the protection device comprises an X80 buried pipeline, a protection pipeline, an end cone pipeline, a flange structure, a displacement sensor, an air pressure sensor, a pneumatic booster pump, an air storage tank, an air inlet pipe, an air outlet pipe, a signal transmission and receiving device, a microcontroller and an electromagnetic valve. When the X80 buried pipeline passes through the earthquake fracture zone, the fault displacement can cause buckling deformation and even damage of the X80 buried pipeline. The invention can determine the area of X80 buried pipeline affected by fault displacement, and adds protective pipeline in the area, and fills nitrogen into the cavity between the protective pipelines, and can adjust the air pressure between the pipelines according to the strain of X80 buried pipeline to protect the buried pipeline. The invention can effectively reduce the influence of fault displacement on the buried X80 pipeline, prevent the pipeline strain from further increasing, and timely send out warning under the condition of pipeline danger.

title_en: Life monitoring method and device based on intelligent vehicle-mounted box
abstract_en: The application provides a life monitoring method and device based on an intelligent vehicle-mounted box, which specifically comprise the following steps: the millimeter wave radar sends a signal to scan an area in a vehicle, receives an echo signal of the radar, and mixes the sending signal with the echo signal to obtain a beat frequency signal; acquiring N frames of beat frequency signals, transmitting the N frames of beat frequency signals to an intelligent vehicle-mounted box for first data processing, and judging whether a target exists or not; filtering the signal with the target obtains a heart rate signal and a respiration rate signal respectively. The intelligent vehicle-mounted box provided by the application can monitor vital signs of targets in a vehicle in real time, and can give an alarm and ask for help in time when abnormal vital signs are found.

title_en: Coal mine goaf surface subsidence data acquisition system based on microseismic monitoring technology
abstract_en: The application provides a surface subsidence data acquisition system based on microseism monitoring technology, including earthquake wave sensor, data acquisition station and data processing host computer, this system adopts the mode that earth's surface and deep hole were buried underground, has realized that the noise is low, the fast characteristics of response. The earth surface grid and the deep hole are close to the bottom layer, and the characteristics of micro-seismic wave high-low frequency propagation are matched, so that the characteristics of long distance, large area, three-dimensional, real-time monitoring and time continuity are realized. The data can accurately obtain the three-dimensional space position and magnitude of the occurrence of the microseismic event through specialized data processing software, so that the rock mass damage condition and the filling treatment effect are evaluated. By means of microseism monitoring, long-time and wide-area bottom layer monitoring is achieved, and the method is well applied to aspects of reducing enterprise cost risks, providing effective goaf treatment schemes, treatment positions, evaluating treatment effects and the like.
assignees: CCTEG ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD;CCTEG BEIJING LAND CONSOLIDATION AND ECOLOGICAL RESTORATION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent system for detecting human heart rate and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent system for detecting human heart rate and a detection method thereof, belonging to the technical field of health management; the method comprises a detection stage, a position identification stage, a judgment stage, an information transmission stage, a reminding stage and a rescue information sending stage: s1, the detection stage comprises: arranging an infrared or direct microwave radar sensor in the toilet, and judging whether the current state of the vital sign target is entering a detection area or not through a microwave radar signal; s2: the location identification phase comprises: detecting personnel position identification, area water stain identification and area dehumidification control; s3: the judging stage comprises: the method comprises the steps of judging the inclination angle of a detector and judging the acceleration of the detector. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the reminding module started by the processor can be released through the key module, so that unnecessary panic of family members of the wearer is avoided; the time delay alarm is adopted, the false alarm is reduced, meanwhile, the innovative radar algorithm is adopted to obtain the vital sign signals of the human body, and the accuracy of the falling alarm can be improved.

title_en: Atrial fibrillation detection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vital sign detection technology and discloses an atrial fibrillation detection device, which transmits radar detection signals to a human body object to be detected, receives echo signals reflected by the human body object, processes and analyzes baseband signals obtained after the echo signals are mixed with the radar detection signals serving as local oscillation signals to obtain the heart rate of the human body object to be detected, judges whether atrial fibrillation occurs or not according to the heart rate of the human body object to be detected, and sends an alarm through an alarm unit when the atrial fibrillation occurs to the human body object to be detected, so that real-time monitoring of the atrial fibrillation of the human body object to be detected is realized. According to the atrial fibrillation detection device, atrial fibrillation does not need to be detected through electrocardiogram detection equipment, and the real-time non-contact atrial fibrillation monitoring can be performed on the human body object to be detected only by installing the atrial fibrillation detection device in the living environment of the human body object to be detected, so that the atrial fibrillation detection device is beneficial to timely finding when the human body object to be detected suffers from atrial fibrillation, does not influence the life of the human body object to be detected, and is particularly suitable for being used at home by old patients with irregular atrial fibrillation.

title_en: Fireproof Sleeve for Standing Duct
title_ko: 입상 에어덕트용 방화슬리브
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fireproof sleeve for a standing air duct, capable of excellently performing heat and flame insulation by quickly and perfectly closing a space with a thermal expansion fireproof sheet installed on the inside of a sleeve connecting a standing air duct to be shrunk from top to bottom while being expanded by heat in case of a fire. In accordance with the present invention, the fireproof sleeve for a standing air duct includes: a sleeve body formed into a cylindrical shape with open upper and lower parts to be buried in the sleeve; a thermal expansion fireproof sheet made of a thermal expansion material expanded by heat in case of a fire to be installed in a circumferential direction on the inner surface of the sleeve body; and a clamping member fixing a lower part of the thermal expansion fireproof sheet to a lower part of the sleeve body such that the internal space of the sleeve body can be closed with the thermal expansion fireproof sheet shrunk from top to bottom while being expanded by heat in case of a fire.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 입상 에어덕트를 연결하는 슬리브 내측에 설치되는 열팽창 내화시트가 화재시 열에 의해 팽창하면서 상부에서부터 하측으로 우그러지면서 공간을 신속하고 완전하게 차폐할 수 있도록 함으로써 우수한 차열 및 차염 작용을 하는 입상 에어덕트용 방화슬리브에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 입상 에어덕트용 방화슬리브는, 상단부와 하단부가 개방된 통 형태로 되어 슬라브 내에 매립되는 슬리브 본체; 화재 시 열에 의해 팽창하는 열팽창성 소재로 되어 상기 슬리브 본체의 내측면에 원주방향을 따라 설치되는 열팽창 내화시트; 및, 화재시 상기 열팽창 내화시트가 팽창하면서 상부에서부터 하측으로 우그러지면서 슬리브 본체 내부 공간을 차폐하도록, 상기 열팽창 내화시트의 하단부를 상기 슬리브 본체의 하부에 대해 고정하는 클램핑부재;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle airborne life detection radar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle airborne life detection radar, which comprises a radar device and a shell for installing the radar device, wherein the radar device comprises an antenna, a power module, a radio frequency module and a baseband module, and is characterized in that a damping device is also arranged on the shell, the damping device comprises a damping shaft, and a damping spring and a damper cover plate which are nested on the damping shaft; the shock absorber shaft extends out of the surface of the shell and is connected with the shell through the shock absorber cover plate. The utility model discloses the device is direct to be carried on the carbon plate of unmanned aerial vehicle bottom, can realize life detection, and can effectively reduce and take the interference problem for life detection device by unmanned aerial vehicle vibrations, and damping device adopts dual shock-absorbing structure, can reach the best shock attenuation effect.

title_en: Frequency spectrum estimation method based on Doppler radar heartbeat detection
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-contact type accurate heartbeat detection method based on a Doppler radar. Firstly, the frequency shift caused by weak chest displacement caused by the beating of the heart of a human body is captured by adopting the principle of continuous wave Doppler radar sign detection, namely, the radar transmits T (t) to a subject through a transmitting terminal. Then the phase of the signal T (t) is modulated by the chest wall movement x (t) of the subject, and the reflected signal is captured by a radar receiving end; secondly, after the reflected signal passes through a low noise amplifier at the front end, a baseband signal is obtained, a quadrature mixer is adopted to demodulate the baseband signal, and after the baseband signal passes through a gain amplifier, a chest wall signal can be obtained through arc tangent demodulation and joint winding calculation; and finally, the chest wall analog signal is processed by an analog-to-digital converter to obtain a digital signal x (t), the digital signal is separated and extracted by a Muller algorithm and a matched filtering algorithm at a PC end, and a heartbeat frequency spectrum result is obtained by an FTPR-TWV algorithm.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring children target
abstract_en: The utility model provides a target object for monitoring vital signs of children, which comprises: the children model comprises a children model body, a children model skin and a motion mechanism, wherein the children model skin is attached to the children model body and is formed by multiple layers of cloth and used for generating the same millimeter wave radar RCS radar scattering sectional area, the same micro Doppler effect and the same laser radar attribute as those of real children; motion is located the abdominal cavity of children's model body, includes: the device comprises a moving motor, an eccentric wheel, a jacking sliding plate and a fixed shell, wherein vertical slideways are arranged on two walls of the inner side of the fixed shell, the jacking sliding plate is erected on the vertical slideways, an output shaft of the motor is connected with a central shaft of the eccentric wheel, an eccentric shaft of the eccentric wheel is rotatably connected with a driving end of the jacking sliding plate so as to drive the eccentric wheel to rotate by the moving motor, and therefore the eccentric wheel drags the jacking sliding plate to reciprocate up and down to simulate the fluctuation of the thoracic cavity during respiration.

title_en: Neck-worn physiological monitor
abstract_en: The invention provides a neck-worn sensor that is a single, body-worn system that measures the following parameters from an ambulatory patient: heart rate, pulse rate, pulse oximetry, respiratory rate, temperature, thoracic fluid levels, stroke volume, cardiac output, and a parameter sensitive to blood pressure called pulse transit time. From stroke volume, a first algorithm employing a linear model can estimate the patient's pulse pressure. And from pulse pressure and pulse transit time, a second algorithm, also employing a linear algorithm, can estimate systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure. Thus, the sensor can measure all five vital signs along with hemodynamic parameters. It also includes a motion-detecting accelerometer, from which it can determine motion-related parameters such as posture, degree of motion, activity level, respiratory-induced heaving of the chest, and falls.

title_en: Sliding connection type distributed radar life detection positioning equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a distributed radar life detection positioning device in sliding connection, which comprises at least one radar unit and a sliding rail, wherein the radar unit is connected with the sliding rail and can slide along the sliding rail, and the sliding rail and the radar unit can rotate at any angle through a connecting device. The sliding rail is provided with the plurality of radar units, the base line of the antenna is increased, the detection resolution of the radar life detection positioning equipment can be effectively improved, and the performance of the radar life detection positioning equipment is improved; the number of the slide rails, the number of the radar units and the adjustable connecting devices among all the parts can change the antenna polarization direction of each independent unit, form multi-polarization or full-polarization antenna detection and improve the positioning performance; the number of the sliding rails, the number of the radar units and all the parts are matched through the adjustable connecting devices, and free arrangement of the independent radar units can be achieved.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device and Method for Imaging Structures Positioned Behind or Within a Surface
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a surface scanning and imaging device. The surface scanning and imaging device is designed for viewing through walls, ceilings, and other surfaces in a building to view structural components by positioning the device in proximity to the desired surface. The device includes one or more sensors for transmitting surface penetrating signals, a transceiver for receiving signals reflected from one or more structures positioned behind the surface, and an image processor to process the received signals to create a 2D or 3D image of the structural component that reflected the transmitted signals. The device displays the image of the structural component located behind the surface, allowing a user to determine where a repair or modification can be made. The structural components can be one or more of wires, circuits, studs, pipes, taps and other construction components.

title_en: Human body physical sign monitoring system based on microwave radar
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of physical sign monitoring, in particular to a human body physical sign monitoring system based on a microwave radar, which can monitor the information of human body vital signs in real time and send out an alarm in time, and can know monitoring data at any time through terminal equipment, and the system comprises: the monitoring device detects the vital sign state by the induction radar detector; the main controller processes the detection signals of the vital sign states by STM32 series chips and outputs data and alarm control signals; the relay output module outputs an alarm control signal sent by the STM32 series chip to peripheral alarm equipment; the peripheral alarm equipment realizes sound-light alarm; the power supply module is used for supplying power to the system as a whole; the local server receives data sent by the STM32 series chips, stores the data and uploads the data to the cloud platform server, and the cloud platform server can be accessed by the terminal equipment to obtain monitoring data in real time.

title_en: Three-dimensional rendering method and system for underground buried object based on three-dimensional ground penetrating radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional rendering method and a three-dimensional rendering system for an underground buried object based on a three-dimensional ground penetrating radar, wherein the three-dimensional rendering method for the underground buried object comprises the following steps: step S1, extracting target radar data according to a designated position; s2, preprocessing the extracted radar data, including removing direct waves of the extracted target radar data, eliminating background transverse waves of data of each channel, applying reverse amplitude attenuation gain to the data of each channel and removing low-frequency noise of the channel; step S3, calculating and projecting the processed radar data to obtain a full-channel data slice set; s4, processing data of the full-channel data slice set by utilizing an edge detection algorithm to obtain a slice set for separating a target waveform from background clutter; and S5, performing three-dimensional rendering on the targets separated in the slice set. The invention combines various filtering and data preprocessing, thereby being capable of effectively separating underground buried objects and effectively performing three-dimensional rendering.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign detection equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses non-contact vital sign detection equipment, relates to the technical field of vital sign detection equipment, and aims to solve the problem that the non-contact radar vital sign detection equipment in the prior art is inconvenient to carry due to the use scene problem. The fixing base is installed to radar life detection instrument's below, and fixing base and radar life detection instrument fixed connection, be provided with the shrink seat on the preceding terminal surface of fixing base, and shrink seat and fixing base sliding connection, the hand pull is installed to one side of shrink seat, and hand pull and shrink seat fixed connection, install the wheel seat on radar life detection instrument's the rear end face, and wheel seat and radar life detection instrument fixed connection, the inboard of wheel seat is provided with the wheel, the top of fixing base is provided with the interlock leg, and fixing base and interlock leg set up structure as an organic whole, the interlock leg is connected with radar life detection instrument interlock.
assignees: NANJING JINGYI SECURITY SYSTEM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Anti-irradiation multifunctional life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-irradiation multifunctional life detector, wherein automatic leveling devices are arranged at four corners of the outer side of a radar box; a level bubble is fixed on the top surface of the radar box; a common handle switch is arranged between the two automatic leveling devices positioned on the same side of the radar box; the automatic leveling device comprises an outer sleeve and an inner sleeve, the outer sleeve is fixed on the radar box, and the inner sleeve is arranged inside the outer sleeve in a sliding manner; the inner wall of the outer sleeve is fixed with a downward inclined agnail scale; the outer wall of the inner sleeve is provided with a positive thorn scale which inclines upwards. The utility model can work on the ground which is approximately horizontal, and also can work on the rugged rubble, thereby ensuring the maximum range of the radar during one-time detection, reducing the detection times of the same place and saving the detection time. The structure is simple, no additional power source is needed, and the trouble of power connection is avoided during outdoor operation; convenient to use, swift, very big operating time that has saved makes the rescue more quick.
assignees: SHANDONG YINLING ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wall-penetrating radar imaging method, device, equipment and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a through-wall radar imaging method, a device, equipment and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring through-wall radar echo signal sets acquired by a transmitting-receiving co-located antenna at a plurality of observation position points; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing a through-wall radar echo signal set to remove echo signals of a fixed wall static background in the through-wall radar echo signal set, inputting the preprocessed through-wall radar echo signal set and preset tuning parameters into a preset low-rank sparse optimization algorithm to solve so as to extract echo signals of a target to be detected, and constructing an image of the target to be detected according to the echo signals of the target to be detected. The method effectively removes strong reflection of foreign matters such as pipelines or steel bars in the wall, enhances the through-wall radar image of the target behind the wall, and improves the imaging quality of the through-wall radar.

title_en: Wisdom fire control is with having life to detect alarm function's intelligence smoke detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent smoke detector with a life detection and alarm function for intelligent fire fighting, which comprises a mounting plate, wherein a sucker component is mounted at the top of the mounting plate, and a shell is arranged at the bottom of the mounting plate. According to the utility model, the suction cup is placed on the ceiling through the mutual matching of the mounting plate, the suction cup assembly, the suction cup, the exhaust pipe, the exhaust valve, the exhaust pump, the exhaust pipe, the shell, the sealing cover, the smoke detector body, the fixing mechanism, the driving motor, the lead screw, the moving groove, the bearing, the threaded sleeve, the sliding groove, the sliding block, the fixing frame, the supporting plate, the guide rod and the infrared imaging probe, so that the suction cup is firmly fixed on the ceiling along with the exhaust of the exhaust pump, when the suction cup needs to be disassembled, the exhaust valve exhausts the air in the suction cup, the suction cup can be taken down, nails do not need to be nailed for fixation, the attractiveness of the roof is improved, the installation and the disassembly of the smoke detector are very convenient, and great convenience is brought to users.

title_en: Radar life detection instrument of portability rescue equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a radar life detection instrument capable of carrying rescue equipment, and relates to the technical field of radar life detection instruments. According to the radar life detection instrument, the detection instrument body, the lifting handle, the storage bin, the placing drawer, the pull handle, the limiting block, the limiting plate, the fixing block, the cushion block, the sleeve, the loop bar, the clamping plate, the spring and the clamping block are arranged, so that the function of placing rescue equipment inside the radar life detection instrument is achieved, occupied space is reduced by placing the rescue equipment inside the radar life detection instrument, influence on normal actions of search and rescue personnel is prevented, rescue time of the rescue personnel is avoided, meanwhile, the rescue equipment is prevented from being lost, influence on normal operation of the rescue actions is avoided, meanwhile, the rescue equipment is fixed and buffered, and damage to the rescue equipment due to impact force generated by bumping and shaking of the radar life detection instrument is prevented.
assignees: JIANGSU FLAME BLUE FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mounting platform extension device of micro-variation monitoring radar system
abstract_en: An installation platform extension device of a micro-variation monitoring radar system comprises: the system comprises rail equipment, a rail equipment bracket, a wire groove bracket, a distribution box, a rod body, video monitoring equipment, wireless communication equipment and a lightning rod; the rail equipment is erected on the rail equipment support; the wire groove is horizontally arranged, one end of the wire groove is connected with the track support, and the other end of the wire groove is connected with the distribution box; the bottom of the wire groove is supported by a wire groove bracket, and the bottom of the wire groove bracket is buried underground; the rod body is vertically arranged, the bottom of the rod body is buried underground, the upper part of the rod body is respectively provided with a video monitoring device and a wireless communication device, and the top of the rod body is provided with a lightning rod; the wire groove arranged in the horizontal direction is connected with the rod body arranged in the vertical direction through a universal flange; the cable of the track equipment is connected to the distribution box through the wire groove, and the cables of the video monitoring equipment and the wireless communication equipment are also connected to the distribution box through the wire groove. The utility model has the advantages of convenient installation, light weight and convenient transportation.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA MYPATTERN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Transceiver module for detection radar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of life detection, in particular to a transceiver module for a detection radar, which aims at solving the problem that the mbgc space is small, namely the relative space of large steel structure cabins such as a refrigeration house is limited, and radiated electromagnetic wave signals are completely reflected by a steel cabin metal structure body, so that the generated power is less than 1 mg, and the target of a life cannot be detected in the prior art. The invention can effectively solve the problem that the detection radar in the prior art cannot detect the target of the living body because the generated power is less than 1 mg because the radiation electromagnetic wave signal is completely reflected by the metal structure body of the steel cabin in a large steel structure cabin such as a refrigeration house with limited relative space.

title_en: Human body presence sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent induction, in particular to a human body presence sensor, which comprises a microwave sensor, an infrared sensor, a register unit, a control unit and a power supply unit, wherein the microwave sensor and the infrared sensor detect target environment information through a microwave sensing signal and an infrared temperature signal respectively, and detected data are transmitted into an operation unit to be processed by a statistical algorithm to classify the microwave sensing signal and the infrared temperature signal; judging according to the microwave sensing data and the temperature value, and when the data is stored in the high-temperature register, the control unit sends the human existence sensing to be true; when data is stored in the low Wen Jicun device, the control unit sends a human presence perception of no. The invention can sense the moving heat body and record the heat value, and the heat value can be used for judging whether the moving/static heat body exists or not and finally outputting whether the heat body exists in the closed space or not; based on the microwave sensor and the infrared sensor, it is jointly determined whether a person exists in the detected environment.

title_en: Metal sensing device and system for preventing crime and diasasters using thereof
title_ko: 금속탐지장치 및 이를 이용한 방범방재시스템
