abstract_en: In accordance with the present invention, disclosed are a metal detection device and a crime/disaster prevention system using the same. The metal detection device comprises: a case having a hollow inside and formed in a predetermined size; a cable formed in the case, and carrying a predetermined current; a permanent magnet formed in the case, and generating a magnetic field varied by a reaction to the current of the cable by moving in the case while reacting to an iron component; and a detection sensor sensing the varied magnetic field. Also, the metal detection device is buried to a predetermined depth in the ground. The crime/disaster prevention system comprises: the metal detection device; an analysis device analyzing and determining whether a fence is abnormal and where an abnormality occurs based on a sensed value transmitted from the detection sensor of the metal detection device; a remote reception device (server) receiving the information determined by the analysis device about whether the fence is abnormal; and a power supply part applying operating power to the system. Therefore, the present invention is capable of enabling accurate crime/disaster prevention by increasing usability.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 내부가 중공형태이고 일정한 크기로 형성되는 케이스; 케이스 내부에 구성되고, 일정한 전류가 흐르는 케이블; 케이스 내부에 구성되고, 철 성분과 반응하면서 케이스 내부에서 움직임에 따라 상기 케이블 전류와의 반응에 의해 변화되는 자기장을 발생하는 영구자석; 및 변화되는 자기장을 감지하는 감지센서로 구성되고 지중 일정깊이에 매설되는 금속탐지장치; 및 금속탐지장치의 감지센서로부터 전송된 감지값을 토대로 펜스의 이상여부 및 이상 발생 위치를 분석 판단하는 분석장치; 분석장치에서 판단된 펜스의 이상여부를 전송받는 원격 수신장치(서버); 및 시스템에 동작전원을 인가하는 전원부로 이루어진 금속탐지장치 및 이를 이용한 방범방재시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Treating pathogenic infections
abstract_en: Controllers induce a hypoglycemic condition within a predetermined blood glucose range and bacterial or viral infection are targeted for death. One or more controllers are in signal communication with sensors and measure physiological vital signs. Controllers are in signal communication with one or more fluid flow control devices to control delivery of at least insulin and glucose and at least one cocktail containing at least one of an antibiotic and an antiviral. The fluid control devices are in signal communication with at least one microprocessor having memory and the one or more physiological sensors, one or more databases or lookup tables and, wherein the controller controls the fluid control devices for at least insulin glucose, and the cocktail to keep blood glucose level (BGL) within a target hypoglycemic range.

title_en: Electronic device capable of measuring biological signal
title_ko: 생체 신호를 측정 가능한 전자 장치
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, an electronic device comprises: a housing including at least a conductive part; a display visually exposed to the outside through at least a part of the housing; a communication circuit electrically connected to the conductive part; a sensor electrically connected to the conductive part; a first blocking circuit connected between the conductive part and the communication circuit, and blocking a signal in a first frequency range; a second blocking circuit connected between the conductive part and the sensor, and blocking a signal in a second frequency range; and a processor operatively connected with the display, the communication circuit, and the sensor. The conductive part can be operated as an antenna of the communication circuit and a bio-signal measuring electrode of the sensor. In addition, various embodiments identified through the specification are possible. Therefore, a communication function and a biometric function of the electronic device can be efficiently provided.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 일 실시예에 따른 전자 장치는, 전도성 부분을 적어도 일부 포함하는 하우징, 상기 하우징의 적어도 일부를 통해 외부로 시각적으로 노출되는 디스플레이, 상기 전도성 부분과 전기적으로 연결되는 통신 회로, 상기 전도성 부분과 전기적으로 연결되는 센서, 상기 전도성 부분과 상기 통신 회로 사이에 연결되고, 제1 주파수 범위의 신호를 차단하도록 구성된 제1 차단 회로, 상기 전도성 부분과 상기 센서 사이에 연결되고, 제2 주파수 범위의 신호를 차단하도록 구성된 제2 차단 회로, 및 상기 디스플레이, 상기 통신 회로 및 상기 센서와 동작적으로(operatively) 연결된 프로세서를 포함할 수 있고, 상기 전도성 부분은 상기 통신 회로의 안테나 및 상기 센서의 생체 신호 측정 전극으로 동작하도록 구성될 수 있다.  이 외에도 명세서를 통해 파악되는 다양한 실시 예가 가능하다.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring waveform recovery method based on deep learning and radio frequency sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for recovering vital sign monitoring waveforms based on deep learning and radio frequency perception, which is based on radio frequency sensing and deep contrast learning technology, recovers vital sign monitoring waveforms in a contactless manner, builds a neural network by applying an encoder-decoder model, avoids loss of waveform details compared with a traditional comparison model, can recover vital sign waveforms with fine granularity more accurately in a motion state, and further improves the robustness of vital sign monitoring to motion; in addition, the vital sign waveform recovery method provided by the invention adopts a unified data format, so that the method can be almost deployed on any type of commercial grade radar in the prior art, can adapt to different application requirements, and is independent of bottom hardware.

title_en: Rotary locking telescopic device applied to distributed radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rotary locking telescopic device applied to a distributed radar life detection instrument in the field of life detection. When the telescopic adjusting mechanism is in telescopic adjustment, the guide positioning groove slides in the outer guide groove, the stop block slides in the inner guide groove, the sliding copper sleeve slides in the inner hole of the shell of the telescopic device, and the sliding copper sleeve provides guide for the telescopic motion of the telescopic device, so that the stability of the telescopic motion process of the telescopic device can be greatly improved.

title_en: Automatic locking expansion device applied to distributed radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic locking expansion device applied to a distributed radar life detection instrument in the field of life detection instruments. The sliding plate is pushed, so that the transition inclined surface jacks up the positioning column, the positioning column is separated from the positioning hole in the guide positioning strip, the first telescopic shell can slide along the inner pipe, the length of the telescopic device is adjusted, when the switch is loosened, the switch can be restored to the original position under the reverse action of the spring, when the switch is adjusted to the other positioning hole, the positioning column is matched with the positioning hole under the action of the spring, and the telescopic device is automatically locked and fixed at the extension position or the telescopic position, and the sliding plate is extremely convenient.

title_en: Vital sign detection device and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vital sign detection device and a method, wherein the vital sign detection device comprises: the equipment belt is internally provided with a direct current power supply; the radar mechanism comprises a shell, a support and a breathing radar, wherein the shell is fixed on the equipment belt, the support is fixed in the shell, the support is provided with an inclined plane which forms an included angle with the surface of the shell, the breathing radar is installed on the inclined plane of the support, and the direct-current power supply is electrically connected with the breathing radar; the vital sign detection device is embedded in the equipment belt, no extra construction stay wire is needed, and the vital sign detection device is powered by a direct-current power supply in the equipment belt; the structure of the vital sign detection device is inclined by a certain angle, so that the vital sign detection device effectively covers the whole sickbed and detects the vital sign condition of a patient in real time.
assignees: YIANDAI HEALTHY TECH HANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent detection device for physical signs of drivers and passengers based on radar fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of transportation, and discloses an intelligent detection device for physical signs of drivers and passengers based on radar fusion; the system comprises a power management part, a core control processing part, a 4G communication module part, a GPS positioning module part, a vital sign detection part, a face recognition part and an emotion analysis part, wherein the system is used for dynamically monitoring emotion analysis and vital signs of drivers and passengers in real time based on radar and video fusion technology, establishing a mental health monitoring long model for individual drivers and passengers, particularly people engaged in the driving industry for a long time, monitoring the physical health state and the mental state of the drivers and passengers for a long time, and timely and pertinently providing psychological counseling and timely intervention or post allocation through individual long model curve data; the body state of the driver is dynamically detected in real time through the millimeter wave radar, so that traffic accidents caused by sudden body diseases of the driver can be effectively prevented.
assignees: ANHUI FUHUANG SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wall-penetrating radar imaging method, system, terminal equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a through-wall radar imaging method, a through-wall radar imaging system, terminal equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring radar echo data in a preset radar detection scene and discretizing an imaging scene in the preset radar detection scene; constructing a dictionary matrix according to a discretization result of an imaging scene, constructing a low-rank sparse signal model according to the dictionary matrix, determining a low-rank sparse optimization problem in the low-rank sparse signal model, constructing a through-wall radar imaging model according to the determined low-rank sparse optimization problem, performing model training on the through-wall radar imaging model until the through-wall radar imaging model converges, inputting echo data to be imaged into the converged through-wall radar imaging model, and performing imaging analysis to obtain a reconstructed image. According to the invention, the clutter suppression and target image reconstruction problems of the wall are converted into the low-rank sparse optimization problem, the reflection clutter of the wall is effectively suppressed, and the imaging quality of the reconstructed image is improved.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring action removing method based on deep learning and radio frequency perception
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign monitoring action removing method based on deep learning and radio frequency perception. By applying the method, the influence of motion on non-contact vital sign monitoring can be eliminated, the fine-grained vital sign waveform is correctly recovered, the robustness of the vital sign monitoring on the motion is improved, and the defect that the existing waveform separation technology is limited to linear signals is overcome. In addition, the method samples the sensing data captured by the radar on two time scales of fast and slow, converts the data captured by various radars into a uniform format, facilitates subsequent signal processing, and enables the vital sign monitoring method provided by the invention to be independent of bottom hardware.
assignees: CHINESE AND NEW INTERNATIONAL UNITED RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Two-stage wall parameter estimation method based on ultra-wideband through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage wall parameter estimation method based on an ultra-wideband through-wall radar, which is applied to the technical field of through-wall radar imaging and aims at solving the problem of difficult wall parameter estimation in the prior art; the method comprises two stages of estimating wall parameters, wherein the first stage is an electromagnetic propagation path calculation stage, namely, a search interval of unknown parameters such as a radar wall-separating distance R, wall thickness d, wall dielectric constant epsilon and the like is firstly determined, and then, the time delay of the front surface and the rear surface of the wall is calculated by adopting a specular reflection and refraction point approximation method; the second stage is a wall parameter estimation stage, and projection imaging is carried out on each parameter in the parameter searching region; only when the candidate parameter is equal to the true value, the echo is coherently accumulated, and the intensity of the image after the back projection is the maximum, so that the candidate parameter is searched through the back projection image to obtain the true value.

title_en: Mobile terminal under disaster
abstract_en: To enable a mobile device buried in a debris flow or an avalanche to oscillate a specified frequency.SOLUTION: A mobile terminal such as a smartphone is equipped with a sensor for detecting a disaster. When a person using a mobile terminal encounters a disaster such as a mudslide or an avalanche that suddenly occurs, the mobile terminal involved in the disaster detects the disaster at the same time, and detects a sudden change in radio wave condition, for example, in a case that the radio wave condition from a base station suddenly gets out of range because the mobile terminal is buried, whereby it is possible to find a buried location in a short period of time by transmitting a specified frequency by an oscillator incorporated in the mobile terminal even when the mobile terminal is broken.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Sleep staging method and device based on radar information and terminal
abstract_en: The invention provides a sleep staging method, a sleep staging device, a sleep staging terminal and a sleep staging storage medium based on radar information. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring respiratory heartbeat information in a sleep period monitored by a vital sign monitoring radar; calculating a sleep staging index at each moment in a sleep period based on the breathing heartbeat information; calculating a sleep stage characteristic value of each moment in a sleep period based on the sleep stage index; and comparing the sleep stage characteristic value with a preset stage threshold value, and determining the sleep stage corresponding to each moment in the sleep period according to the comparison result. The invention carries out sleep staging based on radar information, acquires information under the conditions of no perception and no influence on normal sleep of a user, has simple and accurate sleep staging processing process and has higher reliability.
assignees: SONISTEK HEBEI SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device and method for detecting respiration and heart rate based on biological radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a device and a method for detecting respiration and heart rate based on a biological radar. The device comprises a vital signs detection sensor 102, a WiFi module 103, a Bluetooth module 104, a power supply module 107, a display module 106, a real-time alarm module 105 and a single-chip microcomputer minimum system module 101. The vital signs sensor 102 is an IR-UWB biometric radar sensor. The method comprises the steps of utilizing a vital sign detection sensor to emit nanosecond or picosecond narrow pulse signals for detection, utilizing a single chip microcomputer to process IR-UWB echo signals I and Q, and extracting respiratory signals and heart rate signals by methods of a specially designed low-pass filter and the like. The invention can detect the breath and the heart rate of the person 108 to be detected under the condition of non-contact, and can give an alarm immediately once the abnormality occurs, if the terminal device 109 is connected, the data can be transmitted to the terminal device 109 through communication modes such as WiFi or Bluetooth, and alarm information can be displayed on the terminal device.
assignees: GUILIN ELECTRONICS SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY UNIV

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a non-contact vital sign monitor, includes the housing, the monitor still includes millimeter wave biological radar module and display screen, the signal transmission end of millimeter wave biological radar module is located the housing outer wall, waits to detect human thorax position and is located the coverage of signal transmission end, the output and the main control module of millimeter wave biological radar module are connected, the main control module is connected with display module, display module's output is connected with the display screen, the display screen is located on the housing. The utility model provides a non-contact vital sign monitor which is convenient to use, simple in structure and rich in functions.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring camera system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The utility model provides a vital sign monitoring camera system based on a millimeter wave radar, which comprises: the device comprises a millimeter wave radar module, an optical camera module, a main control board, an audio module, a storage module, a rotating assembly, a communication module and a power module; the millimeter wave radar module is used for transmitting electromagnetic waves and receiving echo signals, and judging the motion amplitude, the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency of the human body according to the echo signals; the optical camera module is used for acquiring image information through optical imaging; the main control board is used for processing echo signals and image information; the audio module is used for outputting and inputting audio signals; the storage module is used for storing the echo signal, the image information and the audio signal; the rotating assembly is used for driving the millimeter wave radar module and the optical camera module to rotate, and the rotation of the millimeter wave radar module and the optical camera module realizes omnibearing monitoring. The utility model adopts non-contact vital sign monitoring, can carry out all-round monitoring and has better monitoring effect.
assignees: SHENZHEN WANJIAAN INTELLIGENT SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: All in one survival kit for fire escape and evacation leading LED line system connected to thereof
title_ko: 화재 대피용 일체형 생존키트 및 이와 연동되는 피난유도 led라인 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated survival kit for fire evacuation and an evacuation guidance LED line system linked therewith and, more specifically, to an integrated survival kit for fire evacuation, which is always carried by a user to wear goggles and an oxygen mask in case of a fire or disaster so that the user quickly responds to suffocation accidents caused by fire and evacuates safely from the fire scene, and an evacuation guidance LED line system linked therewith. According to the present invention, a thermal sensor, a controller, and a beacon sensor are buried in an existing winker hose LED guidance lamp, are configured to be connected to an emergency exit, and are linked with a beacon sensor installed in the integrated survival kit for fire evacuation, so that an emergency exit in a direction away from the place where a fire occurred, and thus prompt evacuation is guided.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재 대피용 일체형 생존키트 및 이와 연동되는 피난유도 LED라인 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 화재나 재난 상황에서 항시 고글 및 산소마스크를 착용할 수 있게 휴대하여 화재로 인한 질식사고에 신속하게 대응함과 동시에 화재 현장으로부터 안전하게 대피하는 것이 가능한 화재 대피용 일체형 생존키트 및 이와 연동되는 피난유도 LED라인 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
특히, 본 발명의 화재 대피용 일체형 생존키트 및 이와 연동되는 피난유도 LED라인 시스템은 기존 윙카호스LED 유도등 내에 열감지센서 및 콘트롤러와 비콘센서를 매립하고, 비상구와 연결되도록 구성되며, 상기 화재 대피용 일체형 생존키트에 설치된 비콘센서와 연동하게 하여 화재발생장소로부터 이격되는 방향의 비상구로 안내하도록 구성하여 신속한 피난을 유도하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method for detecting adjacent multi-target vital sign of millimeter wave MIMO radar under clutter background
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting adjacent multi-target vital signs of a millimeter wave MIMO radar under clutter background, which belongs to the field of vital sign detection and comprises the following steps of: transmitting a plurality of chirp signals modulated with space-time block codes; the receiving end: a. mixing echo signals of all receiving antennas with reference modulation signals, extracting recombination and space-time decoupling to obtain arrayed signals; performing distance azimuth two-dimensional smoothing and spatial spectrum estimation on the arrayed signals to locate adjacent human targets; b. extracting phase difference value sequences corresponding to the human body target and the clutter scattering points to construct vital sign signals and clutter scattering point phase signals corresponding to the human body target; c. and carrying out variation constraint multi-mode decomposition on the detected vital sign signals and clutter scattering point phase signals to obtain vital sign parameters. The invention can separate adjacent human targets under clutter background, and the separated vital sign signals have obvious periodicity, smooth waveform and high parameter estimation precision.

title_en: Wall-hanging smog gas sensor is used in wisdom fire control
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wall-mounted smoke gas sensor for intelligent fire fighting, which comprises a wall body, wherein a pre-buried box is arranged in an inner cavity of the wall body, a control box is arranged in the inner cavity of the pre-buried box, the right side of the control box penetrates through the outer side of the pre-buried box and is fixedly connected with a mounting box, the top and the bottom of the inner cavity of the pre-buried box are fixedly connected with fixed boxes, limiting plates are arranged in the inner cavity of the fixed boxes, the opposite sides of the two limiting plates are fixedly connected with first springs, and the opposite sides of the two limiting plates are fixedly connected with clamping rods. According to the wall-mounted smoke gas sensor for intelligent fire fighting, the limiting plate, the first spring, the clamping rod, the adjusting shell, the pushing block, the partition plate, the sliding rod, the sliding sleeve, the pressing plate, the second spring and the pushing rod are arranged, so that the problems that an existing wall-mounted smoke gas sensor for intelligent fire fighting is troublesome in installation and disassembly processes, time-consuming and labor-consuming are solved, the wall-mounted smoke gas sensor for intelligent fire fighting has the advantages of being rapid and convenient to disassemble and assemble, and the wall-mounted smoke gas sensor for intelligent fire fighting is worth popularizing.
assignees: ZHEJIANG MIDDLE INDUSTRY FIRE FIGHTING SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Smoke alarm and smoke alarm system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a smoke alarm and a smoke alarm system, wherein the smoke alarm comprises a shell, a mounting carrier, a chip and an alarm device, the shell is mounted on the mounting carrier, air inlets are circumferentially formed in the outer part of the shell, and the alarm device is mounted on the outer wall of the shell; a chip is arranged in the middle of the inner wall of the shell; it is characterized by also comprising: a dual smoke detection device and a life detection device; the dual smoke detection device is arranged on the outer wall of the shell. The smoke alarm provided by the utility model comprises the double smoke detection devices, can be used for respectively detecting the concentration of white smoke and black smoke in smoke, is more accurate in smoke concentration detection compared with the existing smoke alarm, and is provided with the life detection device, so that the privacy of a user in a space is protected, and meanwhile, the life activity signs in a millimeter wave radar monitoring range with strong penetrating fog, smoke and dust penetrating capability are depended.

title_en: Six sufficient search and rescue type robots
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a six-foot search and rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of search and rescue of robots and comprises a six-foot robot, a main control module, a material area, an infrared temperature measurement module, an ultrasonic sensor, a camera, a cardiotachometer pulse measurement module, a voice recording and playing module, a satellite mobile communication module, a temperature and humidity measurement module and a radar life detection instrument, and is suitable for complex terrains, so that convenience is brought to search and rescue work, trapped persons can be rescued more quickly and safely by rescuers after disasters, and casualties of rescuers can be reduced; the radar life detection instrument is more accurate, and trapped people can be more accurately found in a complex environment after an earthquake disaster; the body temperature and the pulse of the trapped person can be measured, a water bag and nutrient solution can be sent to the trapped person, and the trapped person can be helped to insist for a longer time; the carried satellite mobile communication module and the voice recording and playing module can enable trapped people to carry out voice communication with rescue workers or family people outside a disaster area.

title_en: Automated health check device and methods
abstract_en: An automated health check device and methods, the device comprising: at least one imaging sensor configured for capturing at least one image of at least an area confined by a window of the vehicle; at least one vital signs sensor configured for measuring a health parameter of a passenger at the area confined by the window; and at least one processor configured for: acquiring and analyzing the at least one image to determine location of the window; determining based on the determined location of the window a location of the passenger; determining the at least one vital signs sensor being oriented to a predetermined point of view in relation to the location of the passenger determined; and obtaining a measurement of the health parameter of the passenger from the at least one vital signs sensor.

title_en: Portable handheld radar life detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable handheld radar life detection device, which comprises: the mobile mechanism is arranged in the shell; the moving mechanism comprises a U-shaped plate, the U-shaped plate is slidably mounted in the shell, and a radar life detection head is mounted in the U-shaped plate through a support column; when the radar life detection head is used, life signs are detected through the radar life detection head on the spot after a disaster, when the device is used for a long time, the condition of high temperature load is easily generated, the use temperature of the radar life detection head is detected through a temperature sensor in a U-shaped plate, when the temperature is too high, a motor is started through a DSP controller to drive the gear to rotate on a rack, the U-shaped plate is driven to move downwards to the inside of a shell through the meshing of a gear and the rack, the radar life detection head is closed, the storage is rapidly completed, a heat dissipation fan is started to blow the radar life detection head, and the temperature of the probe is reduced.

title_en: Breathing heartbeat detection method, system and device based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a breath and heartbeat detection method, a system and a device based on millimeter wave radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a radar echo signal, and acquiring object distance and phase information based on the mixture of the radar echo signal and a transmitting signal; enhancing the phase information to obtain enhanced phase information; performing wavelet packet decomposition on the enhanced phase information, reconstructing a respiratory signal based on the decomposed low-frequency component, and reconstructing a heartbeat signal based on the decomposed high-frequency component; reconstructing the physiological rate of the reconstructed respiratory signal and the reconstructed heartbeat signal; based on the reconstructed respiratory signal, the reconstructed heartbeat signal and the sensing matrix, constructing a loss function, and introducing a sparse penalty term and an adaptive factor into the loss function to realize physiological rate reconstruction. The scheme can effectively eliminate the influence caused by multipath effect in the environment, improves the signal to noise ratio, overcomes the interference caused by different intensity movements and realizes the accurate detection of respiratory heartbeat.

title_en: In-vehicle vital sign monitoring and protecting system and method and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system for monitoring and protecting vital signs in a vehicle, which is characterized by comprising the following components: the monitoring unit is used for monitoring the environment in the vehicle and the characteristics of the left living body; the vehicle-mounted host is used for calculating signals identified by the relevant sensors and sending out relevant instructions; a communication unit for transmitting MSD information; the alarm unit is used for reminding people around the vehicle; the active rescue unit is used for relieving adverse conditions of people in the vehicle; the recognition speed is ensured, and meanwhile, the recognition precision is increased; meanwhile, the active rescue function is equipped, when the temperature in the vehicle does not reach the dangerous degree, the safety of the vital signs in the vehicle can be guaranteed without extra rescuers arriving at the site, when the temperature in the vehicle is too high, the safety of the vital signs in the vehicle can be guaranteed through the third-party rescue mode, the boarding rate of the third-party rescue mode is reduced, and the rescue cost is reduced.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZHONGRUN SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Portable millimeter wave vital sign monitoring radar
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a portable millimeter wave vital sign monitoring radar, which belongs to the technical field of health monitoring, and particularly comprises an MCU module, a speaker module, a millimeter wave radar antenna board, a power supply module and a display screen, wherein the MCU module, the speaker module, the millimeter wave radar antenna board and the power supply module are arranged in a shell, and the display screen is arranged on the shell; the utility model adopts non-contact monitoring, has wide application range and simple and quick monitoring.
assignees: SHANXI GERUAN SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Buried object survey device, method for controlling display of buried object survey device, and display control program
abstract_en: To provide a buried object survey device, a method for controlling the display of the buried object survey device, and a display control program, with which it is possible to eliminate the need for marking work and lighten the burdens of workers at buried object survey time.SOLUTION: A buried object survey device 10 comprises a capacitance sensor 13, a survey image conversion processing unit 25, a storage unit 22, a display unit 12, an operation input unit 15, and a display control unit 30. The capacitance sensor 13 detects the presence/absence of a buried object 51. The survey image conversion processing unit 25 converts the result of detection by the capacitance sensor 13 to a survey image. The storage unit 22 stores the survey image and a grid layer that includes grid lines corresponding to a prescribed reduction scale. The display unit 12 displays the survey image and the grid layer. The display control unit 30 controls the display unit 12 so as to display the survey image and the grid layer, and to display the survey image to be movable relatively to the grid layer in response to input to the operation input unit 15.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Portable contactless biosignal detection device, driver monitor device, visitor screening system, and household healthcare system
abstract_en:
The present invention provides a vital signal detection device of a portable and non-contact type that can independently acquire vital information such as body temperature, respiratory rate, and heart rate simultaneously. 
     The present invention includes: an antenna unit provided with a planar antenna of a MIMO radar on a front surface; and a display unit including a display panel on the front surface. The antenna unit is combined with the display unit or the display unit is combined with the antenna unit in a rotatable manner so that, from a state where the planar antenna and the display panel face in a direction ahead of the front surface, the planar antenna is turned to be directed to a direction of a back surface of the display unit opposite from the display panel. The portable non-contact vital signal detection device detects a vital signal on a side ahead of the front surface and a vital signal on a side in the direction of the back surface opposite from the front surface.

title_en: Intelligent nursing home monitoring system and method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent monitoring, and provides an intelligent monitoring device of an aged people house based on a millimeter wave radar, wherein a vital sign signal acquisition module is used for sending a radar signal to a target to be detected and receiving a returned echo signal, a signal processing module is used for processing the echo signal to obtain a distance-speed spectrogram and a distance-angle spectrogram, judging whether the target to be detected is a target human body or not based on the distance-speed spectrogram and the distance-angle spectrogram, if so, calculating distance information of the surface fluctuation of the chest cavity of the target human body in unit time according to the echo signal, and extracting vital sign data of the target human body according to a phase difference signal in the distance information; the signal processing module is used for judging whether a set threshold value is exceeded or not according to the target human body vital sign data, if so, sending an early warning signal to the cloud early warning module, and sending a notice or timely warning to a related contact person or a caregiver through the cloud early warning module.

title_en: Human body respiration and heartbeat detection method based on terahertz and recurrent neural network
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of obtaining a human physiological sensing signal through a terahertz radar signal, preprocessing the information in a noise reduction mode, marking the processed signal data, training through a constructed recurrent neural network model, and obtaining a relevant model after training; the technical scheme is that on the basis of carrying out noise reduction processing on the terahertz echo signal, an empirical mode decomposition method is adopted, an original signal is decomposed into inherent mode functions on different frequencies, data are learned through a designed multilayer cyclic neural network, a recognition model for human heartbeat and respiratory information is constructed, the influence of noise on the terahertz echo signal can be effectively removed, and the terahertz echo signal has good robustness; the detection accuracy of the signal is better improved by a mode of carrying out feature fusion on the high-frequency signal and the low-frequency signal.

title_en: Colliery is personnel positioning device in pit based on 5G technique
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of underground safety, in particular to coal mine underground personnel positioning equipment based on a 5G technology, and aims to solve the problems that the existing coal mine underground personnel positioning equipment is inaccurate in positioning and lacks a vital sign detection function. The coal mine underground personnel positioning equipment based on the 5G technology is used for positioning underground personnel based on the 5G technology, has extremely high positioning precision, and greatly improves the positioning accuracy of the underground personnel; the built-in body temperature rhythm of heart blood pressure sensor of wearing equipment I, body temperature rhythm of heart blood pressure sensor's detection data send for 5G chip I after signal processor handles, and 5G chip I sends real-time vital sign of staff in the pit to ground controlgear, provides important basis for the formulation of rescue scheme when the mine disaster takes place.
assignees: DAGUANG WISHONG INFORMATION TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Non-contact vital sign detection crawler control device
abstract_en: A non-contact type vital sign detection crawler control device comprises a radar module, a control module, a power driving module, a wireless communication module, a power supply module and a program configuration module; the radar module, the power driving module, the wireless communication module and the program configuration module are all connected with the control module, the power supply module is connected with all other modules and supplies power to the other modules, the control module comprises a chip STM32F103C8, the power driving module comprises two motor driving chips and two motors, and the wireless communication module comprises a component HC-08. According to the utility model, the power driving module can intelligently drive the tracked vehicle to replace fire rescue personnel to enter a severe life detection environment, non-contact type life sign detection is realized through the radar module, instruction interaction and data transmission between the tracked vehicle and rear-end control personnel are realized through the wireless communication module, and the accuracy and reliability of life detection can be effectively improved.
assignees: SHENYANG FIRE PROTECTION RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT

title_en: Emergency situation detection system in private space based on lidar sensor
title_ko: 라이더 센서 기반 사생활 공간에서의 위급상황 감지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a light detection and ranging (LiDAR) sensor-based emergency detection system in a private space, which accurately detects dangerous situations while minimizing privacy exposure. According to the present invention, the LiDAR sensor-based emergency detection system comprises: a LiDAR sensor detecting an object in a detection area requiring privacy protection; a vibration sensor detecting the magnitude of vibration in the detection area; a breath sensor detecting a breathing pattern of the object when the object detected by the LiDAR sensor is a person; a smart hub relaying data among the LiDAR sensor, the vibration sensor, the breath sensor, and an analysis server; and an analysis server receiving and applying detection data of the vibration sensor, detection data of the breath sensor, and an image taken by the LiDAR sensor to a convolutional neural network (CNN) algorithm to detect a predetermined movement pattern of the object. Therefore, the present invention determines an emergency.
abstract_ko: 사생활 공간에서의 위급상황 감지 시스템은, 사생활 보호가 필요한 감지영역에서 객체를 검출하기 위한 라이더 센서와, 감지영역에서의 진동크기를 감지하는 진동감지센서와, 라이더 센서에서 감지된 객체가 사람일 경우, 객체의 호흡패턴을 검출하는 호흡감지센서와, 라이더 센서, 진동감지센서 및 호흡감지센서와 분석서버의 사이에서 데이터를 중계하는 스마트 허브와, 진동감지센서의 감지 데이터, 호흡감지센서의 감지 데이터 및 라이더 센서에서 촬영된 영상을 각각 수신하고 컨벌루션 뉴럴 네트워크(Convolutional Neural Network, CNN) 알고리즘을 적용하여 미리 설정된 객체의 설정된 움직임 패턴을 검출하면서 위급상황을 판단하는 분석서버를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KUMOH NAT INST TECHNOLOGY IND ACAD COOP FOUND;TLBIZ CO LTD

title_en: Radar system and bio-signal detection method performed thereby
title_ko: 레이더 시스템 및 그에서 수행되는 생체 신호 탐지방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a radar system and a bio-signal detection method performed thereby, the method comprising the steps of: (a) a radar signal processing part removing a fixed target included in a received signal, detecting a peak power distance index of a bio-target using a bio-signal, which is a moving target, and selecting a preset number of neighbor distance indices based on the detected peak power distance index; (b) performing autocorrelation on multi-chirp data corresponding to the selected neighbor distance index to detect the periodicity characteristics of the bio-signal; (c) selecting a plurality of multi-chirp data of the neighbor distance index exceeding a preset reference value from among power values on which the autocorrelation has been performed; (d) summing the multi-chirp data of the selected neighbor distance index to improve the signal-to-noise ratio of the signal, thereby detecting a Doppler frequency signal; (e) performing power correlation on the detected Doppler frequency signal; and (f) detecting a maximal peak from the result of the power correlation and calculating the BPM of the bio-signal using a frequency corresponding to the detected maximal peak. The detection rate and accuracy of a bio-signal including the respiration rate or the heart rate of a human being can be improved using the periodic characteristics of the bio-signal.
abstract_ko: 레이더 시스템 및 그에서 수행되는 생체 신호 탐지방법에 관한 것으로, (a) 레이더 신호처리부에서 수신신호에 포함된 고정 표적을 제거하고, 이동 표적인 생체 신호를 이용하여 생체 표적의 피크 파워 거리 인덱스를 검출하며, 검출된 피크 파워 거리 인덱스를 중심으로 미리 설정된 개수의 이웃 거리 인덱스를 선택하는 단계, (b) 선택된 이웃 거리 인덱스에 해당하는 다중 첩 데이터에 대해 각각 자기 상관을 수행해서 생체 신호의 주기성 특징을 검출하는 단계, (c) 상기 자기 상관을 수행한 파워 값 중에서 미리 설정된 기준치를 초과하는 이웃 거리 인덱스의 다중 첩 데이터를 복수 개 선택해서 생체 신호를 선별하는 단계, (d) 선택된 이웃 거리 인덱스의 다중 첩 데이터를 합산해서 신호의 신호 대 잡음비를 향상시켜 도플러 주파수 신호를 검출하는 단계, (e) 검출된 도플러 주파수 신호에 대해 파워 상관을 수행하는 단계 및 (f) 상기 파워 상관을 수행한 결과에서 최대 피크를 검출하고, 검출된 최대 피크에 해당하는 주파수를 이용해서 생체 신호의 BPM을 계산하는 단계를 포함하는 구성을 마련하여, 생체 신호의 주기적인 특성을 이용해서 사람의 호흡수나 심박수를 포함하는 생체 신호의 탐지율 및 정확도를 향상시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Fire door for apartment house
title_ko: 공동주택용 방화문
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire door for an apartment house, wherein the fire door can be safely operated. Moreover, the fire door comprises: a ceramic pipe buried along a wall surface; a door frame for forming a frame moving path; a fire door for allowing cold air to be sprayed to the door frame; a hinge axis; a door temperature sensor for checking a temperature; and a controller for controlling a temperature and intensity of the cold air.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공동주택용 방화문에 관한 것으로서, 벽면을 따라 매설되면서 에어컨 냉기가 공급되도록 하는 세라믹 배관; 상부에는 세라믹 배관이 연결되고, 상부면과 양측면을 통해 하부면으로 내부에는 냉기가 순환하도록 틀 이동로를 형성하는 도어 틀; 일측에서 상기 도어 틀에 상단부와 하단부가 회전 가능하게 축지지되고, 일정 폭이 이격되도록 구비되는 내측 패널과 외측 패널, 상기 내측 패널과 외측 패널의 안쪽면에 접합되는 내열판과, 상기 내측 패널과 외측 패널의 사이에 구비되어 내외측 공간을 분리되게 하는 중앙 격판과, 상기 내열판과 상기 중앙 격판 사이의 공간을 수직의 방향으로 다단 분리되게 하면서 각 분리되는 공간은 상호 반대측 단부간 교번으로 연통되도록 하여 상부로부터 냉기가 지그재그 형상으로 하향 이동할 수 있도록 냉각 통로를 형성하는 가이드 격판으로 이루어지며, 상기 내열판과 중앙 격판과 가이드 격판은 상호 결합되는 불연 및 단열 소재로서 이루어지고, 상기 내측 패널과 외측 패널의 주연부를 일정 폭으로 절곡시킨 사이드면에는 상기 내측 패널과 외측 패널의 절곡 단부간 일정 폭 이격되도록 하면서 외측의 상기 가이드 격판에 의해 패널간 열 전달이 차단되도록 하며, 양측의 패널 단부간 일정 폭으로 노출되는 사이드면은 상기 가이드 격판에 의해 커버되도록 하면서 상기 가이드 격판의 사이드면을 따라 일정 간격으로 미세 분사홀이 형성되도록 하여 내부의 냉각 통로를 통해 유동하는 냉기가 상기 도어 틀에 분사되도록 하는 방화 도어; 상기 도어 틀에 대해서 상기 방화 도어가 회전 가능하게 축지지되도록 하면서 중앙은 수직 관통되도록 하며, 상부축은 상기 도어 틀의 상부면측 틀 이동로와 상기 방화 도어의 상부측 냉각 통로에 각각 일부가 삽입되고, 하부축은 상기 방화 도어의 하부측 냉각 통로와 상기 도어 틀의 하부면측 틀 이동로에 일부 삽입되면서 에어컨 냉기가 상기 방화 도어에 공급 및 배출되도록 하는 힌지축; 상기 방화 도어의 내측 패널과 외측 패널에 각각 설치되도록 하여 화재 발생 시 각각의 온도를 체크하는 도어 온도 센서; 상기 도어 온도 센서로부터 감지되는 온도에 따라 일정 온도 이상에서 에어컨이 자동으로 가동되게 하면서 감지되는 온도 변화에 따라 냉기의 온도와 세기가 조절되도록 하는 콘트롤러로서 이루어지는 구성이 특징이다.

title_en: Vital sign detection method and system for moving target
abstract_en: The invention provides a vital sign detection method and a vital sign detection system for a moving target, wherein the method comprises the following steps: transmitting chirp signals with different slope frequencies based on an MIMO technology to obtain a plurality of groups of signal data with different distance resolutions; acquiring target distance information and extracting a target phase signal; and decomposing the target phase signal to obtain a heartbeat signal and a respiration signal of the target based on a modal decomposition algorithm, and estimating the heart rate and the respiration rate of the target. The invention uses the non-contact millimeter wave radar for detection, realizes the detection of the respiration rate and the heart rate of the moving target, and brings pleasant experience to users while ensuring privacy compared with wearable and contact devices; compared with other traditional non-contact vital sign monitoring methods, the method does not need the monitored person to sit on a chair or lie on a bed to enable the chest to face the radar equipment, supports the target to normally move in the monitoring area, and realizes the monitoring of the vital signs.
assignees: WUHAN BEACON FIRE KEANDROID SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY;UNIV SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY CHINA

title_en: Urban buried pipeline ground penetrating radar calibration method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for calibrating a ground penetrating radar of an urban buried pipeline, which comprises the following steps of S1 designing and manufacturing various standard blocks, forming various standard sample blocks by combining the standard blocks into different layering models, wherein the standard sample blocks are used for simulating layering of a real urban road and a buried pipeline of the real urban road, S2 continuously sweeping the calibrated ground penetrating radar from left to right above the standard sample blocks to generate a visual picture, S3 calculating thickness of different layering, pipeline burial depth, pipeline spacing, pipeline trend and pipeline medium attribute according to the generated picture, S4 comparing, calculating metering performance errors of the calibrated radar to calibrate the metering performance of the calibrated radar, meanwhile checking whether the calibrated radar is accurate or not, S5 judging whether the radar performance is qualified according to the result of the step S4, and solving the problem that the measuring result is biased due to factors such as different dielectric constants, different material compositions and noise interference.

title_en: Ultra-wideband UWB life signal data processing method and device based on singular value decomposition
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a method and a device for processing Ultra Wideband (UWB) vital signal data based on singular value decomposition, the method comprising: transmitting a continuous pulse sequence by using an ultra-wideband radar life detector to detect so as to obtain a plurality of groups of continuous echo signals containing vital sign signals, and preprocessing an echo signal matrix; singular value decomposition is carried out on the echo signal matrix after pretreatment so as to obtain multi-order singular values and singular matrix components; extracting space eigenvectors and time eigenvectors corresponding to the singular values of each order from the singular matrix components; the method and the device have the advantages that compression storage processing is carried out on the singular values, the space feature vectors and the time feature vectors of each order, and through the method and the device, the problems of large clutter and noise interference, space-time feature coupling, overlarge data size, occupation of a large amount of storage space and the like of the echo signals of the ultra-wideband radar life detector can be reduced, meanwhile, the singular values of the signals are processed, and the timeliness of processing the vital sign signals is improved.

title_en: A sensor apparatus of pile-type and sensor fixing-type this is able to amplify sensing signal for diagnosing integrity of facilities
title_ko: 센싱 신호 증폭이 가능한 센서 고정형 시설물 건전성 진단용 파일형 센서장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pile-type sensor apparatus for diagnosing a health of a sensor fixed-type facility capable of amplifying a sensing signal. According to the present invention, the pile-type sensor apparatus for diagnosing the health of the sensor fixed-type facility capable of amplifying the sensing signal of the present invention is installed to a certain depth inside facilities such as slopes, buried pipes, dams and buildings to detect waves generated by structural displacement inside the facility. In addition, the pile-type sensor apparatus for diagnosing the health of the sensor fixed-type facility capable of amplifying the sensing signal amplifies an electrical waveform signal and provides a detection signal to the outside so that the health of the facility can be evaluated. Therefore, the structural displacement of the facility can be detected in advance before a serious structural displacement or collapse accident of the facility occurs, so that casualties and accidents can be prevented in advance. The pile-type sensor apparatus for diagnosing the health of the sensor fixed-type facility capable of amplifying the sensing signal comprises: an iron-type pile unit (100); a sensing unit (200); and an amplification unit (300).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비탈 경사면, 지중 매립 관, 댐, 건물과 같은 시설물 내부에 일정 깊이로 삽입 설치되어 시설물 내부의 구조 변위에 따라 발생하는 파동을 감지하고, 전기적 파형 신호를 증폭하여 외부로 감지 신호를 제공하여 시설물의 건전성 평가를 할 수 있도록 하여, 시설물의 심각한 구조 변위나 붕괴 사고가 발생하기 전에 시설물 구조 변위를 사전에 파악할 수 있어 인명피해와 사고 발생을 사전에 방지할 수 있는 효과를 제공 발명으로, 철재형 파일부(100), 센싱부(200), 증폭부(300)를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Negative Pressure Clothing having portable negative pressure apparatus
title_ko: 휴대용 음압기가 구비된 음압복
abstract_en: The present invention relates to negative pressure clothing with a portable negative pressure device. The present invention comprises: a sensor unit which detects air pollution and fine dust indoors; a head unit which forms a penetrating unit on a front side and covers a face part; a body unit which is downwardly connected to the head unit, is combined to be separated, and covers a body; an earphone which is combined and provided to be wirelessly connected to a smartphone in the head unit; an oxygen supplying line which receives oxygen by allowing one end to be inserted into an inner space of a lower part of the head unit and allowing the other end to be exposed to the outside; an oxygen generating device which is installed in the other end of the oxygen supplying line and generates the oxygen; and a wearable type portable negative pressure device which discharges indoor contaminated air to the outside by lowering indoor air pressure below outdoor air pressure. The present invention can promote health.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 휴대용 음압기가 구비된 음압복에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 실내에는 공기 오염도와 미세먼지를 검출하기 위한 센서부와 전면에는 투시부가 형성되며, 얼굴 부분을 감싸도록 하는 머리부와 상기 머리부와 하향으로 연결되며, 분리 가능하게 결합되어 몸을 감싸는 몸통부와 상기 머리부에는 스마트폰과 무선 연결되도록 하기 위해 결합, 구비되는 이어폰과 상기 머리부의 하부의 내부공간에 일단이 삽입되고 외부에 타단이 노출되어 산소가 유입되는 산소공급라인과 상기 산소공급라인의 타단에 설치되어 산소를 발생시키는 산소발생기와 실내의 공기 압력을 실외의 공기 압력보다 낮게 하여 내부의 오염된 공기를 실외로 배출시키는 웨어러블 형태의 휴대용 음압기를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: UNIV TONGMYONG IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Multi-target respiration and heartbeat signal detection method for FMCW radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target respiration and heartbeat signal detection method for an FMCW radar, which comprises the following steps: constructing a matrix R (m, n) for the radar intermediate frequency signals according to a frame period, and performing FFT (fast Fourier transform) on each frame of data in the matrix R (m, n) respectively to obtain a time distance matrix D (p, n); detecting the front N1 column data of D (p, N) by using a constant false alarm rate to obtain potential distances of a plurality of targets; clustering the potential distances of the multiple targets in the N1 column by using a K-means algorithm to obtain rough distances of the K targets, and determining distance ranges of the K targets; searching peak values in K distance ranges for each line of data in D (p, n) to obtain K target distance values, and calculating phases of K target positions; and performing unwrapping and difference on K target phases in the N lines of data, and performing filtering separation to obtain respiratory and heartbeat signals of K targets. The invention can overcome clutter influence and quickly obtain rough positions of a plurality of targets; the method improves the detection precision of respiration and heartbeat signals, and is suitable for detecting multi-target vital signs in a complex environment.

title_en: System and method for controlling the temperature of a chamber
title_ko: 챔버의 온도를 제어하기 위한 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a chamber control system for controlling a thermal chamber used for a thermal environment test on a satellite component. In accordance with the present disclosure, the chamber control system for controlling a thermal chamber includes: a human-machine interface receiving a biometric signal of a user from a wearable device, identifying whether a problem occurs to the user based on the biometric signal, and, when identifying that a problem has occurred to the user, transmitting a danger signal indicating the occurrence of the problem; a thermal chamber control part transmitting an emergency situation command signal in response to the danger signal; and a thermal chamber changing the internal temperature of the chamber to a room temperature in response to the emergency situation command signal. The present invention is capable of preventing a satellite component from being exposed to an extreme situation.
abstract_ko: 본 개시는 위성체 부품의 열 환경 시험에 이용되는 열 챔버를 제어하기 위한 챔버 제어 시스템에 관련된 것이다. 본 개시에 따르면, 열 챔버를 제어하기 위한 챔버 제어 시스템은 웨어러블(wearable) 장치로부터 사용자의 생체 신호를 수신하고, 상기 생체 신호에 기반하여 상기 사용자에게 문제가 발생하였는지 여부를 식별하고, 상기 사용자에게 문제가 발생한 것으로 식별한 경우 상기 문제의 발생을 지시하는 위험 신호를 송신하는 휴먼-머신 인터페이스와, 상기 위험 신호에 응답하여, 비상 상황 명령 신호를 송신하는 열 챔버 제어부와, 상기 비상 상황 명령 신호에 응답하여 챔버의 내부 온도가 상온으로 변경되는 열 챔버를 포함한다.

title_en: Biological signal measuring device based on electric stimulation for each part
title_ko: 부위별 전기자극 기반의 생체신호 측정장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a biometric signal measurement device based on electric stimulation for each part to maximally treat a part of a user's body. According to the present invention, the biometric signal measurement device comprises: a plurality of biometric signal sensors for measuring biometric signals of parts of a user's body; a plurality of electrical stimulation sensors transmitting a plurality of electrical stimulation signals for treatment to the user's body at the same time or sequentially with a time difference; a monitoring unit monitoring a biometric signal-based user bio-rhythm or a user bio-rhythm changed according to the electrical stimulation signals; a database storing information about the user's biorhythm monitored by the monitoring unit; an analysis unit storing a first analysis algorithm analyzing information on the user's biorhythm stored in the database to determine an optimal biometric signal sensor for measuring an optimal biometric signal best reflecting the user's biorhythm among the plurality of biometric signal sensors and a second analysis algorithm calculating an optimal electrical stimulation signal for maximally treating a part of the user's body on the basis of the optimal biometric signal; and a control unit performing control so that the optimal biometric signal is measured from the biometric signal sensor and performing control so that the optimal electrical stimulation signal is generated from the electrical stimulation sensor.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 부위별 전기자극 기반의 생체신호 측정장치는, 사용자의 신체 일부에 대한 생체신호를 측정하는 복수의 생체신호 측정센서; 사용자의 신체 일부에 치료를 위한 복수의 전기자극 신호를 동시에 전달하거나 시간차를 두고 순차적으로 전달하는 복수의 전기자극 센서; 생체신호 기반의 사용자 바이오리듬 또는 전기자극 신호에 따라 변화되는 사용자 바이오리듬을 모니터링하는 모니터링부; 모니터링부에서 모니터링된 사용자 바이오리듬에 대한 정보가 저장되는 데이터베이스; 데이터베이스에 저장되는 사용자 바이오리듬에 대한 정보를 분석하여 복수의 생체신호 측정센서 중 사용자 바이오리듬을 최대로 반영하는 최적의 생체신호를 측정하기 위한 최적의 생체신호 측정센서를 판단하는 제1 분석 알고리즘과, 최적의 생체신호를 기준으로 사용자의 신체 일부가 최대로 치료되도록 하기 위한 최적의 전기자극 신호를 연산하는 제2 분석 알고리즘이 기저장되는 분석부; 및 생체신호 측정센서로부터 최적의 생체신호가 측정되도록 제어하며, 전기자극 센서로부터 최적의 전기자극 신호가 생성되도록 제어하는 제어부;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Circular plastic tarpaulin room
abstract_en: The circular plastic tarpaulin room comprises a roof and a room body, wherein the roof is arranged at the top end of the room body, a working cavity is arranged in the room body, a sliding door is arranged on the side wall of the front end of the working cavity, shutters and observation windows are arranged on the side walls of the left side and the right side of the working cavity, a pre-buried layer is arranged at the bottom end of the room body, a driving motor is arranged at the top end of the working cavity, a driving gear is arranged at the top end of the working cavity, the output end of the driving motor is connected with the driving gear, the room body is arranged above the working cavity and provided with an annular conduction cavity, and through the arrangement of the driving gear, the conduction gear, the convex block, the fire sprinkler and a dry powder storage tank, when a fire disaster happens, a smoke sensor drives a control valve to be opened, and simultaneously controls the driving motor to work, so as to drive the conduction gear and the fire sprinkler to carry out circular motion, and spray dry powder outwards through the fire sprinkler, thereby spraying of dry powder is more comprehensive even to promote fire extinguishing effect.
assignees: TIANJIN LONGISU SEA CRYSTAL GROUP LTD COMPANY;DRY FARMLAND INTELLIGENT SCIENCE AND TECH BALANCED WATER LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Apparatus and method for detecting body component
title_ko: 체내 성분 검출 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: One embodiment of a device for detecting a body component includes: a sensor unit which contacts a subject and detects a biosignal; and a processor which determines a time point at which the influence of local blood pressure is minimized, including a time point at which the amplitude of an AC component is maximized or a time point at which the slope of a DC component is maximal, and detects body components based on the determined time point.
abstract_ko: 체내성분 검출장치의 일 실시예는 피검체와 접촉되어 생체신호를 검출하는 센서부, 생체신호에서, AC성분의 진폭이 최대가 되는 시점 또는 DC성분의 기울기가 최대가 되는 시점을 포함하는, 국부혈압의 영향이 최소가 되는 시점을 결정하고, 상기 결정된 시점을 기초로 체내성분을 검출하는 프로세서를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar-based real-time monitoring method for vital signs of driver
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time monitoring method for vital signs of a driver based on a millimeter wave radar, wherein the millimeter wave radar corresponding to the position of the chest of the driver is arranged in a vehicle and is accessed to an information entertainment domain controller; and, performing the steps of: the information entertainment domain controller receives the vital sign data information of the driver collected by the millimeter wave radar and receives the driving state information of the vehicle; and the infotainment domain controller superposes and processes the vital sign data information of the driver and the vehicle running state information into real-time vital sign information, and uploads the real-time vital sign information to a cloud server for calling. According to the invention, the heartbeat frequency information of the driver and/or the breathing frequency information of the driver are monitored in real time by arranging the millimeter wave radar, so that the driver can be ensured to be timely provided with danger warning, and the driver can be ensured to have enough time to carry out emergency treatment.

title_en: Be applied to rotatory locking telescoping device of distributed radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotary locking telescopic device applied to a distributed radar life detection instrument in the field of life detection. When the telescopic adjusting mechanism is in telescopic adjustment, the guide positioning groove slides in the outer guide groove, the stop block slides in the inner guide groove, the sliding copper sleeve slides in the inner hole of the shell of the telescopic device, and the sliding copper sleeve provides guide for the telescopic motion of the telescopic device, so that the stability of the telescopic motion process of the telescopic device can be greatly improved.

title_en: Mechanical telescopic locking device applied to distributed radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mechanical telescopic locking device applied to a distributed radar life detection instrument in the field of life detection instruments, which comprises a telescopic device, wherein the telescopic device is of a U-shaped structure, two end parts of the telescopic device are respectively provided with a rotating device, the rotating devices are connected with the telescopic device through screws, the periphery of the bottom end of one rotating device is provided with a first radar unit, the periphery of the bottom end of the other rotating device is provided with a second radar unit, and the first radar unit and the second radar unit are connected with the rotating device through screws. According to the telescopic device, the three-section ball slide rail is arranged between the telescopic inner tube and the telescopic shell I and used for providing telescopic guidance for the telescopic inner tube and the telescopic shell I, the flexibility of telescopic is greatly improved, the adjustment is labor-saving and convenient, the telescopic device is extremely practical, and the locking switch is only required to be rotated to enable the locking switch to stretch into the clamping groove, so that the fixing operation of the telescopic device can be realized, and the telescopic device is extremely convenient and fast.

title_en: Vital-sign radar sensor using wireless internet signals
abstract_en: A vital-sign radar sensor uses wireless internet signals to detect vital signs. It includes a first and second demodulation unit to demodulate an incident and reflected wireless internet signal with an injection-locked oscillator into a first and second demodulated signal, respectively. The combined use of the first and second demodulated signals can eliminate the influence of communication modulation on the extraction process of a Doppler shift due to vital signs. Moreover, the vital-sign radar sensor is a receive-only device so that it won't cause interference to ambient wireless communication networks.

title_en: Three-dimensional detection and positioning device for dental implant
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a three-dimensional detection and positioning device for a dental implant, which is used for detecting the implant in a gingival. The tooth implant detection device comprises a detection sensor, a software and hardware control device and the like, wherein the detection sensor consists of a spiral coil at the front end and an electrode at the tail end, and when the detection sensor senses a metal implant buried in gum, the inductance of the coil is changed, and the frequency of an oscillation circuit is changed along with the change of the inductance, so that the detection and positioning effects are achieved. Can bury three dimensions such as the outside of gum, the inboard of gum through top, the planting body to wearing the planting body and survey to can fix a position the inside accurate position whether have planting body and planting body of gum fast, not only can make things convenient for the planting body in accurate location patient oral cavity of doctor, also can reduce patient's economic burden and reduce the injury to the human body.
assignees: CHANGSHA SMILE TOOTH BEAUTIFYING INTELLIGENT SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Human motion, heartbeat and respiration monitoring system based on millimeter waves
abstract_en: The invention provides a millimeter wave-based human body motion, heartbeat and respiration monitoring system, which comprises a vital sign detection mechanism, wherein the vital sign detection mechanism is respectively arranged on an installation support in the human body movement range, the installation support is triangular in shape, shock absorption pads are arranged at the corners of the bottom of the installation support, a circular support plate is arranged in the middle of the top end of the installation support, a circular nut is arranged in the middle of the top end of the disc surface of the circular support plate, and a sleeve is arranged in the middle of the top end of the circular nut in a threaded manner, the millimeter wave-based human body motion, heartbeat and respiration monitoring system comprises a vital sign detection mechanism, wherein the vital sign detection mechanism is arranged on the installation support in the human body movement range, the circular nut is arranged in the middle of the disc surface of the circular support plate, and a sleeve is arranged in the middle of the top end of the circular nut in a threaded manner: the method can be conveniently applied to health and activity monitoring radar data and monitoring maps in private places such as hospitals, offices and families for verification and acquisition respectively, and dual privacy safety is provided from the mechanism. Through millimeter wave sign detection case, conveniently make the access with data, combine the convenient speed that will obtain of vital sign radar still to include all motion components. By performing a doppler FFT to perform spectral analysis on the obtained velocity, various components can be resolved.
assignees: HEFENGCHU VOYAGE SCIENCE AND TECH DEVELOPMENT LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: A method for detecting vital signs based on a radar senor and a system for monitoring and improving state of sleeping
title_ko: 레이다 센서 기반 생체신호 검출 방법 및 이를 이용한 수면 모니터링 및 개선 시스템
abstract_en: According to the present specification, disclosed are a method for detecting a biosignal based on a radar sensor, and a system for monitoring and improving a sleep using the same. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the system comprises: a first device (100) including a radar sensor (130); and a second device (200) wirelessly communicating with the first device (100). The radar sensor (130) performs radar transmission/reception with respect to a subject to obtain a heartbeat signal and a breathing signal separated from each other from a received radar, and the second device (200) receives data on the heartbeat signal and the breathing signal from the first device (100) to monitor a sleep. Therefore, the precision on bio-signal detection can be further improved.
abstract_ko: 본 명세서는 레이다 센서 기반 생체신호 검출 방법 및 이를 이용한 수면 모니터링 및 개선 시스템을 개시한다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 수면 모니터링 및 개선 시스템은 레이다 센서(130)를 포함하는 제1 기기(100); 및 상기 제1 기기(100)와 무선통신하는 제2 기기(200);를 포함하며, 상기 레이다 센서(130)는 피검체에 대한 레이다 송수신을 수행하여 수신 레이다로부터 상호 분리된 심박 신호 및 호흡 신호를 획득하며, 상기 제2 기기(200)는 상기 제1 기기(100)로부터 상기 심박 신호 및 상기 호흡 신호에 대한 데이터를 전송받아 수면 모니터링을 수행한다.

title_en: Bio-metric signal measuring apparatus using sensors and method of performing there of
title_ko: 복수의 센서를 이용한 생체 신호 측정 장치 및 이의 실행 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a biometric signal measurement apparatus using a plurality of sensors to minimize power consumption and an execution method thereof. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the biometric signal measurement apparatus comprises: a plurality of sensors sensing motion of a biometric signal measurement target and sensing whether the biometric signal measurement apparatus comes in contact with the skin of the biometric signal measurement target; a first ADC converting a sensing value of a second sensor or third sensor among the plurality of sensors into a skin contact signal to detect a first contact state and generating a first contact state detection result; a second ADC converting a sensing value of the second sensor or third sensor among the plurality of sensors into a skin contact signal to detect a second contact state and generating a second contact state detection result; a first control unit determining whether a predetermined pattern is detected by using a sensing value of a first sensor among the plurality of sensors, providing an activation command for changing the state of the first ADC to an active state to the first ADC according to a determination result, and providing an activation command for changing the state of the second ADC to an active state on the basis of a first contact state detection result to the second ADC when a contact state detection result is received from the first ADC; and a second controller measuring a biopotential difference through the second sensor or third sensor according to the second contact state detection result when a second contact state detection result is received from the second ADC.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 복수의 센서를 이용한 생체 신호 측정 장치는 생체 신호 측정 대상의 모션을 센싱하고, 상기 생체 신호 측정 장치가 상기 생체 신호 측정 대상의 피부에 접촉되었는지 여부를 센싱하는 복수의 센서, 상기 복수의 센서 중 제2 센서 또는 제3 센서의 센싱 값을 피부 접촉 신호로 변환하여 제1 접촉 상태를 감지한 후 제1 접촉 상태 감지 결과를 생성하는 제1 ADC, 상기 복수의 센서 중 제2 센서 또는 제3 센서의 센싱 값을 피부 접촉 신호로 변환하여 제2 접촉 상태를 감지한 후 제2 접촉 상태 감지 결과를 생성하는 제2 ADC, 상기 복수의 센서 중 제1 센서의 센싱 값을 이용하여 특정 패턴이 감지되었는지 여부를 판단하고, 상기 판단 결과에 따라 상기 제1 ADC의 상태를 활성화 상태로 변경하기 위한 활성화 명령을 제1 ADC에 제공하고, 상기 제1 ADC로부터 접촉 상태 감지 결과를 수신하면 상기 제1 접촉 상태 감지 결과를 기초로 상기 제2 ADC 상태를 활성화 상태로 변경하기 위한 활성화 명령을 상기 제2 ADC에 제공하는 제1 제어부 및 상기 제2 ADC로부터 제2 접촉 상태 감지 결과를 수신하면 제2 접촉 상태 감지 결과에 따라 상기 제2 센서 또는 제3 센서를 통해 생체 전위차를 측정하는 제2 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for determining a distance for measuring vital sign based on coherency between magnitude and phase
title_ko: 크기와 위상 사이의 코히어런시에 기반한 활력 징후 측정 거리 결정 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and method for determining a distance for measuring a vital sign based on coherency between magnitude and phase. According to the present invention, the method comprises the following steps of: receiving a signal reflected through a radar; determining a magnitude signal and a phase signal on the basis of the reflected signal; determining coherency between the magnitude and phase signals; and determining a distance for vital sign measurements on the basis of the coherency. Accordingly, since a magnitude-phase coherency index, which quantifies the coherency between magnitude and phase in each range bin, is utilized on the basis of mathematical models and experimental observations that magnitude and phase fluctuations are highly correlated in range bins where vital signs are present, accurate vital signs can be measured in comparison with conventional methods when the range bin with the highest index value is selected.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 크기와 위상 사이의 코히어런시에 기반한 활력 징후 측정 거리 결정 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다.  본 발명에 따르면, 활력 징후 측정을 위한 거리를 결정하는 방법에 있어서, 레이더를 통해 반사된 신호를 수신하는 단계; 반사된 신호에 기초하여 크기 신호와 위상 신호를 결정하는 단계; 크기 신호와 위상 신호 사이의 코히어런시를 결정하는 단계; 및 코히어런시에 기초하여 활력 징후 측정을 위한 거리를 결정하는 단계를 포함한다.  
본 발명에 따르면, 활력 징후가 존재하는 범위 빈에서는 크기 및 위상의 변동이 높은 상관 관계가 있다는 수학적 모델과 실험적 관찰을 기반으로 각 범위 빈에서 크기와 위상 간의 코히어런시를 정량화하는 크기 위상 코히어런시 지수를 활용함으로써, 가장 높은 지수 값을 가지는 범위 빈이 선택된다면, 종래의 방법들에 비하여 더욱 정확한 활력 징후가 측정될 수 있다.

title_en: Solar energy buried type geomagnetic radar and RFID induction all-in-one machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a solar buried geomagnetic radar and RFID induction integrated machine which comprises a base, wherein an installation barrel is arranged in the base, a heat dissipation cavity is formed between the base and the installation barrel, a cleaning cover is arranged at the top end of the heat dissipation cavity, and a filter frame is arranged at the bottom end of the cleaning cover. According to the utility model, through the matched use of the heat dissipation cavity, the cleaning cover, the filter screen, the external thread, the internal thread and the holding rod, the heat generated inside the installation cylinder is convenient to dissipate, so that when the equipment works, the heat generated inside the equipment is transmitted to the inside of the heat dissipation cavity through the heat dissipation holes and the heat dissipation fins, and then the heat is discharged through the cleaning cover at the top end of the heat dissipation cavity to dissipate the heat.
assignees: YUNNAN INTER FLYING SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Data pre-processing method and exercise vital sign detection radar
abstract_en: A data pre-processing method is provided. By using an energy distribution parameter set obtained through beamforming scanning, a signal-to-noise ratio of a signal can be improved and a detection range region can be automatically generated, thereby improving an object tracking effect. An exercise vital sign detection radar is also provided.

title_en: Breathing abnormity detection method based on frequency domain analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of respiratory signal abnormity identification, and discloses a respiratory abnormity detection method based on frequency domain analysis, which comprises the following steps: sending electromagnetic waves to the chest cavity of the human body by using the radio frequency sensor, receiving echo signals returned by the electromagnetic waves, and processing the echo signals to obtain respiratory signals of the human body; denoising the respiratory signal based on the wavelet entropy; converting the respiratory signal subjected to noise reduction processing into frequency domain representation by using a fast Fourier transform method; and constructing a breathing abnormity detection model based on a random forest algorithm, and inputting the frequency domain representation of the breathing signal into the breathing abnormity detection model to obtain a breathing abnormity detection result. The method realizes the frequency domain representation of the breathing signal based on the wavelet entropy and the fast Fourier transform, realizes the breathing abnormity detection by combining the frequency domain representation result by utilizing the random forest method, and realizes the long-time and continuous breathing detection based on the radio frequency sensor.
assignees: HUNAN WANMAI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Millimeter wave radar subassembly for vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a millimeter wave radar component for monitoring vital signs, which comprises a bottom plate, a fixed plate and a workbench, wherein a group of fixed plates are installed in the middle of the top of the bottom plate, a plurality of threaded holes are formed in the middle of one side of each fixed plate, bolts are connected with the threads in the threaded holes, a group of connecting plates penetrate through the surfaces of the bolts, the workbench is arranged at the top of each connecting plate, a group of supporting plates are installed in the middle of the top of the workbench, a rotating shaft penetrates through the through holes, a fixed lantern ring is sleeved on the surface of the rotating shaft, a connecting column is installed on the surface of the fixed lantern ring, and a camera body is arranged at the bottom end of the connecting column. Through the setting of backup pad, pivot, the fixed lantern ring, camera body, millimeter wave radar body, lead screw, arc clamp splice and transmitting antenna, through the collocation use of pivot, camera body, lead screw and arc clamp splice, be convenient for fix and adjust the position of camera body, simple structure, convenient monitoring simultaneously.
assignees: JIANGSU YUNHAO INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;NANJING SIX SEASON PHOTOELECTRIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Rotating device applied to distributed type full-polarization radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotating device applied to a distributed full-polarization radar life detection instrument in the field of radar life detection instruments. Under the action of the pressure spring, the utility model can provide an upward acting force for the ball, and further, under the matching of the ball and the clamping hole on the sliding block, the rotation self-locking operation of the rotating device is tried, and then, when the radar unit I and the radar unit II on the base are rotated forcibly, the radar unit I and the radar unit II are locked in the matching position of the clamping hole and the ball in a matching way, so that the self-fixing operation of the radar unit I and the radar unit II in each rotation adjusting position is realized, the trouble of adopting screw fixation is saved, the rotation operation is extremely convenient and fast, and the rotation operation is extremely practical.

title_en: Emergency monitoring system based on vital sign sensor
title_ko: 바이탈 사인 센서 기반의 응급상황 모니터링 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 바이탈 사인 센서 기반의 응급상황 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 실내 환경에서 사용자의 재실 여부, 활동 여부, 호흡수, 심박수, 체온 및 낙상 의심 여부를 포함하는 생체 신호를 비접촉 감지하는 레이더 측정기; 상기 레이더 측정기에 의해 수집된 생체 신호를 수신하여 상기 실내 환경 하에서 상기 사용자에 대한 응급상황의 발생을 검출하고 상기 응급상황에 관한 알림을 제공하는 모니터링 서버; 및 전용 어플리케이션을 통해 상기 레이더 측정기 및 상기 모니터링 서버 각각과 연동하는 사용자 단말;을 포함한다.  따라서, 본 발명은 가정, 사무실 등의 실내 환경에서 생체 신호를 감지하여 사용자의 위급상황 발생을 효과적으로 검출할 수 있다.

title_en: System for monitoring safety of living using sound waves and radio waves
title_ko: 음파 및 전파를 이용한 생활안전 모니터링 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 환경오류에 의한 오탐이나 해킹 등의 사생활 침해 걱정없이, 레이더 센서를 이용하여 관리 대상자의 생체신호(심장박동, 호흡, 움직임 등)를 감지하고 딥러닝 기술에 기반한 음향분석을 통해 관리 대상자를 실시간으로 정확하게 모니터링 및 이상발생 시 원격지의 관리자에게 신속히 알릴 수 있는 음파 및 전파를 이용한 생활안전 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Multi-person positioning and vital sign detecting method and system based on FMCW radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for positioning multiple persons and detecting vital signs based on an FMCW radar, comprising the following steps: amplitude and phase correction is carried out on the echo signals of each channel; weighting the corrected signals by using the guide vectors at each search angle to obtain echo signals of corresponding angles; calculating a distance dimension FFT (fast Fourier transform) for each echo signal, and suppressing the interference of a static object; processing the constant false alarm rate to obtain the distance and angle information of each human body target; solving the optimal directional diagram weight vector forming a main lobe at each expected human body target angle and forming a null in other interfering human body target angle intervals; weighting each channel signal respectively, and calculating distance dimension FFT; and extracting respiration and heartbeat signals of each human body target according to the phase information of the range gate where the target is located. The method is effective and feasible, has reliable performance, can accurately judge the distance and angle information of a plurality of human body targets positioned in different or same distance gates and extract corresponding respiration and heartbeat signals.

title_en: Millimeter wave (mmwave) mapping systems and methods for generating one or more point clouds and determining one or more vital signs for defining a human psychological state
abstract_en: Millimeter (mmWave) mapping systems and methods are disclosed for generating one or more point clouds and determining one or more vital signs for defining a human psychological state.
