A point cloud comprising point cloud data defining a person or an object detected within a physical space is generated based on one or more mmWave waveforms of an mmWave sensor. A posture of the person within the portion of the physical space is determined from the point cloud data. One or more vital signs of the person is determined based on the mmWave waveform(s). An electronic feedback is provided representing a human psychological state of the person as defined by the point cloud data and the one or more vital signs of the person.

title_en: Radar type life detection method, system and medium based on unmanned aerial vehicle carrying
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a radar type life detection method, a system and a medium based on unmanned aerial vehicle carrying; the method can comprise the following steps: receiving radar echo signals in a detection area by a biological radar carried on an unmanned aerial vehicle platform; the radar echo signals comprise a plurality of channel signals; eliminating motion interference about a platform in radar echo signals by using platform motion information sensed by a sensor carried on an unmanned aerial vehicle platform, and obtaining a first radar signal after preliminary interference suppression; after all channel signals in the first radar signal are subjected to cross-correlation processing, restraining environmental motion interference in a detection area by adopting a self-adaptive spectral line enhancement mode, and obtaining a second radar signal which is subjected to interference suppression processing; extracting the breathing detail characteristics of the human target from the second radar signal; and determining whether a human body target exists in the detection area based on a human body motion recognition strategy of the two-dimensional CA-CFAR and the breathing detail characteristics of the human body target.
assignees: CHINESE PEOPLE LIBERATION AIR FORCE AND MILITARY UNIV

title_en: Monitor for remotely and centrally monitoring vital signs of patient
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a monitor for remotely and centrally monitoring vital signs of patients, which comprises a shell, wherein a display screen is arranged outside the shell, a microwave radar is arranged inside the shell, the shell is rotatably connected with a driving screw rod, the external thread of the driving screw rod is connected with a thread block, the external of the thread block is movably connected with a first connecting rod, and the inside of the shell is fixedly connected with a fixed frame; this monitor of long-range central authorities guardianship patient vital sign passes through the drive wheel and meshes with the pinion rack when rotating, thereby make the drive wheel remove, the drive wheel removes and drives the ejector pin removal, the ejector pin removes and drives the monitor and carry out altitude mixture control, and can carry out individualized setting to every patient's vital sign baseline threshold value through the display screen on the monitor, can be higher than or be less than the automatic triggering warning when the threshold value at patient's real-time reading, the nursing staff can in time master the unusual that patient vital sign appears, take measures.
assignees: ZHEJIANG GREEN CATTLE HEALTH SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Millimeter wave vital sign detection method introducing compressed sensing theory
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of millimeter wave vital sign detection, provides a millimeter wave vital sign detection method introducing a compressive sensing theory, and can effectively realize the non-contact real-time monitoring of human respiration and heart rate by a Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (FMCW) radar system while greatly reducing the transmission frame rate of a radio frequency front end. The algorithm is used for constructing an underdetermined equation by introducing a compressed sensing theory aiming at the phase information of a human body target, and can accurately capture the position of a spectral peak by directly adopting a small amount of inner product operation under the condition of not calculating a phase signal frequency spectrum, thereby outputting vital sign data. Compared with the existing FMCW radar sign monitoring system, the method has obvious advantages in the aspects of Chirp number required to be transmitted by the radio frequency module, calculation cost of the DSP and the like, and the algorithm can be fused with fast Fourier transform, wavelet transform and various spectrum thinning technologies, and can be used in the fields of nursing monitoring, sleep analysis, family medical treatment, earthquake rescue and the like.

title_en: Early warning method and device for real-time monitoring of geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field related to real-time monitoring of geological disasters, and particularly relates to an early warning method and device for real-time monitoring of geological disasters, which comprise the following steps: install bin and post leg, when the hillside of position department takes place to ftracture or sink between post leg and the pre-buried nail, the pre-buried nail can drive hollow floating frame through spacing post and keep away from the post leg, at this moment, hollow floating frame drives the movable block through second connecting rod and pull pole and glides in the spout, when the movable block touches shift knob, start audible-visual annunciator and report to the police, remind the ground fracture condition serious, in time, the reply is made, first ratchet and second ratchet on transmission assembly are at the pivoted in-process, can drive the pointer and take the inside removal of locating frame that has the scale mark, observe constantly the pointer position through the surveillance camera, thereby can master rivers variation in size in real time, when taking place the debris flow, according to vibrations sensor response shaking force size, judge the serious degree that the hillside produced the debris flow.

title_en: Buried radar early warning sensor
abstract_en: A buried radar early warning sensor relates to the monitoring field and comprises a bidirectional probe, wherein the bidirectional probe comprises a sealed probe shell and two chips, a partition plate is connected in the probe shell and divides the probe shell into two cavities, the two chips are respectively arranged in the corresponding cavities, and each chip is connected with a stress sensor, a vibration source sensor, a sound wave conduction module and a sound wave conduction module; a magnet is connected in the probe shell; buried formula radar early warning sensor is still including moulding the type shell, sets up sealed inner cover in moulding the type shell, sets up battery and integrated circuit board in sealed inner cover, and integrated circuit board is connected to the battery, and two chips all are connected with integrated circuit board through the chip signal line, and integrated circuit board still connects the terminal signal line, and the terminal signal line stretches out sealed inner cover and moulds the type shell after connect intelligent terminal. The utility model can effectively detect artificial damage, natural damage and sudden accidents of the pipeline and can be conveniently fixed on the oil and gas pipeline.
assignees: ZHONGHONG MONITORING TECH YANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Mud-rock flow disaster monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a debris flow disaster monitoring device, which comprises: the bottom of the main body is provided with a fixed steel column which is inserted into the ground; the tension sensors are fixedly connected to the main body, and the number of the tension sensors is a plurality; the inner end of the underground pipeline is connected with the main body and is buried underground, and the outer end of the underground pipeline extends outwards; the detection column is arranged at the outer end of the underground pipeline and is vertical to the ground upwards; the pull wire is arranged in the underground pipeline, one end of the pull wire is fixedly connected with the detection column, and the other end of the pull wire penetrates through the underground pipeline and the main body to be connected to the pull sensor; and the humidity detector is arranged on one side of the main body. When landslide and debris flow occur, the surface soil can slide downwards, so that the detection column in the soil is brought to topple, the pull wire is pulled, the pull sensor receives a pull signal, and the possibility of landslide and debris flow in the place is judged.
assignees: WUHU TIANKE ENVIRONMENT TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: System for monitoring elderly people living alone and method performing the same
title_ko: 독거노인 응급 위험 상황 감지 시스템 및 이를 실행하는 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 응급 위험 상황 감지 서버, 게이트웨이, 레이더 센서 및 응급 위험 상황 모니터링 장치를 포함하는 독거노인 응급 위험 상황 감지 시스템은 게이트웨이로부터 수신된 영상 이미지를 미리 생성된 위험 상황 감지용 학습 모델에 적용한 후 상기 위험 상황 감지용 학습 모델로부터 추출된 영상 이미지에 대한 독거노인 자세에 따른 독거노인 응급 위험 예측 등급을 상기 게이트웨이를 통해 상기 응급 위험 상황 모니터링 장치에 제공하고, 상기 독거노인 응급 위험 예측 등급에 따라 관리자 단말에 독거노인 응급 위험 상황 알림 메시지를 제공하는 응급 위험 상황 감지 서버, 독거노인의 거주지에 설치되며 임펄스 신호를 생성하여 송신 안테나를 통해 방사하고, 상기 방사된 신호에 대한 반사 신호에 따라 생체 신호 값을 생성하여 상기 게이트웨이에 제공하는 레이더 센서, 상기 레이더 센서로부터 생체 신호 값을 수신하면 상기 생체 신호 값에 따라 응급 위험 상황이 발생한 순간의 영상 이미지를 생성하여 상기 응급 위험 상황 감지 서버에 제공하고, 상기 응급 위험 상황 감지 서버로부터 수신된 독거노인 응급 위험 예측 등급에 따라 독거노임 응급 위험 상황 여부를 판단하는 게이트웨이 및 상기 응급 위험 상황 감지 서버에 등록된 독거노인에 대한 모니터링 결과를 수신하여 저장하는 응급 위험 상황 모니터링 장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Novel multi-functional intelligent fire control unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel multifunctional intelligent fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle. The unmanned aerial vehicle air-drop equipment part utilizes two motors to control the switching of the storing interlayer in the medical box and the opening and closing of the electrically operated gate respectively, and realizes the air-drop function. The medical detection device utilizes the health detection thermal infrared imager capable of self-adapting to the environment to find trapped people and detect sign information of the trapped people, and effective information is timely provided for medical staff rescue. The life detection device utilizes the change of the respiratory thorax of a human body to form a Doppler effect and feeds back the Doppler effect to the detector. The gas detection sensor utilizes a catalyst to perform flameless combustion, converts a heat signal into a differential pressure signal and sends the differential pressure signal to the singlechip. The high-temperature-resistant structure of the lithium battery is composed of a C/Ph composite heat-insulating material. Unmanned aerial vehicle buffer utilizes step motor to change the inertia of rotor, and the drive pulley is rotatory, realizes that low-power unmanned aerial vehicle ground traveles. The multi-functional fire control unmanned aerial vehicle that this patent provided can provide reliable helping hand for the fire control cause.

title_en: Wall clutter suppression method based on SVD iteration entropy value
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wall clutter suppression method based on SVD iteration entropy, belonging to the technical field of microwave imaging; the method comprises the following steps of firstly, carrying out singular value decomposition on an echo received by a through-wall radar, and estimating a first singular value as a singular value set representing a wall subspace; then removing wall echo signals by a subspace projection method, calculating and storing an entropy value at the moment; adding one to the singular value set representing the wall subspace, and repeating the steps until the iteration of all the singular value intervals is finished; finding the minimum entropy value in the entropy value set, wherein the singular value set under the entropy value represents a wall subspace; and finally, filtering the wall subspace and the estimated noise subspace, and obtaining the through-wall radar image through a BP imaging algorithm. The algorithm provided by the invention has a good wall clutter suppression effect aiming at different wall thicknesses and wall relative dielectric constants, and can effectively improve the quality of images.

title_en: Method, system and computer equipment for recognizing vital signs of multiple human body targets
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a system and computer equipment for identifying vital signs of multiple human body targets, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting a region to be detected by adopting an ultra-wideband radar to obtain a radar echo matrix corresponding to the region, and filtering static clutter in the radar echo matrix; calculating the arrangement entropy value of each range gate corresponding to the slow time sequence in the radar echo matrix; determining an initial range gate region where the human body target is located according to each arrangement entropy value; determining the number of the human body targets and the positions of the human body targets according to the initial distance gate area where the human body targets are located; and according to the position of each human body target, extracting the body surface vibration signal of each human body target from the radar echo matrix for filtering the static clutter and respectively identifying each human body target. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the KMeans + + clustering algorithm and the HOC algorithm are utilized to identify the vital signs of the multi-human body target, so that the identification efficiency, accuracy and intelligent degree are improved, and further, the guarantee is provided for timely and effective rescue.

title_en: Human body vital sign detection method of millimeter wave radar in complex indoor scene
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of radars, and discloses a human body vital sign detection method of a millimeter wave radar under a complex indoor scene, which comprises the following steps: training the classifier according to the sample data; performing ADC data acquisition on the millimeter wave radar echo signal to obtain sampled data, and performing FFT processing, static clutter filtering and CFAR and DOA estimation to obtain point cloud data; performing Doppler transformation and feature extraction on point cloud data, and filtering moving points with large motion amplitude; extracting phase information from the signals of continuous N frames of the point cloud, and estimating breathing and heartbeat frequencies; extracting the characteristics of the point cloud signals of continuous N frames; inputting the extracted features into a classifier for prediction; and outputting the human target respiration heartbeat data detected in the scene. The method classifies the clutter and the scattering interference, and outputs the vital sign detection result of the human target; the method can eliminate large motion amplitude and static interference items in the scene, and ensure stable detection.
assignees: CHANGSHA MICROBRAIN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for detecting buried longitudinal structures by means of a ground-penetrating radar
abstract_en: A method for detecting buried longitudinal structures using a ground-penetrating radar, the method includes the steps of: acquiring a plurality of radar signals for a region of ground, determining, based on the radar signals, a 3D point cloud, each point corresponding to one radar detection and being geolocated in space, searching for at least one set of substantially aligned points in the 3D point cloud by: i. for each straight line among a set of straight lines of the 3D space, determining the number of points of the 3D point cloud that are located at a distance smaller than a predetermined minimum distance from the straight line, ii. determining at least one straight line for which the number of points is higher than a predetermined minimum detection threshold, the points located at a distance from this straight line smaller than said minimum distance characterizing a longitudinal structure.
assignees: COMMISSARIAT A L’ENERGIE ATOMIQUE ET AUX ENERGIES ALTERNATIVES

title_en: Vehicle-mounted life body monitoring and alarming method, system, storage medium and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle-mounted vital body monitoring and alarming method, a system, a storage medium and equipment, wherein the vehicle-mounted vital body monitoring and alarming method comprises the steps of obtaining a vehicle power-off instruction, detecting according to an echo signal received by a millimeter wave radar when a vehicle is detected to be in a closed state, collecting detection results for multiple times at preset intervals, continuously collecting the detection results in a first time period when the ratio of the detection results with vital sign signals in the preset interval reaches a first preset ratio, wherein the first time period comprises a plurality of preset intervals, and judging whether the ratio of the detection results with vital sign signals reaches the first preset ratio or not in the first time period; if yes, determining that the life exists in the vehicle, and triggering an alarm mode. According to the vehicle-mounted life monitoring and alarming method, system, storage medium and device, the accuracy of life detection in a vehicle is improved by periodically detecting and judging the echo signals received by the millimeter wave radar in a first time period.

title_en: Air cleaning headphone system with rotating guide capable of collecting fine dust information
title_ko: 미세먼지정보 수집이 가능하며 회전식 가이드를 가진 공기청정 헤드폰 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an air cleaning headphone system with a rotary guide capable of collecting fine dust information, comprising: a headphone main body including two earplugs emitting sound and cleaned air, a headband connecting the two earplugs and having an adjustable length, and a rotary guide rotatably engaged with each earplug to be fixed at a specific position; a fine dust measuring sensor mounted on the headphone main body and measuring the fine dust concentration around a user and transmitting the information of the fine dust concentration to a mobile device of the user; a bio signal measuring sensor mounted on the headphone main body and measuring bio signals of the user and transmitting the information of the measured bio signals to the mobile device of the user; and a central server wirelessly communicating with the mobile device of the user and receiving the information of the fine dust concentration and the information of the bio signals. The present invention aims to provide an air cleaning headphone system with a rotary guide capable of collecting fine dust information, which is capable of allowing a user to breathe clean air anywhere.

title_en: Air cleaning headphone system with sliding guide capable of collecting fine dust information
title_ko: 미세먼지정보 수집이 가능하며 슬라이딩식 가이드를 가진 공기청정 헤드폰 시스템
abstract_en: An air purifying headphone system of the present invention comprises: a headphone body which includes two earplugs discharging sound and purified air, a headband connecting the earplugs and having an adjustable length, and a sliding guide for collecting the purified air discharged from the earplugs around a mouth and a nose; a fine dust measuring sensor mounted on the headphone body to measure a fine dust concentration around a user and transmitting the measured fine dust concentration information to a mobile device of the user; a bio-signal measuring sensor mounted on the headphone body to measure a bio-signal of the user and transmitting the measured bio-signal information to the mobile device of the user; and a central server for communicating with the mobile device of the user and receiving the fine dust concentration information and the bio-signal information.

title_en: A Structure of Insulator for Preventing Thermal Bridge
title_ko: 상하부 인장근이 구성된 내단열용 열교차단재
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a thermal bridge breaker for internal insulation installed at a joint between an external wall and a slab. More specifically, the thermal bridge breaker according to the present invention includes tensile reinforcements which are provided at upper and lower portions of an insulating element to penetrate through the insulating element to resist both ± moments and ± shear forces, thereby securing seismic performance by bearing compression and tension simultaneously even when tension and compression forces act alternately on a tensile-shear element during an earthquake, and increasing shear force by forming a shear element which connects the upper and lower reinforcements inside the insulating element. The thermal bridge breaker includes: an insulating element made of insulation material in a rectangular shape with a predetermined size; a plurality of tensile reinforcements which penetrate upper and lower portions of the insulating element in a width direction, of which both end portions protrude outwardly from each insulating element to a predetermined length, and which are installed at regular or irregular intervals in the insulating element; a horizontally buried reinforcement which is configured at one end of the tensile reinforcement in a horizontal direction and buried in a slab; a settling buried reinforcement which is configured to connect the upper and lower tensile reinforcements to the other end of the tensile reinforcement and are buried in a wall; a shear element which is manufactured integrally with the tensile reinforcement by connecting the pair of tensile reinforcements located at the upper and lower portions and is embedded in the insulating element; and fireproof plates which are formed on upper and lower surface of the insulating element with a predetermined thickness, and are made of a high temperature resistant material or ultra-high performance concrete (UHPC).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 외벽체와 슬래브의 이음부에 설치되는 내단열용 열교차단재에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 단열요소의 상부와 하부에 각각 단열요소를 관통하는 인장근을 구성하여 ±모멘트와 ±전단력에 모두 저항할 수 있어 지진 발생 시 인장력과 압축력이 번갈아서 인장-전단요소에 작용하는 때도 압축과 인장을 동시에 견딜 수 있는 구조로써 내진 성능을 확보할 수 있으며, 단열요소의 내부에 상하근을 연결하는 전단요소를 구성하도록 함으로써 전단력을 높이도록 하는 상하부 인장근이 구성된 내단열용 열교차단재에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 바람직한 일 실시예는 외벽체와 슬래브의 이음부에 설치되는 내단열용 열교차단재에 있어서, 일정 크기 직육면체 형상으로 단열소재로 이루어지는 단열요소와; 단열요소의 상부와 하부를 각각 폭방향으로 관통하여 양단부가 각각 단열요소의 외측으로 일정길이 돌출하도록 한 쌍으로 형성되며 단열요소에 등간격 또는 부등간격으로 복수개가 설치되는 인장근과; 인장근의 일단부에 수평방향으로 구성되며 슬래브에 매립되는 수평매립근과; 인장근의 타단부에 상하부 인장근을 연결하도록 구성되며 벽체에 매립되는 정착매립근; 상부와 하부에 위치한 한 쌍의 인장근을 연결하여 인장근과 일체로 제작되며 단열요소에 내재되는 전단요소와; 단열요소의 상부면 및 하부면에 각각 일정 두께로 구성되며 내화재질 또는 초고성능콘크리트(UHPC, ultra high performance concrete)로 이루어지는 내화판;을 포함하여 이루어진다.

title_en: fire fighting building indoor fire hydrant
title_ko: 소방용 건축물 옥내 소화전
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting building indoor fire hydrant, which can easily extinguish a fire, comprising: a hose holder; a fire alarm; a hose sensor; a nozzle sensor; an alarm sensor; a firefighting water sensor; a sight glass; a pocket unit; an LED module; and a status checking controller.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건축물에 설치되어 화재를 진압하기 위한 소방용 건축물 옥내 소화전에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 소방용 건축물 옥내 소화전은 벽체에 매립되는 소화전 함체, 상기 함체를 개폐하는 함체도어, 및 상기 함체의 내부에 설치되어 방화수를 공급하는 방화수전, 상기 함체의 내부에 수용되며 상기 방화수전과 연결되는 소방호스, 상기 소방호스의 끝단에 설치되어 방화수를 분사하는 관창노즐을 포함하는 소방용 건축물 옥내 소화전에 있어서, 상기 함체의 내부에 설치되어 상기 소방호스를 거치하는 호스거치대, 상기 함체의 내부에 설치되어 상기 관창노즐을 거치하는 노즐거치대, 상기 함체에 설치되어 화재의 발생을 외부로 알리는 화재경보기, 상기 호스거치대에 설치되어 상기 소방호스의 거치여부를 감지하는 호스감지센서, 상기 노즐거치대에 설치되어 상기 관창노즐의 거치여부를 감지하는 노즐감지센서, 상기 화재경보기의 작동여부를 감지하는 경보기감지센서, 상기 방화수전에 방화수의 공급여부를 감지하는 방화수감지센서, 상기 함체도어에 형성되어 상기 함체의 내부를 투과하여 보는 투시창, 상기 함체도어의 내측에 상기 투시창의 둘레를 감싸 상부가 개방된 수용포켓을 형성하는 포켓부, 상기 포켓부의 내부에 복수 개가 삽입되어 상기 투시창을 통해 보여지며, 내부가 투과되는 투명한 소화액이 충전되고 투척 시 용이하게 깨지면서 충전된 소화액을 분출하여 화재를 진압하는 투척식 소화기, 상기 투척식 소화기를 통해 빛이 확산되어 상기 투시창을 통해 보이도록 상기 각 투척식 소화기와 대응되는 위치마다 빛을 조사하는 LED가 설치되는 LED모듈, 및 상기 함체의 내부 상태를 상기 함체의 외부에서 상기 투척식 소화기를 통해 확산되는 빛을 통해 파악하도록 상기 호스감지센서, 상기 노즐감지센서, 상기 경보기감지센서, 및 상기 방화수감지센서에서 감지되는 신호에 따라 서로 다른 위치의 LED을 점등하는 상태확인컨트롤러를 포함한다.
assignees: JI SUNG CONSULTING ENG CO LTD

title_en: Life detection method and system based on radar signals
abstract_en: The life detection method and system based on the radar signals comprise the steps of detecting an area to be detected by an ultra-wideband radar to obtain a radar echo matrix, filtering static clutter in the radar echo matrix, extracting body surface vibration signals of human targets in the area to be detected according to the radar echo matrix after filtering clutter, carrying out modal decomposition on the body surface vibration signals by a modal decomposition method, determining main frequencies of all eigen mode functions by a wavelet analysis method, screening eigen mode functions of the main frequencies in a preset breathing and heartbeat frequency band range, reconstructing breathing and heartbeat signals based on the screened eigen mode functions, and determining vital sign information of the detected human targets based on a stochastic resonance system and the reconstructed breathing and heartbeat signals. The technical scheme provided by the application has strong anti-interference capability, and can accurately and rapidly detect the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency of the target to be detected.

title_en: Handheld through-wall radar with support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a handheld through-wall radar with a bracket, relating to the technical field of through-wall radars, comprising a shell; two roller grooves which are vertically arranged are formed above the left side and the right side of the back surface of the shell and below the middle part of the back surface of the shell, rollers are connected in the roller grooves in a rolling manner, and a silencing pad is wrapped on the surface of each roller; a transverse groove is formed in the rear side of the bottom of the shell, two ends of the transverse groove are communicated with a containing opening which is formed in the left side and the right side below the rear surface of the shell, a supporting shaft is movably connected in the containing opening, an extending shaft penetrating through the bottom of the supporting shaft is movably embedded in the supporting shaft, and five clamping holes which are vertically and equidistantly distributed are formed in the rear surface of the supporting shaft; the utility model discloses beneficial effect does: when convenient handheld, can give the holding power through the back shaft, physical demands when reducing handheld to the pulley of bottom shaft bottom can also play the effect of supplementary removal through-wall radar, can reduce the noise of gyro wheel when the wall removes through the silence pad simultaneously.

title_en: Method for quickly evaluating wall bushing of converter station after earthquake
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for quickly evaluating a wall bushing of a converter station after an earthquake, which comprises the following steps: s1, before earthquake, establishing a valve hall-through wall sleeve system earthquake response equivalent substitution model through a finite element model and a mathematical approximation relation; in an S2 earthquake, three-direction earthquake acceleration, speed and displacement data of a site where the wall bushing is located are monitored; after the earthquake of S3, the data monitored in S2 are input into the equivalent substitution model of the valve hall-wall bushing system earthquake response of S1, so that the stress peak values of the inner and outer wall bushing roots are estimated. The method has higher objectivity; the data monitoring mode is simple, the sensors arranged on the wall bushing do not need to be responded and collected, and only the seismic data of the area where the wall bushing is located are monitored; the post-earthquake emergency rescue method is simple and quick in post-earthquake work, can provide the root stress condition of the inner casing and the outer casing in a short time by simply processing earthquake motion parameters and guiding in the equivalent substitution model, guides the post-earthquake emergency rescue work, and has good engineering application prospect.

title_en: Method for detecting buried longitudinal structures by means of a ground-penetrating radar
abstract_en: A method for detecting buried longitudinal structures using a ground-penetrating radar, the method includes the steps of: acquiring a plurality of radar signals for a region of ground, determining, based on the radar signals, a 3D point cloud, each point corresponding to one radar detection and being geolocated in space, selecting, from the 3D point cloud, at least one set of points comprising a number of points higher than or equal to a minimum detection threshold allowing a longitudinal structure to be characterized, the points of the set being substantially aligned with one another.
assignees: COMMISSARIAT A L’ENERGIE ATOMIQUE ET AUX ENERGIES ALTERNATIVES

title_en: Wireless tag, apparatus and method for measuring biological signal using the tag
title_ko: 무선 태그와 이를 이용한 생체신호 측정 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an apparatus for measuring a biological signal of an occupant received from a wireless tag that can be mounted to a seat belt in a vehicle includes: a radar unit transmitting a pre-set radar signal to the wireless tag and receiving a radar reflection signal as a reflection signal for the radar signal converted from a frequency signal of an electromagnetic wave into a harmonic wave signal according to a biological change of the occupant; and a signal processing unit for detecting a heartbeat signal and breathing signal of the occupant through analysis on a frequency area for the radar reflection signal received from the radar unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 차량 내 좌석벨트에 장착 가능한 무선 태그로부터 수신되는 탑승자의 생체신호를 측정하기 위한 생체신호 측정 장치에 있어서, 기설정된 레이더 신호를 상기 무선 태그로 송신하고, 상기 레이더 신호에 대한 반사 신호로서 탑승자의 생체변화에 따른 전파의 주파수 신호가 고조파 신호로 변조된 레이더 반사 신호를 상기 무선 태그로부터 수신하는 레이더부 및 상기 레이더부로부터 수신된 상기 레이더 반사 신호에 대하여 주파수 영역 분석을 통해 탑승자의 심박 신호 및 호흡 신호를 검출하기 위한 신호 처리부를 포함한다.

title_en: Multifunctional air cleaning headphone system capable of collecting fine dust information
title_ko: 미세먼지정보 수집이 가능한 다기능 공기정청 헤드폰 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multifunctional air cleaning headphone system capable of collecting fine dust information, comprising: a headphone main body including two earplugs emitting sound and cleaned air, a mask connected to the part between the two earplugs, a headband rotatably engaged with the two earplugs, and an eye cover rotatably engaged with the part between the two earplugs and the headband; a fine dust measuring sensor mounted on the headphone main body and measuring the fine dust concentration around a user and transmitting the information of the fine dust concentration to a mobile device of the user; a bio signal measuring sensor mounted on the headphone main body and measuring bio signals of the user and transmitting the information of the measured bio signals to the mobile device of the user; and a central server wirelessly communicating with the mobile device of the user and receiving the information of the fine dust concentration and the information of the bio signals. The present invention aims to provide a multifunctional air cleaning headphone system which is capable of allowing a user to breathe clean air anywhere.

title_en: Multifunctional continuous power supply life detection platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional continuous power supply life detection platform which comprises a parking shelter, wherein a power supply system and an emergency communication system are arranged in the parking shelter, the power supply system consists of an energy storage module and a power generation module, the emergency communication system consists of a satellite communication system, a mobile G communication system short wave and ultrashort wave radio station, a power generator is connected to the power supply system, and the power generator is installed in the parking shelter. The capacity of the radar life detection instrument for continuous work is greatly improved, the box body can still depend on the power supply of the generator after leaving the chassis, and the emergency communication system can well communicate with field personnel or command personnel at all levels in time and effectively when an emergency occurs.
assignees: XINXING HEAVY IND GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Breath detection sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a respiration detection sensor. Relates to the medical field. The sensor comprises a sensor shell, an elastic component, a first coil, a second coil and a conversion module, wherein the first coil, the second coil and the conversion module are arranged in the sensor shell; one side of the sensor shell is provided with an opening, and the elastic component is arranged at the opening of the sensor shell; the second coil is arranged on the elastic component, and one side of the second coil, which is far away from the elastic component, is arranged in the first coil; the second coil moves in the first coil along with the deformation of the elastic component. The processing module determines the respiratory state of the patient according to the first direct current signal converted by the conversion module, directly senses according to the abdominal state of the patient, reduces or even eliminates the influence of limb movement of the patient, improves the anti-interference capability, is not influenced by the environment of a ward where the patient is located, improves the reliability, can continuously monitor the respiratory state of the patient for many times, and reduces the treatment cost of the patient.
assignees: HENAN XIANGYU MEDICAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Multi-person vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-person vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar, which comprises the steps of utilizing the millimeter wave radar to emit frequency modulation continuous wave signals to a human body, extracting intermediate frequency signals, estimating the azimuth angle of the human body relative to the radar, adopting digital wave beam formation, generating a distance-azimuth thermal map, estimating the elevation angle of the human body relative to the radar, extracting a distance-azimuth thermal map corresponding to the obtained elevation angle, determining detection points of different human bodies, extracting the intermediate frequency signals of different human bodies according to the distance-azimuth-elevation angle, and estimating heart rate and respiratory rate. The invention realizes non-contact multi-person vital sign monitoring, can effectively separate echo signals of different human bodies in a radar monitoring scene through the joint estimation of distance, azimuth and elevation, removes interference signals in the monitoring scene, and utilizes various algorithms to jointly estimate heart rate and respiratory rate, thereby improving the monitoring precision and ensuring good monitoring effect.

title_en: Metal ore body detector
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a metal ore body detection instrument, wherein this instrument includes: the device comprises a sensor, an electromagnetic signal processing circuit, a laser sensor and an upper computer. The utility model discloses an whether near utilizing laser data preliminary judgement geologic body contains the metal, then use the sensor to come the perception to detect the natural electromagnetic wave signal of geologic body reflection, and obtain the frequency-selecting signal after enlargiing and screening processing natural electromagnetic wave signal, thereby can carry out the analysis to the characteristic of geologic body and reachs the kind of this near geologic body metal ore body, the buried depth, thickness and the appearance of producing, the efficiency of surveying of metal ore body has been improved greatly, and do not receive conventional electrical equipment basically, the influence that steamship iron material or sea were strikeed, it is big to have the detection degree of depth, the advantage that the detection precision is high.

title_en: Shaft rescue communication probe
abstract_en: A shaft rescue communication probe is used for underground rescue. The rescue communication probe is connected with the aboveground computer through an optical fiber; an external power supply supplies power to the photoelectric transceiver and the main control circuit board through a lithium battery; the optical fiber is connected to the photoelectric transceiver, the photoelectric transceiver is connected with the main control circuit board through a network cable, the photoelectric transceiver converts optical signals received from an aboveground computer into electric signals, the signals are input to the main control circuit board through the network cable, the electric signals sent from the main control circuit board are converted into optical signals, and the optical signals are sent back to the computer; the main control circuit board is connected with the sound equipment, the microphone, the camera and the infrared thermal imaging sensor through a USB serial bus, and is connected with the environmental sensor module through an I2C serial bus. The invention supports long-distance communication, has multiple functions of life detection, video, two-way talkback, environment sensing and the like, can judge the position of the trapped person, know the field condition of the trapped person, acquire underground environment information and quickly and accurately make and execute a rescue plan.
assignees: SHENZHEN SHANNENG INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD

title_en: ESS data protection system in case in fire
title_ko: 화재 발생 시 배터리 데이터 보호 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a battery data protection system. More specifically, the present invention relates to a battery data protection system, comprising: an ESS container (100) including a fire detection sensor unit (110), a control unit (120), a data central processing unit (130), a data storage unit (150), and a separation unit (140) therein; a storage unit (300) located outside the container; and an opening/closing unit (200) located between the container and the storage unit, wherein a fire occurrence signal is received from the fire detection sensor unit (110), the opening/closing unit (200) is opened by the control unit (120), and the data storage unit (150) is moved to the storage unit (300) and buried. According to the present invention, the data storage unit can be safely protected.
abstract_ko: 본원발명은 배터리 데이터 보호 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 내부에 화재 감지 센서부(110), 제어부(120), 데이터 중앙처리부(130), 데이터 저장부(150) 및 분리부(140)를 포함하는 상기 ESS 컨테이너(100), 상기 컨테이너 외부에 위치하는 보관부(300), 및 상기 컨테이너와 상기 보관부 사이에 위치하는 개폐부(200)를 포함하고, 상기 화재 감지 센서부(110)로부터 화재발생신호를 전송받고, 상기 제어부(120)에 의해 상기 개폐부가(200)가 열리며, 상기 데이터 저장부(150)가 보관부(300)로 이동되어 매설되는 것을 특징으로 하는 배터리 데이터 보호 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Metal detector and method therefor
title_ko: 금속탐지기 및 탐지방법
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a metal detector and a metal detection method capable of detecting a metal object, which can determine whether a metal object is buried by detecting a part where the temperature rise is different from the surrounding soil. According to the present invention, the metal detector may comprise: an emitting means for emitting microwaves to a sensing area; a sensing means for sensing a temperature change in the sensing area; and a conversion means for converting the temperature value detected by the sensing means into an electrical signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 금속탐지기는, 감지 영역에 마이크로웨이브를 방출하는 방출수단; 상기 감지 영역의 온도변화를 감지하는 감지수단; 및 상기 감지수단에서 검출된 온도값을 전기적 신호로 변환하는 변환수단을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Dynamic detection method for vital signs of millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a vital sign dynamic detection method based on a minimum mean square error criterion. The method comprises the steps of firstly, preprocessing human body information detected by a radar through intermediate frequency signals to reduce background noise and radar emission leakage interference; then carrying out speed prior detection on the target, determining that the human body belongs to a resting state or a moving state, and verifying and compensating the distance unit occupied by the human body through the obtained speed value after obtaining the moving state; after an accurate distance unit is obtained, positioning the random motion of the human body through continuous wavelet transformation and restraining through attenuation of a moving average filter to obtain an original thoracic cavity waveform; and finally, extracting the human respiration and heartbeat signals by adopting an optimization filter based on a mean square error criterion. The invention can accurately measure the vital signs of the human body in a resting state or a moving state in single detection, and can ensure that the human body freely moves in a non-contact state and simultaneously the radar can accurately acquire the vital sign information.

title_en: Electronic device including sensor module
title_ko: 센서 모듈을 포함하는 전자 장치
abstract_en: According to various embodiments of the present disclosure, an electronic device may include: a housing; a battery disposed in the housing; and a sensor module of which at least a part is disposed inside the housing. The sensor module may include: a substrate; a biometric recognition sensor disposed on the substrate; a sealing member covering at least a part of the substrate and the biometric recognition sensor; and a biometric signal detection electrode which covers at least a part of the sealing member, which is electrically connected with the substrate, and of which at least a part is exposed outwards. In addition, various embodiments may be possible.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 다양한 실시예들에 따르는 전자 장치는, 하우징, 상기 하우징 내에 배치된 배터리 및 적어도 일부가 상기 하우징 내에 배치된 센서 모듈을 포함하고, 상기 센서 모듈은, 기판, 상기 기판 상에 배치된 생체 인식 센서, 상기 기판 및 상기 생체 인식 센서의 적어도 일부를 둘러싸는 밀봉 부재, 및 상기 밀봉 부재의 적어도 일부를 둘러싸고, 상기 기판과 전기적으로 연결된 생체 신호 감지 전극으로서, 적어도 일부가 상기 하우징의 외부로 노출된 생체 신호 감지 전극을 포함할 수 있다. 그 외에도 다양한 실시예들이 가능할 수 있다.

title_en: Vital sign state identification method and system based on Transformer network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying vital sign states based on a Transformer network, relates to a vital body detection technology, and provides a scheme aiming at the problem of ignoring the front-back relation of time sequence data in the prior art. The attention layer performs the following processing on any data block: respectively mapping the data block into a query vector, an index vector and an information vector by using three different randomly initialized matrixes; and then calculating the fractional value of the attention relationship between the current data block and other data blocks, and introducing asymmetric chi-square distribution as an additive bias of the attention layer during calculation. The method has the advantages that the method adopts a Transformer network to carry out feature extraction and state recognition on the vital sign signals collected by the continuous wave Doppler radar, supplements the relative position information of the continuous wave Doppler radar sequence captured by the position code by adding chi-square bias in the attention layer, and has better detection real-time performance and accuracy.

title_en: Life detection device, rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and use method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a life detection device, a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and a use method thereof, aiming at the problems that the existing unmanned aerial vehicle has complicated operation when being provided with a life detection radar, the detection range of the life detection radar is small, and the life detection radar is exposed outside and is easily damaged by complex terrains when descending, the invention provides the following scheme, which comprises a detection shell, wherein the bottom of the detection shell is provided with an opening, both sides of the detection shell are provided with first threaded holes, the inner wall of one side of the detection shell is rotatably connected with a second rotating shaft, one end of the second rotating shaft is fixedly sleeved with a first semi-gear, in the invention, a swinging component can be used for driving the life detection radar to swing, so that the life detection radar can search in a large range, the search efficiency is improved, the installation is simple, and the height can be adjusted, when descending, the life detection radar is retracted to the inside of the detection shell, the safety of the life detection radar can be guaranteed, and the service life of the device is prolonged.
assignees: HUNAN HAOTIANYI AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Underground pipeline detection robot
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an underground pipeline detection robot, include the frame and be used for surveying the detection radar of burying buried pipeline, on the detection radar located the frame through fixed establishment, still be equipped with electric drive mechanism and encoder on the frame, electric drive mechanism passes through transmission shaft output power to frame, and the encoder is connected with the transmission shaft to fix a position according to the rotation of transmission shaft. The underground pipeline detection robot can realize the forward and backward movement of the underground pipeline detection robot through the electric driving mechanism, and compared with the existing mode of manually pushing the pipeline detection trolley, the underground pipeline detection robot has the advantages that the working strength of workers is reduced; through setting up the encoder, can carry out digital location, the record of being convenient for to buried pipeline's position.

title_en: Non-contact sleep vital sign detection method based on sector distributed radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact sleep vital sign detection method based on a sector distributed radar. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining a baseband signal output by a distributed radar, and identifying and eliminating a turning body movement signal; carrying out unbalance calibration and demodulation on baseband signals output by the distributed radar to obtain N paths of demodulation signals; separating the respiratory signal from the heartbeat signal of the N paths of demodulation signals, detecting and obtaining N respiratory rates and N heart rates; and respectively carrying out weighted fusion on the detection results of the respiration rate and the heart rate to obtain a fused respiration rate and a fused heart rate. The invention can detect the respiratory rate and the heart rate under different sleeping postures in a mode of combining a plurality of radars, and improve the accuracy of detecting the respiratory rate and the heart rate in the sleeping process. The invention provides a non-contact detection means for sleep health detection.

title_en: User monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar and computer equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a user monitoring method and computer equipment based on millimeter wave radar, wherein, computer equipment includes: a millimeter wave radar module configured to detect vital sign signals of a user, wherein the vital sign signals include a heart rate and/or a respiration rate; circuitry connected with the millimeter wave radar module and configured to: determining whether the user is abnormal or not according to the vital sign signals; and prompting the user when the user has an abnormality. Adopt this openly, can realize non-contact monitoring through millimeter wave radar module to automatically, carry out whole monitoring in the user use, need not the user and wear relevant equipment, avoided forgetting to wear and lead to unable monitoring. Under the condition that the user is determined to have abnormity according to the vital sign signals, the user is prompted, so that the user can know that the vital signs of the user are abnormal, and the user can have a rest in time.
assignees: SHENZHEN KONKA ELECT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on IR-UWB radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vital sign detection method based on an IR-UWB radar, and belongs to the field of physiological information. The method comprises the following steps: deploying IR-UWB radar indoors to acquire human body characteristic data of a detected person in different activity states; preprocessing data based on an MTI algorithm; disclosed is a vital sign detection method with maximized spectrum sparsity. Aiming at the defects that the existing respiratory heartbeat signal monitoring mostly adopts contact equipment and the detection accuracy rate is low under the non-contact condition, the invention provides a method for acquiring human body characteristic data by utilizing an IR-UWB radar, preprocessing the data by an MTI algorithm and then extracting the respiratory heartbeat signal in the human body characteristic data from the preprocessed IR-UWB radar signal by utilizing a vital sign detection method with the spectrum sparse maximization.

title_en: Fall detection method and system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fall detection, and particularly discloses a fall detection method based on a millimeter wave radar, which comprises the following steps: acquiring intermediate frequency ADC data through a millimeter wave radar; performing signal preprocessing operation on the intermediate frequency ADC data to obtain moving target point cloud data; identifying the current posture of a target human body according to the moving target point cloud data; and judging the falling state of the target human body according to the current posture recognition result of the target human body. The invention also discloses a fall detection system based on the millimeter wave radar. The method for detecting the falling of the millimeter wave radar based on the invention can select the millimeter wave radar with better environmental adaptability, does not relate to the privacy problem, not only judges the falling state through the information of the radar, but also adds means such as behavior logic judgment, vital sign detection and the like, and improves the falling accuracy of the millimeter wave radar.
assignees: WEIFU HIGH TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign signal monitoring method and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses a vital sign signal monitoring method and a related device, and belongs to the field of intelligent driving. The method comprises the steps of carrying out phase expansion on phases corresponding to each sample frequency point in a plurality of sample frequency points to obtain a plurality of target phases, subtracting every two adjacent target phases in the plurality of target phases according to time sequence corresponding to the plurality of sample frequency points to obtain a plurality of phase differences, determining radar vital signals based on the plurality of phase differences, and determining vital sign signals based on the radar vital signals. Because of heart fluctuations corresponding to adjacent times in the heartbeat waveform, or chest fluctuations corresponding to adjacent times in the respiration waveform, are both correlated with the phase difference between the two phases corresponding to adjacent times. Therefore, the radar vital signals determined based on the plurality of phase differences are accurate, so that vital sign signals can be accurately determined based on the radar vital signals, and the safety of vehicle driving is ensured.

title_en: Target imaging method and system based on multipath echo suppression
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of through-wall radar target imaging, in particular to a target imaging method and system based on multipath echo suppression, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an original echo of a through-wall radar; determining pixel point amplitude and multipath echo peak values in a target amplitude image according to original echoes and multipath propagation coefficients by using a delay and sum wave beam forming algorithm, carrying out echo cancellation according to the pixel point amplitude and the multipath echo peak values to obtain a plurality of wall body cancellation echoes, fusing the plurality of wall body cancellation echoes to determine a fused image, imaging the original echoes by using a BP algorithm to obtain echo images, sequentially carrying out region division and sequencing on the echo images to obtain a pixel point set, carrying out overlapping target screening according to the pixel point set, an amplitude threshold value and a region limiting proportion to obtain an overlapping target image, and carrying out superposition according to the fused image and the overlapping target image to determine the target image. The invention improves the accuracy of target imaging by eliminating part of echo.

title_en: Non-contact heartbeat and respiration detection equipment based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to a non-contact heartbeat and respiration detection device based on a millimeter wave radar, which comprises: helmet shells and helmet liners. The invention has the beneficial effects that: if the contact switch in the monitoring device is started for multiple times, the central processing unit starts the electronic gas generator to inflate the airbag, so that the impact force generated when the head of the riding person collides with the ground is reduced; when the riding personnel are collided and in a dangerous condition, the heart rate and the respiration intensity of the riding personnel can be judged by the millimeter wave radar, the starting times of the contact switch are obtained, the heart rate, the respiration intensity and the turning rough times of the riding personnel can be quickly transmitted and submitted to an emergency center, and meanwhile, the geographic position information is provided; the portable on-site first-aid equipment can be conveniently selected by the first-aid center according to the situation, the first-aid center can quickly arrive at the place where the accident happens and can be used for carrying out first-aid, and the survival rate of riding personnel when the riding personnel collide is improved; higher numbers of contact switch actuations indicate a greater risk to heart rate and respiration intensity.

title_en: System and method for mitigation of random body movement and interference effects in radar-based vital signs monitoring systems in medical applications
abstract_en: A radar system for vital signs monitoring such as at least heart rate or breathing and a method for mitigating random body movement and external interference effects in vital signs monitoring such as at least heart rate or breathing by employing a radar system that is configured for providing in-phase and quadrature signals from reflected and received radar waves are provided. The problem of random body movement effects and external interference affecting vital signs monitoring is at least mitigated by decomposing and filtering a reconstructed displacement signal using a time and frequency analysis technique such as Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT), followed by a Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF) operation. This decomposition allows the identification of time and frequency basis components containing the random body movement interference. Hence, the filtered signal can be reconstructed after removing the random body movement components, thus enabling reliable and robust vital-signs parameter estimation.

title_en: Indoor object echo extraction method and system based on acoustic-electromagnetic intermodulation
abstract_en: The invention provides an indoor object echo extraction method and system based on acoustic-electromagnetic intermodulation, which comprises the steps of transmitting acoustic wave excitation from an electromagnetic wave transmitting and receiving end so as to trigger an object to vibrate and generate a corresponding acoustic wave signal; selecting an electromagnetic signal capable of modulating the sound wave signal according to a required frequency band, transmitting the electromagnetic signal, and performing sound-electromagnetic mutual modulation on the sound wave signal by using the electromagnetic signal to obtain sound-electromagnetic echo of an object; the electromagnetic wave receiving and transmitting end receives the acoustic electromagnetic echo, and the Fourier transform is carried out on the acoustic electromagnetic echo to obtain a corresponding frequency spectrum; and filtering the frequency spectrum according to the phase shift and amplitude modulation generated by the acoustic electromagnetic echo, thereby filtering the signal of the frequency band where the acoustic wave is excited and the symmetrical sideband signal, and further obtaining the characteristic frequency spectrum containing the characteristics of the object. Compared with the traditional mode of modulating weak vibration signals based on electromagnetic waves, the method increases the information amount carried by sound wave excitation and improves the stability of through-wall detection.

title_en: Vital sign extraction method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of millimeter wave radars, and particularly discloses a vital sign extraction method based on a millimeter wave radar, wherein the vital sign extraction method comprises the following steps: acquiring an echo signal of a millimeter wave radar for a target human body, and extracting distance information in the echo signal; selecting an index corresponding to the strongest power point for phase analysis to obtain an analysis phase according to the distance information in the echo signal; judging whether the target human body is in a motion state or not and judging whether the respiratory signal of the target human body is weak or not according to the analytic phase; when the target human body is in a non-motion state and the respiratory signal of the target human body is weak, the vital sign value of the target human body is determined after the alternative distance gate is expanded; and when the target human body is in a non-motion state and the respiratory signal of the target human body is not weak, calculating the vital sign value of the target human body. The method for extracting the vital sign based on the millimeter wave radar can improve the accuracy of extracting the vital sign signal.
assignees: WEIFU HIGH TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Large robot burying rescue method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-scale robot burying rescue method and a system, which relate to the technical field of robots and comprise the following steps: the rescue robot dynamically scans a scene and constructs a three-dimensional model to obtain point cloud data; acquiring a target image to perform target detection; acquiring vital sign data of trapped people through a living body detection radar; evaluating the health state of the trapped person based on vital sign data of the trapped person; making a rescue decision, planning a local path of the rescue robot by using an artificial potential field method, and simultaneously sending a control instruction according to the rescue decision to enable the rescue robot to carry out rescue operation; the invention can integrate the functions of detecting life signs, positioning the positions of a plurality of trapped persons, researching rescue strategies, automatically planning paths, realizing automatic obstacle avoidance and assisting rescue workers to rescue, thereby making rescue path decisions according to the life strengths and the positions of the trapped persons.
assignees: SICHUAN TIANQI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG

title_en: Biopotential electrode body and biopotential sensor
abstract_en: Provided is a biopotential electrode body having high mechanical strength and suitable for acquiring more bioinformation. The biopotential electrode body includes multiple electrically conductive portions each having a contact surface contactable with a biological body, and one or more electrically insulating portions that electrically insulate the multiple electrically conductive portions from each other. The electrically conductive portions each include a first elastic resin and a plurality of first particles buried in the first elastic resin. The electrically insulating portions each include a second elastic resin and a plurality of second particles buried in the second elastic resin.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitoring facilities based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The utility model provides a non-contact vital sign monitoring facilities based on millimeter wave radar, including millimeter wave radar chip, ADC data collection card, RAM random access memory, SD card, DSP chip, MCU, LCD display screen and Zigbee module. The utility model has the advantages that: the data line does not need to be laid, the upper computer does not need to be used, the processing speed is high, and the cost for detecting the vital signs is greatly reduced. The scheme is a circuit structure integrating acquisition, processing and display, realizes high integration of equipment, and is convenient and quick to use; meanwhile, the problem that the data volume is too large and cannot be processed timely can be solved, the privacy leakage problem of the posture monitored by the camera is solved, and the problem that the breathing and the heartbeat are inconvenient to monitor by the wearable device is solved. The result of vital sign monitoring is directly displayed in the integrated circuit instead of the upper computer, so that the monitoring result can be viewed in real time and space.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: A vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar uses a wavelet threshold denoising method based on an adaptive threshold function to denoise collected signals, so that pure vital sign signals can be obtained, and the method can adapt to different signals by adjusting the size of a control factor, so as to achieve a better denoising effect; when the vital sign frequency is estimated, a method of combining a Hamming window function and an MUSIC algorithm is used, the Hamming window function is used for processing sliding window data, a space spectrum is constructed by the MUSIC algorithm, and spectrum peak searching is carried out to obtain the frequency of heartbeat and respiration. The method has better stability, noise immunity and resolution, can eliminate the influence of clutter in a measuring environment on a result, can reduce the influence of respiratory harmonics on heart rate estimation, and further improves the accuracy of respiratory and heartbeat signal frequency estimation results.

title_en: Heart beat and respiratory frequency joint estimation method based on MIMO radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heartbeat respiratory frequency joint estimation method based on an MIMO radar, belongs to the technical field of radars, and particularly belongs to the technical field of non-contact vital sign monitoring. By adopting the ML estimation method, the estimation of the heartbeat and the respiratory frequency is realized, and compared with the traditional method based on time-frequency analysis, the ML estimation method has more stable performance, smaller error and smaller dependence on data duration; in addition, the invention provides an estimation performance evaluation method with more theoretical basis for the field by calculating the CRB estimated by the heartbeat respiratory frequency; based on the CRB obtained by derivation, the invention provides a system parameter optimization design method which can assist technicians to find out the optimal radar parameters, thereby improving the performance of heartbeat and respiratory frequency estimation.

title_en: Building layout tomography method based on direct wave time delay estimation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building layout tomography method based on direct wave time delay estimation, which is characterized by accurately extracting a direct wave from a sampling signal with complex components, establishing a tomography projection model according to the relation between the propagation time delay of the direct wave and the relative dielectric constant of a medium on a path, reconstructing the building layout by using a minimum total variation augmented Lagrange alternating direction algorithm, realizing high-precision reconstruction of a conventional building only containing horizontal and vertical walls, accurately estimating the direct wave time delay, solving the problems of more artifacts, fuzzy walls and the like in an imaging result, being suitable for reconstruction of the conventional building layout, being beneficial to optimizing the reconstruction quality of the partial unconventional building layout, having the advantages of simple processing flow and low cost, and being directly applied to through-wall radar equipment.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign detection system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of vital sign detection, and discloses a non-contact vital sign detection system which comprises a host, a slave and a terminal display device, wherein the slave comprises a slave processor, a millimeter wave radar chip and a slave communication module; the millimeter wave radar chip is used for receiving the millimeter wave radar parameters sent by the host, generating frequency modulation continuous waves according to the millimeter wave radar parameters and transmitting the frequency modulation continuous waves; receiving an echo signal of a user to be tested and sending the echo signal to a slave processor; the slave processor is used for obtaining the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency of the user to be detected through a preset respiratory heartbeat algorithm according to the echo signal of the user to be detected, and sending the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency to the master through the slave communication module; the host is used for receiving the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency of the user to be detected and sending the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency to the terminal display equipment; and the terminal display equipment is used for receiving and displaying the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency of the user to be detected. The method has the advantages of realizing non-contact detection, being convenient to use and user-friendly, and being capable of remotely detecting the vital sign information under the condition of no contact.
assignees: FUJIAN HUAHAI TRANSSION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for processing ultra-wideband UWB (ultra Wide band) vital signals
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for processing ultra-wideband UWB (ultra-wideband UWB) vital signals, electronic equipment and a storage medium. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting a plurality of echo signals corresponding to ultra-wideband UWB life signals to obtain a first echo signal matrix consisting of the echo signals, obtaining a second echo signal matrix after clutter preprocessing is carried out on the first echo signal matrix, carrying out singular value decomposition to obtain a plurality of singular values corresponding to the second echo signal matrix, screening the singular values and important items to obtain a plurality of main singular values, generating a third echo signal matrix corresponding to the main singular values, carrying out signal decomposition to obtain an inherent modal component matrix corresponding to the third echo signal matrix, and reconstructing a target ultra-wideband UWB life signal according to the inherent modal component matrix.

title_en: Buffer type ground transformer with electric power equipment installed
title_ko: 전력설비가 부설된 완충형 지상변압기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a buffer type ground transformer with electric power equipment installed therein. The buffer type ground transformer comprises: a body for accommodating a transformer unit connected to a high-voltage cable and a low-voltage cable buried in the ground; a plurality of support springs for distancing the body from the ground and absorbing shocks applied thereto from the outside; a power supply built in the body, connected to the transformer unit, and for providing power; an optical sensor disposed on the body to detect ambient brightness; a rain sensor disposed on the body to detect rainwater when it rains; a controller for receiving detection information from the optical sensor and the rain sensor and outputting a control signal; and a retractable streetlight waiting in a concealed state inside the body and operating under the control of the controller to output light while being exposed to an upper part of the body. Therefore, the buffer type ground transformer can perform the basic functions and have a self-operating streetlight or an emergency charging means, thereby serving as a facility that is useful in real life, not an inconvenient facility that hinders traffic. In addition, the buffer type ground transformer can have a buffering capacity to prevent damage caused by external shocks such as vehicle collisions or earthquakes, thereby being stably used.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전력설비가 부설된 완충형 지상변압기에 관한 것이다. 이는, 지중에 매설된 고압케이블 및 저압케이블과 각각 접속된 변압유니트를 수용하는 본체와; 상기 본체를 지면으로부터 이격시키고, 외부로부터 가해지는 충격을 흡수하는 다수의 받침스프링과; 상기 본체에 내장된 상태로 변압유니트에 접속되고 전력을 제공하는 전원과; 본체의 상부에 배치되며 주변 밝기를 감지하는 광센서와; 본체의 상부에 배치되고 강우 시 빗물을 감지하는 레인센서와; 상기 광센서 및 레인센서로부터 감지정보를 전달받아 제어신호를 출력하는 제어기와; 상기 본체의 내부에 은폐된 상태로 대기하며, 제어기의 제어에 의해 동작하여 본체 상부로 노출된 상태로 조명을 출력하는 출몰형가로등을 구비한다. 
상기와 같이 이루어지는 본 발명의 전력설비가 부설된 완충형 지상변압기는, 변압기의 기본 기능을 수행함은 물론, 스스로 작동하는 가로등이나 비상용 충전수단을 가져, 통행에 방해를 주는 불편 시설물이 아닌 실생활에 도움을 시설물의 역할을 한다. 또한, 완충능력을 가져 차량의 충돌이나 지진과 같은 외부 충격에 의한 손상이 없어 안정적인 사용이 가능하다.

title_en: Method and system for rapidly detecting through-wall radar target by frequency modulation continuous wave signal system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for rapidly detecting a through-wall radar target by using a frequency modulated continuous wave signal system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving each frame of transmission information transmitted by an FMCW receiver according to a set frequency by adopting a zero intermediate frequency de-frequency modulation mode to obtain a corresponding beat signal; acquiring echo range images corresponding to the beat signals respectively according to the obtained beat signals; carrying out difference on any two adjacent frames of echo range profiles to obtain a sequence of difference range profiles; screening out a differential distance image meeting a first preset condition; performing Fourier transform on the complex scattering value at the corresponding distance of the differential distance image meeting a first preset condition along the sequence direction to obtain a function of the complex scattering value after Fourier transform; and calculating function value points of the complex scattering values after Fourier transform meeting a second preset condition along the sequence direction aiming at the functions of the complex scattering values after Fourier transform, and taking the distance positions corresponding to the function value points meeting the second preset condition as effective targets.
assignees: WUHAN XINLANG PHOTOELECTRIC TECH CO LTD;HUAXIA CHUANGWEI BEIJING SAFETY PREVENTION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;BEIJING LSJ TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Top-mounted millimeter wave radar heartbeat and respiration detection device and detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a top-mounted millimeter wave radar heartbeat and respiration detection device which comprises a transmitting antenna, a receiving antenna, a control circuit connected with the transmitting antenna and a base provided with the control circuit, wherein the base is arranged on a roof, the transmitting antenna and the receiving antenna of the base face a detection target respectively.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;SICHUAN BAWEIJIUZHANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Robot-based autonomous interaction millimeter wave radar respiration heart rate detection system
abstract_en: The invention provides a robot-based autonomous interaction millimeter wave radar respiration heart rate detection system, which comprises: the device comprises a millimeter wave radar module, a robot control module, a man-machine interaction module, an AI system module, a memory module and an equipment main control module, wherein the robot control module is configured to control the millimeter wave radar and collect millimeter wave radar application data, and the millimeter wave radar module is configured to process original echo data received by the radio frequency transceiver unit, so that vital sign information of a living body is formed, and the vital sign information of the living body is analyzed and predicted. The advantage of endowment service robot millimeter wave radar detection breathing rhythm of the heart inspection in the set not only this application still compensaties prior art's service robot and lacks the function of autonomic service interaction service detection rhythm of the heart. The method is convenient, simple and rapid, is non-contact, finds the state of an illness and prevents the state of the illness in advance, and makes a pre-diagnosis conclusion.
assignees: FUNING PIPAYU TECH HANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for identifying human body behaviors of through-wall radar based on multilink information decision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar human body behavior recognition method and device based on multi-link information decision, which comprise the steps of obtaining an original image of through-wall radar human body behavior echo, preprocessing the original image, carrying out Bayesian statistical decision on micro Doppler signal characteristics by a first link to obtain a first link recognition result, obtaining visual layer local characteristics from the processed image by a second link to obtain a second link recognition result, obtaining visual layer global characteristics from the processed image by a third link, namely classifying the processed image by a residual neural network introducing an attention mechanism to obtain a third link recognition result, and fusing the first link recognition result, the second link recognition result and the third link recognition result to obtain a final recognition result. The invention realizes the identification of high accuracy and high information utilization rate under severe conditions such as fuzzy radar imaging, low signal-to-noise ratio and the like.

title_en: Radar heart rate detection method, and system thereof
abstract_en: To detect a heart rate by detection based on non-contact type 'Vital Signs' of a radar.SOLUTION: In a radar heart rate detection method and its system, raw signals are collected by facing a radar sensor to at least one object, and according to a concept for visualizing an image, after converting the raw signals into two-dimensional image information, a network is allowed to learn automatically by deep learning, which in the two-dimensional image information is a notable heart rate frequency, or which is a heart rate frequency to be filtered, to thereby take out the heart rate frequency effectively.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting safety helmet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire control intelligent safety helmet, including the cap body, extension subassembly and monitoring subassembly, the downside the place ahead external fixation of the cap body has the brim of a hat, and the upside of the brim of a hat installs and is used for monitoring subassembly for the extension cap body protects the position extension unit mount in the rear side below of the cap body, and the extension subassembly includes equipment board, locking bolt and backplate, equipment board and the cap body are fixed connection, and the backplate is installed to the below of equipment board, and is connected through the locking bolt between backplate and the equipment board for monitor vital sign the monitoring subassembly sets up in the rear side below of equipment board. This fire control intelligent security cap is convenient for carry out video acquisition to user's route through the camera to can carry out network video transmission through 4G 5G, can also carry out personnel's location to the user through gps orientation module, can pass through blood oxygen sensor real-time supervision user's rhythm of the heart and oxyhemoglobin saturation moreover, functional preferred.
assignees: BEIJING WEIYIN ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Life monitoring intelligent bracelet capable of being worn by personnel independently through mobile mechanical arm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a life monitoring intelligent bracelet, which is worn by a mobile mechanical arm by personnel independently and comprises a clamping mechanism and a detection mechanism, wherein the clamping mechanism comprises a shell, a clamping jaw, a push rod and a reset piece, the clamping jaw and the push rod are arranged on the shell, the push rod is used for loosening the clamping jaw, the reset piece is used for keeping the clamping jaw in a clamping state, the detection mechanism comprises a fixing piece and a vital sign information sensor, the fixing piece is arranged on the lower side of the shell, and the vital sign information sensor is arranged on one side of the fixing piece, which is far away from the shell, and is arranged in the middle of the clamping jaw. According to the life monitoring intelligent bracelet, the bracelet is automatically worn on the wrist of a patient by the mobile mechanical arm, and the vital sign information of the patient is collected by the bracelet to perform diagnosis and classification, so that the accuracy of triage can be improved, the treatment rate of the patient can be improved, and the requirements on professional medical staff in emergency situations can be reduced.

title_en: Deep-buried tunnel surrounding rock dielectric property inversion and loosening ring range identification method
