abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for inverting the dielectric property of surrounding rock of a deep-buried tunnel and identifying the scope of a loosening ring  Front side  Conductivity σ  Front part  And magnetic permeability mu  Front part  Obtaining a scan of the region of interest, and calculating the radar wave velocity v through a wave velocity model before excavation  Front side  (ii) a After the deep-buried tunnel is excavated, the high-precision dielectric constant epsilon and the conductivity sigma are output through dielectric property inversion, and the excavated deep-buried tunnel is solved through an excavated wave velocity modelThe wave velocity v; calculating the thickness of the loosening ring according to the wave velocity v; passing wave velocity v and radar wave velocity v  Front side  And (4) taking the square of the ratio as the quantitative evaluation of the integrity degree of the loose circle of the surrounding rock, and dividing a condition table according to the rock integrity index to obtain the grade of the loose circle of the surrounding rock. The method solves the problems of low measurement precision, unreliable measurement data, complex operation and the like in the conventional method for measuring the range of the loose coil after the deep-buried tunnel is blasted.
assignees: UNIV SHENYANG TECHNOLOGY;CHINA RAILWAY 19TH BUREAU GROUP 3RD CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional ground penetrating radar quantitative imaging method based on improved backward projection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional ground penetrating radar quantitative imaging method based on improved back projection, and relates to the technical field of ground penetrating radar imaging. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring echo signal data of the three-dimensional ground penetrating radar in the survey area; preprocessing the echo signal data to obtain a three-dimensional data matrix, wherein the preprocessing comprises direct wave removal and gain control; segmenting the three-dimensional data matrix into two-dimensional profile data, and performing visual imaging on the two-dimensional profile data through improved back projection imaging; and extracting single channel wave A-scan data of the abnormal region, and quantifying the geometric dimension, the horizontal position and the buried depth of the underground buried target body corresponding to the amplitude abrupt change position of the single channel wave A-scan data. The method effectively solves the problem of misjudgment of directly judging target echo data in engineering practice, realizes the visualization of the underground target, simplifies the identification of the underground target, and provides technical support for the decision of subsequent related workers.

title_en: Method and device for enhancing human behavior characteristics of through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for enhancing human body behavior characteristics of a through-wall radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: dividing the input data into a plurality of areas based on information relationship, and giving corresponding weight to each divided area, wherein the output of the attention weighting module is a feature map; the convolutional layer module is used for generating a two-dimensional image for downscaling the input data; inputting a characteristic diagram into a super-resolution module comprising a plurality of LISTA models; the two-dimensional image is input into a self-adaptive weight module to generate enhanced information of each region; and fusing the enhanced information of each region to obtain a fusion characteristic vector, and performing scale conversion on the fusion characteristic vector to obtain output. The method combines the specific complex multipath effect of through-wall radar imaging and the physical background under the low signal-to-noise-ratio scene, so that the method achieves a better data enhancement effect by using less cost.

title_en: Agricultural meteorological disaster dynamic monitoring and yield loss assessment system
abstract_en: A dynamic monitoring and yield loss assessment system for agricultural meteorological disasters belongs to the technical field of agricultural information intelligent analysis, and comprises a monitoring rod, a high-definition camera, an integrated meteorological five-element monitor, a photovoltaic panel storage battery, a rainfall sensor, a soil temperature and humidity sensor, a weak current box, a 4G router and a hard disk video recorder; the high-definition camera is arranged on the top of the monitoring rod; the integrated meteorological five-element monitor and the rainfall sensor are arranged on the monitoring rod; the weak current box is arranged on the monitoring rod, and the 4G router and the hard disk video recorder are both arranged in the weak current box; the photovoltaic panel is arranged on the monitoring rod, and a photovoltaic panel storage battery is arranged on the photovoltaic panel; the soil temperature and humidity sensor is buried in the soil. The method is used for monitoring meteorological conditions and meteorological disasters by agricultural farmers in the crop growth process, giving early warning to the meteorological disasters in real time, and storing disaster-suffering conditions in a video image mode, so that the farmers can resist disasters in time, save themselves and settle claims in later period conveniently.
assignees: JILIN PROVINCE ZHONGNONG SUNSHINE DATA CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact vital sign signal measuring device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact vital sign signal measuring device and a non-contact vital sign signal measuring method, wherein a target is directly selected through a camera, millimeter waves are sent through an antenna to realize the detection of the target, the vital sign signal detection can be accurately carried out on the moving target, the moving range of a patient is not limited, and discomfort or even secondary injury can not be brought to the patient, particularly a burn patient. Meanwhile, the non-contact detection can avoid the problems of poor contact of the sensor, inaccurate data acquisition, reduced service life of the equipment, even damage to equipment and the like caused by multiple plugging and unplugging of contact equipment; accurate and not fragile equipment.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle life detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle life detection device, including mounting bracket and radar life detection instrument, the side symmetry of mounting bracket is provided with two drive mechanism, and the week side of radar life detection instrument is equipped with the electric putter who corresponds the setting with drive mechanism, and electric putter's top is connected with drive mechanism, and electric putter's bottom is equipped with the gesture regulating part of control radar life detection instrument gesture, and the gesture regulating part is including installing the base in the electric putter bottom, and the both ends of base are all rotated and are provided with the landing leg. This unmanned aerial vehicle life detection device can carry radar life detection instrument through unmanned aerial vehicle to can adjust the height of radar life detection instrument and the gesture of falling to the ground, can also monitor and buffer protection when radar life detection instrument falls to the ground, make radar life detection instrument can normally carry out the life and detect, can carry out the life to the center of suffering from a disaster fast and survey, convenient rescue, easy operation, convenient to use.

title_en: Situation monitoring system based on activity sensor
title_ko: 활동센서 기반의 상황 감시 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a situation monitoring system based on an activity sensor, which comprises: a radar measuring device which senses a user's biological signal in an indoor environment; a monitoring server which receives the biological signal collected by the radar measuring device to detect the occurrence of an emergency situation for a user in the indoor environment; and a user terminal which interworks with each of the radar measuring device and the monitoring server through a dedicated application. Accordingly, the present invention can effectively detect the occurrence of the user's emergency situation by sensing a biological signal in an indoor environment such as a home or an office.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 활동센서 기반의 상황 감시 시스템에 관한 것으로, 실내 환경에서 사용자의 생체 신호를 감지하는 레이더 측정기; 상기 레이더 측정기에 의해 수집된 생체 신호를 수신하여 상기 실내 환경 하에서 상기 사용자에 대한 응급상황의 발생을 검출하는 모니터링 서버; 및 전용 어플리케이션을 통해 상기 레이더 측정기 및 상기 모니터링 서버 각각과 연동하는 사용자 단말;을 포함한다. 따라서, 본 발명은 가정, 사무실 등의 실내 환경에서 생체 신호를 감지하여 사용자의 위급상황 발생을 효과적으로 검출할 수 있다.

title_en: Remote Vital signs Detection Sensor
title_ko: 원격 생체 신호 감지 센서
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a remote vital signs detection sensor. The prior art is a method of detecting a bio signal by confirming a position of a person and transmitting a signal in a corresponding direction. Therefore, in order to detect the bio signal of the person continuously moving in a space, the direction of the signal should be continuously changed, and it may be difficult to detect a bio signal of a person who is not continuously located in a specific direction and moves away. Accordingly, there is a problem in that accuracy of the detected bio signal can be reduced. The purpose of the present invention is to provide the remote bio signal detection sensor capable of accurately detecting the bio-signal of the person. A remote bio signal detection sensor according to a preferable embodiment of the present invention includes: an antenna unit for radiating a frequency signal to the outside and receiving a reflected high frequency signal which is reflected from an object; and a control unit which analyzes the bio signal based on a change pattern of the received reflected high frequency signal. The present invention can accurately extract the detected bio signal. In addition, accurate bio signal information enables quick and accurate identification of emergency situations such as myocardial infarction, and enables a quick action against personal abnormalities such as death of the elderly living alone.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 원격 생체 신호 감지 센서에 관한 것이다. 종래 기술은 사람의 위치를 확인하고 해당 방향으로 신호를 보내어 생체 신호를 감지하는 방식이다. 따라서, 연속적으로 공간을 이동하는 사람의 생체 신호를 감지하기 위해서는 연속적으로 신호의 방향을 변경해야 하며 특정 방향에 지속적으로 위치하지 않고 이동하여 벗어난 사람의 생체 신호는 감지가 어려울 수 있다. 이에 의해 감지된 생체 신호는 정확성이 떨어질 수 있는 문제점이 있다. 본 발명은 사람의 생체 신호를 정확하게 감지할 수 있는 원격 생체 신호 감지 센서를 제공하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 본 발명의 바람직한 일 실시예에 따른 원격 생체 신호 감지 센서는 주파 신호를 외부로 방사하고, 대상물에 반사되어 되돌아온 반사 고주파 신호를 수신하는 안테나부; 및 수신된 상기 반사 고주파 신호의 변화 패턴을 기반으로 생체 신호를 분석하는 제어부를 포함할 수 있다. 본 발명은 감지된 생체 신호를 정확하게 추출할 수 있다. 또한 정확한 생체 신호 정보는 심근경색 등의 위급 상황을 신속하고 정확하게 알 수 있으며 독거노인 고독사와 같은 신변 이상에 대하여 빠르게 조치를 취할 수 있다.

title_en: Noninductive vital health sign parameter measuring instrument
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-inductive vital health sign parameter measuring instrument, which comprises a hemispherical shell, wherein an opening at the bottom is fixedly connected with a support, a radar module for collecting vital sign parameters of a human body is arranged in the hemispherical shell, and an information processing module for receiving and processing the vital sign parameters is fixedly arranged on the support below the radar module; the vital sign parameters processed by the information processing module can be uploaded to a cloud server through a wireless WIFI module and then pushed to a user terminal. The invention adopts the non-contact Doppler radar detection technology to detect the vital sign parameters of the human body, thereby being free from the influence of the external environment and avoiding the danger of contact infection; the intelligent home monitoring system has the functions of data checking, data storage, alarming and remote monitoring, detected data are pushed to the user terminal through the cloud server, so that the user can know the health condition of a detected person in time, and medical treatment and intelligent home are combined.

title_en: Self-adaptive vital sign monitoring method for intelligent automobile cabin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive vital sign monitoring method for an intelligent cabin of an automobile, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: the vehicle millimeter wave radar detects a human body target in a vehicle; detecting the position of a human body target; extracting the echo phase of a human body target; separating a heartbeat signal and a respiratory signal in a human body target echo; directly estimating the frequency of the separated respiratory signals; and for the heartbeat signal, after the interference is eliminated by utilizing an adaptive cancellation method, frequency estimation is carried out. In a vehicle-mounted environment, the invention can realize non-contact monitoring of the health state of the driver, including measurement of respiratory and heartbeat frequency. The invention can eliminate the interference caused by vehicle body vibration and environmental noise and reduce the measurement error of respiratory and heartbeat frequency by the thought of self-adaptive filtering facing the application background of the intelligent cabin.

title_en: Portable toxin filtering box service life detection device
abstract_en: The application discloses a portable toxin filtering box service life detection device, which comprises a box body, a gas detection module, a power supply module and an electric control device; gaseous detection module includes the air duct, gaseous detection sensor, aspiration pump and tail gas adsorber, the inlet end of air duct is located outside the box body, the end of giving vent to anger of air duct is connected with the inlet end of aspiration pump in the box body, gaseous detection sensor locates in the box body, and the sense terminal of gaseous detection sensor stretches into in the air duct in order to detect the gas through the air duct, the end of giving vent to anger of aspiration pump is connected with the tail gas adsorber, power module provides the electric energy for gaseous detection module, electrically controlled device is used for receiving external user's control command, and control the operation of gaseous detection module and with the data output that gaseous detection module detected. The detection device can help a respirator using unit to evaluate the service life of the poison filtering box according to the shift or the daily period, and remind a user of timely replacing the poison filtering box with the expired service life.
assignees: SHANGHAI HUXIANG ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Recuperation monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recuperation monitoring method and a system based on a millimeter wave radar, which relate to the technical field of recuperation monitoring and solve the technical problem that in the prior art, a recuperation patient cannot be timely analyzed according to vital sign parameters in a recuperation process in a recuperation period in real time; monitoring and analyzing the vital sign parameters of the rehabilitation process of the analysis object, and judging whether the rehabilitation state of the analysis object in the rehabilitation period is qualified or not, thereby carrying out rehabilitation monitoring on the analysis object in the rehabilitation period.
assignees: YIHUIYUN INTELLIGENT TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign detection apparatus and system and data processing method
abstract_en: The vital sign detection device of the present invention includes one or more sensors, which can detect a plurality of vital sign signals of a test subject in a non-contact manner, and output corresponding a plurality of vital sign information, thereby achieving fast and accurate vital sign detection. The invention also relates to a combined multi-functional detection device, which includes a camera, a radar sensor, an infrared sensor and a sensor driving unit, used for measuring vital signs. The invention also provides a non-contact blood pressure measurement method and device. The method includes receiving radar echoes and video signal streams at first and second parts, extracting first and second pulse wave signals therefrom, obtaining a measured pulse wave transit time, matching the measured pulse wave transit time with a reference pulse wave transit time, and obtaining a blood pressure value.
assignees: NAT UNIV SINGAPORE;NATIONAL UNIV OF SINGAPORE SUZHOU RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Information acquisition device for reinforcing-bar in concrete by radar scan and operation method thereof
abstract_en: To provide a reinforcing-bar arrangement information acquisition device which can obtain an image that correctly and clearly displays the arrangement state of reinforcing-bars even if alignment of a scan start position for each radar scan is performed fuzzily when grasping positions of a plurality of reinforcing-bars arranged in parallel to each other in concrete by performing the radar scan by an electromagnetic radar device, and provide an operation method thereof.SOLUTION: A reinforcing-bar arrangement information acquisition device for acquiring arrangement information of a plurality of reinforcing-bars arranged in parallel to each other by being buried in concrete C, comprises: a hyperbola information holding part 0361 which holds hyperbola information acquired by performing plural times of radar scans that pass through different paths in the orthogonal directions over the plurality of reinforcing-bars; a hyperbola information synchronization unit 0362 which synchronizes the repetition period of the reflection intensity of the held hyperbola information by the plural times of radar scans that pass through different paths; and an arrangement information generation unit 0363 which generates arrangement information of the reinforcing-bars on the basis of the synchronized hyperbola information obtained for each of the different paths.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3D

title_en: Non-contact respiration and heartbeat detection lamp based on UWB radar technology
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the space perception, concretely relates to contactless heartbeat detection lamp of breathing based on UWB radar technique, a serial communication port, include: the device comprises a power management module, a lighting module, a voltage processing module, a wireless communication module, a radar measuring module, a storage module, a display module and a transceiving module. This contactless heartbeat detecting lamp of breathing based on UWB radar technique sends the signal through two way TX board-mounted antennas of radar detection module, and rethread four way RX board-mounted antennas carry out the analysis to received signal, isolate breathing, heartbeat life information, has got rid of temperature and illumination to the interference of information acquisition with the transmission, has promoted the accuracy of detected information.

title_en: Disaster early warning radar convenient to install
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the radar technique and specifically relates to calamity early warning radar that can be easy to assemble, including the radar, the stand is installed to the lower extreme of radar, the lower extreme of stand is equipped with two sets of first installation mechanisms, and is two sets of be equipped with second installation mechanism between the first installation mechanism, first installation mechanism is including base plate, first fixed establishment, second fixed establishment, the equal symmetry in upper end of base plate is equipped with the jack, the inner chamber of jack is all pegged graft and is had first fixed establishment, first fixed establishment is including the buried pipe of pegging graft mutually with the jack, the equal equidistance in buried pipe both sides is equipped with the through-hole, the inner chamber of through-hole all is connected with the rubber sack, the utility model has the advantages of reasonable design, and convenient installation dismantlement to the radar, its installation effectiveness of effectual improvement, the labour saving and time saving, the effectual fixed stay that can dismantle the radar, and be convenient for play the supported effect of shock attenuation buffering, the effectual fixed effect that improves it.

title_en: Bury formula fire pump station water tank
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire-fighting water tanks, and discloses a buried fire-fighting pump station water tank, which comprises a main body, the bottom fixedly connected with supporting mechanism of main part, the supporting mechanism includes the base, the supporting mechanism is installed in the bottom of main part, the inside of base has been seted up and has been held the chamber, the inside of main part is installed separating mechanism, the inside fixedly connected with water pressure sensor of main part, the inside of main part is installed pumping mechanism, the top of main part is installed scrubbing mechanism, scrubbing mechanism includes the scrubbing pipe, the end fixedly connected with scrubbing head of scrubbing pipe, scrubbing head is located and holds the inside of chamber, the top of main part is installed into water mechanism; the utility model discloses can get rid of the inside impurity of water tank.
assignees: XINJIANG DABAIXIANG WATER SUPPLY EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent blood pressure measuring system and method based on single vital sign monitoring radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of blood pressure measurement, and particularly discloses an intelligent blood pressure measurement system based on a single vital sign monitoring radar. An intelligent blood pressure measuring method based on a single vital sign monitoring radar comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring an aortic pulse waveform signal of a subject at intervals by using a single vital sign monitoring radar, and acquiring an environmental signal around the subject by using the radar; s2: the pulse data of the hand of the testee is collected in a contact mode, and meanwhile the vibration sensor detects whether the hand of the testee vibrates or not. The scheme solves the problem of inaccurate blood pressure measurement caused by the change of the radar waves when the radar waves are used for measuring the blood pressure.

title_en: Integrated non-contact millimeter wave radar system for health monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to an integrated non-contact millimeter wave radar system for health monitoring, which comprises a vital sign monitoring module, a sleep monitoring module, a falling monitoring module and a Labview visual display module. The system adopts the millimeter wave radar sensor with 60Ghz to realize the non-contact health monitoring of the human body, and avoids the problems of complex operation, limited application range, low user dependency and low integration degree of the existing monitoring system. Compared with the existing monitoring system, the system has the advantages of high resolution, strong sensitivity, high visualization degree and multifunction integration, health characteristic signals of a human body can be monitored, evaluated and judged in real time through the millimeter wave radar, and fed back to a doctor or a guardian in time, and the doctor or the guardian can make emergency treatment according to corresponding prompts. The system plays an important role in special crowds such as children, old people, burn patients, infectious disease patients and the like, and can achieve the purpose of efficient and accurate monitoring.
assignees: SUZHOU ZHIJU XINLIAN MICROELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Method for detecting biometric information and electronic device supporting the same
title_ko: 생체 정보 검출 방법 및 이를 지원하는 전자 장치
abstract_en: An electronic device according to various embodiments includes: an output module; a communication module configured to communicate with at least one external device; a first sensor configured to sense a biometric signal; a second sensor configured to sense an inertial signal; and a processor operatively connected to the output module, the communication module, the first sensor, and the second sensor. The processor may be configured: to determine a location of the electronic device for a human body based on a signal transmitted or received with the at least one external device through the communication module in response to sensing the biometric signal through the first sensor; to determine a posture of the electronic device based on information obtained through the second sensor; to determine a measurement posture based on the location and the posture of the electronic device; and to guide the measurement posture to correspond to a predetermined reference posture. Accordingly, the present invention can measure biometric information with high reliability.
abstract_ko: 다양한 실시 예에 따른 전자 장치는, 출력 모듈, 적어도 하나의 외부 장치와 통신하도록 설정된 통신 모듈, 신체에 대한 생체 신호를 감지하는 제 1 센서, 관성 신호를 감지하도록 설정된 제 2 센서 및 상기 출력 모듈, 상기 통신 모듈, 상기 제 1 센서 및 상기 제 2 센서와 동작 가능하게 연결된 프로세서를 포함하며, 상기 프로세서는, 상기 제 1 센서를 통해 생체 신호를 감지하는 것에 응답하여, 상기 통신 모듈을 통해 상기 적어도 하나의 외부 장치와 송수신하는 신호에 기초하여 신체에 대한 상기 전자 장치의 위치를 결정하고, 상기 제 2 센서를 통해 획득되는 정보에 기초하여 상기 전자 장치의 자세를 결정하고, 상기 전자 장치의 위치 및 상기 전자 장치의 자세에 기초하여, 사용자에 대한 측정 자세를 결정하고, 상기 측정 자세가 미리 지정된 기준 자세에 대응되도록 가이드 하도록 설정될 수 있다.

title_en: Smart valve chamber
title_ko: 스마트 밸브실
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart valve chamber. More specifically, various kinds of preset sensors are installed in multiple valve chambers locally installed in a pipe buried underground. Accordingly, various kinds of data caused by a natural disaster accident, such as an earthquake, a sinkhole, and the like are collected and stored as sensing data so that various kinds of diagnosis, such as detecting leakage and damage to the pipe are possible. Moreover, when a pipe problem occurs between valve chambers, a pipe leak point can be checked by using the sensing data. Also, the valve chamber has an open structure in which the upper part is completely open. Therefore, the smart valve chamber has a structure easy to maintain an inner pipe or a device. The smart valve chamber includes the multiple valve chambers (10), multiple sensors (30), and a system unit (40).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트 밸브실에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 지하에 매설된 배관에 국부적으로 설치된 다수의 밸브실 내부에, 사전설정한 다양한 종류의 감지센서를 설치함으로써, 이를 통해 지진, 싱크홀 등의 자연재해 사고에 의한 각종 데이터를 감지데이터로 취합 및 저장하여, 배관의 누수탐지, 파손 등 각종 진단이 가능토록 하며, 밸브실과 밸브실 사이에서의 배관 문제 발생시, 배관리크지점을 이러한 감지데이터를 통해 확인할 수 있도록 하며, 밸브실도 상부가 완전히 개방되는 개방구조를 가지도록 함으로써, 내부 배관이나 장비의 유지보수 또한 용이한 구조를 가지도록 하는 스마트 밸브실에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Fine dust information collection system using multifunctional air cleaning headphone
title_ko: 다기능 공기청정 헤드폰을 이용한 미세먼지정보 수집 시스템
abstract_en: A fine dust information collection system using a multifunctional air cleaning headphone comprises: a headphone body which includes two earplugs emitting sound and purified air, a mask connected between the two earplugs, a headband rotatably coupled to the two earplugs, and a blindfold rotatably coupled between the two earplugs and the headband; a charging station on which the headphone body is held and which can emit purified air; a fine dust measurement sensor which is mounted on the headphone body to measure fine dust concentration around a user and transmits information on the measured fine dust concentration to a mobile device of the user; a biosignal measurement sensor which is mounted on the headphone body to measure a biosignal of the user and transmits information on the measured biosignal to the mobile device of the user; and a central server which wirelessly communicates with the mobile device of the user and receives information on the fine dust concentration and information on the biosignal. Accordingly, the present invention enables users to breathe in fresh air anywhere through an air cleaning mode.

title_en: Vital sign parameter estimation method and performance evaluation based on MIMO radar
abstract_en: The application discloses a vital sign parameter estimation method and performance estimation based on MIMO radar, relates to the technical field of MIMO radar application, and provides a technical scheme for improving the performance of parameter estimation by further applying the MIMO radar to vital sign parameter estimation. The application includes placing MIMO radar in an observation area; acquiring MIMO radar position information and observation area position information; acquiring received acquisition sample information of the MIMO radar, wherein the acquisition sample information is a transmitting signal of an MIMO radar transmitting antenna passing through an observation area; inputting the position information and the sample information into a signal model, outputting unknown parameters of the input information through maximum likelihood estimation by the signal model, and outputting a Kramer boundary value for estimating the unknown parameters by the signal model; and outputting vital sign parameter information and performance of parameter estimation thereof. The application realizes that the MIMO radar adopts Bayesian estimation to obtain the estimation value of the heartbeat frequency, and the Clarituxan boundary value of the parameter is utilized to evaluate the estimation performance.

title_en: Method for improving detection precision of soil moisture content based on buried depth of soil sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving the detection precision of soil moisture content based on the buried depth of a soil sensor, which comprises the following steps: s1, preparing or selecting a soil sensor; s2, detecting a soil capacitance factor W; s3, measuring a buried depth factor H of the soil sensor; and S4, measuring data of different depth positions in the soil sample with the same water content, and selecting a binary linear polynomial equation model to fit the water content, the soil capacitance factor and the depth factor to obtain the final soil water content. The influence of the buried depth of the soil sensor on the water content of the soil is fully considered, the depth factor buried by the soil sensor is measured through the ranging radar module, the corresponding relation between the soil capacitance factor generated through the algorithm of reverse fitting and the water content of the soil is finally obtained, and the precision of the water content detection of the soil under the conditions of different depths of the soil is greatly improved.

title_en: Fine dust information collection system using air cleaning headphone with sliding guide
title_ko: 슬라이딩식 가이드를 가진 공기청정 헤드폰을 이용한 미세먼지정보 수집 시스템
abstract_en: A fine dust information collection system using an air cleaning headphone with a sliding guide of the present invention comprises: a headphone body which includes two earplugs emitting sound and purified air, a headband connecting the two earplugs and having an adjustable length, and a sliding guide concentrating the purified air emitted from the earplugs around a mouth and a nose; a charging station on which the headphone body is held and which can emit purified air; a fine dust measurement sensor which is mounted on the headphone body to measure fine dust concentration around a user and transmits information on the measured fine dust concentration to a mobile device of the user; a biosignal measurement sensor which is mounted on the headphone body to measure a biosignal of the user and transmits information on the measured biosignal to the mobile device of the user; and a central server which wirelessly communicates with the mobile device of the user and receives information on the fine dust concentration and information on the biosignal. Accordingly, the present invention enables users to breathe in fresh air outdoors and even indoors.

title_en: Fine dust information collection system using air cleaning headphone with rotating guide
title_ko: 회전식 가이드를 가진 공기청정 헤드폰을 이용한 미세먼지정보 수집 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention comprises: a headphone body which includes two ear plugs emitting sound and purified air, a headband connecting the two earplugs and having an adjustable length, and a rotary guide coupled to the ear plugs to be rotatable and fixed to a specific position; a charging station in which the headphone body is mounted and which can discharge purified air; a fine dust measurement sensor which is mounted on the headphone body, measures a concentration of fine dust around a user, and transmits information on the measured concentration of fine dust to the user's mobile device; a bio-signal measurement sensor which is mounted on the headphone body, measures the user's bio-signal, and transmits information on the measured bio-signal to the user's mobile device; and a central server which wirelessly communicates with the user's mobile device and receives the information on the concentration of fine dust and the information on the bio-signal. According to the present invention, a concentration of fine dust in a place where a user is located can be identified in real time, and the user can breathe clean air anywhere through an air cleaning mode of the headphone body.

title_en: Fire extinguisher identification device of a road tunnel using RF communication
title_ko: 알에프 통신을 이용한 도로 터널 소화장치 식별장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire extinguisher identification device of a road tunnel using RF communication, which is for a road tunnel fire extinguisher including a fire extinguisher box (40) and comprises an installation space recess (33), a smoke and fire sensor (31a), a smoke penetrating LED lighting box (10), a lighting box protection frame (20), and a remote manager terminal (60). According to the present invention, a fire in a tunnel can be easily identified by a plurality of smoke and fire sensors installed on the wall of the tunnel, a nearby fire extinguisher box accommodating a fire extinguisher can be easily found by upper and side smoke penetrating LEDs even if smoke and various noises are generated in the event of a fire in the tunnel, and a door of the fire extinguisher box accommodating the fire extinguisher is automatically opened, so that a user near the fire extinguisher box can easily and quickly take out the fire extinguisher from the fire extinguisher box and quickly extinguish the fire.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 터널(30) 내 보행로(32) 상측 벽면(31)에 설치되어 작동시 터널(30) 내 화재를 시청각수단으로 알리는 비상벨스위치(41)와 경광등(42)을 갖고 도어(44)에 의해 개폐되는 내부 공간에는 소화기(43)를 포함하는 소방관련 설비들이 구비되는 소화전함(40)을 포함하는 도로 터널 소화장치에 있어서, 상기 소화전함(40)이 설치된 직하부 보행로(32) 일정길이가 절개되어 분리되면서 도로(50)와 동일평면을 이루게 형성되는 설치공간요부(33); 상기 터널(30) 벽면(31) 다수 곳에 설치되는 연기및화재감지센서(31a); 상기 설치공간요부(33)에 안착되는 반투명 재질의 박스체로 전후방측에 각각 수직기립되어 보행로(32) 선단면과 각각 밀착되는 직사각판체인 전후방사각판(11a,11b)을 각각 갖고 전후방사각판(11a,11b)의 바닥면과 우측면을 각각 이음연결하는 바닥판(11c)과 우측판(11d)을 각각 갖으며 우측단은 전후방사각판(11a,11b) 우측상단에 각각 고정되고 좌측단은 전후방사각판(11a,11b) 좌측하단에 각각 경사지게 고정설치되는 상면만 반사상면(12a)이 형성된 판체인 내측경사반사판(12)을 갖고 좌측단은 전후방사각판(11a,11b) 좌측상단에 각각 고정되고 우측단은 내측경사반사판(12) 반사면(12a) 중심부에 위치되어 밀착되면서 전후방사각판(11a,11b)에 각각 고정설치되는 양면이 반사면인 상하부반사면(13a,13b)이 형성된 상부경사반사판(13)을 갖으며 바닥판(11c) 및 우측판(11d)에 고정설치되어 상기 연기및화재감지센서(31a)와 알에프 신호로 통신연결되는 박스체인 알에프수신부및제어박스(14)를 갖고 내측경사반사판(12)과 상부경사반사판(13)이 만나는 지점의 상측에서 전후방사각판(11a,11b)에 각각 고정되게 조명설치되어 소화전함(40) 방향으로 조명하는 연기투시상부엘이디(15)를 갖으며 내측경사반사판(12)과 상부경사반사판(13)이 만나는 지점의 좌측에서 전후방사각판(11a,11b)에 각각 고정되게 조명설치되어 도로(50) 방향으로 조명하는 연기투시측부엘이디(16)를 갖는 조명박스몸체(11)가 형성되고, 투명판체로 일측은 조명박스몸체(11)의 전후방사각판(11a,11b) 상단에 안착되어 고정설치되는 상면커버(17a)를 갖고 타측은 상면커버(17a) 좌측단에서 하부로 수직절곡되어 전후방사각판(11a,11b) 좌측단에 고정설치되는 측면커버(17b)를 갖는 투명조명커버(17)가 형성되는 연기투시엘이디조명박스(10); 상기 연기투시엘이디조명박스(10) 투명조명커버(17)의 상면커버(17a) 상측에 수평으로 위치되어 상면이 보행로(32) 상면과 동일 평면을 이루고 우측단은 터널(30) 벽면(31)과 밀착되며 좌우측 일정간격으로 다수개 통공(21aa)이 형성되는 수평지지대(21a)를 갖고 수평지지대(21a) 좌측단에서 도로(50)측으로 연장되어 선단이 도로(50)와 밀착되되 좌측면이 보행로(32) 최측면과 동일 평면을 이루는 외측지지대(21b)를 갖는 횡방향지지프레임(21)이 길이방향으로 일정간격 다수개 형성되고, 다수개 횡방향지지프레임(21) 우측단을 길이방향으로 고정지지하고 일정간격 상부로 수직돌출되어 터널(30) 벽면(31)에 앵커볼트(22c)에 의해 고정되는 볼트공(22b)이 통공형성된 고정바(22a)를 갖는 우측단지지프레임(22)이 형성되며, 다수개 횡방향지지프레임(21) 좌측단을 길이방향으로 고정지지하는 좌측단지지프레임(23)이 형성되며, 다수개 횡방향지지프레임(21) 수평지지대(21a)의 통공(21aa)을 길이방향으로 연결지지하는 봉체인 종방향상단지지봉(24)을 갖는 조명박스보호프레임(20); 상기 소화전함(40)의 도어(44)는, 우측단부 중심에 회동축(44a)이 형성되고, 우측단 외측면은 평면이 원형으로 랙기어부(44b)가 형성되며, 랙기어부(44b)에는 내측에 설치되어 상기 알에프수신부및제어박스(14)와 통신연결되고 화재시 도어(44)를 개방시키는 정역회전모터(44c)의 피니언기어부(44ca)가 기어결합되고, 좌측단부 내측면에는 선단부에 상하로 잠금공(44da)이 통공형성된 잠금바(44d)가 돌출형성되며, 소화전함(40) 내측면에는 상기 알에프수신부및제어박스(14)와 통신연결되어 잠금바(44d)가 단속장공(45c)을 통해 삽입되고 삽입된 잠금바(44d)의 잠금공(44da)에 솔레노이드(45a)의 단속바(45b)가 삽입되어 화재시 솔레노이드(45a)의 단속바(45b)가 잠금바(44d)의 잠금공(44da)에서 분리되는 솔레노이드도어괘정장치(45)가 형성되고, 소화전함(40) 내부 상면에는 상기 알에프수신부및제어박스(14)와 통신연결되어 회재시 점등되는 조명등(46)이 형성되며; 상기 알에프수신부및제어박스(14)와 통신연결되는 원격의 관리자단말기(60)를 구비하는 알에프 통신을 이용한 도로 터널 소화장치 식별장치에 관한 것이다. 이러한 본 발명은 터널 벽면에 설치된 다수개 연기및화재감지센서에 의해 손쉽게 터널내 화재를 인식할 수 있고 터널 내 화재시 연기와 각종 소음이 발생하더라도 소화기가 수납된 인근의 소화전함을 연기투시상부엘이디와 연기투시측부엘이디에 의해 손쉽게 찾을 수 있으며 이때 자동으로 소화기가 수납된 소화전함의 도어가 자동으로 오픈됨에 따라 소화전함 인근의 사용자가 소화전함에서 손쉽고 신속하게 소화기를 꺼내 신속히 화재를 진압할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Joint estimation of respiratory and heart rates using ultra-wideband radar
abstract_en: A method for contactless vital sign monitoring includes transmitting, via a transceiver, radar signals for object detection. The method also includes generating a clutter removed channel impulse response from received reflections of the radar signals a portion of which are reflected off of a living object. The method further includes identifying a set of range bins corresponding to a position of the living object. Additionally, the method includes identifying a first set of signal components representing a respiration rate of the living object and a second set of signal components representing a heart rate of the living object.

title_en: Underwater emergency rescue navigation command system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an underwater emergency rescue navigation command system and a method, wherein the system comprises a water area high-speed remote control mobile equipment component, a water area rapid search detection and positioning component, a water area rescue worker high-speed auxiliary power component, a water area rescue heat preservation suit, an underwater high-precision search component, an underwater search and rescue worker monitoring positioner, an underwater communication and positioning base station, an aerial video and information relay component and a water surface or ground emergency command controller; carry on waters fast search through waters high speed remote control mobile equipment subassembly and survey and locating component etc. carry out quick detection and location under water, gather the vital sign information of rescue workers and environmental information under water through waters high-speed auxiliary power subassembly of rescue workers, waters rescue thermal-insulation suit, search for and rescue personnel monitoring locator etc. under water to transmit for the controller end, rescue the condition under water through controller real time monitoring, in time adjust the rescue strategy when emergency appears and carry out high-efficient, safe rescue work of developing.
assignees: SHENYANG FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Method and system for extracting and identifying embedded target based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for extracting and identifying a buried target based on multi-source data fusion, which relate to the field of disaster relief and multi-source data fusion and can be used for carrying out horizontal fusion and vertical fusion on multi-source data related to disaster, wherein disaster information is extracted, disaster clues are determined through horizontal fusion, a collapsed building is identified according to basic geographic data to obtain an initial judgment result, and then mobile phone signal data, radar signal data and the like are vertically fused to confirm the buried target. According to the invention, the multi-source data are fused, so that the target to be rescue and buried can be rapidly and accurately identified.

title_en: Multi-person vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-person vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar, which belongs to the technical field of non-contact vital sign monitoring, and comprises the steps of firstly processing echo data into a radar three-dimensional data matrix, executing FFT (fast Fourier transform) on each line of each channel data along a fast time dimension, and performing MVDR (mechanical vapor digital radiography) on data corresponding to Range-FFT points to obtain a data matrix containing distance angle information and a distance-angle diagram; and after preprocessing the distance-angle diagram, extracting connected domains by a connected domain analysis method, wherein the mass center of each connected domain is the target position, further extracting a corresponding phase sequence from a data matrix, and after phase unwrapping processing, first-order phase difference and band-pass filtering, realizing separation of a respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal, and respectively carrying out FFT processing and estimation to obtain a final monitoring result. According to the method, the number of the detected multi-person targets is not required to be known, the multi-targets at the same distance or the same angle can be distinguished, and vital sign estimation under the scene of the same distance is realized.

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses geological disaster monitoring equipment, which relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and improves the problem that the equipment is easy to be impacted or buried by stones, and comprises a bracket, a rainfall sensor and a collection box, wherein the rainfall sensor and the collection box are arranged on the bracket; the base is characterized in that an accommodating groove is formed in the upper end face of the base, the supporting plate is located right above the accommodating groove, a supporting block is connected to the groove wall of one end, far away from the baffle, of the accommodating groove in a sliding mode, an inserting port for inserting the supporting block is formed in one side, close to the supporting block, of the supporting plate, and the inserting port penetrates through the supporting plate and the baffle along the direction perpendicular to the baffle. When the monitoring device is impacted from the upper part of the slope, the monitoring device can be timely received into the accommodating groove for protection.

title_en: Buried fire-fighting water tank
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bury formula fire water tank, including the fire water tank body, the inner wall fixedly connected with level sensor of fire water tank body, the surface of fire water tank body is provided with the protective housing, the inner wall of protective housing is provided with the protection and fills up, the equal fixedly connected with a plurality of extension board of both sides wall of protective housing, the upper end fixedly connected with mounting panel of fire water tank body, the upper end fixedly connected with alarm of mounting panel, the upper end fixedly connected with mounting box of fire water tank body, the inside of mounting box is provided with the controller, the high-pressure water pump of upper end fixedly connected with of fire water tank body. The utility model discloses in, through setting up level sensor and feeling, alarm, controller, when not having water in the water tank, through the level sensor response, the alarm reports to the police, informs fire fighter in time to add water, because of anhydrous loss that causes in the water tank when avoiding appearing emergency, improves the availability factor.
assignees: CHONGQING ANBANG FIRE DESIGN AND INSTALLATION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Signal processing method and device
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a signal processing method and device. The method comprises: processing a radar echo signal to obtain a thoracic cavity movement signal, wherein the radar echo signal is an echo signal generated by a target object reflecting an electromagnetic wave emitted from a radar; filtering the thoracic cavity movement signal by using a filter to obtain a respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal, wherein the respiratory signal corresponds to a respiratory bandpass frequency of the filter, and the heartbeat signal corresponds to a heartbeat bandpass frequency of the filter; and performing joint time-frequency domain processing on the respiratory signal to obtain a respiratory frequency corresponding to the respiratory signal, and performing joint time-frequency domain processing and data statistical analysis on the heartbeat signal to obtain a heartbeat frequency corresponding to the heartbeat signal. The present disclosure solves the technical problem in the related art that in radar-based heartbeat and respiration detection methods, low accuracy of detection is caused by relaying only on a time domain characteristic or a frequency domain characteristic of a radar signal during analysis.

title_en: Radar system and radar signal processing method performed thereby
title_ko: 탑승객 감시 레이더 시스템 및 그에서 수행되는 레이더 신호처리방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a passenger monitoring radar system and a radar signal processing method performed therein. The method comprises the steps of: (a) removing, by a preprocessing unit, a fixed target included in a received signal and preprocessing to detect a biosignal which is a moving target; (b) storing, by a data buffer unit, the data preprocessed by the preprocessing unit and monitoring a power value of the signal; (c) detecting, by a multiple targets detection unit, multiple targets including the presence or absence of living things, 3D location information of the living things, and information on the number of living things through a multiple target detection signal processing process for the preprocessed data; and (d) detecting, by a biosignal detection unit, a biosignal including respiration and heart rate BPM of the living things. The present invention can remove the fixed object existing in a space to be detected, and detect the presence or absence of the living things, the 3D location information of the living things, the number of the living things, and biosignal information for each the living things.
abstract_ko: 탑승객 감시 레이더 시스템 및 그에서 수행되는 레이더 신호처리방법에 관한 것으로, (a) 전처리부에서 수신신호에 포함된 고정 표적을 제거하고, 이동 표적인 생체신호를 검출하도록 전처리하는 단계, (b) 데이터 버퍼부에서 상기 전처리부에 의해 전처리된 데이터를 저장하고 신호의 파워 값을 모니터링하는 단계, (c) 다중 표적 검출부에서 전처리된 데이터에 대한 다중 표적 검출 신호처리 과정을 거쳐 생명체의 존재 유무, 생명체의 3차원 위치정보 및 생명체의 수 정보를 포함하는 다중 표적을 검출하는 단계 및 (d) 생체신호 검출부에서 생명체의 호흡 및 심박 BPM을 포함하는 생체신호를 검출하는 단계를 포함하는 구성을 마련하여, 탐지하고자 하는 공간 내에 존재하는 고정 물체를 제거하고, 살아있는 생명체의 존재 유무, 생명체의 3차원 위치정보 및 생명체의 수 및 생명체별 생체신호 정보를 탐지할 수 있다.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring system for prevention of infectious disease
title_ko: 지능형 방역 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: An intelligent monitoring system for the prevention of infectious disease is disclosed. According to one aspect of the present invention, the intelligent monitoring system for the prevention of infectious disease includes: a user identification part; a radar sensor part; a radar signal analysis part; a data storage part; a receiving part; a virus confirmation user extraction part; a close contact user extraction part; and a transmitting part. Therefore, it is possible to monitor users of multi-use facilities in a non-contact manner.
abstract_ko: 지능형 방역 모니터링 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 측면에 따르면, 특정시설에 대한 모니터링의 개시 시각과 종료 시각을 입력 받아 이벤트 기간을 설정하는 이벤트기간설정부; 상기 특정시설에 입장하는 이용자의 신원 정보를 입력 받는 이용자신원확인부; 상기 특정시설 내에 초광대역 레이다 신호를 송출하고, 상기 특정시설 내에 있는 이용자에 의해 반사되어 돌아오는 초광대역 레이다 신호를 수신하는 레이다센서부; 상기 레이다센서부에 수신된 초광대역 레이다 신호를 분석하여 이용자의 위치 정보 및 생체 신호 정보를 생성하는 레이다신호분석부; 상기 레이다신호분석부에 의해 생성된 이용자의 위치 정보 및 생체 신호 정보를 상기 이용자신원확인부를 통해 입력 받은 이용자의 신원 정보와 매칭시켜 상기 이벤트기간설정부에 의해 설정된 이벤트 기간 별로 구분하여 저장하는 데이터저장부; 외부 서버로부터 바이러스 확진자의 신원 정보 및 전염 추정 시각을 수신하는 수신부; 상기 수신부에 수신된 정보와 상기 데이터저장부에 저장된 정보를 기초로 전염 추정 시각 이후의 이벤트 기간 중에 바이러스 확진자의 입장 여부를 확인하여 바이러스 확진 이용자를 추출하는 바이러스확진이용자추출부; 상기 데이터저장부에 저장된 정보를 기초로 바이러스 확진 이용자에게 기 설정된 거리 이내로 접근한 이력이 있는 밀접 접촉 이용자를 추출하는 밀접접촉이용자추출부; 및 상기 밀접접촉이용자추출부에 의해 추출된 밀접 접촉 이용자의 휴대용 단말기로 밀접 접촉 사실을 안내하는 메시지를 전송하는 송신부를 포함하고, 상기 데이터저장부는 바이러스 확진 정보를 이용자의 신원 정보와 매칭시켜 저장하고, 상기 바이러스확진이용자추출부는, 상기 데이터저장부에 저장된 이용자의 생체 신호 정보와 바이러스 확진 정보를 기초로 바이러스 확진 이용자의 생체 신호 특성을 머신러닝에 의해 학습하고, 상기 레이다신호분석부에 의해 생성된 이용자의 생체 신호 정보가 바이러스 확진 이용자의 생체 신호 특성을 나타내면 해당 이용자를 바이러스 확진 의심 이용자로 추출하는 것을 특징으로 하는 지능형 방역 모니터링 시스템이 제공될 수 있다.

title_en: Gully type debris flow monitoring and early warning method based on multiple sensors
abstract_en: The invention provides a gully-type debris flow monitoring and early warning method based on a multi-element sensor, which comprises a debris flow monitoring station, wherein the debris flow monitoring station consists of a sensor sensing system, a data acquisition and transmission system and a power supply and energy storage system, the debris flow monitoring station is arranged in a debris flow monitoring area, the debris flow monitoring station is provided with an upright post, the bottom end of the upright post is provided with a debris flow detection station foundation, the debris flow detection station foundation is buried in the debris flow monitoring area, the rear side middle part of the upright post is provided with a back water surface fluid viscometer, the upper left part of the upright post is provided with a data acquisition and transmission system, and the debris flow area monitored by the upright post is internally provided with a warning water level and a perennial water level. According to the invention, the sensor data and the camera shooting data information connected with the debris flow monitoring station are synchronously transmitted back to the background database, so that the data accumulation and the mastering of the site situation are realized, the dynamic monitoring and early warning of the occurrence of the debris flow can be realized, and the monitoring reliability is improved.

title_en: Method for measuring walking safety sense of streets at night in city
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for measuring the walking safety of streets at night in cities, which comprises the following steps: selecting a measure street; organizing a testee to perceive walking on the spot on the street at night; the testee carries a wearable dynamic vital sign monitor and a GPS positioning system; deriving a skin conductance response SCR value of the tested person during walking at night by wearing the dynamic vital sign monitor; calculating the peak value incidence rate of the SCR wake-up period of the testee, and then carrying out nonparametric inspection to judge whether the sensing data is effective or not; after the test is passed, calculating the SCR awakening peak value incidence rate of the unit period of the tested person; fusing GPS signals synchronously acquired by walking of a testee to generate an awakening hot spot map; performing emotion valence on the awakening hotspot to form a night fear hotspot map of the testee; and finally, performing nuclear density analysis on the hot spot map to obtain a night fear feeling thermal force distribution result, and realizing real-time measurement of the night safety feeling of the urban street.

title_en: Method for extracting vital sign signals based on full-phase fast Fourier transform
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for extracting vital sign signals based on full-phase fast Fourier transform, which solves the technical problem that the existing fast Fourier transform is difficult to obtain correct respiration heartbeat waveform, and comprises the following steps: the radar transmits and receives signals, and intermediate frequency digital signal data obtained by analog-to-digital conversion after echo frequency mixing is extracted; reconstructing the data to distinguish the speed time; carrying out full-phase data preprocessing on the data to obtain processed data; performing fast Fourier transform on the data after full-phase preprocessing, and selecting a frequency point corresponding to a target distance to perform phase solving; and extracting and connecting each snapshot phase to obtain the respiration heartbeat waveform. The invention can be widely applied to the non-contact radar monitoring of the vital signs of people.
assignees: BEIJING PHOSENSE ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mountain landslide monitoring sensor installation mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mountain landslide monitoring sensor installation mechanism, include: the mounting plate is provided with a rotating rod in a penetrating way; the driving motor is connected with one end of the rotating rod, which penetrates out of the mounting plate; the bevel gear box is arranged on the mounting plate; the bevel gear group is arranged in the bevel gear box; the sliding box is arranged at the bottom side of the bevel gear box; the screw rod is vertically and rotatably connected in the sliding box, and one end of the screw rod is in transmission connection with the bevel gear group; the sliding block can be arranged in the sliding box in a vertically sliding manner and is sleeved outside the screw rod in a threaded manner; the mounting column is arranged at the bottom side of the sliding block and penetrates through the bottom of the sliding box; the sensor shell is detachably arranged on the mounting column, and one end of the sensor shell is a conical tip; the bevel gear boxes are multiple; the rotating rod is in transmission connection with the bevel gear set. The utility model relates to a rationally, easy operation is easy, can accomplish the buried installation or the adjustment landfill degree of depth or the dismantlement of a plurality of massif landslide monitoring sensors through a dwang, effectively improves the adjustment efficiency of corresponding installation effectiveness, landfill degree of depth, dismantlement efficiency.
assignees: SICHUAN YATONG ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact respiration monitoring method based on doppler radar
abstract_en: A non-contact respiration monitoring method based on a Doppler radar. The method comprises: pre-processing a radar echo signal; extracting, from the radar echo signal, the position where the thorax of a monitored object is located; extracting motion information of the position where the thorax of the monitored object is located; extracting a respiration waveform component from the motion information of the thorax of the monitored object; and obtaining a respiration frequency of the monitored object on the basis of a corresponding spectrum estimation of the respiration waveform. The method for monitoring the thorax of an object has a higher positioning precision, and is a basis for accurately extracting a thoracic motion signal. A respiration signal is separated from a heartbeat signal by means of an improved CEEMD algorithm, such that a good separation effect is achieved on body motion interference, background noise and a vital sign signal, and the problem of an end effect in an original CEEMD algorithm is effectively ameliorated by means of an improvement, thereby increasing the decomposition speed.
assignees: NANJING ZHELI INTELLIGENT MANUFACTURING RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Life monitoring and rescuing device for cooperative robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooperative robot which belongs to the technical field of robots and comprises a cooperative robot arranged on a mobile robot, a vital sign monitoring device, an alarm rescue device and a main control device, wherein the vital sign monitoring device comprises a biological radar, the alarm rescue device and the main control device are arranged on the mobile robot, the mobile robot monitors that a target falls into the coverage range of the vital sign monitoring device through the vital sign monitoring device, the main control device makes a decision according to a signal uploaded by the vital sign monitoring device, positions the target according to a visual positioning device and starts the alarm rescue device to act, the alarm rescue device comprises a height adjusting component, a transverse moving mounting seat and a rescue bed component, the height of the cooperative robot is controlled through the height adjusting component, the extending length of the cooperative robot is controlled through the transverse moving adjusting component, and the cooperative robot is matched with the visual positioning device to control a grabbing piece to move the target to the rescue bed component.
assignees: CHUANGKE TIANXIA BEIJING TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Identity recognition method based on pulse ultra-wideband radar
abstract_en: The invention provides an identity recognition method based on a pulse ultra-wideband radar, belonging to the field of radar signal processing; after the pulse ultra-wideband radar acquires radar echo signals of a person to be tested, preprocessing is sequentially carried out, an energy concentration array and an energy concentration area are selected, sliding sections are carried out, and variation modal decomposition is carried out on each section to obtain heartbeat frequency and respiratory frequency information representing vital signs; and (3) forming the vital sign feature vectors of all the slices into an energy concentrated waveform, inputting the energy concentrated waveform into an identity recognition neural network, and respectively passing through an attention module, a convolution layer and a full connection layer of an encoder and a decoder to realize the identity recognition of the tested personnel. The invention can realize non-contact identity recognition, has no specific requirements on the behavior and action of detected personnel, uses various characteristics of heartbeat, respiration and posture, and has higher robustness.

title_en: Cognitive biological radar method and device for detecting human body posture and vital signs
abstract_en: The invention provides a cognitive biological radar method and a cognitive biological radar device for detecting human body postures and vital signs, and is applied to detecting the human body postures and the vital signs. The method is based on a perception and action cycle mechanism; the radar transmits waveforms of a certain group of parameters to a detection area, a receiving end collects reflected radar signals, the sensing target and the environment are calculated, the waveform parameters focusing more on the target to be detected in the environment are selected according to the optimization rule by minimizing the information entropy, and the transmitting end adjusts the waveform attribute of the next radar transmission in real time based on the sensing of the target and the environment. Taking the application to human body postures (fall, gesture recognition) and vital signs (respiration, heart shake, skin surface vibration caused by blood vessel pulse and the like) as an example, after the cognitive biological radar acquires radar echo data of a high-precision target and environment, the characteristic information of the acquired data is extracted through a data characteristic extraction module; and the data are transmitted into a deep learning classification module for classification; and transmitting the result to a result display module. The invention realizes the implementation and application of the cognitive biological radar technology, combines a deep learning model and realizes the high-precision detection of human body gestures, vital signs and the like.

title_en: Apparatus and method for radar sensor-based personal recognition
title_ko: 레이더 센서 기반 개인 인식 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a personal recognition device and method based on a radar sensor, which use a radar sensor, which is a non-contact sensor, to measure a heartbeat signal, which is one of the biosignals, and recognize an individual based on the measured heartbeat signal. To achieve the purpose, according to the present invention, the personal recognition device based on a radar sensor comprises: a sensor unit which obtains an individual's biosignals in a non-contact manner; a feature extraction unit which extracts feature information from the obtained biosignals; and a personal recognition unit which recognizes an individual using the extracted feature information.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 목적은 비접촉 센서인 레이더 센서를 이용하여 생체 신호 중에 하나인 심장박동 신호를 측정하고, 측정된 심장박동 신호를 기반으로 개인을 인식할 수 있도록 하는 레이더 센서 기반 개인 인식 장치 및 방법을 제공하는 것이다. 
상기 목적을 달성하기 위해, 본 발명에 따른 레이더 센서 기반 개인 인식 장치는, 비접촉 방식으로 개인의 생체 신호를 획득하는 센서부; 상기 획득한 생체 신호에서 특징 정보를 추출하는 특징 추출부; 상기 추출된 특징 정보를 이용하여 개인을 인식하는 개인 인식부;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: UNIV GACHON IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Bed with bio-signal measurement function and bio-signal monitoring system using the same
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정 기능을 갖는 침대 및 이를 이용한 생체 신호 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a bed having a bio-signal measurement function and a bio-signal monitoring system using the same. The bed having the bio-signal measurement function according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises: a sensor unit sensing a bio-signal of a user sleeping on a mattress of the bed; a signal analyzing unit analyzing the bio-signal sensed by the sensor unit and generating change trend information of the bio-signal; and an alarm warning unit alerting a user terminal of a danger related to a user's sleeping status by using the change trend information generated by the signal analyzing unit. Provided are the bed having the bio-signal measurement function capable of informing the danger, the bio-signal monitoring system using the same, and a method thereof.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 생체 신호 측정 기능을 갖는 침대는 침대의 매트리스에서 수면을 취하는 사용자의 생체 신호를 감지하는 센서부; 상기 센서부에 의해 감지된 상기 생체 신호를 분석하여 상기 생체 신호의 변화 추이 정보를 생성하는 신호 분석부; 및 상기 신호 분석부에 의해 생성된 상기 변화 추이 정보를 이용하여 사용자 단말기에 상기 사용자의 수면 상태와 관련한 위험성을 알람으로 경보하는 알람 경보부를 포함한다.

title_en: System and method for monitoring vital signs of animal in shelter
title_ko: 보호시설 내 동물의 생체 신호 모니터링 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a system for monitoring a biosignal of an animal in a shelter includes: a sensor unit installed in a shelter and detecting the biosignal of each animal accommodated in the shelter; a signal analyzer configured to analyze the biosignal detected by the sensor unit and generate change trend information of the biosignal; and an alarm unit for alerting at least one of a veterinarian terminal and an animal owner terminal with an alarm of a risk related to the health state of the animal by using the change trend information generated by the signal analyzer. Therefore, it is possible to efficiently manage the state of health of the animal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 보호시설 내 동물의 생체 신호 모니터링 시스템은 보호시설 내에 설치되고, 상기 보호시설 내에 수용된 동물들 각각의 생체 신호를 감지하는 센서부; 상기 센서부에 의해 감지된 상기 생체 신호를 분석하여 상기 생체 신호의 변화 추이 정보를 생성하는 신호 분석부; 및 상기 신호 분석부에 의해 생성된 상기 변화 추이 정보를 이용하여 수의사 단말기 및 동물 주인 단말기 중 적어도 하나에 상기 동물의 건강 상태와 관련한 위험성을 알람으로 경보하는 알람 경보부를 포함한다.

title_en: Blood pressure measurement system and method using radar sensor
title_ko: 레이더 센서를 이용한 비접촉식 혈압 측정 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a non-contact blood pressure measurement system using a radar sensor comprises: a sensor unit including a radar sensor that detects a bio signal of a blood pressure measurement target; a signal analyzing unit that analyzes a waveform of the bio signal sensed by the sensor unit; and a blood pressure measurement unit that extracts a blood pressure value of the blood pressure measurement target based on an analysis result of the waveform of the bio signal by the signal analyzing unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 레이더 센서를 이용한 비접촉식 혈압 측정 시스템은 혈압 측정 대상의 생체 신호를 감지하는 레이더 센서를 포함한 센서부; 상기 센서부에 의해 감지된 상기 생체 신호의 파형을 분석하는 신호 분석부; 및 상기 신호 분석부에 의한 상기 생체 신호의 파형의 분석 결과에 기초하여 상기 혈압 측정 대상의 혈압 값을 추출하는 혈압 측정부를 포함한다.

title_en: Position estimation device, position estimation method, and position estimation program
abstract_en: This invention is capable of estimating the three-dimensional position of a buried object using a set of two-dimensional ground penetrating radar data.　In this position estimation device, a candidate point extraction unit extracts buried object position candidate points from ground penetrating radar data that is two-dimensional data obtained through measurement of a buried object that is buried in the ground. A two-dimensional processing unit inputs the ground penetrating radar data into a recognition device that has been trained in advance to output a recognition score representing buried object likeness and outputs recognition scores representing the buried object likenesses corresponding to the candidate points. A three-dimensional integration unit integrates the ground penetrating radar data using a graph structure on the basis of the recognition scores and relative position information for the ground penetrating radar data and estimates the three-dimensional position of the buried object.

title_en: Leak detection system and method based on intelligent smart metering
title_ko: 지능형 스마트 미터링 기반 누수탐지시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to an intelligent smart metering based water leak detection device and a driving method thereof, remote management of water supply through a backbone network can be performed by linking an intelligent smart metering based water leakage sensor and a locking device with a wireless communication terminal system. In addition, without opening an index, a micro-electro mechanical system (MEMS) is used so that users can check whether there is an abnormal behavior of a pipe due to a leak signal in a specific area of a buried pipe, ground deformation around the pipe, water pressure imbalance in the pipe, external damage, etc. By linking the intelligent smart metering based water leakage sensor and locking device with the wireless communication terminal system, remote management of water supply through the backbone network can be performed. The intelligent smart metering based water leak detection system includes multiple meters, a corrosion detection module, a monitoring module, and a wireless communication terminal.
abstract_ko: 지능형 스마트 미터링 기반 누수탐지장치 및 그 구동방법은 지능형 스마트 미터링 기반 누수센서 및 잠금장치와 무선통신 단말 시스템을 연동함으로써, 기간망을 통한 상수도 원격 관리를 가능하게 한다. 또한, 지표를 개복하지 않고 MEMS(Micro-Electro Mechanical System)을 이용하여 지중에 매립된 관거의 특정 지역에서의 누수신호, 관로 주변의 지반 변형, 관로 내 수압 불균형, 외부 손상 등에 의한 관의 이상거동 여부를 확인할 수 있도록 하고, 지능형 스마트 미터링 기반 누수센서 및 잠금장치와 무선통신 단말 시스템을 연동함으로써, 기간망을 통한 상수도 원격 관리를 가능하게 한다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: Privacy-preserved User Context Prediction Method and System for Healthcare Services with Radar-based Contactless Biometric Monitoring System
title_ko: 레이더 기반 비접촉식 생체정보 모니터링 기반 1인가구용 헬스케어 서비스를 위한 프라이버시 보호형 사용자 상황 예측 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: A privacy-protection-type method of predicting a user situation for single-person household healthcare services using radar-based contactless biometric information monitoring, and a system therefor are suggested. The privacy-protection-type system of predicting a user situation for single-person household healthcare services using radar-based contactless biometric information monitoring, suggested in the present invention, comprises: a biometric signal collection unit which collects time-series biometric information of a user using a radar-based contactless biometric information measurement method; a privacy-protection-type data processing module which generates a plurality of pieces of characteristic data without additional privacy infringement on the user by performing a pre-processing process to extract feature points with respect to the collected time-series biometric information; and a radar-based biometric information monitoring system analysis module which selects characteristic data types to predict a situation of the user among the plurality of pieces of generated characteristic data and performs learning to predict the situation of the user using the pieces of selected characteristic data. According to the present invention, the method and system can efficiently analyze biometric information of users without privacy infringement.
abstract_ko: 레이더 기반 비접촉식 생체정보 모니터링 기반 1인가구용 헬스케어 서비스를 위한 프라이버시 보호형 사용자 상황 예측 방법 및 시스템이 제시된다. 본 발명에서 제안하는 레이더 기반 비접촉식 생체정보 모니터링 기반 1인가구용 헬스케어 서비스를 위한 프라이버시 보호형 사용자 상황 예측 시스템은 레이더 기반 비접촉 생체정보 측정 방식을 이용하여 사용자의 시계열 생체정보를 수집하는 생체 신호 수집부, 수집된 시계열 생체정보에 대하여 특징점 추출을 위한 전처리 과정의 수행을 통해 사용자에 대한 추가적인 프라이버시 침해가 없는 형태로 복수의 특징 데이터를 생성하는 프라이버시 보호형 데이터 처리 모듈 및 생성된 복수의 특징 데이터 중 사용자의 상황을 예측하기 위한 특징 데이터 종류들을 선정하고, 선정된 특징 데이터들을 이용하여 사용자의 상황을 예측하기 위한 학습을 수행하는 레이더 기반 생체 정보 모니터링 시스템 분석 모듈을 포함한다.

title_en: Emergency situation detection system in private space based on Thermal array sensor
title_ko: 열상감지 센서 기반 사생활 공간에서의 위급상황 감지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides an emergency detection system in a private space, capable of accurately detecting emergency while minimizing exposure of privacy based on a thermal array sensor. The emergency detection system in the private space comprises: the thermal array sensor for detecting an object in a detection area in which privacy protection is required; a vibration sensor sensing the magnitude of vibration in the detection area; a respiration sensor detecting a respiration pattern of the object when the object sensed by the thermal array sensor is a person; a smart hub relaying data between the thermal array sensor, the vibration sensor, and the respiration sensor, and an analysis server; and the analysis server individually receiving sensing data of the vibration sensor, sensing data of the respiration sensor, and an image photographed by the thermal array sensor and determining the emergency while detecting a predetermined movement pattern of the predetermined object by being applied with a convolutional neural network (CNN) algorithm.
abstract_ko: 사생활 공간에서의 위급상황 감지 시스템은, 사생활 보호가 필요한 감지영역에서 객체를 검출하기 위한 열상감지 센서와, 감지영역에서의 진동크기를 감지하는 진동감지센서와, 열상감지 센서에서 감지된 객체가 사람일 경우, 객체의 호흡패턴을 검출하는 호흡감지센서와, 열상감지 센서, 진동감지센서 및 호흡감지센서와 분석서버의 사이에서 데이터를 중계하는 스마트 허브와, 진동감지센서의 감지 데이터, 호흡감지센서의 감지 데이터 및 열상감지 센서에서 촬영된 영상을 각각 수신하고 컨벌루션 뉴럴 네트워크(Convolutional Neural Network, CNN) 알고리즘을 적용하여 미리 설정된 객체의 설정된 움직임 패턴을 검출하면서 위급상황을 판단하는 분석서버를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Ambient-light seal with integrated dry electrodes for electrical vital signs measurements
abstract_en: A wearable device (10) for individual health assessment measurement of vital signs comprises a housing (16), an optical sensor/emitter assembly (18), a controller (20), and a light seal (12). The optical sensor/emitter assembly emits optical signals from a bottom surface (22) of the housing through skin of a subject and receives reflected optical signals. The controller (20) controls a physiological measurement modality of the wearable device in the measurement of the vital signs and is coupled to the optical sensor/emitter assembly (18) for controlling the optical sensor/emitter assembly. The light seal (12) is configured to be removably coupled with the skin of the subject and to prevent ambient light interference with the optical sensor/emitter assembly when coupled. The light seal (12) comprises at least one integrated dry electrode (14) for transmitting and/or receiving electrical signals to/from the skin of the subject. Each integrated dry electrode (14) is electrically coupled to the controller (20) for obtaining electrical measurements according to the physiological measurement modality.

title_en: Wireless detection device for slope safety
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of safety detection, and discloses a wireless side slope safety detection device, which comprises a detection assembly pre-embedded in the slope surface of a slope body, an installation seat fixed on the ground and positioned at one side of the slope body, and an external remote control terminal, wherein the detection assembly comprises a plurality of parallel steel stranded wires and a plurality of photosensitive sensors equidistantly arranged on the steel stranded wires; this wireless detection device of side slope safety, through set up a plurality of photosensitive sensor in the domatic inside of side slope, when domatic production landslide phenomenon soon, domatic at first can produce the crack, can give central processing unit with signal transmission when pre-buried photosensitive sensor perception in domatic inside light, central processing unit at first starts the on-the-spot warning subassembly and carries out the police dispatch newspaper to the scene, prevent that the side slope is gone into to the field personnel mistake, central processing unit is giving remote control terminal with information transfer through wireless communication module simultaneously, so that the professional in time handles the side slope.
assignees: HENAN ZHONGGU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Display equipment control method based on human body recognition and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a display equipment control method based on human body recognition and related equipment; the method comprises the following steps: for the display equipment in a preset first working state, detecting whether a human body exists at a preset target position by using a preset millimeter wave radar; collecting postures of the human body by using a millimeter wave radar in response to the determination that the human body is detected at the target position, judging whether the postures are preset target postures by using a pre-trained neural network model, monitoring vibration of the human body by using the millimeter wave radar in response to the determination that the postures are the target postures, judging whether the human body is in a preset target state according to the vibration, and adjusting the display equipment to be in a preset second working state in response to the determination that the human body is in the target state, wherein the vibration of the human body comprises displacement changes of the thoracic cavity caused by heartbeat and respiration; in response to determining that no human presence is detected at the target location, the display device is adjusted to a second operating state.

title_en: Vibration subsidence in-situ dynamic test bed for foundation soil and test method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vibration sinking in-situ dynamic test bed of foundation soil and a test method thereof. In the in-situ test field, a horizontal vibration load is applied to the soil body of the lower foundation through a vibration table, and dynamic response of the foundation soil is measured by sensors buried at different positions to reflect the seismic subsidence deformation of the soil body. At present, the vibration sinking test of soil comprises a dynamic single shear, dynamic triaxial and dynamic torsional shear indoor test method, but no mature method exists for the field in-situ vibration sinking test of foundation soil. A method for testing dynamic response and vibration subsidence deformation of foundation soil is provided by the vibration effect of a vibrator on an in-situ soil column on site, and a soil dynamics test method is filled. The method for measuring the acceleration response and the seismic subsidence deformation of the foundation soil under the in-situ condition has good practical significance for disaster prevention and control.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar device for sensing vital signs
abstract_en: A millimeter wave radar device for sensing vital signs comprises a microprocessor, a millimeter wave radar and an electrocardiogram machine; the millimeter wave radar is configured to sense a human body to obtain a plurality of wireless vital sign signals; the microprocessor is configured to receive the plurality of wireless vital sign signals; the electrocardiograph is configured to sense the human body to obtain a plurality of wired vital sign signals; the microprocessor is configured to receive the plurality of wired vital sign signals; after the microprocessor receives the plurality of wireless vital sign signals and the plurality of wired vital sign signals, the microprocessor is configured to output the plurality of wireless vital sign signals and the plurality of wired vital sign signals.

title_en: Expansive soil slope seepage instability prediction method, system and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of landslide monitoring and early warning, in particular to a method, a system and terminal equipment for predicting osmotic instability of an expansive soil slope, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining key factors of the instability of the expansive soil slope; based on the key factors, an expansive soil slope instability model is established; calculating to obtain a critical state value of the instability of the expansive soil slope based on the instability model of the expansive soil slope; obtaining the displacement change rate of the expansive soil through a sensor pre-buried in the expansive soil; judging a target instability risk interval and a target expansion displacement grade of the expansion soil side slope according to the expansion soil displacement change rate and the critical state value; and obtaining a prediction result of the osmotic instability of the expansive soil slope according to the target instability risk interval and the target expansion displacement level. And the target risk interval and the target expansion displacement level are combined, the stability of the expansive soil slope is judged, and the judgment result is more accurate.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring system based on millimeter waves
