abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign monitoring system based on millimeter waves; the system comprises a control module, wherein a first driving module is electrically connected to the control module, a millimeter wave radar module is electrically connected to the first driving module, a transmitting antenna and a receiving antenna are electrically connected to the millimeter wave radar module, a data information processing module is electrically connected to the millimeter wave radar module, a phase measurement module is electrically connected to the data information processing module, and the phase measurement module is electrically connected to the control module; the invention realizes the detection of the vital signs of the human body through the millimeter wave radar module, the reflected signals are phase-modulated due to the motion of the chest, the receiving signals and the sending signals are combined through the frequency mixer to generate an Intermediate Frequency (IF) signal, the phase is calculated, the subsequent data information is calculated and processed, the information accuracy of the data is improved, and the detection result is calibrated through the phase measurement module.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring method and system based on terahertz radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue equipment, in particular to a method and a system for monitoring vital signs based on a terahertz radar, which comprise a radar subsystem, a power supply subsystem, a monitoring subsystem and a transportation subsystem, wherein the radar subsystem comprises a flight module, an installation module, a radar module and a positioning module, the transportation subsystem transports the radar subsystem and the monitoring subsystem to a disaster area place, the flight module drives the radar module to automatically carry out multidirectional detection on the disaster area place, so that life bodies under ruins are detected, radar signals are obtained, and the positioning module carries out positioning marking on an area with the life bodies to obtain a marked area; the monitoring subsystem receives the radar signal, converts the radar signal into detection image display to based on the regional command rescue personnel of mark and go to the rescue, the radar module of this system need not the rescue personnel and carries, and it is more convenient than traditional detection device that attaches on the back to rescue.
assignees: CHENGDU WUWEI JICHUANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source disaster situation data online fusion processing method and hollow unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for multi-source disaster data online fusion processing and a hollow unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method is applied to the hollow unmanned aerial vehicle, mobile phone signals are acquired at a plurality of specified sampling points in a target damaged area according to a search instruction issued by a ground command system, and preliminary mobile phone signal data are acquired; correcting the preliminary mobile phone signal data according to the offset vector sequence of each screened target sampling object; generating a primary judgment result of the buried point according to each corrected position and the position of each building target in the target damaged area; guiding the low-altitude airspace unmanned aerial vehicle to perform radar scanning in a multi-point observation mode based on the positions of the building buried points in the buried point initial judgment result; the target positioning result uploaded by the low-altitude airspace unmanned aerial vehicle is received, the target positioning result and the primary judgment result of the buried point are fused to form a buried point search result, and the buried point search result is transmitted back to the ground command system, so that disaster area emergency rescue can be efficiently and accurately carried out.
assignees: NAT EARTHQUAKE RESPONSE SUPPORT SERVICE;UNIV XIDIAN

title_en: Deeply buried underground pipeline detection equipment
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of pipeline surveys, especially, bury pipeline detection equipment deeply, which comprises a mounting bracket, the mounting bracket bottom is provided with lifting mechanism, and lifting mechanism including install on the mounting bracket inner wall electric telescopic handle, fixed connection in electric telescopic handle piston rod outer wall on the mount, install the detection radar on the mount inner wall. The utility model discloses an install on one can the equipment that slides together detection radar and display screen, just can accomplish the work that the underground pipeline surveyed alone, the labour has been saved, simultaneously through the brake mechanism who sets up, the security of equipment has been improved, and the operation is simple, high durability and convenient use, when there is higher barrier in the road surface, staff's accessible control electric telescopic handle drives the detection radar rebound, not only can avoid the barrier to influence the detection result who surveys the radar, can also increase the protective effect who surveys the radar.
assignees: SICHUAN QIAOJIAN ENG DETECTION CO LTD

title_en: Water-containing soil buried environment multi-source search and rescue equipment test dummy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a test dummy system for multisource search and rescue equipment in a buried environment containing water and soil, which is formed by matching a main dummy body and a dummy vital sign simulation system arranged in the dummy body, wherein the dummy vital sign simulation system comprises a central control unit, a power supply unit, a breathing unit, a whole body temperature unit, an acoustic unit, a vibration unit, a trace gas secretion unit and a breathing thorax movement unit; the scheme provided by the invention has the characteristics of simulating dynamic respiration, typical expiration, gas secretion, sound, vibration, body temperature and the like of a human body under various life states under disaster conditions, has strong environmental adaptability and comprehensive simulation capability, and can meet the requirement of comprehensive efficiency test of water-bearing life search and rescue equipment.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Millimeter wave radar apparatus determining vital sign
abstract_en: A millimeter wave radar apparatus determining a vital sign includes a microprocessor, a millimeter wave radar and an electrocardiogram machine. The millimeter wave radar is configured to detect a human body to obtain a plurality of wireless vital-sign signals. The microprocessor is configured to receive the wireless vital-sign signals. The electrocardiogram machine is configured to detect the human body to obtain a plurality of wired vital-sign signals. The microprocessor is configured to receive the wired vital-sign signals. After the microprocessor receives the wireless vital-sign signals and the wired vital-sign signals, the microprocessor is configured to output the wireless vital-sign signals and the wired vital-sign signals.

title_en: High safe type radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the radar detection instrument technique and specifically relates to a high safe type radar life detection instrument, including the mounting bracket main part, the inboard fixedly connected with dead lever of mounting bracket main part, the top of mounting bracket main part is equipped with the battery, the inboard swing joint of dead lever has the telescopic link, the top fixedly connected with installation piece of telescopic link, the top fixedly connected with locking ring of dead lever, the external thread groove has been seted up in the outside of locking ring, the one end of installation piece is connected with the universal joint, the one end of universal joint is connected with the platform, the bumper shock absorber is installed to the bottom of dead lever, the base is installed to the bottom of bumper shock absorber, the utility model discloses in, through setting up telescopic link, external thread groove, universal joint, tong-jaw, a section of thick bamboo and platform soon to the realization supports the adjustment that different height carries out radar detection angle to four angles of detection instrument, shortens search and rescue time, improves search and rescue efficiency.
assignees: LVCHUANG WUHAN NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Radar and infrared combined composite life detector packaging structure
abstract_en: The utility model provides a radar and infrared combined composite life detection instrument packaging structure, which comprises a base, a first cover body, a second cover body, a radar unit and an infrared unit; the first cover body is hollow, a first opening is formed in one side face of the first cover body, and the side face is connected with the base in a sealing mode through the first opening; a second opening is arranged on one end face of the first cover body; the end part of the second cover body is connected with the first cover body in a sealing way, and the non-end part position of the second cover body and the first cover body is arranged in a clearance way; the radar unit is arranged on the end face of one side, close to the first cover body, of the base; the infrared unit is embedded in the first cover body at the second opening; through optimizing the inner structure of first lid and base for at the inside rational overall arrangement radar detection device and the infrared detection device of hand-held apparatus, satisfied the requirement of miniaturization, the portability of equipment, single use of specially adapted calamity or accident rescue scene.
assignees: WUHAN XINLANG PHOTOELECTRIC TECH CO LTD;HUAXIA CHUANGWEI BEIJING SAFETY PREVENTION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;BEIJING LSJ TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting smoke-sensing alarm
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fire control smoke detector alarm, including pre-buried box, the bottom surface of pre-buried box is provided with the smoke detector cover, the bottom surface intercommunication of smoke detector cover sets firmly the cooperation cover, the bottom surface port intercommunication of cooperation cover sets firmly the collar, a plurality of flashing lamps are evenly installed to the bottom surface of collar, the collar has set firmly the installation section of thick bamboo, the installation section of thick bamboo is located the cooperation cover, the top surface port of installation section of thick bamboo is internal fixed mounting has the mounting bracket, the mid-mounting of mounting bracket has smoke alarm sensor, the fixed mounting has the cross in the bottom surface port of installation section of thick bamboo, the mid-mounting of cross has the smoke detector speaker; an oval connecting plate is fixedly arranged on the inner top surface of the embedded box, and a mounting assembly is arranged between the oval connecting plate and the smoke sensing cover. The utility model discloses a setting of installation component not only is convenient for install and dismantle the alarm is felt to the fire control cigarette, easy operation does benefit to the popularization moreover.
assignees: ANHUI YUNHAI ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact blood pressure monitoring method based on frequency modulation continuous wave radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a frequency-modulated continuous wave radar-based non-contact blood pressure monitoring method, which belongs to the field of non-contact vital sign detection and specifically comprises the following steps: firstly, an echo signal from a chest of a human body to be detected is collected by a frequency modulation continuous wave radar, then a heart rate value of a human body target is detected through variational modal decomposition, relocation is carried out in an interval by a pulse wave extraction method based on heart rate guidance to obtain a pulse wave signal with smaller interference, different modes are screened by taking the heart rate as a standard through VMD decomposition and then added, the interference of respiration and slight body movement on the pulse wave signal is removed, a relatively pure effective pulse wave signal waveform is obtained based on heart rate recovery, then time characteristics related to blood pressure are extracted from the waveform, a blood pressure estimation model is constructed, and the period of heart contraction and expansion is extracted for blood pressure prediction. The non-contact continuous blood pressure monitoring algorithm provided by the invention can accurately and robustly realize blood pressure estimation and provides possibility for realizing long-term real-time non-contact blood pressure monitoring.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and storage medium for monitoring driving state of driver
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for monitoring the driving state of a driver, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a millimeter wave radar field of view, and identifying a distance range corresponding to a detected human body target in the radar field of view; correcting direct current offset in a distance range corresponding to a human body, unlocking an arc tangent demodulation phase and extracting a differential phase signal; separating the heartbeat and the respiration of the differential phase signal and reconstructing heartbeat and respiration signals; based on the reconstructed heartbeat and respiratory signals, estimating and calculating the heartbeat and respiratory frequency by using a frequency domain FFT algorithm and a time domain autocorrelation algorithm, and further estimating the vital signs. The method is suitable for human body vital sign detection, measures vital signs to determine the health level of a person, and can be used as early warning information of potential health problems of drivers.
assignees: INTERSECT INFORMATION CORE TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE XIAN CO LTD

title_en: Television anti-addiction method and system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a television anti-addiction method and a system based on a millimeter wave radar, wherein human body vital sign information of watching a television is collected through the millimeter wave radar, the current audience watching the television is judged, and different anti-addiction conditions and anti-addiction measures are set, so that the anti-addiction effect can be effectively realized, and the specific conditions can be flexibly processed; in another aspect, the present invention provides a system comprising: the system comprises a television, a television controller, a millimeter wave radar, a cloud system and an anti-addiction evaluation module. The method and the system provided by the invention can not collect image information and have good privacy; and the anti-addiction effect is good without being influenced by light rays and facial shielding.
assignees: SICHUAN HONGMEI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Healthcare system reflecting IoT and AI service design using data communication-based village broadcasting device
title_ko: 데이터 통신기반 마을방송장치를 이용한 IoT 및 AI서비스 설계반영의 헬스 케어 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a healthcare system based on data communication which transmits and receives data between a village broadcasting device and a data communication server and at least one home IoT linking device based on a binary-CDMA communication network. The home IoT linking device comprises: a sensor module which senses biometric signals of a user, risk signals such as gas and fires, and activity signals for managing dying alone of the user; a B-CDMA module which receives a village broadcasting or disaster broadcasting from the village broadcasting device using the binary-CDMA communication network and transmits a message data of the user or the sensing data sensed through the sensor module; and a broadcasting output module which is provided to output the village broadcasting transmitted from the village broadcasting device. Accordingly, the system understands emergencies and accidents occurring each home in real time to rapidly deal with emergencies and accidents of each home.
abstract_ko: Binary-CDMA 통신망을 기반으로 마을방송 장치 및 데이터 통신 서버와 적어도 하나의 홈 IoT 연동 장치 간에 데이터를 송수신하는 데이터 통신 기반 헬스 케어 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 상기 홈 IoT 연동 장치는 사용자의 생체 신호, 가스 및 화재 등의 위험 신호, 사용자의 고독사를 관리하기 위한 활동 신호를 감지하는 센서 모듈, 상기 Binary-CDMA 통신망을 이용하여 마을방송 장치로부터 마을방송 또는 재난방송을 수신하고, 사용자의 메시지 데이터 또는 상기 센서 모듈을 통해 감지된 센싱 데이터를 송신하기 위해 마련된 B-CDMA 모듈, 상기 마을방송 장치로부터 전송된 마을방송을 출력하기 위해 마련된 방송 출력 모듈을 포함하며, 각 가정에서 발생하는 위급 상황 및 사고 내용을 실시간으로 파악하여 각 가정의 위급 상황 및 재난사고에 신속하게 대처할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for determining a distance for measuring vital sign based on spatial phase coherency
title_ko: 공간적 위상 코히어런시에 기반한 활력 징후 측정 거리 결정 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device and method for determining a vital sign measurement distance based on spatial phase coherency. According to the present invention, the method for determining a distance for measuring vital signs comprises the steps of: receiving a reflected signal through radar; determining a phase signal based on the reflected signal; determining coherency between phase signals for a first distance and a second distance, which are a distance pair selected from among a plurality of distances, using the phase signals determined for each distance; and determining a distance for measuring vital signs based on the coherency. According to the present invention, by utilizing a spatial phase coherency index, which quantifies the inter-phase coherency in a pair of different range bins, the pair of range bins with the highest index value is selected as a distance for vital sign detection, so more accurate vital signs can be measured compared to conventional methods.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 공간적 위상 코히어런시에 기반한 활력 징후 측정 거리 결정 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면, 활력 징후 측정을 위한 거리를 결정하는 방법에 있어서, 레이더를 통해 반사된 신호를 수신하는 단계; 상기 반사된 신호에 기초하여 위상 신호를 결정하는 단계; 복수의 거리 별 결정된 위상 신호를 이용하여 상기 복수의 거리 중에서 선택된 거리 쌍인 제1 거리 및 제2 거리에 대한 위상 신호 사이의 코히어런시를 결정하는 단계; 및 상기 코히어런시에 기초하여 활력 징후 측정을 위한 거리를 결정하는 단계를 포함한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 한 쌍의 서로 다른 범위 빈에서의 위상 간 코히어런시를 정량화하는 공간적 위상 코히어런시 지수를 활용하여, 가장 높은 지수 값을 가지는 한 쌍의 범위 빈을 활력 징후 탐지를 위한 거리로 선택함으로써, 종래의 방법들에 비하여 더욱 정확한 활력 징후가 측정될 수 있다.

title_en: Information detection method and apparatus for indoor object, and storage medium and processor
abstract_en: An information detection method and apparatus for an indoor object, and a storage medium and a processor. The method comprises: collecting target data information of an indoor target object by means of a target detection device (S101), wherein the target data information at least comprises vital sign information and behavior information of the target object, and the target detection device comprises a radar monitoring device, which does not need to be worn by the target object, and a vital sign monitoring device, which is worn by the target object; analyzing behavioral state information of the target object on the basis of the target data information (S102); and displaying the behavioral state information of the target object on a display interface (S103). The problem in the related art of an information detection effect for an indoor person being poor is solved.

title_en: Portable vital sign monitoring devices
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable vital sign monitoring device, which comprises a radar sign detection module, a camera auxiliary positioning module, a cardio-pulmonary health evaluation and display early warning module and an operation environment monitoring module, wherein the radar sign detection module is used for transmitting electromagnetic waves and receiving echo signals and judging the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency of a person according to the echo signals, the camera auxiliary positioning module realizes target positioning operation, the cardio-pulmonary health evaluation and display early warning module further processes and analyzes the heartbeat and respiratory information separated by the radar sign detection module to provide reference for judging the health of cardio-pulmonary functions, and the operation environment monitoring module is used for judging the air quality of an operation environment and early warning and displaying dangerous conditions. The device can be used for monitoring vital signs of soldiers, disaster relief personnel and injured people in the scenes of battlefields, disaster areas and the like, can be used for monitoring the vital signs of the soldiers, the disaster relief personnel and the injured people, can also be used for monitoring the vital signs of surrounding people, has a sign abnormal alarm signal and guides rescue work.

title_en: Safe efficient energy storage container
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a container technical field, concretely relates to safe efficient energy storage container has the battery compartment, and the battery compartment array is equipped with a plurality of battery clusters, and the side is equipped with the side door corresponding to a plurality of battery clusters around the battery compartment, and the left side of battery compartment is connected with the explosion vent, and the right side separate connection of battery compartment has fire control cabinet and distribution to converge the cabinet. The utility model discloses cut apart and be equipped with battery cabin and electric cabin, both all adopt non-step-in layout design, separate electric cabin as safe operation district, do benefit to the fire control and put out a fire, cool down, exhaust, let out and explode for the system is safer, and energy density is higher. The fireproof partition wall is a double-layer steel plate clamped with fireproof rock wool, and the fire resistance limit is not less than 2h. The fire-fighting pipeline and the through-wall hole of the cable on the partition wall are blocked by steel plates and fire-proof mud, so that combustible gas generated by thermal runaway of the left battery compartment is prevented from spreading to the right electric compartment, and the electric equipment is prevented from arcing, lighting and igniting to explode.
assignees: Jiangsu tianhe energy storage co ltd

title_en: Radio Frequency Life Detection Radar System
abstract_en: Trapped or confined individuals may be located and rescued by detecting their movement using reflected, radio frequency signals over a range of multiple antenna polarities.

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign detection method based on a millimeter wave radar. The method comprises the steps of emitting linear frequency modulation continuous wave FMCW, obtaining original data after frequency mixing is carried out on echo signals, and forming the original data into a first matrix comprising a fast time dimension and a slow time dimension; performing one-dimensional fast Fourier transform on the first matrix to obtain a corresponding second matrix; then, carrying out static filtering operation on the second matrix to obtain a fourth matrix; performing unwrapping operation on the distance unit for judging the existence of the human body target in the fourth matrix; judging the vital sign of the human body target from the unwrapped phase signal; extracting corresponding chest wall displacement signals from the distance units of the human body targets with vital signs; and reconstructing the chest wall displacement-time signal to acquire accurate vital signs of the human target. Compared with the prior art, the invention improves the monitoring accuracy of the human heart rate respiration, and well reduces the calculated amount in the detection process so as to improve the capability of quick response.

title_en: Terahertz wave plethysmography
abstract_en: Terahertz wave plethysmography provides a new principle of radar-based vital sign detection. This disclosure presents new applications at terahertz (THz) frequency band for non-contact cardiac sensing. For the first time, cardiac pulse information is shown to be simultaneously extracted based on two established principles using unique THz waves. A novel concept of Terahertz-Wave-Plethysmography (TPG) is introduced, which detects blood volume changes in the upper dermis tissue layer by measuring the reflectance of THz waves, similar to the existing remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) principle. A detailed analysis of pulse measurement using THz is provided. The TPG principle is justified by scientific deduction and carefully designed experimental demonstrations. Additionally, pulse measurements from various peripheral body regions of interest (ROIs), including palm, inner elbow, temple, fingertip, and forehead, are demonstrated using a novel ultra-wideband (UWB) THz sensing system.
assignees: RONG YU;THEOFANOPOULOS PANAGIOTIS;TRICHOPOULOS GEORGIOS;BLISS DANIEL W;UNIV ARIZONA STATE

title_en: Fire scene rescue fire-fighting equipment with high temperature resistance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire scene rescue fire-fighting equipment of high temperature resistance, including rescue module shell, rescue module door and window and jet, the bottom of rescue module shell all is provided with bearing structure, and the top of jet is provided with detection mechanism, and the display screen is installed to one side of mounting panel, and one side of display screen is provided with crashproof structure. The utility model discloses a high definition digtal camera feeds back the condition around the scene of the conflagration position in real time to controlling personnel, thermal infrared imager can simulate out the spatial distribution by scanning object surface temperature completely simultaneously, and be used for the line to dodge or puncture on electronic system handles the formation thermal image transmission display screen, then ultra-wide spectrum radar life detection instrument detects human life activity, be convenient for confirm stranded personnel position fast, the detection locate function of this device has been realized from this, the functionality of this device has been improved, improve the speed of location, be convenient for in time rescue stranded personnel, the casualty rate is reduced.
assignees: ZHONGZHEN KEJIAN GUANGDONG DISASTER PREVENTION AND MITIGATION RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent monitoring wearable system based on electrical impedance imaging
abstract_en: The utility model provides an intelligent monitoring wearable system based on electrical impedance imaging, which relates to the technical field of bioelectrical impedance monitoring, and comprises wearable equipment and a cloud server which are in communication connection; wearable equipment includes wearable overcoat, sensor module, control module, power module, and sensor module, control module and power module all are connected with the wearable shell, and sensor module and control module all are connected with the power module electricity, and sensor module is connected with the control module electricity, and control module is connected with cloud service communication. The system has the functions of noninvasive and remote monitoring of vital signs of patients with infectious diseases and critical diseases, uploading data to a cloud platform by using the internet technology, and providing remote interpretation and guidance for a doctor.

title_en: Method for specifying coherent noise and method for detecting position of buried pipe
abstract_en: To specify coherent noise included in a reflected wave in an underground radar.SOLUTION: A background component is obtained by a moving average of a plurality of cross-sectional images obtained while an underground exploration radar is moved. A background-removed component is obtained by removing the background component from the cross-sectional image. With an intermediate frequency between a peak frequency of a frequency spectrum of the background component and a peak frequency of the frequency spectrum of the background-removed component as a boundary, coherent noise is specified based on a magnitude relation of power before and after the intermediate frequency in the frequency spectrum of the cross-sectional image.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Small non-contact human body vital sign detection device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a small non-contact human body vital sign detection device, which comprises a signal processing and transmitting module, a binary power divider, a transmitting antenna, a receiving antenna, an amplitude-phase comparator, a terminal module and a wireless module; the signal processing and transmitting module is used for transmitting a microwave signal with set frequency; the power divider is used for receiving microwave signals and dividing the microwave signals into two paths, one path is transmitted through a transmitting antenna, and the other path of signals is transmitted to the amplitude-phase comparator; the receiving antenna is used for receiving the reflected modulation signal and sending the modulation signal to the amplitude-phase comparator; the amplitude-phase comparator is used for comparing the amplitude difference and the phase difference of the two paths of signals and sending the signals to the signal processing and transmitting module, and the signal processing and transmitting module respectively sends the signals to the terminal module for displaying and sends the signals to the wireless module for uploading to the cloud. The device has the advantages of detecting the vital signs of the human body in a non-contact manner, extracting the respiration heartbeat signal, visualizing the data and reducing the complexity of the system and the data processing difficulty.

title_en: Rotatable distributed radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotatable distributed radar life detection instrument, which comprises two radar units with rotating devices, wherein a telescopic rod is connected between the two rotating devices, and each rotating device comprises an upper base, an upper rotating shaft, a bearing, a lower base, a lower rotating shaft, a damping rotating shaft, a rotating shaft cover plate and a contact switch; the upper base and the lower base clamp the shell of the radar unit; the upper rotating shaft is arranged in the upper base, and a bearing is sleeved outside the upper rotating shaft; the lower rotating shaft is arranged in the lower base and is fixedly connected with the upper rotating shaft; the tail end of the lower rotating shaft is provided with a damping rotating shaft and a rotating shaft cover plate; the electric shock switches are arranged on the periphery of the lower rotating shaft; the upper rotating shaft is fixedly connected with the telescopic rod.

title_en: Localized triggering of human activity analysis
abstract_en: The present description relates to determining human activity in an environment (ENV) in which at least one sensor is configured to measure a parameter relating to human activity. This process comprises: - providing a device for detecting a human presence in the environment (GW, TV, BB1, PRN, BB2), and - activating the sensor (C11, C12, C13) if a human presence has been detected in the environment (RO1).

title_en: System and method for detecting vital signs using imaging-assisted radar
title_ko: 촬영 보조형 레이더를 이용한 생체 신호 검출 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for detecting vital signs using imaging-assisted radar. The system for detecting vital signs according to an embodiment comprises: an imaging part for imaging an object; at least one radar transmission part for transmitting radar signals to the object; at least two radar reception parts for receiving radar signals reflected on different body parts of the object, respectively; and a processing part for detecting vital signs having noise, which is caused by the movement of the object, using weight for each body part of the object and the radar signals reflected on different body parts. According to an embodiment, noise caused by the movement of an object can be actively removed by the assistance of an imaging device, thereby improving the accuracy of detecting vital signs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 촬영 보조형 레이더를 이용한 생체 신호 검출 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 일 실시예에 따른 생체 신호 검출 시스템은, 대상을 촬영하기 위한 촬영부; 상기 대상을 향해 레이더 신호를 송신하기 위한 적어도 하나의 레이더 송신부; 상기 대상의 서로 다른 신체부위에서 반사된 레이더 신호를 각각 수신하기 위한 적어도 두 개의 레이더 수신부; 및 대상의 신체부위별 가중치와 서로 다른 신체부위에서 반사된 레이더 신호를 이용하여, 상기 대상의 움직임에 의한 노이즈가 제거된 생체 신호를 검출하는 처리부를 포함한다. 실시예에 따르면 촬영장치의 보조를 통해 대상의 움직임에 의한 노이즈를 능동적으로 제거함으로써 생체 신호의 검출 정확도를 향상시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Continuous wave life detection radar
abstract_en: The application provides a continuous wave life detection radar, this continuous wave life detection radar includes: the frequency synthesizer module is used for generating a linear frequency modulation radio frequency signal; an antenna for transmitting and receiving radio frequency signals; a circulator for connecting the transmitter, the receiver and the antenna; the antenna radiates amplified linear frequency modulation radio frequency signals outwards according to the fixed directivity of the circulator; and the radio frequency cancellation module is used for isolating the transmitter and the receiver. The ultra-wideband radar signal receiving and transmitting are realized by adopting a linear frequency modulation continuous wave system, the coherent processing of the radar is realized, and the detection distance and the resolution of the radar can be further improved. The single antenna is used for realizing the receiving and transmitting of the radar, and has the characteristics of small volume, light weight and the like. And the circulator is adopted to realize the isolation of the emitting electrode and the receiver, and a radio frequency cancellation scheme is further adopted to realize better receiving and transmitting isolation, thereby being more beneficial to improving the detection performance of the radar. The radar is provided with a plurality of devices for networking, and three-dimensional or higher-precision life detection is realized.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact sensing of vital signs
abstract_en: Methods, apparatus, systems, and articles of manufacture are disclosed for non-contact sensing of vital signs. An example electronic device to measure vital signs includes a camera to capture an image; a radar antenna to transmit and receive radar signals; and processing circuitry to: identify a subject in the image; identify a location of the subject in an environment; control the radar antenna to steer the radar signals toward the location; and determine a vital sign of the subject based on a reflected radar signal.

title_en: fire suppression system for electric vehicles in charging
title_ko: 충전중 전기자동차 화재진압 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire extinguishing system for an electric vehicle in charging which can effectively extinguish a fire by preventing thermal runaway to prevent the fire from being transferred to other cells of a battery. The fire extinguishing system for an electric vehicle in charging comprises: fire water injection parts separated from each other, buried and installed on a floor surface on which an electric vehicle in charging connected to a charger is positioned, and provided with a fine spray nozzle with a head installed to face the bottom surface of the electric vehicle; a sensing part having temperature sensors separated from each other and arranged on the floor surface to sense the battery temperature of the electric vehicle; and a control part having a controller opening and closing a valve of a fire water supply pipe connected to the fine spray nozzle based on information generated by the temperature sensors to regulate the supply of fire water to the fine spray nozzle. The fine spray nozzle finely sprays the fire water toward the battery by projecting the head above the floor surface by the water pressure of the fire water supplied as the controller opens the valve of the fire water supply pipe when the temperature of the battery sensed by the temperature sensors exceeds a preset temperature.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 충전기에 연결된 충전중의 전기자동차가 위치하는 바닥면에 간격을 두고 매립 설치되되, 헤드가 상기 전기자동차 저면을 마주하게 설치되는 미세분무 노즐을 구비하는 소화수분사부; 상기 바닥면에 간격을 두고 배치되어 상기 전기자동차의 배터리 온도를 감지하는 온도센서를 구비하는 감지부; 및 상기 온도센서가 생성하는 정보를 기반으로 상기 미세분무 노즐에 연결되는 소화수공급관의 밸브를 개폐하여 상기 미세분무 노즐로의 소화수 공급을 단속하는 제어기를 구비하는 제어부;를 포함하고, 상기 미세분무 노즐은 상기 온도센서가 감지한 상기 배터리의 온도가 사전 설정된 온도를 초과할 때 상기 제어기가 상기 소화수공급관의 상기 밸브를 개방함에 따라 공급되는 상기 소화수의 수압에 의해 상기 헤드가 상기 바닥면 상부로 돌출되어 상기 배터리를 향해 상기 소화수를 미세분무하는 것을 특징으로 하는 충전중 전기자동차 화재진압 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for detecting living body in cabin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for detecting a living body in a cabin. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a current original data frame acquired by a millimeter wave radar, and determining current output data; determining the action amplitude detection result of the target object in the cockpit according to the current output data; and determining the vital sign of the target object according to the action amplitude detection result. By the method, data acquired by the millimeter wave radar are analyzed, the action amplitude detection result of the target object in the cabin is determined, the vital sign of the target object is determined according to the result, and detection of the living body in the cabin is achieved. The target objects with different action amplitudes in the cockpit can be accurately detected, the existence of the target object with vital signs is accurately judged, and the probability of missing report is effectively reduced. The living body in the cockpit is quickly and successfully sensed, and the relevant information of the living body target can be obtained.
assignees: HUIZHOU DESAY SV INTELLIGENT TRANSP TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Old person heartbeat detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an old person's heartbeat detection device belongs to breathing, heartbeat frequency detection technical field. The method comprises the following steps: a front cover plate and a rear shell of the heartbeat detection device; the front cover plate is provided with a microwave radar and an infrared detection probe; the rear shell is fixedly provided with a single chip microcomputer MCU, an internal module and an external module; wherein, the external module, the MCU, the internal module, the microwave radar and the infrared detector head form a complete circuit. The utility model uses commercial power supply and wall mounting mode; the self-contained display module displays the measured data in real time, so that historical data can be stored, and the data can be conveniently checked; the device has an infrared detection function, when a user approaches the device, the display screen is on, heartbeat data is displayed in real time, and when the user leaves, the display function is turned off; when the detected heartbeat is abnormal, the sound-light alarm is immediately sent out, meanwhile, the alarm data are sent to a community hospital or an emergency contact through the communication module, and the old people can be rescued in an emergency.
assignees: NANJING OHOSURE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Respiration and heartbeat monitoring system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a respiration and heartbeat monitoring system based on a millimeter wave radar, which comprises an FMCW millimeter wave radar, wherein the FMCW millimeter wave radar is adopted to transmit electromagnetic wave signals to a human body, receive reflected signals carrying vital signs, demodulate received radar echo signals, separate and extract respiration and heartbeat information from the received radar echo signals, and acquire and analyze data: after receiving echo data, the radar transmits the original echo data to a PC (personal computer) end through a network cable and analyzes the original echo data so as to obtain Range-FFT (fast Fourier transform-fast Fourier transform) data; and (3) judging whether a target exists or not: and calculating the echo signal energy of the current frame through single frame Range-FFT data. The invention receives the radar echo signal which is returned from the human body and carries the vital sign information of the human body through the FMCW millimeter wave radar, and then processes the echo signal by utilizing the signal processing technology to obtain the respiration and heartbeat values of the human body, thereby achieving the purpose of monitoring the vital sign.
assignees: DEXIN INTELLIGENT TECH CHANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Behind-wall hidden target tracking method suitable for low signal-to-noise ratio environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a behind-wall hidden target tracking method suitable for a low signal-to-noise ratio environment, which is applied to the technical field of radar tracking. The method aims at solving the problems that in the prior art, complex electromagnetic environment causes more clutter and noise in echo, the imaging quality is poor, and then the target is difficult to track. Firstly, reconstructing a scene by adopting a backward projection method, then, establishing a target template based on a ridge regression idea by extracting characteristics of a target area, establishing a scale pool with small distance scale change and large azimuth scale change based on a through-wall radar target imaging mechanism and imaged target characteristics, tracking a next frame of target based on a related filtering idea, updating the target template for each frame of change of the characteristics of the through-wall radar target, and finally dynamically estimating the target area and obtaining a tracking track; the invention can realize the accurate tracking of hidden targets behind the wall in a low signal-to-noise ratio scene.

title_en: Sleep quality assessment method, equipment, system and medium based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sleep quality assessment method, equipment, a system and a medium based on millimeter wave radar, wherein the sleep quality assessment method comprises the following steps: acquiring vital sign data of a tested person through millimeter wave radar monitoring equipment; according to the obtained vital sign data, one or more operations of body movement frequency analysis, respiratory disturbance degree analysis and bed duration determination of the tested person are executed; and carrying out sleep quality assessment of the tested person based on the obtained one or more information among the body movement frequency, the respiratory disturbance degree and the bed duration. In view of the advantages of non-contact detection of the millimeter wave radar, vital signs of a user can be detected without wearing the millimeter wave radar, the sleep quality of the detected person is estimated by utilizing various vital sign data with representative significance in the sleep process of the detected person acquired by the millimeter wave radar, and detailed and accurate estimated data is obtained on the premise of no perception detection, so that the method has a wide application prospect.

title_en: Microwave life detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a microwave life detection instrument relates to life detection technical field, including detection instrument display screen and microwave detection head body, the bottom fixed mounting of detection instrument display screen has the fixed plate, the left side of fixed plate is provided with probe adjustment mechanism, the right side of fixed plate is provided with hand heating mechanism, probe adjustment mechanism includes electric telescopic handle, electric telescopic handle fixed mounting is in the left side of fixed plate. The utility model discloses a work that control electric telescopic handle extends or contracts can be adjusted the stretching out position of microwave detecting head body, and control step motor work drives the ring rotation through the link, and it is rotatory to drive the microwave detecting head body simultaneously, lasts the detection angle who changes the microwave detecting head body, realizes the function that the automation was adjusted the microwave detecting head body promptly, reduces operator's physical demands, promotes the efficiency that the life was surveyed, increases the convenience of this device.

title_en: Anti-hiding system for vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a vehicle anti-system of hiding, include: the vehicle access passage is provided with a first scanning area and a second scanning area; the drive-up passage type vehicle scanning and checking system is arranged in a first scanning area; the vehicle bottom imaging device is arranged in the middle of the first scanning area; radar life check out test set, radar life check out test set includes L type support, the top inner wall of L type support is installed and is prevented escaping perspective life detection radar. Through adopting passageway formula vehicle scanning inspection system and vehicle bottom imaging device of exempting from to detect vehicle inside and vehicle chassis, can understand, accurate, effectively discern the inside article of vehicle and the vehicle chassis condition, improved detection accuracy, both cooperate the use simultaneously, have avoided a single detection technology to receive specific environmental interference to cause the problem of unable normal detection.

title_en: Test device and test method for researching influence of extreme rainfall on diversion channel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a test device and a test method for researching influence of extreme rainfall on a diversion channel, comprising a channel filling box, a drainage body and a water distribution device, wherein a channel model is filled in the channel filling box, the channel model comprises two side channel slopes and a channel lining plate positioned between the two side channel slopes, and one side of the channel model, which is close to a first drainage hole, is filled with the drainage body; the system comprises a channel model, a rainfall simulation component, a channel water supply component, a groundwater water supply component and a sensor component, wherein the rainfall simulation component simulates a channel rainfall scene, the channel water supply component simulates a channel water supply scene, the groundwater water supply component is positioned on one side of the simulation box and comprises a groundwater storage tank, water in the groundwater storage tank permeates into the channel model through a water permeable hole to simulate groundwater, and the sensor component is buried in the channel model to collect channel bottom, channel slope pore water pressure and channel slope displacement. The method considers the influence of water, ground water level and rainfall in the channel on the channel, and has important significance for further clarifying the catastrophe mechanism and disaster prevention of the channel slope under the extreme rainfall condition.

title_en: Through-wall radar target identification method, equipment and medium based on vortex electromagnetic waves
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, equipment and a medium for identifying a through-wall radar target based on vortex electromagnetic waves, wherein the method comprises the following steps: respectively executing corresponding multi-mode signal transceiving processes based on each transmitting mode in the transmitting mode range to obtain each echo signal of the target; acquiring characteristic information of the target object based on each echo signal of the target object; wherein the multi-modal signaling process, when executed, comprises: determining a wall echo mode corresponding to a current emission mode based on the current emission mode; executing a current multi-mode echo signal acquisition process based on the current emission mode, the wall echo mode and the receiving mode range; updating the emission modality to re-execute the multi-modality signal transceiving process based on the new emission modality until exiting; the invention realizes clutter suppression on the echo signal of the partition wall target object and improves the radar identification efficiency of the through-wall target object.
assignees: SHANGHAI INST MICROSYSTEM & INFORMATION TECH CAS

title_en: Remote medical system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote medical system which utilizes a microwave human body sensing technology to realize the analysis of human body vital signs and data processing; the application is mainly applied to medical monitoring items such as detection of human body care/medical health monitoring and the like, and timely and effectively solves the problem of care health by analyzing the real-time health state of the human body in the room through a large amount of data analysis and a large amount of data analysis; the indoor space is periodically scanned, an indoor organism distribution diagram is obtained according to scanning reflection signals, microwave radar signals are used as induction media, radar signals are transmitted to a living body, radar echo signals reflected by the living body are received, original echo data are formed, and the original echo data are processed through a processing module, so that on one hand, non-contact measurement is achieved, and the comfort of the living body is improved; on the other hand, the respiration rate, the heart rate and the body movement of the living body can be effectively extracted, and the purposes of real-time monitoring and early warning are achieved.
assignees: NINGBO YINGXIN MICROELECTRONICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Radar and microseism combined composite life detection instrument
abstract_en: The utility model provides a compound life detection instrument that radar and slight shock combined relates to search for and rescue apparatus technical field, including shell, radar send-receiver portion, slight shock sensing portion, illumination unit, display element and handle unit, send and receive radar signal through setting up radar send-receiver portion, set up slight shock sensing portion and discern the micro-vibration, set up illumination unit and deal with night or the dim environment of light, set up the information that radar send-receiver portion and slight shock sensing portion output is looked over to display element, set up the handle unit and be used for portable handheld. The utility model discloses when possessing the radar detection function, still possess the microseism and survey the function, synthesize the two advantage, realized the accurate location to stranded person.
assignees: WUHAN XINLANG PHOTOELECTRIC TECH CO LTD;HUAXIA CHUANGWEI BEIJING SAFETY PREVENTION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;BEIJING LSJ TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Breathing protection device with breathing detection function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a respiratory protection device with respiratory detection function, which comprises a protective cover and a head-wearing bracket, wherein the head-wearing bracket is provided with an exhaust fan, the exhaust fan is connected with a vent pipe, the vent pipe is detachably connected with the protective cover, and a sensor is arranged in the vent pipe and can detect expiratory parameters, respiratory state and the like; the head-mounted bracket is provided with a controller which is electrically connected with the sensor. The controller comprises a driving circuit, a processor, a power supply, a control key and a Bluetooth module. The utility model discloses an air exhauster takes the waste gas in the protection casing out, is favorable to the protection casing to ventilate, makes the user keep breathing unobstructed, effectively reduces carbon dioxide and gathers, improves use comfort. And the sensor is used for detecting parameters of expiration and respiration states, and parameter data are wirelessly sent through the Bluetooth module, so that real-time health condition monitoring is conveniently carried out. And the diversified application scenes can be experienced through listening to music, news, making and receiving calls and the like through the Bluetooth headset.

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on ultra-wideband radar under motion disturbance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign detection method based on ultra-wideband radar under motion disturbance, which comprises the following steps: performing down-conversion processing on original radar echo data; determining a region of interest according to the result of the down-conversion processing; preprocessing the data of the region of interest, and extracting an optimal respiratory signal by using a respiratory signal extraction algorithm based on an R square value; removing the background of the data of the region of interest, and simultaneously obtaining a start-stop frame of each random body movement through a movement detection algorithm; calculating to obtain the respiratory rate and the heart rate according to the region of interest data obtained after the Butterworth band-pass filtering, and optimizing the detection of the respiratory rate according to the optimal respiratory signal; and stopping detection when the random body movement is detected according to the start-stop frames of each random body movement obtained by the movement detection algorithm, and setting the respiration rate and the heart rate at the previous moment as the current detection result. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the continuous monitoring of vital signs of a human body under the condition of small random body movement is realized.

title_en: Heartbeat and respiration detection device and heartbeat and respiration detection program
abstract_en: To improve fastness, reduce an effect of disturbance, isolate heartbeat and respiration, prevent multiple counts, and expand a detection range while also making it possible to reduce a burden on nurses and reduce a risk of infection when the heart rate and the respiration rate are calculated on the basis of a radar signal (optionally including an ultrasonic signal) that is reflected off a body surface.SOLUTION: According to the present disclosure, heartbeat detection is performed by extracting a frequency component produced by heartbeat micro-vibrations over a prescribed heartbeat observation time window, extracting amplitude peaks from the frequency component produced by the heartbeat micro-vibrations, and extracting one characteristic micro-vibration from a plurality of characteristic micro-vibrations for one heartbeat. On the other hand, respiration detection is performed by extracting positive and negative frequency components produced by heartbeat micro-vibrations, performing complex multiplication of the positive and negative frequency components, and removing a heartbeat phase change produced by the heartbeat micro-vibrations from the positive and negative frequency components of which the complex multiplication was performed to extract a respiration phase change produced by respiration micro-vibrations.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Apparatus, sensor system, electronic device and method
abstract_en: In accordance with an embodiment, a method includes receiving data indicating a receive signal of a sensor; processing the data by isolating a locally stationary signal component of the receive signal from at least one of a stochastic or a deterministic signal component of the receive signal; and determining a vital sign of a living being based on the isolated locally stationary signal component of the receive signal.

title_en: Home care artificial intelligence fall detection system with emergency recognition function
title_ko: 위급상황 인지기능을 갖춘 가정용 홈케어 인공지능 낙상감지 시스템
abstract_en: A home care artificial intelligence fall detection system, which can accurately detect emergency situations while minimizing privacy exposure, comprises: a thermal imaging sensor for detecting an object in a detection area where privacy protection is required; a vibration detection sensor which detects a magnitude of vibration in the detection area; a breathing detection sensor which detects a breathing pattern of the object if the object detected by the thermal imaging sensor is a person; a smart hub which relays data between the thermal imaging sensor, the vibration detection sensor, the breathing detection sensor, and an analysis server; and an analysis server which receives detection data from the vibration detection sensor, detection data from the breathing detection sensor, and images taken from the thermal imaging sensor, respectively, and applies a convolutional neural network (CNN) algorithm to detect set movement patterns of preset objects and determine emergency situations.
abstract_ko: 가정용 홈케어 인공지능 낙상감지 시스템은, 사생활 보호가 필요한 감지영역에서 객체를 검출하기 위한 열상감지 센서와, 감지영역에서의 진동크기를 감지하는 진동감지센서와, 열상감지 센서에서 감지된 객체가 사람일 경우, 객체의 호흡패턴을 검출하는 호흡감지센서와, 열상감지 센서, 진동감지센서 및 호흡감지센서와 분석서버의 사이에서 데이터를 중계하는 스마트 허브와, 진동감지센서의 감지 데이터, 호흡감지센서의 감지 데이터 및 열상감지 센서에서 촬영된 영상을 각각 수신하고 컨벌루션 뉴럴 네트워크(Convolutional Neural Network, CNN) 알고리즘을 적용하여 미리 설정된 객체의 설정된 움직임 패턴을 검출하면서 위급상황을 판단하는 분석서버를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Remote monitoring method for converter station based on image recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote monitoring method for a converter station based on image recognition. The invention comprises the following steps: setting a camera to shoot images of all physical assets in the converter station, and marking the position information of the physical assets; extracting images shot by a camera from a database to a data center for image recognition of the real assets needing to be checked; setting vital signs of millimeter wave radar detection personnel; carrying out image identification to judge whether smoke appears; if smoke exists, judging whether the smoke has vital signs of personnel by using a millimeter wave radar; and constructing an electronic fence for the set working area of the converter station, then carrying out image recognition, and recognizing personnel and vehicles entering and exiting the set working area. The invention can remotely check the real assets in the converter station and improve the checking efficiency and timeliness.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle life detection system based on vision SLAM technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle life detection system based on a visual SLAM technology, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous life detection platform for detecting human life through an infrared camera sensor and realizing integration of composition, navigation and life detection, wherein the SLAM technology is used as an autonomous navigation mode of an unmanned aerial vehicle, binocular cameras are used for extracting and screening characteristic points, matching and updating key frames, filtering and optimizing rear ends, three-dimensional reconstruction is carried out on the space where the unmanned aerial vehicle is located, and three-dimensional coordinates of the real-time position of the unmanned aerial vehicle are obtained through pose calculation, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can realize the establishment of a surrounding environment map and carry out self positioning according to the established environment map on the basis of no external signals, the autonomous flight function is achieved, meanwhile, the existence of a trapped person is detected in real time in the autonomous navigation flight process of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the position of the trapped person is positioned quickly and efficiently according to the information autonomously detected by the unmanned aerial vehicle, thereby rescue is implemented.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vital sign monitoring, in particular to a vital sign monitoring method based on a millimeter wave radar, which comprises the following steps: step S1: the method comprises the steps that a millimeter wave radar is adopted to transmit millimeter waves to a target direction pointing to a target area and receive echo signals, and at least one target to be detected in the target direction is separated from the echo signals; step S2: acquiring a breathing signal and a heartbeat signal of a target to be detected by adopting a processing device associated with the millimeter wave radar according to the echo signal; and step S3: and generating the respiratory frequency of the target to be detected according to the respiratory signal by adopting a processing device, and generating the heartbeat frequency of the target to be detected according to the heartbeat signal. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the targets in the target direction are detected through millimeter waves, the targets are separated in two dimensions of distance and direction angle, the targets which actually need to monitor vital signs are accurately obtained, and therefore good separation degree among multiple targets is achieved, and the multiple targets can be monitored simultaneously.

title_en: Doppler radar heartbeat detection method based on multi-scale residual error shrinkage network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Doppler radar heartbeat detection method based on a multi-scale residual error shrinkage network, which considers that continuous wave radar signals in a time domain are different in performance on different time scales, provides a multi-scale time domain feature extraction module, and places the multi-scale time domain feature extraction module in a residual error shrinkage network structure to form a multi-scale residual error shrinkage module, wherein the residual error shrinkage network uses a soft threshold value as a nonlinear conversion layer, so that related noise interfering with heartbeat detection can be effectively eliminated; performing Hilbert-Huang transform on radar signals under different scales, wherein the obtained result reflects time-frequency characteristics of the signals, and further extracting the characteristics of the transformed signals, so that heartbeat related characteristics are separated from complex mixed signals; and the output of the multi-scale residual error contraction module and the output of the Hilbert-Huang Lvbo module are subjected to feature fusion, so that noise interference in an original radar signal is effectively reduced. The method can reconstruct high-quality radar signals and improve the accuracy of heartbeat detection.

title_en: Contactless type apparatus for measuring biological signal and Method thereof
title_ko: 비접촉식 생체신호 측정기 및 측정방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a non-contact biosignal measuring device and a measuring method, and more specifically to the measuring device and measuring method capable of determining a location and movement of a subject to be measured using a radar sensor after detecting the movement of the subject to be measured or shaking of the subject to be measured using a 3-axis acceleration sensor, and measuring a respiratory rate or heart rate per unit time by extracting only biological signals. The biosignal measuring device of the present invention includes a 3-axis acceleration sensor; a radar sensor; a micro controller unit (MCU); and a display.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비접촉식 생체신호 측정기 및 측정방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 3축 가속도 센서를 이용하여 측정자의 움직임 또는 측정기의 흔들림 여부를 파악한 후, 레이더 센서를 이용하여 측정 대상자의 위치와 움직임 여부를 파악하고, 생체신호만을 추출하여 단위 시간당 호흡수 또는 심박수를 측정하는 측정기 및 측정방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Compressed air displacement prevents soil frost heaving disaster system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compressed air displacement system for preventing soil frost heaving disasters, which integrally comprises a detection control system and a gas displacement system. The detection control system respectively detects the temperature, the humidity and the acting force among the soil of the freeze thawing soil above the protection object through the temperature sensor, the humidity sensor and the force sensor, and the detection result is analyzed by the controller and then regulates and controls the electromagnetic control valve of the gas displacement system. The gas displacement system is used for realizing the start and stop of the air compressor and the dryer under the control of the detection control system, pressurized dry gas is transmitted to the gas spray head through the displacement gas pipeline, and the displacement gas is used for uniformly displacing moisture and wet air in freeze thawing soil through the gas spray head, so that frost heaving of soil nearby a protection object is prevented. The invention effectively prevents frost heaving damage of the protected object in the frost thawing soil area, and is applicable to the scenes of preventing the facilities such as buried pipelines, bridge foundations, roadbeds and the like from frost heaving damage.

title_en: System and method for continous and real-time locating and tracking scraper using UAV
abstract_en: A method includes: launching an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) parallel to a buried pipeline; sending a plurality of transmitted ground penetrating radar (GPR) waves to the buried pipeline using a GPR antenna of the UAV; receiving a received GPR wave from the buried pipeline such that the received GPR wave is a combination of a reflected GPR wave with a ringing noise signal from the one or more scrapers; measuring one or more parameters of the received GPR wave and determining if values of the one or more parameters are within a predefined threshold region; recording location coordinates and a time stamp of the one or more scrapers by analyzing the received GPR wave; and sending the location coordinates and the time stamp of the one or more scrapers to a controller unit for continuous and real-time locating and tracking movement of the one or more scrapers.

title_en: Motion compensation method, device and system of unmanned aerial vehicle through-wall radar detection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a motion compensation method, a device and a system of an unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted through-wall radar detection system, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted through-wall radar detection system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle platform and a through-wall radar, the through-wall radar is carried on the unmanned aerial vehicle platform, and the motion compensation method comprises the following steps: acquiring radar echo data received by an unmanned aerial vehicle through-wall radar detection system, and acquiring the position of an immobilized structure in a detection environment according to the radar echo data; acquiring data point information corresponding to the position of the stationary structure; and calibrating the radar echo data of each frame by using the data point information corresponding to the position of the stationary structure obtained by the radar echo data of each frame. The method has the advantages of simple implementation method, low cost, high compensation efficiency and precision, capability of realizing an efficient and flexible through-wall radar detection system based on unmanned aerial vehicle clusters, and the like.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact type vital signal monitoring millimeter wave radar system with mechanical rotation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact type vital signal monitoring millimeter wave radar system with mechanical rotation, and belongs to the technical field of electronic information. The system comprises a computer, a millimeter wave radar, an antenna module, a two-phase four-wire stepping motor, a control chip, a transformer and a driver, and is based on the FMCW and millimeter wave radar technology at the same time. The system is provided with the mechanical rotating device, so that the automatic detection without dead angles in all directions on a plane can be realized, the detection area is enlarged, the safety and the convenience are greatly improved, vital sign monitoring can be carried out on different people in real time and conveniently, and the waste of human resources is reduced; the method provides an alternative scheme for the construction of vital signal monitoring, traffic, security inspection and monitoring of special crowds.

title_en: Working method of omnidirectional biological radar device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an omnidirectional biological radar device and a working method thereof, wherein an FMCW radar is arranged on a 360-degree rotating platform, and omnidirectional vital sign detection of a plurality of human targets is realized through a radar rotating at a high speed. The rotary radar platform not only can realize the identification of the existence of people in the surrounding environment, but also can estimate the relative angle between the radar initial position and the object by using the virtual SIMO (Simple Input Multiple Output, single input multiple output) method provided by the invention, and finally realizes the simultaneous detection of all-dimensional vital signs of a plurality of human targets. The implementation of the task may have important application value for future search and rescue and vital sign detection.

title_en: In-vehicle vital sign detection and early warning method, system, storage medium and vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides an in-vehicle vital sign detection and early warning method, a system, a storage medium and a vehicle; the vital sign detection and early warning method comprises the following steps: acquiring the current vehicle state, acquiring vital sign data of personnel in the vehicle through a millimeter wave radar, and processing the vital sign data through a digital signal processing technology to obtain heart rate and respiratory rate of the personnel in the vehicle; and then, carrying out anomaly detection on the heart rate and the respiratory rate of the personnel in the vehicle, and making an early warning sound according to an anomaly detection result. The invention adopts the millimeter wave radar, and realizes the detection and reporting of vital sign data during running and after parking by judging the heart rate and the respiratory rate of personnel in the vehicle, thereby ensuring that the personnel in the vehicle can be timely rescued when danger occurs.
assignees: HUIZHOU DESAY SV AUTOMOTIVE CO LTD

title_en: Animal vital sign monitoring method and system based on microwave beam regulation and control
abstract_en: The invention provides an animal vital sign monitoring method and system based on microwave beam regulation, comprising the following steps: positioning: detecting and positioning sensitive parts of target respiration and heartbeat in a visual field range based on a band-pass filter bank; a phase shift control step: constructing a phase coding matrix, and performing phase shift control on the transmitting signals of the transmitting antennas so that the synthesized wave beams of the transmitting antennas face the sensitive part obtained by positioning; a signal receiving and transmitting step: acquiring a plurality of echo signals and performing signal processing to obtain a multichannel baseband signal; demodulation: and performing micro-motion phase demodulation on the multichannel baseband signal, and extracting vital sign information of a target. The invention can process the multichannel baseband signal through the band-pass filter group to realize the detection and the positioning of the respiratory heartbeat sensitive part of the animal; animal vital sign detection is carried out by a phase coding and beam focusing method, and the testing distance, the signal-to-noise ratio and the measuring precision are improved.

title_en: Ground penetrating radar underground pipeline parameter inversion method based on graphical user interface
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ground penetrating radar data interpretation, and particularly relates to a ground penetrating radar underground pipeline parameter inversion method based on a graphical user interface. The method comprises the steps of designing a special graphic user interface, namely displaying a ground penetrating radar B-Scan signal, adjusting an interaction area and a threshold value, inputting basic parameters of the ground penetrating radar, starting a button and displaying a fitting result, marking key points of hyperbolic features in a ground penetrating radar B-Scan image through the graphic user interface, and realizing inversion of buried depth and radius parameters of an underground pipeline by combining a sampling time interval and a transverse inter-channel distance of an input ground penetrating radar system to obtain the buried depth and the radius parameters of the underground pipeline. Experimental results show that the method can accurately invert the buried depth and the radius of the underground pipeline of the ground penetrating radar, and solves the problems that the traditional method is not strong enough in universality, affected by noise, large in calculated amount, lack of radius inversion results and the like.

title_en: Non-contact exercise vital sign detection method and exercise vital sign detection radar
abstract_en: A non-contact exercise vital sign detection method is provided. At least one candidate position having an energy intensity exceeding an energy threshold is pre-selected from a vibration frequency map, and a position having a vibration frequency meeting a vital sign parameter range is then selected as a target position from the at least one candidate position. Accordingly, phase data obtained according to the target position facilitates accurate detection of a vital sign parameter of a subject.

title_en: Doppler through-wall radar positioning method based on data driving and time-frequency analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Doppler through-wall radar positioning method based on data-driven time-frequency analysis, which comprises the steps of obtaining Doppler through-wall modulation echo signals of multi-target movement, analyzing and processing the obtained Doppler through-wall modulation echo signals of multi-target movement through STFT, constructing a time-frequency distribution matrix data set, constructing a neural network model, training the constructed neural network model by adopting the obtained time-frequency distribution data set to obtain an optimal time-frequency distribution prediction model, predicting and processing the constructed time-frequency distribution matrix data set by adopting the constructed optimal time-frequency distribution prediction model to obtain predicted time-frequency distribution, and completing positioning processing by adopting the obtained predicted time-frequency distribution to the Doppler through-wall modulation echo signals of multi-target movement. The method realizes real-time tracking and positioning processing of the target, can better solve the problem of time-frequency blurring, improves the time-frequency resolution, and has high accuracy, strong overfitting resistance and obviously improved identification capability.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster early warning calling integrated equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses mountain torrent disaster early warning and calling integrated equipment, which comprises a monitoring station point arranged beside a river course, wherein the monitoring station point comprises a mounting frame which is pre-buried and arranged beside the river course, a rain gauge arranged on the mounting frame and a plurality of ultrasonic velocimeters for measuring water flow rate, the side surface of the rain gauge is fixedly connected with an ultrasonic water level gauge for measuring water level height, the side surface of the ultrasonic water level gauge is fixedly connected with a monitoring device, and the top of the ultrasonic water level gauge is fixedly connected with a water drop sensor. This mountain torrent calamity early warning calls integration equipment through set up the edulcoration cover at the rain gauge top, and its partly comprises fixed rack, and partly comprises a plurality of rotatable edulcoration poles to a plurality of edulcoration poles can link to rotate, can directly outwards release impurity such as the leaf that falls on the edulcoration cover in the rotation in-process, has realized automatic clearance, can avoid the leaf to cover the problem that influences the collection rain and cause the jam.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring method and system based on radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to a radar-based vital sign monitoring method and a radar-based vital sign monitoring system, wherein the radar-based vital sign monitoring method comprises the following steps: generating a frequency modulation continuous wave signal based on a radar, wherein one path of the generated signal is sent towards a monitoring target, and the other path of the generated signal is mixed with the obtained echo signal, and filtering and digital-to-analog conversion are sequentially carried out to obtain a digital signal; according to the distance between the monitoring target and the radar, the digital signals are subjected to phase expansion to obtain phase difference, the respiration signals and the heartbeat signals are separated according to a band-pass filter of a set frequency band, and the respiration rate and the heart rate of the monitoring target are obtained through post-processing. The method comprises the steps of sending radar signals to a subject by using a frequency modulation continuous wave radar, modulating the signals by using the radar signals, mixing the captured echo signals with the emission signals, and processing to obtain the required heartbeat and respiration data, so that vital sign monitoring is realized in a non-contact mode.

title_en: Ultra-wideband radar heart rate detection method based on multi-sequence WOA-VMD algorithm
