abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ultra wideband radar, and relates to an ultra wideband radar heart rate detection method based on a multi-sequence WOA-VMD algorithm, which is used for acquiring multi-sequence vital sign vectors by utilizing vital sign information carried by reflected echoes of the ultra wideband radar, inhibiting respiratory interference and accurately separating heartbeat signals to obtain heart rate values, and comprises the following steps: the radar transmits pulses in a certain pulse repetition period, and the receiving end samples and records data in a certain time interval; performing clutter suppression, linear trend suppression and signal-to-noise ratio improvement preprocessing on radar echo signals, and calculating a slow time direction data variance to obtain a target position so as to obtain a multi-sequence vital sign vector; and (5) integrating a whale algorithm WOA and a variation modal decomposition algorithm to obtain the heart rate value. The method is mainly applied to occasions for acquiring vital sign information by using ultra-wideband radar.

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of radar signal detection, in order to improve detection accuracy, a vital sign detection method based on millimeter wave radar comprises the following steps: 1. acquiring an original signal of respiration and heartbeat overlapping; 2. the denoising method based on phase space reconstruction is adopted to carry out signal separation on the original signal so as to obtain a respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal, and the method specifically comprises the following steps: 21. reconstructing the phase space of respiration and heartbeat respectively by adopting different embedding dimensions and time delays to obtain a high-dimensional phase space; 22. a zero subspace in Gao Weixiang space represents noise components, an attractor space represents respiratory signals or heartbeat signal components, the zero subspace is projected to the attractor space continuously to eliminate the noise components, and the projected phase points are corrected; 23. carrying out weighted anti-reconstruction processing on all corrected phase points to obtain respiratory signals and heartbeat signals; 3. the respiration signal and the heartbeat signal are analyzed to obtain a respiration value and a heartbeat value. By adopting the mode, the detection accuracy is improved.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign real-time millimeter wave radar monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact vital sign real-time millimeter wave radar monitoring device, which relates to the technical field of millimeter wave radars and comprises the following components: the positioning devices are provided with a plurality of groups, and each positioning device is respectively fixed at the joints of the limbs and the skull of the patient; the positioning device comprises a plurality of positioning ends which are respectively fixed in a use place to form a 3D positioning area, and the positioning ends transmit signals to the monitoring device; the auxiliary equipment is used for acquiring the image information of the patient and transmitting the image information to the monitoring equipment; and the monitoring equipment generates a signal set after receiving the signals and the image information of each positioning equipment, and generates the body information of the patient based on the signal set. According to the invention, the gesture of a patient can be detected by arranging the plurality of positioning devices, and the position and angle of each positioning device can be identified by the auxiliary device through the set signal frequency, the set light color and the set stroboscopic effect.

title_en: Portable local mine earthquake monitoring, early warning and alarming device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable local mine earthquake monitoring early warning device and a portable local mine earthquake monitoring early warning method, wherein the device comprises an equipment protection shell, the equipment protection shell comprises a feedback part, a connecting part and a buried part which are connected from top to bottom, and the buried part is internally provided with a plurality of sensors which are electrically connected from bottom to top in sequence: the system comprises a P-L-S energy receiver, a seismic wave memory, an electric energy memory and an ARM program programming module; the feedback part is provided with the components which are electrically connected from bottom to top in sequence: an electron emitter, a buzzer, and a vibration display for displaying frequency and energy; an electric wire is arranged in the connecting part which is communicated with the feedback part and the embedded part, and the ARM program programming module is electrically connected with the electronic emitter through the electric wire; the embedded part is sleeved with a steel pipe, and a seismic wave expansion space is formed between the steel pipe and the embedded part. Aiming at rock burst disasters, the invention can monitor the vibration energy level induced by the fracture of the coal seam and realize early warning and alarming, thereby providing a scientific solution for the early warning and alarming of the occurrence of rock burst.

title_en: Non-contact sleep respiration monitoring method and device based on IR-UWB radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact sleep respiration monitoring method and device based on an IR-UWB radar, which are characterized in that IR-UWB radar equipment is deployed at the bedside to collect vital sign data of a tested object in an environment where the device is positioned during the bed at night; automatically positioning the position range of the bed, and extracting vital sign signals representing the tested object in the range of the bed from echo signals reflected by the radar; respectively identifying five states of the human body in the whole night process based on a signal processing algorithm; estimating the sleeping period of the tested object according to the state change condition of the human body overnight; monitoring the respiration rate change condition of a tested object in a sleep period; and identifying respiratory events occurring in the sleep period of the tested object by using a deep learning method based on a multi-head self-attention mechanism. The invention improves the accuracy of the calculation of the breathing frequency overnight and can obtain more accurate sleep apnea low-ventilation index AHI data.

title_en: Multi-person heartbeat detection and positioning method and system based on SIMO radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-person heartbeat detection and positioning method and system based on a SIMO radar, wherein the method comprises the steps of correcting amplitude and phase of echo signals of each channel of the radar; weighting the corrected signals to obtain echo signals corresponding to the search angle, calculating a two-dimensional FFT of distance Doppler for the echo signals, reconstructing, imaging to obtain distance and angle information of a human body target, calculating an optimal direction diagram weight vector through a DBF principle, calculating a distance dimension FFT, obtaining vital sign signals of each human body target, estimating heart rate by utilizing PCA and ZASLMS algorithms, decomposing and extracting the vital sign signals according to the estimated heart rate by utilizing a tensor decomposition theoretical algorithm, obtaining a target heartbeat signal and recovering corresponding time domain waveforms. The method is effective and feasible, has reliable performance, can accurately judge the distance and angle information of a plurality of human targets positioned in different or same distance doors, inhibit the interference of moving and static objects and extract the heartbeat signals of the corresponding targets.

title_en: Method and System for GPR Investigating on the basis of LiDAR and Positioning Information
title_ko: 라이다 센서와 위치정보에 기반한 ｇｐｒ 지중탐사장치 및 그 지중탐사방법
abstract_en: A GPR underground surveying apparatus based on LiDAR and location information and an underground surveying method thereof are disclosed. The GPR underground surveying apparatus of the present invention displays the location of a measurement point where an underground image was taken using GPS coordinates generated by a GPS sensor, and when accurate map coordinates are calculated using a LiDAR module, correct the GPS coordinates to map coordinates. In addition, the GPR underground surveying apparatus can create a map of buried objects by displaying discovered underground objects in the form of nodes and branches on a digital map. To achieve the above, the GPR underground surveying apparatus comprises a GPS sensor, a GPR sensor, a warning lamp, an underground search module, a data processing module, and a map generation module.
abstract_ko: 라이다(LiDAR)와 위치정보에 기반한 GPR 지중탐사장치 및 그 지중탐사방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 GPR 지중탐사장치는 지중영상을 촬영한 측정점의 위치를 GPS 센서가 생성하는 GPS 좌표를 이용하여 표시하되, 라이다 모듈을 이용해 정확한 지도상 좌표가 계산되면 GPS 좌표를 지도상 좌표로 보정할 수 있다. 또한, GPR 지중탐사장치는 탐색한 지중매설물을 디지털 지도상에 노드와 가지의 형태로 표시하여 매설물 지도를 만들 수 있다.

title_en: Forest fire detection device and forest fire monitoring system using the same
title_ko: 산불발생 감지장치 및 이를 이용한 산불감시 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a forest fire detection device having a power supply structure using a thermoelectric module, and a forest fire monitoring system using the same. In accordance with the present invention, the forest fire detection device includes: a first ceramic substrate forming a high temperature part; a second ceramic substrate forming a low temperature part; a thermoelectric semiconductor provided between the first and second ceramic substrates to sense a temperature difference, and generate an electromotive force based on the temperature difference; a PCB for supplying the electromotive force generated by the thermoelectric semiconductor as direct current power; a control part provided on the PCB to generate a forest fire detection signal with the electromotive force generated when a forest fire occurs; and a communication module connected to the PCT, and wirelessly transmitting the forest fire detection signal generated by the control part to a nearby communication hub, wherein the second ceramic substrate is provided with a heat-conducting ground bracket formed of metal having high thermal conductivity and buried in the ground such that the ground temperature can be conducted to the second ceramic substrate. In accordance with the present invention, the forest fire detection device generates a forest fire occurrence signal with the electromotive force generated by a temperature difference due to the occurrence of a forest fire between a ground part and a heat-conducting support mount buried below the surface of the ground, and transmits the generated signal through the communication module, thereby facilitating installation and enabling more stable forest fire occurrence detection.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 열전모듈을 이용한 전원공급 구조의 산불발생 감지장치 및 이를 이용한 산불감시 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 산불발생 감지장치는 고온부를 형성하는 제1세라믹기판과, 저온부를 형성하는 제2세라믹기판과, 상기 제1,2세라믹기판 사이에 구비되어 온도차를 감지하고, 온도차에 의해 기전력을 생성하는 열전 반도체와, 상기 열전 반도체에 의해 생성된 기전력을 직류전원으로 공급하기 위한 PCB기판과, 상기 PCB 기판에 구비되어 산불 발생시 생성되는 기전력으로 산불 감지 신호를 생성하는 제어부와, 상기 PCT 기판과 연결되며, 상기 제어부에 의해 생성된 산불발생 감지신호를 인근 통신허브에 무선 송출하기 위한 통신모듈을 포함하며, 상기 제2세라믹기판에는 열전도도가 높은 금속으로 형성되며 지중에 매설되는 열전도 지중브라켓이 구비되어 지중 온도가 상기 제2세라믹기판으로 전도되도록 한다. 
이와 같은 본 발명에 따르면 산불 발생으로 인한 지상부의 온도와 지표면 하부에 매설된 열전도 지지마운트의 온도차에 의해 발생되는 기전력을 전원으로 산불발생 신호를 생성하고, 생성된 신호를 통신모듈을 통해 송신 함으로써 설치가 용이하고 보다 안정적인 산불 발생 감지가 가능한 이점을 가진다.

title_en: Device and method for non-contact detection of galvanic skin response based on imaging
title_ko: 영상 기반 갈바닉 피부 반응 비접촉 감지 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technology for detecting a non-contact biological signal and more specifically, relates to a device and method for an image-based galvanic skin response non-contact detection that extract a galvanic skin response (GSR) as a brightness value of a skin from a non-contact infrared image. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the biological signal can be alternatively detected in a non-contact method using a correlation of a brightness value of the infrared skin image and a galvanic skin response value. The device comprises: an acquisition part; a calculation part; and an analysis part.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비접촉 생체 신호를 검출하는 기술에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 갈바닉 피부 반응(GSR, Galvanic Skin Response)을 비접촉식 적외선 영상에서 피부의 밝기 값으로  추출하는 영상 기반 갈바닉 피부 반응 비접촉 감지 장치 및 방법에 대한 것이다. 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따르면, 적외선 피부 영상의 밝기 값과 갈바닉 피부 반응 값의 상관 관계를 이용해 비 접촉식으로 생체 신호를 대체 감지할 수 있다.
assignees: UNIV SANGMYUNG INDUSTRY ACADEMY COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: System and method for non-contact people localization and vital signs monitoring via fmcw radar
abstract_en: A monitoring system (100) is presented for monitoring vital signs of subject(s). The monitoring system (100) includes a control system (12) configured for signal communication with a frequency modulated continuous wave FMCW radar system (10) to process measured data which is received from a single-channel limited to either the in-phase or the quadrature component of receiver of said FMCW radar and which is in the form of a data matrix (DM) indicative of consecutive beat signals. The control system comprises a data processing utility comprising: a localization module (30) configured and operable to process the measured data indicative of said data matrix (DM) and provide support recovery data indicative of the received signals originated at localized one or more subjects; and a vital signs extraction module (32) configured and operable to analyze the support recovery data and monitor vital signs, such as respiration rate RR and heart rate HR, of said localized one or more subjects.

title_en: Electronic deviece, and method for estimating bio-information
title_ko: 전자장치 및 생체정보 추정방법
abstract_en: According to one aspect, an electronic device may comprise: a main body; a sensor part disposed on one surface of the main body to detect a biological signal of a subject; a first output part comprising a light emitting part disposed on one surface of the main body, and guiding a measurement step to a user by adjusting the light emitting method of the light emitting part; and a processor that controls the first output part according to the measurement step, and estimating the biometric information of the user based on a biosignal detection result of the sensor part. Therefore, the present invention enables each measurement step to be efficiently guided to the user.
abstract_ko: 일 양상에 따른 전자장치는, 본체, 상기 본체의 일면에 배치되어 피검체의 생체신호를 검출하는 센서부, 상기 본체의 일면에 배치되는 발광부를 포함하며, 상기 발광부의 발광 방식을 조절하여 사용자에게 측정 단계를 안내하는 제 1출력부, 및 상기 측정 단계에 따라 상기 제 1출력부를 제어하고, 센서부의 생체신호 검출결과를 기초로 사용자의 생체정보를 추정하는 프로세서를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Systems and methods for remotely tracking life signs with a millimeter-wave radar
abstract_en: Systems and methods for monitoring life signs in a subject a radar unit comprising generates raw data and a processor unit receives raw data and identifies oscillating signals in a series of frames of complex values representing radiation reflected from each voxel of a target region during a given time segment. A processor may collate a series of complex values for each voxel representing reflected radiation for the associated voxel in multiple frames and generate therefrom a real signal sample for each voxel. Neural networks may be used to select the voxel with the best waveform.

title_en: Auxiliary rescue machine vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides an auxiliary rescue machine vehicle which comprises an upper chassis and a lower chassis, wherein a hydraulic jack is fixed in the middle of the lower chassis, a rotation driving device is arranged between the lower chassis and the hydraulic jack, a traveling device is fixed on the upper chassis, a camera and an LED lamp are arranged on the upper chassis, and an infrared sensor, a singlechip control system and a life detector are also arranged on the upper chassis. The utility model realizes the omnibearing steering of the trolley by the rotation between the upper chassis and the lower chassis. The camera is used for comprehensively visually identifying objects and barriers of the robot car and returning specific pictures of an accident scene, the infrared sensor can detect the ambient temperature and realize infrared imaging, and the camera can be used for detecting the barriers and can also serve as a flame detector to assist rescue workers in detecting the environmental safety of the disaster scene. The vital sign near the car can be detected to the vital detector, assists the rescue personnel to search and rescue, can improve the rescue efficiency after the disaster by a wide margin, reduces the casualties.

title_en: Method and medium for detecting, extracting and classifying life signals based on millimeter wave FMCW radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life signal detection extraction and classification method and medium based on millimeter wave FMCW radar, comprising acquiring a static human body target by adopting the millimeter wave FMCW radar to obtain a radar echo signal; sampling the radar echo signal to obtain original ADC data; and filtering background noise and removing direct current components of the acquired original ADC data to obtain two-dimensional matrix data M x N to be processed, wherein M is a fast time sampling point, and N is a slow time sampling point. And carrying out Range FFT on the M-N two-dimensional matrix along a fast time axis to lock a target distance gate, and extracting a target position life signal according to the target distance gate. And performing time-frequency analysis or spectrum estimation on the extracted vital signals to perform vital sign estimation to obtain heart rate and respiratory rate parameters, and finally performing abnormal classification on the heart rate and respiratory rate to perform health monitoring.

title_en: Omnibearing three-dimensional life monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an omnibearing three-dimensional life monitoring system, which aims to solve the technical problem that the current life monitoring system needs to be worn, and mainly comprises front-end acquisition equipment, edge computing equipment and a background server; the invention adopts a completely unconstrained and non-contact monitoring mode to monitor the change condition of each data of vital signs of a suspected person in real time, and simultaneously monitors the state and vital sign data of a target in real time by accessing audio and video data, radar data and optical fiber positioning data through an intelligent monitoring sensing device equipped for rooms and beds to infer the psychological condition of the target and discover abnormal timely automatic alarm. Once any sudden illness or sudden situation appears in personnel, the intelligent monitoring sensing device can monitor the change that the health produced in the first time to in time the police on duty is informed in the alarm, effectively promotes prevention and control factor of safety, reduces the nurse risk.

title_en: Method and device for detecting life
abstract_en: To provide a method and device for detecting life.SOLUTION: A life detection device is provided, comprising: a first data processing unit for removing an average value of a wave motion of a radar signal; a second data processing unit for filtering radar signal data on the basis of the wave motion of the radar signal, and/or intensity of the radar signal, and/or the size of a detection area; and a detection unit for determining the presence or absence of life on the basis of candidate radar signal data obtained after processing by the first data processing unit and the second data processing unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Vital sign detection method, system, equipment and medium based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign detection method, a system, equipment and a medium based on machine learning, which are used for monitoring a target by utilizing a millimeter wave radar to obtain target information; inputting target information into a pre-established monitoring model to obtain vital sign signals, wherein the vital sign signals comprise respiratory signals and heartbeat signals; the process for establishing the monitoring model comprises the following steps: monitoring different targets by utilizing a millimeter wave radar to obtain target information, wherein the target information comprises a target signal and a target echo signal; synthesizing the target signal and the target echo signal into an intermediate frequency signal; performing signal processing on the intermediate frequency signal to obtain a respiration signal corresponding frequency and a heartbeat signal corresponding frequency; constructing a plurality of R-D graphs by taking the corresponding frequency of the respiratory signal and the corresponding frequency of the heartbeat signal as labels; training the learning model through a plurality of R-D graphs to obtain a monitoring model.
assignees: INTERSECT INFORMATION CORE TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE XIAN CO LTD;XIAN SHENXIN KECHUANG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Underground nonmetallic pipeline positioning detection method
abstract_en: The application provides a positioning detection method of an underground nonmetallic pipeline, which comprises the steps of moving a multi-frequency microwave probe in a target area, marking a position designated by a target indicator on the ground as a first position when a microwave signal receiver receives microwave signals reflected by the underground nonmetallic pipeline, rotating the multi-frequency microwave probe to enable an included angle beta between the indication direction of the target indicator and the vertical direction to be 90 degrees and more than 0 degrees, moving the multi-frequency microwave probe along the first direction, marking the position designated by the target indicator on the ground as a second position when the microwave signal receiver receives the microwave signals, and obtaining the burial depth D of the underground nonmetallic pipeline according to the beta, the distance L between the first position and the second position and a first operation rule. By the technical scheme, the buried depth of the underground nonmetallic pipeline can be rapidly positioned, so that the later management and maintenance of the pipeline are facilitated.

title_en: Smart diffuser with non-contact bio-signal measurement function
title_ko: 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨져
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart diffuser including a non-contact bio-signal measurement function, and more specifically, to a smart diffuser including a non-contact bio-signal measurement function, wherein air quality management customized for the indoor position of a resident, the living pattern of the resident by the measurement of bio-signals, and each space can be performed in a non-contact manner using an RF radar. The smart diffuser including a non-contact bio-signal measurement function according to the present invention can track, in real time, the position of a resident in a non-contact manner using an RF radar and can analyze the amount of activity, thereby enabling air quality management customized for each living space. In addition, the smart diffuser including a non-contact bio-signal measurement function according to the present invention measures the respiration rate and the heart rate of a resident in real time in a non-contact manner using an RF radar to check whether an emergency situation occurs and to enable prompt follow-up measures, and can recognize an intruder by analyzing the activity pattern and bio-signals of the resident.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨져에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 RF레이더를 활용하여 비접촉 방식으로 거주자의 실내 위치, 생체신호 측정을 통한 거주자의 생활패턴 및 공간별 맞춤형 공기질 관리가 가능한 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨져에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨져는 RF레이더를 활용하여 비접촉 방식으로 거주자의 위치를 실시간으로 추적 및 활동량을 분석하고, 이에 따른 주거 공간별로 맞춤형 공기질 관리가 가능한 장점이 있다.  
또한, 본 발명에 따른 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨져는 RF레이더를 활용하여 비접촉 방식으로 거주자의 호흡수 및 심박수를 실시간 측정함으로써 응급상황 발생 여부를 확인 및 신속한 후속조치가 가능하고, 거주자의 활동패턴 및 생체신호 분석을 통해 침입자 인식이 가능한 장점이 있다.

title_en: A leak detection system for water and sewage pipes using 3D surface penetration radar and a leak verification system for water and sewage pipes
title_ko: 3차원 지표투과레이더를 이용한 상하수관의 누수탐사 시스템 및 상하수관의 누수검증 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a leak detection system for water and sewage pipes including a 3D ground penetrating radar (GPR) for checking a passing speed of fluid passing through a pipe network, a difference in reflection intensity through a phase change and a dielectric constant difference on a radar-gram, and a change in depth of a reflection boundary in order to check whether there is a water leak in the pipe network buried underground. Therefore, regardless of the buried depth of the water and sewage pipes, the size of the water and sewage pipes, the water and sewage pipe leaks, and the material of the water and sewage pipes, the signal reflected from an upper boundary of the pipe is used to detect water and sewage pipes buried underground to identify leakage parts.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지하에 매설되어 있는 관망의 누수 여부를 확인하기 위하여, 관망을 통과하는 유체의 통과속도, 레이더 그램상의 위상변화 및 유전율 차이를 통한 반사강도의 차이 및 반사 경계면의 심도변화를 확인하는 3차원 지표투과레이더(GRP, Ground Penetrating Radar)를 포함하는, 상하수관의 누수탐사 시스템을 제공한다. 
따라서 상하수관의 매설깊이, 상하수관 크기, 상하수관 누수, 상하수관 재질에 상관없이 관로의 상부 경계면으로부터 반사된 신호를 이용하여 지하에 매설되어 있는 상ㅇ하수관을 탐지하여 누수부위를 파악할 수 있다.

title_en: Early recognition device for slope geological disasters
abstract_en: The utility model provides a slope geological disaster early-stage identification device, which comprises a main telescopic rod, wherein a plurality of telescopic connecting rods are fixedly connected to the main telescopic rod in the height direction, a clamp is fixedly connected to the telescopic connecting rods, a bottom plate is fixedly connected to the main telescopic rod, a mounting plate is arranged on one side of the bottom plate, a monitoring pipeline is arranged below the bottom plate, a plurality of strain sensors are respectively and fixedly connected to the mounting plate and the monitoring pipeline, the mounting plate can rotate so as to adjust the height of the strain sensors on the mounting plate, the main telescopic rod can adjust the required height according to the environment, the clamp can be fixedly connected with trunks with different heights so as to fix the device, the strain sensors can detect stratum deformation and landslide surface deformation and upload detection data, and by arranging the clamp, the clamp can be fixed by using forest trees, so that the device has good stability and is suitable for long-term use; through setting up the monitoring pipeline and the mounting panel that can angle regulation under the buried stratum, can adapt to the forest area that deep trench, stratum show few, topography are complicated.
assignees: ZHEJIANG HUADONG CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Sensor-fusion-based blood pressure measurement
abstract_en: Various arrangements for measuring blood pressure using sensor fusion are presented herein. Radio frequency (RF) signals are emitted and RF reflection signals are received by a radar sensor of a stationary device. The RF reflection signals are analyzed at a first distance range to identify a first pulse pressure waveform (PPW) at an aortic valve of a user. Vital sign data measured at an extremity of the user by a mobile device are received by the stationary device. The vital sign data is analyzed to identify a second PPW at the extremity of the user. Using the first PPW and the second PPW, a pulse transit time from the aortic valve to the extremity is determined. Using the PTT, a blood pressure (BP) of the user is determined and an indication of the BP is output.

title_en: Physiological parameter monitoring system and method and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a physiological parameter monitoring system and method and a storage medium, wherein the system comprises a first measuring part, a second measuring part and a processor. On the one hand, the technical scheme uses one measuring part to mainly measure vital signs and the other measuring part to mainly measure actions, so that interference conditions can be comprehensively judged in an information correction mode, and the condition that vital sign measurement is inaccurate due to a single measuring part is avoided; on the other hand, the problem of poor anti-interference performance when the radar equipment is singly used for carrying out non-contact vital sign measurement can be solved by adding the second measuring part in the technical scheme, and the reliability of the system can be enhanced by selecting, fusing or correcting the information measured by different measuring parts and participating in the processing process of the vital sign information, so that a more accurate vital sign measurement result is obtained.
assignees: SHENZHEN MINDRAY BIOMEDICAL ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Millimeter wave radar-based fire fighting search and rescue system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar-based fire protection search and rescue system and method, when a fire disaster occurs in a fire protection monitoring area, a smoke sensing module of the invention sends a smoke sensing signal to a signal trigger switch to trigger a millimeter wave radar to operate, the millimeter wave radar is used for detecting the position information and the vital sign information of trapped personnel in the monitoring area, an NB wireless transmission unit transmits the position information and the vital sign information to a search and rescue management platform for analysis and processing, and the search and rescue management platform obtains a fire protection search and rescue scheme and sends specific work task instructions to each execution end. Compared with the traditional carpet type search and rescue, the invention can rapidly make a correct rescue strategy, and the fire fighting search and rescue personnel can accurately capture the position information and the vital sign information of the trapped personnel, thereby being beneficial to rapidly and accurately rescuing the fire fighting search and rescue personnel, greatly shortening the rescue time, reducing the rescue difficulty and improving the survival rate of the trapped personnel.
assignees: GUIZHOU VOCATIONAL AND TECHNICAL COLLEGE OF WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER

title_en: Method and device for inversion of scattering measurement of buried targets in internal and external fields
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for inversion of scattering measurement of buried targets in an inner field and an outer field, wherein the method comprises an operation computer, a vector network analyzer, a power amplifier, a receiving and transmitting antenna and a bracket which are sequentially connected, a box with a low scattering film material is arranged below the receiving and transmitting antenna, a microwave darkroom is arranged at the periphery of the box, and a layer of wedge-shaped wave absorbing material is paved on the inner wall of the microwave darkroom; collecting soil of a target field to be measured and preparing an experimental model; placing the buried target in soil for measurement, calculation and analysis and collecting parameter values; writing an initial neural network, and inverting buried target parameters; substituting the measured experimental data into a neural network to obtain a trained neural network model under the soil; the invention has the characteristics that the FDTD method and the BP neural network are used as core algorithms, and the electromagnetic scattering measurement and the machine learning method are utilized to jointly solve the problem of carrying out scattering measurement on the buried target.

title_en: Life detection positioning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection positioning system and a life detection positioning method, comprising an unmanned aerial vehicle, a life detection radar, a path planning module and an SLAM system, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle is provided with the life detection radar, the path planning module and the SLAM system to detect a disaster area. The life detection radar can locate relative position information between a living body and the unmanned aerial vehicle in a disaster area. The path planning module can plan the next moving path of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the positioned relative position information, the unmanned aerial vehicle can plan the moving path according to the path planning module, the unmanned aerial vehicle goes to the position of the living body before and returns to the position of the rescue personnel from the position of the living body. After the unmanned aerial vehicle reaches the position of the living body, the carried SLAM system is started, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can start to return to the navigation, a three-dimensional map model corresponding to the return route is synchronously constructed by taking the position of the living body as a starting point, and the three-dimensional map model is provided for a rescuer to refer to, so that the rescuer can conveniently make a rescue route.
assignees: CHINESE PLA ARMY SPECIALIZED MEDICAL CT

title_en: Sign measurement system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a millimeter wave radar-based sign measurement system which can accurately extract and measure vital sign signals of human bodies in different directions. The invention carries out human vital sign measurement based on the linear frequency modulation continuous millimeter wave radar, provides a dynamic circle center tracking algorithm aiming at the DC offset existing in the I/Q two paths of signals, determines the existing DC offset, further corrects the I/Q two paths, removes the DC component and reduces the phase estimation error caused by the DC offset; the multi-channel signal is realized by using the MIMO virtual aperture technology, the distance-azimuth image is constructed, and the interference in other directions is further suppressed by using the self-adaptive beam forming technology, so that the existence azimuth of the human body is determined, and the accurate extraction and measurement of the vital sign signals of the human body in different azimuth are realized.
assignees: BIT RACO ELECTRONIC INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Blood pressure waveform measuring sensor and blood pressure measuring device
title_ko: 혈압 파형 측정센서 및 그의 혈압 측정장치
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a sensor which measures biological signals such as blood pressure waveforms, and a blood pressure measuring device equipped with such a sensor to measure blood pressure. In the present invention, the measuring sensor comprises: a first metal sheet which acts as a ground and has a hole in the center; a first insulator located below the first metal sheet and having a hole formed in the center; a second metal sheet located below the first insulator and functioning as a patch; a second insulator located below the second metal sheet; and a signal pin which penetrates the hole and has an end in contact with the second metal sheet. And when an electromagnetic field is supplied through the signal pin, the impedance formed in the second metal sheet is measured to sense the blood pressure waveform.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 혈압 파형과 같은 생체 신호를 측정하는 센서, 그리고 이러한 센서가 구비되어 혈압을 측정하는 혈압 측정장치를 제안한다. 본 발명에서 측정 센서는, 그라운드(Ground)로 작용하며 중앙에 홀이 형성된 제1 메탈 시트, 상기 제1 메탈 시트 하부에 위치하며 중앙에 홀이 형성된 제1 절연체, 상기 제1 절연체 하부에 위치하며 패치로 작용하는 제2 메탈 시트, 상기 제2 메탈 시트 하부에 위치하는 제2 절연체, 및 상기 홀을 관통하며 끝 단은 상기 제2 메탈 시트와 접촉하는 신호 핀을 포함하여 구성된다. 그리고 상기 신호 핀을 통해 전자기장이 급전되면 상기 제2 메탈 시트에 형성되는 임피던스를 측정하여 혈압 파형을 센싱한다.

title_en: Radar-based single target vital sensing
abstract_en: In an embodiment, a method includes: generating a target displacement signal indicative of a movement of a human target based on raw digital data generated by a millimeter-wave radar sensor; and estimating a vital sign of the human target based on the target displacement signal, where generating the target displacement signal includes: generating target in-phase (I) and quadrature (Q) (I/Q) data associated with the human target based on the raw digital data, classifying the target I/Q data as high quality data or as low quality data using a first neural network, when the target I/Q data is classified as low quality data, discarding the target I/Q data, when the target I/Q data is classified as high quality data, performing ellipse fitting on the target I/Q data to generate compensated I/Q data, and generating the target displacement signal based on the compensated I/Q data.
assignees: INFINEON TECHNOLOGIES AG;UNIV FRIEDRICH ALEXANDER ER

title_en: Coal gas stratum landslide body monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a monitoring device for a landslide body of a coal gas stratum, which comprises the following components: the device comprises an inclinometer catheter, a sensor probe, a bearing cable, a reader and a probe pulley block; the inclinometer is characterized in that the inclinometer conduit is buried in a coal gas stratum landslide body, the top of the inclinometer conduit is provided with a fixed pulley block, one end of a bearing cable is connected with the top end of the sensor probe, and the other end of the bearing cable is connected with the reader; the bearing cable is fixed at the top of the inclinometry conduit through a fixed pulley block. The beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows: the monitoring data is transmitted and stored to the reader through the bearing cable, the data is tidied and analyzed in time, the deep displacement and deformation trend of the landslide can be intuitively and accurately judged, reliable and real basic data is provided for engineering design and construction, the monitoring effect on the landslide body of the coal gas stratum is good, and the monitoring device is simple to operate and convenient to use.
assignees: HANGZHOU INSTITUTE OF TRANSP PLANNING AND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the fields of medical care and health monitoring, in particular to a non-contact vital sign monitoring method, which comprises the following steps: 1) Respectively carrying out data acquisition on the I/O two paths of signals of the radar module at a set sampling frequency to obtain a data frame signal group of the I/O two paths of signals; wherein, the signal buffered every second is used as a frame of data; 2) Respectively carrying out time domain analysis on the data frame signal groups of the I/O two-path signals, and judging the implantation state and the body movement state of the user; and respectively carrying out frequency domain analysis on the data frame signal groups of the I/O two paths of signals to obtain the breathing times and the heart rate times of the user. The invention provides a method for carrying out vital body detection by fusing various vital sign information, which realizes implantation/separation judgment, body movement intensity judgment, breath count (breath holding) calculation and heart rate count calculation under the same equipment, can effectively monitor four vital sign information of an implantation person, and is also suitable for scenes of other vital body detection such as post-disaster rescue and the like.

title_en: System for monitoring leakage piping of underground and buried pipe
title_ko: 지하 매설관의 누수배관 및 누수지반 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: A water leak detection monitoring system for an underground buried pipe according to an embodiment comprises: a first sensor for detecting temperature change information generated from an underground buried pipe; a second sensor disposed at predetermined intervals on the buried pipe and detecting an acoustic emission signal; a controller for determining a leakage range around the buried pipe using a temperature distribution and an average value of the temperature around the buried pipe based on the temperature change information around the buried pipe detected by the first sensor, and determining the location of at least one buried pipe leakage based on a change in a vibration frequency and a change in a propagation speed of a leakage sound of a buried pipe fluid detected by the second sensor; and a monitoring module for outputting at least one buried pipe leakage information by converting to a digital signal for a leakage range around a buried pipe and the location of the buried pipe leakage and providing alarm information if the outputted buried pipe leakage information exceeds a preset range. Accordingly, it is possible to accurately determine the location of a leaky pipe of a buried pipe buried underground.
abstract_ko: 실시예에 따른 지하 매설관의 누수 검출 모니터링 시스템은 지하 매설관으로부터 발생하는 온도변화정보를 검출하는 제1 센서; 매설관 상에 소정간격으로 배치되며, 음향방출 신호를 검출하는 제2 센서; 제1 센서에서 감지한 상기 매설관 주변의 온도변화정보에 의존하여 매설관 주변 온도 분포와 평균 값을 이용하여 매설관 주변 누수범위를 결정하며, 제2 센서에서 감지한 매설관 유체 누수음 진동 주파수 변화 및 전파 속도 변화에 의존하여 적어도 하나 이상의 매설관 누수위치를 결정하는 컨트롤러; 매설관 주변 누수범위와, 상기 매설관 누수위치에 대하여 디지털 신호로 변환하여 적어도 하나 이상의 매설관 누수정보를 출력하고, 상기 출력된 매설관 누수정보가 미리 설정된 범위를 초과하는 경우, 알람 정보를 제공하는 모니터링 모듈; 을 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: Leakage pipe and ground monitoring system of underground buried pipe
title_ko: 지하 매설관의 누수 관로 및 지반 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: A leakage pipe and ground monitoring system of an underground buried pipe according to an embodiment can improve the reliability and efficiency of underground pipe maintenance through inspection and analysis of leaky pipes and leaky ground of underground pipes, including heat transport pressure pipes for district heating. Specifically, in the embodiment, a leakage area of the buried pipe can be identified through analysis of vibration signals including ground penetrating radar (GPR) signals, heat distribution signals, and elastic waves. The leakage pipe and ground monitoring system of an underground buried pipe includes a ground penetrating radar (GPR); a non-contact GPR receiving antenna; a thermal imaging camera; at least one vibration detection sensor; a controller; and vehicles.
abstract_ko:
실시예에 따른 지하 매설관의 누수 관로 및 지반 모니터링 시스템은 지역난방용 열수송 압력 관로를 포함하는 지하 매설관의 누수관 및 누수지반의 탐상 및 분석을 통하여 지하 매설관 유지관리의 신뢰성 및 효율성을 향상시킨다. 
구체적으로, 실시예에서는 지표투과레이더(GPR)신호, 열분포 신호, 탄성파를 포함하는 진동신호 분석을 통해 매설관의 누수영역을 파악할 수 있도록 한다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: Multi radar sendor-based biosignal measurement system and method
title_ko: 멀티 레이더 센서 기반 생체 신호 측정 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: A multi-radar sensor-based biological signal measurement system and method are disclosed. The multi-radar sensor-based biological signal measurement system according to the present invention includes: a multi-sensor unit consisting of first and second radar sensors and detecting biological signals of a subject using the first and second radar sensors; and a signal analysis unit selecting one of the first and second radar sensors and receiving and analyzing the biological signal detected by the selected radar sensor.
abstract_ko: 멀티 레이더 센서 기반 생체 신호 측정 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 멀티 레이더 센서 기반 생체 신호 측정 시스템은 제1 및 제2 레이더 센서로 구성되고 상기 제1 및 제2 레이더 센서를 이용하여 피검체의 생체 신호를 감지하는 멀티 센서부, 및 상기 제1 및 제2 레이더 센서 중 어느 하나의 레이더 센서를 선택하고 상기 선택된 레이더 센서에 의해 감지된 생체 신호를 수신하여 분석하는 신호 분석부를 포함한다.

title_en: Tailing body safety monitoring system and monitoring method based on InSAR and optical fiber sensing technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a tailing body safety monitoring system and a monitoring method based on InSAR and optical fiber sensing technology, comprising mine and satellite InSAR and unmanned aerial vehicle LiDAR data around the tailing body, safety monitoring wells distributed in a grid shape on the tailing body, three-component distributed acoustic wave sensing optical fibers fixed outside a monitoring well sleeve, distributed strain or displacement sensing optical fibers, distributed temperature sensing optical fibers and a composite modem instrument. Real-time displacement investigation of a local displacement area is carried out on a mining area and a tailing stacking body by depending on satellite InSAR and unmanned aerial vehicle LiDAR data, and meanwhile, parameters such as temperature, strain or deformation, displacement, microseism events, change of groundwater level and the like of the tailing body are monitored in real time according to a grid armor monitoring optical cable which is arranged on the tailing body and is buried outside a downhole casing of a safety monitoring well and at the front end face of the tailing body, so that land areas where tailing body landslide or dam break are likely to occur are reinforced and early warning information is issued in time, and geological disasters such as dam break and the like are timely avoided.
assignees: CNPC AOBO CHENGDU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign detection method and device based on radar, radar and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a vital sign detection method and device based on radar, the radar and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: extracting vital signs of a user based on echo signals obtained by detecting the surface area of the bed body by the radar when the user is in the bed; if the vital sign of the current vital sign monitoring period is smaller than a preset vital sign threshold value, acquiring a distance unit and a corresponding signal amplitude value of a user in echo signals of N continuous calculation periods before the current vital sign monitoring period; if the distance unit where the user is located in the echo signals of N continuous calculation periods before the current vital sign monitoring period is continuously increased and the corresponding signal amplitude is continuously reduced, judging that the user has the bed leaving action, otherwise, judging that the user does not have the bed leaving action, and generating an alarm signal with weak vital signs of the current frame. By the method, the two conditions of bed separation and weak heartbeat of the person can be accurately distinguished, the false alarm rate is reduced, and the accuracy of vital sign detection is ensured.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar antenna device for vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar antenna device for vital sign monitoring, which comprises a base, wherein a monitoring equipment main body is rotatably connected to the base, an antenna assembly is arranged at the top end of the monitoring equipment main body, the monitoring equipment main body comprises a bottom plate, a housing and a locking rod, the antenna assembly comprises a casing, a top cover and an antenna plate, and the casing is connected with the housing through a pull plate. According to the invention, the antenna assembly which can be independently extended and the orientation angle can be adjusted on the monitoring equipment main body, so that the orientation of the antenna plate in the antenna assembly can be changed along with the change of the orientation of the antenna assembly, and the orientation angle of the antenna plate can be manually adjusted, so that the direction of sending and receiving signals by the antenna plate can be opposite to a patient needing vital sign monitoring, the monitoring error is reduced, and the accuracy of monitoring data is increased.
assignees: CHINESE PLA ARMY SPECIALIZED MEDICAL CT

title_en: Non-excavation accurate positioning method and device for deeply buried underground pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-excavation accurate positioning method and device for underground pipelines, comprising the following steps of arranging a movable detection trolley on the ground, carrying out positioning detection by a ground penetrating radar and an adjustable induction coil type accurate positioner on the detection trolley, regulating the ground penetrating radar to be close to the ground to be detected in a rotating mode, inquiring the distribution condition of underground metal or nonmetal pipelines, analyzing the strength of signals between induction coils to judge the moving direction through regulating the interval between the induction coils, and carrying out pitching regulation and storage when in idle through the ground penetrating radar mechanism.

title_en: Human body breathing and heartbeat detection method based on improved BP neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of radar signal processing, in particular to a human breath and heartbeat detection method based on an improved BP neural network, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out wavelet denoising treatment on an original vital signal acquired by a radar, then utilizing an improved self-adaptive fully integrated empirical mode decomposition (ICEEMDAN) algorithm to decompose the radar original thoracic signal to obtain a plurality of modal functions (IMFs) with different spatial scales, and then predicting and optimizing IMF components through the BP neural network improved by an immune Genetic Algorithm (GA); the invention has good noise robustness, can effectively separate noise and accurately extract respiratory and heartbeat signals, and improves the reconstruction accuracy and the signal-to-noise ratio of the sign signals.

title_en: Non-contact sleep respiration monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-contact sleep respiration monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar. The method comprises the following steps: s1, scanning the upper body of a tester through an integrated radar sensor to obtain radar original data; s2, carrying out data preprocessing on the radar original data to obtain heartbeat data, breathing data and breathing heartbeat rate parameters of each window time; s3, positioning abnormal events according to the waveform change condition of the radar data, extracting relevant features, and judging respiratory obstruction and classifying and judging body movement events. The invention combines the monitoring of vital signs and the detection of apnea and falling events in body movement in the whole night with an alarm mechanism, is more suitable for sleep monitoring in household scenes, can generate more reliable sleep reports and reflects real sleep conditions.

title_en: Moving target tracking method based on overcomplete angle dictionary optimization technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a moving target tracking method based on an overcomplete angle dictionary optimization technology, which comprises the steps of obtaining echo signals of a moving target by adopting a Doppler through-wall radar module; estimating and processing the echo signal by adopting a windowing time-frequency analysis method to obtain an instantaneous frequency value; fitting the instantaneous frequency value by adopting a high-order polynomial model to obtain a fitting curve; solving an instantaneous frequency inclination angle through a fitting curve, and further constructing an overcomplete instantaneous frequency inclination angle dictionary; performing time-frequency analysis processing on the echo signals by adopting an inclination angle dictionary to obtain optimal parameter domain distribution; processing the optimal parameter domain distribution by adopting a signal demodulation technology, extracting and processing the demodulated signal by adopting a characteristic value classification technology, and constructing an instantaneous frequency component set of the echo signal; and synthesizing the track of the moving target through the instantaneous frequency component set to finish the tracking processing of the moving target. The invention has high target positioning precision and good tracking effect.

title_en: Method and device for identifying human behaviors of rapid multi-scale through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for identifying human body behaviors of a rapid multi-scale through-wall radar, which are used for constructing a lightweight deep neural network with multi-scale characteristic information mining capability by combining a super-resolution Doppler estimation model based on a nuclear distance, a lightweight non-anchor single-stage target detection network model and a lightweight classification network model according to frequency stepping radar data, synchronously extracting translation information of a human body in a complex through-wall environment and generated mu-D characteristics, mixing the two scales of information to carry out decision recognition, and finally giving out a through-wall radar human body motion recognition result.

title_en: Error correction method for random body movement of target in millimeter wave radar vital sign detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses an error correction method for random body movement of targets in millimeter wave radar vital sign detection, which comprises the steps of separating signals of each target from radar echo signals; tracking echo signals in each target detection time; correcting respiratory heartbeat detection errors caused by random body movement of the target during detection based on a distance alignment and phase compensation algorithm; extracting a phase signal of a target, and decomposing the phase signal into N modes by using a successive variation mode decomposition algorithm; and identifying K modules corresponding to the vital signs, and reconstructing respiratory signals and heartbeat signals according to the K modules. The method can realize the simultaneous detection of the vital signs of a plurality of targets in the radar visual field range; the detection error caused by random movement of the target body in the radar detection process is corrected; the respiratory heartbeat signal of the target is extracted by adopting the successive variation modal decomposition algorithm, the number of modalities is not required to be set in advance, and the convergence speed is higher compared with that of the variation modal decomposition algorithm.

title_en: Ultra-wideband radar life detection algorithm based on SE and SSD
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wideband radar life detection algorithm based on SE and SSD, and belongs to the technical field of radar life detection. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing clutter and noise signals in original radar echo signals by adopting a channel signal subtraction method, a direct subtraction average method, linear trend suppression, automatic gain control, slow time filtering and other methods, and then carrying out echo selection by calculating time delay corresponding to a SE value peak value of radar receiving pulses along the slow time direction so as to position a target. Selecting and recombining the signals on these adjacent range gates based on the SE values may obtain more vital sign information than a single frame signal and may reduce the observation time. And decomposing and reconstructing radar echo signals by using SSD, reconstructing the signals according to the energy percentage of SSCs in the breathing and heartbeat frequency bands obtained by decomposition, and calculating the breathing and heartbeat frequency by using FFT. The radar life detection method provided by the invention can accurately locate the target and extract the life information, effectively improves the signal to noise ratio, and has wide research value and application prospect.

title_en: FMCW radar target detection method for vital signal detection
title_ko: 생체 신호 감지를 위한 fmcw 레이다 목표물 탐지 측정 방법
abstract_en: An FMCW radar target detection method for vital signal detection is provided. A vital signal detection method using radar according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: using the correlation between the phase change profile of an IF signal due to fine movement and a target signal intensity change profile to select a range bin where an accurate vital signal exists. Thus, it is possible to increase the estimation accuracy of biological signals through accurate tracking of people (targets), and to accurately remove clutter by utilizing the phase unwrapping technology that is adaptive to a change in upper body movement compared to the 180-degree fixed phase unwrapping technology.
abstract_ko: 생체 신호 감지를 위한 FMCW 레이다 목표물 탐지 측정 방법이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 레이다를 이용한 생체 신호 감지 방법은, 미세 움직임으로 인한 IF 신호의 위상 변화 프로파일과 표적 신호 세기 변화 프로파일 간의 상관관계를 이용하여 정확한 생체 신호가 존재하는 거리 빈을 선택함으로써, 사람(표적)에 대한 정확한 추적을 통해 생체 신호의 추정 정확성을 높이고, 180도 고정형 위상 언래핑 기술 대비 상체 움직임 변화량에 적응형인 위상 언래핑 기술을 활용하여 클러터를 정확하게 제거할 수 있다.

title_en: Intelligent through-obstruction 3d imaging system using uwb electromagnetic sensing for object detection
abstract_en: Herein disclosed a system and method to utilize information from imaging sensor and UWB sensor to perform object recognition, object tracking, activity recognition, vital sign detection, and 3D image reconstruction through any obstruction. This proposed invention uses deep learning algorithm and neural network to perform feature extraction of image data and signal data, identify depth estimation, recognize object and track its activity, and construct a 3D model of the object even though the object is not visible or overlapped with other objects.

title_en: Alarm system to prevent safety accidents caused by flooding of underpasses
title_ko: 지하차도 침수로 인한 안전사고 방지를 위한 경보시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present document is an alarm system that can effectively deliver a danger of entering an underpass during heavy rainfall to a driver to prevent the driver from recklessly entering the underpass. The alarm system according to an embodiment comprises: a water level sensor provided inside an underpass; a drainage pump provided inside the underpass; a drainage pipe having one end connected to the drainage pump and the other end located outside the underpass; a spray nozzle buried in the ground at an entrance of the underpass; a branch pipe connecting the drainage pipe with the spray nozzle; an electronic valve provided in the branch pipe and opening and closing the branch pipe; and a control unit controlling the drainage pump and the electronic valve based on information obtained by the water level sensor.
abstract_ko:
본 문건은 집중호우시 지하차도 진입의 위험성을 운전자에게 효과적으로 전달하여, 운전자의 무모한 지하차도 진입을 막을 수 있는 경보시스템을 개시한다. 
실시예에 따른 경보시스템은, 지하차도 내부에 구비되는 수위센서; 지하차도 내부에 구비되는 배수펌프; 일단이 상기 배수펌프와 연결되고, 타단의 상기 지하차도의 외부에 위치되는 배수파이프; 지하차도의 입구 지면에 매설되는 분사노즐; 상기 배수파이프와 상기 분사노즐를 연결하는 분기파이프; 상기 분기파이프에 구비되어, 상기 분기파이프를 개폐하는 전자밸브; 및 상기 수위센서로 획득된 정보를 바탕으로, 상기 배수펌프와 상기 전자밸브를 제어하는 제어유닛;을 포함한다.

title_en: System for Emergency Notification of Solitude Oldster
title_ko: 독거노인의 응급상황 알림 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for notifying an emergency situation of the elderly living alone. More specifically, the present invention relates to a system for notifying an emergency situation of the elderly living alone, which is able to detect and analyze the status of the elderly living alone through bio signals, detect information on an emergency situation in real time, transmit the information to a management server, and allow the rapid response to the emergency situation. Therefore, the present invention provides a system for notifying an emergency situation of the elderly living alone, which comprises: a terminal including a sensor worn on the wrist of an elderly living alone and detecting bio signals periodically, and a communication unit transmitting the signal received from the sensor along with location information to a management server; and the management server analyzing the bio signals received from the terminal, and comparing the bio signals with pre-saved data, and, if it is determined that there is an emergency situation, transmitting the emergency situation information to the emergency rescue institution which is the closest to the location of the terminal transmitted from the terminal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 독거노인의 응급상황 알림 시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 독거노인의 상태를 생체신호를 통해 감지하고 분석하여 실시간으로 응급상황에 대한 정보를 감지하여 관리서버에 관리전송함으로 신속하게 응급상황에 대처할 수 있도록 된 독거노인의 응급상황 알림 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
따라서 본 발명은 독거노인의 손목에 착용하여 생체신호를 주기적으로 감지하는 센서와 이 센서로부터 전달받은 신호를 위치정보와 함께 관리서버에 전송하는 통신부로 이루어지는 단말기; 상기 단말기로부터 전달 받은 생체신호를 분석하여 미리 저장된 데이터와 비교하여 응급상황이라고 판단될 경우 상기 단말기로부터 송신된 단말기의 위치와 가장 가까운 응급구조기관으로 응급상황 정보를 송신하는 관리서버;를 포함하는 독거노인의 응급상황 알림 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Pilot distress call device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pilot distress device, which comprises: the device comprises a shell, wherein keys, an air pressure sensor, an ambient temperature sensor, a display screen, a charging interface, a heart rate blood oxygen sensor and a body surface temperature sensor are arranged on the shell; the shell is internally provided with a controller, a clock module, a communication positioning module, a power module, a memory and a motion sensor; the controller is used for controlling the working mode switching, the state information acquisition, the activity state judgment and the vital sign state classification of the device, and realizing manual and automatic distress alarm after the pilot is in danger. According to the invention, under the complex condition, the influence of human body activity states and environmental factors on vital sign states can be comprehensively considered, the classification of the vital sign states can be comprehensively and accurately identified, help calling can be actively or automatically carried out, warning information of pilots can be sent to a management center, timely and accurate information can be provided for pilot search and rescue, and search and rescue progress can be accelerated.
assignees: CHINESE PEOPLES LIBERATION ARMY AIR FORCE CHARACTERISTIC MEDICAL CENTER

title_en: Method and system for positioning trapped person based on four-dimensional biological radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for positioning trapped people based on four-dimensional biological radar. The method comprises the following steps: s1, rearranging echo data acquired by a four-dimensional biological radar to form a three-dimensional complex matrix; s2, obtaining a three-dimensional complex radar image after filtering, and splicing the three-dimensional complex radar image obtained by continuous measurement into a four-dimensional radar image sequence according to time sequence; s3, calculating the energy entropy ratio of the four-dimensional radar image sequence; s4, weighting energy entropy ratio of the four-dimensional radar image sequence along a time dimension; s5, detecting a plurality of targets in each frame of three-dimensional image of the four-dimensional radar image sequence, and clustering, wherein a clustering center is used as the three-dimensional position coordinates of each human body target; s6, respectively extracting vital sign signals corresponding to each human body from voxels at the three-dimensional position coordinates along the time dimension. The invention greatly improves the signal-to-noise ratio after processing, improves the signal-to-noise ratio of the buried human body detection by more than 30dB, and can realize human body detection and three-dimensional positioning of the buried human body with the depth of tens of meters.

title_en: Control method and system of electrical wheel-chair for autonomous moving
title_ko: 전동휠체어의 자율주행 제어 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: An autonomous driving control system for an electric wheelchair comprises an electric wheelchair that is configured to autonomously drive to a first destination within or outside a certain space while monitoring the health status of an occupant through at least one bio-signal sensor and a central server that manages a CCTV installed inside and outside the space. The central server comprises: a detection unit that detects location-specific environmental information inside and outside the certain space from location-specific image information of the CCTV; a communication unit that transmits map information inside and outside the certain space and the environmental information to the electric wheelchair and receives emergency information of the occupant from the electric wheelchair when the health status of the occupant is an emergency; and an emergency processing unit that selects second destination information where emergency treatment can be performed based on the emergency information and transmits the second destination to the electric wheelchair. The electric wheelchair moves autonomously by setting a first route to the first destination based on the map information and the environmental information, and when the second destination information is received, the electric wheelchair moves autonomously by setting a second route from the current location to the second destination. Accordingly, the system enables immediate patient transfer.
abstract_ko: 상기한 본 발명의 목적을 실현하기 위한 일 실시예에 따른 전동휠체어의 자율주행 제어 시스템에 있어서, 적어도 하나 이상의 생체 신호 센서를 통해 탑승자의 건강 상태를 모니터링하면서, 일정 공간 내외부의 제1 목적지까지 자율주행하도록 구성된 전동휠체어, 및 상기 일정 공간 내외부에 설치된 CCTV를 관리하는 중앙 서버를 포함하고, 상기 중앙 서버는, 상기 CCTV의 위치별 영상 정보로부터 상기 일정 공간 내외부의 위치별 환경정보를 감지하는 감지부, 상기 전동휠체어에 상기 일정 공간 내외부의 맵(map) 정보와 상기 환경정보를 송신하고, 탑승자의 건강 상태가 응급 상황인 경우, 상기 전동휠체어로부터 탑승자의 응급 상황 정보를 수신하는 통신부, 및 상기 응급 상황 정보에 기초하여, 응급 처치가 이루어질 수 있는 제2 목적지 정보를 선정하여 상기 전동휠체어에 송신하는 응급상황 처리부를 포함하고, 상기 전동휠체어는 상기 맵 정보와 상기 환경정보에 기초하여 제1 목적지까지의 제1 경로를 설정하여 자율주행으로 이동되고, 상기 제2 목적지 정보가 수신되면, 현재 위치로부터 상기 제2 목적지까지의 제2 경로를 재설정하여 자율주행으로 이동된다.

title_en: Method and system for contactless vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for vital sign monitoring using a radar sensor system (1), the radar sensor system (1) comprising a transmitter (2), a receiver (3) and processing device (5), wherein: the transmitter (2) irradiates (100) at least one body region (21) of a person (20) with radar radiation (30); the receiver (3) generates (110) a receiver signal from reflected radiation (11) from the at least one body region; the processing device (5) generates, for each of a plurality of processing windows, a displacement signal based on the receiver signal, which displacement signal characterizes a body motion comprising as oscillating motions a breathing motion and a heartbeat motion, and calculating an estimated fundamental frequency for at least one oscillating motion. In order provide reliable and efficient means for life sign monitoring, the invention provides that the processing device (5), based on the displacement signal, applies an adaptive Nonlinear Least Squares method to calculate (250) a plurality of frequency estimates (f r1 , f r2 , f r3 ), each of which corresponds to one of a plurality of harmonics of a first oscillating motion, wherein the processing device (5) uses an individual search region (A h1 , A h2 , A h3 ) for each frequency estimate (f r1 , f r2 , f r3 ), adapts at least one search region (A h1 , A h2 , A h3 ) for at least one processing window, and calculates (300) a first estimated fundamental frequency (f h ) for the first oscillating motion based on the frequency estimates (f r1 , f r2 , f r3 ).

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring system based on optical fiber sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster monitoring system based on optical fiber sensing, which comprises an optical fiber sensor and a plurality of optical transmitters which are in communication connection with the optical fiber sensor, wherein the optical transmitters are communicated with each other through communication optical fibers and form a monitoring network, and the optical transmitters are respectively connected to a monitoring center; the optical fiber sensor is buried in the area to be monitored in an M shape, and a plurality of acquisition ends are connected along the extending direction of the sensor optical fiber; the optical transmitter receives the electric signal of the optical fiber sensor and outputs an optical signal; the monitoring center receives the multipath optical signals sent by the plurality of optical transmitters and performs data processing.
assignees: STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION COMPANY

title_en: Vital sign detection method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a vital sign detection method and device, which are characterized in that a radar sensor is used for collecting data of a vital sign region to be detected, after the data is processed, a distance-energy mapping relation of a moving target is obtained after a static target in the vital sign region to be detected is removed, a distance-phase mapping relation of the moving target is obtained, and then at least one specified parameter corresponding to the distance is determined according to the two mapping relations. Wherein the specified parameter includes at least a high frequency signal duty cycle. And inputting the specified parameter corresponding to the at least one distance into a pre-constructed support vector machine model to obtain a vital sign detection result output by the support vector machine model. By determining the specified parameter corresponding to the at least one distance and further using the determined specified parameter as the input of the support vector machine model, whether vital signs exist in the vital sign region to be detected can be accurately determined according to the specified parameter at least comprising the high-frequency signal duty ratio.

title_en: Calcareous sand grouting diffusion reinforcement simulation device and experimental method in seawater environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a calcareous sand grouting diffusion reinforcement simulation device and an experimental method in a seawater environment, and belongs to the field of geological disaster prevention and control of island reef engineering. It comprises the following steps: the system comprises a seawater environment simulation system, a calcareous sand layer simulation system, a data acquisition and monitoring system and a grouting and slurry storage system; the seawater environment simulation system forms a seepage loop; the calcareous sand layer simulation system is arranged in the seawater environment simulation system, and two ends of the calcareous sand layer simulation system are respectively connected with two groups of grouting pipes and one group of exhaust ports; the data acquisition and detection system comprises pressure sensors buried in different positions of the calcareous sand layer, wherein the sensors are connected with a signal collector and are fed back to the computer control platform through the signal collector; and the grouting and slurry storage system inputs the slurry into the calcareous sand layer simulation system from the slurry storage barrel. The first water storage tank, the second water storage tank and the flow speed control mechanism can control the inlet and outlet and the flow speed of seawater and form a seepage loop, so that the real seawater environment can be accurately simulated and restored, and the grouting test simulation research is conveniently carried out indoors.

title_en: Multi-target behavior perception multipath elimination method for millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: A millimeter wave radar multi-target behavior perception multipath elimination method relates to the technical field of radar multipath elimination, and aims at the problems that in the prior art, under the condition of multi-target human body detection, due to the fact that targets are too many, interference exists between targets and detection accuracy is affected, the characteristics of ordered statistics are utilized, multipath interference and clutter are effectively restrained and eliminated, and the problem that under the condition of multi-target human body life detection, interference exists between targets and detection accuracy is affected due to the fact that targets are too many is solved. Meanwhile, multipath elimination is further verified through the coherence coefficient, and the robustness of the method is improved. The method can effectively improve the target detection and tracking performance of the radar system, and has higher practical value for applications such as behavior perception and the like.
assignees: ZHONGYI ZHILIAN WUXI INDUSTRIAL AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD;HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Underground base facilities protection system using DAS system and drone
title_ko: Ｄａｓ 시스템과 드론을 이용한 지중매설 기반 시설 보호 시스템
abstract_en: A system for protecting underground buried infrastructure using a distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) system and a drone is disclosed. The system for protecting underground buried infrastructure using a DAS system and a drone comprises: an integrated control server linked with an underground buried infrastructure management system including pipelines, power and communication cables, gas pipelines, and oil pipelines, and a distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) system using an optical communication cable; and a drone. When the distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) system detects excavation work related to the underground buried infrastructure (pipelines, power and communication cables, gas pipelines, and oil pipelines), the drone is urgently dispatched to arrive at the excavation site of the construction work, transmits camera image data captured by the drone to the integrated control server, and performs a remote warning broadcast to workers using a speaker of the drone to alert them to excavation caution during the construction work, thereby preventing damage to the underground buried infrastructure in advance. The drone includes a GPS receiver, a camera, a directional speaker, and a 13.56 MHz RFID tag. Accordingly, by performing a warning broadcast for construction excavation caution using the speaker of the drone, damage to the underground buried infrastructure can be prevented in advance.
abstract_ko:
DAS 시스템과 드론을 이용한 지중매설 기반 시설 보호 시스템이 개시된다. 
DAS 시스템과 드론을 이용한 지중매설 기반 시설 보호 시스템은 배관, 전력 및 통신 케이블, 가스관, 및 송유관이 포함된 지하매설물 관리 시스템과 광통신 케이블을 이용한 분산 음향 감시(DAS) 시스템과 연동된 통합관제 서버; 및 상기 분산 음향 감시(DAS) 시스템이 지중매설 기반 시설(배관, 전력 및 통신 케이블, 가스관, 송유관)에 관련된 굴착 공사가 감지되면, 드론을 긴급 출동시켜 건설 공사 굴착 현장에 도착하여 드론의 카메라 영상 촬영 데이터를 통합관제 서버로 전송하고, 드론의 스피커를 사용한 작업자들에게 건설 공사 굴착 주의 원격 경고 방송을 하여 상기 지중매설 기반 시설의 손상을 사전에 방지되도록 하며, GPS 수신기와 카메라와 지향성 스피커 및 13.56MHz RFID 태그가 부착된 드론을 포함한다. 따라서, 드론의 스피커를 사용한 건설 공사 굴착 주의 경고 방송을 함으로써 지중매설 기반시설 손상을 사전에 방지한다.

title_en: Ultra-wideband radar vital sign signal denoising algorithm based on PE and TVF-EMD
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wideband radar vital sign signal denoising algorithm based on PE and TVF-EMD, and belongs to the technical field of radar vital detection. Firstly, preprocessing clutter and noise signals in original radar echo signals by adopting methods such as channel signal subtraction, average subtraction, linear trend suppression, automatic gain control, fast time filtering, slow time filtering and the like; then, the position of a human body target is detected by adopting a PE algorithm through analyzing statistical characteristics such as kurtosis, standard deviation, variance and the like of data in a slow time direction. The optimization algorithm can conveniently and accurately locate the time when the signal is suddenly changed, and can amplify the fine change of the signal. And decomposing the extracted vital sign signals by adopting a TVF-EMD algorithm, calculating the respective energy duty ratio of each IMF component in the respiratory frequency band and the heartbeat frequency band after decomposition, selecting a proper signal for reconstruction, and finally carrying out spectrum analysis on the reconstructed signal by utilizing FFT (fast Fourier transform). The radar vital signal denoising method provided by the invention can accurately locate the target and extract the vital information, and the denoising result is quite considerable.

title_en: Emergency management method and system for the elderly using smart band
title_ko: 스마트 밴드를 이용한 노인 대상 응급상황 관리 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: Provided are a method and a system for managing an emergency situation for the elderly using a smart band. The method of the present invention comprises the steps of: monitoring, by a smart band worn by the elderly, a biosignal and motion information on the elderly; randomly transmitting an emergency call to an adjacent smart device using UWB short-range wireless communication when the smart band determines that a situation is an emergency on the basis of the biometric signal and the motion information; transmitting, by a smart device, a response signal to the emergency call to the smart band using the UWB short-range wireless communication; and transmitting, by the smart band, location information on the smart band to the smart device using the UWB short-range wireless communication. Therefore, a serious accident and a fatal accident of a senior citizen who lives alone can be remarkably reduced.
abstract_ko: 스마트 밴드를 이용한 노인 대상 응급상황 관리 방법 및 시스템이 제공된다. 이 노인 대상 응급상황 관리 방법은, 노인에게 착용된 스마트 밴드가 노인의 생체신호 및 운동정보를 모니터링하는 단계; 스마트 밴드가 생체신호 및 운동정보를 기반으로 응급상황이라 판단하는 경우, UWB 근거리 무선통신을 사용하여 인접한 스마트 기기에 무작위로 비상호출을 전송하는 단계; 스마트 기기가 UWB 근거리 무선통신을 사용하여 비상호출에 대한 응답신호를 스마트 밴드에 전송하는 단계; 및 스마트 밴드가 UWB 근거리 무선통신을 사용하여 스마트 밴드의 위치정보를 스마트 기기에 전송하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Continuous identity recognition system based on millimeter wave perception heart characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a continuous identity recognition system based on millimeter wave radar sensing heart characteristics, which comprises a control module, a millimeter wave radar sensing module, a heart motion signal extraction module and an identity recognition module. The system avoids the problems of privacy invasiveness, easiness in forging, low availability and the like faced by the existing biological characteristic-based identity recognition system to a certain extent; the continuous identity recognition mechanism is used, so that the system safety is enhanced; the non-contact vital sign sensing method based on the millimeter wave radar can collect heart motion signals which are not easy to forge or steal under the condition of protecting the privacy of users, and improves the usability of the recognition system. The invention has a certain novelty and can be used as an identity recognition solution in an intelligent interconnection scene.

title_en: Radar and microseism composite life detection circuit
