abstract_en: The utility model provides a radar and micro-seismic composite life detection circuit, which comprises a comprehensive processing module, a radar detection module, a micro-seismic detection module, a camera module and a display module; the radar detection module comprises a first power supply unit and a radar detection unit which are independently arranged; the first power supply unit and the radar detection unit are respectively electrically connected with the comprehensive processing module, and the first power supply unit is used for providing working voltage for the radar detection unit; the microseismic detection module comprises a second power supply unit and a first acceleration sensor which are independently arranged, and the second power supply unit is used as a current source of the first acceleration sensor; the camera module and the display module are both in communication connection with the comprehensive processing module; the comprehensive processing module sequentially enables the first power supply unit and the radar detection unit to be conducted, or sequentially enables the second power supply unit and the first acceleration sensor to enter a working state.

title_en: Electronic device for determining vital sign of user and method for thereof
title_ko: 사용자의 생체 사인을 결정하는 전자 장치 및 그 동작 방법
abstract_en: According to various embodiments, an electronic device for determining the vital sign of a user while the user activates comprises a first sensor for detecting the vital sign of the user, a second sensor for detecting the activity of the user, and at least one processor connected to the first sensor and the second sensor. The at least one processor is configured to check a vital sign determined through a first signal obtained through the first sensor, normalize the vital sign to correspond to an activity characteristic of the user based on the vital sign determined via the first signal and an activity level of the user determined via a second signal obtained via the second sensor, and determine a vital sign by merging the vital sign determined through the first signal and the normalized vital sign. Accordingly, the electronic device can accurately measure the vital sign of a wearer when the wearer of the electronic device engages in high-intensity exercise.
abstract_ko: 다양한 실시예들에 따르면, 사용자가 활동하는 동안 생체 사인(vital sign)을 결정하는 전자 장치는, 사용자의 생체 사인을 감지하기 위한 제1 센서, 상기 사용자의 활동을 감지하기 위한 제2 센서, 및 상기 제1 센서 및 상기 제2 센서에 연결된 적어도 하나의 프로세서를 포함한다. 상기 적어도 하나의 프로세서는, 상기 제1 센서를 통해 획득한 제1 신호를 통해 결정되는 생체 사인을 확인하고, 상기 제1 신호를 통해 결정되는 상기 생체 사인 및 상기 제2 센서를 통해 획득한 제2 신호를 통해 결정되는 상기 사용자의 활동 레벨에 기반하여 상기 사용자의 활동 특성에 상응하도록 생체 사인을 정규화(normalization)하고, 상기 제1 신호를 통해 결정되는 상기 생체 사인 및 상기 정규화된 생체 사인을 머징(merging)하여 생체 사인을 결정하도록 설정될 수 있다.

title_en: Health management intelligent system and human cardiopulmonary function signal monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of health management, in particular to an intelligent health management system, which structurally comprises: a 24GHz CFK101A millimeter wave radar sensor, a waveform generator and an AD acquisition card are adopted to form a human body vital sign real-time monitoring system platform, wherein the human body vital sign real-time monitoring system is embedded with MATLAB script in a LabVIEW real-time data acquisition program for processing phase signals and real-time filtering radar signals, and the result obtained by the MATLAB script is returned to the LabVIEW; the intelligent terminal for health management of the elderly further comprises a control circuit board and a display screen, wherein a processor and a voltage stabilizing single-way unit are integrated on the control circuit board; the CFK101A millimeter wave radar sensor is internally provided with a CFK101A1T1R Kband radar chip and a VCO oscillator. The invention provides a health management intelligent system which can realize household intelligent monitoring of daily breathing and heart rate of the elderly, and achieves heart and lung function health management.
assignees: YIHUIYUN INTELLIGENT TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Configurable distributed radar life detection instrument
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of life detection, and discloses a configurable distributed radar life detector which comprises a display and control terminal and more than two radar detection units, and aims to solve the technical problems of poor detection performance and low detection efficiency of the life detector at the present stage; each radar detection unit can be flexibly arranged in a disaster-stricken scene, and each radar detection unit is wirelessly connected to form a distributed detection networking to detect a target object; the display and control terminal positions the radar node positions of the radar detection units through a UWB positioning technology, establishes a three-dimensional reference coordinate system, and calculates the three-dimensional coordinates of the target object by combining the one-dimensional distance between the target object and the radar node positions detected by the corresponding radar detection units through a least square positioning method; meanwhile, by combining the MIMO array imaging technology, the signal-to-noise ratio of the target object can be improved, the three-dimensional information of the target can be more accurately obtained, and the purposes of improving the detection performance and the detection efficiency of the life detector are achieved.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on space-time equivalent virtual array technology
abstract_en: A vital sign detection method based on space-time equivalent virtual array technology obtains equivalent multi-channel virtual array signals through signal recombination according to phase information obtained by demodulating received single-channel continuous wave radar signals; then, carrying out frequency domain estimation on the multichannel virtual array signal by utilizing a subspace method to obtain incoming wave angle information; and accurately acquiring vital sign information of the target by a coarse-to-fine frequency estimation method according to the target frequency obtained by converting the angle information of the incoming wave. The invention synthesizes an equivalent virtual array by utilizing the similarity of a single-input single-output (SISO) CW radar single-channel phase signal and a single-input multiple-output (SIMO) radar multi-channel array signal, and completes the conversion from time to space, thereby realizing the accurate and stable estimation of the respiratory rate and the heart rate of a human body with super-resolution.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring method and device
abstract_en: The specification relates to the technical field of radar vital sign monitoring, and particularly discloses a vital sign monitoring method and device, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining echo data, carrying out 3D-FFT processing on the echo data to determine whether the echo data contains a target, carrying out target detection to obtain micro Doppler signals corresponding to vital signs when the echo data contains the target, carrying out phase extraction on the micro Doppler signals to obtain phase information, respectively filtering the phase information by using a first band-pass filter and a second band-pass filter to obtain first phase data and second phase data, carrying out frequency tracking on the first phase data and the second phase data based on an M-Rife interpolation algorithm to obtain a first frequency value and a second frequency value, wherein the first frequency value is used for representing the first vital sign, and the second frequency value is used for representing the second vital sign. The scheme can improve the accuracy and efficiency of vital sign monitoring.

title_en: Methods for improving the accuracy of vital radar heart rate based on heart rate analysis algorithms
title_ko: 심박 유형 분석 알고리즘을 통한 바이탈 레이더 심박수의 정확도 개선 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for improving the accuracy of a vital radar heart rate through a heart rate type analysis algorithm, which classifies the heart rate waveform of the first heart rate for a heart rate signal detected based on a biosignal into a plurality of types according to the interval spacing. By recalculating the heart rate using the weights assigned to each type, errors occurring in the primary heart rate calculation process can be further reduced, and the accuracy can be dramatically increased.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 생체 신호에 기초하여 검출된 심박 신호에 대한 1차 심박수의 심박 파형을 인터벌 간격에 따라 다수의 유형으로 분류하고, 각 유형 별로 부여되는 가중치를 이용하여 심박수를 재산출함으로써 1차 심박수 산출 과정에서 발생되는 오차를 더욱 줄이고 정확도를 획기적으로 높일 수 있는 심박 유형 분석 알고리즘을 통한 바이탈 레이더 심박수의 정확도 개선 방법에 대한 것이다.

title_en: Smart UWB Sleep Apnea Monitoring System using Deep Learning
title_ko: 딥러닝을 이용한 비접촉 수면 무호흡 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: A non-contact sleep apnea monitoring system using deep learning comprises: a non-contact motion detection sensor that detects motion of an observer; a non-contact breathing detection sensor that detects breathing of the observer; and an apnea monitoring unit that determines a sleep state of the observer based on detection data of the non-contact motion detection sensor by using a preset deep learning algorithm in individually receiving and processing the detection data of the non-contact motion detection sensor and the non-contact breathing detection sensor and determines an apnea state during a sleep state of the observer based on the detection data of the non-contact breathing detection sensor.
abstract_ko: 딥러닝을 이용한 비접촉 수면 무호흡 모니터링 시스템은 관측자의 동작을 감지하는 비접촉 동작감지센서와, 관측자의 호흡을 감지하는 비접촉 호흡감지센서와, 비접촉 동작감지센서 및 비접촉 호흡감지센서의 감지 데이터를 각각 수신하여 처리함에 있어서, 미리 설정된 딥러닝 알고리즘을 이용하여 비접촉 동작감지센서의 감지 데이터를 토대로 관측자의 수면상태를 판단하고, 비접촉 호흡감지센서의 감지 데이터를 토대로 관측자의 수면상태 중의 무호흡 상태를 판단하는 무호흡 모니터링부를 포함한다.
assignees: KUMOH NAT INST TECHNOLOGY IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Small animal vital sign monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a small animal vital sign monitoring device, which comprises a box body, an ultra-wideband radar monitoring system fixedly arranged at two ends of the inner bottom surface of the box body and a small animal fixing device, wherein the ultra-wideband radar monitoring system is arranged at the bottom surface of the box body; the radar monitoring system comprises a shell, an ultra-wideband radar module, a radar echo signal processing module and a safety power module, wherein the ultra-wideband radar module, the radar echo signal processing module and the safety power module are arranged in the shell; the fixing device comprises a support track plate, a base and an upper cover, wherein the base is in sliding connection with the support track plate, the upper cover is in rotary connection with the base, and the base and the upper cover can be matched to form a movable space which is more suitable for accommodating small animals. According to the utility model, non-contact type small animal vital sign monitoring is realized through the ultra-wideband radar monitoring system and the fixing device, the moving space of the small animal is effectively limited, the interference of body movement data on the vital sign is avoided, the respiratory frequency and heart rate data are more accurately obtained, meanwhile, the monitored small animal is isolated through the box body, and the risk of damaging the body health of an experimenter is reduced.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar vital sign detection method for inhibiting body movement effect
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar vital sign detection method for inhibiting body movement effect, which comprises the following steps: extracting phase data containing vital sign information from the radar signal, then carrying out multichannel average processing, and extracting a heartbeat signal by using a high-pass filter; detecting body movement of a heartbeat signal by using a double-energy threshold detection method, judging a body movement mode, and selecting initial distribution parameters of a maximum expected algorithm; filtering out motion artifacts using a maximum expected algorithm; and acquiring the heart rate of the tested target by using a fast Fourier transform spectrum analysis method. The non-contact heart rate detection framework of the MCA treatment, the APSEM method and the FFT spectrum analysis method provided by the invention realizes the inhibition of strong interference caused by body movement in the detection process, and is beneficial to obtaining accurate heart rate measurement results in the detection environment of the body movement of a detected person.

title_en: Artificial intelligence smart wear Helmet
title_ko: 인공지능 스마트웨어 헬멧
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart helmet having a black box function, and more specifically, to a smart helmet having a black box function comprising: a helmet body having an opening on a lower part thereof so as to be worn on an outside of a head, and having a see-through window on a front surface thereof so as to enable a user to see a front side; a helmet support part connected to the opening of the helmet body and worn to surround a neck and shoulders of a user; an airbag device formed on an inner rear of the helmet body and including an airbag expanded to protect an occipital part and a temporal part, and a sensor for sensing impact and operating the airbag; a black box part including a camera mounted on an outer side of the helmet body to capture the outside, and a storage connected to the camera to store information; a headset embedded inside the helmet body and including an earphone part and a voice recognition part corresponding to ears and mouth, respectively; and a wireless communication part connected to an external wireless terminal; and an information display part connected to the wireless communication part and displaying road guide, time, and temperature information on the see-through window. According to the present invention, the helmet can be distributed to be used for the protection of an environment other than a special purpose and for the convenience of life, and additionally provides a function of minimum coping with fires and emergencies as an additional function, thereby helping the safety of the user and minimizing inconvenience of daily life by distributing the weight of the helmet over the entire shoulder.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 블랙박스 기능을 갖는 스마트 헬멧에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는, 머리의 외부에 착용되도록 하부에 개구부가 형성되고, 전면에는 앞을 볼 수 있도록 투시창이 형성된 헬멧본체; 상기 헬멧본체의 개구부에 연결되며 사용자의 목과 어깨까지 감싸도록 착용되는 헬멧지지부;를 포함하고, 상기 헬멧본체의 내측 후방에 형성되며, 후두부 및 측두부를 보호하도록 팽창되는 에어백과, 충격을 감지하여 에어백을 작동시키는 센서로 구성된 에어백 장치; 상기 헬멧본체의 외측에 장착되어 외부를 촬영하는 카메라와, 상기 카메라에 연결되어 정보를 저장하는 저장소로 구성된 블랙박스부; 상기 헬멧본체의 내부에 매립되며 귀와 입에 각기 대응되는 이어폰부와 음성인식부를 구비한 헤드셋; 외부 무선단말과 연결되는 무선통신부와, 상기 무선통신부에 연결되며 투시창에 길안내와 시간, 온도 정보를 표시해주는 정보표시부;를 포함한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 특수목적이 아닌 환경에 대한 보호 및 생활편의를 위해 사용되도록 보급될 수 있고, 추가적인 기능으로 화재, 긴급상황 등에도 최소한의 대처가 될 수 있는 기능을 추가적으로 제공하여, 사용자의 안전에 도움을 줄 수 있도록 하며, 헬멧의 무게를 어깨 전체에 무게를 분산시켜 일상생활을 하는데 불편함을 최소화할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Biological monitoring and care system for care services for the elderly living alone
title_ko: 독거 노인에 대한 돌봄 서비스를 위한 생체 모니터링 및 케어 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a bio-monitoring and care system for providing a care service for an elderly person living alone. The disclosed bio-monitoring and care system includes: a bio-signal measurement device which measures a movement path according to a dynamic state of an elderly person living alone in a predetermined space by using an FMCW radar, and measures a bio-signal in a static state of the elderly person living alone to analyze the bio-signal measured in the static state of the elderly person living alone, and then transmits a resulting signal according to the analysis of the bio-signal through a communication network; a server which stores a bio-signal and a signal related to the movement path measured by the bio-signal measurement device and provides the signal related to the movement path to a management unit according to a request of the management unit; and the management unit which selectively provides a care service for the elderly person living alone as the resulting signal is received from the bio-signal measurement device through the communication network. Therefore, the care service for elderly person living alone can be provided efficiently and stably.
abstract_ko: 독거 노인에 대한 돌봄 서비스를 제공하기 위한 생체 모니터링 및 케어 시스템이 개시된다. 개시되는 생체 모니터링 및 케어 시스템은, FMCW 레이더를 이용하여 소정의 공간 내에서의 독거 노인의 동적 상태에 따른 동선을 측정하고 상기 독거 노인의 정적 상태에서의 생체 신호를 측정하여 상기 독거 노인의 정적 상태에서 측정된 생체 신호를 분석한 후, 상기 생체 신호의 분석에 따른 결과 신호를 통신 네트워크를 통해 전송하기 위한, 생체 신호 측정 장치와, 상기 생체 신호 측정 장치에 의해 측정된 동선에 관한 신호 및 생체 신호를 저장하고 상기 관리부의 요청에 따라 상기 동선에 관한 신호를 상기 관리부 측으로 제공하는 서버와, 상기 생체 신호 측정 장치로부터 상기 결과 신호를 상기 통신 네트워크를 통해 수신함에 따라 선택적으로 상기 독거 노인에 대한 돌봄 서비스를 제공하는 관리부를 포함한다.

title_en: Ductile segment suitable for fracture zone and simulation experiment device and experiment method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a ductile segment suitable for a fracture zone, a simulation experiment device and an experiment method thereof, wherein the ductile segment comprises an arc segment main body, a shearing joint is arranged in the middle of the segment main body, a shearing force sensor is arranged at the shearing joint, and segment main bodies at two opposite sides in the shearing joint are connected through elastic members; the steel plate member and the water-swelling water stop strip are buried in the duct piece main body; the upper side and the lower side of the duct piece main body are provided with bolt holes for connecting with adjacent duct piece main bodies; the steel plate member comprises fixed steel plates positioned at the upper side and the lower side, the left side and the right side of the steel plate member are movable steel plates capable of moving left and right, and the duct piece main body is connected with the movable steel plates through double-acting jacks. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the toughness of the whole structure is improved, the safety is higher, and the influence of dislocation of the fracture zone on the tunnel structure under the action of an earthquake can be effectively reduced.
assignees: UNIV SHENZHEN;CCCC TUNNEL ENGINEERING COMPANY LTD

title_en: Method and system for detecting radar system living body penetrating through obstacle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar system living body detection method penetrating through an obstacle, which comprises an FMCW radar system, and the detection method comprises the following steps: determining the response of the potential barrier through FFT calculation, detecting the position of the obstacle and determining a hot spot area; and carrying out second-stage FFT on the phase value of the first-stage FFT sequence recorded on the hot spot area, searching the FFT sequence with the maximum peak spectrum, and designating the FFT sequence with the maximum peak spectrum as target respiratory vital sign data. The obstacle response is identified, the result is used for eliminating beat frequency generated by the obstacle structure, so that the signal-to-noise ratio is improved, the obstacle response is identified by combining the obstacle response with a phase detection method, and Doppler response related to the vital sign of target respiration is extracted. Clutter from other objects reflected under debris is minimized by detailed cross-correlation weighting to effectively eliminate respiratory wall effects, improving detection accuracy.

title_en: Method for determining the position and vital parameters of an occupant of a transportation vehicle and transportation vehicle
abstract_en: A method for determining the position and vital signs of an occupant of a transportation vehicle and a transportation vehicle having a radio system and a control unit connected to the radio system. The method is based on channel impulse response (CIR) measurements and is performed using at least two UWB antennas during the operation of the transportation vehicle to determine a position and a vital sign of one or more occupants of the transportation vehicle.

title_en: Mouse having human health monitoring function
title_ko: 지식근로자의 건강상태 모니터링 기능을 가지는 마우스와 이를 포함하는 컴퓨터장치 및 스마트기기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mouse having a knowledge worker health state monitoring function, and a computer device including the same, and a smart device linked thereto to be operated. More specifically, the mouse used as a pointing device of a computer device includes a first sensor capable of measuring blood oxygen saturation (SpO2) and pulses or heartbeats of a user and a second sensor capable of measuring skin conductance (EDA) of a user. A measured biosignal is compared with previously stored data to be shown to monitor the health state of knowledge workers who use a computer device and a mouse for a long time at all times.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지식근로자의 건강상태 모니터링 기능을 가지는 마우스와 이를 포함하는 컴퓨터장치 및 이와 연동되어 작동될 수 있는 스마트기기에 관한 것이다. 보다 상세하게로는, 컴퓨터장치의 포인팅 장치로 사용되는 마우스에 사용자의 혈중 산소포화도(SpO2)와 맥박 또는 심박을 측정할 수 있는 제1센서 및 사용자의 피부전도도(EDA)를 측정할 수 있는 제2센서를 포함하도록 하고, 측정되는 생체신호를 이전에 저장된 데이터와 비교하여 보여주도록 함으로써, 장시간 동안 컴퓨터장치 및 마우스를 이용하는 지식근로자들의 건강상태를 상시 모니터링할 수 있도록 한 것이다.

title_en: Radar-invisible region estimation device and estimation method for reinforced concrete structure
abstract_en: To provide a radar-invisible region estimation device and estimation method for a reinforced concrete structure that can estimate a position of a reinforcing-bar near a wall even when a hyperbola waveform related to the reinforcing-bar buried near the wall of a floor is the waveform in which only a skirt portion of the base thereof is visible and an apex thereof is invisible in a case where the hyperbola waveform is acquired by performing radar scan on the floor being a reinforced concrete structure.SOLUTION: A radar-invisible region estimation device for a reinforced concrete structure includes: a radar survey result acquisition unit 0361 for a reinforced concrete structure; an apex-invisible waveform portion information acquisition unit 0362 which acquires waveform information on a waveform portion where an apex of a hyperbola waveform is invisible in the acquired radar survey result; an apex estimation means retention unit 0363 which holds apex estimation means to estimate an apex position of the apex-invisible waveform portion on the basis of the apex-invisible waveform portion information; and an apex estimation unit 0364 which estimates the apex position of the apex-invisible waveform portion on the basis of the apex-invisible waveform portion information and the apex estimation means.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3C

title_en: Movable fire extinguishing parking station for electric vehicle
title_ko: 전기 자동차용 이동식 소화 주차장
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile fire extinguishing parking lot for electric vehicles which can quickly extinguish a fire by immersing an electric vehicle in fire water and isolating the electric vehicle to prevent the fire from spreading if the fire breaks out in the corresponding electric vehicle by a battery defect, a battery impact, and overcharging. To this end, the mobile fire extinguishing parking lot for electric vehicles comprises: a parking base having a towing ring; wall tubes embedded at four positions of the edge of the parking base to be expanded to the upper surface of the parking base when a fire breaks out to form a temporary wall; a plurality of fire detection sensors exposed to the upper surface of the parking base to detect a fire of an electric vehicle; a plurality of injection nozzles exposed to the upper surface of the parking base to inject fire water to a lower portion of the electric vehicle; and a fire-extinguishing tank supplying fire water to the injection nozzles. The parking base also has compartments formed at four positions of the edge to embed the wall tubes. A hinge pin for maintaining the embedded wall tubes in a buried state is connected to an upper portion of the compartments. The wall tubes hold fire water to extinguish a fire of an electric vehicle by immersion or partial immersion.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전기 자동차용 이동식 소화 주차장에 관한 것으로, 이를 위해 견인고리가 구비된 주차대;와, 상기 주차대의 가장자리 4개소에 내장되어 화재시 주차대의 상부면으로 팽창되어 가벽체를 이루는 팽창식 벽체튜브;와, 상기 주차대에 상부면에 다수 노출되어 전기차의 화재를 감지하는 다수의 화재감지센서;와, 전기차의 하부로 소화수를 분사될 수 있도록 상기 주차대의 상부면에 노출되는 다수의 분사노즐; 및 상기 각 분사노즐로 소화수를 공급하는 소화탱크;를 포함하되, 상기 주차대는 벽체튜브를 내장시키기 위해 가장자리 4개소에 격실이 더 형성되고, 상기 격실의 상부에는 내장된 벽체튜브를 매립된 상태로 유지하기 위한 힌지판이 연결되고, 상기 벽체튜브는 소화수를 담수시켜 전기차를 수장 또는 부분 수장에 의해 소화시키는 것을 특징으로 하는 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Non-contact biosignal measurement system and method
title_ko: 비접촉식 생체 신호 측정 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention comprises: a MIMO antenna which transmits or receives an FMCW-type radar signal; a raw data collection unit which stores raw data obtained by sampling, at a rate of N signals per chirp, a plurality of chirp signals that are received by a plurality of reception antennas in response to reflection of radar signals transmitted from a plurality of transmission antennas of the MIMO antenna; a cube generation unit which generates two-dimensional data including data corresponding to an ADC sampling index and a reception antenna (Rx) index from the raw data stored in the raw data collection unit, accumulates the two-dimensional data on a time axis in a chirp period, and converts same into a 3D radar cube; a location measurement unit which obtains angle and distance information by performing range-fast Fourier transformation (RFFT) and digital beamforming on data of the 3D radar cube, and specifies a location of a person by using the angle and distance information; and a biosignal detection unit which obtains a respiratory waveform on the basis of a distance between the person at the location specified by the location measurement unit and the MIMO antenna. The present invention has an advantage of enabling contactless measurement of a person's biosignal using an FMCW radar.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, FMCW 형태의 레이다 신호를 송수신하는 MIMO 안테나; 상기 MIMO 안테나의 복수개의 송신 안테나에서 송신한 레이다 신호가 반사되어 복수개의 수신 안테나에 수신되는 복수개의 첩 신호(chirp signal)를 하나의 첩 당 N개로 샘플링하여 획득한 로데이터(raw data)를 저장하는 로데이터 수집부; 상기 로데이터 수집부에 저장된 로데이터로 ADC 샘플링 인덱스(ADC sample index) 및 수신 안테나 인덱스(Rx index)에 해당하는 데이터로 구성되는 2차원 데이터를 생성하고 첩 주기의 시간 축 상에서 누적하여 3D 레이다 큐브로 변환하는 큐브 생성부; 상기 3D 레이다 큐브의 데이터를 RFFT(Range-Fast Fourier Transform)와 디지털 빔포밍을 수행하여 각도와 거리정보를 획득하고, 각도와 거리정보로 사람의 위치를 특정하는 위치 측정부; 및 상기 위치 측정부에서 특정한 위치의 사람과 상기 MIMO 안테나 사이의 거리를 기반으로 호흡 파형을 획득하는 생체신호 검출부;를 포함하는 것을 일 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Heartbeat breath detection method based on radar signal and related device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of signal detection, and discloses a heartbeat and respiration detection method based on radar signals and a related device. The method comprises the following steps: receiving an echo signal of a radar, and generating an echo sequence phase; according to a preset phase unwrapping algorithm, unwrapping the echo sequence phase to generate an unwrapped sequence phase; performing median filtering processing on the unwrapped sequence phase based on the average value of the unwrapped sequence phase to generate a filtered sequence phase; according to a preset FFT conversion algorithm, carrying out conversion processing on the phase of the filtering sequence to obtain a frequency domain phase signal; and carrying out peak extraction processing on the frequency domain phase signal according to a preset peak analysis algorithm to generate a heartbeat frequency or a respiratory frequency. The invention solves the technical problem that the current heartbeat breath detection still needs to be fit with a human body to bring inconvenience to the user's use experience.

title_en: Building interaction system based on virtual reality technology
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of building interaction systems, and discloses a building interaction system based on a virtual reality technology, which comprises: a target building and a virtual reality terminal device, the target building being configured with a plurality of entrance ends and a first sensing unit; the virtual reality terminal equipment is provided with a live-action display unit and a virtual reality display unit, and is provided with a second sensing unit, an information storage unit, a positioning unit, a thermal sensing unit, a radar life detection unit and a local processor; the local processor is configured with a path guiding module, when a firefighter wearing the virtual reality terminal device enters the interior of the target building from the entrance end, the information storage unit retrieves three-dimensional model information of the corresponding target building, and the path guiding module generates path guiding information according to the three-dimensional model information, the positioning information, the heat source information in the interior of the target building and the life body information and outputs the path guiding information to the virtual reality display unit.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar vital sign detection system based on medical protective clothing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a millimeter wave radar vital sign detection system based on medical protective clothing, which solves the problems of overlarge detection result error and inconvenient carrying caused by large influence of environment and severe movement of signals in the existing non-contact detection technology, and comprises a signal transmitter, a first signal receiver, a signal processor, an early warning module and an upper computer, wherein the signal transmitter comprises a millimeter wave radar chip set, the first signal receiver comprises an acoustic wave sensor, the signal processor comprises a singlechip, a signal processing chip, a band-pass filter and a triaxial acceleration sensor, and the early warning module comprises a wireless Bluetooth module, a second signal receiver and a vibration motor; compared with contact detection such as ECG and PPG and conventional non-contact detection, the utility model has better signal processing capability and signal stability, and ensures that each basic vital sign of a human body can be accurately detected in real time.
assignees: UNIV XIAN POLYTECHNIC;SHAANXI YUANFENG TEXTILE TECH RESEARCH CO LTD;XIAN CHILDRENS HOSPITAL

title_en: Human vital sign monitoring method oriented to sports scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human vital sign monitoring method oriented to a motion scene, which is characterized in that a radar reflected signal reflected by a human body is received, the radar reflected signal and a radar transmitted signal are subjected to frequency mixing treatment to obtain an original intermediate frequency signal, then the original intermediate frequency signal is subjected to Fourier transformation to construct characteristic spectrum data, a sliding window sampling method is adopted for the generated characteristic spectrum map, the characteristic spectrum map is intercepted according to a preset window length and a step length, and the characteristic spectrum map is input into a trained classifier network model to identify a motion state or a non-motion state and a motion type in the motion state. And monitoring the breathing or heartbeat frequency during the exercise time in a non-exercise state. The invention monitors vital sign information of human body by utilizing millimeter wave radar, and has the advantages of low illumination dependency, good privacy protection, high monitoring sensitivity, no contact and the like.

title_en: Vital sign detection method and system based on ultra-wideband radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign detection method and a vital sign detection system based on ultra-wideband radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of measuring vital signs through an ultra-wideband radar to obtain echo signals, wherein the echo signals comprise vital sign signals and clutter signals of stationary objects; clutter filtering processing is carried out on the echo signals to obtain body surface micro-motion signals; after the body surface micro-motion signal is compensated and undersampled, performing modal decomposition by using an improved self-adaptive noise complete set empirical mode decomposition ICEEMDAN algorithm, and reconstructing to obtain a heartbeat respiratory micro-motion signal; and classifying and processing the heartbeat respiratory micro-motion signals through a multiple signal classification MUSIC algorithm to obtain respiratory signals and heartbeat signals. The problem of modal aliasing caused by modal decomposition of the existing EMD algorithm is avoided, and the problem of interference of the respiratory signal to the heartbeat signal during separation of the heartbeat respiratory signal in the prior art is solved.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar human vital sign monitoring method and system based on diversity mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar human vital sign monitoring method and system based on a diversity mechanism, comprising the following steps: the millimeter wave radar is provided with a plurality of transmitting antennas for transmitting millimeter wave signals to the environment and a plurality of receiving antennas for receiving the signals reflected by human bodies and objects; the signal processing module is used for carrying out frequency mixing on the reflected signals received by the receiving antenna, carrying out space diversity on the positions of the human body to obtain reflected components of the positions of the human body, carrying out dynamic signal extraction by estimating echo static components to obtain dynamic components, carrying out time diversity on the echo dynamic components at a plurality of moments to improve the signal to noise ratio, carrying out phase extraction and unwrapping on the signals after the time diversity, and carrying out band-pass filtering and period estimation on the time domain to obtain the target respiration rate and heart rate. The invention utilizes a diversity method to improve the accuracy of monitoring the vital signs of the human body in a complex environment and a long distance by integrating multi-antenna and multi-pulse data.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar heart rate detection method based on adaptive clutter filtering
abstract_en: The application discloses a millimeter wave radar heart rate detection method based on adaptive clutter filtering. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, a millimeter wave radar life detection system acquires an intermediate frequency signal data matrix containing target human body respiratory heartbeat signals, and the intermediate frequency signal data matrix is preprocessed to obtain unwrapped signals and vital sign phase information; step two, extracting heart beat signals from vital sign phase information; thirdly, training the state of the heartbeat signal in the database, constructing a wavelet scattering-long-short-time memory network, and judging the state of the heartbeat signal in the second step; selecting a reference noise vector corresponding to the state of the heartbeat signal, and constructing a self-adaptive filter of a recursive least square method to filter the reference noise to obtain a pure heartbeat signal; fifthly, performing fast Fourier transform to perform heart rate estimation on the pure heartbeat signals. The application has the advantages of small operand, high measurement precision, strong stability and real-time realization.

title_en: Non-contact identity recognition method, system, medium, equipment and terminal
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of identity recognition, and discloses a non-contact type identity recognition method, a non-contact type identity recognition system, a non-contact type identity recognition medium, a non-contact type identity recognition device and a non-contact type identity recognition terminal, wherein a life motion signal of a target individual acquired by AWR1642 is subjected to phase extraction, demodulation and difference; denoising the phase signals after the difference by utilizing sine fitting to obtain heart motion information; the wild dog algorithm optimization support vector machine is improved by using self-adaptive adjustment weights and local disturbance, so that identity recognition is realized; and separating respiratory and heartbeat signals through a Butterworth low-pass filter, comparing the obtained heartbeat frequency with an intelligent bracelet, and verifying the feasibility of the FMCW millimeter wave radar for detecting the vital signals. Experimental results show that the heart beat frequency obtained by the method and the pearson correlation coefficient obtained by the contact method are 0.96, the feasibility of acquiring life signals by the FMCW radar is shown, the accuracy of real individual identification by using the improved wild dog optimization algorithm to optimize the SVM can reach 88%, and the identification accuracy can be effectively improved by the identification method.

title_en: FMCW radar approaching multi-target vital sign signal separation method
abstract_en: The application provides a method for separating adjacent multi-target vital sign signals of an FMCW radar, which comprises the following steps: acquiring FMCW radar echo intermediate frequency signal data, and determining slow time data containing a life signal according to the FMCW radar echo intermediate frequency signal data; carrying out phase extraction on the slow time data to obtain mixed vital sign data; according to the mixed vital sign signal data, combining a signal decomposition algorithm to obtain virtual multichannel data; and obtaining vital sign signal data close to multiple targets according to the virtual multichannel data. The method can perform applicable reconstruction conversion on the FMCW radar signals, construct a virtual multichannel through the CEEMDAN method, convert the space domain problem into the signal domain problem by using the FastICA method, and finally can effectively extract the vital sign signals of a plurality of targets in the same space unit from the FMCW radar echo signals.
assignees: BEIJING INSTITUTE OF TECH CHONGQING INNOVATION CENTER;BEIJING INSTITUTE TECH

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine pulse condition detection method based on vital sign radar data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine pulse condition detection method based on vital sign radar data, and relates to the technical field of medical detection; the method comprises the following steps: the first step: and (3) data acquisition: collecting human breath and heartbeat data through a vital sign detection radar; and a second step of: data screening: extracting effective data segments of respiratory heartbeats; and a third step of: and (3) data processing: generating a respiration peak value screened frequency table and a heartbeat peak value screened frequency table; fourth step: outputting a result: judging pulse conditions according to the correspondence of the RB_ratio and the traditional Chinese medicine pulse condition table and outputting a result; the invention is suitable for the medical field.

title_en: Bio-signal measuring device and bio-signal real-time monitoring system including the same
title_ko: 생체신호 측정장치 및 이를 포함하는 생체신호 실시간 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: A bio-signal measurement device and a bio-signal real-time monitoring system including the same are provided. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the bio-signal measurement device comprises: a wearable sensor device which periodically measures bio-signal information of a user while attached to or worn on the body of the user and transmits the measured bio-signal information to the outside in real time; and a data collection transmitter which is worn by the user, receives the bio-signal information transmitted from the wearable sensor device, and transmits the user's bio-signal information received from the wearable sensor device to the outside, wherein the data collection transmitter may include an emergency alert signal generator that generates an emergency alert signal when operated by the user and transmits the generated emergency alert signal to the outside. According to the present invention, a user can send an emergency alert signal to a monitoring manager and thus can quickly and efficiently respond in the case of an emergency.
abstract_ko: 생체신호 측정장치 및 이를 포함하는 생체신호 실시간 모니터링 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 생체신호 측정장치는 사용자의 신체에 부착 또는 착용된 상태에서 상기 사용자의 생체정보를 주기적으로 측정하고, 측정된 생체정보를 실시간으로 외부로 송출하는 웨어러블형 센서 디바이스; 및 사용자가 패용하고, 상기 웨어러블형 센서 디바이스에서 전송된 생체정보를 수신하며, 상기 웨어러블형 센서 디바이스로부터 수신된 사용자의 생체정보를 외부로 송출하는 데이터 수집 송신기;를 포함하고, 상기 데이터 수집 송신기는 사용자의 조작시 긴급알람신호를 생성하여 외부로 송출하는 긴급알람신호발생부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Distributed biological radar system and monitoring system for home care
abstract_en: The application discloses a distributed biological radar system and a monitoring system for home care, wherein the radar system comprises a first radar and a second radar which are arranged at a certain height of a monitoring area, and the first radar detects the distance measurement and/or the angle measurement of a moving object and vital sign signals; detecting ranging and/or angulation of a moving object when the second radar is in the first detection mode; the method comprises the steps of moving up and down in a second detection mode and detecting a monitoring area to obtain point cloud data; if the distance measurement and/or angle measurement signals detected by the two radars are not changed and the vital sign signals are detected by the first radar, the second radar moves up and down; the calculation module divides the point cloud data detected by the second radar into a plurality of layering spaces, determines a ground base line, judges whether the point cloud data conforming to the human body characteristics exist in a preset height range above the ground base line, and if so, performs data exception processing. The application can realize fall alarm monitoring in a larger range and more accurately.
assignees: APPLIED TECHNOLOGY COLLEGE OF SOOCHOW UNIV

title_en: Occupants sensing device based on ir-uwb rader sensor and disaster response system using the same
title_ko: Ir-uwb 레이더 센서 기반 재실자 감지장치 및 이를 이용한 재난 대응 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention discloses an occupant detection device based on an IR-UWB radar sensor, which comprises: an IR-UWB radar sensor which is installed in at least one indoor location and periodically transmits IR-UWB impulse signals to a predetermined surveillance area to detect vital signs of occupants including breathing and a heart rate; a motor unit which is connected to the IR-UWB radar sensor and rotates the IR-UWB radar sensor left and right with respect to the ground within a predetermined angular range; a signal processing unit which, whenever a reflected signal corresponding to each of the IR-UWB impulse signals is received, converts the reflected signal into a frequency domain signal for the same designated time period; a frequency analysis unit which analyzes the frequency domain signal and classifies the same into a breathing section and a heart-rate section; a peak extraction unit which extracts a peak signal above a predetermined level for the breathing section; and an occupant counting unit which counts the peak signal extracted by the peak extraction unit to derive the number of occupants. According to the present invention, the detection ability can be equally exerted even when there are partitions, walls, and obstacles.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 실내의 적어도 하나 이상의 개소에 설치되고, 미리 정해진 감시영역으로 IR-UWB 임펄스 신호들을 주기적으로 송신하여 재실자의 호흡 및 심박을 포함하는 생체 신호를 탐지하는 IR-UWB 레이더 센서; 상기 IR-UWB 레이더 센서에 연결되어 미리 정해진 각도 범위 내에서 상기 IR-UWB 레이더 센서를 지면에 대해 좌우로 왕복회전시키는 모터부; 각각의 IR-UWB 임펄스 신호에 대응하는 반사 신호가 수신될 때마다 지정된 동일 시간 구간에 대해 주파수 도메인 신호로 변환하는 신호 처리부; 상기 주파수 도메인 신호를 분석하여 호흡 구간과 심박 구간을 구분하는 주파수 분석부; 상기 호흡 구간에 대하여 정해진 레벨 이상의 피크 신호를 추출하는 피크 추출부; 및 상기 피크 추출부에 의해 추출된 피크 신호를 카운트하여 재실자의 수를 도출하는 재실자 카운트부;를 포함하는 IR-UWB 레이더 센서 기반 재실자 감지장치를 개시한다.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign monitoring system and a vital sign monitoring method. The intelligent monitoring system has the advantages that technologies such as RFID, radar and cloud computing are combined together, full-automatic monitoring and early warning of vital signs are achieved, the intelligent monitoring system is powerful in function, high in precision, wide in application range, free of privacy risks, friendly to the elderly, and suitable for being used in a multi-person environment.

title_en: Floor buried type evacuation guidance light and control system for evacuation guidance lamp using the same
title_ko: 바닥매립형 피난유도등 및 이를 이용한 피난유도등 제어시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a floor-embedded evacuation guide light which is embedded in the floor to guide an escape route in an emergency situation such as the event of a fire, and if there are multiple escape routes, can lead to a smooth escape by dispersing the number of evacuees rather than concentrating the evacuees in one direction, and an evacuation guide light control system using the same. The floor-embedded evacuation guide light according to the present invention is installed embedded in the floor to guide the escape route according to detection information of a fire detection sensor, and comprises: a housing installed to be embedded in the floor; a battery installed in the housing; a light emitting module portion installed in the housing and emitting light by the battery or an external power source; and a cover portion installed on an upper part of the housing. The light emitting module portion or the cover portion is formed to display a set escape direction to guide the escape route of the evacuees. Accordingly, a quick and safe escape route can be guided.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재발생과 같은 비상상황시 탈출 경로를 안내하기 위한 피난유도등이 바닥에 매립된 상태로 설치되며, 탈출경로가 다수일 경우 탈출인원이 일방향으로 집중되지 않고 분산되어 원활한 탈출이 이루어질 수 있도록 유도할 수 있는 바닥매립형 피난유도등 및 이를 이용한 피난유도등 제어시스템에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에 따른 바닥매립형 피난유도등은 화재감지센서의 감지정보에 따라 탈출경로를 안내하도록 바닥에 매립 설치되는 것으로, 바닥에 매립되도록 설치되는 하우징, 상기 하우징에 설치되는 배터리, 상기 하우징에 설치되며 상기 배터리 또는 외부 전원에 의해 발광하는 발광모듈부, 상기 하우징의 상부에 설치되는 커버부를 포함하고, 상기 발광모듈부 또는 커버부는 탈출인원의 탈출경로를 가이드할 수 있도록 설정된 탈출 방향을 표시할 수 있게 형성된다.
assignees: INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION HONAM UNIV

title_en: A Life Detection System Using Radar Sensors with Anti-Misdetection Technology
title_ko: 오탐지 방지 기술이 적용된 레이더 센서를 이용한 인명 탐지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a human detection system using a radar sensor applied with a false detection preventing technology, which promotes the safety of a rescue worker, comprising: a plurality of human detection modules; a plurality of repeaters connected to the human detection modules via a communication network; a plurality of gateways connected to the repeaters via the communication network; a control server for operating a life rescue system; and a local control system for controlling the life rescue system.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 오탐지 방지 기술이 적용된 레이더 센서를 이용한 인명 탐지 시스템은, 오탐지 요인을 제거하여 구조대원이 재난상황에 처한 사람의 위치를 정확히 파악하고 신속히 구조함은 물론 구조요원의 불필요한 위험지역 출동을 차단하여 구조요원의 안전을 도모하는 레이더 센서 기반의 재난구호 시스템을 제공하는데 목적이 있다.  
이에 따라, 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 오탐지 방지 기술이 적용된 레이더 센서를 이용한 인명 탐지 시스템은, 하우징 형태로 시설물 내부의 다수 위치에 설치되고, 재난 발생 시 시설물 내부의 사람을 탐지하며, 탐지데이터 및 분석데이터를 관제서버 및 로컬관제센터와 구조요원의 스마트기기로 전달하는 다수의 인명탐지모듈; 다수의 인명탐지모듈과 통신망으로 연결되어 탐지데이터 및 분석데이터를 취합하고 게이트웨이에 전달하는 다수의 중계기; 중계기와 통신망으로 연결되어 탐지데이터 및 분석데이터를 관제서버 및 로컬관제시스템에 제공하는 다수의 게이트웨이; 시설물 내 관제실에 위치하여 재난 발생 시 시설물 내 재난통제시스템을 가동하고 게이트웨이와 연결되어 탐지데이터 및 분석데이터를 수신하여 인명이 탐지되면 인명 구호시스템을 가동하는 관제서버; 및 시설물 외부 현장지휘본부에 위치하여 재난 발생 시 시설물 내 인명에 대한 탐지데이터 및 분석데이터를 수신하여 구호요원의 스마트기기에 전달하고 인명 구호시스템을 제어하는 로컬관제시스템;을 포함하되, 인명탐지모듈은, 레이더 센서로 구성되어 객체의 움직임과 위치를 탐지하고, 탐지데이터를 생성하여 신호처리부에 전달하는 레이더센서부; 탐지데이터를 수집하여 객체의 움직임, 위치, 크기, 속도를 계산하고 인명 여부를 해석한 후 분석데이터를 생성하는 신호처리부; 신호처리부에서 탐지데이터와 분석데이터를 전달받아 중계기로 전송하는 통신모듈부; 및 외부전원이 연결되고 내부 배터리로 구성되며 인명탐지모듈에 전원을 공급하는 전원부;를 하우징 내부에 포함하고, 신호처리부는, 다수의 비교대상 파라미터에 대한 탐지데이터 중 유효데이터로 측정된 파라미터의 종류가 기 설정한 판단기준값을 초과하면, 해당 객체는 사람인 것으로 간주하여 탐지데이터 및 분석데이터를 관제서버 및 로컬관제시스템에 제공하여 사람만 구호 대상에 포함되도록 하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Fire security apparatus and method while charging electric vehicle charging station
title_ko: 전기차량 충전소에서의 충전중 화재감시 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device for monitoring a fire at an electric vehicle being charged in an electric vehicle charging station, which comprises: a plurality of fire detection modules; a vehicle detection sensor; and a fire monitoring main body unit. The plurality of fire detection modules each comprise: a flame detection sensor which is disposed to be partially buried in a charging parking area of an electric vehicle charging station and detects a fire in a vehicle being charged at an early stage; a smoke and combustible gas detection sensor which is configured to detect a small amount of smoke or combustible gas leaking from a point where fire vehicle occurs; and a suction fan installed to suck in gas so as to quickly guide smoke or combustible gas leaks from the point where the fire vehicle occurs toward the smoke and combustible gas detection sensor. The vehicle detection sensor is disposed in the charging parking area and detects an electric vehicle in charging. The fire monitoring main body unit is wirelessly connected to the plurality of fire detection modules via short-distance wireless communication, checks whether a fire is detected by the fire detection modules depending on vehicle detection at the vehicle detection sensor, verifies a fire outbreak, selectively supplies main power for charging electric vehicles to a vehicle charger, shuts off the main power for charging as the fire outbreak is verified, sends a fire report message to a local firefighting situation room, and provides an evacuation announcement when a human body within the charging station is detected. According to the present invention, it is possible to prevent and manage fire accidents that frequently occur when electric vehicles are charged in a charging station.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전기차량 충전소에서의 충전중 화재감시 장치로서, 전기차량 충전소의 충전주차구역에 일부매립 배치되어 충전중인 차량의 화재를 초기에 검지하기 위해 불꽃감지센서, 차량화재시 소량의 연기나 가연성가스 누출 감지를 위한 연기 및 가연성가스 감지센서, 차량화재 발생지점에서의 연기나 가연성가스 유출분을 연기 및 가연성가스 감지센서쪽 방향으로 신속 유도하기 위해 흡기 작동되게 설치된 흡기팬 등이 개별적으로 포함된 다수개의 화재감지모듈들과, 충전주차구역에 배치되어서 충전중인 전기차량을 감지하는 차량감지센서와, 다수개의 화재감지모듈과 근거리 무선통신을 통해 무선 연결되며, 차량감지센서에서의 차량감지에 따라 화재감지모듈들로부터 화재감지 여부를 체크하고 화재발생을 검증하여서 전기차량 충전용 메인전력을 차량충전기로 선택적으로 공급하고, 화재발생이 검증됨에 따라 충전용 메인전력을 차단하고 화재신고 메시지를 해당 지역 소방상황실로 전송함과 함께 충전소내 인체감지시 대피안내방송을 하는 화재감시용 본체유닛을 구비한 것이다.

title_en: Life detection method and device based on radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection method and device based on radar, and the method comprises the steps of detecting a target by the radar, determining distance information and angle information of the target, preprocessing signals in a target distance unit, outputting target signals, obtaining phase information of the target signals, performing phase unwrapping on the target signals to obtain life signals, separating the life signals to obtain breathing signals and heartbeat signals, obtaining the frequency of the heartbeat signals and the frequency of the breathing signals by a time domain method and a frequency method, respectively determining a breathing frequency weighting coefficient and a heartbeat frequency weighting coefficient according to the numerical value difference of the breathing frequency and the numerical value difference of the heartbeat frequency under the time domain method and the frequency method, and obtaining a breathing frequency detection value and a heartbeat frequency detection value. The method effectively eliminates the defects of the time domain method and the frequency method, and improves the accuracy of vital sign data detection.

title_en: Ground penetrating radar detection and disease treatment method for deep-buried high-voltage tunnel
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ground penetrating radar detection and disease treatment method for a deep buried high-voltage tunnel, wherein on-site survey lines are of a two-transverse two-longitudinal net structure, radar transmitting antennas continuously transmit pulse high-frequency electromagnetic waves to the underground, receiving antennas receive reflected waves and transmitted waves generated by interfaces with electrical differences or targets, and judging the properties of the targets according to the form, strength and change of radar spectrum reflected waves to form a forecast, wherein the forecast content comprises four aspects of forecasting whether rock formations are broken in front of a face, forecasting whether water-rich rock formations are formed in front of the face, forecasting whether water or mud burst exists in front of the face, forecasting fault fracture zones in front of the face and water content of the fault fracture zones in front of the face, and summarizing, surveying and constructing design files and construction specifications according to the forecast content.

title_en: Radar high-precision heart rate detection method based on fitting matched filtering and Double-CZT
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar high-precision heart rate detection method based on fitting matched filtering and Double-CZT. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining an intermediate frequency signal data matrix containing target human body respiratory heartbeat signals by adopting a millimeter wave radar life detection system, secondly preprocessing the intermediate frequency signal data matrix to obtain unwrapped signals and preprocessed signals, thirdly, fitting the unwrapped signals by using smooth splines to obtain template signals, then convolving the template signals with the preprocessed signals, wherein convolution results are output results of matched filtering, fourthly, extracting variation of the output results of the matched filtering to obtain heartbeat signals, and fifthly, performing heart rate estimation on the obtained heartbeat signals by using bilinear frequency modulation Z conversion (Double-CZT). The invention has high measurement accuracy and high stability, and is easy for real-time detection of heart rate and engineering realization.

title_en: Underground structure detection apparatus and underground structure detection method
abstract_en: To accurately detect an underground buried object detected by a radar in an underground structure detection apparatus.SOLUTION: An underground structure detection apparatus detects information including a component constituting an underground structure, a type of the component, and position/posture information on the basis of a plurality of pieces of two-dimensional data indicating a cross section of ground and three-dimensional data indicating the underground structure. With respect to synthetic data obtained by synthesizing the two-dimensional data and the three-dimensional data, the position/posture information of a component represented by the synthetic data is corrected on the basis of an image feature grasped from the two-dimensional data. When a determination is made in a transverse direction with respect to a road, and the image feature is included in continuous images by a threshold or more, it is determined as a transverse pipe, and when a determination is mode in a longitudinal direction with respect to a road, and the image feature is included in continuous images by a threshold or less, it is determined as a longitudinal pipe, and the posture is corrected for each direction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title_en: Life detection radar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a life detection radar which comprises at least three support rods with adjustable lengths, a support plate, a mounting seat, a life detection radar body, a first angle adjusting mechanism and a second angle adjusting mechanism, wherein the support rods are vertically arranged and surround to form a polygon; the supporting plates are horizontally fixed on the tops of the supporting rods; the mounting seat is arranged below the supporting plate, and the upper end of the mounting seat is rotatably arranged on the supporting plate; the life detection radar body is rotatably mounted at the lower end of the mounting seat, and the life detection radar body is provided with a scanning surface facing the ground. The beneficial effects of the utility model are as follows: the scanning range of the scanning surface when the life detection radar body is placed once can be enlarged, so that the detection blind area is reduced, the times of placing the life detection radar body are reduced, the labor intensity of search and rescue personnel is reduced, and the search and rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Buried structure position estimation system
abstract_en: To reduce the time required for estimation of a three-dimensional position of a buried structure to improve the accuracy of estimation.SOLUTION: A waveform image creation unit 41 creates, based on data observed by a buried structure survey system, a waveform image that takes the position of a radar survey device in a predetermined direction as a lateral direction, takes a delay time of a radio wave received by the radar survey device as a vertical direction, and takes the intensity of the radio wave received by the radar survey device as the brightness of pixels, for every position of the radar survey device in a second predetermined direction different from the predetermined direction. A two-dimensional position estimation unit 42 estimates a two-dimensional position of a buried structure by using a convolutional neural network based on the waveform image created by the waveform image creation unit 41. A three-dimensional position estimation unit 43 estimates a three-dimensional position of the buried structure based on the two-dimensional position of the buried structure estimated by the two-dimensional position estimation unit 42.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Buried pipe position estimation system
abstract_en: To save labor and improve efficiency in estimation of a position where a buried pipe is buried.SOLUTION: A burying position estimation unit 42 estimates the position and depth of an underground buried structure based on a position measured by a survey position measuring device and an intensity pattern of a radio wave received by a radar survey device. A buried pipe determination unit 44 determines whether the underground buried structure continues linearly based on the position and depth of the underground buried structure estimated by the burying position estimation unit 42, and determines the underground buried structure determined to continue linearly as a buried pipe.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Self-tracking non-contact vital sign monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a self-tracking non-contact vital sign monitoring device which comprises a CW radar system, a two-degree-of-freedom cradle head and a two-stage cross sliding track, wherein the CW radar system is arranged at the action end of the two-degree-of-freedom cradle head; the base of the two-degree-of-freedom cradle head is driven by a two-stage track motor to walk on a two-stage track of the two-stage cross-shaped sliding track, and the two-stage track is driven by a one-stage track motor to walk on a one-stage track of the cross-shaped sliding track; the CW radar system comprises a host and two antennas arranged on the end face of the host antenna, wherein the distance between the two antennas is an integral multiple of half wavelength of radar signals, the two antennas are always positioned on the same plane, and the host of the CW radar system controls the motion states of the two-degree-of-freedom cradle head, the primary track motor and the secondary track motor. The device can detect vital signs of a human body in real time according to the radar, and can realize real-time adjustment of the distance and the angle between the device and the target.

title_en: Heartbeat detection method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of wireless communication and provides a heartbeat detection method, a heartbeat detection device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a spatial channel between an edge computing gateway and each target equipment in a first target area to acquire first breathing information perceived by the spatial channel; the method comprises the steps of sensing first respiration information based on a spatial channel, determining a second target area where a first object is located, detecting second respiration information of the first object in the second target area by adopting a millimeter wave radar, determining the second object based on the first respiration information and the second respiration information, and detecting heartbeat information of the second object. According to the application, the rough position of the target in the static state is perceived through indoor space channel perception connection, and then the millimeter wave radar is controlled to perform heartbeat detection, so that the accuracy and the efficiency of heartbeat detection are improved.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar respiratory frequency detection method and system based on broadband frequency spectrum weighting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar respiratory rate detection method and a system based on broadband frequency spectrum weighting, wherein the millimeter wave radar respiratory rate detection method based on the broadband frequency spectrum weighting comprises the following steps: s1, performing distance dimension FFT on an ADC signal to obtain a distance dimension FFT result; s2, carrying out dynamic and static separation on the distance dimension FFT result, and extracting a life signal from the static part; s3, dynamic and static separation among multiple frames is performed, and static objects and micro-moving targets are distinguished; s4, selecting a distance unit from dynamic and static separation results among multiple frames, and extracting phases in the distance unit; s5, phase unwrapping and filtering are carried out on the phase to obtain a breathing signal; s6, FFT (fast Fourier transform) calculation is carried out on the respiratory signal to obtain a frequency spectrum of the respiratory signal; s7, calculating the respiratory frequency according to the frequency spectrum. The invention can improve the accuracy of respiratory rate detection.
assignees: SHENZHEN HUAJIE ZHITONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Postoperative atomizing nursing device
abstract_en: The invention provides a postoperative atomization nursing device, which comprises an atomization device, a state monitoring and adjusting module and a control module, wherein the atomization device comprises an induced draft fan, a filtering and sterilizing assembly, a medicament container, a stirring device, a first micro-mesh atomization device, a second micro-mesh atomization device, a gas detection assembly, a heating assembly, an oxygen regulation assembly, a humidity regulation assembly, a gas regulation cavity, an inspiration control valve, an expiration control valve, a one-way valve, a respiration detection assembly, an air pipe and a respiratory mask, and the state monitoring and adjusting module comprises a fixed ring, a brain wave generating assembly, a first electrode, a second electrode, a millimeter wave radar, a blood oxygen detection assembly and a brain wave acquisition assembly. According to the invention, the atomization working process is adjusted according to the breathing state, and the blood pressure, heart rate, blood oxygen and emotion of the user are monitored in an omnibearing manner, so that the comfort of the user is improved by improving the oxygen content, brain wave physiotherapy and other modes.
assignees: THE SECOND AFFILIATED HOSPITAL ARMY MEDICAL UNIV OF PLA

title_en: Life detection system and method for mine drilling rescue
abstract_en: The application provides a life detection system and a life detection method for mine drilling rescue, wherein the system comprises a ground terminal and a multifunctional life detection device, the ground terminal is in communication connection with the multifunctional life detection device in a wireless transmission or network transmission mode, the ground terminal comprises a central processing unit and an interaction module, the central processing unit is used for sending control instructions to the multifunctional life detection device, the multifunctional life detection device comprises a controller, a video/infrared image detection module, an audio detection module and a radar detection module, and the controller is used for receiving the control instructions and controlling the video/infrared image detection module, the audio detection module and/or the radar detection module based on the control instructions. The technical scheme provided by the application can be suitable for various conditions of drilling rescue, improves the success rate and accuracy of life information detection, and simultaneously improves the rescue efficiency by a full-automatic detection process.

title_en: Method and system for providing health information based on bio-signal measured by non-contact manner
title_ko: 비접촉 방식으로 측정된 생체 신호에 기반하여 건강 정보를 제공하는 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a system for providing health information based on biometric signals obtained by measurement in a non-contact manner. The method of the present invention comprises the steps of: collecting non-contact biometric signals through a non-contact biometric sensor spaced apart from a subject; using a previously trained conversion model to convert the collected non-contact biometric signals such that they correspond to contact biometric signals, thereby generating virtual biometric signals; and analyzing the health conditions based on the generated virtual biometric signals to provide health information on the subject. According to the present invention, health conditions can be diagnosed by converting the biometric signals obtained in a non-contact manner into virtual biometric signals that correspond to biometric signals obtained in a contact manner. Accordingly, without the development of a separate diagnostic technique (or a diagnostic method or a diagnostic algorithm) to analyze biometric signals in a non-contact manner, health conditions such as cardiovascular diseases can be easily diagnosed based on the biometrical signals obtained in the non-contact manner to provide health information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비접촉 방식으로 측정된 생체 신호에 기반하여 건강 정보를 제공하는 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것이다. 상기 방법은 피검자와 이격되어 위치하는 비접촉 생체 센서를 통해, 비접촉 생체 신호를 수집하는 단계; 기 학습된 변환 모델을 이용하여, 상기 수집된 비접촉 생체 신호를 접촉 방식의 생체 신호에 상응하도록 변환하여 가상의 생체 신호를 생성하는 단계; 및 상기 생성된 가상의 생체 신호를 기반으로 건강 상태를 분석하여 상기 피검자에 대한 건강 정보를 제공하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다. 이러한 본 발명은 비접촉 방식으로 측정된 생체 신호를 접촉 방식으로 측정되는 생체 신호에 상응하는 가상의 생체 신호로 변환하여 건강 상태를 진단할 수 있다. 이로 인하여, 본 발명은 비접촉 방식의 생체 신호를 분석하기 위한 별도의 진단 기법(또는 진단 방법 또는 진단 알고리즘)을 개발하지 않고도, 비접촉 방식으로 측정된 생체 신호를 기반으로 건강 상태(예: 심혈관 질환)를 용이하게 진단하여 건강 정보를 제공할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION OF YEUNGNAM UNIV

title_en: Fire detection and fire handling system for electric vehicle charging station
title_ko: 전기차 충전소 화재 감지 및 화재 처리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire detection and handling system for an electric vehicle charging station, which is integrated to an electric vehicle charging and parking system to enable an early warning and an appropriate response in case of a fire, thereby causing an operator and a manager of an electric vehicle charging station to take quick and effective action for a fire risk, and guaranteeing the safety of a user. More specifically, the fire detection and handling system includes: a waterproofing device buried to be liftable in a lower part of the floor surface of a parking lot in which an electric vehicle is parked, and ascending while surrounding the electric vehicle parked in the parking lot; a water supply device supplying water into the waterproofing device when the waterproofing device ascends; a camera module photographing the electric vehicle parked in the parking lot; a sensor module detecting at least one of a sound, smoke and heat emanating from the electric vehicle parked in the parking lot; and a processing part connected to the waterproofing device, the water supply device, the camera module and the sensor module, and actuating the waterproofing device and the water supply device when detecting a fire on the electric vehicle through at least one of the camera module and the sensor module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전기차 충전 및 주차 시스템에 통합되어 화재 발생 시 조기 경보 및 적절한 대응을 가능하게 함으로써, 전기차 충전소의 운영자 및 관리자가 화재 위험에 대한 신속하고 효과적인 대응을 할 수 있으며, 사용자의 안전을 보장할 수 있도록 구성한 전기차 충전소 화재 감지 및 화재 처리 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는, 전기차가 주차되는 주차장의 바닥면 하부에 승강되도록 매설되며, 상승시 상기 주차장에 주차된 전기차를 둘러싸면서 상승하는 방수장치; 상기 방수장치 상승시, 상기 방수장치의 내부로 물을 공급하는 급수장치; 상기 주차장에 주차된 전기차를 촬영하는 카메라 모듈; 상기 주차장에 주차된 전기차에서 발생하는 소리, 연기, 열 중 적어도 어느 하나를 감지하는 센서 모듈; 및 상기 방수장치, 상기 급수장치, 상기 카메라 모듈 및 상기 센서 모듈과 연결되며, 상기 카메라 모듈과 상기 센서 모듈 중 적어도 어느 하나를 통해 전기차의 화재 감지 시, 상기 방수장치와 상기 급수장치를 동작시키는 처리부를 포함하는 전기차 충전소 화재 감지 및 화재 처리 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Underground PE pipeline detection device and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an underground PE pipeline detection device and method. The device comprises: the system comprises a main control unit and a glass fiber board, wherein a transmitting antenna and a receiving antenna are integrated on the glass fiber board; the transmitting antenna and the receiving antenna respectively comprise a pair of plane dipoles which are symmetrically arranged on the upper surface and the lower surface of the glass fiber plate; the transmitting antenna and the receiving antenna comprise: an antenna pole, a microstrip feed line; the external outline of the antenna pole is of an arc structure; one end of the microstrip feeder is electrically connected to the tail of the antenna pole. According to the PE pipeline detection device provided by the invention, the outer contours of the antenna poles of the transmitting antenna and the receiving antenna are designed into arc structures, so that the detection precision of the buried depth of an underground PE pipeline is improved; and the radar wave velocity is estimated through the radar data image, and the burial depth of the PE pipeline is calculated according to the radar wave velocity, so that the accurate measurement of the burial depth of the PE pipeline is realized.

title_en: Multifunctional composite net material for building
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of safety protection, in particular to a multifunctional composite net material for building, which comprises a top layer and a bottom layer, wherein the top layer and the bottom layer are formed by alternately weaving polyester fibers, glass fibers and carbon fibers; the structure of the connecting layer is consistent with that of the top layer and the bottom layer. The wave-shaped fiber is arranged between the top layer and the bottom layer, the wave-shaped fiber comprises cavities, and the cavities are gaps of the wave-shaped fiber. The beneficial effects are that: the electric heating wires are pre-buried in the composite net material and used for paving the tunnel portal or the side ditch in the tunnel, and the electric heating wires are electrified and heated when the electric heating wires encounter icing in winter, so that the icing is melted, the water flow is normal, and the water in the tunnel is prevented from being frozen in the tunnel or when the water flows out of the tunnel portal, so that the water level is continuously increased, and the railway track bed is flooded. The displacement sensor, the acceleration sensor and the sensor for monitoring vibration for measuring landslide and falling stones and rolling stones are buried in the net material, so that the movement of the landslide body and the rolling stones and falling stones can be monitored, and the safety of railway and highways is ensured.
assignees: SHAANXI YONGGUBANG ENGINEERING MATERIALS TECH CO LTD;TAIZHOU MENGNENGDA ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Respiratory heartbeat detection method and device based on signal self-adaptive standard comparison
abstract_en: The application provides a breath and heartbeat detection method and device based on signal self-adaptive standard comparison, wherein the method comprises the following steps: transmitting microwave signals to a living body in a target range by adopting a millimeter wave radar meeting requirements; receiving echo signals formed by the reflection of a living body, filtering the echo signals to obtain a respiration original signal sequence and a heartbeat original signal sequence, and processing the respiration original signal sequence and the heartbeat original signal sequence to obtain possible respiration detection data and possible heartbeat detection data; comparing the respiration original signal sequence with the possible respiration detection signal sequence self-adaptive standard signal to obtain a respiration frequency value, and comparing the heartbeat original signal sequence with the possible heartbeat detection signal sequence self-adaptive standard signal in a preset time period to obtain a heartbeat frequency value; the respiratory rate value and the heartbeat rate value are displayed. The scheme can detect the respiratory rate value and the heartbeat rate value in a contactless, efficient and accurate way.

title_en: Handheld through-the-wall radar with support
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a handheld through-wall radar with a bracket, which belongs to the technical field of through-wall radars and aims at the problems that the through-wall radars are easy to wear during use and the loss is caused when the through-wall radars are contacted with a wall; according to the utility model, through the arrangement of the mounting assembly, the disassembly and assembly work of the through-wall radar body can be completed in a short time, the disassembly and assembly work efficiency of the through-wall radar body is greatly improved, the disassembly and assembly of the through-wall radar body can be completed without using tools for workers, and the practicability is high.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGAN RUIDUN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: System based on photoelectric sensor vital sign signal acquisition and analysis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of health detection, and provides a system based on photoelectric sensor vital sign signal acquisition and analysis, which comprises the following modules, namely an FP430 control module; an FPGA processing module; an expansion module; a cloud platform end; an APP end; a PPG detection module; an ECG detection module; a body fat detection module; according to the invention, physiological signal characteristics of a human body are analyzed by combining the PPG signal and the ECG signal to obtain various human body parameters such as blood pressure, blood oxygen saturation, heart rate, pulse condition, respiratory rate, pulse wave conduction speed, arteriosclerosis index, anxiety index signal, body fat and body water ratio, health management of a whole family can be realized through face recognition, whole-process voice health detection and guidance are realized, timing voice reminding is realized, convenience is brought to personnel, measurement data can be uploaded to a cloud platform and APP through BLE, 4G and WIFI modes, and various communication modes improve convenient data transmission and use experience.
assignees: SHANDONG SHANKE ZHIXIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Life detection radar device
abstract_en: The application provides a life detection radar device, which comprises a base, a pulley assembly, a driving mechanism, a detection radar body, a pushing assembly, a pressing assembly and a rotation stopping assembly, wherein the pulley assembly is arranged on the base; the top surface of the base is provided with grooves, and the pulley assemblies are provided with a plurality of pulley assemblies and are uniformly distributed on the bottom surface of the base; the driving mechanism is rotatably arranged on the base, and the detection radar body is arranged on the driving mechanism; the pushing component and the pressing component are respectively and slidably arranged in the groove of the base, and the rotation of the driving mechanism can drive the pushing component to slide towards the pressing component, so that the pressing component slides towards the rotation stopping component; the bottom surface of the base component is provided with a plurality of strip holes, the rotation stopping component is slidably arranged in the groove of the base and can slide in the strip holes, and the sliding of the pressing component can simultaneously enable the rotation stopping components to slide towards the pulley component and be inserted into the pulley component to limit the rotation of the pulley component. The rotation of the life detection radar device does not need to continuously limit the base.
assignees: CHINESE PLA ARMY SPECIALIZED MEDICAL CT

title_en: Millimeter wave-based non-contact vital sign monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a non-contact vital sign monitoring method and a non-contact vital sign monitoring system based on millimeter waves, which relate to the technical field of millimeter wave radars and are used for transmitting millimeter wave radar signals to a target human body; receiving echo signals reflected by thoracic cavity vibration of a target human body; mixing an echo signal with a transmitted millimeter wave radar signal to obtain an intermediate frequency signal, and extracting the frequency and the phase of the intermediate frequency signal; and constructing a frequency domain signal according to the frequency and the phase of the intermediate frequency signal, and filtering the respiratory signal based on the difference of the respiratory signal and the heartbeat signal in the frequency spectrum characteristic to obtain the heartbeat signal.
assignees: KANGLIYUAN TIANJIN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Human vital sign detection method based on MIMO radar and beam forming
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human vital sign detection method based on MIMO radar and beam forming. The human vital sign detection method based on MIMO radar and beam forming comprises the following steps: extracting a distance-angle unit of the measured object; acquiring Doppler frequency spectrum; and estimating the heart rate value and the respiration value of the tested object, and detecting the vital signs of the human body of the tested object.
