According to the invention, each distance-angle unit of a measured object is extracted through preprocessing the received initial echo signals, then the corresponding phase signals are extracted, the Doppler frequency spectrum is obtained through unwrapping and differential processing, then the Doppler frequency spectrum is analyzed, a respiratory pseudo spectrum is constructed in a preset respiratory frequency range to obtain the respiratory value of the measured object, finally a heart rate pseudo spectrum is constructed in a preset heart rate range, and the heart rate value of the measured object is obtained by combining the heart rate harmonic product spectrum, so that the improvement of the detection accuracy of the vital signs of the human body is achieved, and the problem of low detection accuracy of the vital signs of the human body in the prior art is solved.

title_en: FMCW radar-based method for collecting skin superficial pulse wave signals
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pulse wave signal acquisition, and discloses a method for acquiring skin superficial pulse wave signals based on an FMCW radar, which comprises a pulse wave extraction method based on an FMCW radar signal acquisition module and an FMCW radar signal; the FMCW-based radar signal acquisition module comprises a shell, an FMCW radar and a transmission wire, wherein the human body surface based on the action of the FMCW radar signal acquisition module is a pulse wave body surface conduction position, including but not limited to a wrist, an upper arm, a neck and the like; the surface of the shell, which is contacted with the skin, is hollow. The invention can be applied to the monitoring of human vital signs of wearable equipment and the like by expanding the FMCW radar, and particularly relates to the estimation of vital sign parameters such as human blood pressure, heart rate, respiratory rate and the like under the condition of limiting exercise.
assignees: HEBEI XIONGAN HUIYI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Buried pipeline positioning device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a buried pipeline positioning device, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein an ultrasonic pipeline detector and a controller are arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate, a probe of the ultrasonic pipeline detector penetrates through the bottom plate and extends to the lower surface of the bottom plate, a first obstacle sensor is arranged on the front side of the lower surface of the bottom plate, a second obstacle sensor is arranged on the rear side of the lower surface of the bottom plate, the heights of the probe and the second obstacle sensor relative to the ground are higher than those of the first obstacle sensor relative to the ground, telescopic units are arranged at four corners of the lower surface of the bottom plate, universal wheels are arranged on the telescopic units, a push handle is arranged on the rear side of the upper surface of the bottom plate, and the ultrasonic pipeline detector, the first obstacle sensor, the second obstacle sensor and the telescopic units are electrically connected with the controller; the utility model can effectively avoid the collision between the probe of the ultrasonic pipeline detector and the obstacle in the moving process, thereby protecting the probe.

title_en: Method, device, and system for detecting an occupant
title_ko: 승객 탐지 방법, 승객 탐지 장치, 및 승객 탐지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a passenger detecting method, a passenger detecting apparatus, and a passenger detecting system. The passenger detecting method according to one embodiment of the present application comprises the following steps of: acquiring sensor data; obtaining class information related to a status of a seat of a vehicle from the sensor data through a learned classification model; sensing a biosignal by analyzing the sensor data; sensing movement by analyzing the sensor data; and determining whether to board a passenger based on the class information, a sensing result of the biosignal, and a sensing result of the movement.
abstract_ko: 본 출원의 일 실시예에 따른 승객 탐지 방법은, 센서 데이터를 획득하는 단계; 학습이 완료된 분류 모델(classification model)을 통하여, 상기 센서 데이터로부터 상기 차량의 좌석의 상태(status)와 관련된 클래스 정보를 획득하는 단계; 상기 센서 데이터를 분석하여 생체 신호를 감지하는 단계; 상기 센서 데이터를 분석하여 움직임을 감지하는 단계; 및 상기 클래스 정보, 생체 신호의 감지 결과, 및 움직임의 감지 결과에 기초하여 승객 탑승 여부를 판단하는 단계;를 포함한다.

title_en: Smart infant stethoscope toy and infant health condition minotoring system including the same
title_ko: 스마트 영유아 청진기 장난감 및 이를 포함하는 영유아 건강 상태 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart infant stethoscope and an infant health condition monitoring system including the same which comprise: an insertion unit having a rubber cap attached to the outside thereof, wherein the insertion unit is inserted into an ear; a head unit having a gripping unit formed on one surface, wherein the gripping unit is gripped by a hand, and having a contact unit formed on the other surface, wherein the contact unit contacts a human body; a sensor unit prepared in the insertion unit and the head unit to measure vital signs of an infant who is playing; and a control unit that determines a health condition of the infant based on the measured vital signs. Accordingly, the health condition of the infant is determined through multi-channels including a body temperature, a pulse wave, oxygen saturation, and skin conductance and the health condition of the infant is transmitted to an external device to be monitored.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트 영유아 청진기 및 이를 포함하는 영유아 건강 상태 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 외부에 고무 캡이 결합되어 귀에 삽입되는 삽입부; 일면은 손에 파지되는 파지부가 형성되고, 타면은 신체에 접촉되는 접촉부가 형성되는 헤드부; 상기 삽입부 및 헤드부에 마련되어 놀이 중인 영유아의 생체 신호를 측정하는 센서부; 및 상기 측정된 생체 신호에 기초하여 영유아의 건강 상태를 판단하는 제어부를 포함한다. 이에 따라, 체온, 맥파, 산소 포화도 및 피부전도도를 포함하는 멀티 채널을 통해 영유아의 건강 상태를 판단하고, 영유아의 건강 상태를 외부 장치에 전달하여 모니터링할 수 있다.

title_en: Health care system and method for driver
title_ko: 차량 운전자를 위한 헬스 케어 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment, provided are a smart device that includes at least one of a location data generating unit, an acceleration sensor, a camera, a radar, a microphone, and an optical sensor and collects information related to health care of a user and a health care system for a vehicle driver that analyzes a health condition including at least one of an activity level of the user, a sleep condition, and a biological signal by using the information related to health care collected from the smart device and activates a vehicle start lock function according to a health condition.
abstract_ko: 실시예에 따르면, 위치 데이터 생성부, 가속도 센서, 카메라, 레이다, 마이크 및 광 센서 중 적어도 하나를 포함하며, 사용자의 헬스 케어 관련 정보를 수집하는 스마트 디바이스; 및 상기 스마트 디바이스에서 수집한 상기 헬스 케어 관련 정보를 이용하여 상기 사용자의 활동량, 수면 상태 및 생체 신호 중 적어도 하나를 포함하는 건강 상태를 분석하고, 상기 건강 상태에 따라 차량 시동 잠금 기능을 활성화하는 차량 운전자를 위한 헬스 케어 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Seismic diffraction lens
title_ko: 지진파 굴절 렌즈
abstract_en: The present invention performs control using a combination acoustic lens and refractive index conversion lens. Seismic waves are a type of elastic wave and acoustic wave, and like other waves, when encountering materials with different impedances, show general wave properties such as reflection, refraction and transmission. If a seismic lens with a diameter approximate to the wavelength of a seismic wave is manufactured and buried underground, an area similar to a kind of artificial seismic dark zone, where seismic waves are weakened by being refracted, can be made. For maximal effectiveness, the seismic wave wavelength to be blocked should be between the thickness and the diameter of the cylindrical lens. Therefore, the seismic wave refraction lens is buried underground not to be exposed to the outside, thereby preventing the surrounding environment from being harmed. Even if the lens is destroyed, the lens can be repaired without causing any damage to a building. Since the degree of weakening seismic waves is linearly proportional to the number of lenses, the seismic wave refraction lens is effective against earthquakes of magnitude 6 or higher, which require a lot of costs with current technology.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 음향 렌즈이자 굴절률 변환렌즈를 이용하여 제어하는 것이다. 지진파는 탄성파이자 음향파의 일종으로서 다른 파동들과 마찬가지로 임피던스가 다른 물질을 만나면 반사, 굴절, 투과 등 파동이 보이는 일반적 성질을 보인다. 지진파 파장 정도의 직경을 가진 지진파 렌즈를 제작하여 지하에 매설하면 지진파를 굴절시켜 지진파가 약화되는 일종의 인공 지진파 암영대와 유사한 지역을 만들 수 있다. 최대 효과를 위해서는 차단하고자 하는 지진파 파장은 원통형 렌즈의 두께와 직경 사이로 한다.  
따라서 지하에 매설되므로 외부에 노출되지 않아 주위 환경을 해치지 않는다. 설령 렌즈가 파괴되더라도 건물에 전혀 피해를 끼치지 않고 보수가 가능하다. 지진파를 약화시키는 정도가 렌즈의 개수에 선형 비례하므로 현재의 기술로 많은 비용이 소요되는 ‘규모 6’이상의 강진에 효과적이다.
assignees: MOKPO NATIONAL MARITIME UNIV INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Fire protection water tank type electric vehicle fire protection device with firewall
title_ko: 방화벽 겸용 방화수조형 전기자동차 방화장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire water tank type electric vehicle firefighting apparatus functioning as a firewall. The fire water tank type electric vehicle firefighting apparatus includes: a fire floor formed in a size including a lower area of a vehicle to function as a vehicle parking space floor; fire airbags buried and installed consecutively in the periphery of the fire floor; a fire detection sensor installed on the fire floor to detect a fire on a parked electric vehicle; an inflator embedded in the fire airbags to actuate the airbags; and a control circuit part installed in the fire floor, and sensing a signal of the fire detection sensor to output an operation control signal of the inflator. Therefore, in case of a fire on the electric vehicle parked on the fire floor, the airbags are actuated to form a slope firewall. In accordance with the present invention, the fire water tank type electric vehicle firefighting apparatus functioning as a firewall can be conveniently installed in a parking lot, and can be installed one by one on each parking position with a minimized parking space invasion issue.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 방화벽 겸용 방화수조형 전기자동차 방화장치에 관한 것으로서, 자동차 하부 면적을 포함하는 크기로 형성되어 자동차 주차 공간 바닥이 되는 방화바닥; 상기 방화바닥 외주변에 연속하여 매몰 설치되는 방화 에어백; 상기 방화바닥에 설치되어 주차된 전기자동차의 화재를 감지하는 화재 감지센서; 상기 방화 에어백에 내장되어 에어백을 작동시키는 인플레이터; 상기 방화바닥 내부에 설치되며, 화재 감지센서의 신호를 감지하여 상기 인플레이터의 작동 제어신호를 출력시키는 제어 회로부;를 포함하여 구성되어 상기 방화바닥에 주차된 전기자동차의 화재 발생시 상기 에어백이 작동하여 사면 방화벽을 형성시키는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에 의하여, 주차장 내 설치가 간편하고, 주차 공간의 침해 문제가 최소화되어 각 주차 위치당 하나씩 설치 가능한 방화벽 겸용 방화수조형 전기자동차 방화장치를 제공되는 이점이 있다.

title_en: Method for informing of ofobituary
title_ko: 사망 인지시점에 따른 부고정보 제공방법
abstract_en: Provided is a method for providing obituary information according to the time of death recognition, comprising: a terminal registration step in which a server registers a terminal in a database according to personal information entered from the terminal; a will information generation step in which the server generates a will according to a will information generation request from the terminal; a list generation step in which the server receives at least one selected from among contact information entered in the terminal and another contact information transmitted to the terminal from another terminal and generates a transmission list; a biometric information measurement step in which the server determines in real time whether the user's biometric information measured from the terminal is above or below a preset threshold; and a will information and emergency rescue request transmission step in which an emergency rescue request is transmitted to the police department when the user's biometric information measured from a biometric sensor is determined to be above a preset threshold value, and in which the will information and emergency request are transmitted to the input transmission list when the user's biometric information measured from the biometric signal sensor is determined to be below a preset threshold value. Accordingly, the present invention may automatically transmit obituary information to the list of bereaved family members stored in the terminal of the deceased at the time of death.
abstract_ko: 서버가 단말기로부터 입력된 개인정보에 따라 상기 단말기를 데이터베이스에 등록하는 단말기 등록단계, 상기 서버가 상기 단말기의 유언정보 생성요청에 따라 유언장을 생성하는 유언정보 생성단계, 상기 서버가 상기 단말기에 입력된 연락처 및 또 다른 단말기로부터 상기 단말기에 전송된 또 다른 연락처 중 선택된 적어도 하나를 수신 받아 전송리스트를 생성하는 리스트 생성단계, 상기 단말기로부터 측정되는 사용자의 생체인식정보가 기 설정된 임계값 이상 또는 이하인지 여부를 실시간으로 판단하는 생체정보 측정단계, 생체신호 센서로부터 측정되는 상기 사용자의 생체정보가 기 설정된 임계값 이상으로 판단되는 경우에 경찰청으로 긴급구조요청이 전송되는 구조요청 발송 단계가 진행되고, 상기 생체신호 센서로부터 측정되는 상기 사용자의 생체정보가 기 설정된 임계값 이하로 판단되는 경우에 상기 입력된 전송리스트로 상기 유언정보 및 긴급요청을 발송하는 유언정보와 긴급요청 발송단계;를 포함하는 사망 인지시점에 따른 부고정보 제공방법을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Radar apparatus with natural convection
abstract_en: An apparatus detects and measures vital signs of each human target by a continuous, non-intrusive method. In an example, the vital signs of interest include a heart rate and a respiratory rate, which can provide valuable information about the human’s wellness. Additionally, the heart rate and respiratory rate can also be used to identify a particular person, if more than two target humans are living in a home. The apparatus has a natural convection spatial flow path that draws heat from at least one processor, one fan-less radar and a heat sink.

title_en: Prevent outdoor high-voltage board of automatic rising that wades
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an anti-water-wading automatic lifting outdoor high-voltage cabinet, which comprises a concrete prefabricated base, sliding cylinders are fixed at four corners of the top of the concrete prefabricated base, sliding rods are inserted into the sliding cylinders, high-voltage cabinet bases are fixedly arranged at the tops of the four sliding rods, the concrete prefabricated base at the bottom of the high-voltage cabinet is buried underground for fixation, when a water-logging disaster occurs, the water level rises, when the water level reaches a water-wading sensor, the water-wading sensor detects a water-wading signal at the moment, the water-wading signal is transmitted to a controller, the controller controls a speed-reducing motor to start, the speed-reducing motor drives a threaded rod to rotate in a threaded cylinder so as to enable the threaded rod to axially move in the vertical direction, the speed-reducing motor moves upwards through the upward movement of the threaded rod, and when a limit disc in the sliding cylinder slides to the top of the threaded cylinder, the limit disc presses a pressing switch at the moment, the speed-reducing motor is closed, the rising operation of the high-voltage cabinet is completed, and severe weather can be coped with, and water-wading of the high-voltage cabinet is prevented by the water-wading disaster.
assignees: HUBEI TAIAN SIYUAN ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Well detection method for buried pipeline valve
abstract_en: The invention discloses a buried pipeline valve well detection method, which comprises the following steps: determining a presumed location of a buried valve well to be probed and determining a type of pipe connected to the valve well; selecting a detection mode according to the pipeline type, detecting the position and the trend of the pipeline at the estimated position, and determining the crossing position of the pipeline; and detecting and excavating verification by using a ground penetrating radar according to the crossing position, and determining the accurate position of the valve well. By utilizing the scheme of the invention, accurate data information can be provided for gas enterprises, the management of pipelines is convenient, and powerful guarantee is provided for the datamation and informatization of cities.

title_en: Living body detection method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a life detection method and device. The life detection method comprises the following steps: calculating the signal fluctuation and intensity ratio of the current position according to the current position radar signal fluctuation, the current position radar signal intensity and the current position radar signal intensity in a certain range; determining candidate positions according to the signal fluctuation and intensity ratio; and determining the position of the living body according to the candidate position. Wherein the starting point of the current position with a certain range is in the direction of the position of the radar towards the current position; the end point of the certain range of the current position is in the direction of the current position far away from the position where the radar is located. According to the embodiment of the application, the detection rate of a person in lying is improved, and false detection is reduced.

title_en: Method, device, vehicle and medium for identifying target object
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method, a device, a vehicle and a medium for identifying a target object, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining, by the first sensor, whether vital sign data exists for the target subject; and determining the type of the target object according to the outline characteristics of the target object determined by the second sensor when vital sign data of the target object exist. According to the method and the device for identifying the type of the target object, the type of the target object can be accurately identified based on vital sign data, and therefore basis can be provided for subsequent operation.
assignees: WENZHOU GANGYUAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Positioning method for distributed optical fiber sensing system
abstract_en: The method is used for carrying out phase correction on signals acquired by an optical fiber sensor array, so that the influence of the scale of an optical fiber sensing channel is eliminated, and the corrected signals can be directly used for obtaining high-precision target source position information by using an array signal processing method. The method is not dependent on a specially designed optical fiber winding structure, and is suitable for the conventional buried communication optical cable. The invention has the advantages of simple implementation, low cost, large range, high precision and the like, can further improve the positioning capability of the existing sensing system on the target signal in the actual application scene, is suitable for the fields of railway safety, perimeter security, earthquake rapid reporting and the like, and has great significance.
assignees: SHANGHAI INST OPTICS & FINE MECH CAS

title_en: Engineering roadway gas coal dust explosion test system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of gas coal dust disaster prevention and control, and discloses an engineering roadway gas coal dust explosion test system, which comprises a simulated roadway, wherein the simulated roadway comprises a main roadway and a secondary roadway which are communicated; the main lane comprises a gallery communicated with the auxiliary lane and an inclined lane communicated with the outside; an explosion-proof door and an explosion chamber are arranged at the joint of the gallery and the auxiliary gallery; a plurality of coal dust frames are axially arranged in the upper space of the gallery along the gallery; the two side walls of the middle part of the gallery are buried with a plurality of test boxes communicated with the pipelines, a plurality of sensors are arranged in the test boxes, and cables of power supplies and sensors are laid in the communication pipelines. According to the scheme, the explosion of a real roadway or the coal dust explosion scene caused after the real explosion is simulated, so that the spreading rule and the disaster-causing mechanism of the gas coal dust explosion of the engineering level are effectively researched, and the explosion suppression performance of the roadway can be researched by using explosion suppression equipment, so that theoretical models and bases are provided for reducing or even avoiding the underground coal mine explosion injury, and the safety of the underground coal mine and the gas mine operation is further improved.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Intelligent elderly accompanying system based on computer vision technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent nursing system for the elderly based on a computer vision technology. The system mainly comprises an indoor monitoring system, a robot system and a mobile equipment display terminal. The indoor monitoring system is provided with a plurality of integrated cameras according to indoor space layout, and dynamic tracking of real-time information of the aged day and night is realized in a video and infrared combined mode; the robot system consists of a built-in intelligent analysis and control system, a voice interaction system, an indoor navigation system, a vital sign detection system and the like; the accompanying robot consists of an integrated camera, a motion system, an imitation human arm system, a partition storage box (medicine, nutrient and the like) and a sensor module; the mobile device display terminal comprises a mobile phone, an intelligent watch, a computer and the like and is used for displaying video information according to task call, and simple gesture interaction can be achieved. The accompanying and nursing system meets the demands that children care about the health and psychological factors of the old and reduce the consumption of manpower and material resources, and improves the timeliness and accuracy of emergency rescue.

title_en: Personnel intelligent monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar and related equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a personnel intelligent monitoring method and related equipment based on millimeter wave radar, and relates to the technical field of nursing monitoring, wherein the method comprises the following steps: transmitting millimeter wave signals and receiving radar original echo data; preprocessing according to the radar original echo data to obtain time domain feature information of a target human body; obtaining monitoring information of a target human body by processing according to the time domain characteristic information and adopting a deep learning method, wherein the monitoring information at least comprises the number, the position, the movement track, vital sign information and gesture recognition information of people; and generating corresponding alarm information and control instructions according to the monitoring information, wherein the alarm information is sent to a set crowd, and the control instructions are sent to set household appliances. The application can acquire various monitoring data of personnel in real time, is non-contact, is simple and convenient, and can realize intelligent monitoring of personnel and intelligent control of household appliances.
assignees: GUANGDONG LABORATORY OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE AND DIGITAL ECONOMIC GUANGZHOU;UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: UWB vital sign signal detection method based on NGO-VMD algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a UWB vital sign signal detection method based on an NGO-VMD algorithm, and relates to the technical field of signal detection. The method comprises the steps of transmitting Gaussian pulse signals through an ultra-wideband radar module and receiving UWB radar echo signals reflected by a target human body so as to monitor vital signs of the target human body, wherein the method comprises the following steps: preprocessing the UWB radar echo signals to obtain echo signals containing vital signs; processing echo signals containing vital signs through an NGO-VMD algorithm, and decomposing the echo signals to obtain a plurality of modal components; dividing the modal components according to a pre-acquired reference respiratory signal frequency range and a reference heartbeat signal frequency range to obtain a respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal. The method realizes the detection of the vital sign signals, overcomes the unsafe of contact detection, can also reduce signal noise interference, and effectively improves the accuracy and timeliness of the extraction of the vital sign signals.
assignees: SUZHOU RUIKEDA ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Self-powered displacement sensor, landslide monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The application provides a self-powered displacement sensor, a landslide monitoring system and a landslide monitoring method. The self-powered displacement sensor is used for being buried in a mountain to be monitored so as to monitor whether landslide occurs in the mountain to be monitored, when landslide occurs in the mountain to be monitored, the self-powered displacement sensor generates corresponding electric signals, the principle that the self-powered displacement sensor generates corresponding electric signals when landslide occurs in the mountain to be monitored is consistent with that of the friction nano generator, and the working mode of the friction nano generator at least comprises a vertical contact-separation mode, a horizontal sliding mode, a single electrode mode and an independent layer mode. According to the application, an external power supply is not needed, and corresponding electric signals can be generated when landslide occurs on the mountain to be monitored based on the principle of the friction nano generator, so that the reliability of the sensor is improved, and the research, development and manufacturing costs of the sensor are reduced.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign data monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact vital sign data monitoring method, a system and a computer readable storage medium based on millimeter wave radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving echo signals in a radar detection space, and screening static detected personnel from the radar detection space according to the echo signals to serve as target objects; calculating the space position information of the target object in the radar detection space according to the echo signal of the target object; judging the number of target objects equidistant to the radar according to the space position information; if at least two target objects equidistant to the radar exist in the radar detection space, calculating phase information according to azimuth angle information and pitch angle information of the target objects; and calculating vital sign data of the target object according to the phase information. The non-contact vital sign data monitoring method based on the millimeter wave radar has the advantages of non-contact monitoring, strong monitoring reliability, low cost and the like.

title_en: Multi-radar signal fusion tracking algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an algorithm for fusion tracking of multiple radar signals, which comprises the following steps: A. the method comprises the steps that a through-wall detection radar partition wall is used for collecting echo signals of a through-wall radar, the radar continuously transmits step frequency signals outwards, and meanwhile target echo signals are received; B. and eliminating direct waves from each piece of scanning data in the acquired through-wall radar echo signals, wherein the implementation mode is that two adjacent pieces of scanning data are subtracted in sequence. The invention is suitable for the positioning operation of the portable through-wall detection radar on a moving human body in a partition wall environment by matching with the detection and display device of the through-wall radar on the basis of the echo signal correlation, thereby more rapidly realizing the detection, positioning and tracking of the moving target by utilizing the through-wall detection radar, and solving the problem that the target information can be extracted only by processing multi-frame periodic data due to lower detection data utilization rate when the conventional wireless through-wall radar is used.
assignees: NANJING MIAOMI SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Sand shallow-buried garbage detection method and system based on intelligent trolley and IR-UWB radar
abstract_en: The application provides a sand shallow garbage detection method and system based on an intelligent trolley and an IR-UWB radar, comprising the following steps: step S1: detecting sand by using an IR-UWB radar carried by the intelligent trolley, and collecting radar data which can be used for detecting and positioning garbage; step S2: preprocessing collected radar data which can be used for garbage detection and positioning; step S3: based on the preprocessed radar data, utilizing an improved algorithm based on Canny edge detection to adaptively detect edge features corresponding to a plurality of garbage; step S4: extracting garbage features of the corresponding region and constructing the garbage features as feature vectors; step S5: garbage and noise are distinguished based on the constructed feature vector.

title_en: Non-contact human vital sign measuring device and measuring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact human vital sign measuring device, which comprises a monitoring room, wherein the monitoring room comprises a first wall body and a second wall body which are opposite to each other, the second wall body is provided with an infrared imaging instrument, the first wall body or the second wall body is provided with a moving mechanism, and the moving mechanism is provided with a radar transceiver; the infrared imaging instrument is electrically connected with the processing center, the radar transceiver is electrically connected with the processing center, and the moving mechanism is electrically connected with the processing center. The radar transceiver is used for transmitting signals and receiving reflected signals, the processing center receives the signals, the frequency of the heartbeat and the respiration is obtained according to the Doppler frequency shift of the heartbeat and the respiration, and the moving mechanism is used for changing the position of the radar transceiver, so that the radar transceiver is always aligned to the body of a patient in a monitoring room, and the influence of an interference source on the monitoring result of the radar transceiver is reduced.

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on phase encoding
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vital sign detection, and discloses a vital sign detection method based on phase coding, which is characterized in that a vital sign detection signal is coded in a random coding mode, so that the transmitted signal has certain randomness, interference between adjacent carriers can be avoided, and after correct decoding, the phase of a false target generated by coherent interference can be randomized, thereby detecting a real target and avoiding the influence of coherent interference; the phase noise caused by interference is reduced through phase encoding and traversal decoding, vital signs are obtained from signals subjected to serious incoherent interference, and the capability of the radar system for detecting the vital signs is enhanced; static clutter and false targets are distinguished through variance of phase signals, so that human targets can be accurately detected, and difference operation is carried out on heartbeat signals, so that heartbeat signal components are enhanced, and accuracy of heartbeat frequency detection is improved.

title_en: Human body existence induction detection method and device based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human body existence induction detection method and device based on millimeter wave radar, comprising the following steps: modeling human body vital signs; the monitoring radar transmits a transmission signal of the linear frequency modulation continuous wave into the monitoring area, and simultaneously continuously captures an echo signal reflected by a human body; analyzing a transmitting signal, an echo signal and a beating signal of the radar, and extracting human body vital sign data; checking vital sign information in real time; and separating the heartbeat signal and the respiratory signal, and respectively carrying out frequency calculation on the heartbeat signal and the respiratory signal. According to the invention, the human body vital sign signal is measured by measuring the relative frequency relation between the received signal and the transmitted signal, so that the real-time performance and accuracy of human body vital sign signal detection are improved; the data of the heartbeat signal and the respiratory signal are extracted through confidence parameters based on FFT, autocorrelation and spectrum estimation of peak intervals, so that the accuracy of sensing detection of human existence is greatly improved.

title_en: Machine learning-based non-contact user health anomaly detection method and system
title_ko: 머신 러닝 기반 비접촉식 사용자 건강 이상 상태 탐지 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a machine learning-based non-contact user health anomaly detection system. The present invention includes: a data acquisition unit that acquires user biometric detection data from an image captured by a non-contact biometric signal sensor; a data conversion unit that converts the biometric detection data acquired through the data acquisition unit into biometric signal data; and a user risk detection unit that detects a user's health risk state by using the user's biometric signal data converted through the data conversion unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 머신 러닝 기반 비접촉식 사용자 건강 이상 상태 탐지 시스템에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명은 비접촉 생체 신호 센서를 통해 촬영되는 영상에서 사용자의 생체 검출 데이터를 획득하는 데이터 취득부; 상기 데이터 취득부를 통해 획득한 상기 생체 검출 데이터를 생체 신호 데이터로 변환하는 데이터 변환부; 및 상기 데이터 변환부를 통해 변환된 사용자의 생체 신호 데이터를 이용하여 사용자의 건상 위험 상태를 감지하는 사용자 위험 감지부를 포함한다.

title_en: Ai-based living sensor-linked care service provision system
title_ko: 인공지능 기반의 생활센서 연계 돌봄 서비스 제공 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an artificial intelligence-based care service providing system which comprises: a radar sensor installed in a specific space, detecting life signals including the user's presence, activity, respiration, and heartbeat information in the specific space without contact, and detecting user's body temperature information among the life signals; an artificial intelligence speaker linked to the radar sensor and uttering a speech message of conversation content for confirming an emergency situation to the user to confirm whether there is an emergency situation based on a detection result of the radar sensor, and uttering a speech message of conversation content for recommending a body temperature measurement behavior of the user at a designated time to make the user's body temperature measurement a habit; a monitoring server receiving the life signals collected by the radar sensor, analyzing the received life signals to perform monitoring of the specific space and detect the occurrence of an emergency situation for the user, and confirming the emergency situation detected by the artificial intelligence speaker to provide a notification regarding the emergency situation; and a user terminal linked to each of the radar sensor, the artificial intelligence speaker, and the monitoring server through a dedicated application. Therefore, according to the present invention, it is possible to effectively detect emergency situations by monitoring the health of elderly people living alone at home and situations which may occur in case of an emergency in an aging society.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인공지능 기반의 돌봄 서비스 제공 시스템에 관한 것으로, 특정 공간에 설치되고 상기 특정 공간에서 사용자의 재실, 활동, 호흡 및 심박 정보를 포함하는 생활신호를 비접촉 감지하고 상기 생활신호 중 사용자의 체온 정보를 접촉 감지하는 레이더 센서; 상기 레이더 센서와 연동하고 상기 레이더 센서의 감지결과를 토대로 상기 사용자에게 응급상황 확인을 위한 대화내용의 발화 메시지를 발화하여 응급상황 여부를 확인하고 지정된 시간에 상기 사용자의 체온측정 행동 추천을 위한 대화내용의 발화 메시지를 발화하여 상기 사용자의 체온측정을 습관화시키는 인공지능 스피커; 상기 레이더 센서에 의해 수집된 생활신호를 수신하고 수신된 생활신호를 분석하여 상기 특정 공간에 대한 모니터링을 수행하면서 상기 사용자에 대한 응급상황의 발생을 검출하고 상기 인공지능 스피커에 의해 검출된 응급상황을 확인하여 상기 응급상황에 관한 알림을 제공하는 모니터링 서버; 및 전용 어플리케이션을 통해 상기 레이더 센서, 상기 인공지능 스피커 및 상기 모니터링 서버 각각과 연동하는 사용자 단말;을 포함한다.  따라서, 본 발명은 고령화 사회에서 집에 홀로 있는 노인분들의 건강 체크 및 유사시 발생할 수 있는 상황을 모니터링하여 위급상황을 효과적으로 검출할 수 있다.
assignees: NURION LED CO LTD;HWIAN CO LTD;HAPPY CONNECT;SK TELECOM CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitoring method for bedridden patient
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact vital sign monitoring method for bedridden patients, which comprises monitoring equipment, wherein the monitoring equipment comprises a bed body, a radar transceiver, a processing center and an alarm, wherein the radar transceiver, the processing center and the alarm are arranged on the bed body; the weighing device comprises a weighing piece, a plurality of weighing devices, a processing center and a control unit, wherein the weighing devices are arranged in the weighing piece at intervals, the weighing devices are used for measuring stress conditions of all parts of the weighing piece, and the weighing devices are electrically connected with the processing center. The weighing piece is used for weighing, measuring stress conditions of each point on the mattress, effectively judging the position of a patient, and judging whether an interference source is positioned on the bed.

title_en: Method for arranging asymmetric high-ground-stress tunnel rock burst microseismic sensor
abstract_en: The invention provides an asymmetric high-ground-stress tunnel rock burst microseismic sensor arrangement method, and relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering. Based on tunnel surrounding rock geological data, carrying out three-dimensional numerical simulation on the stability of an asymmetric high-stress tunnel according to the ground stress distribution of an asymmetric original rock and the geometric characteristics of a tunnel section, calculating the energy of the asymmetric high-stress tunnel, determining the position of a rock burst risk area, distributing microseismic sensors in the front and rear of the stress concentration area, and always including an area with higher risk and an area nearby the area in two groups of microseismic sensor arrays arranged in the front and rear of a tunnel face; the microseismic sensors are mutually cooperated and are arranged in a staggered mode in space, and the installation arrangement of the microseismic sensors immediately moves forwards and backwards in the stress concentration area and always keeps a certain distance range with the stress area. The invention ensures that more effective micro-fracture source signals in and near the tunnel stress concentration area can be captured by the micro-seismic sensor, improves the positioning precision of the micro-seismic source, and lays a foundation for accurately predicting and forecasting the tunnel disasters of the deep buried hard rock.

title_en: Fall alarm detection method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of radio wave measurement, in particular to a fall alarm detection method based on millimeter wave radar, which comprises the following steps: step 1: determining a falling alarm detection area boundary, and deploying a millimeter wave radar in the detection area according to the area boundary; step 2: the method comprises the steps of installing life detection equipment in a detection area, setting the life detection equipment to run in real time, and controlling the millimeter wave radar to be converted into a running state from a standby state when a life characteristic target in the detection area is detected; the method can provide fall detection service for the appointed area, provides two different working modes in the execution process of the steps, is suitable for fall detection service of the appointed user or random fall detection service of the user, adopts the millimeter wave radar to detect dynamic vital sign targets in the appointed area, judges whether the user falls through the dynamic state of the vital sign targets, and has the characteristics of accurate identification and low resource consumption cost.

title_en: Human motion gesture recognition method based on radar vital sign signals
abstract_en: The invention provides a human body action classification method based on radar vital sign signals. Firstly, refining and processing a narrow-band spectrum region of interest in a signal global spectrum by using a linear frequency modulation Z conversion method, and extracting accurate information of a specific frequency band; secondly, extracting characteristic values of respiratory and heartbeat signals subjected to the linear frequency modulation Z transformation to obtain 6 effective characteristic values of absolute value characteristics, variances, amplitudes, zero crossing time, slope transformation and root mean square; then, taking the absolute value characteristics, variance, amplitude, zero crossing time, slope transformation and root mean square as input quantities of a support vector machine classifier, and classifying corresponding human actions; finally, a one-dimensional convolutional neural network combined with the provided characteristic values is designed to classify the human body actions. The invention comprehensively considers the relevant characteristics of the human body actions corresponding to the sign signals, monitors the household human body actions, and has good accuracy and reliability.

title_en: Method and device for monitoring movement behavior of patient in magnetic resonance operation
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method and a device for monitoring movement behaviors of a patient in magnetic resonance surgery, which relate to the technical field of human body detection and comprise the following steps: acquiring individual vital sign information of a patient based on a plurality of monitoring devices worn on the patient during a magnetic resonance procedure; judging a first movement grade corresponding to the patient according to each vital sign information and the corresponding reference information; acquiring a first image of a patient in the operation process, and comparing the first image with a preset reference image to judge the corresponding movement range of the patient; determining a second movement grade corresponding to the movement range based on a preset mapping relation; judging a third movement level corresponding to the patient based on measurement information measured by an inertial sensor mounted on the patient; and judging whether the movement behavior of the patient has hidden danger or not according to the first movement grade, the second movement grade and the third movement grade. Therefore, the movement behavior of the patient can be timely, reliably and accurately detected, and whether hidden danger exists or not can be judged.
assignees: SHENSHAN CENTRAL HOSPITAL SUN YAT SEN UNIV

title_en: Improved method of magneto-electric dipole antenna and application system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improvement method of a magneto-electric dipole antenna and an application system thereof, which relate to the technical field of medical vital sign detection, and comprise the improvement of a medium, the improvement of a patch and the improvement of a magnetic dipole, and the application of non-contact non-line-of-sight internal human health detection. The improved method of the magnetic electric dipole antenna and the application system thereof aim at the traditional magnetic electric dipole antenna, and the cost is greatly reduced by using a multilayer PCB technology; based on three improvements of magnetic dipoles, media and patches, the size of the antenna is greatly reduced, and meanwhile, the gain and the higher performance of the directivity pattern are maintained, and meanwhile, the antenna is particularly suitable for a miniaturized radar detection system.
assignees: BEIJING INSTITUTE TECH;TANGSHAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE BEIJING INSTITUTE OF TECH

title_en: Detection system and detection method of vital sign
abstract_en: A detection system (10) and a detection method of vital sign are provided. The method includes: transmitting a first radio frequency (RF) signal and receiving a first radar signal corresponding to the first RF signal by a first radar (210, 220, 230, or 240); performing IQ-demodulation on the first radar signal to obtain a first receiving in-phase component and a first receiving quadrature component; performing a first convolution operation to the first receiving in-phase component and a first symbol and performing a multiply accumulate (MAC) operation to a first result of the first convolution operation to obtain a first accumulated value; performing a second convolution operation to the first receiving quadrature component and the first symbol and performing a MAC operation to a second result of the second convolution operation to obtain a second accumulated value; and generating a vital sign according to the first and the second accumulated value.

title_en: Life detection radar fire environment operation performance research test device
abstract_en: The invention provides a life detection radar fire environment operation performance research test device, and relates to the technical field of life detection radar operation performance research. The device comprises a flue and a combustion chamber; the first end of the smoke inlet channel is connected with the combustion chamber, the second end of the smoke inlet channel is connected with the flue, and the cavity channel, the storage bin and the smoke inlet channel of the flue are communicated; the radar signal transceiver is positioned outside the first end wall of the flue; the radar signal reflector is connected to the second end wall of the flue; the smoke environment parameter monitoring and adjusting assembly is arranged in the flue and is suitable for adjusting smoke parameters in the cavity so as to accord with a preset value. The life detection radar fire environment operation performance research test device can accurately simulate the smoke environment under the condition of fire, provides a test platform for researching the operation performance of the life detection radar under the fire environment, and ensures the feasibility of quantitative evaluation of the operation efficiency under the fire environment of the life detection radar.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign detection system with privacy protection function
abstract_en: The invention relates to a non-contact vital sign detection system with privacy protection, which comprises a human body detection radar, at least one signal power connection line and a server, wherein the human body detection radar is used for detecting whether a user enters an environment space, if so, a frequency modulation pulse signal is transmitted to the user to generate vital sign signal data corresponding to the user, and the server is connected to the human body detection radar through the signal power connection line and is used for judging whether the vital sign signal data is in a normal range or not, and if not, an abnormal alarm is issued. The non-contact vital sign detection system with privacy protection can simplify the configuration of wires.

title_en: Apparatus for controlling smart health care mattress
title_ko: 환자 특정이 가능한 스마트 병실용 침대 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart hospital bed monitoring system capable of specifying a patient. The bed monitoring system comprises: a hospital bed; an RFID tag storing preset unique tag identification information; a plurality of RFID readers mounted on one side of the hospital bed; at least one radar sensor device mounted on one side of the hospital bed; a radar control device; and a patient management server connected to the radar control device through a communication network. Therefore, the bed monitoring system can efficiently collect and monitor only bio-signal data of a corresponding patient by specifying the patient.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 환자 특정이 가능한 스마트 병실용 침대 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 환자가 누울 수 있도록 구비되는 병실용 침대와, 해당 환자가 소지할 수 있도록 구비되며, 기 설정된 고유한 태그식별정보를 저장하는 RFID 태그와, 병실용 침대의 일측에 장착되며, RFID 태그의 정보를 RFID 방식으로 인식하고, 인식된 RFID 태그의 고유한 태그식별정보를 전송하는 복수개의 RFID 리더기들과, 병실용 침대의 일측에 장착되며, 적어도 하나의 레이더를 이용하여 병실용 침대 상에 존재하는 해당 환자의 생체정보와 관련된 신호를 비접촉식으로 검출하는 적어도 하나의 레이더 센서장치와, 복수개의 RFID 리더기들 중 전파가 수신되고 있는 RFID 리더기의 방향으로 빔포밍 방식을 이용하여 레이더 신호가 송출되도록 레이더 센서장치의 동작을 제어하고, 전파가 수신되고 있는 RFID 리더기로부터 인식된 RFID 태그의 고유한 태그식별정보와 함께 레이더 센서장치로부터 검출된 해당 환자의 생체정보와 관련된 신호를 수집 및 전송하는 레이더 제어장치와, 레이더 제어장치와 통신망을 통해 연결되며, 레이더 제어장치로부터 전송된 RFID 태그의 고유한 태그식별정보와 함께 해당 환자의 생체정보와 관련된 신호를 제공받아 이를 기반으로 해당 환자의 재실/부재, 수면, 체위, 호흡, 심박, 움직임, 또는 거리 상태 중 적어도 하나의 환자 상태정보를 실시간 분석 및 환자 상태 통합 모니터링을 수행하는 환자 관리서버를 포함함으로써, 불필요한 생체신호 데이터가 섞이는 경우를 최소화할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 환자를 특정하여 해당 환자의 생체신호 데이터만을 효율적으로 수집 및 모니터링 할 수 있다.
assignees: PEOPLE MULTI CO LTD;CHUNGNAM NATIONAL UNIV HOSPITAL

title_en: Sleep capsule
title_ko: 수면 캡슐
abstract_en: A sleep capsule according to one aspect of the present disclosure comprises: a mattress; a base supporting the mattress; a cover coupled with the base to form an internal space; an air conditioning unit which discharges air at a predetermined temperature into the internal space formed by the base and the cover; and a sensor unit including one or more sensors that detect biometric signals of a user lying on the mattress, wherein the air conditioning unit changes an angle of the vane, which adjusts the wind direction of air discharged into the internal space, based on the biometric signals detected by the sensor unit. According to the present invention, the comfortable sensation can be increased by utilizing a plurality of cooling and heating means.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 일 측면에 따른 수면 캡슐은, 매트리스, 상기 매트리스를 지지하는 베이스(base), 상기 베이스와 결합되어 내부 공간을 형성하는 커버(cover), 상기 베이스와 상기 커버가 형성하는 내부 공간으로 소정 온도의 공기를 토출하는 공조부, 및, 상기 매트리스에 누워 있는 사용자의 생체신호를 감지하는 하나 이상의 센서를 포함하는 센서부를 포함하고, 상기 공조부는, 상기 센서부에서 감지되는 생체신호에 기초하여, 상기 내부 공간으로 토출되는 공기의 풍향을 조절하는 베인의 각도를 변경한다.

title_en: Sleep capsule
title_ko: 수면 캡슐
abstract_en: A sleep capsule according to one aspect of the present disclosure comprises: a mattress; a base supporting the mattress; a cover coupled with the base to form an internal space; a mattress air pressure control unit which adjusts the air pressure of an air area formed inside the mattress; and a sensor unit including one or more sensors that detect biometric signals of a user lying on the mattress, wherein the mattress air pressure control unit adjusts the air pressure of the air area based on the biometric signals detected by the sensor unit. According to the present invention, the comfortable sensation can be increased by utilizing a plurality of cooling and heating means.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 일 측면에 따른 수면 캡슐은, 매트리스, 상기 매트리스를 지지하는 베이스(base), 상기 베이스와 결합되어 내부 공간을 형성하는 커버(cover), 상기 매트리스의 내부에 형성된 에어(air) 영역의 공기압을 조절하는 매트리스 공기압조절부, 및, 상기 매트리스에 누워 있는 사용자의 생체신호를 감지하는 하나 이상의 센서를 포함하는 센서부를 포함하고, 상기 매트리스 공기압조절부는, 상기 센서부에서 감지되는 생체신호에 기초하여, 상기 에어 영역의 공기압을 조절한다.

title_en: Thermal cycle chemical industry reation kettle
abstract_en: The invention provides a thermal cycle chemical reaction kettle, which relates to the field of chemical reaction kettles, and comprises: a base; the base is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the unloading pool, the unloading pool is buried underground in a workshop, and the upper end face of the unloading pool is level with the ground of the workshop; the chemical reaction kettle main body is fixedly arranged on the left side of the upper end surface of the base, and the thermal circulation box is fixedly arranged on the right side of the upper end surface of the base; an insulation layer is arranged outside the chemical reaction kettle main body; according to the invention, through the cooperation of the temperature sensor, the controller and the auxiliary discharging mechanism, the quick discharging work can be realized when the chemical reaction kettle encounters emergency situations such as continuous overhigh production temperature, and the like, so that the safety of the chemical reaction kettle is improved when the chemical reaction kettle encounters emergency situations; the problem of current chemical industry reation kettle when meetting the production temperature and last emergency such as too high is difficult to realize quick blowing work to the security when meetting the emergency has been reduced to chemical industry reation kettle.
assignees: NANTONG HUAXING MAGNETIC MAT CO LTD

title_en: High-precision camera detector based on loop antenna
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-precision camera detector based on a loop antenna. Including the main part, main part one end is annular head, and the other end is handheld portion, and the main part is fixed mounting has the light filter in the interior ring chamber of annular head, and annular head inside is provided with annular installation cavity, has buried annular antenna in the annular installation cavity, and handheld portion is external to have infrared LED lamp and built-in circuit board and battery. The loop design of the loop antenna can enlarge the detection area, so that the loop antenna is more sensitive to detection than a single vertical antenna, and the signal detected by the antenna is processed by a designed signal processing circuit, so that the signal is subjected to secondary signal transportation and amplification, and the voltage follower is combined to achieve the effects of buffering and improving the load capacity, thereby further improving the detection accuracy in circuit signal processing.

title_en: Respiration detection method based on MIMO millimeter wave radar signals
abstract_en: The invention designs a respiration detection method based on MIMO millimeter wave radar signals. The method mainly comprises three modules: a quick screening module based on cosine similarity, an optimal channel screening module based on distance dimension total energy and a breathing rate estimation module based on WOA-VMD. The rapid screening module can primarily screen a group of channels with larger difference from a plurality of channels of the MIMO millimeter wave radar. The optimal channel screening module further selects a channel with the largest distance dimension total energy from the group of channels. And finally, the respiratory rate estimation module sequentially performs phase unwrapping, phase difference calculation and self-adaptive optimal modal decomposition on the radar signals in the optimal channel, so that the respiratory rate is extracted. The method solves the problem that the target is far away from the radar and has larger breath detection error when deviating from the radar, and improves the breath detection accuracy based on radar signals.

title_en: Fine-granularity respiration waveform reconstruction method based on MIMO millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of non-contact vital sign monitoring, and discloses a fine-granularity respiration waveform reconstruction method based on MIMO millimeter wave radar, which comprises the following steps: setting radar parameters and collecting data, processing the data by utilizing a two-dimensional Fourier transform to obtain a time-distance-azimuth radar matrix, removing reflected signals of static objects in the time-distance-azimuth radar matrix by utilizing a loop filter, positioning a human body region by utilizing a 2D-CFAR algorithm, performing rotation processing on I/Q components in the human body region, performing label normalization processing and data set division, constructing an IQ-transducer model, inputting radar data to be predicted into a trained network model, and realizing fine-granularity respiration monitoring. The invention is responsible for extracting and encoding the breath-related hidden features from the I/Q component of the radar data by designing an IQ-transducer model, and finally recovering the fine-granularity respiration waveform from the hidden features.

title_en: Old man's robot system of accompanying and attending to based on interaction of multidimension degree intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional intelligent interaction-based elderly accompanying robot accompanying system, which relates to the technical field of accompanying robots, wherein heart rate, respiratory rate and body temperature can be monitored in real time by utilizing a vital sign radar without contacting a user, the health state of the user is comprehensively estimated by combining the monitoring of the heart rate, the respiratory rate and the body temperature, the multi-dimensional health monitoring and the evaluation are beneficial to finding potential health problems as soon as possible, in addition, the user can interact with the robot through voice instructions to carry out video call, inquire calendar and weather information, the user experience of the elderly is improved, the technical use threshold is reduced, the system is internally provided with an image processing unit, dangerous situations such as falling or abnormal behaviors can be identified, medical staff and family contacts are automatically contacted, timely emergency rescue is provided, daily chatting and psychological guiding with the elderly are realized by utilizing a large language model, and possible autism and depression symptoms are relieved.

title_en: Non-contact heart rate monitoring device based on FMCW radar, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact heart rate monitoring device based on an FMCW radar, computer equipment and a storage medium. The device comprises a signal acquisition and acquisition module and is used for extracting vital sign signals from radar echo signals, and the flow is as follows: firstly, capturing an echo signal containing vital signs, selecting the echo signal through Fourier transformation and a target corresponding distance gate to obtain a quadrature I/Q signal, demodulating the I/Q signal by removing direct current and arctangent phases, and extracting the vital sign signal; the signal processing module is used for performing singular value decomposition on the vital sign signals and removing noise and interference; then, carrying out complementary aggregate empirical mode decomposition (CEEMD) on the denoised vital sign signals to obtain heartbeat signals; the heart rate abnormality alarm module is used for heart rate calculation and abnormality processing, and the flow is as follows: firstly, zero filling and windowing are carried out on the heartbeat signal, the signal frequency spectrum is calculated, the frequency corresponding to the maximum peak value is used as a heart rate result, and an alarm is given when the heart rate result is abnormal. The heart rate monitoring system can monitor heart rate in real time and provide an abnormality alarm function.
assignees: NANJING HONGDING PERCEPTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for detecting through-wall radar target
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar target detection method, which comprises the steps of detecting by adopting a through-wall radar and acquiring an original echo signal; pulse compression is carried out to obtain compressed echo data; performing clutter suppression; performing coherent imaging to obtain an imaging result; constructing a robust principal component analysis optimization model based on the imaging result; and solving the model to obtain a final target detection result, and finishing the through-wall radar target detection. The invention also discloses a system for realizing the through-wall radar target detection method. The method for analyzing the robust principal component is applied to the target detection of the through-wall radar, and not only realizes the target detection of the through-wall radar through the technical scheme of pulse compression, clutter suppression, coherent imaging and robust principal component analysis, but also is suitable for the simultaneous detection of multiple moving and static targets under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio, and has the advantages of higher detection accuracy and reliability, better robustness, higher detection speed and higher efficiency.

title_en: Fine detection system and method for dam formic nest ground penetrating radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a dam newly-buried nest ground penetrating radar refined detection system and method, which relate to the technical field of dam newly-buried nest geophysical detection, and aim at the current short plates such as shallow detection depth, difficult sketching of space characteristics of newly-buried nest in detection section, incapability of reflecting expansion degree of newly-buried nest on a dam cross section and the like of the current ground penetrating radar.
assignees: ZHEJIANG GUANGCHUAN ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Wall clutter suppression method based on DPSS dictionary and block self-adaptive subspace tracking
abstract_en: The invention provides a wall clutter suppression method based on a DPSS dictionary and a block self-adaptive subspace tracking. Aiming at the problems that the through-wall clutter suppression method needs more priori and is suitable for single radar system, the invention firstly utilizes the characteristics of time-frequency truncation and strong energy aggregation capability of the DPSS dictionary to effectively characterize the expansion target of the wall body, and avoids the priori requirement on the relevant parameters of the wall body. And then, the backtracking characteristic of the subspace tracking algorithm and the characteristic of simultaneously iterating a plurality of atoms are utilized to realize the accurate reconstruction of wall clutter, avoid the prior limitation of the wall clutter range and realize single-channel processing to be popularized to multiple radar systems such as SAR, MIMO and the like. And the efficiency of the reconstruction algorithm is improved by utilizing the blocking characteristic of the DPSS dictionary, and the sparseness prior required by the reconstruction algorithm is avoided by combining with the self-adaptive iteration. And finally, accurately reconstructing the wall clutter, and subtracting the original echo to complete wall clutter suppression.

title_en: Vital sign remote monitoring system for emergency rescue safety management
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign remote monitoring system for emergency rescue safety management, which relates to the technical field of emergency rescue and comprises a vital sign acquisition end, a comprehensive processing module, a 5G data transmission module, a display module and a power supply module, wherein the vital sign acquisition end comprises an infrared body temperature monitoring module, a heart rate blood pressure monitoring module, an electrocardio monitoring module and a blood oxygen monitoring module, the output ends of the infrared body temperature monitoring module, the heart rate blood pressure monitoring module, the electrocardio monitoring module and the blood oxygen monitoring module are all connected with the comprehensive processing module through signal wires, and the output end of the comprehensive processing module is respectively connected with the input ends of the 5G data transmission module and the display module through the signal wires. According to the invention, a doctor diagnoses through observing the data or waveforms of blood pressure, electrocardio, blood oxygen, respiration and the like displayed on the system, so that the doctor can timely acquire vital sign data information of a patient, thereby facilitating remote rescue guidance and improving emergency efficiency.
assignees: HEFEI D E ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Feature extraction method and device for vital sign signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a feature extraction method and device of vital sign signals, comprising the following steps: modeling vital sign signals caused by chest movement; mixing echo signals of a continuous wave radar system to obtain beat frequency signals for modeling; obtaining a phase gradient of the obtained beat frequency signal, and estimating a second-order delay product; estimating a second-order cyclic time-varying torque using the second-order delay product; root of Chinese characterEnhancement spectrum based on second order cyclic time-varying moment structure Extracting the strongest respiratory harmonic frequency in the enhancement spectrum; estimating the strongest respiratory harmonic order to extract the target respiratory rate Constructing harmonic suppression enhancement spectra from respiratory frequencies Extracting target heart beat frequency And iteratively optimizing and estimating the target respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency. The invention can realize accurate extraction of non-contact target respiration and heartbeat frequency under strong harmonic interference.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;PURPLE MOUNTAIN LABORATORIES FOR NETWORK COMMUNICATION & SECURITY

title_en: Technique for treating surface air leakage of shallow-buried coal seam easy to naturally fire
abstract_en: The invention relates to a shallow-buried natural ignition-prone coal seam surface air leakage treatment technology, which comprises three parts of surface air leakage treatment, fire area gas detection and emergency rescue treatment. The earth surface air leakage monitoring and detecting device is used for carrying out qualitative and quantitative measurement, and plugging materials with bentonite as a substrate are used for filling cracks. And constructing a multi-jump infinite area network, arranging data acquisition nodes at the middle and lower parts of the hydraulic support along the working surface, and covering the outer sides of the nodes by large-block coal-losing to form a triangular protection area. Along with the pushing of the working face, the nodes are buried in the goaf, a data acquisition local area network is constructed, and gas and temperature signals are transmitted in a relay mode. The stepless air damper is provided with an air speed sensor and a rotating blade, so that the aperture of the variable air window is formed, the tunnel air quantity is sensed in real time, and remote intelligent regulation and control are realized. The wall surface spraying vehicle sprays and forms plugging foam on the rugged roadway wall surface. The technology has the remarkable characteristics of high systematic degree of treatment and strong application scene pertinence, and can be used for carrying out high-efficiency treatment on the coal seam which is shallow buried and easy to fire naturally.

title_en: A battery charging system that can quickly extinguish a fire with an infiltration extinguishing agent
title_ko: 침윤소화약제에 의해 신속 화재진압이 가능한 배터리충전 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a battery charging system for extinguishing a fire occurring during the charging of a battery by spraying an infiltration fire-extinguishing agent when the fire starts.The battery charging system capable of quickly extinguishing a fire by using an infiltration fire-extinguishing agent according to an embodiment of the present invention, which charges an electrically operating device operated by a battery, comprises: a battery charging chamber for accommodating the battery-driven device; and a fire-detecting attachment and detachment jig including a fire detection sensor installed on a portion where the battery is placed in the battery-driven device, to be able to be attached and detached, thereby detecting a fire in the battery. The fire-detecting attachment and detachment jig includes a perforator for perforating the device case of the electrically operating device so that the infiltration fire-extinguishing agent can be infiltrated into the electrically operating device to extinguish a fire in the battery when the fire in the battery is detected by the fire detection sensor. Therefore, a fire in the battery can be extinguished quickly when the fire in the battery starts.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 배터리의 충전 시 발생하는 화재의 발화 시점에 침윤소화약제를 분사하여 진압하기 위한 배터리충전 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 침윤소화약제에 의해 신속 화재진압이 가능한 배터리충전 시스템은 배터리에 의해 작동하는 전기작동장치를 충전하는 침윤소화약제에 의해 신속 화재진압이 가능한 배터리충전 시스템으로서, 상기 배터리구동장치를 수용하는 배터리충전챔버, 상기 배터리구동장치에서 상기 배터리가 위치하는 부분에 탈착 가능하게 설치되어 상기 배터리의 화재를 감지하는 화재감지센서를 포함하는 화재감지 탈착지그를 포함하고, 상기 화재감지 탈착지그는 상기 화재감지센서에서 상기 배터리의 화재를 감지하는 경우, 상기 전기작동장치의 내부로 상기 침윤소화약제를 침투시켜 화재를 진압하도록 상기 전기작동장치의 장치케이스를 천공하는 천공부를 포함한다. 따라서 배터리의 발화시점에서 신속하게 화재를 진압할 수 있다.
assignees: KOREA FLAME PROOF TECH;KIM KYOUNG HO;CHO HEUBG HWAN

title_en: Radar respiration detection method, device and system adopting infrared camera shooting assistance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of human health monitoring, in particular to a radar respiration detection method, device and system adopting infrared camera shooting assistance. According to the radar respiration detection method adopting infrared camera shooting assistance, provided by the invention, the infrared camera is used for assisting the millimeter wave radar as a non-contact monitoring means, the position information of a subject can be positioned through an infrared image, and the phase deviation generated by a large-amplitude body movement is corrected, so that more accurate respiration data can be obtained. According to the invention, the body temperature value is measured through infrared, so that whether the monitored object is in a human or non-human state can be judged, thereby realizing the screening of effective respiration data, avoiding the misjudgment of an autocorrelation link and being capable of monitoring the respiration rate of the human body more accurately.

title_en: Safety monitoring method, system and terminal for ultra-deep buried high-ground-stress hydraulic tunnel
abstract_en: The application relates to a safety monitoring method, a system and a terminal for a hydraulic tunnel with ultra-deep buried high ground stress, belonging to the technical field of safety monitoring of hydraulic tunnels, wherein the safety monitoring method comprises the following steps: acquiring construction information of a hydraulic tunnel to be monitored, wherein the construction information comprises lining structure information and surrounding rock type information; searching hydraulic tunnel information which is matched with the hydraulic tunnel construction information to be monitored and is monitored in a history; if the information is found, an image set associated with the hydraulic tunnel information is called, wherein the image set comprises a normal image subset, an interference image subset and an abnormal image subset; acquiring a detection image of a geological radar when the hydraulic tunnel to be monitored is detected; comparing the detection images with the images in the image set respectively to generate a comparison result; and classifying the detection images according to the image set according to the comparison result. The application has the beneficial effect of reducing the labor capacity of staff.
assignees: SHANDONG WATER CONSERVANCY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Radar identification of persons via vital signs
abstract_en: A radar apparatus comprises: a processor; a radar; and a non-transitory memory storing instructions that, when executed by the processor, configure the apparatus to perform a method. The method comprises: emitting a radar signal with the radar; receiving backscattered radar signals with the radar; extracting reflection data from the backscattered radar signal; determining at least one vital sign of at least one person from the extracted reflection data; and identifying the at least one person by using a first machine learning model to provide a similarity score between the determined at least one vital sign and at least one vital sign from previously collected vital signs of the at least one person.

title_en: Pipeline buried depth precision detection device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pipeline buried depth precision detection device, which comprises a bottom frame, wheels are arranged at four corners of the bottom frame, the wheels are connected to the bottom frame through lifting components, a supporting frame is arranged on the upper end face of the bottom frame, a spherical hinge connecting piece is arranged above the inside of the bottom frame and fixedly arranged on the supporting frame, a ball head is arranged in the spherical hinge connecting piece in a universal rotation mode, a straight rod is connected below the ball head, a locking component for limiting the ball head to rotate in the spherical hinge connecting piece is further arranged on the spherical hinge connecting piece, a push rod is further connected above the rear end of the bottom frame, a holding rod is further arranged behind the upper end of the push rod, a control component for controlling the locking component is further arranged on the holding rod, a mounting plate for loading a ground penetrating radar is further arranged at the bottom of the straight rod, and a plurality of counterweight components are further arranged at the non-center position of the mounting plate. The device has high trafficability and high stability, and effectively reduces the collision risk of the ground penetrating radar and improves the stability of the ground penetrating radar when detecting on a complex road surface.

title_en: Underground pipeline parameter detection method based on deep learning and ground penetrating radar
abstract_en: The application provides an underground pipeline parameter detection method based on deep learning and ground penetrating radar, which comprises the following steps: according to the distribution diagram of the existing underground pipeline and the known actual excavation data, arranging the underground pipeline with known material parameters, buried depth parameters and pipe diameter parameters; scanning and detecting a known underground pipeline, acquiring an actual measurement radar profile image of the underground pipeline, preprocessing the actual measurement radar profile image, modeling the underground pipeline by using ground penetrating radar forward modeling software, acquiring and processing an emulation radar profile image, processing and labeling the material, the burial depth and the pipe diameter of the emulation radar profile image according to parameters of the underground pipeline, training a pre-trained target detection network by using the emulation radar profile image, generating an underground pipeline detection network, and carrying out parameter adjustment and optimization on the underground pipeline detection network; outputting parameter information of the underground pipeline through the optimized underground light detection network.

title_en: Through-wall radar imaging method based on maximum echo energy selection back projection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar imaging method based on maximum echo energy selection backward projection, which comprises the steps of obtaining a multi-channel original echo signal through a through-wall radar; performing pulse compression processing on the acquired original echo signals; performing clutter suppression processing on the echo signals obtained after the processing; performing compensation processing on the extra time delay through a refraction angle approximation wall time delay compensation algorithm; dividing an imaging area by adopting the echo signals obtained after processing and the compensation processing result, and establishing a mapping relation between a distance-direction pixel point and an azimuth-direction pixel point; based on the established mapping relation, obtaining a final imaging result through coherent superposition processing, and completing imaging processing; according to the method, the echo signal with larger energy is selected as a scattering echo of a target, a mapping relation of a distance direction and a direction is constructed, and coherent imaging is carried out; the method has the advantages of reduced redundant calculation, increased imaging speed and improved imaging precision.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring product and health management platform for medical care patients
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring product and health management platform for medical care and patient integration, which solves the technical problems by adopting the following technical scheme: the method comprises the steps of constructing desktop-end child monitoring equipment, namely a monitoring terminal, wherein the monitoring terminal comprises a development board, and a sleep breathing sensor, a microphone and a screen which are respectively in communication connection with the development board; and the USB camera module is externally connected. According to the invention, a service system comprising the child monitoring equipment is designed, the child condition is concerned at any time through real-time data feedback, and the platform is alarmed when vital signs are abnormal. In addition, the desktop end equipment can not lead to the skin to be scalded by the electrode slice and other phenomena because of long wearing time. And the active health platform provides the functions of data management, data acquisition, health management, risk early warning, remote diagnosis and data analysis.
assignees: SHANGHAI CHILDRENS MEDICAL CENTER AFFILIATED TO SHANGHAI JIAOTONG UNIV SCHOOL OF MEDICINE

title_en: Underground facility surveying and exploration system using GPR exploration equipment
title_ko: 지피알(gpr) 탐사장비를 이용한 지하시설물 측량 탐사 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an underground facility surveying and exploration system using ground penetrating radar (GPR) exploration equipment. More specifically, the present invention relates to an underground facility surveying and exploration system using GPR exploration equipment, which is improved to facilitate surrounding exploration based on underground facilities and improve the convenience of exploration when exploring the buried depth of underground facilities, structures around underground facilities and the distance to those structures, or the like.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지피알(GPR) 탐사장비를 이용한 지하시설물 측량 탐사 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 지하시설물의 매설 깊이, 지하시설물 주변의 구조물 및 그 구조물과의 거리 등을 탐사할 때 지하시설물을 기준으로 주변 탐사를 용이하게 하고, 탐사의 편의성을 향상시키도록 개선된 지피알(GPR) 탐사장비를 이용한 지하시설물 측량 탐사 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar and deep learning
