abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of vital sign monitoring, and discloses a vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar and deep learning, aiming at solving the problems of high cost, low accuracy and insufficient privacy protection of the existing vital sign monitoring method, and the scheme mainly comprises the following steps: the transmitting antenna transmits the linear continuous frequency modulation electromagnetic wave, the transmitting antenna receives the echo signal reflected by the target human body, and the echo signal is subjected to frequency mixing operation to obtain an intermediate frequency signal; obtaining radar cube data according to the intermediate frequency signals, and constructing a distance-azimuth heat map according to the radar cube data; detecting the distance-azimuth heat map to obtain a distance and azimuth unit where a chest of a target human body is located, and extracting to obtain effective phase data; and inputting the effective phase data into a deep learning model, obtaining the respiratory rate and the heart rate of a target human body in the current time period, and determining whether the state of the target human body is abnormal. According to the method and the device, the vital sign monitoring cost is reduced, and the accuracy and privacy protection are improved.

title_en: Method, device, terminal equipment and storage medium for acquiring vital sign data
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method, a device, a terminal device and a storage medium for acquiring vital sign data, wherein the terminal device comprises a radar system, so that raw data can be acquired directly through the radar system, direct contact with a user is not needed, the raw data is processed through a preset network model, the vital sign data is acquired, and the convenience for acquiring the vital sign data of the user is greatly improved. The method of the embodiment of the application is applied to terminal equipment, wherein the terminal equipment comprises a radar system, and the method can comprise the following steps: under the condition that the radar system is in an on state, acquiring first original data through the radar system; under the condition that the radar system is in an on state, acquiring first original data through the radar system; inputting the first original data into a first preset network model, and outputting vital sign data, wherein the first preset network model is an algorithm model obtained by model training according to a first historical original data set and a historical vital sign data set.
assignees: OPPO GUANGDONG MOBILE TELECOMMUNICATIONS CO LTD

title_en: Pile top indwelling pipe internal vibration pickup detection method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of pile foundation detection, and particularly relates to a pile top indwelling pipe internal vibration pickup detection method, which comprises the following steps: s1, arranging an acceleration sensor; s2, data acquisition and pretreatment; s3, data processing and analysis; s4, evaluating and analyzing results, wherein the pile top indwelling pipe internal vibration pickup detection technology provided by the invention detects the problems of damage, defects and the like in the reinforced concrete pile foundation deeply buried and fixed underground through the pile top indwelling pipe, can improve detection accuracy, efficiency and reduce cost, plays a positive promoting role in ensuring the safety of the pile foundation, can be used for solving the monitoring problem of the pile foundation quality during the service period of a building and the evaluation problem of the damage degree of the building pile foundation after disaster, and has an important guiding role in reinforcing an old house and capping a house.

title_en: Monitoring method for breathing and heart rate of multiple persons based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring method of breathing and heart rate of multiple persons based on millimeter wave radar, comprising the following steps: transmitting electromagnetic waves to a target area, determining a distance unit where the target is located according to echo signals, estimating an arrival angle according to signals received by different receiving antennas, and determining the target in the area through Gaussian smoothing filtering; determining the phase of the target according to the distance unit, so as to obtain an original signal of the respiratory heartbeat overlapping of the real human target; separating a respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal from the original signals overlapped with respiratory heartbeats through a principal component analysis algorithm, and decomposing the respiratory signal and the heartbeat signal through a variation mode to obtain a respiratory signal component and a heartbeat signal component; estimating a respiration value and a heart rate value according to the respiration signal component and the heartbeat signal component; the invention provides some important information during vital sign monitoring or discovery.

title_en: Sleep physiological information monitoring system based on sleep monitoring platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sleep monitoring, and discloses a sleep physiological information monitoring system based on a sleep monitoring platform, which comprises an electroencephalogram detector, a sleep mattress, a radar respiration detection device, a visualization device and a monitoring center; the electroencephalogram detector comprises an electroencephalogram acquisition module, a blood oxygen acquisition module, a forehead temperature acquisition module, a main control chip and a Bluetooth module. The beneficial effects are as follows: the invention provides a sleep physiological information monitoring system based on a sleep monitoring platform, which utilizes an electroencephalogram detector to collect electroencephalogram signals, blood oxygen concentration signals and forehead temperature signals, and utilizes a sleep mattress and a radar respiration detection device to synchronously monitor respiration heart rate signals. Compared with the prior art, the physiological data monitored in the invention is more comprehensive and more accurate, and more accurate data support is provided for subsequent treatment of sleep monitoring.
assignees: CHONGQING THE SEVENTH PEOPLES HOSPITAL;UNIV CHONGQING TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Buried electric network equipment detection device and detection method based on ground penetrating radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underground grounding detection, in particular to a buried electric network equipment detection device and a detection method based on ground penetrating radar. In the ground penetrating radar-based ground penetrating network equipment detection device and the ground penetrating radar-based ground penetrating network equipment detection method, the three-dimensional and four-dimensional space image ground penetrating radar measuring instrument is realized by detecting the change generated when an earth electromagnetic field encounters different mediums. Therefore, underground grounding devices such as transformers, lightning arresters, towers and the like in the power grid structure are conveniently subjected to underground hidden engineering inspection and acceptance, daily inspection operation and maintenance inspection is performed for positioning, measuring and analyzing, positioning and measurement of the underground metal grounding body without excavation are realized, and power grid construction hidden engineering inspection and acceptance and daily operation and maintenance positioning, detection and flaw detection are assisted.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD QUJING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Wearable through-wall radar system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wearable through-the-wall radar system, which comprises a radar host, a display control terminal and a body armor, wherein the radar host is connected with the display control terminal; the radar host comprises a receiving and transmitting antenna array, a radio frequency subsystem, a data processing subsystem and a power supply; the body armor comprises a cover, a bulletproof layer, a buffer layer and bulletproof plugboards, and the cover, the bulletproof layer, the buffer layer and the bulletproof plugboards are sequentially arranged from outside to inside; the receiving and transmitting antennas in the receiving and transmitting antenna array are arranged on the outer side of the bulletproof layer, and the radio frequency subsystem is arranged on the inner side of the bulletproof plugboard; the bulletproof layer and the buffer layer are provided with mounting holes, the data processing subsystem comprises a circuit board and a metal shell, the circuit board is arranged inside the metal shell, the metal shell is arranged in the mounting holes, and the transceiver antennas in the transceiver antenna array are arranged on the periphery of the mounting holes on the bulletproof layer and are connected with the circuit board through flexible flat cables. The utility model integrates the radar system and the body armor, and meets the wearable requirement of the radar system.

title_en: Indoor static personnel detection method for millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting indoor static personnel of a millimeter wave radar, which comprises the following steps: step S1: reconstructing data, detecting categories of indoor personnel and the like, wherein the targets are in a scene with low movement speed, and then performing subsequent signal processing after the reconstruction data are needed; step S2: signal processing; step S3: implementing an algorithm, and implementing a cluster tracking algorithm according to the point cloud data in the step S2; step S4: confirming a target; step S5: and outputting a result. The method can realize the detection of indoor dynamic personnel and static personnel targets. The dynamic target detection is mainly realized through radar signal processing and a cluster tracking algorithm, and the static target detection is based on the detection of the respiratory heartbeat intensity, standard deviation and spatial correlation of the vital signals by using a vital sign detection algorithm, so that the effective detection of the static target is realized.

title_en: Human health data measuring and calculating method and system based on frequency modulation continuous wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human health data measuring and calculating method and a system based on a frequency modulation continuous wave radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: constructing a transmitting end array and a receiving end array of the FMCW radar, configuring a transmitting signal, and mixing an echo signal with the transmitting signal to obtain an intermediate frequency signal; s2: sampling and rearranging the intermediate frequency signals to obtain a data matrix and signal data after direct current bias filtering; s3: determining the position of a human body target according to the signal data; s4: extracting vital sign phase signals according to the position of a human body target; s5: from the phase signal, wavelet decomposition and reconstruction, and heart rate estimation are performed. The heart rate estimation method and the heart rate estimation device can effectively improve the accuracy rate of heart rate estimation.
assignees: SICHUAN JINGCHENG DIANKE TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Washing machine and control method thereof
title_ko: 세탁기 및 세탁기의 제어 방법
abstract_en: A washing machine and a control method for the washing machine are provided. The washing machine may comprise: a cabinet which forms the appearance of the washing machine; a tub formed inside the cabinet; a life detection sensor which detects life inside the washing machine through millimeter wave radar; and at least one processor. The at least one processor may receive a request for activating a remote control mode of the washing machine from an external device through a communication interface. The at least one processor may, upon the request, activate the life detection sensor. The at least one processor may receive a detection signal regarding the presence or absence of life inside the washing machine from the life detection sensor. The at least one processor may transmit information about whether life exists inside the washing machine to the external device through the communication interface, based on the received detection signal.
abstract_ko: 세탁기 및 세탁기의 제어 방법이 제공된다. 세탁기는 세탁기의 외관을 형성하는 캐비닛, 캐비닛 내부에 형성된 터브, 밀리미터파 레이더를 통해 세탁기 내부의 생명체를 감지하는 생명체 감지 센서, 및 적어도 하나의 프로세서를 포함할 수 있다. 적어도 하나의 프로세서는, 통신 인터페이스를 통해 외부 장치로부터 세탁기의 원격 제어 모드를 활성화하기 위한 요청을 수신할 수 있다. 적어도 하나의 프로세서는, 요청에 따라, 생명체 감지 센서를 활성화할 수 있다. 적어도 하나의 프로세서는, 생명체 감지 센서로부터 세탁기 내부의 생명체의 존재 여부에 관한 감지 신호를 수신할 수 있다. 적어도 하나의 프로세서는, 수신한 감지 신호에 기초하여, 통신 인터페이스를 통해 세탁기 내부에 생명체가 존재하는지에 관한 정보를 외부 장치로 전송할 수 있다.

title_en: Target tracking method and related device based on low-frequency ultra-wideband through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a target tracking method and a related device based on a low-frequency ultra-wideband through-wall radar, which mainly solve the problems of high dependence on a complex multi-antenna imaging system and low algorithm instantaneity of the existing through-wall target tracking technology. The implementation scheme is as follows: firstly, removing wall clutter direct current components in an original time-distance graph by using an RPCA algorithm; then constructing an echo data matrix, detecting a target in the RD spectrum by using a region maximum detection method, and extracting distance and speed information; then estimating the target distance by using a two-way receiving channel, and positioning the target by combining the geometric relation of the antenna base line; and finally, tracking by using a Kalman filter. The invention realizes real-time tracking of human body targets behind the wall through the one-shot two-shot low-cost and low-complexity wall-penetrating radar, and the verification result shows that the RPCA algorithm can be used for removing wall clutter components in a wall-penetrating scene, the tracking track is matched with the actual track, the target positioning error is smaller, the performance is better, and the method can be used for anti-terrorism and disaster rescue.

title_en: Rescue site intelligent detection system and application
abstract_en: The application provides a rescue scene intelligent detection system and application, wherein a firefighter terminal device comprises a wireless communication module and an intelligent detection module, wherein the wireless communication module is used for receiving and sending voice, data and video information, and the intelligent detection module comprises an environment sensor, a vital sign detector, a data processing unit and a camera device; the base station equipment is used for receiving and processing voice, data and video signals from the firefighter terminal and comprises fixed base station equipment and mobile base station equipment, wherein the fixed base station equipment is positioned in a command part, and the mobile base station equipment is integrated with the unmanned aerial vehicle; according to the mobile base station equipment, the mobile base station equipment is integrated with the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the appointed area can be rapidly deployed in a short time through the mobility and the flexibility of the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the communication requirements of different scenes are met, and the high-efficiency communication quality of the fire disaster and the command part is ensured.
assignees: SHENZHEN HONGJIALI FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Biosignal Measurement Patch Structure and Its Use Method
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정 패치 구조 및 그 사용 방법
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a biosignal measurement patch structure capable of maintaining a contact force by bringing sensors for biosignal measurement into close contact with the skin. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a biosignal measurement patch structure comprises: a substrate made of a flexible material; a housing disposed in a first region of the substrate; and a biosignal measurement sensing electrode disposed in a second region of the substrate. The substrate is formed with a slit that penetrates in a direction dividing the first region and the second region.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 피부에 생체 신호 측정을 위한 센서들을 밀착시켜 접촉력을 유지할 수 있는 생체 신호 측정 패치 구조를 제공하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 
본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 생체 신호 측정 패치 구조는, 플렉서블한 소재의 기판; 상기 기판의 제1영역에 배치되는 하우징; 및 상기 기판의 제2영역에 배치되는 생체 신호 측정 센싱전극; 을 포함하고, 상기 기판은 상기 제1영역 및 상기 제2영역을 구획하는 방향으로 형성되는 슬릿이 관통 형성된다.

title_en: PCR radar sensor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of vital sign recognition sensors and discloses a PCR radar sensor which comprises a sensor body, wherein a connecting table is arranged on the back surface of the sensor body, connecting shafts are fixedly arranged on two sides of the connecting table, connecting rods are rotatably connected to the connecting shafts, screws are arranged at the ends of the connecting rods and used for limiting the relative positions of the connecting shafts and the connecting rods, mounting plates are arranged at the tops of the connecting rods and used for fixing the PCR radar sensor at a use position. The PCR radar sensor utilizes the wavelet with different emission lengths of the sensor body to accurately control pulse repetition frequency, center frequency and pulse duration, realizes high precision with low power consumption, is more beneficial to micro feature observation, feature extraction and motion feature detection of targets, and improves the precision of detecting various vital signs in various fields such as expressway toll stations.

title_en: In-bed human body respiration and heart rate monitoring equipment and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of physiological signal detection, and particularly relates to equipment and a method for monitoring breathing and heart rate of an in-bed human body. The method comprises the following steps: 1) Detecting a target through a radar sensor, and preprocessing a radar signal to obtain a vital sign signal of the target; 2) The method comprises the steps of carrying out weighted accumulation on sweep frequency signal echoes of a plurality of periods in a frame to locate a target unit; 3) The vital sign signals of the target units are subjected to phase unwrapping through an arctangent method; 4) Separating a respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal in the vital sign signal through a band-pass filter; 5) Real-time monitoring of the human body is realized based on the respiratory signal and the heartbeat signal. Aiming at the breathing behavior of the user in the bed, the invention provides a non-contact multi-mode connection mode, and provides a convenient method for the communication of the sleep detection equipment.
assignees: NEUSOFT HANFENG MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional health monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional health monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving echo signals in a space, and calculating point cloud data of a user and phase change data caused by respiration and heartbeat of the user according to the echo signals; calculating the behavior of the user according to the point cloud data; calculating vital signs of the user according to the phase change data, wherein the vital signs comprise respiratory frequency and heart rate; monitoring whether a user triggers a set alarm event according to the behaviors and/or vital signs; if yes, executing corresponding alarm operation according to the triggered alarm event type. The multifunctional health monitoring method based on the millimeter wave radar has the advantages of multifunctional monitoring, low cost, non-contact all-weather monitoring, privacy protection, two-way call and the like.

title_en: Non-contact sleep monitoring method and monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a non-contact sleep monitoring method and a monitoring device, comprising the following steps: transmitting electromagnetic wave signals to a test target through a millimeter wave radar, collecting human chest micro-motion echoes, obtaining intermediate frequency signals, and separating respiration signals and heartbeat signals in the intermediate frequency signals; processing the respiration and heartbeat phase signals, and accurately estimating respiration and heartbeat and body micro-motion information; generating variability data by utilizing the results acquired in real time by breathing, heartbeat and body micro-motion, extracting characteristics, and obtaining awake duration, sleep duration, body movement times and bed leaving times according to an algorithm; the millimeter wave radar simultaneously detects the unmanned object, abnormal respiration, abnormal heartbeat and abnormal condition to a large extent in the monitoring process, and carries out red light warning and buzzer warning when abnormal conditions occur; the non-contact sleep monitoring method and the monitoring device can simultaneously monitor the non-contact vital signs and the sleep, and have great significance for sleep monitoring.
assignees: SUZHOU KANGHUDA INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Test device and method for simulating landslide erosion-collapse-reviving evolution process
abstract_en: The test device for simulating the landslide 'erosion-landslide-reviving' evolution process comprises a landslide model arranged in a test box, wherein a wave making device and a wave absorbing device are respectively arranged at two ends of the model, the wave making device is arranged at the front end of the landslide model, the wave absorbing device is arranged at the rear end of the model, shooting devices are arranged at the top and two sides of the outside of the test box, the shooting devices at the top are arranged at the front end of the landslide model, a water body monitoring device is arranged side by side, the landslide model comprises a multistage bedrock plate and a bedrock plate lifting device, during test, bedrock, a sliding belt and a sliding body material are sequentially paved on the bedrock plate, a sensor is buried in the sliding body material, the test box is a transparent box with an opening at the top, double-layer glass is arranged in the box of a wave making device area, water injection and drainage devices are respectively arranged at the bottoms of the box on the sides of the wave making device and the wave absorbing device, and a sponge is arranged at the wave absorbing device end in the box; the utility model realizes the simulation of the erosion-collapse-reviving linkage process.

title_en: Mud-rock flow gabion prevention and control structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a debris flow gabion control structure, which comprises a gabion, wherein broken stones stacked together are wrapped on the inner side of the gabion, steel wires penetrate between grid-like meshes of the gabion, two ends of each steel wire are led out outwards and wound on a wood rod, two ends of each steel wire penetrate through holes in the bottoms of bolts, the bottoms of the bolts are propped against the outer side of the grid-like meshes of the gabion, the outer ends of the bolts are arranged on the surface of a stress plate through nuts, a gasket strip is arranged at the contact position of the stress plate and the gabion, a concave pressing plate is arranged at the rear end of the stress plate, a digital display pressure sensor is fixed on the inner side surface of a concave area in the middle of the concave pressing plate, and protruding areas on two sides of the concave pressing plate are fixed on the side surface of a wall through wall-in bolts. The gabion control structure is provided with a visual tensioning reference structure, so that constructors can be helped to accurately judge whether the tensioning degree of the binge gabion meets the standard or not, and the construction quality of debris flow gabion control is improved.

title_en: Vital sign measuring device and vital sign measuring method
abstract_en: The vital sign measurement device is provided with a single infrared sensor (1), a single radar sensor (2), and a final vital sign output unit (3), wherein the single infrared sensor (1) acquires an infrared image of a target object, identifies a living body from the acquired infrared image, estimates the body temperature and two-dimensional azimuth of the identified living body, the single radar sensor (2) is arranged in time synchronization with the infrared sensor and in close proximity to the infrared sensor, the single radar sensor (2) is provided with a signal acquisition unit (221) for acquiring a received signal of a reflected wave from an antenna receiving the reflected wave reflected by the target object, a signal separation unit (222) for separating the acquired received signal into a moving object signal and a stationary object signal, a moving object estimation unit (223) for estimating the distance, the speed and the two-dimensional azimuth of the moving object from the moving object signal, and a radar vital sign estimation unit (224) for estimating the position, the respiratory frequency and the heart rate of the living body from the stationary object signal based on the detected detection result of the moving object, and the final vital sign output unit (3) acquires and outputs the position, the respiratory frequency and the heart rate and the body temperature.

title_en: Three-dimensional imaging method and device for through-wall radar based on priori information
abstract_en: The invention provides a three-dimensional imaging method and device of a through-wall radar based on priori information, which belong to the technical field of radars, consider three-dimensional characteristics of a wall structure, characterize local similarity of images through 3D-TV constraint, inhibit influence of wall artifacts and random half-points by using group sparse constraint, and can keep global coherence of the wall structure under the influence of noise by combining tensor Tucker decomposition constraint, so that perspective three-dimensional imaging quality is improved. According to the invention, the three-dimensional characteristics of the wall structure are considered in the solving process, so that the solving result is more consistent with the real wall structure.

title_en: In-vehicle cabin living body detection method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted cabin in-vivo detection method based on millimeter wave radar, which comprises the following steps: step S1, after a flameout door of a vehicle falls down to be locked, activating in-cabin living body detection, opening an in-cabin millimeter wave radar, and performing target detection; s2, preprocessing echo signals of the millimeter wave radar; s3, decomposing vital sign signals according to echo signals of the millimeter wave radar; and S4, extracting a living body signal and judging whether a living body exists in the cabin. The invention provides a vehicle-mounted cabin in-vivo detection method based on millimeter wave radar, which is characterized in that dynamic and static detection of human bodies in a vehicle is advanced, then breath and heartbeat signal detection is carried out, and the detection process is decomposed, so that the movable human bodies can be detected preferentially and rapidly and alarm, and the operation efficiency of an algorithm is improved.
assignees: CHANGZHOU XINGYU AUTOMOTIVE LIGHTING SYSTEMS CO LTD

title_en: Communication security and protection integrated routing system, method, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a communication security and protection integrated routing system, a method, equipment and a storage medium suitable for a fire scene, which comprise the following steps: the fire scene far-end MCU selects a target area to be detected according to the SSID provided by the WiFi routing module carrying the fire scene near-end MCU, and connects the fire scene far-end MCU with the SSID of the selected target area in a frequency band of 5 GHzWiFi; the WiFi routing module collects the CSI data and uploads the CSI data to the communication cloud module; the Tencel cloud module sends the CSI data to an edge computing power PC end, human existence state judgment is carried out through filtering processing of the edge computing power PC end and by utilizing a sliding window function algorithm, and a judgment result is fed back to the mobile end APP module. According to the application, information feedback is provided by utilizing the physical layer characteristics of human body activities on disturbance of WiFi 5GHz electromagnetic waves, so that the function of monitoring the human body existence state in a fire scene is realized, and a firefighter can rapidly judge whether the human body vital signs to be rescued exist in the fire scene.

title_en: Personnel safety intelligent management system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a personnel safety intelligent management system based on big data, relates to the technical field of personnel safety intelligent management, and solves the technical problems of low-efficiency safety management means and false alarm or missing report caused by inaccurate risk assessment in the prior art; according to the invention, the identification model is used for identifying and verifying the identity of the staff to be identified, so that the safety of the construction site is improved; the invention collects the working environment image of staff through the camera, the vital sign detector collects vital sign information of staff, and the ultrasonic sensor collects the working height of staff; based on the collected information, analyzing vital sign risk coefficients, operational height risk coefficients, and operational environment risk coefficients; based on various dangerous coefficients, comprehensively analyzing to obtain personal dangerous coefficients of staff, and early warning is carried out on the time when the personal dangerous coefficients exceed a preset threshold value; the accurate evaluation of personal safety coefficients is realized, and casualties and property loss are effectively reduced.
assignees: SHANXI DATANG INT LINFEN CO GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Data analysis device, search system, data analysis method, and program
abstract_en: An objective of the present disclosure is to grasp the accurate state of a buried object or a hollow and identify the position thereof without limitation on location.　Accordingly, a data analysis device 9 performs image data matching between first image data A1, which pertains to a first specified surface associated with radar search data A2 related to the first specified surface, and second image data B1, which pertains to a second specified surface adjacent to the first specified surface and associated with radar search data B2 related to the second specified surface, and composites the two pieces of radar search data to generate composite search data AB2. The data analysis device 9 performs image data matching between each of third image data pertaining to a specific surface 51 and fourth image data pertaining to a specific surface 52, the third image data and the fourth image data being acquired from a ground control-point measurement device 6, and specific image data that is at least one of the first image data or the second image data and includes the specific surface 51 and the specific surface 52, and performs calibration of an absolute position pertaining to the composite search data AB2 on the basis of individual absolute positions associated with the third image data and the fourth image data.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar vital sign detection equipment and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses millimeter wave radar vital sign detection equipment and a millimeter wave radar vital sign detection system, wherein the equipment comprises a mobile robot main body, a height angle adjusting unit, a camera and a millimeter wave radar, and the camera and the millimeter wave radar are arranged on the mobile robot main body through the height angle adjusting unit. The system comprises a server and one or more millimeter wave radar vital sign detection devices connected with the server through a network. The invention adjusts the pitch angle and the height of the millimeter wave radar in real time, so that the pitch angle and the height can be adjusted in real time when the position of a subject changes, the possibility of data loss is reduced, and the accuracy of vital sign information is improved. And can realize comprehensive nursing in a large range, greatly improve the utilization rate of equipment.
assignees: CHINA NANHU ACAD OF ELECTRONICS AND INFORMATION

title_en: Personnel safety monitoring method and system based on data driving and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a personnel safety monitoring method and system based on data driving, and electronic equipment, comprising the following steps: s100, measuring heart rate data of a target person located in a preset monitoring area according to a first monitoring period by using a millimeter wave radar arranged at a preset position; s200, acquiring an infrared thermal imaging image of a preset monitoring area according to a first monitoring period by using an infrared thermal imaging device arranged at the adjacent position of the millimeter wave radar, calculating the barycenter coordinates of a target person in the infrared thermal imaging image, and calculating the moving speed of the target person according to the barycenter coordinates of the target person; and S300, judging whether vital signs of the target personnel are normal according to heart rate data and moving speed of the target personnel. The heart rate abnormality monitoring of personnel in the movement process of different intensity degrees can be realized by only utilizing the millimeter wave radar and the infrared thermal imaging device, and the intelligent degree, the heart rate monitoring reliability and the application scene of the invention are improved to a great extent.

title_en: Direct-buried fire-fighting pipe antifreezing device on outdoor local freezing line
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an antifreezing device for directly buried fire pipes on an outdoor local freezing line, which comprises a fire pipe pre-buried outdoors and underground, wherein the top of the fire pipe is provided with a U-shaped structure, the U-shaped structure of the fire pipe is sleeved with a heat insulation layer, the central part of the U-shaped structure of the fire pipe is welded with a rigid sleeve pipe with both ends being of plugging structures, the rigid sleeve pipe is positioned in the heat insulation layer, the heat insulation layer is matched with the rigid sleeve pipe to insulate and freeze the U-shaped pipe, the top and the bottom of the rigid sleeve pipe are communicated and fixed with first connecting pipes, one sides of the two first connecting pipes far away from each other extend out of the heat insulation layer, and the right side of the heat insulation layer is provided with a thermal valve inspection well. According to the utility model, through a series of structures, the fire-fighting pipe can be insulated in a mode of hot water circulation and heat insulation by matching with the heat insulation layer, so that the water temperature in the local fire-fighting pipe is ensured to be higher than 5 ℃, and the anti-freezing effect is achieved.
assignees: HEBEI SONGYUN ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Bio-signal detection apparatus, operating method of bio-signal detection apparatus, and user terminal comprising bio-signal detection apparatus
title_ko: 생체 신호 감지 장치, 생체 신호 감지 장치의 동작 방법 및 이를 포함하는 사용자 단말
abstract_en: A bio-signal detection apparatus according to disclosed embodiments may comprise: a sensor unit including a plurality of electrodes that obtain bio-signals; a memory including one or more instructions; and one or more processors. The one or more processors according to an embodiment may execute the one or more instructions to determine the time at which arbitrary electrodes of the plurality of electrodes obtain bio-signals. The one or more processors according to an embodiment may determine the variability of the bio-signals obtained by the arbitrary electrodes. The one or more processors according to an embodiment may determine an arrangement of the arbitrary electrodes when the time at which the arbitrary electrodes obtain the bio-signals and the variability of the obtained bio-signals meet predetermined criteria, and may learn the determined arrangement of the electrodes.
abstract_ko: 개시된 실시예에 따른 생체 신호 감지 장치는 생체 신호를 획득하는 복수의 전극들을 포함하는 센서부, 하나 이상의 인스트럭션을 포함하는 메모리 및 하나 이상의 프로세서를 포함할 수 있다. 일 실시예에 따른 하나 이상의 프로세서는 하나 이상의 인스트럭션을 실행하여, 복수의 전극들을 중 임의의 전극들이 생체 신호를 획득하는 시간을 판단할 수 있다. 일 실시예에 따른 하나 이상의 프로세서는 임의의 전극들이 획득한 생체 신호의 변동성을 판단할 수 있다. 일 실시예에 따른 하나 이상의 프로세서는 임의의 전극들이 생체 신호를 획득하는 시간 및 획득된 생체 신호의 변동성이 미리 정해진 기준을 만족하면, 임의의 전극들의 배치를 결정하고, 결정된 전극들의 배치를 학습할 수 있다.

title_en: Vital sign detection method
abstract_en: The application discloses a vital sign detection method, which comprises the following steps: constructing a distance angle energy array based on a radar data frame of a region to be detected received by a radar receiving antenna and a guiding vector of the radar receiving antenna; the method comprises the steps of acquiring an accumulated radar frame set corresponding to a radar receiving antenna, wherein a plurality of radar data frames which are accumulated and received by the radar receiving antenna are stored in the accumulated radar frame set; performing peak characteristic analysis on the distance angle energy array to obtain a micro-motion analysis result corresponding to the region to be detected; trend analysis is carried out on the accumulated radar frame set to obtain a trend analysis result corresponding to the region to be detected; and determining a vital sign detection result corresponding to the region to be detected by combining the micro-motion analysis result and the trend analysis result. The method can effectively save storage resources and computing resources, and simultaneously accurately sense vital sign information in the region to be detected by combining micro analysis and trend analysis.

title_en: Apparatus for emitting sonic sound for rescuing maritime distress
title_ko: 해상조난 구조용 음파발생장치
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a sound wave generating device for marine distress rescue, which collects a bio-signal of a user to generate bio-information, determines whether the user is flooded without an error by a flooding sensor and a water pressure sensor, and transmits a sound wave signal including the bio-information to the water, thereby enabling rapid marine disaster rescue. The present invention comprises: a band unit wound around and fixed to a specific body of a user; a sound wave generation unit including a housing frame having a watertight structure, a bobbin formed inside a voice coil to which a current corresponding to sound information is conducted to transmit vibration, a vibration plate having a watertight structure to transmit a sound wave signal in an audible frequency range to the water, and a control module to control application of a current to the voice coil; a biometric sensor attached and fixed to an inner surface of a strap to sense a biometric signal of the user; a flooding sensing unit including three or more seawater inlet holes, a soluble blocking film formed at an inlet of the seawater inlet hole, and a flooding sensor to sense seawater introduced into the seawater inlet hole; and a water pressure sensor formed on a side surface of the sound wave generation unit to sense water pressure. According to the present invention, bio-information is generated by collecting a bio-signal of a user, and whether the user is submerged in water is determined by a flooding sensor and a water pressure sensor without an error. Therefore, a sound wave signal including the bio-information is transmitted underwater, thereby enabling a rapid marine disaster rescue.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 사용자의 특정 신체에 감겨 고정되는 밴드부(110), 하우징 프레임(121)과, 진동을 전달하는 보빈(122)과, 보빈(122)의 상단에 결합되어 가청주파수범위의 음파신호를 수중으로 전달하는 수밀구조의 진동판(123)과, 보이스 코일로의 전류 인가를 제어하는 제어모듈(125)로 이루어진, 음파발생부(120), 생체신호를 감지하는 생체 인식 센서(130), 진동판(123)의 테두리 영역에 일정거리 이격 배치되는 3개 이상의 해수유입홀(141)과, 해수유입홀(141)의 입구에 형성된 용해성 차단막(142)과, 차단막(142)의 용해로 노출된 해수유입홀(141)로 유입된 해수를 각각 감지하는 침수 센서(143)로 이루어진, 침수감지부(140), 및 수압을 감지하는 수압 센서(150)를 포함하여, 제어모듈(125)은, 생체신호를 분석하여 사용자의 정상상황과 위급상황을 판단하여 생체정보를 생성하고, 침수 센서(143)의 3개 이상의 해수유입홀(141)로 해수가 유입되어 일정시간이상 지속되고, 수압 센서(150)에 의해 일정 수압이 감지되면, 음파발생부(120)가 침수된 것으로 판단하여, 생체정보를 포함하는 음파신호를 수중으로 송출하도록 하는, 해상조난 구조용 음파발생장치를 개시한다.

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on human factor intelligence and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of health medical detection, in particular to a vital sign detection method based on artificial intelligence and related equipment. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring radio frequency reflected signals related to a target object and continuous multi-frame image data; obtaining first characteristic data based on the radio frequency reflection signal; and obtaining second feature data based on the multi-frame image data; performing feature fusion on the first feature data and the second feature data to obtain fusion features; and obtaining vital sign signals of the target object based on the fusion characteristics. In the embodiment of the invention, the vital sign is detected by mixing the millimeter wave radar and the remote photoplethysmography, so that the defect of inaccurate detection result caused by larger environmental factors of the millimeter wave radar in the prior art is overcome.

title_en: Wall-penetrating radar system and identification method for both sides of friend and foe
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wall-penetrating radar system and a method for identifying enemy, comprising a wall-penetrating radar host and a positioning tag, wherein the wall-penetrating radar host is used for acquiring the position information of all human targets; the wall-penetrating radar host is in communication connection with the positioning tag and is used for acquiring distance information between the wall-penetrating radar host and the positioning tag on the own human body target; and the through-wall radar host identifies the two sides of the friend and foe in each human target according to the position information and the distance information. According to the invention, UWB base stations are not required to be arranged in advance, the indoor positioning of the target is realized through the multi-transmission multi-reception MIMO architecture of the through-wall radar host, the problem that nodes need to be erected in UWB positioning is solved, and the method has the characteristics of convenience and flexibility in use and the like.

title_en: Monitoring system for communication of wisdom ward and millimeter wave physical sign radar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a monitoring system for communication between an intelligent ward and a millimeter wave vital sign radar, which comprises a client, a server, a data layer, an MQTT server and the millimeter wave vital sign radar, wherein the millimeter wave vital sign radar is arranged above a sickbed of a patient. According to the utility model, the millimeter wave vital sign radar is arranged above a sickbed of a patient, vital sign data and sleep data of the patient are monitored and reported in real time to the intelligent ward management platform and are pushed to the bedside machine, the nursing signboard and the management machine, so that the accuracy and timeliness of the data are ensured, medical staff can accurately judge the corresponding data, the medical staff can check the vital sign data and the sleep monitoring data of the patient in the nursing signboard and the management machine, in addition, the patient can be warned and prompted when the vital sign is abnormal, the abnormality of the patient can be timely found, corresponding measures are taken, and certain analysis can be carried out on the sleep data, so that the medical staff and the patient can be fed back.
assignees: XIAMEN WORLD LINKING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster safety robot
title_ko: 재난 안전로봇
abstract_en: Disclosed is an amphibious disaster safety robot that can be operated in narrow spaces such as overhead sewer pipes, as well as on general roads, sand, and water. The disclosed disaster safety robot comprises: a driving wheel unit capable of being independently driven and including a pair of driving wheels spaced apart from each other to form a spherical body; an environment detection unit including a first sensor module formed on an outer side of each of the pair of driving wheels; and a human life detection unit including a second sensor module formed on an upper portion of a spaced area between the pair of driving wheels, wherein the environment detection unit and the human life detection unit can maintain a posture while rotating in a direction opposite to a rotation direction of the pair of driving wheels.
abstract_ko:
천장 하수관과 같은 협소한 공간과 일반 도로, 모래, 물 위에서 운용이 가능한 수륙양용 재난 안전로봇이 개시된다.  
개시된 재난 안전로봇은, 
독립적으로 구동 가능하며, 서로 이격되어 구형 몸체를 이루는 한 쌍의 구동 바퀴를 포함하는 구동 바퀴부; 상기 한 쌍의 구동 바퀴 각각의 외측에 형성된 제1 센서 모듈을 포함하는 환경 탐지부; 상기 한 쌍의 구동 바퀴 사이의 이격된 영역의 상부에 형성된 제2 센서 모듈을 포함하는 인명 탐지부;를 포함하며, 상기 환경 탐지부 및 인명 탐지부는 상기 한 쌍의 구동 바퀴의 회전 방향에 대해 반대 방향으로 회전되면서 자세를 유지할 수 있다.

title_en: Doppler radar positioning method based on complex convolution neural network and time-frequency analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Doppler radar positioning method based on complex convolution neural network and time-frequency analysis, which comprises the steps of constructing echo signals after multi-user mobile Doppler through-wall demodulation, constructing a corresponding ideal time-frequency spectrogram by adopting the constructed echo signals, and constructing a training data set; constructing a preliminary time-frequency spectrogram prediction model by taking a deep learning network as a basic framework, and training the model by adopting a training data set to obtain a final time-frequency spectrogram prediction model; predicting the radar echo signals acquired in real time by adopting the obtained model to acquire a predicted time-frequency spectrogram; adopting the obtained prediction time-frequency spectrogram to predict the track of the target in the wall so as to realize radar positioning; the method combines deep learning with time-frequency analysis to solve the problem of frequency ambiguity; the time-frequency resolution is further improved by introducing a network with a jump residual error structure; the method has the advantages of improved precision, reduced offset, enhanced robustness and improved noise immunity.

title_en: Forest fire disaster resistance control equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides forest fire disaster resistance and control equipment which comprises a water collecting assembly and a detection resistance and control mechanism, wherein the water collecting assembly comprises a pre-buried water tank, a rain collecting cover and a central pipe; the detection resistance control mechanism comprises a spray head, an electric control box, a plurality of flame sensors, a small submersible pump, a plurality of water collecting needles and a plurality of diversion trenches; the rain collecting cover is communicated with the top of the embedded water tank; according to the utility model, the high-temperature heat source around the equipment is detected by the flame sensor, when the flame sensor detects the high-temperature heat source, the water in the embedded water tank is injected into the central pipe by the small submerged pump, and then the water in the central pipe is sprayed to the periphery of the equipment by the spray head under the action of water pressure, so that the fire source in a forest or a grassland is extinguished before the fire is formed, the cost of extinguishing the forest and grass fire is further reduced, and the continuous sprayed water can be utilized to inhibit the spreading speed of the fire so as to provide sufficient time for large-scale fire-fighting equipment.

title_en: Life signal detection method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital signal detection method, a system and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of vital sign monitoring, and the method comprises the steps of receiving an echo signal reflected by a target to be detected, and mixing the echo signal to obtain an intermediate frequency signal; converting the intermediate frequency signal to obtain a distance dimension FFT frequency spectrum; based on a YoloV5s neural network and a deep SORT target tracking algorithm, a binocular camera is adopted to identify and track a human body, and a target distance gate to be detected is determined; circularly extracting the phase at the distance gate of the target to be detected, recovering the true displacement curve of the target to be detected through phase unwrapping, and constructing a new differential phase sequence; and separating a respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal, performing FFT processing on the respiratory signal and the heartbeat signal respectively, and obtaining the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency of the target to be detected through spectrum peak search. The method can realize the matching of the target and the vital signals calculated by the radar signals, and effectively eliminates the influence of environmental interference on vital sign signal detection.

title_en: High-stability vital sign signal judging method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of millimeter wave radars, and particularly discloses a high-stability vital sign signal judging method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring distance dimension FFT data of all targets; judging whether moving targets exist in all targets according to the distance dimension FFT data of all targets; when a moving target exists, extracting a phase to be selected of the moving target in a current time window; calculating the current respiratory rate and the current heart rate of the moving target according to the time domain information and the frequency domain information of the phase to be selected; judging the current mode of the moving target; and outputting the current respiratory rate and the current heart rate of the moving target according to the current mode of the moving target. The invention also discloses a high-stability vital sign signal judging system. According to the invention, the current state of the target is judged through the millimeter wave radar, and the decision of the vital sign signal is carried out, so that the occurrence of misjudgment is avoided to a certain extent, and the stability and accuracy of the calculation of the respiratory rate and the heart rate are improved.
assignees: WEIFU HIGH TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: A device for outputting simulated vital signs and a method for operating the same
title_ko: 시뮬레이션된 생체 신호를 출력하는 디바이스 및 그 동작 방법
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a device for outputting a simulated vital signal to prevent an unauthorized external user from leaking personal information like a user's vital signal and to reinforce security. The device according to an embodiment of the present disclosure may: detect a UWB scanning pulse transmitted by an external device to measure a user's vital signal in a non-contact manner; if the UWB scanning pulse is detected, simulate a virtual person's vital signal to generate a virtual vital sign; and output simulated vital signal data including the vital signal and the virtual vital signal by using a UWB antenna.
abstract_ko: 본 개시는 허가되지 않은 외부 사용자에 의해 사용자의 생체 신호와 같은 개인 정보가 유출되는 것을 방지하고, 보안을 강화하기 위하여 시뮬레이션된 생체 신호를 출력하는 디바이스를 제공한다. 본 개시의 일 실시예에 따른 디바이스는 비접촉 방식(non-contact)으로 사용자의 생체 신호(vital sign)를 측정하기 위하여 외부 디바이스에 의해 송신된 UWB 스캐닝 펄스를 검출(detect)하고, UWB 스캐닝 펄스가 검출된 경우 가상 인물(virtual person)의 생체 신호를 시뮬레이션함으로써 가상 생체 신호(virtual vital sign)를 생성하고, UWB 안테나를 이용하여 생체 신호 및 가상 생체 신호를 포함하는 시뮬레이션된 생체 신호 데이터를 출력할 수 있다.

title_en: Quantitative simulation method for contribution of sandstone overpressure causes
abstract_en: The invention relates to a quantitative simulation method of sandstone overpressure contribution, which comprises the steps of collecting data such as finishing analysis test, well logging, geology, earthquake and the like, analyzing stratum pressure characteristics of sandstone at a target horizon, reconstructing buried history and thermal history of sandstone at the target horizon, quantitatively simulating pore pressure evolution history of uncompacted pressure and hydrocarbon generation pressurization, quantitatively simulating total pore pressure evolution history, quantitatively analyzing overpressure contribution, quantitatively analyzing contribution of uncompacted pressure, hydrocarbon generation pressurization and other factors to overpressure according to P  total ＝P underc +P hydrog  and P  total ＝P underc +P hydrog +P other , obtaining three overpressure mechanisms of the causes, quantitatively simulating the overpressure contribution of sandstone, and determining geological exploration areas of oil and gas reservoirs. The invention meets the requirements of the current geological exploration of the oil and gas reservoir, and has guiding significance for the quantitative analysis of the contribution of the overpressure causes of sandstone and the exploration work of the oil and gas reservoir.

title_en: Life detection equipment with analysis function
abstract_en: The invention provides life detection equipment with an analysis function, which comprises a sensor for detecting a signal emitted by a target source, wherein the sensor comprises a sound sensor and a vibration sensor; a probe body for receiving a signal transmitted from the sensor; the analysis module is used for analyzing at least two received signals and converting the signals into an AI image, and the display module is used for displaying the AI image on the display module, so that a rescuer can intuitively check the relative positions of a target source and each sensor so as to acquire the position information of the target source, the time for manual analysis of the rescuer can be saved, the sensor position does not need to be moved for many times to determine the target source, the rescue efficiency is effectively improved, the probability of occurrence of secondary accidents can be reduced, and the safety of trapped people and rescue workers is ensured; but also can reduce the cooperation of personnel, so that more rescue work can be done by limited manpower.
assignees: GUANGZHOU E DESIGN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fall alarm method, device, equipment and medium based on millimeter radar
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a fall alarm method, a device, equipment and a medium based on millimeter radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of receiving an environment laser point cloud of a preset detection area, receiving a second vital sign detection signal sent by a vital monitoring device, continuously sending millimeter radar to the preset detection area, receiving a first laser point cloud set fed back by human vital signs in the preset detection area within a preset time range, performing human target object point cloud segmentation on the laser point cloud of the human vital signs, determining a motion point cloud track of the human vital signs in the preset detection area, performing motion distortion compensation on the motion point cloud track according to preset motion compensation parameters of the human vital signs, generating a target motion point cloud track, determining vertical acceleration of the human vital signs in the vertical direction, and sending a falling alarm signal if the vertical acceleration is larger than an acceleration threshold. Thereby improving the accuracy of falling alarm and guaranteeing the safety of users.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar-based physical sign rapid and accurate detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar-based physical sign rapid and accurate detection method. The invention can rapidly detect the vital sign signals, and has high detection precision and low complexity. Firstly, mixing echo signals and transmitting signals, and cross sampling to obtain complex signals; then, the variance of slow time energy based on complex signals is adopted, and the optimal distance unit is selected under the condition of not damaging the target phase signals, so that the optimal distance unit is ensured to simultaneously contain human respiration and heartbeat signals; meanwhile, the invention eliminates the higher harmonic wave of the respiratory signal before heart rate estimation, and outputs the final result of heart rate according to the amplitude value, so that the heart rate estimation has high accuracy. The method reduces the requirements of processing signals and estimating the time length of the signals under the condition of ensuring the detection precision, so that the method achieves the precision requirement of high-precision quick heart rate estimation and can be suitable for quick detection in various scenes.
assignees: BEIJING INSTITUTE OF TECH YANGTZE RIVER DELTA RESEARCH INSTITUTE JIAXING;BEIJING INSTITUTE TECH

title_en: Vital sign detection method and system based on millimeter wave vital radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign detection method and a vital sign detection system based on millimeter wave vital radars, wherein the method adopts six millimeter wave radars which are respectively placed at six positions of front, back, left, right, upper and lower of a tested person, uses continuous wave radars to emit electromagnetic waves and analyze echo signals, carries out MEEMD decomposition on phase signals, carries out full-phase spectrum analysis on modal components obtained after decomposition, carries out respiration and heartbeat reconstruction according to the energy proportion of frequency-amplitude peak response on the IMF components and peaks after classification, processes to obtain a cardiogram and a pulmonary map, and realizes high-efficiency and accurate non-contact vital sign monitoring. The method is used for three-dimensional measurement of the lung and the heart aiming at six directions with different angles, so that high sensitivity and high accuracy of the test are ensured, and accurate detection of the lung and the heart is realized.

title_en: Electrode displacement self-correction grid array device of resistivity imaging system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrode displacement self-correcting grid array device of a resistivity imaging system, which is used for realizing real-time monitoring of the position of a monitoring point by a self-monitoring remote positioning system and timely finding out the distortion condition of an electrode grid; meanwhile, the electrode monitoring points are monitored in real time by the conical threaded electrode monitoring equipment. According to the self-monitoring remote positioning system, on one hand, the positions of electrodes in an electrode grid are uploaded in real time, electrode displacement data recording and self-correction are realized, so that accuracy of device coefficients in the apparent resistivity calculation process is improved, on the other hand, angular acceleration and acceleration sensors can intuitively monitor position changes of two transverse and longitudinal dimensions of the device in a period of time, a data transmission monitoring line and a total cable are respectively led out from the lower part of a disaster intelligent monitoring shell, and are buried in 20-30 cm underground, so that influences of human and animal factors and natural factors are reduced, and mistaken touching and breaking of the cable in the long-term monitoring process are avoided, so that effectiveness of monitoring data is guaranteed.

title_en: Portable millimeter wave vital sign monitoring radar
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a portable millimeter wave vital sign monitoring radar which comprises an outer box body and a detector body, wherein one side of the outer box body is connected with a box cover through a hinge, a limiting assembly is arranged on the inner side of the box cover, the detector body is arranged in an inner cavity of the outer box body, and a protection assembly is arranged at a position, close to the bottom end, of the detector body; the protection component is used for protecting the detection end of the detector body, and a butt joint component is arranged between the protection component and the detector body; according to the utility model, the outer protection frame is matched with the mounting groove and the elastic belt layer, so that when a worker grabs the detector body to detect in ruins, the detection end of the detector body can be protected through the outer protection frame, so that external sundries are prevented from being collided with the detector body, and the detector body is effectively protected.

title_en: Rapid vital sign analysis method and system based on millimeter wave radar time sequence data
abstract_en: The invention provides a rapid vital sign analysis method and a rapid vital sign analysis system based on millimeter wave radar time sequence data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a two-dimensional image corresponding to target millimeter wave radar data, wherein the two-dimensional image comprises a distance dimension and a Doppler dimension, the target millimeter wave radar data is obtained by preprocessing noise data in the millimeter wave radar data, and the preprocessing comprises the following steps: static clutter filtering, average maximum energy range gate positioning and signal phase unwrapping; acquiring a data cube corresponding to the millimeter wave radar data of the target based on the two-dimensional image, wherein the data cube comprises a time dimension, a distance dimension and a Doppler dimension; projecting the data cube onto three orthogonal two-dimensional planes to obtain image data of the data cube on each two-dimensional plane, wherein the three orthogonal two-dimensional planes are a time distance plane, a time Doppler plane and a distance Doppler plane; and analyzing the image data to obtain a predicted value of vital sign data corresponding to the image data.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and early warning equipment and system method for geological disasters
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, and provides intelligent geological disaster monitoring and early warning equipment and a system method thereof, comprising a buried rod, the surface internally mounted of buried pole has interior pole, the lower extreme fixedly connected with butt joint pole of interior pole, the surface of interior pole is provided with the arc hole, and the internally mounted of arc hole has the gasbag. According to the application, the inner rod is arranged in the buried rod, the air bag is arranged on the inner rod, the pressure sensor is arranged in the air bag, on one hand, the air bag is used for protecting the pressure sensor, the condition of pre-triggering is avoided, the monitoring accuracy is reduced, the air bag is arranged in the arc hole, after the inner rod penetrates into a stratum, the air bag is extruded through the compression ring, the expansion direction of the air bag is changed, a certain space is reserved between the stratum and the pressure sensor after the air bag is transversely expanded, and when the stratum changes in pressure, the air bag is pushed, and then the pressure plate is touched, so that the pressure plate is touched under the extrusion of the stratum.

title_en: Underground buried pipe detector
abstract_en: The utility model provides an underground pipe detector, belongs to detection equipment technical field, includes the base and installs in four wheels of base both sides wall, and the standing groove has been seted up on the base top, and geological radar has been placed to the standing groove inner chamber, and geological radar passes through stop gear detachable setting in the inner chamber of standing groove, and stop gear includes drive part and spacing part, drives spacing part through drive part and carries out spacingly to geological radar position. The geological radar is arranged at the base in a detachable mode, so that the geological radar can be flexibly detached or installed, the geological radar is convenient and quick to detach, the subsequent independent maintenance and overhaul of the geological radar are facilitated, the phenomenon that the screen display device slides left and right and falls down can be effectively prevented by limiting the rear side and the left and right sides of the screen display device respectively, and the screen display device can keep stable positions in the geological detection process.
assignees: LIAONING JUWEI CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Blood pressure detection method and system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blood pressure detection method and a system based on millimeter wave radar, wherein the blood pressure detection method based on millimeter wave radar comprises the following steps: s1, designing a data acquisition system, and acquiring original data from a millimeter wave radar sensor through the data acquisition system; step S2, formulating a signal processing algorithm, and converting the original data into vital sign parameters related to blood pressure; and S3, correcting the individual difference through a personalized correction algorithm according to the physiological difference of each individual. The invention provides a blood pressure detection method and a blood pressure detection system based on millimeter wave radar, which are used for continuously measuring blood pressure without interruption and improving the accuracy of blood pressure measurement.
assignees: DEXIN INTELLIGENT TECH CHANGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Respiration detection method, device and equipment based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to a breath detection method, a device and equipment based on millimeter wave radar in the technical field of intelligent detection, comprising the following steps: determining acquisition sensor parameters according to first user data and environment data acquired by the millimeter wave radar according to a preset detection time interval for a user object; adjusting sensor parameters of the millimeter wave radar by taking the acquired sensor parameters as targets, and acquiring second user data of the user object again through the millimeter wave radar after adjusting the sensor parameters; generating a breathing characteristic of the user object based at least on the environmental data and the second user data; according to the preset key length, a random encryption key is randomly generated by adopting a random number generator, and a target key is derived according to the random encryption key and the fixed key; and according to the target key and the random encryption key, converting the breathing characteristics into a target system format, encrypting the breathing characteristics of the target system format through the target key, and generating a breathing detection result of the user object.

title_en: Portable life detection radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of life detection radar equipment, and discloses a portable life detection radar which comprises a device shell, wherein the device shell is hollow, communication grooves are uniformly formed in the bottom end of the device shell, a cover plate is arranged at the top end of the device shell, and a linkage mechanism is arranged between the cover plate and the device shell; the detection equipment is arranged in the device shell, and a buffer mechanism is arranged at the bottom end of the detection equipment. The invention reduces the weight of the total equipment by eliminating unnecessary equipment, realizes more convenient carrying, can realize quick linkage starting and locking closing of the equipment under the action of the linkage mechanism in the equipment, effectively improves the starting efficiency of the equipment, can quickly enter a rescue state, and can realize automatic cleaning operation on the bottom end of the inner wall of the shell of the device when the equipment is closed and locked under the linkage of the transmission mechanism and the cleaning mechanism, thereby being more convenient to maintain.
assignees: HUAINAN UNION UNIV HUAINAN EMPLOYEE UNIV HUAINAN BRANCH OF ANHUI OPEN UNIV

title_en: Microseism life detection system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a microseism life detection system, which comprises a control host capable of carrying out wireless communication, a plurality of wireless detection terminals and a plurality of wired detection terminals, wherein the plurality of wireless detection terminals and the plurality of wired detection terminals are integrated on the control host and can be disassembled; each wireless detection terminal and each wired detection terminal are internally provided with a vibration acceleration sensor, a millimeter wave radar module and an information processing module, the vibration acceleration sensor and the millimeter wave radar module detect information in the vehicle, and the information processing module processes the information detected by the vibration acceleration sensor and the millimeter wave radar module into sound waves with the frequency not more than 500Hz and transmits the sound waves to a control host through wireless communication and wired communication; each wireless detection terminal is also internally provided with a rechargeable battery; and an alarm device is also arranged on the control host. The invention is convenient for detecting whether the life body exists in the vehicle body, can effectively avoid environmental interference, is convenient for use, and improves the working efficiency.

title_en: Non-contact biosignal measurement system and method capable of removing motion noise
title_ko: 움직임 노이즈 제거가 가능한 비접촉식 생체 신호 측정 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a non-contact biosignal measurement system capable of removing motion noise, which comprises: a plurality of MIMO antennas for transmitting and receiving FMCW type radar signals; a location specifying unit for specifying a location of a person using signals received by the plurality of MIMO antennas; a biosignal detection unit for measuring a biosignal based on a distance between a location of a person specified by the location specifying unit and the plurality of MIMO antennas; and a noise removing unit for detecting a change in the biosignal caused by movement of the person and canceling out a signal change detected by each MIMO antenna to remove noise caused by movement of the person from the biosignal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, FMCW 형태의 레이다 신호를 송수신하는 복수개의 MIMO 안테나; 상기 복수개의 MIMO 안테나가 수신한 신호를 이용하여 사람의 위치를 특정하는 위치 특정부; 상기 위치 특정부에서 특정한 사람의 위치와 상기 복수개의 MIMO 안테나 사이의 거리를 기반으로 생체 신호를 측정하는 생체신호 검출부; 및 사람의 움직임에 의해 발생한 상기 생체 신호의 변화를 검출하고, 각각의 MIMO 안테나에서 검출된 신호 변화를 상쇄하여 상기 생체 신호에서 사람의 움직임에 의한 노이즈를 제거하는 노이즈 제거부;를 포함하는 것을 일 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method and system for validating optimal body sensor placement
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system comprising a monitoring patch configured to be adhesively attached to skin of an associated patient, the monitoring patch including at least one vital sign sensor arranged to measure vital sign data of the associated patient when the monitoring patch is adhesively attached to the skin of the associated patient. The monitoring patch includes a wireless transceiver or transmitter configured to wirelessly transmit the vital sign data, a monitoring device configured to receive the wirelessly transmitted vital sign data and to store, retransmit, or both store and retransmit the vital sign data, a skin condition sensor configured to measure skin measurement data on the skin of the associated patient, and at least one hardware processor configured to analyze the skin measurement data to determine advice on adhesive attachment of the monitoring patch to the skin and output the advice on the monitoring patch or the monitoring device.

title_en: Spontaneous flashlight-like layered pressure sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-generating flashlight-shaped layered pressure sensor, which comprises a sensor shell, a sensor body and a sensor body, wherein the sensor shell comprises an inner shell which is buried in soil body, and an outer shell which is coaxially connected above the inner shell, is used for bearing the soil body pressure of landslide, and can generate axial relative movement with the inner shell; the sensor shell is internally provided with a magnetic field mechanism which can form an induction electric signal through the relative motion of the inner shell and the outer shell and the cutting of a magnetic induction wire; an inner shell electrode layer and an outer shell electrode layer which can output induction electric signals to the outside through the relative movement of the inner shell and the outer shell are respectively arranged on the outer surface of the inner shell and the inner surface of the outer shell. The invention effectively solves the problem that external power supply is needed in landslide monitoring, can be used for pressure measurement in landslide monitoring, reflects the pressure parameter when landslide occurs, and judges the landslide state through the pressure parameter.
assignees: HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER PLANNING AND DESIGN INST CO LTD;UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN

title_en: Non-contact human vital sign sensing method and system based on radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to a radar-based non-contact human vital sign sensing method and system, which comprise the steps of collecting radar echo signals comprising targets, processing intermediate frequency signals obtained through a low-pass filter to obtain signal spectrums, selecting a distance domain with the largest dynamic energy as a distance domain of a sensing target, determining the dynamic and static states of the detected targets according to the signal spectrums, re-collecting signals if the dynamic state is dynamic, performing distance beam forming on the signals in the distance domain of the sensing target if the dynamic state is static, enhancing the signal-to-noise ratio of the target signals, performing fast Fourier transform on the target signals to obtain frequency spectrums of complex signals, calculating the respiratory rate, sequentially performing first-order difference and fast Fourier transform on the target signals to obtain frequency spectrums of differential complex signals, and calculating the heart rate of the targets according to the frequency spectrums and the respiratory rate of the differential complex signals. The invention can expand the range of breath and heartbeat detection, improve the accuracy of heartbeat detection, and can be widely applied to the field of non-contact human vital sign sensing.

title_en: Wall-penetrating radar wall type intelligent identification method based on yolov5
abstract_en: A wall-penetrating radar wall type intelligent identification method based on yolov comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring wall data by using an ultra-wideband single-channel through-wall radar, and preprocessing the acquired data to obtain available data; step 2, intercepting an image with a wall object for each data; marking each image to obtain a final data set and a label; step 4, sending the marked data set into a yolov model for feature training; and step 5, training a model to obtain model weights for target detection and classification. The method disclosed by the invention can improve the accuracy of target detection.
assignees: CHINA INSTITUTE OF RADIO WAVE PROPAGATION CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION NO 22 RESEARCH IN

title_en: Human behavior recognition and vital sign measurement method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human behavior recognition and vital sign measurement method and device, and belongs to the field of deep learning and signal processing. The method comprises the following steps: collecting radar signals and corresponding visual images of human behavior actions; 3DFFT preprocessing is carried out on the radar signals, and a human behavior data set of the radar fusion is constructed; determining a radar data enhancement algorithm to enhance the data set; constructing an end-to-end thunder-vision fused human body behavior recognition model, and training the human body behavior recognition model by adopting an enhanced data set; acquiring the position and behavior action of a human body target according to the trained human body behavior recognition model; and separating the sign parameters according to the position of the human body target, and acquiring and displaying the current action and vital sign analysis result of the human body. According to the invention, the position and the behavior action of the human body target are obtained through the human body behavior recognition model, the vital sign information of each human body is obtained, and a comprehensive health monitoring analysis result is effectively provided for a user.

title_en: Sepsis risk assessment and treatment
abstract_en: A patient support apparatus includes a controller, a sensor capable of detecting vital signs, and a point of care (PoC) device for assessing risk of developing sepsis and for providing local and/or remote indications to caregivers. The controller is coupled to the sensor and the point of care device, and the controller can analyze signals from the sensor and the point of care device to determine data indicative of sepsis.

title_en: Super-regenerative oscillator integrated metamaterial leaky wave antenna for multi-target motion detection and ranging
