abstract_en: Various embodiments comprise systems, methods, architectures, mechanisms and apparatus providing a super-regenerative oscillator (SRO) integrated metamaterial (MTM) leaky wave antenna (LWA) architecture suitable for use in radio frequency (RF) detecting, ranging (e.g., RADAR), and sensing systems/applications, such as a noncontact multi-target vital sign detection system.

title_en: Body detects vice driver's seat
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a body detection auxiliary driving seat, which comprises a seat plate and a pedal, wherein a backrest is arranged on one side of the seat plate, rotating arms are arranged on two sides of the backrest, first electrode plates are arranged on the two rotating arms, a weighing mechanism is arranged on the seat plate, and a detection mechanism is arranged on the pedal; the weighing mechanism comprises a bottom plate, a weighing sensor and a plurality of reset springs are arranged on the bottom plate, and the other ends of the reset springs are connected with a supporting plate; the utility model discloses a detection mechanism, including keeping off the lid, keep off to cover the lock and be in set up the standing groove upper end on the footboard, be equipped with a plurality of second electrode slices in the standing groove, body composition and vital sign that the body detected the vice driver seat to take personnel can be measured by oneself, weigh and measurement data and observe through display screen or cell-phone connection transmission on the vehicle, increase device multifunctionality, through weighing the setting of mechanism, can measure the weight of taking personnel.
assignees: THE SECOND AFFILIATED HOSPITAL OF NANJING MEDICAL UNIV;NANJING HAIWANG AUTO PARTS CO LTD

title_en: Multipath echo identification and personnel detection method based on fingerprint characteristics of vital signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multipath echo discrimination and personnel detection method based on fingerprint characteristics of a vital signal, which comprises the steps of separating echo signals of each target from radar received signals, and decomposing the echo intermediate frequency phase signal into a plurality of IMF modes by using a successive variation mode decomposition algorithm, and reconstructing a respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal from the IMF modes. And further, based on the extraction of multi-target respiration and heartbeat signal fingerprint characteristics of the millimeter wave radar, the multi-target personnel are distinguished and detected and the multi-path false targets are identified according to the similarity of the fingerprint characteristics of the multi-path false targets and the corresponding real targets. The method does not need priori information of the environment or post measurement of the environment size, has small scene limitation, is applicable to complex indoor scenes, has strong practicability, is effective in multi-person vital sign detection, can remove multiple paths by only a single radar, simplifies the whole detection system, and does not need to change the configuration of radar arrays and other system layers.

title_en: Vital sign detection method under ultra-wideband radar shielding environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new generation information, in particular to a vital sign detection method under an ultra-wideband radar shielding environment. Collecting echo signal data to construct an echo signal matrix; performing clutter removal pretreatment on the echo signal matrix, and performing singular value decomposition on the pretreated echo signal matrix to obtain a reconstruction signal; one-dimensional expansion is carried out on the reconstructed signal; obtaining an optimal bandwidth threshold value for empirical mode decomposition of a reconstructed signal and B spline orders to decompose the reconstructed signal which is one-dimensionally unfolded, so as to obtain a plurality of signal components; transforming each signal component into a frequency domain, and respectively calculating the frequency duty ratio of the respiratory signal and the heartbeat signal in each signal component; acquiring a respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal; and detecting vital signs according to the obtained respiratory signals and heartbeat signals. According to the method, the radar echo data are subjected to a series of processing, so that clutter in the data can be effectively removed, and the accuracy of identifying vital signs is improved.

title_en: FMCW-based radar vital sign detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a vital sign detection method based on an FMCW radar, and the method can realize the vital sign detection by adopting single-channel data of a single receiving antenna, belonging to the technical field of non-contact vital sign detection. Firstly, radar intermediate frequency signals are stored as a two-dimensional data matrix, distance information is obtained through Fourier transformation of fast time dimension, after static target clutter interference is filtered through a static target filtering algorithm, the position of a human body is determined, after phase information is extracted from the position of the human body, a periodic signal multiplication algorithm and a heart rate optimizing equation are carried out, and finally, the solution of physical sign information is successfully obtained through an optimizing algorithm. The invention can effectively reduce the interference of the limb movement of the human body without the need of the test personnel to keep the whole-course static state, and realize the vital sign detection under different body states.

title_en: Low-rank block sparse decomposition-based vital signal enhancement method
abstract_en: The invention provides a vital signal enhancement method based on low-rank block sparse decomposition, and belongs to the technical field of radar detection. According to the characteristics of the respiratory signal and the noise signal between different frames in the time domain echo, the method firstly divides the echo signal into two parts of low rank and block sparse signals in the time domain, fully utilizes the characteristics of the life signal between different frame data, then decomposes the signals by using an alternate direction method, minimizes the distortion of the life signal while suppressing the noise, extracts the required block sparse part from the preprocessed echo data, and further realizes the life signal enhancement. The method processes in the time domain, uses a projection scheme to perform acceleration operation in the solving process, enhances the respiratory signal while suppressing noise in the time domain echo signal, enables the extraction of the respiratory signal under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio to be possible, and can be cascaded with other frequency domain processing methods in the follow-up process, thereby remarkably improving the result.

title_en: Implantable device based on smartphone control
title_ko: 스마트폰 제어 기반의 임플랜터블 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an implantable device based on smartphone control which comprises: a bio-signal collecting unit which collects a bio-signal related to a user's disease through an implant bio-sensor inserted into a living body, performs pre-processing according to the type of the bio-signal, and receives the bio-signal which is pre-processed an emergency disease response unit; primarily analyzing the pre-processing bio-signal to determine the necessity of emergency response of the user disease, and if so, providing an emergency disease response module instructing the implant bio-sensor to respond to an emergency disease to a user terminal; and a chronic disease corresponding part which secondarily analyzes the pre-processing performance bio-signal and determines the chronic response necessity of the user disease and if so, provides the chronic disease corresponding module directing the chronic disease correspondence to the implant biosensor to the user terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트폰 제어 기반의 임플랜터블 장치에 관한 것으로, 생체 내에 삽입된 임플란트 생체 센서를 통해 사용자 질환과 연관된 생체신호를 수집하고 상기 생체신호의 유형에 따른 전처리를 수행하여, 전처리 수행 생체신호를 수신하는 생체신호 수집부; 상기 전처리 수행 생체신호를 1차적으로 분석하여 상기 사용자 질환의 긴급대응 필요성을 결정하고 그렇다면 상기 임플란트 생체 센서에 긴급 질환대응을 지시하는 긴급 질환대응 모듈을 사용자 단말에 제공하는 긴급질환 대응부; 및 상기 전처리 수행 생체신호를 2차적으로 분석하여 상기 사용자 질환의 만성대응 필요성을 결정하고 그렇다면 상기 임플란트 생체 센서에 만성 질환대응을 지시하는 만성 질환대응 모듈을 상기 사용자 단말에 제공하는 만성질환 대응부;를 포함한다.
assignees: UNIV KOOKMIN IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Landmine detection system and the method thereof
title_ko: 지뢰 탐지 시스템 및 탐지 방법
abstract_en: A mine detection system and detection method utilizing a ground penetrating-synthetic aperture radar (GP-SAR) mounted on an unmanned aerial vehicle (drone) to measure the vertical position of buried objects through time-series profiling of ultra-wideband (0.6 to 6 GHz) high-resolution radio signals, and to measure the horizontal position of buried objects through spatial profiling, interpreting the measured vertical and horizontal position data to visualize the location and size of buried landmines, thereby selecting priorities for detecting and removing metallic and non-metallic landmines, and proactively eliminating accident factors that may arise from landmine loss due to typhoons and floods.
abstract_ko: 무인비행체(드론)에 탑재된 Ground Penetrating-Synthetic Aperture Radar (GP-SAR)로 측정한 초광대역 밴드(0.6 ~ 6 GHz) 고해상도 전파신호의 시계열 프로파일링을 통해 매설물의 수직적 위치를 측정하고, 공간적 프로파일링을 통해 매설물의 수평적 위치를 측정하여, 측정된 수직 및 수평 위치 데이터를 해석하여 매설된 지뢰의 위치와 크기를 가시화함으로써, 금속성 및 비금속성 지뢰 탐지 및 제거 우선순위를 선정할 수 있고, 이에 따라, 태풍 및 홍수에 의한 지뢰 유실 등 지뢰로 인해 발생할 수 있는 안전사고 요인을 선제적으로 제거할 수 있는 무인비행체에 탑재된 GPR-SAR 센서를 활용한 지뢰 탐지 시스템 및 탐지 방법이 제공된다.

title_en: Vital sign detection method, device, equipment and medium in indoor scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of detection and discloses a vital sign detection method, device, equipment and medium in an indoor scene. According to the invention, the vital sign detection and snore detection are carried out on the scene to be detected by combining various detection data of the pressure-sensitive sensor, the millimeter wave radar and the microphone, so that the final target vital sign detection result is obtained, and the accuracy and the instantaneity of the vital sign detection are improved. Therefore, by implementing the invention, vital signs can be monitored more comprehensively, so that the requirements of users can be better met and the market competitiveness is improved.
assignees: WONLY SECURITY & PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wireless body area network MAC method based on priority scheduling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless body area network MAC method based on priority scheduling, which can divide data into three types according to the characteristics of different data generated in the practical application of the wireless body area network: emergency data, periodic data, general data. Wherein the emergency data comprises random data, such data typically being associated with vital sign abnormality reports or medical emergency situations, such as arrhythmia emergency alert signals, or other medical conditions requiring immediate response. Periodic data includes periodic collection from sensors. The invention improves the superframe structure, simplifies the control difficulty, reduces the control overhead, makes the superframe more easily adapt to network changes, and ensures more flexible and reliable data transmission; optimizing the sensor node category and the sensor node priority setting strategy, and effectively relieving the collision problem during data transmission; by optimizing the time slot allocation strategy, the duty ratio of the sensor node is reduced, the energy loss is reduced, and the overall network performance and the system service quality of the wireless body area network are improved.

title_en: Opening and closing mechanism based on display unit in fire mask
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an opening and closing mechanism based on a display unit in a fire mask, which belongs to the technical field of fire masks. The opening and closing mechanism can control the display device to be far away from or close to the front of the eyes of the firefighter, and when the display device is not needed in front of the eyes of the firefighter, the normal sight of the firefighter is prevented from being disturbed; when the display device is needed in front of the fire fighter, the infrared image, vital signs of the fire fighter, position information, temperature information and the like can be displayed on the fire scene.
assignees: ANHUI ZHONGHANG DISPLAY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electronic device for measuring biometric signal and method of opearating the same
title_ko: 생체 신호를 측정하는 전자 장치 및 그 동작 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is an electronic device including a sensor module, a communication circuit, and at least one processor. The at least one processor may be configured to check a mounting state of the electronic device based on sensor data received from the sensor module, select at least one antenna combination including at least one transmission antenna and at least one reception antenna among the one or more antennas according to the mounting state, obtain a radar signal for a measurement target from the communication circuit using the at least one antenna combination, obtain a bio-signal from the obtained radar signal, evaluate a signal quality of the bio-signal, and adjust control parameters for the selected antenna combination among the at least one antenna combination according to the sensor data, the radar signal, and the signal quality of the bio-signal.
abstract_ko: 센서 모듈, 통신 회로, 및 적어도 하나의 프로세서를 포함하는 전자 장치를 개시한다. 상기 적어도 하나의 프로세서는, 상기 센서 모듈로부터 수신된 센서 데이터를 기반으로 전자 장치의 거치 상태를 확인하고, 상기 거치 상태에 따라, 상기 하나 이상의 안테나들 중 적어도 하나의 송신 안테나 및 적어도 하나의 수신 안테나를 포함하는 적어도 하나의 안테나 조합을 선택하고, 상기 적어도 하나의 안테나 조합을 통해 상기 통신 회로로부터 측정 대상에 대한 레이더 신호를 획득하고, 상기 획득된 레이더 신호로부터 생체 신호를 획득하고, 상기 생체 신호의 신호 품질을 평가하고, 상기 센서 데이터, 상기 레이더 신호, 및 상기 생체 신호의 신호 품질에 따라 상기 적어도 하나의 안테나 조합 중 선택된 안테나 조합에 대한 제어 파라미터들을 조정하도록 구성될 수 있다.

title_en: System for Safety Management using EEG-Based Complex Signal
title_ko: 뇌파를 기반으로 하는 복합 신호 활용 안전관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technology related to a system for determining whether a user is abnormal by using a complex bio-signal based on a brain wave and determining an emergency situation and an abnormal symptom based on the same. In a process of determining the state of the user by using the complex signal together with the brain wave, the emergency situation of the user can be immediately determined, so that it is possible to immediately cope with an accident. In addition, in that it is possible to determine fatigue and thermal diseases by using the complex signal together with the brain wave, there is an effect of preventing the possibility of an accident that may occur in the future by diagnosing an abnormal symptom in advance.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 뇌파를 기반한 복합 생체신호를 활용하여 사용자의 이상 여부를 판단하고, 이를 기반으로 긴급상황 및 이상 징후을 판단하는 시스템에 관한 기술로, 뇌파와 함께 복합 신호를 활용하여 사용자의 상태를 판단하는 과정에서, 사용자의 긴급상황을 즉각적으로 판단할 수 있는 점에서, 사고 발생시 즉각적으로 대처할 수 있는 효과가 있을 뿐만 아니라, 뇌파와 함께 복합 신호를 활용하여 피로도 및 온열 질환 등을 판단할 수 있는 점에서, 이상 징후를 사전에 진단하여 향후 발생할 수 있는 사고 가능성을 예방할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar-based vital sign detection system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a vital sign detection system and method based on millimeter wave radar. The detection system comprises: a transmit antenna, a receive antenna, a mixer, and a signal processor, the transmit antenna configured to transmit a signal from a signal source; the receiving antenna receives the echo signals reflected after the transmitting antenna transmits to the object to be detected, and transmits the echo signals to the mixer; and the signals mixed by the mixer are transmitted to a signal processor after being subjected to signal processing so as to extract characteristic signals. And transmitting FMCW electromagnetic waves to radiate the object to be detected by using the radar system to receive electromagnetic wave signals reflected by the object to be detected. Further extracting phase change information and Doppler frequency shift information in the reflected signals, thereby extracting vital sign information such as heartbeats.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a vital sign monitoring system and method, comprising: the respiratory airflow temperature data acquisition unit is used for acquiring the respiratory airflow temperature through the temperature sensor; a chest respiratory motion data acquisition unit for acquiring chest respiratory motion data by an acceleration sensor; the chest impedance imaging unit is used for acquiring chest impedance imaging results through a plurality of impedance electrodes; the processor unit is used for issuing a data acquisition command and processing acquired data, and specifically comprises the following components: based on the obtained respiratory airflow temperature data, chest respiratory motion data and chest impedance imaging results, vital sign monitoring is achieved, wherein when the respiratory airflow temperature data is abnormal, a data acquisition command is issued to the chest impedance imaging unit to obtain an imaging result, meanwhile, whether the chest respiratory motion data is normal or not is judged, if so, the occurrence of obstructive apnoea is judged, and if not, the occurrence of central apnoea is judged.
assignees: SHANDONG ZHONGKE ADVANCED TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign extraction and classification method and device based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign extraction and classification method and device based on machine learning, which are characterized in that an intermediate frequency signal is extracted through a millimeter wave radar device, the influence of an interference signal is reduced under the condition of higher accuracy through a normalized least mean square algorithm NLMS, accurate respiratory signals and heartbeat signals are separated, the characteristics extracted from a radar echo on a time domain and a frequency domain are used as labels of training data, and the labels are input into MBSVM multiple classifiers for training test and verification, so that the accurate classification of human sleep signs is obtained. The invention is combined with a non-contact physiological signal sensing system, can keep the stability of the system while improving the accuracy and the reliability, monitors information such as respiratory heartbeat and the like of a user in real time, and has high practical value.

title_en: Heating system of direct-buried fire-fighting water tank for photovoltaic power plant
abstract_en: A heating system of a direct-buried fire water tank for a photovoltaic power plant comprises a direct-buried fire water tank, an electric heater, a temperature sensor, a control cabinet, a municipal power supply, a power plant self-use power supply, a circulating water pump, heat dissipation equipment and a water dirt remover; the electric heater is used for heating water in the directly buried fire-fighting water tank; the temperature sensor feeds the water temperature of the directly buried fire water tank back to the control cabinet, and the control cabinet controls the operation of the electric heater; the control cabinet is selectively connected with a municipal power supply or a power plant self-use power supply, and the municipal power supply or the power plant self-use power supply supplies power to the heating system; the water at the water intake of the heating water of the direct-buried fire-fighting water tank flows back to the direct-buried fire-fighting water tank sequentially through the circulating water pump, the heat radiation equipment and the water dirt remover; the heat dissipation device is used for supplying heat for external equipment by utilizing the heat of hot water of the direct-buried fire-fighting water tank. The utility model can be applied to the range of the booster station of the photovoltaic power plant, the system stores heat for electricity generated by the photovoltaic power plant, the heating cost in the booster station is reduced, and the problem of freezing of water in the directly buried fire water tank is solved.
assignees: HEILONGJIANG ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD OF CHINA ENERGY CONSTRUCTION GROUP;NORTHEAST ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD OF CHINA POWER ENGINEERING CONSULTING GROUP

title_en: Underground buried seismic station using pipe and method of constructing same
title_ko: 관을 이용한 지하 매설형 지진관측소 및 이의 시공방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an underground buried seismic observation station comprises: a plastic pipe buried at a predetermined depth in a lower portion of the ground surface; and a guide unit inserted into a lower end portion of the buried pipe to support the pipe. a lower surface of the pipe is fixedly installed on a bedrock through concrete placement. an upper portion of the pipe protrudes from an upper portion of the ground surface at a predetermined height. a protective cover is installed on an upper surface of the pipe. a seismometer sensor, a seismic recorder, and auxiliary equipment may be installed inside the pipe.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 지하 매설형 지진관측소는, 지표면 하부에 일정한 깊이를 가지며 매립된 플라스틱 재질의 관; 및 매립된 상기 관의 하단부에 외삽되어 상기 관을 지지다는 가이드부;를 포함하고, 상기 관의 하부면은 콘크리트 타설을 통해 기반암 상에 고정 설치된 것이고, 상기 관의 상부는 지표면 상부에 일정한 높이를 가지고 돌출 형성되되, 상기 관의 상부면에는 보호덮개가 설치되어 있는 것이고, 상기 관의 내부에는 지진계 센서, 지진 기록계 및 부대장비가 설치되어 있을 수 있다.
assignees: DOIT CO LTD;KEPCO ENG & CONSTR CO INC

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted through-wall radar track deviation estimation method based on image domain self-focusing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of through-wall radars, and particularly relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted through-wall radar track deviation estimation method based on through-wall imaging image domain self-focusing. Firstly, realizing wall energy integration by using Radon transformation, realizing the estimation of the track deviation in the sight direction in a transformation domain by using an image self-focusing method, and secondly, carrying out maximum contrast self-focusing on a plurality of point target areas distributed behind the wall, and realizing the estimation of the track deviation along the course. The invention can reduce the dimension of the optimized variable, improve the estimation efficiency and fully utilize the space-variant pitch error information provided by targets with different distances and azimuth positions.

title_en: Deformable disaster area rescue detection robot
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of robots, and provides a deformable disaster area rescue detection robot, which comprises a robot body and further comprises: a flight control system, a life detection system, and a ground motion control system, the ground motion control system comprising: the four mechanical arms are sequentially provided with a movable joint, a telescopic joint and a rotary joint from inside to outside; the double-shaft steering engine is used for controlling the rotation of the movable joint; the first steering engine is used for controlling the rotation of the telescopic joint; the second steering engine is used for controlling the rotation of the rotary joint; the control main board is used for controlling the steering engine; an ultrasonic sensor; and the buffer mechanism is used for protecting the rotary joint. The invention can be in different motion states for multi-task scenes, can meet the life detection of various complex environments such as caves, ruins, dangerous buildings and the like, has higher environmental adaptability, and improves rescue efficiency; the whole device has reasonable structure, flexible and direct operation and strong practicability.

title_en: Through-wall radar human body behavior identification method based on micro Doppler angular point characteristics and dynamic graph neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar indoor human body behavior identification technology based on micro Doppler angular point characteristics and a Dynamic Graph Convolution Neural Network (DGCNN). The method firstly utilizes the DoG-mu D-CornerDet to extract the radar distance and the angular point characteristics on the Doppler image. And secondly, maximizing the distance between behavior classes under the constraint of a kinematic model by using a micro Doppler angular point screening method based on polynomial fitting smoothing. And thirdly, fusing micro-Doppler angular point features on the distance and Doppler images by using a non-maximum suppression algorithm, and establishing a three-dimensional angular point Yun Te collection. And finally, utilizing DGCNN identification models to realize the mapping from the point cloud characteristic data to the behavior label. Simulation and actual measurement results show that the method has high identification accuracy and strong generalization capability on radar data acquired by different subjects.

title_en: Multi-target regional rapid through-wall imaging method under polar coordinate system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-target regional rapid through-wall imaging method under a polar coordinate system, which belongs to the technical field of through-wall radar imaging and comprises the following steps: preprocessing a target echo signal to remove wall echo and background clutter; carrying out one-dimensional constant false alarm detection on the central channel, and extracting the number of targets and the electric length corresponding to the positions of the targets; step 2, measuring that the electric length of the target position is larger than the real distance of the target due to the existence of the wall, and obtaining the relation between the real distance of the target and the electric length according to detailed mathematical deduction; calculating the difference between the electric length corresponding to the target position and the real distance and the width of the main echo lobe, and determining the width of the local imaging strip; the true distance at which each target is located is striped. The method shortens the time consumption of the algorithm, avoids the condition that strong targets mask weak targets due to energy attenuation, and corrects the deviation of the imaging positions of the targets due to the existence of the wall body by deducing the wall body compensation formula under the polar coordinate system.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: WiFi signal-based respiration detection method and related equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a breath detection method based on WiFi signals and related equipment, which are used for capturing the breath change of personnel by utilizing the WiFi signals of the equipment so as to improve the monitoring accuracy and the real-time performance as much as possible. The method of the embodiment of the application comprises the following steps: acquiring a reflected wireless broadcast signal sent by WiFi equipment; extracting Channel State Information (CSI) signals from the wireless broadcast signals, and analyzing amplitude variation values and phase variation values corresponding to respiration signals in the CSI signals; calculating a respiratory rate value and a respiratory depth value in the respiratory signal according to the amplitude variation value and the phase variation value; and determining a corresponding breathing state identifier according to the breathing frequency value and the breathing depth value, so as to output prompt information according to the breathing state identifier.

title_en: Ultra-wideband radar respiration detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ultra-wideband radar breath detection device, which comprises a storage rack, wherein a detection device body is arranged in the storage rack, slots are fixedly formed in the inner wall surfaces of two sides of the interior of the storage rack, notches are formed in the two sides of the exterior of the detection device body, a plugboard is arranged on the inner top wall of the notch, fixed clamping boards are connected to two sides of the bottom end of the plugboard, movable clamping boards are further arranged on two sides of the bottom end of the plugboard, through sliding grooves are formed in the bottom end of the plugboard, clamping blocks are arranged on the inner wall surfaces of two sides of the interior of the slot, the storage rack and the detection device body are clamped in a plugging and clamping mode, the movable clamping boards, the fixed clamping boards and the clamping blocks are used for achieving the purposes of pressing and releasing the clamping by pressing again, so that the functions of storing and taking and placing the detection device body are achieved, the convenience of use is improved, the folding function is achieved by using a telescopic rod and a movable connecting seat, and the occupation of space is reduced.
assignees: SUZHOU RUIKEDA ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Systems and methods for monitoring a vehicle cabin
abstract_en: Vehicle cabin monitoring using a radar unit positioned within the cabin to obtain image data of the vehicle cabin, a beam deflector for deflecting electromagnetic waves into obstructed regions of the cabin and a processor to generate detect occupancy of seats within the vehicle cabin, categorize occupants, detect posture, determine seatbelt status and monitor life signs of the occupants.

title_en: Systems and methods for vehicle occupant vital sign detection
abstract_en: Methods and systems for detection and/or estimation of a rate of an occupant vital sign from within a cabin of a vehicle. In some implementations, the method may comprise identifying a repeating pattern of Doppler spectrum peaks in RADAR signal using a plurality of different range bins. An estimated frequency distance between adjacent peaks of the repeating pattern may then be identified using the signal data. An estimated rate of a repeating vital sign of an occupant within the cabin of the vehicle may then be calculated using the estimated frequency distance.

title_en: Intelligent medical and nutritional noninductive comprehensive detection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive intelligent medical-care noninductive detection system, which relates to the medical-care detection field, and comprises the following components: the system comprises an edge control platform, a radar, an infrared temperature sensor, a wireless network card and a camera; the edge control platform is provided with an SDIO and high-speed SPI, UART, RMII, HDMI, USB physical interface; the radar and the infrared temperature sensor are connected with the edge control platform through a high-speed SPI interface; the wireless network card is connected with the edge control platform through an SDIO interface; the RMII interface signals are physically connected with a network cable through an RJ45 connector; the camera is connected with the edge control platform through a USB or UART interface; based on the detection system provided by the invention, vital signs, actions, falling and other emergency conditions of a patient can be monitored in real time through millimeter wave radar, infrared and optical lenses and by combining technical means such as AI, and the life quality of the patient is improved.
assignees: SICHUAN JIZHUANZHENGXIN SMART MEDICAL CARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign detection method and device based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign detection method and device based on millimeter wave radar, belonging to the technical field of radar signal processing, comprising the following steps: performing fast Fourier transform on radar echo intermediate frequency signal data to obtain a frequency spectrum and a phase spectrum of an intermediate frequency signal; suppressing interference in the frequency spectrum using a phasor mean cancellation algorithm; performing incoherent accumulation on multi-frame data; searching the maximum value in the range of the human body target distance to obtain a distance unit corresponding to the target; extracting phases at the corresponding distance units of the target from the phase spectrum, unfolding the phases, and calculating a target body surface displacement curve; separating the respiratory and heartbeat signals; and respectively carrying out spectrum estimation on the respiration and heartbeat signals obtained by separation, and obtaining corresponding respiration and heartbeat times per minute according to a spectrum estimation result. By adopting the vital sign detection method and device based on the millimeter wave radar, the frequency estimation with high resolution can be carried out on the vital sign signals with limited length, so that more accurate vital sign detection results can be obtained.

title_en: Reverse pushing method simulated submarine landslide impact pipeline model test device and test method
abstract_en: The invention provides a reverse pushing method for simulating submarine landslide impact pipeline model test device and a test method. The size of the model device is effectively controlled by reversely pushing the pipeline impact slope through a reverse pushing method, unexpected sliding impact force errors are avoided, and the difficulty that the shape and sliding trend of the traditional sliding surface are difficult to quantitatively control is overcome; the thrust magnitude, deflection and bending moment distribution rules of the pipeline can be obtained by measuring the values of the axial force sensor between the jack and the push rod and the strain gage at different positions on the pipeline, so that the feedback of the effect of the submarine landslide impact on the buried pipeline is determined, and a reference basis is provided for the design of submarine pipelines.

title_en: Bio-signal measurement system and method using terahertz wave
title_ko: 테라헤르츠파를 이용한 생체신호 측정 시스템 및 측정방법
abstract_en: The present invention comprises: a terahertz wave detection sensor; an imaging unit converting a terahertz wave incident to the terahertz wave detection sensor into an electrical signal and generating an image using the electrical signal; and a bio-signal detection unit detecting a movement of a lung part of a human body in the image generated by the imaging unit to detect a respiration rate of the human body.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 테라헤르츠파 검출 센서; 상기 테라헤르츠파 검출 센서로 입사된 테라헤르츠파를 전기 신호로 변환하고, 상기 전기 신호를 이용하여 이미지를 생성하는 이미징부; 및 상기 이미징부가 생성한 이미지에서 인체의 폐 부분의 움직임을 검출하여 인체의 호흡수를 검출하는 생체신호 검출부;를 포함하는 것을 일 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Monitoring vital signs of multiple persons via single phased-mimo radar
abstract_en: System and method for sensing movement such as chest movement of each of a plurality of target test subjects by: transmitting, at each of N transmitting antennas (TXs) of a phased multiple-input multiple-output (phased-MIMO) radar, a common frequency modulated continuous wave (FMCW) signal in each of a plurality of time division multiplex (TDM) slots, each TDM slot having associated with it a respective weight selected in accordance with a transmit steering vector configured to cause a coherent summation of transmitted signal in a desired direction θ0 toward at least one target; receiving target-reflected energy associated with the transmitted FMCW signals at a virtual array formed by stacking signal from P TDM slots received via M receiving antennas (RXs) of the phased-MIMO radar; and processing an output of the virtual array to extract therefrom signal received from the desired direction θ0 to determine thereby target movement in the desired direction θ0.

title_en: Water barrier system for river level monitoring
title_ko: 하천 수위 모니터링을 위한 차수벽 시스템
abstract_en: A water barrier system for river level monitoring is disclosed. The water barrier system for river level monitoring includes: a water barrier buried in the ground of a river bank that rises or falls to block overflowing water from the river; a cylinder module that raises or lowers the water barrier; a water level sensor that measures the water level of the river; a broadcaster that outputs an evacuation guidance broadcast; and a controller that determines whether the river is expected to overflow beyond the river bank using the water level of the river measured by the water level sensor, controls the broadcaster to broadcast an evacuation guidance broadcast if the river is expected to overflow as a result of the determination, operates the cylinder module to raise the water barrier buried in the ground of the river bank if the measured water level of the river reaches a preset dangerous water level, and controls the height of the water barrier to rise corresponding to the measured water level.
abstract_ko: 하천 수위 모니터링을 위한 차수벽 시스템이 개시된다. 하천 수위 모니터링을 위한 차수벽 시스템은, 하천의 강둑의 지중에 매립되어 있다가 상승 또는 하강하여 하천에서 범람하는 물을 차단하는 차수벽, 차수벽을 상승 또는 하강시키는 실린더 모듈, 하천의 수위를 측정하는 수위센서, 대피 안내 방송을 출력하는 방송기 및 수위센서에 의하여 측정된 하천의 수위를 이용하여 하천이 강둑을 넘어 범람할 것으로 예상되는지 여부를 판단하고, 판단 결과 하천이 범람할 것으로 예상되면, 방송기가 대피 안내 방송을 하도록 제어하고, 측정된 하천의 수위가 미리 설정된 위험 수위에 도달하면, 강둑의 지중에 매립되어 있던 차수벽이 상승하도록 실린더 모듈을 동작시키고, 측정된 수위에 상응하게 차수벽의 상승 높이를 제어하는 제어기를 포함한다.
assignees: DAEJIN UNIV CENTER FOR EDUCATIONAL INDUSTRIAL COOPERATION

title_en: Vital sign detection radar signal processing method under low signal-to-noise ratio
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for processing a vital sign detection radar signal under a low signal-to-noise ratio, which belongs to the technical field of electronic information and comprises the following steps: measuring the digital intermediate frequency signal amplitude of a plurality of groups of I/Q channels, dynamically tracking the DC offset and compensating; coherent accumulation of intra-frame signals; distance processing; detecting a moving target based on the history estimation and the current state; performing distance tracking based on the distance dimension CFAR and the auto-covariance function; phase demodulation; demodulating the real phase, and differentiating the phase to enhance the heartbeat signal; two paths of breathing and heartbeat are filtered by a band pass filter to obtain a phase component; respectively carrying out signal recombination on the two paths of band-pass filtering output signals; and outputting a frequency estimation result based on the spectrum estimation of the multiple signal classification algorithm. The invention adopts the method for processing the vital sign detection radar signal under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio, realizes better random body dynamic interference resistance, and can realize high-precision detection under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio.

title_en: Human breath detection method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of signal processing, and relates to a human breath detection method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, radar echo data are read; s2, performing inverse fast Fourier transform on the radar echo data to obtain a fast-slow time plane; s3, detecting a moving target on the fast and slow time planes, eliminating background clutter, obtaining echo signals of a human body, and determining the target position of the human body; s4, performing fast Fourier transform on the fast and slow time planes subjected to moving object detection along slow time to determine the respiratory rate of the human body. The human body behind the obstacle (wall) can still be detected under the conditions of complex environments such as strong clutter and low signal to noise ratio to acquire the breathing frequency and one-dimensional distance of the human body target, so that whether the human body target exists or not and whether the vital sign of the human body is stable or not can be determined, and the method can be applied to scenes such as anti-terrorism and earthquake disaster rescue.
assignees: SHENZHEN LAN YOU TECH CO LTD

title_en: MIMO through-wall radar wall clutter suppression method based on amplitude coherence factor
abstract_en: Aiming at the problem that the conventional method cannot effectively solve the problem of noise suppression of the MIMO through-wall radar wall, the invention provides a method for suppressing noise of the MIMO through-wall radar wall based on an amplitude coherence factor. In this method, the amplitude coherence factor is calculated by using the variance of the echo amplitudes over all transmit-receive channels, which directly reflects the coherence of the echo amplitudes for each pixel in the imaging region. The image of the original imaging of the radar echo is then weighted based on the weights of the amplitude coherence factor, thereby suppressing wall clutter. Compared with the existing subspace decomposition method, the method has better wall clutter suppression effect. Through verification of simulation experiments and actual measurement experiments, the method has a good clutter suppression effect in a scene that the wall body contains a single-layer wall body.

title_en: Smart diffuser with directional antenna-based non-contact bio-signal measurement function
title_ko: 지향성 안테나 기반 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨저
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a smart diffuser having a non-contact bio-signal measurement function based on a directional antenna capable of acquiring more precise data. The smart diffuser having a non-contact bio-signal measurement function based on a directional antenna comprises: a main body including a cylindrical body, an expansion flange, and a support; a coupling nut having screw-joining holes formed in the upper and lower directions; an elevating drive shaft coupled to the screw-joining holes of the coupling nut; a cover part for opening and closing an exhaust port of the main body; an elevating drive motor for rotating the elevating drive shaft; an elevating guide for blocking rotation of the cover part when the cover part is elevated; a bio-signal detection sensor part for detecting the presence and location of a resident based on a reflected signal by outputting an ultra-wideband frequency signal and detecting a resident's bio-signal; an environmental information detection sensor part for detecting indoor environmental information; and a controller for controlling the bio-signal sensor part, receiving bio-information and environmental information, and controlling the elevating drive motor accordingly.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지향성 안테나 기반 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨저에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 지향성 초광대역 안테나를 활용하여 비접촉 방식으로 거주자의 실내 위치, 생체신호 측정을 통한 거주자의 생활패턴 및 공간별 맞춤형 공기질 관리가 가능하고, 지향성을 가지도록 하여 정확도 높은 센서데이터의 취득이 가능한 지향성 안테나 기반 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨저에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 지향성 안테나 기반 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨저는 지향성 초광대역 안테나를 활용하여 비접촉 방식으로 거주자의 위치를 실시간으로 추적 및 활동량을 분석하고, 이에 따른 주거 공간별로 맞춤형 공기질 관리가 가능한 장점이 있다.  
또한, 본 발명에 따른 지향성 안테나 기반 비접촉식 생체신호 측정 기능을 구비한 스마트 디퓨저는 지향성 초광대역 안테나를 활용하여 비접촉 방식으로 거주자의 호흡수 및 심박수를 실시간 측정함으로써 응급상황 발생 여부를 확인 및 신속한 후속조치가 가능하고, 거주자의 활동패턴 및 생체신호 분석을 통해 침입자 인식이 가능한 장점이 있다.

title_en: Machine vision and artificial intelligence-based bracelet for real-time monitoring of patients' vital signs under emergency and critical situations
abstract_en: An advanced biometric bracelet has been designed that can monitor vital signs in emergencies and critical situations. Thanks to facial recognition technology, this bracelet records, displays, and sends the patient's data to the doctor. In situations where the number of patients or clients to hospitals and medical centers is high, or in case of natural disasters, this bracelet can alleviate probable risks by shortening the waiting time of patients. Equipped with biometric sensors, this bracelet can record vital signs including blood oxygen level, heart rate, and body temperature. In emergencies, the bracelet will alert and store the data for a while so that the doctor can check for fluctuations. The camera mounted on the bracelet helps to save the changes in the patient's face in the memory of the device and transmit it to the doctor via Wi-Fi.

title_en: Ground penetrating radar ground vehicle adapter
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a ground penetrating radar, and provides a ground penetrating radar adapter, which aims to solve the problems of easy damage, less information amount and large error of the existing pavement detection mark, and comprises a main body which is buried on the ground, wherein the main body is T-shaped, the upper surface of the top end of the T-shaped is provided with a two-dimensional code, and the T-shaped top ends on two sides of the two-dimensional code are provided with positioning holes for fixing the main body and the ground; the bottom end of the main body T-shaped vertical section is provided with a cavity, a plastic package capsule is arranged in the cavity, and an identification chip is packaged in the plastic package capsule.
assignees: JIANGSU LIANJIAN TESTING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Accurate detection method for underground pipeline
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underground pipeline detection, in particular to an accurate detection method for an underground pipeline, which comprises the following steps: obtaining corresponding construction position information and pipeline distribution diagrams in a construction position range, wherein the pipeline distribution diagrams comprise position information and buried depths of different pipelines, and step two: establishing a pipeline distribution model according to the construction position information and the pipeline distribution diagram, and step three: pipeline point location information within a pipeline database is retrieved and added to the pipeline distribution model. According to the invention, the depth information and the position information of the pipeline to be detected are determined by detecting the aluminum foil and the vertical origin on the ground twice and combining the radar model of the detector by a direct connection method, and the radar information of the two times are combined and compared, so that accurate positioning is realized, the parameter information is imported into the GNSS handbook after measurement, a pipeline distribution model is established, measurement and check are performed, and the pipeline detection precision is improved.
assignees: CHINA CHEMICAL CIVIL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Test device for simulating landslide erosion-collapse-reviving evolution process
abstract_en: The test device for simulating the landslide 'erosion-landslide-reviving' evolution process comprises a landslide model arranged in a test box, wherein a wave making device and a wave absorbing device are respectively arranged at two ends of the model, the wave making device is arranged at the front end of the landslide model, the wave absorbing device is arranged at the rear end of the model, shooting devices are arranged at the top and two sides of the outside of the test box, the shooting devices at the top are arranged at the front end of the landslide model, a water body monitoring device is arranged side by side, the landslide model comprises a multistage bedrock plate and a bedrock plate lifting device, during test, bedrock, a sliding belt and a sliding body material are sequentially paved on the bedrock plate, a sensor is buried in the sliding body material, the test box is a transparent box with an opening at the top, double-layer glass is arranged in the box of a wave making device area, water injection and drainage devices are respectively arranged at the bottoms of the box on the sides of the wave making device and the wave absorbing device, and a sponge is arranged at the wave absorbing device end in the box; the device realizes the simulation of the erosion-collapse-reviving linkage process.

title_en: System and methods for detection of subjects vitals and physiological symptoms via non-contact methods
abstract_en: The present invention provides a non-contact vital sign monitoring which properly detect subject's vital signs by correcting the measured signals for reflectance and variations in distance between measurements. The present invention provides for adequate sensor numbers and types to properly monitor a subject's vitals and physiological signals. Certain aspects of the invention include the use of signal scoring methods. In such embodiments, acquired data and/or information is used for scoring a signal acquired from non-contact vital monitoring assisting in the accurate measurement of various vitals of a subject, including, without limit, a subjects temperature, cardiovascular and respiratory information. The present invention provides a viable solution for at-a-distance non-contact vital sign monitoring that overcomes the shortcomings of existing solutions known in the art.

title_en: Sedimentation monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sedimentation monitoring device, comprising: and the sedimentation cylinder is buried in the tunnel ground and used for presenting the sedimentation quantity of the tunnel ground. The buckle component is arranged on the sedimentation cylinder and is rotationally connected with the top wall of the sedimentation cylinder. The corner reflector is arranged on the buckle assembly, fixedly connected with the buckle assembly and in communication connection with the radar system and used for reflecting echo signals to the radar system and assisting the radar system in detecting the settlement of the tunnel ground. The buckle component is screwed out of the sedimentation cylinder and is buried in the ground of a tunnel by means of the driving force of the electric drill after being connected with the common electric drill, and then the buckle component is transferred into the sedimentation cylinder and extends into the ground, so that the sedimentation cylinder is supported in the sedimentation cylinder, and the work of monitoring the sedimentation quantity simultaneously with the control monitoring system on a construction site is realized. And only need rotatory two processes of burying in ground and rotatory installation buckle subassembly, simple easy operation, time saving and labor saving have improved work efficiency.
assignees: SHAANXI PUBLIC STAR SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Lightweight through-wall radar human body posture recognition method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying indoor human body gestures by a through-wall radar, which comprises the following steps: acquiring radar signals of the human body posture target behind the wall to obtain motion information of the human body target behind the wall; background cancellation and clutter suppression are carried out on the radar signals; processing the radar data by time-frequency transformation to generate a micro Doppler image; and inputting the generated micro Doppler images into a trained lightweight model for classification. By adopting the invention, the actions of the human body behind the wall can be rapidly and accurately identified.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar vital sign detection method for inhibiting body movement interference
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar vital sign detection method for inhibiting body movement interference, which comprises the steps of firstly positioning a human body target, obtaining a recovered human body vital sign signal through a SARIMA model, finally carrying out first-order difference on the recovered human body vital sign signal to remove phase drift, and decomposing the signal into a respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal through different band-pass filters after removing impulse noise and moving average filtering, wherein the heartbeat signal is required to pass through a band-stop filter to remove respiratory harmonics; finally, respectively carrying out fast Fourier transform on the respiration signal and the heartbeat signal, extracting peak frequency and converting the peak frequency into corresponding respiration rate and heart rate; according to the invention, non-contact detection is realized by utilizing the millimeter wave radar, so that the respiratory rate and the heart rate of a human body are obtained, meanwhile, the position of the human body is dynamically detected, and the SARIMA model is used for recovering vital sign signals interfered by the movement of the human body, so that the measurement error is reduced.

title_en: Driver safety monitoring method and device, vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a driver safety monitoring method, a device, a vehicle and a storage medium, comprising the following steps: acquiring vital sign data of a driver in the target vehicle through at least one millimeter wave radar during the running process of the target vehicle; uploading vital sign data of the driver to a driver health management server through an internet of vehicles system; and generating a health management result matched with the driver according to the vital sign data of the driver through the driver health management server. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention can provide an effective driver health and safety management mode, and improves the safety of drivers and target vehicles.

title_en: Passenger's bording poistion and biometric information detection radar system and radar signal processing method thereof
title_ko: 탑승객의 탑승 위치 및 생체 정보 감지 레이더 시스템 및 그의 레이더 신호 처리 방법
abstract_en: A purpose of the present invention is to provide a radar system for detecting passenger seating positions and biometric information, which can stably detect seating positions and biometric information of passengers, such as adults or children, in an interior space while a vehicle is in motion, using a radar sensor, and a radar signal processing method thereof. The system includes: a moving target data signal processing unit that receives ADC data received through a plurality of receiving channels to detect biometric data of passengers while the vehicle is in motion, and processes the data to detect moving targets; a distance and angle data signal processing unit that distinguishes biometric signals from vibration signals by signal processing 3D data including distance and angle data of the detected moving target data; a frequency data signal processing unit that detects frequency components for biometric signals based on periodicity detected from the 3D data; and a biometric data signal processing unit that determines biometric information based on the detected frequency values and analyzes fluctuation characteristics of the determined frequency values to track biometric signals. According to the present invention, a radar system for detecting a passenger's boarding position and bio-information and a radar signal processing method thereof can obtain the effect of accurately distinguishing and determining random noise components and target signals generated by vibrations during vehicle driving, and stably detecting a passenger's boarding position and bio-signals.
abstract_ko: 탑승객의 탑승 위치 및 생체 정보 감지 레이더 시스템 및 그의 레이더 신호 처리 방법에 관한 것으로,탐지 대상을 향해 레이더 신호를 송신하고 탐지 대상으로부터 반사되는 수신신호를 수신해서 탑승객을 감지하며, 차량 주행 중 탑승객의 생체 데이터를 검출하도록, 복수의 수신 채널을 통해 수신된 ADC 데이터를 수신해서 신호처리해서 이동 표적을 검출하는 이동 표적 데이터 신호처리부, 검출된 이동 표적 데이터의 거리와 각도 데이터를 포함하는 3D 데이터를 신호처리해서 생체 신호와 진동 신호를 구분하는 거리 각도 데이터 신호처리부, 상기 3D 데이터에서 검출된 주기성에 기반하여 생체 신호에 대한 주파수 성분을 검출하는 주파수 데이터 신호처리부 및 검출된 주파수 값을 기반으로 생체 정보를 판별하고 판별된 주파수 값의 변동 특성을 분석하여 생체 신호를 추적하는 생체 데이터 신호처리부를 포함하는 구성을 마련하여, 차량 주행 중 진동으로 발생하는 랜덤한 잡음 성분과 표적 신호를 정확하게 구분 및 판별해서 탑승객의 생체 신호 및 탑승 위치를 안정적으로 검출할 수 있다.

title_en: Firefighting rescue equipment
abstract_en: The present invention relates to firefighting rescue equipment that consists of a helmet that adjusts to the head in order to protect the rescuer's face from smoke in the event of a fire, and it also integrates a self-contained breathing mask to supply oxygen in order to minimise risk related to a low concentration of oxygen in areas with a fire. Another feature of the present invention is a camera for transmitting real time video as a support, in addition to installed lights for improving visibility in areas with low lighting. The firefighting rescue equipment also has a communication system to establish contact with support personnel, and it is important to note that said equipment has mechanisms that supply air therein to keep the rescuer cool when they are in a high temperature environment. Another feature of the present invention is a vital sign sensor that monitors the critical systems of a person in risk situations.

title_en: Non-excavation detection electromagnetic device and method for direct-buried heat supply pipeline based on geomagnetic feedback data collection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a direct-buried heat supply pipeline non-excavation detection electromagnetic device and method based on geomagnetic feedback data collection, comprising a shell, wherein a fixed plate is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the front end of the shell, the front end of the shell is connected with a permalloy plate shielding cover, and the upper side of the inner part of the shell is connected with a movable handle; the cover plate is arranged on the inner side of the disassembly structure, the right side of the rear end of the cover plate is provided with a 64-bit thermal sensor, the left side of the rear end of the cover plate is provided with a fixed ring, the rear end of the fixed ring is fixedly provided with an installation block, the outer side of the middle part of the installation block is connected with a movable rod, the inner side of the movable rod is connected with a limiting block, and the inner side of the limiting block is connected with a cesium magnetic sensor matrix. The non-excavation detection electromagnetic device and the method for the direct-buried heat supply pipeline based on geomagnetic feedback data collection are convenient to carry the detection electromagnetic device, convenient to replace a cesium magnetic sensor of a phased array scanning radar, and convenient to collect geomagnetic feedback data.
assignees: TIANJIN HENGTAI PERCEPTION PRECISION MEASUREMENT TECH CO LTD;TIANJIN JINAN THERMAL POWER CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact human body heartbeat waveform extraction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact human body heartbeat waveform extraction method, which belongs to the technical field of human body perception and heartbeat detection, and comprises the steps of obtaining a reflected signal of a heartbeat of a target person by utilizing IR-UWB equipment, constructing an autocorrelation matrix characteristic of the reflected signal, carrying out characteristic mapping with an autocorrelation matrix of a heartbeat waveform extracted by real heartbeat acquisition equipment, obtaining a value of a heartbeat rate by utilizing a period similarity characteristic of a heartbeat period signal, and constructing the heartbeat waveform. The invention solves the problem that the high-precision human heartbeat waveform is difficult to obtain under the conditions of real stability and motion state and is limited by the interference of different indoor environments, the postures of personnel, the surface coverings and other factors.

title_en: Human presence detection device and method
abstract_en: A human presence detection apparatus and method are disclosed. The human body presence detection device according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a radar sensor unit configured to transmit a radar signal, receive a reflected radar signal generated by an obstacle reflecting the radar signal, and generate an analog electronic signal based on the reflected radar signal; and a signal processor unit configured to generate a digital electronic signal by analog-to-digital conversion of the analog electronic signal, and determine the presence of a human body within the sensing range of the radar sensor unit based on the amplitude variation condition of the digital electronic signal.
assignees: GUANGZHOU ON BRIGHT ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign monitoring radar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vital sign monitoring radar, which relates to the technical field of vital sign monitoring and comprises a radar body and a display screen, wherein a key is arranged on one side of the radar body, a connecting port is arranged on one side of the radar body, an MCU module is fixedly connected to one side of the radar body, a loudspeaker module is fixedly connected to the front side of the MCU module, a protection block is arranged at the upper end of the loudspeaker module, one side of the protection block is fixedly connected with the front side of the radar body, and a millimeter wave radar antenna board is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the radar body. According to the utility model, the sliding blocks on two sides slide in the sliding groove by pulling the handle and drive the metal connecting rod, so that the magnetic blocks are separated, the protection plate covers the surface of the speaker module, the problem of blockage caused by dust on the surface of the speaker module when the speaker module is used for a long time is solved, and the effect of protecting the speaker module and preventing the dust from being blocked is achieved.

title_en: Vital sign detection device and method based on wireless radar signal and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a vital sign detection device and method based on a wireless radar signal. The method comprises the following steps: determining an initial position of a living body according to the wireless radar signal; determining a target position corresponding to a characteristic signal conforming to the physiological characteristic of the living body according to the frequency domain characteristic of the characteristic signal for detecting the vital sign parameter in a neighborhood range containing the initial position; and detecting vital sign parameters from the characteristic signal at the target location. Thus, clutter interference can be reduced, and detection accuracy can be improved.

title_en: Color image rendering for ground-penetrating radar systems
abstract_en: Devices, methods and techniques related to image rendering for ground-penetrating radar (GPR) systems are disclosed. In one example aspect, a method for producing one or more images associated with a GPR includes receiving information representative of signals received by the GPR, determining at least three frequency bands associated with the received information, assigning color values to the received information corresponding to the at least three frequency bands, and generating a color image for the one or more objects by combining the received information in all of the at least three frequency bands together such that the color values in the color image indicate a size of the one or more objects, a depth at which the one or more objects is buried underground, or an electrical permittivity of the one or more objects.
assignees: L LIVERMORE NAT SECURITY LLC;TERES TECH INC

title_en: Radar signal processing method for improved occupant vital monitoring
abstract_en: A radar signal processing method for improved occupant vital monitoring includes a method for detecting vital signs using at least one radar sensor mounted to a vehicle. The method includes detecting a plurality of target candidates using the at least one radar sensor, analyzing the plurality of target candidates to generate a list of targets, steering the at least one radar sensor towards the target using the angle of arrival to the target, and detecting a vital signal of the target based on the range using the at least one radar sensor.

title_en: Fire spread prevention and fire suppression apparatus for electric vehicle parking facility
title_ko: 전기차 주차시설 화재 확산방지 및 진압 장치
abstract_en: An object to be achieved by the present invention is to provide a fire spread prevention and suppression device for an electric vehicle parking facility, which is specialized for an electric vehicle to quickly suppress a fire. The fire spread prevention and suppression device for an electric vehicle parking facility comprises: a sensor unit for detecting whether a fire has occurred in a vehicle being charged through an electric charging facility for a vehicle; a control unit for generating a control signal for controlling the installation of a flame retardant fabric, a driving signal for controlling the driving of a water barrier, and a turn-on signal for controlling the on/off of a fire extinguishing water supply nozzle; the flame retardant fabric descending from a ceiling to a floor in response to the control signal to block the inflow of air into a surrounding space of the vehicle when a fire occurring in the vehicle is detected; the water barrier protruding from the buried floor toward the ceiling by a predetermined height in response to the driving signal to seal the surrounding space under the vehicle; and the fire extinguishing water supply nozzle for supplying fire extinguishing water to the surrounding space under the vehicle sealed by the water barrier in response to the turn-on signal to submerge a battery installed in the vehicle. According to the present invention, the fire spread prevention and suppression device for an electric vehicle parking facility can prevent the spread of a fire to people, other parked vehicles and charging facilities around a vehicle in which a fire has occurred by quickly installing a flame retardant fabric around the vehicle when the fire occurrence in the vehicle being charged through an electric charging facility is detected.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따른 전기차 주차시설 화재 확산방지 및 진압 장치는 차량용 전기 충전 설비가 설치된 공간의 천장에 설치되어, 상기 차량용 전기 충전 설비를 통해 충전중인 차량에 대한 화재 발생 여부를 감지하고, 감지 결과를 제어부로 전송하는 센서부, 상기 센서부로부터 상기 차량에 대한 화재 발생 감지 여부를 나타내는 적어도 하나의 센싱신호를 수신하고, 상기 적어도 하나의 센싱신호에 응답하여 난연포의 설치를 제어하는 제어신호, 차수벽의 구동을 제어하는 구동신호 및 소화수 공급노즐의 온오프를 제어하는 턴온신호를 각각 생성하는 제어부, 상기 센서부가 상기 차량에 대한 화재 발생 감지 시, 상기 제어신호에 응답하여 상기 천장으로부터 바닥으로 하강하여 상기 차량의 주변 공간 내 공기 유입을 차단시키는 난연포, 상기 차량의 주변을 둘러싸도록 바닥에 매립되고, 상기 차량에 대한 화재 발생 감지 시, 상기 구동신호에 응답하여 매립된 바닥으로부터 천장 방향으로 소정 높이 돌출하여 상기 차량의 하부 주변 공간을 밀폐시키는 차수벽 및 상기 바닥 상에 설치되고, 상기 턴온신호에 응답하여 상기 차수벽에 의해 밀폐된 상기 차량의 하부 주변 공간으로 소화수를 공급하여, 상기 차량 내 설치된 배터리를 침수시키는 소화수 공급노즐을 포함한다.

title_en: High-resolution three-dimensional through-wall imaging device and rapid imaging method
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-resolution three-dimensional through-wall imaging device and a rapid imaging method, and particularly relates to the technical field of microwave through-wall imaging. The invention further provides a high-resolution three-dimensional through-wall imaging device which comprises a multi-port vector network analyzer, an ultra-wideband directional antenna area array and a control terminal.
assignees: THE 41ST INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: Vital sign monitoring method, system and terminal based on biological radar
abstract_en: In order to overcome the defects in the prior art, the application provides a vital sign monitoring method, a system and a terminal based on a biological radar, which comprise the following steps: setting at least 2 biological radars; alternately adjusting the direction angle of the biological radar according to a preset period so as to alternately acquire echo data of a person to be monitored through the biological radar; according to the echo data, obtaining the face orientation of the person to be monitored, taking the biological radar of the face orientation of the person to be monitored as a biological radar close to the person to be monitored, and taking the biological radar as a monitoring radar; and monitoring vital signs of the person to be monitored by using the monitoring radar. The monitoring method can monitor the vital signs continuously in the sleeping process of the person to be monitored, and can monitor the respiratory rate and the heartbeat rate more accurately even if the person to be monitored turns over in the sleeping process.
assignees: SHENZHEN YICHENG MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Pet house system enabling companion animal health management through biosignal measurement
title_ko: 생체신호 측정을 통한 반려동물 건강관리가 가능한 펫하우스 시스템
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a pet house system that can analyze heart rate, respiratory rate, and stress of a pet, classify sleep state, and analyze body water and body fat; and a pet health management method using the same. Provided is a method for managing pet health through biosignal measurement comprising: a step of obtaining, by a sensor part, a pressure signal of the pet; a step of signal processing, by a processor, a signal measured through the sensor part; and a step of estimating, by the processor, a stress of the pet by analyzing the heart rate variability (HRV) included in the signal processing result, wherein the obtaining step obtains the pressure signal from each of a plurality of channels, and selects an optimal signal among the pressure signals of each channel. According to embodiments of the present invention, the present invention enables to contribute to the health management of pets by providing functions for analyzing heart rate, respiratory rate, and stress of the pet, classifying sleep state, and analyzing body water and body fat.
abstract_ko: 생체신호 측정을 통해 반려동물 건강관리가 가능한 펫하우스 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 생체신호 측정을 통한 반려동물 건강관리 방법은, 센서부가, 반려동물의 압력 신호를 획득하는 단계; 프로세서가, 센서부를 통해 측정된 신호를 신호처리하는 단계; 및 프로세서가, 신호처리 결과에 포함된 심박변이도(HRV)를 분석하여 반려동물의 스트레스를 추정하는 단계;를 포함하고, 획득하는 단계는, 복수의 채널에서 각각 압력 신호를 획득하고, 각 채널의 압력 신호 중 최적 신호를 선택한다. 이에 의해, 반려동물의 심박수, 호흡수 및 스트레스 분석, 수면 상태 분류, 체수분과 체지방 분석 기능을 제공하여, 반려동물의 건강관리에 기여할 수 있다. 또한, 여러 채널의 센서를 활용하여 센서값을 수집하고, 이 중 최적의 센서값을 선택할 수 있어, 다양한 자세에서도 높은 정확도의 생체신호 측정이 가능하며, 반려동물의 심박변이도(HRV)를 측정하여 심박과 호흡의 Peak를 도출하고 심박수와 호흡수를 보정함으로써, 종래의 기술보다 더 높은 정확도로 심박수와 호흡수를 측정할 수 있다.

title_en: Smart door lock with multi-factor authentication
title_ko: 다중 요소 인증을 적용한 스마트 도어락
abstract_en: A purpose of the present invention is to provide a smart door lock and an authentication method using the same, which can complement the security vulnerabilities of existing single-factor authentication by performing user authentication based on biometric signals, fingerprint images, and facial images by applying a multi-factor authentication method. A smart door lock applying multi-factor authentication is provided, which includes: a first sensor unit for extracting a user's biometric signal; a second sensor unit for extracting a user's fingerprint image; a third sensor unit for scanning the user's face surface to obtain a facial image; and a processor for performing user authentication.
abstract_ko: 다중 요소 인증(Multi-Factor-Authentication)을 적용한 스마트 도어락이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 다중 요소 인증을 적용한 스마트 도어락은, 사용자의 생체 신호를 추출하는 제1 센서부; 사용자의 지문 이미지를 추출하는 제2 센서부; 사용자의 얼굴 표면을 스캔하여 얼굴 이미지를 획득하는 제3 센서부; 및 생체 신호, 지문 이미지 및 얼굴 이미지를 심층신경망 기반의 생체신호 인증모델, 지문 인증모델 및 얼굴 인증모델에 각각 적용하여 사용자 인증을 수행하는 프로세서;를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 다중 요소 인증 방식을 적용하여, 생체 신호, 지문 이미지 및 얼굴 이미지를 기반으로 사용자 인증을 수행함으로써, 기존의 단일 요소 인증의 보안 취약점을 보완할 수 있다. 더불어, 피부 습도에 따라서 상반된 인식률을 가진 두 생체요소(지문 및 생체 신호)를 대상으로 습도 수치에 따라 가중치를 적용하고, 조도를 기준으로 얼굴 이미지(안면 인식 요소)에 가중치를 적용하여 개인 인증의 정확도를 안정적으로 유지할 수 있다.

title_en: Highway engineering mountain landslide safety monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention provides a highway engineering mountain landslide safety monitoring device, which comprises: the system comprises a plurality of groups of calibration rods, wherein the calibration rods are buried on a mountain to be monitored; the system comprises a data acquisition unit, a data acquisition unit and a data processing unit, wherein the data acquisition unit comprises a laser radar, visual equipment, a gyroscope and a moisture measuring instrument, the moisture measuring instrument acquires moisture data Q of a mountain, and the laser radar acquires a distance M; the gyroscope measures the inclination angle N of the calibration rod and the rock stratum offset direction change quantity w on the horizontal plane; the image analysis unit is used for calculating the mountain change rate X according to the data collected by the data collection unit, and the image analysis unit is used for calculating the final risk grade Y by combining the mountain change rate X through the comparison of the front and rear characteristic point ratios. The risk grade Y provided by the invention is obtained by performing superposition calculation on the mountain deformation coefficient and the mountain change rate, so that the early warning accuracy is improved, and the misjudgment on the landslide risk is reduced.

title_en: MIMO through-wall radar hidden target imaging method based on multipath virtual image positioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a MIMO through-wall radar hidden target imaging method based on multipath virtual image positioning, which mainly solves the problem that the existing MIMO through-wall radar images a hidden target in a building, and the positioning effect of a real target is poor due to too many multipath virtual images. The implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring MIMO array echo data, calculating a one-dimensional range profile of an imaging area, and estimating wall parameters according to the range profile; compensating the refraction error of the wall body by adopting a refraction point approximation method, and establishing an improved BP algorithm of the through-wall scene; constructing a MIMO radar multipath virtual image positioning model, selecting a virtual image ectopic sub-aperture, and imaging sub-aperture echo data by using an improved BP algorithm; and carrying out gamma correction-based sub-image fusion on the sub-aperture images to obtain the built-in hidden target radar image after multipath virtual image suppression. The invention can effectively inhibit multipath virtual images generated by wall reflection, improves the imaging effect of hidden targets in buildings, and can be used for rescue activities, public safety and military investigation.

title_en: Deep learning-based radar non-contact human electrocardiogram monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical health monitoring, and particularly relates to a radar non-contact human electrocardiograph monitoring method based on deep learning. The invention can realize noninvasive vital sign monitoring of the human body target, and solves the limitations of the traditional electrocardiogram in long-term monitoring and special cases. The method transmits signals to a human body in a non-contact mode by using a CW continuous wave radar based on a six-port technology, obtains original radar sensing signals from radar echoes, and simultaneously completes synchronous acquisition of electrocardiographic signals (ECG) of the human body by using reference equipment. The obtained radar signals as well as the ECG signals are processed using a signal processing algorithm and a data set is constructed. Then training a mixed convolution automatic coding and two-way long-short-term memory cyclic network (BiLSTM) with MODWT layers in a data driving mode to finally obtain a reconstruction mapping model from the radar original signal to the ECG signal.

title_en: Wall-mounted induction fire extinguishing device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of fire control, and discloses a wall-mounted induction fire extinguishing device which comprises a suspension frame arranged on a wall, wherein an adjusting member, a spray head and a containing member are arranged on the suspension frame, the input end of the spray head is provided with a connecting pipe, the tail end of the connecting pipe is provided with a booster pump, the input end of the booster pump is communicated with a fire extinguishing medium supply source, the adjusting member is used for pulling the spray head to be close to a fire source and pulling the spray head to swing when a fire disaster occurs, and the containing member is used for keeping the connecting pipe in an ordered state; according to the utility model, the fire disaster is sensed through the temperature sensor pre-buried at the position where the fire disaster easily occurs, and when the fire disaster occurs, the temperature sensor sends out signals to enable the first motor, the second motor and the third motor to operate, the former drives the spray head to be close to the fire source, so that accurate fire extinguishment is realized, the fire extinguishment effect is improved, the latter two motors cooperate to drive the spray head to swing, the spraying range of the spray head is improved, and the fire extinguishment effect is improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU JINGBA FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Handheld through-wall radar
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of through-wall radars, in particular to a handheld through-wall radar, which comprises a radar detector, wherein the front surface of the radar detector is provided with a protection groove, the inner side of the protection groove is provided with a handle, the top end of the handle is provided with a side button, the front surface of the handle is provided with a front button, the rear surface of the handle is provided with a supporting leg, the inner wall of the protection groove is provided with a chute, the bottom end of the supporting leg is positioned at the inner side of the chute, the surface of one side of the supporting leg is provided with a clamping groove, the inner side of the clamping groove is provided with a first spring, one side of the first spring is provided with a clamping block, the inner wall of the chute is provided with a limiting groove, and the inner side of the limiting groove is provided with a pushing block; through having set up the handle, with side button and positive button setting at the handle surface, can both hands hold and control radar detector under the state, improve stability and portability greatly, can release the locking to the supporting legs through promoting the ejector pad, make the supporting legs take the handle to take in the protection groove inboard, conveniently accomodate and carry.
assignees: SUZHOU RED POLICE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Sleep respiration screening method integrating blood oxygen and radio frequency sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sleep respiration screening method by fusing blood oxygen and a radio frequency sensor.
