The method comprises a signal acquisition and acquisition module, a blood oxygen signal acquisition unit and a radar signal acquisition unit, wherein the blood oxygen signal acquisition unit is used for acquiring blood oxygen signals by utilizing a blood oxygen finger ring, and the radar signal acquisition unit is used for acquiring vital sign signals of a user by utilizing a biological radar; the signal preprocessing module is used for realizing the synchronization of a radar signal and a blood oxygen signal and extracting a respiratory signal from the radar signal; a respiratory event detection module for detecting an apneic event and a possible hypopneas event for the preprocessed radar signal; and the radar blood oxygen fusion module is used for fusing possible low-ventilation events and blood oxygen states to obtain detection results of the low-ventilation events. The sleep respiration monitoring system can monitor sleep respiration information of a user, screen whether apnea/hypopnea occurs in the sleep process, and is effective, feasible and reliable in performance.
assignees: NANJING HONGDING PERCEPTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Animal health monitor device, system and method
abstract_en: Animal health monitor device, system and method An animal health monitor device 1 for monitoring the health and/or one or more vital signs of an animal 10 comprises: an attachment means 2 for attaching the animal health monitor device 1 to the animal 10; a sensing means 3 configured to output raw sensor data; and a processing means 4 configured to produce processed output data from the raw sensor data. The sensing means 3 comprises a plurality of contact means for applying an alternating current to the skin of the animal 10 and measuring a voltage across the skin of the animal 10. Each contact means comprises at least one electrode configured for extending through hair or fur. The processed output data comprises at least one output signal indicative of the health and/or one or more vital signs of the animal 10.

title_en: Human vital sign radar signal processing method and device based on sliding singular spectrum
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of signal processing, and provides a human vital sign radar signal processing method and device based on a sliding singular spectrum, wherein the human vital sign radar signal processing method based on the sliding singular spectrum comprises the following steps: acquiring a physical sign vibration signal, and dividing the physical sign vibration signal into a plurality of signal segments based on a sliding window; carrying out singular spectrum analysis on each signal segment to obtain a reconstruction subsequence corresponding to each signal segment; and determining target sub-fragments of the signal fragments, and combining the reconstructed sub-sequences corresponding to the target sub-fragments to obtain the target sign vibration signal. The invention improves the efficiency of signal processing by reconstructing after segmentation, ensures the accuracy and reliability of analysis results, and is suitable for analyzing long-time sign monitoring data.

title_en: Contactless vital sign detection and gesture recognition device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of non-contact vital sign detection and gesture recognition, and discloses a non-contact vital sign detection and gesture recognition device, which comprises a millimeter wave radar sensor and a controller, wherein the millimeter wave radar sensor acquires radar sequence frame data for detecting vital sign and gesture recognition of a scene and an object in a non-contact mode, and the radar sequence frame data is connected with a first high-speed signal connector and transmitted to the controller through a first serialization deserializer and superimposed with a power supply from the controller; the central computing processor contained in the controller reads radar parameter data and receives radar sequence frame data through the second serializer-deserializer, the radar sequence frame data is continuous data frames for scene and object measurement, the continuous radar data frame data changes are associated with vital signs and/or gesture changes, and vital sign detection and/or gesture recognition is achieved through running a continuous radar sequence frame data processing program and an AI algorithm program.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar heartbeat and respiration detection device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of accessory devices of millimeter wave equipment, in particular to a heartbeat breath detection device of a millimeter wave radar, which can clamp a machine body through a clamping mechanism, in the process, a radiation position of the machine body is adjusted through a rotation adjusting device matched with a swinging device, and the radiation range of the equipment is diffused through a rotating mechanism, so that the application range of the equipment is improved, the working efficiency of the equipment is improved, and the practicability is improved.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitoring and health conditioning instrument
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of medical appliances, in particular to a non-contact vital sign monitoring and health conditioning instrument, which comprises an installation box, a sensor module, an artificial intelligent machine learning algorithm module, a communication module, a power module and a cloud server, wherein each group of modules are installed in the installation box, the sensor module consists of a millimeter wave/terahertz microstrip array antenna transceiver, a fundamental wave signal generator and a digital signal processor and is responsible for detecting vital sign data of heart rate and respiratory rate of a human body, and the body shape, the body state, the movement and the position of a monitored person; the cloud server receives the data of the artificial intelligent machine learning algorithm module, performs storage operation, and then utilizes a built-in algorithm model and a business model to combine the data condition to send state notification, early warning notification, alarm information and intelligent suggestion to the mobile terminal of the user.
assignees: CHENGDU LINGRUI AOCHUANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wireless telemetry sensor system
abstract_en: The presently disclosed technique includes a multi-detector wearable medical sensor that combines biopotential, optical, temperature, acceleration, and acoustic measurement into a single device. It leverages sensor fusion and deep learning algorithms on device which allows it to directly monitor vital signs, physiological waveforms, and early warning of medical complications. One utility is the ability for the sensor to expand and adapt to several use cases. An expansion port and accessory cables allow the biopotential electrodes to step up or down for any combination of continuous 1-12L electrocardiography ("ECG") measurements. It can also measure fetal ECG with a different accessory cable, or electroencephalogram ("EEG") with another cable. The sensor has BLUETOOTH® Low Energy ("BLE"), Wireless Fidelity ("WIFI®"), Fifth Generation mobile network ("5G") Long Term Evolution Machine Type Communication ("LTE-M"), Near Field Communication ("NFC"), and Ultra Wideband ("UWB") radios. The sensor can also charge and communicate over Universal Serial Bus ("USB").

title_en: Pipeline signal identification and trend calculation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of water supply and drainage pipeline detection, and provides a pipeline signal identification and trend calculation method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring three-dimensional radar data of a buried pipeline; determining the size and the movement overlapping rate of the three-dimensional radar data array block, carrying out array processing on the three-dimensional radar data to form an array block data set, and manually marking the array block data set; performing signal enhancement and data enhancement on the array block data set; inputting the array block data set subjected to signal enhancement and data enhancement into a pipeline identification model trained on three-dimensional radar data; and (3) according to the pipeline recognition result of the pipeline recognition model, dyeing the array block data set and calculating the pipeline trend by using the dyed array block. The pipeline with various materials can be accurately identified, the interference of noise characteristics of the underground environment is reduced, the trend of a hidden pipeline is automatically and accurately calculated, and construction excavation is facilitated; and the processing efficiency is higher, so that reliable technical support is provided for urban infrastructure construction and management.

title_en: Human vital sign detection method and system based on ultra-wideband radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human vital sign detection method and system based on ultra-wideband radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the vital sign measurement is carried out through an ultra-wideband radar to obtain a target human chest echo signal; clutter filtering processing is carried out on the target human chest echo signal to obtain an original chest micro-motion signal; reconstructing the original chest cavity micro-motion signal by utilizing an improved singular spectrum analysis SSA algorithm to obtain a reconstructed chest cavity micro-motion signal; and classifying and processing the reconstructed chest micro-motion signals through a variational modal decomposition VMD algorithm to obtain respiratory signals and heartbeat signals. The method solves the problems that the center frequency hopping estimation accuracy is not high and the influence of respiration and noise is caused in the prior art.

title_en: Multimode fusion living body vital sign detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of living body vital sign detection, and provides a multimode-fused living body vital sign detection system and method, wherein the system comprises the following components: the system comprises a signal acquisition module, a data alignment module, a position acquisition module and a vital sign calculation module. According to the invention, the signal detection device provided with the infrared imaging unit and the millimeter wave radar detection unit is arranged in the target scene, the primary position of the human body is positioned through the infrared detection image acquired by the infrared imaging unit, then the millimeter wave radar is driven to rotate to point to the direction corresponding to the primary position of the human body to execute accurate detection, and finally the accurate position and vital sign of the human body are generated based on the millimeter wave radar detection data acquired by the accurate detection, so that the problem that the traditional vital sign detection system cannot acquire the accurate position of the human body is solved.
assignees: SICHUAN YICHUANG KANGHUA HEALTH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign monitoring method, device, equipment and medium based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a vital sign monitoring method, device, equipment and medium based on millimeter wave radar, which are characterized in that data acquired by the radar on a target area are firstly acquired, and intermediate frequency signal sampling is carried out on the data to generate ADC data; then, when the target person is judged to be in bed according to the ADC data and the body movement index is smaller than a preset value, extracting the chest position of the target person; then, extracting phase data of the chest position, and performing phase unwrapping on the phase data to generate unwrapped data; and finally, preprocessing the unwrapped data, performing FFT operation on the preprocessed unwrapped data to generate heart rate data and performing tracking processing on the heart rate data. The method solves the problem of misjudgment when vital signs are monitored based on millimeter wave radar.

title_en: Multifunctional composite net material for building
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of safety protection, in particular to a multifunctional composite net material for building, which comprises a top layer and a bottom layer, wherein the top layer and the bottom layer are formed by alternately weaving polyester fibers, glass fibers and carbon fibers; the structure of the connecting layer is consistent with that of the top layer and the bottom layer. The wave-shaped fiber is arranged between the top layer and the bottom layer, the wave-shaped fiber comprises cavities, and the cavities are gaps of the wave-shaped fiber. The beneficial effects are that: the electric heating wires are pre-buried in the composite net material and used for paving the tunnel portal or the side ditch in the tunnel, and the electric heating wires are electrified and heated when the electric heating wires encounter icing in winter, so that the icing is melted, the water flow is normal, and the water in the tunnel is prevented from being frozen in the tunnel or when the water flows out of the tunnel portal, so that the water level is continuously increased, and the railway track bed is flooded. The displacement sensor, the acceleration sensor and the sensor for monitoring vibration for measuring landslide and falling stones and rolling stones are buried in the net material, so that the movement of the landslide body and the rolling stones and falling stones can be monitored, and the safety of railway and highways is ensured.
assignees: SHAANXI YONGGUBANG ENGINEERING MATERIALS TECH CO LTD;TAIZHOU MENGNENGDA ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Underground mining area safety monitoring system and monitoring method based on optical fiber sensing technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a underground mining area safety monitoring system and a monitoring method based on an optical fiber sensing technology, wherein the monitoring system comprises the following steps: the system comprises an armored optical cable safety monitoring well distributed on the ground in a grid mode in a mining area, a three-component distributed acoustic wave sensing optical fiber fixed on a top plate of an underground mining roadway, a distributed strain or displacement sensing optical cable, a distributed temperature sensing optical fiber, a distributed chemical sensing optical fiber and a multi-channel DAS/DSS/DTS/DCS composite modem instrument. The underground mining area is monitored in real time by means of the well-ground combined distributed optical fiber sensing network, meanwhile, parameters such as temperature, strain or deformation, displacement, microseism events, groundwater level and groundwater component change and the like of the underground mining area are monitored in real time according to an armored monitoring optical cable which is arranged in the underground mining area and is buried underground and fixed on the top plate of the underground mining roadway, and a section where fracture and settlement of the top plate of the mining roadway are likely to happen is reinforced and processed in time, early warning information is issued, so that geological disasters and underground water source pollution are timely avoided.

title_en: Non-contact sleep monitoring system based on radio frequency sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact sleep monitoring system based on a radio frequency sensor. The system comprises a signal acquisition and acquisition module, a signal processing module and a signal processing module, wherein the signal acquisition and acquisition module is used for acquiring vital sign information of a user during sleep by using a biological radar, and performing signal processing on received echo signals containing vital signs to obtain vital sign signals under different distance gates; the multi-distance door fusion module is used for fusing vital sign signals under a plurality of distance doors; the feature extraction module is used for extracting feature parameters reflecting the sleep state from the fused signals; the data transmission module is used for transmitting the characteristic parameters to the cloud service platform; and the cloud analysis and prediction module is used for analyzing the characteristic parameters and evaluating the sleep quality. The method and the device can monitor the vital sign information of the user, and automatically classify the sleep stages through the cloud service platform according to the information, thereby being effective and feasible and having reliable performance.
assignees: NANJING HONGDING PERCEPTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent emergency marker light display system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent emergency marker lamp display system, wherein a language identification system, a temperature sensor and a smoke detector are electrically connected with an emergency lighting controller, the emergency lighting controller is electrically connected with an escape emergency lighting lamp and a life detection and positioning module, the life detection and positioning module and the escape emergency lighting lamp are electrically connected with the display system, the smoke detector detects fire smoke, meanwhile, the temperature sensor can monitor the temperature of a fire place in real time, so that the situation of false triggering of the fire is prevented, the voice identification system can identify the voice of a person in the case of the fire, then the emergency lighting controller can simultaneously receive a detection signal of the smoke detector, a detection signal of the temperature sensor and a disaster signal identified by the voice identification system, then the escape emergency lighting lamp is controlled to be lightened, meanwhile, the escape lamp is displayed in a matched animation mode through the display system, and the direction of the person far away from a fire source is reminded.

title_en: Non-contact heart rate detection system integrating millimeter wave radar and neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of radar signal processing and heartbeat detection, in particular to a non-contact heart rate detection system integrating a millimeter wave radar and a neural network. According to the invention, the average value cancellation technology in the radar and processing module is used for overcoming static clutter interference in the environment to improve the signal quality, the heart rate detection module fully utilizes the time sequence of the heart beat waveform, the introduction of a multi-head attention mechanism can more comprehensively understand the relation between phase signals to improve the accuracy of heart rate prediction, and meanwhile, the mixed neural network can be used for more effectively exploring local features and global features, so that the heart rate prediction system has better adaptability and higher robustness.

title_en: Ultra-wideband biological radar vital sign monitoring sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-wideband biological radar vital sign monitoring sensor, and relates to the technical field of medical equipment. This ultra wide band biological radar vital sign monitoring sensor, including biological radar sensor host computer, biological radar sensor host computer's lower fixed surface is connected with the fixed plate, the inside threaded connection of fixed plate has the screw rod, the output of screw rod rotates and is connected with first splint and second splint, biological radar sensor host computer's surface is provided with places the cover shell, place the surface fixedly connected with buffer and the solar panel of cover shell, place the lower fixed surface of cover shell and be connected with mobile device, place the top of cover shell and be provided with the upper cover, the upper fixed surface of upper cover is connected with first elastic plate and second elastic plate, place the bottom fixedly connected with battery of cover shell internal surface, cooperation between through each structure, make equipment can be used for different places, the practicality of equipment has been improved greatly, not only easy operation, but also the square portable outdoor use of taking.
assignees: SUZHOU RUIKEDA ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Management control system based on unmanned aerial vehicle rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a management control method based on unmanned aerial vehicle rescue, which comprises the following steps: step one: building a rescue mechanical group comprising a high-altitude search and rescue unmanned plane and a ground search and rescue crawler; step two: the unmanned aerial vehicle for high-altitude search and rescue utilizes multiple sensors to collect regional data and search vital signs in geological disasters; step three: the ground search and rescue crawler judges and selects a overcoming mode or a avoidance mode based on the detected obstacle; step four: the unmanned aerial vehicle for high-altitude search and rescue contacts with the ground search and rescue crawler by using the intelligent sensing system to perform combined search and rescue management control through the butt joint of the two search and rescue modes of flight and crawling; the invention discloses a rescue mechanical group comprising a high-altitude rescue unmanned plane and a ground rescue crawler, which is characterized in that the rescue mechanical group is butted with multiple rescue modes by using an intelligent sensing system to contact the ground rescue crawler to quickly reach a rescue place through the butt joint of two rescue modes, namely flying and crawling.

title_en: Vital sign data health analysis method and system based on wearable finger ring monitoring
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of health monitoring, and particularly relates to a vital sign data health analysis method and system based on wearable ring monitoring, which comprises a sensor module, a fall detection module, an alarm module, a GPS module, a wearable ring, an application terminal and a monitoring cloud platform, wherein the health data of a user are analyzed in real time, the health data of the user are synchronized to the application terminal in real time, under abnormal conditions, the position information of the user is synchronized in real time, a plurality of health indexes of the user can be monitored in real time, continuously and for a long time, the fall detection function is provided, and more importantly, when the abnormality occurs, the family members and medical personnel of the user receive the alarm information, the position of the user can be tracked in real time, emergency rescue or health guidance is provided for the user according to the situation, and the health monitoring management of the user forms a closed loop.
assignees: SHENZHEN KANGHENG MEDICAL GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Module cascade millimeter wave vital sign detection radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a module cascading millimeter wave vital sign detection radar, which comprises a power supply data board and a medium substrate, wherein an antenna array, a data processing chip and a peripheral circuit module are arranged on the medium substrate, the antenna array comprises a transmitting antenna area and a receiving antenna area, a plurality of transmitting antenna arrays are uniformly distributed in the transmitting antenna area at intervals, a plurality of receiving antenna arrays are uniformly distributed in the receiving antenna area at intervals, two sides of the receiving antenna area are respectively provided with an isolation virtual free area, and a plurality of isolation virtual free arrays are uniformly distributed in each isolation virtual free area at intervals; the data processing chip is connected with the transmitting antenna array and the receiving antenna array, and the isolation virtual array is grounded; the power supply data board is electrically connected with the medium substrate. The antenna array with high isolation and low side lobe performance is arranged, so that the information receiving and transmitting are not aliased, the radar performance is good, and the vital sign monitoring accuracy is improved.
assignees: TEACHING HOSPITAL CHENGDU UNIV TRADITIONAL CHINESE MEDICINE

title_en: Nuclear power plant operator's stress measurement system and method
title_ko: 원자력발전소 운전원의 스트레스 측정 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for measuring stress of a nuclear power plant operator. The system comprises a biosignal detection device having a heart rate measurement sensor and a skin electric resistance measurement sensor, and a server communicating with the biosignal detection device. A stress index calculation unit of the server calculates a stress index by comparing biometric information received from the biosignal detection device with pre-stored biometric information in a normal state. A determination unit derives state information of an operator as any one of a normal state, an attention observation state, and a dangerous state according to whether the calculated stress index exceeds a preset threshold value. A control unit generates alarm notification information when the derived state information is in a dangerous state. Therefore, the system can improve stress management efficiency of a nuclear power plant operator and can improve work satisfaction by adjusting a work load according to stress.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 원자력발전소 운전원의 스트레스 측정 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 심박수 측정 센서 및 피부전기저항 측정 센서를 구비하는 생체신호 감지장치; 및 상기 생체신호 감지장치와 통신하는 서버를 포함하고, 서버의 스트레스 지수 산출부가 생체신호 감지장치로부터 수신된 생체정보를 기 저장된 정상상태의 생체정보와 비교하여 스트레스 지수를 산출하고, 판단부가 상기 산출된 스트레스 지수의 기 설정된 임계값 초과여부에 따라 운전원의 상태정보를 정상상태, 주의관찰상태, 및 위험상태 중 어느 하나로 도출하고, 제어부가 상기 도출된 상태정보가 위험상태이면 경보알림정보를 생성하는 구성으로 원전 운전원의 스트레스 관리 효율성을 향상시킬 수 있고, 스트레스에 따른 업무 부하를 조절하여 업무 만족도를 향상시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Human body pose and physiological sign real-time monitoring and early warning system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human body pose and physiological sign real-time monitoring and early warning system based on a millimeter wave radar, which comprises the millimeter wave radar, a functional module and a data real-time monitoring and early warning module, wherein a signal output end of the millimeter wave radar is connected with a signal input end of the functional module, and a signal output end of the functional module is connected with a signal input end of the data real-time monitoring and early warning module; the functional module is configured to acquire signals of the millimeter wave radar, calculate physiological sign data through phase change based on the signals of the millimeter wave radar, acquire point cloud data based on the signals of the millimeter wave radar, and identify and detect the pose of the human body based on the point cloud data; the data real-time monitoring and early warning module is configured to process the pose and vital sign data of the human body, store the processed pose and vital sign data in the database, and perform visual display and accidental state early warning based on the processed data. The invention has the advantages of non-contact, all-weather, all-around, comprehensive functions, low cost and privacy protection.

title_en: System for vital sign monitoring and analysis for emergency with wireless radar sensor
title_ko: 비접촉 센서를 이용한 활력 징후 모니터링 및 위급 상황 분석 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a system for monitoring vital signs and analyzing an emergency situation using a non-contact sensor, which comprises: a main unit measuring vital signs, transmitting and receiving the measured data, and outputting the measured data through a sound and a display; a stretch arm unit provided to stretch an arm on one side of a robot-type body unit provided to be movable and adjustable; and a display unit displaying medical information of stored data. The present invention can provide the system capable of checking and predicting a health condition by measuring a cumulative state of a patient by proposing a sensing device located on the upper or upper end of a lying human body.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 가려지거나 시야 확보가 어려운 공간에서 사용자의 바이탈 사인을 확인하고, 활력징후 센싱과 정보제공용 모니터링을 위해 스트레치 암 끝단에 비접촉센서를 장착하여 활력징후 정보의 실시간 표시 및 위급 상황 분석 시스템에 관한 것으로, 스마트 헬스케어 시스템에 도입되어 위급 상황에서 다양한 정보와 대응 방법을 제공할 수 있다. 
본 발명에 따른 비접촉 센서를 이용한 활력 징후 모니터링 및 위급 상황 분석 시스템은,  활력 징후를 측정하고, 상기 측정된 데이터를 송수신하며, 소리 및 디스플레이로 출력하는 메인부; 이동이 가능하도록 마련된 로봇형의 바디부 일측에 암(arm)을 뻗을 수 있도록 마련된 스트레치암부; 및 저장된 데이터의 의료 정보를 표시하는 디스플레이부;로 구성하되, 상기 메인부는 활력 징후를 측정하는 센서부; 상기 측정된 활력 징후의 데이터를 송수신하는 통신부; 상기 측정된 활력 징후 데이터에서 기설정된 값을 벗어나는 경우 위급상황으로 인지하여 알림 소리로 출력하는 알림부; 상기 측정된 활력 징후 데이터에서 기설정된 값을 벗어나는 경우 위급상황으로 인지하여 디스플레이로 출력하는 표시부; 및 상기 메인부를 컨트롤하는 컨트롤부;로 구성되고, 상기 메인부가 스트레치암부의 말단에 장착되어 상기 활력 징후를 측정하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: SILLA UNIV INDUSTRY UNIV COOPERATION FOUNDATION;FUTURE ICT CO LTD

title_en: Smart safety device system based on thermal sensor
title_ko: 열상센서기반 스마트안전 디바이스 시스템
abstract_en: The smart safety device system includes: a thermal imaging sensor for detecting an object in a detection area requiring privacy protection; a vibration detection sensor for detecting the vibration level in the detection area; a respiration detection sensor for detecting a breathing pattern of an object when the object detected by the thermal imaging sensor is a person; a smart hub for relaying data between the thermal imaging sensor, the vibration detection sensor, and the respiration detection sensor and an analysis server; and an analysis server for receiving detection data of the vibration detection sensor, detection data of the respiration detection sensor, and images captured by the thermal imaging sensor, respectively, and detecting a set movement pattern of a preset object by applying a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithm to determine an emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 스마트안전 디바이스 시스템은, 사생활 보호가 필요한 감지영역에서 객체를 검출하기 위한 열상감지 센서와, 감지영역에서의 진동크기를 감지하는 진동감지센서와, 열상감지 센서에서 감지된 객체가 사람일 경우, 객체의 호흡패턴을 검출하는 호흡감지센서와, 열상감지 센서, 진동감지센서 및 호흡감지센서와 분석서버의 사이에서 데이터를 중계하는 스마트 허브와, 진동감지센서의 감지 데이터, 호흡감지센서의 감지 데이터 및 열상감지 센서에서 촬영된 영상을 각각 수신하고 컨벌루션 뉴럴 네트워크(Convolutional Neural Network, CNN) 알고리즘을 적용하여 미리 설정된 객체의 설정된 움직임 패턴을 검출하면서 위급상황을 판단하는 분석서버를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION OF KYUNGWOON UNIV

title_en: Portable radar life detection device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a portable radar life detection device, comprising: the radar detection device comprises a storage box, a mounting shell, a radar detection module and a display module. The containing box realizes the placement and protection of parts of the device in an unassembled state; the installation shell consists of a handshake, a telescopic machine and a rotary machine, and an assembly state is formed by threaded connection, so that the height adjustment of the device in a use state and the vertical rotary scanning function of the radar module are realized; the display module is used for guiding the direction of the user in the use state; the radar module is used for searching the life body in the use state. The device disclosed by the utility model is simply assembled when in use, and disassembled after the use, and is stored in the storage box, so that the problems of heavy weight, difficult transportation and complex operation of the conventional radar life detection device are solved.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar-based driver state point cloud detection method
abstract_en: The invention provides a driver state point cloud detection method based on millimeter wave radar, which relates to the technical field of millimeter wave radar, and comprises the steps of acquiring a target data matrix, wherein the target data matrix consists of target vital sign signals of a target driver, which are dynamically measured by a multi-transmission multi-reception MIMO-FMCW millimeter wave radar based on a preset measurement distance; determining a distance unit by combining the position of a target part and the radar distance resolution, performing Fourier transform on a target data matrix to obtain a target motion three-dimensional point cloud, analyzing and constructing a target space diagram, performing hidden space normal estimation between continuous frames on the target space diagram to obtain a target continuous frame point cloud, and performing state estimation on a target driver according to a target dense point cloud obtained by performing multi-frame fusion processing on the target continuous frame point cloud. The invention solves the technical problems that the traditional driver state monitoring method often depends on vision or sensor data, and has the defects of limited vision, large environmental interference, large difficulty in complex scene recognition and the like.

title_en: Underground obstacle crossing life detection vehicle and emergency rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an underground obstacle crossing life detection vehicle and an emergency rescue system, wherein the underground obstacle crossing life detection vehicle comprises a chassis, a traveling mechanism and a vehicle body, the traveling mechanism adopts a wheel and crawler combined structure with a deformation function, the top of the vehicle body is provided with a liftable image pickup element, the front end of the vehicle body is provided with an infrared detector, an audio life detection instrument and a radar life detection instrument, and a storage box for placing articles is arranged in the vehicle body.

title_en: Methods and systems for estimating vital signs of vehicle occupants using ultra wideband
abstract_en: Methods and systems for estimating vital signs of vehicle occupants using Ultra-Wideband communication. UWB signals are transmitted from one UWB system node to another UWB system node. Channel impulse responses (CIRs) associated with the UWB signals are determined. Based on the CIRs, in some embodiments velocities associated with the UWB signals are determined, and activities of vehicle occupants are classified based on the CIRs along with vital signs such as breathing rates. In other embodiments, based on the CIRs, phase unwrapping of phase features associated with the CIRs is performed, and principle component analysis (PCA) transforms the CIRs, allowing estimated vital signs such as breathing rates to be determined.

title_en: Human body existence detection device, computer equipment and storage medium based on radio frequency sensor in home environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human body existence detection device, computer equipment and storage medium based on a radio frequency sensor in a home environment, wherein the device comprises a signal acquisition and acquisition module, a detection module and a detection module, wherein the signal acquisition and acquisition module is used for utilizing a vital sign monitoring radar to acquire radar echo signals of a tester in real time, and performing signal processing on the received echo signals containing vital signs to obtain distance gate quadrature I/Q signals; the signal preprocessing module is used for preprocessing the acquired signals, selecting a range gate, and demodulating the selected signals to obtain vital sign signals; the body movement detection module is used for processing the vital sign signals to obtain body movement information and detecting and judging the movement state target; the breath detection module is used for extracting breath information in vital sign signals and detecting and judging a static state target; and the feature extraction and verification module is used for extracting and classifying the features of the input signals and detecting and judging the transition state targets. The invention can monitor whether human bodies exist in the home environment in real time, and is effective and feasible and reliable in performance.
assignees: NANJING HONGDING PERCEPTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Heart rate and respiratory rate millimeter wave radar detection method based on CNN fusion characteristics
abstract_en: The invention provides a heart rate and respiration rate millimeter wave radar detection method based on CNN fusion characteristics, which comprises the steps of obtaining a one-dimensional radar signal of a target person in real time, wherein the one-dimensional radar signal is obtained by monitoring vital signs of the target person through a millimeter wave radar sensor, carrying out time-frequency analysis based on the one-dimensional radar signal to obtain a two-dimensional time-frequency signal, carrying out human heart rate and respiration rate detection on the target person based on the one-dimensional radar signal and the two-dimensional time-frequency signal to obtain the heart rate and respiration rate of the target person, overcoming the problems of inconvenience and discomfort caused by long-term monitoring and limitation of application of the traditional contact detection method, realizing comprehensive and accurate detection of the heart rate and the respiration rate of the human body through a non-invasive monitoring means, being particularly beneficial to old people, chronic disease patients and individuals needing long-term rehabilitation monitoring, and providing support for home medical treatment and remote health monitoring.

title_en: Muzzle device for health care
title_ko: 건강관리용 입마개 디바이스
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a muzzle device for health care. The muzzle device for health care comprises: a muzzle member provided to cover a face portion including the nose and mouth of a target animal; a binding member connected to a rear end of the muzzle member to bind the muzzle member to the face portion; a vital sensor unit provided in one area of the muzzle member to measure vital sign information of the target animal; and a device controller unit performing health risk analysis of the target animal based on the vital sign information measured by the vital sensor unit, generating risk alarm information when a health risk signal is detected as a result of the analysis, and transmitting the risk alarm information to a user terminal pre-registered in a storage unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건강관리용 입마개 디바이스에 관한 것이며, 건강관리용 입마개 디바이스는, 대상 동물의 코와 입을 포함한 안면부를 가리도록 마련되는 입마개 부재; 상기 입마개 부재를 상기 안면부에 결속시키기 위해 상기 입마개 부재의 후측단과 연결되는 결속 부재; 상기 입마개 부재의 일영역에 마련되어 상기 대상 동물의 바이탈 사인 정보를 측정하는 바이탈 센서부; 및 상기 바이탈 센서부에서 측정된 바이탈 사인 정보를 기반으로 상기 대상 동물의 건강 위험도 분석을 수행하고, 분석 결과 건강 위험 신호가 감지된 경우 위험 알람 정보를 생성하여 저장부에 기 등록된 사용자 단말로 전송하는 디바이스 컨트롤러부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Untact sleep apnea detection system
title_ko: 언택트 수면 무호흡 감지 시스템
abstract_en: According to the present invention, an untact sleep apnea detection system comprises: a non-contact respiration measurement sensor installed in a lower portion of a bed to detect respiration of a user; and a respiration determination unit classifying measurement data of the non-contact respiration measurement sensor into respiration, apnea, and movement by using a pre-learned deep learning model.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 언택트 수면 무호흡 감지 시스템은 침대 하부에 설치되어 사용자의 호흡을 감지하는 비접촉 호흡측정센서와, 비접촉 호흡측정센서의 측정 데이터를 미리 학습된 딥러닝 모델을 이용하여 호흡, 무호흡, 움직임으로 분류하는 호흡 판별부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KUMOH NAT INST TECHNOLOGY IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Wearable device for monitoring body water, electronic device, and operation method therefor
title_ko: 체수분 변화를 모니터링하는 웨어러블 장치, 전자 장치 및 그의 동작 방법
abstract_en: A wearable device according to an embodiment of the present disclosure may comprise: a communication circuit set to transmit or receive data or signals to or from an external electronic device; an output module; an electrical sensor that measures a first biological signal related to electrical properties; an optical sensor that measures a second biological signal related to optical properties; a temperature sensor that measures the temperature of skin; and at least one processor operatively connected to the communication circuit, the output module, the electrical sensor, the optical sensor, and the temperature sensor. The at least one processor may be configured to: acquire the first biological signal, the second biological signal, and a third biological signal related to the temperature from the electrical sensor, the optical sensor, and the temperature sensor, respectively; transmit first data related to the acquired first biological signal, second data related to the acquired second biological signal, and third data related to the third biological signal to the external electronic device via the communication circuit; receive data related to body water changes in the body from the external electronic device via the communication circuit, the body water changes being calculated on the basis of changes in the first data and the second data respectively corrected using the third data; and output feedback related to the body water changes to the output module on the basis of the received data related to body water changes.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 일 실시예에 따른 웨어러블 장치는, 외부 전자 장치와 데이터 또는 신호를 송신하거나 또는 수신하도록 설정된 통신 회로, 출력 모듈, 전기적 특성과 관련한 제1 생체 신호를 측정하는 전기 센서, 광학적 특성과 관련한 제2 생체 신호를 측정하는 광학 센서, 피부의 온도를 측정하는 온도 센서, 및 상기 통신 회로, 상기 출력 모듈, 상기 전기 센서, 상기 광학 센서 및 상기 온도 센서와 동작적으로 연결된 적어도 하나 이상의 프로세서를 포함할 수 있다. 상기 적어도 하나 이상의 프로세서는, 상기 전기 센서, 상기 광학 센서 및 상기 온도 센서로부터, 상기 제1 생체 신호, 상기 제2 생체 신호, 및 상기 온도와 관련한 제3 생체 신호를 각각 획득하고, 상기 통신 회로를 통하여, 상기 획득한 제1 생체 신호와 관련한 제1 데이터, 상기 획득한 제2 생체 신호와 관련한 제2 데이터, 및 상기 제3 생체 신호와 관련한 제3 데이터를 상기 외부 전자 장치로 전송하고, 상기 통신 회로를 통하여, 상기 제3 데이터에 의해 각각 보정된 상기 제1 데이터 및 상기 제2 데이터의 변화에 기반하여 산출된 신체의 체수분 변화에 관련한 데이터를 상기 외부 전자 장치로부터 수신하고, 상기 수신한 체수분 변화에 관련한 데이터에 기반하여, 상기 출력 모듈에 상기 체수분 변화에 관련한 피드백을 출력하도록 설정될 수 있다.

title_en: 4D heart positioning system and method based on MIMO frequency modulation continuous wave millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a 4D heart positioning system and method based on MIMO frequency modulation continuous wave millimeter wave radar, and belongs to the technical field of radar detection. The system comprises an upper computer, a radio frequency module and a baseband module. The method of the invention detects the vital sign signals of the human body through the system, acquires the phase information of each channel under the condition of highly suppressing the interference signals by using the FMCW radar time domain anti-interference phase information extraction method, and then carries out MIMO heart beam forming and heart signal quality modeling evaluation so as to determine the position of the heart of the human body. The invention has the characteristics of wide applicability and high detection accuracy, can complete the positioning of the heart position of the human body without additional mechanical devices through a single radar, and can detect the vital sign parameters of the human body in a home vital sign monitoring scene more accurately.

title_en: Intelligent super-surface-assisted non-line-of-sight human vital sign sensing system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent super-surface-assisted non-line-of-sight human vital sign sensing system and method, which are characterized in that a deep learning model Yolo-v7 is combined to position a human body target, and the propagation path of a sensing signal is changed through intelligent super-surface coding optimization, so that human vital sign sensing under a non-line-of-sight scene is realized. Aiming at the limitation of the traditional variational modal decomposition algorithm in human vital sign perception, the invention further provides an improved variational modal decomposition algorithm based on filtering, which is used for extracting human respiration and heartbeat echo signals and realizing accurate estimation of respiration rate and heart rate. The invention is different from the human body sensing technology based on the through-wall radar, and utilizes the flexible regulation and control capability of the electromagnetic wave of the super surface to change the propagation path of the sensing signal, thereby customizing the sensing environment between the wireless signal transceivers, opening up a new application environment and scene for the non-contact vital sign sensing based on the wireless signal, thereby improving the universality of the vital sign wireless sensing technology and promoting the further development and landing of the vital sign wireless sensing technology.

title_en: Earthquake monitor
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure disclose a seismic monitor. This earthquake monitor includes that the earthquake monitor includes power DC, computer control computer display terminal and a plurality of position sensing subassembly, and a plurality of position sensing subassembly are placed respectively in different positions, and sensing subassembly is connected and power DC connects with computer control computer display terminal, and sensing subassembly includes: receiving sensor LMIC, resistor R1, resistor R2, integrated chip IC1, capacitor C2. The implementation mode adopts the infrasound and electromagnetic synchronous receiving principle and the chip processing technology to monitor the earthquake infrasound and electromagnetic wave signals, so that the seismograph is not required to be buried underground, is not limited by high floors, does not need to set points for scanning and receiving the earthquake waves in any direction, reduces the waste of manpower, material resources and resources, is a comprehensive instrument, monitors the earthquake display technology in advance in the whole world, solves the unpredictable problem of earthquake, predicts and monitors the earthquake in advance, and achieves the aims of earthquake prevention and disaster reduction.
assignees: BEIJING WEIDIAN YUNXIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Through-wall radar grating lobe suppression method based on phase non-uniform quantization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar grating lobe suppression method based on phase non-uniform quantization, which comprises the steps of firstly calculating the phase of radar imaging at grating lobe or side lobe positions; and then, aiming at radar receiving signals, calculating imaging results of all channels and radar original imaging results by using a back projection algorithm, and quantifying the phases of all channels by means of the phases of grating lobes or side lobe positions according to the operation results. And then calculating standard deviation of phase quantization results of different channels at the same pixel point position, thereby forming a weight image. And finally, weighting the radar original imaging result to obtain radar images after grating lobes and side lobe suppression. The effectiveness and the robustness to noise of the disclosed method are proved through a plurality of simulation and actual measurement embodiments. The method is not only suitable for the field of through-wall radar imaging detection, but also can be applied to the fields of synthetic aperture radar imaging, microwave imaging and the like, and is a universal image grating lobe and sidelobe suppression method.

title_en: Through-wall radar grating lobe suppression method based on imaginary symbol coherence factor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wall-penetrating radar grating lobe inhibition method based on imaginary symbol coherence factors, which comprises the following steps of, the phases of a centrally symmetrically arranged MIMO array at grating lobe positions are derived and demonstrated to be symmetrical. Based on this conclusion, the imaginary positive and negative of the imaging results for each channel are then quantified. Finally, weights are calculated based on the quantized results and the original image is weighted to suppress grating lobes and side lobes. The effectiveness of the disclosed method is demonstrated by a plurality of simulated and actually measured embodiments. The method is not only suitable for the field of through-wall radar imaging detection, but also can be applied to the fields of synthetic aperture radar imaging, microwave imaging and the like, and is a universal image grating lobe and sidelobe suppression method.

title_en: Method for repositioning moving targets in building based on unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted double-channel through-wall radar interference phase
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for repositioning a moving target in a building based on an unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted double-channel through-wall radar interference phase, which comprises the step of providing a novel method for repositioning the azimuth of the moving target based on the double-channel interference phase. The method firstly extracts the two-channel interference phase of the moving target in a distance compression domain. And secondly, establishing an interference phase polynomial model, and calculating coefficients of each order by using a least square method. Finally, the obtained polynomial coefficients are used for constructing and solving an optimization problem about the azimuth position of the moving target. In contrast to conventional methods, the present invention does not require imaging and multi-channel registration operations. In addition, the method provided by the invention can directly obtain the azimuth position of the moving target without estimating the radial speed and calculating the offset, thereby avoiding the problem of space Doppler ambiguity of the radial speed estimation faced by the traditional synthetic aperture radar moving target positioning technology. The validity of the proposed method is verified through simulation.

title_en: Deterministic method for non-contact vital signs monitoring via multiple radar signals and related monitoring system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the estimation of vital signs of living beings, human or animal, through radar signals of different types both in terms of the signals and the devices used for the transmission and reception of such signals. In particular, a new algorithm is developed for the real-time estimation of the heart rate optionally in combination with the respiratory rate and further capable of detecting apnea if desired. It employs a selection combining technique and a filtering method with memory which, in one embodiment, is inspired by the principles of Bayesian filtering applied to radar signals reflected from the body of the monitored living being. The invention also relates to the system and software implementing such method.
assignees: UNIV DEGLI STUDI DI MODENA E REGGIO EMILIA

title_en: Emergency exit guide device for firefighting using electric device of building
title_ko: 건축물의 전기장치를 이용한 소방용 비상구 유도장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency exit guide device for firefighting using an electric device of a building, which is buried to expose one surface to a side wall or a ceiling to indicate an emergency exit direction by LED lighting and accurately and stably perform the direction indication to an escapeable emergency exit in an emergency such as a fire. The emergency exit guide device for firefighting comprises a main installation box (10), a direction indication panel (20), a control box (30), a panel drive motor (40), a ventilation means (50), a power supply unit (60), and a controller (70).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건축물의 전기장치를 이용한 소방용 비상구 유도장치에 관한 것으로서, 벽면(W)에서 사람의 눈높이 또는 천정면의 폭 중간에 소정의 깊이가 요입되도록 하면서 실내측으로는 개방되게 형성한 설치홈(T)에 맞춤 삽입되도록 하는 메인 설치함(10); 상기 메인 설치함(10)의 개방된 일측면에 접하는 길이 방향의 상호 마주하는 상하부면 또는 양측면의 길이 중간에 길이 중간 부위가 회전 가능하게 축지지되도록 하며, 개방된 일측면으로는 복수의 엘이디들의 배열로 이루어지는 표시부(21)를 형성하는 방향 지시패널(20); 상기 메인 설치함(10)과 동일 수직선상의 상측 벽면(W)에 소정의 깊이로 요입되도록 하는 박스홈(BT)에 맞춤 삽입되도록 하면서 실내측으로 개방된 일측면은 도어(31)에 의해 개폐되도록 하는 콘트롤 박스(30); 상기 콘트롤 박스(30)의 내부에서 상기 방향 지시패널(20)의 길이 중간과 동일 수직선상에 축고정되도록 하여 상기 방향 지시패널(20)을 소정의 각도로 회전시키도록 하는 패널 구동모터(40); 상기 메인 설치함(10)의 개방된 단면에 대응되는 벽체측 판면(W)에 형성되는 휀(51)과 그릴(52)을 통해 외부로부터 외기가 소정의 압력으로 유입되도록 하여 화재 시 발생되는 연기를 희석시키거나 실내에 신선한 공기가 유입되도록 하는 환기 수단(50); 상기 콘트롤 박스(30)의 내부에서 상기 패널 구동모터(40)의 일측에 구비되어 상기 패널 구동모터(40)와 상기 방향 지시패널(20) 및 휀(51)에 전원이 공급되도록 하는 동시에 필요한 양의 전원이 충전되도록 하는 전원 공급 수단(60); 상기 콘트롤 박스(30)의 내부에서 상기 전원 공급 수단(60)과 반대측에 형성되어 화재 발생 시 화재 감지 센서로부터 감지되는 신호에 의해 화재 발생 위치를 체크하여 상기 방향 지시패널(20)을 설정한 각도로 회전시켜 대피할 방향으로 방향 지시패널(20)의 일부가 상기 메인 설치함(10)으로부터 돌출되도록 하여 표시부(21)에 표시되는 화살표에 의해 비상구를 찾아 대피할 수 있도록 하는 콘트롤러(70)의 결합으로 이루어진다.

title_en: Wearable device, electronic device and operation method thereof for monitoring body water change
title_ko: 체수분 변화를 모니터링하는 웨어러블 장치, 전자 장치 및 그의 동작 방법
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a wearable device for monitoring a change in body water, an electronic device, and an operating method thereof. The wearable device (200; 101) includes: a communication circuit (220; 190) configured to transmit or receive data or a signal to or from an external electronic device (E); an output module (260); an electrical sensor (230) configured to measure a first bio-signal related to electrical characteristics; an optical sensor (240) configured to measure a second bio-signal related to optical characteristics; a temperature sensor (250) configured to measure the temperature of skin; and at least one processor (210; 120) operatively connected to the communication circuit (220; 190), the output module (260), the electrical sensor (230), the optical sensor (240), and the temperature sensor (250).
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 일 실시예에 따른 웨어러블 장치는, 외부 전자 장치와 데이터 또는 신호를 송신하거나 또는 수신하도록 설정된 통신 회로, 출력 모듈, 전기적 특성과 관련한 제1 생체 신호를 측정하는 전기 센서, 광학적 특성과 관련한 제2 생체 신호를 측정하는 광학 센서, 피부의 온도를 측정하는 온도 센서, 및 상기 통신 회로, 상기 출력 모듈, 상기 전기 센서, 상기 광학 센서 및 상기 온도 센서와 동작적으로 연결된 적어도 하나 이상의 프로세서를 포함할 수 있다. 상기 적어도 하나 이상의 프로세서는, 상기 전기 센서, 상기 광학 센서 및 상기 온도 센서로부터, 상기 제1 생체 신호, 상기 제2 생체 신호, 및 상기 온도와 관련한 제3 생체 신호를 각각 획득하고, 상기 통신 회로를 통하여, 상기 획득한 제1 생체 신호와 관련한 제1 데이터, 상기 획득한 제2 생체 신호와 관련한 제2 데이터, 및 상기 제3 생체 신호와 관련한 제3 데이터를 상기 외부 전자 장치로 전송하고, 상기 통신 회로를 통하여, 상기 제3 데이터에 의해 각각 보정된 상기 제1 데이터 및 상기 제2 데이터의 변화에 기반하여 산출된 신체의 체수분 변화에 관련한 데이터를 상기 외부 전자 장치로부터 수신하고, 상기 수신한 체수분 변화에 관련한 데이터에 기반하여, 상기 출력 모듈에 상기 체수분 변화에 관련한 피드백을 출력하도록 설정될 수 있다.

title_en: Device and method for simulating mud bursting and sand bursting under high pressure and with adjustable mining crack width
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of burst sand disaster prevention and control, and particularly relates to a burst sand simulation device and method with adjustable mining crack width under high pressure. The simulation device includes: a cement sand material source cabin; the adjustable crack die at least comprises two crack plates which are oppositely arranged, the distance between the two crack plates is adjustable, and the mining cracks with different widths are simulated by adjusting the gap between the two crack plates; the cement sand material source cabin is positioned above the adjustable crack die, and the cement sand material source cabin is communicated with the adjustable crack die; the air pump is communicated with the cement sand source cabin through a pipeline; the data acquisition system at least comprises a plurality of water pressure sensors. The simulation device has a more practical accurate simulation result, and is favorable for providing more reliable basis for construction of a thick bedrock deep buried coal seam mining mud bursting disaster prevention and control technology system.

title_en: TER radar detection transceiver for urban underground buried pipeline detection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a TER radar detection transceiver for urban underground buried pipeline detection, which comprises a constant voltage clamping module and a bracket; the constant voltage clamping module is simultaneously connected between the transmitting control module and the transmitting coil and between the receiving control module and the receiving coil, and is used for performing constant voltage control on the transmitting signal and clamping control on the receiving induction signal; the support is frame-shaped, the bottom is equipped with the universal wheel, and the side direction is equipped with the layer board, transmitting coil and receiving coil all wind into annular and place on the layer board, and constant voltage clamp module, emission control module, receiving control module, data and instruction interface are all installed on the support. The utility model is stable and firm in structure and convenient to install, improves the detection precision and efficiency, increases the constant voltage clamp module in composition, improves the detection stability and reliability, is suitable for urban underground pipeline detection engineering, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Biological magnetic field signal self-adaptive adjustment system based on giant magneto-resistance sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a biological magnetic field signal self-adaptive adjustment system based on a giant magneto-resistance sensor, which comprises an external programmable magnet module and a programmable external magnetic field, wherein the external programmable magnet module is composed of a permanent magnet and an electromagnet; the analog front-end module collects a biological induction magnetic field generated by an external programmable magnet module and charged particles in blood vessels by using a giant magneto-resistance sensor, and processes the collected signals through an amplifier and a filter; the digital back-end module simulates the biological induction magnetic field processed by the front-end module to carry out self-adaptive adjustment on the external programmable magnet module through peak-to-peak average ratio, and carries out vital sign detection on the biological induction magnetic field obtained after electromagnetic field adjustment. The invention combines the permanent magnet and the electromagnet to avoid the limitation under the interference of external environment, and the problem that the permanent magnet alone cannot be self-adaptively used for detecting individuals and external environment is solved by detecting the IBF magnetic field signal in real time and then self-adaptively adjusting the magnetic field of the electromagnet.

title_en: FMCW radar vital signal detection method based on ESOA-VMD algorithm and fuzzy logic reasoning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a FMCW radar vital signal detection method based on ESOA-VMD algorithm and fuzzy logic reasoning, comprising the following steps: s1: preprocessing an FMCW radar echo signal to extract a plurality of phase signals with vital signs in the echo signal; s2: extracting phase signals with vital signs in the echo signals in a reference range, and respectively processing the phase signals to obtain a plurality of corresponding modal components; s3: and screening out the modal components corresponding to the respiratory signal and the modal components corresponding to the heartbeat signal from the modal components to obtain the respiratory modal components and the heartbeat modal components, thereby obtaining the respiratory signal and the heartbeat signal. The method realizes the detection of the vital sign signals, overcomes the inconvenience of contact detection, reduces the interference of respiratory harmonics and intermodulation waves on heartbeat signals, and effectively improves the accuracy of the extraction of the vital sign signals.
assignees: SHENZHEN LIANRUI MAITE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Animal vital sign monitoring devices under different states
abstract_en: The disclosure provides an animal vital sign monitoring device under different states, belongs to the technical field of vital sign monitoring. This animal vital sign monitoring device under different states includes: the biological radar module is used for acquiring physical sign data of the target animal based on radar signals; the state identification module is used for identifying the target state of the target animal according to the sign data; the data processing module is used for obtaining the sign information of the target animal based on the sign data and the target state; and the environmental parameter adjusting module is used for adjusting the environmental parameters of the target animal based on the sign information. The problem that traditional animal vital sign monitoring accuracy is poor can be solved to this disclosure.

title_en: Non-contact detection system and method for soil moisture content based on antenna sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a non-contact detection system and method for the moisture content of soil based on an antenna sensor, and belongs to the technical field of soil property measurement. Comprises 5 steps: step S1, selecting proper antenna sensor frequency and ground penetrating radar center frequency according to the detected water content range and depth of the soil body; step S2, detecting the frequency spectrum response of an antenna sensor in the air by adopting a ground penetrating radar to obtain a minimum value f  a  of a frequency spectrum signal; step S3, detecting the frequency spectrum response of an antenna sensor buried in the stratum by adopting a ground penetrating radar to obtain a frequency spectrum signal minimum f  d ; s4, calculating the dielectric constant of the stratum to be tested according to a formula epsilon  r =(f a /f d ) 2 ; and S5, calculating the water content of the stratum to be tested by adopting a Topp formula. The method has the advantage of non-contact detection of the water content, and reduces the difficulty of signal processing on the basis of the traditional ground penetrating radar-based water content detection method.

title_en: Ground penetrating radar inversion method, device, equipment and medium based on semantic segmentation
abstract_en: The application discloses a ground penetrating radar inversion method, device, equipment and medium based on semantic segmentation. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring initial simulation image data of forward modeling of a ground penetrating radar scatterer, and preprocessing the initial simulation image data to obtain optimized simulation image data; constructing a ground penetrating radar scatterer inversion model based on semantic segmentation; inputting the optimized simulation image data into a ground penetrating radar scatterer inversion model based on semantic segmentation to obtain a predicted scatterer dielectric constant and a predicted scatterer mask; and obtaining the dielectric constant of the real scatterer and the real scatterer mask, calculating the difference between the dielectric constant of the predicted scatterer and the dielectric constant of the real scatterer and the difference between the predicted scatterer mask and the real scatterer mask through a preset loss function and a preset evaluation index, and training a ground penetrating radar scatterer inversion model based on semantic segmentation. According to the application, the interpretation precision and efficiency of the underground buried scatterer are improved by constructing the inversion model of the ground penetrating radar scatterer based on semantic segmentation.
assignees: XINJIANG HUIER ZHILIAN TECH CO LTD;UNIV XINJIANG AGRICULTURAL

title_en: FMCW radar non-contact vital sign extraction method based on MFO-SVMD algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to an FMCW radar non-contact vital sign extraction method based on an MFO-SVMD algorithm, which comprises the following steps: s1: an FMCW radar is arranged, a transmitting antenna continuously transmits continuous wave signals with continuously variable frequencies, and a receiving antenna receives echo signals reflected by a human body; s2: after receiving the echo signal, preprocessing the echo signal to obtain a phase differential signal containing vital sign information; s3: performing MFO-SVMD decomposition on the obtained phase difference signal to obtain a plurality of modal components including respiratory heartbeat signal components; s4: and calculating the variance contribution rate of each modal component obtained by decomposition, and carrying out signal screening according to the variance contribution rate of the respiratory heartbeat signal, so as to obtain the required respiratory and heartbeat signals. The method has the advantages of high precision and good real-time performance, overcomes the limitation that the traditional vital sign instrument needs to be worn, avoids the risk of cross infection, and has wider applicability.
assignees: SHENZHEN LIANRUI MAITE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-purpose infant health status monitoring device and multi-purpose infant health status monitoring system including the same
title_ko: 다용도 영유아 건강 상태 모니터링 장치 및 이를 포함하는 다용도 영유아 건강 상태 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: According to one aspect of an embodiment of the present invention, a multipurpose infant and toddler health state monitoring device may be provided comprising: a head part having a grip part gripped by a hand formed on one surface, and having a contact part having a central groove concaved inward or an edge groove formed on an edge to be coupled to a nipple part so that the other surface is in direct contact with the body to measure a bio-signal; a sensor part provided on the head part to measure the bio-signal of an infant and toddler playing; and a control part for determining a health state of the infant and toddler based on the measured bio-signal. According to thereof, a health state of the infant and toddler may be determined through a multi-channel comprising body temperature, pulse wave, oxygen saturation, electrical conductivity of the skin, and pressure, and the health state of the infant and toddler may be transmitted to an external device to be monitored.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예의 일 측면에 따르면, 일면은 손에 파지되는 파지부가 형성되고, 타면은 신체에 직접 접촉되어 생체 신호를 측정하거나, 젖꼭지부에 결합할 수 있도록 내측으로 오목한 중앙 홈 또는 가장자리에 테두리 홈이 형성되는 접촉부가 형성되는 헤드부; 상기 헤드부에 마련되어 놀이 중인 영유아의 생체 신호를 측정하는 센서부; 및 상기 측정된 생체 신호에 기초하여 영유아의 건강 상태를 판단하는 제어부를 포함하는, 다용도 영유아 건강 상태 모니터링 장치를 제공할 수 있다. 이에 따라, 체온, 맥파, 산소 포화도, 피부의 전기전도도 및 압력을 포함하는 멀티 채널을 통해 영유아의 건강 상태를 판단하고, 영유아의 건강 상태를 외부 장치에 전달하여 모니터링할 수 있다.

title_en: Radar detection device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a radar detection device and a radar detection method. The radar detection apparatus may include a radar apparatus and a signal processing apparatus. The radar apparatus includes a plurality of antennas to transmit or receive radar signals. The signal processing device is coupled to the radar device and determines whether a target object is in a first area of a detection area or in a second area of the detection area according to the radar signal received by the radar device, so as to determine whether to perform an activity detection or a vital sign detection on the target object.

title_en: Portable vital sign contactless detection system
abstract_en: The invention provides a portable vital sign contactless detection system, comprising: portable monitoring devices and central monitoring systems. The portable monitoring device integrates an infrared thermal imaging sensor, a microwave radar module, a built-in battery, a wireless communication module and a man-machine interaction interface. The central monitoring system adopts an intelligent analysis algorithm to analyze the received monitoring data in real time, and the alarm prompt is triggered immediately once the abnormal situation is found. The system can also interface with a hospital information system to incorporate monitoring data into the electronic medical record. In addition, the invention also comprises a vital sign monitoring device which can be fixedly arranged in the ward, so as to realize continuous automatic monitoring of patients. The invention fully utilizes the advanced technologies such as infrared thermal imaging, microwave radar and the like, realizes the high-efficiency and accurate non-contact monitoring of vital signs of patients, greatly improves the efficiency and flexibility of medical monitoring, and provides powerful support for intelligent medical application.
assignees: SHANGHAI EAST HOSPITAL TONGJI UNIV AFFILIATED EAST HOSPITAL

title_en: Detection method and positioning method for weak human body vital signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection method of weak human body life signals, which comprises the steps of adopting an ultra-wideband radar to transmit high-frequency high-repetition frequency sub-pulse signals to a target area and receiving sub-pulse echo signals; signal preprocessing is carried out on the sub-pulse echo signals; performing fast Fourier transform on the preprocessed signals to obtain frequency spectrums of sub-pulse signals; filtering and selecting the frequency spectrum of the sub-pulse signal to obtain a target frequency; and judging the target frequency to finish the detection of the weak human body vital signals. The invention also discloses a positioning method comprising the detection method of the weak human body vital signals. The invention is based on the repetition frequency, frequency agility and corresponding signal processing scheme, and improves the detection and positioning capability of the radar on weak human body vital signals after medium while reducing the coherent accumulation time; therefore, the invention not only can realize the detection and positioning of weak human body vital signals, but also has higher reliability and better accuracy.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring method and system based on edge calculation and millimeter wave band
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vital sign monitoring and discloses a vital sign monitoring method and system based on edge calculation and millimeter wave bands. The vital sign monitoring method specifically comprises the following steps: s101: sending an acquisition instruction to the millimeter wave radar, and acquiring a real-time target displacement signal and a reference target displacement signal when a human body holds breath in the same time period; s102: and acquiring a real-time target displacement signal, uploading the real-time target displacement signal to an edge computing system, defining an edge computing model for the received content by the edge computing system, and comparing the computing model with the real-time target displacement signal to separate out a real-time respiratory signal. The invention carries out non-contact measurement on key vital signs such as respiratory signals, heartbeat signals and the like of a real-time target, has small error fluctuation, simultaneously carries out conveying and definition comparison based on edge calculation and millimeter wave bands, has high measurement precision, and efficiently realizes rapid processing of data by the edge calculation and monitoring of vital signs by the millimeter wave bands.

title_en: FMCW radar human vital sign detection method based on CEEMDAN combined wavelet threshold
abstract_en: A FMCW radar human vital sign detection method based on CEEMDAN united wavelet threshold is characterized by constructing a millimeter wave radar experiment system, wherein a human body is positioned in front of the radar, and intermediate frequency signals of human body echoes are collected; data preprocessing is carried out on the received intermediate frequency signals, and the influence of noise is reduced through distance dimension FFT and incoherent accumulation, so that the distance between the chest of the human body and the radar is determined; recovering the phase of the vital sign signal from the incoherently accumulated FFT result by using the linear characteristic of arctangent demodulation, and performing phase unwrapping and phase difference to obtain optimized phase information; the processed phase signals are combined with a wavelet threshold method through CEEMDAN algorithm, decomposed into IMF components, and heartbeat and respiratory signals are reconstructed; and carrying out FFT (fast Fourier transform) on the obtained heartbeat and respiration signals to estimate the heart rate and the respiration rate. The invention remarkably reduces the parameter quantity and the calculated quantity while maintaining higher detection precision.

title_en: Buried pipeline stress strain monitoring system based on LoRa communication and vibrating wire sensing
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a buried pipeline stress-strain monitoring system based on LoRa communication and vibrating wire sensing, wherein data acquisition units are arranged on a buried pipeline at intervals, each data acquisition unit is respectively provided with a data processing unit, the data processing units concentrate acquired data to a LoRa gateway through a LoRa communication module, and the LoRa gateway uniformly uploads all acquired data to a data center; the data acquisition unit comprises a vibrating wire type sensor stuck to the outer surface of the buried pipeline, and the data processing unit comprises a processor and a LoRa communication module. Each data acquisition unit comprises four vibrating wire sensors for respectively monitoring the axial, radial and oblique stress changes of the buried pipe. The utility model combines the vibrating wire type strain sensing monitoring technology and the LoRa communication technology to solve the engineering technical problem of stress strain monitoring of special pipe sections with frequent natural disasters such as goaf, geological settlement, landslide and the like of long-distance natural gas pipelines.
assignees: HENAN HUIRONG OIL AND GAS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Radar system for locating pipes buried in the ground and for detecting underground leaks of liquid, in particular water, with a square waveguide antenna for emitting orthogonally polarised signals of the same frequency
abstract_en: The invention relates to a radar system for locating pipes buried in the ground and for detecting underground leaks of liquid, in particular water, with a square waveguide antenna for emitting orthogonally polarised signals of the same frequency. The invention essentially consists of a radar system (1) with an antenna (4) that can emit waves at a nominal frequency towards the ground in two polarisations that are distinct and orthogonal to one another, and that incorporates a measuring element (5) configured to measure the polarimetric ratio of the signals received in the two polarisations, in order to deduce from the imbalance between the two received signals the presence of a pipe buried in the ground, and, where appropriate, the presence of leaks of liquid, in particular water.

title_en: Vital signs beacon system
abstract_en: Monitoring and action related to an end user's sleep activity may be provided by a system, device, and associated methods to monitor an end user's heart activity. A ballistocardiograph (BCG) signal may be detected by a physiological sensor that is not in contact with the end user. The BCG signal may be used to determine one of a plurality of sleep related statuses and health. Reports, alerts, and control of local electronic devices may be performed by a remote computer server and analysis engine that process the BCG signal.

title_en: Concurrent monitoring of indoor oxygen concentration levels and human vital signs with mmWave radar sensors
abstract_en: Technologies directed to are concurrent monitoring indoor oxygen-deficiency and human vital signs with mmWave radars described. One method sends a first signal having a first chirp having a triangular shape and a second chirp having a ramp shape. A frequency of the first signal is in a millimeter wave (mmWave) frequency range. The method receives a second signal corresponding to the first signal, the second signal comprising a first portion corresponding to the first chirp and a second portion corresponding to the second chirp. The method generates a third signal indicative of a human vital sign using the first chirp and the first portion. The method measures a value indicative of oxygen-deficiency in air using the second chirp and the second portion.

title_en: Vital sign detection signal denoising method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for denoising vital sign detection signals, which relate to the technical field of physiological sensing and signal processing and comprise the steps of acquiring an original phase signal containing physiological signals based on the Doppler technology of millimeter wave radar; the method comprises the steps of carrying out variational mode decomposition on an original phase signal based on a variational mode decomposition super-parameter search algorithm optimized by a particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain vibration mode function information corresponding to the original phase signal, carrying out denoising treatment on the vibration mode function by using a substitution entropy and a fuzzy entropy as fitness functions, recombining the vibration mode function after denoising treatment to obtain a physiological signal after high-precision denoising treatment, and extracting respiratory and heartbeat physiological signals from the physiological signal after high-precision denoising treatment.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar baseband module and system for multi-target vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar baseband module and a system for multi-target vital sign monitoring, wherein the radar baseband module comprises a time domain processing sub-module, a frequency domain processing sub-module and an FFT sub-module, the time domain processing sub-module is used for filtering and preprocessing digital intermediate frequency signals of echo signals reflected by targets to obtain time domain sampling point sequences, the FFT sub-module is used for carrying out FFT conversion on the time domain sampling point sequences output by the time domain processing sub-module to obtain one-dimensional frequency domain signals, the frequency domain processing sub-module is used for extracting phase characteristics of a plurality of targets from the one-dimensional frequency domain signals, the FFT sub-module is also used for carrying out FFT conversion on the phase characteristics of the plurality of targets to obtain two-dimensional frequency domain signals so as to extract vital sign information of each target, and the frequency domain processing sub-module comprises a distance extraction unit, a phase extraction unit, a plurality of parallel unwrapping units, a parallel-serial conversion unit and a null filter. The invention has high integration, low power consumption, low cost and low time delay.

title_en: Prediction method for surface type rock burst of deep-buried tunnel structure
