abstract_en: The invention provides a prediction method of a surface type rock burst of a deep-buried tunnel structure, and relates to the technical field of deep-buried tunnel construction; comprising the following steps: in the area needing to evaluate the rock burst tendency, determining the ground stress information by a hydraulic fracturing method, and determining the maximum main stress and direction; collecting field rock blocks and preparing samples required by rock tests in areas needing to evaluate rock burst tendency; carrying out a uniaxial compression test on the rock sample to obtain the elastic modulus, the uniaxial compressive strength and the strain corresponding to the uniaxial compressive strength of the rock sample; obtaining geological information of a construction area through geological sketch, advanced geological radar and other methods; establishing a corresponding numerical calculation model according to the ground stress information of the construction area, the geological information obtained by on-site geological investigation and the rock mechanical parameters; and predicting the position and strength of the rock burst through numerical simulation of the tunnel excavation process.

title_en: A vibration-based human detection system using piezoelectric sensor
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vibration-based human detection system using a piezoelectric sensor (1 ) for search and rescue applications, by focusing on detecting human presence in disaster areas such as collapsed buildings. The microcontroller (2) in the system distinguishes between human and non-human vibrations by filtering noise and interference caused by environmental factors, using signal processing techniques and deep learning algorithms.

title_en: Non-contact respiration detection method based on CSI dynamic component rapid alignment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of respiration monitoring, and discloses a non-contact respiration detection method based on rapid alignment of a CSI dynamic component, which comprises the steps of firstly, collecting wireless signal data transmitted by a WiFi transmitter in an indoor environment, and extracting CSI original data from the WiFi signal; secondly, carrying out data preprocessing on the original CSI data to obtain a CSI ratio signal, removing static components and reducing noise; then, calculating a covariance matrix of the preprocessed data, obtaining a main direction by using a characteristic value decomposition method, and then calculating an included angle between the main direction and the positive direction of the I axis; then, calculating the angle of the alignment CSI ratio signal to be rotated according to the polarity of the CSI ratio signal sample sum; finally, all CSI ratio signal enhancement dynamic components are combined to extract breathing patterns. The method solves the problem that the target is far away from the WiFi equipment, so that the breath cannot be detected, and improves the sensing range of the WiFi signal for detecting the breath.

title_en: Breathing and heartbeat detection method based on ultra-wideband radar CIR
abstract_en: The invention provides a respiration and heartbeat detection method based on an ultra-wideband radar CIR, which comprises the steps of obtaining an original signal of respiration and heartbeat signals, preprocessing the first signal to obtain a second signal, performing fast Fourier transform on real part and imaginary part signals on a range gate in a buffer window of the first signal, performing time domain judgment when the signal-to-noise ratio of real parts or imaginary parts of continuous 3 range gates in a frequency domain is higher than a first threshold, performing time domain judgment when the frequency domain judgment is continuously performed for 3 times, considering that the time domain detection is passed when the value obtained by dividing the number of effective half cycles by the number of half cycles exceeds a preset threshold, and detecting the respiration signal, and performing time domain detection on the second signal to detect the heartbeat signal when the respiration signal is detected. According to the respiration and heartbeat detection method based on the ultra-wideband radar CIR, which is provided by the invention, the respiration and heartbeat signals can be accurately detected based on the fast Fourier transform and time signal characteristic statistics.

title_en: Microseism life detection system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a microseism life detection system, which comprises a control host capable of carrying out wireless communication, a plurality of wireless detection terminals and a plurality of wired detection terminals, wherein the plurality of wireless detection terminals and the plurality of wired detection terminals are integrated on the control host and can be disassembled; each wireless detection terminal and each wired detection terminal are internally provided with a vibration acceleration sensor, a millimeter wave radar module and an information processing module, the vibration acceleration sensor and the millimeter wave radar module detect information in the vehicle, and the information processing module processes the information detected by the vibration acceleration sensor and the millimeter wave radar module into sound waves with the frequency not more than 500Hz and transmits the sound waves to a control host through wireless communication and wired communication; each wireless detection terminal is also internally provided with a rechargeable battery; and an alarm device is also arranged on the control host. The utility model is convenient for detecting whether the life body exists in the vehicle body, can effectively avoid environmental interference, is convenient for use, and improves the working efficiency.

title_en: Distributed reconfigurable through-wall radar detection system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a distributed reconfigurable through-wall radar detection system, which comprises a power supply module, a transceiver antenna unit module, a radio frequency module, a signal processing module and a display control module, wherein the power supply module is connected with the transceiver antenna unit module; the power supply module, the receiving and transmitting antenna unit module, the radio frequency module, the signal processing module and the display control module are all independent modules; the receiving and transmitting antenna unit module is detachably connected with the radio frequency module through a first connector; the signal processing module is detachably connected with the radio frequency module through a second connector; the power module is detachably connected with the radio frequency module and the signal processing module through a third connector respectively; the signal processing module is in communication connection with the display control module. The utility model can be carried by common knapsack, can be assembled quickly when in use on site, and can switch detection modes by adopting flexible distributed scheme.

title_en: Automatic vital sign interconnection monitoring system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an automatic vital sign interconnection monitoring system based on millimeter wave radar, which realizes full coverage monitoring of a monitoring area through interconnection of multiple groups of radar data and replaces a mechanical rotating structure, so that the use cost and noise interference are reduced, and the monitoring efficiency and accuracy are improved. The system comprises a communication unit host and at least two vital sign monitoring devices, wherein the at least two vital sign monitoring devices are installed towards an area to be detected, monitoring scanning areas are not overlapped with each other, the vital sign monitoring devices comprise millimeter wave transceiver modules, vital sign recognition modules and communication modules, the communication unit host is connected with the communication modules in a wireless communication mode, monitoring data of the vital sign monitoring devices are received, the at least two vital sign monitoring devices are divided into a host and a slave, vital sign data exist in the host monitoring areas, and the vital sign data do not exist in the slave monitoring areas. The utility model is suitable for the technical field of clinical nursing.
assignees: ZHUHAI PULSE TIME HEALTH TECH CO LTD

title_en: A sight glass structure for a roller type fire shutter
title_ko: 롤러 타입 방화셔터용 투시창 구조
abstract_ko: 본 고안은 롤러 타입 방화셔터용 투시창 구조는, 저장박스의 내부에 감속모터에 연결된 차단판 롤러가 포함되고, 양측 가이드 레일 사이에 다수의 철판단위체로 구성된 차단판이 결합되어 화재감시센서의 화재신호에 의해 통로가 차단되도록 구성된 롤러 타입 방화셔터에 있어서, 상기 철판단위체의 철판을 관통하는 투시구멍; 철판이 절곡되어 상하좌우 네개의 변을 이루고, 일측 네개의 변이 안쪽으로 절곡되어 전면에 투시구를 이루어 상기 투시구멍에 결합되는 투시창 하우징; 철판이 "ㄷ"자 형상으로 절곡되고, 상부의 양측판이 일정한 깊이로 절삭되어 가운데 부분이 돌출된 돌출판이 형성되고, 상기 돌출판에 축홀이 형성된 한쌍의 브라켓; 상기 한쌍의 브라켓에 삽입되는 석영유리; 상기 양측 브라켓 돌출판의 축홀에 삽입되어 구르도록 구성된 굴대; 상기 석영유리의 하부를 감싸는 하부커버 난연천; 상기 석영유리의 앞뒤와 굴대를 감싸는 덮게 난연천; 및 상기 덮게 난연천의 단부가 외부로 돌출되어 형성된 손잡이;를 포함하여 구성된다.

title_en: IoT-based wearable devices for the vulnerable group of emergency response and healthcare service
title_ko: 취약계층의 응급대처 및 헬스케어를 위한 IoT 기반의 웨어러블 디바이스
abstract_en: The present invention can provide an IoT-based wearable device for emergency response and healthcare for a vulnerable group, which measures a health condition including electrocardiogram and a bio-signal of a vulnerable group and monitors the health condition in real time when an emergency occurs to provide a supporter and a caregiver with the health condition and cooperate with a medical institution, thereby providing an immediate and personalized emergency response service within a golden time. The IoT-based wearable device for emergency response and healthcare for a vulnerable group comprises: a strap unit including a conductive wire embedded in an electrocardiogram (ECG) electrode pad to measure electrocardiogram; a data measurement module processing the electrocardiogram measured by the strap unit and including a plurality of sensors for measuring a bio-signal; a server analyzing, transmitting, and receiving information transmitted from the data measurement module; and a user terminal receiving information from the server and providing a user with the information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 취약계층의 응급대처 및 헬스케어를 위한 IoT 기반의 웨어러블 디바이스에 있어서, ECG(Electrocardiogram, ECG) 전극패드에 전도선이 내장된 형태로 구비되어 심전도를 측정하는 스트랩부, 상기 스트랩부에서 측정된 심전도를 가공하고, 생체 신호를 측정하기 위한 복수의 센서를 포함하는 데이터 측정 모듈, 상기 데이터 측정 모듈에서 전송된 정보를 분석하고 송수신하는 서버, 상기 서버로부터 정보를 수신하여 사용자에게 제공하는 사용자 단말을 포함하되, 상기 데이터 측정 모듈은, 상기 심전도 및 생체 신호를 차동 증폭하여 데이터의 정확도를 향상시키는 계측부, 고역통과필터(High Pass Filter ,HPF) 및 저역통과필터(Low Pass Filter ,LPF)를 포함하여, 상기 심전도 및 생체 신호를 필터링하여 노이즈를 제거하는 필터부, 상기 서버와 통신하여 상기 스트랩부 및 데이터 측정 모듈에서 가공한 데이터를 송수신 하는 통신부를 포함하되, 상기 데이터 측정 모듈은 실시간 심박수, 분당 심박수, 산소포화도, 맥박 및 체온을 측정하기 위한 센서와 상기 웨어러블 디바이스의 위치 정보를 파악하기 위한 GPS 센서를 더 포함하고, 상기 서버는 상기 심전도 및 생체 신호를 가공 및 데이터베이스화 함으로써 상기 사용자 단말에 건강상태 데이터 및 응급 상황 데이터를 제공하여, 착용자인 취약계층과 부양자에게 착용자의 심전도 및 생체 신호 데이터를 제공하고, 응급상황 발생 시 부양자에게 응급상황 알림 및 전화연결을 진행하고, 일정시간 동안 연결이 진행되지 않을 시 응급센터로 신고 및 전화연결을 진행하여 불필요한 응급센터와의 연결이 감소되며 응급상황에서의 효과적인 대처를 제공하는 것을 특징으로 하는 취약계층의 응급대처 및 헬스케어를 위한 IoT 기반의 웨어러블 디바이스.

title_en: Radar data processing method and radar data acquisition system
abstract_en: The invention provides a radar data processing method and a radar data acquisition system. The method is applied to the field of medical radars. The method comprises the steps of initializing radar parameters of a radar data transceiver, acquiring radar echo signals, extracting vital sign information and body movement information according to the radar echo signals, judging whether vital signs exist in a monitoring scene, continuously acquiring a judging result of whether the vital signs exist, adjusting the radar parameters to a low-power mode if the vital signs exist and the time exceeds a preset time, acquiring a bed Zhou Leida echo signal in the low-power mode, carrying out body movement detection and body target integration according to the radar echo signals around the bed, judging whether the vital signs exist around the bed, continuously acquiring a judging result of whether the vital signs exist around the bed, and adjusting the radar parameters to an initialized state if the vital signs exist and the time exceeds the preset time. The invention reduces the power consumption and optimizes the battery endurance, storage and data processing efficiency of the system.

title_en: Human sleeping posture identification and vital sign monitoring method based on FMCW radar
abstract_en: The invention provides a human body sleeping posture recognition and vital sign monitoring method based on FMCW radars, which comprises the steps of obtaining gray level images corresponding to distance time matrixes formed by splicing two radars under each human body sleeping posture, training a sleeping posture recognition model by using the gray level image data, carrying out sleeping posture recognition classification on a human body to be monitored by using the trained sleeping posture recognition model, correspondingly selecting one of the two distance time matrixes according to the recognized sleeping posture result, precisely positioning a plurality of continuous distance doors where a human body thoracic cavity is located by using a thoracic cavity displacement signal correlation algorithm, jointly decomposing thoracic cavity displacement signals of the plurality of continuous distance doors occupied by the human body by using a GA-MVMD method to obtain a plurality of IMF components, and reconstructing a respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal according to each IMF component. The method improves the accuracy of sleep posture recognition and can realize accurate measurement of vital signs of human bodies under different sleep postures.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar human heart rate measurement method and system based on breath harmonic analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a millimeter wave radar human heart rate measurement method and system based on breath harmonic analysis. The method utilizes I/Q signals acquired by millimeter wave radar, and uses an extended DACM algorithm to acquire phase change information; then analyzing the time domain waveform of vital sign information, and calculating to obtain an asymmetry parameter of respiration and a pause parameter of a respiration gap, so that the bandwidth of a notch filter is dynamically adjusted by analysis, and the influence on a heartbeat frequency spectrum is reduced while respiratory harmonic waves are suppressed; finally, the heart rate estimation range is narrowed in a time domain peak counting mode, and the heart rate with higher precision is obtained by applying Chirp-Z transformation. Compared with the traditional respiratory harmonic elimination method, the heart rate measurement method is simple and convenient in flow, more effectively analyzes the intensity of respiratory harmonic and inhibits pertinence, and can effectively improve the measurement accuracy when the heart rate is overlapped with the respiratory harmonic frequency.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG;GUANGANMEN HOSPITAL CHINA ACAD OF CHINESE MEDICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Microseism monitoring equipment of semiconductor equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a semiconductor device microseism monitoring device, and relates to the technical field of earthquake monitoring devices. The utility model comprises the following steps: the top of pre-buried bucket is connected with coupling mechanism, and the bottom of pre-buried bucket inner wall is connected with the butt platform, and the top of butt platform is provided with the sensor, and the both sides of pre-buried bucket inner wall all are connected with fixed establishment, and the top of sensor is connected with the bracing piece, and the top activity of bracing piece runs through connection and mechanism and extends to coupling mechanism's outside. According to the utility model, through the cooperation of the connecting ring, the fixing clamp, the slot and the fixing groove, when the embedded barrel needs to be sealed, the fixing ring is rotated by rotating the fixing ring to drive the fixing clamp to rotate, so that the fixing ring and the connecting ring are fixed, the embedded barrel can be sealed, and the problem that the bolt is blocked and cannot be opened due to rust fall of the top of the embedded barrel in a humid environment is avoided; through cooperation of the fixing semi-rings, the mounting groove plates, the positioning plates, the connecting rods and the like, stability of the sensor can be improved.

title_en: Micro-Doppler vital sign detection method and system for noise suppression
abstract_en: The invention discloses a micro Doppler vital sign detection method and a micro Doppler vital sign detection system for noise suppression, which belong to the technical field of radar perception, and the method and the system eliminate the static clutter interference of the environment through a sliding cancellation method and coherent accumulation, so as to improve the signal to noise ratio of a target; obtaining a phase difference by adopting an extended differential cross multiplication algorithm, determining a target phase, and inhibiting random body movement noise; the filter is designed to realize the accurate separation of the respiration and heartbeat signals, so that the respiration and heartbeat rate can be accurately detected. The invention improves the detection accuracy and the anti-interference capability, and is suitable for vital sign monitoring in various complex environments. The method provided by the invention can capture the thoracic cavity surface micro-vibration caused by respiration and heartbeat, and eliminate the interference of multi-source noise such as environmental clutter and dynamic human noise, so that the respiration and heartbeat characteristics are more obvious, and the accurate vital sign detection is realized.

title_en: Radar respiratory heart rate detection method, equipment and storage medium based on multi-unit detection and harmonic fusion statistics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar respiratory heart rate detection method based on multi-unit detection and harmonic fusion statistics, which comprises the following steps of selecting an AOI in a buffer area for subsequent processing; the method comprises the steps of carrying out phase calculation on all distance units in an AOI to obtain an unwrapped phase matrix and a phase difference matrix, respectively screening out distance units suitable for detecting respiration and heart rate according to the phase matrix and the phase difference matrix, respectively storing the distance units in a respiration index array and a heart rate index array, respectively carrying out multi-unit respiration detection on the screened respiration detection distance units and heart rate detection distance units, calculating the confidence coefficient of each respiration detection result and each heart rate detection result, respectively caching the respiration detection results and the heart rate detection results of a plurality of frames and a plurality of units, carrying out statistical analysis on the cached respiration detection results, carrying out harmonic fusion statistical analysis on the cached heart rate detection results, and carrying out result smoothing treatment on the two results.

title_en: Gesture recognition method of wireless through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gesture recognition method of a wireless through-wall radar, which comprises the following steps: A. collecting source data; a1, collecting source domain data in an obstacle-free environment: the human body targets put out different postures, the radar collects and receives signals, and the signals are collected and a source data set is manufactured. According to the invention, the human body echo data of the through-wall radar is collected firstly, so that the effect of automatically comparing the gesture recognition is facilitated in the later period, the through-wall radar can be applied to actual tasks such as safety detection, disaster rescue and the like, the human body gesture is conveniently and automatically recognized by adopting the cooperation of the discriminator and the memory, the condition that the manual recognition is time-consuming and labor-consuming is avoided, and the problem that the gesture of a human body target is distinguished manually according to the statistical characteristics is solved; the method relies on the statistical characteristics of manual design, so that judgment is needed manually, and the method not only consumes time and energy, but also has the problem of low recognition accuracy.
assignees: WUXI XINCHENGHUI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: RIS-assisted WIFI signal multi-target respiration detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a WIFI signal multi-target respiration detection method and system based on RIS assistance, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the WIFI intelligent device establishes connection with the WIFI access device; setting the number N of the quasi-structure antennas based on the number M of the multi-target to be detected, wherein N is more than or equal to M; changing the channel from the RIS to the WIFI intelligent device by switching the RIS reflection direction to obtain a new equivalent transmitting antenna; adjusting RIS emission gain to enable the WIFI intelligent equipment to receive a proper signal; the WIFI intelligent device reads the CSI data stream and acquires a new mixed signal; repeatedly switching the RIS reflection direction for N times to obtain sampling data of the N-dimensional mixed signal at a time point t  1 ; repeatedly sampling the N-dimensional mixed signal to obtain a time sequence of the N-dimensional mixed signal; and carrying out signal separation on the time sequence of the N-dimensional mixed signal based on a blind source classification technology to acquire the breathing information of a plurality of targets to be detected. The method can realize multi-target respiratory behavior detection under a large-scale user scene by only needing a small number of antenna pairs.
assignees: HARBIN INSTITUTE OF TECH SHENZHEN INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH INNOVATION

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on MIMO rotary radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign detection method based on MIMO rotary radar, which relates to the technical field of radar, and comprises the steps of detecting all targets in an omnidirectional range based on the MIMO rotary radar to obtain an original radar data matrix, dividing the original radar data matrix into a plurality of pieces of virtual radar data, and carrying out multidimensional processing on the plurality of pieces of virtual radar data to obtain position information of all dynamic targets and angles of static references, wherein the position information comprises distances and angles; correcting the angles of all the dynamic targets by utilizing the angles of the static reference objects to obtain corrected angles of all the dynamic targets; and (3) selecting a detection target at will from the dynamic targets, and detecting vital signs of the detection target under the same-distance and non-same-distance conditions based on the distances and correction angles of all the dynamic targets. The invention can realize the omnidirectional detection around the radar, acquire the absolute position of the dynamic target in the omnidirectional range and improve the accuracy of the detection of the life signal.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring method based on principal component analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign monitoring method based on principal component analysis, which comprises the following steps: sending radar microwave signals to a target human body, receiving one path of radar microwave echo signals, and extracting frequency domain characteristics of the radar microwave echo signals; judging whether the human body is in bed or not according to the frequency domain characteristics of the radar microwave echo signals, and if so, extracting abdomen breathing characteristics according to the frequency domain characteristics of the radar microwave echo signals; analyzing radar microwave echo signals according to the abdominal respiratory characteristics to obtain thoracic phase data, and reconstructing the thoracic phase data to obtain reconstructed thoracic phase data; and calculating the heart rate and the respiratory rate of the human body according to the reconstructed thoracic phase data.

title_en: Method and system for detecting static human body target based on FMCW through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting a static human body target based on an FMCW through-wall radar, belonging to the technical field of human body target detection, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an echo signal of an FMCW radar, mixing to obtain an intermediate frequency signal, and sampling the intermediate frequency signal to obtain a two-dimensional signal matrix; performing a row distance dimension FFT on the two-dimensional signal matrix to obtain a distance-slow time image; extracting phase information of all static targets according to the distance-slow time image, and respectively calculating the peak intervals of autocorrelation functions of the phase information; and estimating the signal frequency of each stationary target according to the peak value interval of the autocorrelation function, and eliminating stationary targets with signal frequency not in the human respiratory frequency range to obtain stationary human targets. The invention can distinguish the static human body target and other interference signals by judging whether the signal frequency of the static target is in the frequency range of the human body respiratory signal, thereby effectively reducing the false alarm probability.
assignees: WUHAN XINLANG PHOTOELECTRIC TECH CO LTD;HUAXIA CHUANGWEI BEIJING SAFETY PREVENTION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign supervision is breathed and air purification healthy and is supported device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign monitoring and air purifying health-care device, and in particular relates to the technical field of vital sign monitoring, which comprises a monitoring shell, a driving motor, a rotating block and a transverse extension deflection adjusting mechanism; the transverse extension deflection adjusting mechanism comprises a rotating frame, an adjusting screw rod, an adjusting motor, a sleeve block, a linkage bar, a sleeve and a vertical motor, wherein the output end of the vertical motor is fixedly provided with the vertical frame, and the vertical deflection adjusting mechanism is arranged in the vertical frame. According to the invention, the displacement adjusting mechanism is transversely prolonged, so that the monitoring biological radar can automatically carry out displacement adjustment according to the signal intensity, thus the monitoring operation is carried out under the stronger signal intensity range, the monitoring effect of respiration and heartbeat is greatly improved, and the problem that the monitoring operation is difficult to be carried out under the stronger signal intensity range, and the monitoring effect of vital signs is poor is solved.

title_en: Multi-view distributed through-wall radar system based on same-frequency orthogonal signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-view distributed through-wall radar system based on same-frequency orthogonal signals, and relates to the technical field of distributed radar systems. The invention provides a multi-view distributed through-wall radar system based on same-frequency orthogonal signals, which comprises a distributed radar module, a receiving end and a moving target detection module, wherein the distributed radar module comprises a first radar and a second radar, the first radar and the second Lei Dabu are arranged at different view angles, radar detection is carried out on a target scene behind a wall by adopting the same-frequency orthogonal signals, the receiving end comprises an orthogonal mixing signal filter for filtering the orthogonal mixing signals, the self mixing signals are respectively obtained by the first radar and the second radar, and the moving target detection module is used for extracting target information according to the obtained self mixing signals of the first radar and the second radar. Therefore, by adopting the method, the blind area detection capability of the through-wall radar can be improved, false target interference is restrained, meanwhile, the problem of channel interference of a distributed through-wall radar system is avoided, and the detection precision of the through-wall radar is improved.
assignees: BEIJING INSTITUTE OF TECH YANGTZE RIVER DELTA RESEARCH INSTITUTE JIAXING

title_en: Radar-based in-vehicle vital sign monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a radar-based in-vehicle vital sign monitoring method which comprises the steps of S1, transmitting signals to an in-vehicle space by a vehicle-mounted radar to obtain intermediate frequency echo signals, S2, preprocessing the obtained intermediate frequency echo signals to obtain a fixed distance d  0  between a determined target and the radar, S3, extracting continuous multiframe vital sign signals p (t) from the target of the radar d  0 , and S4, carrying out frequency estimation on the vital sign signals p (t) obtained by the S3 to obtain the frequency of respiratory heartbeat.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZHIHUI CHELIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and program for exploring underground buried pipe
abstract_en: To provide a method and a program for exploring an underground buried pipe capable of detecting the underground buried pipe with high accuracy.SOLUTION: A method for exploring an underground buried pipe includes: a reflected wave acquisition step of acquiring reflected waves of radio waves of an underground radar transmitted toward a ground at a plurality of measurement points by scanning the underground radar along a survey line; an underground buried pipe detection step of detecting the reflected waves from the underground buried pipe appearing in a hyperbolic shape from an image created by arranging waveforms of the reflected waves for each scanning distance of the underground radar; and a reflection coefficient sign estimation step of estimating a sign of a reflection coefficient of the underground buried pipe.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Early warning device for disaster prevention and reduction monitoring
abstract_en: An early warning device for disaster prevention and reduction monitoring relates to the field of meteorological early warning, and solves the problems that an existing early warning device is complex and has large limit on terrains. The early warning device comprises a mounting column, a bearing part, a water cup and a rainfall sensor, wherein the mounting column is partially buried in a preset area, the bearing part is arranged on a part where the mounting column is not buried, the bearing part is provided with a bearing cavity, the water cup is arranged in the bearing cavity and is provided with a water receiving port, a water leakage port and a water containing cavity, the rainfall sensor is arranged on the bearing part and comprises a sensor body, a probe and a first communication module, the probe is connected with the sensor body, and the probe penetrates through the side wall of the water cup and stretches into the water containing cavity. The real-time rainfall in the preset area is detected by the water cup and the rainfall sensor so as to judge the natural disaster degree and early warn, and the scheme has the advantages of simple structure, convenient installation and low cost, has no limitation on the terrain, and is suitable for areas with larger rainfall and frequent natural disasters.

title_en: Multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted multichannel biological radar respiratory signal measurement method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted multichannel biological radar respiratory signal measurement method which comprises the steps of obtaining a three-dimensional radar image sequence of respiratory signals, carrying out threshold detection on each frame of three-dimensional radar image sequence, converting voxel data in each frame of three-dimensional radar image sequence into a three-dimensional radar point cloud sequence, registering the three-dimensional radar point cloud sequence, carrying out continuous radar imaging on the registered three-dimensional radar point cloud sequence to obtain a human body target area, extracting phase values in the voxel data of the human body target area to obtain physiological micro-motion signals, and carrying out signal separation on the physiological micro-motion signals to obtain respiratory signal waveforms. The invention solves the problem of inaccurate detection of the non-contact respiratory vital sign signal measurement technology under the condition of platform movement interference in the prior art.

title_en: Device for monitoring slope stability under rainfall simulation condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for monitoring slope stability under a simulated rainfall condition, which relates to the technical field of slope simulation devices and comprises a simulated landslide body, a stable base, a simulated rainfall system, a monitoring system, an angle adjusting device, a soil moisture detecting device, an optical fiber sensor and a controller, wherein one end of the simulated landslide body is rotationally connected to the upper surface of the stable base, the angle adjusting device is arranged between the other end of the simulated landslide body and the upper surface of the stable base and is used for adjusting the inclination angle of the simulated landslide body, the simulated rainfall system is positioned above the simulated landslide body, the monitoring system is arranged above the simulated landslide body, the soil moisture detecting device is inserted into soil on the simulated landslide body, the optical fiber sensor is buried in the soil on the simulated landslide body, and the simulated rainfall system, the monitoring system, the angle adjusting device, the soil moisture detecting device and the optical fiber sensor are all electrically connected with the controller. The invention can simulate the slope scene under the rainfall condition.

title_en: Nuclear power plant operator's workload evaluation system and method using biosignal
title_ko: 생체신호를 이용한 원자력발전소 운전원의 직무부하 평가 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for evaluating a job load of a nuclear power plant operator using a bio-signal. The system comprises: a bio-signal detection device including a heart rate measurement sensor and a skin electric resistance measurement sensor; and a server communicating with the bio-signal detection device, wherein a data receiving unit of the server receives bio-activity information from the bio-activity detection device; a preprocessing unit classifies the received bio-activity information into a mental element and a physical element, and compares the classified mental and physical elements with pre-stored mental and physical elements in a normal state to derive a first result value of the mental element and a second result value of the physical element, respectively; a priority setting unit sets a priority of each of the mental element and the physical element by applying a preset weight to each of the derived first result value and the derived second result value; and an evaluation result report creation unit creates an individual job load evaluation result report according to the set priority. Therefore, the present invention can improve the accuracy and reliability of job load evaluation, and can reduce manpower and time required for evaluation work.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 생체신호를 이용한 원자력발전소 운전원의 직무부하 평가 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 심박수 측정 센서 및 피부전기저항 측정 센서를 구비하는 생체신호 감지장치; 및 생체신호 감지장치와 통신하는 서버를 포함하고, 서버의 데이터 수신부가 생체활동 감지장치로부터 생체활동 정보를 수신하고, 전처리부가 수신된 생체활동 정보를 정신적 요소 및 육체적 요소로 분류하고 분류된 정신적 요소 및 육체적 요소와 기 저장된 정상상태의 정신적 요소 및 육체적 요소를 비교하여 정신적 요소의 제1 결과값 및 육체적 요소의 제2 결과값을 각각 도출하고, 우선순위 설정부가 도출된 제1 결과값 및 도출된 제2 결과값 각각에 기 설정된 가중치를 적용하여 정신적 요소 및 육체적 요소 각각의 우선순위를 설정하고, 평가결과보고서 작성부가 설정된 우선순위에 따라 개인별 직무부하 평가결과보고서를 작성하는 구성으로 직무부하 평가의 정확성 및 신뢰성이 향상되며, 평가업무에 소요되는 인력과 시간을 절감할 수 있다.

title_en: Fire hydrant capable of preventing water resources from being stolen
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fire hydrant for preventing water resources from being stolen, which relates to the field of fire hydrants and comprises a fire hydrant main body; the fire hydrant is characterized in that the lower end of the fire hydrant body is connected with a water supply pipeline buried underground, a water pressure sensor is installed on the water supply pipeline, a protective shell is fixedly installed outside the fire hydrant body, and the right side of the protective shell is rotatably connected with a 匚 -shaped protective shutter through a rotating shaft. The screwing piece, the W-shaped driving piece, the W-shaped slot, the fixing bolt, the first connecting piece and the second connecting piece are matched, and the screwing piece is carried by a firefighter, so that the phenomenon that an illegal person steals a water source in the hydrant main body is avoided; the outdoor fire hydrant is characterized in that a protection box type protection structure is arranged outside the outdoor fire hydrant, and a door lock structure is arranged on a baffle door on the protection box type protection structure, but the common door lock structure is easy to be opened by illegal personnel, so that the phenomenon of stealing water source inside the outdoor fire hydrant is caused.
assignees: HEBEI XINZHENGYE FIRE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact vital sign data monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of physiological information monitoring, in particular to a non-contact vital sign data monitoring method and a non-contact vital sign data monitoring system, which comprise the following contents: the device comprises a chest cavity micro-motion data acquisition module, a heartbeat data analysis module, a body temperature measurement module, a threshold parameter adjustment module and a health index calculation module. According to the invention, the millimeter wave radar sensor and the infrared sensor are utilized to collect and analyze the chest micro-motion and infrared radiation data of a target individual in real time, so that the vital sign is accurately monitored, the physiological state of the individual is combined, the abnormal detection threshold value is adjusted, the monitoring result is attached to the actual health condition of the individual, the comprehensive evaluation of the health state is realized through the combined analysis of a plurality of vital signs, the data support is provided for preventive health management and early disease diagnosis by combining the health trend prediction, the practicability of a monitoring system is improved, and the application range of the non-contact monitoring technology under a complex environment is expanded.

title_en: Electrical equipment protection system for apartment houses using IoT
title_ko: IoT를 이용한 공동주택 전기 설비 보호 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electrical facility protection system for apartment houses using IoT. The electrical facility protection system for apartment houses using IoT can manage power consumption of a plurality of outlets through the IoT, groups a plurality of outlets corresponding to a plurality of IoT devices, and blocks standby power for each group by comparing the amount of used power and the amount of standby power for the corresponding group, thereby effectively managing electricity of apartment houses. In addition, the electrical facility protection system for apartment houses using IoT includes: a main horizontal buried pipe in which wiring is installed; and an in-pipe inspection robot that detects current and flame in the buried pipe while moving inside a branch horizontal buried pipe and photographs the inside of the buried pipe as a thermal image. When a situation inside the buried pipe and a buried wiring conduit installed in the buried pipe buried in a wall or ceiling and connected to the outlet is in an emergency situation, power can be cut off, and the situation in the pipe can be monitored to respond quickly. An electric shock accident and a fire accident caused by a short circuit can be prevented, thereby providing high-quality electricity.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 IoT를 이용한 공동주택 전기 설비 보호 시스템에 관한 것으로, 사물인터넷을 통해 다수의 콘센트들의 소비전력을 관리할 수 있으며, 다수의 IoT 디바이스 대응되는 다수의 콘센트들을 그룹화하고, 해당 그룹에 대한 사용전력량과 대기 전력량을 비교함에 따라 그룹별로 대기 전력을 차단함으로써 공동주택 전기를 효과적으로 관리할 수 있도록 함과 아울러, 배선이 포설되는 메인수평매설관과 분기수평매설관 내부를 이동하면서 매설관 내의 전류와 불꽃을 감지하고 매설관 내부를 열화상으로 촬영하는 관내점검로봇을 구비하여, 벽체나 천장에 매설된 매설관 내에 포설되어 콘센트에 연결되는 매설배관과 매설관 내부의 상황이 비상 상황이면 전원을 차단함과 아울러 관내 상황을 모니터링하여 신속히 대처할 수 있으며, 누전에 따른 감전사고와 화재사고를 예방할 수 있어 양질의 전기를 제공할 수 있도록 한 것이다.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar signal motion noise removing method based on total variation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of non-contact vital sign detection, in particular to a millimeter wave radar signal motion noise removing method based on total variation, which comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining a thoracic cavity signal containing motion noise by utilizing a millimeter wave radar, rearranging and converting the thoracic cavity signal into a gray level map; S2, after acquiring a chest image containing noise, respectively calculating second-order gradient information of the image in different directions, S3, according to the gradient information in different directions, obtaining sparse characteristics of noise and a bottom image structure, respectively designing a transverse second-order regularization constraint term and a longitudinal second-order regularization constraint term by introducing an Lp pseudo-norm, simultaneously designing a global sparse constraint term based on the priori characteristic of the noise, and S4, restoring the denoised image into a one-dimensional chest signal. According to the method, the sparse characteristics of the motion noise and the underlying image structure are fully utilized, the Lp pseudo-norms are introduced to better describe the sparse characteristics, the motion noise is effectively removed, and the detailed characteristics of the chest signals are better reserved.

title_en: Sleep sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sleep sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar, which comprises the steps of firstly presetting acquisition parameters of the millimeter wave radar, transmitting signals by the millimeter wave radar, capturing reflected signals by a receiving antenna, obtaining intermediate frequency digital signals after sampling, and sending sampling results to back-end computing equipment; and identifying the sleeping posture of the user by utilizing the point cloud characteristics and the breathing characteristics obtained after the characteristic extraction. Then, effective reflection points are extracted, and the breathing frequency is accurately estimated by a weighted average method by using the reflection points. The invention aims to realize an accurate and reliable vital sign monitoring system by using low-cost and easy-to-deploy commercial millimeter wave radar equipment, stably identify 6 sleep postures and accurately measure respiratory rate, acquire rich and stable point cloud information, enhance the characterization of the point cloud on the sleep postures and acquire more accurate respiratory rate estimation results.
assignees: TIANJIN UNIV HEFEI INNOVATION DEVELOPMENT RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Millimeter wave radar vital sign detection system based on SVMD and harmonic estimation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of non-contact vital sign detection and discloses a millimeter wave radar vital sign detection system based on SVMD and harmonic estimation, which comprises the steps of placing a millimeter wave radar at the position right in front of a detected human body, collecting an IF signal, obtaining the distance between the millimeter wave radar and the detected human body in a field of view according to the IF signal, and determining the position of a target human body in an area; selecting candidate distance units adjacent to the target human body according to the phase information of the IF signals, carrying out principal component analysis by combining the distance units of the target human body and the phase information of the IF signals in the candidate distance units, extracting vital sign signals, decomposing the vital sign signals to reconstruct to obtain respiratory signals, heartbeat signals and heartbeat harmonic signals, and carrying out frequency spectrum estimation and correction on the reconstructed signals to obtain final respiratory estimated values and heartbeat estimated values. The invention can effectively strengthen and extract vital sign signals and realize accurate estimation of respiration and heartbeat.

title_en: Movable vital sign monitor
abstract_en: A movable vital sign monitor. The movable vital sign monitor comprises a shell(1), a control panel(2), a body temperature probe(3), a finger insertion port(5), a plurality of electrode slices(7), a display screen(8), a battery(9) and a communication interface(10), wherein the finger insertion port(5) is formed with a finger insertion notch and is formed in a surface shell of a shell(1), an inner groove of the finger insertion notch is provided with a blood oxygen sensor(6), and the blood oxygen sensor(6) is electrically connected with a control panel(2). The movable vital sign monitor of the present invention is integrated with a plurality of sensing modules for detecting vital signs, so that the movable vital sign monitor can detect a plurality of vital signs, and is more diversified in function. Meanwhile, the movable vital sign monitor is internally provided with a battery(9) and a display screen(8), so that the movable vital sign monitor itself can be used singly and movably and can display detection results directly by means of the display screen(8), and therefore, the movable vital sign monitor is convenient to use. In addition, the movable vital sign monitor can be grasped by a single hand in the whole volume, so that it is further convenient for a user to detect by himself or herself.
assignees: XUZHOU YONGKANG ELECTRONIC SCIENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Life detection method and system based on radar signal processing
abstract_en: The invention provides a life detection method and a system based on radar signal processing, which relate to the technical field of radar signal processing and comprise the steps of collecting radar echo signals of a target area, controlling a phased array radar transmitting antenna array to transmit orthogonal frequency division multiplexing double-frequency continuous wave radar signals, and inputting the processed radar echo signals into an orthogonal demodulation module for synchronous coherent demodulation to obtain baseband signals; the method comprises the steps of inputting feature vectors into a multi-task deep learning network integrating an attention mechanism to perform feature fusion and target recognition to obtain a second processing signal, obtaining a target feature frequency spectrum by calculating time-frequency distribution of the second processing signal, judging whether a living body exists in a target area according to time-varying characteristics and amplitude fluctuation rules of respiratory frequency components and heartbeat frequency components, calculating three-dimensional space coordinates of the living body by a multi-base station cooperative positioning algorithm if the living body exists in the target area, and outputting detection results containing the three-dimensional space coordinates and living body feature information.

title_en: Termite detection method and termite detection system based on microwave radar through-wall
abstract_en: The invention discloses a termite detection method and system based on microwave radar through-wall detection, and belongs to the technical field of microwave radar through-wall detection. The detection method comprises the steps of scanning a region to be detected by using a multi-output microwave radar detection device to obtain radar echo signals, performing signal receiving processing on the radar echo signals to obtain discrete time domain intermediate frequency signals, removing background clutter by band-pass filtering, reconstructing the signals to achieve DOA estimation of an information source, screening white ant targets in amplitude and measuring target distances, and sending termite detection results comprising the target distances and the DOA estimation to target users. The detection system comprises a microwave radar detection device and a user terminal, wherein the microwave radar detection device is used for scanning an area to be detected, performing signal processing and analysis on radar echo signals to obtain termite detection results, and sending the termite detection results to the user terminal. The invention adopts a non-invasive detection mode to realize rapid, convenient and low-cost accurate termite self-detection so as to obviously reduce the hazard of termite disasters.

title_en: Multifunctional post-disaster detection trolley
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multifunctional post-disaster detection trolley which comprises a bottom plate, wherein the bottom plate is connected with a crawler wheel assembly, the crawler wheel assembly is connected with an accelerating motor, the crawler wheel assembly is connected with a decelerating motor, the bottom plate is connected with a power supply, the bottom plate is connected with a detection assembly, the bottom plate is connected with a manipulator, the bottom plate is connected with a material assembly, the material assembly comprises a rotating motor, a screw rod and a material box, the material box is connected with a sealing assembly, and the sealing assembly comprises an electric telescopic rod and a sealing block. According to the utility model, a victim is prompted by the buzzer, the sound source of the victim is identified by the sound identification module, the position and the vital sign of the victim are detected by the radar life detector, the infrared equipment and the camera, the robot is used for cleaning the obstacle, the screw rod is driven to rotate by the rotating motor, so that the material box is driven to move, the material is conveniently sent to the front of the victim, and the electric telescopic rod drives the sealing block to move, so that the victim can drink water conveniently.

title_en: Baby Monitoring System
title_ko: 베이비 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a baby monitoring system, and the baby monitoring system of the present invention installs an arm capable of pan-tilt-zooming, monitors the baby's movements in a pre-sleep mode to determine whether the baby is sleeping, and in the sleep mode, a camera, a gas detection sensor, a respiration detection sensor, etc. installed in the head of the arm are moved in all x, y, and z directions on a rectangular coordinate system by the pan-tilt-zooming, so that sound, humidity, body temperature, etc. are accurately detected at an accurate detection location, and fecal gas and respiration are accurately detected, so that the baby's safety can be easily and accurately monitored remotely.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 베이비 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 베이비 모니터링 시스템은, 팬틸트 줌이 가능한 아암(arm)을 설치하여, 취침 전 모드에서 베이비 움직임을 모니터링하여 취침 여부를 판단하고, 취침 모드에서 상기 아암의 헤드에 설치된 카메라, 가스감지센서, 호흡감지센서 등을 상기 팬틸트 줌으로 직각좌표계 상의 x,y,z 모든 방향으로 이동해 정확한 감지 위치에서 소리, 습도, 체온 등 뿐만아니라 분변 가스의 감지 및 호흡의 감지가 정확하여, 베이비의 안전 여부가 원격에서도 용이하고 정확히 모니터링 가능한 베이비 모니터링 시스템을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for heartbeat detection using radar
title_ko: 레이더 기반의 심박신호 추출 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus and a method for extracting a heartbeat signal based on radar. According to an embodiment of the present application, the method for extracting a heartbeat signal based on radar comprises the steps of: obtaining a reception signal in which a transmission signal of radar is reflected by a target person; extracting a unit signal having a preset window size from the reception signal; reconstructing a data set by combining a plurality of the unit signals; and extracting a heartbeat signal of the target person using a result of fourier transform using the data set.
abstract_ko: 레이더 기반의 심박신호 추출 장치 및 방법이 개시되며, 본원의 일 실시예에 따른 레이더 기반의 심박신호 추출 방법은, 레이더의 송신 신호가 대상자에 의해 반사된 수신 신호를 획득하는 단계, 상기 수신 신호로부터 미리 설정된 윈도우 크기를 갖는 단위 신호를 추출하는 단계, 상기 단위 신호를 복수 개 결합하여 데이터 셋을 재구성하는 단계 및 상기 데이터 셋을 이용한 푸리에 변환의 결과를 이용하여 상기 대상자의 심박신호를 추출하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: KONKUK UNIV HOLDINGS CO LTD;MILLISIGHT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign detection device and method
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a vital sign detection device and method. The method comprises the steps of obtaining radar multi-antenna zero-speed distance FFT signals, selecting a first radar signal from the radar multi-antenna zero-speed distance FFT signals, generating amplitude characteristics and phase characteristics of the first radar signal, generating multi-segment candidate physiological signals by using a detection model based on a deep neural network according to the amplitude characteristics and the phase characteristics, selecting target physiological signals from the multi-segment candidate physiological signals, and detecting vital sign parameters according to the target physiological signals. Thereby, the accuracy of the vital sign detection result can be improved.

title_en: Forest fire prevention monitoring system based on data transmission
abstract_en: The invention provides a forest fire prevention monitoring system based on data transmission, which belongs to the technical field of data monitoring, and comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a data transmission module, a warning module and a real environment assessment monitoring effect, wherein the data acquisition module is used for configuring a sensor to a target forest monitoring area and carrying out real-time monitoring to acquire original forest parameter data, the data processing module is used for preprocessing the original forest parameter data and then storing the preprocessed original forest parameter data into a first database, the data transmission module is used for detecting whether the edge equipment is connected with a receiver of a data transmission terminal on line or not by adopting a heartbeat detection mechanism and regularly transmitting the data, if yes, the first parameter data of the first database received by the receiver are standardized to acquire standard parameter data, and the warning module is used for predicting fire risk of the target forest monitoring area according to the historical parameter data and the standard parameter data and configuring the fire risk to the real environment assessment monitoring effect. The system improves monitoring, early warning and response efficiency, optimizes resource allocation and efficiently processes disaster conditions.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring system and method for health and accidental injury of old people at home
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for intelligently monitoring health and accidental injury of a household old person, comprising a non-contact monitoring module, a sensor module and an integrated signal module, wherein the non-contact monitoring module and the sensor module are respectively in communication connection with the integrated signal module, the non-contact monitoring module is used for monitoring the behavior state of the old person and sending monitoring data to the integrated signal module, the sensor module integrates various sensing functions and is used for collecting specific physiological information of the old person to form a physiological data pool facing the specific individual and sending the physiological data pool to the integrated signal module, and the integrated signal module carries out vital sign recognition and human body falling body position recognition based on the physiological data pool of the specific individual collected by the sensor module and the behavior state parameters of the old person collected by the non-contact monitoring module and forms an analysis report. The invention can monitor and timely find the state of the old people at home in real time, and reduce the risk possibly caused by accidental injury to the maximum extent.

title_en: Method and system for identifying life detection signals based on MIMO digital array
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection signal identification method and a system based on MIMO digital arrays, which relate to the technical field of life detection and comprise the steps of constructing a life detection signal feature library; the method comprises the steps of transmitting electromagnetic waves by a plurality of radar antennas based on a MIMO digital array, receiving reflected target echo signals, judging whether living body life signals exist or not based on the target echo signals of the plurality of radar antennas, analyzing the physiological states of the living body life if the living body life signals exist, evaluating rescue priority emergency degree of each living body life based on the physiological states of all living body life detected by the MIMO digital array, and determining and generating a rescue overall scheme of all living body life based on the rescue priority emergency degree of all living body life. The invention has the advantages of effectively realizing the target precision detection of the human body in a static state and providing a more efficient and accurate non-contact life detection solution for the fields of disaster rescue, medical monitoring and the like.

title_en: Ultra-wideband biological radar vital sign monitoring method, device and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, equipment and medium for monitoring vital signs of an ultra-wideband biological radar, which relate to the technical field of monitoring vital signs of drivers and comprise the following steps of monitoring the drivers by transmitting short pulse signals by using the ultra-wideband biological radar; the method comprises the steps of filtering a monitoring signal to obtain a sign signal, extracting signal characteristics of the sign signal, grouping the signal characteristics based on different signal characteristics to obtain different characteristic groups, analyzing the relation between the signal characteristics and vital signs based on the different characteristic groups, and monitoring the vital signs of a driver based on the relation between the signal characteristics and the vital signs.

title_en: Positive pressure oxygen respirator capable of self-adaptively supplying oxygen and output adjusting method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of positive pressure oxygen respirators, in particular to a positive pressure oxygen respirator capable of self-adaptively supplying oxygen and an output adjusting method thereof, wherein the positive pressure oxygen respirator comprises an oxygen bottle, a pressure reducer, an air bag, an inflating mechanism, a gas sensor, a body state monitoring unit, a main controller, an electric control adjusting valve and an electric control exhaust valve, wherein the gas sensor monitors a gas detection value in a breathing circuit, the body state monitoring unit monitors vital sign parameters of a person, and the inflating mechanism firstly fills the air bag and a pipeline with air when the oxygen respirator is started initially; the invention forms feedback control by adding the inflation mechanism, the electronic monitoring and the electronic control valve, so that the whole proportion of oxygen and nitrogen in the loop is close to that of air, the invention is suitable for the normal physiological requirement of human body, improves the adaptability of using oxygen and self-adaptively adjusts the oxygen concentration according to the requirement of the human body, and can use the oxygen more safely and healthily.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Vital sign and sleep monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign and sleep monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar, wherein the method utilizes the millimeter wave radar to realize non-contact sleep monitoring, firstly, the millimeter wave radar is used for collecting radar echo signals obtained by chest wall vibration in a sleep state, the position of a monitored object is determined, vital sign signals of the object are extracted, then, first amplitude body movements and second amplitude body movements of the object are accurately detected, whether an apnea event occurs in the object or not is detected in real time, alarm information is prompted under the condition that the event occurrence time is long, three sleeping positions of supine, lateral lying and prone lying are detected, finally, sleep state monitoring is formed, a user sleep quality analysis report is formed by combining the monitored information, and health advice is given. The method is simple, accurate, economical and efficient, is suitable for various application scenes such as families, hospitals, nursing homes and the like, and provides all-weather health monitoring services for users.

title_en: Human presence detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human body presence detection system and method. The human body presence detection system includes a plurality of radar modules each configured to detect a human body presence within a detection range thereof, generate human body presence detection information indicating the detected human body presence, and transmit the generated human body presence detection information to the information processing device, and the information processing device is configured to receive the human body presence detection information from the plurality of radar modules and determine a human body presence in a detection space in which the plurality of radar modules are disposed based on the human body presence detection information from the plurality of radar modules.
assignees: GUANGZHOU ON BRIGHT ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Multi-target vital sign detection method of TDM-MIMO millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target vital sign detection method of a TDM-MIMO millimeter wave radar, which comprises the steps of firstly controlling a transmitting antenna to transmit signals to a target area under a TDM-MIMO mode of the millimeter wave MIMO radar, simultaneously controlling a receiving antenna to receive echo signals reflected by the target area, extracting and recombining the echo signals to form array signals, then carrying out distance FFT, carrying out static clutter filtering by using a phasor mean value cancellation algorithm, carrying out forward and backward spatial smoothing and spatial spectrum estimation, carrying out two-dimensional constant false alarm rate detection and clustering to realize two-dimensional plane positioning of a human body target, then carrying out phase unwrapping and smoothing treatment to obtain a phase difference value sequence, finally carrying out iterative optimization on parameters of a variational modal decomposition algorithm by using an improved sinusoidal algorithm to guide a dung beetle optimization algorithm, and carrying out variational modal decomposition on the phase difference value sequence by using the parameters after iterative optimization to obtain vital sign parameters of each human body target. The method has stronger environmental adaptability and improves the reliability and the automation degree of detection.

title_en: Crib health monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crib health monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar, which belongs to the technical field of millimeter wave radar and comprises the following steps of starting the millimeter wave radar, entering a detection mode, judging whether an infant is on a crib, performing multi-frame accumulation after entering a crib state, judging whether the heart rate of the current infant is normal, judging whether the breath of the current infant is normal, judging whether the infant moves greatly, starting sleep recording in a time unit after the infant meets a sleep threshold, performing sleep cycle analysis on the infant, evaluating the respiratory health quality and sleep quality of the infant, and transmitting the result to a mobile terminal of a parent. The invention realizes real-time vital sign monitoring of the crib to the baby based on the millimeter wave radar, can detect the breathing and heartbeat data of the baby in the crib, monitor whether the baby moves greatly, can record the sleeping condition of the baby, and can improve the monitoring capacity of the crib in the actual use process.
assignees: FURUI ZHIXING INTELLIGENT TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Human body perception detection method based on FMCW millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human body perception detection method based on an FMCW millimeter wave radar, which comprises the steps of acquiring and processing data of an environment by adopting the FMCW millimeter wave radar to obtain a plurality of frames of original intermediate frequency signal data, carrying out frame processing to obtain an adaptive speed amplitude threshold value and a target speed energy amplitude of a corresponding frame, then detecting by using different strategies according to the human body perception detection result of the previous frame, judging whether the current frame is a human body target with large amplitude motion or a stationary human body target if the human body perception detection result of the previous frame is a human body target with large amplitude motion or not, judging whether the current frame is a human body target with large amplitude motion if the current frame is larger than the adaptive speed amplitude threshold value, otherwise, carrying out human vital sign detection to obtain a target breathing signal and a heartbeat signal, analyzing and judging whether the current frame is a human body target or not, judging whether the current frame is a human body target with large amplitude motion or not if the human body perception detection result of the previous frame is a human body target with large amplitude motion or not. The invention can detect the static human body target and the human body target with large-amplitude action, and realize more accurate human body perception detection in different scenes.

title_en: Method and system for monitoring heart rate of personnel in vehicle based on radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar-based in-vehicle personnel heart rate monitoring method and a radar-based in-vehicle personnel heart rate monitoring system, which belong to the technical field of vital sign detection, and the method comprises the steps of acquiring radar echo signals of vital signs of personnel in a monitoring vehicle; the method comprises the steps of determining phase signals of a range gate where a human target is located and a range gate nearby the range gate according to acquired radar echo signals, extracting spatial characteristics of the range gate where the human target is located and the range gate nearby the range gate, extracting time sequence characteristics from the extracted spatial characteristics, acquiring heartbeat signals of personnel in a vehicle according to the time sequence characteristics, and acquiring heart rates of the personnel in the vehicle according to the heartbeat signals of the personnel in the vehicle. The accuracy of monitoring the heart rate of the personnel in the car is improved.

title_en: Pre-seizure detection device incorporating electronic nose technology
abstract_en: In one aspect, the disclosure relates to a sensor for predicting epileptic seizures in a subject. In an aspect, the sensor includes carbon nanotubes (CNTs) functionalized with organic molecules that can reversibly bind pre-seizure volatile organic compounds (VOCs) by IT-IT bonding, polar bonding, van der Waals interactions, and the like. The sensor can detect the pre-seizure VOCs from biological fluids including sweat, saliva, and breath, thus allowing the prediction of a seizure from 10 to 45 minutes before the seizure occurs, allowing a subject wearing the sensor to take actions to ensure safety and/or to alert caregivers. In an aspect, the sensor can be incorporated into a wearable device that also monitors vital signs such as heart rate, body temperature, skin impedance, and/or body movements in order to predict the type of epileptic seizure. Also disclosed are methods of making the sensors and methods for predicting epileptic seizures.

title_en: Through-wall human body posture estimation method based on MIMO radar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of MIMO radar and neural network, and discloses a through-wall human body posture estimation method based on the MIMO radar, which adopts a MIMO radar system to capture the signals, processes the obtained signals by analyzing the original radar signals generated by human body reflection in a scene and utilizing Fourier transformation to extract Doppler information, combining the original signals and Doppler signals, a horizontal feature matrix and a vertical feature matrix of the human body posture are constructed, and the feature matrices are then input into a transducer network for training and learning to realize human body posture estimation. The invention can improve the generalization capability of the system under the conditions of light-weight data and light-weight network, and has the characteristics of strong robustness, high stability, real-time performance and high efficiency.

title_en: Sleep assisting method and system for detecting sleep quality based on microwave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sleep assisting method and system based on microwave radar detection of sleep quality, comprising the following steps of S1, transmitting and receiving radar signals through the microwave radar, searching for the position of a human body, S2, controlling the microwave radar to rotate and/or translate, searching for a vital sign detection area, S3, receiving radar signals returned by the vital sign detection area, extracting vital signs from the radar signals, and S4, evaluating the sleep quality according to the vital signs, and controlling sleep assisting equipment to work according to the sleep quality.

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on millimeter wave radar and camera fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, and provides a vital sign detection method based on fusion of a millimeter wave radar and a camera, which comprises the steps of detecting the gesture based on a human body image of a target person to obtain a chest area of the target person, and performing frequency analysis on a millimeter wave radar signal to obtain a distance angle heat map; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a chest area, carrying out human body positioning based on the chest area and a distance angle heat map to obtain a human body position, carrying out phase extraction on millimeter wave radar signals based on the human body position to obtain vital sign signals of target personnel, carrying out variation modal decomposition on the vital sign signals to obtain vital sign parameters of the target personnel, overcoming the defects that the current detection is easily influenced by the skin state of the human body, the detection result is inaccurate, and limitations exist on special crowd, continuous monitoring and remote monitoring, realizing non-invasive detection, ensuring that the detection result is more accurate and reliable, being more beneficial to the special crowd, and providing support for home medical treatment and remote health monitoring.

title_en: Fire trapped person positioning method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire rescue and discloses a method and a system for positioning trapped fire personnel, wherein the method for positioning trapped fire personnel comprises the following steps of integrating a heart rate sensor, a body temperature sensor and a respiratory rate sensor into portable equipment, collecting vital sign data, sending the vital sign data to a central processing unit through a wireless transmission mechanism, and monitoring and analyzing the vital sign data to obtain the vital sign monitoring data; according to the invention, by integrating sensor data and carrying out real-time analysis, more accurate vital sign state identification and abnormal early warning are realized, the positioning precision of trapped people is further improved by combining the real-time acquisition of acoustic fluctuation and acoustic feature processing, the allocation of rescue resources is optimized by calculating sound source positioning coordinates, and the efficient and targeted rescue strategy and priority allocation can be formulated, so that the rescue efficiency is remarkably improved, the search time and resource waste are reduced, and the survival probability of the trapped people is improved.
assignees: WEIFANG PINGAN FIRE PROT ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Contactless biosignal detection methods for multiple targets
title_ko: 다중 타겟용 비접촉식 생체신호 검출 방법
abstract_en: The objective that the present invention aims to solve is to provide a non-contact biometric signal detection method for multiple targets using a radar sensor, which is designed to overcome the limitations of conventional non-contact biometric signal detection devices for a single target. The method comprises the steps of: extracting, by a control unit, the phase from each frame of a reflected signal and detecting the phase difference between two consecutive frames; determining, by the control unit, a frequency change based on the detected phase difference, determining the frequency change as a change in the body caused by a subjects respiration if the frequency change is in the range of 0.1 to 0.5 Hz, and performing a fast Fourier transform to determine the respiratory rate; and determining, by the control unit, the frequency change as a change in the body due to the subject's heartbeat if the frequency change is in the range of 0.8 to 4.0 Hz and performing a fast Fourier transform to determine the heart rate.
abstract_ko: 다중 타겟용 생체 신호 검출 방법이 개시된다. 이러한 다중 타겟용 생체 신호 검출 방법은, 방위각, 거리 고도에 관한 정보를 검출하기 위한 송신 안테나들, 반사 신호를 수신하는 수신 안테나들, 제어부의 제어하에 처프 신호를 생성하기 위한 처프 신호 발생부, 중간 주파수 신호 생성부, 아날로그 디지털 컨버터, 디지털 프론트 엔드, ADC 버퍼, 복수의 대상자들의 심박수 및 호습수를 결정하기 위한 처리를 수행하는 제어부와, 제어부에 의해 결정된 심박수 호흡수를 포함하는 데이터를 통신망을 통해 관리자 측으로 전송하기 위한 통신부를 포함하는 다중 타겟용 생체 신호 검출 장치를 이용하는 다중 타겟용 생체 신호 검출 방법으로서, 상기 반사 신호의 각 프레임에서 위상(Phase)을 추출한 다음 연속적인 두 프레임 사이의 위상차를 상기 제어부에서 검출하는 단계와, 상기 검출된 위상차에 따라 주파수 변화를 상기 제어부에서 판단하여, 상기 주파수 변화가 0.1Hz ~ 0.5Hz 범위에 있으면 대상자의 호흡에 의한 신체의 변화로 판단하여 이에 대해 고속 퓨리에 변환을 수행한 후 호흡수를 결정하는 단계와, 상기 주파수 변화가 0.8Hz ~ 4.0Hz 범위에 있으면 대상자의 심장박동에 의한 신체의 변화로 상기 제어부에서 판단하여 이에 대해 고속 퓨리에 변환을 수행한 후 심박수를 결정하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Contactless biosignal detection devices and systems for multiple targets
title_ko: 다중 타겟용 비접촉식 생체신호 검출 장치 및 시스템
abstract_en: A purpose of the present invention is to provide a non-contact biosignal detection apparatus for a plurality of targets using a radar sensor to overcome the limitations of the non-contact biosignal detection apparatus for a single target. The bio-signal detecting apparatus for the plurality of targets comprises: a plurality of transmission antennas transmitting a chirp signal; a plurality of receiving antennas for receiving a reflective signal resulting from the chirp signal; a chirp signal generator for generating the chirp signal and transmitting the same to the plurality of transmitting antennas; a low noise amplifier which is positioned to be corresponded to a plurality of receiving antennas; an intermediate frequency signal generator for signal-converting having the intermediate frequency (IF); an analog to digital converter for converting the intermediate frequency signal into the digital signal; a digital front-end packetizing the transformed signal; an ADC buffer storing the packetized digital signal; a control unit performing the processing for determining the heart rate and respiratory rate of the plurality of subjects; and a communication unit for transmitting the data to the manager side through a communication network. According to the present invention, it is possible to overcome the limitations of conventional non-contact biometric signal detection apparatus for a single target, and to provide an efficient management service for a plurality of subjects.
abstract_ko: 다중 타겟용 생체 신호 검출 장치 및 시스템이 개시된다. 상기 다중 타겟용 생체 신호 검출 장치는, 소정의 공간 내에 위치하는 복수의 대상자들 측으로 처프(chirp) 신호를 송출하는 복수 개의 송신 안테나들과, 복수의 대상자들로부터 처프 신호에 기인한 반사 신호를 수신하는 복수 개의 수신 안테나들과, 처프 신호를 생성하여 복수 개의 송신 안테나들로 보내기 위한 처프 신호 발생부와, 복수 개의 수신 안테나들 각각에서 수신한 반사 신호에서 잡음을 제거하기 위해, 복수 개의 수신 안테나들 각각에 대응되게 위치한 저잡음 증폭기와, 저잡음 증폭기를 통과한 신호를 중간 주파수(IF)를 갖는 신호 변환하기 위한 중간 주파수 신호 생성부와, 중간 주파수 신호 생성부에 의해 변환된 중간 주파 신호를 디지털 신호로 변환하기 위한 아날로그 디지털 컨버터와 디지털 신호를 저장하는 ADC 버퍼와, 처프 신호 발생부에서 연속적으로 주파수를 변화시키도록 제어하고, ADC 버퍼에 저장된 데이터를 수신하여 복수의 대상자들의 심박수 및 호흡수를 결정하기 위한 처리를 수행하는, 제어부와, 제어부에 의해 결정된 심박수 및 호흡수를 포함하는 데이터를 통신망을 통해 관리자 측으로 전송하기 위한 통신부를 포함한다.

title_en: Microwave radar vital sign detection method and system based on infrared temperature sensing detection
