abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for detecting vital signs of a microwave radar based on infrared temperature sensing detection, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, rotating infrared temperature sensing detection to detect whether a human body exists, if yes, transmitting and receiving radar signals through a microwave radar, searching the position of the human body, S2, searching a region of a micro-motion state corresponding to the position of the human body, controlling the microwave radar to rotate and/or translate, respectively searching vital sign detection regions of each human body from the region of the micro-motion state, and S3, respectively receiving the radar signals returned by the vital sign detection regions, and respectively extracting vital signs from the radar signals.

title_en: Vital sign detection method and device based on microwave radar
abstract_en: The application relates to a vital sign detection method and equipment based on a microwave radar, which comprises the following steps of S1, transmitting and receiving radar signals through the microwave radar, searching the position of a human body, S2, controlling the microwave radar to rotate and/or translate, searching a vital sign detection area, S3, receiving the radar signals returned by the vital sign detection area, and extracting vital signs from the radar signals. The application can control the rotation and/or translation of the microwave radar to find the vital sign detection area, so that the microwave radar for detecting vital signs can be placed at a plurality of indoor positions, manual adjustment of a scanning area of the microwave radar is not needed before the microwave radar is used, and the microwave radar can automatically find the vital sign detection area and detect the vital signs.

title_en: Buried object display device, buried object detection device, and program
abstract_en: To use an AI detection function and a MG detection function in combination in an underground radar survey to improve accuracy of survey.SOLUTION: An AI detection unit 12 performs an AI detection function that represents processing for detecting an underground range in which a buried object exists by using survey data acquired from a radar survey device 10 and using machine learning related to a shape of the buried object in the survey data. A MG detection unit 13 performs a MG detection function that represents processing for performing migration processing of a reflection signal from the buried object by using the survey data acquired from the radar survey device 10 to detect a position of the buried object. An integration processing unit 14 superimposes the detection result by the AI detection unit 12 and the detection result by the MG detection unit 13 together on one screen so as to display the position of the buried object as the respective detection results.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Vital sign detection device based on distributed millimeter wave radar technology
abstract_en: The utility model provides a vital sign detection device based on a distributed millimeter wave radar technology, which comprises a first radar module, at least two second radar modules and a motor driving module, wherein the first radar module, the at least two second radar modules and the motor driving module are arranged on a main body, the second radar modules are connected with the first radar module, the first radar module is connected with the motor driving module, the main body is used for monitoring sleep quality of a plurality of users, the second radar module is used for acquiring vital sign data of each user and sending the vital sign data to the first radar module, the first radar module is used for comparing the vital sign data of each user detected and the vital sign data of each user with preset vital sign threshold values, judging sleep quality of each user and controlling the motor driving module according to the sleep quality of each user so as to adjust lifting heights of different positions of the main body through the motor driving module. The scheme improves the detection precision of the multi-user vital sign detection information.
assignees: JINGHUA INTELLIGENT PERCEPTION TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Autonomous cardiac resuscitation
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of cardiac resuscitation devices for resuscitating the heart, which enables an emergency physician or paramedic to perform cardiac resuscitation automatically and very professionally, saving the paramedic time and effort and ensuring patient comfort. The device of the invention is easy to use and is installed as a single piece that the user can easily place and secure to the patient's chest, which is desirable in such devices because saving time is paramount in emergency situations. In addition to saving time, the device does not require installation tools or preparation time. The device is formed by an adhesive silicone piece (1) comprising detectors (2) surrounded by compression massage sensors (3) that perform movements like the movement of a hand pressing on the heart during resuscitation, wherein the silicone piece is attached over the heart, directly on the patient's chest, and works using an AI feature together with the receipt of messages sent by detectors attached to the surface of the sensors to measure the patient's vital signs, the sensors massaging the area by pressing, contracting and vibrating.

title_en: Health monitor device, system and method
abstract_en: A health monitor device (1) for monitoring the health and/or one or more vital signs of a user comprises: an attachment means (2) for attaching the health monitor device (1) to a limb or the neck of the user; a sensing means (3) configured to output raw sensor data, the sensing means (3) comprising at least a plurality of electrodes (31) for applying an alternating current to the skin of the user and measuring a voltage across the skin of the user; a processing means (4) configured to produce processed output data from the raw sensor data; and a communication means for sending or reporting the raw sensor data and/or processed output data to one or more further devices. The processed output data comprises at least a first output signal indicative of the respiration of the user.

title_en: Human body automatic focusing vital sign monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign monitoring method of human body automatic focusing, which comprises the steps of sending radar microwave signals to a target human body, receiving three paths of radar microwave echo signals, respectively extracting frequency domain characteristics of the three paths of radar microwave echo signals, generating human body three-dimensional point cloud data according to the frequency domain characteristics of the three paths of radar microwave echo signals, determining the lying position of the target human body according to the human body three-dimensional point cloud data, carrying out signal reconstruction on the three paths of human body radar microwave echo signals obtained according to the lying position of the target human body, obtaining three paths of reconstructed human body radar microwave signals, judging whether the target human body is in a resting state according to the three paths of reconstructed human body radar microwave signals, if so, searching for the chest of the target human body, and calculating the heart rate and respiratory frequency of the target human body.

title_en: Vital sign monitoring method based on multi-layer variational modal decomposition reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign monitoring method based on multi-layer variation modal decomposition reconstruction, which comprises the steps of sending radar microwave signals to a target human body, receiving a return path of radar microwave reflection signals, extracting frequency domain characteristics of the radar microwave reflection signals, judging whether the current human body is in a resting state according to the radar microwave reflection signals, extracting radar microwave reflection signals in the resting state, carrying out separation reconstruction on respiratory signals and heart rate signals of the radar microwave reflection signals in the resting state to obtain reconstructed respiratory signals and heart rate signals, respectively extracting phase data of the reconstructed respiratory signals and heart rate signals, respectively carrying out wavelet transformation on the phase data of the respiratory signals and heart rate signals to obtain respiratory phase characteristics and heart rate phase characteristics, and calculating respiratory frequency and heart rate according to the respiratory phase characteristics and the heart rate phase characteristics.

title_en: Sleep monitoring and intervention system and method
abstract_en: A sleep monitoring and intervention system comprises an elevated indoor electrical appliance (100) with a sensor module (310) for continuous detecting individuals in a room to acquire information of human presence, physical state and sleep-related activities, a loudspeaker (300) for a playback of audio data, and a control unit (320) programmed for analyzing and processing said information, communicating control signals and/or audio data through a communication link, and triggering a playback of the audio data from the loudspeaker (300) based on the analyzed and processed information. The system aims to elevate sleep quality across age groups by harnessing advanced detection technology for personalized interventions, fostering a serene sleeping ambiance and promoting overall well-being.
assignees: AI SPARK INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Microwave radar sleep monitoring method and device based on user charging time
abstract_en: The invention relates to a microwave radar sleep monitoring method and device based on user charging time, which comprises the following steps of S0, S1, searching a human body position by transmitting and receiving a radar signal through a microwave radar when detecting that a terminal is connected with a charger, S2, controlling the microwave radar to rotate and/or translate to search a vital sign detection area, S3, receiving the radar signal returned by the vital sign detection area, and extracting vital signs from the radar signal.

title_en: Multi-mode self-positioning networking radar life detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode self-positioning networking radar life detection method, which relates to the technical field of radar life detection and comprises the following steps of firstly dividing a region to be detected into a plurality of subareas. According to the invention, the area to be detected is divided into a plurality of subareas, and the dynamic change of the signals is analyzed, so that the system can timely identify abnormal signals in complex environments such as debris flow. And generating a signal change coefficient by combining characteristic parameters such as a phase shift index, a frequency spectrum expansion index and the like with a machine learning model, and accurately judging the signal quality. The method effectively avoids missed detection and improves rescue success rate. Meanwhile, the system optimizes resource allocation by comparing the signal change coefficient with a reference threshold value, improves rescue efficiency, ensures that trapped people can be positioned rapidly, and saves more lives.
assignees: BEIJING SHENGBOLAN AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geophysical soil pollutant migration and early warning simulation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of soil pollutant migration and early warning, and particularly discloses a geophysical soil pollutant migration and early warning simulation method which comprises the steps of S1, installing a geophysical detection equipment assembly, S2, data acquisition, S3, data processing, S4 and data imaging, wherein an induction electromagnetic method is generally used for rapid bottoming investigation, rapid acquisition of stratum conductivity distribution, finding out of a conductivity abnormal region and providing assistance for subsequent construction of a geophysical method, and a ground penetrating radar is mainly suitable for stratum, underground pipeline position, underground storage tank position, shallow waste buried thickness and distribution, underground tank leakage, shallow DNAPL/LNAPL pollution and heavy metal pollution. In the underground pollution investigation project, the ground penetrating radar method is mainly used for finding out the positions of underground metal, pipelines and electromagnetic wave attenuation, and is convenient for laying and constructing the measuring lines by the high-density electric method, and the application range of the high-density electric method comprises hydrogeology detection, large-scale underground structure detection, underground tank body leakage detection and the like.
assignees: GEOLOGICAL INFORMATION EXPLOR BRANCH OF SINOPEC PETROLEUM ENGINEERING GEOPHYSICS CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign and consciousness condition monitoring system based on active and passive radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign and consciousness condition monitoring system based on an active and passive radar, which is characterized in that on the basis of monitoring vital signs by an existing millimeter wave radar, millimeter wave echo signals and brain wave signals can be received by adopting a low-side lobe high-gain high-sensitivity dual-frequency receiving antenna, meanwhile, an extremely low-frequency (brain wave band signal frequency range: 0-20 MHz) high-sensitivity receiver is added to a high-sensitivity receiver module for receiving and conditioning brain wave radiation signals, then sampling and analyzing are carried out in a signal processing module, the analyzed data result is compared with the analyzed data result of normal personnel stored in a data storage module, and when the difference is larger than a threshold value, the occurrence of abnormality of the vital signs or consciousness conditions of a patient is indicated, and an early warning signal is sent. The invention relates to a non-contact monitoring system based on active and passive radars, which is used for accurately collecting vital sign signals and brain electrical signals, and realizing real-time, continuous and dynamic monitoring of vital signs and consciousness conditions of patients, thereby being beneficial to rapid recovery of the patients under good resting conditions.

title_en: Sleep apnea detection method and system based on microwave radar and microphone
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sleep apnea detection method and system based on a microwave radar and a microphone, wherein the method and the system comprise the following steps of radar data processing, S11, S12, receiving radar signals through the microwave radar, searching for the position of a human body, S13, controlling the microwave radar to rotate and/or translate, searching for a respiration detection area, S13, receiving radar signals returned by respiration detection, extracting and recording respiration waveforms from the radar signals, audio data processing, S21, capturing audio data through the microphone, identifying whether the audio data accords with the characteristics of snore, judging that the audio data comprises snore if the audio data comprises the snore, recording the snore, and judging that the sleep apnea is detected if the sound characteristics corresponding to the sleep apnea exist in the snore and the respiration characteristics corresponding to the sleep apnea exist in the respiration waveforms.

title_en: Ocean carrier evaluation early warning method based on unmanned plane and geographic grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ocean carrier evaluation early warning method based on unmanned planes and geographic grids, which belongs to the technical field of ocean disaster bearing evaluation and comprises the following steps of S1, determining an evaluation area and establishing a monitoring network, wherein a plurality of first sensors are buried in the area of the carrier area, geographic grid division is carried out based on the positions of the first sensors, the first sensors and a preset data processing system are connected to form the monitoring network, real-time acquisition and transmission of data are realized, S2, receiving monitoring data and data preprocessing are carried out, namely, receiving and monitoring ocean disaster data, when the ocean disaster data reach a first preset threshold value, enabling the first sensors to acquire corresponding data of the carrier area according to preset frequency, and after the first sensor data are collected, carrying out data preprocessing. The invention improves the real-time performance and the accuracy of evaluation and enhances the monitoring and early warning capability of ocean disasters.

title_en: Electrical cable construction system for apartment houses using artificial intelligence
title_ko: 인공지능을 이용한 공동주택 건축물의 전기 케이블 벽체 시공 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electric cable wall construction system of an apartment building using artificial intelligence that enables an inspection robot equipped with a current sensor, a flame sensor, and a camera to be movably installed within a main horizontal pipe, a branch horizontal pipe, and a vertical pipe buried in a wall and a ceiling, wherein an electric heat wiring and an electric lamp wiring are laid, so that a terminal and an electric wire are connected among the electric systems of an apartment building, detects, in real time, whether there is an abnormality in an outlet part into which a plug of a home appliance and the like is inserted and an electric lamp switch part that is frequently turned on/off, enables a fire to be prevented in advance by responding quickly by notifying a relevant person and enables quality electricity to be supplied to a user, sets a standard value by being equipped with an integrated management server, enables to be managed in conjunction with artificial intelligence by enabling the same to be databased, and enables construction of an integrated management system through test operations during construction.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인공지능을 이용한 공동주택 건축물의 전기 케이블 벽체 시공 시스템에 관한 것으로, 벽체와 천장에 매설되어 전열배선과 전등배선이 포설되는 메인수평관과 분기수평관 및 수직관 내에 전류센서, 불꽃센서 및 카메라가 구비된 점검로봇을 이동 가능하게 설치하여 공동주택의 전기계통 중 단자와 전선이 접속되며 가전제품 등의 플러그가 삽입되는 콘센트 부분과 자주 온/오프 되는 전등스위치 부분에서의 이상여부를 실시간으로 감지하여, 관계자에게 알림으로써 신속히 대처하여 화재발생을 사전에 예방할 수 있고 사용자에게 양질의 전기를 공급할 수 있도록 하며, 통합관리서버를 구비하여 표준값을 설정하고, 이를 데이터베이스화하여 인공지능과 연계하여 운용 관리할 수 있으며, 시공시 시운전을 통한 통합관리시스템을 구축할 수 있게 한 것이다.

title_en: Device for flooding an ant nest using ground-penetrating radar
title_ko: 지반 투시를 이용한 개미집 침수장치
abstract_en: An ant house flooding device using ground penetration of the present invention may comprise: a boundary object having a predetermined height on the ground and disposed to surround a hole connected to an ant house; a seawater storage device connected to an upper end of the boundary object and supplying seawater to one area set by the boundary object through an opening/closing hole; a control device controlling opening/closing of the opening/closing hole; a camera transmitting photographing data photographing the one area to the control device; and a ground penetration radar (GPR) device irradiating electromagnetic waves to the ground and analyzing the received electromagnetic waves to determine characteristics of the ant house below the ground. By an embodiment of the present invention, environmental pollution can be prevented by reducing the use of harmful chemicals contained in pesticides. In addition, harmful foreign species ants can be removed by an eco-friendly method using seawater, and the influence on the soil ecosystem can be reduced by using a quantitative amount of seawater.
abstract_ko:
본원 발명의 지반 투시를 이용한 개미집 침수 장치는 지면 상에서 일정 높이를 가지며 개미집과 연결된 구멍을 둘러싸도록 배치되는 경계물; 상기 경계물의 상단과 연결되고, 개폐홀을 통해 상기 경계물에 의해 설정된 일 영역에 해수를 공급하는 해수 저장 장치; 상기 개폐홀의 개폐를 제어하는 제어 장치; 상기 일 영역을 촬영한 촬영 데이터를 상기 제어 장치에 전송하는 카메라; 및 상기 지면에 전자기파를 조사하고, 수신된 전자기파를 분석하여 상기 지면 아래의 상기 개미집의 특성을 결정하는 지반 투시 레이더(GPR) 장치를 포함할 수 있다. 
본원 발명의 실시로, 살충제에 포함된 유해 화학 물질의 사용을 줄여 환경 오염을 방지할 수 있다. 
또한, 유해 외래종 개미를 해수를 사용한 친환경적인 방법으로 제거할 수 있고, 정량의 해수를 사용하게 되어 토양 생태계에 미치는 영향을 줄일 수 있다.
assignees: SHINIL ENG & CONSULTANT CO LTD;SHINIL ENV CO LTD

title_en: Low-sample through-wall radar high-resolution imaging method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of radar signal processing, and particularly relates to a high-resolution imaging method of a few-sample through-wall radar, which comprises the following steps of 1, acquiring through-wall radar images of different targets with different rotation angles and optical images serving as optical labels, and constructing a source domain data set and a target domain data set; the method comprises the steps of (1) training a source domain high-resolution imaging network by using a source domain data set, (3) initializing a target domain network by using a trained source domain high-resolution imaging countermeasure network, and training the target domain network by using a target domain data set to obtain a migrated target domain high-resolution imaging network, wherein the structure of the target domain high-resolution imaging network is the same as that of the source domain high-resolution imaging network, and (4) inputting a radar image into a generator of the target domain high-resolution imaging network to obtain a high-resolution imaging result containing shape and contour information.

title_en: Locked structure emergency access systems and methods
abstract_en: A locked structure emergency access method involves a vital signs sensor (20) (e.g. a wearable smartwatch) communicating an emergency alert to a rescue professional server (60) (e.g., a 911 server), a rescue volunteer device (80) (e.g., a smartphone or a table), and/or a defibrillator (e.g., an automated external defibrillator or a semi-automated external defibrillator). Based on the communication(s) of the emergency alert by the vital signs sensor (20), a virtual key (92) (e.g., a NFS, QR-code or a bar code) may be communicated to the rescue volunteer device (80) whereby a rescue volunteer via the volunteer key may obtain a physical key (91) to gain access to a locked structure (e.g. a home or an office). Additionally, a rescue professional via the volunteer key may obtain an additional physical key (91) to gain access to the locked structure.

title_en: Medical and medical detection system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical detection system based on millimeter wave radar, which relates to the field of medical detection and specifically comprises an antenna end, a radio frequency front end and a digital part, wherein the antenna end comprises a transmitting antenna and a receiving antenna, the radio frequency front end comprises a transmitting unit and a receiving unit, the digital part comprises a direct digital frequency synthesizer, a data processing module and a network communication interface, the direct digital frequency synthesizer is respectively connected with the data processing module and the transmitting unit, the transmitting unit is respectively connected with the transmitting antenna and the receiving unit, the receiving unit is also connected with the receiving antenna and the data processing module, and the network communication interface is connected with the data processing module. The invention explores the instantaneity, the accuracy and the full timeliness of the non-induced vital sign detection and ensures the large-scale application of the non-induced detection technology in the medical and nutritional fields.

title_en: fire protection shutter for disaster evacuation
title_ko: 재난 대피 겸용 방화셔터
abstract_en: The present invention provides a fireproof shutter capable of protecting a safe evacuation space in case of a disaster such as a fire, an earthquake, a flood, etc., and quickly grasping a location of an evacuee through a see-through window and a directional noise sensor. A fireproof shutter with a disaster evacuation function includes a shutter box. The shutter box includes a slat assembly and a guide rail, a see-through window, a temperature sensor, and an evacuation direction display unit formed on a slat, and in the event of a fire, cools the slat by a fire extinguishing water injection nozzle, and efficiently supports disaster rescue and evacuation by grasping the location of an evacuee based on a noise sensor.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따른 재난 대피 겸용 방화셔터는: 후술할 슬랫 어셈블리가 권취 또는 권취 풀림 되도록 하는 회전 구동력을 제공하는 구동부가 내부에 구비되는 셔터박스; 상기 셔터박스의 좌우 양단 하부에서 지면으로 연장되어 상기 셔터박스가 지면에 대해 지지 되도록 구비된 가이드레일; 및, 상기 구동부에 의해 상하로 권취 또는 권취 풀림 되며 승강 개폐 가능하게 구비되고, 다수개의 슬랫들이 서로 상하로 결속되어 구비되며, 좌우 양단은 상기 가이드레일에 의해 상하 승강 이동이 안내되도록 구비된 슬랫 어셈블리;를 포함하고, 
상기 슬랫 어셈블리를 이루는 슬랫의 판면에는 슬랫 어셈블리를 기준으로 내외 어느 일측에서 반대편을 향한 시야가 확보될 수 있도록 투시공이 천공 형성되며, 상기 투시공은 투명재질로 마련된 투시창으로 덮이도록 구비되고, 상기 가이드레일의 전후 상단에는 상기 슬랫 어셈블리를 기준으로 내외 영역의 온도를 각각 감지하는 온도센서가 구비되며, 상기 가이드레일의 전후 양측에는 상기 온도센서에서 감지된 결과에 따라 램프의 색이 가변 되며 표시되도록 하는 대피방향 표시부가 구비되고, 
상기 온도센서에서 감지된 결과에 기초하여 상기 슬랫 어셈블리를 기준으로 한 내외 영역 중 어느 일측의 온도가 반대편의 온도와 비교해 기준 온도차보다 더욱 높은 경우 상기 대피방향 표시부를 통해 반대편에서 이를 알리도록 상기 대피방향 표시부를 제어하는 제어부를 더 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.  
이에 의하여, 화재 발생시뿐만 아니라 지진이나 홍수 등의 각종 재난 발생시에도 외부로부터 내부의 피난 공간이 안전하게 보호되도록 하며, 외부에서 구조를 위한 내부의 상황 파악 또는 내부에서 외부의 재난 상황 등을 파악하는 것이 투시창을 통해 모두 용이 해지도록 할 수 있고, 방화셔터를 기준으로 외부와 내부 중 화재가 발생 된 위치가 반대편에서 미리 알 수 있도록 화재 대피 방향이 표시되도록 함으로써 화재로 인한 인명 피해가 최소화되도록 할 수 있으며, 투시창이 오염되거나 파손되어 잘 보이지 않게 되더라도 지향성 노이즈 센서의 감지를 통해 방화셔터를 기준으로 외부와 내부 중 대피자가 생존해 있는 영역을 용이하게 파악할 수 있게 됨으로써 재난 대피자의 구조가 골든타임 안에 신속하게 이뤄지도록 할 수 있는 재난 대피 겸용 방화셔터를 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Wearable vital sign monitoring and early warning equipment and application
abstract_en: The invention discloses wearable vital sign monitoring and early warning equipment and application, and belongs to the technical field of vital sign monitoring. The utility model provides a wearable vital sign monitoring early warning equipment, includes the electrocardio monitoring clothing, the electrocardio monitoring clothing includes cuff and collarband, wherein, the outside of cuff is provided with the radar arm area, and one side of collarband below is provided with the electrocardio monitor, the electrocardio monitor is through mounting hole groove and electrocardio monitoring clothing combination, wherein, the surface in mounting hole groove is provided with the colloid magnetic ring. For solving the problem that most of existing portable vital sign monitoring equipment is wrist-worn, the detection accuracy that this kind of wrist-worn structure can realize is limited, and can also receive wearing environment influence, the electrocardio monitoring clothing adopts the design of wearing next to the skin, and the user needs the electrocardio monitor in guarantee chest region and skin direct contact when wearing, can carry out real-time supervision through electrocardio monitor to pulse and blood pressure concentration and other numerical values in daily life in-process.
assignees: THE FIFTH MEDICAL CENTER OF CHINESE PLA GENERAL HOSPITAL

title_en: Multi-person heartbeat and respiration information monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-person heartbeat and respiration information monitoring method and system, which comprise the steps of adopting 1-transmission N-reception mode to emit wide beams by a radar antenna, enabling N receiving antennas to receive echo signals, utilizing a digital beam forming algorithm to conduct multi-target identification, obtaining initial azimuth angles of all targets, utilizing a sum-difference angle measuring algorithm to correct the initial azimuth angles of all targets to obtain final azimuth angles of all targets, mixing echo signals of all target azimuth angles with local oscillation signals to obtain intermediate frequency signals, taking the intermediate frequency signals as input of discrete wavelet transformation to obtain frequency spectrums of all targets, locking distance unit information of all targets, meanwhile dynamically adjusting discrete wavelet transformation coefficients to adapt to signal change by combining an adaptive filtering algorithm based on minimum mean square error, and conducting signal processing on the distance unit information of all targets to obtain multi-target vital sign information. The invention can realize the monitoring of the heartbeat and respiratory information of multiple people and simultaneously ensure the real-time performance and the accuracy of a monitoring system.

title_en: Indoor moving object detection method based on Doppler frequency modulation profile and range gating filtering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting an indoor moving target of an unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted through-wall radar, which comprises the steps of providing a moving target detection method based on Doppler frequency modulation profile and distance gating filtering. The imaging result of the moving target is defocused and is easy to be submerged in strong static clutter, so that the detection rate of the moving target is reduced. To solve this problem, the present invention analyzes Doppler frequency characteristics of stationary clutter and moving targets. Then, the range migration of the target echo is corrected in the range-doppler domain by sinc interpolation. Then, the Doppler frequency of each range gate of the echo is estimated by fractional Fourier transform, the estimated value of the frequency modulation is compared with the theoretical value of the frequency modulation of the stationary target, and a range gating filter is designed to inhibit clutter generated by walls and stationary objects based on the difference of the Doppler frequency modulation. And finally, constructing an azimuth compression filter to realize focusing imaging of the moving target. Simulation and actual measurement experiments verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the method.

title_en: Coal storage fire control is synthesized and is buried pipe network subassembly directly
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field, in particular to a comprehensive directly buried pipe network component for fire control in coal storage. The technical scheme includes that the direct-buried pipe fitting, a communicating pipe, an upper disc and a rotating block are arranged on the direct-buried pipe fitting, a protective shell is fixed on the outer wall of the upper end of the communicating pipe, the upper disc is installed on the top end of the inner wall of the protective shell, the rotating block is rotationally arranged between the upper disc and the communicating pipe, the upper disc and the rotating block are mutually communicated through eccentric detection holes, a pressure relief pipe is arranged at the top end opening of the upper disc, and a flow sensor is installed in the pressure relief pipe. According to the utility model, drainage and pressure measurement are carried out at multiple points in the operation process of the coal storage fire-fighting comprehensive direct-buried pipe network through cooperation between the structures, so that the problematic pipe section can be rapidly inspected, and the pipeline overhaul difficulty is reduced.
assignees: YIJINHUOLUO BANNER MENGTAI COAL CO LTD

title_en: Wall-Touching Holey Patterned Metamaterial Surface Combinative to the High-Gain SIW-Slot-Array Antenna for Through-Wall Radars
title_ko: 벽 투과 레이다용 기판집적도파관 슬롯배열 고이득 안테나와 결합하는 벽 접촉 메타재질표면 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a transmitter for a wall-contact type wall-transmissive object detection system, which comprises: a new antenna which is an electromagnetic wave radiation source capable of making a radar usable for detecting a metal body in a building, a metal body in another room next to an office, a metal body in an office in a corridor, and a non-destructive metal body in the office, or greatly improving the performance of the existing radar for the same purpose; and a new metamaterial surface coupled to the new antenna to allow electromagnetic waves to penetrate a wall when a wall is in contact. A wall-contact type wall-transmissive object detection system includes a signal generator that generates a signal; a wall-contact type transmitter that radiates radio waves by inputting the signal of the signal generator; a receiver that receives a signal in which the radio waves radiated from the transmitter pass through the wall and hit an object behind the wall and reflected waves re-transmit the wall; and an object detection unit for detecting the object based on the signal of the receiver.
abstract_ko: 건물 내 금속체, 사무실 옆 다른 방의 금속체, 복도에서 사무실 안의 금속체, 비파괴 금속체 검출에 사용 가능한 레이다를 만들거나 기존의 동일 목적의 레이다의 성능을 크게 향상시킬 수 있는 전자파 방사원인 새로운 안테나와 그에 결합하여 벽 접촉 시 전자파가 벽을 투과할 수 있게 하는 새로운 메타재질 평면렌즈를 발명하였다. 전자파 방사원은 흔하게 사용되는 혼 안테나의 단점인 구조의 큰 길이는 없애고 장점인 안테나 고이득을 위해 기판집적도파관형 슬롯 배열 안테나를, 메타재질구조 표면은 벽 접촉 시 임피던스의 급격한 차이를 줄이는 임피던스 정합을 위해 상대 유전율이 낮은 유전체에 공기구멍을 내고 이득을 증가시키는 렌즈 기능을 위해 공기구멍들의 패턴을 형성한 모습의 메타재질 표면을 공극을 두고 방사원에 결합한다. 그렇게 하여, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 의한 벽 접촉형 벽 투과 물체 감지 시스템은, 전자파를 만들어 벽을 투과하는 것은 물론 금속체에 닿아 반사되어 오면서 또 한 번 벽을 투과하여 송신기 옆의 수신기에 신호가 도달하게 만들어, 벽 뒤의 물체를 감지하게 하는 신기술이다.
assignees: UNIV NAT INCHEON RES & BUSINESS FOUND

title_en: Wall-Touching Gain-Booster and Impedance-Treatment Metamaterial Surface Combined with Patch Antennas for Through-Wall Radars
title_ko: 벽 투과 벽 접촉 레이다용 패치 방사원의 고이득화 및 표면 임피던스 등화기형 메타재질표면 장치
abstract_en: A transmitter for a wall contact type wall penetrating object detection system comprises: a radiation source; and a meta-material planar lens which is arranged to be spaced apart from the radiation source by a predetermined distance and includes a plurality of unit cells using a stacked structure of a metal ring pair patterned on a dielectric as a unit cell. The radiation source includes a microstrip patch array antenna. The microstrip patch array antenna includes: a plurality of microstrip patches for radiating an input signal; and a guard which is spaced apart from the plurality of microstrip patches by a predetermined distance to surround the plurality of microstrip patches in order to alleviate the spread of electromagnetic waves radiated from the plurality of microstrip patches. The present invention can accurately detect a metal body and improve radar performance by transmitting electromagnetic waves through a wall using a wall contact-type meta-material antenna.
abstract_ko: 건물 내 금속체, 사무실 옆 다른 방의 금속체, 복도에서 사무실 안의 금속체, 비파괴 금속체 검출에 사용 가능한 레이다를 만들거나 기존의 동일 목적의 레이다의 성능을 크게 향상시킬 수 있는 전자파 방사원인 새로운 안테나와 그에 결합하여 벽 접촉 시 전자파가 벽을 투과할 수 있게 하는 새로운 메타재질표면을 발명하였다. 전자파 방사원은 흔하게 사용되는 혼 안테나의 단점인 구조의 큰 길이는 없애고 장점인 안테나 고이득을 위해 메타재질 렌즈와의 결합에 적합한 마이크로스트립 패치 안테나를 시초점으로, 메타재질구조 표면은 벽 접촉 시 임피던스의 급격한 차이를 줄이는 임피던스 정합을 위해 벽 상의 균일 임피던스 분포에 맞도록 임피던스를 균등화하며 집속하여 이득을 증가시키는 렌즈 기능을 위해 금속패턴의 적층구조의 메타재질 표면을 만들어, 공극을 두고 방사원에 결합한다. 그렇게 하여, 전자파를 만들어 벽을 투과하는 것은 물론 금속체에 닿아 반사되어 오면서 또 한 번 벽을 투과하여 송신기 옆의 수신기에 신호가 도달하게 만들어, 벽 뒤의 도체를 감지하게 하는 신기술이다.
assignees: UNIV NAT INCHEON RES & BUSINESS FOUND

title_en: Ground penetrating radar-audio frequency identification combined detection underground water supply pipeline and construction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a ground penetrating radar-audio frequency identification combined detection underground water supply pipeline and a construction method thereof, mainly relating to a three-dimensional model experimental device for detecting leakage of the ground penetrating radar pipeline, a quick pressing-in anti-floating sinking technology for a sound listening pipe of a high-underground water level deep buried pipeline of a hand propelled geological radar guiding limit running device, a non-excavation side grouting plugging model experimental device for leakage of the underground pipeline, a pressing-in type small steel plate box enclosure excavation technology for a soft soil geological shallow buried pipeline, and mainly comprising a flattening roller, an openable bottom plate, a pipeline support, a geological radar, a sound listening rod, a sound listening instrument, a sensor, a steel plate box and the like. The ground penetrating radar-audio frequency identification combination detection underground water supply pipeline and the construction method thereof improve the safety and efficiency of underground water supply pipeline restoration and reduce adverse effects on the surrounding environment.
assignees: HANGZHOU JIANGRUN TECH CO LTD;ZHEJIANG SHIRUN JIANCHUANG TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Multi-radar fusion vital sign monitoring device and monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-radar fusion vital sign monitoring device and a monitoring method, comprising a mounting frame, a bottom plate, a first shell, a second shell, a 3D laser radar, an infrared array sensor, a rotating structure and a millimeter wave radar, wherein the bottom plate is connected with the mounting frame, the rotating structure is arranged on the bottom plate, the first shell is connected to the rotating structure, the 3D laser radar and the infrared array sensor are arranged in the first shell, the second shell is connected with the bottom plate and located below the first shell, and the millimeter wave radar is arranged in the second shell. Through the cooperation of multiple different radars, judge whether the old person in the room is in the state of tumbleing, and then in time report to the police, under the condition of guaranteeing old man's privacy, both increased the monitoring area, improved monitoring accuracy again, reached the purpose of full-range monitoring.

title_en: Far infrared vital sign monitoring method and device based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sign monitoring, in particular to a far infrared vital sign monitoring method and device based on deep learning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining thermal imaging data of a monitoring area, generating a thermal diagram to obtain the thermal diagram of the monitoring area, integrating physical sign characteristics of the thermal diagram of the monitoring area to obtain vital sign data of a user of the monitoring area, detecting unbalance of the center of gravity of the user based on the vital sign data of the user of the monitoring area to obtain unbalance behavior data of the center of gravity of the user, obtaining millimeter wave signal sets of the monitoring area, analyzing gesture change behavior to obtain quick gesture change behavior data of the user, performing risk assessment according to the unbalance behavior data of the center of gravity of the user and the quick gesture change behavior data of the user to obtain falling risk data of the user of the monitoring area, and performing falling risk early warning strategy analysis according to the falling risk data of the user of the monitoring area to obtain a falling risk early warning strategy of the user. The method can improve the accuracy and efficiency of physical sign monitoring.
assignees: SHENZHEN DAYIN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: ARM-based non-contact sleep respiration monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a non-contact sleep respiration monitoring device based on ARM, which belongs to the field of non-contact vital sign monitoring and comprises a control board, an SD card and a millimeter wave radar unit, wherein the control board comprises an SD card holder, the SD card is inserted on the SD card holder, the millimeter wave radar unit is electrically connected with the control board, the control board comprises a first central processing unit, a first synchronous dynamic random memory, a second synchronous dynamic random memory, a flash memory chip, a memory card holder, a first serial communication interface, a buzzer and a buzzer control chip, the millimeter wave radar unit comprises a second central processing unit and a second serial communication interface, and the second serial communication interface is electrically connected with the second central processing unit. Adopt non-contact sleep respiration monitoring, there is foreign matter sense and low accuracy, and health monitoring effect is better, and equipment is owing to not receive weight, size factor's restriction, and its health detection function of realization that can be better improves detection precision, promotes user experience.
assignees: UNIV HANGZHOU DIANZI;HANGZHOU KUANGWEI JURUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fiber bragg grating soil monitoring device
abstract_en: The application relates to a fiber grating soil monitoring device, which relates to the technical field of soil monitoring and comprises a demodulator, a plurality of strain fiber grating detection chains and a plurality of installation pieces, wherein the plurality of fiber grating detection chains respectively comprise multi-core optical cables which are pre-buried under the slope surface of a slope body to be monitored, the multi-core optical cables are respectively connected with a plurality of strain fiber grating sensors in series, the plurality of strain fiber grating sensors are respectively detachably installed on the plurality of installation pieces, the plurality of installation pieces are inserted under the slope surface of the slope body to be monitored, the plurality of installation pieces are arranged in a linear array, the output ends of the multi-core optical cables are connected with the demodulator, the signal output ends of the demodulator are connected with a signal processor, the signal processor receives a plurality of stress induction signals and generates a slope body monitoring array, the signal output ends of the signal processor are connected with a display in a control room, and the signal output ends of the demodulator are also connected with a fire alarm host. The application can monitor the landslide in real time and reduce the loss caused by landslide disaster.

title_en: System and methods for detection of subjects vitals and physiological symptoms via non-contact methods
abstract_en: The present invention provides a non-contact vital sign monitoring which properly detect subject' s vital signs by correcting the measured signals for reflectance and variations in distance between measurements. The present invention provides for adequate sensor numbers and types to properly monitor a subject's vitals and physiological signals. Certain aspects of the invention include the use of signal scoring methods. In such embodiments, acquired data and/or information is used for scoring a signal acquired from non-contact vital monitoring assisting in the accurate measurement of various vitals of a subject, including, without limit, a subjects temperature, cardiovascular and respiratory information. The present invention provides a viable solution for at-a-distance non- contact vital sign monitoring that overcomes the shortcomings of existing solutions known in the art.

title_en: Life perception monitoring analysis system for whole house of solitary old man
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent home and discloses a living old people whole house life perception monitoring analysis system which comprises a user terminal and a monitoring platform, wherein the monitoring platform comprises a life perception monitoring module, an abnormality evaluation module and an alarm module, the life perception monitoring module comprises a distribution control unit, a behavior monitoring unit, a position monitoring unit and a body monitoring unit, the distribution control unit is connected with a plurality of groups of sensors through a network to distribute and control an area, the behavior monitoring unit is used for acquiring a behavior data set, the position monitoring unit is used for acquiring a position data set, the body monitoring unit is used for acquiring a body data set, the abnormality evaluation module carries out abnormality evaluation according to received data, and sends a signal to the alarm module when the abnormality exists in the evaluation, and the alarm module receives the signal and gives an alarm. The comprehensive and refined monitoring and intelligent response to living environment, vital signs, daily behaviors and health management of the solitary old people are realized through multiple cross judgment.

title_en: Indoor vital sign sensing device and sensing method based on SLAM technology
abstract_en: The invention provides an indoor vital sign sensing device and an indoor vital sign sensing method based on SLAM technology, wherein the indoor vital sign sensing device comprises an SLAM mobile detection vehicle placed on the ground and a positioning radar structure arranged on a wall, the positioning radar structure is communicated with the SLAM mobile detection vehicle, and the SLAM mobile detection vehicle is provided with a laser radar for scanning the surrounding environment, an odometer for acquiring distance and direction information of an object and an inertial measurement unit for measuring acceleration and angular velocity of the vehicle. Through SLAM simultaneous localization and mapping technique, automatic calculation route, automatic obstacle avoidance and travel to the monitoring target nearby region, the millimeter wave radar on the car starts the vital sign of monitoring object, realizes the accurate control of vital sign, in time sends the alarm to the dangerous emergence in the ward to guarantee monitoring object's safety.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle human vital sign detection method based on ultra-wideband radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote detection, and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle human body vital sign detection method based on ultra-wideband radar, which comprises the following steps of planning a flight path of an unmanned aerial vehicle; the method comprises the steps of acquiring reflected signals received by an ultra-wideband radar, position information of an unmanned aerial vehicle and image data of a thermal imager in real time, acquiring and preprocessing the reflected signals received by the ultra-wideband radar in real time, processing the reflected signals based on a signal processing algorithm and extracting human vital sign characteristic parameters, wherein the human vital sign characteristic parameters comprise respiratory frequency and heartbeat frequency, and judging the existence condition of human life according to the normal range of the human vital sign characteristic parameters and preset human vital sign characteristic parameters and the image data of the thermal imager. The invention can remotely detect vital signs, and quickly and accurately detect human vital sign signals under ruins in a large range by utilizing the high maneuverability of the unmanned aerial vehicle.
assignees: NANJING NINGYING INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fatigue detection method for millimeter wave radar and vision fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fatigue detection method by fusing millimeter wave radar and vision, which relates to the field of safe driving and comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining head videos and vital sign signals of a driver through a camera and a millimeter wave radar, preprocessing the head videos and the vital sign signals, calculating facial fatigue parameters and respiratory frequency through a software algorithm, and judging the fatigue state of the driver according to the facial fatigue parameters and the respiratory frequency. The invention improves the accuracy of fatigue detection by using a double detection mode, and avoids the single aspect characteristic and the possible false detection phenomenon during single fatigue detection.

title_en: Automatic pet door with prey detection and method for its use
abstract_en: A method and a system for detecting the proximity of a pet (10) attempting to pass through a pet door and preventing access if the pet is carrying another live animal (12). Upon determining that the input signal (308) from the proximity sensor is indicative of the presence of the pet (10), a received UWB return signal (310) is analyzed for vital signs (20, 22). If the analysis of the UWB return signal (310) results in detection of vital signs from more than one animal, an opening mechanism for the pet door is disabled (306). If, on the other hand, the analysis of the UWB return signal results in detection of vital signs from no more than one animal, the opening mechanism for the pet door is activated.

title_en: Portable wireless vital sign monitor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable wireless vital sign monitor, which relates to the technical field of medical equipment and comprises a monitor component, wherein the monitor component comprises a base, a shell is arranged above the base, a millimeter wave biological radar for monitoring vital signs of a monitored person is arranged in the shell, the inside of the base is provided with a mounting component, the top of the base is in sliding sleeve joint with the bottom wall of the shell so as to realize omnibearing angle adjustment of the shell, the bottom of the base is provided with a mounting component so as to realize quick assembly and disassembly of the monitor component, and an adjusting component is arranged in the base so as to realize unfolding and closing of the shell. According to the invention, the mounting assembly and the adjusting assembly are arranged, so that the monitor can be disassembled and assembled more conveniently, and the state of the monitor can be further adjusted, so that the portable monitor is convenient to carry.
assignees: JIANGSU PROVINCE HOSPITAL FIRST AFFILIATED HOSPITAL WITH NANJING MEDICAL UNIV

title_en: Physiological index monitoring method, device, equipment and medium applied to micro-pressure oxygen cabin
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a physiological index monitoring method, device, equipment and medium applied to a micro-pressure oxygen cabin, wherein the method comprises the following steps of carrying a physiological index monitoring system comprising a radar sensing module and a fingerstall module to the micro-pressure oxygen cabin; the method comprises the steps of continuously detecting whether a moving target exists in a set area through a radar sensing module, triggering a system to enter a working state if the moving target exists, detecting whether the target wears a fingerstall through a temperature module of a fingerstall module, monitoring physiological indexes of the target through the radar sensing module, the temperature module and a blood oxygen detection module if the moving target is worn, outputting generated data as physiological index data, sending prompt information if the fingerstall is not worn, setting a duration threshold, and recovering the physiological index monitoring system to a standby state if the time that the target is in the non-moving state exceeds the duration threshold and the target is not worn. Because the proposal realizes the full-automatic vital sign monitoring through the physiological index monitoring system.
assignees: CROSS STRAIT TSINGHUA RES INSTITUTE XIAMEN;SUZHOU YAOZHIKANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign detection method based on WOA-SVMD
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign detection method based on WOA-SVMD, which comprises the steps of carrying out self-adaptive optimization on balance parameters of Successive Variation Modal Decomposition (SVMD) by using a Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA), decomposing a signal into a series of eigen modal functions by using the successive variation modal decomposition based on the optimal balance parameters, carrying out twice screening on the eigen modal functions through energy ratio and correlation coefficient, and finally determining the eigen modal function with the largest correlation coefficient to reconstruct a heartbeat signal. The vital sign detection method based on WOA-SVMD can realize accurate estimation of heart rate, the separated heart beat signal is closer to the actual signal, and the problem that noise interference and respiratory harmonics in radar vital sign detection easily interfere with the heart beat signal can be effectively solved.

title_en: Land-air collaborative monitoring and early warning method and system for buried gas pipeline in landslide hidden danger area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a land-air collaborative monitoring and early warning method and a land collaborative monitoring and early warning system for a buried gas pipeline in a landslide hidden danger area, wherein the method comprises the steps of utilizing distributed optical fiber sensing for ground monitoring, embedding an optical fiber sensor into the outer wall of the buried gas pipeline or paving a concomitant optical fiber pipeline; the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-physical quantity data of strain, temperature and vibration of a pipeline, carrying out air inspection by utilizing a multi-sensor platform carried by an unmanned aerial vehicle in air monitoring, fusing the air monitoring data with ground monitoring data to construct a landslide hidden danger area pipeline safety state assessment model, carrying out real-time intelligent analysis on the fused data by utilizing an advanced mixed attention convolution neural network to identify a potential disaster hidden danger area of the pipeline, carrying out early warning classification according to a risk assessment result, and formulating a corresponding emergency plan. The method can realize real-time and accurate monitoring of the pipeline state, discover landslide hidden danger in time and accurately early warn, and can effectively ensure safe operation of the buried gas pipeline in the landslide hidden danger area.
assignees: SUZHOU NANYONG EMERGENCY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-target vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: A multi-target vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar includes the steps of sending linear frequency modulation electromagnetic wave signals through the millimeter wave radar, constructing a three-dimensional data matrix according to reflected signals, carrying out Fourier transformation and data processing on different dimensions of the data matrix, obtaining distance, speed and angle information of targets, manufacturing a three-dimensional point cloud data set, clustering the generated point cloud data to obtain related information of a plurality of targets, generating a two-dimensional movement state scatter diagram based on clustered information, inputting the scatter diagram into a movement state classifier network model to identify movement states, extracting signals of targets in a movement interval period, and monitoring respiration rate and heartbeat rate of the targets. The invention has the characteristics of good privacy protection, low time delay, non-contact performance and the like, and can realize the monitoring of multi-target vital signs.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for monitoring buried cable external damage
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of electric power equipment monitoring, in particular to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for monitoring the external damage of an underground cable, which are used for acquiring radar signals of the surrounding environment in real time based on a millimeter wave radar unit, detecting whether engineering mechanical equipment exists in the surrounding environment through a trained engineering mechanical equipment identification model, calculating the relative position between an intelligent ground nail and the engineering mechanical equipment if the engineering mechanical equipment exists in the surrounding environment, acquiring voiceprint signals of the surrounding environment based on a voiceprint acquisition unit, acquiring the category of the engineering mechanical equipment through an engineering mechanical equipment category identification model library, and calculating the distance between a vibration source and the underground cable based on a triaxial vibration unit. Therefore, based on the combination of the artificial intelligence algorithm and the multiple characteristics, the type of the engineering machinery equipment and the vibration source position of the external breaking behavior are accurately identified, and the monitoring accuracy is improved.
assignees: LINZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;ZHENGZHOU XINGONG INTELLIGENT SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Multimode compound life detection system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency rescue and discloses a multimode composite life detection system which comprises a radar detection module, an infrared sensor module, an acoustic detection module, a central processing unit and a data processing and signal fusion module, wherein the radar detection module is used for detecting surrounding environment through radar signals and identifying the position and existence of a target, the infrared sensor module is used for detecting the body temperature change of a life body through temperature difference, the acoustic detection module is used for detecting weak sound signals of the life body through sound collection and analysis, the central processing unit is used for coordinating the work of each module, receiving and processing signals from different detection modules and carrying out signal fusion and judging the existence of the life body, and the data processing and signal fusion module is used for receiving the signals of each detection module. According to the invention, through multi-mode composite detection, environment adaptability modeling, wireless communication optimization and intelligent man-machine interaction interface, high-precision life detection, stable data transmission and high-efficiency operation response in a complex environment are realized, and rescue efficiency and accuracy are greatly improved.

title_en: Multi-target life detection method and system based on radar signals
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of life detection and discloses a multi-target life detection method based on radar signals, which comprises the following steps of firstly, collecting multi-target mixed signals received by a radar and preprocessing the signals; the method comprises the steps of carrying out phase space reconstruction on a preprocessed signal to obtain Gao Weixiang space tracks, constructing a self-adaptive dictionary, carrying out sparse representation on the signal, and separating primary vital sign signals of all targets from a mixed signal through a sparse optimization algorithm. The application adopts the technical scheme of fusion of the multi-band radar signals and the deep learning, and achieves the technical effect of high-precision separation of multi-target vital sign signals in a complex electromagnetic environment. Compared with the technical scheme of relying on single frequency band or fixed threshold classification in the prior art, the method solves the defects of serious signal aliasing and low separation precision in dense barriers or multi-target mixed scenes.

title_en: Three-dimensional positioning life detection radar system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of radars and discloses a three-dimensional positioning life detection radar system which comprises a phased array antenna unit, a signal receiving unit, a Doppler frequency shift analysis module, a target motion analysis module, a three-dimensional reconstruction module and a deep learning module, wherein the phased array antenna unit is used for transmitting radar waves and dynamically adjusting the beam direction according to the position of a target, the signal receiving unit is used for receiving radar signals reflected by the target, the Doppler frequency shift analysis module is used for analyzing the frequency change of the received radar signals and extracting micro-motion signals of the target, the target motion analysis module is used for tracking the motion of the target through a Kalman filtering technology, the three-dimensional reconstruction module is used for reconstructing the three-dimensional position of the target through an electromagnetic field integral equation and multi-source sensor information fusion according to the received signals, and the deep learning module is used for identifying the micro-motion signals and optimizing target classification. By adopting the phased array antenna unit and the beam forming technology, the technical effects of accurately three-dimensionally scanning the target and quickly adjusting the dynamic beam are achieved.
assignees: BEIJING SHENGBOLAN AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Walking state vital sign monitoring method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for monitoring vital signs in a walking state, and relates to the technical field of vital sign monitoring. The method comprises the steps of determining an anchor distance gate according to the first K frames in N frames of FMCW radar echo signals, and respectively executing processing steps on each frame of FMCW radar echo signals after the K frames to obtain a plurality of third signals and a plurality of target distance gates, further determining a plurality of second signals, further determining respiratory frequency and heartbeat frequency, and sending the respiratory frequency and the heartbeat frequency to an upper computer to monitor vital signs of a human body. The processing steps comprise updating the anchor range gate according to the target range gate corresponding to the last frame of the FMCW radar echo signal of the current frame, determining the target range gate according to the plurality of first signals and the anchor range gate, and determining the third signal according to the plurality of first signals and the target range gate. The method and the device can solve the problem that vital signs of a human body in a walking state are difficult to accurately monitor, enlarge the applicable scene of vital sign monitoring, and improve the accuracy of vital sign monitoring.

title_en: Multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning system and positioning method
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of emergency rescue, disaster search and rescue and life detection positioning, and discloses a multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning system which comprises a sensor array module, a multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning method and a multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning system, wherein the sensor array module is composed of a plurality of sensors of different types and is used for collecting environment data in a target area, the multi-sensor fusion life detection positioning method comprises the following steps of S1, deploying a multi-type sensor array in the target area to collect the environment data of the target area, S2, conducting noise filtering and signal enhancement processing on the original data collected by the sensors, and extracting key characteristics of a living body. According to the application, through self-adaptive multi-mode fusion, deep learning feature recognition, nonlinear TDOA optimization and reinforcement learning path planning, the problems of single sensor failure, low signal-to-noise ratio erroneous judgment, complex environment positioning error, static path planning hysteresis and the like are solved, the accuracy of life detection and rescue response efficiency are improved, and the method is suitable for extreme disaster environments.
assignees: BEIJING SHENGBOLAN AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire-retardant high temperature resistant fire control respirator with life monitoring function
abstract_en: The application provides a flame-retardant high-temperature-resistant fire-fighting respirator with a life monitoring function, which comprises a heat-insulating hood and a breathing mask connected with the heat-insulating hood, wherein the heat-insulating hood comprises a flame-retardant reflecting layer, a polyimide fiber sponge heat-insulating filling layer, a phase-change material temperature-regulating layer and a moisture-absorbing quick-drying cotton layer which are sequentially arranged from outside to inside, a transparent window is arranged in the middle of the breathing mask, an air inlet hole and an air outlet valve are arranged at the lower part of the breathing mask, the air inlet hole is communicated with a filtering and life signal monitoring device, a friction layer and an electrode layer are arranged in the filtering and life signal monitoring device, and the fire-fighting respirator further comprises a signal collecting and transmitting device connected with the filtering and life signal monitoring device through signals. The application has high-efficiency filtering effect, low respiratory resistance, excellent air permeability, flame retardant property and high temperature resistance, and can dynamically monitor the respiratory rate, strength and position information of a wearer through a high-efficiency friction electric sensor structure, thereby improving the safety guarantee of personnel in a fire scene.

title_en: Multi-sensor fusion life detection system based on handheld display and control terminal
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of life detection and discloses a multi-sensor fusion life detection system based on a handheld display control terminal, which comprises a sensor group, a sensor control module and a control module, wherein the sensor group is used for collecting vital sign signals and environmental parameters and comprises a thermal infrared imager, an audio vibration sensor, a radar wave detector and an environmental sensor; the data processing module is connected with the sensor group and is used for carrying out noise filtering and feature extraction on the data acquired by the sensor group. The application adopts the multi-sensor collaborative detection and data fusion technology, and achieves the technical effect of detecting vital signs in real time and accurately in a complex environment. Compared with the detection method of a single sensor in the prior art, the method can be used for carrying out complementation and fusion on the data of a plurality of sensors on a disaster site, so that the reliability and the accuracy of detection are obviously improved, and the problem of detection blind areas of the traditional method under the conditions of environmental noise and interference is solved.
assignees: BEIJING SHENGBOLAN AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Driver health monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring and early warning the health of a driver, which belong to the technical field of intelligent cabins of automobiles, wherein the method comprises the steps of calling camera data in a DMS (digital management system) in the intelligent cabin, positioning the chest of the driver and obtaining three-position coordinates of the chest part of the driver in a cabin space; the method comprises the steps of combining three-dimensional coordinates positioned on a thoracic cavity part, adjusting a millimeter wave radar integrated in a steering wheel to send radar signals, receiving echo signals of the radar signals after interference of movement of a fluctuation cavity of the thoracic cavity part, extracting respiratory signals and heartbeat signals in real time based on the echo signals to obtain vital sign signals, extracting features of the vital sign signals to obtain vital sign parameters, analyzing the vital sign parameters, and sending an abnormality processing request when the vital sign parameters exceed a threshold value. The method analyzes the cardiopulmonary data of the driver and judges the occurrence of crisis abnormal conditions such as the suppressed respiration and the heart beat pause in advance.

title_en: Health monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a health monitoring system and method, the system comprising an indoor device equipped with a sensor module, a processor communicatively connected to the sensor module, an alarm system, and a user interface. The embodiment of the invention discloses breakthrough integration of radar technology and artificial intelligence in common household equipment (ceiling fans). The system consists of a seamlessly integrated radar module and decorative radome, turning the fan into a discreet and unobtrusive health-monitoring device. The radar module remotely transmits signals to the monitoring area, captures signals reflected from the individual's body, and provides continuous real-time data regarding vital signs such as heart rate and respiratory rate. Such information, when processed by the artificial intelligence processor, enables the system to detect abnormal conditions, triggering an alert communicated to the user through the user interface. The novel system can adapt to different living environments and has deployment flexibility, and a new era of comprehensive, continuous and user-friendly health monitoring is created.
assignees: AIHUI INTELLIGENT TECH ZHONGSHAN CO LTD

title_en: Monitoring systems and methods for the health and safety of infants/elderly people
title_ko: 유아/노약자의 건강 및 안전을 위한 모니터링 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a monitoring system and a monitoring method for health and safety of infants/the elderly. According to the present invention, a monitoring system for health and safety of infants/the elderly comprises: a sensor unit for sensing the health and indoor environment of infants or the elderly; a monitoring unit for monitoring the health state and sleep environment of infants or the elderly by analyzing sensing data on the health and indoor environment sensed through the sensor unit; and a communication unit for transmitting monitoring information on the health state and sleep environment to a guardian terminal. the sensor unit includes at least one of a general image CCD sensor for photographing a general image, a thermal image sensor for detecting body temperature, a radar sensor for detecting respiration, and a microphone for detecting voice.
abstract_ko: 유아/노약자의 건강 및 안전을 위한 모니터링 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다.  본 발명에 따른 유아/노약자의 건강 및 안전을 위한 모니터링 시스템은 유아나 노약자의 건강 및 실내 환경을 감지하는 센서부, 상기 센서부를 통해 감지된 건강 및 실내 환경에 관한 센싱 데이터를 분석하여 유아나 노약자의 건강 상태 및 수면 환경을 모니터링하는 모니터링부, 및 상기 건강 상태 및 수면 환경에 관한 모니터링 정보를 보호자 단말기에 전송하는 통신부를 포함하고, 상기 센서부는 일반 영상을 촬영하는 일반 영상 CCD 센서, 체온 감지를 위한 열화상 센서, 호흡 감지를 위한 레이다 센서, 및 음성 감지를 위한 마이크 중 적어도 하나를 포함한다.

title_en: Subway foundation pit construction pipeline subsides monitoring devices
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pipeline settlement monitoring, and discloses a subway foundation pit construction pipeline settlement monitoring device which comprises a base, wherein the base is provided with a guide rail hoisting assembly and a guide rail overturning assembly, the guide rail hoisting assembly is provided with a guide rail formed by butt joint combination of multiple sections, the guide rail is parallel to the side wall of a subway foundation pit and extends downwards, the tail end of the guide rail is provided with a vertically-displaced lift car, and one side of the lift car facing the subway foundation pit is provided with a ground penetrating radar. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages that the device is not contacted with the pipeline, the pipeline is not damaged, a plurality of pipelines with different depths can be scanned in the vertical movement process of the ground penetrating radar, the guide rail can be butted and prolonged, the pipeline with larger buried depth can be monitored, the laser target and the laser range finder are adopted to realize accurate perception of elevation, the vertical position of the laser target is maintained by the liquid level in the static level, a stable measuring reference surface can be provided, and the accuracy of settlement monitoring is ensured.
assignees: NORTHWEST RES INST CO LTD CREC;NANCHANG RAIL TRANSIT GROUP CO LTD METRO PROJECT MAN BRANCH;BEIJING URBAN CONSTR ENG CONSULT CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign detection circuit and device
abstract_en: The circuit comprises a power supply unit, a Doppler sensor unit, a primary filtering unit, a signal processing unit, an input and output unit, a communication unit and a display unit, wherein the power supply unit is used for providing three direct current voltages of 5V, 3.3V and 1.65V for the whole circuit, the Doppler sensor unit is used for acquiring vital sign original signals and generating I signals and Q signals, the primary filtering unit comprises an I signal primary filtering amplifying circuit and a Q signal primary filtering amplifying circuit which respectively conduct primary filtering amplification on the I signals and the Q signals, the signal processing unit is used for processing the signals after filtering amplification and transmitting the signals to a control end and receiving control instructions of the control end, the input and output unit is used for providing general input and output ports, the communication unit is used for providing an external communication channel for the signal processing unit, and the display unit is used for providing indication lamp display. The device comprises a PCB provided with the vital sign detection circuit. The application solves the problem of poor signal filtering effect in the prior art, and obtains the signal with higher gain and smaller noise.
assignees: SHANDONG WORLD BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD;SHANDONG HANFU HEFENG BIOTECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Small emergency first-aid machine with remote video consultation function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication, in particular to a small emergency first-aid machine with a remote video consultation function. The system comprises a pavement detection unit, an information acquisition unit, a vital sign monitoring unit, a video consultation unit, a remote video module and a response scheduling unit, wherein the pavement detection unit is used for monitoring pavement conditions in real time based on a pavement detection sensor module and ensuring that a patient obtains emergency rescue in the shortest time, the information acquisition unit is used for recording and managing personal information and symptom description of the patient based on an information management module, the vital sign monitoring unit is used for monitoring and analyzing vital signs of the patient by applying an anomaly detection algorithm based on data acquired by the information acquisition unit, the video consultation unit is used for establishing video connection with a remote doctor by the remote video module based on the analysis result of the vital sign monitoring unit and performing consultation on the patient, and the response scheduling unit is used for performing emergency treatment on the patient based on the consultation result of the video consultation unit and planning subsequent medical treatment. The professional guidance of a remote doctor is obtained through video consultation, and the emergency treatment quality is improved.

title_en: Oxygen generator breathing optimization system and method, oxygen generator and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field related to oxygen generation control, and particularly relates to an oxygen generator breathing optimization system, an oxygen generator, a storage medium, a breathing detection pressure sensor for detecting the breathing frequency of a wearer, an oxygen storage container for storing oxygen generated by an oxygen generation module, an electromagnetic valve arranged on an oxygen delivery pipe communicated with the oxygen storage container, a blood oxygen saturation and heart rate detection sensor for detecting blood oxygen saturation and heart rate data of the wearer, and a control module electrically connected with the breathing detection pressure sensor, the electromagnetic valve and the blood oxygen saturation and heart rate detection sensor, wherein the control module is configured to be suitable for controlling the valve opening time and the valve opening frequency of the electromagnetic valve according to the detected breathing frequency and the detected blood oxygen saturation and heart rate data. The invention can be used to adapt the oxygen output or shut down to the breathing rhythm of the wearer.

title_en: Brain function composite monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of brain function monitoring, in particular to a brain function compound monitoring system, which comprises an infrared and radar common-caliber antenna, a receiving module, a signal processing module and an alarm module, wherein the receiving module is connected with the infrared and radar common-caliber antenna and comprises a high-sensitivity extremely-low frequency receiver and an infrared detector, the signal processing module comprises an AD plate, a signal processing plate, a data processing plate and a data exchange plate, the data storage module is used for storing vital sign and brain wave characteristic data of a monitored object, and the alarm module is used for sending out early warning signals when detecting that the vital sign or consciousness state of the monitored object is abnormal. The system is suitable for hospitalization, home rehabilitation and elderly patient monitoring, and provides important support for emergency treatment and accurate medical treatment.

title_en: Health monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of health detection, in particular to health monitoring equipment, which comprises a monitor and a monitoring mechanism, wherein the monitoring mechanism is arranged in the monitor, the monitoring mechanism comprises a physical sign detector, a camera, an infrared transmitting tube, an infrared receiving tube and an infrared temperature measuring probe, the infrared transmitting tube and the infrared receiving tube are used for detecting the distance between a user and the monitoring equipment, the infrared transmitting tube is used for transmitting infrared rays in a specific wavelength range, the infrared receiving tube is used for receiving the reflected infrared rays and converting the infrared rays into electric signals to measure the distance, and the infrared temperature measuring probe is used for measuring the temperature of the surface of the user or an object in a non-contact mode.
