According to the utility model, through infrared ranging, infrared temperature measurement, UWB radar vital sign monitoring and camera real-time monitoring technologies, the health condition and working state of a user can be comprehensively monitored, and the accuracy and stability of a measurement result are ensured by adopting infrared rays and UWB radar technologies with specific wavelengths.

title_en: Treadmill breath detection device based on forward scattering radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forward scattering radar-based treadmill respiration detection device, which relates to the field of respiration signal monitoring and comprises a treadmill transmitting device and a receiving monitoring device, wherein the treadmill transmitting device is provided with a transmitting antenna, a high-definition display screen, the receiving monitoring device comprises a receiving antenna, a Lime SDR, an edge computing device and a high-resolution camera, the edge computing device comprises a personal computer, a raspberry pie and other development boards, and the outer wall of the edge computing device is provided with the high-definition display screen. According to the invention, through the cooperation of the transmitting and receiving antenna and the high-resolution camera, the radar scattering cross section change (RCS) of abdominal change during human respiration is monitored, so that the signal amplitude change is transmitted to the edge computing equipment, the respiratory frequency during exercise is displayed, the defect that the existing running machine cannot monitor the respiratory frequency of a user in real time is overcome, the influence on the training effect or the exercise risk caused by the incapability of adjusting the exercise intensity in time is avoided, and the effective and accurate detection of the respiratory signal based on the chest and abdomen exercise signal is realized.

title_en: FMCW-based vital sign monitoring method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a vital sign monitoring method, device and equipment based on FMCW and a storage medium, relating to the field of vital sign monitoring. The method comprises the steps of receiving multi-frame FMCW radar echo signals, respectively executing processing steps on the multi-frame FMCW radar echo signals to obtain a plurality of third signals and a plurality of target motion phases corresponding to the third signals, determining a plurality of second signals according to the plurality of third signals and the plurality of target motion phases, further determining respiration and heartbeat frequencies and sending the respiration and heartbeat frequencies to an upper computer to monitor vital signs of a human body, and determining target motion phases and target distance gates according to the plurality of first signals, and determining third signals and phase values of the third signals according to the plurality of first signals and the target distance gates, wherein the third signals are average signals of the first signals located in the target distance gates. The problem that the accuracy of monitoring vital signs is not high when the RBM of faster speed appears in the human body in the prior art can be solved to this disclosure, improves the accuracy of monitoring vital signs.

title_en: Intermediate frequency signal phase demodulation method under low signal-to-noise ratio condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intermediate frequency signal phase demodulation method under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio, which belongs to the technical field of millimeter wave radar non-contact vital sign detection, and the method reserves key information of a phase signal and provides rich characteristic representation through gram transformation, so that noise components without fixed modes are restrained; the phase demodulation network adopts an asymmetric U-Net structure, so that the complexity of the network is reduced, the signal demodulation precision is not reduced while the low calculation amount is realized, and the introduced SwinTransformer module and dynamic convolution attention module enhance the noise suppression capability and the signal detail capturing capability of the network. The invention has stronger anti-noise performance and accurate phase demodulation effect under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio, remarkably reduces the estimated deviation of heart rate in millimeter wave radar vital sign detection, and has wide application prospect in the research of non-contact vital sign detection.

title_en: Vital sign collaborative monitoring system based on multi-band reconfigurable radar array
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign collaborative monitoring system based on a multi-band reconfigurable radar array, which breaks through the limitation of fixed frequency bands, adopts a 20-80GHz adjustable radar module on a horizontal layer, integrates a rotatable waveguide structure and an MEMS phase array, deploys 45-300GHz photon radar on a vertical layer, and combines an optical comb generator to realize continuous frequency modulation. The system automatically matches a penetration mode (24 GHz), a high-precision mode (60 GHz) and a multi-target mode (77 GHz) through a dynamic spectrum sensing and beam forming algorithm. Innovative definition of frequency band combination mathematical constraint conditions (fV/fH is more than or equal to 1.5) covers existing and future potential frequency band combinations. The application scene covers the metal environment penetration monitoring of hospitals, the dense target separation of the aged communities and the safety monitoring of the industrial high-humidity environment.
assignees: GUANGZHOU LINGHAO SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Eco-friendly an ant nest device using seawater
title_ko: 해수를 이용한 친환경 개미집 침수장치
abstract_en: Provided is an eco-friendly ant nest flooding apparatus using seawater, which comprises: a boundary object having a predetermined height on the ground and disposed to surround a hole connected to an ant nest; a seawater storage device connected to an upper end of the boundary object and supplying seawater to an area set by the boundary object through an opening and closing hole; a control device controlling opening and closing of the opening and closing hole; a camera transmitting photographing data obtained by photographing the area to the control device; and a ground-penetrating radar (GPR) device irradiating electromagnetic waves to the ground and analyzing the received electromagnetic waves to determine characteristics of the ant nest below the ground, wherein the control device includes at least one processor. According to an embodiment of the present invention, an apparatus for analyzing the structure of an ant nest using ground-penetrating radar may be provided.
abstract_ko:
본원 발명의 지반 투시를 이용한 개미집 침수 장치는 지면 상에서 일정 높이를 가지며 개미집과 연결된 구멍을 둘러싸도록 배치되는 경계물; 상기 경계물의 상단과 연결되고, 개폐홀을 통해 상기 경계물에 의해 설정된 일 영역에 해수를 공급하는 해수 저장 장치; 상기 개폐홀의 개폐를 제어하는 제어 장치; 상기 일 영역을 촬영한 촬영 데이터를 상기 제어 장치에 전송하는 카메라; 및 상기 지면에 전자기파를 조사하고, 수신된 전자기파를 분석하여 상기 지면 아래의 상기 개미집의 특성을 결정하는 지반 투시 레이더(GPR) 장치를 포함하고, 상기 제어 장치는 적어도 하나 이상의 프로세서를 포함하고, 상기 적어도 하나 이상의 프로세서는, 상기 촬영 데이터를 제1 인공지능 모델에 입력하고, 상기 제1 인공지능 모델로부터 획득한 판단 결과에 기초하여 상기 카메라가 촬영한 개미가 외래종인지 여부를 판단할 수 있다. 
본원 발명의 실시로, 살충제에 포함된 유해 화학 물질의 사용을 줄여 토양 생태계를 보전할 수 있다. 
또한, 유해 외래종 개미를 해수로 제거하는 방법을 실용화하여 환경 및 토양 생태계의 파괴를 방지할 수 있다.
assignees: SHINIL ENG & CONSULTANT CO LTD;SHINIL ENV CO LTD

title_en: Meditation chair and booth being individually optimized according to user mental and physical condition
title_ko: 사용자의 정신적, 신체적 상태에 따라 개인 최적화되는 명상 의자 및 부스
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to enable anyone to easily meditate by transforming a chair or creating a meditation environment according to a user's mental and physical state. The weight and pressure sensor, bio-signal detection sensor, air bag cushion, drive unit are set up in the pelvis, buttocks, thigh, knee supporting part and the optimized meditation posture is provided according to the state of the user, and the bio-signal can be measured and the size and position of the supporting part can be controlled.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따르면, 사용자의 정신적, 신체적 상태에 따라 개인 최적화되는 명상 의자에 있어서, 상기 사용자의 골반을 지지하도록 구성된 골반 지지부; 상기 사용자의 둔부를 지지하도록 구성된 둔부 지지부; 상기 사용자의 허벅지를 지지하도록 구성된 허벅지 지지부; 상기 사용자의 무릎을 지지하도록 구성된 무릎 지지부; 상기 골반 지지부, 상기 둔부 지지부, 상기 허벅지 지지부 및 상기 무릎 지지부 중 적어도 하나에 설치되고, 설치된 위치에서 상기 사용자의 무게 및 압력을 측정하도록 구성된 적어도 하나의 무게 감지 센서 및 압력 센서; 상기 골반 지지부, 상기 둔부 지지부, 상기 허벅지 지지부 및 상기 무릎 지지부 중 적어도 하나에 설치되고, 설치된 위치에서 상기 사용자의 생체 신호를 감지하도록 구성된 적어도 하나의 생체 신호 감지 센서 - 상기 적어도 하나의 생체 신호 감지 센서는 심전도를 측정하도록 구성된 ECG 센서, 광용적맥파를 측정하도록 구성된 PPG 센서 및 피부 전도율을 측정하도록 구성된 GSR 센서 중 적어도 하나를 포함함 -; 상기 골반 지지부, 상기 둔부 지지부, 상기 허벅지 지지부 및 상기 무릎 지지부 중 적어도 하나에 설치되고, 상기 골반 지지부, 상기 둔부 지지부, 상기 허벅지 지지부 및 상기 무릎 지지부 중 적어도 하나의 크기를 조절하기 위해 에어 펌프에 의해 수축 또는 팽창하도록 구성된 적어도 하나의 에어백 쿠션; 및 상기 골반 지지부, 상기 둔부 지지부, 상기 허벅지 지지부 및 상기 무릎 지지부 중 적어도 하나에 설치되고, 상기 골반 지지부, 상기 둔부 지지부, 상기 허벅지 지지부 및 상기 무릎 지지부 중 적어도 하나의 위치를 이동시키도록 구성된 적어도 하나의 구동 장치를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Apparatus for predicting disease based on sleep analysis installed in senior house
title_ko: 노인 주택 내 설치되는 수면분석기반의 질병예측장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a sleep analysis-based disease prediction device installed in an elderly house. The sleep analysis-based disease prediction device according to an embodiment of the present invention may comprise: a biosignal sensor which can be installed in an elderly house, is installed in a bedroom, and remotely measures the heart rate or respiration of a sleeper to generate biosignal data; and a sleep analysis unit which analyzes the sleep pattern of the sleeper based on the biosignal data, and generates an alarm message when a disease suspicion pattern is determined from the sleep pattern.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 노인 주택 내 설치되는 수면분석기반의 질병예측장치에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 의한 수면분석기반의 질병예측장치는 노인 주택 내 설치될 수 있으며, 침실 내 설치되어, 원격으로 수면자의 심박 또는 호흡을 측정하여 생체신호 데이터를 생성하는 생체신호 센서; 및 상기 생체신호 데이터를 기반으로 상기 수면자의 수면패턴을 분석하고, 상기 수면패턴으로부터 질병의심패턴이 판별되면, 알람 메시지를 생성하는 수면분석부를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: CHEIL ELECTRIC WIRING DEVICES CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for enhancing through-wall radar signal of human body movement
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a device for enhancing a through-wall radar signal of human body movement, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a through-wall spectrogram to be enhanced; and inputting the through-wall spectrogram to be enhanced into a generator in a spectrogram processing-based network model to obtain an enhanced through-wall spectrogram so as to monitor human body movement. The training method of the network model comprises the steps of training a pre-training model through a free space spectrogram and a corresponding free space turning spectrogram in a data set, inputting a through-wall spectrogram into a generator to obtain a corresponding enhanced through-wall spectrogram, inputting the enhanced through-wall spectrogram and a non-paired free space spectrogram into the trained pre-training model to respectively obtain a corresponding channel dimension autocorrelation matrix, inputting the enhanced through-wall spectrogram and the non-paired free space spectrogram into a discriminator to obtain a discrimination result, constructing a loss function to optimize the generator and the discriminator, enabling the generator to carry out signal enhancement, and improving the accuracy of downstream semantic recognition.

title_en: Frequency estimation method, storage medium and device based on rootMUSIC and signal dimension conversion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of biological signal processing, in particular to a frequency estimation method, a storage medium and equipment based on rootMUSIC and signal dimension conversion. The method comprises the steps of modeling chest displacement signals extracted from radar echoes into the sum of sine waves with integral multiple frequencies of basic respiration and heart rate, generating corresponding single-channel analysis signals through Hilbert transformation, converting the single-channel analysis signals into multi-channel data through a signal rearrangement method, enabling chest wall signal models to be equivalent to uniform linear array multi-snapshot receiving signal models, enabling vital sign frequencies to be in one-to-one correspondence with the arrival directions of signal sources, processing the receiving data of the multi-snapshot receiving signal models through an alternate direction multiplier method frame, solving denoised signal matrixes, and carrying out frequency estimation on the denoised signal matrixes by using rootMUSIC algorithm to calculate roots. The invention converts the signal model, so that the frequency estimation range is equivalent to the angle estimation range, and the frequency estimation precision is improved.

title_en: Intelligent wearable underwear-based vital sign real-time monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a vital sign real-time monitoring method and system based on intelligent wearing underwear, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring vital sign data of a user based on a sensor integrated in the intelligent wearing underwear, acquiring a current exercise activity state of the user through an accelerometer and a gyroscope built in the intelligent wearing underwear, acquiring a vital sign data threshold of the user based on the current exercise activity state of the user, vital sign data change of the user in a preset time window and vital sign data of the user in the same time period, sending out early warning when the vital sign data of the user exceeds the threshold, acquiring abnormal vital sign data of the user sending out early warning, training an abnormal prediction model based on the abnormal vital sign data of the user, and predicting abnormal conditions of the vital sign of the user based on the abnormal prediction model. By the method and the corresponding system, the state of the user is considered to customize the vital sign data threshold value for each user, and the monitoring accuracy is improved.
assignees: TIANJIN FURUIXING HEALTH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact heart rate variability detection method based on improved variational modal decomposition and modal selection criteria
abstract_en: The invention discloses an HRV estimation method of a millimeter wave radar. Firstly, the human body is positioned by utilizing the distance resolution characteristic of the FMCW radar, and noise and interference existing in echo signals are preprocessed. Secondly, a gray wolf optimization algorithm is introduced, and a traditional variation modal decomposition method is optimized by taking the maximum mutual information coefficient and the minimum reconstruction error as fitness functions, so that the self-adaptive separation of vital sign signals is realized. And simultaneously, a mode selection criterion based on the correlation coefficient is provided to select the optimal heartbeat component from the decomposed modes. Finally, extracting a time parameter corresponding to the heartbeat peak, further obtaining IBI, and calculating the time-frequency domain characteristics of the HRV through the IBI. The invention effectively extracts the heartbeat signal through an improved mode decomposition method and a mode selection criterion, thereby realizing high-precision estimation of heart rate variability.

title_en: Non-contact respiration monitoring method, device, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of vital sign monitoring, and provides a non-contact respiration monitoring method, equipment, a system and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of controlling a radar sensor to emit signals to an object to be detected, receiving echo signals through reflection, identifying frequency characteristics of first interference information in the echo signals and time sequence information of the frequency characteristics, wherein the first interference information is used for representing random motion interference of the object to be detected, and eliminating the first interference information in the echo signals according to the frequency characteristics of the first interference information and the time sequence information of the frequency characteristics to obtain target respiration monitoring signals, and the target respiration monitoring signals are used for representing respiratory frequency. By implementing the scheme, more reliable and accurate monitoring results can be obtained.
assignees: WUHAN UNITED IMAGING ZHIRONG MED TECH CO LTD

title_en: Accident Prevention System for Elderly Living Alone
title_ko: 독거노인 사고방지 시스템
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a system for detecting an emergency dangerous situation for the elderly living alone including an emergency dangerous situation detection server, a gateway, a radar sensor, a motion detection sensor, and a pressure sensor comprises: an emergency dangerous situation detection server which applies a video image received from the gateway to a pre-generated learning model for detecting a dangerous situation, provides an emergency risk prediction grade for the elderly living alone according to a posture of the elderly living alone with respect to the video image extracted from the learning model for detecting a dangerous situation to an emergency dangerous situation monitoring device through the gateway, and provides an emergency dangerous situation notification message for the elderly living alone to a manager terminal according to the emergency risk prediction grade for the elderly living alone; a radar sensor which is installed in a residence of the elderly living alone, generates an impulse signal, radiates the same through a transmission antenna, generates a bio-signal value according to a reflection signal for the radiated signal, and provides the same to the gateway; a gateway which, when receiving the bio-signal value from the radar sensor, generates a video image at the moment when an emergency dangerous situation occurs according to the bio-signal value, provides the same to the emergency dangerous situation detection server, and determines whether there is an emergency dangerous situation for the elderly living alone according to the emergency risk prediction grade for the elderly living alone received from the emergency dangerous situation detection server; and an emergency dangerous situation monitoring device which receives and stores a monitoring result for the elderly living alone registered in the emergency dangerous situation detection server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 응급 위험 상황 감지 서버, 게이트웨이, 레이더 센서, 동작 감지 센서, 압력 센서를 포함하는 독거노인 응급 위험 상황 감지 시스템은 게이트웨이로부터 수신된 영상 이미지를 미리 생성된위험 상황 감지용 학습 모델에 적용한 후 상기 위험 상황 감지용 학습 모델로부터 추출된 영상 이미지에 대한 독거노인 자세에 따른 독거노인 응급 위험 예측 등급을 상기 게이트웨이를 통해 상기 응급 위험 상황 모니터링 장치에 제공하고, 상기 독거노인 응급 위험 예측 등급에 따라 관리자 단말에 독거노인 응급 위험 상황 알림 메시지를 제공하는 응급 위험 상황 감지 서버, 독거노인의 거주지에 설치되며 임펄스 신호를 생성하여 송신 안테나를 통해 방사하고, 상기 방사된 신호에 대한 반사 신호에 따라 생체 신호 값을 생성하여 상기 게이트웨이에 제공하는 레이더 센서, 상기 레이더 센서로부터 생체 신호 값을 수신하면 상기 생체 신호 값에 따라 응급 위험 상황이 발생한 순간의 영상 이미지를 생성하여 상기 응급 위험 상황 감지 서버에 제공하고, 상기 응급 위험 상황감지 서버로부터 수신된 독거노인 응급 위험 예측 등급에 따라 독거노임 응급 위험 상황 여부를 판단하는 게이트웨이 및 상기 응급 위험 상황 감지 서버에 등록된 독거노인에 대한 모니터링 결과를 수신하여 저장하는 응급위험 상황 모니터링 장치를 포함한다.
assignees: LEE JONG HWA;OH YOU JIN;YUN JU YOUNG;CHOI BEOM SOO

title_en: Sleep quality assessment method and system based on non-contact UWB radar vital sign signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sleep quality assessment method and a sleep quality assessment system based on a non-contact UWB radar vital sign signal, and relates to the technical field of sleep quality assessment, and the method specifically comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring vital sign data; the method comprises the steps of acquiring vital sign data in the sleeping process of a human body through a non-contact UWB radar, wherein the vital sign data comprise heart rate, respiratory rate, distance, body movement and body energy, S2, processing the vital sign data in S1, and performing clustering analysis and feature processing on the vital sign data in each T time from a starting point of a specified monitoring time interval through setting a time judging window T to obtain a sleeping state sequence in each T time and a time-sharing sequence of the sleeping state. The sleep mode is monitored uninterruptedly for a long time in a non-contact way, the sleep is not affected, privacy invasion is avoided, a personalized sleep health file is established for the user, the user can detect the related problems of sleep disorder in advance, and the effective reference basis is provided for treatment by a follow-up doctor.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign sleep monitoring method and device based on UWB radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact vital sign sleep monitoring method and device based on UWB radar, and relates to the technical field of UWB radar sleep monitoring, comprising the following steps of (a) switching on a power supply and installing a sleep monitoring device, wherein the front face of the device faces to the angular position of the chest of a human body and the sleep activity range area; and (c) acquiring radar wave signals of the UWB radar module by a signal processing module arranged in the sleep monitoring device, processing the radar echo signals by clutter cancellation, adaptive filtering denoising and a slow time-frequency domain analysis method, and calculating vital sign data. The device has the characteristics of strong penetrating power, high accuracy, good stability and low use complexity, and provides better sleep monitoring experience for users.

title_en: Real-time through-wall human body posture estimation method based on WIFI equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of infinite perception and human body posture estimation, and discloses a real-time through-wall human body posture estimation method based on WIFI equipment, which comprises the following steps: the system is deployed, wherein an emitter and a receiver are carried with an inter5300 network card and a plurality of emitter antennas, an emitter and a receiver are respectively arranged on two sides of a wall body, the emitter is provided with a synchronous camera, the receiver receives reflected CSI passing through an indoor human body and surrounding wall bodies, the camera synchronously collects video data, and a data set is manufactured by aligning the CSI data frame and the video frame by utilizing time stamps of the CSI and the video frame according to the collected channel state information CSI signals and the video frames. Through arranging the WiFi transmitting end and the WiFi receiving end on two sides of the wall body and carrying corresponding artificial neural network models, non-contact human body posture estimation is achieved, and the effects of through-wall human body recognition and posture estimation through wireless signals are achieved.

title_en: Impulse radar device and method
abstract_en: A miniaturized impulse radar is provided. The radar uses a slight frequency difference between a local oscillator and an RF signal to generate high quality A- Scans using an inexpensive microcontroller's analog-to-digital converter. A DMA circuit is used to write analog-to-digital converter outputs to a buffer memory. The radar has applications in, for instance, ground penetrating radar for detecting buried utilities, automotive collision avoidance, autonomous robot navigation, and machine vision in general.

title_en: Multi-unit radar cooperative motion state and vital sign monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unit radar cooperative motion state and vital sign monitoring system and method. The system comprises an edge sensing node and an upper computer which are in communication connection, wherein the edge sensing node is provided with complete vital sign wireless sensing, signal resolving and communication capability, the upper computer is used for receiving information such as a target ID, a target position, a target vital sign, a target abnormal state and the like sent by the edge sensing node, the edge sensing node is composed of a microcontroller module, a radar sensor module, a DSP module, an FPGA neural network reasoning module, a communication module and a power supply module, the microcontroller module is respectively in communication connection with the radar sensor module, the DSP module and the FPGA neural network reasoning module, the radar sensor module is in communication connection with the DSP module, the DSP module is in communication connection with the FPGA neural network reasoning module, and the power supply module is used for supplying power to the edge sensing node. The method carries out the accurate tracking of the vital signs and the positions of the multiple targets, and realizes the accurate tracking of the health states of the multiple targets.

title_en: Method for monitoring coastal water area geological disasters by utilizing optical cable
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for monitoring geological disasters in a coastal water area by utilizing an optical cable, which is characterized in that when geological disasters occur in the coastal water area in a jurisdiction, an optical cable sensing technology is utilized, an optical fiber is used as a sensing medium, sensitivity is provided for external environment changes, environmental parameter changes are monitored through scattering effects of optical signals in the optical cable, the optical cable is laid along the coast and buried on the ground surface or underground of the coastal water area to cover a potential geological disaster area, an optical fiber sensor system is deployed, change signals such as displacement, vibration and strain of the optical cable in the coastal water area are collected in real time, a background optical transmission management system is used for monitoring field optical fiber equipment in real time, meanwhile, the real-time monitoring of the geological disasters in the coastal water area is considered, the geological conditions in the jurisdiction are dynamically sensed, and the optical cable sensing technology is combined with big data, the Internet of things and artificial intelligent analysis, so that the monitoring efficiency and the early warning precision of the geological disasters in the coastal water area can be obviously improved, and powerful guarantee is provided for channel safety.

title_en: Intelligent teaching lectern system based on multi-mode unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent teaching lectern system based on a multi-mode unmanned aerial vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of education equipment. The intelligent inspection system comprises a lectern body integrating a hidden unmanned cabin, a folding unmanned aerial vehicle provided with a multispectral sensor and an edge computing center, three functions are innovatively realized, namely, firstly, intelligent inspection, namely, unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous navigation (drawing precision + -3 cm) through laser SLAM, millimeter wave radar vital sign detection (respiratory frequency precision + -0.5 times/min) and thermal imaging abnormal positioning are fused, manual inspection is replaced, secondly, teaching enhancement is supported, AR knowledge point projection (brightness 500 nit) is supported, a multi-mode question answering system (dialect recognition rate is more than or equal to 95%) is realized, air touch interaction is realized through an ultrasonic array, thirdly, five-stage emergency response is realized, namely, an escape channel is opened from abnormal sign early warning to autonomous, and response delay is less than or equal to 2.5 seconds due to linkage of a spraying system and AED equipment.
assignees: GUANGZHOU LINGHAO SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode unmanned aerial vehicle cluster nursing system and deployment platform thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-scene unmanned aerial vehicle nursing system, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent health care. The system comprises a modularized duty workstation, a multi-mode unmanned aerial vehicle cluster and a central dispatching platform, and is innovatively provided with three main core functions, namely, firstly, elastic deployment, namely, dynamically adjusting the ratio of unmanned aerial vehicles (1:4-1:8) based on the number of beds, adopting a tidal charging strategy to ensure the continuous voyage of a high-risk area, enabling a single machine to cover 8 beds, greatly reducing equipment cost, secondly, non-contact monitoring, namely, integrating a 60GHz millimeter wave radar and a thermal imaging technology, realizing 2-meter vital sign monitoring, identifying 9 types of abnormal sounds such as pain and groan by voiceprint analysis, and thirdly, a five-stage emergency system, namely, automatically rechecking to opening an autonomous emergency channel, and obviously improving response speed compared with the traditional scheme. The intelligent monitoring system is suitable for places needing continuous monitoring such as nursing homes, hospitals, kindergartens, pet nursing centers and the like, and realizes the organic integration of intelligent patrol, health early warning and emergency response.
assignees: GUANGZHOU LINGHAO SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Arithmetic processing device for identifying location of buried long object using gpr data from array-type ground-penetrating radar device
abstract_en: To accurately identify a buried position and an extension direction even when an apex position of a hyperbolic reflection image is not located directly below data acquisition points.SOLUTION: GPR data are obtained by an array-type ground-penetrating radar device on the first, second, and third analysis lines, which extend in different directions and consist of data acquisition points. From a first angle between the first analysis line and the second analysis line and a second angle between the second analysis line and the third analysis line, a vertex position of a hyperbola of the GPR data on the first analysis line, and a first virtual propagation velocity, a second virtual propagation velocity, and a third virtual propagation velocity of the radio wave in the material below the first analysis line, the second analysis line, and the third analysis line are calculated, respectively. An oblique angle between a fourth straight line projected onto the ground from a long object and the first analysis line, an inclination angle between the long object and the ground, a buried depth from a first point located directly above the long object on the first analysis line to the long object directly below, and a position of the first point are calculated to identify the buried position and extension direction of the long object.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title_en: Sleep monitoring method and sleep monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a sleep monitoring method and sleep monitoring equipment. The sleep monitoring method comprises the steps of obtaining continuous multi-frame two-dimensional temperature images obtained by temperature monitoring of a sleeping scene through a two-dimensional temperature sensor, obtaining a spatial perception signal obtained by spatial perception of the sleeping scene through a body perception radar, wherein the body perception radar is a radar capable of perceiving body movement characteristics representing vital signs of an object, carrying out recognition processing on the multi-frame two-dimensional temperature images to obtain a gesture prediction sequence representing body gesture change of the object, carrying out joint recognition processing on the multi-frame two-dimensional temperature images and the spatial perception signal to obtain a sleep state prediction sequence representing sleep characteristic states of the object, and recognizing sleep time of the object based on the gesture prediction sequence and the sleep state prediction sequence. By adopting the scheme of the embodiment of the disclosure, the problem that the time for determining the object to fall asleep is inaccurate through the information representing the vital signs of the user can be found.
assignees: BEIJING GEWU CENTURY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency rescue personnel health state research and judgment device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for studying and judging the health state of emergency rescue workers, and relates to the technical field of human body protection. The intelligent fire extinguishing protective clothing comprises a fire extinguishing protective clothing body, a flexible sensing system, a communication system, a performance evaluation and safety early warning system and an individual soldier display system, wherein the performance evaluation and safety early warning system comprises a wide-temperature-range human body thermal reaction module, a skin burn module and a multi-source information fusion module, and the multi-source information fusion module comprises a feature extraction sub-module, a prediction sub-module, a conversion sub-module and a combination sub-module. The invention introduces an active protection technology, and through the comprehensive application of the wide-temperature-range human thermal reaction module, the skin burn module and the multi-source information fusion module, the space-time distribution of the toxic gas concentration in the rescue operation environment, the operation track and vital sign state of rescue workers can be displayed in real time, and the dangerous area classification, the accurate evaluation of the operation efficiency and the intelligent early warning of the health state can be performed based on the acquired data.

title_en: Precise rescue method for small earthquake space by utilizing miniature intelligent robot
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing, and provides an earthquake narrow space accurate rescue method by utilizing a microminiature intelligent robot. The method comprises the steps of obtaining millimeter wave Lei Dadian cloud data and infrared thermal imager thermal imaging data based on a target area, drawing up a ruin environment three-dimensional model according to the data and generating a passing path map, deploying a self-adaptive networking for the micro-robot cluster, carrying out structural stability assessment and residual vibration risk prediction by combining the map, distributing detection partitions and rescue tasks of the micro-robot cluster in real time based on an assessment result, introducing vital sign information, optimizing balanced distribution of the detection partitions and the tasks, and outputting a parallel scheduling strategy. The application solves the technical problems of low rescue efficiency and low precision in a narrow space caused by complex environment and incomplete perception data, and achieves the technical effects of utilizing a microminiature robot cluster to perform life search and rescue and task allocation in the narrow space and improving the precision and efficiency of earthquake rescue in the narrow space.

title_en: Underground space vehicle-mounted through-wall radar path optimization method based on improved ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimization method of an underground space vehicle-mounted through-wall radar path based on an improved ant colony algorithm, firstly, considering the specificity of an underground space, according to the distance of the unmanned vehicle motion path and the imaging quality of the three-dimensional through-wall radar, the self-adaptive rule of the heuristic function is designed, and the global searching performance and the convergence speed of the algorithm are balanced. Secondly, by solving the non-convex optimization problem under the multi-constraint conditions including path length, imaging quality, non-purity of the kene and the like, the environment perception, accurate imaging and path planning are ensured to be efficiently and accurately completed in a complex underground environment. The method can be applied to unmanned detection and target search and rescue in underground space, and has strong adaptability and high efficiency.

title_en: Life detection device used in collapses and under debris
abstract_en: The present disclosure is a life detection device comprising an outer and inner ring (2, 3) containing sensor units (9), speaker (14), wireless communication module (15) and similar data sensors and transmitters in order to detect life much faster after a disaster or accident, to perform more accurate search/rescue operations by detecting the locations of living beings trapped under collapse/debris, and to prioritise rescue operations after life status determinations are made upon the search. It is a life detection device that does not require any training or expertise, is single-use, has an outer cage (1 ) that protects the important parts inside and the circuit board (5) and allows it to roll, has a round shape, a flexible structure that can be rolled, and can easily move in collapsed areas and under debris.
assignees: SUELEYMAN DEMIREL UENIVERSITESI IDARI VE MALI ISLER DAIRE BASKANLIGI GENEL SEKRETERLIK

title_en: Satellite SAR reflector for landfill monitoring
title_ko: 위성 sar 데이터를 이용한 매립시설 유지관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a buried facility maintenance system using satellite aperture radar (sar) data, wherein a satellite sar signal reflection device for receiving a satellite signal is installed in a buried facility to obtain sar data, and the obtained sar data and measurement data obtained from various measurement modules integrally installed in the satellite sar signal reflection device can be used to accurately monitor ground subsidence, leachate level, methane gas concentration, odor, fine dust state, and the like of the buried facility.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 매립시설에 인공위성 신호를 수신하는 위성 SAR 신호 반사장치를 설치하여 합성개구레이더(SAR : Synthetic Aperture Radar) 데이터를 획득하고, 획득한 SAR 데이터와, 위성 SAR 신호 반사장치에 통합 설치되는 각종 측정모듈로부터 획득된 측정 데이터를 이용하여 매립시설의 지반 침하, 침출수 수위, 메탄 가스 농도, 냄새, 미세먼지 상태 등을 정확하게 모니터링할 수 있는 위성 SAR 데이터를 이용한 매립시설 유지관리 시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: Buried pipe detector using underground detection radar and wireless headphones
title_ko: 지중 탐지 레이더와 무선 헤드폰을 활용한 매립 배관 탐지기
abstract_en: The idea proposes a buried pipe detector developed to accurately detect pipes buried in the ground and prevent pipe damage. This idea is attached to the excavator bucket and integrates underground detection radar (gpr) and wireless headphones to deliver piping location information to the excavator pilot in real time.
abstract_ko: 본 아이디어는 지중에 매립된 배관을 정확하게 탐지하고 배관 훼손을 예방하기 위해 개발된 매립 배관 탐지기를 제안한다. 이 아이디어는 굴착기 버킷에 부착되며 지중 탐지 레이더(GPR)와 무선 헤드폰을 통합하여 배관 위치 정보를 실시간으로 굴착기 조종사에게 전달한다.

title_en: Earthquake detection system and method and application thereof in seismic surface survey
abstract_en: The invention provides a seismic detection system, a method and application thereof in seismic surface investigation, relating to the technical field of seismic exploration, comprising a detection well; the system comprises an optical fiber sensor, an optical fiber data acquisition module, an excitation device and a seismic source, wherein the optical fiber sensor is arranged in a detection well and/or buried on the ground, the optical fiber data acquisition module is connected with one end of the optical fiber sensor and used for providing a light source and acquiring detection data, the excitation device is arranged in the detection well and/or on the ground close to a wellhead of the detection well and used for forming the seismic source, and the problems in the seismic surface investigation technology in at least one prior art are solved.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;SINOPEC GEOPHYSICAL RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Hand Held Bio Signal Measuring Device and Method Using Radar
title_ko: 레이더를 이용한 핸드 헬드 생체 신호 측정 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus and a method for measuring a hand-held bio-signal using radar. The disclosed apparatus comprises: a handle; an IMU sensor coupled to the handle; and a radar device coupled to the handle, receiving speed information for each direction output from the IMU sensor to calculate a moving distance between a previous time point and a current time point, calculating a distance from a subject at the current time point using the calculated moving distance, transmitting a radar signal to the subject, and measuring a bio-signal of the subject by receiving a fast time signal reflected from the subject, wherein the IMU sensor is arranged such that an x-axis coincides with a transmission signal direction of the radar device. According to the disclosed apparatus and method, it is possible to measure a bio-signal in a portable manner, and it is possible to accurately measure a bio-signal of a subject even in an environment in which radar moves.
abstract_ko: 레이더를 이용한 핸드 헬드 생체 신호 측정 장치 및 방법이 개시된다. 개시된 장치는 손잡이; 상기 손잡이와 결합되어 있는 IMU 센서; 상기 손잡이와 결합되며 상기 IMU 센서에서 출력되는 방향별 속도 정보를 제공받아 이전 시점과 현재 시점의 이동 거리를 연산하고, 상기 연산된 이동 거리를 이용하여 현재 시점의 피측정자와의 거리를 연산하며, 상기 피측정자에게 레이더 신호를 송신하고, 상기 피측정자로부터 반사되는 패스트 타임 신호를 수신하여 상기 피측정자의 생체 신호를 측정하는 레이더 장치를 포함하되, 상기 IMU 센서는 x축이 상기 레이더 장치의 송신 신호 방향과 일치하도록 배치된다. 개시된 장치 및 방법에 의하면, 휴대용으로 생체 신호를 측정할 수 있으며, 레이더가 움직이는 환경에서도 피측정자의 생체 신호를 정확히 측정할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Apparatus for monitoring human posture in a closed space using radar
title_ko: 레이더를 이용한 폐쇄 공간 내 사람의 자세 모니터링 장치
abstract_en: According to the present invention, the posture monitoring device monitors a posture of an occupant in a closed space by using radar, detects a bio-signal for each of a plurality of sectors dividing the closed space in a height direction, and determines the posture of the occupant based on a distribution pattern of the sectors in which the bio-signal is detected.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 자세 모니터링 장치는 레이더를 이용하여 폐쇄 공간 내의 재실자의 자세를 모니터링 하는 장치로 폐쇄 공간을 높이 방향으로 구분한 복수의 섹터 별로 생체 신호를 검출하고 생체 신호가 검출된 섹터들의 분포 패턴에 기초하여 재실자의 자세를 판단한다.

title_en: Household personnel health monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention provides a health monitoring system for household personnel, which utilizes millimeter wave radar technology to monitor vital sign changes of human body in real time, and performs data analysis through a medical monitoring module to generate a health report. The system comprises a millimeter wave radar module, a medical monitoring module, an alarm, a GPS positioning module, a wireless transmission module, a controller and a power module. The millimeter wave radar module receives weak millimeter wave signals sent by a human body through a plurality of radar antennas, and identifies potential health risks and provides alarm information through intelligent analysis. The alarm can trigger sound and light signal alarm according to health abnormality and transmit accurate position information by combining with the GPS positioning module. The system also supports wireless transmission, sends alarm information and health data to the receiving terminal, and provides real-time monitoring and remote management functions for users. The system is particularly suitable for health monitoring of solitary old people, and provides a safe, real-time and intelligent solution.
assignees: LIKAI PRECISION TECH KUNSHAN CO LTD

title_en: Emergency disaster relief vehicle-mounted imaging system based on time-frequency transmission technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of microwave general induction, and discloses an emergency disaster relief vehicle-mounted imaging system based on a time-frequency transmission technology, in particular to an antenna communication system based on the time-frequency transmission technology, and an accuracy enhancement type vehicle-mounted radar imaging system for emergency disaster relief by combining the time-frequency transmission technology with a through-wall radar. The invention aims to provide an emergency disaster relief vehicle-mounted imaging system which can be connected in a multipoint mode and is more accurate in three-dimensional imaging, and the functions of providing quicker and more accurate detection data for emergency disaster relief and mutually communicating on time are achieved. Can provide support for operators to detect the environment and determine the human body orientation, and increase the safety coefficient and the operation efficiency.

title_en: Trusted digital personal local secure storage system and cross-domain synchronization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a trusted digital personal local secure storage system, which comprises an anti-intrusion safe, a quantum optical storage body and a blockchain mapping engine. The safe adopts a five-layer composite protective structure (shape memory alloy and tungsten carbide armor), and triggers three-level self-destruction (flame retardant/laser ablation/aluminum thermal fusion destruction) when intrusion is detected. The quantum optical storage body is used for recording the nano grating in a quartz glass medium through femtosecond laser, so that the 1PB capacity and thousand year data are stored. The innovation points comprise 1) a biological dynamic key technology, a double-chain synchronous protocol, a public chain certificate transaction hash and 3) a federal disaster recovery mechanism, wherein the biological dynamic key technology fuses fingerprints, irises and real-time vital signs to generate encryption factors, 2) the double-chain synchronous protocol is used for storing local encryption data by a private chain, and 3) the data regeneration is realized through a Shamir algorithm and a multi-signature intelligent contract. The system achieves the IP68 protection Level and EMC Level 4 immunity, the data irrecoverable rate is 100%, and the system is suitable for protecting digital assets at home, enterprises and government Level.

title_en: Airborne through-wall radar moving target coherent accumulation method based on time domain conjugate inversion transformation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for accumulating phase parameters of an airborne through-wall radar moving target based on time domain conjugate inversion transformation, which comprises the step of providing a new method for accumulating the phase parameters by using the time domain conjugate inversion transformation and the key transformation. The invention enables the return waves of the moving target to obtain correct coherent accumulation by removing the second-order range migration and the second-order Doppler expansion items. Compared with the traditional method, the frequency domain cancellation method provided by the invention avoids the high requirements of the traditional multichannel cancellation method on the time domain registration, and is more suitable for practical application requirements. Meanwhile, the invention can image the moving object more accurately under the condition of knowing the type of the moving object. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through numerical simulation.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted life detection method, related device and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a vehicle-mounted life detection method, a related device and a storage medium. Under the condition of vehicle state change, switching the working mode of the vehicle-mounted radar, transmitting radar signals into the vehicle based on the vehicle-mounted radar and receiving echo signals thereof, and performing signal processing on the echo signals to obtain moving state parameters of the targets, wherein the moving state parameters comprise at least one of the distance from the targets to radar signal transmitting points, the distance change rate, the azimuth, the height and the phase, a life detection algorithm module corresponding to the working mode of the vehicle-mounted radar is called, and the moving state parameters are input into the life detection algorithm module to perform life detection on the targets so as to trigger corresponding auxiliary functions of the vehicle according to life detection results, thereby reducing hardware integration difficulty and cost, improving detection precision and reliability and reducing privacy leakage.
assignees: HANGZHOU SHENGDEWEI INTEGRATED CIRCUIT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Pet house system with health care based on pet biometric information
title_ko: 반려동물 생체정보 기반의 건강 관리 펫 하우스 시스템
abstract_en: A pet house system is provided that offers real-time health care functions based on the pet's biometric information. The pet house system for health care based on the pet's biometric information according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a sensor unit equipped with a piezoelectric sensor and a photosensor embedded in the pet house; a processor that processes biometric signals acquired through the piezoelectric sensor, measures heart rate and respiratory rate based on the signal processing results, and estimates the pet's stress by analyzing heart rate variability (HRV) included in the signal processing results; and a urine component testing device that tests the pet's urine components using the photosensor. By doing so, the pet's heart rate, respiratory rate, and stress analysis, sleep state classification, and body water and body fat analysis can be performed, and real-time body temperature detection can be carried out through urine component testing and epidermal temperature measurement, thereby contributing to the health management of the pet.
abstract_ko: 반려동물 생체정보를 기반으로 실시간 건강 관리(health care) 기능을 제공하는 펫 하우스 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 반려동물 생체정보 기반의 건강 관리 펫 하우스 시스템은, 펫 하우스에 내장되는 압전센서(Piezoelectric Sensor) 및 광센서(Photosensor)가 구비되는 센서부; 압전센서를 통해 획득된 생체 신호를 신호처리하고, 신호처리 결과를 기반으로 심박수(Heart rate) 및 호흡수(respiratory rate)를 측정하고, 신호처리 결과에 포함된 심박변이도(HRV)를 분석하여 반려동물의 스트레스를 추정하는 프로세서; 및 광센서를 활용하여 반려동물의 소변 성분을 검사하는 소변 성분 검사 장치;를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 반려동물의 심박수, 호흡수 및 스트레스 분석, 수면 상태 분류, 체수분과 체지방을 분석하고, 반려동물의 소변 검사 성분 검사 및 표피온도 측정을 통한 실시간 체온감지를 수행하여 반려동물의 건강관리에 기여할 수 있다.

title_en: Air conditioner
title_ko: 공기조화기
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an air conditioner. According to the present disclosure, an air conditioner comprises: a case having a suction port and a discharge port; a blowing fan disposed inside the case to form an air current; an indoor heat exchanger for exchanging heat between air inside the case and a refrigerant; and a radar sensor for detecting a bio-signal, wherein the radar sensor is spaced apart from a front wall and may be inclined downward.
abstract_ko: 본 개시는 공기조화기에 관한 것이다. 본 개시의 공기조화기는: 흡입구와 토출구가 형성된 케이스; 상기 케이스의 내부에 배치되어 기류를 형성하는 송풍팬; 상기 케이스 내부의 공기와 냉매를 열교환시키는 실내열교환기; 및 생체 신호를 감지하는 레이더 센서를 포함하고, 상기 레이더 센서는, 전방벽으로부터 이격되고, 하측으로 향하도록 기울어질 수 있다.

title_en: Personalized alarm provision system using Doppler signal-based biometric and motion information
title_ko: 도플러 신호 기반의 생체 정보 및 움직임 정보를 이용한 개인 맞춤형 알람제공 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a personalized alarm providing system using bio-information and motion information based on a doppler signal, comprising an apparatus for obtaining bio-signal and motion signal information using a doppler signal, a server, and a guardian terminal. The apparatus for obtaining bio-signal and motion signal information using a doppler signal includes: a doppler signal obtaining unit configured to emit a radar signal to a subject, obtain a doppler signal by obtaining a signal returning after the radar signal is reflected, and obtain a first phase doppler signal and a second phase doppler signal by processing the doppler signal; a doppler signal processing unit configured to obtain first signal information and second signal information by processing the first phase doppler signal and the second phase doppler signal, respectively; and a signal information output unit configured to obtain the first signal information and the second signal information, and obtain bio-signal information and motion signal information by analyzing the first signal information and the second signal information, respectively, using a preset algorithm.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도플러 신호를 이용한 생체 신호 및 움직임신호 정보 획득 장치, 서버 및 보호자 단말을 포함하는 도플러 신호 기반의 생체 정보 및 움직임 정보를 이용한 개인 맞춤형 알람제공 시스템이다. 상기 도플러 신호를 이용한 생체 신호 및 움직임신호 정보 획득 장치는  대상자에게 레이더 신호를 방출하고, 상기 레이더 신호가 반사되어 돌아오는 신호를 획득하여 도플러 신호를 획득하며, 상기 도플러 신호를 처리하여 제1 위상 도플러 신호 및 제2 위상 도플러 신호를 획득하는 도플러 신호 획득부; 상기 제1 위상 도플러 신호 및 상기 제2 위상 도플러 신호를 각각 처리하여 제1 신호 정보 및 제2 신호 정보를 획득하는 도플러 신호 처리부; 및상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보를 획득하고, 기 설정된 알고리즘을 이용하여 상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보를 각각 분석하여 생체 신호 정보 및 움직임신호 정보를 획득하는 신호 정보 출력부를 포함한다.

title_en: Pet house system with real-time pet health monitoring and care functions
title_ko: 실시간 반려동물 건강 모니터링 및 케어 기능이 포함된 펫하우스 시스템
abstract_en: A pet house system capable of real-time health monitoring and care for pets through the measurement of biosignals is provided. A pet house system including a real-time pet health monitoring and care function according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a sensor unit embedded in the bottom of the pet house to acquire biosignals including a heartbeat signal of the pet and a microvascular vibration signal generated during heartbeat; and a processor that processes the biosignals acquired through a multi-channel piezoelectric sensor, measures the heart rate and respiratory rate based on the signal processing results, and analyzes the heart rate variability (HRV) included in the signal processing results to estimate the stress of the pet. By doing so, it is possible to contribute to the health management of pets by analyzing the pet's heart rate, respiratory rate, and stress, classifying sleep states, analyzing body water and body fat, automatically creating a comfortable environment using a temperature sensor, and detecting body temperature in real-time through epidermal temperature measurement.
abstract_ko: 생체신호 측정을 통해 반려동물의 실시간 건강 모니터링과 케어가 가능한 펫하우스 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 실시간 반려동물 건강 모니터링 및 케어 기능이 포함된 펫하우스 시스템은, 펫하우스 바닥에 내장되어, 반려동물의 심장 박동 신호 및 심장 박동시 발생하는 미세 혈관 진동 신호를 포함하는 생체 신호를 획득하는 센서부; 및 다채널 압전센서를 통해 획득된 생체 신호를 신호처리하고, 신호처리 결과를 기반으로 심박수(Heart rate) 및 호흡수(respiratory rate)를 측정하고, 신호처리 결과에 포함된 심박변이도(HRV)를 분석하여 반려동물의 스트레스를 추정하는 프로세서;를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 반려동물의 심박수, 호흡수 및 스트레스 분석, 수면 상태 분류, 체수분과 체지방을 분석하고, 온도 센서를 이용한 쾌적한 환경 자동조성 및 표피온도 측정을 통한 실시간 체온감지를 수행하여 반려동물의 건강관리에 기여할 수 있다.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar self-adaptive transmitting power optimization method for vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to a millimeter wave radar self-adaptive transmitting power optimization method for vital sign monitoring, which comprises the steps of adopting an FMCW-MIMO radar to monitor vital signs of a human body, processing echo signals reflected by the human body of each frame corresponding to each frame of transmitting signals to obtain discrete echo signals, preprocessing the discrete echo signals, estimating target distance, speed and arrival angle by adopting CFAR detection, carrying out receiving end beam forming on the received signals according to the target arrival angle, carrying out phase extraction according to a range gate where the target distance is located, carrying out band-pass filtering on the extracted phase, extracting vital sign signals including respiration and heart rate, estimating signal power in an arrival angle area according to the arrival angle of the data of the previous frame, and carrying out self-adaptive adjustment on the transmitting power of the radar of the next frame so that the power of the echo signals reflected by the human body corresponding to the frame meets the power requirement of CFAR detection. The invention realizes low-radiation and high-precision human vital sign monitoring.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar vital sign detection method based on improvement RPSEMD
abstract_en: The invention provides an improved RPSEMD-based millimeter wave radar vital sign detection method, which comprises the steps of performing signal preprocessing on echo signals of a target captured by a frequency modulation continuous wave radar module, performing fast Fourier transform on the captured signals in a distance dimension, positioning a distance unit where the target object is located by a distance door locking technology, performing phase extraction on the signals, performing phase unwrapping processing, enhancing the stability of the signals through differential operation, improving the signal quality through a median filtering technology, and separating and extracting vital sign signals through an improved RPSEMD algorithm model to realize millimeter wave radar vital sign detection. And taking the square sum of the cross-correlation coefficients as an objective function, optimizing the parameters of the traditional RPSEMD algorithm by using Bayesian optimization, and finding out an optimal group of parameters in a given parameter range. The result of the algorithm verification on the actually measured signals shows that the modal aliasing problem of the traditional algorithm in the process of decomposing the signals is reduced.

title_en: Time domain through-wall radar sequential equivalent sampling receiver system based on SRD and integrated SoC
abstract_en: The invention discloses a time domain through-wall radar sequential equivalent sampling receiver system based on SRD and integrated SoC, and belongs to the technical field of ultra-wideband time domain electromagnetics. The receiver system has a simple circuit structure, low cost and good circuit stability, can collect echo data and process signals simultaneously by using an integrated SoC of FPGA and ARM, reduces the complexity of the system, improves the efficiency of signal processing and increases the integration level of the system, ensures that the ADC cost is lower by using a sequential equivalent sampling method, can reach an equivalent sampling rate of more than 100GSPS by controlling sampling delay, effectively solves the problem of cost and meets the requirement of waveform precision, and the receiver system realizes accurate delay control by using a cascaded numerical control delay chip, ensures a larger range by using a coarse delay chip, simultaneously ensures a higher precision by using a fine delay chip, and effectively improves the sampling rate and the signal to noise ratio of the system.

title_en: Collaborative vital sign monitoring system based on fixed radar and mobile unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a vital sign monitoring system with a fixed radar and an unmanned aerial vehicle, which realizes large-scale basic monitoring through a millimeter wave radar array, and a specific unmanned aerial vehicle performs accurate rechecking after receiving an abnormal signal. The system adopts a multistage response mechanism, when the fixed radar detects sign abnormality, the unmanned aerial vehicle is scheduled to lock a target through millimeter wave echo feature matching, identity binding is carried out by utilizing a binocular camera, body temperature data is supplemented by combining an infrared sensor, and finally an early warning decision is generated through a multi-mode fusion algorithm. The hardware layer defines the minimum configuration requirement (including millimeter wave radar module, visual identification unit, infrared temperature measuring component and obstacle avoidance system) of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the software layer designs a cross-equipment data space-time alignment model and a dynamic task scheduling protocol. The application scene covers the sudden night monitoring of the nursing home, the health monitoring of the gym group and the non-contact patrol of the hospital isolation ward, and the problems of loss of tracking of moving targets, unhooking of identity information and the like in the traditional scheme are effectively solved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU LINGHAO SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-radar vital sign monitoring system applied to fixed crowd place
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-radar vital sign monitoring system applied to fixed crowd places, which comprises a horizontal layer 24GHz radar network, a vertical layer 60GHz radar array and an auxiliary sensor module. Through three-dimensional collaborative deployment of the heterogeneous radars, the improved variational modal decomposition algorithm and the joint probability data association tracking technology are combined, and multi-target respiration, heart rate and behavior feature separation in dense scenes is achieved. The system adopts a space-time diagram convolution network to extract individual gait cycle characteristics, and establishes a unique biological characteristic coding file through dynamic gesture track matching to complete non-contact identity binding. The hardware design integrates a multi-band radar chip and a dual-mode communication interface, and the software architecture deploys a lightweight AI model to realize localized real-time analysis. The embodiment covers the fields of fall monitoring in the nursing home, postoperative monitoring in the hospital and safety control in the kindergarten, radar spacing and beam pointing can be dynamically adjusted, and the problems of privacy leakage and target confusion existing in the traditional monitoring system are solved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU LINGHAO SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: High-resolution imaging method of forgetful through-wall radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-resolution imaging method of a wall-penetrating radar with less forgetting. The method comprises the specific steps of training an optical image-assisted high-resolution imaging network of a source domain to enable the optical image-assisted high-resolution imaging network to recover the shape of a source domain target and take the optical image-assisted high-resolution imaging network as a pre-training network, loading a pre-training model to initialize corresponding partial parameters of a target domain network LFHRNet with a multi-branch structure, training the target domain network on a target domain data set, learning a new knowledge of the target domain when one branch is trained, freezing the other branch to keep the source domain knowledge, and introducing a routing network to carry out accurate expert allocation. The invention effectively reduces forgetting of source domain knowledge, and enables the network to have the capability of high-resolution imaging of static targets in the source domain and the target domain.

title_en: Roadbed construction method for crossing V-shaped valley area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a roadbed construction method for crossing a V-shaped valley area, and belongs to the technical fields of foundation engineering and foundation treatment. The method solves the problems of low foundation drainage efficiency, unstability of the filled side slope and differential settlement control in the construction of the V-shaped valley roadbed. The technical scheme includes that a ditch is dug along the bottom of a valley, a broken stone drainage blind ditch wrapped by permeable geotextile is paved to form a foundation drainage system, a vibratory roller with a piezoelectric sensor embedded into a steel wheel is adopted in layered filling, a unidirectional geogrid is paved along a side slope after each two layers of filling and is vertically anchored into a compaction layer through a U-shaped anchoring piece, a transverse drainage pipe is pre-buried when filling is carried out to a threshold value of a bearing capacity abrupt change point of a foundation, and a sedimentation monitoring array is paved after filling is completed. The method is used for remarkably improving the bearing stability of the roadbed filled under complex terrains through the optimization of the foundation drainage structure and the system integration of intelligent compaction and differential settlement dynamic treatment of the filling body, and is suitable for foundation construction and disaster prevention and control of V-shaped canyon sections of mountain roads.
assignees: XINGTAI ROAD & BRIDGE CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Through-wall radar target tracking method based on scale self-adaption-rotation kernel correlation filtering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar target tracking method based on scale self-adaption-rotation kernel correlation filtering. In the method, size and angle information of a target area are acquired by performing basic geometric feature estimation on a continuously changing target image, and are used for generating training samples and updating a correlation filter. Then the target candidate area of the current frame is defined according to the geometric information of the previous frame, and then the relevant filter is used for positioning the target position. Numerical simulation and experimentation verified the effectiveness of the proposed method.

title_en: Following type human health state monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to follow-up human health state monitoring equipment which comprises a follow-up base, wherein the follow-up base is provided with a lower mounting cavity, a fixed shell is provided with an upper mounting cavity, a controller is fixed in the lower mounting cavity, a motion control module is in control connection with the controller, a data processing module is arranged in the lower mounting cavity, a data acquisition module is in control connection with the data processing module, a radar sign monitoring module is in control connection with the controller, an output module is in control connection with the controller, the data acquisition module comprises a camera, a first rotating structure capable of swinging left and right in the horizontal direction and a second rotating structure capable of swinging in the vertical direction are arranged in the fixed shell, the camera is arranged on the first rotating structure, the first rotating structure is relatively fixed on the second rotating structure, a first angle sensor is arranged on the first rotating structure, the first angle sensor is in control connection with the controller, the second angle sensor is in control connection with the control, and vital signs of monitored personnel can be continuously acquired.
assignees: SHENYANG YISHENGKANG HEALTH MAN CO LTD

title_en: Lead fish cableway radar wave current meter
abstract_en: The invention is used in the technical field of hydrologic monitoring, and particularly discloses a lead fish cableway radar wave current meter which comprises ground surfaces, wherein the ground surfaces are respectively poured and buried on two sides of a river channel, a second vertical rod is fixedly arranged on one side, far away from a first vertical rod, of the ground surfaces, a mounting frame is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the first vertical rod, traction ropes are respectively arranged on the outer surfaces of the first vertical rod and the second vertical rod, and a relay moving end is arranged between the moving ropes. This lead fish cableway radar wave current meter only needs to start motor roller subassembly and rotates when needs monitor and gather the hydrological data of river surface, makes motor roller subassembly can drive the relay and removes the end that removes, makes the relay remove the end and can take radar monitoring component to remove on the removal rope, makes radar monitoring component monitor and gather data in the position of difference on the river surface, makes the monitoring can obtain the hydrological data of river course different points, can be more accurate obtain the hydrological data of river course.

title_en: Railway line geological disaster monitoring and forecasting system
abstract_en: A railway along-line geological disaster monitoring and forecasting system relates to the field of railway safety and is used for guaranteeing railway traffic safety. The railway line geological disaster monitoring and forecasting system comprises an upper computer and disaster monitoring components, wherein the upper computer is provided with a plurality of alarms, the disaster monitoring components are arranged on one side of the railway and are distributed at intervals along the extending direction of the railway, the disaster monitoring components further comprise embedded parts, sensors and communicators, the embedded parts are buried underground on one side of the railway, the sensors are arranged on one side of the embedded parts and are in contact with the embedded parts, the communicators are fixedly connected with the embedded parts, the communicators are electrically connected with the sensors, and the communicators are in communication connection with the upper computer. The disaster monitoring assembly is buried at the railway side, and can detect whether the topography and the topography of the railway side are greatly changed, so that whether geological disasters occur in the area where the disaster monitoring assembly is located is monitored, and the railway traffic safety is ensured.
assignees: TIBET PLATEAU ATMOSPHERIC ENVIRONMENT SCIENCE INST

title_en: Buried object detection device, and buried object detection method
abstract_en: To provide a buried object detection device capable of detecting buried objects more accurately over a wider area, and a buried object detection method.SOLUTION: The buried object detection device includes: a radar data processing unit that converts multiple radar data measured by an underground measuring device into images: a buried object detection unit that detects buried objects from the images of the radar data; an underground feature detection unit that detects a characteristic portion that is different from the buried object in the images of the radar data; an alignment unit that calculates alignment information for multiple radar data alignment based on the detection results from the underground feature detection unit; and a result integration unit that integrates the buried object detection results based on the output result of the buried object detection unit and the output result of the alignment unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: OFDM-based radar communication integrated signal vital sign signal detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for detecting vital sign signals of radar communication integrated signals based on OFDM. Belonging to the technical field of radar communication integration. According to the method, the micro-motion characteristic information of the human chest cavity carried in the echo is utilized more comprehensively, in the aspect of accurate signal extraction, the sensitive sub-carrier is screened by calculating the slow time variance of the sub-carrier, the signal corresponding to weak motion of the chest cavity is accurately captured, the separation precision of respiratory and heartbeat signals is greatly improved, the high-frequency noise is suppressed by combining wavelet transformation soft threshold denoising, effective low frequency is reserved, and the VMD decomposition nonstationary signal is taken as a modal function, so that the signal quality is optimized in all directions, and the vital sign monitoring is more accurate. The intelligent safety system has the advantages that the application advantages of the intelligent safety system in the cross-field are obvious, the safety of personnel in the vehicle is guaranteed in unmanned operation, the body of dangerous personnel is abnormal in the intelligent safety system in a long-distance insight, and the remote accurate diagnosis of assistance and medical care during remote medical treatment is really realized, so that the requirements of multiple fields are met.

title_en: Underwater buried metal detection method using distributed MIMO ground penetrating radar
abstract_en: The invention provides an underwater buried metal detection method by using a distributed MIMO ground penetrating radar, which is characterized by comprising two pairs of transceiving antenna arrays, wherein a first transceiving antenna and a second transceiving antenna are arranged in water and fixed at different positions, the underwater transceiving antenna arrays are respectively fixed on different floating bodies through fixing rods, the two groups of transceiving antennas are mutually far away, the first transceiving antenna and the second transceiving antenna are connected with transceiving devices positioned on the water surface through cables, the two groups of transceiving devices are respectively fixed on different floating bodies on the water surface, the floating bodies float above preset detection positions, the distance between the floating bodies on the water surface is adjusted according to the emission inclination angles of the different antennas, a water surface transceiver is connected with an upper computer through the cables, and the upper computer judges the position of the underwater buried metal according to data transmitted by the two pairs of the transceiving antenna arrays.

title_en: Underground excavation deformation monitoring method based on ultra-shallow buried high-flow stratum subway channel
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of underground excavation deformation monitoring of subway channels, and particularly discloses an underground excavation deformation monitoring method based on an ultra-shallow buried high-flow stratum, which generates a geological risk distribution map by carrying out geological radar detection on a construction influence range in the early stage of construction, further carries out differential arrangement of monitoring points by carrying out risk grading on the construction influence region by utilizing the geological risk distribution map, improves the deformation capturing capability of a key region on the premise of ensuring the monitoring effect, the monitoring redundancy of the low-risk area is reduced, the jump modification and stability characteristics of deformation are identified by dynamically analyzing deformation data collected by monitoring points in each sub-area in the construction process, whether a monitoring blind area or a redundant area exists is judged, encryption or migration operation of the monitoring points is triggered according to the jump modification and stability characteristics, the transition from static layout to dynamic evolution of the monitoring system is realized, and the real-time matching performance between the layout of the monitoring points and deformation evolution of the stratum is effectively ensured.

title_en: Search and rescue device for radar detection
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of search and rescue, in particular to a search and rescue device for radar detection. The life detector comprises a life detector body, wherein a mobile platform which is used for driving a search and rescue equipment body to move is installed on the life detector body. According to the invention, the life detector is arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle through the arrangement of the mobile platform, so that the life detector can be used in different rescue scenes, the mobility and the search range of the search and rescue device are obviously improved, trapped people can be found out in time, the rescue success rate of the trapped people is improved, and the flexibility and the efficiency of rescue work are improved. Through the setting of dehumidification subassembly, the drying cabinet absorbs the moisture in the life detection appearance through the drier to reduce the humidity in the life detection appearance, make the moisture in the life detection appearance be difficult to too high, make the life detection appearance be difficult to receive the influence of moisture and produce the damage, improve the security and the life of life detection appearance.

title_en: Self-driven landslide pore water pressure sensor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a self-driven landslide pore water pressure sensor, which relates to the technical field of mechanical instruments and comprises a shell and at least one detection probe arranged in the shell, wherein the detection probe comprises a tray, a slide bar, a plurality of nano friction rings, metal friction rings and an elastic piece, the tray is slidably arranged on the surface of the shell, one end of the slide bar is connected with the tray, the other end of the slide bar is connected with the elastic piece, the other end of the elastic piece is fixedly arranged, each nano friction ring is sleeved on the slide bar at intervals, and the metal friction ring is fixedly arranged on the periphery of one nano friction ring. The utility model has the advantages that the nano friction rings can be directly buried in soil, when pore water pressure acts on the detection probe, the tray is extruded to slide towards the inside of the shell to drive the slide bars to slide so as to enable the nano friction rings to move, and then the nano friction rings are contacted with the metal friction rings and are rubbed to generate electricity, and the change of charges can be used as a detection signal of the pore water pressure, so that the pore water pressure can be accurately calculated.
assignees: HUBEI PROVINCIAL COMMUNICATIONS PLANNING AND DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Method of monitoring a user's condition and electronic device performing the same
title_ko: 사용자의 상태 모니터링 방법 및 이를 수행하는 전자 장치
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a method for monitoring a state of a user of an electronic device comprises: an operation of generating a first biometric signal of a user; an operation of determining a first value for the first biometric signal based on the first biometric signal; an operation of determining whether the state of the user corresponds to a first state based on the first value; an operation of generating a second biometric signal of the user through a second sensor when the state of the user corresponds to the first state; an operation of determining a second value for the second biometric signal based on the second biometric signal; an operation of determining whether the state of the user corresponds to a second state based on the second value; and an operation of performing a preset first action when the state of the user corresponds to the second state.
abstract_ko: 일 실시 예에 따른 전자 장치의 사용자의 상태를 모니터링하는 방법은,   사용자의 제1 생체 신호를 생성하는 동작, 제1 생체 신호에 기초하여 제1 생체 신호에 대한 제1 값을 결정하는 동작, 제1 값에 기초하여 사용자의 상태가 제1 상태에 대응하는지 여부를 결정하는 동작, 사용자의 상태가 제1 상태에 대응하는 경우, 제2 센서를 통해 사용자의 제2 생체 신호를 생성하는 동작, 제2 생체 신호에 기초하여 제2 생체 신호에 대한 제2 값을 결정하는 동작, 제2 값에 기초하여 사용자의 상태가 제2 상태에 대응하는지 여부를 결정하는 동작, 및 사용자의 상태가 제2 상태에 대응하는 경우, 미리 설정된 제1 액션을 수행하는 동작을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Portable smart CPR device with AI algorithms
title_ko: Ai 알고리즘이 적용된 휴대형 스마트 심폐소생술 장치
