abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a portable smart cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) device applied with an AI algorithm that enables the implementation for cardiopulmonary resuscitation and additional functions to be easily progressed, and enables feedback for the cardiopulmonary resuscitation to be clearly delivered to the rescuer. Provided is a portable smart CPR device applied with the AI algorithm comprising: a body part; a feedback part embedded in the body part and partially exposed, wherein feedback information is confirmed by visual and auditory data; a defibrillator part embedded in the body part and formed in a detachable structure, wherein an electric shock is implemented to a user; an electrode sensor part embedded in the body part and partially exposed, wherein a vital sign of the user is obtained by being in contact with the user, and comprising a plurality of electrodes and sensors to which the electric shock of the defibrillator part is transmitted to the user; and a remote monitoring part located at a separate place and collecting and analyzing the vital sign.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 심폐소생술 장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 환자에 대한 정보가 수집 및 분석되는 AI 알고리즘으로부터 환자에 대한 심폐소생술의 피드백 정보가 획득되고, 추가적으로 AI 알고리즘에서 분석된 정보를 바탕으로 전기충격이 진행되어 전문지식이 없는 구조자가 응급 환자에 대한 심폐소생술을 효율적이면서도 스마트하게 실시될 수 있는 AI 알고리즘이 적용된 휴대형 스마트 심폐소생술 장치에 관한 것이다. 
상기한 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명에 따른 AI 알고리즘이 적용된 휴대형 스마트 심폐소생술 장치에 있어서, 몸체부; 상기 몸체부에 내장되어 일부가 노출되되, 피드백 정보가 시각 및 청각데이터로 확인되는 피드백부; 상기 몸체부에 내장되어 분리가능 구조로 형성되되, 사용자에게 전기충격이 실시되는 제세동부; 상기 몸체부에 내장되어 일부가 노출되되, 사용자에게 접촉되어 사용자의 바이탈사인이 획득되고, 상기 제세동부의 전기 충격이 사용자에게 전달되는 복수개의 전극 및 센서가 포함되는 전극센서부; 및 별도의 장소에 위치되되, 상기 바이탈사인이 수집 및 분석되는 원격모니터링부;가 포함되는 것을 기술적 요지로 한다.

title_en: System, method, and application using the same to acquire biological/movement signal information using Doppler signals
title_ko: 도플러 신호를 이용한 생체/움직임 신호 정보 획득 시스템, 방법 및 이를 이용한 애플리케이션
abstract_en: Provided are a system and a method for acquiring bio/movement signal information using a doppler signal, and an application using the same. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a system for obtaining bio/motion signal information using a doppler signal comprises: a doppler signal obtaining unit which emits a radar signal to a subject to be observed, obtains a doppler signal by obtaining a signal returned by reflecting the radar signal, and obtains a first phase doppler signal and a second phase doppler signal by processing the doppler signal; a doppler signal processing unit which obtains first signal information and second signal information by processing the first phase doppler signal and the second phase doppler signal, respectively; and a signal information output unit which obtains the first signal information and the second signal information, and obtains bio signal information and motion signal information by analyzing the first signal information and the second signal information using a preset algorithm, respectively.
abstract_ko: 도플러 신호를 이용한 생체/움직임 신호 정보 획득 시스템, 방법 및 이를 이용한 애플리케이션이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 도플러 신호를 이용한 생체/움직임 신호 정보 획득 시스템은 관측 대상자에게 레이더 신호를 방출하고, 상기 레이더 신호가 반사되어 돌아오는 신호를 획득하여 도플러 신호를 획득하며, 상기 도플러 신호를 처리하여 제1 위상 도플러 신호 및 제2 위상 도플러 신호를 획득하는 도플러 신호 획득부; 상기 제1 위상 도플러 신호 및 상기 제2 위상 도플러 신호를 각각 처리하여 제1 신호 정보 및 제2 신호 정보를 획득하는 도플러 신호 처리부; 및 상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보를 획득하고, 기 설정된 알고리즘을 이용하여 상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보를 각각 분석하여 생체 신호 정보 및 움직임 신호 정보를 획득하는 신호 정보 출력부;를 포함한다.

title_en: Sleep state determination system, method, and application using the same using Doppler signals
title_ko: 도플러 신호를 이용한 수면 상태 판단 시스템, 방법 및 이를 이용한 애플리케이션
abstract_en: A system for determining a sleep state using a doppler signal comprises: a doppler signal acquisition unit which emits a radar signal to a subject to be observed, acquires a doppler signal by acquiring a signal returned by reflecting the radar signal, and acquires a first phase doppler signal and a second phase doppler signal by processing the doppler signal; a doppler signal processing unit which acquires first signal information and second signal information by processing the first phase doppler signal and the second phase doppler signal, respectively; and a sleep state determination unit which acquires the first signal information and the second signal information, acquires biosignal information and motion signal information by analyzing the first signal information and the second signal information using a preset algorithm, respectively, and determines a sleep state of the subject to be observed using the biosignal and the motion information. A bio-signal and motion information may be obtained by analyzing the doppler signal. Sleep is not obstructed to the contactless radar method. The sleep state can be decided accurately by using respiration and heart rate information.
abstract_ko: 도플러 신호를 이용한 수면 상태 판단 시스템, 방법 및 이를 이용한 애플리케이션이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 도플러 신호를 이용한 수면 상태 판단 시스템은 관측 대상자에게 레이더 신호를 방출하고, 상기 레이더 신호가 반사되어 돌아오는 신호를 획득하여 도플러 신호를 획득하며, 상기 도플러 신호를 처리하여 제1 위상 도플러 신호 및 제2 위상 도플러 신호를 획득하는 도플러 신호 획득부; 상기 제1 위상 도플러 신호 및 상기 제2 위상 도플러 신호를 각각 처리하여 제1 신호 정보 및 제2 신호 정보를 획득하는 도플러 신호 처리부; 및 상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보를 획득하고, 기 설정된 알고리즘을 이용하여 상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보를 각각 분석하여 생체 신호 정보 및 움직임 신호 정보를 획득하고, 상기 생체 신호 및 움직임 정보를 이용하여 상기 관측 대상자의 수면 상태를 판단하는 수면 상태 판단부;를 포함하며, 상기 제1 위상 도플러 신호를 통해 획득되는 상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보는 제1-1 신호 정보 및 제1-2 신호 정보이며, 상기 제2 위상 도플러 신호를 통해 획득되는 상기 제1 신호 정보 및 상기 제2 신호 정보는 제2-1 신호 정보 및 제2-2 신호 정보를 포함한다.

title_en: Mobile scheduling management device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency dispatch management and discloses a mobile dispatch management device which comprises an information acquisition unit, an integration unit, a dispatch optimization unit, a decision-making auxiliary unit, a command unit and a communication unit, wherein the information acquisition unit comprises a field information acquisition module, an environment monitoring module and a vital sign detection sensor, the field situation can be rapidly, comprehensively and accurately mastered in an emergency scene through the information acquisition unit, the integration unit, the dispatch optimization unit, the decision-making auxiliary unit and the command unit, the accurate allocation and dynamic optimization of resources are realized based on scientific data analysis and intelligent algorithm, the scientificity and the efficiency of command decision are improved by means of an immersive virtual reality technology, and close fit and efficient cooperation among departments are ensured through a cross-department integrated cooperative communication system, so that the efficiency and effect of emergency rescue are remarkably improved, and casualties and property loss are furthest reduced.
assignees: BEIJING GREAT WALL HUA RUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Smart Mattress
abstract_en: To provide a smart mattress which can solve conventional technical problems that require contact measurement, instant monitoring, and long-time monitoring, when measuring biological data of a human body.SOLUTION: The present invention provides a smart mattress which is useful for performing a measurement or instant monitoring of long-term biological data of a user to establish an accurate care mode by: measuring biological data of a human body mainly using a non-contact sensor; tracing a rapid-eye-movement phase of a user through a detection method of measuring vital signs remotely; monitoring cardiac beat; sensing biological information such as respiration; detecting and recording biological information on getting up and sleeping posture and the like of the user; pairing and connecting a mobile device and computer via a control box; and then outputting and displaying, or uploading and storing, in a cloud database, all the acquiring information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Miniaturized card type human vital sign monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent health monitoring, in particular to miniaturized card type human vital sign monitoring equipment which comprises a millimeter wave radar module, a flexible substrate, an ADC (analog to digital converter) conversion unit and a signal processing unit, wherein the millimeter wave radar module comprises an antenna array unit and an antenna substrate, the antenna array unit is etched on the antenna substrate through a folding antenna technology, the flexible substrate is bonded with the antenna substrate, the ADC conversion unit is connected with the millimeter wave radar module, and the signal processing unit is connected with the ADC conversion unit and is used for extracting human vital sign signals and calculating medical parameters. The application adopts the flexible substrate and the folding antenna array technology, greatly reduces the area of a core module of the monitoring equipment, can reach the size and the dimension of a credit card, can adapt to various application scenes, is manufactured into the shape of a mobile phone shell, is coupled with the mobile phone, realizes monitoring closed loop, is simple to use and convenient to carry, does not need to be worn on the surface of a human body, and can realize non-contact medical grade health monitoring.

title_en: Autonomous driving mobility for detecting buried objects and method for detecting buried objects using the same
title_ko: 매설물 탐지를 위한 자율 주행 모빌리티 및 이를 이용한 매설물 탐지 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an autonomous driving mobility for detecting a buried object and a method for detecting a buried object using the same. The autonomous driving mobility for detecting a buried object comprises: a driving control unit for switching to a tracking driving mode to control driving according to a position where a magnetic field signal is detected when the magnetic field signal is detected by a magnetic field sensor while driving in a designated range in the autonomous driving mode; a data collection unit for collecting reception position data, intensity data, and time data required for signal transmission and reception of the magnetic field signal received while driving in the tracking driving mode; an information analysis unit for analyzing buried object information including the position, type, and depth of the buried object using the collected data; and a map generation unit for storing a driving route driven in the tracking driving mode and generating a buried object map in which the buried object information is reflected in the stored driving route. Accordingly, a position of an underground buried object can be detected by using a magnetic field sensor provided in the mobility, thereby preventing an accident caused by the buried object.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 매설물 탐지를 위한 자율 주행 모빌리티 및 이를 이용한 매설물 탐지 방법에 관한 것으로, 상기 자율 주행 모드로 지정 범위를 주행하는 도중 자기장 센서에 의해 자기장 신호가 감지되면, 상기 추적 주행 모드로 전환시켜 상기 자기장 신호가 감지되는 위치를 따라 주행하도록 제어하는 주행 제어부; 상기 추적 주행 모드로 주행하면서 수신되는 자기장 신호의 수신 위치 데이터, 세기 데이터 및 신호 송수신 시 소요되는 시간 데이터를 수집하는 데이터 수집부; 상기 수집한 데이터를 이용하여 매설물의 위치, 종류 및 깊이를 포함하는 매설물 정보를 분석하는 정보 분석부; 및 상기 추적 주행 모드로 주행한 주행 경로를 저장하고, 저장된 주행 경로에 상기 매설물 정보가 반영된 매설물 지도를 생성하는 지도 생성부를 포함한다. 
이를 통해 모빌리티에 구비되는 자기장 센서를 이용하여 지하 매설물의 위치를 탐지할 수 있어 매설물로 인한 안전 사고를 예방할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: KYUNGPOOK NAT UNIV IND ACADEMIC COOP FOUND

title_en: Wearable underwater vital sign and environment monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vital sign measurement, in particular to a wearable underwater vital sign and environment monitoring system which comprises a physiological signal acquisition module, a photoelectric volume pulse wave sensor, a bioelectrical impedance electrode, a piezoelectric sensor and a neck piezoelectric signal, wherein the photoelectric volume pulse wave sensor is fixed at a wrist position, the bioelectrical impedance electrode is attached to the chest, the piezoelectric sensor is placed at the neck position, and the photoelectric volume pulse wave signal, the bioelectrical impedance signal and the neck piezoelectric signal of the wrist position are acquired. In the invention, signal reconstruction is carried out based on energy proportion calculation, the position of an electrocardio R wave crest value point and an R-R interval time sequence are extracted, variability indexes are generated through frequency domain decomposition and frequency band energy statistics, time domain and frequency domain index values are calculated, and weight distribution is carried out, so that the overall monitoring of the underwater physical sign state is realized. The signal acquisition precision is improved by means of a multi-source signal acquisition mode, noise interference is eliminated through signal track matrix decomposition operation, and the reconstruction quality of signals is ensured by adopting characteristic vector energy specific gravity calculation.
assignees: QINGDAO CHENGLANG MARINE UNMANNED EQUIPMENT CO LTD;SHANGHAI DIVING EQUIPMENT FACTORY CO LTD

title_en: Full-period electrocardiogram acquisition and diagnosis auxiliary system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of health monitoring and management, and discloses a full-period electrocardiogram acquisition and diagnosis auxiliary system based on millimeter wave radar, which comprises a hardware acquisition and real-time signal processing module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the hardware acquisition and real-time signal processing module is used for acquiring vital sign data of a user through the millimeter wave radar and a multi-mode sensor and preprocessing an acquired original signal; the system comprises a crowd classification and feature modeling module, an edge calculation and real-time monitoring module and a monitoring module, wherein the crowd classification and feature modeling module classifies according to information and acquired data input by a user and builds personalized health portraits, and the edge calculation and real-time monitoring module is used for extracting electrocardiosignals and other vital sign data in real time and monitoring abnormal events. The hardware acquisition and real-time signal processing module for acquiring vital sign data by the millimeter wave radar and the multi-mode sensor and the technical scheme for dynamically updating the health portrait by combining the user classification realize high-precision and multi-dimensional acquisition and personalized management of the user health data.

title_en: Method for nondestructive detection of farmland buried peat by radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geophysical exploration, in particular to a method for nondestructive detection of farmland buried peat by using a radar, which comprises the following steps that step 1, any point on a farmland to be detected is selected as a starting point; step 2, loading a ground penetrating radar by using a carrying device to detect a starting point, dynamically selecting the antenna frequency of the ground penetrating radar according to the formation type of a deposit in the detection process, dynamically adjusting the acquisition mode according to the gradient of the landform, acquiring the soil profile of the starting point position, and acquiring the peat layer thickness of the position according to the soil profile, step 3, selecting a plurality of test points according to the peat layer thickness, sequentially detecting the peat layer thickness of each test point position by using the ground penetrating radar, and step 4, connecting the peat layer thickness of the starting point and the numerical value of the peat layer thickness of the test point position into a smooth curved surface, thereby predicting the peat layer thicknesses of other positions of farmlands. The invention is used for reducing the influence of farmland grass roots and the like on data acquisition.

title_en: Through-wall radar multipath ghost suppression method based on array virtual rotation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wall penetrating radar multipath ghost suppression method based on array virtual rotation. Aiming at the problems of unknown scene layout, difficult acquisition of multiple view angles and unstable azimuth dependence, echo data of multiple rotation angles are acquired through virtual rotation of an array, then multipath paths are divided into areas outside the main lobes by utilizing different main lobe orientations under different rotation angles, so that multipath ghost phase mismatch is caused, and a target keeps a certain focus on the basis of approximate compensation. Then, the cross-correlation back projection algorithm is utilized to complete imaging at each virtual rotation angle, and simultaneously, non-target components are restrained. And finally, carrying out incoherent multiplication fusion on the plurality of angle echo data, and finally realizing the suppression of multipath ghost. The method is applied to multipath ghost suppression of the through-wall radar, and can effectively utilize the azimuth dependence of multipath ghost through single array based on signal processing under the condition of no prior information of a layout structure, so as to obtain better multipath ghost suppression performance.

title_en: Non-contact sleeping posture detection and vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact sleeping posture detection and vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar, which uses the millimeter wave radar with multiple transmission and multiple reception, adopts innovative signal processing algorithm and data processing algorithm, the sleep monitoring is carried out by comprehensively considering the frequency spectrum information and the point cloud information, and comprises the steps of extracting vital sign data such as breathing and heartbeat and judging the states of the bed, the body movement and the sleeping posture. The respiratory heartbeat component is effectively extracted through cross-correlation entropy operation, so that the signal to noise ratio is increased, and then the cross-correlation entropy is subjected to fast Fourier transform, and the respiratory heartbeat frequency is proved to be effectively extracted.
assignees: CHENGDU DUOPU DETECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Radar System for Detection of Human Trapped in Deep Subsurface and Control Method thereof
title_ko: 고심도 매몰자 탐지용 레이더 시스템 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a radar system for detecting a high-depth buried person and a control method thereof. According to the present invention, a pipe-type radar system for detecting a high-depth buried person comprises: a radar device including a pulse radar and a doppler radar; a winch device for raising or lowering the radar device in a borehole; a ground control device for driving the winch device to raise or lower the radar device in the borehole, and collecting pulse reflection wave signal data obtained from the pulse radar and frequency shift detection data obtained from the doppler radar; and a computing device for checking the depth of an underground cavity from the pulse reflection wave signal data collected while lowering the radar device in a pulse radar mode state, and monitoring a requester in the underground cavity through the frequency shift detection data obtained from the doppler radar after switching the radar device to the doppler radar mode state in a state where the radar device is raised and positioned at the depth of the underground cavity. According to the present invention, even if the buried people do not penetrate the through-hole through drilling into the space where the buried people will survive, radar equipment is inserted into the borehole around the buried person space to check whether the buried people survive.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 고심도 매몰자 탐지용 레이더 시스템 및 그 제어 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 고심도 매몰자 탐지용 파이프형 레이더 시스템은 펄스 레이더와 도플러 레이더를 포함하는 레이더 장치, 레이더 장치를 시추공에서 상승 또는 하강시키는 윈치 장치, 윈치 장치를 구동하여 레이더 장치를 시추공에서 상승 또는 하강시키고, 펄스 레이더에서 획득되는 펄스 반사파 신호 데이터와 도플러 레이더에서 획득되는 주파수 변이 감지 데이터를 수집하는 지상 통제 장치, 및 펄스 레이더 모드 상태에서 상기 레이더 장치를 하강시키면서 수집되는 펄스 반사파 신호 데이터로부터 지하공동의 심도를 확인하고, 레이더 장치를 상승시켜 지하공동의 심도에 위치시킨 상태에서 레이더 장치를 도플러 레이더 모드 상태로 전환한 후 도플러 레이더에서 획득되는 주파수 변이 감지 데이터를 통해 지하공동에서 요구조자를 모니터링하는 컴퓨팅 장치를 포함한다. 본 발명에 매몰자들이 생존해 있을 공간으로 시추를 통해 관통공을 관통하지 않더라도 매몰자 공간 주변의 시추공에 레이더 장비를 투입하여 생존여부를 확인할 수 있다.

title_en: Internet of things based smart mirror device with sensing function
title_ko: 센싱 기능을 갖는 사물인터넷 기반 스마트 미러 장치
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an IoT-based smart mirror device having a sensing function, which configures an IoT-based smart mirror and enables an emergency call to be immediately contacted to a designated contact or a management room when a person falls down or suddenly has a heartbeat or breathing abnormality. An IoT-based smart mirror device (100) having a sensing function comprises: a smart mirror main body (110) used as a smart mirror; a sensor unit (120) installed in the smart mirror main body (110) and detecting a biometric signal and an operation of a person located in front of a mirror of the smart mirror main body (110); and a control unit (130) performing emergency call control in preparation for emergency and emergency situations based on the detection of the biometric signal and the operation of the person detected by the sensor unit (120).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 센싱 기능을 갖는 사물인터넷 기반 스마트 미러 장치에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 센싱 기능을 갖는 사물인터넷 기반 스마트 미러 장치로서, 스마트 미러로 사용되는 스마트 미러 본체; 상기 스마트 미러 본체에 설치되어, 상기 스마트 미러 본체의 거울 전방에 위치하는 사람의 생체신호 및 동작을 감지하는 센서부; 및 상기 센서부에서 감지되는 사람의 생체신호 및 동작 감지에 기초한 응급 및 위급 상황에 대비한 응급 호출 제어를 수행하는 제어부를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 센싱 기능을 갖는 사물인터넷 기반 스마트 미러 장치에 따르면, 스마트 미러로 사용되는 스마트 미러 본체와, 스마트 미러 본체에 설치되어, 상기 스마트 미러 본체의 거울 전방에 위치하는 사람의 생체신호 및 동작을 감지하는 센서부와, 센서부에서 감지되는 사람의 생체신호 및 동작 감지에 기초한 응급 및 위급 상황에 대비한 응급 호출 제어를 수행하는 제어부를 포함하여 구성함으로써, 사물인터넷 기반의 스마트 미러를 구성하되, 스마트 미러 본체의 거울 전방에서 사람이 쓰러지거나 갑자기 심박이나 호흡 상태에 이상이 있는 경우, 즉시 지정된 연락처 또는 관리실에 응급 호출의 연락이 가능하도록 할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 센싱 기능을 갖는 사물인터넷 기반 스마트 미러 장치에 따르면, 사물인터넷 기반의 스마트 미러를 구성하되, 스마트 미러 본체의 거울 전방에서 사람이 쓰러지거나 갑자기 심박이나 호흡 상태에 이상이 있는 경우, 즉시 지정된 연락처 또는 관리실에 응급 호출의 연락이 가능하도록 함으로써, 일상적인 생활의 장소에서 사람의 응급 상황에 대비한 호출 서비스가 제공되고, 그에 따른 응급 환자의 안전이 확보될 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
뿐만 아니라, 본 발명의 센싱 기능을 갖는 사물인터넷 기반 스마트 미러 장치에 따르면, 사물인터넷 기반의 스마트 미러를 구성하되, 스마트 미러 본체의 거울 전방에서 사람이 쓰러지거나 갑자기 심박이나 호흡 상태에 이상이 있는 경우, 즉시 지정된 연락처 또는 관리실에 응급 호출의 연락이 가능하도록 함으로써, 일상적인 생활의 장소에서 혼자 위급한 상황이 발생되더라도 신속한 연락을 통한 구호조치가 가능하고, 스마트 미러의 건강 추적 및 응급 호출의 안전 서비스가 더욱 향상될 수 있도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Method for fallen detection using radar sensors
title_ko: 레이더센서를 활용한 낙상 감지 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for detecting a fall using a radar sensor, which is performed by a server. The method for detecting a fall using a radar sensor comprises: (a) a step in which a plurality of radar sensors installed in a lower portion of a bed detect a movement and a bio-signal of a user located in the bed; (b) a step of receiving a movement signal and a bio-signal of the user from the radar sensor and inputting the movement signal and the bio-signal to a fall detection model to determine whether the user is present and falls; (c) a step of transmitting a message notifying the fall of the user to at least one of a user terminal, a guardian terminal, and a medical center terminal according to whether the user is present and falls; and (d) a step of remotely controlling an IoT device within a preset range from the radar sensor to perform follow-up measures when the movement signal and the bio-signal of the user received from the radar sensor are determined to fall after a preset time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 서버에 의해 수행되는, 레이더센서를 활용한 낙상 감지 방법에 관한 것으로서, (a) 침대의 하부에 설치된 복수의 레이더센서가 상기 침대에 위치한 사용자의 움직임 및 생체신호를 감지하는 단계; (b) 상기 레이더센서로부터 사용자의 움직임 신호 및 생체신호를 수신하여 낙상감지모델에 입력함으로써, 상기 사용자의 재실 여부 및 낙상여부를 판단하는 단계; (c) 상기 사용자의 재실 여부 및 낙상여부에 따라, 사용자 단말, 보호자 단말 및 의료센터 단말 중 적어도 하나로 상기 사용자의 낙상을 알리는 메시지를 전달하는 단계; 및 (d) 기 설정된 시간 이후, 상기 레이더센서로부터 수신한 사용자의 움직임 신호 및 생체신호가 낙상 상태로 판단되는 경우, 상기 레이더센서로부터 기 설정된 범위 이내의 IoT 장치를 원격으로 제어하여 후속조치를 수행하는 단계;를 포함하는, 레이더센서를 활용한 낙상 감지 방법에 관한 기술이다.

title_en: System and method for detecting undergroung object using frequency analysis
title_ko: 주파수 분석을 이용한 지하 매설물 탐지 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, provided is an underground buried object detection system comprising: a GPR module for producing reflected wave data; and an analysis module for producing detection information on an underground buried object by using the reflected wave data, wherein the GPR module includes a GPR sensor for producing reflected wave signals by repeating a process of causing an electromagnetic wave to enter the ground and receiving a reflected wave returning in response thereto while moving a predetermined distance on the ground, the reflected wave data includes a plurality of reflected wave signals produced by the GPR sensor, the analysis module includes a frequency analysis unit for producing frequency analysis data by performing frequency analysis on the reflected wave data, a machine learning unit for performing machine learning on learning data, and an underground buried object estimation model generated by the machine learning and configured to detect a target underground buried object, and the learning data includes the frequency analysis data as an input learning factor.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 의하면, 반사파 데이터를 생산하는 GPR 모듈; 및 상기 반사파 데이터를 이용하여 지하 매설물에 대한 탐지 정보를 생산하는 분석 모듈을 포함하며, 상기 GPR 모듈은 지상에서 일정 거리 이동하는 동안 전자기파를 땅속으로 입사시키고 대응하여 되돌아오는 반사파를 수신하는 과정을 반복하여 반사파 신호를 생산하는 GPR 센서를 구비하며, 상기 반사파 데이터는 상기 GPR 센서에 의해 생산되는 복수 개의 반사파 신호들을 포함하며, 상기 분석 모듈은 상기 반사파 데이터에 대한 주파수 분석을 수행하여 주파수 분석 데이터를 생산하는 주파수 분석부와, 학습데이터에 대한 기계학습을 수행하는 기계학습부와, 상기 기계학습에 의해 생성되어서 탐지 대상 지하 매설물을 탐지하는 매설물 추정 모델을 구비하며, 상기 학습데이터는 입력 학습 인자로서 상기 주파수 분석 데이터를 포함하는 지하 매설물 탐지 시스템이 제공된다.

title_en: Non-contact sleep stage method and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact sleep stage method and device, which comprises the steps of placing radar equipment at a designated position and powering on, processing echo signals of the radar equipment to obtain vital sign data, sending the vital sign data to a cloud server for storage, deriving and processing the vital sign data into time sequence features and frequency domain features, constructing a sleep stage prediction model, inputting the time sequence features and the frequency domain features into the sleep stage prediction model, carrying out feature learning and outputting sleep stage prediction values, simultaneously modeling the time sequence features and the frequency domain features through a double-branch structure, capturing a time sequence dependency relationship by utilizing BiLSTM, and enhancing the attention of the model to the time sequence information and the frequency domain information in the sequence by utilizing a attention mechanism.

title_en: In-pipe robot positioning method and system suitable for non-excavation deep buried pipeline
abstract_en: The invention discloses an in-pipe robot positioning method and system suitable for non-excavation deep buried pipelines, relates to the technical field of robot positioning, can be applied to the field of pipeline detection, and mainly aims to solve the problem that the existing in-pipe robot endurance and signal detection strength cannot be balanced, so that the applicability to different pipeline detection scenes is low. The method mainly comprises the steps that an in-pipe robot synchronously receives electromagnetic signals sent by an out-pipe auxiliary inspection robot through a transmitter array through a plurality of carried receivers, relative position coordinates of the in-pipe robot and the out-pipe auxiliary inspection robot are calculated according to receiving time of all the electromagnetic signals received by each receiver to obtain target relative position coordinates, in-pipe positioning coordinates are calculated according to each group of relative position coordinates, and weighted average calculation is conducted according to the in-pipe positioning coordinates and in-pipe positioning coordinates of a positioning sensor to obtain target in-pipe positioning coordinates. The method is mainly used for positioning the robot in the pipe.

title_en: Method and system for synchronously collecting multi-person gestures of through-wall radar and binocular camera
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for synchronously collecting Multi-person gestures of a through-wall radar and a binocular camera, wherein the method comprises the steps of respectively acquiring an echo signal of the through-wall radar and an image of the binocular camera; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing echo signals to obtain a channel-distance matrix formed by stacking one-dimensional distance images of all receiving and transmitting channels of a radar, synthesizing binocular camera images to obtain a synthesized image, performing three-dimensional position calculation on the synthesized image to obtain three-dimensional point clouds of all pixel points in the synthesized image, performing time matching on the channel-distance matrix, the synthesized image and the three-dimensional point clouds to obtain an initial data frame, extracting YOLO gesture information based on the three-dimensional point clouds, estimating three-dimensional gestures from the images through a Multi-HMR algorithm, fusing the two gesture information to generate a final tag, and performing spatial registration on the gesture tag and radar data to form the final data frame. The invention realizes high-quality three-dimensional attitude information acquisition.
assignees: SUN YAT SEN UNIV SHENZHEN;UNIV SUN YAT SEN

title_en: Explosion-proof device and system that spouts
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of steel slag treatment equipment, in particular to an anti-blowout device and an anti-blowout system. The explosion-proof spraying device comprises a silo, a cut-off valve group and a sensor, wherein the silo is provided with a containing cavity and an opening, the containing cavity is used for containing materials, the opening is opposite to an automobile trunk, the cut-off valve group is in movable fit with the silo and is used for closing or opening the opening, the sensor is arranged at the opening, and/or the sensor is arranged below the opening, the sensor is electrically connected with the cut-off valve group, and the sensor is used for detecting the moving speed of the materials. The explosion-proof spraying device can prevent materials from suddenly collapsing or spraying, and avoid safety accidents such as buried vehicles, casualties and the like.
assignees: GUANGDONG HUAXIN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-target vital sign detection method, terminal device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of data processing, and discloses a multi-target vital sign detection method, terminal equipment and a storage medium. The multi-target vital sign detection method comprises the steps of controlling a millimeter wave radar to scan a target area to obtain a point cloud sequence, determining the number of target characters in the target area according to the point cloud sequence, generating an independent point cloud sequence of each target character according to the point cloud sequence when the number of the target characters is multiple, and generating vital sign parameters corresponding to each target character according to the independent point cloud sequence of each target character. The invention reduces the complexity and the cost of hardware and also maintains the advantages of non-contact detection of the millimeter wave radar.
assignees: SHENZHEN JIYUAN TIMES TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wounded rescue life detection and positioning method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning-based wounded rescue life detection and positioning method which comprises the steps of S1, collecting and time synchronizing a plurality of RGB-D images, laser radar point clouds, millimeter wave vital sign radar data and infrared thermal image data, S2, outputting a pixel-level semantic mask, S3, generating wounded semantic point clouds, S4, forming a measurement-semantic dual map data set, S5, generating vital sign scores and writing the measurement-semantic dual map data set, S6, updating the wounded dynamic anchor attribute in the measurement-semantic dual map data set, S7, calculating the three-dimensional coordinates and rescue priority ordering of each wounded dynamic anchor based on the updated measurement-semantic dual map data set, and generating a obstacle avoidance optimization navigation path avoiding a risk semantic area. The invention effectively improves rescue efficiency and safety.
assignees: THE FIRST MEDICAL CENTER OF CHINESE PLA GENERAL HOSPITAL

title_en: Indoor LED fire emergency lamp
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field related to fire emergency lamps, in particular to an indoor LED fire emergency lamp, which comprises a fixed plate, wherein a storage battery is fixedly connected to one side of the fixed plate, a display structure is arranged on one side of the fixed plate, an induction mechanism is arranged on one side of the fixed plate, in the use process, the indoor LED fire emergency lamp can be buried in advance at a floor, a first bolt can be loosened, a direction indicator can rotate through loosening of the first bolt, so that the effect of adjusting the indication direction of the direction indicator is achieved, when a sudden fire disaster occurs, a temperature sensor senses abnormal indoor temperature, a loudspeaker and an illumination lamp are triggered, the loudspeaker can broadcast preset voice to help a person in the presence to escape in order, the illumination lamp can provide a certain illumination condition for the person in the presence, clear and correct escape direction is provided for the person in the presence, and the safety level of the whole fire fighting is greatly improved.
assignees: TIANJIN DINGYU CONSTRUCTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hemodialysis patient intelligent monitoring system, method and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent monitoring system, an intelligent monitoring method and electronic equipment based on hemodialysis patients, which are suitable for a hospital and community dialysis center scene. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, an AI analysis module and a feedback and decision module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring vital sign evaluation anxiety/pain grades, the data processing module is used for receiving sensor data and triggering real-time early warning on key indexes, the AI analysis module is used for establishing a patient individuation baseline model, dynamically identifying abnormal modes, carrying out emotion analysis, combining dialysis parameters with real-time data and predicting risks, and the feedback and decision module is used for pushing three-level alarms and providing a visual interface, displaying patient history data and AI inference logic and assisting clinical decisions. According to the invention, vital sign and emotion data of a hemodialysis patient are collected in real time through the wearable equipment, and graded alarm and solution are provided after AI analysis.
assignees: RENMIN HOSPITAL WUHAN UNIV HUBEI GENERAL HOSPITAL

title_en: Portable radar life detector
abstract_en: The invention relates to a portable radar life detector in the technical field of radar detection equipment, which comprises a machine case, a supporting table, a workbench and a working table, wherein the top of the machine case is hinged with an organic cover, the top of the machine cover is provided with a handle assembly, the supporting table is arranged at the top of the inner wall of the machine case, the circumferential inner wall of the supporting table is rotatably connected with a rotary table through a bearing, the bottom of the supporting table is provided with a rotating mechanism for driving the rotary table to rotate, the surface of the workbench is designed into a spherical shape, and the middle of the rotary table is provided with a spherical groove matched with the surface of the workbench. The invention can convert the detection radar body from a vertical state to an inclined state, and enables the detection radar body to break through the limitation of the traditional vertical downward detection, thereby realizing the scanning of different areas by changing the detection direction, covering wider areas, accurately detecting the life signs at different positions and greatly improving the accuracy and the effectiveness of life detection.
assignees: SICHUAN FENGBANG FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for reconstructing circulatory generation countermeasure network based on non-contact electrocardiosignal
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the field of electrocardiosignal monitoring, in particular to a method and a device for reconstructing a circulatory generation countermeasure network based on a non-contact electrocardiosignal. The method comprises the steps of carrying out component extraction processing on a pre-acquired non-contact electrocardio radar signal to obtain an electrocardio radar characteristic signal, carrying out coding processing on the electrocardio radar characteristic signal, respectively carrying out preprocessing on a pre-acquired sample radar signal set and a label electrocardio signal set, constructing an image reconstruction model based on a sample Lei Dage lambda angle difference field image set and a label electrocardio gram angle difference field image set, inputting an electrocardio Lei Dage lambda angle difference field image into the image reconstruction model, and carrying out conversion processing on the reconstructed electrocardio image to obtain a reconstructed electrocardio signal. The embodiment can effectively reconstruct ECG signals and provides a new idea for non-contact vital sign sensing.

title_en: OFDM radar vital sign signal separation method based on FGO-VMD and multi-feature clustering
abstract_en: The invention discloses an OFDM radar vital sign signal separation method based on FGO-VMD and multi-feature clustering, and belongs to the technical field of radar communication integration. According to the method, OFDM signal radar is utilized for human body detection, multi-subcarrier phase difference linear regression is utilized for estimating displacement, chest micro-motion signals are extracted, a FGO-VMD combined optimization model is provided, the mode number and penalty factor parameters of a VMD decomposition algorithm are determined through minimum envelope entropy self-adaption, a multi-feature clustering and weighting construction strategy is designed, frequency band screening and related coefficient weighting are combined, robustness of separation of respiratory signals and heartbeat signals is enhanced, and high-precision separation of vital sign signals is achieved. The invention realizes non-contact vital sign detection based on the OFDM radar signal, solves the problems that the traditional algorithm needs to manually set parameters of the modal number and punishment factor, signal amplitude attenuation and modal aliasing under complex noise, and the like, remarkably improves the accuracy of vital sign monitoring, and realizes high-accuracy separation of vital sign signals.

title_en: Integrated steering wheel sensors for driver safety and health monitoring
abstract_en: A steering wheel system is disclosed for monitoring a driver's vital signs of a driver. The steering wheel system comprises a steering wheel and sensors integrated into the steering wheel. The sensors are configured to detect one or more driver vital signs. The steering wheel system comprises a memory storing computer executable instructions, and a processor configured to execute the computer executable instructions. The processor receives the one or more vital signs from the array of sensors, wherein the one or more vital signs correspond to cortisol levels, alcohol levels, one or more proteins associated with an occurrence stroke, one or more biomarkers associated with myocardial infarctions, temperature, pulse rate, and oxygen levels. The processor determines a health risk of the driver based at least in part on the vital signs and alerts the driver in response to the health risk exceeding a certain health risk level.

title_en: Non-contact sleep stage classification system and classification method based on visual view
abstract_en: The invention provides a non-contact sleep stage classification system and a classification method based on visual views. The system comprises a non-contact physiological information acquisition module, a visual network construction module and a sleep stage multi-element classification module. The visual network construction module is used for training network features extracted by the visual network construction module by using a machine learning method, firstly carrying out normalization processing on the extracted network features, then dividing sleep stages into a awake stage and a sleep stage, then carrying out fine classification on the sleep stage, dividing the sleep stage into a rapid eye movement stage, a sleep stage I, a sleep stage II and a sleep stage III, and finally completing the division of five sleep stages. The visual network is applied to the respiration and heartbeat signals extracted by the non-contact vital sign monitoring radar, so that the two branch networks of respiration and heartbeat are built, deep information of the respiration and heartbeat signals is further mined, and the accuracy rate of sleep stage classification is improved.

title_en: Joint remote vital signs sensing communications and pnt based drone swarm
abstract_en: Embodiments of a method of operating a drone swarm system of a swarm of unmanned arial vehicles (UAVs) are disclosed. In some embodiments, a search of a geographic area is performed based on one or more first radar signals from at least one of the UAVs. Additionally, it is determined whether at least one obstruction of the geographic area is found in response to performing the search. A radar operation mode for each of the UAVs is determined based on whether at least one obstruction is detected. One or more living entities are detected in the geographic area based on one or more second radar signals transmitted in accordance with the determined radar operation mode.

title_en: Underground garage fire-fighting fire-extinguishing system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of fire extinguishing and fire extinguishing, in particular to a buried underground garage fire extinguishing and fire extinguishing system, which comprises a cover plate arranged on the surface of a parking space, an infrared temperature sensor embedded in the ground surface, a smoke sensor arranged on a wall surface and a groove arranged below the surface of the parking space, wherein a fire extinguishing mechanism is arranged on the upper layer in the groove and comprises a first pipeline, two ends of the first pipeline are respectively connected with a second pipeline through a rotating shaft, one of the second pipelines is sleeved with a first turbine, the second pipeline is respectively connected with a third pipeline through a first telescopic steel pipe, one end of the third pipeline is respectively connected with a cooling spray head, the rotating shaft at the other end of the third pipeline is respectively connected with a water curtain spray head, the end of the third pipeline, which is provided with the water curtain spray head, is respectively sleeved with a second turbine, one side of the second pipeline is connected with a fourth pipeline through a first connecting rod, and two ends of the fourth pipeline are respectively provided with a dry powder spray head.
assignees: ZHONGWAI JIANHUACHENG ENGINEERING TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus and method for bio-signal detection using radar sensor
title_ko: 레이더 센서를 이용한 생체신호 검출 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus and a method for detecting a bio-signal using a radar sensor. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the method for detecting a bio-signal using a radar sensor comprises: a preprocessing step through filtering for removing a harmonic noise component with respect to a baseband signal reflecting a difference between a transmission signal of a radar and a reception signal reflected by a target and limiting a maximum frequency signal range of the baseband signal; a step of generating a plurality of intrinsic mode functions (imf) by applying empirical mode decomposition (emd) to the preprocessed baseband signal; a step of identifying a first mode function including a target signal component and a removal signal component among the plurality of intrinsic mode functions and a second mode function including the removal signal component; a step of generating a harmonic signal of the removal signal component by using the second mode function; and a step of deriving a target signal including the target signal component by using the first mode function and the harmonic signal.
abstract_ko: 레이더 센서를 이용한 생체신호 검출 장치 및 방법이 개시되며, 본원의 일 실시예에 따른 레이더 센서를 이용한 생체신호 검출 방법은, 레이더의 송신 신호와 대상자에 의해 반사된 수신 신호의 차이를 반영하는 기저대역 신호에 대하여 고조파 잡음 성분을 제거하고 기저대역 신호의 최대 주파수 신호 범위를 한정하는 필터링을 통한 전처리 단계, 전처리된 기저대역 신호에 경험적 모드 분해(Empirical Mode Decomposition, EMD)를 적용하여 복수의 내재 모드 함수(Intrinsic Mode Function, IMF)를 생성하는 단계, 상기 복수의 내재 모드 함수 중 타겟 신호 성분 및 제거 신호 성분을 포함하는 제1모드 함수와 상기 제거 신호 성분을 포함하는 제2모드 함수를 식별하는 단계, 상기 제2모드 함수를 이용하여 상기 제거 신호 성분의 고조파 신호를 생성하는 단계 및 상기 제1모드 함수 및 상기 고조파 신호를 이용하여 상기 타겟 신호 성분을 포함하는 타겟 신호를 도출하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: UNIV KONKUK IND COOP CORP;MILLISIGHT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Human body respiration and heartbeat signal estimation method and system based on UWB radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a human body respiration and heartbeat signal estimation method and system based on UWB radar, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting channel impulse response signals by using the UWB radar; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing channel impulse response signals, namely filtering random noise of direct current offset and high frequency parts in the signals respectively by means of average filtering and low-pass filtering, selecting a distance gate with the largest autocorrelation value as a distance gate with the most abundant human vital sign information based on the preprocessed response signals by using an autocorrelation function, using a signal sequence corresponding to the distance gate as an input signal for signal processing, decomposing the input signal based on discrete wavelet transformation, extracting characteristic information of the input signal in a time domain and a frequency domain, acquiring frequency point information of a respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal based on the characteristic information, and respectively carrying out respiratory frequency estimation and heartbeat frequency estimation based on frequency point extraction in a specific frequency range. The method can realize high-precision respiratory frequency and heartbeat frequency estimation.
assignees: HARBIN INSTITUTE OF TECH SHENZHEN INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH INNOVATION

title_en: MIMO through-wall radar imaging method based on propagation compensation and coherence factor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a MIMO through-wall radar imaging method based on propagation compensation and coherence factors. Aiming at the problems of attenuation weakening of target signals, grating lobe side lobes accompanying imaging and low imaging efficiency, firstly, reconstructing obtained data based on coherent factors, deforming echo data, obtaining reconstructed data, enabling the obtained reconstructed data to be capable of being calculated in parallel with original echo data to obtain incoherent superposition parts of the coherent factors, then reducing the dimension of the echo data of the MIMO array to be single static array echo data based on an equivalent phase center, quantitatively deriving to obtain a specific propagation compensation value based on scalar diffraction theory, compensating fixed free space propagation attenuation under the condition that non-fixed wall attenuation is difficult to obtain, completing wave number domain processing, designing wall compensation factors of the wave number domain, directly correcting extra time delay introduced by wall penetrating refraction in the wave number domain, and finally utilizing incoherent superposition components and coherent superposition components obtained through parallel calculation to complete weighted imaging to obtain a final imaging result.

title_en: Escape guiding method and system based on firefighting multi-physical-field analysis and AR equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of escape guiding scheme design, in particular to an escape guiding method and system based on firefighting multi-physical-field analysis and AR equipment. Aiming at the defects of path planning, survivor positioning and cutting, dynamic risk response lag and the like in the traditional rescue, vital signs are detected through multi-source sensor fusion, and an optimal rescue path is generated in millisecond-level time by combining real-time coupling simulation of a stress field, a toxic gas diffusion field and a fire disaster thermal flow field of a building structure. The system automatically classifies priorities after detecting the vital body signals, supports the through-wall mode to quickly approach to high-risk survivors, and synchronously optimizes the multi-objective traversal sequence. The guiding path is dynamically projected to a visual field interface of the rescue personnel through the AR equipment, and the heartbeat frequency domain visualization and the risk chromaticity warning are fused. The scheme breaks through the bottleneck of artificial experience decision making, realizes closed loop intelligent response from physical sign perception to path execution, and greatly improves rescue timeliness, target hit rate and action safety in complex disaster environments.
assignees: QINGDAO JUNHAI IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-excavation detection electromagnetic device of direct-buried heat supply pipeline based on geomagnetic feedback data collection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a direct-buried heat supply pipeline non-excavation detection electromagnetic device based on geomagnetic feedback data collection, which comprises a shell, a cover plate, a fixing ring, a mounting block, a movable rod, a limiting block and a cesium magnetic sensor matrix, wherein a fixing plate is fixedly arranged on the outer side of the front end of the shell, the fixing plate is connected with the front end of the shell, the movable handle is connected with the upper side of the inner part of the shell, the cover plate is arranged on the inner side of a disassembly structure, the right side of the rear end of the cover plate is provided with the 64-bit heat sensor, the fixing ring is arranged on the left side of the rear end of the cover plate, the mounting block is fixedly arranged at the rear end of the fixing ring, the outer side of the middle part of the mounting block is connected with the movable rod, the inner side of the movable rod is connected with the limiting block, and the inner side of the limiting block is connected with the cesium magnetic sensor matrix. This non-excavation of direct-burried heat supply pipeline detects electromagnetic means based on earth magnetism feedback data collection conveniently carries detection electromagnetic means, conveniently changes phased array scanning radar cesium magnetic sensor, and conveniently collects earth magnetism feedback data.
assignees: TIANJIN HENGTAI PERCEPTION PRECISION MEASUREMENT TECH CO LTD;TIANJIN JINAN THERMAL POWER CO LTD

title_en: Disaster search and rescue motion control system based on multi-sensor robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster search and rescue motion control system based on a multi-sensor robot, which relates to the technical field of motion control of robots, and comprises the steps of determining a perception range threshold of the robot according to overall perception of a disaster scene environment, generating a preliminary search and rescue route of a clustered robot based on regional division of the disaster environment, predicting the change trend of obstacles in a region to be searched by the robot and the corresponding dangerous degree based on multi-sensor data, further adjusting the search and rescue route of the robot in real time to realize dynamic obstacle avoidance, determining vital signs of trapped people through a life recognition system of infrared detection, simultaneously recognizing the postures and rescue difficulties of the trapped people based on multi-sensor fusion, reporting the vital signs, the postures and the rescue difficulties of the trapped people, and dynamically adjusting the search and rescue route according to the current position and the state of the robot by utilizing position information of a decentralized network sharing robot. The disaster search and rescue of high-efficient accurate, safe dynamic has been realized, search and rescue efficiency and success rate have been greatly promoted.

title_en: Safe and efficient mining control method for shallow-buried close-range coal seam
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal seam exploitation control, in particular to a safe and efficient exploitation control method for a shallow-buried close-range coal seam. According to the invention, through multi-mode data acquisition such as distributed optical fibers, laser spectrum sensors and unmanned aerial vehicle thermal imaging, a Cauchy distribution model is combined to comprehensively analyze temperature overflow values, CO anomaly monitoring ratio values, microseismic energy and oxygen concentration influence values to position a fire source, so that accurate guidance is provided for a target surface or the fire source is provided, the fire source positioning precision is improved, the fire extinguishing cost is low, and a spontaneous combustion risk assessment model is constructed by utilizing historical fire source information and real-time gas data, and through calculation of spontaneous combustion probability, low/medium/high risk grading response is realized, the safety of underground personnel is improved, and meanwhile, through support strengthening and disaster comprehensive early warning, disaster risks such as roof fall, gas overrun and the like are remarkably reduced, and the safe and efficient exploitation of a shallow buried short-distance coal seam is ensured.
assignees: CHINA COAL NO 3 CONSTR GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Training method of heartbeat detection model and heartbeat interval detection method
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a training method of a heartbeat detection model and a heartbeat interval detection method, which can be applied to the technical field of radar signal processing. The method comprises the steps of determining signal quality of a plurality of sample echo signals based on signal characteristics of the plurality of sample echo signals, wherein the plurality of sample echo signals are obtained by detecting a plurality of positions to be detected of a sample object by using a sample radar signal, determining a target echo signal from the plurality of sample echo signals based on the signal quality of the sample echo signals, detecting a heartbeat interval of the target echo signal by using a preset heartbeat detection algorithm to obtain a tag signal, and training an initial heartbeat detection model by using the tag signal and the plurality of sample echo signals to obtain a target heartbeat detection model.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Anti-seismic bracket for natural gas long-distance pipeline separate-transportation station
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of natural gas engineering, and particularly discloses an anti-seismic bracket for a natural gas long-distance pipeline sub-transmission station, which comprises two shock buffers with two ends respectively installed. The support comprises a first bearing part and a second bearing part, the second bearing part is pre-buried in the installation position, and the two shock-absorbing buffers are respectively connected with the first bearing part and the second bearing part. One side of the first bearing part is provided with a pipeline installation part which is fixedly connected with the first bearing part. The shock absorber is mounted on the bearing part through a universal hinged support. The second receiving part is fixed on the structure. Under normal working conditions, the thermal displacement of the pipeline is not limited by the bracket. When an earthquake occurs, the support limits the vibration of the pipeline and prevents resonance damage. The support improves the stability and reliability of the pipeline, the earthquake force is dispersed through the double shock buffers, the universal hinged support allows multidirectional displacement, the maintenance is convenient, and the safety and stability of the natural gas conveying system are guaranteed.
assignees: SICHUAN GUORUI ENG DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium for inverting and reconstructing water content of soil layer
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for inverting the water content of a reconstructed soil layer, wherein the method comprises the steps of detecting the structure of the reconstructed soil layer by using a ground penetrating radar system to obtain electromagnetic wave propagation data of each layer of the reconstructed soil layer; the method comprises the steps of detecting a reconstructed soil layer provided with a reflector based on a ground penetrating radar system, obtaining double-pass time-of-flight data, obtaining the relative dielectric constant of a medium layer based on the double-pass time-of-flight data and the buried depth of the reflector, obtaining an empirical formula based on the relative dielectric constant, correcting the empirical formula based on the actual water content of the reconstructed soil layer, obtaining a water content model, and inverting based on the water content model to obtain the water content of the reconstructed soil layer. The method can obviously improve the accuracy of inversion of the water content of the soil layer by combining a ground penetrating radar system and a corrected empirical formula, and is particularly suitable for land reclamation and ecological restoration engineering of arid and semiarid open-air mining areas.

title_en: Wearable monitoring bracelet of preeclampsia early warning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wearable monitoring bracelet for early warning of preeclampsia, which relates to the technical field of wearable monitoring bracelets and comprises a monitoring bracelet main body, wherein a touch round screen is arranged in the middle of the top surface of the monitoring bracelet main body, two ends of the monitoring bracelet main body are fixedly connected with splicing end blocks, the end parts of the two splicing end blocks are respectively provided with an expanding splicing box, the tail end of the monitoring bracelet main body is internally filled with an elastic glue box, one side of the inside of the elastic glue box is provided with a gas pressure sensor, the monitoring precision and the monitoring efficiency of the monitoring bracelet are effectively improved, and meanwhile, the sensor in the expanding splicing box can be replaced according to the requirement by utilizing a general splicing structure at the splicing position of the expanding splicing box and the splicing end blocks, so that the monitoring bracelet can also carry out special accurate detection on other vital signs while detecting epilepsy symptoms, and the use safety and smoothness of the monitoring bracelet are further improved.

title_en: Biological sign parameter acquisition method, electronic scale and storage medium
abstract_en: The application is applicable to the technical field of data processing, and provides a method for acquiring biological sign parameters, an electronic scale and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring an infrared imaging image of a user through an infrared camera module and acquiring a corresponding airflow value when the user measures through an airflow sensor; the method comprises the steps of determining output current parameters corresponding to all electrodes on an electronic scale through an infrared imaging image, determining the acquisition frequency of a pressure sensor on the electronic scale through an airflow value, controlling electronic equipment to acquire at least one group of vital sign data of a user based on the output current parameters and the acquisition frequency, and obtaining a vital sign measurement report corresponding to the user according to a plurality of groups of vital sign data. By adopting the method, the accuracy of measuring the biological sign data can be improved.

title_en: Vital sign data acquisition and processing management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign data acquisition and processing management system, which belongs to the technical field of vital sign data management and monitoring, and particularly relates to a vital sign data acquisition and processing management system, comprising a cloud end unit, wherein a millimeter wave radar sensing unit is connected with the cloud end unit, a multi-band millimeter wave radar array and an adaptive beam forming technology are adopted to realize vital sign monitoring with high precision, long distance and dynamic tracking, a signal processing unit is connected with the cloud end unit, adaptive noise filtering, anomaly detection and data enhancement are carried out on first data information, the edge computing unit is connected with the millimeter wave radar sensing unit, the vital sign monitoring of high-precision, long-distance and dynamic tracking is realized by adopting the multi-band millimeter wave radar array and the self-adaptive beam forming technology, and based on the edge computing technology, the data acquired by the radar are processed in real time, which is equivalent to the built-in microprocessor of each node, the data are automatically judged after being processed and integrated, and then the data information is uploaded, so that the delay is reduced and the real-time response capability is enhanced.
assignees: JIANGXI UNIV OF FINANCE AND ECONOMICS

title_en: Algorithm and Method to Calculate Trajectory Lengths of Buried Cables
abstract_en: A method of determining the real length of underground cables in a line location receiver having a spatial array of 6 antennas, wherein the antennas can receive and measure a phase coherent low frequency alternating magnetic field emanating from a buried conductor that is energized by a signal generator, wherein the antennas are arranged in 2 sets each comprising sensors on 3 orthogonal axes, includes computing a relative position of a buried conductor that includes both the cable depth and the transverse offset relative to a magnetic axis of the line location receiver, the transverse offset being vector at 90° to the buried conductor trajectory; and determining the real trajectory length of a buried cable from defined start and end positions from the relative positions.

title_ko: 비닐하우스, 축사에서 실내보온용 지열흡수보강장치
abstract_en: The present invention provides a structure that maintains stable temperature and humidity by supplying thermal air, which has absorbed geothermal heat, into an indoor space through a long heating pipe and a drainage pipe buried underground. In addition, by linking a sensor and a pump, it prevents cold damage in vinyl greenhouses and storage warehouses and improves energy efficiency. In a geothermal heat absorption reinforcement device comprising a drainage pipe buried underground with an inner space and a reinforcing member formed with ribs on its outer surface, a penetration hole is formed in the upper section of the drainage pipe and a first suction pipe is connected thereto, and an inlet is formed in the lower section of the first suction pipe to supply air into the indoor space through a pump. In addition, air is supplied by a pump through a second hose fixed to the injection section of the reinforcing member to provide indoor thermal insulation for vinyl greenhouses or livestock barns.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비닐하우스, 축사에서 실내보온용 지열흡수보강장치에 대한 발명으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 비닐하우스의 실내에서 습설로 붕괴되는 손실을 예방에 필요한 보온을 지열의 공급과, 아울러 지붕이나 실내에 실용적인 지열을 공급으로, 냉해, 폭염, 습설에 의한 자연재해의 피해방지를 제공하기 위한 발명이다.  
일반적으로 기후변화에 의한 실매보온을 위하여 보일러 또는 태양광과 같은 신재생에너지를 활용하고 있으나, 이는 실내안전을 위한 에너지 제공을 위하여 요구되는 비용의 증가함이며, 특히 기후변화에 의한 급격한 한파, 폭염에 대한 대비를 위한 비용에 대한 절약을 위한 신제생에너지, 지열 등의 보온장치에 대한 관심이 높아가는 현실이다 
그러나 가온변화에 따른 실내의 온도변화에 따라 냉해, 폭염에 의한 부패 등의 문제가 발생하고 있는 현실이다.  
   따라서 조립식 작업장에서 혹한, 폭염기에 냉해, 열사병, 고온에 의한 식재료의 변질에 대한 공기온도를 조절시켜 주도록 친환경적이면서 경제성이 양호한 지열을 공급을 제공함이며, 이는 산업발전에 따른 AI기술의 도입에 따른 감지장치와 펌프의 구동을 자동화로서, 영농지역에 구축된 농업시설에 대한 공기조화를 위하도록 지하수의 순환적인 활용으로 안정적인 실내공간에 대한 실용성 재고를 위한 발명이다.  
 따라서 상기 비닐로 감싸주는 내측공간에  분출구가 천공된 공급 및 배출용 파이프을 교호상으로 고정시켜 주되, 상기 파이프에는 호오스로 연결된 펌프을 구비로서, 기온 변화에 따른 모니터링 감응장치의 구동에 따라, 창고, 작업장의 실내공간에 대한 쾌적의 온도유지용 체크밸브로 제공하는 발명이다.

title_en: Biological signal processing device and biological signal processing program
abstract_en: To acquire more accurate vital information from a reflection wave obtained by transmitting an electric wave to a living body.SOLUTION: In a biological signal processing device, vital signals in which a body motion component is removed are taken out by using the ratio of complex signals of two reflection waves by a reflection wave from a region R1 where the motion is large because it includes a vital component in a person to be measured (living body) 7 and a reflection wave from a region R2 where the motion is small because it does not include a vital component by a beamforming and a null beam of a reception signal using one radar module using an array antenna (23 and 25) as indicated in Fig. 1. As a method of the present invention for acquiring a reflection wave by designating a specific site such as the region R2 (shoulder) which does not include a vital component and whose motion is small, the reflection wave is multiplied by weighting information w1 and w2 obtained by beamforming beforehand.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Multi-source data fusion-based high-voltage test hall electric shock prevention early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source data fusion-based high-voltage test hall electric shock prevention early warning system and method, wherein an electric field dynamic monitoring module is used for acquiring and calibrating electric field data through a distributed three-axis field intensity sensor array and predicting field intensity distribution by combining an ARIMA-GRU hybrid model; the UWB-IMU co-location module adopts TOF-TDOa-aOA algorithm to fuse inertial data to achieve location of testers, the vital sign abnormality detection module is used for monitoring body surface leakage current and physiological parameters, the three-dimensional live-action modeling module is used for constructing dynamic safety boundaries based on laser SLAM, the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation decision module is used for dynamically distributing weights and calculating risk indexes through an LSTM-ATT model, and the multistage emergency linkage control module is used for executing hierarchical power-off response. According to the invention, through multi-source data fusion and dynamic threshold adjustment, quick power-off response and full scene risk management and control are realized, the false alarm rate is reduced, and the electric shock accident of the high-voltage test is effectively prevented.
assignees: STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;WUHAN NARI LTD LIABILITY CO OF STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Through-wall radar clutter suppression method based on space frequency diversity
abstract_en: The invention provides a through-wall radar clutter suppression method based on spatial frequency diversity, and aims to solve the problems of background clutter interference and difficult detection of low-speed moving targets of through-wall radars in complex indoor environments. The method mainly comprises the steps of solving the problem P1 (formula (1) in the specification), generating signal waveforms with low side lobes and good Doppler tolerance through multi-band radar signal waveform optimization design, solving the problem P2 (formula (2) in the specification), optimizing a beam array according to antenna patterns of signals with different frequencies by combining an antenna beam forming technology, and realizing effective differentiation of target signals and background clutter by comparing echo power ratios of signals with different frequencies in different directions based on bat bionic multi-band radar array signal processing.

title_en: Mounting structure for vital sign detection radar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mounting structure for a vital sign detection radar, which comprises a fixing mechanism, a supporting rod, an adjusting mechanism and the vital sign detection radar, wherein the fixing mechanism is used for being detachably connected with a side plate of a bedstead, the lower end of the supporting rod is connected with the fixing mechanism, the upper end of the supporting rod is fixedly connected with the adjusting mechanism, the vital sign detection radar is connected with the adjusting mechanism, the adjusting mechanism has two degrees of freedom, the adjusting mechanism can adjust the vital sign detection radar to rotate around the axis of the supporting rod and pitch and swing up and down, and a sleeping area on the bedstead can be covered by radio waves emitted by the vital sign detection radar. The problem of among the prior art through drilling on the wall body, adopt the inflation screw to install sign detection radar, the installation is inconvenient, and inconvenient installation angle to sign detection radar adjusts is solved.

title_en: System and method for non-contact people localization and vital signs monitoring via fmcw radar
abstract_en: A monitoring system is presented for monitoring vital signs of subject(s). The monitoring system includes a control system configured for signal communication with a frequency modulated continuous wave (FMCW) radar to process measured data which is received from a single-channel front end of receiver of said FMCW radar and which is in the form of data matrix indicative of consecutive beat signals. The control system comprises a data processing utility comprising: a localization module configured and operable to process the measured data indicative of said data matrix and provide support recovery data indicative of the received signals originated at localized one or more subjects; and a vital signs monitoring module configured and operable to analyze the support recovery data and monitor vital signs of said localized one or more subjects.

title_en: Wisdom ward platform based on thing networking
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent ward platform based on the Internet of things, and relates to the technical field of intelligent ward. The system comprises a patient room, a patient room monitoring system and a patient room, wherein the patient room is internally provided with a bedside interaction unit, an infusion unit, a nursing electronic whiteboard unit and a patient room display screen, the patient is worn with an electrocardiograph monitoring bracelet, the patient room monitoring system comprises a millimeter wave blood flow monitoring module and is used for acquiring vital sign data and electrocardiograph monitoring data, the patient room monitoring system further comprises a vital sign fusion monitoring module, an infusion optimization system comprises a piezoelectric film sensing array arranged in the infusion device, an identity authentication unit, an integrated near infrared structured light projection module, and a multi-data comparison thermodynamic diagram and a conflict report are generated based on a medical record similarity map recommendation execution scheme. The invention realizes personalized accurate regulation and control of the infusion rate, overcomes the defect of traditional infusion management, and improves the safety and effectiveness of the infusion link.
assignees: GUANGXI HOSPITAL AFFILIATED TO SUN YAT SEN UNIV

title_en: Multi-mode data fusion human body target recognition method based on automatic control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-modal data fusion target recognition, in particular to a multi-modal data fusion human body target recognition method based on automatic control, which is characterized in that the existing life detection system is difficult to effectively distinguish the spatial distribution of a human body target and a thermal pseudo target, real-time synchronous analysis of multi-source heterogeneous data cannot be realized, the target positioning reliability in an extreme environment is severely restricted, the cross-modal data of infrared thermal imaging and visible light imaging are fused, A characteristic complementation and interference suppression model based on a deep neural network is constructed, a multi-scale anti-interference network based on wavelet graph rolling and attention mechanisms is adopted, the broadband interference of environmental noise is suppressed through time-frequency localization characteristics, high robustness recognition of human targets in severe environments such as dense smoke shielding and thermal radiation interference is realized, and accurate distinction of human bodies and thermal pseudo targets in complex fire scene environments is realized.
assignees: SHANXI UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Training method of breath detection model, and breath detection method and equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a breath detection model training method, a breath detection method and a breath detection device, which can be applied to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of sample echo signals of a sample object, wherein the sample echo signals are reflection signals of sample radar signals, the sample radar signals are used for detecting a target detection area of the sample object, the plurality of sample echo signals correspond to a plurality of detection positions in the target detection area, fusing signal attributes of the plurality of sample echo signals based on the detection positions corresponding to the sample echo signals to obtain sample attribute signals, and training an initial respiration detection model by utilizing the sample attribute signals to obtain a target respiration detection model.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Multidimensional radar life detection device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-dimensional radar life detection device, which belongs to the field of multi-dimensional radar life detection and comprises a detection equipment protection box body, wherein a radar life detection equipment placing plate is embedded in the detection equipment protection box body, a first accommodating groove, a second accommodating groove and a handheld detection equipment placing groove are formed in the radar life detection equipment placing plate, and a group of detection equipment limiting assemblies are arranged in the handheld detection equipment placing groove. According to the multi-dimensional radar life detection device, the limit plate can be matched with the rubber ring to elastically clamp the handheld radar detection equipment body through elastic reset of the compression spring, so that the limit plate is stably positioned in the handheld detection equipment placing groove, the risk of moving or collision in the transportation and transportation process is reduced, and the handheld radar detection equipment body can be surrounded and protected through the sponge arranged in the handheld detection equipment placing groove and the foam ball head positioned in the protection box cover.

title_en: Radar life detector
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of life detection and provides a radar life detector which comprises a remote control car, wherein a scanning imaging assembly is arranged in the top end of the remote control car and used for scanning and imaging the surrounding environment, a surrounding detection assembly is arranged on the outer side of the scanning imaging assembly and used for detecting surrounding vital signs, information acquisition assemblies are arranged on the left side and the right side of the remote control car and used for acquiring information of a rescuer, a storage battery is arranged in the bottom end of the remote control car, the surrounding detection assembly comprises an infrared thermal imaging scanner fixedly connected to the front side and the rear side of the top end of the remote control car, radar detectors are fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the top end of the remote control car and used for scanning living bodies in the left direction and the right direction, and the infrared thermal imaging scanner is used for carrying out infrared scanning on living bodies in the front direction and the rear direction, so that the detection range of the device is improved and the detection efficiency of the device is improved.
assignees: BEIJING RUNJINGCHANG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distributed sensing with ultra wideband radio
abstract_en: A distributed Ultra Wideband (UWB) radar system and method for operating the same are disclosed. Distributed radar systems use multiple separate UWB radios or nodes that do not use a centralized clock or time source. However, distributed UWB systems operate to provide radar-like functionality and fine sensing capability through synchronization based on line-of-sight (LOS) signal processing and noise estimation. The synchronized Channel Impulse Response (CIR) may be processed for general object detection and tracking, gesture recognition, or even micro-motion, such as monitoring vital signs.

title_en: Vital sign detection method, device and storage medium based on radar
