abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar-based vital sign detection method, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the detection method comprises the steps of carrying out target detection on radar echo to obtain a real target, a range gate where the real target is positioned and respiratory frequency; the heart rate of the target is obtained by carrying out Chrip-Z expansion and maximum peak frequency search on the heart beat frequency band of the vital sign signal. The method carries out normalization fusion on the phase signals of the multi-range gate, improves the signal-to-noise ratio of respiration and heartbeat signals, fully utilizes vital sign information carried by radar echo, realizes high-resolution spectrum analysis in a heartbeat frequency band through Chrip-Z expansion, refines the frequency spectrum of the heartbeat signals, and improves the detection precision of vital sign parameters.

title_en: Method and system for detecting vital sign signals
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting vital sign signals, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining radar mixed signals with target vital sign information; the method comprises the steps of adopting a sliding-moving target display method to eliminate static noise to radar mixed signals, obtaining target enhanced radar mixed signals, carrying out coherent accumulation to the target enhanced radar mixed signals, obtaining human body target position information, obtaining phase information according to the human body target position information, sequentially carrying out phase unwrapping and phase difference to obtain vital sign phase information, adopting an internal noise self-elimination method to the vital sign phase information, extracting initial heartbeat signals, adopting a sliding average filtering method to extract initial respiratory signals, and carrying out band-pass filtering to the initial heartbeat signals and the initial respiratory signals to obtain heartbeat signals and respiratory signals. The invention can effectively solve the problem of serious interference caused by environmental noise when the FMCW radar is used for monitoring the respiration and the heart rate.

title_en: Intelligent household anti-interference human body presence detection method and system based on 24GHz radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent home and discloses an intelligent home anti-interference human body presence detection method and system based on a 24GHz radar, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring an intermediate frequency signal in a front space of an intelligent home based on a 24GHz FMCW radar front-end module integrated inside the intelligent home, and filtering the intermediate frequency signal; the method comprises the steps of extracting a distance-speed matrix of a filtering signal in a motion detection channel to generate a motion mark in a front space through the motion detection channel and the distance-speed matrix, outputting respiratory harmonic energy in the front space through a vital sign channel, sampling a noise spectrum baseline in the front space, converting the noise spectrum baseline into a noise interference mark through a frequency domain mutual exclusion verifier, and detecting whether a human body exists in the front space according to the motion mark, the respiratory harmonic energy and the noise interference mark to obtain a human body existence detection result. The invention can achieve both static human body detection reliability and anti-interference performance.
assignees: SHENZHEN HI LINK ELECTRONIC CO LTD

title_en: Full aviation life intelligent detection and emergency rescue decision-making method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full aviation life intelligent detection and emergency rescue decision-making method and system, the method comprises the steps of dividing an emergency rescue scene into gridding subareas, identifying disaster degree and number of people affected, combining identification results with the gridding subareas to form a red, yellow, blue and green post-disaster gridding subarea map, sequentially adopting a full aviation transient electromagnetic method life detector, optical personnel detection equipment and microwave radar life detection equipment to detect a potential disaster area step by step to form a final replacement result of a red, yellow, blue and green four-color gridding target mark, determining the priority level of ground rescue entering search and rescue according to the gridding subarea map and the final replacement result, collecting rescue result information entering the ground rescue entering search and rescue to form box count statistics of gridding information, automatically generating rescue decision-making advice according to the box count statistics result, and forming high-efficiency cooperation with a ground team, and effectively overcoming the limitation of a single detection method under complex terrain and extreme environments.
assignees: INST ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS;WUHAN ZHONGKE KECHUANG ENG DETECTION CO LTD;JILIN JINDUN FIRE SAFETY DETECTION CO LTD

title_en: AI-based monitoring method of driver's state of stress by use of look and biomedical signal
title_ko: 운전자 표정 및 생체신호를 활용한 신경망 기반의 운전자 스트레스 모니터링 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technology that constructs a neural network model for outputting a driver stress evaluation value based on facial expressions, biometric signals, and driving patterns, as well as an RNN-based neural network model for predicting future changes in stress levels, thereby providing driver stress monitoring and stress change prediction through the models. More specifically, the present invention inputs driver facial information and driving pattern information, obtained during vehicle operation, into a brain neural mapping model and a sympathetic nervous system mapping model to derive, in real time, the activation states of brain neural networks (sensor network, action network, and default mode network) and the sympathetic nervous system. Based on this, the driver's stress state is monitored in real time and visualized through radar charts and gauge charts. In addition, the present invention predicts future changes in stress states using an RNN-based neural network model and visually represents the changes in the driver's sympathetic nervous system (SNR) and parasympathetic nervous system (PNR) activation through accumulated area charts, divided into past records and future predictions. The present invention enables the driver to intuitively understand the driver's stress response state and respond in advance.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 표정, 생체 신호, 주행 패턴에 의해 운전자 스트레스 평가치를 출력하는 신경망 모델 및 향후 스트레스 상태 변화를 예측하는 RNN 기반 신경망 모델을 구성하고 이들 신경망 모델에 의해 운전자 스트레스 모니터링과 스트레스 변화 예측을 제공하는 기술에 관한 것이다. 구체적으로, 본 발명은 차량 주행 중에 운전자 표정 정보와 주행 패턴 정보를 뇌신경 매핑 모델과 교감신경 매핑 모델에 입력하여 뇌신경 네트워크(센서 네트워크, 액션 네트워크, 디폴트 모드 네트워크)와 교감신경의 활성화 상태를 실시간으로 도출하고 이를 통해 운전자 스트레스 상태를 실시간으로 모니터링하고 레이더 차트 및 게이지 차트를 통해 운전자 스트레스 상태를 시각화 제공하는 기술에 관한 것이다. 또한, 본 발명은 RNN 기반 신경망 모델에 의해 향후의 스트레스 상태 변화를 예측하고 누적 영역 차트를 통해 운전자의 교감신경(SNR)과 부교감신경(PNR) 활성화 변화를 과거 기록과 미래 예측으로 나누어 시각적으로 표현함으로써 운전자가 자신의 스트레스 반응 상태를 직관적으로 이해하고 미리 대응할 수 있도록 지원하는 기술에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Reservoir engineering safety management system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering, in particular to a reservoir engineering safety management system and method, comprising the steps of acquiring a crack chromatographic image of a drainage gallery wall body through a through-wall type ground penetrating radar, and synchronously acquiring infiltration linear displacement dynamic data of a distributed optical fiber sensor; the method comprises the steps of carrying out space-time alignment on the two types of data, constructing a fracture space topological relation and a seepage conduction path model, generating a defect-seepage coupling map, utilizing a coupling map analysis module and a space-time convolution neural network module to identify the abrupt change trend of the displacement rate of a seepage line, triggering a gallery structure failure early warning signal, automatically generating a reinforcement work order after early warning, calling an unmanned aerial vehicle to carry out high-definition image rechecking task, and feeding back a rechecking result to correct the seepage conduction path model to realize dynamic self-correction. The invention has the capabilities of accurate modeling, intelligent early warning and real-time closed-loop regulation and control, and can remarkably improve the structural safety management level of reservoir engineering.
assignees: ANHUI JUNYUAN WATER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Small sample injury identification and first-aid decision-making auxiliary system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of deep learning, and particularly relates to a small sample injury identification and first-aid decision-making auxiliary system based on deep learning. The intelligent diagnosis and decision-making system comprises a vital sign acquisition module, an edge calculation platform module and a man-machine interaction module, wherein the vital sign acquisition module is used for acquiring physiological parameters of a sensor, the man-machine interaction module is used for acquiring injury image data and human body posture data, the edge calculation platform module comprises an injury image data processing model, an injury characteristic fusion model and a decision-making model, and intelligent injury diagnosis and decision-making are carried out through an expert system based on a knowledge graph and a multi-sensor fused neural network model by combining the biological characteristic data and the image characteristics, so that scientific and reliable support is provided for injury identification and emergency decision-making under a complex environment. The invention solves the technical problems of difficult acquisition of medical data, difficult fusion of heterogeneous data, complex emergency decision and the like, can be applied to various scenes such as disaster site emergency training and the like, and has important application value.

title_en: Multi-mode health monitoring method and device, radar, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a multi-mode health monitoring method, a multi-mode health monitoring device, a multi-mode health monitoring radar, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of transmitting a linear frequency modulation signal through a frequency modulation continuous wave radar and receiving a return wave signal, carrying out cluster analysis on the return wave signal, dynamically judging the relevant behavior state of the bed according to a clustering result, switching among a plurality of monitoring modes according to the behavior state and a switching condition of a finite state machine, wherein the monitoring modes comprise a bed occupation monitoring mode, a vital sign monitoring mode and a falling monitoring mode, the switching condition of the finite state machine comprises a vital sign monitoring mode when the behavior state is the stable bed occupation, a falling monitoring mode when the behavior state is the object movement, and a bed occupation monitoring mode when the behavior state is the continuous empty bed, so as to meet the multi-mode dynamic monitoring requirement under a complex scene.
assignees: HANGZHOU SHENGDEWEI INTEGRATED CIRCUIT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Millimeter wave radar heartbeat signal extraction method based on variation modal decomposition
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of non-contact vital sign detection, in particular to a millimeter wave radar heartbeat signal extraction method based on variation modal decomposition. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a reference signal of a heartbeat signal, S2, calculating the number of modal components and penalty factors of a variation modal decomposition (vmd) algorithm by using information entropy of a chest signal as an adaptability function of an Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm (ABCA), S3, obtaining a plurality of imf (intrinsic modal function) signals by using the vmd algorithm for signal decomposition, screening and removing the imf signals, reconstructing the remaining imf signals to obtain a reconstructed signal, S4, setting a threshold, repeating the step S3 until imf signals with the largest correlation in all imf signals reach the set threshold, and stopping circulation. The imf signal is the required heartbeat signal. The method fully utilizes the characteristic that the vmd algorithm is good at processing the non-fixed frequency signals, better solves the optimal input parameters of the vmd algorithm by introducing the artificial bee colony algorithm, effectively removes respiratory signals and noise, and better retains the detailed characteristics of heartbeat signals.

title_en: Survey device
abstract_en: To provide a survey device capable of acquiring information on a pavement multilayer structure layer in which a buried pipe is installed.SOLUTION: A survey device using an underground radar comprises: a reflected signal processing unit 41 that generates two-dimensional image data representing a cross section of a pavement multilayer structure layer on the basis of reflected signals of an emitted radar beam from the pavement multilayer structure layer; a first image processing unit 42 that generates first image processing data by performing suppression processing to suppress ground surface reflection signals on the two-dimensional image data; a second image processing unit 43 that generates second image processing data by performing sharpening processing to sharpen boundaries between layers of the pavement multilayer structure layer on the first image processing data; and a thickness calculation unit 44a that calculates the pavement thickness and the base course thickness from the second image processing data.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Multi-source sensing integrated tree root health intelligent early warning system and method
abstract_en: The application provides a tree root system health intelligent early warning system and method integrating multi-source sensing, comprising a multi-source sensing module, wherein the multi-source sensing module consists of four types of heterogeneous sensors, the four types of heterogeneous sensors form a distributed monitoring network, the system specifically comprises a ground penetrating radar, a dielectric characteristic sensor array, a gas detection unit module and a geomagnetic anomaly detection module, the ground penetrating radar, the gas detection unit module and the geomagnetic anomaly detection module are all arranged in a cylindrical titanium alloy shell, the dielectric characteristic sensor array is connected with the cylindrical titanium alloy shell through cables, and the dielectric characteristic sensor array is vertically buried in a main distribution area of a tree root system.
assignees: QINGDAO AOLIPU QIZHI INTELLIGENT INDUSTRIAL TECH CO LTD;UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Feature extraction method of vital sign signals based on multichannel fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a feature extraction method of vital sign signals based on multichannel fusion, which comprises the steps of modeling vital sign signals caused by chest cavity movement, carrying out mixing processing on multichannel radar human body target echo signals to obtain multichannel sampling intermediate frequency signals to obtain one-dimensional distance images of the echo signals, carrying out moving target display processing to realize static clutter background cancellation and extract target distance unit multichannel complex signals, obtaining a decomposition form of a track matrix based on multidimensional singular spectrum analysis, dividing the decomposition sub-matrix into disjoint groups, overlapping sub-sequences with the same signals to obtain main component reconstruction complex signals of each channel, carrying out time-frequency analysis and weighted fusion on the reconstruction complex signals of each channel to obtain a fusion time spectrum, tracking the ridge line of the fusion time spectrum to obtain a phase signal containing chest cavity movement features, and extracting vital sign parameters. The invention can improve the estimation precision of the non-contact human target respiration and heartbeat frequency parameters under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio.

title_en: Patient vital sign monitoring method and system for ward environment
abstract_en: The invention provides a patient vital sign monitoring method and system for ward environments. The invention relates to the technical field of medical monitoring, and the system consists of a millimeter wave radar radio frequency front end, a radar data high-speed acquisition board and an upper computer. The target signal extraction processing is carried out in the radar high-speed acquisition board, and a light-weight self-stabilizing target distance unit selection method is adopted, so that the stability and accuracy of the target distance unit extraction are improved under the multipath interference and signal sparseness conditions of a ward. The upper computer performs vital sign signal separation and enhancement processing, and provides a multi-strategy fusion MTOC-VMD decomposition method and a spectrum weighted heartbeat enhancement method, which decompose target phase signals, construct weighting coefficients, effectively inhibit respiratory harmonic interference and enhance the spectrum characteristics of heartbeat signals. The invention can realize real-time monitoring of vital signs of patients in a non-contact manner in a ward environment, is beneficial to early detection of abnormal trends of the patients and reduces the manpower burden of hospital monitoring.

title_en: Multi-target beef cattle respiration heart rate monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-target beef cattle respiration and heart rate monitoring device, and relates to the technical field of agricultural information. The method effectively solves the problems of inconvenient installation of contact equipment, interference to beef cattle and the like by utilizing a non-contact measurement technology of the radar, effectively solves the problem of insufficient efficiency of a single-target measurement method by utilizing a multi-target echo decoupling method, can monitor respiration and heart rate of multi-target beef cattle more accurately by fusing visual data and radar data, distinguish non-beef cattle targets, improve monitoring accuracy and automation level, can rapidly process multi-target echo information by utilizing a data processing module, realize simultaneous monitoring of the multiple beef cattle targets, improve monitoring efficiency, realize positioning and vital sign monitoring of the targets by fusing the visual information and the radar data, and can also perform identity recognition, provide data support for refined breeding management and also provide powerful technical support for health management of modern animal husbandry.

title_en: Multi-band millimeter radar detection system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-band millimeter radar detection system which comprises a multi-band reconstruction radar module, an MIMO antenna array, an FPGA preprocessing module, an edge computing unit and a power management module, wherein the multi-band reconstruction radar module supports 24GHz/77GHz dynamic switching, intelligent adaptation of a penetration mode and a positioning mode is achieved through a radio frequency switch, the MIMO antenna array is used for receiving signals transmitted by the multi-band reconstruction radar module, the FPGA preprocessing module is used for preprocessing radar echo signals received by the MIMO antenna array, the edge computing unit is used for computing and analyzing the preprocessed radar echo signals to determine detection results, and the power management module is used for providing electric quantity. The invention breaks through the technical bottlenecks of weak penetrability, difficult multi-target separation and high response delay of the traditional detection equipment, fills the blank of life detection technology in a complex environment, and promotes the remarkable improvement of emergency rescue efficiency and success rate.
assignees: HUAINAN UNION UNIV HUAINAN EMPLOYEE UNIV HUAINAN BRANCH OF ANHUI OPEN UNIV

title_en: Mental health monitoring and nursing robot with body-multidimensional intelligent cooperation function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a physical-multidimensional intelligent cooperative mental health monitoring and nursing robot which comprises a mobile robot platform provided with a differential driving chassis, a laser SLAM navigation module and the like, a multi-modal sensing network integrated with an RGB-D depth camera, a thermal imager and the like, wherein the multi-modal sensing network processes data in real time through an edge computing unit, an intelligent decision engine based on a micro-service architecture covers modules such as patrol recognition, vital sign monitoring non-mental support transducer dialogue model and multi-modal emotion recognition and the like, and a man-machine interaction interface is connected through an end-to-end encryption 5G network. The medicine compliance management module is also provided with a privacy protection scheme of RFID medicine box, medicine taking action recognition, federal learning and differential privacy. The intelligent nursing system has the beneficial effects that the nursing efficiency is improved by more than 40%, the occurrence rate of adverse events is reduced by 35%, the psychological intervention coverage rate is improved, the medicine taking compliance is improved, the sublingual medicine hiding detection rate is improved to more than 95%, the data privacy is safe and controllable, and the intelligent upgrading of mental health care is promoted.
assignees: THE 7TH PEOPLES HOSPITAL OF HANGZHOU HANGZHOU MENTAL HAZARD RES AND PREVENTION CENTER

title_en: Method and device suitable for carbon dioxide pipeline leakage experimental test
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon dioxide pipeline transportation, in particular to a method and a device suitable for experimental test of carbon dioxide pipeline leakage, wherein the method comprises the steps of experimental integrity check and device air tightness check; introducing carbon dioxide gas into the device for scavenging, checking the test pipeline, the temperature sensor, the pressure sensor and the safety protection device again, filling sand into the sand box, and performing carbon dioxide pipeline leakage experiment test on the test pipeline. The latter includes carbon dioxide gas cylinder, three-way valve, constant temperature water bath storage tank and sand box. According to the invention, the test pipeline is buried in the sand box, so that the acquisition, control and the like of pressure and temperature parameters of the buried multiphase carbon dioxide pipeline in the leakage process are realized, different leakage morphological characteristics and wall temperature changes in a leakage port area are obtained, the rapid qualitative judgment of leakage caliber, leakage position and the like after the pipeline leakage accident occurs is facilitated, and the development of subsequent emergency rescue work is facilitated.

title_en: Life sign detection system, apparatus, and method
abstract_en: A Life Sign Detection system (LDS) monitors one or more environments using radar. The radar signals are processed to generate one or more point clouds, each associated with an organism in the environment(s). Life signs for the organisms(s) are inferred based on the radar point clouds. For example, the coordinates of the point cloud may be tracked to determine if the organism is moving about the environment, frequency domain components of the points of the point cloud may be used to determine involuntary movements, or combinations thereof. The LDS may determine a status of the organism(s) based on the inferred life signs. For example, if the organism is moving or has involuntary movement, the organism may be determined to be alive. In some embodiments, the life signs may be compared to normal ranges to determine a status of the organism(s).

title_en: Sickbed with intelligent monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention provides a sickbed with an intelligent monitoring system, and relates to the technical field of medical appliances. The sickbed with the intelligent monitoring system comprises a sickbed body, an environmental field analysis module, a medical equipment signal multiplexing module, a multi-mode data fusion engine and a clinical decision module, wherein the environmental field analysis module comprises an electromagnetic field monitoring unit, a sound field imaging unit and a thermal field entropy change analysis unit. The technology adopts a non-contact type multi-physical-field monitoring technology, thoroughly avoids the skin injury risk caused by a contact type sensor, realizes omnibearing and accurate monitoring of vital signs such as respiration, heart rate, body temperature and the like by deeply mining the multi-source heterogeneous data value of medical equipment, and provides a more efficient monitoring mode for clinical monitoring.

title_en: Building interior and exterior wall reconstruction system and method based on through-wall radar and laser radar fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building interior and exterior wall reconstruction system and a method based on fusion of a through-wall radar and a laser radar. According to the invention, the high-precision reconstruction is carried out on the building outer wall through the SLAM technology of the laser radar and the optical camera, the surface contour is extracted by utilizing the obtained outer wall point cloud, and the time delay optimization is carried out on the wall compensation part in the imaging process of the wall inside the through-wall radar by utilizing the contour information, so that the imaging accuracy of the wall inside the building in the BP result of the through-wall imaging is improved. And finally, high-precision reconstruction of the building outer wall and the inner wall is realized at the same time. The invention builds a corresponding data acquisition and processing system to verify the technical scheme.

title_en: Anti-interference method for multi-band radar
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-interference method of a multi-band radar, which comprises the following steps of firstly obtaining an enhanced model in an offline state through offline dynamic countermeasure training, secondly obtaining an original echo signal in an online state to carry out self-adaptive filtering, carrying out space-time spectrum feature extraction by using the enhanced model, thirdly carrying out feature fusion and target separation according to the extracted space-time spectrum feature, fourthly carrying out optimization according to the separation result and judging whether a termination condition is achieved, if so, ending and outputting a multi-dimensional data packet, otherwise, returning to the step two. The method disclosed by the invention achieves the industry leading level on the anti-interference performance and vital sign monitoring precision through triple technical breakthroughs of hardware reconstruction, dynamic countermeasure training method and closed loop feedback, and is particularly suitable for extreme scenes such as firefighting rescue, battlefield search and rescue and the like. And the next step can focus on optimizing the light weight of the model, and further improve the deployment efficiency of the mobile platform.
assignees: HUAINAN UNION UNIV HUAINAN EMPLOYEE UNIV HUAINAN BRANCH OF ANHUI OPEN UNIV

title_en: Non-contact electrophysiological monitoring method based on acoustic wave reflection and AI analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact electrophysiological monitoring method based on sound wave reflection and AI analysis, which comprises the steps of multiplexing consumer-level Bluetooth sound box hardware, transforming a loudspeaker and a microphone of a Bluetooth sound box into a biological radar and a vital sign sensor, detecting the vital sign information through sound wave modulation, processing echo signals based on a TDOA positioning algorithm and an MVDR beam forming algorithm, improving the signal to noise ratio of the echo signals, establishing a time-frequency domain joint feature matrix, processing the time-frequency domain joint feature matrix based on a dual-channel AI model, respectively processing a respiratory frequency band and a blood oxygen band through an LSTM network and an SVM classifier, and finally outputting the vital sign information such as respiratory frequency, heart rate value, blood oxygen saturation and the like.

title_en: High-temperature drought disaster-receiving device for field monitoring crops
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of monitoring devices, in particular to a high-temperature drought disaster-receiving device for field monitoring crops, which comprises a positioning tube, wherein a humidity sensor can be directly buried into soil through a ground drilling tube through the arrangement of an adjusting mechanism, meanwhile, the depth of the humidity sensor in the soil can be adjusted, the sensor is not required to be taken out and buried into the soil again, namely, the device is carried to a monitoring place, a support ring is held to vertically insert a ground drilling cone into the soil, a second motor is started to drive a second bevel gear to rotate, a second screw rod drives a transmission block to drive a humidity sensor part to move out of a through groove and enable the sensor to be in contact with the soil, the humidity of the soil can be monitored, in the detection process, a first motor is started, the first motor drives a first screw rod to rotate, and the screw rod drives a screw rod to descend continuously so as to adjust the depth of the ground drilling tube.
assignees: LANZHOU DROUGHT METEOROLOGY INST OF CHINA METEOROLOGICAL ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Underground radar device and buried object survey method therefor
abstract_en: To provide an underground radar device and a buried object survey method therefor capable of estimating the reliability of the relative permittivity used for calculating the depth of a buried object, and issuing a warning about poor depth accuracy to a user when the reliability of the relative permittivity is estimated to be low.SOLUTION: An underground radar device comprises a radar unit 21, an underground survey device 22, and a display device 14, radiates an electromagnetic wave EM from a transmitting antenna 23 into the ground, receives a reflected wave RW reflected at a boundary surface between materials having different relative permittivities by means of a receiving antenna 24, and surveys a buried object BO in the ground. A reliability calculation section 29 estimates the reliability of the relative permittivity used for calculating the depth of the buried object on the basis of changes in the road surface condition and the measurement speed of the measurement path. When the reliability is estimated to be low, a display section 14a issues a warning about poor depth accuracy to a user.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Tailing pond sediment beach instability early warning system and method based on space-ground cooperation
abstract_en: A method and a system for early warning of sediment beach instability of a tailing pond based on air-ground cooperation comprise the steps that an air-ground monitoring module comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster and a satellite remote sensing unit, a ground sensing module comprises an array type saturation sensor and a micro-seismic sensor network, the array type saturation sensor is buried in a beach key area, the micro-seismic sensor network is buried in a beach substrate, an edge-cloud cooperation calculation module comprises an edge calculation module and a cloud processing module, the edge calculation module is used for fusing multisource monitoring data to obtain target fusion data, the cloud processing module is used for calculating dynamic instability indexes and classifying early warning, and a dynamic prevention and control execution module is used for executing early warning actions. The method comprises the steps of collecting monitoring data, fusing the monitoring data by an edge computing module, computing a dynamic instability index by a cloud processing module based on target fusion monitoring data, and performing early warning classification. The system and the method can perform real-time accurate early warning on the dynamic deposition beach instability risk.
assignees: GUANGDONG SAFETY PRODUCTION AND EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Full-flow management method and system for non-contact microwave monitoring physiological parameters
abstract_en: The invention provides a full-flow management method and a full-flow management system for non-contact microwave monitoring physiological parameters, which are characterized in that microwave signals of physiological parameters of a user are collected, and the microwave signals are preprocessed and subjected to feature extraction processing to obtain vital sign parameters of a human body; the method comprises the steps of wirelessly transmitting human vital sign parameters to a terminal of a user or a nurse station to evaluate the human vital sign parameters, comparing an evaluation result with a health rule base to generate corresponding health suggestions and pushing the health suggestions to the user terminal, analyzing the human vital sign parameters in the terminal through a pre-training model when the user is in a night sleep state, judging whether the user is in an abnormal breathing state according to an analysis result, if so, sending a control instruction to a sickbed corresponding to the user to control the sickbed to execute angle adjustment operation, and particularly, realizing real-time response and intervention on the health state of the patient through a complete flow management method of collecting the vital sign, judging the state and performing linkage intervention.

title_en: Vital sign signal enhancement method and system based on frequency modulation continuous wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign signal enhancement method and a vital sign signal enhancement system based on a frequency modulation continuous wave radar, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining radar echo signals, and recombining fast time sampling points into a subarray along a slow time direction; the method comprises the steps of screening subarrays according to a signal quality evaluation mechanism, removing low-quality subarrays to form sparse subarrays, performing digital beam forming of a distance dimension on the sparse subarrays, introducing asymmetric beam pattern constraint, and extracting vital sign phase information from a slow time signal output by beam forming. The invention can improve the signal-to-noise ratio of the vital sign signal, enhance the signal detectability and ensure the detection accuracy and the robustness.

title_en: Detection method, detection equipment and detection system for vital signs of pets
abstract_en: The specification provides a detection method, detection equipment and detection system for vital signs of pets. The method comprises the steps of controlling a millimeter wave radar module to send millimeter wave radar signals to a region to be detected, receiving millimeter wave radar echo signals returned by the region to be detected, enabling a target pet to move in the region to be detected, determining position information of the target pet in a first time window based on the millimeter wave radar echo signals in the first time window, determining activity conditions of the target pet in a second time window based on a plurality of position information of the target pet in the second time window, wherein the activity conditions comprise an activity state and a resting state, the second time window comprises a plurality of first time windows, and determining vital sign parameters of the target pet in the second time window if the target pet is in the resting state in the second time window. According to the technical scheme of the embodiment of the specification, the automatic detection of vital signs of the pets can be realized under the conditions of no contact and no wearing.
assignees: SHENZHEN HUAYI MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Millimeter wave radar vital sign detection method based on HHO-CEEMDAM algorithm
abstract_en: A millimeter wave radar vital sign detection method based on a HHO-CEEMDAM algorithm is characterized by comprising the steps of building a millimeter wave radar experiment system, collecting intermediate frequency signals of human echoes, carrying out data reading and recombination, extracting phase characteristics, determining the distance between a human chest and a radar through non-coherent accumulation enhancement target signals, recovering phases of vital sign signals from an FFT result of incoherent accumulation by utilizing linear characteristics of arctangent demodulation, carrying out phase unwrapping and phase difference to obtain optimized phase information, setting an initialization range of CEEMDAN parameters and designing an adaptation function, optimizing CEEMDAN parameters by utilizing the HHO algorithm, carrying out CEEMDAN decomposition by utilizing optimized parameters, screening breath and heartbeat IMF components, and obtaining estimated values of a respiratory frequency and a heart rate according to the IMF components. The method improves the accuracy of estimating the respiratory rate and the heart rate of the millimeter wave radar in fatigue driving detection.

title_en: Anti-disassembly function control method
abstract_en: The utility model provides a prevent tearing open function control method, back lid subassembly includes main control board, plastics lower cover and metal cold rolled sheet back stores pylon, be equipped with hall switch element and radar response function module on the main control board, be equipped with a plurality of fixed pre-buried box holes on the metal cold rolled sheet back stores pylon, be equipped with two neodymium iron boron magnets on the plastics lower cover, hall switch element is fixed on the main control board in the intermediate position of two neodymium iron boron magnets, the plastics lower cover passes through self tapping screw to be fixed on the casing, produces magnetic field induction through two magnets on the left and right sides and metal back stores pylon and acts on hall switch components and parts, can play product installation fixed and prevent tearing open early warning bilayer effect, and in addition radar response and camera face capture function combine, the safety and convenience of protection user can save space and product pleasing to the eye again.
assignees: XIAMEN DNAKE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Motion sickness reduction method and system
title_ko: 멀미 저감 방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 이동 장치에 탑승한 탑승자의 멀미 저감 방법에 있어서, 생체센서를 통해 상기 탑승자의 생체 신호를 측정하고; 상기 이동 장치의 센서로부터 상기 이동 장치의 거동 신호를 획득하며; 상기 측정한 생체 신호 및 상기 획득한 거동 신호를 딥러닝 모델을 포함하는 프로세서에 입력하고; 상기 프로세서를 통해, 상기 입력된 거동 신호를 구간 단위로 분할(Epoching)하며, 상기 입력된 생체 신호를 레이블링(Labeling)하고; 상기 분할된 거동 신호 및 상기 레이블링된 생체 신호를 융합하여 특성값을 추출하며; 상기 추출된 특성값을 기초로 상기 탑승자의 멀미 상태를 예측하여 상기 이동 장치를 제어하는 멀미 저감 방법은, 이동 장치에 탑승한 탑승자의 멀미 상태를 딥러닝 모델에 기반하여 예측의 신뢰도를 높이면서 보다 효과적으로 이동 장치를 제어할 수 있다.

title_en: Vital sign detection method and device based on millimeter wave radar, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a vital sign detection method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium based on millimeter wave radar, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a distance frequency domain signal based on a radar echo signal; the method comprises the steps of carrying out frequency spectrum analysis on distance frequency domain signals, positioning the position of an object to be detected, extracting phase information at the position, filtering through a band-pass filter to obtain a respiratory frequency band interval signal and an initial heartbeat frequency band interval signal, carrying out real-time respiratory rate estimation on the basis of the respiratory frequency band interval signal to obtain respiratory frequency, eliminating respiratory harmonics in the initial heartbeat frequency band interval signal by using an adaptive trap based on the respiratory frequency to obtain a heartbeat frequency band interval signal, decomposing the heartbeat frequency band interval signal by using a variation modal decomposition algorithm with minimum fuzzy entropy as an optimization target to obtain a heartbeat signal, and carrying out real-time heart rate estimation on the basis of the heartbeat signal to obtain a real-time heart rate. The method, the device, the electronic equipment and the storage medium provided by the invention can improve the accuracy of heart rate measurement.
assignees: SUZHOU LEIJIADA HEALTH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Portable optical cable buries degree of depth intellectual detection system appearance
abstract_en: The invention provides a portable optical cable burial depth intelligent detector, which belongs to the technical field of underground pipeline detection and comprises a shell, a multi-mode sensing unit, a main control and data processing unit, a man-machine interaction unit and a power supply unit, wherein the multi-mode sensing unit, the main control and data processing unit, the man-machine interaction unit and the power supply unit are integrated in the shell. The multi-mode sensing unit comprises an electromagnetic induction sensor, a ground penetrating radar sensor and an inertial measurement unit IMU. The main control and data processing unit runs a data fusion algorithm, fusion processing is carried out on the multi-source sensing data, and parameters of the electromagnetic induction model are dynamically corrected according to the dielectric constant of soil detected by the radar through the self-adaptive calibration module. The invention effectively overcomes the defects that a single detection principle is easy to be interfered and depends on experience through multi-mode sensing complementation and intelligent information fusion, obviously improves the accuracy, reliability and efficiency of measuring the buried depth of the metal and nonmetal optical cables under different soil conditions, and realizes continuous acquisition, intelligent interpretation and informationized management of buried depth data.

title_en: Respiratory heartbeat detection method and system based on frequency modulation continuous wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a respiratory heartbeat detection method and a respiratory heartbeat detection system based on a frequency modulation continuous wave radar, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining a reflected echo signal obtained by detecting a target object by a continuous wave signal sent by an FMCW millimeter wave radar; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing echo signals, separating respiratory signals from heartbeat signals on the basis of an EPH multistage cooperative signal processing algorithm, and carrying out anomaly correction on separated instantaneous frequency anomaly data on the basis of a local weighted regression algorithm. Therefore, the method can improve the accuracy of radar detection of vital signs under the interference conditions of background noise, signal harmonic waves and the like.
assignees: SUZHOU LEIJIADA HEALTH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact type respiratory heartbeat monitoring method and device combining vision auxiliary positioning and millimeter wave radar dynamic tracking
abstract_en: The application provides a non-contact type respiration and heartbeat monitoring method and device combining vision auxiliary positioning and millimeter wave radar dynamic tracking, and belongs to the technical field of vital sign monitoring and millimeter wave radar. The device comprises a depth camera module, an edge calculation module and a millimeter wave radar module, wherein the depth camera module is used for acquiring human body image data, the edge calculation module is used for identifying skeleton key points, positioning chest positions and predicting movement tracks of targets according to the human body image data to obtain prediction information, the millimeter wave radar module is used for dynamically adjusting wave beams according to the prediction information and tracking and acquiring signals of chest areas, and the edge calculation module is used for separating the signals of the chest areas and extracting respiration and heartbeat information to obtain noninductive monitoring data of vital signs of human bodies. The application can realize accurate positioning and dynamic non-contact vital sign monitoring on the chest of the human body, and effectively improve the monitoring accuracy and the anti-interference capability.

title_en: Non-contact vital sign recognition and detection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact vital sign recognition detection system, which relates to the technical field of vital sign monitoring and comprises a time-sharing echo acquisition module, a phase processing module, a vital sign separation module, a respiratory event judgment module, a radar dynamic scheduling module and a power compensation module, wherein the time-sharing echo acquisition module acquires echo signals and constructs an original data matrix, the phase processing module performs background subtraction and phase extraction processing on the original data matrix and calculates phase signals, the vital sign separation module processes the phase signals to generate respiratory waveforms, the respiratory event judgment module converts the respiratory waveforms into physical displacement waveforms and judges and generates an apnea early warning signal, the radar dynamic scheduling module generates radar switching instructions according to the calculated target positions, and the power compensation module acquires signal quality parameters and generates power adjustment instructions. According to the invention, through the cooperation of double radars and dynamic scheduling, the continuous monitoring of the whole domain without blind areas is realized, and the advanced signal processing method is utilized, so that the obstacle can be penetrated, the respiration heartbeat can be accurately separated, and the high precision is ensured, and meanwhile, the low power consumption and the high environmental adaptability are realized.
assignees: BAOJI WEIXI NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact vital sign monitoring method and system based on FMCW radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive vital sign monitoring method and system based on an FMCW radar. Firstly, receiving radar echo signals, generating a three-dimensional data matrix, extracting amplitude signals and phase signals, then adopting a self-adaptive distance unit locking technology to respectively determine an optimal breathing distance unit and an optimal heartbeat distance unit, extracting phase signals from the screened optimal breathing distance unit, extracting breathing signals by a band-pass filter, extracting phase signals from the selected optimal heartbeat distance unit, differentiating the phase signals, and carrying out joint denoising through a dynamic double filter to obtain heartbeat signals. And finally, carrying out error correction on the physiological parameters obtained by spectrum analysis through sliding window statistical constraint. The invention solves the problems of mutual interference of respiratory and heartbeat signals, difficult extraction of weak heartbeat signals, insufficient suppression of environmental noise and the like in the existing radar monitoring, and can be widely applied to medical monitoring, intelligent home and health management scenes.

title_en: FMamba neural network-based non-contact electrocardiogram generation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vital sign monitoring, in particular to a non-contact electrocardiogram generating method based on FMamba neural network, which comprises the steps of processing received radar data, extracting heart beat micro signals from the radar data, step S2, carrying out multi-level decomposition on the input heart beat micro signals by utilizing Maximum Overlapped Discrete Wavelet Transform (MODWT), step S3, respectively mapping the multi-level signals to a high-dimensional characteristic space by adopting an embedded network (Embedding), inputting the high-dimensional characteristic space into an independent FMamba neural network module for carrying out sequence characteristic extraction, step S4, carrying out self-adaptive variable-pitch scanning on Frequent SSM (FSSM) modules in the FMamba neural network module, carrying out self-adaptive variable-pitch scanning on different frequency bands of each level to obtain M  o , and carrying out non-contact electrocardiogram generation, thereby being suitable for remote medical monitoring, vehicle-mounted health systems, home care and other application scenes.

title_en: Inspection of passengers device based on distributed dual-polarized millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a inspection of passengers device based on a distributed dual-polarized millimeter wave radar, which relates to the inspection of passengers device and the radar imaging detection field, and comprises a detection device body and upper computer equipment, wherein the detection device body comprises an electromagnetic wave shielding box and a wave absorbing material conveying belt, an inlet and an outlet are respectively arranged on the front side and the rear side of the electromagnetic wave shielding box to form a transmission channel, the wave absorbing material conveying belt penetrates through the transmission channel and is fixed at the bottom of the electromagnetic wave shielding box through a transmission bracket, electromagnetic shielding curtains are arranged at the inlet and the outlet of the electromagnetic wave shielding box, vertical polarization detection radars and horizontal polarization detection radars are symmetrically arranged on the inner walls of the left side and the right side of the electromagnetic wave shielding box, and the dual-polarized MIMO imaging radar is arranged in the central area of the inner wall of the top of the electromagnetic wave shielding box. The device utilizes the distributed dual-polarized millimeter wave radar to cooperatively detect and integrate multi-mode information, solves the contradiction between coverage and identification precision in inspection of passengers and the difficulty in vital sign detection, and improves the security inspection efficiency and accuracy.

title_en: Search and rescue robot for path planning
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of search and rescue equipment, in particular to a search and rescue robot for path planning, which comprises a bottom plate and a search and rescue assembly, wherein the search and rescue assembly comprises a head part, a main body, a battery compartment, a cover plate, a locking block and legs, the robot is started to detect the surrounding environment through the head part and transmit detected pictures to monitoring pictures of workers through a network, meanwhile, the legs start to operate to drive the robot to integrally start to move, the head part and the legs are connected stably on the main body, after entering a narrow space, a target with vital signs is detected through a thermal imaging instrument arranged on the head part, and the search and rescue task is completed through the joint of all execution mechanisms, so that the problems that when the existing crawler type search and rescue robot is used for searching and rescue, the flexibility of the crawler robot in the narrow space is limited, the running speed of the crawler robot is slow, and the search and rescue efficiency is influenced are solved.

title_en: Health care monitoring and smart home convergence system based on ceiling-embedded built-in IoT radar sensor
title_ko: 천장 빌트인 IoT 레이더 센서 기반 건강관리 모니터링 및 스마트홈 융합 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 천장 빌트인 IoT 레이더 센서 기반 건강관리 모니터링 및 스마트홈 융합 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 의한 건강관리 모니터링 및 스마트홈 융합 시스템은, 침실 내 천장에 설치되며, 레이더 신호의 ToF(Time of Flight)를 기반으로 사용자의 심박수 또는 호흡수를 측정하여 생체신호 데이터를 생성하는 천장 빌트인 IoT 레이더 센서; 및 상기 생체신호 데이터를 기반으로 상기 사용자의 수면패턴을 분석하고, 상기 수면패턴을 이용하여 상기 사용자의 건강상태에 대한 건강예측정보를 생성하는 건강분석부를 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: POSCO E&C CO LTD;POSCO DX COMPANY LTD;CHEIL ELECTRIC WIRING DEVICES CO LTD

title_en: Human heart rate detection method based on multi-harmonic weighting reconstruction
abstract_en: A human heart rate detection method based on multi-harmonic weighting reconstruction is characterized in that a millimeter wave radar experiment system is built to collect human chest echo intermediate frequency signals, a frequency modulation continuous wave radar is used for non-contact and non-invasive vital sign signal collection, fast Fourier transformation is applied to the intermediate frequency signals of radar four-antenna receiving signals, chest positions of people are effectively obtained through inter-frame sliding difference and incoherent accumulation, and phase information about the measurement positions is collected. Then, the extracted phases are subjected to phase unwrapping and phase difference, decomposed into IMF components, and a heartbeat signal is reconstructed by using a method based on CEEMDAN multiple harmonic addition weight construction. According to the invention, higher detection precision is realized, and meanwhile, the threshold parameter is not required to be set manually, so that the heartbeat frequency detection robustness in a complex dynamic environment is remarkably improved.

title_en: Artificial intelligence auxiliary multi-mode small animal anesthesia and consciousness research device and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of neurobiology and anesthesiology research, and discloses an artificial intelligence-assisted multi-mode small animal anesthesia and consciousness research device and system, wherein the system comprises an integrated monitoring cabin, a transparent experiment box and a sound insulation dark box; the brain electricity/myoelectricity recording module records brain cortex and muscle electricity activities, the optical fiber calcium imaging module, the optical fiber probe and the high-sensitivity photoelectric detector, the drug administration module, the program-controlled microinjection pump, the intravenous, intraperitoneal and inhalation drug administration support module, the vital sign monitoring module, the behavior capturing module, the infrared high-speed camera and the gesture analysis system, the AI operation and analysis platform and the data acquisition, processing and visualization function are integrated, wherein the vital sign monitoring module comprises a wireless infrared body temperature detector, a wireless millimeter wave radar detector and a high-precision pressure sensor. The invention realizes the full-flow automation from drug administration to data acquisition, does not need manual intervention, improves the multi-mode data synchronization precision by more than 90 percent and improves the experimental efficiency by more than 50 percent.

title_en: Multi-parameter vital sign monitoring and rehabilitation device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of health care devices, in particular to a multi-parameter vital sign monitoring and health care device. The intelligent radar system comprises a plurality of bearing seats, square shells and at least two negative pressure components, wherein the bearing seats are distributed on different areas of a living room wall body, the square shells are provided with a health care radar body, the at least two negative pressure components are respectively arranged on two sides of adjacent sides of the square shells, and the square shells can be adsorbed on the wall body through the negative pressure components. According to the invention, the health care radar body can monitor the movement of the monitored old people, and when the health care radar body moves towards the monitoring dead angles in the functional areas, the health care radar body can move to the other bearing seat through the matching operation of the two negative pressure assemblies and the walking assembly, so that the monitored old people are positioned in the monitoring range of the health care radar body.
assignees: JIANGSU JIANLAIBANG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Medical treatment device for search and rescue type aircraft
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical treatment device for a search and rescue type aircraft, which comprises a rewarming device, a vital sign monitoring device, an emergency treatment device and an onboard power supply, wherein the rewarming device comprises a thermal blanket and a far infrared rewarming bag and is used for rewarming a user, the vital sign monitoring device is respectively connected with the rewarming device and the emergency treatment device and comprises a sphygmomanometer, a heart rate measuring module, a body temperature measuring module, an oxygen saturation measuring module, a carbon dioxide sensor, an electrocardiograph and a vital sign evaluation module and is used for carrying out vital sign monitoring on the user, and the emergency treatment device comprises an automatic external defibrillator, a cardiopulmonary resuscitation instrument, a simple breathing machine, an airborne oxygen supply device, an injection pump and a quantitative infusion pump and is used for carrying out emergency treatment on the user.

title_en: Earthquake rescue robot convenient to carry materials
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seismic rescue robot convenient to carry materials, relates to the technical field of seismic rescue robots, and solves the problem that the existing seismic rescue robot can only detect trapped people and cannot convey materials to the trapped people. The utility model provides a conveniently carry earthquake rescue robot of goods and materials, includes the automobile body, the track wheel is all installed to preceding terminal surface and the rear end face of automobile body, one side movable mounting of automobile body up end has put the thing device, the opposite side of automobile body up end rotates and is connected with the roating seat, thermal imaging appearance and life detection appearance are installed to the up end of roating seat, the casing is still installed to the up end of automobile body, the camera is installed to the inboard of casing, feeding mechanism is installed through rotary mechanism to one side on automobile body surface. The invention can pass through the narrow gap, is convenient for conveying materials to trapped people, can increase the carrying amount of the materials, and improves the use effect.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & TECH CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Emergency patient triage decision-making method and system based on intelligent grading of illness states
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hospital emergency systems, and discloses an emergency patient triage decision method and system based on intelligent grading of conditions. According to the invention, by setting the triage score, automatically and objectively acquiring multidimensional physiological data including vital sign data, nerve functions and autonomic nerve states through equipment such as a multiparameter monitor, an electroencephalograph and a skin electric sensor on an emergency ambulance, generating a quantized triage score based on a fusion weight algorithm, and additionally introducing delta wave duty ratio, GSR and HRV, the triage score can discover hidden crisis such as intracranial pressure increase and cerebral hernia more rapidly and earlier, and the scoring precision is improved from the fuzzy grade of mild, moderate and severe to continuous numerical quantization, so that an extremely reliable and refined basis is provided for subsequent decision.
assignees: HUNAN SHOUCHEN HEALTH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Amphibious search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an amphibious search and rescue robot, which comprises a base, wherein a chassis is fixedly connected to the base, travelling mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the chassis and used for moving on land, a floating assembly is arranged on the chassis, the invention can lead the robot to walk on land and in water by arranging the travelling mechanism and the propelling mechanism, can realize land and in-water rescue, is applicable to multi-occasion emergency rescue, and leads the search and rescue to be more reasonable, efficient, accurate, safe and comprehensive; the three-dimensional laser scanning device has the advantages that the three-dimensional laser scanning device is used for carrying out all-dimensional scanning on the search and rescue area, processing laser scanning data, generating a three-dimensional model of the search and rescue area, carrying out path planning and formulation of search and rescue strategies, providing accurate environmental information for search and rescue work, detecting and visually displaying vital sign information in real time through the thermal infrared imager, guiding search and rescue personnel to quickly locate trapped personnel, and improving the efficiency and success rate of the search and rescue work greatly through the combination of the two.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Buried pipeline settlement detection and evaluation method and system based on ground penetrating radar
abstract_en: The application discloses a buried pipeline settlement detection and evaluation method based on a ground penetrating radar and a system thereof, wherein the detection method acquires a B-Scan mask image of a shallow buried pipeline, extracts the integral and local characteristics of target hyperbolic reflection signal characteristic points in the image, removes singular points in the characteristic points, performs curve fitting on all effective target hyperbolic reflection signal characteristic points, calculates and screens a score on depth values and wave velocity values corresponding to the target characteristic points, and obtains the pipeline buried depth; the evaluation method is based on a pipeline sedimentation detection result, an angle is formed through the height change between two points on the pipeline, the position of the maximum sedimentation deformation is identified, the position where the fracture risk of a detection section is possibly generated is predicted, the detection system implements the detection method, and the evaluation system implements the evaluation method. The application solves the problem that the hyperbolic reflection signal with characteristics damaged due to the attenuation and coupling problems of electromagnetic waves in engineering actual measurement cannot be effectively calculated, and remarkably improves the processibility and the analyzability of data.

title_en: Safety system inside school bus using radar sensor
title_ko: 레이더 센서를 이용한 통학 차량 내부 안전 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 양상에 따른 레이더 센서를 이용한 통학 차량 내부 안전 시스템은 차량 내 좌석이 배치된 행마다 복수 개 설치되되, 통학 차량 내부의 일측 벽면에 좌석 시트에 상응하는 높이로 각 좌석 행마다 설치되어 타측 벽면 방향으로 사람의 생체 신호를 검출하는 복수의 레이더 센서 모듈과, 레이더 센서 모듈들로부터 생체 신호 검출 결과를 수신하여 통학 차량 내부에서의 알람 발생 여부를 판단하고, 알람 발생 시 알람 제어 메시지를 생성하여 전송하는 알람 제어기와, 알람 제어기로부터 알람 제어 메시지를 수신하여 스피커를 통해 경고음을 출력하고 하나 이상의 엘이디를 점멸하여 표시하는 알람 제어기를 포함한다.

title_en: Method and device for positioning moving object based on millimeter wave radar and binocular camera, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for positioning a moving object based on millimeter wave radar and a binocular camera, which are used for acquiring different point cloud data and visual image data by utilizing millimeter wave radar and binocular visual technology, respectively processing the point cloud data and the visual image data, and fusing the point cloud data by adopting a fusion strategy to obtain fused point cloud data, and simultaneously, identifying the fused point cloud data to acquire the motion track and behavior characteristic information of the living object in the fused point cloud data, so as to further determine the information of the living object, and combining clustering and fusion algorithm to process the data, so that the vital sign can be monitored in real time and accurately without direct contact with a patient, the defect of manual monitoring is effectively compensated, and more comprehensive and efficient health guarantee is provided for the patient.
assignees: UNIV PEKING 3RD HOSPITAL PEKING UNIV 3RD CLINICAL MEDICAL COLLEGE;BEIJING XINGYING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vertical rescue probe radar life detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a vertical rescue probe radar life detection system and method, which belong to the technical field of radars and comprise a radar probe, wherein the radar probe is used for detecting trapped personnel in a down-hole roadway and comprises a vertical rescue radar and a cylindrical metal probe, a cable tray is used for placing the radar probe in a vertical shaft, the cable tray is connected with the radar probe through a cable, a ground processing display terminal is used for processing and displaying data and results detected by the radar probe, and the radar probe is connected with the ground processing display terminal through wireless communication.
assignees: ZHONGAN GUOTAI BEIJING TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;SHANXI COAL GEOLOGY 115 EXPLORATION INST CO LTD

title_en: Multichannel through-wall radar micro Doppler characteristic enhancement method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multichannel through-wall radar micro Doppler characteristic enhancement method. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining Doppler images corresponding to optimal channels and Doppler images of optimal channels, secondly carrying out two-layer wavelet decomposition and low-rank decomposition on the Doppler images of each optimal channel, averaging low-frequency and low-rank components of the Doppler images to realize multi-channel Doppler feature fusion to obtain a fusion Doppler spectrum, carrying out human body movement direction angle estimation by using a BFGS optimization algorithm, carrying out stretching transformation on a frequency axis of the fusion Doppler spectrum by using the movement direction angle obtained by estimation, and carrying out linear smoothing technology complementation on data points missing after transformation, thereby obtaining a micro Doppler feature enhancement result. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through numerical simulation and actual measurement.

title_en: Heartbeat detection method, device, equipment, medium and product based on integration of video and millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The application discloses a heartbeat detection method, device, equipment, medium and product based on integration of video and millimeter wave radar, and relates to the field of heartbeat detection. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-mode sensor data, extracting video mode heartbeat features according to a face video data stream based on a spatial attention mechanism to obtain video heartbeat feature embedded vectors, then extracting heartbeat features, carrying out weighted fusion processing based on a video-guided attention mechanism to obtain radar heartbeat feature embedded vectors, carrying out dimension normalization processing on the video heartbeat feature embedded vectors and the radar heartbeat feature embedded vectors, obtaining environment feature vectors through global average pooling, carrying out scene division based on a scene classifier to obtain scene classification results, and carrying out heartbeat signal reconstruction after determining multi-mode fusion weights according to the environment feature vectors and the scene classification results to obtain a heartbeat signal sequence. The application aims to improve robustness and detection accuracy.

title_en: UWB and Beidou positioning-based converter station personnel tracking method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a converter station personnel tracking method based on UWB and Beidou positioning, which comprises the steps of simulating a propagation path of a UWB base station and a Beidou signal by utilizing a three-dimensional digital twin model in combination with a ray tracking algorithm, analyzing multipath effect distribution, optimizing base station layout, generating personnel position samples by adopting a Monte Carlo method, judging signal shielding strength, dynamically adjusting base station positions, generating an optimized deployment map, generating personnel density heat map by expanding Kalman filtering fusion time difference data, dynamically adjusting personnel configuration by combining a weighted fusion algorithm, optimizing base station selection by utilizing a geometric dilution precision factor, obtaining high-precision path data, monitoring deviation conditions by utilizing a geofence technology, generating a position correction instruction, finally fusing vital sign sensor data, judging abnormal states in real time and triggering a rescue program. The invention obviously improves the positioning precision and the safety management efficiency and reduces the safety risk of the converter station.
assignees: ULTRAHIGH PRESSURE BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY LTD

title_en: System and method for through-wall detection
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a through-wall detection system and a through-wall detection method. The through-wall detection system includes a synthetic aperture radar (SAR), configured to scan an area of interest behind a wall to obtain SAR scanning data, where the SAR includes a linear frequency-modulated continuous-wave (LFMCW) time-division multiple access (TDMA) multi-input multi-output (MIMO) SAR; a laser range finder, configured to estimate a distance between the SAR and the wall; and further include a mobile device. A data processor is configured to pre-process SAR scanning data of all Tx-Rx antenna pairs and transfer pre-processed SAR scanning data of all Tx-Rx antenna pairs to the mobile device; and the mobile device is configured to process the pre-processed SAR scanning data of all Tx-Rx antenna pairs to generate a 2-dimensional SAR image and determine presence or absence of a target in the area of interest behind the wall.

title_en: Mountain apple frost prevention device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain apple frost prevention device, which relates to the field of disaster protection devices and comprises a base, an upright post, a reciprocating rotating assembly, a wind power assembly, heat release filling bins and a temperature sensor, wherein the base is buried below the ground for fruit tree planting and is used as a mounting base for stabilizing, the upright post is arranged at the top of the base, the reciprocating rotating assembly is arranged at the top of the upright post, the wind power assembly is arranged at the rotating end of the reciprocating rotating assembly, the temperature sensor is arranged at the middle lower part of the upright post, frost prevention main bodies formed by the base, the upright post, the reciprocating rotating assembly, the wind power assembly and the temperature sensor are distributed on the fruit tree planting at intervals, and a plurality of heat release filling bins are placed on the ground for fruit tree planting at intervals and release heat in low-temperature frost weather. The invention can realize turbulence without dead angle in a large range to destroy the near-ground reverse temperature layer, and simultaneously provides a long-acting low-cost auxiliary heat source which does not depend on external energy, and the whole device is convenient for quick installation, flexible adjustment and seasonal storage.
assignees: GANSU CONGLI AGRICULTURAL DEV CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for analyzing vital signal characteristics based on radar acquisition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of vital signal analysis and discloses a vital signal characteristic analysis method and a device based on radar acquisition, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a signal analysis model matched with thoracic cavity displacement parameters according to the thoracic cavity displacement parameters of a tested person acquired by radar, wherein the signal analysis model comprises a target signal analysis function, and the target signal analysis function comprises a vital signal analysis function and a non-vital signal analysis function; the characteristic analysis module is used for carrying out characteristic analysis on the target signal analysis function to obtain the target period characteristic parameter and the space-time characteristic parameter of the target signal analysis function as the signal characteristic analysis result of the tested person, so that the characteristic analysis can be carried out on the life and non-life signal analysis functions through the characteristic analysis module to obtain the target period characteristic and the space-time characteristic of the collected signals of the tested person, the signal characteristic analysis comprehensiveness of the tested person is improved, and the accuracy and the high efficiency of the life signal characteristic analysis of the tested person are improved.
assignees: FOSHAN YUNMI ELECTRICAL APPLIANCE SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Portable thunder Life detector
abstract_en: The utility model provides a portable radar life detection appearance belongs to detection appearance technical field, and its structure includes portable package, and the vertical detection pole cover that is provided with in portable package left surface takes the seat group, and portable package intracavity is equipped with the detection appearance subassembly, the activity suit is taken in to detection pole cover opposite side extension, through the combination design of taking the seat group to portable package and the detection pole cover that detects host computer room, the opening, the portable room of detection head, the winding displacement is deposited room, the inclusion constitutes one and is used for carrying the knapsack of detection instrument subassembly, when the detection instrument subassembly does not use, the detection pole subassembly is retracted and is reduced the length volume and take in the detection pole cover and take the seat group, and the folding storage is taken in the portable room of detection head fast to the detection head group, makes the detection instrument subassembly take in the seat group in portable package and detection pole cover, also takes the detection host computer through portable package back, and the user holds the detection pole subassembly and just can carry out portable search and rescue use, the practicality is strong.

title_en: High-resolution radar through-wall imaging method based on fusion of various communication signals and spatial frequency spectrum shifting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-resolution microwave through-wall imaging method based on multi-system communication signal fusion and spatial spectrum shifting of a cellular base station, which is oriented to a sense-of-general integrated application scene. The method comprehensively utilizes the spectrum resources of a plurality of Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) communication signals coexisting in the cellular base station, introduces a spatial spectrum shift imaging method, and combines a wall structure path compensation algorithm to realize high-resolution imaging of a target. The invention is based on the transmission and receiving architecture of the distributed cellular base station, integrates the advantages of various OFDM signals and the resolution of spatial spectrum shifting, effectively overcomes the defects of the existing through-wall imaging technology in the aspects of low resolution, fuzzy target contour and the like, and obviously improves the imaging definition and the target identification accuracy. The method realizes high-resolution through-wall imaging by using the base station communication signals, is suitable for through-wall detection scenes such as security monitoring and anti-terrorism search and rescue in cities, and has important significance for improving the imaging performance of the through-wall radar and the scene capability of the through-wall radar in practical application.

title_en: Millimeter wave and thermal imaging fusion face shielding detection method and system for bedridden personnel
abstract_en: The invention provides a millimeter wave and thermal imaging fusion face shielding detection method and system for bedridden personnel, wherein the method comprises the steps of detecting a target based on ADC (analog-to-digital converter) original data so as to detect the position of the target and extracting vital signs of the target; extracting the temperature of a face area of a target based on temperature matrix data, carrying out temperature distribution entropy calculation on the temperature of the face area to obtain a distribution entropy calculation result, carrying out sign abnormality judgment on the target based on vital signs to obtain a judgment result, carrying out distribution abnormality judgment on the target through the distribution entropy calculation result to obtain a judgment result, carrying out weighted probability fusion on the judgment result and the judgment result to obtain the shielding probability of the target, judging whether the shielding probability exceeds a preset value, and if so, triggering an alarm. The invention can effectively monitor the sign of the target and whether the face is blocked under different conditions, and can also monitor the target under the premise of not invading the privacy of the target.

title_en: Lightweight human body behavior recognition method and system based on ultra-wideband radar in complex environment
