abstract_en: The invention discloses a light human body behavior recognition method and system based on ultra-wideband radar in a complex environment, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an echo matrix of human body behaviors by collecting through-wall human body behavior experimental data, preprocessing the echo matrix to obtain a processed echo matrix, obtaining a TDM data set based on the processed echo matrix, and inputting the TDM data set into a constructed recognition model to complete human body behavior recognition in the complex environment. The invention can effectively remove wall clutter in echo signals, improve adaptability in complex environments, enhance time-frequency representation capability of human behavior characteristics, and adopt an improved ShuffleNetV feature extraction module. The model can improve the accuracy and the robustness of human behavior recognition, thereby realizing a lighter and efficient radar behavior recognition system.

title_en: An iot-enabled smart garment for location-based detection of bulletproof vest penetration using a liquid-conductivity-based sensor technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a novel loT-enabled smart garment system designed to be worn beneath a bulletproof vest, to perform location-based determination of a body region penetrated by a projectile after penetration of the vest, to detect multiple projectile impacts, and to differentiate impacts to vital organs, thereby enabling advance planning of medical intervention and casualty evacuation, wherein the loT-enabled smart garment comprises liquid-conductivity-based sensor nodes positioned in a 3x3 matrix arrangement on both the front and rear sides of the body so as to define a total of 18 independent regions, wherein each sensor node includes an IV fluid bag disposed between two opposing conductive metal plates in the sensor and containing silver nitrate or a similar conductive liquid, wherein the loT-enabled smart garment incorporates a liquid-conductivity-based switching mechanism which operates on the principle that, when a projectile impacts the body, rupture of the IV fluid bag causes the conductive liquid to flow between the metal plates, thereby forming a short-circuit condition, wherein, by means of said mechanism, a microcontroller determines which of the 18 sensor nodes corresponds to a closed switch state, thereby providing a point-specific identification of the body region through which the projectile has penetrated, wherein the loT-enabled smart garment further includes a GPS module for determining a location information of the injured person, an IMU sensor for monitoring the motion state of the injured person, biometric sensors for tracking vital signs such as a heart rate and a body temperature, and a GSM module for transmitting real-time notifications to medical response teams and relevant security units so as to accelerate the intervention process, and wherein the loT-enabled smart garment system thereby enables life-saving medical intervention in projectile-related injuries by means of all these features.
assignees: ATATURK UNIV FIKRI MULKIYET HAKLARI KOORDINATORLUGU DONER SERMAYE ISLETMESI

title_en: Non-contact multi-mode data acquisition and emotion monitoring method, device, system, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact multi-mode data acquisition and emotion monitoring method, a non-contact multi-mode data acquisition and emotion monitoring device, a non-contact multi-mode data acquisition and emotion monitoring system, equipment, media and products, and relates to the technical field of emotion recognition. The method comprises the steps of starting a human-computer interaction program to conduct interview with target personnel, receiving human vital sign signals and audio-video signals collected by a millimeter wave biological radar module and an audio-video collection module for the target personnel in the interview process, then sequentially carrying out pretreatment, signal separation treatment and frequency estimation treatment on the human vital sign signals to obtain respiratory rate and heartbeat frequency, carrying out feature extraction treatment on the audio-video signals to obtain audio features and video features, and finally comprehensively analyzing the audio features and the video features to obtain the emotion state of the target personnel according to the respiratory rate, the heartbeat frequency, the audio features and the video features, thereby providing high-quality data support for the establishment of a follow-up artificial intelligent emotion early warning and assessment model and realizing emotion state analysis with higher accuracy and higher reliability.

title_en: Area array detection system based on through-wall radar
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an area array detection system based on a through-wall radar, which comprises a radar main control and an antenna area array, wherein the antenna area array comprises four transmitting antennas and six receiving antennas, the four transmitting antennas and the six receiving antennas are respectively and electrically connected with the radar main control, the four transmitting antennas are respectively positioned at four vertexes of a rectangular surface, two receiving antennas are respectively arranged on two long sides of the rectangular surface, one receiving antenna is respectively arranged on two short sides of the rectangular surface, and the distance between each transmitting antenna and each adjacent receiving antenna is equal to the distance between each adjacent receiving antenna. The detection system disclosed by the utility model adopts a stepping frequency system, an area array is formed by arranging spiral antennas in a central symmetry mode, and the distance between each array element is accurately calculated, so that the Nyquist sampling theorem is satisfied, and the interference area is made to be small enough as much as possible, thereby avoiding the influence of grating lobes on the array performance.
assignees: CHINA INSTITUTE OF RADIO WAVE PROPAGATION CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION NO 22 RESEARCH IN

title_en: Modularized detection module integrated on fire rescue helmet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a modularized detection module integrated in a fire-fighting and rescue helmet, in particular to the technical field of fire-fighting and rescue helmets, which comprises a helmet main body and a cape, wherein the cape is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the helmet main body, the top of the helmet main body is provided with the detection module, the detection module comprises a control host, two connecting belts, a thermal imaging detection module, a high-definition camera module, a gas detection module, a vital sign detection module and a positioning module, wherein a protective component is arranged inside the helmet main body. According to the utility model, the self-locking motor works to drive the pair of eye protection glasses to rotate, the position of the pair of eye protection glasses is regulated according to the requirement, the air pump inflates the two piston boxes and the hard tube, and the two piston connecting rods start to move oppositely, so that the two bone conduction type earphones are driven to move into the ears of a user oppositely, the operation is simple, and the use effect is good.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM;WUXI CHANGKAICHANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multimode sensor vital sign monitoring method of high dynamic simulator
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of vital sign monitoring algorithms, and particularly relates to a multi-mode sensor vital sign monitoring method of a high-dynamic simulator. The method integrates a millimeter wave radar, an IMU and an ECG sensor, phase information of a person to be tested is acquired through signals and positioned through targets, self-adaptive signal decomposition and signal screening are carried out on the phase information through phase unwrapping and signal extraction, and a novel method for realizing stable, real-time and non-contact vital sign monitoring in a high dynamic simulation environment can be realized. The method has the perception capability of motion state, and can dynamically adjust the signal processing strategy and the detection mechanism by combining the information of the multi-mode sensor, so that higher detection precision and robustness are maintained in a complex environment.
assignees: GUANGDONG RUIFAN PERCEPTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact heartbeat signal extraction method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of radars, and particularly relates to a non-contact type heartbeat signal extraction method based on a millimeter wave radar. The method comprises the following steps of preprocessing radar original phase signals, extracting specific frequency components by using an elliptic filter, carrying out SSA singular spectrum analysis on the phase signals, constructing a track matrix and singular value decomposition to realize signal noise reduction reconstruction, and extracting intrinsic mode components related to vital signs in a self-adaptive mode decomposition algorithm by combining SVMD variation modes to extract a heartbeat envelope line for normalization. By adopting the method, the radar signal can be processed stably and accurately, and the information of the millimeter wave radar heartbeat can be extracted effectively.

title_en: High-resolution radar through-wall imaging method based on broadband radar signal space spectrum shifting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-resolution radar through-wall imaging method based on broadband radar signal space spectrum shifting, and belongs to the technical field of through-wall radar imaging. The method aims to solve the problems of low imaging resolution, target defocusing, position deviation and the like caused by wall refraction in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of adopting a mutual MIMO radar structure to transmit broadband signals and receive echoes, firstly carrying out path compensation on echo signals according to the dielectric constant and thickness of a wall body, correcting wave beam propagation delay and path bending caused by the wall body, then eliminating time waveform information of the transmitted signals in the echoes, extracting spatial phase components containing target position information, calculating corresponding spatial frequency points of different transmitting-receiving antenna pairs, filling the spatial frequency points into a spatial frequency spectrum matrix to construct an original spatial spectrum of a target, and finally carrying out two-dimensional inverse Fourier transform on the spatial frequency spectrum matrix to realize high-resolution and high-precision focusing imaging of the target. The invention effectively reduces imaging sidelobe and defocusing effects, and improves definition and accuracy of through-wall imaging under the condition of limited hardware and data.

title_en: Chaotic MIMO through-wall radar imaging device and method based on 2D-SCF
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of radar imaging, in particular to a 2D-SCF-based chaotic MIMO through-wall radar imaging device and method, which mainly overcome the defects of the existing MIMO through-wall radar imaging technology in terms of detection signals and imaging quality. The device comprises a signal transmitting path and a signal receiving path, wherein the signal transmitting path comprises a signal generator, a power amplifier, a single-pole double-throw radio frequency switch and a transmitting antenna which are sequentially connected, the signal receiving path comprises a receiving antenna, a single-pole eight-throw radio frequency switch, a low-noise amplifier and a data acquisition processor which are sequentially connected, and the data acquisition processor is connected with a reference signal output end of the signal generator. The device generates chaotic modulation pulse width-position signals through the signal generator and is used as detection signals, has the advantages of high distance resolution, low autocorrelation sidelobes, strong anti-interference performance and the like, adopts a 2D-SCF algorithm to inhibit image grating sidelobes, and effectively improves the imaging capability and imaging quality of the MIMO through-wall radar.

title_en: Radar vital sign detection method, radar vital sign detection device, radar vital sign detection system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a radar vital sign detection method, a radar vital sign detection device, a radar vital sign detection system and a storage medium, wherein the radar vital sign detection method comprises the steps of obtaining a historical frequency modulation continuous wave FMCW millimeter wave radar signal; the method comprises the steps of separating respiration and heartbeat data from historical frequency modulation continuous wave FMCW millimeter wave radar signals, training a neural network model according to the respiration and heartbeat data, acquiring the frequency modulation continuous wave FMCW millimeter wave radar signals of a tested person in real time, inputting the frequency modulation continuous wave FMCW millimeter wave radar signals of the tested person into the trained neural network model, obtaining a sleep quality report of the tested person, detecting sudden disease risk in real time, and carrying out human dynamic tracking according to environment data acquired in real time. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the high-precision detection of the respiratory rate and the heart rate is realized.

title_en: Non-invasive vibration-based material identification and leakage detection for underground pipelines
abstract_en: A nondestructive evaluation system and method are provided for detecting the material type and leakage of an underground service line. An impactor applies a controlled impact to an instrumented rod in contact or proximity with the service line, inducing stress waves that propagate into the service line and surrounding soil. Sensors on the rod and/or on the ground surface detect the resulting waveforms. A processing unit analyzes time and frequency domain characteristics such as wave speed, attenuation, and vibration response to determine service line material and identify anomalies associated with leakage. The system enables accurate, real-time diagnostics of buried pipelines without excavation or fluid interruption.

title_en: Heart rate monitoring method and device, vehicle and storage medium thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heart rate monitoring method, a heart rate monitoring device, a vehicle and a storage medium thereof, and relates to the technical field of vital sign monitoring, comprising the steps of acquiring navigation information of the vehicle and determining indication information according to the navigation information, wherein the indication information is information for indicating detection of a user in the vehicle and comprises one or more of traffic signal lamp information, position information of the vehicle or driving information of the vehicle; if the indication information meets the preset condition, responding to the monitoring request, controlling the millimeter wave radar on the vehicle seat to monitor the heart rate of the user on the vehicle seat, and determining heart rate monitoring information of the user according to the electromagnetic wave signal of the millimeter wave radar for monitoring the heart rate of the user. According to the scheme, the heart rate of the user on the vehicle seat is monitored through the non-contact millimeter wave radar, the arrhythmia detection requirements of the driver and the passenger are met, and convenience in heart rate monitoring of the user on the vehicle seat is guaranteed.
assignees: WUHU AUTOMOBILE QIANZHAN TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;CHERY AUTOMOBILE CO LTD

title_en: In-vehicle vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar and data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an in-vehicle vital sign monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar and data fusion, which relates to the technical field of automobile safety monitoring and comprises the steps of collecting multi-mode environment data through an arranged sensor and preprocessing to obtain a processed vital sign signal, a carbon dioxide concentration change rate and an environment temperature value; the method comprises the steps of inputting a processed vital sign signal into a pre-trained convolutional neural network model, outputting the existence probability of a living body, fusing the existence probability of the living body, the change rate of carbon dioxide concentration and the environmental temperature value by adopting a multi-sensor information fusion algorithm, judging the risk level, and respectively executing a grading early warning strategy and an active intervention strategy according to the risk level judgment result. The invention can improve the detection accuracy, enhance the environmental adaptability, realize timely rescue response and have engineering application value in the field of passenger safety monitoring of intelligent network-connected automobiles.

title_en: Grenade Training Simulation System
title_ko: 수류탄 훈련 시뮬레이션 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 훈련병이 가상 현실(VR), 증강 현실(AR), 혼합 현실(MR) 기술을 활용하여 실제 수류탄 투척 훈련을 가상으로 경험할 수 있는 수류탄 훈련 시뮬레이션 시스템에 관한 것이다. 이 시스템은 센서 기반 시뮬레이션을 통해 훈련병의 투척 궤적과 속도를 실시간으로 감지 및 분석하여 훈련 효과를 극대화하며, 훈련 관리, 데이터 분석, 비상 대피, 신체 상태 모니터링 등의 기능을 포함한다. VR 시스템은 VR 헤드셋을 통해 가상 환경에서 훈련을 진행하게 하며, AR 시스템은 실제 훈련 환경에 가상 정보를 추가하여 실감 나는 훈련을 가능하게 한다. MR 시스템은 가상과 실제 환경이 결합된 훈련 환경을 제공하여 현실감 있는 훈련을 지원한다. 센서 기반 시뮬레이션 시스템은 센서수류탄, 센서플레이트, 콘솔박스로 구성되어 훈련 데이터를 실시간으로 감지하고 분석한다. 대형 스크린은 투척 결과를 시각적으로 제공하여 몰입감을 높이며, 훈련 관리 시스템은 훈련 상황을 모니터링하고 제어할 수 있게 한다. 데이터 분석 시스템은 훈련 성과를 평가하고 피드백을 제공하여 훈련 효과를 극대화하고, 비상 대피 시스템은 비상 상황 시 훈련병을 안전하게 대피시킬 수 있다. 신체 상태 모니터링 시스템은 훈련병의 생체 신호를 감지하여 이상 징후가 발생하면 경고하는 기능을 포함한다. 이를 통해 훈련병이 안전하고 효과적으로 수류탄 훈련을 받을 수 있도록 하며, 훈련의 질과 효과를 향상시킨다.

title_en: Vehicle, early warning control method and device
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a vehicle, an early warning control method and a device, which can solve the technical problem of failure of emergency response after power failure of the whole vehicle in the related technology, and relates to the field of intelligent cabins. The vehicle comprises a bus, a micro-motion detection device, an environment sensor, a microcontroller MCU, an actuator and an auxiliary power supply device, wherein the microcontroller MCU is connected with the bus, the micro-motion detection device and the environment sensor are connected with the MCU, the actuator is connected with the bus and used for controlling the starting of external ventilation operation and early warning operation according to vital signs detected by monitoring data of the micro-motion detection device and the environment sensor, the auxiliary power supply device comprises auxiliary electric equipment and power supply switching equipment, and when the power supply switching equipment is switched to the auxiliary power supply equipment to be in a working state, the auxiliary power supply equipment provides power supply for the MCU, the actuator, the micro-motion detection device and the environment sensor. Thus, the early warning capability under the extreme scene (such as the power failure of the whole vehicle) is ensured, and the early warning operation is ensured not to be interrupted.

title_en: Three-dimensional imaging through-wall detection radar device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a three-dimensional imaging through-wall detection radar device, which belongs to the technical field of through-wall detection radar, and structurally comprises a shell, wherein a direction changing component is vertically arranged at the upper end of a cavity of the shell, a three-dimensional imaging through-wall detection radar main body is arranged on the top surface of the direction changing component, a plurality of sucker legs are obliquely arranged at four sides of the rear end of the shell, a controller and a battery are arranged in the cavity of the lower end of the shell, an operation panel is arranged on the front side of the shell, so that the three-dimensional imaging through-wall detection radar main body can directly pass through a wall to detect an object right in front of the rear side of the wall after being adsorbed and fixed on the wall by the four sucker legs, and a swinging component is driven by a rotator to rotate, so that the left and right visual angles of the three-dimensional imaging through-wall detection radar main body can be enlarged, the detection visual angles of the three-dimensional imaging through-wall detection radar main body after passing through the wall can be enlarged, and the through-wall detection area is promoted, and the practicability is strong.

title_en: Intuitively and rapidly applicable tourniquets
abstract_en: The Retrofit Tourniquet System is a portable, non-invasive diagnostic device designed to assess and monitor vital signs for early detection of hypovolemic shock and other trauma-related medical conditions. Utilizing integrated sensors, the system continuously tracks critical metrics such as heart rate, blood pressure, respiratory rate, pulse pressure, and blood oxygen levels, comparing them against individualized baseline values stored in lookup tables. The system's diagnostic algorithms identify deviations in vital signs, calculate estimated blood loss stages, and provide recommended treatment options. Built to function seamlessly on or off a tourniquet, the Retrofit Tourniquet System enables first responders and military personnel to assess a patient's condition in real-time, even in field conditions. Enhanced by secure data encryption and compatibility with healthcare interoperability standards (e.g., FHIR and HL7), the system also supports remote monitoring by medical professionals when integrated with remote databases. This tailored, AI-assisted device improves patient survivability by allowing for timely interventions, particularly in cases of internal bleeding where traditional diagnostics are insufficient.
assignees: DIMINO MICHAEL J;DIMINO MICHAEL C;DIMINO ALFONSE

title_en: Anomalous phase detection based ground penetrating radars
abstract_en: A method of buried metal object detection is described, which includes generating RF signal in a radio frequency module, supplying RF signal to a ground penetrating radar, scanning the ground penetrating radar over an area comprising buried metal objects, and detecting a buried metal object using anomalous phase response measured in the reflected signals.
assignees: PRINCE SATTAM BIN ABDULAZIZ UNIV PSAU

title_en: Self-adaptive scene classification and interference suppression method based on TCN module
abstract_en: The invention discloses a TCN module-based self-adaptive scene classification and interference suppression method, which comprises the steps of acquiring sensor data in different scenes by using a wearable device, including radar signal data of human body vital signals detected by a millimeter wave radar and triaxial acceleration data acquired by a triaxial accelerometer, constructing a random forest model, training the random forest model, inputting the sensor data set, outputting a dynamic scene discrimination result, acquiring the dynamic scene discrimination result of current sensor data by using the trained random forest model, and enhancing radar signals by using the TCN module aiming at the dynamic scene discrimination result. According to the method, scene classification and interference suppression are combined, the indoor and outdoor subnetworks are dynamically invoked based on random forest judgment results, and model threshold parameters and targeted enhancement weak signals are dynamically adjusted according to different energy duty ratios, so that an interference suppression strategy and a scene are synchronized in real time.

title_en: Multifunctional distributed multi-vital sign non-contact detection radar system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional distributed multi-vital sign non-contact detection radar system which comprises a central processing module, a line distribution module and a front-end detection module. The front-end detection module is composed of a plurality of vital sign sensing access modules, transmits optical signals or microwave signals to a detection area and receives echoes to obtain original detection signals. The central processing module comprises a signal generation and processing unit, a pulse condition extraction unit, a blood pressure estimation unit and a dynamic tracking and fall-preventing early warning unit, and realizes the functions of generating and processing detection signals, pulse condition extraction, blood pressure estimation, fall-preventing monitoring and early warning processing based on range profile and micro Doppler analysis and the like. The circuit distribution module is connected with the sensing access module and the central processing module, adds delay in each link and consists of a plurality of optical splitters and optical delays. The invention realizes the continuous measurement functions of non-contact, respiration and pulse detection, acquisition of human body pulse condition information, rapid estimation of human body systolic pressure, falling prevention and dynamic tracking.

title_en: Millimeter wave radar arrhythmia detection method based on particle swarm optimization variation modal decomposition and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of non-contact vital sign detection, in particular to a millimeter wave radar arrhythmia detection method based on particle swarm optimization variation modal decomposition and deep learning, which specifically comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring human chest micro-motion signals by utilizing a millimeter wave radar, and carrying out static clutter filtering, phase extraction, unwrapping and trending treatment on radar echo signals to obtain chest displacement signals containing heartbeat and respiratory information; the method comprises the steps of S2, constructing a variation modal decomposition model aiming at the chest displacement signal, carrying out self-adaptive optimization on the modal number and penalty factors through a particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain optimal decomposition parameters and complete signal decomposition, S3, screening modal components located in a heartbeat frequency range according to the center frequency and energy distribution characteristics of each modal component and carrying out reconstruction to obtain a heartbeat characteristic signal representing the mechanical activity of a heart, S4, carrying out time sequence segmentation on the heartbeat characteristic signal, extracting local heartbeat morphological characteristics by utilizing a convolutional neural network, modeling the long-term rhythm dependency relationship of the heartbeat signal by combining a time sequence modeling network based on an attention mechanism to obtain a heart rhythm depth characteristic representation, S5, inputting the heart rhythm depth characteristic into a heart rhythm discrimination model, analyzing the heart rhythm state of a tested person, and outputting a heart rhythm abnormality detection result. According to the invention, the adaptive selection of variation modal decomposition parameters is realized by introducing a particle swarm optimization mechanism, the heartbeat signal, the respiration and motion interference components are effectively separated, and the rhythm characteristics of the heart rhythm are modeled by combining a deep learning model, so that the non-contact detection of arrhythmia is realized. The method does not need to wear electrodes or contact a human body, has the advantages of strong anti-interference capability, good adaptability and high detection precision, and has good application prospects in the fields of heart rhythm health monitoring, disease screening and the like.

title_en: Intelligent sleep detection and follow-up adjustment system and method and intelligent bedding
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent sleep detection and follow-up adjustment system, an intelligent sleep detection and follow-up adjustment method and an intelligent bedding, comprising an electromagnetic wave vital sign sensing module, an infrared thermopile array sensing module, a multimode fusion processing unit, a follow-up control unit and an intelligent follow-up mechanism, wherein the electromagnetic wave vital sign sensing module is used for acquiring point cloud data and micro Doppler frequency spectrum information of a user in a non-contact mode, the infrared thermopile array sensing module is used for acquiring body surface temperature distribution information of the user in a non-contact mode and generating a heat map matrix, the heat map matrix comprises a user body surface heat source outline and local thermal fluctuation information caused by physiological activities of the user, the multimode fusion processing unit is used for carrying out fusion processing on the point cloud data, the micro Doppler frequency spectrum information, the user body surface heat source outline and the local thermal fluctuation information, outputting a physiological parameter set representing sleep quality of the user, the follow-up control unit is used for generating deformation control parameters of a sleep support according to the physiological parameter set, and the intelligent follow-up mechanism is used for executing deformation adjustment operation of the sleep support according to the deformation control parameters.
assignees: BEIJING GEWU CENTURY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ruminant respiration detection method, ruminant respiration detection system, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a ruminant respiration detection method, a system, computer equipment and a storage medium, which belong to the field of vital sign detection and comprise the steps of collecting radar echo ADC data, carrying out distance dimension fast Fourier transform on the radar echo ADC data to obtain a distance-snapshot matrix, carrying out phase extraction and calculating the difference of phase signals to construct a vital sign time sequence, carrying out fast Fourier transform on the vital sign time sequence to obtain fast Fourier spectrum energy distribution, determining a respiration candidate signal based on a preset respiration frequency band, carrying out empirical mode decomposition on the respiration candidate signal to obtain a plurality of intrinsic mode components, calculating comprehensive scores based on frequency matching degree, energy weight and cycle consistency, determining a respiration main component by the intrinsic mode component with the highest comprehensive score, calculating a power spectrum peak corresponding to the respiration main component, and determining the respiration times by the power spectrum peak. The method enhances the robustness of the animal breath detection method.

title_en: Rehabilitation training system and method for gesture perception and proprioception
abstract_en: The invention discloses a posture sensing and proprioception rehabilitation training system, a quantitative evaluation method executed by the posture sensing and proprioception rehabilitation training system and a rehabilitation training method executed by the posture sensing and proprioception rehabilitation training system. The system comprises a multi-layer heterogeneous flexible sensor array mattress, a system control unit, a man-machine interaction module and an undisturbed physiological index detection unit. The mattress is laid on the surface of the sickbed and is used for collecting the body pressure distribution signals of the patient, outputting touch sense and warm stimulation and collecting vital sign signals in a non-contact mode. The system control unit processes the body pressure distribution and vital sign signals, runs intelligent recognition and control algorithms and generates stimulation control instructions. The man-machine interaction module displays the system state information and receives the user instruction. The undisturbed physiological index detection unit is integrated in the mattress and is used for collecting vital sign signals.

title_en: Multi-mode space-time fusion-based radar point cloud target detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring equipment, in particular to a radar point cloud target detection system and method based on multi-mode space-time fusion. The method comprises the following steps of synchronously collecting echo signals of targets by at least two radar transceivers at different visual angles, establishing a three-dimensional coordinate system, clustering target points of each time slice based on the three-dimensional coordinate system of the target points, acquiring a coordinate set of point cloud clustering, judging whether the center of gravity of the point cloud of each detection target is displaced, if the detection target is displaced, capturing a space track of the target point based on the center of gravity coordinate, performing gait analysis on the detection target, and if the detection target is not displaced, judging the body posture of the detection target. The invention has the advantage of low cost, can realize reliable radar point cloud, breaks through the defects of multiple antenna MIMO and high cost required by the traditional point cloud, realizes body point cloud modeling in the walking process, simultaneously jointly verifies pose point cloud and vital sign data, and enhances the reliability.
assignees: SHANDONG HAIKE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign detector based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of criminal escort monitoring, in particular to a vital sign detector based on millimeter wave radar, which comprises a detector shell, a rotor craft and a machine base, wherein a base plate is fixedly connected to the top of the machine base, a hanging structure is arranged at the top of the base plate, a mounting assembly is fixedly connected to the bottom of the rotor craft, and the detector shell is arranged at the bottom of the mounting assembly. The invention provides a vital sign detector based on millimeter wave radar, which has the advantages that millimeter wave detection components are arranged through arranging a detector shell to detect vital signs and activities of escorted personnel, an arranged base is used for arranging a fixed structure in a carrier or being worn in front of escorted personnel in cooperation with a hanging structure, the external features of the escorted personnel, which are input in advance through a rotor craft when the carrier walks outside to move for escort, are tracked, and a certain distance is kept to avoid the escorted personnel from damaging equipment.

title_en: Radar-based human presence monitoring system with edge filtering and cloud-based feedback
abstract_en: A human presence monitoring system includes a radar-based sensing device configured for installation in a residential environment and a cloud-based server configured to receive and analyze sensing data. The device emits frequency-modulated continuous-wave radar signals and performs on-device signal processing using distance, energy, and motion gating to detect and classify human presence. A visual indicator provides real-time feedback to the user. The device aggregates radar data into a compressed two-dimensional histogram and transmits periodic reports via a cellular or Wi-Fi connection. The server applies machine learning classifiers trained on historical activity and client-specific circadian patterns to assess reported data and determine alert conditions. Updated classification parameters may be transmitted back to the device without user intervention, allowing the system to adapt over time. A companion application enables authorized contacts to receive daily reports, view activity history, configure alert preferences, and manage support circle communications.

title_en: Intelligent wall lamp health monitoring method and system based on radar induction
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of health monitoring, and discloses an intelligent wall lamp health monitoring method and system based on radar induction. The system generates movement characteristics and vital sign data by collecting space echo signals through the radar, realizes multi-mode data fusion analysis by combining an external sensor, judges whether a user triggers an abnormal event, sends alarm information through visible light communication, and realizes self power supply by adopting a photovoltaic film and a radio frequency energy collection technology.
assignees: HAIKAIBAO INTELLIGENT TECH JIAXING CO LTD

title_en: Lightweight millimeter wave radar child age classification method based on feature engineering
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lightweight millimeter wave radar child age classification method based on feature engineering, which comprises the steps of obtaining millimeter wave radar vital sign data sets containing a plurality of children with different ages, extracting respiratory signals, calculating a plurality of candidate features from the respiratory signals, constructing a candidate feature set, screening key feature subsets for child age classification from the candidate feature set, training a lightweight machine learning model to obtain a child age classification model, processing input millimeter wave radar signals, and outputting child age classification results. The invention has the beneficial effects that the calculation complexity and the storage cost of the model are obviously reduced, so that the high-precision child age classification model can be efficiently operated on an embedded platform with limited resources.

title_en: Pseudo data creation system, pseudo data creation method, and program
abstract_en: To create pseudo underground radar data at a low calculation cost.SOLUTION: A pseudo data generation system for generating pseudo data of a pseudo buried pipe includes: a reflection profile point calculation unit that calculates a reflection profile point which is a foot of a perpendicular dropped from a pseudo survey point to a profile line; a reference reflection profile point calculation unit that calculates a reference reflection profile point which is a foot of a perpendicular dropped from a reference survey point to a reference profile line; a reference pseudo survey point calculation unit that calculates a reference pseudo survey point which is a point at which a minute line segment of the profile line at the reflection profile point and a minute line segment of the pseudo profile line at the reference reflection profile point are matched; and a buried pipe signal calculation unit that calculates a buried pipe signal at the reference pseudo survey point and calculates pseudo data by associating the buried pipe signal with the pseudo survey point.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Self-adaptive multi-person real-time breath heartbeat monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive multi-person real-time breath heartbeat monitoring method and system based on millimeter wave radar. The method comprises the steps of carrying out one-dimensional Fourier transform on radar echoes and removing static clutter, carrying out rough target detection of a self-adaptive threshold value by utilizing global statistical characteristics, dynamically updating the threshold value by utilizing a front-to-back frame noise intensity ratio, carrying out target verification and accurate positioning by utilizing a 2D-CFAR, carrying out angle measurement by adopting a subspace MUSIC algorithm with enhanced micro-motion characteristics, determining target space information by combining specific frequency filtering, carrying out angle compensation on multi-channel data to obtain phase information, carrying out preliminary separation signal by utilizing two-channel heterogeneous wavelet packet transformation, introducing respiratory frequency multiplication harmonic wave removal technology to eliminate interference, reconstructing respiratory and heartbeat signals with high signal to noise ratio, and carrying out characteristic tracking by combining Kalman filtering and short-time Fourier transform. The invention effectively solves the problems of flexibly switching target positioning and interference under different conditions of single person, double person, same distance, multiple persons and the like, and realizes high-precision self-adaptive vital sign monitoring.

title_en: Pre-buried antidetonation support and pre-buried antidetonation system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building earthquake resistance, in particular to an embedded earthquake-resistant bracket and an embedded earthquake-resistant system. The both ends of pre-buried muscle are connected in supporting seat and pre-buried board respectively, and supporting mechanism rotates to be connected in supporting seat and main frame or bottom plate. The backup pad is installed in the top of main frame, butt in the bottom plate. When an earthquake occurs, the first support rod and the second support rod deviate and displace along with the vibration, and the adjusting plate generates acting force on the first elastic piece and the second elastic piece along with the vibration, so that the first elastic piece and the second elastic piece deform. The pressure sensor is used for sensing acting force at two ends on the adjusting plate, the hydraulic rod stretches and contracts according to the acting force on the adjusting plate, the first supporting rod and the second supporting rod are driven by changing the position of the adjusting plate, vibration energy is consumed, the whole supporting mechanism is kept stable, and the vibration-resistant effect of the whole embedded vibration-resistant support is guaranteed.
assignees: MCC COMM CONSTR GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Multi-person same-distance vital signal detection method based on OMP super-resolution algorithm
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of radars, and particularly discloses a multi-person same-distance vital signal detection method based on an OMP super-resolution algorithm, which comprises the following steps of obtaining a distance information matrix containing a plurality of target human body vital signals; performing OMP super-resolution reconstruction on distance information containing a plurality of target human body vital signals to obtain a reconstructed distance information matrix, processing the reconstructed distance information matrix to respectively obtain vital signal phase information, and respectively decomposing the vital signal phase information through a fully self-adaptive noise set empirical mode decomposition algorithm to obtain a reconstructed respiratory signal and a heartbeat signal. According to the invention, the distance information matrix is decomposed and OMP reconstruction is carried out, so that the multi-person life signals which are originally overlapped on the traditional distance-time spectrum are clearly separated after reconstruction, and the signal resolution capability of the millimeter wave radar in a multi-person same-distance scene is obviously improved.

title_en: Multi-person detection, positioning and vital sign monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-person detection, positioning and vital sign monitoring method and system, wherein the system comprises a 77G radar module, a signal preprocessing module, a target separation and people counting module, a positioning module, a vital sign extraction module, a gesture monitoring module and a data output module, and the method comprises the steps of radar signal transmission and reception, signal preprocessing, target separation and people counting, multi-person positioning, vital sign extraction, gesture monitoring and data output. The invention adopts 77G frequency modulation continuous wave radar combined with M X N phased array antenna, which improves distance resolution and angle resolution obviously, effectively separates multi-target superimposed signals through a signal separation algorithm based on sparse representation, realizes accurate people counting, realizes non-perception and high-precision multi-person comprehensive monitoring, has strong illumination resistance, shielding and environmental noise resistance and good privacy protection, and can be widely applied to multiple scenes such as intelligent security, intelligent home, medical monitoring, care and the like.

title_en: Vital sign detection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vital sign detection system which comprises a power supply part and a detection part, wherein the power supply part is configured to provide energy, the detection part is used for detecting vital signs of a user and is electrically connected with the power supply part, the detection part comprises a circuit board and a millimeter wave radar sensor, the circuit board is arranged in the detection part, the millimeter wave radar sensor is arranged on the circuit board, and the millimeter wave radar sensor can emit millimeter-level electromagnetic waves to detect the vital signs. Because the detection portion is suitable for including circuit board and millimeter wave radar sensor, millimeter wave radar sensor integration sets up on the circuit board to let the structure that uses above-mentioned detection portion more simple reliable, can realize the portable use of vital sign detecting system, and can integrate and have multiple performance in order to let the diversified function of vital sign detecting system use.

title_en: Multifunctional sleep monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: A multifunctional sleep monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar comprises the steps of reorganizing, dividing frames and removing clutter of collected original ADC data, obtaining a target distance spectrum through one-dimensional FFT and inter-frame difference, and determining a target distance unit through non-coherent accumulation. Extracting phase information of the unit signal, unwrapping and differentiating to obtain vital sign signals, separating respiratory and heartbeat components by utilizing multi-mode decomposition and reconstruction, and obtaining respiratory frequency and heart rate through Fourier transformation; the system can analyze vital signs and sleeping posture states in real time, and automatically output alarm information when detecting apnea, abnormal heart rate or dangerous sleeping posture continuously exceeding a preset time. The invention has the advantages of non-contact, high precision and real-time performance.

title_en: Smart ring for biosignal measurement
title_ko: 생체 신호 측정용 스마트 링
abstract_en: A smart ring for biosignal measurement, according to an embodiment of the present invention, comprises: a housing having a ring shape to be worn on a finger of a wearer and having an inner circumferential surface that contacts the finger on which the housing is worn and an outer circumferential surface formed to be larger than the inner circumferential surface; a protrusion unit protruding from the inner circumferential surface of the housing; a sensor unit which is positioned on the inner circumferential surface of the housing and measures biosignals; a control unit that receives the measured biosignals from the sensor unit; and a battery unit which supplies power to the sensor unit and the control unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 생체 신호 측정용 스마트 링은 착용자의 손가락에 착용되도록 반지형상을 가지고, 착용된 손가락이 맞닿는 내주면 및 내주면보다 크게 형성되는 외주면을 가지는 하우징, 하우징의 내주면으로부터 돌출형성되는 돌출부, 하우징의 내주면에 위치하고, 생체 신호를 측정하는 센서부 및 센서부로부터 측정된 생체신호를 수신하는 제어부 및 센서부 및 제어부로 전원을 공급하는 배터리부를 포함한다.

title_en: System for observing carbon dioxide gas in earthquake precursor fault gas
abstract_en: The invention relates to a carbon dioxide gas observation system for earthquake precursor fault gas, which comprises a solar vertical rod, a storage battery buried box, a comprehensive weather station, an observation well and an observation host, wherein the solar vertical rod is arranged on the ground, a solar panel is arranged on the solar vertical rod, the storage battery buried box is buried underground, a storage battery is arranged in the storage battery buried box and is connected with the solar panel, the comprehensive weather station is arranged on the solar vertical rod, a carbon dioxide sensor and a ground temperature and humidity sensor are arranged in the observation well, the observation host is arranged on the solar vertical rod and is connected with the storage battery, the comprehensive weather station, the carbon dioxide sensor and the ground temperature and humidity sensor, and the device can be used for evaluating the influence of environmental factors on the observation of carbon dioxide concentration by arranging the observation well and the comprehensive weather station on the ground so as to finish the measurement of carbon dioxide concentration, air temperature, humidity, air pressure, rainfall and ground temperature, and the observation accuracy is improved.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF BEIJING HUAYUN ANALYTICAL INSTR CO LTD

title_en: Karst vacuum corrosion simulation experiment device under dynamic and static load coupling effect
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of physical simulation of geotechnical engineering geological disasters, and discloses a karst vacuum corrosion simulation experiment device under the action of dynamic and static load coupling, which comprises a test box, a vacuum corrosion simulation system, a dynamic and static load loading system, a comprehensive monitoring system and a central control system; A covering layer for simulating karst is filled in layers in the test box, a plurality of karst cavities are arranged in the covering layer, the top of the test box is connected with a moving platform in a sliding mode, a dynamic and static load loading system is arranged on the moving platform, a comprehensive monitoring system comprises a mechanical sensor array, a negative pressure sensor and a visual monitoring unit, the mechanical sensor array is buried in the covering layer, and the negative pressure sensor is arranged in the karst cavities. The invention can simulate vacuum corrosion, apply independent or coupled static and dynamic load with adjustable size and position to the karst covering layer, accurately simulate the formation, development and dissipation process of vacuum negative pressure in the karst cavity, and improve the reality and accuracy of simulation.

title_en: Millimeter wave vital sign monitoring method based on Narx neural network
abstract_en: The application discloses a millimeter wave vital sign monitoring method based on Narx neural network, which comprises the following steps of 1, initializing monitoring system parameters, configuring the working frequency of a millimeter wave radar sensor to be 77GHz, setting the sampling frequency to be 100MHz, 2, executing signal acquisition, transmitting and receiving millimeter wave signals to a monitoring area through a millimeter wave radar sensor component, 3, judging whether abnormal conditions exist after acquisition is completed, and executing 4 if no abnormal conditions exist, and 4, executing signal processing and analysis. The intelligent monitoring system has the advantages of realizing real-time and accurate monitoring and deep analysis of respiration and heartbeat signals and meeting the comprehensive monitoring requirements of multiple fields such as medical monitoring, intelligent home furnishing, security protection and the like.

title_en: Safe storage for used batteries
title_ko: 폐배터리 안전 보관함
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 폐배터리 안전 보관함에 관한 것으로 외부충격에 의해 발생되는 폭발 및 화재를 신속히 소화하고, 외부 환경으로 인한 폐배터리의 자발적인 발화 위험성을 최소화하면서, 운송과정에서 발생할 수 있는 화재 및 폭발 사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있도록 함과 아울러, 보관함의 적재효율을 높일 수 있도록 하기 위해, 내부공간부(19)가 형성되고 전방측이 개방 형성된 직사각형 함체 형상이며, 내열, 내화 및 단열성을 갖는 내장재가 적용되어 화재 확산을 방지토록 하는 챔버(10); 상기 챔버(10)는 상부벽체(13), 하부벽체(14), 좌측벽체(11) 및 우측벽체(12)로 둘러싸여 전방측이 개방 형성된 직사각형 함체 형상으로 형성되며, 상기 상부벽체(13)의 각 모서리부에서 수직상부측으로 높이를 갖는“ㄴ”자 형태의 안착브라켓(81)이 구비되고, 상기 하부벽체(14)의 저면에 지게차의 포크를 삽입할 수 있는 간격으로 받침대(93)가 구비되어, 상기 챔버(10)의 상부벽체(13) 상부측에서 다른 챔버(10)의 적층 시, 상기 챔버(10)의 하부벽체(14)에 구비된 받침대(93)의 모서리부가 챔버(10)의 상부벽체(13) 각 모서리부에 형성된 안착브라켓(81) 내에 안착지지되도록 구성되고, 상기 챔버(10)의 전방 개방측 양측면에 각각 힌지(32)로 연결되어 전방 개방측을 개폐하며, 상기 챔버(10)가 차량에 적재된 상태에서도 내부공간부(19) 상태를 확인할 수 있는 양문형 도어(31); 상기 양문형 도어(31) 상에 각각 챔버(10)의 내부공간부(19) 상태를 사용자가 육안으로 관찰할 수 있는 강화유리 재질의 투시창(35)이 구비되고, 상기 챔버(10)의 내부공간부(19)를 상,하방향으로 다수개 각 단으로 분리토록 하여, 각 단마다 다른 종류의 폐배터리(B)를 안착할 수 있도록 하는 수평칸막이판(20); 상기 챔버(10)의 내벽면에 구비되어 내부공간부(19)에서 발생되는 불꽃 및 연기를 감지하는 불꽃연기감지센서(98); 상기 챔버(10)의 내벽면에 구비되어 내부공간부(19)의 온도 및 폐배터리(B)의 온도를 감지하는 온도센서(99); 상기 챔버(10)의 내부공간부(19) 바닥면 및 수평칸막이판(20)의 바닥면에 구비되며, 리튬이온배터리 화재 전용 소화액을 내장하는 소화액탱크(71); 상기 소화액탱크(71)에 연결되어 챔버(10)의 내부공간부(19) 천정면에서 수직하향으로 소화액을 분사하는 소화노즐(73); 상기 챔버(10)의 내부공간부(19) 천정면에 구비되어 내부공간부(19)를 감시하는 카메라(94); 상기 챔버(10)의 일측 외면에 연결된 함체(60) 상에 구비되며, 상기 불꽃연기감지센서(98), 온도센서(99), 소화노즐(73) 및 카메라(94)에 연결되어 제어하는 컨트롤러(65);를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Portable non-contact millimeter wave human body breathing and heartbeat monitoring method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable non-contact millimeter wave human breath and heartbeat monitoring method and device, the device comprises a millimeter wave lens antenna, a radio frequency front end module, a digital control and intermediate frequency processing module, a digital signal processing module, a shell module and upper computer software. According to the invention, the millimeter wave radar is adopted to realize non-contact respiration and heartbeat measurement, the special millimeter wave lens antenna is utilized to realize narrow wave beam so as to improve signal to noise ratio, the digital signal processing module is used for automatically processing to obtain respiration waveform, respiration frequency, heartbeat waveform and heartbeat frequency vital signs, and the results are synchronously displayed on a shell screen and upper computer software, so that a laser indicator lamp in front of the shell is convenient for observing a measurement position, and the power supply of an adapter and the power supply of a battery are supported. The invention has the characteristics of portability, miniaturization and integration, realizes accurate measurement of respiration and heartbeat in a non-contact scene, is used for emergency diagnosis, intensive care and sleep monitoring, and meets the clinical rapid and accurate respiratory heartbeat detection application requirements.

title_en: End-to-end vital sign monitoring radar system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an end-to-end vital sign monitoring radar system. The system comprises a radio frequency and buffer module and an analog demodulation module. The radio frequency and buffer module is used for completing the transmission, the reception and the signal buffering of millimeter wave signals and comprises a radio frequency module and an IQ two-way buffer. The analog demodulation module performs signal demodulation in the analog domain using a modified differential and cross multiplication algorithm (MDACM) method and outputs a target time-varying displacement signal. The analog demodulation module is composed of analog devices and comprises an IQ two-way direct current item extraction module, an IQ two-way differentiator, an IQ two-way multiplier, a first-stage subtracter, a second-stage subtracter, an adder and an integrator. The phase demodulation principle of the analog demodulation module follows MDACM algorithm, and the process is completely carried out in the analog domain. The whole radar system can realize end-to-end vital sign monitoring, has high real-time performance and low power consumption, and can reduce the sampling rate and the sampling channel.

title_en: A system for detecting passengers who have not gotten off a school bus using radar sensors
title_ko: 레이더 센서를 이용한 통학 차량 미하차 탑승객 검출 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 양상에 따른 레이더 센서를 이용한 통학 차량 미하차 탑승객 검출 시스템은 차량 내 좌석이 배치된 행마다 복수 개 설치되되, 통학 차량 내부의 일측 벽면에 좌석 시트에 상응하는 높이로 각 좌석 행마다 설치되어 타측 벽면 방향으로 사람의 생체 신호를 검출하는 복수의 레이더 센서 모듈과, 레이더 센서 모듈들로부터 생체 신호 검출 결과를 수신하여 미하차 탑승객을 검출한다. 이때, 본 발명은 설치된 레이더 센서 모듈의 레이더 신호가 간섭되지 않도록 시간을 분할하여 미하차 탑승객을 검출하도록 제어된다.

title_en: Non-contact respiration state monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact respiration state monitoring method based on millimeter wave radar, and belongs to the technical field of non-contact human vital sign monitoring. The method comprises the steps of collecting radar echo signals of a human body target by utilizing a millimeter wave radar, obtaining a phase sequence through frequency mixing, filtering and phase demodulation, extracting respiratory signals through phase unwrapping and displacement conversion, carrying out Fourier transformation on the respiratory signals, calculating respiratory frequency and amplitude, adopting various slope extraction algorithms to derive the respiratory signals in inspiration and expiration phases to obtain respiratory slopes, and finally integrating the respiratory frequency, the amplitude and the slope, setting a threshold value and a scoring system, and realizing rapid and accurate assessment of respiratory distress degree. The method does not need to contact with human body, can penetrate clothes, is suitable for various scenes such as clinical monitoring, emergency diagnosis and the like, and has the advantages of simplicity and convenience in operation, strong instantaneity and high reliability.
assignees: UNIV BEIHANG;PEKING UNION MEDICAL COLLEGE HOSPITAL CAMS

title_en: Multi-sensing fusion property center 24-hour home health monitoring emergency system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 24-hour home health monitoring emergency system for a multi-sensing fusion property center, and relates to the technical fields of Internet of things, intelligent care and medical health monitoring. The system realizes 24-hour continuous vital sign monitoring, high-precision abnormal detection, rapid emergency response and personalized health service for the elderly and senior pregnant women in communities through the combination mode of intelligent bedding noninductive monitoring at night and intelligent wearing noninductive monitoring at daytime, and the integrated multi-sensor fusion technology is in deep linkage with a property center. The intelligent monitoring system comprises an intelligent monitoring terminal group, a property intelligent monitoring center, a property APP mobile terminal, a property community gateway and other core modules, adopts a dynamic weight fusion algorithm, a precursor trigger mechanism and a blockchain evidence storage technology, achieves early warning trigger within 3 seconds and response rescue information task dispatch within 30 seconds, effectively solves the problems of accuracy, response timeliness and data safety of home health monitoring, has the advantages of low cost, easiness in popularization and high practicability, and accords with the national intelligent care industry development policy.
assignees: HONGSEN ZHIKANG HAINAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: LFMCW through-wall radar analog domain distance compensation method based on intermediate frequency filter special design
abstract_en: The invention discloses an analog domain distance compensation method based on special design of an intermediate frequency filter. The method utilizes the strong correlation between the LFMCW radar intermediate frequency signal frequency and the target distance, designs a filter with a specific slope of the transition band amplitude-frequency response characteristic, directly pre-compensates the echo signal energy of targets with different distances in an analog signal processing stage, and inhibits the front wall strong echo signal. Through verification of actual measurement experiments, the special design of the intermediate frequency filter can be realized, and the method can successfully compensate the echo energy of targets with different distances to similar levels while effectively inhibiting the strong echo signals of the front wall, so that the detection distance of the LFMCW through-wall radar system can be effectively improved.
assignees: BEIJING INST TECHNOLOGY;BEIJING INST OF TECHNOLOGY YANGTZE RIVER DELTA RESEARCH INST JIAXING

title_en: UWB vehicle-mounted airtight space detection system with respiratory rate monitoring and SOS linkage
abstract_en: The UWB vehicle-mounted airtight space detection system with the breathing frequency monitoring and SOS linkage is characterized by comprising an ultra-wideband signal acquisition module, a preprocessing module, a control decision module and a response module which are sequentially connected, wherein the ultra-wideband signal acquisition module is provided with at least 3 array antennas which are used for covering the vehicle-mounted airtight space completely and have no dead angle and continuously transmitting ultra-wideband pulses and receiving echo signals reflected by the breathing motion of a chest of a human body, the preprocessing module is used for preprocessing the echo signals to obtain breathing characteristic data, the control decision module is used for detecting the breathing state of the human body according to the breathing characteristic data, and sending corresponding control signals to the response module when the breathing abnormality of the human body is detected, and the response module is used for completing acousto-optic alarm, window control and emergency call response according to the control signals. The intelligent life sign monitoring system has the advantages that stable and accurate life sign monitoring can be realized and emergency rescue is triggered while low power consumption is guaranteed.
assignees: CHONGQING REBO LIGHTING & ELECTRONICS CO LIMITED

title_en: Fixed placer of human vital sign radar monitor
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fixed placement device of a radar monitor for human vital signs, which relates to the technical field of instrument fixed placement and comprises a base, wherein a fixing mechanism is arranged at the top end of the base, a monitor main body is arranged at the inner side of the fixing mechanism, the fixing mechanism comprises a support frame, arbitrary stop shafts are symmetrically arranged at the positions, close to the top end, of the left side and the right side of the inner part of the support frame, a bracket is rotationally connected between the two arbitrary stop shafts, the inner side of the support frame is matched with the arbitrary stop shafts through a rotary table, the monitor main body can be subjected to multi-angle adjustment, the use convenience is improved, the inserted rod is pushed inwards through a spring group, the monitor main body can be placed and fixed in a fixed block, the inserted rod is driven to be separated from the fixed block through pushing a push plate outwards, and the aim of rapid disassembly and assembly are achieved, and convenience and disassembly efficiency are greatly improved.

title_en: Intelligent child vital sign acquisition system, method and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of medical health monitoring, and discloses an intelligent child vital sign acquisition system, an intelligent child vital sign acquisition method and a storage medium, wherein the intelligent child vital sign acquisition system comprises a wearable patch device and a data processing system; the wearable patch device comprises a biocompatible adhesive layer, a multi-mode sensor integrated layer and a medical TPU packaging layer, and the data processing system comprises a micro control unit, an energy and communication unit, a hospital cloud server and a user mobile terminal. The method and the storage medium correspond to the system. The invention solves the technical problems of poor multi-parameter fusion capability, serious motion artifact interference and lack of skin safety monitoring and personalized early warning mechanisms of the existing child monitoring equipment, and realizes the integrated management of accurate acquisition of physiological parameters, real-time risk early warning and remote collaborative monitoring.
assignees: WOMEN AND CHILDRENS MEDICAL CENTER OF GUANGZHOU MEDICAL UNIV

title_en: Intelligent emergency rescue cabin with self-adjusting thermal environment and air quality and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent emergency rescue cabin and a method for self-adjusting thermal environment and air quality, and relates to the technical field of emergency rescue. The method is characterized by comprising the steps of firstly, establishing a standard loss rate by simulating the heat loss characteristics of an environment learning rescue cabin, then setting a target temperature interval, and dynamically selecting a grading temperature control mode such as dormancy, low-power consumption maintenance or dynamic balance based on comparison of the real-time monitored temperature loss rate and a standard value. The invention further discloses integrated vital sign monitoring, which can dynamically adjust the target temperature according to parameters such as core body temperature, blood oxygen, blood pressure and the like of a patient and start medical intervention modes such as active cooling, shock rewarming and the like, wherein the Hucken rewarming mode adopts a mode of heating a core area by directional radiation to realize safe rewarming. The system also incorporates a multi-rule priority arbitration mechanism. The cabin body comprises a sensor, an air conditioner, vital sign monitoring equipment and a directional heating plate. The invention realizes the unification of energy conservation, temperature stabilization and accurate medical intervention, and remarkably improves the intelligent level and the safety guarantee capability of emergency rescue.
assignees: CSSC HAISHEN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Management and control method and system for vital sign monitoring sickbed
abstract_en: The invention relates to a management and control method and a management and control system for a vital sign monitoring sickbed. The utility model provides a vital sign monitoring sick bed's management and control system includes millimeter radar wave module, body temperature detection module, blood pressure monitoring module, data processing module, wireless communication module and alarm module, millimeter radar wave module's data transmission end is connected with data processing module first input, body temperature detection module's output is connected with data processing module second input, blood pressure monitoring module is connected with data processing module's third input, data processing module's output is connected with wireless communication module's input, alarm module is connected with data processing module's output. The invention has the effect of improving the medical response efficiency.
assignees: XIAMEN SHITUO MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Meteorological service early warning device applied to karst landform scenic spot
abstract_en: A meteorological service early warning device applied to karst landform scenic spots relates to the technical field of meteorological service early warning and is used for improving accuracy of detection results of meteorological disasters caused by rainfall of the karst landform scenic spots. The meteorological service early warning device applied to karst landform scenic spots comprises a monitoring module, a data processing module and an early warning module, wherein the monitoring module comprises a displacement sensor, an inclination sensor, a soil humidity sensor and a pressure type water level sensor, the displacement sensor is arranged on a bedrock or a concrete base, the displacement sensor is used for monitoring displacement changes of the geologic body, the inclination sensor is attached to the surface of the geologic body, the inclination sensor is used for monitoring inclination conditions of the geologic body, the soil humidity sensor is buried in soil, the soil humidity sensor is used for measuring soil water content, the pressure type water level sensor is arranged in a karst cave ponding area, and the pressure type water level sensor is used for monitoring ponding amount of the karst cave ponding area.
assignees: Guanling Buyi and Miao Autonomous County Meteorological Bureau

title_en: Display panel, display device and vital sign monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention provides a display panel, a display device and a vital sign monitoring method, wherein the display panel comprises an array substrate, a color film substrate and a millimeter wave radar antenna array positioned between the color film substrate and the array substrate, the millimeter wave radar antenna array is at least partially positioned in a black matrix area of the color film substrate, and is electrically connected with a radar circuit through a conductive connection structure arranged in a frame of the display panel and used for transmitting millimeter wave signals under the control of the radar circuit and receiving millimeter wave echo signals reflected by a user in a detection area of the millimeter wave radar antenna array, and the millimeter wave echo signals are used for determining vital sign parameters of the user. Therefore, under the condition that an additional independent radar module and a windowing structure are not needed, the display panel is enabled to integrate a non-contact vital sign monitoring function, and the integration level and the light weight level of the whole machine are improved while the display effect is kept.

title_en: Life detection device of emergency rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle application and discloses an emergency rescue unmanned aerial vehicle life detection device which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, two groups of bottom beams, a supporting component, two groups of adjustable connecting pieces and a slider, wherein the two groups of bottom beams are arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the supporting component is detachably arranged between the two groups of bottom beams, the two groups of adjustable connecting pieces are arranged on the supporting component in a sliding mode, the relative positions of the two groups of adjustable connecting pieces on the supporting component are conveniently adjusted through the slider through the cooperation among the bottom beams, the supporting component and the adjustable connecting pieces, and then the relative distance between the two groups of connecting pieces is conveniently adjusted through the sliding of the connecting bolts in an adjusting groove, so that the positions of the connecting bolts can be conveniently and randomly adjusted, the connecting bolts can be conveniently matched with a damping device on a life detection radar device, the installation efficiency of the life detection radar device is improved, the installation and debugging difficulty of the life detection radar device is reduced, and the practicability is improved.
assignees: CHENGDU FENGYU ZHIHANG UNMANNED PLANE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hilbert transform-based millimeter wave radar heart rate estimation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a millimeter wave radar heart rate estimation method and device based on Hilbert transform, wherein the method utilizes a millimeter wave radar to collect echo data containing human chest wall tiny displacement information, positions chest wall positions and extracts phase information to obtain vital sign signals; and (3) processing the signals by adopting sliding time windows, solving an instantaneous phase in each window through improved Hilbert transformation, calculating candidate heart rate estimated values through slopes of regression fit straight lines on the basis of corresponding relations between time and phases periodically in the window sliding process, and carrying out time sequence constraint on the candidate heart rate values to inhibit isolated abnormal values and non-physiological jumps. The method uses improved Hilbert transformation, overcomes the problem of easy jump at two ends of a window in the conventional method, and combines a heart rate estimation method based on regression fitting and heart rate time sequence constraint to improve the accuracy and stability of heart rate estimation.

title_en: Through-wall radar respiratory signal detection method based on PCA and VMD
abstract_en: The invention discloses a through-wall radar respiratory signal detection method based on PCA and VMD, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out characteristic decomposition on an ultra-wideband radar echo data matrix after direct current component removal, then carrying out modal decomposition on a dynamic signal matrix after impurity removal in a slow time dimension, screening relevant modal components in a respiratory frequency range, reconstructing the screened modal components, carrying out Fourier transformation in the slow time dimension to construct a distance-frequency spectrogram, finally constructing a two-dimensional Gaussian template which accords with human respiratory spectrum characteristics and matching, and calculating the distance and frequency estimated value of human respiratory signals. The invention solves the problems of weak anti-interference capability and high false alarm probability of a single clutter suppression method, thereby realizing accurate respiratory signal detection in a strong clutter environment.

title_en: System for detecting and preventing school accidents using radar for biometric signal analysis and operating method thereof
title_ko: 생체신호 분석용 레이더를 이용한 학교내 사고 감지 및 예방 시스템 및 그 동작 방법
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a system for detecting and preventing school accidents, and the system according to an embodiment of the present disclosure may comprise: a first radar unit that extracts and detects a biometric signal from a surrounding area by using a radar signal and transmits the biometric signal and first location information associated with the biometric signal; a school safety server that receives and analyzes the biometric signal, determines, on the basis of the analysis, whether an abnormal situation has occurred, when the abnormal situation has occurred, determines an incident type of the abnormal situation, and generates, on the basis of the determination, an incident occurrence signal including the first location information and transmits same; and an imaging unit that is movably installed, upon receiving the incident occurrence signal, moves to a first location corresponding to the first location information, and generates image data in which the abnormal situation is recorded and transmits same to the school safety server.
abstract_ko: 본 개시는 학교내 사고 감지 및 예방 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 개시의 일 실시예에 따른 시스템은, 레이더 신호를 이용하여 주변 영역에서 생체신호를 추출하여 감지하고, 상기 생체신호와 연관된 제1 위치정보 및 상기 생체신호를 전송하는 제1 레이더부, 상기 생체신호를 수신하여 분석하고, 이에 기초하여 이상사태의 발생여부를 판단하고, 이상사태가 발생한 경우, 상기 이상사태의 사건유형을 판단하고, 이에 기초하여 상기 제1 위치정보를 포함하는 사건발생신호를 생성하고 전송하는 교내안전서버, 및 이동 가능하도록 설치되고, 상기 사건발생신호를 수신하면 상기 제1 위치정보에 해당하는 제1 위치로 이동하고, 상기 이상사태를 기록한 화상데이터를 생성하여 상기 교내안전서버로 전송하는 촬영부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Distributed detection of living beings through walls while in motion
abstract_en: A system comprises: first through-wall sensing radar transceiver(s) configured to sense living being(s) within area at first current location; second through-wall sensing radar transceiver(s) configured to sense living being(s) within area at second current location; first and second inertial navigation systems corresponding to first and second through-wall sensing radar transceivers, wherein first and second inertial navigation systems compute position data relating to first and second current locations; and circuitry configured to: receive first ranging data pertaining to current location of living being(s) relative to first current location from first through-wall sensing radar transceiver(s); receive second ranging data pertaining to current location of living being(s) relative to second current location from second through-wall sensing radar transceiver(s); receive position data relating to first and second current locations from first and/or second inertial navigation systems; and determine current location of living being(s) based on first ranging data, second ranging data, and position data.

title_en: Heart rate estimating method and device based on millimeter wave radar multichannel combination
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of millimeter wave radar non-contact vital sign monitoring, and particularly relates to a heart rate estimation method and device based on millimeter wave radar multichannel combination, which comprises the following steps that firstly, a chest echo signal is synchronously acquired by a millimeter wave radar based on multichannel frequency modulation continuous wave FMCW, a distance bin containing a vital signal is extracted from the echo signal through a distance FFT, and a multichannel phase signal is obtained by preprocessing; secondly, constructing a multichannel signal joint optimization objective function, combining a multichannel phase signal to perform modal decomposition, adaptively determining an initial center frequency of modal decomposition according to peak values fused by multichannel signal spectrums and peak values with large energy, performing iterative update based on the objective function to obtain an optimal heart rate modal sequence, and finally screening a final heart rate modal from the heart rate modal sequence according to an energy maximum principle, and outputting the center frequency of the screened heart rate modal as a heart rate value to realize heart rate estimation.

title_en: GPR target detection method integrating proxy model and dimension reduction
