abstract_en: The invention relates to a GPR (general purpose computing) target detection method integrating a proxy model and dimension reduction, which comprises the steps of adopting a B spline to draw the outline of a target body and define the minimum dimension, adopting the number of points, relative dielectric constant and conductivity of the B spline as model parameters, simulating target scattering echo data by using FDTD-based method simulation software GprMax, adopting a forward modeling part to perform dimension reduction processing on the GPR data to obtain a corresponding main component weight coefficient and serve as the output of the proxy model, constructing a network circulation proxy model based on a radial basis RBF, replacing complex target function calculation by constructing an approximate model, accelerating population convergence and improving optimization efficiency, realizing rapid forward modeling of the GPR scattering echo data, integrating a proxy model strategy by a particle swarm algorithm, solving nonlinear microwave backscattering problem and realizing precise inversion of the shape and position of a buried target.

title_en: Pipeline leakage point detection method, device and equipment integrating thermal response and earthquake waves
abstract_en: The invention provides a pipeline leakage point detection method, device and equipment integrating thermal response and earthquake waves, and relates to the technical field of underground pipeline leakage detection. The method comprises the steps of obtaining seismic wave signals and space-time thermal response data obtained by detecting an underground pipeline, inputting the space-time thermal response data into a space-time convolutional neural network to conduct space-time feature extraction to obtain a thermal field change mode of the underground pipeline, inputting the thermal field change mode into a physical information neural network to conduct inversion to obtain first leakage source information of the underground pipeline, wherein the physical information neural network uses a heat conduction equation as a hard constraint, conducting inversion on the seismic wave signals to obtain second leakage source information of the underground pipeline, and determining leakage point detection results of the underground pipeline based on the first leakage source information and the second leakage source information. The invention can realize the omnibearing accurate sensing of the deep buried leakage point from the space position to the leakage state, and improves the detection depth and the positioning precision.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY INTER CITY PLANNING CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Vital sign simulation equipment and interference signal generation system
abstract_en: The invention provides vital sign simulation equipment and an interference signal generation system, wherein the equipment comprises a controller, a displacement generation unit and a displacement generation unit, wherein the controller is used for generating a control signal according to vital sign simulation parameters, the displacement generation unit is connected with the controller and is used for generating periodic displacement according to the control signal sent by the controller, the vital sign simulation parameters comprise heart beat parameters or/and breathing parameters, and the problem that the biological radar test equipment in the prior art lacks standard test equipment and cannot evaluate the accuracy of products in the quality inspection test process is solved.
assignees: JIAXING HUIHE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: A method and an arrangement for monitoring
abstract_en: An arrangement and a method for observing presence, location, movement and/or attitude of one or more persons in a monitored area with an arrangement comprising at least one sensor (101, 201, 401, 501), measuring electronics and a processor configured to process the sensor data. The at least one sensor (101, 201, 401, 501) is a radar-based sensor, such as frequency-modulated continuous-wave MIMO radar-based sensor, and the arrangement measures with the at least one sensor (101, 201, 401, 501) the area to be monitored, and determines the presence, location, movement and/or attitude of the person. The arrangement has a first operating mode and a second operating mode, and in the first operating mode the arrangement detects falling of a person (206, 402, 502) and/or measures vital signs of the person (206, 402, 502), such as heartbeat and/or breathing of the person (206, 402, 502), in the monitored area with the at least one sensor (101, 201, 401, 501) and sends an alarm if the person (206, 402, 502) has been determined as fallen and/or vital signs of the person (206, 402, 502) are not within the predefined limits, and in the second operating mode the sensor (101, 201, 401, 501) and/or the arrangement detects presence and/or location of a person (206, 402, 502) in the monitored 5 area with the at least one sensor (101, 201, 401, 501) and sends an alarm if a person (206, 402, 502) is present in the monitored area when the second operating mode is in use.

title_en: Life detection information presentation method, equipment and medium based on radar detection and depth analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a life detection information presentation method, equipment and medium based on radar detection and depth analysis, and relates to the technical field of radar detection and information processing. The method comprises the steps of processing and imaging an original echo signal, carrying out image enhancement on an obtained amplitude image, carrying out target detection through a deep learning model, carrying out time sequence optimization and track tracking on a detection result by combining a target state memory bank and a Kalman filter, outputting actual position information of a target with dynamic and static attributes, carrying out clustering and confidence assessment on a static target, carrying out track clustering and second-level behavior recognition on the dynamic target, and finally, synchronously presenting the information on a display control interface in a form of association of graphical marks and semantic text description. The invention solves the problems of single information presentation, insufficient analysis and non-traceability of the traditional life detection radar, and obviously improves the detection accuracy, the information reading depth and the system usability.

title_en: Water storage device with water quantity detection mechanism for forest fire prevention
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water storage device for forest fire prevention with a water quantity detection mechanism, which comprises a water storage tank and a cement pool, wherein the water storage tank and the cement pool are buried under the ground, a water outlet is arranged in the center of the inner wall of the bottom of the cement pool, the water outlet is communicated with the inside of the water storage tank through a water outlet pipe, a water quantity detection control mechanism is arranged on one side of the water storage tank, and a filtering water storage mechanism is arranged in the cement pool. According to the utility model, the water storage tank and the cement pool are buried under the ground, so that the occupied space of the water storage device can be saved, direct irradiation of sunlight is reduced, evaporation of a water source is greatly reduced, water resources are saved, the water level sensor monitors the water quantity in the water storage tank, the external rainfall is small, water can be supplemented through tap water for water storage, when rainfall is abundant, the cement pool can collect rainfall of forests, and water sources are provided for the water storage tank through filtering sediment, so that the consumption of surface water resources is reduced.
assignees: ZHANGJIAKOU SAILIN FORESTRY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Millimeter wave radar vital sign monitoring method and system based on VMD
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of non-contact vital sign monitoring, and discloses a millimeter wave radar vital sign monitoring method and system based on a VMD, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining sample data containing vital signs; the method comprises the steps of performing multi-feature fusion analysis to obtain a frequency band energy ratio, a frequency spectrum entropy, a signal to noise ratio estimation and a peak value concentration degree of vital signs, judging whether the frequency band energy ratio, the frequency spectrum entropy, the signal to noise ratio estimation and the peak value concentration degree of the vital signs meet preset conditions or not to match corresponding punishment factors and decomposition layers in a grading mode, decomposing the inching signals by a VMD algorithm to obtain a plurality of sample components, performing multi-feature weighted scoring on the sample components, screening the sample components by a bidirectional interference suppression strategy to obtain target signals, reconstructing the vital sign signals based on the target signals, and outputting monitoring results. The method has the effect of improving the monitoring precision and timeliness of vital signs in a real-time processing scene.

title_en: Slope landslide early warning device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of slope early warning, in particular to a slope landslide early warning device which comprises a detection assembly, wherein the detection assembly comprises a plurality of detection rods, the detection rods are connected in sequence, two adjacent detection rods are movably connected through a ball connector, a plurality of tension sensors are arranged between the two adjacent detection rods, the tension sensors are arranged around the ball connector, one end of each tension sensor is fixed on one detection rod, the other end of each tension sensor is connected with a tension spring, one end of each tension spring, which is far away from the tension sensor, is connected to the other detection rod, one end of each detection assembly is used for being buried in a slope, the other end of each detection assembly is provided with a slope detector for detecting a surface, and the slope detector and the tension sensors are connected with batteries for supplying power. The application has the effect of early warning when landslide occurs in the side slope.
assignees: HENAN KEDA WATER CONSERVANCY SURVEY AND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Lightweight millimeter wave vital sign measurement method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a lightweight millimeter wave vital sign measurement method, a system, equipment and a medium, which relate to the technical field of millimeter wave radar application, and the method generates a human body reflection energy factor by fusing a echo energy characteristic and a micro-motion energy characteristic, and inputs the human body reflection energy factor into a lightweight deep learning network, so that high-precision joint discrimination of the existence state of personnel and the human body distance is realized; after confirming personnel existence, carrying out multistage filtering and unwrapping processing by combining phase signals of corresponding range gates to obtain smooth continuous phase signals so as to effectively support stable extraction of follow-up vital sign parameters, further, constructing self-adaptive harmonic spectrum based on instantaneous respiratory frequency and human body distance, precisely removing interference caused by respiratory higher harmonic from heartbeat components, remarkably improving accuracy of heart rate estimation, avoiding invalid calculation in an unmanned state, and considering measurement accuracy and system efficiency.

title_en: Intelligent lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent lamp, which comprises a lamp structural main body, an LED light-emitting module, a millimeter wave detector for detecting heartbeat and respiratory signals of a human body, and a wireless controller for receiving and processing acquisition signals of the millimeter wave detector. By integrating the millimeter wave radar detector and the wireless transmission controller into the lamp, the integration of the lighting and vital sign monitoring functions is realized. The intelligent lamp is arranged near a sickbed, and the millimeter wave radar technology is utilized to detect the micro motion of the chest of a human body, so that heartbeat and respiratory signals are extracted, and the uninterrupted heart rate and respiratory monitoring of 24 hours of personnel on the sickbed is realized. The built-in wireless transmission controller is responsible for receiving the original data acquired by the millimeter wave detector, performing preliminary processing and analysis, and transmitting the processed data to the mobile device or the cloud platform through wireless. When in use, the device is not required to be worn, is convenient and comfortable, is particularly suitable for patients lying in bed for a long time, and can be also applied to the scenes such as families, nursing homes and the like.
assignees: HUIZHOU ZHENGYUAN LIGHTING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device and method for generating user-customized multi-angle highlights using biosignal analysis
title_ko: 생체신호 분석을 이용한 사용자 맞춤형 멀티앵글 하이라이트 생성 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 실시예들은 생체신호 분석을 이용한 사용자 맞춤형 멀티앵글 하이라이트 생성 장치 및 방법을 제공한다. 실시예에 따른 장치는, 사용자를 촬영하도록 설치되는 복수의 카메라를 포함하는 촬영 시스템; 사용자의 생체신호를 포함하는 센싱데이터를 수집하는 센서 장치; 및 상기 촬영 시스템으로부터 원본영상데이터를 수신하고 상기 센서 장치로부터 상기 센싱데이터를 수신하여 개인맞춤형 하이라이트 최종영상을 생성하는 전자장치;를 포함하되, 상기 센서 장치는 심박센서, 피부전도도센서, 가속도센서, 자이로센서 중 적어도 하나를 포함하고, 상기 전자장치는, 상기 센싱데이터를 기설정된 임계값과 비교하여 사용자의 감정상태를 인식하고, 상기 인식된 감정상태를 기초로 감정가중치를 산출하는 영상 전처리부; 상기 원본영상데이터를 복수의 시간 구간으로 분할하고, 각 시간 구간에 상기 감정가중치를 매핑하되, 상기 감정가중치가 기설정된 임계치 이상인 시간 구간의 프레임들을 하이라이트 후보 프레임으로 선정하고 상기 감정가중치가 높은 순서대로 시간 구간을 정렬하여 상위 기설정된 비율의 구간을 선택하여 감정반영 연속프레임세트를 생성하는 영상 관리부; 및 상기 감정반영 연속프레임세트를 기초로 하이라이트 최종영상을 생성하여 사용자 단말로 전송하는 통신부;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Animal vital sign measurement method based on millimeter wave radar, applied device and pet collar
abstract_en: The invention discloses an animal vital sign measurement method based on millimeter wave radar, an applied device and a pet collar, wherein the method comprises the steps of adopting the millimeter wave radar to collect radar data of a pet target area, dynamically locking an echo zone of the target area according to the body type of the pet in the collection process, and separating the target area from the millimeter wave radar by a certain distance; the method comprises the steps of eliminating environmental noise and motion artifacts in radar data by adopting a band-pass filter, retaining effective signals in the range of 0.2-5Hz, then carrying out sliding window segmentation on the radar data, extracting heart rate signals and respiratory signals from the segmented radar data, inputting the extracted heart rate signals and respiratory signals into a trained measuring model, and outputting predicted values of heart rate and respiratory frequency in real time. The invention collects signals and removes environmental noise and motion artifacts in the signals through the millimeter wave radar, solves the problems of low measurement precision and the like caused by the length Mao Zhedang of the pet and the high-frequency circadian rhythm, and can accurately measure the heart rate and the respiratory rate of the pet in real time.

title_en: Deep complex space environment monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep complex space environment monitoring method which comprises the following steps of constructing a deep WiFi 6E+mesh ad hoc network communication and collection node network, cooperatively collecting multidimensional data, collecting environment parameters, vital sign data, communication state data and equipment power supply state data, carrying out relay transmission on Mesh ad hoc network data, and carrying out ground data processing and scheduling support. The method has the advantages that the WiFi 6E and Mesh ad hoc network architecture is adopted, a fixed wired link is not needed, or high-cost base stations are not needed to be deployed densely, the deep topology dynamic change can be dealt with through the bidirectional redundant link of the Mesh protocol, the electromagnetic interference resistance can be enhanced by means of the 6GHz frequency band of the WiFi 6E, meanwhile, access of mobile equipment such as rescue robots and portable terminals is supported, the problems that an existing wired scheme is slow in repair, the wireless scheme is high in cost and the low-power consumption scheme is insufficient in bandwidth are solved, and instantaneity and flexibility of deep emergency communication are considered.
assignees: SHENDI SCIENCE AND ENG YUNLONG LAKE LABORATORY;UNIV XUZHOU MEDICAL

title_en: Underslung unmanned aerial vehicle aeromagnetic vertical vector measurement system for detecting humanoid magnetic source object in emergency rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a down-hanging unmanned aerial vehicle aeromagnetic vertical vector measurement system for detecting a humanoid magnetic source object in emergency rescue, the system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle platform module, a magnetic probe rod and driving module, a sensor module, a data acquisition processing module, a data transmission module and a ground terminal module. The invention has the beneficial effects that the probe of the high-sensitivity light pump atomic vector magnetometer is hung below the unmanned aerial vehicle by adopting the actively telescopic magnetic probe rod, the probe can be lowered to the ground-near height for work, and the detection sensitivity of the shallow weak magnetic target is improved. Through the airborne computing platform based on the ROS, magnetometer data, unmanned aerial vehicle RTK positioning data and attitude data are synchronously acquired, and high-precision time alignment and fusion processing are carried out. The ground terminal provides various visual displays such as a real-time magnetic anomaly contour map, a magnetic anomaly profile map and the like. The technical problems that an existing unmanned aerial vehicle magnetic measurement system is insufficient in detection sensitivity of a shallow-buried small-scale humanoid magnetic source target, poor in low-altitude operation safety and insufficient in multi-source data fusion processing are solved.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RESEARCH INST OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN

title_en: Intelligent vital sign monitoring method, system and device based on migration learning mechanism and UWB radar
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent vital sign monitoring method, system and device based on a migration learning mechanism and UWB radar, and relates to the technical field of radar signal processing and medical health monitoring, and the technical key points are that the monitoring method and system of the invention pre-trains a deep neural network model on simulation radar data by generating the simulation radar data so as to enable the simulation radar data to learn the basic characteristics of vital sign signals; and then, the pre-training model is finely adjusted by using a small amount of acquired real UWB radar data, so that knowledge of the pre-training model is migrated and adapted to the current specific scene and individuals, and the effect of training a large amount of data is achieved by using a small amount of real data. The invention uses the simulation data to complement the deficiency of the real data, and enables the model to be rapidly adapted to the new monitoring environment and the target individual through the migration learning mechanism, thereby finally achieving the non-contact vital sign monitoring with high accuracy, high stability and high practicability.

title_en: Polyaniline-based multi-mode thermoelectric sensor for environmental hazard and vital sign monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a polyaniline multi-mode thermoelectric sensor for monitoring environmental hazard and vital signs. The sensor comprises a composite thermoelectric functional layer formed by polyaniline and a carbon material, wherein the carbon material is used as a flexible conductive substrate, and polyaniline grows on the carbon material in situ in an electrochemical deposition mode to form a stable polyaniline/carbon composite structure. The self-powered temperature sensing of the environmental temperature difference is realized based on the Seebeck effect of the composite material, meanwhile, the pressure sensing function is realized by utilizing the high specific surface area of the carbon material and the resistance change characteristic caused by stress of the carbon material, and the detection of the gas and the pH environment is realized by further combining the reversible doping/dedoping behavior of polyaniline. The sensor realizes multi-parameter collaborative monitoring of temperature, pressure, chemical environment and the like in a single material system, has the characteristics of simple structure, good flexibility and self-power supply, and is suitable for the fields of complex environment monitoring and vital sign sensing.

title_en: Explosion-proof device and system that spouts
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of steel slag treatment equipment, in particular to an anti-blowout device and an anti-blowout system. The explosion-proof spraying device comprises a silo, a cut-off valve group and a sensor, wherein the silo is provided with a containing cavity and an opening, the containing cavity is used for containing materials, the opening is opposite to an automobile trunk, the cut-off valve group is in movable fit with the silo and is used for closing or opening the opening, the sensor is arranged at the opening, and/or the sensor is arranged below the opening, the sensor is electrically connected with the cut-off valve group, and the sensor is used for detecting the moving speed of the materials. The explosion-proof spraying device can prevent materials from suddenly collapsing or spraying, and avoid safety accidents such as buried vehicles, casualties and the like.
assignees: GUANGDONG HUAXIN ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Radar heartbeat signal detection based on prt model shaping
abstract_en: In radar heartbeat signal detection based on PRT model shaping, a vital-sign signal including a heartbeat component and a respiration component is detected by a radar and sent to a computing device which is electrically connected to the radar, the computing device extracts the heartbeat component from the vital-sign signal to obtain a radar heartbeat signal and segments the radar heartbeat signal into two or more one-cycle radar heartbeat signals, and the computing device multiply each of the one-cycle radar heartbeat signal with a PRT model and connects the one-cycle radar heartbeat signals as a shaped radar heartbeat signal.

title_en: Geological operation-oriented real-time monitoring method and device for mental fatigue of operators
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time monitoring method and device for mental fatigue of operators facing geological operations, comprising the steps of S1, determining layout of a measured target and a millimeter wave radar, S2, acquiring a millimeter wave radar intermediate frequency echo, extracting complex phases of corresponding distance information after the measured target is positioned by a distance domain, performing phase expansion and steady state correction to obtain a continuous phase sequence representing chest micro-displacement, S3, applying IIR digital band-pass filtering to the continuous phase sequence and decoupling the continuous phase sequence to form a respiratory channel and a heartbeat channel, S4, extracting time domain and frequency domain features of heart rate variability HRV and respiratory rhythm from the respiratory channel and the heartbeat channel in a sliding time window to form a multidimensional vital sign feature vector set, S5, performing incremental learning by using an OS-ELM and judging and outputting mental fatigue grade in real time, S6, implementing hierarchical risk management, triggering early warning and intervention measures, and S7, performing local storage and visual display on fatigue grade and event log and synchronizing to a remote management platform.
assignees: CHINA CONSTR CIVIL ENG CO LTD;UNIV HONG KONG POLYTECHNIC

title_en: Ultra-wideband through-wall radar wall parameter measurement method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for measuring ultra-wideband through-wall radar wall parameters, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of S1, data acquisition and input of a hardware part; S2, clutter and noise suppression, S3, data imaging, S4, parameter identification and output. The method optimizes the characteristic enhancement technology and the high-precision recognition technology of the aiming through-wall radar human body activity recognition, obtains parameters more quickly, calculates more accurately, and has better excellent performance.
assignees: SUZHOU RED POLICE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-Channel Radar Apparatus and Control Method for Detecting Humans Trapped in the Subsurface
title_ko: 매몰자 탐지용 다채널 레이다 장치 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 매몰자 탐지용 다채널 레이다 장치 및 그 제어 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 다채널 레이다 장치는, 지하 매질로 펄스 신호를 방사하기 위한 펄스 발생기, 지하 매질로 연속파(CW) 신호를 방사하기 위한 연속파 발생기, 및 펄스 신호 또는 연속파 신호 중 선택된 신호가 공급되어 지하로 방사되는 광대역 송신 안테나를 포함하는 송신부, 지하 매질에서 반사되어 수신된 펄스 반사신호를 샘플링 및 양자화하는 펄스 샘플러, 지하 매질에서 반사되어 수신된 연속파 반사신호의 주파수 변이를 감지하는 도플러 감지기, 및 펄스 반사신호 또는 연속파 반사신호 중 선택된 신호가 공급되는 광대역 수신 안테나를 포함하는 수신부 및 지하 공동 탐지를 위한 펄스 레이다 모드와 생명 신호 탐지를 위한 연속파 레이다 모드 사이의 전환을 제어하고, 펄스 레이다 모드에서 획득된 펄스 반사신호를 이용하여 정해진 지하 공동의 상부 위치에서 연속파 레이다 모드를 실행하여 연속파 반사신호를 수집하도록 제어하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Self-powered multi-parameter wearable health monitoring system and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wearable equipment, and discloses a self-powered multi-parameter wearable health monitoring system and a working method thereof, wherein the self-powered multi-parameter wearable health monitoring system comprises a dual-mode self-powered module, a DC-DC voltage stabilizing chip and a power supply module, wherein the dual-mode self-powered module is used for generating and outputting electric energy to the DC-DC voltage stabilizing chip; the intelligent health monitoring system comprises a multi-mode sensor array, an edge AI processing unit, a dynamic power consumption management module, a power consumption scheduling instruction generation and transmission device, wherein the multi-mode sensor array is used for acquiring a plurality of preset vital sign index information and environment data, the edge AI processing unit is used for carrying out AI reasoning according to the plurality of vital sign index information and the environment data to generate and output health risk assessment results, the dynamic power consumption management module is used for acquiring the input power of a DC-DC voltage stabilizing chip and the current power consumption of a system and generating and transmitting a power consumption scheduling instruction to the multi-mode sensor array and the edge AI processing unit according to the input power of the DC-DC voltage stabilizing chip and the current power consumption of the system.

title_en: Petrochemical site safety intelligent management platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of petrochemical safety production management, in particular to a petrochemical site safety intelligent management platform which comprises a sensing layer, a transmission layer, a data layer, an application layer and a display layer, wherein all the layers are cooperated to realize the whole flow coverage of the petrochemical site safety management, the sensing layer is provided with a positioning terminal, health monitoring equipment, behavior identification equipment and environment monitoring equipment and is used for collecting personnel positions, health data, operation behaviors and environment parameters, and the transmission layer adopts a 5G private network, a WIFI local area network and ZigBeePlus wireless communication modules to realize the high-speed stable data transmission of the sensing layer and the data layer. According to the invention, through ZigBeePlus three-dimensional positioning technology, the positioning precision of personnel can reach the meter level, the specific position of personnel in an equipment area and a limited space can be accurately mastered, the vital sign watch is associated with position data in real time, when the personnel is in a health abnormality or in a dangerous area, the system can rapidly trigger early warning and lock the position, the rescue response time is shortened by more than 50%, and the casualties risk is greatly reduced.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGYAN CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: System and method for monitoring patient risk by using bio-signal obtained in non-contact type
title_ko: 비접촉 방식으로 획득한 생체신호를 이용한 환자 위험도 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for monitoring patient risks by using bio-signals obtained in a non-contact type. According to the present invention, an apparatus for automatically collecting bio-signals comprises the steps of: periodically emitting radar toward a patient; measuring the heart rate and the respiration rate of the patient by using radar signals reflected from the patient; measuring the body temperature of the patient by using an infrared body temperature measurement sensor; estimating the blood pressure of the patient by using the heart rate; estimating the electrocardiogram and the oxygen saturation of the patient by using the heart rate and the blood pressure value; and predicting the risk of a severe disease of the patient by using the heart rate, the respiration rate, the blood pressure, the body temperature, the electrocardiogram, and the oxygen saturation. The apparatus may further comprise a step of delivering an alarm signal to an external terminal if the predicted risk is greater than a reference value.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비접촉 방식으로 획득한 생체신호를 이용한 환자 위험도 모니터링 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면 생체신호 자동 수집 장치는 환자를 향하여 레이더를 주기적으로 조사하는 단계, 환자로부터 반사된 레이더 신호를 이용하여 환자의 심박수와 호흡수를 측정하는 단계, 적외선 체온 측정 센서를 이용하여 환자의 체온을 측정하는 단계, 심박수를 이용하여 환자의 혈압을 추정하는 단계, 심박수와 혈압 값을 이용하여 환자의 심전도와 산소포화도를 추정하는 단계, 그리고 상기 심박수, 호흡수, 혈압, 체온, 심전도 및 산소포화도를 이용하여 환자의 중증질환에 대한 위험도를 예측하는 단계를 포함하고, 예측된 위험도가 기준값보다 크면 외부 단말로 알람 신호를 전달하는 단계를 더 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Correlation elimination method for multi-robot co-location
abstract_en: A correlation elimination method for multi-robot co-location belongs to the field of multi-robot co-location. The method solves the problem that the existing method cannot guarantee the coexistence of communication requirements and estimation consistency and positioning accuracy. The method comprises the steps of establishing a kinematic model, establishing a sliding window state model, establishing an absolute measurement model when a robot detects a landmark, storing corresponding measurement information, a jacobian matrix and a noise covariance matrix, establishing a relative measurement model when other robots are detected, projecting the relative measurement model onto the left zero space of the measured jacobian matrix of the detected robot to construct a pseudo absolute measurement model, storing information, the jacobian matrix and the noise covariance matrix of the pseudo absolute measurement model, stacking the measurement information, the jacobian matrix and the noise covariance matrix, and updating the state estimation and the covariance matrix of the robot. The method is used for the fields of disaster search and rescue, agricultural inspection, underwater exploration and the like.

title_en: Complex terrain-oriented unmanned aerial vehicle group collaborative searching and positioning method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of emergency search and rescue, and discloses a complex terrain-oriented unmanned aerial vehicle group collaborative search and positioning method, which comprises the following steps of S1, a ground control station is used for calling three-dimensional terrain data of a target city mountain park from a prestored park geographic information database, receiving initial information of a non-connected target sent by a case reporting terminal through a mobile communication network, and storing the two types of data in a local task database in an associated manner, and S2, the ground control station is used for calling a terrain analysis module to process the three-dimensional terrain data in the S1, and calculating real-time gradient values and vegetation coverage rates of all areas. Through the fine area division based on gradient and vegetation coverage, the precise adaptation of unmanned aerial vehicle type and sub-area characteristics is combined, the directional distribution of search resources is realized, the resource waste of a conventional road section and a complex area is avoided, meanwhile, the effective search coverage of complex terrain is improved through global path planning and multi-machine collaborative coverage, and the discovery time of a loss target is obviously shortened.

title_en: Deformable search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a deformable search and rescue robot, and belongs to the technical field of search and rescue robots. The robot comprises a machine body and three-section crawler travelling mechanisms arranged on two sides of the machine body, wherein the three-section crawler travelling mechanisms consist of fixed crawler travelling mechanisms and movable crawler travelling mechanisms. The movable crawler belt travelling mechanism realizes independent rotation adjustment through the angle adjusting component, and can adjust the inclination angle according to the terrain requirement, so that the robot can adapt to complex terrains such as stairs, ruins and the like. The differential diameter design of the driving wheel and the driven wheel improves obstacle surmounting capability and steering flexibility. The utility model has compact structure and simple and convenient control, and can effectively improve the terrain adaptability and the search and rescue efficiency of the robot in disaster sites.

title_en: Survivor search system in disaster situations and its operation method
title_ko: 재난 상황에서의 생존자 탐색 시스템 및 그 동작 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 재난 상황에서의 생존자 탐색 시스템은, 탐색 대상 영역에 설치될 복수의 무선 음향 센서; 상기 각 무선 음향 센서가 수집한 음향 데이터와 해당 무선 음향 센서의 식별 정보를 수집하고, 각 무선 음향 센서의 음향 데이터와 상기 무선 음향 센서의 식별 정보에 매칭되는 위치 정보를 생존자 탐색 수행 장치로 전송하는 컨트롤 장치 및 상기 컨트롤 장치가 전송하는 각 무선 음향 센서의 음향 데이터와 위치 정보를 생존자 탐색 학습 모델에 입력하여 생존자의 위치를 추정하는 생존자 탐색 수행 장치를 포함하되, 상기 생존자 탐색 학습 모델은, 서로 다른 위치에 배치된 적어도 3개 이상의 무선 음향 센서를 통해 센싱된 음향 데이터 세트, 각 무선 음향 센서의 위치 정보 및 해당 음향 데이터 세트에 매칭된 정답 위치 정보를 포함하는 복수의 학습 데이터에 기초하여, 생존자 위치를 추론하도록 학습된 것이다

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle lighting device searches for and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle lighting device, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles and comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein one end of the top of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is provided with an adjustable lighting component, the use angle of an adjusting seat is adjusted by rotating a rotating shaft in a rotating seat, a battery cavity is arranged to supply power to a first lighting lamp, a limiting piece is arranged to connect the battery cavity with the first lighting lamp to limit, the use angle of the first lighting lamp can be adjusted to conveniently perform the action of omnibearing lighting on a scene when the unmanned aerial vehicle body flies to a search site, a guide frame is connected with the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body through four arranged mounting bolts, the use protectiveness of a second lighting lamp and two third lighting lamps is improved by virtue of a guide frame, an L-shaped supporting plate is arranged to install the second lighting lamp by virtue of a locking disc, and a battery is arranged in each of a protective cylinder and the installation cylinder to supply power to the second lighting lamp and the two third lighting lamps.
assignees: WUHAN TOP XINKE UNMANNED AERIAL VEHICLE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Four-degree-of-freedom search and rescue lamp for emergency rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of search and rescue lamps, in particular to a four-degree-of-freedom search and rescue lamp for emergency rescue, which comprises a three-degree-of-freedom platform capable of ascending and descending, tilting forwards and backwards and tilting leftwards and rightwards, wherein a rotary platform mechanism is fixedly arranged at the moving end of the three-degree-of-freedom platform, a lamp holder is fixedly arranged at the moving end of the rotary platform mechanism, a searchlight is fixedly arranged on the lamp holder, a high-definition camera for transmitting rescue pictures in real time, a thermal imaging camera for searching rescue targets in dark environment and a laser range finder for detecting the distance of the rescue targets are respectively fixedly arranged on the searchlight.
assignees: NANJING ALL CONTROLLER AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue, in particular to a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein a fixed plate is arranged at the middle position of the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, an annular plate is arranged at the bottom of the fixed plate, a hemispherical protection cover is fixed at the bottom of the annular plate, the protection cover is arranged in a transparent manner, a camera module is arranged on the fixed plate in the protection cover, the camera module is arranged downwards, a thermoelectric cooling sheet is arranged on the fixed plate in the protection cover at a position staggered with the camera module, and the hot end of the thermoelectric cooling sheet faces the inner side of the protection cover. According to the utility model, the camera module for search and rescue is isolated by using the protective cover, then the thermoelectric refrigerating sheet is used for heating in the protective cover, and the protective cover is heated to separate from the dew point temperature, so that the condition that the camera module images are influenced by moisture condensation in a high-humidity environment is avoided.
assignees: SHANDONG YUNSHENCHU GENERAL AVIATION SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: robot prevention for mud flat accident
title_ko: 갯벌 사고 예방용 로봇
assignees: REPUBLIC OF KOREA KOREA COAST GUARD DIRECTOR OF THE KOREA COAST GUARD RES CENTER;AMTEC CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle matched emergency rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of emergency rescue unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to an emergency rescue device matched with an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein a small rescue machine is arranged above the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, a loading box is arranged below the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, the small rescue machine is connected with the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle through a release mechanism, and the loading box is connected with the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle through a throwing mechanism. The unmanned aerial vehicle matched emergency rescue device provided by the utility model not only can realize the material transportation of the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, but also can carry the small rescue machine to search and rescue, is small and flexible in the small rescue machine in charge of searching and rescue, is quick and effective in release, is compact in structure, is convenient to operate, has comprehensive functions, can realize shouting, signal construction, image transmission and the like, and has a wide application prospect.

title_en: Wheel leg type emergency rescue robot integrated with unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a wheel leg type emergency rescue robot of an integrated unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a four-rotor flying unit and a wheel leg robot unit. The four-rotor flying unit comprises four propellers (11), a flying motor (12) correspondingly connected with the propellers (11), a horn (13) connected with the flying motor (12), a frame (17) and a top plate (18) fixed at the top of the frame (17), wherein the wheel-leg robot unit is provided with a wheel-leg main body (24), a wheel-leg structure (22) connected with the main body (24) and a steering engine (23) for driving the wheel-leg structure to act, a camera (14) is fixed on the four-rotor flying unit through a bracket (15), and an XT90 plug (16) is arranged on the frame (17). The invention has the capability of aerial investigation and flexible rescue of complex ground terrain.

title_en: Multi-band fusion imaging device for dense smoke detection search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multiband fusion imaging device for detecting, searching and rescuing dense smoke, which relates to the technical field of fire emergency rescue equipment and comprises a core main board, wherein a system switch and a function switch are welded on one side of the core main board, an infrared thermal imaging module, a visible light imaging module and a near infrared active illumination module are electrically connected on one side of the core main board side by side, the urgent need of complicated scene of a fire environment can not be satisfied completely, the utility model discloses the system innovatively combines visible light, infrared thermal imaging and near infrared initiative lighting technology, relies on high performance domestic ARM+NPU computing power platform, provides the fused image that has heat radiation characteristic and visible light detail concurrently, and possesses the end-to-end processing delay that is less than 50ms and the wireless image transmission delay within 200ms, has ensured real-time and the accuracy of information, provides panorama visual perception ability for the firefighter.

title_en: Multi-joint mechanical arm structure of search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a multi-joint mechanical arm structure of a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a frame, wherein connecting seats are fixedly arranged at two ends of the left side and the right side of the frame, through grooves are formed in the connecting seats, the through grooves are rotationally connected with one side of a first mechanical arm through a first rotating column, the other side of the first mechanical arm is connected with a second mechanical arm, a fixed seat is fixedly arranged on one side of the second mechanical arm, a fixed plate is fixedly arranged on the first mechanical arm, a second rotating column is arranged in the fixed plate, the second rotating column is rotationally connected with the rotating plate on one side of the second mechanical arm, and the unmanned aerial vehicle arm can be folded and contracted by arranging the connecting seats and the first and second mechanical arms, so that the whole structure is obviously reduced, the unmanned aerial vehicle is convenient to carry and store, quick deployment is realized, and the rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: System and method for water rescue using autonomous driving robot
title_ko: 수상구조 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 기술은 수상 구조시스템 및 방법이 개시되어 있다. 이러한 본 기술의 구체적인 구현 예에 따르면, 사용자 단말의 스마트 앱 제어를 통해 구동되는 카메라를 통해 익수자의 위치를 도출하고 도출된 익수자위치를 수상구조 로봇에 제공하고 수상구조로봇에 의거 익수자의 위치로 자율주행 후 익수자의 정면에서 구명튜브를 팽창시켜 익수자를 구조함에 따라 수상에서 발생되는 사고를 신속하게 감지할 수 있고 안전하게 인명 구조를 수행할 수 있고, 익수자위치를 추적함에 따라 익수자의 위치에 따라 수상구조 로봇의 이동경로를 재설정할 수 있고, 이에 수상사고에 대한 구조 정확도를 높일 수 있고 관계기관의 긴급 출동을 유도하여 수상구조 속도를 향상시킬 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: HANBAT NATIONAL UNIV INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Method and apparatus for using thermal imaging and augmented reality
abstract_en: A method for using Augmented Reality (AR), in conjunction with a real or simulated thermal imager. A primary application is to train emergency first responders. Particularly, the system uses a thermal imaging camera or standard video camera, and tracking system to provide a tracked viewpoint in an AR environment. The augmented portions of the environment can consist of fire, smoke, extinguishing agent, or other emergencies. This allows for inexpensive, flexible, and realistic on-site training of fire fighting, damage control, search and rescue, and other first responder techniques using thermal imaging.

title_en: Zigbee wireless tracking position system and method
abstract_en: This patent is incorporated into radio tracking positioning system with purple-bee technology, for its practical application in zonule wireless security track and localization provides condition.This system is by forming (seeing accompanying drawing) from node device (101), main access point apparatus (102), Surveillance center (103), search and rescue equipment (104) and communication bus (105), carry out information exchange from node device with communication and main access point apparatus or search and rescue equipment, main access point apparatus links to each other with communication bus with Surveillance center.Comprise zifeng modular, antenna, microprocessor, power supply circuits, voltage check device and voice module from node device; Main access point apparatus comprises zifeng modular, antenna, microprocessor, power supply circuits and communication bus interface; Surveillance center comprises information management database, display terminal, acoustic-optic alarm and voice module; Search and rescue equipment comprises zifeng modular, antenna, microprocessor, display module, power supply circuits and PC synchronization module.

title_en: Multiple leg tumbling robot
abstract_en: A robot or vehicle locomotes by tumbling. Legs distributed over the surface of the robot individually extend or retract. A control system coordinates the action of the legs to cause the robot to tumble in any direction. A robot using this form of locomotion is highly maneuverable, can climb slopes, and can step over obstacles. It can provide a smooth ride on rugged terrain. A variation can jump into the air and land safely. A variation can be built with as few as six moving parts, can fold to fit into a projectile, and instantly unfold on landing. It may use airbags instead of legs. It can include a video system without moving parts that produces a stable, non-tumbling view of its surroundings while tumbling. It is an ideal remotely operated vehicle for search and rescue, firefighting, or reconnaissance for the military or police.

title_en: Hazardous environment probing, search and rescue flight robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to mine and public safety field, relating to a special purpose robot which is suitable for detecting in dangerous environment and rescuing people and property under disaster. The invention can realize pilotless detection and rescue in dangerous environment and disaster. The flying robot is well in design, unique in shape and high in lifting efficient, and has anticollision function. The unconventional structural layout ensures that the whole structure is simple and compact with strong resistance to air disturbance. The invention has a good mobility and is easy to do maintenance with a low producing cost.

title_en: Multimodal agile robots
abstract_en: Examples and implementations of various robotic mechanisms, devices, components, systems and techniques are provided, including multimodal robotic devices and systems. For example, a multimodal robot can be configured to autonomously reconfigure between two or more primary modes of operation. Such robots may be used in a wide range of applications, including reconnaissance, exploration, search and rescue, military, sports, personal assistance, education, and entertainment and toys. Described examples of multimodal robots can be wheeled robots that use two or more drive wheels to perform various motions and operations.
assignees: BEWLEY THOMAS R;SCHMIDT-WETEKAM CHRISTOPHER;MOORE JOSEPH;DIMATTEO JERIMIAH;RAMIREZ MARK;ZHANG DAVID;SUMMERS SEAN;UNIV CALIFORNIA

title_en: Disaster rescue robot
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a disaster rescue robot capable of also intruding to a narrow space between upper and lower rubbles in a small area by fully working a device to an arrangement constitution of a plurality of crawlers.  <P>SOLUTION: The disaster rescue robot is provided with a left side crawler unit CL, a right side crawler unit CR and a container B. The left side crawler unit CL has a lower side crawler CL1 and an upper side crawler CL2 superposed on the lower side crawler CL1, and the upper side crawler CL2 is reversely rotated by a crawler belt 30 while engaged with the crawler belt 30 of the lower side crawler CL1. The right side crawler unit CR has a lower side crawler CR1 and an upper side crawler CR2 superposed on the lower side crawler CR1, and the upper side crawler CR2 is reversely rotated by the crawler belt 30 while engaged with the crawler belt 30 of the lower side crawler CR1. The container B is clamped/connected between the both left and right sides crawler units CL, CR.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Flame-proof type robot platform for search operation in coal mine well
abstract_en: The invention relates to an explosion-proof robot platform used in search and rescue operation under coal mines, comprising an explosion-proof housing (1), a driving wheel unit (3), a driven wheel and swing arm unit (6), a traveling driving motor unit (14) and a swing arm rotary driving motor unit (15). The explosion-proof robot platform is characterized in that the driving wheel unit (3) and the driven wheel and swing arm unit (6) are symmetrically positioned at the two ends of the explosion-proof housing (1); the traveling driving motor unit (14) positioned in the explosion-proof housing (1) is connected with the driving wheel unit (3); the swing arm rotary driving motor unit (15) positioned in the explosion-proof housing is connected with the driven wheel and swing arm unit (6); a main track (4) is positioned between the driving wheel (26) of the driving wheel unit (3) and the driven wheel (39) of the driven wheel and swing arm unit (6); an auxiliary track (53) is positioned on the swing arm of the driven wheel and swing arm unit (6); an explosion-proof joint surface is used in the joint with the explosion-proof housing, suitable for search and rescue operation under coal mines.

title_en: Recombinable silkworm-snake mixed robot and rescue robot system composed thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a silkworm-snake combined type robot that can be recombined, comprising a snake head and a body. Each single body on the body is provided with a measurement and control unit,an information transmission unit and cables. The single body is provided with a navigation and positioning system, an information system, a marching drive device, a cable swivel device, a controller and a single body interface, and all single bodies are connected in series with each other sequentially through cables and the single body interface; a search and rescue robot system constituted by theinvention also comprises a manipulater that controls the operation and a main measurement and control platform arranged on a safety location, the main measurement and control platform is connected with the robot snake head and the body through cables, and the manipulater is provided with a hand-held operation panel and a wireless control device. The silkworm-snake combined type robot that can berecombined and the search and rescue robot system constituted by the robot have the advantages that the cable connection solves the energy supply problem for the robots; the single body of the robot can receive and release cables initiatively and has high autonomous ability, thereby avoiding the drag, entwisting, clamping and damage of the cables and having high flexible moving ability and long-time operation ability.

title_en: Inquiry robot scattering wireless repeater
title_ko: 무선 통신 중계기를 살포하는 탐사 로봇
abstract_en: An inquiry robot capable of scattering wireless repeaters is provided to enable mutual communication with scattered wireless repeaters without external power supply by installing batteries in the wireless repeaters and to reuse the wireless repeaters by collecting the scattered wireless repeaters. An inquiry robot(300) capable of scattering wireless repeaters(200) includes a scattering device(380) for scattering the wireless repeaters. The inquiry robot includes an imaging device(310), a sound receiving device(320), a collecting unit(360), first and second communication parts(330,340), and a control part(350). The collecting unit collects the wireless repeaters scattered by the scattering device. The first communication part transmits and receives images of the imaging device and sounds of the sound receiving device to the wireless repeaters. The second communication part transmits and receives electric waves through the wireless repeaters. The wireless repeaters have respective batteries.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 무선 통신 중계기를 살포하는 탐사 로봇에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 영상 및 텍스트가 출력되는 디스플레이부, 음향이 출력되는 음향출력부, 조종레버 및 전원스위치가 형성된 무선 조종기 및 상기 무선 조종기에 의해 조종되며 복수개의 무선 통신 중계기를 수용하고, 전파음영지역에서 상기 무선 통신 중계기를 살포하여 상기 무선 조종기간의 전파의 송수신을 가능하게 하는 탐사 로봇을 포함하는 무선 통신 중계기를 살포하는 탐사 로봇에 관한 것이다.  본 발명에 따르면, 동굴, 지하터널 및 땅굴과 같은 전파음영지역(Blanket Area)에서 로봇에 탑재된 소형 무선 통신 중계기를 살포하여 영상 및 음향과 같은 데이터를 원활하게 송수신하여 탐색 및 수색 등에 활용될 수 있으며, 전쟁 또는 지진으로 인해 건물이 붕괴된 재난위험지역에서의 인명구조용으로 활용될 수 있고, 천재지변으로 인한 통신두절지역에서의 긴급통신망으로 활용될 수 있는 무선 통신 중계기를 살포하는 탐사 로봇을 제공할 수 있다. 
       
     무선통신, 중계기, 애드혹, 탐사, 로봇

title_en: Rescue robot in narrow space
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue robot for narrow spaces, comprising a first part and a second part which are mutually connected; the first part consists of a main controller, an upper bracing arm and a spur gear lead rail; the main controller can control the movement of the robot; the upper bracing arm is provided with a telescopic bracing arm which can support a bearing surface to facilitate the crawl of the robot and one end of the upper bracing arm is connected with the main controller; one end of the spur gear lead rail is connected with the upper bracing arm, while the other end thereof is connected with the second part; the second part consists of a turbine worm system, a lower bracing arm and sensor parts; one end of the turbine worm system is connected with the spur gear lead rail and forms a dynamic movable lead rail together with the spur gear lead rail; the lower bracing arm is provided with a telescopic bracing arm which can support a bearing surface, one end of the lower bracing arm is connected with the turbine worm system, and the lower bracing arm and the upper bracing arm can support the bearing surface alternately; the sensor parts are distributed on the main body of the robot, used for collecting the movement information of the robot and send the information to the main controller for executing.

title_en: Earth-air special-shaped multi-robot searching and rescuing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground-air heterogeneous multi-robot search and rescue system, which comprises air flying robots, a plurality of ground rescue robots, an image processing computer, an image acquisition card, a monitoring computer, search and rescue command personnel, a wireless data transmission radio, a wireless image transmission radio, obstacles, and objects to be rescued. The air flying robots are responsible for carrying out rapid and systematic large-area reconnaissance on the rescue site so as to more accurately judge the rescue site conditions, find out the positions of the obstacles or objects to be rescued, and help the search and rescue command personnel formulate detailed rescue plan. The ground rescue robot group, according to control instructions issued by the search and rescue command personnel, cooperatively executes the search and rescue work of the objects to be rescued at the rescue site. The robots in the system all adopt the control mode combining the autonomous intelligent control with remote control of the search and rescue command personnel; by the coordination of a plurality of ground-air robots with different structures, the system improves the reliability and accuracy of rescue site environmental perception and object recognition, reduces the search spread time and improves the rescue efficiency.

title_en: Jiggle bar type four-wheel robot
abstract_en: A rocker-style four-wheel robot comprises a main box body, a differential balancer, left and right rockers and wheels; the shell body of the differential balancer is fixedly connected on the main box body of the robot; the two extending shafts of the shell body are respectively connected with the two rockers arranged at both sides of the main box body; two support legs are connected on a joint and form a certain angle; the tail ends of the support legs are connected with a bevel gear commutator; the support legs are tubular; a speed reduction motor is arranged inside each support leg; the speed reduction motor shaft is connected with the input bevel gear of the bevel gear commutator at the tail ends of the support legs; the wheels are coaxially connected with the output shaft of the commutator; the upper ends of the support legs are provided with holes; the power supply and the control cables of the speed reduction motors are threaded through the holes and introduced into the main box body of the robot through a cable introduction device arranged on the main box body of the robot. The utility model can highly adapt to uneven terrain and can be used as a mobile robot platform for field search, environmental detection and post-disaster search and rescue.

title_en: Search and rescue robot for coal mine with closed caterpillar band characters
abstract_en: A coal mine search and rescue robot with closed track characteristics comprises a swing arm (1), a main track (3), a flameproof enclosure (4), a drive pulley (5) and a driven pulley (2); hollow lug bosses (6) are arranged at the lateral side of the robot flameproof enclosure (4) and have a shape similar as the shape enclosed by the drive pulley (5), the driven pulley (2) and the main track (3); the lug bosses are filled among the main track (3), the drive pulley (5) and the driven pulley (2) to effectively prevent foreign matters entering the main track (3); and the swing arm unit (1) enables the space between a front pulley and a rear pulley to be closed through external side plates (12)(21) and a support plate (13), so as to effectively prevent foreign matters entering an auxiliary track (20). The utility model can effectively improve the robot adaptability to a complex environment.

title_en: Robot for search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to a searching and rescuing robot belonging to the field of industrial robots. The searching and rescuing robot comprises a head part, a body part and a tail part; the head part and the tail part have the same conical structures; the front ends of the head part and the tail part are respectively provided with a cephalic cone in which a camera and an illuminator are arranged; the body part comprises a plurality of independent body part units; the head part units are mutually axially connected, and the body part units are mutually axially connected with the head part and the tail part to form the complete robot; casings of the head part, the body part and the tail part of the robot are in column-shaped structures; the casings are provided with a plurality of movable claws which are distributed circumferentially. Under the control of a program, the searching and rescuing robot can creep, make turns and leap over barriers to and fro on complex surfaces, and passes through narrow gaps for searching and rescuing tripped persons in ruins; and the searching and rescuing robot is controlled freely and works efficiently.

title_en: Rescue robot capable of falling into well
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot for rescuing people fell in a well. A ground composition part comprises a controller, a monitor, a power supply, a clean air source and a hoisting device for hoisting and dropping an underground composition part; the underground composition part comprises a robot body, a lighting device, an air supply device and a pick-up device; the robot body is provided with a body stander, a well wall anchoring mechanism, a mechanism rolling along the well wall, an arm probing mechanism and an arm holding mechanism; and the lighting device, the air supply device and the pick-up device are connected with corresponding equipment and/or units through cables or pipelines. Under the control of ground rescue workers, the underground composition part is dropped to a position above a person fell in the well, and an operator adjusts the posture of the underground composition part according to field information such as video images returned from the underground so as to control the arm probing mechanism and the arm holding mechanism to carry out proper motions and simultaneously supply fresh air or oxygen, so the robot can effectively rescue the people fell in the well in different postures.

title_en: Search-and-rescue robot for underground mine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a search-and-rescue robot for underground mine, belonging to the technical field of robot. The structure of the robot is as follows: the robot comprises an explosion-resistant enclosure, two sets of symmetrical running systems, an arm-swinging system and a control system which are respectively independent, wherein the driving mechanisms of the control system, the running systems and the arm-swinging system are arranged in the explosion-resistant enclosure, the control system is connected with the driving mechanisms, a mechanical cradle head and an optical fiber-discharging device are arranged above the explosion-resistant enclosure, the optical fiber of the optical fiber-discharging device is connected with the control system, and the mechanical cradle head is internally provided with a sensor group which is electrically connected with the control system with the drive plate of the cradle head. The utility model adopts the static overbalance model explosion-resistant enclosure so as to improve the moving ability of the robot when reaches the static overbalance. By adopting the driving mechanisms with four independent arms, the posture of the robot can be exactly controlled, and the adaptive capacity and the obstacle-climbing ability of the robot to complex terrains are improved. By adopting on-vehicle optical fiber mode, the optical fiber is freely discharged, and the influence on the moving ability of the robot which is caused by the rubbing and being locked by cables is reduced.

title_en: Rocker type four-wheel robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rocker type four-wheel robot comprising a main box body, a differential balancer, a left rocker, a right rocker and wheels, wherein the shell of the differential balancer is fixedly connected with the main box body of the rocker type four-wheel robot, and two projecting shafts of the differential balancer are respectively connected with the two rockers positioned at both sides of the man box body; two landing legs are connected with a connection joint at a certain included angle, and the tail ends of the landing legs are connected with conical gear tumblers; the landing legs are in a cylinder shape and internally provided with reducing motors, the reducing motors are connected with input bevel gears of the conical gear tumblers connected to the tail ends of the landing legs, and the wheels are connected with output shaft coaxial lines of the conical gear tumblers; the upper ends of the landing legs are provided with holes, a power supply of the reducing motors and control cables penetrate through the holes, and the control cables are introduced into the main box body of the rocker type four-wheel robot through a cable introducing device arranged on the main box body of the rocker type four-wheel robot. The rocker type four-wheel robot can be adapted to uneven terrains and can be used as a movable robot platform for outdoor search, environment detection and search and rescue after disasters.

title_en: Image collecting and processing system applicable to movable rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image collecting and processing system applicable to a movable rescue robot. The image collecting and processing system comprises an image sensing unit, an image preprocessing unit, an analogue/digital conversion unit, an image collecting unit and an image format conversion unit, an edge detection unit, an image transmission unit and a control center unit; the image collecting unit, the image preprocessing unit and the analogue/digital conversion unit are realized by adopting a CMOS sensor; and the image format conversion unit and the edge detection unit are realized by an ARM processor. The image collecting and processing system carries out characteristic extraction by an image local characteristic extraction processing module configured in the ARM processor, thus obtaining the environment information more effectively and facilitating the timely rescue activity for the rescuers.

title_en: Rescue robot system, rescue method, and rescue robot
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a rescue robot system which requires no high-performance controller for recovery without reducing the processing amount and memory consumption of a CPU of an autonomous mobile robot which has failed to estimate its own position, and to solve the problem that the operation of the manager is required for the recovery and there is a problem in the timing of the recovery.  <P>SOLUTION: A management server holds robot information about the autonomous mobile robot and periodically obtains position information from the autonomous mobile robot. When receiving a notification of rescue from the autonomous mobile robot, the server gives an instruction to a robot under control for rescue. Upon receiving the instruction for rescue, the rescue robot searches for the corresponding robot, and recovers the robot to be rescued, by calculating the absolute position and the azimuth of the robot to be rescued on the basis of its position relative to the robot to be rescued.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Life detection device for searching for survivors in ruins
abstract_en: A life detection device for searching survivors in ruins relates to the technical field of search equipment and solves the technical problems in searching survivors in ruins. The device is characterized in that the life detection device comprises a monitor with a built-in wireless receive module, a remote controller, a detection vehicle, a detection unit and a snake robot, wherein the remote controller is used for controlling the running of the detection vehicle and starting the snake robot to carry out autonomous detection; the detection unit is mounted in the detection vehicle and used for searching life bodies around the detection vehicle, and the detection unit is equipped with a photoelectric switch for detecting barriers on two sides of the detection vehicle so as to dodge; the snakerobot is carried on the detection vehicle and can walk autonomously, and further used for performing autonomous detection on places where the detection vehicle can not reach and passing back image information in a real time manner through a wireless camera; and batteries are arranged on both the detection vehicle and the snake robot and used for supplying power to all components. The device provided by the utility model can timely assist relief workers in search and rescue operations in places where the relief workers are hard to reach for the time being.

title_en: Underground rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of robots. The invention provides the underground rescue robot, which can perform underground rescue task with less labor, high speed, high accuracy and high efficiency. The robot comprises a machine frame, wherein a fixed table with a through hole is fixed in the machine frame, a lifting motor is fixed above the fixed table and the motor shaft of the lifting motor is connected with a screw rod through the through hole of the fixed table; a lifting table with threads is arranged under the fixed table, and the threads of the lifting table correspond to those of the screw rod; hydraulic cylinders are arranged under the fixed table and above the lifting table respectively; the piston rods of the hydraulic cylinders are connected with telescopic rods; a rotating motor is fixed above the lifting table; the motor shaft of the rotating motor is connected with one end on one side of a three-end connecting piece through a through hole on the lifting table; and the two ends on the other side of the three-end connecting piece are connected with the top ends of first and second fixed plates with grooves and through holes, and mechanical arms are arranged on the first fixed plate and the second fixed plate.

title_en: Earthquake search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an earthquake search and rescue robot which is a snake robot and comprises a control device, a detector, at least one pipe body and a transmission line, wherein the control device used to control actions of the robot is connected to the detector used to detect positions of trapped people; the at least one pipe body used to supply water, food and other rescue commodities to the trapped people is connected to the control device; and the transmission line positioned inside the robot body is connected to the control device in order to transmit received detection information to rescue workers. By using the detector to detect the positions of the trapped people, surrounding terrain and signs of life of the trapped people and transmit the information to the rescue workers, the earthquake search and rescue robot is favorable for leading rescue work to be more direct and efficient and improve rescue efficiency, and further capable of providing water, liquid food and other rescue commodities to the trapped people so as to offer sufficient preparation and win precious time for the trapped people.
assignees: SHANGHAI CITY YANGPU DISTR KONGJIANG ERCUN PRIMARY SCHOOL

title_en: Search and rescue robot used in pit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a search and rescue robot used in pit, belonging to the robot technology field. The search and rescue robot comprises an explosion-resistant enclosure, two sets of symmetrical running system, independent swinging arm systems and a controlling system; transmission mechanisms of the controlling system, the running systems and the swinging arm systems are arranged in the explosion-resistant enclosure, the controlling system is connected with a driving mechanism, a mechanical cradle head and an optical fiber laying device are arranged above the explosion-resistant enclosure, the optical fiber of the optical fiber laying device is electrically connected with the controlling system, a sensor group is internally arranged in the mechanical cradle head, and the sensor group and a cradle head drive plate are electrically connected with the controlling system. A static positive pressure explosion-resistant enclosure is adopted in the invention, when the static positive pressure is reached, the moving ability of the robot is improved. A four-swinging-arm independent driving mechanism is adopted, the posture of the robot is accurately controlled, and the adaptbility and the barrier jumping ability of the robot to a complex terrain are increased. The method of vehicle-mounted optical fiber is adopted, the optical fiber is laid freely during movement, and the effect to the moving ability of the robot, which is caused by the friction of the optical fiber and the clamping of the optical fiber, is reduced.

title_en: Mine rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mine rescue robot capable of implementing the mine rescue tasks in a labor-saving, quick, high accuracy and high-efficient manner, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The robot comprises a frame, wherein a fixed station with a through hole is fixed in the frame, a jacking motor is fixed above the fixed station, and the motor shaft of the jacking motor is connected with a lead screw through the through hole of the fixed station; a lifting table with threads is arranged under the fixed station, and the threads of the lifting table correspond to the lead screw; hydraulic cylinders are respectively arranged under the fixed station and above the lifting table, and the piston rods and the telescopic links of the hydraulic cylinders are connected; and an electric rotating motor is fixed above the lifting table, the motor shaft of the electric rotating motor is connected with one end on one side of a three-end connecting piece through the through hole on the lifting table, two ends on the other side of the three-end connecting piece are connected with the top ends of a first fixed plate and a second fixed plate with grooves and through holes, and mechanical arms are arranged on the first and the second fixed plates.

title_en: Assisting rescue robot for multiple road conditions
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an assisting rescue robot for multiple road conditions, and aims to solve the problems that the conventional functions are less and a work bench can not be placed on the ground in a completely level manner. The assisting rescue robot comprises a remote control part and a mechanical part between which a wireless transmission mode is adopted. The mechanical part mainly comprises four sets of walking devices (18), a screw jack (5), a work bench (10), a camera (15), and a hand-driven/power-driven gear-shifting device (9). One end of each walking device (18) is fixed at one of the four corners of the work bench (10), the four sets of walking devices are symmetrically distributed relative to the lengthwise and the transverse symmetric lines of the work bench (10), the screw jack (5) is fixed in the center position of the work bench (10), the camera (15) and the hand-driven/power-driven gear-shifting device (9) are respectively fixed on the work bench (10) in positions on the left and the right sides of the screw jack (5), and the output shaft of the hand-driven/power-driven gear-shifting device (9) is in rotational connection with the screw jack (5).

title_en: Method for controlling movement of woundless rat robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for controlling movement of a woundless rat robot. The conventional animal robot has the defects of difficult development process and low success rate by adopting a creative movement control mode. The invention adopts a mode of integrating ultrasonic stimulation with epidermal electrode stimulation and LED light auxiliary stimulation, wherein the ultrasonic stimulation is used for stimulating sense of hearing; the epidermal electrode stimulation is used for stimulating sense of pain; and the LED light auxiliary stimulation is used for stimulating sense of vision to make the rat robot have active escape behavior so as to control the movement of the rat robot. The method for controlling movement by adopting a woundless rat movement control mode has the advantages of solving the problems of neurolysis, difficult operation and the like in creative stimulation control, accelerating practical process, along with no need of craniotomy on the rat, short development cycle, and wide development potential in aspects of personnel search and rescue, military activities, and acquisition of physiological parameters of organisms in the future.

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rescue robot, which adopts a traction rope as a driving mechanism of each joint and totally has 18 degrees of freedom, flexibly movement, stronger ability to adapt to uneven terrain and better obstacle capability. The rescue machine has small volume, light weight and stable operation, and is used in greatly dangerous disasters, especially in situations that people are anxious to ascertain the inside dangerous situations of disaster site but dare not or can not be close to or enter the disaster site.

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rescue robot, which adopts drawing ropes as driving mechanisms for joints, has 18 degrees of freedom and is flexible in movement, higher in adaptability to concave-convex terrain and better in jumping capacity. Besides, the rescue robot is small in volume, light in weight and stable in running, and has significant effect on situations that people are eager to detect inside risk on disaster fields but do not dare to or unable to approach or enter the disaster fields.

title_en: Simple search-and-rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a simple search-and-rescue robot, which includes a control module, a movement mechanism, a cradle head mechanism with a camera, an information acquisition module, an image processing module, a wireless communication module, a lighting module and a power resource module, wherein the control module inputs control signals to the movement mechanism, the cradle head mechanism and the information acquisition module; the movement mechanism moves forwards and backwards and steers according to the control signals; the camera in the cradle head mechanism transmits acquired image information to the control module through the image processing module, and the wireless communication module sends the image information to receiving equipment; the information acquisition module returns information to the control module after acquiring information of barriers and signs of life according to the control signals, and the control module controls the motion of the movement mechanism according to the information of barriers, and returns returned life information to the receiving equipment; the control module controls the opening and closing of the lighting module; and all components inside the robot are powered by the power resource module. The simple search-and-rescue robot can effectively improve the efficiency of searching and rescuing work and can be widely applied in the rescuing operation on the ruins of various disasters.

title_en: Small-sized variable crawler type search and rescue robot
