abstract_en: The invention provides a small-sized variable crawler type search and rescue robot, comprising a body, a crawler travelling device, a communication device and a signal acquisition device, wherein the body is a carrier for the crawler travelling device, the communication device and the signal acquisition device; the crawler travelling device comprises a retractable crawler, a driving wheel and a retractor device; the retractor device is a slipper rocker mechanism consisting of two movable driven wheels, two fixed driven wheels and two linear push rods; the driving wheels are driven by driving shafts on the body, a linear push rod motor is taken as a slider and drives rockers and the movable driven wheels thereon to rotate around the fixed driven wheels so as to drive the crawler to stretch and shrink, thus forming a certain angle in the forward to backward direction of the crawler. The robot of the invention has small volume and flexible movement and can run forwards and backwards and turn in narrow space. The variable crawler can form certain angles in the forward to backward direction, thereby being beneficial to realizing obstacle detouring, reducing the volume of the crawler type search and rescue robot and improving the running speed of the robot.

title_en: Portable type mine safety instrument
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable type mine safety instrument comprising a lamp body, wherein the upper part of the lamp body is provided with a search and rescue lamp, one side of the search and rescue lamp is provided with a miniature gas probe, the side part of the search and rescue lamp is provided with an audible alarming buzzer, and the back part of the safety instrument is provided with a bayonet which is suitable for being placed between the waistbands of a mine worker. When the gas concentration of gas for an operation area exceeds a specified limit value, the safety lamp twinkles automatically and carries out acoustic and optical alarming.

title_en: Modularized disaster rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modularized disaster rescue robot comprising a hexagonal main body module and a mechanical arm, wherein the mechanical arm is arranged on the main body module, and the main body module is connected with a moving mechanism. The main body module comprises an identifying unit, a motion control unit, a communication unit and a master control unit which are mutually communicated by a bus technology. The identifying unit is used for identifying the motion way of the moving mechanism, and the motion control unit is used for establishing a kinematics model according to the motion way and driving the moving mechanism to move; and a body of the mechanical arm is a robot operating arm with five degrees of freedom, a steering engine and a hand gripping mechanism are arranged on the operating arm, and the steering engine is connected with the master control unit. The invention finishes the plug and play function by utilizing a cordwood system type modularized mechanical connection scheme and a mechanical self-adaptive double-rail guide rail, realizes the multifunction of one object by taking the main body module as a platform and can fast assemble a plurality of task modules according to the environments and the types of tasks.

title_en: Emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency rescue robot which comprises a rescue cabin device, a spray self-protecting device and a control and picture transmission system, wherein the rescue cabin device is arranged on a crawler-type automatic traveling chassis; the rescue cabin device comprises a life searching system, an oxygen breathing system, a positive-pressure exhaust device, chairs, a cabin door and a cabin body; the cabin body is installed on the crawler-type automatic traveling chassis; the cabin door is installed on the cabin body; the oxygen breathing system and the positive-pressure exhaust device are respectively arranged at the top of the cabin body; the life searching system and the chairs are installed in the cabin body; the oxygen breathing system and the positive-pressure exhaust device are respectively arranged at the top of the cabin body; and the chairs are installed in the cabin body. The emergency rescue robot in the utility model has the capacity of climbing stairs quickly and safely with heavy load, and the adopted crawler-type automatic traveling machine can realize the functions of normally traveling, backing, steering and pivot steering, so that the robot has the advantage of small turning radius and is flexible in operation.
assignees: SHANXI YIN HE FIRE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Rescue robot capable of crossing and breaking obstacles
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to a robot, and particularly relates to a rescue robot capable of crossing and breaking obstacles, which comprises a crossbeam (6), longitudinal beams (5) and a rescue chamber oxygen supply cylinder (9). The two longitudinal beams (5) are respectively, fixedly and symmetrically arranged at two ends of the crossbeam (6), dovetail iron sliders (7) are fixedly disposed at two ends of each longitudinal beam (5), X-direction walking portions (1) are arranged in the middles of the longitudinal beams (5), a dovetail chute (8) is penetratingly mounted on the two dovetail iron sliders (7) of each longitudinal beam (5), a Y-direction walking portion (2) is disposed on each dovetail chute (8), two upright posts (3) are fixedly arranged on each longitudinal beam (5), the four upright posts (3) encircle to form a rescue chamber (10), a gear fixed plate (12) is fixed at the top ends of the four upright posts (3) and the rescue chamber (10), and the lower end surface of the gear fixed plate (12) is connected with the dovetail chute (8) by a lifting cylinder. The rescue robot capable of crossing and breaking obstacles greatly shortens time for leading trapped people out of danger, and realizes effective and high-speed rescue.

title_en: Quickly-detachable combined search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a quickly-detachable combined search and rescue robot, which comprises a parent robot and a son robot, wherein the parent robot and the son robot are provided with separable parent and son machine connecting mechanisms which are matched with each other respectively. The robot has the advantages that: a telescopic swing arm has high adaptability to the complicated environment of a disaster field; the separable parent and son machine connecting mechanisms enhance the maneuvering characteristic and obstacle performance of the robot; combined modules have rich functions and small dependence on one another; and a butt joint device is easy and quick, and has a small occupied space.

title_en: Disaster detection robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster detection robot, which comprises a body (1), a detection supporting frame (2) and a camera, wherein a crawler-type running gear is arranged on the body (1); a buffer supporting device (11) is arranged between the body (1) and the running gear; a rotating device (12) is arranged between the body (1) and the detection supporting frame (2); the detection supporting frame (2) consists of a main supporting frame (13) and an auxiliary supporting frame (14) hinged with each other; the main supporting frame (13) and the auxiliary supporting frame (14) are controlled by a main supporting frame swing system (22) and an auxiliary supporting frame swing system (23) respectively; and the camera (3) is connected with a signal emitter (15). The disaster detection robot is skillful in design and flexible in movement, can enter various severe disaster scenes, and informs search and rescue personnel of conditions of trapped persons through video signals.

title_en: Underwater life search and rescue system based on wireless sensor network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater life search and rescue system based on a wireless sensor network. Creative points of the invention are as follows: the system comprises a control center, a buoy node device, a ship-borne base station and an underwater node device, wherein, the underwater node device transmits information to the buoy node device and the ship-borne base station in an underwater acoustic communication manner; and the buoy node device and the ship-borne base station respectively send the received information to the control center in a wireless communication manner. By utilizing the underwater life search and rescue system, position information of persons in danger can be rapidly and efficiently located when a ship is in danger, and the persons in danger can be searched and rescued immediately. In addition, the underwater life search and rescue system has the advantages of simple structure and low production cost.

title_en: Infrared simulated image platform under ocean background and image generation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention aims at providing an infrared simulated image platform under an ocean background and an image generation method thereof. The infrared simulated image platform comprises an infrared face statistic template generation subsystem, an ocean background infrared image selection subsystem and an infrared simulated image generation subsystem, wherein the infrared face statistic template generation subsystem is used for generating face templates at different distances; the ocean background infrared image selection subsystem takes the charge of managing databases of background images and extracting the ocean background images according to the conditions of weathers and an ocean environment; and the infrared simulated image generation subsystem can generate ocean background infrared simulated images at different detection distances under different ocean conditions and weathers, which take faces as targets. The invention can provide infrared images or videos of artificial targets under an ocean environment background and is used for researching target detection and tracking algorithms in a laboratory environment, thereby providing an experiment research platform for the target detection during maritime search and rescue.

title_en: Wireless explosion-removal rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a wireless explosion-removal rescue robot, which belongs to a rescue robot and consists of a chassis, a base joint, elbow joints, wrist joints, upper arms, forearms and clamping hands. The chassis is provided with four wheels which are driven symmetrically and independently, the base joint is provided with a rotary pair and a swing pair, each elbow joint is provided with a swing pair, each wrist joint is provided with a rotary pair and a swing pair, each upper arm is connected between the base joint and the corresponding elbow joint, each forearm is connected between the corresponding elbow joint and the corresponding wrist joint, each clamping hand is connected with the corresponding wrist joint, and the rotary pairs and the swing pairs of the joints and independent driving connecting rods of the clamping hands are respectively driven to move by a stepping motor. The robot can move to a place at which people cannot safely arrive when in danger. By the aid of matching actions of mechanical arms and the chassis, the wireless explosion-removal rescue robot can realize operation functions of grabbing, placing, tightening, opening and closing, water spraying and the like.

title_en: disaster detection robot
abstract_en: Disaster detection robot, including automobile body (1), survey support (2) and camera, be provided with crawler-type running gear on automobile body (1), still be provided with buffering strutting arrangement (11) between automobile body (1) and running gear, still be provided with rotating device (12) between automobile body (1) and survey support (2), survey support (2) and comprise mutual articulated main support (13) and auxiliary stand (14), control through main support swing system (22) and auxiliary stand swing system (23) on main support (13) and auxiliary stand (14) respectively, still be connected with signal emission device (15) with camera (3). The disaster detection robot is ingenious in design and flexible in action, can enter various severe disaster fields, and informs trapped personnel conditions to search and rescue personnel through video signals.

title_en: Overwater emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides an overwater emergency rescue robot comprising a head tank, a front tank, a midship tank and an afterpeak tank. The front tank is internally provided with an independent navigation mould, a gear mechanism, a wireless remote control module and a lodging type antenna, wherein the lodging type antenna is driven by the gear mechanism, the independent navigation mechanism is electrically connected with the gear mechanism by an independent navigation signal cable, and the wireless remote control mould is electrically connected with the gear mechanism by a remote control signal cable. The afterpeak tank is internally provided with a control cable, a cable guiding mould and a propulsion system. A power battery tank is installed in the upper half tank of the midship tank, supplies power for the independent navigation mould, the wireless remote mould, the cable guiding mould and the propulsion system and transmits control commands. The overwater emergency rescue robot has the advantages of providing a multiple control unit mode, integrating cable control, remote control and independent navigation into a whole, solving the problem that the existing product has limitation on the rescue distance, can not obtain video data and image data, and can not be controlled due to the failure of a single control unit, and enhancing the rescue capability.
assignees: KUNMING WUWEI S & T INDUSTRY TRADE CO LTD

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to robots, in particular to a rescue robot, which comprises a drive motor (10), a motor (14) and a control casing (7). The bottom of the rear two sides of the control casing (7) is respectively equipped with a rear drive axle (9-2) and the bottom of the front two sides thereof is respectively equipped with a driven axle (19-1). The bottom of the intermediate two sides of the control casing (7) is respectively equipped with a driving axle (15-1). The two sides of the front bottom of the control casing (7) are respectively equipped with a support wheel support (20). Each of the support wheel supports (20) is used for fixing a support axle (1-1) and each of the support axles (1-1) is respectively sleeved with a support wheel (1). Driven wheels (19) are respectively sleeved on the driven axles (19-1) and driving wheels (15) are respectively sleeved on the driving axles (15-1). The driving wheel (15) is fixedly equipped with a driving wheel gear (15-2) and the motor (14) equipped with a gear. The rescue robot is simple in structure and flexible in action.

title_en: Search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot, comprising a basal body, a middle framework, motors, PVC (polyvinylchloride) tubes, a camera and a light source module. The basal body is a circular cylinder, both two ends of which are of semi-spherical elastic soft structures. The middle framework is of a transverse I-shaped structure. The basal body is sleeved on the middle framework. A motor groove and four PVC tube grooves are arranged on the middle framework. A plurality of motors are fixed on the basal body and form a ring by being connected from end to end through a rope. The ring passes through the motor groove of the middle framework. The tail ends of the motors are provided with light sensitive resistors. A plurality of PVC tubes are fixed on the basal body. Each four PVC tubes in a vertical plane of a motor shaft of one corresponding motor are connected with the corresponding motor through a rope and correspond to the four PVC tube grooves of the middle framework respectively. The camera and the light source module are fixed at the front and rear ends of the middle framework respectively. By means of the structure of the invention, the search and rescue robot can advance in a clearance, which is smaller than self size, so as to search and rescue trapped persons under ruins.
assignees: CHANGZHOU MECHANICAL ELECTRONIC ENGINEERING RES INST

title_en: Small-sized emergency rescue and detection robot for nuclear radiation environment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of special equipment for nuclear industries, and in particular relates to an emergency treatment and rescue robot which can be used for a nuclear radiation environment. The robot consists of a walking base plate, a mechanical arm, a robot body motion control system, a robot redundancy navigation control system, a gamma camera, a holder, a gamma ray imaging system, a battery and a controller, wherein the walking base plate has a crawler-type structure; a motor is arranged in the middle of the base plate and is used for driving a crawler belt to operate through a chain; the mechanical arm is arranged at the front end of the base plate and has four degree of freedom; the gamma camera and the imaging system are positioned on the rear part of the robot and are arranged above the battery; and the gamma camera can be used for detecting the intensity and the direction of radiation and the robot can perform emergency treatment through the mechanical arm of the robot.

title_en: Rotary foot type amphibious mine disaster search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a rotary foot type amphibious mine disaster search and rescue robot which comprises a shell, a shell upper cover, servo driving motors, amphibious legs and land legs. The amphibious legs and the land legs are arranged at both sides of the shell. Each amphibious leg and each land leg are respectively connected with one servo driving motor. All the servo driving motors are arranged in the shell. The shell upper cover is fixed on the shell. The invention provides the novel search and rescue robot with high efficiency, small volume and bionic characteristic. After an accident occurs, the rotary foot type amphibious mine disaster search and rescue robot can rapidly and accurately reach the disaster field and timely obtain accurate information of the field. The rotary foot type amphibious mine disaster search and rescue robot has high research value and wide application prospect.

title_en: Helmet equipment for fire fighting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to helmet equipment for fire fighting. The helmet equipment for fire fighting is characterized in that a thermal infrared imager is arranged on the side face outside a helmet through a fixing device; and a breathing mask is arranged at the front part of the helmet. Soft silica gel is arranged at the peripheries of eyeshades of an ocular display module of the helmet equipment, so as to prevent eyes from being scratched carelessly. An ocular display is arranged between the lower part of nose protection silica gel of a respirator mask of a fireman and the wall of the mask, so that the visual line of looking forward is not blocked, and the fireman can lower the eyes to watch field pictures through oculars, and the field pictures can not be seen with the naked eyes, so that removal of dangerous field conditions and search and rescue of trapped persons are convenient. The helmet equipment has a simple structure and small volume, is convenient in use, prevents water mist of the respirator mask from affecting the visual line, liberates both hands of the fireman, and can be adjusted in position.
assignees: SHANDONG ZETVISION ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Navigation algorithm of bionic robot for position cells
abstract_en: The invention discloses a positional cell bionic robot navigation algorithm, A1, firstly, a wide-angle camera of a robot takes a panoramic picture, converts the panoramic picture into a gradient map, and then, a Gaussian difference filter is used for filtering the panoramic picture to detect characteristic points; carrying out logarithmic polar coordinate transformation on local areas near the characteristic points, wherein the characteristic points correspond to specific road signs; a2, acquiring an angle relative to the true north direction, i.e. azimuth, provided by a compass, for each landmark; the azimuth angle and the road marking jointly determine the position cell at the current moment; a3, determining a transfer matrix by the position cell at the current moment and the position cell at the previous moment; when the robot is exploring in an unknown environment, a transfer matrix is continuously formed, and the transfer matrix forms a cognitive map; a4, jointly determining a motion transformation matrix by the transfer matrix and the cognitive map, wherein the motion transformation matrix is responsible for sending out a motion command; the robot can be applied to intelligent ground cleaning robots, battlefield search and rescue robots and the like.

title_en: Instrument is searched and rescued in multifunction wireless location
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multifunction wireless location and search and rescue instrument, including for calculating and process various data signal, and search and rescue the control core DSP coordinating and managing between each module of instrument in described wireless location；It is connected with described control core DSP, for the radio frequency system control module that radiofrequency signal is processed；It is connected with described radio frequency system control module and is carried out, by it, the antenna that feed controls；It is connected with described control core DSP, for the audio system control module that acoustic signals is processed；The sonic generator that is connected with described audio system control module, sonic probe.Multifunction wireless of the present invention location is searched and rescued instrument and is utilized radio frequency, audio frequency, infrared multimedium comprehensive transmission analysis, it is provided that the location mode of flexibility and reliability, and after accident occurs, communication network possesses self-healing ability；It addition, 802.11b agreement observed by search and rescue instrument of the present invention, compatible with the Internet, networking is convenient, and replicability is strong.

title_en: Mine disaster rescue robot with tunneling function and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine disaster rescue robot with tunneling function, comprising a cone-shaped drill head, a cylindrical front body segment and a cylindrical back body segment, wherein the front body segment and the back body segment are connected through a waist part capable of rotating on a plane; the two sides of the front body segment and the back body segment are symmetrically provided with landing legs; the landing legs are connected with the front body segment or the back body segment by a hip joint composed of a revolute pair; the tail end of each landing leg is a curved surface foot; the cone-shaped drill head is fixedly connected to the front end of the front body segment. The invention can adjust lengths of the legs and environment adaptability according to the space. The invention can achieve tunneling function in media like earth mounds and ruins through earth loosening by the drill head and earth stirring by the foot. The robot can be used to assist in dangerous tasks like mine disaster rescue and wilderness exploration.

title_en: Moveable roboticized life detection equipment
abstract_en: Moveable roboticized life detection equipment comprises three motion modules which are connected in sequence and can form a plurality of configurations, and further comprises a life signal detecting head mounted at the upper end of the second motion module through a bracket table. According to the invention, the three motion modules can be connected and combined through linking arms into a plurality of structural forms, and the equipment can be enabled to have an autonomous mobile detection capability and a detection adjustment capability, so that the horizontal detection range and the vertical detection range can be enlarged. The equipment can realize robotization in a complex environment and a mobile life detection function, have an adjustable detection range and be not limited by orographic condition or the state of trapped persons, solves a big problem of rescue work, improves the rescue working efficiency and has a wide application prospect. Due to the life signal detecting head, life detection is free from dependence to human, and injuries caused to search and rescue persons executing detection task in a dangerous ruin environment can be prevented.

title_en: Swarm robot and sweeping method using swarm robot
title_ko: 군집 로봇 및 군집 로봇을 이용한 수색 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A swarm robot and a method for searching using the same are provided to maximize productivity of a stick removal work by removing sticks placed on unknown areas through cooperative operation of robots. CONSTITUTION: A swarm robot(100) comprises a driving unit(110), a manipulating unit(120), a sensing unit(130), a position checking unit(140), and a control unit(150). The driving unit moves in a sweep area. The manipulating unit grips an object. The sensing unit senses environmental information of the sweep area. The position checking unit grasps the position of a robot within the sweep area. The control unit makes a local map and an object map using the environmental information of the sensing unit and the position information of the position checking unit, and controls the driving unit and the manipulating unit in order that the robot moves to the object according to the local map and the object map and removes the object.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 군집 로봇 및 군집 로봇을 이용한 수색 방법에 관한 것으로서, 이 군집 로봇은 주어진 탐색 영역에 위치한 복수의 목적물을 제거하되 개별 목적물을 적어도 2대가 협조하여 제거하는 로봇으로서, 탐색 영역에서 이동하여 탐색 영역의 환경 정보를 감지하고, 탐색 영역 내에서 자신의 위치를 파악하며, 환경 정보 및 위치 정보를 이용하여 지역 지도 및 목적물 지도를 작성하고, 지역 지도 및 목적물 지도에 따라 목적물로 이동하여 목적물을 제거한다.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting rescue robot, which comprises a vehicle body with a travelling mechanism and a mechanical arm which is hinged with the vehicle body and is provided with a power mechanism, wherein a fixed mount for placing a fire extinguisher is arranged on the top surface of the vehicle body; a temperature sensor and a flame sensor are arranged on the mechanical arm; a barrier shunning module for inducing barriers is arranged on the vehicle body; the travelling mechanism is provided with a driving motor; the driving motor, the temperature sensor, the flame sensor, the barrier shunning module and the power mechanism of the mechanical arm are connected to a master control module; and the master control module is connected with a wireless transceiving module for wireless communication. The intelligent fire-fighting rescue robot can provide multiple operations such as safety control and the like for personnel in fire sites, and can help and even replace fire fighters to enter fire disaster sites and put out a fire or search and rescue in accident sites.
assignees: ZHEJIANG JINGANG AUTOMOBILE CO;ZHEJIANG GEELY HOLODING GROUP

title_en: Deformable rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deformable rescue robot, which comprises a main frame and a first traveling drive mechanism arranged at two sides of the main frame. The deformable rescue robot is characterized in that an end car node is arranged at each end of the main frame; and a turning drive mechanism used for driving the end car node to turn up and down is arranged between the end car node and the main frame. The deformable rescue robot of the invention has the following advantages: the end car nodes can turn up and down around the main frame, that is to say, the shape of the robot can be adjusted through the changes of the relative angle and the distance among the main frame and the end car nodes at two ends of the main frame so that the robot can flexibly deform to fit different terrains according to different requirements such as movement, obstacle crossing, pit crossing, upslope, down-slope and the like; as an opening and closing drive mechanism is arranged on an end car frame of the end car nodes, clamping arms of the robot can be flexibly opened and closed so that the robot can finish a clamping function; and for relieving the victims of a disaster, the robot can act together with all kinds of rescue items or rescue aids such as a camera and a life detector so as to play a big role at the rescue scene.

title_en: Search and rescue robot utilizing SMS (Short Messaging Service) for communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot utilizing SMS (Short Messaging Service) for communication. A controller and a human body sensing module are arranged in a robot body, a movement mechanism comprise a chassis with wheels or caterpillar bands, the robot body is arranged on the chassis, the wheels or the caterpillar bands are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the chassis, and two groups of separated driving mechanisms are respectively connected with the wheels or the caterpillar bands on the two sides of the chassis; an environment monitoring module consists of a sensor arranged below the chassis and at the upper part of the robot body, and an analysis processing module; a GSM (Global System For Mobile Communication) module and a GPS (Global Positioning System) module are arranged in the robot body; and the controller is connected with the environment monitoring module and the human body sensing module respectively so as to receive the detection information and analyze the detection information. The control and the communication of search and rescue robot can be realized by applying SMS through a GSM network, so that the cost of the search and rescue task can be lowered effectively. The robot moves flexibly and can effectively avoid the possibility of casualties of the search and rescue personnel in the search and rescue task.

title_en: Coal mine underground search-and-rescue detection robot moving device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine underground search-and-rescue detection robot moving device, belonging to the technical field of robots. The device comprises walking track mechanisms on the left and right sides, a front swing arm track mechanism, a wheel swing arm connecting rod mechanism, a wheel chassis and a power device. The front swing arm track mechanism is mounted on the outer side of the walking track mechanism; and the wheel swing arm connecting rod mechanism is mounted on the outer side of the front swing arm track mechanism. In both moving modes, the steering is realized by the differential speed between the left and right wheels, the wheel walking is driven by double rear wheels, and the track walking is driven by double front wheels. In the wheel swing arm connecting rod mechanism, a wheel lifting motor drives a rear wheel swing arm box to rotate, and the movement is transferred to a front wheel swing arm sleeved on a front mandrel through a transmission connecting rod; in the case of special underground environment of the coal mine, the track or wheel running can be selected according to different road conditions; and the device disclosed by the invention has perfect moving ability and adaptability, and provides a moving platform with strong maneuverability and reliability for building a coal mine underground environment detection robot.

title_en: Underwater rescue mini-type submarine for mine disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to an underwater rescue mini-type submarine for a mine disaster. The underwater rescue mini-type submarine can immediately reach a rescue scene before an assault boat, a robot, a frogman, a rubber dinghy and the like can not enter a water-seepage channel. The underwater rescue mini-type submarine consists of a high-strength framework and a light compression-resisting material, is divided into three parts, namely a control cabin, a rescue material cabin and a base weight reducing cabin, is powered by batteries and has driving, turning and lifting functions. The underwater rescue mini-type submarine is provided with an ultrasonic radar so as to be capable of running in a pitch dark shaft, and can safely run in an intermediate channel of a shaft in a manual or automatic navigation manner; a sonar image sensor, an infrared night-vision device and a liquid crystal display (or other displays) change the pitch dark shaft to be bright, a submarine driver can clearly see the surrounding situation of the shaft under deep water so as to immediately find out and save disaster suffers, thereby greatly improving the search and rescue efficiency and providing optimal and fastest rescue time and opportunity for the disaster suffers; due to the sonar image sensor and a receiver, the underwater rescue mini-type submarine keeps communication with the underground disaster surfers and a mine command department; in order to ensure the safety of an operator of the submarine, the operator of the submarine can convert to utilize a manually pedaling manner to get out of the shaft when the power of a battery of the submarine is used up; and the mini-type submarine disclosed by the invention can be also used for rescuing the disaster suffers in rivers and reservoirs.

title_en: Search and rescue robot using SMS communication
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue robot using SMS communication. A controller and a human body sensing module are arranged inside a machine body. A moving mechanism comprises a chassis with wheels or tracks. The machine body is arranged on the chassis. Two sides of the chassis are symmetrically provided with the wheels or the tracks. Two groups of independently set driving mechanisms are respectively connected with the wheels or the tracks at the two sides of the chassis. An environmental monitoring module is formed by sensors arranged under the chassis and at an upper part of the machine body and an analysis processing module. The machine body is also internally provided with a GSM module and a GPS module. The controller is respectively connected with the environmental monitoring module and the human body sensing module so as to receive detection information and carry out analysis and processing. Controlling and communicating with the search and rescue robot by applying an SMS through a general GSM network are realized, and cost of carrying out a search and rescue mission is effectively reduced. The robot is flexible in moving, and the probability of casualty of search and rescue personnel in the search and rescue mission is effectively avoided.

title_en: Ant robot based on search and rescue functions
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an ant robot based on search and rescue functions. The ant robot consists of a singlechip circuit, a power supply circuit, a motor drive circuit, a battery charge circuit, an infrared communication circuit, a target detection circuit, an indication circuit and an alarm circuit; in the search process, states of the ant robots can be known by a person by infrared communication. When the search and rescue ant robot comes across an obstacle in the searching process, an antenna switch is triggered, and the search and rescue ant robot turns around. When one search and rescue ant robot finds a survivor, the ant robot informs other ant robots by means of infrared information, and other ant robots approach to the ant robot when receiving the information and send alarm sounds. Through the cooperation of the search and rescue ant robots, survivors can be found quickly and accurately in complicated situations.

title_en: Correlation-based multi-sensor collaborative target detection method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a correlation-based multi-sensor collaborative target detection method. The method is characterized by comprising the following steps that sensor nodes measure signals in a monitoring area independently; when the measured value of a certain sensor node exceeds a preset threshold, triggering to generate a dynamic detection cluster; member nodes in the cluster transmit a detection value sequence in a period of time to a cluster head node to form a detection matrix; and the cluster head node calculates the correlation measure among detection vectors in the detection matrix, and judges the existence of a target according to a calculation result. The target detection method provided by the invention is a measured value-based fusion detection method; a single sensor node does not need to perform local judgment; the influence on the judgment result caused by noises can be inhibited effectively; and the detection result has high accuracy. The method can be used in the aspects such as anti-intrusion alarm, people search and rescue under sudden disasters and traffic control in important places and areas.

title_en: Active geometric exoskeleton with pseudo-rhombohedral annular fairing for gyropendular craft
abstract_en: The invention relates to an active geometric exoskeleton device (FIG. l) for a multi environment, multi mode, vertical or horizontal take off and landing gyropendular piloted craft or drone with compensatory propulsion and fluidic gradient collimation capable of moving in the following various physical environments: on land, in the air, in or under the sea or in space, comprising an active pseudo-rhombohedral annular fairing which 1) protects the various propulsion units and the payload by absorbing impacts, 2) corrects the trim and reorientates the trajectory upon collisions with any obstacle in the physical environment or the terrain, such a craft being provided with upper, intermediate and lower propulsion units, and with a hollow annular vertebral structure incorporating a payload containing the application functions suited to various domains: 1) civil defence emergency preparedness in the context of search and rescue activities, 2) exploration, navigation, transport, surveillance, 3) detection of deposits of hydrocarbons or ores, of boreholes or pump holes on land, under water or in space, 4) supporting and stabilizing a mobile, free or tethered submerged pontoon for a wind turbine or a water turbine, 5) maintenance work, 6) endovascular or intra-cavity navigation and intravention during surgery, 7) land, aerial, underwater or space telecommunications, and 8) deployment of telecommunications infrastructure in free space.

title_en: Disaster resistant rescue robot with variable wheel tread and adjustable center height
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a disaster resistant rescue robot with a variable wheel tread and an adjustable center height. The disaster resistant rescue robot comprises a traveling chassis component, a conveying device component and a mechanical arm component, a traveling mechanism by the aid of a symmetrical double parallelogram mechanism is mounted at the bottom of a sweeping board, a driving device is provided with conveyor belts, and a mechanical arm provided with a two-degree-of-freedom large flare angle simple gripping mechanism is mounted on the sweeping board. The symmetrical double parallelogram mechanism of gear transmission is simple in structure, the wheel tread and the center height of the robot can be synchronously changed, the disaster resistant rescue robot is high in part interchangeability, low in cost, low in freedom degree, wide in implementation range, simple in structure, simple to operate, high in stability and low in rescue injury probability, the whole mechanism is stable in movement and wide in use range, the gripping mechanism has a large bore and low freedom degree, and the disaster resistant rescue robot can be applied to a large machine by means of hydraulic transmission.

title_en: Miniature fire-extinguishing rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a miniature fire-extinguishing rescue robot which comprises a chassis, wherein a box body mechanism is arranged on the chassis, a fire-extinguishing system, a self-protection system and a warning and lighting system are arranged on the box body mechanism, a tracing system is arranged on the fire-extinguishing system, the self-protection system is provided with six self-protection spraying heads and is connected with the fire-extinguishing system by a high-pressure hose, and the fire-extinguishing system is directly fixed on the chassis by welding. The miniature fire-extinguishing rescue robot can be operated by long-distance remote control, and therefore, fire-extinguishing rescue can be carried out under the condition that the firefighting rescue personnel do not enter a more dangerous location.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHENXIANG VEHICLE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Individual soldier collection and search-and-rescue system with infrared thermal imaging
abstract_en: An individual soldier collection and search-and-rescue system with infrared thermal imaging comprises a plurality of fire-fighting individual soldier bearing units and a fire protection commanding terminal. The fire-fighting individual soldier bearing units are allocated to fire-fighting individual soldiers, the fire protection commanding terminal is allocated an on-site command point outside a fire ground, and the fire-fighting individual soldier bearing units are communicated with a wireless receiver of the fire protection commanding terminal through a wireless transmitter. By collecting data of sub modules, the individual soldier collection and search-and-rescue system with the infrared thermal imaging dynamically masters conditions in real time, labor intensity is largely reduced, and command scheduling force and overall management level are improved.
assignees: NANJING GUOAN PHOTOELECTRIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;NANJING LANTAI TRAFFIC FACILITY CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle-mounted infrared telescope device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a vehicle-mounted infrared telescope device which comprises a detection part, a display part and a control part. The detection part comprises an installation base, a rotary base and an infrared telescope. The installation base is fixed onto the top of the vehicle in absorption mode, the rotary base is arranged on the upper portion of the installation base and rotates relatively and the infrared telescope provided with a launcher is arranged on the upper portion of the rotary base. The display part is arranged in the vehicle and comprises a receiver. The receiver and the launcher are connected wirelessly. The vehicle-mounted infrared telescope device receives infrared rays emitted by an object by the infrared telescope. A converter can convert infrared images into digital signals of general visual images. The digital signals of general visual images are sent by the launcher, received by the receiver and displayed by a displayer so that the object can be observed in darkness, a driver can drive the vehicle conveniently at night, and especially the rescue staff can conveniently perform tasks of search and rescue at night.
assignees: WUHU EIDSON AUTOMATION EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Small-scale high-altitude rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a small-scale high-altitude rescue robot, and relates to the technical field of simple robots. The small-scale high-altitude rescue robot comprises a robot body, wherein a mounting plate is arranged in a shell of the robot body; a miniature speed reducer device is arranged on the mounting plate; the output end of the miniature speed reducer device is connected with a driving shaft, and the input end of the miniature speed reducer device is connected with a rotating shaft of a small motor; the small motor is connected with a battery by a wire; and two outer ends of the driving shaft extend out of two sides of the robot body and are provided with two arms with the same connecting rod structure. The small-scale high-altitude rescue robot can climb to the high-altitude positions of high-rise buildings, cliffs and the like where rescue is needed through a rope to convey rescue materials and small tools, and is simple in structure, convenient and practical.

title_en: Intelligent remote control system for mechanical arm and rescue robot using intelligent remote control system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent remote control system for a mechanical arm and a rescue robot using the intelligent remote control system. The intelligent remote control system for the mechanical arm comprises a sensor, a mechanical arm action system, a wireless signal transmission device and a wireless signal receiving device, wherein the mechanical arm action system and the wireless signal receiving device are arranged on the mechanical arm, and are connected; and the sensor is connected with the wireless signal transmission device which is in communication connection with the wireless signal receiving device. A human arm acts to control the mechanical arm to carry out approximate or similar human arm actions, so that the mechanical arm can better finish an action command transmitted by an operator during rescue; the rescue robot advances under various road conditions through a caterpillar track, so that advancement difficulty caused by the obstruction of ground unevenness is avoided; and an infrared detector and an ultrasonic detector are both used for detection, so that damage to a human body caused by radiation of ultrasonic waves is reduced, the problem that the infrared detection distance is short is also solved, and radiation to a trapped person is maximally lowered.

title_en: Fire scene rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire scene rescue robot, which comprises a base, a control unit, a camera, a mechanical arm, a safety cabin and a plurality of crawler wheels, wherein the mechanical arm is in transmission connection with the base through a first motor; the first motor is electrically connected with the control unit; the control unit and the camera are in communication connection with a remote control center; the crawler wheels are fixed on both sides of the base in a transmission way through a second motor; the second motor is electrically connected with the control unit; and the safety cabin is fixed on the base. Due to the adoption of the fire scene rescue robot disclosed by the utility model, a robot which can go upstairs and downstairs easily and can be used for rescuing effectively is realized; and the fire scene rescue robot has the advantages of high stability and high security.
assignees: SHANGHAI JING AN DISTR YOUTH ACTIVITY CT

title_en: Search and rescue system based on crawler robots
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue system based on crawler robots. A network system consists of three types of crawler robots, i.e. a relay robot, a front-end robot and a tail-end robot; the robots are networked and communicated through a ZigBee technology; a search and rescue network is built through the advance of the robots; and trapped person search and rescue, position determination, thermal infrared image transmission and Bluetooth voice intercom are contained in the whole system. The system has the benefits that a rapid networking strategy of ZigBee is applied to robot bodies, the underground rescue network is networked and built by utilizing the dynamic and parallel advance of the robots, and the positioning of underground staff when mine disasters occur and the acquisition of environmental information are realized.

title_en: Vertical take off/landing and balance system for aerial vehicles
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system providing vertical take off and landing for military aircrafts or civilian airplanes, unmanned aerial vehicles and so on. The rotating fans working with electric motor taking electricity from the very powerful generator integrated with the main motor, provides balance and take off-landing of aerial vehicle. The rotors, which haven't axis shafts, belonging to special designed electric motors, rotates with the spiral fan blades integrated with the rotor in the magnetic shell supporting with bearings. The system uses the advantages of direct driver technology and brushless electric motor together. This system doesn't cause an environmental pollution and a noise pollution and works with high efficiency for years. Both production and also maintenance of this system are very easy. The project relates to a system providing a feature of vertical take off and landing as well as to remain in the air without motion for hours at the point determined beforehand. This feature enables all aerial vehicles used for search and rescue operations and also special military missions successfully.

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue robot. The rescue robot comprises an article placing platform and a bodywork advancing driving mechanism arranged below the article placing platform, and is characterized in that a sweep type mechanical arm assembly is arranged on the article placing platform, the front end of the article placing platform is connected with a shovel in a coupling mode, and a shovel rotating driving mechanism is arranged on the article placing platform. The rescue robot has the advantages that due to the facts that the sweep type mechanical arm assembly is arranged on the article placing platform and the front end of the article placing platform is connected with the shovel in a coupling mode, through cooperation of the sweep type mechanical arm assembly and the shovel, rescue is implemented in an object sweeping method, and work efficiency is high; due to the fact that an auxiliary wheel mechanism is further arranged on one side of the article placing platform, when the rescue robot meets with a bridge floor wider than a bodywork, the lateral auxiliary wheel mechanism can be put down so as to help the robot to cross a bridge smoothly.

title_en: A kind of imitative floating jump type search and rescue robot of jellyfish flea formula
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of imitative floating jump type search and rescue robot of jellyfish flea formula, comprise the flotation gear be connected from top to bottom successively, bracing or strutting arrangement, control device and bouncer, described control device comprises automatic inflation mechanism and the take-off controlling organization for controlling bouncer take-off, described automatic inflation mechanism pipeline is connected on the puff prot in each face of flotation gear, control and regulation automatic inflation mechanism is also provided with in described control device, the single chip control module that take-off controlling organization runs, described single chip control module connects with the various sensor signals of testing environment.The present invention uses bionics principle, this search and rescue robot copies the floating and flea of jellyfish to jump design organization, realize floating and two kinds of functions of jumping, simple and ingenious structure, multiple functional perfect, and ground traffic information can be detected at any time, again traffic information is judged, select track route, thus various complicated landform can be adapted to, and working stability, dependable performance.

title_en: Quadruped robot with regulating and control device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a quadruped robot, in particular to a quadruped robot with a regulating and control device. The quadruped robot with regulating and control device aims at solving the problems that a quadruped robot walking mechanism in the prior art is excessive in freedom, complex in control system, large in energy consumption, and is not prone to long-time stable walking of a quadruped robot under load-bearing conditions. The robot comprises an outer frame, a power control mechanism, a walking mechanism and a power regulating and control device. The outer frame comprises a body steel frame and a base plate support board. The power control mechanism comprises a stepping motor and a controller. The walking mechanism comprises thighs, cruses and feet. The power regulating and control mechanism comprises a fore limb driven gear, a worm, a worm gear, a driving gear, a hind limb driven gear, a short shaft, a long shaft, a worm support frame, a short frame support frame, a long shaft support frame, a crank, a crank connecting pin, a crank connecting rod and a bearing. The quadruped robot with regulating and control device is used for the field of search and rescue, and detection.

title_en: Exploring robot workstation in hazardous areas
abstract_en: Provided is an exploring robot workstation in hazardous areas. The basic unit of the exploring robot workstation in hazardous areas comprises a steel carriage which is anti-corrosion, totally-enclosed, filled with inert gases, positive pressurized and explosive-proof and a running mechanism back driving wheel composed of a back driving wheel, a front idler, a front bearing wheel, a back bearing wheel and a tension wheel. The back driving wheel, the front idler, the front bearing wheel, the back bearing wheel and the tension wheel use rubber double-sided teeth tracks. The ability of climbing stairs is improved by the special arrangement of wheel treads and the controlling of tensions. A storage battery is the power of a vehicle. A left driving adjustable-speed motor and a right adjustable-speed motor are respectively driven by the storage battery. The vehicle controlling is accomplished by PLC (programmable logic controller). The vehicle operating is implemented by a speed adjustable brushless motor driving module. The hazardous area exploring robot workstation is a distributed control and cluster operating system formed by a plurality of robots which are capable of running and operating with remote controlling, anti-corrosion and explosive-proof and a portable rear mounted controlling platform. The detection robot workstation in hazardous areas replaces human to enter into dangerous areas and conduct operation in non-living environments of counter terrorist attacks, mine search and rescue, chemical emergencies, radiation source detection and the like.

title_en: Four-footed walking robot transmission device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a four-footed walking robot transmission device, and relates to a robot transmission device. The four-footed walking robot transmission device solves the problems in the prior art that a four-footed walking robot transmission mechanism is bad in reliability, large in overall size and high in redundancy rate of unnecessary structures. A base plate supporting plate is arranged on the bottom portion of a body steel frame. A gear supporting frame, a worm supporting frame and a stepping motor supporting frame are fixedly installed on the base plate supporting plate. A control system is installed on the body steel frame. A stepping motor is driven by the control system and installed on the stepping motor supporting frame. An output shaft of the stepping motor is connected with a worm in a transmission mode. The worm is installed on the worm supporting frame. The worm is meshed with a worm wheel in the transmission mode. The worm wheel and a driving gear are installed on a first shaft. The driving gear is respectively meshed with a foreleg driven gear and a hind leg driven gear in the transmission mode. The foreleg driven gear is installed on the gear supporting frame. The four-footed walking robot transmission device is applicable to the fields of detection and search-and-rescue.

title_en: Search and rescue robot based on remote control
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue robot based on remote control. The search and rescue robot comprises a motor driving circuit, an infrared detection circuit, a smoke detection circuit, an alarm circuit, a power supply voltage stabilizing circuit, a serial communication circuit, a singlechip circuit and a bluetooth transmission circuit and judges whether a survivor is found by the cooperation of a thermal electricity discharge infrared sensor and a high-definition camera. By the bluetooth transmission circuit, a computer can remotely control the movement direction of the search and rescue robot, the robot transmits video signals of the camera to an upper computer by a wireless network, so that search and rescue personnel can master the condition of the search and rescue site. When the search and rescue robot encounters barriers, robot arms are operated to remove the barriers, or the robot keeps away from the barriers according to the transmission information. Once the thermal release infrared sensor senses a survivor, a buzzer gives out an alarm. The personnel for remote control can use a vehicle-mounted mechanical arm to transport objects covering the survivor in proper time, and meanwhile, nutrient solution is delivered to a trapped person so as to maintain the life.

title_en: Building system and method of wireless communication network for emergency rescue in underground coal mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building system and method of a wireless communication network for emergency rescue in an underground coal mine. The system comprises a rescue commanding center computer and a rescue robot system. The rescue robot system comprises a carrying robot, a probe robot placed in a robot storage cabin, and a wireless communication relay placing system which places a communication network robot and is placed in a placing system storage cabin. The wireless communication relay placing system comprises a wireless communication relay placing device and a wireless communication relay. The method comprises the steps that first, the carrying robot detects and processes signals, the placing device in the placing system storage cabin casts the wireless communication relay and draws an emergency rescue wireless communication network link map; then, the communication network robot is placed to detect and process the signals and the wireless communication relay is cast to update the map till the underground emergency wireless communication network is built. The system and the method are reasonable in design, strong in practicality and high in popularization and application value.

title_en: Mine lift capsule
abstract_en: A mine lift capsule comprises a capsule door-extending and -retracting mechanism (2) and a capsule body (4), and a capsule door (11) is connected with the capsule body (4) through the capsule door-extending and -retracting mechanism (2), and can be downwardly turned to open with the capsule door bottom as a center; a flexible supporting seat (8) and landing supporting mechanisms (7) are mounted on the bottom of the capsule body (4), and the landing supporting mechanisms (7) are evenly mounted on the outer wall of the capsule body (4). The mine lift capsule as a transporting tool is controlled and operated by a ground industrial control terminal, a rescue robot is mounted into the mine lift capsule, a ground traction winch is utilized to hoist the mine lift capsule into the borehole of the incident, so that the exploratory rescue robot or emergency rescue articles for emergency rescue rapidly reach the bottom of the borehole via the borehole, and thereby casualties can be reduced to the max.
assignees: TANGSHAN KAICHENG ELECTRONIC CONTROL EQUIPMENT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Software robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a software robot. The software robot can be applied to unstructured working environments like pipeline maintenance, search and rescue in the ruins and military reconnaissance and the like. The software robot comprises a basal body, a differential magnetic rigid unit or differential magnetic polymer composite materials, a control power supply and a control circuit. The basal body comprises a head portion, a neck portion, a trunk portion, feet and a tail portion. The differential magnetic rigid unit or differential magnetic polymer composite materials are in a small and slice-shaped structure. Four or more than four channels are arranged upward on the inner circumference of the trunk portion. The differential magnetic rigid unit or differential magnetic polymer composite materials are embedded into the channel along axial direction. The overall bending and peristalsis are realized through controlling retracted quantity of the differential magnetic rigid unit or differential magnetic polymer composite materials. The software robot utilizes a built-in power supply. The whole circuit is covered in the basal body, and environmental erosion and damage are prevented. Processability and elasticity of mouldings are good, and actions of the mouldings are sensitive and continuous.

title_en: Jellyfish imitation flea-type floating-and-bouncing-type search-and-rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a jellyfish imitation flea-type floating-and-bouncing-type search-and-rescue robot which comprises a floating device, a supporting device, a controlling device and a bouncing device which are connected in sequence from top to bottom. The controlling device comprises automatic inflating mechanisms and a take-off controlling device used for controlling take-off of the bouncing device. The automatic inflating mechanisms are connected on air jet holes on surfaces of the floating device through pipelines. A single-chip microcomputer control module used for controlling and adjusting the operation of the automatic inflating mechanisms and the take-off controlling device is arranged in the controlling device, and the single-chip microcomputer control module is connected with various sensing signals used for detecting environment. The jellyfish imitation flea-type floating-and-bouncing-type search-and-rescue robot utilizes the bionics principle, imitates floating of a jellyfish and bouncing of a flea to design a mechanism, and then achieves the two functions of floating and bouncing. The jellyfish imitation flea-type floating-and-bouncing-type search-and-rescue robot is simple and ingenious in structure, complete and perfect in function, and capable of detecting ground traffic information at any time, then judging the ground traffic information and choosing a walking route. Accordingly, the jellyfish imitation flea-type floating-and-bouncing-type search-and-rescue robot can be suitable for various kinds of complex terrain, and is stable in working and reliable in performance.

title_en: Underground coal mine disaster information detection robot platform
abstract_en: An underground coal mine disaster information detection robot platform comprises a track platform and a walking mechanism which is arranged on the track platform in a sliding mode. The walking mechanism is provided with an information detection robot. The track platform is provided with at least two supporting cross rods. One supporting cross rod is provided with a fixing support and the other supporting cross rod is provided with a telescopic support. An experiment platform which uses the track platform as a framework is constructed. The underground coal mine disaster information detection robot platform is compact in structure, flexible, small in size, easy to operate, high in intelligence, and capable of enabling the information detection robot to rapidly accurately reach the place nearest to a disaster site and enabling the information detection robot to move forward and backward and suspend in order to conduct information detection and a search-and-rescue operation. The inclination of the track platform can be adjusted through the telescopic support in order to conduct the experiment on gradeability of the information detection robot.

title_en: Gas concentration real-time monitoring system of underground coal mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas concentration real-time monitoring system of an underground coal mine. The gas concentration real-time monitoring system of the underground coal mine comprises an upper monitoring host and a plurality of underground coal mine gas concentration monitoring robots. Each underground coal mine gas concentration monitoring robot comprises a robot body, a walk chassis, an electric walk drive mechanism and an electronic circuit board. A gas concentration monitoring unit, a walk position monitoring unit, a walk direction monitoring unit, a data processor, a first parameter input unit, a second parameter input unit, an alarm indicating unit, a data storage unit, a long-distance wireless communication unit and a clock circuit are arranged on the electronic circuit board, wherein the data processor is used for drawing a changing curve of gas concentration of an area under monitoring along with time according to information monitored by the gas concentration monitoring unit. The gas concentration real-time monitoring system of the underground coal mine has the advantages of being reasonable in structural design, convenient to operate, high in intelligent degree, good in using effect, capable of synchronously monitoring gas concentration around a search-and-rescue area, and capable of automatically carrying out analysis on changing situations of the gas concentration.
assignees: XI AN KUOLI MECHANICAL & ELECTRICAL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Gas concentration real-time monitoring robot of underground coal mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas concentration real-time monitoring robot of an underground coal mine. The gas concentration real-time monitoring robot of the underground coal mine comprises a robot body, a walk chassis, an electric walk drive mechanism and an electronic circuit board. A gas concentration monitoring unit, a walk position monitoring unit, a walk direction monitoring unit, a data processor, a first parameter input unit, a second parameter input unit, an alarm indicating unit, a data storage unit and a clock circuit are arranged on the electronic circuit board, wherein the data processor is used for drawing a changing curve of gas concentration of an area under monitoring along with time according to information monitored by the gas concentration monitoring unit, and correspondingly calculating a change rate of the gas concentration at each moment, the first parameter input unit is used for inputting a gas concentration alarm threshold value, the second parameter input unit is used for inputting a gas concentration change rate alarm threshold value, and the alarm indicating unit and the data storage unit are controlled by the data processor. The gas concentration real-time monitoring robot of the underground coal mine has the advantages of being reasonable in structural design, convenient to operate, high in intelligent degree, good in using effect, capable of synchronously monitoring gas concentration around a search-and-rescue area, and capable of automatically carrying out analysis on changing situations of the gas concentration.
assignees: XI AN KUOLI MECHANICAL & ELECTRICAL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Multi-form real-time information transmission rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-form real-time information transmission rescue robot. The multi-form real-time information transmission rescue robot comprises wheel-leg conversion mechanisms, flying devices, a real-time image acquisition and transmission device and a control system. Each wheel-leg conversion mechanism comprises a horizontal movement steering gear, a vertical rotation steering gear, a wheel rotation steering gear and a universal wheel, wherein the horizontal movement steering gear is connected with the vertical rotation steering gear through two connecting plates which cross each other, the wheel rotation steering gear is connected with the vertical rotation steering gear through a wheel-leg conversion plate, and the wheel rotation steering gear is connected with the universal wheel. Each flying device comprises a brushless motor, a flight controller, an attitude sensor, a brushless electronic stability control, a rotor support and a propeller, wherein the propeller is disposed at the end of the rotor support, and the brushless motor is connected with propeller through the brushless electronic stability control. The real-time image acquisition and transmission device comprises a camera module and a rotation steering gear, wherein a signal wire of the camera module is connected with the control system. The multi-form real-time information transmission rescue robot is applicable to disaster sites such as earthquake, mine, and terrorist blasting, and is highly flexible, highly maneuverable and convenient and practical.

title_en: Accurate positioning fire search-and-rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an accurate positioning fire search-and-rescue robot. The accurate positioning fire search-and-rescue robot comprises a robot body, wherein a master control system, three global position system (GPS) satellite positioning modules, an attitude sensing system, a global system for mobile communication (GSM) multimedia message module, five series port video camera, a environment detecting system, a wireless data transmission module, a caterpillar drive mechanism and a high-performance storage battery are installed on the robot body. The master control system is connected with the attitude sensing system to obtain present multi-spindle attitude information of the robot. The master control system is connected with the three GPS modules to obtain three groups of positioning information, and the master control system is relevant to the attitude information, and accurate positioning information of the robot can be obtained through an accurate positioning algorithm. The master control system is connected with the caterpillar drive mechanism to achieve motion control of the robot. The accurate positioning fire search-and-rescue robot can be suitable for application of searching and rescuing under fire environment and the like.

title_en: Coal mine assisting rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a coal mine assisting rescue robot which comprises a robot body, standby power supply, a power socket, a walking mechanism, an electric walking driving mechanism, a fixed floodlight, a moveable floodlight, a food storage case, a GPS (Global Position System) locating unit, an underground environment condition detection device and an electronic circuit board which is arranged inside the robot body; the fixed floodlight and the moveable floodlight are connected with the standby power supply; an electromagnetic control switch I is in series connection with a power supply circuit which is arranged between the fixed floodlight and the standby power supply; a manual control switch I is connected with the electromagnetic control switch I in a parallel mode; an electromagnetic control switch II is in series connection with the power supply circuit which is arranged between the moveable floodlight and the standby power supply, a manual control switch II is connected with the electromagnetic control switch II in a parallel mode; and the standby power supply is connected with a controller I. The coal mine assisting rescue robot has the advantages of being reasonable in structural design, rapid in movement speed, convenient to utilize and operate, good in utilization effect and capable of providing safe evacuation routes and a plurality of emergency facilities.
assignees: XI AN ZHONGZHI HUIZE PHOTOELECTRIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Folding unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a folding unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises an aerial vehicle body and wings, wherein the two wings are respectively and symmetrically arranged at the two sides of the aerial vehicle body; one ends of the wings are respectively articulated on wing main shafts which are arranged in the middle in the aerial vehicle body in a coaxial way; two wing pass in and out through grooves are respectively and horizontally arranged at the wing installation positions at the two sides of the aerial vehicle body; and the wings are respectively driven and controlled by an electric/ pneumatic device arranged at the lower part in the aerial vehicle body, and swing and rotate around the wing main shafts. The folding unmanned aerial vehicle is flexible to use, wide in usage, rapid in use, slow in flight speed, low in height, convenient to operate by an operator and rapid in response speed, does not need preparation time, and can be used for tasks such as exploration, search and rescue and measurement, and is wide in application scope.
assignees: CHINA TIMES AEROSPACE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Rescue robot for polymorphic real-time information transmission
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rescue robot for polymorphic real-time information transmission. The robot comprises a wheel foot conversion mechanism, a flying device, a real-time image collection and transmission device and a control system, wherein the wheel foot conversion mechanism comprises a horizontal mobile steering engine, a vertical rotary steering engine, a rotor rotary steering engine and a universal wheel; the horizontal mobile steering engine and the vertical rotary steering engine are connected through a wheel foot conversion plate; the rotor rotary steering engine is connected with the universal wheel; the flying device comprises a brushless motor, a flying controller, a gesture sensor, a brushless electronic speed controller, a rotor wing bracket and a spiral blade; the spiral blade is installed at the end of the rotor wing bracket; the brushless motor is connected with the spiral blade through the brushless electronic speed controller; the real-time image collection and transmission device comprises a camera module and a rotary steering engine; and the signal line of the camera module is connected with a control system. The rescue robot provided by the utility model can be applied to disaster fields of earthquake, coal mine, terrorist bombing and the like, and is good in agility, strong in mobility and convenient and practical.

title_en: Screw drilling robot with underground detection function
abstract_en: The invention relates to a screw drilling robot with an underground detection function. The screw drilling robot comprises a screw drilling system for cutting soil and providing forward power, a steering system for adjusting a drilling direction, a detection system for detecting surrounding environment of the robot, and a control system for processing detection information and regulating and controlling motion, wherein the drilling system is connected with the steering system; the control system is in communication connection with the detection system, the drilling system and the steering system; the robot can freely drill and turn underground, and explores the surrounding environment in real time by utilizing the detection system, so that motion directions are adjusted; and the robot is connected with ground equipment through compound cables, so that energy can be acquired and information can be fed back, and ground crews conveniently carry out remote real-time monitoring. The screw drilling robot with the underground detection function is compact in structure and flexible in movement, can drill in a closed environment under the ground, can detect the surrounding environment and specific objectives, and is suitable for underground exploration and mine disaster search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Bionic hexapod robot
abstract_en: A bionic hexapod robot is manufactured through imitation of flexible structure characteristics of a cockroach and has the advantages which human beings can not compare. The bionic hexapod robot can flexibly pass through a disorderly ruin and conduct works such as search and rescue. The bionic hexapod robot is small in size and the size of the bionic hexapod robot can be adjusted appropriately according to environments. Each foot has three degrees of freedom. The feet are driven by three steering engines and have 18 degrees of freedom in total, four gaits are adopted so that the gaits of the bionic hexapod robot are various, various and complex environments can be adapted, and even through the bionic hexapod robot is turned over, the bionic hexapod robot can move under the condition that work is not influenced.

title_en: Robot capable of climbing stairs to carry out search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a robot capable of climbing stairs to carry out search and rescue. The robot capable of climbing the stairs to carry out search and rescue comprises a movement mechanism and a control mechanism. The movement mechanism is composed of four planet gear sets. Two planet gear sets which serve as a group are arranged on one side of the bottom of a vehicle body, and another two planet gear sets which serve as a group are arranged on another side of the bottom of the vehicle body in a symmetrical mode. Each planet gear set comprises a center gear, two transmission wheels, six transmission gears, two direct-current servo motors, a wheel frame and three wheels. The center gear is connected in the center of the wheel frame through a rotary shaft. The output end of the rotary shaft is connected with a first direct-current servo motor through a first transmission wheel in a coaxial mode. The first transmission wheel is connected with a second direct-current servo motor in a coaxial mode after being meshed with a second transmission wheel. The two direct-current servo motors are both controlled by the control mechanism to work. On the same side of the center gear, the three supports of the wheel frame are respectively provided with a pair of transmission gears which are meshed with each other, transmission gears which are close to the center of the wheel frame are meshed with the center gear, and transmission gears which are far away from the center of the wheel frame are connected with the wheels in a coaxial mode. The robot capable of climbing the stairs to carry out search and rescue can be widely applied to various environments needing rescue or special environments.

title_en: Spherical impeller robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spherical impeller robot. The spherical impeller robot comprises two oppositely arranged hemispherical impeller devices, a center shaft penetrating into the two hemispherical impeller devices and a barrier crossing auxiliary mechanism located between the two hemispherical impeller devices. The barrier crossing auxiliary mechanism comprises a middle box connected to the center shaft, two oppositely arranged guide rails fixedly installed on the middle box, a sliding cross bar matched with the two guide rails, a lead screw fixed with the sliding cross bar, a nut matched with the lead screw, a nut driving mechanism driving the nut to rotate and a bottom support mechanism fixed with the lead screw. The spherical impeller robot can walk through a track, is particularly suitable for search and rescue, has various motion modes, turns flexibly and accurately, is shockproof and fall-resistant, can obtain external environment information well, has strong adaptability for various complex environments and can also pass a barrier smoothly when met with the barrier of a certain height.
