title_en: Nuclear power station rescue robot pose leveling block
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of mobile robot's pose leveling block. Comprise the laser sensor that robot, robot carry, camera, video encoder, wireless routing, the pose of nuclear power station is corrected object of reference-slope, notch and baffle plate, host computer wireless routing and host computer. Erect with cement or plank the fixed ramp that pose is known on nuclear power station ground, the left and right sides on slope is adjacent to two baffle plates to be connected and to fix with slope by bolt, bore several holes as notch in the by-level region of baffle plate, the degree of depth of notch and number are determined by actual information amount demand; Host computer staff views slope by host computer, in the time that robot motion arrives stage casing, slope, measures the degree of depth of digging at the notch of baffle plate by the laser sensor that is contained in both sides, obtains the current position coordinates of robot, and implements rectification. The present invention can use at the nuclear power station without any power supply that overweight large nuclear leakage occurs.

title_en: Multifunctional hydraulic rescue robot
abstract_en: A multifunctional hydraulic rescue robot belongs to the technical field of robots. The robot can replace rescuers to enter dangerous or narrow spaces to conduct rescue, is simple in structure and complete in functions, and does not rely on power facilities. The robot comprises an advancing mechanism, a ditch crossing mechanism, a lifting mechanism and an obstacle clearing mechanism. The advancing mechanism is composed of a front wheel assembly and a back wheel assembly. The ditch crossing mechanism is composed of a base plate, a ditch crossing back wheel, a ditch crossing back chain wheel, a ditch crossing motor wheel, a rack, a ditch crossing chain, a ditch crossing front chain wheel, idler wheels, a left swing arm and a right swing arm. The lifting mechanism is composed of a hydraulic cylinder, a hydraulic cylinder base, a lead screw, a sliding block, a support rod, a hydraulic support and a bearing. The obstacle clearing mechanism is composed of a threaded rod, a front obstacle clearing support, a back obstacle clearing support, a baffle, a first gear, a second gear, a third gear, a square hole cylinder, a square rod, an obstacle clearing lead screw, a square rod gear, an obstacle clearing lead screw gear and a transmission gear.

title_en: Device for decongesting search and rescue route in advance based on automatic search of search and rescue target
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for decongesting a search and rescue route in advance based on automatic search of a search and rescue target. The device comprises a small-sized automatic search mechanism and a road decongesting robot which moves forward synchronously along with the small-sized automatic search mechanism, wherein the small-sized automatic search mechanism comprises a horizontal supporting rod, a travelling driving mechanism, a direction detection unit used for detecting the length direction of the horizontal supporting rod, a position detection unit used for detecting the central position of the horizontal supporting rod, an electronic circuit board I and a vital sign detector mounted above the horizontal supporting rod; and the road decongesting robot comprises a robot body, a travelling mechanism II, an electric motor driving mechanism II, a barrier size detection unit, a distance detection unit, a GPS (global position system) communication unit and a plurality of electric barrier-removing mechanisms. The device is reasonable in structural design, high in moving speed, simple and convenient to operate and good in use effect; the small-sized automatic search mechanism is adopted and matched with the road decongesting robot; and the device can decongest the search and rescue route in advance according to the search and rescue target.
assignees: XI AN ZHONGZHI HUIZE PHOTOELECTRIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Emergency rescue robot
title_ko: 응급 구조용 로봇
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A rescue robot for emergencies is provided to arrange a storing space which is formed by a body unit to close on the bottom and to improve the stability by minimizing the impact applied to a patient when saving a life. CONSTITUTION: A rescue robot (30) for emergencies comprises a body unit (10), a driving unit (20), and a robot (1) for rescuing. The body unit includes a storing space (16) inside. The body unit includes a first lateral surface unit (11), a second lateral surface unit (13), a rear surface unit (14), and a front surface unit (15). The first and second lateral surface units are extended in parallel in a perpendicular direction from an upper surface unit (12). The rear surface unit is extended in a vertical direction from the upper surface unit and is connected to the first and second lateral surface units. The front surface unit faces the rear surface unit and is fixed to rotate with the upper surface unit. The driving unit is fixed inside the lateral surface units and moves the body unit. The robot is stored in the lowermost storing space.
abstract_ko: 구조용 로봇은 몸체부, 구동부 및 베드부를 포함한다.  상기 몸체부는 상면부, 상기 상면부로부터 수직한 방향으로 서로 평행하게 연장된 제1 및 제2 측면부들, 상기 상면부로부터 수직한 방향으로 연장되며 상기 제1 및 제2 측면부들과 연결된 후면부, 및 상기 후면부에 마주하며 상기 상면부와 회전 가능하도록 고정되는 정면부를 포함하여, 내부에 수납공간이 형성된다.  상기 구동부는 상기 몸체부의 측면부들 각각의 내부에 고정되어 상기 몸체부를 이동시킨다.  상기 베드부는 상기 수납공간의 최하단에 수납되며, 상기 몸체부에 고정된 제1 베드, 및 상기 제1 베드와 회전 가능하도록 결합되는 제2 베드를 포함한다.

title_en: Transformable search-and-rescue robot with multiple motion tread
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformable search-and-rescue robot with multiple motion tread. The transformable search-and-rescue robot comprises a head portion, a tail portion, joint portions, a trunk portion and extendable leg portions. An installation hole is arranged on the head portion, corresponding sensors, communication devices, control systems and the like can be installed according to requirements, the joint portions are in orthogonal series connection, a digital steering engine is installed, and wriggling, squirming, overturning and other motions of bionic snakes can be achieved. The trunk portion is connected with the joint portions, and a control system, batteries and the like are installed in the trunk portion. Each extendable leg portion is composed of double connection rods and provided with two steering engines, so that the extendable leg portions can achieve extending deformation, creeping and the like. A driven wheel is installed on a bottom connection rod for assisting the motions like wriggling. The transformable search-and-rescue robot can choose different motions according to different requirements, the motion modes can be independent or be combined, and adaptability and moving efficiency of the robot can be effectively improved in complex terrain environment.

title_en: Body splitting device for search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a body splitting device for a search and rescue robot. The splitting device comprises a left end cover, a right end cover, sleeves, a steering engine, a steering engine fixing plate, a connecting rod, a pin and the like. A whole body portion comprises the left end cover, the right end cover and the sleeves, the steering engine fixing plate is mounted on one sleeve through screws, the steering engine is mounted on the steering engine fixing plate through screws, one end of the connecting rod is fixed on a steering disk, the other end of the connecting rod is fixed on the pin, and the pin is used for connecting two separated sleeves. When the search and rescue robot needs to be split, the steering engine rotationally drives the steering disk to rotate, the steering disk drives the connecting rod to move, and the pin breaks away from the two sleeves by movement of the connecting rod, so that the robot is split. The splitting device has the advantage that the splitting device is simple in structure, modularized to mount and easy to machine, and the robot can be smoothly split when the robot needs to be split.

title_en: Search and rescue robot and moving pattern thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a structural design of a coal mine search and rescue robot and a moving pattern thereof. The search and rescue robot comprises a moving mechanism. The moving mechanism comprises two moving bodies. The two moving bodies are connected in sequence by two rigid rods in order of one moving body, one rigid rod, the other rigid rod and the other moving body, and each moving body is provided with two motors. The search and rescue robot is characterized in that the two moving bodies are respectively of a double-crawler-type structure, and each crawler is driven by one of the motors. When the search and rescue robot moves, under the matching of the four drive motors, a gear of which two parts are connected is driven by a fifth motor, and therefore, the front half part is jacked to cross an obstacle, and then, the rear half part is driven by the first half part to cross the obstacle. The search and rescue robot is better in passing ability and flexibility, and the search and rescue accuracy and efficiency are improved.

title_en: Exploring and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an exploring and rescue robot, which comprises a frame and a controller, wherein a camera and a master controller for controlling the camera are mounted on the top of the frame, the controller is used for remotely controlling the master controller; the frame comprises four supporting plates which are sequentially articulated end to end in the same plane to form an equilateral quadrilateral, a telescopic device for driving the opposite angles of the frame to relatively move is mounted between any one pair of opposite angles of the frame, the left side and right side of the chassis are respectively provided with a slide rail which is extended forward and backward, sliders on which supporting shafts are rotatably sleeved are respectively mounted on the front part and the back part inside the slide rails in a sliding manner, power mechanisms for driving the supporting shafts to rotate are mounted on the slide rails, and the power mechanisms, a motor and the telescopic device are controlled by the master controller to operate. The exploring and rescue robot can change self width to pass through different gaps, has simple path-broadening or obstacle-moving functions, is convenient to operate, and is particularly suitable for exploration and rescue in the ruins of geological disasters.

title_en: Coal mine search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a coal mine search and rescue robot which comprises two moving bodies, machine frames and two connecting rods, wherein crawler belts on the left and right edges are arranged on the moving bodies respectively; the machine frames forms the supporting structures of the moving bodies respectively, thereby enabling each moving body to be rigid; the moving bodies are hinged to each other in a relative front-and-back movement way through the connecting rods; each connecting rod is provided with a connecting rod gear wheel fixed at one end where the connecting rods are adjacent; one connecting rod gear wheel can be synchronously and rotationally connected with a connecting rod gear wheel motor. The search and rescue robot is good in passing ability and flexibility, so that the search and rescue accuracy and efficiency are improved.

title_en: Remote-sensing-control forestry-patrol unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a remote-sensing-control forestry-patrol unmanned aerial vehicle. The unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body. A power propulsion system, a flight control system and remote sensing equipment are arranged in the unmanned aerial vehicle body. The power propulsion system is provided with a fault determination apparatus. The flight control system possesses a radio remote control device and a satellite signal control system. The remote sensing equipment possesses a camera shooting system which is formed by a camera and a television camera. A shell of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is provided with a solar cell panel. The solar cell panel provides power for an electronic component in the unmanned aerial vehicle through a storage battery. The structure of the unmanned aerial vehicle of the utility model is simple. A system composition is clear and functions are comprehensive and rich. A requirement of the forestry patrol can be satisfied. Generations of disasters of fire and the like can be effectively prevented. The unmanned aerial vehicle can be used for prevention of the fire and some search and rescue investigation work.

title_en: Marine search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of marine search and rescue, and particularly relates to a marine search and rescue system which is high in reliability and strong in pertinence. The marine search and rescue system comprises a visible image sensor, an infrared image sensor, two video ADCs (Analog to Digital Converters), an image processing platform, a display interface, a display and a search and rescue vessel, wherein the visible image sensor and the infrared image sensor are respectively connected with the video ADCs, the video ADCs and the display interface are also connected with the image processing platform through a corresponding I/O (Input/Output) interface, the other end of the display interface is connected with a monitor, the other end of the monitor is connected with the search and rescue vessel, and the search and rescue vessel is connected with the visible image sensor and the infrared image sensor through a console control technology.
assignees: Shenyang chuangda technology trade market co ltd

title_en: Moving mechanism of search-and-rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the design of a search-and-rescue robot, specifically to the design of a moving mechanism of a search-and-rescue robot. The moving mechanism comprises two moving bodies, the two moving bodies are sequentially connected through two rigid rods in the sequence of a moving body, a rigid rod, the other rigid rod, and the other moving body, and each moving body is provided with two motors. The moving mechanism is characterized in that the two moving bodies are of a double-crawler belt type structure, each crawler belt is driven by a motor. The search-and-rescue robot has relatively good passing ability and flexibility, thereby improving accuracy and efficiency of search and rescue.

title_en: A kind of life detection and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of life detection and rescue robot, comprise housing, guider, running gear, conveying pipeline, call module and peripheral control unit matching used with robot, guider is arranged on housing forward end, housing cavity is provided with microcontroller and positioner, conveying pipeline front end passes from guider, and rear end is passed from housing afterbody by housing cavity, and call module is separately positioned in guider and housing afterbody, running gear is gyro wheel, is arranged on housing both sides.This robot can when earthquake and Post disaster relief bad environments, complete the searching detection to life, position determines and implement multinomial rescue etc., and volume is small, in rescue operations, even if robot arbitrary overturn rolls, also can walk at small space, accommodative ability of environment is strong.

title_en: Detection sensing system for remotely operating rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a detection sensing system for remotely operating a rescue robot. The detection sensing system comprises a monitoring computer, an on-board computer, a bottom control circuit unit, an image collecting and transmitting unit, a laser distance-measuring radar unit, an inertial attitude reference system unit and a detection sensor unit, wherein the bottom control circuit unit comprises a main control unit module, a pan-tilt camera driving module, a power supply module and a bottom circuit main board; the image collecting and transmitting unit comprises a pan-tilt camera and a video transmission module; the detection sensor unit comprises a temperature sensor, a sound sensor, a gas sensor and the like; the on-board computer is connected with the main control unit module through a USB (Universal Serial Bus) data interface; and the main control unit module and the pan-tile camera driving circuit module are designed to be arranged on the bottom control circuit main board through a pin type interface. The detection sensing system has good universality and higher transportability, and can be used for various types of robots such as rescue robots and domestic service robots.

title_en: Portable thermal imagery video recorder with target ranging function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable thermal imagery video recorder with a target ranging function. The portable thermal imagery video recorder with the target ranging function comprises an infrared lens, a thermal imagery detector, a core control module, an eye lens display module and eye lenses, and is characterized in that the core control module is connected with a laser ranging module; the laser ranging module and the infrared lens are of an alignment design; the farthest position is observed by an aiming device of the laser ranging module, and when an observed image is adjusted to be consistent with the imaging of the infrared lens, the alignment design of the laser ranging module and the infrared lens is realized. According to the portable thermal imagery video recorder with the target ranging function disclosed by the invention, by arranging the laser ranging module aligned with the infrared lens, the distance between a far object and a near object can be accurately measured, and is displayed by the eye lenses, and therefore, videography personnel can favorably select and align targets. The whole thermal imagery video recorder is stable and reliable, convenient and accurate in ranging, clear in imaging and long in service life, and can be widely used for fields of reconnaissance, monitoring, search and rescue, and the like.
assignees: SHANDONG SHEENRUN OPTICS & ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Deformable search-and-rescue sniffing robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deformable search-and-rescue sniffing robot, which comprises a first triangular component (A1), a second triangular component (A2), three branched chain rod groups (B1, B2 and B3) and six drive motors (1 to 6), wherein the first branched chain rod group (B1) is respectively connected with the first triangular component (A1) and the second triangular component (A2) via the first drive motor (1) and the fourth drive motor (4); the second branched chain rod group (B2) is respectively connected with the first triangular component (A1) and the second triangular component (A2) via the second drive motor (2) and the fifth drive motor (5); the third branched chain rod group (B3) is respectively connected with the first triangular component (A1) and the second triangular component (A2) via the third drive motor (3) and the sixth drive motor (6). The robot can move by mechanism deformation and can be deformed into the folded state characterized in convenience in storage and the probing state characterized in stable support. Meanwhile, camera devices on the first triangular component (A1) and the second triangular component (A2) can be used for probing the surrounding environment.

title_en: Complete-coverage underwater search and rescue device and search and rescue method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a complete-coverage underwater search and rescue device which comprises an embedded controller, a sensor system, an upper optical transceiver, a lower optical transceiver, a water face monitoring system, a manual operator and an underwater robot body. The embedded controller and the sensor system are arranged on the underwater robot body, the input end of the embedded controller is connected with the output end of the sensor system, the output end of the embedded controller is connected with the input end of the lower optical transceiver, the input end of the upper optical transceiver is connected with the output end of the lower optical transceiver, the output end of the upper optical transceiver is connected with the input end of the water face monitoring system, and the output end of the manual operator is connected with the input end of the water face monitoring system. The invention further discloses a search and rescue method for the complete-coverage underwater search and rescue device. According to the device and the system, the amount of transmission information is large, image transmission is particularly facilitated, characteristics of AUV and ROV are both taken into consideration, and complete-coverage search and rescue is carried out by means of a bio-inspired neural network model.

title_en: Small-sized high-altitude rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a small-sized high-altitude rescue robot, and relates to the technical field of simple robots. The small-sized high-altitude rescue robot comprises a robot body. A mounting board is arranged inside a shell of the robot body, a miniature reduction gear device is arranged on the mounting board, the output end of the miniature reduction gear device is connected with a driving shaft, the input end of the miniature reduction gear device is connected with a rotary shaft of a small motor, the small motor is connected with a battery through a wire, the two outer ends of the driving shaft stretch out of the two sides of the robot body and the two outer ends of the driving shaft are provided with two connecting rod structure arms with the same structure. The robot can climb to high-altitude positions, such as tall buildings and cliffs, in need of rescue through a rope to convey certain relief supplies and small tools, and is simple in structure, convenient to use and practical.

title_en: Intelligent control system and method for double-field of view thermal imager
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent control system of a double-field of view thermal imager. The intelligent control system comprises an infrared lens, a thermal imaging detector, a microprocessor, a stepping motor and a limit switch. The intelligent control system is characterized in that the microprocessor drives the stepping motor to operate through a motor driving circuit, and the input end of the microprocessor is connected with a photoelectric encoder and a temperature sensor. A control method of the intelligent control system of the double-field of view thermal imager comprises the steps of (a) detecting states, (b) moving to a starting position, (c) determining the distance of a large field of view, (d) moving to the position of the large field of view, (e) judging whether switching of fields of view is needed, (f) determining the position and temperature, (g) acquiring a reference temperature, (h) judging whether position compensation is needed, (i) switching to a small field of view, (j) determining focus bias quantity, (k) conducting forward compensation, and (l) conducting reverse compensation. The double-field of view thermal imager can be used for focus position compensation of the fields of view at different temperatures, is accurate, reliable, stable in operation, capable of meeting quick switching between the fields of view, and capable of being widely applied to many fields including weaponry, scout monitoring, people search and rescue and the like.
assignees: SHANDONG SHEENRUN OPTICS & ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Robot operating system for search, rescue and fire extinguishment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a robot operating system for search, rescue and fire extinguishment. The robot operating system comprises a remote master control center, a ground robot group and a multi-axis aerial reconnaissance robot which is located around the ground robot group, wherein the ground robot group consists of three robots, namely a barrier-removing rescue robot, a crawler fire extinguishing robot and a wheeled search and rescue robot. The robot operating system has the beneficial effects that the operating mode of reconnaissance, search and rescue work can be changed into an omnidirectional three-dimensional operating mode from single planes, so that the operating area is large, and the efficiency is high; the positions of fire sources are positioned accurately through the cooperative work of the robots, different fire extinguishing schemes are carried out for different fire sources, meanwhile, the robot group can be easily incorporated into the Internet, and fire site information is transmitted to rescue and command staff in real time by combining with an internet system, so that wounded personnel and properties are protected to the maximum.

title_en: Wheel type search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a wheel type search and rescue robot which comprises a steering engine, an aluminum driving wheel, a dry powder extinguisher and a machine frame. A holder camera is connected with the upper portion of the steering engine, the dry powder extinguisher is connected with the lower portion of the steering engine, and the aluminum driving wheel is arranged at the bottom of the dry powder extinguisher. A flame sensor is arranged above the holder camera, and the holder camera is connected with a pressure switch arranged on one side of the dry powder extinguisher. A human body sensor is arranged on the lateral side of the machine frame on the periphery of the dry powder extinguisher. The wheel type search and rescue robot has the advantage that a spider gear structure is adopted, the camera, a searchlight, a wireless router, the dry powder extinguisher and the like are arranged, and remote operation is finished through manipulators through wifi wireless communication; video images which can not be seen by rescuers on the rescue field can be shot in an all-dimensional mode, the size is small, the flexibility is good, and the robot can enter small space to finish work; remote or high-place rescuing tasks can be finished by cooperating with obstacle removing rescue robots; fire extinguishing can be operated remotely.

title_en: Modular search and rescue robot with reconfigurable function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modular search and rescue robot with a reconfigurable function and relates to a search and rescue robot in order to solve the problems that the conventional search and rescue robot has limited functions, is low in expandability and difficultly configures the search and rescue function reasonably according to the disaster in complicated search and rescue work. A first working module comprises a mobile trolley, a mobile telescoping mechanism and a cutting mechanism; the cutting mechanism is hinged to the telescoping mechanism; a mobile module and the mobile trolley comprise trolley shells and trolley body moving components; the trolley body moving components are arranged on the trolley shells; the trolley shells are rectangular box bodies, and an opening is formed in one end of each rectangular box body; the mobile module is connected with the mobile trolley through a first connection module; a first connection piece on the first connection module is fixedly connected with the trolley shell on the first working module; an insertion body on the first connection module is fixedly connected with the trolley shell on the mobile module; the mobile telescoping mechanism and the cutting mechanism are arranged in the shells on the mobile trolley through the opening in the mobile trolley. The modular search and rescue robot disclosed by the invention is used in a complicated and severe cutting environment.

title_en: Multi-parameter multi-sensor intelligent garment
abstract_en: A multi-parameter multi-sensor intelligent garment mainly comprises a waterproof breathable garment body, an intelligent module, a communication module, a miniature display, a microphone, a loudspeaker and a power supply. A central processing unit, a positioning chip, a triaxial accelerometer, a triaxial gyro, a magnetic sensor and an environment gas sensor. The intelligent module, the communication module and the power supply are sewn into the waterproof breathable garment body. The probe of the environment gas sensor is disposed at the chest part of the garment body. The microphone is disposed at the neckline part of the garment body. The loudspeaker is disposed in the hat of the garment body. The waterproof miniature display is sewn to the sleeve part. The intelligent module is connected with the power supply, the communication module, the probe of the environment gas sensor and the miniature display through wires. The multi-parameter multi-sensor intelligent garment has the advantages that activities of field personnel can be tracked and positioned accurately, the uploaded real-time data can be collected and analyzed timely, information and instructions can be provided, emergency search and rescue can be assisted, and the garment is capable of automatically detecting harmful gases.
assignees: WUXI HUISIDUN TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;FINE MEMS INC

title_en: Intelligent cruise robot based on wireless charging odd-shaft aircraft
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent cruise robot based on a wireless charging odd-shaft aircraft. The intelligent cruise robot comprises the odd-shaft aircraft and a rear end control module, wherein the odd-shaft aircraft comprises a lifting force supply module, a main control module, a rear end flight control mode module, a cradle head camera module and a wireless charging module; the lifting force supply module supplies lifting force to the odd-shaft aircraft according to a flight mode control instruction of the rear end flight control mode module; the main control module acquires environment and position data; the rear end flight control mode module controls a flight mode of the odd-shaft aircraft; the cradle head camera module acquires video data; the wireless charging module wirelessly charges the odd-shaft aircraft; the rear end control module processes or analyzes the received data. The intelligent cruise robot disclosed by the invention substitutes the human for cruising, and enter a place where is difficult to reach by the human for monitoring or enter a danger zone for detection and search by using a navigation and positioning technology and a wireless charging technology and controlling flying of the odd-shaft aircraft, thereby reducing the human cruise and the working intensity of monitoring and enhancing the safety of the detection, search and rescue in the danger zone.
assignees: CHINESE ACAD INST AUTOMATION;CLOUD COMPUTING IND TECHNOLOGY INNOVATION & INCUBATION CT CHINESE ACADEMY SCIENCES DONGGUAN CHINA

title_en: A kind of have the small-sized search and rescue robot cutting off obstacle function
abstract_en: A kind of have the small-sized search and rescue robot cutting off obstacle function, it relates to a kind of search and rescue robot, mostly be difficult to mobile to solve existing cutting robot or cutting machine mechanical arm, and relative position relation is fixed between each component of cutting arm, there is volume large, the problem of work can not be carried out in the occasion of narrow space complexity.The present invention includes cutting machine mechanical arm, travelling car, moving telescopic mechanism and cutting tool, cutting machine mechanical arm comprises cutting hand, forearm and large arm, travelling car comprises car housing and car body moving-member, car housing is the oblong box body of one end open, cutting tool is fixedly mounted on one end of cutting hand, the cutting other end of hand is connected with one end of forearm, the other end and the large arm of forearm are rotationally connected, large arm is fixedly mounted in moving telescopic mechanism, moving telescopic mechanism and large arm are all arranged in housing by the opening of car housing, car body moving-member is fixedly mounted on housing.The present invention is used for using in the severe cutting environment of circumstance complication.

title_en: Moving and flying multi-robot system used for gallery detection and search-and-rescue
abstract_en: A moving and flying multi-robot system used for gallery detection and search-and-rescue comprises an out-of-gallery commanding terminal (1), a controlling terminal (2), a moving carrier robot (4) and flying robots (5). The moving carrier robot and the controlling terminal are in communication through an optical fiber (2), the flying robots are carried to enter a gallery in a control mode of remote-control guiding and automatic obstacle avoiding, flying of a takeoff flying robot can be guided by generating a laser beam (9) through a laser generating module (8), a wireless communication network is automatically established among the robots through a wireless communication module, and the flying robots fly under combined control of laser guiding, remote control and automatic obstacle avoidance modules, transmit detection information back to the moving carrier robot and further transmit on-site detection information to the controlling terminal and the out-of-gallery commanding terminal through the moving carrier robot. Long-distance detection and search-and-rescue in the gallery are realized by adopting a mode combining moving with flying and combining the optical fiber with wireless communication.

title_en: Miniaturization foldable cutting tool for search-and-rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cutting tool, and provides a miniaturization foldable cutting tool for a search-and-rescue robot to solve the problems that an existing cutting tool is large in size and incapable of freely moving and can be helped by external force only. An L-shaped cavity is arranged in a horizontal moving cutting arm, a horizontal moving motor is fixedly installed on a horizontal moving motor supporting frame, a gear is installed on an output shaft of the horizontal moving motor and meshed with a rack, a horizontal rotating shaft is installed at the front end of the horizontal moving cutting arm, a pitching cutting arm is in key connection with the horizontal rotating shaft, a pitching motor is installed in a groove, a driving bevel gear is installed on an output shaft of the pitching motor, a driven bevel gear is meshed with the driving bevel gear and is installed on the horizontal rotating shaft, an output shaft of a rotating motor penetrates through the upper surface of the pitching cutting arm and is matched with a rotating cutting arm, a cutting head motor is installed in the rotating cutting arm, and an output shaft of the cutting head motor penetrates through the upper surface of the rotating cutting arm and is matched with a cutting head. The miniaturization foldable cutting tool is used for cutting in a search-and-rescue process.

title_en: Search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot. The search and rescue robot comprises a vehicle body and a six-degree-of-freedom manipulator, wherein the six-degree-of-freedom manipulator is arranged at the front end of the upper surface of the vehicle body, and comprises a rotating platform, a large arm, an elbow portion, a small arm and a claw. The robot is controlled by using a PC (Personal Computer) control terminal. The robot further comprises a direct-current motor and a steering engine, the small arm and the claw are controlled by using the steering engine, and the large arm and the elbow portion are controlled by using the direct-current motor. The robot further comprises a first camera and a second camera. The first camera is arranged on the small arm of the six-degree-of-freedom manipulator, and the second camera is arranged at the back end of the upper surface of the vehicle body. The six-degree-of-freedom manipulator is driven by using the motor and the steering engine together, thereby reducing the load of the robot. On the premise of ensuring certain gripping capability and the softness, the steering engine is adopted for driving instead of the motor on three joints, thereby reducing the total mass of the manipulator as well as the load of the vehicle body. The camera resources are utilized fully, binocular depth measurement is realized, and waste caused by repeated use of the same type of sensors is avoided.

title_en: Small-scale search-and-rescue robot with function of putting in
abstract_en: A small-scale search-and-rescue robot with function of putting in relates to a small-scale search-and-rescue robot used on the shoring tool for solving the problem that the existing shoring tool cannot be used for the narrow space or the environment that the human body cannot enter inside. A driving gear engaged with a first rack and a driving pulley fixed together with the driving gear are installed on an output shaft of a motor, the driving pulley is connected to a driven pulley through a belt, a driven gear is fixed together with the driven pulley and engaged with the second rack installed on a first movable plate, the first movable plate is connected to two first straight tracks in a sliding mode while two first straight tracks are formed on a second movable plate in a parallel mode, the second movable plate is connected to the motor and connected to two second straight tracks being parallel to each other in a sliding mode, and a plugboard is connected to the front end of the first movable plate through a hinge. The robot is used for supporting the heavy matter in combined utilization with other supporting tools.

title_en: Overturn-preventing surrounding crawler-type mobile mechanism
abstract_en: Overturn-preventing surrounding crawler-type mobile mechanism, it relates to a kind of travel mechanism, is specifically related to a kind of overturn-preventing surrounding crawler-type mobile mechanism.The present invention, in order to solve conventional machines people travel mechanism poor stability, deals with uncertain landform ability very low, and the problem of easily toppling.The present invention includes car body, motor, four pedrail mechanisms and driver train, car body is rectangular structure, the each side of described cuboid is each installation described pedrail mechanism respectively, motor and described driver train are fixedly mounted in car body, and the turning cylinder of motor is connected with four described pedrail mechanisms by described driver train.The present invention is used for search and rescue robot field.

title_en: Coal mine exploration robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a coal mine exploration robot, and particularly relates to an obstacle crossing and walking device. A walking main crawler belt drive motor (19) drives a walking main crawler belt (18) to achieve the walking function. A tire lifting drive motor (21) drives a tire lifting mechanism (2) to operate to achieve the walking assisting function. A rocker rotation drive motor (7) drives a rocker mechanism (1) to swing arms to achieve the obstacle crossing function. A camera (28) can transmits the underground condition of mines to the ground in a wireless mode to monitor the underground in real time. The coal mine exploration robot can provide reliable decision bases, improve search and rescue efficiency, reduce casualties to the largest extent, guarantee life safety, and reduce economical loss.

title_en: Life rescue system using overwater robot and life rescue method using the same
title_ko: 수상 구조로봇을 이용한 인명 구조시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a life-saving system using a waterborne robot and a life-saving method using the same system and, more specifically, to a life-saving system using a waterborne robot and a life-saving method using the same system capable of preventing casualties, and conducting an early dispatch of the waterborne robot to an accident spot to rescue a drowning person when a drowning accident occurs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수상 로봇을 이용한 인명 구조시스템과, 이를 이용한 인명 구조방법에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 수상 인명사고를 예방하고 수난사고 발생시, 수상의 각 지점에 대기상태에 있던 수상 구조로봇이 사고 발생지점으로 초동 출동하여 수난자를 구조하도록 한 수상 로봇을 이용한 인명 구조시스템과, 이를 이용한 인명 구조방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Coal mine underground search and rescue robot with voice notification function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine underground search and rescue robot with a voice notification function. The coal mine underground search and rescue robot comprises a robot body, a travelling chassis, an electric travelling drive mechanism and an electronic circuit board. A controller, a GPS positioning unit, an environmental information monitoring system, a data processor, a voice recording unit, a voice data storage unit, a voice player and a parameter input unit are disposed on the electronic circuit board. The data processor is used for analyzing and processing the information monitored by the environmental information monitoring system and correspondingly obtaining the environment condition danger level of the monitored area under the current state. Multiple voice information can be stored in the voice data storage unit, and the voice information is in one-to-one correspondence of possible coal mine underground environment condition danger levels. The coal mine underground search and rescue robot is reasonable in structural design, simple to operate, high in intelligence level, good in application effect, and capable of automatically analyzing and processing to obtain the environment condition danger level of the monitored area under the current state and notifying underground rescuers through the voice player.
assignees: XI AN KUOLI MECHANICAL & ELECTRICAL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Low-visibility guiding system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-visibility guiding system. The low-visibility guiding system comprises two parts, i.e., a detector front end and a fusion system, wherein the detector front end comprises a fixed base, a rotary base, an installation frame, a thermal infrared imager, a micro-optical imager, and a camera; the fusion system comprises image processing equipment and display equipment. The low-visibility guiding system can be used for auxiliary driving systems of helicopters, ships and vehicles, helps drivers to drive safely and also can be used for search and rescue and security protection in accidents and the like.
assignees: SHANGHAI CITY MINHANG DISTR INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY PROT ASS

title_en: Manipulator for disaster rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a manipulator for a disaster rescue robot. The manipulator comprises a power supply, a translational motor, a reducer coupling, a reducer, a mechanical clamp, a mechanical drill, mechanical shears, a camera, a small arm, a small arm connector, a small arm hydraulic rod, a large arm, a large arm connector, a large arm hydraulic rod, a main control plate, a rotary drive bevel gear, a rotary bevel gear, a rotary bevel gear shaft, an electromagnetic clutch, an angle sensor, a rotary small gear, a rotary large gear, a hydraulic pump, and an electromagnetic reversing valve. The manipulator is characterized in that the manipulator can operate in a 360 DEG operating range, two manipulators can operate in a matching manner, the manipulator is provided with three end mechanical hands of the mechanical clamp, the mechanical drill, and the mechanical shears which can be changed for operation in different occasions, operating efficiency of the disaster rescue robot is improved, and the operating range of the disaster rescue robot is expanded.

title_en: Rescue drone
abstract_en: To provide a rescue drone (20), for rescuing an idle drone (21), it consists of an adjustable length hook (22) to engage with the idle drone, to carry it away, an L- shaped metallic tool (27) to push the idle drone away from the middle of the road, or to help in repositioning it to be at a side that permits for the hook (22) to engage with it, an emergency light (SOS) (28), to assist while hovering over the idle drone located in a road, an electric shock stick (29), which is to be used against any person approaching the idle drone to steal it, a speaker (30) and camera (31), to assist a security person in a command center to assess the case, talk with and warn any person who is trying to steal the idle drone, or to advise and guide a volunteer who is trying to help and assist in rescuing the idle drone.

title_en: Search and rescue robot capable of moving transversely
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot capable of moving transversely. The search and rescue robot comprises a transverse moving module (1), a pitching module (2), a crawler belt moving module (3), a robot body (4) and a function module (5). The search and rescue robot is simple in structure; the special search and rescue robot can move transversely in situ and turn without angels through the transverse moving module and the pitching module and can adapt to complex search and rescue application environments.
assignees: SHANGHAI PUDONG INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY PROT ASS;YU KAI

title_en: Search and rescue path early dredge device achieving automatic searching based on searched and rescued target
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue path early dredge device achieving automatic searching based on a searched and rescued target. The search and rescue path early dredge device achieving automatic searching based on the searched and rescued target comprises a small-size automatic searching mechanism and a road dredge robot moving forwards synchronously along with the small-size automatic searching mechanism. The small-size automatic searching mechanism comprises a horizontal supporting rod, a first walking drive mechanism, a direction detection unit, a position detection unit, a first electronic circuit board and a vital sign detector, wherein the direction detection unit detects the length direction of the horizontal supporting rod; the position detection unit detects the middle of the horizontal supporting rod; the vital sign detector is installed on the horizontal supporting rod. The road dredge robot comprises a robot body, a second walking mechanism, a second electric drive mechanism, a barrier size detection unit, a barrier distance detection unit, a GPS communication unit and a plurality of fault removal mechanisms. The search and rescue path early dredge device achieving automatic searching based on the searched and rescued target is reasonable in structural design, high in movement speed, easy and convenient to operate and good in use effect, the small-size automatic searching mechanism and the road dredge robot are used in cooperation, and search and rescue paths can be dredged in advance according to the searched and rescued target.
assignees: XI AN ZHONGZHI HUIZE PHOTOELECTRIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine assisting rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine assisting rescue robot which comprises a robot body, standby power supply, a power socket, a walking mechanism, an electric walking driving mechanism, a fixed illuminating lamp, a movable illuminating lamp, a food storage case, a GPS positioning unit, an underground environment condition detection device and an electronic circuit board arranged inside the robot body. The fixed illuminating lamp and the movable illuminating lamp are connected with the standby power supply, a first electromagnetic control switch is in series connection with a power supply loop arranged between the fixed illuminating lamp and the standby power supply, a first manual control switch is connected with the first electromagnetic control switch in parallel, a second electromagnetic control switch is in series connection with a power supply loop arranged between the movable illuminating lamp and the standby power supply, a second manual control switch is connected with the second electromagnetic control switch in parallel, and the standby power supply is connected with a first controller. The coal mine assisting rescue robot has the advantages of being reasonable in structural design, high in movement speed, easy and convenient to utilize and operate, good in using effect and capable of providing safe evacuation routes and various emergency facilities for trapped persons.
assignees: XI AN ZHONGZHI HUIZE PHOTOELECTRIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire rescue robot, which consists of a flame detection shooting device, a wireless communication system, a fire extinguishing device, a three-dimensional detection radar, a central monitoring system, an automatic navigation system, a power system and a manual remote control system, wherein the flame detection shooting device consists of a flame sensor and a camera; the wireless communication system consists of a communication module; the power system consists of an electric motor and a caterpillar track. The fire rescue robot has the beneficial effects that the robot charges forwards, so that the threat to the personal safety of a firefighter is reduced; the advanced three-dimensional detection radar can be used for rapidly making a three-dimensional diagram of a current afire room, and the three-dimensional diagram of the current afire room is transmitted to a wireless remote control device held by the firefighter through the wireless communication system, so that the problem that the firefighter gets lost under the condition of heavy smoke is solved; the position of flame can be rapidly detected through the flame sensor, and a fire source can be rapidly extinguished through a mechanical arm and the carried firefighting device.
assignees: QINGDAO SANLI ZHONGDEMEI WATER EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Lifesaving system and method to save thereof
title_ko: 수상 인명 구조 시스템 및 그의 구조 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a lifesaving system in the water comprises: a control unit which controls the water environment through a camera unit in a stereo type; and a saving unit which saves a drowning person based on information provided by the control unit. The saving unit comprises: a saving robot which can save a drowning person; and a base station which provides a space where the saving robot can be anchored, and transmits the information received from the control unit to the saving robot. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the lifesaving system in the water can control the saving robot in real time capable of being in standby at the base station based on the information obtained from the control unit in order to dispatch the saving robot immediately during emergencies such as the occurrence of a drowning person, thereby rapidly dealing with the emergencies.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 수상 인명 구조 시스템은, 스테레오 타입의 촬영부를 통해 수상 환경을 관제하는 관제 유닛; 및 관제 유닛으로부터 제공되는 정보에 기초하여 익수자 발생 시 익수자를 구조하는 구조 유닛;을 포함하며, 구조 유닛은, 익수자의 구조가 가능한 구조 로봇; 및 구조 로봇의 정박이 가능한 공간을 제공하며, 관제 유닛으로부터 수신된 정보를 구조 로봇에게 전달하는 베이스 스테이션;을 포함할 수 있다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따르면, 관제 유닛으로부터 획득된 정보를 토대로 베이스 스테이션에 대기 가능한 구조 로봇을 실시간으로 제어할 수 있어, 익사자 발생 시와 같은 위급한 상황에 바로 구조 로봇을 출동시킬 수 있어 위급한 상황에 대한 대처를 신속하게 수행할 있다.

title_en: Automatic inspection robot applied to nuclear industry
abstract_en: Disclosed is an automatic inspection robot applied to the nuclear industry. The robot is designed so as to meet the automatic operation requirement of nuclear power stations and has functions of automatic insertion weld joint detection, radioactive contaminant cleaning, dangerous disaster site search and rescue and the like. An embedded computer system is used for building an inspection robot hardware platform and building a search and rescue task environment model, targets are sensed through detection sensors (such as infrared sensors and laser range finders), automatic motion planning and motion control resolving of corresponding actuators are performed through an artificial intelligence method, accordingly, the inspection robot can complete the target search operation automatically and optimally.
assignees: HARBIN WANGTENG SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Multi-section swing arm crawler-type robot for detection of mine disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-section swing arm crawler-type robot for detection of mine disasters. The robot comprises three sections of robot bodies, crawler-type traveling mechanisms, front and rear swing arm units, joint modules and power devices, wherein each section of robot body has an independent crawler-type traveling mechanism that is symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the robot body; the first and last robot bodies are respectively provided with two crawler-type swing arms; the swing arms can be controlled by a motor to rotate around the robot body; besides, crawlers of the swing arms are transmitted by driven wheels of the crawlers of the robot bodies, so as to realize synchronous rotation of the crawlers of the robot bodies and the crawlers of the swing arms; the robot bodies are connected with one another through joint devices which can realize pitching and yaw of each section of robot body; the first and last sections of robot bodies are respectively provided with the power devices; both of the two sections of robot bodies can be used to pull or push the whole robot. According to the multi-section swing arm crawler-type robot for detection of mine disasters disclosed by the invention, the integral construction of the robot is simple; the crawler-type traveling mechanisms feature excellent climbing and obstacle crossing performances; with use of the front and rear swing arms, ability of crossing vertical obstacles and relatively long gullies of the robot is improved; front and rear sets of power devices solve the problem of the robot in insufficient power in case of special terrains; utilization of multi-section construction helps greatly enhance balance and stability of the whole robot; in conclusion, a detection and rescue robot that is simple in structure, high in safety and strong in obstacle crossing ability is implemented according to the invention.

title_en: Snakelike search-and-rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a snakelike search-and-rescue robot which is composed of a plurality of modules. The modules are connected end to end, wherein the head end of the module at the head portion is provided with a camera and a light source. Each module comprises a body which can deflect in multiple directions and connection parts arranged at the two ends of the body, wherein the body comprises a plurality of hollow rings which are respectively provided with four movable connection points, the two opposite movable connection points are arranged on the upper surface of the corresponding hollow ring, and the other two movable connection points are arranged on the lower surface of the corresponding hollow ring. The adjacent hollow rings are movably connected through the movable connection points. The modules can deflect in multiple directions so that the snakelike robot can operate more flexibly in various environments. The modules are integrally wrapped by a protection net and a waterproof protection sleeve, the waterproof function is achieved, and meanwhile the service life of the robot can be effectively prolonged.

title_en: Snakelike search-and-rescue robot joint module
abstract_en: The invention discloses a snakelike search-and-rescue robot joint module. The module comprises a body which can deflect in multiple directions and connection parts arranged at the two ends of the body. The body comprises a plurality of hollow rings which are respectively provided with four movable connection points, wherein the two opposite movable connection points are arranged on the upper surface of the corresponding hollow ring, and the other two movable connection points are arranged on the lower surface of the corresponding hollow ring. The adjacent hollow rings are movably connected through the movable connection points. According to the snakelike search-and-rescue robot joint module, linear driving is adopted, the module can deflect in multiple directions, the module is wholly wrapped by a protection net, and the service life of the module can be effectively prolonged.

title_en: Folding type probing mechanical arm based on triangular configured connecting rod transmission
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a folding type probing mechanical arm based on triangular configured connecting rod transmission. The folding type probing mechanical arm comprises a telescopic mechanism, a pitching mechanism and a rotating mechanism. The telescopic mechanism comprises a telescopic motor, a telescopic lead screw, a telescopic lead screw slider, a telescopic rod and a telescopic bracket, and the telescopic motor is controlled to realize relative sliding of the telescopic rod and the telescopic bracket. The pitching mechanism comprises a pitching motor, a pitching lead screw slider, a pitching lead screw, a pitching frame, a pitching rod, a pitching rod connecting frame and a triangular configured connecting rod. The rotating mechanism comprises a rotating motor, a gearbox, a main gear and a pinion. When a robot cannot move due to spatial limit, the tail-end implementing mechanism of the robot still can stably reach any point in space coordinates within a controllable range, the tail-end implementing mechanism can be equipped with a CCD (charge coupled device) camera to observe the internal condition of a closed space and also can be equipped with a clamping mechanism. When vital signals in the closed space is observed, food, water and medicine and the like can be correspondingly provided for the first time, and search and rescue and detection task can be completed well.

title_en: Low-wind-resistance and high-balance light flying wing type unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a low-wind-resistance and high-balance light flying wing type unmanned aerial vehicle which has the main technical characteristics that a wing at each side is formed by connecting an inner-side wing and an outer-side wing which are dismantled, the front end of each inner-side wing is arranged in a vehicle body, the rear end of each inner-side wing is arranged at the rear end of the vehicle body, a flap is arranged at the rear edge of each inner-side wing, an aileron is arranged at the rear edge of each outer-side wing, the ailerons and the flaps are controlled by the driving of steering engines inside the wings and swing around the corresponding wings, and a wing tip capable of reducing the eddy resistance is installed at the tail end of each outer-side wing in an inclined manner. The low-wind-resistance and high-balance light flying wing type unmanned aerial vehicle is reasonable in design, has the characteristics of convenience in control, stability in flying, strong wind resistance capacity and the like, and can be widely applied to exploration, search and rescue, artificial rainfall, artificial haze removal, and the like; structures of a horizontal tail and a vertical tail are eliminated so that the vehicle body and the wings are integrated, the length of the vehicle body is greatly reduced, and the low-wind-resistance and high-balance light flying wing type unmanned aerial vehicle can be taken off when being mounted on a vehicle.

title_en: Snake-like search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a snake-like search and rescue robot. The snake-like search and rescue robot consists of a plurality of modules, wherein various modules are connected end to end; a camera and a light source are arranged at the head end of a module positioned at the head part; each module comprises a body capable of defecting in multiple directions and connecting parts arranged at two end parts of the body; the body comprises a plurality of hollow rings; each hollow ring is provided with four movable connecting points; two opposite movable connecting points are arranged on the upper surface of each hollow ring; another two movable connecting points are arranged on the lower surface of each hollow ring; adjacent hollow rings are movably connected through the movable connecting points. According to the snake-like search and rescue robot disclosed by the utility model, the modules can defect in the multiple directions, so that the snake-like robot operates in various environments more flexibly; each moduleis integrally wrapped with a protecting net and a waterproof projecting jacket, so that the service life of the robot can be effectively prolonged while a waterproof function is realized.

title_en: Mine rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mine rescue robot. The mine rescue robot comprises a machine body and a main crawler belt, wherein the main crawler belt is used for driving the machine body to move; an observation probe is arranged at the upper part of the machine body; a mechanical arm is arranged on front of the machine body; a climbing crawler belt is arranged at the back of the machine body; the climbing crawler belt and the main crawler belt form an integral crawler belt transmission system through a cocked transition crawler belt; a crawler wheel of the climbing crawler belt is supported by a bracket; one end of the bracket is hinged on a bracket of the transition crawler belt; the bracket is controlled to drive the climbing crawler belt to rotate around a hinge point through a piston rod of a hydraulic cylinder on the machine body, thereby adjusting the inclination angle of the climbing crawler belt. The crawler belt system consists of the main crawler belt, the transition crawler belt and the climbing crawler belt; the inclination angle of the climbing crawler belt is controlled by extension and retraction of the piston rod of the hydraulic cylinder, thereby improving the capability of the robot of climb over obstacles and the smoothness in movement; the observation probe and the mechanical arm are arranged on the robot, so that trapped persons can be found and rescued simply.

title_en: Crawler-type mining rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a crawler-type mining rescue robot. The crawler-type mining rescue robot comprises a machine body and a main crawler, wherein the main crawler is used for driving the machine body to move; an observing probe and a gas sampler are arranged at the upper part of the machine body; a mechanical hand is arranged in front of the machine body; a climbing crawler is arranged at the rear part of the machine body, crawler wheels of the climbing crawler are supported by a support frame, one end of the support frame is articulated with a support frame of a transition crawler, and the climbing crawler is controlled by a hydraulic oil cylinder on the machine body to rotate around an articulated point so as to regulate the inclined angle of the climbing crawler. According to the crawler-type rescue robot disclosed by the utility model, a crawler system is formed through the main crawler, the transition crawler and the climbing crawler and the inclination of the climbing crawler is controlled through the stretching of the piston rod of the hydraulic oil cylinder, thereby enhancing the barrier crossing capacity and movement stability of the robot; the crawler-type rescue robot disclosed by the utility model can be used for discovering trapped persons, carrying out simple rescue on the trapped persons and bringing a downhole gas sample back for analysis and assay to provide the basis for subsequent manual search and rescue by virtue of the observing probe, the mechanical hand and the gas sampler.

title_en: Search-and-rescue robot for competitions
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search-and-rescue robot for competitions, which comprises a central controller, an environment information acquisition module, a motor driving module, a power supply module, a motor and a robot vehicle body, and is characterized in that the central processing module is connected with the environment information acquisition module, the motor driving module and the power supply module, the power supply module provides power for the central controller and the motor driving module, and the robot vehicle body is used for carrying each physical device. The search-and-rescue robot for competitions can provide an optimized hardware and software design based on specific competition fields and competition rules, and provides theoretical and experimental basis for designing a large search-and-rescue robot in reality.

title_en: Underwater rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater rescue robot which comprises a frame structure, an electronic cabin group, a searchlighting system, a monitoring system, a positioning system, an operating system, a propelling system and a floatage module, wherein the propelling system comprises a left-front horizontal propeller, a right-front horizontal propeller, a left-back horizontal propeller, a right-back horizontal propeller, and a vertical propeller located at the middle of the robot, and the propelling system is used for providing power to the robot. By using the four horizontal propellers, the underwater rescue robot realizes advancing and retreating, turning and side-moving actions. The underwater rescue robot has the beneficial effects that the robot is simple in structure, flexible in movement and strong in power, and can be widely applied to resource exploration, routing inspection of structures and facility equipment, detection of channels, barrier removal, rescue of persons falling in water, searching of shipwrecks in water, fishing of vehicles and articles falling in water, and finding of underwater appointed articles after disaster accidents occur.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a maritime search and rescue system. The maritime search and rescue system is characterized by comprising an infrared image sensor, a video coder, a video server and a monitor, wherein the infrared image sensor is connected with the video server through the video coder, and the video server is connected with the monitor through a display interface. In the maritime search and rescue system, sea surface detection imaging is carried out through the infrared image sensor, images are processed, processed image information is transmitted to a video coding module, the video coding module conducts video coding on the received image information to obtain high-quality video signals, the high-quality video signals are output to the video server through a standard video interface and are transmitted to the monitor through the video server, and search and rescue work of people and objects in a sea area is completed. The maritime search and rescue system can be used for conducting fast and reliable search and rescue in the sea area with high accuracy and high efficiency.
assignees: CHENGDU JING LIN SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Method for the automated identification of real world objects
abstract_en: A method is provided for the automated identification of real world objects. The invention, implementable via various means such as a processing system, method, or data structure in a recording medium such as memory or as a self-contained electronic circuit, has wide ranging applicability to numerous fields such as in a user interface for gaming systems, like Kinect, or immersive environments such as remote surgical operations, and other medical diagnostic applications. Similarly, our method can be utilized in artificial intelligence application for automated robotic identification of targets, such as drone assisted search and rescue missions, and the enablement of patent protection against unlawful replication on 3D printers. The method of the invention includes the steps of creating a 3D representation for the real world object to be identified, segmenting the newly created 3D representation according to potential identities, alignment of minimal, unique representations for said potential identities to the corresponding segments of the newly created 3D representation, and then the analysis of said alignments to determine which potential identity correctly identifies the real world object to be identified.

title_en: caterpillar robot
abstract_en: A caterpillar robot, comprises Athey wheel, stay bearing plate, actuating device, the first worm couple and the second worm couple.Athey wheel has the first driving wheel, the second driving wheel, the first flower wheel and the second flower wheel that forms each other piston crank mechanism, and the first driving wheel connects by the first transmission shaft, and the second driving wheel connects by second driving shaft; Stay bearing plate is set up on the first transmission shaft and second driving shaft; Actuating device is installed on stay bearing plate; The two ends of actuating device are connected with the first worm couple and the second worm couple respectively, and the other end of the first worm couple and the second worm couple is connected with the first transmission shaft and second driving shaft respectively.On caterpillar robot, carry camera, so that the situation in the scene of a fire is groped, the information that staff outside the scene of a fire passes back by caterpillar robot is analyzed, to follow-up search-and-rescue work is carried out to reasonable arrangement, has improved the search-and-rescue work dynamics of fire fighter to the scene of a fire.

abstract_en: The utility model discloses one search and rescue robot under water, comprising: framed structure, electronic compartment group, searchlighting system, monitored control system, position fixing system, operating system, propulsion system, buoyant module; Propulsion system comprises: left front, right front, left back, right back four horizontal propellers and be positioned at the vertical pusher at robot middle part, propulsion system is used for providing power for robot.The utility model utilizes four horizontal propellers, realizes advance and retreat, turning and the sidesway action of robot.The beneficial effects of the utility model are: this robot mechanism is simple, maneuverability, power are strong, can be widely used in the patrolling and examining of resource exploration, structures, facilities and equipment, navigation channel detection, remove obstacles and after disaster accident occurs, persons falling in water is sued and laboured, in water search, overboard vehicle and the object localization of shipwreck salvage, the searching of specified object under water.

title_en: Multi-component robot for below ice search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to remotely operated multi-component search robots for underwater search and rescue operations, and particularly suited for searches under ice.

title_en: Coal mine search and rescue robot and cognitive behavior search and rescue method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine search and rescue robot and a cognitive behavior search and rescue method of the coal mine search and rescue robot. The coal mine search and rescue robot comprises a robot actuator and a cognitive behavior controller. The robot actuator comprises a robot body and a detection device which is installed on the robot body. Wheel sets are installed on the sides of the robot body. The detection device is connected with the cognitive behavior controller. The cognitive behavior controller extracts feature information detected by the detection device for comparison, and controls the robot actuator to act according to a processing result. The robot actuator is flexible in action, high in obstacle crossing ability and high in reliability. By means of the cognitive behavior search and rescue method, the coal mine search and rescue robot can analyze captured information independently, can select action plans independently, has the independent cognitive ability and can better adapt to the complex underground coal mine environment.

title_en: Full fabric artificial skin based on snake-shaped deformation search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a full fabric artificial skin based on a snake-shaped deformation search and rescue robot. The fabric skin comprises a flexible fabric substrate, a flexible connecting wire, a sensor array, an encapsulation material, encapsulation fabrics and the like. According to the structural design and the information sensing requirements of the snake-shaped deformation search and rescue robot, the distribution type sensing of the sensor array is realized. When the robot executes the search and rescue task, the temperature, the humidity and the harmful gas content of the environment and the environment pressure applied to the snake-shaped robot can be sensed in real time, and the deformation and the splitting are realized. The full fabric artificial skin has the characteristics that the structure is simple, the processing and the manufacturing are easy, and in addition, the information sensing function of the complicated environment can be realized.

title_en: Foot carries out compound type search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to foot and carries out compound type search and rescue robot, belong to intelligent robot technology field, include robot waist, robot hip joint, robot thigh, robot knee joint, robot shank, robot anklebone, robot foot end, the first steering wheel, the second steering wheel, the 3rd steering wheel, DC machine, coupler, the first rotating shaft, clutch shaft bearing, drive wheel, tension wheel, crawler belt, the second rotating shaft, the second bearing, frame.Robot waist is connected with robot thigh by robot hip joint, and robot thigh is connected with robot shank by robot knee joint, and robot shank is connected with robot foot end by robot anklebone.The utility model is designed to the fabricate block of track structure and sufficient formula structure, so it has not only possessed the common feature of caterpillar type robot and legged type robot, can also its shortcoming complementary, be more suitable for complicated search and rescue environment, greatly reduce work capacity and the work risk of rescue worker.

title_en: Movable monitoring robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a movable monitoring robot which is a wheel type movable monitoring robot with a wireless network as media. A camera is carried on the robot to collect video information, and a developed upper computer master control program is used for controlling moving of the robot through the wireless network to collect relevant video information; meanwhile, abundant sensors on the robot can collect and return information of site conditions, and the movable monitoring robot can be applied to movable monitoring or seismic hazard search and rescue and other special work.

abstract_en: The invention provides a 3G network based wireless monitoring system. A wheel type mobile monitoring robot using a wireless network as a propagation medium is adopted. In addition, a plurality of sensors on the robot can acquire and return information of a lot of field environments, and the 3G network based wireless monitoring system can be used in mobile monitoring or earthquake disaster search and rescue and other special works.

title_en: City rescue intelligent agent dynamic path planning method based on improved ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a city rescue intelligent agent dynamic path planning method based on an improved ant colony algorithm, and belongs to the technical field of robot simulation. Aiming at the issue of path planning of a dynamic changing environment in robot rescue simulation, the classic ant colony algorithm is improved, the target dominance is introduced, the approach for calculating the probability of state transfer of ants is modified, and the pheromone updating rules adapt to a situation in which the road condition is unknown and dynamically changes, a rescue intelligent agent is given complex tasks, and the path planning requirements are inconsistent in a rescue environment, so that a rescue robot can search the optimum path according to the task attribute. Compared with the classic ant colony algorithm, the improved ant colony algorithm of the invention is effective and reliable.

title_en: Submarine robot with underwater organism shape and Method for managing the same

abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a submarine robot comprises a main body (10), which is formed to have the shape of underwater organisms and can perform bending and stretching motions; a propulsion unit (20) having a propeller (24) installed in the main body (10); a communications unit (30) having a sonar (33) installed in the main body (10); an attachment unit (40) having a magnetic generator (48) installed in the main body (10); and a control unit (50), which supplies power to the propulsion unit (20), the communications unit (30), and the attachment unit (40) and inputs and outputs an operation signal at a set condition. Accordingly, the loss of life can be minimized, using a rescue robot capable of waiting in the water for a long time and swimming. Also, the robot can be attached to the body of an enemy ship and can provide information on location and a movement route.
