title_en: Underground six-foot spider type search-and-rescue robot for coal mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to an underground six-foot spider type search-and-rescue robot for a coal mine. The underground six-foot spider type search-and-rescue robot for the coal mine comprises a main support, a control panel, an image acquisition device and six bionic limbs, wherein the main support comprises an upper supporting plate and a lower supporting plate which are connected through multiple stand columns, and the six bionic limbs are distributed on the outer sides of the six protruding ends of the two supporting plates. Each bionic limb comprises a round connecting disc which is connected to the corresponding protruding end, wherein the round connecting disc is connected with a leg motor, the bottom of a motor support connected with the outer side of the leg motor is connected with another motor support, an inner limb motor is connected to the interior of the motor support connected with the bottom of the motor support connected with the outer side of the leg motor, the round connecting disc connected with the inner limb motor is connected to a supporting arm of a U-shaped connecting frame, and the other supporting arm of the U-shaped connecting frame is connected with another motor support; one supporting arm of another U-shaped connecting frame connected with the bottom of the U-shaped connecting frame is connected with an outer limb motor, the other supporting arm of the U-shaped connecting frame connected with the bottom of the U-shaped connecting frame is connected with the corresponding motor support, and the outer limb motor is connected to the interior of the motor support; an artificial tibia joint is connected to the upper portion of the outer limb motor. According to the underground six-foot spider type search-and-rescue robot for the coal mine, due to the fact that vertical dual steering engines are installed at the positions of all joints, the movement flexibility of the robot is effectively improved, and the load capacity of the robot is improved.

title_en: A kind of snakelike search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of snakelike search and rescue robot, belong to robot and search and rescue field.This snakelike search and rescue robot comprises remote control, snakelike device, snakelike device comprises support, wheel, power supply, master controller, sensor, camera, video transmitter, steering wheel, Energy control camera circuit, steering wheel circuit, controller circuitry, master controller comprises single-chip microcomputer and communication device, Single-chip Controlling sensor, camera and steering wheel.Send instruction by host computer, snakelike search and rescue robot moves to assigned address with wriggling movement form, completes and detects and environment measuring the life in target area.Meanwhile, the wireless camera of head is by rescue spot information transmission to host computer, and rescue center can formulate search and rescue scheme according to information.Snakelike search and rescue robot structure is simple, it is convenient to control, and motion flexibly, has multiple sensors on the ground, can testing environment, searches trapped personnel and has certain application prospect.

title_en: Searching and rescue robot system moving control method based on multi-intelligent-agent theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a searching and rescue robot system moving control method based on a multi-intelligent-agent theory. The searching and rescue technology applied to large-scale high-efficiency robot groups is not comprehensive, and particularly, the group behavior control of the searching and rescue robot group is deficient. The method provided by the invention comprises the following concrete steps that a leader robot and a plurality of follower robots form a queue to enter a region A; in a concrete searching and rescue process, the leader robot firstly searches a partial region of the region A, if the region is not searched, a follower robot G1 is left for searching the region A, and the leader robot leads the rest follower robots to continuously search a next region until the whole target region is completely searched; after completing the searching on the region A, the follower robot G1 finds the leader robot and follows the leader robot. The method provided by the invention that the possibility is provided for the large-scale searching, workers only need to control the leader robot through a terminal, the control mode is simplified, and the control effect is enhanced through a high-automation work mode among the robots.

title_en: A kind of multifunctional rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to ruins rescue aid, specifically a kind of multifunctional rescue robot, robot comprises travel mechanism, camera, gas receiver and wireless connections module, the creeper undercarriage that travel mechanism comprises driver module and is arranged on driver module both sides respectively, walked by driver module driving, camera and wireless connections module are connected with driver module respectively by quick plug, camera are provided with the gas receiver gathering gas sample in ruins; Three kinds of working methods that the utility model robot has to be had cable, work independently without cable and camera, the quick plug on driver module is directly connected with console by cable, and realizing has cable; Driver module is connected by quick plug with wireless connections module, realizes without cable; The mode that camera works independently is that camera takes off from travel mechanism together with gas receiver, is directly connected with console by cable.The utility model structure is simple, compact, modularization, is easy to install, and volume is little, lightweight.

title_en: A kind of turnable search and rescue robot based on double helix driving
abstract_en: A kind of novel intelligent robot for search and rescue, mainly by the way of double helix driving, and it is arranged using three spiral-tube triangular structures, the function that robot still can advance after overturning any angle is realized, audiovideo transmitting device and position detecting device are had, the present invention utilizes wire transmission mode, it is equipped with two transmission pipelines, one transmits for data, and one is used for water, the conveying of the nutriments such as slop.It can be used for all kinds of mine disasters, the accident rescues such as earthquake.

A device may be included in a reconfigurable instrument. Reconfigurable instruments may be useful in a variety of applications, including reconfigurable airfoils, soft armor, exoskeletons, and search and rescue robots.

title_en: A kind of multi-joint mechanical arm device continuously
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of multi-joint mechanical arm device continuously, comprise pedestal and mechanical arm two parts, base part is by driver part and lower motor fixing plate, upper motor fixing plate, downslide wheel plate, top sheave plate, connecting rod composition between pulley assembly and each plate, and driver part comprises described motor, shaft coupling, leading screw, and mechanical arm is made up of the joint and multiple joint backbone with two frees degree, each joint and joint backbone all adopt identical structure, described driver part is arranged in the pedestal of robot arm device, drive unit other end connecting rope, the rope other end is fixed on the articular lamella place of joint backbone.Mechanical arm flexible structure of the present invention, it is good to keep away barrier ability, is adapted at ruins search and rescue, mechanical fitting assembling etc. narrow and use in the working space environment of complexity, is widely used.

title_en: Mine disaster environment detecting rescue robot with tunneling function and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mine disaster environment detecting rescue robot with a tunneling function and a control method thereof. Compared with the prior art, the mine disaster environment detecting rescue robot has the advantages that the defect that a mine disaster rescue robot inconveniently advances and cannot perform environment detection and wireless transmission is overcome. A parallel three-freedom degree sensation head mechanism is horizontally and fixedly arranged on a waist part external force detection section I; the waist part external force detection section I and a waist part external force detection section II are horizontally arranged through a cross universal joint A; the waist part external force detection section II and a waist part wireless network node releasing section III are horizontally arranged through a cross universal joint B; a motor A and a motor F are respectively arranged on the two sides in a section of shell of the waist part external force detection section I; a three-claw wheel leg A arranged on an output shaft of the motor A and a three-claw wheel leg F arranged on an output shaft of the motor F are respectively arranged on the two sides of the outer side of the section of shell. The mine disaster environment detecting rescue robot is m freer in procedure and integrates multiple functions, such as the tunneling function, the environment detecting function and the data transmitting function.

title_en: Self-balancing multi-spiral ground drilling robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-balancing multi-spiral ground drilling robot. The self-balancing multi-spiral ground drilling robot comprises a fixed bracket rod piece and a plurality of spiral mechanisms, wherein the spiral mechanisms comprise left spiral mechanisms and right spiral mechanisms; the spiral mechanisms are arranged in parallel and are fixed to the fixed bracket rod piece; balanced rotation is kept through leftward rotation and rightward rotation of the spiral mechanisms; when a drilling direction is adjusted, the axial force of the corresponding spiral mechanism is changed. Compared with the prior art, the robot provided by the invention has drilling and steering functions, and is simple in structure, high in driving efficiency, suitable for geological exploration, mine disaster search and rescue and the like, and is higher in reliability and practicability.

title_en: Triphibian robot provided with three impeller paddles
abstract_en: A triphibian robot provided with three impeller paddles consists of a propeller, a signal receiver, a base plate, an electric telescopic rod, a transmission shaft, a sensing gyroscope, a motor, a remote control, the three impeller paddles and a spherical casing and is characterized in that the casing is in a spherical shape, the spherical shape can be changed into an oval shape, the size is decreased, the impeller is located inside the spherical casing, the motor part is provided with a storage battery, charging and discharging can be realized, a bottom wheel consists of the three impeller paddles, the three impeller paddles constitute the round wheel type when the robot walks on land, and the three impeller paddles are switched to the impeller paddle type when the robot swims in water, so that a triphibian function is realized; equipment such as a camera and the like can be carried, tasks such as investigation, search and rescue and the like are finished on complex terrains and fire scenes, and the remote control controls the sensing gyroscope to direct movement of the sensing gyroscope. The triphibian function of the robot can be realized through switching of the three impeller paddles, the practicability and the multi-functionality of the robot are guaranteed, the service life is prolonged, and the safety is improved.

title_en: Creeping ground drilling robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a creeping ground drilling robot which comprises an electric push rod mechanism, a motor steering mechanism and a drill bit mechanism which are sequentially connected. The outer wall of the electric push rod mechanism and the outer wall of the drill bit mechanism are each provided with a scale device capable of expanding and retracting, the electric push rod mechanism stretches and retracts periodically, each scale device expands or retracts under the action of soil body force and is used for providing supporting counterforce in the drilling direction, the motor steering mechanism adjusts steering of the drill bit mechanism, and a good platform is provided for the task that the robot is provided with a sensor to go deep into soil for geological prospecting, mine disaster search and rescue or soil sample collection in the future. Compared with the prior art, the robot has the advantages of being simple in structure, low in manufacturing cost, convenient to control and the like.

title_en: Unmanned rescue robot and rescue system and rescue method using the same
title_ko: 무인 수상 구조 로봇과 이를 이용한 구조 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an unmanned water rescue robot and a system and a method for rescue using the same capable of executing unmanned rescue activities at sea. An unmanned water rescue robot executes rescue activities by moving to a rescue position when receiving a signal for help from a control center while floating on a designated position on sea. To perform the rescue activities, the unmanned water rescue robot may be equipped with a device for shooting, a sensor device which detects a subject to rescue and an airbag, and a rescue apparatus for rescue. Additionally, the unmanned water rescue robot can be provided with electric power through a solar cell, thereby extending time for activities while floating on sea. To execute rescue activities, the unmanned water rescue robot needs organic activities with the control center. The control center can issue a rescue command to the unmanned water rescue robot located in the nearest vicinity of the accident spot. The unmanned water rescue robot executes the rescue task by shooting an airbag for rescue after automatically moving to the rescuing spot when receiving a rescue command. When the rescue activity is completed, the control center commands the rescue robot to automatically return to the designated position. By using an unmanned water rescue robot, the time to move to the spot of the accident can sharply be reduced.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 해상에서 무인 구조활동을 수행할 수 있는 무인 수상 구조 로봇과 상기 무인 수상 구조 로봇을 이용한 구조 시스템 및 방법에 관한 발명이다. 무인 수상 구조 로봇은, 해상에 지정된 위치에서 부유하면서 관제 센터로부터 구조 신호를 수신하면 구조 위치로 출동하여 구조 활동을 수행한다. 상기 구조 활동을 위해서 무인 수상 구조 로봇은 구조 대상을 감지할 수 있는 센서 장치, 구조용 구조 기구인 에어백을 발사하는 장치를 구비할 수 있다. 또한 무인 수상 구조 로봇은 태양 전지를 통해서 전력을 공급받을 수 있어서 해상에서 부유하면서 활동 시간을 늘릴 수 있다. 무인 수상 구조 로봇이 구조 활동을 하기 위해서는 관제 센터와 유기적인 협동이 필요하다. 관제 센터는 해상을 감시하며, 해상에서 사고가 발생하였을 때 사고 발생 여부와 사고 지점을 파악하여, 사고 지점과 가장 가까운 곳에 위치한 무인 수상 구조 로봇에게 구조 명령을 내릴 수 있다. 무인 수상 구조 로봇은 구조 명령을 수신하면 구조 지점까지 자동으로 이동하여 구조용 에어백을 발사하여 구조 작업을 수행한다. 구조 활동이 끝나면 관제 센터는 무인 수상 구조 로봇에게 상기 지정된 위치로 자동으로 복귀한다. 무인 수상 구조 로봇을 이용함으로써, 사고 지점까지 출동하는데 걸리는 시간을 대폭적으로 줄이는 효과가 있을 수 있다.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a portable robot for detecting a human life, and more specifically, to a portable robot for detecting a human life, which comprises: a mounting unit including a body having a mounting hole formed thereon, a photographing means installed on one side of the body and photographing a front side to obtain video data, a display coupled with the one side of the body through a hinge, being adjusted in angle, and displaying the video data in real time, and a grip coupled with the other side of the body; and a human life detecting unit including a detecting camera detachably attached to the mounting hole and photographing surroundings to obtain detection data, and a wireless transmitting part transmitting the detection data to the mounting unit. title_en: Microminiature robot capable of walking up and down stairs automatically
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microminiature robot capable of walking up and down stairs automatically and belongs to the technical field of investigation, search and rescue. The robot comprises a tracked movable chassis, a stair climbing support component and a control component, wherein the tracked movable chassis enables the robot to travel on a flat ground, the stair climbing support component enables the tracked movable chassis to rise, fall and move horizontally relative to the stair climbing component, and the control component controls the movement of the tracked movable chassis and the stair climbing support component and detects the positions of the tracked movable chassis and the stair climbing support component relative to steps. According to the robot, the function of walking up and down stairs is realized automatically; the stair climbing component is additionally arranged based on an existing minitype tracked robot chassis, and the robot chassis can be raised upwards and pushed forwards to a step plane and a support can be retracted by means of the stair climbing support component; by the adoption of the structure and the operation scheme, the microminiature robot can walk up and down stairs.

title_en: Wireless radar firefighting disaster rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless radar firefighting disaster rescue robot. The firefighting robot comprises an installation base, traveling crawlers, a slewing base, a big arm base, a big arm, a transition arm, a third arm, a fire extinguishing nozzle, an integrated control system and material storage chambers, wherein the traveling crawlers are installed at the bottom of the installation base, the upper surface of the installation base is provided with a slewing support and the material storage chambers, a wireless controller is installed on the installation base, a radar detection device is arranged in the wireless controller and the wireless controller is provided with a radar distance display screen. The wireless radar firefighting disaster rescue robot has the advantages that a radar detection device can quickly detect whether signs of life exist in a disaster rescue scene or not, realize quick rescue, keep rescuers to be far away from high-temperature, flammable and explosive environments and guarantee personal safety; the plurality of material storage chambers can carry various fire extinguishing materials to cope with different fire disasters and extinguish fire; a pushing system can remotely deliver the fire extinguishing materials through a booster chamber and a pushing oil cylinder to realize remote fire extinguishing.

title_en: A kind of wall surface detection rescue robot and its control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of wall surface detection rescue robot and its control method, overall structure includes robot body, control system, roof safety system.Robot body includes turntable, driving wheel, driving motor, sucker, mechanical arm, camera, spray equipment etc.；Roof safety guard includes follow-up trolley, hoisting mechanism and steel wire rope etc., bears the part dead weight of system, and random device people moves together.The present invention can realize that robot detects the fitting situation of ceramic tile and glass etc. and crack situation on high-rise surface in real time, and it can utilize self-contained spray equipment that will apply paint at loosening automatically when ceramic tile or glass loosen to be marked, maintenance personal is facilitated to replace, in addition, when emergency occurs, window can be broken to get in, expansion rescue.

title_en: Overwater helping type unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: A disclosed overwater helping type unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an equipment cabin, a task cabin, a support arm, a rotor motor, a rotor and an undercarriage; the inner sides of the undercarriage are symmetrically provided with a pair of lifebuoy clamping devices, the clamping devices comprise a motor base, a rotation motor, and clamping arm assemblies for flexibly clamping a lifebuoy at the inner sides of the undercarriage; and the rotation motor is installed on the motor base and drives the clamping arm assemblies to swing, and the clamping arm assemblies synchronously make motions. title_en: Maritime search and rescue system based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: A maritime search and rescue system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle (1) and a life boat (2). The unmanned aerial vehicle (1) is wirelessly connected to the life boat (2) through a communication network (3). The unmanned aerial vehicle (1) is provided with an infrared search and rescue device (10). The life boat (2) is provided with an automatic navigation device (20). When the unmanned aerial vehicle (1) flies to a space above a sea area in which a marine peril occurs, the unmanned aerial vehicle (1) starts the infrared search and rescue device (10) to collect videos and images of the sea area in which a marine peril occurs, and carries out maritime search and rescue target detection on the collected videos and images; when a maritime search and rescue target is detected, the infrared search and rescue device (10) acquires geographical location information of the maritime search and rescue target and sends the geographical location information of the maritime search and rescue target to the automatic navigation device (20) of the life boat (2), and the automatic navigation device (20)automatically navigates the life boat (2) to the location of the maritime search and rescue target to carry out rescue. The present invention can better assist maritime searches and rescues and can resolve the problem of difficulty in maritime searches and rescues at night.

The utility model discloses a search time in being applied to sea search and rescue system with unmanned air vehicle technique, when shortening the sea system that searches for ands rescue and falling into water the person in the search location.

title_en: A kind of deformable bionical search and rescue robot

The utility model discloses it is higher to have intelligent degree, and the flexibility is strong, maintains that the maintenance is convenient, can and can put out a fire at certain vertical direction freedom adjustment shower nozzle height according to flame direction level, on -vehicle large capacity water tank is convenient for the extension time of putting out a fire adopt water pressure turbocharging system and high pressure nozzle, and water pressure is big and jet distance is far away, and the radius of putting out a fire is bigger than the like product.

title_en: Underground robot communication control system based on Wifi
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground robot communication control system based on Wifi. The system is used for underground routing inspection and accident rescue and is particularly suitable for mines having accidents such as a gas explosion and a fire. An underground robot can reach a region where rescuers cannot reach as toxic and harmful gas exists, according to the rescue robot wireless communication control system, a new temporary Wifi network construction method is provided based on a multihop Wifi network technology, the wireless communication distance of the underground robot can be continuously increased along with advancing of the robot, and communication between the underground robot and control equipment is ensured. The problem that on the condition that an original wireless communication system in a mine cannot be used, the wireless communication distance between the underground robot and the control equipment is limited is solved.
assignees: CHINA UNIV OF MINING AND TECH (BEIJING)

title_en: UCOSII-based mine search and rescue system and search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a UCOSII-based mine search and rescue system and search and rescue method. A downhole rescue robot requires great terrain adaptability, obstacle avoidance capacity and search function. A search and rescue robot carries a mobile terminal node; the mobile terminal node transmits data acquired by the search and rescue robot to a router node; the router node is responsible for route inquiring of the mobile terminal node and forwarding the data to a network coordinator; the network coordinator receives data information acquired by the mobile terminal node and then transmits the data to a control center through a serial port; and the control center receives the data and then displays field environmental parameter information in real time and transmits an instruction to the search and rescue robot. Rescue personnel can be assisted to rapidly acquire field information, ascertain the position of trapped people, acquire the disaster field environmental parameter information, return disaster field images in real time and dynamically plan search and rescue routes so as to strive for high efficiency of the search and rescue process and guarantee life rescuing.

title_en: Emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an emergency rescue robot, include that chassis and supporting, power and platform, jack -up lift arm, covering, seat, operation panel, preceding both arms and assist utensil, hydraulic transmission system, rotation mechanism and detection head. The beneficial effects of the utility model are that: possess search and rescue function simultaneously. Possess remote search on a large scale and mechanical excavation, the breakage that possesses of nearly all rescue, cut, grab functions such as dress, loading and unloading, fork dress, hoist and mount, flattening, high altitude construction. The reaction rate is fast, can be in walking of non - highway environment and steady operation. Possess manual operation, remote control and computer remote control function, can realize operating personnel and rescue equip between, between operating personnel and the victim, many rescues equip between the communication of various ways.

title_en: Multifunctional rescue robot and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to ruin rescue equipment, in particular to a multifunctional rescue robot and a using method thereof. The robot comprises a moving mechanism, a camera, a gas storage cylinder and a wireless connecting module. The moving mechanism comprises a driving module and crawler traveling modules, wherein the crawler traveling modules are installed on the two sides of the driving module correspondingly and driven by the driving module to travel. The camera and the wireless connecting module are connected with the driving module through quick plugs correspondingly. The gas storage cylinder used for collecting gas samples from ruins is installed on the camera. The multifunctional rescue robot has a cabled working mode, a cable-free working mode and an independent camera working mode. The corresponding quick plug on the driving module is directly connected with a console through a cable, and the cabled working mode is achieved. The driving module and the wireless connecting module are connected through the quick plug, and the cable-free working mode is achieved. According to the independent camera working mode, the camera and the gas storage cylinder are taken down from the moving mechanism and directly connected with the console through cables. The multifunctional rescue robot is simple, compact and modularized in structure, easy to install, small in size and low in weight.

title_ko: 아메바 운동을 응용한 인명 구조용 로봇
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a robot to save a life applied with amoebic movement which enables a rescue worker to more quickly grasp a position of a survivor in a buried space, thus enabling fast rescuing to save a human life. Moreover, a machine entering an inside of a collapsed structure photographs a surrounding environment using a camera, and photographed information is received from the outside to quickly grasp the position of the survivor. In addition, various relief supplies are transmitted to the survivor for the survivor not to pass away before a rescue team enters. According to the present invention, a robot to save the life applied with amoebic movement comprises: an inner layer; an outer layer; filling materials; a plurality of small electromagnets; and a driving controller.

abstract_en: The invention relates to a three-surface driven search and rescue robot for ruins. The three-surface driven search and rescue robot comprises front-end communication equipment, a plurality of elastic bodies and a plurality of three-surface driven crawler belt mechanisms, wherein the elastic bodies and the crawler belt mechanisms are sequentially and alternatively fixed to a connecting ring through screws and connected together in series, so that the robot with bionic feet and multiple joints is formed; the front-end communication equipment is mounted on the connecting ring of a head crawler belt mechanism through screws. The three-surface driven search and rescue robot disclosed by the invention has good locomotivity, besides, is relative small in size and stable in properties, and can enter the ruins to perform search and rescue work or enter pipelines to perform related detection and the like.

title_en: Underground robot communication control system based on wireless sensor network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground robot communication control system based on a wireless sensor network. The system is applied to underground polling and accident rescue, and is particularly suitable for mines in which accidents such as gas explosions and fire disasters happen. An underground robot can reach areas with toxic and harmful gas which are unreachable for rescue workers. A rescue robot wireless communication control system is characterized in that on the basis of a multi-hop wireless sensor network technology, a method for building a new temporary wireless sensor network is provided in order that a wireless communication distance of the underground robot can increase continuously along with the advancing of the robot, and communications between the underground robot and control equipment are ensured. Through adoption of the underground robot communication control system, the problem of limited wireless communication distance between the underground robot and the control equipment under the condition that an original wireless communication system in a mine cannot be used is solved.

title_en: Tracked firefighting rescue robot applicable to complex terrain and high-risk environments
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tracked firefighting rescue robot applicable to complex terrain and high-risk environments, and relates to the technical field of firefighting rescue robots.The tracked firefighting rescue robot comprises a vehicle device, a wheel device, a fire extinguishing device and a water fetching device.The fire extinguishing device comprises a fire extinguishing platform, a hydraulic support, a rotary motor, a rotary support inner ring, a rotary support outer ring, a rotary fire extinguishing table, a foam water cannon, a haze spray nozzle, an electric heating ring, a direct-current water cannon, a driving motor and a smoke driving fan.The tracked firefighting rescue robot has the advantages that the tracked firefighting rescue robot is high in adaptability to severe terrain environments and has in-situ multi-angle water cannon spraying functions; as proved by pressure detection, the tracked firefighting rescue robot can be automatically switched to be in low-speed states when under the condition of high resistance or climbing, and can be switched to be in high-speed states when the tracked firefighting rescue robot travels in gentle road segments and resistance is reduced, and accordingly the vehicle advancing safety and the firefighting efficiency can be guaranteed; the tracked firefighting rescue robot can be in diversified fire extinguishing modes, is wide in application range and is provided with the water fetching device, and accordingly water can be fetched locally; the tracked firefighting rescue robot is further provided with a surrounding water curtain, a smoke driving device and a radio control device, and accordingly smooth firefighting work can be guaranteed in the severe environments.

title_en: Multi-rotor safety shield
abstract_en: The Multi-Rotor Safety Shield (MRSS) provides a complete and substantial encasement system which can be secured about a Drone, protecting a multitude of aircraft components from contact with any outside disturbance and which can protect the sensitive components from dust, water, wind, rain, snow, fingers, toes, appendages of any kind, and atmospheric changes as example, from disabling the Drone and can protect people, places or things from high velocity spinning exposed rotor/propellers. The MRSS provides rigid non-permeable platform for attaching or incorporating additional safety devices as found in the Drone industry (or other industries) resulting in a safety device that completely prevents the loss a Drone due to the catastrophic failure of any Drone system or combination of systems which would typically result in rapid decent, and/or uncontrolled flight. The MRSS makes Drones safe near humans and safe to use around public gatherings, stadium events, accident scenes, disaster search and rescue and disaster relief, and indoors for the security and communications markets among others expanding the availability of Drones to further assist humanity.

title_en: Robot with digital media playing function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot with a digital media playing function. The robot comprises a base and a media player; the base comprises a base body, wheels, a power assembly, a power source, a communication module and a controller; the media player, the communication module and a control unit of the power assembly are all in communication connection with the controller; the power source respectively supplies power to the power assembly, the media player, the communication module and the controller; the wheels are mounted on driving shafts of the power assembly. The robot is amphibian and can be applied to search and rescue operations after earthquakes and flood disasters. The robot can also serve as a tested subject to allow students to complete program compilation for controlling the robot after analysis of a specific structure and an action theory of the robot. In addition, the robot can be used as a toy for children to completely stimulate the interest of children in mechanical coordination relation and control process to promote study enthusiasm.

The utility model overcomes the hardware and the comparatively complicated drawback of software design of tradition sound direction design the new mode that provides for rescue robot based on sound direction.

title_en: Path programming and navigation system based on improved artificial potential field method and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine rescue robot path programming and navigation system based on an improved artificial potential field and a method thereof. An obstacle filling method and a disturbance potential field method are combined. In the obstacle filling method, virtual filling is performed on a concave obstacle, a potential field function is constructed and filled and a corresponding repulsive potential field function is generated. In the disturbance potential field method, through adding a disturbance potential field in a gravitational potential field, a gravitational potential field function is changed and a rescue robot can autonomously walk out of a local minimum point when falling into the local minimum point. The two methods are combined, which can well help the underground rescue robot escape from the local minimum point; and the path is reprogrammed, and the robot can be avoided from falling into other local minimum points again and can successfully complete a disaster rescue task; an algorithm is concise and high reliability is possessed.

title_en: An Emergency Situation Perception and Notifying Apparatus for Underwater Worker
title_ko: 수중작업자의 위급상황 감지 및 알림장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency situation detecting and notifying apparatus of an underwater worker which can transfer information on an accident position or the like through a wireless communications network by using a GPS as well as an agreed rescue request signal by floating a floating material having a wireless communications apparatus (RF transceiver) on the water when a rescue does not execute within several minutes (four minutes, a most desirable time) after accident occurring.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 수중작업자 스스가 위험에 노출된 것으로 판단되거나 감지하면 구조버튼을눌러 구조신호를 보내거나, 수중작업자(해녀 또는 잠수작업자)의 작업 패턴을 분석하여 발생이 의심될 때에 요구조자에게 경고 신호를 출력하여 사고유무를 파악하고 맥파등의 신체 정보를 활용하여 사고발생 후 최단 시간내에 사고 발생을 감지하여 사고로 파악되면 즉시 음향신호, 형광물질 표식 및 경광등, 초음파 통신등으로 사고 발생 사실을 전파하여, 주변 작업자들이 신속히 구조할 수 있도록 하고, 사고 발생 후 수분(가장 바람직하게는 4분)이내 구조가 실시되지 않으면 무선통신장치(RF송수신기)가 내장된 부유물을 수면에 띄워 약정된 구조요청신호와 더불어 GPS를 이용한 사고위치 등의 정보를 무선통신망을 통해 전달할 수 있도록 된 수중작업자의 위급상황 감지 및 알림장치이다. 
본 발명은, 수중 작업 중에 사고를 감지하거나 발생할 경우 인명의 손실을 줄이기 위해사고 발생(시작)부터 구조에 소요되는 시간이 매우 짧다는 것을 충분히 감안하여 사고 발생 인근에서 공동 작업 중인 동료들에게 사고 사실을 신속히 알려(전파)주고 발생지점을 표시하여 요구조자(구조요청자)를 신속히 구조할 수 있도록 하고,  또한 사고초기에 요구조자를 구조하지 못하더라도 사고자의 몸과 연결된 부유물을 수면에 표시하여 실종자를 신속히 발견 및 인양하게 하며, 실종자의 수색 및 그에 따른 시간과 사회적 비용을 줄이고 행정적 손실을 최소화할 수 있다.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to an unmanned flight system for searching distress and broadcasting guidance of emergency, which automatically gathers water and measures water quality. Also, a first aid kit, which is installed around a frame constructed on the bottom of the main body of the flight vehicle to rapidly provide a survivor with first aid equipment, a wireless voice device, which accurately and rapidly enables urgent guidance communication, and a camera for rapidly searching survivors are mounted on the unmanned flight system for searching distress and broadcasting guidance of emergency. The fire-fighting robot, the rescue robot and the multi-shaft aircraft conduct information interaction with the upper computer. The fire-fighting and rescue robot system further comprises a wall sensor unit conducting information interaction with the upper computer. The wall sensor unit comprises a flame sensor, a combustible gas sensor, an infrared temperature measurement sensor and a doppler displacement sensor. In the fire-fighting and rescue robot system, the fire-fighting robot, the rescue robot and the wall sensor unit are responsible for environmental monitoring, fire fighting and rescue in a building. The multi-shaft aircraft is responsible for image capture outside the building, and obtained data are comprehensive and have practical application and referable performance. title_en: Intelligent life detecting robot with capabilities of independent positioning and map building
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent life detecting robot with capabilities of independent positioning and map building. A life detecting module is used for detecting life features in an environment, and feeding back an electrical signal to a micro-processing unit when a life is detected, and the micro-processing unit is used for controlling a remote alarm module to alarm; a positioning base station is used for providing real-time coordinate information of the robot in the located environment for a master controller and recording a historical movement track of the robot. The intelligent life detecting robot has the advantages that through application of a laser scanning module, on one hand, the robot can independently carry out life detection in a severe environment without remote control of people; on the other hand, a built environmental map can show indoor environmental information under the condition that no person enters the environment, and the rescue difficulty is reduced; through application of a positioning system, detected coordinate information of a to-be-rescued person in the environment is provided, and a historical detecting track of the robot is recorded, accordingly, the search and rescue efficiency of wounded personnel is improved and injuries and deaths of rescue workers in a high-risk environment are reduced.

title_en: High-altitude quick rescue robot

title_en: A kind of deep-sea ultra-short baseline positioning precision method of inspection
abstract_en: The invention belongs to hydrolocation field, relates generally to a kind of deep-sea ultra-short baseline positioning precision method of inspection.The present invention includes：Distance of the ultra-short baseline acoustic basic matrix between the measurement of different measuring point and beacon, while collecting the gps data of different measuring points；The geodetic coordinates of subsea beacon is calculated using different measuring point gps data and range information；With this geodetic coordinates as basis, according to the geodetic coordinates of ultra-short baseline principle inverse waterborne vessel；The gps data for selecting waterborne vessel forms reference locus；Calculate the geodetic coordinates of waterborne vessel and the beeline of gps data line；Using the beeline of above-mentioned calculating as the positioning precision for weighing ultra short base line.The present invention on the basis of using the resolving beacon position that crosses calculates acoustics basic matrix coordinate using ultra-short baseline positioning principle, obtains computational accuracy with the minimum range between acoustics basic matrix GPS track so as to compare.The method all has wide practical use in terms of target search and rescue and subsea beacon navigation.

title_en: System and method for assisting in simultaneous positioning and environment map construction of search and rescue robot arms
abstract_en: The application discloses a system and a method for assisting in positioning and constructing an environment map by arms of a search and rescue robot, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the robot comprises a robot body, wherein a robot controller, a positioning sensor module, an image acquisition module and a robot arm are arranged on the robot body, the robot arm is connected with an arm driving mechanism, the arm driving mechanism is connected with the robot controller, and the positioning sensor module and the image acquisition module are respectively connected with the robot controller; the positioning sensor module detects the position information of the appointed target in real time and transmits the position information into the robot controller, and the image acquisition module acquires the image information around the robot in real time and transmits the image information into the robot controller; the robot controller is used for carrying out point cloud matching according to the received image information and the position information of the appointed target to construct a target environment map; the robot controller is used for outputting pulse signals to the arm driving mechanism in real time according to the constructed target environment map so as to control the robot arm to realize search and rescue work.

title_en: Route planning method for search and rescue robot in chemical disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to a route planning method for a search and rescue robot in a chemical disaster scene. The route planning method comprises the following steps: s-1, performing environment modeling on the disaster scene by virtue of a grid method; s-2, finally obtaining an initial optimum route by virtue of a genetic ant colony algorithm; s-3, in each unit time, detecting whether the initial optimum path enters a continuously diffusing toxic gas range or not; s-4, if so, performing route planning again on two points of a line section in the toxic gas range so as to avoid toxic gas; and otherwise, following the current route. The route planning method for the search and rescue robot provided by the invention sets the toxic gas in a dynamic diffusing mode. By detecting and updating the route superposed with the toxic gas region, the defect caused by stationary toxic gas in a conventional model is overcome, so that obtained planned route is relatively safe and reliable.

title_en: Rescue method of abandoned well rescue robot with high safety
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a rescue method of a abandoned well rescue robot, which effectively reduces the length of a rescue rope, has high rescue speed and high safety. The robot comprises a spherical shell-shaped road exploring body, a spherical shell-shaped rescuing body and a rescuing rope, is compact in size, is suitable for rescuing in narrow space and is high in passing capacity. The robot is separated from the rescue rope after entering the water surface, the underwater propelling device provides power to continue submerging, the rapid floating process can depend on gas in the air bag to realize floating, the length of the needed rescue rope is greatly reduced, and the robot is convenient to carry. When the robot descends, the robot freely falls into the water, and then the robot is powered by the underwater propulsion device to continue to descend, the descending speed is high, when the robot ascends, the robot firstly depends on the buoyancy of the air bag, floats to the vicinity of a water level line and then is lifted by the rescue rope, and the ascending speed is high; when the lifting underwater propelling device is lifted, the position of the person to be rescued can be adjusted according to the deep well map, and the safety is high.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle with biometric verification
abstract_en: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for locating, identifying, and tracking a known criminal, fugitive, missing person, and/or any other person of interest. An embodiment operates by deploying an unmanned aerial vehicle, determining the mode of operation of the UAV, operating the UAV in accordance with the mode of operation of the UAV, determining whether a subject has been detected, capturing a first voice sample associated with the subject, authenticating the identity of the subject, and transmitting the GPS location of the unmanned aerial vehicle to a computing device.

title_en: One kind is based on the multi-functional mine search and rescue robot of cell-phone customer terminal
abstract_en: The multi-functional mine search and rescue robot of cell-phone customer terminal, including robot slave computer detecting system and host computer mobile control system are based on the present invention relates to one kind.The robot slave computer detecting system includes STM32 controllers, and the STM32 controllers are connected by power line and Minepit environment information acquisition system, S5PV210 processors, SIM908 modules, power module, SD card, OpenWrt routers and clock module.The S5PV210 processors are connected by power line with robot pose monitoring system with vehicle body drive system.The host computer mobile control system uses Android intelligent, controls robot to run and obtain Minepit environment information parameter by developing the application program of corresponding monitoring system.From the data transfer between high-performance, STM32 each modules of controller control system of low-power consumption, the fireballing feature of its processing data can be given full play to using the S5PV210 processors with high performance computation ability, improve running efficiency of system.

title_en: One kind automation rescue at sea method
abstract_en: The invention discloses one kind automation rescue at sea method, it is comprised the following steps：S1, the top that air rescue equipment is hovered over persons falling in water；S2, whether consciously to judge persons falling in water, if so, step S3 is then performed, if it is not, then performing step S4；S3, from the air rescue equipment upthrow lower pontoon, move to the persons falling in water at one's side after the floating drum navigator fix, the persons falling in water itself will be fixed on the floating drum；S4, from rescue robot under the air rescue equipment upthrow, move to the persons falling in water at one's side after the rescue robot navigator fix, and the persons falling in water is fixed on the rescue robot；S5, the air rescue equipment are by the floating drum or rescue robot traction reboard.The present invention improves the efficiency and speed of rescue at sea, reduces the workload and danger of marine rescuer.

title_en: Intelligent rescue method suitable for deep well rescue robot in narrow space
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to an intelligent rescue method which is strong in passing ability, timely in rescue and convenient to carry and is suitable for a deep well rescue robot in a narrow space. The robot comprises an elliptical spherical shell-shaped path exploring body and a plurality of spherical shell-shaped rescue bodies; four-rotor or six-rotor flying mechanisms are arranged at corresponding positions of the upper end surfaces of the road probing body and the rescue body respectively, two rows of landing leg groups which are horizontally and annularly arranged are arranged on the outer side surface of the road probing body along the vertical direction, and each row of landing leg group comprises a plurality of automatically telescopic folding landing legs; the rescue robot can realize flight motion or creeping motion underground by depending on a flight mechanism or supporting legs, is compact in size and capable of meeting underwater rescue, avoids obstacles when an exploratory body descends, is high in passing capability, and is suitable for rescue in narrow space. When the road exploring body descends, the first type of deep well map and the second type of deep well map are drawn, so that the descending speed and the ascending speed of the rescue body and the road exploring body can be improved.

title_en: Automatic detection rescue robot for deep well and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to an automatic detection and rescue robot for a deep well and a rescue method, which have strong passing capacity and timely rescue and can adapt to complex environments in the well. The robot comprises a road detecting body, a rescue rope penetrates through a through hole of the road detecting body, a plurality of rescue bodies are hung on the rescue rope, and a road detecting device, a first processor, an infrared thermal imager, an altitude altimeter, a camera and a rescue mechanism are arranged at the bottom end of the road detecting body respectively; a wireless router and a second processor are arranged in the rescue body; the path exploring body is responsible for path exploring positioning and field rescue, the rescue body is responsible for field auxiliary rescue and rapid rise, and the robot is compact in size and strong in passing capability; when the road exploring body descends, drawing a first type deep well map and a second type deep well map is beneficial to improving the descending and ascending speeds of the rescue body and the road exploring body; when water exists in the deep well, the wheel hub motor of the road probing body ensures the descending speed of the road probing body, the elevator type lifting driving mechanism of the rescue body ensures the descending speed of the road probing body, and the environmental suitability is high.

title_en: A kind of cellular market safe emergency refuge apparatus
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of cellular market safe emergency refuge apparatus, the single cellular market generally rectangle structure of safe emergency refuge apparatus cell cube is bolted between independent single unit body and combines；Single unit body includes：Housing, sealed door, vertical ladder, supporting plate, battery, oxygen supply control system, console, lock pressure regulation robot control system(RCS), gas parameter detecting system, air cleaning unit, chemical refrigeration system in cabin；A kind of cellular market of present invention safe emergency refuge apparatus are by rationally increase and decrease single unit body number, it is assembled into many set safe emergency refuge apparatus of different sizes, when disaster occurs, cover safe emergency refuge apparatus more and be fixedly connected, shorten the search and rescue time of lifesaving personnel；Even if single unit body drops into single position in disaster environment, the life security of escape personnel in cabin is also can guarantee that, the device has simple structure, compact, easy to operate remarkable advantage.

title_en: The cellular urban safety act of rescue device of one species
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the cellular urban safety act of rescue device of a species, the generally rectangle structure of the single cellular urban safety act of rescue device unit body of a species is bolted between independent single unit body and combines；Single unit body includes：Housing, sealed door, vertical ladder, supporting plate, battery, oxygen supply control system, console, lock pressure regulation robot control system(RCS), gas parameter detecting system, air cleaning unit, chemical refrigeration system in cabin；The cellular urban safety act of rescue device of a species of the invention is by rationally increase and decrease single unit body number, it is assembled into many set safe emergency refuge apparatus of different sizes, when disaster occurs, cover safe emergency refuge apparatus more and be fixedly connected, shorten the search and rescue time of lifesaving personnel；Even if single unit body drops into single position in disaster environment, the life security of escape personnel in cabin is also can guarantee that, the device has remarkable advantage simple and compact for structure, easy to operate.

title_en: Early-stage rescue method for fire disaster of highway tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a highway tunnel fire initial rescue auxiliary system, which is characterized by comprising the following components: detecting a robot platform; the embedded control unit, the signal detection unit and the mark putting unit are carried on the detection robot platform; a human-computer interaction system; and a wireless routing device. The man-machine interaction system comprises a main control console and an intelligent mobile terminal; the man-machine interaction system receives fire information transmitted by the embedded control unit in real time and evaluates and processes the fire information, and field search and rescue personnel can acquire the front situation in real time through the intelligent mobile terminal and make a response in advance. The system is designed based on an embedded development platform, and a reasonable track drawing algorithm is adopted to help the rescue workers to determine the positions of trapped people in advance in a severe rescue environment, and help the rescue workers to find a safe path as soon as possible and make a reasonable rescue plan.

title_en: A kind of search and rescue system with search and rescue robot and communication robot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of search and rescue system with search and rescue robot and communication robot, wherein system includes multiple search and rescue robots, and the search and rescue robot includes signal lamp, the first wireless transport module, the first power supply, first microprocessor and the first Power Component；Multiple communication robots, the communication robot includes camera, the second wireless transport module, second source, the second microprocessor, the second Power Component and is wirelessly transferred terminal；Host computer, the host computer is wirelessly transferred terminal and/or first wireless transport module is communicated with described.Using this kind of system, communication robot is parked in corner and serves as the smooth transmission that signal terminal maintains signal, so as to increased the wireless transmission distance of search and rescue robot, considerably increases search efficiency；Search-and-rescue work under mine can be efficiently applied to, it is also possible to be applied to other scenes or the search-and-rescue work of other demands, it is adaptable to large-scale promotion application.

title_en: Intelligent fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire-fighting and fire-extinguishing robots, in particular to an intelligent fire rescue robot, which comprises a robot body, wherein a fire extinguishing device is carried on the robot body, and walking mechanisms are arranged at four corners of the bottom of the robot body and comprise a first movable arm hinged to the robot body, a second movable arm hinged to the first movable arm, a third movable arm hinged to the second movable arm and a climbing pedal hinged to the third movable arm; the two sides of the top of the machine body are respectively provided with a set of fire extinguishing device, each fire extinguishing device comprises a high-pressure water spraying pipe, a conveying pipe, a hydraulic ejector and a spraying control system, the spraying control system and the hydraulic ejector are arranged on one side of the top of the machine body in parallel, and the high-pressure foam spraying pipes are connected with the hydraulic ejector through the conveying pipes. The invention has simple and compact structure, reliable work and strong adaptability, can be applied to high-rise wall work, replaces firemen to quickly enter a dangerous fire first line, and reduces the rescue time.
assignees: DONGGUAN EQUITY EXCHANGE CT;ZHOU HAO;LYU MENG;XIAO ZHENGTING

title_en: A kind of wheeled emergency rescue robot, control system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of control system of wheeled emergency rescue robot, the processor, data for receiving the collection of the drive device, video frequency transmitter, automatic fault avoidnig device, life detecting device, distance-measuring device and gas-detecting device, the data of the collection are uploaded to host computer by way of the transmission being wirelessly transferred again, and remote operation control is carried out to system by way of being wirelessly transferred.Excellent in mechanical performance of the present invention, simple structure but realizes corresponding function, and consumptive material is few, and damper is only made up of spring, stator, bolt, and strong innovation, what is greatly reduced makees cost certainly；Using comparatively relatively wider, it be equipped with many sensor-based systems and realize the functions such as automatic obstacle avoiding, path planning, transmission of video, be allowed to more intelligent, along with the application of mechanical arm mechanism, substantially increases operating efficiency.

title_en: System and method for capture of random sized boxes by unmanned vehicle
abstract_en: For delivery applications of all types, search and rescue, disaster relief, and many other tasks an Unmanned Autonomous Vehicle (UAV) may have to grasp a cardboard box of a wide range of dimensions, hold it tight enough that it does not come loose during flight, and then release the package at the destination. This invention describes a system and methodology which can be implemented on UAV platforms consisting of four sets of grip plates with micro-protrusions which can be fitted to nearly any size of box and a methodology to test the grip strength on the box before liftoff.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method and device and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method and device and an unmanned aerial vehicle. The method comprises the following steps: controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly along a set route in the target search area; receiving position updating information sent by a terminal, wherein the position updating information comprises a terminal identifier; judging whether the terminal identification is the same as the terminal information of the terminal to be searched and rescued which is stored in advance; and if the terminal identification is judged to be the same as the terminal information of the terminal to be searched and rescued, acquiring the position information of the terminal to be searched and rescued. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle is controlled to fly along the set route in the target search area, and when the terminal identifier sent by the terminal is judged to be the same as the terminal information of the terminal to be searched and rescued, the position information of the terminal to be searched and rescued is obtained, so that search and rescue personnel can search and rescue according to the position information, and thus the search and rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: A kind of unmanned plane, ship wireless charging device and joint cruise rescue method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of unmanned plane, ship wireless charging device and joint cruise rescue method, the device includes unmanned boat and multiple UAVs, be provided with unmanned boat it is multiple stop carrying platform, unmanned plane is stopped and landing by stopping carrying platform；Wireless charging unit is provided with below unmanned plane, stops being provided with wireless power unit on carrying platform；When unmanned plane is rested on carrying platform, wireless charging is carried out by wireless charging unit and wireless power unit.The present invention makes cruise search and rescue scope and efficiency greatly improve by unmanned plane and unmanned boat joint cruise search and rescue, enables maritime sector to find the abnormal conditions at sea earlier or search and rescue earlier to arrive wrecked ship and persons falling in water；The endurance of unmanned plane is improved to unmanned plane wireless charging by using unmanned boat, allows unmanned function to carry out more cruise search operations.

title_en: A kind of multiaxis propulsion search and rescue robot waterborne
abstract_en: The present invention relates to field in intelligent robotics, specifically a kind of multiaxis promotes search and rescue robot waterborne, there is middle control platform, control platform circumferentially has at least three holders extended downwardly in, hinged cable device is respectively mounted on each holder, hinge cable device is lifted with folding life net below middle control platform by hawser, power device with float is also associated in the lower end of each holder, controller is equipped in the middle control platform, controller is connected with hinge cable device and the communication of power device with float；The present invention, which has in water, hovers, advances, retreating and 360 ° the multi-motion modes such as freely turn to, stability is extremely strong, capacity of anti-storm is strong, it can be good at replacing traditional rescue mode, while the design of folding life net realizes fast and safely lifesaving purpose, can realize that the search and rescue waterborne under complex water areas and inclement weather conditions are salvaged, the several work task such as monitor surface and observing and controlling waterborne, practicability is high, and flexibility is good, has good promotion prospect.

title_en: A kind of ratchet spine bar driven type is taken refuge safely cave
abstract_en: Taken refuge safely cave the present invention relates to a kind of ratchet spine bar driven type, the single ratchet spine bar driven type is taken refuge safely the generally rectangle structure of cave cell cube, being bolted flange combination between independent single unit body forms；Single unit body includes：Housing, sealed door, vertical ladder, supporting plate, battery, oxygen supply control system, console, cave pressure regulation robot control system(RCS), gas parameter detecting system, air cleaning unit, chemical refrigeration system in cave；The profile of the housing is rectangle structure, and inside is honeycomb structure, and multiple cell cubes, which are bolted, to be combined, according to the size of the interior space, rationally the quantity of increase and decrease cell cube, is assembled into safety of different sizes and takes refuge cave；When disaster occurs, many safe caves of taking refuge of set are fixedly connected, and shorten the search and rescue time of lifesaving personnel；Even if single unit body drops into single position in disaster environment, the life security of escape personnel in cave also can guarantee that.

title_en: The search and rescue robot of chemical industry disaster assistance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of search and rescue robot of chemical industry disaster assistance, including：Power supply module, drive the roll wheel assembly of robot motion, perceive the ultrasonic rangefinder of distance between periphery barrier and running gear, realize the camera head assembly of 360 all-directional rotations, ultrasonic rangefinder, the Master control chip of the information of camera head assembly are received, the channel radio mail of transmission information is connected to the locating module of Master control chip, the motor of roll wheel assembly is connected to, Master control chip and the motor control module of controlled motor is connected to.The utility model, which provides one kind, can realize omnidirection circumstance information gathering, telecommunication, the search and rescue robot of the chemical industry disaster assistance of automatic obstacle avoiding function.

title_en: Intelligent emergent rescue robot and its intelligent control method
abstract_en: A kind of intelligent emergent rescue robot and its intelligent control method, including：Man-machine interactive system, wireless communication system, data collecting system, fault self-diagnosis system, delivery drive-control system, variable stability control system, rescue control system of actuating mechanism, thermal protection control system, dynamical system, hydraulic system and emergency lighting system.The present invention greatly improves the technical performance of emergency management and rescue equipment, the a tractor serves several purposes function of emergency management and rescue is expanded, and accurate disaster field data are provided in good time for emergency management and rescue command centre, for smoothly expansion rescue action provides important foundation and help in time, rescue time is saved, the loss of lives and properties is preferably minimized.

title_en: Storage tank fire detection system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to technical field of fire control, more particularly to a kind of storage tank fire detection system, including flying platform and ground monitoring device, flying platform uses unmanned plane, and it is integrated with rotatable three-axis stability augmentation head, gas detection device and high definition image transmission system, three-axis stability augmentation head includes the first head and the second head, first head carries telephoto zoom monopod video camera, second head carries thermal infrared imaging camera, high definition image transmission system is used to the image information of collection and detection of gas information being wirelessly transmitted to ground monitoring device, ground monitoring device is used to control flying platform to perform flare maneuver, control the first head, second head performs spinning movement, and control telephoto zoom monopod video camera, thermal infrared imaging camera performs shooting action.The present invention substantially increases the field range and rapid reaction rate of emergency command, and search and rescue scouting effect has preferably been played to resist all kinds of disaster tasks.

title_en: Disaster relief robot using a variable characteristics
title_ko: 가변의 특성을 이용한 재난 구조로봇
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a disaster rescue robot using variable characteristics comprises: a body unit formed with a space where goods are able to be loaded in or people are able to ride on; a sensor unit to collect data and attached to one surface of the body unit; a plurality of joint units coupled to both sides of one end and to both sides of the other end of the body unit respectively, and rotating such that a length and position thereof are varied; a wheel unit coupled to the other end of the joint units, and varying depending on a driving environment; a grip unit extending from at least one of the joint units; and a control unit to receive the data from the sensor unit, controlling whether to move the wheel unit in accordance with the data, controlling the joint units such that a height of the body unit is changed in accordance with the height on a moving route calculated from the data, and controlling the joint units and the grip unit such that the grip unit is able to grip an object.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 가변의 특성을 이용한 재난 구조로봇은, 물건을 적재하거나 사람이 탈 수 있는 공간이 형성된 몸체유닛; 데이터를 수집하며 상기 몸체유닛의 어느 한 면에 부착되는 센서유닛; 상기 몸체유닛의 일단의 양측과 타단의 양측에 각각 결합되고, 길이와 위치가 가변되도록 회전되는 복수 개의 관절유닛; 상기 관절유닛의 타단에 결합되며, 주행환경에 따라 가변되는 바퀴유닛; 상기 관절유닛 중 적어도 하나 이상에 연장 형성되는 집게유닛; 및 상기 센서유닛으로부터 데이터를 전송받고, 상기 데이터에 따라 상기 바퀴유닛의 이동여부를 제어하며, 상기 데이터로부터 산출된 이동경로상의 높이에 따라 상기 몸체유닛의 높이가 변화하도록 상기 관절유닛을 제어하고, 상기 집게유닛이 물체를 잡을 수 있도록 상기 관절유닛과 상기 집게유닛을 제어하는 제어유닛; 을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: UNIV KOREA IND UNIV COOP FOUND

abstract_en: Wall rescue robot is climbed the utility model discloses one kind, including climbing robot, one end of adjusting mechanical arm is fixedly connected with adjusting mechanical arm and rescue robot control device, climbing robot, the other end of adjusting mechanical arm is connected with rescue robot control device；Rescue robot control device includes controller, the input of controller is connected to temperature sensor, flame sensor, image processing module and avoidance module, described image processing module is also associated with image collection module, and the output end of the controller has been electrically connected alarm module, wireless communication module, motor drive module, fire-fighting fire extinguishing equipment and adjusting mechanical arm.When the utility model is applied to fire generation, rescue difficulty big, the robot of expansion search and rescue is carried out in the case of disaster affected people can not be properly positioned, it is particularly suitable for use in the high-rise, fire rescue of high-rise building, fire floor can quickly be reached by climbing wall by climbing wall rescue robot, be searched and rescued by colour TV camera, thermal imaging system, communication system expansion.

abstract_en: The utility model is related to search and rescue robot under water and TRT, its remote operation platform that search and rescue robot includes being arranged on the water surface under water, the pressure hull being in water, the anchor being arranged on pressure hull, be arranged on pressure hull and for the communication antennas of remote operation platform wireless telecommunications, the tail ballast tank being arranged in pressure hull afterbody inner chamber, the five leaf skew back oars for being horizontally set on pressure hull afterbody, the stabilizer and X-type rudder being separately positioned on tail ballast tank lateral wall；The utility model is reasonable in design, compact conformation and easy to use.

abstract_en: Underground rescue robot disclosed by the invention, including supporting construction, supporting construction are connected with crawl structure by rotating shaft.Wherein supporting construction includes fixation support bar, side wall attachment, fixed structure upper end cover, support bar adjusts motor, fixed structure bottom end cover, barrel shape hanger device, gear putting hole, mechanical arm assembly swing pinion and mechanical arm assembly electric rotating machine, wherein crawl structure includes antitorque supporting construction, mechanical arm assembly upper end cover, mechanical arm assembly bottom end cover, mechanical arm moves up and down motor, mechanical arm, manipulator electric rotating machine, manipulator support, manipulator adjusts motor, manipulator and manipulator folding motor.Operation in the case that the present invention can coordinate in the case where bore is less than 25CM deep-well without rescue target, it is time saving and energy saving, it is safe.

title_en: A kind of moveable crawler type search and rescue robot
abstract_en: A kind of moveable crawler type search and rescue robot, including provided with the battery for energy storage, for detecting fire temperature, gas density, disaster scene, call for help information and image information module fuselage that audio communication and passback are collected, the fuselage both sides are provided with moving parts, drive motor is additionally provided with the fuselage, the drive motor connecting band track wing plate, there is rocking arm decelerator on the right side of the rocking arm wing plate, there is control cabinet below the water receiver, there is sensor the control cabinet lower right, the sensor internal LED, alert speaker is provided with the right side of the sensor.The utility model uses Liang Lv legs travel mechanism, is raising grade climbing performance, obstacle performance, across ditch performance and maneuverability in complex environment.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system, which comprises a search and rescue system arranged at an unmanned aerial vehicle end: the electronic compass module is used for detecting the flight state of the unmanned aerial vehicle; the flight fault detection module is connected with the electronic compass module and is used for judging the flight state of the unmanned aerial vehicle; the unmanned aerial vehicle positioning module is used for detecting the current position of the unmanned aerial vehicle; the search and rescue control module is respectively connected with the flight fault detection module and the unmanned aerial vehicle positioning module and is used for controlling to close a power supply loop of the unmanned aerial vehicle positioning module when the flight state of the unmanned aerial vehicle is abnormal; the communication module is connected with the search and rescue control module and is used for outputting the position data of the unmanned aerial vehicle in a wireless mode after adjusting the position data; and the upper computer is in remote communication with the unmanned aerial vehicle and is used for analyzing the position data of the unmanned aerial vehicle. The invention also correspondingly provides a search and rescue method for the unmanned aerial vehicle, when the unmanned aerial vehicle fails to cause accident, the accident place of the unmanned aerial vehicle is accurately confirmed, so that search and rescue can be conveniently carried out, and the loss is reduced.

title_en: Search and rescue robot for GIS/HGIS transformer stations
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of search and rescue robot for GIS/HGIS transformer stations, including crawler unit, head and armo(u)red cassete, the crawler unit is installed in armo(u)red cassete both sides, the head is installed on armo(u)red cassete, it is equiped with the armo(u)red cassete and crawler unit on the fish-eye camera for panoramic imagery, the head and is equiped with visible ray high-definition camera and infrared imaging temperature measuring camera.The search and rescue robot for being used for GIS/HGIS transformer stations has the advantages that obstacle performance is strong, can reflect the extent of damage of the scene of the accident comprehensively in the very first time, is easy to precise controlling to operate.

title_en: Disaster site robot
title_ko: 재난현장용 로봇
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster site robot, which is released to a disaster area when a disaster situation such as a fire and an earthquake occur, and then generates coordinates in order to locate a missing person, thereby enabling life-saving to quickly proceed, and comprises: an inner body having a weight, which is formed at a lower part thereof, for maintaining the center of gravity at the center thereof; a driving motor provided inside the inner body; a driving unit comprising a pair of wheels axially coupled to the driving motor and formed at both sides of the inner body; an outer body moving by receiving power from the rotating wheels; an ultrasonic sensor unit for recognizing an external environment by using an ultrasonic wave; a communication unit; and a control unit.
