title_en: Search and rescue method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle group
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue method and system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, which comprises the steps of firstly utilizing a personal wireless network simulated by the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster to search registration or resident information of a personal mobile terminal of people in danger, interacting information searched by different unmanned aerial vehicles through an unmanned aerial vehicle self-organizing network formed by inter-machine communication modules, then calculating and confirming the identity, the geographic position and other information of the people in danger according to the information of the people in danger independently obtained by a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles, and finally sending the combined information back to a rescue center ground station through a remote pass-back module equipped by a pass-back unmanned aerial vehicle. The invention realizes the purpose of carrying out large-range accurate and efficient rescue search on a plurality of persons in danger by utilizing a plurality of different communication modules equipped by the unmanned aerial vehicle group.

title_en: A kind of search and rescue system with search and rescue robot and communication robot
abstract_en: The utility model is related to a kind of search and rescue system with search and rescue robot and communication robot, wherein system includes multiple search and rescue robots, and the search and rescue robot includes signal lamp, the first wireless transport module, the first power supply, first microprocessor and the first Power Component；Multiple communication robots, the communication robot includes camera, the second wireless transport module, second source, the second microprocessor, the second Power Component and is wirelessly transferred terminal；Host computer, the host computer is wirelessly transferred terminal and/or first wireless transport module is communicated with described.Using this kind of system, communication robot is parked in corner and serves as the smooth transmission that signal terminal maintains signal, so as to add the wireless transmission distance of search and rescue robot, considerably increases search efficiency；Search-and-rescue work under mine can be efficiently applied to, other scenes or the search-and-rescue work of other demands can also be applied to, it is adaptable to large-scale promotion application.

title_en: A kind of double-crawler type emergency rescue robot and control method

abstract_en: The invention discloses a SLAM system and a method based on a wireless self-organizing local area network of a robot search and rescue environment, wherein the system comprises a wireless self-organizing local area network formed by at least two satellite robots and a leading robot; each satellite acts as a mobile network node in the wireless ad hoc local area network and is configured to: transmitting the self-positioning information and the constructed corresponding local map information to the leading robot; the dominant robot acts as a mobile master network node in a wireless ad hoc local area network and is configured to: and receiving information transmitted by all the mobile network nodes, merging the position information of the dominant robot, forming a real-time robot cooperative motion control strategy and a global map of the search and rescue environment, and transmitting the real-time information to each mobile network node to control the mobile network nodes to accurately execute corresponding SLAM tasks.

title_en: missing man location tracking system and operating method thereof

abstract_en: The present invention provides a location tracking system of a missing person using an unmanned aerial vehicle which is programmed to maintain a stationary state at a flight location only when a Bluetooth communication connection with a slave Bluetooth module provided in a specific carrying recognizer received by a seeker is checked as well as to allow an unmanned aerial vehicle to flight along a path received by the seeker, and a control method thereof. Therefore, a seeker searching at a remote place can easily find as well as quickly and accurately tracking a location of a missing person.

title_en: unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system and a method thereof.A positioning device is arranged on a user body, and the coordinate position of the user is obtained by utilizing one satellite positioning module; when the positioning device is triggered, a signal transmitting module transmits the identification code and the coordinate position of the positioning device to a host; the host transmits the coordinate position to the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle flies to the coordinate position, captures the image picture of the position and transmits the image picture to the host in real time; the host judges whether the user is contained in the image picture, and sends a control signal to the unmanned aerial vehicle so as to control the unmanned aerial vehicle to correct the flight route until the user is found. The invention utilizes the long-distance transmission technology to send positioning information during emergency rescue, and utilizes the unmanned aerial vehicle to capture images and send the images to the host computer to judge information, thereby increasing the success rate of search and rescue.

title_en: A kind of robotic vision system and its control method for mine rescue

title_en: Lost person rescue drone
abstract_en: A system and method for optimizing a rescue operation of an individual. The method comprises maintaining, by an individual engaged in an activity, an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) associated with and in proximity to the individual. For storage at the UAV, the individual records at a recording device a message. A sensor device is configured to detect a situation requiring a need to rescue the individual at a current location, and generates a trigger signal in response to a detection. In response to the receipt of the trigger signal, a current GPS location of the individual is recorded and a launching of the UAV to traverse a flight-path to a destination location. At or before arriving at the destination location, the UAV contemporaneously provides the stored recorded message and current GPS location of the individual to an emergency response authority to inform of the individual's situation and location.

title_en: All-terrain intelligent rescue robot with self-balancing objective table

The walking mechanism with the structure overcomes the defect that the existing robot cannot adapt to various complex terrains in earthquake disaster areas, and has the characteristics of strong maneuvering performance and simple structure; the self-balancing object stage can be always in a horizontal state under any condition, so that wounded in a disaster area can be rapidly, stably and safely transported out of the disaster area for rescue, and the situation that secondary injury possibly occurs in the transportation process is avoided.

abstract_en: An improved unmanned aerial vehicular system having a rotor head assembly with any balanced number of rotary wings or blades, a generally tubular body assembly, a gimballed neck connecting the head to the body, and a navigation, communications and control unit such as for military and humanitarian operations, including payload delivery and pickup. title_en: Unmanned Vehicle Control and Operation in a Marine Environment

The present invention provides various configurations of unmanned vehicles, or drones, that can be operated and/or controlled for such systems or tasks. One or more unmanned vehicles can be integrated with a dedicated marine electronic device of a marine vessel for autonomous control and operation. Additionally or alternatively, the unmanned vehicle can be manually remote operated during use in the marine environment. Such unmanned vehicles can be utilized in many different marine environment systems or tasks, including, for example, navigation, sonar, radar, search and rescue, video streaming, alert functionality, among many others. However, as contemplated by the present invention, the marine environment provides many unique challenges that may be accounted for with operation and control of an unmanned vehicle.

abstract_en: Disclosed are a portable device and a drone for a location tracking service, and a location tracking service providing method using the same. title_en: Search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention relates to search and rescue systems intended for providing prompt assistance to persons who are in life-threatening situations. A search and rescue system includes: a base object equipped with a receiver/direction-finding device and an omnidirectional antenna for receiving an emergency signal from a person in distress; a life-saving flotation means having a receiver/direction-finding device; and also a compact radio transceiver secured to a person and linked via a radio channel to the omnidirectional antenna and receiver/direction-finding devices of the base object and the life-saving flotation means. The life-saving floatation-means is a robotic floatation means equipped with an engine, a transceiver and an automatic control system. The base object is additionally equipped with perimeter monitoring means, a device for releasing a lock and automatically ejecting the flotation means, a transceiver, and a command device which, upon receiving a signal indicating that the perimeter has been crossed and/or a signal from a radio identifier of a person in distress, controls release of the lock and the automatic ejection of the robotic life-saving flotation means. The possibility of instantaneous rescue of persons falling from base objects is achieved.

title_en: Search and reconnaissance method by multiple drones using particle swarm algorithm
title_ko: 생체 모방 알고리즘을 이용한 다수 드론의 수색 및 정찰 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a searching and reconnoitering method for multiple drones using bio-mimetic algorithm. According to the present invention, the searching and reconnoitering method for multiple drones using the bio-mimetic algorithm includes: a step of setting an area which a drone searches and reconnoiters by a main server of a ground control center; a step of determining the number of drones searching and reconnoitering a predetermined area and determining a related matter necessary for mission execution of the drone based on the determined number of the drones; a step of forming a group of the all available drones based on the determined number of drones and dividing the total area for search and reconnaissance in accordance with a group number; a step of setting a head drone of each group, a flight speed of the drone, and flight time of the drone and starting initiation of flight; a step of performing the search and reconnaissance using the bio-mimetic algorithm by each group and changing the general message between groups after a predetermined time stamp renewing situation of each group; a step of performing redistribution of the drone when the battery capacity of the drone exceeds a predetermined battery critical value by determining whether the battery capacity of the drone exceeds the predetermined battery critical value and performing the search and reconnaissance when the battery capacity of the drone does not exceed the predetermined battery critical value; and a step of stopping the search and reconnaissance in a predetermined area when search tie and reconnaissance times of the random group exceed total flight time by determining whether the search time and reconnaissance time of the random group exceed the total flight time, and limiting performing search and reconnaissance work to the total flight time when the search time and reconnaissance time of the random group do not exceed the total flight time. The purpose of the present invention is to provide a searching and reconnoitering method for multiple drones using the bio-mimetic algorithm, capable of enabling the drones to perform a given mission in an effective and optimized method.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 생체 모방 알고리즘을 이용한 다수 드론의 수색 및 정찰 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 생체 모방 알고리즘을 이용한 다수 드론의 수색 및 정찰 방법은, 지상 관제 센터의 메인 서버에 의해 드론이 수색 및 정찰할 총 지역을 설정하는 단계; 설정된 지역을 수색 및 정찰할 드론의 수를 정하고, 정해진 드론 수를 바탕으로 드론의 임무 수행에 필요한 관련 사항을 결정하는 단계; 정해진 드론 수를 바탕으로 사용 가능한 모든 드론의 그룹을 형성한 후, 수색 및 정찰의 총 지역을 그룹 번호에 따라 분할하는 단계; 각 그룹의 헤드 드론, 드론의 비행 속도 및 시간을 설정하고, 비행 초기화를 시작하는 단계; 각 그룹이 생체 모방 알고리즘을 이용하여 수색 및 정찰을 수행하고, 각 그룹의 상황을 갱신하는 특정 시간 스탬프 후 그룹들 간에 일반 메시지를 교환하는 단계; 드론의 배터리 용량이 설정된 배터리 임계값을 초과하는지를 판별하여, 초과하면 드론의 재분배를 수행하고, 초과하지 않으면 수색 및 정찰을 계속 수행하는 단계; 및 임의의 그룹의 수색 및 정찰 시간이 총 비행 시간을 초과하는지를 판별하여, 초과하면 해당 그룹의 드론은 해당 지역 내에서 수색 및 정찰을 중단하고, 초과하지 않으면 총 비행 시간 때까지 수색 및 정찰 작업을 계속 수행하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Emergency Rescue Method Using Radar Sensor
title_ko: 레이더 센서를 이용한 재난 현장에서의 조난자 탐색 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a victim search method at a disaster site using a radar sensor and, more specifically, to a victim search method at a disaster site using a radar sensor which collects information including location information of an injured person or a victim via a radar sensor and an unmanned aerial vehicle to perform disaster management if site access is difficult because a communication system including a base station and an infrastructure including roads are destroyed when a catastrophic disaster such as a flood, an earthquake, a fire, or a forest fire occurs. The victim search method at a disaster site using a radar sensor comprises: a step of loading a radar sensor on an unmanned aerial vehicle; a step where the unmanned aerial vehicle (10) performs automatic flight in a flight path set for a disaster environment in air of a disaster area and uses a radar sensor to search for a victim when a disaster occurs; a step where a disaster management center (20) performs a set operation to acquire location information of the victim and rescue the victim by the unmanned aerial vehicle (10); and a step of automatically performing a warning if data are not inputted from the unmanned aerial vehicle.
abstract_ko:

무인 항공기에 레이더 센서를 탑재하는 단계와; 재난이 발생되면 무인 항공기(10)는 재난 지역 상공에서 재난환경에 설정된 비행경로로 자동비행을 수행하고 레이더 센서를 이용하여 조난자를 수색하는 단계와; 재난관리 센터(20)가 무인 항공기(10)를 통해 조난자의 위치 정보 파악 및 구조를 위해 설정된 동작을 수행하는 단계와; 무인 항공기로부터 데이터가 입력되지 않으면 경보를 자동으로 수행하는 단계로 이루어지는 것이 특징이다.

title_en: Overwater search and rescue positioning method based on multiple sensor networks
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-sensor network-based overwater search and rescue positioning method, and belongs to the technical field of multi-sensor networks. The invention comprises the following steps: acquiring the position of a sensor node, and acquiring and exchanging position coordinate information of the sensor node in real time through GPS and wireless communication; establishing a sensor node stress model, abstracting a sensor node into particles in a potential force field, and analyzing the action of force between the sensor nodes to control the moving direction and distance of the sensor node; multi-sensor network area coverage based on improved virtual force algorithms. The invention can realize seamless coverage of the area of the multi-sensor network and collect data of the covered area; the photoelectric imaging system determines a search target by utilizing the gray level and temperature difference, and determines and feeds back the coordinate position information of the target by utilizing a trilateral positioning algorithm.

title_en: Robot to rescue people in case of fire
title_ko: 화재 인명구조 로봇
abstract_en: Disclosed is a life rescue robot in fire. According to the present invention, the life rescue robot in fire comprises: a frame having an evacuation space formed in a center to evacuate persons to be saved; a driving unit including a pair of driving wheels installed on both front sides of the frame and driven by a driving motor, a pair of driven wheels installed on both rear sides of the frame, and a driving track having a structure of a caterpillar installed in the driving and driven wheels; a camera installed on the front top of the frame to photograph a driving direction and surroundings; a fire extinguishing agent spray nozzle installed on the front side of the frame to selectively spray a fire extinguishing agent; an infrared sensor installed on the front side of the frame to recognize the person to be saved; and a control unit installed inside the frame, including a wireless communication module, transmitting an image photographed by the camera and a signal detected by the infrared sensor to a user′s controller disposed outside a building in real-time, and controlling the driving unit and the fire extinguishing agent spray nozzle in accordance with a control signal generated from the controller. Accordingly, the life rescue robot in fire enters the building to check a fire site through the camera in occurrence of fire, thereby providing effects of easily figuring out the scale of the fire, performing a firefighting function by operating the fire extinguishing agent spray nozzle, and safely rescuing and evacuating the person to be saved to the outside when the person to be saved exists.

title_en: A kind of multiobjective priority sorting appraisal procedure under disaster assistance environment
abstract_en: The present invention provides the multiobjective priority sorting appraisal procedure under a kind of disaster assistance environment, including：Rescue target is clustered：According to practical rescue situations, rescue target is divided into disaster affected people or ignition point two major classes, and according to each target point measured value, establish its task feature vector respectively；In similar target point, subordinated-degree matrix of the influence factor measured value to corresponding opinion rating of target point is calculated；In similar target point, the weighted value of each influence factor is calculated according to measured value；The evaluation vector of target point is calculated according to subordinated-degree matrix and weighted value；According to maximum membership grade principle, the evaluation of estimate of target point is obtained.Present invention mainly solves the multiobjective priority sorting evaluation problems of rescue robot under rescue background, help to improve identification of the rescue robot for rescue target, to greatly improve rescue effect and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Missing person searching system using VHF and UHF wireless backhaul based Drone with camera and mobile communication base station

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for searching for a missing person using a drone based on a wireless backhaul which uses non-licensed bands of VHF and UHF. A system for searching for a missing person while constructing a missing person searching network which provides a communication network in an area where a communication infrastructure cannot be provided comprises a TVWS donor, a TVWS relay, a terrestrial device, and a drone. The TVWS donor, the TVWS relay, the terrestrial equipment and the drone are enabled to perform data communication with each other using a signal of TV white space (TVWS) band, thereby constructing a missing person search network. The TVWS donor is connected to the TCP/IP network and relays data communication between the TCP/IP network and the missing person search network. The TVWS relay performs data communication with the TVWS donor and the terrestrial equipment using the signal of the TVWS band. The terrestrial equipment performs data communication with TVWS relay and the drone using the signal of the TVWS band. The drone performs a search for a missing person in a predetermined area using a thermal imaging camera and/or a CCTV camera. According to the present invention, provided is an effect of reducing the search cost and time by providing a system capable of searching for a missing person with a low cost and a small number of rescue personnel.

본 발명은 VHF 및 UHF의 비면허 대역을 사용하는 무선백홀을 기반으로 드론을 이용하여 실종자를 수색하는 실종자 수색 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 개시된 통신 인프라를 제공할 수 없는 지역에서 통신망을 제공하는 실종자 수색망을 구성하면서 실종자를 수색하기 위한 실종자 수색 시스템은 TVWS 도너, TVWS 릴레이, 지상기기, 및 드론을 포함하고, 상기 TVWS 도너, 상기 TVWS 릴레이, 상기 지상기기, 및 상기 드론을 TVWS(TV White Space) 대역의 신호를 이용하여 데이터 통신이 되도록 하여 실종자 수색망을 구성하고, 상기 TVWS 도너는 TCP/IP망과 연결되고, 상기 TCP/IP망과 상기 실종자 수색망 간의 데이터 통신을 중계하고, 상기 TVWS 릴레이는 상기 TVWS 도너 및 상기 지상기기와 TVWS 대역의 신호를 이용하여 데이터 통신을 수행하고, 상기 지상기기는 상기 TVWS 릴레이 및 상기 드론과 TVWS 대역의 신호를 이용하여 데이터 통신을 수행하고, 상기 드론은 열화상 카메라 및/또는 CCTV 카메라를 이용하여 설정된 영역에서 실종자를 수행할 수 있다.

title_en: Systems and methods for semantic knowledge based dynamic utility calculation
abstract_en: Parameters specific to robot, environment, target objects and their inter-relations need to be considered by a robot to estimate cost of a task. As the existing task allocation methods assume a single utility value for a robot-task pair, combining heterogeneous parameters is a challenge. In applications like search and rescue, manual intervention may not be possible in real time. For such cases, utility calculation may be a hindrance towards automation. Also, manufacturers follow their own nomenclature and units for robotic specifications. Only domain experts can identify semantically similar terms and perform necessary conversions. Systems and methods of the present disclosure provide a structured semantic knowledge model to store and describe data in a uniform machine readable format such that semantics of those data can be interpreted by the robots and utility computation can be autonomous to make task allocation autonomous, semantic enabled and capable of self-decision without human intervention.

abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of search and rescue unmanned planes that vibration control can be realized based on piezo-electricity composite material, it is related to air vehicle technique field, including searching and rescuing drone body and two blade cylinders, two blade tube inner chamber side walls are socketed on the shaft outer wall of motor in drone body, the left and right lateral wall of two blade cylinders is provided with blade, the bottom of the blade is provided with piezoelectric film sensor, piezoelectric actuator is provided at the top of the blade, the piezoelectric film sensor and piezoelectric actuator pass through the power supply in controller and drone body and are electrically connected, this kind can realize the search and rescue unmanned plane of vibration control based on piezo-electricity composite material, design is reasonable, it is practical, pass through piezoelectric film sensor, the control system of piezoelectric actuator and controller composition, the vibration that blade can be inhibited to generate, it improves and searches and rescues nobody The stability of machine operation.

title_en: It is a kind of for testing the environment simulator of search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of for testing the environment simulator of search and rescue robot, including cabin, the two sides of the cabin are mounted on hatch door, the cabin is made of No.1 boiler-plate and No. two boiler-plates, and No.1 boiler-plate is identical as the size of No. two boiler-plates, the inner upper end of the No.1 boiler-plate and No. two boiler-plates is mounted on spray tube, the lower end outer surface of the spray tube is fixedly installed with spray head, the inner upper of the No.1 boiler-plate and No. two boiler-plates is mounted on camera, the back end outer surface of the cabin is equipped with water tank, the upper end outer surface of the water tank is equipped with water pump, the side of the water pump is fixedly connected with water pipe, the interior side of the No.1 boiler-plate and No. two boiler-plates is equipped with simulation and searches and rescues body, the upper end that body is searched and rescued in the simulation is equipped with counterweight.The utility model can make search and rescue robot and more fully test, and can improve the accuracy of test result, have practicability.
assignees: JINSHENG SHIDAI TIANJIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of unmanned plane search and rescue repeater system carrying Beidou, AIS
abstract_en: This patent discloses the unmanned planes of a kind of carrying Beidou, AIS to search and rescue repeater system, the system comprises: unmanned aerial vehicle platform, the unmanned aerial vehicle platform uses regular hexagon plate structure, and multiple perforative through-holes are evenly distributed on platform, and the shape of the through-hole is circle；Extend a cantilever arm on each angle of the unmanned aerial vehicle platform, the length of six cantilever arms is identical to be evenly distributed on around the unmanned aerial vehicle platform, is fixed with blade in the external end of cantilever arm；Battery frame；Forwarding module host, for the forwarding of search and rescue signal, the forwarding module host is also connected with the AIS module external antenna, Beidou module external antenna, battery and camera, controls the work of each external device.Through the above technical solutions, the range of search and rescue signal transmission can be expanded by UAV system, and the stability of enhancing signal transmission, to improve the probability of being rescued of drowning man and article.
assignees: QINGDAO SEALION NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of system design for searching and rescuing unmanned plane
abstract_en: The present invention relates to unmanned plane field more particularly to a kind of system designs for searching and rescuing unmanned plane.A kind of double loop controller is devised using PID control, and TRAJECTORY CONTROL and gesture stability are carried out to quadrotor drone.Control system uses two close cycles circuit, the control system of quadrotor drone is divided into two parts of outer loop control and inner loop control, outer ring is TRAJECTORY CONTROL circuit, and inner ring is gesture stability circuit.To realize search-and-rescue work, need to carry out the acquisition of image information by image collecting device, present invention employs visible light image acquisition devices and graphic images acquisition device.The present invention improves the efficiency of search-and-rescue work, has very high practical value and promotional value.

title_en: A kind of mining rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of mining rescue robots, including body and the main crawler belt being arranged on body, climbing crawler belt, lifting wheel and drilling rod, the inner rotation of main crawler belt is connected with multiple groups lifting wheel, fixing sleeve is socketed on the outer wall of rotating bar, the inside of fixing sleeve is fixedly connected with drilling rod, the second air-leg is fixedly connected on the lower inner wall of drilling rod, the upper end of second air-leg is fixedly connected with conveyance conduit, the upper end of drilling rod slidably connects drill bit, drill bit can be separated by control body, two groups of sliding blocks separate, channel is formed between drill bit, then pass through the length of the second air-leg of adjusting, conveyance conduit is set to enter the inside in the hole that drill bit drills out, relief goods inside conveyance conduit enter the inside in hole, supplement trapped person in time, reduce risk, it ensure that trapped person's Safety, rescue efficiency is high, is suitble to promote.

title_en: Robot management system
abstract_en: The invention provides a robot management system, which properly determines the service required by the person staying in the facility. The robot management system is provided with a movable robot, a camera for shooting, and a human detection part for detecting a human from a shot image, wherein the robot provides a service for the detected human, and the robot management system is provided with: a behavior pattern table (111g) which registers the still time and the action time of the person and the behavior pattern defined by the repetition of the combination of the still time and the action time in association with the service provided to the person; and a behavior pattern determination unit (111f) which determines, when the behavior of the person detected from the captured image matches the behavior pattern registered in the behavior pattern table (111g), the service that the robot should provide to the person based on the corresponding behavior pattern.

title_en: High-rigidity reconfigurable wheel/track deformation traveling mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a high-rigidity reconfigurable wheel/track deformation walking mechanism, which comprises a machine body, a driving assembly, a wheel assembly and a reconfiguration assembly, wherein the machine body comprises two symmetrically arranged outer wheel units and a connecting piece, and the symmetrical surfaces of the two outer wheel units are transverse middle surfaces; the driving assembly comprises a main shaft and two driving gears which are symmetrically arranged about a transverse middle plane, and the driving gears are symmetrically arranged on the main shaft to form the driving assembly; the wheel assembly comprises two inner gears which are symmetrically arranged about the transverse middle plane, the inner gears are connected with the machine body through a revolute pair, and the two driving gears are respectively meshed with the two inner gears, so that transmission is realized; the reconfiguration assembly comprises two deformation mechanisms, and switching of the running mechanism wheel/track movement modes can be realized through the folding and unfolding deformation of the two deformation mechanisms; the invention is an over-constraint mechanism, has high rigidity and high stability, and can be applied to a post-disaster rescue robot rapid moving mechanism and the like.

title_en: Flexible parcel rescue device in narrow space
abstract_en: A flexible package rescue device in narrow space relates to a deep well rescue robot, which comprises a support chassis, an air inlet connecting disc, a transmission mechanism, a support cylinder, an inflation end cover, a power source, a double-layer flexible inflation bag and a plurality of soft ropes; the support cylinder is connected to the lower end face of the support chassis, the inflatable end cover covers the support chassis, the air inlet connecting disc and the transmission mechanism, the inner layer of the double-layer flexible inflatable bag is clamped at the contact connection position of the support chassis and the air inlet connecting disc, and the outer layer of the double-layer flexible inflatable bag is clamped at the contact connection position of the inflatable end cover and the air inlet connecting disc; the transmission mechanism is arranged at the through hole of the supporting chassis and is driven by a power source arranged on the inflatable end cover. The invention has simple structure, safety and reliability, and is suitable for rescue operation in a deep well in a narrow space.

title_en: Adaptive gait autonomous emerging method of snake-like search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an adaptive gait self-emerging method of a snake-like search and rescue robot, which is used for designing a corresponding gait self-learning method by using a deep reinforcement learning theory aiming at a special mechanical structure of the snake-like search and rescue robot and a complex dynamic non-structural environment where the snake-like search and rescue robot is located. The method is applied to the snake-like search and rescue robot, and can generate an optimal control strategy by continuously acquiring information from the environment, so that the adaptive gait of the snake-like search and rescue robot can emerge autonomously in a complex non-structural rescue scene. The method adopts distributed parallel approximate strategy optimization, and strategy experiences of a plurality of snake-like search and rescue robots are mutually shared, so that quick adaptive learning of unknown rescue environment is realized. The invention solves the problems that the traditional reinforcement learning method can not adapt to a complex non-structural environment, the algorithm has low convergence speed, poor stability and the like, is more practical, and can enable the snake-like search and rescue robot to autonomously generate an adaptive optimal gait in a search and rescue task.

title_en: A kind of intelligent AR thermal imaging fire helmet
abstract_en: The present invention proposes a kind of intelligent AR thermal imaging fire helmet, including helmet shell body, infrared thermal imaging optical lens, display, optical projection apparatus and shield, infrared thermal imaging optical lens, display, optical projection apparatus and shield are arranged in helmet shell body, and helmet shell body, infrared thermal imaging optical lens, display, optical projection apparatus and shield become one.The present invention have the advantages that it is new reasonable, simple and practical in structure, be related to technology maturation, be easy to industrialized production, while intelligent AR thermal imaging fire helmet of the present invention can provide an intelligence for fireman and reliably search and rescue equipment.
assignees: QIDONG SHENGHAN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of rescue robot Special transmitting formula life discovery mould group
abstract_en: The utility model proposes a kind of rescue robot Special transmitting formula life find mould group; including shell; shell includes front housing section, shell middle section and shell back segment; front housing section includes preceding attachment base and outer jointing jacket; shell back segment embeds battery; limit plate, guide plate and module protection shell are set in shell middle section; module protection shell embeds life discovery module; the utility model structure is simple; pass through the shell of segmented; life discovery module is integrated in wherein, dismountable battery of arranging in pairs or groups is powered life discovery module；Shell is in shell shape, is carried without fire fighter, and usable transmitter is emitted in the scene of a fire, carries out life detection, can also be dropped, and when air-drop, under the action of clump weight, direction, applicability are high always for front housing section；Outer jointing jacket provides protection of falling, and the first, second fire-proof sponge of lining of arranging in pairs or groups is buffered, and guarantees that life discovery mould group after landing, reduces impact injury, can run well.
assignees: ZHONG HONG NANO FIBER TECH DANYANG CO LTD

title_en: A kind of dedicated remote life discovery module of rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model proposes a kind of dedicated remote life discovery module of rescue robot, it can be mounted on rescue robot, including emitter and life detectors, emitter includes transmitter, pedestal, electrical turntable, front support seat, rear branching holder and control motor, life detectors are emitted to designated position by transmitter, the utility model structure is simple, transmitter passes through electrical turntable and control motor, adjust the direction of the launch and the angle of departure, adjust rapid reaction, and it is laborsaving, life detectors use sectional casing, and integrate life discovery module, collocation battery, it is powered；Shell is carried without fire fighter, is emitted in the scene of a fire, is detected by transmitter, can also be dropped by aircraft, and it is accurate to fall position, and risk bottom；Outer jointing jacket on front housing section provides protection of falling, and collocation fire-proof sponge is buffered, and guarantees that life discovery mould group after landing, reduces suffered impact injury, operating is stablized.
assignees: ZHONG HONG NANO FIBER TECH DANYANG CO LTD

title_en: Flexible deep well rescue robot based on air pressure drive
abstract_en: A flexible deep well rescue robot based on air pressure drive relates to a deep well rescue robot, which comprises an upper control platform, a flexible arm, a connecting rod, a clamping device and an inflatable rescue device; a plurality of connecting rods connected with the upper control platform and the inflatable rescue device are arranged between the bottom of the upper control platform and the inflatable rescue device, the inflatable rescue device is of an annular hollow structure and is positioned in an annular space defined by the connecting rods, a plurality of flexible arms which can swing and stretch up and down are connected to the bottom of the upper control platform along the circumferential direction, and the lower ends of the flexible arms are connected with a clamping device used for clamping clothes; the clamping device is arranged in the hollow part of the inflatable rescue device, a double-layer flexible inflatable bag capable of inflating and coating a human body is fixedly connected to the inflatable rescue device, and two ends of the hollow connecting rod are respectively in sealing connection with the double-layer flexible inflatable bag and an above-ground air source. The invention has compact structure and good flexibility and is suitable for rescue operation in narrow space.

title_en: A kind of large size fire-fighting fire extinguishing reconnaissance robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of large-scale fire-fighting fire extinguishing reconnaissance robots, the robot includes fire-fighting robot ontology and long-range control cabinet two parts, and wherein fire-fighting robot ontology is made of cabinet, cabinet attachment, independent-suspension damping system, main drive part, data acquisition and hop.Long-range control cabinet is the remote control unit of fire-fighting fire extinguishing reconnaissance robot, and long-range control cabinet is equipped with display, fire-fighting robot ontology control rocking bar and water cannon control button.The robot can replace fire-fighting and rescue personnel to enter the problems such as hazards scene of the accident such as inflammable and explosive, toxic, anoxic or dense smoke explore, search and rescue, put out a fire, efficiently solve personal safety threat that fire fighter faces in above-mentioned place, data information acquisition is insufficient.
assignees: CITIC HEAVY IND KAICHENG INTELLIGENT EQUIP CO LTD

title_en: A kind of emergency rescue vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to emergency and rescue equipment technical field, and in particular to a kind of emergency rescue vehicle includes specially installing standby and chassis, and specially installing is standby is installed on chassis；It includes power supply system, the communication system for being used for transmission data and image, the unmanned plane for completing search-and-rescue work, the electro-optical system for detecting ambient enviroment and the station for manipulating unmanned plane and electro-optical system that specially installing is standby；Electro-optical system is installed on roof, and electro-optical system and unmanned plane are connect with station；Electro-optical system and unmanned plane pass through communication system and exterior terminal device talk；Communication system, electro-optical system and station are powered by power supply system.Emergency rescue vehicle provided by the utility model is searched and rescued using electro-optical system and unmanned plane cooperation, after electro-optical system detects doubtful wrecked personnel, it is flown using UAV flight's appropriate payload to suspected target, it is confirmed whether it is wrecked personnel and carries out rescue work again, search efficiency can be improved, and reduce rescue worker's danger.
assignees: WUHAN GAODE ANXIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mobile robot positioning and mapping method in dangerous chemical engineering accident
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for positioning and mapping a mobile robot in a dangerous chemical accident environment, which is applied to a search and rescue mobile robot and can be used for positioning and mapping on a complex dangerous chemical accident site, so that the influence of illumination and smoke caused by dangerous chemical explosion and the like is weakened to a certain extent, and the robustness and the precision of positioning and mapping under the accident condition are improved. The core of the method is to carry out image defogging processing by using a space-time Markov random field method, and to adopt a stable monocular vision SLAM method based on a characteristic point method to fuse IMU sensor data to carry out positioning and mapping of the mobile robot in dangerous chemical accidents, so that the exploration capability of the robot to the environment under the dangerous chemical accidents is further improved.

title_en: Universal configurable perception decision terminal and perception decision method for underground robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a universal configurable perception decision terminal and a perception decision method for an underground robot, wherein the terminal comprises a data perception conversion module, a decision processor, a data transmission module and a wireless network communication module. The invention can provide a quick decision processing method for various robots such as flying, crawler-type walking and the like for executing mine disaster search and rescue tasks to search for the optimal moving path, improves the flexibility of robot rescue movement, provides effective technical support for rescue, shortens the time of the robot moving underground, and has popularization value.

title_en: A kind of scene of a fire unmanned plane search and rescue system
abstract_en: It is disclosed by the utility model to belong to search and rescue device technical field, specially a kind of scene of a fire unmanned plane search and rescue system, including drone body, the drone body bottom is equipped with the first protective shell, the first protective shell inner cavity top is equipped with the first mounting plate, first mounting plate bottom is from left to right sequentially installed with data storage module, GPS positioning device and A/D conversion module, the protective shell intracavity bottom is equipped with the second mounting plate, reception of wireless signals emitter and single-chip microcontroller are installed at the top of second mounting plate, the first protective shell lower center position is equipped with hemispherical transparent shield, the hemispherical transparent shield inner cavity is equipped with image collecting device, the New Scheme can effectively position trapped person, fire fighter is facilitated to be unfolded to search and rescue, it simultaneously can be to inflammable in the scene of a fire Explosives is positioned, and fire fighter is facilitated to shift, and avoids exploding, effectively control the condition of a disaster.

title_en: Rope rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of rope rescue robots, are related to field of rescue equipment.Including rectangular main body box, semicircle side box；Wherein, battery, Diao Sheng mechanism, keying line plate and headlamp are installed in rectangular main body box, drive wheel groove motor is installed in semicircle side box.It is that rectangular main body box along the two sides in rope direction is respectively arranged with handrail at innovation, manual governing handle wherein is installed on a side handrail, the manual governing handle and keying line plate are electrically connected, for controlling the advance of the rescue robot, astern speed and the lifting speed of Diao Sheng mechanism；The conductor rope mechanism that the rope rescue robot vertical climbs is provided on semicircle side box.For the utility model by setting manual governing handle and conductor rope mechanism, rescue personnel can manual or remote control robot traffic direction (up and down move forward and backward) and the speed of service.The efficiency for improving rope rescue is more applicable in the rescue of the disaster accidents such as valley, lofty mountains, river, high-rise.
assignees: SICHUAN ZHONGKE LINGE TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of fire rescue rescue robot for searching trapped person
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of fire rescue rescue robots for searching trapped person, including accepting pedestal and linking shaft, the lower end linking for accepting the middle of the base has driving wheel, and wheel outer water cooled pipeline is installed on the outside of driving wheel, the left upper end of the outer water cooled pipeline of the wheel is mounted with major cycle water tank, and pedestal water cooled pipeline is installed on the right side of major cycle water tank, time cyclic water tank is mounted on the right side of the major cycle water tank, lower-left end inside the major cycle water tank is equipped with water circulating pump, and the lower end of water circulating pump is connected with water delivery nozzle, the right side linking of the water circulating pump has pump mouth.The beneficial effects of the utility model are: the fire rescue rescue robot for searching trapped person; it is provided with undertaking pedestal; the driving wheel being distributed in a ring by four about the center for accepting pedestal; can be convenient apparatus body come to driving wheel add cooling protection structure, thus conveniently come to accept pedestal power mechanism protect.
assignees: DONGGUAN QIQU ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of track combined underground moving robot of wheel leg
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of track combined underground moving robots of wheel leg, it includes car body (1), chassis (2), leg formula moving assembly (3), steering assembly (4), wheeled rotary components (5), mobile device deformed component (6), resilient track (7) and Athey wheel rotary components (8).The utility model can realize the track combined movement of wheel leg, most suitable motion mode can be selected according to topographic features, and whole height flexibility and changeability executes the undergrounds tasks such as exploration search and rescue to quickly reach designated position.
assignees: CHANGZHI LUANZHANG VILLAGE IND TRADE CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of fire-fighting search and rescue robots, it is connected including robot data processing module and controller data processing module and by wireless device, the input terminal of robot data processing module connects Temperature Humidity Sensor, harmful gas sensor, pyroelectric sensor, radar range finding sensor and flame sensor, the output end and motor drive module of robot data processing module, lifting arm drive module is connected with the input terminal of fire extinguisher starting module, direction controlling module, the output end of lifting arm control module and fire extinguisher selection starting module is connect with the input terminal of controller data processing module, the output end of controller data processing module and the input terminal of Liquid Crystal Module connect, detect camera and fire extinguisher direction camera by camera 4G router and 4G network and host computer 4G router again with host computer phase Connection.It is that one kind can detect scene of fire environment automatically and data and image wireless transmission are returned terminal, terminal control machine people is precisely put out a fire and searched and rescued.
assignees: GUANGDONG PROVINCE JIEYANG SENIOR TECHNICAL SCHOOL

title_en: Search And Rescue Unmanned Aerial System
abstract_en: The subject matter of this specification can be embodied in, among other things, a method that includes a computer-implemented method for creating three-dimensional models includes capturing, at a first location, a two-dimensional first image of a three-dimensional scene, capturing, at a second location, a two-dimensional second image of the three-dimensional scene, measuring a range distance from at least one of the first location and the second location to a closest object in the scene, determining a depth map based on differences between the first image and the second image, determining a three-dimensional point cloud based on the range distance, the depth map, and at least one of the first image and the second image, and providing the three-dimensional point cloud as a three-dimensional model of the three-dimensional scene.

title_en: A kind of search and rescue detection flashlight
abstract_en: The present invention relates to search and rescue instrument field, and in particular to a kind of search and rescue detection flashlight, including optical detection end and acoustic detection end, optical detection end are connected through a screw thread with acoustic detection end；The optical detection end includes headlamp, laser emitter, laser pickoff, battery cavities and control unit, brightness regulating switch；The acoustic detection end includes ultrasonic transmitter-receiver, vibrator, loudspeaker, display screen and mode selecting button.Present invention incorporates two kinds of distance measuring methods of laser and sound ranging and torch functions, flashlight brightness is adjustable and can use suitable distance measurement mode according to environment difference, the distance value detected shows that detection efficient early period for improving search-and-rescue work keeps search-and-rescue work more convenient by display screen.

title_en: A kind of Multifunctional firefighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of Multifunctional firefighting rescue robot, including patrol car body and fire-fighting car body, goes on patrol between car body and fire-fighting car body and connected by bindiny mechanism；Going on patrol car body includes mobile mechanism, and mounting plate is fixedly installed in mobile mechanism, a water tank is provided on mounting plate, immersible pump is provided in water tank, immersible pump water outlet is equipped with water pipe, and water pipe top is equipped with spray assembly；Spray assembly includes turntable and multiple spray heads for being installed on disk peripheral face, water pipe top protrude into turntable and with turntable connects with the internal cavities, deep groove ball bearing is fixedly installed in turntable, water pipe passes through deep groove ball bearing, is fixedly connected with deep groove ball bearing inner ring, to realize being rotatably connected between turntable and water pipe；Multiple spray heads are circumferentially uniformly distributed along turntable and spray head is tilted to same direction；Robot of the invention improves fighting efficiency the case where can scene of fire be maked an inspection tour and be saved simultaneously, grasp scene of fire in real time.
assignees: XIAN DINGZI ELECTRONIC INFORMATION SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: A kind of slidably easy-to-dismount emergency management and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of slidably easy-to-dismount emergency management and rescue robots, including cabinet and telescopic rod, the bottom surface of the cabinet is equipped with flexible rotary column, and the bottom of flexible rotary column is provided with directive wheel, footing is provided at left and right sides of the flexible rotary column, connecting column is provided at left and right sides of the cabinet, and connecting column is provided with motor far from the side of cabinet vertical centerline, spherical-shaped piece is installed on the outside of the motor, and motor is provided with shaft far from the side of cabinet vertical centerline, the bottom end of the telescopic rod is provided with idler wheel, and telescopic rod is located at the lower section of spherical-shaped piece, roller shaft is provided on the inside of the idler wheel, and roller shaft is provided with elastic belt far from one end of cabinet vertical centerline, billiard table column is installed above the connecting column.Slidably easy-to-dismount emergency management and rescue robot is equipped with idler wheel and arm bar for this, which is fast moved, and the robot possesses the ability to article carrying.

title_en: Fire search and rescue system and its control method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to fire search and rescue system and its control method, fire search and rescue system includes: search and rescue robot and the monitor terminal that connect with search and rescue robot wireless telecommunications；The search and rescue robot includes: image collecting device, for acquiring scene of fire depth image；Characteristic extracting module, for extracting the profile of indicator of trapped personnel from the depth image；Flame detector, for being detected around the profile to the indicator of trapped personnel；And the fire gun with horizontal and vertical two rotary freedoms.

title_en: A kind of intelligent carrying platform of water surface rescue
abstract_en: A kind of water surface provided by the invention rescues intelligent carrying platform, comprising: cabinet, camera, the first control module, rescue robot, catapult-launching gear and dynamic positioning mechanism；Camera is set to the top of cabinet, for acquiring the image data in presetting range；First control module is set on cabinet, and is communicated to connect with camera, for determining whether there is drowning man according to image data；Rescue robot and catapult-launching gear are set in cabinet, rescue robot is released cabinet by the ejection instruction that catapult-launching gear is used to be sent according to the first control module, and the rescue instruction that rescue robot is used to be sent according to the first control module moves to target position and rescued；Dynamic positioning mechanism is set to the bottom of cabinet, for cabinet to be fixed on the water surface.The technical issues of present invention, which is able to solve traditional mode of suing and labouring waterborne rescue personnel is needed to be lauched, to sue and labour, and the life security of itself is unable to get guarantee, and secondary disaster easily occurs.
assignees: GUANGZHOU TUOLANG INTELLIGENT EMERGENCY TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of hydraulic control system based on mine disaster rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of hydraulic control system based on mine disaster rescue robot, mainly by fuel tank 1, filter 2, volume adjustable hydraulic pump 3, overflow valve 4, hand reversal valve 5, for the hydraulic cylinder (6 of telescopic moving, 7), hydraulic cylinder (8,9,10), hand reversal valve 11 forms.Variable displacement hydraulic pump 3 rotates under the drive of motor, and oil liquid enters hydraulic pump through filter 2, after oil liquid pressure reaches the pressure of overflow valve setting, pulls hand-operated direction valve 5 and is at left position, oil liquid flows to hand-operated direction valve 11 by hand-operated direction valve 5.It pulls the hand-operated direction valve 11 positioned at the right and is at left position, oil liquid flows into telescopic hydraulic cylinder (6,7), and system starts to carry out stretching motion；The hand-operated direction valve 11 positioned at the left side is pulled simultaneously and is at left position, and oil liquid flows into hydraulic cylinder (8,9,10), and gradation force-increasing mechanism is started to work, and upper cover plate starts to act on.

title_en: Method and device for prolonging service life of underwater sound search and rescue beacon
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for prolonging the service life of an underwater sound search and rescue beacon.A main body device of the underwater sound beacon starts an electric quantity detection function after entering water, and calculates the ratio of the residual electric quantity of a battery to the total electric quantity of the battery; setting the work of an internal transmitting module into a first work mode; in a first working mode, the underwater acoustic beacon main body device transmits underwater acoustic signals at intervals of T1 and accumulates the transmitting times S1 of the first working mode, wherein T1 is more than 1S; if the underwater sound beacon main body device meets the preset condition C, setting the work of the transmitting module to be a second working mode, and otherwise, setting the transmitting module to be a first working mode; and in a second working mode, the underwater sound beacon main body device transmits the underwater sound signals at intervals of T2, and the transmission times S2 of the second working mode are accumulated, wherein T2 is less than 1S. The underwater acoustic search and rescue beacon automatic adjustment method automatically adjusts the transmission interval of the underwater acoustic signals according to the detection result of the external search signals and the residual electric quantity of the battery, prolongs the service life of the underwater acoustic search and rescue beacon, and improves the success rate of searching and positioning underwater targets.

title_en: A kind of wheel leg type multi-mode inspection search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of wheel leg type multi-mode inspection search and rescue robots, including multistable rack, movement leg, the omni-directional wheel with driving motor, steering engine line wheel component and outer sensor, the multistable rack includes four base units, four base units constitute a polygonized structure, and be connected between adjacent two base units by accumulation of energy hinge two-by-two, each base unit is made of the spring hinge of two link blocks and centre；There are four the movement legs and what is be mutually symmetrical respectively is mounted on four base units；There are four the omni-directional wheels, which is separately mounted on four base units；The steering engine line wheel component includes line wheel interconnected and driving steering engine, and the wirerope in the line wheel connects eight link blocks, and the driving steering engine is connect with any link block；The outer sensor is mounted in multistable rack.The present invention has the characteristics that lightweight, strong flexibility and reliability are high.

title_en: A kind of rescue machine snake and its working method based on positioning with imaging technique
abstract_en: A kind of rescue machine snake and its working method based on positioning with imaging technique disclosed by the invention, belongs to rescue aid technical field.Including snake-shaped robot and controlling terminal；Rescue robot does not need setting extremity body structures using snakelike, small in size, body is streamlined, and kinetic stability is good, and adaptation to the ground ability is strong, can flexibly take action in the ruins gap after disaster；And it reduces the movement to ruins or further destroys, trapped person is avoided further to be injured.Rescue personnel passes through the positioning system and audio and video acquisition devices on snake-shaped robot, the physiological status of trapped person can be intuitively obtained over the display, determine rescue priority, keep rescue work more reasonable, the location information that positioning system obtains simultaneously can make to rescue more accurate, efficient, improve the probability of being rescued of trapped person.

title_en: A kind of Multifunctional firefighting rescue robot
abstract_en: It the present invention relates to a kind of Multifunctional firefighting rescue robot, including active car body and is connected from motor vehicles bodies, active car body and between motor vehicles bodies by bindiny mechanism, bindiny mechanism includes the plug division being set on active car body and is set to from the receptacle portion on motor vehicles bodies；The first groove for interconnecting piece insertion is provided in receptacle portion, the upper and lower two sides of first groove are provided with the second groove for link block insertion, it active car body and is connected in the second groove between motor vehicles bodies by link block, to realize active car body and from the connection of motor vehicles bodies；Rescuing robot for fire control of the invention, two car bodies are connected by bindiny mechanism, two car bodies can be driven to travel together by a driving element, save component, reduce cost, and the connection and separation of two car bodies can be realized by remotely control for bindiny mechanism, and two car bodies can carry out different operating simultaneously, improve rescue efficiency.

title_en: The rescue system of six wheel rescue nonirrigated farmland robots
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the rescue systems of six wheel rescue nonirrigated farmland robot of one kind, comprising: six wheel rescue nonirrigated farmland robots, cloud database, tele-control system, the six wheels rescue nonirrigated farmland robot, for executing the rescue operation in rescue site；The cloud database, for recording and saving rescue robot rescue information；The tele-control system, for showing robot real-time position information and real-time video information, to six wheel rescue nonirrigated farmland robot real-time controls.The robot architecture is small and exquisite, spare parts purchasing replacement is convenient, frame is carried with equipment, plurality of devices can be carried simultaneously, in cave, after rescue environment or Debris-flow Hazard that ruins et al. hardly enter in the lower environment of safety coefficients such as scene, scene of fire, it can be used as the rescue vanguard, it is presented by its flexible performance and camera function and completely clearly rescues environment, completed the highly difficult rescue tasks such as investigation, search, rescue, realize the multifunctional rescue of intelligent accurate.

title_en: A kind of unmanned plane search and rescue system and method
abstract_en: A kind of unmanned plane search and rescue system and method, belong to air vehicle technique field.This unmanned plane search and rescue system, including DF, signal conversion communication module, flight control panel, winged control, ground control station, number biography.Distress signal in region is searched and positioned by UAV flight DF equipment, this is for the first time to use the technology on unmanned plane in search and rescue field；Corresponding rescue method is provided, during utilization, explores more realistic search highway route design, improves the reliability and search and rescue ability of the unmanned plane search and rescue system.
