title_en: Rescue robot end effector
title_ko: 구난로봇 말단장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a rescue robot terminal device and, more specifically, to a terminal device combined with the ends of both arms of a rescue robot for rescuing people in a disaster area. The rescue robot terminal device includes: a lower roller rotated closely on the ground; and an upper roller rotated closely on the upper part of the lower roller.
abstract_ko: 제안기술은 구난로봇 말단장치에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 재해 또는 재난 지역에서 인명을 구조하기 위한 구난로봇의 양팔 단부에 결합되는 말단장치에 관한 발명이다.

title_en: Emergency delivery all-in-one machine of territory wisdom
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of intelligent emergency delivering integrated machine, including: the system comprises a monitoring analysis module, a resource mass storage module, a three-dimensional delivery module, a display module and a human-computer interaction module; the monitoring analysis module integrates the information of each disaster situation, and calculates and obtains disaster situation parameters required for formulating an emergency delivery scheme; the resource mass storage module acquires and manages daily storage information and disaster-time storage information of each material storage point, each personnel storage point and each transport means storage point; and the three-dimensional delivery module is used for formulating a three-dimensional delivery distribution scheme according to the disaster parameter information obtained by the monitoring analysis module and the material and facility storage information obtained by the resource mass storage module, and performing comprehensive distribution operation of the local emergency mass storage material by utilizing the local delivery scheduling platform according to the three-dimensional delivery distribution scheme. The disaster information processing system integrates the processed disaster information of a search and rescue center, a meteorological center and a statistical unit and various disaster condition information of an unmanned aerial vehicle and the like, and realizes the information acquisition and the effective utilization of materials in the area where the disaster area belongs.

title_en: A kind of maritime affairs UAV Video image defogging method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of maritime affairs UAV Video image defogging method based on deep learning, comprising steps of 1) establishing marine video image data library according to atmospherical scattering model by the marine clear video image of unmanned aerial vehicle onboard video camera shooting；2) multiple dimensioned convolutional neural networks model is established, the training of marine video image data library is used；3) marine video image is acquired by the visible image capturing head being mounted on unmanned plane, obtains the I ' of image containing mist (x) of shooting；4) the trained multiple dimensioned convolutional neural networks model of mist image I ' (x) input will be contained to handle, obtain intermediate variable k (x)；5) formula is restored using clear image obtain mist elimination image J ' (x) to the end, the recovery formula of clear image are as follows: J ' (x)=k (x) (I ' (x) -1)+b, I ' (x) is the video image containing mist of shooting, J ' (x) is the clear image restored, k (x) is intermediate variable, and b can use arbitrary constant.The present invention can effectively solve the smudgy problem of video image of unmanned plane vision system acquisition under the conditions of the greasy weather, to improve the search and rescue ability of unmanned plane.

title_en: Search and rescue trolley and search and rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model embodiment discloses a kind of search and rescue trolley and search and rescue system, wherein searching and rescuing trolley includes: car body；Terminal device is installed in car body, terminal device be equipped with universal input/output interface, utilizing camera interface, radio network interface and power interface, to from each interface to data handle；Information collecting device is installed on the front end of car body, connect with the utilizing camera interface of terminal device and universal input/output interface, acquires video data and thermal imaging data are transmitted to terminal device；Power drive device is installed on the two sides of car body, connect with the universal input/output interface of terminal device, the movement for the control instruction control car body that receiving terminal apparatus issues；Terminal device also passes through radio network interface and connect with remote equipment, to remote equipment uploaded videos data and thermal imaging data, receives the control instruction that remote equipment issues；Power supply is set in car body, is connect with the power interface of terminal device, provides electric energy to be installed on each equipment of car body.

title_en: A kind of landslide geological disaster rescue intelligent robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of landslide geological disasters to rescue intelligent robot, including intelligence machine human agent, the lower end outer surface of the intelligence machine human agent is fixedly connected with control device shell, the surrounding outer surface of the control device shell is fixedly connected to articulate axis, one end outer surface of the articulate axis is fixedly connected with mobile mechanical arm, the outer surface of the intelligence machine human agent is provided with sealing hatch door and life sensing detecting head, and the life sensing detecting head is located at the two sides of sealing hatch door.A kind of landslide geological disaster of the present invention rescues intelligent robot, equipped with gyroscopes frame, first aid goods and materials storehouse and GPS locator, it can guarantee that spherical lifesaving booth is in stable state, the wounded are avoided to receive secondary injury, and rescue materials needed can be provided to trapped person, search-and-rescue work can also be carried out by GPS positioning within the specified range according to geologic topographic map, bring better prospect of the application.

title_en: A kind of rescue robot with the deformable wheel of umbrella shape
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of rescue robots with the deformable wheel of umbrella shape, belong to lifesaving appliance technical field.The robot includes fuselage, fuselage is equipped with deformable wheel, driving running gear and driving anamorphotic system, deformable wheel includes affixed side plectane, jackshaft, link mechanism and active side plectane, affixed side plectane is coaxially fixed on the outside of jackshaft, active side plectane is coaxially fixed on the inside of jackshaft, link mechanism is that the hinged end of multiple groups and its both ends respectively with affixed side plectane and active side plectane is fixed, driving anamorphotic system is slided on jackshaft by controlling active side plectane, realizes the deformation of wheel；The rotation of running gear control jackshaft is driven to realize the walking of deformable wheel.The mine rescue robot is very good to the adaptability of roadway unstructured moving grids after catastrophe.The gap narrow by underground when using wheel radius minimum is gone to cross biggish obstacle when with wheel radius maximum, saves a large amount of time to the search and rescue of rescue personnel.

title_en: A kind of overboard target search and rescue system with homing function
abstract_en: A kind of overboard target search and rescue system with from target-seeking function, it includes long-range Quick throwing unit, multi-sensor fusion fast search positioning system and lifesaving raft, the multi-sensor fusion fast search positioning system includes Beidou positioning module, radio-frequency spectrum direction finding module, visible light infrared detection module and fuse information processing platform, the Beidou positioning module, radio-frequency spectrum direction finding module, visible light infrared detection module is used to determine the orientation of target, the information such as distance, the fuse information processing platform is used for use processing, the data that multisensor is obtained carry out fusion treatment, form unified target range, azimuth information, and it is transferred to the control system of unmanned boat, unmanned boat control system generates navigation data according to the target information of fusion, guide unmanned boat close to target to be rescued.The utility model has many advantages, such as that easily realization, timeliness are good, rescue range is wide.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of highly-safe landslide geological disaster rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to robotic technology fields, and disclose a kind of highly-safe landslide geological disaster rescue robot, including body, the interior lower end of body offers cavity, the inside of cavity is fixed with dual-axle motor, two output ends of dual-axle motor pass through shaft coupling and are rotatably connected to the first threaded rod, the left and right sides of cavity offers circular hole, the inside of two circular holes slidably connects the first internal screw thread cylinder, two the first threaded rods extend respectively to the inside of two circular holes and are threadedly coupled with the first internal screw thread cylinder, the side wall of first internal screw thread cylinder is fixedly connected close to one end of dual-axle motor there are two symmetrically arranged first sliding block, the inner sidewall of circular hole offers the first sliding groove to match with the first sliding block, two opposite both ends of the first internal screw thread cylinder are fixedly connected to perpendicular setting support column.The utility model can effectively carry out intelligent robot stablizing support, and intelligent robot is avoided to topple over when excavating, and use convenient for people.

title_en: Multi-source Information Fusion search and rescue system based on multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of Multi-source Information Fusion search and rescue system based on multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, which is characterized in that including multi rack large size multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, the small-sized short distance multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle of multi rack, locator, ground maneuvers center and the unmanned vehicles of Duo Tai.The present invention merges big small drone, unmanned transit equipment and infrared detector data, information fusion is carried out at the ground maneuvers center and repeated data deletes choosing and processing, when some disaster-stricken individual has been launched locator, ground maneuvers center is labeled it, prevents the repetition dispensing of locator and the repetition of rescue information.Due to the adoption of the above technical solution, compared with prior art, the present invention having the following advantages that and good effect: the present invention has good practicability, disaster-stricken individual can quickly be positioned, disaster-stricken individual position can be utmostly captured, the dispensing of locator is carried out, facilitates later period Quick rescue.

title_en: A kind of fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire rescue robots, including shell, mobile mechanism and rescue room, rescue room is fixedly installed at the top of the mobile mechanism, and the internal activity for rescuing room is equipped with rescue plate, shell is fixedly installed at the top of the rescue room, and the inside of shell is fixedly installed with installation room, the inside of the installation room is fixedly installed with first motor, turntable is rotatably equipped at the top of the shell, the output end and turntable of the first motor are rotatablely connected, the top of the turntable is fixedly installed with watering can by mounting base, and watering can is flexibly connected with mounting base by hydraulic telescopic rod, the inside of the watering can is fixedly installed with the second motor by mounting rod, and second the output end of motor be fixedly installed with fan.The utility model is provided with rescue room and rescue plate, and when finding masses suffering from disaster, masses suffering from disaster can enter rescue room by rescue plate and reduce the Personal Risk of fireman to save masses suffering from disaster.

title_en: A kind of automation search and rescue UAV system and control method using infrared thermal imaging sensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of automations using infrared thermal imaging sensor to search and rescue UAV system and control method, the rotor and undercarriage being arranged on body；Model airplane battery, thermal imaging sensor and infrared sensor below the body；The distributor plate of the internal body, electric tune, GPS system, flight control system, sensor signal processing board, wireless telecommunication system；Since the difference of body temperature and ambient temperature can have the higher effect for identifying human body relative to common camera using thermal imaging sensor under more low resolution, it will be greatly reduced in the discrimination of night common camera, and thermal imaging/sensor can improve identification due to the reduction of environment temperature and the disappearance of natural optical noise.Search and rescue region flight control assemblies are divided by base station and realize that traversal is searched automatically by biologically inspired neural network algorithm according to region, once detect that human body just sends signal and image to base station and notifies rescue worker by thermal imaging sensor.

title_en: A kind of unmanned plane inspection search and rescue system and rescue method based on Multi-sensor Fusion
abstract_en: The unmanned plane inspection search and rescue system and rescue method that the invention proposes a kind of based on Multi-sensor Fusion, system includes signal projector, unmanned plane search and rescue system and ground rescue center, signal projector is set on wearable bracelet, dot position information is rescued for sending, unmanned plane search and rescue system and ground rescue center are for determining personnel positions and personal information, record landform, determine rescue route, the flight sub-control system of unmanned plane is by the autonomous unmanned plane of quadrotor in the present invention, image and quantity acquisition processing module, signal transmission module, terrain analysis and route planning module form, fast reaction and in real time collection analysis image information can be made in autonomy-oriented inspection operation.Automatic body identification is carried out using image procossing, the information and date library recognized is subjected to Data Matching, it is determined whether has searched target person and while having determined trapped person's quantity.

title_en: A kind of data correlation pedestrian tracking algorithm based on unmanned plane
abstract_en: Currently, unmanned plane has good flight advantage and wide flight range, it can easily complete to take photo by plane, search and rescue, topographic(al) reconnaissance, monitor the tasks such as scouting, it is in an increasingly wide range of applications in numerous areas.But currently, the correlative study for pedestrian tracking in UAV Video image is also less, and the accuracy of the tracking of target is need to be improved.The present invention proposes a kind of data correlation pedestrian tracking algorithm based on unmanned plane, mainly there are following steps: generating fusion feature in deep learning frame by trace model end to end and extract and respond, and combine target line people and its correlation between different frame, data correlation tracking is carried out to target pedestrian.A kind of data correlation pedestrian tracking algorithm based on unmanned plane, which realizes, can automatically position pedestrian according to the feature of input picture when unmanned plane shoots pedestrian and achieve the effect that tracking, it is obviously improved in the identification and tracking of existing pedestrian, algorithm speed.

title_en: Sea search and rescue equipment based on unmanned aerial vehicle technique
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sea surface search and rescue equipment, and discloses sea surface search and rescue equipment based on an unmanned aerial vehicle technology. This kind of sea search and rescue equipment based on unmanned aerial vehicle technique, the fixed slot is aimed at to the stabilizer blade when unmanned aerial vehicle descends, at the in-process that falls down, unmanned aerial vehicle's stabilizer blade and commentaries on classics piece contact, and it is rotatory to promote the commentaries on classics piece, the commentaries on classics piece is gone through ninety degrees after stabilizer blade and the yacht contact, live unmanned aerial vehicle's stabilizer blade buckle, the telescopic link extension promotes the kicking block and stretches out simultaneously, block the position of commentaries on classics piece, the realization is firmly in the same place unmanned aerial vehicle and yacht lock joint, it drops from the yacht to avoid unmanned aerial.

title_en: Evaluation method of intelligent ground-air heterogeneous multi-robot human performance evaluation system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of simulation evaluation of robots, and particularly relates to an evaluation method of an intelligent performance evaluation system of a multi-robot in a terrestrial and space heterogeneous structure, wherein the performance evaluation system comprises the following steps: the system comprises an information processing terminal, an image processing terminal, an evaluation processing terminal, a command terminal, a land robot, an aerial robot, a 3D printing terminal and a pre-estimation terminal; the search and rescue robot disclosed by the invention is mainly used for solving the problems that the search and rescue environment is limited due to the single motion form of the existing search and rescue robot, the search and rescue effect is not obvious due to the fact that the existing search and rescue robot does not have the functions of automatic judgment and search and rescue, the search and rescue efficiency of the search and rescue robot is greatly improved, meanwhile, all places in a search and rescue area can be ensured to be covered by search and rescue, and the survival probability of trapped people is greatly improved.

title_en: A kind of multi-functional search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to robot fields, specifically disclose a kind of multi-functional search and rescue robot, it is bad for existing search and rescue robot damping effect, and it is easy the problem of toppling over, now propose following scheme, it includes bottom plate, the top of the bottom plate is connected with detection device, and hingedly there are two symmetrically arranged connecting rods in the bottom end middle position of bottom plate, second spring is connected between the connecting rod and the bottom end of bottom plate, and the bottom end of connecting rod is hinged with mounting rack, the mounting rack is in inverted u-shaped structure setting, and movable pulley is rotatably equipped between the two sides inner wall of mounting rack, the side that two mounting racks are located remotely from each other is respectively connected with motion bar, the two sides arc inner wall of the bottom plate is provided with sliding slot.The utility model structure novel, and the search and rescue robot has good buffering protection function when moving on complex terrain, and effectively can prevent it from falling down, and protects, prolongs its service life to its internal structure.

title_en: A kind of quick-detachable combination search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of quick-detachable combination search and rescue robots, it is existing convenient for combination aiming at the problem that, now propose following scheme, it includes mobile body, mounting plate is welded at the top of the mobile body, it is opened up at the top of the mounting plate fluted, the bottom interior wall of the groove is vertically welded with the elastic mechanism being equally spaced, the top of the elastic mechanism is welded with the limiting plate being laterally arranged, and the inner wall of limiting plate and groove is slidably connected, the restriction plate that the inner wall of the groove top opening is welded with, installing port is offered at the top of the restriction plate, the inner wall of the installing port offers the positioning port in arranged in matrix, connecting plate is placed between the limiting plate and restriction plate, the utility model, it is combined mobile body with body is detected, to propose production efficiency, and convenient replacement in time is appointed The body of a part, is allowed to not influence to use, meets demand.

title_en: A kind of forest fire prevention and control rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to robotic technology fields, disclose a kind of forest fire prevention and control rescue robot, circuit control part including remote controler and control forest fire prevention and control rescue robot operation, further includes: vehicle body frame, link assembly, rotary tillage mechanism, diesel engine, hydraulic cylinder and transmission mechanism；The link assembly includes first end, the second end and third end, and first end and third end are located remotely from each other setting, and the second end is set between first end and third end, and first end is hinged with vehicle body frame；The rotary tillage mechanism is rotatably arranged in third end；The cylinder bottom of hydraulic cylinder is hinged with vehicle body frame, and piston rod is hinged with the second end；The diesel engine is fixed in vehicle body frame and drives rotary tillage mechanism rotation by transmission mechanism, this forest rescuing robot for fire control, which has, digs fire extinguishing isolation strip using rescuing robot for fire control, both the advantages that improving the efficiency for digging fire extinguishing isolation strip, fire also avoided to damage fire-fighting rescue personnel's life.

title_en: A kind of respirator apparatus applied to fire-fighting and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of respirator apparatus applied to fire-fighting and rescue, it include respirator, respirator is equipped with electronic system circuitry, electronic system circuitry is connected with the forward sight camera being respectively arranged on respirator, thermal imaging sensor, laser range sensor, binocular AR display device, pass through night-viewable high definition preceding camera, laser range sensor and thermal imaging sensor detect field data, it is handled by electronic system and redraws fire field environment structure and shown in binocular AR display device, it realizes fire field environment information superposition to reality, so that fireman makes fast reaction；In addition the electronic system in thermal imaging sensor and electronic system mainboard cooperates, and helps fireman quickly to search and rescue indicator of trapped personnel, and can realize with electronic system mainboard travel track recording and quickly withdraw.

title_en: Dynamic search and rescue method for geospatial heterogeneous rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of rescue robots, and particularly relates to a dynamic search and rescue method for a geospatial heterogeneous rescue robot; firstly, aerial photography is carried out on terrain and landform to be rescued through an aerial photography camera, an action route is determined, then the determined action route is input into a ground-air rescue robot, equipment needing to be carried by the ground-air rescue robot is determined again, the ground-air rescue robot is released, finally, the aerial photography camera is used for tracking the work of the ground-air rescue robot in time, and rescue is carried out on the found situation of the ground-air rescue robot in time; according to the invention, through the contact ball and the sucker, the contact ball can deform when the robot body walks, so that the robot can better adapt to uneven terrains, meanwhile, the sucker on the surface of the contact ball can be adsorbed on the ruins, so that the robot body is prevented from overturning when walking on the ruins, and the stability in operation and the capability of adapting to different terrains are improved.

title_en: A kind of robot wireless telecommunication system based on Corba middleware Technology Yu Ad hoc network
abstract_en: Robotic technology field of the present invention, specifically a kind of robot wireless telecommunication system based on Corba middleware Technology Yu Ad hoc network, including robot, fixed plate and machine pawl；Described hold is placed with communication setting above object plate, network interface is equipped in communication setting, and network interface connects Corba middleware by Ad hoc network in real time；Two drive shafts of No. two motors are fixed with rotation axis, are fixed with sender unit in rotation axis；Arc panel opposite side side is fixed with blade；The arc panel is fixed with rubber layer close to the surface in machine pawl occlusion outside；Inventive network interface connects Corba middleware by Ad hoc network in real time, realize the real-time wireless telecommunications of robot, the information and network share between robot can be realized by Ad hoc network, signal coverage distance is improved, while injury to personnel when can effectively avoid artificial search and rescue is searched and rescued by robot.

title_en: A kind of rescue robot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of rescue robots, belong to robotic technology field, including rescue cabin, rescue mechanical gripper device, four-footed telecontrol equipment, battery；The rescue cabin is rectangular box, and rescue mechanical gripper device is mounted on inside rescue cabin body, and four-footed telecontrol equipment is mounted on front and rear sides outside rescue cabin body, and it is that rescue robot integrally provides power supply that battery, which is mounted on inside rescue cabin body,.Personnel rescuing and protection work can be realized using mechanical gripper device and rescue cabin body, it is mobile that cooperation four-footed movement mechanism can be realized the walking under different road conditions.

title_en: Accidents Disasters collapsing live emergency management and rescue robot based on wireless communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses the Accidents Disasters collapsing live emergency management and rescue robots based on wireless communication, it is made of body, functional compartment and control cabinet, the functional compartment is fixed on body, the control cabinet is fixed in functional compartment, and the control cabinet is equipped with display, and the display is equipped with camera and headlamp, described body one end, which is equipped with, carries frame, the organism bottom is equipped with Overthrow preventing device, and the internal body is equipped with driving motor, the driving wheel connection of the driving motor and body.This rescue robot, the main transmission realized by movable signal to the remote control and realtime graphic of robot, load frame on body can carry relief goods, global positioning system can realize that position positions, loudspeaker can prompt trapped person, while the clamp arm on mechanical arm opens the eyes of trapped person, confirms the reaction of pupil, vibrating sensor in clamp arm can perceive the pulse of trapped person, effectively raise the success rate of rescue.

title_en: High temperature resistant fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-temperature-resistant fire rescue robot which structurally comprises a fire-fighting water spray pipe, a lifting rotating support, a camera set, a wireless signal rod, a water tank, a rear atomization walking device, a front-drive steering wheel set, a chassis and a main control machine body, wherein the rear atomization walking device consists of a left atomization wheel, a pressurization flow guide mechanism, a water inlet vertical pipe and a right atomization wheel, and the fire-fighting rescue robot has the following effects: left atomizing wheel and right atomizing wheel, utilize the forerunner to turn to the effort of dragging that the wheelset during operation produced, make left atomizing wheel and right atomizing wheel roll rotatory, utilize the rotatory kinetic energy of left atomizing wheel and right atomizing wheel, last with the inside liquid suction left atomizing wheel of water tank and right atomizing wheel, and make the liquid of input form the water smoke parcel around the robot through solid atomizing tire, form one water barrier, make and keep ice-cold constant temperature state around the robot, the direct contact of flame with the robot has been avoided, play the guard action under the high temperature environment operation to fire rescue robot.

title_en: Search and rescue auxiliary robot
abstract_en: This application involves a kind of search and rescue auxiliary robots, comprising: aerial mechanical part, land mechanical part, aerial search part, land search part, aerial controller, land controller, aerial motor, land motor and master controller；The input terminal of the master controller is connect with the aerial search part and the land search part respectively, the output end of the master controller is connect with the aerial controller and land controller respectively, is obtained search signal from the aerial search part or/and the land search part and is sent master signal to the aerial controller or/and land controller according to the search signal.The application obtains search signal by aerial and two kinds of land approach, can increase the comprehensive of search, avoid the occurrence of blind area, further, robot autonomous search and rescue mode may be implemented by the way that at least one obstacle avoidance sensor is arranged, to simplify user's operation.

title_en: One kind crossing rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses one kind to cross rescue robot, it includes airborne end and remote control end, airborne end includes airborne end housing, airborne end housing is set as semi-circular shape, airborne end housing, which is internally provided with, hangs a liter component, limit assembly, control assembly and battery pack, hangs the middle part that liter component is located at airborne end housing, hang liter component include laterally be arranged hang lifting motor, the left and right ends for hanging lifting motor are respectively connected with deceleration mechanism, and the lower part for hanging lifting motor is provided with rescue rope volume；The lower left of rescue rope volume is provided with dampening assembly, lower right is provided with limit assembly；There are two pulley, the outside of pulley is provided with upper housing for the head clearance setting of airborne end housing, and pulley is internally provided with the sheave motor for controlling pulley rotation, is provided with electric brake on pulley.The object of the invention rescues trapped person and goods and materials under the extreme environment after disaster generation, has the characteristics that functional diversities, simple operation, equipment small light and high reliability.
assignees: SUZHOU BORUIXIN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Drone for marine rescue
title_ko: 해상구조드론
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a marine rescue drone, which drops a plurality of lifesaving devices, and more specifically, to a marine rescue drone, which drops a lifesaving device provided in a receiving unit by rotating an opening and closing unit with operation of a driving unit so as to be possible to more safely protect drowning people until rescue workers arrive by quickly approaching a drowning accident site. In addition, according to the present invention, the marine rescue drone is possible to have a plurality of expandable tubes which are the lifesaving device, thereby being possible to rescue a lot of drowning people with fewer drones at once since a plurality of drones are not required when a plurality of drowning people are generated and being possible to prevent instability of the drone caused by weight imbalance by a load change after dropping the lifesaving device and unnecessary electricity consumption.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 다수의 구명장비를 투하하는 해상구조드론에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 익수사고 현장에 신속하게 접근하여 구조요원이 도착할 때까지 익수자를 보다 안전하게 보호할 수 있도록 수용부 내부에 구비된 구명장비를 구동부의 동작으로 개폐부를 회전시켜 투하는 해상구조드론에 관한 기술분야가 개시된다. 
또한, 본 발명에 의한 해상구조드론은 구명장비인 팽창형 튜브를 복수개 구비가 가능하여 다수의 익수자가 발생한 경우에도 다수의 드론이 필요치 않아 적은 수의 드론으로도 한번에 많은 익수자를 구조할 수 있는 효과가 발생하였고, 구명장비 투하 후 하중 변화에 의해 무게 불균형으로 인한 드론의 불안정 및 불필요한 전력소모를 차단할 수 있는 효과가 발생하였다.
assignees: JEONG SUN CHEOL;IND ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION DAEJON HEALTH COLLEGE;JEONG YOON SANG

title_en: Bomb dropping device and fire rescue drone
abstract_en: Provided are a bomb dropping device (32) and a fire rescue drone. The bomb dropping device (32) comprises a cartridge (325) for containing fire extinguishing bombs, a mounting seat (326) and a limiting mechanism (327), wherein the mounting seat (326) is arranged at the lower end of the cartridge (325), and the mounting seat (326) is provided with a bomb drop opening (322) at a position corresponding to the cartridge (325), the limiting mechanism (327) is disposed in the mounting seat (326) and is used for limiting the fire extinguishing bomb within the cartridge (325) when the bomb dropping device (32) is in the bomb storage state, and the limiting mechanism (327) is used to release the limit on the fire extinguishing bomb when the projectile device (32) is in the bomb dropping state.

title_en: A kind of combined type search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The present patent application belongs to robotic technology field, specifically disclose a kind of combined type search and rescue robot, including crawler type walking mechanism, framework case and barrier getting over mechanism, the crawler type walking mechanism and barrier getting over mechanism are mounted on framework case lower end, and barrier getting over mechanism is located at the front side of crawler type walking mechanism.Compared with prior art, robot can steadily advance in ruins, have preferable obstacle climbing ability, can preferably be adapted to the rescue work of earthquake.

title_en: Soft robot with alarm function for earthquake ruin search and rescue

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle landing gear and landing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle landing gear and a landing method thereof. Unmanned aerial vehicle has advantages such as simple structure, flexible, but the duration is not enough to become its biggest soft rib. The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle landing gear which comprises a base plate, a turnover steering engine, a plate top stop block, a cone top stop block and a turnover landing assembly. The base plate fix the bottom at the unmanned aerial vehicle main part. The roll-over landing assembly includes a first roll-over arm and a second roll-over arm. The first turnover arm comprises a first connecting plate, a first lifting bottom plate, a first transition plate and a first single hanging and leaning claw which are sequentially connected. The second turnover arm comprises a second connecting plate, a second lifting bottom plate, a second transition plate, a trough penetrating plate and a second hanging single claw which are sequentially connected. The unmanned aerial vehicle can stop at a higher position, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can better execute tasks such as reconnaissance, search and rescue and the like in the stop state, and the cruising ability of the unmanned aerial vehicle is improved.

abstract_en: The utility model relates to multispectral gondola technical fields, a kind of especially multispectral gondola of medical search and rescue UAV system, including firm banking, the bottom of firm banking is equipped with link block, the bottom of link block is equipped with inserted block, the first rotary electric machine is equipped in link block, the output end of first rotary electric machine is equipped with first rotating shaft, first rotating shaft runs through link block and inserted block far from one end of the first rotary electric machine, the lower section of link block is equipped with fixed frame, slot is offered at the top of fixed frame, the both ends of fixed frame symmetrically offer mounting groove, the two sides of mounting groove are symmetrically arranged with the support frame of L-type, the corresponding side of two symmetrically arranged support frames is equipped with mounting blocks, the second rotary electric machine is equipped in mounting blocks, the output end of second rotary electric machine is equipped with the second shaft, second shaft runs through mounting blocks far from one end of the second rotary electric machine, two symmetrically set Multispectral gondola is equipped between the mounting blocks set.The utility model of simple structure and strong practicability is suitble to promote.

abstract_en: The utility model provides search and rescue robot under a kind of intelligent water, waterproof base including annular, rubber air storehouse is provided on waterproof base, multiple cameras are provided in the peripheral outer wall of waterproof base, the two sides of the bottom of waterproof base are respectively connected with link mechanism, link mechanism includes fixed link, and the lower end of fixed link is hinged with connecting rod, is hinged with Powerpush Unit in connecting rod.Powerpush Unit includes cylindrical outer cylinder, is provided with floor on outer cylinder, floor is hinged with connecting rod, and lithium ion battery and propeller are provided in outer cylinder.Bottom on waterproof base is additionally provided with central controller and air pressure regulator, and air pressure regulator is connected with rubber air storehouse.The utility model monitors drowned situation using camera, once discovery drowned accident, by adjusting Powerpush Unit, so that robot quickly reaches the lower section of drowning person, the atmospheric pressure value in rubber air storehouse is adjusted, drowning person is lifted using law of buoyancy, has ensured the safety of tourist.

title_en: Drone with thermo-graphic camera and zoom camera for searching the missing on the sea and system for searching the missing on the sea
title_ko: 열화상 카메라와 줌 카메라가 장착된 해상 조난자 수색용 드론 및 이를 이용한 해상 조난자 수색 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a drone for searching missing people at sea having a thermal imaging camera and a zoom camera and a system for searching for missing people on the sea using the same. To this end, the drone for searching missing people on the sea according to the present invention comprises: a drone driving unit for a flight; a thermal imaging camera filming a thermal image video during the flight by the operation of the drone driving unit; a zoom camera filming a normal video, and having a zoom function; and a video processing unit recognizing a human body by processing the thermal imaging video and normal video filmed by the thermal imaging camera and the zoom camera. Here, the image processing unit comprises: a thermal image detection unit detecting a thermal image event corresponding to a heat source in the thermal image video; a human body detection unit extracting a human body from the normal video; and a main control unit which controls the zoom camera such that the zoom camera may zoom in and film the location in which the thermal image event is detected when a thermal image event is detected by the thermal image detection unit, and controls the human body detection unit to detect whether an object at the location corresponding to the thermal image event is a human body from the normal video filmed while the zoom camera is zoomed in. Therefore, missing people who are lost at sea due to a maritime accident can be searched in a more effective manner.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 열화상 카메라와 줌 카메라가 장착된 해상 조난자 수색용 드론 및 이를 이용한 해상 조난자 수색 시스템에 관한 것이다.  본 발명에 따른 해상 조난자 수색용 드론은 비행을 위한 드론 구동부와, 상기 드론 구동부의 구동에 따른 비행 중에 열화상 영상을 촬영하는 열화상 카메라와, 일반 영상을 촬영하며, 줌 기능을 갖는 줌 카메라와, 상기 열화상 카메라와 상기 줌 카메라에 의해 촬영된 상기 열화상 영상과 상기 일반 영상을 처리하여 인체를 인식하는 영상 처리부를 포함하며; 상기 영상 처리부는 상기 열화상 영상에서 열원에 해당하는 열화상 이벤트를 감지하는 열화상 감지부와, 상기 일반 영상에서 인체를 추출하는 인체 감지부와, 상기 열화상 감지부에 의해 상기 열화상 이벤트가 감지되는 경우, 상기 줌 카메라가 상기 열화상 이벤트가 감지된 위치로 줌-인하여 촬영하도록 상기 줌 카메라를 제어하고, 상기 줌 카메라의 줌-인 상태에서 촬영된 일반 영상으로부터 상기 열화상 이벤트에 해당하는 위치의 물체가 인체인지 여부를 감지하도록 상기 인체 감지부를 제어하는 메인 제어부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.  이에 따라, 해상 사고 등으로 해상에서 실종된 조난자를 보다 효율적으로 수색할 수 있다.

title_en: Single-degree-of-freedom wheel/track form reconfigurable walking mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to a single-degree-of-freedom wheel/track form reconfigurable walking mechanism which comprises a wheel body frame, a driving device, a walking device and a form conversion device, wherein the wheel body frame comprises two symmetrically arranged spoke plate assemblies, an upper connecting piece and a lower connecting piece, the symmetrical surfaces of the two spoke plate assemblies are transverse symmetrical surfaces, the spoke plate assemblies comprise outer wheel spoke plates and two driven gears, the symmetrical surfaces of the two driven gears are longitudinal symmetrical surfaces, the driving device comprises a driving main shaft and two driving gears, the walking device comprises two internal gears with the same structure, the two driven gears are respectively in meshing transmission with the two internal gears, the form conversion device comprises a driving hydraulic cylinder, two symmetrically arranged folding and unfolding mechanisms and a central connecting piece, and the switching of the wheel/track movement forms of the walking mechanism can be realized through the folding and unfolding deformation of the two folding and unfolding mechanisms. The over-constrained mechanism is high in rigidity, high in stability and good in obstacle crossing performance, and can be applied to a mobile obstacle crossing mechanism of a rescue robot after disasters and the like.

abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of industrial robots, in particular to a modular robot joint and a snake-shaped robot adopting the same, wherein the robot joint comprises two joint modules, a telescopic mechanism arranged between the two joint modules, the joint modules comprise a shell, a pawl device arranged in the shell and a power mechanism, the power mechanism drives the pawl device in one of the joint modules to extend out of the shell to limit the relative movement of the shell and the ground, so that the other joint module moves under the action of the telescopic mechanism to realize the relative movement or rotation of the two joint modules and realize the retreating action under the condition of no U-turn, the structure and the principle are simple, the robot joint with the structure is not only suitable for the use in conventional pipelines or narrow spaces, but also can be suitable for the use in soft environments such as grasslands, mud lands and the like, the device can be comprehensively suitable for various complex working environments faced by search and rescue work, and has strong adaptability.

title_en: Open scene-oriented multi-robot autonomous collaborative search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an open scene-oriented multi-robot autonomous collaborative search and rescue method, aiming at quickly constructing an autonomous collaborative strategy of multiple robots in a new task scene and realizing autonomous collaborative search and rescue of the multiple robots in the open scene. The technical scheme includes that various possible conditions are met by the multi-robot system in a simulation search and rescue environment, a basic multi-robot collaborative search and rescue strategy is formed, so that when the multi-robot system faces an actual search and rescue scene which cannot be predicted, strategy optimization can be performed only by using a small amount of time, and a multi-robot autonomous collaborative completion search and rescue task can be effectively completed in an open scene. By adopting the method and the system, a collaborative search and rescue strategy for a real search and rescue scene can be quickly formed based on a pre-training strategy formed in a simulated search and rescue environment, and the problem of time consumption in the process of formulating a strategy for a new scene can be effectively solved. The search and rescue strategy constructed by the method has generalization and can be suitable for different search and rescue scenes.

title_en: Deep well rescue robot for farmland
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a farmland deep well rescue robot, including well head, barrel holder, rope section of thick bamboo, commentaries on classics handle and rescue robot, rescue robot includes the piece that hangs through rope and rope section of thick bamboo fixed connection, and all installs supporting mechanism around hanging the piece, the other end of first movable rod all articulates and is connected with the third movable rod, the other end of second movable rod all articulates and is connected with the fourth movable rod, the below of fixed axle is provided with the loose axle, and is two sets of the other end of third movable rod all with left clamping bar welded fastening, two sets of the other end of fourth movable rod all with right clamping bar welded fastening. The utility model discloses it is hard to need not to meet the victim, lifts by crane victim safety, has prevented to lift by crane in-process victim and wall of a well collision and has caused secondary damage to this rescue robot need not the electric energy, is applicable to the place that this kind of switch on is difficult to in farmland deep well, the effectual survival rate that has improved the deep underground victim in farmland.

title_en: Autonomous positioning navigation method based on crawler-type rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an autonomous positioning navigation method based on a crawler-type rescue robot, which comprises the following steps: s1, configuring necessary parts and expanding a sensor by taking a crawler robot as a mobile robot platform; s2, setting TF transformation, and collecting odometer and laser radar data; s3, constructing an open source package map by adopting a Hector _ Slam map, applying KLD sampling, and positioning by adopting a particle filter; s4, the WIFI built by the router is used as wireless communication between the tracked robot and the PC upper computer, so that the data information of the sensor of the tracked robot is extracted by the PC upper computer, and an observer can monitor the running state of the tracked robot in real time; and S5, opening working nodes for autonomous positioning, drawing and navigation, indicating any self-defined target point in the simulated environment, and automatically receiving a control instruction by the crawler robot according to the path planned by the algorithm to complete the autonomous positioning and navigation task.

title_en: Special hybrid power vehicle service platform based on augmented reality technology and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a special hybrid vehicle service platform based on augmented reality technology and a control method thereof. The intelligent exploration module of the walking robot acquires the information of the damage of buildings and wounded persons on the earthquake field and feeds the information back to the earthquake monitoring workstation. The earthquake monitoring workstation plans a search and rescue route according to the earthquake field condition, and sends information to the wearable augmented reality equipment. The rescue personnel wear the wearable augmented reality equipment to enter the scene for rescue. The invention is used for earthquake rescue, can avoid unnecessary casualties of rescuers, finds the position of the disaster-stricken person in time and realizes quick and effective rescue.

title_en: Intelligent carrying platform for water surface rescue
abstract_en: The utility model provides a surface of water rescue intelligence carries on platform, include: the rescue robot comprises a box body, a camera, a first control module, a rescue robot, an ejection device and a power positioning mechanism; the camera is arranged at the top of the box body and used for collecting image data within a preset range; the first control module is arranged on the box body, is in communication connection with the camera and is used for determining whether people falling into water exist or not according to the image data; the rescue robot and the ejection device are arranged in the box body, the ejection device is used for pushing the rescue robot out of the box body according to an ejection instruction sent by the first control module, and the rescue robot is used for moving to a target position according to the rescue instruction sent by the first control module to perform rescue; the power positioning mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the box body and used for fixing the box body on the water surface. The utility model discloses can solve traditional rescue on water mode of suing and labouring and need rescue personnel launch and rescue, the life safety of self can't obtain the guarantee, very easily takes place the technical problem of secondary disaster.
assignees: GUANGZHOU TOP WAVE EMERGENCY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional firefighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire control, in particular to a multifunctional fire-fighting rescue robot, which comprises a chassis, a water tank and a water replenishing pump which are arranged at the rear part of the chassis, smoke and toxicity reducing and releasing devices which are arranged at the two sides of the chassis, a high-pressure pump set, a fire monitor, a camera monitoring mechanism and an electric control mechanism which are arranged at the front part of the chassis, wherein the water tank, the water replenishing pump and the high-pressure pump set are sequentially communicated through pipelines; the fire monitor and the smoke and toxin reducing and releasing device are respectively communicated with the high-pressure pump set through a pipeline provided with an electromagnetic valve; the monitoring mechanism that makes a video recording is used for remote monitoring and keeps watch on the scene of a fire real-time situation, and automatically controlled mechanism passes through wireless mode and remote control terminal realization wireless control, the utility model discloses a multi-functional fire rescue robot has better mobility and flexibility, has good fire extinguishing effect to can search for and rescue the scene of a fire personnel and create the fire control passageway, to improving rescue security, reduce casualties and have the significance.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle searching and positioning method and device and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides a search positioning method and device for an unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the search positioning method for the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises the following steps: controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to search a search target in a first search area; after the unmanned aerial vehicle searches the search target in the first search area, with the search target as a center, defining an area with a preset area as a second search area; reducing the flying height of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the transmitting power of an antenna on the unmanned aerial vehicle, and positioning the search target in the second search area; and acquiring the position information of the search target. This application can realize when utilizing unmanned aerial vehicle to search for, after searching for the search target, reduces unmanned aerial vehicle's flight height and the transmitting power of the antenna on the unmanned aerial vehicle, fixes a position the search target in the search area who reduces, improves the accuracy of the search position who obtains, and then improves search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Fire rescue robot
abstract_en: A fire rescue robot comprises an upper computer control unit and a device body, wherein the device body comprises a chassis, a mechanical arm, a fire extinguishing device and an electric control part, and the mechanical arm is movably arranged above the chassis; a power mechanism is arranged in the chassis and used for driving the moving components correspondingly arranged at the left side and the right side of the chassis; the fire extinguishing device is respectively arranged on the chassis and the mechanical arm; the electric control part is arranged on the chassis and is respectively and electrically connected with the mechanical arm, the fire extinguishing device and the power mechanism. Various sensing technologies, automatic control technologies, computer technologies, electromechanical integration technologies, precision mechanical design technologies and the like are adopted. The fire extinguishing system realizes the functions of fire point early warning, fire scene reconnaissance, fire scene extinguishment, fire scene rescue, obstacle clearing and the like, improves the fire extinguishing efficiency, and protects the life and property safety of people.

title_en: Rescue robot convenient to remove
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rescue robot convenient to remove, this rescue robot includes supporting component and sets up the motion subassembly at each tip of supporting component respectively to and set up the arm in the inside left and right sides of supporting component respectively. The supporting assembly comprises a rectangular top seat, supporting rods, horizontal frames and guide rails, the supporting rods are fixedly connected to two sides of the rectangular top seat at certain intervals, the bottoms of the supporting rods are fixedly connected with the horizontal frames, and the guide rails are fixedly connected between the end portions of the horizontal frames on two sides. The device has the advantages of convenience in moving, high efficiency and the like in the use process by arranging a series of structures, and is suitable for rescue places with flat road surfaces and difficult personnel entry.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle fire rescue system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire rescue system of a vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a multi-rotor load unmanned aerial vehicle and a rescue cabin, wherein the multi-rotor load unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a flight unit, an image vision unit and a data transmission unit; rescue cabin one end is equipped with the rescue entry, the rescue entry is provided with telescopic rescue bridging, rescue cabin bottom still be equipped with rescue cabin inside communicating and open closed rescue export, on-vehicle unmanned aerial vehicle fire rescue system can be used to high altitude fire rescue, adopt unmanned aerial vehicle rescue system can reduce fire fighter search and rescue time and route planning time, can reduce the time of suing and labouring of fire fighter to the stranded people by a wide margin, the danger of fire fighter sacrifice in search and rescue has been avoided, stranded personnel rescue success's probability has been improved simultaneously.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system
abstract_en: A search and rescue drone system includes a buoyant body member, a frame attached to the buoyant body member for carrying a motor and propeller, and an electronic array including a camera, GPS, an EPIRB radio distress beacon, and a transmitter/receiver for remote control flying the drone and communicating with an operator. A laser guidance system may provide coordinates for landing near a swimmer in distress. The search and rescue drone may also be programmed to simply fly to the location of an electronic wearable device, like a bracelet, that is worn by a man overboard. In another embodiment, the search and rescue drone includes pivoting motor mounts, so that it can take off and land vertically with propellers rotating in a horizontal plane, and then the propellers may pivot to rotate in a vertical plane for propulsion across water similar to a fan boat with rescued people aboard.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system
abstract_en: A search and rescue drone system includes a buoyant body member, a frame attached to the buoyant body member for carrying a motor and propeller, and an electronic array including a camera, GPS, an EPIRB radio distress beacon, and a transmitter/receiver for remote control flying the drone and communicating with an operator. The search and rescue drone may be flown manually, or may have some autonomous flight and locator capabilities. For example, in one embodiment, the search and rescue drone may be programmed to simply fly to the location of an electronic wearable device, like a bracelet, that is worn by a man overboard. In another embodiment, the search and rescue drone includes a basket, harness, or other means for actually recovering a swimmer in distress, and flying that person back to safety on a ship or on shore.

title_en: Water side rescue robot based on SLAM technology and deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waterside rescue robot based on SLAM technology and deep learning, which comprises: the image information acquisition module is used for acquiring map information of the surrounding environment and image information of the water surface environment; the sound information acquisition module is used for acquiring sound information of the water surface environment; the information processing module is used for receiving the map information, the image information and the sound information and identifying the map information, the image information and the sound information based on an SLAM technology of an ROS system and a target detection and sound classification algorithm based on a deep convolutional neural network; the control module is used for outputting a motion control signal; the motion module is used for responding to actions according to the motion control information; the transmission receiving module is used for data transmission; and the rescue alarm module is connected to the information processing module and is used for sending out a rescue signal. The water-side rescue robot based on SLAM technology and deep learning provided by the embodiment of the invention can be used for rapidly patrolling, detecting sudden drowning conditions and timely notifying rescuers, and is efficient and intelligent.

title_en: A unmanned aerial vehicle for forest control
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for forest monitoring, which comprises a body, a high-definition camera and a signal transceiver, wherein an antenna is arranged at the front end of the body, the signal transceiver is arranged at the top of the body, an electrostatic releaser is arranged at the top of the signal transceiver, a solar cell panel is arranged on the upper side of the body, an empennage is arranged at the tail of the body, an organic tire, a telescopic rod, a smoke detection head and an air humidity detector are respectively arranged at the bottom of the body, and the high-definition camera is arranged at the bottom of the telescopic rod. Has the advantages that: the invention is provided with the electrostatic releaser, a large amount of charges accumulated on the unmanned aerial vehicle shell are discharged into the atmosphere, the requirement of safe operation in thunderstorm and rainy days can be met, the signal connection of a local area network can be realized by arranging the signal transceiver, the antenna, the search and rescue lamp and the search and rescue loudspeaker, the position of trapped personnel is quickly positioned, and the rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Rescue robot with high safety reliability for fire

The utility model discloses unmanned aerial vehicle in unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system based on thing networking includes the input device, and the input device includes loading module and input module, and loading module is used for loading emergent article, and input module is used for controlling the input of emergent article, can in time send emergent article for stranded personnel through this input device; meanwhile, the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a first video call module, the control terminal comprises a second video call module, the remote monitoring platform comprises a third video call module, the video calls of the trapped people and external search and rescue people (or the trapped people's family) can be realized through the communication connection among the first video call module, the second video call module and the third video call module, the trapped people's morale is encouraged, and the emotion of the trapped people is stabilized.

title_en: Search for and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle device based on leather basic station
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle airborne equipment technical field, concretely relates to search for and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle device based on leather base station, include: the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a microcontroller arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle body, and a battery module, a rotor module, a transceiver and a network card module which are connected with the microcontroller, wherein the network card module is also connected with a pico base station; wherein, the leather basic station set up in the lower extreme of unmanned aerial vehicle body, the transceiver set up in the upper end of unmanned aerial vehicle body, the utility model discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle device has realized the communication connection of user terminal with the basic station to search for and rescue regional terminal signal.

title_en: Underwater search and rescue robot path planning method based on flow function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flow function-based path planning method for an underwater search and rescue robot, which comprises the following steps: step 1: acquiring an underwater environment through a sonar and a camera, and performing terrain modeling; step 2: when the front obstacles are overlapped, establishing a virtual obstacle of the front obstacle; and step 3: replanning a path based on a flow function method according to the virtual barrier established in the step 2; and 4, step 4: and (3) optimizing the path re-planned in the step (3) based on the constraint conditions of the underwater search and rescue robot, and finishing the path planning process. According to the method, the problems of loud sonar noise and unclear images are solved by median filtering and gray processing, and then the images acquired by the camera are subjected to image enhancement by using a Laplacian pyramid fusion method, so that the peripheral information of the robot can be better acquired, and the accuracy of a map model is improved.

title_en: Combined robot for road rescue
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of automatic rescue equipment, and provides a portable road rescue combined robot for timely processing traffic accidents and cleaning fault vehicles, which comprises a remote accident handling robot, wherein the remote accident handling robot is used for uploading accident place related information and transmitting a real-time picture to a traffic management department for remote responsibility identification and processing; portable road rescue robot; the portable road rescue robot is used for timely cleaning a fault vehicle. The system has the functions of remotely recording the damaged condition of the accident vehicle in real time, remotely recognizing the traffic accident responsibility and timely cleaning the accident vehicle, and the realization of the functions can greatly save the time required by road rescue of the fault vehicle at present, avoid the rear road congestion and even traffic paralysis caused by longer waiting rescue time and avoid the occurrence of secondary accidents in the waiting rescue process.

title_en: Search and rescue positioning method and device
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a search and rescue positioning method and a device, relates to the technical field of wireless communication, and is applied to a mobile terminal, wherein the method comprises the following steps: after a starting instruction for starting the search and rescue mode is acquired, the method enters the search and rescue mode, and performs signal search according to a preset first search strategy at a preset first search time frequency, wherein the first search strategy comprises the following steps: and designating a system and a frequency point set, and sending target information to the unmanned aerial vehicle sending the first signal when the first signal is searched according to the first search strategy, wherein the target information is used for positioning the mobile terminal by the unmanned aerial vehicle. Can practice thrift mobile terminal's electric quantity in the scene of searching for and rescuing, improve mobile terminal and unmanned aerial vehicle and establish the possibility of being connected to improve the success rate of searching for and rescuing.

title_en: Underwater robot, platform for water area search and rescue and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to an underwater robot, a platform for water area search and rescue and an operation method thereof. An underwater robot comprising: a body portion; a plurality of pushers disposed on a side of the body portion; a connecting device coupled via an end of the upper cover; and a sensor system. A platform for water area search and rescue including above-mentioned underwater robot includes: unmanned boats that navigate on the water or underwater; and a control cabin loaded above the unmanned boat. A method for operating the platform, comprising: receiving a release command; releasing the underwater robot to a predetermined depth in response to receiving the release command; in response to the underwater robot reaching a predetermined depth, receiving a work command to cause the underwater robot to perform work.

title_en: Double-task deep matching method for self-positioning and target positioning of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of multi-unmanned aerial vehicle cooperation, and discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle self-positioning and target positioning double-task depth matching method. According to the invention, both the reconnaissance unmanned aerial vehicle and the target are regarded as the objects to be estimated with uncertain positions, and the correlation among the positions of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles is considered, so that the target is positioned more objectively and accurately based on the correlation. The CSL+CTL depth fusion mode is superior to the task quality which can be completed by each of the two independent modes. The invention can be used for target positioning of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles when performing tasks such as search and rescue or monitoring.

title_en: Workshop fire rescue robot based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting rescue robot for a workshop based on the internet of things, which belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting rescue equipment, wherein a support is arranged at the top of a 1.5 x 2 crawler chassis assembly, a fire-fighting box is arranged at the top of the support, a box cover is hinged to the left side of the fire-fighting box, a camera, a smoke sensor and a laser range finder are sequentially arranged on the surface of the fire-fighting box from top to bottom, a support is arranged at the top of the fire-fighting box, a movable pin shaft is inserted on the support, a support post is welded at the top of the movable pin shaft, a support tube is welded at the top of the support post, a high-pressure spray head is arranged at the front side of the support tube, a connector is welded at the left side of the bottom of the support tube, an electric telescopic rod is arranged at the left side of the, the intelligent degree is high, and the rescue is efficient, and the practicality is strong.

title_en: Automatic rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic rescue robot, which comprises a frame, an actuating mechanism, a remote control system, an observation system and a crawler-type travelling mechanism, wherein the actuating mechanism is arranged on the frame; the frame comprises a vehicle body and a multifunctional hydraulic tail plate; the multifunctional hydraulic tail plate comprises a vehicle door, a conveying mechanism and a vehicle door hydraulic driving mechanism; the lower end of the vehicle door is hinged with the lower end of the vehicle body; the actuating mechanism comprises a swing arm, a power mechanism, a clamping assembly and a clamping driving mechanism; the clamping driving mechanism comprises a clamping hydraulic cylinder; the clamping assembly comprises two claws and two overload spring shock absorbers; one end of the overload spring shock absorber is hinged with the paw, and the other end of the overload spring shock absorber is hinged with the driving rod of the clamping hydraulic cylinder. The robot can be suitable for rescuing the wounded in severe environments such as natural disasters, fires, wars and the like; in addition, the robot can quickly align and clamp wounded persons, and the rescue efficiency and effect of the battlefield rescue robot are guaranteed.

title_en: Agricultural machinery well rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an agricultural machinery well rescue robot, which comprises a motor, a winding drum, a base, a mechanical claw hydraulic cylinder body and a grabbing and clamping finger frame, wherein the winding drum is arranged at one end of the motor along the end surface, a speed changer is arranged at the top surface of the winding drum far away from one end of the motor, the base is fixedly connected with the motor along the lower part of one end of the winding drum, the outer end of the horizontal plane of the base is provided with a convex block, the middle part of the inner surface of the convex block is connected corresponding to the rotation of the top end, and the rubber anti-collision plates are wrapped outside the convex blocks, the anti-slip chassis is made of aluminum alloy, and the lower end of the anti-slip chassis is inlaid with the wear-resistant metal block, so that the rescue workers do not need to go into the well in person, the risk of the rescue workers in the rescue process is reduced, the injury of the past rescue workers can be avoided, meanwhile, the reasonable structure of the device is utilized, the hands required for rescue are greatly reduced, and the rescue work can be carried out quickly and safely.

title_en: Foot-shaped investigation fire-extinguishing rescue robot system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a foot-shaped investigation fire-extinguishing rescue robot system and a method, the scheme comprises a foot-shaped mobile chassis, a fire-extinguishing rescue assembly and a background control system, wherein the fire-extinguishing rescue assembly and the background control system are arranged on the foot-shaped mobile chassis; the background control system acquires the field environment data and/or the field state data acquired by the fire-fighting and rescue assembly to form a fire-fighting and rescue instruction so as to control the moving state of the foot-shaped moving chassis and drive the fire-fighting and rescue assembly to carry out fire-fighting and/or rescue actions according to the moving state of the foot-shaped moving chassis. The scheme can be suitable for various dangerous accident sites, and can carry out real-time investigation and fire-extinguishing rescue on the sites; simultaneously, this scheme still has very big effective work scope, and the practicality is strong.

title_en: Docking structure of drone
title_ko: 드론의 도킹구조
abstract_en: Disclosed is a docking structure of a drone. The docking structure of a drone of the present invention is composed of a drone and baggage to be moved by the drone. The drone comprises: a body portion controlling a flight; a plurality of wing portions for the flight; a drone seating device which extends downward and lengthwise from a bottom portion of the body portion and is installed; a pair of main fixing devices installed opposite to each other on both side surfaces of the body portion; and a pivoting device connecting the main body and each main fixing device, and pivoting and driving the main fixing device. The baggage includes a landing portion having both sides to which the main fixing device of the drone can be detachably coupled. The drone can securely approach and be settled on the baggage, and can firmly fix and couple the baggage so that the baggage can be securely moved to a destination.

드론의 도킹구조가 개시되어 있다. 본 발명은, 드론과 상기 드론이 이동하고자 하는 수화물로 구성되는 것으로서, 
상기 드론은, 비행을 제어하는 몸체부; 비행을 위한 다수의 날개부; 상기 몸체부의 저부로부터 하방으로 길게 연장되어 설치되는 드론 안착장치; 상기 몸체부의 양측면에 서로 대향하여 설치되는 한 쌍의 메인고정장치; 및 상기 몸체부와 각각의 메인고정장치를 연결하며, 상기 메인고정장치를 선회구동시키기 위한 선회장치;를 포함하며, 상기 수화물은, 그 양측에 상기 드론의 메인고정장치가 탈착가능하게 결합될 수 있는 랜딩부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하며, 수화물에 안전하게 접근하여 안착할 수 있으며, 목적지까지 수화물을 안정적으로 이동시킬 수 있도록 견고하게 고정 및 결합시킬 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Novel search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a novel search and rescue robot, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein a plurality of travelling mechanisms are arranged at the bottom of the bottom plate, mounting plates are arranged at two sides of the bottom plate, the mounting plates are respectively provided with a first guide mechanism and a second guide mechanism, the first guide mechanism and the second guide mechanism respectively comprise first mounting seats which are symmetrically arranged, a bidirectional screw rod is axially connected on each first mounting seat, a guide rod is fixedly arranged above the bidirectional screw rod, the two ends of the bidirectional screw rod are symmetrically and threadedly connected with a slide block, a hinge rod is horizontally hinged on the slide block, a U-shaped plate is arranged at the side part of the bidirectional screw rod, the end part of the hinge rod is hinged on the U-shaped plate, a guide wheel is also arranged on the U-shaped plate, a power mechanism which drives the first guide mechanism and the second guide mechanism to rotate is also arranged on the bottom plate, and the search and rescue robot is suitable for various terra, and the stability is very high, can clear away the barrier.

title_en: Narrow space detection rescue robot based on TRIZ theory
abstract_en: The invention provides a small space detection rescue robot based on a TRIZ theory.A driving motor is arranged in a robot main body, driving wheels are symmetrically arranged on two side walls of the robot main body, a track shoe is arranged on the robot main body through the driving wheels, and a plurality of infrared sensors are arranged on the front side wall of the robot main body; the top of the front part of the robot main body is provided with an mechanical arm and an infrared camera in parallel, the top of the middle part is provided with a line expansion board and an Arduino auxiliary control board in parallel, and the top of the rear part is provided with a WIFI module and a drive board in parallel; and a driving steering engine is arranged at the bottom of the infrared camera. The invention is convenient for collecting field information and returning in a narrow area, gets rid of the dependence on the internet by automatically building a local area network, ensures the independence and the safety of data transmission, and realizes the removal of roadblocks by being provided with the four-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm. The structure of the invention adopts a modular design, is convenient to disassemble and assemble, is easy to maintain, and has the advantages of stable data transmission, stronger adaptability and practicability and the like.

title_en: Earthquake search and rescue device based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle, especially, earthquake search and rescue device based on unmanned aerial vehicle, including six rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, six rotor unmanned aerial vehicle's top is equipped with the GPS instrument, six rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and GPS instrument fixed connection, six rotor unmanned aerial vehicle's lower extreme fixedly connected with fixed disk, the spout has been seted up on the fixed disk, be equipped with the slider in the spout, spout and slider sliding connection, the inner wall of spout and the surface phase-match of slider, the lower extreme of slider is equipped with places the box, slider and place box fixed connection, place the lower extreme of box and seted up the cavity, be equipped with positioner in the cavity, positioner includes shockproof case, extension spring, place the board, GPS module and audible-visual annunciator, place the board and be located shockproof incasement, the fixedly connected with the sponge on shockproof incasement roof, detect the life through radar, the search and rescue team member can be conveniently and accurately positioned to the position of the trapped person, the search and rescue time is shortened, and the search and rescue team member is convenient, efficient and accurate.

title_en: Hanging type search and rescue sonar device, system and direction measurement method
