abstract_en: The invention discloses a hanging type search and rescue sonar device, a system and a direction measurement method, which can be used for searching and positioning a sunken ship beacon and an airplane black box beacon, and comprise a vector hydrophone array, a watertight electronic cabin, a load-bearing photoelectric composite cable, a photoelectric modem, a portable processor and a GPS (global positioning system) locator; the method utilizes the direction-finding principle of a vector hydrophone to carry out direction-finding on a black box beacon of a wrecking ship or an airplane, combines a multi-time direction-finding result in a different place and a measuring point position output by a GPS (global positioning system) locator, adopts a multi-point intersection and coordinate conversion method to estimate the absolute position of an acoustic beacon, and is a precondition for rescuing the wrecking ship and the wrecking airplane. The search and rescue sonar is low in cost and simple in system constitution, and can be hung and placed on a helicopter or a ship participating in rescue.
assignees: NO 750 PROVING GROUND CHINA SHIPBUILDING IND CORPORATION

title_en: Underwater search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an underwater search and rescue robot, which comprises a submarine body and a worm gear, wherein a rescue bin is welded on the top surface of the submarine body, a plurality of life buoys are superposed in the rescue bin, a through hole is formed in the side wall surface of the rescue bin, which is positioned on one side of each life buoys, and a hydraulic telescopic rod is transversely installed on the surface of the submarine body, which is positioned on one side of each through hole; the utility model discloses well submarine body top surface is installed and is rescued the storehouse, it has a plurality of life buoys to overlap layer upon layer in the rescue storehouse, the hydraulic telescoping rod that controller through submarine body starts rescue storehouse lower part and be equipped with, make hydraulic telescoping rod pass the through hole and release rescue storehouse with the life buoys one by one, thereby be favorable to rescuing drowning person on the surface of water, connect the drive chassis through the cylinder in submarine body's the inner chamber, four corners on drive chassis rotate and are connected with the wheel of grabbing, the wheel of grabbing through the propeller formula is favorable to submarine body to slide on the surface of water, thereby be favorable to rescuing the storehouse and carry out the accurate of life bu.
assignees: SHANDONG LIJU SPECIAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Ice-breaking emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides an icebreaking rescue robot that speedily carries out rescue work, including two risers and wire, first through-hole is all seted up at the riser middle part, the equal fixed mounting in outside middle part of two risers has double-shaft motor, first bevel gear is all installed in the cooperation after an output shaft level of double-shaft motor passes inboard corresponding first through-hole, second bevel gear is installed in the cooperation of another output shaft level of double-shaft motor outside and outer end, the second through-hole is all seted up to the lateral wall around the box, the equal fixed suit blade in both ends around the first pivot, the fixed suit third bevel gear in middle part of first pivot. When the small ball is applied to deicing of the quadripartion conductor, the small ball can be automatically pushed on the quadripartion conductor, so that the small ball is continuously away from and impacts the conductor, the ice layer on the surface of the conductor can be quickly cleaned, the ice breaking efficiency is improved, the small ball does rotational motion during reciprocating motion of the small ball away from and impacting the conductor, the effect of cleaning the ice layer on the surface of the conductor by the small ball is more obvious, and the ice breaking emergency rescue effect is timely and efficient.

title_en: Intelligent underwater search and rescue robot combining mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combination mechanism of an intelligent underwater search and rescue robot, wherein a connecting column and an assembly groove are vertically arranged on the surface of a connector, a slide way is arranged on the side wall of the assembly groove, the slide way is vertical to the axis of the assembly groove, a limiting pin is slidably arranged in the slide way, a vertical limiting groove is arranged on the surface of the side wall of the connecting column and corresponds to the limiting pin, when two connectors are connected, the connecting column of one connector is inserted into the assembly groove of the other connector.

title_en: Low-cost rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The scheme relates to a low-cost rescue unmanned aerial vehicle which is matched with a rescue helicopter or a ship for use and comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, an inflating device, a life buoy storage device and a spool; the life buoy receiving device is an annular container with a receiving groove at the bottom; the inflation device is provided with an inflation needle; the inflation needle is arranged at the top of the inner side of the life buoy storage device; the life buoy is folded and arranged in the accommodating groove; the life buoy comprises a life buoy ring body and an air nozzle, and the inflation needle is inserted into the air nozzle; the reel is rotatably and horizontally fixed on the inner ring of the lifebuoy receiving device; the reel is provided with a traction rope, and one end of the traction rope is tied on the life ring; the low-cost rescue unmanned aerial vehicle of the utility model takes a small or micro unmanned aerial vehicle with lower price as a carrier, greatly reduces the search and rescue cost, has wide search and rescue visual field and large search range, and is superior to a search and rescue mode of throwing or throwing a large amount of lifesaving equipment in a certain area; search and rescue personnel do not need to go deep into the dangerous ground to search and rescue, and the safety of the search and rescue personnel is improved.
assignees: TAIZHOU KEPUNI COMM EQUIP CO LTD

title_en: Maritime search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle searches for ands rescue at sea, including the unmanned aerial vehicle main part, the unmanned aerial vehicle main part is ball shell structure, and the equal fixed welding in both ends has connecting plate one about the unmanned aerial vehicle main part, the tip upper surface of connecting plate one is provided with waterproof protective housing, the equal fixed welding in lower surface both ends of waterproof protective housing has connecting plate two, and connecting plate two passes through the upper surface of fix with screw at connecting plate one. Has the advantages that: the utility model discloses a be the arc form of upwards sunken with the setting of flight oar for the air current that can the bearing when the flight oar rotates becomes many, the laborsaving flight that the unmanned aerial vehicle main part can be better, the unmanned aerial vehicle main part sets up and is the spheroid form, has reduced the influence of air current, and the flight is more stable. The utility model discloses a be provided with waterproof protective housing in the flight motor outside to make unmanned aerial vehicle flight on the sea when searching for and rescuing difficult because of moisture influences motor and battery production and damages, thereby guarantee unmanned aerial vehicle's normal search for and rescue operation.

title_en: UWB positioning-based on-water intelligent rescue machine system and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent underwater rescue machine system based on UWB positioning, belonging to the technical field of underwater rescue, comprising a movable tag, a positioning base station, a software platform and a rescue robot, wherein the movable tag can emit UWB signals; the positioning base station can receive UWB signals sent by the movable tags and analyze the positions of the tags through a self-adaptive algorithm; the software platform acquires, analyzes and transmits information to users and other related information systems, and assigns rescue robots to carry out rescue; the rescue robot comprises an MCU control module, a power supply module and a power device, wherein the MCU control module adopts an stm32f407 single chip microcomputer as a main control MCU, the power device comprises a direct-current brush motor, propellers and a driving circuit, two groups of propellers are arranged on two sides of the rescue robot respectively, and the direct-current brush motor drives the propellers to rotate so as to realize the rotation of the rescue robot.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a machine head, an electricity storage chamber, a machine body and a tail wing, wherein the machine head is connected with the electricity storage chamber; the top of the machine body is provided with a first propeller and a third propeller; a first brushless motor is arranged in the machine body corresponding to the first propeller; a second brushless motor is arranged in the machine body corresponding to the third propeller; side wings are fixedly arranged on the two sides of the machine body; a third propeller is arranged on the tail wing; a third brushless motor is arranged in the machine body corresponding to the third propeller; the bottom end of the machine body is provided with an air injection mechanism, a first material port, a second material port and a detection mechanism; a material box and a material box are arranged in the machine body corresponding to the first material port and the second material port. The invention is stable and safe, has high searching efficiency and can provide timely material support for victims.

title_en: Emergency rescue's intelligent helmet
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of protective equipment for fire emergency rescue, and relates to an intelligent helmet for emergency rescue. Through the head computer system, audio and video collection system, gas sensor system, temperature sensor system, attitude characteristic sensor system, communication system, scarf protection system, fire prevention inside lining system, combined material casing system, air exhale ware integration face guard system, command software system, infrared thermal imaging camera etc. integrated one set of intelligent helmet of installation are carried to the helmet, and this kind of helmet has set up scientific and technological functions such as protection and search and rescue, can effectual improvement rescue efficiency. The visualization of disaster site environment, the datamation of the plan, the command interaction, the scientific judgment and the definite situation are really realized.
assignees: IMAGE DEV TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Novel overwater search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel water search and rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of robots and comprises a robot body, wherein one side of the robot body is provided with a connecting cylinder, the interior of the robot body is provided with a motor, a controller, a signal receiver and a storage battery, the signal receiver and the storage battery are positioned between the motor and the controller, one side of the motor is rotatably connected with a rotating shaft, the rotating shaft extends to the interior of the connecting cylinder, one side of the rotating shaft, which is far away from the motor, is provided with a propeller, the interior of the connecting cylinder is provided with a clamping block, the interior of the clamping block is clamped and connected with a filter screen, the novel water search and rescue robot is provided with a damping rotating shaft and a balancing plate, the damping rotating shaft is convenient to rotate the balancing plate, the balancing plate can be unfolded, the balancing plate can increase the balance of the rescue robot on the water surface, so, avoid personnel to lie prone and take place easily on searching for andrescuing the robot and turn on one's side.
assignees: SINOCOP AUTOMOBILE TECH DEVELOPMENT TJ CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue dolly collection control system based on Lora wide area network wireless communication
abstract_en: The utility model provides a search and rescue dolly collection control system based on Lora wide area network wireless communication, includes dolly hardware module, Lora gateway module and operation terminal module, wherein, dolly hardware module includes control mechanism and hardware control mechanism, control mechanism is based on Cortex-M3 kernel's microprocessor, control mechanism installs on the dolly, hardware control mechanism includes: lora wireless communication, GPS positioner, motor, USB camera, robotic arm, temperature and humidity sensor, Lora wireless communication, GPS positioner, motor, USB camera, robotic arm and temperature and humidity sensor all install on the dolly and be connected with control mechanism. The utility model discloses utilize a wide area network wireless communication technique based on Lora chip, can realize that remote control dolly is to humiture data, the image data acquisition of environment under the topography condition of complicacy to real-time control dolly fortune accuse and robotic arm operation.

title_en: Multifunctional guy cable unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional guy cable unmanned aerial vehicle, it includes fuselage foot rest (1) upper end be fixed with flat board (9), the lower extreme is fixed on life buoy (5), the bottom of flat board (9) be fixed with spool (8), spool (8) hang in fuselage foot rest (1) inside, fuselage foot rest (1) lower extreme both sides all install first mounting panel (11), first steering wheel (2) and first bolt (3) are installed respectively to first mounting panel (11) both ends, thin rope (4) one end with first bolt (3) fixed, the other end of thin rope (4) fixed with life buoy (5); a main rope (10) is wound on the spool (8), and the other end of the main rope (10) is fixed on the life buoy (5); the device overcomes the defects that drowning search and rescue is carried out manually in the prior art, so that the efficiency is low, secondary accidents are easy to happen, and the like, and has the advantage of making up the blank that overwater rescue cannot directly pull a trapped person ashore.

title_en: Double-control method of unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-control method of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps: local area network connection: connecting the main remote controller and the wireless local area network; and (3) permission acquisition: acquiring the IP and the password of the main remote controller in a local area network from the main remote controller, and logging in the IP to acquire a video stream acquisition permission and a camera remote control permission; remote control of the camera: the method comprises the steps of obtaining the video stream of the unmanned aerial vehicle, displaying a video stream picture shot by a camera on the unmanned aerial vehicle in real time and a camera control interface, and sending a camera control instruction to the unmanned aerial vehicle through a local area network. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle double-control method, the extended remote controller can conveniently and independently control the camera of the unmanned aerial vehicle through wireless connection, the extended remote controller is combined with the flying control of the main remote controller, the camera and the flying control are separately controlled, more than two operators can conveniently use the unmanned aerial vehicle, the control process is more specific and accurate, more complex operation is convenient to realize, and when the unmanned aerial vehicle double-control method is applied to the field of rescue, search and rescue targets are not easily missed.
assignees: SHENZHEN RONGSHENG INTELLIGENCE EQUIPMENT CO LTD;GLOBEEZ (GUANGDONG) EMERGENCY SAFETY TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue robot is listened to mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine detection search and rescue robot, which comprises a chassis, a mechanical arm component, a walking component and a fire-fighting component, wherein the chassis is provided with a base plate; the mechanical arm assembly comprises a large arm, a small arm, a first arm seat, a second arm seat and a connecting rod, a servo motor and a cycloid speed reducer are arranged on the outer side of the first arm seat, an output shaft of the servo motor penetrates through the first arm seat to be connected with the large arm, and one end of the large arm is hinged with the second arm seat; one end of the small arm is connected with the rotating motor, and the other end of the small arm is connected with the brick axe; one end of the connecting rod is hinged with the second arm seat, and the other end of the connecting rod is connected with an output shaft of the servo motor; the fire control subassembly includes squirt, fixing base, hydraulic telescoping rod, detector, and the fixing base cup joints with the cycloidal speed reducer and is connected, and hydraulic telescoping rod one end is articulated with the fixing base, and the other end is articulated with first arm seat, and the detector is located on the squirt. According to the invention, the brick cutter is driven by the mechanical arm to flexibly rotate for search and rescue, the hydraulic telescopic rod simultaneously drives the water gun and the detector to rotate in multiple angles, and the combined action is suitable for mine detection, search and rescue.

title_en: Search and rescue snatchs integration unmanned aerial vehicle including digital positioning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search for and rescue including digital positioning system and snatch integration unmanned aerial vehicle, including body frame, body frame is by the carbon plate, the rotor, switching plank clamp and carbon pipe are constituteed, the carbon plate is formed with the mounting groove for bilayer structure and centre, the rotor divide to be equipped with four groups and evenly installs in the carbon plate periphery, the switching plank clamp is all installed in the outside of four group's rotors, the carbon pipe sets up perpendicularly under the switching plank clamp and the upper end is connected with the switching plank clamp, the last angular displacement sensor a that is equipped with of carbon plate, one side of angular displacement sensor is provided with first 360 degrees steering wheels. The utility model discloses a high definition digtal camera can be with the image passback who contains the target person's of controlling image display system, utilizes MATLAB to carry out the two-dimensional plane coordinate that digital image processing can obtain the target and grab the point, spreads into the control chip with it again on, thereby can make the gripper remove to correspond directly over the target through the mechanical positioning mechanism in the picture and realize snatching.

title_en: Casualties Classification Method, And Rescue Robots for Performing the Method
title_ko: 부상자 분류 방법 및 그 방법을 수행하는 구조 로봇
abstract_en: Disclosed are an injured person classification method and a rescue robot for performing the same. The injured person classification method analyzes a biosignal of an injured person at an accident site where the rescue robot is deployed to classify transport rank according to an injury level of the injured person and rescues the injured person using the rescue robot according to the sorted transport rank.
abstract_ko: 부상자 분류 방법 및 그 방법을 수행하는 구조 로봇이 개시된다.  부상자 분류 방법은 구조 로봇이 투입된 사고 현장 내 부상자의 생체 신호를 분석하여 부상자의 부상 정도에 따라 이송 순위를 분류하고, 분류한 이송 순위에 따른 구조 로봇을 이용하여 부상자를 구조한다.

title_en: Emergency disaster rescue search and rescue robot applying D2D communication
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a disaster rescue technical field just discloses an emergent disaster rescue search and rescue robot of using D2D communication, which comprises a housing, the interior diapire fixedly connected with support column of casing, the top fixedly connected with servo motor of support column, servo motor's output shaft fixedly connected with connecting axle, the positive one end fixedly connected with output gear of connecting axle, output gear's outside transmission is connected with the belt, the inboard transmission of belt is connected with drive gear, the spread groove has been seted up at drive gear's the back, the inside fixedly connected with connecting block of spread groove, the back fixedly connected with connecting rod of connecting block. This use emergent calamity rescue search and rescue robot of D2D communication removes the baffle through the setting, and the obstacle is clear away to effectual messenger emergent calamity rescue search and rescue robot, and through setting up the outlet pipe, the fire extinguishment is rescued to effectual messenger emergent calamity rescue search and rescue robot.

title_en: Mine disaster early warning, investigation and rescue robot cluster system and operation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mine disaster early warning, investigation and rescue robot cluster system and an operation method, comprising an underground advanced detection robot, an underground investigation robot, a ground surface investigation detection robot, an air detection robot, an underground rescue robot, a ground control station and a remote command station, the underground advanced detection robot comprises a multi-point rotary detection assembly and a matrix advanced detection module, real-time detection of front end of a mine tunneling surface and surrounding disaster parameters is realized by adopting the multi-point rotary detection assembly, and the matrix advanced detection module which transmits waveforms with different frequencies is matched to realize multi-frequency detection of a fixed point detection area, so that the detection precision is higher and the robustness is stronger. The clustered robots are matched with the ground control station and the remote command station, so that the comprehensive three-dimensional system detection, investigation and rescue of the mine are realized, the mine safety operation is higher, the automation degree is higher, and the mine disaster is reduced or even avoided.

title_en: Portable inflatable life-saving device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a maritime search and rescue and lifesaving technical field, in particular to portable physiosis life saving equipment, including the valve end, automatic inflation float child and manual inflation float child enclose to close and form closed float child, separate through the lobe between automatic inflation float child and the manual inflation float child, set up the below at whole closed float child at the valve end. Light in weight, small under this device accomodate the state, can be by general unmanned aerial vehicle air-drop, can form one side open-type valve body in the use, the personnel of being convenient for fall into water climb the raft smoothly, save physical power, climb the raft and accomplish the back, steerable whole life saving equipment is closed completely, sufficient and water isolation avoids the danger of falling into water once more.

title_en: Automatic search and rescue positioning system, device and positioning method
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic search and rescue positioning system, device and method, and relates to the field of search and positioning, wherein the system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a detection device and an unmanned aerial vehicle positioning device; the detection device is fixed on the unmanned aerial vehicle; be equipped with a plurality of setpoint that supply unmanned aerial vehicle positioner location on the unmanned aerial vehicle, include in the system and survey module, transport module, orientation module and calculation module. The invention provides a search and rescue positioning method on the basis, and solves the problem that the target cannot be quickly positioned on a complex terrain.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle, control method, and program
abstract_en: This unmanned aerial vehicle (1) comprises: a sensor (such as a human detection sensor unit (100)) which senses the outside of the unmanned aerial vehicle; a detection unit (suspicious person specifying unit (110)) which detects a moving object on the basis of the sensing result from the sensor; an acquisition unit (movement inhibition position determining unit (113)) which acquires area information indicating an area where entry of the moving object is undesirable; and a flight control unit (114) which, on the basis of a positional relationship between the moving object and an area indicated by the area information, moves the unmanned aerial vehicle (1) between the area and the moving object, and causes the unmanned aerial vehicle (1) to fly to the destination.

title_en: Robots for detection and rescue of persons in narrow spaces
title_ko: 협소공간에서의 인명탐지 및 구호용 로봇
abstract_en: Disclosed is a robot for life detection and relief. The present invention is to provide the robot for the life detection and the relief which can additionally enter a narrow buried space difficult for a snake-shaped robot to enter. The present invention provides the robot for the life detection and the relief, which comprises: a main body unit composed of a plurality of unit joints; a head unit which is installed in the front of the forward direction where the main body unit moves forward and wherein a gripper capable of picking up an object while a plurality of tongs are squeezed and unfolded is provided; and an extension unit provided to be able to extend forward from the head unit, and entering the narrow space difficult for the main body unit to enter.
abstract_ko: 인명탐지 및 구호용 로봇이 개시된다. 본 발명은 복수 개의 단위 관절로 구성되는 본체부, 상기 본체부가 전진하는 방향의 전방에 설치되며 복수의 집게부가 오므라들었다 펼쳐졌다 하며 물체를 집을 수 있는 그리퍼가 구비되는 헤드부, 상기 헤드부로부터 전방으로 연장 가능하게 구비되어 본체부가 진입하기 어려운 협소한 공간에 진입하는 연장부를 포함하는 인명탐지 및 구호용 로봇을 제공한다.
assignees: KOREA INST ROBOT & CONVERGENCE;UNIV KOREA RES & BUS FOUND

title_en: Multifunctional underwater search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-functional search and rescue robot under water, including main part and base, the inside both ends of main part all are provided with the protection curb plate, the internally mounted of main part has the search and rescue subassembly, the base is located the outside of the bottom of search and rescue subassembly, and the outside upper end of search and rescue subassembly rear end is installed and is linked up the piece, it has the rotation pivot to link up the inside middle part of piece, the external connection that links up piece bottom has the barrier frame. This multi-functional search for and rescue robot under water can be cleared up the outside foreign matter of robot in the use through the setting of cleaning device, mounting panel, spacing sleeve board, loose axle and hydraulic stem, avoids having more blind spot when carrying out video acquisition under water, can keep the field of vision of robot work under water, increases the convenient degree of search for and rescue, and can carry out the adjustment of angle to cleaning device as required, can clear up the removal to outside foreign matter at any time when the operation under water.

title_en: Small-size rescue robot for conflagration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small-sized rescue robot for fire disasters, which comprises a frame, wherein a front shaft, a rear shaft and at least one first motor are rotatably arranged in the frame, front wheels are respectively arranged at two ends of the front shaft, rear wheels are respectively arranged at two ends of the rear shaft, the first motor is used for driving the front shaft or the rear shaft, a second motor is arranged at the upper part of the frame, a rotating shaft of the second motor is provided with a rotating table, a base is arranged at the upper part of the rotating table, and a water spraying mechanism is arranged on the base. The small-sized rescue robot for the fire disaster is used for replacing rescue workers to enter a fire disaster site, and timely and effectively controlling or eliminating the fire disaster at a source.

title_en: One-to-many scheduling system based on ad hoc network remote control search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a one-to-many dispatching system based on an ad hoc network remote control search and rescue robot, which comprises a dispatching center and a plurality of robots, wherein the dispatching center is provided with a main ad hoc network device, and transmits data and control information through the main ad hoc network device; the robot is provided with a secondary ad hoc network device, a network module, a conversion module and a waveform signal generator, wherein the secondary ad hoc network device, the network module, the conversion module and the waveform signal generator of the robot are sequentially connected, ad hoc network communication is realized between the main ad hoc network device and the secondary ad hoc network device, the network module holds different ip addresses and runs socket service inside, the network module converts a received control instruction into a waveform instruction and outputs the waveform instruction to the waveform signal generator, and the waveform instruction of the waveform signal generator controls a driving motor of the robot to realize remote control of the robot; the invention can control the robot on any platform supporting socket, realizes one-to-many control, enlarges the remote control range and has strong system adaptability.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHONGLI ELECTRONICS INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Radiological Monitoring Vehicle
title_ko: 방사능 탐지 로봇
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a radiation detecting robot detects the amount of radiation leakage with a radiation sensor, checks a current position of the radiation detecting robot with coordinates with a GPS sensor, and confirms an environment in which the robot is located by an NTSC camera attached thereto. Therefore, according to the present invention, the radiation detecting robot is equipped with multifunctional functions such as detecting the leaked radiation in the event of a disaster, as well as checking a damage situation and checking the location coordinates of a missing person. The user can also handle the robot smoothly with low budget and simple operation. The radiation detecting robot includes the camera, a transmission unit, a reception unit, a pc.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따르면, 방사능 탐지 로봇은 방사능 센서로 방사능 누출량을 탐지, GPS 센서로 방사능 탐지로봇의 현재위치를 좌표로 확인, NTSC 카메라를 부착하여 로봇의 위치한 환경 확인. 
따라서, 본 발명에 따르면, 방사능 탐지 로봇은 재난 발생시 누출된 방사능 탐지 뿐만 아니라 피해상황 확인 실종자 위치 좌표 확인 등 다기능을 갖추고 있으며, 저예산, 간단한 조작으로 사용자또한 원활히 로봇을 다룰 수 있다.

title_en: Search method and search system using profiling technique and drone
title_ko: 프로파일링 기법 및 드론을 이용한 찾기 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a search method using a profiling technique and a drone and a system therefor. The system of the present invention comprises: a search server for accepting a search report and receiving search target information and search site information; a profiling server for storing a plurality of profiling information related to the search target information and the search site information, and analyzing a behavior type of a search target based on the profiling information, the search target information and the search site information to calculate a plurality of movement paths and a plurality of search candidates of the search target; and a flight control server for calculating a plurality of flight paths based on the movement paths and the search candidates of the search target, which are calculated by the profiling server, and controlling a plurality of first drones to fly along the flight paths to search a search site.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 프로파일링 기법 및 드론을 이용한 찾기 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 수식신고를 접수하여 수색 대상자 정보 및 수색 현장 정보를 수신하는 수색 서버; 상기 수색 대상자 정보 및 상기 수색 현장 정보와 관련된 복수의 프로파일링 정보를 저장하고, 상기 복수의 프로파일링 정보, 상기 수색 대상자 정보, 및 상기 수색 현장 정보에 기초하여 수색 대상자의 행동유형을 분석함으로써 수색 대상자의 복수의 이동경로 및 복수의 수색 후보지를 산출하는 프로파일링 서버; 및 상기 프로파일링 서버에 의해 산출된 수색 대상자의 복수의 이동경로 및 복수의 수색 후보지에 기초하여 복수의 비행경로를 산출하고, 상기 복수의 비행경로를 따라 비행하도록 복수의 제1 드론을 제어함으로써 수색 현장을 수색하는 비행 관제 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Control system that unmanned aerial vehicle searched
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue, in particular to a control system for unmanned aerial vehicle search, which comprises a flight module, wherein the flight module comprises a normal flight module, a search low flight module, an oil tank detection module and a GPS module, the oil tank detection module monitors the normal flight module and the storage capacity of an oil tank when the search low flight module operates, the search low flight module comprises an obstacle avoiding module and a search module, the search module searches through an infrared scanning module, image data after search is transmitted to an image transmission module, the image transmission module feeds back to a base station on the ground through a wireless signal, longitude and latitude information can be transmitted to the base station in real time during search, obstacles in the process of search can be avoided in time, and the searched image information can be transmitted to the base station in real time, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can search safely and efficiently, unmanned aerial vehicle damages can be avoided.

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rescue robot, belonging to the technical field of robots, comprising a rescue cabin body, a rescue mechanical claw device, a four-foot motion device and a storage battery; the rescue cabin is a rectangular box body, the rescue mechanical claw devices are installed inside the rescue cabin, the four-foot movement devices are installed on the front side and the rear side outside the rescue cabin, and the storage battery is installed inside the rescue cabin and provides power for the whole rescue robot. The mechanical claw device and the rescue cabin body can realize rescue and protection of people, and walking movement under different road conditions can be realized by matching with the four-foot movement mechanism.

title_en: One-to-many scheduling system based on ad hoc network remote control search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue robot one-to-many dispatch system based on ad hoc network remote control, it includes dispatch center and a plurality of robot, and the dispatch center has main ad hoc network equipment, and the dispatch center transmits data and control information through main ad hoc network equipment; the robot is provided with a secondary ad hoc network device, a network module, a conversion module and a waveform signal generator, wherein the secondary ad hoc network device, the network module, the conversion module and the waveform signal generator of the robot are sequentially connected, ad hoc network communication is realized between the main ad hoc network device and the secondary ad hoc network device, the network module holds different ip addresses and runs socket service inside, the network module converts a received control instruction into a waveform instruction and outputs the waveform instruction to the waveform signal generator, and the waveform instruction of the waveform signal generator controls a driving motor of the robot to realize remote control of the robot; the utility model discloses can control the robot on any platform that supports socket, realize a to many controls, increase the remote control scope, system's strong adaptability.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHONGLI ELECTRONICS INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Female spider search and rescue exploration robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mother spider search and rescue exploration robot, the external shape of which is a spider-shaped structure and comprises a head, a spider-shaped main body unit and eight groups of spider leg units; a plurality of groups of small spider robots are arranged inside the robot, and the arranged structure is completely the same as that of the mother spider search and rescue exploration robot, and only the volume is different. When the robot is used for search and rescue exploration, the robot control handle is adopted to select the mother spider search and rescue exploration robot to explore or one or more groups of small spider robots to explore according to the size of a search and rescue space, so that the danger coefficient of the exploration process is greatly reduced, the robot is convenient to carry and recover, the operation flexibility is high, the exploration time is shortened, and the rescue work efficiency is improved.

title_en: Multi-section snake-shaped robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multistage formula snake-shaped robot, include: the joint device is arranged between two adjacent front advancing devices and rear advancing devices; the travelling device comprises a plurality of travelling devices, each travelling device comprises three groups of tracks and three groups of track motors for driving the tracks, the three groups of tracks are respectively arranged on three surfaces of a regular triangle formed by two driving screw rods and one driven screw rod, and the three tracks run along the length directions of the driving screw rods and the driven screw rods; the sensor is arranged on the traveling device. The robot has the advantages that the regular triangle section can realize three-dimensional angle transformation, so that the purpose of crawling when any surface is contacted due to uneven ground during search and rescue is achieved, and meanwhile, the length expansion effect is realized by combining the segment number of the robot at will according to the uncertainty of the search and rescue site. In addition, compared with snake-shaped robots with other moving structures, the robot has the characteristics of small required space and high traveling speed.

title_en: Multifunctional vacuum adsorption climbing fire-extinguishing rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-functional vacuum adsorption climbing rescue robot that puts out a fire, including climbing ware, load equipment, the camera, the signal lamp, climbing ware is including climbing ware organism, the lead screw straight line module of installing along its length direction setting is erect to the positive middle part position of climbing ware organism, lead screw middle part in the lead screw straight line module closes soon rather than leading the mobilizable grapple of complex, it has the spout to open in the climbing ware organism left and right sides, the spout of climbing ware organism left and right sides is passed at the grapple both ends, the grapple stretches out the end and installs buffering formula sucking disc group respectively, install fixed mounting formula sucking disc group on the upper left side position in the middle of the back of climbing ware organism, the top position at climbing ware organism is installed respectively to camera and signal lamp, load equipment is including foam generator or rescue unit, it installs the front at climbing ware organism. The utility model discloses a climbing ware removal on glass curtain wall cooperates corresponding load equipment, needs when satisfying the fire rescue, rescue.
assignees: ANHUI AMOS FLUID TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire rescue robot based on sound navigation
abstract_en: The utility model provides a fire rescue robot based on sound navigation, include: the sound collection device is arranged on a back vertical face back plate of the material bin, the material bin is fixedly arranged above the frame, the sound collection device is electrically connected with the position positioning system, the position positioning system is electrically connected with the navigation controller, the position positioning system and the navigation controller are both arranged in the frame, and the navigation controller is connected to the robot power mechanism; the utility model discloses simple structure, control is simple and convenient, and the rescue is efficient, and is integrated nimble, and the robot is light and by being close of rescue personnel, finally reachs by the rescue personnel position, and walking speed is fast, and the rescue is efficient, reduces fireman's operation risk, and the stable performance can adapt to different fire scene, flexible operation, and the delivery of instrument and goods and materials under the different disaster condition is accomplished to the manipulator of adjustment not unidimensional and structure.

title_en: Search and rescue robot target search method based on path passing probability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot target search method based on path passing probability, which comprises the following steps: s01: establishing a topological environment model of a working environment of the mobile robot, and recording paths among nodes; s02: establishing an evaluation model of the probability that the path between the nodes can pass through, and carrying out reliability evaluation; s03: performing search and rescue key node sequence planning according to the optimization index; s04: planning paths among nodes according to the path passability of the local environment; s05: searching is executed according to the obtained path, and the path passable probability in the topological data set is updated according to the actual condition; if the target to be rescued is found, sending the real-time image and the target position to rescuers; s06: steps S03 through S05 are repeated until the search task is completed. The invention plans the search path according to the probability of the path, updates the topological model according to the current determined path condition, ensures that the robot passes through an uncertain area with the maximum probability, and efficiently finishes the task.

title_en: Disaster relief robot and operating method of thereof
title_ko: 재난 구조 로봇 및 이의 동작 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster rescue robot and an operation method thereof. The disaster rescue robot according to one embodiment of the present invention includes: a mecanum wheel movable in all directions; a robot arm which performs object acquisition and transport; a camera connected to the robot arm and movable back and forth with respect to the front; and a control unit. The control unit controls the mecanum wheel to autonomously travel to a target point. When approaching an object, the control unit controls the robot arm so that the camera acquires a plurality of images including the object. The control unit controls the robot arm to pick up the object when the distance between the object analyzed based on the image and the disaster rescue robot is less than a threshold value.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 의한 재난 구조 로봇은, 전 방향으로 이동 가능한 메카넘 휠; 과 객체 습득 및 운반을 수행하는 로봇 팔; 과 상기 로봇 팔에 연결되어 전방에 대해 전후로 이동 가능한 카메라; 및 목표 지점까지 자율 주행하도록 상기 메카넘 휠을 제어하고, 상기 객체에 접근하면 상기 카메라가 상기 객체를 포함하는 복수개의 영상을 획득하도록 상기 로봇 팔을 제어하고, 상기 영상에 기초하여 분석한 상기 객체와 상기 재난 구조 로봇과의 거리가 임계값 미만이면 상기 객체를 습득하도록 상기 로봇 팔을 제어하는 제어부를 포함한다.
assignees: LEE SEUNG JIN;OH HYEON TACK;KIM SANG HOON;BEAK JI HOON

title_en: Water rescue robot with original return function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a take rescue robot on water of original road function of returning voyage, include: casing, set up in main control board in the casing, set up in casing both sides below the propeller and with the main control board carries out wireless connection's remote controller, the main control board includes: the system comprises a power supply module, a main MCU module, a flight control system connected with the main MCU module and a GPS module connected with the flight control system, wherein the main MCU module is connected with a flight control interface, the main MCU module is connected with the flight control system through the flight control interface, and the flight control system comprises a memory unit. The utility model discloses a flight control system record departure point and the node of route of advancing for the rescue robot when returning a journey, if take place with remote controller disconnection's anomaly, can return a journey automatically according to the route information that flight control system recorded, with this obstacle in avoiding the route, promote rescue robot's mobility and security.

title_en: Multi-information rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a many first-aid information rescue robot, its structure includes the laminar organism structure of compriseing the plywood of a plurality of levels, arrange from top to bottom the plywood, the plywood is together fixed by the metal column, be provided with crawler respectively in laminar organism structure's both sides, be provided with master control drive plate and group battery in laminar organism structure, structural hot inductive sensor that is provided with of laminar organism, ultrasonic probe and infrared distance probe, structural driving motor that is provided with of laminar organism, every crawler is driven by a driving motor alone, the group battery is the master control drive plate, hot inductive sensor, ultrasonic probe, infrared distance probe and driving motor provide the electric energy, master control drive plate and hot inductive sensor, ultrasonic probe, the electricity is connected between infrared distance probe and the driving motor. The utility model discloses can the automatic tracking location, trafficability characteristic is strong, and the flexibility is high, and simple structure nevertheless has sufficient structural strength, and the quality is little.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue method suitable for unmanned boat-unmanned aerial vehicle combination
abstract_en: The invention discloses a maritime search and rescue method suitable for unmanned boat-unmanned aerial vehicle combination, which comprises the following steps: acquiring and generating a search and rescue area map; step two, search for and rescue marshalling; step three, determining a search and rescue main shaft; planning a navigation route; and step five, searching and rescuing by cruising on the air route. The invention realizes the maritime search and rescue method suitable for unmanned boat-unmanned aerial vehicle combination through model establishment, and provides a specific cruise method aiming at several typical formation modes. The invention is easy to understand, has strong performability and is convenient to be adopted in maritime search and rescue to realize better effect.

title_en: Disaster relief unmanned aerial vehicle based on satellite navigation
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an unmanned air vehicle technique field just discloses a relief of disaster unmanned aerial vehicle based on satellite navigation, which comprises a bod, the top fixed mounting of organism both sides has the cantilever, the top of cantilever one end is equipped with the screw, and the middle part fixed mounting of cantilever bottom has infrared detection instrument. This relief of disaster unmanned aerial vehicle based on satellite navigation, cooperation through infrared detection instrument and camera, and combine unmanned aerial vehicle's high mobility, when the conflagration takes place in the forest zone, the quick personnel of being trapped of searching, after searching the personnel of being trapped, provide the effect of navigation for personnel of being trapped and search and rescue personnel, utilize the real-time navigation data of receiving of satellite signal receiver according to the intensity of a fire, and revise navigation position, provide safe route of marcing for personnel of being trapped and search and rescue personnel, and utilize the megaphone to be convenient for search and rescue personnel and personnel of being trapped to exchange and meet, stabilize personnel of being trapped mood, save search and rescue time, improve personnel of being trapped and search and rescue personnel's security.
assignees: HARBIN CANGLONG TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Fire scene rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire scene rescue robot, including robot and spray pipe, the welding has supporting seat upper portion to be connected with the telescopic link in the spray pipe top, the upper end of telescopic link is equipped with the camera, and the camera outward appearance is  circles, the welding of one side of camera has the bracing piece, and the upper end of the support bar is equipped with rotating base. The utility model discloses in, carry out the reconnaissance scene through flexible camera, in time know stranded personnel health state and the intensity of a fire trend, whether the surrounding environment exists more convenient rescue condition, when the conflagration night, the far-reaching headlamp through rotating base carries out the all-round irradiation, in time discover stranded personnel's position, with the fastest speed hostage of rescuing, respirator and oxygen cylinder have been set up inside the rescue robot, at the rescue in-process, stranded personnel can follow inside respirator and the oxygen cylinder that can take of rescue robot and carry out the self-protection, the accident of taking place in rescuing stranded personnel has been avoided.

title_en: Software robot with life detection and guarantee functions for earthquake search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a soft robot with life detection and guarantee functions for earthquake search and rescue, relating to the technical field of soft robots for earthquake search and rescue, in particular to a shell, a supporting block and an air inlet valve, wherein the left side and the right side of the shell are both provided with soft feet, the soft robot with life detection and guarantee functions for earthquake search and rescue can ensure that a spring can pull the double-layer air bag through the contraction of the double-layer air bag through the arrangement of the connection relation between the double-layer air bag and the spring, thereby moving a sealed grease block, providing convenience for the connection work between the supporting block and other objects, and further leading the soft robot to adjust the contraction and expansion degrees of the double-layer air bag according to the shape of the object and the smoothness of the road surface, thereby leading the supporting block to adjust the contact area between the supporting block and the contact object through creases, and further leading the soft robot to rapidly move on the smoothness different road surfaces, thereby improving the flexibility of the device.

title_en: Six-foot bionic robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses to prior art's is not enough, provides hexapod bionic robot, has solved current hexapod robot poor stability, the problem that the flexibility is low. Meanwhile, the problems that the existing hexapod robot is large in mass, difficult to control and the like are solved. Therefore, the hexapod bionic robot has simple operation, flexible movement, strong loading capability and high stability, and can be applied to reconnaissance, exploration, search and rescue and the like. The utility model provides a six sufficient bionic robot, its constitution includes: trunk, mechanical leg, the cloud platform of making a video recording, manipulator, wherein the steering wheel in the trunk is connected with mechanical leg, and the trunk is connected with cloud platform, manipulator of making a video recording respectively simultaneously.

title_en: Take life to detect search for and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle of function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle with life detection function, which comprises a case, wherein a case cavity is arranged in the case, a smoke paintball filling device is arranged in the case cavity, the smoke paintball filling device comprises a bottom channel supporting block, a bomb body delivery channel is arranged in the bottom channel supporting block, a sliding limiting block is fixedly arranged on the bottom channel supporting block, and a smoke paintball bin is arranged in the sliding limiting block in a sliding way. And also prevents the search and rescue personnel from suffering disasters during search and rescue.

title_en: Intelligent fire protection system in building
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of intelligent buildings, and particularly relates to an intelligent fire protection system in a building. The intelligent anti-theft door lock comprises an intelligent control host, an outdoor monitoring device, an indoor monitoring device, an intelligent anti-theft door lock, an intelligent anti-disaster robot and an intelligent escape ladder, wherein the intelligent anti-disaster robot comprises a detection device, a fire fighting device and a mobile device, the indoor monitoring device and the outdoor monitoring device can effectively monitor indoor and outdoor fire disaster conditions while guaranteeing that the privacy of a user is not violated, the intelligent anti-disaster robot can effectively prevent and treat the fire disaster when the fire disaster does not happen, and the fire disaster can be timely treated when the fire disaster happens. The intelligent system of this application adopts indoor outdoor real-time supervision and intelligent rescue robot's scanning to detect, has guaranteed effectively that inflammable and explosive factor is in time discovered, has accomplished to guard against in the bud, and the security is good.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue missile warhead
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a marine search and rescue equipment technical field, and a marine search and rescue missile warhead is disclosed, including guiding device, guiding device's top is provided with the battery, this marine search and rescue missile warhead, open the back when the warhead upper cover, start the motor that is located, motor corotation round drives the rotation of pivot, the rotation of pivot drives the rotation of connecting plate, the rotation of connecting plate is through two connecting rods, the rotation of circular through-hole and rectangle piece drive every connecting plate, thereby with the front of one connecting plate of magnetic plate, with the bottom surface of two connecting plates that turn to of magnetic plate, make the unmanned aerial vehicle loading board unsettled through the repulsion force that produces between two and the magnetic plate of magnetic plate, can effectually reduce rocking that to be located the submarine warhead and lead to rocking of loading board unmanned aerial vehicle, thereby make the unmanned aerial vehicle that is located unmanned aerial vehicle loading board upper surface more stable, avoid rocking of warhead too big condition that leads to unmanned aerial vehicle to can's unable completion to .

title_en: Nuclear power station emergency rescue robot, system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nuclear power station emergency rescue robot, a system and a method, wherein the nuclear power station emergency rescue robot, the system and the method comprise the following steps: a robot body; the robot body is provided with a detection device for acquiring environmental information of the nuclear power station; the robot body is provided with a main control module for sending environmental information of the nuclear power station and receiving a control instruction; and the robot body is provided with double robot arms for executing rescue operation according to the control command. The robot carries two mechanical arms to complete a rescue task by monitoring the environment of the nuclear power station in real time; and remotely monitoring the nuclear radiation condition and remotely controlling the rescue operation of the robot through a remote control operation end. The emergency rescue system can replace manual on-site rescue after a nuclear power station accident, improve accident handling efficiency and avoid damage of nuclear radiation to rescuers.
assignees: INST OF AUTOMATION SHANDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Mountain area missing person search and rescue system based on unmanned aerial vehicle group and Beidou positioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain area missing person search and rescue system based on unmanned aerial vehicle set and Beidou positioning, which relates to the technical field of tourism safety and comprises a missing person rescue terminal and a search and rescue communication integrated system, wherein the missing person rescue terminal comprises a positioning module, a sign monitoring module, a control module and a signal transmitting module; the output end of the physical sign monitoring module is bidirectionally connected with the control module, and the output end of the control module is connected with the transmitting module; the physical sign monitoring module comprises a temperature sensor and a pulse sensor, and the temperature sensor and the pulse sensor are respectively connected with the control module; the invention has the advantage that the missing person can be searched in an optimal way under the condition that the missing person cannot send help seeking information autonomously.

title_en: Mountain scenic spot complex terrain unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue system and device thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a complex terrain unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue system based on a hybrid network system, which comprises a personal help-seeking end unit, a communication base station, a rescue center, an unmanned aerial vehicle unit and a positioning information unit; and the plurality of groups of communication base stations are respectively distributed in mountainous scenic areas and realize partial coverage of at least two groups of communication base stations. The invention solves the transmission problem of search and rescue signals in the scenic areas of the complex mountainous regions, processes and analyzes decision information of emergency rescue in real time, provides guarantee for tourism safety of the scenic areas of the complex mountainous regions, and realizes intelligent, unmanned and three-dimensional efficient search and rescue, thereby obviously improving the efficiency of search and rescue.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a lifting driving device and a propeller, wherein the top side of the lifting driving device is provided with the propeller, the bottom side of the lifting driving device is provided with an electric control unit, the bottom side of the electric control unit is provided with a connecting rod, the bottom side of the connecting rod is provided with a camera, the bottom side of the lifting driving device is provided with a supporting leg, the bottom side of the supporting leg is provided with a fixed block, one side of the fixed block is provided with a containing groove, the inner side of the containing groove is provided with a locking block, a spring is arranged between one side of the locking block opposite to the containing groove, the bottom side of the fixed block is provided with a connecting plate, the top side of the connecting plate is provided with a fixed groove, one end of the inner side of the fixed groove, this search for and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, the function increases, and the search for and rescue scope increases, provides goods and materials, convenient to use.

title_en: Self-adaptive rapid dynamic positioning system and method based on improved Boltzmann machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to an adaptive fast dynamic positioning system and method based on an improved Boltzmann machine, and belongs to the technical field of marine rescue. The life jacket comprises a signal generator, a Beidou satellite positioning system, an unmanned aerial vehicle base station and an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the signal generator is arranged on the life jacket; the Beidou satellite positioning system is connected with the unmanned aerial vehicle through the unmanned aerial vehicle base station; the signal generator that is equipped with on the life vest is connected with big dipper satellite positioning system and unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the invention, the area of the accident is rapidly obtained through the Beidou positioning system, the drift model of the personnel falling into the water on the sea is constructed through the analysis of the real-time data of the terrain and the hydrological environment of the sea area in China, and the rapid locking of the search and rescue area is realized through the LORA three-point positioning method and the improved trajectory planning algorithm of the Boltzmann machine. The invention has good practicability, can quickly position the person falling into the water, can capture the position of the person falling into the water to the maximum extent, realizes the putting of the positioner and is convenient for quick rescue in the later period.

title_en: Multifunctional fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire fighting equipment, in particular to a multifunctional fire fighting robot, which comprises a robot body, a walking device, a rescue mechanical arm and a fire fighting lance, wherein the upper part of the robot body is provided with the rescue mechanical arm, the rescue mechanical arm comprises a main rotating block, a fixed base, a first mechanical arm, a second mechanical arm, a third mechanical arm, a first rotating shaft and a second rotating shaft, the tail end of the third mechanical arm is provided with a mechanical claw, the bottom of the fire fighting lance is communicated with the robot body, and the fire fighting lance comprises a horizontal rotating motor and a carbon dioxide compression tank. The technical problems to be solved by the invention are as follows: the rescue efficiency is influenced by reconnaissance and analysis on the site and manual breaking and dismantling, and the existing fire rescue robot has the problems of single function and narrow application range.
assignees: NANJING HANGCHUANG SPECIAL ROBOT CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle night search system and method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of night search of unmanned aerial vehicles, and particularly relates to a night search system and a night search method of an unmanned aerial vehicle based on deep learning, which comprises the unmanned aerial vehicle and remote control equipment, wherein the remote control equipment is provided with a display screen, a sound player and a first language receiving module, the unmanned aerial vehicle is provided with an infrared thermal imager, a low-light level night vision device, a small computer, a second language receiving module, a loudspeaker and a wireless communication module, and the small computer is provided with a GPS positioning system and an image collector. The infrared thermal image heating shape of a person is identified, and the search and rescue efficiency is improved while the search and rescue accuracy is improved.

title_en: Outdoor medical rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an outdoor medical rescue system, which can solve the problem that when people in special environments such as high mountain scenic spots, jungles and deserts have emergency situations, rescue personnel can not obtain help calling information in time and can not accurately find rescue places in time, and the like, which results in long rescue time; the technical scheme is as follows: the utility model provides an outdoor medical rescue system, includes terminal bracelet, rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, scenic spot search and rescue center and first aid center, the terminal bracelet is worn on stranded personnel's arm, the terminal bracelet can launch the rescue signal, and this rescue signal can be received by rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and scenic spot search and rescue center, the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle can arrive the rescue scene earlier than scenic spot search and rescue center rescue personnel to collect on-the-spot movie & TV data and send back to scenic spot search and rescue center, scenic spot search and rescue center can directly arrange search and rescue personnel and go to the rescue scene, simultaneously scenic spot search and rescue center can communication connection, contacts first aid center and dispatches the ambulance and goes to scenic spot search and rescue center and await the order.

title_en: Camera protection device for search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a camera protection device for search and rescue robot, which comprises a camera, a shell, a feeding mechanism, a barrier strip, a plug board, a separation sleeve, a light-passing board, a limit sleeve and a board-releasing mechanism, wherein the plug board is drawn out from the barrier strip, and then the light-passing board is inserted into the inner side of the shell in sequence; when the uppermost layer of the transparent plate is polluted and needs to be replaced, the plate-releasing mechanism acts, the motor drives the roller to rotate, the inserting nails arranged on the roller drive the transparent plate in contact with the roller to be transmitted to the outer side of the shell through the plate outlet, then, the spring pushes the tray fixedly connected with the guide rod to drive the lower layer of the transparent plate to move upwards to be in contact with the plate-releasing mechanism, and the continuous replacement of the transparent plate can be completed by repeating the above actions. The device simple structure effectively avoids the camera to pollute, improves search for and rescue efficiency of robot.

title_en: Sea surface video compression sensing method based on 5G transmission and improved residual error neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sea surface video compression sensing method based on 5G transmission and an improved residual error neural network, which belongs to the field related to sensors and comprises the following steps: the invention improves the reconstruction precision and the reconstruction speed of the video frame image by establishing an improved residual convolution neural network structure to carry out compressed sensing on the video. Aiming at the problems of low transmission speed, high delay and insufficient bandwidth of the traditional communication scheme, the invention aims to adopt the 5G technology to transmit the video data of the sea surface search and rescue area shot by the unmanned aerial vehicle, improve the real-time performance of sea surface video data transmission and provide a high-resolution video frame image.

title_en: Fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting rescue robot, which comprises a frame, wherein the bottom of the frame is fixedly connected with a movable chassis, the lower left side of the frame is provided with a main power cavity, the left side wall in the main power cavity is fixedly connected with a main motor, and a first transmission mechanism which takes the main motor as main power and enables a movable belt to move a rescue vehicle is arranged in the main power cavity and the movable chassis. Has wide prospect and is worth of great production and application.

title_en: Data deep fusion image segmentation method for multispectral rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a data deep fusion image segmentation method for a multispectral rescue robot, which aims to further improve the accuracy of semantic segmentation of images of the rescue robot, improve the accuracy of investigation and analysis of the rescue robot in a disaster scene, and can break away from manual command and control to perform autonomous detection work. The method comprises the following steps: generating a target segmentation training data set; constructing a U-shaped network for identifying single-spectrum single-target image segmentation; establishing an evidence theory-Bayesian two-stage decision fusion model aiming at image semantic segmentation; training to obtain a semantic segmentation model for multi-spectrum data fusion. According to the invention, the evidence theory-Bayesian two-stage decision fusion model aiming at image semantic segmentation is utilized, so that the accuracy, recall rate, accuracy and the like are obviously improved, the robot can autonomously check disaster sites in a complex disaster relief environment, the detection accuracy and efficiency are improved, the labor cost is reduced, the disaster relief time is shortened, and the casualties are reduced.

title_en: Robot for fire scene rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire scene rescue robot, comprising: engineering protection system including coating in fire prevention coating and the electrostatic protection device on disaster relief robot shell surface, the robot motion system includes: two robotic arm, two robotic leg and two crawler attachment, two robotic arm, two the joint department and two crawler attachment of robotic leg all are equipped with driving motor, robot perception system includes: a panoramic camera module and a smoke sensor, signal transmission system comprising: the transmission module is arranged in the head, the transmission interfaces are arranged on the driving motor respectively, and the transmission module utilizes an Ethernet/gigabit Ethernet to connect the smoke sensor, the panoramic camera module and the transmission interfaces to a user side. The invention can replace the fire fighter to enter the fire scene to participate in the rescue task, thereby greatly reducing the personnel loss caused by the emergency.

title_en: Coastline initiative calling type rescue robot on water
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of coastline rescue robots, in particular to a coastline active calling type water rescue robot, which comprises a wireless transceiving bracelet and a water rescue robot, wherein the water rescue robot comprises: the robot body comprises a U-shaped buoy; the propellers are arranged at the head end of the U-shaped buoy and the bottoms of the tail ends of the two sides, and the drainage end of the propeller faces the outer side of the U-shaped buoy; the real-time steering camera is arranged at the head end of the U-shaped buoy; the underwater steering engine is arranged at the bottom of the propeller; the mounting deck is arranged at the head end of the inner side of the U-shaped buoy; the controller is arranged at the top end of the placing deck; the sealing boxes are arranged on two sides of the placing deck; the lifting frame is hinged with the bottom end of the placing deck through a hinge seat; the sealed ratchet wheel non-return rope collector is arranged on the inner side of the tail end of the U-shaped buoy; the rope collecting wheel is arranged on the output shaft of the rope collecting device; one end of the steel wire rope is wound on the rope collecting wheel, the other end of the steel wire rope is connected with two sides of the lifting frame, and the device can automatically lift a drowned person to float out of the water through the lifting frame.

title_en: Chassis and wheel coupling mechanism are stabilized to six wheeler
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a chassis and wheel coupling mechanism are stabilized to six wheeler, comprising a main body, the central authorities surface mounting of main part has the direct current motor, is connected with the power take off support on the direct current motor, and the one end of power take off support is connected with the support of bending, and the surface mounting of the support of bending has double row hole support, is connected with movable articulated elements on the double row hole support, installs on the movable articulated elements and links the sheet metal component, and the support of bending is installed to the tip of linking the sheet metal component, and double row hole support and link and be connected with the spring between the sheet metal component. The utility model relates to a chassis and wheel coupling mechanism are stabilized to six wheeler, this design preparation new-type wheeled rescue robot support mainly is the topography adaptive capacity that increases six wheeler, makes it can steadily pass through in complicated district, and this kind of mechanism can alleviate the problem that intensity of labour is big, inefficiency in the rescue work after the calamity to a certain extent, and the practicality is strong.

title_en: Earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides an earthquake rescue robot, there is control power in this application fuselage, case is placed to electrical control mechanism and dry powder fire extinguishing agent, the fuselage both sides respectively have a set of track structure, the life detection instrument is installed to the fuselage front side, there is the carousel fuselage front side top, be fixed with the arm support on the carousel, the arm support internal fixation has the arm, lower arm and last arm hinge and articulated department relevant electromechanical machine, lower arm lower extreme and arm support hinge and articulated department have an angle motor, the shower nozzle passes through the support to be fixed in arm middle part on, the shower nozzle leads to pipe to be put the case with the interior dry powder fire extinguishing agent of fuselage and links to each other, the arm tip has the gripper power supply through gripper mount front end on the machine, gripper power supply tip articulates there is the gripper. The utility model provides an earthquake rescue robot to present disaster scene rescue difficulty, is difficult to discover more stranded people, and the personnel that are stranded can not only be discover sooner to the subsidiary auxiliary structure of this robot, also can enter into the place that search and rescue personnel can't get into, carries out supplementary rescue.

title_en: Fire-fighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting rescue robot, when receiving a rescue signal, a displacement driving assembly drives a telescopic cylinder and a telescopic partition to extend out of a rear end base, in the extending process, the bottom of the plugging cover plate loses the support of the rear end base seat, so that the plugging cover plate compresses the return spring to enable liquid to enter between the telescopic cylinder and the telescopic partition, the three-phase water pump pumps liquid into the first accommodating cavity and the second accommodating cavity, the spray nozzle sprays the liquid to the outer shell, the interiors of the front end base, the telescopic cylinder and the rear end base are cooled, so that the fire extinguishing search and rescue robot can be lengthened, and the space for storing the fire extinguishing liquid is vacated for loading the trapped people, thereby ensuring that the trapped people can be successfully rescued.

title_en: Management platform and method for taking off and landing of rotor unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a rotor unmanned aerial vehicle take-off and landing management platform and a method, wherein the rotor unmanned aerial vehicle take-off and landing management platform comprises a flight control device of the flight unmanned aerial vehicle and an operation and control system running in the flight control device, the flight control device of the unmanned aerial vehicle is composed of an aircraft and a take-off and landing platform, the aircraft comprises a central airframe, two main force arms, a longitudinal rotor rod and a landing gear, the number of the main force arms is two, and the two main force arms are respectively fixed on two sides of the central airframe and are arranged; the number of the longitudinal rotor wing rods is two, and the two longitudinal rotor wing rods correspond to the main force arms one by one; according to the unmanned dynamic take-off and landing system, the flight control module, the visual calculation module and the image acquisition and transmission module are cooperated to complete unmanned dynamic take-off and landing, so that the unmanned flexibility is greatly improved, and search and rescue tasks can be executed more efficiently.
assignees: HANGDA HOLLY TIANJIN AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire rescue robot
abstract_en: A fire rescue robot comprises an upper computer control unit and a device body, wherein the device body comprises a chassis, a mechanical arm, a fire extinguishing device and an electric control part, and the mechanical arm is movably arranged above the chassis; a power mechanism is arranged in the chassis and used for driving the moving components correspondingly arranged at the left side and the right side of the chassis; the fire extinguishing device is respectively arranged on the chassis and the mechanical arm; the electric control part is arranged on the chassis and is respectively and electrically connected with the mechanical arm, the fire extinguishing device and the power mechanism. Various sensing technologies, automatic control technologies, computer technologies, electromechanical integration technologies, precision mechanical design technologies and the like are adopted. The fire extinguishing system realizes the functions of fire point early warning, fire scene reconnaissance, fire scene extinguishment, fire scene rescue, obstacle clearing and the like, improves the fire extinguishing efficiency, and protects the life and property safety of people.

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the robot, especially, relate to a rescue robot.
