The rescue robot comprises a rack, a rescue mechanism, wheels, a driving device and a damping mechanism, wherein the rescue mechanism is arranged on the rack, the wheels are respectively arranged on two sides of the rack, the damping mechanism comprises a damping plate and an elastic damping component, the damping plate is located below the rack and is close to the wheels, the elastic damping component is connected between the damping plate and the rack, and the driving device is respectively installed on the damping plate and is respectively connected with the wheels in a driving mode. Through setting up shock attenuation board and elasticity shock attenuation component, make the connection maintenance between shock attenuation board and the frame have certain elasticity surplus, when rescue robot's wheel vibrations, the elasticity shock attenuation component of connecting between shock attenuation board and frame takes place elastic deformation to release or increase elasticity surplus and cushion vibrations, thereby reduce the vibrations that rescue robot receives, improve the stationarity that the robot removed, reduce the impaired probability of part of robot, increase of service life.

title_en: On-site detection intelligent vehicle based on multi-degree-of-freedom bionic mechanical arm
abstract_en: The utility model provides a scene detection intelligent vehicle based on multi freedom bionic mechanical arm. The intelligent vehicle comprises a mobile platform and a multi-degree-of-freedom bionic mechanical arm, an intelligent vehicle control system arranged on the mobile platform comprises a core processor, a driving circuit module, a planet driving module, an obstacle avoidance module, an ultrasonic module, a mechanical arm module, LCD display and voice broadcast, and the intelligent vehicle control system further comprises a Bluetooth module, a GPS positioning module and a body state sensor, and is also provided with an omnibearing PC upper computer monitoring system, the body state sensor is used as a field environment monitoring sensor and is conveyed to the core processor through signal amplification and A/D conversion to be combined with the bionic mechanical arm control, and environment monitoring and field search and rescue coordination of the intelligent vehicle are carried out. The utility model discloses use the bluetooth to realize wireless remote control intelligent car, the GPS technique shows dolly geographical position, and bionical robotic arm of installation carries out remote monitoring and explores search and rescue work. The intelligent vehicle is suitable for being used as an intelligent vehicle for field detection.

title_en: Fast assembly's unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapidly assembled unmanned aerial vehicle, and relates to the technical field of aircrafts. The problem of wasting time and energy of unmanned aerial vehicle equipment and dismantlement can be solved. An unmanned aerial vehicle of fast assembly includes fuselage main part, central wing, rotor connecting rod, outer wing, fin, first landing gear, second undercarriage, rotary wing and rearmounted screw together. The center wing is detachably provided on the body. The outer wings are detachably disposed at both sides of the central wing. The rotor links are disposed on the central wing or the outer wing. The tail wing is detachably arranged at the tail end of the main body of the machine body. The first landing frame is arranged at the tail end of the machine body. The second landing gear is arranged at the front end of the fuselage main body. The rotor wing detachably sets up at rotor wing connecting rod both ends. The rear propeller is arranged at the tail end of the machine body main body. The rotor wing connecting rod and the rotary wing are fixed through a second locking device. Each part is connected by adopting a quick detachable mode, and the assembling and disassembling efficiency is obviously improved. In occasions such as search and rescue, topography reconnaissance, such efficiency promotion is vital.
assignees: SUNNY AERONAUTICS AND SPACE ADVENTURE CO LTD

title_en: Kinect-based somatosensory rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a body feeling rescue robot based on Kinect, including track moving platform, arm and control circuit module, the arm is fixed mounting on track moving platform, and track moving platform includes frame, athey wheel and motor, and the frame includes frame upper plate frame, frame lower plate frame and frame side bearer, and two athey wheels are installed respectively in the outside of two frame side bearers, and the inboard of each frame side bearer is installed two motors; each crawler wheel comprises a crawler, a driving wheel and a driven wheel, and the mechanical arm comprises a chassis, a steering engine, a rudder rack and a mechanical arm clamp. The utility model discloses replace the manual work to the regional rescue of surveying of taking place the disaster to the tracked vehicle that has the ability of hindering more can have fine adaptability to complicated topography as moving platform, uses the Kinect sensor to show people's arm action with the motion of arm as the direct carrier of realizing long-range hand action with the arm, realizes remote control, reduces the secondary casualties, improves work efficiency.

title_en: Apparatus for transmitting the position of the victim over the sea and search drone operating system
title_ko: 해상 조난자 위치 발신 장치 및 수색용 드론 운용 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a device for transmitting a location of a survivor at sea, a receiver thereof, and a search drone operating system. According to one embodiment of the present invention, a method for searching for a survivor at sea by using a drone comprises the following steps of: receiving a rescue signal from a survivor; determining the location of the survivor based on the rescue signal; and moving to the location of the survivor, wherein the location of the survivor can be estimated based on at least one of a previously received rescue signal and maritime information received from a monitoring device, when the rescue signal is not received from the survivor.
abstract_ko: 해상 조난자의 위치를 발신하는 장치와 이의 수신기 및 수색용 드론 운용 시스템이 개시된다. 일 실시예에 따른 드론이 해상 조난자를 탐색하는 방법은 조난자로부터 구조 신호를 수신하는 단계, 구조 신호를 기초로 조난자의 위치를 결정하는 단계, 조난자의 위치로 이동하는 단계를 포함하되, 조난자로부터 구조 신호가 수신되지 않는 경우, 이전 수신한 구조 신호, 모니터링 장치로부터 수신한 해상 정보 중 적어도 하나를 기초로 구조자의 위치를 추정할 수 있다.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based maritime distress personnel detection and tracking method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting and tracking people in distress on the sea based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring image information of a maritime distress scene shot by a camera carried on an unmanned aerial vehicle; inputting image information to a Yolov3 small target detection model, and extracting a candidate region; calculating the confidence coefficient of the person in distress corresponding to the candidate region, and obtaining the target information of the person in distress according to the confidence coefficient; according to the target information, measuring distress signals of the persons in distress and acquiring signal strength indication information; and obtaining the positioning information of the persons in distress according to the signal strength indication information. By establishing a YOLOv3 small target detection model, the processing speed of image information and the accuracy of detecting persons in distress are improved; by means of signal intensity indication information and a patrol algorithm based on multiple unmanned aerial vehicles, real-time tracking and positioning of persons in danger are achieved, the search and rescue range is further narrowed, and the efficiency of maritime rescue is improved.

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a rescue robot. The four right angles of the carriage are respectively and correspondingly provided with a travelling mechanism and an inflating mechanism; running gear includes first motor, second motor, hydraulic tank, hydraulic cylinder, flexible leg, supporting leg and support claw, and the mechanism of aerifing includes water storage box, medicament box and air guide mechanism, and air guide mechanism includes gasbag and empty horizontally inlayer breather pipe, the outer breather pipe of sleeving together, evenly has seted up more than two outer gas outlets along the pipe shaft of outer breather pipe, and the outer gas outlet is communicating the gasbag through the pipe of ventilating, the gas outlet of inlayer breather pipe is communicateing the gas outlet of medicament box body lower floor, and inlayer breather pipe and outer breather pipe link up in outer gas outlet department. The rescue robot can be well suitable for various scenes in which disasters occur, can freely move in a complex and changeable disaster environment to complete rescue tasks, and can detect the disasters in real time and perform primary disaster relief.

title_en: Remote rescue robot system based on GPS and INS combined guidance
abstract_en: The remote rescue robot system based on the GPS and INS combined guidance comprises the following steps: (1) carrying out data fusion of GPS positioning and data of a gyroscope and a three-axis accelerometer through a Kalman filtering algorithm to realize accurate positioning; (2) controlling the motion of the robot according to the fused positioning data; (3) realizing human body infrared detection and radio signal transmission. The method disclosed by the invention discloses a remote rescue robot system for grains based on GPS and INS combined guidance, which can still accurately provide directional navigation service under the condition of satellite loss and no signal, and can carry out human body infrared detection in real time, thereby ensuring the rescue efficiency of a search and rescue vehicle.

title_en: Intelligent door lock
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent door lock which comprises an outdoor lock and an indoor lock, wherein the outdoor lock is provided with a door handle, an identification module, a digital key, a liquid crystal screen, a clutch and a control circuit board, the outdoor lock or the indoor lock is internally provided with a power supply, and the identification module, the digital key, the liquid crystal screen, the clutch and the control circuit board are electrically connected with the power supply. The indoor lock is characterized in that a thermal sensing device is further arranged in the indoor lock and electrically connected with the control circuit board, when the thermal sensing device receives that the external temperature reaches an opening threshold value, the control circuit board controls the clutch to work, and then the clutch drives the movable supporting ring to move, so that the ejector pin is driven to enable the driving shaft fixing piece and the door handle to be connected together, and at the moment, the door handle can be rotated to drive the driving shaft fixing piece and the driving shaft to rotate to open the door lock. When a fire disaster happens, the rescue robot is convenient to enter the room outdoors for rescue.
assignees: ZHEJIANG KINGKIND SECURITY AND SAFETY DEFENSE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle using infrared scanning for search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an use infrared scanning search and rescue's unmanned aerial vehicle, including the unmanned aerial vehicle main part, main flight spiral fan, the mount, vice flight spiral fan and the unmanned aerial vehicle attached aircraft, the inside surface swing joint of unmanned aerial vehicle main part has main flight spiral fan, and main flight spiral fan piece quantity is six, main flight spiral fan bottom middle part fixedly connected with mount, and the mount is the cross form, the equal swing joint in surface all around of unmanned aerial vehicle main part has unmanned aerial vehicle attached aircraft, and the quantity of unmanned aerial vehicle attached aircraft is four, the equal swing joint in inside of unmanned aerial vehicle attached aircraft has vice flight spiral fan, and the equal fixedly connected with mount in vice flight spiral fan bottom middle part, the embedding of the unmanned aerial vehicle main part left and right sides middle part is provided with attached aircraft. The utility model discloses whole device stable in structure, the flying height is high, and the investigation range is wide, and investigation information transmission is fast, and any search and rescue task all can be used, has very high spreading value.

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle undercarriage convenient to replace
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle undercarriage of convenient change, including the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the lower extreme left and right sides symmetrical welding of unmanned aerial vehicle body has the fixed block, and the lower extreme of fixed block has seted up first slot, the opening part of first slot is inserted and is equipped with the roof-rack, the inside of fixed block is provided with installation mechanism, the fixed block is connected with the roof-rack through installation mechanism, and both ends all are provided with the support frame around the roof-rack, the fixed welding of lower extreme of support frame has the inserted block, and the inserted block is connected with the chassis through coupling mechanism. The utility model discloses a set up installation mechanism, installation mechanism's simple structure, convenient operation, can be rapid connect roof-rack and fixed block to facilitate the erection bracing frame, and when needs dismantle the change temporarily, need not the instrument and assist, can directly dismantle, easy operation is convenient, and understandable.

title_en: Rescue method and rescue system for life-saving unmanned ship based on carrying unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rescue method and a rescue system based on a lifesaving unmanned ship carrying an unmanned aerial vehicle. The invention relates to a rescue method at sea based on a lifesaving unmanned ship capable of carrying an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps that a lifesaving unmanned ship obtains coordinates of a target sea area and navigates to the target sea area; after the unmanned ship sails to a target sea area, the unmanned ship stops sailing, and sends a search and rescue instruction and target sea area coordinates to the unmanned plane parked on the unmanned plane lifting platform of the unmanned ship; the unmanned aerial vehicle rises to the sky above the target sea area according to the search and rescue instruction and shoots on the sea surface in the target sea area; the unmanned aerial vehicle identifies a rescue target from the shot sea surface image, flies above the rescue target and sends the coordinate position of the rescue target to the lifesaving unmanned ship; and the rescue unmanned ship runs to the coordinate position of the rescue target to complete rescue. The method reduces the time and difficulty for searching the target in the rescue process of the unmanned ship.

title_en: Deep well rescue robot
abstract_en: Deep well rescue robot, including tripod (1) and electric hoist (2), be equipped with on tripod (1) and hang horizontal pole (3), electric hoist (2) hang on hanging horizontal pole (3) of tripod (1), have robot fixing device (5) through lifting rope (4) on the lifting hook of electric hoist (2), are fixing electronic armpit life saving equipment (6) and electronic lifesaving bracket (7) that open and shut on robot fixing device (5). Compared with the prior art, the utility model discloses a controlling fixed robot device and can effectively avoiding deep well rescue robot at the swing back and forth in the pit, being provided with the lifesaving backplate simultaneously on the armpit life saving equipment, can leaning on the lifesaving backplate by the personnel of saving and avoid directly rubbing with the wall of a well.
assignees: HEBEI FEICHANG ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Forest fire-oriented heterogeneous robot crowd rescue plan auxiliary decision algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire-oriented heterogeneous robot group rescue plan auxiliary decision algorithm. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a forest fire rescue simulator model, and establishing a forest fire rescue simulator model based on a cellular automata according to the fire scene environment information; establishing a rescue robot manager to update the real-time state of the rescue robot; establishing a fire extinguishing knowledge base comprising a forest fire fighting basic principle, a forest fire rescue plan and a forest fire extinguishing strategy; establishing a forest fire rescue plan auxiliary decision system, and selecting an optimal rescue plan by using a multi-attribute decision method; generating a specific rescue scheme for each area through an artificial bee colony algorithm integrating fire extinguishing knowledge; and generating a specific rescue action for the rescue robot by using a rescue action fuzzy inference machine. The algorithm of the invention can meet the requirement of providing an efficient fire extinguishing scheme for forest fire rescue, can effectively reduce economic loss caused by forest fire, and reduces rescue cost.

title_en: Mine disaster early warning, investigation and rescue robot cluster system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mine calamity early warning, investigation and rescue robot cluster system, including the advanced detection robot in pit, the investigation robot in pit, the earth's surface investigation detection robot, aerial detection robot, the rescue robot in pit, ground control station, the remote command station, the advanced detection robot in pit includes the multiple spot rotation type and surveys the subassembly, the matrix is advanced to survey the module, realize the real-time detection to mine tunnelling face front end and disaster parameter on every side through adopting the multiple spot rotation type to survey the subassembly, the matrix of the different frequency wave forms of cooperation transmission is advanced to survey the module, realize the multifrequency detection to fixed point detection area, it is higher to survey the precision, the robustness is stronger. The cluster robots are matched with the ground control station and the remote command station, so that the mine omnibearing three-dimensional system detection, detection and rescue are realized, the mine safety operability is higher, the automation degree is higher, and the reduction and even avoidance of mine disasters are facilitated.
assignees: SHANDONG ATU ROBOT TECH CO LTD;SHANDONG GUOXING ROBOT UNITED RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an unmanned air vehicle technique field, and an unmanned aerial vehicle searches for ands rescue is disclosed, including the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the bottom center department of unmanned aerial vehicle body is through moving mechanism fixedly connected with camera body, the fixed camera lens that is provided with of left side wall of camera body, the fixed motor that is provided with of lower extreme center department of camera body, the terminal fixed connection of output shaft of motor has the horizontally dwang, the left end of dwang extends to the left side and the fixedly connected with turning block of camera lens, four evenly distributed's of circumference wall fixedly connected with clearance poles of turning block, the equal fixedly connected with brush of right side pole wall of four clearance poles, the right-hand member of four brushes all offsets with the surface of camera lens, be located two symmetrical settings in the left and right sides of camera lens with one side. The utility model discloses not only be convenient for clear up the dust that the camera lens is infected with, work efficiency is high, and the clearance pole causes the camera lens to shelter from when can preventing moreover that the motor stall, hinders camera work.
assignees: NANJING HONGWU SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Infrared thermal imaging search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an infrared thermal imaging search and rescue robot, which comprises a robot shell, a crawler belt, a positioning block, a buzzer, a connecting arm and a mechanical arm, wherein the shell is arranged around the search and rescue robot, the crawler belt is arranged at two sides of the shell, the positioning block is connected at the front end of the shell by welding, the buzzer is embedded and fixed on the upper surface of the shell, the connecting arm is connected at the tail end of the positioning block by movable clamping, the mechanical arm is arranged at the tail part of the connecting arm in a matching way, the shell is provided with an infrared thermal imaging module, ultrasonic ranging, a camera, a city natural gas sensor and a detection hole, the positioning block is provided with a supporting block, one side of the chassis buzzer is provided with an internet of things block, the top of the shell is composed of a carbon monoxide sensor and an air vent, an infrared thermal imaging module is added on the basis of the search and rescue robot, the safety of the rescue environment is ensured.

title_en: Obstacle avoidance method of narrow space remote search and rescue robot based on stereoscopic vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses an obstacle avoidance method of a narrow space remote search and rescue robot based on stereoscopic vision, which belongs to the technical field of robots, wherein a robot obstacle avoidance system is established, a steering engine is controlled to select an angle in a first-choice mode, the distance between obstacles on the left side and the right side is measured, and then a chassis of a trolley is controlled to perform corresponding rotating actions, so that the technical problem that the robot rapidly advances and avoids obstacles in a narrow space is solved.

title_en: Compound motion mode mobile robot with autonomic reset function
abstract_en: A composite motion mode mobile robot with an autonomous reset function relates to the technical field of robots. The crawling foot is driven to move forwards by a crawling motor; the robot jumping system comprises a jumping system, wherein the robot jumps by quickly releasing energy stored by a torsion spring; the robot reset system comprises a reset system, and is used for opening the reset wings after the robot overturns, and the robot completes reset by moving the gravity center position of the robot. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the robot can easily traverse various complex terrains, has wide range of motion and strong trafficability, and has great advantages in the aspect of avoiding danger due to the sudden and explosive properties of the bouncing motion. The flexibility of the movement of the robot can be applied to military reconnaissance, the difference of the gravity acceleration among the planet is facilitated, and the robot can exert stronger bouncing capability during extraterrestrial exploration. Has wide application prospect in archaeological detection, anti-terrorism action and ruin search and rescue.

title_en: Maritime rescue-oriented unmanned three-dimensional collaborative search and rescue platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a maritime rescue oriented unmanned three-dimensional collaborative search and rescue platform, which belongs to the field of rescue equipment and engineering application and comprises the following components: intelligent ship (IntVe), Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV), and underwater Vehicle (AUV). The Intve module is responsible for infrared searching, tracking and positioning; the UAV module is responsible for searching rescued persons, finding an optimal route and carrying out intelligent vertical supply; the AUV module is responsible for shooting, avoiding underwater risks, grabbing underwater rescued objects and transmitting signals through the remote control center. The invention well completes the cooperative cooperation and control communication between the intelligent marine aircrafts, realizes respective complete functions and communication and cooperation of three parties, finally forms an underwater-water surface-air three-dimensional search and rescue network, and improves the search and rescue efficiency to the maximum extent on the premise of safety and economy.

title_en: Wheel-leg variable-structure robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a wheel-leg variable-structure robot, which comprises: the mechanical arm is arranged on the rack; the mechanical legs are arranged on two sides of the frame, a plurality of wheel legs are symmetrically arranged, and a wheel type or leg type movement mode can be switched; the mechanical legs are in a series configuration, are connected through a driving branched chain and have multiple degrees of freedom respectively. According to the invention, the springs with different rigidity are installed on each driving branched chain in series, so that the driving branched chains can be used as passive suspension to reduce the impact load on a motor when the robot walks in a leg type; the operation mechanical arm has seven degrees of freedom, has better motion flexibility and can carry out sampling or carrying operation; the wheel-leg variable-structure robot provided by the invention has the advantages of rapid and flexible movement, strong terrain adaptability and good obstacle-crossing capability, and can meet the requirements of work such as terrain detection, material transportation, sample collection, personnel search and rescue and the like under complex non-structural terrain.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle for fire inspection
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an unmanned vehicle technical field just discloses a conflagration patrols and examines unmanned vehicle, including unmanned vehicle, unmanned vehicle's bottom is provided with the track, unmanned vehicle's inside is provided with treater, tracking module, camera, video acquisition module, wireless transmission module, temperature sensor, air quality sensor, human detection sensor and ultrasonic sensor. The fire inspection unmanned vehicle comprises a crawler belt, a wheel disc, an adhesive tape, a ball bearing, a wheel axle cover, a fixing nut, a rewinding oil baffle cover and the like. The bogie wheels are large in number, so that the weight born by each wheel is small, the pressure on the ground is uniformly distributed, the passing performance of the robot is favorably improved, the bogie is suitable for most terrains, and the shuttle is convenient to shuttle on a fire scene.

title_en: Chassis anti-collision structure for fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a chassis anticollision structure for fire rescue robot, include: the fire-fighting rescue robot comprises a chassis, an outer anti-collision plate, a connecting rod and a water storage cavity, wherein the bottom of the chassis is provided with an anti-collision part, the interior of the chassis is provided with a water storage part, the top of the chassis is provided with a fire-fighting rescue robot, the right end of the chassis is arranged in an L shape, and is arranged in a triangular shape with the chassis through the outer anti-collision plate and the inner anti-collision plate, when collision occurs, the outer anti-collision plate can firstly touch sundries such as stones and the like, and the outer anti-collision plate can be buffered by utilizing the elasticity of the return spring, and the whole chassis can be buffered by the arrangement of the buffer spring, thereby achieving the effect of double buffering, effectively increasing the anti-impact performance of the chassis, ensuring the stability of the chassis and the normal running of the fire rescue robot, through the setting of water storage chamber and atomizer, be convenient for spray the front end on the chassis with water, can effectual reduction temperature on every side, avoid the chassis impaired.

title_en: Voice search and rescue robot combining vision and radar laser
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a vision and radar laser combined voice search and rescue robot, which comprises a first body, a second body, a third body, a fourth body, a bionic foot, a voice unit, a laser radar, a depth camera, a lateral camera and a connecting joint; the first machine body and the second machine body, the second machine body and the third machine body, and the third machine body and the fourth machine body are connected through connecting joints; the bionic feet are respectively arranged on two sides of the first machine body, the second machine body, the third machine body and the fourth machine body. The utility model discloses a search for and rescue robot, the volume is small, can not only go on rugged surface, also contains parts such as degree of depth camera, laser radar and pronunciation talkback simultaneously, can realize the building picture of collapse internal environment, more can realize stranded personnel and rescue personnel's dialogue, judges stranded personnel's concrete position, knows its health, and the rescue personnel of being convenient for give best rescue scheme.

title_en: Hang formula of putting search and rescue sonar device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a suspension type search and rescue sonar device which can be used for searching and positioning sunken ship beacons and airplane black box beacons and comprises a vector hydrophone array, a watertight electronic cabin, a bearing photoelectric composite cable, a photoelectric modem, a portable processor and a GPS locator; the method utilizes the direction-finding principle of a vector hydrophone to carry out direction-finding on a black box beacon of a wrecking ship or an airplane, combines a multi-time direction-finding result in a different place and a measuring point position output by a GPS (global positioning system) locator, adopts a multi-point intersection and coordinate conversion method to estimate the absolute position of an acoustic beacon, and is a precondition for rescuing the wrecking ship and the wrecking airplane. The search and rescue sonar is low in cost and simple in system constitution, and can be hung and placed on a helicopter or a ship participating in rescue.
assignees: NO 750 PROVING GROUND CHINA SHIPBUILDING IND CORPORATION

title_en: Underwater detection search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue robot surveys under water, which comprises a housin, the casing bottom is equipped with first extension board, first extension board quantity is established to two, first extension board bottom is equipped with the second and extends the board, first extension board one end is articulated with the second extension board, the second extension board fixedly connected with inserted block of casing bottom one side, the slot has been seted up to the second extension board one end of casing bottom opposite side. The utility model discloses a set up first extension board, through the extension effect of first extension board, the area that the top of search and rescue robot effectively lifted increases, has made things convenient for drowned person's rescue operation of lifting greatly to through launching the second extension board, the drowned person of being convenient for snatchs the handle rapidly, and then the search and rescue robot can pull drowned person and emerge and remove the bank to the surface of water, make drowned person and search and rescue robot can cooperate and accomplish rescue work, improved the efficiency and the success rate of rescue.

title_en: Obstacle-crossing type earthquake rescue robot based on information technology control
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a formula earthquake rescue robot hinders more based on information technology control, which comprises a bod, the top of organism has been seted up and has been held the chamber, the bottom both sides that hold the chamber all have electric telescopic handle through the bolt fastening, electric telescopic handle's top has the fixed plate through bolted connection, the support column has all been welded in the upside four corners of fixed plate, the upper end welding of support column has the mounting panel, the side of mounting panel is provided with the mounting box, the quantity of mounting box is provided with four, four the equal fixed mounting in top of mounting box has infrared detector, four one side that the movable block was kept away from to the mounting box is installed infrared camera. The utility model discloses an electric telescopic handle is flexible to adjust infrared detector and infrared camera's height and angle respectively with positive and negative motor work, greatly increased the area that detects, eliminated the detection blind area, improved the rescue effect.
assignees: CHONGQING CITY ZHONGXIAN ZHONGZHOU HIGH SCHOOL

title_en: Snakelike detection robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a snakelike detection robot, which comprises a head and a plurality of trunk modules which are connected in sequence; the utility model discloses a head is provided with wireless camera module, can give wireless device such as cell-phone or flat board by the real-time transmission picture, makes things convenient for the search and rescue. The utility model discloses can install sensor device additional at the afterbody according to the rescue environment, reduce the input of various sensing robot, make the detection rescue environment that the rescue personnel can convenient and fast simultaneously. The utility model provides a snakelike detection robot can survey the search and rescue in the ruins, has improved the efficiency of search and rescue.
assignees: THE ENGINEERING & TECHNICAL COLLEGE OF CHENGDU UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Infrared thermal imaging search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots, in particular to an infrared thermal imaging search and rescue robot, which comprises a detection component, a support box and a moving component, wherein the detection component is arranged at the top of the support box, and the moving component is arranged at the bottom of the support box; the moving assembly comprises a bottom plate, side plates, a brake wheel, a driven wheel, a crawler and a motor B, wherein the side plates are connected to two sides of the bottom plate through screws, one side of the motor B is connected to the bottom of the bottom plate through screws, one end of the motor B penetrates through the side plates through bearings, the penetrating part of the motor B is connected to one end of the brake wheel, the driven wheel is connected to one side of the side plates through bearings, and the crawler is wound on the surfaces of the brake wheel and the driven wheel, so that searching can be performed; moreover, the searching device can perform multi-angle searching; meanwhile, the operation is convenient.

title_en: Crawler-type rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a crawler-type rescue robot, which comprises a supporting component, walking components respectively arranged at two sides of the supporting component, an mechanical arm arranged on the supporting component and a control system respectively electrically connected with the walking components and the mechanical arm, wherein each walking component comprises two shaft sleeves respectively arranged at two ends of the supporting component, two driving wheels respectively rotatably sleeved outside the two shaft sleeves, a crawler sleeved outside the two driving wheels and meshed with the driving wheels and two first driving pieces respectively arranged in the two shaft sleeves and used for driving the corresponding driving wheels to rotate, the first driving pieces are electrically connected with the control system, compared with the prior rescue robot, the crawler-type rescue robot of the utility model can flexibly and rapidly move, has a large climbing angle, so that the crawler-type rescue robot of the utility model can continuously work on site after complex and severe disasters, the operation is convenient, and the life safety of the rescue workers is ensured.

title_en: Rescue robot arm
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue robotic arm, which comprises a carriage body, the top of automobile body is equipped with the carousel, be equipped with the slide on the carousel, sliding connection has the slider on the slide, automatic telescopic link is connected to the slider, automatic telescopic link fixes on the automobile body, be equipped with manipulator arm assembly on the slider, manipulator arm assembly's end is equipped with the manipulator, is equipped with the controller on the automobile body, be equipped with wireless receiving device on the automobile body, be equipped with the track on the automobile body, automatic telescopic link of controller electric connection, carousel, manipulator arm assembly, manipulator, wireless receiving device and track can extend whole manipulator arm organism to extend into more tiny space with manipulator arm and search and rescue, improve rescue efficiency, and provide more accurate rescue.

title_en: Pigeon swarm robot motion control method based on multiple agents
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of robot control, in particular to a multi-Agent-based pigeon swarm robot motion control method, which comprises a monitoring unit, a master pigeon Agent and a slave pigeon Agent; the monitoring unit is arranged in the search and rescue working room and acquires search and rescue information through the main pigeon Agent and the sub pigeon Agent; the search and rescue personnel issue search and rescue tasks to the main pigeon Agent, the main pigeon Agent analyzes and decodes the information through the task management Agent, a team is further established, and meanwhile the working state of each sub pigeon Agent robot is coordinated; each sub pigeon Agent robot and the main pigeon Agent carry out information sharing and experience sharing, so that each sub pigeon Agent robot realizes the optimization of searching path, posture and motion control; and finally, the search and rescue personnel perform comprehensive analysis and rescue work and further judge and indicate according to the received display information. The method can realize information sharing among robots, self-adaptive control, search path optimization and real-time monitoring of the search state of the single pigeon robot, thereby effectively improving the search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a machine head, an electricity storage chamber, a machine body and a tail wing; the top of the machine body is provided with a first propeller and a third propeller; a first brushless motor is arranged in the machine body corresponding to the first propeller; a second brushless motor is arranged in the machine body corresponding to the third propeller; side wings are fixedly arranged on the two sides of the machine body; a third propeller is arranged on the tail wing; a third brushless motor is arranged in the machine body corresponding to the third propeller; the bottom end of the machine body is provided with an air injection mechanism, a first material port, a second material port and a detection mechanism; a material box and a material box are arranged in the machine body corresponding to the first material port and the second material port. The utility model discloses it is stable safe, search efficient, can give the timely material support of victim.

title_en: Heavy robot nuclear rescue car
abstract_en: The utility model provides a heavy robot nuclear rescue vehicle, which comprises a chassis system, a square cabin and a hydraulic loading bridge; the chassis system comprises a chassis vehicle, traction equipment, vehicle-mounted warning equipment, a cockpit and a shaft generator; the driving cabin is arranged at the forefront part of the chassis vehicle in the driving direction, the traction equipment is an electric winch and is fixedly arranged at the middle position of the lower part of the front end of the driving cabin, and the vehicle-mounted warning equipment is fixedly arranged at the upper part of the driving cabin; the shaft generator is arranged at a concave part at the lower side of the front end of the shelter and is fixedly connected with the chassis vehicle; the square cabin is arranged at the rear part of the cockpit; the hydraulic boarding bridge is arranged at the rear part of the square cabin. Heavy robot nuclear rescue car, be equipped with the poison filtering ventilation system to can carry the robot and go deep into the scene of accident and accomplish the search and rescue task, make rescue ability and search and rescue efficiency show the improvement under the nuclear environment.

title_en: Nuclear rescue vehicle with accessory warehouse
abstract_en: The utility model provides a nuclear rescue vehicle with an accessory library, which comprises a chassis system, a square cabin and a hydraulic boarding bridge; the chassis system comprises a chassis vehicle, traction equipment, vehicle-mounted warning equipment, a cockpit and a shaft generator; the square cabin is arranged at the rear part of the cockpit and comprises a control square cabin and an equipment square cabin, and the control square cabin and the equipment square cabin are separated by a partition plate; the control shelter is arranged at the front part of the equipment shelter, an accessory warehouse and a robot system are arranged in the equipment shelter, and wing-opening doors are arranged at the two sides of the equipment shelter and correspond to the accessory warehouse; the hydraulic boarding bridge is arranged at the rear part of the square cabin. The nuclear rescue vehicle with the accessory library of the utility model is provided with a poison filtering and ventilating system and can carry the robot and the accessories matched with the robot to complete the search and rescue tasks; the accessory library can stably carry various rescue accessories, and is matched with the robot to realize unmanned replacement of various accessories, so that the rescue efficiency can be improved, and the personal risk can be reduced.

title_en: Liftable tracked robot chassis
abstract_en: The utility model provides a liftable tracked robot chassis, including platform and crawler, crawler comprises track running gear and track elevating system. The crawler traveling mechanism is provided with a hexagon consisting of two long connecting rods and four short connecting rods. The crawler lifting mechanism is used for adjusting the height of the chassis, the crawler lifting mechanism is arranged inside the crawler traveling mechanism, a parallelogram structure is adopted, the crawler lifting mechanism is driven to lift by a lead screw, and the self-locking structure is used at the highest position and the lowest position of the platform, so that the mechanism is more stable. When some accidents are handled, search and rescue equipment can be carried, the height of the chassis can be reduced to realize stable and smooth passing through when the road conditions are good or the height is limited, and the chassis can be improved to realize higher passing performance when the road surfaces have deeper or poor road conditions.

title_en: Flight bionic control arm rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flight bionic control arm rescue robot which comprises a multi-rotor flight platform, wherein the bottom of the multi-rotor flight platform is connected with a mechanical arm through a support frame, the bottom end of the support frame is movably connected with a base frame, the mechanical arm is movably connected with a mechanical bionic hand, a far-end control system is arranged on the multi-rotor flight platform, and the far-end control system is connected with the mechanical arm, the mechanical bionic hand and the base frame; the glove comprises a control glove, and is characterized by further comprising an arm bionic controller, a finger bionic controller and a glove sensor which are arranged on the control glove, wherein the arm bionic controller, the finger bionic controller and the glove sensor are all connected with a data wireless transmitter arranged at the wrist of the control glove, the data wireless transmitter is connected with a near-end control system, and a far-end control system is connected with the near-end control system. The flight control device has the characteristics of free flight, rapid arrival at a task position, reduction of rescue time and simulation of complex action operation of human arms.
assignees: SHAANXI BEIDOU JINJIAN AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue target identification method, system and equipment based on water robot
abstract_en: According to the search and rescue target identification method, system and equipment based on the water robot, the water robot shoots the environmental information of the sea area in front through the camera positioned at the head; the overwater robot scans the acquired environment picture, candidate point information of the search and rescue target is calculated through pixel color information, an image coordinate system is mapped to a world coordinate system after the candidate point information is calculated, and the world coordinate information of the search and rescue target is acquired according to the GPS positioning information of the overwater robot; and screening the area around the candidate point to delete the candidate points which do not meet the screening condition from the candidate point queue. And when the pixel color proportion in the candidate region meets the preset proportion, the region is considered as a search and rescue region of the person to be rescued. The water robot transmits back the position information of the target to be searched and rescued and the picture information shot by the camera.
assignees: QINGDAO HAIMI FEICHI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned plane cluster task cooperation method and system for rescue and relief work
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster task cooperation method and system for rescue and relief work, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle cooperative control. The system comprises a service dispatcher, search and rescue detection, communication guarantee and material delivery subsystems; each subsystem is divided into three layers of a strategy layer, a campaign layer and a micro-action layer; the service scheduler is used for scheduling the execution time sequences of three tasks, namely search and rescue detection, communication guarantee and material delivery. The invention can decompose a complex task problem into a plurality of relatively simple sub-problems, then respectively solve the optimal solutions of the sub-problems, and finally, the optimal solutions of the sub-problems form the optimal solution of the original problem.

title_en: Self-protection structure device of sensing monitoring mechanism of search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-protection structure device of a sensing and monitoring mechanism of a search and rescue robot, and relates to the field of robot mechanism protection structure devices. In the invention: the two end sides of the robot body are respectively provided with a first position adjusting power device and a second position adjusting power device; a first protective frame plate which is semi-surrounded on the first wide-angle camera shooting and collecting device is connected to the first supporting substrate; a second protective frame plate which is semi-surrounded on the second wide-angle camera shooting and collecting device is connected to the second supporting substrate; the robot body is fixedly provided with a telescopic adjusting power device; the fixed support vertical connecting plate is provided with a pair of infrared detection devices and a pair of voice acquisition devices; the fixed support vertical connecting plate is fixedly connected with an upper side protective cover plate. The wide-angle camera shooting acquisition device is effectively protected by the protection frame plate; the infrared detection device and the voice acquisition device are effectively supported and protected through the upper side protective cover plate, and the danger of damage to the search and rescue robot in a dangerous environment is reduced.
assignees: QUANZHOU QUANGANG JINGFENG IND DESIGN SERVICE CENTER

title_en: Disaster-relief exploration four-footed bionic robot dog suitable for various environments
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a machinery bionical ware technical field, concretely relates to be suitable for bionical machine dog of disaster relief exploration four-footed of multiple environment, including the host computer, both ends are equipped with the carriage release arm respectively around the host computer, and the carriage release arm includes shank pole, thigh pole, shank connecting piece, thigh connecting piece, steering wheel connecting piece, possesses following beneficial effect: the four-footed machine has stricter stability, the gravity center adjustment amount can be reduced to the minimum by adopting the gait, the efficiency is highest, different rescue environments can be effectively coped with, the system is made of alloy materials and has stronger architecture performance, the system can be applied to the search and rescue process of natural disasters such as earthquake, fire, landslide and the like, so the identification of the life body becomes the difficulty which must be overcome, the search task of the life body in a disaster area is realized, the identification of the life body is carried out on the basis of image processing by a camera and infrared thermal imaging, the imaging principles of the camera and the infrared thermal imaging are different, and the application environments of the camera and the infrared thermal imaging are different.

title_en: Animal husbandry is bred and is searched for andd rescue on-line monitoring integrated management device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue on-line monitoring integrated management device is bred in animal husbandry belongs to and breeds search and rescue technical field. The utility model provides a search for and rescue on-line monitoring integrated management device is bred in animal husbandry, includes: control panel still includes: set up positioning mechanism on the animal body, set up in the hoist mechanism on breed room roof, set up the unmanned aerial vehicle mechanism in hoist mechanism, control panel be used for controlling positioning mechanism, hoist mechanism and unmanned aerial vehicle mechanism operation, positioning mechanism, hoist mechanism and unmanned aerial vehicle mechanism and control panel wireless connection, positioning mechanism include the cloth, the cloth bottom surface is provided with glue, the cloth passes through glue and sets up on the animal body, the cloth top surface be provided with reflector layer, fluorescent layer, battery case, loudspeaker, this practical accessible sound is retrieved the animal or is retrieved through unmanned aerial vehicle, convenient and fast.
assignees: GUIZHOU JINGRUN ANIMAL HUSBANDRY CO LTD

title_en: Automatic fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic fire rescue robot which comprises a crawler mechanism, a vertical lifting mechanism, a horizontal telescopic mechanism, a slewing mechanism and a rescue mechanism, wherein rescue of trapped people in a fire is automatically completed; the crawler belt mechanism and the slewing mechanism telescoping mechanism automatically walk to a fire scene, automatically adjust the height angle and automatically rescue; the chest fixing device and the waist fixing device automatically clamp the chest and the waist of the trapped person, so that the rescue safety is ensured; the chest fixing device is internally provided with the binding rope mechanism, so that the trapped person can be prevented from being injured if the trapped person slides down to a certain extent.

title_en: Intelligent auxiliary search and rescue system for people in distress on water based on visual perception and calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent auxiliary search and rescue system for people in distress on water based on visual perception and calculation, which comprises: the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle flight platform carries a video acquisition module and portable life-saving equipment; the video acquisition module is used for acquiring video images of persons in distress on water in the target area; the base comprehensive processing platform comprises a video processing unit, a drowning person detection and identification unit and a control unit; the drowning person detection and identification unit is used for carrying out drowning person autonomous identification and detection according to the processed image; the rescue unmanned ship drives the area where the people falling into the water are located to rescue according to the control information of the comprehensive processing platform of the base. The invention provides the autonomous identification unit of the personnel falling into water of the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle based on the YOLOv3, and the unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned boat are utilized to effectively complete the intelligent auxiliary search and rescue of the personnel in distress on water.

title_en: Landslide geological disaster rescue robot with high safety
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent rescue robots, and particularly discloses a landslide geological disaster rescue robot with high safety; the escape capsule comprises a running mechanism, an excavating mechanism and an escape capsule body, wherein the running mechanism comprises a base, crawler belt wheel sets are arranged on the front end surface and the rear end surface of the base, a crawler belt is arranged on the crawler belt wheel sets, the escape capsule body is arranged on the upper surface of the base, a safety cabin is arranged in the escape capsule body, a plurality of safety seats are fixedly arranged in the safety cabin, safety belts are arranged on the safety seats, and emergency safety airbags are arranged on two sides of the upper end of each safety seat; the lifesaving cabin body is arranged in a double-layer mode, the safety cabin is arranged in the lifesaving cabin body, a large number of buffer springs are arranged between the safety cabin body and the lifesaving cabin body, and when falling stones impact the surface of the lifesaving cabin body in the landslide rescue process, the impact force of the stones can be effectively reduced due to the existence of the buffer springs, so that the rescuee can be prevented from causing secondary damage.

title_en: Intelligent control's conflagration rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent control fire rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of fire rescue robots and comprises a crawler-type fire rescue robot, wherein a heat insulation plate is arranged at the top of the crawler-type fire rescue robot, and a heat insulation glass cover is arranged at the position, corresponding to the heat insulation plate, at the top of the crawler-type fire rescue robot. According to the invention, through the mutual cooperation of the designed heat-insulating glass cover, the shock absorber, the buffer plate, the windshield wiper, the water pump, the motor, the BIM modeling unit, the sensor module, the microprocessor, the display module and other technologies, the definition of indoor scene information obtained by the indoor arrangement recording module is ensured, meanwhile, a rear fire fighter can quickly draw up a correct and effective rescue scheme according to the scene of an indoor fire scene and can be matched with a crawler-type fire rescue robot for use, the remote conversation between trapped people and the fire fighter can be realized, the fire fighter can conveniently tell the trapped people about the rescue scheme, and the rescue efficiency is effectively improved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG SHUREN COLLEGE ZHEJIANG SHUREN UNIV

title_en: Robot fire rescue system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot fire-fighting rescue system, which comprises management substations distributed in each area where fire easily occurs, a plurality of fire-fighting rescue robots distributed around the management substations and in wireless communication connection with the management substations, a data service center connected with each management substation, and a terminal of the fire-fighting rescue center connected with the data service center; the fire-fighting rescue robots which are distributed at the periphery of the management substation and are in wireless communication with the management substation are distributed in the defined area, and the management substation sets automatic inspection for a plurality of fire-fighting rescue robots, inspects the safety of the surrounding environment, and discovers and controls disasters in early stage. The invention forms real-time network interaction among the management substation, the data service center and the fire rescue center through a plurality of fire rescue robots arranged in a certain area, so that the command center and the fire rescue personnel can accurately know the field situation at the first time, the dangerous case is controlled at the early stage, the fire rescue robots are used for replacing the rescue personnel in the rescue, and the casualties are avoided.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle with search and rescue function
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle with search and rescue functions, which comprises a body, wherein four support columns are fixed on the outer wall of the top of the body through screws, the same electric slide rail is fixed on the outer wall of the top of the four support columns through screws, two slide blocks are connected on the inner wall of the electric slide rail in a sliding manner, the tops of the slide blocks are rotatably connected with electric push rods through bearings, the outer wall of the top of one electric push rod is fixed with a first connecting frame through screws, and the outer wall of the top of the other electric push rod is fixed with a second connecting frame. According to the invention, the electric slide rail is arranged, the two slide blocks are arranged on the electric slide rail, the same telescopic rod is arranged on the two slide blocks, and the cutting tool is arranged on the telescopic rod, so that after the unmanned aerial vehicle is wound by leaves or grass clusters, the two slide blocks can be controlled, the angle and the length of the telescopic rod can be adjusted, the cutting tool can be enabled to contact the leaves or the grass clusters, then the motor III is started to cut, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be prevented from being damaged, and the rescue efficiency is improved.
assignees: HENGYANG YUNYAN AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Aquatic rescue robot and operation method thereof
abstract_en: Disclosed are an aquatic rescue robot and an operation method thereof. The robot is applicable to outdoor swimming pools or aquatic recreational establishments, and can assist a lifeguard in performing an aquatic rescue operation. The robot comprises: a robot body; a control system in communication with a controller of the robot body; and a user wristband. The robot body comprises: a drive compartment; stabilization fins symmetrically installed at two sides of the drive compartment; a power device provided in the driving compartment; a buoyancy detection and control device fixedly installed at the periphery of the drive compartment; and rescue throw devices fixedly installed at the top of the drive compartment facing multiple directions. The control system of the present invention communicates with the controller of the robot body and the user wristband. The control system is provided with a user wristband emergency button signal receiving device used to convert a received signal and perform positioning. After conversion of the signal is completed, the control system assigns a robot closest to a location where a user is drowning to start up and move to said location to perform rescue. The invention can efficiently and quickly increase the buoyancy of a drowning person while facilitating reducing physical exhaustion of a lifeguard.
assignees: NANJING LINGQUE INTELLIGENT MFG CO LTD

title_en: Underwater searching device supporting remote communication
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a search and rescue equipment under water aims at providing a search device under water who supports remote communication, and its technical scheme main points are including search and rescue robot body, remote control center and big dipper satellite navigation, search and rescue robot body includes first central processing unit, first central processing unit is through first signal transmission module and big dipper satellite navigation wireless connection, remote control center is relevant with big dipper satellite navigation, search and rescue robot body still includes signal connection in first central processing unit's sonar detection ware and camera, first central processing unit department ware is connected in the high in the clouds server through first signal transmission module, remote control center is including connecting second signal transmission module, second central processing unit, display screen and the control module in the high in the clouds server. The utility model discloses greatly reduced search for and rescue the cost, promoted search for and rescue efficiency.

title_en: A unmanned aerial vehicle for forest control
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for forest monitoring, which comprises a body, a high-definition camera and a signal transceiver, wherein an antenna is arranged at the front end of the body, the signal transceiver is arranged at the top of the body, an electrostatic releaser is arranged at the top of the signal transceiver, a solar cell panel is arranged on the upper side of the body, an empennage is arranged at the tail of the body, an organic tire, a telescopic rod, a smoke detection head and an air humidity detector are respectively arranged at the bottom of the body, and the high-definition camera is arranged at the bottom of the telescopic rod. Has the advantages that: the invention is provided with the electrostatic releaser, a large amount of charges accumulated on the unmanned aerial vehicle shell are discharged into the atmosphere, the requirement of safe operation in thunderstorm and rainy days can be met, the signal connection of a local area network can be realized by arranging the signal transceiver, the antenna, the search and rescue lamp and the search and rescue loudspeaker, the position of trapped personnel is quickly positioned, and the rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Autonomous intelligent overwater search and rescue boat
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water search and rescue, in particular to an autonomous intelligent water search and rescue boat, wherein two handrails and a safety belt are arranged on the upper surface of a boat body, a detection positioning module is arranged on the upper surface of the boat body through a motor, the motor drives the detection positioning module to rotate for 360 degrees, the detection positioning module is internally integrated with a wireless direction finding module, an image recognition module, an infrared imaging module, a GPS module and an iridium module, cylindrical channels are respectively arranged inside the left side and the right side of the tail part of the boat body, a propeller is arranged inside each cylindrical channel, a power supply control module is arranged inside the boat body, the power supply control module is internally integrated with a power supply module for supplying power to the search and rescue boat and a control module for controlling an internal system of the search and rescue boat, the autonomous navigation search and rescue boat automatically searches for personnel falling into water through the modes of wireless direction finding, image recognition, infrared imaging and the like, autonomously, greatly improves the efficiency and success rate of search and rescue and improves the survival probability of people falling into water.

title_en: Multi-sensor fusion search and rescue robot system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-sensor fusion search and rescue robot system which comprises a local robot, a remote gateway, a cloud server and a client, wherein the local robot is connected to a visual console in the cloud server through the remote gateway, and the visual console is in communication connection with the client; the local robot comprises a Waffle _ pi model case set, a servo motor set, a battery pack, a laser radar range finder, an infrared sensor, a harmful gas sensor, a binocular camera, an SBC microcomputer and an OpenCR controller, wherein the SBC microcomputer and the OpenCR controller are in master-slave relation, and an SBC master control module in the SBC microcomputer is in wireless connection with a remote gateway. The system achieves intelligent integration by utilizing cloud big data processing and cloud decision and control, so that the search and rescue task is safer, more stable and more efficient, and more practical and more convenient, and people without professional background can also complete the search and rescue task through the system.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle and unmanned vehicle cooperative sensing system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooperative sensing system of an unmanned vehicle and a control method thereof, which are applied to the field of rescue and exploration equipment, and comprise the unmanned vehicle, wherein the unmanned vehicle comprises a vehicle body, a sensor, a first processor and a first wireless communication module, the sensor, the first processor and the first wireless communication module are all arranged on the vehicle body, and the first processor is respectively connected with the sensor and the first wireless communication module; the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a second processor, a second wireless communication module and a third wireless communication module, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle body is provided with a hanging bracket for bearing an unmanned vehicle, the second processor is respectively connected with the second wireless communication module and the third wireless communication module, and the second wireless communication module is communicated with the first wireless communication module; and the receiving end comprises a fourth wireless communication module, and the fourth wireless communication module is communicated with the third wireless communication module. The invention is beneficial to the implementation of putting and search and rescue in complex terrain areas.

title_en: Self-floating type marine unmanned aerial vehicle and drowning search and rescue system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-floating offshore unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a fuselage and wings, wherein the wings are arranged on two sides of the fuselage, vertical take-off and landing arms are arranged on the two wings, and the fuselage is made of a carbon composite PVC foam material; the wings are made of Kevlar composite PVC foam materials; the vertical lifting arm is made of 3K carbon fiber; the falling water can be ensured to float on the water surface through the material and the pneumatic design of the machine body. The system comprises the unmanned aerial vehicle, a Beidou satellite transmitter, an AIS base station, a command end and a plurality of AIS ship terminals, wherein the command end arranges ships to salvage nearby through modeling calculation and analysis according to unmanned aerial vehicle Beidou positioning information and AIS identification information of the AIS ship terminals. The unmanned aerial vehicle rescue system is convenient for search and rescue and salvage of the unmanned aerial vehicle falling into water, the salvage cost is reduced, and the search and rescue process is safe and reliable.
assignees: TRANCOMM BIG DATA SHANGHAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent camera for coal mine search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model particularly relates to an intelligent camera for a coal mine search and rescue robot, which comprises a self-balancing main camera component, a main camera base and a robot main body, wherein the main camera base and the robot main body are arranged below the self-balancing main camera component; the self-balancing main camera assembly comprises a self-balancing carrier and a main camera, and the main camera is arranged on the self-balancing carrier; be provided with supplementary camera on the camera base, be provided with high definition on the machine walking arm and visit thing camera subassembly. The utility model discloses intelligent camera for colliery search and rescue robot, the modern design, compact structure, the stability of making a video recording is good, and the definition is high, and the limitation is little, convenient to use.
assignees: BOLE KUNPENG ELECTRONIC COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Simulation method and device for unmanned aerial vehicle and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: A simulation method, a simulation apparatus, and a computer-readable storage medium for an unmanned aerial vehicle are provided. The simulation method comprises the following steps: displaying a search and rescue task of a virtual unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the virtual unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a virtual shooting device; acquiring a virtual image acquired by the virtual shooting device according to an unmanned aerial vehicle operation instruction sent by a control terminal, wherein the control terminal can control the virtual unmanned aerial vehicle; and determining the completion condition of the search and rescue task at least partially according to the virtual image.

title_en: Lighting mechanism for unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the unmanned air vehicle technique and specifically relates to a lighting mechanism for unmanned aerial vehicle, including frame and the control box of setting in the frame bottom, the control box passes through the fixed setting of connecting rod in the frame bottom, and the fixed front end light that is provided with in control box left side, control box bottom range formula are provided with the LED group, and the fixed lamp shade that is provided with on the control box bottom plate in the LED group outside. The utility model discloses in, all set up lighting mechanism through in control box front side and bottom, and the infrared distance measuring sensor who sets up, this infrared distance measuring sensor conveys the controller with the information that detects, corresponding resistance value is adjusted to controller control numerical control potentiometre, then realize the illumination luminance of control front end light and LED emitting diode group, this unmanned aerial vehicle lighting mechanism, can highly realize the automatically regulated of illumination luminance according to unmanned aerial vehicle, satisfy ordinary illumination task, still can be applied to the search and rescue task of the proruption dangerous situation of natural disasters, and suitable using widely.
assignees: SHAOWU SHUNYI AGRICULTURAL DEV CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel emergency automatic rescue device and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic emergency rescue device and method for a tunnel, which comprises driveways on two sides of the tunnel, wherein the driveways on the two sides are communicated through a gate; a plurality of charging stations are arranged in the tunnel, a plurality of robots are arranged in the charging stations, the robots are arranged on the hanger rails to move, and reversing rails are arranged between the charging stations and the hanger rails; the robot is provided with an intelligent search and rescue device, an automatic fire extinguishing and fire fighting device and a carrying and rescue stretcher which are mechanically connected. The emergency treatment device can guide evacuation of people in the tunnel in time, avoids accident further expansion simultaneously, warns vehicle personnel afterwards, and automated control can timely and effectively carry out emergency treatment to emergency accidents occurring in the tunnel, greatly improves rescue efficiency, avoids further fermentation of accidents, protects personal safety, and is suitable for popularization and use.
assignees: WUHAN MUDU ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: High-penetrability fusion search and rescue device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-penetrability fusion search and rescue device which comprises an acquisition component, an adjusting component, a display component and a control component, wherein the acquisition component is connected with the adjusting component; the acquisition assembly comprises an infrared thermal imaging module, a lighting module, a millimeter wave radar module and a lamp body with an accommodating space, the infrared thermal imaging module, the lighting module and the millimeter wave radar module are accommodated in the accommodating space of the lamp body, and the infrared thermal imaging module, the lighting module and the millimeter wave radar module can be coordinated to work cooperatively through the control assembly. The millimeter wave radar module is used for rapidly identifying the moving target, and the infrared thermal imaging module is used for further confirming the moving target, so that the rescue target can be rapidly identified.

title_en: Drone with folding structure
title_ko: 폴딩 구조 드론
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a drone having a folding structure. According to the present invention, the drone having a folding structure comprises a main body (100), a battery module (200), a camera module (300), and a wing module (400), wherein the main body (100) comprises a first body (110) and a second body (120), and the first body (110) comprises a first rear plate (112), a first base plate (115), and a first side plate (118). According to the present invention, left and right fixed wings can be maintained in an unfolded state.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 폴딩 구조 드론에 관한 것으로서, 상세하게는 드론 본체를 본체의 길이 방향으로 연장되는 힌지결합부에 의해 서로 폴딩 가능하게 결합되는 제1 몸체 및 제2 몸체로 분리 구성하되, 제1 몸체 및 제2 몸체에 의해 공동으로 형성되는 배터리모듈 장착공간에 배터리모듈을 장착하도록 하여 몸체가 폴딩되지 않도록 함으로써, 항공중 드론 날개가 펼쳐진 상태를 유지하도록 하는, 폴딩 구조 드론에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은, 본체(100), 배터리모듈(200), 카메라모듈(300) 및 날개모듈(400)을 포함하는 드론에 있어서, 본체(100)는 본체(100)의 길이 방향으로 연장되는 힌지결합부(130)에 의해 서로 폴딩 가능하게 결합되는 제1 몸체(110) 및 제2 몸체(120)로 분리 구성되고, 제1 몸체(110)는 제1 리어 플레이트(112), 제1 베이스 플레이트(115), 제1 사이드 플레이트(118)를 포함하도록 구성되고, 제2 몸체(120)는 제2 리어 플레이트(122), 제2 베이스 플레이트(125), 제2 사이드 플레이트(128)를 포함하도록 구성되고, 제1 몸체(110)와 제2 몸체(120)가 언폴딩된 상태에서, 제2 베이스 플레이트(125)는 제1 베이스 플레이트(115)의 상면에 놓이게 되고, 제1 사이드 플레이트(118)와 제2 사이드 플레이트(128)와 제2 리어 플레이트(122) 및 제2 베이스 플레이트(125)는 본체(100)의 외측면에서 내측으로 함몰되어 형성되는 배터리모듈 장착공간(140)의 경계를 구성하며, 배터리모듈(200)에 구비되는 한 쌍의 클램프(211, 212) 가운데, 제1 클램프(211)는 제1 몸체(110)의 제1 클램프홀(111)에, 제2 클램프(212)는 제2 몸체(120)의 제2 클램프홀(121)에 각각 체결되며, 배터리모듈(200)의 후방으로 돌출 구비되는 한 쌍의 체결다리(221, 222) 가운데, 제1 체결다리(221)는 제1 몸체(110)의 제1 리어 플레이트(112)에, 제2 체결다리(222)는 제2 몸체(120)의 제2 리어 플레이트(122)에 끼움 결합되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: High-storage-rate bionic pneumatic soft worm robot based on paper folding theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-storage-rate bionic pneumatic soft worm robot based on a paper folding theory. Two ends of the flexible driver are respectively bonded with the front end cover plate and the rear end cover plate, and the flexible driver is expanded in a manner of inflating through an inflation system to drive the front exhaust movable foot to move forwards; the flexible driver is used for driving the exhaust movable foot to move forwards, so that the axial large-stroke bionic crawling is realized. The pneumatic foot is stretched and contracted through the air bag, and the included angle between the hinge connecting piece and the ground is adjusted, so that the friction form between the pneumatic foot and the ground is changed to realize unidirectional movement. The bionic pneumatic soft worm robot with high storage rate based on the paper folding theory has the advantages of high expansion rate, light weight, low power consumption, strong load-carrying capacity and the like, can realize quick and stable crawling, and can be applied to the fields of post-disaster search and rescue actions or pipeline monitoring and the like.

title_en: Small-bore deep well rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small-caliber rescue robot, which comprises an automatic airborne safety rope mechanism, an automatic lifting mechanism and an external frame, wherein the automatic airborne safety rope mechanism is connected with the automatic lifting mechanism through a lifting hook, the automatic lifting mechanism comprises an upper notch conjugate mechanism and a lower notch conjugate mechanism, the conjugate mechanism comprises an upper notch slide way disc and a lower notch slide way disc, a knob shaft is arranged between the upper notch slide way disc and the lower notch slide way disc, a turning foot is arranged on an upper slide way, a positioning ball is arranged at the front end of the turning foot, and a friction block is fixed on the positioning ball.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation method considering operation environment and performance in collaborative search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation method considering operation environment and performance in collaborative search and rescue, and belongs to the field of task allocation methods of navigation and unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue.
