The invention considers the disaster level of the search and rescue points to endow each search and rescue point with a level attribute, considers the influence of the detection range of the unmanned aerial vehicle on the disaster level, corrects the level, and converts the level result into the hovering time of the unmanned aerial vehicle. Selecting a certain number of unmanned aerial vehicle release positions according to the minimum total search and rescue cost, allocating a proper search and rescue point to each position, considering the influence of unmanned aerial vehicle performance, terrain and low-altitude wind on unmanned aerial vehicle battery energy consumption and other factors, establishing a helicopter release unmanned aerial vehicle position location optimization model, solving by using an improved binary bat algorithm, and comparing and analyzing with a result before improvement. The invention greatly improves the practicability and accuracy of the task allocation research of the unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Four-wheel-drive firefighting forcible entry rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a four-wheel-drive fire-fighting dismantling rescue robot. The robot comprises a frame, two independent crawler-type traveling mechanisms are arranged on two sides of the frame respectively, a rotary platform is connected to the upper side of the front end of the frame through the rotary mechanism, a hydraulic working arm mechanism is arranged on the rotary platform, a diesel engine assembly is arranged on the upper side of the frame, the diesel engine assembly is connected with a hydraulic pump, the hydraulic pump is connected with a control valve group and a hydraulic oil tank, the control valve group is connected with an electric cabinet, the rotary mechanism, the hydraulic working arm mechanism and the crawler-type traveling mechanisms respectively, and the electric cabinet is in wireless connection with a remote control. The four independent crawler-type traveling mechanisms are adopted, so that the robot is suitable for moving operation on a pothole road section and stairs, the demolition operation can be carried out on various occasions, the maneuverability of the demolition operation is greatly improved, the operation efficiency is improved, the damping mechanism has a good damping effect, and the abnormality of parts on the upper side of the frame under the pothole road condition is avoided.
assignees: ANHUI HENGCHUANG INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Rescue robot and method for searching trapped people for fire fighting
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rescue robot for searching trapped persons for fire protection, which comprises a movable base, wherein the bottom of the movable base is provided with a movable roller with a self-locking mechanism, a machine installation seat is fixed on the movable base, the middle part of the top of the machine installation seat is provided with a rotating upright post, the bottom of an inner cavity of the machine installation seat is provided with a driving motor, the right output end of the driving motor is sleeved with a driving bevel gear, the bottom of the rotating upright post penetrates through the top of the machine installation seat and is sleeved with a driven bevel gear, the driving bevel gear and the driven bevel gear are mutually meshed, the outer wall of the rotating upright post is positioned above the machine installation seat and is sleeved and fixed with a fixed seat, the left side and the right side of the fixed seat are provided with symmetrical bridge cranes, and two groups of bridge cranes are mutually far away from one side and provided with a rotating shaft seat The second power arm carries the stone and the beam column and moves away.

title_en: Multi-sensor combined detection and display method based on unmanned aerial vehicle platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-sensor combined detection and display method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle platform, which is realized by utilizing a binocular camera module, an infrared thermal imager module, an information fusion processing module and an augmented reality presentation module, wherein the binocular visible light camera module and the infrared thermal imager module are both mounted on the unmanned aerial vehicle platform, the binocular camera module comprises two monocular camera modules which are respectively arranged on the left side and the right side, the binocular camera module is utilized to sense visible light information of the environment, the infrared thermal imager module is utilized to sense infrared information of the environment, the information comprehensive processing module is utilized to complete fusion processing of sensing information of the binocular camera module and the infrared thermal imager module, the fusion processing comprises calibration, correction, registration and target identification, and the augmented reality fusion display module is utilized to complete fusion display of the sensing information. The invention can more effectively detect and position the target, has great advantages for target detection in complex environment, and can be widely applied to disaster area search and rescue, military reconnaissance and the like.
assignees: NATIONAL DEFENSE SCIENCE AND TECH INNOVATION INSTITUTE ACADEMY OF MILITARY SCIENCES PLA CHINA

title_en: Intelligent search and rescue method and system for offshore unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent search and rescue method and system for a maritime unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the system comprises a central server, at least one unmanned aerial vehicle and at least one search and rescue ship, and the method comprises the following steps: after receiving the first person search and rescue task, the unmanned aerial vehicle reports information to the central server in the form of the second person search and rescue task, the central server generates a third person search and rescue task according to detection information of the unmanned aerial vehicle, matches with a search and rescue ship, sends the third person search and rescue task to the search and rescue ship, and executes subsequent operation by the search and rescue ship. The invention combines the unmanned aerial vehicle and the search and rescue ship, and performs task association and task allocation through the central server, thereby realizing high-efficiency and high-quality maritime search and rescue.

title_en: Robot lifesaving method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot lifesaving method and a system, wherein S101: the water rescue robot is controlled to move to the side of the person to be rescued through a wireless remote controller; s102: wirelessly controlling the rescue robot to launch the life buoy; s103: the lifebuoy is provided with an alarm to give an alarm; s104: starting a tractor to pull the rescuer to the side of the rescue robot; s105: the invention relates to a robot lifesaving method and a robot lifesaving system, which can be used for quickly and accurately rescuing a drowner, can be used for rescuing the drowner in the rescue gold time of the drowner and increasing the survival possibility of the drowner, and can be used for monitoring the water surface and the environment in water in the process of pulling the drowner to land so as to reduce the secondary injury to the drowner in the rescuing process.
assignees: JIANGMEN ZHIHONG ROBOT RES AND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Rescue robot and method for quickly cleaning building collapse materials
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue robots, in particular to a rescue robot and a method thereof for quickly cleaning house collapse building materials, wherein the rescue robot comprises a movable vehicle body, a movable box body is fixed at the top of the movable vehicle body, a placing groove is formed in the movable box body, two ground breaking side plates are arranged in the placing groove, a T-shaped sliding block is arranged on the right side of each ground breaking side plate, two T-shaped sliding grooves are formed in the left side of the movable box body, the T-shaped sliding grooves are connected with the left side of the movable box body in a sliding manner, and two electric push rods are arranged on the right side of; the invention is provided with two ground breaking side plates, the transverse push rod is pushed by the electric push rod to cause the ground breaking side plates to prop open the ruins, and the high-density canvas folded at the tops of the ground breaking side plates is also opened to be matched with the crossed side prop rods to form a top guard, so that an emergency channel is formed, a rescuer can conveniently enter rescue or transmit food, water source or detector inwards, all the ruins do not need to be cleaned completely, and the channel forming speed is high and stable.

title_en: Large-load emergency rescue robot control system facing complex environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-load emergency rescue robot control system facing a complex environment, which structurally comprises: the robot control system comprises a robot chassis control subsystem, a mechanical arm control subsystem, a communication subsystem, a video subsystem, an automatic wire winding and unwinding control subsystem and a terminal display control subsystem, wherein the robot chassis control subsystem is connected with the terminal display control subsystem through a serial WIFI module of the communication subsystem, and a chassis main controller of the robot chassis control subsystem is connected with a mechanical arm controller through a CAN (controller area network) line; the technical scheme of the invention has the characteristics of large load of a hydraulic system and convenient operation and control of an electric system; wireless and wired dual communication mechanisms: ensuring normal communication under the condition of serious electromagnetic interference; meanwhile, the invention is easy to realize and suitable for popularization and application due to reasonable and simple structural design.
assignees: BEIJING ACADEMY OF SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Large-load emergency rescue robot for complex environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large-load emergency rescue robot facing a complex environment, which comprises a mechanical arm, a power chassis, a suspension system, a hydraulic system and the like, wherein the suspension system is arranged on two sides of the power chassis and used for supporting a whole equipment platform and walking, the suspension system is suspended by adopting a Kreisti, the robot has high maneuverability and cross-country performance, the maximum obstacle crossing height reaches 300mm, and the mechanical arm and the power chassis are connected through a mechanical arm mounting flange; the platform is formed by welding high-strength thin steel plates and profiles, has the characteristics of high strength and low quality, and is used for mounting and supporting a power transmission box, a battery box, a heat dissipation system, a mechanical arm, a hydraulic system and vehicle-mounted controller parts; the walking motor adopts a high-power servo motor, has low speed and large torque and meets the walking function, the hydraulic pump station adopts a high-power motor to provide power for the hydraulic transmission of the mechanical arm, and the platform can realize fault self diagnosis and automatic control.
assignees: BEIJING ACADEMY OF SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle marine landing charging device and charging method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle on-sea boat charging device and a charging method, wherein the charging device comprises an unmanned ship body (5), a charging bin (4), a stopping platform (1) and a moving track are arranged on the unmanned ship body (5), a charging structure is arranged in the charging bin (4), the stopping platform (1) is movably arranged on the moving track, part of the moving track is positioned in the charging bin (4), and part of the moving track is positioned outside the charging bin (4), the moving track is used for moving and transporting the stopping platform (1) inside and outside the charging bin (4), the stopping platform (1) is a rotary platform capable of rotating 360 degrees on a plane where the stopping platform is positioned, and the stopping platform (1) is connected with a pose adjusting controller. Compared with the prior art, the invention can improve the efficiency of the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle in open sea operation, particularly maritime search and rescue operation, and expand the maritime application range of the multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG;INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INSTITUTE SHANGHAI TRAFFIC UNIV

title_en: Mine accident emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine accident emergency rescue robot, which relates to the field of emergency equipment and comprises a driving mechanism and an auxiliary mechanism, wherein the device is placed at a mine opening, an operator sends a signal to a data transceiver at a far end by using a remote controller, a driving motor drives a rotating shaft to rotate, the rotating shaft drives spiral blades at two ends of an installation joint to rotate in the same direction, so that the whole device flies under the driving of wind power of the spiral blades, the whole device can pass through a mine gap higher than the ground in a flying state and cannot move in the flying state, the rotating speed of the driving motor is reduced at a constant speed, the whole device can enable an anti-seismic mechanism to be in contact with the ground, when the anti-seismic mechanism is in contact with the ground, the bottom end of an adjusting wheel disc is simultaneously in contact with the ground, the adjusting wheel disc rotates integrally through angle adjustment of different performance, and is driven to rotate by, thereby driving the whole device to move on the ground of the mine accident.

title_en: Fire-fighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting rescue robot which comprises a mobile platform system, a fire hydrant system, a lifting platform system, a forklift system, a vehicle body system, a motor and wheels, wherein the vehicle body system is a base and is also an installation platform of the lifting platform system, the forklift system and the wheels, the lifting platform system is an installation platform of the motor and the mobile platform system, and the mobile platform system is an installation platform of the fire hydrant system. The walking and the turn of robot are controlled to the automobile body system, the forklift system is used for clearing up the barrier in the place ahead, the elevating platform system can control the lift of mobile station system, realize the height position control of fire hydrant system, the flexible of the steerable fire hydrant system of mobile station system, the fire hydrant system is used for putting out the conflagration, the terminal accessible multiunit electric jar combined control in forklift system the place ahead, realize the quick clearance of barrier, open a safe road for being rescued people.

title_en: Rescue equipment in narrow space and using method
abstract_en: The invention discloses rescue equipment in a narrow space and a using method thereof.A multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm is mounted at the top of a robot main body through a gear rack sliding mechanism, and a mechanical arm for carrying and moving trapped people is mounted at the tail end of the multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm; a steel wire lifting rope traction mechanism is installed at the top of the robot main body; the bottom of the robot main body is provided with a fixing mechanism through a push plate and a push plate sliding groove, and the fixing mechanism is matched with the multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm and the mechanical arm to adjust the posture of the front or rear limb of the trapped person to fix; the bottom of the robot main body is connected with a first section of trolley structure through a telescopic mechanism and is connected with a rescue trailer structure. The rescue robot can replace rescuers to go deep into a narrow space to independently perform rescue operation.

title_en: Urban homeless population assistance system, and monitoring method
abstract_en: An urban homeless population assistance system, and a monitoring method. The system comprises a data collection apparatus, a cloud management center, and a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the data collection apparatus is arranged on a road facility; the data collection apparatus comprises a photographic apparatus, a data processing apparatus and a wireless communication apparatus; the cloud management center comprises a wireless communication module, a data processing module and a storage module; and the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body (1), a wireless communication unit, a high-definition camera (2), a data processing unit and a storage module. The present invention can systematically manage the homeless population in a city, and determines, by means of activity routines, activity states, etc., whether the homeless population needs assistance; furthermore, since homeless people like to rest in some places that cannot be photographed by monitors, such as under overpasses, these regions can be photographed by means of a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, and whether homeless people need assistance is determined by means of photographed images, such that the efficiency of assistance is improved.
assignees: TANGSHAN HARBIN SHIP TECH CO LTD;TANGSHAN HYDRIENCE MARINE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire scene rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire scene rescue robot, wherein the front side and the rear side of a robot frame of the robot are respectively supported by a gravity center adjusting and buffering mechanism to form a high-pressure-resistant storage tank, the middle position of the bottom of the high-pressure-resistant storage tank is supported by an elastic supporting spring column at the middle position of the robot frame, a fire extinguishing and cooling agent is stored in the high-pressure-resistant storage tank, and one side or two sides of the high-pressure-resistant storage tank are also provided with a fire extinguishing and cooling agent injection head group which is communicated with the high-pressure-resistant storage tank and is used for injecting the fire extinguishing and cooling agent, so that fire extinguishing and cooling of a path during rescue can be realized by injecting the fire extinguishing and cooling agent, and meanwhile, the gravity center adjusting and buffering mechanism can adjust the gravity center of the robot, so that the robot can walk and prevent inclination, the reliability and stability of the posture of the robot during walking are ensured, and the robot is prevented from capsizing.

title_en: Remote unmanned aerial vehicle operating system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a remote unmanned aerial vehicle operating system, which comprises a control room of a tower, wherein the control room of the tower is connected with an unmanned aerial vehicle; unmanned aerial vehicle is including: the system comprises a GPS positioning system, a video monitoring system, a take-off and landing control system, an electric power monitoring system, an emergency alarm system, a central processing unit and an automatic driving system. The unmanned aerial vehicle has the advantages that the unmanned aerial vehicle has stronger search and rescue functions on people, and the lives of people are further guaranteed.
assignees: SHAANXI HOUKAI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Drones equipped with multi-adapters
title_ko: 멀티 어댑터를 구비하는 드론
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a drone with multi-adapters, which comprises: a detachable frame including a body fixing panel mounted on a drone body, a first connection panel detachably coupled to the body fixing panel, a vibration reducing member coupled to both sides of the first connection panel, and a detachable means for attaching and detaching the first connection panel to the body fixing panel; a multi-adapter which performs at least one function of an advertisement function, a delivery function, a distress search function, a relief function, a weather observation function, a traffic control function, and a construction monitoring function even during the flight of the drone; and a tilt frame which is connected to the first connection panel and the vibration reducing member, and includes a drive housing with a connector block configured therein to be connected to a control unit, an X-axis driving unit configured inside the drive housing and connected to the multi-adapter at a lower end to rotate the multi-adapter in an X-axis direction, and a Y-axis driving means for rotating the multi-adapter in a Y-axis direction.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 멀티 어댑터를 구비하는 드론에 관한 것으로, 드론본체에 장착되는 본체 고정패널과, 상기 본체 고정패널에 탈착 가능하게 결합되는 제1연결패널과, 상기 제1연결패널의 양측부에 결합되는 진동 저감부재와, 상기 제1연결패널을 상기 본체 고정패널에 탈착시키는 탈착수단을 포함하는 탈착 프레임; 드론의 비행 중에도 광고 기능, 배송 기능, 조난수색 기능, 구호 기능, 기상관측 기능, 교통단속 기능, 건설감시 기능 중 적어도 하나 이상의 기능을 수행하는 멀티 어댑터; 및 상기 제1연결패널 및 진동 저감부재와 연결되고, 내부에 제어부와 연결되는 커넥터 블록이 구성된 구동 하우징과, 상기 구동 하우징의 내부에 구성되며, 하단부가 상기 멀티 어댑터와 연결되어 상기 멀티 어댑터를 X축 방향으로 회전시키는 X축 구동부와, 상기 멀티 어댑터를 Y축 방향으로 회전시키는 Y축 구동수단을 포함하는 틸트 프레임;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Search method and search system using profiling technique and drone
title_ko: 프로파일링 기법 및 드론을 이용한 찾기 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a search method and a search system using a profiling technique and a drone. The search system using a profiling technique and a drone comprises: a search server which receives a search report to receive search target information and search site information; a profiling server which stores the search target information, the search site information, and a plurality of pieces of related profiling information, analyzes behavior types of the search target based on the plurality of pieces of profiling information, the search target information, and the search site information, and calculates a plurality of moving paths and a plurality of search candidate sites of the search target; and a flight control server which calculates a plurality of flight paths based on the plurality of moving paths and the plurality of search candidate sites calculated by the profiling server, and controls a plurality of first drones to fly along the plurality of flight paths, thereby searching the search sites. The present invention is able to rapidly and systematically search for a search target.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 프로파일링 기법 및 드론을 이용한 찾기 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 수식신고를 접수하여 수색 대상자 정보 및 수색 현장 정보를 수신하는 수색 서버; 상기 수색 대상자 정보 및 상기 수색 현장 정보와 관련된 복수의 프로파일링 정보를 저장하고, 상기 복수의 프로파일링 정보, 상기 수색 대상자 정보, 및 상기 수색 현장 정보에 기초하여 수색 대상자의 행동유형을 분석함으로써 수색 대상자의 복수의 이동경로 및 복수의 수색 후보지를 산출하는 프로파일링 서버; 및 상기 프로파일링 서버에 의해 산출된 수색 대상자의 복수의 이동경로 및 복수의 수색 후보지에 기초하여 복수의 비행경로를 산출하고, 상기 복수의 비행경로를 따라 비행하도록 복수의 제1 드론을 제어함으로써 수색 현장을 수색하는 비행 관제 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Disaster relief robot control system and method
title_ko: 재난 구조 로봇 제어시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster rescue robot control system and a method thereof. The disaster rescue robot control system comprises: a slave arm of multiple degrees of freedom which is installed on a disaster rescue robot, and performs restoration and rescue operations in a disaster environment; a master arm to receive an operation command of a worker; a control unit linked to an operation of the master arm to control an operation of the slave arm; and an operation limiting unit to limit an operation of the master arm based on an operating area of the slave arm to allow an instruction of the master arm to be generated in the operating area of the slave arm. The slave is operated based on an operation applied to the master arm to perform restoration and rescue operations in a disaster environment. Even if the operating area of the slave arm and an instruction area of the master arm do not match each other, an instruction of the master arm can be limited to be prevented from being generated outside the operating area of the slave arm.
abstract_ko: 재난 구조 로봇 제어시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 재난 구조 로봇에 설치되고, 재난 환경에서 복구 및 구조 동작을 수행하는 다자유도의 슬레이브암, 작업자의 조작명령을 입력받는 마스터암, 상기 마스터암의 동작에 연동해서 상기 슬레이브암의 동작을 제어하는 제어부 및 상기 마스터암의 지령이 상기 슬레이브암의 동작영역 내부에서 발생하도록, 상기 슬레이브암의 동작영역을 기준으로 상기 마스터암의 동작을 제한하는 동작 제한부를 포함하는 구성을 마련하여, 마스터암에 가해지는 조작에 기초해서 슬레이브암을 동작시켜 재난 환경에서 복구 및 구조 동작을 수행하고, 슬레이브암의 동작영역과 마스터암의 지령영역이 서로 불일치하더라도 마스터암의 지령이 슬레이브암의 동작영역 외부에 생성되지 않도록 제한할 수 있다.

title_en: Disaster relief robot control system and cross over operation method
title_ko: 재난 구조 로봇 제어시스템 및 그의 교차 운전 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster rescue robot control system. The disaster rescue robot control system includes: a plurality of disaster rescue robots dispatched to a disaster environment to perform restoration and rescue operations; and a control server identifying a disaster site situation through communication with each of the disaster rescue robots and integratively controlling the restoration and rescue operations. A robot control part controlling the operation of the disaster rescue robots is formed to set priority so as to drive the disaster rescue robots by crossing manual driving or remote driving, and control the disaster rescue robots so as to drive the disaster rescue robots by crossing remote driving or manual driving based on request signals of a riding operator and a remote operator and the set priority, thereby changing a control right of the disaster rescue robots by determining intentions of the riding operator and the remote operator in a complex disaster situation by setting priority over remote driving and manual driving, and changing a determination basis of the remote operator for determining a drivable state of the riding operator and a control right in accordance with the same in case of an emergency such as an injury or death of the riding operator.
abstract_ko: 재난 구조 로봇 제어시스템에 관한 것으로, 재난 환경에 투입되어 복구 및 구조 동작을 수행하는 복수의 재난 구조 로봇 및 각 재난 구조 로봇과의 통신을 통해 재난 현장 상황을 파악하고 복구 및 구조 동작을 통합적으로 관제하는 관제서버를 포함하고, 상기 재난 구조 로봇의 구동을 제어하는 로봇 제어부는 상기 재난 구조 로봇을 수동 운전 또는 원격 운전을 교차해서 운전하도록 우선 순위를 설정하며, 탑승 조작자와 원격 조작자의 의뢰 신호와 설정된 우선 순위에 기초해서 원격 운전 및 수동 운전을 교차해서 운전하도록 제어하는 구성을 마련하여, 원격 및 수동 운전에 대한 우선순위를 설정하여 복합 재난 상황에서 탑승 조작자와 원격 조작자의 의도를 판단해서 재난 구조 로봇의 제어 권한을 변경할 수 있고, 탑승 조작자의 부상 또는 사망과 같은 응급 상황에서 탑승 조작자의 운전 가능 상태를 판단하기 위한 원격 조작자의 판단 근거와 그에 따른 제어 권한 변경이 가능하다.
assignees: KOREA INST ROBOT & CONVERGENCE;NAT UNIV PUKYONG IND UNIV COOP FOUND

title_en: Ship containing search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ships, in particular to a ship containing a search and rescue robot. The invention solves the problem that the bottom end of the search and rescue robot is not provided with a fixing mechanism, improves the overall stability of the robot by arranging the fixing mechanism, effectively avoids the search and rescue robot from toppling over, thereby reducing the occurrence of safety accidents, greatly improving the overall practicability of the device, and solving the problem of inconvenient rope length limitation.
assignees: FUZHOU JIANJINJIAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Small-sized traversing robot based on arm-carried vision
abstract_en: The invention relates to a small-sized traversing robot based on arm-mounted vision, which comprises a robot main body, a control unit, eight arm-foot walking modules and a drawing transmission module, wherein each arm-foot walking module comprises three motion shafts, a buffer rubber pad, a vision module and an omnidirectional wheel, the eight arm-foot walking modules are all arranged on a robot body, the tail end of each arm-foot walking module is provided with the omnidirectional wheel, the inner side of each arm-foot walking module is provided with the vision module, the vision module collects the surrounding environment information of the robot, and the drawing transmission module transmits the environment information collected by the robot. The invention can realize biped, quadruped and hexapod moving modes and wheel and rolling moving modes, and can realize binocular, trinocular and hexaocular vision to collect image information by carrying the vision module. The whole unique arm-foot walking module structure design is combined with the vision module to realize that the robot can feel the surrounding environment to move in an all-around and autonomous manner. The invention has the characteristics of reasonable structure, small volume, light weight, flexible movement, stability, reliability and the like, and can be popularized and applied to search and rescue tasks in complex environments.
assignees: TIANJIN UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY AND EDUCATION CHINA VOCATIONAL TRAINING INSTRUCTOR TRAINING CENTER;TIANJIN BONUO INTELLIGENT CREATIVE ROBOTICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Robot device for underwater lifesaving
abstract_en: The utility model provides a robot device of lifesaving under water belongs to the robot technical field. The underwater robot solves the technical problems that the existing robot cannot realize underwater lifesaving and the like. The robot device comprises a lifesaving tube, wherein the rear end of the lifesaving tube is provided with a propeller, and two sides of the lifesaving tube close to the rear end are provided with horizontal wings; the middle part of the lifesaving tube is provided with a closed lifesaving cabin, independent transition cabins are arranged in the lifesaving tube close to the upper, lower, left and right sides and the front side, and a channel between each transition cabin and the lifesaving cabin is closed or communicated through an independent cabin door I; each transition cabin is internally provided with a drainage pump and an air inlet valve; each transition cabin is provided with a cabin door II communicated with the outside of the lifesaving cylinder; the second cabin door can be opened through external manual operation or automatically opened through an electric control system; each transition cabin is internally provided with a mechanical grabbing mechanism which can extend out of the transition cabin; cameras are arranged around the lifesaving tube. The utility model provides a robot device can carry out personnel search and rescue work, high-efficient accurate in effectual aquatic.

title_en: Disaster rescue robot
title_ko: 재난 구조 로봇
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster rescue robot capable of exchanging a tool through a robot arm, which comprises: an armored car; a tool tray installed on a front side of the armored car and storing the multiple working tools; and the robot arm installed adjacent to the tool tray in the armored car and enabling at least one type of the tool to be mounted in the tool tray to perform required work. The robot arm comprises a gripper which grips the tool and is provided to one end.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 로봇팔로 툴 교체가 가능한 재난 구조 로봇에 관한 것으로써, 장갑차량; 상기 장갑차량 전방에 설치되고, 여러 개의 작업용 툴을 수용하는 툴 트레이; 및 상기 장갑차량에서 상기 툴 트레이와 인접한 곳에 설치되고 상기 툴 트레이에서 적어도 한 종류의 상기 툴을 장착하여 필요한 작업을 수행하는 로봇팔; 를 포함하고, 상기 로봇팔은 일단에 상기 툴을 그리핑하는 그리퍼를 구비하는 재난 구조 로봇을 제공한다.

title_en: Disaster relief robot including working arm
title_ko: 작업용 암을 구비하는 재난구조로봇
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster relief robot including working arm, which enables self-driving in a wireless signal disconnection section for responding to a situation at a disaster site, enables work in a high temperature environment such as a fire, comprises a heterogeneous walking means to improve ability to break through obstacles, and comprises a robot arm capable of various kinds or work to improve ability to handle the situation at the disaster site.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난현장의 상황에 대응할 수 있도록 하기 위한 무선신호 단절구간에서 자가운행이 가능하며, 화재와 같은 고열환경에서 작업이 가능하도록 함과 아울러, 이종 보행수단을 구비하도록 하여 장애물 돌파 능력을 향상시키고, 다양한 작업이 가능한 로봇암을 구비하여 재난현장의 상황대처 증력을 향상시킨 작업용 암을 구비하는 재난구조로봇에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Soft robot arm and control system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soft robot arm, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The soft robot arm comprises an inner flexible supporting piece, a first outer supporting piece, a second outer supporting piece and a third outer supporting piece, a plurality of first outer supporting pieces are sleeved outside the inner flexible supporting piece, the first outer supporting pieces are arranged at intervals along the length direction of the inner flexible supporting piece, two adjacent first outer supporting pieces are connected through at least three second outer supporting pieces, each first outer supporting piece is connected with the inner flexible supporting piece through at least two third outer supporting pieces, and at least one telescopic piece made of a memory alloy material is arranged on each second outer supporting piece and each third outer supporting piece. The invention also discloses a control system of the soft robot arm. The invention can generate motion with infinite freedom degree, can be suitable for occasions such as geological exploration, underwater search and rescue or obstacle clearing in the military field, and has wide application prospect.
assignees: NINGBO INST MATERIALS TECH & ENG CAS

title_en: Flood rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood rescue robot which comprises a hull system, rescue systems and driving systems, wherein the hull system is a main body part of the robot, the two rescue systems are arranged at two ends of the hull system, the two driving systems are arranged at the bottom of the hull system, a steering structure is arranged on the hull system, the rescue systems have enough freedom degree and can reach the vicinity of rescuers, anti-skidding pads are arranged on the crawling ladder and can skid in water, when the arm strength of the rescuers is insufficient or the rescuers are out of force, the rescue systems can directly lift the rescuers, the crawling ladder is further arranged on the side face of the hull system, all-directional rescue is realized, and a protection device is arranged outside an impeller of the driving systems to prevent the rescuers from being injured.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system based on the Internet of things, which comprises a ground control station, a communication platform, a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and a plurality of groups of detection unmanned aerial vehicles, wherein the ground control station is connected with the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and the plurality of groups of detection unmanned aerial vehicles through the communication platform; the communication platform: the system is used for receiving data fed back by the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and the detection unmanned aerial vehicle and sending control instructions of the ground control station to the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and the detection unmanned aerial vehicle; the unmanned aerial vehicle is detected: the system is used for detecting the position of the trapped person, environment data and person identity information. The unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system based on the Internet of things can be directly communicated with personnel in a ground control station, so that the search and rescue personnel can know the situation conveniently, the search and rescue personnel can carry out self-test by matching with a physical sign detection terminal, the search and rescue personnel can prepare rescue goods and materials conveniently, and the rescue beacon machine is put in, so that the rescue personnel can know the position of trapped personnel conveniently at any time, the rescue efficiency is improved, and a better use prospect is brought.
assignees: ANHUI WONDER UNIV OF INFORMATION ENGINEERING

title_en: Toxic gas detection and disaster area fire source detection rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a poison gas detects and disaster area fire source detection rescue robot, including the robot, the lateral wall of robot is fixed with the first backup pad that the symmetry set up, first recess has been seted up to the top lateral wall of first backup pad, the bottom lateral wall sliding connection of first recess has first slide and second slide, set up on first slide and the second slide about running through the screw hole, the second recess has been seted up to one side lateral wall of first recess, the inside of second recess is fixed with driving motor, driving motor's output shaft is fixed with the connecting axle through the shaft coupling, the connecting axle is kept away from driving motor's one end and is passed the screw hole and rotate with first recess lateral wall and be connected, the lateral wall setscrew of connecting axle. The utility model discloses can protect rescue robot when rainy day uses, avoid long-time drenching with the rain to detect the rescue, improve security and practicality, also improve the life of robot simultaneously.

title_en: Helix mobility model construction method based on SDN
abstract_en: The invention provides a helix mobility model construction method based on an SDN (software defined network), which is used for solving the problems of uneven track and inaccurate coverage of the existing model in search and rescue scenes. The scheme comprises the following steps: 1) constructing an application layer including a search and rescue control center and a field command vehicle, and commanding search and rescue teams to enter a disaster area; 2) the method comprises the steps that a control layer is built to collect emergency events occurring in a scene, the emergency events are calibrated and sequenced, and then a target area search list is generated according to an event sequence; 3) generating unmanned aerial vehicle movement track data according to an area search list provided by a control layer, and establishing a data layer; 4) and the application layer, the control layer and the data layer jointly form a spiral line mobility model based on the SDN, and the model is utilized to complete coverage of a disaster area. The invention realizes the accurate search of the target area while ensuring the flight track smoothness; the system can be used for searching and rescuing victims in disaster scenes and provides temporary aerial base stations for the victims.

title_en: A warning calling device for unmanned aerial vehicle control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of alarm calling devices and discloses an alarm calling device for unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring. This an alarm calling device for unmanned aerial vehicle control, the mounting box is protected by the shock attenuation pole, make the calling equipment of installing in the mounting box safer, the shock pad can be better protects calling equipment in the cooperation, make calling equipment safer, even receive the impact, also can reduce the damage that calling equipment in the mounting box received, in order to guarantee that calling equipment can normally send alarm calling signal, and then can more effectually send alarm calling signal, so that search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, and even unmanned aerial vehicle leads to the calling equipment outage because the accident appears, make the more effectual transmission that call calling alarm signal can be better go out.

title_en: Rescue robot based on small-bore deep well
abstract_en: The invention provides a rescue robot based on a small-bore deep well, which relates to the technical field of robots and comprises a connecting block, a grabbing mechanism and an auxiliary mechanism, wherein reinforcing rods are arranged at the corners of a cross rod and the connecting block, a fixing sleeve is fixedly connected onto the reinforcing rods, a supporting rod is fixedly connected to the bottom of the fixing sleeve, a rotating block is rotatably connected to the bottom of the supporting rod, a turntable is fixedly connected onto the supporting rod, an air cylinder is fixedly connected to the bottom of the turntable, a connecting ball is arranged at the output end of the air cylinder, a sliding rail is arranged on the outer side of an arc-shaped clamping plate, and the connecting ball is movably connected in the sliding rail, can provide assistance for trapped people by adjusting the height of the floating plate, enhance the safety of the trapped people and improve the success rate of rescue.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which is convenient for the first-aid kit to be quickly hung and put in, saves labor when hanging and putting in, consumes less time for rescue, is convenient to use, has higher practicability, and meanwhile, the first-aid kit is not easy to be extruded in the descending process of the unmanned aerial vehicle, has better protection performance to the first-aid kit and higher use reliability, comprises a machine body, a camera and the first-aid kit, the camera fixed mounting is on the lateral wall of organism, the equal fixedly connected with backup pad of bottom front side and bottom rear side of organism, two the one end left side that the backup pad is close to each other and the one end right side that is close to each other all rotate and be connected with the support frame, two the equal fixedly connected with extension spring of one end front side that is close to each other and the one end rear side that is close to each other of support frame, the equal fixedly connected with dwang in top of two support frames, two the dwang all is connected with the push-and-pull rod through the axis of rotation.

title_en: Underground rescue robot based on bidirectional interaction technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground rescue robot based on a bidirectional interaction technology, which belongs to the technical field of robots, and the scheme is characterized in that an induced draft fan is started to introduce external air into an airflow conduction hole, partial sodium peroxide powder is carried under the action of atmospheric pressure and blown into a lens installation groove, on one hand, a large amount of heat can be generated by the reaction of sodium peroxide and water vapor in the air, and on the other hand, water drops on the surface of an external heat insulation envelope can be dried by the flowing of wind, so that dust on the surface of the envelope is promoted to fall off, on the other hand, the underground oxygen content can be improved by the oxygen generated in the reaction process, so that oxygen is provided for underground trapped people, on the other hand, a corrugated air bag can be promoted to expand by the heat generated in the reaction process, an extrusion push plate is pushed to extrude the sodium peroxide powder, so that the efficiency of the sodium peroxide powder brought out by the wind, thereby improving the cleaning efficiency of the surface of the external heat insulation coating.

title_en: Rescue robot with variable-diameter wheels
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue robot with variable-diameter wheels, which comprises a frame and a variable-diameter wheel mechanism arranged on the frame, wherein the variable-diameter wheel mechanism comprises a wheel body and a wheel body; the reducing wheel mechanism comprises a hollow shaft cylinder, a fixed frame fixedly connected to the inner side end of the hollow shaft cylinder, a movable frame movably sleeved on the hollow shaft cylinder, a driving mechanism installed in the inner cavity of the hollow shaft cylinder and used for driving the movable frame to move axially on the hollow shaft cylinder, a variable-diameter wheel wing unit installed on the fixed frame and the movable frame and radially arranged along wheels, a main motor installed on a frame and used for driving the wheels to rotate, and a rotating connection mechanism used for connecting an output shaft of the main motor and the fixed frame on the hollow shaft cylinder. The invention can adapt to outdoor rescue activities, and when the complex roadblock environment after disaster is faced, the wheel diameter can be changed along with the environment difference, thereby ensuring that the searching robot can rapidly and effectively cross the heavy obstacle and successfully complete the searching and rescuing task.
assignees: TIANJIN UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY AND EDUCATION CHINA VOCATIONAL TRAINING INSTRUCTOR TRAINING CENTER

title_en: System and method for multidimensional gradient-based cross-spectral stereo matching
abstract_en: A hardware system is configured for, and a method of, generating detail-rich gradient-based disparity maps in real-time using an automated gradient-based disparity map classification process that is scalable, can be used under different environment conditions with little to no restrictions, and whose level of precision can be adjusted in a scalable manner. Highly accurate cross-spectral stereo matching methods may be used for search and rescue operations and work at day time and night time using current and past visual and full infrared imaging to generate, classify, and identify scenes in real-time with minimum constraints. Such system and methods may be used to improve operations of existing search and rescue equipment.

title_en: Expansion rescue device for water surface rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting equipment, specifically be a surface of water rescue robot is with extending rescue device. Comprises an expanding buoy and an automatic rope coiling disc; the main body of the expanding buoy is spindle-shaped, wherein the front section of the bottom of the expanding buoy is V-shaped; the expansion buoy is provided with a plurality of handles for being held by rescuers; rope connecting holes are formed in the head and the tail of the expanding buoy; the automatic rope winding disc can wind and unwind a floating rope preset on the automatic rope winding disc, one end of the floating rope is connected with the automatic rope winding disc, and the other end of the floating rope is connected with a rope connecting hole for expanding the head of the floating rope; the automatic rope winding disc is fixedly arranged on the water surface rescue robot; the rope connecting hole at the tail part of the expansion buoy is detachably connected with the water surface rescue robot through a detachable connecting device. The utility model discloses can infinitely extend surface of water rescue robot's rescue ability, increase rescue efficiency, the mechanism is simple, the simple operation.
assignees: PINGHU CHENGSHI ROBOT CO LTD;SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Shipborne unmanned aerial vehicle charging platform and charging method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a shipborne unmanned aerial vehicle charging platform and a charging method. The shipborne unmanned aerial vehicle charging platform comprises a landing platform, a charging module and a controller; the charging module comprises an outer barrel and a wireless charging assembly arranged in the outer barrel, wherein a plurality of guide grooves are formed in the outer barrel, and a plurality of bulges which are in sliding fit with the guide grooves are uniformly distributed at positions, close to the bottom end, on the outer side surface of the wireless charging assembly; the driving component of the charging module can drive the wireless charging component to ascend to the outside of the outer barrel or retract into the outer barrel under the guidance of the guide groove; when the wireless subassembly that charges rises to the urceolus outside, the wireless subassembly that charges docks with unmanned aerial vehicle's battery, realizes charging to the unmanned aerial vehicle battery. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle charging platform is arranged on the offshore platform or the ship deck, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle for performing offshore flight tasks can be charged in time when needing to be charged, and the applicability of the unmanned aerial vehicle in offshore monitoring or search and rescue is greatly improved.

title_en: Drowned rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a drowning rescue robot, which comprises a power impeller mechanism, a carrier air bag mechanism, a cable communication mechanism, an upper suspension mechanism, a lower suspension mechanism, a bridging support mechanism and a flying wing balance mechanism, wherein the power impeller mechanism can carry out sufficient floating support after approaching a drowner so as to ensure that the drowner can bear the gravity of floating on the water surface, the carrier air bag mechanism is used for the drowner to lie over on an air bag so as to ensure smooth respiration, the cable communication mechanism is in signal communication with a controlled person and can remotely control the robot so as to ensure the position and the state of the drowned person, the upper suspension mechanism and the lower suspension mechanism are connection devices of an uplink aircraft and a downlink rescue mechanism and can be accurately put in the drowned position, the bridging support mechanism is used for constructing and connecting a carrier for the aircraft, the flying wing balance mechanism provides mechanical energy for flying, so that the flying mechanism can drive the whole device to fly in the air and can change the direction, the invention can realize holographic operation control, accurately release the rescue mechanism and remotely transmit position signals.

title_en: Coal mine rescue robot and obstacle avoidance method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine rescue robot and an obstacle avoidance method thereof, belongs to the technical field of coal mine rescue, and comprises a binocular vision system, an ultrasonic ranging system, an information acquisition system and a coal mine rescue robot body. The coal mine rescue robot body is respectively connected with the ultrasonic ranging system, the binocular vision system and the information acquisition system; the information acquisition system is used for acquiring gas quality information of a coal mine; the coal mine rescue robot body detects obstacles around the coal mine rescue robot according to the obstacle visual information acquired by the binocular visual system and the obstacle distance information acquired by the ultrasonic ranging system to realize real-time obstacle avoidance, and simultaneously stores the acquired gas quality information in the coal mine rescue robot body. The invention overcomes the dead angle effect of the binocular vision system by assisting the ultrasonic ranging system on the basis of the binocular vision system, so that the coal mine rescue robot can carry out accurate path planning in the blind area of the binocular vision system.
assignees: DAOHE YONGSHENG BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic cooling intelligent manufacturing device for fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of special robots and discloses an automatic cooling intelligent manufacturing device for a fire-fighting rescue robot, which comprises a shell, wherein a rotating wheel is movably connected inside the shell, and the surface of the rotating wheel is provided with a first sliding groove; through the runner, spout one, spout two, the slide rail, position detecting element, photosensitive element, the slide, the movable block, hide the dog, accept the board, a supporting bench, the coil, the electro-magnet, the water spray board, the electromagnetic pump, under the interact between the jar body, can make fire-fighting robot can both keep the working property of preferred all the time, just so can accelerate the speed of rescue and improve the work efficiency of rescue in the rescue of actual conflagration, also can accelerate the process of rescue in the scene of a fire of "life is exactly the time" simultaneously, just can accomplish rescue work and the work of putting out a fire in the initial stage that the conflagration took place, this device also accords with the intelligent development theory of making that the country proposed simultaneously.
assignees: HANGZHOU KONG FAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ice surface intelligent rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ice surface intelligent rescue robot which comprises a vehicle body, crawler wheels are symmetrically arranged on the front and back of the lower side of the vehicle body, ice claw cavities are symmetrically arranged on the left and right sides of each crawler wheel, ice claw assemblies are arranged in the ice claw cavities, each ice claw assembly comprises a dovetail sliding groove communicated with the outer side end wall of each ice claw cavity, a dovetail sliding block connected with the upper end wall of each dovetail sliding groove through a dovetail groove spring is arranged in each dovetail sliding groove in a sliding mode, the rescue robot is driven to a trapped person area, ice claws slide downwards to grasp an ice surface, when the ice claw is cracked on the ice surface and falls into water, a lower side screw rotates to keep the rescue robot balanced, a clamping device slides downwards to clamp trapped persons, and the trapped persons are lifted upwards to the upper side of the rescue robot.

title_en: Complex environment high-mobility mooring type high-rise fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire fighting, in particular to a mooring type high-rise fire-fighting rescue robot with high maneuverability and a complex environment, and solves the technical problems that an existing robot is potential safety hazard, inconvenient to move, incapable of timely reaching, and prone to irregular winding and knotting of electric wires. Comprises a vehicle body, wherein the vehicle body comprises a chassis and a vehicle cabin; the chassis is provided with a brushless motor and a battery, the chassis is provided with a differential, a spherical connecting rod on the side surface of the differential is in transmission connection with a tire connecting shaft, the damping device is provided with a connecting plate, a hydraulic spring device and a connecting rod, and the upper ends of the hydraulic spring and the connecting rod are connected with the connecting plate; the lower end of the hydraulic spring device is connected with a long connecting rod, the chassis is provided with a tire and a tire connecting shaft, the lower end of the connecting rod is connected with the tire connecting shaft, and the long connecting rod is connected with the tire connecting shaft; the tire connecting shaft is connected with the tire, is simple to operate, convenient to use and suitable for various places.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises a camera shooting mechanism and a cleaning mechanism, wherein the camera shooting mechanism comprises an adjusting motor, a belt pulley, a threaded ring, a threaded rod, a protective shell, a glass plate, a fixed plate and a camera, the belt pulley is fixedly connected to an output shaft of the adjusting motor, the belt pulley is in belt transmission with the threaded ring, the threaded ring is in thread transmission with the threaded rod, the threaded rod is in sliding connection with the protective shell, the glass plate is arranged on the protective shell, the fixed plate is fixedly connected to the bottom end of the threaded rod, the fixed plate is in sliding connection with the protective shell, the camera is rotatably connected to the fixed plate, the cleaning mechanism comprises a.
assignees: ZHEJIANG KETE GEOGRAPHIC INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Device for automatically starting search and rescue signal after unmanned aerial vehicle is out of control
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle devices, in particular to a device for automatically starting a search and rescue signal after an unmanned aerial vehicle is out of control, which comprises an outer shell, wherein a first trigger mechanism is fixed in the outer shell, a base is fixed on the first trigger mechanism, an external hole is arranged on the base, an internal hole is arranged in the external hole, a second trigger mechanism is arranged in the external hole and the internal hole, the first trigger mechanism is electrically connected with the second trigger mechanism, a chute communicated with the internal hole is arranged on the base, a third trigger mechanism is arranged in the chute, the second trigger mechanism is connected with the third trigger mechanism in a clamping way, a buzzer and a flash lamp are fixed on the outer shell, a battery electrically connected with the first trigger mechanism, the second trigger mechanism, the third trigger mechanism, the buzzer and the flash lamp is arranged on the base, the utility model discloses can the signals after unmanned aerial vehicle is out of control, be convenient for search, have extensive application prospect in unmanned aerial vehicle device technical field.
assignees: ZHONGJIAN GUOXIN PROSPECTING PLAN CO LTD

title_en: Fire rescue robot, rescue assisting system and communication method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire rescue robot, a rescue assisting system and a communication method thereof, wherein the robot comprises: the motion power subsystem is used for driving the fire rescue robot to move; the identification positioning subsystem is used for acquiring indoor fire scene images by using a binocular camera and then drawing a fire scene three-dimensional map according to stereoscopic vision matching; the safety detection subsystem is used for combining information obtained by detection of various sensors with the identification and positioning subsystem, detecting toxic smoke on site and dividing the area attribute of the site area; the path navigation subsystem is used for selecting/updating an optimal rescue path in real time by using an optimized particle swarm algorithm on a fire scene; and the first information processing subsystem is used for acquiring or receiving the data sent by each subsystem, and obtaining corresponding processing result data after operation processing. The invention can be used for rescuing on the fire scene, improves the rescue efficiency and reduces unnecessary casualties.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle with personnel search and rescue positioner
abstract_en: The utility model provides an unmanned aerial vehicle with personnel search and rescue positioning device, which comprises a machine body and the personnel search and rescue positioning device, wherein the personnel search and rescue positioning device is fixed on the machine body and comprises five infrared thermal imaging cameras which are all arranged at the bottom of the machine body, wherein, the first infrared thermal imaging camera is arranged in the middle of the bottom of the machine body, the second infrared thermal imaging camera, the third infrared thermal imaging camera, the fourth infrared thermal imaging camera and the fifth infrared thermal imaging camera are arranged around the periphery of the first infrared thermal imaging camera, and the imaging range of any one of the second infrared thermal imaging camera, the third infrared thermal imaging camera, the fourth infrared thermal imaging camera and the fifth infrared thermal imaging camera is partially overlapped with the imaging range of the first infrared thermal imaging camera. The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle with personnel search and rescue positioner can increase the detection scope, improves the detection degree of accuracy.
assignees: SUZHOU BOXUAN YUHUI ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent rescue robot and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent rescue robot and a working method thereof, wherein the intelligent rescue robot comprises a walking mechanism, a bottom plate is arranged on the walking mechanism, and a first-aid device, a plurality of cutting devices and a rope releasing device are respectively arranged on the bottom plate; the first-aid device comprises a first-aid kit, first-aid articles are placed in the first-aid kit, a fire extinguisher is further arranged in the first-aid kit, an electromagnetic valve is arranged on a pipeline of the fire extinguisher, and a placing rack for placing the pipeline is arranged at the top of the first-aid kit; the cutting device comprises a rotary table, the rotary table is driven by a motor, a lifting rod is arranged on the upper surface of the rotary table, a fixed block is arranged on a piston rod of the lifting rod, a telescopic rod is transversely arranged on the fixed block, and a cutting machine is arranged at the front end of the telescopic rod. According to the invention, the cutting device is arranged, so that the anti-theft window can be cut and broken, and the possibility of escaping from the anti-theft window can be provided for indoor personnel when a fire disaster happens; through setting up the rope releasing device, can provide the rope of fleing of metal material for the personnel of fleing from the burglary-resisting window, increaseed indoor personnel's survival probability when taking place the conflagration.
assignees: MAHU INTELLIGENT TECH SUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Fire rescue robot and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire rescue robot and a working method thereof, belonging to the technical field of robots and comprising a main robot controlled by a control terminal, wherein a group of sub-robots are arranged in the main robot, the sub-robots comprise a first robot, a second robot and an … … N robot, the first robot is used for rescuing at a fire scene, the second robot is used for inactivating at the fire scene, the third robot is used for exhausting smoke … … at the fire scene, the N robot is used for performing other auxiliary operations at the fire scene, the main robot and the sub-robots perform fire rescue operations at the fire scene simultaneously, and the sub-robots automatically enter the main robot for resetting and standby after completing the fire rescue operations. This kind of fire rescue robot is furnished with a plurality of sub-robots in the main robot, can assign a plurality of sub-robots and carry out the fire rescue operation simultaneously, can effectively improve the fire rescue efficiency of robot.

title_en: Rescue unmanned aerial vehicle with search and rescue function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle with search and rescue function, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a wireless transmission device, a hollow support plate, an infrared imager, a camera, a distance measuring sensor, a support frame, universal wheels, a spring, a rope, a first-aid kit, a lock catch and a positioner; wireless transmission device installs unmanned aerial vehicle body top, hollow backup pad is installed unmanned aerial vehicle body below, infrared imaging appearance is installed hollow backup pad right side below, the camera is installed hollow backup pad left side below, the support frame is fixed hollow backup pad four corners, the universal wheel passes through the spring mounting is in the support frame bottom, the rope is fixed hollow backup pad bottom, the first-aid kit is fixed the rope bottom, the locator is installed the first-aid kit front end. The utility model discloses simple structure can carry out the life and explore and search, puts in urgent medicine and food, has better protection shock-absorbing function.
assignees: SHANXI NEW AIRSPACE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Articulated crawler motion chassis of coal mine search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an articulated crawler movement chassis of a coal mine search and rescue robot, which comprises a front end rotating shell, a rear end rotating shell, a middle main body part, a middle swinging part, crawlers at the left side and the right side, guide wheels and driving wheels, wherein the front end rotating shell is connected with the front end rotating shell; the front end rotating shell and the rear end rotating shell are connected with the middle main body part through rotating joints, the relevant joint motors are installed at the rotating joints, the left middle main body part and the right middle main body part are connected through the middle swinging part, and the left crawler belt and the right crawler belt are tensioned through the belt pressing device. The crawler movement chassis has strong obstacle crossing performance and single-side obstacle crossing capability, can overcome complex environments after underground disasters, is three-section, and has the advantages that when encountering an obstacle, the front-end rotating shell and the rear-end rotating shell serve as swing arms to assist in obstacle crossing, and when encountering the obstacle on one side of the chassis, the middle main bodies of the left part and the right part of the chassis can swing around the middle connecting shaft, so that the chassis keeps stable in obstacle crossing, and the crawler movement chassis has strong application value for complex rescue environments after underground disasters of a coal mine.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle lighting mechanism searches for ands rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lighting mechanism of a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which relates to the technical field of search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicles and comprises a fixed plate, wherein a driving mechanism is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the fixed plate, a mounting mechanism is fixedly arranged on the bottom surface of the fixed plate, and an adjusting mechanism is fixedly arranged below the mounting mechanism. This search for and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle lighting mechanism, rotation drive gear two through servo motor two rotates, gear two drives gear one and rotates, it carries out the regulation of direction to drive every searchlight lamp body, flexible through the flexible end of electric putter, it carries out the regulation of angle to drive every searchlight lamp body, anticlockwise rotation through servo motor three, drive two movable plates through gear three and carry out opposite direction synchronous motion, it drives the searchlight lamp body that removes the intermediate position and uses the bulb to rotate as the centre of a circle to stir every regulation post, the angle that the searchlight lamp body that is close to more the border position was adjusted is big more, make the irradiation range increase of searchlight lamp body, the irradiation range is adjusted according to the demand better.

title_en: Water-air integrated search and rescue system and method
abstract_en: A water-air integrated search and rescue system includes a flight power module, a navigation power module, a plurality of biomimetic unmanned boats, a drone, and an integrated control module. The integrated control module is configured to acquire weather information and determine whether to send a flight signal to the flight power module or to send a navigation signal to the navigation power module based on the weather information; the flight power module is configured to fly the drone to a search and rescue region after receiving the flight signal; the navigation power module is configured to navigate the drone to the search and rescue region after receiving the navigation signal; the integrated control module is further configured to control the drone to deploy the plurality of biomimetic unmanned boats; and the plurality of biomimetic unmanned boats are configured to carry out search and rescue work in the search and rescue region.

title_en: Emergency robot for water surface rescue
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of rescue robots, and particularly relates to an emergency robot for water surface rescue, which comprises a shell, wherein driving mechanisms are arranged on two sides of the bottom end of the shell, an anchoring mechanism is arranged in the center of the bottom end of the shell, a reaction cavity is arranged in the shell, storage cavities are arranged at two ends of the reaction cavity, a communication port is formed between each storage cavity and the corresponding reaction cavity, the reaction cavity can control the state of the anchoring mechanism through the pressure of the reaction cavity, and a telescopic cylinder is arranged at the top end of the reaction cavity. The device can be moved to a place needing rescue autonomously, the snowflake-shaped floating piece after inflation can enable a person falling into water to have enough attachment, the device can serve as an emergency device when a rescue team cannot rescue the person falling into water at one time, the physical consumption of the person in water can be reduced through the floating piece, meanwhile, the anchoring mechanism can prevent the person falling into water from flowing along with waves, and the device is convenient for subsequent rescue and final survival probability.

title_en: Multi-unmanned-aerial-vehicle search and rescue system and method based on mobile communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system based on wireless communication, which comprises a wireless communication base station and a life detection instrument, wherein the wireless communication base station can be used for self-networking among unmanned aerial vehicles, establishes communication connection with a ground station through an unmanned aerial vehicle antenna, and sends search and rescue information to a ground terminal carried by a searched and rescued person; the life detector is used for accurately positioning the searched and rescued personnel in a smaller range, and can be used as an auxiliary positioning means for the searched and rescued personnel if the environmental conditions are poor; the ground station is used for controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle, receiving the returned data of the unmanned aerial vehicle and adjusting the flight track of the unmanned aerial vehicle in real time. The invention relates to a multi-unmanned-aerial-vehicle search and rescue method based on wireless communication.
assignees: XIAN LINGKONG ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system based on infrared thermal imaging
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system based on infrared thermal imaging, including host system, GPS orientation module, data transmission module and the image acquisition module who is connected respectively with host system, wherein, the bottom of image acquisition module is installed and is stabilized the platform, and stabilized the platform and is connected to the unmanned aerial vehicle below through mechanical connecting rod; the image acquisition module is used for identifying the heat of the object, generating a heat map and outputting the heat map to the main control module; the GPS positioning module is used for positioning the position information of the unmanned aerial vehicle and outputting the position information to the main control module; and the main control module is used for processing the position information of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the heat map to obtain the positions of the stranded personnel, and transmitting the positions of the stranded personnel to the ground control center through the data transmission module. The utility model discloses can be used for natural disasters such as earthquake collapse of multiple occasion, the accurate position of finding the patient of discernment through infrared thermal imaging picture has improved the efficiency of searching for and rescuing greatly and has reduced wounded and search for and rescue personnel's secondary injury risk.

title_en: Intelligent cruise search and rescue robot under foot type coal mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a foot type underground intelligent cruise search and rescue robot for a coal mine, which comprises an object carrying unit, a leg unit, a control unit and peripheral devices, wherein the object carrying unit is used as a main body of the device and is directly connected with the leg unit, the control unit is arranged in the object carrying unit, the peripheral devices are arranged on the surface of the object carrying unit, the robot can enter a post-disaster mine for autonomous detection, search for people in distress and provide first-aid materials, and a mine three-dimensional structure map is established in the process and the coordinate position information of the underground difficult personnel is marked, meanwhile, the robot can detect the gas content information such as gas in the mine, the robot can transmit the information to a PC outside the mine through a wireless transmission module, the rescue personnel can be effectively assisted to know the positions of the difficult personnel and the specific conditions in the mine, and the casualty rate in the mine rescue is reduced.

title_en: Disaster area vital signal detection and positioning method based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster area vital signal detection and positioning method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps: step S1, using an unmanned aerial vehicle to carry out video acquisition and image stabilization; step S2, extracting motion signals of the processed video; step S3, analyzing the frequency characteristics of the motion signal, and extracting the peak frequency sequence of the motion signal; step S4, designing a signal classifier, wherein the signal classifier is used for judging whether the peak frequency is approximately kept unchanged along with the time and whether the peak frequency meets the normal respiration rate range of the search and rescue object; step S5, vital signal detection and localization: and distinguishing the respiratory motion signal through a designed signal classifier, and mapping the respiratory motion signal to a preset frame of the video image after image stabilization processing to obtain a distribution map of the respiratory motion signal, namely obtaining the position of the potential survivor. The invention effectively improves the accuracy of detecting and positioning the vital signals in the disaster area and has stronger robustness to background motion.

title_en: Fire rescue robot, rescue assisting system and communication method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire rescue robot, a rescue assisting system and a communication method thereof, wherein the robot comprises: the motion power subsystem is used for driving the fire rescue robot to move; the identification positioning subsystem is used for acquiring indoor fire scene images by using a binocular camera and then drawing a fire scene three-dimensional map according to stereoscopic vision matching; the safety detection subsystem is used for combining information obtained by detection of various sensors with the identification and positioning subsystem, detecting toxic smoke on site and dividing the area attribute of the site area; the path navigation subsystem is used for selecting/updating an optimal rescue path in real time by using an optimized particle swarm algorithm on a fire scene; and the first information processing subsystem is used for acquiring or receiving the data sent by each subsystem, and obtaining corresponding processing result data after operation processing. The invention can be used for rescuing on the fire scene, improves the rescue efficiency and reduces unnecessary casualties.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle networking flight system and unmanned aerial vehicle remote communication method applying same
abstract_en: The invention discloses a networking flight system of an unmanned aerial vehicle and a remote communication method of the unmanned aerial vehicle using the system, belonging to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and comprising a ground flight host, a communication relay wing plane and a server which is in wireless communication with the ground flight host and the communication relay wing plane; the number of the ground flying hosts is a plurality of groups, so that multi-node transmission and equipment shift change connection are facilitated, and the circuit structures of the plurality of groups of ground flying hosts are the same. The invention adopts the mode of communication relay bureaucratic plane and ground flight host shift to realize the cruising and dynamic monitoring in long distance and long voyage, the communication relay bureaucratic plane is not limited by the ground flight host signal, the flight data transmission signal and the picture transmission signal can be enhanced and relayed, in addition, the authorized picture transmission signal is received and processed, the identification of the target and the interpretation of the ground object target are realized, the simultaneous relay of a plurality of unmanned planes is supported, the scope of routing inspection, search and rescue is enlarged, and a better use prospect is brought.
assignees: SUZHOU ZHONGFEI REMOTE SENSING TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Method for implementing search and rescue by using unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted EPIRB and photoelectric pod equipment
