abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle application, in particular to a method for implementing search rescue by utilizing an unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted EPIRB and a photoelectric pod device, which utilizes the onboard EPIRB to directly receive distress warning signals with the working frequency of 406MHz, which are sent by manually or automatically starting a distress ship with an onboard emergency radio position indicator (EPIRB) in the action range of an air patrol sea area, and simultaneously combines image data acquired by the onboard photoelectric pod device to implement optical image high-precision positioning on the distress ship, and can transmit accident site image data and information such as identification number, danger type, high-precision position data and the like of the distress ship back to a search rescue task control center through an unmanned aerial vehicle radio data chain so as to timely and quickly decide to deploy to implement subsequent rescue work and effectively improve the search rescue efficiency, reduce the loss of personnel and property.

title_en: Marine search and rescue method in severe weather environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine search and rescue method in severe climate environment, which comprises the steps of acquiring a marine blurred Image by an unmanned aerial vehicle/unmanned ship, preprocessing a few images by adopting Deep Image Prior (DIP) technology, reconstructing the images by an improved ESRGAN neural network, removing blurs and ghosts generated by severe environment, realizing defuzzification of the images, and finally identifying a person falling into water by a YOLOv4 target detection algorithm. The image reconstruction method based on the object detection technology reconstructs the image, and the position area of the person to be rescued is accurately positioned by using the object detection technology, so that the rescue efficiency is improved, the image reconstruction method based on the object detection technology has good practicability, can reconstruct the image of the marine environment in severe weather, can position the position area of the person falling into water to the greatest extent, and is convenient for quick rescue in the later period.

title_en: Crawler-type remote sensing rescue robot and rescue method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crawler-type remote sensing rescue robot and a rescue method thereof. The rescue robot is mostly used in the aspects of resource transportation, regional survey, remote operation treatment and the like, and neglects the search, rescue, evacuation and transfer of the wounded. The invention relates to a crawler-type remote sensing rescue robot which comprises a grabbing device, a lifting stretcher table and a main body part. The gripping device and the lifting stretcher platform are both arranged in the front of the main body part. The gripping device comprises a manipulator and a mechanical arm module. The manipulator is mounted at the end of the robot arm module. The mechanical arm module drives the mechanical arm to move in three degrees of freedom. The lifting stretcher platform comprises side wheels, a conveying frame and a conveyor. The transport frame is used for loading wounded persons. The transport frame is arranged on the transport frame; the outer end of the transportation frame can be turned over up and down. The outer end of the transportation frame is provided with a side wheel. The invention can ensure that the wounded are transported and evacuated to a safe area for timely treatment, and can be applied to natural disasters, war areas and areas with serious virus infection.

title_en: Control method and system for earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a control method and a control system of an earthquake rescue robot, wherein the main body of the earthquake rescue robot is a four-wheel electric vehicle, and the control system comprises: the device comprises a main control module, an ultrasonic module, a human body infrared induction module, a driving module, a steering engine, a voice module and a Bluetooth module, wherein the ultrasonic module, the human body infrared induction module, the driving module, the steering engine, the voice module and the Bluetooth module are respectively connected with the main control module; the Bluetooth module is in communication connection with a remote terminal; the method comprises the following steps: after the communication connection between the remote terminal and the Bluetooth device is established, the main control module controls the driving module to drive the four-wheel electric vehicle to operate according to a motion instruction sent to the Bluetooth module by the remote terminal; when the device runs, the main control module controls the ultrasonic wave module to measure distance and controls the human body infrared induction module to detect thermal infrared; when the distance value is measured, the running direction of the four-wheel electric vehicle is adjusted in real time; when the human body is detected, the pacifying instruction is broadcasted in voice through the voice module, and earthquake rescue can be performed more safely and efficiently.

title_en: Fast assembly's unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle of fast assembly relates to aircraft technical field. The problem of wasting time and energy of unmanned aerial vehicle equipment and dismantlement can be solved. An unmanned aerial vehicle of fast assembly includes fuselage main part, central wing, rotor connecting rod, outer wing, fin, first landing gear, second undercarriage, rotary wing and rearmounted screw together. The center wing is detachably provided on the body. The outer wings are detachably disposed at both sides of the central wing. The rotor links are disposed on the central wing or the outer wing. The tail wing is detachably arranged at the tail end of the main body of the machine body. The first landing frame is arranged at the tail end of the machine body. The second landing gear is arranged at the front end of the fuselage main body. The rotor wing detachably sets up at rotor wing connecting rod both ends. The rear propeller is arranged at the tail end of the machine body main body. The rotor wing connecting rod and the rotary wing are fixed through a second locking device. Each part is connected by adopting a quick detachable mode, and the assembling and disassembling efficiency is obviously improved. In occasions such as search and rescue, topography reconnaissance, such efficiency promotion is vital.

title_en: Spherical rescue robot with rolling-jumping function and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spherical rescue robot with a rolling-jumping function and a control method, belongs to the technical field of rescue robots, and relates to a spherical robot with rolling and jumping functions and a control method for disaster search and rescue. The robot consists of a left hemisphere, a right hemisphere, a central control cabin and a plurality of same magneto-rheological thrust mechanisms. The magnetorheological thrust mechanism consists of a return spring, a thrust mechanism shell, magnetorheological materials, an electromagnetic coil, a connecting bolt, a nut, a magnetorheological material-water diaphragm, water, a sealing ring and a ground supporting rod. The control method is controlled by a central control bin, an IMU sensor measures the pose and acceleration data of the current spherical robot, the power-on state and power-on time of each electromagnetic coil are controlled, and an internal ground supporting rod is controlled to pop up to impact the ground so as to provide power for the spherical robot. The spherical robot has compact structure, strong environment adaptability and low motion energy consumption, and effectively solves the problem of multi-group cooperative rolling-jumping driving in a small-size space of the spherical robot.

title_en: Highway 2nd accident prevention system using drone
title_ko: 드론을 이용한 고속도로 2차 사고예방 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for preventing a secondary accident occurring on a highway using a drone. The system comprises: a control center (10) which automatically identifies an accident that has occurred on a highway through at least a CCTV or receives an accident report from a reporter, and outputs a dispatch signal along with location information of an accident site; a rescue drone (20) which receives the dispatch signal, moves to the accident site, photographs an on-site situation at the accident site, and extinguishes the fire as necessary; and a guidance drone (30) which receives the dispatch signal, moves to a point spaced rearward by a predetermined distance from the accident site, and guides an accident situation to a driver driving to the accident site. Accordingly, the present invention is characterized in that a rescue drone is dispatched to an accident site and takes pictures of a situation around the accident site and an on-site situation so as to allow a rescue team to understand the accident situation before arriving at the accident site, thereby inducing a prompt action. In addition, in the event of a fire, fire extinguishers are directly fired so as to extinguish fire at an early stage, thereby preventing the occurrence of a big accident. Moreover, the guidance drone moves to a reverse road spaced apart from the accident site by a predetermined distance and displays an appropriate speed limit, an accident guidance text, and an accident scene video so as to induce safe driving of a driver who drives to the accident site, thereby effectively preventing the occurrence of a secondary accident.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 드론을 이용하여 고속도로의 2차 사고를 예방하는 시스템에 관한 것으로, 적어도 CCTV를 통해 고속도로에 발생한 사고를 자동 파악하거나 신고자로부터 사고신고를 접수받고, 사고지점의 위치정보와 함께 출동신호를 출력하는 관제센터(10); 상기 출동신호를 전달받아 사고지점으로 이동하고, 사고지점의 현장상황을 촬영하며 필요에 따라 화재를 진압하는 구난드론(20); 상기 출동신호를 전달받아 사사고지점으로부터 후방으로 설정 거리만큼 이격된 지점으로 이동하고, 사고지점으로 주행하는 운전자에게 사고 상황을 안내하는 안내드론(30);을 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
따라서 본 발명은 구난드론이 사고지점으로 출동하여 주변과 현장상황을 촬영해줌으로써, 구조대가 사고지점에 도착하기 이전에 사고상황을 미리 숙지할 수 있으므로 신속한 조치를 유도할 뿐만 아니라 화재 시 소화탄을 직접 발사하여 초기에 진압해줌에 따라 대형 사고를 예방할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 안내드론이 사고지점으로부터 설정 거리로 이격된 역방향 도로로 이동하여 적절한 제한속도와 사고안내문자 및 사고현장영상을 표시해줌으로써, 사고지점으로 주행하는 운전자에게 안전운전을 유도하여 2차 사고를 예방할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Tension constraint deformation crawler robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a tension constraint warp crawler robot, this robot is based on plane three pole mechanism, realize underactuated track warp with the help of track tension constraint, by first frame (1), second frame (2), third frame (3), first step motor (4), second step motor (5), first bearing wheel left half wheel (6), first bearing wheel right half wheel (7), second bearing wheel left half wheel (8), second bearing wheel right half wheel (9), motor fixed angle aluminium (10), first band pulley (11), second band pulley (12), first bevel gear (13), second bevel gear (14), third bevel gear (15), fourth bevel gear (16), first transmission shaft (17), second transmission shaft (18), first junction axle screw rod (19), second junction axle screw rod (20), track (21), attenuator (22) are constituteed. The movement and deformation are realized through the front and rear motor differential motion, and the device can be well applied to the fields of exploration, search and rescue, military reconnaissance and the like.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle who possesses search for and rescue function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle that possesses search and rescue function relates to unmanned air vehicle technical field, and easy because external factors take place wearing and tearing and broken problem takes place for solving current unmanned aerial vehicle when searching for and rescuing the camera lens end of during operation imaging device. The inside of unmanned aerial vehicle organism is provided with zooms camera and infrared imaging appearance, the lower extreme of zooming camera and infrared imaging appearance is provided with laser range finder, the front end of zooming camera, infrared imaging appearance and laser range finder is provided with leading toughened glass, the both sides of zooming camera, infrared imaging appearance and laser range finder all set up organism support, laser range finder's lower extreme is provided with the support suspension, and supports suspension and organism support integrated into one piece and set up, all be provided with the mount pad on the preceding terminal surface of support suspension and unmanned aerial vehicle organism, and mount pad and support suspension and unmanned aerial vehicle organism integrated into one piece set up.
assignees: NANJING NEW AIRSPACE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Air-ground collaborative search and rescue system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an open-air collaborative search and rescue system and a method, wherein the system comprises a disaster information acquisition and research unit, a disaster information acquisition and research unit and a disaster information research and judgment unit, wherein the disaster information acquisition and research and judgment unit is used for acquiring disaster data of a disaster area through a first unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted platform and determining a key rescue area; the target fast searching unit is used for carrying out wide-area large-range target fast searching on the disaster area through the second unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted platform, rechecking the key rescue area and searching other missed key rescue areas; the ground search and rescue command platform is used for receiving the final information of all key rescue areas, forming a rescue scheme and issuing a search and rescue instruction; the target accurate positioning unit is used for receiving a search and rescue instruction, searching and positioning the trapped target in the multipoint rescue area through a third unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted platform or/and a ground platform, and obtaining information of the trapped target; and the target accurate rescue unit is used for receiving the information of the trapped target and rescuing the trapped target. The invention has the advantages of fast, accurate, efficient, systematic, streamlined and standardized search and rescue.
assignees: HUNAN NOVASKY ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Air-ground cooperative search and rescue system and method based on three-dimensional map and autonomous navigation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air-ground cooperative search and rescue system and method based on a three-dimensional map and autonomous navigation, wherein the system comprises: the system comprises an aerial monitoring unit and a ground search and rescue unit, wherein the aerial monitoring unit comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a first microcomputer, an inertia measuring device, a first image acquisition device and a first wireless transmission device, wherein the first microcomputer, the inertia measuring device, the first image acquisition device and the first wireless transmission device are carried on the unmanned aerial vehicle; the ground search and rescue unit comprises a tracked vehicle, a second microcomputer, a second image acquisition device, a laser radar, an ultrasonic module and a second wireless transmission device, wherein the second microcomputer, the second image acquisition device, the laser radar, the ultrasonic module and the second wireless transmission device are arranged on the tracked vehicle, and A-Star algorithm software is arranged in the second microcomputer and used for realizing autonomous navigation and obstacle avoidance. The invention has the function of air-ground cooperation, can construct a three-dimensional map of a search and rescue scene, can enable the robot search and rescue system to automatically navigate, search for a search and rescue target and successfully rescue the target.

title_en: Be used for forest fire rescue robot to prevent intelligent device that catches fire
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligent robots, and discloses a fire-catching prevention intelligent device for a forest fire rescue robot, which comprises a shell, wherein the outer part of the shell is fixedly connected with a detection shell, the surface of the detection shell is provided with an air inlet, and the inner part of the detection shell is fixedly connected with a bimetallic strip; through detecting the shell, the air inlet, bimetal strip, the touch panel, connecting rod one, connecting rod two, the pendulum rod, the transfer line, the swing plate, the runner, the connecting plate, the sleeve, the coil, the electro-magnet, spray plate, the storage jar, under the interact between the electromagnetic pump, can make the improvement that rescue robot is showing at the on-the-spot operating efficiency of rescue forest fire, thereby effectively improve the reaction rate and the rescue efficiency of rescue, also can be in the early stage that forest fire takes place just can be fast and high-quality completion rescue work simultaneously, the life safety and the property safety of the personnel in the disaster have been ensured, also can improve rescue robot's practicality and intelligent level simultaneously.
assignees: GUANGZHOU AOKE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Searching and Rescue Method through Snake Robot Whole Body Control Based on Weight Change
title_ko: 무게변화를 기초로 한 뱀형 로봇 전신제어를 통한 탐색 및 구조 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a search and rescue method through whole body control of a snake-shaped robot based on weight change. The snake-shaped robot according to an aspect of the present invention includes a body part to which a plurality of modules are connected. Based on a change of at least one of a connection point and a separation distance between the plurality of modules, at least one of the length and shape of the body part is changeable. The weight of at least some of the plurality of modules is variable. A predetermined task may be performed based on the changed length of the body part, the changed shape of the body part, and the changed weight of the at least one module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무게변화를 기초로 한 뱀형 로봇 전신제어를 통한 탐색 및 구조 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일 양상인 뱀 로봇은, 복수의 모듈을 연결한 몸통부;를 포함하고, 상기 복수의 모듈 간의 연결지점 및 이격거리 중 적어도 하나의 변화를 기초로, 상기 몸통부의 길이 및 형태 중 적어도 하나가 변화 가능하고, 상기 복수의 모듈 중 적어도 일부의 무게가 변화 가능하며, 상기 변화된 몸통부의 길이, 상기 변화된 몸통부의 형태 및 상기 변화된 적어도 하나의 모듈의 무게를 기초로 미리 지정된 태스크(task)를 수행할 수 있다.
assignees: KOREA INST ROBOT & CONVERGENCE;NAT UNIV PUKYONG IND UNIV COOP FOUND

title_en: High-storage-rate bionic pneumatic soft worm robot based on paper folding theory
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high storage rate bionic pneumatic soft worm robot based on paper folding theory, including flexible driver, front and back end cover board, pneumatic sufficient and inflation system. Two ends of the flexible driver are respectively bonded with the front end cover plate and the rear end cover plate, and the flexible driver is expanded in a manner of inflating through an inflation system to drive the front exhaust movable foot to move forwards; the flexible driver is used for driving the exhaust movable foot to move forwards, so that the axial large-stroke bionic crawling is realized. The pneumatic foot is stretched and contracted through the air bag, and the included angle between the hinge connecting piece and the ground is adjusted, so that the friction form between the pneumatic foot and the ground is changed to realize unidirectional movement. The utility model discloses bionic pneumatic software worm robot of high storage rate based on paper folding theory has advantages such as the concertina rate is big, light in weight, low power dissipation, load capacity are strong, can realize that rapid stabilization creeps, can be applied to fields such as search and rescue action or pipeline monitoring after the calamity.

title_en: Bionic pneumatic soft worm robot with high storage rate
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bionic pneumatic soft worm robot with high storage rate, which comprises a membranous soft driver, a front end cover plate, a rear end cover plate, a one-way motion mechanism, an elastic traction mechanism and an inflation system. The membrane-shaped soft driver is a cylinder when inflated and unfolded, and two ends of the membrane-shaped soft driver are respectively sealed and fixed with the front end cover plate and the rear end cover plate. The inflation system realizes extension and contraction by inflating and exhausting air into the membranous soft driver, and drives the unidirectional motion mechanisms at the bottoms of the front end cover plate and the rear end cover plate to move forwards, so that the axial large-stroke bionic crawling is realized. The elastic traction mechanism assists the extension or contraction of the membranous soft body driver in a mode of releasing elastic potential energy. The unidirectional movement mechanism realizes unidirectional movement by adjusting the friction coefficient of the movable foot and the ground. The utility model discloses a bionical pneumatic software worm robot has advantages such as the expansion ratio is big, light in weight, low power dissipation, development low cost, can realize crawling fast, can be used to fields such as the post-disaster search and rescue action or pipeline monitoring.

title_en: Investigation mobile robot based on continuum mechanism
abstract_en: Reconnaissance mobile robot based on continuum mechanism belongs to reconnaissance and surveys the field. The four-freedom-degree robot arm is composed of a four-freedom-degree robot arm based on a continuum mechanism, a Mecanum wheel omnidirectional movement four-wheel chassis and a camera, and is characterized in that: the camera is controlled by the motion of a mechanical arm, the mechanical arm is composed of a continuum mechanism, the continuum mechanism is driven by a steel wire, the steel wire is controlled by a stepping motor, the chassis movement is driven by a direct-current speed reducing motor, the motor controls a Mecanum wheel, the Mecanum wheel realizes omnidirectional movement, the device adopts a flexible structure similar to an elephant nose based on the continuum mechanism, and a single-component joint and a rigid connecting rod are not arranged. Therefore, the robot has excellent bending characteristics which are not possessed by the traditional robot, can flexibly change the shape of the robot, and has strong environmental adaptability, thereby excellently completing tasks which are greatly limited by environmental factors, such as earthquake search and rescue, military reconnaissance and the like.

title_en: Intelligent-manufacturing anti-falling wall-climbing robot for mine rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine rescue robots and discloses an intelligently manufactured mine rescue anti-falling wall-climbing robot which comprises a robot body, wherein driving rods are movably arranged on two sides of each driving wheel, rotating rods are rotatably arranged on the upper side and the lower side of each driving rod, a power switch is fixedly arranged above each rotating rod, an electromagnet is fixedly arranged below each power switch, a movable rod is movably arranged on the left side of each electromagnet, and a control switch is rotatably arranged on the inner side of the right end of each movable rod. This mine rescue that intelligence was made prevents climbing wall robot that falls through drive wheel clockwise rotation and extrusion actuating lever to both sides removal to the dwang both ends respectively with switch and electromagnet contact, make the electro-magnet circular telegram and promote the movable rod outwards to remove, the electric current in the electro-magnet lasts the increase simultaneously, makes movable rod front end gyro wheel latch closely laminate with the pore wall, has realized climbing wall robot can adapt to the effect in different diameter rescue holes automatically.
assignees: GUIGANG TONGXU NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Throw type secondary disaster monitoring and positioning device for geological landslide emergency search and rescue center
abstract_en: The invention discloses a secondary disaster monitoring and positioning device thrown by a geological landslide emergency search and rescue center, which comprises an equipment bin, a battery bin, a wedging part and a rotary propeller, wherein the equipment bin comprises: beidou displacement monitoring equipment is arranged in the equipment bin and is connected with a Cors station and platform data through a radio station; the battery bin is positioned below the equipment bin; the wedging part is positioned at the lower side of the battery bin; the rotary propeller comprises a rotary propeller sleeve and blades, and the rotary propeller sleeve is sleeved at the joint of the equipment bin and the battery bin. The device disclosed by the invention can be used for throwing equipment to a certain position of a landslide area for fixing by an airplane or an unmanned aerial vehicle after geological landslide occurs on the basis of Beidou high-precision positioning, so that the monitoring can be accurately assisted and the rescue safety can be ensured to the maximum extent after a period of time.
assignees: HARBIN TIANSHU WENDAO TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mine rescue robot path planning method based on BRRT algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine rescue robot path planning method based on BRRT algorithm, which comprises the steps of firstly, adopting a laser sensor to collect obstacle information of a post-disaster mine environment, and building an environment map of the post-disaster mine by using a rectangle () function under an MATLAB platform according to the obstacle information; then generating a primary path 1 with fewer bidirectional random search tree nodes by using an APF-BRRT algorithm; simultaneously starting collision detection on route1 at the starting point and the target point of the environment map by using an A-algorithm, deleting redundant nodes in route1 based on the detection result, and adjusting route1 generated in an APF-BRRT algorithm into shortest route 2; the shortest path route2 is discretized into a scatter plot, and based on each scatter plot, a least squares method is used to fit an "optimal" curve based on the condition that the sum of squares of the deviations is minimal Eliminate all inflection points of route2, the fitted curve Resulting in a smooth path 3. Finally, the method for planning the path of the mine rescue robot based on the BRRT algorithm is realized.

title_en: Four-wheel-drive firefighting forcible entry rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a four-wheel-drive fire-fighting dismantling rescue robot. The robot comprises a frame, two independent crawler-type traveling mechanisms are arranged on two sides of the frame respectively, a rotary platform is connected to the upper side of the front end of the frame through the rotary mechanism, a hydraulic working arm mechanism is arranged on the rotary platform, a diesel engine assembly is arranged on the upper side of the frame, the diesel engine assembly is connected with a hydraulic pump, the hydraulic pump is connected with a control valve group and a hydraulic oil tank, the control valve group is connected with an electric cabinet, the rotary mechanism, the hydraulic working arm mechanism and the crawler-type traveling mechanisms respectively, and the electric cabinet is in wireless connection with a remote control. The four independent crawler-type traveling mechanisms are adopted, so that the robot is suitable for moving operation on a pothole road section and stairs, the demolition operation can be carried out on various occasions, the maneuverability of the demolition operation is greatly improved, the operation efficiency is improved, the damping mechanism has a good damping effect, and the abnormality of parts on the upper side of the frame under the pothole road condition is avoided.
assignees: ANHUI HENGCHUANG INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: High-penetrability fusion search and rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-penetrability fusion search and rescue device, which comprises an acquisition component, an adjusting component, a display component and a control component, wherein the acquisition component is connected with the adjusting component, the adjusting component is connected with the display component, and the acquisition component and the display component are respectively connected with the control component; the acquisition assembly comprises an infrared thermal imaging module, a lighting module, a millimeter wave radar module and a lamp body with an accommodating space, the infrared thermal imaging module, the lighting module and the millimeter wave radar module are accommodated in the accommodating space of the lamp body, and the infrared thermal imaging module, the lighting module and the millimeter wave radar module can be coordinated to work cooperatively through the control assembly. Carry out quick discernment to moving target through millimeter wave radar module, the hot imaging module of rethread infrared is further confirmed, can discern the rescue target fast, compares in single mutually independent search and rescue device, the utility model discloses a search and rescue device can obviously promote rescue target identification efficiency, the advantage of the individual soldier removal of being convenient for use.

title_en: System, apparatus, and method for controlling unmanned aerial vehicles for search and rescue
abstract_en: A system, method, and non-transitory computer-readable storage medium to perform a search and rescue mission according to a Layered Search and Rescue (LSAR) methodology using a plurality of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) communicatively connected to a remote server. The LSAR methodology can involve receiving data corresponding to a center of an area corresponding to an adverse/disaster event potentially having survivors at unknown locations; dividing the area into a set of numbered box-shaped layers within the area; calculating a thickness of the box-shaped layers based on a total number of the Unmanned Aerial Vehicles; exclusively assigning one or more of the Unmanned Aerial Vehicles to each box-shaped layer; and controlling the Unmanned Aerial Vehicles to perform the search and rescue mission by selectively switching one or more of the Unmanned Aerial Vehicles between a searcher mode and a rescuer mode.

title_en: Amphibious multi-foot robot with dynamic tail
abstract_en: The amphibious multi-foot flexible tail bionic robot comprises a main body, bionic legs and a bionic tail, and has functions of amphibious movement and personnel hiding, reconnaissance and fight replacement, wherein the bionic legs and the bionic tail are respectively and mechanically connected with the main body and are electrically connected with one or more pairs, and the bionic tail comprises an elastic main rib, a tail power module fixed on the elastic main rib, a force transmission device, a middle section device arranged on the elastic main rib at intervals and a tail section device fixed at the tail end of the elastic main rib; compared with other types of amphibious robots, the amphibious robot has more excellent environmental adaptability and wider application field, and can replace personnel to perform all-weather and high-reliability search and rescue, latency, information collection, monitoring, reconnaissance and countermeasure work.

title_en: Crawler-type fire-fighting and fire-fighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the field of robots, in particular to a crawler-type fire-fighting and rescue robot, which comprises a fire-fighting and rescue robot main body, an infrared camera and an installation column which are arranged at the top end of the fire-fighting and rescue robot main body, wherein a spray device is arranged in the installation column in a penetrating way, when in use, a main control panel is used for controlling the opening and closing of a first valve and a second valve, when in use, if the fire is small, the first spray head can be used for spraying, if the fire is large, the first spray head and the second spray head can be selected for combined spraying to improve the fire-fighting efficiency, when in spraying through the second spray head, an electric telescopic pipe can be controlled by the main control panel, after the electric telescopic pipe is extended, the second spray head can be moved to the position needing to extinguish fire through the electric telescopic pipe, and simultaneously, a rotator can be controlled by the main control panel to drive a rotary column to rotate, and then the second spray head is driven to rotate, and the spraying area is increased.
assignees: ANHUI XIANGPIN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Portable infrared thermal imaging device for emergency rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable infrared thermal imaging device for emergency rescue, which comprises a fixed plate, wherein two connecting rings are symmetrically and fixedly arranged at the top end of the fixed plate, a thermal imager is fixedly arranged on the two connecting rings together, a camera is fixedly arranged at one end of the thermal imager, a groove is cut on the side edge of the thermal imager, a display screen is rotatably arranged on the thermal imager, the display screen is matched with the groove, a supporting cloth is arranged below the fixed plate, four tightening mechanisms are symmetrically and fixedly arranged on the supporting cloth, one ends of the four tightening mechanisms, which are far away from the supporting cloth, are movably sleeved with the fixed plate, the portable infrared thermal imaging device for emergency rescue can lead the supporting cloth and the fixed plate to be firmly connected into a whole through the tightening mechanisms, then the device is tied on an arm, and the worry that the device drops from the hand in the search and rescue process is not needed, the trouble that the reduction device carried the stability problem and caused the user has improved the convenience that it carried greatly.

title_en: Automobile-used body structure of multi-functional city search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a car body structure is used in multi-functional city search and rescue relates to special vehicle manufacturing industry field, including automobile body chassis, carriage door, hinge, carriage, install bin, transposition railway carriage or compartment, transposition axle, transposition support, hydraulic pressure calliper, brake disc, driven sprocket, drive chain, driving sprocket, transposition reduction gear, transposition motor, the heavy groove of installation, supporting spring, unmanned aerial vehicle support, latch hook, electronic lock, cat ladder, cut off frame, machine cabin, control cabinet, jack. The utility model relates to a scheme makes the carriage door act as car side footboard under the open mode through the integral carriage door design of automatic switching, and the robot and the operation control personnel of being convenient for search and rescue are from top to bottom, and the design through the transposition railway carriage or compartment makes unmanned aerial vehicle install in its inside shock absorber support simultaneously, can act as the air park and use when the transposition railway carriage or compartment is located horizontal position, has greatly made things convenient for receiving and releasing of collecting device, is favorable to improving work efficiency, saves the valuable time for search and rescue work.

title_en: Building wisdom fire extinguishing system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fire-fighting systems, in particular to an intelligent fire-fighting system for a building, which comprises a spraying fire-fighting module, a gas fire-fighting module and an intelligent smoke discharging module, wherein the spraying fire-fighting module comprises a water conveying pipeline arranged in the building, and a plurality of water mist spray heads are arranged on the water conveying pipeline; the gas fire extinguishing module comprises a fire extinguishing gas storage tank arranged in a building and a fire extinguishing gas conveying and spraying component which is connected with the fire extinguishing gas storage tank and laid along the interior of the building; the intelligent smoke exhaust module comprises a main smoke exhaust pipeline arranged at the top in the building and an auxiliary smoke exhaust mechanism arranged on the inner side wall of the building; the robot-assisted rescue system further comprises a robot-assisted rescue module arranged in the building, wherein the robot-assisted rescue module comprises a plurality of rescue signal transmitters and rescue robots which are arranged in the building. The method has the effects of improving the fire fighting safety level in the building and protecting personnel.

title_en: Helicopter simulation search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a helicopter simulation search and rescue system which comprises a ground workstation, a single-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and a mechanical grabbing module, wherein the ground workstation is connected with the single-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle through a wireless connection module, the single-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle is connected with the mechanical grabbing module, and the mechanical grabbing module comprises a main support and an image shooting module. The invention ensures the success rate of grabbing smooth objects and irregular objects, and ensures the safety of grabbing objects in the air by double insurance of the vacuum suction head and the mechanical claw, and the design of the splayed structure is innovatively used, so that the influence of the foot rest on the objects to be saved and the grabbing structure during rescue is minimized.

title_en: Cardiopulmonary resuscitation robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of rescue robots, in particular to a cardiopulmonary resuscitation robot, wherein swing arm mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on two sides of a robot body, the swing arm mechanisms on two sides synchronously rotate through swing arm driving mechanisms arranged in the robot body, a cardiopulmonary resuscitation instrument is arranged at the front end of a mechanical arm, the rotation of the swing arm mechanisms can adjust the inclination angle of the body to be matched with the movement of the mechanical arm so as to tightly hold and fix trapped personnel, and then the cardiopulmonary resuscitation instrument presses the hearts of the trapped personnel, so that the blood flow of the hearts and the brains of patients suffering from sudden cardiac arrest is increased, and the bridge bearing function is realized for subsequent defibrillation, intravenous medication, vascular reconstruction and the like, and the survival rate of the trapped personnel is increased. The invention can implement cardiopulmonary resuscitation treatment for trapped people in ruins environment, has strong adaptability to robot environment, can freely cross obstacles, cross ravines and climb steps in non-structural environment, and has the characteristics of flexible movement, wide adaptability, compact structure and the like.

title_en: Tumbler type soft jumping robot
abstract_en: A tumbler type soft jumping robot belongs to the field of jumping robots. The problem of current software robot's instantaneous acceleration lower, land jumping ability is poor and the direction of motion controllability is poor is solved. The invention comprises a soft body explosion chamber, a base, a battery, a supporting upright post, a control panel, a gravity center adjusting device, a gas storage and transmission device and a circular structure; on one hand, the invention realizes the release of energy by using the explosion energy release principle and the expansion mode of the soft explosion cavity, can convert chemical energy into mechanical energy in a short time, can realize larger instantaneous acceleration of the robot, and has stronger jumping capability; on the other hand, the super-elasticity characteristic of the soft body explosion chamber is utilized to realize the automatic reset function after jumping. The invention can be applied to the occasions of surveying, post-disaster search and rescue and the like of complex land environments.

title_en: Intelligent voice control system of water surface lifesaving robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent voice control system of a water surface lifesaving robot, which comprises: one end of the voice console is electrically connected with a voice awakening module; the image processing module is electrically connected to one end of the voice awakening module, one end of the image processing module is electrically connected to a voice interaction layer, one end of the voice interaction layer is electrically connected to a voice impurity removal module, and the voice conversion module is electrically connected to one end of the voice impurity removal module. The invention has the beneficial effects that: according to the intelligent voice control system for the water surface lifesaving robot, through the design of the anti-theft module, the networking video uploading can be carried out when some people maliciously delete or tamper rescue voice and videos during search and rescue through abnormal means, then the local information is automatically destroyed, meanwhile, the quick intelligent analysis can be carried out during rescue on water through the design of the central control module, and the time for thinking in rescue is shortened.

title_en: Modular high-expansion-ratio robot based on paper folding mechanism
abstract_en: The invention provides a modular high-expansion-ratio robot based on a paper folding mechanism, which comprises a robot end effector, a connecting module, a paper folding module, a base and a driving module, wherein the connecting module is arranged on the end effector; the paper folding module and the driving module are respectively installed on two sides of the base, the robot end effector is installed at the tail end of the paper folding module through the connecting module, and the driving module drives the robot end effector to move through stretching of the paper folding module. The paper folding module is a Jicun mode tubular paper folding mechanism, and the driving guide wire is a nickel-titanium memory alloy wire. The invention realizes higher expansion and contraction rate in the axial direction, has better flexibility and adaptability, and can be applied to the fields of detection, search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Heart defibrillation robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of rescue robots, in particular to a heart defibrillation robot, wherein swing arm mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on two sides of a robot body, and the swing arm mechanisms on two sides synchronously rotate through a swing arm driving mechanism arranged in the robot body; the defibrillation operation module comprises a defibrillator and an operation mechanical arm, wherein an electrode plate of the defibrillator is arranged at the front end of the operation mechanical arm, the lifting angle of a robot body can be adjusted through rotation of a swing arm mechanism, the position and the angle of the electrode plate of the defibrillator can be adjusted by matching with movement of the operation mechanical arm, electric shock treatment is implemented on hearts of heart disease recurrence personnel, arrhythmia is eliminated, and survival rate of trapped personnel is increased. The invention can be used for implementing the defibrillation treatment for personnel in a complex environment, has strong environmental adaptability of the robot, can freely cross obstacles, cross ravines and climb steps in a non-structural environment, and has the characteristics of flexible movement, wide adaptability, compact structure and the like.

title_en: Rescue robot for quickly cleaning building materials collapsed in house
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rescue robots, in particular to a rescue robot and a method thereof for quickly cleaning house collapse building materials, which comprises a movable vehicle body, wherein a movable box body is fixed at the top of the movable vehicle body, a placing groove is arranged inside the movable box body, two ground breaking side plates are arranged in the placing groove, a T-shaped slider is arranged on the right side of each ground breaking side plate, two T-shaped chutes are arranged on the left side of the movable box body, the T-shaped chutes are slidably connected with the left side of the movable box body, and two electric push rods are arranged on the right side of the movable box body; the utility model discloses set up two broken ground curb plates, promoted horizontal push rod through electric putter and made broken ground curb plate strut the ruins, and broken ground curb plate top folding high density canvas also opens the criss-cross side vaulting pole of cooperation thereupon and forms the fender top, has formed urgent passageway this moment, and the person of being convenient for rescue gets into and exerts and labours or inwards transmits food, water source or detector, does not need all ruins of complete clearance, and the passageway forms fastly and firmly.

title_en: Intelligent escape robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to an intelligent escape robot which comprises a shell; the shell can float on the water surface, a rescue cavity is arranged in the shell, an opening is formed in the shell, sliding grooves are formed in the end portion of the shell respectively, sliding plates matched with the sliding grooves in shape are connected in a sliding mode in the sliding grooves respectively, pistons are arranged at the inner ends of the sliding plates respectively, air sources are arranged at the inner ends of the sliding grooves respectively, power cavities are symmetrically connected to the outer side wall of the shell, motors are arranged on the side walls of the power cavities respectively, the end portions of the motors are connected with power paddles through rotating shafts, and a camera is arranged on one side of the top surface of the shell; according to the invention, through the arrangement of the escape robot, the escape robot can effectively search and rescue drowners, and meanwhile, the escape robot is small in size, light in weight and convenient to use, so that the use effect of the escape robot is greatly improved.
assignees: SUZHOU CHUANGSHIWEI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: High-precision stable control method for fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-precision stable control method for a fire-fighting robot, which comprises the following steps: decoupling the mass center and the angular momentum of the robot system based on a kinematic and dynamic model based on an extended zero moment point method to obtain a three-dimensional linear model for global dynamic optimization control; based on an overall kinematics model and a kinematics model of a robot system and a boundary stability condition model when a robot platform cooperatively acts, stability criteria of the robot under specific load working conditions, working environments and movement tracks are constructed and used for judging the reasonability of a remote control command; and analyzing the stability of the robot under a specific remote control instruction in real time according to the environment perception information and the information of the robot platform pose component and in combination with a boundary stable condition model, and obtaining a rationalization correction strategy of the remote control instruction according to the stability. The invention constructs a boundary stable condition based on the stable operation control method of the fire-fighting robot in the unsteady state environment, and realizes the stable operation of the rescue robot in the complex environment.
assignees: XINXING JIHUA TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Maritime search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an emergency rescue technical field just discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle searches for ands rescue at sea, including elevating gear, elevating gear surface downside fixedly connected with flotation device, elevating gear include the main part device, main part device surface one side fixedly connected with bracing piece, and main part device surface one end fixedly connected with motor box is kept away from to the bracing piece. This unmanned aerial vehicle searches for ands rescue at sea, through setting up the flotation device in elevating gear surface downside, and through setting up the contact plate in flotation device, when unmanned aerial vehicle stops flying, make unmanned aerial vehicle descend, when contact plate and sea contact, make catch bar upward movement, thereby make fixed inserted bar break away from with the tubular pole, thereby make the upper end spring can drive upper end push pedal upward movement, thereby make the reciprocating lever motion, thereby make the floating plate outward movement, thereby make the floating plate can float on the sea, thereby the marine effect that still can retrieve after stopping flying of unmanned aerial vehicle has been realized.

title_en: Rapid structural parameter design method of S-shaped emergency robot based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly designing structural parameters of a snake-shaped emergency robot based on deep reinforcement learning, belongs to the field of structural design of snake-shaped emergency robots, and relates to a method for quickly designing structural parameters of a snake-shaped emergency robot used for disaster search and rescue and based on deep reinforcement learning. The method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a snake-shaped emergency robot parameter multi-target planning model, and carrying out Markov modeling aiming at the robot structure parameter multi-target planning problem. Respectively establishing a state space, an action space and a reward function according to a planning problem; then, a reinforcement learning framework is constructed. And finally, training the constructed reinforcement learning network to realize a quick design task of the snake-shaped emergency robot. The invention can quickly and efficiently complete the quick design task of the structural parameters of the S-shaped emergency robot on the premise of ensuring the completion of task indexes, thereby obtaining the structural parameters of the lightweight S-shaped emergency robot with better comprehensive performance.

title_en: Multi-information fusion perception search and rescue robot control system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a robot control system is searched for andd rescue to multi-information fusion perception, including the robot main part, the upper end of robot main part is provided with the connecting plate, the lower extreme both sides of robot main part all are provided with removes the wheel, upper end one side of robot main part is provided with the wireless data transceiver, one side that the wireless data transceiver was kept away from to the upper end of robot main part is provided with the camera, the inside of robot main part is provided with adjusting device with camera matched with, the upper end middle part of robot main part is provided with temperature and humidity sensor and attitude sensor respectively, the side of robot main part is provided with carbon monoxide sensor and methane sensor respectively, the front end of robot main part is provided with ultrasonic sensor and infrared body temperature sensor respectively. Has the advantages that: by adopting the multi-information fusion perception search and rescue robot, the survivors can be searched and positioned in the disaster site through video, sound and other information, the rescue efficiency is greatly improved, and the practicability is improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for forest search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model provides an unmanned aerial vehicle for forest search and rescue, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, an inserting component and a spiral component, wherein two sides of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body are provided with first grooves, two sides of each first groove are provided with rotating shafts, and wings are connected on the rotating shafts; support rod seats are arranged on two sides of the lower end of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, and a detector is arranged at the lower end of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body; the inserting assembly comprises an installing block, the front side of the installing block is provided with an inserting block, cavity grooves are formed in two sides of the inserting block, a pushing spring is arranged in each cavity groove, one end of each pushing spring is fixed to the bottom of each cavity groove, a clamping block is fixed to one end of each pushing spring, and clamping grooves for clamping the clamping blocks are formed in two sides of each wing; the spiral component comprises an insertion seat, the insertion seat is installed at the upper end of the installation block, a rotating shaft is arranged at the upper end of the insertion seat, propellers are arranged on two sides of the rotating shaft, the device can be retracted into the first groove through the wing, and the insertion component can be conveniently installed and detached with the wing in a telescopic mode.

title_en: Underwater robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a be applied to robotechnology field's an underwater robot, its structure includes protective housing, turn to the flank, rear propeller and regulation and control fin, protective housing includes semi-circular end sealed cowling and rear shell, the end sealed cowling sets up in the tip of rear shell and surrounds and form the function inner chamber, the rear shell includes cylindrical middle section and toper tail end, cylindrical middle section forms the evagination back along the axis symmetry, turn to the flank for setting up in two front end flanks that the evagination back is close to the end sealed cowling, rear propeller and regulation and control fin are coaxial to be set up in the toper tail end. This underwater robot has realized that "the rear promotes, and the place ahead turns to"'s mode of operation has effectively promoted regulation and control flexibility under water, combines together with its appearance simultaneously and has further promoted its functioning speed and application scope, has promoted its work efficiency to further cooperate with the functional component of end sealed cowling, easily realize going on of efficient information collection and search and rescue operation.
assignees: SUZHOU RUNSIDA INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Head anti-scratch and oxygen supply protection bracket for narrow space rescue
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the fire rescue, concretely relates to head anti-scratch and oxygen suppliment protection bracket of narrow and small space rescue, including establishing the protection bracket main part in head protection bracket box, protection bracket main part is equipped with the bracket recess, protection bracket main part is equipped with the backplate, the backplate is connected with electric telescopic handle, the oxygen import has been seted up to the backplate, the inboard of protection bracket main part is equipped with the oxygen diffusion layer corresponding with the oxygen import, the inboard of oxygen diffusion layer is equipped with ventilative arc. The utility model provides a head anti-scratch and oxygen suppliment protection bracket for narrow and small space rescue, when the rescue robot march to by the rescue personnel head position, control electric telescopic handle release protection bracket main part is arranged in by rescue personnel head downside, and the protection is treated rescue personnel head to for treating rescue personnel provides oxygen through the oxygen suppliment mouth, prevent to stifle because of oxygen is not enough.
assignees: JINHUA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle night search and rescue method based on YOLOv3 and gesture recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nighttime search and rescue method of an unmanned aerial vehicle based on YOLOv3 and gesture recognition, which is characterized in that a YOLOv3 network model is used for training a data set based on an infrared photo, so that whether a heat source is human or not can be confirmed within dozens of microseconds during actual operation of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the algorithm is strong in real-time performance. The gesture recognition method based on Kinect can realize the collection of stranded personnel quantity and state information under complete unmanned operation state, helps the going on of rescue goods and materials input decision-making, has promoted rescue equipment's intelligence and interactivity simultaneously, has solved the not good technical problem of use unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue effect night among the prior art.

title_en: Search and rescue robot system based on multi-agent theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot system based on a multi-agent theory, which comprises a search and rescue control center and a search and rescue robot unit cluster, wherein the search and rescue control center comprises a wireless receiving and transmitting module and a display module, the search and rescue robot unit cluster comprises a plurality of search and rescue robot units, and a power supply module, a CPU processing chip, a communication module, a driving module and a sensor assembly are arranged in each search and rescue robot unit. According to the search and rescue control system, the search and rescue range can be defined through the search and rescue control center, the search and rescue robot units are automatically moved into the search and rescue range after being put in, information exchange is carried out among the search and rescue robot units through the communication module, and position and speed parameters are shared, so that the search and rescue robot units can be uniformly dispersed, the search and rescue area is enlarged, all-dimensional search and rescue can be carried out in the search and rescue range, and the search and rescue efficiency is improved. The residual electric quantity can be detected after the robot rescue unit, so that the power supply module can reserve enough electric quantity to return to the home for supplementing electric energy.

title_en: All-terrain remote control detection, search and rescue robot with swing arm and crawler belt
abstract_en: The invention discloses an all-terrain remote control detection and search-and-rescue robot with a swing arm crawler belt, which comprises a protective cover, a U-shaped bottom plate, a connecting column, a bolt, a connecting fastening plate, a battery module, an antenna module, an industrial personal computer, a camera, a direct current motor, a servo motor, a crawler belt supporting plate, a crawler belt driving wheel, a fastening pin and an anti-skid crawler belt shoe, wherein the U-shaped bottom plate is fixedly connected with the connecting column; the system is used for environmental detection in various terrains and environments and provides decision basis for search and rescue. The invention can realize the adjustment of the arrangement position in a certain range by using components such as a detachable motor and the like, thereby meeting the structural requirements of different sizes in the engineering; the remote control system has the advantages of simple remote control operation and short personnel training period, and saves a large amount of manpower and time expenditure.

title_en: Small-space fire-extinguishing smoke-removing robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a small space fire-extinguishing and smoke-removing robot, which comprises a crawler wheel, a shell is arranged above the crawler wheel, a motion receiving controller is arranged between the shell and the crawler wheel, a built-in water tank is arranged in the shell, power supply sets and controllers are respectively arranged on the inner walls of the two sides of the shell, the robot comprises a smoke sensing and infrared alarm device, can receive and transmit instructions through a communication module in real time to carry out good man-machine interaction with a user, the fire extinguishing and search and rescue device can replace a fireman to enter a fire scene for fire extinguishing and search and rescue, so that the personnel outside the scene can take corresponding measures, the rescue efficiency is improved, and the casualties of the fireman and the disaster-stricken are reduced.

title_en: Waterborne three-dimensional search and rescue system based on ship information platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waterborne three-dimensional search and rescue system and method based on a ship information platform, wherein the system comprises a positioning device, a search and rescue device and a control center, wherein the positioning device is connected with the control center and used for positioning the specific direction of a person to be rescued and sending the specific direction to the control center; the control center receives positioning information sent by the positioning device and sends the positioning information to the search and rescue device; the search and rescue device is driven to the rescued person according to the positioning information; the radar map and the chart are combined to serve as the most basic map displaying method, emergency beacon rescue, radar chart positioning, unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue and photoelectric evidence obtaining search and rescue are comprehensively adopted, when the specific position of a rescued person is located, the position is displayed on the combination of the radar map and the chart, the intelligent life buoy is automatically thrown out, the position of the intelligent life buoy is displayed simultaneously, and the rescue can be timely unfolded even if the visibility is not high and the situation is severe.

title_en: Rescue robot escape method based on multi-objective optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue robot escape method based on multi-objective optimization. The method comprises the steps that a distributed sensing system and an airborne sensor on a rescue robot are used for obtaining data of hazard source information in a post-disaster rescue environment; establishing a mathematical model, obtaining the regional danger degree in the environment model of the rescue robot working under different dangerous source states and distribution, combining the path cost and the risk cost of the dangerous domain, and establishing a comprehensive cost evaluation index; on the basis of the model, a comprehensive cost decision method of a neighborhood expansion process combined with an A Star algorithm is adopted to realize selection of an optimal safe exit target and corresponding path output. The algorithm can well reduce the path length and reduce the risk brought by the danger source in the post-disaster rescue scene on the target selection and the path output in the constructed simulation rescue environment, can be used in the post-disaster rescue scene with the danger source, and can realize the escape route planning when the robot finishes tasks or emergencies.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue method, system, equipment and medium based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a maritime search and rescue method, a maritime search and rescue system, maritime search and rescue equipment and a medium based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving approximate azimuth information sent by the personnel involved in the marine accident, and informing the search and rescue ship to start to the approximate azimuth information; determining an incident airspace according to the approximate azimuth information and generating a corresponding search route; controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly to the incident airspace to fly along the search air route and shooting corresponding image data; determining all suspected risk-related targets in the search route according to the image data shot by the unmanned aerial vehicle; respectively positioning all suspected risk-involved targets according to the flight data of the unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain corresponding suspected risk-involved target coordinates; the rescue vehicle has the advantages that the rescue vehicle can accurately position the personnel involved in the marine accident through the unmanned aerial vehicle, accurately position the ship and the personnel in danger, facilitate the search and rescue of the ship to quickly and timely reach and deploy for rescue, and improve the success rate of search and rescue.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue positioning method, system, equipment and storage medium based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a maritime search and rescue positioning method, a maritime search and rescue positioning system, maritime search and rescue positioning equipment and a storage medium based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving distress information sent by distress persons of the marine accident; determining an incident airspace according to the approximate azimuth information and generating a corresponding search route; controlling an unmanned aerial vehicle to fly to the incident airspace to fly along the search air route, shooting corresponding image data and synchronously recording the flight data of the unmanned aerial vehicle; determining whether a suspected risk-involved target exists in the search route according to the image data shot by the unmanned aerial vehicle; controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to lock and track the suspected dangerous object to be close to the suspected dangerous object, and confirming whether the suspected dangerous object is a dangerous person of a marine accident; the rescue ship can quickly and timely arrive by accurately positioning the risk-involved personnel of the marine accident through the unmanned aerial vehicle and sending the risk-involved personnel to the search and rescue ship, so that the search and rescue ship is improved in success rate.

title_en: Multi-angle cloud platform for search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-angle cloud platform for a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a fixed plate, a first supporting base plate arranged at one end of the fixed plate, a second supporting base plate arranged above the first supporting base plate, a supporting plate connected with the second supporting base plate, a first connecting assembly arranged between the first supporting base plate and the second supporting base plate, a first check ring arranged at the other end of the supporting plate, a second check ring arranged opposite to the first check ring, and a second connecting assembly arranged between the first check ring and the second check ring. According to the multi-angle cloud platform for the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, the first supporting base plate and the second supporting base plate are connected through the first connecting assembly, so that the fixing plate is conveniently connected with the supporting plate, in addition, the first retaining ring and the second retaining ring are conveniently connected through the second connecting assembly, and further, the other end of the supporting plate is conveniently connected with the mounting plate.

title_en: Beyond-visual-range VR intelligent search and rescue system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an beyond-visual-range VR intelligent search and rescue system which is characterized by comprising an beyond-visual-range remote display and control system, a 5G intelligent search and rescue robot and a search and rescue system cloud server; the over-the-horizon remote display and control system, the 5G intelligent search and rescue robot and the search and rescue system cloud server are connected to a public network through wires or wireless connections, and bidirectional interconnection communication is achieved. The beyond-the-horizon VR intelligent search and rescue system can implement movable search and rescue on the post-disaster site, combines immersive 5G beyond-the-horizon remote control operation, does not need search and rescue personnel and the search and rescue system to be in the same area and city, can rapidly deploy search and rescue force to the post-disaster site, and realizes beyond-the-horizon remote search and rescue and deep operation at the first moment after the disaster.

title_en: Rescue robot based on small-bore deep well
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rescue robot based on small-bore deep well, which relates to the technical field of robots and comprises a connecting block, a grabbing mechanism and an auxiliary mechanism, wherein reinforcing rods are arranged at the corners of a cross rod and the connecting block, a fixed sleeve is fixedly connected on the reinforcing rods, a support rod is fixedly connected at the bottom of the fixed sleeve, a rotating block is rotatably connected at the bottom of the support rod, a turntable is fixedly connected on the support rod, a cylinder is fixedly connected at the bottom of the turntable, a connecting ball is arranged at the output end of the cylinder, a slide rail is arranged at the outer side of an arc-shaped clamping plate, and the connecting ball is movably connected in the slide rail, the device adjusts the angle of the arc-shaped clamping plate through a driving piece, thereby smoothly and efficiently completing grabbing the armpit of the upper limb of a trapped person, reducing the secondary injury to the trapped person, enabling the trapped person to be successfully rescued, and being conscious, can provide assistance for trapped people by adjusting the height of the floating plate, enhance the safety of the trapped people and improve the success rate of rescue.

title_en: Earthquake search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides an earthquake search and rescue robot, which comprises a robot body, wherein a group of wings are symmetrically arranged on the side parts of the front end and the rear end of the robot body respectively, the wings are connected with propellers, the front end of the robot body is also provided with a wide-angle camera, the wings are also provided with an adsorption device and a motor, the wings are connected with the robot body through the adsorption device, a pulley is arranged below the robot body, and the pulley is connected with the robot body through a connecting guide rod; the bottom and the side part of the robot body are also provided with a plurality of signal lamps. The utility model discloses earthquake search and rescue robot to a great extent has reduced search and rescue personnel and has searched for and rescued the during operation unnecessary physical demands. The robot solves the problem of single function limitation of the robot in large-space application, can operate in the air and on the ground, and shortens the search and rescue time.
assignees: SHAANXI ZHONGJIAN JIANLE INTELLIGENT ROBOT CO LTD

title_en: Small-sized traversing robot based on arm-carried vision
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a small-size robot that passes through based on vision is carried to arm, including robot main part and the control unit, eight arm-sufficient walking modules, picture biography module, every arm-sufficient walking module includes three motion axis, a buffering cushion, a vision module, an omniwheel, eight arm-sufficient walking modules are all installed on the robot body, the omniwheel is all installed to the end of every arm-sufficient walking module, the vision module is all installed to every arm-sufficient walking module inboard, the vision module gathers the robot surrounding environment information, the picture biography module transmits the environmental information that the robot gathered. The utility model discloses can realize biped formula, four-footed formula, six-footed formula moving means and wheeled and rolling moving means, carry on visual module, can realize two meshes, trinocular, six visual sense and gather image information. The whole unique arm-foot walking module structure design is combined with the vision module to realize that the robot can feel the surrounding environment to move in an all-around and autonomous manner. The utility model has the characteristics of rational in infrastructure, small, the quality is light, the motion is nimble, reliable and stable etc, can promote and be applied to the search and rescue task of complex environment.
assignees: TIANJIN UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY AND EDUCATION CHINA VOCATIONAL TRAINING INSTRUCTOR TRAINING CENTER;TIANJIN BONUO INTELLIGENT CREATIVE ROBOTICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Air cavity positioning measurement method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cavitation positioning measurement method, which comprises the following steps: a plurality of knocking points and a plurality of sound pickups are arranged on the outer side of the bottom of the inverted hull; knocking each knocking point one by one; collecting a sound signal and a resonance echo signal generated by knocking each time; respectively carrying out decoupling operation on the sound signal and the resonance echo signal to obtain a resonance frequency section; the resonance frequency section comprises a time domain signal and resonance frequencies which are arranged in an increasing order according to the time domain signal; obtaining a two-dimensional space position of the air pocket according to the resonance frequency section; from the resonant frequency band, the volume of the air pocket is obtained. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the speed of positioning the air cavity position is extremely high, and the accuracy rate is extremely high; compared with the prior art, the labor cost is greatly saved, and the working potential safety hazard of search and rescue personnel is greatly reduced; compared with the prior art, the rescue robot is not influenced by environmental factors such as water depth, visibility and water temperature, and can implement effective rescue even in a severe environment.

title_en: Multi-functional fire rescue robot in community
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a community multifunctional fire-fighting rescue robot, which relates to the technical field of fire-fighting rescue, and comprises an automatic fire-fighting sprinkler, wherein a water tank is arranged in the automatic fire-fighting sprinkler, a motor is fixedly connected on the water tank, a rotating rod is arranged on the motor, a first half gear is fixedly connected on the rotating rod, a sliding block is slidably connected on the automatic fire-fighting sprinkler, a rack bar is fixedly connected on the right side of the sliding block, the back part of the first half gear is meshed with the rack bar, the community multifunctional fire-fighting rescue robot drives the rotating rod to rotate through the motor work, and can drive the first movable bar to move up and down, thereby adjusting the height of a sprinkler pipe by adjusting a telescopic pipe, the existing community multifunctional fire-fighting rescue robot cannot adjust the height of the sprinkler pipe after entering a fire disaster, can not be adjusted according to the fire condition, thereby reducing the fire extinguishing efficiency.

title_en: Laser for field search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention provides a laser for field search and rescue, which comprises: the laser comprises a laser outer shell, wherein a display screen and an operation panel are fixedly arranged on the laser outer shell, a loudspeaker is arranged on a first partition plate, a processor, a controller, a positioning module and a wireless transceiving module are arranged on a second partition plate, and a storage battery is also arranged in a second cavity; the inclined rods are multiple in number and at least fixedly provided with a laser transmitter, a laser receiver, a light supplement lamp and a camera; the infrared laser thermal imager is fixedly arranged on the positioning frame, and the integrated switch is in signal connection with the laser transmitter, the laser receiver, the light supplementing lamp and the camera. The invention provides a laser for field search and rescue, which is internally provided with a laser transmitter, a laser receiver, an infrared laser thermal imager and other related structures, improves the search and rescue efficiency in many aspects, is internally provided with a structure for carrying out key detection on key ranges, can simultaneously adjust the detection directions and is more convenient to use.

title_en: Elastic force field-based bee colony collision avoidance control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bee colony collision avoidance control method based on an elastic force field, and belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle formation control. The method comprises the steps of firstly, obtaining initial spatial position information of unmanned aerial vehicle formation, and constructing and generating an initial unmanned aerial vehicle formation grid by adopting a Delaunay diagram method; then constructing a swarm elastic disturbance resisting equation based on a global elastic force field method, and determining an elastic force field boundary condition; and finally, calculating and adjusting the flying position of the nodes in the unmanned formation in real time in the movement process. Simulation shows that the swarm collision avoidance control method designed by the invention has higher practicability and better robustness, can better solve the problem of unmanned swarm flight collision avoidance control in strong disturbance airflow, and has wide application prospect in military and civil fields such as unmanned plane swarm battle, unmanned plane collaborative search and rescue, unmanned plane group performance and the like.

title_en: Omnidirectional wheel device for rescue robot
