abstract_en: The invention discloses an omnidirectional wheel device for a rescue robot, which controls the shape of a wheel carrier in a regular polygon through a first transverse plate, a second transverse plate and a vertical plate, and is divided into a plurality of accommodating spaces, wherein each accommodating space corresponds to a driving part comprising an omnidirectional wheel, and omnidirectional running is realized by the omnidirectional wheel; meanwhile, the connecting piece is arranged on the outer edge of the wheel frame, and the wheel frames can be connected together through the connecting piece, so that a larger movable bearing device is formed, larger support can be realized, and larger bearing capacity can be obtained. When a plurality of wheel brackets are arranged on the bearing body, only a plurality of hexagonal grooves need to be designed to be clamped, the design requirement is simple, and if one set of wheel bracket is damaged, a device which is directly replaced and renewed is clamped. The search and rescue robot has the advantages of achieving the effects of universality, quick replacement and convenient operation, and solving the problems that the existing search and rescue robot can not achieve omnidirectional traveling and can not improve bearing capacity through combination at the same time.

title_en: Unmanned inspection, search and rescue and disinfection robot and working method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned inspection search and rescue disinfection robot and a working method thereof.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting rescue robot structure based on 5G communication network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting rescue robot structure based on a 5G communication network, relates to the technical field of fire-fighting rescue, and solves the problem that an existing robot cannot continuously and quickly collect, filter and discharge smoke. An intelligent fire-fighting rescue robot structure based on a 5G communication network comprises a mobile base; the main body of the mobile base is a crawler-type mobile device; the main body of the water tank is of a T-shaped structure, and the water tank is fixedly arranged at the top of the movable base; the top of the rear side of the water tank is provided with an L-shaped turning exhaust structure; through being provided with the air inlet section of thick bamboo, for the robot provides the flue gas and collects the function, the quantity of air inlet section of thick bamboo is four groups, can evenly absorb the air of equidirectional not, and then reduces the flue gas in the fire scene, and filters the water that the cotton board lasts in the contact water tank, keeps moist through diffusion phenomenon, can filter the flue gas.

title_en: Search and rescue robot suitable for complicated topography
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and discloses a search and rescue robot suitable for complex terrains, which comprises a box body, two groups of front planetary wheel sets and two groups of rear planetary wheel sets, wherein: the two groups of front planetary wheel sets are symmetrically arranged on the left side and the right side of the front part of the box body, the two groups of rear planetary wheel sets are symmetrically arranged on the left side and the right side of the rear part of the box body, the front planetary wheel set and the rear planetary wheel sets respectively comprise a driving motor, a gear box and a planetary wheel, the gear box is of an equilateral triangle box body structure, three corners are respectively connected with the planetary wheel, a gear is arranged in the gear box, a rotating shaft of the planetary wheel is meshed with the gear, and an output shaft of the driving motor is connected with an input shaft of the gear box; the rear planetary wheel set further comprises a steering motor, a driving gear and a driven gear, the driven gear is fixed on a gear box of the rear planetary wheel set, the driving gear is arranged on an output shaft of the steering motor of the rear planetary wheel set, and the driving gear is meshed with the driven gear. The robot has higher obstacle crossing capability and is very beneficial to the application of complex terrains.

title_en: Underwater robot
abstract_en: The application discloses underwater robot includes: the side part of the sealed cabin is provided with a vertical propeller, one end of the sealed cabin is provided with a first transverse propeller, and the other end of the sealed cabin is provided with a second transverse propeller; the bow diversion shell is arranged on the outer side of the sealed cabin, which is provided with the first transverse propeller; and the stern diversion shell is arranged on the outer side of the sealed cabin provided with the second transverse propeller, and the stern diversion shell is provided with an advancing propeller. According to the scheme, the AUV and the ROV are combined, and a full-freedom-degree control scheme is adopted, so that effective search and rescue can be realized in a complex water area with large storms and many obstacles.
assignees: CETC OCEAN INFORMATION TECH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue robot based on multi-agent
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a search for and rescue the robotechnology field, specifically be a search for and rescue the robot based on multi-agent, including search for and rescue the robotechnology main part, search for and rescue the robotechnology main part and include camera and automobile body, and the camera downside is provided with the automobile body, the camera downside is provided with dismouting mechanism, and the camera downside has all linked firmly first connecting plate, the one end that the camera was kept away from to first connecting plate is inserted and is established in the spout, and sets up inside the second connecting plate outside the spout, second connecting plate upside all links firmly at the automobile body inner wall, and the inside second fluting of having seted up of first connecting plate, the inside third connecting plate that is equipped with of inserting of second fluting, and one side that first connecting plate was kept away from to the third connecting plate has linked firmly the spring, the one end that the third connecting plate was kept away from to the spring links firmly on second connecting plate inner wall. The utility model discloses camera and automobile body are when installing and demolising, and is simpler convenient, sparingly installs demolish time, promotes work efficiency, and subsequent maintenance of being convenient for detects.

title_en: Rescue robot-based on-site investigation and material supply method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue robot-based on-site exploration and material supply method, system and equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a planned path entering a rescue place based on a prior map, and sending an operation instruction to a chassis control system based on the planned path so that the rescue robot enters an accident scene according to the planned path according to the operation instruction; acquiring environmental data and real-time picture data of an accident scene, identifying the environmental data of the disaster scene in real time by utilizing a multi-classifier fusion algorithm, and transmitting the environmental data and the real-time picture data to a command center; and receiving a rescue strategy formulated by the command center according to the real-time image data, and completing field investigation and material supply based on the rescue strategy. Therefore, the technical problems of on-site exploration and low material supply efficiency of the rescue robot in the prior art are solved.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH NATIONAL SAFETY TRAINING CENTER OF COAL MINES

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device and search and rescue method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device and a search and rescue method thereof.
assignees: GUANGDONG NASASI COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Double-light fusion unmanned aerial vehicle's image acquisition system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image acquisition system of a double-light fusion unmanned aerial vehicle, and belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle image acquisition. The above-mentioned system includes: the system comprises a data acquisition module, an intelligent data processing module and a real-time data transmission module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring visible light images and infrared light images and transmitting the acquired images to the intelligent data processing module for image processing and fusion, and the real-time data transmission module is used for receiving the images fused by the intelligent data processing module and transmitting the images to a ground end through a communication link of a specific frequency band by an airborne image transmission sky end in real time. The method utilizes the topology self-adaptive snake algorithm model to process the visible light and infrared light images, can realize quick fusion, real-time display, low-delay quick transmission and the like of double light images, can effectively solve the problems that forest fire points are not easy to find, personnel search and rescue are easy to miss and the like, and can perform more accurate corresponding operation.
assignees: HEILONGJIANG VOCATIONAL COLLEGE OF BIOLOGY SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a body and a rescue box carried by the body; the rescue box is clamped by the symmetrically arranged L-shaped first clamping jaws to be kept stable; the organism below sets up electronic capstan winch, when the rescue place is unsuitable to descend, puts in the rescue case for stranded personnel through the rope, sends out the signal by flight controller, makes first clamping jaw relieve the rescue case, makes capstan winch work, rope drive rescue case slowly descend again, and after the rescue case descends to suitable position, the distance sensor of the bottom of the case sends out the signal and makes the second clamping jaw relieve the rescue case, makes the rescue case drop near stranded personnel. In order to avoid the situation that the rescue box shakes or a rope is wound around an obstacle when the rescue box descends, an annular air column covering the periphery of a winch is arranged below a machine body and is in a folded state before the annular air column is not inflated, when the winch is folded and unfolded, the annular air column is inflated or deflated, the annular air column is extended after being inflated, and the lower end of the annular air column abuts against the rescue box, so that the rescue box and the rope can be kept stable in the descending process.
assignees: ZHEJIANG YUFENG AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Forest clearance barrier search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides an inter-forest obstacle-clearing search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle body, a plurality of propeller blades and an unmanned aerial vehicle remote control system, the plurality of propeller blades are fixedly arranged on the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle body, the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle is provided with an embedded groove, a hydraulic lifting rod and a cutting device are arranged in the caulking groove, the hydraulic lifting rod comprises a hydraulic system and a plurality of cylindrical short pipes with gradually reduced radiuses, the plurality of cylindrical short pipes are movably connected in sequence from large radius to small radius and are connected with a hydraulic system and are controlled by the hydraulic system to stretch, a supporting frame is arranged in the cylindrical short pipe with the smallest radius, the cutting device comprises a motor and a cutting knife, the cutting knife comprises a rotary knife shaft and a cutting blade, the motor is fixedly installed on the support frame of the cylindrical short pipe with the smallest radius, and the hydraulic system and the cutting device are controlled by the unmanned aerial vehicle remote control system through the PLC.
assignees: ZHEJIANG YUFENG AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rescue robot and rescue method for comprehensive pipe rack rail-mounted robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue robot of a comprehensive pipe rack rail-mounted robot, wherein the rescue robot and a fault robot are both comprehensive pipe rack rail-mounted robots and run on rails in a pipe rack, and the rescue robot is characterized in that: a plurality of RFID radio frequency tags are arranged at intervals along the track in sequence, and the fault robot is provided with a radio frequency tag identifier for feeding back the position of the fault robot when the fault robot passes through the RFID radio frequency tags; the rescue robot comprises an obstacle identification device, a distance measuring device, an anti-collision slow-connection device and a dragging device which are arranged on a rescue robot body; obstacle recognition device detects the place ahead and whether has trouble robot, and range unit measures rescue robot and trouble robot's distance, and anticollision buffer device is used for buffering and thick butt joint, drags the device and is used for dragging rescue robot back. Hang rail formula robot and break down the back in the piping lane, hang rail formula rescue robot and pull out trouble place with trouble robot, avoid the robot trouble to lead to the influence of efficiency of patrolling and examining to the piping lane.

title_en: Earthquake search and rescue device based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle, in particular to an earthquake search and rescue device based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, aiming at the problem that the existing search and rescue device is not convenient to shrink, which causes the influence on the flight of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the proposal is provided, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is fixedly connected with a connecting plate, the top of the connecting plate is provided with a groove, the inner part of the groove is fixedly connected with a motor, the outer wall of the motor output shaft is fixedly sleeved with a straight gear, the straight gear is meshed with a rack, the right side of the connecting plate is provided with a rectangular groove, one end of the rack is fixedly connected with a U-shaped plate, the outer wall of the U-shaped plate is connected with the inner wall of the rectangular groove in a sliding way, the inner part of the rectangular groove is connected with a plurality of positioning devices in a sliding way, the outer wall of the connecting plate is rotatably connected with a baffle, the earthquake search and rescue device is convenient to shrink, the flying is more stable, the structure is simple, and the use is convenient.

title_en: Real-time disaster information detection system and method using artificial intelligence and drone images
title_ko: 인공지능과 드론 영상을 이용한 실시간 재난정보 탐지 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a real-time information detection system and a method using artificial intelligence and drone images, and more specifically, to a real-time information detection system and a method using artificial intelligence and drone images, wherein drones, artificial intelligence and real-time mapping techniques are connected as a single system to make disaster investigation practices convenient and to construct an advanced system capable of grasping a disaster situation swiftly. According to an aspect of the present invention, comprised are: a drone for photographing a disaster area through a camera mounted on a main body to obtain still image information and video information; a controller for controlling the flight of the drone by communicating wirelessly with the drone and receiving information related to the flight of the drone and the still image information and video information of the disaster area; a router for communicating wirelessly with the controller; and an analysis server connected to the router to receive the information related to the flight of the drone and the still image information and video information of the disaster area, which are transmitted through the router from the controller, and to store the same in a database, analyzing disaster type detection information by inference from the still image information based on a preset artificial intelligence model, analyzing human detection information by inference from the video information, and visualizing and providing the analyzed disaster type detection information and the human detection information through an online web.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 인공지능과 드론 영상을 이용한 실시간 재난정보 탐지 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 드론, 인공지능, 실시간 매핑 기술을 하나의 체계로 연계하여 재난조사 실무에서 편리하고, 신속하게 재난 상황을 파악할 수 있는 고도화된 체계를 구축할 수 있는 인공지능과 드론 영상을 이용한 실시간 재난정보 탐지 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 일측면에 따르면, 본체에 탑재된 카메라를 통해 재난 지역을 촬영하여 정지영상 정보 및 동영상 정보를 획득하기 위한 드론, 상기 드론과 무선 통신하여 상기 드론의 비행을 제어하고, 상기 드론의 비행 관련 정보와 재난 지역의 정지영상 정보 및 동영상 정보를 전송받는 조종기, 상기 조종기와 무선 통신하는 공유기 및 상기 공유기와 연결되어, 공유기를 통해 상기 조종기에서 전송되는 드론의 비행 관련 정보와 재난지역의 정지영상 정보 및 동영상 정보를 전송받아 데이터베이스에 저장하고, 기설정된 인공지능 모델을 기반으로 상기 정지영상 정보를 추론하여 재난 유형 탐지 정보를 분석하며, 상기 동영상 정보를 추론하여 사람 탐지 정보를 분석하여, 분석된 재난 유형 탐지 정보 및 사람 탐지 정보를 온라인 웹(Web)을 통해 가시화하여 제공하기 위한 분석 서버를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Dynamic path planning auxiliary management system for mobile robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic path planning auxiliary management system of a mobile robot, which relates to the technical field of mobile rescue robots and comprises a rescue module: the processing module is used for searching the data of the vital signs of a region: processing the data acquired by the rescue module, determining the position of the vital body characteristics, and sensing the module: determining the positions of all barriers in the region from the current position of the mobile robot to the vital sign position to form corresponding data information, and controlling the module to: the method comprises the steps of acquiring data information of the sensing module, uploading data signals to the calculating module, acquiring a global optimal path by the calculating module through a calculating method, returning the global optimal path to the control module, controlling the mechanical module to move by the control module, and enabling the mechanical module to reach the vital sign position through the global optimal path.

title_en: Medical rescue robot, system and method for victims poisoned in high-toxicity environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical rescue robot for a poisoned wounded person in a high-toxicity environment.A image acquisition module is used for acquiring high-toxicity environment information and controlling a walking mechanism to reach the position near the poisoned wounded person through an intelligent controller to implement rescue operation; the multi-joint actuating mechanism is provided with a micro lead screw stepping motor, an injection needle clamping device and a pressure sensor, the injection needle clamping device is arranged at the front end of the micro lead screw stepping motor and is used for clamping an injection needle, and a thrust lead screw of the micro lead screw stepping motor is just abutted against the rear end of the injection needle after reaching the maximum stroke; the front end of the pressure sensor is aligned with the front end of the injection needle and used for feeding back a pressure value to the intelligent controller, and the intelligent controller corrects the pressing position and the injection position according to the pressure value and performs injection when the pressure value reaches a preset threshold value. The robot self-rescue system realizes robot self-rescue, replaces manual on-site rescue, avoids the harm of chemical poisoning to rescuers, and has a great application prospect.
assignees: INST MILITARY MEDICINE ACADEMY MILITARY SCIENCES PLA

title_en: Disaster rescue robot system
title_ko: 재난 구조용 로봇 시스템
abstract_en: According to one aspect of the present invention, a robot system for disaster rescue comprises: a first robot which has a first body, a bed coupled to the first body, a main driving unit driving the first body, and a rail driving unit; and a second robot where a rail which can be docked to the rail driving unit is hinge-coupled to the rail driving unit of the first robot. The present invention can stably transfer an emergency patient along stairs or a tilted place.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 측면에 따른 재난 구조용 로봇 시스템은, 제1 몸체, 상기 제1 몸체에 결합된 베드, 상기 제1 몸체를 구동시키는 메인 구동부, 및 상기 제1 몸체 결합되어 도킹된 레일을 따라 구동하는 레일 구동부를 포함하는 제1 로봇 및 상기 제1 로봇의 상기 레일 구동부에 도킹 가능한 상기 레일이 힌지 결합된 제2 로봇을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Intelligent cruise search and rescue robot under foot type coal mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a foot type underground intelligent cruising search and rescue robot for a coal mine, which comprises an object carrying unit, a leg unit, a control and communication and human body detection unit and an image acquisition, radar ranging and auxiliary function unit, wherein the object carrying unit is directly connected with the leg unit as the main body of the device, the control and communication and human body detection unit is arranged in the object carrying unit, and the image acquisition, radar ranging and auxiliary function unit is arranged on the surface of the object carrying unit. Can effectively assist rescue workers to know the positions of the difficult workers and the specific conditions in the mine.

title_en: Multifunctional water search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a multifunctional water search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle. Arrange one telescoping device (6) down on the diapire of unmanned aerial vehicle body, diapire is passed in multipurpose pipe (2), and the telescopic shaft of telescoping device (6) is multipurpose pipe (2), and multipurpose pipe (2) cavity, hollow multipurpose pipe (2) embeds there is built-in inflatable structure (8), when aerifing enough can dismantle that air cushion part (3) fall into water, built-in inflatable structure (8) continue to aerify and let atmospheric pressure enough big can press disconnected easy-to-break pin. The multifunctional detachable air cushion part (3) is creatively utilized, the unmanned aerial vehicle can deliver the multifunctional detachable air cushion part (3), the multifunctional detachable air cushion part is intelligently transmitted to people needing to be rescued, the detachable air cushion part (3) can rescue people, and the detachable air cushion part (3) can serve as a buffer structure and can rescue people in flood.
assignees: SHAANXI LANYUE UAV TECH CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine detection and rescue robot with glider and working method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-provided glider type coal mine detection and rescue robot and a working method thereof, which are suitable for underground coal mine disaster relief. The device comprises a traveling mechanism, a launching frame is arranged on the traveling mechanism, a horizontal angle control system and an elevation angle control system are arranged between the traveling mechanism and the launching frame, a launching track and a pneumatic thrust device for providing launching power are arranged on the launching frame, a glider is arranged on the launching track, a video acquisition device and a wireless transmission device are arranged on the glider, the shape of an obstacle and the distance between the obstacle and the obstacle are firstly measured by an ultrasonic range finder inside a robot, the yaw angle and the pitch angle of a launching platform of the glider are adjusted by a stepping motor on the robot and an electric push rod arranged in the launching frame, and the glider is launched by the counterthrust generated by an air bag on the launching frame. In the flight process of the glider, a CCD camera in the glider is used for collecting images of dangerous environments. The device has reasonable design and convenient use, and effectively enlarges the detection distance.

title_en: Rescue robot for searching trapped people for fire fighting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire control is with searching stranded personnel's rescue robot, including removing the base, remove the base bottom and install the removal gyro wheel that has self-locking mechanism, remove the base and be fixed with the machine mount pad, machine mount pad top middle part is provided with the rotation stand, machine mount pad inner chamber bottom is installed driving motor, driving motor right side output has cup jointed drive bevel gear, it runs through machine mount pad top and has cup jointed driven bevel gear to rotate the stand bottom, drive bevel gear and driven bevel gear intermeshing, it is fixed with the fixing base to rotate the stand outer wall to be located machine mount pad top cup joint, the symmetrical bridge crane of fixing base left and right sides, two sets of bridge cranes keep away from one side each other and install the rotation axle bed, the utility model discloses the device is pinned to the stone and the beam column centre gripping of stranded personnel top, then drives first power armed lever through first hydraulic telescoping rod and second hydraulic telescoping rod, The second power arm carries the stone and the beam column and moves away.

title_en: Infrared thermal imaging reconnaissance flashlight
abstract_en: An infrared thermal imaging reconnaissance flashlight comprises a flashlight body, a sucker, a mobile terminal, an infrared thermal imaging assembly, a highlight lens assembly and a charging assembly; the sucker is arranged on the flashlight body; the mobile terminal is arranged on the sucker; the infrared thermal imaging assembly, the highlight lens assembly and the charging assembly are arranged on the flashlight body; the infrared thermal imaging component and the highlight lens component are electrically connected with the charging component. The utility model solves the problems that a single flashlight can not work all day long and can not find a remote search and rescue target in a special environment; the flashlight is suitable for night patrol and reconnaissance, adopts a domestic vanadium oxide uncooled infrared detector, has the functions of high-intensity illumination, remote thermal image detection, hotspot tracking and the like, adopts Wi-Fi transmission, and adopts a mobile phone APP for real-time observation.
assignees: BEIJING HENGSHENG JIUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional fire fighting helmet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multi-functional fire helmet, including helmet main body, helmet main body's front end is close to upside department and is provided with infrared camera, and infrared camera's right side is provided with the visible light camera, and helmet main body's rear side is provided with left fixed band and right fixed band, and helmet main body periphery is provided with outline and thermal shield. The multifunctional fire-fighting rescue robot has multiple functions of detecting a fire source, reproducing a scene, insulating heat, amplifying sound and the like, and improves the convenience and the high efficiency of fire-fighting rescue and daily training. In the actual rescue process, an infrared and visible light dual camera collects and stores an infrared image and a visible light image to a hard disk video recorder, and the infrared image and the visible light image are displayed through a helmet display; in the daily simulation training process, the scene rescue video stored in the hard disk video recorder is transmitted to the helmet display, so that the rescuers can more efficiently perform backstepping summary on the scene rescue work, and the speed of searching for a fire source and the work experience of searching for and rescuing by the fire rescue workers are improved.

title_en: Method for searching and rescuing unmanned aerial vehicle on water and method for amphibious emergency forced landing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a search and rescue method for an overwater unmanned aerial vehicle and an amphibious emergency forced landing method. Arrange one telescoping device (6) down on the diapire of unmanned aerial vehicle body, diapire is passed in multipurpose pipe (2), and the telescopic shaft of telescoping device (6) is multipurpose pipe (2), and multipurpose pipe (2) cavity, hollow multipurpose pipe (2) embeds there is built-in inflatable structure (8), when aerifing enough can dismantle that air cushion part (3) fall into water, built-in inflatable structure (8) continue to aerify and let atmospheric pressure enough big can press disconnected easy-to-break pin. The multifunctional detachable air cushion part (3) is creatively utilized, the unmanned aerial vehicle can deliver the multifunctional detachable air cushion part (3), the multifunctional detachable air cushion part is intelligently transmitted to people needing to be rescued, the detachable air cushion part (3) can rescue people, and the detachable air cushion part (3) can serve as a buffer structure and can rescue people in flood.
assignees: SHAANXI LANYUE UAV TECH CO LTD

title_en: Telescopic wriggling rescue robot in narrow and small space
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the fire rescue, concretely relates to telescopic wriggling rescue robot in narrow and small space, including preceding expansion plate and back expansion plate, the bottom intermediate junction of preceding expansion plate has the gear strip, and brake roller is installed to preceding expansion plate, and preceding expansion plate is equipped with the layer board, and the layer board is connected with the oxygen hose, and back expansion plate is equipped with the spout corresponding with the gear strip, and the downside of back expansion plate is connected with servo motor, and back expansion plate is connected with wheel power and brake equipment, and wheel power and brake equipment's power take off end is connected with the wheel. The utility model provides a telescopic wriggling rescue robot in narrow and small space cooperates the rescue work of narrow and small space rescue robot, effectively protects and the oxygen suppliment to being rescued personnel's head to avoid the secondary injury among the rescue process, structurally adopted range upon range of formula wriggling device, the resistance of its motion mode effectual reduction wriggling in-process, portability when guaranteeing not using simultaneously reduces the space and uses.
assignees: JINHUA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: High-trafficability all-terrain search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a high trafficability characteristic is all topography search and rescue robot. The two sides of the shell are respectively and symmetrically provided with an adjusting mechanism and a traveling mechanism; a driven gear is fixed on one side of the rotating frame close to the shell, the adjusting mechanism further comprises an adjusting motor, and the adjusting motor is in meshing transmission with the driven gear through a driving gear arranged on an output shaft of the adjusting motor so as to drive the rotating frame to rotate; the rotating frame is internally provided with a gravity center adjusting motor and a worm which are coaxially connected, the other end of the worm is rotatably assembled on the rotating frame, one side of the rotating frame, which is far away from the shell, is provided with two oscillating rods at intervals along the front-back direction, one end of each oscillating rod is fixed with a worm wheel, each oscillating rod is hinged with the rotating frame through a hinge shaft which is coaxial with the worm wheel, the worm wheels of the two oscillating rods are simultaneously meshed with the worm for transmission so as to drive the two oscillating rods to synchronously oscillate along the front-back direction under the driving of the worm, and the travelling mechanism comprises a support frame and a plurality of toothed wheels which are arranged at intervals along the length direction of the support frame. Has the advantages of high trafficability and simple structure.

title_en: Deep well rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a deep well rescue robot, the top of cylinder is equipped with the fixed disk, fixed block annular array is in the bottom of cylinder, be equipped with the fixed column between fixed block and the fixed disk, the top of fixed column is equipped with the slider, both ends are equipped with the mount respectively about fixed block and the slider, crawler attachment's top and bottom articulate respectively has upper connecting rod, lower connecting rod, the upper connecting rod, the free end of lower connecting rod articulates respectively on the mount of slider and the mount of fixed block, wherein lower connecting rod inclines upward, fixed plate annular array installs on the cylinder, install telescopic machanism between the frame seat of fixed plate and the fixing base, the window has been seted up at the middle part of fixed plate, the window department is installed and is prevented weighing down the wheel, fishing device is installed to the cylinder bottom, fishing device includes personnel rescue mechanism, drill bit fishing mechanism; the robot can replace rescue workers to go into the well to execute rescue tasks, and the condition that casualties appear when the rescue workers go into the well accidentally is avoided.

title_en: Method and equipment for positioning underground personnel in coal mine water permeability accident
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater beacon tracking systems, and discloses a method and equipment for positioning underground personnel in a coal mine water-permeable accident, which comprises an underwater search and rescue robot, an above-water control platform, an underwater beacon tracking system, a receiving system and an above-water control system, wherein the underwater beacon tracking system is processed inside a bracelet, the bracelet is worn by a mine worker, and the above-water control system is mainly provided with a display, a computer host, a control console, a control handle, a control relay and a control unit; in the invention, when a mine is in flood, a mine channel is submerged, people are trapped underground, the positions of the people in distress are not determined enough, the places where the escape people are located are difficult to guess, the positions of the people can be tracked through the underwater beacons in the detection bracelet worn by the mine workers, signals are sent to the underwater beacon receiving system, and the bracelet can also detect the vital signs of the people, determine the number of the people in distress and timely perform search and rescue.

title_en: Intelligent road identification and guidance control system for fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting robot road intelligent identification guidance control system, which comprises a dynamic acquisition unit, a road condition analysis unit, a mode matching unit, a data storage unit, a real-time communication unit and a control unit, wherein the dynamic acquisition unit is used for acquiring a road condition of a fire-fighting robot; acquire the thermal imaging image through infrared thermal imager, determine the risk after meshing processing and color value mark and explore the region, reachd the route sequence according to priority sequencing fast and select the optimum route, afterwards, road conditions analysis unit is comparing the analysis to various road conditions, confirm that fire-fighting robot can pass through the place ahead road smoothly, through setting up the mode matching unit, match the speed of fire-fighting robot when different road conditions, the problem that meets in the driving process of timely efficient solution fire-fighting robot, investigation and search and rescue efficiency have been improved.
assignees: ANHUI HUNING INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake auxiliary rescue vehicle and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue equipment, and discloses an earthquake auxiliary rescue vehicle and a rescue method, wherein the earthquake auxiliary rescue vehicle comprises a vehicle frame structure and the following components arranged on the vehicle frame structure: a search for and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle for receiving remote control signal in order to clear away the obstacle clearance mechanism of barrier, be used for the drive the hydraulic pressure of frame structure motion is moved and is moved away to avoid possible earthquakes wheelset, is used for surveying the life detection module of life sign relevant data, deposits medical supplies's medical kit and is fixed in on the medical kit. The earthquake auxiliary rescue vehicle and the rescue method can automatically realize automatic search and rescue after an earthquake, and avoid casualty of manual rescue.

title_en: Robot device for search and rescue in narrow space
abstract_en: The utility model provides a robot device for search and rescue in narrow and small space, including rescue exploration system, crawler-type chassis is provided with the track, be provided with a plurality of driving sprocket on the track, rescue exploration system is including edge computing device terminal, edge computing device terminal is connected with crawler-type chassis is used for the adjustment driving sprocket's drive power size. The utility model discloses can go deep into the unable area that arrives of rescue personnel and shoot the data and supply the rescue personnel to refer to, can carry on necessary rescue goods and materials and go deep into the narrow space in ruins and salvage stranded personnel, light in weight is difficult to arouse danger for the second time.
assignees: GUANGZHOU INTELLIGENT TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Be used for narrow and small space rescue split type robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a split type rescue robot used in a narrow space, which is used for detecting and rescuing people to be rescued in the narrow space. It includes rescue robot and peristaltic robot, the peristaltic robot is installed inside the rescue robot, the peristaltic robot includes preceding expansion plate and back expansion plate, preceding expansion plate is connected with preceding drive arrangement and preceding brake roller, back expansion plate is connected with back drive arrangement and back brake roller, back expansion plate is connected with wire rope, the rescue robot install with wire rope assorted coiler, preceding expansion plate is connected with the oxygen hose, preceding expansion plate is equipped with the oxygen mouth with the oxygen hose intercommunication, the rope couple is installed to the rescue robot, camera, gaseous detection device are installed to the rescue robot, two arms are installed to the rescue robot, the arm is equipped with the gripper, install the fixed clamping device of telescopic in the rescue robot.
assignees: JINHUA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Telescopic wriggling rescue robot in narrow and small space
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire rescue, and particularly relates to a telescopic peristaltic rescue robot in a narrow space, which comprises a front telescopic plate and a rear telescopic plate, wherein a gear strip is connected in the middle of the bottom of the front telescopic plate, a brake roller is installed on the front telescopic plate, the front telescopic plate is provided with a supporting plate, the supporting plate is provided with an oxygen pipe, the rear telescopic plate is provided with a sliding groove corresponding to the gear strip, the lower side of the rear telescopic plate is connected with a servo motor, the rear telescopic plate is connected with a wheel power and brake device, and the power output end of the wheel power and brake device is connected with a wheel. The invention provides a telescopic peristaltic rescue robot in a narrow space, which is matched with the rescue work of the rescue robot in the narrow space to effectively protect the head of a rescued person and supply oxygen, so that secondary damage in the rescue process is avoided.

title_en: Multi-scene universal four-wheel-drive rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-scene general four-wheel-drive rescue robot, which comprises a base and a crawler belt, and further comprises: the fixing cylinder is arranged above the base, the top of the fixing cylinder is fixedly connected with a fixing plate, the end part of the fixing plate is fixedly connected with a fixing rod, the outer surface of the fixing rod is provided with a torsion spring, and the end part of the torsion spring is fixedly connected with a baffle; the mounting groove is arranged at the top of the fixed cylinder; pusher, pusher sets up in the inside of a fixed section of thick bamboo, first draw-in groove has been seted up to the bottom of baffle, the internal surface of first draw-in groove is provided with first ultraviolet lamp, the second draw-in groove has been seted up to the internal surface of mounting groove, the inside of second draw-in groove is provided with second ultraviolet lamp, the internal surface fixed connection of mounting groove has the push pedal, the tip sliding connection of push pedal has places a section of thick bamboo for rescue article can obtain safer guarantee.
assignees: ANHUI HAIMATE RESCUE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Production line safety management method, system, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a production line safety management method, a system, a device and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of safety management, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring position information of trapped people; sending a preset rescue robot to the position of the trapped person based on the position information of the trapped person; acquiring the physiological state of the trapped person based on a preset rescue robot; and determining a corresponding rescue mode based on the physiological state of the trapped person. The method has the following effects: when some serious safety accidents occur, such as fire disasters, a preset rescue robot is dispatched to rescue by acquiring the position information of the trapped person, and the rescue robot can also determine a corresponding rescue mode according to the physiological state of the trapped person, so that the trapped person is initially rescued by the preset rescue robot, convenience is provided for subsequent rescuers, and the rescue difficulty is reduced to a certain extent.
assignees: HANGZHOU HONGXIN SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-contact type electric energy and data interaction time-sensitive beacon and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a time-sensitive beacon for non-contact electric energy and data interaction and a control method, wherein the time-sensitive beacon is positioned outside an underwater vehicle and is not electrically connected with the underwater vehicle; when the underwater vehicle encounters a fault and cannot float upwards, the time-sensitive beacons acquire state information of the equipment, whether the underwater vehicle encounters the fault and needs to float upwards is judged by a main control unit in the beacons through a decision tree, and water surface search and rescue personnel can accurately position the position of the vehicle according to the beacons; charging a battery in the beacon by using a wireless charging technology based on electromagnetic coupling, and simultaneously combining the wireless charging technology with battery current estimation based on fuzzy logic to realize the quick charging of the beacon battery with constant current and constant voltage; when the aircraft is not powered, the beacon can still work normally or be released; the scheme has low cost, does not need to deploy an acoustic emission source in advance, does not depend on external power supply, and has wider practical application and popularization value.

title_en: Mobile robot visual range coverage path planning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for planning a coverage path of a visual range of a mobile robot, which comprises the following steps: s1, abstracting the visual range of the camera to a fan-shaped plane, and therefore geometrically filling the map by using the fan-shaped plane; s2, planning the path according to the coverage result of the visible range node obtained in S1 in the map: and converting the coverage result into a traveling salesman problem to solve, and planning the path according to the visiting sequence. The method expands the coverage problem from point coverage to surface coverage, better meets the actual requirements of search and rescue tasks, can effectively shorten the path length, and improves the search efficiency.

title_en: Artificial intelligence search and rescue robot with keep away barrier function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots, in particular to an artificial intelligent search and rescue robot with an obstacle avoidance function, which comprises a robot body, wherein a U-shaped vertical plate is fixedly connected to the top of one end of the robot body, the inner walls of the upper and lower opposite edges of the U-shaped vertical plate are rotatably connected with a same vertically arranged lifting screw rod through ball bearings, a mounting seat is fixedly connected to the top of the other end of the robot body, a positioning screw cylinder is vertically and fixedly connected to the top of the mounting seat, a lifting sleeve is sleeved on the outer wall of the positioning screw cylinder in a sliding mode, a same anti-collision shield is sleeved on the outer wall of each sliding rod in a sliding mode, and the end, far away from the sliding rod, of each sliding rod comprises a limiting block. According to the invention, the lifting sleeve can be lifted through the rotating vertical screw rod, so that the lifting and descending of the road condition detector and the signal collector are realized, the detection and signal collection of the road condition detector and the signal collector aiming at different road conditions and environments are improved, the working efficiency is improved, and the time is strived for search and rescue.

title_en: Novel rescue robot
abstract_en: A novel rescue robot relates to the field of fire rescue. Comprises a robot main body, a mechanical arm, a tool rack and an accessory. The mechanical arm and the tool rack are both arranged on the robot main body. The mechanical arm is provided with a connecting part which is detachably connected with the accessory. The tool rack is provided with a plurality of mounting positions, each mounting position comprises a positioning plate, and each positioning plate is provided with a notch which is formed by extending the edge of the positioning plate towards the middle part of the positioning plate. The accessory is provided with a matching part matched with the notch, and the accessory is fixedly connected with the positioning plate along the direction vertical to the positioning plate. The novel rescue robot is simple in structure, accessories can be replaced quickly and conveniently, the response capability of a complex fire scene is greatly improved, the monomer response capability of the novel rescue robot is improved, and the rescue efficiency of the novel rescue robot is obviously improved.

title_en: Barrier-breaking rescue robot for biochemical environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to an obstacle-breaking rescue robot for biochemical environments, which comprises a robot main body, wherein one end of the robot main body is provided with a hydraulic driving excavating and crushing mechanism, the other end of the robot main body is movably provided with a cabin door, a medical cabin is arranged in the robot main body, a sickbed and a first linear sliding table are arranged in the medical cabin, the first linear sliding table is positioned above the side of the sickbed and fixed on the inner wall of the medical cabin through bolts, a second linear sliding table is arranged on the first linear sliding table in a sliding manner, a supporting beam is arranged at one end of the second linear sliding table, which is far away from the first linear sliding table, in a sliding manner, and a first rescue bracket assembly and a second rescue bracket assembly are movably arranged on the outer surface of one end of the supporting beam, which is far away from the second linear sliding table. The multifunctional rescue robot is convenient for rescuing faint personnel, can deal with various complex environments, and can safely rescue the groggy faint personnel.
assignees: ZHONGGUANCUN SCIENCE PARK INCUBATOR FOR CIVIL MILITARY INTEGRATION BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle fire fighting disposal system and method and storable medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for unmanned aerial vehicle fire fighting disposal and a storable medium, wherein the system comprises: the fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle cluster comprises a plurality of fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicles and is used for acquiring environmental information and fire information and carrying out fire early warning; the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle cluster comprises a plurality of search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicles and is used for completing search and rescue tasks when a fire occurs; the ground control station is connected with the fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle cluster and the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle cluster through a communication network, and is used for receiving and processing data of the fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle cluster and adjusting the working states of the fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle cluster and the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle cluster in time; the invention can effectively play the fire-fighting efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster and realize the treatment and search and rescue of fire.
assignees: SICHUAN WUJING ZHONGCHUANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Water rescue drone and method for controlling the same
title_ko: 수상 인명 구조용 드론 및 이를 제어하는 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for controlling a drone for lifesaving on the water, which comprises the steps of: when a distressed person is found by a user, using a vision sensor of a drone to obtain image information about the accident site on the water; setting the location of the distressed person in the image information by the user; flying a drone to the location of the distressed person; landing and flying the drone when the drone arrives within a certain distance from the location of the distressed person; inflating an air tube mounted on the drone when the drone lands on the water surface; and transmitting the current location information of the drone to a lifesaving center.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수상 인명 구조용 드론 제어 방법으로서, 사용자에 의해 조난자가 발견된 경우, 드론의 비전 센서를 이용하여 수상 사고 현장에 대한 영상 정보를 획득하는 단계, 상기 사용자에 의해 상기 영상 정보 내에서 상기 조난자의 위치가 설정되는 단계, 상기 조난자의 위치로 상기 드론을 비행시키는 단계, 상기 드론이 상기 조난자의 위치로부터 일정한 거리 내에 도달한 경우, 상기 드론을 착륙 비행시키는 단계, 상기 드론이 수면에 착륙한 경우, 상기 드론에 탑재된 에어튜브를 팽창시키는 단계 및 상기 드론의 현재 위치 정보를 인명 구조 센터로 송신하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KIM YONG CHEOL;DRONE MEDIA CO LTD

title_en: Disaster rescue robot
title_ko: 재난 구조용 로봇
abstract_en: A rescue robot in disaster according to one aspect of the present invention comprises: a body; a bed coupled to an upper part of the body so that the angle thereof can be adjusted; a main driving part coupled to a lower part of the body to drive the body; and a rail driving part coupled to a lateral side of the body and coupled to a rail installed outside to drive along the rail. The present invention provides the rescue robot in disaster, which can stably transport emergency patients along stairs or slopes.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 측면에 따른 재난 구조용 로봇은, 몸체, 상기 몸체 상부에 각도 조절 가능하게 결합된 베드, 상기 몸체 하부에 결합되어 상기 몸체를 구동시키는 메인 구동부 및 상기 몸체 측면에 결합되고, 외부에 설치된 레일과 결합하여 상기 레일을 따라 구동하는 레일 구동부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Coal mine search and rescue robot based on machine vision and motion control
abstract_en: A coal mine search and rescue robot based on machine vision and motion control comprises the following steps that 1, environmental data of the coal mine search and rescue robot are collected; step 2, training a detection model of the people in distress in the mine; step 3, designing a motion control system of the coal mine search and rescue robot: step 4, designing a primary navigation system of the coal mine search and rescue robot; and 5, processing and storing the data, wherein under the actual condition of mine disaster, the communication line is completely destroyed or partially paralyzed, and the communication cannot be used, so that the relevant data collected by the search and rescue robot is packaged by certain grouping, written into the SD card storage module according to the SPI communication protocol and used as the data support of return voyage. The design of the invention enables underground data to be acquired by the robot deep field detection, which is beneficial to the planning and commanding of field rescue, ensures the survival rate of trapped people and reduces unnecessary loss and disasters.

title_en: Guide system for emergency rescue
title_ko: 위급 상황 구조 가이드 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a guide system for emergency rescue, which uses the application of a mobile communication terminal such as a smartphone, which is an essential part of daily life, to make it easy to find a person to be rescued in an emergency situation where it is impossible to ask for help or lose consciousness due to carbon monoxide poisoning, and to reduce the time required to search for people. For example, disclosed is a guide system for emergency rescue. The guide system for emergency rescue comprises: an application unit which is installed in a mobile communication terminal, and outputs signals and information for a rescue personnel to recognize the location of a user at the rescue site by using at least one among a GPS function, a lighting function, a sound function, a call function, and a short-distance wireless communication function in the event of an emergency; and a life search device unit which provides signals and information for locating the user based on at least one of GPS signals and short-range wireless communication signals provided from the application unit, and operates to communicate with the user in conjunction with the call function of the application unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 위급 상황 구조 가이드 시스템에 관한 것으로, 해결하고자 하는 과제는 일상생활의 필수품인 스마트 폰과 같은 휴대통신단말의 어플리케이션을 이용하여 일산화탄소에 중독되어 의식을 잃거나 도움을 요청할 수 없는 위급 상황에서 구조대상자를 쉽게 발견할 수 있도록 하며, 인명검색에 걸리는 시간을 단축할 수 있도록 하는데 있다. 
일례로, 휴대통신단말에 설치되고, 위급상황발생 시 GPS기능, 조명기능, 음향기능 통화기능 및 근거리무선통신기능 중 적어도 하나를 이용해 구조현장에서 구조대원이 사용자의 위치를 인지하기 위한 신호와 정보를 출력하는 어플리케이션부; 및 상기 어플리케이션부로부터 제공되는 GPS신호 및 근거리무선통신신호 중 적어도 하나에 기초하여 사용자의 위치를 파악하기 위한 신호와 정보를 제공하고, 상기 어플리케이션부의 통화기능과 연동하여 사용자와 소통 가능하도록 동작하는 인명수색 장치부를 포함하는 위급 상황 구조 가이드 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Underwater search and rescue machine with six groups of propellers
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a contain machine of searching for and rescuing under water of six group's propellers, which comprises a bod, the first connecting plate of organism both sides fixedly connected with, the first impeller of first connecting plate one end fixedly connected with, first connecting plate and first impeller all are equipped with 4 altogether, first connecting plate is the streamline arc, organism one side fixedly connected with second connecting plate, second connecting plate both sides fixedly connected with second impeller, the second impeller is equipped with 2 altogether, the organism size is 380mm 350mm 170 mm. The underwater rescue robot adopts 6 groups of propellers with multi-vector layout, can be externally hung with 1 group of transverse moving propellers, can realize underwater full-attitude operation with six dimensions of advancing and retreating, heaving, translating, pitching, bow turning and rolling, has obviously improved depth-fixing anti-flow capacity, is more stable to control, adopts a compact machine body design of high-strength aluminum alloy and PC, has the weight of less than 5KG, is single-person and portable, can be carried by a plane, and can be quickly set to carry out operation.

title_en: Novel triangular prism-shaped artificial intelligence search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel triangular prism-shaped artificial intelligent search and rescue robot, and relates to the technical field of intelligent robots. This novel three prismatic form artificial intelligence search and rescue robot, which comprises a housin, the outside of casing is rotated and is connected with the walking wheel, fixed mounting has the camera between the walking wheel of the casing outside, the inside center of casing is rotated and is connected with the power shaft, the peripheral spacing sliding connection of power shaft has first gear. This novel three prismatic form artificial intelligence search and rescue robot has avoided the unsettled phenomenon of walking wheel, can be better through complicated search and rescue ground to can overturn and stride across great search and rescue obstacle, can make walking wheel outlying track switch between circular and triangle-shaped, make it can be fast through flat road surface, also can be through complicated road conditions, when the resistance is great, can increase the frictional force between walking wheel and the ground, avoided the emergence of the phenomenon of skidding.

title_en: Big data storage type rescue operation platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to a big data storage type rescue operation platform, which comprises: the mode selection device is used for switching the current running mode of the unmanned aerial vehicle to a rescue operation mode when more than one suspected fallen personnel picture exists in the received three-time processed image; the data judgment device is connected with the mode selection device and used for sending the current positioning data of the unmanned aerial vehicle as search and rescue positioning data when the current running mode of the unmanned aerial vehicle is switched to a rescue operation mode; the mode selection device is further used for switching the current operation mode of the unmanned aerial vehicle to a normal flight mode when more than one suspected fallen person picture does not exist in the received three processed images. By the aid of the method and the device, whether scenes that the sports personnel fall down and need to be rescued exist in each searched and rescued event area can be judged in real time based on the targeted visual detection result, and accordingly rescue efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle is guaranteed.
assignees: TAIZHOU LEIXIN AGRICULTURAL MACHINERY ELECTRIC MFG CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle data transmission method, device and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device and a system for data transmission of an unmanned aerial vehicle. Wherein unmanned aerial vehicle transmission system includes unmanned aerial vehicle subsystem, high in the clouds subsystem and ground satellite system, and the unmanned aerial vehicle data transmission device who is applied to the unmanned aerial vehicle subsystem includes: the switching communication unit is used for switching communication connection with the cloud subsystem; the direct connection communication unit is used for performing direct connection communication connection with the ground station subsystem; and the central control unit is used for generating a direct connection video and a switching video according to the original image data, so that the ground station subsystem acquires the direct connection video through the direct connection communication connection, and sends the switching video to the cloud subsystem through the switching communication connection. The beneficial effects lie in that, in case the circumstances such as the disconnection of direct connection communication takes place, can realize data transmission's switching through high in the clouds subsystem rapidly to ensure data transmission's real-time and reliability, promoted the security of unmanned aerial vehicle operation by a wide margin, provide the guarantee for unmanned aerial vehicle application scene that environmental conditions such as search and rescue are more abominable.

title_en: Air-ground communication search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a land-air communication search and rescue robot, which is controlled by a remote upper computer to carry out communication and detection, can search targets in a complex environment in a long distance through a series of designed land motion units and air motion units, can realize signal receiving and transmitting of surrounding communication equipment through an onboard relay module, and simultaneously wirelessly transmits images of the surrounding environment back to the remote upper computer. In addition, through reasonable deployment and use of the land motion unit, the air motion unit and the visual image module (5), the land-air communication search and rescue robot has the advantages of multiple functions, strong obstacle crossing capability, wide communication range, accurate detection information, long cruising ability and the like.

title_en: Rescue robot and rescue method for falling into well
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a rescue robot and a rescue method for falling into a well; the robot comprises a frame and a robot body, wherein the robot body comprises a detection robot, an arm, a bobbin, a cable, a force receiving arm, a pulley, a cylinder, two air pipes, a rubber layer and two shoulder belts, the bobbin is connected with the bobbin and the cable, the belt pulley is connected with the force receiving arm and the cable, the detection robot is connected with the arm, the cylinder and the shoulder belts, the air pipes are connected with the arm and the cylinder, the detection robot enters a well, the shoulder belts are fixed on shoulders of people to be trapped, the cylinder operates to transmit air to the arm through the air pipes, the arm rotates to hold the trapped people up, the detection robot rises to save the trapped people, the traditional well falling rescue method is solved, the hand of the trapped people has water stains and is slippery, and the grabbing robot is unstable and falls again.
assignees: ZHONGLIANG DAHUANGSHAN HIGH QUALITY DEVELOPMENT RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for field search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the unmanned air vehicle technique and specifically relates to indicate an open-air unmanned aerial vehicle that searches for ands rescue. It has solved the problem that current unmanned aerial vehicle is not convenient for adjust the camera. It includes quick-witted body, rotor, undercarriage, baffle, first cavity, second cavity, pivot, first apron, power and GPS, is equipped with the backup pad in the second cavity, is equipped with the support column in the backup pad, and threaded connection has the camera on the support column, is equipped with on the second cavity to drive camera longitudinal movement and can wind the axis pivoted actuating mechanism of support column simultaneously. The utility model discloses an actuating mechanism drives camera longitudinal movement to drive its axis rotation around the support column simultaneously, can change the visual area who adjusts the camera at any time in unmanned aerial vehicle's motion process, let the user can know open-air search and rescue environment clearly, do benefit to the open-air rescue of carrying out unmanned aerial vehicle, improve the search and rescue ability of rescue unmanned aerial vehicle in the open-air.
assignees: QINGHAI XINGRUI AGRICULTURE AND ANIMAL HUSBANDRY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional emergency rescue robot, which comprises a rescue robot body, wherein two crawler wheels convenient for the rescue robot body to move under different environments are symmetrically arranged at the bottom of the rescue robot body, two obstacle removing shovels for removing obstacles are symmetrically arranged at the tail part of one side of the rescue robot body, a material box for storing materials is arranged at one side of the rescue robot body away from the obstacle removing shovels, the material box is of a cavity structure with an opening at the top, a sealing cover for preventing dust from entering the material box is arranged at the top of the material box, and the dust on a protective net is cleaned through the rotation of a cleaning rod in the use process of the rescue robot body through the arrangement of a filtering component, so that the dust enters a dust collecting box and the problem of smoke discharge effect reduction caused by the blockage of the protective net is prevented, stability when using has been improved, has prolonged the effective life of fan of discharging fume, makes things convenient for the staff to use.
assignees: GUANGXI YIHAO NONGFU AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Underwater combined search and rescue robot and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an underwater combined search and rescue robot and a system, comprising a shell, a sealed cabin, a rescue device, a power propulsion device, a control device and a sensing device; the shell is symmetrical about a particle plumb surface and is in a double-water-drop symmetrical type; the control device is used for controlling the power propulsion device and the rescue device; the rescue device is used for fixing the searched target and is rotatably arranged on the left side and the right side of the shell; the power propulsion device is used for providing power and assisting the stability of the robot and is arranged in the shell. Therefore, the underwater combined search and rescue robot has the advantages of small resistance, uniform resistance, strong turbulent flow resistance, integration of search and rescue and automatic identification capability; through loRa wireless communication between a plurality of underwater search and rescue robot terminals, on the other hand provides a search and rescue system jointly under water based on LoRa and degree of depth study that possesses high-efficient search and rescue ability.

title_en: Deep well rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep well rescue robot, belonging to the technical field of rescue robots, and providing a deep well rescue robot, which comprises a frame body, wherein a lighting camera lamp and a motor can realize monitoring rescue in a whole lighting environment, meanwhile, the positive and negative rotation of the motor is controlled to realize the change fit connection between the guide device and the fixing device and the inner wall of the deep well, when the motor rotates positively, the first guide wheel can fit the inner wall of the deep well for guiding, when the motor rotates reversely, the second lug push plate is pushed to enable the rack to move together, so that the winding disc rotates and one end of the safety rope falls down, then the circular belt is sleeved in the shoulder socket of the difficult person, then when the motor continues to rotate forwards, the two groups of conical blocks are separated from the deep well, the first guide wheel can continue to guide, the circular belt can be accommodated and rolled up through the safety rope to be lifted, so that the difficult patient is in a vertical posture.
assignees: JIANGSU SANMING ZHIDA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Eight-foot robot with bionic rigid-flexible coupling legs and control method
abstract_en: The invention provides an eight-legged robot with bionic rigid-flexible coupling legs and a control method, wherein the search and rescue robot comprises a rack, a shell, rigid-flexible coupling legs, a control processing module, a sensing unit, a wireless transmission module, a motor driving module and a power supply module, the rigid-flexible coupling legs comprise eight pieces of same structures, and a left leg I, a left leg II, a left leg III and a left leg IV which are arranged on the left side of the rack and a right leg I, a right leg II, a right leg III and a right leg IV which are arranged on the right side of the rack are all composed of rigid joint blocks, joint shafts, feet, torsion springs, linear drivers, connecting pieces and spring steel sheets. The eight-foot robot combines the rigid joint block with the flexible spring steel sheet, has the advantages of compact structure, light weight, self-adaptive flexibility and the like, and can be used for tasks such as search and rescue, detection and the like.

title_en: Crawler-type search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an intelligent robot technical field discloses a crawler-type search and rescue robot, including crawler-type chassis, the revolving stage, the searchlight platform, the image recognition module, orientation module, compound sensor and power, be equipped with the rescue arm on the revolving stage, searchlight platform inside is equipped with communication module and whole machine control module, the top is equipped with many brightness control searchlight respectively, the barrier integrated module and infrared thermal imager are kept away to the infrared ray, communication module carries out the information interaction through thing networking card and high in the clouds server, the crawler-type chassis, the revolving stage, the rescue arm, many brightness control searchlight and communication module are connected with whole machine control module electricity respectively. The utility model discloses a crawler-type chassis can adapt to the environment of various complicacies, carries on multiple sensor and avoids the barrier, can search for and rescue work in the scene after the calamity fast in a flexible way, promotes search for and rescue efficiency and reliability, effectively reduces the loss of the property of life.

title_en: Long-distance sensing method for underground rescue robot based on LoRa
abstract_en: A long-distance sensing method of an underground rescue robot based on LoRa is characterized in that the robot carrying a receiver moves along an underground tunnel, a transmitter is fixed in the underground tunnel, two antennas arranged on the receiver respectively receive signals, and the influence of phase deviation is eliminated by utilizing signal quotient operation; in order to identify the human body activity signal under the interference of the robot moving signal, the signal is subjected to standardized processing by adopting empirical mode decomposition, and the signal received by a receiver is processed while the human body induction signal change mode is kept; in order to better distinguish the robot moving signal and the human body activity signal, a periodic characteristic is defined to quantize the periodic level of the signal, and meanwhile, a fast Fourier transform ratio criterion is adopted as a frequency characteristic to quantize the frequency level of the signal; and finally, the human body activity signals are judged by using a support vector machine classification method, so that the method can accurately sense survivors in the well after the disaster, expand the sensing range and improve the rescue rate.

title_en: Rescue communication system and method based on signal simulation and heterogeneous ad hoc network technology
abstract_en: The application relates to a rescue communication system and method based on signal simulation and heterogeneous ad hoc network technology. The system comprises signal simulation and heterogeneous networking devices, each unmanned aerial vehicle in the unmanned aerial vehicle group can carry the signal simulation and carry out flight search and rescue with the heterogeneous networking devices, each rescue person carries the heterogeneous networking devices and carries out ground search and rescue, broadcast network access signals are continuously transmitted through the signal simulation devices, after the broadcast network access signals are searched by the mobile phones of the searchers, the mobile phones can be automatically connected to the communication network, the communication function of the mobile phones and the unmanned aerial vehicle devices is achieved, the mobile phones can transmit GPS positioning information back to the unmanned aerial vehicle signal simulation devices, the signal simulation and heterogeneous networking devices can broadcast the received GPS signals in the heterogeneous networks, and accordingly the whole network broadcast positioning function is achieved. The invention constructs a communication channel between the searched and rescued people and the rescue team.

title_en: Search and rescue searching device for deep mountain jungles based on Beidou positioning
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue finding device based on Beidou positioning for mountain-deep jungle, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle and a search and rescue mechanism, wherein the search and rescue mechanism is arranged on the lower end surface of the unmanned aerial vehicle, a driving machine body can drive a component box to search high altitude, the unmanned aerial vehicle can continuously move, a thermal imager and a camera are used for searching, the ground clearance of the component box is more than that of two groups of ground falling frames, namely, the component box can not be damaged when the unmanned aerial vehicle falls, a camera transmission module and a thermal imaging transmission module can transmit the shot image and thermal imaging information to a microcomputer processing module, thereby transmitting the information to a receiving center, facilitating the observation of search and rescue personnel, the Beidou positioning module can notify the position of the unmanned aerial vehicle in real time, facilitating the search and rescue, the alarm module is arranged, when the component box violently moves, the abnormal condition is reported, the smoke sprayer module is convenient for sensing smoke concentration, when a forest fires, the fire center can be quickly found.
assignees: GUANGDONG BANGSHENG BEIDOU INDUSTRY RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Nutrient supply type earthquake emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: Nutrient supplement type earthquake emergency rescue robot, including remote control track automobile body, remote control track automobile body on be equipped with standing groove, arm, air compressor machine, first light and second camera, be equipped with the storage case on the standing groove, be equipped with charge door and intubate on the storage case, be equipped with on the charge door and revolve wrong lid, the air compressor machine passes through booster tube and storage case intercommunication, the intubate is connected with the conveying pipe that sets up on the arm of machinery, the conveying pipe passes through the solenoid valve and feeds the union coupling, is equipped with the gripper on the arm. By adopting the structure, obstacles along the way are cleaned through the mechanical arm, the robot can rapidly advance, and the rescue efficiency is improved; the nutrition supply is provided, so that a bedridden person with limited action or no arm can obtain nutrition in time, and the life cycle is prolonged; the whole device is reasonable in structure, convenient to unpick and wash, flexible and direct to operate and high in practicability.

title_en: Spider leg structure for robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a robot is with spider leg structure, it includes a plurality of joint parts that rotate the connection in order, joint part includes: joint servo motor, joint servo motor installs on the joint, and the gear is installed to joint servo motor's output for be connected with robot leg mounting bracket meshing, one side between joint and the adjacent joint is connected through the gear engagement that sets up on the joint servo motor's on adjacent joint output, and the opposite side between joint and the adjacent joint is connected through the pivot. Through using the utility model provides a search and rescue appearance that spider leg was made, the inside accurate position of surveying stranded personnel of earthquake ruins is given specific longitude and latitude coordinate from various gaps to the eyes of substitute person, collects environment, position that stranded personnel were located and dangerous transmission and is convenient for formulate the scheme and the rescue order that are fit for the rescue for search and rescue personnel. This greatly improves rescue efficiency and survival rate of trapped people.

title_en: Rescue robot based on thing networking VR
