abstract_en: The utility model belongs to a rescue robot based on thing networking VR in rescue device field, including the device storehouse, the device storehouse left and right sides all is equipped with step-by-step track, set up slottedly in the device storehouse, tank bottom fixedly connected with unable adjustment base, unable adjustment base fixedly connected with driving motor, driving motor rotates and is connected with the carousel, the carousel top rotates and is connected with the arm, carousel top fixedly connected with pneumatic cylinder, device storehouse rear end is equipped with the water tank, water tank top fixedly connected with booster pump, the fixed intercommunication in booster pump top has the outlet pipe, the one end that the booster pump was kept away from to the outlet pipe is equipped with the shower nozzle, device storehouse rear end is equipped with the oxygen jar, device storehouse rear end is provided with the handrail; the device not only avoids unnecessary casualties, but also can help trapped people in time.

title_en: Intelligent rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent rescue robot, which comprises a walking mechanism, wherein the walking mechanism is provided with a bottom plate, and the bottom plate is respectively provided with a first-aid device, a plurality of cutting devices and a rope releasing device; the first-aid device comprises a first-aid kit, first-aid articles are placed in the first-aid kit, a fire extinguisher is further arranged in the first-aid kit, an electromagnetic valve is arranged on a pipeline of the fire extinguisher, and a placing rack for placing the pipeline is arranged at the top of the first-aid kit; the cutting device comprises a rotary table, the rotary table is driven by a motor, a lifting rod is arranged on the upper surface of the rotary table, a fixed block is arranged on a piston rod of the lifting rod, a telescopic rod is transversely arranged on the fixed block, and a cutting machine is arranged at the front end of the telescopic rod. The utility model can cut and break the security window by arranging the cutting device, thereby providing the possibility of escaping from the security window for indoor personnel when a fire disaster happens; through setting up the rope releasing device, can provide the rope of fleing of metal material for the personnel of fleing from the burglary-resisting window, increaseed indoor personnel's survival probability when taking place the conflagration.
assignees: MAHU INTELLIGENT TECH SUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Wisdom fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a wisdom fire control technical field just discloses a wisdom fire control rescue robot, the power distribution box comprises a box body, the both sides upper end of box all is fixed with the loop bar, the internally mounted of loop bar has first spring, the one end of loop bar is pegged graft and is had the post of inserting, the one end of inserting the post is fixed with the fixed block, the fixed block is the semicircle spheroid, cylinder and walking wheel are all installed to the both sides lower extreme of box, the flexible end of cylinder is fixed with the mount pad. This wisdom fire control rescue robot appears empting the phenomenon in the rescue robot, all is provided with the cylinder through the both sides lower extreme at the box to be provided with the pulley in the flexible mount pad of serving of cylinder, in order to reach the purpose of aligning the rescue robot, when the phenomenon appears empting the rescue robot, all be provided with the loop bar and insert the post through the both sides upper end at the box, and be provided with first spring in the inside of loop bar, reached and carried out the purpose of protecting to the rescue robot.
assignees: NANJING HAIRUN ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Tension constraint deformation track robot
abstract_en: A tension-constrained deformed crawler robot is based on a planar three-rod mechanism and realizes under-actuated crawler deformation by means of crawler tension constraint and comprises a first frame (1), a second frame (2), a third frame (3), a first stepping motor (4), a second stepping motor (5), a first bearing wheel left half wheel (6), a first bearing wheel right half wheel (7), a second bearing wheel left half wheel (8), a second bearing wheel right half wheel (9), motor fixing angle aluminum (10), a first belt wheel (11), a second belt wheel (12), a first bevel gear (13), a second bevel gear (14), a third bevel gear (15), a fourth bevel gear (16), a first transmission shaft (17), a second transmission shaft (18), a first junction shaft screw (19), a second junction shaft screw (20), a crawler (21) and a damper (22). The movement and deformation are realized through the differential motion of the front motor and the rear motor, and the device can be well applied to the fields of exploration, search and rescue, military reconnaissance and the like.

title_en: Crawler-type multifunctional wounded person search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a crawler-type multifunctional wounded search and rescue robot, which is positioned on a mechanical tank (7) and also comprises an induction type grab (1), a wounded transport cabin (2), an infrared thermal imager (3), a shouting horn module (4), a multifunctional mechanical grabbing arm (5) and a telescopic cradle head (6); mechanical tank (7) top be provided with wounded's transport cabin (2), wounded's transport cabin (2) in install rotatoryly the induction type grab son (1), wounded's transport cabin (2) front end install infrared thermal imager (3), call loudspeaker module (4) and flexible cloud platform (6), wounded's transport cabin (2) front end be fixed with machinery and snatch arm (5). The device overcomes the defects that the search and rescue mode in the prior art is not only low in efficiency, but also easily causes secondary accidents and the like, and has the advantages of simple overall operation, reliable function, low maintenance cost and convenient use.

title_en: Mining rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mining rescue robot, including organism and the track that is used for driving the organism motion, organism the place ahead is equipped with the light, and the organism top is equipped with thermal imaging system, locater, infrared obstacle avoidance appearance to and gas consistency transmitter and oxygen consistency transmitter, simultaneously, be equipped with four screws on four angles of organism. The robot is little influenced by the mine environment, trapped people can be efficiently and accurately detected in a mine, and a small amount of water, food or medicine in the body cavity can be used for self rescue by the trapped people when the trapped people are unfolded at the first time, so that the rescue success rate of rescuers is increased. Meanwhile, in the rescue process of the robot, the gas and oxygen concentrations detected by the sensor can be displayed in real time, and the image of the thermal imager can be synchronously transmitted to the ground control end in real time, so that support is provided for improving the mine disaster rescue efficiency.

title_en: Infrared imaging fixed wing inspection search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an infrared imaging stationary vane patrols and examines search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle belongs to and patrols and examines unmanned aerial vehicle technical field, and it includes the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the lower surface joint of unmanned aerial vehicle body has the casing, shells inner wall's upper surface and electric putter's top fixed connection, electric putter's bottom and the last fixed surface of fly leaf are connected. This search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle is patrolled and examined to infrared imaging stationary vane, through setting up electric putter, baffle and connecting rod, control electric putter shrink, when infrared induction system moves suitable position in the casing, the fly leaf passes through in connecting rod and two baffles drive cardboard card advance the draw-in groove simultaneously, for current search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, this unmanned aerial vehicle falls or transports in the accident, infrared induction system can accomodate in the casing, make infrared induction system can not contact with the foreign object, make the infrared induction system that sets up in the casing can not receive the harm, the normal life of this infrared induction system has been guaranteed.

title_en: Amphibious multi-foot flexible tail bionic robot
abstract_en: An amphibious multi-foot flexible tail bionic robot comprises a main body, bionic legs and a bionic tail, and has amphibious movement and the functions of replacing personnel to hide, reconnaissance and fight, wherein the bionic legs and the bionic tail are respectively and mechanically connected with and electrically connected with the main body, the bionic legs are in one pair or multiple pairs, and the bionic tail comprises an elastic main rib, a tail power module fixed on the elastic main rib, a force transmission device, middle section devices arranged on the elastic main rib at intervals, and a tail section device fixed at the tail end of the elastic main rib; the utility model discloses possess land, the surface of water and the amphibious design of motion function and combat function under water, compare in the amphibious robot of other types, have more superior environmental suitability and wider application, can substitute the work that personnel carry out all-weather, high reliability search and rescue, are hidden, information is collected, is kept watch on, is reconnaissance and confrontation.
assignees: CHANGSHA ZICHEN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Underwater robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an underwater robot, which comprises a bottom plate, wherein two sides of the bottom plate are fixedly connected with side plates, the upper part of one side, close to each other, of the two side plates is provided with a top plate, the top of the bottom plate is provided with a sealed cabin, a steering assembly for steering an auxiliary device is arranged between the bottom plate and the top plate, one sides, far away from each other, of the two side plates are provided with lifting assemblies for lifting and descending the auxiliary device, a partition plate is arranged inside the sealed cabin, one side of the sealed cabin is provided with a plurality of wire arranging holes, the underwater robot has a simple structure, the functions of advancing, retreating and steering can be achieved by starting a second steering propeller and a first steering propeller at different positions, the lifting function of a control device can be realized by the second lifting propeller and the first lifting propeller, the operation is simple and convenient, and no cable is required to be connected, the search and rescue range is large, the search and rescue effect is good, and the use is convenient.

title_en: Rescue robot on water
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of water rescue, and particularly discloses a water rescue robot, which comprises a machine body, wherein the surface of the machine body is provided with a mounting seat, the mounting seat is provided with an inflating unit, the tail part of the machine body is also provided with a driving unit for providing power for the machine body, the front surface of the machine body is also provided with a detecting unit, the side surface of the machine body is also provided with a plurality of object placing units, the two sides of the machine body are detachably provided with mounting plates for bearing, through the object placing units and the detachable mounting plates arranged on the two sides of the machine body, a worker can fix rescue articles such as a life jacket, a rope body or a life buoy and the like on the object placing units, and through an air pump arranged on the mounting seat, a trapped person can inflate the rescue articles after taking the rescue articles, so that the volume of the rescue articles during transportation is reduced, the device can carry more rescue articles, and the functionality of the device is more diversified, the practicability is stronger.

title_en: Speed regulation handle of rope rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of fire rescue equipment, and particularly relates to a speed regulating handle of a rope rescue robot. The handle comprises a handle, a first handle fixing seat and a second handle fixing seat; the first handle fixing seat and the second handle fixing seat are respectively arranged at two ends of the handle to form rotary connection; the first handle fixing seat comprises a first fixing seat, a spring fixing seat, an extension spring and a first fixing seat end cover; the second handle fixing seat comprises a second fixing seat, a magnet, a travel switch, a magnetic encoder and a second fixing seat end cover; the speed regulation handle is simple in structure, can control the rope rescue robot to advance, regulates the advancing speed of the rope rescue robot according to the rotating angle of the handle, and improves the use feeling and the safety of the rope rescue robot.
assignees: ZHEJIANG CHENGSHI ROBOT CO LTD;UNIV EAST CHINA NORMAL

title_en: But camera device multi-angle is adjusted searches for ands rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle with a camera device capable of being adjusted in multiple angles, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein the lower part of a shaft lever penetrates through the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body and is connected with a bearing, the lower part of the bearing is fixedly connected with a connecting rod, limiting plates are arranged on two sides of the lower part of the bearing, guide grooves matched with guide rods are formed in the limiting plates, and the lower parts of the limiting plates are fixedly connected with the camera device. But unmanned aerial vehicle is rescued to this kind of camera device multi-angle is adjusted, promotion through the pneumatic cylinder, guide bar and guide way cooperation to make the limiting plate can drive the rotation of the vertical direction of camera device, and then increase camera device's the area that shines, improve the search range, increase search efficiency, the air intake forms the passageway of intercommunication with the air outlet, make the air current that flows can carry out the drying to camera and lens, prevent to lead to the unclear condition of image to take place because of camera and lens fog.
assignees: ZHIYANG TIANJIN AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent auxiliary search and rescue hexapod robot for mine tunnel
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to an intelligent auxiliary mine hole search and rescue hexapod robot which comprises an execution unit, an autonomous search and rescue unit and a manual control unit, wherein the autonomous search and rescue unit takes a raspberry group as a main control unit, visual detection is carried out through the matching use of a camera and a searchlight, a corresponding instruction is sent out to control the execution unit after an acquired picture is processed by the raspberry group, an infrared detection module is used for detecting a trapped mine, and 3 clamping steering engine clamping mark modules are placed near the trapped mine after the trapped mine is found, so that a human can conveniently find the trapped mine; when an emergency occurs, the manual mode can be switched in time, the human makes a decision by returning the picture to the PC through the camera, and the human remotely controls the walking of the hexapod robot by controlling the keys of the PC, so that the human can be effectively assisted to rescue the trapped person in the shortest time, and the property loss and the casualties are reduced.

title_en: Underground surveying robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an underground surveying robot, which comprises a robot main body, a ball screw, a driving motor, a moving member, a sliding member and a driving assembly, wherein the ball screw is rotatably connected to the top of the robot main body; through setting up motor, ball screw, slider and drive assembly cooperation work and promote testing platform's height to effectual survey height that has improved the robot has enlarged detection range, makes the testing result more reliable, and then can provide safe and reliable's data guidance more for search and rescue work.
assignees: XUZHOU RONGCHUANG NEW MATERIALS TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Crawler snake-shaped search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a crawler snake-shaped search and rescue robot which comprises a main control cabin and omnidirectional wheels arranged on two sides of the main control cabin, wherein one end of the main control cabin is hinged with a second power system, the other end of the main control cabin is hinged with a third power system, the other end of the second power system is also hinged with a first power system, and one surface, far away from the second power system, of the first power system is fixedly connected with a protection cabin; the crawler-type traveling mechanism is small in size, capable of passing through narrow space gaps, high in stability of a crawler-type traveling mode, strong in cross-country capacity under the cooperation of the power system and the climbing arms, and suitable for complex mine environments. The direction does not need to be turned, and the front camera and the rear camera can provide visual fields to move forwards and backwards. The fire quickly arrives at the rescue site and quickly arrives at the trapped personnel. The voice module is used for communicating in real time to know the trapped condition, and carrying the hose to supply oxygen, milk, water and the like, so that more precious time is provided for the follow-up large-scale equipment to enter rescue.

title_en: Infrared small target intelligent identification method based on progressive hierarchical fusion network
abstract_en: The invention relates to an infrared small target intelligent identification method based on a progressive hierarchical fusion network, which utilizes the complementarity of dual-waveband infrared imaging information to perform data fusion enhancement from a data dimension and improve the available information quantity of a neural network for infrared small target identification; the method comprises the steps of constructing a dual-waveband infrared data fusion and target detection integrated neural network from embedded application deployment, fully utilizing weight sharing of parameters among different components in the network, enhancing the coupling effect among data, and reducing the overall computation complexity of a network model; based on dual-band infrared data fusion, an integrated neural network architecture for establishing pixel level-feature level-decision level progressive multi-level fusion for infrared dim target detection and identification is designed, high-efficiency infrared small target identification capability is realized, and the integrated neural network architecture plays an important role in night vision monitoring, hazard source detection, personnel search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Disaster recovery robot with replaceable power supply
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of disaster recovery robots, and discloses a disaster recovery robot with a replaceable power supply, which comprises a robot main body, wherein a mounting seat is fixedly connected to the right end of the upper surface of the robot main body, a search and rescue camera device is mounted at the center of the upper surface of the mounting seat, a plurality of stabilizing assemblies are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the robot main body, and a storage assembly is arranged on the left side of the mounting seat on the upper surface of the robot main body First-aid materials such as drinking water, clothes and the like can enable the trapped person to recover to a state to wait for rescue workers.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for detecting and putting in field life search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for detecting and putting in field life, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein an airborne camera is arranged on one side of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, an infrared imaging module, a real-time signal transmission module, an image processing module and a human-computer interaction terminal are arranged in the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is fixedly connected with a storage box, one side of the storage box is rotatably connected with two symmetrical rotating shafts, and cover plates are fixedly sleeved on the outer walls of the rotating shafts; the unmanned aerial vehicle has a simple structure, is convenient to use, can store food and water through the storage box, so that people who are difficult to fall can allay hunger in the first time when searching and rescuing in the field, can wait for the arrival of the search and rescue people, can be inserted into the field land through the conical rod, and further ensures the stability of the unmanned aerial vehicle body.

title_en: Open-air life search and rescue detection unmanned aerial vehicle with laser radar carries out intelligence and keeps away barrier
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a field life search and rescue detection unmanned aerial vehicle with a laser radar for intelligent obstacle avoidance, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body and a storage battery, wherein a protective box matched with the storage battery is arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, a second sliding plate is slidably connected with the inner wall of the top of the protective box, the same second spring is fixedly connected between one side of the second sliding plate, which is far away from an opening, and the inner wall of one side of the protective box, an insulating plate is arranged at one side of the second sliding plate, which is close to the opening, and two connectors are arranged at one side of the insulating plate, which is close to the opening. Is convenient to use.

title_en: Search for and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle camera device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a camera device of a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a machine body, wherein a rescue assembly and a control assembly are arranged inside the machine body, fixed arms are fixedly connected at four corners of the machine body, the lower ends of the fixed arms are fixedly connected with protective rings, and the lower end of the machine body is fixedly connected with a fixed shell. According to the utility model, the infrared camera carries out real-time shooting, shot information is transmitted to the rescue center, human body activity is sensed through the pyroelectric infrared sensor, when the human body activity is recorded, the position signal and the enhanced signal are transmitted to the rescue center through the wireless communication module to be displayed, the storage box is thrown to the position near a person to be rescued, emergency articles are stored in the storage box, the alarm device is started to prompt rescue, and the person to be rescued carries out rescue according to the position to be rescued, so that the device has the advantages of automatic positioning, high cruising efficiency, wide distribution range and timely rescue.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for emergency rescue and disaster relief
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for emergency rescue and disaster relief, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body and a honeycomb marking device arranged on the belly of the unmanned aerial vehicle body; the belly of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is also provided with a camera; the honeycomb marking device comprises a honeycomb plate, a plurality of supporting mechanisms and a plurality of markers; the top surface of the honeycomb plate is attached to the belly of the unmanned aerial vehicle body to plug the upper ports of the honeycomb holes; marker, bearing mechanism, honeycomb holes three one-to-one, the marker sets up in the honeycomb holes, and bearing mechanism sets up in the honeycomb panel bottom surface, and bearing mechanism bearing marker, and marker accessible bearing mechanism release. The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for rescuing, which is used for releasing a signal for marking after a search and rescue target is found, guiding search and rescue to ground rescue personnel and greatly improving the search and rescue efficiency.
assignees: CCCC REMOTE SENSING LOAD JIANGSU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency rescue robot which comprises a baffle, a supporting bottom plate and a second electric cylinder, wherein the lower end of the second electric cylinder is rotatably connected with a supporting wheel, the upper end of the second electric cylinder is rotatably connected with a first movable shaft, one side of the second electric cylinder is provided with a sliding chute, one side of the sliding chute is provided with a third electric cylinder, the third electric cylinder is in sliding fit with the sliding chute, and the bottom end of the third electric cylinder is rotatably connected with a fixed supporting frame. According to the utility model, the baffle, the second electric cylinder and the water pump are arranged, so that a buffering effect can be realized, articles can be prevented from falling to the equipment and being damaged, the fixed support frames are arranged on the two sides of the protective shell, and the robot can be supported in position through the third electric cylinder, the first movable shaft and the second electric cylinder when the robot is inclined or toppled.
assignees: TIANJIN GAOKE YUTONG DEFENSE EQUIPMENT MFG CO LTD

title_en: Water surface remote control rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water surface remote control rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of rescue equipment and comprises an air bag hull, a waterproof centralized control box, a fixed seat, a plurality of propellers and an automatic inflation valve bank, wherein the waterproof centralized control box is detachably connected with the air bag hull through the fixed seat, the air outlet end of the automatic inflation valve bank is communicated with the air inlet end of the air bag hull, the propellers are detachably connected with the bottom of the air bag hull, and the signal end of the propellers is electrically connected with the signal end of the waterproof centralized control box. The water surface remote control rescue robot disclosed by the utility model is composed of the air bag hull, the waterproof centralized control box, the fixed seat, the propeller and the automatic inflation valve group, so that the water surface remote control rescue robot can realize remote accurate remote control, the search and rescue range is enlarged, the operation is more stable and reliable, and the rescue effect is improved.
assignees: XIAMEN SHENSHOU SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: High-altitude long-endurance solar search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-altitude long-endurance solar search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises a body, wings and an empennage, wherein the body comprises a machine head, a middle section and a tail section, the wings comprise a main wing and a pair of auxiliary wings, the empennage comprises a vertical tail and a horizontal tail, the machine head, the middle section and the tail section are fixedly connected by adopting a bolt structure, a motor is fixedly arranged on the machine head, the main wing is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the middle section, and the pair of auxiliary wings are respectively and fixedly arranged at two ends of the main wing. Compared with a plurality of rotors, the unmanned aerial vehicle provided by the utility model has the advantages that the conventional pneumatic layout is adopted, the gliding performance is strong, the carrying capacity is large, the defect that the conventional energy unmanned aerial vehicle cannot work for a long time is overcome by utilizing solar energy, great convenience is brought to search and rescue tasks, energy supplement is carried out without landing, the time is saved, the national environment-friendly call is responded, the improvement space is large, and the unmanned aerial vehicle can be developed in other aspects in the later stage: geological exploration and agriculture.

title_en: Water-air combined human body recognition search and rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a water-air combined human body recognition search and rescue device, which comprises: the underwater robot comprises a waterproof cover and a propeller arranged outside the waterproof cover, wherein a master control module, a power supply module, a motor driving module controlled by the master control module and an underwater image acquisition module are arranged in the waterproof cover; the aerial signal transfer module comprises a multi-rotor autonomous aircraft provided with a water surface image acquisition and transmission module and a signal transfer device carried on the multi-rotor autonomous aircraft; the water surface buoy communication module comprises a wireless communication module, and the wireless communication module is used for receiving the underwater video image data output by the master control module and transmitting the underwater video image data to the signal transfer device; and the shore host machine is used for receiving the water surface video data output by the aerial signal transfer module and transferred underwater video image data, and detecting and identifying the underwater human body target. The utility model improves the operation range of the underwater robot and finds the underwater human body quickly and accurately.

title_en: Crawler-type fire-fighting and fire-fighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rescue robot equipment, in particular to a crawler-type fire-fighting fire-extinguishing rescue robot which is stable in connection and convenient to operate and comprises a crawler-type robot and a water pipeline, wherein a water storage cavity is arranged inside the crawler-type robot, a water pump is arranged in the middle of the upper wall of the crawler-type robot, the water pump pipeline of the water pump extends into the lower end of the inside of the water storage cavity, a drainage pipeline faces the front end, a water inlet pipe is arranged in the middle of the upper end of the rear wall of the crawler-type robot, a switch valve is arranged in the middle of the water inlet pipe, support rods are arranged on the rear walls of the crawler-type robot at the left end and the right end of the water inlet pipe through bearings, a first U-shaped clamping plate is arranged at the rear end of the side wall of each support rod, a connecting sleeve is arranged at the front end of the water pipeline, second U-shaped clamping plates are arranged at the front ends of the side walls at the left end and the right end of the connecting sleeve, a fixing block is arranged at the rear end of the upper wall of the connecting sleeve, and fixing screws are fixedly arranged at the left end and right end of the fixing block, the middle part of the fixed screw rod is sleeved with a nut.

title_en: Miniature thermal infrared imager of endoscope
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an endoscope miniature thermal infrared imager in the technical field of endoscopes, which comprises a host, the host comprises a handle and a display screen, the top of the handle is provided with an operating key, the inner side of the front end of the handle is provided with a battery bin, the handle is provided with a holding rod, the rear end of the main machine is movably inserted with an insertion pipe assembly, the insertion pipe assembly comprises a shapable hose, the inner side of the shapeable hose is provided with a snake bone, the front end of the snake bone is provided with a thermal imaging infrared probe, the back end of the snake bone is provided with a rope protection pipe which is electrically connected with the host machine, the hot forming survey technology is combined with the endoscope, when the special generator is inspected, the power is patrolled and examined, personnel search and rescue and the sealed container is inspected, the endoscope not only has the image shooting and surveying effect, but also can carry out temperature monitoring and displaying, and hot spots and leakage points can be found.
assignees: XUZHOU WEIPUSS OPTOELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Maritime search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a maritime search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises a flight assembly, an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, supporting legs, a moving wheel, a fixed plate, a shooting assembly, a lifting assembly and a damping assembly, wherein the supporting legs are arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, one end of the fixed plate is arranged on the supporting legs, the moving wheel is arranged at the other end of the fixed plate, the damping assembly is arranged on the supporting legs and connected with the fixed plate, the flight assembly is arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, the lifting assembly is arranged in the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, the lower end of the shooting assembly is arranged on the lifting assembly, and the upper end of the shooting assembly penetrates through the unmanned aerial vehicle main body.

title_en: Underground rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of underground search and rescue, and discloses an underground rescue robot which comprises a control device, wherein two sides of the bottom end of the control device are connected with frames, a hoisting mechanism is connected between the frames, the rear side of the hoisting mechanism is connected with a crushing device, a conveying frame is connected between the bottom ends of the frames, a motor is arranged in one side of the conveying frame, one side of the motor is connected with a rotating shaft, one side of the rotating shaft is connected with a moving roller, two sides of each frame are provided with tracks, one side of the inside of each frame is connected with a rotating part, one end of the rotating part is connected with a gear, the gear is in transmission connection with a toothed cylinder, the bottom of the toothed cylinder is connected with a fixed plate, the top end of the inside of each frame is connected with a connecting rod, and the connecting rod is arranged in the toothed cylinder. This underground rescue robot can convey the garrulous sediment and the small-size stone that the ware of slagging tap was broken down to the robot both sides during rotation, prevents to influence the holistic marcing of robot in broken process.

title_en: Overwater and underwater search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an overwater and underwater search and rescue robot, which comprises a robot main body, wherein the left side and the right side of the robot main body are respectively provided with a propulsion system, the robot main body is internally provided with a diving system and a controller, the controller is electrically connected with the propulsion system and the diving system, the propulsion system consists of a turbine propeller and a water inlet pipe, the turbine propeller is arranged at the rear part of the side end of the robot main body, the water inlet pipe is arranged at the front part of the side end of the robot main body, the interior of the water inlet pipe is communicated with the water inlet side of the turbine propeller through a pipeline, both sides of the front end of the robot main body are respectively provided with a manned handle, the top end of the robot main body is provided with a carrying surface for carrying people, the robot main body is also provided with a search module for underwater search, the controller is connected with a remote control system, the robot has simple integral shape and compact structure, greatly increasing the rescue speed, shortening the rescue time and having high safety and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Search and rescue robot on water
abstract_en: The invention relates to an underwater rescue device, and discloses an underwater search and rescue robot, which comprises a driving mechanism, a rescue main body structure and a control mechanism, wherein the driving mechanism is fixedly arranged on the rescue main body structure, and the control mechanism comprises a rotatable camera module and an illumination module (704) for illuminating the surrounding environment; the Beidou positioning module (713) can be used for positioning the current position of the rescue robot; the data processing module (709) is electrically connected with the Beidou positioning module (713) and the camera module; the central control module (708) is electrically connected with the data processing module (709), and the central control module (708) can receive the position information processed by the data processing module (709), plan a travel track according to the position information, and control the driving mechanism to travel along the travel track. The invention can flexibly adjust the camera module to acquire the surrounding water surface information, and the lighting device is arranged to enable the rescue robot to perform rescue actions at night.
assignees: HUNAN ZOOMLION EMERGENCY EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: 5G communication security protection-based rescue and investigation robot for extreme road surface
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue equipment, and discloses a 5G communication security-based rescue and investigation robot for an extreme road surface. According to the rescue robot, the friction heating mechanism is arranged, so that when the rescue robot runs on water, the friction wheel continuously rotates under the action of resistance of water to the outer side of the friction wheel, and the temperature of the robot body continuously rises under the action of continuous friction of blades on the outer side of the friction wheel and the upper side and the lower side of the friction wheel and the robot body, so that when people suffering from disasters lie on the rescue robot, the body temperature can gradually rise, and the situation that the rescue robot cannot be gripped and the rescue efficiency is influenced due to temperature loss is avoided.
assignees: JIANGXI SPACE ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Bionic search and rescue robot and space self-deployment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bionic search and rescue robot and a space self-deployment method, wherein the bionic search and rescue robot node comprises a bouncing mechanism, a self-resetting mechanism, a course adjusting mechanism and a sensing control unit, and the space self-deployment method comprises a path planning algorithm, a two-dimensional self-deployment algorithm and a three-dimensional self-deployment algorithm; the bouncing mechanism comprises a frame, a four-bar mechanism and a driving mechanism, the self-resetting mechanism comprises a gear motor and a bar leg, and the course adjusting mechanism comprises a fixed frame, a gear motor and an adjusting wheel; the path planning algorithm comprises a traversal adjacent node method and a feasible region judging method, the two-dimensional self-deployment algorithm comprises a dynamic course adjustment method, a step adjustment strategy and a two-dimensional self-deployment method, and the three-dimensional self-deployment algorithm comprises a sequence point planning method, a bouncing error and obstacle processing method and a three-dimensional self-deployment method. The bionic search and rescue robot node and the spatial self-deployment method can be applied to non-structural complex environments to complete tasks such as monitoring, search and rescue, signal relay and the like.

title_en: Indoor wheel type search and rescue robot map building system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an image building system of an indoor wheel type search and rescue robot, which comprises a PC (personal computer), a central control unit, a motion control unit, a motor and a plurality of sensors, wherein the PC is connected with the central control unit; the PC, the motion control unit and the sensor are all connected with the central control unit; the motion control unit comprises a singlechip and a motor drive circuit; the motor is connected with the singlechip through the motor driving module; the singlechip is connected with the motion control unit; the inertia measurement unit, the laser radar and the camera are combined, a high-precision grid map can be obtained, the operation resource is greatly saved compared with the situation that a camera is used for drawing, meanwhile, deviation caused by field reasons such as smoke and light is avoided, the camera is used for shooting an environment picture of the field with the current pose of the robot, shielding can be effectively avoided, drawing is accurate, and the drawing process of the search and rescue robot is finally achieved.

title_en: Beach swimming distress rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a beach swimming distress rescue system, which belongs to the technical field of marine rescue equipment and comprises a main control system, a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and a positioning signal transmitter; the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a life buoy, a rope and a rope retraction and release mechanism; the rope retracting and releasing mechanism is fixedly installed at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the rope is wound on the rope retracting and releasing mechanism, and one end of the rope is connected with the life buoy; the unmanned aerial vehicle body controls the rope retraction and release mechanism to retract and release the rope; the unmanned aerial vehicle body the positioning signal transmitter all with master control system wireless communication connects. According to the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, the positioning signal transmitter is used for triggering alarm, the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle can immediately carry the life buoy to autonomously go to rescue, monitoring personnel can trigger alarm at the first time to react in real time to carry out rescue, so that the rescue time and the rescue difficulty are reduced, and the probability of drowning in distress is reduced.

title_en: Intelligent door lock
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent door lock which comprises an outdoor lock and an indoor lock, wherein the outdoor lock is provided with a door handle, an identification module, a digital key, a liquid crystal screen, a clutch and a control circuit board, the outdoor lock or the indoor lock is internally provided with a power supply, and the identification module, the digital key, the liquid crystal screen, the clutch and the control circuit board are electrically connected with the power supply. The indoor lock is characterized in that a thermal sensing device is further arranged in the indoor lock and electrically connected with the control circuit board, when the thermal sensing device receives that the external temperature reaches an opening threshold value, the control circuit board controls the clutch to work, and then the clutch drives the movable supporting ring to move, so that the ejector pin is driven to enable the driving shaft fixing piece and the door handle to be connected together, and at the moment, the door handle can be rotated to drive the driving shaft fixing piece and the driving shaft to rotate to open the door lock. When a fire disaster happens, the rescue robot is convenient to enter the room outdoors for rescue.
assignees: ZHEJIANG KINGKIND SECURITY AND SAFETY DEFENSE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Water surface intelligent search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent water surface search and rescue robot which comprises a robot body, wherein a holding rod is fixedly connected to the side wall, close to each other, of the robot body, two through grooves are symmetrically formed in the side wall of the holding rod, slide blocks are connected to the inner walls of the two through grooves in a sliding mode, rotating rods are connected to the side walls of the two sides of each slide block in a rotating mode, a pressing plate is connected to one end, far away from the slide blocks, of each rotating rod in a rotating mode, an electric push rod is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the robot body, the movable end of each electric push rod penetrates through the side wall of the holding rod and extends into the corresponding through groove, the movable end of each electric push rod is fixedly connected with the side wall of each slide block, and two grooves are formed in the side wall of the robot body. When the hand holds the holding rod, the two electric push rods are adjusted to contract at the moment, so that the two slide blocks are driven to slide in the direction away from each other, the two slide blocks drive the two press plates to approach each other through the rotating rod, the hand is pressed tightly, the hand can easily hold the holding rod, and the search and rescue efficiency of the machine body is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN TONGZHOU SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire rescue robot, which comprises: the motion power subsystem is used for driving the fire rescue robot to move; the identification positioning subsystem is used for acquiring indoor fire scene images by using a binocular camera and then drawing a fire scene three-dimensional map according to stereoscopic vision matching; the safety detection subsystem is used for combining information obtained by detection of various sensors with the identification and positioning subsystem, detecting toxic smoke on site and dividing the area attribute of the site area; the path navigation subsystem is used for selecting/updating an optimal rescue path in real time by using an optimized particle swarm algorithm on a fire scene; and the first information processing subsystem is used for acquiring or receiving the data sent by each subsystem, and obtaining corresponding processing result data after operation processing. The utility model can be used for rescuing on the fire scene, improves the rescue efficiency and reduces unnecessary casualties.

title_en: Annular structure composite wing VTOL unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an annular structure composite wing vertical take-off and landing unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises an annular structure composite wing, a power propulsion structure and a flight control surface structure part, wherein the annular structure composite wing is used for generating flight lift force, providing structural strength, loading effective load and the like, the power propulsion structure realizes the vertical take-off and landing lift force and the flight thrust of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the flight control surface structure part consists of a plurality of control surfaces and is used for controlling and adjusting horizontal flight and vertical attitude. Compared with the similar unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle disclosed by the utility model has the advantages that the lift performance can be improved by more than 25% when flying flatly, the resistance is reduced by about 20%, the range is long, the load is large, and the unmanned aerial vehicle can be used for logistics transportation, post-disaster search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Unmanned ship capable of automatically searching and rescuing
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the field of emergency rescue, and provides an autonomous search and rescue unmanned ship which comprises a ship body, wherein handrails are installed on the periphery of the ship body, a cabin body is arranged at the top of the ship body, the autonomous search and rescue unmanned ship further comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle placed in the cabin body, a manned buoy is fixed on the rear side of the ship body, a shouting module, a camera module and a communication module are arranged on the ship body, rollers are further installed at the bottom of the ship body, and a propeller is further arranged on the rear side of the ship body. The unmanned ship is searched and rescued autonomously, more trapped persons are rescued in the fastest rescue mode with higher rescue efficiency, and the safety of the rescuers is improved.

title_en: Air-land dual-purpose obstacle-crossing search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to an air-land dual-purpose obstacle-crossing search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises: unmanned aerial vehicle, electromagnetism mortise lock, unmanned search and rescue car and snap close ring, the mounting panel is installed to unmanned aerial vehicle bottom face, and the sliding mounting groove is installed to the mounting panel, and the electromagnetism mortise lock is installed at unmanned aerial vehicle bottom face, and unmanned search and rescue car top installation slide rail, slide rail sliding connection are in the sliding mounting groove, and the snap close ring is installed in unmanned search and rescue car top and corresponds the below of electromagnetism mortise lock. The unmanned aerial vehicle can solve the technical problem that the existing unmanned aerial vehicle cannot be effectively rescued on complex terrains, the locking ring can be locked by designing the electromagnetic mortise lock so as to lock the sliding rail to be fixed in the sliding mounting groove or release the sliding rail to slide out of the sliding mounting groove, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be connected with or separated from the unmanned search and rescue vehicle, when the unmanned aerial vehicle cannot be explored by the aircraft on the complex terrains, the unmanned aerial vehicle releases the unmanned search and rescue vehicle to continue exploring, the adaptability of the search and rescue terrains is improved, the rescue time is saved, and the success rate of rescue is improved.
assignees: HUBEI XINGHANG AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Underwater robot
abstract_en: The application discloses underwater robot includes: the side part of the sealed cabin is provided with a vertical propeller, one end of the sealed cabin is provided with a first transverse propeller, and the other end of the sealed cabin is provided with a second transverse propeller; the bow diversion shell is arranged on the outer side of the sealed cabin, which is provided with the first transverse propeller; and the stern diversion shell is arranged on the outer side of the sealed cabin provided with the second transverse propeller, and the stern diversion shell is provided with an advancing propeller. According to the scheme, the AUV and the ROV are combined, and a full-freedom-degree control scheme is adopted, so that effective search and rescue can be realized in a complex water area with large storms and many obstacles.
assignees: CETC OCEAN INFORMATION TECH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle capable of delivering emergency substances
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle capable of delivering emergency substances, wherein a signal transmitter and a first central controller are arranged in the body of the unmanned aerial vehicle, an infrared camera is arranged below the head of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the first central controller is respectively and electrically connected with the signal transmitter and the infrared camera, the lower surface of a wing is fixedly connected with one end of a delivery frame, the other end of the delivery frame is provided with a mounting groove, a linear driving device is arranged in the mounting groove, the front end of an output shaft of the linear driving device is provided with an extrusion sleeve, a sleeve is arranged below the extrusion sleeve, an air-drop box is provided with a connecting piece capable of being arranged in the sleeve, the top of the connecting piece is provided with a groove, a lock rod is arranged in the groove, the lock rod is fixedly connected with one end of a spring, the other end of the spring is fixedly connected with the connecting piece, and the left end face of the lock rod is an inclined face. The utility model has long endurance time, can deliver emergency substances to trapped people, and can release colored smoke after the airdrop box lands, thereby facilitating the positioning of the trapped people and search and rescue personnel.
assignees: CHENGDU YUXIANG SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: High-temperature-resistant crawler-type fire-fighting robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire-fighting robots, in particular to a high-temperature-resistant crawler-type fire-fighting robot. The water tank is provided with a water inlet which is positioned on the upper side of the rear end of the frame. The anti-explosion vehicle frame further comprises an anti-explosion box and a high-temperature resistant shell, wherein the anti-explosion box is fixedly connected to the vehicle frame, and all electric parts are arranged in the anti-explosion box; the high-temperature resistant shell is fixedly connected to the frame and covers the outside of the fire-fighting robot, the high-temperature resistant shell is of an interlayer structure, the interior of the high-temperature resistant shell is filled with water, a water inlet pipeline communicated with the interior of the high-temperature resistant shell is arranged, and a nozzle communicated with the interior of the high-temperature resistant shell is arranged on the high-temperature resistant shell. The fire rescue robot can resist high temperature on a fire scene with higher temperature.
assignees: ANSHAN HENGYE SPECIAL VEHICLE MFG CO LTD

title_en: Streamlined rescue robot on water
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue equipment and discloses a streamline waterborne rescue robot, which comprises a streamline body and the following components arranged on the body: the sensor is used for acquiring the ambient environment data of the body, the characteristic data of the person to be rescued and the barrier data; the controller is connected with the background server and the sensor and is used for: determining an illumination compensation strategy, a human body searching equipment switching strategy and a bearing comfort degree adjusting strategy according to the ambient environment data and the characteristic data of the person to be rescued; and determining whether to send a request corresponding to the reacquired travelling route to the background server according to the barrier data, and controlling the machine body to travel according to the travelling route newly sent by the background server. The streamlined water rescue robot can realize water rescue without the need of rescue workers to launch in person.

title_en: Intelligent obstacle-surmounting water curtain cooling type firefighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent obstacle-surmounting water curtain cooling type firefighting rescue robot. Including interior casing, shell body, casing bottom plate, many telescopic links, by interior casing, shell body, the retaining chamber that the casing bottom plate encircleed forms, install in the laser point cloud sensor of shell body, the controller, interior casing and shell body pass through spliced pole fixed connection, and interior casing bottom is provided with many bracing piece outer bars and nestification in the bracing piece inner rod in the bracing piece outer rod, and the one end of bracing piece inner rod is provided with the gyro wheel. The intelligent obstacle crossing device has the beneficial effects that the intelligent obstacle crossing device is high in mobility, water can be sprayed by the water curtain spray head to cool the local part, the phenomenon that the rescued personnel are influenced by smoke and high temperature can be guaranteed as far as possible, most of working parts are arranged at the bottom of the inner shell, water in the water storage cavity has heat insulation and cooling effects on the working parts, the failure rate of the working parts is reduced, the laser point cloud sensor can reconstruct a real-time map, a complex fire scene map can be reconstructed, and the rescue personnel can be helped to rush in and evacuate.

title_en: Self-floating type marine unmanned aerial vehicle and drowning search and rescue system thereof
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a self-floating offshore unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a fuselage and wings, wherein the wings are arranged on two sides of the fuselage, vertical take-off and landing arms are arranged on the two wings, and the fuselage is made of a carbon composite PVC foam material; the wings are made of Kevlar composite PVC foam materials; the vertical lifting arm is made of 3K carbon fiber; the falling water can be ensured to float on the water surface through the material and the pneumatic design of the machine body. The system comprises the unmanned aerial vehicle, a Beidou satellite transmitter, an AIS base station, a command end and a plurality of AIS ship terminals, wherein the command end arranges ships to salvage nearby through modeling calculation and analysis according to unmanned aerial vehicle Beidou positioning information and AIS identification information of the AIS ship terminals. The utility model discloses a be convenient for search and rescue and salvage the unmanned aerial vehicle that falls into water, reduce the cost of salvage, search and rescue process safe and reliable.
assignees: CCCC COMMUNICATION BIG DATA SHANGHAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire rescue robot with protection function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire-fighting rescue robots, in particular to a fire-fighting rescue robot with a protection function, which is characterized in that a smashing prevention mechanism is arranged to prevent objects falling from high altitude from directly smashing and falling on the fire-fighting robot, and the smashing gravitational potential energy is absorbed and discharged, so that the impact force is prevented from being transmitted to the fire-fighting robot, the fire-fighting robot is prevented from being damaged, and the use stability is improved; the fire monitor comprises a movable base, a water storage tank, a mounting plate, a fire monitor and an anti-smashing mechanism, wherein the water storage tank is fixedly mounted on the movable base, cooling water is stored in the water storage tank, the mounting plate is fixedly mounted on the water storage tank, the fire monitor is arranged on the mounting plate in a swinging mode, and the anti-smashing mechanism is fixedly mounted on the mounting plate; the anti-smashing mechanism comprises supporting legs, a first protection plate, a guide pillar mounting frame, a buffering guide pillar, a buffering guide sleeve, a first spring, a connecting rod and a second protection plate, wherein two groups of supporting legs are symmetrically and fixedly mounted on the mounting plate, and the bottom end of the first protection plate is fixedly connected with the top ends of the supporting legs.

title_en: Fire rescue robot and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire fighting equipment, in particular to a fire fighting rescue robot and a rescue method; including the robot body, frame and damper assembly, damper assembly includes the shock attenuation board, a plurality of movable rod, a plurality of first damping spring, a plurality of sleeve, a plurality of slide bar, a plurality of second damping spring, a plurality of snubber block and four anticollision boards, first damping spring is connected to the snubber plate, second damping spring and sleeve, slide bar connection sleeve and snubber block, snubber block connection slide bar and anticollision board, the frame is given in the bottom vibrations transmission, the frame is with the vibrations impact transmission for the preliminary consumption of first damping spring, remaining vibrations are consumed by the snubber plate secondary, the collision produces vibrations, consume by the snubber block is preliminary, slide bar slip second damping spring compression secondary consumes vibrations, it is not good to solve current fire-fighting robot anticollision antidetonation effect, the instrument rocks the problem that influences rescue robot life.
assignees: MEDIUM QUANTITY RHUANGSHAN HIGH QUALITY DEVELOPMENT RES INSTITUTE LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle that function is comprehensive
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle with comprehensive functions, which comprises a base, a docking platform, an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a clamping manipulator and a bottom plate, wherein the docking platform is installed at one end of the top of the base through an installation groove, an XYZ electric sliding table is installed at the other end of the top of the base through an installation bolt, a fixed table is arranged at one side of the docking platform, a vertical electric sliding table is installed at the top of the fixed table through a bolt, a first extension plate is connected to one side of a displacement end of the vertical electric sliding table, and a servo motor is fixed to one side of the bottom of the first extension plate through a screw. This novel unmanned aerial vehicle possesses the mechanism that can conveniently be berthhed back quick replacement spare battery, need not to wait for to charge, has striven for search and rescue time greatly, and unmanned aerial vehicle possesses the mounting structure who bears the installation to multiple external equipment such as camera, and realizable function is comparatively comprehensive, is fit for extensively using widely.

title_en: All-terrain search and rescue robot platform
abstract_en: The utility model provides an all-terrain search and rescue robot platform which comprises a rack, a traveling mechanism, a floating mechanism and a propelling mechanism, wherein the traveling mechanism is arranged on the rack; a flying mechanism is parked at the top of the frame; the flying mechanism is provided with a clamping device; a material storage device and a jacking device are arranged between the clamping device and the top of the frame; the jacking device is used for jacking the material capsules of the material storage device into the clamping device; the propelling mechanism comprises a pushing fan; the air outlet end of the pushing fan is hinged with a swinging device; the swinging device is used for changing the air outlet direction of the pushing fan; the walking mechanism drives the robot platform to move on the ground; the floating mechanism and the propelling mechanism drive the robot platform to move on the water surface; the flying mechanism moves in the air; the search and rescue work in three directions of water, land and air is realized; meanwhile, the flying mechanism is parked at the top of the frame; when the flight mechanism is started for search and rescue, the search and rescue range is expanded. The air outlet direction of the pushing fan is changed by arranging the swinging device; the robot platform can realize turning in the water surface movement.

title_en: Amphibious bionic centipede structure for outdoor search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses an amphibious bionic centipede structure for outdoor search and rescue, which comprises a headstock, wherein one end of the headstock is connected with a group of head member assemblies, the head member assemblies are sequentially connected with a plurality of groups of trunk member assemblies through head steering engine assemblies, the trunk member assemblies are connected with one ends of tail member assemblies through tail steering engine assemblies, and the other ends of the tail member assemblies are connected with a tailstock. The invention solves the problems of large size, and poor adaptability and obstacle crossing capability of the existing search and rescue robot.

title_en: Rescue robot for transferring injured person out of danger
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue robot for the escape and transfer of wounded persons, which comprises: an electrical box body; the chassis is arranged on two sides of the electric box body; the safety cabin is arranged at the top of the electric box body; a transfer assembly disposed on the safety cabin; the safety cabin comprises two mechanical grippers, and the two mechanical grippers are respectively arranged on two symmetrical sides of the safety cabin. According to the invention, through the matching of the mechanical gripper and the conveying assembly, the wounded on the ground losing consciousness in a post-disaster complex environment can be lifted and conveyed into the safety cabin, and then the rescue robot brings the wounded out of a dangerous environment, so that the danger escaping transfer of the wounded is realized.

title_en: Novel underwater robot based on wave propulsion
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a novel underwater robot based on wave propulsion. The novel underwater robot based on wave propulsion comprises a machine body and two wavy fin plates, wherein the appearance of the machine body is a bionic structure simulating devil fish; a plurality of steering engines arranged in rows are arranged on two sides in the machine body, connecting arms are fixedly connected to the end parts of output shafts of the steering engines, and a plurality of connecting arms positioned on the same side of the machine body are arranged in a wave shape; the two fin plates are respectively hinged to two sides of the machine body, and the connecting arms located on the same side of the machine body are respectively fixedly connected with the fin plates on the same side of the machine body. The novel underwater robot based on wave propulsion can be applied to the fields of underwater resource exploration, underwater search and rescue, underwater garbage cleaning and the like, and brings convenience to the aspects of researching ocean ecological diversity, collecting relevant hydrological and geographic data and the like. Compared with an underwater robot in the prior art, the underwater robot has high propelling efficiency and strong environmental friendliness.

title_en: Searchlighting helmet for fire search
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a searchlighting helmet for fire search, which belongs to the field of fire fighting equipment and comprises a helmet body, wherein the right side of the helmet body is fixedly connected with a fixed block, the right side of the fixed block is provided with a clamping groove, a first magnetic suction block is fixedly connected inside the clamping groove, a movable block is inserted into the clamping groove, the back of the movable block is fixedly connected with a second magnetic suction block, and the front of the fixed block is provided with a limiting mechanism. The utility model discloses a through draw-in groove on the fixed block and movable block cooperate the loading and unloading of convenient searchlight to through the cooperation of first magnetism suction block and second magnetism suction block, can make the movable block joint when the draw-in groove is inside, connect more closely, be difficult for rocking and drop, and cooperation infrared imaging mechanism can assist the fireman to carry out more accurate search and rescue under the not good environment of illumination effect, make the device possess and make things convenient for the lamp holder to load and unload, convenient to use, advantage that the searchlight is accurate.
assignees: SHENZHEN XINTIZE FIRE ENG CO LTD

title_en: Path optimization target positioning method and device, storage medium and unmanned equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a path optimization target positioning method and device, a storage medium and unmanned equipment, which can realize the rapid and accurate estimation and positioning of targets (such as foreign object violation invasion, personnel search and rescue and the like) of a single unmanned aerial vehicle/unmanned ship in regional security through a novel proposed path optimization technology. The method mainly solves the problems of positioning speed and positioning precision of the target by a path optimization strategy, and solves the problem of local optimal traps in the traditional gradient method path optimization technology.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;URBAN WEST POWER SUPPLY BRANCH COMPANY OF STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. This unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue includes the organism, and the organism all runs through the side all around and is connected with the wing, and inboard center department of organism is provided with the center post, and the sliding sleeve is cup jointed on the center post surface, and wing medial extremity is articulated with sliding sleeve top lateral surface. According to the invention, the clamping work of the rescue box is controlled by utilizing the lifting of the wing, when the outer side end of the wing moves upwards, the inner side end of the wing is matched with the clamping device through the sliding sleeve so as to clamp the rescue box, when the outer side end of the wing moves downwards, the inner side end of the wing is matched with the clamping device through the sliding sleeve so as to drop the rescue box, the clamping frames are correspondingly matched with the rescue box according to the matching of nuts and screws, the matching effect of the clamping device on the rescue boxes with different shapes is ensured, the plurality of clamping frames limit different directions of the rescue box in different directions, the rescue box is prevented from shaking in the transportation process, and the stability of the rescue box in the transportation process is ensured by utilizing the plurality of clamping frames.
assignees: GUANGZHOU BATH NETWORK SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Sea search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a sea surface search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein the top of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is fixedly connected with a protective cover, two sides in the protective cover are symmetrically and rotatably connected with rotating shafts, the outer side of each rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a cotton brush, one end of one rotating shaft extends to the inside of the protective cover and is fixedly connected with a second gear, and the sea surface search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle has the beneficial effects that: through adding electric telescopic handle No. two, the rack, No. two gears and cotton brush isotructure use of mutually supporting, be favorable to the cotton brush to wipe off fast the water stain in the protection casing outside, make the shooting definition of camera higher, improve the efficiency that sea was searched for and rescued, through adding the ring gear, including a motor, an end cap, a controller, and a cover plate, be favorable to adjusting the shooting position of camera, make the camera can 360 no dead angles shoot, improve the shooting scope, through adding electric telescopic handle, be favorable to adjusting the every single move angle of camera, improve the flexibility of camera.

title_en: Obstacle-crossing rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an obstacle-crossing rescue robot which comprises a robot body, wherein a walking mechanism and a detection assembly are arranged on the robot body, and the walking mechanism comprises a crawler walking assembly, a swing arm wheel walking assembly and a connecting rod supporting assembly; the detection assembly is used for data acquisition at a specific position. The obstacle-crossing rescue robot disclosed by the invention has the advantages that through carrying out subversion type improvement on the walking mechanism, the obstacle-crossing rescue robot can carry out autonomous control according to environment information, search a signal source and transmit disaster environment information to rescue commanders, complex actions such as turning, ascending and descending, continuous steps ascending and descending, boss and gully crossing can be carried out in a complex disaster area, and in addition, a temperature sensor, an oxygen sensor, a methane sensor and a carbon monoxide sensor are arranged, so that various data can be acquired by penetrating into the center of the complex disaster area.

title_en: Robot rescue detection system for mine water-permeable accidents
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of rescue robots, and particularly relates to a robot rescue detection system for mine water permeation accidents.A unmanned base station is arranged in an underground roadway and is used as a storage place of an underwater vehicle under normal conditions, and is used as a place for recovering and charging the underwater vehicle and a relay station of a communication link after the water permeation accidents occur; the underwater vehicle is normally stored in the unmanned base station, and is used for detecting the environment in the roadway after a water permeation accident occurs and uploading the condition in the roadway to the ground terminal through the unmanned base station; the water snake robot is adsorbed on an underwater vehicle through an electromagnet and is used for detecting narrow areas which cannot be detected by the underwater vehicle. The detection system provided by the invention has the capabilities of underground detection, recovery charging and communication guarantee, provides a new idea that the robot participates in permeable mine disaster rescue, and simultaneously, the underwater vehicle and the water snake robot are separated to operate according to the requirements of different spaces, so that the search and rescue range is expanded.

title_en: Rescue unmanned aerial vehicle is used after calamity with search and rescue function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a post-disaster rescue unmanned aerial vehicle with search and rescue functions, which comprises a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein a storage bin is fixed at the bottom end of the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle body, a winch used for lifting articles is arranged on the storage bin, a fixing structure used for fixing the articles is arranged on the storage bin, an anti-falling structure used for preventing a life buoy from falling off is arranged on the fixing structure, and an unloading structure used for unloading the life buoy is arranged on the fixing structure; the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle body is provided with a search and rescue structure, a waterproof structure for protecting the camera is arranged inside the search and rescue structure, and a cleaning structure for cleaning the waterproof structure is arranged on the search and rescue structure; a cleaning structure is arranged on the search and rescue structure; and then be convenient for collect the information through searching for and rescuing the structure, waterproof construction's setting makes searching for and rescuing structural information collection effect better, and the setting of clean structure is convenient for clean waterproof construction, further improvement search for and rescue the effect.
assignees: SICHUAN PROVINCE TIANJI NAVIGATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Drowning perosn Recognition System Using Deep Learning
title_ko: 딥러닝을 이용한 익수자 인식 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a drowning person recognition system using deep learning. More specifically, according to the drowning person recognition system using deep learning, it is possible to quickly rescue a drowning person. To this end, the drowning person recognition system using deep learning of the present invention comprises: a learning data generation module (100); a data learning module (200); a plurality of thermal imaging camera modules (300); a person detection module (400); and a bounding box positioning module (500).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 딥러닝을 이용한 익수자 인식 시스템에 관한 것이다. 보다 상세하게는, 영상처리 분야에서 활용되고 있는 딥러닝 기술 중 하나인 컨볼루션 신경망(Convolution Neural Network(CNN))를 이용하여 선박 내에 위치하는 사람 또는 선박에서 바다로 추락하는 상황에 있는 사람 또는 바다에 빠져 익수 상황에 있는 사람을 식별하기 위한 학습을 하고, 열화상 영상 화면에 설정된 경계선을 통해 선박에 위치한 사람이 경계선을 넘어 바다로 추락할 경우, 학습된 딥러닝 네트워크 모델에서 익수 상황을 인지하고, 신속하게 다른 선원들에게 익수 발생 상황을 알려 바다에 빠진 익수자를 구조할 수 있는 딥러닝을 이용한 익수자 인식 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해 본 발명은 선박의 갑판을 포함하여 선박 내에 위치하고 있는 사람 또는 사람이 선박에서 해상으로 추락하는 상황에 있는 사람 또는 해상에 추락하여 익수 상태에 있는 사람들을 포함하여 다수의 이미지에서 사람에 대해 경계박스를 설정하는 라벨링 과정을 통해 배경이 포함된 이미지에서 사람만을 식별할 수 있는 학습데이터를 생성하는 학습데이터생성모듈(100); 컨볼루션신경망이 포함된 딥러닝 네트워크 모델이 포함되며, 학습데이터생성모듈(100)에 의해 생성된 학습데이터를 딥러닝 네트워크 모델에 대한 입력데이터로 이용하여 입력데이터로 사용된 이미지 상에서 사람를 탐지하기 위한 학습을 진행하는 데이터학습모듈(200); 선박에 위치하는 사람 또는 선박에서 해상으로 추락하는 상황에 있는 사람 또는 해상에 추락하여 익수 상황에 있는 사람을 촬영하기 위해 선박에 구비되는 다수의 열화상카메라모듈(300); 데이터학습모듈(200)에 의해 학습된 딥러닝 네트워크 모델을 이용하여 선박에 위치하는 사람 또는 선박에서 해상으로 추락하는 상황에 있는 사람 또는 해상에서 익수 상황에 처한 사람을 탐지하는 모듈로서, 열화상카메라모듈(300)에서 획득한 영상 정보를 시간 단위로 캡쳐하고, 캡쳐된 영상 중에 포함된 사람을 탐지하며, 탐지된 사람에 대해 경계박스가 설정된 이미지를 출력하는 인명탐지모듈(400); 인명탐지모듈(400)에서 사람을 탐지한 경우, 열화상카메라모듈(300)에서 획득한 영상 정보에 있는 사람의 위치를 알아내고 저장하는 경계박스위치파악모듈(500)을 포함하는 딥러닝을 이용한 익수자 인식 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Fire rescue robot for high-rise building
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire rescue robot for a high-rise building, and relates to the technical field of intelligent robots.
