The invention comprises a bearing box; a mounting rack is horizontally fixed on two opposite outer side surfaces of the bearing box; the mounting frame is provided with an unmanned aerial vehicle; the bearing box comprises a first side wall and a second side wall which are arranged side by side; one surface of the first side wall is provided with two pairs of through holes which are arranged side by side; an adsorption component is arranged on one surface of the first side wall; the inside of the bearing box is provided with a drilling component corresponding to the through hole and a shifting component corresponding to the drilling component; two pairs of positioning studs matched with the through holes are mounted on the displacement assembly; the inside of the bearing box is also provided with a rope component corresponding to the adsorption component. The invention not only has reasonable structural design and convenient operation, but also effectively improves the rescue efficiency of high-rise buildings and has higher market application value.
assignees: JIANGSU SANQINGZHIDA SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Primary and secondary unmanned aerial vehicle release recovery unit
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a release and recovery device for a primary-secondary unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a square cabin box, a steering engine fixing frame, a steering engine body and a square cabin cover, and is characterized in that: the square cabin box is characterized in that a steering engine fixing frame is in threaded connection with the outer wall of one side of the square cabin box, a steering engine body is in clamping connection with the inside of the steering engine fixing frame, connection contact blocks are arranged on two sides of the outer wall of the steering engine body, and the steering engine body is in mutual contact with the top end of the steering engine fixing frame through the connection contact blocks; the utility model can execute a plurality of tasks, such as power inspection, road detection and the like, when a rescue task is carried out, the primary machine carries the secondary machine to reach the area required by the task, but the area is narrow or the environment is severe, when the six rotor unmanned aerial vehicles can not reach, the secondary machine can play a role and can search and rescue in a large area, one unmanned aerial vehicle is not enough and the other unmanned aerial vehicle is carried, at the moment, the two unmanned aerial vehicles can separately execute the task, and the primary idea of task planning of the multiple unmanned aerial vehicles is basically realized.

title_en: Novel deformable wheel-leg robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel deformable wheel-leg robot, which comprises a frame, four deformable wheel-leg mechanisms and four transmission mechanisms, wherein the four deformable wheel-leg mechanisms are arranged on the frame; the deformable wheel leg mechanism comprises three deformable legs, three planet gears, a planet gear carrier, a central gear and an outer end cover, the deformable legs comprise a first connecting rod, a second connecting rod, a third connecting rod, a first arc leg and a second arc leg, the transmission mechanism comprises a hollow shaft driven by a driving motor to rotate and a deformable shaft driven by a deformation motor to rotate, the tail end of the hollow shaft is connected with the first connecting rod, and the tail end of the deformable shaft is connected with the central gear. The novel deformable wheel-leg robot can be used in the fields of exploration, observation, target detection, destruction, search and rescue and the like of structured and unstructured terrains. The deformable wheel-leg type mobile robot based on the folding and extending motion characteristics of the parallelogram in the circle and the deformable circular arc improves the obstacle crossing capability of the wheel-leg type mobile robot, and is simple in structure, simple in control strategy and high in deformation rate.

title_en: Omnidirectional multi-degree-of-freedom modular soft robot based on paper folding structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to an omnidirectional multi-degree-of-freedom modular soft robot based on a paper folding structure, which comprises a head sensor, a bending paper folding unit and a telescopic paper folding unit, wherein the head sensor is arranged at one end of the bending paper folding unit, the bending paper folding unit comprises a plurality of paper folding modules, a connecting shell and a bending driving assembly, the telescopic paper folding unit comprises a plurality of paper folding modules, a connecting shell and a telescopic driving assembly, each paper folding module comprises a variation Jicun mode paper folding mechanism and a variation Tripu mode paper folding mechanism, a plurality of groups of variation Tripu mode paper folding mechanisms are circumferentially and uniformly distributed on the variation Jicun mode paper folding mechanisms, and the bending driving assembly and the telescopic driving assembly drive the paper folding modules to generate bending and telescopic motion by controlling the flowing direction of liquid in each group of variation Tripu mode paper folding mechanisms respectively. The invention has the advantages of flexibility of multiple degrees of freedom, self-driving simplicity, modularization independence and the like, and can be applied to the fields of post-disaster extreme environment search and rescue, pipeline multi-curvature crawling and the like.

title_en: Miniature fire-fighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a miniature fire-extinguishing rescue robot which comprises a bottom plate, moving wheels, a fire-extinguishing box and a fire-extinguishing device, wherein the moving wheels are arranged below the bottom plate, the fire-extinguishing box is arranged on the upper surface of the bottom plate, the fire-extinguishing device is arranged on the upper surface of the fire-extinguishing box, mounting plates are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the fire-extinguishing box, two fixing plates are fixedly connected to the upper side and the lower side of each mounting plate, a movable plate is connected between the two fixing plates in a sliding manner, a supporting rod is fixedly connected to the lower surface of each movable plate, and the bottom end of each supporting rod is rotatably connected with a rotating shaft. According to the miniature fire-fighting rescue robot, the roller at the bottom end of the supporting rod is in contact with the ground until the bottom plate moves above the obstacle, then the second motor is started to drive the roller to rotate, and the robot can cross the obstacle in the rotating process of the roller, so that the rescue time is shortened without detouring, and the rescue task is better completed.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle combination search and rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle combined search and rescue system which comprises a floor stand positioned at the bottom of an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein parallel and symmetrical reinforcing walls are arranged in the middle of the floor stand, driving equipment is arranged at the joint of the reinforcing walls and the floor stand, a rotating shaft penetrates through the reinforcing walls, the top of one end of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a driving end of the driving equipment, a clamping frame is arranged at the top of one end, away from the driving equipment, of the rotating shaft, and the driving equipment drives the clamping frame to rotate through the rotating shaft; according to the unmanned aerial vehicle, the driving device, the rotating shaft and the clamping frame are arranged, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle has a function of clamping articles to move, the rotating shaft is driven to rotate through the driving device, the clamping frame is rotated, the articles are fixed inside the clamping frame, and therefore the rescue of the disabled is facilitated, the rescue implementation efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the search and rescue process is improved, the articles are rescued for the disabled in time, and the safety of the disabled is improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI AND TRUE INFORMATION SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Voice wireless transmission and AI voice recognition equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a voice wireless transmission and AI voice recognition device, which comprises a storage battery and a box body, a storage battery is arranged on one side of the guard plate, a first groove is arranged on the outer surface of the front end of the storage battery, a first universal pipe is arranged in the first groove, the top end of the first universal tube is provided with a lamp tube, the outer surface of the rear end of the storage battery is provided with a second groove, a second universal pipe is arranged in the second groove, a heat radiation fan is arranged at the top of the second universal pipe, a camera, a display screen and a microphone are arranged on one side of the storage battery, which is far away from the guard plate, a box body is arranged at the lower end of the storage battery, the upper surface of the box body is provided with a storage tank, the storage tank is internally provided with a water storage tank, an insulation can, a medical box and an oxygen supply machine, the LED projection lamp is characterized in that an infrared probe, an LED projection lamp and a signal transmitter are arranged at the front end of the box body, supporting rods are arranged at the front end of the box body, and a push shovel is arranged between the supporting rods. The multifunctional rescue robot has multiple functions and is suitable for rescue in emergency situations where people cannot easily enter the environment.
assignees: SHENZHEN XINSIWEI SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Intelligent search and rescue system in special environments such as disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent search and rescue system in disaster and other special environments, which comprises a body surface feature extraction device, a vital sign extraction device, a voice feature extraction device and a network transmission device which are sequentially in communication connection, wherein the body surface feature extraction device adopts a GRU network model for transmission and storage, the voice feature extraction device comprises a voice acquisition module, a voice feature extraction module and a voice analysis processing module which are sequentially in communication connection, the voice analysis processing module is provided with a noise database comprising various environmental sounds, the environmental sounds in the noise database are removed through wavelet analysis for noise reduction, and the network transmission device comprises a Zigbee network communication module, a network transmitting module, an unmanned aerial vehicle network relay module and a network receiving base station which are sequentially in communication connection. The comprehensive scheme for extracting the multiple characteristics of the wounded in the special environment such as the disaster is provided, the real state of the disaster site is restored, and a basis and artificial intelligence assistant decision are provided for the efficient development of rescue work.
assignees: CHINESE PEOPLE LIBERATION ARMY LAND ARMY AND MILITARY UNIV

title_en: Underwater emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides an underwater emergency rescue robot, which comprises: the buoyancy housing module is used for providing buoyancy; the underwater propulsion module is arranged on the buoyancy shell module and used for providing propulsion; the underwater sensing module is arranged on the buoyancy shell module and used for sensing the external environment; the mechanical arm module is arranged at the advancing end of the buoyancy shell module; the breaking-in cutting module is arranged on the mechanical arm module and is used for realizing breaking-in cutting; and the main control module is used for controlling the underwater propulsion module, the underwater sensing module and the mechanical arm module. According to the underwater emergency rescue robot, the buoyancy shell module provides buoyancy, the underwater sensing module senses the external environment, the main control module controls the underwater propelling module to achieve the movement of advancing and retreating, floating and submerging, turning and the like, the main control module controls the telescopic movement of the mechanical arm module, and the cutting of the breaking and detaching cutting module is achieved according to the requirement, so that the purposes of guaranteeing life safety and reducing property loss are achieved.
assignees: INST OF AUTOMATION OF CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Underwater lifesaving robot system
abstract_en: The invention provides an underwater lifesaving robot system, which comprises a movable signal station, an unmanned aerial vehicle carrying a small lifesaving robot and the like. The movable signal station comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle signal receiving and transmitting module and a lifesaving robot signal receiving and transmitting module, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a flight module, a positioning module and a signal receiving and transmitting module, and the lifesaving robot comprises an underwater driving module, a positioning module, an air bag module and the like. The unmanned aerial vehicle information and the lifesaving robot information are shared through the signal station, the position of the water falling point is rapidly positioned through aerial photographing of the unmanned aerial vehicle and laser radar positioning, and the possible drowning range of a person falling into water is sent through the signal station, so that the search and rescue time is effectively reduced, and the search and rescue efficiency is improved. The lifesaving robot distinguishes normal swimmers from drowners through autonomous recognition and carries out rescue on the drowners. Rescue efficiency can be greatly improved by controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle and the lifesaving robot to rescue, and the rescue device has the advantages of high efficiency, convenience in operation and low cost.

title_en: Rotatable multi-angle adjustable thermal imaging respirator
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rotatable multi-angle adjustable thermal imaging respirator, which relates to the field of respirators and solves the problems that the traditional respirator cannot effectively penetrate through a smoke layer to search and rescue trapped people under a dangerous-case and big-smoke environment, has a low rescue effect and cannot flexibly adjust the respirators provided with thermal imaging equipment at the same time, and has large limitation. This device can be nimble multi-angle rotate the regulation to thermal imaging camera lens, and the convenience carries out the characteristics of installation dismantlement to thermal imaging camera lens.
assignees: XIAANET JIANGSU SCIENCE AND TECH SHARE LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method and system based on marine environment
abstract_en: The application provides an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method and system based on marine environment, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a real-time GPS positioning signal transmitted back by an accident unmanned aerial vehicle in real time; determining the accident occurrence position and the accident type of the accident unmanned aerial vehicle according to the real-time GPS positioning signal; determining a rescue position according to the real-time GPS positioning signal, the accident occurrence position and the accident type; controlling the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle to move to a rescue position in a fixed wing state; detecting the current position and the current environmental information of the accident unmanned aerial vehicle through a double-optical camera arranged on the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle; determining a rescue mode according to the current environment information and the current position; the fixed wing state of adjustment is many rotor states to rescue accident unmanned aerial vehicle according to the rescue mode. It is thus clear that implementing this kind of implementation mode, can searching for and rescuing to the observation unmanned aerial vehicle that breaks down in the marine environment to can ensure to retrieve the effect of observing data under all kinds of marine environment, avoid observing the condition emergence of loss.

title_en: A fire rescue robot of high temperature resistance for forest rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of forest fire rescue, in particular to a high-temperature-resistant fire rescue robot for forest rescue, which comprises a bearing box, wherein a cooling mechanism is arranged in the bearing box, the bearing box is provided with a water inlet cavity, a working cavity is arranged below the right side in the bearing box, and the upper end of the working cavity is provided with a working box; the working box is provided with a water inlet cavity, the water inlet cavity is communicated with the water inlet cavity through a communicating pipe, an adjustable water spraying mechanism is arranged inside the working box, and the adjustable water spraying mechanism is connected with the adjustable image acquisition assembly; the front side of the bearing box is provided with a telescopic obstacle breaking component, a working cavity of the bearing box is correspondingly provided with a chain tightness maintaining component, and the chain tightness maintaining component is matched with the telescopic obstacle breaking component; through the cooperation between adjustable water spray mechanism, adjustable image acquisition subassembly, scalable broken barrier subassembly, the tight degree of chain keep subassembly and each part, can accurately put out a fire rescue work to forest fire position fast again when the device prevents high temperature.

title_en: Emergency rescue device for bungee jumping
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency rescue device for a bungee jumping, which comprises a base, wherein a bearing seat is slidably connected inside the base, fixing components are arranged on two sides of the upper end of the bearing seat, an emergency bed is clamped on the bearing seat through the fixing components, an emergency component is arranged on the upper side of the emergency bed, the emergency bed is conveniently unfolded and stored through the matching of a driving component and an adjusting component, the space occupied by the bungee jumping platform by the emergency bed is reduced, the emergency bed can be protected, the use is facilitated, bungee jumping personnel and workers are prevented from being influenced, the bungee jumping personnel can be conveniently rested through a supporting component, the fatigue is reduced, as the temperature of a high-altitude bungee is too low, when the body of the bungee jumping personnel is uncomfortable, the patient can be preliminarily rescued through the emergency component on the emergency bed, the discomfort of the patient is reduced, and the jumping personnel can be conveniently rescued by subsequent medical personnel, the rescue robot has the advantages of providing convenience for rescue work, and being simple in structure and convenient to operate.
assignees: SICHUAN YAKANG EXPRESSWAY LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY;LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY FOR EXPRESSWAY IN TIBETAN AREA OF SICHUAN

title_en: A panoramic picture collection system for unmanned aerial vehicle is open-air to be searched for andd rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a panoramic image acquisition device for field search and rescue of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the unmanned aerial vehicle and a mobile power supply arranged on the inner side of the unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein an unmanned aerial vehicle landing support is arranged on a body of the unmanned aerial vehicle, a shooting device fixing support is arranged on the body of the unmanned aerial vehicle, a panoramic shooting module is arranged on the shooting device fixing support and comprises an infrared thermal imaging panoramic submodule and an optical panoramic submodule, and a GPS (global positioning system) module and a wireless communication module are also arranged on the inner side of the body of the unmanned aerial vehicle. Can realize panoramic image and gather, solve traditional unmanned aerial vehicle and shot the limited problem of field angle.

title_en: Inflatable emergency rescue boat
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an inflatable emergency rescue boat which is characterized in that: the method comprises the following steps: the rescue boat body is provided with a driving control platform, a group of seats are arranged behind the driving control platform, a group of storage batteries are arranged behind the seats, and a group of hitches are arranged at the tail of the rescue boat body; still include the rescue sonar, the rescue sonar passes through the sonar mount pad to be installed in the front end of rescue boat hull, just the rescue sonar is connected with the controlling means among the driving console to be connected through controlling means and the display screen on the driving console. The rescue sonar is arranged at the head of the inflatable boat, so that the acoustic vision in front of a carrier can be provided no matter in a clear or turbid water body, the functions of target detection and identification, collision avoidance, obstacle detection and the like are realized, the size is small, the weight is light, the power consumption is low, the search and rescue requirements are met, and the investment cost of the rescue boat is reduced.
assignees: JIANGSU SINGRUI DEFENSE SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: High-efficiency recyclable maritime search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of maritime search and rescue, and particularly relates to a high-efficiency recyclable maritime search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle and a maritime mobile platform, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle is arranged in the maritime mobile platform, the maritime mobile platform comprises an installation shell, a gravity center adjusting device, a deceleration device, a floating device, a driving device and an elastic driving device, a first partition plate, a second partition plate and a third partition plate are sequentially arranged on the inner wall of the installation shell from bottom to top, gaps exist among the first partition plate, the second partition plate and the third partition plate, the gravity center adjusting device is arranged on the bottom side of the first partition plate, and the driving device is arranged between the first partition plate and the second partition plate. The invention can be quickly released in an accident sea area in a non-stop way by a large-scale transport unmanned aerial vehicle or a helicopter, and meanwhile, the search and rescue of the sea surface in the area can be completed by the adaptive offshore mobile platform, and the sea surface can be recovered after the search and rescue is completed.

title_en: Search and rescue robot on water
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an underwater rescue device, and discloses an underwater search and rescue robot, which comprises a driving mechanism, a rescue main body structure and a control mechanism, wherein the driving mechanism is fixedly arranged on the rescue main body structure, and the control mechanism comprises a rotatable camera module and an illumination module (704) for illuminating the surrounding environment; the Beidou positioning module (713) can be used for positioning the current position of the rescue robot; the data processing module (709) is electrically connected with the Beidou positioning module (713) and the camera module; the central control module (708) is electrically connected with the data processing module (709), and the central control module (708) can receive the position information processed by the data processing module (709), plan a travel track according to the position information, and control the driving mechanism to travel along the travel track. The utility model can flexibly adjust the camera module to acquire the surrounding water surface information, and the lighting device is arranged to enable the rescue robot to perform rescue actions at night.
assignees: HUNAN ZHONGBIAN DUPLEX EMERGENCY EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned robot for searching, rescuing and disinfecting during inspection
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned inspection, search and rescue and disinfection robot which comprises a bottom-layer moving trolley and an upper-layer disinfection device, and the robot effectively solves the problems of untimely inspection, untimely troubleshooting, inconvenient personnel search and rescue, substandard epidemic situation prevention and control and the like of equipment of a chemical enterprise, not only ensures the stable operation of the equipment of the chemical plant, but also ensures the safety of the working environment of the personnel, and has remarkable practical significance after actual production.

title_en: Novel three hull surface of water unmanned aerial vehicle that take off and land of rhombus structure
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel three-hull water surface take-off and landing unmanned aerial vehicle with a diamond structure, which comprises three-hull type airframes, wings with the diamond structure, a composite control surface control part, a propulsion device and the like, wherein the three-hull type airframes are used for realizing water surface staying, high-speed sliding, water surface sliding stability, load loading and the like, the wings with the diamond structure adopt the composite diamond structure to obtain higher lift force and structural strength, the composite control surface control part provides attitude control of water surface sliding and flying states, and a power device provides propulsion force for the unmanned aerial vehicle. Compared with the existing water unmanned aerial vehicle, the water surface take-off and landing unmanned aerial vehicle has the advantages that the lift performance is improved by 35%, the voyage is improved by more than 25%, the water surface high-speed sliding performance is better, and the water surface take-off and landing unmanned aerial vehicle can be widely applied to water surface search and rescue, information tracking, material throwing and the like.

title_en: Rescue device based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue device based on unmanned aerial vehicle contains the unmanned aerial vehicle main part, and the top that is equipped with in the unmanned aerial vehicle main part is equipped with the blade drive all around, is equipped with the camera on the outer wall of unmanned aerial vehicle main part, and the bottom of unmanned aerial vehicle main part is equipped with the support frame, and the bottom of unmanned aerial vehicle main part is equipped with rescue goods and materials transport structure; rescue goods and materials transport structure includes: the device comprises a shell, a pair of fixing frames, a motor, a screw rod, a pair of sliding blocks, a pair of clamping plates, a guide rod and a conveying box; search and rescue personnel that can be on a large scale nature through being equipped with the camera on unmanned aerial vehicle improve search and rescue efficiency, let stranded personnel and missing personnel can find fast. Through the rescue goods and materials conveying structure, the rescue goods and materials can be sent to trapped people and lost people when the trapped people and the lost people are found, the safety of the people can be guaranteed at the first time, one layer of guarantee is provided for the trapped people and the lost people, and therefore the probability of accidental danger is reduced.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle searches for ands rescue monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a search for and rescue equipment technical field, specifically indicate an unmanned aerial vehicle searches for ands rescue monitoring device. Including the unmanned aerial vehicle body, there is crashproof subassembly around the unmanned aerial vehicle body, crashproof subassembly includes the spring beam, the spring beam has the inner ring, the inner ring is connected with the outer loop through damper, there is the control subassembly unmanned aerial vehicle body bottom, the control subassembly includes the carriage, there is angle adjusting part in the carriage, angle adjusting part includes the motor, the output shaft of motor has the master gear, master gear one side has two pinions and auxiliary gear in proper order, the master gear, there is the division board bottom two pinions and auxiliary gear, there is connecting axle two the division board bottom, there is the rotor plate on the connecting axle two, there is supervisory equipment two bottoms of connecting axle, master gear and auxiliary gear all have the actuating lever, rotor plate and the mutual slip joint of actuating lever. The utility model discloses a can the anticollision, can make a round trip to adjust supervisory equipment's angle, the unmanned aerial vehicle that can the multi-angle search and rescue monitoring device.
assignees: COLLECTIVE UNIV;XIAMEN WANLONG SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Self-navigation underwater search and rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a self-navigation underwater search and rescue device which comprises a waterproof shell, wherein a waterproof lamp is arranged on a cover plate on the upper part of the waterproof shell, anti-collision foam is arranged on the periphery of the cover plate, a storage battery, an integrated mainboard, an infrared thermal imager and a motor are arranged in the waterproof shell, a motor rotor at the tail part of the motor is connected with a propeller, the integrated mainboard simultaneously controls the motor, the waterproof lamp and the infrared thermal imager, and the storage battery arranged in the waterproof shell provides energy for the whole device. The device is based on the requirements of rescue timeliness, device simplicity and search and rescue self-navigation, and through the integrated mainboard of function synthesis, the coordinated work of the control motor, the waterproof lamp and the infrared thermal imager realizes the independent omnibearing search and rescue work of water surface and underwater deployment in a certain water area.

title_en: Post-disaster air-land dual-purpose rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster air-land dual-purpose rescue robot, which relates to the field of rescue robots and comprises a machine body, machine arms, an automatic folding mechanism, a rotor wing mechanism and a land running mechanism, wherein the machine arms are respectively arranged around the machine body through the automatic folding mechanism, the rotor wing mechanism is respectively arranged on each machine arm, and the land running mechanism is arranged below the machine body. The invention has the advantages that: the invention is an organic combination of a rotor robot and a ground robot, and can freely switch between two modes of air and ground; when the robot is in the air, each arm is unfolded and moves through the rotor wing mechanism; the robot moves through the land running mechanism when on the ground, and folds each arm to the vicinity of the machine body through the automatic folding mechanism, so that the occupied area of the rotor wing mechanism is reduced, and the robot can adapt to the movement among various complex terrains.

title_en: Apparatus and method for controlling drones to search for victims at sea
title_ko: 해상 조난자를 수색하기 위한 드론 제어 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a device and method for controlling a drone for searching for a survivor using a drone. The device for controlling the drone according to one embodiment may comprise: a path generating part that generates the flight path information based on the drone location information received from the drone and the distress location information received from at least one or more survivors; and a location calculation part that calculates a location of the survivor detected in an image photographed by the drone based on at least one among the drone location information, the camera setting information, and the image information received from the drone.
abstract_ko: 드론을 이용하여 조난자를 수색하는 드론 제어 장치 및 방법이 개시된다. 일 실시예에 따른 드론 제어 장치는 드론으로부터 수신한 드론 위치 정보 및 하나 이상의 조난자로부터 수신한 조난 위치 정보를 기초로 비행 경로 정보를 생성하는 경로 생성부; 및 드론으로부터 수신한 드론 위치 정보, 카메라 설정 정보 및 영상 정보 중 적어도 하나를 기초로 드론에서 촬영된 영상에서 검출되는 조난자의 위치를 계산하는 위치 계산부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Emergency management monitoring method based on three-dimensional model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency management monitoring method based on a three-dimensional model, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring. It fixes a position the danger source fast and analyzes out danger area, rescue area and safe region through surveying unmanned aerial vehicle to set up and build the picture and keep away the artifical potential field algorithm behind the barrier module and the supplementary potential field of introduction, generate the best three-dimensional emergency rescue route, reduced unmanned aerial vehicle's unnecessary and lost, help improving rescue personnel's search and rescue efficiency simultaneously, thereby can prevent to cause personnel to be meaningless when rescue personnel clear away the danger source and die.

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle convenient to change camera
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for searching and rescuing, which is convenient for replacing a camera, and relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles. According to the utility model, the second screw rod is rotated by the handle to drive the second fixing plate to move, and the second fixing plate can clamp the camera through matching with the frame, so that the camera can be quickly assembled and disassembled, and further, the time is effectively saved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle positioning method and device for search and rescue scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue scene-oriented unmanned aerial vehicle positioning method and device, and relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles and positioning. Wherein unmanned aerial vehicle is equipped with height measurement module, communication module, range finding module, removes distance measurement module, angle measurement module, storage module and calculation module. The positioning method comprises the following steps: firstly, the unmanned aerial vehicle is lifted off, height information is obtained by using a height measurement module, and a projection plane is determined according to the height information; then, a distance measurement process is executed to obtain distance information from the base station to the unmanned aerial vehicle; then, the current position is used as the origin to establish a virtual coordinate system along which The shaft advances forward; stopping moving after a distance, measuring the advancing distance by using a moving distance measuring module, and executing a distance measuring process to the base station; selecting a new direction, and then advancing along the new direction; stopping moving after advancing for a certain distance, measuring the advancing distance, and executing the distance measurement process to the base station; and finally, calculating and determining the starting position of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the measured information.

title_en: Snake-shaped robot capable of being disconnected
abstract_en: The invention relates to a breakable snake-shaped robot. The invention relates to a breakable snake-shaped robot, which comprises: the snake head unit and the snake tail unit are respectively connected to two ends of the trunk unit, the trunk unit comprises a plurality of connected joints, and each joint can be controlled to be disconnected through the control unit. In the working process, when the trunk unit is damaged or blocked, the joint can be disconnected, the snake head can continue to advance to work within a certain range from one section to the disconnected part, and the snake head can be used for operation in environments which are difficult to enter, such as detection, exploration and search and rescue after an earthquake in complex environments.

title_en: Cross-domain combined lifesaving positioning device and lifesaving method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of marine engineering equipment industry, and particularly relates to a cross-domain combined lifesaving positioning device and a lifesaving method, wherein the cross-domain combined lifesaving positioning device comprises the following components: one end of the electronic cabin is provided with a receiving device, and the other end of the electronic cabin is provided with a protective cover; one end of the protective cover is provided with a folding air bag, the inner side of the protective cover is provided with an air bag needle, a high-pressure air chamber and an antenna system, the side surface of the protective cover is provided with a seawater switch and a tying point, and the tying point is provided with a tying line; the antenna system and the seawater switch are electrically connected to the electronic cabin; and the high-pressure air chamber is provided with a one-way valve. The life-saving positioning device can send Beidou positioning information per se according to appointed time when floating on the water surface; when the beacon is in an underwater state, underwater sound response can be realized under the call of underwater sound search and rescue equipment, and the underwater positioning and the identification of the beacon are completed. The device integrates three positioning modes of Beidou positioning, AIS positioning and underwater sound positioning, can be installed on an airplane and a ship, and can replace the existing wireless telecommunication beacon and the acoustic beacon after losing the fact.

title_en: Bionic six-foot search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bionic six-foot search and rescue robot which comprises a head and an abdomen, wherein the head is connected to the abdomen, two rows of lower limbs are arranged on the left side and the right side of the head, the lower limbs are multi-stage mechanical arms, a high-definition camera is arranged on the head, an infrared detector is further arranged on the head, and a control and communication module is arranged on the abdomen. The earthquake-resistant searching method can solve the problems that the efficiency of searching trapped people by manpower is low and the searching is not timely after the earthquake happens at present.

title_en: Running gear and bionical search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a walking mechanism and a bionic search and rescue robot, relates to the technical field of rescue equipment, and solves the technical problem that the existing crawler-type search and rescue robot cannot work efficiently and reliably in environments with large obstacle size or complex terrain. The walking mechanism comprises a driving device, a transmission structure and walking legs, wherein the walking legs are in transmission connection with the driving device through the transmission structure; and the walking legs comprise crawler wheel mechanisms, and the walking mechanisms can adopt foot type walking and/or crawler type walking under the driving of the driving device. After the bionic search and rescue robot adopts the walking mechanism, a track advancing mode is adopted on a road section with few obstacles, and when the bionic search and rescue robot encounters a step and a large-size obstacle, the bionic search and rescue robot can be switched to a foot type to be combined with a track to advance so as to cross the obstacle, so that the bionic search and rescue robot is suitable for various complex rescue environments, can pass through complex terrains, quickly and smoothly completes search and rescue tasks, improves search and rescue efficiency and strives for precious time for rescue.

title_en: Ruins search and rescue-oriented vitamin soft continuum robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ruin search and rescue-oriented vitamin soft continuum robot, wherein a soft continuum module comprises a nylon corrugated outer tube and an inner hose; the inner hose is formed into a double-layer pipe structure by sleeving an inner pipe body and an outer pipe body at intervals; the inner pipe body is formed into an installation cavity, and the outer pipe body is connected with the inner pipe body through a plurality of separation soft strips, and a plurality of pneumatic control cavities are formed; the inner side wall of the mounting cavity is provided with a supporting pressure spring in a fit manner; a fiber bag tube and a functional pipeline are integrally arranged in the mounting cavity, and nylon wires are filled in the fiber bag tube; each pneumatic control cavity is connected with a driving air pipe; the driving air pipe and the fiber bag pipe are respectively connected with the pneumatic mechanism; the gear feeding mechanism is meshed with the outer side ripple of the nylon ripple outer tube through a gear, and displacement driving of the nylon ripple outer tube is achieved through gear rotation; the working head is fixed at one end of the nylon corrugated outer pipe and is fixed with the end head of the inner hose, and the working head is integrally provided with a functional piece corresponding to the functional pipeline.

title_en: Based on AI intelligence search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AI-based intelligent search and rescue robot, which comprises: the intelligent rescue system comprises a main control module, a power supply circuit, an interface circuit, a detection circuit, a driving circuit, a clue acquisition circuit, an emergency circuit, a lighting circuit and a communication circuit, wherein the power supply circuit provides stable power supply voltage for the movement of the robot and a control system of the whole robot, the interface circuit can be connected with peripheral electronic equipment, the detection circuit can detect various environmental indexes, the driving circuit provides power guarantee for the rescue of the robot, the clue acquisition circuit can acquire information such as sound, temperature and humidity and the like of an accident occurrence place, the emergency circuit comprises a fire extinguishing circuit, a ventilation circuit and an oxygen supply circuit, the lighting circuit can carry out lighting guidance in a dark environment, the communication circuit can keep real-time data interaction with the connected electronic equipment, and the intelligent rescue system can replace rescue personnel to carry out emergency rescue tasks and simultaneously carry out emergency rescue on the rescue personnel, has good market value.
assignees: SHENZHEN CLOUD STORAGE SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Miner lamp capable of realizing accurate positioning of trapped personnel in mine permeable well
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine water-permeable accident emergency rescue, and is particularly suitable for accurately positioning trapped personnel in a mine water-permeable underground. A miner lamp capable of realizing accurate positioning of trapped personnel in a mine permeable well comprises an underwater positioning acoustic beacon and a portable miner lamp. The underwater positioning acoustic beacon consists of a signal generating unit and a piezoelectric ceramic transmitting transducer, wherein the signal generating unit is used for forming periodic sinusoidal electric signals, and the piezoelectric ceramic transmitting transducer is used for converting the received sinusoidal electric signals into acoustic signals. Under normal conditions, the circuit of the signal generating unit is in an off state, and after water is met, the circuit can emit sound signals by taking water as a medium to conduct the circuit. After the mine water-permeable accident occurs, search and rescue personnel or robots can carry search sonar to capture acoustic signals emitted by the underwater positioning acoustic beacons, so that the positions of trapped personnel are accurately determined.

title_en: Remote-controlled special operation robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a special operation robot capable of being remotely controlled, which comprises an electric crawler chassis and a monitoring crushing structure, wherein the monitoring crushing structure is arranged at the top of the electric crawler chassis; the broken structure of control includes the base, the top fixedly connected with motor case of base, the first motor of interior diapire fixedly connected with of motor case, the top swing joint of motor case has first carousel, the first electric putter of top fixedly connected with of first carousel, two surveillance cameras of top fixedly connected with of first electric putter piston rod, first mounting groove has been seted up at the top of base, the interior diapire fixedly connected with second motor of first mounting groove. This but remote control's special work robot can carry out the breakage to the roadblock, can let the device continue to advance in special road conditions, continues to carry out the search and rescue task.
assignees: EXQUISITE ROBOT SYSTEM JIANGSU CO LTD

title_en: Rescue robot for transferring injured person out of danger
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue robot for wounded person takes off danger and shifts, include: an electrical box; the chassis is arranged on two sides of the electric box body; the safety cabin is arranged at the top of the electric box body; a transfer assembly disposed on the safety cabin; the safety cabin comprises two mechanical grippers, and the two mechanical grippers are respectively arranged on two symmetrical sides of the safety cabin. The utility model discloses a mechanical tongs and conveying assembly's cooperation can hold up the wounded who loses consciousness down to the ground under the complex environment behind the calamity and convey in the safety capsule, then rescue robot will hinder the environment that the person takes out danger, realize the transfer of taking off danger to hindering the person.

title_en: Overwater triaxial suspension type search and rescue machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water triaxial suspension type search and rescue machine, which relates to the technical field of rescue robots.A base body of an unmanned aerial vehicle, a buffer component and a rescue component are sequentially connected from top to bottom; the unmanned aerial vehicle base body comprises a first connecting plate, the center of the upper portion of the first connecting plate is vertically connected with a first connecting rod, a first fan blade is arranged at the top end of the first connecting rod, an unmanned aerial vehicle body is coaxially arranged in the middle of the first connecting rod, the first connecting plate is hinged around a second connecting rod, a second fan blade is arranged at the end portion of the second connecting rod, and the second connecting rod is connected with the unmanned aerial vehicle body through a hinged hydraulic rod; the buffer assembly comprises an upper fixing plate and a lower fixing plate, and a flow guide base body is arranged between the upper fixing plate and the lower fixing plate; the rescue assembly comprises a rescue plate, and handles capable of swinging are arranged on two sides of the rescue assembly. The invention can improve the rescue efficiency, ensure the rescue safety and improve the stability of the rescue equipment.

title_en: Coal mine post-disaster rescue robot and positioning and communication method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine post-disaster rescue robot and a positioning and communication method thereof. The scheme accurately utilizes available information of a roadway after disaster, fully combines the actual running state of the robot, deploys and positions communication nodes independently and scientifically, and realizes the automatic recovery, positioning and communication functions of the nodes.

title_en: Flexible shaft drive type bionic robot fish with variable fin wave shape
abstract_en: The invention provides a flexible shaft drive type bionic robot fish with variable fin wave shape, which comprises a shell module (1), a power and control module (2), a transmission module (3) and an execution module (4), wherein the power and control module (2), the transmission module and the execution module are connected to the shell module (1); the shell module (1) comprises a head section shell, a tail section shell and a plurality of middle section shells; the head section shell, the middle section shell and the tail section shell are sequentially and flexibly connected; the power and control module (2) transmits the execution module (4) through the transmission module (3). The flexible shaft drive type bionic robot fish with the variable fin fluctuation waveform has the characteristics of strong stealth performance, good maneuvering performance, high propelling efficiency, small environmental disturbance and the like, and has military applications such as battlefield investigation, target search and rescue and the like or civil applications such as ecological monitoring, ocean salvage and the like.

title_en: Search and rescue ROV control system and method with path planning function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue ROV control system and method with a path planning function, wherein the search and rescue ROV control system comprises an underwater environment grid map model building module, a path planning module and a control module, wherein the underwater environment grid map model building module is used for building an underwater environment grid map model through the working environment of an underwater robot, the path planning module is used for planning a path to obtain a good path, the improved genetic algorithm is used for planning the path, the process of initializing a population by adopting an A-type algorithm, designing a path fitness function, intersecting, mutating and selecting the path, the path optimizing module is used for optimizing the good path by adopting a Bezier optimizing operator to obtain an optimal path, and the control module is used for controlling the underwater robot to search and rescue through the optimal path. The method ensures safe and efficient movement of the robot by introducing the A algorithm to optimize the initial population and designing the fitness function added with the safety distance, and utilizes the smoothness of the Bezier curve to make the path smoother and more consistent, thereby reducing the energy loss in the movement of the robot and improving the search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Sea-air stereoscopic collaborative searching system and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sea-air stereoscopic collaborative searching system and a control method thereof. The system collects the environmental information of a target area through the unmanned aerial vehicle module, then generates a rescue scheme through the decision generation module according to the environmental information collected by the unmanned aerial vehicle module, then the control module controls the unmanned aerial vehicle module to carry out rescue operation according to the rescue scheme, a user can check the environmental information collected by the unmanned aerial vehicle module in real time through the input and output module, and the control module can be controlled through the input and output module. The system can realize the precise positioning of the search and rescue target in a long distance and realize the quick rescue of the search and rescue target through the WIG craft. The invention can be widely applied to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles.

title_en: Amphibious emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an amphibious emergency rescue robot which comprises a medical system, a damping system, a power system and a communication and control system. The medical system comprises a lifesaving capsule body, a lifting and conveying mechanism, a containing and fixing mechanism, a wound condition detection mechanism and a mechanical arm group; the damping system comprises a base frame, a roller and a roller groove; the power system comprises a storage battery pack, a motor transmission mechanism, a double-rocker-arm crawler travel mechanism, an inflatable air bag, a buoyancy tank, a double-turbocharging cabin water-spraying propulsion power system and a soft body life detection mechanism; the control and communication system comprises a Beidou navigation and positioning mechanism, a radio communication mechanism and a damage monitoring mechanism. Systematic innovation is carried out from multiple shock attenuation design, comprehensive medical diagnosis and rescue, wounded's detection and storage, several aspects of information-based all-terrain walking, can freely walk in the complicated topography behind the calamity, in time searches for and rescues and emergency treatment and transportation to wounded.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: AI-based unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method, device, equipment and storage medium based on AI, this method includes: receiving a search and rescue task sent by a central server, wherein the search and rescue task comprises a target search area and terminal information of a terminal to be searched and rescued; determining a flight route based on the target search area; receiving position information sent by a terminal in the process that the target search area flies along the flight route, wherein the position information comprises terminal identification information; judging whether the terminal identification is the same as the terminal information of the terminal to be searched and rescued; if the terminal identification is judged to be the same as the terminal information of the terminal to be searched and rescued, acquiring the position information of the terminal to be searched and rescued; and sending the position information of the terminal to be searched and rescued to a search and rescue terminal so that search and rescue personnel holding the search and rescue terminal can carry out rescue according to the position information of the terminal to be searched and rescued, thereby realizing the quick positioning of the trapped position of the personnel to be searched and rescued and improving the search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue reconnaissance planning method in dynamic environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue scout planning method in a dynamic environment, which comprises the following steps: in the area to be detected or rescued, setting a no-fly area and initializing the positions of all unmanned aerial vehicles in the unmanned aerial vehicle formation as the initial cruise center positions of all unmanned aerial vehicles; constructing a Voronoi diagram, and performing respective initial region division on each unmanned aerial vehicle; determining a new cruising center position of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and determining a final cruising center position of the unmanned aerial vehicle through iterative updating; each unmanned aerial vehicle moves from the initial cruising center position to a circle with the final cruising center position as the center of a circle and the minimum turning radius of the unmanned aerial vehicle as the radius according to the Dubins flight path to carry out cruising flight; when targets appear in the area to be scouted or rescued, unmanned aerial vehicles are allocated for the targets, the unmanned aerial vehicles allocated with the targets go to the targets to perform scouting access on the targets, and the unmanned aerial vehicles return to the original cruising state after the access is completed; and if a no-fly zone is encountered in the flight path of the target access process, performing obstacle avoidance operation.
assignees: CHINESE AERONAUTICAL RADIO ELECTRONICS RES INST

title_en: Intelligent search and rescue vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent search and rescue vehicle which comprises a crawler and a rescue bin, wherein the crawler and the rescue bin are connected through a detachable hook, at least one group of mechanical arms are arranged at the top of the crawler, a lifting platform is further arranged at the top of the crawler, an unmanned aerial vehicle is arranged on the lifting platform, and the unmanned aerial vehicle is in wireless communication with the crawler. Through the main part of tracked vehicle as power, drive the rescue storehouse, can place most rescue article in the rescue storehouse, the arm still has simultaneously on the tracked vehicle, can carry or move large-scale object, thereby personnel's intensity of labour during the reduction rescue, and effectual rescue efficiency has been improved, still be equipped with unmanned aerial vehicle on the tracked vehicle in addition, search range can be enlarged through unmanned aerial vehicle, thereby the position of faster definite rescue target, can utilize unmanned aerial vehicle to implement the navigation through intelligent rescue car, long-range discovery target is and implement the intelligent operation of rescue, thereby ensure that the safety of search and rescue work goes on, and provide effectual guarantee service.

title_en: Post-disaster air-land dual-purpose rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a post-disaster air-land dual-purpose rescue robot, which relates to the field of rescue robots and comprises a robot body, a plurality of robot arms, an automatic folding mechanism, rotor wing mechanisms and a land traveling mechanism, wherein the plurality of robot arms are respectively installed on the periphery of the robot body through the automatic folding mechanism, the rotor wing mechanisms are respectively installed on the robot arms, and the land traveling mechanism is installed below the robot body. The utility model has the advantages that: the utility model is the organic combination of a rotor robot and a ground robot, and the switching between the aerial form and the ground form is free; when the robot is in the air, all the arms are unfolded and move through the rotor wing mechanism; the robot moves through the land running mechanism on the ground, and folds each horn to the vicinity of the fuselage through the automatic folding mechanism, thereby reducing the occupied area of the rotor wing mechanism and being suitable for the movement among various complex terrains.

title_en: Searching and rescuing unmanned aerial vehicle for lifting in earthquake ruin environment and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle equipment, in particular to a searching and rescuing unmanned aerial vehicle for taking off and landing in a ruins environment after earthquake and a system thereof. Including the anticollision cover, still include the unmanned aerial vehicle body and be used for adjusting the regulation cover of unmanned aerial vehicle body flight state, adjust the inside that the cover setting is covered at the anticollision, the unmanned aerial vehicle body setting just can keep the focus downward all the time at the center of adjusting. The adjusting cover is arranged inside the anti-collision cover, damage to the unmanned aerial vehicle caused by complex environments after an earthquake can be avoided, and the problem that the existing search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle cannot stably take off and land in the ruin environment after the earthquake is solved all the time by the aid of the center of gravity of the unmanned aerial vehicle body; the vision measuring unit provides relevant inclination angle image data, collects images with the inclination angle image data, and establishes a three-dimensional model with dimension information of an obstacle at the position of the survivor.

title_en: Search and rescue method and device of search and rescue robot and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a search and rescue method, a device and a storage medium of a search and rescue robot, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when a search and rescue instruction is acquired, initializing the self state of the search and rescue robot; generating an automatic search and rescue strategy according to the state of the search and rescue strategy model after training; executing search and rescue actions according to the automatic search and rescue strategy; wherein the training of the automatic search and rescue strategy model comprises: constructing a search and rescue simulation environment, and formulating a training task according to the simulation environment; constructing an automatic search and rescue strategy model based on a VDN algorithm; initializing an automatic search and rescue strategy model and training based on a training task; the invention can improve the learning efficiency of the search and rescue robot for reinforcement learning and meet the real-time requirement of the search and rescue robot in the actual task.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle system for realizing multifunctional mobile communication connection
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle system for realizing multifunctional mobile communication takeover, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein mobile communication takeover equipment is arranged between undercarriage at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the mobile communication takeover equipment comprises a communication takeover main control processor and a wireless access processor; the communication takeover main control processor is used for executing user registration processing, user searching, user identification, acquiring identity information of a user, judging whether the user is a registered user or not, executing attachment acceptance processing on the registered user and providing voice service and data service for the registered and attached user; the wireless access processor is used for realizing the communication between the user terminal and the communication takeover main control processor. The invention realizes the functions of emergency communication, communication control, information broadcasting, personnel search and rescue and the like, has the advantages of no need of ground system cooperation, comprehensive application scene, flexible and various services and the like, and can meet the service requirements of communication recovery after disasters, disaster rescue, emergency communication control and the like.
assignees: BEIJING ANHUAXIN SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Combined amphibious unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a combined amphibious unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises a floatable unmanned aerial vehicle body, a towing system, a ground control terminal and an underwater robot assembly. According to the technical scheme, the combined amphibious unmanned aerial vehicle can fly over obstacles and submerge into water to acquire underwater information in real time, and can be widely applied to occasions such as underwater search and rescue, underwater exploration and the like.
assignees: SICHUAN DUOQI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Amphibious many rotor unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an amphibious multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, which belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle manufacturing and comprises the following components: many rotor unmanned aerial vehicle subassembly, control data transmission picture pass body subassembly, transmission cable and ground control terminal. Many rotor unmanned aerial vehicle subassembly, including hollow structure's sealed organism and setting at sealed organism outside many rotor frame all around, the terminal vertical amphibious propeller that sets up of many rotor frame, amphibious propeller top and bottom set up air oar and water thick liquid respectively, and sealed organism inner chamber middle part sets up the drag system, and the top sets up mechanical interface. The control data transmission diagram transmission floating body assembly comprises a hollow sealing floating body, a data transmission antenna is arranged at the top of the sealing floating body, and a waterproof interface is arranged at the bottom of the sealing floating body. The transmission cable is respectively connected with the waterproof interface and the mechanical interface, and the dragging system can receive and release the transmission cable. The underwater information acquisition device is simple in structure, can fly over obstacles and submerge into water to acquire underwater information in real time, and can be widely applied to occasions such as underwater search and rescue, underwater exploration and the like.
assignees: SICHUAN DUOQI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mine explosion-proof rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a mine explosion-proof rescue robot which comprises a shell, a first crawler, a second crawler, a searchlight, a camera, a marking component, a protection component and a storage component, wherein the marking component comprises a water tank, a conduit and a sprinkler head, the water tank is fixedly connected with the shell and positioned above the shell, the conduit is arranged on the water tank and communicated with the inside of the water tank, the sprinkler head is fixedly connected with the conduit, marking liquid is printed on the ground, so that the running track of the robot is formed, and rescuers can be conveniently and quickly positioned for trapped people through the mutual combination of the running track of the robot on the ground and position signals sent by the robot when the robot finds the trapped people, so that the rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Camera megaphone
abstract_en: The application relates to a camera shouting device which comprises a rack, a camera shooting mechanism and an audio mechanism, wherein the upper side of the rack is used for mounting an unmanned aerial vehicle, and the lower side of the rack is used for connecting the camera shooting mechanism and the audio mechanism; the camera shooting mechanism comprises a zoom camera and a multi-shaft tripod head, and the zoom camera is rotatably connected to the rack through the multi-shaft tripod head; the audio mechanism comprises an audio transmitter and a direction adjusting component, the direction adjusting component is connected with the rack, the audio transmitter is rotatably connected with the direction adjusting component, and the audio transmission direction is adjusted through the direction adjusting component; on one hand, the invention can greatly enlarge the camera shooting range and the audio transmission range; on the other hand can utilize the multiaxis cloud platform to provide stable environment of zooming for the camera, makes unmanned aerial vehicle make a video recording the calling device and can adopt the camera of zooming to carry out remote search and rescue discernment, adapts to the disaster relief demand under the special scenes such as high-voltage line, earthquake or conflagration, avoids unmanned aerial vehicle to be close to under the scenes such as high-voltage line, earthquake or conflagration because of the electric shock, collision or high temperature etc. cause the damage.
assignees: ZHEJIANG HOVFREE INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent obstacle-crossing water curtain cooling type fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent obstacle-crossing water curtain cooling type fire rescue robot. Including interior casing, shell body, casing bottom plate, many telescopic links, by interior casing, shell body, the water storage chamber that the casing bottom plate surrounds and forms, install in the laser point cloud sensor of shell body, the controller, interior casing and shell body pass through spliced pole fixed connection, interior casing bottom is provided with many outer poles of bracing piece and the pole in the bracing piece of nestification in the outer pole of bracing piece, the one end of pole is provided with the gyro wheel in the bracing piece. The beneficial effects are as follows: the intelligent obstacle crossing capability is realized, and the maneuverability is strong; the water curtain spray head sprays water, so that the local temperature can be reduced, and the rescued people can be protected from being influenced by smoke and high temperature as much as possible; most of the working components are arranged at the bottom of the inner shell, and water in the water storage cavity has heat insulation and cooling effects on the working components, so that the failure rate of the working components is reduced; the laser point cloud sensor can be used for reconstructing a map in real time, and can be used for reconstructing a complex fire scene map and helping fire fighters to move in and out suddenly.

title_en: Mechanical device of multifunctional bionic snake-shaped search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a mechanical device of multi-functional bionical snakelike search and rescue robot, including snake head and snake body, be equipped with two eyes on the snake head, the snake body is stored the storehouse by 15 cone joint, 4 motor storehouses, 16 steering engines and 1 and is constituteed. Each pair of conical joints, each motor bin and the two ends of the storage bin in the horizontal direction are respectively provided with a through hole, and the through holes between every two adjacent components are acted through rubber rings to play a role in excessive connection. 4 steering gears are fixedly placed in each motor bin, and the steering gears are placed in an up-down left-right mode. 1 storage bin is placed at the tail of the snake body and used for storing materials required for rescue. The nylon rope passes through the through holes of all the parts in the same direction to connect all the parts. The utility model discloses a STC89C52 single chip microcomputer control realizes motion forms such as heliciform motion, abdominal motion, linear motion, side motion through the procedure, has characteristics such as simple structure, multi-functionalization, low cost, practicality are higher.
assignees: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY COLLEGE OF HUBEI UNIV OF ARTS AND SCIENCE

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue robot relates to rescue equipment technical field, including machine main part, manipulator, a drive arrangement and breaker, the manipulator sets up in machine main part, a drive arrangement fixed connection in machine main part's top, a drive arrangement's output and breaker fixed connection, a drive arrangement can drive breaker around first vertical axis for machine main part rotates and keep in the position after the rotation, and the manipulator can snatch the wounded, and breaker can break open the ruins. The utility model provides a rescue robot is convenient for operate, uses in a flexible way, can improve the promptness of rescue, reduce the rescue cost and alleviate operator's operation intensity.
assignees: ENGINEERING UNIV OF CHINESE PEOPLES ARMED POLICE FORCE

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue systems and methods
abstract_en: Systems and methods for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) search and rescue operations are provided. A UAV may include a camera configured to capture one or more images of a search area. The UAV may include at least one logic device configured to calculate a flight pattern for searching the search area, receive a target image, and analyze the one or more images of the search area to identify a target matching the target image.

title_en: Emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an emergency rescue technical field, concretely relates to emergency rescue robot. The emergency rescue robot of the utility model comprises an installation shell; the traction mechanism is arranged at the rear end of the mounting shell and is suitable for drawing the supply pipe; the crawling devices are arranged at the front end of the mounting shell along the circumferential direction of the mounting shell, one end of each crawling device is provided with a driving wheel, and the other end of each crawling device is rotatably connected with the front end of the mounting shell; at least two groups of the driving wheels have a creeping state close to each other and a boosting state open to each other. The utility model provides an emergency rescue robot can easily pass through constrictive bend and unevenness's passageway.

title_en: Fire rescue transportation robot and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire rescue transportation robot and a using method thereof, wherein the fire rescue transportation robot comprises the following steps: the medical stretcher comprises a body of a cover body, wherein a placing cabin is formed in the cover body, the space of the placing cabin can accommodate an adult to lie flat in the placing cabin, and a general medical stretcher is placed in the placing cabin; a flow dividing pipe used for spraying water to the outside of the cover body for cooling is arranged at the top of the cover body along the length direction of the cover body; one side of the outer part of the cover body is movably connected with one side of the upper part of the connecting plate; on the connecting plate, a vent hole is arranged at the first end close to the connecting plate, more than two vent holes are arranged at intervals at the second end of the connecting plate, and a water pipe hole is arranged in the middle of one side of the connecting plate; the chassis is arranged at the bottom of the connecting plate and adopts a groove-shaped structure, and an equipment layer is arranged in the groove. The invention can transport the wounded to the safe area, so that the wounded can be rescued in the gold rescue time, the search and rescue time of the rescue workers is reduced, the search and rescue risk is reduced, and the invention can be applied to the technical field of fire fighting equipment.

title_en: Novel intelligent robot inspection system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel intelligent robot system of patrolling and examining, include: the intelligent robot system comprises a running track, an intelligent robot, a field control cabinet, a receiver and a central control room, wherein the running track is arranged along an environment needing to be patrolled, the surface of the running track is provided with the intelligent robot, a network communication module is arranged on the running track, the intelligent robot is connected with the field control cabinet through the network communication module, the field control cabinet is arranged at the end part of the running track, the field control cabinet reads information of a sensor assembly, a patrolling instruction input by the field control cabinet is sent to the receiver, and the field control cabinet is connected with the central control room through the network communication module; the robot is patrolled and examined to installation on the orbit, and the rescue robot arranges the switch board in when not having the rescue task in, and intelligent control robot fixed point is regularly patrolled and examined, reduces the artifical potential safety hazard of patrolling and examining probably production, and practicality is excellent.
assignees: HEFAN ROBOT TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Running gear of heavy-duty emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traveling mechanism of a heavy-load emergency rescue robot, which comprises a plurality of groups of traveling frame bodies, wherein the adjacent traveling frame bodies are connected through a connecting piece to form a series traveling body, and the traveling frame bodies comprise: the lower end face of the bearing bracket seat is provided with a load cross beam frame, and the middle part of the load cross beam frame is provided with a ground grabbing device; and the two sides of the expansion and contraction assembly are symmetrically arranged on the load cross beam frame and are used for driving a ground gripping device to be regulated and controlled, and the output end part of the expansion and contraction assembly is also provided with a traveling support arm.

title_en: Autonomous navigation method and system of terrain-imitating city rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an autonomous navigation method of a terrain-imitating city rescue robot, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a rescue robot model; s2, designing a controller for each wheel of the rescue robot to adjust the wheel speed of each wheel; s3, performing closed-loop control on the controller in a PID speed loop mode to ensure the accuracy of the control effect; s4, obtaining perception information, so that subsequent map building and autonomous navigation are facilitated; s5, on the basis of a general PUTN algorithm, designing a corresponding cost function so that the rescue robot can avoid local obstacles in real time and stably follow a global reference path. The invention realizes the function of the robot in real-time autonomous navigation without priori under unstructured urban terrain environment, and can be used for rescue tasks under dangerous terrain. The invention realizes the kinematic modeling and simulation of the terrain-imitating eight-wheel vehicle, and can be used for verification and debugging of different navigation algorithms.

title_en: Wireless transmission underground rescue robot suitable for multiple terrains
