abstract_en: The utility model provides a wireless transmission underground rescue robot adapting to multiple terrains, which belongs to the technical field of rescue equipment, and comprises an arc plate, a driving component is arranged on the outer arc surface of the arc plate, an ultrasonic ranging sensor is arranged at the bottom of the arc plate, a main control device is arranged on the plate body of the arc plate, an anti-abrasion cushion layer is arranged on the inner arc surface of the arc plate, a bearing component is fixedly arranged on the inner arc surface of the arc plate, a regulating block is driven by the movable end of a pneumatic cylinder to slide in a regulating groove, the sliding regulating block pushes a frame and a linking arm to move through a push rod, when the linking arm is vertical to the frame, the frame is farthest away from the arc plate at the moment, so as to regulate the fitting degree of the frame and the wall of a well, the effect of supporting the arc plate is achieved, after the device goes into the well, the ultrasonic ranging sensor detects the position height of a trapped person and moves, the trapped person is covered with the bearing belt under the armpit, and the rescue person pulls up the trapped person through the stay cord, improves the rescue success rate.

title_en: Rescue robot's control system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rescue robot's control system, relates to automatic control technical field, includes controller, transmission module, mobile control orientation module and data acquisition control module based on the computer, the controller based on the computer is installed in rescue robot's electrical apparatus case for the action of each electrical part of control rescue robot, and give the control center of distal end through transmission module wireless transmission, mobile control orientation module includes attitude sensor, location chip and motor drive, attitude sensor, location chip and motor drive are connected with the controller communication electricity based on the computer respectively. The rescue robot can be automatically controlled, and the industrial control embedded computer board card can automatically control the action of the movable part of the electric holder, so that the orientation of the camera, the smoke sensor, the hazardous gas sensor and the life detector is adjusted, the detection range is enlarged, and the efficient automatic control of the rescue robot is realized.

title_en: Emergency rescue equipment for linkage of large-load unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency rescue equipment of big load unmanned aerial vehicle linkage, unmanned aerial vehicle all connect the horn all around, and the motor is installed to the end of horn, installs the screw on the motor, and the frame that falls is all installed to unmanned aerial vehicle's bottom both sides, and the bottom mid-mounting of frame has the connection box, accomodates quick aerate lifeboat in the box. A reinforcing rope is arranged in the connecting box, one end of the reinforcing rope is connected to the bottom of the battery bin, a hook is arranged at the other end of the reinforcing rope, and the hook is hung on a hanging device at one end of the fast inflatable lifeboat. The rescue equipment of the utility model realizes the effective combination of two links of search and rescue, saves a large amount of time and improves the success rate of rescue; at individual waters environment, scenes such as road bridge waters construction or floods, the manpower rescue degree of difficulty is big and take place the secondary danger easily, use the utility model discloses relevant this problem can be solved to equipment, reduces the input of manpower and equipment etc. simultaneously.

title_en: Control system for flexible joint robot
title_ko: 유연관절 로봇의 제어시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a control system for a flexible joint robot control system according to the present invention, which comprises: a control input dimension conversion unit which receives a control input of the robot and converts an orthogonal coordinate system of the control input into a rotational coordinate system; a whole flexible joint robot dynamics unit receiving the control input and a disturbance and outputting a control output by multiplying at least one or more matrix equations to the control input to which the disturbance is reflected; and a disturbance observer which calculates an estimated disturbance and reflects the estimated disturbance to the control input. The disturbance observer includes a reciprocal reaction force elimination unit containing a matrix equation for eliminating reciprocal reaction force between joints of the robot, a low pass filter, and an estimated disturbance dimension conversion unit. According to the configuration, the control system for a flexible joint robot can perform various tasks without constraints in various fields such as disaster rescue robots, collaborative robots, and rehabilitation robots, since constraints on a robot's working radius disappear due to singularity removal, maximize driving efficiency near the singularity, provide enhanced efficiency in robot's task performance by utilizing the effects, and achieve high performance and stability unlike the conventional conservative controller by providing constant performance regardless of the robot's posture.
abstract_ko:
개시된 본 발명에 의한 유연관절 로봇 제어시스템은, 로봇의 제어입력이 입력되고, 제어입력의 직교 좌표계를 회전 좌표계로 변환하는 제어입력 차원변환부; 상기 제어입력 및 외란이 입력되고, 상기 외란이 반영된 상기 제어 입력에 적어도 하나 이상의 행렬식을 곱하여 제어 출력를 출력하는 전체 유연관절 로봇 동역학부; 및 상기 외란을 추정한 추정외란을 계산하여 상기 제어 입력에서 상기 추정외란을 반영하는 외란 관측기; 를 포함하고, 상기 외란 관측기는 상기 로봇의 관절들 사이의 상호 반력을 제거하기 위한 행렬식을 포함하는 상호 반력 제거부, 저역 통과 필터, 추정외란 차원변환부를 포함하는 유연관절 로봇의 제어시스템을 포함한다.   
이러한 구성에 의하면, 특이점 제거로 인하여 로봇의 작업 반경 제약이 사라지기 때문에 재난구조 로봇, 협업 로봇, 재활 로봇 등 다양한 분야에서 제약없이 다양한 작업을 수행할 수 있고, 특이점 근처에서 구동 효율을 극대화할 수 있고, 이러한 효과를 활용하여 로봇의 작업 수행에 있어 높은 효율을 가질 수 있으며, 로봇 자세에 상관없이 성능이 일정하기 때문에 종래 보수적인 제어기와는 달리 높은 성능과 안정성을 동시에 달성할 수 있다.

title_en: Multi-machine collaborative three-dimensional modeling system and method for field mountain forest environment search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-machine collaborative three-dimensional modeling system and method for field mountain forest environment search and rescue, wherein a ground station control module is used for communicating with an unmanned aerial vehicle, a preliminary generated rough flying track is sent to the unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle is controlled to fly and receive state information returned by the unmanned aerial vehicle, an aerial image real-time splicing module carries out real-time splicing based on images matched by features, a depth estimation module obtains a global depth map of a spliced image based on a depth estimation model of a monocular image of deep learning, a multi-machine collaborative path planning module obtains a region with higher height in the global scene as a key region, an inclined photographing track is generated on the heavy point region, and then an improved k clustering algorithm is utilized to divide all track points into categories with balanced task amount, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can pass through all track points of each category point set, and a three-dimensional reconstruction model of a region to be searched is built according to the images returned by the unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Intelligent safety inspection rescue robot for production workshop
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent safety inspection rescue robot for a production workshop, which comprises a movable vehicle body, wherein one end of the top of the movable vehicle body is provided with an adjusting rod, the two ends of the top of the adjusting rod are respectively provided with a shooting component, the top of the adjusting rod is provided with a fire-fighting component, the middle part of the movable vehicle body is provided with a sound box, the two sides of the movable vehicle body are respectively provided with a protection component, the bottom of the movable vehicle body is uniformly provided with a plurality of movable wheels, and one end, far away from the adjusting rod, of the movable vehicle body is movably connected with a switch door. According to the intelligent safety inspection rescue robot for the production workshop, the movable vehicle body is arranged, so that the inspection efficiency of the production workshop is improved by the aid of the shooting assembly in inspection of the production workshop, when a small fire disaster occurs in the production workshop, the fire is conveniently extinguished by the aid of the fire fighting assembly, the spread of the fire condition is reduced, and people are timely evacuated by sending an alarm through sound equipment, so that damage caused by the fire disaster is reduced.

title_en: Throwing type fire rescue robot and using method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a throwing type fire-fighting rescue robot and a using method thereof, and relates to the technical field of rescue robots. This throw formula fire rescue robot, including robot main part, two foreign steamer and remote control mechanism, the fixed goods and materials storage mechanism that is provided with of lower terminal surface center department of robot main part, robot main part both ends are all fixed to be provided with interior wheel, two the wheel of interior wheel all is equidistant form on one's body and has seted up a plurality of constant head tanks, two the vibration damping slot has all been seted up to one side that the foreign steamer is relative, two all be equidistant form on the vibration damping slot inner wall and seted up a plurality of constant head tanks No. two, two the interior wheel is equallyd divide and does not be located the vibration damping slot. The invention provides a throwing type fire-fighting rescue robot and a using method thereof.

title_en: Rescue robot based on wearable exoskeleton
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue robot based on a wearable exoskeleton, which comprises a robot main body and a connecting mechanism arranged on the robot main body; the connecting mechanism comprises a connecting base and a clamping adjusting component; the centre gripping adjusting part includes: the clamping device comprises a fixed clamping block, a movable clamping block, a connecting rod, a cam locking piece and an internal thread knob; the fixed clamping block is fixed on the connecting base; one end of the connecting rod is a sliding sleeving end, and the other end of the connecting rod is an external thread end; the external thread end of the connecting rod movably penetrates through the fixed clamping block and then is screwed with the internal thread knob; the sliding sleeve connecting end of the connecting rod is movably connected with the cam locking piece after movably penetrating through the movable clamping block; the connecting base is also provided with a sliding limiting groove, and the sliding sleeve connecting end of the connecting rod is accommodated in the sliding limiting groove in a sliding mode. The rescue equipment can be quickly installed on or taken down from the rescue robot by arranging the connecting mechanism which is convenient to disassemble and assemble; meanwhile, the device can also adapt to rescue equipment with different specifications and models.
assignees: SHENZHEN SEVA LIGHTING CO LTD;HUIZHOU CHUANGJIAN IND CO LTD;SHENZHEN SHANGWEI PHOTOELECTRIC ENG CO LTD

title_en: Bionic hexapod robot for mining search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a colliery search and rescue technical field discloses a mining search and rescue bionical six sufficient robot, including main part truck 1, leg sufficient mechanism 2, six joint of 1 bilateral symmetry arrangement of main part truck, a leg sufficient structure can be connected to every joint department, installs the sensor of gathering surrounding environment information on the main part truck 1, and leg sufficient mechanism 2 is according to the sufficient biological characteristic design of spider leg, and the bionical proportion design of four segments is 1.5, refers to the sufficient biological characteristic of spider leg, and the inclination design between tilting bracket and the steering wheel is 135, and this structure is nimble stable, can be suitable for the narrow and small space of colliery environment; the laser radar, the ultrasonic sensor and the binocular vision camera are matched, so that the intelligence of the robot is greatly improved, and the robot is suitable for information detection underground operation in narrow space and complex road conditions of a coal mine.
assignees: CCTEG ROBOT TECH CO LTD;CCTEG SHENYANG RES INST

title_en: Fire scene low-quality image recovery method for rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire scene low-quality image recovery method for a rescue robot. According to the method, the flame region is segmented based on the region threshold segmentation algorithm, so that the influence of a flame light source on the global atmospheric light estimation is avoided; an atmospheric light detection operator is designed, accurate atmospheric light parameters are obtained based on the super-pixel block, and the problem of global atmospheric light estimation distortion is solved; a transmissivity estimation optimization module is constructed, the transmissivity is refined based on a bilateral weighting guide filtering method, and the problems of halation and the like caused by the traditional method are solved. The method provided by the invention is beneficial to improving the clarity of the fire scene image recovery, and provides a data basis for improving the scene detection, identification, environment mapping and path planning of the rescue robot.

title_en: Mine is permeated water and is searched for aquatic speaker of usefulness of helping
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater loudspeaker for mine water-permeable searching and rescue, relates to the technical field of mine water-permeable accident emergency rescue equipment, and solves the problem that the existing underwater loudspeaker cannot be directly used due to the fact that the existing underwater loudspeaker is low in pressure resistance and structural pressure resistance strength, and the technical scheme is characterized by comprising the following steps: the cabin body is provided with a sliding channel, and the sliding channel is provided with an open end and a closed end; the sound output mechanism is hermetically and slidably connected with the sliding channel and is provided with a sound source output surface; the sealing part is arranged at the end part of the sound output mechanism facing the open end, is provided with a sealing interval with the sound source output surface, and can be in sealed sliding connection with the sliding channel; the invention can provide changeable sealing state for the sound output mechanism so as to be convenient for adapting to different use environments at any time, is particularly carried on an underwater search and rescue robot, and is suitable for mine permeable search and rescue scenes.
assignees: GUANGDONG INTELLIGENT UNMANNED SYSTEM RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Air-based Internet of things rescue platform and emergency search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air-based Internet of things rescue platform, which comprises a patrol unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the patrol unmanned aerial vehicle is used for patrolling a search and rescue area; the broadcasting unit is mounted on the patrol unmanned aerial vehicle and used for periodically sending broadcasting information to a sensing terminal of a search and rescue area, the sensing terminal is worn on the body of ground personnel and used for acquiring life information of the ground personnel, and the life information comprises life characteristic information and position information of the ground personnel; the receiving unit is used for receiving the life information sent by the sensing terminal; and the sending unit is used for analyzing the life information and sending the life information to the ground control center. The emergency search and rescue system actively acquires the life information of the sensing terminal through the temporary regional wireless network constructed by the patrol unmanned aerial vehicle, sends the life information to the ground control center, acquires the data of the abnormal target by sending out the nuclear detection unmanned aerial vehicle, and appoints a rescue scheme by the ground control center, so that the rescue time is greatly saved, and the survival rate of ground personnel is improved.
assignees: SHAANXI ZHIYING ELECTRONIC SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wheel-leg type walking mechanism of rescue robot after earthquake
abstract_en: A wheel-leg type walking mechanism of a rescue robot after earthquake is provided with a bottom plate, two front limbs and two rear limbs. Each front limb is provided with a first shock absorber, a first rubber foot pad, a first foot base, a plurality of first shock absorbers, a first M3508 direct-current brushless speed reduction motor, three first GM6020 direct-current brushless motors, a first motor mounting base, a third GM6020 direct-current brushless motor, a first upper limb, a first middle limb, a first lower limb, a first Mecanum wheel and a first flange plate. Each rear limb is provided with a second shock absorber, a second rubber foot pad, a second foot seat, a plurality of second shock absorbers, a second M3508 direct-current brushless speed-reducing motor, three second GM6020 direct-current brushless motors, a second motor mounting seat, a fourth GM6020 direct-current brushless motor, a second upper limb, a second middle limb, a second lower limb, a second Mecanum wheel and a second flange plate. The invention can automatically complete the switching between the wheel type and leg type movement modes to adapt to the complex terrain after the earthquake occurs, and has reliable work and high work efficiency.

title_en: Robot walking structure and search and rescue robot comprising same
abstract_en: The application discloses a robot walking structure and a search and rescue robot comprising the same, and relates to the technical field of robot walking structures, wherein the robot walking structure comprises a robot body, a main motor, a rotating rod, a primary motor, a primary arc plate, a secondary motor and a secondary arc plate; the main motors are arranged on two sides of the robot body; the two main motor rotating shafts are arranged coaxially; the rotating rods are multiple and are fixedly arranged on the side wall of the rotating shaft of the main motor; the first-stage arc plate is rotatably connected to one end of the rotating rod, which is far away from the main motor; the first-stage motor is arranged on the rotating rod and drives the first-stage arc plate to rotate; the second-stage arc plate is rotatably connected to one end of the first-stage arc plate; the secondary motor is arranged on the primary arc plate to drive the secondary arc plate to rotate; the rotation axes of the first-stage arc plate and the second-stage arc plate are arranged in parallel; the first-stage arc plate and the second-stage arc plate which are positioned on one side of the robot body can form an annular structure. The application provides a novel walking structure to make search and rescue robot can satisfy the miniaturization and have the effect of good obstacle avoidance ability.

title_en: Portable emergency rescue underwater detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lightweight emergency rescue underwater detector, receive subassembly and underwater detector subassembly including the formation of image, the underwater detector subassembly includes the fuselage, the left end of fuselage is connected with transparent head shell, the right-hand member of fuselage is connected with the afterbody shell, the surface of afterbody shell is connected with a plurality of fin, this underwater rescue detector comprises formation of image receiving assembly and underwater detector subassembly, the underwater detector subassembly passes through the camera and shoots the picture under water, cooperation sonar detection ware carries out sonar detection under water, and then can effectively search for the target under water, formation of image receiving assembly is used for the picture of shooting the camera and the sonar detection result of sonar detection ware form images, effectively with formation of image, acoustics, optical system integration, formation of image result accessible is wireless, wired network passes to required monitoring point, has the multiple spot monitoring function, when satisfying emergent search and rescue demand, the flexibility and the ageing of search and rescue task have been improved.
assignees: T SEA MARINE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Obstacle avoidance unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model provides a search and rescue is with keeping away barrier unmanned aerial vehicle, including organism, wing and screw, the wing loop type is arranged in the bottom of organism and inclines certain angle and extends towards the outside of organism bottom, the inclination of wing is adjusted through the swing joint spare that the articulated was equipped with between wing and the organism, the wing bottom is equipped with the launching tube, the launching tube can select to launch a plurality of coordinate modules, the organism embeds has the travelling data recorder that can fix a position the coordinate module position and receives the signal receiver that the coordinate module sent; the screw set up in the top of wing outer end, the outer end of wing is equipped with light source detector, the bottom of organism is equipped with infrared scanner and the vision sensor that are used for searching for and rescuing the detection and is used for keeping away the range sensor of barrier. The utility model discloses the improvement unmanned aerial vehicle keep away barrier efficiency and search and rescue efficiency.
assignees: SUZHOU LINGYI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Four-footed bionic robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quadruped bionic robot, which comprises a body and four groups of bionic leg structures, wherein each bionic leg structure is driven by three direct-current brushless motors and a belt, each axial angle of the three direct-current brushless motors is calculated by inverse kinematics, the motors are controlled, and actions such as advancing, creeping and the like are finished. The difference between the first DC brushless motor and the second DC brushless motor is 90 degrees, and the third DC brushless motor is parallel to the second DC brushless motor and drives the support shank by using a belt and a belt pulley, so that the rotational inertia of the support shank end is reduced. The small fuselage and leg structure can be explored in rugged terrains such as stone, mud, grass and other complex terrains. The four-footed bionic robot can be remotely controlled, is additionally provided with various sensors according to exploration requirements, is matched with WIFI (wireless fidelity) and is transmitted back to a user end, and replaces human beings to enter a high-risk environment for reconnaissance and search and rescue, so that casualties are reduced.
assignees: JIANGSU VOCATIONAL COLLEGE OF INF TECH

title_en: Novel HUD thermal imaging system voice air breathing mask
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel HUD thermal imager voice air breathing mask, and relates to the field of rescue equipment. A novel HUD thermal imager voice air breathing mask comprises a mask shell, an oxygen tank communicated with the mask shell, a pressure transmitter module and a voice module, wherein the pressure transmitter module is used for detecting pressure data in the oxygen tank, and the mask shell is provided with a display module, a thermal imager module, a single chip microcomputer module and a battery module; the thermal imager module is used for displaying images of the thermal imager; the singlechip module is used for respectively driving the display module, the battery module and the imager module; the thermal imager module and the pressure transmitter are respectively in communication connection with the single-chip microcomputer module, so that the single-chip microcomputer module can display thermal imager images and pressure data through the display module; the voice module is in communication connection with the single chip microcomputer so as to adjust the display mode of the thermal imager module; the overall size of the rescue equipment can be reduced, and the search and rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Mine is with multi-functional search and rescue robot with wheel track auto-change over device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mine is with multi-functional search and rescue robot with wheel-track auto-change over device relates to the robotechnology field, including the frame, the left and right sides of frame all is equipped with the recess, installs the wheel-track switching mechanism in the recess, and the wheel-track switching mechanism includes the turning block that the cross-section is the rectangle, and the turning block rotates with the inner wall of recess front and back side through two first pivots to be connected, and one of them first pivot runs through the lateral wall of the recess of its connection side, and is connected with actuating mechanism; the wheel subassembly is installed to the downside of turning block, installs on the adjacent lateral wall of wheel subassembly one side the wheel subassembly is installed to the turning block and installs the track subassembly. The rotating block in the groove can be driven to rotate through the driving mechanism, so that the switching effect of the crawler assembly and the wheel assembly on the rotating block is achieved, and therefore in actual use, the robot in the application can switch the wheels and the crawler according to the use environment at any time, and the robot can walk fast on simple terrains and can cross obstacles on complex terrains to run.

title_en: Thermal imaging unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to search and rescue equipment field especially is a thermal imaging unmanned aerial vehicle for search and rescue, include: the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body and a hanging rack, wherein two electric push rods which are horizontally arranged are symmetrically fixed on the bottom surface of the hanging rack, the stretching directions of the two electric push rods are opposite, the stretching ends of the two electric push rods face outwards, and mounting racks are fixed on the stretching ends of the two electric push rods; when the unmanned aerial vehicle main part search of cruising, two electric putter extend to the outside, make the thermal imaging appearance of cloud bench stretch out the influence range of unmanned aerial vehicle main part air current, prevent that unmanned aerial vehicle's heat dissipation air current from causing the influence to the thermal imaging appearance, guarantee thermal imaging's video quality, and simultaneously, the inside packing of counter weight mechanism of opposite side has the counterweight of corresponding weight, and outwards stretch out the same distance in step, carry out weight balance to cloud platform and thermal imaging appearance, make the unmanned aerial vehicle main part steadily cruise, guarantee that thermal imaging appearance's video acquisition is stable.
assignees: SICHUAN YUYUN INNOVATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Underwater rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater robots, and discloses an underwater rescue robot, which comprises a main frame body, wherein a support frame is fixedly assembled on the side surface of the main frame body, a main probe is fixedly assembled on the side surface of the main frame body, a hanging buckle is fixedly assembled on the top of the main frame body, an auxiliary probe is fixedly assembled on the bottom of the main frame body, a first fan is fixedly assembled on the bottom of the inner wall of the support frame, and a second fan is fixedly assembled on the inner wall of the top of the main frame body. This rescue robot under water, external equipment controls the kelly through the body frame body and uses with the cooperation of first pole of grabbing, and first pole of grabbing is grabbed with the second and is grabbed the pole and remove and be close to, to the rescuer centre gripping, and at this moment, the second electro-magnet adsorbs with the third electro-magnet to stabilize the centre gripping to the rescuer, the air pump is aerifyd to come-up cover and external floating cover inner chamber through the admission cylinder this moment, thereby drive the device and move upward, traditional device compares, the device removes more fast, thereby rescue speed has been improved.
assignees: QINGDAO AXR INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Walking type emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a walking emergency rescue robot relates to rescue technical field, and this walking emergency rescue robot includes that automobile body and setting are used for providing the survival capsule of dodging the space in automobile body upper end, the automobile body head is equipped with the camera that is used for the place ahead image and is used for surveying whether someone is the infrared human detection instrument in the place ahead, the automobile body is inside still be equipped with workpiece electric connection's control panel, the application is designed to the drawback of current rescue device, replaces traditional track and wheeled through the mode that imitates arthropod crawl, has improved the emergent ability of rescue under complex environment, can also utilize unmanned aerial vehicle to acquire high altitude image, is convenient for master rescue site information fast, provides the survival capsule, can hide people or thing, has improved rescue efficiency.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device belongs to low latitude unmanned aerial vehicle field, it includes the unmanned aerial vehicle main part and with a plurality of support arms of unmanned aerial vehicle main part fixed connection, the one end that the unmanned aerial vehicle main part was kept away from to the support arm is connected with the spiral piece and is used for driving screw pivoted motor, be equipped with the draw-in groove on the support arm, be equipped with in the draw-in groove and store box and first inductor with support arm fixed connection's smog, the smog is stored the box and is connected with first inductor, first inductor is used for induction motor's the state of opening and close. This application has the effect that makes things convenient for the staff to retrieve unmanned aerial vehicle when unable receipt GPS positioning signal.
assignees: SHAANXI HUADI PROSPECTING AND DESIGN CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Autonomous flight control method for UAVs using Swarm Intelligence
title_ko: 군집지능을 이용한 복수 무인기의 자율 비행 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for controlling the autonomous flight of a plurality of unmanned aircrafts using swarm intelligence and, more specifically, to a method for controlling the autonomous flight of a plurality of unmanned aircrafts using swarm intelligence, capable of enabling autonomous flight without central control on individual unmanned aircrafts or a separate leading unmanned aircraft by receiving position and speed information, mission information, control constants and the like of other unmanned aircrafts to enable control in directions for moving the unmanned aircrafts closer to and away from each other, which are gravitational and repulsive forces of the unmanned aircrafts during swarm flight, thereby more efficiently performing a mission such as a survivor search in a disaster situation, which is environmentally dangerous, such as an earthquake, a fire or the like. The method includes a data input step, an acceleration calculation step, a route point guide step and a route point command step.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 군집지능을 이용한 복수 무인기의 자율 비행 제어방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 다른 무인 비행체의 위치 및 속도 정보와 임무정보 및 제어상수 등을 입력받아 군집 비행 중인 무인 비행체들의 인력과 척력 즉, 무인 비행체들 사이의 거리를 좁히는 방향과 멀어지는 방향으로의 제어가 가능하도록 하여 개별 무인기들에 대한 중앙의 통제 또는 별도의 선도 무인기 없이도 자율적 비행이 가능하도록 함으로써 지진, 화재 등의 환경적으로 위험이 큰 재난 상황에서의 생존자 탐색 등의 임무를 보다 효율적으로 수행할 수 있도록 하는 군집지능을 이용한 복수 무인기의 자율 비행 제어방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Full-automatic fire-extinguishing rescue robot equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a full-automatic fire-fighting rescue robot equipment, including the base station, the motor is installed at the upper surface position placed in the middle of the base station, the action wheel is installed to the drive end of motor, install the tail frame on the outer wall of action wheel, the other end of tail frame is installed from the driving wheel. This full-automatic fire-fighting rescue robot equipment, the control motor body rotates, it is rotatory to drive the lead screw, and threaded connection's lead screw cover will be displacement from top to bottom on the lead screw outer wall, because of the interior wall sliding connection of lead screw cover outer wall connection's welding rod and chamber box, thereby it is spacing to the lead screw cover, after the ascending displacement of lead screw cover, the welding rod and the push rod of connection also will make progress the displacement, thereby the bottom plate of connection on push rod top will jack-up base station upwards, thereby the realization is to the regulation and control of spraying the height.
assignees: SHENZHEN JIUHANG FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional flexible robot applied to ruins search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional flexible robot applied to searching and rescuing in ruins, wherein one end of a spine mechanism is provided with a front scapular frame, and the other end of the spine mechanism is provided with a rear scapular frame; two ends of the front scapular frame are respectively provided with a first walking mechanism, and two ends of the rear scapular frame are respectively provided with a second walking mechanism; one part of the first driving mechanism is arranged on the front scapular frame and is connected with the first travelling mechanism, the other part of the first driving mechanism is arranged on the rear scapular frame and is connected with the second travelling mechanism, and the heights of the first travelling mechanism and the second travelling mechanism can be adjusted; and a second driving mechanism is arranged on the rear scapula frame and can bend the spinal mechanism. The device has compact structure and high transmission efficiency, can finish multiple motion actions such as multi-angle flexible and stable steering, creeping forward, climbing up a slope, obstacle crossing and the like, can shuttle in the ruins, finish the work of search and rescue, material transportation and the like, and cannot cause the damage to search and rescue and trapped personnel due to secondary collapse of the ruins.

title_en: Intelligent maritime patrol search and rescue system and method based on large unmanned helicopter platform
abstract_en: The application discloses system and method for searching and rescuing is patrolled at intelligence sea based on large-scale unmanned helicopter platform, and the system includes: an unmanned aerial vehicle platform and a ground control platform; the unmanned aerial vehicle platform is used for acquiring sea surface real-time information and transmitting the information to the ground console; and the ground console is used for receiving the information and sending out a control command based on the information. The method comprises the following steps: s1, collecting sea surface images and topographic information in real time by an unmanned aerial vehicle platform, and transmitting the images and the topographic information to a ground control platform; and S2, the ground control platform makes a rescue plan to implement rescue based on the image and the terrain information. The method combines the acquisition of real-time images and thermal imaging, so that the accuracy and the high efficiency of searching are ensured; meanwhile, the equipped radar equipment can acquire a three-dimensional topographic map of a search and rescue point, and provide topographic information for the ground control platform to make a rescue plan.
assignees: TIANJIN RESEARCH INST WATER TRANSP ENGINEERING MOT

title_en: Forest fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a forest fire rescue robot which comprises a flexible fire extinguishing mesh blanket for extinguishing fire and 2n crawler robots for driving the flexible fire extinguishing mesh blanket to move, wherein n is an integer and is not less than 2, and a connecting rope is connected between the flexible fire extinguishing mesh blanket and the crawler robots. The crawler-type robot can be used for remotely monitoring a fire scene, rapidly identifying a hidden fire area and monitoring the fire scene in real time. The flexible fire-extinguishing net blanket can effectively prevent the dead ash in the blind fire area from reburning, and has good fire-extinguishing effect. Through the forest fire rescue robot can give the one-by-one treatment with hidden dark fire region in the scene of a fire, and the treatment effeciency is high, makes things convenient for follow-up fire fighting team to impel forward to improve forest fire rescue effect.

title_en: Airborne sensing and positioning system based on air awakening technology and emergency rescue method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of aviation emergency rescue equipment, in particular to an airborne sensing and positioning system and an emergency rescue method based on an aerial awakening technology. The unmanned aerial vehicle positioning system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, an unmanned aerial vehicle flight controller, an airborne LoRa base station and a ground LoRa positioning beacon module, wherein the ground LoRa positioning beacon module periodically and actively sends a data packet to the air; the airborne LoRa base station receives a data packet of the LoRa positioning beacon at the ground end, calculates the basic coordinate position of the LoRa beacon and sends the basic coordinate position to a ground emergency rescue command center; unmanned aerial vehicle carries on the data packet that receives ground terminal loRa location beacon in the flight of machine-borne loRa basic station near ground. The invention provides an airborne sensing and positioning system and an emergency rescue method based on an aerial awakening technology, which do not need to transmit a high-power signal, and actively sense the signal transmitted by a positioning beacon module in near-ground flight through an unmanned aerial vehicle carrying a sensing base station, so that the positioning search and rescue of an unconnected target are quickly realized, and the problem that the signal is limited by the geographical environment is solved.

title_en: Rescue unmanned aerial vehicle with carry thing function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle for rescue with carry thing function relates to unmanned air vehicle technical field, including the unmanned aerial vehicle body, install laser radar, depth of field camera, casing on the unmanned aerial vehicle body, install control and communication module in the casing, control and communication module with the unmanned aerial vehicle body laser radar depth of field camera electric connection, the first cardboard of the equal fixedly connected with in both sides of casing. The utility model discloses a set up laser radar, the camera of depth of field realizes the flight of independently keeping away the barrier of unmanned aerial vehicle in the close forest, pass through crown layer and obtain the signal and cover the back, fly to the target area and send locating information and distress signal to ground personnel, ground personnel accept the rescue goods and materials of packing into in the casing behind the unmanned aerial vehicle, and operate unmanned aerial vehicle and carry rescue goods and materials and independently return to the journey after the flight route in acquisition control and the communication module, and organize the rescue group to implement the rescue, the search and rescue work load has effectively been reduced, and the efficiency of rescue is improved.

title_en: Bionic crab robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of machinery, in particular to a bionic crab robot. The bionic crab robot is developed based on analysis of crab motion characteristics and by applying a bionics principle, the robot does not need algorithm control and deep learning to keep the robot stable in motion, is simple in structure and low in cost, always has four legs in contact with the ground during motion, ensures the motion stability at the same time of low cost, and can realize the functions of carrying, obstacle avoidance and search and rescue and detection in a complex environment.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle sea rescue method and device, unmanned aerial vehicle and ship
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle sea rescue method, an unmanned aerial vehicle sea rescue device, an unmanned aerial vehicle and a ship, and the method comprises the following steps: s1, obtaining a rescue task and planning a rescue route; s2, identifying a rescue path in real time and adjusting the rescue path according to environmental conditions; s3, identifying a rescue target and changing a rescue material putting method according to target conditions; the path planning can be carried out in a self-adaptive manner through the rescue task, the rescue efficiency can be improved by optimizing the rescue path, the rescue path is adjusted in real time by monitoring the influence factors in the rescue process, the rescue path is further optimized, useless search and rescue are reduced, and the rescue efficiency is further improved; the method has the advantages that the releasing mode of the rescue goods and materials is adjusted by recognizing the environment of the rescue target, the releasing accuracy is guaranteed, releasing conditions can be changed in a self-adaptive mode when the goods and materials are released according to the wind speed and the wind direction of the rescue target, and therefore the accuracy and the efficiency of the goods and materials releasing are improved.

title_en: Maritime emergency burst search and rescue method based on sea-air platform cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a maritime emergency burst search and rescue method based on sea-air platform cooperation, which comprises the following steps: acquiring distress ship position data; acquiring dynamic environment information of the region based on the position data of the distress ship; acquiring an image of a ship in distress, and acquiring a basic condition of the ship in distress based on the image of the ship in distress; and formulating a search and rescue scheme based on the position data of the ship in distress, the basic condition of the ship in distress and dynamic environment information, and searching and rescuing according to the search and rescue scheme. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle is adopted to obtain the image, so that the condition of the ship in distress can be accurately judged; determining the search and rescue priority through analyzing the basic situation; by adopting the outward diffusion of the segments and adopting different searching modes and different searching densities for different segments, the economy is ensured under the condition of ensuring the comprehensive and rapid search and rescue.
assignees: TIANJIN RESEARCH INST WATER TRANSP ENGINEERING MOT

title_en: Wearable life-saving equipment with positioning and heating functions and solar cell
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of water rescue protective equipment, and provides wearable life-saving equipment with positioning and heating functions and a solar cell. According to the invention, the positions of the personnel can be sent through the satellite positioner, so that search and rescue personnel can be conveniently positioned and locked through the satellite, one side can be heated by utilizing the thermocouple heater, and the other side can be heated, so that obvious cold and hot temperature difference contrast can be formed, and the search and rescue personnel can quickly lock the personnel falling into the water through the thermal imaging camera, thereby improving the search and rescue efficiency.
assignees: NANJING JIAJINTONG ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Channel accident handling and delivering method based on unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a channel accident handling and delivering method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography technology, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: the UAV management system receives the channel accident signal, selects a proper UAV, generates flight mission data and uploads the flight mission data to the UAV, the UAV takes off and arrives above the channel accident ship area, the UAV transmits aerial pictures/videos to the ground mobile terminal in real time, and police and insurance companies take pictures of the channel accident ship through the ground mobile terminal to obtain evidence and upload the pictures to police bureaus, insurance companies and the like; meanwhile, search and rescue personnel and qualified personnel can carry out work through the ground mobile terminal, and the ground mobile terminal can also access databases such as a public security bureau, an insurance company and the like. By the method and the system, accident evidence collection, insurance compensation evidence collection, search and rescue, improvement and other work can be simultaneously and concurrently carried out, and a plurality of departments simultaneously and concurrently carry out work, so that the efficiency of channel accident treatment is greatly improved.
assignees: NANJING MAGICSKY AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional barrier-breaking rescue robot for mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional mine barrier-breaking rescue robot which comprises a rescue vehicle, wherein a barrier cleaning device is arranged at the front end of the rescue vehicle, an anti-collapse auxiliary device positioned above the barrier cleaning device is arranged at the front end of the rescue vehicle, a plurality of anti-collapse supporting steel beams are driven by a three-dimensional driving mechanism to move to the front of a barrier below a collapse position, then the anti-collapse supporting steel beams are controlled to be inserted into the barrier in front, so that the collapse position is supported by the anti-collapse supporting steel beams, and then the barrier cleaning device starts to clean the barrier, so that the possibility of secondary collapse caused by the barrier cleaning device cleaning the barrier is greatly reduced, the barrier-breaking rescue efficiency is favorably improved, and the safety of rescuers, trapped persons and rescue equipment is guaranteed.
assignees: ANHUI TECHNICAL COLLEGE MECHANICAL & ELECTRICAL ENG

title_en: Small search and rescue robot for jacking tool
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots, and discloses a small search and rescue robot used on a jacking tool, which comprises a main body, wherein four groups of transmission devices are symmetrically arranged at four corners of the side surface of the main body, a rotating device comprises a transportation block, a crawler is sleeved on the side surface of the transportation block, a mounting groove is formed in the transportation block corresponding to the crawler, a first motor is fixedly arranged in the mounting groove, gears are fixedly arranged on two sides of the first motor, the gears are constrained out of the mounting groove and are in a meshing relationship with the crawler, a first movable groove is formed in the side surface of the transportation block close to the main body, and a first movable block is movably arranged in the first movable groove. According to the robot, the controller controls the rotating motor to rotate the fixing plate to adjust the angle of the cutting plate, the cutting plate cuts the obstacle, the cutting device is finally retracted into the storage tank, and the camera is used for observing in real time, so that the robot can process the obstacle, and the robot can conveniently perform search and rescue tasks.

title_en: Geological disaster is with supplementary rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an auxiliary rescue robot for geological disasters, which comprises a movement mechanism, wherein a first material box, a second material box, a mechanical arm and a monitoring mechanism are arranged on the movement mechanism; the first goods and materials case is used for placing solid goods and materials, the second goods and materials case is used for placing the fluid material, monitoring mechanism is used for monitoring the environment position. This geological disasters are with supplementary rescue robot not only can search for and wait to rescue the personnel, can carry out goods and materials rescue to it moreover, promotes the success rate of rescue greatly.

title_en: Ocean rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and particularly relates to a marine rescue unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle frame, wherein a plurality of satellite unmanned aerial vehicles and air pumps which are positioned in the unmanned aerial vehicle frame and arranged at the bottoms of the satellite unmanned aerial vehicles are arranged in the unmanned aerial vehicle frame, symmetrical foot rests are respectively arranged on two sides of the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle frame, connecting rods are fixed between the foot rests and the unmanned aerial vehicle frame, the interiors of the foot rests and the interior of the unmanned aerial vehicle frame are in through connection through the interiors of the connecting rods, each foot rest comprises a supporting rod, hinge sleeves hinged on two sides of the supporting rod and air bags arranged in the hinge sleeves on two sides, two sides of the top of each air bag are tightly attached to two sides of the bottom of the supporting rod, and the air bags are communicated with the interiors of the supporting rods through openings in the tops. According to the invention, the endurance of the maritime unmanned aerial vehicle in the search and rescue process can be improved, the space range of the search and rescue can be enlarged, the search and rescue efficiency can be improved, and the search and rescue time can be shortened.

title_en: Empty face guard of exhaling of HUD pronunciation thermal imaging system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a face guard is exhaled to HUD pronunciation thermal imaging system sky relates to the empty face guard field of exhaling. The method comprises the following steps: the device comprises a cover body and a pressure transmitter arranged on an oxygen tank, wherein the cover body is provided with a respirator, the cover body is provided with an optical waveguide display assembly, a thermal imager assembly is arranged on the side of the cover body, the optical waveguide display assembly is electrically connected with the thermal imager assembly, and the pressure transmitter is wirelessly connected with the thermal imager assembly; it can superpose the image of the pressure data of the oxygen jar of being connected with the respirator and thermal imaging system and fuse, direct imaging display thermal imaging system image and pressure numerical value in the empty face guard of exhaling of HUD pronunciation thermal imaging system, when liberation rescue personnel's both hands, can more audio-visual grasp surrounding environment and oxygen jar state data, make things convenient for rescue personnel's search and rescue action and save oneself more.

title_en: Forest and forest fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a forest mountain fire rescue robot, including travelling car, movable mounting be in arm on the travelling car, U type clamping jaw is installed to the tip of arm, U type clamping jaw is including connecting arm tip's connecting plate and just being connected the splint at connecting plate both ends, install the high-pressure squirt on the U type clamping jaw, two that the U type groove position of U type clamping jaw corresponds install disconnected wooden mechanism between the splint, disconnected wooden mechanism includes that the symmetry is installed at two inside running rollers of U type clamping jaw and symmetry and is installed and is being corresponded the leading wheel of splint anterior segment, an annular band saw strip suit are on running roller and leading wheel, one of them the running roller is rotatory by motor drive, two it is used for establishhing the fire-isolating harrow in fire-isolating area still to articulate between the splint to install driven mechanism drive, the utility model discloses the device can improve the efficiency of construction fire-isolating area.

title_en: All-terrain self-adaptive omni-directional passive rocker arm obstacle-surmounting search and rescue robot and search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an all-terrain self-adaptive omnidirectional passive rocker arm obstacle-crossing search and rescue robot and a search and rescue method, wherein the robot comprises a robot body, a frame (5) and a control center arranged at the front end of the robot body; locate climbing mechanism of robot body front end, with climbing mechanism is connected obstacle crossing mechanism, and with climbing mechanism matches preceding balance mechanism of setting, with obstacle crossing mechanism matches the back balance mechanism of setting, preceding balance mechanism includes first dynamic balance mechanism (7), back balance mechanism includes second dynamic balance mechanism (13) and third dynamic balance mechanism (14). According to the invention, the self-adaptive adjustment of the angle between the climbing mechanism and the obstacle is realized, the obstacle crossing mechanism realizes multi-stage energy storage driving to increase the friction between the climbing mechanism and the obstacle, and the self-adaptive dynamic balance of the vertical obstacle, the ditch obstacle and the concave-convex crossing section obstacle is realized through the front balancing mechanism and the rear balancing mechanism.

title_en: Marine searching system using drone and the method thereof
title_ko: 드론을 이용한 해양 구난대상 수색 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a marine rescue target searching system using a drone and a method thereof. A server collects weather information, marine information, sea surface image information photographed by the drone and GPS information matched with the corresponding sea surface image information, learning in a neural network manner is performed with the same as input values to generate sea surface pattern information for each weather situation, for each marine situation and for each position, the sea surface image information photographed by the drone is transmitted in real time and is compared with the sea surface image pattern to detect a rescue target, and the real-time positional information of the rescue target is generated by calculating the current position of the rescue target based on the weather information, the marine information and GPS information at the point of time when the rescue target was photographed by the drone. Therefore, time for searching for a rescue target can be minimized and the protection of lives and property can be maximized.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 드론을 이용한 해양 구난대상 수색 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 서버에서 기상 정보와, 해양 정보와, 드론에서 촬영되는 해수면 영상 정보와 해당 해수면 영상 정보와 매칭되는 GPS 정보를 수집하고 이를 입력값으로 하여 뉴럴 네트워크(Neural-Newtork) 방식의 학습을 진행하여 기상 상황별, 해양 상황별 및 위치별 해수면 영상 패턴 정보를 생성하며, 드론에서 촬영되는 해수면 영상 정보를 실시간으로 전송받고, 상기 해수면 영상 패턴 정보와 비교하여, 구난대상 감지하고, 상기 기상 정보, 해양 정보 및 드론에서 구난대상이 촬영된 시점의 GPS 정보를 기반으로 구난대상의 현재 위치를 계산하여 실시간 구난대상 위치정보를 생성하는 드론을 이용한 해양 구난대상 수색 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Vertical take-off and landing unmanned aerial vehicle for missing persons search and delivery of emergency medical supplies
title_ko: 실종자 수색 및 긴급의료품 배송용 수직이착륙 무인기
abstract_en: A vertical take-off and landing drone for searching for a missing person and delivering emergency medical supplies according to the present invention includes technologies for controlling drones based on real-time video transmission of EO/IR (Visual Image, Thermal Image) through a control center while excluding drone experts at a site where an incident or situation occurred, checking a status of a missing person found in a search process with a real-time video, and dropping first-aid medicine when necessary, and has a non-face-to-face service at the same time, thereby capable of minimizing casualties and searching for missing persons.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 실종자 수색 및 긴급의료품 배송용 수직이착륙 무인기는 EO/IR(실화상, 열화상)의 실시간 영상전송을 기반으로 사건 또는 상황이 발생한 현장에 드론 전문가를 배제한 상태에서 관제센터를 통해 드론을 제어하고, 수색 과정에서 발견된 실종자의 상태를 실시간 영상으로 상태를 확인하고 필요시에 구급약품 투하를 하는 기술을 갖는 것으로서, 비대면 서비스를 동시에 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Outdoor emergency rescue system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an outdoor emergency rescue system, which belongs to the field of search and rescue and comprises an intelligent wristwatch, a three-prevention handheld terminal, an unmanned aerial vehicle and a search and rescue command background, wherein the intelligent wristwatch is wirelessly connected with the unmanned aerial vehicle through a narrowband Internet of things, the unmanned aerial vehicle is wirelessly connected with the three-prevention handheld terminal through the narrowband Internet of things, and the unmanned aerial vehicle is connected with the search and rescue command background through an image transmission link. The invention is used for searching, rescuing and commanding rescue workers under various field emergency rescue conditions, adopts technologies and equipment such as intelligent wearing, beidou positioning, unmanned aerial vehicles and LORA-ONE narrow-band communication, and can realize the functions of monitoring vital signs of the search and rescue workers in real time, quickly positioning the missing rescue workers, expanding the search and rescue communication distance, automatically searching and rescuing by the unmanned aerial vehicles and the like. The search and rescue range can be expanded, the search and rescue efficiency can be accelerated, and casualties of rescue workers can be reduced to the maximum extent. The invention has stronger adaptability to search and rescue terrains and can be suitable for various terrains. The search and rescue range is wider, and the communication distance is farther.

title_en: Maritime unmanned intelligent search and rescue equipment and maritime search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention discloses maritime unmanned intelligent search and rescue equipment and a maritime search and rescue system, wherein the high-speed search and rescue unmanned boat has high navigation speed, quickly reaches an accident sea area, and releases a projection rescue device and a life raft to rescue centralized personnel falling into water through remote control; the double-body search and rescue unmanned boat is provided with a lifting frame and a small search and rescue unmanned boat, and carries out accurate rescue on single falling personnel and unconscious personnel; the captive unmanned aerial vehicle and the captive balloon both carry signal transfer stations to form a local area network of a rescue area, and send field data to a centralized control center, and meanwhile, the captive unmanned aerial vehicle and the captive balloon are provided with panoramic micro-optical cameras, so that people falling into water can be accurately identified; the centralized control center is used for receiving and analyzing various sensor data and issuing rescue instructions to the search and rescue unmanned boats according to the maximum rescue efficiency principle. The maritime search and rescue equipment can adapt to severe sea conditions, adopts multi-boat collaborative search, aerial water surface collaborative search and multiple rescue means collaborative rescue, can realize accurate and rapid rescue, improves rescue efficiency and reduces rescue labor cost.
assignees: TAIZHOU CITY JINHAIYUN VESSEL FACILITY CO LTD

title_en: Portable post-disaster rescue robot and rescue method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable post-disaster rescue robot and a rescue method thereof. The post-disaster rescue robot comprises a robot body, an inner winding drum power-assisted system and an outer winding drum module, wherein the robot body comprises a robot moving chassis and a wounded transferring system, and the moving chassis comprises a supporting frame, walking wheels and a motor; the wounded transferring system comprises a wounded bearing platform and a headrest module; the headrest module includes a headrest, a mechanical arm, and a towing connector. The inner reel power-assisted system and the outer reel module are both rope driving mechanisms. The robot body is dragged to reciprocate between a safety site and a rescue site in a disaster relief site by the aid of the outer reel module. Therefore, the rescue device can replace rescue workers to complete rescue tasks, strives for rescue time and improves rescue efficiency.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue positioner
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the unmanned aerial vehicle field especially is an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue positioner, include: the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle main body and supporting legs, wherein a winding motor is fixed on one side of the bottom surface of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a winding roller is fixed at the output end of the winding motor, a traction belt is wound on the winding roller, and a satellite positioner for positioning is fixed at the bottom end of the traction belt; after the discovery search target, will pull the area and emit, it is regional to be close to the target until satellite positioning ware and audible-visual annunciator, and simultaneously, audible-visual annunciator carries out audible-visual annunciator, the position of warning target, be convenient for ground search personnel quick travel to the target location, prevent trees, the grass or darker light causes the influence to search personnel, be fixed with a plurality of alternative arrangement's first reflection of light subsides and second reflection of light subsides on the traction belt of expansion, first reflection of light subsides and second reflection of light subsides reflection of light, the ground search personnel of being convenient for discern, in time discover the locate position.
assignees: SICHUAN YUYUN INNOVATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned ship combined cruise search and rescue system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a cruise search and rescue system and method combined with an unmanned ship, wherein the system comprises: the unmanned ship is provided with an unmanned aerial vehicle; the integrated navigation system is arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle and used for acquiring the position information of the unmanned aerial vehicle; the search control system is arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle and used for receiving the navigation information of the control terminal and sending the navigation information to the main control of the unmanned aerial vehicle; and the unmanned aerial vehicle main control controls the unmanned aerial vehicle to reach a preset cruise point to operate according to the position information of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the navigation information. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle is carried on the unmanned ship, so that the search and rescue advantages between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned ship can be combined, and the search and rescue efficiency is greatly improved.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;WUHAN ELECTRIC POWER TECHNICAL COLLEGE

title_en: Drone traking a target
title_ko: 목표물을 추적하는 드론
abstract_en: The present invention is to solve the above problems. More particularly, the present invention is intended to provide the coordinates of a search dog to a situation room while a drone chases the search dog, rather than a person chasing the search dog during a search operation using the search dog. According to a drone tracking a target of the present invention, a search dog is equipped with a radio, tracking equipment, a camera device, or the like, and the drone is equipped with a camera, a searchlight, a speaker, or the like, so that it is possible to enable the drone to follow the search dog, relay the situation at the search point, and make broadcasts directed to the search dog or target.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 위와 같은 문제를 해결하기 위한 것으로, 보다 자세하게는 수색견을 활용한 수색 작전시 사람이 수색견을 쫓는 것이 아니라 드론이 수색견을 쫓으면서 수색견의 좌표를 상황실 등에 제공할 수 있도록 하기 위한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 목표물을 추적하는 드론은 수색견에 무전기, 추적장비 및 카메라 장치 등을 탑재하고 드론에는 카메라, 서치라이트 및 스피커 등을 탑재하여, 드론이 수색견을 쫓아 수색 지점에서의 상황을 중계하고 수색견 또는 목표물을 향한 방송을 실시할 수 있도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Campus emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a campus emergency rescue robot, which comprises a base, a main body and a folding chair, and further comprises an obstacle avoidance module and a mobile module, wherein the main body is fixed on the upper end of the base, the base is provided with a containing groove for containing the folding chair, the sliding groove is connected with the folding chair in a sliding manner, the mobile module is arranged on two sides of the base, a medicine providing module is arranged in a cavity structure of the main body, a wireless communication module is arranged in the main body, and the wireless communication module is electrically connected with the obstacle avoidance module, an alarm button and a distress call module; the utility model collects the sound source needing help through the help calling module and the voice recognition function and makes a corresponding treatment scheme; common medical supplies can be provided in a targeted manner by providing the medicine module, so that the effect of auxiliary treatment is achieved; the remote alarm, emergency call or remote control assistance are realized through the alarm module; the intelligent movement can be realized through the obstacle avoidance module; the folding chair can assist in adjusting good treatment posture.

title_en: Outdoor search and rescue and use high strength unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides an outdoor search and rescue and use high strength unmanned aerial vehicle, including the organism, the top welding of organism lateral wall has the support arm that the equidistance is the annular structure and distributes, and the support arm keeps away from the other end welding of organism and has the arc piece, and the center department welding that support arm opposite side outer wall was kept away from to the arc piece has the lug, and the lug keeps away from the other end of arc piece and has seted up the rectangular channel, and the inside of rectangular channel is pegged graft and is had to support the post. The utility model discloses support the post sliding connection in the inside of rectangular channel under the effect of limiting plate and volute spring for the arc has had fine cushioning effect, and then has promoted unmanned aerial vehicle's intensity and impact resistance, make the flabellum obtain fine protection simultaneously, the buffer block sliding connection is in the inside of arc under the effect of locating plate and spring, make the buffer block have fine buffering cushioning effect, and then the stationarity when having promoted unmanned aerial vehicle descending, make unmanned aerial vehicle have fine anti ability of falling simultaneously.
