title_en: A rescue device for unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue device for unmanned aerial vehicle relates to unmanned aerial vehicle rescue device technical field, including unmanned aerial vehicle body, wire rope, control box I, grapple, control box II and grapple bracing piece, the lower terminal surface of unmanned aerial vehicle body is equipped with the grapple bracing piece, the lower terminal surface of grapple bracing piece is equipped with the control box II that is used for going up and down goods and materials, wire rope's lower extreme is connected to the control box I that is used for loading and unloading goods and materials, terminal surface is fixed with the grapple that is used for hoist and mount goods and materials under the control box I, the utility model discloses location flight and camera function based on unmanned many gyroplanes overcome the rescue environment complicacy, carry rescue goods and materials, when the unable descending in scene, unload the rope through remote control, make the inside rope of unloading of grapple stretch up straightly and lift up, realize rescue goods and materials unhook, put in for the personnel in disaster rescue goods and materials, improve one deck safety guarantee for them to realize quick rescue and high-efficient search and rescue.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle real-time online flight path planning method for measurement tasks of recoverable spacecraft
abstract_en: The invention relates to a recoverable spacecraft measurement task oriented unmanned aerial vehicle real-time online flight path planning method, which takes the flight performance and flight limiting area of an unmanned aerial vehicle as constraints, takes a real-time dynamic tracking spacecraft re-entry capsule as a core target, plans the flight path of the unmanned aerial vehicle tracking the re-entry capsule while fully considering the real-time performance of the flight path planning method, organically combines the maneuvering operation characteristics of the unmanned aerial vehicle and a detection load, and improves the tracking coverage rate of the re-entry capsule as much as possible. After the method is applied, the search and rescue information network constructed by the cooperative operation of the search and rescue information network and the conventional land-based measurement and control system for guaranteeing the tracking task of the spacecraft re-entry capsule is realized, and the problems that the measurement performance of a low elevation angle generated by the conventional search and rescue information network is poor and the measurement and control coverage capability of the landing section of the spacecraft re-entry capsule is insufficient when the conventional search and rescue information network is only dependent on the land-based measurement and control system are effectively solved. The search and rescue information network can provide continuous and visual image information for accurate research and judgment of landing search and rescue situations, and efficient completion of search and rescue recovery tasks is facilitated.

title_en: Separable search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a separable search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which belongs to the field of search and rescue equipment and comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle inner main body and an unmanned aerial vehicle outer main body, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle inner main body is fixedly connected with the unmanned aerial vehicle outer main body; the unmanned aerial vehicle can be used as a single integral unmanned aerial vehicle and can be used separately, a large unmanned aerial vehicle main body and a small aircraft are separated to search and rescue in a large range, trapped personnel are searched for, and the unmanned aerial vehicle also has the functions of photography illumination and information communication.

title_en: Unmanned plane cluster task cooperation method and system oriented to multi-source disaster situation data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster task cooperation method and system for multi-source disaster situation data fusion, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing spatial cluster analysis on the grid queues according to the spatial distribution of each target and generating a plurality of disaster-stricken zones; generating one or more task areas according to the area and the spatial distribution of each disaster-stricken area and the covering capacity of the high-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle; generating a plurality of operation areas in the task area according to the distance between the targets in the task area and the coverage capability of the hollow unmanned aerial vehicle; determining the low-altitude space unmanned aerial vehicles matched with each target in the operation area according to the area, the number and the spatial distribution of each target in the operation area and the number and the reserved electric quantity of each low-altitude space unmanned aerial vehicle; the high-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle is utilized to form a task area plan to provide communication guarantee, the hollow unmanned aerial vehicle is utilized to form an operation area plan to provide communication relay, and the low-altitude airspace unmanned aerial vehicle is utilized to conduct accurate search, so that the recognition and state analysis working efficiency of the buried life target are improved, and the search and rescue working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Intelligent search and rescue device based on wireless networking and positioning technology
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligence search and rescue device based on wireless network deployment and location technology, including unmanned aerial vehicle, unmanned aerial vehicle's bottom fixed mounting has the camera, and unmanned aerial vehicle's outside fixed mounting has microprocessor, and unmanned aerial vehicle's the outside and the top fixed mounting that is located microprocessor have wireless communication module, and unmanned aerial vehicle's the outside and the below fixed mounting that is located microprocessor have GPS orientation module, the equal fixedly connected with baffle box in both ends of unmanned aerial vehicle bottom, and one side that the inner wall of baffle box is close to unmanned aerial vehicle all is provided with buffer gear, the utility model discloses the beneficial effect who reaches is: the utility model discloses compact structure, easy operation is convenient, and the practicality is strong, sets up the buffering box that has buffer gear through the both sides at unmanned aerial vehicle, can cushion the side collision that unmanned aerial vehicle intelligence search and rescue equipment received to the completion searches and rescues the guard work of equipment to unmanned aerial vehicle intelligence, very big improvement the result of use of equipment, be favorable to practical application and operation.
assignees: SUZHOU YUNJIHUAN ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Modularized bionic search and rescue robot oriented to narrow space
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modularized bionic search and rescue robot oriented to a narrow space, which belongs to the technical field of search and rescue robots and comprises the following components: the system comprises a motion chassis, a material supply box, a life detection and environment sensing module, an identity verification module and a communication and control system. The motion chassis comprises a chassis frame, an arc leg motion mechanism and a mounting plate; the six arc-shaped leg movement mechanisms are symmetrically arranged at two sides of the outer part of the chassis frame, and three arc-shaped leg movement mechanisms at each side are distributed on the same straight line; the modularized material supplementing box is fixedly connected to the chassis frame, and can be automatically opened and closed according to the instruction of the communication system to provide first-aid materials for wounded persons; the life detection and environment sensing module is integrated on the identity verification module, and the modularized design can enable the life detection and environment sensing module to be quickly disassembled and assembled for other search and rescue robots. The invention has small size and strong obstacle crossing capability, can detect and locate wounded persons, identify the wounded persons, supply first-aid materials and reconstruct the search and rescue environment in three dimensions, and solves the search and rescue difficult problem in narrow space or dangerous environment.

title_en: Search and rescue method and device based on digital terrain model and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a search and rescue method, a search and rescue device, a storage medium and electronic equipment based on a digital terrain model, and aims to provide a collaborative rescue operation mode which is convenient to control and good in visualization effect. In addition, the thermal image shot by the aircraft is used, and the digital terrain model and the self-adaptive contrast enhancement technology are matched, so that effective decision information is provided for search and rescue personnel, and the timeliness of search and rescue operation is improved.
assignees: JIULING SHANGHAI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rescue unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue guiding mechanism
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle, concretely relates to rescue unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue guiding mechanism, including the unmanned aerial vehicle body, the lower terminal surface fixedly connected with mounted frame of unmanned aerial vehicle body, the bottom joint of mounted frame has to hang and holds the piece, hangs the lower terminal surface fixedly connected with cloud platform subassembly that holds the piece, and the cloud platform subassembly is including vertically hanging the board, vertically hangs the first accent of bottom side fixedly connected with of board to the motor, and first accent is to the horizontal alignment jig of output end fixedly connected with of motor, and the one end fixedly connected with second of horizontal alignment jig is transferred to the motor. When the hanging piece is arranged at the bottom of the hanging frame, the clamping buckles are buckled on the hanging column and are oppositely arranged, when the clamping buckles are buckled on the hanging column, the clamping buckles can be outwards opened and can be reset after being buckled, and therefore the clamping process between the clamping buckles and the hanging column is more convenient; compared with the traditional screw fixing mode, the installation time of the thermal imaging camera can be shortened.

title_en: Bionic mechanical ant search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bionic mechanical ant search and rescue robot, which comprises a front body and a rear body, wherein the front body is connected with the rear body through a steering mechanism; a front left walking foot and a front right walking foot are arranged on two sides of the front body, a left middle walking foot and a left rear walking foot are arranged on one side of the rear body, and a right middle walking foot and a right rear walking foot are arranged on the other side of the rear body; the left middle walking foot, the left rear walking foot, the right middle walking foot and the right rear walking foot are controlled by the same driving device, the front left walking foot, the right middle walking foot and the left rear walking foot are in a group, the other 3 walking feet are in a group, and the two groups of walking feet walk alternately, so that the overall stability of the robot is improved. The invention has simple integral structure, stable gait and high flexibility, can walk in buildings and natural environments with very complex topographic relief, and can complete the reconnaissance and search and rescue work in various environmental occasions.

title_en: Control method and system of nuclear emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and a control system of a nuclear emergency rescue robot, and relates to the technical field of emergency rescue control, wherein the method comprises the steps of calibrating rescue grades based on a position mapping relation between a nuclear hazard area and a preset rescue area set to obtain an emergency rescue grade information set; the method comprises the steps of carrying out element extraction on rescue areas with different grades in a corresponding rescue grade information set to obtain target area rescue element information, obtaining target area rescue task parameters based on the target area rescue element information and the hazard condition parameters of a nuclear hazard area, inputting the target area rescue task parameters and the task scheduling information of the nuclear emergency rescue robot into a rescue resource allocation model to obtain rescue resource allocation information, and carrying out emergency rescue management and control on a preset rescue area set based on the rescue resource allocation information. The intelligent and accurate optimization of the robot allocation in the rescue area is achieved, and further the technical effect of improving the rescue efficiency of the nuclear emergency accident treatment is achieved.

title_en: A track rock climbing robot for monitoring
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a monitoring robot technical field, in particular to track climbing robot for monitoring, including mobile device, casing and monitoring devices, mobile device movable mounting is in the both sides of casing, monitoring devices fixed mounting is at the top of casing, monitoring devices includes triaxial arm and shooting device, the one end fixed mounting of triaxial arm is at the top of casing, shooting device fixed mounting is at the other end of triaxial arm, the top fixed mounting of casing has adjusting device, adjusting device's top fixed mounting has warning device, adjusting device is used for adjusting warning device's position, one side fixed mounting of casing has a plurality of signal receiving device, solar panel has been laid at the top of casing, the inside solar energy conversion equipment that is provided with of casing, solar energy conversion equipment is used for turning into the electric energy with solar energy and supplies the robot to use. The utility model aims at providing a track rock climbing robot for monitoring has wide and the search and rescue personnel's of application scope advantage.
assignees: SUZHOU ZHEXIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Small-sized autonomous deformable modular robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a small-sized autonomous deformable modular robot, which comprises a plurality of robot modules and a flexible spine; the bottom of the robot module is provided with a wheel-foot composite mechanism; the flexible spine is connected between the adjacent robot modules to form a chain structure; the robot modules at two ends of the robot are autonomous separable modules which are connected with the flexible spine through magnetic interfaces with controllable separation; the robot module positioned in the middle of the robot is an autonomous inseparable module, and two ends of the robot module are fixedly connected with the flexible spine through mechanical interfaces; the utility model discloses a robot can open up operation tasks such as geological exploration, search and rescue after the calamity, can realize the real-time transmission of investigation information, search and rescue information, possesses stronger complicated topography throughput.

title_en: Security system using drone and cctv
title_ko: 드론과 감시카메라를 이용한 보안 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a security system using a drone and surveillance camera, comprising: a drone which monitors an area around an operator at a certain distance from the operator; at least one surveillance camera installed on a designated search route of the drone; a display device which is linked to the surveillance camera and drone, and receives and displays images from the surveillance camera close to the operator and images from the drone monitoring the operator's surroundings; and a controller which adjusts a height and magnification of the drone based on a surveillance area of the surveillance camera and controls the same to provide an image in a moving direction of the operator. Additionally, the security system using a drone and surveillance camera can be implemented in various ways depending on embodiments. In the present invention, even if a return for maintenance, repair, and charging of the drone are required during a mission, the mission can be continued without interruption.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 드론과 감시카메라를 이용한 보안 시스템에 관한 것으로, 오퍼레이터와 일정한 간격을 가지며 오퍼레이터 주변을 감시하는 드론과, 드론의 지정된 수색 경로 상에 구비된 적어도 하나의 감시카메라와, 감시카메라 및 드론과 연동되며 오퍼레이터의 근접한 감시카메라의 영상과 오퍼레이터의 주변을 감시하는 드론의 영상을 수신하여 표시하는 디스플레이 장치 및 감시카메라의 감시 영역을 기본으로 드론의 높이 및 배율을 조정하며, 오퍼레이터의 진행방향으로 영상을 제공하도록 제어하는 컨트롤러를 포함할 수 있다.  
또한, 상기와 같은 드론과 감시카메라를 이용한 보안 시스템은, 실시예에 따라 다양하게 구현될 수 있다.

title_en: Electronic apparatus and method for searching distress, unmanned aerial vehicle, computer program
title_ko: 조난 수색을 위한 전자 장치, 조난 수색 방법, 무인 비행체 및 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention is an electronic apparatus for searching distress, the electronic apparatus comprising: a processor which controls the flight of an unmanned aerial vehicle, and is operated to analyze the surrounding image according to the flight route of the unmanned flight vehicle; and a memory in which at least one command executed by means of the processor is stored. The at least one command executed by means of the processor is characterized by comprising: a command of determining whether a distress detection condition, which is defined in advance during the flight of the unmanned aerial vehicle, is satisfied; a command of, in case the distress detection condition is determined to be satisfied, applying a human detection model which is learned in advance to the surrounding image to determine whether a human being exists in the surrounding image; and a command of determining whether the distress situation has occurred according to the determination result. Therefore, inefficiency in searching can be removed, and precision in searching can be improved.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 조난 수색을 위한 전자 장치를 개시한다. 상기 전자 장치는 무인 비행체의 비행을 제어하며, 상기 무인 비행체의 비행 경로에 따른 주변 영상을 분석하도록 동작하는 프로세서(processor); 및 상기 프로세서를 통해 실행되는 적어도 하나의 명령이 저장된 메모리;를 포함하고, 상기 프로세서를 통해 실행되는 적어도 하나의 명령은, 상기 무인 비행체의 비행 과정에서 미리 정의된 조난 탐지 조건이 충족되었는지 여부를 판단하도록 하는 명령, 상기 조난 탐지 조건이 충족된 것으로 판단된 경우, 상기 주변 영상에 미리 학습된 사람 탐지 모델을 적용하여 상기 주변 영상에 사람이 속해있는지 여부를 판단하도록 하는 명령, 및 상기 판단 결과에 따라 조난 상황의 발생 여부를 결정하도록 하는 명령을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire rescue robotechnology field just discloses a fire rescue robot, which comprises a frame, the bottom fixedly connected with electric turntable of frame, electric turntable's bottom fixedly connected with removes the track, the top of frame is provided with the rescue device, the rescue device includes the connecting rod of fixed connection in the frame upper surface, the top fixedly connected with light of connecting rod, the upper surface of frame and the left fixed mounting who is located the light have a every single move driver, the pivot outside fixedly connected with robotic arm frame of every single move driver, the one end that the every single move driver was kept away from to robotic arm frame is rotated and is connected with the cutting member, the last fixed surface of frame installs infrared camera. According to the fire rescue robot, the threat degree of a scene to rescuers is reduced through the rescue device, so that the rescuers can carry out scene investigation and make a corresponding plan through the rescue robot remotely.

title_en: Distributed park safety management system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distributed park safety management system, which comprises: the personnel dispatching mechanism is arranged in a control room of the zoo and used for determining the number of emergency rescue personnel dispatched to the wild animal presence area according to the type of the main wild animal corresponding to the wild animal presence area where the wireless alarm device sending the vehicle leaving alarm signal is wirelessly received when the vehicle leaving alarm signal is received; and the wireless alarm equipment is arranged near the visual imaging mechanism and is used for wirelessly sending the off-vehicle alarm signal to the personnel dispatching mechanism when more than one object far away from the vehicle body exists in the secondary conversion picture. The invention also relates to a distributed park safety management method. By the aid of the rescue robot, the rescue hands with corresponding number can be adaptively matched according to types of main animals which are present and absent in the area sending the rescue signal, and whether human targets far away from the vehicle body exist can be judged according to the visual distance of the human body vehicle body of the whole area in which the animals are present and absent.

title_en: Thermal imaging living body identification and environment acquisition data transmission device for emergency search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a thermal imaging live body discernment and environmental acquisition data transmission device for emergent search and rescue, including power management unit, state indicating unit, thermal imaging unit, microprocessor unit, low-power consumption camera unit, sensing module unit, location module unit and loRa communication unit, power management unit is thermal imaging unit, microprocessor unit, low-power consumption camera unit, sensing module unit, location module unit and the power supply of loRa communication unit, microprocessor unit is connected with state indicating unit, thermal imaging unit, low-power consumption camera unit, sensing module unit and location module unit respectively, low-power consumption camera unit, sensing module unit and location module unit are connected with loRa communication unit respectively. The device is beneficial to carrying out living body searching, image shooting, environment acquisition and remote data transmission on the space area of the emergency scene.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle and cluster unmanned aerial vehicle cooperative operation method and related device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent unmanned systems, in particular to a cooperative operation method of an unmanned vehicle and a cluster unmanned aerial vehicle and a related device. The method comprises the following steps: the unmanned vehicle receives a total task and divides the total task into a plurality of subtasks; the unmanned vehicles determine the number of unmanned aerial vehicles executing tasks according to the number of the subtasks, and distribute and issue the subtasks; the unmanned vehicles receive the state information and the scanned information of each unmanned aerial vehicle and construct a three-dimensional map according to the scanned information; the unmanned vehicle fuses the three-dimensional map and constructs a global map; and the unmanned vehicle plans a path according to the landing position information and the global map, and searches the unmanned vehicle according to the path. The invention can automatically distribute tasks, reduce the operation level of operators, reduce the task issuing time and improve the search and rescue efficiency. Unmanned aerial vehicle can make full use of duration and exert the advantage that unmanned aerial vehicle's high altitude search and rescue visual angle is big, and unmanned vehicle also can exert the advantage that duration is long.
assignees: SHENZHEN INST OF ADV TECH CAS

title_en: UE equipment signal searching device and method based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a UE equipment signal searching device based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the unmanned aerial vehicle, unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted equipment and a ground station; the unmanned aerial vehicle is used for carrying the unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted equipment for searching; the unmanned airborne equipment comprises an active transmitting module and an uplink direction-finding module, wherein the active transmitting module is used for transmitting signals to interact with the UE equipment so as to acquire the signals of the UE equipment; the uplink direction finding module is used for measuring and calculating the position relation between the UE equipment and the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the signal intensity of the UE equipment and outputting the position relation to the ground station; the ground station is used for acquiring the position relation and obtaining the position of the UE equipment according to the position relation, and the ground station is also used for controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle. The device has universal applicability and can realize accurate search and rescue.

title_en: Bionic snake-shaped search and rescue robot based on touch driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bionic snake-shaped search and rescue robot based on touch drive, which comprises: the snake-shaped robot comprises a snake-shaped robot body, wherein the snake-shaped robot body comprises a plurality of motion units, two adjacent motion units are connected end to end and are orthogonally arranged, and each motion unit comprises a motor, a U-shaped connecting piece and a strain gauge for touch induction; the snake-shaped robot driving system comprises an upper computer, a PID (proportion integration differentiation) controller and a mode controller, wherein the mode controller is respectively connected with the upper computer and the snake-shaped robot body and transmits a deformation signal generated by a strain gauge to the upper computer; the upper computer is used for processing data transmitted by the snake-shaped robot body and driving the motor to run through the PID controller. According to the bionic snake-shaped search and rescue robot, the touch sensor is arranged on the bionic snake-shaped search and rescue robot to identify the environmental terrain, so that the moment of the snake-shaped robot is better controlled, the posture of the snake-shaped robot is adjusted, and accurate search and rescue in an unknown environment is realized.

title_en: Fire rescue robot heat sink
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire-fighting robot technical field discloses a fire rescue robot heat sink, including covering at the outside robot shell of fire rescue robot, the robot shell includes inlayer and skin, be equipped with the thermal-insulated filler material of certain thickness between inlayer and the skin, the inside of inlayer is equipped with the spray tube, be equipped with atomizer on the skin, atomizer is connected with the spray tube, the one end of spray tube is connected with the high pressure water piping on the fire engine, the other end and the last reserve tank of fire rescue robot of spray tube are connected, have that the cooling protection is effectual, the full coverage does not have the omission, and the flow is convenient for adjust, the advantage of water conservation water-saving.
assignees: YIXIAO PARTS TECH XIANGYANG CO LTD

title_en: Remote shooting control device for drones using radar
title_ko: 레이더/원격사격 통제장치 일체형 드론
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a radar/remote fire control device integrated drone. The radar/remote fire control device integrated drone includes: a radar transceiver; a sensor system; a shooting aiming launcher; and a mission execution computer, thereby capable of searching for and tracking intruders, eliminating automatic fire on cluster terror drones, extinguishing forest fires through extensive area reconnaissance, and finding missing people.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 레이더/원격사격 통제장치 일체형 드론에 관한 발명이다. 
레이더/원격사격 통제장치 일체형 드론은 레이더 송수신기; 센서 시스템; 사격조준 발사장치 및 임무수행 컴퓨터로 구성되고, 침입자 수색, 추적, 군집 테러 드론에 대한 자동 사격 제거, 광범위한 지역 정찰을 통한 산불 소방, 실종자 발견 임무를 수행 할 수 있다.

title_en: Sound source positioning system based on unmanned aerial vehicle platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue, and discloses a sound source positioning system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle platform, which comprises an aircraft, a closed bin, a main image acquisition module, a noise reduction module, an anti-inertia damping release module, a sound acquisition module, a collection control module and a micro-image acquisition module, wherein the anti-inertia damping release module is arranged in the closed bin and is used for adjusting the distance between the main image acquisition module and the sound acquisition module and improving the sound acquisition precision of a dense forest zone; the anti-inertia damping release module is used for separating and paralleling the sound acquisition module and the main image acquisition module, time delay positioning is combined, high-order acquisition is achieved, the positioning mode of low-order sound acquisition is achieved, the crown-attaching flight of the sound acquisition mechanism is utilized to reduce the influence of dense forest on sound energy reduction, the sound acquisition quality is poor when the acoustic-energy-collecting mechanism is applied to mountainous regions and dense forest search and rescue, and the search and rescue precision and the search and rescue quality are improved in the small region of the low-order flight image acquisition region.

title_en: Emergency positioning method, unmanned aerial vehicle, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency positioning method, an unmanned aerial vehicle, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a registration request of a user terminal, wherein the registration request comprises an International Mobile Subscriber Identity (IMSI); and transmitting the unmanned aerial vehicle position information and the IMSI obtained when the registration request is obtained to a ground control center so that the ground control center obtains identity information of the user according to the IMSI and the unmanned aerial vehicle position information and positions a target area where the user is located. The problem that in the related technology, a large number of search and rescue personnel are required to be invested in searching for the personnel in distress in the area without the coverage of the mobile communication network, and the searching efficiency is low is solved, and the method is suitable for scenes of unmanned aerial vehicles and search and rescue positioning.

title_en: Intelligent salvage robot for object refused to be rescued or unconscious
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent rescue robot for a rescue refusing or unconscious object, and relates to the technical field of water rescue equipment. This intelligent salvage robot to refusing rescue or unconscious object, including hull support and install two on hull support bottom surface and aerify the hull, two the bottom surface of aerifing the hull all installs brushless propeller, the bottom surface mounting of hull support has two sets of driving system, and is two sets of driving system's bottom surface installs the salvage arm respectively, and is two sets of salvage arm's one side surface distribution installs salvage fixture. The invention fixes the person falling into the water between the arc-shaped side plates through the expansion air bag, stably fixes the person falling into the water between the arc-shaped side plates, simultaneously can not cause excessive extrusion to the person falling into the water, does not need the person falling into the water to automatically cooperate, and can effectively avoid the life safety risk brought by the face-to-face short-distance rescue of the rescuer caused by the meaningless resistance of the light person in the water.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle night vision device and unmanned aerial vehicle system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle night vision device and unmanned aerial vehicle system, unmanned aerial vehicle night vision device includes: the holder assembly is used for being installed on the unmanned aerial vehicle; the night vision assembly is located in the accommodating cavity and comprises a camera and an enhancing piece, and the enhancing piece is used for enhancing the illumination intensity received by the camera. When unmanned aerial vehicle carried out the inspection work of flying, because the reinforcing effect of reinforcement for the picture luminance reinforcing that the night vision subassembly was obtained has the night vision effect under weak illumination, need not to provide initiative illumination, also is not restricted to the scope and the angle of illumination, can realize patrolling and examining with night under the low light level, is favorable to improving personnel's search and rescue work efficiency. Moreover, the night vision device of the unmanned aerial vehicle is simple in structure, light in overall weight, convenient to install, suitable for unmanned aerial vehicles of various models and beneficial to improving applicability and using convenience.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID GENERAL AVIATION SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Following type unmanned aerial vehicle for emergency rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, specifically disclose a follow-up unmanned aerial vehicle for emergency rescue, including the unmanned aerial vehicle fuselage, can dismantle on the integration switching box and be fixed with lighting system, propaganda directed to the public system and collection system, collection system includes 360 revolving stages and the camera based on yolo algorithm, the camera is installed on 360 revolving stages; the utility model discloses an installation lighting system in the below of unmanned aerial vehicle fuselage, propaganda directed to system and collection system, the processing of data collection is managed to the yolo algorithm that makes this unmanned aerial vehicle accessible camera gather and camera from taking, realize that unmanned aerial vehicle is automatic to follow, through lighting system, provide the illumination for the place ahead personnel, through the propaganda directed to system of one-to-one, ensure that should be suffered from a disaster personnel and carry out the fastest safety evacuation according to appointed unmanned aerial vehicle, thereby make unmanned aerial vehicle possess and follow, the function of illumination and propaganda directed to say, the search and rescue efficiency is improved, personnel's safety is ensured to furthest.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle emergency positioning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle emergency positioning system, which comprises a waterproof and electromagnetic-proof shell installed on an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein a positioning antenna capable of receiving a navigation system signal, a position indicating antenna capable of outputting positioning data outwards, a positioning/position indicating module respectively electrically connected with the positioning antenna and the position indicating antenna, an overload sensing module capable of sensing the falling and collision of the unmanned aerial vehicle, a control module and a power supply module are installed in the shell; overload perception module and control module are supplied power by unmanned aerial vehicle's on-board power supply, and location/position indicating module is supplied power by power module, and power module is last to have the power switch that can switch over to self-power supply state from outage standby state, and overload perception module is connected with control module and power switch electricity in proper order. This system can be at the automatic outside output location data of unmanned aerial vehicle weight back of hitting, and the ground search and rescue personnel of being convenient for learn the accident site at the very first time, search for and rescue fast.
assignees: AVIC AEROSPACE LIFE SUPPORT IND LTD

title_en: Intelligent search and rescue platform for offshore operating personnel based on AIS and Beidou system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of maritime search and rescue, and discloses an intelligent search and rescue platform for maritime operators based on AIS and Beidou system, comprising a Beidou satellite system, AIS personal beacons, a signal processing unit, a rescue command terminal, an unmanned search and rescue unit, an acousto-optic-electric alarm device, and a wireless signal unit integrated in the AIS personal beacons; big dipper satellite system and AIS personal beacon wireless connection, AIS personal beacon and signal processing unit electric connection, signal processing unit and rescue command terminal wireless connection, rescue command terminal and unmanned search and rescue unit wireless connection, sound and light alarm device and rescue command terminal electric connection. The utility model discloses can be in the twinkling of an eye with the personnel in distress pinpoint with the help of satellite and data link conveniently, the very first time guide search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, lifesaving robot, the unmanned lifeboat of intelligence catch up to the place of incident and carry out timely rescue to the personnel in distress at sea.
assignees: DONGYING JIARUI YUANHENG PETROLEUM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle flight search and rescue track optimization method for disaster area rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle flight search and rescue track optimization method for disaster area rescue, which comprises the following steps: a remote base station is connected using a drone equipped with a Radio Frequency (RF) communication module and a Free Space Optical (FSO) communication module as a relay node. Considering RF/FSO communication spectrum resource management and unmanned aerial vehicle number minimization, a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative track optimization method for disaster area emergency communication is provided through an enhanced K-means algorithm and an extended multi-mode deep reinforcement learning algorithm. Meanwhile, based on multi-mode deep reinforcement learning, the unmanned aerial vehicle is trained to work cooperatively according to the position and the motion trail of the mobile user. The invention improves the utilization rate of RF/FSO communication spectrum resources through a multi-mode deep reinforcement learning algorithm, simultaneously improves the throughput of the same total link to the maximum extent, and compared with other methods, the invention also improves the RF distribution efficiency and the bit rate of FSO communication backhaul.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle location sending device that falls
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle location sending device that falls, which comprises a fixing plate and i, the winding displacement hole has been seted up on the surface of fixed plate, the bottom fixedly connected with go-between of fixed plate, the bottom of fixed plate just is located the insulating storehouse of inside fixedly connected with of go-between, the bottom fixedly connected with electro-magnet of insulating storehouse inner wall, the top of electro-magnet and the bottom fixed connection of fixed plate, the bottom fixedly connected with holding ring in insulating storehouse. The utility model discloses a fixed plate, insulating storehouse, electro-magnet, holding ring, support storehouse, go-between, battery, distribution storehouse, stand pipe, metal block, conducting block, logical groove, electrode slice, bee calling organ, mutually support with the alarm lamp, prevent to touch because of the mistake and make the metal block fall and lead to the circuit switch-on, lead to the mistake to report, through the battery of installation, realize permanent power supply to bee calling organ and alarm lamp, report to the police for a long time for the search and rescue provides the warning, make things convenient for search and rescue personnel's search and rescue.

title_en: Method and apparatus for controlling drone swarm transport and security station through AI
title_ko: Ai를 통한 드론 군집비행 운송 및 보안 스테이션 제어 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: One embodiment of the present invention relates to a method of operating a first main station capable of docking a plurality of drones operated by at least one server, comprising: a step of generating first flight information including information about a first sub-station among a plurality of sub-stations in a preset area corresponding to the first main station and transmitting it to a first drone which is not currently flying among the plurality of drones according to a preset cycle; a step of receiving first image information for security search obtained through a first imaging device mounted on the first drone while the first drone is flying based on the first flight information; and a step of labeling the first image information with information about the first sub-station and flight time information of the first drone and storing it in a security image database related to security search. Accordingly, the present invention can provide rapid and effective logistics transportation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예는 적어도 하나의 서버에 의해 수행되는 복수의 드론들이 도킹 가능한 제1 메인 스테이션의 동작 방법에 관한 것으로 상기 제1 메인 스테이션에 대응되는 미리 설정된 영역 내의 복수의 서브 스테이션들 중 제1 서브 스테이션에 관한 정보를 포함하는 제1 비행 정보를 생성하여 미리 설정된 주기에 따라 상기 복수의 드론들 중 현재 비행 중이지 않은 제1 드론에게 전달하는 단계, 상기 제1 비행 정보를 기반으로 상기 제1 드론이 비행하는 동안 상기 제1 드론에 탑재된 제1 촬영 장치를 통해 획득되는 보안 수색을 위한 제1 영상 정보를 수신하는 단계 및 상기 제1 영상 정보에 상기 제1 서브 스테이션에 관한 정보 및 상기 제1 드론의 비행 시간 정보를 라벨링하여 보안 수색에 관한 보안 영상 데이터베이스에 저장하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Lifting and rotating device for depth camera of rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a lifting and rotating device of a rescue robot depth camera, which comprises a base, a lifting motor, a storage battery, a depth camera, a lifting platform, a lifting screw rod, a fixed rod, a depth camera shell, an angle adjusting motor, a bolt, a nut, a depth camera rotating support, a threaded hole, a fixed seat and a fixed hole, wherein an output shaft of the lifting motor is fixedly connected with the lifting screw rod, threads are arranged on the periphery of the lifting screw rod, the lifting platform is sleeved on the periphery of the lifting screw rod, the angle adjusting motor is fixedly arranged on one side of the lifting platform, the output shaft of the angle adjusting motor is fixedly connected with the depth camera rotating support, and the depth camera rotating support is fixedly connected with the depth camera shell through the bolt and the nut. The device can be conveniently deployed on a rescue robot platform, the adjustment of the height and the pitching angle of the depth camera is realized, the capability of the rescue robot for acquiring environmental information is improved, and the search and rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Air-breathing backboard integrating audio and video, thermal imaging acquisition and 4G real-time transmission functions
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air-breathing backboard with audio and video collection, thermal imaging collection and 4G real-time transmission functions, which comprises an air-breathing backboard main body, wherein a central control unit and a power module for supplying power to the central control unit are arranged in the air-breathing backboard main body, and one side of the air-breathing backboard main body is also provided with an electronic pressure gauge; the electronic pressure gauge is connected with a wire harness pipe, and the wire harness pipe is embedded in the backboard main body. The fire scene monitoring system is provided with an audio and video acquisition module, a thermal imaging acquisition module and a 4G transmission module, the audio and video data are acquired through the audio and video acquisition module, the thermal imaging data are acquired through the thermal imaging acquisition module, so that firefighters can search and rescue trapped personnel in the fire scene conveniently, the search and rescue efficiency of firefighters is improved, the audio and video data and the thermal imaging data are transmitted out of the fire scene in real time through the 4G transmission module, and external personnel can know the fire scene situation in real time conveniently to deploy and rescue.

title_en: Method of searching and rescuing drone based on wake-up receiving skill and apparatus performing thereof
title_ko: 웨이크업 수신 기술 기반의 무인 이동체 수색 구조 방법 및 이를 실행하는 장치
abstract_en: A system for searching and rescuing an unmanned vehicle based on a wake-up reception technology according to the present invention comprises: an unmanned distress vehicle that enables a power supply to be applied to a GPS sensor to activate the GPS sensor when a wake-up signal is received, and provides location information after obtaining the location information through the GPS sensor; a navigation unmanned vehicle that provides the wake-up signal to search for the unmanned distress vehicle while driving in a mountainous environment, and receives and provides the location information for each unmanned distress vehicle in response to the wake-up signal; and a ground device that displays the location information for each unmanned distress vehicle received from the navigation unmanned vehicle. Therefore, the present invention is capable of having the advantage of being able to provide search and rescue.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 웨이크업 수신 기술 기반의 무인 이동체 수색 구조 시스템은 웨이크업 신호를 수신하면 GPS 센서에 전원을 인가하여 상기 GPS 센서를 활성화시키고 상기 GPS 센서를 통해 위치 정보를 획득한 후 상기 위치 정보를 제공하는 조난 무인 이동체, 산악 환경을 주행하면서 조난 무인 이동체를 검색하기 위한 웨이크업 신호를 제공하고, 상기 웨이크업 신호에 대한 응답으로 조난 무인 이동체 별 위치 정보를 수신하여 제공하는 탐색 무인 이동체 및 상기 탐색 무인 이동체로부터 수신되는 조난 무인 이동체 별 위치 정보를 표시하는 지상 장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Self-aviation underwater search and rescue device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-aviation underwater search and rescue device which comprises a waterproof shell, wherein a waterproof lamp is arranged on a cover plate at the upper part of the waterproof shell, anti-collision foam is arranged around the cover plate, a storage battery, an integrated main board, an infrared thermal imager and a motor are arranged in the waterproof shell, a motor rotor at the tail part of the motor is connected with a propeller, the integrated main board simultaneously controls the motor, the waterproof lamp and the infrared thermal imager, and the storage battery arranged in the waterproof shell provides energy for the whole device. The device is based on the requirements of rescue timeliness, device simplicity and search and rescue self-aviation, and controls the motor, the waterproof lamp and the infrared thermal imager to work in a coordinated manner through the integrated main board with comprehensive functions, so that the comprehensive search and rescue work of water surface and underwater expansion in a certain water area is realized.

title_en: Indoor fire emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire rescue and discloses an indoor fire emergency rescue robot which comprises a top plate, wherein crawler assemblies are arranged on the left side and the right side below the top plate, a support frame is fixedly arranged on the left side and the right side between the two crawler assemblies, the top end of the support frame is fixedly connected with the bottom end of the top plate, and a mounting frame is fixedly arranged in front of the top end of the top plate. According to the invention, through realizing the independent suction and the independent discharge processes of external air, the rotary motion is converted into the horizontal reciprocating motion, and then the air is respectively sucked and discharged, so that the periodical air discharge is realized, the air is discharged after being pressurized, the flow speed is high, the surrounding smog can be rapidly expelled, other compressed air equipment is not required to be carried, the equipment servicing quality is effectively reduced, the equipment trafficability is improved, the problem that the traditional device is difficult to photograph the surrounding environment indoors is effectively avoided, the picture definition is effectively improved, and the normal operation of rescue is ensured.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZHONGCHEN CITY EMERGENCY SERVICE MAN CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle jointly cruises search and rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a combined cruising search and rescue system of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following components: the unmanned ship is provided with an unmanned plane; the integrated navigation system is arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle and used for collecting the position information of the unmanned aerial vehicle; the search control system is arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle and is used for receiving the navigation information of the control terminal and sending the navigation information to the unmanned aerial vehicle main control; and the unmanned aerial vehicle main control controls the unmanned aerial vehicle to reach a preset cruising point for operation according to the position information and the navigation information of the unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle is carried on the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the search and rescue advantages of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned aerial vehicle can be combined, and the search and rescue efficiency is greatly improved.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;WUHAN ELECTRIC POWER TECHNICAL COLLEGE

title_en: Inverted arm climbing robot and advancing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inverted arm climbing robot and a traveling method thereof. The robot comprises a soft driving arm and self-adaptive clamping claws respectively arranged at two ends of the soft driving arm. The flexible drive arm is capable of bending motion. The self-adaptive clamping claw comprises a fin holder, a clamping driving assembly, a self-adaptive rotating disc, a camera, a rotating driving assembly, a connecting rod assembly, a unidirectional locking mechanism, a fastening piece and an air duct. The connecting rod assembly comprises a fixed support, a first fin installation rod, a rotating rod, a second fin installation rod and a clamping and adjusting elastic bag body. The invention can realize continuous advancing in rugged environment by matching the bending motion of the soft driving arm with the clamping of the two self-adaptive clamping claws to the raised position in the environment, can adapt to inclined or even vertical environment, and can be applied to the scenes of ruin search and rescue, military reconnaissance and the like.

title_en: Unmanned ship based on multitasking control emergency search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency search and rescue unmanned ship based on multitasking control, which comprises an unmanned ship body, wherein two sides of the unmanned ship body are connected with cabin bodies; the lifting assembly is connected with a cabin in the unmanned aerial vehicle body through a scroll, and the scroll works to drive the lifting assembly to ascend or descend; the water quality monitoring assembly is carried on the unmanned aerial vehicle body and/or the cabin and is used for monitoring the water quality of the water body below the unmanned aerial vehicle body; the gyroscope and the geomagnetic sensor are positioned on the unmanned aerial vehicle body and/or the cabin body and are used for acquiring the posture of the unmanned aerial vehicle body and/or the cabin body; and the control component sends out a control command to form an expected value, and feeds back the acquired gesture of the unmanned aerial vehicle body and/or cabin body to the control component, so that the gesture is compared with the expected value, and the target speed and/or angle of the propeller is obtained. The invention realizes humanization of operation through compensation optimization.
assignees: SHAANXI ENVIRONMENTAL PROT INDUSTRY INNOVATION CENTER CO LTD;XIAN HUSHA UNMANNED SHIP CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue robot with positioning function
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots, in particular to a search and rescue robot with a positioning function. The telescopic mechanism is driven by the control mechanism to extend to the periphery of the roller, so that the holding power of the roller is improved, idle slipping of the roller is avoided, the moving efficiency of the search and rescue robot is improved, the roller and the rotation radius of the cross rod are increased after the telescopic mechanism extends to the periphery of the roller, the height of the frame body is integrally lifted, the ground clearance of the frame body is increased, and the robot is prevented from being supported by the support in the moving process, so that the trafficability of the robot is effectively improved.
assignees: SUZHOU YILAN ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system
abstract_en: A search and rescue drone system includes a buoyant body member, a frame attached to the buoyant body member for carrying a motor and propeller, and an electronic array including a camera, GPS, an EPIRB radio distress beacon, and a transmitter/receiver for remote control flying the drone and communicating with an operator. A laser guidance system may provide coordinates for landing near a swimmer in distress. The search and rescue drone may also be programmed to simply fly to the location of an electronic wearable device, like a bracelet, that is worn by a man overboard. In another embodiment, the search and rescue drone includes pivoting motor mounts, so that it can take off and land vertically with propellers rotating in a horizontal plane, and then the propellers may pivot to rotate in a vertical plane for propulsion across water similar to a fan boat with rescued people aboard.

title_en: Multi-line human detection and posture estimation method under ultra-low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle visual angle
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of computer vision, and particularly provides a multi-line human detection and posture estimation method under an ultra-low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle visual angle, which comprises the steps of acquiring image data by using an unmanned aerial vehicle and preprocessing the data set; the method comprises the steps of enhancing a data set, training a target detection network by using the enhanced data through a YOLOv algorithm, performing multi-row human detection by using the trained target detection network, and performing gesture estimation by using a single gesture estimation algorithm. The method solves the problems of redundancy and inaccurate labeling of the data set, avoids the influence of the quality of the data set on the uncertainty of the detection result, solves the problem of difficult detection caused by smaller pedestrian targets, improves the detection precision by using a deep learning algorithm and a data enhancement technology, and realizes the posture estimation of pedestrians under the view angle of the ultra-low-altitude unmanned plane.

title_en: Multifunctional water surface robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional water surface robot, which comprises a device main body; the water surface robot not only has the cruising monitoring function of the water surface robot, but also has the water surface rescue function, a rescuer can remotely control the water surface robot, search and rescue people through a real-time picture transmitted by the camera, after searching the water falling people, the rescuer can remotely control the electric telescopic rod to shrink, so that the pressing plate is removed from the connecting plate, and further, the life ring is popped out of the placing box, the water falling people can grasp the life ring to float on the water surface, meanwhile, the water falling people can grasp handrails on two sides of the floating body along the rope, after the water falling people are stable, the rescuer can control the water surface robot to return to the shore, rescue is implemented on the shore for the water falling people, the device can replace the rescuer to quickly search the water falling people, and put a life-saving appliance into the water falling people, and the device has the advantages of being intelligent, multiple in functions and the like.

title_en: Unmanned rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned rescue robot which comprises a shell, a rope, a flying device, a driving device and a rescue bag, wherein the flying device, the driving device and the rescue bag are arranged at the upper end of the shell, the shell is in a U-shaped design, the rope is arranged in a U-shaped opening on the shell and props against the inner side wall of the U-shaped opening, a partition plate is fixedly connected to the inner side wall of the shell, the partition plate divides the inner space of the shell into an upper cavity and a lower cavity, a limiting mechanism extending out of the shell is arranged in the upper cavity, the limiting mechanism can rapidly install and automatically loosen the rope, and electric telescopic rods are arranged on the inner side walls at two ends of the upper cavity. The rope lifting rescue device is reasonable in structural design, not only can enable the device to lift along the rope or fly for rescue according to the use requirement, and has flexibility, but also can realize automatic throwing of the rescue bag without manually taking the rescue bag by survivors.

title_en: Emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency rescue robot, wherein a power and control unit is arranged in a bearing platform, two first-aid bags can be fastened on the bearing platform by two binding belts, a camera is respectively arranged at the front end and the rear end of the bearing platform, a first leg mechanism is arranged at the front end of the lower side of the bearing platform and can move forwards and backwards and leftwards and rightwards, two ends of a first cross arm in the first leg mechanism are respectively bent forwards, two ends of the first cross arm are respectively provided with a supporting leg capable of moving upwards and downwards and positioning, a second leg mechanism is arranged at the middle position of the lower side of the bearing platform and can move forwards and backwards and leftwards and rightwards, a second cross arm in the second leg mechanism is of a transverse straight rod structure, and two ends of the second cross arm are respectively provided with a supporting leg capable of moving upwards and downwards and positioning; the third leg mechanism is arranged at the rear end of the lower side of the bearing platform and can move back and forth and left and right, two ends of a third cross arm in the third leg mechanism are bent backwards, and two ends of the third cross arm are respectively provided with a supporting leg capable of moving up and down and positioning.

title_en: Water-air integrated unmanned system, use method and application thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water-air integrated unmanned system, a use method and application thereof; belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle equipment; the water-air integrated unmanned system comprises an aircraft, an underwater vehicle and a connecting line; the aircraft carries the underwater vehicle to fly, float and take off and land on the water surface, so that the rapid search and rescue in the water area are convenient to carry out; the connecting line plays a role in power supply or control, the problem of underwater signal control is solved for some times, meanwhile, the connecting line is wound to drive the underwater vehicle to be retracted and retracted, the underwater vehicle is convenient to recover and effectively guarantee the safety (prevent loss) of the underwater vehicle, meanwhile, the underwater vehicle can be controlled to disconnect the connecting line, the connecting line is convenient to disconnect in emergency (trip) or when the length of the connecting line is insufficient, the underwater vehicle can independently continue to work or float upwards to return to the air after getting rid of trouble, and flexible operation is facilitated; the water-air integrated unmanned system realizes triphibious operation in the air, on the water and under the water, and is greatly helpful for water area searching, rescuing and scientific research.
assignees: NANJING KTY UAV TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mine tunnel rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine tunnel rescue robot, and relates to the technical field of mine tunnel safety rescue. Comprises a front section, a middle section, a rear section and two rotary joints. The front section and the rear section are provided with Mecanum wheels at the head and the tail, and the central parts of the front section and the rear section are provided with storage grids for placing emergency rescue articles; the front section, the middle section and the rear section are connected by rotary joints provided with stepping motors. The middle section is internally provided with a three-section mechanical arm. The mechanical arm terminal is provided with a mechanical arm, so that the object can be accurately grabbed. The front section head part, the rear section tail part, the top of the first rotary joint and the top of the second rotary joint are all provided with night vision wide-angle cameras. The invention can pass through a pipeline system and a more complex road surface environment; the camera with the 5G signal module is used for checking the site condition in real time, adjusting to the optimal posture according to the topography, carrying out omnidirectional movement by means of the Mecanum wheel, and the mechanical arm can assist personnel to transport emergency materials and clear obstacles after reaching a rescue point.
assignees: SHANXI MACHINERY PRODUCT QUALITY SUPERVISION AND INSPECTION STATION CO LTD;SHANXI INSTITUTE OF MECH & ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Underwater search and rescue acoustic detection robot equipment with adjusting wings
abstract_en: The invention provides underwater search and rescue acoustic detection robot equipment with an adjusting wing, and relates to the technical field of rescue equipment. This attach and adjust underwater search and rescue acoustic detection robot equipment of wing, including the equipment shell, power device is installed to equipment shell tail end, equipment shell internally mounted has acoustic detection device, equipment shell both sides all are provided with the support wing frame, two support wing frame one end is all rotated and is connected with U-shaped linking frame, should attach and adjust underwater search and rescue acoustic detection robot equipment of wing, and first electric putter is articulated with the installation piece, makes first electric putter promote the support wing frame and rotates the junction around rotating with U-shaped linking frame and deflect to collapsible wing between messenger support wing frame and the fixed plate is expanded, makes the equipment shell can slide smoothly in water, and can adjust the speed of sliding through the degree of expansion of adjusting collapsible wing.

title_en: Optimizing human detection and tracking of human-machine collaboration in industry using sensor fusion
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to optimizing detection and tracking of human beings in human-computer collaboration in industry using sensor fusion. A method of detecting and tracking human activity in the vicinity of a robot comprising the steps of: combining one or more two-dimensional images acquired from a time-of-flight (ToF) sensor with data acquired simultaneously from a radar sensor to acquire fused sensor data; further comprising detecting the presence of a human in the vicinity of the robot based on the fused sensor data; and estimating a direction of motion and a speed of motion of the human based on the fused sensor data. In some embodiments, detection and estimation is performed using a machine learning model that has been trained using two-dimensional ToF images representing the environment for the robot and radar sensor data.

title_en: Ground situation real-time accurate reconstruction system based on space-sky integrated perception
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground situation real-time accurate reconstruction system based on space-sky integrated perception, belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle reconnaissance and situation perception, relates to a system and a method for acquiring ground live-action images and ground target longitude and latitude data by using positioning satellites and unmanned aerial vehicles, processing and generating a live-action map and a ground situation, and particularly relates to a method for superposing and combining the ground live-action map and an electronic map to accurately generate the ground live-action map, and a method for labeling target longitude and latitude on the ground live-action map, identifying target identities and generating azimuth and distance between targets. The ground reconnaissance method solves the problems of ground reconnaissance of the unmanned aerial vehicle, such as difficulty in acquiring ground target coordinate data, incapability of simultaneously tracking multiple targets by a single unmanned aerial vehicle, incapability of accurately reconstructing ground situation in real time and the like. The invention can be widely applied to the fields of military, emergency and the like, and can obviously improve the capability of acquiring, analyzing and deciding the ground situation of a investigation region when in field investigation, small team combat and personnel search and rescue.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle high-altitude shooting image detection method based on dynamic convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle high-altitude shot image detection method based on a dynamic convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps of: collecting, screening, labeling and preprocessing the data of the personnel to be rescued to obtain a processed image; inputting the processed image into a proposed dynamic convolutional neural network model to perform model training and parameter adjustment optimization to obtain an improved dynamic convolutional neural network model; shooting a rescue land high-altitude image by adopting an unmanned aerial vehicle camera; inputting the high-altitude image of the rescue place into the improved dynamic convolution neural network model in real time for detection and identification, and outputting a detection result until a person to be rescued is found. The beneficial effects are that the search and rescue speed is improved, the detection precision is high, the discrimination effect is good, and the cost is low.

title_en: Search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of robots, in particular to a search and rescue robot, which comprises a wheel body, wherein one side of the wheel body is provided with a power bearing, and the search and rescue robot further comprises a first thigh, a second thigh and a shank, wherein one end of the second thigh is fixedly connected with a connecting sleeve, the other end of the second thigh is fixedly connected with a connecting shaft, the connecting sleeve is connected with the power bearing, one end of the first thigh is fixedly provided with a connecting sleeve plate, and the other end of the first thigh is fixedly provided with the connecting shaft; according to the search and rescue robot, the wheels can be freely and flexibly adjusted through the hinge joint of the first thigh, the second thigh and the two shanks, four groups of mechanisms are arranged on the robot body and connected with the multiple legs in a hinge joint mode, when the wheels sink into the small pit, the wheels are pulled to move backwards to rotate under the influence of gravity, the distance between the robot body and the wheels is prolonged, and therefore the wheels can be conveniently contacted with the pit bottom and can be conveniently moved out of the small pit together with other wheels.

title_en: Cross-medium multi-motion-mode bionic water snake robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-medium multi-motion mode bionic water snake robot which is formed by connecting a plurality of sections of bionic water snake units in series through a cross orthogonal driving mechanism. A plurality of first snake scales and second snake scales are arranged on the shell of each section of bionic water snake unit through a rotating shaft, the first snake scales and the second snake scales are arranged on the shell at intervals in an Archimedes spiral shape, and a driving mechanism for driving the shell, the first snake scales and the second snake scales to deform and move is arranged in the shell. According to the bionic water snake robot, different forms and motion modes of the bionic water snake robot are realized through modular design and scale deformation design, the purpose of a cross-medium multi-motion mode is achieved, the bionic water snake robot can move in the sea, rivers and lakes, shoal landing, land movement and seabed complex terrain motion can be realized, and the requirements of carrying out tasks such as reconnaissance, detection, search and rescue and the like under varied medium environments and varied working conditions such as land, water, gas/liquid pipelines and the like are met.

title_en: Comprehensive fire rescue robot for transformer substation and fire extinguishing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a transformer substation comprehensive fire-fighting and rescue robot and a transformer substation fire-extinguishing method, which relate to the technical field of transformer substation comprehensive fire-fighting and rescue robots and comprise the following steps: the upper computer and the fire-fighting robot; the singlechip receives a walking path sent by the upper computer through the wireless communication module, acquires current position information through the positioner, and controls the motor driving module to drive the motor and the wheels to run according to the walking path preset by the upper computer, so that the fire-fighting robot walks according to the preset walking path; when the equipment temperature information exceeds a preset first equipment temperature threshold value, the singlechip controls the control valve to be opened, and the extinguishing agent is sprayed to the area where the equipment temperature information exceeds the threshold value to extinguish the fire; the fire extinguishing device is used for rapidly extinguishing the sudden fire, controlling the spread of the initial fire, and winning time for rescue work. The system enhances early fire prevention and suppression, and more effectively improves the fire safety condition of the transformer substation.

title_en: Search and rescue ROV path planning system and method for three-dimensional environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue ROV path planning system and method of a three-dimensional environment, wherein an environment modeling module is used for acquiring underwater environment information of an ROV robot, abstracting a three-dimensional space model from a real environment in a region where the ROV robot moves, and constructing an underwater environment map three-dimensional grid model; the algorithm invokes the path generation module to select a target point of the path planning, and takes the current position of the ROV as a starting point of the path planning and the target position as an end point; adopting a three-dimensional path planning algorithm based on JPS-COSPS, inputting a three-dimensional grid model of an underwater environment map, a starting point and a target point, and carrying out path planning to obtain a planned path; the path detection module is used for ensuring the continuity of the path by judging the integrity of the planned path. The invention reduces the complexity of the three-dimensional environment and the difficulty of road searching; the safety of the path, the quality of the path and the smoothness of the path are guaranteed; ensuring the smooth operation of the search and rescue ROV.

title_en: Unmanned vehicles is searched for and rescue to water sky amphibious
abstract_en: An amphibious search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a buoyancy double-hull, a deck, a control cabin and a propeller mechanism; the deck is horizontally and fixedly arranged above the buoyancy double-hull, and the control cabin is fixedly arranged above the middle part of the deck; the screw propeller mechanisms are arranged at the front end and the rear end above the deck; the control cabin is internally provided with a power battery, a controller, satellite navigation equipment and a signal transceiver. A target search camera is arranged at the front end below the deck. The unmanned aerial vehicle can replace a manned plane to execute an aerial search task, can directly land on the water surface without returning after finding a target, can send accident position coordinate information to a ground command center in real time, can move along with an accident ship after falling, ensures the dynamic accuracy of the accident position coordinate, shortens the time spent on rescuing the plane or the ship to go on a target area, and improves the success rate of rescuing; because the aerial search task realizes unmanned, the safety risk possibly occurring when the manned rescue aircraft searches for the target in severe weather is avoided.

title_en: Phase-change temperature-control sheath material for maglev train cable and manufacturing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-flame-retardance, high-flexibility and phase-change temperature-control sheath material for a magnetic suspension train cable and a manufacturing method and application thereof, wherein a polybenzimidazole (DOPO-PBI) phosphorus-nitrogen flame retardant containing 9,10-dihydro-9-oxa-10-phosphaphenanthrene-10-oxide elements is compounded with a char forming agent containing rich oxygen elements to improve the flame retardance of the material. The silicon carbide and feldspar powder subjected to the surface modification by the aniline methyl triethoxysilane are subjected to a step-by-step blending process, a carbon forming agent, the silicon carbide and feldspar powder solid-solid composite type controllable phase change system is built in the material, the high movement capacity of a molecular chain segment of the material in an operation environment below the glass transition temperature of the material is guaranteed, the material and a cable can be stably used at an extremely low temperature, and in addition, the material has excellent flame retardant, fire resistance, oil resistance, mechanical property and aging resistance, and can be simultaneously applied to cables for intelligent service equipment in complex environments such as fire-fighting robots, emergency treatment rescue robots and the like.

title_en: Firefighter distress call device with search and rescue function and mutual rescue function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a firefighter distress call device with a search and rescue function and a mutual rescue function, which comprises a distress call device main body, wherein the distress call device main body comprises a distress call device rear shell and a distress call device front cover, and the distress call device front cover is arranged on the distress call device rear shell; a control panel module, a microphone and a display screen are arranged in the back shell of the distress call device. The fire fighter monitoring system is provided with the infrared camera, the video camera, the microphone and the loudspeaker are used for carrying out calling search and rescue for the fire fighter, communication between the fire fighters is realized by matching with wireless data transmission, the infrared camera and the video camera are used for collecting thermal imaging and video and displaying the thermal imaging and video on a display screen, the fire fighter can search and rescue according to the thermal imaging and the video, the fire fighter can search and rescue trapped people in a fire scene, and the fire fighter monitoring system is also provided with the help seeking button, the loudspeaker is used for sending an alarm by starting the help seeking button, and the fire fighter can carry out mutual rescue according to an alarm sound source.

title_en: GPS-free positioning system for forest rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle positioning search and rescue under a GPS-free condition, in particular to a GPS-free positioning system for forest rescue, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, an automatic tracking directional antenna A, an automatic tracking directional antenna B, a goniometer, a wireless signal transmitter and intelligent computing equipment, wherein the wireless signal transmitter is used for transmitting corner data of the automatic tracking directional antenna A and the automatic tracking directional antenna B to the intelligent computing equipment in a wireless mode. Compared with a differential GPS system, the method and the system can be used in a scene without GPS signals, the situation that the GPS signals cannot be unlocked and taken off can not occur, and the problem that unmanned aerial vehicle signals cannot return due to the fact that the unmanned aerial vehicle signals are not connected due to the influence of ground clutter can not occur.
assignees: XIAN GUANGHUAN ELECTRONIC SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: A unmanned aerial vehicle for crackdown on illegal crops and a serch system comprising the saem
title_ko: 불법 작물 단속용 무인 비행체 및 이를 포함하는 수색 시스템
