abstract_en: The present invention is to provide a realistically implementable and usable unmanned aerial vehicle for cracking down on illegal crops, and a search system including the same. According to an embodiment of the present invention, an unmanned aerial vehicle may comprise: a housing part; a flight module disposed in the housing part to allow the housing part to be moved in the sky; an image generation module disposed in the housing part to photograph an object; a storage module which stores images collected from the image generation module; a shadow module disposed in the housing part to form a shadow on the ground; and a power module disposed in the housing part to supply electrical energy to the flight module, the image generation module, the storage module, and the shadow module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 무인 비행체는, 하우징부; 상기 하우징부에 배치되어 상기 하우징부가 상공 상에서 위치 이동되도록 하는 비행 모듈; 상기 하우징부에 배치되어 객체를 촬영하는 영상 생성 모듈; 상기 영상 생성 모듈로부터 수집되는 영상을 저장하는 저장 모듈; 상기 하우징부에 배치되어 지면 상에 그림자가 형성되도록 하는 그림자 모듈; 및 상기 하우징부에 배치되어 상기 비행 모듈, 상기 영상 생성 모듈, 상기 저장 모듈 및 상기 그림자 모듈에 전기 에너지를 공급하는 전원 모듈;을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: A unmanned aerial vehicle control system and a serch method for detecting illegal crops
title_ko: 불법 작물 단속을 위한 무인 비행체 관제 시스템 및 수색 방법
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, an unmanned aerial vehicle control system comprises: a path module which calculates a path to be searched by an unmanned aerial vehicle; an air traffic control module which controls the unmanned aerial vehicle so that the unmanned aerial vehicle searches and collects images based on the path calculated by the path module; and an analysis module which determines the presence of illegal crops based on the images collected by the unmanned aerial vehicle. The air traffic control module can control the unmanned air vehicle to collect an image of an object at a first height and control, when a predetermined first condition is satisfied based on the first image, which is the image collected at the first height, the unmanned air vehicle to collect an image of an object at a second height lower than the first height. According to the present invention, it is possible to minimize the number of people deployed for search.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 무인 비행체 관제 시스템은, 무인 비행체가 수색할 경로를 산출하는 경로 모듈; 상기 경로 모듈에서 산출된 경로를 기초로 상기 무인 비행체가 수색하여 영상을 수집하도록 상기 무인 비행체를 제어하는 관제 제어 모듈; 및 상기 무인 비행체로부터 수집되는 영상을 기초로 불법 작물의 존재 여부를 판단하는 분석 모듈;을 포함하고, 상기 관제 제어 모듈은, 제1 높이 상에서 객체에 대한 영상이 수집되도록 상기 무인 비행체를 제어하고, 상기 제1 높이 상에서 수집된 상기 영상인 제1 영상을 기초로 미리 정해진 제1 조건이 만족되는 경우, 상기 제1 높이 보다 낮은 제2 높이 상에서 객체에 대한 영상이 수집되도록 상기 무인 비행체를 제어할 수 있다.

title_en: SOS rescue drone
title_ko: Sos 구조드론
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an SOS rescue drone which is able to allow a user to recognize a signal from a motion sensor by a communication device and immediately request for rescue, and solve the problem that it is hard to deal with a situation where it is hard to carry and use a device and request for a rescue. That is, according to the present invention, the SOS rescue drone comprises: a drone body with only the essential things inside without other things to be as small as to be inside a pocket; a drone wing which is a foldable wing to fly immediately when being thrown; a motion sensor for the drone to automatically start flying when a great force is applied; and a communication device configured to automatically request for rescue by being connected to the motion sensor to recognize a signal from the motion sensor and to immediately request for rescue. Therefore, the present invention is able to allow a user to recognize a signal from a motion sensor by a communication device and immediately request for rescue, and solve the problem that it is hard to deal with a situation where it is hard to carry and use a device and request for a rescue.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 SOS 구조드론에 관한 것으로서 통신장치에 의하여 움직임센서로 부터 온 신호를 인식하여 바로 구조요청을 할 수 있게 함으로써 휴대 및 사용이 어렵고 구조 요청을 하기 힘든 상황에 쉽게 대응하기 어려운 문제점을 해소하도록 함으로써 기존의 휴대 및 사용이 어렵고 구조 요청을 하기 힘든 상황에 쉽게 대응하기 어려운 문제점을 해소 하도록 한 것이다. 즉 본 발명은, 드론에 있어서 주머니에 넣을 수 있을정도로 작게  다른 조작기기들을 없애고 필요한 것만 남게 한 드론 몸체한 드론 몸체, 던졌을 때 바로 날 수 있게  접이식 날개로 구성한 드론 날개, 큰 힘이 가해질 경우 자동으로 비행을 시작하게 움직임 센서를 부착해 자동으로 비행한 움직임 센서, 움직임센서로 부터 온 신호를 인식하여 바로 구조요청을 할 수 있게 움직임센서와 통신장치를 연결하여 자동으로 구조요청을 할 수 있게 구성한 통신장치로 구성한 것이다. 따라서, 본 발명은 통신장치에 의하여 움직임센서로 부터 온 신호를 인식하여 바로 구조요청을 할 수 있게 함으로써 휴대 및 사용이 어렵고 구조 요청을 하기 힘든 상황에 쉽게 대응하기 어려운 문제점을 해소하도록 함으로써 기존의 휴대 및 사용이 어렵고 구조 요청을 하기 힘든 상황에 쉽게 대응하기 어려운 문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: Method for detecting missing object based on Deep-learning using drone and system for the method
title_ko: 드론을 통한 딥러닝 기반의 실종자 검출 및 수색 경로 관리 방법 및 이를 수행하는 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for detecting a missing person on the basis of deep learning. According to the present invention, a method for detecting a missing person includes the steps of: receiving an image to be detected; dividing the image to be detected into unit images of a predetermined size; and detecting a missing person on the basis of the unit images. The present invention can efficiently detect a missing person within a large screen, and can be utilized for setting a search route for a drone by searching for a missing person on the basis of a trained neural network while displaying a detection result on the basis of unit areas.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 딥러닝 기반의 실종자 검출 방법에 관한 것으로 본 발명에 따른 실종자 검출을 수행하는 방법을 검출 대상 이미지를 입력 받는 단계; 상기 검출 대상 이미지를 미리 결정된 크기의 단위 이미지로 분할하는 단계; 및 상기 단위 이미지를 기초로 실종자 검출을 수행하는 단계를 포함한다. 본 발명에 따르면 대화면 내에서 실종자를 효율적으로 검출할 수 있으며, 학습된 신경망을 바탕으로 실종자를 수색함과 동시에 단위 영역을 기준으로 검출 결과를 표시힘으로써 드론의 탐색 경로 설정에 활용할 수 있다.

title_en: Search and rescue robot based on multiple agents
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot based on multiple intelligent bodies, which relates to the field of robots and comprises a hexagon protection cylinder, wherein six edges of the outer side of the hexagon protection cylinder are respectively provided with a first connecting frame, two sides of the first connecting frame are respectively provided with a first fixing frame and a second fixing frame in a rotating way, one sides of the first fixing frame and the second fixing frame, which are far away from the first connecting frame, are internally provided with a movable wheel in a rotating way, one end of the hexagon protection cylinder is provided with a ring cylinder, the outer ring of the ring cylinder is fixedly provided with an outer protection ring, the outer ring of the outer protection ring is uniformly provided with a plurality of inclined blocks, when a trapped animal or pet encounters in a pipeline, an electric push rod pushes a chassis to enable a gripper to extend out of the hexagon protection cylinder, and the inner side of the gripper is uniformly provided with a plurality of air bags, and the bottom ends of the plurality of the air bags are provided with sponge pads, so that the contact object can be isolated and protected.

title_en: All-weather ocean search and rescue system and method based on rainbow unmanned aerial vehicle multi-source remote sensing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle maritime rescue, in particular to an all-weather maritime search and rescue system and method based on rainbow unmanned aerial vehicle multi-source remote sensing, which are used for solving the problems that the existing unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue is low in efficiency and is difficult to bear high-strength search and rescue tasks, and the method comprises the following steps: determining an original search and rescue area of a rescue target; selecting a remote sensing satellite, and acquiring weather conditions and geographic information of the original search and rescue area and surrounding sea areas by using the remote sensing satellite; according to the weather conditions and the geographic information, a control console formulates a search and rescue task of the rainbow unmanned aerial vehicle; according to the search and rescue task, the rainbow unmanned aerial vehicle carries search and rescue equipment to search and rescue the rescue target; and identifying the rescue target by using the rainbow unmanned aerial vehicle, throwing rescue materials, and providing guidance for rescue staff to rescue the rescue target.
assignees: ZHONGKE HAIHUI BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent helmet system for post-disaster accident scene search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent helmet system for searching and rescuing on post-disaster accident scene, which comprises a personnel information acquisition module, an image information acquisition module, an equipment information acquisition module, a searching and rescuing acquisition module, an environment information acquisition module, a data processing module, a general control module and an information sending module; the personnel information acquisition module is used for acquiring personnel information of search and rescue personnel, wherein the personnel information comprises search and rescue time length information, human body basic information and personnel real-time position information; the image information acquisition module is used for acquiring real-time image information, and the equipment information acquisition module is used for acquiring equipment information; the environment information acquisition module is used for acquiring environment information of a search and rescue position, the search and rescue acquisition module is used for acquiring search and rescue information acquired by search and rescue equipment, and the search and rescue equipment comprises an acoustic wave detector, an optical acoustic wave detector and an infrared detector. The invention can better assist the search and rescue of the accident scene after the disaster, and better ensure the safety of search and rescue personnel.

title_en: Time planning method for collaborative search and rescue of helicopter and unmanned aerial vehicle in low-altitude environment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a time planning method for collaborative search and rescue of a helicopter and an unmanned aerial vehicle in a low-altitude environment, relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle track planning, and can optimize an address selection mode under the cooperation of a carrier helicopter and the unmanned aerial vehicle so as to reduce address selection cost. The invention comprises the following steps: acquiring site selection condition parameters, and establishing an unmanned aerial vehicle take-off and landing point site selection model in a collaborative search and rescue scene according to the site selection condition parameters; acquiring an address selection result of the unmanned aerial vehicle take-off and landing point by using the unmanned aerial vehicle take-off and landing point address selection model; obtaining subtasks corresponding to the address selection result through a task distribution model; and determining the task completion time of the unmanned aerial vehicle through the search and rescue time model. The invention is suitable for the collaborative search and rescue of the helicopter and the unmanned aerial vehicle in the low-altitude environment.

title_en: Post-disaster search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster search and rescue robot, wherein a power and control unit is arranged in a bearing platform, two binding belts can tightly bind two first-aid kits on the bearing platform, trapped personnel emergency articles are arranged in the first-aid kits, a camera is respectively arranged at the front end and the rear end of the bearing platform, a first leg mechanism is arranged at the front end of the lower side of the bearing platform and can move forwards and backwards and leftwards and rightwards, two ends of a first cross arm in the first leg mechanism are respectively bent forwards, two ends of a second leg mechanism are respectively arranged at the rear end of the lower side of the bearing platform and can move forwards and backwards and leftwards and rightwards, two ends of the second cross arm are respectively provided with a supporting leg which can move upwards and downwards and can be positioned, a front supporting leg mechanism is fixedly arranged at the front end of the bearing platform, a supporting leg which can move upwards and downwards and be positioned is structurally the same as the front supporting leg mechanism, and a rear supporting leg mechanism is fixedly arranged at the front end of the bearing platform.

title_en: Marine rescue method based on improved YOLOV < 4 > target detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses an offshore rescue method based on improved YOLOV < 4 > target detection, and belongs to the field of offshore rescue. The method comprises the steps that an image preprocessing (rain removing and defogging) method based on improved pixel-by-pixel filtering is used for processing images acquired by an unmanned aerial vehicle through an onboard high-definition camera, and a shot blurred image is converted into a clear image so as to provide effective data for subsequent image detection. The improved YOLOV-based target detection algorithm is used for accurately identifying people falling into water, and the characteristic pyramid converter (FPT) is used for improving the picture semantic extraction capability of small-size marine floaters (to-be-rescued people), so that the search and rescue success rate is improved. And a feature pyramid converter (FPT) is added after the traditional feature pyramid structure, so that the feature map of the semantic information of the small target is enhanced, and the detection of the small target object at sea is facilitated.

title_en: Remote light-driven micro soft robot and manufacturing and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote optical drive miniature soft robot and a manufacturing and control method thereof, which can be applied to non-structural operation environments such as environment monitoring, ruin search and rescue, medical diagnosis, military investigation and the like. The micro-soft robot mainly comprises micro-nano column supporting legs, wherein the movement of the micro-soft robot is determined by the micro-nano column supporting legs and the interaction of the micro-nano column supporting legs and the environment in which the micro-soft robot is positioned, and under the irradiation of infrared light with a certain frequency, a silicon rubber driving part doped with infrared absorption materials responds to the stimulation of external infrared light and converts the infrared light into heat, so that the silicon rubber is promoted to expand and shrink, and driving force is provided for the soft robot. The miniature soft robot has a simple structure, is not limited by the traditional mechanical structure, and can realize safe, effective and stable movement under the drive of remote light.

title_en: Anti-interference safety control method for variable-configuration unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-interference safety control method of a variable-configuration unmanned aerial vehicle, which relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle control and aims to solve the problems of influence of moment interference caused by deviation of a pneumatic center and a mass center when the variable-configuration unmanned aerial vehicle flies at a large inclination angle and compliance control during collision. The invention can realize decoupling flight of position and attitude movement, and comprises the steps of designing a dynamic control distribution strategy according to an unmanned aerial vehicle power distribution structure, taking steering engine servo as a part of control distribution, and reducing the difficulty of solving a control distribution matrix; according to the theory of the time domain disturbance observer, a moment disturbance observer is designed, and disturbance estimation is compensated into a controller to improve control precision; and compensating the output of the admittance controller into a gesture instruction, and guiding the unmanned aerial vehicle to adaptively adjust the gesture during collision. The invention has good real-time performance and high control efficiency, can reduce attitude tracking errors, relieves continuous collision in flight, and is suitable for tasks such as search and rescue in narrow buildings after disaster.

title_en: Alarm device of search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of alarm devices, and particularly relates to an alarm device of a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein one end of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is provided with a camera for aerial photographing, the middle part of the lower surface of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is fixedly provided with a prompt alarm, the prompt alarm comprises a hemispherical alarm shell, the output end of a side motor is fixedly provided with a laser lamp for irradiating a rescue point, and one side of the alarm shell is fixedly provided with a powder throwing device for displaying an irradiation light path of the laser lamp. The utility model can enable the search and rescue personnel to quickly find the position of the trapped person, reduce the search time of the search and rescue personnel on the ground as much as possible, and simultaneously facilitate the search and rescue personnel to quickly make rescue measures by combining the specific position of the trapped person and the nearby accident environment.

title_en: Multifunctional rescue robot based on visual recognition
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional rescue robot based on visual identification, wherein a crushing device, mechanical grabbing equipment and a material conveying device are fixedly connected with a vehicle body and are positioned above the vehicle body, the material conveying device is fixedly connected with the mechanical grabbing equipment, two ends of a visual inertia slam system are respectively fixedly connected with the material conveying device and the mechanical grabbing equipment and are positioned above the material conveying device and the mechanical grabbing equipment, trapped personnel are identified and reported to a trapped position through the visual inertia slam system, the crushing device breaks and removes obstacles such as ruins, the crushing device can horizontally move and rotate as required, the material conveying device provides timely rescue materials for the trapped personnel, and the mechanical grabbing equipment grabs wounded personnel. The rescue robot provided by the utility model is convenient to operate, flexible to apply, and capable of improving the timeliness of rescue and reducing the operation intensity of operators.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system capable of being rapidly laid on water surface
abstract_en: The utility model provides an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system capable of being rapidly arranged on a water surface, which comprises a transmitter and an unmanned aerial vehicle formation, wherein the transmitter comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle platform cabin section, an air bag platform cabin section and a boosting section, an air bag group is arranged in the air bag platform cabin section, the unmanned aerial vehicle platform cabin section comprises a cabin flap group, when the unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system is in a flight state, the air bag group is not inflated, the cabin flap group is folded, and the unmanned aerial vehicle formation is positioned in the cabin flap group; when the unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system is in a water surface undeployed state, the air bag group is inflated to form a floating plane, and the cabin flap group is in a folded state; when unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue system is in the surface of water expansion state, cabin lamella group expands and forms a plurality of cabin lamella, is the horizontality and sets up on the gasbag group, unmanned aerial vehicle formation takes on the cabin lamella of horizontal setting this moment. The utility model sets the air bag group to form a floating plane by inflation, and can realize rapid arrangement on the water surface, thereby independently completing sea search and rescue within hundreds of square kilometers.

title_en: System and method for detecting rescuer based on drone image
title_ko: 드론 영상 기반의 구조대상자 탐지 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a system and method for detecting a rescuee based on a drone image. A rescuee detection apparatus based on a drone image that detects a rescuee in the drone image comprises: a learning data collection unit which collects learning data according to at least one type for detecting the rescuee; a detection model generation unit which learns the collected learning data to generate a rescuee detection model; and a rescuee detection unit which detects the rescuee in the drone image by separating a background color from the drone image and inputting the background color-separated image to the rescuee detection model. Therefore, the present invention may provide a more accurate and fast lifesaving system by overcoming the limitation of an existing system that manually identifies a missing person or sufferer, thereby securing a golden time to save life.
abstract_ko: 드론 영상 기반의 구조대상자 탐지 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명은 드론 영상 내에서 구조대상자를 탐지하는 드론 영상 기반의 구조대상자 탐지 장치로서, 상기 구조대상자를 탐지하기 위해 적어도 하나 이상의 유형에 따른 학습데이터를 수집하는 학습데이터 수집부, 상기 수집된 학습데이터를 학습하여 구조대상자 탐지 모델을 생성하는 구조대상자 탐지 모델 생성부 및 상기 드론 영상으로부터 배경색을 분리하고, 상기 배경색이 분리된 영상을 상기 구조대상자 탐지 모델에 입력하여 상기 드론 영상 내에서 구조대상자를 탐지하는 구조대상자 탐지부를 포함한다. 따라서, 상술한 본 발명에 따르면, 종래의 수동으로 실종자 혹은 조난자를 인식하는 것의 한계를 극복한, 보다 정확하고 빠른 인명구조 시스템을 제공할 수 있어 인명구조 상황에서의 골든 타임을 확보할 수 있다.

title_en: Multifunctional rescue robot based on visual recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional rescue robot based on visual identification, wherein a crushing device, mechanical grabbing equipment and a material conveying device are fixedly connected with a vehicle body and are positioned above the vehicle body, the material conveying device is fixedly connected with the mechanical grabbing equipment, two ends of a visual inertia slam system are respectively fixedly connected with the material conveying device and the mechanical grabbing equipment and are positioned above the material conveying device and the mechanical grabbing equipment, trapped personnel are identified and reported to a trapped position through the visual inertia slam system, the crushing device breaks and removes obstacles such as ruins, the crushing device can horizontally move and rotate as required, the material conveying device provides timely rescue materials for the trapped personnel, and the mechanical grabbing equipment grabs wounded personnel. The rescue robot provided by the invention is convenient to operate, flexible to apply, and capable of improving the timeliness of rescue and reducing the operation intensity of operators.

title_en: Snakelike rescue robot adapting to complex post-disaster topography
abstract_en: The invention discloses a snake-shaped rescue robot adapting to complex post-disaster terrains, which comprises: a snake head and a plurality of independent cabin sections which are connected in sequence; detecting the number of cabin sections; after the head processor obtains the angle theta 1 and the speed V1 of the current snake head, the numerical values of dtheta 2 and theta 11 are calculated, l is the length of the cabin section, if there is no next cabin section, returning, if there is, transferring dθ2 into the second cabin section, then the second cabin section continuously obtains the own angle θ2 and speed V2, calculates dθ3 and θ21, acquiring the angle and the speed of the second cabin section to be adjusted, and so on, acquiring the angle and the speed of each cabin section to be adjusted; and transmitting the control instruction to the corresponding cabin section to realize the control of the movement of the whole snake. The invention provides a post-disaster adaptive method for complex disasterThe serpentine rescue robot solves the technical problems that the existing serpentine rescue robot changes the structure of the serpentine rescue robot according to task requirements and has poor applicability and expansibility.

title_en: Life rescue robot system
title_ko: 구조 로봇 시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a life rescue robot system for accurately recognizing sound generated by a rescue object to identify the location of the rescue object and rescue the rescue object. Disclosed is a life rescue robot system comprising: a sound recognition unit for generating sound information using the voice recognized by a sound recognition sensor; an analysis unit for analyzing the sound information to determine whether an object of the sound information is a rescue object; a scanning unit for generating scan information by scanning the surroundings; and a direction calculation unit for setting a movement path to where the sound information is generated from the current location information and modifying the movement path according to the scan information.
abstract_ko: 소리인식센서로부터 인식되는 음성을 이용하여 소리정보를 생성하는 소리인식부, 상기 소리정보를 분석하여 상기 소리정보의 대상이 구조대상체 인지를 파악하는 분석부, 상기 주변을 스캔한 스캔정보를 생성하는 스캔부 및 현재의 위치정보에서 상기 소리정보가 발생된 방향으로 이동경로를 설정하며 상기 스캔정보에 따라 상기 이동경로를 수정하는 방향연산부를 포함하는 구조 로봇 시스템이 개시된다.

title_en: Multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle control system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle control system which comprises a central processing module, wherein an output end and an input end of the central processing module are respectively and bidirectionally electrically connected with an information acquisition module, a GPS positioning module, an environment monitoring module, an information storage module, an information conversion module, a search and rescue module and a body detection module. The utility model adopts the machine body detection module, the flight driving module, the automatic cruising module, the temperature monitoring module, the humidity monitoring module, the air monitoring module, the illumination monitoring module, the wind speed monitoring module, the lighting module, the ultrasonic detection module and the terrain shooting module, is convenient for coping with the influence of external factors, and is convenient for the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly.
assignees: JIANGSU JINYINGXIONG AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Bionic mantis rescue robot
abstract_en: A bionic mantis rescue robot is characterized in that the head of the bionic mantis rescue robot is arranged at the front end of the abdomen through a neck; the left forelimb and the right forelimb are mirror symmetrically arranged at two sides of the neck; the left middle limb and the right middle limb are mirror symmetrically arranged at two sides of the front end of the abdomen; the left hind limb and the right hind limb are mirror-symmetrically arranged at two sides of the rear end of the abdomen; the head comprises a head skeleton, a camera, a searchlight and an article clamping device; the camera is fixedly arranged at the front end of the head framework; the searchlight is fixedly arranged at the front end of the head framework and positioned at two sides of the camera; the article clamping device is positioned below the camera and arranged on the head framework; the inside of the abdomen shell is provided with a wireless intercom. The robot disclosed by the utility model can move in a slit space of a building ruin, help rescue workers to determine the trapped position of a survivor at the first time, can establish voice communication between the survivor and a rescuer, and simultaneously can synchronously carry life maintenance materials to the survivor at the trapped position, so that the survival probability of the survivor in the waiting rescue process is improved.

title_en: Fireproof rescue type search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicles, and discloses a fireproof rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein a connecting plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the middle of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, storage grooves are symmetrically formed in the front side and the rear side of the surface of the connecting plate, a rotary screw is movably arranged in the storage grooves, and the surface of the rotary screw is in threaded connection with a telescopic rod. According to the utility model, through the cooperation of structures such as the half-tooth gear, the full-tooth gear, the hinge block and the like, the right end of the hinge rod moves to the right side, so that the sliding block is driven to overcome the elasticity of the top spring to move to the right side, and after half of rotation, the tooth slot of the half-tooth gear is separated from the full-tooth gear, namely the top spring loses constraint, the top spring finally ejects the sliding block to the left side, so that the breaking rod rapidly extends out, thereby impacting the surface of glass, achieving the effect of breaking the surface by points, breaking the glass, and facilitating entry.
assignees: CHENGDE JIUSHENG EMERGENCY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric automobile battery fire extinguishing system based on high-pressure water jet cutting
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric automobile battery fire extinguishing system based on high-pressure water jet cutting, which comprises an extinguishing management background, a plurality of front-end detection devices positioned in a detection area and a plurality of firefighting rescue robots provided with high-pressure water jet cutting devices and control modules. According to the invention, when a fire disaster occurs, the position of the electric automobile and the position information of the battery can be quickly positioned, the fire rescue robot is controlled to carry the high-pressure water jet cutting device to go forward, the high-pressure water jet cutting device is used for directly cutting and breaking the power battery part of the electric automobile, the electric conductivity of the high-pressure water jet is utilized for quickly discharging the energy of the electric automobile battery, the fire extinguishing agent with large specific heat capacity such as water is utilized to enter the power battery pack to quickly cool the battery, and the chemical reaction of the battery is blocked, so that quick fire extinguishing is realized, the latest idle fire rescue robot can be searched for distributing a fire-fighting task, and the time consumed by the robot to reach a fire-fighting destination is saved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle searching and positioning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle searching and positioning method and system, relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle application, and aims to solve the problem that manual rescue is inconvenient in a special field environment. The method comprises the steps of making unmanned aerial vehicle flight mission planning for a selected suspicious target area based on flight geographic environment information, and acquiring images of the suspicious target area based on a target detection algorithm after the unmanned aerial vehicle reaches the suspicious target area; constructing a local map according to the received image information, and marking suspicious target positions in the local map; and according to the spatial distance between the suspicious target position and the target position, the unmanned aerial vehicle is selected to perform high-resolution confirmation and tracking tasks on the suspicious target position. The method and the system provided by the invention can realize the positioning and confirmation of the suspicious target in the complex environment, provide favorable and reliable target information for ground rescue personnel to perform actions, are more accurate and more efficient compared with the search and rescue of a manual search unmanned aerial vehicle, and have high practicability.

title_en: A drone system to search and locate missing persons using mobile signals
title_ko: 모바일 신호를 이용하여 실종자 탐색 및 측위가 가능한 드론 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a drone system capable of searching and locating missing people using mobile signals. According to the present invention, the drone system comprises: a plurality of base stations installed on the ground to establish a wireless communication network to transmit and receive mobile signals on a cell basis; a terminal configured to transmit and receive mobile signals in conjunction with the wireless communication network of the base station; and a drone which is designed to enable autonomous driving in areas where GPS is unavailable by using the mobile signal from the base station and can search for or measure the location of a missing person carrying the terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 모바일 신호를 이용하여 실종자 탐색 및 측위가 가능한 드론 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 지상에 설치되어 셀 단위로 모바일 신호를 송수신할 수 있도록 무선통신망을 구축하는 다수 개의 기지국과, 상기 기지국의 무선통신망과 연동되어 모바일 신호를 송수신할 수 있도록 형성되는 단말기와, GPS 사용불가지역에서 상기 기지국의 모바일 신호를 이용하여 자율주행이 가능하도록 형성되며 상기 단말기를 소지한 실종자를 탐색하거나 위치를 측정할 수 있도록 형성되는 드론을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KUMOH NAT INST TECHNOLOGY IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rescue equipment field provides a rescue robot, include: the mobile chassis is used for carrying out movement and rotation; a machine body mounted on the moving chassis; the window breaker launching device is arranged on the machine main body and is used for launching the window breaker to break a window or a door; and the camera is arranged on the machine body and used for image recognition. In the scene that some people can not stay outside for a long time, the robot goes forward to carry out window breaking or door breaking operation in advance, so that the risk of long-term exposure of the people can be reduced, explosion risks possibly exist in some fields of fire extinguishment and disaster relief, and the robot goes forward to operate, so that the personnel can be prevented from facing dangers. Meanwhile, the rescue rope can be thrown accurately by a mode of carrying the rescue rope by launching the window breaker, so that the rescue speed is increased.

title_en: Carrier carrying rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carrier for carrying a rescue robot, which comprises a vehicle body, a console and a storage cabinet, wherein wheels are arranged on the bottom surface of the vehicle body, the storage cabinet comprises a vertical plate and a ground placing box, the vertical plate is vertically arranged on the bottom surface of the vehicle body in a telescopic manner, the vertical plate can extend to be flush with the bottom surface of the wheels, and the vertical plate is driven by a motor to extend up and down. The ground placing box is connected to the extending end of the vertical plate in a turnover mode and is driven by the motor to turn over up and down. The ground placing box is internally provided with a box cavity, a robot is stored in the box cavity, the box cavity is provided with a cover opening, the cover opening is arranged on the ground placing box in a horizontal placing state, the edge of the cover opening is connected with a box cover in an overturning manner, and the box cover is driven by a motor to overturn up and down. The control cabinet is arranged on the vehicle body, and the vertical plate, the ground placing box and the box cover are respectively and electrically connected with the control cabinet. The robot is convenient to carry, discharge and retract after the robot goes to a disaster area, and damage caused by collision of the robot is prevented.

title_en: Diameter-variable interactive vertical well rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an interactive vertical well rescue robot of variable diameter, comprising a main body, including reducing system, stall protection system, track system, locking system, rescue interactive system in the main part, the main part is hollow shell structure, along the axial circumference of main part offers the passageway that link up that is used for holding installation track system, the fixed convex annular inner wall that is equipped with on the upper end inner wall of main part, through bolt fixed connection trailer box frame on the annular inner wall, bolt fixed stall protection system is passed through to the top of trailer box frame, the fixed reducing system that is provided with in below of trailer box frame, the reducing system is fixed in through the spiral shell dress mode on being provided with the location baffle on the main part inner wall, the utility model discloses increase the compound elastic construction in the track system on the basis of adopting cam reducing system, can adapt to the complicated uneven wall of a well, also guaranteed the sufficient frictional holding power of whole needs.

title_en: Modularized rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a modularized rescue robot, which relates to the field of rescue robots and solves the problems that the existing rescue and detection robots are complex in type, various devices are combined together by no integral system to realize modularized multipurpose application, and the modularized rescue robot comprises a trolley base, a control module, a mounting base, a mounting plate, rescue devices, a limiting mounting groove, a sliding seat, a traveling module, a servo motor, a screw rod, a three-way hinging seat, a first rotating rod, a pressing plate and a guide sliding rod, wherein the pressing plate is sleeved on the outer side of the guide sliding rod and is matched and pressed with the sliding seat, side plates are arranged on the left side and the right side of the upper end face of the control module, and a clamping mechanism for clamping the mounting base is arranged between the side plates on the two sides. The device has the characteristics of being capable of flexibly modularized, being good in universality and suitable for more subtended terrains and disaster occurrence environments, and replacing the rescue module and the walking module.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device and search and rescue method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device and a search and rescue method thereof, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, lift-off mechanisms are arranged on two corresponding sides of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a signal transmission antenna is fixedly arranged at the top of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, two bottom stabilizing frames are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, an adjusting mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body and between the two bottom stabilizing frames, and a monitoring mechanism is arranged on one side of the adjusting mechanism, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device has the beneficial effects that: this unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device and search and rescue method thereof sets up the coordinate thing that can throw in through the inside at unmanned aerial vehicle to can carry out further position location to group's coordinate after searching by the searcher, can collect by the basic information of searcher according to the in-service behavior, thereby further improvement search and rescue's effect when taking place extensive calamity, and promote search and rescue efficiency, make the completion that search and rescue work can be as early as possible.
assignees: ZHENJIANG RUISEN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban flood rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban flood rescue robot, which at least comprises a ship body part capable of moving on the water surface and an ejection part for ejecting a rescue net to a rescue object; the ejection part comprises an ejection box body, an ejection pipe, a node, a warhead ejection mechanism and an ejection triggering mechanism; the warhead ejection mechanism comprises an ejection spring, a warhead connecting rope, a cam steering engine, a wire winding motor, a clutch and a wire winding shaft I; the ejection triggering mechanism comprises a transverse tube, a clip spring, a clip connecting rope and a triggering steering engine; when rescue is carried out, the ejection triggering mechanism releases locking of the warhead, and the warhead impacts the node under the action of the ejection spring, so that the node carries the rescue net to pop up to the rescue object, the rescue object floats above the water surface by using the rescue net, and further a rescue task is completed.

title_en: Robot search and rescue method based on offline reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot search and rescue method based on offline reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a robot control system consisting of a server node and a robot node, wherein the server node is provided with a first storage module, a first model module, a first track module, a first strategy module, a second track module and a second strategy module; the robot node is provided with a detection module, a motion module and a calculation module. The first model module trains a deep probabilistic neural network using the D4RL dataset and integrates into an environmental dynamics model. The first track module and the second track module respectively use an environmental dynamics model to construct O-MDP and P-MDP. Training the first strategy module under the O-MDP, and training the second strategy module under the P-MDP to obtain the robot search and rescue strategy. And the robot node executes the search and rescue task according to the search and rescue strategy. The invention can complete the search and rescue task under the condition of limited quantity and low quality of the offline data sets.

title_en: 5G network-based field search and rescue system
abstract_en: The application provides a 5G network-based field search and rescue system, which comprises a 5G terminal, flight equipment and a 5G base station; the flight equipment is used for carrying the 5G base station; a 5G base station for transmitting a paging signal; the 5G terminal is used for initiating a registration request to the 5G base station when receiving the paging signal; and the 5G base station is used for responding to the registration request, acquiring the position information of the 5G terminal after the registration of the 5G terminal is completed, and reporting the position information of the 5G terminal to the positioning system. The unmanned aerial vehicle or the helicopter carries the portable 5G base station to patrol at low altitude, after the 5G terminal to be rescued searches for the network and is accessed to the 5G network through the 5G base station, the 5G base station acquires the position of the 5G terminal, and the position information of the 5G terminal is transmitted back to the positioning system in real time, so that the 5G terminal can be searched and accessed to the 5G network in an area without network coverage, the 5G terminal to be rescued can be positioned quickly, and the outdoor quick search and rescue can be realized.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device based on thing networking
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device based on the Internet of things, which comprises a cylindrical body, wherein four struts are fixedly connected to the outer wall of the body, one end of each strut, which is far away from the body, is fixedly connected with a driving seat, a rotor is fixedly connected to a rotating shaft of each driving seat, the bottom of the body is fixedly connected with a plurality of landing legs, a front camera is fixedly arranged on the outer wall of the front side of the body, and a search mechanism is arranged in the body. The invention is provided with the searching camera which is specially used for searching trapped people, the shooting direction and the shooting angle of the searching camera are changed in the searching and rescuing process, the shooting range of the searching camera is increased, the searching and rescuing efficiency is improved, when the trapped people on the ground are found, no one can position himself to the adjacent ground searching and rescuing people through the Internet of things, so that the searching and rescuing people can know the trapped information of the trapped people at the first time and can rescue the trapped people to the trapped place.

title_en: AIS-based field rescue system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AIS-based field rescue system, which comprises a distress signal transmitting device for carrying out distress and survival when the field is in distress, an AIS search and rescue transmitting device for transmitting distress signals and position information, and an unmanned aerial vehicle searching unit used by search and rescue personnel and used for retrieving the distress signals, wherein the distress signal transmitting device comprises a light-emitting balloon mechanism, a power supply mechanism, an upper section cylinder part and a middle section cylinder part arranged at the bottom of the upper section cylinder part, the AIS search and rescue transmitting device is arranged on the light-emitting balloon mechanism, and the light-emitting balloon mechanism comprises an inflatable balloon, an air inlet nozzle, an inflatable needle, a string, an inflator pump, a needle connector and a helium tank body; according to the invention, rescue workers can quickly find out the people in distress and rescue the people in distress through the self-contained positioning signal transmitter, and on the other hand, the rescue workers can find out the people in distress more easily in the search and rescue process through the balloon distress signal marker with the LED luminous body.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue path planning method based on tabu bee colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue path planning method based on a tabu-swarm algorithm, which comprises the steps of initializing task information, constructing a search and rescue target model and an objective function from rescue requirements and environmental characteristics, initializing constraint condition information, determining resource constraint and environmental constraint in a path planning process, constructing a constraint description model, analyzing various types of information involved in the unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue process, constructing a corresponding capacity description model, carrying out preliminary planning on the unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue path according to the task information and the constraint condition information, generating a preliminary search and rescue plan, and carrying out iterative updating on the preliminary search and rescue plan by utilizing the objective function and combining the tabu search and the swarm algorithm until an optimized planning scheme is output. The tabu-based swarm algorithm of the method provided by the invention improves the exploration capacity and convergence speed of the algorithm, and realizes the efficient solution of large-scale and complex maritime search and rescue path planning problems.

title_en: Fire alarm and linkage rescue method and device for energy storage and conversion station based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire alarm and linkage rescue method and device for a storage transduction station based on the Internet of things, and belongs to the technical field of the Internet of things. The method comprises the steps of carrying out fuzzification processing on sensor signals of an area to be detected in a storage transduction station to obtain target sensor signals, carrying out reasoning on the target sensor signals through a preset fuzzy neural network system to obtain fire occurrence probability, determining estimated fire bursting degree according to an area image of the area to be detected when the fire occurrence probability exceeds a safety probability threshold value, sending an alarm signal to a cloud monitoring platform, and uploading the estimated fire bursting degree to the cloud monitoring platform; and finally, carrying out fire rescue on the area to be detected based on a rescue request through the fire rescue robot system, accurately detecting the fire condition in the energy storage and conversion station, and timely carrying out fire alarm, and simultaneously carrying out timely rescue through the fire rescue robot system, thereby greatly reducing the property loss and casualties of the energy storage and conversion station.
assignees: SHENZHEN YINTE SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Reconfigurable robot and deformation mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reconfigurable robot and a deformation mechanism, which comprise a robot body, a universal cradle head, a body driving wheel, a tensioning wheel, a supporting wheel, a rear swing arm driven wheel, a rear swing arm driving motor, a front swing arm deflection wheel and a front swing arm deflection wheel, wherein the robot body comprises a robot shell, the robot shell is connected with a control module in a bidirectional communication mode, the body driving wheel is sleeved on a driving wheel shaft, the tensioning wheel and the supporting wheel are respectively positioned at the upper and lower intersection points of a connecting rod, the rear swing arm driven wheel and the rear swing arm driving motor are rotatably arranged at two ends of a rear swing arm, and the front swing arm deflection wheel is connected with the connecting shaft. The reconfigurable robot and the deformation mechanism utilize the adjustment of the front swing arm and the rear swing arm, so that the robot can adjust the motion gesture according to the field condition, adapt to complex field environment, and adopt the modularized structural design, so that the universal cradle head, the control module and the swing arm structure can quickly form the small search and rescue robot.

title_en: Wheeled bipedal robot and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wheeled bipedal robot and a control method thereof, belongs to the technical field of bipedal wheeled leg robots, and solves the technical problems that the bipedal wheeled leg robot in the prior art is short in continuous working time, single in action, low in moving efficiency and incapable of adapting to complex environments. The device comprises a trunk part, a walking part and a working part, wherein the walking part and the working part are respectively connected with the trunk part; the trunk part comprises a pair of middle plates, and a plurality of support rods are arranged between the middle plates; a battery assembly, a driver assembly, an encoder assembly and a main control assembly are respectively arranged between the pair of middle plates; the walking part comprises a driving leg, a driven leg and a shank; the operation portion includes the base, the base set up in the lower part of trunk portion, be provided with calliper subassembly on the base. The wheel type biped robot and the control method thereof can be better used for scientific research, medical equipment, logistics transportation, environmental exploration, disaster area search and rescue and other works, and have good stability and strong adaptability.

title_en: Water falling person identification method, system and medium based on water searching and rescuing unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water falling person identification method, a system and a medium based on an overwater search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which belong to the field of overwater search and rescue and comprise a training stage, wherein a training set is adopted to train a water falling person identification network, training samples in the training set are public picture data of past water falling persons, and labels are position information of the water falling persons; the water falling person identification network is an improved YOLOv network and comprises a framework, a neck and a detection head, the feature fusion module comprises a downsampling operation, a splicing operation and a 1*1 convolution operation, and the application stage comprises the steps of inputting a sample to be detected into the trained water falling person identification network to obtain position information of the water falling person. And a corresponding data enhancement processing mode and a mode for filtering unreasonable detection results are also provided. The invention can improve the accuracy and speed of identifying the person falling into water, is favorable for rapidly and accurately completing search and rescue work, improves the survival probability of the person falling into water, and reduces the loss of life and property.

title_en: Self-adaptive pipeline diameter rescue robot and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-adaptive pipeline diameter rescue robot and a use method thereof, wherein the self-adaptive pipeline diameter rescue robot comprises a main body box, and walking mechanisms for driving the robot to walk are respectively supported and installed at bottom corner parts of two sides of the main body box; upper supporting leg mechanisms for being in contact fit with the pipeline are respectively supported and arranged at the top corner parts of the two sides of the main body box; a plurality of groups of mechanical arms for scooping up the personnel to be rescued are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the main body box, and a spade-shaped gripper is arranged at the tail end of each mechanical arm. The robot can be well applied to deep wells and mining pipeline rescue, can effectively solve the problem that the pipeline is too narrow and can not contain rescue personnel to rescue trapped personnel, or the situation that the trapped personnel has no vital signs and is in life-threatening emergency, can rapidly rescue the personnel, and ensures the personal safety of the trapped personnel.

title_en: Search and rescue robot with monitoring function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue robot with a monitoring function, which relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots, and aims at solving the problems that dust is easy to adhere to a monitoring probe and the observation under a mine is influenced due to the severe environment under the mine, and the utility model provides the following scheme that: the search and rescue robot comprises a search and rescue robot body, wherein a monitoring camera is fixedly arranged on the search and rescue robot body, and a protective cover is fixedly arranged on the search and rescue robot body; the motor is fixedly arranged on the protective cover, and a reciprocating screw rod is fixedly connected to an output shaft of the motor. The utility model can conveniently observe the environment under the mine through the monitoring camera, can play a role in protecting the monitoring camera through the protective cover, can conveniently wipe the lens of the monitoring camera, and can prevent dust from being stained on the lens of the monitoring camera to influence the observation of the environment under the mine by search and rescue personnel outside the mine.

title_en: Intelligent detection disaster relief vehicle and combined disaster relief method thereof
abstract_en: The intelligent detection disaster relief vehicle and the combined disaster relief method thereof comprise a traveling mechanism and a detection mechanism positioned on the traveling mechanism, wherein the detection mechanism comprises an explosion-proof vehicle body, a controller is arranged in the explosion-proof vehicle body, the controller is connected with a Beidou positioning module and a disaster relief vehicle storage battery, the disaster relief vehicle storage battery is connected with a first charging interface of the unmanned aerial vehicle through a wire, and the first charging interface is positioned at the top of the explosion-proof vehicle body; the controller is in communication connection with the control center; ultrasonic probes are arranged on the front side and the rear side of the detection mechanism, and are connected with the controller. When the disaster relief is combined, the disaster relief area is firstly divided, then the intelligent detection and relief vehicle is used for detection, the unmanned aerial vehicle disaster relief area is secondarily determined, and finally the disaster relief is combined. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the unmanned aerial vehicle is used for carrying out combined disaster relief, so that the efficiency is improved; the unmanned aerial vehicle does not need to consider the flight distance, and can realize remote charging in the rescue area; the mobility and the carrying and breaking capacity are strong, and the search and rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Augmented reality-based indoor disaster monitoring system
title_ko: 증강현실 기반 실내 재난 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide an augmented reality-based indoor disaster monitoring system for supporting rescue and firefighting activities of firefighters in the event of an indoor disaster. An augmented reality-based indoor disaster monitoring system is disclosed. The augmented reality-based indoor disaster monitoring system comprises: a plurality of beacons which are arranged indoors at preset intervals and measure and transmit the reception signal strength of Bluetooth signals transmitted by nearby Bluetooth devices; a plurality of CCTV cameras which are arranged indoors at preset intervals and acquire CCTV videos by filming locations where the CCTV cameras are located; an augmented reality helmet which is worn by a firefighter deployed indoors where a disaster has occurred and provides information to the firefighter; a search robot which is deployed indoors where a disaster has occurred, acquires indoor videos to search for rescuers, and transmits the acquired indoor videos in real time; and a management server which determines locations of firefighters and rescuers using the reception signal strength, transmits location information about the locations of firefighters and rescuers to the augmented reality helmet, analyzes the CCTV videos and indoor videos to determine the presence or absence of the rescuers, and transmits the location information of the rescuers to the augmented reality helmet.
abstract_ko: 증강현실 기반 실내 재난 모니터링 시스템이 개시된다. 증강현실 기반 실내 재난 모니터링 시스템은, 실내에 미리 설정된 간격을 두고 배치되며, 주변에서 블루투스 기기가 송출하는 블루투스 신호의 수신신호세기를 측정하여 전송하는 복수의 비콘, 실내에 미리 설정된 간격을 두고 배치되며, 배치된 장소를 촬영하여 CCTV 영상을 획득하는 복수의 CCTV 카메라, 재난이 발생한 실내에 투입되는 소방관이 착용하며, 소방관에게 정보를 제공하는 증강현실 헬멧, 재난이 발생한 실내에 투입되어, 요구조자를 수색하기 위하여 실내 영상을 획득하고, 획득된 실내 영상을 실시간 전송하는 수색 로봇 및 수신신호세기를 이용하여 소방관 및 요구조자의 위치를 파악하여 소방관 및 요구조자의 위치 정보를 증강현실 헬멧으로 전송하고, CCTV 영상 및 실내 영상을 분석하여 요구조자의 존재 여부를 판별하고, 요구조자가 존재하는 위치 정보를 증강현실 헬멧으로 전송하는 관리 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Antifog and dustproof thermal infrared imager for fire rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anti-fog and dustproof infrared thermal imager for fire rescue, which relates to the technical field of fire rescue and comprises a main body, a connecting rod and a bottom bracket shell, wherein main straps are fixedly connected to the outer walls of the left side and the right side of the main body. The anti-fog and dustproof thermal infrared imager for fire rescue receives a thermal image transmitted by a host body in real time through an image receiving module, extracts temperature information of the thermal image and area information of each temperature value through an information extracting module, judges whether trapped personnel exist in the thermal image through a temperature judging module and an area judging module, can control a navigation assembly to be started through a navigation module, guides rescue personnel to go to the position of the trapped personnel, can automatically identify and search the position of the trapped personnel, guides the rescue personnel to go to the position, enables the rescue personnel to better develop search and rescue work on a rescue site with low visibility, reduces influence caused by direction sensing variation, and is not easy to deviate from the direction in the search and rescue process.

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle convenient for putting in materials
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle convenient for putting in materials, and particularly relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. According to the utility model, the motor works to drive the positive and negative screw rods to rotate, the positive and negative screw rods drive the two threaded sleeves to move in opposite directions, so that the two connecting plates are driven to move in opposite directions, the two cutting knives cut off the hanging rope, the motor reversely rotates to drive the two cutting knives to move in opposite directions, the structure is simple, the hanging rope is cut off quickly, and life-saving articles can be thrown out of the unmanned aerial vehicle body quickly, so that the use effect is good.

title_en: Comprehensive fire rescue robot for transformer substation
abstract_en: The utility model provides a transformer substation comprehensive fire rescue robot, which comprises: the upper computer and the fire-fighting robot; the singlechip receives a walking path sent by the upper computer through the wireless communication module, acquires current position information through the positioner, and controls the motor driving module to drive the motor and the wheels to run according to the walking path preset by the upper computer, so that the fire-fighting robot walks according to the preset walking path; when the equipment temperature information exceeds a preset first equipment temperature threshold value, the singlechip controls the control valve to be opened, and the extinguishing agent is sprayed to the area where the equipment temperature information exceeds the threshold value to extinguish the fire; the fire extinguishing device is used for rapidly extinguishing the sudden fire, controlling the spread of the initial fire, and winning time for rescue work. The system enhances early fire prevention and suppression, and more effectively improves the fire safety condition of the transformer substation.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle communication connection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle communication connection system, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. The system comprises an information transmission module, an audio and video transmission module, a cruising recording module and a ground station, wherein the information transmission module is used for carrying out communication connection between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the ground station, the audio and video transmission module is used for carrying out bidirectional voice signal transmission between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the ground station, the cruising recording module is used for recording a cruising route so as to automatically cruise on a route for multiple search and rescue rescuing, the information transmission module, the audio and video transmission module and the cruising recording module are all electrically connected, and the ground station is in signal connection with the information transmission module, the audio and video transmission module and the cruising recording module through a data transmission radio station. The invention sets up the information transmission module, make except the furthest unmanned aerial vehicle of ground station, the transfer station that the surplus unmanned aerial vehicle can all act as signal transmission, make all unmanned aerial vehicle gathered audio and video signal can be transmitted to the ground station, have not merely expanded the communication connection scope of unmanned aerial vehicle, have guaranteed the stability of signal transmission, have improved the convenience of field search and rescue.
assignees: CHENGDU XINGJI YUANHANG COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent scheduling auxiliary decision-making platform for autonomous driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent scheduling auxiliary decision-making platform for autonomous driving, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aircrafts. The unmanned aerial vehicle comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle with two acquisition systems, namely real-time transmission and recording, a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle with a search and rescue device, a geographic database established according to acquisition information, a communication station for receiving acquisition data and an unmanned aerial vehicle database established according to unmanned aerial vehicle characteristics. According to the invention, the geographic database is established, the unmanned aerial vehicle is utilized to periodically collect and input geographic information, and the geographic information can be directly called when a disaster occurs, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can be searched and rescuing to divide an autonomous driving area, and the overall search and rescue efficiency is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN XIYUE WISDOM DATA CO LTD

title_en: High-rise fire rescue unmanned aerial vehicle system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-rise firefighting rescue unmanned aerial vehicle system, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle application. The high-rise firefighting rescue unmanned aerial vehicle system comprises: unmanned aerial vehicle body, fire detection module, communication relay module, integrated control module, material transport module, personnel search and rescue module and fire suppression module. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle is provided with the smoke clearing function, a visual field is opened up for rescue workers and trapped workers, the unmanned aerial vehicle and the rescue workers are helped to quickly find the fire points and the trapped workers, the rescue efficiency is effectively improved, the lung injury probability of the rescue workers and the trapped workers is reduced, when the fire is spread and expanded, the fire truck water pipe is connected with the water pipe connection port, the unmanned aerial vehicle is controlled to enter a fire house through the control station, the adjustable rotary spray head is controlled to spray fire for the fire house indiscriminately, the delivery water quantity of the unmanned aerial vehicle is improved, and the fire extinguishing rate and safety are ensured.
assignees: SHANDONG LONGYI AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The application discloses a fire rescue robot, which comprises a movable base, a box body and a spraying mechanism, wherein the movable base comprises a base body, a driving wheel assembly and a walking wheel assembly, the driving wheel assembly and the walking wheel assembly are respectively arranged on the lower end face of the base body, the box body is arranged on the upper end face of the base body, the spraying mechanism comprises a fire-fighting foam spraying assembly and a fire-fighting water spraying assembly, and further comprises a front anti-collision assembly and a rear anti-collision assembly, the front anti-collision assembly is arranged on the front side face of the base body, and the rear anti-collision assembly is arranged on the rear side face of the base body.
assignees: QINGDAO AXR INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Reconfigurable search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The application discloses a reconfigurable search and rescue robot which comprises a first box body, a second box body and a driving mechanism, wherein the first box body and the second box body are hinged; the deformation mechanism is arranged on the first box body, the deformation mechanism is kept connected with the second box body, and the second box body is driven to rotate towards the first box body through the deformation mechanism. According to the reconstruction search and rescue robot provided by the application, the driving mechanisms are arranged on the first box body and the second box body, the reconstruction search and rescue robot can be driven by the independent driving mechanisms, the search and rescue robot can have stronger driving force by adopting the independent driving systems, the obstacle crossing capability of the search and rescue robot can be improved, meanwhile, the second box body can rotate with the first box body through the deformation mechanism arranged on the first box body, the obstacle crossing can be carried out by utilizing the driving mechanism on the second box body when an obstacle is met, and the second box body can be kept attached to the first box body through the deformation mechanism, so that the obstacle crossing capability of the search and rescue robot can be greatly improved.

title_en: Dummy for testing multisource search and rescue equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dummy for testing multisource search and rescue equipment, which comprises a dummy body, a central control unit, a power supply unit, a breathing unit, a whole body temperature unit, an acoustic unit, a vibration unit, a trace gas secretion unit and a respiratory thoracic motion unit, wherein the central control unit, the power supply unit, the breathing unit, the whole body temperature unit, the acoustic unit, the vibration unit, the trace gas secretion unit and the respiratory thoracic motion unit are arranged in the dummy body; the dummy body adopts a multi-degree-of-freedom composition structure; the central control unit is respectively connected with the breathing unit, the whole body temperature unit, the acoustic unit, the vibration unit, the trace gas secretion unit and the respiratory thoracic movement unit; the power supply unit is electrically connected with other units. The dummy scheme provided by the utility model has strong environmental adaptability and comprehensive simulation capability and high reliability, and can effectively solve the problems existing in the prior art.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle that can fix a position
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and discloses a positionable search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein a base is fixedly connected to the outer surface of the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, a double-shaft motor is fixedly arranged on the outer surface of the bottom of the base, threaded rods are fixedly connected to two output ends of the double-shaft motor, threaded barrels are connected to the outer surfaces of the two threaded rods in a threaded manner, and search cameras and infrared imagers are respectively arranged on the outer surfaces of two electric holders. This search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle that can fix a position through setting up biax motor and threaded rod cooperation screw section of thick bamboo, has solved current search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle when installing thermal imaging collection module, all installs thermal imaging collection module under unmanned aerial vehicle, and unmanned aerial vehicle when the operation, inside heat dissipation air current is blown downwards by the paddle to the video acquisition to thermal imaging collection module causes certain influence, leads to the problem that video acquisition's precision reduces.

title_en: Remote rescue equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a remote rescue device, which comprises a rescue robot connected by signals and a remote operation device, wherein the remote operation device is worn by a user to control the action of the rescue robot; the remote operation equipment acquires the image information acquired by the environment acquisition system and plays the image information in the playing equipment, and the electroencephalogram signal acquisition device and the motion capture equipment collect the response made by the user according to the played image and transmit the response to the motion system to control the rescue robot to move. The control mode of the remote rescue robot is simplified, and the operation pressure of a user is reduced, so that the working gravity center is transferred to disaster treatment.

title_en: Charging device for water emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a charging device of an overwater emergency rescue robot, which comprises a floating bin, a robot salvaging mechanism and a wireless charging mechanism, wherein the robot salvaging mechanism and the wireless charging mechanism are arranged on the floating bin, the robot salvaging mechanism is used for salvaging the robot into the floating bin, the wireless charging mechanism is used for charging the robot, the robot salvaging mechanism comprises a driving device and a turnover plate, the turnover plate is arranged along the length direction of the floating bin and is rotatably arranged in the floating bin, the driving device is used for driving the turnover plate to rotate so as to salvage the robot in water, and the wireless charging mechanism is arranged at one end of the floating bin and is used for being abutted with the robot positioned on the turnover plate so as to charge. The utility model realizes the charging and storage of the water emergency rescue robot in the water area, so that the water emergency rescue robot can be deployed in the central position of the water area, and the timeliness of rescue is ensured.
assignees: HENAN TIMESCLOUD COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Foldable miniature solar unmanned aerial vehicle of many flight modes
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-flight-mode foldable miniature solar unmanned aerial vehicle, which adopts a vector double-rotor wing flying wing layout, wherein flexible solar panels are arranged on the upper surfaces of a fuselage and wings; one side surface of the wing is rotatably connected with one side surface of the fuselage, and the wing is driven to unfold or fold around the fuselage through a second steering engine. The multi-flight modes comprise a hovering mode, a low-speed accompanying flight mode, a high-speed flat flight mode, a perching charging mode, a take-off mode and a landing mode, and different flight modes or combinations of different flight modes can be selected according to different task demands; the miniature solar unmanned aerial vehicle with multiple flight modes can complete energy supply in the flight process, can land, inhabit and charge, circularly complete search and rescue tasks, does not need to carry batteries too much, and can increase load capacity. Based on the above, the flight control intelligent management control system can complete autonomous decisions including flight state alternation, whole-machine appearance maintenance, autonomous landing decisions, autonomous charging decisions and the like.

title_en: Fire scene fire-extinguishing rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire scene fire-extinguishing rescue robot which comprises a crawler base, an audiovisual acquisition device, a storage box and a cooling assembly, wherein a water tank is arranged in the middle of the upper end of the crawler base, a fire water monitor is arranged in the front of the upper end of the crawler base, the fire water monitor can horizontally rotate and pitch according to a fire point, the tail end of the crawler base is provided with a plurality of water inlets, the audiovisual acquisition device is positioned at the upper end of the water tank, the storage box is positioned at the tail of the upper end of the crawler base, a temperature monitoring device is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the storage box, the temperature monitoring device can monitor the temperature of each part of a vehicle body and the temperature of the surrounding environment in real time, and the cooling assembly is positioned at the upper end of the water tank.

title_en: Infrared imaging inspection search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to an infrared imaging inspection search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein a protection component is arranged at the front part of an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a cleaning component is arranged at the position of the front part of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body corresponding to the protection component, the protection component comprises a cradle head arranged at the front bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a thermal imaging camera is arranged at the front part of the cradle head, a glass protection cover is arranged at the position of the front part of the cradle head corresponding to the thermal imaging camera, connecting frames are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the outer wall of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, the cleaning component comprises an adjusting seat arranged at the bottom of the glass protection cover, and adjusting frames are symmetrically and rotatably connected to the two sides of the front part of the adjusting seat through rotating shafts. The infrared imaging inspection search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle can enable the whole device to achieve better protection of the thermal imaging camera, improves stability during search and rescue, and brings better use prospects.
assignees: SHAANXI QINGFENG YIBO DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ground-air amphibious double-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an amphibious double-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and a control method thereof, comprising a transverse double-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle main body, two sets of hemispherical rotating wheel assemblies and rotor assemblies, the hemispherical component is of a hollow structure and is fixedly connected to the rotating arm of the unmanned aerial vehicle and can rotate along with the rotating arm.
