The invention creatively designs a transmission mechanism based on the conductive slip ring on the basis of the traditional horizontal double-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, so that the rotor driving motor can be tilted and lifted to rotate 360 degrees from a traditional small angle under the driving of the steering engine, and then the unmanned aerial vehicle can be matched with the hemispherical rotating wheel to roll on the ground safely, flexibly and hidden, thereby greatly reducing the energy consumption of the unmanned aerial vehicle, expanding the operation range of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and combining the high maneuverability of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the air, the invention has great application potential in the scenes of disaster search and rescue, survey, environment map building and the like.

title_en: Multi-foot rescue robot motion control method and device based on stress balance
abstract_en: The invention provides a motion control method and a motion control device for a multi-foot rescue robot based on stress balance, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring mass center speed and angular speed of a fuselage; obtaining expected acceleration according to the centroid speed and the expected speed, and obtaining expected angular acceleration according to the angular speed and the expected angular speed; obtaining mass center acceleration deflection according to the expected acceleration and the acceleration, and obtaining angular acceleration deflection according to the expected angular acceleration and the angular acceleration; the method provided by the invention realizes coordinated movement of the support legs, and further improves the safety of the multi-foot rescue robot in complex terrain operation.

title_en: Marine rescue robot system
title_ko: 해난 구조용 로봇 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a marine rescue robot system, detecting search and rescue signals in an event of a maritime accident, moving to the accident site, injecting rescue capsules into the victims, and then rescuing them using a robot arm, etc., and calling a dedicated drone to the site to transport the rescue capsules. Thus, the present invention can support smooth rescue operations even in environments that are difficult for rescue personnel to access.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 해양 사고발생시 수색과 구조신호를 감지하고 사고현장으로 이동하여 조난자에게 구조캡슐을 사출 후 로봇 암 등을 통해 구조가 이루어지도록 하고 현장으로 전용 드론을 호출하여 구조캡슐을 이송하는 절차로 운용되는 해난 구조용 로봇 시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: UNIV NAT HANBAT IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Maritime search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a maritime search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a body, wherein a camera is fixed on the front surface of the body, a storage bin is fixed on the bottom surface of the body, baffle plates are hinged on the inner walls of the front side and the rear side of the storage bin and close to the bottom surface, an annular air bag is arranged in the storage bin, a hoisting assembly is arranged in the storage bin, and an inflating assembly is arranged in the storage bin. This maritime search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle when using, when finding that the waters face has the person of falling into water, control platform dispatches the rescue boat and rescue, the baffle is opened to the organism simultaneously, then control hoisting assembly, slowly hang out the storage bin with annular gasbag, when being located the bottom of storage bin, inflate annular gasbag through inflating assembly, make its inflation be annular, then continue to hoist the annular gasbag that will charge through hoisting assembly to victim next door, make victim implement saving oneself when waiting for the rescue, when improving organism utilization ratio, still can increase the probability of rescue success, and is more practical.
assignees: QINHUANGDAO BAWU MARINE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Human body target searching system and method suitable for jungle shielding
abstract_en: The application discloses a human body target searching system suitable for jungle shielding, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and specifically comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle and further comprises: the edge computing device is connected into the unmanned aerial vehicle through a serial port; the infrared camera is arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and a lens on the infrared camera is vertically downward; wherein, the edge computing device is internally provided with an artificial intelligence model. The application aims at the problem that when people on the ground need to go to search and rescue due to various accidents in outdoor travel, the visible light camera cannot shoot the object to be rescued due to factors such as illumination and the like, and the object to be rescued cannot be completely exposed to the infrared camera due to the fact that trees and the like are blocked by the people to be rescued due to factors such as geographic positions and the like, and the wounded searching method based on artificial intelligence and capable of overcoming partial blocking conditions by using the unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted infrared camera can be used for effectively searching and rescuing the people to be rescued.
assignees: CHINESE PEOPLE'S LIBERATION ARMY AIR FORCE MILITARY MEDICAL UNIV

title_en: Target positioning method, target positioning device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing, and provides a target positioning method, a target positioning device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image of a target area shot by an unmanned aerial vehicle; inputting the image into a target detection model to obtain a detection result output by the target detection model; the target detection model is obtained by training a sample image and labeling information thereof; if the detection result is that a detection target exists in the image, determining two-dimensional coordinate information of the detection target in the image; and converting the two-dimensional coordinate information based on the three-dimensional coordinate information of the camera shooting the image in the geodetic coordinate system and the gesture information of the camera to obtain the three-dimensional coordinate information of the detection target in the geodetic coordinate system. The application can rapidly and accurately position the rescue target, thereby improving the search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Wounded person searching method capable of overcoming partial shielding condition based on unmanned aerial vehicle rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wounded searching method capable of overcoming partial shielding conditions based on unmanned aerial vehicle rescue, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and mainly aims at solving the problems that when outdoor exploration is carried out, ground personnel are required to go to search and rescue because of various accidents, meanwhile, a visible light camera cannot shoot a target to be rescued because of illumination factors, the target to be rescued cannot be completely exposed to an infrared camera because of shielding caused by factors such as geographic positions and the like, the target to be rescued is used for artificial intelligent recognition, a suspected target position marked by artificial intelligence is utilized, high-precision geographic coordinates of a picture shooting point are provided through an onboard RTK (real time kinematic) device, the high-precision geographic coordinates of the suspected target are calculated by using an onboard edge computing device, the high-precision geographic coordinates of the suspected targets marked by a plurality of pictures are transmitted into the target to be rescued through a map software API (application program interface), and clustering algorithm is used for calculating the geometric center positions of each type.

title_en: Emergency search and rescue system, method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an emergency search and rescue system, an emergency search and rescue method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which are applied to the technical field of emergency search and rescue communication. The system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, terminal equipment and core network equipment; wherein, unmanned vehicles mounts portable basic station. The portable base station is used for transmitting the wireless signals of the full frequency band; the terminal equipment is used for registering and accessing the core network equipment through the wireless signal; the core network equipment is used for acquiring the identity information of the first user which is accessed through the wireless signal registration and storing the identity information into the database; the core network device is further configured to obtain target location information of the first user according to the identity information. In the system, the portable base station transmits the full-band wireless signal, so that when the network signal of an operator is interrupted, network support can be provided for disaster-stricken personnel to register and access the core network equipment, and the position information of the disaster-stricken personnel is acquired, so that the disaster-stricken personnel can be accurately counted, and accurate rescue is implemented on the disaster-stricken personnel.

title_en: Rescue robot is searched under water
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an underwater searching and rescuing robot which comprises a rescuing robot main body, wherein a protective cover is arranged at the top end of the main body, a rotating rod is arranged on the rescuing robot main body, a rotating plate is fixedly connected to the top end of the rotating rod, cameras are arranged on two sides of the rotating plate, a cleaning mechanism for cleaning the outer part of the protective cover is arranged on the protective cover, and the cleaning mechanism comprises a fixed shaft, a connecting block, a supporting plate, two fixing plates, two sponge blocks and a plurality of bristles. According to the utility model, the fixed shaft, the connecting block, the supporting plate, the fixed plate, the sponge block and the bristles are matched with each other, the rotating rod drives the connecting block and the bristles to rotate in the fixing process, the fixed shaft drives the supporting plate to rotate, the supporting plate drives the fixed plate to rotate, the fixed plate drives the sponge block and the bristles to rotate, and the sponge block and the bristles brush and wipe the outer wall of the protective cover, so that the cleaning of the outer part of the protective cover is facilitated, and the camera is facilitated to search and rescue.
assignees: NANJING SELUSHEN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ultrasonic sensing search and rescue equipment and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses ultrasonic sensing search and rescue equipment and a use method thereof, wherein wings are fixedly connected to two sides of the front surface and the back surface of an unmanned aerial vehicle, a chassis is movably connected to the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle, an ultrasonic detector is fixedly connected to the bottom of the front surface of the chassis, ultrasonic transmitting ends are fixedly connected to two sides of the bottom of the ultrasonic detector, connecting plates are fixedly connected to two sides of the top of the ultrasonic detector, the top of each connecting plate penetrates into the chassis, and transmission mechanisms are arranged on two sides of the front surface of the chassis. According to the invention, the connecting mechanism drives the stabilizing rod to be inserted into the rod, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle is connected with the chassis, and the transmission mechanism drives the clamping rod to be inserted into the connecting plate, so that the chassis is connected with the ultrasonic detector, and the ultrasonic sensing search and rescue equipment can sense at high altitude when in use, so that the search and rescue equipment is not blocked by sapling or mountain in the surrounding environment, and the search and rescue range can be enlarged.

title_en: Multimode motion robot and motion method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-mode motion robot and a motion method thereof, wherein the multi-mode motion robot comprises a duct propeller, a hip module, a left leg module, a right leg module and a control module; the bypass propeller is connected with the hip module; the buttock module is symmetrically provided with the left leg module and the right leg module; the hip module comprises a propeller yaw unit and a hip joint unit; the left leg module and the right leg module are symmetrically arranged and respectively comprise a knee joint unit, a tibia unit, an ankle bone unit and a heel unit; the robot realizes a unique multi-mode movement capability, thereby realizing a robot which can perform search and rescue and scout tasks in two environments of the ground and the air at the same time.

title_en: Integrated field emergency rescue system
abstract_en: The application discloses an integrated field emergency rescue system in the field of field emergency rescue, which comprises three integral modules, namely a field operation end, a data transmission end and a display end, wherein the field operation end comprises an intelligent wristwatch for monitoring information of a wearer, a search and rescue flat plate end for data transmission, an unmanned aerial vehicle and a search and rescue command background, the search and rescue command background is switched into a search and rescue mode, and the search and rescue mode comprises a direct search mode and an unmanned aerial vehicle mode; the data transmission end comprises a Beidou receiving and sending device and a cloud server, and the data transmission mode of the data transmission end is switchable and comprises network transmission and Beidou transmission; the display terminal comprises a front-end display page and a mobile phone APP. The system has stronger adaptability to the search and rescue terrains, can adapt to multiple terrains, has wider search and rescue range and longer communication distance; the operation is more convenient, the functions are more abundant, and the method is suitable for various requirements; the data is coordinated and perfected, the data can be persistent, and efficient command and rescue operation is realized.

title_en: Low-altitude airspace planning method for maritime large-area search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides a low-altitude airspace planning method of a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle in a large area at sea, which comprises the following steps: step 1, grouping search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicles into minimum task groups; step 2, determining an optimal layout method of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the minimum task group according to the working mode of the unmanned aerial vehicle; step 3, determining a co-location coverage area according to the layout method in the step 2; step 4, performing airspace distribution according to the optimal layout method and the search and rescue area shape; and 5, planning an unmanned aerial vehicle route according to the airspace distribution scheme in the step 4, and completing the search and rescue task. The application provides a rapid quantitative low-altitude airspace planning and designing method for the cooperative work of a large-area search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle at sea so as to meet the monitoring requirements of different detection modes such as direction finding positioning, direction finding-time difference positioning, time difference positioning and the like.
assignees: NANJING SHANYAO AVIATION TECH CO LTD;CHANGZHOU HAIJIANG KONGTIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Stretcher inclined bed for firefighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The application discloses a stretcher tilting bed for a fire-fighting and rescue robot, which comprises a bed body, a bottom plate, a push-pull mechanism and a tilting adjustment mechanism, wherein an upper groove is formed in the middle of the lower end part of the bed body, a lower groove is formed in the middle of the upper end surface of a bed plate, the upper groove and the lower groove are symmetrically arranged, a rotating shaft is arranged between the upper groove and the lower groove, the push-pull mechanism is arranged between the bed plate and the inner wall of a rescue robot box body, and the tilting adjustment mechanism is arranged between the bed body and the bottom plate.
assignees: QINGDAO AXR INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent coal mine pumped storage inspection robot
abstract_en: An intelligent coal mine pumped storage inspection robot comprises a machine body, a drive, a mechanical arm, a power supply, a leg type travelling mechanism, a track type travelling mechanism and a front end sensor integration area; the leg type travelling mechanism and the track type travelling mechanism are arranged on two sides of the machine body; the driving, mechanical arm, power supply and front end sensor integration area are arranged on the machine body and are connected with the driving unit; the intelligent coal mine pumped storage robot controls the movement of legs through the leg-like structure and moves by adopting the crawler belt, so that the intelligent coal mine pumped storage robot is better suitable for rugged terrains in a coal mine; the working environment of the robot can be accurately detected by combining various sensors such as vision, proximity sense and ultrasonic wave, the stability is improved, the robot is enabled to be closer to the working state of a person, and a laser scale detection instrument is mounted. The method can be applied to underground development operations such as construction of coal mine pumped storage power stations and tunnel development, and has a huge application prospect in disaster search and rescue operations such as debris flow and earthquakes.

title_en: Combat training search and rescue command background system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combat training search and rescue command background system, which belongs to the field of combat training search and rescue and comprises a main interface, wherein the main interface comprises a mode switching unit, a search and rescue setting unit, an information management unit, a system setting unit and a system exiting unit. The mode switching unit comprises a through mode and an unmanned aerial vehicle mode, the search and rescue setting unit comprises a search and rescue personnel module, a search instrument binding module and an electronic fence module, and the search and rescue personnel module is in wireless connection with a watch of a search and rescue personnel; the searcher binding module is connected with the searcher. The information management unit comprises a personnel management module, a search instrument management module and a data synchronization module, wherein the personnel management module can set information of the watch to be searched and rescued; the search instrument management module can set information of the handset to be rescued, and the system setting unit comprises a forced switching unit and a history track unit. The invention can expand the search and rescue range, accelerate the search and rescue efficiency and furthest reduce the casualties of rescue workers.

title_en: Inchworm bionic robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides an inchworm bionic robot, and belongs to the technical field of search and rescue robots. The problem that an existing real search and rescue robot cannot climb over obstacles is solved. This inchworm bionic robot includes the support main part, the support main part includes first backup pad and second backup pad, connect through transmission between first backup pad and the second backup pad, first backup pad is provided with drive arrangement, drive arrangement connects transmission, drive arrangement is used for driving drive arrangement and drives first backup pad and second backup pad and keep away from transmission's one end and be close to each other or keep away from, first backup pad is provided with first removal wheel, the second backup pad rotates and is connected with the connecting rod, the connecting rod is provided with second removal wheel and first supporting wheel, first removal wheel and second are removed the wheel and all are set up locking device, first backup pad and second backup pad all are provided with the arm, the arm is provided with the gripper of centre gripping pipeline. The utility model has the advantages of climbing over obstacles and the like.
assignees: ZHIJIANG COLLEGE OF ZHEJIANG UNIV TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Rescue robot with infrared imaging function
abstract_en: A rescue robot with an infrared imaging function comprises a front car body, a rear car body, a middle frame and a first aid basket; the front car body and the rear car body are connected through a middle frame, two symmetrical bidirectional telescopic air cylinders are arranged in the middle frame, one side telescopic ends of the two bidirectional telescopic air cylinders are connected with the tail end of the front car body, and the other side telescopic ends of the two bidirectional telescopic air cylinders are connected with the tail end of the rear car body; cavities are formed in the front car body and the rear car body, and two ends of the first aid basket are respectively positioned in the cavities of the front car body and the rear car body; the top parts of the front car body and the rear car body are respectively provided with an infrared imager; the robot can search and rescue personnel in an environment with low visibility, and can immediately implement preliminary rescue.
assignees: RUIPUTE NINGBO PHOTOELECTRIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle disaster search and rescue system
abstract_en: The application provides an unmanned aerial vehicle disaster search and rescue system, and relates to the technical field of intelligent search and rescue. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle disaster search and rescue system, a three-dimensional coordinate graph of trapped personnel is generated by means of the acquisition module, the sensing module and the heterogeneous fusion module; combining the unmanned aerial vehicle position information obtained by the GPS positioning module; and then, the position information of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the three-dimensional coordinate graph are processed through the main control module to obtain the position of the trapped person, and the position of the trapped person is transmitted to the ground control center through the data transmission module.

title_en: Many rotors search for and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-rotor search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. Left and right sides outer wall symmetry fixedly connected with support frame of unmanned aerial vehicle main part, the front side end fixedly connected with monitoring mechanism of unmanned aerial vehicle main part is provided with the water storage chamber in the unmanned aerial vehicle main part, and unmanned aerial vehicle main part upper end is provided with the mounting groove, is provided with controller, equipment power, wireless transmission module and remote control module in the mounting groove, and the upper end fixedly connected with photovoltaic of unmanned aerial vehicle main part, the lower extreme fixedly connected with storing frame of unmanned aerial vehicle main part. When outside dust etc. cause the pollution to the protection casing, the clearance motor drives the driving gear and rotates, and driving gear and swivel ring cooperation drive wash rack rotate, utilize the wash rack to drive the clearance scraper blade and rotate, utilize the clearance scraper blade to clear up the dust of protection casing outside surface, utilize the wash pump to lead into the wash rack with the water in the water storage chamber simultaneously to spout from the hole for water spraying, to the operation of protection casing water spraying, more do benefit to the clearance of protection casing surface spot.

title_en: Multisection search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multisection search and rescue robot which comprises a machine body, wherein a rack is arranged on the surface of the machine body, a driving mechanism is arranged on the rack, a connecting assembly is arranged at the end part of the machine body, the connecting assembly comprises mounting grooves arranged at the front end part and the rear end part of the machine body, mounting plates are rotatably connected in the mounting grooves through bearings, one end part of one mounting plate is hinged with a hemispherical connecting piece, and the other end part of the other mounting plate is hinged with a spherical connecting piece; the hemispherical connecting piece comprises an upper connecting part and a lower connecting part, hemispherical blocks are arranged at the end parts of the upper connecting part and the lower connecting part, limiting grooves are formed in the surfaces of the hemispherical blocks, and arc grooves communicated with the limiting grooves are further formed in the surfaces of the hemispherical blocks. The utility model can enable each robot to adjust the position of the robot according to the fluctuation of the road surface, thereby enabling the robot to pass through the complex road surface more stably.

title_en: Flexible manipulator of scalable centre gripping based on composite drive
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a telescopic clamping flexible manipulator based on compound driving, which belongs to the technical field of flexible manipulators. The robot can be applied to the fields of search and rescue robots, agricultural picking robots, life service robots and the like. The manipulator has the advantages of large expansion ratio, no need of driving and transmission elements for bending envelope, and more compact whole structure.

title_en: Combat training search and rescue command system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combat training search and rescue command system, which belongs to the field of combat training search and rescue and comprises a search and rescue command background, a communication base station and a military wristwatch, wherein the search and rescue command background is connected with the communication base station, the communication base station is connected with a plurality of groups of military wristwatch, the communication base station is connected with a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle through wireless communication, a relay nacelle of the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle is connected with a plurality of groups of military wristwatch, the search and rescue command background is connected with a hand-held machine searching instrument through Mesh high-frequency wireless communication, the hand-held machine searching instrument is connected with a plurality of groups of military wristwatch through wireless communication, the search and rescue command background and the communication base station are connected with a data server through 4G communication, beidou short message and data server, and the data server is connected with a combat command hall through a network. The invention can realize that the combat rescue team can communicate with the department command center in the global scope by combining various communication modes. Not only can be used in daily combat training, but also can effectively solve the problem that people in distress cannot be timely and accurately searched and rescuing in field combat.

title_en: Marine search and rescue system and method based on multi-sensor fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a marine search and rescue system and a marine search and rescue method based on multi-sensor fusion, wherein the marine search and rescue system comprises radar sensors and navigation sensors which are respectively arranged at the head part and the tail part of a ship; performing point cloud parameter cluster analysis in computer equipment based on cloud characteristic information of detected target points in a severe environment to obtain moving image categories around different boats; based on the relative variable quantity between the head and tail coordinates in different boat numbers, taking the effective image category change' and the relative variable quantity between the head and tail coordinates as safety priori information, and executing early warning of safety or not by judging the correlation between the effective image category change and the relative variable quantity between the head and tail coordinates in different subframes; according to surrounding detection targets in different ship brands, a search and rescue plan in the unmanned ship is executed in a management center, real-time monitoring in the sea area and implementation of the search and rescue plan are realized, and safety and reliability of sea area staff are improved.

title_en: Multifunctional fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional fire rescue robot which comprises a chassis, wherein Mecanum wheels are arranged at the front and rear of the bottom of the chassis, atomizing spray heads are fixed at the front and rear of the chassis through bolts, six atomizing spray heads are sequentially distributed from left to right, an obstacle avoidance sensor and an infrared camera are fixed at the center of the right end of the chassis through bolts, explosion-proof lamps are arranged at the left side of the obstacle avoidance sensor and the right side of the infrared camera, the explosion-proof lamps are fixed on the chassis through bolts, fan-shaped spray heads are arranged below the obstacle avoidance sensor and the infrared camera, the fan-shaped spray heads are distributed left and right and are fixed on the chassis through bolts, a control box is fixed at the center of the top of the chassis through bolts, a fixing seat A is arranged at the left side of the control box, and a water tank is arranged at the left side of the fixing seat A; the multifunctional fire rescue robot has the advantages of changing the direction in situ, searching and rescuing fire scene personnel, creating a fire-fighting channel and improving rescue safety.

title_en: Snake-shaped mining disaster rescue robot and rescue method thereof
abstract_en: A snake-shaped mine disaster rescue robot and a rescue method thereof relate to the field of coal mine rescue machinery. Each part of the rescue robot is flexibly connected in sequence, and the detection cabin is positioned at the head end; the detection cabin is used for rock breaking propulsion, life and underground environment detection; the lifting cabin is used for assisting the detection cabin to climb over the obstacle; the driving cabin is used for driving the rescue robot to travel and turn; the mechanical arm cabin is used for grabbing and deploying objects during life rescue and cleaning a rescue channel; the life support cabin is used for storing life support materials necessary for rescue; the signal relay cabin is used for finishing underground signal relay under the condition that no signal exists in the mine disaster; the underwater propulsion cabin is positioned at the tail of the serpentine rescue robot and is used for driving the rescue robot in water. The narrow space trafficability of the mining disaster rescue robot and the adaptability of various environments are improved, and the search and rescue efficiency and capacity of the search and rescue robot are enhanced.

title_en: Emergency search and rescue accompanying robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an emergency search and rescue accompanying robot, which comprises a robot body, and more than two of a decoration module, a tray module, a projection module and a control module; the robot body is provided with a multipurpose groove cavity; the decoration module, the tray module, the projection module or the control module is adaptively installed on the multipurpose groove cavity; the projection module or the control module arranged on the multipurpose groove cavity is electrically connected with the main control module on the robot body. The emergency search and rescue accompanying robot can be provided with corresponding functional modules according to actual needs so as to ensure that related functions are fully used in proper places, and the adaptability of the robot can be improved.

title_en: Search and rescue method of search and rescue robot, upper computer and lower computer
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a search and rescue method of a search and rescue robot, an upper computer and a lower computer. The search and rescue method of the search and rescue robot comprises the following steps: sending the search and rescue robot to a disaster site; establishing real-time connection with the robot; starting various sensors on the robot to acquire on-site environmental information; constructing a map according to the environment information; searching for a search and rescue target according to the map information and a navigation algorithm; when the target is found, the position information of the target is acquired and is transmitted to a command center or an operator; and the command center or the operator instructs the robot to execute corresponding rescue actions according to the target position information. The search and rescue robot is used for disaster field search and rescue tasks, can control the robot in real time through wireless communication of the PC terminal 433, receive field pictures of the search and rescue robot and complete automatic map building, so that post-disaster rescue tasks can be completed safely and efficiently.
assignees: CHONGQING RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF HARBIN INSTITUTE OF TECH;HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Medical joint search and rescue system with multiple unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-unmanned-plane medical joint search and rescue system, which relates to the technical field of unmanned-plane rescue and comprises a ground control station, a search unmanned plane group and a search and rescue unmanned plane group which are connected in a communication manner, wherein the ground control station is used for receiving information of personnel to be searched and rescue and correspondingly generating search and rescue image characteristics and search and rescue paths; the searching unmanned aerial vehicle group is used for flying along the searching path, acquiring image information on the searching path, and marking searching points matched with the searching image features after the ground control station receives the image information and compares the image information with the searching image features; the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle group generates a search and rescue path based on the search point, performs low-altitude flight along the search and rescue path, and performs life recognition exploration on the search point. The invention can expand the search and rescue range and synchronously perform accurate search and rescue, thereby ensuring the search and rescue precision.

title_en: Multifunctional rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multifunctional rescue robot, which comprises a box body, a traveling mechanism and further comprises: a protection device; a flying device; the protection device includes: the supporting mechanism is internally provided with a first cavity, and a shell of the supporting mechanism is provided with a gap; the baffle, the baffle with supporting mechanism fixed connection, the baffle inboard is provided with the extension rod, the extension rod is connected with the connecting rod. The multifunctional rescue robot provided by the invention has ingenious structure and various functions, contains various working states, is used for adapting to environments with different disaster degrees, realizes the investigation and control of disaster situations and simultaneously provides rescue personnel, and solves the problems of complex operation environment, large rescue equipment requirement, long and urgent rescue duration, high rescue danger and the like in rescue.

title_en: Fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire rescue robot, and belongs to the technical field of disaster relief. Comprises a trunk shell and a head shell which are fixed together; the upper part of the trunk shell is provided with a flapping wing mechanism and an auxiliary rotor wing mechanism, and the lower part of the trunk shell is provided with a supporting leg running mechanism and a crawler running mechanism; the head shell is provided with a camera and a pair of tool assemblies; a pair of protection components are installed on the upper portion of the trunk shell. The invention can freely switch the flight mode and the walking mode, makes proper selection for complex road conditions, improves the passing efficiency and quickly reaches a preset place; the tool assembly can process the obstacles on the route to a certain extent, so that the passing rate is improved; the round hole structure on the protection component coleopteran cooperates with the lamp tube to realize light condensation transmission, improve the ambient brightness, also ensure that the fire-fighting rescue robot can be easily observed, and realize communication with the rescued personnel as soon as possible.
assignees: XUZHOU INST TECHNOLOGY;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Intelligent visual internal attack search and rescue control method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent visual internal attack search and rescue control method and system, and relates to the technical field of fire rescue, wherein the control method comprises the following steps: acquiring the current position point of a rescue worker; house structure information is called according to the current position point of the rescue personnel; analyzing and processing the current position point of the rescue personnel and house structure information to form traveling initial route information; detecting and acquiring fire scene environment detection information along a plurality of groups of unmanned aerial vehicle groups based on the traveling initial route information; analyzing and processing the traveling initial route information and the fire scene environment detection information to form a traveling route difficulty level value; analyzing and processing the fire scene environment detection information to form a fire scene environment influence value; and analyzing and processing the travel initial route information, the travel route difficulty level value and the fire scene environment influence value to form travel route final information, and outputting the travel route final information and the fire scene environment detection information. The rescue efficiency of rescue personnel to stranded personnel in the indoor scene of a fire is got into to this application has the effect that improves.

title_en: Communication equipment deployment method and device, storage medium and intelligent terminal
abstract_en: The invention provides a communication equipment deployment method, a device, a storage medium and an intelligent terminal, and relates to the technical field of the Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the disconnection position of a disconnection user, wherein the disconnection position is the last position of the disconnection user; determining a searching area according to the disconnection position, wherein an area center point of the searching area is a coordinate point corresponding to the disconnection position; and deploying a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles for searching the offline user in the searching area, wherein the area searched by different unmanned aerial vehicles is partially different. According to the invention, the last position of the lost user is used as a search center to determine the possible search area where the lost user stays, and a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles are arranged in the search area to cruise, so that the time for finding the position of the lost user can be shortened, and the search and rescue efficiency of the lost user can be improved by quickly inspecting the search area through an unmanned aerial vehicle set formed by the unmanned aerial vehicles.
assignees: GUANGZHOU JINGTIAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue device simulating worm movement form
abstract_en: The invention provides a search and rescue device imitating worm movement, which relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots and comprises a head unit, a plurality of trunk units and a tail unit which are sequentially connected, wherein the head unit is connected with the trunk unit, the trunk unit is connected with the trunk unit, and the trunk unit is connected with the tail unit through a steering engine; the head unit comprises a first main body block, a supporting plate is arranged at one end of the first main body block, a second main body block and an infrared sensor are arranged at the other end of the first main body block, the infrared sensor is arranged above the second main body block, a groove is formed in the front surface of the second main body block, and a camera is arranged in the groove; the worm-like search and rescue robot designed by the invention has the advantages of small size and flexible action, and can be used for surveying and rescue in a more severe and narrow environment.
assignees: COLLEGE OF ARTS & INFORMATION ENGINEERING DALIAN POLYTECHNIC UNIV

title_en: Brand new search and rescue system constructed by wireless communication equipment
abstract_en: The utility model provides a brand new search and rescue system constructed by wireless communication equipment, which comprises the following components: handheld terminal, unmanned aerial vehicle, search and rescue command car, handheld terminal and search and rescue command car two-way junction, handheld terminal and unmanned aerial vehicle two-way junction, unmanned aerial vehicle and search and rescue command car two-way junction, unmanned aerial vehicle include the organism, and the removal subassembly includes four removal grooves. The utility model provides a brand new search and rescue system constructed by wireless communication equipment, which is characterized in that an extension component is contracted and drives a rotating rod to rotate to one side while moving to one side in a supporting rod, and meanwhile drives a moving component to move to one side, so that a protection box is driven to move to the middle to protect a camera, and impact force generated when a machine body descends is buffered to a certain extent, and damage to the camera caused by dust, small stones or branches and the like brought by the machine body during descending and taking off is reduced.

title_en: Multifunctional obstacle avoidance, breaking and dismantling rescue robot
abstract_en: A multifunctional obstacle avoidance, breaking and dismantling rescue robot. The utility model relates to the technical field of rescue robots. The utility model aims to solve the problem that the existing fire rescue robot cannot realize breaking and dismantling operations such as shearing, expanding and the like. The utility model comprises a chassis, a lifting rod, a supporting rod, a swinging rod, a shearing expansion head, two groups of crawler-type wheel groups and two expanding plates, wherein the lifting rod is vertically arranged on the upper end face of the chassis, the upper end of the lifting rod is vertically and fixedly connected with a rotating mechanism, the output end of the rotating mechanism is connected with a pitching mechanism, the output end of the pitching mechanism is connected with the side wall of the rear end of the supporting rod, the side wall of the front end of the supporting rod is fixedly connected with a swinging mechanism, the output end of the swinging mechanism is connected with the side wall of the lower end of the swinging rod, the front side of the upper end of the swinging rod is rotationally connected with the shearing expansion head through a rotating mechanism, one side of the shearing expansion head is provided with a camera, the two expanding plates are oppositely and symmetrically arranged at the front end of the chassis, and the upper part of the front end face of the chassis is provided with a shooting head. The utility model is used for fire rescue.

title_en: Night search and rescue type unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a night search and rescue type unmanned aerial vehicle, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles and comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein rotor wings are arranged on the outer surface of the unmanned aerial vehicle body in a matched mode at positions close to four corners. According to the utility model, the first motor is started to drive the first gear to rotate, so that the effect of driving the connecting column and the illuminating lamp and the audio and video acquisition end in the quick-release mechanism to rotate in the horizontal direction is achieved, the second motor is started to drive the rotating block in the quick-release mechanism to rotate, so that the effect of adjusting the pitching angle of the audio and video acquisition end and the illuminating lamp is achieved, under the mutual cooperation, the illumination and audio and video information acquisition can be carried out at any angle below under the condition that the flight state of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is not adjusted, and the audio and video information is transmitted to the ground receiving equipment after being processed and converted by the comprehensive processing module, so that the operation difficulty is greatly reduced, and the search and rescue efficiency is improved.
assignees: NANJING WEIZE CHUANGLI ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein a transport case is fixedly connected to the lower side of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, a double-output-shaft motor is fixedly connected to the inner side of the transport case, and a first straight gear is fixedly connected to the left side of the double-output-shaft motor. According to the utility model, the transportation box is arranged, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can carry disaster relief materials, the disaster relief materials are timely distributed, the search and rescue efficiency of the device is improved, the rescue materials are conveniently discharged from the inner side of the transportation box by arranging the movable studs, the search and rescue efficiency of the device is further improved, the disaster relief materials can be clamped through the push plate when the device is transported by arranging the lifting studs, the shaking damage of the disaster relief materials is avoided, and after the device is transported to a disaster relief position, the disaster relief materials can be pushed out through the push plate, so that the search and rescue efficiency of the device is further improved, and the problem that the search and rescue efficiency is reduced due to the fact that the conventional unmanned aerial vehicle cannot rapidly transport disaster relief materials is solved.

title_en: Bluetooth search and rescue device and system based on transmission type reconfigurable intelligent super surface
abstract_en: The utility model provides a Bluetooth search and rescue device and a Bluetooth search and rescue system based on a transmission type reconfigurable intelligent super-surface, wherein the Bluetooth search and rescue device comprises a first shell, a main board and an antenna array board, wherein the main board and the antenna array board are arranged in the first shell, and a first Bluetooth module is arranged on the main board; the antenna array board is provided with a radio frequency control circuit and a multi-antenna array of a transmissive reconfigurable intelligent super-surface, and is arranged on the main board and connected with the multi-antenna array through the radio frequency control circuit; the radio frequency control circuit can start any antenna oscillator to sample signals sent by the Bluetooth communication tag, or enable the multi-antenna array to be simultaneously started to be responsible for signal transmission or signal reception. The search and rescue personnel carry bluetooth communication location label and search and rescue device and rely on bluetooth to carry out electromagnetic wave wireless communication when getting into the scene, overcome infrared imaging's shortcoming, rely on reconfigurable intelligent super surface antenna array, can enlarge antenna array's angle coverage to search and rescue personnel's stranded position is confirmed to the high efficiency when unexpected.

title_en: Son-mother type mountain area patrol search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mother-son mountain patrol search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a mother unmanned aerial vehicle, a child unmanned aerial vehicle and a mobile command center, wherein the mother unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a first main body and a signal relay device, a top cover of the first main body is provided with a groove for placing the child unmanned aerial vehicle, the signal relay device is arranged in the first main body and is close to the top cover, and the signal relay device is respectively in communication connection with the child unmanned aerial vehicle and the mobile command center. The invention adopts the form of a combined unmanned aerial vehicle with a master unmanned aerial vehicle and is provided with the signal relay device, thereby solving the technical problem that the existing unmanned aerial vehicle has limited searching range due to weak signal in the patrol searching and rescuing process in mountain areas.

title_en: Amphibious search and rescue robot
abstract_en: An amphibious search and rescue robot belongs to the technical field of amphibious robots. The water-based search and rescue robot is used for solving the problem that an existing search and rescue robot can not work in water. The waterproof shell is internally provided with a posture adjusting system and is connected with the robot main body, the robot main body is provided with a power supply and control equipment, the lower part of the robot main body is connected with a motion system, and the control equipment controls the posture adjusting system and the motion system to work. According to the moving system, the travelling mechanism and the propeller are combined, so that the number of motors is reduced, the structure is simplified, and the manufacturing cost is reduced. According to the travelling mechanism disclosed by the invention, the guide vane is adopted to pre-accelerate water flow, so that the water flow flowing to the propeller has a certain initial speed, the working efficiency of the propeller is improved, and the energy consumption is reduced. The invention has the advantages of flexibility, light weight, simple structure, easy installation and the like, can perform multi-degree-of-freedom motion in beach, seabed and sea water, and has the function of environment reconnaissance.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle and intelligent vehicle collaborative patrol method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of path planning, and discloses a collaborative patrol method and system for an unmanned aerial vehicle and an intelligent vehicle. The method comprises the following steps: constructing an HWT-OS operating system; performing task scheduling, allocation, real-time scene mapping, target detection, path planning, obstacle avoidance and positioning of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the intelligent vehicle; the robot system formed by the unmanned aerial vehicle and the intelligent vehicle works in the land-air working area range. And identifying and early warning the space coordinate position of the collected related information images in the land-air working interval range by utilizing a digital twin technology, and sending the related information to a dispatching center for visual display, wherein the related information comprises dynamic target information and static target information to be identified of a certain area. The invention can better complete the tasks of distribution, search and rescue, etc. The current situation of work of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the intelligent vehicle is broken through, and a technical solution is provided for the multi-robot cross-field operation problem.

title_en: Search and rescue robot for building collapse
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot for building collapse, which comprises a robot main body, wherein crawler wheels are arranged on two sides of the robot main body, a rotating base is arranged on the outer side wall of the upper end of the robot main body, a cantilever is arranged on the rotating base, a cutting mechanism is arranged at the end part of the cantilever, when the cutting mechanism cuts concrete, water can be sprayed to cool the cutting mechanism, when a cutting saw blade performs high-power cutting, simple spraying water can not meet the cooling requirement of the cutting saw blade, the spraying water can be adjusted in a self-adaptive manner, the cooling requirement of the cutting saw blade is met, in addition, the cooling liquid on the upper side of a liquid storage cavity can be mixed with water in the spraying water in a self-adaptive manner when the cutting saw blade performs high-power cutting, the cooling effect of the water mixed with the cooling liquid is better, the cooling effect of the cutting saw blade can be further improved, and the efficiency of the cutting saw blade during search and rescue cutting can be ensured.
assignees: HANGZHOU TIANHAIXIANG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for rescue
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle, concretely relates to rescue is with unmanned aerial vehicle, including the organism, still include: the top plate is assembled at the bottom of the machine body, a limiting clamp is fixedly connected to the bottom of the top plate, a rotating sheet is rotatably connected to the inside of the limiting clamp, and a limiting arm is arranged on the outer side of the rotating sheet; a cradle head; a camera; the anti-explosion illuminating lamp is assembled on the camera; the rescue material package, the rescue material package sets up in the below of spacing clamp, the outside of rescue material package is equipped with the string, the string of hanging winds spacing arm. The utility model discloses can throw light on the region that the camera was shot at present, improve the accuracy of auxiliary lighting, be convenient for observe the underground environment situation of dark in a flexible way, improve the search and rescue ability under the mine of dark, and be convenient for put in rescue goods and materials package and give the personnel of waiting for rescue, improve the survival probability of waiting for rescue personnel.

title_en: Vehicle assist drone
abstract_en: Particular embodiments described herein provide for a vehicle assist drone. The vehicle assist drone can be operated in different modes. For example, the vehicle assist drone can be deployed in a user of an AV service assist mode, a clear occlusion mode, refined routing mode, a security mode, a search and rescue mode (e.g., search for missing child mode), or some other mode. In addition, the vehicle assist drone can be used to supplement a vehicle's sensors. For example, supplementary sensor data from the vehicle assist drone can be used in place of the vehicle's sensors or combined with sensor data from the onboard sensors of the vehicle to supplement the vehicle's sensors.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle intelligent remote command system and method for forest fire prevention
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent remote command system and method for a forest fire prevention unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the system comprises an electromagnetic wave positioning module for positioning the distance between the unmanned aerial vehicle and a fire disaster ignition point; the main control module is used for controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to cruise in the unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring forest area and calculating the distance between a fire source ignition point and the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the fire monitoring data acquisition module, the image acquisition module, the semiconductor gas sensor and the light sensing smoke sensor monitoring data in real time, optimizing the flight route of the unmanned aerial vehicle based on a random forest algorithm and then sending a command to the flight control module, and controlling the flight angle, the speed and the acceleration of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the flight route planned by the main control module to search and rescue personnel in the fire source ignition point. Compared with the traditional manual searching mode, the invention not only saves time and reduces cost, but also is flexible and has unique advantages.
assignees: PEOPLE'S LIBERATION ARMY NATIONAL UNIVERSITY OF DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Marine unmanned aerial vehicle formation granularity-variable collaborative search and rescue method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reinforcement learning-based maritime unmanned aerial vehicle formation granularity-variable collaborative search and rescue method, which belongs to the technical field of search and rescue in a marine environment and comprises the following steps of: step 1, initializing a sea surface target search and rescue operation area range, and deploying a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles in the operation area to form an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster; step 2, the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster executes coarse-granularity search and rescue operation by using a collaborative mower algorithm, and records the target existence probability of each regional cell by using a digital pheromone; step 3, capturing the movement of the target on the sea surface by using an improved digital pheromone propagation formula, and realizing information fusion by using a digital pheromone updating formula; and 4, executing fine-granularity search and rescue operation by the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, and executing a variable-granularity search and rescue formation cooperative algorithm of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster. The invention can be suitable for the requirements of rapid search and rescue positioning and collaborative operation of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles of targets under the sea surface environment with stable characteristics.

title_en: Search and rescue illumination unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a search and rescue lighting unmanned aerial vehicle, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles and comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a lifting control assembly and a material box throwing connector group, wherein the lifting control assembly is fixedly arranged in the middle of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, the lower end of the lifting control assembly is movably connected with the material box throwing connector group, and the lower end of a material box hanging steel cable is fixedly connected with a material box cover; according to the invention, materials required by first aid are placed in the material box, the material box cover with the material box hanging steel rope is covered, the upper end of the material box hanging steel rope is connected with the material box throwing connector set, the electric control mortise lock fixedly arranged on the material box fixing brackets at two sides is started to fix the material box, after the ground is reached, the structure in the material box throwing connector set is triggered, and the power supply is communicated, so that the materials in the material box can be unlocked, the materials in the material box can be better protected, unhooked after delivery, and illumination is provided through the illuminating lamp.
assignees: CHONGQING VOCATIONAL COLLEGE TRANSP;CHONGQING YUYAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Material throwing device for search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a material throwing device for a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle material throwing. The unmanned aerial vehicle intelligent control system comprises a throwing box, wherein a throwing opening is formed in the side face of the throwing box, a throwing door is arranged in the throwing opening, a loop bar is arranged in the throwing box, a plurality of groups of partition plates are annularly arranged on the outer side of the loop bar, a laser ranging sensor is arranged at the inner top of the throwing box, a control main board is arranged at the top of the throwing box, the control main board is electrically connected with the laser ranging sensor and an unmanned aerial vehicle speed control system, and the control main board can control the flying speed of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the measurement result of the laser ranging sensor. According to the invention, the delivered materials are automatically weighed through the descending height of the supporting plate, then the descending distance of the supporting plate is detected by the laser ranging sensor, then the flying speed of the unmanned aerial vehicle is automatically controlled through the controller, the horizontal delivering distances of the materials with different weights are the same, and the delivering precision is high.

title_en: Indoor search and rescue anticollision mechanism of fire control unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an indoor search and rescue anti-collision mechanism of a fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a machine body, wherein a camera device is arranged in the middle of the bottom of the machine body, hydraulic telescopic rods are arranged on the left side and the right side of the bottom of the machine body, the bottom of each hydraulic telescopic rod penetrates through an inner cavity of a cylinder and is provided with a circular plate, a first damper is arranged in the inner cavity of the cylinder and is sleeved with a first spring, a supporting plate is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the cylinder, an anti-skid layer is arranged at the bottom of the supporting plate, supporting rods are arranged on four sides of the machine body and are arranged in a central symmetry manner, a rotary wing is arranged at the top of each supporting rod, a cylinder is arranged in the middle of the top of the machine body, and a fixing piece is fixedly connected to the top of each cylinder. When unmanned aerial vehicle receives the collision all around, protection pad can be atress can be to bracing piece intracavity extrusion, comes the buffer protection pad through third attenuator and third spring to collide the collision force that brings for the fuselage, has guaranteed the stationarity when unmanned aerial vehicle flies, reduces the possibility of crash and plays the guard action.
assignees: XIAN HAIYANG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Target detection method based on fusion of two modal images
abstract_en: The invention discloses a target detection method based on two-mode image fusion, which comprises the steps of constructing a relevant scene based on a AirSim platform to carry out simulation, collecting image data sets of different modes, constructing a bimodal image fusion network, training the fusion network according to a counter-propagation principle, simultaneously extracting features of images of two modes by using a Siamese neural network, reconstructing the features into a fusion image through deconvolution operation, carrying out inspection and evaluation on the quality of the reconstructed fusion image through quantized evaluation indexes, modifying the fusion network according to an evaluation result, directly inputting the fusion features output by the trained fusion network into a single-stage YOLOv target detection network, freezing trained network parameters of the fusion network, and training the target detection network to obtain an optimized fusion and detection network. The method is convenient to realize efficient and accurate bimodal image fusion and detection, and is beneficial to improving the target detection capability of the unmanned aerial vehicle in scenes such as emergency search and rescue.

title_en: Urban flood rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an urban flood rescue robot, which at least comprises a ship body part capable of moving on the water surface and an ejection part for ejecting a rescue net to a rescue object; the ejection part comprises an ejection box body, an ejection pipe, a node, a warhead ejection mechanism and an ejection triggering mechanism; the warhead ejection mechanism comprises an ejection spring, a warhead connecting rope, a cam steering engine, a wire winding motor, a clutch and a wire winding shaft I; the ejection triggering mechanism comprises a transverse tube, a clip spring, a clip connecting rope and a triggering steering engine; when rescue is carried out, the ejection triggering mechanism releases locking of the warhead, and the warhead impacts the node under the action of the ejection spring, so that the node carries the rescue net to pop up to the rescue object, the rescue object floats above the water surface by using the rescue net, and further a rescue task is completed.

title_en: Resource pre-allocation-based airship cluster collaborative search and rescue method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for collaborative search and rescue of a airship cluster based on resource pre-allocation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: 1) Designing an emergency resource allocation optimization model, 2) determining an accident site after an accident occurs, planning a path of the unmanned ship, and performing obstacle avoidance processing on the intelligent local path planning aiming at different scenes so that the unmanned ship can quickly and safely reach the accident site; 3) After the unmanned boats arrive at the accident site, cooperatively controlling a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles to realize multi-task scheduling, and cooperatively completing search and rescue through the unmanned aerial vehicles; 4) After the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle completes the collaborative formation, searching, identifying and tracking work of the people falling into water is carried out, and finally rescue resources are allocated to the people falling into water by combining the search results of the unmanned aerial vehicles to complete rescue. According to the invention, the unmanned ships and the unmanned aerial vehicle clusters are used for collaborative search and rescue, and the unmanned aerial vehicle clusters are fully utilized for target search, positioning and tracking, so that rapid and accurate global search and rescue are realized.

title_en: Remote control rescue robot based on crawler step-shaped double driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a crawler-step-shaped double-drive-based remote control rescue robot, which comprises a machine body, crawler wheels, a camera, a rescue mechanism, a upstairs and downstairs mechanism and an adjusting mechanism, wherein the machine body is provided with a crawler belt; the crawler wheels are respectively arranged at two sides of the lower end of the machine body; the camera is arranged on the machine body; the rescue mechanism comprises an inflatable bag arranged on the machine body; the upstairs and downstairs mechanism is arranged in a device groove at the bottom of the machine body and comprises two groups of walking plates and driving parts; the driving piece controls the two groups of walking plates to alternately reciprocate; the adjusting mechanism is respectively connected with the machine body and the upstairs and downstairs mechanism; the adjusting mechanism is used for adjusting the angle of the machine body, and controlling the rotation angle of the two groups of walking plates and the rotation state when going upstairs and downstairs, so that the upstairs and downstairs mechanism can climb up and down. The invention can gradually convey trapped personnel to the lower layer through the stairs, thereby ensuring the safety of the trapped personnel.

title_en: Method for collaborative search and rescue of heterogeneous robot in air-ground
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure relates to a method for collaborative search and rescue of a heterogeneous robot in an air-ground space. On the premise of determining a search and rescue range, an aerial robot perceives a ground environment by utilizing the overall visual field advantage, shoots downwards to obtain an initial overall map, the aerial robot transmits the initial overall map to edge nodes, the edge nodes conduct semantic segmentation on the initial overall map by utilizing a SAM algorithm to obtain a target overall map, the target overall map is processed and finally converted into a grid map, and the grid map is transmitted to the ground robot. The ground robot performs autonomous positioning by using an AMCL algorithm, global path planning by using an A-x algorithm, local path planning by using a DWA algorithm and protection of steering of the ground robot by adding an expansion layer on the grid map, so as to select a target point for searching and rescuing to perform path planning, and the search and rescue are completed by using the local accurate positioning advantage navigation of the target point.

title_en: Robot path optimizing method applied to fire rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot path optimizing method applied to fire rescue, which comprises the following steps: collecting surrounding environment information by a laser radar carried by the ROS robot, and acquiring odometer data of the robot; based on the odometer data acquired by the laser radar, the Gmapping algorithm improves the proposal distribution and resampling strategy through the RBPF algorithm in SLAM; adopting an improved particle swarm optimization Gmapping algorithm, and drawing a map according to the odometer and laser radar data of the ROS robot; and for the drawn map, carrying out global path planning and local path planning by adopting an RRT algorithm and a TEB algorithm, and realizing the optimal path planning of obstacle avoidance of the ROS robot. Compared with the prior art, the invention shortens the map acquisition time of the fire scene, and the search and rescue personnel do not need to risk to enter the dangerous case to conduct map survey, thereby ensuring the safety of the search and rescue personnel.

title_en: Wheel leg type land-air amphibious robot with single driving joint and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a wheel leg type land-air amphibious robot with a single driving joint and a control method thereof. The control method comprises a flight mode, a ground mode and a transition mode; the flight mode comprises forward and backward movement control, lifting movement control rolling movement control and yaw movement control; the forward and backward movement control, steering movement control, lifting movement control and rolling movement control; the transition mode includes transitioning from a ground movement mode to an air flight mode and from an air flight mode to a ground movement mode. The invention prolongs the endurance time, can be applied to task scenes such as road traffic supervision, search and rescue in damaged houses after disaster, field unknown mine holes, geological exploration, hidden reconnaissance and the like, and has important significance and value in the future.

title_en: Disaster site search and rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a disaster site search and rescue system, which comprises an ad hoc network module, a background terminal, a thermal imaging module, a radar detection module, a microseismic detection module and an audio/video detection module, wherein the ad hoc network module comprises a command box, a first ad hoc network radio station, a second ad hoc network radio station, a third ad hoc network radio station and a fourth ad hoc network radio station, the command box, the first ad hoc network radio station, the second ad hoc network radio station, the third ad hoc network radio station and the fourth ad hoc network radio station are in two-phase intercommunication communication connection, the command box is electrically connected with the background terminal, the first ad hoc network radio station is in communication connection with the thermal imaging module, the second ad hoc network radio station is in communication connection with the radar detection module, the third ad hoc network radio station is in communication connection with the microseismic detection module, and the fourth ad hoc network radio station is in communication connection with the audio/video detection module. The rescue efficiency is improved in the help of this application.
assignees: WUHAN XINLANG PHOTOELECTRIC TECH CO LTD;HUAXIA CHUANGWEI BEIJING SAFETY PREVENTION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rescue robots, in particular to a seismic rescue robot, which avoids the situation that when a life detector detects vital signs in a range near a body, the position of the life detector is changed by adjusting the body, so that the detection range and efficiency of the life detector are improved, the golden time of rescue is prevented from being influenced, and the using effect of the device is improved; including fuselage, dead lever and panoramic camera, the inside battery and the automatically controlled mechanism of being provided with of fuselage, the dead lever is fixed in the front side at the top middle part of fuselage, and panoramic camera fixes the top at the dead lever, and panoramic camera is used for observing the environment of seismic ruins, still includes lifting assembly, lifter plate, adjustment mechanism, movable block, life detector and bee calling organ, and lifting assembly installs the front end at the fuselage, and lifting assembly is used for driving the lifter plate and reciprocates to adjustment mechanism installs on the lifter plate.

title_en: Unmanned plane platform and load integrated design method based on group intelligent search
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle platform and load integrated design method based on group intelligent search, which aims to optimize unmanned aerial vehicle group task planning and platform-load performance index matching and improve timeliness and accuracy of task planning. According to the invention, a cluster search task planning algorithm framework is established, and an improved sequential clustering algorithm, an ant colony algorithm, a particle swarm optimization algorithm, a crow search optimization algorithm and other multi-algorithm combined optimization strategies are fused, so that scientific decisions of the number of unmanned aerial vehicles, optimal task scheduling and index matching in two-dimensional and three-dimensional spaces are realized. According to the invention, the performance indexes of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the load are finely adjusted by combining sensitivity analysis and a multi-objective optimization function, so that the completion of the optimal multi-objective search task is ensured. The method is suitable for large-scale cluster tasks, can remarkably improve the application efficiency and the operation effect of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, and has important application value in the fields of urban logistics, ocean monitoring, border security, regional search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Multi-network converged communication system of search and rescue robot under non-preset scene
abstract_en: The application discloses many networks of search and rescue robot communication system that fuses under non-presupposes scene belongs to many networks and fuses communication technology field, includes: the system comprises a base station, an access point, a relay point, a central point and a plurality of rescue robots; the base station is in communication connection with the access point, receives images acquired by each rescue robot in real time and sends corresponding base instructions to the access point; the access point exchanges data with a remote relay point through a first 1.4GHz communication module; the relay point exchanges data with a remote central point through a second 1.4GHz communication module; the central point comprises an image transmission module A end and a first Zigbee module for carrying out multi-network data exchange with each rescue robot; the rescue robot comprises a graph transmission module B end used for carrying out data interaction with the graph transmission module A end and a Zigbee throwing mechanism used for carrying out multi-network data exchange with other rescue robots. The method is suitable for search and rescue work under non-preset complex scenes.

title_en: Search and rescue robot
