abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of search and rescue equipment and comprises a main frame and a floating suspension, wherein main driving assemblies for driving the main frame to move are arranged on two sides of the front end and the rear end of the main frame, an auxiliary driving assembly is arranged on the floating suspension, one end of the floating suspension is hinged with the main frame, a suspension adjusting steering engine is arranged below the main frame, an output shaft of the suspension adjusting steering engine is connected with the floating suspension, when the search and rescue robot encounters an obstacle which is difficult to pass in the advancing direction, the floating suspension is driven to be lifted upwards by the suspension adjusting steering engine until a suspension driving wheel is lifted to the upper surface of the obstacle, so that the ground grabbing force of the search and rescue robot can be increased when the search and rescue robot continues advancing, and meanwhile, a better climbing angle can be obtained.

title_en: Robot device for searching and rescuing in narrow space
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a robot device for searching and rescuing in a narrow space, which comprises a movable chassis, wherein a protective box is arranged at the top end of the movable chassis, two scissor-type lifting frames are arranged in the protective box, a lifting platform is arranged at the top of each scissor-type lifting frame, a protective shell is arranged at the top end of each lifting platform, and a high-definition infrared camera is arranged in each protective shell; two screw rod sliding rails are symmetrically arranged at the bottom end in the protective box, a screw rod and a sliding block matched with the screw rod are arranged on the screw rod sliding rails, the two screw rods are connected, a driving rod is arranged at the bottom of the scissor type lifting frame, and the two screw rods are respectively penetrated through the two driving rods; a guide rod is arranged between the two fixing plates, and a spring is sleeved on the guide rod; the utility model can adjust the height of the high-definition infrared camera through the arrangement of the integral structure, has a sufficient protection effect on the high-definition infrared camera, and is more suitable for search and rescue work in a narrow space.
assignees: SHANGHAI KEXIN INFORMATION TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Underground space position identification method based on multi-head attention feature enhancement
abstract_en: A method for recognizing the position of underground space based on multi-head attention feature enhancement. According to the underground space position recognition method based on multi-head attention feature enhancement, key points in point cloud are extracted through a point cloud preprocessing module, redundant points are removed, and then a sinusoidal multi-head self-attention module is used for extracting local descriptors in data and exchanging local features. And then, a feature fusion module is used for aggregating global descriptors with more identification degree. And finally, calculating the similarity of the global descriptors by using a feature similarity calculation module, and mapping the similarity of the corresponding scenes. Through effectively removing redundant information in data and enhancing global descriptor recognition degree, the recognition precision and real-time performance of the mobile robot to scenes are improved, the complex scenes of the underground tunnel can be accurately recognized, the automatic position recognition requirement of the mobile robot in complex scenes such as post-disaster search and rescue, tunnel patrol and the like is met, and the generalization and real-time performance of the model are stronger.

title_en: Man-machine collaborative rescue situation map construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a man-machine collaborative rescue situation map construction method which can organically combine rescue terminal equipment carried by rescue workers, a detection robot terminal and a rescue command terminal. The detection robot is used for carrying sensing equipment, laser radar and the like required by detection, the detection robot enters a rescue area to acquire multi-view and multi-mode target information, and after the target is sensed by the sensor, the position of the detection target is calculated by a high-efficiency positioning algorithm on the detection robot. The method solves the problems that the rescue front line has large rescue risk and people cannot enter places in the search and rescue process. The situation map is constructed through man-machine cooperation, the inherent defects existing in the independent use of an AI algorithm are overcome, the intelligence of the AI is enhanced, and the reliability and the effectiveness of the constructed situation map are improved. The problems of less rescue information data, untimely rescue information updating, complex interaction and more time consumption existing in the front and the rear of rescue are solved.
assignees: CHINA SOUTH INDUSTRIES GROUP CORPORATION INST OF AUTOMATION CO LTD

title_en: Air-ground cooperative system for rescuing and extinguishing explosion accidents and use method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air-ground cooperative system for rescuing explosion accidents and extinguishing fire and a use method thereof, comprising an unmanned aerial vehicle for extinguishing fire, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle is provided with a first image acquisition module, a fire extinguishing bomb projectile device, a radio sound amplifying device, a first GPS positioning system, a wireless signal receiving device and a first control module, the image acquisition device is used for transmitting depth information of real-time pictures and images, and the fire extinguishing bomb projectile device controls the projectile of a fire extinguishing bomb through signals of a remote control module; the rescue robot is provided with a second image acquisition module, a laser radar, a first GPS positioning system and a second control module and is used for conveying real-time pictures; and the remote control module takes YOLO V5 as a basic model, adds a SEnet attention mechanism, detects fire areas and trapped personnel targets, and realizes accurate positioning. The invention can rapidly and accurately position the fire source, and can throw fire extinguishing bomb and guide and evacuate trapped personnel so as to efficiently and scientifically cope with explosion accidents.

title_en: Disaster rescue robot
abstract_en: The disaster rescue robot comprises an explosion-proof rescue capsule, a crawler mechanism, a mechanical arm, an oxygen feeding device and a control system, wherein the bottom of the explosion-proof rescue capsule is rotationally connected with the crawler mechanism, two sides of the explosion-proof rescue capsule are connected with the mechanical arm, an oxygen outlet of the oxygen feeding device is communicated with the explosion-proof rescue capsule, and the control system is electrically connected with the crawler mechanism, the mechanical arm and the oxygen feeding device so as to control the crawler mechanism, the mechanical arm and the oxygen feeding device to unfold and rescue. Because toxic gas exists or oxygen is lacking under the mine, the oxygen supply device can provide enough oxygen for the explosion-proof rescue capsule. When unexpected conditions such as collapse and the like are met in the road, and the vehicle can not travel, the vehicle can also be kept for a long time to wait for rescue. The crawler can well cross obstacles and avoid tire burst, and is more suitable for the submerged environment.

title_en: Helicopter photoelectric pod simulation training system and training method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of spaceflight search and rescue training, and relates to a helicopter photoelectric pod simulation training system and a training method thereof. The training system comprises a six-degree-of-freedom motion platform, a photoelectric pod system, a parachute-return cabin model and an unmanned aerial vehicle; the photoelectric ball is additionally arranged on the six-degree-of-freedom motion platform, then the motion trail of the helicopter is input or imported at the operation interface of the platform controller, and the operation handle of the operation panel can be normally operated by an operator to perform unfolding training. The simulation of the motion gesture of the photoelectric pod additionally arranged on the search and rescue helicopter can be realized, a training approach in a non-task period is provided for a pod operator, the training of the helicopter close to actual combat equipment when the helicopter is not in a landing field is realized, the training efficiency is improved, and the simulation method has important significance for improving the combat force.
assignees: CHINESE PEOPLES LIBERATION ARMY NO 63628 TROOPS

title_en: Drowning detection and intelligent underwater rescue system based on Beidou navigation
abstract_en: The invention provides a drowning detection and intelligent underwater rescue system based on Beidou navigation, which belongs to the technical field of drowning detection and rescue and comprises a user remote monitoring end, an aerial real-time monitoring unmanned aerial vehicle and an underwater drowning automatic rescue robot, wherein the user remote monitoring end and the aerial real-time monitoring unmanned aerial vehicle are both in wireless connection with the underwater drowning automatic rescue robot. According to the invention, through the unmanned aerial vehicle arranged in the air, no dead angle or wave fluctuation can not clearly see the drowning situation of a person, the drowning situation of the person can be issued in the first time, the precious time for rescue can not be missed, and meanwhile, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be used for carrying out rapid rescue, so that the situation that swimming can not be carried out on the shore, and the drowning risk caused by manual rescue is reduced, and the drowning accident is avoided.

title_en: Portable handheld multiband anti-camouflage high-definition observation mirror
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable handheld multiband anti-camouflage high-definition observation mirror which comprises a front mirror body group, a middle group and a rear cover group, wherein the middle group is positioned in the front mirror body group, and the rear cover group is positioned at the rear part of the front mirror body group. The upper part of the front mirror body group is a battery cylinder for disassembling and assembling the battery; the rear mirror body group comprises an eyepiece group, function keys, a rotary switch and a mode selection knob; the middle part group is integrated with a long wave infrared imaging component, a short wave infrared imaging component, a ranging laser transmitting end and a multifunctional optical component, and the components are sequentially arranged and connected on a front lens frame and a rear lens frame of the middle part group from right to left. Compared with the independent working mode of each component of the traditional multiband high-definition observation mirror, the observation mirror realizes the functions of low-light imaging, visible light direct-view, ranging laser receiving and OLED imaging through turning the light path by optical elements such as a reflector, a beam splitting prism and the like. The invention has small volume and light weight, and can be used for single person to execute scout, search and rescue tasks.
assignees: YUNNAN NORTH OPTICAL & ELECTRON INSTR CO LTD

title_en: Outdoor search and rescue system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an outdoor search and rescue system which comprises a movable LoRa base station, loRa positioning labels and search and rescue display equipment, wherein the movable LoRa base station is used for sending broadcast so as to activate more than one LoRa positioning label in a coverage area, receiving data signals of the LoRa positioning labels and pushing received data information to the search and rescue display equipment. According to the utility model, a standard low-power-consumption search and rescue system is established, and the search and rescue base station which can be portable in various modes such as unmanned aerial vehicle, search and rescue personnel and the like is utilized, so that the quick search in a certain area range is achieved, the search and rescue efficiency is improved, the search difficulty is reduced, and the danger of rescue personnel and trapped personnel is reduced.
assignees: SEVEN STAR COMMUNICATION TECH ANHUI CO LTD

title_en: Bionic post-disaster search and rescue instrument carrier device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a bionic post-disaster search and rescue instrument carrier device, which relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots and comprises two crawler bodies, wherein the two crawler bodies are connected through a plurality of groups of bionic frame structures, one ends of the two crawler bodies are respectively provided with a torsion steering engine, the output end of one torsion steering engine is connected with a long U-shaped connecting frame I, and the output end of the other torsion steering engine is connected with a short U-shaped connecting frame I. The carrier device for the search and rescue instrument has the advantages of reasonable and reliable structure and simple operation, is convenient for the protection plate to effectively protect the search and rescue instrument, prevents the search and rescue instrument from being damaged by the severe environment, can fix the search and rescue instrument under the action of the gravity of the search and rescue instrument, and prevents the search and rescue instrument from sliding off, so that the safety is improved, the search and rescue efficiency of the carrier device for the search and rescue instrument is improved, and the applicability is wider.

title_en: High-voltage station house emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a robot applied to a high-voltage station, and particularly discloses a high-voltage station room emergency rescue robot which comprises a movable chassis, a loading execution mechanism and visual equipment, wherein the loading execution mechanism is carried on the movable chassis. The robot has an emergency operation function, can process emergency tasks, and can be applied to high-voltage station rooms such as 10kV high-voltage chambers of transformer substations and distribution network switching stations.
assignees: Quanzhou Power Supply Company Of State Grid Fujian Electric Power Company

title_en: High-mobility deep well rescue robot
abstract_en: The application provides a deep well rescue robot with high maneuverability, and relates to the technical field of deep well rescue. The high-mobility deep well rescue robot comprises a connecting mechanism, supporting legs and a rescue device, wherein a hinged support is arranged at one end of the connecting mechanism; the support legs are provided with a plurality of support legs, one ends of the support legs are contacted with the ground, and the other ends of the support legs are connected with the hinged support of the connecting mechanism; the rescue device is connected with the other end of the connecting mechanism and comprises a supporting structure for supporting the legs of the wounded and a mechanical arm for fixing the upper body of the wounded. The whole machine adopts the telescopic folding mechanism, and lightweight structural design has higher mobility, is equipped with emergency treatment device, can carry out emergency treatment to the injury in the shortest time, reduces the casualties risk, improves rescue efficiency.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-assisted communication positioning method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle-assisted communication positioning method, a device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, determining current position information of second equipment and communication data volume of a search and rescue system according to position information of an unmanned aerial vehicle and position information of first equipment in a current time slot; determining the energy efficiency ratio of the search and rescue system according to the current position information and the communication data volume; and S2, under the condition that the energy efficiency ratio does not meet the first preset condition, adjusting the position information of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the next time slot, repeatedly executing the step S1 in the next time slot until the energy efficiency ratio meets the first preset condition, and determining the current position information corresponding to the energy efficiency ratio when the energy efficiency ratio meets the first preset condition as the target position information of the second equipment, wherein the target position information is used for representing the current position information of the personnel to be searched and rescuing. The method improves the positioning precision and the communication performance so as to accurately rescue the personnel to be searched and rescued.

title_en: Omnibearing fire-fighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an automatic rescue robot, in particular to an omnibearing fire rescue robot which comprises a vehicle body, four swing arms, a walking driving mechanism, a pitching driving mechanism, a signal transmission module, a gas detection module, an environment sensing module and a life detection module, wherein the four swing arms are symmetrically arranged on the vehicle body, the left front swing arm, the right rear swing arm, the left rear swing arm and the right front swing arm are in mirror image distribution in structure, and four Mecanum wheels on the four swing arms are arranged in diagonal lines; the four swing arms respectively realize the rotation of the crawler driving wheel and the wheat wheel and the pitching action of the swing arms through a walking driving mechanism and a pitching driving mechanism which are arranged in the vehicle body; the robot can realize the conversion of crawler type, omnibearing wheel type and leg type movement modes through the pitching action of the four swing arms. The utility model can be applied to the patrol rescue of the high-rise stair environment, can freely walk in the narrow space of the stair in all directions, and has the characteristics of modularization, flexible movement, compact structure and wide adaptability.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle image rotation target detection method based on local-global characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection method of an unmanned aerial vehicle image rotation target based on local-global characteristics, and relates to the field of computer vision. After an unmanned aerial vehicle aerial image rotation target detection data set is constructed, a backbone feature extraction network is designed based on a ResNet50 structure, so that the feature extraction capacity of a model is stronger; then, a multi-scale feature fusion module is used for improving the multi-scale target detection capability of the algorithm; and finally, generating a rotating region proposal on different scale output feature graphs of the multi-scale feature fusion module by using a rotating region proposal module, so as to realize the direction detection of the rotating target and improve the recognition capability of the dense target. The method can accurately detect the typical ground target in the aerial image of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and meets the automatic target detection requirement of the unmanned aerial vehicle in complex scenes such as post-disaster search and rescue, urban patrol and the like.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle non-contact type personnel heart rate and respiratory rate detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a non-contact type personnel heart rate and respiratory rate detection method of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps of: after searching and positioning personnel by using an unmanned plane, acquiring personnel video data by using camera equipment, and then, based on the principles of personnel face recognition and optical flow detection, estimating personnel heart rate information by analyzing tiny color changes of facial skin, and estimating personnel breathing information by analyzing facial tiny expression changes based on image processing and personnel facial motion changes. The invention also provides a non-contact type personnel heart rate and respiratory rate detection system of the unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle acquisition unit, a personnel heart rate acquisition unit and a personnel respiratory rate acquisition unit. The invention solves the problem that the prior art cannot detect the vital sign state of wounded in a complex combat environment. The invention can search and rescue wounded in time in the face of complex combat environment and can collect the vital signs of the wounded while searching and rescuing.

title_en: Search and rescue robot system for map exploration and search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model is suitable for the field of robots, and provides a search and rescue robot system for map exploration and a search and rescue robot. Compared with the prior art, the solid-state laser radar is adopted to enable the search and rescue robot to be lower in cost, smaller in weight, smaller in size and more flexible in body; the visual angle of the solid-state laser radar is improved through a rotatable steering engine fixed with the solid-state laser radar; an extended Kalman filter is provided that can accurately reconstruct positioning data in combination with different sources of information. The robot of the search and rescue robot system for map exploration can enter a narrow space to acquire data, and can accurately acquire point cloud space data so as to facilitate exploration of rescue teams, thereby greatly reducing the risk and time consumption of search and rescue tasks.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle coverage path planning method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for planning a coverage path of an unmanned aerial vehicle, belonging to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining a search area based on real-time marine environment data, and dividing the search area into a plurality of sub-areas; taking the glancing width and the route interval of each subarea as decision variables and taking the duration, the path coverage rate and the target detection rate of the unmanned aerial vehicle as constraints to construct a single unmanned aerial vehicle coverage path planning model of each subarea; based on a single unmanned aerial vehicle coverage path planning model of each subarea, taking minimized searching time and maximized searching success rate as objective functions, taking unmanned aerial vehicle endurance, path coverage rate, target detection rate and minimum turning radius as constraints, and adopting a multi-target optimization algorithm to determine a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle coverage path planning result. The invention determines the search area through real-time marine environment data and combines a multi-objective optimization algorithm to solve the problem of low maritime search and rescue efficiency and success rate of people falling into water.
assignees: SANYA SCIENCE AND EDUCATION INNOVATION PARK WUHAN UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Air-ground dual-purpose rescue robot and deformation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-ground dual-purpose rescue robot and a deformation method, comprising the following steps: the robot body is provided with a supporting frame below; one end of the at least four rotating arms is in rotating fit on the robot body and comprises a driving gear in rotating fit; the propeller is in rotating fit with one end of the rotating arm far away from the robot body; the rotating outer frame is coaxially matched with the propeller in a rotating way, and driven teeth meshed with the driving gear are arranged on the inner side wall of the rotating outer frame; the rescue robot is provided with a first state and a second state, and in the first state, the rotating arm, the rotating outer frame and the propeller are horizontally arranged; under the second state, the rotating arm, the rotating outer frame and the screw are vertically arranged, the rotating outer frame is propped against the ground, the driving gear drives the rotating outer frame to independently rotate and the supporting frame is suspended, and the free switching between the driving mode and the flying mode can be realized, so that different requirements in the detection and rescue processes in roads and tunnels can be met.
assignees: ZHEJIANG COMMUNICATIONS INVESTMENT GROUP EXPRESSWAY OPERATION MAN CO LTD

title_en: Amphibious robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a amphibious robot which comprises a robot body, a plurality of connecting components and a plurality of main motors, wherein each main motor is connected with the robot body through a connecting component, the robot body simultaneously changes the directions of the corresponding main motors through the connecting components, and the robot is controlled to switch among at least three movement modes of air, land and underwater. The invention can generate three different modes of movement, has simple structure and convenient control, can be applied to occasions such as geological exploration, underwater search and rescue or obstacle sweeping in the military field, and has wide application prospect.
assignees: NINGBO INST MATERIALS TECH & ENG CAS

title_en: Multifunctional emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional emergency rescue robot, which comprises a rescue robot body, wherein one forward advancing end of the rescue robot body is provided with an obstacle removing shovel for removing obstacles; a mechanical gripper for gripping the rescue object is arranged at the top end of the rescue robot body; the top end of the rescue robot body is provided with a smoke filtering box for filtering smoke particles, one end of the smoke filtering box facing forward is provided with a smoke inlet pipe communicated with the smoke filtering box, the outer end of the smoke inlet pipe is provided with a smoke collecting cover, and a smoke suction fan is arranged in the smoke inlet pipe; the gas is discharged from the exhaust pipe on the smoke filtering box through the filtering screen plate, particles are filtered into the smoke filtering box, and the particles in the smoke can be sucked into the smoke filtering box, so that the harm to human health caused by excessive suction of the particles in the smoke in a fire scene is avoided.
assignees: SHANGHAI KEXIN INFORMATION TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Integrated diver wearing acoustic support system and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention provides an integrated acoustic support system for diver wearing and an implementation method thereof, comprising the following steps: the system comprises a wearable image sonar and an underwater communication positioning machine, wherein the wearable image sonar is in communication connection with the underwater communication positioning machine; the wearable image sonar provides real-time image monitoring of the underwater environment for the diver, and the underwater communication positioning machine provides real-time underwater wireless voice communication and beacon positioning capability for the diver based on the real-time image of the underwater environment. The invention adopts the technical means of underwater wireless communication, beacon positioning, image detection and the like to construct a multifunctional wearable acoustic support system, thereby effectively guaranteeing that the diving operators can develop the underwater salvage, search and rescue, cutting and other operation tasks under the condition that the construction environment can be clearly observed, simultaneously realizing the real-time information communication between the water surface and the underwater clusters, and being beneficial to the rapid and efficient realization of the tasks and the safety guarantee of the diving operators.
assignees: SHANGHAI SHIP ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT RES INSTITUTE CHINA STATE SHIPBUILDING CORPORATION NO 726 RES INS

title_en: Outdoor wrecking personnel search and rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an outdoor emergency personnel search and rescue device which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a dustproof assembly and a cleaning assembly, wherein a fixed seat is arranged at the bottom end of the unmanned aerial vehicle, a through hole is formed in the fixed seat, the dustproof assembly comprises a dustproof pipe sleeved with the unmanned aerial vehicle, a first baffle hinged to the bottom of the dustproof pipe and a second baffle hinged to the bottom of the dustproof pipe, and the cleaning assembly comprises a fixed plate, brush wires, a stud and a second nut, the fixed plate is abutted to the inner wall of the fixed seat, the brush wires are arranged at the bottom end of the fixed plate, and the stud is in threaded connection with the stud. In the utility model, the stud of the cleaning assembly can be inserted into the through hole on the fixed seat, the first nut can be rotated to fix the stud, the motor can be controlled to drive the rotating seat and the camera to rotate after the stud is inserted, and the rotating camera can rub with the brush wires, so that dirt on the camera can be automatically cleaned by utilizing the friction effect, and the cleaning assembly is convenient to use.
assignees: UNIV ELECTRONIC SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CHINA ZHONGSHAN INST

title_en: water rescue drone
title_ko: 수상구조드론
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a water rescue drone with a new structure capable of effectively rescuing a shipwrecked person generated on the water. The water rescue drone according to the present invention is provided with a life tube (30) connected to a winch (20), and in a state in which the life tube (30) is lowered so that the shipwrecked person can hold the life tube (30), a flight vehicle (A) is adjusted to move and rescue a riverside or a coastal horizontal shipwrecked person, thereby having an advantage of more effectively rescuing the shipwrecked person more effectively compared to a conventional life tube (30), which requires the shipwrecked person to swim under their own power.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 수상에서 발생된 조난자를 효과적으로 구조할 수 있도록 된 새로운 구조의 수상구조드론에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 수상구조드론은, 윈치(20)에 연결된 구명튜브(30)가 구비되어, 구명튜브(30)를 하강시켜 조난자가 구명튜브(30)를 잡을 수 있도록 한 상태에서, 비행체(A)를 조정하여 강변이나 해안가로 조난자를 이동시켜 구조할 수 있음으로, 조난자가 자력으로 헤엄을 쳐야 하는 종래의 구명튜브(30)에 비해 조난자를 더욱 효과적으로 구조할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle searches for and rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model provides an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles and comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, wherein a propeller is arranged at the top of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, supporting legs are arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, an electric push rod is arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a plurality of cameras are annularly arranged at the outer side of the electric push rod, a clamping device is arranged at the bottom of the electric push rod, a storage battery is arranged in the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, and a control panel is arranged at the top of the storage battery. The clamping device of this device, through driving motor corotation and reversal, accomplish the centre gripping to small-size object, promote the efficiency of searching and rescuing, the camera annular is installed in the bottom of unmanned aerial vehicle main part simultaneously, enlarges the field of vision when searching and rescuing, helps clamping device to carry out the centre gripping, because the landing leg is bow-shaped landing leg, provides the buffering when descending for unmanned aerial vehicle, promotes the security.

title_en: Fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent fire-fighting equipment, and particularly provides a fire-fighting rescue robot, which comprises a robot body, wherein a mounting plate is arranged on the robot body, and a connecting hole for connecting a fire-fighting medium is formed in the mounting plate; the spray head assembly is provided with a plurality of spray heads respectively provided with different spray openings, and is arranged on the mounting plate; the switching component is arranged on the mounting plate and is connected with the spray head component; the switching component is used for driving the spray head component to move relative to the mounting plate so as to respectively connect a plurality of spray heads with the connecting holes. Through setting up the hydrojet subassembly of a plurality of shower nozzles that have different hydrojet mouths respectively to set up hydrojet subassembly on switching component, and all set up hydrojet subassembly and switching component on the mounting panel, and then can drive different shower nozzles through switching component and remove relative the mounting panel, so that the shower nozzle that has different hydrojet mouths is connected with the connecting hole, realizes the automatic switch of different shower nozzles.

title_en: Post-disaster rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a post-disaster rescue robot, which comprises a vehicle body, wherein the vehicle body is used for supporting an integral device; the two groups of travelling mechanisms are respectively arranged at two sides of the vehicle body and are used for driving the vehicle body to travel; the cleaning mechanism is arranged at the upper part of the vehicle body and is used for cleaning cement; and the cutting mechanism is arranged on one side of the vehicle body and is used for cutting the collapse building. The utility model is provided with the cleaning mechanism and the cutting mechanism, can realize the cleaning and cutting functions at the same time, is provided with the camera, can perform image transmission while cleaning and rescuing the scene, is convenient for rescue personnel to judge the scene condition, is provided with the dismantling mechanism and the illuminating lamp, can dismantle the non-collapsed wall, and can also realize the illumination of the rescue scene.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary positioning method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary positioning method, an unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary positioning device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining an initial estimated position of target equipment according to a first broadcast signal received by the target unmanned aerial vehicle on a first track, wherein the first broadcast signal is sent by the target equipment; iterative optimization of a second track of the target unmanned aerial vehicle by adopting a heuristic algorithm, wherein each iterative optimization process is as follows: determining the sequence of positioning the personnel to be searched and rescued by the target unmanned aerial vehicle according to the initial estimated position; based on the sequence, determining a second track of the target unmanned aerial vehicle by taking the reduced positioning time as a target according to the initial estimated position, the initial estimated position error and the positioning error required by the search and rescue system; and determining the target estimated position of the target equipment according to a second broadcast signal received by the target unmanned aerial vehicle on the second track, wherein the second broadcast signal is sent by the target equipment. The method improves the positioning precision of the unmanned aerial vehicle, effectively shortens the positioning time of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and realizes accurate rescue of the personnel to be searched and rescued.

title_en: Small-size changeable crawler-type search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and provides a small-sized variable crawler-type search and rescue robot which comprises a fixed frame, a driving wheel, a crawler, a first variable driven wheel assembly and a second variable driven wheel assembly, wherein the components in the first variable driven wheel assembly and the second variable driven wheel assembly are consistent, the driving wheel, the first driven wheel and the second driven wheel in the first variable driven wheel assembly are all arranged on the surface of the fixed frame, the crawler is in transmission connection with the outer sides of the driving wheel, the first driven wheel and the second driven wheel, one ends of a rotating shell and a telescopic rod are respectively connected with the first driven wheel and the second driven wheel, the other ends of the telescopic rod are movably sleeved in the rotating shell, an arc plate is fixedly connected with the surface of the rotating shell, a tooth-shaped groove is formed in the surface of the arc plate, a driving part is in transmission connection with the tooth-shaped groove, one end of the telescopic rod is fixedly connected with the surface of the rotating shell, and the other end of the telescopic rod is fixedly connected with the surface of the telescopic rod.

title_en: Multipurpose drone
title_ko: 다목적 드론
abstract_ko:
본 고안의 일실시예에 따른 다목적 드론은, 드론의 본체의 하방향으로 연장되어 상기 드론이 착륙시의 지면으로부터 상기 본체를 이격시키는 다리부, 상기 다리부를 둘러싸는 클램프부에 의해 고정되는 판부, 상기 판부 상면에 고정됨과 동시에 상기 본체와 결착되는 전력공급부, 상기 판부 하면에 고정되는 브라켓부, 상기 브라켓부에 고정되는 제1 보관함, 상기 제1 보관함 하면에 고정되는 제1 중심구조체 및 상기 제1 중심구조체에 일단이 결합되어 상기 드론의 하방 사선으로 연장되는 제1 주변구조체를 포함하는 제1 연결부, 상기 제1 주변구조체 타단에 결합되는 제2 보관함, 상기 제2 보관함에 결합되는 제2 중심구조체 및 상기 제2 중심구조체에서 일단이 양방향으로 연장되는 제2 주변구조체를 포함하는 제2 연결부, 상기 제2 주변구조체의 타단에 회전 가능하게 결합되고 조명부와 오디오부를 포함하는 조명방송모듈 및 상기 본체에서 하방으로 연장되어 결합되는 카메라부를 포함한다. 
본 고안에 따른 다목적 드론은 수색견에 무전기, 추적장비 및 카메라 장치 등을 탑재하고 드론에는 카메라, 서치라이트, 통신중계기, 무전기 및 스피커 등을 탑재하여, 드론이 수색견을 쫓아 수색 지점에서의 상황을 중계하고 수색견 또는 목표물을 향한 방송을 실시할 수 있도록 할 수 있으며 계곡등 통신 불가지역에서도 통신중계가 가능하다.

title_en: Emergency situation supporting method related to drone monitoring system
title_ko: 드론 모니터링시스템과 연계된 긴급 상황 지원서비스방법
abstract_en: An emergency situation support service method associated with a drone monitoring system is disclosed. The emergency situation support service method associated with the drone monitoring system of the present invention includes: the steps of: receiving location information of the drone using a server connected to the drone through a mobile communication network; and providing the location of the user in the tidal flat by the drone monitoring system connected to the server. When a safety accident including the user's distress or disappearance occurs in the tidal flat, the drone monitoring system provides the user's location and controls the drone to search for the user.
abstract_ko: 드론 모니터링시스템과 연계된 긴급 상황 지원서비스방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 드론 모니터링시스템과 연계된 긴급 상황 지원서비스방법은, 이동통신망을 통해 드론과 연결된 서버를 이용하여 상기 드론의 위치 정보를 수신하는 단계; 및 상기 서버와 연결된 드론 모니터링 시스템에 의해 상기 갯골에서 사용자의 위치를 제공하는 단계를 포함하되, 상기 갯골에서 사용자의 조난이나 실종을 포함하는 안전 사고의 발생 시 상기 드론 모니터링 시스템은 사용자의 위치를 제공함과 아울러 상기 드론으로 사용자를 수색하도록 제어하는 것을 포함한다.

title_en: Ruins and transportation rescue robot based on space expansion under narrow space
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ruin and transportation rescue robot based on space expansion under a narrow space, and relates to the technical field of emergency rescue. When facing the narrow space generated after collapse, the robot can enter the narrow space through the thin seam between collapse to rescue, the robot can detect the proper supporting point in the narrow space through the infrared sensing device equipped with the robot when entering the narrow space, the coal mine single anti-falling fixing device and the hydraulic single prop clamping device on the rescue robot chassis can fix the supporting point which is recognized, the rescue robot can stretch into a plurality of honeycomb structure units from the original spiral structure after fixing, the air bags are installed outside the honeycomb structure units, the air bags gradually grow in the process of continuously outwards stretching, and accordingly the narrow space is expanded, and the purpose of rescuing the narrow space is achieved.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & TECH CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based personnel search and rescue method
abstract_en: The application discloses a personnel search and rescue method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps: controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly; acquiring visible light video streams and infrared video streams of the same environment in real time through imaging equipment carried on the unmanned aerial vehicle holder; wherein; determining whether the personnel to be searched and rescued exist in the current environment according to the visible light video stream, and if the personnel to be searched and rescued exist in the current environment; determining whether the personnel to be searched and rescuing exist in the current environment again according to the infrared video stream; and acquiring longitude and latitude information of personnel under the view angle of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the human body pixel points in the visible light image and the flight control data of the unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the application, secondary confirmation is carried out on the personnel to be searched and rescued through the visible light video stream and the infrared video stream, false detection caused by complex terrains and the like is avoided, meanwhile, the accuracy of a prediction result can be greatly improved, and the detection capability of a tiny target is enhanced.

title_en: Missing Person Searching System Using Smart Device Based on Drone
title_ko: 드론 기반의 스마트기기를 활용한 실종자 추적 시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a missing person tracking system using drone-based smart devices. The missing person tracking system using drone-based smart devices includes: a searcher smart device that receives a missing person ID from the outside through a wireless communication network and transmits missing person identification information and missing person location information to the outside; a drone that receives a seed ID from the outside through a wireless communication network and transmits GPS information, altitude information, missing person identification information and missing person location information to the outside, and takes aerial photographs of the area when the missing person smart device is called; and a management server that stores missing person personal information internally, transmits a missing person ID with missing person personal information encrypted to the searcher smart device and drone, and transmits GIS information on the missing person's location to the searcher smart device. According to the present invention, the search area can be prevented from being duplicated or a specific area from being excluded from the search area.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 드론 기반의 스마트기기를 활용한 실종자 추적 시스템에 관한 것으로, 무선 통신망을 통해 외부로부터 실종자가 소지한 실종자 스마트기기를 호출할 수 있는 실종자 ID를 전송받고, GPS 정보와 함께 실종자 스마트기기로부터의 응답여부에 따른 실종자 인식 정보와 실종자 위치 정보를 외부로 전송하는 수색자 스마트기기; 무선 통신망을 통해 외부로부터 실종자가 소지한 실종자 스마트기기를 호출할 수 있는 실종자 ID를 전송받고, GPS 정보, 고도 정보, 실종자 인식 정보 및 실종자 위치 정보를 외부로 전송하며, 실종자 스마트기기가 호출될 때에는 해당 지역의 항공사진을 촬영하는 드론; 및 실종자 구조요청 시 입력되는 실종자 개인정보를 내부에 저장하고, 실종자 개인정보를 암호화한 실종자 ID를 수색자 스마트기기 및 드론으로 전송하며, 수색자 스마트기기와 드론으로부터 전송되는 실종자 인식 정보, GPS 정보, 고도 및 항공사진을 통해 실종자 수색반경 및 실종자의 위치를 분석한 후 실종자 위치에 대한 GIS 정보를 수색자 스마트기기로 전송하는 관리서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Remote unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a remote unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device which comprises a machine body, wherein driving devices are fixedly arranged at the top of the machine body, the number of the driving devices is two, the two driving devices are symmetrically distributed, a propeller is fixedly arranged at the output end of the driving device, a supporting frame is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the machine body, an anti-slip sleeve is fixedly arranged on the surface of the supporting frame and is made of rubber materials, a connecting block is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the machine body, a shooting assembly and a wiping assembly are arranged at the bottom of the connecting block, water tanks are fixedly arranged at the left side and the right side of the connecting block, and auxiliary assemblies are arranged on the surface of the water tanks.
assignees: BEIJING TIANSHU TONGDA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for fire control search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a bearing seat, wherein the bearing seat is also provided with: the storage assembly comprises a coiling wheel which is movably arranged, and a coiling groove is formed in the coiling wheel; the buffer assembly comprises a buffer piece and a third elastic piece. According to the firefighting search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle provided by the invention, the bearing seat is connected to the unmanned aerial vehicle, the cable is released or stored through the reel, the unmanned aerial vehicle is convenient to move in a running way, the unmanned aerial vehicle forwards moves through the cable to pull the floating plate to move, the extending part is inclined due to the action of tensile force, the cable is pulled to incline and push the abutting plate to drive the buffer member to overcome the third elastic member to slide, the abutting plate and the buffer member are used for buffering the extending part, the problem that the cable is pulled to break due to overlarge acceleration of the unmanned aerial vehicle is avoided, the acceleration of the floating plate in the pulling movement is reduced, and the problem that the floating plate falls off or the floating plate slides quickly to cause personnel to fall into water is avoided.

title_en: Underwater search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides an underwater search and rescue robot which comprises a shell, side plates, a robot main body, a camera, a protective cover, a transparent cover, a water spray pipe and a miniature water pump, wherein the side plates are arranged on the shell; the plastic garbage collecting device is provided with the water spraying pipe communicated with the miniature water pump, when plastic garbage is arranged on the transparent cover, the water spraying pipe can generate high-speed water flow to push away the plastic garbage, and meanwhile, the robot main body retreats, so that the situation that the plastic garbage is wound on the camera is reduced, and the robot can better perform underwater operation.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle wounded person search and rescue system and method based on deep learning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle wounded person search and rescue system and method based on a deep learning method, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, wherein the search and rescue system comprises a remote controller, a ground station system and an unmanned aerial vehicle; the remote controller is used for controlling the flight direction, the height and the speed of the unmanned aerial vehicle; the ground station system is used for receiving and processing information transmitted back by the unmanned aerial vehicle, planning a track of a patrol area of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and automatically generating a wounded condition evaluation report according to model data information returned by an onboard computer; the unmanned aerial vehicle is used for searching and positioning wounded persons and detecting in a non-contact mode. The search and rescue method comprises the step of controlling a remote controller, a ground station system and an unmanned aerial vehicle. The invention combines computer vision and artificial intelligence capability, can quickly search and identify wounded, can detect important vital signs such as body temperature, heart rate, respiratory frequency and the like of the wounded and detect the consciousness state of the wounded in a non-contact way, provides wounded injury evaluation reports for medical staff, and improves rescue efficiency.

title_en: Snake-shaped underwater search and rescue robot and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a snake-shaped underwater search and rescue robot and a use method thereof, wherein the snake-shaped underwater search and rescue robot comprises a snake head module, a motion balancing module, a forward power module, a bending module, a control module, a power supply module and a snake tail module which are sequentially connected, the snake head module is integrated with a plurality of functional modules which are convenient for collecting information, the motion balancing module is used for adjusting the forward gesture of the robot, the forward power module is used for providing forward power for the robot, the bending module is used for adjusting the advancing path of the robot, the snake head module, the motion balancing module and the outside of the snake tail module are respectively provided with a touch sensor, and the control module can control the motion balancing module and the forward power module to complete the adjustment of the advancing path of the robot based on signals fed back by the touch sensors. The underwater snake-shaped robot is designed according to a bionic principle, can search trapped personnel in the cabin inside the ship which is turned over and buckled, and has definite division of work of each part of modules and convenient installation and maintenance.

title_en: Complex environment search and rescue method based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a complex environment search and rescue method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, and relates to the technical field of rescue and search and rescue. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle is provided with the onboard computer and the depth camera, is matched with a slam frame fused with the laser radar and the vision, and fuses the built-in IMU data of the depth camera on the basis of the slam frame, so that the effects of self positioning and real-time image construction are achieved. The local path planning adopts an improved EGO-Planner algorithm, and the function of fully autonomous planning path flight is realized through remote setting of goal-point. In a search and rescue scene, a human body is identified through a YOLO-V5 target detection algorithm, and the identification accuracy is improved by combining a thermal imaging module at night. In the inspection scene, the segmentation of instruments and meters and accurate reading are realized through SEGMENT ANYTHING Model (SAM). And under the condition of exploring unknown environmental scenes (such as karst cave and mine cave), generating a three-dimensional point cloud map through visual slam to obtain the geometric structure and shape information of the unknown scenes. The invention can search and rescue in areas where manpower cannot reach, and can carry out emergency response under the conditions of natural disasters, human accidents and the like.

title_en: Underwater robot for emergency detection and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater robot for emergency detection and rescue, which comprises a shell, an advancing screw propeller arranged on the rear side of the shell, lifting screw propellers arranged on the front side and the middle part of the rear side of the shell, and a circuit connection joint connected to the center of the rear side wall of the shell, wherein a transparent cover is arranged in the middle of the front side wall of the shell, light supplementing lamps are arranged on two sides of the front side wall of the shell, a camera is arranged in the transparent cover, and a shake compensation mechanism is arranged on the rear side of the camera. According to the invention, the design of preventing fish ventral fins can be achieved by arranging the stopping mechanism, and the fan-shaped telescopic air bags provide running resistance for the robot, so that the robot can finish stopping after the speed is reduced, the damage caused by collision of the robot under water is avoided, and the safety of underwater search and rescue of the robot is improved; through setting up arc edge and humidity transducer, can reach in time remind the operator robot to take place the infiltration phenomenon, realize the infiltration monitoring and the warning function of robot.
assignees: HENAN JINCHANZI SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Maritime search and rescue method and system based on 5G satellite communication and satellite positioning
abstract_en: A maritime search and rescue method and system based on 5G satellite communication and satellite positioning are characterized by comprising the following steps: real-time monitoring global maritime traffic and meteorological data by utilizing artificial intelligence and big data analysis; constructing an offshore accident prediction model, and determining a possible offshore accident occurrence area based on historical data and model prediction; automatically identifying help seeking signals by using a machine learning algorithm, and transmitting information to a search and rescue command center through 5G satellite communication; the position of a search and rescue target is determined based on an image recognition technology through satellite image analysis, satellite images, robot sensor data, 5G communication data and satellite positioning information are integrated, a comprehensive scene graph is constructed, and the image is utilized to coordinate search and rescue actions. The invention can rapidly acquire and transmit help signal information by combining the 5G satellite communication and satellite positioning technology, and quickens the response speed of search and rescue, thereby improving the search and rescue efficiency, reducing false alarm and missing report and ensuring that rescue resources are utilized most effectively.

title_en: Deep ultraviolet detector
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a deep ultraviolet detector which comprises a detector shell, wherein an ultraviolet wire slot is arranged in the middle of any side of the detector shell, a deep ultraviolet receiver is arranged in the ultraviolet wire slot, and an ash removing structure is arranged on the top surface of the detector shell. According to the utility model, the ash removing structure is arranged on the top surface of the detector shell, when dust and impurities are attached to the deep ultraviolet receiver in the flight process of the unmanned aerial vehicle, four air inlet fans can be started, so that air flow is blown out from the air source pipe through the two air outlet holes, the dust and impurities attached to the deep ultraviolet receiver are blown down, meanwhile, the filter screen can prevent the impurities from being attached to the ash removing air flow, the ash removing effect is further improved, the deep ultraviolet receiver cannot influence the ultraviolet receiving detection effect due to the attached dust and impurities, the deep ultraviolet detection effect is improved, and the maritime search and rescue efficiency is improved.
assignees: JIANGSU NANDA FIVE DIMENSIONAL ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-assisted edge computing and unloading method
abstract_en: An edge computing and unloading method based on unmanned aerial vehicle assistance belongs to the field of Internet of things. Aiming at the extreme situation that communication infrastructures such as sudden natural disasters or accidents cannot work normally, the edge calculation key technology in the process of generating the unloading strategy of the unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary mobile equipment is researched. Aiming at the problem of generating the unloading strategy of the mobile equipment, the unmanned aerial vehicle and the edge computing service vehicle can be considered to serve as auxiliary unloading equipment, so that the mobile equipment can be helped to share computing tasks. Firstly, modeling a task model, respectively analyzing time and energy consumption generated by local calculation, unmanned aerial vehicle calculation and edge calculation service vehicle calculation, aiming at minimizing the time and the energy consumption, and proposing to optimize an unloading strategy by using a deep reinforcement learning method based on a dual-delay depth deterministic strategy gradient. The algorithm used by the invention can obviously reduce time delay and energy consumption, especially for search and rescue robots, can increase endurance time and search capacity, and has great practical value.

title_en: Amphibious bionic jellyfish robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of underwater rescue, and particularly relates to an amphibious bionic jellyfish robot which comprises a head shell, wherein a thrust mechanism is fixedly connected to the head shell in the tail end direction of a Z axis, a plurality of double-freedom-degree adjusting pieces are fixedly connected to the head shell in the tail end direction of the Z axis and positioned on the periphery of the thrust mechanism, telescopic supporting legs are assembled on the double-freedom-degree adjusting pieces, the thrust mechanism comprises a first waterproof motor fixedly connected to the interior of the head shell, the output end of the first waterproof motor extends to the head shell in the tail end direction of the Z axis and is fixedly connected with a spiral sheet, the double-freedom-degree adjusting piece comprises a third waterproof motor fixedly connected to the tail end of the Z axis of the head shell and positioned on the periphery of the spiral sheet, the output end of the third waterproof motor is positioned in the tail end direction of the Z axis of a winding mechanism, and the output end of the third waterproof motor is fixedly connected with an outer frame. The invention can perform amphibious operation on land and under water, and is well suitable for search and rescue operation in complex environments in flood areas.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted real-time action detection method and system for search and rescue scene
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted real-time action detection method and system for search and rescue scenes, which are characterized in that the position information, the gesture type and the key point information of human bones of trapped people are obtained through a human body gesture estimation network, the characteristics of the trapped people are matched in time sequence by adopting a multi-target tracking network, and the structure information of the key points of the human bones in time and space is captured by a hand-waving help-seeking action detection network, so that the detection of the hand-waving help-seeking actions of multiple people in complex scenes is realized. According to the invention, the human body posture estimation network, the multi-target tracking network and the hand-waving help-seeking action detection network are deployed on the unmanned plane board card by the edge neural network acceleration method, so that the effect of detecting the hand-waving help-seeking action of trapped personnel in real time is achieved.
assignees: HUADONG INSTITUTE OF COMPUTING TECH CETC NO 32 RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Mining-influenced coal mine water burst rescue robot and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention provides a mining-affected coal mine water inrush rescue robot and a rescue system, wherein the mining-affected coal mine water inrush rescue robot comprises a mine flood alarm system, a mine flood monitoring center, a robot control center and a robot body, wherein the mine flood alarm system, the mine flood monitoring center and the robot control center are connected by wireless signals, and the robot body comprises a rescue cabin, a mechanical arm, a mechanical leg and an image falcon camera and is responsible for going to a flood occurrence place for rescue; and the real-time condition in the roadway can be transmitted to a mine flood monitoring center through wireless signals. The invention realizes accurate positioning and timely rescue, can effectively reduce mine loss and casualties, and has great significance for improving mine flood accident rescue.

title_en: A drone system for seashore patrol and search
title_ko: 해안 순찰 및 수색을 위한 드론 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a drone system (1000) for coastal patrol and search. the drone system (1000) may comprise: a drone (100) having a camera (120) configured to photograph a coastal area; and a ground computer (200) having a communication unit (220) configured to receive an image photographed by the drone (100).
abstract_ko: 해안 순찰 및 수색을 위한 드론 시스템(1000)이 제공된다.  상기 드론 시스템(1000)은 해안 지역을 촬영하도록 구성되는 카메라(120)가 구비되는 드론(100); 및 상기 드론(100)에 의해 촬영되는 영상을 수신하도록 구성되는 통신부(220)가 구비되는 지상 컴퓨터(200)를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Marine rescue robot
title_ko: 수중 구난 로봇
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an underwater rescue robot comprises a main body, a sensor unit, a photographing unit, a control unit, a traction module, and a fixing module. The main body is provided with a buoyancy control unit and a propulsion unit to move in water. The sensor unit senses at least one of a water depth, a water pressure, a water temperature, a direction of a tidal current, and a speed of the tidal current at a point where the main body is located. The photographing unit photographs the surroundings of the main body. The control unit determines a target based on information obtained from at least one of the sensor unit and the photographing unit. The traction module pulls the target around the main body to the main body. The fixing module fixes the target pulled to the main body through the traction module to the main body.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 수중 구난 로봇은 본체, 센서부, 촬영부, 제어부, 견인모듈 및 고정모듈을 포함한다. 본체에는 수중에서 이동할 수 있도록 부력조절부 및 추진부가 구비된다. 센서부는 본체가 위치한 지점의 수심, 수압, 수온, 조류의 방향 및 조류의 속도 중 적어도 하나를 감지한다. 촬영부는 본체의 주변을 촬영한다. 제어부는 센서부 및 촬영부 중 적어도 하나로부터 획득한 정보를 기초로 목표물을 결정한다. 견인모듈은 본체 주변의 목표물을 본체로 당긴다. 고정모듈은 견인모듈을 통해 본체로 당겨진 목표물을 본체에 대하여 고정한다.

title_en: Light-weight electric unmanned emergency rescue ship, control method, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a light-weight electric unmanned emergency rescue ship, a control method, a device and a storage medium. The front end of the ship is provided with a cleaning mechanism, a camera group and an alarm lamp, the top of the ship is provided with a solar panel and a cabin, the lower part of the ship is provided with a garbage bin, and the rear end of the ship is provided with a propulsion propeller. The unmanned aerial vehicle bottom has the supporting legs, charges with the constant head tank cooperation in the ship cabin, and group, electric lock structure and the speaker of making a video recording are equipped with to middle bottom. The life buoy is connected with the unmanned aerial vehicle through the cable, can be pulled up and put in by the unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the application, through integrating various sensors and intelligent algorithms, efficient and accurate overwater search and rescue operation is realized.

title_en: Dangerous gas composite catalyst for fire rescue site, preparation method and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dangerous gas composite catalyst for a fire rescue site, a preparation method and a rescue robot, which are prepared from calcium oxide powder and aluminum oxide powder as raw materials according to the molar ratio of 1-1.5: adding a doping agent according to 0.5% -5% of the total mass of the mixed powder after mixing 0.8, and calcining at 1000-1500 ℃ for 4-5 hours after uniformly mixing the powder to obtain doped mayenite; taking doped mayenite as a carrier, and adding the doped mayenite into water according to the solid-liquid mass ratio of 0.2-0.3:1; adding one or more raw materials of zinc nitrate, copper nitrate, magnesium nitrate or manganese nitrate according to the mass of the doped mayenite accounting for 30-50%, supplementing proper ferric nitrate according to the valence M  2+ ：M 3+  =1:2, uniformly mixing, adjusting the pH value to 9-11 by adopting a sodium hydroxide solution, aging the obtained mixture in a water bath at the temperature of 100-150 ℃ for 6-12 hours, and drying the obtained precipitate to obtain the doped mayenite/spinel composite catalyst. The invention sucks untreated gas in the environment through the air inlet fan, and the sucked gas reacts with the mayenite/spinel composite catalyst powder in the reaction chamber of the dangerous gas treatment device, so that insoluble waste gas can be treated, and the waste gas can be treated in a fixed-point positioning way, thereby reducing the casualties of fire fighters and the manual intervention, having good use effect and safer use.

title_en: Mining rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mining rescue robot, which comprises a body, a traveling device, a mask and an air supply device, wherein the traveling device is arranged on the body; the walking device comprises a walking crawler belt, a plurality of crawler wheels and a driving assembly for driving the crawler wheels to rotate, wherein the crawler wheels are rotatably connected with the body, and the crawler belt is wound on the crawler wheels; the mask is connected with the body and is provided with an air source interface and a fitting part for fitting the face; the air supply device comprises an air inlet assembly, a filtering assembly and an exhaust assembly, wherein the air inlet assembly comprises an air pump and an air inlet end, the air inlet end is detachably connected with the body, an inlet of the air pump is connected with the air inlet end, the filtering assembly is provided with an air inlet and an air outlet, an outlet of the air pump is connected with the air inlet, one end of the exhaust assembly is connected with the air outlet, and the other end of the exhaust assembly is connected with an air source interface. The mining rescue robot provided by the embodiment of the invention can filter air in the external environment, provide sufficient oxygen for trapped people, and maintain vital signs of the trapped people, so that the rescue probability of the trapped people is improved.
assignees: CHINA COAL RES INST;BEIJING TECH RESEARCH BRANCH OF TIANDI SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster search and rescue robot capable of removing obstacles and provided with multiple moving modes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster search and rescue robot capable of removing obstacles and provided with multiple moving modes, and relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots. The wheel feet and the crawler wheels arranged on the machine body can be matched to adapt to obstacle surmounting, rapid movement and special movement in different environments; the fire-fighting lance and the cooling water head arranged in front of the machine body can eliminate small fire and reduce dust, so that the visibility of the environment is improved, and the rescue is convenient; the mechanical arm of the attached mechanical claw and the mechanical arm of the attached cutting knife in the mechanical arm obstacle clearing module arranged in front of the machine body are matched to carry out obstacle clearing and simple rescue on a rescue target; the fire rescue module is arranged on the machine body and is used for cooling the machine body and the cutting device; the hydraulic system of the bearing rescue module arranged on the machine body can be matched with a plurality of rods to be used as a support for supporting the building to be collapsed. The combination of the modules and the structure can greatly improve the safety and the high efficiency of rescue.

title_en: Helicopter photoelectric pod simulation training system
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of spaceflight search and rescue training, and relates to a helicopter photoelectric pod simulation training system. The training system comprises a six-degree-of-freedom motion platform, a photoelectric pod system, a parachute-return cabin model and an unmanned aerial vehicle; the photoelectric ball is additionally arranged on the six-degree-of-freedom motion platform, then the motion trail of the helicopter is input or imported at the operation interface of the platform controller, and the operation handle of the operation panel can be normally operated by an operator to perform unfolding training. The simulation of the motion gesture of the photoelectric pod additionally arranged on the search and rescue helicopter can be realized, a training approach in a non-task period is provided for a pod operator, the training of the helicopter close to actual combat equipment when the helicopter is not in a landing field is realized, the training efficiency is improved, and the simulation method has important significance for improving the combat force.
assignees: CHINESE PEOPLES LIBERATION ARMY NO 63628 TROOPS

title_en: Air-ground collaborative life detection and mapping method applied to earthquake relief scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses an air-ground collaborative life detection and mapping method applied to an earthquake relief scene, relates to an air-ground collaborative life detection and mapping method, and belongs to the technical field of active mapping and exploration algorithms of robots. The invention aims to solve the problems that the existing method only focuses on the establishment of a map and the exploration of the environment, does not organically combine the functions of life detection and the like with the establishment of the map, and the established map often cannot play a targeted guiding role on a search and rescue task, so that the search and rescue efficiency is low and the safety is poor. The method comprises the steps of collaborative mapping of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned aerial vehicle, active exploration can be carried out under the condition of no complete map, and detection of life signs and further supplement of the map can be carried out. And the life sign information is fused with the three-dimensional map to generate a point cloud map containing the life sign information, so that targeted guidance is provided for earthquake relief, and the search and rescue efficiency and safety are effectively improved.

title_en: Crawler search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a crawler search and rescue robot, which comprises: the front vehicle body is provided with a three-degree-of-freedom cradle head; the front vehicle body and the rear vehicle body are respectively provided with a crawler unit, and the rear vehicle body is provided with a driving mechanism; one end of the connecting rod body is connected with the front vehicle body, and the other end of the connecting rod body is connected with the rear vehicle body. The utility model provides a track search and rescue robot, can make preceding automobile body and back automobile body all have good drive power through the track unit that sets up on preceding automobile body and the back automobile body, can have good drive power in the corridor and narrow and small space, can enter into and rescue the operation in the narrow and small space, simultaneously, be provided with three degree of freedom cloud platforms on preceding automobile body, can improve the range of observation of preceding automobile body, reach the effect that improves rescue efficiency, keep connecting through the connecting rod body between preceding automobile body and the back automobile body, can improve holistic trafficability characteristic, can make wholly have better obstacle crossing performance.

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rescue robot which comprises a body, a mechanical foot assembly and a rescue rod, wherein the body is provided with a traction rope which is used for being connected with an external lifting device; the mechanical foot component is rotatably arranged on the body; the rescue pole includes telescopic link and bracing piece, and telescopic link telescopic mounting is in the body, and the bracing piece rotates the one end of installing keeping away from the body in the telescopic link, and the bracing piece can rotate or keep away from the telescopic link and rotate towards the telescopic link. When the rescue robot walks to a certain depth, the telescopic rod stretches out, the driving support rod is far away from the telescopic rod to rotate, trapped personnel can stand on the support rod at the moment, the hand grasps the rescue rod, the rescue personnel outside the wellhead drive the lifting device, so that the rescue robot can be pulled outwards towards the wellhead through the traction rope, and meanwhile, the trapped personnel can also follow and move to the wellhead. Therefore, the operation danger of rescue workers can be reduced, rescue can be completed in a short time, and the survival rate of trapped workers is improved.

title_en: A real-time inspection system and method for the interior of a cavity using a cavity inspection robot
title_ko: 공동구 점검 로봇을 이용한 공동구 내부의 실시간 점검 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention provides a real-time inspection system and method for the interior of a cubicle using a cubicle inspection robot, which can detect and warn of harmful gases existing inside an underground cubicle, a communication cubicle, and a confined space in advance by a mobility method through a cubicle inspection robot, thereby preventing workers from suffocating in advance, and increasing the convenience of operation by miniaturizing the cubicle inspection robot. The real-time inspection system for the interior of a cubicle using a cubicle inspection robot comprises: a cubicle inspection robot (10) that drives inside a confined space; an RF controller (151) and a remote PC (152) for controlling the driving and direction of the cubicle inspection robot (10); an integrated server (1100) that receives and analyzes in real time various detection signals detected by the cubicle inspection robot (10), captured images, and the inclination, position, and distance values from obstacles of the cubicle inspection robot (10) measured by the cubicle inspection robot (10); and a monitor (1200) that tracks the location of a joint inspection robot (10) and displays various data values in real time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공동구 점검 로봇을 통해 지하공동구, 통신구, 밀폐공간의 내부에 존재하는 유해가스를 모빌리티 방식에 의해 미연에 감지,경보할 수 있도록 하여 작업자의 질식 재해를 사전에 예방하고, 공동구 점검 로봇의 소형화로 운용 편의성이 증대되고, 공동구 점검 로봇의 주행 안정성과 주행 조작을 편리하게 할 수 있도록 한 공동구 점검 로봇 및 이의 제어 방법을 제공한다. 본 발명의 적절한 실시 형태에 따르면, 지하공동구, 통신구를 비롯한 밀폐공간 내 유해가스 감지 및 인명수색용으로 사용되는 공동구 점검 로봇에 있어서, 전면부에 카메라 및 LED 램프가 설치되고 상부에 센서박스를 탑재시킨 로봇 본체와; 상기 로봇 본체에 상호 나란하게 배치되어 회전가능하게 지지되어 있는 한 쌍의 구동샤프트와; 상기 한 쌍의 구동샤프트와 각각 나란하게 일측에 위치하여 로봇 본체의 중심축에 대하여 상호 대칭적으로 배치됨과 동시에 기어 결합을 통해 각각의 구동샤프트를 상호 반대 방향으로 회전 구동시키는 한 쌍의 구동모터와; 상기 한 쌍의 구동샤프트에 대해 각기 직각방향으로 위치하여 로봇 본체의 하부측 전후좌우 4개소에 각기 하향 각도를 가지고 경사지게 배치되어 회전 지지되며, 한 쌍의 구동샤프트와 기어결합을 통해 연결되어 회전 구동되는 4개의 앵글 휠샤프트와; 4개의 앵글 휠샤프트에 각기 연결되어 회전 구동하는 앵글 스포크 휠;을 포함한 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning method for underground rescue task
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-agent reinforcement learning method aiming at an underground rescue problem, which mainly solves the problem of low efficiency in the underground rescue task in the prior art. The implementation scheme is as follows: modeling the underground rescue task as a partially observable markov process; respectively generating an action space, an observation space and a state space of the environment of the rescue robot according to the environmental characteristics and the actions of the robot; the reward functions of the two subtasks approaching and rescuing are integrated according to the characteristic design of the task; generating an optimal rescue strategy by using a hybrid Q network algorithm according to the actions, observations, rewards obtained and the environment state of the robot; and controlling the robot to execute the underground rescue task by utilizing the optimal rescue strategy. The invention can enable the robot to execute rescue tasks in a more real and challenging environment, has better generalization capability, effectively improves the efficiency of underground rescue tasks, and can be used for treating earthquake, mine and building collapse accidents.

title_en: Rescue unmanned aerial vehicle megaphone
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle megaphone, which comprises an outer cylinder, an inner cylinder, a cradle head and a camera device. The outer barrel is connected with the cloud platform, and the cloud platform is connected with unmanned aerial vehicle through the female head that connects soon, is provided with camera device at the front end of inner tube, and camera device is including connecting portion, installs the camera in connecting portion to install the visor through tongue-and-groove detachable on connecting portion, wherein be provided with the tongue-and-groove at connecting portion periphery, the tongue-and-groove is including vertical portion and horizontal portion, is provided with the tenon inboard the protective cover, and the tenon cooperatees with vertical portion and horizontal portion respectively to be provided with the locking device between tenon and horizontal portion. When the system is used, the situation of the ground can be observed through the camera, so that the system is beneficial to efficient search and rescue work, and can be matched with the megaphone to realize pacifying and guiding of the ground personnel to be rescued, and has important significance in guaranteeing the life safety of the personnel to be rescued.
