assignees: HENAN WANXINGXINGCHI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Folding supporting type search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a folding supporting type search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle which comprises a device main body and a driving assembly, wherein clamping grooves are formed in two ends of the device main body, a supporting device is arranged in each clamping groove, a limiting block is arranged at the top of each supporting device, one end of each limiting block is connected with a sliding rod which is in sliding connection with the device main body, and springs are sleeved on the sliding rods; the two sides of the supporting device are rotatably connected with arc-shaped supporting frames, connecting rods are arranged on the arc-shaped supporting frames, and electric telescopic rods are connected between the connecting rods and the supporting device; the drive electric shaft is installed to device main part tip, and drive electric shaft one side is connected with the support arm, through promoting the stopper, makes stopper compression spring and slip, and then makes strutting arrangement shift out the draw-in groove, makes unmanned aerial vehicle's support frame dismantle fast when the trouble, has solved the extending structure setting of current unmanned aerial vehicle's support frame inside unmanned aerial vehicle, is inconvenient for the problem of maintaining.

title_en: Offshore underwater search and rescue cabin
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of underwater rescue, and in particular relates to an offshore underwater rescue bin, which comprises a bin body and further comprises: a distribution room; the accommodating cylinders are distributed in the bin body along the circumferential array, the opening parts of the accommodating cylinders extend out of the bin body, the inside of the accommodating cylinders are sequentially provided with a lifting mechanism, a top plate, a winding disc and a cover plate from top to bottom, the lifting mechanism penetrates out of the accommodating cylinders upwards and extends into the bin body, the lifting mechanism is fixedly connected with the top plate, the lower surface of the top plate is fixedly provided with a rotating mechanism for rotating the winding disc, and a mounting plate is fixed between the upper surface of the cover plate and one side of the top plate; the underwater robots are located on the upper surfaces of the corresponding cover plates and are opposite to the top plate; and a water pumping mechanism. The invention can finish the sending out, advancing, returning and recycling of a plurality of underwater robots and cables thereof, is matched with each other smoothly, and is beneficial to conveniently and rapidly carrying out the combined rescue of the cabin body and the underwater robots.
assignees: ANHUI HONGQIANG GENERAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue car with elevation structure
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of emergency rescue, and particularly relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue vehicle with a lifting structure, which is used for lifting an unmanned aerial vehicle out of a carriage and comprises the following components: the first fork arm mechanism is arranged in the carriage and is provided with an upper end and a lower end respectively, wherein the upper end is a free end which is lifted relative to the carriage, and the lower end is a fixed end hinged with the carriage; the second fork arm mechanism comprises a first end connected with the upper end and a second end far away from the first fork arm mechanism, wherein the second end can rotate around the first end by taking the radial length of the second fork arm mechanism as a radius to extend out of the carriage; the support plate is in running fit with the second end and is used for arranging the unmanned aerial vehicle; the first control mechanism is arranged on the second end, the control end is connected with the supporting plate, and the first control mechanism is matched with the supporting plate to control the unmanned aerial vehicle to keep horizontal when the first fork arm mechanism and/or the second fork arm mechanism are in an active state. The invention can strengthen the adaptability to the field environment and improve the search and rescue efficiency.
assignees: BAODING LANBAO SPECIAL VEHICLE MFG CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing image target detection method and device based on lightweight model LTE-Det
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing image target detection method and device based on a lightweight model LTE-Det, which constructs the lightweight model LTE-Det, and comprises a lightweight feature extraction module L-GhostNet, a lightweight feature Enhancement module Tiny-Enhancement and a prediction module based on a weighted combination loss function. L-GhostNet integrates the advantages of the channel shuffling idea and the GhostNet model, and is used as an extraction backbone network of four-scale effective features of the unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing image; the Tiny-Enhancement focuses on the Enhancement of four scale features extracted by L-GhostNet, and the maximum scale and other scale features are fused in a bidirectional manner to form three-scale fusion features; and based on a prediction module of the weighted combination loss function, the influence of the differences of different target sample sizes in the data set on the target detection precision is considered, and the weighted combination loss function is designed. The whole scale of the LTE-Det network is about 3.3M, which is about 1/10 of the classical network model CNN, and when the LTE-Det network is applied to application scenes such as maritime search and rescue, mobile terminals such as unmanned aerial vehicles can be embedded, so that real-time detection of searched and rescue objects is realized.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle rescue searching and searchlighting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle rescue searching and searchlighting device, which comprises a bridge, searchlight, a connecting frame and an installation box. The bridge frame comprises a bridge frame body, wherein a red-blue warning lamp is arranged in front of the bridge frame body, searchlight is arranged on two sides of the bridge frame body in a connecting mode, a connecting frame is fixedly connected to the bridge frame body and is connected with an installation box in a rotating mode through the connecting frame, an unmanned aerial vehicle connecting portion connected with an unmanned aerial vehicle and a connector connected with an unmanned aerial vehicle through an electrical signal are arranged on the installation box, and a steering engine is arranged in the installation box and is connected with the connecting frame in a rotating mode through the steering engine. The utility model has the advantages of convenient use and installation, brighter searchlight in the use process, larger searchlight range, convenient operation of night search and rescue, and capability of adjusting the searchlight angle, so that the use is more convenient and faster.
assignees: HENAN WANXINGXINGCHI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned vehicle system for earthquake disaster rescue and control method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of earthquake disaster relief, in particular to an unmanned vehicle system for earthquake disaster relief and a control method, wherein the system comprises the following components: the system comprises an unmanned vehicle unit, a small rescue robot unit, a vehicle rescue mechanical unit and a vehicle rescue unit; the unmanned aerial vehicle unit realizes an aerial exploration task and/or a communication link construction task according to unmanned aerial vehicle unit instructions; the small rescue robot unit is responsible for a detection task and/or a material conveying task of a target area according to an unmanned vehicle unit instruction; the vehicle-mounted rescue mechanical unit completes rescue operation tasks according to the unmanned vehicle unit instructions; the vehicle-mounted rescue unit can carry out medical rescue on injured personnel; the unmanned vehicle unit is also provided with an artificial intelligence system, and works according to remote personnel instructions or automatically completes rescue tasks. Therefore, the problems that rescue is difficult and the like caused by the fact that comprehensive information of a disaster area cannot be obtained in the related technology are solved.

title_en: Intelligent control system based on emergency rescue car
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent control method based on an emergency rescue vehicle, which is applied to an intelligent control system based on the emergency rescue vehicle, and comprises the following steps: big data are acquired in-situ information of disasters and are transmitted to an emergency rescue command center for information analysis, and communication between the command center and the emergency rescue vehicle is realized under the condition of private networks by being provided with private network vehicle-mounted stations; transmitting disaster site related information to an emergency rescue command center; after the position information of the disaster-stricken place is obtained, the safety planning is carried out on the path of the emergency rescue vehicle reaching the disaster-stricken place; after the emergency rescue vehicle arrives at the disaster-stricken site, building a rescue camp according to the road disaster grade identification information; the invention further provides a method for searching and confirming wounded persons through the rescue robot, and the wounded persons are transferred and sent to other disaster areas or returned through the emergency rescue vehicle after the rescue is finished.

title_en: Six-foot and wheel type emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a six-foot and wheel type emergency rescue robot which comprises two groups of chassis, wherein the middle part of each group of chassis outwards protrudes out of six groups of ring structures, connecting rods are arranged between the two groups of chassis for connection and fixation, supporting legs are sleeved on the outer sides of the connecting rods, battery bins, signal receiving devices and rotating tables are arranged at the top ends of the chassis, the top ends of the rotating tables are fixedly connected with a support, the tail ends of the support are fixedly connected with connectors, when the supporting legs walk, steering gears can deflect on the connecting rods, the angle of the supporting legs is adjusted, the steering gears can drive overturning discs to rotate, and when walking wheels are needed to be used, the walking wheels can drive rear joints to deflect towards front joints until walking wheel structures on the rear joints are contacted with the ground, (the front ends of the rear joints can retract to the rear ends of the front joints), and on the supporting legs, the steering gears, overturning discs and the bus steering gears can form a three-shaft deflection structure, so that the deflection in all directions of the supporting legs is met.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle head cloud deck structure for emergency search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aircraft nose tripod head structure for emergency search and rescue, which belongs to the technical field of search and rescue equipment and comprises a support frame, wherein a yaw axis steering engine is arranged at the bottom end of the support frame, a yaw axis steering engine rudder stock penetrates through the support frame and is connected with a rotating rod, the side surface of the rotating rod is connected with a shaft sleeve, the top end of the rotating rod is fixedly provided with a camera support, the camera support is connected with a camera through a movable shaft, and a driving mechanism is further arranged between the camera and the shaft sleeve; the shaft sleeve is movably connected with a driving rod through a second rotating shaft, the side surface of the shaft sleeve is provided with an annular chute, the side surface of the supporting frame is also provided with a pitching mechanism for driving the shaft sleeve to vertically move, and the pitching mechanism and the driving mechanism drive the camera to rotate so as to perform angle adjustment; use unmanned aircraft nose for emergent search and rescue chases after cloud platform structure can carry out the multi-angle and adjust for the image capture scope is great, and the operation is more convenient moreover, and the location is more accurate, searches for and rescue efficiency is higher.
assignees: WUXI XINGCHEN UAV TECH CO LTD

title_en: Thermal imaging monitoring control system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a thermal imaging monitoring control system. A plurality of monitoring nodes are deployed in a monitoring area. The plurality of monitoring nodes includes a plurality of first monitoring nodes dispersed in the monitoring area. Each first monitoring node includes a first thermal imaging camera. The first thermal imaging cameras are each disposed at a first predetermined height from the ground surface with an optical axis substantially perpendicular to the ground surface to thermally image a corresponding imaging region on the ground surface, and each pixel region of the resulting thermal imaging map corresponds to each spatial region of the imaging regions, respectively. The control system analyzes the thermal imaging map from the plurality of first monitoring nodes to identify temperature-related information therein. Thus, accurate identification analysis and positioning can be realized on site temperature-related information. In the fire-fighting application scene, for example, the occurrence of fire hazard missing and false alarm phenomena can be reduced, and the fire hazard and the like in a monitoring area can be accurately positioned, so that effective personnel evacuation and search and rescue are more convenient.

title_en: Snake-shaped rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a snake-shaped rescue robot, which relates to the field of rescue robots, wherein after an environment monitoring system is utilized to detect the environment of a disaster area, a control terminal drives the snake-shaped rescue robot to move to a position to be rescued, the rescue robot comprises a base, and a plurality of self-walking mechanisms are serially arranged on the base, so that the snake-shaped rescue robot can walk and can freely swing in a snake shape; the base is also provided with a human body sensing mechanism and an ultrasonic mechanism, the top is also provided with a central control mechanism and a life supply mechanism, and the central control of each mechanism of the robot is realized through the central control mechanism; the life supply mechanism is internally provided with injectable liquid medicine, and the control terminal controls the operation of injecting the liquid medicine to trapped people, so that the medication rescue of disaster-stricken people is realized. The robot disclosed by the invention can flexibly move in a complex environment, can accurately sense the position and the surrounding environment of trapped people, can also carry life resources to prolong the life line of the trapped people, and can fight more rescue time for rescue workers.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Intelligent sensing and early warning method and system for man falling into water
abstract_en: The invention provides a personnel falling water intelligent sensing and early warning method and system, comprising the following steps: installing a high-resolution infrared camera and a personnel water falling detection camera in a ship area, and monitoring and early warning potential water falling behaviors in real time; arranging a buoyancy beacon at a preset position of the ship, and releasing the beacon to mark the falling person to go when a falling event is detected, so as to optimize the search and rescue range; when a water falling event is detected, automatically starting an unmanned aerial vehicle equipped with a high-definition camera and a thermal imager to perform quick search and rescue; collecting and analyzing camera and sensor data, and optimizing a prediction model by using a machine learning technology; and identifying and monitoring key people through behavior pattern analysis. The invention obviously improves the personnel safety guarantee level of the ship in offshore navigation, and realizes comprehensive perception, accurate positioning and high-efficiency rescue of personnel falling events.
assignees: HAIKOU MARITIME BUREAU OF PEOPLES REPUBLIC OF CHINA

title_en: Deep well rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep well rescue robot which comprises a support module, wherein a grabbing module is arranged at the bottom end of the support module, the support module comprises a mounting frame, two mounting blocks are fixedly arranged on the mounting frame, three support arms are hinged to the side surfaces of each mounting block, and omni-wheels are arranged at one ends of the support arms. This deep well rescue robot, through starting motor one, drive the guide arm and remove, prop up a plurality of support arms on the mounting bracket, support the device and fix the inside at the deep well, rethread motor three drives the omnidirectional wheel and removes, remove the below of deep well with the device, then close two hinges and close, let wait the rescue personnel to ride the top, then motor three again reverse and drive the device and upwards move, rescue personnel to be stranded, the device gets into the deep well through the robot and rescue, be provided with the camera on the mounting box, both convenient observation to deep well inside does not need the rescue personnel to go deep in the well again, rescue personnel's safety has been guaranteed.

title_en: Rescue robot track planning method adaptive to local environment change
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-adaptive rescue robot track planning method with local environment change, which comprises the following steps: determining a guiding route of the rescue robot, and dividing the map into a static area and a dynamic area according to whether the approach area is continuously affected by the disaster; constructing a reinforcement learning network for rescue robot track planning, wherein the reinforcement learning network guides the network based on an efficiency rewarding function in a static area so as to ensure the running efficiency of the rescue robot, and guides the network based on an adaptive rewarding function in a dynamic area so as to cope with a changed disaster area; and generating a rescue robot planning track by utilizing the reinforcement learning network through continuous interaction of the network and the environment. Compared with the prior art, the invention obviously improves the completion probability under the condition of local disaster area change under the condition of ensuring the operation efficiency of the rescue robot through the finely designed differentiated multi-target rewarding optimization reinforcement learning.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle for water area search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle rescue, and discloses a water area rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and a rescue method, wherein in use, a rescue ladder is firstly arranged on a ladder frame in advance, when the unmanned aerial vehicle moves on a water surface, rescue personnel can control the angle of a resistance plate through controlling the output of a rocker adjusting motor according to the stability and the water flow condition of the unmanned aerial vehicle, specifically, when the unmanned aerial vehicle is affected by water flow to incline or be unstable, the rescue personnel can adjust the angle of the resistance plate to form a certain included angle with the transverse thrust of the water flow, so that the resistance plate can generate a force opposite to the water flow direction to help stabilize the posture of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the rescue personnel can effectively control the stability of the unmanned aerial vehicle on the water surface by adjusting the angle and the position of the resistance plate, so that the rescue personnel can perform efficient rescue work in a complex water area environment.
assignees: QUANZHOU ST SOURCE POLICE SURVEILLANCE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Marine unmanned aerial vehicle carries search and rescue equipment integrated configuration
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated structure of unmanned aerial vehicle-mounted search and rescue equipment at sea, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue, and comprises the following steps: unmanned aerial vehicle body, locating piece and access door, the bottom of unmanned aerial vehicle body is provided with integrated shell, high definition digtal camera and infrared camera are installed to one side of integrated shell, the internally mounted of integrated shell has wireless communicator. This marine unmanned aerial vehicle carries search and rescue equipment integrated configuration, through the locating piece with mounting hole in the connecting block of integrated shell top and unmanned aerial vehicle body bottom dock, press two sets of clamp plates and make the gag lever post rotate when docking, can stretch the extension spring of one side when the gag lever post rotates, make it stretch, the locating piece can enter into the inside of connecting block this moment, when the connecting block can't continue to remove, can loosen the clamp plate, the extension spring can again stimulate the gag lever post and rotate this moment, make the gag lever post enter into in the spacing groove of locating piece inside, accomplish the installation to integrated shell.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle with protection machanism
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle with a protection mechanism, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein a camera is arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the protection mechanism is arranged at the outer side of the camera, a buckle mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the protection mechanism, the protection mechanism comprises a main body, the top of the main body is fixedly connected to the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle, a rotating shaft is connected to the middle part of the main body in a penetrating and rotating manner, a connecting rod is fixedly connected to the outer wall of one side of the rotating shaft, which is positioned outside the main body, is penetrated and connected with the outer wall of the outer side of the main body, and the unmanned aerial vehicle with the protection mechanism plays a role of shielding and protecting the camera when the camera is not in use by arranging the protection mechanism, so that the service life of equipment is prolonged, the maintenance cost is reduced, the failure rate in the use process is reduced, the equipment is guaranteed to be used rapidly, and the search and rescue efficiency of people in a meeting is improved.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue method and system based on image recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a maritime search and rescue method and a maritime search and rescue system based on image recognition, which are used for collecting initial positions corresponding to distress signals and ocean current information as distress information and collecting regional ocean current data; inputting the distress information into a ocean current model to obtain first data; establishing an offset model based on the regional ocean current data, optimizing the offset model, and inputting the distress information and the first data into the offset model to obtain second data; determining a predicted offset track based on the initial position and the second data, determining the weight of the predicted offset track by using a clustering algorithm, calculating a position error and determining a search and rescue area according to the weight; and the unmanned aerial vehicle group flies in the search and rescue area, shoots image data, establishes an image recognition model by using a convolutional neural network algorithm, and analyzes the image data in real time to plan a rescue route. The invention combines the image recognition technology and the artificial intelligence algorithm to improve the efficiency and success rate of maritime search and rescue.
assignees: RESCUE AND SALVAGE BUREAU OF MINISTRY OF TRANSP

title_en: Portable small-size fire extinguishing robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots and discloses a movable small fire extinguishing robot, which comprises a main body, wherein four groups of transmission devices are symmetrically arranged at four corners of the side surface of the main body, each rotation device comprises a transportation block, a crawler belt is sleeved on the side surface of each transportation block, a mounting groove is formed in the transportation block corresponding to the crawler belt, a first motor is fixedly arranged in each mounting groove, gears are fixedly arranged on two sides of each first motor and are restrained to form a meshing relationship with the crawler belt, a first movable groove is formed in the side surface, close to the main body, of each transportation block, and the first movable block is movably arranged in each first movable groove. According to the invention, the angle of the cutting plate is adjusted by controlling the rotating motor to rotate the fixed plate through the controller, the obstacle is cut through the cutting plate, and finally the cutting device is retracted into the storage tank and is observed in real time through the camera, so that the robot can process the obstacle, and the robot can conveniently perform search and rescue tasks.

title_en: Bouncing robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bouncing robot, which comprises a driving part, a limb part and a control part. The driving part provides power for bouncing of the robot and mainly comprises a battery, a motor, an incomplete gear, a rack gasket, a spring and a foot bottom plate; the limb part provides support for other parts and comprises a shell, a front leg and a cover plate; the control part is used for controlling the movement of the robot and collecting image information, and comprises a baffle, a miniature camera and a control circuit. The invention is flexible and small, is convenient to maintain and use, can perform search and rescue activities in more complex places, and has higher application value.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue path planning method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a maritime search and rescue path planning method and system for an unmanned aerial vehicle, which are characterized in that a reinforcement learning method is used for retaining new individuals generated in cross variation, an elite warehouse is used for retaining excellent individuals of each generation, when the individuals in the elite warehouse reach a threshold value, the elite warehouse is used for replacing the current population, updating is delayed, local optima are prevented from being trapped, and the optimal individuals cannot be found. The method can quickly obtain the optimal search and rescue scheme for search and rescue.

title_en: Bionic snake-shaped search and rescue robot based on modularized technology
abstract_en: The utility model provides a bionic snake-shaped search and rescue robot based on a modularization technology, which belongs to the technical field of robot rescue and comprises the following components: the device comprises a bionic snake structure, a driving mechanism, a joint obstacle crossing mechanism, an idle end bevel gear, a universal ball bearing and a monitoring system; the bionic snake structure comprises a snake head structure, a snake tail structure and a snake body structure, wherein the snake body structure comprises a plurality of joint movement units; the driving mechanism is respectively arranged at the snake head structure and the snake tail structure; the device combines the use through bionical snake structure and monitoring system, assists people to implement the rescue, and utilizes orthogonal joint and bevel gear driven mode, realizes the purpose that many postures of snake body structure change to the rescue robot of being convenient for gets into in the narrow space and searches for and rescue, and avoid the building to collapse and cause the secondary injury to stranded personnel or animal.

title_en: Automatic detection rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of water rescue, and discloses an automatic detection rescue robot which comprises a rescue boat and a detection unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein a stop seat is integrally formed at the front side of the top of the rescue boat, a guide disc is embedded at the top of the stop seat, a charging jack is formed in the center of the top of the stop seat, a lying plate is arranged at the rear side of the top of the rescue boat, a hand rod is fixedly arranged on two sides of the top of the lying plate, heating wires are arranged in the lying plate, connecting pipes are arranged on two sides of the rear end of the rescue boat, a driving seat is arranged at one end, far away from the rescue boat, of the two connecting pipes, a winding and unwinding machine is fixedly arranged at the center of the rear end of the rescue boat, a rescue rope is fixedly arranged at one end, far away from the winding and unwinding machine, a pull rod is fixedly arranged at the top of the stop seat, and a charging metal rod is arranged at the bottom of the detection unmanned aerial vehicle, corresponding to the charging jack; the rescue robot is used for offshore rescue, and the design of synchronous underwater and aerial detection is adopted, so that the efficiency is high, and the rescue positioning accuracy is high.

title_en: Underwater anchoring type drowning fire rescue device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater anchoring type drowning fire rescue device, and relates to the technical field of underwater fire rescue equipment. It comprises the following steps: the device comprises a floating platform, wherein a hanging piece used for being matched with an unmanned aerial vehicle/a man-machine mount is fixed on the floating platform, a vertical main mounting seat is arranged at the front part of the floating platform, a pair of auxiliary mounting seats which are obliquely arranged are symmetrically arranged at the two sides of the floating platform, main anchors are installed in the main mounting seat in an interference mode, an A rope is pre-wound on the anchor rods of the main anchors, one end of the A rope is connected with the top of the anchor rods of the main anchors, the other end of the A rope is connected with the main mounting seat, an auxiliary anchor is packaged in each auxiliary mounting seat, a transmitting base is installed at the bottom of the floating platform, the transmitting base is communicated with the bottoms of the two auxiliary mounting seats, and a time-delay firing mechanism is arranged in the transmitting base. The invention can play a role in all weather, has low cost, and can lock the search and rescue range in advance and improve the rescue efficiency by arranging and controlling the invention layer by layer in the downstream or diffusion direction of water flow.

title_en: Multi-robot formation control method based on multi-agent reverse reinforcement learning
abstract_en: A multi-robot formation control method based on multi-agent reverse reinforcement learning comprises the following steps of; step one, designing characteristic functions of individuals in robot formation, wherein the characteristic functions are used for enabling the individuals to generate basic actions for realizing formation, and meanwhile, collision among the individuals is avoided and formation is kept; step two, estimating a reward function needed by individuals in the multi-robot system to generate formation motions from the multi-agent formation motion example trajectories based on the reward function approximation of the maximum entropy reverse reinforcement learning method; and thirdly, generating a formation motion strategy of the robot based on a deterministic strategy gradient method, wherein the formation motion strategy is used for generating a strategy function required by an individual to realize formation motion according to a reinforcement learning method. And step four, calculating by a wheel robot formation controller with incomplete constraint, wherein the calculation is used for converting the formation motion strategy into a control strategy capable of controlling the real wheel robot. The invention effectively solves the actual problems of multi-robot unknown area exploration, target search and rescue and security protection.

title_en: Wrapped underground rescue robot capable of self-adapting to pipe wall
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wrapped underground rescue robot capable of adapting to pipe walls, which comprises a supporting and rotating mechanism, an adaptive and lifting mechanism, an arc-shaped rope feeding mechanism, a rope collecting device and a cloth collecting device, wherein the adaptive and lifting mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the supporting and rotating mechanism, the arc-shaped rope feeding mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the adaptive and lifting mechanism, the rope collecting device and the cloth collecting device fixing disc are arranged at the bottom end of the adaptive and lifting mechanism, and the rope collecting device and the cloth collecting device are arranged below the rope collecting device and the cloth collecting device fixing disc. The invention has even stress; the two lifting detecting arms which can independently operate are arranged, the two lifting detecting arms pull the wear-resistant cloth to the lower part of the foot of the person to be saved, the person to be saved is wrapped, the person to be saved is lifted to the ground in a traction wrapping mode, and the stress center is always on the central axis of the well wall and is not easy to damage.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle wireless energy-carrying auxiliary relay method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle wireless energy-carrying auxiliary relay method, an unmanned aerial vehicle wireless energy-carrying auxiliary relay system, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a use scene model of communication among a base station, an unmanned aerial vehicle relay and a user terminal to be rescued; performing mathematical description on the usage scenario model based on the two communication time slots to obtain a mathematical representation of the communication rate at the user terminal to be rescued; under the constraint condition that the power of the unmanned aerial vehicle is limited, the communication rate of the terminal user to be rescued is maximized by optimizing the power splitting ratio, the relay processing matrix and the beam forming vector so as to obtain a model optimization problem; and solving a model optimization problem by using a preset two-stage step-by-step solving algorithm to obtain the optimal communication rate of the terminal user to be rescued. The unmanned aerial vehicle wireless energy-carrying auxiliary relay method can provide effective and efficient search and rescue in complex environments, strive for the golden time of disaster rescue, and practically guarantee the life and property safety of disaster area masses.
assignees: SYSTEMS ENGINEERING RES INSTITUTE CHINA STATE SHIPBUILDING CORPORATION;CSSC ZHIHAI INNOVATION RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Four-foot walking robot for rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots and discloses a four-foot walking robot for rescue, which comprises a machine body, a machine head, a shooting mechanism and four walking mechanisms, wherein the machine head is connected to the machine body; the shooting mechanism is arranged on the machine body and the machine head and is used for shooting and transmitting environment information of the robot; the walking mechanism comprises a first supporting leg, a second supporting leg, a driving component and a controller, wherein the first supporting leg is hinged with the second supporting leg, and the driving component is respectively connected with the first supporting leg and the second supporting leg; the controller is connected to the machine body, the controller is electrically connected with the driving assembly, and the driving assembly receives control information of the controller to drive the second support leg to rotate relative to the first support leg and drive the second support leg and the first support leg to jointly rotate relative to the machine body. The walking robot can freely walk on ruins and other complex terrains across obstacles, can shoot and transmit peripheral information, and can be used for assisting search and rescue under ruins of large disasters.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD EHV BRANCH

title_en: Safe transmission method for air-ground emergency communication
abstract_en: The invention provides a safe transmission method for air-ground emergency communication, which comprises the steps of firstly deploying 2 search and rescue robots, 1 relay airship with a buffer, 1 rescue team and 1 emergency command center; then, optimizing power distribution P and mode selection M, providing a maximized weighted safety and speed problem, deriving and solving through Lyapunov optimization and closed solution based on an objective function and optimization conditions of the constructed weighted safety and speed maximizing problem, and maximizing the weighted safety and speed; then, a data link anti-interference scheme is designed based on the multi-system spread spectrum, so that the anti-interference performance of the safe transmission method is improved; finally, the simulation result shows that the weighted safety sum rate of the scheme is obviously superior to that of the comparison scheme. The invention is oriented to an emergency communication network, deploys an air airship with a buffer function to overcome link blockage and improve the information safety of air-ground emergency communication, and improves the anti-interference performance of a safe transmission method, and the weighted safety and the speed are superior to those of the existing scheme.

title_en: YOLO-based search and rescue automatic unmanned aerial vehicle navigation system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a YOLO-based automatic unmanned aerial vehicle navigation system and a method for searching and rescuing, comprising real-time monitoring equipment, a monitoring system, a self-defined deep learning model training end, an algorithm module, a back-end program and a man-machine interaction interface.

title_en: Thermal imaging image wireless transmission system for fire rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a thermal imaging image wireless transmission system for fire rescue, which comprises a front end and a rear end, wherein the front end comprises a front end microprocessor control board MCU, a front end wireless communication module, a thermal imaging sensor and a power supply conversion module; the rear end comprises a rear end wireless communication module, a rear end micro-processing control board MCU and a rear end LCD display screen; the thermal imaging image is transmitted wirelessly, so that infrared thermal imaging of a fire scene can be transmitted remotely, front detection personnel are reduced, the safety of fire rescue personnel is ensured, and decision assistance is provided for a rear commander; the wireless connection mode of the public network and the local area network is adopted, and the wireless connection mode can be switched to the local area network connection in the place with poor public network signals, so that the wireless connection mode is high in adaptability. The front end can be used in a handheld manner, can be used in a mode of being worn on a helmet or being placed on the ground through a support base, and is suitable for various occasions such as internal attack search and rescue, oil tank fire remote monitoring and the like.

title_en: Earthquake search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The application relates to a seismic search and rescue robot which comprises a frame main body, a crawler belt travelling mechanism, a mounting plate and a supporting mechanism. The crawler travelling mechanisms are arranged on the left side and the right side of the frame body and are used for driving the frame body to move; the mounting plate is arranged on the frame main body; the supporting mechanisms comprise two supporting mechanisms and are respectively arranged on the mounting plate along the front-back direction; the earthquake search and rescue robot of this embodiment can nimble motion and bear great load in the course of the work with the help of the action of arm and push rod on two back and forth supporting mechanism, is enough to satisfy the support floor in search and rescue in-process, avoids the secondary subsidence that the aftershock brought.

title_en: Mobile sterilization-robot with human pose estimation
title_ko: 자세인식기술이 적용된 이동형 제균-로봇
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile sterilization robot with posture recognition technology applied thereto, which moves to a sterilization-required area, which is a place requiring sterilization, through autonomous driving, and at the same time, upon arrival at the sterilization-required area, detects a human body and performs sterilization work using a UVC sterilization unit, a UVA sterilization unit, and a plasma ion unit depending on whether a human body is detected, and detects the pose of a detection object using HPE (Human Pose Estimation) to which a PoseNet model is applied, and classifies the detection object into a 'temporary mode' or a 'visit mode' based on the detected pose and determines whether to move to another place or wait based on the classification result, thereby maximizing the sterilization effect and efficiency of a wide area without human intervention, and minimizing human harm by increasing the accuracy of human detection, and effectively preventing the spread of viruses and bacteria, and capable of maintaining the sterilization effect even in a space where a critical number of visitors gather.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자율주행을 통해 제균이 필요한 장소인 제균-필요구역으로 이동함과 동시에 제균-필요구역 도착 시, 인체를 감지하여 인체감지여부에 따라 UVC 제균유닛, UVA 제균유닛 및 플라즈마 이온 유닛을 사용하여 제균작업을 수행하며, PoseNet 모델이 적용된 HPE(Human Pose Estimation)를 이용하여 감지객체의 포즈를 검출한 후, 검출된 포즈에 따라 감지객체를 ‘임시모드’ 또는 ‘방문모드’로 분류하여 분류된 결과에 따라 다른 장소로 이동하거나 또는 대기할지를 결정하도록 구성됨으로써 인간이 개입하지 않아도, 넓은 장소의 제균 효과 및 효율성을 극대화할 뿐만 아니라 인체감지 정확성을 높여 인체 유해성을 최소화하며, 바이러스 및 세균의 확산을 효과적으로 방지할 수 있으며, 임계치 이상의 방문객이 밀집된 공간에서도 살균 효과를 지속시킬 수 있는 자세인시기술이 적용된 이동형 제균-로봇에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Search and rescue device simulating worm movement form
abstract_en: The utility model provides a search and rescue device imitating worm movement, which relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots and comprises a head unit, a plurality of trunk units and a tail unit which are sequentially connected, wherein the head unit is connected with the trunk unit, the trunk unit is connected with the trunk unit, and the trunk unit is connected with the tail unit through a steering engine; the head unit comprises a first main body block, a supporting plate is arranged at one end of the first main body block, a second main body block and an infrared sensor are arranged at the other end of the first main body block, the infrared sensor is arranged above the second main body block, a groove is formed in the front surface of the second main body block, and a camera is arranged in the groove; the worm-like search and rescue robot designed by the utility model has the advantages of small size and flexible action, and can be used for surveying and rescue in a more severe and narrow environment.
assignees: COLLEGE OF ARTS & INFORMATION ENGINEERING DALIAN POLYTECHNIC UNIV

title_en: Intelligent disaster area search and rescue wheeled intelligent vehicle based on multi-sensor fusion sensing
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of search and rescue equipment, and particularly discloses an intelligent disaster area search and rescue wheeled intelligent vehicle based on multi-sensor fusion sensing, which comprises a chassis and a control mechanism, wherein the control mechanism is arranged at the top of the chassis and comprises a main control circuit board and a driving circuit board; according to the utility model, through the arrangement of the data acquisition mechanism, a user can effectively perceive the travelling image, the distance between the travelling image and a travelling obstacle and the posture of the vehicle body in the travelling process of the intelligent vehicle, can effectively adjust the travelling action and the route of the vehicle in time, ensures the normal operation of the vehicle, better adapts to complex terrains of disaster areas and effectively realizes search and rescue tasks.

title_en: Emergency search and rescue method and system for unmanned aerial vehicle detection code positioning
abstract_en: The application discloses an emergency search and rescue method and system for unmanned aerial vehicle detection code positioning, which are characterized in that a search and rescue task is acquired, a flight route of an unmanned aerial vehicle is planned by using map software, and a control instruction is sent to the unmanned aerial vehicle; the unmanned aerial vehicle flies to a target area according to a preset route, and starts a code detection device after reaching the target area to search a target signal; after the code detection equipment detects a target signal, the unmanned aerial vehicle records the position of the target signal by using a GPS positioning module; the method and the device for detecting the disaster of the unmanned aerial vehicle have the advantages that the target position information sent by the unmanned aerial vehicle is received, the target position information is analyzed, the accurate position of trapped or missing persons is determined, rescue staff are coordinated to rescue, the mobility of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the accurate positioning capability of the code detection technology are combined, disaster victims can be rapidly positioned in various complex terrains, the search and rescue efficiency and success rate are greatly improved, and the method and the device have great significance in improving emergency management capability and reducing casualties.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle self-generation energy storage supply system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle self-power generation energy storage supply system, which comprises: the power generation system is used for converting resources into electric energy; the energy storage system is an energy storage device for storing electric energy and can receive and store the generated electric energy; the control system is used for managing and monitoring the power generation and energy storage processes so as to ensure the normal operation of the system; the illumination system is used for carrying out self-adaptive illumination adjustment on the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the light ray degrees of different working environments. Through installing peripheral hardware basic station system on unmanned aerial vehicle, make unmanned aerial vehicle expand search and rescue during operation in the weak area of signal, still can keep good signal connection, cooperate handheld terminal and peripheral hardware basic station system to be connected simultaneously, real-time accurate supplementary search and rescue personnel carry out rescue work, have improved search and rescue work's efficiency.
assignees: DONGGUAN LIANYAO MATERIAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-functional unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue platform
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue platform, which belongs to the technical field of maritime search and rescue, wherein the multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue platform comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle module, an image acquisition module and a life raft throwing module; the ground control module is used for controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle module to perform maritime search and rescue; the unmanned aerial vehicle module further comprises a load module and a photoelectric detection module arranged in the load module; the load module is used for throwing the life raft; the photoelectric detection module is used for image acquisition. According to the utility model, rescue workers do not need to go to the site for rescue, and the efficiency and safety of maritime search and rescue are improved.
assignees: SANYA SCIENCE AND EDUCATION INNOVATION PARK WUHAN UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Mechanical arm path planning method and system of nuclear accident emergency rescue robot and robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mechanical arm path planning method and system of a nuclear accident emergency rescue robot and the robot, wherein the path planning method comprises the following steps: tracking and detecting the dynamic environment in the nuclear accident scene space to obtain the dynamic environment information of the nuclear accident scene; generating a three-dimensional composite map according to the dynamic environment information; and carrying out path planning by adopting a preset method based on the pose information of the mechanical arm of the three-dimensional composite map and the sampling information of the mechanical arm of the emergency rescue robot, so as to obtain a target path of the mechanical arm of the emergency rescue robot. According to the invention, the obstacle and the radiation area of the accident scene are dynamically perceived, and the high-radiation area is regarded as an invisible obstacle, so that a target path is planned for the mechanical arm, the operation safety of the emergency rescue robot is improved, the mechanical arm is prevented from being damaged, the performance of the mechanical arm is improved, and the service life of the mechanical arm is prolonged.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR POWER INST CO LTD;CGN POWER CO LTD

title_en: System for searching and rescuing drowning person using unmanned flying device
title_ko: 무인 비행 장치를 이용한 익수자 수색 및 구조 시스템
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a drowning person search and rescue system using an unmanned aerial vehicle comprises: an unmanned aerial vehicle including a buoyancy unit generating buoyancy when positioned on the surface of water, and a towing target unit connected to a wire and winding the connected wire to be towed; a control device including a control unit controlling flight, landing, and operation of the unmanned aerial vehicle; and a towing device including a towing unit connected to the wire and winding the connected wire to tow the unmanned aerial vehicle.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 무인 비행 장치를 이용한 익수자 수색 및 구조 시스템은 수면에 위치하는 경우 부력을 발생시키는 부력부; 및 와이어가 연결되고, 연결된 상기 와이어를 권취하여 피견인되도록 하는 피견인부;를 포함하는 무인 비행 장치; 상기 무인 비행 장치의 비행, 착륙 및 작동을 제어하는 제어부;를 포함하는 제어 장치; 및 상기 와이어와 연결되고, 연결된 상기 와이어를 권취하여 상기 무인 비행 장치를 견인하는 견인부;를 포함하는 견인 장치;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Dron lighting system
title_ko: 드론 조명 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a drone lighting system. The drone lighting system of the present invention includes: a drone equipped with a lighting device; a user terminal that calls a drone using a mobile application; a drone station that is equipped at different locations to settle the drone and charge the drone's battery; and a control server that manages the drone and the drone station in an integrated manner. When the drone lighting system calls a drone equipped with a lighting device using a user terminal, the drone is dispatched to a location required by the user and the lighting device of the drone is used to output lighting light at the location. According to the present invention, in a place without streetlights, lighting light is output using the lighting device according to an event situation at night, so that various events such as safety accident prevention, safety surveillance activities, emergency situations, search and rescue, and leisure use can be dealt with.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 드론 조명 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 드론 조명 시스템은 조명 장치가 구비된 드론, 모바일 애플리케이션을 이용하여 드론을 호출하는 사용자 단말기, 서로 다른 위치에 구비되어 드론을 안착하고 드론의 배터리를 충전하는 드론 스테이션 및, 드론과 드론 스테이션을 통합 관리하는 관제 서버를 포함한다. 드론 조명 시스템은 사용자 단말기를 이용하여 조명 장치가 구비된 드론을 호출하면, 드론을 사용자가 필요로 하는 장소로 출동시키고 드론의 조명 장치를 이용하여 해당 장소에서 조명광을 출력시킨다. 본 발명에 의하면, 가로등이 없는 장소의 야간에서 이벤트 상황에 따라 조명 장치를 이용하여 조명광을 출력시켜 안전 사고 예방, 안전 감시 활동, 응급 상황, 수색 구조, 레저 활용 등의 다양한 이벤트에 대처할 수 있다.

title_en: Special robot with all-terrain passing capability
abstract_en: The utility model provides a special robot with all terrain throughput ability, includes the frame, both sides all are equipped with two suspensions around the frame, the middle zone fixed mounting of frame has the seat, the rear end fixed mounting of frame has the goods shelves, the end connection of suspension has wheel hub motor, and its wheel hub motor's inboard is equipped with the brake disc, the joint department of suspension is equipped with hydro-pneumatic spring and shock absorber, the top of frame is equipped with the light screen, and the surface of its light screen sets up antenna, camera, solid-state radar and multi-line laser, multi-line laser is located the top of solid-state radar. The autonomous navigation function can be realized through the cooperation of the set antenna, millimeter wave radar, solid radar, multi-line laser and other modules, and the traditional SLAM autonomous navigation mode capable of avoiding obstacles is intended to be improved by combining the characteristics of the wheel type structure, the unique suspension structure and the good obstacle crossing performance of the all-terrain robot, so that the emergency rescue robot is more intelligent.
assignees: AEROSPACE SCIENCE & IND SHENZHEN GROUP CO LTD;SHENZHEN AEROSPACE INDUSTRY TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster detection rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of detection and rescue robots, in particular to a post-disaster detection and rescue robot which comprises a frame, a detection device, a moving device and a balancing component, wherein the detection device is arranged above the frame; the sliding block is in sliding connection with the fixed frame and is located inside the fixed frame, part of the sliding block extends out of the fixed frame, the driving member is arranged on the fixed frame and drives the sliding block to move, the balancing weight is fixedly connected with the sliding block and is located on one side, away from the fixed frame, of the sliding block, the gravity center of the robot can be adjusted according to the climbing gradient, and the probability of rollover of the robot is reduced.

title_en: Emergency navigation method and system based on combination of remote sensing and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The application provides an emergency navigation method based on combination of remote sensing and unmanned aerial vehicles, which is characterized in that a disaster place image is obtained through a remote sensing image, the image is divided into a plurality of areas to be detected, each area to be detected is searched and planned to pass through a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles, and a suspected search and rescue target is marked, so that rescue navigation of a disaster area is realized.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method and device, unmanned aerial vehicle and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method, an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue device, an unmanned aerial vehicle and a storage medium, comprising the following steps: constructing a data generation model, wherein the data generation model comprises a generator; training the generator based on the first training data sets in a plurality of scenes to obtain a trained generator; respectively constructing a target detection model and a plurality of target re-identification models; training the target detection model based on the second training data set, training the target re-recognition model based on the third training data set, and detecting the video shot by the unmanned aerial vehicle based on the trained target detection model to obtain a detection target object and a target class corresponding to each detection target object; when the target category corresponding to the detected target object is matched with the category corresponding to the missing target information, calculating the association degree according to the target re-identification model; when the association degree is larger than a preset threshold value, acquiring first positioning information, and determining a first search and rescue area according to the first positioning information; the unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: System and method for autonomous mobile robot to ride and co-share elevator with human(s)
abstract_en: To provide a system and method for an autonomous mobile robot to ride and co-share an elevator with human(s).SOLUTION: Upon an elevator riding task is started, a human detection and location finding module, and a human identification and state estimation module detect and count at least one human inside and/or outside the elevator, and a human-robot-interaction module interacts with the at least one human. An elevator confined space positioning module carries out a space positioning inside the elevator according to a result of detecting and counting the at least one human through the human detection and location finding module and the human identification and state estimation module, and chooses to enter the elevator or restart another elevator riding task.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: DELTA ELECTRONICS INT L SINGAPORE PTE LTD

title_en: Maritime search and rescue strength scheduling command method
abstract_en: The application provides a method for commanding maritime search and rescue strength dispatching, which comprises the following steps: according to the generated visibility distribution diagram, carrying out regional division on the search and rescue scene by adopting a clustering algorithm, clustering regions with similar visibility into the same search and rescue subareas, calculating the average visibility value and the environmental characteristic coefficient of each subarea, and establishing a corresponding relation table of the search and rescue regions, the visibility and the environmental characteristics; the method comprises the steps of obtaining available search and rescue resource information from a preset search and rescue force database, including types, quantity, performance parameters and current states of search and rescue ships, helicopters and unmanned aerial vehicle equipment, and formulating a preliminary search and rescue force distribution scheme by combining a corresponding relation table of search and rescue areas, visibility and environmental characteristics.
assignees: GUANGDONG HAIXIN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Under-ice rescue device for unmanned and cableless submersible and use method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of underwater search and rescue devices, and particularly relates to a remote control device suitable for polar region under-ice search and rescue. In order to solve the problem that the recovery difficulty of a robot formed by the common technology is too high. The rescue hook device, the power carrier umbilical cable, the rescue rope, the altimeter, the camera system, the acoustic positioning beacon, the power system, the frame, the electronic cabin, the power cabin and the deep posture sensor are connected with the rescue hook device, the power carrier umbilical cable is connected with the power cabin, the rescue hook device, the altimeter and the acoustic positioning beacon are arranged outside the frame, and the camera system, the power system, the electronic cabin, the power cabin and the deep posture sensor are arranged inside the frame. According to the invention, the electromagnetic hooking device is designed, so that a rescue rope can be carried to carry out rope hanging tasks on the trapped robot under ice, and the safe recovery of the trapped robot is realized.
assignees: SANYA NANHAI INNOVATION DEVELOPMENT BASE HARBIN ENGINEERING UNIV

title_en: Slit rescue robot based on functional anisotropic lattice superstructure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slit rescue robot based on a functional anisotropic lattice superstructure, which relates to the technical field of slit rescue and comprises the functional anisotropic lattice superstructure and a driving system, wherein the driving system comprises a shrinkage release deformation driving and a constraint function driving, the functional anisotropic lattice superstructure comprises a plurality of functional anisotropic unit cells, two adjacent functional anisotropic unit cells are connected with each other, and each functional anisotropic unit cell comprises a positive poisson ratio face part and a zero poisson ratio face part which are connected with each other. The slit rescue robot has the motion mode of inchworm-like motion, is respectively driven to generate constraint at the head and the tail of the robot, and is driven to shrink, eccentrically shrink and release along the length direction of the robot to control the robot to perform linear motion and direction-changing motion. The invention solves the problem that the robot meeting the anisotropic requirement of the constraint function and the deformation function is lacking in the prior art.

title_en: Rescue drone
abstract_en: A remote control drone assembly to assist in the rescue of distressed swimmers. The drone assembly includes a flotation device that can be released over a distressed swimmer. A retractable spool assembly attached to the drone assembly includes a line having a proximate end tethered to the spool assembly. The drone assembly is constructed and arranged to be flown by an operator over a distressed swimmer. The floatation device is released for use by the distressed swimmer and the drone assembly is returned to the operator. The retractable spool is detached from the drone assembly and attached to a spool retractor. The spool retractor retrieving the floatation device together with the distressed swimmer.

title_en: Self-charging modular portable survival drone that recharges by natural elements
abstract_en: A self-charging modular portable survival drone that recharges by natural elements is disclosed. The self-charging modular portable survival drone is capable of conventionally charging other devices, performing remote flight operations, and signaling for help. The natural elements include wind and water. The self-charging modular portable survival drone is configured to rapidly and repeatedly charge mobile battery units stored in ducted fan assemblies. The ducted fan assemblies can be used to charge personal electronic devices and power remote flight operations via modular drone. The self-charging modular portable survival drone can be used to signal for help using onboard high-output LEDs during SOS flight operations. The self-charging modular portable survival drone can further be used, during SOS flight operations, to broadcast current GPS coordinates over local search and rescue bands.

title_en: Safety drones with air tube
title_ko: 에어 튜브가 설치된 안전 드론
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a functional drone having an air tube installed on one side of the lower part of the drone so that the drone is not damaged even if the drone falls on land and floats without sinking even if the drone falls on the water. A safety drone equipped with an air tube comprises: a drone frame (40) forming a body of the drone; a transmission and reception device (80); a photographing camera (100); a battery unit (60) which is a power source for rotating a motor and a propeller (120); and a leg unit (140) on a lower surface, wherein at least one air tube (160) for air injection is installed on or attached to a lower portion of the drone (20) or one side of the leg unit (140). According to the present invention, even if the drone falls in a place where people are gathered, the air tube forms a protective barrier on the human body, thereby preventing injuries and enabling safer and more economical flight.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 상술하였듯이 에어 튜브가 설치된 안전 드론에 관한 것으로 더욱 자세하게는 드론 하부 일측면에 에어 튜브가 설치되어 드론이 육상에 추락해도 파손되지 않고 물에 추락해도 침몰되지 않고 떠있는 기능성 드론에 관한것이다. 
본 발명의 드론은 통상의 일반적인 드론 처럼 배터리 부와 촬영 카메라 및 송수신 장치가 구비되며 드론 프레임의 상부에 설치된 모터및 프로펠라가 구성되며 상기 모터의 회전력에 의하여 프로펠라가 소속으로 돌아가서 빠르게 하늘을 날아가는 비행체이다. 
본 발명에 의하면 드론은 취미용,군사용은 물론 다양한 산업분야에 그범위를 넓히며 널리 사용되고 있다. 이러한 드론은 육상은 물론 논이나 하천,해상에서의 측량, 수색 등을 포함하는 각종 시설물 등의 점검및 관리에 사용되는 드론의 운용시 원일 모를 고장이나 배터리 방전으로 인하여 육상으로 추락하는일이 비일비재하게 발생하고 있다. 
본원은 드론이 육상 추락시 지면과의 충격을 에어 튜브가 모두 커버하여 드론의 파손을 최소화하고 특히 하천이나 해상과같은 수면 추락시 하면에 설치된 에어 주머니인 에어 튜브의 부력으로 고가에 드론이 물에 가라 않지 않고 떠있어 즉시 회수가 가능한 기능성 드론인 것이다. 
더불어 사람이 모여있는 곳에 드론이 추락을 하더라고 상기 에어 튜브가 인체 추돌시 자동차 에어백과 같은 푹신한 방어막을 형성하므로 부상을 예방하고 값비싼 드론을 보다 안전하고 경제적으로 운영할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Sea-air cross-domain collaborative intelligent unmanned water search and rescue system and control method
abstract_en: The invention provides a sea-air cross-domain collaborative intelligent unmanned water search and rescue system and a control method, and relates to the technical field of multiple intelligent agents. The system consists of a multifunctional unmanned plane, an autonomous obstacle avoidance unmanned ship, a lifesaving robot and a ground station system; the multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle can carry and throw the unmanned aerial vehicle and provide real-time position information of people falling into water for the whole system; the autonomous obstacle avoidance unmanned ship is provided with an intelligent unmanned aerial vehicle library and a rescue system with a conveyor belt; the lifesaving robot can approach to the person falling into the water according to the real-time position information provided by the multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle and provide buoyancy for the person falling into the water; the ground station system is used for sending the initial position information of the personnel falling into the water to the multifunctional unmanned aerial vehicle and the autonomous obstacle avoidance unmanned ship and monitoring the running condition of the whole system in real time. The invention provides a cross-domain collaborative intelligent unmanned water search and rescue system which can quickly respond after people fall into water, can realize efficient and accurate rescue and reduce drowning of people falling into water.
assignees: QINGDAO XINDONG AVIATION TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle platform task planning and allocation system and method for landslide disaster rescue
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of task planning and allocation, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle platform task planning and allocation system and method for landslide disaster rescue, wherein the system comprises the following components: the unmanned aerial vehicle task planning system determines a scheduling scheme for multiple unmanned aerial vehicles based on judgment of meteorological factors, traffic factors and population density factors; the data processing system is used for fusing multi-source data of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle into a data chart and evaluating information of the data chart to judge whether the information is reasonable and effective; the task distribution system is used for reissuing the uploading task area aiming at the data invalid area and transmitting the effective life body position to the terminal corresponding to the on-site rescue personnel aiming at the data reasonable effective area so as to carry out rescue actions. Therefore, the problems that in the related technology, due to single consideration factor, limited algorithm and simple theoretical analysis in the allocation process, complex conditions of multiple conditions cannot be adapted, search and rescue efficiency and accuracy are reduced, time and resources are wasted and the like are solved.
assignees: UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES BEIJING;BEIJING HUAHUI DETECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Underwater search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of underwater search and rescue robots, and discloses an underwater search and rescue robot which comprises a supporting frame, wherein four supporting plates are arranged on the surface of a connecting plate of the supporting frame, one end of each supporting plate is connected with a protection box, an underwater camera is arranged in each protection box, a transparent glass cover plate is arranged on the front surface of each protection box, two symmetrical studs are arranged between each connecting plate and each protection box, a waterproof motor is arranged on the surface of each connecting plate, a transmission mechanism is arranged in each mechanism box, a cleaning mechanism in contact with each transparent glass cover plate is arranged between each two studs, and soil, plankton and other foreign matter impurities adhered on each transparent glass cover plate can be cleaned through the cooperation among the waterproof motor, the transmission mechanism, the studs and the cleaning mechanism, so that the definition of shooting is prevented from being influenced, and search and rescue work is convenient.
assignees: HENAN YUNZHAN INNOVATION INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine search and rescue robot path planning method based on A-algorithm improvement
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine search and rescue robot path planning method based on A-algorithm improvement, which comprises the following steps: selecting a proper barrier grid size based on map resolution, and creating a two-dimensional plan of the environment according to the environment information; searching an initial node S, establishing an O table and a C table, and judging whether the path planning is completed or not; the method for creating hierarchical neighborhood search and pruning improves the neighborhood search mode of the A algorithm; the 24 adjacent points are adopted to enlarge the searching range of the robot; the weight of heuristic functions in the valuation function is improved, and the search nodes of the algorithm are reduced; smoothing the path by using a B spline method; and introducing a D algorithm to finally optimize the robot path planning under the A algorithm. By improving the algorithm A, the path planning flow of the mine search and rescue robot can be optimized to a certain extent, the path planning length and turning times of the robot are reduced, the path smoothness is increased, the navigation precision of the robot is improved, and a new optimization scheme is provided for enhancing the rescue efficiency of the mine search and rescue robot.

title_en: Forest fire rescue decision-making method based on cooperative control of unmanned aerial vehicle and robot
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of control science, and provides a forest fire rescue decision method based on cooperative control of an unmanned aerial vehicle and a robot. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring control operation systems of unmanned aerial vehicles and rescue robots, and analyzing control structures, route planning and fleet formation technologies; designing a control instruction generation algorithm, and constructing an unmanned aerial vehicle-vehicle cluster command control system; acquiring real-time images of forest disaster areas by using a visible light camera and an infrared camera, and generating a situation map and a local image; the multi-terminal information fusion determines rescue planning, configures and executes the unmanned aerial vehicle and the rescue robot, is connected to a command system, and establishes a cooperative wireless network; and generating a control instruction according to the planning, and sending the control instruction to the execution unmanned aerial vehicle and the rescue robot. According to the application, the cooperative wireless network is established to cooperatively control the unmanned aerial vehicle and the rescue robot, so that the technical problems of insufficient accuracy and response speed of rescue actions caused by untimely information acquisition are solved, and the high efficiency of forest fire rescue is realized.

title_en: Novel bionic hexapod robot oriented to rugged topography
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel bionic hexapod robot for rugged terrains, which comprises six leg shells with conical toe, wherein each leg is connected with three steering engines, and each steering engine is connected by different brackets, so that the leg multi-degree-of-freedom motion is realized, and the all-weather operation capability and adaptation to various terrains of the robot are realized; six mechanical legs are connected with the frame, various sensors and real-time transmission high-definition cameras are arranged in the frame, data and monitoring information of surrounding environments can be better perceived, the mechanical arm is connected to the frame, the inside of the mechanical arm is controlled by five steering gears, the five steering gears are mutually matched, and the two steering gears at the lowest part are connected with the bearing to form a cradle head steering gear. The invention adopts the modular design idea, and is provided with a multifunctional platform, so that the structure is compact and the integration is convenient; the invention can quickly explore surrounding terrains and transmit more information, allows a plurality of robots to work cooperatively, and is suitable for relevant crowds such as search and rescue personnel, exploration personnel and the like.

title_en: Earthquake emergency rescue auxiliary tool
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an earthquake emergency rescue auxiliary tool which comprises a robot, a sliding plate, a damper and a stretcher, wherein the sliding plate is connected to the inner wall of the robot in a sliding manner, the damper is fixedly connected to the top of the sliding plate, the stretcher is fixedly arranged at the top of the damper, mounting blocks are fixedly connected to the two sides of the front side and the rear side of the stretcher, and the inner wall of the mounting block is movably connected with a rotating rod through a bearing. According to the utility model, the rotating rod, the limiting railing, the driving assembly and the warning assembly are arranged, so that the driving assembly can effectively drive the rotating rod to rotate the limiting railing, the problem that the rescue robot is not provided with a limiting structure, the wounded person can deviate to two sides of the stretcher through the uneven ground when being transported by the robot, the wounded person can be secondarily injured by the binding belt, the fixing performance of the binding belt is poor, and the phenomenon of sliding of the wounded person can still be caused, so that the problem of a certain danger exists.

title_en: All-terrain search and rescue firefighting rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire-fighting robot, in particular to an all-terrain search and rescue fire-fighting rescue robot. The all-terrain search and rescue firefighting rescue robot comprises a fire extinguishing system, a detection system, a rescue bearing system, a medical care system and a motion system, wherein the fire extinguishing system comprises a fire extinguishing cannon and a water tank, and the fire extinguishing cannon is connected to the water tank; the detection system comprises a laser sensor, cameras and a telescopic rod, wherein the laser sensor is installed on the upper portion of the telescopic rod, the cameras are installed on two sides of the upper portion of the telescopic rod, and the laser sensor is located between the two cameras; the rescue bearing system comprises a conveying mechanism, a rescue box and a cooperative mechanical arm, wherein the initial position of the conveying mechanism is arranged in the rescue box. The fire-fighting robot has the beneficial effects that the advantages of the traditional fire-fighting robot are combined, the capability of searching and rescuing wounded persons, safely conveying wounded persons and emergency rescuing wounded persons in a complex environment is realized, and therefore the fire-fighting rescue efficiency is improved.
assignees: HARBIN INST TECHNOLOGY;HARBIN INSTITUTE OF TECH ZHENGZHOU RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Novel wheel-foot type emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel wheel-foot type emergency rescue robot, which comprises a robot body, wherein the top end of the robot body is provided with a platform, the platform is provided with a through hole, the top end of the platform is provided with a driving box, the driving box is rotationally connected with a mounting seat through a bearing, a camera is mounted on the mounting seat, a spraying mechanism is mounted on the platform and used for spraying water to the robot body, the technical field of rescue robots is related, and the spraying mechanism is mounted on the platform of the robot body, so that the robot body can be sprayed with water when fire rescue is carried out, the damage caused by baking is reduced, and the service life is prolonged; the camera is driven to rotate through the arranged servo motor, so that a larger range can be shot; and the camera is provided with two, not only further enlarges the shooting scope, and two cameras are reserve each other simultaneously, promotes the reliability of use.
