assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & TECH CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Safety drones with air tube
title_ko: 에어 튜브가 설치된 안전 드론
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety drone installed with an air tube and more specifically, relates to a functional drone installed with the air tube on one side surface of a drone lower part, that is not damaged even if the drone crashes on the ground and floats without sinking even if crashing on water. Provided, in a drone (20) realized with a drone frame (40) realized with a body of the drone, a transmission/reception device (80), a photographing camera (100), a battery part (60), which is a power source for rotating a motor and a propeller (120), and a leg part (140) on a lower surface, is the safety drone installed with the air tube that is characterized in enabling an air tube (160) for injecting at least one or more air to be installed or attached to the drone (20) lower part or one side of the leg part (140).

title_en: Safe drones with anti-sinking and damage features
title_ko: 침몰 및 파손 방지 기능이 구비되 안전 드론
abstract_en: Provided is a drone (20) comprising: a drone frame (40) forming the body of the drone; a transmission and reception device (80); a photographing camera (100); a battery unit (60) which is a power source for rotating a motor and a propeller (120); and a leg unit (140) on a lower surface. According to the present invention, the drone is a functional drone that minimizes damage upon impact with the ground on land in the event of a fall due to a malfunction during the operation of the drone used for inspection and management of various facilities, etc., including surveying, searching, etc., on land as well as in fields and the sea, and can be recovered immediately by floating without sinking in the water due to the buoyancy of a gas bag installed on the underside when the drone falls on the water.

본 발명은 상술하였듯이 침몰 및 파손 방지 기능이 구비되 안전 드론에 관한 것으로 더욱 자세하게는 드론 하부 일측면에 가스백이 설치되어 드론이 육상에 추락해도 파손되지 않고 물에 추락해도 침몰되지 않고 떠있는 기능성 드론에 관한것이다. 
본 발명의 드론은 통상의 일반적인 드론 처럼 배터리 부와 촬영 카메라 및 송수신 장치가 구비되며 드론 프레임의 상부에 설치된 모터 및 프로펠러가 구성되며 상기 모터의 회전력에 의하여 프로펠러가 소속으로 돌아가서 빠르게 하늘을 날아가는 비행체이다. 
본 발명에 의하면 드론은 취미용, 군사용은 물론 다양한 산업분야에 그 범위를 넓히며 널리 사용되고 있다. 이러한 드론은 육상은 물론 논이나 하천, 해상에서의 측량, 수색 등을 포함하는 각종 시설물 등의 점검 및 관리에 사용되는 드론의 운용시 원일 모를 고장이나 배터리 방전으로 인하여 육상으로 추락하는 일이 비일비재하게 발생하고 있다. 
본원은 드론이 육상 추락시 지면과의 충격을 가스백이 모두 커버하여 드론의 파손을 최소화하고 특히 하천이나 해상과 같은 수면 추락시 하면에 설치된 가스 주머니인 가스백의 부력으로 고가에 드론이 물에 가라 않지 않고 떠있어 즉시 회수가 가능한 기능성 드론인 것이다.  
또한, 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 침몰 및 파손 방지 기능이 구비되 안전 드론에 있어서, 기체를 저장하는 가스통, 상기 가스통으로부터 상기 가스백까지 기체를 전달하는 가스 주입 포트와 가스 배출호스가 상기 드론의 일측에 배치되고, 내부에 상기 가스통이 구비되는 것을 본원의 특징으로 한다. 
더불어 사람이 모여있는 곳에 드론이 추락을 하더라고 상기 가스백이 인체 추돌시 드론 가스백과 같은 푹신한 방어막을 형성하므로 부상을 예방하고 값비싼 드론을 보다 안전하고 경제적으로 운영할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
드론에 기능 장애 발생이나 주변환경의 급격한 변화 등에 의하여 비정상적으로 운항하거나 낙하하는 경우 낙하하는 드론이 파손되지 않도록 보호하면서 낙하하는 드론에 의하여 인명피해와 같은 피해를 주지 않도록 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Nuclear accident rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a nuclear accident rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of nuclear accident rescue equipment and comprises a movable lifting support, a radiation shield, a plurality of adjusting units, two traction devices and a plurality of flexible wrapping assemblies, wherein the adjusting units are uniformly arranged along the outer surface of the radiation shield, each adjusting unit comprises a mounting frame, a driving gear assembly, a driven gear and a movable screw, the driven gears are rotatably arranged on the mounting frame, one end of each movable screw sequentially penetrates through the driven gears and the mounting frame, the driving gear assembly is arranged on the mounting frame and is positioned on one side of the driven gears to be meshed with the driven gears, an adjusting ball is fixed at one end of each movable screw, a pressure sensor is arranged at the end of each adjusting ball, the inner sides of the radiation shield are arranged in a staggered mode along the circumferential direction, the flexible wrapping assemblies comprise arched flexible plates and two traction devices, the two traction devices are respectively fixed and symmetrically arranged on the cover edges of the radiation shield, and two ends of each flexible plate are respectively connected with the two traction devices. The robot provides a flexible protective mechanical claw which can rapidly wrap a target object or a wounded person and achieves the purposes of stable transfer and nuclear radiation sputtering protection.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle supervision task-oriented abnormal state analysis and detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an abnormal state analysis and detection method and system for unmanned aerial vehicle supervision tasks, comprising an eye movement event detection module, an eye movement characteristic calculation module, an abnormal state detection module and a visual analysis module; the eye movement event detection module is realized by using a double-mean value clustering method, detects different eye movement events and divides the segments of the eye movement data according to the different eye movement events; the eye movement characteristic calculation module is used as input of a subsequent machine learning classification model and is used for visual analysis; the abnormal state detection module predicts the abnormal state by using the classification model based on the calculated eye movement characteristics; the visual analysis module is used for visually analyzing the abnormal state detection result. The invention is insensitive to whether the eye tracker is calibrated or not, and time-consuming calibration of the eye tracker is not needed before work, so that the usability of the system is greatly improved, and the task efficiency is improved; the unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring system can be applied to unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring tasks in the fields of disaster search and rescue, electric power inspection, border patrol, military investigation and the like, and has wide application prospects.

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots. The invention discloses a rescue robot, comprising: the device comprises a trunk, a vision component, a water spraying component, a breaking barrier component and a barrier avoiding component; the visual component is arranged on the trunk and is used for collecting surrounding environment images; the water spraying component is arranged on the trunk and is used for spraying water to a target position; the obstacle breaking assembly is arranged on the trunk and used for breaking obstacles; the obstacle avoidance assembly is arranged on the trunk and used for driving the robot to avoid obstacles. The invention comprises a vision component, a water spraying component, a breaking barrier component and an obstacle avoidance component, wherein the vision component is used for collecting surrounding environment images, the water spraying component is used for spraying water to a target position, the breaking barrier component is used for breaking an obstacle, the obstacle avoidance component is used for driving a robot to avoid the obstacle, the robot can be used for surveying and rescuing after an earthquake disaster, complex disasters can be dealt with, and a technology and equipment guarantee are provided for providing detailed and reliable field information for post-disaster rescue.

title_en: Efficient intelligent post-disaster search and rescue crawler robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster relief, and particularly relates to a high-efficiency intelligent post-disaster search and rescue crawler robot, which comprises: a support platform; the two first crawler mechanisms are used for enabling the supporting platform to move; the two second crawler mechanisms are used for adjusting the posture of the supporting platform; a camera assembly; a laser scanning assembly; a life detection assembly; an external control system. The invention improves the operation efficiency of the search and rescue robot in a complex environment, enhances the adaptability and stability of the search and rescue robot, is convenient for the search and rescue robot to detect the environment and wounded persons under the complex environment condition, and is convenient for personnel rescue.

title_en: Mine rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine rescue robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The robot can make a series of correct judgments under the well with complex environment, and the environment information collected by each sensor on the robot is fed back to the ground end, such as: gas concentration, carbon dioxide concentration, methane concentration, etc. The robot is internally provided with a storage space, so that a part of first-aid materials can be timely conveyed to trapped personnel. The robot is internally provided with a search and rescue module, so that the trapped personnel can be searched and rescued in a complex and difficult environment. The interaction system arranged in the robot can understand simple instructions and timely make feedback. Each function provides a new form for underground rescue, provides a plurality of feasible schemes for underground rescue, is convenient for better commanding rescue actions, and achieves the aim of the invention.

title_en: Time slot allocation method and device for unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a time slot allocation method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an initial time slot allocation result and an adaptability value corresponding to each node in the plurality of nodes; determining the allocation priority corresponding to each node according to the initial time slot allocation result, the adaptability value and the identity information corresponding to each node; and determining a final time slot allocation result according to the allocation priority corresponding to each node. According to the method, the allocation priority is introduced based on the identity of the node in the hierarchical clustering network and the demand degree of the node for the time slot, a final time slot allocation result is obtained according to the allocation priority, the time slot can be allocated more reasonably, and the throughput rate of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster is improved.

title_en: Gecko-like robot design with autonomous ultrasonic detection capability
abstract_en: The invention provides a new gecko-like robot design, and relates to the technical field of special robot equipment. The invention relates to a gecko-like robot which is a special bionic robot with the structure and advantages of a four-foot robot and a wall climbing robot, plays an important role in various fields of aerospace, investigation, disaster search and rescue and the like, and aims to enable the gecko-like robot to normally perform exploration work on complex terrains and various occasions. And then, carrying out statics and dynamics simulation on the robot, and providing a corresponding optimal design scheme aiming at simulation analysis results. Finally, a robot control system is designed to complete the linear walking function and the obstacle avoidance function.

title_en: Electromagnetic wave detection capability testing device for earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake rescue, in particular to an electromagnetic wave detection capability testing device for an earthquake rescue robot, which comprises the following components: a closed space (1); and at least two mesh plates (2) which are detachably arranged on the outer side surface (3) of the closed space (1) and cover at least a part of the outer side surface (3) for simulating wall steel bars. According to the electromagnetic wave detection capability testing device for the earthquake rescue robot, provided by the invention, the wall body with different heights, different reinforcement densities and different reinforcement sizes for the earthquake rescue robot radar detection test can be simulated by adjusting the mesh plates 2. The invention has small occupied area, low manufacturing cost and convenient operation.

title_en: Extreme environment simulation device for earthquake rescue robot test
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake rescue, in particular to an extreme environment simulation device for earthquake rescue robot test, which comprises: a room (1) for providing a test space; and an environment changing device set disposed in the room (1) for changing the environment of the test space; wherein the environment change device group at least comprises any two of the following environment change devices (2): heaters, refrigerators, fuming machines, and humidifiers. The extreme environment simulation device for the earthquake rescue robot test can test the operation capability and adaptability of the earthquake rescue robot in various extreme environments. The invention can combine a plurality of extreme environments and can perform basic function index test experiments of the earthquake rescue robot under comprehensive extreme climate conditions such as extremely cold, high temperature, high humidity, low visibility and the like.

title_en: System searching of sufferer based on unmanned aerial vehicle
title_ko: 무인 비행 기반 조난자 수색 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an unmanned flight-based victim search system. The present invention is to provide an unmanned flight-based victim search system which attaches a sound sensor to an unmanned flying drone to detect only a sound of a specific frequency band generated from a victim even in environmental conditions difficult to access at various disaster sites such as fire sites or collapse sites, thereby determining that the victim has occurred.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무인 비행 기반 조난자 수색 시스템에 관한 것으로, 무인 비행하는 드론에 음향 센서를 부착하여, 화재현장이나 붕괴현장과 같은 각종 재해현장에서 접근이 어려운 환경 조건에서도 조난자로부터 발생하는 특정 주파수 대역의 음향만을 탐지하여 조난자가 발생한 것으로 판단할 수 있는 무인 비행 기반 조난자 수색 시스템을 제공하는 것이다.

title_en: Rescue transfer trolley and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned rescue, and discloses a rescue transfer vehicle and a use method thereof, wherein the rescue transfer vehicle comprises the following components: the device comprises a vehicle body, a ground robot, a retraction device, an aerial robot, a lifting fixing mechanism, a dragging mechanism and a stretcher transferring mechanism; the receiving and releasing device comprises a telescopic mechanism, a bearing mechanism and a receiving box body arranged in the vehicle body, the bearing mechanism can move from the receiving box body to the outside of the vehicle body through an opening, a supporting plate of the bearing mechanism is connected with the telescopic mechanism, a bearing frame can move up and down relative to the supporting plate, and a ground robot can be stopped on the bearing frame; the aerial robot is arranged on the lifting fixing mechanism; the stretcher body of the stretcher transfer mechanism is movably connected with the vehicle body through a transfer rail, and the transfer power assembly can enable the stretcher body to move backwards from a horizontal position on the vehicle body to an inclined position contacting with the ground. The invention can realize unmanned intellectualization of the search and rescue system, quickly search for the positioning of wounded, automatically and accurately stop the transfer trolley, drag the wounded to the stretcher and transport to the medical place.
assignees: GUANGZHOU HAIGE TIANCHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Island surrounding sea area emergency search and rescue method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for emergency search and rescue of sea areas around island reefs, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring acquisition data obtained by searching a designated area by a plurality of first unmanned aerial vehicles, and dynamically adjusting the flight strategy of each first unmanned aerial vehicle according to each acquisition data; acquiring video data obtained when each first unmanned aerial vehicle executes a corresponding flight strategy, and determining the target position of the victim according to the video data and the acquired data; acquiring the current position of a second unmanned aerial vehicle flying in a designated area, wherein the second unmanned aerial vehicle is an unmanned aerial vehicle on which rescue materials are mounted; comparing the current position of each second unmanned aerial vehicle with the target position, marking the second unmanned aerial vehicle closest to the target position as the target unmanned aerial vehicle, generating a scheduling instruction according to the target position, and issuing the scheduling instruction to the target unmanned aerial vehicle so as to control the target unmanned aerial vehicle to execute the rescue and release task.
assignees: CHINA COMMUNICATIONS CONSTRUCTION CO LTD NANFANG BRANCH

title_en: Underwater power-assisted robot device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an underwater power-assisted robot device, wherein a computer main board, a camera, a navigation controller, a water depth sensor, a sonar detector, an illuminating lamp and a mechanical arm are arranged on a machine body of a submersible, the computer main board is connected with a shore-controlled PC (personal computer) through a communication line, the camera and the navigation controller are electrically connected with the computer main board, and a steering engine, the water depth sensor, the sonar detector and the illuminating lamp of the mechanical arm are electrically connected with the navigation controller. Compared with the prior art, the system can replace manual underwater operation with extremely high risk coefficient, is convenient for rapid case detection, is widely applied to various fields including ocean engineering, scientific research, maritime law enforcement evidence collection, naval defense and the like, and is used for completing various works such as underwater search and rescue, underwater investigation, detection and salvage, material evidence collection, deep sea resource investigation, underwater engineering inspection and maintenance and the like.

title_en: Multifunctional emergency rescue robot suitable for mine disaster condition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency rescue robots, and discloses a multifunctional emergency rescue robot suitable for mine disasters, which comprises a robot main body, wherein the outer wall of the robot main body is rotationally connected with a movable wheel, the outer wall of the movable wheel is provided with a movable crawler belt, the outer wall fixedly connected with first fixed block of robot main part, the last fixed surface fixedly connected with fixing base of first fixed block, the outer wall rotation of fixing base is connected with the dead lever, the outer wall fixedly connected with rectangle frame of dead lever, the inner wall sliding connection of rectangle frame has the removal post. The telescopic rod is driven to overturn through the fixed rod, the protection plate positioned on the side edge of the robot main body is driven to the upper side of the robot main body, so that key parts of the robot in the mine can be prevented from being directly smashed by falling rocks, the normal operation of the robot is protected, the working time of a disaster site is prolonged, the rescue efficiency is improved, and the complex situation in a mine under the condition of mine disasters is dealt with.
assignees: HUANENG COAL TECH RESEARCH CO LTD;WALNUT COAL MINE HUANENG QINGYANG COAL AND ELECTRICITY CO LTD;GENERAL PROSPECTING INSTITUTE CHINA NAT ADMINISTRATION OF COAL GEOLOGY

title_en: Tunnel deformation driving robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a roadway deformation driving robot, which relates to the technical field of robots and comprises a machine main body, wherein two arc-shaped display boards are arranged on the machine main body and are connected with the machine main body through rotating shafts, and arc-shaped guide rails are arranged on the arc-shaped display boards; the bottom of the machine body is provided with two linear guide rails, the linear guide rails are movably connected with a movable wheel driving piece, and the movable wheel driving piece is fixedly connected with a shifting running wheel; a deformation driving part for driving the two arc-shaped display boards to be simultaneously opened or closed is arranged in the machine body; after the arc-shaped display board is completely opened, the arc-shaped guide rail is in smooth butt joint with the corresponding linear guide rail; the machine body is provided with two driving running wheels which are driven by respective main motors. The running robot provided by the invention can stably run in a concave environment with a certain concave degree, and provides basic conditions for work such as inspection, search and rescue and the like when the running robot is unfolded in the concave environment.

title_en: Mining robot search and rescue path self-adaptive optimization model construction method based on PPO-CA
abstract_en: The invention provides a mining robot search and rescue path self-adaptive optimization model construction method based on PPO-CA, and belongs to the field of mine emergency rescue. The invention comprises: firstly, constructing an autonomous terrain perception and obstacle avoidance model of a mine search and rescue robot through the fusion of three technologies of three-dimensional motion model navigation, three-dimensional sonar waveform processing and three-dimensional vision sensor image analysis; secondly, constructing a motion track comprising a system state, a behavior and a reward function according to a Markov decision model, and obtaining an approximate value of a gradient through a Monte Carlo approximate expectation method; then, optimizing gradient calculation through an A2C algorithm, and introducing importance sampling to improve the utilization rate of data; finally, adopting a near-end strategy optimization cutting attention mechanism algorithm (Proximal Policy Optimization Clip Attention, PPO-CA) to enable updating of an objective function to be more stable, and finally obtaining a mining robot search and rescue path self-adaptive optimization model through continuous iteration of strategy parameters to better meet the actual application scene.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue path planning method, device and program product
abstract_en: The invention provides a maritime search and rescue path planning method, a maritime search and rescue path planning device and a program product, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, receiving position information of a search and rescue signal, and establishing a two-dimensional grid map of an area where the position information is located; s2, quantifying seawater flow information and marine environment information in the two-dimensional grid map into corresponding grade values, accumulating the two grade values to obtain a comprehensive environment influence value of the two-dimensional grid, and dividing the two-dimensional grid map into search and rescue areas with different priorities according to a preset corresponding relation; s3, planning a search and rescue path by adopting a corresponding search and rescue path planning algorithm according to the priority; s4, after the unmanned ship carries the unmanned aerial vehicle to reach the position of the search and rescue signal, expanding the search and rescue according to the search and rescue path; and S5, when the target detected by the unmanned aerial vehicle is greater than the preset detection confidence, the unmanned ship reaches the position of the target for secondary confirmation. By utilizing the technical scheme, the efficiency and the success rate of maritime search and rescue are remarkably improved, and the method is particularly outstanding in a middle and open sea complex environment.

title_en: Multifunctional rescue searching and rescuing device for machine dog
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rescue search and rescue equipment, in particular to a multifunctional rescue search and rescue device for a robot dog. The mounting box is connected with the machine dog through a power supply communication interface, a radio microphone is arranged in front of the mounting box, the megaphone and the searchlight are arranged above the mounting box, the radio microphone is connected with the megaphone through a main board in the mounting box, red and blue warning lamps are arranged on two sides of the mounting box, and meanwhile the searchlight is connected with the mounting box through a searchlight mounting frame in an adjustable angle. The utility model is matched with the machine dog for use, and the plurality of power supply communication interfaces are suitable for machine dogs with different specifications and models, so that the machine dog is more convenient to use, has various functions, has the functions of warning, shouting, searchlight and the like, can regulate angles according to actual needs, and is more convenient to use in rescue operation.
assignees: HENAN WANXINGXINGCHI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Building fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building fire rescue robot, in particular to the field of fire robots, which comprises a mobile robot, wherein an executing mechanism is arranged on the mobile robot and comprises a supporting seat IV, a detecting mechanism is arranged on the supporting seat IV, the detecting mechanism comprises a visual identification module and a temperature identification module, and the mobile robot is used for driving the supporting seat IV to horizontally move. According to the utility model, by arranging the executing mechanism, not only can the electric equipment with different heights be inspected, but also the fire-starting positions with different heights can be effectively extinguished when a fire disaster occurs, so that the scale of the fire disaster is prevented from being enlarged. Through setting up the booster, carbon dioxide fire extinguishing gas when circulating in the hose, can increase the velocity of flow of gas in the hose through the booster to can improve gaseous velocity of flow and pressure, in order to improve the effect of putting out a fire.
assignees: ZHONGHUI XIANGRUI CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Model predictive control-based motor boat formation path tracking control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a model predictive control-based unmanned ship formation path tracking control method, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a three-degree-of-freedom unmanned ship motion mathematical model considering external interference and a six-degree-of-freedom unmanned ship motion mathematical model; s2, designing reference tracks of unmanned ships and unmanned aerial vehicles in a unmanned ship formation configuration by taking time as a parameter based on a virtual structure formation method; s3, constructing a nonlinear disturbance observer according to the unmanned ship movement mathematical model so as to observe the unmanned ship disturbance and compensate the unmanned ship disturbance at a control input end; s4, constructing a plane ship formation path tracking control law according to the reference track of the unmanned ship and the unmanned plane based on a model predictive control algorithm so as to realize control of unmanned ship and unmanned plane formation path tracking according to the plane ship formation path tracking control law. The problem of compare in unmanned aerial vehicle, unmanned ship's visual distance and supervision scope are less, so have the difficulty when carrying out tasks such as search and rescue or maritime work patrol, current unmanned ship-unmanned aerial vehicle formation can not be abundant in addition consider under the condition that there is environmental interference to the unstable influence that formation control system caused is solved.

title_en: Separable fire rescue robot device and control method
abstract_en: A separable fire rescue robot device and a control method thereof relate to the technical field of fire rescue. The invention solves the problems that the existing flapping-wing rescue robot is difficult to maintain stable flight, incapable of breaking and disassembling and capable of carrying out on-site comprehensive rescue. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle is adopted as the transportation device of the multi-terrain rescue robot, and the unmanned aerial vehicle occupies a small space compared with a flapping wing in the flight process of the rescue scene, so that the collision probability with members such as steel bars, balance beams, broken stones and the like in the rescue scene can be effectively avoided or reduced, the stability of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the flight process is ensured, and the problem of limited flight space is further reduced to the greatest extent. The unmanned transportation device and the multi-terrain rescue robot can be effectively integrated, the rescue efficiency is improved, the purpose of timely and accurate rescue is achieved, the unmanned transportation device and the multi-terrain rescue robot are endowed with the characteristics of separation-combination and multi-function integration, and the unmanned transportation device and the multi-terrain rescue robot are more suitable for emergency rescue scenes. The invention is used for rescuing on fire scene.

title_en: Reconfigurable multi-movement-mode rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a reconfigurable multi-movement-mode rescue robot which comprises a robot body and a robot module, wherein the robot body is of a triangular structure, the three sides are respectively connected with the robot module through connecting a buckle matching buckle groove and a gear sleeve in a rotating mode, three sides of the robot body are also provided with digital steering gears, rotating shafts of the digital steering gears are correspondingly matched with the gear sleeve, the gear sleeve is driven to rotate through the rotation of the digital steering gears, and then the three robot modules are driven to rotate respectively to form a risk avoiding space. The rescue robot has smaller volume and changeable overall form and dimension, can adapt to various environments, can quickly search survivors and protect the survivors or provide rescue materials, and can solve the problems that the environment of a disaster site is complex, rescue workers are difficult to enter the interior, the survivors are serious in injury and difficult to rescue, and the like.
assignees: ORDOS HAOHUA HONGQINGLIANG MINING CO LTD;BEIJING JINGNENG ENERGY TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Fire control removes snatchs rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting mobile grabbing rescue robot, which relates to the technical field of fire-fighting rescue and comprises a sleeve type baffle plate, wherein the sleeve type baffle plate is used for conducting interval type resisting protection on a contact surface of a clamping plate, the grabbing device further comprises a first curved plate, one side of the first curved plate is fixedly connected with a motor, the fire-fighting mobile grabbing rescue robot is convenient for the sleeve type baffle plate to be matched with an object surface through a rubber plastic pad made of elastic materials arranged on one side of the sleeve type clamping plate close to the sleeve type baffle plate, the situation that the sleeve type baffle plate is difficult to be contacted with the object surface due to the fact that more irregular sundries exist on the grabbed object surface is prevented, the sleeve type baffle plate is arranged on one side of the sleeve type clamping plate to be in direct contact with the object for interval type resisting protection, and the risk that the clamping plate is damaged easily when the clamping plate is closely contacted with a high-temperature object or corrosive product for a long time, so that the grabbing force of the clamping plate is reduced, and the object is prevented from sliding down.
assignees: BEIJING JINGPINTEZHUANG SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Teleoperation rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a teleoperation rescue robot which comprises a chassis, a moving mechanism and a moving mechanism, wherein the moving mechanism comprises wheels and a driving motor, the moving mechanism is arranged on the chassis, a cradle head is arranged on the upper surface of the chassis, a first motor is arranged at the bottom of the chassis, the first motor drives the cradle head to rotate, a mechanical arm is arranged on the cradle head, clamping jaws are arranged at the end parts of the mechanical arm and are driven to clamp and loosen by a special second motor, a main control circuit board and a power supply unit are arranged on the chassis, a camera is arranged at the front part of the chassis, a control instruction sent by a remote control end is connected with the robot through a communication unit, and a main control MCU controls the moving mechanism and the moving mechanism to move according to the control instruction. The utility model can replace firefighters to go deep into the scene to implement search and rescue activities, protects the personal safety of firefighters, can find trapped personnel in places which firefighters are not easy to reach as soon as possible, is convenient to implement rescue measures in advance, and can greatly improve rescue efficiency.

title_en: Search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a search and rescue robot, which comprises a robot body, wherein triangular plates are arranged at four corners of the robot body, a driving structure is arranged on each triangular plate and comprises a double-shaft steering engine I, a double-shaft steering engine II, a connecting frame, a crawler mechanism and a supporting component, an output shaft of the double-shaft steering engine I penetrates through the triangular plates and is connected with the double-shaft steering engine II, two output shafts of the double-shaft steering engine II are connected with L-shaped arms, the lower ends of the two L-shaped arms are rotatably connected with the connecting frame, two ends of the connecting frame are respectively connected with the crawler mechanism and the supporting component, and an adjusting component is arranged between the crawler mechanism and the L-shaped arms. The utility model can effectively travel on special road surfaces after earthquake, climb on collapsed trees and ruins, and have the capability of crossing obstacles.

title_en: Image quality enhancement method based on self-adaptive adjustment of light source intensity
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image quality enhancement method based on self-adaptive adjustment of light source intensity, which comprises the following steps of firstly constructing a data set, sorting and screening the data set, then training the screened data set to obtain a light source intensity prediction model, then predicting the optimal light source intensity by utilizing the light source intensity prediction model according to the distance and angle information of a light source to a target object fed back in real time in the moving process of a robot, and finally converting the obtained optimal light source intensity into a PWM signal, and realizing accurate control of the light source brightness by a singlechip. In addition, the mechanical arm is flexibly controlled, the specific position is accurately illuminated, the operation efficiency of the rescue robot in a complex and severe post-disaster mine environment is enhanced, the energy consumption is reduced, and the overall working efficiency is improved.

title_en: Crawler-type earthquake emergency rescue robot with strong multi-environment adaptability
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue robots and discloses a crawler-type earthquake emergency rescue robot with strong multi-environment adaptability, which comprises a robot body, a plurality of auxiliary arm crawler mechanisms and a plurality of auxiliary arm crawler mechanisms, wherein the two sides of the robot body are provided with walking crawler mechanisms; the inside of robot body is equipped with auxiliary moving mechanism, auxiliary moving mechanism can stretch out by the below of robot body. Through auxiliary arm crawler cooperation walking crawler, can drive the robot body and cross higher obstacle, can drive the robot body through supplementary moving mechanism and remove to arbitrary direction with shorter route in shorter time to change the direction of movement of robot body, make rescue robot can adapt to more complicated environment, in order to promote search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Remote rescue remote sensing information processing method and related device for biped rescue robot
abstract_en: The application discloses a remote rescue remote sensing information processing method and a related device of a biped rescue robot, which are applied to a teleoperation system terminal, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining first information of a disaster-stricken area, wherein the first information comprises the temperature of the disaster-stricken area, the smoke concentration of the disaster-stricken area, video information of the disaster-stricken area and audio information of the disaster-stricken area; the method comprises the steps of determining a first index for measuring disaster degree of a disaster area according to first information, judging whether a person to be rescued exists in the disaster area according to the first information, determining a target rescue measure according to the first index and a preset disaster degree threshold value if the person to be rescued exists in the disaster area, and rescuing the person to be rescued according to the target rescue measure. The biped rescue robot is remotely controlled to enter the disaster area to collect information, and the trapped personnel are rescued according to the information, so that the safety of the rescue personnel is ensured, and meanwhile, the rescue information processing efficiency is improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI FOURIER INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle path planning method based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle systems and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle path planning method based on deep learning, which comprises the following working steps of acquiring unmanned aerial vehicle flight environment data in real time through a data acquisition module; the third step, the data training module trains the stored data by utilizing a deep learning algorithm, and optimizes a path planning model in the artificial intelligent module. According to the method, intelligent planning and optimization of the unmanned aerial vehicle path are realized through a deep learning technology, and the flight safety, flexibility and robustness of the unmanned aerial vehicle in a complex environment are improved by combining the mechanisms of real-time data acquisition, safety early warning, system self-optimization and upgrading and the like. Through the 5G communication and data encryption technology, the high efficiency and the safety of data transmission are ensured, and the method has wide application prospects in the fields of logistics, agriculture, environmental monitoring, search and rescue and the like.
assignees: TIANJIN SINO GERMAN UNIV APPLIED SCIENCES

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle self-adaptive wind disturbance resisting angle formation control method under input limitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle self-adaptive wind disturbance resisting angle formation control method under input limitation, which comprises the steps of 1) dividing external wind disturbance into mean wind, gust and wind shear, combining different wind conditions into a composite wind disturbance model, 2) establishing an input limited model by analyzing nonlinear characteristics of an unmanned aerial vehicle, 3) establishing a four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle formation system model according to communication topology, 4) designing global stable angle rigid formation control law and self-adaptive law by utilizing local information obtained by communication, 5) designing a formation control strategy based on the angle information, and 6) calculating control input of each four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle by integrating the steps. The method has the characteristics of simple structure, high reliability, high control precision and easiness in practical application, and the formed four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle has wide application in the fields of environment monitoring, search and rescue, military and the like.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle load combination
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle load combination, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a searchlight and a megaphone, wherein the top end surface of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is provided with a butt joint port, the bottom end surface of a searchlight control box is provided with the megaphone, the inner side of the end part of the top end surface of a connecting piece and the inner side of the lower part of the two end surfaces of a megaphone shell are both provided with hand screws, and through the combined design of the searchlight body and the megaphone body, the unmanned aerial vehicle can have the functions of illumination and megaphone simultaneously, can be disassembled simply and conveniently, and the functions of illumination or megaphone are used singly, so that the functional diversity and the task execution capability of the unmanned aerial vehicle are greatly improved. In complex environments such as night search and rescue, safety inspection and the like, an unmanned aerial vehicle can provide illumination by using a searchlight, and meanwhile instruction transmission or information communication is carried out by a megaphone, so that the execution efficiency and accuracy of tasks are remarkably improved.

title_en: Rescue robot with rescue equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue robot with rescue equipment, which belongs to the technical field of rescue equipment and aims at solving the problems of poor rescue effect on people falling into water and difficult movement in a narrow area, and the rescue robot comprises a central plate and a plurality of inflatable buoys, wherein the inflatable buoys are circumferentially distributed outside the central plate, one side of the central plate is provided with an extension assembly matched with the inflatable buoys, a mounting plate is arranged under the central plate, one side wall of the mounting plate is fixedly provided with a waterproof motor, one end of an output shaft of the waterproof motor is fixedly provided with a propeller, and one side of the central plate is provided with an adjusting assembly matched with the mounting plate; according to the utility model, through the arrangement of the extension assembly, the distance between the inflatable pontoon and the central plate can be adjusted according to specific requirements, so that the rescue effect on a person falling into water can be greatly improved, the situation that the person falling into water is difficult to rescue due to inconvenient adjustment position caused by narrow space is avoided, and meanwhile, the casualties of rescue workers can be greatly reduced.

title_en: Beidou-based multifunctional snake-shaped robot control method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a Beidou-based multifunctional snake-shaped robot control method and device, and relates to the technical field of bionic robots, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a snake-shaped robot motion model; predicting the path and the observed road sign position in the map according to the motion model of the snake-shaped robot and the control information and the observation information acquired at each moment, and moving the snake-shaped robot according to the path and the observed road sign position in the map. The invention provides a Beidou-based multifunctional snake-shaped robot control method and device, wherein a transverse fluctuation coupling nonlinear oscillator system controls movement of a snake-shaped robot, and sensor modules related to pipeline detection, life search and rescue and water quality detection are added on a snake-shaped robot body so as to realize three different functions.

title_en: Odor tracing unmanned aerial vehicle and search robot collaborative navigation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a collaborative navigation method and a collaborative navigation system for an odor tracing unmanned aerial vehicle and a search robot, and relates to the technical field of intelligent search and rescue. According to the invention, the information entropy is used as a main odor navigation basis, so that the search robot can still normally operate and accurately navigate in environments with poor visibility such as smoke diffusion, night or low illumination, and the application scene of the search robot is expanded.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue image fusion method and device based on feature matching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue image fusion method and device of an unmanned aerial vehicle based on feature matching, which belong to the technical field of image processing and comprise the steps of obtaining a feature image and a thermodynamic diagram based on an RGB image and an infrared image and respectively converting the feature image and the thermodynamic diagram into a feature image model and a thermodynamic diagram image model, updating undirected edges of the two image models through a Markov random field, updating directed edges through a Bayesian network, calculating the regional similarity between the updated two image models through a twin network, obtaining an optimal region matching result through global energy minimization, fusing the feature image and the thermodynamic diagram into a first fused image, respectively extracting image features and thermodynamic features from the feature image and the thermodynamic diagram, combining spatial attention, channel attention and feature reconstruction to obtain a reconstructed feature image and a reconstructed thermodynamic diagram, and fusing the reconstructed feature image into a second fused image, and combining the first fused image and the second fused image into a final generated image. The method and the device can improve the efficiency and accuracy of searching target personnel in complex scenes such as unmanned aerial vehicle searching and rescuing.

title_en: Collaborative task allocation and path planning method and system for search and rescue machine crowd group
abstract_en: The invention provides a search and rescue machine crowd cooperative task allocation and path planning method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a global product Markov decision process model according to task requirements corresponding to search and rescue machine crowd system tasks and current environment information; the method comprises the steps of selecting robots circularly based on an MDP model, solving an optimal strategy of each robot in a local MDP model by using an improved Q-learning algorithm, controlling the selected robots to move according to the optimal strategy, updating environment estimation weights of each step of movement of the robots, fusing environment estimation results of the robots, updating a global product MDP according to the environment fusion results, judging whether the final state of the global product MDP is entered, stopping calculation if the final state is entered, otherwise, returning the final state to enable all the robots to complete search and rescue tasks and update all positions in the implementation process, and solving the technical problem of the prior art that the applicability of the search and rescue robots in an actual task environment is effectively improved.

title_en: Exploration and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an exploration and rescue robot which comprises a machine body, a transmission mechanism and a rescue mechanism, wherein the transmission mechanism is arranged on the machine body, the transmission mechanism comprises a transmission wheel assembly and a propelling assembly arranged on one side of the machine body close to the transmission wheel assembly, the transmission wheel assembly is connected with the machine body through a damping assembly, the propelling assembly comprises floating pieces and propellers which are arranged on two sides of the machine body, the rescue mechanism comprises a functional assembly wall breaking assembly arranged on one side of the machine body far away from the transmission wheel assembly, and the functional assembly comprises a positioning piece and a camera which are arranged on the machine body. The utility model drives the machine body to travel on the road surface through the driving wheel assembly, breaks the wall breaking assembly to break the obstacle for trapped personnel, can provide buoyancy for the machine body through the floating piece and provide power for the propeller to realize the underwater exploration function when working underwater, and the positioning piece and the camera can acquire the information of the disaster-stricken environment in real time, thereby being capable of replacing rescue personnel to carry out rescue actions under some emergency conditions.
assignees: GANNAN UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Robot vision SLAM method and system based on multi-scale residual error network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot vision SLAM method based on a multi-scale residual error network, which comprises the following steps of obtaining a working environment image of a robot, carrying out equal division cutting, drawing a brightness gray scale image, wherein the working environment image is an RGB image, carrying out high-brightness image and low-brightness image identification in the working environment image based on the brightness gray scale image, carrying out enhancement processing on the low-brightness image by utilizing the multi-scale residual error network to obtain an enhanced low-brightness image, and carrying out tracking, local image construction and closed loop detection in sequence based on the high-brightness image and the enhanced low-brightness image to obtain an optimized robot pose and a global map. The method has the advantages that through intelligent processing of images under different illumination conditions, the positioning and map construction capabilities of the robot in a complex environment are remarkably improved, and the method is particularly suitable for various application scenes such as indoor navigation, unmanned warehouse management and search and rescue.

title_en: Multifunctional rescue robot based on fire scene
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional rescue robot based on a fire scene, which belongs to the technical field of fire rescue robots and comprises a chassis, wherein claw-type opening and closing obstacle crossing wheels are arranged at four corners of the chassis, an obstacle cleaning mechanism is arranged on the top surface of the front end of the chassis, a jack lifting structure is arranged on the top surface of the rear end of the chassis, a fire extinguishing steering mechanism and an automatic opening and closing material transportation box are sequentially arranged in the middle of the top surface of the chassis from front to back, the bottom end of the fire extinguishing steering mechanism is communicated with a fire extinguisher switching mechanism, the fire extinguisher switching mechanism is fixedly connected with the top surface of the chassis, a cover plate is fixedly connected with the top surface of the chassis, a containing cavity is formed between the cover plate and the chassis, the fire extinguisher switching mechanism is positioned in the containing cavity, and the fire extinguishing steering mechanism is positioned on the top surface of the cover plate. The fire extinguisher combines a plurality of mechanisms, has various functions, realizes fire extinguishing in a plurality of different complex environments, replaces manual fire extinguishing, ensures the safety of firefighters, greatly reduces the casualty rate, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Outdoor search and rescue device based on laser radar and thermal imaging
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an outdoor search and rescue device based on a laser radar and thermal imaging, which comprises a frame and a main control box fixedly arranged in the middle of the frame, wherein mounting frames are fixedly arranged on four side sides of the frame, wing mechanisms for controlling the search and rescue device to fly are fixedly arranged on the four mounting frames, the thermal imaging mechanism for searching and rescue is fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the frame, and a battery rack is fixedly arranged in the middle of the top end of the frame.

title_en: Smart drone rescue and mission rescheduling on a swarm of drones
abstract_en: According to one embodiment, a method, computer system, and computer program product for rescuing a malfunctioning drone is provided. The present invention may include responsive to detecting a total failure in a malfunctioning drone comprising a drone fleet, operating one or more rescue drones to physically or virtually attach to the malfunctioning drone; reconfiguring sub-missions comprising a mission assigned to the drone fleet based on an absence of the malfunctioning drone and the one or more rescue drones; and transporting, by the one or more rescue drones, the malfunctioning drone to a safe landing location.

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle cluster exploration method based on neighborhood random network distillation
abstract_en: The application provides a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle cluster exploration method based on neighborhood random network distillation, which comprises the steps of initializing unmanned aerial vehicle states, network parameters and super parameters in unmanned aerial vehicle training, constructing joint observation of unmanned aerial vehicles into neighborhood observation data, converting the neighborhood observation into neighborhood characterization through a coding layer, obtaining attention weights through attention modules in the neighborhood random network, obtaining communication weights through the neighborhood characterization through communication modules in the neighborhood random network, obtaining exploration characterization of unmanned aerial vehicle clusters through an output layer by the attention weights and the communication weights, calculating intrinsic rewards, obtaining comprehensive rewards by weighting calculation of the intrinsic rewards and the environmental rewards, updating the network parameters of unmanned aerial vehicle training, and carrying out next iteration to obtain an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster control model. The method can make full use of the neighborhood relation among unmanned aerial vehicles in the search and rescue environment with sparse rewards to realize efficient exploration of the environment and intelligent control of the unmanned aerial vehicle clusters.

title_en: Cluster cooperation method and device for search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle system
abstract_en: The application relates to a cluster cooperation method and device of a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle system. The method comprises the steps of respectively sending preset search and rescue information to a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles, wherein the search and rescue information comprises a search and rescue area and a search and rescue target, obtaining search and rescue results obtained by the unmanned aerial vehicles based on the search and rescue information, screening target results from the search and rescue results, wherein the target results are search and rescue results with the search and rescue target, and respectively sending the target results to the unmanned aerial vehicles. Through sending preset search and rescue information to a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles respectively to make unmanned aerial vehicle obtain search and rescue result based on search and rescue information, be convenient for control a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles simultaneously, improved control efficiency. Then under the condition that the search and rescue targets exist in the search and rescue results, the search and rescue results are respectively sent to the unmanned aerial vehicles, so that sharing of data among the unmanned aerial vehicles is completed, repeated search of the unmanned aerial vehicles is avoided, and search and rescue efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicles is improved.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID BIG DATA SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Modularized robot for fire control
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire control and discloses a modularized robot for fire control, which comprises a machine body, wherein a mounting platform is mounted on the top surface of the machine body, a module platform is arranged on the top surface of the mounting platform, at least five groups of module platforms are arranged, and a fire extinguishing module, a smoke discharging module, a water hose collecting and releasing module, a lighting module and a detection reminding module are respectively mounted on the top surfaces of the five groups of module platforms. The robot carries different modules for fire control through the robot to achieve different fire control purposes, can replace manual carrying of a water gun to enter a scene for fire extinguishment, can carry the existing fire-fighting hydraulic smoke extractor to enter an indoor scene with dense smoke for smoke extraction, can independently or along with fire fighters to enter the scene, assist in investigation and personnel search and rescue on scene conditions, can illuminate the scene at night or indoors, can lay and roll up a water hose, and can automatically select modules required for installation according to scene conditions and requirements during use.

title_en: Bionic post-disaster search and rescue robot for spiders
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots, and provides a bionic spider post-disaster search and rescue robot which comprises a robot head, an abdomen jack and six groups of leg hydraulic mechanisms, wherein the abdomen jack is provided with a head connecting frame, the robot head is arranged on the head connecting frame, three groups of leg hydraulic mechanisms are respectively arranged on two sides of the abdomen jack, and each leg hydraulic mechanism comprises a first joint, a first joint hydraulic device, a first joint connecting piece, a second joint hydraulic device, a joint connecting rod, a second joint, a third joint, legs and feet. The utility model can rapidly move in narrow ruins to perform post-disaster search and rescue, can clear up obstacles such as broken stones encountered in the search process, and improves search and rescue efficiency and search and rescue personnel safety.

title_en: Dragonfly-simulated flapping-wing flying robot with multiple degrees of freedom and brain-like control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dragonfly-simulated flapping-wing flying robot with multiple degrees of freedom and a brain-like control method, which comprise a skeleton device, a flying device, a detection device, a tail device, a control console and a leg device, wherein the skeleton device is fixedly connected with the flying device, the detection device, the tail device, the control console and the leg device, the flying device is used for controlling the flying of the robot, the detection device is used for detecting environmental information, the tail device is used for stabilizing flying, and the control console is used for controlling the skeleton device, the flying device, the detection device and the tail device to work. The invention adopts the design of the flapping wing structure imitating the dragonfly and the design scheme of independently driving four wings, thereby providing higher flexibility and maneuverability and enabling the flapping wing to execute complex flight actions such as hovering, fast turning and accurate landing. The flexibility enables the robot to perform excellently in narrow or complex environments, and can adapt to different task demands, such as environment monitoring, indoor navigation, search and rescue and the like.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU;JINGDONG TECHNOLOGY INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Underground structure for functional test of disaster accident earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake rescue, in particular to an underground structure for testing functions of earthquake rescue robots in disasters and accidents, wherein a comprehensive testing system is located in an underground space and comprises at least two testing units which are connected in series, wherein each testing unit is communicated through a channel, a passing testing device or/and an environment control device is arranged in each testing unit, the channels are selectively opened or closed through a door, a lifting device is used as a connecting channel of the ground space and the underground space and used for carrying the earthquake rescue robots to convert between the ground space and the underground space, an extreme environment simulation unit is used for simulating a comprehensive extreme environment, and a climbing testing device is connected with the testing units and the extreme environment simulation unit. The invention can simulate various emergency situations after earthquake in underground space, including extreme environment and complex terrain, and can test the earthquake rescue robot in different types according to specific requirements so as to meet application requirements in different scenes.

title_en: Infrared image processing method and device for realizing night vision function
abstract_en: The invention discloses an infrared image processing method and device for realizing a night vision function, which relate to the technical field of image processing, and are used for acquiring an active infrared image and a passive infrared image, registering images according to a preset overlapped view field, performing resolution alignment by using a bilinear interpolation method, denoising the active infrared image through an improved non-local mean value filtering algorithm, determining a suspicious heat source area according to the passive infrared image, and enhancing the active infrared image according to the suspicious heat source area to obtain a target fusion image. The active infrared image can provide environmental terrain information, the passive infrared image can provide heat source information of trapped people, and the heat source information is added into the active infrared image to obtain a fusion image, so that the search and rescue personnel can see clear terrain features through the fusion image and can easily find the trapped people, the search and rescue personnel are not limited by dark environments at night, and the search and rescue efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Detection rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a detection rescue robot, which belongs to the field of emergency rescue and solves the problem that the existing rescue robot cannot continue to operate after searching a single survivor, and comprises a rescue robot main body, a movable crawler assembly and a shooting assembly, wherein the two sides of the rescue robot main body are symmetrically provided with auxiliary rescue robot main body integrally movable crawler assemblies, the survivors can communicate with the outside conveniently, detailed coordinate information of the survivors is provided, rescue emergency materials can be put in the putting process, the survivors can carry out emergency treatment on the survivors in use, after the putting is completed, the rescue robot can continue to move and put into the line of searching for the next survivors, and the survivors can not serve as a coordinate transmitter or a communication tool nearby the survivors, so that the working quality of the equipment in use is guaranteed.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & TECH CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Multi-robot cooperative control method and system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-robot cooperative control method and system based on edge calculation, which relate to the technical field of multi-robot control and comprise the steps of dividing a search and rescue area into a plurality of subareas, generating a subarea search and rescue task, generating an optimal matching scheme of the subarea search and rescue task and the subarea search and rescue task according to the subarea search and rescue task and capacity parameters and current states of all the ground robots, adopting different search and rescue strategies for different types of ground robots, generating a heterogeneous robot cooperative search and rescue strategy by defining formal languages and morphology of cooperative control of all the ground robots, executing the search and rescue task in the corresponding subarea according to the heterogeneous robot cooperative search and rescue strategy, starting calculation and unloading decisions when the condition of resource use or network condition is detected to meet preset conditions, and unloading part of the search and rescue tasks to other calculation nodes according to decision results until the search and rescue task is completed.
assignees: TIANJIN SAIWEI INDUSTRIAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional infrared thermal imaging temperature measurement double-light firefighting intelligent display helmet
abstract_en: The invention provides a multifunctional infrared thermal imaging temperature measurement double-light firefighting intelligent display helmet, which relates to the technical field of firefighting search and rescue and comprises a helmet shell, wherein a helmet liner is fixedly arranged on the inner side of the helmet shell, a circuit controller is fixedly arranged at the tail part of the helmet shell, a high-temperature resistant wire is fixedly connected with the circuit controller, an intelligent controller is fixedly arranged at the top part of the circuit controller, an imaging mechanism is fixedly arranged at one end, far away from the circuit controller, of the helmet shell, a display mechanism is fixedly connected below a visor of the helmet shell, a connecting ring and a scraping plate are arranged, and by arranging the infrared thermal imager, firefighters are assisted in disaster relief actions, dense smoke in a fire scene can be attached to the lens end of the infrared thermal imager, and the firefighters can drive the scraping plate to scrape the lens of the infrared thermal imager through rotating the connecting ring, so that the problem that firefighters of the traditional device are not easy to clean the lens under the condition of wearing firefighting gloves is solved.
assignees: BEIJING SETTALL TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue training system based on VR
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue training system based on VR, which relates to the technical field of maritime rescue and comprises a basic platform layer for providing a bottom hardware resource environment support for a data resource layer, a data resource layer for providing fresh and high-quality basic data resources for service support layer data application, and a service support layer and application system layer for providing service call, interface management and safe operation basic service support services for an application system layer, wherein the application system layer comprises a virtual marine environment simulation subsystem, an immersion subsystem, a motion capture subsystem and a result evaluation feedback subsystem, and is used for enabling a trainer to operate the system for maritime search and rescue training of an unmanned aerial vehicle according to the process of training virtual environment construction, training motion capture mapping and training result evaluation feedback. The invention can solve the problem that unmanned aerial vehicle operators are difficult to accurately control the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle in a short time, and can quickly find and identify the capability of the personnel in distress on the sea.

title_en: Infrared ad hoc network video command system for disaster site search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model provides an infrared ad hoc network video command system for disaster site search and rescue, which comprises an ad hoc network module, a command box, a thermal imaging module and a command post, wherein the ad hoc network module comprises a first ad hoc network radio station, a second ad hoc network radio station, a third ad hoc network radio station and a fourth ad hoc network radio station, the command box, the first ad hoc network radio station, the second ad hoc network radio station, the third ad hoc network radio station and the fourth ad hoc network radio station are in two-phase intercommunication communication connection, the command box is electrically connected with the command post, the first ad hoc network radio station, the second ad hoc network radio station, the third ad hoc network radio station and the fourth ad hoc network radio station are respectively in communication connection with the thermal imaging module, and the command box comprises a power amplifier module, an internal ad hoc network radio station, a 4G module, a display control terminal and a power module. The utility model can effectively shorten the search and rescue time and improve the search and rescue efficiency.
assignees: WUHAN XINLANG PHOTOELECTRIC TECH CO LTD;HUAXIA CHUANGWEI BEIJING SAFETY PREVENTION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Air-ground cooperative rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a land-air cooperative rescue robot, which relates to the field of special robots and comprises a flight module, a walking module and a control module, wherein the walking module comprises two groups of walking feet, each walking foot consists of a plurality of electric joints capable of rotating in multiple degrees of freedom, the bottom of each walking foot is provided with a plurality of driving wheels, the joints in the middle of each walking foot are provided with a tray for transporting objects, the two sides of the bottom of each flight module are provided with mounting brackets for being detachably connected with the trays, the land-air robots can coordinate with each other in tasks, the ground robots can collect environment information, perform ground searching and material transportation and transmit the environment information to an aerial unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle can provide a real-time high-altitude visual angle, and the unmanned aerial vehicle can adjust the shape according to the environment conditions and task requirements through a deformable design.

title_en: Underwater emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underwater emergency rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of underwater robots and comprises a robot main body, wherein the robot main body comprises a frame and a propeller assembled on the frame, a dragging unit is assembled at the bottom of the frame, after the robot main body approaches to an underwater person to be rescued, the robot main body is abutted against the person through a cross rod and then rotated to the rear side to be attached to the front of the robot main body, the surrounding of the person is completed through an L-shaped rod, the surrounding air bag is inflated, the air bag brings the person and the surrounding unit to the water surface, meanwhile, the person after floating upwards is dragged by the dragging rope to be close to the shore in the process of moving the robot main body after floating upwards, and the problem that the person needs to wait on the water surface when the floating position is far away from the water surface is avoided under the cooperation of the robot main body, so that the person to be rescued can be brought to the shore to carry out next rescue in time.

title_en: Wireless sensor network marine rescue monitoring system and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wireless sensor network marine rescue monitoring system, which comprises a network energy-saving strategy model and a base station-cluster head node-node three-layer network topology consisting of a base station, an unmanned aerial vehicle and sensor nodes, wherein the sensor nodes carry an energy-saving strategy network model algorithm. When the sensor node monitors a person falling into water, the sensor node transmits the transmitted information to the base station, the base station immediately sends out the rescue yacht and the rescue helicopter, and meanwhile, the unmanned aerial vehicle nearest to the sensor node is rapidly close to the sensor node to dynamically track the position of the person falling into water, and transmits the dynamic coordinates to the rescue yacht and the rescue helicopter to help to obtain the real-time accurate position of the person falling into water. According to the offshore rescue monitoring system, the dynamic intelligent monitoring network is arranged in a larger range centering on an accident site through the combined system of the wireless sensor network and the unmanned aerial vehicle, so that automatic, high-efficiency and large-range digital search and rescue are realized, the rescue probability of people falling into water is improved, and the rescue time is shortened.

title_en: DeepSORT-based target tracking and searching method for fixed wing cluster unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a target tracking and searching and rescuing method for fixed wing clustered unmanned aerial vehicles based on DeepSORT, which comprises the steps that unmanned aerial vehicles take off simultaneously and enter a searching and rescuing area, targets in images are detected in real time by each unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain target detection results, tracking and predicting the targets through a DeepSORT algorithm to obtain track information of the targets, the position information and corner marks of the targets are returned to a surface searching and rescuing control computer by each unmanned aerial vehicle, the accurate target positions and corner marks are obtained by fusing the target information returned by a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles by the searching and rescuing control computer, a searching and rescuing task is distributed to each unmanned aerial vehicle by the searching and rescuing control computer, the searching and rescuing actions are executed by each unmanned aerial vehicle according to the distributed tasks, the target positions and the corner mark information are updated in real time through a positioning and communication module, and when the searching and rescuing task is completed or time reaches a limit, the clustered unmanned aerial vehicles return to a base. The invention can effectively cooperate with the fixed wing unmanned aerial vehicle to execute the search and rescue task, and improves the flying capacity and level of the fixed wing unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Assembled unmanned aerial vehicle searches for and rescue mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses an assembled unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue mechanism, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles and comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a first-aid kit and a landing platform example, wherein a thermal imager is arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a parachute is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the first-aid kit, when the first-aid kit is carried by the unmanned aerial vehicle main body to lift off, the output shaft of a servo motor is triggered to rotate anticlockwise by downward movement of a T-shaped column, and the clamping column is utilized to clamp and fix the first-aid kit on the surface of a placing plate.

title_en: Earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a seismic rescue robot, which relates to the technical field of seismic rescue and comprises a base, wherein a chassis is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the base, an extrusion device and a rotating device are respectively arranged in the chassis, a transmission device is fixedly arranged on the bottom surface of the base, a first mechanical arm is arranged on one side of the chassis, a second mechanical arm is arranged on one side of the chassis far away from the first mechanical arm, the first mechanical arm is matched with the second mechanical arm, a collecting box is arranged at the bottom of the extrusion device in the chassis, and under the matching of the extrusion device, the rotating device, the first mechanical arm, the second mechanical arm, a folding device and an induction device which are arranged in the device, the device can enable the device to search and rescue in mountain scenes, walk and transport materials in mud, rescue in fire scenes, search and rescue in collapsed houses, lift floors, crush crushed stones, crack on the ground, collapse trees, landslide and giant stones, cross obstacles, avoid obstacles and clear obstacles, and improve rescue efficiency.

title_en: Double-light personnel search and rescue positioning visual system on unmanned aerial vehicle
