abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a double-light personnel search and rescue positioning visual system on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a shooting camera, a lifting device, a lifting seat, a rotating motor, a mounting seat, an infrared thermal imaging camera, a storage battery, two driving motors, two driving wheels, a plurality of driven wheels and two tracks, wherein the shooting camera shoots specific visual information through visible light to guide rescue, the lifting device is used for downwards releasing the lifting seat, the rotating motor is used for adjusting the angle of the infrared thermal imaging camera, the infrared thermal imaging camera assists in searching for a person to be rescued, the two driving motors are used for driving the tracks to rotate to provide moving capability, and when the unmanned aerial vehicle moves to the terrain with more obstacles, the infrared thermal imaging camera is driven by the driving motors to move, so that the shooting blind area is effectively reduced, the detection range is improved, and the problems of higher cost and poorer effect on the increase of the detection range of the existing unmanned aerial vehicle are solved.
assignees: UNIV QINGHAI NORMAL;NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & TECH CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue path planning method based on multi-target particle swarm optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue path planning method based on multi-target particle swarm optimization, which comprises the following steps of S1, converting a to-be-searched and rescue area into a two-dimensional search and rescue area, S2, conducting grid decomposition on the two-dimensional search and rescue area, S3, obtaining a probability map through a Gaussian mixture model, S4, establishing a multi-target collaborative optimization function of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue, S5, solving the function based on a mixed particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain an optimal solution, and generating a specific search and rescue path of an unmanned aerial vehicle according to the solved optimal solution. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue multi-objective collaborative optimization function, the unmanned aerial vehicle is guided to execute the search and rescue task by taking the resource balanced allocation, the maximum path safety, the priority coverage of the high-risk area and the minimum energy consumption as targets, the task allocation, the path planning and the energy management are improved, the multi-objective optimization of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue path planning is realized, the accurate flight path is determined for each unmanned aerial vehicle, the whole coverage of the search and rescue task is ensured, and the search and rescue efficiency and the success rate are remarkably improved.

title_en: Model prediction contour control system and method based on neural network enhancement
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle control, and discloses a model prediction contour control system and method based on neural network enhancement, the system processes multisource sensing data of the unmanned aerial vehicle through an S4-Conv self-adaptive network architecture, wherein the multisource sensing data comprises an odometer, a thrust output and a PVDF flexible collision sensor, and the position and the gesture of the unmanned aerial vehicle at the next moment are accurately predicted. Based on the prediction model, a neural network enhanced model prediction contour control framework is provided, and is used for optimizing the thrust output of the unmanned aerial vehicle and carrying out real-time posture adjustment. The method can quickly respond to external collision and dynamic disturbance in a complex environment, obviously improve the track tracking precision of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the stability of task execution, and is suitable for unmanned aerial vehicle flight control tasks in complex environments such as urban space, disaster area search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Multifunctional earthquake rescue robot car
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a rescue machine vehicle device, in particular to a multifunctional earthquake rescue machine vehicle. The utility model provides a multifunctional earthquake rescue robot vehicle which comprises a rescue vehicle, a mechanical arm, a robot clamp and the like, wherein the mechanical arm is symmetrically arranged on the front side of the rescue vehicle, the mechanical arm is arranged in the middle of the front side of the rescue vehicle, the multifunctional earthquake rescue robot vehicle further comprises a placing component and a pushing component, the placing component for storing rescue materials is arranged in the rescue vehicle, and the pushing component for pushing the placing component outwards is arranged in the rescue vehicle. Through setting up and placing the subassembly and pushing the subassembly, place the subassembly and can save emergency rescue supplies in the rescue car inside, can not receive external influence and damage, push the subassembly and will place the subassembly and release from the rescue car inside to be convenient for catch personnel take out emergency rescue supplies, thereby obtain urgent treatment and nutrition supply, so as to wait for subsequent rescue.
assignees: GANNAN UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Underwater robot path planning method for obstacle avoidance in complex underwater environment
abstract_en: The invention provides an underwater robot path planning method for complex underwater environment obstacle avoidance, which comprises the steps of 1, determining a search and rescue task area, marking static obstacles in the search and rescue task area, establishing a grid map, 2, obtaining an initial obstacle avoidance path of the static obstacles according to an improved ISSA algorithm, 3, performing path tracking by an AUV according to the initial obstacle avoidance path, updating dynamic obstacle information detected by a forward-looking sonar in real time into the grid map, starting the improved IDWA algorithm to obtain the dynamic obstacle avoidance path, 4, detecting a target object through a sensor after the AUV reaches a target point, uploading detection information to an onshore base end, judging whether the search and rescue task is completed, and if not, continuing to execute the steps 2-3 until the search and rescue task is completed. The invention can improve the safety of the underwater robot in the process of executing the underwater search and rescue task, efficiently realize the detection task of the search and rescue target objects and effectively improve the efficiency of the underwater search and rescue task.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster search and rescue task distribution method based on discrete particle swarm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster search and rescue task distribution method based on a discrete particle swarm. The method comprises the steps of determining legal clusters and legal tasks at the current moment t according to the life cycle of the tasks and the task execution capacity of the clusters, and generating a plurality of task pairs. The method comprises the steps of calculating task values of task pairs according to a preset task value function, generating a task value matrix, generating random particles based on a random particle model, carrying out genetic variation on the random particles according to local optimal particles and/or global optimal particles to obtain optimized random particles, carrying out optimization on the optimized random particles based on the task value matrix to determine the local optimal particles, carrying out optimization on a plurality of local optimal particles to determine global optimal particles with maximum task value sum and minimum variance among the task values, decoding the global optimal particles after the preset cycle times to obtain a plurality of optimal task pairs, and generating a task allocation scheme, so that high adaptability and high completion rate of task allocation are realized.

title_en: Underwater robot double-layer path planning system and method for underwater search and rescue task
abstract_en: The invention provides an underwater robot double-layer path planning system and method for an underwater search and rescue task, wherein the system comprises an underwater robot system and a shore-based system, the shore-based system is used for providing search and rescue task area and starting point position information and deciding whether to deploy a breaking and disassembling machine to execute the breaking and disassembling rescue task according to a forward looking sonar image transmitted by the underwater robot system, and the underwater robot system is used for executing a wreck ship search and rescue task according to the search and rescue task area and the starting point position information. According to the invention, the search and rescue task is executed in two steps, so that the performance characteristics and advantages of different sensors of the underwater robot can be fully exerted, the AUV can be helped to autonomously complete the detection task of the target area, and the search efficiency and the intelligence of the AUV are effectively improved.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle control method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle control method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method is applied to a vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle control system comprising vehicle equipment and VR equipment, and comprises the steps that the vehicle equipment determines a control mode in response to the acquired indication information of exploration or search and rescue of the vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle, the vehicle equipment acquires an attitude image and a voice command of a user in response to the determined attitude voice control mode and controls the vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle to move in response to the determined automatic cruise mode, the vehicle equipment acquires a cruise space range and cruise height in response to the determined automatic cruise mode and controls the vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle to move based on the head action information of the user acquired by the VR equipment, and the vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle or the VR equipment displays the image acquired by the vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle in the moving process of the vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle. By the method, the accuracy of the vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle control is improved, and further the use experience of a user is improved.
assignees: LANMA CANGXING INTELLIGENT TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for planning quick search path in search and rescue environment
abstract_en: The application provides a rapid search path planning method and device in a search and rescue environment, wherein the method and device comprises the steps of determining a search and rescue area, dividing the search and rescue area into a plurality of grids, constructing POMDP seven-tuple information corresponding to each grid, wherein the POMDP seven-tuple information comprises a finite state set, a finite action set, a state transition matrix, rewards, a finite observation set, observation probability and discount coefficients, acquiring current position information of a search and rescue robot and surrounding map environment information of the search and rescue robot in real time, determining the current grid of the search and rescue robot based on the current position information, determining the next target grid of the search and rescue robot based on the POMDP seven-tuple information corresponding to the current grid through a partially observable Markov decision algorithm, and determining the search path of the search and rescue robot based on the target grid and the surrounding map environment information. According to the application, the robot can complete searching work of searching and constructing the map while searching under the condition of unknown environment map, and the adaptability of the robot to search and rescue environment is improved.

title_en: Fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of fire rescue and aims at solving the problems that the robot cannot clear up a front obstacle and cannot reach a fire extinguishing position through the obstacle to influence the golden time of fire rescue; according to the utility model, the inclination of the impurity removing plate is enabled, the position of the second rotating rod can be limited by movement through the arranged locator and the annular groove, and the second rotating rod can rotate leftwards through the arranged first cylinder, so that the obstacle on the impurity removing plate can be moved leftwards, the obstacle in front can be effectively cleaned, and the obstacle is prevented from blocking the movement of the robot and influencing the golden time of fire-fighting and rescue.
assignees: SUZHOU BOFENG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake rescue robot car
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake rescue robot vehicle which comprises a vehicle body, crawler wheel sets, mechanical arms, water spraying assemblies and mechanical arms, wherein the crawler wheels are assembled on two sides of the vehicle body, the crawler wheel sets are connected with driving assemblies which are used for driving the crawler wheel sets to rotate, when searching and rescuing, the contact area between the crawler wheel sets and the ground is large, the condition that a crawler falls into mud to idle in situ is avoided, meanwhile, the crawler wheel sets can climb a building to search and rescue, meanwhile, the mechanical arms can partially support a dangerous building to avoid secondary collapse of the dangerous building, so that the safety of rescue personnel is ensured, the water spraying assemblies spray water mist above the rescue vehicle to reduce the ambient temperature of equipment to ensure normal and stable operation of the rescue vehicle, and a scene of road obstacle is formed, and the mechanical arms are used for moving the obstacle away from the scene to facilitate rescue.

title_en: Intelligent fireproof rescue robot and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fireproof rescue robot and a rescue system, and belongs to the technical field of fire rescue equipment. The rescue robot comprises a main body part, wherein the main body part is connected with a driving mechanism, a moving mechanism and a fire extinguishing mechanism, the intelligent rescue robot further comprises an intelligent detection mechanism, the intelligent detection mechanism comprises a detection device which is connected with the rescue robot in a split mode and can be independently and movably controlled, and a storage cabin for placing the detection device, the rescue mechanism comprises a rescue mechanical arm and a rescue cabin, and the end portion of the rescue mechanical arm is connected with a rescue mechanical arm. Under the cooperative control of the control system, the rescue system is connected and communicated through the 5G network, when a mine fire disaster occurs, the ground command center can timely determine and monitor the place where the mine fire disaster occurs in real time after receiving the alarm, and the communication base station gives a starting instruction to the rescue robot or not, so that the robot is started to perform rapid and intelligent rescue work, and the rescue is efficient and has high safety coefficient.
assignees: DALAI NUR COAL IND CO LTD

title_en: Variable-rigidity flexible grabbing system for complex narrow space operation
abstract_en: A variable-rigidity flexible grabbing system for complex narrow space operation comprises a variable-rigidity bending deformation flexible arm and a foldable end effector. The variable stiffness bending deformation flexible arm comprises a plurality of independent hollow air cavities at the periphery and a variable stiffness fiber blocking cavity at the center. The collapsible end effector includes a plurality of fingers, each finger including a non-stretchable film, a plurality of stiff sheets, and an elastic film. The flexible arm realizes multi-degree-of-freedom bending and easily passes through a narrow channel through a three-cavity pneumatic bending design and a central fiber blocking rigidity-changing module. The end effector realizes multi-state conversion from folding to stretching to bending through the cooperation of soft materials, hard sheets and elastic films, adapts to objects with different shapes and sizes, and realizes accurate grabbing. In addition, a telescopic flexible wrist is introduced, so that the degree of freedom of axial extension is increased, the position error is compensated, and the grabbing precision is improved. The invention is suitable for robot operation in complex environments, and is particularly suitable for the fields of industrial assembly, post-disaster search and rescue, ocean exploration and the like.

title_en: A cluster robot system for disaster rescue and a method of searching and transporting objects in a disaster environment using it
title_ko: 재난 구조용 군집 로봇 시스템 및 이를 이용한 재난 구조용 군집 로봇 시스템을 이용한 재난 환경 물체 탐색 및 운반 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cluster robot system for disaster rescue and a method for searching and transporting a disaster environment object using the same and, more specifically, to a cluster robot system for disaster rescue and a method for searching and transporting a disaster environment object using the same, which can maximize the autonomy and efficiency of the cluster robot system input to search, rescue, and material transport work at a disaster site, can flexibly respond to a complex disaster environment through organic cooperation between robot agents, secures the stability and reliability of the system by introducing a centralized monitoring and control system, and minimizes user intervention.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 구조용 군집 로봇 시스템 및 이를 이용한 재난 구조용 군집 로봇 시스템을 이용한 재난 환경 물체 탐색 및 운반 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 재난 현장에서의 수색, 구조 및 물자 운송 작업에 투입되는 군집 로봇 시스템의 자율성과 효율성을 극대화할 수 있으며, 로봇 에이전트 간의 유기적인 협력을 통해 복잡한 재난 환경에 유연하게 대응할 수 있고, 중앙 집중식 모니터링 및 제어 체계를 도입함으로써 시스템의 안정성과 신뢰성을 확보하고, 사용자의 개입을 최소화하는 재난 구조용 군집 로봇 시스템 및 이를 이용한 재난 구조용 군집 로봇 시스템을 이용한 재난 환경 물체 탐색 및 운반 방법에 관한 것이다.
assignees: UNIV KOREA IND UNIV COOP FOUND

title_en: Drone Wings Made of Corrugated Cardboard and Method thereof
title_ko: 골판지 재질 구조 드론 날개의 제작 방법
abstract_en: A drone wing made of cardboard material of the present invention is arranged so that the first to n^th ribs (10a to 10n) made of paper or wood boards have a device mounting space (1-1) on the first and second wooden bars (30A, 30B) made of wood, and the first, second and third cardboards (40A, 40B, 40C) made of paper cover the first to n ribs (10a to 10n) as a wing surface that generates lift, and the second cardboard (40B) of the first, second and third cardboards (40A, 40B, 40C) is provided with an aileron (46) that performs a folding and unfolding operation by an aileron drive device (80), thereby reducing the weight of the wing while ensuring structural strength, and has the feature that the wing structure can be easily assembled in the field.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 골판지 재질로 제작된 드론 날개는 종이 또는 나무 판재인 제1 내지 n 리브(10a~10n)를 목재인 제1, 2 목봉(30A, 30B)이 장치 장착 공간(1-1)을 갖도록 배열하고, 종이인 제1, 2, 3 골판지(40A, 40B, 40C)가 제1 내지 n 리브(10a~10n)를 양력이 발생 되는 날개 표면으로 덮어주고, 제1, 2, 3 골판지(40A, 40B, 40C)의 제2 골판지(40B)에 에일러론 구동장치(80)에 의해 접혔다 펴지는 동작을 수행하는 에일러론(46)이 구비 됨으로써 날개의 무게는 감소하면서도 구조적 강도를 확보할 수 있는 구조이면서도 전장에서 날개 구조가 쉽게 조립되는 특징을 갖는다.

title_en: A method for the search path generation in a search system using multiple drones
title_ko: 복수의 무인비행체들을 이용한 수색시스템의 수색경로 생성방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for setting and arranging an optimal repeater position for operating each unmanned aerial vehicle and generating a search path of the unmanned aerial vehicles optimized in each repeater in order to secure a stable communication environment and minimize duplication and shadow area of a search area when performing a search mission using a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles. According to the present invention, a communication line of sight for unmanned aerial vehicles for search at a search site which is difficult to access is secured, and a search path for each unmanned aerial vehicle is efficiently and automatically generated, thereby contributing to performing a safer and more efficient autonomous search mission than an existing operation method depending on manual coordinate input.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 다수의 무인비행체을 이용하여 수색임무를 수행할 때, 안정된 통신 환경 을 확보하고 수색 지역의 중복과 음영 영역을 최소화하기 위해, 각 무인비행체을 운용하기 위한 최적의 중계기 위치를 설정하여 배치하고, 각 중계기에서 최적화된 무인비행체들의 수색경로를 생성하기 위한 방법에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명을 통하여 접근이 어려운 수색 현장에서 수색용 무인비행체들에 대한 통신 가시선을 확보하고, 무인비행체별 수색경로를 효율적으로 자동 생성함으로써 수동적 좌표 입력에 의존하는 기존 운용 방식보다 안전하고 효율적인 자율 수색 임무를 수행하는데 수행하는데 기여할 수 있다.

title_en: Fire-fighting emergency three-dimensional fire-extinguishing rescue robot system for high-rise building communities
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of high-rise fire-fighting, in particular to a fire-fighting emergency three-dimensional fire-fighting rescue robot system for a high-rise building community, which solves the problems that when a fire-fighting rescue robot is used, the fire-fighting rescue robot can not be sprayed to a fire point due to overhigh fire point, the pressure of sprayed fire extinguishing agent is reduced, multiple layers of fire can be generated at the same time when the high-rise fire is generated, and when a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles extinguish the fire on different floors at the same time, the unmanned aerial vehicles are easy to wind fire-fighting pipes to cause the unmanned aerial vehicles to fall out of control when moving, and comprises a robot module, a fire-fighting module, a matching module, a monitoring module and an identification module, wherein the fire-fighting module is arranged below the robot module. According to the fire-extinguishing device, the two unmanned aerial vehicle mechanisms are mutually matched, so that the first unmanned aerial vehicle mechanism pulls the fire-extinguishing hose to the high altitude, and the connecting hose is used for connecting the second unmanned aerial vehicle mechanism, so that the fire-extinguishing height of the device is prolonged, and the situation that fire cannot be extinguished when the fire point is higher than the fire-extinguishing hose is avoided.
assignees: CONTINENTAL UNION CHAOLUN TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Four-rotor two-wheel type wall climbing aircraft
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of ground and air robots, and relates to a four-rotor two-wheel type wall climbing aircraft, which comprises a rotor module, a wall climbing module, a motion control module, a suspension module and a main body frame, wherein the rotor module realizes the aerial lift force and horizontal thrust output during wall pasting through the motion control module, the wall climbing module provides upward wall climbing power through driving wheel driving and suspension design to realize the wall climbing function, and the main body frame adopts a modularized design, so that different functional modules can be quickly combined, and the multi-scene rescue requirement is met. By integrating the wall climbing stability of the wall climbing module and the flight capability of the rotor wing module, the invention can realize the smooth switching from the flight attitude to the wall climbing mode to realize the tasks of wall climbing, crawling and the like, and has great application potential in the scenes of wall surface detection, unmanned aerial vehicle inspection, unmanned aerial vehicle investigation, unmanned aerial vehicle disaster search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Bionic earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: The application discloses a bionic earthquake rescue robot which comprises a head part and a body part, wherein a bionic foot capable of transforming deformation is arranged on the body part, a multistage deformable tail structure is arranged at the tail part of the body part, a lifting structure for lifting obstacles is further arranged at the end part of the tail structure, the head structure, the body structure, the bionic foot, the tail structure and the lifting structure are assembled to form a scorpion shape, the bionic foot comprises a first mechanical arm, the first mechanical arm is connected with the body part through a connecting structure, one side of the first mechanical arm is rotationally connected with a second mechanical arm, and one side of the second mechanical arm is rotationally connected with a walking claw.

title_en: Search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The application relates to a search and rescue robot, and relates to the field of small walking robots. The robot comprises a robot body and six legs encircling the robot body, wherein the robot body comprises two guard plates which are arranged in parallel up and down, and a control box which is positioned between the two guard plates, the upper ends of the legs are arranged between the edges of the upper guard plate and the lower guard plate, the control box comprises a box body, a control circuit board, a camera and a storage battery which are contained in the box body, the box body is a rectangular groove body, mounting plates are arranged on the outer edges of the long sides of the openings of the box body, mounting holes are formed in the two ends of the mounting plates, bolts are arranged through the mounting holes to firmly connect the box body with the upper guard plate, wiring holes are arranged on the side walls of the box body, one end face of the box body is provided with a camera, the control circuit board is connected with the legs through wires which penetrate through the wiring holes, and a lens of the camera penetrates through the camera. The robot can avoid collision of the camera and the electronic components on the circuit board, and plays roles of protecting the components and reducing damage.
assignees: GUANGXI VOCATIONAL COLLEGE OF WATER RESOURCES AND ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle beyond-vision road condition detection device, method and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle over-the-horizon road condition detection device, a method and a storage medium, wherein the vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle over-the-horizon road condition detection device comprises the following components: the visual range expansion module controls the vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle to fly to a designated position in the effective range distance outside the visual field range perceived by the driver, and controls the vehicle-mounted unmanned aerial vehicle to acquire the field beyond visual range perception data of the unmanned aerial vehicle corresponding to the designated position. The method and the system can monitor and return the road condition outside the front sight distance of the driver in real time, enable the driver to sense the road condition information in advance, combine and analyze the satellite big data, give out an optimal driving route, reduce traffic jam to the greatest extent, detect surrounding terrains under the condition of outdoor road turning, confirm whether the surrounding terrains can pass through, provide reference information for the driver, and enable the driver to fly quickly and help search and rescue in an outdoor rescue scene.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZEEKR INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;GEELY HOLDING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method, system, equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method, system, equipment, storage medium and program product. The method comprises the steps of determining a signal frequency sweeping instruction based on heartbeat information sent by a search and rescue base station through a control system, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle is internally provided with the search and rescue base station, determining a frequency sweeping result based on the signal frequency sweeping instruction through the search and rescue base station, determining signal configuration parameters based on the frequency sweeping result through the control system, determining identification information of target terminal equipment based on the signal configuration parameters through the search and rescue base station, and determining position information of the target terminal equipment based on power information transmitted by the target terminal equipment at a set frequency domain position through the search and rescue equipment so as to search and rescue personnel based on the position information. According to the embodiment of the application, the efficiency and the response speed of the search and rescue process are improved, the search and rescue accuracy is improved, and the search and rescue safety is improved.
assignees: BEIJING SILANG DONGXIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle and organic machine combined search and rescue path planning method under airspace layering
abstract_en: The application discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle and man-machine combined search and rescue path planning method under airspace layering, which belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out airspace layering according to a target search and rescue area, and establishing an airspace layering model; the method comprises the steps of carrying out joint search and rescue path planning on a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles and a plurality of organic robots based on an airspace layering model, carrying out path conflict simulation optimization on the plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles and the plurality of organic robots based on joint search and rescue path planning results, and carrying out search and rescue on a target search and rescue area according to the optimized search and rescue path planning results by the plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles and the plurality of organic robots through encryption. The method solves the technical problems of low search and rescue efficiency and high risk of aircraft collision caused by the lack of systematic path planning and airspace management during joint search and rescue of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the man-machine in the prior art.
assignees: CHINA FIRE AND RESCUE INST;BISHENG AVIATION TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: A system for providing search and rescue operation via a micro-robot
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system (1) for monitoring complex environments, detecting the location of victims, and providing life support via micro-robots (6) designed for search and rescue operations in collapsed structures such as buildings, mines and other confined spaces.

title_en: Water rescue robot system and method with unmanned aerial vehicle image building assistance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water rescue robot system with unmanned aerial vehicle image building assistance and a method thereof, which aim to solve the problems of poor planning and limited efficiency of a traditional water rescue robot rescue path, realize dynamic monitoring and map updating of a rescue area environment through an integrated unmanned aerial vehicle, realize the omnibearing scanning of a water area by taking off regularly or according to requirements through unmanned aerial vehicle equipment high-precision sensors such as cameras, laser radars and the like, collect environment data, generate or update a digital map through algorithm processing, comprise obstacle positions, water depth information and the like, and transmit the digital map to the rescue robot in a wireless mode, and realize high-efficiency and safe rescue actions by automatically adjusting the rescue path and strategy according to the data.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The application discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method and system based on the Internet of things, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle control, wherein an area with average signal strength smaller than or equal to a first target threshold value is marked as a first target area by acquiring area information of a target search and rescue area and based on the area information; and sending the unmanned aerial vehicle to the first target area to execute a signal relay task based on the area information of the first target area, starting to acquire search and rescue information of the target search and rescue area, and adjusting the flight task and the flight path of the unmanned aerial vehicle based on the search and rescue information. The system consists of an acquisition unit, a processing unit and an execution unit, and is used for acquiring regional information, processing and dispatching the unmanned aerial vehicle and adjusting the flight task. The method and the device determine the optimal final position based on various path loss calculations, and improve the success rate of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue.
assignees: BEIJING TT AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Man-machine cooperative control method for heavy-load rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a man-machine cooperative control method for a heavy-load rescue robot in the field of robot control, which is based on the state of a movable chassis of the heavy-load rescue robot and pose information of a rescue operation device, constructs a risk recognition and safety constraint model of the heavy-load rescue robot, and provides a man-machine cooperative control method based on safety reinforcement learning. The method can dynamically adjust the sharing weight between the operator and the mobile chassis system and between the operator and the intelligent rescue operation device system, realize the joint man-machine sharing control of the operator, the mobile chassis and the operation device, improve the working efficiency of the heavy-load rescue robot in the emergency rescue environment and ensure the safety of the rescue process.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based control method
abstract_en: A control method based on unmanned aerial vehicle comprises the steps of controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly in a search range, taking the unmanned aerial vehicle as an origin O  1 , transmitting base station broadcast signals with the radius of R outwards, reading the number of a mobile phone after the base station is successfully communicated with the mobile phone in the search and rescue range, judging whether the mobile phone is a target mobile phone or not, entering the next step, primarily calculating the position of the target mobile phone to be a target point T  1  through the signals of the target mobile phone, defining a circle O  2  with the target point T  1  as the center and the radius of R/n, defining at least three points B  1 ,B 2 ,B 3  on the circle O  2  along the clockwise or anticlockwise direction as base stations, controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to sequentially fly to the base station B  1 ,B 2 ,B 3 , acquiring the distance X  1 ,X 2 ,X 3  from each base station to the target mobile phone, taking the base station point B  1 ,B 2 ,B 3  as the center, taking the X  1 ,X 2 ,X 3  as the radius as the circle O  3 ,O 4 ,O 5 , acquiring an intersection point A  1 ,A 2 ,A 3  between the three circles, and taking the area formed by the three intersection points as a search and rescue area.
assignees: XIAMEN YUNLUN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Systems and associated methods for generating a digital representation of an environment
abstract_en: Robotic systems and associated methods are described herein. The robotic system may collect measurements from various sensors corresponding to motion of the robotic system, the surrounding environment of the robotic system, or both. The robotic system may generate measurement data based on the collected measurements. Measurements from a particular sensor may be processed in conjunction with different sensors of the robotic system, which may facilitate more accurate or more useful measurement data. The systems and methods of the present disclosure enable the detection, labeling, and locating of features in real time or near real time using the robotic system with little or no reliance on human interaction to detect and map the features. The disclosure provides enhanced accuracy and efficiency as it enhances the functionality and reduces the reliance on human detection of features.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle rescue full-coverage search and rescue method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a full-coverage rescue method and system for unmanned aerial vehicle rescue, wherein the method comprises the steps of inwards shifting a rescue boundary for a certain distance to obtain a search and rescue region boundary offset line, judging whether a hole exists in the center of a region surrounded by the search and rescue region boundary offset line, mapping the region onto a circular ring containing a slit through conformal slit mapping when the hole exists, mapping the boundary of the region onto a circular disk containing the slit through slit mapping when the hole exists, mapping the region onto the circular disk containing the slit through slit mapping when the hole does not exist, mapping the boundary of the region onto the circular disk outside boundary and the inner circular slit, obtaining an unequal spiral line which does not intersect the slit in the circular ring or the circular disk image domain, obtaining a spiral track on an original image after the unequal spiral line is mapped back to the original image domain through inverse mapping of the conformal slit mapping, and performing search and rescue along the search and rescue region boundary offset line, and eliminating dangerous regions which cannot be searched and rescue.

title_en: Unmanned rescue robot of underground boat type and control method thereof
abstract_en: The application provides an underground boat type unmanned rescue robot which comprises a robot body, an induction component and a control device, wherein the induction component is connected with the control device, the control device is positioned in the robot body and is connected with a driving device of the robot body, the induction component comprises a pressure sensor and a thermal imaging sensor, the pressure sensor is positioned at the outer bottom of the robot body, the thermal imaging sensor is positioned on the outer side wall of the robot body, the pressure sensor is used for sensing the draft of the robot body and sending the draft to the control device, the thermal imaging sensor is used for sensing the positions of people around the robot body and sending the positions to the control device, and the sensor is not limited by communication signals and can automatically respond to and search and rescue underground people in the first time after an underground water disaster accident occurs, so that the underground rescue capability of the water disaster is improved, and the survival probability of trapped people is increased.

title_en: Adaptive terrain traversing control method and system applied to search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive terrain traversing control method and a system applied to a search and rescue robot, and relates to the technical field of intelligent control, wherein the method comprises the steps of reading a target point of a target search and rescue robot, setting a path range area, establishing a central path based on the current position, activating a sensor to collect environmental data, and generating an environmental data set with a distance attenuation mark; and carrying out path traffic compensation and terrain traversing control by reading the associated environment data of the group search and rescue robot. The invention solves the technical problems that the prior art lacks dynamic path adjustment and real-time environment adaptation capability in the multi-robot collaborative search and rescue task, and influences the search and rescue efficiency and safety, and achieves the technical effects of multi-robot collaborative work, dynamic path adjustment and obstacle avoidance, and search and rescue efficiency and safety improvement.
assignees: XUZHOU BEIYU SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Fire rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and particularly discloses a fire rescue robot which comprises a rescue isolation cover, wherein a search and rescue mechanism is commonly arranged between inner walls of two sides of the rescue isolation cover and is positioned in the rescue isolation cover, a detection mechanism is arranged on one side of the top end of the rescue isolation cover, a fire extinguishing mechanism is arranged on the other side of the top end of the rescue isolation cover, the search and rescue mechanism comprises a fixed frame, a limiting groove, an adjusting mechanism, a driver, a protective cover, a through hole and a transmission belt, and the two adjusting mechanisms can be simultaneously driven to adjust the positions of the two adjusting mechanisms by the synchronous transmission of the transmission belt through the driving of the driver, and can automatically capture trapped people, particularly those who lose consciousness or cannot move independently, and safely transfer the trapped people into the rescue isolation cover.

title_en: Hardware equipped with multiple multi-complex sensors for human detection
title_ko: 인명 탐지를 위한 다중 멀티 복합센서가 구비된 하드웨어
abstract_en: The present invention relates to hardware having multiple multi-composite sensors for detecting lives and, more specifically, to a wearable device having multiple multi-composite sensors for detecting lives, which comprises: a hardware unit provided in the form of a wearable unit which can be worn or fixed to a part of a user's body or a mobile robot unit; and a composite sensor module coupled to the hardware unit to collect comprehensive information on the surrounding environment of the user, and providing the collected information to the user wearing the wearable unit or to a control center or a manager who oversees the user at a long distance.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인명 탐지를 위한 다중 멀티 복합센서가 구비된 하드웨어에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 사용자의 신체의 일부에 착용 또는 고정 가능한 웨어러블부 또는 이동 가능한 로봇부 등과 같은 형태로 제공되는 하드웨어부 및 상기 하드웨어부에 결합되어 사용자 주변 환경에 대한 종합적인 정보를 수집하고, 수집한 정보를 상기 웨어러블부를 착용한 사용자에게 제공하거나 관제센터 또는 원거리에서 사용자를 감독하는 관리자에게 제공하는 복합센서모듈을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 인명 탐지를 위한 다중 멀티 복합센서가 구비된 웨어러블 기기에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle aeromagnetic and ground penetrating radar integrated emergency search and rescue system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle aeromagnetic and ground penetrating radar integrated emergency search and rescue system and method. The system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, an aeromagnetic detection unit, a ground penetrating radar unit and a data processing unit, wherein the aeromagnetic detection unit and the ground penetrating radar unit are configured to be mounted on the unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle is configured to move above a target searching area along a flight route of the unmanned aerial vehicle in response to a flight instruction of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the aeromagnetic detection unit is configured to measure the intensity or gradient of an earth magnetic field in the target searching area to obtain first detection data, the ground penetrating radar unit is configured to detect the characteristics and distribution of substances in the target searching area to obtain second detection data, and the data processing unit is configured to display detection results of the target searching area according to the first detection data and the second detection data. The embodiment of the invention can solve the problems of low efficiency and insufficient coverage of the traditional search and rescue technology.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN

title_en: Water area emergency rescue robot and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a water area emergency rescue robot and a use method thereof, belonging to the technical field of water area rescue equipment, wherein the water area emergency rescue robot comprises a rescue robot main body; the device comprises an inner ring frame, a connecting assembly, a moving assembly and a control device, wherein the inner ring frame is rotatably connected to the circumferential inner wall of a rescue robot main body, the connecting assembly is provided with a plurality of groups, each group of connecting assemblies comprises a first electric push rod and a connecting plate, the first electric push rod is fixedly connected to the rescue robot main body, the connecting plates are fixedly connected to the extending ends of the first electric push rods, the moving assembly is provided with two groups, each group of moving assembly comprises a fixed block, a second electric push rod and a water spraying propeller, the fixed blocks are fixedly connected to the circumferential surface of the rescue robot main body, after the device is taken out, the device is connected with a life buoy, and the control device and the life buoy are moved to hands of a person needing rescue, so that the person needing rescue can be timely rescued, and life safety of the person in danger is protected.
assignees: WISDOM SENSITIVE SCIENCE & TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: High-temperature-resistant fire-extinguishing rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-temperature-resistant fire-extinguishing rescue robot, which relates to the technical field of high-temperature-resistant robots and comprises a shell, wherein the top of the shell is fixedly connected with a top shell, the top of the top shell is rotatably connected with a protective cover, a fixing seat is arranged at the inner position of the top shell at the top of the shell, an adjusting motor is arranged in the fixing seat, one end of an output shaft of the adjusting motor is fixedly connected with a base, and the top of the base is rotatably connected with a first mechanical arm. According to the high-temperature-resistant fire-extinguishing rescue robot disclosed by the invention, the supporting blocks support the ground through the cooperation of the first mechanical arm, the second mechanical arm and the third mechanical arm, so that the robot can move on stairs, the rotation of the first mechanical arm, the second mechanical arm and the third mechanical arm is controlled through the robot, and trapped people are saved through the breaking and disassembly of doors and windows of a room by a saw blade, so that the effects of simultaneously realizing the steps of crossing floors and breaking and disassembly of doors and windows to rescue trapped people in a fire disaster are achieved.
assignees: BEIJING TOPSKY INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle aeromagnetic device for water area search and rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle aeromagnetic device for water area search and rescue, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body and a water immersion sensor, wherein the middle end of the top of an inner cavity of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is fixedly connected with a fixed cylinder, and the top of the inner cavity of the fixed cylinder is fixedly provided with the aeromagnetic device body. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the aeromagnetic device body, the magnetic abnormal characteristics generated by the underwater vehicle in the flying process of the unmanned aerial vehicle body can be collected, so that the detection and positioning effects of the underwater vehicle in the water area searching and rescuing process are realized, and through the arrangement of the water immersion sensor, the first motor, the L-shaped rotating rod, the connecting plate, the T-shaped moving rod, the piston, the air guide cylinder, the first one-way valve, the fixed box, the second one-way valve, the air guide pipe and the air bag, the air bag can be effectively inflated when the unmanned aerial vehicle body falls into water, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle body can float on the water surface, and people can conveniently find and recover when the unmanned aerial vehicle body falls into water.
assignees: THE NATIONAL NATURAL DISASTER PREVENTION AND CONTROL RES INSTITUTE OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMEN;LIANGSHAN RESOURCE TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: A base that charges for rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a charging base for a rescue robot, which comprises a charging base and a support, wherein the bottom of the charging base is fixedly connected with the top of the support. Through setting up stop device, the stopper, the movable hole, remove the cooperation of frame, spring and spacing groove and use, it has been solved current rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and is a special design unmanned vehicles for emergency rescue task, it can arrive the scene of occurrence and carry out multiple task in the short time, rescue unmanned aerial vehicle charges the base and is a device that provides high-efficient and safe charging for unmanned aerial vehicle, place rescue unmanned aerial vehicle in the top of charging the base during the use, and guarantee charging hole accurate butt joint can, if the mouth that charges of charging the base accumulate too much dust and easily lead to the dust to get into inside the interface, cause the phenomenon of contact failure, influence charging efficiency and damage the interface even, but the problem of the base that charges that current rescue unmanned aerial vehicle used does not carry out dustproof protection's component.

title_en: Automatic positioning method and system for intelligent offshore emergency equipment
abstract_en: The application provides an automatic positioning method and system for intelligent offshore emergency equipment. The method comprises the steps of receiving and fusing multiple distress signals to generate optimal geographic position information and a time stamp, determining distress areas on a preset sea area electronic map, correcting the distress positions, evaluating probability distribution of each potential distress area to generate a primary searching target with highest probability, starting a thermal imaging and optical sensing system on a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle to scan to generate a potential survivor position with high accuracy, dynamically adjusting and optimizing a search path, adjusting a search strategy, updating an optimal flight path in real time to generate an economic and efficient search and rescue path plan, feeding accurate coordinates of the potential survivor position back to a nearest rescue coordination center in time, and guiding first-aid equipment to carry out rescue along the optimal path. The technical scheme provided by the application improves the search and rescue efficiency and accuracy, and ensures that the position of a potential survivor is quickly and accurately positioned.

title_en: Multi-source cooperative rocker arm-crawler robot for earthquake search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source cooperative rocker arm-crawler robot composite mechanical structure for seismic search and rescue, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent rescue equipment. The three-dimensional motion structure system of rocker arms, tracks and wheels is innovatively designed, the middle part of the robot adopts a multi-degree-of-freedom rocker arm structure driven by a steering engine, the bottom is provided with a double-track differential driving module driven by a motor, and the front part is provided with a swing arm balance wheel set to assist climbing operation. The composite structure establishes a gesture stability control algorithm through a barycentric dynamics model, and can realize intelligent switching of three movement modes of wheel type high-speed maneuvering, track obstacle crossing and rocker arm climbing. Through tests, the structure can enable the robot to stably cross 100mm vertical barriers, maintain good attitude stability in unstructured terrains such as broken stones, rubble and the like, and sense the environment through various sensors. Compared with the traditional single-motion structure, the multi-dimensional mechanical capacity of the rescue equipment is realized through mechanical structure innovation, and the terrain adaptability of the rescue equipment is effectively improved.

title_en: Detection method and system for earthquake search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention provides a detection method and a detection system for earthquake search and rescue, which relate to the technical field of search and rescue robots, wherein the system comprises an air detection module and a detection module, wherein the air detection module is used for acquiring life body information by utilizing a composite life detector; the system comprises a ground search and rescue module, a processing sub-module, a base station sub-module, a search and rescue module, an air detection module, a base station sub-module, a communication device, a base station sub-module, a processing sub-module and an earthquake search and rescue module, wherein the communication device is used for transmitting life body information to the ground search and rescue module, the communication device is used for receiving path planning information and controlling an unmanned aerial vehicle to detect according to a planned path, the ground search and rescue module is used for carrying out optimal path planning on the unmanned aerial vehicle and the search and rescue trolley based on a depth-first search algorithm to obtain path planning information, the search and rescue trolley is controlled to carry out a search and rescue task based on the path planning information, the base station sub-module is used for converting the life body information into a life body information digital signal, sending the life body information digital signal to a search and rescue personnel, and sending the path planning information to the communication device of the air detection module to complete earthquake search and rescue. The invention solves the problem that the trapped personnel are difficult to rescue effectively in complex post-disaster environments.

title_en: Multi-sensor fusion environment perception control fault tolerance assessment method and device for underwater robot
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of autonomous underwater robots, in particular to a control fault tolerance assessment method for multi-sensor fusion environment perception of an underwater robot. The method comprises the steps of generating a search route according to the regional environment of an ocean region where an obtained target object is located, constructing a fusion model according to received data of multiple sensors when the target object is found along the search route, generating multiple detection routes for detecting the target object based on the fusion model by combining the sensing performance and the motion performance of an underwater robot, evaluating fault tolerance of each detection route, detecting the target object along the detection route with the optimal fault tolerance, obtaining detection results according to the received data in the detection process and sending the detection results, and the method avoids the problem that detailed information of the search and rescue object cannot be obtained.

title_en: A Drone Assemby for Searching
title_ko: 수색용 드론 조립체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a drone assembly for searching. The drone assembly for searching comprises: a drone body unit capable of flying and provided with a winch provided with a wire; a sonar unit mounted on a front end of the wire; and a buoyancy unit connected to the sonar unit to support the sonar unit to float on water.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수색용 드론 조립체에 관한 것으로, 그 구성은, 비행가능하고, 와이어가 구비된 윈치가 마련되는 드론몸체부와, 상기 와이어의 선단에 장착되는 소나부와, 상기 소나부에 연결되어 상기 소나부가 물에 뜨도록 지지하는 부력부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: A rescue drone
title_ko: 인명구조 드론
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a lifesaving drone comprises: a drone; a communication module enabling data transmission and reception of the drone; and an air module receiving data from the communication module and expanding a lower end portion of the drone using gas. The air module comprises: a gas storage unit provided at a lower end portion of the drone and storing compressed gas; and an expansion unit expanded by diffusion of the compressed gas.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 인명구조 드론은, 드론, 상기 드론의 데이터 송수신을 가능하게 하는 통신모듈 및 상기 통신모듈로부터 데이터를 전달받아 기체를 이용하여 상기 드론의 하단부를 팽창시키는 공기모듈을 포함하고, 상기 공기모듈은 상기 드론의 하단부에 구비되고, 압축 기체가 저장되는 기체저장부 및 상기 압축 기체의 확산에 의해 팽창되는 팽창부를 포함한다.

title_en: Ai based search and rescue technology platform
abstract_en: A search and rescue (SAR) application platform configured to provide SAR support services. A process includes: receiving, at a mission support system, mission data from structured and unstructured data feeds including data from an unmanned aerial system (UAS); outputting mission support information to a set of output nodes having disparate user interfaces (UIs), wherein at least one of the output nodes includes an augmented reality (AR) equipped device; and receiving, at a large language model (LLM), queries from the mission support system, and generating AI responses that augment the mission support information, wherein the LLM is trained with a model training system using structured and unstructured data sources involving SAR content.
assignees: GRABOWSKI MARTHA;MORGAN GWENDOLYN;RANCY JEAN PHILIPPE;MCGARVEY JAMES

title_en: Rescue task scene-oriented intelligent unmanned vehicle system
abstract_en: An intelligent unmanned vehicle system for rescue task scenes relates to laser radar map building and automatic driving, target detection and identification, and belongs to the technical field of embedded artificial intelligence. The invention aims to solve the problems that the existing automatic rescue robot cannot meet the navigation requirement of a rescue scene task in a complex environment, cannot make decisions in real time, does not have a man-machine interaction function and the like. The technical key points are that the laser radar map building module is used for sensing environment information and converting the environment information into map data, the path planning module is used for calculating an optimal cost path between a starting point and a target point according to the acquired map data and generating motion data to be output to the system, the target detection module is used for acquiring image data through a depth camera and identifying a target to be detected and generating three-dimensional coordinate data of the target to be output to the system, and the voice interaction module is used for acquiring external voice instructions in man-machine interaction and controlling a robot system to make a decision in real time. The invention develops a set of automatic robot embedded software capable of automatically navigating and automatically scanning surrounding environment recognition targets after reaching target points, and the automatic design of carrying artificial intelligence enables the robot to flexibly adjust decisions when facing complex environments, thereby improving the strain capacity of an unmanned robot system facing uncertain environmental factors.

title_en: Earthquake search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a seismic search and rescue robot which comprises a robot main body, a lifting assembly, a wear-resistant cable, an elastic screw rod assembly, a fixing ball, an auxiliary camera and an auxiliary camera, wherein the lifting assembly is arranged on the robot main body, one part of the wear-resistant cable is wound on the lifting assembly, the elastic screw rod assembly is fixedly sleeved outside the wear-resistant cable, the fixing ball is arranged at the bottom end of the elastic screw rod assembly, the auxiliary camera is arranged on the fixing ball, and the bottom end of the wear-resistant cable is electrically connected with the auxiliary camera, an opening is formed in the bottom end of the robot main body, and the seismic search and rescue robot is convenient to operate and is beneficial to detecting scenes inside ruins.
assignees: XUZHOU BEIYU SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: High-rise fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle with broken window deployment robot function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-rise fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicle with a window breaking deployment robot function, which relates to the technical field of fire-fighting unmanned aerial vehicles, and comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is provided with a cargo cabin, the front side of the carrying cabin is rotationally connected with a cabin door through a rotating shaft, a driving motor is installed on the side face of the carrying cabin, an output shaft of the driving motor is connected with the rotating shaft, and a window breaking assembly is arranged at the front end of the lower side of the carrying cabin. According to the utility model, the unmanned aerial vehicle is used for conveying the window breaking assembly and the search and rescue robot to a high-rise building on fire together, the collision cone and the trapezoid opening arranged on the overhanging plate on the window breaking assembly can be used for breaking glass rapidly, so that the search and rescue robot can be conveyed into a room on fire conveniently, meanwhile, the honeycomb holes arranged on the overhanging plate can reduce the weight of the overhanging plate, and meanwhile, the strength of the overhanging plate is ensured, when the overhanging plate is lifted up and down along with the unmanned aerial vehicle, wind can flow from the honeycomb holes on the overhanging plate, and the impact of wind on the overhanging plate is avoided, so that the lifting load of the unmanned aerial vehicle is caused.

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle capable of removing obstacles
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and particularly discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle capable of removing obstacles, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle upper cover and an unmanned aerial vehicle bottom plate, wherein an air cylinder assembly is fixedly arranged between the unmanned aerial vehicle upper cover and the unmanned aerial vehicle bottom plate through bolts, a basic connecting matrix assembly is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle bottom plate through bolts, an air cylinder connecting matrix assembly is connected below the air cylinder assembly, a movable clamping shovel assembly is connected below the air cylinder connecting matrix assembly, the air cylinder assembly comprises an air cylinder body fixedly arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle bottom plate through bolts, an air cylinder push rod is slidingly connected to the inner side of the air cylinder body, the air cylinder connecting matrix assembly comprises an air cylinder connecting matrix body connected with the air cylinder push rod, and five matrix connecting rod connecting blocks are connected to the air cylinder connecting matrix body.

title_en: Cross-medium water-air operation rescue robot and attitude switching method
abstract_en: The invention provides a cross-medium water-air operation rescue robot and a posture switching method, and relates to the technical field of rescue robots. The cross-medium water-air operation rescue robot comprises a body, a propulsion unit, an electrowetting wing panel, a communication base station, a detection unit, a main control unit and the like. The underwater navigation system can navigate underwater, cruise on the water surface and fly in the air, can realize the switching of the flying gesture, the cruising gesture on the water surface and the underwater navigation gesture, is flexible and reliable in gesture switching, is suitable for rescue operation working conditions of underground roadways after water penetration accidents occur, further realizes the search and rescue operation on the underwater, the water surface and the water, is provided with a plurality of robots at intervals in the roadway, and is communicated with communication base stations between adjacent robots in a wireless manner so as to transmit signals of the surrounding environment detected by each robot detection unit in a relay manner, wherein the robots can float on the water surface for a long time, are in a low-power standby operation state, and greatly prolong the operation duration of the robots.
assignees: ZAOZHUANG MINING GROUP FU VILLAGE COAL IND CO LTD;UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Multi-mode four-track robot for rescue task
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-mode four-track-leg robot facing rescue tasks, belongs to the technical field of robots, and aims to solve the problems that an existing rescue robot is single in movement mode, limited in passing capacity under narrow space and extreme terrain conditions and lacking in limit climbing capacity. The robot has the advantages that the robot can be obviously improved in movement capacity through the mutual matching of multiple movement modes, wherein the robot is provided with a conventional crawler-type movement mode of a flat semi-flat pavement, a four-foot gait mode for crossing obstacles, an upright passing mode in a narrow space, a guide rail-based cross-floor limit climbing mode and the patrol and operation capacity after relevant sensors or mechanical arms are additionally arranged according to task requirements. The application is mainly used for robots in emergency rescue tasks such as natural disasters, industrial accidents, fires and the like.

title_en: All-terrain search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides an all-terrain search and rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of rescue and disaster relief, and comprises a frame, a travelling mechanism, two front swing arms, two rear swing arms and a driving mechanism, wherein the travelling mechanism, the two front swing arms, the two rear swing arms and the driving mechanism are arranged on the frame, two transmission antennas and two cloud platforms are arranged on the frame, a first cavity and a second cavity are arranged in the frame, the driving mechanism is arranged in the first cavity, an installation opening between the two cloud platforms is arranged at the upper end of the frame and communicated with the second cavity, a sleeve is further arranged at the upper end of the frame, the sleeve and the second cavity form a containing cavity, the height of the sleeve is lower than that of the cloud platforms, a cover plate is arranged at the upper end of the sleeve, the width of the sleeve is smaller than or equal to that of the two transmission antennas, two first clamping blocks which are respectively arranged at two sides of the sleeve are arranged at the upper end of the frame, and clamping grooves are formed in the first clamping blocks. The all-terrain search and rescue robot provided by the utility model enhances the functionality of the whole robot and has a wider application range.
assignees: HEBEI CHENGJIANG EMERGENCY EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake rescue robot and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention provides an earthquake rescue robot and a rescue method, which comprise a main box body structure used for carrying the whole robot, wherein a plurality of groups of support leg mounting frames are symmetrically hinged to two sides of the main box body structure, a vertical shaft of each support leg mounting frame is connected with a steering engine output shaft fixed on the main box body structure and controls the swing of the support leg mounting frame through a steering engine, a main leg is hinged to each support leg mounting frame, the tail end of each main leg is fixedly provided with a telescopic leg through an ear plate structure, a first telescopic cylinder structure is arranged between each support leg mounting frame and the ear plate structure, a second telescopic cylinder structure is arranged between each main leg and the ear plate structure, and a holding mechanism used for grabbing wounded persons or abandoned sundries is arranged at the bottom end of the main box body structure. The robot adopts a bionic spider robot structure, can well adapt to complex environments of earthquake areas, has high bearing capacity, is provided with a mechanical claw and a wounded riding space below a central vehicle body, and is provided with a material carrying platform above the central vehicle body, so that the robot can perform tasks such as search and rescue, assistance, transportation and the like of the earthquake disaster areas through the structural design.

title_en: Target positioning and detecting method based on cooperative work of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract_en: The invention provides a target positioning and detecting method based on cooperative work of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles, and relates to the technical field of target recognition and positioning. The method comprises the steps of providing a plurality of cameras through an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, collecting target images from different visual angles in real time, extracting features of the images collected by each camera through a deep convolutional neural network, introducing a cross attention mechanism to perform self-adaptive fusion on the feature images from different visual angles, combining a feature pyramid network to perform multi-scale target detection and target positioning, finally combining positioning and detection results from different unmanned aerial vehicles in a decision fusion module, performing decision fusion through a consensus algorithm, performing post-processing on the fused target recognition results, and outputting final recognition results. The invention not only improves the accuracy of target identification and positioning, but also provides effective technical support for the application of unmanned aerial vehicle in the fields of military reconnaissance, outdoor search and rescue and the like, and has wide market prospect and application value.
assignees: UNIV NORTHEASTERN;CHINA NAT GOLD GROUP GEOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Articulated search and rescue robot
title_ko: 관절형 탐색구조 로봇
abstract_en: The technical problem of the present invention is to reduce vibration and provide accurate driving information by controlling the driving point of an articulated search structure robot to align with a waypoint. The articulated search structure robot includes a head segment; a plurality of body segments; a tail segment; a chain segment; and a control unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 관절형 탐색구조 로봇에 관한 것으로, 제 1 구동모터 및 제 1 스프로킷휠을 구비하는 머리몸체를 포함하며, 상부, 전방부 및 하부의 길이방향 외주면에 제 1 체인통로를 구비하는 머리마디부; 상기 머리마디부의 후단부에 결합되되, 서보모터를 각각 구비하는 몸통몸체를 각각 포함하며, 상부 및 하부에 전후 길이방향으로 제 2 체인통로를 각각 구비하는 복수의 몸통마디부; 상기 복수의 몸통마디부의 후단부에 결합되되, 제 2 구동모터 및 제 2 스프로킷휠을 구비하는 꼬리몸체를 포함하며, 상부, 후방부 및 하부의 길이방향 외주면에 제 3 체인통로를 구비하는 꼬리마디부; 상기 제 1 구동모터 및 제 2 구동모터에 회전가능하게 결합되어 구동되는 체인과 기 설정된 간격에 따라 상기 체인에 결합되어 추력을 발생시키는 복수의 패드가 구비되되, 상기 제 1 체인통로, 제 2 체인통로 및 제 3 체인통로에 상기 체인이 이동가능하게 안착되는 체인부; 및 상기 제 1 구동모터, 서보모터 및 제 2 구동모터를 로봇의 주행경로에 따라 각각 구동시키되, 각 마디가 결합되는 관절부분에 대응하여 복수의 구동점을 각각 정의하고, 상기 주행경로에 대응하는 복수의 경유점을 정의하며, 상기 복수의 경유점 중 머리경유점 상에 상기 복수의 구동점 중 머리구동점을 위치하도록 제어하고, 상기 복수의 경유점 중 꼬리경유점 상에 상기 복수의 구동점 중 꼬리구동점을 위치하도록 제어하며, 상기 복수의 경유점 중 나머지경유점을 각각 연결하는 선분상에 상기 복수의 구동점 중 나머지구동점이 위치하도록 제어하는 제어부;를 포함함으로써, 충격과 주행정보의 부정확성을 해결할 수 있도록 진동을 감소시킬 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 정확한 주행정보를 제공할 수 있다.
assignees: UNIV KOREA IND UNIV COOP FOUND

title_en: Reconfigurable maritime search and rescue reconnaissance robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reconfigurable maritime search and rescue reconnaissance robot which comprises a robot main body, reconfigurable mechanisms and rotor-paddle wheel integrated modules, wherein reconfigurable mechanism supports are obliquely arranged at tail ends of supporting legs of the robot main body, the reconfigurable mechanisms are arranged in the reconfigurable mechanism supports, support end covers with spherical structures are arranged on the reconfigurable mechanism supports, each reconfigurable mechanism is connected with one rotor-paddle wheel integrated module, the rotor-paddle wheel integrated modules are driven to rotate at 360 degrees on the support end covers when the reconfigurable mechanisms rotate, and meanwhile, the rotor-paddle wheel integrated modules do shearing motion around the support end covers to realize the reconfiguration of a robot motion mode. The invention can change the shape of the robot and realize the reconstruction of the movement mode of the robot, thereby solving the problems of low efficiency, poor stability and the like of the existing maritime search and rescue technology, and especially in the face of maritime emergency accidents, rescue ships can not enter disaster sites due to falling of goods or buildings.

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative computing unloading and resource allocation method and system for emergency search and rescue of sudden disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative computing unloading and resource allocation method and system for emergency search and rescue of sudden disasters, which comprise the steps of building a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle assisted three-dimensional computing unloading network architecture for the emergency disaster search and rescue scene, taking unloading fairness of search and rescue equipment, load balancing of unmanned aerial vehicles and reduction of unmanned aerial vehicle energy consumption into consideration, building a system utility function, building a deep reinforcement learning model aiming at the maximum utility function of the search and rescue equipment for task unloading, training the deep reinforcement learning model based on an improved multi-agent dual-delay depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm, introducing OU noise and a priority cloning learning mechanism, and learning and optimizing unmanned aerial vehicle track planning and task unloading decisions of the search and rescue equipment. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be used as a cooperative computing and unloading requirement of the MEC server in a disaster scene, so that the purposes of ensuring the fairness of search and rescue equipment service and reducing the energy consumption of the unmanned aerial vehicle can be achieved by reasonably and efficiently computing and unloading decisions and resource allocation.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;JIANGSU JICUI MOBILE COMMUNICATION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Multi-degree-of-freedom underwater emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of underwater robots, and discloses a multi-degree-of-freedom underwater emergency rescue robot, which solves the problems that as the whole weight of a body becomes larger as the sediment is accumulated on the body, the power of an impeller controlling the lifting of the robot is required to be increased to balance the excessive weight, so that the energy consumption of the robot is increased and the duration time is shortened, and a buoyancy component expanding through inflation generates buoyancy under water to offset the gravity burden caused by storing the sediment in a basket, so that the impeller keeps the original power to run, the suspension state of the robot in water can be ensured, and the problem that the whole weight of the frame becomes larger due to the fact that the sediment is salvaged by the load is avoided, so that the energy consumption of the robot is increased and the duration time is shortened.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue target detection method based on improved YOLOV algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle maritime search and rescue target detection method based on an improved YOLOV algorithm, which is beneficial to the search and rescue deployment on water when maritime events such as drowning or sunken ship occur and belongs to the field of maritime rescue. The method comprises a training stage of training an offshore target detection network by adopting a training set, wherein training samples in the training set are automatically collected by an unmanned aerial vehicle, labels in a data set comprise drowning personnel, motorboats, ships, life buoys and life saving equipment (life jackets), and a network architecture of the offshore target detection network based on improvement YOLOv comprises a framework, a neck and a detection head. The invention can well overcome the problem of low target detection precision caused by small size of the detection object under the unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photographing scene, and negative influence of sea water wave and illumination factors on target detection.

title_en: Regional planning search and rescue method and system based on multi-agent cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional planning search and rescue method and system based on multi-agent cooperation, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles.
