The method comprises the steps of obtaining altitude field information from a deployment position to an initial position, planning a point-to-point path from the deployment position to a preset search and rescue starting position by utilizing a cellular automaton algorithm, obtaining unmanned aerial vehicle moving paths from the deployment position to the preset search and rescue starting position, dividing a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles into a leader and a follower, controlling the leader and the follower to reach the preset search and rescue starting position according to the unmanned aerial vehicle moving paths, distributing search paths of the unmanned aerial vehicles by utilizing an improved genetic algorithm based on a predetermined and divided search and rescue area, and respectively controlling each unmanned aerial vehicle to search along a corresponding search path. According to the invention, the search time of each unmanned aerial vehicle can be fully considered, the target to be searched and rescuing can be rapidly positioned, the search and rescue efficiency is remarkably improved, and the labor cost is reduced.

title_en: Air-ground collaborative search rescue system applied to complex environment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an air-ground collaborative search and rescue system applied to a complex environment, which belongs to the technical field of search and rescue, and comprises an air unmanned aerial vehicle system, a ground mobile robot system and a data center, wherein the air unmanned aerial vehicle system and the ground mobile robot system are interconnected through the data center; the aerial unmanned aerial vehicle system comprises an aerial image building unmanned aerial vehicle subsystem formed by a plurality of first echelons and an aerial navigation unmanned aerial vehicle subsystem formed by a plurality of second echelons, map data collected by the aerial image building unmanned aerial vehicle subsystem and position coordinates collected by the aerial navigation unmanned aerial vehicle subsystem are transmitted to the ground mobile robot system through a data center, and finally the ground mobile robot system executes search and rescue tasks according to the map data and the position coordinates.

title_en: Infrared thermal imaging device of quadruped robot for police
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an infrared thermal imaging device of a quadruped robot for police, and belongs to the technical field of radiation high-temperature measurement. The four-foot robot comprises a four-foot robot body, wherein a base is fixedly arranged at the top end of the four-foot robot body, a lantern ring is fixedly arranged on the base, a rotatable inner gear ring is arranged in the lantern ring, a gear is arranged in the inner gear ring, a rotating motor I is arranged in the four-foot robot body, a rotating shaft of the rotating motor I stretches into the inner gear ring to be connected with the gear, a cover plate is fixedly arranged on the inner gear ring, a rear arm is hinged on the cover plate, two first air cylinders are arranged between the cover plate and the front side surface and the rear side surface of the rear arm, a front arm is hinged at the front end of the rear arm, a second air cylinder is hinged between the rear arm and the front arm, a third air cylinder is arranged at the front end of the front arm, a second rotating motor is arranged between piston rods of the two third air cylinders, and an infrared thermal imager is arranged on the second rotating motor. The utility model has high flexibility and can be suitable for search and rescue and investigation work which are difficult to spread in the ruins of luxurious mountain forests or cities and villages.
assignees: XIAMEN DONGMEI SENTAI TECH CO LTD;THE SPECIAL POLICE DETACHMENT OF BINZHOU PUBLIC SECURITY BUREAU

title_en: Novel modularized rescue robot search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel modularized rescue robot search and rescue method, and relates to the technical field of rescue and rescue equipment. The novel modularized rescue robot search and rescue method is realized by a modularized rescue robot adopting a power structure design of a composite power unit structure, the modularized rescue robot consists of four modularized crawler wheel power units and a machine equipment main body, each modularized power unit is driven by a direct current motor, four motors respectively control four independent crawler wheels, and two independent crawler wheel power units on the same side of the search and rescue machine equipment main body form a composite power unit. According to the method of the robot, the characteristics of strong exploration capacity, strong passing capacity and the like of the robot are utilized, the robot is used as a pioneer and a role of an explorer in land disasters such as collapse, earthquake and the like, and the robot provides assistance for a rescue team to acquire effective information in the first time.

title_en: Personnel search and rescue identification method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle cluster and on-board imaging equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a personnel search and rescue identification method and system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster and an onboard imaging device, wherein the personnel search and rescue identification method and system comprise the following steps that each unmanned aerial vehicle in the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster receives a patrol flight parameter corresponding to the unmanned aerial vehicle; each unmanned aerial vehicle in the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster executes a patrol task according to the corresponding patrol flight parameters, in addition, in the execution process of the patrol task, a ground image in a patrol area is acquired in real time, after the existence of trapped personnel is determined, a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles execute a collaborative search and rescue task, and the unmanned aerial vehicles return to a material storage point, return to the area where the trapped personnel is located according to a material delivery path, and deliver materials to the area where the trapped personnel is located. The system can detect trapped people in real time, accurately identify the trapped people, track the trapped people in real time, finish a plurality of links such as emergency material throwing and guiding ground search and rescue personnel to go to search and rescue places through cooperative work of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, and enable the personnel to execute various tasks in the complex environment of the unmanned area.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle lighting structure with adjustable
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle illumination, in particular to an adjustable unmanned aerial vehicle illumination structure, which comprises an adjustable unmanned aerial vehicle illumination structure, a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicle modules, a plurality of control arms and a control module, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle modules are fixedly connected to the outer wall of the unmanned aerial vehicle main body at equal intervals; the movable clamping joints of the limiting sleeves are arranged on the outer walls of the adjacent machine arms, the clamping rings are connected to the two ends of the limiting sleeves in a rotating mode, and the regulating plate is movably clamped at the bottoms of the clamping rings. According to the utility model, the LED lamp panels are connected to the bottoms of the regulating and controlling plates in a rotating way, the second electric push rods are started to drive the clamping rings to swing back and forth, so that the LED lamp panels are driven to adjust back and forth, the investigation range of disaster areas is conveniently enlarged, the first electric push rods are synchronously started to adjust the angles of the LED lamp panels, the light lines of the LED lamp panels are gathered right below, the rescue place is conveniently and strongly irradiated, better lighting conditions are provided for rescue operation, search and rescue exploration are conveniently assisted for rescue workers to disaster areas, and the LED lamp panels are convenient to use.
assignees: HEFEI YINGHANG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Low-carbon post-disaster rescue system based on quantum computation and autonomous robot technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-carbon post-disaster rescue system based on quantum computing and an autonomous robot technology, and belongs to the technical field of post-disaster rescue. The system comprises a post-disaster information acquisition module, a data acquisition and analysis module, a quantum computation decision optimization and resource scheduling module, an autonomous robot task scheduling and execution module and a low-carbon technical model module. The method comprises the steps of carrying out ultra-high-speed processing and multi-objective optimization decision on post-disaster environmental data by adopting a mixed quantum annealing algorithm to generate a resource scheduling and path planning scheme, carrying out post-disaster building assessment, material delivery and personnel search and rescue tasks by an autonomous robot based on an AI algorithm, reducing the artificial risk, and realizing the reduction of the carbon emission by more than 30% in the rescue process by combining low-energy hardware, renewable energy power supply and a real-time carbon emission monitoring technology. The invention solves the problems of low efficiency, poor safety and high carbon emission of the traditional rescue, is suitable for the extreme post-disaster scene of communication interruption, and provides an innovative solution for intelligent low-carbon rescue.

title_en: Ground robot retraction device for rescue vehicle and rescue vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rescue robots, and discloses a ground robot retraction device for a rescue vehicle and the rescue vehicle, comprising a storage box body, a telescopic mechanism and a bearing mechanism, wherein the storage box body, the telescopic mechanism and the bearing mechanism are arranged in the rescue vehicle; the storage box comprises a storage box body, a bearing mechanism and a supporting plate, wherein an opening is formed in one side of the storage box body, the bearing mechanism is movably connected with the storage box body through a telescopic mechanism, the bearing mechanism can move out of the storage box body from the storage box body through the opening, the bearing mechanism comprises a supporting plate, a lifting assembly and a bearing frame for placing a ground robot, the supporting plate is connected with the telescopic mechanism, the bearing frame is arranged below the supporting plate and is movably connected with the supporting plate through the lifting assembly, and the bearing frame can move up and down relative to the supporting plate. The utility model can rapidly release the ground robot from the vehicle and put into operation, and simultaneously can ensure that the robot is properly stored and protected when not in use so as to cope with various emergency situations and ensure the smooth progress of rescue actions.
assignees: GUANGZHOU HAIGE TIANCHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative coverage path planning method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative coverage path planning method based on reinforcement learning, and belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous navigation and path planning. The method is suitable for scenes requiring multi-agent area coverage path planning problems (MACPP) such as post-disaster search and rescue, agricultural irrigation and the like. The invention decomposes MACPP into two sub-problems of inter-area access sequence planning (MTSP) and sub-area Coverage (CPP), and designs a lightweight cross-layer connection multi-agent reinforcement learning framework. The framework adopts a complete collaborative learning strategy to optimize MTSP, designs and uses an exploration mechanism dynamically adjusted along with the interaction frequency to optimize the entrance and exit combination strategy in the training process, and combines a round-trip path algorithm to efficiently solve the CPP problem. By the method, the multi-area search task can be efficiently completed in the shortest time by multiple unmanned aerial vehicles, so that the requirements of actual application scenes are met.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle capable of being contracted in small space for search and rescue and control system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small-space contractible search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and a control system thereof, comprising an unmanned aerial vehicle main body, a microprocessor and a microcontroller, the left side of unmanned aerial vehicle main part is from front to back fixed mounting in proper order has visible light high definition digtal camera and infrared thermal imaging camera. Through the setting of infrared thermal imaging camera and visible light high definition digtal camera, make things convenient for the backstage personnel to carry out the in-process that flies to the unmanned aerial vehicle main part, search for and rescue operation to personnel is carried out to relevant region, and through laser radar's setting, can survey barrier and space around the unmanned aerial vehicle main part, so that the backstage personnel judge and know the environment of search for and rescue operation, personnel can search for and rescue in the little space, carry out corresponding shrink folding operation between main wing and the aileron around the remote control unmanned aerial vehicle main part, and the span between the paddle takes off around the effectual reduction unmanned aerial vehicle main part, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle main part searches for and rescue operation in the little space.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search course determining method based on time sequence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search course determining method based on a time sequence, and relates to the technical field of information perception and recognition. The unmanned plane heading determining method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining ship navigation data in real time, recording comparison sequences of different moments and positions, predicting possible positions and headings of ships after AIS (automatic identification system) tracks of the ships disappear for a period of time based on a time sequence analysis model, and then calculating unmanned plane heading determining methods when the ship can search areas based on different navigational speeds based on searching meeting points. According to the invention, under the condition that the current ship position information cannot be acquired, the unmanned aerial vehicle is required to be dispatched to search and rescue the ship, the course of the unmanned aerial vehicle for searching and rescue is calculated and determined after a period of interruption based on a time sequence method, and engineering realization and application are easy.

title_en: Device for testing trafficability of small space of earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of earthquake rescue, in particular to a device for testing the trafficability of a small space of an earthquake rescue robot, which comprises a cross beam (1) arranged along the X-axis direction, a support column (2) arranged along the Y-axis direction, a first adjusting rod (4), a second adjusting rod (5), a first limiting slide block (31) and a second limiting slide block (32), wherein the first adjusting rod (4) and the second adjusting rod (5) are used for dividing a channel into a plurality of adjustable sub-channels. Any one sub-channel can be used as a channel for carrying out trafficability test of the earthquake rescue robot, and the size and shape of the sub-channel can be adjusted, so that the trafficability test of the earthquake rescue robot based on the channel with the shape and the size of the blind shape is facilitated.

title_en: Earthquake search and rescue device based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides an unmanned aerial vehicle-based earthquake search and rescue device, which comprises a shell, wherein the upper surface of the shell is fixedly connected with a supporting rod, the other end of the supporting rod is fixedly connected with a hydraulic rod, the movable end of the hydraulic rod is fixedly connected with a collecting barrel, the side surface of the collecting barrel is provided with a sliding groove, the inner wall of the sliding groove is slidably connected with a gas pipe, the position, close to the upper end, of the inner wall of the sliding groove is provided with a through hole, the side surface of the collecting barrel is positioned right above the through hole, a plurality of ventilation grooves are annularly arranged, the other end of the gas pipe is communicated with a guide plate, the guide plate is provided with an opening close to the gas pipe surface, wind energy is generated through rotation of a propeller, the generated wind energy enters the gas pipe along the opening, then the hydraulic rod moves downwards to drive the collecting barrel, the through hole on the surface of the collecting barrel is abutted against the gas pipe when the collecting barrel slides downwards, and the wind energy enters the collecting barrel along the gas pipe and the through hole, and the wind energy entering the collecting barrel is discharged to the surface of the shell along the ventilation grooves due to the pressure in the barrel, so that the cleaning of the shell is realized.

title_en: Gecko-like intelligent robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gecko-simulated intelligent robot, which relates to the technical field of biological bionic intelligent robots and comprises a gecko-simulated precursor and a gecko-simulated rear body, wherein the gecko-simulated precursor and the gecko-simulated rear body are connected through a body connecting part; according to the invention, a lightweight mechanical structure design is adopted, 3D modeling is carried out, all parts are manufactured by combining a 3D printing technology, a multi-joint driving system consisting of an STM32F103C8T6 main control chip and an SC90 steering engine is carried, multi-foot gait control is realized, the feet are filled with water-based polyacrylate pressure-sensitive adhesive, the feet of geckos are covered, stable adhesion can be realized on the surfaces of various materials such as glass and concrete, bluetooth/Wi-Fi wireless control is supported, and the forward, steering and obstacle crossing actions of a robot can be remotely operated through a mobile device APP, so that the method is applicable to high-risk scenes such as urban pipeline flaw detection, high-rise building cleaning, earthquake ruin search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Search and rescue method based on airborne synthetic aperture imaging and white display removal technology
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of emergency rescue, in particular to a search and rescue method based on an airborne synthetic aperture imaging and white display technology, which comprises the steps of indicating an unmanned aerial vehicle to shoot at multiple positions and multiple visual angles above a current appointed position; based on the shot thermal image, judging whether the current designated position is a suspected target position, if yes, performing motion estimation on the shot RGB image, preprocessing the thermal image and the RGB image to obtain the thermal image and the RGB image with the same resolution, performing white de-display processing, inputting the RGB image after white de-display and the corresponding thermal image into a multi-modal image fusion model to obtain fusion images, performing projection texture mapping and three-dimensional rendering by using an image rendering technology to obtain a synthesized image synthesized by perspective projection rendering corresponding to each fusion image, adjusting each fusion image to obtain de-occlusion images, and determining whether the current suspected target position is included in a search and rescue route based on the de-occlusion images.

title_en: Deep well rescue device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep well rescue device and a deep well rescue method, wherein the deep well rescue device comprises a fixed tripod and a rescue robot, the device comprises a main frame, a winch traction module, a clamping device, a well head adaptive adjusting device, a clamping plate downward inserting angle adjusting device and a controller, the clamping device comprises two clamping plates and two air bags, the well head adaptive adjusting device is arranged at the bottom of the main frame and is used for controlling the distance between the two clamping plates, the clamping plate downward inserting angle adjusting device is used for adjusting the position of the clamping plates on the inner circumference of a well, and the controller is respectively connected with an air supply module, a winch traction module, the well head adaptive adjusting device and a motor through an electric control communication module for communication.
assignees: HENAN YUXIN FIRE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Adjustable door frame for trafficability test of large earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the field of earthquake rescue, in particular to an adjustable door frame for trafficability test of a large earthquake rescue robot, which comprises a first side beam (1-1), a second side beam (2-1), a top beam (3-1), a first sleeve (1-2) arranged perpendicular to the ground, a second sleeve (2-2) arranged perpendicular to the ground, a third sleeve (3-2) arranged parallel to the ground, a positioning bolt (4) and a guide rail (5) arranged perpendicular to the ground. The adjustable door frame for the passing performance test of the large-scale earthquake rescue robot provided by the utility model has the advantages that the distance between the top beam (3-1) and the ground is adjustable, the distance between the second side beam (2-1) and the first side beam (1-1) is adjustable, namely, the transverse distance and the longitudinal height of the door frame are adjustable. The utility model has simple installation and convenient adjustment, and can provide inlets with various sizes for the trafficability test of the large-scale robot.

title_en: Unmanned search and rescue system construction method based on simulation platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle simulation, and particularly relates to a simulation platform-based unmanned search and rescue system construction method, which comprises the following steps of 1, performing personalized modeling on a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle; step 2, creating behavior logic of the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle model, step 3, carrying out functional division on all parts of an actual unmanned aerial vehicle, determining the influence of all parts on actions, obtaining performance parameters corresponding to all parts, mapping the performance parameters with all parts corresponding to the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle model, step 4, constructing unmanned control equipment capable of transmitting data with the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle model in real time, step 5, creating a simulation map for the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle model and unmanned control equipment, and step 6, building a carrier, and finishing aggregation or deagglomeration of the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle model and the carrier. The invention realizes the comprehensive simulation of multidimensional factors such as the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle model, ground equipment and the like, and provides guiding significance in the aspects of multi-task cooperation, flight optimization and the like.

title_en: Search and rescue type rescue unmanned aerial vehicle control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle control, in particular to a search and rescue type rescue unmanned aerial vehicle control method which comprises the following steps of collecting weather data of a rescue area through a weather station and a satellite, integrating air temperature, humidity, wind speed and terrain height data, and carrying out data comparison analysis to generate a comprehensive environment data set. According to the invention, through real-time simulation and flight condition analysis feedback of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the search and rescue task, not only is the task adaptability improved, but also the operation flexibility is improved, potential obstacles in the search and rescue area are dynamically identified and evaluated, the unmanned aerial vehicle is allowed to adjust the flight path in real time, the collision risk is obviously reduced, the safety of the rescue task is improved, the optimal obstacle avoidance distance and angle between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the obstacles are calculated in real time, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be ensured to maintain the highest operation efficiency in the unsafe flight area, the unmanned aerial vehicle can more quickly position victims and effectively support ground rescue actions, the dependence on manpower resources is reduced, and the rescue effect and efficiency are improved.

title_en: Control system of spy robot applied to emergency
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control system of a spy robot applied to an emergency, which relates to the technical field of emergency rescue and discloses a sign spy module, a rescue judging module and a supplementary rescue module, wherein the sign spy module and the sign spy module are arranged to control the spy robot to identify vital signs in a rescue area and judge whether a spy video needs to be uploaded according to a spy video shot by the spy robot, and judging to send the detection video to a rescue expert group or a common rescue group, intelligently distributing the rescue video, and not needing the rescue group to review the rescue video any more, so that the rescue efficiency of an emergency is improved, and setting a supplementary rescue module can control the fixed rescue robot to move to the expert rescue position to shoot the video, control to provide multi-angle video shooting for personnel needing expert rescue for the detection robot, and assist the rescue expert in carrying out multi-angle rescue work.
assignees: GUANGZHOU TAILUNHUI SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Resource optimization management method based on reconfigurable meter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resource optimization management method based on a reconfigurable meter, which remarkably improves the calculation efficiency, the cruising ability and the cooperative safety of an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, realizes the efficient power distribution, the energy consumption control and the real-time cooperation of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster and improves the cruising ability, the safety and the task execution efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster under a complex task scene through dynamic task distribution, reinforcement learning driven intelligent scheduling, a low-power model compression technology and an ultra-low delay communication technology of a heterogeneous multi-core architecture. The method is suitable for scenes such as security patrol, disaster search and rescue, agricultural monitoring and the like, solves the problems of stiff resource allocation, high energy consumption and large communication delay in the prior art, and has wide industrialized application prospect.
assignees: XINCANG INTELLIGENT TECH SUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Self-adaptive multi-terrain four-foot search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a self-adaptive multi-terrain four-foot search and rescue robot which comprises a carbon fiber machine body and a parallel leg mechanism, wherein the parallel leg mechanism is arranged on two sides of the carbon fiber machine body and comprises a leg fixing frame and a leg moving assembly, the leg fixing frame is arranged on one side of the carbon fiber machine body, the leg moving assembly is arranged on the front side and the rear side of the leg fixing frame and comprises a joint motor, two symmetrical thigh connecting rods, two symmetrical shank connecting rods and a flexible foot end, the joint motor is fixed at one end of the leg fixing frame, the thigh connecting rods are connected with the joint motor, the shank connecting rods are in rotary connection with the thigh connecting rods, the tail ends of the two shank connecting rods are connected with the flexible foot ends, the four-foot robot adopts a riveted all-carbon fiber structure, and has high symmetry, can realize functions of jumping, overturning and the like, thereby improving the obstacle surmounting and escaping capability of the leg and the structural strength and the impact resistance.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster self-adaptive path finding method and system based on bionic intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-adaptive path finding method for an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, which specifically comprises task initialization and environment perception, path planning based on bionic intelligence, multi-machine cooperation and dynamic adjustment. The method designs a pheromone updating strategy with a variation mechanism and dynamic obstacle avoidance capability, so that the path search has higher adaptability and stability. And on the communication level, a decentralised communication architecture is adopted among unmanned aerial vehicles, and a cloud synchronization mechanism is assisted, so that real-time sharing of task information and efficient adjustment of a path scheme are realized. The road searching method is suitable for various actual scenes including post-disaster search and rescue, ecological environment monitoring, large-scale regional inspection and the like, has good expansibility and robustness, and can effectively cope with challenges brought by dynamic environment and task changes.

title_en: Amphibious and air triphibian rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an amphibious and air triphibian rescue robot, and relates to the field of rescue robots. The scheme is that the device comprises a main frame body, walking wheel sets, fixed floating bodies and pneumatic rescue mechanisms, wherein the walking wheel sets are distributed at four corners of the main frame body and used for driving the main frame body to move, the fixed floating bodies are fixed at the bottom of the main frame body and used for providing basic buoyancy for the main frame body, and the pneumatic rescue mechanisms are assembled at the bottom of the main frame body and used for providing adjustable buoyancy and multi-scene rescue capability for the main frame body. The pneumatic rescue mechanism is arranged at the bottom, the air bag floating body can be used as a water-passing floating body of the main frame body after being inflated, can be quickly separated from the second air cylinder, can be used as a distress person floating body for rescuing in water, can be used as a collapse object support when a collapse scene is stretched into a collapse object, can share the pressure of the distress person, and can improve the survival probability of the distress person.

title_en: Land-air amphibious rescue robot with protection obstacle avoidance function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a land-air amphibious rescue robot with a protection and obstacle avoidance function, which relates to the technical field of rescue robots and comprises a robot body, wherein a case is arranged on the bottom end surface of the robot body, a driving system is arranged in the case, an electric push rod is vertically arranged on the bottom end surface of the case, an installation plate is arranged at the output end of the electric push rod, an installation plate is arranged at one end of the installation plate, a rectangular hole is formed in the surface of the installation plate in a penetrating manner, a transmission rod is arranged in the rectangular hole, an arc-shaped clamping claw is movably arranged on the outer side surface of the transmission rod, a driving plate is arranged at the top end of the arc-shaped clamping claw, and the electric push rod, the installation plate, the rectangular hole, the arc-shaped clamping claw, the transmission rod, the driving plate, a traction rope and an electric push rod are matched for use, so that small-volume objects can be conveniently grabbed, collected and transported during rescue of the robot body.

title_en: Compact bionic rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a compact bionic rescue robot, which relates to the technical field of rescue robots and comprises a robot body, wherein the robot body comprises a bionic head, the bionic head is arranged on a robot frame, a driving box is arranged on the robot frame, a wing is arranged on the surface of the robot frame, a main supporting rod and an auxiliary supporting rod are arranged in the wing, universal seats are arranged on the surfaces of the main supporting rod and the auxiliary supporting rod, folding rods are movably arranged between the universal seats, a plurality of folding rods are connected through a folding film, a rotating motor is arranged on the robot frame, a collecting disc is arranged at the output end of the rotating motor, a traction rope is wound on the surface of the collecting disc, the other end of the traction rope is connected with the auxiliary supporting rod, a supporting spring is arranged on the outer side of the traction rope, and the robot body adopts a structure with the shape of a mosquito, so that the mosquito can fly can be simulated, and the rescue actions can be unfolded.

title_en: Image acquisition and processing system and method based on three-light pod
abstract_en: The invention discloses an image acquisition and processing system and method based on three light pods, comprising a three light pod module, an image acquisition synchronization module, an image processing and fusion module, an edge calculation and data transmission module and a man-machine interaction and control terminal, wherein the three light pod module is a core front end acquisition component, the image acquisition synchronization module is used for synchronously controlling exposure and sampling time of three light sensors to realize time-space aligned data acquisition, the image processing and fusion module is a data processing core part and consists of an embedded processing unit and an algorithm engine, and the edge calculation and data transmission module is used for improving the processing capacity of the system, reducing the feedback pressure and realizing the intelligent judgment of the front end. The invention is suitable for the fields of electric power inspection, forest fire prevention, security monitoring, disaster search and rescue, traffic monitoring, and is deployed on carriers such as unmanned aerial vehicles, mobile robots, vehicle-mounted platforms and the like, so as to realize all-weather and all-terrain target sensing and information acquisition in complex environments.

title_en: Underwater small target detection device based on bionic magnetic induction array
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of bionic robots, and discloses an underwater small target detection device based on a bionic magnetic induction array, wherein a main control module is internally provided with a control module for controlling equipment to run, and the control module is electrically connected with a detection module and a miniaturized low-frequency electromagnetic emission unit which are arranged on the main control module; the underwater propelling type lifters are arranged around the main body control module at equal intervals, the underwater propelling type lifters are electrically connected with the control module, the mechanical tentacles are arranged around the main body control module at equal intervals, the mechanical tentacles are electrically connected with the control module, the mechanical tentacles are flexibly arranged in multiple sections, and different sections of the mechanical tentacles are independently controlled. The invention breaks through the limitations of the mechanical structure and the sensing mode of the traditional underwater detector, solves the problems of large metal small target detection blind area and weak eddy current interference resistance in complex underwater topography, and provides a novel detection scheme with high sensitivity and strong environmental adaptability for underwater search and rescue and submarine pipeline detection.

title_en: ABC-DQN layered optimization-based multi-unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue mission planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue task planning method based on ABC-DQN hierarchical optimization, and belongs to the technical field of multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue. The method is based on an artificial bee colony algorithm and a depth Q network to conduct task planning on a search and rescue area to which the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle is applied, and self-adaptive collaborative search and rescue of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle is completed. The invention constrains and optimizes the global planning of the search and rescue task and the path planning of the local area, firstly analyzes the scene of the search and rescue area and selects the number of unmanned aerial vehicles with different performances, and determines the unmanned aerial vehicle with a well-controlled central node. And then the central unmanned aerial vehicle utilizes an ABC algorithm to complete static global area division, then unmanned aerial vehicles in the local area conduct self-adaptive search and rescue path planning based on an DQN algorithm, and in the local search and rescue process, the local unmanned aerial vehicle and the central unmanned aerial vehicle conduct information interaction. Once the target is determined to appear, the central unmanned aerial vehicle further reduces the global area and re-performs the ABC algorithm division until the last search and rescue target is determined to be within the required range.

title_en: Intelligent fire rescue robot capable of climbing stairs
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent fire-fighting rescue robot capable of climbing stairs, which comprises a crawler robot body, wherein the crawler robot body comprises a body driving wheel, a shell and a bottom plate, a driving mechanism of the crawler robot body is arranged at the rear part of the robot, two swinging mechanisms are symmetrically arranged at the front part of the robot, a steering engine of each swinging mechanism is arranged below the adjacent bottom plate, each swinging mechanism comprises a steering engine, a swinging driving shaft, a swinging plate, swinging driven wheels, swinging tracks and a heart-less wheel, one end of the swinging driving shaft is connected with a driving steering engine shaft at the output end of the steering engine through a coupler, the other end of the swinging driving shaft sequentially penetrates through a connecting plate connected with the bottom plate and the heart-less wheel and is connected with the swinging plate through a flange coupler, and the upper space of the bottom plate is divided into two parts, one part is used for installing a stretching platform, and the other part is used for installing a detection execution module and a water storage tank. The system has better adaptability to complex terrains, and can realize integration of discovery, fire extinguishment and search and rescue.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle scheduling method, system, terminal and storage medium for emergency rescue
abstract_en: The application relates to a scheduling method, a system, a terminal and a storage medium of an unmanned aerial vehicle for emergency rescue, belonging to the technical field of emergency rescue, wherein the scheduling method of the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises the steps of sending a patrol instruction to a front-end unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, and the front-end unmanned aerial vehicle cluster carries out patrol according to a preset patrol path; the method comprises the steps of receiving a preliminary evaluation report of a disaster site sent by a front-end unmanned aerial vehicle cluster after the front-end unmanned aerial vehicle cluster finds the disaster site, generating and uploading the preliminary evaluation report after the front-end unmanned aerial vehicle cluster finds the disaster site, inputting the preliminary evaluation report into a pre-constructed scoring model to obtain a scoring value of the preliminary evaluation report, calling a current dispatching scheme matched with the scoring value from a historical dispatching database, and sending a rescue instruction to a standby unmanned aerial vehicle cluster and a rescue terminal according to the current dispatching scheme. The application has the beneficial effects of shortening the response time of the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, thereby improving the search and rescue efficiency.

title_en: Technology and equipment for searching and positioning wounded person based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wounded person searching and positioning technology and equipment based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, and relates to the technical fields of artificial intelligence, computer vision and unmanned aerial vehicle emergency rescue. The system is composed of an unmanned plane platform, a sensor module, an image processing unit, an artificial intelligent algorithm module and a ground control station. The unmanned aerial vehicle carries a multi-mode sensor to execute autonomous cruising and acquire disaster area images and environmental data in real time, an image processing unit introduces AIA-guided questions, enhanced Pixel Decoder and other improved deep learning algorithms, performs pixel level segmentation and accurate positioning on wounded persons, synchronously outputs semantic association information of the wounded persons and dangerous factors such as fire sources, collapsed objects and the like, and a ground control station visualizes the result in real time on a GIS platform and generates an optimal rescue path based on dynamic programming. The invention can obviously reduce the rate of missed detection and false detection under the conditions of strong shielding, low illumination and high dynamic background, improves the detection robustness and positioning accuracy in complex environments, and is suitable for scenes such as post-disaster emergency search and rescue.

title_en: Motion control method for coal mine rescue robot formation based on model predictive control
abstract_en: The invention relates to a motion control method for coal mine rescue robot formation based on model predictive control. The method comprises the steps of providing a coal mine rescue robot queue, configuring formation information of the coal mine rescue robot queue, controlling a driving state of a pilot by a pilot controller until the pilot reaches a target position corresponding to a pilot expected path, and when the pilot is controlled to follow the pilot, generating following control information by the formation controller based on a model prediction control method at least based on the pilot pose information of the pilot, the following pose information of the follower and the expected formation state of the current follower, so that the follower can drive under the following control information and follow the pilot. The invention effectively aims at uncertainty and emergency in the underground coal mine environment, realizes efficient and coordinated motion control and obstacle avoidance of the formation of the coal mine rescue robot, and improves the execution efficiency and safety of rescue tasks.

title_en: Rescue method and system of rescue robot for exploration
abstract_en: The application discloses a rescue method and a system of a rescue robot for exploration, and relates to the technical field of underground space rescue, comprising the following steps of acquiring multipath acoustic echo data of a karst cave and motion trail data of the robot, and constructing a three-dimensional point cloud model according to the multipath acoustic echo data and the motion trail data of the robot; and identifying unmatched data in the multipath acoustic echo data and the robot motion trail data, and taking the area where the unmatched data is located as an abnormal area. According to the application, the spatial resolution of signal acquisition is enhanced through the multi-microphone array, the noise reduction algorithm and short-time Fourier transform are combined to extract robust acoustic fingerprints, and the human body sound source signals with high confidence are screened out by utilizing the characteristic template matching mechanism, so that the accurate extraction and identification of human body acoustic characteristics in the complex noise environment of the karst cave are realized, and the problem of misjudgment caused by confusion of sound source characteristics and environmental noise in the traditional method is effectively solved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster communication system based on weak signal connection
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster communication system based on weak signal connection. According to the invention, the communication reliability in a complex environment is remarkably improved through the intelligent cooperative mechanism of the dynamic relay path optimization module. The system analyzes the topology and the node state of the cluster network in real time, combines multidimensional parameters such as signal stability, energy consumption efficiency, task load and the like, dynamically screens the optimal relay node and generates an efficient transmission path. For example, in a weak signal area, the system can automatically start adjacent high-stability nodes to serve as relays, so that the problem of stiffness of a traditional fixed relay strategy is avoided, meanwhile, the risk of signal attenuation is avoided in advance through predictive switching, and continuous return of key data is ensured. The capability of actively adapting to network fluctuation effectively reduces the communication interruption probability, and can ensure the noninductive connection of task instructions and key information especially in the scenes of severely requiring real-time performance such as search and rescue, exploration and the like.
assignees: ZHIGAO WEILAI SHENZHEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Calculation method for same-route double-aircraft collaborative flight distance for improving double-aircraft search and rescue efficiency
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue, and particularly relates to a calculation method for a co-aircraft co-flight distance of a same route, which is used for improving the double-aircraft search and rescue efficiency. And calculating the target positioning accuracy according to the position of the airplane, the direction finding error of the airplane and the distance from the airplane to the target, and converting the target positioning accuracy into the cooperative distance between the airplane. And finally, constructing an optimal aircraft collaborative space universal model meeting the positioning precision requirement, and obtaining the optimal collaborative space of the two aircraft by solving the highest sum of the target values of the collaborative search and rescue of the two aircraft. According to the method, the optimal distance between the two machines in collaborative flight can be solved for different airlines, the probability that the targets are searched by the collaborative machines at the same time is increased, and the efficiency of searching the targets by the two machines in collaborative mode can be improved.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU;ZHONGYUAN ELECTRONIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE NO 27 RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROU

title_en: Multi-agent game construction method and multi-agent system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a multi-agent game and a multi-agent system, which belong to the technical field of multi-agent learning and comprise the following steps: after information data of the unmanned aerial vehicle multi-agent are received, state dimension characterization factors of the unmanned aerial vehicle multi-agent are analyzed, and a first execution scheme of the unmanned aerial vehicle multi-agent is judged. And analyzing the state dimension adjusting effect characterization factors of the unmanned aerial vehicle multi-agent, and analyzing the first adjusting effect information, thereby obtaining a second execution scheme of the unmanned aerial vehicle multi-agent. And synchronously analyzing the multi-agent bot strategy characterization factors of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and analyzing a third execution scheme of the multi-agent bot by combining the state dimension characterization factors of the multi-agent bot. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle game decision-making method, the state dimension of the unmanned aerial vehicle multi-agent is judged and correspondingly adjusted, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle game decision-making can be accurately and stably carried out, diversified requirements can be met, the task completion degree is improved, and the collaborative search and rescue efficiency of the subsequent unmanned aerial vehicle clusters is improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle task planning method based on graphic labels
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle control and RFID, and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle task planning method based on a graphic label, which comprises the steps of designing a graphic label with an RFID chip; the method comprises the steps of deploying a graphic tag network with environment awareness, establishing an optimal communication link between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the graphic tag, setting an initial position and an initial direction, reading a data packet containing a state code and a timestamp through an optimal communication protocol, executing grading actions based on a state code bit pattern, carrying out path planning and generating an action sequence by adopting an improved A-x algorithm, and carrying out path verification and built-in sensor calibration by monitoring abnormal conditions of the unmanned aerial vehicle in real time. According to the invention, through the combination of the graphic tag and the RFID technology and the collaborative design of the state code and the path planning algorithm, the efficient planning and execution of the unmanned aerial vehicle task are realized, the problems of unmanned aerial vehicle positioning drift and poor task adaptability in a complex environment are solved, and the unmanned aerial vehicle positioning drift and the unmanned aerial vehicle path planning method are particularly suitable for field inspection and search and rescue scenes.
assignees: SHANDONG XUNJIA AEROSPACE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Form reconfigurable four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and flexible robot cooperation device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle and flexible robot collaborative operation, in particular to a morphological reconfigurable four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle and flexible robot collaborative device, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle central plate, an unmanned aerial vehicle upper plate, an unmanned aerial vehicle top plate and an unmanned aerial vehicle bottom plate, wherein the MG996R steering engine drives four rotors to dynamically switch between an X type (high-speed flight), an H type (narrow crossing) and a Y type (load expansion), the width compression ratio of the H type is 70% (to 350 mm), the narrow passage (such as a narrow lane and an industrial pipeline in an old urban area) which cannot be passed by a traditional unmanned aerial vehicle can be traversed, the compression ratio of the unmanned aerial vehicle is improved by 2 times compared with that of an M IT deformed unmanned aerial vehicle, the X type lower rotor is alternately arranged up and down, the hovering precision is +/-0.5M, and the flight speed is 15M/s; the Y-shaped model supports equipment such as a single-side horn extension mounting thermal imager, and the like, and can stably fly when the gravity center deviation is less than or equal to 15mm, so that the multi-task requirements such as post-disaster infrared search and rescue, logistics distribution and the like are met.

title_en: Mobile platform of miniature search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of building collapse ruin search and rescue equipment, in particular relates to a microminiature search and rescue robot moving platform which comprises two moving modules and a load module, wherein the two moving modules are connected end to form a snake-shaped robot moving platform, the two moving modules are identical in structure and comprise driving joints, deflection joints and a fixed shell, the driving joints provide power for the robot moving platform to walk, the deflection joints control the walking direction of the robot moving platform and ensure that the robot moving platform successfully avoids obstacles in the walking process, and the load module is internally provided with a life detector and a battery and can search and rescue in the ruins and provide a power supply for the wireless communication robot to realize functions. The mobile platform of the miniature snake-shaped robot has good adaptability under the complex environment inside the ruins of building collapse, is particularly suitable for passing through narrow gaps, and has the characteristics of modularized structure, light weight, flexible walking, easy installation, replacement and accurate control.

title_en: Autonomous energy-supply amphibious rescue robot and use method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an autonomous power supply amphibious three-dimensional rescue robot, which is characterized in that a plurality of unit robots are sequentially connected through mechanical iris units to form an annular main body or a strip main body, each unit robot comprises a main shell, an autonomous power supply module, a rotor propulsion unit, a control module, a photographing unit, a fluid parameter sensing unit and a universal wheel, wherein the photographing unit and the fluid parameter sensing unit are electrically connected with the control module, the control module is electrically connected with the rotor propulsion unit, the universal wheel and the mechanical iris unit respectively for judging an operating environment and used for adjusting a motion gesture, the autonomous power supply module is used for converting mechanical impact vibration energy received by the unit robots into electric energy for storage and supplying power for each module in the unit robots, and the use method comprises the steps of inspecting and identifying the environment, switching the operating mode, deforming to approach a rescue object, surrounding rescue and charging by utilizing various energies. The problem that the rescue robot is single in application environment, poor in rescue performance and depends on external energy sources is solved.

title_en: On-board water search and rescue honeycomb system and on-board search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shipborne water search and rescue honeycomb system which comprises a main body support, a fixing device, an information data transmission and control module and an antenna assembly, wherein the main body support is provided with a plurality of honeycomb storage bins for storing unmanned aerial vehicles, the unmanned aerial vehicles park and charge in the storage bins, the fixing device is arranged in the storage bins and is used for fixing the unmanned aerial vehicles, the information data transmission and control module is arranged in the main body support and is used for receiving, transmitting data and controlling the unmanned aerial vehicles, and the antenna assembly is used for providing connection signals for the unmanned aerial vehicles and the information data transmission and control module. The intelligent centralized management and control system has the advantages that by adopting the advanced honeycomb type modularized storage bin design, not only can a large number of unmanned aerial vehicle equipment be carried efficiently, but also intelligent centralized management and control of the whole unmanned aerial vehicle formation can be realized, the coverage range of the intelligent centralized management and control system can be several times of that of the traditional single machine operation, the search and rescue efficiency is greatly improved, and a large-area search and rescue task can be completed in the shortest time.
assignees: SUZHOU JIANGHAI COMMUNICATION DEVELOPMENT IND CO LTD

title_en: Modularized amphibious search and rescue detection robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a modularized amphibious search and rescue detection robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The robot mainly comprises a spherical main body robot which can deform, an auxiliary robot split cabin is connected to the inner bottom of the spherical main body robot, the auxiliary robot split cabin comprises a cabin upper cover plate, cabin side plates are fixedly connected to the periphery of the cabin upper cover plate, a cabin bottom plate which can lift and is matched with the cabin side plates is arranged at the bottom of the cabin side plates, a release cabin is fixedly connected to the bottom of the cabin upper cover plate, an ellipsoidal auxiliary robot is arranged in the release cabin, and a limiting guide plate used for limiting the ellipsoidal auxiliary robot is fixed to the upper end face of the cabin bottom plate. The utility model adopts the deformable spherical robot body to match with the ellipsoidal auxiliary robot with amphibious design, so that the search and rescue task can be fully carried out under different environments, the robot can be suitable for narrow space and unstable terrain, and can fly over obstacles such as rivers, and the survivability of the robot is improved.

title_en: Class inertia wheel hydrofoil and air wing integrated water-air span medium unmanned aerial vehicle and control algorithm thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inertia wheel-like hydrofoil air wing integrated water-air span medium unmanned aerial vehicle and a control algorithm thereof. The unmanned aerial vehicle structurally integrates a fixed wing air lift system and an adjustable hydrofoil propulsion assembly, a marine propulsion propeller is taken as an inertia-like wheel, the attitude of the unmanned aerial vehicle is adjusted through rotation of the marine propulsion propeller, high dynamic control performance is achieved, the control method is based on a double-layer framework combining Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) reinforcement learning and Model Predictive Control (MPC), MPC output is corrected in real time through a neural strategy network, and high-robustness attitude control in a complex environment is achieved. The invention has compact structure, intelligent control and strong adaptability, and is suitable for various cross-medium task scenes such as sea and air integrated inspection, search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Earthquake search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of search and rescue robots, in particular to an earthquake search and rescue robot which comprises a frame, wherein a detection mechanism is arranged on the frame, a dust removing mechanism is arranged on the frame, a locking mechanism is arranged on the frame, a transmission mechanism is arranged in the frame, a marking mechanism is arranged on the frame, a collecting mechanism is arranged on the frame, the detection mechanism is matched with the frame to facilitate on-site search and rescue work after an earthquake, the transmission mechanism is driven by the detection mechanism to enable the transmission mechanism to control the dust removing mechanism to work, dust falling is facilitated to on-site spraying, secondary damage to trapped personnel caused by smoke dust is reduced, the dust removing mechanism is facilitated to be disassembled and assembled by the locking mechanism, subsequent water adding is facilitated, medical medicine storage is facilitated by the installation of the collecting mechanism, signal bomb storage is facilitated by the installation of the marking mechanism, signal throwing is realized by the rotation of the marking mechanism, and smoke is generated after landing to facilitate search and rescue of staff.
assignees: XUZHOU BEIYU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue path planning method based on COMA method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of path planning, and provides a search and rescue path planning method of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles based on a COMA method, which comprises two stages of offline centralized training and online distributed deployment; and in the offline centralized training stage, a project designs a double-layer collaborative framework covering a planning layer (upper layer) and a path planning layer (lower layer), and decoupling and linkage of macroscopic task allocation and microscopic path execution are realized. The method comprises the steps of expanding and applying the COMA reinforcement learning algorithm to an informative path planning task of a UAV team, introducing a counterfactual baseline by adopting a framework of a centralized reviewer and a decentralised executor, and independently planning and executing a path of the next step by each unmanned aerial vehicle according to a local map and communication information in an online distributed deployment stage. The invention can effectively cope with the collaborative search and rescue task of multiple unmanned planes in a dynamic environment, and obviously improves the task completion speed and accuracy.

title_en: Method and system for searching and positioning mobile phone signals by using unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle application, in particular to a method and a system for searching and positioning mobile phone signals by using an unmanned aerial vehicle, comprising the following steps of S1, covering geographic information by using an operator network, planning and executing a flight task by using the unmanned aerial vehicle, starting mobile phone information acquisition equipment after reaching a target area to be searched, and forming a mobile phone signal coverage area below the unmanned aerial vehicle; step S2, the mobile phone information acquisition equipment and the mobile phone in the mobile phone signal coverage area acquire IMSI information through signaling interaction, for a specified IMSI, the unmanned aerial vehicle approaches a target through the field intensity change of the mobile phone signal, and finally the mobile phone position is locked, and step S3, the position is displayed and confirmed in real time in a geographic information system of a ground station according to the track diagram of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the IMSI track diagram, and the position is immediately provided for a professional ground search and rescue team. Compared with the prior art, the method and the system for searching and positioning by using the unmanned aerial vehicle mounted mobile phone signal have the advantages of high searching and positioning efficiency, basically no extra flight time, improvement of the effective working time of the unmanned aerial vehicle, realization of quick searching, and contribution to quick finding out of lost people and rescue.
assignees: SHENZHEN AIPUSAIER INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster is with supplementary rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of rescue robots and discloses an auxiliary rescue robot for geological disasters, which comprises a robot main body, wherein a first rotating shaft is rotatably arranged on the robot main body, wheels are arranged on the first rotating shaft, a motor is fixedly arranged in the robot main body, an output shaft of the motor is in transmission connection with the first rotating shaft through a first transmission piece, a second rotating shaft is rotatably arranged on the robot main body, a connecting rod is fixedly arranged on the second rotating shaft, a life detector is arranged on the connecting rod, and the output shaft of the motor is in transmission fit with the connecting rod through a second transmission piece. The motor drives the first rotating shaft and the connecting rod to rotate through the first transmission piece and the second transmission piece, has a simple structure and a small driving source, greatly reduces the weight of the whole robot, widens the adaptable geological disaster scene, and reduces the transportation difficulty.
assignees: HANGZHOU ITR ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-robot collaborative search and rescue method and system for police service site
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle-robot collaborative search and rescue method for a police service site, which relates to the technical field of indoor navigation and positioning, and aims to construct a three-dimensional grid map by acquiring building structure data of an indoor search and rescue area, realize high-precision three-dimensional positioning based on an air-ground double-layer beacon network, dynamically adjust beacon density and frequency by combining Doppler frequency shift characteristics of sound wave beacons and thermal radiation intensity changes of infrared beacons, synchronously optimize search and rescue path planning of cooperation of an unmanned aerial vehicle and a robot, effectively solve the problems of low target positioning precision and unstable dynamic tracking in a complex indoor environment, and improve the efficiency and reliability of collaborative operation of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the robot in the police service site and disaster rescue to a certain extent, thereby remarkably improving the success rate and the overall execution effect of search and rescue tasks in the complex scene.
assignees: SHANDONG SIWO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle multitasking point approaching reconnaissance online route planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle multi-task point approaching reconnaissance online route planning method which comprises the steps of firstly determining all task points to be reconnaissance in a task area, combining dense task points according to the distribution of the task points and the detection breadth of an unmanned aerial vehicle airborne detection device, determining equivalent task points to obtain an equivalent task point set, secondly determining the reconnaissance sequence of the equivalent task points by adopting a greedy algorithm according to the position distribution relation of an unmanned aerial vehicle and the equivalent task point set, and finally adding the turning radius of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the constraint of the aircraft ability in the flight speed direction on the basis of a heuristic A-type method according to the reconnaissance sequence, and considering the en-route flying zone to avoid obstacles so as to finish approaching reconnaissance route planning of all the equivalent task points in the task area. The method has high reliability, strong real-time performance and strong engineering practice, can be used for scenes such as regional situation awareness, search and rescue and the like, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Multi-unmanned-plane collaborative search and rescue intelligent decision-making method and device based on layering intention
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue intelligent decision-making method and device based on layering intention. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an environment simulation diagram, constructing a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue model, extracting features of a search and rescue target and an obstacle through the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue model to obtain target position features and obstacle position features, dividing an information gain grid based on the environment simulation diagram, determining a local information gain field of a proxy unmanned aerial vehicle, calculating according to the local information gain field of the proxy unmanned aerial vehicle, fusing information of a neighborhood unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain local gain information of the proxy unmanned aerial vehicle, extracting features of the local gain information to obtain local gain features, focusing attention of the target position features, the obstacle position features and the local gain features to output multi-source aggregation features, and processing the multi-source aggregation features through a multi-layer perceptron to output normal distribution of actions of the unmanned aerial vehicle. The invention can improve the search and rescue efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle in the search and rescue scene.

title_en: Method for predicting position of unconnected personnel under mountain torrent mud-rock flow disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting the position of a person who is not connected under a mountain torrent mud-rock flow disaster, and belongs to the field of disaster rescue. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data fusing thermal infrared images, radar images and terrains, extracting characteristics of the obtained multi-source data to detect multi-source identification of positions of the missing persons under mountain torrent mud-rock flow disasters from human body thermal radiation, human body bones, constructing a comprehensive analysis function based on the extracted characteristics, obtaining predicted values of different positions at time t based on the comprehensive analysis function, and completing prediction of the positions of the missing persons. The invention aims to solve the problems of low accuracy and low efficiency of the existing method for predicting the position of the disjunctor.
assignees: SICHUAN ANXIN KECHUANG TECH CO LTD;SICHUAN ACADEMY OF SAFETY SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Water Rescue Drone
title_ko: 수상구조 드론
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to improve water rescue efficiency by rapidly reaching a rescue drone to a rescuer and safely transferring the rescuer when a water accident occurs. Moreover, speed and safety of the aquatic rescue process are improved. The water structure drone characterizes to include to the drone body(100), front leg(200), rear leg(300), structure leg(400), balance wing(500).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 수상사고 발생시에 수상구조자를 구조하는 구조드론에 있어서, 수상사고 발생시에 신속하게 구조자에게 도달하고 구조자를 바로 안전하게 이송시켜 효율적인 수상구조가 이루어지는 수상구조 드론을 제공하는 것을 그 목적으로 하는 발명이다. 
즉 본 발명은 구조드론에 있어서, 드론의 몸체가 되는 드론몸체, 양측으로 돌출되어 전단에 비행을 위한 프로펠러를 갖는 전방다리, 양측으로 돌출되어 전단에 비행을 위한 프로펠러를 갖는 후방다리, 영상을 촬영하는 카메라, 내부배터리를 갖는 전원부, 장치를 제어하는 제어부로 구성하고, 구조자와 드론을 묶도록 양측 후방으로 돌출되어 구조자가 붙들거나 구조자를 거는 구조다리, 프로펠러와의 연결점에 비행가동시에는 프로펠러를 방향을 수평으로 형성여 비행상승 추진체가 되고 수상가동시에는 프로펠러를 수직으로 변형시켜 수중 전진 추친체로 변형하도록 프로펠러의 결속각을 수직변형되게 형성된 가변프롭, 후방으로 돌출되어 수상가동시 드론을 안정화하고 전복을 방지하며 보조부력체가 되도록 형성한 균형날개로 구비하여서, 수상사고 발생시에 구조자에게 접근할때는 비행가동하여 접근하고, 구조자에게 도착후에 수상가동하여 구조자를 직접 운송하도록 구조자를 신속하고 안전하게 구조가 이루어지는 효과를 갖는 수상구조 드론에 관한 발명이다.
assignees: CHEONGJU UNIV INDUSTRY & ACADEMY COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Maritime rescue drone
title_ko: 해양 구조 드론
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to quickly and accurately deliver rescue products to a rescuer when a marine accident occurs. That is, the marine rescue drone of the present invention comprises: a drone body formed in a hexagonal column shape which is a body; a flight wing unit which is a rear wing of the drone; a structure which is bound and separated to rescue a rescuer; a camera unit which is a photographing device dedicated to photographing an image; a power unit which is a power source of the device; and a control unit which controls the device. The marine rescue drone of the present invention comprises: a wing frame which is formed in a rectangular plate shape horizontally protruding from the drone body unit which is the wing body of the flight wing unit; and a wing propeller which horizontally rotates. Furthermore, the present invention relates to an offshore structure drone having an effect of effectively transferring a device by reducing the volume when the flying wing unit is vertically folded on the side surface of the drone body to transfer the device.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 해양 사고가 발생하였을 때 신속하고 정확하게 구조자에게 구조용품을 전달하는 것을 그 목적으로 하는 발명이다. 
즉 본 발명은 해양 구조 드론에 있어서, 몸체가 되는 육각기둥형으로 형성된 드론몸체, 드론의 추친날개가 되는 비행날개부, 결속분리되어 구조자를 구조하는 구조체, 영상을 촬영전속하는 촬영장치가 되는 카메라부, 장치의 전력원이 되는 전력부, 장치를 제어하는 제어부로 구성하고, 비행날개부의 날개몸체되는 드론몸체부에서 수평하게 돌출된 사각판형으로 형성된 날개프레임, 수평회전하는 날개프로펠러로 구성하고, 비행날개부가 수직으로 접어지도록 접힘구조물로 형성된 날개체접힘구를 구비하여, 해양 구조자 발생시에 드론을 이용하여 신속하게 구조지역에 도달하고 구조체를 구조자에게 투하하여 구조자에 구조가 이루어지는 것이다. 나아가 비행날개부가 드론몸체의 측면에 수직으로 접어져서 장치를 이송함에 있어서 부피를 줄여 효과적인 이송이 이루어지는 효과를 갖는 해양 구조 드론에 관한 발명이다.
assignees: CHEONGJU UNIV INDUSTRY & ACADEMY COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Drone for emergency rescue
title_ko: 응급구조 드론
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency rescue drone. The emergency rescue drone comprises: a drone main body flying by a flight lifting unit. The drone main body includes: an internal space unit capable of accommodating an emergency rescue box and a person therein; a control unit for controlling the drone main body, including communicating with a camera and the outside; and a lower loading unit having a lower door capable of being opened and closed at a lower portion of the middle of the internal space unit, and capable of loading objects or people as needed. The lower loading unit is formed to be located below the lower door and is detachably provided on a lower side of the drone main body. The emergency rescue box includes rescue equipment or emergency supplies having an automated external defibrillator (aed). The drone main body delivers emergency equipment or emergency supplies to a female emergency site or transports a patient, which further includes a communication drone that flies within a range capable of communicating with each other nearby and facilitates a communication signal, and allows the drone to connect various experts at an emergency site and a remote place by video, thereby quickly coping with an emergency situation.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비행승강부에 의해 비행하는 드론본체; 상기 드론본체는, 
내부에 응급구조함 및 사람을 수용할 수 있는 내부공간부와, 카메라 및 외부와 통신하는 것을 포함하며 드론본체를 제어하는 제어부, 상기 내부공간부 중단하부에는 여닫기가 가능한 하부도어가 형성되고, 필요에 따라 물건 또는 사람을 적재할 수있는 하부적재부를 구비하며, 상기 하부적재부는, 
하부도어 아래의 위치해 형성되며 드론본체 하부측에 탈착가능하게 구비되고, 상기 응급구조함은, 자동제세동기(Automated External Defibrillator, AED)를 구비한, 구조 장비 또는 응급 용품이 포함되며, 상기 드론본체에는 근처에 서로통신할 수 있는 범위에서 비행하며 통신신호를 원활하게 하는 통신드론을 더 포함하는 여 응급 현장에 응급 장비나 응급 용품을 전달하거나 환자를 이송하고, 드론이 응급 현장과 원격지에 있는 다양한 전문가를 화상으로 연결하도록 함으로써 신속히 응급 상황에 대처할 수 있는 응급구조 드론에 관한 것이다.
assignees: CHEONGJU UNIV INDUSTRY & ACADEMY COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Urban flood monitoring unmanned plane based on remote sensing, monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote sensing-based urban flood monitoring unmanned aerial vehicle, a monitoring system and a method, wherein the remote sensing-based urban flood monitoring unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring system comprises a remote sensing image acquisition module, a data analysis module, an emergency rescue module and a ground control processing center. The unmanned aerial vehicle is including visual monitor and unmanned aerial vehicle control box, supplementary surface of water floats the mechanism setting at unmanned aerial vehicle's bottom terminal surface, supplementary surface of water floats mechanism including auxiliary control device and floating gasbag subassembly. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle is stressed by the water surface rescue robot and the auxiliary water surface floating mechanism, and when the unmanned aerial vehicle falls to the water surface, the water surface rescue robot can control the unmanned aerial vehicle to run on the water surface, and after the unmanned aerial vehicle moves to a safe position, the unmanned aerial vehicle can take off again to carry out monitoring operation.

title_en: Folding supporting type search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a folding supporting type search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle and a bottom plate fixedly connected to the bottom of the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein a clamping groove is formed in the bottom of the bottom plate, two groups of movable rods and supporting rods are embedded into the clamping groove, the movable rods are rotatably connected with the inner walls of the clamping groove and the movable rods and the supporting rods through first rotating pins, adjacent supporting rods are connected through connecting rods, two groups of fixed blocks are fixedly connected to the outer side of the bottom plate, bending baffles are movably installed between the two groups of fixed blocks, and the bending baffles are butted to the bottom of the clamping groove. The unmanned aerial vehicle bracket structure can be quickly extended from the clamping groove at the bottom of the bottom plate and quickly assembled to form the unmanned aerial vehicle bracket structure when in use, is convenient for unmanned aerial vehicles to use, is simple and portable to operate, and simultaneously effectively reduces the manufacturing cost and the carrying occupation space of the unmanned aerial vehicle matched machine nest.
assignees: RIZHAO ZHONGAN SPECIAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD
