title_en: Image enhancement method and device of fire-fighting search and rescue infrared thermal imager
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of image enhancement, in particular to an image enhancement method and an image enhancement device of a fire-fighting search and rescue infrared thermal imager, which acquire original RAW infrared image data by using the infrared thermal imager, further introduce an image processing algorithm based on deep learning to perform pixel-level feature learning and temperature partition identification after non-uniformity correction processing, generating a temperature partition probability distribution map, introducing a flexible linear mapping mechanism, and performing linear mapping processing on gray values of all pixel points of the infrared image, so as to optimize the display effect of the infrared image and obtain enhanced infrared image data. The method can adjust the gray distribution of different temperature areas, effectively avoid artifacts and cracking caused by the traditional fixed threshold partitioning method while improving the contrast ratio and detail visibility of the infrared image, and remarkably improve the image quality and readability.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle path planning obstacle avoidance method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle path planning obstacle avoidance method based on reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps of S1, defining an unmanned aerial vehicle environment model, S2, adopting an improved MADDPG algorithm to build a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle system based on reinforcement learning for each unmanned aerial vehicle, introducing a long-period memory network into an Actor and Critic network, S3, adopting centralized training to optimize cooperative path planning and obstacle avoidance decision of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle, S4, dynamically adjusting task allocation and flight paths based on a self-adaptive task allocation mechanism, S5, adopting an experience playback mechanism and a target network, S6, generating the flight path through the Actor network, and making real-time decision. According to the invention, through an improved MADDPG algorithm, the LSTM structure is utilized to optimize multi-unmanned-plane cooperation, path planning and obstacle avoidance decision, and the method is widely applied to the field of unmanned-plane group cooperation in search and rescue.
assignees: AVIC HENGTUO INTELLIGENT TECH HEBEI CO LTD

title_en: Marine quick search and rescue method based on multi-unmanned aerial vehicle cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned-plane-cooperation-based quick search and rescue method for the sea, which relates to the technical field of sea rescue and aims at improving the positioning and rescue efficiency of a sea accident target, and the method comprises the steps of coordinating a plurality of unmanned planes through a ground control center, dynamically dividing search and rescue areas according to the performances of the unmanned planes and distributing tasks; the method comprises the steps of adopting a mixed search path combining Z shape and spiral shape, evaluating the reliability of a target by combining multi-source sensor data, realizing efficient search and accurate locking, constructing a drift prediction model by using ocean currents and wind speeds, dynamically adjusting the path to adapt to target drift, accurately putting rescue materials through visual identification and environment correction, and providing a fault-tolerant mechanism to ensure task continuity. The invention overcomes the limitations of small coverage range and slow response of the traditional search and rescue method and the problem of insufficient adaptation of the existing unmanned aerial vehicle technology to the dynamic environment, obviously improves the search and rescue efficiency, accuracy and reliability, and provides an effective solution for quick rescue at sea.

title_en: Land-air amphibious rescue robot for high-rise fire scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire rescue, in particular to a land-air amphibious rescue robot for a high-rise fire scene, which is characterized in that in a flying and landing descending mode, an analysis module analyzes based on data information to control a telescopic arm to stretch and retract and a control sliding block rocker arm part to rotate through a control module so as to adjust the position of a propeller part and adjust the position of a wheel type suspension part, so that the rescue robot can quickly and stably reach a target floor and shuttle road blocking obstacles, and in the flying and landing descending mode, the analysis module can analyze based on the data information to obtain a ground gradient angle and correct the rotation angle of the sliding block rocker arm part of the robot based on the ground gradient angle through the control module so as to adjust the position of the wheel type suspension part in the descending process, thereby improving the terrain applicability. According to the invention, the land-air amphibious rescue robot can quickly reach a high-rise fire scene and is suitable for an indoor complex environment, so that the rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Unmanned plane collaborative search and rescue-oriented track privacy protection and fault tolerance decision method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a track privacy protection and fault tolerance decision-making method for unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search and rescue, which aims at the track privacy leakage and pilot unmanned aerial vehicle single-point fault problems faced by unmanned aerial vehicle clusters in a complex open environment and provides the following technical scheme that an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster is initialized into a multi-agent system and a Markov decision-making process model of unmanned aerial vehicle cluster search and rescue tasks is constructed; the method comprises the steps of calculating a global optimal strategy by a piloting unmanned aerial vehicle through an optimization problem, maximizing a system expected cumulative reward, enabling the strategy not to be directly shared to member unmanned aerial vehicles to protect privacy, deriving a local strategy by the member unmanned aerial vehicles to ensure consistency with a global target by minimizing dependence on the piloting unmanned aerial vehicles, dynamically injecting noise to protect privacy of a state transition track by adopting a local state transition self-adaptive differential privacy mechanism, dynamically distributing the privacy budget based on the behavior credibility of the member unmanned aerial vehicles and determining a theoretical boundary of performance degradation, achieving dynamic balance of privacy protection and efficient cooperation, enabling the member unmanned aerial vehicles to execute actions according to the local strategy and the state transition matrix of the privacy protection to form a distributed decision mechanism, and enabling the system to converge to the global optimal decision under the strong privacy constraint by circularly training the optimization strategy. The invention effectively improves the cooperation capability and privacy protection efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster in the search and rescue task, and provides technical guarantee for the safe cooperation operation of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster in hostile environment.

title_en: Intelligent rescue method and system in tunnel or mine roadway based on emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent rescue method and system in a tunnel or a mine tunnel based on an emergency rescue robot, and relates to the technical field of tunnel or mine tunnel rescue, wherein the method comprises the following steps: three-dimensional modeling is carried out on a tunnel or a mine tunnel through an emergency rescue robot, a tensor matrix of each position in the tunnel or the mine tunnel is constructed, and the minimum eigenvalue of the tensor matrix is calculated; the method comprises the steps of initializing a plurality of first rescue paths, primarily screening the plurality of first rescue paths according to the minimum eigenvalue to form a plurality of second rescue paths, calculating path stability indexes for evaluating the stability of each second rescue path, sequencing the path stability indexes of all the second rescue paths, and finding out the second rescue path corresponding to the minimum path stability index to serve as a final rescue path of the emergency rescue robot. According to the technical scheme, the rescue path in the tunnel or the mine roadway can be accurately found, the dangerous area is avoided, and therefore the rescue task is completed.

title_en: Self-adaptive whole-body control method suitable for quadruped robot in uncertain dynamic environment
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a self-adaptive whole body control method suitable for a quadruped robot in an uncertain dynamic environment, the method integrates an Extended State Observer (ESO), a Model Predictive Controller (MPC) and a Whole Body Controller (WBC) based on hierarchical optimization, and builds a closed-loop control architecture to improve the robustness and the motion coordination capability of the quadruped robot in a complex environment. Firstly, estimating and compensating external disturbance in real time through ESO, then, rolling and optimizing future system behaviors by MPC under the condition of considering interference items, outputting expected foot end reaction force, and finally, generating each joint control instruction in a constraint optimization mode by combining priorities of a plurality of tasks by WBC, thereby realizing task coordination and dynamic adaptation. The method has the characteristics of strong disturbance self-adaptive capacity, high control precision, suitability for multi-task environments and the like, and is particularly suitable for four-foot robot control tasks under complex dynamic scenes such as transportation, search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Unmanned ship composite unmanned aerial vehicle three-dimensional search and rescue device and method
abstract_en: The application discloses a three-dimensional search and rescue device and method for an unmanned ship and a compound unmanned plane. The unmanned ship composite unmanned aerial vehicle three-dimensional search and rescue device comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle and an unmanned ship. The unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a machine body, a bracket, a camera and a laser radar, wherein the bracket is arranged at the bottom of the machine body, and the camera and the laser radar are arranged at the front part of the machine body. The unmanned ship comprises a ship body, a pressure sensor, an electromagnet and an electromagnet controller, wherein the upper surface of the ship body is provided with a connecting port, the pressure sensor and the electromagnet are embedded in the connecting port, and the electromagnet controller is arranged in the ship body and is electrically connected with the electromagnet. Wherein, unmanned aerial vehicle's support can dismantle with unmanned ship's connector and be connected. According to the application, through the detachable connection design of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle can be accurately put into a water falling point, the rescue response speed and efficiency are improved, the multi-mode sensing system is matched with the target recognition algorithm, the target can be quickly locked under complex sea conditions, and the unmanned aerial vehicle cooperate to effectively solve the problem of insufficient rescue efficiency.

title_en: High-rise building rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of special robots and discloses a high-rise building rescue robot which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle and an adsorption robot, wherein the adsorption robot is mounted at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle and forms a rescue platform by adsorbing the outer side of the high-rise building, the adsorption robot comprises a main frame, at least one multidirectional mechanical arm mechanism is arranged on the main frame, an attachable plane is adsorbed by the multidirectional mechanical arm mechanism and used for supporting the main frame, an electric winch mechanism is arranged on the other side of the main frame, and a rescue rope is transferred to a rotating hook of the unmanned aerial vehicle by rotation of the electric winch. The technical scheme has remarkable advantages in the aspects of deployment efficiency, platform stability, automation degree, composite function, safety guarantee, application range and the like, and provides a novel efficient and reliable technical means for rapid rescue in high-rise building fire and disaster environments.
assignees: QINGDAO HONGRI AUTOMOBILE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-joint connection type snake-shaped exploration and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multi-joint connection type snake-shaped exploration and rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of search and rescue robots and comprises a moving table, a driving wheel, universal joints and a traction table, wherein the driving wheel is rotatably inserted at two sides of the outer wall of the moving table, one end of each universal joint is fixedly arranged at two sides of the outer wall of the moving table, the other end of each universal joint is fixedly arranged at the outer wall of the traction table, an adjusting component is arranged at the outer wall of the traction table, the adjusting component comprises a hanging rod, a buffer frame, a damping, a mounting frame, a driving wheel group, a crawler, a linkage rod, a driving rod and a driving component, and the hanging rod is rotatably inserted at two sides of the outer wall of the traction table. Through the adjusting part, the adjustment of the working angle of the crawler belt at the bottom of the traction table can be realized, the crawler belt is ensured to be always at the optimal working angle, the trafficability of the crawler belt is convenient to improve under various environments, the contact area of the crawler belt is ensured to be always at the maximum state, and the pressure intensity to the ground is reduced.

title_en: Fire personnel intelligent search and rescue method and device based on infrared thermal imaging
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of infrared thermal imaging, and particularly discloses an infrared thermal imaging-based intelligent search and rescue method and device for fire personnel, which synchronously acquire fire scene data by using an infrared thermal imager and a laser radar to obtain infrared thermal imaging data and fire scene three-dimensional point cloud data, further introducing a data processing technology based on deep learning to perform feature extraction on infrared thermal imaging data and three-dimensional point cloud data of a fire scene so as to capture infrared thermal radiation distribution features and three-dimensional space structure features of the fire scene, and further capturing deep correlation features of the thermal distribution of the fire scene and the three-dimensional space by performing fine-granularity feature alignment joint perception on the infrared thermal radiation distribution features and the three-dimensional space feature, thereby realizing intelligent detection on human targets on the basis. By the method, the problem of splitting of thermal radiation information and space structure information in the traditional method can be effectively solved, the information utilization rate is improved, and the accuracy and efficiency of human body target identification are enhanced.

title_en: Ocean rescue navigation system based on dynamic environment modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine rescue navigation system based on dynamic environment modeling, which comprises a rear-end service platform and a rescue execution body, wherein the rescue execution body is provided with a plurality of rescue ships and a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, the rear-end service platform comprises an effective ratio calculation module, a judgment notification module and a judgment notification module, wherein the effective ratio calculation module is used for obtaining the number of additional search areas uploaded by all rescue execution bodies in a current rescue period and summing the number of the total area N1, obtaining the number of the additional search areas uploaded by all rescue execution bodies in the current rescue period and searching the rescue target and summing the number of the effective area N2, calculating the expanded effective ratio Z=N2/N1, and the judgment notification module is used for obtaining a preset ratio threshold Z1, and sending a regulation notification message if Z is not less than Z1 in the current rescue period. Not only can the timeliness be maintained, but also the system has stronger flexibility, thereby remarkably improving the success rate of search and rescue and optimizing the overall rescue efficiency.
assignees: HAINAN WEIZI GUIDE CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle base station RSSI positioning method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle base station RSSI positioning method and system based on deep learning, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle application. According to the method, a single unmanned aerial vehicle carries a base station, the RSSI signal intensity of a terminal and the GPS coordinates of the unmanned aerial vehicle are flown and collected according to a preset path, an RSSI-position data set is constructed, after filtering, standardization and feature extraction are carried out on the data, a mapping relation between the RSSI and the position is learned by using a deep neural network model, and high-precision positioning of the terminal is achieved. The system comprises an unmanned plane platform, base station equipment, a data processing unit and a model training unit, and supports edge-cloud collaborative learning. The invention creatively adopts a single unmanned aerial vehicle dynamic scanning technology, combines a CNN and LSTM hybrid model, solves the problems of high positioning cost and poor environmental adaptability of the traditional multi-base station, has the advantages of simple deployment, high positioning precision, good real-time performance and the like, and is suitable for terminal positioning requirements in complex scenes such as search and rescue, logistics, security and the like.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle group communication perception integrated method based on FMCW signal duty cycle modulation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of wireless communication and radar sensing, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle group communication sensing integrated method based on FMCW signal duty cycle modulation, which comprises the following steps of constructing an unmanned aerial vehicle group system of a master-slave architecture, comprising at least one master unmanned aerial vehicle and a plurality of slave unmanned aerial vehicles; the master control unmanned aerial vehicle integrates a multichannel radio frequency link, a signal processor and an advanced communication module, the slave unmanned aerial vehicle only configures a basic communication unit, three-level time slot communication frames are divided, each frame is divided into a sensing time slot, a downlink and an uplink, dynamic Chirp slope distribution is realized, communication coding based on a duty ratio is realized, communication sensing integration of unmanned aerial vehicle groups is realized through an ingenious technical scheme, the cost and the power consumption are reduced, the anti-interference capability and the communication efficiency of a system are improved, and powerful support is provided for application of small unmanned aerial vehicle groups in field investigation, collaborative search and rescue, border patrol and other scenes.

title_en: High-rise building fire-extinguishing rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to a fire-fighting and rescue robot for a high-rise building, which comprises a platform, a water pipe, a cradle head and a camera, wherein a plurality of blade assemblies are arranged at the top of the platform, a connecting frame is arranged at the bottom of the platform, the water pipe penetrates through the connecting frame, a water pipe connector is arranged at the rear end of the connecting frame, the water pipe is connected with one end of the water pipe connector, the other end of the water pipe connector is used for connecting a fire hose, a plurality of window breaking bullets are arranged on the platform or the connecting frame, the cradle head is arranged at the bottom of the connecting frame, and the camera is arranged on the cradle head. The invention integrates a flight platform, a window breaking device, a tripod head injection system and a visual perception module, realizes an integrated operation flow from fire detection, obstacle breakthrough to fire extinguishing operation, can realize continuous water supply for a long time, can cope with increasingly serious urban high-rise fire rescue challenges, and improves the automation, intellectualization and safety level of fire rescue.

title_en: Segmented unmanned aerial vehicle navigation system for improving ant colony algorithm combined reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a segmented unmanned aerial vehicle navigation system for improving ant colony algorithm joint reinforcement learning. First, with Received Signal Strength (RSS) used as a reference for navigation, the entire navigation process is divided into two phases of weak signal field and strong signal field flight by setting an RSS threshold. The problem of how to quickly position a distress source and plan a subsequent material distribution route in an emergency rescue scene is solved by using the unmanned aerial vehicle. Considering the influence of mountain bodies, environmental media and the like on signal propagation, when the distance from a distress source is far, the gradient change of the received signal strength is not obvious, so that the RSS is insufficient to support the navigation and route finding of the unmanned aerial vehicle in a weak signal field. The unmanned aerial vehicle navigation route searching process in the rescue scene is simulated in the experiment. The result shows that the invention improves the search and rescue efficiency in the unknown environment and shortens the optimal path length.
assignees: UNIV NANYANG NORMAL;XIAN SHUJU ZHANGYU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue robot adapting to multiple terrains
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a search and rescue robot adapting to multiple terrains, and relates to the technical field of robots. The robot comprises a robot body, a search and rescue detection assembly, a crawler assembly and a roller assembly, wherein the robot body comprises a frame, a power supply bin fixed on the upper part of the frame, an equipment bin fixed on the upper part of the power supply bin, a baffle fixed on the bottom of the side face of the power supply bin and a storage box fixed on the upper side of the baffle, the search and rescue detection assembly comprises a rotary table and a cradle head fixed on the rotating end of the rotary table, the crawler assembly comprises a crawler body, a driving wheel and an auxiliary wheel which are matched and arranged in the crawler body, and the roller assembly comprises a transmission disc, a mounting disc fixedly connected with the transmission disc through a support arm and a wheel assembled on the inner side of the mounting disc. The utility model combines the crawler belt component and the roller component, so that the robot can freely move in various complex terrains (such as mud, sand, gravel, grasslands and the like), and the application range and the practicability of the robot are improved.
assignees: JIANGSU CHENGGONG TECH CO LTD;ZHEJIANG CHENGSHI ROBOT CO LTD

title_en: Motion performance testing device for earthquake rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of earthquake rescue, in particular to a motion performance testing device for an earthquake rescue robot, which comprises a first platform (1), a second platform (2), an extension platform (3), a first stair (4) and a second stair (5), wherein the top end of the first stair (4) is connected with the first platform (1), the bottom end of the first stair is connected with a first side (201) of the second platform (2), the top end of the second stair (5) is connected with a second side (202) of the second platform (2), the bottom end of the second stair extends to the ground, the extension platform (3) is connected to a third side (203) of the second platform (2) in a reversible manner, the extension platform is provided with an extension platform first position extending from the second platform (2) to the outside in parallel and an extension platform second position overlapping the second platform (2), the first side (201) and the second side (202) of the second platform are connected, an angle between the first side (201) and the second side (202) of the second platform is 90-180 degrees, and the first side (201) and the third side (203) of the second platform (2) are arranged oppositely.

title_en: Vitality detection system for extreme conditions
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system that detects vitality by being mounted on an unmanned aerial vehicle (drone), which can be used in emergency operations, search and rescue activities, disaster management, and aims to save human lives. The system, which has the ability to visualize, detect and process the obtained data, also comprises a decision support unit (7) that supports decision-making processes in rescue operations by analyzing the collected and processed data. The artificial intelligence-supported decision support unit (7) recognizes emergency situations as a result of analysis and recommends the best action plan for rescue operations.

title_en: Police robot with door and window rapid breaking and dismantling rescue function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a police robot with a door and window rapid breaking and dismantling rescue function, which relates to the technical field of police rescue robots and comprises a rescue robot, wherein an auxiliary mechanism comprises a positive motor, a negative motor, two semicircular annular grooves and a clamp, a cable is wound on a winding wheel, one end of the cable is connected with a detonator, the surface of each first rectangular block is provided with a V-shaped groove in advance, a V-shaped medicine groove cover is arranged in each V-shaped groove, a flexible explosive is arranged in each V-shaped medicine groove cover, a communication hole is arranged in each V-shaped groove, and an electric switch is arranged around the winding wheel.
assignees: JIANGSU HEWEI POLICE EQUIPMENT MFG CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode water rescue robot cooperative control method and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-mode water rescue robot cooperative control method and a related device, and relates to the technical field of robot cooperative control, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a water area environment image acquired based on a visual sensor, distance and depth information of an underwater target determined based on a sonar sensor and position and speed information of the underwater target determined based on a radar sensor in a target water area; the method comprises the steps of determining a rescue target in a target water area according to multi-mode data, determining a rescue task of each rescue robot according to position information of the rescue target, the current position and the current state of each rescue robot and the current water area environment information, and determining an optimal path of each rescue robot reaching a matched rescue target position to execute cooperative rescue actions. According to the application, the target detection is carried out through the multisource sensing data, the accuracy of the target detection is improved, task allocation and path planning are carried out on a plurality of water rescue robots, and the cooperative control of the plurality of robots is realized.

title_en: Scaling ladder device for rescue and disaster relief
abstract_en: The invention relates to an aerial ladder device for rescue and disaster relief, which belongs to the technical field of rescue robots and comprises a moving platform and a telescopic device, wherein the telescopic device comprises a plurality of telescopic pipes with hollow inside and a plurality of driving blocks, the inner diameters of the telescopic pipes are different from each other, the telescopic pipes are coaxially sleeved and matched with each other from small to large according to the respective inner diameters, driving spaces exist between two adjacent telescopic pipes, the driving spaces are in one-to-one correspondence with the driving blocks, any driving block is arranged in the corresponding driving space, the driving block is coaxially connected with the telescopic pipe with the large inner diameter, the inner side wall of the driving block is in meshed connection with the outer side wall of the telescopic pipe with the small inner diameter, and the telescopic pipe with the largest inner diameter is rotatably carried on the moving platform.
assignees: DONGGUAN SENTO AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Efficient search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle mechanism with 11 propellers
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-efficiency search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle mechanism with 11 propellers, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, a propeller impeller 11, a small motor 11, a power notch 1, a gyroscope 1, an accelerometer 1, a compass 1, a barometer 1, a camera 1, a supporting leg 2 and a detection lamp 2. The unmanned aerial vehicle is characterized in that an unmanned aerial vehicle body is a fixed wing aircraft, 11 hollows are formed in the center of an unmanned aerial vehicle wing and the center of the unmanned aerial vehicle body, each hollow is traversed by a column for placing a small motor, and a propeller pusher is placed on the small motor. A detection lamp is respectively arranged in front of the wing, so that bright visual field can be given in the dark. A camera adopting an intelligent anti-shake technology is placed below the machine body and close to the head of the unmanned aerial vehicle, clear and stable images can be shot through cooperation with a detection lamp, and a gyroscope, an accelerometer, a compass, a barometer and the like are placed behind the camera and used for detecting information such as the gesture, the speed, the height and the environmental state of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the information can be fed back to a flight controller for analysis and control. Two ends are placed a supporting legs respectively in the middle of the unmanned aerial vehicle organism for support unmanned aerial vehicle steadily falls to the ground. The unmanned aerial vehicle organism afterbody position has a power notch for place the battery, supply electric power and ensure security and compatibility, the inside motor that connects through the wire of power and then for the screw impeller provides electric power makes it rotate.
assignees: ZHONGKE ANDUN SHANDONG ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Language model prompt construction and agent task planning method based on semantic graph
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of language models and intelligent agent perception control, provides a semantic scene graph-based language Prompt (Prompt) construction and task planning method, and solves the problems that a graph structure cannot be adapted to a language model and task planning lacks a perception closed loop in the existing system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining environment data through a multi-mode sensor and constructing a semantic scene graph, automatically generating a language prompt based on a semantic graph structure and used for guiding a language model to conduct natural language task planning, wherein the language prompt adopts a multi-level template generation mechanism, embeds 'room-object-attribute' information into a structural template to form a level semantic block of an environment section, a target section and an operation section, improves the expression capacity and generalization of the language model, and a planning result output by the language model is implemented by an execution module. The method establishes a closed loop path from the perception diagram to the language reasoning, and is suitable for a semantic task execution system under complex scenes such as unmanned aerial vehicle inspection, search and rescue, detection and the like.

title_en: Multi-domain collaborative ocean emergency rescue search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-domain cooperative marine emergency rescue and search method, which solves the technical problems of short endurance, small operation range and low accuracy of identifying difficultly encountered personnel existing in the prior art that unmanned aerial vehicles, unmanned vessels or underwater robots are adopted to implement search and rescue tasks, combines the unmanned aerial vehicles, the unmanned vessels and the underwater robots to cooperate with each other, the unmanned aerial vehicle performs detection and traversal in the air to find a search and rescue target, the unmanned aerial vehicle approaches the search and rescue target and sends the position information of the target to the control center, the unmanned ship sails to the target position, at least two underwater robots are transferred along with the unmanned ship, and the unmanned ship controls the at least two underwater robots to cooperatively operate. The invention can be widely applied to ocean deep sea emergency rescue and forms a novel air-sea-diving multi-domain collaborative paradigm.

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle adapting to complex terrain rescue
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles and discloses a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle suitable for complex terrain rescue, which comprises a machine body, wherein organic arms are fixed at four corners of the machine body, a folding paddle is arranged at the top of the organic arms, a set top box is arranged at the top of the machine body, a camera main body is arranged at the front end of the set top box, a fixing frame is fixed on the surface of the camera main body, and first shells are fixed on two sides of the fixing frame. This adaptation complicated topography rescue search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle drives the inside removal of slide bar to the second casing through pressing the plectane, makes the movable plate drive the fixture block break away from the inside of draw-in groove, can remove fixedly to first casing, is convenient for take out the front end of camera main part from the STB to the realization is convenient for dismantle fast and maintain the camera main part, has improved maintenance efficiency, reduces the maintenance and the maintenance expense of camera main part, prolongs the life of camera main part, and keeps its good operating condition.

title_en: Double-stage combined optimization method and system for task allocation and path planning of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract_en: The invention provides a double-stage combined optimization method and system for task allocation and path planning of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle path planning. The method realizes collaborative optimization of task allocation and path planning by constructing a novel three-dimensional multi-unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation and path planning dual-stage joint optimization framework, wherein the RL-TPTA algorithm in the task allocation stage can dynamically optimize the task access sequence by means of K-means clustering and reinforcement learning, so that the total flight distance of the unmanned aerial vehicle can be effectively reduced, the adaptability is higher in a large-scale task scene, the MSM-EABC algorithm in the path planning stage can jump out of local optimum and avoid three-dimensional environment collision risk efficiently through multi-strategy fusion, the advantages of the two-stage framework are combined, the path length can be obviously shortened in different-scale task scenes, the convergence efficiency and the running time are improved, the adaptability to complex three-dimensional environment is better, and the problem of task allocation and path planning coupling optimization in search and rescue after three-dimensional unmanned aerial vehicle cluster disaster is solved.

title_en: Post-disaster rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a post-disaster rescue robot, which adopts a storage box to store materials to be transported, and meanwhile, a kidnapping convenient for an unmanned aerial vehicle to hang air transportation is arranged, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can hang the robot and walk to a destination by the robot after the air transportation value is assigned to a position. The robot is controlled independently by the four walking modules, the flexibility is high, meanwhile, the walking modules can roll and walk through the first walking wheels and the second walking wheels, the moving speed is high, meanwhile, the walking arms can rotate, the whole frame can be lifted, the robot can adapt to roadblocks with different heights, and after the robot is lifted, the robot can roll and walk through the first walking wheels, and the walking speed is still high. When the robot cannot walk, the four walking arms are matched to realize a mode similar to the walking of a robot dog, so that the robot can adapt to going up and down stairs, grasslands and the like.

title_en: Search drone
title_ko: 수색용 드론
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 일실시예에 따른 수색용 드론은, 드론의 본체의 하방향으로 연장되어 상기 드론이 착륙시의 지면으로부터 상기 본체를 이격시키는 다리부, 상기 다리부를 둘러싸는 클램프부에 의해 고정되는 판부, 상기 판부 상면에 고정됨과 동시에 상기 본체와 결착되는 전력공급부, 상기 판부 하면에 고정되는 브라켓부, 상기 브라켓부에 고정되는 제1 보관함, 상기 제1 보관함 하면에 고정되는 제1 중심구조체 및 상기 제1 중심구조체에 일단이 결합되어 상기 드론의 하방 사선으로 연장되는 제1 주변구조체를 포함하는 제1 연결부, 상기 제1 주변구조체 타단에 결합되는 제2 보관함, 상기 제2 보관함에 결합되는 제2 중심구조체 및 상기 제2 중심구조체에서 일단이 양방향으로 연장되는 제2 주변구조체를 포함하는 제2 연결부, 상기 제2 주변구조체의 타단에 회전 가능하게 결합되고 조명부와 오디오부를 포함하는 조명방송모듈 및 상기 본체에서 하방으로 연장되어 결합되는 카메라부를 포함한다. 
본 발명에 따른 수색용 드론은 수색견에 무전기, 추적장비 및 카메라 장치 등을 탑재하고 드론에는 카메라, 서치라이트, 통신중계기, 무전기 및 스피커 등을 탑재하여, 드론이 수색견을 쫓아 수색 지점에서의 상황을 중계하고 수색견 또는 목표물을 향한 방송을 실시할 수 있도록 할 수 있으며 계곡등 통신 불가지역에서도 통신중계가 가능하다.

title_en: Visual wounded condition assessment device for three-dimensional reconstruction fusion of unmanned aerial vehicle thermal imaging video and AR glasses
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent rescue, and discloses a wounded injury visual assessment device for three-dimensional reconstruction fusion of unmanned aerial vehicle thermal imaging videos and AR glasses, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle perception system and AR interactive head display equipment, wherein a data processing module comprises a multi-source data access layer, a GPU (graphics processing unit) computing array, a high-speed storage pool, a fusion processing chip and a network exchange module, and a medical decision cloud platform comprises an infrastructure layer, a data middle layer, a knowledge middle layer, a decision engine layer and an application service layer. This unmanned aerial vehicle thermal imaging visual and AR glasses three-dimensional rebuild visual evaluation device of wounded's feeling that fuses realizes the integrative framework of sky and ground through unmanned aerial vehicle reconnaissance and the seamless connection of AR operation, eliminates information fault, and AR projects first aid guide and realizes initiative guide, effectively improves rescue personnel's search and rescue efficiency, adopts ecological cooperation technique access medical knowledge map and resource scheduling cloud platform, realizes detecting the closed loop of relief and treatment decision from the wounded feeling.
assignees: PANYU CENTRAL HOSPITAL AFFILIATED TO GUANGZHOU MEDICAL UNIV GUANGZHOU PANYU DISTRICT CENTRAL HOSPITA

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The application discloses a rescue robot, which relates to the field of rescue equipment, and comprises a main body frame, a travelling mechanism, a capturing mechanism and an ejection mechanism, wherein the rescue robot can be suitable for working conditions of rush repair and rescue, a target object (such as an obstacle, rescue substances and the like) is collected in front of the ejection push plate through two capturing arms, the ejection push plate is ejected forward by utilizing elastic energy stored by an elastic energy storage component, the ejection push plate drives the target object to be ejected forward to be ejected to a target area, and the rescue robot can perform rescue works such as obstacle breaking, rescue material transporting and the like in an obstacle-containing environment, and can avoid casualties of rescue workers when the rescue robot faces dangerous environments such as high temperature, toxicity, collapse and the like, so that the rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Helicopter rescue multifunctional lighting equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a helicopter rescue multifunctional lighting device which comprises a mounting frame and a connecting frame fixed on the inner wall of the top of the mounting frame, wherein a circular plate is arranged on the outer wall of the bottom of the connecting frame, a first searchlight and a first thermal infrared imager are respectively arranged at two ends of the outer wall of the bottom of the circular plate, a rotating pipe is rotatably arranged on the outer wall of the bottom of the mounting frame, and an adjusting component is inserted into the outer wall of one side of the rotating pipe. According to the utility model, the first searchlight and the first infrared thermal imager can be used for lighting and infrared appearance of the area right below the helicopter, the driving component can be used for driving the rotary tube to rotate, the auxiliary lighting component and the auxiliary infrared component are used for circularly lighting scanning and infrared scanning observation of the periphery of the area right below the helicopter, the search and rescue range is enlarged, and in the process, the angle of outward opening of the auxiliary lighting component and the auxiliary infrared component can be regulated by the regulating component, so that the search and rescue range is further enlarged and the search and rescue efficiency is improved.
assignees: JIANGSU UNISHINE GENERAL AVIATION CO LTD

title_en: Multimode forest fire detection and cooperative rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-mode forest fire detection and collaborative rescue robot, which belongs to the technical field of fire fighting and fire fighting, and comprises a machine body module, a crawler driving module, a mechanical arm module, an image acquisition module and a supporting module, wherein the crawler driving module is arranged at two ends of the machine body module, the mechanical arm module comprises a large mechanical arm and a small mechanical arm, the mechanical arm module is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the machine body module, the image acquisition module is fixedly arranged at the front end of the machine body module, the supporting module comprises a hydraulic rod, and the supporting module penetrates through the machine body module and is fixedly connected with the machine body module. The multimode forest fire detection and collaborative rescue robot provided by the invention can adapt to disaster environments, has high-efficiency searching and rescuing capability, and ensures the safety of fire fighters and disaster victims to the greatest extent.

title_en: Parallel electric digital processing robot search and rescue intelligent control system based on optical fiber communication
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue robots, in particular to an intelligent control system for searching and rescuing a parallel electric digital processing robot based on optical fiber communication, which comprises a robot body layer, a communication network layer, a control center layer and a data processing layer, wherein the invention realizes efficient disaster judgment and task scheduling through a multi-mode fusion model and an improved contract network protocol, the multi-mode fusion model can comprehensively analyze various disaster data such as a thermal imaging temperature field, a gas concentration gradient, a structural vibration spectrum and the like, the dangerous level is accurately divided, scientific basis is provided for task scheduling, task bidding is carried out based on a priority strategy, more robots can be timely allocated to rescue in a high-risk area, fewer robots are reasonably arranged in a low-risk area, so that rescue resource allocation is optimized, rescue efficiency and accuracy are improved, and unnecessary resource waste and casualties are reduced.
assignees: BORUI TAIKE TECH NINGBO CO LTD

title_en: Heterogeneous robot-oriented fusion light-weight language model multi-modal task understanding and tactical-based task sequence re-planning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of collaborative intelligence of robots and machines, in particular to a heterogeneous robot-oriented multi-modal task understanding and battle law-based task sequence re-planning method, which is used for constructing an emergency rescue field ontology library and a lightweight large language model based on a knowledge graph, dividing planning field language generation into task identification, task decomposition and ontology reduction, issuing task instructions to the heterogeneous robot by using the lightweight large language model to generate domain and problem file contents of PDDL language description, inputting the planning field language file generated by the lightweight large language model into an FF planner to generate an action sequence meeting requirements, and when the environment changes and the task cannot be completed, collecting detailed information of a current scene by the emergency rescue robot and sending the current state information to a command center. The invention can realize multi-mode task understanding under complex scenes, dynamic adaptation of heterogeneous systems and real-time tasks under sudden situations, and achieves the purposes of light weight and high robustness of emergency rescue.

title_en: Crawler-type search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a crawler type search and rescue robot, which belongs to the field of search and rescue robots and comprises a crawler type search and rescue robot body, wherein a bearing platform is arranged on the crawler type search and rescue robot body, a rotating motor is arranged on the bearing platform, the output end of the rotating motor is connected with a transmission rod, the top end of the transmission rod is provided with a height adjusting assembly, and the height adjusting assembly is detachably provided with a search and rescue exploration camera body. According to the crawler type search and rescue robot, the search and rescue exploration camera body arranged in the height adjusting assembly can be subjected to free height adjustment and angle adjustment, so that full-coverage search and rescue can be realized no matter high-altitude structures such as beam frames, platforms and low-lying areas such as collapsed ruins and ground cracks, and the search and rescue exploration camera body of different types or detection equipment of different sizes can be replaced and installed, so that full-direction search and rescue can be performed.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle flight control method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle flight control, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle flight control method and system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue platform, wherein the method comprises the steps of calculating the current gesture stability and wind resistance consumption of an unmanned aerial vehicle based on a preset time window, further obtaining an excess ratio and calculating a comprehensive wind resistance index, and judging a marked weak machine according to the excess ratio; and respectively calculating the traction force (the current traction force minus release amount) of the weak machine at the next moment and the traction force (the sum of the release amounts of the original traction force plus the weak machine is equal to or greater than the average increment) of the strong machine at the next moment, so as to finish the traction force redistribution of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle wind resistance capability is evaluated intelligently, the traction force distribution is adjusted dynamically, and the task execution stability and reliability of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster in the wind disturbance environment are improved obviously by combining accurate prediction and environment self-adaption, so that the task distribution is ensured to be more scientific and reasonable.

title_en: Robot cooperative control method and system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a robot cooperative control method and system based on edge calculation, comprising the steps of scanning a target environment by a robot, collecting data, constructing a cooperative map according to the collected data, dividing a resource pool according to the type of the robot, monitoring the resource state in the resource pool, carrying out resource allocation, generating a cooperative control strategy according to the cooperative map and the resource state by a model, splitting a search and rescue task into a plurality of subtasks, carrying out subtask task allocation according to the resource state of the subtasks by using an algorithm, collecting performance data of the robot when executing tasks, adjusting the strategy by using the performance data, setting a backup node, sending a signal to the backup node by the robot, monitoring a receiving signal in real time, identifying a fault node by the backup node, realizing dynamic scheduling and cooperative control of air-ground-cloud multi-domain resources by constructing the cooperative map, ensuring that the robot system efficiently executes the search and rescue tasks, and improving the utilization rate of the resources by cross-domain resource pooling.
assignees: CHENGXIN ZHILIAN WUHAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Water area positioning search and rescue method, system and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water area positioning search and rescue method, a system and related equipment, which comprise individual soldier terminal equipment, an unmanned aerial vehicle carrying end and a command end, wherein the individual soldier terminal equipment is used for being worn by rescue personnel and has the functions of automatic alarm, manual alarm, auxiliary search and rescue, near-field positioning and team formation, the unmanned aerial vehicle carrying end comprises a relay forwarding module, a signal scanning module and a target tracking module, and the command end can check acquired data of the individual soldier terminal, including personnel information, personnel position, map display, alarm information, equipment state electric quantity and signals. The water area positioning search and rescue method, system and related equipment can find out trapped or lost rescue workers at the first time, then send the positions of the trapped rescue workers to other rescue workers, prevent the key from being touched by mistake through the anti-misoperation component to interfere the use of individual soldier terminal equipment, and send out voice prompts through the team formation function of the individual soldier terminal equipment when the personnel after team formation are separated from the team to reach the set threshold range.
assignees: LANYUAN TIANDUN BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ocean environment multi-mode situation generation method based on panoramic rotation acquisition and spherical three-dimensional Gaussian reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for generating a multi-modal situation of a marine environment based on panoramic rotation acquisition and spherical three-dimensional Gaussian reconstruction. The method comprises the steps of synchronously obtaining visible light/infrared images, IMU attitude data, RTK positioning data and laser ranging data through an ocean photoelectric nacelle arranged on a ship mast or a shore-based observation tower, preprocessing a multi-mode image in a spherical coordinate system, directly constructing a three-dimensional Gaussian field under an ERP format based on spherical ray sampling, jointly optimizing Gaussian parameters by fusing color reconstruction loss, infrared consistency loss, laser ranging constraint loss, attitude constraint loss and shielding constraint loss, geographically registering the optimized point cloud to the coordinate system, generating a three-dimensional environment situation model containing a static structure and a dynamic target, and finally outputting the three-dimensional environment situation model to a ship navigation, port supervision and search and rescue task system. The invention has the advantages of breaking through the limitation of traditional two-dimensional monitoring and remarkably improving the reconstruction robustness, the multi-mode fusion capability and the service response efficiency in the marine complex environment.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle reinforcement learning target tracking method and device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle visual perception and intelligent control, and provides an unmanned aerial vehicle reinforcement learning target tracking method and device, wherein the invention strengthens human body characteristic characterization through a double-path fixed weight attention fusion module, the detection precision of targets with different distances is optimized by combining a multi-scale self-adaptive detection head, and meanwhile, direct mapping of visual detection to flight control is realized by adopting a depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm. By reconstructing the target detection framework and deeply integrating the reinforcement learning control strategy, the end-to-end real-time control capability is realized on the premise of ensuring the tracking precision. Along with the wide application of unmanned aerial vehicle technology in fields such as emergent search and rescue, security protection control, but intelligent tracking algorithm that combines deep learning and reinforcement learning wide application in disaster relief, public safety and sports event shooting field, promotes autonomous tracking and intelligent decision-making ability under the complex scene.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle black box electric quantity optimization method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of black box electric quantity optimization, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle black box electric quantity optimization method and system based on artificial intelligence, which are used for collecting residual electric quantity, voltage, internal resistance, temperature, geographic position and communication environment parameters after a crash signal is received by a black box, and constructing a state data set to sense the current working condition; and combining the feedback information of the search and rescue terminal to invert the position and infer the movement trend, so as to obtain the search and rescue trend progress. And then, calculating the maximum supportable signal transmission duration and times under the existing battery state and temperature conditions by using a feedforward neural network, and generating the electric quantity supportable parameters. On the basis of the parameters, a state vector of a reinforcement learning model is constructed, the influence of different sending strategies on electric quantity consumption and search and rescue efficiency is evaluated, an optimal electric quantity management strategy is output, and the duration of the black box is obviously prolonged on the premise that the search and rescue progress is not influenced.
assignees: GUANGDONG TIANYU CHUANGZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle sound source positioning search and rescue system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle sound source localization search and rescue system and method for mountain forest search and rescue tasks. The method comprises the steps of constructing a near-crown safe flight surface based on terrains and crowns and rasterizing an accessible area, landing sequential SMTs to multi-unmanned aerial vehicle mountain forest search and rescue tasks, accelerating track planning solving speed and enhancing availability of group search tasks, enabling unmanned aerial vehicles to fly along a set track, collecting data by an annular multi-microphone array and an IMU, generating a sound source probability heat map by combining an acoustic attenuation model, carrying out peak clustering on the heat map after the tasks are finished, and outputting candidate coordinates and priority lists to provide guidance for ground search and rescue personnel. The system consists of suspension vibration reduction, array sensing, embedded processing, wireless communication and independent power supply, and is modularized and fast-assembled. The measured average positioning error of the forest is 5.44 m at 21.05 hectares, the coverage efficiency is improved by about 3 times, and the unmanned aerial vehicle emergency search and rescue method is suitable for unmanned aerial vehicle emergency search and rescue.

title_en: Bionic rescue robot system with vision system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bionic multisection centipede type robot system with self-reconstruction capability for disaster relief. The system consists of an environment sensing module, a multi-mode decision module, a reconstruction execution module and a communication-energy management module. The hardware adopts a raspberry 4 B+raspberry Pico distributed architecture, realizes the rapid separation/recombination of multiple units through a magnetic butt joint device, completes the semantic segmentation and obstacle detection of disaster areas through DeepLabV & gt3 & MobileNetV & lt 3 & gt, extracts disaster time sequence characteristics through LSTM, and drives gait and reconstruction actions through PPO+DRL strategies. The system can complete autonomous obstacle surmounting, life body searching and task level reorganization in narrow space, broken wall and other extreme scenes. The invention also provides a complete control method and an embodiment, and the 'perception-decision-execution-feedback' closed loop can be realized without external manual intervention, so that the rescue response efficiency and the extreme environment adaptability of the robot are obviously improved.

title_en: Double-positioning search and rescue unmanned ship integrating electromagnetic net ring retraction and telescopic supporting harrow
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of offshore rescue, in particular to a double-positioning search and rescue unmanned ship integrating electromagnetic net ring retraction and telescopic supporting harrow. The device comprises a double-pontoon hull, wherein a main propulsion propeller is arranged in front of the bottom of the double-pontoon hull, an underwater positioning robot frame is arranged at the rear of the bottom of the double-pontoon hull, an underwater positioning robot is arranged in the underwater positioning robot frame, a fire rescue device for water falling is arranged at the upper part of the double-pontoon hull, an electromagnetic swimming ring retraction device is arranged at the front end of the upper part of the double-pontoon hull and is positioned at the upper part of the fire rescue device for water falling, a communication and positioning device is arranged at the rear of the upper end of the electromagnetic swimming ring retraction device, a wind driven generator and a solar panel are arranged in the middle of the upper end of the electromagnetic swimming ring retraction device, an electromagnetic throwing device is arranged at the front part of the double-pontoon hull, and a telescopic supporting rake is arranged at the middle position of the front parts of the electromagnetic swimming ring retraction device and the fire rescue device for water falling.

title_en: Search and rescue robot environment sensing method based on multi-task semantic recognition network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot environment sensing method based on a multi-task semantic recognition network, which relates to the field of search and rescue robots and comprises the following steps of acquiring RGB images and depth images of a search and rescue environment and constructing a multi-mode search and rescue data set; the method comprises the steps of performing multi-task semantic recognition network training and optimizing a model light strategy by combining transfer learning, wherein the multi-task semantic recognition network comprises an encoder and a decoder, the encoder comprises a double-flow parallel backbone network, a multi-level feature fusion module, a neck network decoder comprises a target detection branch, an obstacle semantic segmentation branch and a drivable channel segmentation branch, and the optimized multi-task semantic recognition network is deployed on a search and rescue robot to output environment perception results in real time. The method improves the precision of the environment perception of the search and rescue robot, effectively balances the real-time performance and the computing resource requirement, and enhances the adaptability and the robustness of the search and rescue robot in the scene after the sample is scarce and complex and varied.

title_en: Machine-ground ultraviolet range communication system
abstract_en: The system mainly comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, an unmanned wheeled vehicle, an onboard and ground end ultraviolet communication transceiver, a serial port transceiver antenna, a serial port USB inter-conversion module and a computer. The unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned wheeled vehicle are respectively used as aerial and ground communication carriers, and corresponding ultraviolet communication receiving and transmitting ends are mounted to realize the mutual conversion and interaction of ultraviolet signals and digital electric signals. The first serial port receiving and transmitting antenna on the unmanned wheeled vehicle is responsible for converting digital signals and electromagnetic wave signals, is in wireless connection with the second serial port receiving and transmitting antenna, and is connected with a computer through the serial port USB inter-conversion module. The computer can realize the comprehensive monitoring and control of the system and can send instructions, receive and analyze data in real time. The system utilizes ultraviolet vision communication, has strong anti-interference performance and good confidentiality, can meet the stable and efficient communication requirement between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned wheeled vehicle in a complex environment, and has important application value in the fields of military, search and rescue, special industrial monitoring and the like.

title_en: Post-disaster rescue robot-oriented control method and post-disaster rescue robot-oriented control system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of robot control, and discloses a post-disaster rescue robot control method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of continuously collecting pressure distribution data between a robot and a supporting surface and gesture data of a robot body; the method comprises the steps of analyzing pressure distribution data and gesture data in real time to detect whether unexpected trends indicating instability of a supporting surface or unbalance of the gesture of the robot exist, executing adjustment operation according to the unexpected trends when the unexpected trends exist, wherein the adjustment operation comprises adjustment of driving moment of the robot or adjustment of the gravity center position and/or gesture of the robot, and reporting the collected pressure distribution data and gesture data, the detected unexpected trends and the adjustment operation to a remote operator interface. The application can sense the tiny change generated by the interaction between the robot and the environment in real time, and adjust the tiny change in time, thereby effectively avoiding or relieving the secondary danger induced by the behavior of the robot and improving the rescue efficiency and safety.

title_en: Rescue robot flexible joint structure based on multi-field coupling driving and selective locking
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flexible joint structure of a rescue robot based on multi-field coupling driving and selective locking, and belongs to the technical field of rescue robots. The structure aims to solve the technical problems that the existing joint is difficult to consider high flexibility and high rigidity, mode switching is inflexible and energy consumption is high. The technical scheme is characterized in that the modularized design consisting of an outer flexible supporting layer, a middle multi-field coupling driving layer and an inner locking supporting layer is adopted, rapid and accurate joint movement is realized through cooperation of pneumatic and electric actuation, and a reversible locking mechanism of a magnetorheological or phase-change material is utilized to keep high rigidity after the action is completed without continuous energy supply. The invention effectively improves the adaptability, the operation flexibility and the task execution efficiency of the rescue robot in complex disaster environments, and simultaneously obviously reduces the energy consumption of the system.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle image-assisted wireless transmitter three-dimensional positioning method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a wireless transmitter three-dimensional positioning method and device based on unmanned aerial vehicle image assistance, wherein the method adopts an unmanned aerial vehicle to monitor images and received signal intensity of a wireless transmitter, acquires three-dimensional position coordinates of the transmitter, supports low-altitude economy, traffic monitoring, illegal wireless equipment detection and post-disaster search and rescue, extracts the level and pitch angle of the transmitter based on the received signal intensity and image recognition and a coordinate conversion method, respectively adopts a least square method to position the position of the wireless transmitter, and then uses a weight fusion positioning result, and adopts reinforcement learning to optimize positioning parameters such as weight of unmanned aerial vehicle track and data fusion according to unmanned aerial vehicle position, received signal intensity, signal arrival angle and energy consumption, so that positioning accuracy is improved, and unmanned aerial vehicle energy consumption is reduced.

title_en: AIS-based unmanned aerial vehicle search, rescue and throwing method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an AIS-based unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue throwing method and device, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of decoding AIS signals to obtain decoding information; the method comprises the steps of carrying out ship information screening analysis on decoding information based on a particle filtering algorithm to obtain target ship information, carrying out trajectory analysis and trajectory resolving processing on the target ship information to obtain trajectory resolving information, carrying out preprocessing on real-time wind field data, constructing a layered wind disturbance model based on the preprocessed real-time wind field data, carrying out correction and optimization on the trajectory information based on the trajectory resolving information and the layered wind disturbance model to obtain optimized trajectory information, and generating an execution trajectory instruction set by utilizing the optimized trajectory information smoothly based on a B spline curve to carry out unmanned plane search, rescue and throwing in combination with real-time control feedback. According to the invention, the trajectory correction control under wind field disturbance is realized, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle of the danger target is accurately thrown under the condition of complex sea conditions.
assignees: ZHONGSHAN FUKUN AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Self-adaptive machine learning method and system for large-scale search and rescue task based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a self-adaptive machine learning method and system for a large-scale search and rescue task based on an unmanned aerial vehicle. The method comprises the steps of collecting a large amount of search and rescue related data and storing the data in a database, training the data by using a machine learning algorithm, creating a model capable of adaptively learning new data, and integrating the model with an unmanned aerial vehicle system to automatically identify a search and rescue target and provide real-time feedback. The system comprises a database, a machine learning algorithm, an unmanned aerial vehicle system and a monitoring module, and can automatically adjust and improve the self-adaptive model. The self-adaptive machine learning method and the self-adaptive machine learning system can improve the efficiency and the accuracy of large-scale search and rescue tasks and provide better guarantee for search and rescue of human beings and animals.
assignees: ZHONGKE ANDUN SHANDONG ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: System and method for joint communication and illumination through unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract_en: Visible light communication (VLC) enabled unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have evolved as a promising technology for the fifth generation and beyond communications. The proposed invention describes a system and methodology for deploying VLC-enabled UAVs, which serve as flying base stations (V-FBSs) over the target area: disaster regions, concert and fest areas, and search and rescue operations zones. The V-FBSs provide both communication and illumination. The proposed system follows CRAN architecture, which helps reduce the CAPEX and OPEX significantly. Further, present disclosure delivers a complete method to deploy the V-FBS network along with the detailed synchronization process required for autonomous deployment. It offers a complete 3-D deployment of the V-FBSs, which ensures minimum interference while satisfying the promised QoS and providing an energy-efficient position. The proposed network is scalable and can significantly reduce the outage. Since VLC is used for the present invention, the network does not interfere with the neighboring RF networks.

title_en: Marine emergency search and rescue path planning method, system and medium considering shipborne unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a marine emergency search and rescue path planning method, a system and a medium considering a shipborne unmanned aerial vehicle, and belongs to the field of path planning methods. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an unmanned aerial vehicle global access sequence starting from a fixed starting point and ending at a terminal point, enabling each search and rescue responsibility area to be covered by only one unmanned aerial vehicle, classifying according to unmanned aerial vehicle endurance and responsibility area position distribution, using a nested search algorithm to cooperatively optimize unmanned aerial vehicle release and recovery position sequences of ships with minimum task time as a target, generating a path scheme, verifying feasibility of the scheme through multidimensional constraint, and iterating and optimizing again if verification fails. The path planning scheme generated by the method obviously reduces the completion time of the offshore emergency search and rescue task, effectively improves the response efficiency of the offshore emergency search and rescue system, and provides powerful support for the efficient operation of the emergency search and rescue organization.

title_en: Multifunctional emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency rescue equipment, and discloses a multifunctional emergency rescue robot which comprises an all-terrain crawler, wherein a bottom mounting plate is mounted at the bottom of the all-terrain crawler, a special-shaped box body matched with the inner structure of the all-terrain crawler is mounted at the middle front part of the top end of the bottom mounting plate, side guard plates are mounted on two sides of the special-shaped box body, and two sides of the side guard plates are respectively connected with corresponding positions on the inner side of the all-terrain crawler. By adding and arranging the isolation dilution mechanism, when facing to fire disaster caused by leakage of liquefied petroleum gas in petrochemical factories, high-temperature and high-pressure steam sprayed by the mechanism can not only quickly dilute the concentration of the liquefied petroleum gas in a closed or semi-closed space and reduce the possibility of reaching an explosion limit, but also effectively block the spread of fire to peripheral equipment through a water curtain barrier formed by the steam, thereby creating a safe buffer area for the rescue robot and subsequent treatment.

title_en: Multipurpose miniature tethered unmanned aerial vehicle system
abstract_en: A multipurpose miniature tethered unmanned aerial vehicle system comprises a miniature tethered unmanned aerial vehicle, ground equipment and a task load. The invention can carry out communication of a target area in a complex area for a long time, can realize uninterrupted real-time monitoring under the condition of continuous power supply in an important area, is quick in maneuvering, flexible in use, durable in endurance and convenient to ensure, has the altitude flight capability of the maximum take-off and landing altitude of 5000m, and can realize search and rescue and communication of multiple weather in the whole day. The method has the advantages of good plateau environment adaptability, diversified task loads, optional mounting of photoelectric detection equipment and relay equipment, realization of monitoring and communication functions by mounting different equipment, and disaster search and rescue and relay communication task execution. The invention is applicable to different environments and topography conditions, meets the requirements of different occasions, has small system scale and can be carried by two persons. The invention has the advantages of strong loading capacity, long endurance time, small system scale, flexibility, altitude lifting capacity, short preparation time, quick lift-off, repeated use and lower cost.
assignees: CHONGQING JIALING HUAGUANG OPTOELECTRONICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Low-altitude autonomous drone for search and rescue
title_ko: 수색 및 구조를 위한 저고도 자율비행 드론
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 수색 및 구조를 위한 저고도 자율비행 드론은, 장애물의 거리와 형태를 측정하여 주변 환경을 3차원으로 인식하는 깊이 카메라와, 상기 깊이 카메라의 정보를 기반으로 Fast-Planner 알고리즘을 이용하여 경로를 계획하는 경로 계획 알고리즘 처리부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KUMOH NAT INST TECHNOLOGY IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Disaster-prevention rescue positive-pressure type explosion-proof quadruped robot and detection method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency rescue robots and discloses a disaster prevention and rescue positive pressure type explosion-proof quadruped robot and a detection method thereof, wherein the robot comprises a machine body frame, a driving module, an energy module, a navigation module, a detection module, an emergency material box and a positive pressure explosion-proof system, and a driving motor and the energy module of the robot adopt a positive pressure type explosion-proof design; the transmission module comprises a four-foot driving mechanism and an intelligent control system, the robot walks on the ground through four mechanical legs, the stability of the four mechanical legs is realized by utilizing an intelligent control algorithm, the navigation module integrates UWB, inertial navigation and mine radio pulse signal positioning, the detection module is provided with an expandable environment sensor for detecting various complex terrains, the emergency material box can provide rescue materials such as water, food and the like, the robot can realize the explosion prevention of main components, and meanwhile, the detection rescue of rugged road sections can be carried out, the detection efficiency of the environment after underground disaster is improved, and the safety of underground personnel is ensured.

title_en: Can follow formula air-ground cooperation intelligent rescue robot
