abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of disaster relief, in particular to a following type air-ground cooperative intelligent relief robot, which comprises a spherical robot, wherein a storage bin for placing first-aid materials and equipment is arranged on the spherical robot, a movement sphere for controlling the movement of the spherical robot is arranged on the spherical robot in a matched mode, a balanced movement steering engine device is arranged in the movement sphere, and an unmanned cabin with an unmanned aerial vehicle is arranged at the top end of the spherical robot. According to the utility model, the movement of the spherical robot is controlled by changing the internal weight distribution, and the robot is assisted by the movable wheel, so that the flexibility of the robot in movement is improved, the dynamic and surrounding environments of rescue workers are observed and captured through the camera vision module, the close-fitting service of the robot to the rescue workers in disaster rescue is further ensured, the scene of the disaster is captured and photographed through the unmanned aerial vehicle, the rapid deployment and support are provided, and the rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle dynamic path planning method considering marine environment change
abstract_en: The application discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle dynamic path planning method considering marine environment change, and belongs to the field of path planning. The method updates strong convection intensity, storm moving track and ship position in real time through satellite communication, positions a re-planning starting point in millisecond level, generates diversified new path populations, and rapidly outputs safe and feasible paths through limited evolution, and further dynamically calculates path dangerous cost, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle actively bypasses the sudden high risk area. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device effectively solve the problem of path failure caused by environmental mutation in the maritime search and rescue scene, and can remarkably improve the safety and efficiency of tasks.

title_en: Flexible bending module based on Ji Cun paper folding and dielectric hydraulic driving and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible bending module based on Jicun paper folding and dielectric hydraulic driving and a control method, and belongs to the field of soft robots. The flexible bending module comprises a Jicun paper folding structure, flexible dielectric hydraulic units and an open-close type dielectric hydraulic unit, wherein dielectric hydraulic drive units are respectively arranged on the inner side and the outer side of the Ji Cun paper folding structure, the stack of the dielectric hydraulic units is stretched when the power is on, the stack is shortened when the power is off, the paper folding structure is driven to stretch, and the open-close type dielectric hydraulic units on the outer side open the angle by connecting the included angles of the two flexible paper folding units, reduce the included angle when the power is off, and drive the stretching and bending of the paper folding structure. The dielectric hydraulic driving units in three directions can independently control the on-off of power through the control circuit so as to realize the deflection control with three degrees of freedom. The invention has the advantages of multi-degree-of-freedom flexibility, rigid-flexible coupling, modularized independence and the like, and can be applied to the fields of post-disaster search and rescue, pipeline crawling soft robots and the like.

title_en: Portable urgent search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable emergency search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles and comprises a machine body, wherein an organic arm is arranged on the side wall of the machine body, a disassembling component is arranged in the machine body, and a contracting component is arranged in the machine body; according to the utility model, the dismounting assembly is arranged, the telescopic spring extrudes the fixed ring on the positioning rod, the fixed ring drives the positioning rod to move in the partition plate, at the moment, the positioning rod moves on the inclined surface of the resistance rod under the action of the inclined surface of the resistance rod, the horn is pulled out of the moving frame at the moment, the horn drives the propeller to synchronously move, the rest of the horn is dismounted from the moving frame in the same way, when the unmanned aerial vehicle is not in use, the horn can be easily dismounted, the occupied space of the unmanned aerial vehicle can be greatly reduced, the unmanned aerial vehicle is easier to carry and store, when a certain horn of the unmanned aerial vehicle is damaged, the damaged part can be quickly dismounted and replaced, and the maintenance time and cost can be reduced.
assignees: SICHUAN DONGTENG WEIYE TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Implement rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an implement rescue device, which comprises a search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein a placement box is fixedly connected to the bottom of the search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, a control terminal is fixedly connected to the front position of the bottom of the inner wall of the placement box, a high-definition camera is electrically connected to the input end of the control terminal, the top of the high-definition camera is fixedly connected with the middle position of the bottom of the placement box, and an electric motor is fixedly connected to the front position of the bottom of the placement box. According to the utility model, the miniature water pump is started at first, the cleaning liquid is sprayed to the high-definition camera, the electric motor is started at the same time, the semicircular rod and the cleaning soft brush rotate around the high-definition camera, the electric motor reversely rotates after the semicircular rod rotates for one hundred eighty degrees by taking the rotating shaft as the circle center, the output end of the electric motor drives the semicircular rod to reversely rotate for one hundred eighty degrees, and the cleaning is repeated, so that the cleaning liquid and the cleaning soft brush can be utilized to clean the high-definition camera, and the effect of good cleaning effect is achieved.
assignees: SHANGHAI SHENZHOU JINGYI AUTOMOBILE MFG CO LTD;JINGHUAN ENV SANITATION BRANCH SHANGHAI JINGAN URBAN DEVELOPMENT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Moving target space-sky cooperative tracking method and system suitable for civil maritime search and rescue
abstract_en: The invention provides a moving target space-sky cooperative tracking method and a moving target space-sky cooperative tracking system suitable for civil maritime search and rescue, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining accident occurrence places and environmental parameters; the method comprises the steps of constructing a drift model of a lost ship and a person falling into water based on accident places and environmental parameters, obtaining predicted positions and instantaneous speeds of targets to be tracked updated according to time steps, screening applicable unmanned aerial vehicles and satellites according to the environmental parameters, obtaining parameter data of the applicable unmanned aerial vehicles and the satellites, obtaining satellite position updated according to time based on the satellite parameter data, loading the applicable unmanned aerial vehicles and the satellites and the parameter data of the satellites and the satellite position updated according to time into a trained space-sky collaborative reinforcement learning model, inputting the predicted positions and the instantaneous speeds of the targets to be tracked updated according to time steps, and outputting a collaborative tracking strategy.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle reinforcement learning path planning method integrating dynamic uncertainty perception
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle reinforcement learning path planning method integrating dynamic uncertainty perception, which belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous path planning and comprises the steps of constructing a city low-altitude simulation environment, calculating an unmanned aerial vehicle estimated position and an uncertainty matrix based on the city low-altitude simulation environment, constructing a 3D Gaussian probability distribution according to the unmanned aerial vehicle estimated position and the uncertainty matrix, calculating the collision probability of an unmanned aerial vehicle by combining Monte Carlo sampling, calculating rewards according to the collision probability of the unmanned aerial vehicle, maximizing accumulated entropy reinforcement rewards by adopting a strategy pi, and performing strategy learning by utilizing a Soft Actor-Critic, and further outputting an unmanned aerial vehicle path planning optimal control instruction. The method focuses on the urban complex environment, integrates dynamic uncertainty perception and reinforcement learning technologies, solves the problems of unmanned aerial vehicle positioning errors, obstacle collision risks and the like, realizes safe and efficient path planning, and is suitable for unmanned aerial vehicle application scenes requiring autonomous navigation, such as logistics transportation, post-disaster search and rescue and the like.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method based on regional three-dimensional grid modeling assistance
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle search and rescue method based on regional three-dimensional grid modeling assistance comprises the steps of image feature extraction and matching, image preprocessing, ORB feature point extraction, error matching through interframe matching and RANSAC elimination, camera pose estimation through a PnP method, point cloud map preliminary construction, sparse point cloud generation based on pose and matching point triangulation, preliminary optimized point cloud map output through reprojection optimization and redundancy filtering, image semantic segmentation and target recognition, image segmentation and image recognition, three-dimensional coordinate recognition, suggestion of marking semantic point set, high-priority marking, coordinate and semantic label fusion to form semantic map points on a grid unit, regional three-dimensional grid model construction, GRU multipath error model division and vertical layering, regional three-dimensional grid model adjustment, matching of unmanned aerial vehicle positions to grid layers, pseudo range positioning correction after dynamic judgment of model availability, and human body target accurate position calculation in combination with semantic target coordinates.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster disaster search and rescue task allocation method based on improved particle swarm algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster disaster rescuing task allocation method based on an improved particle swarm algorithm, which comprises the steps of S1, constructing a cost function according to a comprehensive advantage matrix and a rescuing efficiency matrix, S2, solving a particle individual adaptation value in the particle swarm algorithm according to the cost function, S3, calculating an individual historical optimal position and a global historical optimal position according to the individual adaptation value, S4, updating an initialization speed vector of a particle individual according to the individual historical optimal position and the global historical optimal position to obtain an updated speed vector, S5, obtaining an updated position vector according to the updated speed vector, dynamic weight and the initialization position vector of the particle individual, S6, obtaining a task allocation result when a preset termination condition is met, and otherwise, returning to S2. The invention solves the problems of uneven resource allocation, adapts to complex conditions such as dynamic update, multi-unmanned aerial vehicle cooperation, multi-task conflict and the like, and improves the overall rescue success rate.

title_en: Dual-mode fusion maritime personnel search and rescue device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of marine emergency rescue equipment, in particular to a double-mode fusion maritime personnel search and rescue device which comprises a tugboat, a search and rescue yacht, an unmanned aerial vehicle, a visible light camera, a sea sweeping lamp, an infrared thermal imaging camera, a radar, a Beidou positioning system and a command center, wherein the visible light camera, the sea sweeping lamp, the infrared thermal imaging camera, the radar and the Beidou positioning system are arranged on the tugboat and the search and rescue yacht, the visible light camera, the sea sweeping lamp and the infrared thermal imaging camera are arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the command center is used for receiving information and images of the tugboat, the search and rescue yacht and the unmanned aerial vehicle and carrying out search and rescue according to the received information and image control. The tug, the search and rescue yacht and the unmanned aerial vehicle are mutually matched, so that a target can be quickly searched in a larger range, the time for finding people falling into water is greatly shortened, precious time is striven for timely rescue, and the search and rescue success rate and the rescue efficiency are improved.
assignees: SHANDONG HAIWAN PORT TUG & LIGHTER CO LTD

title_en: Bee colony navigation method and system based on multisource grouping-evidence fusion
abstract_en: A bee colony navigation method and system based on multisource grouping-evidence fusion belong to the technical field of multi-robot collaborative search and environment perception. The method can search in parallel in a multi-source environment through a grouping-sharing mechanism, and obviously improves the multi-source recall rate. And the robustness of the algorithm to odor intermittence, turbulence disturbance and model mismatch is enhanced through the combination of IP evidence and multi-model Bayesian fitness, and the false detection rate is reduced. Finally, through virtual potential field navigation, the accessibility and the safety of a search path are ensured, and search failure caused by obstacle or cooperation conflict is avoided. The method is suitable for multiple fields of industrial leakage detection, environmental pollution monitoring, dangerous goods search and rescue, public safety monitoring and the like, and has wide application prospect.

title_en: Unmanned plane closed loop intelligent collaborative search and rescue method and device
abstract_en: In order to solve the problems of information fracturing, low efficiency and poor shallow analysis adaptability of the traditional segmented search and rescue process, the invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle closed loop intelligent collaborative search and rescue method and device, wherein the method realizes high-efficiency data acquisition through task-driven self-adaptive multispectral acquisition, utilizes a lightweight AI to analyze high-altitude multispectral data in real time, automatically discovers a potential target and triggers close-up detailed search; based on a spectrum-space feature depth fusion network, multi-source features are fused through a multi-level cross-channel attention fusion module, weak targets which are difficult to detect by a single sensor are accurately identified, and a multi-mode rescue path which takes security and efficiency into consideration is generated by combining multi-dimensional dynamic risk perception and three-dimensional terrain modeling, quantifying environmental risks in real time and superposing the environmental risks to a digital surface model. The invention designs an unmanned aerial vehicle intelligent search and rescue mode based on a 'perception-decision-action-learning' closed loop, and the target recognition precision, response speed and dynamic risk coping capacity under a complex environment are obviously improved.

title_en: Personnel search and rescue method after earthquake disaster and related device
abstract_en: The application discloses a post-earthquake disaster personnel search and rescue method and a related device, and relates to the technical field of post-earthquake disaster personnel search and rescue, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of randomly dividing a target area into a plurality of subareas, generating a search and rescue path based on the seismic source position of the target area and the seismic magnitude and personnel density of each subarea, determining whether disaster-stricken personnel exist in the subareas and the position information of the disaster-stricken personnel when the disaster-stricken personnel exist on the basis of infrared thermal imaging images and radar echo signals of the subareas in the process of controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly along the search and rescue path to a path node corresponding to one subarea, performing three-dimensional reconstruction on the subarea based on SAR images of the subareas if the disaster-stricken personnel exist, obtaining a three-dimensional terrain model of the subareas, marking the position information of the disaster-stricken personnel in the three-dimensional terrain model, and obtaining a search and rescue indication model for guiding the search and rescue process of the subareas. The application can improve the search and rescue efficiency of personnel after earthquake disaster.

title_en: Low-energy-consumption hexapod robot with screw and rope drive coupled and motion control method
abstract_en: A low-energy-consumption hexapod robot with a screw rod and a rope drive coupled and a motion control method relate to the field of robot design. The existing six-foot robot adopts multi-motor cooperative control, and the problems of control difficulty and structural complexity are increased. The leg mechanism is provided with six leg mechanisms which are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the machine body from front to back, the thigh driving mechanisms are arranged in the machine body from front to back and are symmetrically arranged in the machine body from left to right, each thigh driving mechanism can drive the three leg mechanisms on the same side to move back and forth, each leg mechanism corresponds to one calf driving mechanism, and the calf driving mechanism can transmit rectilinear motion generated by the thigh driving mechanisms to the lower leg so as to drive the lower leg to lift or drop. The invention is mainly used for executing tasks in complex environments such as post-disaster search and rescue, field exploration, planet detection and the like.

title_en: Rescue robot path planning method and system based on sound source localization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue robot path planning method and system based on sound source localization, and relates to the technical field of robot path planning, wherein the method collects rescue environment audio data in a stereo format in real time; the method comprises the steps of analyzing acoustic characteristics of rescue environment audio data by adopting a pre-training sound source positioning model, outputting sound event types and position data contained in the audio, determining a rescue target according to an output result of the pre-training sound source positioning model, fusing data acquired by a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain an environment model of a rescue area, formulating a rescue route of the rescue robot by adopting a secondary optimization path planning algorithm based on the position information of the rescue target and the environment model of the rescue area, and realizing dynamic obstacle avoidance in a moving process of the robot by adopting a dynamic window method. The problem of insufficient planning accuracy of the rescue robot path in the post-disaster environment with limited vision is solved, a method for determining rescue target position information from an auditory sense is expanded, and the planning efficiency of the robot path is improved.
assignees: JIANGSU SANMING ZHIDA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle intelligent path planning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for planning an intelligent path of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which are applied to a human body target search and rescue task in a forest environment in rainy and snowy weather, and comprise the following steps: S1, acquiring real-time image data through a multi-mode sensing module carried on the unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the multi-mode sensing module is used for acquiring visible light images, thermal infrared images and environmental meteorological data, and carrying out rain and snow degradation removal processing on the visible light images to reconstruct clear images, wherein the thermal infrared images are used for enhancing the human body heat source recognition capability under low-temperature rain and snow environments.

title_en: Infrared dense weak and small target detection method based on background semantics and cross-task feature interaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an infrared dense weak and small target detection method based on background semantics and cross-task feature interaction, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a DENSESIRST infrared image dataset with background semantics annotation, introducing a pixel-level sky background segmentation mask, and improving the perception capability of a model on background context. Then, a double-branch network architecture named BAFE-Net is provided, a detection and semantic segmentation collaborative learning mode is adopted, a characteristic channel with strong task discrimination is extracted through a dynamic channel selection mechanism, and a characteristic adapter is introduced to realize explicit channel replacement between two tasks, so that the distinguishing capability of a model on a real target and a false alarm under a complex scene is enhanced. The method obtains excellent detection precision and recall expression on DENSESIRST infrared detection reference data sets, can obviously reduce false alarm rate, and is particularly suitable for application scenes of multi-target dense distribution, complex background and false alarm interference in infrared images, such as the infrared vision fields of security and protection, airspace monitoring, night search and rescue, unmanned system navigation and the like.

title_en: Underwater SLAM method and system combining regional level descriptor and LSH retrieval
abstract_en: An underwater SLAM method and system combining regional level descriptors and LSH retrieval belongs to the technical field of autonomous navigation of underwater robots, and solves the problems that dead reckoning errors can accumulate along with time due to the particularity of underwater environments, the traditional SLAM method lacks an effective position sensing mechanism to inhibit the drift and an effective pretreatment mechanism to improve the image quality. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a polar coordinate image, preprocessing, obtaining a priori pose of a current key frame, inputting the priori pose into a position sensing ICP, sequentially scanning and matching point clouds of adjacent key frames, establishing a sequence constraint relation, extracting occupied areas from the point clouds of historical key frames, constructing an area descriptor, conducting neighbor retrieval, screening candidate key frames, verifying matching, generating effective loop constraint, constructing a factor graph, conducting global graph optimization, accumulating and updating the environmental point clouds, and generating an underwater environment map. The invention is suitable for the underwater robot in the scenes of marine exploration, environment monitoring, search and rescue operation and the like.

title_en: Remote modular data collection and uas docking system and method
abstract_en: A remote modular data collection system and method are disclosed, which in one or more embodiments, employs a plurality of data collection pods, which are interspersed within a geographical region and in communication with a remote control station. The pods include a variety of sensors adapted for particular purposes and may be arranged to preprocess data using artificial intelligence prior to transfer to the remote station and for autonomous operation. The pods are mountable on poles and other structures. In some embodiments, the pods are modular in design and construction, allowing quick installation and replacement of optional modules to satisfy particular data collection purposes. The pods may include integrated solar panels for flexible or redundant power purposes. In some embodiments, one or more pods each house an unmanned aerial vehicle, the sensors of which are integrated into the system and which allow for comprehensive on-demand data collection throughout the entirety of the geographical area. These pods include a hangar bay with a selectively retractable opening and charging pad for launching, recovery, storage, and charging of the unmanned aerial vehicle. The system may be used for terrestrial and/or extraterrestrial purposes, and it has particular application in security, military, environmental, law enforcement, and search and rescue operations, as well as an early detection and warning system.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle thermal imaging visual target detection method for search and rescue tasks
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of target detection, in particular to a search and rescue task-oriented unmanned aerial vehicle thermal imaging visual target detection method which comprises the following steps of acquiring unmanned aerial vehicle multi-frame thermal imaging images, extracting region thermal difference characteristics according to windows, marking non-background regions to generate candidate sets, fitting and reconstructing suspected thermal target contours, analyzing tracks and thermal rate to screen background interference, identifying jump abnormality and positioning gravity centers, and generating target repositioning signals. According to the invention, the thermal anomaly area is judged by constructing the thermal value range and variance index sequence in the image area and combining the temperature baseline difference, the background disturbance comparison is carried out by combining the direction vector of the coordinate track in the multi-frame image and the thermal change parameter, the false detection probability caused by background noise is reduced, the target jump recognition is carried out according to the inter-frame heat value and the area change rate linkage thermal contour closure degree, the target discrimination accuracy in the shielding scene is improved, and the robustness of thermal target extraction in the complex search and rescue environment is integrally improved.

title_en: Ground search and rescue robot sharing control method based on multi-level man-machine instruction fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a ground search and rescue robot sharing control method based on multi-level man-machine instruction fusion, which comprises the following steps that after a task level instruction sent by a human is received, a robot performs global optimal path search; and if the risk value is greater than or equal to the threshold value, the behavior level instruction is not responded, otherwise, the behavior level instruction is executed, and after the execution is finished, the nearest path point recovery task in the global path is searched. And after receiving the action level instruction sent by the human operator, dynamically distributing the man-machine authority according to the calculated risk value to generate an optimal control instruction. The invention can dynamically balance autonomous planning and manual intervention, improves the adaptability of complex scenes, reduces the burden of operators and avoids the efficiency loss caused by high-frequency micro-operation.

title_en: Walking type emergency rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of emergency rescue, and discloses a walking type emergency rescue robot which comprises an emergency rescue robot main body, wherein a walking crawler belt is arranged below the emergency rescue robot main body, a picture collecting and monitoring head is arranged above the emergency rescue robot main body, and an adjusting mechanism is arranged between the emergency rescue robot main body and the picture collecting and monitoring head. This walking emergency rescue robot through setting up picture collection control head and adjustment mechanism for this robot is carrying out emergency rescue operation time, and staff's accessible picture collection control head carries out remote observation to the rescue scene, and can be through carrying out suitable regulation to the height and the angle of fire extinguishing agent shower nozzle to the operation of electronic slide with adjustment motor, makes fire extinguishing agent can accurately spout to the fire point, in order to improve the fire extinguishing efficiency of this robot in emergency rescue operation, has improved this emergency rescue robot's practicality.
assignees: XIAN PENGPAI YUEDONG ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned plane patrol-oriented flight and scanning coordination control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flight and scanning coordination control method for unmanned aerial vehicle patrol, and belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle patrol. The invention is divided into a planning phase, a transmission phase and an operation phase. And in the planning stage, planning the unmanned aerial vehicle route and the camera scanning route according to map data, task demands and flight constraints. In the transmission stage, the ground end uploads hexadecimal codes of the route information and the camera scanning route information, and decodes the camera scanning route information into decimal data as a control input. In the working stage, the flight control system controls the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly along a set route and executes hovering operation at the waypoints with scanning lines, and meanwhile, the airborne control terminal controls the scanning process of the camera based on the camera motion control model. According to the invention, through overall planning and control of the unmanned aerial vehicle route and the camera movement route, the patrol efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle is improved, and an efficient and innovative patrol scheme is provided for scenes such as forest fire prevention, search and rescue, regional warning and the like.
assignees: THE 54TH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: Rescue path planning method for search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue robot rescue path planning method, which comprises the steps of firstly, carrying out nonlinear self-adaptive adjustment on a path optimizing strategy by introducing a double-perception system based on population information entropy and optimizing progress, secondly, carrying out orthogonal coordination on social level guidance of a gray wolf algorithm and a speed disturbance mechanism of a simplified meteorological optimizing model, realizing self-adaptive fusion of the two strategies by evolutionable individual weights, and then carrying out iterative optimization based on the combination of the gray wolf optimizing mechanism and the simplified meteorological optimizing model on a candidate path scheme to generate an optimal rescue path. According to the invention, the path searching strategy can be dynamically adjusted through the real-time perceived optimizing state, intelligent balance is achieved between global exploration and local development, the convergence speed, the path quality and the robustness of path planning of the search and rescue robot in a complex environment are remarkably improved, and the reliability and the safety of the planned path are improved.

title_en: Snow detection rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a snow detection rescue robot which comprises a host, two propellers arranged on two sides of the host, wherein two connecting plates are rotationally connected to the bottoms of the host, sledges are rotationally connected to the bottoms of the two connecting plates, two shock absorbing rods are fixedly arranged at the bottoms of the host, the other ends of the two shock absorbing rods are rotationally connected with one sides of the two connecting plates respectively, mounting grooves are formed in the upper surface of the sledges, telescopic bearing tires are arranged in the mounting grooves, two searchlight lamps are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the host, an infrared camera is fixedly arranged at one side of the host, and the arrangement of the connecting plates, the sledges and the shock absorbing rods can enable an apparatus body to effectively buffer when the apparatus runs on snow, so that running stability is ensured. Meanwhile, the telescopic bearing tire arranged on the sled can be telescopic and adjusted according to the actual condition of the snow, and can extend out of the tire on the flat or harder snow surface, and the tire can be used for rolling and advancing, so that the moving efficiency is improved.

title_en: Simulation machine wounded person system based on search and rescue environment perception
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulated machine wounded person system based on search and rescue environment perception, which relates to the technical field of robot action control and comprises an environment acquisition module for acquiring environment information in a water environment area where a machine wounded person is located, a physiological mapping module for predicting the physiological evolution trend of the machine wounded person in the current environment based on an environment state vector, a wounded condition prediction module for predicting the evolution trend of the physiological and wounded condition in a future time period through a constructed wounded condition evolution model, and an operation control module for executing corresponding physiological actions. The invention utilizes the physiological driving model and the environmental injury coupling mechanism to enable a machine wounded to automatically adjust the floating gesture, limb actions, respiratory rhythm and the like according to environmental change and time evolution, and simultaneously considers various environmental factors, predicts injury development through the physiological environment coupling model, and realizes comprehensive simulation of physiological state, injury state and environmental condition.

title_en: Stair climbing emergency rescue robot based on VLA active deformation wheel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a stair climbing emergency rescue robot based on VLA active deformation wheels, which comprises active deformation tires with 12 servo linear motor telescopic units uniformly distributed on the circumference, a multi-mode sensing system integrating a laser radar, a camera, a barometer, an IMU and a wheel speed odometer, a control module carrying a vision-language-action large model and used for mapping the end-to-end of the geometric characteristics of the perceived stair into a cooperative action sequence of the tire rotation and telescopic units to realize high-speed stable climbing, and a dual-function load system of a hollow rotating motor with high-temperature resistance, an electric power system, an integrated material cabin and a reconnaissance module.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle real-time flight track display method, unmanned aerial vehicle real-time flight track display system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for displaying a real-time flight trajectory of an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining flight information transmitted by the unmanned aerial vehicle in real time, analyzing and processing the flight information to obtain position information, transmitting the position information to a message queue, and pushing the position information to a display end through subscribing the message queue so that the display end draws the flight trajectory of the unmanned aerial vehicle on a display interface according to the position information. According to the application, the position information is processed and pushed in real time, so that the display end can immediately present the flight track of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the monitoring efficiency and the timeliness of operation decisions are enhanced in complex task scenes (such as navigation, search and rescue or patrol), and more visual and real-time unmanned aerial vehicle running states are provided for users.

title_en: Maritime search and rescue system based on multi-sensor fusion and unmanned ship applying system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue system based on multi-sensor fusion, which is arranged on an unmanned ship and comprises a millimeter wave radar detection module, a shipborne visual detection module, a multi-sensor fusion positioning module, an autonomous navigation module and a data communication module; through the combined application of millimeter wave radar and improved vision detection algorithm, remote quick screening, close-range accurate identification and positioning of people falling into water are realized, and the unmanned ship is automatically controlled to approach the target for rescue, so that the method is particularly suitable for searching and rescuing in water areas under complex sea conditions, and can effectively reduce false detection rate and improve response speed.

title_en: Cluster robot collaborative search and rescue processing method, system, platform and storage medium based on multi-mode fusion and NB-IoT communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cluster robot collaborative search and rescue processing method, a system, a platform and a storage medium based on multi-mode fusion and NB-IoT communication, according to the scheme, the efficient, stable and collaborative operation of the robot in an uncertain environment is realized through a bionic quadruped robot platform, self-adaptive motion control based on a Central Pattern Generator (CPG), close-coupled multi-mode SLAM front end and collaborative communication and map fusion based on NB-IoT. That is, the scheme of the invention effectively solves the core pain points of large single robot perception blind area, poor motion stability and difficult multi-machine collaborative communication in uncertain environments after disaster through self-adaptive motion control of the bionic quadruped robot, laser-vision-IMU tight coupling SLAM front end optimization and depth fusion of NB-IoT low-power wide area communication technology, realizes autonomous positioning, environment modeling and collaborative search and rescue of the multi-robot with high robustness under extreme environments, and remarkably improves search and rescue efficiency and success rate.

title_en: Auxiliary rescue equipment based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic information and discloses auxiliary rescue equipment based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises a flight platform, a perception and task load system, an AI processing center, a rescue execution module and a communication and control system, wherein the perception and task load system is integrated with a high-definition camera, an infrared thermal imager, a laser radar and a millimeter wave radar, the AI processing center is internally provided with a main processor and an AI acceleration chip and is configured to construct a three-dimensional environment map, plan obstacle avoidance paths and identify life heat sources based on multi-source perception data, and the rescue execution module comprises a wounded placing cabin with constant temperature and shock absorption functions and an automatically-locked cabin door and a modularized material air drop cabin with a drop door. According to the invention, the AI processing center analyzes the task types, and the control equipment autonomously executes the material delivery or personnel search and rescue tasks, so that the rescue efficiency and the wounded transportation safety in a complex environment are effectively improved.

title_en: Underground coal mine emergency rescue robot and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine underground emergency rescue robot and a system, and relates to the technical field of special robots. The robot comprises a crawler-type robot body, wherein the body comprises a vehicle body, a running system and upper equipment. The front ends of the main tracks on two sides of the running system are provided with swinging arm wheel units, and the driving shafts of the swinging arm wheels and the inducer adopt independent movement design of bearing empty sleeves, so that functional decoupling of obstacle crossing swinging and track guiding is realized, and the trafficability of complex terrains is greatly improved. The upper equipment comprises a three-dimensional laser scanning modeling module, a multi-gas detection module, a surrounding camera, an infrared camera and the like, and can synchronously acquire site three-dimensional space information, gas concentration, panoramic video and infrared images. The robot can form a cooperative system with the control terminal and the command terminal at the rear, so that the real-time fusion of data, the three-dimensional situation presentation and the intelligent analysis are realized. The invention solves the problem of poor terrain adaptability of the existing rescue robot.
assignees: GUIZHOU AEROSPACE TIANMA ELECTRO MECH CO LTD

title_en: Novel water rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of water rescue equipment, and particularly discloses a novel water rescue robot. The water rescue robot mainly comprises a shell, a propeller, a control main board and other structural components. The rear side of the shell is provided with a plurality of thrusters, the shell is provided with a plurality of handles, the inside of the shell is provided with a control main board, a remote control signal receiving device and a power supply battery, wherein the control main board is connected with the thrusters, the main control power supply button, the remote control signal receiving device and the power supply battery through cables. The utility model provides a novel water rescue robot which is remotely controlled by a remote controller to arrive at the side of a person falling into water, so that the person falling into water can be helped to get rid of the trouble, the personal safety of a rescuer can be ensured, and meanwhile, the novel water rescue robot can realize double-sided navigation by providing power for four groups of propellers which are symmetrically arranged, can arrive at the side of the person falling into water quickly and efficiently, and the rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Rescue robot target tracking method and system based on satellite navigation
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of robot target tracking, and discloses a rescue robot target tracking method and system based on satellite navigation, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving satellite positioning data of a target last time, recording a receiving time stamp, and calculating the historical data reliability of the satellite positioning data last time; when an intermittent auxiliary signal sent by a target is received, the reliability of the auxiliary signal is calculated according to the intermittent auxiliary signal, the contribution ratio of the satellite positioning data of the target, which is the last time, and the intermittent auxiliary signal in the target position estimation is adjusted, the real-time target position estimation result is calculated by combining the self navigation information of the robot, and the path planning and the energy consumption are optimized according to the real-time target position estimation result, the real-time energy reserve of the robot and the task urgency. The application obviously improves the target tracking capability and rescue efficiency of the rescue robot in complex disaster environments.

title_en: Double-layer and double-stage heterogeneous unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation and track planning method
abstract_en: A double-layer and double-stage heterogeneous unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation and track planning method relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. The method comprises a double-stage task allocation method and a double-stage path planning method. The method has the beneficial effects that the method aims at improving the efficiency of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle for cooperatively executing the search and rescue task, the method for distributing the task in the double-stage mode and the method for planning the path in the double-stage mode are provided, the combined optimization framework combining the mixed integer linear programming and the improved ant colony algorithm is provided for optimizing the load balance and the total flight distance of the task, the better task distribution effect is realized, the method for planning the path in the double-stage mode is provided for optimizing the overall task sequence and the scheme for planning the path in the double-stage mode in cooperation with the local obstacle avoidance mode, and the better path planning effect is obtained by combining the scheme of overall and local double-stage optimization.

title_en: Group intelligence-based earthquake search and rescue robot joint search and rescue method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent earthquake rescue, in particular to a group intelligent-based earthquake search and rescue robot joint search and rescue method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a distributed communication network and a role dynamic allocation mechanism of an earthquake search and rescue robot group; the method comprises the steps of realizing global path planning and regional collaborative coverage of a cluster by adopting an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm, completing vital signal and dangerous region identification by multi-robot heterogeneous perception data fusion, carrying out real-time sharing and decision collaboration of search and rescue information based on a group consensus mechanism, and dynamically optimizing a cluster search and rescue strategy by introducing a feedback adjustment mechanism. Compared with the technical problems of low single machine operation efficiency, limited coverage range and serious information island of the earthquake search and rescue robot in the prior art, the collaborative closed loop of the earthquake search and rescue robot cluster is realized through group intelligence, and the search and rescue efficiency, coverage integrity and target identification accuracy under the earthquake ruin environment are improved.
assignees: XUZHOU BEIYU SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle that can fix a position
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a positionable search and rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, and particularly relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle body, wherein the bottom end of the unmanned aerial vehicle body is fixedly connected with a bottom plate, a camera is arranged on the front side of the bottom plate, a throwing assembly is arranged at the bottom end of the bottom plate, and a moving mechanism is arranged in the bottom plate; the subassembly is put in to include servo motor, servo motor and the inside fixed connection of bottom plate, servo motor output fixedly connected with first bevel gear, and first bevel gear one side meshing has the second bevel gear, and second bevel gear bottom is to the inside rotation connection of bottom plate, and surface fixedly connected with threaded rod on the second bevel gear, threaded rod and the inside rotation connection of bottom plate. According to the utility model, through arranging the throwing component and the moving mechanism, emergency rescue materials can be quickly transferred after the trapped person is positioned, the rescue response time is shortened, the rescue efficiency is improved, and meanwhile, the camera can be tightly wrapped when the camera is in a non-working state, so that the camera is effectively prevented from being impacted and scratched in the parking process.
assignees: HENAN ZHONGYAO UNMANNED PLANE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Search and rescue snake-shaped robot with heat source detection function
abstract_en: The utility model provides a search and rescue snake-shaped robot with heat source detection, which comprises snake body sections, a driving structure, connecting nodes, a storage battery pack, a snake head electric box, cameras and a heat source sensing structure, wherein the driving structure is arranged on two sides of each snake body section, the connecting nodes are connected between the snake body sections, the storage battery pack is arranged on all snake body sections except a first group of snake body sections, the snake head electric box is arranged on the first group of snake body sections, the cameras and the heat source sensing structure are fixedly arranged on the snake head electric box, and the snake body sections and the connecting nodes can be flexibly matched in a modularized mode according to requirements, can effectively traverse complex terrains, and are high in overall flexibility.
assignees: BEIJING HONGYI QIANFENG TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Human detection safety system for autonomous mobile robot using ai camera
title_ko: Ai 카메라를 이용한 자율 이동 로봇의 인체 감지 안전 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 AI 카메라를 이용한 자율 이동 로봇(Autonomous Mobile Robot, AMR)의 인체 감지 안전 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 작업 공간에서 자율 주행하며 주행 경로에 대한 이미지를 촬영하고 촬영 이미지를 분석하여 상기 촬영 이미지에 인체가 포함되어 있는지 여부를 감지하는 자율 이동 로봇 및 상기 작업 공간에 설치되어 있으며 상기 자율 이동 로봇과의 무선 통신을 통하여 상기 자율 이동 로봇으로부터 상기 인체가 감지되는지 여부에 대한 인체 감지 여부 정보를 무선 전송받고, 상기 인체 감지 여부 정보에 따라 상기 자율 이동 로봇의 주행을 제어하는 통합 제어기를 포함한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 무인 지게차와 무인 대차 등과 같이 일정 규모 이상의 작업 공간에서 화물을 운반하는 자율 이동 로봇의 주행 경로에 대한 이미지를 촬영하고 촬영 이미지를 분석하여 상기 촬영 이미지에 인체가 포함되어 있는지 여부를 감지하고, 그 감지 결과에 따라 자율 이동 로봇의 동작을 실시간 제어함으로써, 자율 이동 로봇의 운용과 관련한 안전 사고 발생 가능성을 저감할 수 있는 AI 카메라를 이용한 자율 이동 로봇의 인체 감지 안전 시스템이 제공되는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Satellite navigation-based rescue robot path planning method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of robot path planning, and discloses a satellite navigation rescue robot path planning method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring satellite navigation, inertial measurement and environmental perception data; analyzing data, diagnosing whether a satellite data abnormal mode occurs, dynamically adjusting parameters or strategies of a positioning algorithm when the satellite data abnormal mode occurs to obtain estimated positioning of the robot, identifying environmental features and carrying out matching calibration to obtain the calibrated robot position, and planning a safe action path based on the calibrated robot position and an environmental map. According to the application, through a set of precise abnormality diagnosis and self-adaptive adjustment mechanism, the positioning reliability and the action safety of the rescue robot in an unreliable satellite navigation signal environment are obviously improved.

title_en: Transfer robot and robot system
abstract_en: To enhance the safety of a robot system.SOLUTION: The conveyance robot 6 is provided with a traveling mechanism 5, an obstacle sensor 6 which has a two-dimensional detection area R along a traveling direction and detects an obstacle around, a human detection unit 6 which has a three-dimensional detection area Q spreading around and detects a person around, and a controller 6. The controller 69 executes autonomous traveling control for controlling the traveling mechanism 5 to move to a predetermined work area 13 by autonomous traveling, and braking control for decelerating the traveling speed by the traveling mechanism 5 or stopping traveling when an obstacle is detected by the obstacle sensor 65 or a person is detected by the person detection unit 66 during autonomous traveling.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Earthquake disaster search and rescue robot control system based on multi-sensor fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a multi-sensor fusion-based earthquake disaster search and rescue robot control system. The method comprises the steps of carrying out preliminary fusion on IMU and wheel type odometer data by adopting EKF, carrying out contrast correction by utilizing absolute pose observation obtained by LiDAR scanning and matching, carrying out real-time interpolation and maintaining smooth and continuous state estimation by an LSTM network in a LiDAR updating interval, ensuring the continuity of positioning data, eliminating state jump or delay caused by sensor asynchronism, carrying out space-time coordinate alignment of multi-mode features based on EKF, ensuring feature time consistency by using time alignment constraint, carrying out multi-mode confidence degree fusion, effectively integrating recognition results of different modes and improving recognition accuracy.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INST OF SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECHNOLOGY TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Task planning and power consumption control method and system for earthquake search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a task planning and power consumption control method and system of a seismic search and rescue robot, which relate to the technical field of robot control and collect attribute information of the seismic search and rescue robot, environmental data of a region to be searched and rescue, communication site and charging site information, establishing robot nodes, task nodes and key area nodes, constructing a space-time diagram, and taking estimated power consumption of the robot moving among the nodes and the environmental risk of the area to be searched and rescuing as edge weights among the nodes; the method comprises the steps of inputting a space-time diagram into a pre-training space-time prediction model, outputting the running state of the robot, the search and rescue difficulty of task points, the dynamic information of key areas and the estimated change trend of power consumption in a future period of time, and adjusting the task planning of the search and rescue robot by applying an optimization algorithm according to the prediction result output by the space-time prediction model and taking the minimum power consumption and the search and rescue difficulty as a combined target. The problem of the existing robot control method that response is lagged is solved, and control efficiency and task planning accuracy are improved.
assignees: JIANGSU SANMING ZHIDA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Robot rescue method, program product, storage medium, equipment and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a robot rescue method, a program product, a storage medium, equipment and a system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining accurate positioning information of a robot and an unmanned aerial vehicle through an RTK technology, controlling the robot and the unmanned aerial vehicle to be respectively located on the ground and the air of the same position of a search and rescue area, obtaining a first video frame in front of the robot through a camera on the robot and a second video frame below the robot through a camera on the unmanned aerial vehicle, carrying out image recognition processing on the first video frame and the second video frame to construct a three-dimensional model in front of the robot, and planning a front path of the robot according to the three-dimensional model. The method and the device can improve the planning accuracy of the robot search and rescue path, save the walking time of the robot and ensure smooth search and rescue.
assignees: GUANGXI VOCATIONAL COLLEGE OF WATER RESOURCES AND ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Firefighting robot operating vehicle and firefighting robot operating system comprising it
title_ko: 소방로봇 운용차량 및 이를 포함하는 소방로봇 운용시스템
abstract_ko:
최소한의 인력으로 다양한 소방임무를 수행할 수 있으며, 소방인력의 안전을 확보하고 화재진압의 효율성을 극대화할 수 있는 소방로봇 운용차량 및 이를 포함하는 소방로봇 운용시스템이 개시된다. 
개시된 소방로봇 운용차량은, 
화재현장을 모니터링하는 모니터링 단말기와 통신하며 인명탐지 솔루션이 탑재된 제1 소방로봇과, 모니터링 단말기와 통신하며 화재진압 솔루션이 탑재된 제2 소방로봇과, 모니터링 단말기와 통신하며 화재현장 주변환경 정보를 수집하기 위한 소방용 드론이 내부에 수용되는 적재함; 적재함 내에 설치되며 제1 소방로봇과 제2 소방로봇을 각각 고정 및 충전시키는 로봇 스테이션; 적재함 내에 설치되며 소방용 드론을 고정 및 충전시키는 드론 스테이션;을 포함한다.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle black box control method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle black box control method and system based on deep learning. And carrying out feature extraction and environment type judgment on the regional image based on the deep learning model. Meanwhile, interactive data of the search and rescue terminal and the black box and positioning data of the search and rescue terminal are collected in real time. And then, inputting the environment types, the interaction data and the positioning data into a reinforcement learning model, calculating and selecting the state benefits of different prompt actions through a strategy network, generating a black box control strategy comprising light, sound and smoke control, and realizing self-adaptive scheduling and energy consumption optimization of the prompt actions. The accessibility and the effectiveness of the black box prompt signal are improved under a complex environment, and the search and rescue efficiency under a falling scene is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG TIANYU CHUANGZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Modularized rescue robot power structure
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of disaster relief exploration machines and discloses a modularized rescue robot power structure which comprises an exploration robot body, wherein power assemblies are arranged on two sides of the outer wall of the exploration robot body, connecting frames are fixedly connected to two sides of the inner wall of the exploration robot body, a speed reducing motor is fixedly connected to one side, away from the center of the exploration robot body, of the connecting frames, and a cushioning main body frame is fixedly connected to the output end of the speed reducing motor. In the utility model, two shock absorbers capable of bearing 250 pounds are arranged in each unit, when the robot encounters shaking, leaping, landing and other conditions in the movement process, the pressure born by the independent power unit can be quickly transmitted to the shock absorbers, so that the springs in the shock absorbers are deformed, and meanwhile, the opening and closing angles of the composite power unit can be correspondingly changed, thereby realizing effective protection of the robot and the power unit.

title_en: Disaster scene-oriented anti-shielding structure for robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides an anti-shielding structure for a robot facing a disaster scene, and mainly relates to the field of search and rescue robot equipment. A disaster scene-oriented anti-shielding structure for robots comprises a spider robot. The camera structure capable of lifting and rotating in a large range is arranged on the upper part of the spider robot, the visual range of the robot is increased, the search and rescue capability is enhanced, the baffle structure capable of rotating and overturning is further arranged on the rear part of the camera, the upper part of the camera can be shielded through the structure, the deflector rod is further arranged on the lower side of the end part of the baffle, the front part of the camera can be removed through the deflector rod and the baffle structure are matched for rotation, the view line is prevented from being blocked by the barrier in a disaster scene, the search and rescue efficiency is further improved, and the barrier clearing angle can be further adjusted through the rotating structure of the baffle.

title_en: Maritime unmanned aerial vehicle emergency rescue method, device, equipment, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The application discloses a maritime unmanned aerial vehicle emergency rescue method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a product, and relates to the technical field of emergency search and rescue, wherein the maritime unmanned aerial vehicle emergency rescue method comprises the following steps of responding to a preset maritime search area and dividing the search area into a plurality of subareas to be searched; the method comprises the steps of carrying out multi-mode data acquisition on a sub-region to be searched, carrying out real-time processing on the acquired multi-mode data through a preset lightweight visual semantic model to generate a semantic processing result, sending the semantic processing result and the multi-mode data to a cloud processing system, receiving a cloud identification result returned by the cloud processing system, and executing an emergency rescue strategy corresponding to the cloud identification result. According to the application, the unmanned aerial vehicle is used as the edge equipment to acquire and process data, so that the data processing result which is convenient to transmit to the cloud is obtained, and after the cloud identification result returned by the cloud is received, a corresponding emergency rescue strategy is executed, so that the efficiency of the maritime unmanned aerial vehicle emergency rescue is improved.

title_en: Robot solar panel folding device
abstract_en: The utility model provides a robot solar panel folding device, and mainly relates to the field of search and rescue robot equipment. A robot solar panel folding device comprises a solar folding plate and a bottom plate. The folding solar panel folding device has the advantages that the solar panel folding storage bin is arranged, the solar panel can be folded and stored in the folding storage bin through driving of the power device, the track rods capable of horizontally moving left and right are further arranged on two sides of the device to limit the folding position of the solar panel to prevent deflection, the inclined plate structure is further arranged on the power structure to adjust the width of the track rods on the two sides, the track rods on the two sides are enabled to move inwards to limit the folding mechanism of the solar panel after the solar panel is unfolded, stability of the solar panel after the solar panel is further improved, and the solar folding panel bin cover is further arranged at the rear part of the power device and is shielded at the opening of the folding storage bin, so that the solar panel is further protected.

title_en: Fire-extinguishing rescue conveying mechanism and high-altitude fire-extinguishing rescue device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-extinguishing and rescue conveying mechanism and a high-altitude fire-extinguishing and rescue device, wherein the fire-extinguishing and rescue conveying mechanism comprises a machine body, a support frame and a conveying frame, wherein the support frame is arranged at the bottom of the machine body; the conveying frame is arranged at the bottom of the supporting frame and can be lengthened or shortened along a preset direction so as to convey the fire-fighting and rescue robot to a preset position. According to the utility model, the fire-extinguishing rescue robot can be driven by a machine body to lift off and approach to a fire area, and then the conveying frame is driven to stretch so as to convey the fire-extinguishing rescue robot to a position to be extinguished, so that the high-rise building fire can be conveyed in the air, a rapid rescue fire-extinguishing channel is opened in the air and rescue materials are delivered when a high-rise building is in a fire disaster, so that time is striven for ground fire-fighting rescue, and the condition detection in a fire scene can be finished through the fire-extinguishing rescue robot at the same time, so that real-time information is provided for rescue and fire-extinguishing command.
assignees: HIT PENGZE SHENZHEN ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle differentiated search path planning method based on probability partition
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle differential search path planning method based on probability partitioning, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous navigation. The method comprises the steps of firstly generating a probability grid map according to target existence probability distribution data, then dividing the map into a high probability concentration area and a low probability dispersion area by adopting a weighted K-means clustering algorithm, realizing full coverage by using a bow-shaped scanning path aiming at the high probability concentration area, dynamically selecting nodes by adopting a gain priority greedy strategy aiming at the low probability dispersion area, optimizing the path by utilizing a 2-opt algorithm to eliminate redundancy, and finally generating a flyable track with continuous curvature and meeting the maneuvering constraint of the unmanned aerial vehicle by adopting Clothoid curve smoothing processing. The method can effectively improve the search coverage rate and the path efficiency, reduce redundant flight, and is suitable for tasks such as maritime search and rescue, regional monitoring and the like.

title_en: Virtual simulation test method for fire-fighting robot path planning performance analysis
abstract_en: A virtual simulation test method for fire-fighting robot path planning performance analysis belongs to a virtual environment simulation technology, and comprises a fire-fighting rescue robot performance simulation, a fire-fighting rescue scene virtualization simulation and a performance analysis method. The invention solves the problems of robot humanization simulation, firefighting rescue scene virtualization simulation, performance test and the like, and provides a test basis for later development and shaping of robots.
assignees: SHENYANG FIRE RESEARCH INST OF MEM;UNIV NANKAI

title_en: Rescue drone
abstract_en: A remote control drone assembly to assist in the rescue of distressed swimmers. The drone assembly includes a flotation device that can be released over a distressed swimmer. A retractable spool assembly attached to the drone assembly includes a retrieval line having a proximate end tethered to the spool assembly. The drone assembly is constructed and arranged to be flown by an operator over a distressed swimmer. The floatation device is released for use by the distressed swimmer and the drone assembly is returned to the operator. The retractable spool is detached from the drone assembly and attached to a spool retractor. The spool retractor retrieving the floatation device together with the distressed swimmer.

title_en: Unmanned plane path planning and regional coverage collaborative optimization method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and particularly discloses a collaborative optimization method for unmanned aerial vehicle path planning and area coverage, which comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a two-dimensional plane coordinate system aiming at a target environment; S2, evaluating threat of the obstacle, S3, setting a task starting point and a task ending point, S4, circumscribing the circle center of the obstacle at the dense position, pre-estimating and clustering according to the distribution of the obstacle, determining the dense center, S5, judging whether the coverage radius of the unmanned aerial vehicle is smaller than the radius of the task threshold, if so, planning a path by taking the dense center as a target, if not, planning the path by taking the task ending point as a target, S6, selecting the next node in the path according to the preset parameter constraint, and updating the constraint parameter, S7, and obtaining the optimal path. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, a plurality of key factors such as path length, area coverage area and the like can be comprehensively considered, and the optimization strategy is dynamically adjusted according to the real-time state in the flight process, so that the disaster-stricken search and rescue efficiency and coverage rate are improved.

title_en: Fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle cluster coverage reconnaissance path sensor joint optimization method
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicle cluster coverage reconnaissance path sensor joint optimization method, belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle cluster cooperation area coverage task planning, and is suitable for scenes such as emergency search and rescue, resource inspection and the like. The method aims at solving the problems of decoupling of track planning and sensor parameter configuration and insufficient dynamic response in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of task initialization and environment modeling, determining an optimal coverage direction of a region, building a sensor and unmanned aerial vehicle kinematic model, building a region decomposition and joint optimization model, dividing an operation band, building three types of track models and a mixed integer programming model, solving based on a random search heuristic algorithm, obtaining optimal track and sensor parameters through random construction and reconstruction inversion, and rapidly coping with emergent situations such as unmanned aerial vehicle exit, newly-added region and the like by dynamic event response and re-planning. The invention realizes the joint optimization of the flight path and the sensor parameters, reduces redundant flight paths, improves the coverage efficiency, and has high robustness and real-time performance.

title_en: Rope throwing device special hook claw for rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model provides a special hook claw of a rope throwing device for a rescue robot, which comprises a first mounting column, an automatic ejection mechanism and a hook claw contraction mechanism, wherein a plurality of mounting plates are transversely and fixedly connected to the outer surface of the first mounting column, and the outer end of each mounting plate is rotatably connected with a hook claw. According to the special hook claw for the rope throwing device for the rescue robot, the automatic ejection mechanism and the hook claw contraction mechanism are arranged, the hook claw of the device is rotationally connected to the outer surface of the first mounting column, when the device is not used, the hook claws can be retracted, the sliding block is pushed downwards after the device is retracted, the rotating disc is rotated, the buckle of the rotating disc is clamped into the transverse sliding groove, at the moment, the hook claws cannot be opened under the limit of the clamping blocks, the retraction state is always kept, the volume of the hook claw in the state is relatively small, the hook claw is convenient to store in transportation, and when the device is needed to be used, the device is convenient to use as a whole, and therefore the practicality of the hook claw is improved.

title_en: Mobile platform of miniature search and rescue robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of building collapse ruin search and rescue equipment, in particular relates to a microminiature search and rescue robot moving platform which comprises two moving modules and a load module, wherein the two moving modules are connected end to form a snake-shaped robot moving platform, the two moving modules are identical in structure and comprise driving joints, deflection joints and a fixed shell, the driving joints provide power for the robot moving platform to walk, the deflection joints control the walking direction of the robot moving platform and ensure that the robot moving platform successfully avoids obstacles in the walking process, and the load module is internally provided with a life detector and a battery and can search and rescue in the ruins and provide a power supply for the wireless communication robot to realize functions. The mobile platform of the miniature snake-shaped robot has good adaptability under the complex environment inside the ruins of building collapse, is particularly suitable for passing through narrow gaps, and has the characteristics of modularized structure, light weight, flexible walking, easy installation, replacement and accurate control.

title_en: Rescue robot
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a rescue robot which comprises a machine body, a multi-axis driving arm and clamping jaw assemblies, wherein the multi-axis driving arm is installed on two sides of the machine body in pairs, the multi-axis driving arm is provided with movable ends which move at least along a first direction, the clamping jaw assemblies are installed on the movable ends of the multi-axis driving arm in a one-to-one correspondence mode, the multi-axis rescue robot comprises a first clamp, a second clamp and an opening and closing mechanism, the opening and closing mechanism is arranged between the first clamp and the second clamp, the second clamp is arranged on one side close to the machine body, and the opening and closing mechanism drives the first clamp and the second clamp to rotate and fold or unfold. According to the utility model, the first clamp and the second clamp are driven to open and close by the opening and closing mechanism of the clamping jaw assembly, so that a single clamping jaw can clamp and carry an obstacle, then the second clamp moves to an avoidance position, and the clamping jaw assembly is matched with the multi-shaft driving arm to displace, so that the two clamping jaw assemblies are closed, the two clamping jaw assemblies are combined into a whole, and the clamping jaw assembly is switched into a double-jaw clamping structure formed by the two first clamps.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle is with radar detection search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a radar detection search and rescue system for an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises an upper computer, a radar device, a radar mutual positioning module and a maritime search and rescue device, wherein the upper computer is arranged at the bottom of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the radar device is suspended below the upper computer, a communication interface is reserved below the upper computer and is connected with the radar device in an interconnecting mode, the radar mutual positioning module is arranged below the radar device and is used for positioning radar pose and outputting a radar pose state to the upper computer, the radar device receives a control instruction from the upper computer and outputs detected target parameters to the upper computer, the upper computer generates actual target information comprising target distance, azimuth angle, pitch angle, heading and navigational speed according to the radar pose state and the target parameters and transmits the actual target information to the unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a towing line, the unmanned aerial vehicle transmits the actual target information to the maritime search and rescue device through the towing line, and the maritime search and rescue device carries out the maritime search and rescue of the target according to the received actual target information.
assignees: BEIJING HUAHANG RADIO MEASUREMENT RESEARCH INST

title_en: Smart Drone and Bomb Collaborative Operation and Special Operations System
title_ko: 스마트 드론과 폭탄의 협력 운용 및 특수 작전 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 드론과 폭탄을 활용한 암호화된 무기 시스템에 관한 것으로, 대규모 임무 수행을 지원하며 드론과 폭탄 간의 실시간 통신, 보안, 스텔스 기능, 자율 비행 및 임무 최적화를 통해 군사적 작전을 수행하는 특수 작전용 시스템이다. 이 시스템은 폭탄을 사전에 배치한 후 드론과 협력하여 운용할 수 있으며 장애물 회피, 임무 실패 시 회수 및 자율 모드 전환 기능을 통해 다양한 상황에 대응할 수 있다. 
드론과 폭탄 간에는 암호화된 인증 프로토콜을 통해 보안 통신이 보장되며, 적이 폭탄을 오용하거나 드론을 회수하지 못하도록 설계되었다. 폭탄에 RAM 도료를 도포해 레이더 탐지를 회피하고 열 차단 필름을 통해 적외선 탐지를 방지하는 스텔스 기능을 제공하며, 장거리 운송용 풍선 시스템과 같은 첨단 기술도 포함하고 있다.  
수천 대의 드론과 그 몇 배에 이르는 폭탄이 실시간으로 동기화된 임무를 수행할 수 있는 복합 무기 시스템으로서, 개별 폭탄은 암호화된 인증을 통해 필요 시 활성화된다. GPS 차단 시에도 자율 비행 알고리즘을 통해 드론은 지속적으로 임무를 수행하며 장애물 감지 및 경로 재탐색 기능을 통해 새로운 임무 지점으로 자동 재배치된다.  
폭탄은 임무가 완료된 후 비활성화 모드로 전환되며 필요 시 자폭 또는 회수 대기 모드로 전환될 수 있다. 임무 실패 시 드론이 폭탄을 회수하여 재배치할 수 있으며, 풍선 운송 장치를 사용해 폭탄을 장거리로 이동시킨 후 도착지에서 자동 파괴 시스템을 통해 풍선을 제거한다. 
드론과 폭탄은 상호 협력하며 장애물이 발생할 경우 즉시 경로를 재탐색하거나 새로운 임무 지점으로 재배치된다. 이러한 시스템은 적진 침투와 대량의 폭탄을 배치하여 전략적 목표를 반복적으로 타격하며, 군사적 우위를 확보한다. 보안 및 방어 시스템으로도 활용 가능하며 시설 방어와 국경 경계에 적용해 침입자에 대한 자동 타격과 자폭 시스템을 구현할 수 있다. 
재난 구조 및 특수 임무 수행에서도 활용될 수 있으며 위험 지역에서 수색과 구조 임무를 수행하고 장애물 발생 시 경로를 재탐색해 신속하게 대응할 수 있다.  
군사, 방어, 재난 구조 등 다양한 분야에서 활용 가능한 복합 무기 시스템으로, 자율성과 보안성을 극대화하여 미래 전장에서의 전략적 우위를 확보한다. 
본 발명은 암호화된 드론과 폭탄의 협력적 운용을 통해 전장의 패러다임을 변화시키고 기존 무기 체계의 한계를 극복하며, 미래 전투 및 방어 시스템에서 핵심적인 역할을 수행할 수 있는 혁신적인 기술이다.
assignees: KIM SEONG HUN;KIM SO JIN;KIM HE RIME;PARK RAN

title_en: Drone Landing System with Human Detection
title_ko: 인간 감지 기능이 구비된 드론 랜딩 방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인간 감지 기능이 구비된 드론 랜딩 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로 카메라(30, Camera)가 영상을 촬영하여 드론 랜딩 지역의 이미지 데이터(Image data)를 생성하는 촬영 단계(S30)와, AI 영상 판단부(40)가 상기 카메라(30)로부터 전송된  이미지 데이터(Image data)에 기초하여 드론 랜딩 지역에 인간(Human)이 있는지 여부를 판단하여 상기 드론의 제어부(20)에 전달하는 인간 탐지 단계(S40)와 인간이 탐지된 경우, 드론의 제어부(20)가 드론의 하강(Descent)을 정지시키고, 상기 지상 관제 시스템(10, GCS)에 통보하는 인간 탐지 통보 및 하강 정지 단계(S50)와, 인간이 탐지되지 않은 경우, 드론의 제어부(20)가 랜딩을 계속(Continue Landing)하는 랜딩 지속 단계(S60)와, 랜딩이 완료(Complete Landing)되면 드론의 제어부(20)가 랜딩 확인(Confirmation) 메시지를 상기 지상 관제 시스템(10)에 전송하는 랜딩 완료 통보 단계(S70)를 더 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 인간 감지 기능이 구비된 드론 랜딩 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Multimode fire rescue robot and fire rescue robot system
