title_en: Disaster prevention desk
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a disaster prevention desk having an excellent disaster prevention function.SOLUTION: A disaster prevention desk 1 includes: a top plate 2; a plurality of legs 3s, 3s supporting the top plate 2. The leg 3s includes: a leg frame 11 joining at least two vertical materials 16 and at least two horizontal materials 17 in a closed frame shape and forming an opening on both sides; an outer plate 12 closing an outer side of the opening of the leg frame 11; a lid body 13 closing an inner side of the opening of the leg frame 11; and a floor connection part 15 fixing the leg 3s on a floor 14 of a building. Disaster prevention equipment 24 is stored in an inner space 23 of the leg frame 11 covered by the outer plate 12 and lid body 13. The disaster prevention desk is fixed on the floor through the floor connection part, and is not thereby moved even if the building is oscillated. Thus, an evacuee can firmly grasp the disaster prevention desk and ensure body safety. Even when a building collapses and an evacuee is embedded in debris and trapped under the disaster prevention desk, a possibility of being rescued can be enhanced by the disaster prevention equipment stored in the inner space.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Personal alert safety system for fireman
title_ko: 소방관용 개인 안전 알람장치
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소방관이 일정 시간동안 움직이지 않는 경우 오디오 부저에서 경보신호에 초음파신호를 혼합하여 송출하고, 통제실에서는 상기 초음파신호를 수신하여 소방관의 위치를 확인할 수 있는 소방관용 개인 안전 알람장치에 관한 것이다.  
종래의 소방관용 안전장치는 건물 내부에서 화재 진압에 투입되는 소방관의 위치를 추적하기에 부적합하고, 별도의 부가장치를 추가하여 구성이 복잡한 문제점이 있는 바, 이를 해결하기 위하여 본 발명은 소방복의 일측에 부착되며 주변의 온도를 감지하는 온도센서를 포함하는 개인 안전 알람 장치에 있어서, 움직임센서에서는 소방관의 움직임이 일정시간 이상 없는 경우 소정의 전기적 신호를 발생하여 마이콤에 전달하고, 상기 마이콤에서는 압전소자 구동부를 제어하여 오디오 부저에서 가청주파수의 경보음을 발생함과 동시에 통제실에서 소방관의 위치를 확인할 수 있도록 초음파를 이중으로 발생하여 외부로 송출하는 것을 특징으로 하는 소방관용 개인 정보 알람 장치를 제안한다. 
따라서, 본 발명에 의한 소방관용 개인 안전 알람장치는 소방관이 화재를 진압시 건물붕괴, 유독가스 질식 등의 이유로 바닥에 쓰러져 일정 시간동안 움직이지 않는 경우 이를 움직임센서를 통해 감지하고, 오디오 부저에서 직접 초음파를 발생함으로써 간단한 기술구성에 의해 소방관의 위치 추적을 용이하게 구현하는 효과가 있다. 또한, 공기통에 부착된 압력센서를 통해 공기의 잔여량과, 온도센서를 통해 확인된 주변 온도를 엘시디 디스플레이에 표시함으로써 위험징후를 소방관에게 즉각적으로 경고할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Modular pump assembly and pump module for use therein
abstract_en: The group of inventions relates to modular pump assemblies and can be used for pumping large volumes of fluid using at least one pump module. Both the claimed pump assembly and the claimed pump module can be incorporated into mobile firefighting stations. A modular pump assembly comprises at least one pump module, each of which comprises a frame 1 and, mounted therein, an electric motor, a reduction gear, and a pump for pumping fluid. The frame 1 of each pump module is designed so that at least one other pump module can be detachably connected to the frame 1. The invention is directed toward: providing a broader scope of use by increasing the options for the spatial configuration of modular pump assemblies with pumps so that they can be compactly housed in small and narrow rooms or in low-volume containers in the event of transportation; simplifying the process of regulating the capacity of a pump assembly by adjusting the number of connected modules; and enhancing the structural integrity of the pump assembly and its resistance to vibrations.

title_en: Rescue system for building collapse
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue system for collapse of a building, which comprises a framework system and a control system, wherein the framework system comprises a plurality of fixed frames, each fixed frame comprises stand columns perpendicular to the ground and fixed cross beams perpendicular to the stand columns, the stand columns and the fixed cross beams are at least four, the stand columns are arranged in a rectangular mode, two ends of each fixed cross beam are connected to the top ends of two adjacent stand columns, the top of each fixed frame is provided with a plurality of movable cross beams capable of moving along the X-axis direction, the control system comprises a control room, the control room is arranged on the movable cross beams and can move along the Z-axis direction, a motor, a control panel and an accommodating space are arranged in the control room, an iron hook capable of moving along the Y-axis direction is arranged at the bottom of the control room, and the motor is connected with a power supply. The rescue system provided by the invention has the advantages of small required open area, no limit on height, large rescue surface coverage and high rescue efficiency, and can efficiently rescue the life bodies and effectively reduce casualties.

title_en: A kind of method deformed in fire using situation detection by laser building structure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of method deformed in fire using situation detection by laser building structure, including (1), laser positioning position is set, (2) selection laser positioning region, (3) transmitting multi-stripe laser builds measurement line segment, (4) the relative displacement residual quantity of line segment and reference substance is measured in observation localization region, and there is provided early warning.The present invention is according to targeted design the problem of being run into fire scenario, it is ingenious to make use of multi-stripe laser structure measurement line segment to be compared with architectural existing fixed reference thing in the scene of a fire, and the change residual quantity of the two generation of monitoring in real time, so as to contrast the parameter for obtaining scene of a fire building deformation, the early warning before building collapse is realized, environmental suitability of the present invention is strong, application is good, cost is relatively low, disclosure satisfy that the required precision of fire field environment measurement, is had a good application prospect in fire-fighting and rescue field.
assignees: SICHUAN FIRE RES INST MINISTRY PUBLIC SECURITY

title_en: A kind of method that novel particle builds assembled device and assembly
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of method that novel particle builds assembled device and assembly,Include the individual particle of series of identical moulding,The particle is six cube structures,The middle position in six faces of the particle is equipped with perforate,The wherein symmetrical two sides of the particle is equipped with some small sircle holes,The small sircle hole is located at the periphery of perforate,The series of identical moulding particle is mutually connected to each other by connection strap,It can realize that diversification is built in life,Convenience in transport,It is easily manufactured,Save material,Recycle,And the moulding of the unique setting of the particle is more stable and firm than conventional construction material,And reduce the complicated coagulation process of conventional construction material,The building that the principle of the particle is more beneficial for being in quake zone country is built,Some fritters can be dispersed into during the building collapse built with the granular materials and mitigate weight,Directly people or thing will not be caused death or damaged,Or temporary shelter constructions when combating a natural disaster rescue are built.

title_en: A kind of urban road road ability evaluation method for considering building earthquake collapse
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of urban road road ability evaluation method for considering building earthquake collapse, belongs to civil engineering and prevents and reduces natural disasters technical field.This method establishes the road net model that becomes more meticulous in GIS platform first；Then according to multilayer shear model region groups of building are carried out with the time-history analysis of seismic response, it is determined that the destruction of building, situation of collapsing；Building destruction, coverage of collapsing are calculated according to building collapse accumulation area probabilistic model afterwards；Building destruction, the influence collapsed to road are calculated according to the distance of width of roadway, building to road edge；Finally according to road passage capability damage situations and it is expected that departure place and the optimal path of the act of rescue and rescue, evacuation after shake in the calculating earthquake of destination.The present invention provides accurately and efficiently method to consider that the urban road road ability of building earthquake collapse is evaluated.

title_en: Smart wearable device for disaster response and disaster response system using thereof
title_ko: 재난대응을 위한 스마트 웨어러블장치 및 이를 이용한 재난대응 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device and a method for a swift and safe response when a disaster occurs. According to the present invention, a wearable device which can be worn or attached to the body of a user, to help the user swiftly and safely evacuate in case of natural disasters including typhoon, flood, storm, and earthquake, as well as other accidents such as fire, collapsing building, explosion, forest fire, and shipwrecking, is provided. The smart wearable device is capable of instructing a safe evacuation route based on the current location of the user. Thus, the user is provided with a safe route without the presence of additional equipment or tools during a disaster. Also, according to the present invention, provided is a system for preemptively and efficiently responding to disasters at the early stage to minimize casualties and property damage through a network of wireless sensors which sense the smart wearable device and various sensors, at the same time helping people in danger to swiftly and safely evacuate.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난발생시 신속하고 안전한 대응을 위한 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따르면, 예를 들면, 태풍, 홍수, 폭풍, 지진 등과 같은 자연재해나, 건물화재, 붕괴, 폭발, 산불, 선박침몰 등과 같은 각종 재난상황 발생시 조난자를 신속하고 안전하게 대피시킬 수 있도록 하기 위해, 사용자의 몸에 착용 가능한 웨어러블 디바이스(wearable device)의 형태로 구성되어 현재위치를 기준으로 안전한 대피 경로를 제공할 수 있도록 구성됨으로써, 재난상황 발생시 별도의 장비나 도구를 휴대할 필요 없이 안전한 대피 경로를 제공할 수 있도록 구성되는 재난대응을 위한 스마트 웨어러블장치가 제공되며, 또한, 본 발명에 따르면, 상기한 바와 같이 재난상황 발생시 안전한 대피 경로를 제공하기 위해 사용자의 몸에 착용 가능한 웨어러블 디바이스의 형태로 구성되는 재난대응을 위한 스마트 웨어러블장치 및 다양한 센서들을 활용하여 각종 재난상황을 감지하는 무선 센서 네트워크의 연동을 통하여, 각종 재난상황 발생시 조난자를 신속하고 안전하게 대피시키는 동시에, 재난발생 초기에 선제적이고 효율적인 재난대응이 가능하여 인명 및 재산피해를 최소화할 수 있도록 구성되는 재난대응 시스템이 제공된다.

title_en: A kind of fire based on laser positioning building deformation monitoring device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fire based on laser positioning building deformation monitoring device, including the casing in flat rectangular box, the camera lens installing port being arranged on casing front side wall, the electric installing port being arranged on casing rear wall, it is arranged at the heat emission hole on wall at left and right sides of casing, at least four are arranged side by side in the laser in casing, for the standby tune bearing being individually fixed in each laser in casing, the controller for being placed on electric installing port and being all connected with all lasers, and be placed on camera lens installing port and with the one-to-one lens fine-tuning component of each laser.The problem of the utility model is based in fire scenario carries out targeted design, multiple hot spot structure measurement line segments are formed using adjustable multi-stripe laser is architectural in fire scenario, compared with reference to architectural existing fixed reference thing, realize and the deformation built in fire scenario is monitored, the early warning before building collapse is realized, ensures the life security of fire-fighting and rescue personnel.
assignees: SICHUAN FIRE RES INST MINISTRY PUBLIC SECURITY

title_en: Portable emergency lantern
title_ko: 휴대용 랜턴
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a portable emergency lantern which has a warning unit for displaying a position of a user in an emergency lantern that a fire fighter or a lifeguard working in an emergency situation due to a fire, an earthquake, a collapse accident, etc. carries, and displaying a risk due to a movement to be easily recognized by others, thereby quickly receiving or taking a safety action when a dangerous accident occurs to promote safety from a dangerous situation.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 휴대용 비상 랜턴에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 화재, 지진, 붕괴사고 등에 의한 비상상황에서 작업하는 소방관 또는 인명구조원이 휴대하는 비상 랜턴에 자신의 위치표시 및 움직임에 따른 위험을 주변에서 쉽게 인식할 수 있도록 표시하는 경보부를 구비함으로써, 위험사고 발생시 신속하게 안전조치를 받거나, 줄 수 있도록 하여 위험상황으로부터 안전을 도모할 수 있는 효과를 제공하게 된다.

title_en: Pantographic table lift for fire fighting
title_ko: 소방용 판토그래픽 테이블리프트
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a pantographic table lift for fire fighting, allowing two pantographics to form one leg in parallel so as to adjust the height of a table in accordance with the height of a ceiling of a scene of an accident. More specifically, the present invention relates to a table lift acting as a supporter for a heavy load for fight fighting to prevent falling objects and secure a space in a scene of a fire with the potential for collapse of buildings and perform fire fighting rapidly. Moreover, the table lift comprises: an upper plate unit for supporting the load of a structure; a pair of leg units comprising two pantographics for supporting a lower portion of the upper plate unit; and a height adjusting unit for adjusting the height of the pair of leg units.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 두 개의 판토그래픽이 병렬로 하나의 다리를 구성하여 사고현장의 천장 높이에 따라 테이블의 높낮이를 조절할 수 있도록 한 소방용 판토그래픽 테이블리프트에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 화재 등의 건물 붕괴 우려가 있는 사고현장에서 낙하물 방지 및 공산 확보를 용이하게 하고 신속하게 소방작업을 진행할 수 있도록 하기 위한 소방용 중량물 지지대 역할을 하는 테이블리프트의 제공에 관한 것으로서, 그 구성은 구조물의 하중을 견딜 상판부와; 상기 상판부의 하부를 지지하는 두 개의 판토그래프로 구성된 한 쌍의 다리부와; 상기 한 쌍의 다리부의 높낮이를 조절할 수 있도록 하는 높이조절부;로 구성된 것이다.

title_en: A kind of earthquake rescue tool
abstract_en: A kind of earthquake rescue tool, including hydraulic mandril, the hydraulic mandril includes first hydraulic cylinder body, second hydraulic cylinder body, oil storage cylinder, the oil storage cylinder is connect by oil inlet pipe with first hydraulic cylinder side bottom end, the side bottom end of first hydraulic cylinder side adjacent with the second hydraulic cylinder is connected by oil inlet pipe, the second hydraulic cylinder bottom surface is equipped with flowline, the flowline is connect with the oil storage cylinder, the second hydraulic cylinder connects the position of the oil inlet pipe, higher than the position that the oil storage cylinder connects the flowline；The first hydraulic cylinder body is fixedly connected with the external wall of the second hydraulic cylinder by attachment device, and the attachment device intersects the diamond shape device formed by connecting rod.In the building collapsed of support or other blocks, two supporting points object level that allows to collapse is lifted, and is guaranteed to lift stability when collapsing object, while increasing supporting point, is expanded the mass range for lifting the object that collapses.

title_en: Fire extinguisher including hammer
title_ko: 해머 일체형 소화기
abstract_en: A hammer-integrated fire extinguisher according to an embodiment of the present invention, which is configured so as to perform the functions of a fire extinguisher and a hammer which are individually disposed within an airplane, comprises: a main body container in which a fire extinguishing agent is compressed to be stored therein; a hammer unit fastened to a lower portion of the main body container such that a user can grip the main body container and hit a wall body in order to destroy the wall body; and a fastening unit fastening the hammer unit to the lower portion of the main body container. Therefore, the present invention reduces the overall weight of an airplane, and simplifies processes required for using emergency equipment, thereby improving safety in rescuing human lives in case of an emergency.
abstract_ko: 항공기 내에 각각 개별 비치되는 소화기와 해머의 기능을 함께 수행할 수 있도록 한 본 발명에 따른 해머 일체형 소화기는 소화약제가 압축 내장된 본체용기, 사용자가 상기 본체용기를 파지하고 벽체를 타격하여 상기 벽체를 파괴할 수 있도록 상기 본체용기의 하부에 결속되는 해머부 및 상기 해머부를 상기 본체용기의 하부에 결속시키는 결속부를 포함하므로, 항공기 전체 중량을 절감할 수 있으며, 비상 장비를 이용하는 절차를 단순화하여 비상시 인명구조 안전성을 향상시킬 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Rescue device for providing support for post-disaster buried people
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rescue device for supporting a person who is buried and pressed after a disaster, which mainly comprises a device body rod, a universal shaft, a rotating shaft, a telescopic bracket, a composite material film, a motor and a remote control device. Each section of the device is provided with two supports which can rotate left and right, the supports are telescopic, a single support is arch-shaped when being extended, a rib-shaped metal exoskeleton protection system is formed after a plurality of sections of the supports are extended simultaneously, each section of the device is connected through a universal shaft to deal with a complex rescue environment, and finally, a composite material film in a main body rod extends and expands from the rod to wrap the supports to form a complete protection system, so that secondary collapse in the subsequent rescue process is prevented, and the life safety of a buried person is guaranteed. The invention has the advantages that: the life safety of the buried person is guaranteed, and the use of large-scale rescue equipment is facilitated.

title_en: Jack robot for disaster and control method of the same
title_ko: 재난용 잭 로봇 및 그것의 제어 방법
abstract_en: A jack robot for disaster, according to the present invention, comprises: a robot body made to move; a camera provided in the robot body to photograph the surroundings of the robot in real time; a controller provided in the robot body to input and output a control signal for the robot; a communication unit provided in the robot body, and for transmitting and receiving signals to and from a robot control device located outside and the camera and the controller to enable remote control; a jack mechanism provided on the robot body to lift an object while being operated according to a signal from the controller; and a jack push mechanism for moving the jack mechanism from a storage position in the robot body to a use position outside the robot body. The jack robot for disaster can secure an access road by lifting collapsed debris by being put in a place where people cannot enter, such as a collapsed building site, while monitoring the situation in real time by means of the mounted camera.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 재난용 잭 로봇은, 주행 가능하게 이루어진 로봇 바디와; 상기 로봇 바디에 구비되어 로봇 주변을 실시간으로 촬영하는 카메라와; 상기 로봇 바디에 구비되어 로봇에 대한 제어 신호를 입출력하는 제어부와; 상기 로봇 바디에 구비되어 외부에 위치되는 로봇 제어장치와 상기 카메라 및 제어부와 신호를 주고받도록 하여 원격 제어가 가능하도록 하는 통신부와; 상기 로봇 바디에 구비되어 상기 제어부의 신호에 따라 작동되면서 물체를 들어 올리는 잭 기구와; 상기 잭 기구를 상기 로봇 바디 내의 보관 위치에서 상기 로봇 바디 바깥쪽의 사용 위치로 이동시키는 잭 밀당기구를 포함하여 구성됨으로써 건물 붕괴 사고 현장 등에 사람이 들어가지 못하는 장소에 투입되어 무너진 잔해물을 들어 올려 진입로를 확보함과 동시에 장착된 카메라로 상황을 실시간으로 모니터링 할 수 있다.
assignees: KYUNGPOOK NAT UNIV IND ACADEMIC COOP FOUND

title_en: Laminated elastomeric bearing having ability of safety check-up for bridge
title_ko: 교량 안전진단 기능을 갖는 교좌장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a bridge seat apparatus having a bridge safety diagnosis function which senses deformation acting on an upper plate of a bridge when an earthquake occurs to notify a vehicle passing on the bridge and a remote manager of the deformation of the upper plate of the bridge, and blocks the entrance of the bridge to restrict vehicles if the deformation of the upper plate of the bridge exceeds a prescribed range. According to the present invention, the bridge seat apparatus having a bridge safety diagnosis function comprises: an upper pad fixed on a lower portion of an upper plate of a bridge by an anchor bolt; a lower pad fixed on an upper surface of a bridge post by an anchor bolt to correspond to the upper pad; and an impact absorbing pad arranged between the upper and the lower pad. The bridge seat apparatus having a bridge safety diagnosis function further comprises: a first sensor consisting of a gyroscope sensor attached to a lower surface of the upper pad to sense an inclination angle by vibration; a second sensor consisting of a micrometer attached to an upper surface of the lower pad in an X-axis and a Y-axis to sense a movement of the axes; and a third sensor consisting of a height gate attached to one side of the upper and the lower pad to sense vertical compression. Sensing signals of the sensors are monitored in real time to measure and check a bridge seat exceeding a prescribed range, and then the bridge is controlled as needed.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지진 발생시의 교량 상판에 작용하는 변형을 감지하여 교량을 통과하는 차량과 원거리의 관리자에게 교량 상판의 변형을 알려주며, 교량 상판의 변형이 일정 범위를 벗어나는 경우 교량의 진입로를 차단하여 차량을 통제할 수 있는 교량 안전진단 기능을 갖는 교좌장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 의한 교량 안전진단 기능을 갖는 교좌장치는, 앵커볼트에 의해 교량 상판의 저부에 고정되는 상부패드와, 교각의 상면에 상기 상부패드와 대응되도록 앵커볼트에 의해 고정되는 하부패드와, 그 사이에 개재되는 완충패드로 구성되되, 상부패드의 저면에 부착되어 진동에 따른 기울기 각도를 감지하는 자이로스코프 센서로 된 제1감지기, 하부패드의 상면에 x축과 y축으로 각각 부착되어 축의 이동량을 감지하는 마이크로미터로 된 제2감지기, 및 상하부 패드의 일측면에 부착되어 상하 압축량을 감지하는 하이트 게이트로 된 제3감지기를 포함하여 이들 감지기의 감지신호를 실시간 모니터링하여 일정 변위를 벗어나는 교좌를 측정 확인 후 필요에 따라 교량을 통제하도록 구성된다.

title_en: Smart Emergency Exit Lamp
title_ko: 스마트 피난구 유도등
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart refuge guide light, and more particularly, to a smart refuge guide light which allows a portable emergency light to be separated into a flashlight while maintaining the function of indicating the direction of a refuge when an emergency such as building collapse or a fire, due to the generation of a disaster to serve as a flashlight and transmit a distress signal, thereby being actively used in lifesaving. To this end, the smart refuge guide light comprises: a base emergency light installed to be supported by a building wall, and having an evacuation exit induction light turned on in an emergency; and the portable emergency light constantly charged by a built-in battery in a state of being attached to the base emergency light, provided with the evacuation exit induction light to be constantly turned on, and turning on a flashlight lamp and transmitting the distress signal every predetermined time while being separated from the base emergency light in case of an emergency. The base emergency light turns on the evacuation exit induction light when the portable emergency light is separated therefrom.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 피난구 유도등에 관한 것으로서, 특히 재해/재난 등으로 건물붕괴 및 화재 등의 비상상황 발생시 피난구의 방향표시 기능은 유지한 채 휴대가능한 비상등이 손전등으로 분리되어 후레쉬와 조난신호 전송 기능을 하여 인명구조에 적극 활용되는 스마트 피난구 유도등에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위하여, 본 발명은 건물 벽체에 지지되도록 설치되고, 비상시 점등되는 피난구 유도등이 구비되는 베이스 비상등; 및 상기 베이스 비상등에 부착된 상태로 내장 배터리에 의해 상시 충전되고 피난구 유도등이 구비되어 상시 점등되며, 비상시 베이스 비상등으로부터 분리되면서 후레쉬 램프가 점등되고 조난신호를 일정 시간마다 전송하는 포터블 비상등; 을 포함하여 구성되며, 상기 베이스 비상등은 포터블 비상등의 분리시 피난구 유도등이 점등되는 것을 특징으로 하는 스마트 피난구 유도등을 제공한다.

title_en: Structure collapse early warning system and method based on acceleration data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a structural collapse early warning system and method based on acceleration data, and solves the problem that in the prior art, whether a fire-affected building structure collapses or not can not be accurately judged, so that the deployment of emergency rescue and disaster relief work of firemen is not facilitated. The structure collapse early warning system comprises a wireless acceleration sensor, a wireless signal receiver, an AD converter, a PC (personal computer) and an acousto-optic alarm, wherein the PC converts acceleration information acquired by the wireless acceleration sensor into an acceleration time-course curve, and then converts the acceleration time-course curve into a curve of structure frequency changing along with time through a Hilbert algorithm. When the frequency-time curve is sharply reduced, the acousto-optic alarm is controlled to operate for early warning. The fire-fighting building early warning system is simple in structure, scientific and reasonable in design and convenient to use, can accurately pre-judge the collapse of a fire-fighting building, and pre-warns the fire-fighting building at the first time when the collapse risk of the fire-fighting building is pre-judged so as to guarantee the life safety of fire fighters.

title_en: Passive disconnect-type snake-like robot
abstract_en: The invention relates to a passive separation type snake-shaped robot, which comprises a head, a control unit, an external environment detection unit and a battery unit, wherein the head comprises a head shell, and the control unit, the external environment detection unit and the battery unit are arranged on the head shell; the body part comprises a plurality of separable joint modules which are sequentially connected to form a chain structure and joint driving motors arranged between every two adjacent separable joint modules; the separable joint module comprises a module I, a module II and a connecting assembly; when the building collapses and is pressed by gravity, the pressed part stops moving, the part which is not pressed continues moving to transmit power, so that the spring in the connecting device drives the steel ball to be separated from the spherical groove, the pressed part is separated from the whole body to stop working, the part which is not pressed continues working under the leading of the snake head, and the disaster scene is transmitted to the rescue workers through the miniature camera, thereby improving the rescue working efficiency.

title_en: Random number generation method and random number generator using inorganic scintillator
title_ko: 무기섬광체를 이용한 난수생성방법 및 난수생성장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a random number generation method and a random number generation apparatus using a ZnS scintillator. The random number generation apparatus comprises: a radioactive isotope emitting layer emitting an alpha particle or a beta particle upon natural collapse of an atomic nucleus; a polymer layer disposed on a bottom of the radioactive isotope emitting layer; an inorganic scintillator layer disposed between the radioactive isotope emitting layer and the polymer layer and coated with an inorganic scintillator; and a wafer layer disposed on a bottom of the polymer layer and including a photodiode for detecting light generated from the inorganic scintillator layer.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 ZnS 섬광체를 이용한 난수생성방법 및 난수생성장치에 대한 것으로, 원자핵의 자연붕괴시 알파입자 또는 베타입자를 방출하는 방사성 동위 원소 방출층과, 상기 방사성 동위 원소 방출층의 하단에 배치되는 폴리머층과, 상기 방사성 동위원소방출층과 상기 폴리머층 사이에 배치되며 무기섬광물질이 도포되는 무기섬광체층과, 상기 폴리머층 하단에 배치되고 상기 무기섬광체층으로부터 발생하는 빛을 검출하는 포토다이오드를 포함하는 웨이퍼층을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Novel emergency rescue refuge building platform of earthquake area transformation formula
abstract_en: The utility model provides a novel earthquake belt-modified emergency rescue building platform, which is characterized in that the tops of four sides of the inner wall of the building platform are embedded with an inner frame, the bottom end of the inner frame is uniformly fixed with a plurality of vertical support plates integrated with the inner frame, the vertical support plates are embedded in the four sides of the inner wall of the building platform, and the side surfaces of the vertical support plates are vertically penetrated with at least three horizontal vertical rods, thereby providing bricks, falling rocks and the like generated when the surrounding building collapses, the bricks, falling rocks and the like can be shielded by the building platform, a helicopter can quickly find landing points in high altitude without evacuating people and then vacating a piece of empty ground to stop, thus solving the problem of the existing earthquake belt-modified novel emergency rescue building platform, building bricks and the like are easy to fall in emergency shelters and cause injury accidents of the people, the helicopter is inconvenient to land and needs a certain time to evacuate people.
assignees: SHANGHAI CHUANQIN BUILDING ENG CO LTD

title_en: Safety Diagnosis System for Underground
title_ko: 지하 작업공간에 대한 안전진단 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety diagnosis system for an underground working space which comprises: a gateway installed on a lower portion of a manhole cover to communicate with the outside through Wi-Fi communication and Bluetooth communication; an environment sensor which is installed in the working space and configured to be changed from a sleep mode to a wake-up mode when an operation signal is transmitted from the gateway through the Bluetooth communication to detect at least one of the environment states of gas detection, carbon dioxide detection, temperature and humidity detection, and immersion detection in the working space, and to transmit the environment state to the gateway; and a worker terminal with an application installed therein to provide a worker with environment state information provided by the environment sensor. The gateway performs the Bluetooth communication with the worker terminal when the worker terminal, in which the application is run, enters within a reference distance, generates the operation signal for changing the environment sensor from the sleep mode to the wake-up mode, and transmits the operation signal to the environment sensor.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하 작업공간에 대한 안전진단 시스템에 관한 것으로, 맨홀 뚜껑의 하부에 설치되어 와이파이 통신과 블루투스 통신으로 외부와 통신하는 게이트웨이; 작업공간 내에 설치되고, 블루투스 통신을 통해 상기 게이트웨이로부터 동작신호가 전송될 때 슬립 모드에서 웨이크업 모드로 변경되어 작업공간 내의 가스감지, 이산화탄소감지, 온습도감지, 및 침수감지 중 적어도 어느 하나의 환경상태를 감지하여 상기 게이트웨이로 전송하는 환경센서; 및 상기 환경센서에서 제공하는 환경상태정보를 작업자에게 제공하는 앱이 설치된 작업자 단말기를 포함하고, 상기 게이트웨이는 상기 앱이 구동된 작업자 단말기가 기준 거리 이내로 진입될 때 상기 작업자 단말기와 블루투스 통신을 수행한 후 상기 환경센서를 슬립 모드에서 웨이크업 모드로 변경시키기 위한 동작신호를 생성하여 환경센서로 전송하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Real-time Personnel Identification System
title_ko: 실시간 인원 파악 시스템
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to provide a system for counting the number of people in real time capable of preventing inefficient manpower input for rescuing buried people and quickly progressing a lifesaving activity by collecting data on how many people are in each area in real time until a building collapses through a human body sensing unit to transmit the collected data to a data processing unit, updating collected data in real time through a data control unit and then transmitting updated data to a web server, and transmitting the updated data to certified users including rescue workers and rescue teams through the web browser when a building collapses due to unexpected accidents such as earthquake or natural disasters.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지진과 같은 자연재해나 예기치 못 한 사고로 인해 건물이 붕괴할 경우 건물이 무너지기까지 실시간으로 각 구역 내의 몇 명의 사람이 있는지에 대한 데이터를 인체 감지부를 통해 수집하여 데이터 처리부에 전송하고, 데이터 제어부를 통해 상기 데이터를 실시간으로 업데이트 후 웹 서버에 전송하고, 웹 서버는 웹 브라우저를 통해 구조대원 및 구조대를 포함한 인증된 사용자에게 전달함으로 써 매몰된 인명을 구조하는 데 있어 비효율적인 인력 투입을 방지할 수 있으며 보다 신속하게 인명구조 활동을 진행할 수 있게 만드는 효과를 가진 실시간 인원 파악 시스템을 제공하는데 목적이 있다.
assignees: OH SEUNG HYEON;JEONG CHANG HOON;KIM JAE IN;HWANG HO SUNG;YUN SANG JIN

title_en: Smart-phone nfc marker safty system
title_ko: 스마트폰 nfc마커를 이용하여 시설물관리 재난재해 인명구조 안전조치의 정보안내를 구현하는 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart phone disaster safety system for information guide and reporting for disasters, lifesaving, and safety measures using NFC, wherein the system comprises a housing (100), a body (200), and an NFC (300). The housing has a rectangular shape by including a housing front surface (110) and a housing rear surface (120). The body is protected by the housing. The NFC is attached to the body. The housing has the shape of a box having an empty inside, and thus only the lower surface thereof is opened. The body includes a holding plate fixing part (210) having a bundle shape at the lower portion thereof and an NFC holding plate (220) having a plate shape at the upper portion thereof. The outer surface of the holding plate fixing part is formed to correspond to the shape of a housing lower inner surface (140) of the housing, so that the holding plate fixing part is inserted into and fixed to the inside of the lower end of the housing in close contact therewith. A system capable of storing data for providing evacuation information or the like when an emergency occurs can be provided to have strong durability against an external environment.
abstract_ko:
NFC를 이용하여 재난재해; 인명구조; 안전조치;를 위한 정보안내 및 신고를 위한 스마트폰 재난재해 안전시스템으로서, 
하우징(100); 본체(200); NFC(300);를 포함하고, 
상기 하우징은 하우징전면(110) 및 하우징배면(120)을 포함하여 사각형상을 취하고, 상기 본체는 상기 하우징에 보호되고, 상기 NFC는 상기 본체에 부착되되, 
상기 하우징은 내부가 빈 박스 형태를 취하여 하면만이 개구되고, 
상기 본체는, 그 하부에 뭉치형태를 취하는 거치판고정부(210) 및 상부에 판상의 형태를 취하는 NFC거치판(220)을 포함하고, 
상기 거치판고정부의 외면은 상기 하우징의 하우징하부내면(140)의 형태에 대응되게 형성되어서, 상기 거치판고정부가 상기 하우징의 하단 내부에 긴밀히 접촉하면서 삽입되어 고정되게 하고, 
 상기 하우징전면(110)의 저부 및 상기 거치판고정부(210)의 저부에는, 상기 본체가 상기 하우징 내에 확고하게 고정되어 밖으로 빠지지 않도록 잡아주는 자체 잠금장치(150)가 구성되되, 
수직 및 수평방향으로 컷팅을 시켜 절개된 두 개의 절개부(cut1, cut2)의 의해, 상기 하우징전면(110)의 저면에서, 일 측을 남겨두고 나머지 측이 절개되어 형성되는 잠금판(151); 상기 잠금판(151)의 일 측에 상기 하우징전면(110)의 소정구간 두께를 얇게 파는 방법(cut3)으로 굽힘이 가능하게 형성되어 힌지의 역할을 하는 잠금힌지(152); 및 상기 하우징의 하우징하부내면(140)에서, 상기 잠금판(151)의 내측면으로부터 상기 하우징배면(120) 쪽을 향하여 돌출 형성되는 잠금핀(153);이 상기 하우징에 구성된다.

title_en: Remote Controllable fire fighting truck
title_ko: 원격 컨트롤이 가능한 방수포
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a remotely controllable waterproof cloth and, more specifically, to a waterproof cloth having excellent accessibility for effective firefighting. According to the present invention, the waterproof cloth comprises: a body in which a fire hose is loaded; a track wheel coupled to a lower part of the body; and a waterproof cloth unit installed on a front side of the body to spray firefighting water at high pressure to a fire point.
abstract_ko:
본 개시는 사전 제작된 대형 소방차에 탑재하여 이동성과 기동성을 갖되 자체 동력으로 주행이 가능하여 화재 진압에 대한 유리한 위치 선정 및 접근성이 우수하고, 화재의 초기 진압성이 우수하여 인명을 보호하고, 재산피해를 최대한으로 억제가 가능하며, 소방호스가 탑재되어 있어 대형 소방차로부터 무거운 소방호스를 현장까지 운반해야되는 기존의 소방호스 제공방법이 개선되고, 이를 통해 소방전 등과 연결이 용이하여 화재 및 주변환경에 대한 적극적인 대처가 가능해져 화재 진압의 유리함이 제공되고, 골목길 등의 좁은 통행로의 각종 장애물을 피해 무거운 소방호스를 화재현장까지 운반이 가능하여 시간 소비의 낭비가 발생되지 않아 초기 진압이 유리하며, 원격 컨트롤에 따른 무인 이동이 가능하여 화재 현장에 투입된 소방관이 화염과 연소에 의한 유독가스 및 건물 붕괴, 고온의 화염이 발생하고 폭발 등의 위험을 받는 종래 문제점이 해결되고, 계단이나 건물 붕괴 등으로 인한 잔해에 따른 장애물 통과에 대한 극복이 유리하고, 좁은 공간이나 사람이 출입할 수 없는 곳에 접근이 유리해 효과적인 화재 진압이 가능하며, 화재 진압을 위한 복합적인 기술과 기능의 접목으로 인해 효과적인 화재 진압이 가능하고, 화재 현장에서의 소방 활동성이 보장되어 소방로봇 개발과 보급에 대한 발판이 되고, 화재현장으로 소방호스를 이동해 화재 진압을 함으로써 고압대 유량의 방수가 어려운 종래의 문제점이 개선되는 장점을 갖는 원격 컨트롤이 가능한 방수포에 관한 것이다. 
본 개시의 실시예에 따른 원격 컨트롤이 가능한 방수포는 소방호스가 적재되며, 기제작된 소방차에 상하차되는 몸체와, 상기 몸체의 하부에 결합되되, 계단 또는 건물 붕괴 등으로 인한 장애물을 통과하여 상기 몸체가 화재 진압을 위한 장소로 위치 이동되도록 주행시키는 궤도바퀴 및 상기 몸체의 전방측에 설치되되, 소방차 또는 소화전 등으로부터 공급되는 소방수를 화재 지점에 고압으로 분사하는 방수포를 포함하고, 상기 몸체와 상기 궤도바퀴 및 상기 방수포는 원격에 의한 무인으로 작동된다.

title_en: Falling rock prevention device having disater alarm and collapse senssing function of slope
title_ko: 재난 예·경보 및 붕괴감지 기능이 구비된 낙석 방지장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a rockfall prevention device with disaster forecasting/warning and collapse detection functions. According to the present invention, the rockfall prevention device with disaster forecasting/warning and collapse detection functions comprises: a collapse detection means (10); a plurality of displacement sensors (20) for measuring a ground or underground displacement; a site controller (30); a management server (40); a warning display unit (45) for outputting a warning message on a screen; a reinforcing frame (50); and a blocking member (60). According to the present invention, it is possible to accurately check whether a slope is collapsed.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 경사지를 모니터링하여 붕괴위험 및 붕괴시 이를 감지하여 경보함은 물론 경고표시부나 관리서버에 경고메시지를 출력하고, 경사면의 붕괴로 인해 낙석방지책으로 떨어지는 돌이나 토사물을 막아 도로나 건물로 진입하지 못하도록 하는 재난 예·경보 및 붕괴감지 기능이 구비된 낙석 방지장치를 제공하는 데 있다. 
본 발명은 경사지의 하측에 시공되는 낙석방지책에 설치되어 경사면 붕괴시 이를 감지하는 붕괴감지수단(10); 경사지의 경사면 설정된 위치에 각각 설치되어 지표 또는 지중 변위를 측정하는 복수개의 변위센서(20); 상기 변위센서(20)와 붕괴감지수단(10)의 감지신호를 전달받아 관리서버(40)로 송신하는 현장제어기(30); 원격지에 설치되어 상기 현장제어기(30)로부터 감지신호를 전달받아 실시간 모니터링하고, 변위센서(20)로부터 수신된 정보가 기설정된 기준값을 초과하는 경우에 붕괴위험이 있음을 예·경보하며, 붕괴감지수단(10)으로부터 수신된 정보가 기설정된 기준값을 초과하는 경우에 붕괴가 발생하였음을 알려주는 관리서버(40); 상기 낙석방지책이 설치된 경사지에서 설정된 거리만큼 떨어진 위치에 설치되고, 상기 현장제어기(30) 또는 관리서버(40)로부터 메시지 출력신호를 전달받아 경고메시지를 화면에 출력해주는 경고표시부(45); 복수개의 방지책 지주(1) 사이에 양단부가 각각 연결부재(55)를 매개로 연결되는 수평보강대(51)와, 상기 수평보강대(51)의 중간부분에 수직으로 설치되고 하단이 방지책 지주(1)가 고정된 옹벽 상면에 앵커볼트로 고정되는 수직보강대(52)로 구성된 보강프레임(50); 상기 낙석방지책의 배면에 방지책 지주(1) 간의 사이공간을 커버하도록 설치되어 사면 붕괴로 인해 낙하되는 돌 및 토사물을 막아주는 차단부재(60);로 이루어지고, 상기 붕괴감지수단(10)은, 상기 방지책 지주(1) 또는 보강프레임(50)과 상기 차단부재(60)의 사이 또는 지지프레임(15)과의 사이에 설치되어 차단부재(60)나 지지프레임(15)과의 거리를 감지하는 거리감지센서로 구성된다.

title_en: High-resolution remote sensing image post-earthquake building detection method based on sparse dictionary
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sparse dictionary-based high-resolution remote sensing image post-earthquake building detection method. Belongs to the field of remote sensing and photogrammetry; the method comprises the following specific steps: 1. extracting a potential building set and constructing a multi-feature earthquake damage visual dictionary; 2. constructing a context relation based on spatial pixels in a visual dictionary; 3. the sparse expression of the visual dictionary can realize more detailed expression of the characteristics of the original image; 4. and obtaining a final detection result through earthquake damage building detection based on SVM classification. After an earthquake occurs, the method can quickly and accurately judge the position of the earthquake-damaged building, and has important effects on carrying out emergency rescue and disaster assessment after the earthquake; the method is characterized in that a plurality of groups of high-resolution remote sensing images after the earthquake in different areas and different sensors are tested; meanwhile, through further division of intact buildings, partial earthquake-damaged buildings and ruins in detection results, key decision support can be provided for emergency response rescue after earthquake and reconstruction after disaster.

title_en: Fourier transform-based polarized SAR data collapse identification building method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying collapsed buildings based on polarized SAR data of Fourier transform, which provides a new characteristic parameter, namely angular domain variation coefficient CV _ AFI based on Fourier transform magnitude spectrum, is used for identifying collapsed buildings and perfect inclined buildings, and is combined with a polarization decomposition method to extract collapsed buildings in a post-earthquake disaster area. The method provided by the invention can achieve 82.95% of damaged buildings and 85.20% of perfect buildings. 78% of the perfect sloping structures were successfully separated from the collapsed structures. If the perfect buildings are mistakenly identified as collapsed buildings, rescue deployment is misguided, and a large amount of disaster relief resources are consumed. The CV _ AFI parameter provided by the invention can effectively describe the space distribution difference and the structural feature difference of collapsed buildings and inclined buildings in a frequency domain, can better identify the two buildings, and improves the precision of identifying earthquake damage of the buildings after an earthquake.

title_en: Gas inflatable type lifesaving safety mat
title_ko: 가스팽창식 인명구조 안전매트
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a gas inflation type lifesaving safety mat, which rapidly injects air into a safety mat by using a gas inflator to enable the safety mat to be inflated so as to allow an unskilled person to easily install the safety mat and easily saves a falling person when a fire or an emergency occurs in a high-rise building. The safety mat comprises: a mat main body inflated and expanded by injection of the air; the gas inflator connected to a side portion of the mat main body to inject the air into the mat main body; a shock absorbing unit provided inside the mat main body to absorb a shock; a mat top plate covered by an upper portion of the shock absorbing unit to absorb the shock; and a moving unit provided to the outside of an upper portion of the mat main body to move the mat main body.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가스인플레이트에 의해 안전매트에 신속하게 공기를 주입시켜 팽창되게 하여 미숙련자도 손쉽게 설치가 가능하고 고층건물의 화재나 비상시에 떨어지는 낙하자를 용이하게 구조할 수 있는 가스팽창식 인명구조 안전매트에 관한 것으로, 공기가 주입되어 팽창되면서 펼쳐지는 매트 본체와, 상기 매트 본체의 측부에 연결되어 매트 본체로 공기를 주입시키는 가스인플레이터와, 상기 매트 본체의 내부에 구비되어 충격을 완충할 수 있도록 하는 충격완충부와, 상기 충격완충부의 상부로 덮여져 충격을 흡수하는 매트 상판과, 상기 매트 본체의 상부 외측에 구비되어 매트 본체를 이동시킬 수 있는 이동부를 포함한다.

title_en: Snake robot device used in collapsed areas
title_ko: 붕괴지역에 사용되는 뱀 로봇 장치
abstract_en: A snake robot device according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a head with a protruding tip of a first tube for emergency medicine and a tip of a second tube for nutritional juice; a body comprising a plurality of unit joints; and a tail in which an external wire is inserted and connected, and the first tube for emergency medicine and the second tube for nutritional juice are drawn to the outside. Since the snake robot device according to an embodiment of the present invention injects emergency medicine into the first tube and nutrient juice into the second tube to deliver emergency medicine or nutrient juice to a buried person in the collapsed area, the present invention has the effect of allowing the buried person to take emergency medicine or nutritional juice and securing and extending a lifesaving golden time for the buried person.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 일실시예에 따른 뱀 로봇 장치는 응급약물용 제 1 튜브의 선단부와 영양주스용 제 2 튜브의 선단부가 돌출 구비된 머리부; 다수 개의 단위 관절로 이루어진 몸통부; 및 외부의 배선이 삽입 연결되고 상기 응급약물용 제 1 튜브와 영양주스용 제 2 튜브가 외부로 도출된 꼬리부;를 포함한다.  
본 발명의 실시예에 따른 뱀 로봇 장치는 응급약물을 제 1 튜브로 주입하고 영양주스를 제 2 튜브로 주입하여 붕괴지역의 매몰자에게 응급약물 또는 영양쥬스를 전달하므로, 매몰자가 응급약물 또는 영양쥬스를 섭취하게 하고 매몰자에 대한 인명구조 골든타임을 확보 및 연장할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Gradient type indent honeycomb explosion-proof construction
abstract_en: The invention provides a gradient type concave honeycomb explosion-proof structure, which comprises: the gradient type negative Poisson ratio structure layer is arranged between the panel and the back plate, the panel and the back plate are mutually coupled with the gradient type negative Poisson ratio structure, the structural integrity and strength can be improved, the gradient type negative Poisson ratio structure has stronger impact resistance than a common single-layer negative Poisson ratio structure, has low surface density, high impact strength, high anti-explosion property and good energy absorption and vibration reduction performance, and has wide application prospects in the aspects of explosion prevention, emergency rescue protection, light armor and the like.

title_en: Sticker for firefighter entry and strike point
title_ko: 소방관 진입창 및 타격점 스티커
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present application, a sticker for firefighter entry may enable smooth rescue activities even in a power outage which may occur due to a fire or a building collapse. The sticker includes: a first printed layer; a second printed layer located on the first printed layer; a removable adhesive layer positioned on the second printed layer; and a release paper layer positioned on the adhesive layer.
abstract_ko: 본 출원의 일 실시형태에 따른 소방관 진입창 스티커는 화재나 건축물 붕괴로 발생할 수 있는 정전 상황에서도 원활한 구조 활동이 가능할 수 있다.

title_en: Building collapse emergency rescue equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to emergency rescue equipment for collapse of a building, which comprises a suction and excavation robot, a gas-solid separation device and a power device, wherein the suction and excavation robot is connected with the gas-solid separation device through a pipeline; the power device is connected with the gas-solid separation device through a pipeline, and the gas-solid separation device is connected with the suction excavation robot through a pipeline; the power device is used for providing hydraulic power for the gas-solid separation device and the suction excavation robot; the power device is also used for providing suction negative pressure power for the gas-solid separation device and the suction excavating robot; the suction excavation robot is used for suction excavation of the collapsed building; the gas-solid separation device is used for storing the collapsed building sucked and excavated by the suction excavation robot; the gas-solid separation device is also used for purifying the gas in the gas-solid separation device. The emergency rescue equipment for collapse of the building, disclosed by the invention, is low in labor intensity, time-saving and labor-saving, and long in operation distance, improves the working efficiency and the timeliness of emergency rescue, and does not generate secondary collapse.

title_en: Protection device for fireman with danger detection
title_ko: 위험 감지 기능을 갖는 소방관용 보호장비
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a protection device for a firefighter with a danger detection function, and more specifically, to a protection device for a fireman with a danger detection function, wherein a communication function and a collapse risk detection function are installed on the protection device devised to ensure the safety of a firefighter, such that the risk of collapse of a building is predicted in advance and other firefighters are informed of the occurrence of danger and the location of a firefighter to be rescued. According to the present invention, the protection device for a firefighter with a danger detection function has the effect of: predicting, when a firefighter extinguishes a fire, the risk in advance so as to warn the firefighter and fellow firefighters around the firefighter; enabling communication between firefighters to be smoothly conducted in a situation of a firefighting site full of flames and smoke; and providing information, such that the location of a firefighter who is injured or unconscious can be easily identified and the firefighter can be quickly rescued.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 위험 감지 기능을 갖는 소방관용 보호장비에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 소방관의 안전을 확보하기 위한 보호장비에 통신기능과 붕괴위험감지기능을 설치하여 건물 붕괴의 위험을 미리 예측하고 다른 소방관에게 위험 발생사실과 구조대상 소방관의 위치를 알려줄 수 있도록 하는 위험 감지 기능을 갖는 소방관용 보호장비에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따르면 소방관의 화재 진압시에 위험을 미리 예측하여 자신에게 또는 주변의 동료 소방관에게 경고를 할 수 있으며, 화염과 연기가 가득한 화재진압현장의 상황에서 소방관 사이에 원활한 통신이 가능해지며, 부상을 입거나 의식을 잃은 소방관의 위치를 용이하게 파악하고 신속하게 구조할 수 있도록 정보를 제공하는 것이 가능해지는 효과가 있다.
assignees: HUMEDIA CO LTD;DOVE LIFE TEC CO LTD

title_en: Crushed material loading device
abstract_en: To provide a technique that enables recovery work, rescue activities, etc., in a place where it is difficult to perform the rescue activities and recovery work by manpower in a case of disaster such as a landslide, a building collapse, etc., caused by an earthquake or heavy rain.SOLUTION: A crushed material loading device has: a device body; three or more legs which are provided on the device body, and can change an attitude of the device body; a drilling device which drills a hole in a structure to be crushed; and a feed device which feeds crushed material as a non-explosive crushed composition into the hole formed in the structure by the drilling device. The at least three legs can be made extensible, and also changeable in angle to the device body so as to not only change the attitude of the device body, but also move the device body.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: UNIV AKITA;NIPPON KOKI KK;SANWA TEKKI CORP

title_en: BIM platform-based dynamic escape route optimization system for evacuation after disaster of building
abstract_en: The invention discloses a BIM platform-based dynamic escape route optimization system for post-disaster evacuation of a building, which comprises a seismic wave data acquisition system, a structural health condition data analysis system and a structural safety early warning feedback system; the seismic wave data acquisition system acquires seismic wave data and real-time state parameters of the structure; the structural health condition data analysis system carries out screening analysis and structural damage identification on the collected data; the structure safety early warning feedback system sequentially finishes intelligent judgment of structure damage, disaster alarm, generation of an optimal escape path and escape indication according to the structure damage data, and comprises a BIM information model platform module. The invention can fully automatically monitor and feed back the structure safety condition in real time and plan an escape path in real time, can realize the integration of building structure monitoring, alarming, post-disaster rescue and repair, and has the characteristics of intellectualization, timeliness and accuracy.

title_en: Disaster-avoiding bed for high building
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of furniture, in particular to a disaster avoidance bed for a high building. The disaster avoidance bed starts the traction mechanism through the sensor or the button arranged on the bed body, so that the bearing mechanism in the daily state can be quickly opened and fallen, and the hatch cover can be quickly closed, thereby achieving the purpose of quickly forming a disaster avoidance space. The high-strength heat insulation material adopted by the disaster avoidance bed can bear huge impact force brought by a building when the building collapses caused by earthquake and fire disaster, protects the safety of disaster avoidance personnel, and is not secondarily damaged when the disaster avoidance bed is excavated and searched and rescuing by a large machine. The disaster prevention bed adopts a double-layer heat insulation plate structure and a sealing edge structure, so that the disaster prevention bed has a sealing and heat insulation function, and high temperature and smoke during a fire disaster are effectively isolated. An emergency box is arranged to ensure life needs of disaster avoidance personnel and provide search and rescue positioning information. The folded mattress or the soft mattress can be placed to fall along with the bearing plate, so that the time for forming disaster avoidance space is greatly shortened. The invention has ingenious design and reasonable structure, and is suitable for popularization and application in the technical field of furniture.

title_en: Method for quickly identifying post-earthquake structural damage based on flexibility change rate and pattern matching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly identifying post-earthquake structural damage based on flexibility change rate and pattern matching, which comprises the following steps of: establishing a finite element model of the structure, and carrying out modal analysis on various damage working conditions; calculating the flexibility change rate of the injury to form an injury mode library; carrying out modal identification on the structure dynamic response, and calculating a matching vector to form a test set; and (5) carrying out similarity measurement on the matching vectors in the test set and a pattern library in sequence, and judging the damage position and the damage degree according to the matching result. The method has the advantages of small calculation amount and high calculation speed; the influence of excitation can be eliminated, so that the established damage mode library is not influenced by external environmental factors; the damage position and the damage degree can be efficiently and quickly identified, and the defect that the damage degree cannot be quantified by the traditional method for identifying the structural damage based on the flexibility matrix is overcome. Therefore, the method is suitable for the post-earthquake damage and safety evaluation of the structure, and has great significance for emergency rescue and emergency decision after earthquake.

title_en: Emergency rescue apparatus for building collapse
abstract_en: An emergency rescue apparatus for building collapse. The emergency rescue apparatus comprises a suction and digging robot (3), a gas-solid separation device (2) and a power device (1), wherein the power device (1) is connected to the gas-solid separation device (2) by means of a pipeline, and the gas-solid separation device (2) is connected to the suction and digging robot (3) by means of a pipeline; the power device (1) is used for providing hydraulic power for the gas-solid separation device (2) and the suction and digging robot (3); the power device (1) is further used for providing negative-pressure suction power for the gas-solid separation device (2) and the suction and digging robot (3); the suction and digging robot (3) is used for sucking and digging through a collapsed building; the gas-solid separation device (2) is used for storing collapsed building material sucked and dug through by the suction and digging robot (3); and the gas-solid separation device (2) is further used for purifying gas in the gas-solid separation device (2).
assignees: FUJIAN QIAOLONG EMERGENCY EQUIP CO LTD

title_en: Fire-receiving building collapse early warning method based on damage and damage pattern matching
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of building safety and emergency rescue, and discloses a fire-affected building collapse early warning method based on damage and damage mode matching, which comprises the following steps: marking key elements of the building structure; constructing a structural damage failure mode database based on different fire working conditions, wherein each data sample of the structural damage failure mode database is associated with a component combination causing the fire working condition; and acquiring a member damaged and destroyed on the fire scene, and judging whether a collapse risk exists or not based on the structural damage and destruction mode database. The method can quickly and accurately judge the stability condition of the fire-receiving building, early warn the structural collapse and provide a technical basis for fire extinguishing and rescue command decision on a fire scene.

title_en: Collapse monitoring and early warning system in building fire and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collapse monitoring and early warning system in building fire and an implementation method thereof. The building collapse early warning system carries out data acquisition modeling on the building, installs the deformation monitoring device at key positions in the building, gives an alarm after the preset value is exceeded, carries out comparison, analysis and processing on the acquired data and the standard data, thereby accurately early warning the collapse of the building, and transmits the early warning data to rescuers, so that the rescuers can deal with the early warning in time, the potential safety hazard of the rescuers is reduced, and the building collapse early warning system has popularization and application values.

title_en: Fire rescue that can install fast is with preventing device that collapses
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a collapse prevention device for fire rescue, which can be quickly installed and solves the technical problem that secondary collapse is easily caused due to the fact that a corresponding supporting and stabilizing device is not available in the existing ditch rescue. The device comprises a first baffle plate, a second baffle plate and an adjusting mechanism, wherein the first baffle plate and the second baffle plate are used for supporting soil bodies on two sides of a ditch; the adjusting mechanism comprises a first rotating telescopic rod movably connected with the first baffle, a second rotating telescopic rod movably connected with the second baffle, and a fixed telescopic sleeve for movably sleeving the first rotating telescopic rod and the second rotating telescopic rod. The utility model adopts the adjusting mechanism which can reasonably adjust the supporting distance between the two baffles according to ditches with different widths, and in order to avoid the support collapse caused by the pressure of soil bodies on two sides on the baffles in the rescue process, the utility model is also provided with the fixing mechanism for stabilizing the distance between the two baffles, so the application is stable and safe.

title_en: Emergency rescue device with support function under coal mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency rescue device with a support function in a coal mine well, which comprises a hydraulic rod arranged above a base and clamped and fixed with the base, wherein the hydraulic rod moves upwards a fixing plate to a proper height, a pressurizing unit works, a support mechanism moves upwards, a telescopic rod extends to different degrees according to the depression degree of a hollow part, a top plate is hinged with the fixing rod, the inclination angle of the hydraulic rod is adjusted according to the inclination degree of the joint part, the device is tightly attached to the inner wall of a mine hole and is drilled into the fixing mechanism, and an ejector pin in the fixing mechanism expands and fixes two sides, so that the top plate and a rock-soil layer are integrally fixed, and secondary collapse is prevented under the action of support force and fastening force.

title_en: Rescue method for building structure in fire state
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue method under a fire state of a building structure, which plans a rescue advancing recommended path through a preset building collapse mode, quickly matches the most appropriate advancing path when a fire occurs, and can provide powerful guarantee for the smooth development of rescue work; meanwhile, the monitoring center can master the position of the rescue worker in real time by utilizing the positioning information of the handheld positioning terminal, so that the rescue scheme can be quickly adjusted, casualties of the rescue worker are reduced, and the method has popularization and application values.

title_en: Protective device for landslide rescue
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a protective device for landslide rescue, which comprises a plurality of protective pipe bodies connected end to end, wherein crawling ladders are fixed in the protective pipe bodies, and the crawling ladders in the adjacent protective pipe bodies are connected end to end; a clamping mechanism is further arranged between the protective pipe bodies and used for connecting and fastening two adjacent sections of the protective pipe bodies; the inboard of protection body still is provided with a plurality of stiffeners, the stiffener top is provided with the plug, and the bottom is provided with the socket, and is adjacent the protection body the stiffener pass through the plug with the socket end to end. According to the protection device for collapse rescue, the protection pipe body covers the periphery of the rescue personnel, so that the damage of secondary collapse to the rescue personnel is effectively prevented, and the protection pipe bodies are structurally provided with the reinforcing rods and the like, so that the structural strength is enhanced, and the safety of rescue work is improved.
assignees: HEBEI CONVERSER EMERGENCY RESCUE TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: crashed worker escape succour safety belt
title_ko: 추락한 작업자 탈출 구조 안전대
abstract_en: An objective of the present invention is to allow a fallen worker to escape from danger since the risk of exposure to secondary accidents caused by the shock when falling, an increase in blood pressure, and extreme fear becomes high when a worker performing high place work at a construction site, an industrial site, and the like has a fall accident and hangs in the air, promote a satisfactory structure, minimize pressure through position correction while hanging in the air, and give psychological stability. A fallen worker escape rescue safety belt comprises a hook, a tightening string, a winch, a rope withdrawn from the winch, and a safety belt for connection, and a hook, a tightening string, a winch, and a safety belt fixed and connected to the winch. A wired and a wireless driving button switch for operating the winch can be used to promote an escape. The present invention has a function of correcting a position. Also, a protection pad on a waist portion of the safely belt can be withdrawn to be connected between legs to provide psychological stability and reduce pressure through position correction.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건설현장 및 산업현장 등에서 고소작업 중인 작업자가 추락 사고를 당해 허공에 매달려 있을 때, 극심한 공포 와 혈압상승, 떨어질 때 충격으로 인한 압박으로 인해 2차 사고에 노출될 위험성이 높아지므로 떨어진 근로자 스스로 위험에서 탈출할 수 있도록 하기 위함이며, 원만한 구조를 도모하기 위함이다. 또한 허공에 매달린 상태에서 자세 교정을 통해 압박을 최소화 하고 심리적 안정감을 주기 위함이다. 
기술적 수단으로 으로서 본 발명은 훅, 죔줄, 윈치, 윈치에서 인출된 로우프, 안전대로 연결 구성되어 있으며, 또한 훅, 죔줄, 윈치, 윈치 와 고정 연결된 안전대의 구성으로 된다. 윈치 작동을 위한 유, 무선 구동버튼 스위치를 사용해 탈출을 도모 할 수 있으며, 자세를 교정하는 기능을 가지고 있다. 또한 안전대 허리 부위에 보호대를 인출하여 다리 사이로 연결을 하여 자세 교정을 통한 심리적 안정감 과 압박을 줄여 주는 효과를 가지고 있다. 
색인어: (1) 훅 (2) 죔줄 (3) 윈치 (4) 로우프 (5) 안전대 (6) 구동버튼스위치 (7) 와이어 등 (8) 보호대 보관 캡 (9) 보호대 (10) 보호대 고정 장치

title_en: Apparatus, system and control method for people counting
title_ko: 피플카운팅 장치, 시스템 및 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a people counting apparatus and a system and control method thereof and, more specifically, to a people counting apparatus including a lighting function and a disaster detection function, and a system and control method thereof. According to the present invention, the people counting apparatus detects a counting target passing a detection area and determines whether the counting target is a person to generate information about the number of counted persons, thereby counting the number of people passing the detection area. The people counting apparatus provides the lighting function lighting a predetermined range including the detection area. The people counting apparatus transmits the information on the number of people counted on the basis of an ad-hook network to other nodes or gateways, thereby facilitating installation and operation regardless of indoor or outdoor. The people counting apparatus provides a disaster detection function to detect occurrence of disaster situations such as building collapses, earthquakes, fires, and gas leaks and is configured to supply auxiliary power when operating power supply is cut off or the disaster situation is detected, thereby propagating information about a disaster situation or a rescue target even when operating power is cut off due to a disaster. The people counting apparatus comprises a sensing unit, a lighting unit, a control unit, and a communication unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 피플카운팅 장치, 시스템 및 제어방법에 관한 것으로, 구체적으로는 조명 기능과 재난 감지 기능을 구비하는 피플카운팅 장치, 시스템 및 제어방법에 관한 것이다. 
또한, 본 발명은 감지 영역을 지나는 카운팅 대상을 감지하고 카운팅 대상이 사람인지 판정하여 카운팅된 사람의 수에 대한 정보를 생성함으로써, 감지 영역을 지나는 사람의 수를 카운팅할 수 있고, 감지 영역을 포함하는 소정의 범위에 빛을 비추는 조명 기능을 제공하며, 애드훅 네트워크를 기반으로 카운팅된 사람의 수에 대한 정보를 타 노드 또는 게이트웨이에 송신하도록 구비됨으로써, 실내나 실외의 구분없이 설치 및 운용이 용이하며, 건물 붕괴, 지진, 화재 및 가스 누출을 포함하는 재난 상황의 발생 여부를 감지하는 재난 감지 기능을 제공하며, 동작 전원 공급이 차단되거나 재난 상황이 감지되는 경우 보조 전원을 공급하도록 구비됨으로써, 재난으로 인해 동작 전원이 차단된 상황에서도 재난 상황이나 구조 대상에 대한 정보의 전파가 가능하다.
assignees: CHEJU HALLA COLLEGE IND ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Apparatus of emergency lamp for disaster rescue
title_ko: 재난 구조 비상등 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster relief emergency light device. The device comprises: a differential GPS unit receiving a signal of a GPS satellite to extract precise coordinate information; a disaster relief control unit recording and managing user personal information; an LED lighting unit selectively lighting on or off an LED in white or red; a solar generation unit outputting power generated by sunlight radiation to a 5.1 voltage of constant voltage or constant current or interrupting the power; a commercial electricity unit outputting the 5.1 voltage of constant voltage to the constant current or interrupting the constant voltage; an emergency charge and discharge unit charged by inputting the 5.1 voltage of constant voltage to the constant current; and an anion generation unit generating and emitting an anion when analyzing surrounding air and it is detected that harmful gas is included. Accordingly, the present invention has an effect of protecting breathing of a sufferer.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 정전, 화재, 지진, 태풍, 홍수, 붕괴 등이 포함되는 각종 재난이 발생한 지역에 위치하는 경우 생존자의 위치정보를 정말한 좌표정보로 외부에 알려주고 어두운 장소에서 조난자에게 주변을 확인하도록 조명하여 안정감을 주며, 과다한 먼지 또는 유해가스 등으로부터 조난자의 안전한 호흡을 위하여 정화된 공기를 제공하는 재난 구조 비상등 장치에 관한 것으로 지피에스 인공위성의 신호를 수신하여 50 센티미터 이내의 오차범위에 의한 정밀좌표정보를 추출하는 정밀지피에스부; 정밀지피에스부에 접속하여 현재 위치의 정밀좌표정보를 입력받고 재난 구조 비상등 장치의 전체 운용을 감시하며 각 구성부에 해당 제어신호를 각각 출력하고 각 구성부 사이의 해당 신호 전송경로를 스위칭하며 사용자 신상정보를 기록 관리하는 재난구조제어부; 재난구조제어부의 해당 제어신호에 의하여 6 개 이상의 다수로 이루어지는 5 와트급 엘이디를 선택적으로 백색 또는 적색으로 점등 또는 점멸시키는 엘이디조명부; 재난구조제어부에 접속하고 해당 제어신호를 입력하며 태양광 조사에 의하여 발전된 전력을 5.1 볼트의 정전압과 정정류로 출력하거나 차단하는 태양광발전부; 재난구조제어부에 접속하고 해당 제어신호에 의하여 상용전원을 입력하고 5.1 볼트의 정전압을 정정류로 출력하거나 차단하는 상용전원부; 재난구조제어부에 접속하고 해당 제어신호에 의하여 태양광발전부 또는 상용전원부로부터 인가되는 5.1 볼트의 정전압을 정정류로 입력하여 충전하는 비상충방전부; 재난구조제어부에 접속하고 해당 제어신호에 의하여 주변 공기를 분석하여 유해가스가 포함된 것으로 검출되면 음이온을 발생하여 배출하는 음이온발생부를 포함하는 특징에 의하여 상용전원이 공급되지 않는 경우에도 충방전배터리를 충전시키고 재난발생 상황을 국제공용 조난구조신호로 출력하면서 사이렌, SOS와 다수 통신경로를 이용하여 구조요청 신호를 송출하므로 재난상황을 주변에 정확하고 빠르게 전달하며, 조난자의 호흡을 보호하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Chest-abdomen synchronous linkage cardio-pulmonary resuscitation device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a thoracoabdominal synchronous linkage cardio-pulmonary resuscitation device which comprises a portal frame, an abdominal lifting device and a chest pressing device, wherein a cross beam of the portal frame vertically penetrates through a central rod, the left end of the central rod is connected with a left rod, the abdominal lifting device is connected to the lower end of a telescopic rod, the chest pressing device is connected to the lower end of a right telescopic rod, and the right end of the right rod is connected to a handle through a connecting rod. The invention has the following beneficial effects: the chest compression and the abdomen lifting are orderly and alternately linked to act and synchronously run; the device can be used in disaster sites in narrow spaces such as earthquakes and building collapse, and has small use limitation and strong universality; the distance and the height of the chest pressing device and the abdomen lifting device can be adjusted according to the body type of the patient; the device is fixed on a sickbed, so that the stability of the device during operation is improved; physical strength consumption is reduced, the pressing depth and frequency are guaranteed, the force and frequency can be adjusted in time, and the success rate of cardio-pulmonary resuscitation is improved; simple use, rapid use by the rescuers and the convenient popularization.

title_en: Building a smart university safety campus using safety booths
title_ko: 안심부스를 이용한 스마트한 대학 안전 캠퍼스 구축
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the construction of a safe campus of a smart university using a safety booth, which can recognize a situation of a criminal or evacuee inside and outside a safety booth. The safety booth for criminal prevention and emergency rescue, comprises: a safety booth installed to be spaced apart from each other at a dangerous area; a roof of the safety booth; a glass and a door of the safety booth; an emergency door lock installed on the door; a control center; a rim and a receiving means; a CCTV or camera, Wi-Fi, and warning light; and a fixed chair.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일측면은 범죄예방 및 긴급구조 안전부스를 이용하여 여성 및 노약자, 어린이 등이 안전부스를 통해 신속하게 격리시켜 범죄자로부터 부터 긴급구조 요청함과 동시에 안전을 제공하여 범죄예방을 방지하기 위한 안전부스; 상기 안전부스의 지붕; 상기 안전부스의 유리 및 도어문; 상기 도어문에 설치된 비상도어락; 상기 복수개 안전부스와 유무선 및 영상통신이 가능하고, 대피자와 동시에 유무선 및 영상통화가 가능한 관제센터; 상기 관제센터에 의해 상기 복수개 안전부스 위치와 비상상황을 구조자에게 실시간으로 알려주고 출동하는 알림 및 수신수단; 상기 안전부스에 장착된 CCTV 또는 카메라, 와이파이, 경광등; 및 상기 안전부스 내부에 구비된 CCTV 또는 카메라, 공중전화기, 비상벨, 스마트 미디어기, 긴급통화 장치, 비대면 ATM, AED. 함체형 탈착식 들것, 냉난방기, 고정식 의자;을 포함하고, 대피자가 상기 안전부스 내부에 장착된 상기 비상벨을 누를 경우, 상기 도어문의 비상도어락, 경과등 및 사이렌이 작동되고, 상기 비상벨의 신호는 관제센터에 송신되어서 관제요원 긴급출동중에도 구조자가 대피자에게 응급상황과 대처지시를 하면서 대피자를 구조;하고, 상기 비상벨의 해제 누를 경우 상황이 종료;되게 구성되고, 또한 상기 유리 및 도어문은, 강화유리로 이루어지면서 대피자가 비상벨을 작동할 경우 상기 도어문이 작동되어 잠겨지게 구성될 수 있고, 상기 CCTV 또는 카메라는, 상기 안전부스의 안밖의 범죄사 또는 대피자의 상황을 파악하거나, 상기 안전부스 내부의 대피자의 응급상황을 대처할 수 있도록 포함되게 구성되어 있다.
