title_en: floor indefendent type firefighting unit and floor indefendent type firefighting system using the same
title_ko: 건물 층별 소화유니트 및 이를 적용한 건물 층간 독립형 소방시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a floor independent type firefighting unit and a floor independent type firefighting system using the same. The floor independent type firefighting unit comprises: a pressurized tank which is independently arranged on the respective floor of a building and stores firefighting water in a pressurized state in a water storage space; a firefighting water supply unit which includes an opening and closing valve installed in a supply pipeline which is arranged in communication with the pressurized tank from a firefighting water spray nozzle arranged on the floor where the pressurized tank is installed, to open and close the supply pipeline according to a supply control signal; and a terminal control unit which controls the opening and closing valve to be opened when a fire detection signal is received from a fire detector installed on the floor where the firefighting water supply unit is installed so that the firefighting water stored in the pressurized tank is sprayed through the nozzle. The floor independent type firefighting unit and the floor independent type firefighting system using the same can perform fire detection and suppression independently on each floor, even when some floors collapse or the supply of commercial power is cut off due to the occurrence of a disaster situation such as an earthquake, thereby minimizing disaster damage.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물 층별 소화유니트 및 이를 적용한 건물 층간 독립형 소방시스템에 관한 것으로서, 건물 층별 소화유니트는 건물의 해당 층에 독립되게 마련되며 소방수를 저수공간에 가압상태로 저장하는 가압탱크와, 가압탱크가 설치된 층에 마련된 소화수 분사용 노즐로부터 상기 가압탱크와 연통되게 마련된 공급관로에 설치되어 공급 제어신호에 따라 상기 공급관로를 개폐하는 개폐밸브가 마련된 소화수 공급부와, 소화수 공급부가 설치된 층에 장착된 화재감지기로부터 화재감지신호가 수신되면 개폐밸브가 개방되게 제어하여 가압탱크에 저수된 소화수가 노즐을 통해 분사되게 처리하는 단말제어부를 구비한다. 이러한 건물 층별 소화유니트 및 이를 적용한 건물 층간 독립형 소방시스템에 의하면, 지진과 같은 재난상황 발생에 의해 일부 층이 붕괴되거나 상용전원의 공급이 차단되더라도 층별로 자체 화재 감지 및 진화처리를 독립적으로 수행할 수 있어 재난 피해를 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: Method for quickly constructing underground slide rail type rescue channel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue channels, and particularly discloses a method for quickly constructing an underground slide rail type rescue channel, which comprises the following steps: s1: arranging a plurality of fixing rods penetrating through the stacking bodies along the extending direction of the stacking bodies; s2: the supporting rods are connected to the front ends of the fixing rods to connect and fix the fixing rods, the supporting rods are sequentially connected to form a closed loop structure, and the fixing rods and the supporting rods form a main support frame; s3: arranging a guide assembly on the inner side of the main support frame, wherein the extending direction of the guide assembly is the same as the extending direction of the accumulation body; s4: and arranging a plurality of supporting shells in sequence along the extending direction of the guide assembly, and respectively cleaning accumulated bodies in the supporting shells so as to form a rescue channel. The method for quickly constructing the underground slide rail type rescue channel can reduce the risk of secondary collapse of an accumulation body, increase the stability and safety of the rescue channel and ensure the life safety of rescuers in the rescue process.

title_en: Disaster situation communication network infrastructure supplementation method and system using unmanned mobile device
title_ko: 무인이동체 장치를 활용한 재난상황 통신 네트워크 인프라 보완방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: An apparatus for building a communication network and collecting situation information in a field of a collapse disaster according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises: a ground drone (10) traveling by means of driving of a track device (20) and having a communication device (80) mounted thereon; a flying drone (32) mounted on the ground drone (10) to be transferred and flying according to an operational signal to photograph a field of a collapse disaster; a camera device (40) mounted on the ground drone (10) to photograph the surroundings of the ground drone (10); storage (50) installed on the ground drone (10) to accommodate a relay module (60) and throw the relay module (60) into the field of the collapse disaster according to an operational signal; and a plurality of relay modules (60) connected through a wireless communication network to relay wireless communication among the ground drone (10), the flying drone (32), and a directing control unit (100). Accordingly, situation information on a disaster field can be more accurately ensured and shared and a rescue plan can be made in a safer manner.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 붕괴 재난 현장에서 통신망 구축 및 상황정보 수집하는 장치는, 궤도 장치(20)의 구동으로 주행하고 통신 장치(80)가 탑재된 지상 드론(10); 지상 드론(10)에 탑재되어 운반되고, 작동 신호에 따라 비행하여 붕괴 재난 현장을 촬영하는 비행 드론(32); 지상 드론(10)에 탑재되어 지상 드론(10)의 주변을 촬영하는 카메라 장치(40); 지상 드론(10)에 설치되고 중계기 모듈(60)을 수납하며 작동 신호에 따라 중계기 모듈(60)을 붕괴 재난 현장에 투척하는 스토리지(50); 및 무선 통신망으로 연결되어 지상 드론(10), 비행 드론(32) 및 지휘 통제부(100) 간에 무선 통신을 중계하는 다수의 중계기 모듈(60); 을 포함한다.

title_en: Numerical simulation method for quickly constructing building collapsed ruin lifesaving channel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake field rescue, in particular to a numerical simulation method for quickly constructing collapsed ruin lifesaving channels of buildings. The method comprises the following steps: (1) And establishing a building structure numerical model by adopting an ANSYS/LS-DYNA program, generating a KEYWORDS file 1, and then solving to generate a D3DUMP file. (2) Modifying the KEYWORDS file, adding a keyword STRESS _ INITIALIZATION, and keeping the STRESS state of the collapsed ruin numerical model. (3) Performing 'secondary editing' on the structural collapse ruin numerical model, adding a keyword DELETE _ ELEMENT, and deleting a component unit to realize removal and breaking rescue technology in the rescue process. (4) And generating a new KEYWORDS file 1+i (i =1,2,3 …), and realizing the construction of the ruin numerical model lifesaving channel. The numerical simulation method for quickly constructing the building collapse ruin lifesaving channel can provide scientific and reliable basis for quickly determining the rescue direction and constructing the lifesaving channel for commanders in earthquake sites.

title_en: Operation method for gas detetction robot
title_ko: 기체 탐지 로봇의 운용 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a gas detection robot operation method capable of enabling an emergency response and minimizing the loss of lives in a terror and disaster site, which is difficult for people to access, such as a fire, a harmful gas leak, a collapse, an explosion risk or the like. Moreover, in accordance with the present invention, the gas detection robot operation method includes: an overall search step of measuring gas in a predetermined area for a predetermined time through a gas detection robot, and comparing d_t, which is a concentration value of the measured gas, and d_t-1, which is a gas concentration value measured for the predetermined time before the d_t measurement in the predetermined area, with each other; and a termination step of terminating the overall search step when the value of the d_t-1 is greater than the d_t in the overall search step.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재, 유해가스 누출, 붕괴 및 폭발 위험 등 사람이 접근하기 어려운 테러 및 재난현장에서 긴급 대응이 가능하고 인명 피해를 최소화할 수 있는 기체 탐지 로봇의 운용 방법에 관한 것이다. 
또한, 본 발명은 기체 탐지 로봇을 사용하여 소정의 시간 동안 소정의 영역에서 기체를 측정하고, 측정된 기체의 농도 값인 d t 와 상기 소정의 영역에서 상기 d t  측정 이전에 상기 소정의 시간동안 측정된 기체 농도 값인 d t-1 을 서로 비교하는 전체적 탐색 단계 및 상기 전체적 탐색 단계에서 상기 d t 보다 상기 d t-1 의 값이 크면 상기 전체적 탐색 단계를 종료하는 종료 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Fixed multi-sensor device
title_ko: 고정형 멀티 센서 디바이스
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fixed multi-sensor device. The fixed multi-sensor device, installed in a utility-pipe conduit to detect and respond to a fire or disaster situation, comprises: a fire detection module that detects flame or smoke to provide a fire detection signal; a complex environment detection module that detects temperature, humidity, combustion gas, or volatile gas to provide an environmental information detection signal; a disaster detection module that detects vibrations caused by earthquakes, cracks, or collapses o provide a disaster detection signal; a communication module that receives a control signal from an external control device and transmits the fire detection signal, environmental information detection signal, or disaster detection signal to the external control device; a control module that controls the overall operations of the fixed multi-sensor device in a normal mode or an emergency mode according to the control signal transmitted through the communication module, wherein in the normal mode, a constant detection function of the fire detection module, complex environment detection module, and disaster detection module is performed, and in the emergency mode, an alarm operation upon detection of a fire or disaster is performed in accordance with a signal from at least one of the fire detection module, complex environment detection module, and disaster detection module; a power module that provides power required to drive the fixed multi-sensor device under the control of the control module; and an escape guidance module that outputs guidance light designed as an entry prohibition sign or an evacuation direction sign in a preset direction in an emergency mode under the control of the control module.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 고정형 멀티 센서 디바이스에 관한 것으로서, 공동구에 설치되어 화재 또는 재난 상태를 감지하여 대응하도록 하는 고정형 멀티 센서 디바이스에 있어서, 불꽃 또는 연기를 감지하여 화재 감지 신호를 제공하는 화재감지모듈; 온습도, 연소 가스 또는 휘발성 가스를 감지하여 환경정보 감지 신호를 제공하는 복합 환경 감지 모듈; 지진, 균열 또는 붕괴로 인해 발생되는 진동을 감지하여 재난 감지 신호를 제공하는 재난 감지 모듈; 외부의 제어장치로부터 제어 신호를 수신하고, 상기 화재 감지 신호, 환경정보 감지 신호 또는 재난 감지 신호를 외부의 제어 장치로 송신하는 통신 모듈; 상기 통신 모듈을 통해 전송되는 제어 신호에 따라 상기 화재감지모듈, 복합 환경 감지 모듈 또는 재난 감지 모듈의 상시 감지 기능을 수행하는 일반 모드와, 상기 화재감지모듈, 복합 환경 감지 모듈 또는 재난 감지 모듈 중 적어도 어느 하나의 신호에 따라 화재 또는 재산 감지시 알람 동작을 수행하는 비상 모드로의 동작을 수행하도록 고정형 멀티 센서 디바이스의 전반적인 동작을 제어하는 제어 모듈; 상기 제어 모듈의 제어에 따라 고정형 멀티 센서 디바이스의 구동에 필요한 전원을 제공하는 전원 모듈; 및 상기 제어 모듈의 제어 따라 비상 모드시 진입 금지 표시 또는 기 설정된 방향으로의 대피 방향 표시로 디자인된 유도광을 출력하는 탈출 유도 모듈을 포함하는 것이다.

title_en: Intelligent broken assembly and disassembly equipment for building collapse rescue
abstract_en: The application discloses intelligent breaking and dismantling equipment for building collapse rescue, which comprises a breaking and dismantling equipment body, wherein the breaking and dismantling equipment body comprises a traveling system and a control console arranged above the traveling system, two ends of the control console are provided with adjustable traveling auxiliary components, one side of the top of the control console is provided with an operating part, the operating part comprises an operating force arm, a replacing table is arranged above the operating force arm, a quick-changing device is arranged on the replacing table, the quick-changing device is provided with a breaking hammer, a bucket, a hydraulic grab bucket and a cutting saw, one end of the control console is provided with a protruding control part, the top of the protruding control part is provided with strip-shaped convex strips, and the strip-shaped convex strips are arranged at intervals. The beneficial effects of the application are as follows: compact structure, promote the demand to different rescue environment, improve the broken effect of tearing open of rescue and the stability of equipment.

title_en: Electric breaking and dismantling tool set
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electric breaking and dismantling tool set, which relates to the technical field of rescue tools and comprises a generator arranged in a carriage of a fire engine, a vehicle rescue tool arranged in the carriage and electrically connected with the generator, an urban comprehensive rescue tool arranged in the carriage and electrically connected with the generator and an earthquake building collapse rescue tool arranged in the carriage and electrically connected with the generator. The electric breaking and disassembling tool set provided by the utility model unifies the power sources of various rescue tools, and can be used by placing various rescue tools on a fire engine at the same time.
assignees: SHANGHAI HUARUI RESCUE EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning technology-based fire scene collapse risk early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire scene collapse risk early warning method based on a digital twin technology, which belongs to the technical field of fire scene collapse risk early warning, and mainly adopts the following scheme: acquiring fire scene building environment information, establishing a fire scene building environment digital twin model according to the fire scene building environment information, and determining a collapse initial profile according to the floor temperature distribution information of a combustion area; determining an additional collapse profile; determining collapse risk level by using the thickness information of the floor slab in the burning area and the weight information of the articles on the floor slab in the burning area; determining a predicted collapse profile according to the additional collapse profile and the initial collapse profile; and when the position of the firefighter is coincident with the predicted collapse profile, the predicted collapse profile information and the collapse risk level are timely sent to the firefighter so as to realize collapse risk early warning, and the firefighter in the collapse area is early warned, so that casualties caused by collapse of the building in a fire disaster are effectively avoided.
assignees: GUANGDONG GUANGYU SCIENCE AND TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Seismic structure desgin method of fire extinguishing piping
title_ko: 소화배관의 내진구조 설계방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a seismic structure design method applied to a fire extinguish pipe of a fire prevention facility, which comprises: a fire extinguishing pipe determination step which determines a fire extinguishing pipe facility where a seismic structure design will be applied; an earthquake load selection step which selects an earthquake load on the fire extinguishing pipe determined by the fire extinguishing pipe determination step; an equivalent static load production step which produces an equivalent static load in the horizontal direction applied to the fire extinguishing pipe by earthquakes when the earthquake occurs; a dynamic analysis applying step which applies the dynamic analysis to the fire extinguishing pipe to review the safety of a member to be fixed to the fire extinguishing pipe; a structural safety checking step which checks the structural safety of a basic facility fixed to the floor; and a fixing method determination step which determines a fixing method of the member installed in the fire extinguishing pipe. According to the present invention, the method can improve the accuracy and precision of the seismic structure design.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방시설의 소화배관에 적용되는 내진구조 설계방법에  관한 것으로, 내진구조 설계가 적용될 소화배관 설비를 결정하는 소화배관 결정 단계; 상기 소화배관 결정 단계에 의해 결정된 소화배관에 지진 하중을 선정하는 지진 하중 선정 단계; 지진 발생 시 지진에 의해 소화배관에 적용되는 수평방향의 등가정적하중을 산정하는 등가정적하중 산정 단계; 소화배관에 동적해석법을 적용하여 소화배관에 정착될 부재의 안전성을 검토하는 동적해석 적용 단계; 바닥에 고정되는 기초 설비의 구조안전성을 확인하는 구조 안전성 확인 단계; 및 소화배관에 설치되는 부재의 정착 방법을 결정하는 정착방법 결정 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하고 있다.
assignees: AN CHANG YUP;O HEUNG GYU;KIM KIL JOONG

title_en: Rail embankment disease emergency rescue reinforcement structure and reinforcement method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway embankment disease emergency rescue reinforcement structure and a reinforcement method, which belong to the technical field of roadbed retaining protection, and are used for forming a reinforcement structure on a retaining structure on one side of an embankment slope, wherein the reinforcement structure comprises a support panel attached to one side of an inclined plane of the retaining structure and a support structure arranged at intervals with the support panel, and the support structure penetrates into a ground plane along a vertical part to fix the support structure; and still be equipped with the backup pad between support panel and the bearing structure, this backup pad one end butt support panel's inclined plane, its other end and bearing structure butt to support the panel tightly on the inclined plane of retaining structure. The support panel and the support structure are arranged on the basis of not damaging the original supporting structure, so that the stable use of the supporting structure can be ensured by the existing reinforcing structure, the problems of long construction period and secondary collapse in the construction process caused by damaging the supporting structure are avoided, and the safety and timeliness of repairing and disposing of the supporting structure are greatly improved.

title_en: Buried person search device using detachable module
title_ko: 분리형 모듈을 활용한 매몰자 탐색 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a shipwrecked person detecting device at a collapse disaster site, and more specifically, to a buried person searching device using a detachable module. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the buried person searching device using a detachable module comprises: a ground drone (10) deployed at the collapse disaster site, traveling by driving a track device (20), and equipped with a communication device (80) and a first beacon; a camera device (40) mounted on the ground drone (10) to photograph the front, rear, left and right sides, and top of the ground drone (10); a storage (50) installed on the ground drone (10), storing a repeater module (60), and throwing the repeater module (60) at the collapse disaster site according to an operation signal; a plurality of repeater modules (60) connected to a wireless communication network to relay wireless communication between the ground drone (10), a flying drone (32), and a command and control unit (100) and equipped with a second beacon; and a detection device (70) installed on the ground drone (10) or the repeater module (60) to collect human breathing sounds, voice sounds, mobile phone sounds, and artificial rhythm sounds. According to the present invention, it is possible to more clearly determine whether someone needs help, and if so, where and in what situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 붕괴 재난 현장의 조난자 탐지 장치 더욱 구체적으로 분리형 모듈을 활용한 매몰자 탐색 장치는, 붕괴 재난 현장에 투입되어 궤도 장치(20)의 구동으로 주행하고 통신 장치(80)와 제1 비컨(Beacon)이 탑재된 지상 드론(10); 지상 드론(10)에 탑재되어 지상 드론(10)의 전후방, 좌우 측방 및 상방을 촬영하는 카메라 장치(40); 지상 드론(10)에 설치되고 중계기 모듈(60)을 수납하며 작동 신호에 따라 중계기 모듈(60)을 붕괴 재난 현장에 투척하는 스토리지(50); 무선 통신망으로 연결되어 지상 드론(10), 비행 드론(32) 및 지휘 통제부(100) 간에 무선 통신을 중계하고 제2 비컨(Beacon)이 탑재된 다수의 중계기 모듈(60); 및 지상 드론(10) 또는 중계기 모듈(60)에 설치되어 인체 숨소리, 육성, 휴대전화기 소리 및 인위적 리듬 소리를 수집하는 감지 장치(70); 을 포함한다.

title_en: Real-time early warning method for secondary collapse risk of RC frame semi-ruin structure after earthquake
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of earthquake on-site rescue and early warning, in particular to a real-time early warning method for secondary collapse risk of a ruin structure of an RC frame. The method comprises 4 modules, wherein the module 1 is used for realizing the whole process of the RC frame structure from intact to ruins and then to secondary collapse through simulating a main-aftershock effect by using a seismic simulation vibrating table, the module 2 is used for processing the structural dynamic response time course data by adopting a high-dimensional continuous transverse moving time window method and obtaining dynamic response characteristics of the RC frame semi-ruins secondary collapse structure, the module 3 is used for clustering the secondary collapse risk type of the RC frame semi-ruins structure by using a K-Means machine learning algorithm, and the module 4 is used for realizing real-time early warning of the secondary collapse risk of the RC frame semi-ruins structure by using Informer machine learning algorithm. The invention can scientifically and accurately judge and predict the risk of secondary collapse of the RC frame ruin structure under the aftershock.

title_en: Portable tape measurement for safety diagnosis and check
title_ko: 안전점검 및 정밀안전진단 성능평가 시 사용 가능한 균열측정 휴대용 줄자
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a portable tape measure for measuring cracks that can be used for safety inspection and performance evaluation of precise safety diagnosis, wherein the depth of cracks generated on a structure can be measured using a measure, and if a pipe (fire-extinguishing water pipe, gas pipe, communication pipe, etc.) is in front of the cracks, the measure is supported using the pipe to arrange a flexible measure stably in the longitudinal direction of the cracks without folding and sagging, thereby measuring the depth of the cracks accurately. The portable tape measure for measuring cracks that can be used for safety inspection and performance evaluation of precise safety diagnosis according to the present invention comprises: a well known tape measure (10) having a measure accommodated in a case; a slider (20) connected to the measure of the tape measure to be able to slide and moving to correspond to the position of a pipe; and a pipe supporter (30) connected to the slider to be supported on the circumference of a pipe (1). The pipe supporter moves to the pipe through the slider and then measures the depth of cracks on a structure while being supported on the pipe and supporting the measure with the pipe as a supporting base.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 안전점검 및 정밀안전진단 성능평가 시 사용 가능한 균열측정 휴대용 줄자에 관한 것으로, 자를 이용하여 구조물에 발생된 균열의 길이를 측정하고 균열의 앞쪽에 배관(소방수로관, 가스관, 통신관 등)이 있는 경우 이 배관을 이용하여 자를 지지함으로써 유연성 있는 자를 접힘과 처짐없이 균열의 길이방향을 따라 안정적으로 배열하여 균열의 길이를 정확하게 측정하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 
본 발명에 의한 안전점검 및 정밀안전진단 성능평가 시 사용 가능한 균열측정 휴대용 줄자는, 케이스 안에 자가 수납된 공지의 줄자(10)와; 상기 줄자의 자에 슬라이딩 가능하게 연결되어 배관의 위치에 맞춰 이동하는 슬라이더(20)와; 상기 슬라이더에 연결되며 배관(1)의 둘레부에 지지되는 배관 지지구(30)를 포함하여, 상기 배관 지지구가 상기 슬라이더를 통해 배관으로 이동한 후 상기 배관에 지지되어 상기 배관을 지기기반으로 하여 상기 자를 지지하면서 구조물에 있는 균열의 길이를 측정한다.

title_en: Combined tunneling mechanism for tunneling type lifesaving channel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine rescue teams, in particular to a combined tunneling mechanism for a tunneling rescue channel, which solves the problems that after the existing mine collapses, if the position of the existing mine collapses deeply, the rescue teams can enter the collapse through combining rescue instruments and a large amount of time, so that time and labor are wasted, and secondary collapse is possibly encountered in the rescue process, and the collapse is damaged again in the prior art. The combined tunneling mechanism for the tunneling type lifesaving passage comprises a tunneling mechanism, a pushing mechanism and a supporting mechanism, wherein the tunneling mechanism comprises a bottom supporting frame, a front baffle plate detachably connected to one side of the top of the bottom supporting frame, and an extension cylinder horizontally arranged on one side of the front baffle plate. The invention has reasonable structure, is convenient for splicing and extending the tunneling depth, is convenient for realizing automatic propulsion and crushing, greatly improves the rescue efficiency, saves time and labor, and simultaneously avoids the injury to rescue workers caused by secondary collapse.
assignees: JIANGSU TIANDUN HEAVY INDUSTRY MACHINERY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Graded power propulsion system and propulsion device for tunneling type lifesaving passage
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine rescue, in particular to a grading power propulsion system and a propulsion device for a tunneling rescue channel, which solve the problems that the supporting mechanism of the existing tunneling rescue machine in the prior art is inconvenient to adjust the angle, and after the mine collapses, if the position of the mine is deeper to be rescued, the rescue team is combined with a rescue instrument to enter the collapse, a great amount of time is needed, so that time and labor are wasted, and secondary collapse is possibly encountered in the rescue process, and the secondary injury is caused. The utility model provides a tunneling type life saving passageway is with hierarchical power propulsion system and advancing device, includes tunneling mechanism, pushing mechanism, adjustment mechanism and sediment mechanism, and tunneling mechanism includes bottom support frame. The invention improves the convenience of installation, thereby greatly improving the rescue efficiency, facilitating the splicing and prolonging of the tunneling depth, facilitating the realization of automatic propulsion and crushing and improving the rescue efficiency.
assignees: JIANGSU TIANDUN HEAVY INDUSTRY MACHINERY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus for experiencing the virtual reality
title_ko: 가상현실 체험장치
abstract_en: The present invention aims to provide a virtual reality experience apparatus, in which various virtual environments with respect to citizen safety, earthquakes, tsunamis, landslides, forest fires, building collapse, war, climate change, and various accidents that may occur at construction sites are configured with respective modules, a device for virtual experiences is implemented by selectively assembling modules on the ceiling, walls, and floor of a single frame according to the purpose of a virtual experience, and an experiencer can wear a VR device and enter the inside of the device so as to directly experience various virtual reality accidents. To this end, the present invention comprises: a frame for implementing a polyhedron; modular driving units which are fastened so as to be selectively attached or detached from respective areas that implement respective surfaces of the frame and can physically implement accident experience situations; a head mounted display (HMD) worn by an experiencer; and a control unit which controls the operation of the driving units to match the same with a virtual reality image displayed on the HMD.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 시민안전, 지진, 해일, 산사태, 산불, 건물붕괴, 전쟁, 기후변화, 건설현장에서 발생할 수 있는 각종 안전사고에 대한 다양한 가상환경을 각각 모듈로 구성하고, 가상체험을 위한 목적에 맞게 하나의 프레임의 천장, 벽체, 바닥부위에 모듈들을 선택적으로 조립하여 가상체험을 위한 장치를 구현하며, 체험자가 VR기기를 착용하여 장치의 내부로 진입하여 다양한 가상현실의 안전사고를 몸으로 직접 체험할 수 있도록 한 가상현실 체험장치를 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
이를 위해 본 발명은 다면체를 구현하기 위한 프레임; 상기 프레임의 각 면을 구현할 부위에 선택적으로 탈부착이 가능하도록 각각 체결되며, 안전사고 체험상황을 물리적으로 구현하는 모듈화된 구동부; 체험자가 착용하는 HMD; 상기 HMD에 디스플레이되는 가상현실 영상과 일치되도록 상기 구동부의 구동을 제어하는 제어부;로 구성된다.

title_en: Disaster training device and disaster training system
title_ko: 가상현실을 기반으로 하는 구급대응 도상훈련시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a virtual reality-based emergency response simulation training system. According to the present invention, firefighting training is performed on a virtual reality platform. The virtual reality platform comprises a user unit, a connection unit, a virtual reality unit, and a management unit. According to the present invention, it is possible to enhance disaster response capabilities.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 ICT를 활용한 가상현실 플랫폼(1)상에서 재난 상황을 재연하고, 플랫폼에 접속한 다수의 소방관과 일반인이 소방훈련과 소방체험을 개별 또는 서로 협동하여 실시하되, 상기 플랫폼(1)은 네트워크 망에 연결되어 신호의 입력과 정보의 송수신 및 출력 가능토록 지원하는 유저부(100)와, 유저부(100)들의 동시 접속을 위한 인터넷망이 구축되고, 선택적으로 외부에 저장 관리되는 정보를 호출 및 출력하는 접속부(200)와, 접속부와 연동되어 재난 상황 연출을 위한 가상공간과 체험 오브젝트 및 유저별 맞춤 아바타를 모델링하고, 아바타의 행동과 유저부로부터 입력된 메세지를 가상공간에 출력시켜 상호 소통을 유도하며, 가상공간에 재난 상황을 이벤트별로 제공 및 관리하는 가상현실부(300)와, 유저부, 접속부, 가상현실부간 송수신되는 신호와 데이터 정보를 인계받아 관리 및 제어하고, 가상공간에 연출된 재난 상황에 대한 유저들의 대처 능력을 분석 및 평가하는 관리부(400)를 포함하는 구급대응 도상훈련시스템에 있어서, 상기 가상현실부(300)는 재난상황을 재연하기 위해 설정 지역의 건축물, 도로, 자연, 환자용 NPC(Non-Player Character), 구급 도구, 재난 훈련 및 체험 오브젝트를 구축함과 아울러 플랫폼 및 프로토타입을 기반으로 구축되며, 실제에 입각하여 전체 구조를 설계하고 제공할 수 있는 모델링 기능이 제공되고, 훈련 컨텐츠 및 UX 설계서 작성 기능이 제공되며, 클라이언트의 목표 환경 결정 기능이 제공되고, 플랫폼 서버 및 DB 설계서 작성 기능이 제공되며, 대처 방법에 따른 시나리오를 설계할 수 있고, 환자 중증도 분류 알고리즘(START, SALT, RTS), 환자케이스 관리를 위한 웹기반 CMS 기능을 제공하여 각각 특정 지역들을 3D 환경으로 재연한 가상공간을 형성할 수 있음과 아울러 재연된 가상공간에는 건물, 도로 또는 주변시설 등의 건축물 뿐만 아니라, 사고차량, 경찰차량, 구급차량, 소방차 외 화재나 균열 등의 이펙트가 표현되어 실제와 같은 장소를 연출할 수 있으며, 가상공간 상에 아바타와 소품, 애니메이션 등의 구성 요소가 기획됨과 아울러 이를 관리할 수 있는 DB가 제공되고, 세부 기능을 통해 환자 생성 패턴 및 환경에 따른 상호 작용이 가능한 모델링부(310)와, 유저 아바타의 행동 인식과 텍스트를 출력하여 가상공간에서 유저간 소통을 가능케 하고, 유저 아바타에게 재난 상황을 극복 및 대처할 수 있도록 상황을 안내하는 소통안내부(320)와, 접속부로부터 접속 여부를 판별 산출한 정보, 가상공간과 유저 아바타 및 재난 관련 오브젝트, 영상, 이미지 정보와 아바타의 이동 동선을 일괄 저장하고, 외부에 저장 관리되는 정보를 호출 및 수집하여 영상, 이미지, 재난 관련 오브젝트 정보로 분류 및 저장하는 데이터센터(330)와, 수신되는 입력신호에 따라 데이터센터에 저장된 정보를 설정 경로로 전송하는 송수신부(340)를 포함하고, 상기 환자용 NPC는 환자의 연령대와 성별을 설정하는 외형 설정부(A1)와, 가상공간상에서 환자의 위치를 설정하는 위치 설정부(A2)와, 환자의 상해 위치와 중증도를 설정하는 중증도 설정부(A3)로 이루어지되, 상기 중증도 설정부(A3)는 환자의 상태를 긴급, 응급, 비응급, 사망예상, 사망 단계로 분류하여 환자 증상에 따른 미션을 부여하고, 분류된 단계별로 설정의 색상을 부여하여 유저가 환자의 중증 상태를 시각적으로 안내받을 수 있게 제공하며, 대처 시간에 따른 환자용 NPC의 증상이 변화할 수 있도록 세부 설정이 가능한 것을 포함하고, 상기 접속부(200)는, 회원정보의 입력 및 외부에 저장 관리되는 정보를 호출 가능토록 하는 인터페이스부(210), 게스트와 회원으로 구분하여 입장을 안내하고, 게스트와 회원들의 입장 여부 관련 데이터를 수집 및 관리하고, 인터페이스부에 입력된 회원정보를 승인하는 회원가입부(220), 승인 회원에 대해 가상현실부의 입장을 허용 및 안내하는 접속안내부(230), 가상현실부에 실시간 소통 가능토록 함과 아울러 유니티툴로 개발한 룸(room) 형식의 클라우드 기반 서버로 가상공간에 유저부(100)의 다중 접속을 허용하는 포톤서버부(240)를 포함하여 이루어지며, 상기 소통안내부(320)는, 유저부(100)의 입력신호를 기반으로 아바타를 형성 및 커스텀마이징 기능이 제공되는 아바타 생성부(321), 가상공간에서 아바타의 행동 및 유저가 입력한 텍스트를 출력하는 소통 출력부(322), 유저부의 입력 신호에 따라 아바타의 시점을 제어하는 카메라 제어부(323), 시점을 따라 아바타의 이동을 가능케 하고, 유저부의 입력 신호에 따라 아바타의 모션을 형성하는 아바타 동작부(324), 가상공간상에 연출할 적어도 하나 이상의 화재나 붕괴, 교통사고, 천재지변이나 인명 피해와 관련된 재난 상황 이벤트를 생성, 편집, 출력되게 하며, 제작된 재난 상황 이벤트를 유포할 수도 있으며, 타 기업에서 제작된 재난 상황 이벤트를 불러와 현 플랫폼에 적용할 수도 있고, 관리자 페이지를 통해 재난 환경 이벤트의 플레이 시간을 유동적으로 설정할 수 있으며, 각각의 재난 상황 대처 능력을 평가하기 위한 난이도에 맞춰 시간 제한 모드나, 각종 미션 훈련을 적용시킬 수 있도록 형성되는 이벤트 관리부(325)를 포함하여 이루어지고, 상기 관리부(400)는, 유저부(100)의 행동 정보를 수집하는 모션수집부(410), 유저의 행동 정보를 바탕으로 재난 대처 능력을 판단하는 산출부(420), 산출된 내용으로 유저 개별 및 대단위의 재난 대처 능력을 단계별로 평가할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 개별 및 대단위가 각각 목적을 달성한 시간 및 대처 능력을 분석할 수 있는 시스템을 제공하며, 기입력된 프로그램에 의해 개별 및 대단위 각각에 대처가 미흡했던 부분을 각각 실시간 분석하여 해결 방안을 피드백 해주는 평가부(430)를 포함하여 이루어진다.

title_en: Underground facility survey system for measuring depth of underground facility using level staff
title_ko: 수준 표척을 이용하여 지하시설물의 심도를 측정할수 있는 지하시설물 측량시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an underground facility surveying system and, more specifically, to an underground facility surveying system capable of measuring the depth of an underground facility by using a level indicator. The underground facility surveying system comprises: a lower level indicator which can be inserted into an excavation hole and has a scale engraved on the front surface thereof; an upper level indicator which is inserted into the lower level indicator, can be adjusted in length in a sliding and elastic manner, and has a scale engraved on the front surface thereof; a rotary buffer landing means which is provided at the lower end of the lower level indicator; a vertical maintaining means which is coupled to the upper end of the lower level indicator and allows the lower level indicator and the upper level indicator to be vertical; a foldable handle which is foldably connected to the upper end of the lower level indicator; and a level device which is installed adjacent to the outside of the excavation hole and can measure the scale engraved on the lower level indicator and the upper level indicator. The underground facility surveying system can prevent casualties caused by earth and sand collapse or fall by allowing a level indicator to stand at a desired point without entering the excavation hole.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하시설물 측량시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 굴착공 안으로 진입시킬 수 있으며 전면에 눈금이 새겨진 하부표척, 하부표척에 삽입되어 슬라이드 신축식으로 길이 조절이 가능하며 전면에 눈금이 새겨진 상부표척, 하부표척의 하단에 구비되는 회전식 완충착지수단, 하부표척의 상단에 결합되어 하부표척과 상부표척이 수직을 이루도록 하는 수직유지수단, 하부표척의 상단에 접이식으로 연결되는 접이식 핸들 및 굴착공의 바깥에 인접 설치되어 하부표척과 상부표척에 새겨진 눈금을 측정할 수 있는 레벨장치를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하여, 표척수가 굴착공 내로 들어가지 않고서 표척을 원하는 지점에 세울 수 있어 토사붕괴 또는 추락 등에 의한 인명사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있는 수준 표척을 이용하여 지하시설물의 심도를 측정할 수 있는 지하시설물 측량시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Bridge rescue training facility and training method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bridge rescue training facility and a method, wherein the bridge rescue training facility is provided with a bridge area and a bridge lower area, a plurality of engineering elevators and a plurality of stairways are arranged on the side face of the bridge area, the engineering elevators are used for assisting in carrying appliances to a bridge deck, the bridge rescue training facility is provided with structural stress monitoring sensors at structural stress points, the structural stress monitoring sensors are used for monitoring structural stability in real time, when a structural member is damaged or reaches a maximum set stress value, the bridge area is provided with a bridge intact section, a bridge damaged section and a traffic accident occurring section, the bridge lower area is provided with a dangerous chemical tank car accident occurring section, the bridge damaged section is provided with a bridge damaged point and a bridge damaged section, the bridge upper structural damage, the lower structural damage, the foundation damage and the bridge broken scene are simulated after an earthquake disaster, the bridge is rapidly broken, the bridge is robbed, and the bridge damage points are positioned on a bridge deck, a drop-proof baffle, a supporting seat, a pier and the foundation position.

title_en: Building collapse search and rescue skill simulation training method
abstract_en: The application provides a building collapse search and rescue skill simulation training method which is applied to a simulation training system; the simulation training system comprises terminal equipment and a training platform; the terminal equipment is pre-configured with a training virtual scene corresponding to a search and rescue link of building collapse; the practical training platform comprises an anthropomorphic dummy, a broken and detached practical training platform and a supporting practical training platform; the method comprises the following steps: the terminal equipment acquires equipment wearing data of a user; the terminal equipment displays a plurality of practical training virtual scenes, receives practical training operation instructions of a user aiming at each practical training virtual scene, and obtains simulation training data; the user performs search and rescue skill training through a breaking and tearing training platform and a supporting training platform in the training platform, and real training duration data and real training results of the user are obtained; based on equipment wearing data, simulation training data, training duration data and training results, determining search and rescue skill training results of the user, the method is simple in scene construction, easy in practical training and high in training frequency, and training efficiency is greatly improved.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU J&T HI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dam flood discharge energy dissipation structure safety risk assessment method based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dam flood discharge energy dissipation structure safety risk assessment method based on a Bayesian network, which comprises the steps of constructing a finite element simulation model of a dam and a Bayesian network of the dam flood discharge energy dissipation structure; searching a damage path in the finite element simulation model by adopting a flood discharge energy dissipation structure damage criterion; calculating the damage probability p  o  of each structural damage mode by adopting a Monte Carlo method according to the risk agent model, the mechanical parameters of the dam and foundation materials and the hydraulic parameters of the overflow surface; calculating the structural system damage probability p  α  of the flood discharge energy dissipation structure; when any damaged path o is assumed to be absent, calculating damage probability of flood discharge energy dissipation structure when disaster factors of damaged path o are not damaged based on the rest damaged paths and Bayesian network ; According to p  α  and Calculating the importance of disaster factors of the damaged path o; and selecting a failure path corresponding to the disaster causing factor with the highest importance as a main control path for destroying the flood discharging and energy dissipating structure.

title_en: Emergency rescue method and emergency rescue system for collapsed building
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency rescue method and an emergency rescue system for a collapsed building, and relates to the technical field of emergency rescue. The emergency rescue method for the collapsed building comprises the following steps: step one: before the building collapses, the detection unit predicts earthquake information in advance and gives out warning through the alarm unit, and on-site personnel make a response according to the emergency unit; step two: after the building collapses, the position of a person is detected through a rescue unit, the rescue is excavated, and medical care is timely ensured; step three: temporary dwellings are built outdoors through the building units, rescue channels are provided, and ground cushion pads are paved to cope with secondary earthquakes. According to different earthquake grades, the emergency unit can flexibly select equipment such as an emergency channel, an emergency protection box, an anti-explosion self-rescue bag and the like, so that on-site personnel can make optimal selection according to the environment where the emergency unit is located, and each module of the emergency rescue system cooperatively works, thereby ensuring efficient and orderly rescue process.

title_en: Bridge-cut-off disaster simulation device for emergency rescue training
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of simulation devices, in particular to a broken bridge disaster simulation device for emergency rescue training. Including support column, connecting plate, revolving frame I, revolving frame II etc. two connecting plates all are connected between the support column, and revolving frame I rotates to be connected on the support column, and revolving frame II rotates to be connected on revolving frame I. According to the invention, clean water is added into the water pool, then the cement board is placed between the rotary frame I and the top of the rotary frame II, so that a bridge on a river can be simulated, and then the rotary frame II and the rotary frame I rotate sequentially, so that the cement board falls into the water pool, a bridge-breaking accident and secondary collapse can be simulated, and thus emergency rescue training can be conveniently carried out by rescue workers in a simulation experiment of the bridge-breaking accident and the secondary collapse, the emergency rescue consciousness of the rescue workers is improved, the simulation training can be carried out on the whole condition of the rescue workers, and the training effect on rescue can be maximized.
assignees: CHINA CONSTR 7TH ENG DIVISION CORP LTD

title_en: Earthquake and collapse building rescue waste residue transferring equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses earthquake and collapse building rescue waste residue transfer equipment, which solves the problem that a conveying device in the prior art cannot be suitable for building collapse or earthquake rescue sites. The earthquake and collapse building rescue waste residue transfer equipment comprises a linear conveying assembly, a turning conveying assembly, a supporting assembly for supporting the linear conveying assembly and the turning conveying assembly to leave the ground, a connecting assembly matched with the linear conveying assembly and the turning conveying assembly, and a mobile power supply for supporting the linear conveying assembly and the turning conveying assembly to supply power; the supporting straight line conveying components, the turning conveying components or the supporting straight line conveying components and the turning conveying components are connected through connecting components. According to the invention, the linear conveying assembly, the turning conveying assembly, the supporting assembly, the mobile power supply and the connecting assembly are matched for use, and the linear conveying assembly and the turning conveying assembly can be assembled according to the field environment, so that waste residues can be conveyed conveniently, and the cleaning speed of a rescue channel is improved.

title_en: Earthquake rescue scene secondary collapse monitoring and early warning device
abstract_en: The earthquake rescue site secondary collapse monitoring and early warning device comprises a collapse supporting component and monitoring and early warning components arranged at two ends of the collapse supporting component; the collapse supporting assembly comprises a first linear screw 1, a second linear screw 2, a screw connecting rod 3, a telescopic supporting rod 4 and a monitoring and early warning assembly mounting block 5. The utility model can monitor the collapse building on the earthquake rescue site, and can early warn when the collapse building has secondary collapse signs, thereby preventing casualties of search and rescue personnel.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM;SHANGHAI BEIAN IND CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent dialogue platform for building industry
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent dialogue platforms, in particular to an intelligent dialogue platform for building industry, which comprises the following components: the system comprises a man-machine interaction module, an image acquisition module, a data analysis module, a three-dimensional modeling module, a data storage module, a cloud server and a control management module; the method comprises the steps of repairing a damaged building according to a shot damaged building picture and text data uploaded by a user, drawing a three-dimensional model, displaying repairing reasons and repairing concepts in a text mode by a platform, and adjusting unsatisfied positions on the three-dimensional model of the platform by the user through uploading the picture and the text, so that people can repair the damaged ancient building conveniently, the ancient building can be protected better, or a collapsed building in a natural disaster can be repaired, and rescue workers can know the building structure as soon as possible and rescue can be implemented.
assignees: JINAN HUIGU DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mobile Internet of things alarm device for earthquake rescue site
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a mobile Internet of things alarm device for a seismic rescue site, which improves the prior art, and in actual use, when rescue workers search for and rescue work, the rescue workers can carry out aftershock alarm if aftershock occurs through an aftershock alarm component, so that the probability of accidental injury caused by the rescue workers is greatly reduced, the mobile Internet of things alarm device is very suitable for the rescue site, and the casualties caused by secondary collapse of houses due to strong aftershock can be effectively reduced.

title_en: Prediction method for highest temperature and position of fire roof of underground inclined tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a prediction method for the highest temperature and the position of a fire roof of an underground inclined tunnel, belongs to the technical field of tunnel fire safety, and solves the problem that the error of the determination method for the highest temperature and the position of the highest temperature of the fire roof of the inclined tunnel in the prior art is large. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the fire early warning capability is improved, the fire source position can be effectively identified by accurately predicting the highest temperature and the position of the ceiling when the fire occurs in the inclined tunnel, important references are provided for rescue workers, and the timeliness and the accuracy of fire emergency response are enhanced. The method reduces structural damage, predicts the highest temperature of the ceiling and the position of the ceiling, can take protective measures in time or in advance, reduces damage of fire to the tunnel structure, and prolongs the service life of the tunnel.

title_en: High-rise building monitoring system with emergency evacuation guidance function
title_ko: 비상 대피 유도 기능을 갖는 고층 건물 잔불 감시 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for monitoring a residual fire of a high-rise building having an emergency evacuation guidance function. To this end, the system for monitoring a residual fire of a high-rise building having an emergency evacuation guidance function comprises: a movement detection stand having a thermal imaging camera simply installed on each fire floor of a building to monitor the residual fire after primary fire extinguishing; a dedicated terminal for receiving information detected by the movement detection stand installed on each fire floor through short-range communication and long-range communication and outputting the information; and a relay server for receiving and collecting information on the residual fire by each movement detection stand through long-range communication, monitoring the information, and relaying the information to the dedicated terminal. The dedicated terminal has an evacuation module for predicting the risk of collapse of a building at a residual fire suppression site by itself and generating a risk alarm to a firefighter to induce emergency evacuation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비상 대피 유도 기능을 갖는 고층 건물 잔불 감시 시스템에 관한 것으로, 이를 위해 1차 소화 후 잔불을 감시하기 위해 건물의 각 화재층에 간이 설치되는 열화상카메라를 갖는 이동감지대;와, 상기 각 화재층에 설치된 이동감지대에 의해 감지된 정보를 근거리통신 및 원거리통신으로 연결받아 출력되는 전용단말기; 및 상기 각 이동감지대에 의해 잔불에 관한 정보를 원거리통신을 통해 제공받아 취합한 후, 이를 모니터링하고 더불어 전용단말기로 중계하는 중계서버;를 포함하여 이루어지되, 상기 전용단말기는 자체적으로 잔불 진압 현장의 건물의 붕괴 위험을 예측하고 소방대원에게 위험 경보를 발생시켜 비상 대피를 유도하는 대피모듈를 갖는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Post-earthquake wounded rescue difficulty assessment method and system based on building collapse form
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-earthquake wounded rescue difficulty assessment method and system based on a building collapse form, and relates to the technical field of post-earthquake rescue, wherein the method comprises the steps of extracting geometric form and attribute information of a destroyed building based on earthquake damage analysis of a target earthquake region, and establishing a to-be-collapsed simulation building model; the method comprises the steps of loading a building model to be collapsed with earthquake, generating a ruin model after earthquake reflecting collapse forms based on an explicit time integration method, extracting geometric and spatial characteristics of the ruin model after earthquake, dividing collapse form types of the ruin model after earthquake, calculating comprehensive rescue difficulty indexes of the ruin model after earthquake based on living space evaluation indexes and rescue channel complexity indexes, determining rescue difficulty grades of different areas in the ruin model after earthquake based on the comprehensive rescue difficulty indexes, and determining estimated rescue time of the ruin model after earthquake based on the comprehensive rescue difficulty indexes and collapse form types. The invention relieves the technical problem that the ruins are difficult to quantitatively evaluate after earthquake in the prior art.

title_en: Building collapse rescue simulation test method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of collapse rescue simulation and discloses a building collapse rescue simulation test method, which is characterized in that image data in a collapse simulation scene is recorded through a camera module, and meanwhile, information of the sensor touched by a life detector is recorded through a first sensor and a second sensor, so that a tester can timely obtain test feedback, the proficiency of the tested person in operating the life detector is improved in a test substitution mode, meanwhile, after the test, the defect in operation of the life detector can be purposefully complemented through reviewing the image data and definitely confirming the defects of the tested person, so that the existing problems are purposefully improved, the detection skill of the life detector is improved, the detection efficiency and the rescue efficiency of the rescuer in formal rescue are improved, and the rescue success rate is improved.
assignees: CHONGQING VOCATIONAL INST ENG;CHONGQING XIANCHEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Enhancing Fire Prevention and Fire Safety of Electric Vehicle Charging Stations and Suppression Control Method thereof
title_ko: 충전소 화재예방과 화재 안전성을 강화한 전기차 소화장치 시스템과 그 제어 방법
abstract_en: The electric vehicle fire extinguisher system intensifying the charging station fire prevention and fire safety comprise the battery safety diagnosis part: sensor unit: fire-extinguishing material showerhead: and controller. The present invention performs safety measures for each step of thermal runaway of an electric vehicle battery and directly sprays a fire extinguishing liquid to a lower portion of a vehicle to extinguish a fire at an early stage and prevent secondary damage.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 충전소 화재예방과 화재 안전성을 강화한 전기차 소화장치 시스템과 그 제어방법에 관한 것으로서, 소화장치 시스템은 전기차의 BMS 자기진단장치 또는 충전기로부터 제공받은 배터리에 대한 온도, 충전전압, 충전전류, 충전상태에 대한 배터리 상태정보로부터 데이터 분석과 진단을 통해 배터리 비정상상태를 진단하여 배터리 안전상태정보를 제공받을 수 있도록 된 배터리 안전진단장치부와, 전기차가 주차되는 영역내에 설치되어 충전중인 전기차 주변의 온도를 검출하는 외부 온도센서와, 전기차의 화재여부를 판단하는 화재검출센서 중 적어도 하나 이상이 마련된 센서부와, 전기차가 주차되는 영역내에 설치되어 소방수와 소화약제 중 적어도 하나 이상의 소화물질을 분사할 수 있도록 된 소화물질 분사부와, 배터리 안전진단부로부터 수신된 배터리 상태정보가 화재 예방을 위한 충전 차단조건에 해당하면 충전기의 상기 충전건으로의 전력공급을 차단하거나 조절하도록 제어하며, 센서부로부터 검출된 정보가 소화조건에 해당하면 전기차에 소화물질이 분사되게 상기 소화물질 분사부를 제어하는 제어부를 구비한다. 이러한 충전소 화재예방과 화재 안전성을 강화한 전기차 소화장치 시스템과 그 제어방법에 의하면, 충전과정에서 전기차에 장착된 배터리의 열폭주 진행 단계별로 구분하여 화재안전 조치를 보다 효과적으로 수행할 수 있어 화재예방과 화재 안전성을 강화할 수 있다.

title_en: The method for displaying building safety information using BIM
title_ko: Bim을 이용한 건축물 안전정보 디스플레이 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for displaying building safety information using bim. According to the present invention, the method comprises the steps of: extracting a fire safety grade, a structural safety grade, and an energy performance grade from an inspection manual such as a small-scale old building issued by the ministry of land, infrastructure and transport, wherein the fire safety grade includes evacuation, fireproof, and firefighting items, the structural safety grade includes land information, structures, steel frames, finishing, and living items, and the energy performance grade includes insulation, windows, and electrical equipment items; and performing bim weight reduction on structural information and spatial information. As described above, according to the present invention, detailed information on a building in a virtual environment is displayed based on bim, and safety information is contained and provided, so that building safety information based on bim can be checked intuitively and three-dimensionally in a virtual environment in a method for checking a building safety inspection based on text.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 BIM을 이용한 건축물 안전정보 디스플레이 방법에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에 따르면, 국토교통부에서 발행하는 소규모 노후건축물 등 점검 매뉴얼로부터 화재안전 등급, 구조안전 등급, 에너지 성능 등급을 추출하는 단계, 화재안전 등급은 피난, 내화, 소방 항목을 포함하고, 구조안전 등급은 대지 정보, 구조물, 철골, 마감, 생활 항목을 포함하며, 에너지 성능 등급은 단열, 창호, 전기 설비 항목을 포함하는 단계, 그리고 구조 정보 및 공간 정보에 대하여 BIM 경량화를 수행하는 단계를 포함한다.  
이와 같이 본 발명에 따르면, 가상환경에서 건축물에 대한 상세한 정보를 BIM 기반으로 디스플레이하고, 안전정보를 담아서 제공해 줌으로써 텍스트 중심으로 건축물 안전점검을 확인하는 방법에서 가상환경에서 입체적직관적으로 BIM 기반의 건축물 안전정보를 확인할 수 있다.

title_en: Building collapse risk monitoring system for fire rescue
abstract_en: The utility model provides a building risk monitoring system that collapses towards fire rescue, belongs to fire rescue technical field, including interconnect's front end sensing unit, rear end controlling means, front end sensing unit is used for gathering building inclination/acceleration, surface strain, displacement data, rear end controlling means includes central control module, display module, wireless transceiver module, protocol conversion module, interactive subassembly, power management module. The invention can improve the personal safety level of the fire rescue team when executing the task by displaying and alarming the collected data about the collapse risk of the building after processing.
assignees: SHENYANG FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Rescue structure for seismic reinforcement of school buildings and facilitating emergency evacuation during earthquakes
title_ko: 학교 건축물의 내진 보강 및 지진발생 시 긴급 대피가 용이한 구호용 구조물
abstract_en: The present invention can be applied to both existing and newly-constructed school buildings, can help prevent collapse by dissipating seismic energy during an earthquake, and at the same time, can facilitate floor-by-floor emergency evacuation during emergency situations such as earthquakes or fires.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기존에 건축 된 학교는 물론 신축 학교에도 적용 가능하며, 지진발생 시 지진에너지의 소산 효과로 붕괴 예방에 일익을 담당할 수 있음과 동시에 지진, 화재 등의 긴급 지진 발생 시 층별 긴급 대피가 용이하다.

title_en: Protective tool for auxiliary operation and rescue in collapse risk environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a protective tool for auxiliary operation and rescue in an environment with collapse risk, which belongs to the technical field of rescue protection and comprises a head assembly, a chest assembly and an external display assembly. According to the invention, collapse impact force can be effectively absorbed, the risk of craniocerebral injury is reduced, the face is prevented from being scratched by crushed objects through the protective mask, the relative breathing space can be formed, air required by breathing is provided, the transverse and longitudinal distance of the position of the buried person and the general posture of the human body when the buried person is buried can be obtained, references are provided for external rescue personnel to command large-scale machinery to participate in rescue and rescue by using tools, the rescue time is shortened, and the rescue mask can be used for talking with the trapped person in the rescue process, so that psychological comfort is carried out on the trapped person.

title_en: Device and method for rapidly rescuing and guaranteeing safety of coal mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device and a method for guaranteeing quick rescue safety of a coal mine, and relates to the technical field of coal mine rescue, wherein the device comprises a protection cylinder body, and a rescue safety channel is formed in the inner space of the protection cylinder body; the protection cylinder is internally provided with a rock drilling mechanism and a first conveying mechanism for conveying the broken stone which is drilled out to the outside of the safety channel, the protection cylinder comprises a plurality of cylinder split bodies, the lengths of the cylinder split bodies are the same as those of the protection cylinder, the cylinder split bodies are circumferentially spliced around the axis of the protection cylinder to form the protection cylinder, and the protection cylinder is internally provided with a second conveying mechanism for conveying the cylinder split bodies to the inside of the safety channel. According to the invention, the rescue safety channel is constructed by adopting the protection cylinder body formed by the split surrounding and splicing of the plurality of cylinder bodies, the protection cylinder body is firm and reliable, secondary collapse is not caused, the trapped personnel can be saved in a short time, the safety of the rescue personnel is ensured, the protection cylinder body can be repeatedly utilized, and the rescue cost is greatly saved.

title_en: Elastic continuous road pavement structure with nano-cracks
abstract_en: As part of the search for innovative and sustainable solutions for the design and construction of road pavement, the present invention consists of a continuous structure that challenges conventional maintenance paradigms. The design of the invention, which is based on an elastic and disruptive mechanistic approach, incorporates nano-cracks to improve the strength and durability of the pavement. The invention uses H30 reinforced concrete with A630-420H steel in a central mesh. This pavement is suited to different levels of traffic by means of the variation in the thickness and reinforcement of frameworks, which are installed on a continuous levelling H5 concrete grid, having a thickness that varies depending on the characteristics of the subgrade, ensuring a pavement-ground structure with structural integrity. This approach also includes features such as chamfers on the surface that prevents the edge from breaking due to the load of road traffic, ensuring its structural integrity under different traffic conditions and not requiring maintenance. In 2011, the first generation (1G) invention patent CL47.313 (José Pablo Fernández, 03 November 2008) was granted for a continuous pavement structure with an elastic and disruptive mechanistic design with nano-cracks, in ports, airports and roads, with a double continuous upper and lower mesh, and reinforcing bars at the edges. To date, a third generation invention patent has been applied for which relates to a continuous road pavement structure with a disruptive and elastic mechanistic design with nano-cracks, which is more efficient with a central mesh having a longitudinal framework at 100 mm and a transverse framework at 200 mm, and without reinforcing bars at the edges, for average traffic with a pavement thickness of 100 mm. The invention is used as a firebreak that prevents fire propagation and allows evacuation and access for rescuers and firefighters.
assignees: MADARIAGA ORREGO VERONICA;FERNANDEZ VALDIVIESO JOSE PABLO;VILLAFANAGARRIDO MARIO ALFREDO

title_en: Virtual training method and system for firefighter search and rescue escape
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of virtual training, in particular to a method and a system for virtual training of firefighter search and rescue escape, wherein the system comprises a virtual scene dynamic construction module, a door and a channel are abstracted into sides giving geometric distance weight according to a building plan, a room intersection and a corridor intersection are abstracted into nodes, the fire spreading or structure collapse event is responded in the virtual training, the weight of the corresponding sides is adjusted to infinity, a shortest path is obtained, and a reference rescue path set is established. According to the invention, through dynamic analysis of structural information of the building plan, intersections of rooms and hallways are abstracted into nodes, doors and channels are abstracted into sides with geometric weights, accessibility of the sides is adjusted in real time after fire spread or structural collapse occurs, non-passable conditions are introduced in calculating paths, and real-time adaptability and rescue simulation precision of the path generation process are improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Lining profiling reinforcing device suitable for tunnel collapse accident
abstract_en: The invention provides a lining profiling reinforcing device suitable for a tunnel collapse accident, and relates to the field of emergency rescue of tunnel collapse accidents. After the tunnel collapses, in order to provide a safe working environment for rescue workers, the damaged vault in a metastable state needs to be reinforced. At present, the emergency department mostly adopts a method for temporarily building a support body to strengthen a damaged vault, however, manual operation is rough, secondary collapse of a tunnel is easy to occur, operation time is long, the built support body occupies a large space, and smooth development of rescue work is affected. The profiling reinforcing device provided by the invention adopts a chain with multiple degrees of freedom to perform profiling lamination on the inner wall of the tunnel, and utilizes gear transmission to provide power for the profiling lamination process of each chain link, and when all the chain links are fixed on the frame, the reinforcing work on the inner wall of the tunnel is completed. The invention adopts an automatic operation mode, can support and reinforce the irregular damaged vault, and can provide safety guarantee for rescue workers.

title_en: Intelligent protection method and system for fire extinguishing protective clothing based on impact mechanics analysis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire protection equipment, and discloses an intelligent protection method and system for fire protection clothing based on impact mechanics analysis, wherein the intelligent protection method and system comprise the steps of quantifying main frequency energy of sound waves, heat radiation intensity and human impact force vector, and constructing an environment risk portrait; the method comprises the steps of carrying out grading treatment on different types of data, calculating a human body injury risk index, a collapse risk index and a secondary collapse probability to generate a collaborative threat grading table, monitoring firefighter physiological state data in real time, triggering protection actions according to threat grades and response priorities, dynamically generating a physiological-environment linkage instruction set, detecting high risk positions and triggering conditions through mapping of group topological coordinates and risk areas, generating a directional defense instruction and driving a touch vibration array, synchronously recording group protection execution logs, and dynamically correcting threat grade thresholds, linkage instruction strategies, touch feedback parameters and calculation accuracy of threat indexes in the threat grading table.
assignees: U PROTEC SHENZHEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake disaster area analysis and prediction method, device and medium based on remote sensing data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, equipment and medium for analyzing and predicting an earthquake disaster area based on remote sensing data, which comprises the steps of collecting hyperspectral remote sensing data of the earthquake disaster area after an earthquake occurs, performing cross-modal mutual information calibration, and outputting cross-modal standardized data of a hyperspectral remote sensing image; the method comprises the steps of extracting reflectance vectors corresponding to different spectrum wavelengths, constructing a linear spectrum mixed model, calculating vegetation destruction rate, classifying pixels, calculating building collapse rate of an earthquake disaster area, calculating building stability coefficients after an earthquake by using the building collapse rate, calculating surface layer geological structure stability coefficients after the earthquake, evaluating post-earthquake rescue priority by using the building stability coefficients after the earthquake, and planning vehicle types entering the earthquake disaster area by using the surface layer geological structure stability coefficients after the earthquake. Based on the remote sensing data analysis technology, the accurate prediction and analysis of the risk after the earthquake disaster area disaster are realized, and reasonable technical support is provided for rescue of rescue teams.

title_en: Intelligent fire monitoring and automatic fire extinguishing method and system in highway steel structure canopy
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire monitoring and automatic fire extinguishing method and system in a highway steel structure canopy, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multisource perception data of a fire scene through a double-spectrum imaging device, wherein the multisource perception data comprises video streams and a temperature distribution matrix; the fire source position, the heat release rate, the wind field condition and the structure configuration are input into a fire evolution prediction model, the fire expansion path and the heat intensity change are dynamically simulated, the heat release intensity and the high-temperature spreading trend of the fire source are calculated by combining a temperature distribution matrix, the comprehensive priority ranking result is calculated according to the heat release intensity, the structural damage degree, the personnel distribution and the material value of the fire source, the fire extinguishing and rescue task scheduling strategy is generated, and the fire extinguishing and rescue are performed.
assignees: SHENZHONG CHANNEL MAN CENTER;GUANGZHOU KAIBO BRIDGE ENG CO LTD;BOSHEN BRANCH GUANGDONG BODA EXPRESSWAY CO LTD;HUANGPU BRIDGE OF PEARL RIVER IN GUANGZHOU

title_en: Earthquake disaster reduction refuge bed cabin
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of household protection rescue equipment, and particularly relates to an earthquake disaster reduction refuge bed cabin. The earthquake shelter comprises a bed body, wherein a shelter cabin is arranged in the bed body, a plurality of cabin doors leading to the shelter cabin are arranged on the side part of the bed body, and when an earthquake suddenly occurs and people cannot escape outdoors, a refugee can rapidly enter the shelter cabin from the cabin doors on the side part. The refuge cabin body adopts a steel frame structure and is assembled by at least two frame units, the structure has high strength and stability, can effectively resist impact when a building collapses caused by an earthquake, prevents refuders from being directly pressed by the collapsed building, and provides a relatively safe shelter environment for the refuders. Meanwhile, foods and water (such as compressed biscuits and mineral water which are resistant to long-term storage) are stored and replaced in the refuge cabin at regular intervals, so that necessary dietary support is provided for refugees during waiting for rescue.
assignees: ZHONGFANG AIBAO CHENGDU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Heterogeneous equipment path planning method under complex collapse scene
abstract_en: The invention provides a heterogeneous equipment path planning method under a complex collapse scene, and belongs to the field of emergency rescue heterogeneous equipment navigation and path planning. Setting a terrain index threshold and an initial voxel resolution by utilizing complex collapse scene environment information and heterogeneous equipment characteristics acquired by an unmanned aerial vehicle, constructing a three-dimensional voxel map with dynamic resolution by taking octree as a frame, realizing balance of terrain details and storage efficiency, calculating basic terrain indexes and collapse catastrophe indexes, completing traversal risk assessment and passable area division, and adopting improved technology And (3) an algorithm, which fuses the terrain risk and the path smoothness requirement, and generates an optimal path for adapting to heterogeneous equipment. The method can effectively improve the safety and the high efficiency of equipment path planning in complex collapse scenes, is suitable for emergency rescue scenes such as earthquake, building collapse and the like, and provides reliable path support for heterogeneous equipment rescue operation.
assignees: UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;CHINA ACADEMY SAFETY SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Apparatus and method for generating search area information
title_ko: 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The purpose of the present specification is to provide an apparatus and method for generating information about an area in which a search for a subject to be rescued may be effectively performed by means of radio wave analysis. The apparatus for generating search area information, according to the present specification, may: identify a reference base station, which is last connected to a mobile communication terminal, from information about histories of the mobile communication terminal that has accessed base stations; and select as a search area by means of information about analysis of coverage of the reference base station. The apparatus for generating search area information, according to the present specification, may exclude unnecessary search areas or select areas requiring preferential searches by generating information about an area in which a subject to be rescued is likely to be present, rather than searching the entire signal reachable range of a base station.
abstract_ko: 】 본 명세서는 전파 분석을 통해 구조대상자 수색을 효과적으로 수행할 수 있는 영역에 대한 정보를 생성하는 장치 및 방법을 제공하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 본 명세서에 따른 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치는 이동통신 단말기가 기지국과 접속한 이력에 대한 정보에서 이동통신 단말기와 마지막으로 연결된 기준 기지국을 식별하고, 기준 기지국의 커버리지 분석 정보를 통해 수색 영역으로 선정할 수 있다. 본 명세서에 따른 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치는 기지국의 신호 도달 가능 범위를 전부 수색하는 것보다 구조대상자가 존재할 가능성이 높은 지역에 대한 정보를 생성하여 불필요한 수색 영역을 배제시키거나 우선 수색이 필요한 영역을 선택할 수 있다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for generating search area information
title_ko: 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 명세서는 전파 분석을 통해 구조대상자 수색을 효과적으로 수행할 수 있는 영역에 대한 정보를 생성하는 장치 및 방법을 제공하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 본 명세서에 따른 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치는 이동통신 단말기가 기지국과 접속한 이력에 대한 정보에서 이동통신 단말기와 마지막으로 연결된 기준 기지국을 식별하고, 기준 기지국의 커버리지 분석 정보를 통해 수색 영역으로 선정할 수 있다. 본 명세서에 따른 수색 영역 정보 생성 장치는 기지국의 신호 도달 가능 범위를 전부 수색하는 것보다 구조대상자가 존재할 가능성이 높은 지역에 대한 정보를 생성하여 불필요한 수색 영역을 배제시키거나 우선 수색이 필요한 영역을 선택할 수 있다.
assignees: SOLVIT SYSTEM CO LTD;BIG & DEEP CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake refuge locker
abstract_en: The utility model provides an earthquake shelter cabinet, which belongs to an earthquake risk preventing safety protection article. The earthquake shelter cabinet comprises a high-strength cabinet body, a shock absorption pad, an earthquake alarm, an air hole provided with a filter screen, an escape hole and a safety belt. The earthquake shelter cabinet is a storage space storing salvaging articles such as drinking water, foods, a rescue beacon, a radio, pharmaceuticals, an oxygen bottle, a torch, a mobile phone and the like; as for the suddenness and uncertainty of an earthquake, people can take precaution to prevent the loss brought by the earthquake; the earthquake shelter cabinet can reduce the fluster and helplessness when the earthquake occurs, avoid the risk of getting killed or hurt by stone, prevent the invasion of dust, fire and coal gas and improve the survival rate; and the earthquake shelter cabinet also has the advantages of convenience, quickness and safety, and is widely applied to families, units and hotels.

title_en: Fireman's safety apparatus and methods of use
abstract_en: A strap for utilization as a safety harness, particularly for use by firefighters is disclosed, wherein the strap comprises an elongated center section with four handles, two at each end extending from the elongated center section approximately opposite each other. The invention discloses a single easily deployable tool and methods which can at least carry S.C.B.A. cylinders and/or other equipment, work as a ladder belt and/or a hose strap, move charged lines, provide an increased search area, work as a hasty harness, work for dragging a victim or firefighter, work easily for Denver drill scenarios, and carry victims or firefighters up or down stairs.

title_en: Fireman's safety apparatus and methods of use
abstract_en: Methods for utilization of a safety harness, particularly for use by firefighters is disclosed, wherein the strap comprises an elongated center section with four handles, two at each end extending from the elongated center section approximately opposite each other. The invention discloses a single easily deployable tool and methods which can at least carry S.C.B.A. cylinders and/or other equipment, work as a ladder belt and/or a hose strap, move charged lines, provide an increased search area, work as a hasty harness, work for dragging a victim or firefighter, work easily for Denver drill scenarios, and carry victims or firefighters up or down stairs.

title_en: Computation reduction methode for h.264/avc motion estimation
title_ko: Ｈ.264／ａｖｃ 움직임 추정의 연산량 감소방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A computation reduction method of H.264/AVC motion estimation is provided to adjust a search area during IME(Integer Motion Estimation) and take a partial cost calculating method during FME(Fraction Motion Estimation), thereby largely reducing a computation amount. CONSTITUTION: An integer motion estimation process comprises the following units. An initial search area is extracted from motion vectors of neighbor macro blocks. Distribution values of neighbor motion vectors are calculated in x and y directions. The size of an initial search window increases in the initial search area according to the calculated distribution values of the neighbor motion vectors.
