title_en: Quakeproof and quake-resistant safety ward
abstract_en: The invention provides a quakeproof and quake-resistant safety ward which mainly comprises a buffer plate (1), an anti-impact plate (2), an anti-pressure beam (8), a partial stress plate (4), an anti-pressure column (5), an anti-collapse support (9) and a health cushion plate (10). The quakeproof and quake-resistant safety ward which is used in a building for effectively preventing earthquakes and lessening casualties in earthquakes is a safe and self-rescue facility, solves the problem of being lack of indoor earthquake safety facilities the problems of safe facility insufficiency and building quakeproof capability uncertainty in earthquake prevention and resistance, reduces common panic in the earthquake prevention and resistance, generally increases the safety feelings of people, and provides a relatively safe ward for people in the earthquake prevention.

title_en: Quakeproof safety fort
abstract_en: The invention provides a quakeproof safety fort which mainly comprises a buffer plate (1), an impact plate (2), a compressive beam (8), a separation resisting plate (4), a compressive pillar (5), an anti-sag support (9) and a body-building base plate (10). The safety fort can be used for effectively preventing and reducing the loss of life and personal injuries during earthquake and is a facility for safe self-rescue and daily effective earthquake prevention, which fills the blank of indoor earthquake safety facilities, solves the problem of insufficient safe facilities in quakeproofing all the time and the problem of uncertainty of the quake resistance of buildings, reduces universal panics caused in the quakeproofing, increases the sense of security of people and provides a relatively safe island for people in quakeproofing.

title_en: Method for constructing large through tower in mountain rock mass and section superposing method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a large through tower in mountain rock mass and a section superposing method thereof. The technical scheme adopted is as follows: the construction process comprises the steps of digging a transportation channel, connecting for construction, expanding for construction, strengthening and preburying for construction, and installing for construction. The construction of preburying and irrigating comprises the step of burying the preburied part when irrigating, and the construction of the upper and the lower standard components comprises the step of strengthening the standard component with the preburied part through the method of constructing simultaneously up and down. By using the construction method of the technique, in the construction process, the excavated stone can be output continuously from the transportation channel so that the construction schedule can be quickened and the uncertainty that the stones fall in the course of drilling from down to up is avoided; therefore, the method is safe. The method has the beneficial effects of being small in investment, low in cost, short in construction period, less in influence from disaster, free from the effect of nucleus, safe in constructing process, stable in operating process, easy in confidentiality, easy to start emergency generation system and good in reutilization; besides, multiple processes can run simultaneously in construction.

title_en: Search and rescue simulator and simulation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search and rescue simulator and a simulation method thereof. The search and rescue simulator comprises a marine simulator, an aviation simulator and a communication simulation unit, wherein the search and rescue simulator also comprises a central control simulation unit which is used for setting scene parameter information of the marine simulator and the aviation simulator, and transmitting the scene parameter information to the marine simulator and the aviation simulator; after the marine simulator and the aviation simulator loading the scene parameter information, the marine simulator transmits a distress signal to the central control simulation unit through the communication simulation unit; the central control simulation unit determines an optimal search area by combining an electronic chart according to the distress signal and transmits a search and rescue command to the marine simulator and the aviation simulator; the marine simulator and the aviation simulator performs search and rescue simulation according to the search and rescue command. Therefore, the disadvantages of high cost and high risk caused by using real equipment of a conventional marine search and rescue system for performing search and rescue practice are overcome.

title_en: Rescue system using mobile phone
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method for aiding a rescue operation by a mobile phone of a rescuer side without using a communication line.SOLUTION: By adding functions of a rescue signal transmission system and a rescue signal reception system to one mobile phone, a disaster victim can continually transmit a rescue pulse signal as a rescue signal asking for rescue by the rescue signal transmission system as long as the functions of the mobile phone work even in the case a communication line is unable to use at the time of a disaster or the phone is out of a service area. A searcher side, by the rescue signal reception system, locates a place where the rescue pulse signal transmitted by the disaster victim can be received, and narrows down a search area to a place indicating a strong level to be able to aid rescue operation.

title_en: Forest fire prevention monitoring system based on microwave and wireless transmission
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a forest fire prevention monitoring system based on microwave and wireless transmission. The forest fire prevention monitoring system comprises a monitoring center and monitoring stations, wherein each monitoring station comprises a monitoring room and a monitoring terminal, each monitoring terminal comprises a visible-light camera, a microwave transmitter and a wireless data transmission module A, each monitoring room comprises a microwave receiver and a monitoring room display, outputs of the microwave receivers are connected to the monitoring room displays, and the monitoring center comprises a central processor, a wireless data transmission module B and a TV wall. The forest fire prevention monitoring system based on microwave and wireless transmission has the beneficial effects that images shot by the monitoring terminals are sent to a duty room and the monitoring center respectively, if the fire is small or the phenomenon of uncertainty occurs, only the operator on duty goes to check out for extinguishing the fire, and if the fire is severe, the monitoring center sends additional personnel and instructs the firefighting.
assignees: JING LIN CHENGDU SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Engineering risk monitoring system and method based on state transition
abstract_en: The invention discloses an engineering risk monitoring system and method based on state transition. The system comprises an initial data processing module, a state transition visualization expression module, an image feature extraction module, an automatic learning module and an automatic image identification module, wherein the state transition visualization expression module is used for generating a state transition diagram of all states in an engineering according to data processed by the initial data processing module; the image feature extraction module is used for extracting set features from the state transition diagram; the automatic learning module is used for calculating ratio of each characteristic value to a historical average value and setting a threshold value according to the extracted features the diagram; the automatic image identification module is used for extracting setting feature of t he state transition diagram according to the image feature extraction module and judging whether the engineering is in a risk state or not according to the threshold value set by the automatic learning module. According to the system and the method provided by the invention, the problems of indeterminateness and uncertainty of underground engineering disasters can be effectively solved, and the risks of the engineering can be visually and automatically monitored, so that the intuition and intelligence are realized.

title_en: Power grid disaster real-time regulating and control device and method based on intuition fuzzy rough set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid disaster real-time regulating and control device and method based on an intuition fuzzy rough set. The method includes the steps that historical disaster data in a database unit are called; the collected historical disaster data are reduced through the method based on the intuition fuzzy rough set, and then disaster grade evaluation rules of a power grid are obtained; disaster data of the power grid are collected in real time, and the current disaster grade of the power grid is determined according to the formed historical disaster grade evaluation rules; the data which are evaluated in real time are updated to a historical database and used for addition and modification of a power grid disaster knowledge base; power grid disaster emergency responses are conducted, namely, corresponding emergency restoration measures are taken according to different disaster grades to regulate and control the power grid. According to the system and method, the situation that the data size used in the power grid disaster evaluation process has fuzziness, randomness, uncertainty, redundancy and other characteristics is taken into account, the defect that internal relations and potential relations of data attributes can not be acquired through a traditional probability theory and other method is successfully overcome by the utilization of the method based on the intuition fuzzy rough set, and evaluation accuracy is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;SHENYANG POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;UNIV NORTHEASTERN

title_en: Early warning method for fire disaster in passenger car engine cabin
abstract_en: The invention discloses an early warning method for the fire disaster in a passenger car engine cabin. The method comprises the steps that a mamdani type fuzzy inference system of the fire disaster of the passenger car engine cabin is established, temperature data, oil gas data and current data inside the passenger car engine cabin are collected through a sensor, the collected data are converted into a corresponding temperature rate, corresponding oil gas concentration and a corresponding current pulse, the corresponding temperature rate, the corresponding oil gas concentration and the corresponding current pulse are input into the fuzzy inference system, the danger class of the fire disaster in the current passenger car engine cabin is obtained based on a fuzzy interference rule, and the early warning judgment is further made. The uncertainty and the limitation of a single parameter are overcome according to the coordination of a plurality of parameters and the complementary advantage of the performance, the effective performance of the early warning is improved, and according to the complex environment in the engine cabin, the fire disaster danger degree in the cabin can be effectively judged very well based on the occurrence characteristics of the passenger car fire disaster and the information fusion technology of the fuzzy theory.

title_en: The automatic identifying method of plant leaf blade damage symptoms
abstract_en: An automatic identifying method for plant leaf blade damage symptoms, it comprises the following steps: 1) obtain target leaf image; 2) target leaf image process; 3) Image differentiation and the analysis of regional standard colour is carried out; 4) quadratic function regretional analysis and regression parameter calculating is carried out according to area image norm value; 5) calculating of threshold parameter is carried out with method of analysis of variance; 6) discriminatory analysis of target blade damage symptoms is carried out with Optimal Parameters.The present invention achieves the automatic discrimination of plant leaf blade " ∧ " and " ∨ " type damage symptoms by application image measurements and calculations machine recognition technology, determine its harm mechanism by damage symptoms, accurate quantitative analysis is differentiated that " ∧ " and " ∨ " type damage symptoms and root of being injured thereof have important directive function; Be conducive to solving the uncertainty of current plant leaf blade damage symptoms in research and production and dispute; Robotization is differentiated to the disasters such as plant leaf blade meteorology and disease have most important theories and practical significance.

title_en: Evaluation method of geological disaster risk attribute interval of tunnel and underground construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation method of a geological disaster risk attribute interval of a tunnel and underground construction. The evaluation method comprises the following evaluation steps: (1) establishing a risk evaluation index system and a grading standard thereof; (2) constructing a single-index attribute measure function of the evaluation index; (3) determining a weight vector of a risk interval evaluation index; (4) determining a measurement value interval of the evaluation index, and calculating a single-index attribute measure value of the measurement value interval; and (5) according to a synthesized attribute, measuring a vector, and carrying out attribute recognition by adopting a confidence criterion. The complexity of tunnel and underground construction geological conditions and risk uncertainty are effectively considered, disaster risk levels in the tunnel and underground construction can be determined, and the probability of occurrence of each risk level of construction disasters can be given so as to better realize the quantitative evaluation of the construction disasters.

title_en: A kind of decision-making technique of uncertain emergency materials distribution
abstract_en: The present invention is a kind of decision-making technique of uncertain emergency materials distribution, mainly for the initial stage occurred in extensive accident, in the case of Disaster degree, material requirements and road condition are uncertain fuzzy quantity, fuzzy decision Element Theory is expanded into uncertain fuzzy decision Element Theory, to support decision under uncertainty index.On this basis, using fairness, benefit and feasibility as principle, index Design is carried out to emergency materials allocation unit decision system, so that science quickly determines that emergent life is required assistance the allocative decisions of goods and materials between multiple disaster-stricken points so that first batch of life rescue goods and materials can play maximum utility.The present invention in the case of relevant information is uncertain, science decision method can be provided for the quick allocative decision for determining life rescue goods and materials in multiple disaster areas in initial stage of disasters.

title_en: Method for demarcating large-deformation landslide displacement field based on high-resolution remote sensing image
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for demarcating a large-deformation landslide displacement field based on a high-resolution remote sensing image. The method is that two geometric models are utilized to perform ortho-rectification for the high-resolution remote sensing image and corresponding DEM at different time phases in a search area; after the preprocessing and high-precision image matching, a vector set model is created based on the accurately matched feature points with the same feature points; the space displacement field of a landslide body can be demarcated according to the model. With the adoption method for early warning of large landslide disaster, in particular the landslide disaster under a complex terrain, the sliding landslide can be automatically found out and subjected to macroscopic monitoring, so that the macroscopic displacement direction and displacement of the large deformation landslide body at some time quantum can be obtained, and the sliding range can be determined; the basic data and basis can be provided to accurately monitor the landslide displacement and early warn the landslide disaster. The system and the method are mature in technology, low in cost, convenient to operate, quick to calculate, and high in accuracy; the scientific basis can be provided to monitor and evaluate the landslide disaster, and the safety in fire preventing and reduction can be ensured.

title_en: Search support system and search simulator
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a search support system capable of improving search efficiency.SOLUTION: Provided is a search support system which comprises a first terminal used by the disaster headquarters, an administration device installed in a data center, a second terminal used by a search director, and a third terminal used by each search staff member. The first terminal sends to the administration device search information necessary for search and requests the administration device to send the map data of disaster areas. The administration device sends the requested map data. The first terminal highlights search areas on the received map to prepare a search map and sends it to the administration device. Based on the search information, the administration device prepares search requisites for rescuing victims within seventy two hours in the search areas by a predetermined arithmetic operation and sends the prepared search requisites to the first or second terminal. The administration device receives from the third terminal position information of each search staff member and discovery information about those being searched for and displays the information on the search map. The second terminal receives and displays the search map and the search requisites sent by the administration device. The third terminal sends to the administration device position information acquired by positioning means and discovery information when the search staff member has discovered those being searched for.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Terrain-based path search method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a path search method, in particular to a terrain-based path search method, which belongs to the field of GIS (Geographic Information System) navigation methods and equipment. The method comprises the following steps: expressing a search area as a passage cost figure which consists of a plurality of passage units and contains passage cost information, and then, generating a passage path with the least cost which is formed by connecting passage unit sides in series according to the passage cost figure. Therefore, the capacity of searching for a known and an unknown path quickly can be realized with lower cost; specific equipment support is not required; the technical difficulty is lower, so that the cost can be effectively reduced in the activities of emergency command, field search and rescue and the like, and the cost performance is higher.

title_en: Search-and-rescue method and system based on differential measure random meet uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search-and-rescue method and system based on differential measure random meet uncertainty. The method comprises the following steps: 1, determining a path L along which a lost person D gets lost, and determining a position point where the lost person D is located on the path L finally; 2, measuring a position point where a searcher C is located on the path L; 3, calculating probability density functions pc and pd that the searcher C and the lost person D are distributed on the path L and the probability that C can meet D when being located at a point of the path L, and finding a position point xm corresponding to the maximum value of the differential meet probability; calculating the meet probability that the searcher C can find the lost person D on the path L; 5, arranging the searcher C to conduct search and rescue on the path L according to the position point corresponding to the maximum value of the differential meet probability and the meet probability obtained through calculation.

title_en: Search-and-rescue method and system based on integration measure random meet uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a search-and-rescue method and system based on integration measure random meet uncertainty. The method comprises the following steps: 1, determining a path L along which a lost person D gets lost, and determining a position point where the lost person D is located on the path L finally; 2, measuring the length I of the path L, and measuring a position point where a searcher C is located on the path L; 3, calculating a probability density function that the searcher C and the lost person D are distributed on the path L, and deriving out a meet event Emeet; 4, calculating out the meet probability p (Emeet) according to the probability density function and the meet event Emeet; 5, deriving out the probability p (Emeet xk) of 'an event that the searcher C located at a point xk can meet the lost person D' according to the meet probability p (Emeet); 6, conducting the search and rescue in a mode that the searcher C moves to a position adjacent to a point xm where the lost person D can be found to the maximum probability.

title_en: A kind of international SOS letter shape distress signal balloon
abstract_en: An international SOS letter shape distress signal balloon is made up of SOS letter spheric balloon body, SOS letter spheric balloon air-filled pore, draught line; Wherein, air-filled pore is provided with at SOS letter spheric balloon body lower part, draught line is provided with at SOS letter spheric balloon body lower part, multiple reflecting mark plaster is pasted with at SOS letter spheric balloon body surface, be that SOS letter spheric balloon body surface is pasted with multiple Luminous mark, be that SOS letter spheric balloon body is provided with red LED lamp.The mark that a few place is eye-catching is had in the present invention, holding lead-in wire by deliverer is put into high aerial, facilitate rescuer can find target with telescope at tens kilometers at several kilometers or rescuer, decrease search area, decrease rescuer, shorten the search and rescue time, be conducive to deliverer and succoured within the shortest time, ensure the life security of deliverer.Meanwhile, the distress signal instrument of the present invention or a kind of cheapness.

title_en: Geometric probability model based search and rescue method and system for measuring random meeting uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geometric probability model based search and rescue method and system for measuring random meeting uncertainty. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, determining a lost path L of a lost person and determining a position point of the lost person D finally appearing in the path L; step 2, measuring the path length l of the path L and measuring a position point of a searcher C in the path L; step 3, calculating all position combinations (x,y) of the searcher C and the lost person D, and calculating a position combination for ensuring that the searcher C can meet with the lost person D, wherein a condition that |y-x|<=md is met; step 4, calculating a meeting probability P(M) of the searcher C and the lost person D; and step 5, calculating the position of the searcher C meeting the lost person D with a maximum probability in the path L, and arranging for search and rescue personnel to perform search and rescue according to the position. According to the search and rescue method and system, the possibility of the searcher C meeting the lost person D in the path L can be confirmed, and the position of the searcher C meeting the lost person D with the maximum probability in the path L also can be determined.

title_en: International SOS letter shape distress signal balloon
abstract_en: The utility model provides an international SOS letter shape distress signal balloon, be by SOS letter spheric balloon body, SOS letter spheric balloon aerify the hole, the pull wire constitutes, wherein, being equipped with in SOS letter spheric balloon body lower part and aerifing the hole, be equipped with the pull wire in SOS letter spheric balloon body lower part, have a plurality of reflection of light labelings at SOS letter spheric balloon body surface paste, surface paste has a plurality of luminous labelings at SOS letter spheric balloon body, is provided with red LED lamp at the alphabetical spheric balloon body of SOS. The utility model discloses in have a few striking signs of department, leading the lead wire by succour person, to put the height aerial, conveniently the personnel of suing and labouring several kilometers or the personnel of suing and labouring with the telescope tens kilometers can all the contact with a target, reduced the search area, reduced the personnel of suing and labouring, shortened the search and rescue time, be favorable to succour person to obtain succour, assurance succour person's life safety in the shortest time. And simultaneously, the utility model discloses or the distress signal instrument of a low price.

title_en: Emergency retractable water storage bag
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency retractable water storage bag, which comprises a plastic film water storage bag, wherein the plastic film water storage bag comprises a sealable opening; other mating components comprise a water current pressure pump, a hose, a sealing cover, a suction valve and a guiding pipe. The emergency retractable water storage bag has the beneficial effects that the storage of drinking water is preparation which is first carried out when people face a disaster, however, due to the uncertainty of the disaster, plenty of space can be occupied usually by a common barreled water storage way, and moreover, a food safety problem is also easily induced due to long-time storage; through the emergency retractable water storage bag provided by the invention, the demand of storing plenty of water when the disaster is coped with is met; the accommodating space is saved; the emergency retractable water storage bag is convenient to use; the food sanitation is also guaranteed through a food-grade plastic film.

title_en: High-voltage transmission line icing process integrated prediction method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-voltage transmission line icing process integrated prediction method and belongs to the overhead high-voltage transmission line on-line monitoring and early warning technical field. According to the method, icing process historical data of a high-voltage transmission line on-line monitoring system and corresponding micro meteorological data are utilized to establish an icing process fusion prediction system comprising a data pre processing module, an icing process prediction module and a fusion decision-making module. The method includes the following steps that: dimension reduction processing is performed on the meteorological data based on a principal component analysis method, so that the complexity of modeling can be decreased; a multivariable nonlinear regression model, a support vector machine model, an expert evaluation model and a fuzzy reasoning model are utilized to qualitatively or quantitatively predict the icing process of a power transmission line; and a DS evidence fusion theory is utilized to perform united judgment on four prediction results, and an icing early warning level is confirmed. The high-voltage transmission line icing process integrated prediction method has the following advantages that: a modeling process is simplified; the uncertainty of a single model is eliminated, so that the accuracy of prediction is improved; and effective basis can be provided for relevant departments in decision making of icing disasters.
assignees: UNIV YUNNAN;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Improved maritime search and rescue region predicting method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an improved maritime search and rescue region predicting method and an improved maritime search and rescue region predicting system. A dynamic drifting trajectory of a maritime search and rescue target object can be predicted according to existing meteorological and environmental data, a three-dimensional flow field, an improved AP98 air pressure model and a maritime search and rescue target drifting trajectory calculation model. The improved air pressure drifting model fully considers the uncertainty that motion in the side wind direction at each moment of a drifting target, so that a search and rescue region is more precise.
assignees: XIAMEN LANHIT INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire identification method based on flame detection in night vision scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire identification method based on flame detection in a night vision scene, which comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring an image sequence of a monitored scene through a monitoring camera with a night vision function; step 2, carrying out brightness segmentation on each frame of acquired image, and simultaneously carrying out background modeling and motion detection on the acquired image sequence; step 3, carrying out logic screening on the alternative flame area, finding out scattered bright spots around the large bright spot, and filtering out interference noise of the scattered bright spots; step 4, calculating cumulative distribution on a time axis to form a cumulative distribution probability image of the bright spots; step 5, carrying out binarization and clustering operations on the obtained cumulative distribution probability map in space, and filtering out; step 6, extracting characteristics of each remaining cluster, and performing randomness detection on a time axis; and 7, judging whether a fire disaster occurs in the monitored scene. The method solves the problem that the night fire detection method in the prior art is easy to interfere and has high false alarm rate.
assignees: MECH & ELECTRICAL ENG ANHUI POLYTECHNIC UNIV

title_en: Chemical industry park real-time quantitative risk assessment method based on multi-disaster real-time coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to a chemical industry park real-time quantitative risk assessment method based on multi-disaster real-time coupling, introduces a Monte Carlo analysis method and solves the problem of uncertainty of setting of a model probability parameter. By effective integration of the Monte Carlo analysis method and a risk distance calculation method, a chemical industry park site selection risk protection distance is initially determined. According to an environmental risk system principle, by combining characteristics of the chemical industry, a chemical industry park enterprise comprehensive risk assessment index system based on inherent risks of a risk source, effectiveness of a prevention and control mechanism and vulnerability of a receptor is constructed. A catastrophe rating method is introduced to assess an environmental risk comprehensive level, a chemical industry enterprise environmental risk comprehensive assessment method based on a catastrophe principle is proposed, and comprehensive assessment grades are divided into five grade levels so as to discriminate a comprehensive risk level of a chemical industry park enterprise and timely take emergency response strategies. According to the chemical industry park real-time quantitative risk assessment method disclosed by the invention, planning evaluation and risk management of a chemical industry park can be implemented, and a risk prevention ability and a risk management level of the chemical industry park can be improved.

title_en: Based on rainfall-probability debris flow early-warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses based on rainfall-probability debris flow early-warning method, belong to mountain region disaster field.The present invention is theoretical according to the conditional probability that mud-rock flow occurs, test and theoretical calculation determination and the calculating of condition of raining probability in conjunction with the rainfall critical value that mud-rock flow occurs, realize the construction method for the pre-warning indexes system for combining the rainfall of the probabilistic probability of reflection mud-rock flow and debris flow formation starting to combine.Theoretical method of the present invention is reliable, and computational science is convenient, and warning index is clear, both the Critical Value Problem that rainfall induces mud-rock flow starting had been solved, debris flow formation, the uncertainty in motion process are reflected again, to improve forecast reliability, accuracy and science.The present invention directly can provide technical support for the monitoring and warning of rainfall induced debris flow and forecast.

title_en: Airplane search and rescue method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an airplane search and rescue method, which comprises the following steps: 1. calculating the optimal search width W of search rescue according to the expected search success probability Q; 2. according to the optimal search width W and the minimum turning radius R of the airplane min Determining a search mode; 3. calculating coordinates of each turning point in the search area according to the optimal search width obtained in the step one, the search mode obtained in the step two, the search boundary point obtained in the step three and the turning reference point; all turning points are right below one point of the turning reference points, namely the turning points and the turning reference points have the same longitude; 4. the airplane carries out flying search and rescue according to the entry point and the turning point. The invention provides a method for planning search and rescue air lines in search and rescue areas according to a grid search mode, which defines key navigation parameters such as the entry point coordinates, the turning point coordinates and the like of the flight air lines, establishes feasible flight air lines for airplanes, and reduces repeated search and missed search areas.

title_en: Method and system for searching mountain-climbing distress people by using computer vision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for searching mountain-climbing distress people by using computer vision, which comprises the following steps: firstly, reading videos or pictures in a search and rescue area; secondly, setting a pixel value occupied by the target object in the picture and a color range of the target object; thirdly, determining a convolution kernel matrix; processing all pixel points of the picture in the search and rescue area into a RGB matrix of a two-dimensional array, and then performing binarization processing on the colors of all the pixel points of the picture to obtain a color binarization matrix; and fourthly, performing convolution operation on the convolution kernel matrix and the color binarization matrix to obtain a convolution processing matrix. The method analyzes and processes the distant view picture or video of the search area by using computer vision on the basis that the search and rescue personnel take a picture or a video of the search area from a remote place or an aircraft, and identifies and marks the position of a possible missing person. The invention also discloses a system for searching mountain-climbing distress people by using computer vision.

title_en: Beacon detection system for locating missing persons
abstract_en: A beacon detection system which can locate a missing search subject includes: a beacon signal receiver; a location position detector; and a beacon detector. The detector is configured to detect a location of a broadcasting beacon signal associated with a personal device of a search subject within search data covering a geographic search area derived from a search for the search subject, the search data gathered by the beacon signal receiver and location position detector. A computer implemented method of determining a location of a search subject is also provided. The method determines at least a possible connection request from Wi-Fi signals in search data gathered by a Wi-Fi radio covering a geographic search area for a search subject and associated location information to locate the search subject.

title_en: offshore search area estimation method based on wind pressure difference overturning and drifting model
abstract_en: The invention relates to an offshore search area estimation method based on a wind pressure difference overturning drift model, which comprises the following steps of: normalizing the wind speed change quantity; obtaining the influence of the self speed of the target on the wind pressure difference turnover according to the target drift speed; obtaining the wind pressure difference turnover rate according to the normalized wind speed change and the influence of the target speed on the wind pressure difference turnover, and judging whether the current wind pressure difference is turnover; obtaining a target drift model according to the wind pressure difference overturning structure; and estimating a search area by adopting a Monte Carlo method based on the target drift model. The search area estimated by the sea search area estimation method based on the wind pressure difference overturning and drifting model can contain search and rescue targets to the maximum extent, is small in area, can avoid useless search of invalid areas, and improves the sea search success rate.

title_en: Quantitative evaluation method for risk loss of single landslide
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantitative evaluation method for risk loss of monomer landslides (including soil landslides and rock landslides), and belongs to the field of geological disaster prevention and reduction and risk management research. The method is based on an upper limit theorem, a lower limit theorem and an interval analysis method, approaches to a landslide disaster risk loss truth value from the lower limit direction and the upper limit direction, overcomes the defects of large uncertainty, large deviation between an evaluation result and actual landslide disaster loss and the like caused by the adoption of a single fixed value risk loss evaluation result in the past, has the characteristics of quickness, dynamic property, practicability and the like, can serve for landslide disaster quantitative risk evaluation, and provides a decision basis for formulating landslide disaster risk management measures.
assignees: LOGISTICAL ENGINEERING UNIV OF PLA;CHONGQING INST GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES

title_en: Hazard potential evaluation method for complex disasters
title_ko: 시나리오기반의 대형복합재난 위해성 평가방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a scenario-based hazard potential evaluation method for a big complex disaster, which is improved to display hazard potential evaluation of a big complex disaster on a navigation screen by forming a scenario of an occurrence expectation calculation process by using a hazard map and interdependence calculation for each disaster of a database in a hazard potential evaluation server and using an expert computer of an expert survey for defining interconnectivity between disaster types. To achieve the same, according to the present invention, the hazard potential evaluation server networks with the expert computer (10) of the expert survey for defining the interconnectivity between the disaster types and the database (20) of an existing research material such as an avalanche hazard map, a coastal flooding prognostic chart, and a wind speed probability map. The hazard potential evaluation server individually uses the generation of a natural disaster and social disaster matrix and generation of the map from a hazard map DB (50) for each disaster, from an interdependent database (40) for each disaster in a big complex disaster integrated database system (30). The hazard potential evaluation server selects the disaster in a case in which the interdependence is larger than a preset value in the occurrence expectation calculation process (60) and forms the scenario in accordance with the first disaster. The hazard potential evaluation server classifies the hazard map of a grid unit about a whole country as a result on the disaster forming the scenario and applies the same to the expectation calculation in accordance with the scenario. The hazard potential evaluation of the big complex disaster is displayed on the navigation screen (70) by using a scenario search unit of the disaster, reliability, relation, and disparity, a map display unit on which a grade of the hazard potential is displayed, and a disaster scenario pop-up unit.

abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of building fire early warning based on Internet of Things and fire disaster situation assessment system and method, the present invention has the environmental information being closely connected, electric information with fire by building Internet of Things and gathering in building, feature extraction and data fusion are carried out to the collection information, fire alarm is carried out to building；The present invention gathers building information using Internet of things system is built, the comprehensive information from multiple sensors, data analysis is carried out using data fusion method, accurate, quick early warning is carried out to building fire situation, pass through the weight calculation of much information, effectively filtering interference signal, overcome the uncertainty and limitation of single sensor, improve building fire early-warning and predicting accuracy and effectively condition of a fire situation can be carried out and assess.

title_en: Emergency resource mobilization and transportation scheduling plan generation method based on robust optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for generating an emergency resource mobilization and transportation scheduling plan based on robust optimization, which comprises the following steps of 1: considering uncertainty factors of disaster area requirements and transportation time, establishing an uncertainty parameter optimization model integrating emergency resource mobilization and transportation scheduling, wherein the uncertainty parameter optimization model comprises a total cost optimization target and constraint conditions; step 2: processing the total cost optimization target and the constraint condition under the uncertainty parameter condition into a robust corresponding total cost optimization target and a robust corresponding constraint condition by adopting a robust optimization method; and step 3: solving a robust corresponding total cost optimization target based on the robust corresponding constraint condition; and 4, step 4: and outputting the emergency resource mobilization and transportation scheduling plan. The method has the advantage that emergency resource mobilization and rescue personnel and severe sick and wounded transportation scheduling plans such as rescue personnel, transportation tools and medical services can be generated quickly and effectively after a major natural disaster occurs.

abstract_en: The invention discloses disaster prevention emergency electricity optimization collocation method and device in a kind of urban area, the implementation steps of method include：The allotment time of each user is arrived according to each switched-mode power supply of determination, calculate the loss of outage of each important power consumers during having a power failure on a large scale, the emergent cost that Utilities Electric Co. allocates disaster prevention emergency supply vehicle to user is calculated respectively, the uncertainty of disaster prevention emergency supply vehicle allotment time and power consumer load is described respectively with radial direction interval number and common interval number, calculate total social benefit, establish the disaster prevention emergency electricity optimization allocation models for being up to object function with total social benefit, the method optimized using robust solves preferred plan of each switched-mode power supply to each important power consumers allotment disaster prevention emergency power supply in urban area.Calculating process of the present invention is simple, has taken into full account the uncertainty of disaster prevention emergency supply vehicle allotment time and the uncertainty of customer charge, has at utmost met future scheduling demand and weigh loss of outage and emergent cost.

title_en: A kind of underwater search and rescue region Forecasting Methodology based on wireless sensor network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of underwater search and rescue region Forecasting Methodology based on wireless sensor network, including：Wireless network threedimensional model is established to underwater multiple nodes, distress signal is sent using wireless network, and by multiple node equivalents in model into random particles；Random particles are calculated based on particle cluster algorithm to issue in the initial position probability of several scenes；Combining marine environment according to the distribution of the initial position probability of random particles influences to calculate the drift probability data of random particles, and predicts to obtain search and rescue region according to particle drift probability data.The method that the present invention solves the definite maritime SAR region that the prior art provides determines search and rescue region based on classical search planing method so that definite search and rescue region increases the problem of searching and rescuing risk there are error.

title_en: Small watershed torrential flood disaster risk analysis method based on information diffusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a small watershed torrent disaster risk analysis method based on information diffusion, which introduces an information diffusion theory, takes limited historical torrent data as a basis, integrates samples with single-value observation values under the incomplete information condition into fuzzy integrated value samples with fuzzy uncertainty, establishes a torrent disaster information matrix, and introduces the calculation of a Pearson's triple curve, an override probability and a confidence coefficient, thereby realizing the rapid quantitative evaluation of torrent disaster risks through limited knowledge and leading the result to be closer to the actual condition. This patent can improve the objectivity and the scientificity of mountain torrent calamity risk analysis result.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster risk zoning and prediction method based on GIS-neural network integration
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mountain torrent disaster risk zoning and predicting method based on GIS-neural network integration, which comprises the following steps: s1, mining an association relation between risk factors and risk levels in the mountain torrent disasters by using association rules, identifying the risk factors, and constructing a quantitative mountain torrent disaster risk evaluation index system; s2, determining a risk and vulnerability index system and weights thereof by adopting an analytic hierarchy process to generate each element map layer; s3, overlapping the mountain torrent disaster risk and vulnerability distribution map layers by utilizing ArcGIS to obtain a mountain torrent disaster risk distribution map; s4, clustering by adopting an ISO maximum likelihood method, combining bottom-up region combination and top-down qualitative analysis to form a mountain torrent disaster risk division; and S5, analyzing the nonlinear relation between the evaluation indexes and the risk level and between the evaluation indexes and the disaster data by using an Elman neural network, and constructing a mountain torrent disaster risk evaluation and loss estimation model. The method solves the problem of uncertainty of the spatial scale in mountain flood disaster assessment under the changing environment, and can be widely used for mountain flood disaster risk assessment.

title_en: A kind of nuclear reactor fuel rod fusing visual experimental apparatus and method
abstract_en: A kind of nuclear reactor fuel rod fusing visual experimental apparatus and method, high temperature smelting furnace including having several saturating windows, testpieces is vertically arranged in high temperature smelting furnace, the top and bottom of testpieces are respectively arranged with rhenium molybdenum electrode, rhenium molybdenum electrode is by testpieces, rhenium molybdenum electrode is connected with the copper electrode for passing through high-temperature fusion furnace sidewall, testpieces includes fuel rod, it is provided with W-Re heating rod in fuel rod, is provided on the outside of high temperature smelting furnace for carrying out cooling cooling water recirculation system to high temperature smelting furnace.The present invention guarantees that furnace body temperature outside is maintained within security restriction by high temperature smelting furnace cooling water recirculation system, and external high-speed camera instrument can work normally, being capable of core melt progression under the conditions of real simulation reactor disaster.The experimental data that the present invention obtains can provide verifying for conventional numeric analogy method, reduce the uncertainty of existing Analysis Codes of Severe Accident.

title_en: Small-sized river pollutant carrying capacity disaster risk estimation method under pollution sources center of gravity generalization
abstract_en: The present invention relates to small-sized river pollutant carrying capacity disaster risk estimation methods under a kind of pollution sources center of gravity generalization, include the following steps：(1) investigation receive dirty section initial section position x and plan pollution sources quantity n, they are relative to section initial section position x i And discharge of sewage q i , pollutant concentration c i , determine that analysis generally changes mode if appropriate for center of gravity, estimate pollution sources center of gravity relative to initial section distance x if suitable center of gravity generalization c ；(2) measurement and determining dirty section controls up to par cross section place x', the initial section pollutant concentration C of receiving 0 , measure average section of river flow velocity u, discharge of river Q；(3) dirty section contaminant degradation coefficient k and its uncertainty α are received according to measurement result determination；(4) evaluation of risk of the variance D (W) of the section pollutant carrying capacity as the section pollutant carrying capacity is calculated.Through the invention, the risk of river pollutant carrying capacity in the case of pollution sources center of gravity generalization can be effectively estimated using this method, and improves the management level of river water quality.

title_en: Multiple current Tsunami disaster appraisal procedure based on Monte Carlo stochastic simulation
abstract_en: The multiple current Tsunami disaster appraisal procedure based on Monte Carlo stochastic simulation that the invention discloses a kind of, method include: that S1 applies a variety of focal shock parameter estimation methods to establish potential tsunami source region seismicity parameters logic tree；S2 establishes tsunami unit source Green's function database using linear tsunami numerical simulation；S3 generates Stochastic earthquake event set according to above-mentioned logic tree, using Monte Carlo stochastic simulation；S4 is simulated using random slippage according to tsunami unit source Green's function database and Stochastic earthquake event set and is generated tsunami wave amplitude collection；Analysis of uncertainty of the S5 according to tsunami wave amplitude collection, to multiple current Tsunami disaster distribution results statistics and result.The above method be able to solve risk evaluation result in the prior art it is higher and can not provide its correspond to probability of happening the problem of, a variety of uncertainties are fused in final assessment result, increase the confidence level of result, operational efficiency is improved simultaneously, policymaker is facilitated targetedly to make prevent and reduce natural disasters deployment and physical construction planning.

title_en: A kind of Robot Extinguishing Fire system and Intelligent fire-fighting robot of Multi-sensor Fusion
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of Robot Extinguishing Fire system of Multi-sensor Fusion and Intelligent fire-fighting robots, belong to firefighting robot technical field.The Robot Extinguishing Fire system of the Multi-sensor Fusion of the utility model, including main control module, infrared sensor, UV sensor, visual sensor, water fog sprinkler and powder extinguishing system, infrared sensor and UV sensor are connect with main control module respectively, visual sensor is bi-directionally connected by host computer and main control module, and main control module is connected with water fog sprinkler and powder extinguishing system respectively.The utility model quickly finds fire behavior using infrared sensor, UV sensor and visual sensor and fire behavior is identified, later fire extinguishing processing is carried out using water spray and the segmentation of fine mist fire-fighting mechanism and dry powder bullet fire suppression mechanism, realize the specific aim fire extinguishing processing of different fire behaviors, fire-fighting efficiency and accuracy are more preferable, can preferably cope with uncertainty and the variability of fire behavior.

title_en: Rainfall estimation method based on multi-source information fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a rainfall estimation method based on multi-source information fusion, which comprises the following steps: combining the rainfall data observed by the ground station in the research area with the rainfall data of the multisource satellite in the research area to form a multisource data set of the research area; establishing a Bayesian rainfall prediction model of a research area based on a dynamic Bayesian theory; solving a nonlinear optimal solution of a Bayesian rainfall prediction model by using a maximum entropy method, and further determining optimal weight and uncertainty information of each satellite data source; and generating an estimation result of the rainfall amount of the multi-source information fusion applied in the research area based on the optimal weight and uncertainty of the satellite data source. Has the advantages that: according to the method, the result of fusion analysis of multiple data sources reduces the uncertainty of regional rainfall estimation caused by the inaccuracy of a single rainfall information; the method provides more reliable data input and richer and more refined modeling data for strengthening regional high-precision disaster early warning, avoiding flood risks or estimating torrential rain and flood in a small watershed.

title_en: SAR image change detection method based on deep forest
abstract_en: The invention provides a SAR image change detection method based on a deep forest, which mainly solves the problems that the prior art cannot fully obtain useful information from local image blocks, and the detection precision is poor due to the loss of information of edge parts of images. The implementation steps comprise: acquiring an initial SAR image change detection diagram; optimizing the deep forest model; acquiring a training sample data set; acquiring an initial category probability map P; calculating a gradient magnitude graph G and a gradient directional diagram M of the difference graph D; acquiring a final class probability map P2; and acquiring a final SAR image change detection diagram. The optimized deep forest model is used, the input of the model is multi-scale image input, and a final classification probability map is obtained after a gradient amplitude map and a gradient directional diagram of a difference map are calculated, so that the SAR image change detection precision is improved, and the SAR image change detection method can be used in the related fields of SAR image change detection such as environment monitoring, agricultural investigation, disaster relief work and the like.

title_en: Disaster-stricken person searching method based on rescue unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster-stricken person searching method based on a rescue unmanned aerial vehicle, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: after flying into a designated search area, the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle collects audio signals; when the audio signal is detected to be a voice signal according to the spectral entropy of the audio signal, positioning a sound production source of the audio signal to obtain the position of the disaster-stricken person; controlling a nose of the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle to always point to a target position, wherein the target position and the position of the disaster-stricken person are positioned in the same vertical direction, and the distance between the target position and the position of the disaster-stricken person is a first designated distance; controlling the head of the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle to keep a second specified distance from the target position; and the rescue unmanned aerial vehicle carries out point-winding flight monitoring around the target position according to the preset flying-winding speed and the second specified distance. Can lock the personnel that suffer from a disaster fast to rescue action is saved more lives in limited time in the acceleration of being convenient for.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster probability rain type estimation method based on copula function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carpula function-based rainfall type calculation method for probability of mountain torrent disasters, which comprises the following steps of: collecting typical rainfall data of the small watershed by taking the small watershed as a unit; determining a rain peak position coefficient function; determining a combined distribution function of peak rain intensity and total rainfall by adopting a copula function and solving; the rain pattern at a certain probability is determined. The method fully considers randomness and uncertainty of a rainfall process, collects and collates typical small watershed rainfall data, adopts a combined distribution function of peak rainfall intensity and total rainfall based on copula function, combines a rain peak position function, fully considers uncertainty influences of a rain peak position, the peak rainfall intensity and the total rainfall, and jointly determines rainstorm type characteristics of small watersheds in a research area under different probabilities. The method considers the influence of key factors on the uncertainty of the rain type in the rain type determining process, and provides basis and reference for determining and researching the rain type of different probabilities in the small watershed of the hilly region.

title_en: A kind of unmanned fire boat
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of unmanned fire boats, including hull, fire-fighting system, camera system, master control system；Dynamic positioning system, communication system and UAV system.It sues and labours scheme are as follows: unmanned fire boat passes through the position that communication system receives ship in distress or waterfront.Signal, which is sent, in remote terminal by rescuer carries out extinguishing operation.Operation remote terminal equipment connection UAV system flies small drone to fire source top to safe distance and opens camera and high-power megaphone, is monitored and lifesaving guides work.Program advantage is: the unmanned fire boat real-time reception distress signal and can reach scene of fire；The ship is also equipped with automatic fire extinguisher, the uncertainty for greatly reducing the risk artificially put out a fire and avoiding manual operation；Have the grasp scene the condition of a disaster of the closer distance of UAV system, effectively raises the success rate and efficiency of the disaster relief.Whole system is intuitive, operating efficiency is high, degree of safety is high, has biggish application prospect.

title_en: Critical rainfall early warning method for torrential flood disasters in multi-scenario mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a critical rainfall early warning method for torrential flood disasters in a multi-scenario mode, which comprises the following steps of: collecting disaster prevention object data by taking the small watershed as a unit; determining the early soil state; determining the type of rainstorm which possibly occurs locally to carry out rainfall time course distribution design; combining the contextual models; determining critical rainfall under different situation modes; and selecting corresponding critical rainfall grading early warning according to different weather conditions. The method considers the torrential flood disaster outbreak conditions under different scenes under natural conditions, focuses on the uncertainty influence of designing the rainfall type and the early-stage soil state, combines the actually measured data of the control section of the small watershed, calculates different critical rainfall values in a trial mode, issues corresponding torrential flood early warning according to the actual situation, and verifies that the torrential flood disaster early warning mode under the multi-scene mode is feasible through the actually measured disaster torrential rain flood process inspection, so that the fitness of the torrential flood disaster early warning and the natural conditions is improved, and the reliability, the credibility and the applicability of the torrential flood disaster early warning are further improved.

title_en: SAR image change detection method based on multi-granularity cascade forest model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a SAR image change detection method based on a multi-granularity cascade forest model, which mainly solves the problem of strong dependence of a traditional method on a difference map, and the implementation scheme is as follows: given two registered multi-temporal SAR images I 1 And I 2 (ii) a To I 1 And I 2 Generation of disparity map I by using logarithmic ratio operator d (ii) a To I d Extracting haar-like features and inputting the haar-like features into a trained multi-granularity cascade forest model to generate two probability maps I 1 And I 0 And the difference chart I d Forming new features; retraining the model by using the new characteristics to obtain a new prediction result Handle Kappa coefficient of (2) and last time And selecting a prediction result with a higher coefficient as a final change detection result compared with the Kappa coefficient. The method can effectively inhibit the influence of the difference map on the final result, improve the accuracy of change detection, and can be used for environment detection and disaster detection.

title_en: Gully type mud-rock flow channel Circulation Area dimensional topography evolution analysis method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of gully type mud-rock flow channel Circulation Area dimensional topography evolution analysis methods, belong to geological disaster to prevent and reduce natural disasters technical field, the method of the present invention acquires channel cross section landform altitude along channel stream central line in the flowing area of mud flow at a certain distance, each cross section is subjected to equidistant segmentation based on discretization thought, it is deep by measuring the corresponding flow velocity of any time and mud in each segmentation, the groove channel erosion rate for calculating each cross section segmentation and the depth of erosion during mud-rock flow, landform altitude after obtaining each cross section debris flow erosion, finally adjacent cross section landform contour point is connected by straight line, landform of the channel Circulation Area ditch bed under mud-rock flow souring can be obtained to develop, the method of the present invention not only overcomes the subjectivity and uncertainty of conventional method empirical parameter value in debris flow erosion calculating, Dimensional topography of the channel Circulation Area landform after mud-rock flow washes away can be obtained simultaneously, the work that can prevent and reduce natural disasters for mud-rock flow provides reference.

title_en: Numerical integration early termination method based on disturbed trajectory dynamic characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a numerical integration early termination method based on disturbed trajectory dynamic characteristics, which comprises the following steps: according to the disturbed track information, combining comprises: and judging whether numerical integration is terminated in advance according to dynamic characteristics including instability of a destabilization mode, disturbed track non-co-scheduling, maximum rotor angle gap, information similarity of equidirectional adjacent rotor angle gaps and oscillation attenuation. The invention can automatically match proper integral intervals for each sample according to the dynamic information, and can greatly improve the analysis speed on the premise of ensuring that the analysis precision of the sample is not changed compared with the original transient stability analysis method based on the fixed integral intervals. The method has great theoretical and engineering significance for further considering the accuracy and speed of online transient stability analysis and solving the problems of strong uncertainty, strong nonlinearity and dimension disaster which may be faced by transient stability analysis under the condition of high-proportion renewable energy networking.

title_en: High luminous led searchlight possible to adjust a focus
title_ko: 초점 조절이 가능한 고광도 led 탐조등
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a high-intensity LED search light with an adjustable focus, comprising: a housing; a plurality of search light modules located in the housing; a driving unit adjusting a focus of light irradiated from an LED by rotating a rotating unit of each of the search light modules and moving lenses connected to each moving unit; and a radiating unit emitting heat generated from a plurality of LED modules to the outside of the housing. Accordingly, the LED modules are connected through a gear configuration to enable each of the LED modules to be focused at the same time. Therefore, light can be intensively irradiated to a search area to be searched in a ship to perform rescue, lifesaving, or coastal defense.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 하우징, 하우징 내부에 위치하는 다수의 탐조등 모듈, 각각의 탐조등 모듈의 회전부를 회전시켜 동시에 각각의 이동부에 연결된 렌즈를 이동하여 엘이디로부터 조사되는 빛의 초점을 조절하는 구동부 및 LED 모듈로부터 발생되는 열을 하우징 외부로 방출시키는 방열부를 포함하고, 초점 조절이 가능한 고광도 LED 탐조등을 제공한다.  
본 발명에 따르면 다수의 LED 모듈을 기어구조를 통하여 연결함으로써 각각의 LED 모듈을 동시에 초점조절을 할 수 있음으로 선박에서 탐색하고자 하는 탐색영역에 빛을 집중적으로 조사하여 조난 및 인명구조 또는 해안 경비 등을 수행할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of disaster monitoring early warning platform construction method based on SOA framework
abstract_en: The disaster monitoring early warning platform construction method based on SOA framework that the invention discloses a kind of, solving current Geological Hazards Monitoring early warning is by monitoring and the progress early warning of monitoring device Threshold Alerts of manually patrolling mostly, but the diversity and uncertainty of the factor due to inducing geological disaster, and the usually interspersed complicated geogen that blends, management and evaluation to data become abnormal difficult defect.This invention makes full use of the lower coupling feature of SOA framework by AI Warning Service preferably in conjunction with monitoring system, the advantage of machine learning algorithm processing complex data and precise classification is utilized simultaneously, on the basis of the hazard assessment of risk source and monitoring object are evaluated, the data of each monitoring object of real-time monitoring, a series of grade for varying strength geological disasters that certain period may occur in predicted area of danger, the characteristics of for different risk areas, proposes the every countermeasure reduced risks, and provides aid decision for Geological Hazards Monitoring early warning.
assignees: SHENZHEN MUNICIPAL BUREAU OF GEOLOGY;SHENZHEN ADDRESS CONSTRUCTION ENG COMPANY

title_en: A kind of underwater search and rescue region prediction technique based on wireless sensor network
abstract_en: The underwater search and rescue region prediction technique based on wireless sensor network that the invention discloses a kind of, comprising: wireless network threedimensional model is established to underwater multiple nodes, sends distress signal using wireless network, and by multiple node equivalents in model at random particles；Random particles are calculated based on particle swarm algorithm to issue in the initial position probability of several scenes；It combines marine environment to influence the drift probability data of calculating random particles according to the distribution of the initial position probability of random particles, and predicts to obtain search and rescue region according to particle drift probability data.The method that the present invention solves the determination maritime SAR region that the prior art provides determines search and rescue region based on classical search planing method, so that the search and rescue region determined there are error, increases the problem of searching and rescuing risk.

title_en: One kind being based on the probabilistic flood probability forecasting procedure of multi-source
abstract_en: The present invention relates to one kind to be based on the probabilistic flood probability forecasting procedure of multi-source, and steps are as follows: estimating areal rainfall probability distribution based on incomplete rainfall monitoring group；The suboptimum disaggregation for constructing each model parameter, obtains the probability distribution of model parameter；The random combination for generating areal rainfall and parameter, driving hydrological model generate the initial forecasting runoff process of multiple groups；Estimate that each model is relatively optimal probability using BMA method；Optimal models and corresponding initial forecasting runoff are randomly selected, the Posterior probability distribution of estimated prediction flow realizes probability forecast.The present invention is to comprehensively consider rainfall input, parameter, three aspect uncertainty of model structure, realize the calculation method of flood probability forecast, it can be widely used in that rainfall error originated from input is significant, is suitble to the model of flood forecasting or model structure not to predict accurately, the higher situation of model parameter uncertainty, the accuracy and reliability of flood forecasting result can be improved, provide technical support for flood control and disaster reduction work.
assignees: HUAIHE RIVER COMMISSION OF WATER RESOURCES HYDROLOGY BUREAU INFORMATION CENTER

title_en: Urban road traffic accident emergency rescue path planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban road traffic accident emergency rescue path planning method, which comprises the following steps: 1) generating a topological structure chart of an urban road network, and acquiring traffic flow data and rescue start and end point information; 2) analyzing the emergency rescue characteristics of the urban road traffic accidents, and selecting a proper rescue path planning method to evaluate indexes; 3) constructing a basic framework of the timing coevolution path planning, and explaining the optimization principle of the timing coevolution path planning by a system; 4) designing a proper solving algorithm by combining the running characteristics of the urban road vehicles; 5) determining a calculation method of uncertainty factors in an actual traffic environment of an urban road network; 6) and outputting a rescue path planning result through computer programming. The urban road emergency rescue path planning method can solve the problem of urban road emergency rescue path planning.

title_en: A kind of debris flow early-warning method based on rainfall monitoring
abstract_en: The present invention relates to mountain region disaster fields, particularly disclose a kind of debris flow early-warning method based on rainfall monitoring.It combines the test that the critical excitation approaches of mud-rock flow occur and theoretical calculation determination and the calculating of condition of raining probability, the construction method for the pre-warning indexes system that the rainfall that the probabilistic probability of concentrated expression mud-rock flow and debris flow formation start combines.Theoretical method of the present invention is reliable, and computational science is convenient, and warning index is clear, both the Critical Value Problem that rainfall induces mud-rock flow starting had been solved, debris flow formation, the uncertainty in motion process are reflected again, to improve forecast reliability, accuracy and science.

title_en: Emergency management and rescue Search Area method for visualizing after a kind of accident of aircraft
abstract_en: The invention discloses emergency management and rescue Search Area method for visualizing after a kind of accident of aircraft in emergency management and rescue field.Include: 1, according to ADS-B information last before aircraft accident, determines unmanned plane region of search for the first time；2, according to the geomorphic feature of region of search for the first time, determine the parameter of the type of unmanned plane and the oblique photograph camera of UAV flight；3, the unmanned plane for carrying oblique photograph camera and signal transmission apparatus flies according to preset path, meanwhile, oblique photograph camera acquires oblique photograph data, signal transmission apparatus real-time Transmission oblique photograph data；4, construct the three-dimensional space model with geographical location information.Unmanned plane and oblique photograph camera are combined by the present invention, high definition camera is carried, aircraft accident region shape texture image information with multi-angle is obtained, has broken the limitation that orthography can only be shot from vertical angle, shooting angle is expanded, and aircraft accident region threedimensional model can be established in real time.
assignees: UNIV CIVIL AVIATION FLIGHT CHINA;PAN WEIJUN;LIU KAIYUAN

title_en: Foundation and satellite-borne radar precipitation data fusion method based on wavelet domain regularization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground and satellite-borne radar precipitation data fusion method based on wavelet domain regularization. The fusion process of the invention considers the uncertainty of precipitation estimation of different sensors and the wavelet domain statistical characteristics of precipitation data, and the fusion result reduces the uncertainty of a single sensor, and simultaneously can better maintain and reconstruct the detail characteristics of strong precipitation extreme value, small-scale change and the like, thereby being more beneficial to monitoring and forecasting the strong disaster weather such as flood monitoring and the like.

title_en: SAR image-based method for identifying flood fault hidden danger of transmission tower
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying flood fault hidden dangers of a transmission tower based on SAR images, which comprises the following steps: step 1: filtering the SAR image; step 2: extracting a binary image of the SAR image water body area by adopting a threshold algorithm; and step 3: calculating the shortest distance from the tower to the flood area and the flood ratio in the search area by adopting a tower center distance search algorithm and a tower foundation grid distance search algorithm; and 4, step 4: and calculating a flood hidden danger coefficient based on the distance from the tower to flood and the flood occupation ratio in the range of the tower, and judging the disaster condition of the tower.

title_en: Mine water disaster accident emergency decision method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency decision method and an emergency decision system for mine water damage accidents. The decision method comprises the following steps: acquiring accident elements of the current mine water disaster accident to obtain first accident elements; determining the scene type of the current mine water disaster accident according to the first accident element to obtain a first scene type; acquiring all mine water damage accident cases corresponding to a first scene type in a case base to obtain an accident case set; according to the mine water damage accident case, obtaining decision information corresponding to each mine water damage accident case in the accident case set in the countermeasure library to obtain a countermeasure set; the strategy library comprises decision information corresponding to all mine water damage accident cases, and the decision information is rescue measures and disposal technology of the mine water damage accident cases at each accident stage; and determining the strategy set as an emergency decision of the current mine water disaster accident. The method can make a decision on the mine water disaster accident in real time so as to meet the decision requirements of urgency, complexity and uncertainty of the mine water disaster accident.

title_en: Urban masonry residential safety assessment method based on uncertainty analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a town masonry residential safety assessment method based on uncertainty analysis, and belongs to the field of engineering structure performance assessment. The method comprises the steps of firstly, carrying out acceleration acquisition on a structure under environmental vibration to obtain acceleration data. And secondly, automatically identifying structural modal parameters and uncertainty thereof by adopting a multi-reference-point covariance driven random subspace method and a convolutional neural network.
