And then, correcting the initial finite element model of the structure by taking the obtained uncertainty modal parameters as input and adopting a Bayesian model correction method based on a progressive Markov chain Monte Carlo method (TMCMC), so as to obtain the town masonry residential safety assessment model with uncertainty parameters. And finally, performing safety assessment on the model by simultaneously considering load action and structural parameter uncertainty. According to the invention, an effective town masonry residential security assessment model can be constructed, so that the aims of long-term security management and disaster early warning of the type of houses are fulfilled.

title_en: A kind of Bath Heat-Transfer simulated behavior material, preparation method and applications
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Bath Heat-Transfer simulated behavior materials, it is a kind of three layers of Bath Heat-Transfer simulated behavior material, with the light metal layers in three layers of molten bath in reactor lower head in metal Na simulation major accident, eutectics fused salt LiCl/KCl simulates oxide skin(coating), and metal Sn simulates heavy metal layer.Simulation material of the invention have the characteristics that simple process, be easily achieved, performance is stable and cost is relatively low.Since physical property difference can form natural layering between each component, molten bath top and bottom metal layers in actual response heap are simulated using metal material, the characteristic close of material, the uncertainty that can effectively reduce experimental result, the problem of can be used for reactor disaster mechanism and mitigation strategy experimental study.

title_en: High-dimensional complex system uncertainty analysis method based on statistical machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-dimensional complex system uncertainty analysis method based on statistical machine learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: selecting uncertainty factors affecting a high-dimensional complex system, and acquiring a high-dimensional random variable input sample matrix; inputting the high-dimensional random variable into a sample matrix, and converting the high-dimensional random variable into a low-dimensional random variable sample matrix; the high-dimensional random variable is input into a sample matrix to be calculated one by one, so that an output response matrix is obtained; accurately modeling the random response surface agent model to obtain a random response surface model which is highly similar to the studied high-dimensional complex system; obtaining the mean value and variance of the output response quantity of the random response surface model by a formula deduction method; and analyzing the uncertainty factors according to the mean value and the variance to obtain an uncertainty analysis result. The method has the advantages of high accuracy of calculation results, reduced calculation amount and improved calculation efficiency on the basis of ensuring calculation accuracy, avoidance of dimension disaster, high flexibility and the like.

title_en: Active power distribution network load fault recovery strategy optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of power system control, and particularly relates to an optimization algorithm for load fault recovery strategy of an active power distribution network. According to the traditional fault recovery scheme, when an accident occurs, a load recovery plan is carried out on a whole fault time interval by a controllable Distributed Generation (DG), a distributed energy storage and other limited power generation devices according to the output predicted values of intermittent energy sources such as wind power, photovoltaic and the like, the load recovery scheme cannot be dynamically adjusted by acquiring real-time information, and further the key load in the fault time interval cannot be effectively recovered. The application provides an optimization algorithm for load fault recovery strategy of an active power distribution network, which comprises the following steps: step 1: constructing a multi-period load fault recovery strategy optimization model; step 2: and solving by considering the risk indexes aiming at the optimization model. And in consideration of random uncertainty of wind, light and other intermittent energy output, dynamically correcting the load recovery plan through real-time measurement information of renewable energy after extreme disasters.

title_en: Parallel intelligent emergency collaboration method, system and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to a parallel intelligent emergency cooperation method, a system and electronic equipment. Comprising the following steps: establishing an artificial system model based on visual space-time fusion, and performing crowd sensing and evacuation channel traffic state detection based on cross-video geographic intelligent fusion analysis on a space to be evacuated through the artificial system model; constructing a three-dimensional virtual simulation environment of the space to be evacuated, constructing a multi-agent evacuation simulation model based on personnel distribution based on historical disaster environment simulation and risk situation analysis, performing evacuation simulation through the multi-agent evacuation simulation model, and generating an optimal evacuation scheme prediction result; and establishing a parallel execution cooperative system based on real-time monitoring and augmented reality visualization to perform deduction simulation and dynamic evacuation simulation, and generating an optimal evacuation scheme by combining a prediction result of the calculation experiment system. The application solves the problems of prominence, instability, nonlinearity and uncertainty in a real system through virtual-real interaction mode and collaborative evolution.

title_en: Mathematical modeling method for uncertainty of intermittent energy output
abstract_en: The application relates to a mathematical modeling method for uncertainty of intermittent energy output. The existing modeling mode usually adopts historical data to fit the probability distribution of intermittent energy output, can not accurately describe the actual output distribution after natural disasters, and can not consider the influence caused by weather conditions. The application provides a mathematical modeling method for uncertainty of intermittent energy output, which comprises the following steps: step 1: initialization of the maximum expectation algorithm: solving initial values of model parameters by adopting a hard clustering algorithm; step 2: calculating the expectation: carrying out probability calculation aiming at hidden variables of each datum; and step 3: maximization: deducing a Gaussian mixture model parameter iteration formula with weight data; and 4, step 4: repeating the steps 2-3 until convergence. The method has the advantages that the problem of weight brought by different weather types is considered, the intermittent energy output probability distribution with different weights is effectively fitted, the model parameters are updated in real time, and the uncertainty of the intermittent energy in the extreme fault period is more accurately described.

title_en: Method and device for predicting track position of mobile user
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for predicting a track position of a mobile user, and belongs to the technical field of data mining processing. According to the invention, a circulating mixed density network comprising an LSTM network and an MDN network is constructed as a prediction model, the prediction model can automatically extract depth features, and the prediction model can be used for learning the motion trend, long-time history information and hidden representative features of a user from the latest trajectory data of the mobile user, so that the prediction of the position coordinates of the user in a period of time in the future is realized. The invention solves the problems of sparsity and dimension disaster faced when predicting continuous position coordinate values, can fully simulate the uncertainty of motion behaviors, and can improve the accuracy of prediction.

title_en: Active power distribution network optimal scheduling method for large-scale electric automobile access
abstract_en: The invention discloses an active power distribution network optimal scheduling method for large-scale electric automobile access, which particularly relates to the technical field of power distribution network optimal scheduling, and comprises the following steps: s1, a first layer is two-stage optimized scheduling implemented by DEMS; s2, performing real-time scheduling on the regional EV-EMS by a second layer; s3, optimizing a scheduling model and a solving method in each stage. According to the invention, the three-section type optimal scheduling strategy is adopted to cooperatively realize the daily scheduling of controllable resources of the power distribution network, the daily correction and the real-time control of EVs charging, the influence of uncertainty factors such as RES power generation, EVs charging behavior randomness and the like is reduced, the computing time is greatly reduced, the problem of dimension disaster is solved by adopting a 'centralized + distributed' mixed computing framework, in addition, the adverse effect of local communication failure on overall optimal scheduling is also reduced, and the requirement on the reliability of a communication system is reduced.

title_en: Method and system for calculating fault rate of power distribution network under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for calculating the fault rate of a power distribution network under typhoon disasters, wherein the method comprises the following steps: respectively establishing a probability density function model representing typhoon intensity and a probability distribution function model representing typhoon duration; establishing a power distribution network fault rate calculation model under typhoon disasters; and calculating the total probability of load power loss in the duration time of the typhoon disaster based on the power distribution network fault rate calculation model. The invention simultaneously considers the uncertainty of typhoon intensity and duration, analyzes the physical principle of different types of faults of the power distribution network caused by typhoon disasters and has higher accuracy. The method is used for modeling the fault rate of the power distribution network, the influence of typhoon intensity and duration on the fault rate of the power distribution network is comprehensively considered, the running state of the power distribution network under the typhoon disaster is completely and accurately described by carrying out detailed modeling on multiple disaster-causing factors and disaster-causing mechanisms of the typhoon disaster, and the precision of the fault rate model of the power distribution network is greatly improved by utilizing the advantage of combined driving of the data model.

title_en: Method and system for researching drainage basin water resource risk transfer rule
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for researching a drainage basin water resource risk transfer rule, which mainly aim at the uncertainty problem of drainage basin water resource scheduling and represent the problem of dynamic transfer of a risk source in a drainage basin system and a subsystem. Identifying the risk source elements of the water resources of the basin under study based on a disaster risk system theory and a disaster risk forming mechanism; establishing a watershed water resource risk evaluation model; the method comprises the steps of judging a water resource risk transfer relation by using a basin risk transfer method, identifying a water resource risk transfer path, establishing a basin water resource risk transfer model, drawing a risk transfer path diagram, and researching risk transfer characteristics and transfer rules. The method can evaluate the water resource risk on the time-space scale of the drainage basin, clearly analyze the water resource risk transmission path, direction and strength, analyze the risk transmission rule in a drainage basin system and a subsystem, and provide a new technical scheme for drainage basin water resource risk evaluation, forecast and management.

title_en: Disaster risk assessment method and system based on hesitation fuzzy set
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster risk assessment method based on a hesitation fuzzy set in the field of disaster assessment research, and aims to solve the problem that the accuracy and the usability of an assessment result are low due to the fact that the traditional disaster risk assessment depends on uncertainty information too much, so that the accuracy and the efficiency of the disaster risk assessment are improved. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of converting hesitation fuzzy semantic terms into interval numbers by means of a rough set thought, expressing uncertain information such as urban water disaster occurrence frequency, severity and tightness by adopting the hesitation fuzzy semantic terms, sequencing risk modes by means of DEMATEL analysis of net influence degree of risk factors and a VIKOR method, and constructing a disaster risk assessment model.

title_en: Safety evaluation method for coal mine spontaneous combustion coal seam
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting a fire disaster in a coal mine spontaneous combustion coal seam, which introduces an entropy method and a mutation theory into a model structure, wherein the entropy method is a measure for uncertainty factors, and the mutation theory can directly process discontinuous change and mutation phenomena and is particularly suitable for the research of a system with uncertain internal action. The mutation series method is a nonlinear dynamic evaluation method, and can accurately calculate the membership degree of each evaluation index aiming at the uncertainty and the mutation of the spontaneous combustion fire of the coal mine. Therefore, the entropy method and the mutation theory are combined and applied, and the uncertainty and the mutation of the spontaneous combustion fire of the coal mine can be well met.

title_en: Disaster explore robot and operating method of thereof
title_ko: 재난 탐사 로봇 및 이의 동작 방법
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a disaster exploration robot capable of performing a precise investigation on a target, and an operation method thereof. The disaster exploration robot according to one embodiment of the present invention includes: a movement unit moving the disaster exploration robot; a measurement unit which acquires an image of a search area; a recognition unit which detects a plurality of objects from the image and recognizes coordinates of each of the plurality of objects; a communication unit transmitting the image to a remote device; and a control unit which sets the at least one object as a target object and controls the movement unit to move to coordinates of the target object, when the communication unit receives a selection of at least one of the plurality of objects from the remote device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 의한 재난 탐사 로봇은, 상기 재난 탐사 로봇을 이동시키는 이동부; 와 탐색 지역에 대한 영상을 획득하는 측정부; 와 상기 영상으로부터 복수개의 물체를 검출하고, 상기 복수개의 물체 각각의 좌표를 인식하는 인식부; 와 상기 영상을 원격기기에 전송하는 통신부; 및 상기 통신부가 상기 원격기기로부터 상기 복수개의 물체 중 적어도 어느 하나의 물체에 대한 선택을 수신하는 경우, 상기 적어도 어느 하나의 물체를 목표 물체로 설정하고, 상기 목표 물체의 좌표로 이동하도록 상기 이동부를 제어하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Landslide movement distance transcendental probability calculation method
abstract_en: The application provides a landslide motion distance transcendental probability calculation method, which comprises the following steps: establishing a dynamic numerical model about a landslide object; taking the selected input parameters of the dynamic numerical model as random variables, and determining the statistical characteristics of the random variables; hierarchically sampling the random variable by utilizing a Latin hypercube sampling LHS method to generate a plurality of groups of random samples; inputting the random samples into the dynamic numerical model according to the statistical characteristics, and calculating the landslide motion distance corresponding to each group of random samples; determining a landslide movement distance threshold according to the actual distance between the disaster bearing body and the landslide object; and calculating the probability that the landslide motion distance exceeds the landslide motion distance threshold, and effectively quantifying the uncertainty of the input parameters so as to improve the reliability of the landslide prediction result.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster comprehensive risk dynamic assessment method based on multi-dimensional set information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive risk dynamic evaluation method based on multi-dimensional set information mountain torrent disasters, which comprises the following steps of: step 1, mountain torrent risk assessment based on corrected disaster rainfall; step 2, mountain torrent risk assessment based on water level-flow; step 3, mountain torrent risk assessment based on submergence range, flow velocity and water depth; step 4, determining the risk level of the torrential flood; step 5, dynamically evaluating the risk of torrential flood; and 6, carrying out uncertainty analysis on the mountain torrent risk assessment result. The invention provides a comprehensive risk dynamic assessment method for mountain torrent disasters based on multi-dimensional set information, which is suitable for the mountain torrent risk refined assessment of data-free areas, is more scientific and reliable in assessment index, and provides a more effective decision basis for mountain torrent disaster defense by performing dynamic assessment on the mountain torrent risk based on real-time monitoring data or simulated forecast data of a model.

title_en: Emergency plan validity evaluation method considering integrity and operability
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency plan validity evaluation method considering integrity and operability, which is used for modeling an emergency plan according to an emergency response flow; searching and determining disaster-bearing bodies affected by the emergency and related information thereof; constructing an emergency response logic flow based on a disaster-bearing body; constructing an integrity evaluation index system of the plan text, and determining index weight by adopting an analytic hierarchy process; grading the indexes by comparing the text description of the plan, and calculating to obtain an integrity comprehensive evaluation score; constructing a plan implementation operability evaluation index system, and determining index weight by adopting a triangular fuzzy number analytic hierarchy process; and (4) grading the actual implementation effect, processing the grading data to eliminate the influence of uncertainty on the evaluation result, and calculating to obtain an operability comprehensive evaluation score. The method adopts quantitative evaluation to reduce the influence of data fuzziness caused by subjectivity on the evaluation result as much as possible, and has stronger universality on evaluating the effectiveness of emergency plans for dealing with different emergencies.

title_en: Coal mine gas safety evaluation method based on D-S evidence theory
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine gas safety evaluation method based on a D-S evidence theory, which comprises the steps of S1, setting classification indexes and constructing an identification framework; s2, acquiring original data and calculating to obtain a plurality of evidence source data for evaluation; s3, designing a basic probability distribution function by adopting a posterior probability modeling method; s4, correcting the basic probability distribution function, reducing the conflict of the evaluation evidence data, S5, adopting the conflict distribution coefficient, improving the Dempster combination rule, and fusing the evaluation evidence data; s6, carrying out uncertainty measurement by using Shannon entropy, and proposing a decision suggestion; according to the invention, the predicted value of the monitoring data is used as evidence source data, so that the advance prejudgment of the gas safety state is realized, and the emergency level and the control capability of the gas disaster are improved; the Dempster combination rule is improved, the accuracy of fusion data is improved, and the automation and the reliability of evaluation are improved.

title_en: Method for determining optimal search area of maritime crash airplane and drowning person
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining an optimal search area for a maritime crash airplane and drowning personnel. According to the method, firstly, the crash position of the maritime crash airplane is calculated by using the airplane crash model according to the known air crash information. And then, based on the calculated crash position of the maritime crash airplane, calculating the optimal search area of the maritime crash airplane and the personnel falling into the water by using a search target drift model according to the information of the crash position. The method solves the problem of low success rate of maritime search and rescue depending on experience and judgment of search and rescue personnel, and has important significance for improving the success rate of maritime search and rescue.

title_en: Optimal configuration method, storage medium and device for remote switch of elastic power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimal configuration method, a storage medium and equipment for a telemechanical switch of an elastic power distribution network, which are used for acquiring transformer data, distribution network load data and system topological structure information connected with a distribution network system; and (3) iterating by using a robust optimized CCG algorithm, solving the most serious attack mode with the maximum cut load power as a target for a given telemechanical switch configuration scheme in each iteration, including the attack mode into an uncertainty set of the robust optimization, and solving the optimal switch configuration scheme with the minimum power cut load power of the power grid as a target for the uncertainty set consisting of a series of attack modes obtained at present, wherein the power grid can maintain the power supply to the greatest extent when suffering from the most serious attack through continuous iteration. According to the invention, through reasonable switch configuration, when the power grid is struck by an extreme disaster event and fails, the switch can be operated in time to isolate the failure, so that the power failure range and loss are reduced.

title_en: Plateau mountain land landslide hazard early warning system based on daily displacement rate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a plateau mountain land landslide hazard early warning system based on daily displacement rate, which comprises a plateau mountain land landslide early warning protection system, a landform condition system, a daily displacement calculation system and an intelligent early warning system, wherein the daily displacement calculation system is used for obtaining the action of the place, the distance, the speed and the time of landslide debris flow, a building distance measurement module is used for measuring the distance between a building and the debris flow, a landslide countdown module is used for measuring the time of the debris flow reaching a corresponding building, a plateau mountain position module and an altitude sample analysis module are fixedly arranged in a geographic information module, and a soil quality type analysis module and a flowability analysis module are fixedly arranged in the soil quality information module; the method is applied to predicting the landslide disaster in advance, displaying general conditions intuitively and vividly, and when the disaster happens, the path and direction of the landslide movement can be known in time, so that the uncertainty caused by the disaster is reduced.

title_en: Gaussian process method and device for rapidly identifying stability coefficient of sliding karst dangerous rock
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Gaussian process method and device for rapidly identifying a stability coefficient of sliding karst dangerous rocks, and mainly solves the problem of reasonably identifying the anti-sliding stability safety coefficient of sliding unstable collapse type dangerous rocks in a karst region. Firstly, selecting 14 characteristic indexes which obviously influence the stability coefficient of the sliding karst dangerous rock; secondly, establishing a machine learning sample set through collection of a plurality of engineering examples and calculation of stability coefficients; then, training and testing a GPR model by adopting a cross validation strategy; further, inputting a new dangerous rock mass to be recognized into the trained GPR model, and directly outputting a recognition result with probability significance of the stability coefficient of the dangerous rock mass to be recognized; and finally, quantitatively evaluating the uncertainty of the identification result. The method can be used for rapidly identifying the stability coefficient of the large-batch slippage type dangerous rock mass in the karst region, and is particularly suitable for geological disaster management or technical personnel application without professional background knowledge and experience of calculation and analysis of the stability of the dangerous rock mass.

title_en: Distribution network disaster prevention material allocation method, device, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a distribution network disaster prevention material allocation method, a device, a terminal and a storage medium, which take account of the uncertainty of disaster conditions and utilize the result of Bayesian network disaster condition inference, namely node outage probability of each node, and then fuse the node outage probability on the basis of the distribution network importance degree information such as weight coefficient and load quantity of the nodes, and the elastic risk index of the whole distribution network is taken as a judging objective function to obtain node material allocation quantity of each node when the elastic risk index meets the optimization requirement, thereby realizing the optimization of distribution network overall material allocation and solving the technical problems of unreasonable disaster prevention material allocation and high resource waste degree of the conventional distribution network disaster prevention material allocation mode.

title_en: Search and rescue resource scheme generation method based on search theory and related equipment
abstract_en: One or more embodiments of the present disclosure provide a search and rescue resource scheme generation method and related devices based on a search theory, including: acquiring accident information and search and rescue capacity information of search and rescue resources; determining the search area and the discovery probability of search and rescue resources so as to determine the search success rate; determining a comprehensive score of the search and rescue resources according to the search and rescue capacity information so as to determine a robustness score; and determining a solution set based on a multi-objective decision analysis algorithm, determining an optimal solution set according to the search success rate and the robustness score, and generating and outputting an optimal solution scheme. One or more embodiments of the present disclosure determine the search success rate and the robustness score of the search and rescue resources based on the accident information and the available search and rescue resource information, and perform analysis and solution to provide a more reasonable search and rescue resource scheme to assist a decision maker in making a scientific decision, so that a task allocation scheme for the search and rescue resources can be efficiently completed, the search and rescue time is saved, and the search and rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Fuzzy BN task reliability prediction method for multi-state airborne search and rescue system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of reliability analysis of aviation onboard search and rescue systems, and discloses a fuzzy Bayesian Network (BN) task reliability prediction method for a multi-state onboard search and rescue system. The description advantages of logic association and uncertainty information thereof in a complex system by BN and the division definition capability of a fuzzy set theory on multiple states of performance degradation equipment are integrated, the model can effectively express the uncertainty of the search and rescue system under the multi-level and multi-cross-linked logic and the multi-state attribute of the equipment under the performance degradation, and the prediction and evaluation of the system task reliability level and the health state trend are realized.
assignees: CHINESE AERONAUTICAL RADIO ELECTRONICS RES INST

title_en: Simple typhoon moving direction prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simple typhoon moving direction prediction method, which comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring physical quantity and time sequence thereof on a lattice point isobaric surface; secondly, preprocessing the physical quantity to enable the time intervals to be equidistant and calculating the total time; thirdly, performing multi-scale subspace transformation scale decomposition on the physical quantity; fourthly, calculating the regular transmission of kinetic energy between the typhoon and the environment where the typhoon is located Fifth, intercepting typhoon within 7 degrees of center And performing vertical averaging on the obtained data; sixthly, calculating the typhoon center The orientation of the dipole. The prediction method only uses the existing data to carry out prediction, does not need large-scale numerical prediction, and saves a large amount of calculated amount and precious time on the premise of ensuring the accuracy. The method provides timely opinions for dealing with typhoon disaster early warning decisions, can adjust typhoon disaster protection policies more timely, reduces the panic of the public on the uncertainty of the typhoon disaster, enables the public to transfer property as early as possible, and reduces direct economic loss.

title_en: Simulation method for evacuation process of people in fire, evacuation early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for simulating the evacuation process of people under a fire disaster, an evacuation early warning method and a system. The sample is obtained by a simulation method of a personnel evacuation process under the fire, the simulation method comprehensively considers the correlation among building fire spread, structural failure and personnel evacuation in the simulation process, and simulates an evacuation route corresponding to a fire source according to the preset fire source. The evacuation route adopted by the invention is obtained according to the actual simulation condition, the risk uncertainty of fire spread, the resistance uncertainty of structural failure and the environment uncertainty of personnel evacuation are considered, and the real-time evacuation efficiency and the personnel safety under the condition of uncertain structural failure, in particular the safety of fire rescue people, can be improved.

title_en: Deep learning-based power transmission channel surrounding environment classification method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for classifying surrounding environments of a power transmission channel based on deep learning, wherein the method and the system comprise the following steps: acquiring a high-resolution remote sensing image of the surrounding environment of a power transmission channel to be classified; inputting the high-resolution remote sensing image into a pre-trained deep learning model to generate a class probability map of the surrounding environment of the power transmission channel; classifying the power transmission channel surrounding environment based on the class probability map; the deep learning model is obtained by training by using an object-oriented classification method based on the historical remote sensing images and the probability of each ground object type in the historical remote sensing images. The classification of the surrounding environment of the power transmission channel is realized by utilizing the deep learning model and the object-oriented method, the high-resolution remote sensing image can be further utilized to classify the ground surface covering objects around the power transmission channel, and meanwhile, basic data support and auxiliary decision basis are provided for the safe operation of power facilities, emergency rescue planning and the like.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Deep learning improved algorithm for cold source disaster-induced disaster prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning improved algorithm for cold source disaster causing disaster prediction, which comprises the following steps: carrying out statistical classification on factors affecting disaster-causing disaster of cold source, and carrying out normalization processing on multi-source heterogeneous data by using a data normalization function to obtain grouped sample data; establishing a deep belief network, adopting a momentum learning rate-based deep belief network improvement algorithm, and combining a plurality of groups of sample data to perform repeated iterative training of model parameters so as to obtain a mapping relation determined between input and output of the deep belief network; and predicting the disaster grade of the cold source disaster causing object. According to the invention, by adopting an improved algorithm of deep learning, the network learning efficiency is effectively improved, the error convergence rate of prediction is reduced, and the problem of prediction of marine disaster caused by non-linearity, time variability and uncertainty is well solved.

title_en: Expansion planning method for elastically-lifting urban electricity and gas comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of interconnected comprehensive energy system planning, in particular to an expansion planning method for an elastic lifting urban electricity and gas comprehensive energy system, which comprises the following steps of S1: dividing the urban electricity and gas comprehensive energy system into three disaster-stricken grades according to three evaluation indexes; s2: establishing a disaster fault uncertainty set of basic elements of the urban electricity and gas comprehensive energy system; s3: establishing an elastically-lifted urban electricity and gas comprehensive energy system expansion planning robust optimization model; s4, the established robust optimization model has a max-min-max three-layer structure, the established robust optimization model is converted, and a column constraint algorithm is utilized to solve the robust optimization model; s5: the method comprises the steps of using an IEEE33 node power system and a Belgium 20 node natural gas system as simulation calculation examples to verify and explain a model, using MATLAB language to program the model, and calling a CPLEX tool box to solve; the method has the advantages of more accurate and reasonable result and the aim of improving the elasticity of the system under the condition of optimal expansion planning.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle rescue device and method based on sound wave positioning
abstract_en: An unmanned aerial vehicle rescue device and a method based on sound wave positioning comprise an unmanned aerial vehicle, a ground trapped person matching device and a ground control PC, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle is internally provided with a communication module, a loudspeaker, an unmanned aerial vehicle end audio frequency identification module and a sound source positioning module, the ground trapped person matching device comprises a wearable bracelet and a portable sound production device, the wearable bracelet is in communication connection with the portable sound production device, the wearable bracelet is internally provided with a Bluetooth module, a ground person end audio frequency identification device and a sound production device control module, a search area covers the whole target area by controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to hover at intervals in the search area, the portable sound production device is controlled to emit audio signals after the audio signals emitted by the unmanned aerial vehicle are identified by the ground person end audio frequency identification device, the unmanned aerial vehicle calculates the coordinate information of ground persons according to the received audio signals and the time delay of a microphone and performs marking and, and transmits the information to the ground control PC.

title_en: Spilled oil searching and collecting apparatus
title_ko: 유출유 탐색 및 회수 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for searching and collecting spilled oil and, more specifically, to an apparatus for searching and collecting spilled oil which uses a drone (unmanned moving body) to quickly search for spilled oil, and quickly establishes a disaster prevention plan in accordance with search information of spilled oil. To this end, the apparatus for searching and collecting spilled oil comprises: a disaster prevention search area setting unit which sets the coordinates of a disaster prevention search area in an unmanned moving body to fly the disaster prevention search area in an unmanned manner in accordance with an ocean oil spill accident; a spilled oil search unit which searches for spilled oil based on a spilled oil search image acquired while flying the disaster prevention search area; a spilled oil distinguishing unit which separates oil and seawater based on the spilled oil search image to distinguish spilled oil; a disaster prevention route search unit which searches for a spilled oil collection route based on information of the spilled oil distinguishing unit; an oil collection unit which separates oil and seawater by specific gravity while collecting spilled oil along the searched spilled oil collection route; and a collected oil storage unit which is detachably coupled to and fixed on the oil collection unit, and stores oil separated by the oil collection unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 유출유 탐색 및 회수 장치에 관한 것으로서, 무인 이동체인 드론을 활용하여 신속히 유출유를 탐색하고, 유출유의 탐색정보에 따라 방제 계획을 신속히 수립하는 유출유 탐색 및 회수 장치에 관한 것이다. 이를 위해 해양 기름 유출사고에 따라 방제 탐색영역을 무인 비행하도록 무인 이동체에 방제 탐색영역의 좌표를 설정하는 방제 탐색영역 설정부, 방제 탐색영역을 비행하면서 획득되는 유출유 탐색영상을 토대로 유출유를 탐색하는 유출유 탐색부, 유출유 탐색영상을 토대로 기름과 해수를 구분하여 유출유를 판별하는 유출유 판별부, 유출유 판별부의 정보에 기초하여 유출유 회수 경로를 탐색하는 방제 경로 탐색부, 탐색된 유출유 회수 경로를 따라 유출유를 회수하면서 기름과 해수를 비중에 의해 분리하는 유회수부, 및 유회수부와 착탈식으로 결합 고정되며, 유회수부에서 분리된 기름을 저장하는 회수유 저장부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 유출유 탐색 및 회수 장치가 개시된다.

title_en: Spilled oil collecting apparatus
title_ko: 무인 이동체와 연동되어 유출유를 회수하는 유출유 회수 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a spilled oil collection apparatus linked to an unmanned moving body to collect spilled oil and, more specifically, to a spilled oil collection apparatus linked to an unmanned moving body to collect spilled oil which uses a drone (unmanned moving body) to quickly search for spilled oil, and quickly establishes a disaster prevention plan in accordance with search information of spilled oil. To this end, the spilled oil collection apparatus linked to an unmanned moving body to collect spilled oil comprises: an unmanned moving body which generates and transmits a spilled oil search image photographed while flying a disaster prevention search area set in accordance with an ocean oil spill accident; an oil collector which separates oil and seawater by specific gravity while collecting spilled oil along a spilled oil collection route generated based on the spilled oil search image; a collected oil storage unit which is detachably coupled to and fixed on the oil collection unit, and stores oil separated by the oil collection unit; and a mother ship which establishes a disaster prevention plan based on a disaster prevention area generated based on the spilled oil search image, and generates a control command to allow the oil collector to collect spilled oil along a spilled oil collection route generated based on marine weather information, oil band pattern information, and oil collection coordinate information of the disaster prevention area.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무인 이동체와 연동되어 유출유를 회수하는 유출유 회수 장치에 관한 것으로서, 무인 이동체인 드론을 활용하여 신속히 유출유를 탐색하고, 유출유의 탐색정보에 따라 방제 계획을 신속히 수립하는 무인 이동체와 연동되어 유출유를 회수하는 유출유 회수 장치에 관한 것이다. 이를 위해 해양 기름 유출사고에 따라 설정된 방제 탐색영역을 비행하면서 촬영된 유출유 탐색영상을 생성 및 전송하는 무인 이동체, 유출유 탐색영상에 기초하여 생성된 유출유 회수 경로를 따라 유출유를 회수하면서 기름과 해수를 비중에 의해 분리하는 유회수기, 유회수부와 착탈식으로 결합 고정되며, 유회수부에서 분리된 기름을 저장하는 회수유 저장부, 유출유 탐색영상에 기초하여 생성된 방제영역을 기초로 방제계획을 수립하며, 방제영역의 기름 회수 좌표정보, 기름 띄 패턴정보 및 해상 기상정보를 기초로 생성된 유출유 회수 경로를 따라 유회수기가 유출유를 회수하도록 제어명령을 생성하는 모선을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 무인 이동체와 연동되어 유출유를 회수하는 유출유 회수 장치가 개시된다.

title_en: Method for determining optimal loss curve of non-data city based on double-layer target optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining an optimal loss curve of a double-layer target optimized non-data city based on a variation coefficient and beta distribution optimization principle, which is used for reducing uncertainty in a data processing process. Firstly, transferring loss rate values of a data reference area to a research area aiming at inland plain cities of disaster-lack data by referring to a comparison principle; and secondly, based on a preferred principle that the variation coefficient is minimum and the beta distribution probability is maximum, reducing the quotation error and the statistical error generated in the loss rate quotation, acquiring a relatively accurate investigation region loss value, and further establishing a disaster-suffering water depth-loss rate relation curve of the disaster-lack data city. Therefore, the generalized non-data city disaster damage curve fitting method taking the regional index value as an input parameter and the damage curve as an output result is formed, and scientific reference is provided for the establishment of a non-data city flood damage curve.

title_en: Power distribution network post-disaster power supply recovery method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a system for recovering power supply of a power distribution network after a disaster, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring current state information of a power distribution network system; and acquiring an optimal control strategy of the power distribution network according to the current state information of the power distribution network system and the trained power supply model, wherein the trained power supply model is obtained by training the power supply model through a training sample and a training label. The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a system for recovering power supply of a power distribution network after a disaster, aiming at uncertainty in a micro-grid system, a power supply model is trained, so that the power supply model can fully learn a plurality of uncertain factors in the micro-grid during training, and the robustness of the method is improved; and by utilizing the trained power supply model, the power supply model does not need to be solved again in different scenes, so that the recovery capability of the power distribution network and the load power supply duration are improved.

title_en: Glacier debris flow disaster early warning method based on pregnancy disaster background
abstract_en: The invention provides a glacier debris flow disaster early warning method based on a pregnant disaster background, and belongs to the technical field of disaster reduction and prevention. Determining a characteristic value of a debris flow basin through a remote sensing image or mapping data; (2) acquiring meteorological data in a drainage basin range through meteorological remote sensing or observation data; (3) determining the source quantity through field investigation; (4) obtaining the change of the glacier area by remote sensing or monitoring, calculating the daily change kappa of the glacier area, and obtaining the channel avalanche accumulation V by field investigation s And the change rule day by day; (5) and (4) carrying out data processing on the debris flow pregnancy disaster background parameters obtained in the steps 1-4, calculating an early warning factor value of the glacier debris flow disaster, and sending early warning signals of different grades according to the size of the early warning factor. The invention fully considers the interaction of the trigger factors and the underlying surface conditions, and effectively solves the problems of the polygenetic and uncertainty of the triggering conditions of the glacier debris flow disasters.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF EXPLORATION TECH OF CHINESE ACADEMY OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Electrical interconnection system toughness assessment and improvement method considering seismic uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electrical interconnection system toughness assessment and improvement method considering seismic uncertainty, which comprises the following steps: enumerating the combination of the seismic source position and the seismic level gear, and obtaining the probability of each potential seismic scene according to the seismic disaster probability model; then, intensity distribution of different earthquake scenes is obtained through an intensity attenuation model, and the failure probability of the elements based on the intensity is worked out according to a pre-built electrical interconnection system; solving the load reduction amount under each order of fault state by applying an electrical interconnection system load reduction optimization algorithm based on a two-stage gas network optimization load flow model; calculating toughness indexes according to the probability of each potential earthquake scene, the element failure probability and the load reduction amount under each order of fault state, wherein if the system level toughness index is lower than a set standard value, the planning scheme reaches the standard, otherwise, a toughness improvement strategy needs to be implemented; and obtaining a plurality of alternative schemes according to the element-level toughness indexes, and working out an element strengthening scheme through cost-benefit analysis so as to correct the planning scheme.

title_en: Method for reducing natural disaster loss through artificial intervention earthquake
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the field of geoscience and discloses a method for reducing natural disaster loss through artificial intervention on earthquakes. According to the invention, through drilling and deep burying, explosives are placed near the position of the crust with potential earthquake risk, the explosives are detonated, and the stress and energy accumulated in the crust are released, so that the aims of early prediction and planned occurrence of the earthquake are fulfilled. Avoiding personal casualties and property loss caused by the uncertainty of earthquake. The natural disaster of the earthquake which is originally uncertain and high in loss is made to be interventable and low in loss.
assignees: SHENYANG COMMUNICATION NETWORK SERVICE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Calculation method for volume weight characteristic value of viscous debris flow
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for calculating a volume weight characteristic value of a viscous debris flow, and belongs to the technical field of disaster reduction and prevention. The method comprises the steps of (1) carrying out field investigation on the debris flow gully and calculating the peak flow of the debris flow; (2) determining the position of a sampling area according to the debris flow accumulation form and obtaining a soil sample; (3) analyzing the particle component characteristics of each soil sample, and calculating the volume weight value corresponding to each sample; (4) analyzing the data of each sampling area, and calculating the average value of the volume weight values obtained in the step (3) as the volume weight of the area; (5) analyzing the volume weight obtained in the step (4), and calculating the maximum volume weight and the average volume weight of the debris flow; (6) and (5) analyzing the relation between the volume weight value obtained in the step (5) and the peak flow value obtained in the step (1), and checking the calculation result. The invention fully considers the sampling error generated by the debris flow accumulation sample and the correlation relationship among all parameters, and effectively solves the problems of ambiguity and uncertainty in the definition and calculation of the current debris flow volume weight value.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF EXPLORATION TECH OF CHINESE ACADEMY OF GEOLOGICAL SCIENCES

title_en: Interval demonstration multi-sensor fusion disaster cellular alarm linkage system based on particle swarm optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a particle swarm optimization-based disaster cellular alarm linkage system with interval demonstration and multi-sensor fusion, which comprises a fire monitoring alarm linkage system, a public fire alarm system and a property management platform, wherein the fire monitoring alarm linkage system comprises entrance guard terminals of all unit buildings of a community and cellular user terminals; emergency alarm switches are arranged on the property management platform and the property management platform; the public fire alarm system comprises CO, smoke and temperature sensors and an alarm controller which are arranged in a residential building, wherein a fire judgment data fusion algorithm based on IPSO optimized interval demonstration multi-sensor fusion is arranged in the alarm controller. The fire monitoring alarm linkage system and the public fire alarm system work in a matched mode, automatic fire alarm and manual fire alarm are integrated, an IPSO optimized interval demonstration multi-sensor fusion fire judgment data fusion algorithm is based on, and uncertainty of sensor measurement data is eliminated.

title_en: Mobile fire-fighting robot image building method applied to post-disaster rescue environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mobile fire-fighting robot image building method applied to a post-disaster rescue environment. Firstly, initializing a system, including a state vector of the robot; then adding the landmark state into a robot motion model, and establishing an observation model; and secondly, acquiring the optimal control input of the robot and updating time. If no new landmarks are found, only predictions are made and not updated. If a new landmark is found to be metrology updated, the landmark estimates are convex grouped and fused if the landmark has been found by other robots. Finally, whether the whole environment is traversed or not is judged, and the position of the landmark is determined; and outputting all landmarks to finish map building. According to the invention, through adopting convex combination fusion and introducing attraction factors, the accuracy of self-positioning map construction of the robot is improved, the exploration environment is guided, the uncertainty is reduced, the positioning map construction precision is greatly improved, and the efficiency of post-disaster rescue can be effectively improved.

title_en: Flow process analysis method for intensity index space variation flow state landslide
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flow process analysis method of an intensity index space variation flow state landslide, which comprises the steps of inputting boundary conditions of the flow state landslide, the geometric dimension of a landslide body and rock and soil body intensity index space variation parameters into a program, initializing the boundary conditions, the geometric dimension of the landslide body and the rock and soil body intensity index space variation parameters, utilizing a Karhunen-Lo e expansion method as a stochastic theory, modeling uncertainty and space propagation of a random variable to generate a random sample of the space variation flow state landslide, carrying out deterministic analysis on the flow process of the flow state landslide based on an SPH method, combining the stochastic theory with an SPH model, carrying out Monte Carlo simulation in the SPH method, and finally carrying out statistical analysis on simulation results of different stochastic examples to obtain a probability statistical rule of flow state landslide sliding distance and sliding speed; the method can evaluate the sliding distance, the sliding speed and the disaster causing range of the landslide under the influence of the spatial variability of the strength parameters.

title_en: Quick evaluation method for toughness of power transmission system based on influence increment sensitivity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quick evaluation method for toughness of a power transmission system based on influence on incremental sensitivityThe estimation method comprises the following steps: step 1: inputting initial parameters; step 2: enumerating a transmission system N-order fault state set omega  N  Initializing a fault state counter s to be 1; and step 3: calculating the load loss I of each fault state s  s  (ii) a And 4, step 4: calculating the incremental influence DeltaI of each fault state s  s  (ii) a And 5: if s<S, enabling S to be S +1, and returning to the step 3; otherwise, go to step 6; step 6: calculating a toughness evaluation index value R under the typhoon disaster scene 1  1  (ii) a And 7: calculation of R  1  Partial derivatives of the N order, and the like; finally calculating the toughness index R of the power transmission system with the uncertainty of the typhoon; the method can quantitatively calculate the variable quantity of the toughness index of the power transmission system when the fault probability of the power transmission branch changes in different typhoon scenes, and further can quickly calculate the toughness index of the power transmission system considering the uncertainty of the typhoon.

title_en: Uncertainty quantification method for wind speed of atmospheric boundary layer
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of boundary layer wind speed numerical calculation in atmospheric science, and particularly relates to an uncertainty quantification method for wind speed of an atmospheric boundary layer. The method comprises the following steps: 1, decorrelating the viscosity coefficient of the random turbulence by utilizing K-L decomposition; 2, projecting the multivariate response value to a dimension by using a projection resampling method; 3, solving a full dimension reduction conversion matrix by using a slice inverse regression method; 4, regarding the dimension reduction space obtained in the step 3 as a control variable to restrain the error of the Monte Carlo method; and 5, solving the mean value and the variance of the wind speed of the atmospheric boundary layer along with the height change. The effect of inertia item has been kept in this application, has considered the change of torrent stickness coefficient along with the height, and calculates portably, is a practical and effectual mode of research atmospheric boundary layer, and its result is more accurate, and belongs to non-invasive method, can effectively overcome the problem of "dimension disaster", can also guarantee that the precision of result is more excellent simultaneously under the circumstances that the calculated amount is less than the Monte Carlo method.

title_en: Prediction method for maximum drift distance of debris flow
abstract_en: The invention provides a forecasting method of the maximum washout distance of a debris flow, which comprises the steps of firstly determining an optimal one-dimensional probability distribution model of the maximum washout distance of the debris flow, a washout volume of the debris flow and a height difference of a debris flow basin; then, establishing three-dimensional joint probability distribution among the maximum debris flow rushing-out distance, the debris flow rushing-out volume and the height difference of the drainage basin based on an optimal one-dimensional probability distribution model of the maximum debris flow rushing-out distance, the debris flow rushing-out volume and the height difference of the drainage basin; and finally, a predicted value of the maximum drift distance of the debris flow under a certain conditional probability is given based on the established three-dimensional joint probability model. The calculation result shows that the maximum rush-out distance of the debris flow predicted by the method is well consistent with the measured value. The method overcomes the defects that the existing method for determining the maximum rushing-out distance of the debris flow cannot consider the self variability and uncertainty of the debris flow, and researches the probability prediction method of the debris flow danger zone from an uncertain angle. The probability prediction method has extremely important significance in aspects of debris flow danger range prediction, debris flow disaster risk assessment research and the like.

title_en: Path planning method and device for searching of unmanned aircraft and unmanned aircraft
abstract_en: The invention discloses a path planning method and a path planning device for unmanned aircraft searching and an unmanned aircraft, and belongs to the technical field of offshore intelligent search and rescue, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: analyzing the marine accident information by adopting a Monte Carlo random particle simulation method to establish a particle initial distribution map; performing cluster analysis on the initial particle distribution by using a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM), and determining a target search area corresponding to the probability of the best particle based on a corrosion expansion confidence ellipse algorithm; s2: establishing an under-actuated unmanned aircraft steering mathematical model adaptive to boundary characteristics, and determining a steering non-working path; s3: and optimizing the global search discovery probability and the search total path based on a double-normalization multi-target search planning algorithm to obtain an area coverage optimal path planning strategy. The invention provides a search area determining method, improves a classic parallel line sea sweeping search strategy to realize area search planning, and improves the search success probability of the people in distress on the premise of putting limited search force.

title_en: Random sequential inversion method for permeability coefficient of embankment body material
abstract_en: A random sequential inversion method for permeability coefficient of dyke body material includes such steps as designing the sections according to the flood-fighting requirement and the structural characteristics of dyke, setting up the monitor sections at equal intervals, and arranging several vertical-tube osmometers. According to the uncertainty of the permeability coefficient of the embankment material, a hydraulics or finite element method is used for carrying out embankment seepage analysis, a functional relation among the water level of a monitoring point, a seepage line and the permeability coefficient of the material is established, random sequential inversion analysis is carried out on the permeability coefficient of the embankment material based on a maximum likelihood estimation method, random sequential inversion analysis is carried out on the permeability coefficient of the embankment material by utilizing monitoring data measured from different positions at different moments, the permeability coefficient value of the embankment material is accurately determined, and flood fighting and early warning are carried out by setting a permeability coefficient threshold value. The invention not only is beneficial to finding out the problem of the dike in time, but also can guide dike management personnel to pertinently carry out flood control and emergency rescue work.

title_en: Method for evaluating occurrence probability grade of tunnel water inrush disaster in fault fracture zone
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for evaluating the occurrence probability grade of a tunnel inrush water disaster in a fault fracture zone, which comprises the following steps: designing index system constituent elements; establishing an inrush water disaster occurrence probability evaluation index system; utilizing an expert evaluation mechanism to obtain the membership degree of each level of the evaluation index of the occurrence probability of the inrush water disaster; carrying out weight calculation on the evaluation index of the occurrence probability of the sudden water inrush disaster; and evaluating by adopting a multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. The method overcomes the defect of subjectivity of a hierarchy analysis method decision result in the existing disaster risk evaluation, adopts a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method to carry out decision making, utilizes concepts of fuzzy sets and membership degrees to describe and quantify fuzzy uncertainty factors, adopts an entropy weight method to weaken the subjectivity of evaluation, and improves the defect of strong evaluation uncertainty of the grade of the occurrence probability of the tunnel inrush water disaster.

title_en: Side slope creep monitoring method, device, equipment, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a side slope creep monitoring method, a side slope creep monitoring device, side slope creep monitoring equipment, a side slope creep monitoring system and a storage medium, and relates to the field of geological disaster monitoring. The side slope creep monitoring method comprises the steps of calculating the similarity of a reference image and a window image in a first search area preset by a first acquisition image by using a sliding window method, and determining a first matching image with the highest similarity and larger than a preset first threshold; setting a second search area in the first acquisition picture based on the coordinate range of the first matching image; based on a sliding window method with the step length smaller than 1 pixel, acquiring a range of a first coordinate corresponding to a window image with the highest similarity with the reference image in the second search area; and calculating and outputting a first slope displacement value based on the first coordinate range and the coordinate range of the monitoring area. The sliding window with the step length smaller than 1 pixel is used for identifying the image with the finer granularity, the more accurate image is determined for displacement calculation, so that the calculation result is higher in accuracy, and the obtained conclusion and the alarm are more reliable.
assignees: GUANGZHOU XIEZUO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Post-disaster power distribution network dynamic first-aid repair method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-disaster power distribution network dynamic first-aid repair method and a post-disaster power distribution network dynamic first-aid repair system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring state information of a post-disaster power distribution network to be dynamically repaired through an environment side; inputting the state information of the post-disaster power distribution network to be dynamically repaired to an intelligent body side comprising a reinforcement learning model to obtain a dynamic repair result of the post-disaster power distribution network output by the intelligent body; the intelligent agent side obtains a reinforcement learning state from the environment side, selects an action to act on the power distribution network based on a strategy, receives a corresponding reward value and the next state for iterative training, and obtains the reinforcement learning model after continuously updating network parameters. The embodiment of the invention realizes the high-efficiency and high-accuracy emergency repair effect of the post-disaster emergency repair of the power distribution network under the conditions of deep coupling of cooperative allocation, emergency repair recovery and power transfer and recovery of multiple emergency repair teams and uncertainty of disaster conditions.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle mechanical arm tail end pose control method for multi-source interference
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for controlling the pose of the tail end of a mechanical arm of an unmanned aerial vehicle aiming at multi-source interference, and aims to realize high-precision control of the tail end of a special unmanned aerial vehicle system under the condition of multi-source interference. Firstly, establishing a multi-source interference model of a special unmanned aerial vehicle mechanical arm end pose control system, and secondly, designing a robust H-infinity controller aiming at a system nominal model; then designing a disturbance observer aiming at the multisource disturbance, and estimating and compensating the external disturbance and the model uncertainty; and finally, high-precision control of the pose of the tail end of the mechanical arm is ensured by reasonably selecting parameters of the robust H-infinity controller and the disturbance observer. The invention is based on a composite layered anti-interference control framework, realizes high-precision pose control of the tail end of the mechanical arm of a special unmanned aerial vehicle system under multi-source interference, and is suitable for special tasks such as emergency rescue, non-cooperative target capture in narrow space and the like.

title_en: Graph search driving mode based on extended spiral line
abstract_en: The invention provides a graph search driving mode based on an extended spiral line, and mainly solves the problems that parameters needing to be input when search rescue is carried out in the prior art are complex, the efficiency is low, a search area is incomplete, and the best search and rescue opportunity is easy to miss. The implementation scheme is as follows: according to the principle that the airplane realizes turning by controlling the inclination angle, firstly, four input parameters of an initial position delta, an initial radius chi, a linear increasing speed xi and a turning direction lambda are set; then, respectively calculating an inclination angle alpha and an additional inclination angle beta according to a standard control law and an airplane turning radius formula; and finally, controlling the airplane to realize a circular flight mode with a radius r ═ χ + ξ × dt increasing according to the new inclination angle γ ═ α + β, wherein dt is a program cycle period. The invention has the advantages of simple input parameters, high efficiency and wide search coverage, can effectively avoid or reduce casualties, meets the use requirements of search and rescue, and can be used for an airborne navigation system.
assignees: SHAANXI CHANGLING ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Fire brigade fire fighting rescue success probability calculation method based on Monte Carlo simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for calculating the success probability of fire fighting rescue of a fire brigade based on Monte Carlo simulation, which takes input uncertainty parameters as samples and comprises the following steps: s1, determining simulation times N; s2, obtaining distribution types of uncertainty parameters and generating N groups of uncertainty samples; s3, calculating the bombing time t of the building through Monte Carlo simulation f And the intervention time t of the fire brigade i An uncertainty sample of (d); s4, fitting the ratio R of the intervention time of the fire brigade to the flashover time of the building tc Probability density distribution function f (R) tc ) (ii) a And S5, calculating the fire fighting and rescue success probability of the fire brigade and analyzing the influence of the uncertain parameters. The invention has the advantages that: and (4) calculating the success probability of the fire fighting team for extinguishing the building fire in a simulation mode, and analyzing the influence of each uncertain parameter on the success probability.

title_en: Table lookup correction method for average loss of catastrophe event model
abstract_en: The invention relates to a table look-up correction method for average loss of a disaster event model, which comprises a parameter reading step, a table building step, a calculation step and a correction step; and a computer program product, the computer program/instructions implementing the solution of the invention when executed by a processor; there is also a computing system having at least one processor and a memory storing instructions that, when executed by the at least one processor, implement aspects of the present invention. The invention specifically provides a technical scheme for generating the transcendental probability distribution table according to the ELT of the catastrophe event model, and the average loss of the event is adjusted or corrected by the transcendental probability distribution table, so that the loss of the event can consider secondary uncertainty.

title_en: Transformer substation fire-fighting monitoring model based on multi-information fusion algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformer substation fire protection monitoring model based on a multi-information fusion algorithm, which comprises the following steps: selecting a plurality of sensor measurement signals to obtain a plurality of sensor detection values; describing the measurement trust degree distribution of each sensor according to the detection value of each sensor, and acquiring membership function between the detection value of each sensor and the probability of fire, the probability of no fire and the probability of uncertainty of fire under the framework of fire identification; the method adopts a D-S fire disaster fusion algorithm to perform fusion calculation on the monitoring values of the sensors, and makes an accurate prejudgment on the fire disaster occurrence probability.
assignees: HENAN SHOUZHEN ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-stage toughness improvement method for power distribution network considering intelligent soft switch optimization configuration
abstract_en: The application particularly relates to a multi-stage toughness improving method of a power distribution network considering intelligent soft switch optimization configuration, which comprises the following steps: taking typhoon weather as representative of extreme weather, generating a random disaster scene by considering uncertainty, and establishing a power distribution network fault model under typhoon disasters; analyzing a power distribution network fault processing and power supply recovery process during typhoon disasters; determining constraint conditions, considering cost, determining the installation position of the intelligent soft switch, and obtaining a recovery strategy; and converting the toughness improvement optimization model of the power distribution network into a mixed integer second order cone planning framework, taking the toughness index of the power distribution system during typhoon disasters as an objective function, formulating a recovery operation rule of the power distribution network, and determining the operation sequence of switching between adjacent states of the system to obtain a toughness improvement scheme of the power distribution network. According to the application, by using a two-stage mixed integer second-order cone model, economic cost and toughness indexes are used as objective functions, and the installation position of the intelligent soft switch is optimally determined, so that the toughness improvement scheme of the power distribution network is completed.

title_en: Sea surface search and rescue target strengthening method based on polarization information
abstract_en: The invention relates to a sea surface search and rescue target strengthening method based on polarization information, and aims to solve the technical problems that the existing sea surface search and rescue target based on the polarization information has limited detection imaging technical level and target strengthening level, and is difficult to flexibly meet the requirements of complex and variable sea conditions and weather in real time. The method comprises the steps of firstly, imaging a search area on a plurality of specific polarization angles simultaneously through a real-time snapshot type polarization imaging device, ensuring that the imaging effect is free from adverse effects caused by relative movement such as trailing and the like through a mechanical electronic image stabilizing device on the imaging device, then carrying out initial contrast evaluation and classification on collected images containing suspected targets, and carrying out image enhancement by utilizing target multimode visible light polarization information in combination with weather information at the time of search and rescue when the contrast is evaluated to be low.
assignees: XIAN INST OPTICS & PREC MECHANICS CAS

title_en: Expert knowledge-fused power transmission line environment risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power transmission line risk assessment, and particularly relates to a power transmission line environment risk assessment method integrating expert knowledge. In the data acquisition stage, the invention integrates the influence of multiple data sources and multiple factors on the environmental risk of the power transmission line, and provides a multi-metadata basis for risk assessment. Then, combining expert knowledge and fuzzy mathematics, constructing a multi-risk multi-dimensional disaster-causing factor knowledge base and a multi-dimensional disaster-causing factor membership function knowledge base, achieving the purpose of multi-disaster environment risk assessment of the power transmission line, and improving the universality of the method. Finally, a calculation method for carrying out multi-risk assessment based on a multi-risk multi-dimensional disaster causing factor knowledge base and a multi-dimensional disaster causing factor membership function knowledge base is provided, wherein the calculation method comprises BPA calculation, multi-source evidence fusion, risk probability generation and the like, so that the quantitative assessment of the power transmission line risk is realized, the uncertainty of input data and an assessment result can be flexibly processed, and the stability of the risk assessment is improved.

title_en: Virtual earthquake disaster scene optimization method based on earthquake rescue virtual drilling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual earthquake disaster scene optimization method based on an earthquake rescue virtual drilling system, which comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing a primary model; step 2, respectively establishing a macro disaster area model, a search area model and an operation field model according to the primary model by three layers of different detail degrees, wherein the different detail degree models correspond to different drilling tasks, and the earthquake rescue virtual drilling system comprises: an earthquake rescue drilling scene setting subsystem; an earthquake rescue drilling simulation subsystem; an earthquake rescue drilling efficiency evaluation subsystem; the step 1 comprises the following steps: establishing a seismic motion model and simulation according to the earthquake occurrence principle; building damage models and simulation are built according to the intensity and the building earthquake-resistant structure principle; according to the behavioral principle of the emergency, a disaster victim behavior model and simulation are established; establishing a secondary disaster model and simulation according to the earthquake secondary disaster theory; and establishing a department collaborative rescue model and simulation according to the actual earthquake rescue emergency plan.
assignees: XINXING JIHUA TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;XINXING CATHAY INT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Maritime search and rescue instrument based on infrared detector
abstract_en: The application discloses a maritime search and rescue instrument based on an infrared detector, which comprises a supporting frame and a detector main body; the detector main part bottom is provided with places the case, the department of holding frame bottom central point puts and is fixed with the back shaft, and the back shaft passes through the bearing and places case internal connection. Drive guide frame and movable plate horizontal reciprocating motion through the dwang, thereby drive gear revolve through the tooth piece, then drive through the back shaft and place case reciprocating motion, in the time of the search area of increase detector main part, through reciprocating search's mode, guarantee the validity of searching, the search effect of searching and rescuing the appearance has been improved, and labour saving and time saving more, thereby pivoted angle when can searching the detector main part is adjusted, adjust the search area of detector main part with this, be convenient for according to the actual search condition improvement search efficiency as far as, be convenient for adapt to different search heights, the suitability of searching and rescuing the appearance has been improved greatly, also can guarantee the stability when the carriage is placed simultaneously.

title_en: Mountain area shallow landslide risk assessment method
