abstract_en: The invention provides a mountainous area shallow landslide risk assessment method, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring mountain rainfall data, soil strength parameters and terrain data through rainfall station field monitoring and indoor tests; s2, calculating the soil saturation condition by using the rainfall infiltration hydrological geological model, calculating the slope safety coefficient by combining the slope stability physical mechanical model, finally calculating the slope instability probability by using the Monte Carlo simulation method, and drawing the corresponding landslide risk map in the mountain area. The method is based on a physical mechanics control equation, considers the rainfall infiltration and slope stability change process, simultaneously considers the uncertainty of soil body parameters, realizes shallow layer landslide risk assessment under the condition of rainfall in the mountainous area, and provides an important theoretical basis for disaster prevention and reduction and emergency rescue work of geological disasters of landslides in the mountainous area.

title_en: Power distribution network fault recovery method based on energy storage type flexible switch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault recovery method based on an energy storage type flexible switch, which comprises the following steps: s1, evaluating damage risks and determining the installation position of the energy storage type flexible switch according to landslide disaster historical data of the area where the power distribution area is located; s2, calculating and determining a control strategy of the energy storage type flexible switch according to the annual cycle life and the life cost of a storage battery of the energy storage type flexible switch, the storage and release of electric energy smooth power fluctuation and load demand uncertainty reduction; and S3, calculating and outputting a distributed power supply power output value and a capacity value which enables the service life of the energy storage type flexible switch to be longest with the aim of minimizing the operation cost. The mounting position of the energy storage type flexible switch is determined by evaluating the landslide damage risk of the mountain, the annual cycle life and the service life cost of the storage battery are calculated, the use mode is determined, and finally the output is controlled by combining a distributed power supply with the minimized commissioning cost, so that the power supply recovery efficiency and the power supply quality are improved.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY OF CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INSTITUTE;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Optimization method for maritime search and rescue disposal scheme of civil helicopter
abstract_en: The invention discloses a civil helicopter maritime search and rescue treatment scheme optimization method, which comprises the following steps: initializing a population of a disposal scheme according to the parameterization definition and value range of the task area; carrying out non-dominated sorting on the population, and endowing virtual fitness until all individuals are grouped; performing crossover, mutation and selection genetic mutation operations in the population, and outputting a Pareto front solution set when an optimization result is converged or the iteration number exceeds a set maximum genetic algebra; adding corresponding search and rescue modes and task properties in the task area of each front edge solution set to form a disposal scheme set for maritime search and rescue of the helicopter; simulation deduction is carried out according to the sequence, and simulation data of the treatment scheme evaluation indexes under the influence of uncertainty factors are output through large sample simulation; and comprehensively evaluating the simulation data of each treatment scheme, representing the comprehensive evaluation result in a normal distribution mode, and selecting the treatment scheme with the largest mean value and the smallest variance.

title_en: Wisdom fire control early warning system based on thing networking
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent fire-fighting early warning, and discloses an intelligent fire-fighting early warning system based on the Internet of things, which comprises a sensor, a wireless router and a fire recognition device, and discloses an intelligent fire-fighting early warning method based on the Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a fire distinguishing index system, and acquiring fire distinguishing index data by using a sensor device; preprocessing the collected fire distinguishing index data to obtain a fire distinguishing index vector; constructing a fire recognition early warning model based on the probability map model; and inputting the fire distinguishing index vector into a fire recognition early warning model, outputting the probability of fire occurrence by the fire recognition early warning model, and if the output probability is greater than a specified probability threshold value, indicating that the fire occurs. According to the method, the fire disaster distinguishing index data are collected based on the Internet of things equipment, and a fire disaster recognition early warning model is constructed to realize real-time fire disaster early warning.
assignees: SHANDONG OODEEP INTELLIGENT ENG CO LTD

title_en: Emergency rescue material dynamic allocation method based on distributed robust optimization technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency rescue material dynamic allocation method based on a distributed robust optimization technology, which comprises the following steps of S1: and introducing a vehicle scheduling decision variable, a material distribution decision variable and a time window decision variable. S2: analyzing the relation between the vehicle scheduling decision variables and constructing vehicle scheduling decision variable association constraints; s3: analyzing the relation between the material distribution decision variables, and constructing material distribution decision variable association constraints; s4: and analyzing the relation between the time window decision variables and constructing the time window decision variable association constraint. S5: and analyzing the relation between the material distribution and the vehicle scheduling optimization target, and constructing an objective function to obtain an original model. S6: the uncertainty of emergency rescue material demand is processed based on a distribution robust optimization technology, and a dual theory is utilized to derive an original model safety convex approximation processable form, so that a distribution robust model which is easy to calculate and solve is obtained. S7: and analyzing the complexity of the model and solving to obtain a dynamic rescue material allocation scheme.

title_en: Method for generating average shear wave velocity maps using proxy-based prediction models for earthquake disaster prediction, recording medium and device for performing the method
title_ko: 지진재해 예측을 위한 광범위 레이어 기반 예측 모델을 이용한 평균 전단파 속도 지도 작성 방법, 이를 수행하기 위한 기록 매체 및 장치
abstract_en: A method for generating an average shear wave velocity map using a wide range layer-based prediction model for earthquake disaster prediction comprises: a step of building a dataset including a shear wave velocity soil column map, topographic information, geological information, and distance information from mountain land; a step of analyzing a shear wave velocity in accordance with a soil layer, the type of soil, geological classification, and a rock formation from the built dataset; a step of generating a shear wave velocity estimation model in accordance with the geological classification and the topographic information based on the analyzed shear wave velocity; a step of correcting the generated shear wave velocity estimation model in accordance with the property of each geological age; and a step of using the corrected shear wave velocity estimation model to generate a shear wave velocity map based on the thickness of a sedimentary layer in accordance with the distance information from mountain land. Accordingly, the uncertainty from a land amplification effect can be lowered through accurate V_S30 estimation, and the reliability of Korean peninsula earthquake disaster analysis and seismic designs can be secured by using V_S30 for the Korean peninsula.
abstract_ko: 지진재해 예측을 위한 광범위 레이어 기반 예측 모델을 이용한 평균 전단파 속도 지도 작성 방법은, 전단파 속도 주상도, 지형 정보, 지질 정보 및 산지로부터의 거리 정보를 포함하는 데이터 셋을 구축하는 단계; 구축된 데이터 셋으로부터 토층, 흙의 종류, 지질 분류 및 암반층에 따른 전단파 속도를 분석하는 단계; 분석된 전단파 속도를 기반으로 지질 분류 및 지형 정보에 따른 전단파 속도 추정모델을 생성하는 단계; 생성된 전단파 속도 추정모델을 지질 시대별 특성에 따라 각각 전단파 속도 추정모델을 보정하는 단계; 및 보정된 전단파 속도 추정모델을 이용하여 산지로부터의 거리 정보에 따른 퇴적층의 두께를 기반으로 전단파 속도 지도를 생성하는 단계;를 포함한다. 이에 따라, 정확한 V S30 의 추정을 통해 부지증폭효과의 불확실성을 낮추고, 한반도용 V S30 을 사용하여 한반도 지진재해 분석 및 내진설계의 신뢰도를 확보할 수 있다.

title_en: Distributed multi-agent cooperative full-coverage path planning method
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed multi-agent cooperative full-coverage path planning method which can realize the full coverage of an unknown environment area containing obstacles and improve the cooperative coverage effect. The method provided by the invention considers various complex constraint conditions such as intelligent body obstacle avoidance and collision avoidance, limited energy supply, limited communication range and the like aiming at unknown environment conditions such as underwater detection, post-earthquake rescue and the like, adopts a distributed multi-intelligent body organization structure, utilizes a heuristic motion planning strategy, and carries out motion path planning by combining information obtained by two ways of self perception and mutual communication, can avoid the conflict of the same covering path points among intelligent bodies, realizes efficient cooperation, reduces traversal overlapping degree, improves path planning efficiency, has good real-time property, expansibility and robustness, and provides an effective solution for the multi-intelligent body to cooperatively complete a full covering task under the unknown environment.

title_en: Small hydropower station outage risk assessment method under typhoon disaster based on opportunity constraint model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small hydropower station outage risk assessment method under typhoon disasters based on an opportunity constraint model, which comprises the steps of carrying out Latin hypercube sampling according to a probability distribution function of predicted output of a small hydropower station, carrying out Monte Carlo simulation, substituting a sample value into an electric power system containing the small hydropower station to carry out probability flow calculation, analyzing the small hydropower station outage as an independent event, establishing an opportunity constraint optimal cut-load model when calculating the result of the small hydropower station outage risk and the uncertainty output of the rest small hydropower station of the system, converting the opportunity constraint optimal cut-load model into a deterministic equivalent model and solving the deterministic equivalent model by CPLEX, and multiplying the small hydropower station outage probability by the minimum cut-load cost of the electric power system containing the small hydropower station to obtain a small hydropower station outage risk value. The method effectively solves the contradiction that the safety and the economical efficiency of the power grid cannot be coordinated due to the shutdown of the small hydropower station, and can be used for evaluating the risk caused by the shutdown of the small hydropower station under typhoon disasters.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle full-coverage three-dimensional rescue path planning algorithm in complex disaster-stricken environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a full-coverage three-dimensional rescue path planning algorithm for an unmanned aerial vehicle in a complex disaster-stricken environment. The method comprises the following steps: (1) establishing an environment model; (2) dividing the model into different height layers through a layered planning strategy, and reconstructing a current height layer map through a map reconstruction strategy to obtain a two-dimensional reconstruction map; (3) and (3) performing two-dimensional full-coverage path planning on the two-dimensional reconstruction map: performing regional branch judgment on the position nodes, and screening according to the sequence from the dead zone, the local region to the global region; (4) adopting an interlayer connection strategy to associate child nodes and father nodes between different layers; (5) judging whether all height layers in the three-dimensional environment are traversed or not; (6) and tracing the path, finding out a complete three-dimensional path and outputting the path. The invention effectively reduces the number of the trapped dead points, rapidly plans a short path in real time, reduces the path repetition rate, has better robustness and is suitable for the three-dimensional full-coverage path planning in a complex disaster-stricken environment.

title_en: Firefly algorithm-based regional power grid evaluation model and optimization method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power supply or distribution technology, in particular to a regional power grid evaluation model and an optimization method based on a firefly algorithm, wherein uncertainty risk calculation is carried out based on a risk theory and an N-1 fault, and the importance degree of a line return result representation branch is quantized; evaluating the network characteristics of the nodes based on a Flouard algorithm, comprehensively representing the node importance degree by combining the branch importance degree, and giving consideration to both the electrical characteristics and the network characteristics by an element evaluation system; constructing a core backbone network frame search model by taking the sum of economic construction cost and network operation risk as an objective function and combining actual operation constraint; and solving by adopting an improved binary firefly algorithm to obtain a final core backbone network construction scheme. The method provides a new method and a new idea for constructing the core backbone network frame, optimizes the search result of the network frame, and improves the disaster tolerance and resistance capability of the system so as to establish a safer and more economic power system. The method has certain reference value for the optimization planning development of the power grid in the current region.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based automatic field personnel searching method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic field personnel searching method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle. The unmanned aerial vehicle receives a route flight instruction sent by the handheld terminal device and carries out route flight in a search area, the unmanned aerial vehicle acquires an infrared image of the search area through a camera in the route flight process, carries out image processing on the infrared image, identifies whether a result of a person exists in the image through thermal imaging threshold analysis and trapped person motion analysis, controls the unmanned aerial vehicle to carry out tracking snapshot on the person according to the image identification result, acquires position information and environment information of the person, and sends the position information and the environment information to the handheld terminal device and the cloud server. The invention can accurately identify the trapped person in the field under the condition of more field shielding objects, and accurately rescue the trapped person by fully automatically identifying the person and acquiring surrounding environment information, thereby not only reducing the cost, but also reducing the manpower resource.

title_en: Method for analyzing uncertainty contribution degree in disaster emergency Internet of things model
abstract_en: The invention provides an analysis method for uncertainty contribution in a disaster emergency Internet of things model. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out a communication connection request aiming at the disaster emergency Internet of things model; calculating the power of the communication request of the Internet of things equipment in the disaster emergency Internet of things model; calculating the integral uncertainty of the disaster emergency Internet of things model; calculating the contribution of the sampled uncertainty parameters; and substituting six representative groups of uncertain parameters into the disaster emergency Internet of things communication model according to the variation curve of the contribution degree, and verifying the disaster emergency Internet of things communication model according to the deployment condition of the ground Internet of things equipment. According to the method, on the premise that normal communication of equipment in the disaster emergency Internet of things model is guaranteed, the analysis of the contribution degree of uncertainty parameters in the disaster emergency Internet of things model is achieved, and the method has guiding significance for the analysis of uncertainty in the disaster emergency Internet of things model.

title_en: Mobile energy storage planning method considering reliability and elasticity of power distribution network in extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile energy storage planning method considering reliability and elasticity of a power distribution network in extreme weather, which comprises the following steps: establishing an element fault rate model, and modeling an uncertainty scene of a power distribution network fault disaster; extracting an extreme weather scene by a Monte Carlo method, reducing the extreme weather scene by adopting a K-means algorithm, and taking the uncertainty of load and distributed power output into consideration, extracting the load, the distributed power output and a power distribution network fault scene by adopting Latin hypercube sampling; selecting evaluation indexes from multiple angles, and calculating objective weights of the indexes to construct a power distribution network reliability and elasticity evaluation index system; taking two indexes of the loss before disaster and the recovery rate after disaster as optimization targets, and establishing a mobile energy storage optimization planning model considering the full disaster period; and adopting COBL-PSO algorithm to solve the mobile energy storage optimization planning model. The invention realizes the improvement of the reliability and elasticity of the power distribution network through the optimization planning scheme of the mobile energy storage.

title_en: Safety belt hanger on disconnecting link and using method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety belt hanger on a disconnecting link, relates to the technical field of safety protection, and comprises a supporting rod and a base. The support rod is provided with a plurality of hooks near the top end, and the hooks are used for hanging safety belts and accord with the principle of high hanging support. Install pressure sensor on the couple, pressure sensor detects the pressure sudden change when the operating personnel fall, makes alarm device action, reminds rescue personnel here to take place the accident of falling, has saved rescue time. The base is the shape of falling U, and the base includes roof, inboard baffle, outside baffle and guide rail. The guide rails are arranged, so that the inner side baffle can move in the installation process. The invention adopts double fixing modes of bolt fixing and baffle plate moving fixing, so that the invention is safe and reliable. The pressure sensor is arranged on the inner side baffle plate, so that the force for extruding the channel steel can be digitalized and visualized, and the uncertainty caused by artificially and subjectively judging the fastening degree is avoided.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY ZOUCHENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;JINING POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Multi-stage random planning energy scheduling method and system considering non-predictability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-stage random planning energy scheduling method and system considering non-predictability, aiming at minimizing the expected cost of daily operation, considering the uncertainty of distributed renewable energy power generation, establishing a multi-stage random planning model, determining a pre-scheduling decision in each stage according to the realization of previous uncertain information, not being influenced by future uncertain information, conforming to the actual operation rule of the system and meeting the non-predictability; in order to avoid dimension disaster of multi-stage stochastic programming problem solving, the optimal scheduling decision tree obtained by adopting the SDDP algorithm to solve the multi-stage stochastic optimization has wider decision space than a single decision scheme obtained by deterministic optimization, and the scheduling decision can be updated based on the realization and decision of uncertain information in the last stage, so that the operation cost of the system is reduced.
assignees: EAST INNER MONGOLIA ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV XIHUA

title_en: Preventive microgrid generation method considering uncertainty of transmission line fault probability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a preventive microgrid generation method considering uncertainty of transmission line fault probability. And further converting the established distributed robust optimization model into an equivalent robust optimization model, and then performing iterative solution on the equivalent robust optimization model by adopting a C & CG algorithm. According to the technical scheme, uncertainty of line fault probability in the power distribution network is considered, a preventive micro-grid generation model of uncertainty of the fault probability of the power transmission line is constructed, and by generating a preventive island micro-grid, power failure loss caused by cascading faults is effectively reduced, and the power supply level of the power distribution network under extreme conditions and the coping capability of the power distribution network under disaster events are improved.

title_en: Beidou-based power emergency rescue scheduling method, device and command system
abstract_en: The application discloses electric power emergency rescue dispatching method, device and command system based on Beidou, the scheme of the application determines an emergency search area based on accident position information, searches front-end equipment in the emergency search area, then acquires position information of the front-end equipment at different time points, determines that a relative movement state between the front-end equipment and an accident position is close to or far away from, and determines that the front-end equipment which can reach the accident site faster is used as target front-end equipment according to second position information and relative movement state of different front-end equipment so as to issue an emergency rescue command to the target front-end equipment, thereby solving the technical problems of long emergency rescue dispatching time and low emergency repair efficiency of an electric power system.
assignees: ZHANJIANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution system operation optimization method and system based on artificial bee colony and computer equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of operation scheduling and control in a distribution network, and discloses a method, a system and computer equipment for optimizing operation of a power distribution system under the regional power exchange constraint based on an artificial bee colony, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining uncertain photovoltaic output parameters in the power distribution network by adopting a Monte Carlo method, and constructing a photovoltaic output model; optimizing DG active power output in a dispatching area power grid by taking the minimum network loss of the operation of the power distribution network as a target, constructing an optimized dispatching model containing various DGs and setting constraint conditions; and adopting an artificial bee colony algorithm to solve the model, and calculating an optimal scheduling scheme for optimizing the distribution system of the regional power exchange and a disaster island division strategy. Compared with the prior art, the operation strategy obtained by the invention fully considers the uncertainty of photovoltaic output, can ensure that the safety constraint is met under various conditions, has a simple model, is easy to solve, and has certain theoretical value and engineering value.
assignees: HUAIAN POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus for compensating photovoltaic output prediction uncertainty and intermittency
title_ko: 태양광 발전의 출력 예측 불확실성 및 간헐성 보상 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: A method performed by a device for compensating the output prediction uncertainty and intermittence of photovoltaic power generation according to one embodiment comprises the steps of: additionally generating an independent variable for reflecting a time unit delay value of photovoltaic power generation amount and the characteristics of time series data based on the past power generation amount data of a photovoltaic power generation facility as a dependent variable and disaster prevention weather observation data as an initial independent variable; selecting the variables to be used as an input, based on the correlation between the dependent variable, the initial independent variable, and the additionally generated independent variable; predicting the photovoltaic power generation amount of the photovoltaic power generation facility as an output of a deep learning artificial neural network by inputting the selected variables to the pre-learned deep learning artificial neural network; applying the intermittence by multiplying an actual photovoltaic power generation data value of the photovoltaic power generation facility by a random value following a Gaussian distribution; comparing the predicted photovoltaic power generation amount with the photovoltaic power generation amount to which the intermittency is applied; and determining an operation mode of a BESS as one of stop, a charging operation, and a discharging operation according to a result of the comparison. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the problem of limiting the output of renewable energy due to an imbalance in supply and demand can be alleviated.
abstract_ko: 일 실시예에 따른 태양광 발전의 출력 예측 불확실성 및 간헐성 보상 장치가 수행하는 방법은, 종속변수로서 태양광 발전설비의 과거 발전량 데이터와 초기 독립변수로서 방재기상관측 자료에 기초하여, 태양광 발전량의 시간 단위 지연값 및 시계열 데이터의 특성을 반영하기 위한 독립변수를 추가 생성하는 단계와, 상기 종속변수, 상기 초기 독립변수 및 상기 추가 생성된 독립변수 간의 상관 관계에 기초하여, 입력으로 사용할 변수들을 선정하는 단계와, 상기 선정된 변수들을 기학습된 딥러닝 인공신경망에 입력하여, 상기 딥러닝 인공신경망의 출력으로서 상기 태양광 발전설비의 태양광 발전량을 예측하는 단계와, 상기 태양광 발전설비의 실제 태양광 발전량 데이터 값에 가우시안 분포를 따르는 랜덤 값을 곱하여 간헐성을 적용하는 단계와, 상기 예측된 태양광 발전량과 상기 간헐성을 적용한 태양광 발전량을 비교하는 단계와, 상기 비교의 결과에 따라, BESS의 동작 모드를 정지와 충전 동작 및 방전 동작 중 어느 하나로 결정하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Distribution network elastic lifting method and system based on distributed new energy aggregation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network elastic lifting method and system based on distributed new energy aggregation, which improve the effect of a distributed new energy unit on the elastic lifting of a power distribution system under the large background of energy transformation. The method comprises the steps of carrying out probability modeling on output and load data prediction errors of a new energy unit based on multi-element normal distribution, obtaining a typical output curve which is updated continuously along with time by utilizing rapid forward scene reduction, constructing an aggregation model of an energy storage system and a distributed new energy unit, inputting aggregation characteristics corresponding to the aggregation model, namely a voltage frequency range and an active and reactive power output range, to a power distribution network layer, setting optimization targets and various constraint conditions for maximizing key load recovery, and improving the recovery capacity of a power distribution system after disaster. The invention solves the problems of uncertainty and fluctuation of high-proportion new energy access in the power distribution network under the large background of energy transformation, improves the key load recovery capability of the power distribution system after disaster, and lays a foundation for solving the key outstanding problem of the elastic power distribution network technology advancing to practical industrial application.

title_en: Method for selecting non-landslide sample based on landslide susceptibility evaluation factor characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for selecting a non-landslide sample based on landslide susceptibility evaluation factor characteristics, which comprises the following steps of: collecting data of a research area, perfecting a landslide database and establishing a landslide susceptibility evaluation index system; each evaluation factor is subdivided into a plurality of subclasses, the frequency ratio of each subclass is calculated, and the subclasses with similar frequency ratios are combined to form the final evaluation factor classification; determining a characteristic factor according to the characteristics of the research area and the landslide space distribution characteristics; integrating the region of the category with the lower characteristic factor frequency ratio as a non-landslide sample sampling region; resampling for multiple times in a non-landslide sample sampling area to obtain a non-landslide sample; the method for selecting the non-landslide sample based on the landslide susceptibility evaluation factor characteristics limits the sampling area of the non-landslide sample, improves the quality of the non-landslide sample, reduces the uncertainty of the non-landslide sample, thereby obtaining a more reliable landslide susceptibility partition map and providing basic guarantee for a management department to carry out land planning and disaster prevention and reduction work.

title_en: Emergency broadcast early warning system and terminal based on big data dynamic linkage
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency broadcast early warning system and a terminal based on big data dynamic linkage, wherein the system comprises an emergency broadcast data acquisition module, an emergency broadcast information making and broadcasting module, an emergency broadcast scheduling control module, an emergency broadcast transmission module and terminal equipment; the terminal comprises a broadcasting control table, a Beidou emergency broadcasting terminal, an Ai automatic detection intelligent terminal, a computer and a control console. According to the invention, a set of comprehensive disaster assessment index system which considers influences of all aspects is formed from the aspects of disaster properties, social influences, economic influences and natural environment influences, references can be provided for disaster assessment index selection of different disaster types, the randomness and the ambiguity of subjective assessment are considered based on a weight determination method of a cloud model, the uncertainty conversion from assessment weight to comprehensive weight data is realized, all areas are automatically detected through a pre-installed camera and a sound column, and the linkage broadcasting of video monitoring and emergency broadcasting is realized.

title_en: Goaf collapse disaster risk zoning and grading assessment method
abstract_en: The invention provides a sectional grading evaluation method for collapse disaster risks in a goaf, which comprises the steps of determining instability probability of each ore pillar in the goaf, assuming instability of any ore pillar, and judging the instability of other ore pillars caused by the instability of the ore pillar by adopting a repeated iteration instability method until the instability is terminated; then determining the number of induced ore pillars in the rest ore pillar groups, and calculating the disaster consequence value of the ore pillars; obtaining disaster consequence values of all ore pillars according to the mode, and calculating instability risk weight values of all ore pillars; and finally, determining the risk levels of all ore pillars in the goaf to obtain a goaf collapse disaster risk zoning classification cloud picture. The method is based on the stability theory of the ore pillar group, considers the uncertainty of the strength of the ore pillar, quantifies the potential of collapse of the goaf, particularly the potential of single ore pillar instability induced goaf linkage collapse by introducing the induced ore pillar, realizes the risk zoning grading evaluation of the goaf linkage collapse disaster, and can be used for guiding related personnel to perform differentiated treatment on different risk grade areas.

title_en: Uncertainty quantification method for multi-dimensional parameters in electrical impedance imaging technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for solving the problem of uncertainty quantification of multi-dimensional parameters in an electrical impedance imaging technology. The method comprises the steps of firstly training a deep neural network to construct a substitution model of an original uncertain system, then analyzing and quantifying uncertain parameters based on the deep neural network substitution model and combining a univariate dimension reduction method, and finally obtaining distribution of uncertain output. And compared to the baseline method, the performance of the method of the invention was evaluated. The result shows that the method has high calculation precision and can accurately quantify the uncertainty of output; when the uncertainty dimensionality of the parameters is increased, the uncertainty quantification problem of the high-dimensional parameters can be effectively solved, the dimensionality disaster is relieved, the method is not limited by the interaction between variables, and the calculation cost is effectively reduced. In addition, the method can also be applied to the uncertainty system quantification in other complex fields.

title_en: Spacecraft debris search and rescue identification tracking method and system based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a neural network-based spacecraft debris search, rescue, identification and tracking method, which comprises the steps of determining a theoretical landing point of a falling spacecraft debris, planning a search area, controlling the aircraft to go to the search area, controlling the aircraft to move towards the actual landing point of the spacecraft debris, shooting images in real time in the moving process, carrying out real-time identification and detection on the acquired images by utilizing a multi-scale image neural network model, determining whether the spacecraft debris exists in the images, adjusting the running direction of the aircraft in real time according to the position of a detection target in the images, controlling the aircraft to move above the detection target, determining whether the confidence of a current detection result is larger than a preset threshold, determining whether the detection target is the spacecraft debris, leveling the camera of the aircraft if the detection target is not the spacecraft debris, and continuing controlling the movement of the aircraft. The invention can realize the quick search of the spacecraft remains, effectively reduce the search range and improve the search efficiency.

title_en: Optimal conservation power distribution network recovery method based on information decision and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimal conservative power distribution network recovery method based on information decision and a storage medium, wherein an uncertain parameter is defined and a robustness function is required to be used for determining a risk avoidance area of power distribution line interruption and the total damage length of the risk avoidance area, an optimal topology reconstruction method is realized through a linear optimization model, and a method for adjusting the input of the model through a new conservative selection algorithm is realized. The method comprises the steps of establishing a resilience model based on an information gap decision theory, establishing an execution method of the resilience model, establishing a new conservative degree selection method, optimizing the resource allocation of the distributed power supply, performing topology reconstruction and the like. The method for recovering the power distribution network under the extreme uncertainty of the natural disaster is realized, the reliability and the recovery force of the power distribution network can be obviously improved, the optimal optimization effect can be obtained under the limited budget, and meanwhile, the tolerance to the length of the power failure line is improved under the same load level.

title_en: Natural disaster chain-power system-carbon emission estimation method based on Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a natural disaster chain-power system-carbon emission estimation method based on a Bayesian network, which is characterized in that an emergency model is used for carrying out basic modeling on a natural disaster chain-power system-carbon emission change process, on the basis, the basic model is analyzed by utilizing the advantages of the Bayesian network in uncertainty event analysis, key elements and incidence relations among the key elements are extracted from the basic model to form a node table and an adjacent matrix, the Bayesian network is constructed on the basis of the node table and the adjacent matrix to carry out reasoning calculation, and the carbon emission change analysis of a power system under the action of multiple natural disasters is realized. The method provides support for subsequent disaster-resistant optimization, energy structure optimization, emission reduction and carbon fixation measures and the like of the power system, and can be transferred and applied to other complicated carbon emission process analysis.
assignees: UNIV HANGZHOU DIANZI;NARI GROUP CORP;NARI TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Ship searching method, device, equipment and storage medium applied to river channel
abstract_en: The invention provides a ship searching method, a device, equipment and a storage medium applied to a river channel, wherein the method comprises the steps of cutting a searching area of the current river channel according to the length of a short side and the length of a 1:1 length-width ratio after confirming that the length-width ratio of the searching area on the current river channel is larger than a preset value to obtain a plurality of subareas; establishing respective quadtree models on a plurality of subareas in parallel, establishing respective neighbor tables for the established quadtree models in parallel, establishing the relation among the neighbor tables according to the spatial position relation among different quadtree models, determining leaf nodes in quadtrees to which specified places belong in a search area of a river channel, determining an effective search range, and finding K ships closest to the specified places through distance sorting. The invention can optimize the search and rescue path of the ship, and can reduce the time complexity and improve the inquiry efficiency on the premise of effectively reducing the cost of searching and rescuing the ship, thereby improving the success rate of searching and rescuing.

title_en: Helicopter deployment method for multiple types of areas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a helicopter deployment method in a multi-type area, which comprises the following steps: the first step is as follows: regulating the search area into a search graph with a regular shape; a second step; calculating the maximum hovering times of each fluctuation of a single helicopter; the third step: taking the search range of a single helicopter as a reference circle, filling a plurality of reference circle arrays into a search graph formed in the first step, and calculating the number of frames of the helicopter which need to be deployed and the number of waves of the helicopter which need to be launched for a single wave according to the array types of the plurality of reference circles; and fourthly, planning and generating a search path of the single-wave helicopter according to the number of the helicopters which need to be deployed in the single-wave mode. The invention aims to provide a deployment method for orderly and efficiently deploying a plurality of helicopters for search and rescue in a multi-type area.
assignees: THE 28TH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: Automatic rescue unit recommendation method for intelligent emergency disposal process of elevator
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic rescue unit recommendation method facing an elevator intelligent emergency disposal process, which comprises the steps of taking the position of a failed elevator as the center and a set distance R as the radius to form a search area and acquiring information of all elevator maintenance units in the search area; 2. constructing a rescue capacity evaluation system model of an elevator maintenance unit; 3. and (4) comprehensively evaluating all the elevator maintenance in the step one by utilizing a rescue ability evaluation system to obtain an optimal scheme, and using the optimal scheme as a recommendation unit to rescue the fault elevator. According to the invention, the rescue capacity of each maintenance unit is comprehensively considered through multiple indexes, the rescue dispatching task is recommended, the most reasonable rescue unit is allocated for the fault elevator, professional maintenance personnel are rapidly dispatched to risk the trapped people, the elevator fault rescue speed can be accelerated, the elevator rescue resource utilization efficiency is improved, secondary damage is reduced, and unnecessary casualties are avoided; the problem of dimension guarantor's rescue task allocation inequality, unreasonable is solved.
assignees: NANJING SPECIAL EQUIPMENT INSPECTION INST;NANJING NINGTE SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source precipitation data fusion method based on mathematical uncertainty analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multisource precipitation data fusion method based on mathematical uncertainty analysis, which comprises the following steps: s1, unifying space-time resolution of precipitation data; s2, correcting systematic deviation of precipitation data; s3, constructing an error matrix of the multi-source precipitation data; s4, multi-source precipitation self-adaptive fusion; s5, correcting the weather classification errors of the fusion precipitation data set; s6, precipitation fusion data post-processing. The method and the device furthest overcome the dependence of multi-source precipitation data on ground observation in the uncertainty analysis and fusion process, perfects the precipitation fusion technology of a sparse area of a ground observation station, improves the fusion stability of the multi-source precipitation data in a large space range, remarkably reduces the false alarm rate of precipitation events, avoids the problem of overfitting of satellite data noise, finally obtains more accurate and reliable large-range precipitation data products, and provides powerful support for further improving the regional water resource management and natural disaster early warning and monitoring capability.

title_en: Star-based and foundation lightning data fusion method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for fusing lightning data of a star base and a foundation, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of (1) selecting star base and foundation lightning data effective data; (2) Calculating a time threshold value of the fusion of the lightning data of the star base and the foundation; (3) Calculating a space threshold value of the fusion of the lightning data of the star base and the foundation; (4) And constructing a data fusion scheme to obtain a localized full-lightning data set. The invention realizes the cross fusion of the lightning data of the satellite base and the foundation, overcomes the shortages, solves the problems of data incompleteness and uncertainty caused by a single information source, and is beneficial to more comprehensively recognizing the lightning activity characteristics. The integrated full-lightning data can be applied to the fields of lightning monitoring and early warning, strong weather analysis, lightning disaster investigation and identification and lightning protection design, and provides scientific support for lightning protection and disaster reduction business service and research work.

title_en: Electric traffic coupling network vulnerability assessment method based on probability map
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric traffic coupling network vulnerability assessment method based on a probability map, which comprises the following steps: establishing a Bayesian network model of a power distribution network equipment outage event under a typhoon disaster, and predicting the power distribution network equipment outage probability based on a Bayesian network; establishing an alternating current optimal power flow model, analyzing the overload condition of a power distribution network line, and carrying out load shedding on a power system; evaluating the capability of the coupling network for resisting external interference by using a probability graph-based electric traffic coupling network vulnerability evaluation model; the method takes a probability graph as a support, establishes an electric traffic coupling network vulnerability assessment model, and realizes calculation of electric traffic coupling network elasticity measurement; based on historical meteorological data, the method can be used for predicting the cascade fault propagation mechanism of the electric power traffic coupling network under typhoon disasters, ensures the accuracy and rapidity of real-time estimation, and provides theoretical basis for emergency plans under typhoon weather.

title_en: Power distribution network post-disaster first-aid repair operation strategy optimization method considering renewable energy and load uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network post-disaster rush repair operation strategy optimization method considering renewable energy and load uncertainty. The distribution network emergency repair operation scheme obtained based on the method can consider the worst condition of renewable energy and load uncertainty, can ensure the effectiveness and safety of the recovery process after distribution network disaster, can accelerate the distribution network emergency repair recovery process, reduces load loss, and has certain theoretical value and engineering value.

title_en: Fire monitoring and early warning system for key region of urban underground space
abstract_en: The application discloses a fire monitoring early warning system for urban underground space key region includes: the intelligent monitoring system comprises a data acquisition module, a data transmission module, an intelligent host, a regulation and control module and an alarm module; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring monitoring data of a key region of an urban underground space in real time and sending the monitoring data to the intelligent host; the intelligent host is used for analyzing and early warning the monitoring data so as to control the regulation and control module; the regulation and control module is used for executing disaster treatment; and the data transmission module is connected with the intelligent host and used for sending alarm information to the mobile terminal or the upper computer. According to the invention, the complexity and uncertainty of the fire are quantitatively calculated according to signals such as on-site detection temperature, gas flow rate, smoke concentration and pressure, the current fire situation and the fire development trend are analyzed, a powerful theoretical basis is provided for rescue and fire extinguishing work, and the reliability and the scientificity of an early warning system are greatly enhanced.

title_en: Power distribution network fault recovery method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault recovery method, a system, equipment and a medium, comprising the following steps: and (3) establishing a two-stage robust optimization model for power distribution network fault recovery by considering uncertainty of wind power and photovoltaic output, and adopting a C & CG algorithm to iteratively solve a power distribution network reconstruction and load switching scheme. Firstly, in the first stage, according to the wind-light output predicted value, the operation variables such as the opening and closing state, the load recovery state and the like of a line are decided, and in the second stage, a wind-light output uncertainty set is constructed, the operation power of each distributed power supply is optimized, and the minimum economic loss cost and the load recovery plan under the worst scene are obtained. And (3) rapidly solving a two-stage model by using a C & CG algorithm, and alternately solving the main and sub problems until the model converges, so as to obtain an original problem optimal solution and determine a load recovery scheme. The method fully mobilizes the resources in the power distribution network, furthest recovers the power supply of the key load of the power distribution network, reduces the power failure economic loss caused by extreme weather disasters, and improves the toughness of the power distribution network.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Elasticity evaluation method for power distribution network containing distributed energy sources
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution system elasticity assessment method containing distributed energy, which comprises the steps of firstly adopting Gumbel probability distribution to generate disaster scenes; then randomly sampling the element fault state according to the vulnerability equation, and dividing the network state based on a graph searching algorithm; then establishing an island micro-grid optimization problem based on mixed integer programming, taking the minimum total cost of load shedding compensation and distributed energy running cost as an objective function, and taking reactive power and voltage control problems into consideration to carry out linearization treatment on alternating current power flow; and finally, considering time-varying characteristics of the distributed renewable energy output and the load demand, adopting non-sequential Monte Carlo simulation to simulate, recording the load state under each disaster simulation, and calculating to obtain the elasticity evaluation indexes of the node level and the system level. According to the invention, a set of complete elastic evaluation index system is established by considering various uncertainty factors, so that the defending and recovering capabilities of the distribution network system to extreme events are quantified.
assignees: HUANGGANG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Urban water supply pipe network anti-seismic toughness comprehensive calculation method considering water quality and water quantity indexes
abstract_en: A comprehensive calculation method for the earthquake-resistant toughness of an urban water supply pipe network taking water quality and water quantity indexes into consideration belongs to the field of water supply pipe network earthquake-resistant performance evaluation. The method comprises the following steps: probability P of pipeline shock hazard  f  Is calculated; pipeline lineConfirming the post-earthquake state; determining the area of a leakage hole of a leakage pipeline; establishing a pipe network hydraulic model of the earthquake damage scene; simulating a pipe network post-earthquake recovery process, and adopting a pipeline dynamic importance ranking method to collect the pipeline water source distance to determine the post-earthquake recovery sequence; establishing a hydraulic power and water quality model of a pipe network in the post-earthquake recovery process; calculating the anti-seismic toughness; and (5) calculating the mean value of the anti-seismic toughness. According to the method, the water quality index is incorporated into the evaluation index of the anti-service performance of the urban water supply network, and the anti-seismic toughness of the urban water supply network is comprehensively calculated; the method for integrating the pipeline water source distances by adopting the pipeline dynamic importance sorting method is adopted to determine the post-earthquake repair order, so that the determined pipeline repair order is more reasonable; the water supply toughness evaluation index disclosed by the invention can comprehensively reflect the post-earthquake anti-seismic toughness, the hydraulic power and water quality change characteristics and the relative difference of a pipe network, considers the uncertainty of pipeline damage under an earthquake scene and the uncertainty of leakage type of a leakage pipeline, and generates a sufficient number of random earthquake damage scenes through Monte Carlo simulation. Has guiding significance for post-earthquake disaster relief and repair work.

title_en: Marine rescue resource allocation scheme optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of rescue scheme optimization in the technical field of marine rescue, and discloses a method for optimizing a marine rescue resource allocation scheme, which comprises the following steps: obtaining the types and the quantity of search resources which can be provided according to the received search and rescue tasks and the maximum allowable search and rescue time; calculating a target search area and an actual rescue position based on the water falling point of the person falling into water and the sea condition when the person falls into water; calculating a total search range and a total search time of a single search resource of different search schemes based on the search resource and the target search area; calculating the total needed sea rescue time based on the searching total time and the actual rescue position; based on the total maritime rescue time, the maximum allowable search and rescue time and the total search range of a single search resource, and combining the state and sea conditions of people falling into water, the optimal search and rescue scheme is obtained through screening. The rescue plan can be rapidly and effectively planned, precious search and rescue time is saved, search resources are optimally allocated, and the probability of successfully searching the target is maximized.
assignees: BEIJING JINGHANG COMPUTING COMMUNICATION RES INST

title_en: Regional possible maximum rainfall determining method for mountain flood ditch drainage basin
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining the regional possible maximum rainfall for mountain and flood ditches, which comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting hydrological data and scene rainfall flood data of a research area; step 2, determining the spatial distribution of maximum rainfall in different duration of the scene rainfall; step 3, determining a storm similar area; step 4, determining the possible maximum rainfall in the storm similar area; and 5, determining the possible maximum rainfall time course distribution of the storm similar area. The method fully utilizes the existing data such as hydrological weather in various places, increases the short-duration rainfall sample capacity, ensures the consistency of analysis results of the upstream and downstream of the watershed, and avoids uncertainty caused by subjective selection of typical heavy storm; and fully consider the influence of the regional complex topography change of hilly area to regional rainfall continuous space distribution, the suitability is strong, and the degree of accuracy is high, can supply mountain torrent disaster defense department to select to support work such as mountain torrent disaster defense risk decision-making and planning under the extreme storm scene.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Power distribution network recovery method and device considering switch uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network recovery method and device considering switch uncertainty, which is based on a three-layer robust post-disaster recovery model proposed by a linearization Distflow model and a traveling business model, considers faults of elements and a remote switch in the post-disaster recovery process, considers a distributed generator rescheduling and network reconstruction technology, solves the problem of maintenance personnel scheduling under the condition of uncertain fault types, solves the problem of scheduling of the maintenance personnel under the condition of uncertain fault types, and provides a high-efficiency tool for recovering the power distribution network under the condition of incomplete fault information, wherein the established model only needs a power distribution network operator to predict the maximum occurrence of various types of faults according to historical data, reduces the requirement of required information, effectively reduces the calculation burden of the scene needing to be added, can find the global optimal solution in a short time, and provides the high-efficiency tool for recovering the power distribution network under the condition of incomplete fault information.

title_en: Two-stage robust optimization control method and device for toughness-oriented lifting active power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage robust optimization control method and device for a toughness-oriented lifting active power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: adopting robust optimization to process wind/light/load uncertainty, and constructing a two-stage robust optimization scheduling model; when the power supply of the upper power grid is interrupted due to the extreme disasters, the output quantity of the distributed power supply is adjusted to meet the load demand. The device comprises: a processor and a memory. And the toughness of the active power distribution network is improved. The invention realizes the improvement of the toughness of the system and reduces the reduction of the load of the system. The model provided by the invention integrates the toughness of other forms of energy and energy systems for demand response management, considers the uncertainty before and after disasters, can ensure uninterrupted power supply of key loads after system faults, improves the toughness of a power distribution network, and can obtain an operation scheme with minimum total operation cost of the system in a worst scene, namely an operation scene with maximum uncertainty. The invention enables a power distribution network decision maker to select the most reasonable control operation scheme by adjusting uncertainty.
assignees: STATE GRID JILINSHENG ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO;UNIV NORTHEAST DIANLI;JILIN ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Prediction method for soil corrosion rate of metal material and model thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for predicting the soil corrosion rate of a metal material and a model thereof, belongs to the technical field of metal life assessment and environmental rock-soil disaster prevention and reduction, is used for predicting the metal corrosion rate in a soil environment based on a mathematical model determined by a basic reaction process of an electrode system response, calculates a dissolution reaction current I  1 , a passivation reaction current I  2  and a corrosion product layer coverage rate theta to represent the metal corrosion strength, definitely comprises the key characteristics of the electrochemical reaction of the surface of the metal under the action of different soil environments, compensates the defects of the prior data analysis, and can more reliably predict the charge transfer mechanism between the metal surface and surrounding soil, thereby solving the uncertainty of the traditional analysis method in the aspect of interpreting impedance data.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle searching path planning method and system suitable for emergency rescue
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of aviation automatic control, and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle searching path planning method and system suitable for emergency rescue. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of (1) generating random training samples for a search area, resetting discrete nodes in a reducing chart, acquiring a plurality of pieces of track data through multi-track sampling, and inputting data characteristics into a network model; extracting problem features from the data features through an embedding layer based on the encoder, encoding the problem features by using a attention layer, acquiring the relation of nodes in the graph from the problem features, and outputting graph encoding information; acquiring transition probability distribution of the residual nodes by utilizing a multi-head attention layer, a residual layer and a single-head attention layer based on a decoder, and updating network model parameters by utilizing the probability distribution; selecting a next search path node; and obtaining optimal searching path nodes in the multiple tracks. The method is suitable for path planning of rescue search of unmanned aerial vehicle, and shortens planning time of searching paths.

title_en: Method for constructing forest fire early warning system, decision method and device thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing a forest fire early warning system, a decision method and a device thereof, wherein the method for constructing the forest fire early warning system comprises the steps of obtaining a weather condition set, a date set and relationship sets in different areas, generating an incomplete T-ball type fuzzy relationship set according to the weather condition set, the date set and the relationship sets, constructing a completion method aiming at the incomplete T-ball type fuzzy relationship set, generating a fire early warning standard set according to the T-ball type fuzzy relationship set, and constructing the forest fire early warning system according to the weather condition set, the date set, the relationship set, the incomplete T-ball type fuzzy relationship set and the fire early warning standard set. The scheme can solve the problems of imperfection and uncertainty of the relation between weather factors and the possibility of occurrence of the fire under the background of the actual forest fire early warning, improves the accuracy and problem processing efficiency of the forest fire early warning, and enables forest firefighters to intuitively know the instant relevant information of the forest fire so as to timely judge the situation.

title_en: Four-rotor fault disaster recovery degradation control method based on observer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a four-rotor fault disaster recovery degradation control method based on an observer, which relates to the technical field of four-rotor faults and comprises the following steps: in order to facilitate the design of a subsequent controller, a kinematic model and a dynamic model of the four-rotor unmanned helicopter are introduced, and a coordinate system of the four-rotor unmanned helicopter in the flight process is defined: inertial system { I } = { O  I  ,X  I  ,Y  I  ,Z  I  { B } = { O in body coordinate system }  B  ,X  B  ,Y  B  ,Z  B  }. Subsequently, in order to avoid the singular problem existing in Euler angle gesture expression, a degradation gesture control algorithm based on quaternion is provided, and a disturbance observer is provided to compensate the uncertainty of system modeling and external unknown disturbance; in the four-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle position loop, a robust integral geometric control algorithm is provided for compensating external disturbance introduced by the position loop, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can better resist the external disturbance on the premise that one blade is completely out of control, the safety and the stability of the system are improved, and finally,the effectiveness of the control algorithm provided by the invention is verified through numerical simulation.

title_en: Power distribution network extreme scene modeling method and system based on uncertainty analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network extreme scene modeling method and system based on uncertainty analysis, which relate to the field of power distribution network fault modeling and comprise the following steps: receiving grid frame data, load time sequence data and illumination intensity time sequence data of a power distribution network; obtaining a typical meteorological feature model of an extreme natural disaster by using grid data of a power distribution network; inputting the load time sequence data and the illumination intensity time sequence data into a model to obtain a line fault probability model and an intermittent distributed power generation resource model under the influence of extreme disasters; selecting a typical extreme natural disaster scene through scene reduction; calculating the line fault probability and the intermittent distributed power generation resource fault probability by using a line fault probability model and an intermittent distributed power generation resource model under the influence of extreme disasters; and inputting the line fault probability and the intermittent distributed power generation resource fault probability into a suggested probability distribution function to obtain a plurality of extreme fault scenes, and selecting the extreme fault scene corresponding to the system information entropy with the maximum probability as a typical extreme scene.

title_en: Probabilistic earthquake and tsunami disaster analysis method based on logic tree method
abstract_en: The application relates to a probabilistic earthquake and tsunami disaster analysis method based on a logic tree method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an area to be analyzed for the probabilistic earthquake and tsunami disaster analysis method; respectively determining an earthquake tsunami source and a high-precision terrain file according to the area to be analyzed; constructing a parameter logic tree according to the first parameter set and the second parameter set corresponding to the earthquake tsunami source; calculating according to the high-precision terrain file and using a tsunami numerical model to determine a tsunami maximum wave height file; and determining the wave height exceeding probability at each pixel point of the area to be analyzed according to a logic tree method formed by the parameter logic tree, and a plurality of maximum wave height files which are combined and calculated in a probabilistic manner. The probabilistic earthquake and tsunami disaster analysis method based on the logic tree method can reduce the uncertainty of analysis and obviously reduce occupied computing resources.

title_en: Reliability assessment method for vibration isolation performance of nonlinear vibration isolator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reliability evaluation method for vibration isolation performance of a nonlinear vibration isolator, and relates to the field of mechanical device vibration isolation technology and structural reliability evaluation. The evaluation method comprises the following steps: taking a nonlinear vibration isolator as a research object, taking the steady-state displacement response amplitude Y  ASDR  of the nonlinear vibration isolator as a quantitative evaluation index for evaluating vibration isolation performance under the condition of fully considering the uncertainty of the structure, the size and the excitation parameters of the nonlinear vibration isolator, solving and obtaining dynamic response according to an established nonlinear vibration isolator dynamic model, discussing the influence of the uncertainty of each parameter on the dynamic response amplitude, and evaluating the reliability of the vibration isolation performance by adopting a self-adaptive proxy model method. The invention is suitable for the nonlinear vibration isolator, can improve the reliability and the stability of the vibration isolator, and reduces the economic loss and irreversible disaster accidents caused by harmful vibration.

title_en: Cluster system formation collision prevention control method based on constraint following
abstract_en: The invention provides a cluster system formation collision prevention control method based on constraint following, which comprises the following steps: establishing a dynamic equation of a cluster system; based on a control strategy of constraint following, a constraint condition of formation collision avoidance is proposed; the constraint function is designed, so that compact formation and collision prevention can be completed at the same time, and the problem of dimension disaster caused by the increase of the number of individuals of the cluster system can be solved; obtaining a corresponding constraint matrix based on the constraint function; forming a collision avoidance control design for the cluster system, wherein the collision avoidance control design comprises a nominal system control design without uncertainty and initial state error and a control design of an uncertain system; an adaptive law is designed to estimate the combined impact of uncertainty on the system. By the method, the cluster system can realize compact formation and collision avoidance under the condition of uncertainty, and can solve the problem of dimension disasters.

title_en: Intelligent analysis method and system for preventing and controlling geological disasters in tunnel construction
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent analysis method and system for preventing and controlling geological disasters in tunnel construction, and belongs to a data processing system or method for supervision or prediction. Under complex geological conditions, tunnel construction geological disasters are subjected to the coupling action of various disaster sources, the catastrophe evolution mechanism is extremely complex, disaster prevention and control are closely related to geological environments and disaster characteristics where the disasters are located, and prevention and control measures are selected based on artificial experience or existing standard specifications, so that the tunnel construction geological disasters have larger uncertainty and blindness. The analysis method is provided, the existing expert knowledge and a large number of disaster prevention and control cases are fully researched and summarized, a disaster prevention and control knowledge system and a term dictionary are constructed, a correlation map between disaster characteristics and prevention and control countermeasures is established, potential correlation relations between the prevention and control countermeasures and tunnel construction geological disasters are mined through a visual map analysis technology, and timeliness and effectiveness of prevention and control decisions are improved.
assignees: CARS RAILWAY ENG RES INST;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Two-stage robust fault recovery method for power distribution network based on toughness improvement
abstract_en: A two-stage robust fault recovery method for a power distribution network based on toughness improvement belongs to the field of power distribution network fault recovery. The method comprises the steps of combining important load recovery time in the fault recovery process of the power distribution network and load shedding time possibly caused by output fluctuation of a distributed power supply, and constructing a power distribution network toughness assessment method; an ellipsoid uncertainty set is introduced to fully consider the characteristics of randomness, volatility and the like of the distributed power supply output; and taking the optimal toughness index as an objective function, completing the establishment of a two-stage robust optimization model, and adopting an improved C & CG algorithm based on a limit scene to complete the solution of the fault recovery model. Aiming at the influence of extreme disasters on the power distribution network, the characteristics of randomness and fluctuation of the output of the distributed power supply are fully considered from the viewpoint of load recovery after the power distribution network fails, the power supply to the key load is met to the greatest extent, and the toughness of the power distribution network under the influence of the extreme disasters can be ensured. The method can be widely applied to the fields of operation management and fault emergency treatment of the power distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV WUHAN

title_en: Multi-mode data fusion and uncertain estimation water level prediction method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water level prediction method and system for multi-mode data fusion and uncertain estimation, which utilize various spatial-temporal data related to reservoir water level prediction to generate a plurality of parallel CNN branches for feature fusion and dimension reduction, and the parallel CNN branches are processed as input vectors of Bi-LSTM models to predict water level, and a Monte Carlo technology is introduced to evaluate uncertainty and confidence of a prediction result. According to the invention, a multi-mode data fusion technology is adopted, different CNN branches are built for parallel operation aiming at different types of space-time data, a Bi-LSTM network is built for prediction through PCA dimension reduction, a Monte Carlo technology is introduced for prediction and uncertainty and confidence assessment of a model, so that the prediction error of the model is effectively reduced, and the prediction reliability is improved. The method has higher practicability, can be widely applied to the fields of water conservancy, weather and the like, and provides more rigorous and effective prediction and decision for application scenes such as water resource management, disaster early warning and the like.

title_en: Fire risk assessment method for ancient building group
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire risk assessment method for an ancient building group. Aiming at the problems of heavy fire hidden danger and complex fire cause of the ancient building group, the invention provides a framework for fire risk assessment of the ancient building group single ancient building. The process firstly needs to construct a risk evaluation index system aiming at the fire disaster of the ancient building group, and collects fire risk index data of the individual building of the ancient building group. And then respectively carrying out data processing and fusion according to different characteristics (space-attribute) of the indexes, and forming a corresponding fire risk index database based on the space uniqueness of the single ancient architecture. Considering fire risk uncertainty in an ancient building group, introducing an entropy weight method and combining TOPSIS to construct a fire risk comprehensive evaluation model of a single ancient building, and finally forming a fire risk map. The invention can objectively realize fire risk assessment of single ancient architecture in the ancient architecture group, quantify fire risk uncertainty and provide auxiliary information for fire protection work of the ancient architecture group.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Rock burst intensity level prediction method based on game theory-variable weight
abstract_en: The invention provides a rock burst intensity level prediction method based on game theory-variable weight, which is suitable for the engineering fields of mines, tunnels and the like. The invention establishes a rock burst prediction decision system, and builds a practical rock burst prediction index system by taking the frequency as a standard; based on game theory thought, a fuzzy analytic hierarchy process and an anti-entropy weight process are adopted, and the rock burst prediction cloud model based on game theory-variable weight is established by utilizing the difference information of objective characteristics of rock burst prediction objects and is used for predicting rock burst intensity levels. The rock burst intensity level prediction method provided by the invention better reflects the relative influence between subjective judgment of an expert and characteristic difference of rock burst prediction objects, can better solve the problems of fuzzy uncertainty and random uncertainty in the rock burst prediction process, improves the rock burst prediction accuracy, and provides an important decision method for preventing rock burst disasters.

title_en: Enhanced recovery method and terminal of power distribution system based on disaster uncertainty
