abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster uncertainty-based enhanced recovery method and terminal of a power distribution system, wherein first, the damage intensity of elements of the power distribution system is modeled based on disasters; secondly, aiming at uncertainty of disaster evolution rules and element fault probability, a fuzzy set generation method based on combination of moment measurement and minimum transmission cost measurement is adopted to construct a fuzzy set of the element fault probability, and then a collaborative distribution robust optimization model of pre-disaster strengthening and post-disaster recovery of the power distribution system is provided; and then, carrying out distributed solving on the distributed robust optimization model by using a column constraint generation algorithm, and improving the calculation efficiency of the model. In this way, the problem of coordination of reinforcement and recovery of the existing power distribution system in disaster facing can be solved, and efficient reinforcement and quick recovery of the power system are ensured.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: New energy output uncertainty-based power transmission system partition recovery method and terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a partition recovery method and a terminal of a power transmission system based on uncertainty of new energy output, which are used for establishing a black start power supply operation model according to starting, climbing and scheduling of a thermal power unit in the power transmission system and fully linearizing the model; then, providing a power transmission network partition rule based on power transmission network black start power distribution information and post-disaster damage information; and establishing a random optimization model based on the partitioned recovery of the power transmission network of the plurality of new energy units according to the black start power supply linearization model and the partitioned rule of the power transmission network. And the problem that the model solving efficiency is reduced under the condition that the output scene of the new energy unit is increased is considered, so that model decomposition and distributed solving are carried out, and the calculating efficiency of the model is further improved. In this way, a method for quickly recovering the power system after large-scale grid connection of new energy is provided.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Geomagnetic storm disaster prevention blocking device optimal configuration method based on sensitivity scene
abstract_en: The application relates to an optimized configuration method of a geomagnetic storm disaster prevention blocking device based on a sensitivity scene. The IGF sensitivity model established in the application can effectively reflect the influence of the running characteristics of the magnetoresi-system besides reflecting the uncertainty of IGF. According to the IGF sensitivity scene probability model, the blocking device is optimally configured, so that the number of installation devices can be reduced, and the problem of poor treatment effect caused by IGF amplitude or direction change can be better solved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;BEIJING TIANHE BENAN ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for evaluating earthquake damage of sedimentary basin building group
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for evaluating earthquake damages of a settlement basin building group, which belong to the technical field of engineering disaster prevention and are characterized in that the method for evaluating the earthquake damages of the settlement basin building group comprises the following steps: s1, determining a target site and characteristic input parameters; s2, establishing a three-dimensional sedimentary basin model, and acquiring an earthquake response; s3, establishing an improved data set: s4, optimizing an artificial neural network; s5, acquiring a sample: s6, determining earthquake motion parameters; s7, prediction and evaluation. According to the method, the calculation efficiency of constructing a data set and evaluating the influence of the uncertainty of the site medium parameters on the basin vibration is sequentially improved through the rapid multipole algorithm and the proxy model, the peak acceleration statistical moment and the probability information of any position of the basin surface can be given out, and the method is applied to rapid prediction and evaluation of the earthquake damage of the building group and serves for toughness cities.

title_en: Channel emergency rescue management mode based on robust optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a channel emergency rescue management mode based on a robust optimization algorithm, which comprises the following steps: the uncertainty factors such as whether the actual search and rescue ship travel route is downwind and downwater, whether the actual search and rescue ship travel route is provided with obstacles, whether the actual search and rescue ship travel route is provided with sudden accidents and the like are considered; consider a situation in which different types of accidents may occur at the same time at multiple locations; the rescue materials of the invention are divided into communication, lifesaving, medical, pollution cleaning, protection and fire protection. According to the invention, different accidents are reasonably allocated according to limited rescue resources, and the search and rescue ship can be ensured to load enough materials to arrive at the accident site in the shortest time.

title_en: Small-area single-machine grid-shaped search route planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a small-area single-machine grid-shaped search route planning method. Aiming at a known search area at a certain moment, a single-machine grid-shaped search model is built in a plane based on a kinematic equation and a plane geometry principle, and a complete search route is obtained by planning and obtaining key flight route points of a search helicopter under the condition of comprehensively considering visibility and flight characteristics of the helicopter by using a plane geometry method. The method overcomes the defects of low manual estimation speed and low precision, converts the search application problem into a simple and visual geometric problem, has the characteristics of easy realization of computer programming, high precision, good real-time performance and the like, and can meet the requirements of a ground target search task on precision and effectiveness. The method is particularly suitable for ground target reconnaissance or search and rescue application of the helicopter command system.
assignees: NO 54 INST CN ELECT SCI & TECH

title_en: Power distribution network optimization method and system under typhoon disaster based on two-stage planning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network optimization method and system under typhoon disasters based on two-stage planning, comprising the following steps: modeling wind speed uncertainty, line uncertainty and load uncertainty by using the acquired power distribution network information, meteorological information and geographic information to obtain a distribution function about typhoon wind speed and power distribution line damage probability of the power distribution network, and generating load scenes by Monte Carlo simulation to obtain reactive load and active load in each scene; on the basis of a distribution function, a distribution line damage probability, reactive loads and active power in each scene, constructing a two-stage random planning elastic lifting model for the distribution network; and solving the model under the first-stage constraint condition and the second-stage constraint condition to obtain an optimization decision result, and optimizing the power distribution network through the optimization decision result. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the accuracy of the decision aiming at the power distribution network is improved, and the elastic coping capacity of the power distribution network is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: AC/DC power distribution network post-disaster recovery method considering load uncertainty
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for recovering an AC/DC power distribution network after disaster by considering load uncertainty, which comprises the following steps: modeling various scheduling resources in the rush repair and recovery process; modeling the uncertainty of the load by a scene probability method; constructing a rush repair recovery model under the two-stage AC/DC power distribution system by taking the maximum total load recovery amount and the minimum total air rejection amount as targets; and solving the rush repair recovery model under the two-stage AC/DC power distribution system to obtain the optimal recovery strategy under the AC/DC power distribution system. The recovery strategy obtained by the method fully considers the load uncertainty and the special grid structure and electrical characteristics of the AC/DC hybrid power distribution network, reduces the air discarding quantity while maximizing the recovery quantity, has a simple model, is easy to solve, and has certain theoretical value and engineering value.

title_en: Fine prediction method for disaster-stricken and evacuation population of rural area under typhoon and storm disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of typhoon and storm disaster emergency decision, and particularly discloses a refined prediction method for disaster receiving and evacuation population in a rural area under typhoon and storm disaster, which comprises the following steps: according to basic information and wind speed and rainfall forecast information of residential buildings in a region to be researched, obtaining real-time disaster conditions of the research region, calculating the probability that all residential buildings are in different functional states at different moments by using a building function evaluation frame, and obtaining disaster-affected buildings at village level and town level and expected values of people to be evacuated. And carrying out cyclic calculation by using the method along with continuous updating of rainfall forecast products. The disaster situation deduction and building function evaluation are carried out based on a physical mechanism, the number and distribution of disaster-stricken population are directly deduced from the human demand perspective, the uncertainty of weather forecast and building disaster-bearing capacity is considered, and a decision maker can select two modes of risk neutrality and risk aversion.

title_en: Dynamic risk level assessment method for village scale typhoon and storm related secondary disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic risk level evaluation method of a village scale typhoon and storm related secondary disaster, which comprises the steps of constructing a geographic information database of a region to be researched, and obtaining real-time disaster information of all types of buildings according to real-time wind speed and inundation conditions in a certain time range in the future. Taking the number of disaster-stricken residential buildings, the number of people to be evacuated and the expected value of total economic loss at village level as the dividing index of risk level, when considering the flood secondary disasters and geological secondary disasters caused by typhoons and storm, respectively analyzing by utilizing residential building function evaluation frames which are not coupled and coupled with the geological disasters to obtain the numerical value of each dividing index and dividing the numerical value into corresponding levels. And (5) carrying out cyclic calculation along with updating of weather forecast information. The disaster situation deduction is carried out based on a physical mechanism, building function assessment is taken as a core, and uncertainty of weather forecast and building disaster bearing capacity is considered to carry out real-time dynamic risk level assessment on different kinds of secondary disasters.

title_en: Method, device and equipment for determining marine rescue search area
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device and equipment for determining an offshore rescue search area, wherein the method comprises the following steps: carrying out drift prediction on the offshore targets to be searched and rescuing based on the drift prediction model to obtain predicted scattered point data meeting the time sequence; under the condition that the search period is determined, determining a target strategy based on the search requirement and the predicted scattered point data, wherein the target strategy is used for determining target scattered points corresponding to the target to be searched and rescuing under the search period in the predicted scattered point data; calculating a target convex hull based on a target algorithm for the target scattered points, and forming a first search area based on polygons formed by the target convex hulls; and calculating a minimum coverage rectangle for the first search area, and forming a second search area based on a calculation result, wherein the search and rescue efficiency of the second search area is higher than that of the first search area. The method for determining the search area of the marine rescue can quickly and effectively determine the search area when the marine rescue task is executed.
assignees: PEOPLE'S LIBERATION ARMY NATIONAL UNIVERSITY OF DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Network fault recovery method for coordinating network reconstruction and mobile energy storage system vehicle team
abstract_en: The invention provides a network fault recovery method for coordinating network reconstruction and a mobile energy storage system vehicle team, which comprises the steps of constructing a MESS vehicle team driving model; constructing a coordinated network recovery model according to the MESS motorcade driving model; and constructing a coordinated network recovery model considering the load and the DG output prediction uncertainty, and obtaining a robust variant of the coordinated network recovery model to recover the network power supply of the active power distribution network. The invention coordinates MESS, SESS, network recovery, DG scheduling and demand response resources in the power outage area to recover power supply, considers the uncertainty of load and DG output prediction in the robust variant of the coordinated network recovery model, and provides guidance and suggestion for recovering power supply after power distribution system disaster.
assignees: NANJING INST TECH;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Electric automobile grid-connected optimization operation method for emergency power supply of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric automobile grid-connected optimization operation method for power distribution network emergency power supply, which comprises the following steps: s101, acquiring typhoon extreme weather historical data information; s102, establishing a disaster uncertainty scene set of a traffic-electrical coupling network of typhoon disasters; s103, establishing a scene-based electric vehicle two-stage random optimization problem model, wherein the first stage is a pre-disaster defense plan, and the second stage is post-disaster emergency power supply; s104, solving a two-stage random optimization problem model of the electric automobile to obtain electric automobile scheduling schemes under different probability scenes and obtain optimized operation curves of all units in an optimization period and corresponding index calculation results.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST HAINAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for calculating surging probability of random sampling and storage device
abstract_en: The application provides a calculation method of surging and overtaking probability of random sampling, which comprises the following steps: according to a target area, a numerical model is built, a landslide parameter value range of the target area is analyzed, landslide input parameters required by building the numerical model are processed, and random variables are generated. And carrying out Latin hypercube sampling according to the random variable to generate a random sample, inputting the random sample into the numerical model, extracting the surge propagation height corresponding to the random variable, determining a surge propagation height threshold according to a disaster-stricken body of the target area, and calculating the overrun probability of the surge propagation height exceeding the surge propagation height threshold. The random samples are generated by Latin hypercube sampling of the selected random variables, and then are processed by a model, so that the overrun probability that the surge propagation distance exceeds the threshold height is calculated, the uncertainty of landslide input parameters is quantized, and the accuracy of landslide-surge disaster prediction is improved.

title_en: Worst component damage condition identification method in infrastructure
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying damage condition of worst assembly in infrastructure, belonging to the technical field of management and control of infrastructure, comprising the following steps: in the infrastructure network, if a circle corresponding to a given radius r meets a preset condition, taking the center of the circle as an attack center; further determining a potential attack component set corresponding to the attack center, determining a target attack component set based on component damage uncertainty, and finally identifying the worst local damage situation; the technical problem that regional component damage in an infrastructure network is difficult to accurately identify in the prior art is solved. In addition, the potential attack assembly set is introduced into the network area damage, compared with the method for carrying out area damage on the network division grids, the method considers the arbitrary nature of disaster occurrence positions to enable the scene to be more practical, meanwhile, the attack area for solving the worst attack situation can be identified, the urban manager can be helped to make an optimal protection decision, and the loss of infrastructure is reduced.

title_en: Toughness improvement method and terminal for power distribution network
abstract_en: According to the toughness improving method and terminal for the power distribution network, uncertainty of fault repair time of the power distribution network is considered in the fault repair process, the purpose of least weighted power shortage amount is achieved, a multi-stage fault recovery model of the power distribution network is established, maintenance personnel scheduling and mobile emergency power supply vehicle scheduling are used as optimization variables, and the maintenance personnel and the mobile emergency power supply vehicle are scheduled in a coordinated mode according to a model solving result. Compared with the prior art, the fault repair time is taken as a known condition to be considered, the coupling influence process between the scheduling of post-disaster maintenance personnel, the scheduling of the mobile emergency power supply vehicle and the fault repair time is ignored, the multi-stage process of uncertainty of the fault repair time and load recovery is comprehensively considered, and the rapid recovery of the post-disaster critical load is ensured, so that the resistance and recovery capacity of the power distribution terminal to extreme weather are comprehensively improved.
assignees: ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Three-dimensional geologic body sectioning method based on Markov chain and Monte Carlo simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional geologic body sectioning method based on Markov chain and Monte Carlo simulation, which comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring PRB data, drilling data and a digital elevation model; s2, calculating a geological interface hidden function equation according to PRB data; s3, extracting a DEM point set in the digital elevation model to obtain a tetrahedral geological model; s4, utilizing the hidden function property to carry out section division; s5, simulating the stratum state of the virtual geological drilling by using a Monte Carlo method; s6, defining corresponding geological properties of geological areas in the section according to section combination to form a section model; the method is based on Markov chain and Monte Carlo simulation, can generate a deterministic model which cannot capture the uncertainty of stratum attributes through implicit three-dimensional geological modeling, can better reflect the complex spatial cutting relationship and stacking relationship among geological structures and the specific form inside the structures, and has the characteristics of being more modified, being capable of accurately explaining the ground, carrying out disaster early warning analysis decision and the like on underground excavation engineering.
assignees: UNIV XIAN ARCHITECTUR & TECH;CHINA ROAD & BRIDGE CORP

title_en: Wing section gradient optimization design method integrating working condition and geometric uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention provides an airfoil gradient optimization design method integrating working conditions and geometric uncertainties, which combines the flight working conditions with the geometric uncertainties to carry out airfoil optimization design, considers the uncertainty influence of an aircraft in the processing and manufacturing processes and the actual flight processes, is beneficial to improving the capability of the airfoil for resisting the disturbance of the flight working conditions and the disturbance of the geometric uncertainties and improving the average performance and the performance robustness of the airfoil; aiming at the problem of dimension disaster caused by taking geometric uncertainty factors into consideration, the sampling dimension is reduced by a Karhunen-Loeve expansion method, and the sampling point number is greatly reduced on the premise of ensuring solving precision by carrying out sparsification treatment on a polynomial chaotic expansion method, so that the efficiency of airfoil robustness optimization design is greatly improved; in addition, the invention effectively improves the calculation precision and reduces the calculation cost by utilizing the gradient optimization design method, thereby enabling the airfoil design result to meet the requirements more under the condition of less calculation cost.

title_en: Early warning method for rapidly judging flood level of small reservoir storage based on forecast rainfall
abstract_en: The invention discloses an early warning method for rapidly judging the magnitude of flood in a small reservoir based on forecast rainfall, and particularly relates to the technical field of disaster early warning and hydrologic forecast, comprising the following steps of 101, acquiring a rainfall mean value contour map layer with the maximum 6 hours of the year, a rainfall variation coefficient contour map layer with the maximum 6 hours of the year, a small reservoir element map layer and a forecast rainfall contour map layer; 102, calculating the magnitude of the warehousing flood; and 103, judging according to the design flood standard of the small reservoir and the forecast and warehousing flood level, and issuing early warning information to the reservoir. According to the invention, the reservoir forecast rainfall is extracted through the position of the central point of the small reservoir, then the reservoir storage flood level is calculated through comparing the rainfall grid model of the largest 6 hours of the year under each frequency, and finally the flood level and the design standard are distinguished to send out early warning information, so that the uncertainty and accuracy of manual distinguishing are reduced, and technical support is provided for precise defense.
assignees: GUANGDONG RES INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER

title_en: Power network fault recovery dynamic decision method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power network fault recovery dynamic decision method based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting the structure and disaster damage information of a power network, evaluating the damage probability of a line, establishing a part of observable Markov decision process model for power network fault recovery under the uncertainty of damage evaluation, then constructing an actor-commentator framework for solving the power network fault dynamic recovery strategy, then training an intelligent body by using a near-end strategy optimization method in an offline training stage, and finally outputting an optimal power network fault inspection and recovery strategy based on the power network damage condition in an online decision stage. The method can effectively solve the dynamic decision of the power network recovery under the uncertainty of disaster damage evaluation, furthest improve the power network fault recovery efficiency and reduce the influence of disaster events.
assignees: STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;UESTC

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster risk early warning method and device, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a mountain torrent disaster risk early warning method, a mountain torrent disaster risk early warning device, electronic equipment and a mountain torrent disaster risk early warning medium, and relates to the technical field of mountain torrent disaster research, wherein the mountain torrent disaster risk early warning method comprises the following steps: simulating a flood process based on a hydrologic model to obtain flood occurrence occasions in a research period, and acquiring soil humidity data and rainfall data corresponding to each flood occurrence occasion; calculating the uncertainty of rainfall input corresponding to each flood occurrence according to the rainfall data corresponding to each flood occurrence; calculating uncertainty of a hydrologic model according to the uncertainty of rainfall input corresponding to each flood occurrence, and calculating uncertainty of early warning critical rainfall according to the uncertainty of rainfall input and the uncertainty of the hydrologic model; calculating the coupling uncertainty under each risk level according to the uncertainty of the early warning critical rainfall; and carrying out early warning on the mountain torrent disaster risk according to the coupling uncertainty under each risk level. The method greatly improves the accuracy of mountain torrent disaster early warning.

title_en: Rainfall monitoring data driven intelligent early warning method for small-river-basin geological disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of geological disaster prevention and control, in particular to a rainfall monitoring data-driven intelligent early warning method for small-river-basin geological disasters, which comprises the steps of acquiring historical rainfall data of a target small river basin and preprocessing geological disaster historical record data; the method comprises the steps of matching geological disaster events to corresponding rainfall events to obtain a rainfall event set with geological disasters, taking the rainfall event set as a positive sample and a rainfall event set without the occurrence of the geological disasters as a negative sample, using the positive sample and the negative sample for constructing a data set for learning, training and testing a machine learning model, constructing an intelligent early warning machine learning model array for the geological disasters in the small river basin, training, verifying and testing the intelligent early warning machine learning model array by using the data set, constructing a calculation model and an uncertainty analysis model for the occurrence probability of the geological disasters in the small river basin under the influence of the rainfall events, calculating the occurrence probability and uncertainty of the geological disasters in the small river basin under the influence of the rainfall events, and carrying out early warning. The method improves the reliability and accuracy of the geological disaster early warning result of the small river basin.

title_en: Multi-disaster risk assessment method for long-term wind-induced fatigue and earthquake of reticulated shell structure
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-disaster risk assessment of a reticulated shell structure, and particularly provides a method for assessing long-term wind-induced fatigue and earthquake multi-disaster risk of the reticulated shell structure. The method mainly comprises the steps of generating long-term wind load conforming to the local historical climate rule of the structure, evaluating fatigue damage and performance degradation degree of the latticed shell structure under the action of the long-term wind load, and calculating multi-disaster risk of the latticed shell structure under the action of long-term wind-induced fatigue and earthquake. The method solves the problem that the limitations of long-term wind induced fatigue and wind direction randomness are not considered in the existing multi-disaster analysis technology. In addition, uncertainty of structural materials, uncertainty of earthquake motion and fitting model errors are considered through a statistical method, and an exponential equation is utilized to establish a multi-disaster probability demand model, so that a multi-disaster risk assessment result of the reticulated shell structure is more accurate.

title_en: Toughness improving method for electrothermal communication system under endogenous uncertainty and nonlinear reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of toughness improvement of an electrothermal information physical system, and discloses a method for improving toughness of an electrothermal communication system under endophytic uncertainty and nonlinear reconstruction, which comprises the following steps of: an electric wired communication network model and a thermal wireless communication network model, and a natural disaster uncertainty set model established based on decision-dependent uncertainty; then taking the minimum total investment and running cost as an objective function, and performing dimension reduction and linearization treatment on the electric heating information physical system toughness collaborative lifting model by utilizing an improved Yen's algorithm, so as to establish an electric heating information physical system toughness lifting linearization model; and finally, reconstructing the uncertainty problem into a deterministic problem by a strong dual theory, and generating a robust cutting plane solving method by using the proposed relaxation columns and constraints. The invention realizes the toughness improvement of the electric heating information physical system more economically, reduces the threat of natural disasters to the system and ensures the operation safety of the system.

title_en: Storm trapped person emergency rescue and evacuation method based on double-objective robust optimization technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to a storm trapped person emergency rescue and evacuation method based on a double-target robust optimization technology, which comprises the following steps: s1: introducing decision variables S2 related to emergency center construction, starting, personnel evacuation and material distribution: analyzing the relation among the decision variables and constructing decision variable association constraint; s3: analyzing the relation among the personnel evacuation related decision variables, and constructing personnel evacuation related decision variable association constraint; s4: and analyzing the relation among the material distribution decision variables, and constructing the material distribution decision variable association constraint. S5: analyzing the relation among personnel evacuation, material distribution and emergency center construction or starting optimization targets, and constructing an objective function to obtain an original model; s6: and processing uncertainty of a response node and the like based on a double-target robust optimization technology, and converting the nonlinear robust optimization model by using a robust optimization linearization conversion method to obtain a double-target robust optimization model easy to calculate and solve. S7: and analyzing the complexity of the model and solving to obtain a rescue scheme.

title_en: LSTM-based power line post-disaster inspection scene image understanding method
abstract_en: An LSTM-based power line post-disaster inspection scene image understanding method comprises the following steps: extracting the image characteristics of the post-disaster inspection scene of the power line based on an attention mechanism; extracting time and place information in the picture; constructing an image description sentence data set; the post-disaster inspection scene of the power line describes Chinese word segmentation; and constructing an LSTM-based post-disaster inspection scene image translation model of the power line. Aiming at the problems of batch labeling of a large quantity of images in post-disaster inspection of a power line, and the characteristics of multi-scale inspection scene targets, diversified objects, large style difference, strong space-time correlation, uncertainty targets and the like, the invention provides a Chinese description generation model of the post-disaster inspection scene images of the power line based on the combination of a convolutional neural network and a long-short-term memory network, which is combined with a jieba word segmentation tool, so that the automatic translation of the monitoring images of the post-disaster inspection scene of the power line is realized, and the problems of auditing and annotating of the large quantity of images in the inspection of the power line are solved.

title_en: Method for estimating success rate of multi-machine participation on large-scale search and rescue at sea
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for estimating the success rate of multi-machine participation on a large scale search and rescue at sea, which comprises the following steps: the first step: acquiring various data; and a second step of: calculating the area A of the regular search and rescue area; and a third step of: calculating the searching capability Z of single movement of each rescue platform  i  And calculating the total searching capacity Z of single movement of each rescue platform  total  Comparison of A and Z  total  If Z  total  More than or equal to A goes to the fourth step, if Z  total  Step five, the step A is carried out; fourth step: setting the coverage factor C of the search area to be a fixed value, and then entering a sixth step; fifth step: calculating a corrected coverage factor C of the search area  co  Then, a sixth step is carried out; sixth step: referring to the probability-coverage factor corresponding curve of the detection personnel, and pre-estimatingTo the probability of successfully finding the rescue subject in the existing situation. The invention aims to provide a method capable of rapidly and accurately estimating the success rate of the existing multiple models to participate in the large-scale search and rescue at sea.
assignees: THE 28TH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: Power distribution network information physical system rush-repair method based on information gap decision theory
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power information physical systems and discloses a power distribution network information physical system rush-repair method based on an information gap decision theory. Firstly, establishing a model considering the coupling relation between a power distribution network and an information network by taking the total cost of the information physical system of the power distribution network as a target; then, on the basis of the coupling model of the power distribution network and the information network, a post-disaster coordination recovery model of a post-disaster power distribution network information physical system is established; then, adding an emergency resource model such as network reconstruction of the power distribution network, a mobile emergency power supply, an emergency communication vehicle and the like; and finally, on the basis of an emergency resource model, based on an information gap decision theory, the condition of uncertainty of wind power output is considered, and a multi-source coordination recovery strategy after disaster of the information physical system of the power distribution network is established. The invention can improve the elasticity of the information physical system of the power distribution network after faults and reduce the influence and loss of natural disasters to the power distribution network and users thereof.

title_en: Hydrological model parameter uncertainty analysis method based on Morris and Sobol methods
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mountain torrent disaster research, and discloses a hydrological model parameter uncertainty analysis method based on Morris and Sobol methods, which comprises the steps of: collecting measured rainfall runoff data and geographic data of a research river basin; based on the collected data. According to the invention, an HEC-HMS hydrological model is constructed according to measured rainfall runoff data, soil types, land utilization and other remote sensing image data, and a proper yield and confluence scheme is selected to perform runoff simulation of a small river basin; the Morris method and the Sobol method are combined to qualitatively and quantitatively analyze the sensitivity of the model parameters, so that the relation between the parameter fluctuation and the model output variable is obtained, and the sensitivity parameters are identified; and constructing a parameter optimization regression model based on a random forest algorithm, analyzing HEC-HMS model results output by different parameter combinations, taking a Nash coefficient as an objective function, outputting a parameter optimal combination, and then substituting the parameter optimal combination into the HEC-HMS model for calibration and verification.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle collision risk perception method based on conditional risk value
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle collision risk perception method based on a condition in-danger value, which utilizes risk information caused by uncertainty of obstacle positions when an unmanned aerial vehicle autonomously flies in a complex environment to search paths, and improves the safety of autonomous operation of the unmanned aerial vehicle. Firstly, establishing a random walk model describing uncertainty of a heart position of an obstacle substance, and solving joint distribution of random variables of non-independent positions based on a Copula function; then, establishing an unmanned aerial vehicle motion and dynamics model, and defining a safe flight airspace; secondly, quantifying collision risk of the unmanned aerial vehicle by adopting a risk measurement index based on the condition risk value, generating a risk map, and setting a risk threshold value to reduce conservation; and finally, designing a CVaR-A algorithm, and searching a collision-free optimal path. The method can remarkably improve the autonomous safety obstacle avoidance performance of the unmanned aerial vehicle in an unstructured environment, and can be used for unmanned aerial vehicle operation tasks in dangerous extreme scenes such as emergency rescue material delivery, harmful gas leakage monitoring and the like.

title_en: Output calculation method and terminal for multi-seaborne wind power plant group under influence of typhoons
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a terminal for calculating the output of a multi-sea wind power plant group under the influence of typhoons, which are used for predicting the typhoons track range by training acquired historical typhoons track data, simulating the uncertainty of typhoons tracks in the mode, acquiring surrounding wind speed scenes by adopting a vortex wind field model according to the typhoons track range which is obtained through prediction, establishing a wind speed-fan output physical model by combining the wind speed scenes, environmental parameters and fan parameters of the wind power plant, and then calculating output scenes corresponding to a plurality of wind power plants according to the wind speed-fan output physical model. In this way, under the condition that typhoon disasters occur in the working environment of the offshore multi-wind power plant, the uncertainty of typhoon tracks can be taken into consideration to change brought by wind power output prediction, so that the cooperative operation of various power supplies under the typhoon disasters is facilitated, and the utilization of wind resources and the operation safety of a power grid are considered.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning method and system based on dynamic data monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster early warning method and a geological disaster early warning system based on dynamic data monitoring, comprising the steps of obtaining multi-source geological disaster investigation data of a target area, screening hidden danger positions of geological disasters in the target area, obtaining existing deformation characteristics and geological conditions based on the hidden danger positions, and generating geological disaster hidden danger characteristics; acquiring influence factors of hidden danger positions, determining geological monitoring indexes and acquiring multidimensional monitoring data in real time; and constructing a geological disaster early warning model, dynamically judging the development trend of the geological disaster, carrying out danger analysis and danger avoidance decision making visual expression according to the development trend, and obtaining interactive information between a user and the danger analysis and danger avoidance decision making dynamic correction of the geological disaster early warning model. According to the dynamic expression of the personalized geological disaster characteristics of the hidden danger points, the uncertainty analysis of the geological disaster time is satisfied, the reliability and the accuracy of geological disaster early warning are improved, and a data basis is provided for disaster prevention and reduction work of the geological disaster.

title_en: Source network load collaborative elastic lifting method and system considering multi-fault uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention relates to a source network load collaborative elastic lifting method and a system considering multi-fault uncertainty, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring power transmission network information and constructing a multi-type fault probability distribution uncertainty set under typhoon disasters; based on a distribution robust optimization idea, constructing a source network load collaborative elastic lifting model considering the multi-type fault probability distribution uncertainty set; based on the Benders decomposition and column and constraint generation ideas, solving the source network load collaborative elastic lifting model by adopting an original-dual parallel decomposition algorithm to obtain a source network load collaborative planning strategy. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of reducing line investment and power failure loss of the most serious fault scene under typhoon disasters to different degrees, further coordinating the economical efficiency of the power system and the elastic lifting target and the like.

title_en: Emergency material distribution and allocation method considering demand prediction and risk assessment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency material distribution and allocation method considering demand prediction and risk assessment, which comprises the following steps: based on an artificial intelligent prediction method, a gray model and a regression method, an emergency material demand prediction model is established, and emergency material demand and demand urgency degree of each disaster area are predicted according to disaster information and historical data, so that scientific basis is provided for material distribution. According to the invention, a plurality of sub-models are built to form a complete emergency material distribution and allocation model, and solution calculation is carried out on the emergency material distribution and allocation optimization model based on the sub-models, so that a decision scheme of material distribution and allocation can be dynamically adjusted according to disaster information, material information and the like, thereby realizing efficient utilization and distribution of emergency materials, and solving the problems that the prior art cannot timely respond to the change of demand of disaster areas, cannot effectively cope with uncertainty and risk of a supply chain and cannot balance a plurality of distribution targets and constraint conditions.
assignees: MAT BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power scheduling method considering uncertainty of new energy output and successive fault risk
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of dispatching of power systems, and provides a power dispatching method considering uncertainty of new energy output and successive fault risks, which comprises the following steps: determining relevant parameters of each time interval of each distribution by using a moment estimation method; acquiring an uncertainty set of wind power and photovoltaic output to describe the uncertainty of new energy output; estimating the poisson strength under various disasters by using a moment estimation method; setting a future risk pre-control scheduling period and a risk probability threshold for different types of disasters, determining successive fault poisson probability distribution of the disasters in scheduling time from occurrence, and obtaining the maximum fault number reaching the threshold in the scheduling period; under the double uncertain set of new energy output and successive fault risk, a two-stage robust optimization model aiming at minimizing the running cost of the system under the condition of the most serious faults is constructed so as to determine the temporary unit start-stop and power distribution decision of the corresponding natural disasters.
assignees: NORTHWEST BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA;UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Method for improving precision of earthquake instability model based on post-processing
abstract_en: The embodiment of the method discloses a method for improving the precision of a seismic instability model based on post-processing, which comprises the following steps: the accuracy of the seismic instability model can be improved through the post-processing methods such as data cleaning and preprocessing, parameter optimization and correction, model integration and correction, prediction uncertainty evaluation, model verification and evaluation and the like. This helps to improve the efficiency of seismic risk management, enhance awareness and perception of seismic risk, and effectively reduce the risk of seismic disasters. The implementation of this embodiment has the following main advantages: (1) Providing a more accurate result, errors and uncertainties in the model may be corrected, thereby providing a more accurate result; (2) improving model predictive power: the seismic instability model is typically constructed based on known seismic events and geological data. But the actual situation may differ from the model assumption. By post-processing, deviations in the model can be corrected, improving its predictive power. (3) optimizing resource configuration: the accuracy of the seismic instability model affects the configuration of risk management resources. By post-processing, the source of uncertainty in the model can be identified and optimized according to its importance.

title_en: Regional building earthquake damage prediction method and system aiming at complex terrain geological conditions
abstract_en: The invention provides a regional building earthquake damage prediction method and a regional building earthquake damage prediction system aiming at complex terrain geological conditions, wherein the prediction method is used for acquiring data of a region to be detected and acquiring an earthquake resistance response result of the region to be detected based on the data; correcting the anti-seismic response result to obtain a correction result; the method solves the problem that the prediction result is inaccurate due to the fact that the traditional earthquake prediction system is limited under the geological condition of complex terrain and comprises geological heterogeneity, multiscale, uncertainty of geophysical parameters and the like. In addition, when the post-earthquake damage of the mountain structure is predicted, the soil and the structure influence the earthquake-resistant response of the structure mutually, so that the predicted result is more accurate, the predicted result needs to be corrected, the corrected result avoids the influence of the interaction of the soil and the structure, and the predicted result is more accurate. The method of the invention is helpful for early warning, scientifically planning city construction and improving disaster prevention measures, and provides more effective support for coping with earthquake disasters.

title_en: Dynamic land transfer bee-way recommendation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic forward bee-putting route recommendation method and a system, which belong to the technical field of route planning, wherein the method considers the type, the position, the florescence, the forward migration cost time, the price of bee products, the yield of bee products and the uncertainty of disastrous weather events of honey sources; in the solving part, an approximate dynamic planning method combining the offline and online learning processes is designed to cope with the dimension disaster problem, and three acceleration methods are provided to improve the solving efficiency. The invention provides a thought for the transfer land bee farmers to dynamically recommend efficient and reliable migration routes, and provides a key decision support for the transfer land bee farmers to cope with the transfer land bee production risks and to realize the increase of production and income.

title_en: Building economic dynamic loss assessment and disaster reduction decision system under flood disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building economic dynamic loss assessment and disaster reduction decision system under a flood disaster, which is based on a fine physical model and considers the uncertainty of resistance distribution of building components when coping with the flood disaster, and can obtain time-varying disaster economic loss in the whole flood process when being applied to a pre-disaster simulation scene, thereby providing a basis for the scheduling of related disaster relief materials; when the method is applied to a real-time monitoring scene, compared with the existing method, the method can accurately obtain the economic loss condition of each building in the monitoring area at the current moment.

title_en: Disaster broadcasting wireless relay system that compensates for synchronization signals and improves broadcasting quality of radio shaded areas
title_ko: 동기신호를 보상하고 전파음영지역의 방송품질을 개선한 재난방송 무선중계시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a disaster broadcasting wireless relay system that compensates for a synchronization signal in a wireless section where data loss may occur and improves broadcasting quality in a radio shadow area so as to improve the reliability of disaster broadcasting. The disaster broadcasting wireless relay system that compensates for a synchronization signal and improves broadcasting quality in a radio shadow area comprises: a disaster broadcasting receiving device having an FPGA module for noise reduction to reduce noise caused by the surrounding environment when receiving a disaster broadcasting RF signal, and converting a digital demodulated signal from which the noise has been removed into Internet packet data and outputting the same; a main relay device that receives the Internet packet data output from the disaster broadcasting receiving device through a wired network and outputs the same as a short-range wireless signal; a sub-relay device that receives the short-range wireless signal output from the main relay device, modulates the same into a synchronized disaster broadcasting RF signal, and outputs the same; and a user terminal having a disaster broadcasting reception communication module for receiving the disaster broadcasting RF signal output through the sub-relay device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 동기신호를 보상하여 불확실성을 갖는 무선구간의 신뢰성을 향상시키고 전파음영지역에 용이하게 재난방송을 전달할 수 있도록 하는 동기신호를 보상하고 전파음영지역의 방송품질을 개선한 재난방송 무선중계시스템에 관한 것으로, 전파음영지역의 건물내부에 설치되며 재난방송용 RF신호를 수신하는 경우에 주변환경으로 인한 노이즈를 저감시키기 위한 노이즈 저감용 FPGA모듈을 구비하여 노이즈가 제거된 디지털 복조신호를 인터넷 패킷 데이터로 변환하여 출력하는 재난방송 수신장치, 상기 건물내부를 구성하는 층별로 설치되고 상기 재난방송 수신장치에서 출력되는 인터넷 패킷데이터를 유선망으로 수신하여 근거리 무선신호로 출력하는 메인중계장치, 상기 메인중계장치가 설치된 층에 적어도 하나 이상 설치되며 상기 메인중계장치에서 출력되는 근거리무선신호를 수신하여 동기화된 재난방송용 RF신호로 변조하여 출력하는 서브중계장치, 및 상기 서브중계장치를 통해 출력되는 재난방송용 RF신호를 수신하기 위한 재난방송수신용 통신모듈을 구비하는 사용자 단말기;를 구비한다.

title_en: Power distribution network operation strategy determination method, device, medium and product considering intelligent soft switch and distributed resource cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, a medium and a product for determining a power distribution network operation strategy by considering intelligent soft switch and distributed resource cooperation, and relates to the technical field of power distribution network operation scheduling, wherein the method comprises the following steps: inputting the historical photovoltaic output data into a photovoltaic output prediction model to obtain predicted photovoltaic output data of the day before the disaster occurs; constructing a photovoltaic output uncertainty set based on the predicted photovoltaic output data; inputting the uncertain set of the photovoltaic output and the unit pre-configuration cost into a pre-disaster pre-configuration model to obtain initial power distribution network data; the unit load reduction cost, the initial power distribution network data and the power distribution network constraint quantity of each node in the power distribution network are input into a post-disaster operation strategy determination model, and operation strategy data of each date from the occurrence of the current disaster to the completion of the rush repair are obtained; and regulating and controlling the power distribution network based on the operation strategy data of each date. The invention improves the toughness and economy of the power distribution network and effectively enhances the power supply recovery capability of key loads.

title_en: Search and rescue method and system based on warning lamp
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of warning lamps, and discloses a search and rescue method and system based on the warning lamps, wherein the method and system are characterized in that a plurality of ultrasonic signals are sent out based on the warning lamps, an ultrasonic monitoring device monitors whether at least one ultrasonic signal is received in real time, if the ultrasonic signal is received, a search and rescue range is predicted according to the ultrasonic signal and sent to a dispatching platform, so that the dispatching platform determines a current search area according to the search and rescue range, when the warning lamps search the search area, search results can be transmitted to the dispatching platform in real time, the dispatching platform determines search and rescue positions based on the search results, and after the search and rescue positions are confirmed, the dispatching platform generates dispatching information according to the search and rescue positions, so that the search areas of the warning lamps are dispatched again, and the purpose of search and rescue is achieved. Therefore, the condition of searching and rescuing of the warning lamps can be known in time, and a plurality of warning lamps are scheduled in time when a person waiting for rescuing is found, so that the overall searching and rescuing difficulty is reduced, and the rescuing time is shortened.

title_en: Power distribution network two-stage toughness improvement strategy based on phase-shifting transformer
abstract_en: The invention provides a two-stage toughness improvement strategy of a power distribution network based on a phase-shifting transformer, and belongs to the technical field of power grid planning. In the pre-disaster stage, a two-stage robust planning model which considers a phase-shifting transformer and an energy storage pre-layout is provided in consideration of uncertainty of line faults, linear relaxation is carried out on power flow of a power system by utilizing a Big-M method, and then a pre-layout scheme of the phase-shifting transformer and the energy storage is solved by a nested column and constraint generation algorithm; in the post-disaster stage, a second-order cone planning model of the phase-shifting transformer and the energy storage collaborative optimization is established so as to realize the rapid power supply of the post-disaster load; finally, the validity of the proposed model is verified by testing through an IEEE33 node system. Simulation results show that the cooperative configuration of the phase-shifting transformer and the energy storage can effectively ensure the power supply of the load and improve the toughness of the system.

title_en: Power distribution network rush-repair method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network rush-repair electricity method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: firstly, considering the uncertainty of the output of wind-light power generation during typhoon disasters, and predicting the power generation of wind power and photovoltaic by using a phase space reconstruction and Stacking integrated model; secondly, using pumped storage as a black start power supply, and establishing a mixed integer linear programming model of emergency power generation vehicles, gas generators, hydrogen fuel cells, wind-solar storage and other distributed power supplies participating in power distribution network rush repair scheduling and fault recovery; and solving by using a CPLEX solver to obtain scheduling strategies of the rush-repair teams and the emergency power generation cars under different scenes, and analyzing the influence of the output of each device on the power distribution network. The invention can accurately predict the output of the wind-light power generation equipment when key information such as meteorological environment is lost, greatly improves the power distribution network re-electricity efficiency under typhoon disasters, and effectively reduces the loss caused by power failure.

title_en: Visual geographic cloud image data processing system for intelligent aerial view map customer service risk
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electric power risk, and particularly relates to a visual geographic cloud image data processing system for intelligent aerial view map customer service risk, which comprises the following components: the system comprises a geographic sampling module, a probability evaluation module, an asset statistics module and a risk output module. According to the scheme, a GIS technology is adopted to analyze a flood disaster graph, the failure risk probability of the electric power asset and the potential influence thereof are quantized, and a process for monetizing and visualizing the generated risk results is established; the method comprises the steps of creating a cloud-shaped sampling point which is uniformly distributed in an influence area of each power distribution cabinet, generating a position of a sampling shape by using a Monte Carlo simulation method, randomly shifting the position of the cloud-shaped sampling point, and simulating the uncertainty of the position by using a fuzzy boundary; by means of the vulnerability profile without safeguarding or improvement measures, the losses or the extent of impact suffered by the electrical installation are evaluated in order to operate more robustly in the face of threats.
assignees: NANNING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Expressway tunnel fire evacuation research method and system considering uncertainty
abstract_en: The application discloses a highway tunnel fire evacuation research method and system considering uncertainty, and relates to the technical field of tunnel emergency safety, wherein the method comprises the steps of analyzing the evacuation characteristics and the evacuation uncertainty of tunnel fires based on highway tunnel fire evacuation cases; constructing an evacuation behavior uncertainty quantitative model, and inputting the model by using a fuzzy tool box based on MATLAB; setting up a simulation model, setting up a scene through tunnel space meshing, constructing an evacuation rule based on a floor field model, and introducing an evacuation behavior uncertainty quantitative model into evacuation behavior selection; and carrying out simulation experiments of typical scenes and single-factor control fixed scenes in different cross-hole intervals, carrying out sensitivity analysis on the results of the single-factor control experiments, and determining influence factors of evacuation uncertainty. The application is helpful to reveal the uncertainty influencing factors and the influencing mechanism of crowd evacuation under the fire disaster of the highway tunnel, so that the evacuation simulation result is closer to the actual evacuation behavior.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and early warning system and method for slope disasters based on multi-source information fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multisource information fusion intelligent monitoring and early warning system and method for side slope disasters, wherein the system comprises the following steps: perception layer: the method is used for acquiring slope related information; data layer: the slope monitoring data information base plate is used for constructing the slope monitoring data information base plate through the slope related information; service layer: the slope disaster monitoring function application platform is used for building a slope disaster monitoring function application platform based on the slope monitoring data information base plate; view layer: the method is used for performing visual operation and sending early warning information, and provides support for research, judgment and analysis of the plans and management and release of the plans in a digital scene. The invention overcomes the defects of uncertainty and ambiguity of monitoring data and imperfect slope monitoring system existing in single monitoring means, conforms to the development trend of digitization, automation and integration of slope monitoring, and has important significance for improving the monitoring and early warning capability and the defending capability of slope disasters and guaranteeing the life and property safety of people.

title_en: Coal mine disaster intelligent linkage method based on space-time event chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent linkage method for coal mine disasters based on a space-time event chain, which belongs to the technical field of mining and information and comprises the following steps: step 1, arranging sensors at key positions in a coal mine stope so as to sense environmental parameters in the stope in real time; step 2, storing data by adopting a self-defined data storage mode, fusing and integrating the spatio-temporal data acquired from different sensors, and establishing a complete spatio-temporal event chain; step 3, modeling and deducing the data in the event chain by applying a probability map model; step 4, automatically identifying abnormal conditions of the coal mine stope by utilizing a Boltzmann machine model; and 5, estimating and updating the state of the coal mine stope in real time by using a particle filtering algorithm, automatically triggering an early warning signal according to a preset early warning rule or a threshold value, and automatically generating a rescue scheme and a disaster avoidance route. According to the invention, by constructing a space-time event chain, dynamic monitoring, information acquisition, multi-source data fusion and intelligent analysis of coal mine disaster events are realized.

title_en: Traffic scene big data searching system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a traffic scene big data searching system, which comprises: the content feedback mechanism is used for acquiring a remote sensing image returned by the remote sensing satellite based on the positioning data of the target search area to be output as a target remote sensing image; and the third analysis equipment is used for taking each image block surrounded by each edge pixel point in the multiple conversion image as each reference image block, and sending out an object identification instruction when the contour of a certain reference image block in the multiple conversion image is matched with the reference contour of the human clothing, or else, sending out an object unrecognization instruction. According to the method and the device, when the contour of a certain reference image block in the multiple conversion image after the sea area picture optimization is matched with the reference contour of the human clothing, the object identification instruction can be sent out, and otherwise, when the object is not identified, the accuracy and the efficiency of the subsequent human clothing identification are improved, and the automatic implementation of sea surface human search and rescue is ensured.

title_en: Method, device, equipment, storage medium and product for forecasting river basin flood
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of flood forecasting, in particular to a method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a product for forecasting river basin flood, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a watershed hydrological model based on the acquired topographic data, soil information, vegetation information, meteorological information, actual measurement precipitation data and actual measurement flow data of the target watershed; constructing an accumulated distribution function by utilizing historical remote sensing soil humidity data of a target river basin obtained by a hydrologic model; correcting the current remote sensing soil humidity data of the target river basin by utilizing the accumulated distribution function to obtain a state value of the soil humidity of the underlying surface of the target river basin; and inputting the humidity state value of the underlying soil into a watershed hydrological model, and generating watershed flood forecast information according to the rainfall weather forecast data of the target watershed. The application can effectively reduce uncertainty of flood forecast, realize accurate forecast of flood in river basin, provide more accurate and reliable forecast data for flood forecast, and facilitate expansion of flood control and disaster reduction work.
assignees: SHANGHAI INVESTIGATION DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating power grid restoration supporting capacity of distributed photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of elasticity evaluation of power distribution networks, in particular to a method, a device and equipment for evaluating the supporting capacity of a distributed photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system to power grid recovery and a readable storage medium, which specifically comprise the following steps: dividing the operation scenes of the photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system under extreme weather conditions based on historical statistical data, optimally calculating the recovery capacity of the supporting power grid under different operation scenes of the photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system, and finally obtaining the comprehensive evaluation value of the recovery supporting capacity of the supporting power grid by combining the occurrence probability of each operation scene of the photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system; the uncertainty influence of extreme weather conditions on the photovoltaic output can be fully considered, and the power supply recovery support capability of the photovoltaic-photo-thermal coupling system on the power grid after disaster is reasonably evaluated, so that the adequacy of the output of the schedulable resources and the cooperative coordination among different resources can be fully considered when an application personnel makes a recovery strategy after disaster.
assignees: STATE GRID SUZHOU URBAN ENERGY RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle group forest fire detection and extinguishing method and system based on improved ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle group forest fire detection and extinguishing method and system based on an improved ant colony algorithm, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle control. The method comprises the following steps: updating the flying speed of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the initial flying speed and the initial water carrying capacity; detecting whether an obstacle exists in the current flight direction and executing obstacle avoidance operation; searching for fire points in the current area, and if no fire points exist, releasing the rejection pheromone; if a fire point exists, water source is consumed to extinguish fire, and the attraction pheromone is released in the current area; updating a transfer probability function according to the rejection pheromone and the attraction pheromone, and determining the flight direction at the next moment according to the transfer probability function; under the full coverage condition, if the number of fire points is 0, the fire point detection of the current round is ended. The invention considers the relation between the flying speed and the water carrying capacity, and is more fit with the actual situation; the ant colony algorithm is improved by introducing the attraction pheromone and the rejection pheromone, so that all search areas can be covered more quickly, and the fire disaster point can be detected quickly.

title_en: Ground standby target identification method based on rotation-invariant dimension-reducing HOG (HOG) features
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground standby target identification method based on rotation-invariant dimension-reducing HOG features, relates to the technical field of ground standby target classification identification, and particularly aims to solve the problems that classical HOG features in the background art do not have rotation invariance and feature dimension is too high, and provides the ground standby target identification method based on rotation-invariant dimension-reducing HOG features, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a target image and an interference background to form a sample training set; extracting a rotation-invariant dimension-reducing HOG feature map of a sample training set, and using the feature map for training a classifier; and classifying the target real-time rotation invariant dimension-reducing HOG feature map by using a classifier to obtain the classification identification of the real-time ground standby target. The method has the advantages of describing infrared images with fewer textures and adapting to uncertainty of a standby target visual angle, indirectly reducing the requirement on visual angle transformation training samples, avoiding the SVM classifier from falling into dimension disasters, and improving classification recognition efficiency.

title_en: Marine unmanned equipment search and rescue method, device and equipment based on drifting track prediction
abstract_en: The application relates to a search and rescue method, a device and equipment for offshore unmanned equipment based on drift track prediction, which are characterized in that a trained coefficient correction model is utilized to optimize flow field coefficients and wind pressure coefficients in a pre-constructed target drift model according to feedback information fed back after the offshore unmanned equipment is in distress, an optimized target drift model is obtained, calculation is carried out according to environmental information of a sea area where the offshore unmanned equipment is located and the optimized target drift model, a drift track after the offshore unmanned equipment is in distress is obtained, and a Monte Carlo algorithm is adopted based on the drift track to obtain a search and rescue area of the offshore unmanned equipment, wherein the search and rescue area is represented by uncertainty quantization of search and rescue target distribution probability under marine environment rasterization. By adopting the method, an accurate search and rescue area can be provided for search and rescue of offshore unmanned equipment.

title_en: Landslide vulnerability evaluation method based on negative sample optimization selection strategy
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, and discloses a landslide vulnerability evaluation method based on a negative sample optimization selection strategy, which comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring landslide multi-source data: acquiring historical landslide catalogue data, acquiring landslide influence factor multi-source data of a research area, and unifying the spatial resolution, a projection coordinate system and a geographic coordinate system of the landslide influence factor multi-source data; s2: and (3) extracting evaluation factor layer information: extracting evaluation factor information from the multi-source data through a GIS platform, and establishing a landslide susceptibility evaluation index system; s3: three-dimensional slope stability analysis: and carrying out three-dimensional slope stability analysis on the whole research area by Scoops D by utilizing elevation information and bedrock thickness information of the research area. The invention avoids the interference of artificial factors in the process of selecting the negative sample, improves the quality and the interpretability of selecting the negative sample, reduces the uncertainty of selecting the negative sample, and can objectively and efficiently realize landslide susceptibility evaluation.
assignees: WUHAN CAMPUS OF YANGTZE UNIV;SICHUAN YANJIANG PANNING EXPRESSWAY CO LTD;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Power distribution network and drainage network topology collaborative reconstruction method for coping with storm water logging disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network and drainage network topology collaborative reconstruction method for coping with storm water-logging disasters, which comprises the following steps: step S1, constructing an electric power-drainage network coupling model based on partial differential constraint of pressure and non-pressure unsteady flow hydrodynamic force, and representing dynamic interactive evolution processes of power failure, rainwater overflow and road ponding of a power grid under a storm disaster; s2, establishing an equivalent linear complex algebraic equation of a drainage network nonlinear hydrodynamic partial differential equation in a frequency domain; s3, deducing a multi-hyperplane formula of an electric power-drainage composite safety area, and representing a feasible operation boundary of an electric pump-sluice group under the injection conditions of complex electric power and rainwater; and S4, taking rainfall uncertainty in heavy rain into consideration, adopting multi-scene random optimization based on Monte Carlo simulation, and solving an emergency scheduling decision scheme at the current moment through rolling optimization. The invention realizes the coordination reconstruction of the network topology of the power distribution network and the drainage network under the disaster of rainstorm and waterlogging.

title_en: Multi-type power source cooperative active recovery method and system after network disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for active recovery after disaster in a distribution network with cooperation of multiple types of power supplies, belonging to the field of recovery after disaster in a distribution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: based on source load switching and source load uncertainty analysis, analyzing frequency indexes of a system under dynamic disturbance in a partition expansion process, and considering supporting effects of DG and MES in a distribution network on inertia, primary frequency modulation and load electric energy, constructing partition expansion constraint considering frequency safety and electric energy demand; and establishing a multi-partition net rack continuation model taking the multi-MES as a restoration starting point, and combining partition expansion constraint and source load restoration constraint to construct an overall active restoration model.
