The invention utilizes the flexible movement characteristic, the electric energy supporting characteristic and the frequency supporting characteristic of the MES, considers the recovery process after the disaster of the distribution network and cooperates with the DG to ensure that new energy is possible to be connected in advance on the premise of ensuring the frequency safety, and the power generation resources in the network are utilized in advance and fully, so that a larger amount of load can be recovered.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster risk early warning method based on space-time multi-feature uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent disaster risk early warning method based on space-time multi-feature uncertainty, which is characterized by collecting historical mountain torrent data of a research area, extracting and analyzing mountain torrent vulnerability factor data of the research area to form at least 5-level risk areas, rasterizing the research area and classifying the risk areas into levels of each grid; respectively constructing mountain torrent disaster risk assessment models of all levels of risk areas; fitting the distribution of each torrent disaster risk factor as prior distribution based on historical torrent data, sampling by adopting a DREAM algorithm, respectively inputting a torrent disaster risk assessment model of each grade risk area to obtain posterior distribution of each torrent disaster risk index, and obtaining the probability of risk occurrence of each grade risk area by adopting Bayesian inference; setting a risk scenario set, analyzing the mountain torrent disaster risks of each grid in the research area through a mountain torrent disaster risk assessment model, and calculating the risk contribution rate of each mountain torrent disaster risk factor; the scientificity of mountain torrent disaster risk early warning is improved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG INST OF HYDRAULICS & ESTUARY ZHEJIANG MARINE PLANNING AND DESIGN INST

title_en: Forest fire spread modeling method for minimizing influence of wind field uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire spread modeling method for minimizing influence of wind field uncertainty, which comprises the following steps: acquiring ground data; acquiring aerial data, including multispectral data and DEM data; generating a terrain grid according to the terrain data, and generating an equation set by applying a mass conservation equation at each point of the grid; storing a sparse matrix generated by an equation set by adopting a compressed sparse line CSR storage method, and solving the equation set by utilizing a conjugate gradient solver; finally, generating a wind field diagram according to the solving result; selecting farsite a fire behavior model in a simulator; and (5) superposing live wire positions at different times on the topographic map for visual display. According to the invention, a precise wind field state equation is constructed by introducing a mass conservation law, so that high-precision analysis of wind field distribution is realized, a high-resolution wind field diagram is obtained, and the high-resolution wind field diagram is combined with a farsite simulator, so that the fire disaster prediction accuracy is remarkably improved.
assignees: HEFEI HENGBAO TIANZE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for estimating flood inundation probability by combining microblog data and geographic data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for estimating flood inundation probability by combining microblog data and geographic data, which relate to the technical field of flood disaster prediction and estimation and comprise the following steps: collecting a real-time data source, extracting the water depth value and the geographic position of texts and pictures, and obtaining the specific longitude and latitude of a submerged point; according to the different origins of the geographic information data, processing the geographic information data into influence factors with the same resolution and the same size; calculating flooding probability distribution of the whole graph; calculating the weight value of the influence factor in the interest radius by using the center of the submerged point; and based on the submerged probability layer and the weight value, weighting, superposing and averaging to obtain a weighted comprehensive probability map. According to the invention, through integrating social media, a geographic information system, satellite images and ground observation data, real-time monitoring of flood disasters and accurate estimation of flood probability are realized. The multisource data fusion and efficient information processing method not only greatly improves accuracy and timeliness of flood prediction, but also enhances decision support capability of disaster emergency management.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel surrounding rock convergence deformation prediction model dynamic selection and deformation probability prediction method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a system for dynamically selecting a tunnel surrounding rock convergence deformation prediction model and predicting deformation probability, and relates to the technical field of information processing. In the embodiment of the invention, a surrounding rock convergence deformation dynamic prediction model based on a continuous Bayesian inverse analysis method and optimal model selection is established, tunnel convergence deformation monitoring information is used as an observation value, parameters of 3 empirical models are continuously updated and calibrated, and the optimal model is selected to predict the final convergence deformation value of the surrounding rock and quantify the uncertainty of the final convergence deformation value. The final deformation result about 40 days can be effectively predicted by adopting the prediction Fan Fagei only by using the observation data about 10 days, and an important technical support is provided for the deformation limit of the surrounding rock of the tunnel and the prevention and the control of large deformation disasters.

title_en: A system for locating and tracking floating objects, and methods thereof
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a system for locating and tracking floating objects and methods thereof. In particular, the present disclosure relates to a method and system for locating and tracking objects floating submerged or non-submerged on or near the surface of marine environment. The system and method of the present invention provide for receiving data on the object's physical characteristics, mapping the search area in the water body, acquiring meteorological data for the search area, simulating and predicting the object's movement based on input data, creating a map of predicted locations with probabilities of containing the object, displaying the predictions on a graphical user interface, tracking the object based on the map and communicating the object's location to a rescue team.

title_en: Task planning method, device and equipment for maritime collaborative search and rescue and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a task planning method, device, equipment and storage medium for maritime collaborative search and rescue, which are characterized in that a search and rescue probability map which is quantitatively represented by uncertainty of search and rescue target distribution probability under the gridding of a marine environment is obtained by adopting a Monte Carlo algorithm based on a drifting track, a maritime target search and rescue model is constructed based on the search and rescue probability map, meanwhile, an initial population is obtained by setting an initial chromosome gene segment according to collaborative search and rescue parameters, the optimal solution is obtained by adopting a global optimal genetic bionic intelligent algorithm based on the initial population, the optimal solution is obtained after the initial population is decoded, and a task planning scheme of multiparty participation in collaborative search and rescue is obtained after interaction with the maritime target search and rescue model in each iterative optimization process, and population optimization is carried out according to the fitness. By adopting the method, a multiparty collaborative search and rescue task planning scheme with high search and rescue success rate can be obtained.

title_en: Watershed and arid disaster prediction method based on Bayesian theorem and machine learning
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster prediction, and particularly discloses a watershed and arid disaster prediction method based on Bayesian theorem and machine learning, which comprises the following steps: data collection, construction of a disaster prediction model, adjustment of the disaster prediction model and real-time paddy and dry disaster prediction. The invention uses the loss function to generate Bayesian prediction, and constructs posterior prediction by approximating the variation of the generalized posterior, so that uncertainty in data can be fully considered, and the optimal disaster prediction can be helped to be made so as to minimize loss; according to the invention, three Bayesian optimization hyper-parameter methods of upper confidence, improved probability and expected improvement are combined to optimize the Gaussian process in the disaster prediction model, and the respective advantages of the three methods are combined through complementation of the different methods, so that the hyper-parameters can be optimized more comprehensively, and different conditions and data characteristics can be adapted.
assignees: GEOVIS YISHUI SICHUAN TECH CO LTD;INNER MONGOLIA AUTONOMOUS REGION INST OF WATER CONSERVANCY SCIENCE

title_en: Building function probability prediction method under flood disasters based on deep learning algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building function probability prediction method under flood disasters based on a deep learning algorithm, which comprises the following steps: s1, collecting basic data and historical storm time sequence data of a research area; s2, processing the data; s3, constructing an FFC model based on a deep learning algorithm, training and verifying the FFC model, optimizing the affected building attention coefficient to obtain the optimal affected building attention coefficient for each building type, and testing the performance of the FFC model; s4, inputting the forecast rainfall time sequence into the FFC model tested for each building type, and performing repeated rolling iteration prediction to obtain probability distribution results of different functions of each building in a certain time range in the future of the research area. The obtained building function probability distribution result is beneficial to providing more information and uncertainty quantification for decision-making of decision-makers, thereby providing a good basis for the determination of the subsequent evacuation requirements.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster risk prediction method based on hybrid machine learning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent disaster risk prediction method based on a hybrid machine learning method, which relates to the technical field of model prediction and solves the problems of difficult model data acquisition, uncertainty of mountain torrent disaster influence factor weights, local excessive optimization of a model, inapplicability of the model in a non-observation area, low learning efficiency of a machine learning model and the like in the use process of a current mountain torrent disaster risk prediction model; the method utilizes the ABC algorithm to optimize the initial network structure and the connection weight of the RBFNN model, is beneficial to avoiding the problem of local optimization, integrates the RBFNN and the ABC algorithm, accelerates model learning, the learning speed and accuracy of the mountain torrent disaster prediction model are improved, the weight of the characteristic factors in the model is determined according to historical data based on an RF method, the model is not fixed and unchanged, and the whole system has universality.
assignees: CHINA WATER SUNNY DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network toughness improving method based on source network load multi-resource cooperation in ice disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention develops a method for improving the toughness of a power distribution network by the cooperation of multiple sources of a source network and multiple sources under an ice disaster scene; the influence of ice disaster weather on the power distribution network lines, distributed generators and residential loads is considered, the distribution network line reinforcement, liquefied natural gas capacity allocation and maintenance team allocation schemes are formulated in the pre-disaster stage aiming at the resource differentiation requirements of system prevention, response and recovery, and the load loss is minimized through unit output scheduling, power distribution network reconstruction, maintenance team scheduling maintenance and toughness improvement strategies of differentiated cut loads during disasters. And establishing a two-stage mixed integer random programming model of the multi-fault scene based on the proposed strategy, solving the problem by adopting a Gaussian-Saidel method based on punishment so as to improve the calculation efficiency, and adopting a robust optimization method to treat the uncertainty of wind and light output. The method can improve the power supply effect of the key load of the power distribution network in the ice disaster period, and the load loss can be effectively reduced by the cooperation of multiple resources.

title_en: Important facility early warning critical rainfall calculation method based on high-precision digital earth surface model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an important facility early warning critical rainfall calculation method based on a high-precision digital earth surface model, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting high-precision point cloud mapping data of cities where important facilities are located, data such as current land utilization classification and the like, and collecting submerged water depth data of key positions; s2, correcting various collected data; s3, fusing the corrected various data; s4, dynamically dividing the sub-catchment areas in three stages based on the fused topographic data; s5, constructing a multi-city rainfall flood runoff model based on Bayesian average; s6, inputting rainfall data under different reproduction periods into a multi-city rainfall runoff model based on Bayesian average constructed in the step S5, predicting a flooding result under rainfall conditions of different reproduction periods, and calculating the early warning critical rainfall of each important facility storm disaster caused by the flooding result; the invention overcomes the simulation error caused by the structural uncertainty of the single urban rainfall flood runoff model and improves the accuracy of storm disaster early warning.
assignees: CHANGJIANG INST SURVEY PLANNING DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Distributed power supply loss reduction planning configuration method and device for power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed power supply loss reduction planning configuration method and device for a power distribution network, which are characterized by establishing a load uncertainty set and a natural disaster uncertainty model in the power distribution network, establishing a distributed power supply configuration model for power distribution network loss reduction according to a random robust optimization theory based on the load uncertainty set and the natural disaster uncertainty model, performing random optimization model and robust optimization model decomposition on the distributed power supply configuration model, solving a distributed power supply installation position, and performing distributed power supply configuration according to a distributed power supply installation position solving result. The invention simultaneously considers the influence of load fluctuation and natural disasters based on a random robust optimization theory, so that the distribution of the distributed power supply is more effective, the loss reduction effect of the distribution network is more reasonable, and the technical problems that the existing distributed power supply configuration method does not simultaneously consider the fluctuation of the load and the uncertainty of the natural disasters, influences the effectiveness and the low reliability of the distributed power supply configuration are solved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Data shortage estuary composite flood disaster research method considering climate change
abstract_en: The invention discloses a research method of a composite flood disaster of a data shortage estuary considering climate change, which comprises the following steps: acquiring and preprocessing multi-source heterogeneous data; constructing a wind-rain-wave-current coupling mathematical model; extracting extremum data pairs; estimating an edge distribution parameter; estimating Copula function parameters; generating a joint posterior distribution; and calculating the joint reproduction period and performing uncertainty analysis. The method effectively solves the problem of composite flood disaster research in the river mouth area with data shortage through multi-source data fusion, dynamic model construction and non-stationarity processing. The non-stationary characteristic of hydrologic elements and the complex dependency relationship thereof are accurately described by adopting a Bayesian non-parametric method and a time-varying Copula model, so that the scientificity and reliability of composite flood risk assessment are remarkably improved, and powerful support is provided for flood control and disaster reduction decisions under the climate change background.

title_en: Power grid transmission line assessment method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid transmission line assessment method, which is characterized in that a three-layer optimization model is established to identify a key transmission line in a system on the basis of considering the resource of an attacker, an optimal attack decision and rescheduling of a system operator so as to enhance the capability of the transmission line for resisting potential malicious physical attack and natural disasters; meanwhile, the uncertainty of attack characteristics of an attacker is considered, and a distributed robust optimization model for identifying a key power transmission line with unknown malicious physical attack scene is provided; in order to quantify the importance of the key power transmission lines on the system against malicious physical attacks, improve the system elasticity, and realize the power transmission line importance level ranking, a power transmission line importance level assessment index under the condition of the malicious physical attacks is provided, and the power transmission line importance level of each key power transmission line in the power grid is determined according to the importance level assessment index, so that the power transmission line importance level assessment of the power grid for the malicious physical attacks is realized.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV CHONGQING

title_en: Robust positioning method based on maximum entropy principle and used for cooperation of multiple submarines
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robust positioning method based on maximum entropy principle and used for cooperation of multiple submarines, and relates to the field of underwater positioning. The invention designs a particle characterization method of the relative position information of a submersible based on a particle-implemented submersible position prediction method based on the principle of maximum entropy. The potential device uses self position prediction and relative position representation between the potential device and the adjacent position to calculate the edge probability distribution of the position, and the estimated value of the self position is obtained in real time through a minimum mean square error estimator. Aiming at a severe underwater environment with complex dynamic time-varying and noise interference, the invention improves the stability and the persistence of the position estimation output by weakening the sensitivity of the positioning process of the submersible vehicle to uncertainty. The method can be directly applied to key applications such as sea area safety monitoring, sea information acquisition, underwater search and rescue and the like, and can provide high-efficiency and stable position estimation for the submersible vehicle.

title_en: Rescue method for space point sound source localization based on microphone array
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of emergency rescue, in particular to a rescue method for positioning a space point sound source based on a microphone array. Through rotatable carrying platform, can make microphone array A and microphone array B form a pair of wrong plane, obtain the projection point of two planes of disaster personnel's sound source based on time delay estimation method again, through making the vector intersect on the mathematical model just can accomplish space point sound source location, and then to sound source area location and carry out the work of making a video recording through carrying the camera, locking coordinate information and image. The unmanned aerial vehicle is controlled to perform point-around flight monitoring in the search area, so that the search area covers the whole target area to obtain specific position information of the disaster-stricken, and the disaster-stricken can be locked rapidly.
assignees: UNIV NANCHANG HANGKONG;ZHAOYANG GEVOTAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-unmanned water surface ship maritime search and rescue path planning method based on POS-DQN
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-unmanned-ship maritime search and rescue path planning method based on POS-DQN, and relates to the technical field of path planning. Aiming at the problem of reasonably and efficiently completing maritime search and rescue tasks of multiple unmanned ships, the maritime search and rescue path planning method which is reasonable in task allocation and capable of searching high-probability areas preferentially is provided based on an improved task allocation algorithm and a POS-DQN deep reinforcement learning algorithm. The invention firstly uses an improved task allocation algorithm to integrally divide the search area, so that the task area of each unmanned ship has priority and no repeated division. Secondly, the invention considers the POS of the search environment and provides a POS-DQN algorithm based on deep reinforcement learning. The algorithm can adapt to complex changing environments of search and rescue, and the probability weight rewarding function is utilized to train a plurality of unmanned boats to obtain an optimal search path. Finally, on the basis of considering the whole coverage of obstacle avoidance and collision avoidance, the search path can search the high-probability area preferentially, so that the search and rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Near-shore storm surge and typhoon wave forecasting method based on process and data dual driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a near shore storm surge and typhoon wave forecasting method based on process and data double driving, which comprises the steps of obtaining multisource meteorological data, and adopting a multi-model self-adaptive integrated forecasting method to process the multisource meteorological data so as to obtain high-precision meteorological forecasting data; based on high-precision weather forecast data, a multidimensional feature typhoon path extraction and probability forecast method is adopted for processing, so that probability typhoon path forecast data are obtained; based on the probability typhoon path forecast data, adopting a physical constraint variation assimilation wind field correction method to process so as to obtain corrected wind field data; based on the corrected wind field data, processing by using a multi-grid wind-wave-stream coupling model solving method to obtain near-shore storm surge and typhoon wave forecast data; and calculating to obtain a final forecasting result by adopting an integrated learning offshore disaster forecasting and uncertainty quantifying method. The invention realizes the rapid and accurate prediction of the wind, wave, tide and flow of the important offshore areas during typhoons.

title_en: Expressway mobile energy storage pre-disaster pre-layout planning method, system, equipment and medium considering fault situation and uncertainty of photovoltaic conditions
abstract_en: The invention provides a pre-layout planning method, system, equipment and medium for expressway mobile energy storage before disaster, which take fault situations and uncertainty of photovoltaic conditions into account, comprising the following steps: step 1, constructing a pre-layout model of the expressway before the mobile energy storage disaster by taking the constraint of the expressway power distribution network and the limitation of the scheduling resources into consideration with the aim of ensuring the safety and reliability of the expressway energy consumption and economy; step 2, solving an objective function and constraint conditions in the model based on a robust optimization method of a column constraint generation algorithm to obtain a pre-layout scheme; step 3, based on the consideration of double uncertainties of fault situations and photovoltaic conditions, combining a pre-layout scheme to obtain a robust optimization pre-layout scheme; the invention can reasonably layout the mobile energy storage equipment before disaster according to the prediction scene so as to cope with the adverse effect on the expressway system caused by possible fault moment.
assignees: CHANGAN UNIV;GUANGXI COMMUNICATIONS INVEST GROUP CO LTD;GUANGXI GUIHE HIGHWAY CO LTD

title_en: Energy station elastic lifting planning method and system under multiple uncertainties
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for planning elastic lifting of an energy station under multiple uncertainties, wherein the method comprises the following steps: taking multiple uncertainty factors of the disaster process of the energy station into consideration, and constructing probability distribution of each uncertainty factor, wherein the multiple uncertainty factors comprise earthquake intensity deviation, equipment damage state capability deviation, energy equipment earthquake vulnerability deviation, post-disaster multipotency load prediction error and post-disaster data load prediction error; based on the probability distribution of each uncertainty factor, constructing a load shedding condition risk constraint after the disaster of the energy station by utilizing a condition risk value theory; building an energy station elastic lifting planning model for coping with earthquake disasters under multiple uncertainties; and solving the energy station elastic lifting planning model to obtain a multi-energy station planning scheme for coping with the earthquake disasters. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of effectively avoiding potential risk of post-disaster load shedding of the energy station, improving the elasticity of the planning scheme for coping with earthquake disasters and the like.

title_en: Power distribution network topology reconstruction method based on extreme disaster scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network topology reconstruction method based on an extreme disaster scene, which considers the uncertainty of disaster occurrence through a random optimization method, optimizes the power distribution network topology on the basis of accurately predicting the probability distribution of a power grid fault scene, and realizes the optimal topology reconstruction of the power distribution network under the extreme disaster fault. The virtual tide method is adopted to keep the radial operation of the power distribution network, and the power and voltage balance of the power distribution network under the topology reconstruction is considered, so that a power distribution network topology reconstruction model based on extreme disaster scenes is constructed. According to the invention, the current natural environment and the actual situation that severe weather frequently occur are considered, the fault occurrence scene is considered through a random optimization method, the topology of the power distribution network is reconstructed, and the power supply reliability and the safety of the power distribution network under extreme disasters are ensured.

title_en: Fire anti-interference detection method and system for wind power cabin
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire disaster early warning of wind power cabins, in particular to a fire disaster anti-interference detection method and system for a wind power cabin. The invention discloses a fire anti-interference detection method for a wind power cabin, which comprises the steps of selecting a temperature-sensing fire detector and a smoke-sensing fire detector for signal detection; the temperature-sensing fire detector alarms according to the temperature alarm or the temperature change rate, and effectively adapts to the uncertainty influence of the environmental temperature change on the temperature alarm threshold; the smoke-sensing fire detector alarms according to the smoke self-adaptive threshold, and the smoke self-adaptive threshold is adjusted by processing related parameters, so that the smoke-sensing fire detector outputs a higher value under the condition of interference and outputs a lower value under the condition of open fire and smoldering, the detection sensitivity and anti-interference performance are improved, and the interference influence is reduced. The fire anti-interference detection method and system for the wind power cabin solve the problem that the influence of an interference source cannot be eliminated.
assignees: HUADIAN FUXIN ANHUI NEW ENERGY CO LTD;ANHUI ZHONGKE HENGAN SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Regional rock-soil body strength parameter correction method and device
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of geological disaster risk analysis, in particular to a regional rock-soil body intensity parameter correction method and device, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting at least one influence factor data of a target region to construct a geographical information database of a regional landslide susceptibility evaluation model; calculating an area landslide susceptibility index by using a frequency ratio model to determine an area landslide occurrence probability to obtain first area landslide stability, determining an area rock-soil body intensity parameter to calculate an area slope stability coefficient, reducing the area rock-soil body intensity parameter to obtain second area slope stability, constructing a cross entropy loss function to quantitatively evaluate the result difference, and carrying out iterative updating on the rock-soil body intensity parameter to obtain a final area rock-soil body intensity parameter. Therefore, the problems that in the related technology, the shear strength parameter of the slope has larger uncertainty, the calculation error of the easiness of earthquake landslide is possibly increased, the prediction accuracy and reliability are reduced and the like are solved.

title_en: Cable network time domain coupling characteristic prediction method in external random electromagnetic environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cable network time domain coupling characteristic prediction method under an external random electromagnetic environment, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out normalized modeling on an external source multidimensional random variable, selecting a corresponding chaos polynomial according to probability distribution of the random variable, constructing a multidimensional access sparse basis function and a sample point set isomorphic with the multidimensional access sparse basis function by utilizing a one-dimensional chaos polynomial based on an quasi-entry basis concept, carrying out deterministic solution on coupling response of the cable network and the external electromagnetic environment on the sample point to obtain a corresponding deterministic response, solving coefficients of the basis function based on the deterministic response, and finally forming an explicit function by the constructed multidimensional basis function and the coefficients corresponding to each basis function, and carrying out random sampling by using the explicit function to obtain an uncertainty analysis result. The method can well calculate the statistical characteristics of the response of the complex cable network system in practice, greatly reduces the calculated amount of high-dimensional random analysis through generalized sparse grids, and solves the dimension disaster to a certain extent.

title_en: Loose water-bearing sand layer grouting modification effect checking method, system, medium and equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a loose water-containing sand layer grouting modification effect inspection method, a system, a medium and equipment, and belongs to the technical field of coal mine roof water-bursting sand-bursting disaster prevention and control. The point data of the treatment holes distributed in the point shape are converted into the surface data with continuous space through the spatial interpolation process, the suspicious target area is quickly grouting according to the water permeability partition map, the treatment weak area is determined by adopting a ground drilling-geophysical prospecting combination method, the treatment weak area is comprehensively judged by adopting a downhole drilling-geophysical prospecting combination method, and finally the loose water sand layer grouting treatment effect test result is obtained. The water permeability partition map is introduced as an objective basis for defining a suspicious grouting target area, so that subjectivity and uncertainty of selection of an inspection area in the traditional technology are avoided, and blindness in engineering design of conventional grouting effect inspection and verification is avoided according to a flow of defining the suspicious grouting target area, rapidly positioning and treating a weak area through ground drilling-geophysical prospecting combination and verifying the weak area through underground drilling-geophysical prospecting combination.
assignees: ANHUI HENGYUAN COAL & ELECTRIC CO LTD;XIAN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Node recovery importance expected value evaluation method, system, device and medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power systems, and discloses a node recovery importance expected value evaluation method, a system, a device and a medium, which comprise the steps of obtaining power grid operation information and a power transmission line fault probability evaluation result, and initializing an integral calculation parameter and a round of calculation parameter of sampling simulation based on the power transmission line fault probability evaluation result; sequentially identifying the power grid states of the power transmission line and the node at each time point through iterative sampling of sampling simulation of the recoverable state, removing the power transmission line and the node which do not meet the recoverable requirement in each round of sampling results, calculating the importance degree of the reserved power transmission line and the node, integrating the sampling results after all iterative rounds are finished, and calculating the importance index and the expected operation time value of the damaged power transmission line and the node based on the importance degree of the power transmission line and the node. According to the method, the node importance which considers the influence of disaster uncertainty is dynamically evaluated and updated on line, so that the identification capability of key nodes and lines of the power grid in a recovery state is remarkably improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Optimization method, system and related device for reconstruction of localized emergency power supply charging pile
abstract_en: A method for optimizing the transformation of a local emergency power supply charging pile comprises the steps of considering the distribution and load uncertainty of a building-level electric automobile, considering disaster occurrence frequency estimation, determining a disaster scene set, defining an operation complexity index by combining economic loss and operation cost caused by the transformation of the charging and discharging states of the building-level electric automobile, taking the sum of the transportation and transformation cost of a charging station, the dispatching cost of the building-level electric automobile, the economic cost loss caused by the loss of load power and the conversion cost of the operation complexity index as an objective function of a charging pile transformation optimization model, carrying out linearization treatment on the charging pile transformation optimization model, and solving by taking the objective function and constraint conditions into consideration under the disaster scene set by utilizing the charging pile transformation optimization model after linearization treatment, so as to obtain the charging pile transformation optimization scheme. The invention can formulate a reasonable optimization scheme for the transformation of the bidirectional charging and discharging interface of the charging pile for the localization emergency power supply recovery of the post-disaster building.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Gas-electricity combined distribution network distribution robust extension planning method considering system toughness constraint
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of planning of a gas-electricity combined system and toughness improvement, in particular to a gas-electricity combined network distribution robust expansion planning method considering system toughness constraint, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a gas-electricity combined network expansion planning model taking the sum of operation cost and planning cost as an objective function, considering the capability of changing fuel supply load when natural gas of a dual-fuel unit is insufficient under a disaster in the aspect of improving the toughness, further modeling the construction of the dual-fuel unit and a connecting line, and considering constraints such as power distribution network reconstruction at the operation level, and secondly establishing a two-stage distribution robust expansion planning model considering the toughness constraint of the gas-electricity combined network system under the extreme disaster by using a distribution robust optimization method based on KL divergence to consider the uncertainty of the influence of the extreme disaster. The method can improve the economical efficiency of the gas-electricity combined distribution network in normal operation and enhance the toughness capability in extreme disasters.

title_en: Side slope collapse risk assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood and drought disaster data processing, and provides a slope collapse risk assessment method and a system, wherein the slope collapse risk assessment method comprises the steps of constructing a plurality of grid units based on a surface structure of a research area, and constructing a plurality of data matrixes; the method comprises the steps of obtaining future rainfall probability distribution, generating a future rainfall scene library, constructing a soil hydrologic mechanism model, obtaining a plurality of flood peak element results based on the future rainfall scene library and the soil hydrologic mechanism model to calculate uncertainty, obtaining a hydrologic mechanism data set, establishing a fault tree model of a slope collapse event, evaluating slope collapse risk expectations, and evaluating accuracy of the slope collapse risk expectations according to the uncertainty. By establishing a data matrix related to a time scale, the model simulates the whole hydrologic cycle process, predicts and understands the hydrologic process more deeply, and can obtain a dynamic slope condition change process, and quantitatively evaluate the slope collapse risk expectation and the expected accuracy.

title_en: Flood inundation drawing method and system integrating social media data and SAR (synthetic aperture radar) images
abstract_en: The invention provides a flood inundation drawing method and a system integrating social media data and SAR images, which relate to the technical field of emergency management and comprise the steps of acquiring text data which are related to a storm flood event and provided with POI address information in social media; the method comprises the steps of generating a rough flood inundation range map and a flood inundation probability map of a disaster area based on DEM data, POI inundation points and corresponding water depth information, confirming a flood inundation probability threshold interval based on field pictures and video data obtained through searching, obtaining a flood inundation range map of an urban built-up area by taking intersection, extracting water body data of different periods according to multi-view SAR images before, during and after a disaster, generating a river inundation range map, and combining the flood inundation range map of the urban built-up area and the river inundation range map to obtain a flood inundation range map of the disaster area. According to the method, the advantages of social media data and time sequence SAR images in urban flood and river flood detection are fully utilized, and high-precision drawing of large-scale flood events is achieved.
assignees: UNIV CENTRAL CHINA NORMAL;CHANGJIANG RIVER SCIENT RES INST CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Storm disaster risk early warning method, system and medium based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a storm disaster risk early warning method, system and medium based on multi-source data, and belongs to the technical field of meteorological disaster risk early warning. The method comprises the steps of S1, a historical precipitation data reading stage, S2, a disaster factor calculating stage, S3, a storm disaster risk index calculating stage, a disaster body data calculating stage, S5, a storm disaster risk index calculating stage and a storm disaster risk early warning stage, wherein the storm disaster risk index calculating stage is used for calculating a storm disaster risk early warning grade of each preset area according to the storm disaster risk index, the vulnerability of the disaster body, the exposure of the disaster body and the weights of the disaster body, and the disaster risk early warning grade of the storm disaster. The rainfall estimation precision and the space variability are considered, and the uncertainty of the risk estimation result is reduced by combining the rainfall estimation precision and the space variability with the characteristics of long-sequence observation data identification.

title_en: Electric-gas-heat comprehensive energy micro-grid optimal configuration system considering extreme events
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric-gas-heat comprehensive energy micro-grid optimizing configuration system considering extreme events, which belongs to the technical field of comprehensive energy system optimization and comprises a system model, an objective function, calculation, constraint condition setting, extreme safety constraint setting, a planning model establishment and a solving model establishment, wherein the system model comprises a gas turbine, a gas boiler, photovoltaic equipment, wind power equipment, an electric heat pump, battery energy storage and heat energy storage equipment, and is used for meeting the requirements of electric energy, heat energy and gas load in the system and ensuring the balance of electric quantity and heat of the system. The method is characterized in that an optimization model of the comprehensive energy system is constructed, the uncertainty of renewable energy output is processed by utilizing a static robust optimization technology, and the operation safety and stability of the system during disasters are ensured by combining the uncertainty of power grid or gas network faults caused by extreme natural disasters.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Intelligent switch planning method considering disaster pre-disaster-middle-post multi-stage cooperation and disaster uncertainty
abstract_en: An intelligent switch planning method considering pre-disaster-mid-post multi-stage synergy and disaster uncertainty relates to the technical field of intelligent switch planning of power grids and is used for solving the problem that the existing pre-disaster planning does not consider the disaster intensity uncertainty. The invention realizes the multi-stage coordination of determining the number of switches in the planning stage, finishing switch address selection in the prevention stage and closing the switch to restore load in the post-disaster stage by coupling the available measures of the pre-disaster planning stage, the pre-disaster prevention stage, the post-disaster recovery stage. In addition, a gradual hedging algorithm is provided, a large nonlinear model is decomposed into a plurality of scene-related sub-problems to be solved, and the calculation load is greatly reduced. Simulation results show that compared with a pre-disaster-post-disaster two-stage planning model, the model provided by the invention not only can obtain a more flexible planning scheme, but also can reduce investment cost and load power failure loss.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG;YANTAI ENGINEERING UNIV RESEARCH INSTITUTE;STATE GRID HUNAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST

title_en: Coverage path planning method of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles in dam abnormal environment inspection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coverage path planning method of a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle in dam abnormal environment inspection, which is characterized in that firstly, an abnormal environment, namely a dam area after a disaster occurs, is defined, secondly, the coverage path planning problem of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle in dam abnormal environment inspection is defined as an optimization problem, the optimization targets are coverage rate and energy consumption of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle in the abnormal environment respectively, and a model design is that a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle coverage path planning model based on DRL is constructed according to the optimization problem defined in the previous step, and the parameters of the multi-unmanned aerial vehicle coverage path planning model are updated and the performance of the model is evaluated. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of good practicability and the like.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster factor identification method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to a method and a system for identifying disaster causing factors of geological disasters, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining geological disaster point data and environment data of a target area, generating environment influence factor data according to the environment data, calculating and analyzing influence degree of each environment influence factor on spatial distribution of the geological disaster point by using a geographic detector based on the geological disaster point data and the environment influence factor data, extracting disaster causing factors influencing the spatial distribution of the geological disasters, and carrying out data mapping on the target area, the geological disaster type and the disaster causing factors to generate a disaster causing factor database of the target area. According to the embodiment of the invention, the disaster causing factors influencing the spatial distribution of the geological disasters are extracted by using the geographic detector by acquiring the geological disaster point data and the environment data of different target areas and different geological disaster types, and the disaster causing factor database aiming at the different target areas and different types of geological disasters is established, so that the uncertainty of the susceptibility evaluation of the geological disasters is reduced.
assignees: INST GEOGRAPHIC SCIENCES & NATURAL RESOURCES RES CAS

title_en: Two-stage self-adaptive robust elastic lifting method for high-proportion renewable energy power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage self-adaptive robust elastic lifting method of a high-proportion renewable energy power distribution network, which comprises the specific steps of establishing a two-stage self-adaptive robust optimization model for a power system in a pre-disaster stage and a post-disaster stage, establishing an uncertainty scene set according to the output and load demands of renewable energy sources, determining an objective function of a min-max-min structure of the two-stage self-adaptive robust optimization model and constraint of the power system, decomposing the min-max-min structure of the two-stage self-adaptive robust optimization model, decomposing the model into a main problem of the min structure and a sub problem of the max-min structure, iterating the main problem and the sub problem, and solving an optimal power supply recovery strategy.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Comprehensive energy system toughness assessment method based on Kolmogorov equation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of comprehensive energy systems, in particular to a comprehensive energy system toughness assessment method based on a Kelmogorov equation. The method comprises the steps of constructing a random differential equation of the multi-energy system, decomposing a system change process into a system slow change process and a system fast change process, deducing the characteristics of the system slow change process and the system fast change process by utilizing historical data of extreme disasters, calculating expectations and variances of the system slow change process and the system fast change process, obtaining probability distribution of the system operation process, constructing a forward equation of the Kolmogorov, calculating the entropy value of the Kolmogorov, solving a drift coefficient and a diffusion coefficient, inputting the data of the predicted extreme disasters to be faced into the forward equation of the Kolmogorov, combining an optimized scheduling strategy of the multi-energy system, solving the probability distribution of emergency load shedding of the system, and evaluating the toughness uncertainty of the system by using the probability distribution, supporting a subsequent toughness lifting means, and having important significance for guaranteeing safe and stable operation of the social folk and comprehensive energy systems.
assignees: STATE GRID JILIN ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO;NARI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Ship search and rescue path planning method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship search and rescue path planning method, device, equipment and storage medium. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-ship search and rescue mathematical model, wherein a ship set, a waypoint set and an unpaired waypoint set are defined in the multi-ship search and rescue mathematical model, constructing a state parameterized model diagram covering a search and rescue area based on the multi-ship search and rescue mathematical model, constructing a search model diagram according to the state parameterized model diagram, and planning search and rescue paths according to the state parameterized model diagram and the search model diagram. By constructing a mathematical model and two model diagrams, the complex search and rescue path planning process is simplified, the planning efficiency is remarkably improved, and the planning time is shortened. The multi-aspect factors such as ship set and waypoint set are comprehensively considered, so that the planned search and rescue path is more reasonable, the coverage integrity and accuracy of a search area are improved, search and rescue tasks and paths of a plurality of ships can be reasonably distributed, optimal allocation of search and rescue resources is realized, and the resource utilization efficiency is improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle cluster optimal path planning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle flight planning, and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster optimal path planning method and system. The two models are innovatively trained by adopting a double machine learning algorithm, so that not only are the accuracy of model prediction and decision making improved, but also the path planning result is effectively corrected and optimized by constructing a residual fitting model, and the planning robustness is enhanced. According to the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster optimal path planning method, the dynamic flight state, the environmental uncertainty and the task target diversity of the unmanned aerial vehicle are comprehensively considered, and the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster optimal path planning instruction meeting the actual flight condition can be generated in real time. The method improves the task execution efficiency and the safety of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, is suitable for a plurality of fields such as military reconnaissance, disaster relief, logistics distribution and the like, and has wide application prospect and important practical value.

title_en: Offset registration method and system for disaster deformation image
abstract_en: The invention discloses an offset registration method and system for disaster deformation images, which relate to the technical field of disaster deformation monitoring and comprise the steps of obtaining images to be registered in the same place before and after disaster deformation through a plurality of platforms, dividing the images to be registered into a plurality of blocks, obtaining reference images with geographic reference information before disaster deformation, extracting characteristic points on the reference images, determining search areas in the images to be registered through the geographic reference information of the characteristic points, detecting the same name points between the reference images and each image to be registered, correcting errors of each image to be registered through the same name points, splicing the corrected images to be registered to obtain images to be registered, and performing optical offset processing on the images to be registered to obtain offsets of the images to be registered after registration. The invention overcomes the defect of insufficient data or insufficient time resolution of a single platform and improves the time and space resolution.

title_en: Disaster front movable energy storage configuration method for expressway energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pre-disaster movable energy storage configuration method for an expressway energy system, which belongs to the field of pre-disaster energy storage configuration of expressways, and comprises the steps of constructing a movable energy storage system charge-discharge model, and constructing a pre-disaster deterministic movable energy storage configuration model without considering DG output uncertainty according to the movable energy storage system charge-discharge model; based on a column constraint generation algorithm, decoupling the pre-disaster mobile energy storage two-stage robust optimal configuration model to generate a main problem model and a sub-problem model, and continuously iterating the generated main problem model and sub-problem model to obtain an optimal solution of the pre-disaster mobile energy storage configuration. The invention solves the problem of large-scale power failure of the expressway energy system caused by extreme disasters.

title_en: Multimode integrated precipitation forecasting method and system based on generalized triangular cap theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multimode integrated rainfall forecasting method and system based on a generalized triangular cap theory, which relates to the technical field of weather forecast, the method eliminates systematic deviation by acquiring multisource numerical mode data in real time, and preprocessing through spatial standardization and real-time frequency matching, and dynamically analyzing a covariance matrix of a difference sequence between modes by using a generalized triangular cap theory to quantify uncertainty, dynamically distributing weight coefficients based on the uncertainty, and finally weighting and integrating to output a standardized rainfall forecast product. The method can realize that TS score is improved by 49% -124% compared with an international advanced mode (such as ECMWF) in the rainstorm and heavy rainstorm forecast without depending on historical or live observation data, and the method shows high precision and strong adaptability in turning weather scenes such as a scarce area of a meteorological site, typhoons and fronts, and the integrated result is directly connected with a national meteorological center service platform to support real-time disaster early warning decision.

title_en: Method for evaluating wind disaster vulnerability of reversing branch tower by considering material parameter variation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wind disaster vulnerability assessment method of a reversing branch tower, which considers material parameter variation, wherein the variation rule of various structural material parameters is considered by utilizing sampling operation when wind response of the reversing branch tower is calculated, an intelligent prediction model is adopted to learn the relationship between the average value and standard deviation of wind speed and structural requirement indexes, and finally the overrun probability of a structure under a series of wind speed values is predicted, so that a comprehensive wind disaster vulnerability result which considers the variation of the structural material parameters is formed. The method provides more accurate overrun probability evaluation based on the existing wind disaster vulnerability evaluation of the power transmission tower, and considers more uncertainty risks. The invention considers uncertainty of various variation parameters in a random sampling mode, reduces calculated amount, obtains a quantized relation between wind speed and overrun probability and a relation between wind speed and various material parameters and overrun probability by adopting an intelligent prediction model, can calculate the overrun probability more quickly by adopting the intelligent prediction model under a specified wind speed, obtains a vulnerability curve or curved surface under multiple wind speeds, and greatly improves analysis efficiency.

title_en: Urban flood prediction method based on Bayesian convolutional neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city flood prediction method based on a Bayesian convolutional neural network, which comprises the steps of collecting historical rainfall events of a research area, simulating different rainfall events by using hydrodynamic simulation software to obtain the maximum submerged water depth, selecting characteristic variables which influence the submerged water depth and comprise 10 rainfall characteristic variables and 10 space characteristic variables, constructing a Bayesian convolutional neural network prediction model by considering uncertainty, training the model based on a loss function MAE, inputting verification centralized data into the trained model, and solving an average value of output approximate posterior distribution to serve as a predicted value of the water depth. The method is used for calculating and analyzing the relation between the characteristic variable and the target variable, effectively fusing different data, taking possible uncertainty sources into consideration, not only realizing the prediction of the size and the range of the submerged depth of the research area, but also quantifying the prediction uncertainty, and providing support for real-time flood disaster management.

title_en: Transformer substation enhanced resource allocation method considering uncertainty of element fault quantity
abstract_en: The invention relates to a transformer substation strengthening resource allocation method considering uncertainty of element fault quantity, which comprises the following steps of S1, dividing cognitive uncertainty of damaged quantity of a transformer substation, S2, evaluating random scene probability of the damaged quantity of different transformer substations, S3, fusing probability evaluations of different experts by utilizing an improved D-S evidence theory, and S4, respectively calculating corresponding SSDAD models through NFE C & CG according to uncertainty division of the damaged quantity of the transformer substation, so as to obtain a transformer substation strengthening resource allocation scheme enabling system load shedding loss to be minimum. The random optimization model for the enhanced resource allocation of the transformer substation can enable the system to expect the optimal transformer substation rush repair and enhanced resource allocation scheme with the minimum load loss under extreme events, and the two-stage robust optimization C & CG algorithm embedded in the network flow can improve the solving speed by several orders of magnitude, so that more time is striven for the actual deployment execution of the optimal transformer substation enhanced resource allocation scheme before disaster.

title_en: Resource collaborative elastic planning method for accounting for uncertainty of new energy under typhoon disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resource collaborative elastic planning method for accounting for uncertainty of new energy under typhoon disasters, which comprises the steps of constructing time-varying fault rate of a line through typhoon disaster disturbance and line fault rate models, identifying fragile lines, further constructing an evolution model considering linkage faults under typhoon disasters, generating a wind-light output scene through combining a mixed Copula function with multi-element normal distribution, screening out a wind-light scene set through a synchronous back-band reduction method, improving system elasticity through flexible resource collaborative planning such as wind-light photovoltaic energy storage and line reinforcement, and solving the constructed model through column and constraint generation and Big-M method to obtain a collaborative planning scheme of various flexible resources. The invention can solve the problem of safe and reliable operation of the power system caused by typhoon disasters and uncertainty of new energy output.

title_en: Electric power system scheduling method and system for uncertainty in ice disaster weather
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of preventive optimization scheduling, and discloses a power system scheduling method and system of uncertainty in ice disaster weather, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining prediction data of the ice disaster weather, calculating wind speeds at all moments of a power transmission line in a power system, and obtaining wind speed information of the line at all moments; the method comprises the steps of calculating the icing thickness of a line at each moment based on wind speed information, constructing a comprehensive load model of the line, calculating the fault rate of the power transmission line at each moment in ice disaster weather based on the comprehensive load model, constructing a line fault rate model in the ice disaster weather, constructing a power transmission line fault fuzzy set, a power transmission line fault state supporting set and a wind-light-water prediction deviation uncertain set in the ice disaster weather, and constructing a two-stage distribution robust optimization scheduling model based on the line fault rate model and the uncertain set to obtain an optimal unit start-stop and line maintenance scheme. The operation cost of the power system under the extreme weather condition is effectively reduced, and the phenomena of wind discarding, light discarding and water discarding are reduced.

title_en: Power grid equipment fault prediction method and system under extreme weather
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid equipment fault prediction method and system under extreme weather, comprising the following steps: and acquiring and preprocessing the first object data to obtain a data set. And further sampling to obtain a balanced data set according to the test set condition. And establishing a prediction fault model and outputting a prediction result. The method and the system for predicting the power grid equipment faults in extreme weather well solve the problems of low probability, few samples, nonlinearity and the like of the power grid extreme disasters, and have strong nonlinear mapping capability and learning speed for the characteristics of weather data such as multiple time spaces, multiple dimensions, multiple scales, uncertainty and the like. The method is simple and practical, is reliable in calculation, is easy to realize and deploy on the engineering site, and has strong operability and popularization and application values.

title_en: Fault detection and recovery method, system and device for distributed database and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification relates to the field of micro services and provides a fault detection and recovery method, a system, equipment and a readable storage medium of a distributed database, wherein the method comprises the steps of sending heartbeat detection data to a data master node at regular time through a cluster management node, and the regular period is configurable; and if the continuous failure times reach a preset threshold value, determining the data master node to fail and initiating master-slave switching, wherein the total fault detection time is calculated based on the continuous failure times and the timing period. By configuring fixed heartbeat detection times and detection periods, misjudgment possibly caused by network delay, jitter and other uncertainty factors between main nodes and standby nodes of the distributed database is effectively avoided, rapid fault switching in a few seconds is achieved by active detection and rapid confirmation, RTO recovery time is greatly reduced, and the disaster tolerance requirement that RTO reaches a few seconds in a partial fault scene is achieved on the basis of the existing RPO=0 and RTO <30 seconds disaster tolerance requirement.

title_en: Multi-energy collaborative optimization scheduling method and system for power grid
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid multi-energy collaborative optimization scheduling method and a system, which are used for effectively solving the uncertainty challenges of a power grid after a disaster fault by combining a condition risk value (CVaR) and an information gap theory (IGDT). The invention constructs a multi-energy collaborative optimization scheduling model based on IGDT-CVaR, takes expected outage loss and CVaR risk coefficient under multiple scenes as objective functions, and comprehensively considers constraint conditions such as node voltage, line capacity, distributed power output, energy storage system and the like. By means of data-driven model solving, the method and the system can generate an optimal scheduling plan, give consideration to economy and toughness, and improve reliability and stability of the power grid in a complex operation environment.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO;UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH

title_en: Extreme weather prediction method based on typical weather year
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of weather prediction, in particular to an extreme weather prediction method based on a typical weather year, which comprises the steps of firstly, constructing a typical weather year data set, combining ground, analysis and satellite data, and generating high-quality weather data through interpolation and fusion technologies; the method comprises the steps of generating the enhancement data of the countermeasure network, solving the problem of insufficient extreme event samples, extracting key meteorological variables through super-resolution and feature dimension reduction, constructing a deep learning model based on a convolutional neural network and a long-term and short-term memory network to conduct multi-task prediction, introducing physical constraint rules such as energy conservation and mass conservation to ensure that the prediction accords with the meteorological rules, generating confidence intervals of prediction results through an uncertainty quantization technology, and providing risk assessment and decision support information. The method improves the accuracy and the reliability of the extreme weather event prediction, and supports disaster prevention and reduction, resource scheduling, agricultural production and the like.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST

title_en: Mine rescue training simulation device and simulation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue training, in particular to a mine rescue training simulation device and a simulation method. The device comprises a departure hall, an arrival hall and a simulation system arranged between the departure hall and the arrival hall, wherein the simulation system comprises a path subsystem and a simulation unit, the path subsystem comprises a main roadway and a plurality of secondary roadways connected with the main roadway, the simulation unit comprises a simulation room, a simulation scene is arranged in the simulation room, the simulation scene can be changed according to actual needs, and each secondary roadway is communicated with a plurality of simulation rooms. The main roadway and the multiple secondary roadways are arranged to be connected with the multiple simulation rooms, simulation scenes can be changed, abundant and various rescue simulation environments and path selections are constructed, the rescue workers are prevented from forming fixed thinking and muscle memory, the capability of coping with different disaster positions and types in complex and changeable mine environments is exercised, the reality and effectiveness of training are improved, and the rescue workers are more suitable for the diversity and uncertainty of actual rescue work.

title_en: Hydraulic engineering management system based on GIS
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering and discloses a hydraulic engineering management system based on GIS, which comprises a data access and processing module, a multidimensional factor comprehensive evaluation module, a high-precision DEM generation and calibration module, a flooding simulation module, a scene setting and uncertainty analysis module, a decision support and early warning report module, a machine learning and prediction module and a real-time monitoring and updating module. According to the invention, various factors are introduced, a more accurate risk index is provided, a dynamic adjustment of risk level is supported, the inundation simulation and geological disaster prediction are more close to the actual situation through the high-precision DEM, an automatic early warning mechanism provides powerful technical support for disaster prevention and emergency management, a real-time monitoring updating module ensures rapid updating of post-disaster data, and a detailed support is provided for repairing work.
assignees: DUJIANGYAN WATER CONSERVANCY DEV CENTER OF SICHUAN PROVINCE;JIANGSU XUDIAN AUTOMATION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Rainfall slope instability probability estimation method considering climate change
abstract_en: The invention relates to a rainfall slope instability probability estimation method considering climate change, which comprises the following five steps of (I) collecting future daily rainfall data in a global climate model and performing scale reduction treatment, (II) quantifying time-varying characteristics of non-stationary rainfall variables under the influence of climate change, (III) establishing a rainfall interval-rainfall duration alternating random process update model considering climate change, (IV) analyzing vulnerability of a rainfall slope considering uncertainty of rock-soil parameters, and (V) estimating the slope instability probability based on a full probability theorem convolution rainfall disaster curve and a slope vulnerability curve in a future predefined time. Compared with the prior art, the invention provides a new rainfall slope instability probability estimation method considering climate change, realizes quantitative characterization of non-stationary rainfall caused by climate change effect, and provides an effective method for more accurate estimation of future rainfall slope instability probability.

title_en: Uncertainty-based power system restoring force evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an uncertainty-based power system restoring force evaluation method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining various data of a power system after experiencing extreme disasters, constructing an element fault rate model dynamically associated with a power system restoring decision based on the decision-dependent uncertainty, generating a power failure scene based on the obtained data and the element fault rate model by considering part of element states uncertainty, establishing an association matrix between the state uncertainty and a fault element based on a gray association theory, calculating damage confidence coefficient of the state uncertainty element, screening out a typical power failure scene by utilizing a system information entropy, constructing a multi-dimensional power system dynamic restoring force evaluation index system by combining with renewable energy output uncertainty, and calculating an evaluation index to evaluate restoring force. The invention integrates decision-dependent uncertainty, element state uncertainty and renewable energy output uncertainty, so that the evaluation result is more similar to the complexity of an actual post-disaster scene.

title_en: Low-carbon economic planning method for elastic lifting of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-carbon economic planning method for power distribution network elastic lifting, which comprises the following steps of S1, modeling for uncertainty of new energy output, S2, carrying out renewable energy scene reduction by combining clustering and an optimization algorithm based on an uncertainty model and a plurality of scenes, screening out typical scenes, S3, establishing an index system for elastic recovery strength of a power distribution network when facing accidents and carbon emission strength of the power distribution network, and S4, providing an optimal site selection, a capacity configuration model and an objective function of a distributed power supply in a distributed power network, and constructing a power distribution network fault risk model by analyzing correlation between disaster intensity distribution characteristics and power distribution network element operation risks. The self-healing capacity of the power distribution network facing risks is improved, so that the reliability of power supply is enhanced, the elasticity of the power distribution network is improved, better low-carbon economy is realized, and the supply and demand balance is better realized.
assignees: KAIFENG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Planning track generation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a planned track generation method, a planned track generation device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a state space and a self-vehicle action space; classifying predicted tracks of the side vehicles according to potential collision risks and action spaces to obtain a risk track set and a safety track set, and modeling the state space, the action space, the risk track set and the safety track set through part of observable Markov decision process to obtain a reference track. Modeling a decision-making planning process under the uncertainty of the behavior of the side vehicle as POMDP, so as to fully predict the uncertainty behavior of the side vehicle and ensure the driving safety of the self vehicle. In addition, the fact that the dimensionality of the multi-traffic-participant predicted track cluster in a complex scene is too high is considered, the POMDP model is prone to being involved in a dimensionality disaster, so that predicted tracks of the side vehicles are classified into a risk track set and a safety track set through potential collision risks, state space dimension reduction is achieved, and decision planning efficiency and decision stability are effectively improved.

title_en: Building disaster evaluation uncertainty optimization method for coupling multi-source data with random distribution
