abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source data and random distribution coupled building disaster damage assessment uncertainty optimization method which comprises the steps of collecting historical flood data of different cities and different types of buildings, meshing an assessment area, simulating and generating high-resolution water depth data of each grid unit by using a HiPIMS model, verifying and generating disaster damage data of each grid by combining remote sensing data, generalizing the cost of the different types of buildings by using building cost data in urban statistics annual authentication, assessing the building flood vulnerability based on a meshing method, and quantifying assessment uncertainty of the building flood vulnerability by using a confidence level analysis method. The method solves the problems of multi-source data fusion and accurate classification of buildings, unifies the scale difference of flood characteristics and socioeconomic data, introduces quantitative uncertainty of a confidence level analysis method, remarkably improves evaluation accuracy and reliability, and provides scientific support for urban disaster prevention and reduction, risk management and planning.

title_en: Turbine blade geometric structure uncertainty quantitative analysis system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quantitative analysis system for uncertainty of a turbine blade geometry, which comprises a CAD model building module, an uncertainty sampling module, a CFD batch calculation module, a DNN model training module, an uncertainty analysis module and a turbine performance optimization module. On one hand, the analysis system greatly improves the efficiency and stability of CFD calculation of a large number of uncertainty design sample sets, and is beneficial to promoting the application of uncertainty optimization design technology in the aspect of actual engineering. On the other hand, by means of the system, the structure of the geometric model of the turbine blade is parameterized, sampling calculation of uncertainty design can be carried out on up to dozens of parameters at the same time, and then relatively important parameters are screened on the basis of sensitivity analysis to achieve a dimension reduction target, so that the problem of dimension disaster in traditional uncertainty analysis is solved, and the accuracy and the comprehensiveness of the uncertainty analysis of the turbine blade are improved.

title_en: Method and system for predicting disaster and stability of slope in alpine mountain area by considering climate change
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of natural disaster prevention and control, and discloses a method and a system for predicting the disaster and the stability of a slope in a alpine mountain area by considering climate change, wherein the method comprises the following steps of predicting future precipitation and temperature change by combining output data of a plurality of regional climate models and global climate models and different climate situations; based on historical LULC data and climate change prediction data, predicting future LULC change by using a land change model, calculating landslide susceptibility in different future scenes by using a FSLAM model to obtain failure probability (PoF) of each grid unit, evaluating influence of climate change and LULC change on the stability of the slope by calculating PoF differences in different scenes, and carrying out uncertainty analysis on climate model, LULC prediction and model parameters to quantify the uncertainty range of a prediction result. The application can provide quantitative assessment of landslide risk in alpine regions and reliable data support for the establishment of disaster prevention and reduction measures.

title_en: Power distribution network source network load storage collaborative scheduling method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network source and network load storage collaborative scheduling method, a system, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining information of extreme disasters, historical photovoltaic and power grid parameters; the method comprises the steps of simulating probability distribution of a fault scene and initial probability distribution of output of a typical photovoltaic unit, constructing a distribution network source and load storage collaborative distribution robust optimization model considering fault states and uncertainty of photovoltaic output based on a distribution robust optimization algorithm by taking the minimum total running cost of the distribution network as an objective function and combining constraint conditions, generating a CCG algorithm by adopting columns and constraint, decomposing an original problem into main problems and sub problems, and carrying out iterative solution on the main problems and the sub problems by utilizing a commercial solver to obtain a distribution network source and load storage collaborative scheduling scheme to finish optimal scheduling of the distribution network.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID NARI NANJING CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Multi-sensor fusion environment anomaly detection method under communication limited condition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire monitoring, in particular to a multi-sensor fusion environment anomaly detection method under a communication limited condition. The sensor node is used for collecting multidimensional environmental parameters such as temperature, humidity, methane, carbon monoxide, carbon dioxide concentration and the like in real time, the multisource data are fused through a Dempster-Shafer evidence theory, the conflict and uncertainty of the sensor are solved, and the one-dimensional convolutional neural network 1DCNN classifier is used for identifying fire disaster abnormality based on the fused data. The invention adopts the edge computing technology to deploy the DSET filter and the 1DCNN classifier on the microcontroller. The method not only reduces the dependence on cloud computing, but also improves the real-time performance and the data security of the system. By local processing, the system remains efficient even in the event of network disruption or delay.

title_en: Monitoring and early warning system for geotechnical engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring and early warning system for geotechnical engineering, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning. The monitoring and early warning system for geotechnical engineering comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a model construction module and a disaster early warning module. According to the invention, the displacement and shear stress of the rock-soil body are predicted through the displacement-hydrologic-geological coupling prediction model, so that the comprehensive influence of the mechanical state and environmental factors of the rock-soil body on the rock-soil engineering disasters can be more comprehensively reflected, the coupling effect of each item of monitoring data can be comprehensively considered, the prediction error and uncertainty caused by the data loss or the single model can be effectively reduced, the hydrologic data are processed through causal convolution, the long-term dependency relationship among the hydrologic data can be effectively captured, the relevance and hysteresis between the water level, rainfall and pore water pressure can be embodied, the accuracy of model prediction can be remarkably improved, and the early warning accuracy of the monitoring and early warning system is also improved.
assignees: FUJIAN RONGQI CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Distributed resource uncertain transaction strategy considering typhoon time-space evolution
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distributed resource uncertain transaction strategy considering typhoon space-time evolution, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of S1, establishing a typhoon disaster space-time evolution model, and S2, calculating a power distribution network line time-varying fault rate and a fan time-varying fault rate based on the typhoon disaster space-time evolution model. S3, training a graph attention network based on time-varying failure rate of the nodes to obtain a power distribution network failure rate prediction model based on graph attention, obtaining an actual failure rate prediction value based on the power distribution network failure rate prediction model, S4, obtaining a wind power historical output data set, constructing an uncertainty fuzzy set based on Wasserstein distance, S5, constructing a distributed resource uncertainty trading strategy model considering typhoon time-space evolution, and solving the model to obtain a trading strategy. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of improving the prediction result of the faults of the power distribution network under typhoon conditions, further optimizing the distribution and transaction of power resources and the like.

title_en: Forestry resource space-time spectrum large model construction method oriented to forestry vertical field
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forestry resource space-time spectrum large model construction method facing the forestry vertical field, which belongs to the technical field of image data processing and comprises the steps of constructing a space-time spectrum data set of forestry resources, wherein the data set comprises spectrograms, geographic information, climate data and real fire probability maps of different time steps in a monitoring area, constructing an ST-SegNet network, comprising a SegNet encoder, a SegNet decoder, a ConvLSTM model, a feature fusion layer and a merging layer, constructing the total loss of the ST-SegNet network, and training the ST-SegNet network to obtain the forestry resource space-time spectrum large model. The invention improves the space-time consistency and classification precision of remote sensing image data, ensures higher-quality data processing, enhances the adaptability to complex scenes through space-time spectrum data fusion, improves the detail processing capability, provides a new technical path for environment monitoring and disaster response, and remarkably improves the efficiency of an emergency early warning system.

title_en: High-cold mountain area slope space-time probability prediction method considering snow cover change
abstract_en: The invention provides a space-time probability prediction method for a slope of a alpine mountain area, which considers the change of snow cover, combines a remote sensing model, a climate model and slope stability analysis, comprehensively considers the change of snow cover and the influence of the snow cover on the future climate change, and can more accurately predict the space-time probability of the slope of the alpine mountain area. The accuracy and the reliability of slope space-time probability prediction are effectively improved by accurately detecting the current snow coverage range, scientifically predicting the future snow coverage range change and reasonably determining the rainfall parameter for slope probability prediction, and more powerful support is provided for early warning and prevention and control of geological disasters. The invention considers the temperature and snowfall change under different climate change situations in the future, so that the prediction result can better adapt to the uncertainty of the climate change, and provides scientific basis for the sustainable development of the alpine mountain area.

title_en: Power distribution network toughness improving method for active and reactive power collaborative optimization under extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for improving toughness of a power distribution network through active and reactive power collaborative optimization under extreme disasters, and relates to the technical field of power system optimization scheduling. The method comprises the steps of firstly predicting renewable energy power generation and load requirements in a next time window in a first stage, optimizing control strategies of a remote control switch, a capacitor bank and energy storage charging/discharging in a long time scale, then optimizing output of a distributed resource and a static reactive compensator in a short time scale according to latest accurate prediction information and a first stage decision in a second stage so as to compensate deviation caused by uncertainty in the first stage decision, and finally, continuously rolling forward in the prediction time window along with the passage of time, and cooperatively optimizing active and reactive equipment through cooperation of the two stages to ensure that the decision is always based on the latest prediction information. The invention provides a two-stage active power distribution network scheduling strategy considering the difference of the response capacities of the equipment, and improves the recovery capacity and toughness of a power distribution system.

title_en: Wireless ad hoc network transmission management method for earthquake early warning information
abstract_en: S101, according to seismic wave data, geological structure data, historical seismic data and meteorological data, through the fusion algorithm of the multisource data, produce the predicted value of risk of comprehensive failure; S102, constructing a layered failure probability model based on the comprehensive failure risk predicted value, generating a node failure risk probability map, distributing weights of all layers according to the earthquake stage, S103, constructing a network topology, calculating the survival time of network nodes, calculating the weighted comprehensive failure probability of each network node, dynamically updating the network topology, S104, fusing the weighted comprehensive failure probability and the survival time of each network node to obtain node stable utilization characteristics, and further executing staged resource scheduling. The invention realizes the accurate prediction of the failure risk of the network node and the phased resource scheduling in the whole process of the earthquake disaster.

title_en: Dynamic cable temperature prediction and fire disaster early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting the temperature of a dynamic cable and early warning fire, which relate to the technical field of cable monitoring and comprise the steps of collecting data, constructing a BP-LSTM algorithm model and dynamically predicting the temperature change trend of the cable; and defining a temperature prediction result and a temperature rising trend as fuzzy input variables, defining a fire early-warning level as a fuzzy output variable, and carrying out cable fire early warning. The invention not only can effectively capture the long-term dependence and the periodic mode of the temperature change of the cable, but also can treat the problems of uncertainty and ambiguity in the early warning of the cable fire, reduce false alarms and provide powerful safety guarantee for the stable operation of the cable. The cable temperature change trend can be predicted by realizing remote real-time monitoring, so that early warning of cable fire is realized in an extremely early stage, and safe and stable operation of a power system is ensured.

title_en: Bridge and tunnel geological disaster monitoring method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a bridge and tunnel geological disaster monitoring method and system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring sensor data carried by the unmanned aerial vehicle; the method comprises the steps of carrying out space-time alignment and confidence weighting on three-dimensional point cloud data, image data and flight attitude data through a space-time weighted covariance fusion model to obtain fusion deformation characteristic data, inputting the data into a wavelet-Volterra series coupling prediction algorithm, carrying out nonlinear deformation prediction on key parts, outputting a future displacement prediction value, generating a geological disaster risk probability map according to the prediction value and a preset risk threshold, dynamically optimizing the flight speed, the altitude and the flight path of the unmanned aerial vehicle through a Bayesian self-adaptive flight path planning module based on the probability map, and outputting a real-time monitoring path instruction. According to the invention, through multi-mode fusion and dynamic path planning, the geological disaster monitoring precision and the unmanned aerial vehicle endurance are improved, and the method is suitable for bridge and tunnel safety protection of complex terrains.
assignees: BEIJING BRIDGE RUITONG MAINTENANCE CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Reservoir-lake-river system extreme flood simulation and flood control risk assessment method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir-lake-river system extreme flood simulation and flood control risk assessment method, system, equipment and storage medium, wherein the method firstly identifies risk source factors of historical extreme flood events, and utilizes Vine Copula functions to describe the uncertainty of spatial distribution of the risk source factors, and Latin hypercube sampling is used for generating a risk source factor sample; the method comprises the steps of firstly, carrying out a sampling analysis on a sample, then carrying out sample reduction based on a Neural Gas algorithm, constructing a risk source factor scene tree, combining historical flood data and adopting a homonymy scaling method to generate an extreme flood process line scene, then constructing a combined flood control optimization scheduling model, evaluating flood control risks of reservoirs and lakes, and analyzing evaluation effects. The invention has simple structure, accurate and stable risk assessment, is not only beneficial to the fine risk assessment of the high-incidence area of the flood disasters, but also provides theoretical support for extreme flood risk assessment in the data-deficient area.

title_en: Optimization method and device for rainfall station network, electronic equipment and computer program product
abstract_en: The application relates to a method, a device, electronic equipment and a computer program product for optimizing a rainfall station network. The method comprises the steps of selecting the site by combining uncertainty of rainfall data of each original site, the mountain torrent disaster risk level of the sub-basin where each original site is located, and information overlapping amount of each original site and the previously selected site, and stopping site selection when information gain is smaller. The scheme provided by the application can reduce redundancy and information overlapping, and can ensure the improvement of the monitoring coverage rate of a key area while improving the overall information acquisition efficiency of the station network, thereby effectively improving the monitoring and early warning capability of the mountain torrent disasters.

title_en: Mobile energy storage pre-layout and dynamic scheduling system and method for toughness improvement of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile energy storage pre-layout and dynamic scheduling system and method for improving toughness of a power distribution network, which belong to the technical field of power systems and smart grids and comprise two stages of pre-disaster pre-configuration and post-disaster cooperative scheduling, wherein a two-stage robust optimization model for fusing uncertainty of photovoltaic output is constructed in the pre-disaster stage, the configuration cost of mobile energy storage, load reduction risk and key node traffic accessibility are comprehensively considered to generate an optimal deployment scheme, and a multi-source cooperative dynamic scheduling model is constructed based on traffic network states and multi-source output characteristics in the post-disaster stage to optimize migration paths, charge-discharge strategies and charge state control of mobile energy storage in real time and minimize power supply loss of key load. The system realizes the rapid power supply recovery and safe operation in the island power grid by cooperatively controlling distributed resources such as mobile energy storage, electric vehicles, photovoltaic generators, diesel generators and the like. The invention obviously improves the quick response capability and recovery efficiency of the power distribution network under extreme disasters.

title_en: Electric power-traffic coupling charging network toughness assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating toughness of an electric power-traffic coupling charging network, and belongs to the technical field of electric power system analysis. According to the method, an electric power-traffic coupling charging network is built, a Bezier curve is combined to simulate a typhoon path and a Holland wind field model to calculate wind speed, dynamic traffic flow distribution, alternating current optimal power flow and cascading fault models are built, a Monte Carlo simulation is utilized to generate a fault data set, a dynamic Bayesian network is utilized to train a fault prediction model, a dynamic probability map is output after the actually measured wind speed is input, and dynamic toughness indexes are calculated to evaluate the toughness of the electric power-traffic coupling charging network. According to the method, the problem of fault propagation and insufficient dynamic evaluation among the systems is considered, and the toughness evaluation precision of the power-traffic coupling charging network under typhoon disasters is improved.

title_en: Method and device for determining importance degree of nodes in power supply network and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power supply networks and discloses a method, a device and electronic equipment for determining the importance of nodes in a power supply network, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a basic path set between a power supply node and a demand node in a Markov random field model; determining the length weight and the reliability weight of each path according to the length of each path in the basic path set and the importance of the nodes in each path; the importance of the nodes in the power supply network is determined based on the length weight and the reliability weight. According to the determining method, the power supply system is modeled in a probability map mode, the importance of the nodes in the power supply network is determined based on the length weighting and the reliability weighting, the problems of data acquisition, pre-disaster emergency preparation and the like can be effectively solved, relevant departments can be supported to pertinently arrange the monitoring nodes under different budget standards, and the state sensing tasks of low cost, high precision and large range of the power supply network under extreme disasters are realized.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;HEFEI INST PUBLIC SAFETY RES TSINGHUA UNIV

title_en: Pre-disaster deployment method for mobile power supply of multi-region electricity-hydrogen comprehensive energy system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pre-disaster deployment method for a mobile power supply of a multi-region electricity-hydrogen comprehensive energy system based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps of 1) establishing a pre-disaster deployment frame of the mobile power supply of the multi-region electricity-hydrogen comprehensive energy system based on regional mutual assistance in consideration of trans-regional supporting potential of the mobile power supply, 2) establishing a pre-disaster emergency response model in consideration of distributed power supply and network reconstruction cooperative scheduling based on the pre-disaster deployment frame of the mobile power supply of the multi-region electricity-hydrogen comprehensive energy system, and 3) solving the pre-disaster emergency response model in consideration of the distributed power supply and network reconstruction cooperative scheduling by utilizing a deep reinforcement learning network to obtain a pre-disaster deployment decision of the multi-region electricity-hydrogen comprehensive energy system. The method can fully consider the trans-regional supporting potential of the mobile power supply, fully describe uncertainty of multi-region faults on the premise of guaranteeing solving efficiency, and improve elasticity of the multi-region electricity-hydrogen comprehensive energy system.

title_en: High-permeability power distribution network risk identification model and system based on dynamic power flow analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of vulnerability assessment and pre-disaster risk management of power systems, in particular to a high-permeability power distribution network risk identification method based on dynamic power flow analysis. The existing vulnerability assessment method focuses on static analysis, ignores uncertainty of dynamic tide and distributed generation output, and cannot accurately identify weak links in a power distribution network. The invention provides a vulnerability assessment method based on dynamic power flow analysis. According to the method, a Latin hypercube sampling method is adopted to generate a plurality of distributed power generation output scenes, power grid tide under different weather and load conditions is simulated, and key components in a power distribution network are identified by combining tide calculation and vulnerability analysis, so that scientific basis is provided for risk assessment and emergency response before disaster. Compared with the traditional method, the method can more comprehensively consider the uncertainty of the distributed power generation output and the dynamic characteristics of the power distribution network, and improves the vulnerability identification accuracy of the power distribution network under the condition that the high-permeability renewable energy is accessed to the power distribution network. In addition, the vulnerability of the nodes and the branches in the power system is uniformly evaluated, more comprehensive and reliable technical support is provided for pre-disaster prevention and emergency response of the power grid, and important theoretical value and practical application prospect are achieved.

title_en: Geological disaster hidden trouble point distribution prediction method based on neural network integration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster hidden danger point distribution prediction method based on neural network integration, which comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining geological environment data and preprocessing, S2, constructing and training a heterogeneous model integrated by a graph convolutional neural network and a multi-layer perceptron, S3, combining residual connection and a attention mechanism to enhance the characteristic recognition capability of the model, optimizing model parameters through a cross entropy loss function, S4, evaluating the heterogeneous model through cross verification, calculating precision, mean square error and confidence level, dynamically distributing integration weight, S5, weighting and fusing the model output according to the integration weight, introducing Bayesian uncertainty estimation to generate a risk distribution probability map, S6, quantifying hidden danger point risk level, mapping into a two-dimensional space distribution map, and visualizing, S7, screening hidden danger points with the risk level higher than a threshold value, and outputting a prediction result. The invention provides a high-precision and reliable geological disaster hidden danger prediction method through an integrated neural network and a depth fusion technology.

title_en: Nerve radiation field DSM generation method constrained by two-dimensional triangular network
abstract_en: The invention provides a nerve radiation field DSM generation method based on two-dimensional triangular mesh constraint, which comprises the following steps of step 1, implicit body density and radiation field modeling, step 2, extracting density field gradient and surface normal, step 3, constructing a two-dimensional triangular mesh, step 4, realizing normal consistency constraint based on the two-dimensional triangular mesh, step 5, calculating uncertainty perception rendering loss, and step 6, performing end-to-end joint optimization. The method of the invention optimizes geometric constraint and rendering loss through end-to-end combination, reduces root mean square error of three-dimensional reconstruction compared with the traditional NeRF method, and provides a high-precision DSM generation scheme for remote sensing applications such as city planning, disaster monitoring and the like.

title_en: Intelligent identification system and method for earthquake ground surface fracture zone
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of earthquake disaster emergency monitoring, in particular to an intelligent identification system and an intelligent identification method for an earthquake ground surface fracture zone, wherein the intelligent identification system comprises modules of heterogeneous data registration, feature extraction and fusion, fracture zone segmentation, active learning, form optimization and the like, and realizes accurate processing of remote sensing data and intelligent identification of the fracture zone; the system adopts multi-scale feature point matching and self-adaptive weight registration, improves the data registration precision by more than 30%, overcomes the dependence of the traditional method on artificial experience, combines multi-scale space pyramid pooling and deformation sensitive segmentation through multi-mode feature decoupling and attention-directed feature fusion, effectively identifies fracture zones and evaluates prediction uncertainty, optimizes training data through Bayesian estimation and mixed sampling strategies by an active learning module, and finally outputs accurate fracture zone distribution and attribute information by a morphological optimization module through geological constraint and fault topological reasoning, thereby improving the intelligent level and efficiency of earthquake disaster emergency monitoring.

title_en: Dangerous rock early warning method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a dangerous rock early warning method, a system, equipment and a medium, which are characterized in that local characteristics of ground particle cloud data are extracted, global characteristics are generated by aggregating the local characteristics, dangerous rock characteristics are obtained according to the global characteristics, a dangerous rock three-dimensional model is constructed according to the dangerous rock characteristics, stability and change trend prediction are carried out according to the dangerous rock three-dimensional model, dangerous rock early warning information is obtained, the change trend can be accurately predicted by utilizing the dangerous rock three-dimensional model, the accuracy of dangerous rock early warning is improved, the uncertainty analysis of dangerous rock disaster time is met according to the dynamic expression of dangerous rock hidden danger personalized characteristics, the reliability and accuracy of dangerous rock disaster early warning are improved, and a data basis is provided for disaster prevention and reduction work of geological disasters.
assignees: GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING STATION

title_en: Elastic micro-grid networking method and system considering ice disaster disconnection uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elastic micro-grid networking method and system considering ice disaster disconnection uncertainty, and relates to the technical field of power distribution network toughness improvement, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving line outage probability and preset ice melting decisions, and generating a decision-dependent uncertainty fuzzy set between a deicing decision and line disconnection based on a dynamic coupling relation between the line outage probability and the preset ice melting decisions; the method comprises the steps of establishing a two-stage distribution robust model in advance based on a decision-dependent uncertainty fuzzy set between deicing decisions and line breaks, solving the two-stage distribution robust model based on a constraint generation algorithm and an alternative optimization method to obtain an elastic micro-grid networking result, and improving the toughness of the distribution network to ice disasters.

title_en: Unmanned cluster biology heuristic collaborative crowd-sensing method for disaster search
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned cluster biology heuristic collaborative crowd-sensing method for disaster search, which comprises the steps of firstly, designing an improved YOLOv target detection model, combining a smoke feature guiding and local relation modeling module, enhancing the smoke target recognition capability, and constructing a dynamic fire event detection and positioning mechanism through multi-source sensor information fusion. Secondly, aiming at a multi-ignition disaster scene, respectively constructing a distributed ant colony collaborative search model based on a pheromone triplet, and introducing a exploration and convergence desire function to form a real-time dynamic intelligent decision mechanism. The invention not only improves the fire identification precision and response efficiency, but also improves the coverage rate of the search area and the resource scheduling efficiency.

title_en: Mountain torrent formation disaster-causing mechanism analysis method based on pregnant disaster environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent formation disaster-causing mechanism analysis method based on a disaster-causing environment, which comprises the following steps of 1, constructing a historical mountain torrent disaster attribute set and an environmental factor set of a research area, 2, determining a mountain torrent disaster-causing environment type partition and characteristics thereof, 3, determining explanation degree and uncertainty interval of each partition environment type and environmental factors on mountain torrent disaster attribute change, 4, determining dominant environmental factors of each disaster-causing environment type partition, and 5, analyzing influence of the dominant environmental factor change on a mountain torrent formation process and a disaster-causing process. The method fully considers the space-time heterogeneity of meteorological factors, geography and socioeconomic factors of a disaster-stricken river basin, separates and quantifies the contribution and uncertainty of different environmental factors such as meteorological factors, geography and socioeconomic factors to the formation of the torrential flood, can improve the comprehensive control level of the torrential flood disaster, has strong applicability, and provides scientific basis for the control and management of the torrential flood disaster.

title_en: Geological deformation early warning method and system based on AI vision
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning and discloses a geological deformation early warning method and system based on AI vision, wherein the geological deformation early warning method based on AI vision comprises the steps of obtaining earth surface micro deformation characteristics by using an AI vision system and constructing a geological map structure network, fusing a nonlinear geomechanical equation to achieve characteristic extraction driven by physical constraints in the map neural network, creating a multidimensional map structure model representing different depth layers, achieving cross-layer information transmission through a physical information guiding type map attention mechanism, deploying the map neural network of a Bayesian probability framework to conduct geological stress field distribution modeling, quantifying prediction uncertainty, and finally generating intelligent early warning decision information with risk grade division.

title_en: Remote sensing image segmentation method based on foreground perception network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing image segmentation and discloses a remote sensing image segmentation method based on a foreground sensing network, which comprises the steps of constructing the foreground sensing network based on a coder and decoder structure and constructing a combined loss function; the method comprises the steps of training a foreground sensing network, utilizing the trained foreground sensing network to divide to obtain a class probability map of each pixel, carrying out multi-scale classification on the class probability map based on dynamic multi-resolution attention and combining environmental characteristics, dynamically adapting a post-processing strategy, and carrying out post-processing according to the adapted post-processing strategy so as to optimize a division result. According to the invention, through multi-scale feature fusion, environment self-adaptive post-processing and geographic semantic constraint, an end-to-end intelligent segmentation framework is constructed, segmentation precision, robustness and practicability in a complex remote sensing scene are remarkably improved, and an efficient solution is provided for the fields of natural resource management, disaster emergency response and the like.

title_en: Machine learning driven landslide impact building vulnerability high-efficiency probability evaluation method and product
abstract_en: The invention provides a machine learning driven landslide impact building vulnerability high-efficiency probability evaluation method and a machine learning driven landslide impact building vulnerability high-efficiency probability evaluation product, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and aims to analyze and evaluate different limit state resistance capacities of buildings with different structural forms by using nonlinearity Pushover, construct a building resistance capacity prediction dataset through multi-parameter combination simulation and train a machine learning prediction model. And analyzing the impact force of the building under the action of different landslide impact strengths by using a smooth particle flow and finite element coupling dynamic model, and constructing a mathematical calculation model of the landslide impact force based on impact force data. And (3) establishing a filling wall damage judging condition, comparing landslide impact force with building structure resistance capacity and filling wall resistance capacity, and determining the damage state of the building. And calculating probability vulnerability of the building by considering the landslide impact strength and the uncertainty of building material parameters, constructing vulnerability contour maps of the buildings with different structural forms, and providing theoretical and technical support for landslide quantitative risk evaluation disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Offshore wind power and power transmission network collaborative planning method considering typhoon disaster influence
abstract_en: The invention provides a cooperative planning method of offshore wind power and a power transmission network considering the influence of typhoon disasters, which comprises the steps of establishing a multi-scene distribution robust uncertainty set of the output of an offshore wind power plant and the faults of a power transmission line; establishing an objective function and constraint conditions of the initial model, and introducing short-term source-network-load measures into the initial model to obtain a final collaborative planning model for realizing collaborative planning of the offshore wind power and the power transmission network considering the influence of typhoon disasters. According to the invention, a multi-scene distribution robust model considering typhoon extreme disasters is established for the problem of collaborative planning of the offshore wind power and the power transmission network, multiple uncertainties of output of the offshore wind power plant and faults of the power transmission line in a normal scene and the typhoon extreme disasters are comprehensively considered, and the elasticity of a high-proportion new energy power system is improved.

title_en: Drought early warning method and device based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of data processing, and particularly provides an drought early warning method and device based on artificial intelligence, comprising the steps of collecting data of a drought early warning river basin; the method comprises the steps of constructing a deep learning model considering hydrologic process to simulate daily runoff, reconstructing long-series daily runoff data, constructing a month-scale vegetation-meteorological hydrologic drought regression model, calculating comprehensive meteorological hydrologic drought indexes, extracting drought events, constructing K artificial intelligent models, inputting meteorological hydrologic observation data into the K artificial intelligent models to simulate, adopting a Bayesian mode averaging method to calculate the weight of each artificial intelligent model, constructing a combined distribution function of drought index observation and forecast values based on Copula functions, and adopting an artificial intelligent-Bayesian coupling model to develop drought forecast. The method solves the problems of data scarcity, model uncertainty and the like in drought early warning, and provides high-precision and quantifiable decision support for water resource management, disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Wide area landslide rapid identification method based on interpretable intelligent algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wide-area landslide rapid identification method based on an interpretable intelligent algorithm, which relates to the field of remote sensing science and technology, and is characterized in that a dual-channel feature extraction architecture is constructed through multisource spatial-temporal data fusion and dynamic weighting of a knowledge map, wherein a light CNN captures local textures of images, a graph-convolution network models the geological space relevance, an interpretable contribution thermodynamic diagram and a rule chain are generated by combining SHAP values and causal reasoning, a knowledge map bidirectional verification system is introduced, a priori rule is utilized to verify space logic contradiction, a model and a rule library are triggered to co-evolve based on misjudgment samples, a multidimensional reliability report is output, the analysis granularity is customized and interpreted according to roles by Monte Carlo Dropout quantization uncertainty, and a terrain self-adaptive block-flow processing architecture is adopted, and edge light deployment and federal learning are combined to realize wide-area real-time early warning and dynamic updating of the model. The scheme breaks through the limitation of the traditional black box model, and forms a disaster prevention closed loop of physical driving, transparent decision and second-level response.

title_en: Power distribution network flexible supply and demand resource scheduling strategy considering random faults
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flexible supply and demand resource scheduling strategy of a power distribution network, which takes random faults into account, wherein S1 data acquisition is carried out, disaster parameters, power grid states and resource capacities are obtained in real time, multi-source data fusion and uncertainty quantification are carried out, a full-scene multi-source data monitoring system is constructed, S2 scene mapping is carried out, random fault scene modeling and generation are carried out based on the full-scene multi-source data monitoring system, disasters are converted into line faults and running state changes, S3 strategy generation is carried out, feasible scheduling strategies are enumerated and modeling constraints are constructed, a flexible supply and demand resource scheduling strategy library is constructed, S4 optimization solution is carried out, a robust optimization model of the random faults is established, an optimal strategy is solved according to an objective function selection algorithm, S5 feedback is carried out, issuing commands and real-time adjustment are carried out, closed-loop control is formed, dynamic closed-loop control and self-adaptive adjustment are carried out on the power distribution network, and the toughness and recovery capacity of the power distribution network in natural disasters can be improved, and the safety and reliability of power supply are ensured.
assignees: XUCHANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Post-disaster city full-coverage detection method based on heterogeneous unmanned system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-disaster city full-coverage detection method based on a heterogeneous unmanned system, which belongs to the technical field of rescue and comprises the steps of taking an unmanned aerial vehicle and an unmanned aerial vehicle as the heterogeneous unmanned system, constructing a heterogeneous unmanned system full-coverage path planning model, discretizing the heterogeneous unmanned system full-coverage path planning model to obtain a discrete optimization model of the heterogeneous unmanned system full-coverage path planning, optimizing the on-off state of path points in the discrete optimization model by adopting an improved model algorithm to obtain an optimal open point set, traversing the optimal open point set by adopting a mower algorithm to obtain a shortest full-coverage detection path, constructing a charging point dynamic adjustment mechanism, and carrying out full-coverage detection based on the shortest full-coverage detection path and the charging point dynamic adjustment mechanism. The invention effectively improves the global searching capability and convergence speed of the modular factor algorithm, designs a charging point dynamic adjustment strategy of bidirectional convergence, and effectively reduces the charging waiting time.

title_en: Method and system for generating protection strategy optimization of power generation equipment in extreme weather
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of establishing a power generation equipment defense strategy establishment model, wherein the power generation equipment defense strategy establishment model comprises a first layer model and outputting a power generator protection scheme when the cut load is minimum; the method comprises the steps of establishing a disaster attack strategy for a generator protection scheme, setting a second layer model, a third layer model, outputting generator output, load distribution and optimized line flow when expected values of load loss cut down by an attack are minimum, taking the first layer model as a main problem, combining the second layer model and the third layer model as sub-problems, solving the main problem to obtain the optimal generator protection scheme under the current attack plan set, solving the sub-problems to obtain the worst attack strategy after the given generator protection scheme, judging whether convergence conditions are met, outputting a protection strategy of power generation equipment if the convergence conditions are met, and otherwise, carrying out next iteration solution. The invention considers extreme weather effect, improves emergency response capability and capability of coping with uncertainty of the power system.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle multitasking point path planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle multi-task point path planning method which specifically comprises the following steps of starting the method, establishing an air-ground system channel model and an uncertainty model of an eavesdropper position, establishing CUAV task total completion time and communication interruption time weighted sum minimization model based on the air-ground system channel model and the uncertainty model of the eavesdropper position, discretizing CUAV task total completion time and communication interruption time weighted sum minimization model optimization problems, modeling a Markov decision process for the discretized optimization problems, and solving HT-D3QN algorithm. The path planning method combining the HRL and the T-D3QN can effectively improve the task execution efficiency and the communication safety of CUAV in a complex dynamic environment, and provides reliable technical support for application of CUAV in the fields of smart cities, emergency rescue and the like.

title_en: Geological disaster automatic identification method and system based on multi-source remote sensing data
abstract_en: The application relates to a geological disaster automatic identification method and system based on multi-source remote sensing data, belonging to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, wherein the identification method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source remote sensing data of a region to be detected and performing cross-modal registration to generate a registered multi-source data set; the method comprises the steps of carrying out multi-modal feature extraction based on a multi-source data set and carrying out space-time correlation analysis to obtain a multi-modal feature map, carrying out dynamic weight distribution on the multi-modal feature map to generate a fusion feature vector and inputting the fusion feature vector into a pre-trained geological disaster prediction model to output a geological disaster probability map, carrying out binarization segmentation on the geological disaster probability map to obtain a potential disaster area mask, and carrying out risk classification on the potential disaster area according to the geological disaster probability map and the potential disaster area mask and based on a preset joint judgment rule of the surface deformation rate and gradient features to obtain a risk class distribution map of an area to be detected. The disaster prediction method and the disaster prediction device can improve disaster prediction precision and enhance emergency response capability.
assignees: SHAANXI GEOLOGY AND MINERAL FIRST GEOLOGICAL TEAM CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent tailing dam displacement prediction and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent tailing dam displacement prediction and early warning method, which belongs to the technical field of safety prediction and early warning, and comprises the steps of obtaining online monitoring historical data of a tailing dam, preprocessing data, constructing a GRU main prediction model to predict main prediction displacement, obtaining an error sequence through actual measurement data and the main prediction displacement, decomposing the error sequence into a trend item and a noise item error sequence through PSO-VMD-TOPSIS, respectively constructing a trend item and noise item error correction model based on GRU, obtaining error correction values and standard deviations of the trend item and the noise item through MC-dropout technology, constructing a dynamic weight calculation mechanism, obtaining a final displacement prediction value and a confidence interval through combining the main prediction displacement, judging whether to alarm or not, realizing high-precision real-time prediction, uncertainty quantization and real-time early warning of the tailing dam displacement, and providing intelligent decision support for the safety state assessment and disaster early warning of the tailing dam.
assignees: UNIV SICHUAN SCI & ENG;YIBIN JIABO INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution network pre-disaster toughness improvement method considering typhoon time sequence and information physical cooperative regulation and control
abstract_en: A pre-disaster toughness improvement method for a power distribution network taking typhoon time sequence and information physical cooperative regulation into consideration includes the steps of constructing a DCPS element vulnerability model under the influence of a strong wind-storm dual-disaster-causing factor by analyzing the time sequence and uncertainty of typhoon disasters, generating a typical DPCS disaster scene set based on the DCPS element vulnerability model and combining historical typhoon disaster data, taking the information physical cooperative regulation into consideration, bringing dynamic response of the power distribution network in the typhoon disaster process into a pre-disaster toughness improvement frame, establishing a pre-disaster toughness improvement model, and solving in the generated typical DPCS disaster scene set to obtain an optimal pre-disaster toughness improvement scheme. According to the method, the time sequence of typhoon disasters and the dynamic response of the system are considered, the static assumption limitation of simplifying typhoon disasters into instantaneous uniform impact events in traditional researches is broken through, and a toughness improvement scheme which better meets the actual demands of the system is formulated.

title_en: Multi-unmanned aerial vehicle cluster formation cooperative safety control method and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle control, in particular to a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle cluster formation cooperative security control method and a system thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining brief information of a target search area and unmanned aerial vehicle information of an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster; the method comprises the steps of adopting a first analysis model to analyze brief information and unmanned aerial vehicle information to obtain an initial cooperative control strategy, controlling an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster according to the initial cooperative control strategy and obtaining monitoring information and image acquisition information of a first type formation of the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, carrying out image analysis on the image acquisition information of a disaster area to obtain state evaluation information of the disaster area, and regulating unmanned aerial vehicles and standby unmanned aerial vehicles which are executing tasks in the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster in real time according to the state of the unmanned aerial vehicles so as to complete preset tasks in a single image acquisition task. The unmanned aerial vehicle cluster power utilization system and the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster power utilization method can solve the problems that due to the fact that the scheme in the aspect of unmanned aerial vehicle cluster power utilization and distribution is small, the duration of unmanned aerial vehicle cluster formation is short, and task interruption occurs frequently due to insufficient power.

title_en: Agent index-based quick evaluation method and system for earthquake-resistant toughness of water supply pipe network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rapid evaluation method and a rapid evaluation system for earthquake-resistant toughness of a water supply pipe network based on an agent index, which belong to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of civil engineering and comprise the following steps of S1, pipe network topology modeling and information determination, S2, earthquake-resistant toughness time dimension division and index definition, S3, preparation index and agent index calculation, S4, robustness index and agent index calculation, S5, recovery index and agent index calculation, S6, adaptability index and agent index calculation, S7, monte Carlo simulation and uncertainty analysis, and S8, establishing a functional relation. The rapid evaluation method and the rapid evaluation system for the earthquake-resistant toughness of the water supply pipe network based on the agent index solve the problem of rapid evaluation of the earthquake-resistant toughness of the urban water supply pipe network and provide an effective approach for analysis and design of the earthquake-resistant toughness of the pipe network.

title_en: Intelligent linkage treatment system for fire disaster of power plant
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent linkage treatment system for a power plant fire disaster, which comprises a high-precision sensing layer, a time sequence prediction engine, a game decision system and an execution control system, wherein the high-precision sensing layer collects original data through a distributed sensor and is preprocessed into 12-dimensional feature vectors through edge computing nodes, the time sequence prediction engine takes the 12-dimensional feature vectors as input, adopts a physical constraint transducer model, embeds a heat conduction equation regularization term and outputs a fire evolution probability map, the game decision system generates an optimal evacuation path through a multi-target reinforcement learning algorithm based on the fire evolution probability map and the feature vectors and generates equipment control instructions through a three-level response mechanism, and the execution control system drives an executor to execute the control instructions through a time sensitive network and feeds back equipment states to the game decision system in real time. The invention realizes the efficient coordination and accurate response of fire monitoring, early warning, decision making and treatment by mutual linkage and dynamic adjustment of all links.
assignees: DIQIGAN INTERNET OF THINGS SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Extreme scene cascading failure modeling method considering new energy uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention relates to an extreme scene cascading failure modeling method considering new energy uncertainty, and belongs to the field of disaster simulation and early warning of electric power systems. The method comprises the steps of carrying out cascading failure simulation on a power grid in the typhoon scene, determining disconnection conditions of lines at each time point based on wind-induced failure rates of the lines at each time point in the typhoon scene and forming a wind-induced failure set, traversing the wind-induced failure set, calculating cascading failure caused by wind-induced failure at each time point based on the disconnection conditions of the lines and corresponding wind-electricity output, wherein the cascading failure comprises wind-induced failure and line disconnection failure caused by one or more thermal overloads, and determining key lines in the power grid based on the cascading failure in multiple simulation. The method provided by the invention accurately evaluates the influence of the cascading failure caused by typhoons on the power grid through the simulation of the cascading failure under typhoons by double time scales (typhoons and cascading failure time scales).
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST OF STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Rolling toughness regulation and control method for physical-information coupling power distribution system considering space-time dynamic faults
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rolling toughness regulation method of a physical-information coupling power distribution system considering space-time dynamic faults, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of S1, establishing a tree-shaped space-time dynamic fault model by considering space-time dynamic evolution characteristics of the power distribution system faults, S2, establishing a physical-information coupling power distribution system toughness regulation model considering space-time dynamic faults, S3, rolling to generate a space-time dynamic fault scene of the power distribution system and regulating the dynamic toughness. The rolling toughness regulation method for the physical-information coupling power distribution system considering the space-time dynamic faults can effectively cope with the space-time dynamic uncertainty of the faults of the power distribution system, achieves physical-information collaborative optimization, and has remarkable advantages in the disaster resistance toughness decision aspect of the power distribution system.

title_en: Surface matrix map modification data processing method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geology, in particular to a surface matrix map modification data processing method which comprises the steps of data dynamic acquisition, intelligent pretreatment, three-dimensional modeling, multi-scale nested analysis, decision deduction and dynamic visualization; compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the periodic manual acquisition and static database updating scheme is adopted, the data updating period is long, sudden environmental change is difficult to capture, the scheme adopts the multi-source data real-time access and AI dynamic cleaning scheme, the method has the advantages of real-time updating capability and automatic abnormal value correction, the earth surface matrix model can dynamically respond to environmental change, the timeliness of disaster early warning and emergency decision is remarkably improved, the deep learning fusion multi-mode data and Bayesian uncertainty quantification scheme is adopted, the method has the advantages of high-resolution three-dimensional modeling and risk area visualization, and complex geological structures can be accurately depicted and clear priority guidance is provided for manual verification.
assignees: QINGHAI GEOLOGICAL SURVEY INSTITUTE QINGHAI GEOLOGICAL MINERAL RES INSTITUTE QINGHAI GEOLOGICAL REMO

title_en: Scene modeling method based on fuzzy superposition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of scene modeling, and solves the problems of fusion distortion, uncertainty expression loss and static model self-adaptation deficiency of multi-source heterogeneous data. The method comprises the steps of uniformly processing physical sensing data and subjective description data through a differential fuzzy processing mechanism (continuous quantity is mapped by using a trapezoidal membership function and discrete quantity meaning rules), realizing data collaboration based on a space association matrix by adopting a dynamic weight superposition strategy, adding an aging attenuation factor for dynamic optimization, synchronously outputting a deterministic model frame and fuzzy boundary thermodynamic diagram during scene reconstruction, and establishing a real-time feedback closed loop optimization membership function parameter and weight strategy. The method has the innovation points that a confidence level conversion mechanism eliminates semantic distortion, an adaptive superposition operator switches operation modes according to a confidence level threshold, and three-dimensional semitransparent rendering visualizes uncertainty distribution. The multi-source fusion semantic distortion rate is reduced by 62%, the disaster early warning accuracy rate is improved by 55%, and the continuous operation accuracy attenuation rate of the model is controlled below 3%.
assignees: NANJING QIANCHENGJIAMING INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Planning method and system for improving pre-disaster variability of toughness of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a planning method and a system for improving the pre-disaster variability of the toughness of a power distribution network, belonging to the technical field of planning of the toughness improvement of the power distribution network and a traffic network. Combining historical data, constructing a fuzzy uncertainty set of partial component faults under the conditions of different reinforcement grades and disaster intensities, adopting an opportunity constraint model to carry out constraint modeling to form fault probability condition data, generating a post-disaster severe scene, carrying out maintenance team repair and cutting load scheduling, evaluating a total cost function, and judging whether a minimum total cost target is reached. The invention carries out differential planning based on the uncertainty of the multi-level fault probability and the deep coupling characteristic of the power grid and the traffic network, reduces the investment cost before disaster while improving the toughness of the network, effectively balances the relation between the improvement of the toughness and the economy, and has better applicability.

title_en: Urban underground space geothermal potential intelligent evaluation and decision-making method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban underground space geothermal potential intelligent evaluation and development decision-making method, which comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source heterogeneous data related to geothermal potential, preprocessing the multi-source heterogeneous data to obtain standardized spatio-temporal data with uniform spatio-temporal dimensions, extracting layer by layer characteristics of spatial data corresponding to each time step in the processed standardized spatio-temporal data to obtain multi-level spatial characteristic diagrams corresponding to each time step, obtaining space-time associated field characteristics by combining a bidirectional long-short term memory network and a graph convolution network, inputting physical parameters and space-time associated field characteristics in a three-dimensional geological knowledge graph constructed by unstructured data and structured data into a prediction model of a fusion physical mechanism to obtain a grading result of geothermal potential and a real-time potential index in an uncertainty interval of the grading result, the real-time potential index, the structured data, the unstructured data, the historical disaster data and a plurality of risk evaluation models to obtain a target geological disaster risk diagram, and further deducing a geothermal potential development decision.

title_en: Potential landslide movement path and accumulation state prediction method based on graphic data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a potential landslide movement path and accumulation state prediction method based on graphic data, which comprises the following steps of 1) establishing a basic numerical model, 2) generating a sample combination, 3) solving a control equation and saving a sample calculation result, 4) extracting and reconstructing channel data to form a data set, 5) training the model to an suspension condition, and 6) outputting the model to predict the landslide movement path and the final accumulation state according to given information. The method has the advantages that the method can solve the problems that landslide disasters in engineering have multiple uncertain factors, movement paths and damage ranges cannot be accurately predicted, and has a more efficient prediction analysis process for potential landslide disasters with uncertainty under the condition of ensuring accuracy.

title_en: Historical similar runoff classification recommendation method based on characteristic index identification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a characteristic index identification-based historical similar runoff classification recommendation method which comprises the steps of historical runoff process restoration, historical scene water rising process extraction, historical runoff characteristic depiction, archive construction, scene runoff process cluster analysis and Siamese network architecture-based historical similar runoff process recommendation. According to the invention, the matching efficiency of the historical similar runoffs is shortened from the small hour level to the minute level, the real-time decision of flood control dispatching is supported, meanwhile, the short-term forecast is replaced by recommending the complete historical runoff process, the uncertainty conduction risk is effectively reduced, high-confidence data support is provided for reservoir group joint dispatching and disaster emergency response, and the initiative and the scientificity of flood control disaster defense are comprehensively improved.
assignees: BUREAU OF HYDROLOGY CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION;CHINA YANGTZE POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating vulnerability of shield tunnel under water and sand gushing disaster driven by physical-data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a physical-data fusion-driven shield tunnel vulnerability evaluation method under water and sand gushing disasters, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of (1) determining information such as selected tunnel types, soil layer sections, water gushing disasters and the like, (2) establishing a substance point method-finite element method coupling model taking soil body-structure interaction into consideration under the action of the water gushing sand gushing disasters for dynamic response analysis, (3) training and optimizing a multi-layer perceptron machine learning model, establishing a multi-input-multi-output real-time prediction model, and the like. The method for evaluating the vulnerability of the shield tunnel under the water and sand gushing disaster, which is based on stratum-tunnel interaction and a soil mass catastrophe deformation mechanism, is established by combining a dynamic numerical analysis method and a machine learning prediction model, simultaneously systematically considers the rigidity of the tunnel joint, the soil mass characteristics, the uncertainty of monitoring data and the like, and can comprehensively evaluate the capability of the tunnel for resisting damage under the water and sand gushing effect.

title_en: Artificial intelligence based mountain accident risk area prediction system
title_ko: Ai 기반 산악사고 위험지역 예측 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention is configured so that the ai model predicts a mountain accident risk area by using mountain terrain spatial information and structural activity data. Accordingly, areas with a high risk of accidents are derived in advance. Moreover, the search priority is automatically generated and speed and effectiveness of the rescue activity are improved. In the ai-based mountain accident risk area prediction system 100, the data collection and purification processing unit 110 preprocesses mountain terrain precision space information and fire rescue activity information. Accident risk area prediction the ai model unit 120 generates cell-based learning data, learns the ai model, and predicts a dangerous area. The priority area is created among the accident risk area in which the search priority area recommending part(130) is anticipated based on the risk index and it recommends.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 AI 기반 산악사고 위험지역 예측 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 AI 기반 산악사고 위험지역 예측 시스템으로서, 산악지형의 정밀공간정보와 소방청 구조 활동 정보를 기초로 산악사고 위험지역 예측을 위한 데이터 수집 전처리를 수행하는 데이터 수집 및 정제 처리부; 상기 데이터 수집 및 정제 처리부의 전처리된 수집 데이터를 이용한 학습 데이터 생성과, 모델 학습, 및 사고위험 지역 예측을 수행하는 사고위험 지역 예측 AI 모델부; 및 상기 사고위험 지역 예측 AI 모델부로부터 예측된 사고위험 지역 정보에 기초하여 수색 우선순위 지역을 생성하여 추천하는 수색 우선순위 지역 추천부를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 AI 기반 산악사고 위험지역 예측 시스템에 따르면, 산악지형의 정밀공간정보와 소방청 구조 활동 정보를 기초로 산악사고 위험지역 예측을 위한 데이터 수집 전처리를 수행하는 데이터 수집 및 정제 처리부와, 데이터 수집 및 정제 처리부의 전처리된 수집 데이터를 이용한 학습 데이터 생성과, 모델 학습, 및 사고위험 지역 예측을 수행하는 사고위험 지역 예측 AI 모델부와, 사고위험 지역 예측 AI 모델부로부터 예측된 사고위험 지역 정보에 기초하여 수색 우선순위 지역을 생성하여 추천하는 수색 우선순위 지역 추천부를 포함하여 구성함으로써, 산악지형의 정밀공간정보와 소방청 구조 활동 정보를 활용하여 인공지능(AI) 기반으로 산악 사고 위험 지역을 예측할 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 AI 기반 산악사고 위험지역 예측 시스템에 따르면, 산악지형의 정밀공간정보와 소방청 구조 활동 정보를 활용하여 인공지능(AI) 기반으로 산악 사고 위험 지역을 예측할 수 있도록 함으로써, 산악 사고 위험 지역에서의 인명사고를 최소화할 수 있도록 지원하며, 특히, 실족, 낙석, 낭떠러지, 급경사, 계곡 등과 같이 등산객이 산행 중 노출될 수 있는 위험도를 예측하여 사고 예방 및 실종자 수색 지역을 추천하여 신속한 요구조자 수색 및 구조 활동을 지원할 수 있도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Power distribution network elastic lifting method and device considering typhoon space-time characteristics, storage medium and terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, a storage medium and a terminal for elastically lifting a power distribution network by considering typhoon space-time characteristics, and belongs to the technical field of elastic lifting of power distribution networks; the three-layer problem model is obtained by converting an elastic lifting model of the power distribution network, the elastic lifting model of the power distribution network is constructed according to an investment layer model and an attack uncertainty set, the attack uncertainty set is constructed according to space-time characteristics of typhoons and historical fault operation data of the power distribution network, and nodes and branches in the power distribution network are controlled according to solutions to complete elastic lifting of the power distribution network. According to the invention, the influence of the space-time characteristics of typhoons on the branch fault uncertainty of the power distribution network is simulated by utilizing the space-time characteristics of typhoons, and the system elasticity of the power distribution network to typhoons disasters is increased by combining an investment strategy and an operation strategy.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO RES INST;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent mountain torrent disaster early warning monitoring system
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of natural disaster early warning, and discloses an intelligent early warning mountain torrent disaster monitoring system which comprises a data acquisition unit, a risk prediction unit and a dynamic utility evaluation unit, wherein the data acquisition unit is used for acquiring multi-source dynamic monitoring data and static geographic data, the risk prediction unit is connected with the data acquisition unit and is used for generating probabilistic prediction of mountain torrent disaster states in a specific time window in the future based on the multi-source dynamic monitoring data and the static geographic data, and the dynamic utility evaluation unit is used for combining a preset decision maker risk preference model and a public trust dynamic evolution model to quantify the comprehensive utility of different early warning decisions under different disaster situations. By fusing the multi-element heterogeneous data and applying a hybrid prediction model of dynamic Bayesian network and Gaussian process regression, the accuracy and reliability of mountain torrent risk prediction are obviously improved. Compared with the early warning mode relying on a single data source or a simple model in the prior art, the method effectively overcomes the defect that the data is not fully utilized and uncertainty is difficult to quantify.

title_en: Wind deflection flashover probability prediction method for power transmission line based on conditional diffusion model
abstract_en: A method for predicting wind deflection flashover probability of an electric transmission line based on a conditional diffusion model relates to the field of wind deflection risk prediction of the electric transmission line, and a space-time joint probability generating frame is constructed by fusing meteorological data and line structural features so as to realize the refined prediction of the wind deflection flashover probability of the electric transmission line. The method comprises the steps of S1 obtaining meteorological data, line parameters and historical flashover data of a power transmission line, carrying out data preprocessing, S2 carrying out condition coding, diffusion processing and iterative denoising on the data based on a parameterized Markov chain, establishing a condition diffusion model, S3 completing uncertainty quantification according to hidden probability modeling, generating a confidence interval, evaluating the wind deflection flashover probability of the power transmission line, S4 constructing accuracy and uncertainty quantification evaluation indexes about model prediction results and the confidence interval, and dividing wind deflection risk grades of the power transmission line. The invention promotes the accurate prevention and control of the wind deflection flashover disaster of the power transmission line and provides technical support for constructing a novel power system safety protection system.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO RIZHAO POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Multi-mode data-driven potential disaster intelligent sensing and emergency data engineering system
