abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode data-driven potential disaster intelligent sensing and emergency data engineering system, which relates to the technical field of intelligent information processing, and comprises a super-surface communication module, a communication node and a communication node, wherein the super-surface communication module calculates phase gradients between the communication nodes by utilizing a disaster risk probability map and terrain height data to generate a beam forming matrix, performs low-power consumption non-line-of-sight data transmission, monitors link quality and feeds back communication energy consumption to generate an encrypted data packet; the system comprises a cloud coordination module, a rescue decision module and a communication power consumption data and a feedback topographic parameter, wherein the cloud coordination module decrypts the encrypted data packet and carries out three-dimensional disaster deduction to generate a disaster influence thermodynamic diagram, and the rescue decision module utilizes an improved path planning algorithm to carry out path optimization on the disaster influence thermodynamic diagram to generate an optimized rescue path, and combines the communication power consumption data and the feedback topographic parameter to generate updated communication power and redundancy configuration parameters. The invention greatly improves the reliability and the energy utilization efficiency of emergency communication and ensures the stability and redundancy of the communication link in the key area.

title_en: Damage assessment method and system for shallow foundation bridge under flood disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a damage assessment method under a shallow foundation bridge flood disaster, which comprises the steps of constructing a finite element model of the shallow foundation bridge, introducing uncertainty of flood level height, foundation flushing pit length and flushing depth by using a random Pushover method, obtaining bridge pier top yield displacement of the shallow foundation bridge under a plurality of groups of flushing working conditions, calculating first two-order moment of the structure flood fighting capability logarithm, obtaining flood fighting capability, carrying out flood fighting requirement analysis on response of the shallow foundation bridge under different flood flushing environments based on a finite element reliability method, comparing the flood fighting capability with the requirement analysis, assessing failure probability of the shallow foundation bridge under different working conditions, and fitting through a least square method to generate a vulnerability curve of the shallow foundation bridge. The damage assessment method under the flood disasters of the shallow foundation bridge can quantify the influence of multiple factors such as flow velocity, scouring depth and the like on the performance of the shallow foundation bridge, and effectively assess the damage states of all levels of the shallow foundation bridge.

title_en: Slope material identification method based on-site electrical parameters
abstract_en: The invention relates to a slope material identification method based on-site electrical parameters, which comprises the following steps of obtaining on-site slope electrical measurement data, preliminarily determining a rock-soil material boundary based on a cluster analysis K-Means algorithm, determining a slope material interface target depth through layering probability statistical analysis based on the preliminarily determined rock-soil material boundary, fitting electrical measurement parameters at the slope material interface target depth, determining a segmentation threshold value of a target slope material based on a peak value of a curve obtained through fitting, and dividing the slope material based on the segmentation threshold value. Compared with the prior art, the method considers random uncertainty generated by noise data, can eliminate interference errors caused by external environment in the electrical parameter testing process and human errors in the observing process, realizes accurate slope material identification, and provides an accurate premise for engineering geological investigation, landslide disaster investigation and the like.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG;JIANGSU ZHONGCHUANG RUIZHU ENG TESTING CO LTD

title_en: Mountain torrent early warning method and system based on meteorological data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain torrent early warning method and system based on meteorological data, and relates to the field of mountain torrent early warning; calculating the small-river-basin runoff and the surface runoff according to the characteristics of the small-river-basin torrential flood, obtaining the ratio of the flow peak value to the river basin area according to the flow peak value obtained in the process of calculating the small-river-basin runoff and carrying out early warning on the torrential flood disaster according to the ratio of the flow peak value to the river basin area. The invention improves the accuracy of the mountain torrent early warning, can effectively cope with randomness and uncertainty in the mountain torrent incident process, and reserves enough reaction time for the mountain torrent early warning.
assignees: GUOTIE CHUANZANG SCIENCE AND INNOVATION CENTER CHENGDU CO LTD;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD

title_en: Flexible resource allocation optimization method and device based on elastic planning model
abstract_en: The application discloses a flexible resource allocation optimization method and device based on an elastic planning model. An optimization objective is determined by targeting a first cost at all random failure scenarios in a set of random failure scenarios consisting of failure scenarios occurring in the power distribution network due to natural disasters (e.g., extreme weather events), a second cost of distributed power sources in the power distribution network, and a third cost compensating for interruptible loads in the power distribution network. Based on a particle swarm algorithm, combining an optimization target and a target constraint condition followed by the optimization target, carrying out iterative updating on each particle to obtain a configuration optimization scheme of flexible resources in the power distribution network, overcoming the limitation that only single flexible resources are configured and optimized in the related technology, fully utilizing the potential and synergistic effect of each flexible resource, comprehensively considering the uncertainty and the diversity of random fault scenes caused by natural disasters, and improving the adaptability and the robustness of the configuration optimization scheme, thereby improving the disaster resistance and the disaster reduction capability of the power distribution network.
assignees: XUCHANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Random finite fault seismic source model building method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for establishing a random limited fault source model, which comprises the following steps of S1, determining the geometrical morphology of a fault based on regional geological data and earthquake monitoring data, estimating non-planar fault parameters and average sliding quantity of fault surfaces by combining historical data and an empirical formula, S2, estimating the concave-convex bodies, obstacle distribution and sliding strength of the fault surfaces according to historical earthquake inversion data, obtaining sliding quantity of each sub fault through random disturbance average sliding quantity, S3, determining an initial breaking point and average breaking speed of the discrete fault surfaces as sub fault units, generating random breaking initial time conforming to normal or power law distribution based on a random number method, S4, calculating the earthquake time of each sub fault by adopting a random point source method, superposing contribution and introducing the influence of a shallow speed structure V30, and generating a three-dimensional earthquake dynamic field, S5, comparing actual strong earthquake record adjustment parameters, and outputting a multi-risk-level earthquake parameter evaluation result after iterative optimization. According to the method, the randomness and the experience data are fused, so that the simulation precision of the seismic source model on the uncertainty of the seismic process is improved, the influence of the potential maximum magnitude earthquake of the movable fracture zone in the future can be effectively estimated, the simulation precision and the calculation efficiency of the earthquake are improved, and the method is suitable for earthquake resistant design of engineering structures and earthquake disaster assessment.
assignees: JIANGXI TONGJI CONSTRUCTION PROJECT MAN CO LTD;HU YISHI

title_en: Integrated decision method and system for post-disaster emergency rescue and emergency facility site selection
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated decision-making method and system for post-disaster emergency rescue and emergency facility site selection, which comprises the steps of analyzing various costs of post-disaster emergency rescue and emergency facility site selection, namely facility point station opening cost, personnel evacuation transportation variable cost, fixed cost, material transportation variable cost and fixed cost, constructing an integrated decision-making optimization model by taking the minimum total cost as an optimization target, converting parameter uncertainty conditions in the integrated decision-making optimization model based on robust optimization, and then solving the integrated decision-making optimization model to obtain decision variables, namely the open condition of a refuge, the open condition of a medical center, the number of disaster people evacuated from a disaster point to the refuge, the number of wounded evacuated from the disaster point to the medical center, and various material amounts distributed to the refuge and the medical center by a material distribution center. According to the invention, under the condition of uncertain environment and sufficient emergency materials, the disaster relief efficiency is improved, the disaster loss is reduced, and the uncertainty and complexity of the disaster can be better dealt with.

title_en: Flood control regulation and control method and device with three-dimensional cooperation of double reservoirs and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flood control and disaster reduction, in particular to a method, a device and related equipment for controlling flood control by three-dimensional cooperation of double reservoirs, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining target total water quantity; splitting the target total water quantity to obtain underground water quantity and overground water quantity, wherein the underground water quantity is the total water quantity to be stored in a first water storage area in the target period, the overground water quantity is the total water quantity to be stored in a second water storage area in the target period, the first water storage area is composed of a plurality of underground water storage areas in the target flow area, the second water storage area is composed of a plurality of overground water storage areas in the target flow area, and the first water storage area and the second water storage area are regulated and controlled according to the underground water quantity and the overground water quantity. According to the invention, the adaptation and the robustness of flood control to future uncertainty risks can be enhanced by incorporating the underground water storage area into the flood control system, and the protection effect of the flood control system under the condition of extreme rainfall is improved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG INST OF HYDRAULICS & ESTUARY ZHEJIANG MARINE PLANNING AND DESIGN INST

title_en: Fire station location method and system based on optimal transmission theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire station site selection method and a system based on an optimal transmission theory, wherein a multidimensional urban fire-fighting demand field is constructed, a three-dimensional quantitative index system comprising fire risk core evaluation factors, space population density and traffic accessibility is established, a hierarchical planning logic of 'high risk area priority coverage → population dense area ensured response → traffic accessibility correction' is realized, fire station site selection is abstracted into a probability measure matching problem of 'rescue energy field' and 'fire-fighting demand field', wasserstein distance measurement difference is introduced, systematic balance of fire station coverage and response speed is realized by minimizing 'transportation cost' (namely fire truck response time), uncertainty factors in the site selection process are reasonably processed by introducing probability distribution description, and thus a fire station site selection allocation scheme which meets the actual fire-fighting planning requirement and can realize resource optimization configuration is prepared.

title_en: Uncertainty analysis-based power transmission line environment risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster prevention of a power transmission line, and provides a power transmission line environment risk assessment method based on uncertainty analysis, which comprises the steps of collecting impedance amplitude, phase angle and multidimensional temperature data of a wire, and constructing a multidimensional impedance data set after wavelet noise reduction, temperature compensation and normalization processing; the method comprises the steps of adopting an icing state analysis model to invert the thickness of an ice layer and fuse weather and mechanical parameters to obtain a three-dimensional risk vector, generating a five-dimensional risk parameter matrix based on the fusion time and space dimensions of the three-dimensional risk vector, constructing a risk evolution map, extracting topological critical features through a Morse complex structure and a continuous coherent method to locate high risk critical points, finally combining an NSGA-II multi-objective optimization algorithm to generate a risk index and grade early warning result with geographic coordinates, and outputting an environmental risk assessment report of a power transmission line. The icing thickness inversion precision, the risk assessment response speed and the critical point positioning capability are effectively improved, and the method is suitable for power transmission line environment risk early warning under complex terrains and extreme weather.
assignees: CHUXIONG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Landslide edge recognition method and system integrating CNN and ViT
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide edge recognition method and system fusing CNN and ViT, which belong to the field of landslide edge recognition and comprise the steps of obtaining a remote sensing image and a corresponding digital elevation model image of a landslide area, inputting the remote sensing image into the CNN, extracting a first characteristic map, inputting the digital elevation model image into ViT, extracting a second characteristic map, constructing an edge response map based on the first characteristic map, calculating a fuzzy perception map, constructing a structure expected map based on the second characteristic map, fusing the fuzzy perception map and the structure expected map pixel by pixel to form an occlusion risk thermodynamic map, fusing the occlusion risk thermodynamic map through a cross attention mechanism to generate boundary compensation characteristics, forming a fused characteristic map by the boundary compensation characteristics and the non-occlusion area characteristic map, and inputting the fused characteristic map into a decoder to generate the landslide edge probability map. The method and the device remarkably improve the accuracy of landslide boundary identification under the dust shielding condition, and can be used for the fields of primary disaster edge identification and secondary disaster emergency judgment.
assignees: CHINA ANNENG GROUP THIRD ENG BUREAU CO LTD;UNIV CHENGDU TECHNOLOGY

title_en: DRO-based energy storage collaborative emergency scheduling method under typhoon strong uncertainty
abstract_en: The DRO-based energy storage collaborative emergency scheduling method under typhoon strong uncertainty comprises the steps of S1, constructing a typhoon field model by considering uncertainty of typhoon paths and strength, S2, describing fault rates of overhead lines and towers of a power distribution network power transmission line under typhoon disasters, constructing a power distribution network power transmission line fault model, describing line fault uncertainty by utilizing moment fuzzy sets, constructing a power distribution network power transmission line fault fuzzy set, S3, constructing a DRO-based two-stage energy storage collaborative emergency scheduling model, optimizing pre-disaster layout positions of MES in a first stage, optimizing power output schemes of SES and MES in typhoon disasters in a second stage, S4, acquiring typhoon forecast information and power distribution network information, and S5, inputting the acquired information into the two-stage energy storage collaborative emergency scheduling model, and obtaining an energy storage collaborative emergency scheduling strategy under typhoon strong uncertainty based on CG and C & CG.

title_en: Rural building group flood disaster loss assessment method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of building group flood influence analysis, and provides a method and a system for evaluating the flood disaster loss of a rural building group, aiming at the problem that the accuracy of an evaluation result is low due to the fact that uncertainty factors in the loss evaluation process are not fully considered in the existing building flood loss function; comparing the submerged depth map with SAR image water body extraction data and social media data to obtain a flood simulation result, combining building classification information and the maximum submerged depth map to obtain submerged depth of each building, calculating component information of the building, analyzing building flood vulnerability according to the component information and the submerged depth to determine total loss of all buildings, and evaluating the effect of the current disaster prevention measures according to the total loss under different disaster prevention measures. The invention can provide scientific basis for building flood loss assessment and disaster prevention decision.
assignees: NO 4 ENG CORP LTD OF CR20G;UNIV XIAN ARCHITECTUR & TECH;CHINA RAILWAY 20 BUREAU GROUP CORP

title_en: Method and device for controlling cooperative voltage of regional micro-grid group based on approximate dynamic programming
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for controlling the cooperative voltage of a district micro-grid group based on approximate dynamic programming, wherein the method comprises the steps of taking the characteristic of distributed photovoltaic as an aggregation index and aggregating the distributed photovoltaic in the district micro-grid based on a community theory; and for each decision time point, establishing an evolution uncertainty of the aggregate distributed photovoltaic in the district micro-grid as a Markov model, taking current voltage deviation and future expected voltage deviation into account in each Markov state, establishing a voltage iteration optimization control model comprising an optimization control objective function and constraint conditions, designing an approximate dynamic programming algorithm, estimating a target value function by adopting a piecewise linearization approximation method and a concept of a state after decision, and carrying out iterative solution to obtain an optimal district micro-grid group collaborative voltage control strategy. The invention solves the dimension disaster problem caused by a large number of state variables and decision variables, and accelerates the solving speed.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD LIANYUNGANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: Probabilistic hierarchical fault scene generation method for electric comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a probabilistic hierarchical fault scene generation method of an electric comprehensive energy system, which relates to the technical field of comprehensive energy system optimization and comprises the following steps of firstly, considering the uncertainty of earthquake intensity, dispersing a target earthquake magnitude range into a plurality of equidistant intervals and calculating the occurrence probability of earthquakes of different earthquake magnitudes; the method comprises the steps of modeling disaster causes of earthquakes of different earthquake levels by adopting a vulnerability curve, calculating expected values of damaged elements of a power distribution system and a natural gas system, then randomly generating a fault scene under each classified earthquake level by using a Monte Carlo method, carrying out simulation on cascading faults of an electric comprehensive energy system under the random fault scene, recording the total loss load of the system, and finally calculating average loss load under each classified earthquake level, selecting a typical fault scene and forming a classified fault scene set. The method quantifies the tail risk of the low-probability extreme event and provides a scene basis for the toughness promotion strategy formulation of the comprehensive energy system.

title_en: Embedded landslide real-time early warning method based on space-time feature decoupling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an embedded landslide real-time early warning method based on space-time feature decoupling, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent monitoring and early warning of geological disasters. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical time sequence monitoring data of a landslide body, constructing a training data set, performing space-time characteristic decoupling on the data, decomposing the data into a global component and a detail component, constructing a double-branch lightweight time sequence convolution network comprising the global branch and the detail branch, completing joint training and self-adaptive weight fusion at a cloud end, performing differential lightweight processing on the trained network, deploying the trained network in an embedded terminal, performing characteristic decoupling and prediction by utilizing a real-time data stream at the embedded end, obtaining a predicted value and uncertainty estimation by combining a lightweight Monte Carlo Dropout method, and finally realizing dynamic threshold calculation and hierarchical early warning. The method effectively solves the problem that the existing method is difficult to consider the prediction precision and the calculation efficiency at the embedded terminal, and achieves real-time, accurate and self-adaptive early warning of landslide disasters.

title_en: Landslide identification method based on multi-source data and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a landslide identification method based on multi-source data and related equipment, relates to the technical field of landslide disaster identification, and solves the problem of low landslide identification accuracy. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data of an area to be identified, extracting phase stability index, polarization scattering entropy, interference coherence, topography curvature and time sequence deformation trend of the multi-source data based on multi-temporal SAR data and DEM data in the multi-source data, carrying out weighted calculation on important features in the five-dimensional features through a space-channel dual-attention mechanism to generate a first fusion feature matrix, and inputting the first fusion feature matrix into the random forest classifier to obtain a landslide probability map of the area to be identified, wherein the landslide probability map is output by the random forest classifier. According to the landslide recognition method based on the multi-dimensional feature complementation, on one hand, robustness of landslide recognition is improved through the multi-dimensional feature complementation, and on the other hand, efficiency and accuracy of a recognition algorithm are improved through selecting important features to perform corresponding recognition calculation.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: In-service bridge vulnerability analysis method considering extreme climate influence
abstract_en: The invention provides an in-service bridge vulnerability analysis method considering extreme climate influence, which comprises the steps of obtaining state data, a target extreme climate data set and historical disaster data of an in-service bridge, determining vulnerable key structural components of the in-service bridge under corresponding extreme climate according to the historical disaster data, determining a dominant failure mode, constructing an in-service bridge model containing parameter uncertainty according to the state data of the bridge, the vulnerable key structural components under the corresponding extreme climate and the dominant failure mode by adopting finite elements, inputting the target extreme climate data set into the in-service bridge model, and calculating probability distribution of bridge damage states of the key structural components at the second moment under different intensities through Monte Carlo simulation of a plurality of groups of random parameter samples to generate an extreme climate intensity-failure probability vulnerability curve. By implementing the method, the efficiency and the precision are effectively balanced, and the safety risk of the bridge under extreme weather is reduced.

title_en: Electrothermal energy network toughness improving method considering topology scene uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric heating energy network toughness improvement, and particularly discloses an electric heating energy network toughness improvement method considering uncertainty of topological scenes, comprising the following steps of 1, respectively establishing element fault probability models under different polar disasters according to space-time characteristics of different disasters; the method comprises the steps of calculating a line fault model under the action of typhoons, calculating a line fault model under the action of ice disasters, calculating a line fault model under the action of earthquakes, quantifying uncertainty and risk of a topology scene, introducing an uncertainty set of network topology scene distribution, and introducing a conditional risk value theory to describe the uncertainty of the network topology scene. According to the electrothermal energy network toughness improving method considering the uncertainty of the topological scene, CVaR is combined with the distributed robust fuzzy set of the probability of the topological scene, the risk of the uncertainty of the topological scene is quantized, and the network disaster tolerance capacity is improved.

title_en: Transfer line sequencing method considering economic and social effects of power loss load of distribution network after disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transfer line sequencing method considering economic and social effects of power loss load of a distribution network after disaster, belongs to the technical field of safety planning operation of power systems, and solves the problems that the traditional sequencing relies on manual/single indexes, is difficult to cope with fault uncertainty and lacks a standardized model. The method comprises the steps of calculating load recovery weights based on population density and unit load economic loss by using an improved analytic hierarchy process, simulating and generating a multi-fault scene by using Monte Carlo, building an optimization model by taking minimum economic and social losses as targets and combining a complex electricity means and scheduling constraint, solving the model to obtain switch operation time, and determining transfer priority by using Copride sequencing. The invention provides a scientific scheme for emergency decision of complex fault scenes, meets the requirement of rapidly making an optimal transfer strategy after disaster, and reduces economic and social losses.
assignees: UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG;ECONOMIC RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Distributed laboratory system time keeping method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a distributed laboratory system time keeping method, a distributed laboratory system time keeping device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining calibration data of a coordinated universal time tracing module and clock difference data of at least two clock guards and corresponding stability of the clock differences in a distributed laboratory system, determining local atomic time according to the clock difference data and the corresponding stability of the clock differences, judging whether the coordinated universal time tracing module operates normally or not, calibrating the local atomic time according to the calibration data if yes, obtaining standard time, otherwise, obtaining reference data of a reference clock and prediction data of a virtual coordinated universal time prediction module and corresponding uncertainty of the virtual coordinated universal time prediction module, and calibrating the local atomic time according to the reference data and the prediction data and corresponding uncertainty of the virtual coordinated universal time prediction module, and obtaining the standard time. The embodiment of the application improves the disaster recovery performance and safety of the distributed laboratory system generated in standard time.

title_en: Method and system for sensing disaster of soluble rock stratum tunnel based on multi-source information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a soluble rock stratum tunnel disaster sensing method and system based on multi-source information, which belong to the technical field of tunnel engineering safety monitoring and comprise the steps of establishing a monitoring index data set, converging the monitoring index data set to a cloud end for space-time registration to generate a multi-dimensional time sequence data field, calculating data uncertainty of each monitoring area by adopting an information entropy theory, calculating space-time evolution characteristics, carrying out classifier identification by combining spatial gradients of a deformation field to obtain a key monitoring area, adaptively adjusting sensor acquisition frequency, starting a supplementary monitoring device for encryption observation, carrying out space-time response calculation by adopting a machine learning algorithm to generate a tunnel disaster evolution prediction result, and carrying out grading threshold comparison and numerical simulation verification on the prediction result to realize effective identification and sensing of disaster evolution states. The method adopts the technical means of combining multisource data fusion, information entropy theory, machine learning and self-adaptive monitoring, and can realize dynamic, accurate and predictive sensing of the tunnel disaster evolution process.

title_en: Automatic detection and restoration discrimination method for side slope damage area based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a slope damage area automatic detection and restoration judging method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps of obtaining multi-time-phase slope monitoring data and preprocessing the multi-time-phase slope monitoring data to form multi-source input data, inputting the multi-source input data into a variant DeepLab to divide a network to generate slope damage area boundary data, carrying out time sequence analysis based on the slope damage area boundary data to generate slope damage evolution data, combining the boundary data with the evolution data, extracting areas, crack widths, displacement rates and slopes to form restoration judging parameter sets, inputting the restoration judging parameter sets into an improved multi-parameter restoration judging network to output restoration grade data, introducing an uncertainty modeling module into the network to generate restoration judging confidence coefficient data, matching restoration measure libraries according to the restoration grade data and the restoration judging confidence coefficient to generate restoration measure recommendation results and outputting a judgment report. The detection and discrimination are integrated, and the method is suitable for geological disaster monitoring and treatment.
assignees: GUANGXI ZHUANG AUTONOMOUS REGION GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING STATION

title_en: Sand liquefaction judging method based on cloud model
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of geological disaster evaluation and prevention and control, in particular to a cloud model-based sand liquefaction judging method, which mainly comprises the following steps of determining main influencing factors; the method comprises the steps of collecting and screening sand liquefaction engineering examples, classifying and grading the sand liquefaction engineering examples by adopting a l ogi st ic model, calculating cloud model digital characteristics of each factor under different levels, and calculating the certainty that each factor belongs to each liquefaction risk level based on measured values of each factor of a working point to be evaluated. The cloud model theory is applied to convert the sand liquefaction risk concept with the characteristics of ambiguity and randomness into quantitative certainty, and a novel sand liquefaction risk judging method is established. The method has the advantages of firm and reliable theoretical foundation and easy operation, reveals uncertainty rules in the process of judging the risk of liquefaction of the sand, enables the evaluation result to have more practical significance, and can provide basic basis for prevention and treatment of the geological disaster of liquefaction of the sand.
assignees: HEBEI PROVINCIAL COMMUNICATIONS PLANNING AND DESIGN INST CO LTD;TANGSHAN HIGHWAY CONSTRUCTION MAN CENTER

title_en: Two-stage toughness assessment method for electro-hydrogen comprehensive energy system under cross-region resource sharing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage toughness assessment method of an electro-hydrogen comprehensive energy system under cross-region resource sharing, which comprises the following steps of (1) establishing a two-stage toughness assessment framework of the electro-hydrogen comprehensive energy system under cross-region resource sharing based on a disaster response architecture of 'active deployment before disaster-cooperative recovery after disaster', integrating a cross-region sharing mechanism of mobile emergency resources such as embedded hydrogen energy and the like. (2) The uncertainty of multi-region fault line distribution and the trans-regional mutual potential of a mobile power supply in the electro-hydrogen integrated energy system are fully considered, and a pre-disaster trans-regional deployment method of the mobile power supply of the electro-hydrogen integrated energy system based on a SAC (Soft Actor-Critic) algorithm is provided. (3) And providing a post-disaster recovery strategy of the hydrogen comprehensive energy system under the trans-regional resource sharing by considering trans-regional supporting potential and post-disaster collaborative coordination potential of the mobile emergency resources. (4) Starting from the resistance and the restoring force of the system under extreme disasters, a multidimensional toughness evaluation index of the electro-hydrogen comprehensive energy system is established, and a Latin hypercube sampling-based toughness evaluation method of the electro-hydrogen comprehensive energy system is provided. The method fully considers the trans-regional mutual potential of the mobile emergency resources in the pre-disaster active deployment and post-disaster cooperative recovery stage, and can accurately evaluate the toughness level of the electro-hydrogen comprehensive energy system.

title_en: Network updating method for post-disaster road restoration map fused with heterogeneous disaster sensing data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of emergency management and discloses a network updating method of a post-disaster road restoration map fused with heterogeneous disaster sensing data, which comprises the steps of converting acquired heterogeneous data into basic probability distribution of observation evidence; the method comprises the steps of predicting a physical field state based on a physical process simulator, generating basic probability distribution of prediction evidence, fusing the two to obtain posterior basic probability distribution, deciding and updating a road map network state according to the posterior basic probability distribution, and feeding the updated state back to the simulator as a dynamic boundary condition to form bidirectional coupling of the physical simulation and the road map state. According to the application, by constructing the simulation assimilation framework of the bidirectional coupling, the technical problems of physical simulation and infrastructure state fracture in the traditional method are solved, the uncertainty of data is effectively processed by utilizing the evidence theory, and the authenticity of disaster evolution prediction and the reliability of road state update are improved.

title_en: Current disaster risk assessment method and system based on cascade coefficient quantification early-stage disaster influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a current disaster risk assessment method and system based on cascade coefficient quantification early-stage disaster influence, belongs to the field of disaster risk management and hydraulic engineering intersection, and is suitable for disaster risk assessment of drought, flood and the like in a river basin scale. The method aims at solving the problems that the influence of the early-stage disasters is difficult to quantify, the memory effect lacks a damping mechanism and the coverage of the evaluation scene is limited in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of obtaining early-stage disaster and current disaster data, calculating memory parameters such as soil drought depth and vegetation damage rate, constructing cascade coefficients containing coefficients of same part (enhancement), different part (uncertainty) and opposite part (weakening), correcting the cascade coefficients through an exponential/linear/power function attenuation model, and adjusting a current disaster reference risk value by combining the cascade coefficients to obtain a final risk value. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a memory parameter calculation module, a cascade coefficient construction module, a time correction module, a risk calculation module and a result output module. The invention effectively solves the quantitative problem of the influence of the early-stage disasters, remarkably improves the evaluation precision, reduces the error rate from 22% -31% to 7% -9%, can cover four typical disaster combined scenes such as drought-drought, drought-flood, flood-drought and the like, has good river basin adaptability and practicality, and provides more scientific and operable basis for the disaster prevention and reduction decision of the river basin.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;WENG BAISHA

title_en: Distribution network dynamic partition duplicate optimization method considering uncertainty resource support under typhoon extreme disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic partitioning duplicate supply optimization method of a distribution network considering uncertain resource support under typhoon extreme disasters, belongs to the technical field of partitioning duplicate supply of the distribution network, acquires dynamic fault probability under typhoon conditions by constructing a time-varying fault model of an electric element, generates a representative fault scene by using Latin hypercube sampling and spectral clustering methods, evaluates the output characteristics and damage degree of a distributed power supply such as photovoltaic wind power energy storage and the like under typhoon conditions, dynamically divides a region capable of centralizing duplicate supply and a region incapable of centralizing duplicate supply by using a depth-first search algorithm, respectively constructs a multi-objective optimization model of fault reconstruction and island duplicate supply aiming at different regions, establishes a dynamic feedback adjustment mechanism based on a load recovery rate, realizes dynamic power supply recovery of multi-source coordination in the whole process of typhoon disasters, and solves the technical problems of lack of dynamic self-adaption capability and multi-source coordination scheduling mechanism of the power distribution network duplicate supply method under typhoon disasters.

title_en: Multi-disaster power distribution network recovery method and device considering source-load uncertainty
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-disaster power distribution network recovery method and device considering source load uncertainty, a storage medium and computer equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring meteorological data under the current disaster, determining the fault probability of each line through a preset line fault probability calculation formula based on the meteorological data, and determining a fault line; the method comprises the steps of identifying a power supply region to be restored from a target power distribution network according to a fault line, determining the predicted load demand of each load node in the power supply region to be restored according to a preset load uncertainty model, determining the rigid load demand and the flexible load demand of the power supply region to be restored based on the predicted load demand, generating various predicted disaster scenes corresponding to the power supply region to be restored according to meteorological data under current disasters, constructing an objective function and constraint conditions according to the network topology of the power supply region to be restored, and solving the objective function under each predicted disaster scene to obtain a power supply restoration scheme under each predicted disaster scene.
assignees: NANNING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method, equipment and medium for analyzing instability risk of bedding slope containing weak interlayer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of engineering slope instability risk analysis, in particular to a method, equipment and medium for analyzing instability risk of a soft interlayer-containing bedding slope. According to the technical scheme, the complex and uncertain slope engineering problem is converted into a computable and inferable probability map model. The full life cycle disaster control factors from natural conditions, geological conditions, engineering design, construction and operation maintenance are systematically combed, the omission of key factors is avoided, and the comprehensiveness of risk analysis is ensured. The traditional qualitative causal analysis is upgraded to quantitative probability dependency relationship, and a mathematical model foundation is provided for subsequent risk diagnosis and prediction. The crossing of risk analysis from "static evaluation" to "dynamic reasoning" is achieved. The model not only can give a static risk value, but also can dynamically update the probability of all relevant variables after new evidence (such as monitoring data) is obtained, thereby realizing intelligent diagnosis and prediction.
assignees: SICHUAN HIGHWAY PLANNING SURVEY DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE LTD;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;UNIV SICHUAN

title_en: Toughness prevention scheduling method for hydrogen-containing comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention provides a toughness prevention scheduling method for a hydrogen-containing comprehensive energy system, which is used for performing prevention scheduling based on a preventive scheduling model constructed by a self-adaptive robust optimization framework, wherein the preventive scheduling model comprises the steps of quantifying uncertainty impact caused by natural disasters on three infrastructures of a power transmission line, a natural gas pipeline and a traffic road, integrating two scheduling measures of electric power hydrogen production and heating and hydrogen transportation, and adopting a two-stage optimization structure to generate an active resource deployment scheme before disasters occur. By building a two-stage preventive scheduling model based on self-adaptive robust optimization, the model systematically brings uncertainty damage to three key infrastructures of a power transmission line, a natural gas pipeline and a traffic road caused by natural disasters into a unified frame for the first time, and achieves the purpose of flexible resource operation scheduling in a system by introducing P2HH and HT scheduling.

title_en: Underwater target search and rescue strategy determination method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for determining an underwater target search and rescue strategy. The method comprises the steps of obtaining marine environment information of a target sea area, calculating motion characteristics of an underwater target according to the marine environment information, constructing a dynamics model, predicting a target track of the underwater target based on a Monte Carlo algorithm and combining the dynamics model, constructing a grid probability model, preliminarily determining a search strategy based on the grid probability model, dynamically updating probability distribution through Bayesian theory to optimize the search strategy, and establishing a cost-effectiveness analysis model to secondarily optimize the optimized search strategy. The uncertainty of the environment and the target motion is fully considered, and the reliability of track prediction is improved. And constructing a grid probability model, dynamically updating probability distribution and optimizing a search strategy through Bayesian theory, so that the search has pertinence and the efficiency is improved. Through optimizing the strategy secondarily, optimal allocation of resources is realized, the search and rescue effect is guaranteed, the cost is controlled, and the economical efficiency and the practicability are improved.

title_en: Slope support stability prediction method and system based on remote sensing data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing geological prediction, in particular to a method and a system for predicting the stability of side slope support based on remote sensing data, which are characterized in that a target side slope region multispectral remote sensing image is obtained, a vegetation mask is generated by utilizing a normalized vegetation index, interference pixels of a vegetation coverage region are eliminated by combining morphological filtering and connected region analysis, then the characteristics of a support structure are identified by an improved edge detection algorithm, an influence region is defined by adopting a region growing algorithm based on machine learning, the regional image is input into a convolutional neural network model, a deformation probability map is output by a data enhancement technology and a weight optimization layer, finally, a threshold value is determined according to historical data, slope support stability categories are divided by combining space neighborhood information and a voting mechanism, vegetation interference is effectively eliminated, a support structure is accurately identified, prediction precision is improved, slope support stability can be timely and accurately judged, and a reliable basis is provided for slope disaster early warning and protection.
assignees: MAOMING CITY TRANSP DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD;GUANGDONG DINGTU CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD;GUANGDONG PROVINCE COMMUNICATIONS PLANNING & DESIGN INST GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Multi-source precipitation fusion method based on context error modeling and uncertainty optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source precipitation fusion method based on Context error modeling and uncertainty optimization, which comprises the steps of preprocessing heterogeneous precipitation data, constructing an enhanced error data set containing multi-dimensional environment Context characteristics, carrying out fine modeling on joint probability distribution of the data set by using Context-Aware GMM, carrying out quantitative evaluation on condition deviation and condition variance of each data source under the current Context condition based on the Context-Aware GMM, adopting an uncertainty optimization-oriented strategy, generating optimal fusion weight, simultaneously carrying out condition deviation correction, carrying out space-time weighted fusion on the multi-source data according to dynamic weight, and generating a high-precision and high-space-time resolution precipitation grid product through spatial interpolation. The invention obviously improves the accuracy, robustness and space-time resolution of precipitation monitoring, and provides more reliable data support for refined weather forecast, disaster early warning and water resource management.

title_en: Distribution robust planning method for improving inherent and dynamic toughness of gas-electricity combined distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of planning of a gas-electricity combined system and toughness improvement, and discloses a distributed robust planning method for improving inherent and dynamic toughness of a gas-electricity combined distribution network. The method comprises the steps of establishing an objective function of an expansion planning model of a gas-electricity combined power distribution system, providing a decision-related uncertainty modeling method, representing vulnerability curves of different types of power distribution network lines and natural gas pipelines under earthquake disasters, providing inherent toughness punishment and dynamic toughness punishment concepts, modeling the model objective function, finally establishing a fuzzy set based on KL divergence to obtain a two-stage distribution robust model, carrying out investment and operation cost minimization of a basic scene in a first stage, carrying out planning decisions made in the first stage in a second stage, furthest reducing inherent toughness punishment and dynamic toughness punishment expectations, and effectively solving the two-stage distribution robust planning model through a PH algorithm-based column and constraint generation method. The invention improves the economic benefit and the toughness reinforcing effect.

title_en: Weather drought prediction method and system based on WRF model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a weather drought prediction method and system based on a WRF model, and belongs to the technical field of weather drought prediction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining driving data, constructing a WRF mode aiming at a target area, setting an initial physical parameter combination, running a model, storing a precipitation result, evaluating the precipitation deviation ratio, wet daily frequency deviation and intensity frequency ratio dimensionality, and when a preset rule is not met, performing interactive constraint through dynamic weight parameters, quantitative feedback of driving data uncertainty and physical process consistency verification optimization parameters until the optimal parameter combination is determined. Based on the global climate mode future driving data and the optimal parameter operation model, the drought assessment is completed by combining SPI index calculation. The method realizes the comprehensive improvement of prediction precision, stability, physical interpretability, optimization efficiency and scene suitability, and provides efficient and reliable technical support for drought disaster scientific management and decision.

title_en: Multi-source fusion-perceived space-world integrated geological disaster identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of artificial intelligence, and particularly relates to a multisource fusion-perceived space-earth integrated geological disaster identification method and system. The method comprises the steps of acquiring satellite images of a target area acquired by a static orbit satellite, a synthetic aperture radar satellite and a polar orbit satellite in real time, performing time interpolation and spatial super-resolution reconstruction on multi-source heterogeneous satellite image data to obtain three types of satellite images with consistent space and time and uniform resolution, synchronously inputting the three types of satellite images into a pre-trained coarse-granularity disaster recognition model to obtain a macroscopic probability map reflecting geological disaster risks, identifying a local area with high risk, then mutually matching with ground monitoring equipment, an unmanned plane and the like to obtain a complete high-resolution image, and finally inputting the high-resolution image into a pre-trained fine-granularity disaster recognition model to obtain a geological disaster recognition result. The invention solves the problems of the existing geological disaster monitoring scheme in real-time and accurate aspects.
assignees: ANHUI MINGSHENG HENGZHUO TECH CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING JIAOTONG

title_en: Digital twinning-based drainage basin intelligent flood control scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based watershed intelligent flood control scheduling method and a digital twinning-based watershed intelligent flood control scheduling system, which relate to the technical field of flood control and disaster reduction and comprise the steps of collecting static data and dynamic data of a watershed, constructing a hydrohydrodynamic coupling model based on the static data and the dynamic data to form a watershed digital twinning body, inputting a received numerical weather forecast into the watershed digital twinning body to simulate, generating various flood evolution scenes in a future period, calculating a dynamic flood risk probability map, constructing a simulation training environment by utilizing historical flood data and high-precision watershed digital twinning body, performing offline training on a scheduling strategy network in the simulation training environment based on a reinforcement learning algorithm, and outputting a scheduling strategy network with the training completion of a scheduling instruction according to a real-time watershed state. The invention effectively solves the core problems of insufficient timeliness of decision making and weak self-adaptation capability in an uncertainty environment in the traditional method.

title_en: Self-adaptive plain reservoir dam break simulation method for break position
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hydraulic engineering, discloses a method for simulating dam break of a plain reservoir with self-adaptive break position, and aims to solve the problems of low modeling efficiency, large human error, poor model reusability and the like existing in the traditional method for simulating dam break aiming at uncertainty of the break position of the plain reservoir. According to the invention, the position of the breach is decoupled from the grid profile through a predefined self-adaptive boundary and automatic matching mechanism, the single scene switching is shortened to the minute level, the manual operation error is eliminated, the simulation of the breach at any position of the box dam is supported, the efficiency, the reliability and the flexibility of dam break risk analysis of a plain reservoir are greatly improved, and a powerful technical support is provided for flood control and disaster relief emergency decision.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Post-earthquake building ruin distribution range probability prediction model and urban road network blocking vulnerability estimation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of post-earthquake building falling object accumulation range probability prediction models and urban road network blocking vulnerability estimation, and discloses post-earthquake building ruin distribution range probability prediction models and urban road network blocking vulnerability estimation methods. The building weight accumulation range prediction model provided by the invention considers various damage states of the building under the action of earthquake, including complete collapse of the building and damage of non-structural members, and can obtain posterior probability distribution of unknown parameters of the prediction model based on the Bayesian theory, thereby quantifying the cognitive uncertainty from the model parameters in the evaluation of the vulnerability of road blockage after earthquake. The method is not only beneficial to improving the accuracy of road blocking risk assessment after earthquake, but also beneficial to reasonably planning the rescue evacuation path after disaster.

title_en: Toughness index evaluation method and system for electric comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toughness index evaluation method of an electric comprehensive energy system, which comprises the steps of firstly, taking account of disaster uncertainty caused by extreme disasters to establish a typical fault scene set of the electric comprehensive energy system, secondly, taking account of dynamic and static characteristics and coupling constraints of an electric and gas heterogeneous energy flow system to establish a numerical simulation model of the electric comprehensive energy system under fault conditions, simulating cascade faults and energy supply recovery processes of the system under the typical fault scene set, and finally, drawing a multi-stage toughness curve of the system based on simulation results to establish a multi-dimensional comprehensive evaluation index system of electric-gas dependency under a toughness view. The invention also discloses a toughness index evaluation system of the electric comprehensive energy system, which can realize full-dimensional quantitative analysis of the multi-energy dependence relationship under the fault working condition and effectively screen out weak links caused by multi-energy flow strong coupling.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multi-stage gas-electricity combined distribution network coordination recovery method based on double-layer frequency verification
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of gas-electricity combined systems, and discloses a multi-stage gas-electricity combined distribution network coordination recovery method based on double-layer frequency verification, which aims at minimizing the total cost of the gas-electricity combined distribution network, considers various devices in a distribution network and a gas distribution network and coupling relations thereof, and considers maintenance personnel distribution scheduling to establish a gas-electricity combined distribution network system model; the method comprises the steps of establishing a dynamic discretization frequency standby model by considering system frequency adjustment characteristics, establishing a double-layer frequency verification calculation framework, forming a multi-stage gas-electricity combined distribution network coordination recovery model by considering unexpected characteristics of fault staged development and uncertainty of new energy power generation and load demand, and solving the multi-stage gas-electricity combined distribution network coordination recovery model by adopting an improved decomposition and nesting gradual opposite-impact algorithm. The invention can improve the capability of the gas-electricity combined distribution network to cope with extreme faults, improve the frequency standby utilization efficiency and reduce the influence and loss caused by natural disasters.

title_en: Intelligent deduction and inundation probability visualization system, method and medium for dike breach situation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of dike breach rescue and discloses an intelligent deduction and inundation probability visualization system, method and medium for dike breach. The engineering intervention deduction engine is constructed based on a physical guided nerve operator, takes a two-dimensional multi-physical reconstruction field comprising pile body positions, material distribution, flow velocity fields and terrains as input, directly outputs the water flow velocity-water depth physical field time course of a future period, the on-line self-evolution engine triggers fine adjustment of a model by comparing deviation of a deduction result and real-time monitoring data, and an uncertainty quantitative visual interface dynamically displays the deduction result in a probability inundation thermodynamic diagram mode. The invention initiates a deduction framework of fusion of physical constraint and nerve operator, solves the technical problems of low calculation efficiency of traditional numerical simulation and inconsistent physical of a pure data driving method, realizes unification of minute-level deduction speed and physical rule compliance, and provides real-time and reliable scientific decision support for levee breach rescue.

title_en: Uncertainty landslide displacement prediction method based on TCN-Attention-EWT
abstract_en: The invention discloses an uncertainty landslide displacement prediction method based on TCN-Attention-EWT, and belongs to the field of intelligent prediction of geological disasters. The method comprises the steps of obtaining slope history monitoring data and normalizing, constructing a GRU deterministic prediction model to conduct displacement prediction and generate an error sequence, decomposing the error sequence into a low-frequency system error and a high-frequency random error by adopting a TCN-Attention-EWT combined method, respectively establishing a GRU error correction sub-model with Monte Carlo Dropout, calculating probability distribution dynamic fusion weights of the low-frequency system error and the high-frequency random error correction based on an information theory, fusing a deterministic prediction value with probability distribution of the two correction values, and obtaining a final displacement prediction mean value and a prediction interval through inverse normalization. The method realizes high-precision prediction and uncertainty quantification of landslide displacement and provides reliable technical support for landslide early warning.

title_en: Urban flood disaster dynamic emergency decision method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a dynamic emergency decision method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for urban flood disasters, and relates to the technical field of emergency management and response scheduling. The method comprises the steps of constructing a random differential game model for flood disaster emergency decision, solving a game saddle point strategy through a forward-backward scanning algorithm to obtain an optimal emergency prevention and control strategy, carrying out multi-dimensional simulation verification by taking a typical flood disaster event as a sample, and finally adjusting the strategy according to a simulation result to form a target emergency prevention and control strategy and using the target emergency prevention and control strategy for actual emergency decision. The application can give consideration to space-time dynamic characteristics and random uncertainty in emergency decisions of urban flood disasters, and realize dynamic adaptation and continuous efficient decisions of disaster systems and emergency response systems.

title_en: Geological disaster emergency decision method and system based on self-adaptive generation type AI
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster emergency decision method and a system based on self-adaptive generation type AI, belonging to the technical field of geological disaster emergency response and artificial intelligence intersection, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, data acquisition and preprocessing; S2, landslide segmentation and uncertainty quantification, S3, feature extraction and uncertainty gating, S4, high confidence report Prompt construction, S5, low confidence retrieval enhancement processing, S6, final report generation and output, S7, active learning and model iteration. The geological disaster emergency decision method based on the self-adaptive generation type AI is used for realizing high-efficiency analysis, omitting emergency labeling and retraining cost, improving the reliability of a report, combining an external professional knowledge base which can be dynamically maintained, and enabling a power assisting system to self-evolve, so that the identification accuracy and robustness are continuously improved, and the low confidence coefficient target is reduced.

title_en: Multi-mode set-based method for forecasting icing thickness probability of power transmission line in complex terrain
abstract_en: A multi-mode set-based icing thickness probability forecasting method for a power transmission line in complex terrain relates to the technical field of disaster prevention, disaster reduction and weather forecasting of power systems, provides high-precision weather forecast data in complex terrain through a small micro-scale wind field forecasting mode, constructs a plurality of icing thickness forecasting models based on physical mechanisms and artificial intelligence based on the forecast data, and quantifies icing forecasting uncertainty by using the icing thickness probability forecasting method which integrates the icing thickness forecasting models into one. By the method, the accuracy and the robustness of ice coating thickness prediction under the complex terrain condition can be effectively improved, a scientific basis with certainty and probability is provided for the anti-icing and disaster reduction decision of the power grid, and therefore the risk early warning and prevention and control capability of the power grid for coping with ice disasters is enhanced.
assignees: STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Coal mine gas risk virtual deduction early warning method and system based on multi-source information fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine gas risk virtual deduction early warning method and system based on multi-source information fusion, and belongs to the technical field of gas risk early warning. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting geological, mining and environmental multisource data, carrying out preprocessing and feature extraction, fusing to construct a high-dimensional risk feature vector, then driving a virtual working face system comprising mining, ventilation and gas emission intelligent agents to evolve by the vector, adopting a Monte Carlo tree search algorithm to prospectively deduce future multistep states, calculating risk entropy of each path, finally generating a dynamic risk probability map based on the deduction result, and solving a Pareto optimal decision set considering safety, efficiency and economy through multi-objective optimization. The invention realizes the transition from passive monitoring to active early warning of gas risk, effectively solves the problem of early warning hysteresis, and provides advanced and accurate scientific decision support for gas disaster prevention and control through risk visualization and space positioning.

title_en: Beach vegetation restoration evaluation method based on image feature analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of image analysis, in particular to a beach vegetation restoration evaluation method for image feature analysis, which comprises the steps of obtaining remote sensing images of two time phases of a target beach restoration area before and after an environmental disturbance event occurs, respectively dividing the remote sensing images of the two time phases in an object-oriented manner to generate a plurality of vegetation objects, extracting morphological stability features and ecological stress resistance features of each vegetation object in the two time phases, calculating the functional toughness index of each vegetation object based on the changes of the morphological stability features and the ecological stress resistance features before and after the environmental disturbance event, and evaluating the overall effect of vegetation restoration according to the functional toughness index. The invention changes the uncertainty problem of the traditional graph selection according to the fixed time interval, so that the vegetation restoration evaluation has the advantages of event driving, accurate time phase and effective data, and provides technical support for post-disaster ecological monitoring, post-coastal engineering evaluation and the like.
assignees: FIRST INSTITUTE OF OCEANOGRAPHY MINI OF NATURAL RESOURCES

title_en: Intelligent scheduling method of new energy power system considering weather uncertainty
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of power system operation, in particular to an intelligent scheduling method of a new energy power system considering weather uncertainty, which comprises the following steps of establishing a pre-disaster early warning intelligent body model, adopting a long-period memory network, and generating an early warning signal by combining wind-light power generation power, load history and prediction data; the method comprises the steps of establishing a disaster scheduling agent model, determining a disaster thermal power unit scheduling sequence, establishing a disaster recovery agent model, correcting the disaster thermal power unit scheduling sequence, establishing a multi-agent cooperative Markov game framework, determining a reinforcement learning state value, an action value and a reward value, establishing a staged cooperative reinforcement learning method, determining multi-agent cooperative experience sharing parameters and establishing a strategy updating formula, and can effectively improve the economy and safety of a power system in extreme weather, remarkably improve the operation reliability of the power system and provide technical support for power system scheduling.

title_en: Reservoir flood forecasting system based on data driving model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent water conservancy and intelligent disaster early warning, in particular to a reservoir flood forecasting system based on a data driving model, which comprises a multidimensional data sensing center, a quality quantification unit, a dual-channel calculation unit, an entropy analysis unit, an adaptive decision unit and an adaptive decision unit, wherein the multidimensional data sensing center is used for sending water rain condition data to the quality quantification unit, the quality quantification unit is used for generating data quality scores, the dual-channel calculation unit is used for generating artificial intelligent predicted water levels and experience model predicted water levels, the entropy analysis unit is used for generating system uncertainty entropy values, the adaptive decision unit is used for generating final fusion decision water levels, the adaptive decision unit is also used for generating dynamic alarm trigger water levels, and the adaptive decision unit is further used for comparing and analyzing the final fusion decision water levels and the dynamic alarm trigger water levels to generate flood early warning signals or safe operation signals.
assignees: JIANGXI PROVINCE WATER CONSERVANCY ACADEMY JIANGXI PROVINCE DAM SAFETY MAN CENTER JIANGXI WATER RESO

title_en: Dam strong earthquake simulation system based on digital twin
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of dam safety, and discloses a dam strong earthquake simulation system based on digital twinning, which comprises a physical digital entropy flow twinning body module, a disaster source generation module, a digital twinning simulation module and a model correction module, wherein the physical digital entropy flow twinning body module is used for constructing a finite element model of a dam and dynamically coupling a material constitutive relation in the finite element model with the structural entropy, the disaster source generation module is used for generating a disaster source combination pair, the digital twinning simulation module is used for carrying out dynamic response simulation calculation on the physical digital entropy flow twinning body module, and the model correction module is used for correcting parameters of the physical digital entropy flow twinning body module. According to the application, the structural entropy is introduced to comprehensively quantify the damage, energy dissipation and information uncertainty of the material, and a dynamic coupling mechanism of the constitutive relation of the material and the structural entropy is established, so that the digital twin model is converted from a traditional static parameter model into a dynamic evolution model capable of reflecting the degradation and damage accumulation process of the material by endogenous property, and the reality and fidelity of simulation are improved.
assignees: YUNNAN HUADIAN JINSHAJIANG MIDSTREAM WATER POWER DEV CO LTD LIYUAN GENERATING BRANCH

title_en: Geological disaster early warning method and system based on multi-modal adaptive association learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster early warning method and system based on multi-mode self-adaptive association learning, and belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning. The intelligent migration and sharing of geological knowledge are realized by generating three key steps and components through cross-regional multi-modal associated learning, adaptive analysis in an evolution stage and intelligent early warning, and deeply fusing InSAR monitoring data and geological expert knowledge, the staged features in the geological disaster evolution process are adaptively captured, stable early warning performance can be maintained under different geological conditions and evolution stages, and the uncertainty influence of a single data source is reduced particularly through complementation and constraint of multi-modal information. The method can remarkably improve the accuracy and timeliness of geological disaster early warning, is particularly suitable for data scarce areas, and provides scientific basis for disaster prevention and reduction decisions.

title_en: Physical meteorological factor guidance-based generation type typhoon prediction method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of weather disaster prediction, and discloses a physical weather factor guiding-based generation typhoon prediction method, which comprises the steps of inputting typhoon history time sequence multi-attribute data, typhoon external environment weather variable data and typhoon inclination coefficient into a physical constraint coding module to obtain physical constraint preliminary characteristics; the method comprises the steps of inputting the primary physical constraint characteristics into a multi-constraint fusion alignment coding module to obtain a history multi-attribute information constraint, a typhoon external environment constraint and a typhoon internal structure constraint after fusion alignment coding, inputting standard noise, the history multi-attribute information constraint, the typhoon external environment constraint and the typhoon internal structure constraint which are consistent with the predicted attribute shape and have uncertainty higher than a threshold value into an uncertainty reduction module under the guidance of the physical constraint to obtain a predicted value of a typhoon target attribute with reduced uncertainty. The invention reduces uncertainty and realizes the movable and accurate global typhoon prediction with low calculation resource requirement.

title_en: Throat blockage emergency rescue simulation teaching method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a simulation teaching method and device for throat obstruction emergency rescue, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a replaceable airway physical model integrated with a pressure sensor, a position sensor and an airflow sensor, utilizing an airway resistance-displacement dynamic model to control airway resistance change of the replaceable airway physical model in real time, constructing a case library according to acquired real emergency cases, synchronously calling corresponding teaching guidance content in the case library when a learner operates the replaceable airway physical model, comparing learner operation data with a preset standard operation threshold, adopting a Dempster-Shafer evidence algorithm to carry out uncertainty reasoning on pressure curve stability, operation time and airway smoothness, outputting an evaluation result and an operation error report, and automatically generating a visual training report.
