According to the invention, through the replaceable airway physical model and the Dempster-Shafer evidence algorithm, the pathological and physiological changes of the laryngeal obstruction can be accurately simulated, and the fine flaws in the operation of a learner can be identified, so that the training accuracy and efficiency are obviously improved.
assignees: AFFILIATED TONGJI HOSPITAL OF TONGJI MEDICAL COLLEGE OF HUAZHONG UNIV SCI & TECH

title_en: Pre-deployment robust optimization method and system for electric bus before disaster
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pre-deployment robust optimization method and system before electric bus disaster, and belongs to the technical field of disaster prevention and reduction of electric power systems. The method comprises the steps of obtaining power grid, bus, load and disaster prediction data, adopting Monte Carlo simulation to generate a fault scene set, establishing a robust optimization model aiming at minimizing system load shedding, considering electric bus operation, dispatching, scheduling constraint and power distribution network system constraint, describing line fault uncertainty by constructing a reinforced confidence set, and adopting a C & CG decomposition algorithm solution model to obtain an optimal pre-deployment scheme. The invention effectively solves the problems of inflexible deployment and high cost of the traditional fixed energy storage in post-disaster recovery, and remarkably improves the post-disaster recovery speed and the elasticity level of the power distribution network and reduces the economic loss of power failure while ensuring normal public transportation service by utilizing the mobile energy storage characteristic of the electric public transportation.

title_en: Mine working face stress monitoring and disaster early warning system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for monitoring stress on a mine working face and early warning disasters, in particular relates to the technical field of coal mine safety monitoring, and aims to solve the problem that the reliability of disaster early warning is insufficient due to model uncertainty in the existing stress field inversion method; the method is characterized in that accurate early warning of working face dynamic disasters is realized by constructing a stress field analysis system containing uncertainty evaluation, surrounding rock strain data is obtained through an optical fiber sensing network, leading stress field distribution is obtained through inversion calculation, uncertainty transfer and amplification effects in the inversion process are analyzed, confidence intervals of stress values of all areas are calculated, the critical degree of the current stress state is evaluated by combining historical stress data, disaster early warning information is generated based on a multi-dimensional risk evaluation result, reliability of stress field analysis and accuracy of disaster early warning are effectively improved, and technical support is provided for safe production of the working face.
assignees: CHINA PINGMEI SHENMA HOLDING GROUP CO LTD;XIAN MEIKE TRANSPARENT GEOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD;INST ROCK & SOIL MECH CAS

title_en: Power transaction data reflow method based on deep learning conflict prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a deep learning conflict prediction-based power transaction data reflow method, which relates to the field of power transaction and comprises the following steps of obtaining a data change log of a disaster recovery data center station and analyzing the data change log into a structured change event, carrying out feature extraction on the structured change event to generate a multi-mode feature vector, inputting a pre-trained Bayesian conflict prediction model, outputting conflict probability and uncertainty information of each structured change event, shunting the structured change event to a quick channel or a cautious channel through a rule engine strategy, carrying out differential synchronization processing corresponding to the channel type on the shunted structured change event, and carrying out Bayesian conflict prediction model and rule engine strategy updating by combining a data reflow process monitoring result. The parallelization and self-adaptive optimization of the data reflux are realized through Bayesian conflict prediction and intelligent shunting, and the reflux efficiency and the recovery speed of the main system are improved on the premise of ensuring the data consistency.

title_en: Urban power system toughness improving method and device based on vehicle network interaction
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle-network interaction-based urban power system toughness improving method and device, which construct a two-stage random optimization model aiming at the minimum total cost of a system, cover long-term planning and operation scheduling of the urban power system in disaster scenes, improve the toughness of the urban power system in extreme weather long-term scenes, realize collaborative optimization of multidimensional costs such as power generation capacity expansion, line reinforcement, operation maintenance and load reduction, effectively reduce comprehensive cost and enhance dynamic response capability of the system. The integration channel of vehicle network interaction and urban power network toughness planning is opened, and a technical path capable of being popularized is provided for the safe, flexible and economic operation of the power system under the future climate uncertainty.

title_en: Enhanced emergency notification system
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present disclosure are directed to systems and methods for alerting user devices of anomalous behavior of user equipment (UE) within a wireless communication system. In order to alert users of natural disasters associated with the anomalous behavior and enable them to take appropriate actions such as evacuating or sheltering in place, a pattern of a number of internet of things (IoT) devices and UEs (e.g., smart phones) disconnecting from a network is detected, a cone of uncertainty (e.g., the direction that the natural disaster is likely to continue in) is inferred from that pattern, and people within the cone of uncertainty are warned that they may be in danger of an approaching natural disaster.

title_en: Disaster-resistant toughness assessment method for urban comprehensive pipe rack, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster resistant toughness assessment method, a storage medium and electronic equipment for an urban comprehensive pipe rack, and relates to the technical field of urban comprehensive pipe racks. The method comprises the steps of obtaining disaster resistance toughness classification information of the urban comprehensive pipe rack, obtaining a comprehensive influence matrix based on relative influence among factors affecting the disaster resistance toughness of the urban comprehensive pipe rack in the classification information, analyzing centrality and causality based on the comprehensive influence matrix, obtaining a target reachable matrix based on the comprehensive influence matrix, constructing a layered network model for disaster resistance toughness assessment based on the target reachable matrix and analysis results of centrality and causality, mapping the layered network model into a Bayesian network, and carrying out disaster resistance toughness assessment on the urban comprehensive pipe rack by utilizing the Bayesian network after mapping. Therefore, uncertainty caused by the fact that a single expert is relied on for judgment can be reduced, and accuracy and dynamic response capability of an evaluation result are improved.
assignees: HEFEI INST PUBLIC SAFETY RES TSINGHUA UNIV;UNIV SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CHINA

title_en: Comprehensive evaluation system of pedestrian safetiness according to inunddation flow of underground facility, and method for the same
title_ko: 지하시설의 침수흐름에 따른 보행 안전성 종합평가 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 지하철 역사, 철도시설 등의 지하시설 침수흐름에 따라 대피자의 보행 안전성 분석과 대피경로 설정 의사결정을 위한 보행 안전성 평가를 위해서 다양한 평가지표를 종합적으로 고려한 종합평가점수 산정을 통해 보행 위험구간을 판별할 수 있으며, 또한, 여러 평가지표를 종합 판단한 결과에 따라 홍수로 인한 재난상황 발생시 시설 관리자의 의사결정의 불확실성을 줄임으로써 시설 이용자의 대피 안전성을 향상시킬 수 있는, 지하시설의 침수흐름에 따른 보행 안전성 종합평가 시스템 및 그 방법이 제공된다.

title_en: Electric power system toughness assessment method based on deep learning under large-scale uncertainty scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system toughness evaluation method under a large amount of uncertainty scenes based on deep learning, which aims to solve the problem that the existing power system lacks effective evaluation on various uncertainty scenes. The toughness evaluation method of the electric power system comprises the steps of firstly, constructing a maximum wind speed intensity measurement graph of the electric power system in a target area, secondly, simulating and generating resistance distribution of a power transmission tower in the electric power system by utilizing Monte Carlo, constructing a power transmission line damage scene, simulating power transmission tower damage based on random fields, thirdly, performing recovery simulation on the power transmission tower in the electric power system based on a function loss value, determining a toughness evaluation index, fourthly, establishing a toughness evaluation proxy model of the electric power system under a large number of uncertain scenes based on deep learning, and obtaining the toughness evaluation index of the electric power system based on the trained deep learning model. The method can more accurately evaluate the damage condition of the target power network under various actual uncertain typhoon disaster situations and uncertain power transmission tower damage situations, and improves analysis efficiency.

title_en: Slope and foundation pit stability monitoring and early warning method based on remote sensing data fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and particularly relates to a slope and foundation pit stability monitoring and early warning method based on remote sensing data fusion. According to the method, deformation monitoring precision and point density are improved through the combination optimization of a multiband SAR scattering mechanism, a weighted self-adaptive adjustment model is introduced to achieve objective fusion and uncertainty quantification of deformation-weather-background factors, and a deformation-weather coupling prediction model is constructed to achieve advanced early warning and hierarchical prevention and control. The invention solves the problems of sparse midpoint, low precision and insufficient early warning reliability in the traditional monitoring, and realizes high-precision and full-coverage stability evaluation and active prevention and control.
assignees: XINJIANG ROAD AND BRIDGE CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD;UNIV XIANGTAN

title_en: Path planning method for collaborative search of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract_en: A path planning method for collaborative search of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles comprises the steps of firstly establishing an unmanned aerial vehicle kinematics model, a sensor model and an environment cognition map, updating a target existence probability and an environment uncertainty map in real time based on a Bayesian theorem, secondly establishing a model-based predictive control path decision frame, predicting a future multi-step path through rolling optimization and generating a control sequence. In the optimization solution, a double-population three-layer competition mechanism is adopted to divide individual particle populations into losers, candidates and winners, a differentiated updating strategy is adopted to balance global exploration and local utilization capacity of particles, and a feedback mechanism based on particle evolution quality is introduced to dynamically adjust the size of sub-population scale and combine cycle recombination to maintain population diversity. The method remarkably improves the solving quality of the search path planning problem based on model predictive control, ensures higher search coverage rate, and is suitable for multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative search scenes such as disaster relief, environment monitoring and the like.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning method and system based on multi-temporal remote sensing image
abstract_en: The invention provides a geological disaster early warning method and a geological disaster early warning system based on multi-temporal remote sensing images, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, and are used for collecting multi-temporal SAR images and multi-temporal multi-spectral optical images of a target area and carrying out standardized processing, carrying out super-resolution reconstruction and registration on the images after the standardized processing to generate a multi-modal remote sensing data cube, inputting the multi-modal remote sensing data cube into a pre-trained deep learning model, carrying out inversion and outputting a physical parameter map, dynamically calibrating parameters and boundary conditions of a three-dimensional geomechanical model pre-constructed for the target area based on the physical parameter map, and utilizing the dynamically calibrated three-dimensional geomechanical model to predict and generate a space-time evolution map and critical instability time, carrying out uncertainty fusion analysis on the physical parameter map, the space-time evolution map and the critical instability time, and generating dynamic hierarchical early warning information according to fusion analysis results.
assignees: EAST CHINA UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY NANCHANG CAMPUS

title_en: Power grid toughness enhancement method for cooperative response of hydrogen storage system under heterogeneous uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grid toughness enhancement method for cooperative response of a hydrogen storage system under heterogeneous uncertainty, which comprises the following steps of 1, constructing a mathematical model of a heterogeneous uncertainty set of power transmission line faults, energy output fluctuation and load change of the grid system under a typhoon scene, 2, incorporating a daily market of the power transmission line and a real-time unit combination and the mathematical model of the hydrogen storage system into the mathematical model of the heterogeneous uncertainty set in the step 1, constructing a two-stage robust optimization model, and 3, solving the two-stage robust optimization model obtained in the step 2 by combining a column and constraint generation iterative solution technology to obtain a grid toughness enhancement decision. Aiming at the problem that the existing power grid toughness enhancement strategy generally depends on only emergency means of single disaster prevention and reduction unit combination, and multi-level response is difficult to realize under extreme events, the method can flexibly coordinate resource allocation under typhoon disaster disturbance, and obviously enhance the toughness of a power system.

title_en: End cloud fusion type overspeed prevention control method for emergency rescue vehicle engine
abstract_en: The invention relates to an end cloud fusion type overspeed control method for an engine of an emergency rescue vehicle, which solves the problem that the existing vehicle running recorder only has a speed overspeed alarm function and can only be controlled manually by a driver, so that great uncertainty exists. The method comprises the steps that a real-time monitoring and measuring and calculating function is added on a vehicle-mounted controller of a vehicle, a vehicle-mounted controller operation learning and early warning algorithm model is built, real-time operation data of the vehicle speed, the rotating speed, the torque and the load power of an engine, which are collected by a sensor, are read, the vehicle-mounted controller is analyzed and prejudged through the data, a vehicle-end control system is started in a servo mode according to analysis results, a starting threshold value and data collection surface density are adjusted according to different conditions, abnormal data appear on the vehicle, the vehicle-end automatically intervenes by adopting corresponding measures, and an abnormal information alarm of the vehicle is synchronously transmitted to a cloud end to inform management personnel. The invention can effectively prevent the overspeed damage of the engine, reduce the failure rate and maintenance cost of the vehicle and prevent the overspeed of the vehicle from improving the operation safety of the vehicle.

title_en: Multi-mode joint learning tracking method and system based on attention mechanism
abstract_en: A multi-mode joint learning tracking method and system based on an attention mechanism comprises the steps of obtaining a target template area and a search area of RGB mode and infrared mode images of a fire scene, respectively carrying out blocking and embedding on the target template area and the search area of the two modes to obtain corresponding image blocks, embedding the corresponding image blocks into the target template area and the search area, combining the target template area and the search area with experience vectors to obtain feature representations of the two modes, respectively sending the feature representations corresponding to the two modes into a feature extraction network to extract corresponding feature vectors, sending the feature vectors corresponding to the two modes into a multi-mode fusion network to achieve mutual fusion of the dual-mode features, obtaining the fused robust feature representations, updating the experience vectors through fusion features, transmitting the fused feature representations to a target calibration bit, and generating a classification score graph and a boundary frame regression result of a target of the frame to be used for personnel rescue decisions.

title_en: Disaster information providing system, disaster information providing method, and disaster information providing program
abstract_en: To appropriately calculate an estimated value of a damage scale due to a disaster even when there is a missing value in a report value of the damage scale and an unexpected disaster occurs.SOLUTION: The disaster information providing system holds a report value including a missing value of a damage scale of a disaster at each of a plurality of points, adjacency information indicating an adjacency relationship between points, and a probability distribution model in which the damage scale at each point follows, and calculates an estimation value including uncertainty of a damage scale at a point having a report value that is a missing value and a parameter controlling a spatial random effect included in the probability distribution, based on the report value, a spatial random effect of each point based on the adjacency information, and the probability distribution model.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Distribution system recovery scheduling method for coping with simulation reality gaps
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power system operation optimization, and discloses a power distribution system recovery scheduling method for coping with simulation reality gaps, which is used for executing recovery scheduling by cooperating with recovery scheduling agents and comprises the following steps of constructing a multi-stage random optimization model of the power distribution system after-disaster recovery scheduling based on multi-source uncertainty in the power distribution system and multidimensional constraints of a physical layer and a management layer in a disaster scene; the method comprises the steps of designing a simulation environment for post-disaster recovery scheduling of a power distribution system comprising a state interface, an action interface and a rewarding interface based on a multi-stage random optimization model, respectively constructing a pre-disaster simulation scene set and an in-disaster simulation scene set according to the time evolution and the disclosure characteristics of multi-source uncertainty to jointly form a pre-disaster two-stage training frame, and effectively solving the problems that decision failure and increased safety risk are easily caused in a real disaster scene due to the fact that a simulation-reality gap exists in the prior art.

title_en: Mountain avalanche element characteristic ladder coupling discrimination method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain avalanche element characteristic step coupling discrimination method, and relates to the technical field of mountain disaster space intelligent evaluation. The method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a 'terrain-earth surface-weather' 12.5m resolution factor grid, then carrying out balanced sampling under an elevation-gradient double-step frame to form a 1:2 positive and negative training set, then outputting first-level posterior probability in parallel through a Platt calibrated extreme random tree and CatBoost, XGBoost ternary heterogeneous learner, splicing the first-level posterior probability with original features to form high-dimensional meta features, inputting the meta features into a 'factorizer+residual MLP' dual-channel lightweight depth network to complete secondary coupling and noise suppression, and finally enhancing and generating a 12.5m avalanche susceptibility probability map through multi-scale testing. The invention remarkably improves the accuracy and the robustness of small samples, high dimensionality and strong autocorrelation scenes while keeping the interpretability of the GIS, and can be widely applied to avalanche risk management of western communication hallways, skiing fields and national defense channels.

title_en: Typhoon disaster pre-post-disaster interconnected power distribution network recovery method based on reconfigurable soft switch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for recovering a typhoon pre-disaster post-disaster interconnection power distribution network based on a reconfigurable soft switch, which comprises the steps of considering the power supporting effect of an electric bus in a pre-disaster stage, combining the topology cooperative change of the reconfigurable soft switch and an interconnection power distribution network port to construct a pre-disaster deployment model of the electric bus, so as to determine the stop position of the electric bus before a fault occurs; in the post-disaster stage, the uncertainty of renewable energy sources and loads in continuous faults and recovery of the interconnected distribution network is considered, an event-driven recovery model is built by defining fault events and prediction error events by using an event-driven mechanism, and therefore a fault recovery strategy of the interconnected distribution network is obtained, and fault recovery of the interconnected distribution network is promoted. The invention can carry out fault deduction before disaster, reduce potential power loss load and accelerate power supply recovery after disaster, and can trigger strategy update in real time under the continuous fault state after disaster, thereby being applicable to fault evolution and uncertainty of renewable energy sources and loads.

title_en: Mountain avalanche-prone ladder-coupling element characteristic space prediction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for predicting a mountain avalanche-prone ladder-coupling element characteristic space, and relates to the technical field of mountain disaster space intelligent evaluation and risk mapping. The invention firstly builds a four-dimensional high-resolution factor grid of terrain, weather, vegetation and snow, then balances avalanche positive and negative samples by step sampling, then outputs first-level posterior probability in parallel by a Platt calibrated extreme random tree, an AdaBoost and a naive Bayesian ternary heterogeneous learner, and forms high-dimensional meta-features by splicing with the original features, inputs the meta-features into a sparse attention-light transducer dual-channel dynamic gating network to realize secondary deep coupling and noise suppression, and finally enhances and outputs an avalanche probability map with 12.5m resolution by multi-scale test.

title_en: Island sea area-oriented multi-unmanned-ship autonomous collaborative search method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned ship control and multi-agent cooperation, in particular to a multi-unmanned ship cooperation search method for island-reef sea areas, which comprises the following steps of constructing island-reef environment perception maps containing barriers and search area grids, and dividing a monitoring area into a plurality of subareas according to fixed grid scales; defining a subarea state variable, initializing a task allocation table, constructing an area allocation mechanism based on distance and state judgment, establishing a local obstacle avoidance enhanced propulsion control algorithm, synthesizing the propulsion speed of the unmanned ship by a target guiding speed and an obstacle avoidance speed, enabling the synthesized speed to meet the power constraint of the unmanned ship, setting a search completion judgment mechanism and an area state updating rule, and establishing a search task degradation scheduling mechanism. The method disclosed by the invention has the advantages of strong flexibility, definite division of labor and high autonomy, can effectively improve the searching efficiency of complex sea areas, and has wide application prospects in unmanned system formation searching, disaster emergency inspection and offshore information acquisition.

title_en: Railway tunnel multi-department collaborative emergency rescue method based on two-stage robust optimization
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-department collaborative emergency rescue method for a railway tunnel based on two-stage robust optimization, and relates to the technical field of railway rescue; according to the invention, by constructing a two-stage robust optimization model and a main problem-sub problem iterative solution algorithm, comprehensive minimization of resource preset cost and response cost under the worst accident scene is realized, and strong robustness of the rescue scheme in the face of uncertainty such as demand, passing time and the like is ensured. The method establishes an united command mechanism based on department weights, effectively coordinates actions of multiple departments such as fire fighting, medical treatment and the like, and greatly improves task cooperativity and response speed. Meanwhile, by quantifying the synergistic benefit, the remarkable advantage of the synergistic rescue compared with the independent action in shortening the rescue time is scientifically evaluated, reliable data support is provided for rescue decisions, and the efficiency, reliability and adaptability of the railway tunnel emergency rescue are improved.

title_en: Power distribution network post-disaster rush repair scheduling optimization method considering load three-phase imbalance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system rush-repair scheduling, and discloses a power distribution network post-disaster rush-repair scheduling optimization method considering load three-phase imbalance, which adopts the technical scheme that the weighting of the maximum load accumulation recovery amount and the minimum fuel cost of a mobile generator during the rush-repair of the power distribution network is adopted as a target, the three-phase unbalanced safety constraint and the wind power output uncertainty are considered, a random optimization model is built by modeling wind power output, coupling rush repair team scheduling, mobile generator scheduling and power distribution network operation constraint through a scene probability method, and a CPLEX solver is adopted to solve after linearization so as to coordinate various resources to promote the three-phase load accumulation recovery amount and ensure the operation safety of a system and equipment.

title_en: Geological disaster probability assessment method for multi-source big data fusion analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring and early warning, and discloses a geological disaster probability assessment method for multi-source big data fusion analysis. From three-dimensional coordinate system layout and multi-point sensor acquisition, to standardization, memory core construction, time sequence convolution fusion, anomaly identification, probability mapping and spatial interpolation, and to output of high risk areas. The spatial consistency of the data of each monitoring point is ensured by unifying a spatial reference system, and the dimension unification and comparability of the multi-source heterogeneous data are realized by the quality inspection and standardization of the whole-flow data. The method adopts a finite memory weight model and time sequence weighted convolution to comprehensively reflect the history accumulation effect and improve the anomaly discrimination robustness, thereby avoiding the defect of short-term data only. Probability mapping and space smoothing based on feature distance endow continuity and self-adaptability of risk expression, and scientific judgment of regional high-risk partition is realized.
assignees: NUCLEAR INDUSTRY JINHUA SURVEY AND DESIGN INST CO LTD

title_en: Uncertainty redeemable trust management method and system for disaster relief of unmanned aerial vehicle-oriented auxiliary Internet of vehicles
abstract_en: The invention discloses an uncertainty redeemable trust management method for unmanned aerial vehicle assisted Internet of vehicles disaster rescue, which comprises the steps that after disaster occurs, ground emergency communication vehicle nodes acquire disaster sensing information and generate emergency information, the emergency information is broadcasted through a V2V link, trust evidences comprising trust, uncertainty and untrustworthy three-dimensional parameters are built among the nodes according to communication behaviors, historical trust weights are dynamically adjusted through a time attenuation mechanism, evaluation timeliness is kept, dynamic reward and punishment are carried out on false message nodes based on message consistency calculation, rewards are given to real message nodes, when communication interruption or signal interference is detected, interruption probability is calculated according to a signal-to-noise ratio model, trust redemption is carried out, misjudgment is corrected, the unmanned aerial vehicle side carries out weighted fusion on multi-source trust evidences, global trust values are calculated, node grades are divided according to the uncertainty sensing ratio, and corresponding operations are carried out on the vehicle nodes according to the node grade.

title_en: Geological disaster risk assessment method and system for multi-source data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster risk assessment method and a system for multi-source data analysis, which relate to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and control, and have the advantages that the uncertainty of multi-source data is quantified by an evidence theory, the credibility weight is updated in a Bayesian mode, the data quality is adapted through a attention dynamic neural network, the credibility calibration and the parameter feedback optimization are combined, and the assessment accuracy and the robustness are improved, wherein the invention has the advantages that: the method comprises the steps of quantifying multi-source data uncertainty characteristics through an evidence theory, correcting the data source reliability weight by combining a Bayesian dynamic update mechanism, utilizing a dynamic neural network based on an attention mechanism to adaptively adjust a structure and a decision boundary according to the data uncertainty, introducing robust optimization to inhibit low-reliability data error conduction, and meanwhile, marking key influence factors through reliability interval calibration, thereby effectively solving the defects that the prior art ignores the data uncertainty, an evaluation model cannot adapt to data quality fluctuation, only outputs a single result and has no reliable basis.
assignees: JIANGSU NEW ENERGY GEOLOGICAL SURVEY BRIGADE

title_en: Energy storage power station control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy storage power station control system, relates to the technical field of energy storage control, and is used for solving the defects of the prior art in the aspects of uncertainty coping, special scene adaptation, low-carbon cooperation, heat dissipation efficiency and the like. The intelligent power distribution network power distribution system comprises an uncertainty sensing module, a multi-time-space scale response evaluation module, a cooperative control decision module and an execution regulation module, wherein the uncertainty sensing module collects power grid data under the conditions of distributed energy output, multiple loads and disasters, prediction precision is optimized through a feature extraction and multi-model fusion strategy, the multi-time-space scale response evaluation module divides the day and evaluates energy storage response capacity and generates grid load data, the integrated device comprises a multifunctional mechanism and an intelligent heat dissipation regulation mechanism, the multifunctional mechanism regulates a core module, and the intelligent heat dissipation regulation mechanism dynamically regulates the wind plate angle and the heat dissipation module region to regulate start and stop through a sliding table and worm and gear structure, so that the intelligent power distribution system is suitable for high-efficiency, reliable and low-carbon operation of a power distribution network under high-proportion new energy access.
assignees: ANHUI YINGLE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Bridge digital twin risk assessment method under extreme event
abstract_en: The invention relates to a bridge risk assessment method based on digital twinning under extreme events. Firstly, multi-source data in a short time window are collected to form a unified observation vector. The abnormal sensor is then identified and redundancy repair is performed. And then, constructing a triple calibration model, solving damage parameters, identifying a damage dynamic evolution field, constructing a full-link uncertainty propagation system, and calculating the residual bearing capacity and risk index. When the risk index or confidence interval thereof covers 1.0, a conservative traffic policy is output. And finally, generating a traffic control scheme by combining the risk indexes, and carrying out collaborative updating on multiple bridges in the area. The invention has the advantages of fault tolerance, robustness, causality interpretability, dynamic prediction, full link transparency, assessment-management closed loop and the like, can rapidly and reliably output the residual bearing capacity and traffic strategy of the bridge after an extreme event, and improves the emergency efficiency and operation safety after disaster.
assignees: GUANGXI XINFAZHAN COMMUNICATION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Power distribution system toughness assessment method and system based on medium-and-long-term disaster risk
abstract_en: The invention provides a power distribution system toughness assessment method and system based on medium-and-long-term disaster risks, which comprise the steps of obtaining disaster scenes and disaster occurrence time, establishing a disaster risk uncertainty set, carrying out risk prediction on each disaster scene based on the disaster risk uncertainty set, calculating disaster risk sampling probability, carrying out disaster scene sampling based on the disaster risk sampling probability, sampling the disaster occurrence time based on disaster occurrence time distribution probability in the disaster risk uncertainty set, calculating load loss value expectations according to the sampled disaster scenes and the sampled disaster occurrence time, and determining toughness levels considering disaster risk distribution under the condition that the load loss value expectations are converged. The method solves the problem that the existing power grid toughness assessment resource consumption based on disaster risk is high.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for enabling decision-making of flood storage area based on group intelligent optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a decision-making method, a system, equipment and a medium for enabling a flood storage area based on a group intelligent optimization algorithm, which comprise a multi-source data integration architecture, wherein hydrologic engineering, space geography and historical case data are collected, and after clipping, outlier processing and standardization, structured data with uniform time scale are formed; an uncertainty scene generation architecture for flood scene pre-judgment. Based on the LSTM deep learning model, outputting flood evolution trend and uncertainty interval, automatically generating multi-class disturbance scenes of flood peak flow, peak time and downstream risk level, and using a group intelligent optimization decision framework for solving an optimal scheme. Traversing all scenes through a north sea parrot optimization algorithm, minimizing the total flood diversion cost under the conditions of hard constraint and soft constraint, and dynamically and iteratively outputting flood diversion critical points and an optimal starting scheme. The dynamic adaptability and decision robustness of the invention are obviously improved, the multi-objective balance and the service floor property are considered, and the flood control risk and the disaster loss are effectively reduced.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER;HENAN SHIMANTAN RESERVOIR OPERATION CENTER

title_en: Transient electromagnetic and seismic wave multi-mode joint inversion imaging method based on physical information transducer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a transient electromagnetic and seismic wave multi-modal joint inversion imaging method based on physical information transducer, belonging to the field of geophysical exploration and artificial intelligence intersection. The method comprises the steps of performing anomaly detection, interpolation, filtering and normalization preprocessing on transient electromagnetic and seismic wave original data, extracting characteristics representing electrical property, elasticity and cross physical significance, serializing space data through a meshing and alternating fusion strategy, constructing enhanced codes fusing absolute, relative positions and physical properties, designing a physically constrained encoder-decoder architecture to perform multi-scale forward modeling-inversion, and quantifying uncertainty of inversion results by adopting a Bayesian Monte Carlo method to generate a confidence map. According to the invention, through the physical rule driving and multi-mode depth complementation fusion, the fine recognition capability and interpretation reliability of hidden disaster-causing geologic bodies such as underground goafs and collapse columns are effectively improved while the physical consistency of data is maintained.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;UNIV KUNMING SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY;CHONGQING HUIKAN INDUSTRIAL TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Index construction method for representing sensitivity of multidimensional joint probability model
abstract_en: The invention relates to an index construction method for representing sensitivity of a multi-dimensional joint probability model, which comprises the following steps of carrying out generalized extremum distribution edge fitting on each univariate sample, calculating first-meeting extremum of T years under different reproduction periods according to edge distribution, converting the samples into standard probability space of [0,1], constructing a three-dimensional joint probability model, generating three-dimensional environment equivalent surfaces under different reproduction periods by adopting an inverse first-order reliability method based on each three-dimensional joint probability model, obtaining joint extreme load combinations, and constructing a composite disaster index based on the univariate extremum and the joint load combinations. The method can solve the problem of obvious uncertainty of the existing multi-dimensional joint probability model in the process of estimating the load of the extreme ocean environment, and overcomes the defect that the unified sensitivity evaluation index is lacking among different models. Providing a stable and reliable basis for selecting the environmental load of structures such as offshore wind power, ocean oil and gas platforms and the like.

title_en: Real-time early warning system and method for disaster of coal mine tunnel roof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine safety monitoring, and discloses a real-time early warning system and method for a coal mine roadway roof disaster, wherein the real-time early warning system and method comprises the steps of carrying out time sequence reasoning on monitoring data acquired in real time, respectively judging whether a roof key physical quantity triggers primary early warning or secondary early warning by acquiring an expected value prediction curve and an uncertainty boundary curve of the roof key physical quantity in a future time step, acquiring corresponding early warning information when the early warning is triggered, constructing a dynamic causal graph, inputting the early warning information and the currently acquired key physical quantity into the dynamic causal graph to carry out reasoning, calling candidate intervention measures based on the acquired current state node to carry out anti-fact reasoning in the dynamic causal graph, acquiring a risk track and a risk inhibition efficacy index of the candidate intervention measures, sequencing and preferring the risk inhibition efficacy index, and outputting a causal early warning report containing an optimal intervention scheme, thereby improving the scientificity and effectiveness of the risk inhibition.
assignees: JINING MINING IND GROUP CO LTD XIAOYUN COAL MINE

title_en: Port supply chain service-oriented proprietary cloud multi-stage migration rollback control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a proprietary cloud multi-stage migration rollback control system for port supply chain service, which relates to the technical field of proprietary cloud migration and aims to solve the problems of complexity and uncertainty of rollback decisions in a cloud platform multi-stage migration process, wherein service influence levels and recovery cost levels are obtained based on service system importance mapping and affected system sets, a finite state machine is driven by taking migration state tuples, fault levels, data consistency gears and service influence levels as inputs, the system automatically decides to rollback to stage 0 when specific conditions are met within one week after stage 2 cutting, and automatically prohibits to return to stage 0 after exceeding a window or old platform is removed, and disaster backup switching or self-healing is preferentially selected, so that a set of structured executable rollback opportunity and path control mechanism are formed under the port supply chain service proprietary cloud multi-stage migration scene.
assignees: SHANDONG PORT TECH GROUP QINGDAO CO LTD

title_en: Landslide remote sensing image segmentation method based on multi-mode fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide remote sensing image segmentation method based on multi-modal fusion, and relates to the technical field of remote sensing image analysis and geological disaster monitoring. The method comprises the steps of mapping multi-mode data of a landslide remote sensing image to the same dimension, obtaining respective corresponding token sequences, compressing in a low rank mode, obtaining feature matrixes, sequentially decoupling and dynamically weighting fusion to obtain fusion features, inputting the fusion features into a visual basic model, selecting a plurality of middle layers of the visual basic model to extract scale features, generating sampling fusion features through up-sampling, down-sampling and gating enhancement based on the scale features, inputting the sampling fusion features into BUR, obtaining convolution enhancement features, carrying out convolution, generating an uncertainty diagram, and inputting the uncertainty diagram into a decoder, thus obtaining the landslide remote sensing segmented image. The method effectively solves the problem of isomerism of multi-mode data, generates sampling fusion characteristics with higher spatial accuracy through fusion processing, and realizes accurate segmentation of landslide remote sensing images.

title_en: Side slope displacement prediction method and device based on earthquake induction
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a slope displacement prediction method and device based on earthquake induction, and belongs to the technical field of earthquake induction slope disaster early warning. The corresponding method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of seismic records of a side slope and a plurality of first displacements of the side slope corresponding to the plurality of seismic records, carrying out background grid strain on initial object particles of the side slope according to a preset strain softening constitutive model of the side slope to determine final object particles of the side slope, determining a plurality of second displacements of the side slope under different characterization parameters according to the final object particles, and generating a displacement prediction model according to the plurality of seismic records, the plurality of first displacements and the plurality of second displacements to predict the displacement of the side slope corresponding to the seismic acceleration time course, wherein the displacement prediction model is generated by training the plurality of seismic records, the plurality of first displacements and the plurality of second displacements based on a deep learning algorithm. The invention can reduce uncertainty of earthquake induced soil slope displacement prediction and improve displacement prediction precision.
assignees: YAJIANG CLEAN ENERGY SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH BEIJING CO LTD;UNIV TSINGHUA

title_en: Sampling method for rainfall forecast samples under complex terrain condition of mountain area
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster prevention and reduction, and relates to a sampling method for forecasting rainfall samples under the condition of complex terrains in mountain areas. On the basis of a rainfall probability distribution model, judging a sampling mode adopted by an early warning unit according to a forecast rainfall grade and the position of the early warning unit, wherein the sampling mode comprises tail enhanced sampling and Monte Carlo sampling, the tail enhanced sampling specifically comprises that the layering standard adopted by the early warning unit is judged by combining the forecast rainfall grade of the early warning unit and live rainfall data of the previous day and the position relation between the early warning unit and a major attention area, and corresponding layers are divided according to the layering standard, and the corresponding layers comprise a normal layer and a tail layer. The combination mode of tail reinforcement sampling and common Monte Carlo sampling is adopted, uncertainty and high disaster causing performance of rare events (high-intensity rainfall) at the tail of the rainfall are fully considered, and the problems of common sampling sample concentration and poor coverage are avoided.
assignees: CHINA GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT MONITORING INST GEOLOGICAL DISASTER TECHNOLOGY GUIDANCE CENTER OF MINIS

title_en: Basin risk assessment method and system based on geographic space and Bayesian network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of natural disaster risk assessment and discloses a river basin risk assessment method and system based on a geographic space and a Bayesian network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a digital elevation model diagram of a target river basin, multi-disaster investigation record and simulation research results, and extracting key points; establishing a disaster chain path according to the key points to complete Bayesian network modeling, carrying out node probability modeling and initializing parameters, establishing a disaster chain probability propagation mechanism to describe the sequential transmission process of disasters among nodes, establishing a high-dimensional joint distribution model to carry out forward reasoning propagation of a plurality of Bayesian networks, carrying out uncertainty compression of a disaster reasoning chain, carrying out probability propagation and reasoning, and calculating disaster probability of population loss and economic loss. By utilizing the scheme of the invention, the overall synergy of disaster chain reasoning and the delicacy of risk expression under a complex system can be improved, and the risk assessment capability of the model under the complex chain disaster system is improved.
assignees: CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST;CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST CO LTD;CHINA WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Electric automobile behavior clustering and peak clipping scheduling method based on DQN
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric vehicle behavior clustering and peak clipping scheduling method based on DQN, and belongs to the technical field of electric vehicle and power grid interactive scheduling. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting EV charge and discharge data and power grid operation data, accurately grouping EV users by utilizing MEAN SHIFT and K-means++ combined clustering algorithm to reduce decision dimension, then constructing a dynamic excitation electricity price and user response uncertainty model based on a Logistic function, then establishing a hierarchical optimization model, finally constructing a Markov decision process based on the model, and performing strategy optimization training by adopting DQN to generate a specific scheduling scheme. The method effectively solves the problem of dimension disaster caused by large-scale EV access, achieves the dual goals of obviously reducing peak load of the power grid and optimizing and reducing charging cost of users, and improves the running stability and dispatching economy of the power grid.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER;LUOYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multi-source weather refined prediction method based on physical offset model
abstract_en: A multisource weather refined prediction method based on a physical offset model introduces a double-channel space-time coding, a physical priori guided attention mechanism, a multiscale sliding window input and gating feature fusion strategy into a model framework, and combines the technologies of Bayesian optimization driven super-parameter automatic search, self-adaptive mixed loss function, uncertainty quantization, physical consistency post-processing and the like, thereby remarkably improving modeling capacity and prediction robustness of the model on complex weather processes (especially extreme events). Whether based on simulation testing of analysis data or in verification of a real meteorological observation site, the method shows prediction accuracy, stability and interpretability superior to those of a traditional numerical mode and a single deep learning model. The invention provides reliable technical support for refined weather service, disaster weather early warning and energy scheduling decision, and has important application value and popularization prospect.
assignees: POWERCHINA HENAN ELECTRIC POWER SURVEY & DESIGN INST CO LTD;POWERCHINA CENTRAL CHINA ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING CORPORATION LTD

title_en: Comprehensive energy system toughness improving method considering road network traffic uncertainty
abstract_en: A comprehensive energy system toughness improving method considering road network traffic uncertainty belongs to the technical field of safety planning operation of electric power systems, and comprises the steps of constructing a dual uncertainty model comprising wind power output uncertainty, photovoltaic output uncertainty and traffic road network traffic uncertainty, adopting a two-stage robust optimization method to conduct pre-disaster resource deployment decision-making based on the dual uncertainty model, wherein the resources comprise fixed electricity-hydrogen-storage resources and mobile hydrogen energy resources, and dynamically adjusting scheduling and operation strategies of the mobile hydrogen energy resources by adopting a model prediction control MPC rolling optimization method based on pre-disaster resource deployment decision-making results and system state information acquired in real time in the disaster occurrence process. According to the invention, the fixed and mobile electricity-hydrogen storage resources are cooperatively scheduled, so that the optimal configuration of the pre-disaster hydrogen energy resources and the dynamic response of the mobile hydrogen energy in the disaster are realized, and the survival and recovery capacity of the system under extreme weather events are obviously enhanced.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating risk of strong wind disaster of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution networks, in particular to a method and a system for evaluating the risk of a strong wind disaster of a power distribution network. The method comprises the steps of constructing a data vector of each node at t time by means of meteorological observation of wind resistance parameters, environmental parameters and t time of each node in a power distribution network topology model, constructing a node vulnerability model based on a wind pressure response-failure probability mapping function, acquiring failure probability of each node at t time, acquiring risk propagation weight between each node at t time and adjacent nodes based on electric adjacent strength, inverse proportion function of the geographic coordinates and meteorological consistency of each node and adjacent nodes, and dividing all nodes into a plurality of risk areas by considering consistency, connectivity, boundary complexity and time stability in the areas, and acquiring node level risk assessment results, area level risk assessment results and whole network level risk assessment results at t time. The method and the system effectively improve the evaluation precision of the risk of the wind disaster of the power distribution network.

title_en: Road disaster accurate positioning inspection method for unmanned aerial vehicle AI autonomous cruising
abstract_en: The invention discloses a road disaster accurate positioning and routing inspection method for unmanned aerial vehicle AI autonomous cruise, which belongs to the technical field of space-time image processing and comprises the steps of obtaining dynamic environment parameters and prediction index parameters of an unmanned aerial vehicle, carrying out fusion processing and prediction extraction, generating fusion prediction vectors, adjusting frame rate and regional focusing parameters of image acquisition, obtaining predicted road image data, carrying out predictive preprocessing, generating an optimized prediction image, carrying out space-time fusion feature extraction, generating space-time fusion feature vectors, carrying out prediction disaster identification by utilizing the space-time fusion feature vectors, generating an enhanced disaster probability map, carrying out prediction fusion positioning processing, generating prediction accurate positioning coordinates, updating a cruise path of the unmanned aerial vehicle by combining historical routing inspection data, and generating an optimized prediction cruise path. By combining image acquisition, space-time feature recognition and dynamic cruising path updating driven by fusion prediction, the road disaster can be efficiently, accurately and intelligently subjected to closed loop inspection.

title_en: Transmission tower side slope deformation monitoring method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle corner reflectors
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transmission tower side slope deformation monitoring method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle corner reflectors, which relate to the technical field of remote sensing measurement and side slope disaster monitoring, and comprise that sub-pixel level fine registration of multi-mode images is realized by combining SAR image distance-Doppler model geocoding and optical image strict geometric model orthorectification and SIFT-RANSAC algorithm, so that the fusion precision of SAR and optical data in space is improved, the edge probability map is built by combining a fractional differential image enhancement method with a fractional ant colony algorithm, and an Otsu algorithm is introduced to realize automatic rough positioning of the corner reflector, so that the robustness and positioning efficiency of target extraction are improved, the high-precision inversion and time sequence optimization of three-dimensional geodetic coordinates of the corner reflector are realized by combining sub-pixel contour extraction and least square ellipse fitting with a beam method adjustment model, and the geometric precision of deformation monitoring results is improved.

title_en: Power transmission network toughness improvement and fault recovery method based on adaptive robust optimization
abstract_en: The application provides a transmission grid toughness improvement and fault recovery method based on self-adaptive robust optimization, which comprises the steps of obtaining differential toughness evaluation indexes; and constructing a self-adaptive robust optimization model guided by wind power uncertainty based on the differential toughness evaluation index, and carrying out iterative solution on the self-adaptive robust optimization model to determine a safe and economic scheduling scheme of the power system. According to the method provided by the application, a defending-scheduling collaborative optimization model oriented to budget constraint is established, the system operation cost, the reinforcement cost and the load loss cost are taken as objective functions, a line reinforcement scheme and a post-disaster operation strategy are completed through a C & CG algorithm, and balanced optimization of the toughness and the cost of the power grid is realized.

title_en: Multi-dimensional matrix construction method for disaster monitoring of power transmission corridor
abstract_en: The application provides a method for constructing a multidimensional matrix for monitoring disasters in a power transmission corridor, which relates to the field of disaster monitoring, and comprises the steps of establishing a three-dimensional main coordinate system of a chain pile-cross section-time by taking a central line of a power transmission line as a reference, and constructing a corridor multidimensional coordinate system; mapping a geographic observation point to corridor space coordinates through a space projection mapping relation, performing time resampling and covariance constraint spatial interpolation on multi-source monitoring data to achieve space-time alignment, constructing a fused disaster monitoring matrix, embedding uncertainty dimensions in the matrix, dividing each corridor local unit in the disaster monitoring matrix into a four-quadrant structure, modeling a coupling relation among disaster seeds through a Copula function, embedding map regularization constraint to obtain a multidimensional matrix, slicing the multidimensional matrix embedded with the disaster coupling relation, extracting local risk views, and outputting a risk cube with a confidence interval. The application breaks through the limitation of traditional two-dimensional geography or single disaster monitoring.

title_en: Flood vulnerability identification method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydrology and discloses a method and a system for identifying flood liability, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining flood point data, initially constructing a meteorological factor, a topography factor and an environmental factor data set which influence flood, screening factors which influence flood liability through Spearman rank correlation coefficient, tolerance and variance expansion factor, evaluating flood liability of a research area through an information quantity model to obtain a disaster liability partition map, selecting non-flood points in a low-incidence area and a lower-incidence area to construct a non-flood point data set, constructing a coupling information quantity model and a machine-learned flood liability model by utilizing the flood points and the non-flood point data, constructing a sample set of the non-flood data and the flood data, identifying an optimal flood liability model, and constructing a flood liability model from two angles of uncertainty of model simulation and uncertainty of data according to the invention and research on flood protection of different decision areas.

title_en: Building vulnerability assessment method and system based on AI and GIS
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building vulnerability assessment method and system based on AI and GIS, which comprises the steps of constructing a seismic risk analysis model by acquiring preset building seismic risk data and a geographical space data set of a research area, acquiring building damage indexes and building vulnerability assessment indexes, constructing a vulnerability assessment model, constructing GeoIME ecosystem based on the seismic risk analysis model, the vulnerability assessment model and the LLM model, constructing a GeoIME GPT system, carrying out vulnerability and risk assessment on the building data of the research area according to a GeoIME GPT system to obtain an assessment result, realizing the identification of potential fragile buildings by AI, improving the global disaster resistance, improving the disaster management efficiency by the GeoIME GPT system, realizing the risk assessment automation, enabling a user to trace each analysis step by a transparent reasoning path of GeoIME-GPT, and converting uncertainty from hidden risks to controllable variables.

title_en: Hot melt slump susceptibility assessment method and device based on multispectral and digital elevation model state space network
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geology and geological disaster remote sensing control, and particularly relates to a hot melt collapse susceptibility assessment method and device based on a multispectral and digital elevation model state space network. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining a high-resolution multispectral image of a research area and a digital elevation model constructed by a stereopair, generating a pixel-level label based on an existing hot-melt slump vector list, cutting a training sample on a source domain image in a sliding window mode, constructing a feature extraction trunk based on a state space network, coding multispectral and elevation raster data, expanding local features into a sequence, modeling long-distance space dependency relationship in a state space unit, highlighting spectrum and topography features related to hot-melt slump by using an attention enhancement module, inputting the labeled source domain sample and the unlabeled target domain sample into a shared network at the same time, respectively extracting task related features and domain related features by using a feature decoupling module, introducing correlation alignment loss based on covariance alignment between the domain related features to realize cross-region feature distribution alignment, carrying out sliding window prediction on the whole image of a target area and carrying out weighted fusion on an overlapping region after model training convergence to generate a continuous hot-melt slump probability map. According to the invention, the multisource remote sensing information is utilized, a state space network and a cross-region characteristic alignment mechanism are introduced, and the precision, the space continuity and the cross-region generalization capability of the permafrost region hot melt collapse susceptibility assessment are remarkably improved.
